description.en: Find the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and deliver the Stamped Scroll to Priest Condram at the Altar of Elementor in Darkon 3.
description.ar: Find the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and deliver the Stamped Scroll to Priest Condram at the Altar of Elementor in Darkon 3.
description.br: Por favor, encontre o $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ e entregue o Pergaminho com Selo para a Sacerdotisa Elementor no Altar do Elementor em Darkon 3.
description.cns: 在达肯3海乐伊地区找到黎利香水，再拿去给阴森林的元素使者祭司柯登皮斯。
description.de: Finde das $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ und bringe die gestempelte Schriftrolle zu Priester Condram am Altar of Elementor in Darkon 3.
description.fi: Find the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and deliver the Stamped Scroll to Priest Condram at the Altar of Elementor in Darkon 3.
description.fil: Find the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and deliver the Stamped Scroll to Priest Condram at the Altar of Elementor in Darkon 3.
description.fr: Retrouver le $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ à Heret, dans Darkon 3 et le ramener à Condram, à l'Autel des Elémentaliste de Darkon 3.
description.id: Temukan $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ dan kirimkan Stamped Scroll ke Priest Condram di Altar of Elementor di Darkon 3.
description.it: Find the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and deliver the Stamped Scroll to Priest Condram at the Altar of Elementor in Darkon 3.
description.jp: ダーコン第3地区（ヘルエット）のとこかにある$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$を見つけて、エンシェントツリーの麓にいるエレメンター司祭コンドラム様に会いましょう。
description.kr: 획득한 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, 봉인된 두루마리를 다콘 제3지구의 엘리멘터 제단에 있는 콘드람 사제에게 전달하세요.
description.nl: Find the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and deliver the Stamped Scroll to Priest Condram at the Altar of Elementor in Darkon 3.
description.pl: Znajdź $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ i przekaż Zapieczętowany Zwój Kapłanowi Condram przy Ołtarzu Elementora w Darkon 3.
description.ru: Нужно отыскать благовония Гэндальфи и отнести их жрице Кендре к Алтарю факиров на Даркон-3.
description.sp: Encuentra el $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ y entrega el Pergamino Sellado a la Sacerdotisa Condram en el Altar del Elementor en Darkon 3.
description.sw: Find the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and deliver the Stamped Scroll to Priest Condram at the Altar of Elementor in Darkon 3.
description.th: หา $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ และส่ง Stamped Scroll ไปยัง Priest Condram ที่ Altar of Elementor ใน Darkon 3
description.tw: 找到 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ 並將印章卷軸交給得肯第三區的研術者祭司柯登皮斯。
description.vi: Tìm $ QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME $ và gửi Stamped Scroll cho Priest Condram tại Altar of Elementor trong Darkon 3.

dialogsBegin.en: You'll need to speak with Condram, the Elementor Priest in order to continue your journey. However, fir you'll have to complete another task.
dialogsBegin.ar: You'll need to speak with Condram, the Elementor Priest in order to continue your journey. However, fir you'll have to complete another task.
dialogsBegin.br: Agora por favor visite a sacerdotisa Condram. Ela toma conta do Altar do Elementor em Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.cns: 请你去找达肯3的元素使者祭坛找祭司【柯登皮斯】！
dialogsBegin.de: Besuche nun Priesterin Condram. Sie verwaltet den Altar des Elementor in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.fi: You'll need to speak with Condram, the Elementor Priest in order to continue your journey. However, fir you'll have to complete another task.
dialogsBegin.fil: You'll need to speak with Condram, the Elementor Priest in order to continue your journey. However, fir you'll have to complete another task.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu approches de ton but. et la fin de ton apprentissage se passera à Darkon 3 ! Là-bas, tu trouveras l'Autel où siège Condram, la Doyenne des Elémentalistes.
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu harus berbicara dengan Condram, Elementor Priest untuk melanjutkan perjalananmu. Namun, pertama Kamu harus menyelesaikan tugas lain.
dialogsBegin.it: You'll need to speak with Condram, the Elementor Priest in order to continue your journey. However, fir you'll have to complete another task.
dialogsBegin.jp: じゃぁ、これから司祭に会ってください。司祭コンドラム様はダーコン第3地区地域にあるエレメンター祭壇を管理しています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 여정을 계속 이어가시려면, 엘리멘터 사제 콘드람님을 만나보시는 게 좋겠어요. 하지만 그 전에 다른 임무를 완료해야 해요.
dialogsBegin.nl: You'll need to speak with Condram, the Elementor Priest in order to continue your journey. However, fir you'll have to complete another task.
dialogsBegin.pl: You'll need to speak with Condram, the Elementor Priest in order to continue your journey. However, fir you'll have to complete another task.
dialogsBegin.ru: А теперь отправляйся к жрице факиров Кендре. Но не с пустыми руками.
dialogsBegin.sp: Tendrás que hablar con Condram, la Sacerdotisa Elementor para continuar tu viaje. Pero, primero tendrás que completar otra tarea.
dialogsBegin.sw: You'll need to speak with Condram, the Elementor Priest in order to continue your journey. However, fir you'll have to complete another task.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณต้องพูดคุยกับ Condram Elementor Priest เพื่อเดินทางต่อไป อย่างไรก็ตาม คุณต้องทำภารกิจอื่นให้เสร็จสิ้นก่อน
dialogsBegin.tw: 若要繼續旅程，你必須與研術者祭司柯登皮斯交談。不過在那之前，你還得完成另一項任務。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn sẽ cần nói chuyện với Condram, Elementor Priest để tiếp tục cuộc hành trình của mình. Tuy nhiên, bạn sẽ cần phải hoàn thành một nhiệm vụ khác.

dialogsBegin.en: Elementor Priest Condram is looking for something very important. It is the Perfume of Lillip, which is rumored to be somewhere in Heret, in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.ar: Elementor Priest Condram is looking for something very important. It is the Perfume of Lillip, which is rumored to be somewhere in Heret, in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.br: A Sacerdotisa Condram Elementor está procurando por algo muito importante. É o Perfume de Lillip, que está em algum lugar em Heret, em Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.cns: 听说柯登皮斯在那徘徊不去，他在寻找得莉莉普的香水！
dialogsBegin.de: Elementor-Priesterin Condram ist auf der Suche nach etwas sehr Wichtigem. Es ist das Parfüm von Lillip, von dem es heißt, dass es sich irgendwo in Heret in Darkon 3 befindet.
dialogsBegin.fi: Elementor Priest Condram is looking for something very important. It is the Perfume of Lillip, which is rumored to be somewhere in Heret, in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.fil: Elementor Priest Condram is looking for something very important. It is the Perfume of Lillip, which is rumored to be somewhere in Heret, in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais avant cela. Il y a une mission que tu dois accomplir. Condram est à la recherche du Parfum de Lillip, perdu après la Grande Guerre.
dialogsBegin.id: Elementor Priest Condram sedang mencari sesuatu yang sangat penting. Ini adalah Parfum Lillip, yang dikabarkan ada di suatu tempat di Heret, di Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.it: Elementor Priest Condram is looking for something very important. It is the Perfume of Lillip, which is rumored to be somewhere in Heret, in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.jp: コンドラム様は以前から悩んでいたそうです。ダーコン第3地区（ヘルエット）のとこかにあると言われているリルリップの香水をずっと探してるんです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 엘리멘터 사제 콘드람님이 매우 중요한 것을 찾고 있어요. 릴립의 향수라는 건데, 다콘 제3지구의 헤르엣 어딘가에 있다고 전해지죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: Elementor Priest Condram is looking for something very important. It is the Perfume of Lillip, which is rumored to be somewhere in Heret, in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.pl: Elementor Priest Condram is looking for something very important. It is the Perfume of Lillip, which is rumored to be somewhere in Heret, in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.ru: Кендра давно уже ищет одну из реликвий Гэндальфи - флакон с благовониями. Говорят, он где-то в Арквуде, на Дарконе-3.
dialogsBegin.sp: La Sacerdotisa Elementor Condram está buscando algo muy importante. Es el Perfume de Lillip, que se rumorea que está en algún lugar de Heret, en Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.sw: Elementor Priest Condram is looking for something very important. It is the Perfume of Lillip, which is rumored to be somewhere in Heret, in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.th: Elementor Priest Condram กำลังมองหาบางสิ่งที่สำคัญมาก มันเป็นน้ำหอมของ Lillip ซึ่งมีข่าวลือว่าจะอยู่ที่ไหนสักแห่งใน Heret ใน Darkon 3
dialogsBegin.tw: 聽說柯登皮斯正在尋找很重要的東西，就是據說位於得肯第三區赫瑞特幽林的黎利香水！
dialogsBegin.vi: Elementor Priest Condram đang tìm kiếm một thứ rất quan trọng. Đó là Perfume of Lillip, được đồn đại là ở đâu đó trong Heret, trong Darkon 3.

dialogsAccept.en: Good luck to you, Magician!
dialogsAccept.ar: Good luck to you, Magician!
dialogsAccept.br: Que a sorte lhe acompanhe, Mago(a)!
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你好运，魔导士！
dialogsAccept.de: Viel Glück für dich, Magier!
dialogsAccept.fi: Good luck to you, Magician!
dialogsAccept.fil: Good luck to you, Magician!
dialogsAccept.fr: On raconte qu'elle aurait été volée par une dénommée Kynsy, qui utiliserait actuellement les pouvoirs de la relique. Kynsy serait à Darkon 1, dans la zone de l'Usine des Erons.
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga sukses, Penyihir!
dialogsAccept.it: Good luck to you, Magician!
dialogsAccept.jp: では、お待ちします。
dialogsAccept.kr: 행운을 빌어요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Good luck to you, Magician!
dialogsAccept.pl: Good luck to you, Magician!
dialogsAccept.ru: Good luck to you, Magician!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Buena suerte, Magician!
dialogsAccept.sw: Good luck to you, Magician!
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้โชคดี Magician!
dialogsAccept.tw: 祝你好運，魔法使！
dialogsAccept.vi: Chúc bạn may mắn, Magician!

dialogsDecline.en: You… won't? Why not? It would be a shame to let someone as gifted as you simply give up. Speak to me again when you're ready.
dialogsDecline.ar: You… won't? Why not? It would be a shame to let someone as gifted as you simply give up. Speak to me again when you're ready.
dialogsDecline.br: Você... não vai? Por que não? Seria uma pena deixar alguém tão talentoso como você simplesmente desistir. Fale comigo novamente quando estiver pronto.
dialogsDecline.cns: 这是只有你才可以帮的忙~拜托你~帮我找回来好吗？
dialogsDecline.de: Du... willst nicht? Warum nicht? Es wäre eine Schande, wenn jemand talentiertes wie du einfach aufgeben würde. Sprich erneut mit mir wenn du bereit bist.
dialogsDecline.fi: You… won't? Why not? It would be a shame to let someone as gifted as you simply give up. Speak to me again when you're ready.
dialogsDecline.fil: You… won't? Why not? It would be a shame to let someone as gifted as you simply give up. Speak to me again when you're ready.
dialogsDecline.fr: Il est primordial de retrouver cette relique perdue. Nous comptons vraiment sur toi pour cette tâche.
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu ... tidak akan? Kenapa tidak? Sayang sekali jika seseorang yang berbakat seperti kamu menyerah begitu saja. Bicaralah padaku lagi saat kau siap.
dialogsDecline.it: You… won't? Why not? It would be a shame to let someone as gifted as you simply give up. Speak to me again when you're ready.
dialogsDecline.jp: これは本当に重要なことです。コンドラム様のために助けてください。あなたならきっとできるはずです。最高の後継者様、お願いします。
dialogsDecline.kr: 어... 싫다고요? 당신처럼 재능 있는 분이 포기한다니 아쉽네요. 준비되면 다시 말씀해 주세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: You… won't? Why not? It would be a shame to let someone as gifted as you simply give up. Speak to me again when you're ready.
dialogsDecline.pl: You… won't? Why not? It would be a shame to let someone as gifted as you simply give up. Speak to me again when you're ready.
dialogsDecline.ru: You… won't? Why not? It would be a shame to let someone as gifted as you simply give up. Speak to me again when you're ready.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Tú... no lo harás? ¿Por qué no? Sería una pena dejar que alguien tan dotado como tú se rindiera ahora. Háblame de nuevo si cambias de opinión.
dialogsDecline.sw: You… won't? Why not? It would be a shame to let someone as gifted as you simply give up. Speak to me again when you're ready.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณ... จะไม่? ทำไมล่ะ? น่าอับอายที่จะให้ใครบางคนมีพรสวรรค์ในขณะที่คุณยอมแพ้ พูดกับฉันอีกครั้งเมื่อคุณพร้อม
dialogsDecline.tw: 這是只有你才可以幫的忙~拜託妳~幫我找回來好嗎？
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn… sẽ không ư? Tại sao không? Thật tiếc nếu để một người tài năng như bạn bỏ cuộc. Nói chuyện với tôi một lần nữa khi bạn đã sẵn sàng.

dialogsComplete.en: Ah yes, the Perfume of Lillip. I have been looking for this for a very long time.
dialogsComplete.ar: Ah yes, the Perfume of Lillip. I have been looking for this for a very long time.
dialogsComplete.br: Oh, muito obrigada! Agora posso fazer o meu melhor como sacerdotisa!
dialogsComplete.cns: 谢谢你，找回这东西，我才能对其他人交代！
dialogsComplete.de: Oh, vielen Dank. Nun kann ich mein Bestes geben als Priesterin!
dialogsComplete.fi: Ah yes, the Perfume of Lillip. I have been looking for this for a very long time.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ah yes, the Perfume of Lillip. I have been looking for this for a very long time.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tu as retrouvé le Parfum de Lillip ! Cette relique était introuvable depuis la Grande Guerre.
dialogsComplete.id: Ah ya, Parfum Lilip. Saya telah mencari ini untuk waktu yang sangat lama.
dialogsComplete.it: Ah yes, the Perfume of Lillip. I have been looking for this for a very long time.
dialogsComplete.jp: あ、ありがとう！ボクが司祭として赴任する前からずっと失われていたものが、やっと見つけられました。助かったよ！
dialogsComplete.kr: 아, 릴립의 향수. 제가 정말 오랫동안 찾고 있던 거랍니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Ah yes, the Perfume of Lillip. I have been looking for this for a very long time.
dialogsComplete.pl: Ah yes, the Perfume of Lillip. I have been looking for this for a very long time.
dialogsComplete.ru: А, благовония Гэндальфи! Я давно их ищу.
dialogsComplete.sp: Ah, sí. El Perfume de Lillip. Lo he estado buscando durante mucho tiempo.
dialogsComplete.sw: Ah yes, the Perfume of Lillip. I have been looking for this for a very long time.
dialogsComplete.th: อ่าใช่ น้ำหอมของ Lillip ฉันกำลังมองหาสิ่งนี้มาเป็นเวลานานมาก
dialogsComplete.tw: 謝謝你，找回這東西，我才能對其他人交代！
dialogsComplete.vi: À vâng, Perfume of Lillip. Tôi đã tìm kiếm thứ này trong một thời gian rất dài.

dialogsComplete.en: Thank you very much, Magician. Now the relics of the Elementor Hero are safe.
dialogsComplete.ar: Thank you very much, Magician. Now the relics of the Elementor Hero are safe.
dialogsComplete.br: Obrigada. Obrigada, jovem. Agora as relíquias do Herói Elementor estão seguras.
dialogsComplete.cns: 总之~谢谢你啦！
dialogsComplete.de: Vielen Dank. Vielen Dank.
dialogsComplete.fi: Thank you very much, Magician. Now the relics of the Elementor Hero are safe.
dialogsComplete.fil: Thank you very much, Magician. Now the relics of the Elementor Hero are safe.
dialogsComplete.fr: Merci infiniment ! Désormais cette relique se trouve là où elle aurait toujours dû être.
dialogsComplete.id: Terima kasih banyak, Penyihir. Sekarang peninggalan dari Elementor Hero aman.
dialogsComplete.it: Thank you very much, Magician. Now the relics of the Elementor Hero are safe.
dialogsComplete.jp: ありがとうございます。
dialogsComplete.kr: 정말 고맙습니다. 이제 엘리멘터 영웅의 성물은 안전합니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Thank you very much, Magician. Now the relics of the Elementor Hero are safe.
dialogsComplete.pl: Thank you very much, Magician. Now the relics of the Elementor Hero are safe.
dialogsComplete.ru: Большое спасибо, фокусник. Теперь реликвия героя факиров в надежных руках.
dialogsComplete.sp: Muchas gracias, Magician. Ahora las reliquias de la Héroe Elementor están a salvo.
dialogsComplete.sw: Thank you very much, Magician. Now the relics of the Elementor Hero are safe.
dialogsComplete.th: ขอบคุณมาก Magician ตอนนี้เรลิคของ Elementor Hero ก็ปลอดภัยแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 非常感謝你，魔法師。研術者英雄的遺物現在安全了。
dialogsComplete.vi: Cảm ơn Magician rất nhiều. Bây giờ di vật của Elementor Hero đã an toàn.

dialogsFail.en: This is the altar where we protect the Souls of the Heroes. What can I do for you, my friend?
dialogsFail.ar: This is the altar where we protect the Souls of the Heroes. What can I do for you, my friend?
dialogsFail.br: Este é o altar onde protegemos as almas dos heróis. O que posso fazer por você?
dialogsFail.cns: 这里是守护黎利灵魂的祭坛，你来这里有什么事情呢？
dialogsFail.de: Dies ist der Altar an dem die Seelen der Helden beschützt werden. Was kann ich für dich tun?
dialogsFail.fi: This is the altar where we protect the Souls of the Heroes. What can I do for you, my friend?
dialogsFail.fil: This is the altar where we protect the Souls of the Heroes. What can I do for you, my friend?
dialogsFail.fr: En ce lieu nous protégeons les âmes des Héros. Mais quelle est la raison de ta venue ?
dialogsFail.id: Ini adalah altar tempat kami melindungi Jiwa Pahlawan. Apa yang bisa saya lakukan untukmu, temanku?
dialogsFail.it: This is the altar where we protect the Souls of the Heroes. What can I do for you, my friend?
dialogsFail.jp: ここは英雄たちの魂を守る祭壇です。何か用かい？
dialogsFail.kr: 이곳은 영웅들의 영혼이 잠들어 있는 제단입니다. 무슨 일로 찾아오셨지요?
dialogsFail.nl: This is the altar where we protect the Souls of the Heroes. What can I do for you, my friend?
dialogsFail.pl: This is the altar where we protect the Souls of the Heroes. What can I do for you, my friend?
dialogsFail.ru: Это алтарь, защищающий души героев. Что привело тебя сюда?

dialogsBegin.en: Here it is. The key has been reforged just as planned. Quickly now, go and defeat the Red Meteonyker before it's too late! You must fight through the hoard of undead guardians. Good luck.
dialogsBegin.ar: Here it is. The key has been reforged just as planned. Quickly now, go and defeat the Red Meteonyker before it's too late! You must fight through the hoard of undead guardians. Good luck.
dialogsBegin.br: Aqui está. A chave foi forjada exatamente como planejado. Agora rápido, vá e derrote o Meteonyker Vermelho antes que seja tarde demais! Você deve lutar contra a horda de guardiões mortos-vivos. Boa sorte.
dialogsBegin.cns: 钥匙已按计划重铸。现在，快点！赶在为时已晚之前打败红龙！祝你好运。
dialogsBegin.de: Hier. Der Schlüssel wurde wie geplant neu geschmiedet. Schnell jetzt, besiege den Red Meteonyker bevor es zu spät ist! Du musst dich durch die untoten Beschützer durchkämpfen. Viel Glück!
dialogsBegin.fi: Here it is. The key has been reforged just as planned. Quickly now, go and defeat the Red Meteonyker before it's too late! You must fight through the hoard of undead guardians. Good luck.
dialogsBegin.fil: Here it is. The key has been reforged just as planned. Quickly now, go and defeat the Red Meteonyker before it's too late! You must fight through the hoard of undead guardians. Good luck.
dialogsBegin.fr: Voilà. La clé a été reconstituée, comme prévue. Vite, va maintenant combattre le Meteonyker Rouge avant qu'il ne soit trop tard ! Tu dois traverser les armées de gardiens mort-vivants. Bonne chance.
dialogsBegin.id: Ini dia. Kuncinya telah ditempa ulang seperti yang direncanakan. Cepat sekarang, pergi dan kalahkan Red Meteonyker sebelum terlambat! Kamu harus berjuang melalui timbunan penjaga mayat hidup. Semoga beruntung.
dialogsBegin.it: Here it is. The key has been reforged just as planned. Quickly now, go and defeat the Red Meteonyker before it's too late! You must fight through the hoard of undead guardians. Good luck.
dialogsBegin.jp: カギならここにあります。キーは計画通りに繋ぎ合わせてやったぞ。手遅れになる前にレッドメテオニカを倒しに行ってきてくれ。その前にアンデッドガーディアンの群れと戦わないといけんがな。生きて帰ってこいよ
dialogsBegin.kr: 짜잔. 계획대로 열쇠를 제련했어요. 서둘러요! 늦기 전에 어서 빨강 메테오니커를 처치해 주세요! 언데드 가디언들의 무리와도 싸워야 해요. 행운을 빌어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Here it is. The key has been reforged just as planned. Quickly now, go and defeat the Red Meteonyker before it's too late! You must fight through the hoard of undead guardians. Good luck.
dialogsBegin.pl: Here it is. The key has been reforged just as planned. Quickly now, go and defeat the Red Meteonyker before it's too late! You must fight through the hoard of undead guardians. Good luck.
dialogsBegin.ru: Here it is. The key has been reforged just as planned. Quickly now, go and defeat the Red Meteonyker before it's too late! You must fight through the hoard of undead guardians. Good luck.
dialogsBegin.sp: Aquí está. La llave está reforjada. ¡Rápido, ve y derrota al Meteonyker Rojo antes de que sea demasiado tarde! Debes luchar atravesando la horda de guardianes no-muertos. Buena suerte.
dialogsBegin.sw: Here it is. The key has been reforged just as planned. Quickly now, go and defeat the Red Meteonyker before it's too late! You must fight through the hoard of undead guardians. Good luck.
dialogsBegin.th: นี่มัน กุญแจถูกหลอมใหม่ตามแผนที่วางไว้ เร็วเข้า ไปปราบ Red Meteonyker ก่อนที่มันจะสายเกินไป! คุณต้องต่อสู้ผ่านกลุ่มผู้พิทักษ์ที่ยังมีชีวิตอยู่ ขอให้โชคดี
dialogsBegin.tw: 拿去吧，鑰匙已按計畫重新鑄造完成。快去，在為時已晚之前擊敗炙焰飛龍！你必須一路殺出不死守衛的包圍。祝你好運。
dialogsBegin.vi: Nó đây. Chìa khóa đã được rèn đúng kế hoạch. Nhanh lên, đi và đánh bại Red Meteonyker trước khi quá muộn! Bạn phải chiến đấu thông qua chỗ cất giấu những undead guardians. Chúc may mắn.

dialogsComplete.en: I can't believe it. You achieved the impossible.
dialogsComplete.ar: I can't believe it. You achieved the impossible.
dialogsComplete.br: Eu não posso acreditar. Você conseguiu o impossível.
dialogsComplete.cns: 我不敢相信。你实现了不可能。
dialogsComplete.de: Ich kann es nicht glauben. Du hast das Unmögliche geschafft.
dialogsComplete.fi: I can't believe it. You achieved the impossible.
dialogsComplete.fil: I can't believe it. You achieved the impossible.
dialogsComplete.fr: Je n'y crois pas. Tu as réalisé l'impossible.
dialogsComplete.id: Aku tidak percaya. Kamu mencapai hal yang mustahil.
dialogsComplete.it: I can't believe it. You achieved the impossible.
dialogsComplete.jp: なんてこった。不可能を可能にするとはこのことか。
dialogsComplete.kr: 믿을 수가 없네요. 불가능한 일을 해내셨어요.
dialogsComplete.nl: I can't believe it. You achieved the impossible.
dialogsComplete.pl: I can't believe it. You achieved the impossible.
dialogsComplete.ru: I can't believe it. You achieved the impossible.
dialogsComplete.sp: No puedo creerlo. Has conseguido lo imposible.
dialogsComplete.sw: I can't believe it. You achieved the impossible.
dialogsComplete.th: ฉันไม่อยากเชื่อเลย คุณประสบความสำเร็จในสิ่งที่เป็นไปไม่ได้
dialogsComplete.tw: 我不敢相信。你完成了不可能。
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi không thể tin được. Bạn đã làm được điều không tưởng.

dialogsComplete.en: I would say your victory calls for a celebration, but the armies of Shade are still here. There is a lot left to do in this forsaken place.
dialogsComplete.ar: I would say your victory calls for a celebration, but the armies of Shade are still here. There is a lot left to do in this forsaken place.
dialogsComplete.br: Eu diria que sua vitória exige uma comemoração, mas os exércitos de Shade ainda estão aqui. Há muito o que fazer neste lugar abandonado.
dialogsComplete.cns: 你的胜利值得庆祝，但谢莉德的军队仍然在这里。在这个被遗弃的地方还有很多事情要做。
dialogsComplete.de: Dein Sieg sollte gefeiert werden, aber die Armeen von Shade sind immer noch hier. Es gibt an diesem verfluchten Ort noch einen Haufen zu tun.
dialogsComplete.fi: I would say your victory calls for a celebration, but the armies of Shade are still here. There is a lot left to do in this forsaken place.
dialogsComplete.fil: I would say your victory calls for a celebration, but the armies of Shade are still here. There is a lot left to do in this forsaken place.
dialogsComplete.fr: J'aimerais dire que nous devrions célébrer ta victoire, mais les armées de Shade sont toujours ici. Il y a encore beaucoup à faire dans cet endroit abandonnée.
dialogsComplete.id: Aku akan mengatakan kemenanganmu membutuhkan perayaan, tetapi pasukan Shade masih di sini. Masih banyak yang harus dilakukan di tempat yang ditinggalkan ini.
dialogsComplete.it: I would say your victory calls for a celebration, but the armies of Shade are still here. There is a lot left to do in this forsaken place.
dialogsComplete.jp: あなたの勝利は祝賀に値すると言えるだろう。しかし、シェイドが創ったやつらはまだいるはずだ。この見捨てられた地にも、まだまだやることがたくさん残っている。
dialogsComplete.kr: 승리는 축하할 일이지만, 쉐이드의 군대가 아직도 여기 있어요. 이 버려진 곳에서 해야 할 일이 정말 많다고요.
dialogsComplete.nl: I would say your victory calls for a celebration, but the armies of Shade are still here. There is a lot left to do in this forsaken place.
dialogsComplete.pl: I would say your victory calls for a celebration, but the armies of Shade are still here. There is a lot left to do in this forsaken place.
dialogsComplete.ru: I would say your victory calls for a celebration, but the armies of Shade are still here. There is a lot left to do in this forsaken place.
dialogsComplete.sp: Tu victoria merece una celebración, pero los ejércitos de Shade siguen aquí. Queda mucho por hacer en este lugar abandonado.
dialogsComplete.sw: I would say your victory calls for a celebration, but the armies of Shade are still here. There is a lot left to do in this forsaken place.
dialogsComplete.th: ฉันจะบอกว่าชัยชนะของคุณเรียกร้องให้มีการเฉลิมฉลอง แต่กองทัพของ Shade ยังคงอยู่ที่นี่ ยังมีอะไรให้ทำอีกมากในที่ร้างแห่งนี้
dialogsComplete.tw: 我會說你的勝利需要慶祝，但闇影的軍隊仍然在這裡。在這個被遺棄的地方還有很多事情要做。
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi muốn nói rằng chiến thắng của bạn cần phải có một buổi lễ kỉ niệm, nhưng đội quân của Shade vẫn ở đây. Còn rất nhiều việc phải làm ở nơi bị bỏ hoang này.

dialogsComplete.en: You are a lot more powerful than I thought you were. I am sure the other guardians are proud of your victory. I know I am. Thank you.
dialogsComplete.ar: You are a lot more powerful than I thought you were. I am sure the other guardians are proud of your victory. I know I am. Thank you.
dialogsComplete.br: Você é muito mais poderoso do que eu pensava. Tenho certeza de que os outros guardiões estão orgulhosos de sua vitória. Eu sei que eu estou. Obrigado.
dialogsComplete.cns: 你比我想象的要强大得多。我相信其他守护者会为你的胜利感到自豪，谢谢你。
dialogsComplete.de: Du bist viel mächtiger, als ich dachte. Ich bin sicher, die anderen Beschützer sind stolz auf deinen Sieg. Ich bin es auf jeden Fall. Vielen Dank.
dialogsComplete.fi: You are a lot more powerful than I thought you were. I am sure the other guardians are proud of your victory. I know I am. Thank you.
dialogsComplete.fil: You are a lot more powerful than I thought you were. I am sure the other guardians are proud of your victory. I know I am. Thank you.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tu es beaucoup plus puissant que je ne l'imaginais. Je suis sûr que les autres gardiens sont fiers de toi. Je le suis. Merci.
dialogsComplete.id: Kamu jauh lebih kuat dari yang aku kira. Aku yakin para guardian lainnya juga bangga dengan kemenanganmu. Terima kasih.
dialogsComplete.it: You are a lot more powerful than I thought you were. I am sure the other guardians are proud of your victory. I know I am. Thank you.
dialogsComplete.jp: 思っていたよりずっと強いんだな。他の守護者も勝利を誇りに思っているに違いない。心から感謝する。ありがとう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 용사님은 제가 생각한 것보다도 훨씬 강하시네요. 다른 가디언들도 용사님의 승리에 자랑스러워하실 거예요. 당연히 저도 그렇고요. 감사해요.
dialogsComplete.nl: You are a lot more powerful than I thought you were. I am sure the other guardians are proud of your victory. I know I am. Thank you.
dialogsComplete.pl: You are a lot more powerful than I thought you were. I am sure the other guardians are proud of your victory. I know I am. Thank you.
dialogsComplete.ru: You are a lot more powerful than I thought you were. I am sure the other guardians are proud of your victory. I know I am. Thank you.
dialogsComplete.sp: Eres mucho más poderoso de lo que pensé. Estoy orgulloso de ti y seguro de que los otros guardianes también lo están. Muchas gracias.
dialogsComplete.sw: You are a lot more powerful than I thought you were. I am sure the other guardians are proud of your victory. I know I am. Thank you.
dialogsComplete.th: คุณมีพลังมากกว่าที่ฉันคิดไว้มาก ฉันแน่ใจว่าผู้พิทักษ์คนอื่นๆ ภูมิใจในชัยชนะของคุณ ฉันรู้ว่าฉันเป็นใคร ขอขอบคุณ
dialogsComplete.tw: 你比我想像的要強大得多。我相信其他守護者為你的勝利感到自豪。我知道我是。謝謝你。
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn mạnh mẽ hơn tôi tưởng rất nhiều. Tôi chắc chắn rằng những guardians khác tự hào về chiến thắng của bạn. Cảm ơn bạn.
