description.ar: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Venel Heart to Wendien, the Elementor Guardian in Guardiane.
description.br: Derrote o espírito, Guardião Venel, e obtenha seu coração. Visite então Wendien, a Guardiã Elementor.
description.cns: 去圣堂的守护之室打倒守护兽贝纳卡度温，取得他的心脏，再去找元素使者守护使者文嫡凌！
description.de: Besiege den Wächtergeist, Venel Guardian und nimm sein Herz. Dann besuche Wendien, den Elementor Wächter.
description.fi: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Venel Heart to Wendien, the Elementor Guardian in Guardiane.
description.fil: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Venel Heart to Wendien, the Elementor Guardian in Guardiane.
description.fr: Vaincre Venel et ramener son cœur à la Gardienne des Élémentalistes, Wendien.
description.id: Kalahkan Venel Guardian, dan berikan Venel Heart ke Wendien, Elementor Guardian di Guardiane.
description.it: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Venel Heart to Wendien, the Elementor Guardian in Guardiane.
description.jp: ガルディアの守護者の部屋にいる守護精霊＜ヴェネル・ガーディアン＞のハートを手に入れ、エレメンター守護者ウェンディに会おう。
description.kr: 베넬가디언을 처치하고, 베넬의 심장을 가르디안의 엘리멘터 수호자 웬디엔에게 전달하세요.
description.nl: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Venel Heart to Wendien, the Elementor Guardian in Guardiane.
description.pl: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Venel Heart to Wendien, the Elementor Guardian in Guardiane.
description.ru: Нужно победить Виндигго и принести его сердце Венди, хранительнице факиров.
description.sp: Derrota al Guardián Venel y entrega el Corazón de Venel a Wendien, la Guardiana Elementor en Guardiane.
description.sw: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Venel Heart to Wendien, the Elementor Guardian in Guardiane.
description.th: กำจัด Venel Guardian และส่ง Venel Heart ไปให้ Wendien Elementor Guardian ใน Guardiane
description.tw: 去守護者祭壇的守護者之室打倒守護獸貝納卡度溫，取得他的心臟，再去找研術者守護者文嫡凌！
description.vi: Đánh bại Venel Guardian, và giao Venel Heart cho Wendien, Elementor Guardian ở Guardiane.

dialogsBegin.en: This is the Symbol of the Hero. There is only one more task to complete before you can be named a Successor of the Elementor Hero.
dialogsBegin.ar: This is the Symbol of the Hero. There is only one more task to complete before you can be named a Successor of the Elementor Hero.
dialogsBegin.br: Aqui está o símbolo do herói. Você precisará de mais um comprovante para ser reconhecido como um sucessor do herói.
dialogsBegin.cns: 这标志能证明你是英雄守护使者的继承者，不过还需要另一个证明……
dialogsBegin.de: Hier ist das Symbol der Helden. Du benötigst einen weiteren Beleg um als Nachfolger des Helden anerkannt zu werden.
dialogsBegin.fi: This is the Symbol of the Hero. There is only one more task to complete before you can be named a Successor of the Elementor Hero.
dialogsBegin.fil: This is the Symbol of the Hero. There is only one more task to complete before you can be named a Successor of the Elementor Hero.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je peux maintenant te confier le Sceau des Héros, qui confirme que tu as relevé avec succès tous les défis qui se sont présentés. Mais il te faut encore réussir l'épreuve finale.
dialogsBegin.id: Ini adalah Simbol Pahlawan. Hanya ada satu tugas lagi yang harus diselesaikan sebelum kamu dapat dinobatkan sebagai Penerus Elementor Hero.
dialogsBegin.it: This is the Symbol of the Hero. There is only one more task to complete before you can be named a Successor of the Elementor Hero.
dialogsBegin.jp: じゃあ、これが英雄の証だよ。実は、このほかにもうひとつ証が必要なんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이거야말로 영웅의 증표죠. 엘리멘터 영웅의 후계자가 되려면, 마지막 임무가 하나 더 남았습니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: This is the Symbol of the Hero. There is only one more task to complete before you can be named a Successor of the Elementor Hero.
dialogsBegin.pl: This is the Symbol of the Hero. There is only one more task to complete before you can be named a Successor of the Elementor Hero.
dialogsBegin.ru: Это Знак героя. Он означает, что его владелец является истинным наследником героя-факира.
dialogsBegin.sp: Este es el Símbolo del Héroe. Tienes que completar una tarea más para ser reconocido como Sucesor de la Héroe Elementor.
dialogsBegin.sw: This is the Symbol of the Hero. There is only one more task to complete before you can be named a Successor of the Elementor Hero.
dialogsBegin.th: นี่คือสัญลักษณ์ของฮีโร่ มีเพียงอีกหนึ่งงานที่ต้องทำ ก่อนที่คุณจะสามารถได้ชื่อว่าทายาทของ Elementor Hero
dialogsBegin.tw: 這標誌能證明你是英雄守護者的繼承者，不過還需要另一個證明……
dialogsBegin.vi: Đây là Biểu tượng của Anh hùng. Chỉ còn một nhiệm vụ nữa cần hoàn thành trước khi bạn có thể được phong là Người kế vị Elementor Hero.

dialogsBegin.en: There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You'll find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of the Heroes is protected.
dialogsBegin.ar: There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You'll find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of the Heroes is protected.
dialogsBegin.br: Há um local chamado de A Sala do Guardião. Você a encontrará em Guardiane. Nesse local, a vontade dos heróis está sendo protegida.
dialogsBegin.cns: 有一个地方叫守卫之室，在圣堂附近。去击败那个灵魂吧
dialogsBegin.de: Es gibt einen Ort mit dem Namen "Raum des Wächters". Du findest ihn in Guardiane. Dort wird der Wille der Helden geschützt.
dialogsBegin.fi: There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You'll find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of the Heroes is protected.
dialogsBegin.fil: There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You'll find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of the Heroes is protected.
dialogsBegin.fr: Au sud de Darkon 3, à Gardiane, se trouve un lieu appelé la Chambre du Gardien.
dialogsBegin.id: Ada tempat yang disebut Kamar Penjaga. Kamu akan menemukannya di Guardiane. Di sana, Kehendak Pahlawan dilindungi.
dialogsBegin.it: There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You'll find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of the Heroes is protected.
dialogsBegin.jp: ガルディアの守護者の部屋には英雄たちの紋章があって、そこには英雄たちの意志が保存されているんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 가르디안에는 수호자의 방이 있어요. 영웅들의 의지를 보존하고 있는 곳이죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You'll find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of the Heroes is protected.
dialogsBegin.pl: There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You'll find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of the Heroes is protected.
dialogsBegin.ru: Твоя судьба скоро решится. Но не здесь, а в Гардиане. Там, в Зале хранителей, ты найдешь великого духа - Виндигго. Он стережет волю героев.
dialogsBegin.sp: Hay un lugar llamado la Habitación del Guardián. Lo encontrarás en Guardiane. Allí se protege la Voluntad de los Héroes.
dialogsBegin.sw: There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You'll find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of the Heroes is protected.
dialogsBegin.th: มีสถานที่ที่เรียกว่า Room of the Guardian คุณจะพบได้ใน Guardiane ที่นั่นวีรบุรุษจะได้รับการคุ้มครอง
dialogsBegin.tw: 有個地方叫做守護者之室，你會在守護者祭壇找到它。那裡保存著英雄的意志。
dialogsBegin.vi: Có một nơi được gọi là Room of the Guardian. Bạn sẽ tìm thấy nó trong Guardiane. Ở đó, Ý chí của các Anh hùng được bảo vệ.

dialogsBegin.en: You must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, who resides there, and retrieve his heart.
dialogsBegin.ar: You must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, who resides there, and retrieve his heart.
dialogsBegin.br: Você deve confrontar o $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, que está lá, e recuperar seu coração.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你必须打败驻守在那的$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$，并且夺取他的心脏。
dialogsBegin.de: Du musst dich dem $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ stellen, der sich dort aufhält, und sein Herz zurückholen.
dialogsBegin.fi: You must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, who resides there, and retrieve his heart.
dialogsBegin.fil: You must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, who resides there, and retrieve his heart.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il te faut y pénétrer et vaincre $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$. Ta dernière épreuve sera de lui prendre son cœur !
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu harus menghadapi $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, yang tinggal di sana, dan mengambil jantungnya.
dialogsBegin.it: You must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, who resides there, and retrieve his heart.
dialogsBegin.jp: この守護者の部屋にいる $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を倒して、ヴェネル・ハートを取らなきゃいけないんだ。そしてそのハートが最後の証なのさ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그곳을 지키고 있는 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 몬스터를 처치하고, 심장을 손에 넣으세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: You must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, who resides there, and retrieve his heart.
dialogsBegin.pl: You must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, who resides there, and retrieve his heart.
dialogsBegin.ru: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$. Победи его и забери его сердце. Это станет твоим последним испытанием.
dialogsBegin.sp: Debes enfrentarte al $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, que reside allí, y conseguir su corazón.
dialogsBegin.sw: You must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, who resides there, and retrieve his heart.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณต้องเผชิญหน้ากับ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ซึ่งอาศัยอยู่ที่นั่น และเอาหัวใจของเขากลับมา
dialogsBegin.tw: 你必需面對居住在那裡的 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$，並取回他的心臟。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn phải đối đầu với $ QUEST_END_KILL_NAME $, người đang cư trú ở đó và lấy trái tim của anh ta.

dialogsBegin.en: Deliver the Venel Heart to Wendien, the Elementor Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.ar: Deliver the Venel Heart to Wendien, the Elementor Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.br: Por favor, entregue o coração a Wendien, a Guardiã Elementor.
dialogsBegin.cns: 完成试验后，请你心脏拿给圣堂的元素使者守护使者【文嫡凌】，知道了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Bitte bring das Herz zu Wendien, dem Elementor Wächter.
dialogsBegin.fi: Deliver the Venel Heart to Wendien, the Elementor Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.fil: Deliver the Venel Heart to Wendien, the Elementor Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu pourras alors te présenter à la Gardienne des Elémentalistes, Wendien.
dialogsBegin.id: Kirim Venel Heart ke Wendien, Elementor Guardian di Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.it: Deliver the Venel Heart to Wendien, the Elementor Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.jp: それを手に入れたらエレメンター守護者ウェンディのもとに行ってください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 가르디안의 엘리멘터 수호자 웬디엔에게 베넬의 심장을 전달하세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Deliver the Venel Heart to Wendien, the Elementor Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.pl: Deliver the Venel Heart to Wendien, the Elementor Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.ru: Затем отнеси сердце хранительнице факиров Венди. Справишься?
dialogsBegin.sp: Entrega el Corazón de Venel a Wendien, la Guardiana Elementor en Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.sw: Deliver the Venel Heart to Wendien, the Elementor Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.th: ส่งหัวใจ Venel ไปยัง Wendien Elementor Guardian ใน Guardiane
dialogsBegin.tw: 完成試驗後，請你把心臟拿給守護者祭壇研術者守護者 [文嫡凌]，知道了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Giao Trái tim Venel cho Wendien, Elementor Guardian ở Guardiane.

dialogsAccept.en: Maybe the wisdom of the Heroes guide you, my friend.
dialogsAccept.ar: Maybe the wisdom of the Heroes guide you, my friend.
dialogsAccept.br: Eu lhe desejo sorte.
dialogsAccept.cns: 一切保重~
dialogsAccept.de: Viel Glück!
dialogsAccept.fi: Maybe the wisdom of the Heroes guide you, my friend.
dialogsAccept.fil: Maybe the wisdom of the Heroes guide you, my friend.
dialogsAccept.fr: Je te souhaite que la grandeur de Lillip t'accompagne !
dialogsAccept.id: Mungkin kebijaksanaan para Pahlawan membimbingmu, temanku.
dialogsAccept.it: Maybe the wisdom of the Heroes guide you, my friend.
dialogsAccept.jp: じゃあ、気をつけてね～
dialogsAccept.kr: 영웅의 지혜가 당신을 인도하기를.
dialogsAccept.nl: Maybe the wisdom of the Heroes guide you, my friend.
dialogsAccept.pl: Maybe the wisdom of the Heroes guide you, my friend.
dialogsAccept.ru: Да пребудет с тобой мудрость героев.
dialogsAccept.sp: Que la sabiduría de los Héroes te guíe, amigo mío.
dialogsAccept.sw: Maybe the wisdom of the Heroes guide you, my friend.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้ภูมิปัญญาของ Heroes แนะนำคุณ เพื่อนของฉัน
dialogsAccept.tw: 一切保重~
dialogsAccept.vi: Cầu mong sự khôn ngoan của các Anh hùng sẽ chỉ dẫn bạn, bạn của tôi.

dialogsDecline.en: Quitting now would be foolish, young one. Give it some though and speak to me again should you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ar: Quitting now would be foolish, young one. Give it some though and speak to me again should you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.br: Desistir agora seria tolice, jovem. Pense um pouco e fale comigo novamente se você mudar de ideia.
dialogsDecline.cns: 现在放弃是很愚蠢的，等你改变主意再来找我吧
dialogsDecline.de: Jetzt aufzuhören, wäre töricht, junger Mann. Überlegen Sie es sich gut und sprechen Sie wieder mit mir, wenn Sie Ihre Meinung ändern.
dialogsDecline.fi: Quitting now would be foolish, young one. Give it some though and speak to me again should you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fil: Quitting now would be foolish, young one. Give it some though and speak to me again should you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fr: Après avoir traversé tant d'épreuves, tu es sur le point d'abandonner ? Ceci est la dernière étape, réfléchis bien...
dialogsDecline.id: Berhenti sekarang akan bodoh, anak muda. Berikan beberapa meskipun dan berbicara dengan saya lagi jika kamu berubah pikiran.
dialogsDecline.it: Quitting now would be foolish, young one. Give it some though and speak to me again should you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.jp: うそーん！ほんとにやめちゃうの？ここまできてやめちゃうなんて、君転職を何だと思ってるんだい？
dialogsDecline.kr: 지금 포기하시는 건, 정말 어리석은 선택이에요. 다시 생각해 보시고 마음이 바뀌면 저를 찾아오세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Quitting now would be foolish, young one. Give it some though and speak to me again should you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.pl: Quitting now would be foolish, young one. Give it some though and speak to me again should you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ru: Quitting now would be foolish, young one. Give it some though and speak to me again should you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.sp: Renunciar ahora sería una tontería, joven. Piénsatelo y ven a hablar conmigo de nuevo si cambias de opinión.
dialogsDecline.sw: Quitting now would be foolish, young one. Give it some though and speak to me again should you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.th: มายอมแพ้ตอนนี้คงโง่เง่าไปหน่อย สู้หน่อยสิ กลับมาคุยกับฉันอีกครั้งถ้าคุณเปลี่ยนใจ
dialogsDecline.tw: 現在放棄是愚蠢的，年輕人。如果你改變主意，給它一些，然後再和我說話。
dialogsDecline.vi: Bỏ cuộc bây giờ sẽ là một điều ngu ngốc, bạn trẻ. Hãy xem xét lại và nói chuyện với tôi một lần nữa nếu bạn thay đổi ý định.

dialogsComplete.en: Welcome, Magician. Your journey to becoming an Elementor is complete. I now appoint you, a Successor of the Elementor Hero!
dialogsComplete.ar: Welcome, Magician. Your journey to becoming an Elementor is complete. I now appoint you, a Successor of the Elementor Hero!
dialogsComplete.br: Bem-vindo(a), Mago(a). Sua jornada para se tornar um Elementor está completa. Eu agora o(a) nomeio, Sucessor do Herói Elementor!
dialogsComplete.cns: 恭喜你喔！你已经通过最后的试验，你已经成为了元素使者的继承者！
dialogsComplete.de: Willkommen Nachfolger. Du hast den letzten Test bestanden! Nun werde ich dich zum Nachfolger des Elementor Hero ernennen!
dialogsComplete.fi: Welcome, Magician. Your journey to becoming an Elementor is complete. I now appoint you, a Successor of the Elementor Hero!
dialogsComplete.fil: Welcome, Magician. Your journey to becoming an Elementor is complete. I now appoint you, a Successor of the Elementor Hero!
dialogsComplete.fr: Bienvenue à Gardiane. Tu as réussi brillamment la dernière épreuve et mérites désormais d'être l'un des successeurs du Héros des Élémentalistes.
dialogsComplete.id: Selamat datang, Penyihir. Perjalananmu untuk menjadi Elementor telah selesai. Sekarang saya menunjukmu, Penerus Elementor Hero!
dialogsComplete.it: Welcome, Magician. Your journey to becoming an Elementor is complete. I now appoint you, a Successor of the Elementor Hero!
dialogsComplete.jp: 後継者よ。汝は最後の試練を乗り越えた。これからはエレメンター後継者として新たな道を歩むがよい！時を司る聖樹の葉音が汝に未来を告げるであろう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 잘 오셨습니다, 매지션님. 엘리멘터가 되는 여정이 끝났군요. 이제 당신을 엘리멘터 영웅의 후계자로 임명하겠습니다!
dialogsComplete.nl: Welcome, Magician. Your journey to becoming an Elementor is complete. I now appoint you, a Successor of the Elementor Hero!
dialogsComplete.pl: Welcome, Magician. Your journey to becoming an Elementor is complete. I now appoint you, a Successor of the Elementor Hero!
dialogsComplete.ru: Прекрасно! Испытания позади. Объявляю тебя факиром!
dialogsComplete.sp: Bienvenido, Magician. Tu viaje para convertirte en Elementor ya terminado. ¡Te nombro Sucesor de la Héroe Elementor!
dialogsComplete.sw: Welcome, Magician. Your journey to becoming an Elementor is complete. I now appoint you, a Successor of the Elementor Hero!
dialogsComplete.th: ยินดีต้อนรับ Magician การเดินทางสู่การเป็น Elementor เสร็จสิ้นแล้ว ตอนนี้ผมได้แต่งตั้งคุณเป็นผู้สืบทอดฮีโร่ของ Elementor แล้ว!
dialogsComplete.tw: 恭喜你喔！你已經通過最後的試驗，你已經成為了研術者的繼承者！
dialogsComplete.vi: Chào mừng, Magician. Hành trình trở thành Elementor của bạn đã hoàn tất. Bây giờ tôi chỉ định bạn, một Người kế vị của Anh hùng Elementor!

dialogsComplete.en: Lillip! Bless and guide this brave soul who is following your will! Elementor!
dialogsComplete.ar: Lillip! Bless and guide this brave soul who is following your will! Elementor!
dialogsComplete.br: Lillip, por favor abençoe e encoraje esta pessoa que está seguindo a sua vontade!! Elementor!
dialogsComplete.cns: 啊！ 这里有要继承你的人，祝福它吧！
dialogsComplete.de: Lillip, bitte segne und ermutige diese Person, die deinem Geist folgen möchte! Elementor!
dialogsComplete.fi: Lillip! Bless and guide this brave soul who is following your will! Elementor!
dialogsComplete.fil: Lillip! Bless and guide this brave soul who is following your will! Elementor!
dialogsComplete.fr: Lillip, puisses-tu bénir et soutenir en tout temps cette personne ici qui dédie sa vie à ta volonté !
dialogsComplete.id: Lilip! Memberkati dan membimbing jiwa pemberani ini yang mengikuti kehendakmu! Elementor!
dialogsComplete.it: Lillip! Bless and guide this brave soul who is following your will! Elementor!
dialogsComplete.jp: ＜異世界の理を識る者＞リルリップよ、今ここに新たな後継者が誕生しました！この者に祝福と勇気を授けたまえ！
dialogsComplete.kr: 릴립이시여! 당신의 뜻을 따르고자 하는 이 용감한 영혼을 축복하고 인도하소서! 엘리멘터!
dialogsComplete.nl: Lillip! Bless and guide this brave soul who is following your will! Elementor!
dialogsComplete.pl: Lillip! Bless and guide this brave soul who is following your will! Elementor!
dialogsComplete.ru: О, великий Гэндальфи! Благослови этого человека и дай ему силы исполнить твою волю!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Lillip! ¡Bendice y guía a esta valiente alma que sigue tu voluntad! ¡Elementor!
dialogsComplete.sw: Lillip! Bless and guide this brave soul who is following your will! Elementor!
dialogsComplete.th: Lillip! อวยพรและแนะนำชีวิตที่กล้าหาญนี้ผู้ที่ติดตามความประสงค์ของคุณ! Elementor!
dialogsComplete.tw: 啊！這裡有要繼承你的人，祝福它吧！
dialogsComplete.vi: Lillip! Ban phước và chỉ dẫn linh hồn dũng cảm này, người đang làm theo ý muốn của bạn! Elementor!

dialogsFail.en: I am awaiting a new Successor to the Elementor Hero. If that is you, I believe you may be forgetting something, Magician.
dialogsFail.ar: I am awaiting a new Successor to the Elementor Hero. If that is you, I believe you may be forgetting something, Magician.
dialogsFail.br: Estou esperando um novo sucessor para o Herói Elementor. Se for você, acredito que esteja se esquecendo de algo, jovem Mago(a).
dialogsFail.cns: 这里只有英雄的继承者才可以进入喔，请回去吧！
dialogsFail.de: Nur derjenige, der als Nachfolger anerkannt wurde, darf passieren. Geh zurück.
dialogsFail.fi: I am awaiting a new Successor to the Elementor Hero. If that is you, I believe you may be forgetting something, Magician.
dialogsFail.fil: I am awaiting a new Successor to the Elementor Hero. If that is you, I believe you may be forgetting something, Magician.
dialogsFail.fr: Seuls ceux reconnus comme successeurs de Lillip sont admis ici. Poursuis ton apprentissage...
dialogsFail.id: Saya sedang menunggu Penerus baru untuk Elementor Hero. Jika itu Anda, saya yakin kamu mungkin melupakan sesuatu, Penyihir.
dialogsFail.it: I am awaiting a new Successor to the Elementor Hero. If that is you, I believe you may be forgetting something, Magician.
dialogsFail.jp: ここは英雄の後継者として認められた者のみが立ち入ることを許される、資格のないものは即刻立ち去るがよい･･･。
dialogsFail.kr: 엘리멘터 영웅의 새로운 후계자를 기다리는 중입니다. 당신이 후계자라면, 뭔가 잊어버린 게 있을 것 같은데요, 매지션님.
dialogsFail.nl: I am awaiting a new Successor to the Elementor Hero. If that is you, I believe you may be forgetting something, Magician.
dialogsFail.pl: I am awaiting a new Successor to the Elementor Hero. If that is you, I believe you may be forgetting something, Magician.
dialogsFail.ru: Я жду того, кого смогу назвать факиром. Тебе для этого кое-чего не хватает.
dialogsFail.sp: Estoy esperando a un nuevo Sucesor de la Héroe Elementor. Si ese eres tú, creo que se te olvida algo, Magician.
dialogsFail.sw: I am awaiting a new Successor to the Elementor Hero. If that is you, I believe you may be forgetting something, Magician.
dialogsFail.th: ฉันกำลังรอผู้สืบทอดคนใหม่ของ Elementor Hero ถ้าเป็นคุณ ฉันเชื่อว่าคุณอาจจะลืมบางสิ่งบางอย่าง Magician
dialogsFail.tw: 這裡只有英雄的繼承者才可以進入喔，請回去吧！
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi đang chờ một Người kế vị mới cho Elementor Hero. Nếu đó là bạn, tôi tin rằng bạn có thể đang bỏ quên điều gì đó, Magician.

name.vi: The Promise Ring ( Chiếc nhẫn hẹn ước)

description.en: Meet Elaine and give him the Promise Ring
description.ar: Meet Elaine and give him the Promise Ring
description.br: Encontre Elaine e dê a ele o Anel de Promessa
description.cns: 找见伊莲并给他希望戒指
description.de: Treffen Sie Elaine und geben Sie ihm den Verlobungsring.
description.fi: Meet Elaine and give him the Promise Ring
description.fil: Meet Elaine and give him the Promise Ring
description.fr: Donnez la bague de Hindel à Alain.
description.id: Temui Elaine dan berikan Promise Ring
description.it: Meet Elaine and give him the Promise Ring
description.jp: ハイネルの指輪をエルラインに渡せ。
description.nl: Meet Elaine and give him the Promise Ring
description.pl: Spotkaj się z Elaine i oddaj Pierścień Obietnicy
description.ru: Meet Elaine and give him the Promise Ring
description.sp: Reúnete con Elaine y dale el Anillo de la Promesa.
description.sw: Meet Elaine and give him the Promise Ring
description.th: พบ Elaine และให้แหวน Promise Ring แก่เขา
description.tw: 去見耶拉伊，將約定戒指交給他。
description.vi: Gặp Elaine và trao cho anh ấy Promise Ring

dialogsBegin.en: Alright, bring that ring to Elaine. It will be painful for him, but… I feel it's important that it is returned to him. Maybe he will feel something that was lost a long time ago.
dialogsBegin.ar: Alright, bring that ring to Elaine. It will be painful for him, but… I feel it's important that it is returned to him. Maybe he will feel something that was lost a long time ago.
dialogsBegin.br: Belezaaa, agora leve esse anel para Elaine. Sei que vai ser doloroso para ele, mas... eu sinto que é importante que seja devolvido a ele. Talvez ele sinta algo que foi perdido há muito tempo.
dialogsBegin.cns: 好吧，把那枚戒指带给伊莲。这对他来说会很痛苦，但是......我觉得把戒指给他很重要。或许他能感受到很久以前已经失去的东西。
dialogsBegin.de: Also gut, bringen Sie den Ring zu Elaine. Es wird schmerzhaft für ihn sein, aber... ich halte es für wichtig, dass er ihm zurückgegeben wird. Vielleicht spürt er dann etwas, das er vor langer Zeit verloren hat.
dialogsBegin.fi: Alright, bring that ring to Elaine. It will be painful for him, but… I feel it's important that it is returned to him. Maybe he will feel something that was lost a long time ago.
dialogsBegin.fil: Alright, bring that ring to Elaine. It will be painful for him, but… I feel it's important that it is returned to him. Maybe he will feel something that was lost a long time ago.
dialogsBegin.fr: Apportez cette bague à Alain, ça va lui rappeler des souvenirs douloureux mais c'est un mal nécessaire.
dialogsBegin.id: Baiklah, bawa cincin itu ke Elaine. Itu akan menyakitkan baginya, tapi ... Saya rasa penting jika cincin itu dikembalikan kepadanya. Mungkin dia akan merasakan ada sesuatu yang hilang sejak lama.
dialogsBegin.it: Alright, bring that ring to Elaine. It will be painful for him, but… I feel it's important that it is returned to him. Maybe he will feel something that was lost a long time ago.
dialogsBegin.jp: そうだ。よければ君からこの指輪をエルラインに渡してくれないか？ 彼にとっては辛いだろうが...。きっと昔を思い出すかもしれない。そっとしてあげてくれ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 좋아요, 그 반지를 일레인에게 돌려주세요. 괴롭겠지만... 그래도 꼭 돌려줘야 합니다. 어쩌면 일레인도 잊고 지냈던 무언가를 다시 느낄 수 있겠죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: Alright, bring that ring to Elaine. It will be painful for him, but… I feel it's important that it is returned to him. Maybe he will feel something that was lost a long time ago.
dialogsBegin.pl: Alright, bring that ring to Elaine. It will be painful for him, but… I feel it's important that it is returned to him. Maybe he will feel something that was lost a long time ago.
dialogsBegin.ru: Alright, bring that ring to Elaine. It will be painful for him, but… I feel it's important that it is returned to him. Maybe he will feel something that was lost a long time ago.
dialogsBegin.sp: Muy bien, llévale ese anillo a Elaine. Será doloroso para él, pero... Siento que es importante que se lo devuelvas. Tal vez sienta algo que se perdió hace mucho tiempo en su interior.
dialogsBegin.sw: Alright, bring that ring to Elaine. It will be painful for him, but… I feel it's important that it is returned to him. Maybe he will feel something that was lost a long time ago.
dialogsBegin.th: เอาล่ะ นำแหวนนั้นไปให้ Elaine มันจะเจ็บปวดสำหรับเขา แต่ ... ฉันรู้สึกว่ามันสำคัญที่มันจะถูกส่งกลับไปหาเขา บางทีเขาอาจรู้สึกว่าหายตัวไปนานแล้ว
dialogsBegin.tw: 好，把戒指帶給耶拉伊。這也許會讓他痛苦，但我認為物歸原主很重要。或許他能重新找回早已失去的某些感受。
dialogsBegin.vi: Được rồi, hãy mang chiếc nhẫn đó cho Elaine. Nó sẽ rất đau đớn cho anh ấy, nhưng… tôi cảm thấy điều quan trọng là nó phải được trả lại cho anh ấy. Có lẽ anh ấy sẽ cảm nhận được điều gì đó đã mất từ ​​rất lâu rồi.

dialogsBegin.en: I know he would rather repress all these painful memories, but the time has come to stop hiding and face our individual destinies. Please take this ring to him
dialogsBegin.ar: I know he would rather repress all these painful memories, but the time has come to stop hiding and face our individual destinies. Please take this ring to him
dialogsBegin.br: Eu sei que ele preferiria reprimir todas essas lembranças dolorosas, mas chegou a hora de parar de se esconder e enfrentar nossos destinos individuais. Por favor, leve este anel para ele.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我知道他宁愿压抑所有这些痛苦的记忆，但现在是时候停止逃避，面对我们各自的命运了。请把这枚戒指交给他
dialogsBegin.de: Ich weiß, dass er all diese schmerzhaften Erinnerungen lieber verdrängen würde, aber es ist an der Zeit, dass wir uns nicht länger verstecken und uns unserem individuellen Schicksal stellen. Bitte bringen Sie ihm diesen Ring
dialogsBegin.fi: I know he would rather repress all these painful memories, but the time has come to stop hiding and face our individual destinies. Please take this ring to him
dialogsBegin.fil: I know he would rather repress all these painful memories, but the time has come to stop hiding and face our individual destinies. Please take this ring to him
dialogsBegin.fr: Il doit se rendre compte que les forts ont un devoir de protection envers les faibles qu'ils nous soient proches ou non.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya tahu dia lebih suka untuk menyembunyikan semua kenangan menyakitkan ini, tetapi waktunya telah tiba untuk berhenti bersembunyi dan menghadapi nasib pribadi kita. Tolong bawa cincin ini padanya.
dialogsBegin.it: I know he would rather repress all these painful memories, but the time has come to stop hiding and face our individual destinies. Please take this ring to him
dialogsBegin.jp: 彼は一つ大きな勘違いをしている。彼が戦場に行かねば、またハイネルのような犠牲が出てしまうかもしれないんだ。それぞれが自分の運命と向き合うときです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 고통스러운 기억들을 피하고 싶은 마음, 잘 압니다. 하지만 이제는 숨을 때가 아니라 각자의 운명에 맞설 때죠. 이 반지를 꼭 전해주세요
dialogsBegin.nl: I know he would rather repress all these painful memories, but the time has come to stop hiding and face our individual destinies. Please take this ring to him
dialogsBegin.pl: I know he would rather repress all these painful memories, but the time has come to stop hiding and face our individual destinies. Please take this ring to him
dialogsBegin.ru: I know he would rather repress all these painful memories, but the time has come to stop hiding and face our individual destinies. Please take this ring to him
dialogsBegin.sp: Sé que el prefiere reprimir todos estos recuerdos dolorosos, pero ha llegado el momento de dejar de escondernos y afrontar nuestros destinos. Por favor, llévale el anillo.
dialogsBegin.sw: I know he would rather repress all these painful memories, but the time has come to stop hiding and face our individual destinies. Please take this ring to him
dialogsBegin.th: ถึงเวลาแล้วที่เราจะต้องหลบซ่อนตัวและเผชิญชะตากรรมของเรา กรุณาเอาแหวนนี้ไปหาเขา
dialogsBegin.tw: 雖然想逃避，但是如果逃避，只是會讓同樣的事情不斷重覆發生而已。這一點他也知道吧。現在就把妹妹的指戒轉交給耶拉伊吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi biết anh ấy thà kìm nén tất cả những ký ức đau buồn này, nhưng đã đến lúc không thể che giấu và đối mặt với số phận của mỗi chúng ta. Hãy đưa chiếc nhẫn này cho anh ấy

dialogsAccept.en: I'm sure the result will be good. Go! Give that ring to Elaine.
dialogsAccept.ar: I'm sure the result will be good. Go! Give that ring to Elaine.
dialogsAccept.br: Tenho certeza que o resultado será bom. Vai lá! Entregue esse anel para Elaine.
dialogsAccept.cns: 我相信结果会是好的。去吧！把那个戒指给伊莲。
dialogsAccept.de: Ich bin sicher, dass das Ergebnis gut sein wird. Los geht's! Gib Elaine diesen Ring.
dialogsAccept.fi: I'm sure the result will be good. Go! Give that ring to Elaine.
dialogsAccept.fil: I'm sure the result will be good. Go! Give that ring to Elaine.
dialogsAccept.fr: Il a plus de ressources qu'il ne le soupçonne lui-même.
dialogsAccept.id: Saya yakin hasilnya akan bagus. Pergilah! Berikan cincin itu kepada Elaine.
dialogsAccept.it: I'm sure the result will be good. Go! Give that ring to Elaine.
dialogsAccept.jp: 説得は難しいかもしれない。だが、君なら気持ちを伝えることができるんじゃないか？エルラインに渡してきて！
dialogsAccept.kr: 분명 좋은 결과가 있을 거예요. 어서 반지를 가지고 일레인에게 가세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: I'm sure the result will be good. Go! Give that ring to Elaine.
dialogsAccept.pl: I'm sure the result will be good. Go! Give that ring to Elaine.
dialogsAccept.ru: I'm sure the result will be good. Go! Give that ring to Elaine.
dialogsAccept.sp: Seguro que el resultado será bueno. ¡Adelante! Dale el anillo a Elaine.
dialogsAccept.sw: I'm sure the result will be good. Go! Give that ring to Elaine.
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันแน่ใจว่าผลจะดี ไป! ให้แหวนนั้นแก่ Elaine
dialogsAccept.tw: 一定會有很好的結果。快點把戒指拿去給耶拉伊吧。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi chắc chắn rằng sẽ có kết quả tốt. Đi nào! Đưa chiếc nhẫn đó cho Elaine.

dialogsDecline.en: If you don't want to do it, then I'll do it myself alright?
dialogsDecline.ar: If you don't want to do it, then I'll do it myself alright?
dialogsDecline.br: Se você não pode fazer isso, então eu mesmo irei fazer isso sozinho.
dialogsDecline.cns: 如果你不想做，那我就自己做好了。
dialogsDecline.de: Wenn du es nicht machen willst, dann mache ich es eben selbst, okay?
dialogsDecline.fi: If you don't want to do it, then I'll do it myself alright?
dialogsDecline.fil: If you don't want to do it, then I'll do it myself alright?
dialogsDecline.fr: Comme vous voulez, je m'en chargerai personnellement alors.
dialogsDecline.id: Jika Anda tidak ingin melakukannya, maka saya akan melakukannya sendiri,oke?
dialogsDecline.it: If you don't want to do it, then I'll do it myself alright?
dialogsDecline.jp: そうか、私が渡してもよいのだが……今はこの場を離れられなくてね。
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신이 하기 싫다면… 제가 직접 하겠어요, 알겠죠?
dialogsDecline.nl: If you don't want to do it, then I'll do it myself alright?
dialogsDecline.pl: If you don't want to do it, then I'll do it myself alright?
dialogsDecline.ru: If you don't want to do it, then I'll do it myself alright?
dialogsDecline.sp: Si no quieres hacerlo, lo haré yo mismo.
dialogsDecline.sw: If you don't want to do it, then I'll do it myself alright?
dialogsDecline.th: ถ้าคุณไม่ต้องการที่จะทำมันแล้วฉันจะทำมันเองดีกว่ามั้ย ?
dialogsDecline.tw: 如果討厭，那麼只能讓我親交轉交…知道了。
dialogsDecline.vi: Nếu bạn không muốn thực hiện nó, thì tôi sẽ tự mình làm điều đó?

dialogsComplete.en: Why are you here again? I hope I was clear before about…
dialogsComplete.ar: Why are you here again? I hope I was clear before about…
dialogsComplete.br: Por que você está aqui de novo? Espero ter sido claro o bastante sobre aquele assunto…
dialogsComplete.cns: 你为什么还在这里？我认为我之前说得很清楚了，关于...
dialogsComplete.de: Warum sind Sie wieder hier? Ich hoffe, ich habe mich vorher klar ausgedrückt...
dialogsComplete.fi: Why are you here again? I hope I was clear before about…
dialogsComplete.fil: Why are you here again? I hope I was clear before about…
dialogsComplete.fr: Qu'est-ce que vous faites encore ici.
dialogsComplete.id: Mengapa Anda ada di sini lagi? Saya rasa penjelasan saya cukup jelas sebelumnya tentang...
dialogsComplete.it: Why are you here again? I hope I was clear before about…
dialogsComplete.jp: また、貴方ですか……。私は話すことなどありませんよ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 왜 또 온 거예요? 아까도 분명히 말했을 텐데…
dialogsComplete.nl: Why are you here again? I hope I was clear before about…
dialogsComplete.pl: Why are you here again? I hope I was clear before about…
dialogsComplete.ru: Why are you here again? I hope I was clear before about…
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿Por qué sigues aquí? Espero haber sido claro sobre...
dialogsComplete.sw: Why are you here again? I hope I was clear before about…
dialogsComplete.th: คุณมาที่นี่อีกทำไม ฉันหวังว่าฉันจะเคลียร์ก่อน
dialogsComplete.tw: 又有什麼事情要找我呢？
dialogsComplete.vi: Tại sao bạn lại ở đây? Tôi hy vọng tôi đã truyền đạt rõ ràng về…

dialogsFail.en: Did you return the Promise Ring to Elaine yet? What are you waiting for?
dialogsFail.ar: Did you return the Promise Ring to Elaine yet? What are you waiting for?
dialogsFail.br: Você já devolveu o Anel de Promessa para Elaine? O que você está esperando?
dialogsFail.cns: 你把希望戒指交给伊莲了吗？你在等什么呢？
dialogsFail.de: Hast du Alain den Verlobungsring schon an Elaine zurückgegeben? Worauf wartest du noch?
dialogsFail.fi: Did you return the Promise Ring to Elaine yet? What are you waiting for?
dialogsFail.fil: Did you return the Promise Ring to Elaine yet? What are you waiting for?
dialogsFail.fr: Vous avez déjà donné la bague à Alain ?
dialogsFail.id: Apakah Anda sudah mengembalikan Promise Ring ke Elaine? Tunggu apalagi?
dialogsFail.it: Did you return the Promise Ring to Elaine yet? What are you waiting for?
dialogsFail.jp: エルラインとは話したかい？
dialogsFail.kr: 아직 일레인에게 약속의 반지를 전하지 않았나요? 뭘 망설이고 있는 거죠?
dialogsFail.nl: Did you return the Promise Ring to Elaine yet? What are you waiting for?
dialogsFail.pl: Czy zwróciłeś już Pierścień Obietnicy Elaine? Na co czekasz?
dialogsFail.ru: Did you return the Promise Ring to Elaine yet? What are you waiting for?
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Ya le has devuelto el Anillo de la Promesa a Elaine? ¿A qué estas esperando?
dialogsFail.sw: Did you return the Promise Ring to Elaine yet? What are you waiting for?
dialogsFail.th: คุณได้ส่ง Promise Ring ไปให้ Elaine หรือยัง? คุณกำลังรออะไรอยู่?
dialogsFail.tw: 你把約定戒指交還給耶拉伊了嗎？還在等什麼？
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn đã trả lại Promise Ring cho Elaine chưa? Bạn còn chờ gì nữa?

name.th: ผู้สืบทอดของฮีโร่ -Guardian-
name.tw: 英雄的繼承者 - 守護者

description.en: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Venel Heart to Shyniff, the Psykeeper Guardian in Guardiane.
description.ar: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Venel Heart to Shyniff, the Psykeeper Guardian in Guardiane.
description.br: Derrote o espírito, Guardião Venel, e obtenha seu coração. Visite então Shyniff, a Guardiã Psykeeper.
description.cns: 打倒守护兽贝纳卡度温并取得他的心脏后，再去找精神使者守护使者夏尼普！
description.de: Besiege den Wächtergeist, Venel Guardian und nimm sein Herz. Dann besuche Shyniff, den Psykeeper Wächter.
description.fi: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Venel Heart to Shyniff, the Psykeeper Guardian in Guardiane.
description.fil: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Venel Heart to Shyniff, the Psykeeper Guardian in Guardiane.
description.fr: Vaincre Venel et ramener son cœur à la Gardienne des Sorciers, Shyniff.
description.id: Kalahkan Venel Guardian, dan berikan Venel Heart ke Shyniff, Psykeeper Guardian di Guardiane.
description.it: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Venel Heart to Shyniff, the Psykeeper Guardian in Guardiane.
description.jp: ガルディアの守護者の部屋にいる守護精霊＜ヴェネル・ガーディアン＞のハートを手に入れ、サイキーパー守護者シーニフに会おう。
description.kr: 베넬가디언을 처치하고, 베넬의 심장을 가르디안의 사이키퍼 수호자 샤이니프에게 전달하세요.
description.nl: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Venel Heart to Shyniff, the Psykeeper Guardian in Guardiane.
description.pl: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Venel Heart to Shyniff, the Psykeeper Guardian in Guardiane.
description.ru: Нужно победить Виндигго и принести его сердце Шейле, хранительнице манипуляторов.
description.sp: Derrota al Guardián Venel y entrega el Corazón de Venel a Shyniff, la Guardiana Psykeeper en Guardiane.
description.sw: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Venel Heart to Shyniff, the Psykeeper Guardian in Guardiane.
description.th: กำจัด Venel Guardian และส่งมอบ Venel Heart ให้แก่ Shyniff ผู้พิทักษ์ชาว Psykeeper Guardian ใน Guardiane
description.tw: 打倒守護獸貝納卡度溫並取得他的心臟後，再去守護者祭壇找念力師守護者夏尼普！
description.vi: Đánh bại Venel Guardian, và giao Venel Heart cho Shyniff, Psykeeper Guardian ở Guardiane.

dialogsBegin.en: This is the Symbol of the Hero. There is only one more task to complete before you can be named a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsBegin.ar: This is the Symbol of the Hero. There is only one more task to complete before you can be named a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsBegin.br: Aqui está o símbolo do herói. Você precisa de mais um comprovante para ser reconhecido como um sucessor do herói.
dialogsBegin.cns: 这标志是证明你是英雄守护使者的继承者，不过还需要另一个证明！
dialogsBegin.de: Dies ist das Symbol der Helden. Du brauchst diesen Beleg um beweisen zu können, dass du als Nachfolger anerkannt wurdest.
dialogsBegin.fi: This is the Symbol of the Hero. There is only one more task to complete before you can be named a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsBegin.fil: This is the Symbol of the Hero. There is only one more task to complete before you can be named a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je peux maintenant te confier le Sceau des Héros, qui confirme que tu as relevé avec succès tous les défis qui se sont présentés. Mais il te faut encore réussir l'épreuve finale.
dialogsBegin.id: Ini adalah Simbol Pahlawan. Hanya ada satu tugas lagi yang harus diselesaikan sebelum kamu dapat dinobatkan sebagai Penerus Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsBegin.it: This is the Symbol of the Hero. There is only one more task to complete before you can be named a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsBegin.jp: じゃあ、これが英雄の証だよ。実は、このほかにもうひとつ証が必要なんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이거야말로 영웅의 증표죠. 사이키퍼 영웅의 후계자가 되려면, 마지막 임무가 하나 더 남았습니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: This is the Symbol of the Hero. There is only one more task to complete before you can be named a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsBegin.pl: This is the Symbol of the Hero. There is only one more task to complete before you can be named a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsBegin.ru: Это Знак героя. Он означает, что его владелец является истинным наследником героя-манипулятора.
dialogsBegin.sp: Este es el Símbolo del Héroe. Solo te queda una tarea más antes de que puedas ser nombrado Sucesor de la Héroe Psykeeper.
dialogsBegin.sw: This is the Symbol of the Hero. There is only one more task to complete before you can be named a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsBegin.th: นี่คือสัญลักษณ์ของพระเอก มีเพียงงานเดียวที่ต้องทำก่อนคุณจะสามารถได้ชื่อว่าผู้สืบทอดฮีโร่ Psykeeper ได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 這標誌是證明你是英雄守護者的繼承者，不過還需要另一個證明！
dialogsBegin.vi: Đây là Biểu tượng của Anh hùng. Chỉ còn một nhiệm vụ nữa cần hoàn thành trước khi bạn có thể được phong là Người kế vị Anh hùng Psykeeper.

dialogsBegin.en: There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You'll find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of the Heroes is protected.
dialogsBegin.ar: There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You'll find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of the Heroes is protected.
dialogsBegin.br: Há um local chamado de A Sala do Guardião. Você a encontrará em Guardiane. Nesse local, a vontade dos heróis está sendo protegida.
dialogsBegin.cns: 有一个地方叫守卫之室，在圣堂附近。去击败那个灵魂吧
dialogsBegin.de: Es gibt einen Ort mit dem Namen "Raum des Wächters". Du findest ihn in Guardiane. Dort wird der Wille der Helden geschützt.
dialogsBegin.fi: There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You'll find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of the Heroes is protected.
dialogsBegin.fil: There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You'll find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of the Heroes is protected.
dialogsBegin.fr: Au sud de Darkon 3, à Gardiane, se trouve un lieu appelé la Chambre du Gardien.
dialogsBegin.id: Ada tempat yang disebut Kamar Penjaga. Kamu akan menemukannya di Guardiane. Di sana, Kehendak Pahlawan dilindungi.
dialogsBegin.it: There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You'll find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of the Heroes is protected.
dialogsBegin.jp: ガルディアの守護者の部屋には英雄たちの紋章があって、そこには英雄たちの意志が保存されているんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 가르디안에는 수호자의 방이 있어요. 영웅들의 의지를 보존하고 있는 곳이죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You'll find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of the Heroes is protected.
dialogsBegin.pl: There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You'll find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of the Heroes is protected.
dialogsBegin.ru: Твоя судьба скоро решится. Но не здесь, а в Гардиане. Там, в Зале хранителей, ты найдешь великого духа - Виндигго. Он стережет волю героев.
dialogsBegin.sp: Hay un lugar llamado la Habitación del Guardián. Lo encontrarás en Guardiane. Allí se protege la Voluntad de los Héroes.
dialogsBegin.sw: There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You'll find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of the Heroes is protected.
dialogsBegin.th: มีสถานที่ที่เรียกว่า Room of the Guardian คุณจะพบได้ใน Guardiane ที่นั่นวีรบุรุษจะได้รับการคุ้มครอง
dialogsBegin.tw: 有個地方叫做守護者之室，你會在守護者祭壇找到它。那裡保存著英雄的意志。
dialogsBegin.vi: Có một nơi được gọi là Room of the Guardian. Bạn sẽ tìm thấy nó trong Guardiane. Ở đó, Ý chí của các Anh hùng được bảo vệ.

dialogsBegin.en: You must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, who resides there, and retrieve his heart.
dialogsBegin.ar: You must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, who resides there, and retrieve his heart.
dialogsBegin.br: Você deve confrontar o $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, que está lá, e recuperar seu coração.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你必须打败驻守在那的$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$，并且夺取他的心脏。
dialogsBegin.de: Du musst dich dem $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ stellen, der sich dort aufhält, und sein Herz zurückholen.
dialogsBegin.fi: You must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, who resides there, and retrieve his heart.
dialogsBegin.fil: You must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, who resides there, and retrieve his heart.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il te faut y pénétrer et vaincre $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$. Ta dernière épreuve sera de lui prendre son cœur !
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu harus menghadapi $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, yang tinggal di sana, dan mengambil jantungnya.
dialogsBegin.it: You must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, who resides there, and retrieve his heart.
dialogsBegin.jp: この守護者の部屋にいる $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を倒して、ヴェネル・ハートを取らなきゃいけないんだ。そしてそのハートが最後の証なのさ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그곳을 지키고 있는 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 몬스터를 처치하고, 심장을 손에 넣으세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: You must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, who resides there, and retrieve his heart.
dialogsBegin.pl: You must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, who resides there, and retrieve his heart.
dialogsBegin.ru: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$. Победи его и забери его сердце. Это станет твоим последним испытанием.
dialogsBegin.sp: Debes enfrentarte al $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, que reside allí, y conseguir su corazón.
dialogsBegin.sw: You must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, who resides there, and retrieve his heart.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณต้องเผชิญหน้ากับ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ซึ่งอาศัยอยู่ที่นั่น และเอาหัวใจของเขากลับมา
dialogsBegin.tw: 你必需面對居住在那裡的 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$，並取回他的心臟。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn phải đối đầu với $ QUEST_END_KILL_NAME $, người đang cư trú ở đó và lấy trái tim của anh ta.

dialogsBegin.en: Deliver the Venel Heart to Shyniff, the Psykeeper Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.ar: Deliver the Venel Heart to Shyniff, the Psykeeper Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.br: Por favor, entregue o coração para Shyniff, o guardião Psykeeper.
dialogsBegin.cns: 然后，请你把这心脏拿给位于圣堂的精神使者守护使者【夏尼普】。
dialogsBegin.de: Bringe jenes Herz dann bitte zu Shyniff, dem Psykeeper Wächter.
dialogsBegin.fi: Deliver the Venel Heart to Shyniff, the Psykeeper Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.fil: Deliver the Venel Heart to Shyniff, the Psykeeper Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu pourras alors te présenter à la Gardienne des Sorciers, Shyniff.
dialogsBegin.id: Kirim Venel Heart ke Shyniff, Psykeeper Guardian di Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.it: Deliver the Venel Heart to Shyniff, the Psykeeper Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.jp: それを手に入れたらサイキーパー守護者シーニフのもとに行ってください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그리고 이 베넬의 심장을 가르디안의 사이키퍼 수호자 샤이니프님께 전해 주시면 됩니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Deliver the Venel Heart to Shyniff, the Psykeeper Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.pl: Deliver the Venel Heart to Shyniff, the Psykeeper Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.ru: Затем отнеси сердце хранительнице манипуляторов Шейле. Справишься?
dialogsBegin.sp: Entrega el Corazón de Venel a Shyniff, la Guardiana Psykeeper en Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.sw: Deliver the Venel Heart to Shyniff, the Psykeeper Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.th: ส่งหัวใจ Venel ไปให้ Shyniff Guardian Psykeeper ใน Guardiane
dialogsBegin.tw: 然後，請你把這心臟拿給守護者祭壇念力師守護者 [夏尼普]。
dialogsBegin.vi: Giao Trái tim Venel cho Shyniff, Psykeeper Guardian ở Guardiane.

dialogsAccept.en: May the wisdom of the Heroes guide you, young one.
dialogsAccept.ar: May the wisdom of the Heroes guide you, young one.
dialogsAccept.br: Que a sabedoria dos Heróis o guie, jovem.
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你成功！
dialogsAccept.de: Viel Erfolg.
dialogsAccept.fi: May the wisdom of the Heroes guide you, young one.
dialogsAccept.fil: May the wisdom of the Heroes guide you, young one.
dialogsAccept.fr: Je te souhaite que la force psychique d'Offerep t'accompagne !
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga kebijaksanaan para Pahlawan membimbingmu, anak muda.
dialogsAccept.it: May the wisdom of the Heroes guide you, young one.
dialogsAccept.jp: じゃあ、がんばってね。無事に試練を乗り越えられますように！
dialogsAccept.kr: 영웅들의 지혜가 당신을 인도해 주기를.
dialogsAccept.nl: May the wisdom of the Heroes guide you, young one.
dialogsAccept.pl: May the wisdom of the Heroes guide you, young one.
dialogsAccept.ru: Да пребудет с тобой мудрость героев.
dialogsAccept.sp: Que la sabiduría de los Héroes te guíe, joven.
dialogsAccept.sw: May the wisdom of the Heroes guide you, young one.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้สติปัญญาของเหล่าฮีโร่นำทาง เจ้าเด็กน้อย
dialogsAccept.tw: 祝你成功！
dialogsAccept.vi: Cầu mong sự khôn ngoan của các Anh hùng sẽ chỉ dẫn bạn, người trẻ à.

dialogsDecline.en: Quitting now would be foolish, young one. Give it some though and speak to me again should you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ar: Quitting now would be foolish, young one. Give it some though and speak to me again should you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.br: Desistir agora seria tolice, jovem. Pense um pouco e fale comigo novamente se você mudar de ideia.
dialogsDecline.cns: 现在放弃是很愚蠢的，等你改变主意再来找我吧
dialogsDecline.de: Jetzt aufzuhören, wäre töricht, junger Mann. Überlegen Sie es sich gut und sprechen Sie wieder mit mir, wenn Sie Ihre Meinung ändern.
dialogsDecline.fi: Quitting now would be foolish, young one. Give it some though and speak to me again should you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fil: Quitting now would be foolish, young one. Give it some though and speak to me again should you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fr: Après avoir traversé tant d'épreuves, tu es sur le point d'abandonner ? Ceci est la dernière étape, réfléchis bien...
dialogsDecline.id: Berhenti sekarang akan bodoh, anak muda. Berikan beberapa meskipun dan berbicara dengan saya lagi jika kamu berubah pikiran.
dialogsDecline.it: Quitting now would be foolish, young one. Give it some though and speak to me again should you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.jp: うそーん！ほんとにやめちゃうの？ここまできてやめちゃうなんて、君転職を何だと思ってるんだい？
dialogsDecline.kr: 지금 포기하시는 건, 정말 어리석은 선택이에요. 다시 생각해 보시고 마음이 바뀌면 저를 찾아오세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Quitting now would be foolish, young one. Give it some though and speak to me again should you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.pl: Quitting now would be foolish, young one. Give it some though and speak to me again should you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ru: Quitting now would be foolish, young one. Give it some though and speak to me again should you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.sp: Renunciar ahora sería una tontería, joven. Piénsatelo y ven a hablar conmigo de nuevo si cambias de opinión.
dialogsDecline.sw: Quitting now would be foolish, young one. Give it some though and speak to me again should you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.th: มายอมแพ้ตอนนี้คงโง่เง่าไปหน่อย สู้หน่อยสิ กลับมาคุยกับฉันอีกครั้งถ้าคุณเปลี่ยนใจ
dialogsDecline.tw: 現在放棄是愚蠢的，年輕人。如果你改變主意，給它一些，然後再和我說話。
dialogsDecline.vi: Bỏ cuộc bây giờ sẽ là một điều ngu ngốc, bạn trẻ. Hãy xem xét lại và nói chuyện với tôi một lần nữa nếu bạn thay đổi ý định.

dialogsComplete.en: Welcome, Magician. Your journey to becoming a Psykeeper is now complete. I now appoint you, a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero!
dialogsComplete.ar: Welcome, Magician. Your journey to becoming a Psykeeper is now complete. I now appoint you, a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero!
dialogsComplete.br: Bem-vindo(a), Mago(a). Sua jornada para se tornar um Psykeeper está completa. Agora eu nomeio você, um Sucessor do Herói Psykeeper!
dialogsComplete.cns: 恭喜你喔！你已经通过最后一次测验，你已经成为了精神使者的继承者！
dialogsComplete.de: Willkommen Nachfolger. Du hast den letzten Test bestanden! Nun werde ich dich zum Nachfolger des Psykeeper Helden ernennen!
dialogsComplete.fi: Welcome, Magician. Your journey to becoming a Psykeeper is now complete. I now appoint you, a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero!
dialogsComplete.fil: Welcome, Magician. Your journey to becoming a Psykeeper is now complete. I now appoint you, a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero!
dialogsComplete.fr: Bienvenue à Gardiane. Tu as réussi brillamment la dernière épreuve et mérites désormais d'être l'un des successeurs du Héros des Sorciers.
dialogsComplete.id: Selamat datang, Penyihir. Perjalananmu untuk menjadi seorang Psykeeper telah selesai. Saya sekarang menunjukmu, Penerus Psykeeper Hero!
dialogsComplete.it: Welcome, Magician. Your journey to becoming a Psykeeper is now complete. I now appoint you, a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero!
dialogsComplete.jp: 後継者よ。汝は最後の試練を乗り越えた。これからはサイキーパー後継者として新たな道を歩むがよい！古き神々の叡智が汝の額に宿るであろう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 잘 오셨습니다, 매지션님. 사이키퍼가 되는 여정이 끝났군요. 이제 당신을 사이키퍼 영웅의 후계자로 임명하겠습니다!
dialogsComplete.nl: Welcome, Magician. Your journey to becoming a Psykeeper is now complete. I now appoint you, a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero!
dialogsComplete.pl: Welcome, Magician. Your journey to becoming a Psykeeper is now complete. I now appoint you, a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero!
dialogsComplete.ru: Прекрасно! Испытания позади. Объявляю тебя манипулятором!
dialogsComplete.sp: Bienvenido, Magician. Tu viaje por convertirte en Psykeeper ha finalizado. ¡Te nombro Sucesor de la Héroe Psykeeper!
dialogsComplete.sw: Welcome, Magician. Your journey to becoming a Psykeeper is now complete. I now appoint you, a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero!
dialogsComplete.th: ยินดีต้อนรับหมอผี การเดินทางสู่การเป็น Psykeeper เสร็จสมบูรณ์แล้ว ตอนนี้ผมได้แต่งตั้งคุณเป็นผู้สืบทอดฮีโร่ Psykeeper!
dialogsComplete.tw: 恭喜你喔！你已經通過最後一次測驗，你已經成為了念力師的繼承者！
dialogsComplete.vi: Chào mừng, Magician. Hành trình trở thành Psykeeper của bạn đã hoàn tất. Bây giờ tôi chỉ định bạn làNgười kế vị của Anh hùng Psykeeper!

dialogsComplete.en: Offerep, please guide and protect this brave soul who is following in your path, Psykeeper!
dialogsComplete.ar: Offerep, please guide and protect this brave soul who is following in your path, Psykeeper!
dialogsComplete.br: Offerep, por favor abençoe e encoraje esta pessoa que está seguindo a sua vontade! Psykeeper!
dialogsComplete.cns: 欧布华啊！这里有要继承你的人，祝福他吧！
dialogsComplete.de: Offerep, bitte segne und ermutige diese Person, die deinem Geist folgen möchte! Psykeeper!
dialogsComplete.fi: Offerep, please guide and protect this brave soul who is following in your path, Psykeeper!
dialogsComplete.fil: Offerep, please guide and protect this brave soul who is following in your path, Psykeeper!
dialogsComplete.fr: Offerep, puisses-tu bénir et soutenir en tout temps cette personne ici qui dédie sa vie à ta volonté !
dialogsComplete.id: Offerep, tolong bimbing dan lindungi jiwa pemberani ini yang mengikuti jalanmu, Psykeeper!
dialogsComplete.it: Offerep, please guide and protect this brave soul who is following in your path, Psykeeper!
dialogsComplete.jp: ＜閉じられし瞳＞オルファーよ、今ここに新たな後継者が誕生しました！この者に祝福と勇気を授けたまえ！
dialogsComplete.kr: 오퍼엡이시여, 이 길을 따르는 용감한 영혼을 축복하고 인도해 주시길. 사이키퍼!
dialogsComplete.nl: Offerep, please guide and protect this brave soul who is following in your path, Psykeeper!
dialogsComplete.pl: Offerep, please guide and protect this brave soul who is following in your path, Psykeeper!
dialogsComplete.ru: О, великий Коверфильд! Благослови этого человека и дай ему силы исполнить твою волю!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Offerep, por favor guía y protege a esta valiente alma que sigue tu camino, Psykeeper!
dialogsComplete.sw: Offerep, please guide and protect this brave soul who is following in your path, Psykeeper!
dialogsComplete.th: Offerep กรุณาแนะนำและปกป้องชีวิตที่กล้าหาญนี้ผู้ติดตามเส้นทางของคุณ Psykeeper!
dialogsComplete.tw: 歐布華啊！這裡有要繼承你的人，祝福他吧！
dialogsComplete.vi: Xin hãy chỉ dẫn và bảo vệ linh hồn dũng cảm đang đi theo con đường của bạn, Psykeeper!

dialogsFail.en: I am awaiting a new Successor to the Psykeeper Hero. If that is you, I believe you may be forgetting something, young one.
dialogsFail.ar: I am awaiting a new Successor to the Psykeeper Hero. If that is you, I believe you may be forgetting something, young one.
dialogsFail.br: Somente aquele que for reconhecido como um sucessor poderá entrar aqui. Volte.
dialogsFail.cns: 这里只有英雄的继承者才可以进入喔，请回去吧！
dialogsFail.de: Nur derjenige, der als Nachfolger anerkannt wurde, darf passieren. Geh zurück.
dialogsFail.fi: I am awaiting a new Successor to the Psykeeper Hero. If that is you, I believe you may be forgetting something, young one.
dialogsFail.fil: I am awaiting a new Successor to the Psykeeper Hero. If that is you, I believe you may be forgetting something, young one.
dialogsFail.fr: Seuls ceux reconnus comme successeurs d'Offerep sont admis ici. Poursuis ton apprentissage...
dialogsFail.id: Saya sedang menunggu Penerus baru Pahlawan Psykeeper. Jika itu kamu, aku yakin kamu mungkin melupakan sesuatu, anak muda.
dialogsFail.it: I am awaiting a new Successor to the Psykeeper Hero. If that is you, I believe you may be forgetting something, young one.
dialogsFail.jp: ここは英雄の後継者として認められた者のみが立ち入ることを許される、資格のないものは即刻立ち去るがよい･･･。
dialogsFail.kr: 사이키퍼 영웅의 새로운 후계자를 기다리는 중입니다. 당신이 후계자라면, 뭔가 잊어버린 게 있을 것 같은데요.
dialogsFail.nl: I am awaiting a new Successor to the Psykeeper Hero. If that is you, I believe you may be forgetting something, young one.
dialogsFail.pl: I am awaiting a new Successor to the Psykeeper Hero. If that is you, I believe you may be forgetting something, young one.
dialogsFail.ru: Я жду того, кого смогу назвать манипулятором. Тебе для этого кое-чего не хватает.
dialogsFail.sp: Estoy esperando a un nuevo Sucesor de la Héroe Psykeeper. Si eres tú, creo que te olvidas de algo, joven.
dialogsFail.sw: I am awaiting a new Successor to the Psykeeper Hero. If that is you, I believe you may be forgetting something, young one.
dialogsFail.th: ฉันกำลังรอผู้สืบทอดฮีโร่ Psykeeper คนใหม่ ถ้าเป็นคุณ ฉันเชื่อว่าคุณอาจจะลืมอะไรบางอย่าง
dialogsFail.tw: 這裡只有英雄的繼承者才可以進入喔，請回去吧！
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi đang chờ một Người kế vị mới cho Anh hùng Psykeeper. Nếu đó là bạn, tôi tin rằng bạn có thể quên điều gì đó, bạn trẻ à.

name.br: Caçando Monstros para recuperar o Karma
name.cns: 击杀怪物以减少罪恶值
name.fil: Mangaso ng Halimaw para makarecover ng Karma
name.jp: モンスターを狩ってカルマを回復させる
name.pl: Polowanie na potwory aby odzyskać Karmę
name.sp: Derrota a los Monstruos para recuperar Karma.
name.th: ล่ามอนสเตอร์เพื่อฟื้นค่า Karma
name.tw: 狩獵怪物以讓紅人狀態消失
name.vi: Săn quái vật để phục hồi Karma

description.en: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.ar: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.br: Caçando $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ recuperará seus pontos de Karma.
description.cns: 为了减少你的罪恶值，你要去击杀 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 回来。
description.de: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ jagen wird dein Karma wiederherstellen.
description.fi: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.fil: Ang Pang-huhuli ng $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ay makakapagpanumbalik ng iyong Karma points.
description.fr: Tu devrais chasser des $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s afin de récupérer les points de Karma.
description.id: Berburu $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ akan memulihkan poin-poin Karmamu.
description.it: Stai cacciando $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ per recuperare i tuoi punti Karma.
description.jp: カルマポイントを回復するため、$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を処罰して来てください。
description.nl: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.pl: Polowanie na $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ pozwoli odzyskać punkty Karmy.
description.ru: Твоя цель - $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, только так ты очистишь карму.
description.sp: Cazar $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ recuperará tus puntos de Karma.
description.sw: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.th: การล่า $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ จะกู้คืนคะแนน Karma ของคุณ
description.tw: 狩獵 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 將會恢復你的惡名點數。
description.vi: Săn $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ sẽ phục hồi điểm Karma của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsDecline.en: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.ar: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.br: Você ainda tem que pagar pelos seus pecados...
dialogsDecline.cns: 你还没有为你的罪恶付出代价...
dialogsDecline.de: Du musst noch immer für deine Sünden bezahlen...
dialogsDecline.fi: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.fil: Di mo pa bayad ang iyong mga kasalanan…
dialogsDecline.fr: Quand expieras-tu tes nombreux crimes ?
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu belum membayar untuk dosa-dosamu…
dialogsDecline.it: Devi ancora pagare per i tuoi peccati...
dialogsDecline.jp: いつになったら、この底知れぬ罪悪感から抜けられるのだろう？
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신은 아직 죗값을 치르지 않았으니...
dialogsDecline.nl: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.pl: Musisz najpierw zapłacić za swoje grzechy…
dialogsDecline.ru: Велики твои грехи…
dialogsDecline.sp: Todavía tienes que pagar por tus pecados...
dialogsDecline.sw: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.th: คุณยังไม้ได้ชดใช้บาปของคุณ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 你還沒有為你的罪付出代價…
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn vẫn chưa phải trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình…

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.br: Sua missão foi concluída. Seus pecados foram perdoados.
dialogsComplete.cns: 任务完成，你的罪恶已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Buße getan. Deine Sünden wurden dir vergeben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Questmu telah tercapai. Dosa-dosamu telah diampuni.
dialogsComplete.it: La Missione è terminata. I tuoi peccati sono stati perdonati.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 끝났습니다. 당신의 죄를 용서하지요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Боги одобрили твое деяние и простили тебе грехи.
dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น บาปของคุณได้รับการอภัยแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nhiệm vụ của bạn đã được hoàn thành. Tội lỗi của bạn đã được tha thứ.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

name.th: เครื่องจักรเก่า

description.en: The entrance to Azria was once an industrious place. It is now overrun by ancient machines. Help me bring down their numbers so other travelers may enter this place more safely.
description.ar: The entrance to Azria was once an industrious place. It is now overrun by ancient machines. Help me bring down their numbers so other travelers may enter this place more safely.
description.br: A entrada para Azria já foi um lugar muito industrializado. Agora está cheio de máquinas antigas que ganharam vida com o poder de Shade. Ajude-me a diminuir o número delas para que outros viajantes possam entrar neste lugar com mais segurança.
description.cns: 阿兹利亚的入口曾经是一个行人络绎不绝的地方。它现在被古老的机器所侵占。帮助我减少它们的数量，以便其他旅行者可以更安全地进入。
description.de: Der Eingang zu Azria war einst ein geschäftiger Ort. Jetzt ist er von uralten Maschinen überlaufen. Hilf mir, deren Zahlen zu verringern, damit andere Reisende diesen Ort sicherer betreten können.
description.fi: The entrance to Azria was once an industrious place. It is now overrun by ancient machines. Help me bring down their numbers so other travelers may enter this place more safely.
description.fil: The entrance to Azria was once an industrious place. It is now overrun by ancient machines. Help me bring down their numbers so other travelers may enter this place more safely.
description.fr: L'entrée d'Azria était jadis une zone industrielle. Elle est désormais envahie de vieilles machines. Aidez-moi à en éliminer pour que les autres voyageurs puissent venir ici en toute sécurité.
description.id: Pintu masuk ke Azria dulunya merupakan tempat yang rajin. Sekarang dikuasai oleh mesin kuno. Bantu saya menurunkan nomor mereka sehingga wisatawan lain dapat memasuki tempat ini dengan lebih aman.
description.it: The entrance to Azria was once an industrious place. It is now overrun by ancient machines. Help me bring down their numbers so other travelers may enter this place more safely.
description.jp: アズリアの入り口はかつて平穏な場所でした。それは今、古代の機械に蹂躙されています。他の旅人がより安全にここへたどり着けるよう、モンスターの数を減らすのを手伝っていただけませんか？
description.kr: 아즈리아의 입구는 한때 아주 번성했던 곳이었어요. 지금은 고대 기계들이 점령하고 있지만요. 다른 여행자들이 여기까지 안전하게 올 수 있도록, 저희를 도와 녀석들의 수를 줄여주세요.
description.nl: The entrance to Azria was once an industrious place. It is now overrun by ancient machines. Help me bring down their numbers so other travelers may enter this place more safely.
description.pl: The entrance to Azria was once an industrious place. It is now overrun by ancient machines. Help me bring down their numbers so other travelers may enter this place more safely.
description.ru: The entrance to Azria was once an industrious place. It is now overrun by ancient machines. Help me bring down their numbers so other travelers may enter this place more safely.
description.sp: La entrada a Azria fue una vez un lugar laborioso. Ahora está invadido por máquinas antiguas. Ayúdame a reducir sus números para que otros viajeros puedan ingresar de manera más segura.
description.sw: The entrance to Azria was once an industrious place. It is now overrun by ancient machines. Help me bring down their numbers so other travelers may enter this place more safely.
description.th: ทางเข้า Azria ครั้งหนึ่งเคยเป็นสถานที่ที่มีความอุตสาหะ ปัจจุบันถูกย่ำยีด้วยเครื่องจักรโบราณ ช่วยฉันลดจำนวนของพวกเขาลง เพื่อให้นักท่องเที่ยวคนอื่นๆ เข้ามาที่นี่ได้อย่างปลอดภัยยิ่งขึ้น
description.tw: 阿茲里亞的入口曾經是一個忙碌的地方，它現在被古老的機器所侵占。幫助我降低他們的數量，以便其他旅行者可更安全地進入這個地方。
description.vi: Lối vào Azria từng là một nơi công nghiệp. Bây giờ nó đã bị phá hủy bởi những cỗ máy cổ xưa. Giúp tôi ghi lại số của chúng để những du khách khác có thể vào nơi này an toàn hơn.

dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsDecline.en: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.ar: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.br: Você ainda tem que pagar pelos seus pecados...
dialogsDecline.cns: 你还没有为你的罪恶付出代价...
dialogsDecline.de: Du musst noch immer für deine Sünden bezahlen...
dialogsDecline.fi: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.fil: Di mo pa bayad ang iyong mga kasalanan…
dialogsDecline.fr: Quand expieras-tu tes nombreux crimes ?
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu belum membayar untuk dosa-dosamu…
dialogsDecline.it: Devi ancora pagare per i tuoi peccati...
dialogsDecline.jp: いつになったら、この底知れぬ罪悪感から抜けられるのだろう？
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신은 아직 죗값을 치르지 않았으니...
dialogsDecline.nl: You have yet to pay for your sins…

dialogsDecline.th: คุณยังไม้ได้ชดใช้บาปของคุณ...

dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn vẫn chưa phải trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình…

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.br: Sua missão foi concluída. Seus pecados foram perdoados.
dialogsComplete.cns: 任务完成，你的罪恶已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Buße getan. Deine Sünden wurden dir vergeben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Questmu telah tercapai. Dosa-dosamu telah diampuni.
dialogsComplete.it: La Missione è terminata. I tuoi peccati sono stati perdonati.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 끝났습니다. 당신의 죄를 용서하지요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Боги одобрили твое деяние и простили тебе грехи.
dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น บาปของคุณได้รับการอภัยแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nhiệm vụ của bạn đã được hoàn thành. Tội lỗi của bạn đã được tha thứ.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

name.jp: 覚醒 -セラス・ウリエル-

description.en: Collect 5 pieces of the broken key in the Mars Mine and return to Dr. Estly.
description.ar: Collect 5 pieces of the broken key in the Mars Mine and return to Dr. Estly.
description.br: Por favor, colete 5 fragmentos da chave quebrada em algum lugar dentro da Masmorra Mars, e traga-os para mim.
description.cns: 在魔域密殿入的内部一定可以找的到魔法钥匙碎块，总共有5个！帮我找齐那5个魔法钥匙碎块！
description.de: Bitte sammle 5 Pieces of the Broken Key irgendwo in Mas Dungeon und bring sie mir.
description.fi: Collect 5 pieces of the broken key in the Mars Mine and return to Dr. Estly.
description.fil: Collect 5 pieces of the broken key in the Mars Mine and return to Dr. Estly.
description.fr: Rassembler les 5 Morceaux de la clé à la Mine de Mas.
description.id: Kumpulkan 5 buah broken key di Tambang Mars dan kembalikan ke Dr. Estly.
description.it: Collect 5 pieces of the broken key in the Mars Mine and return to Dr. Estly.
description.jp: フラリスダンジョン内にある鍵の欠片を5個、集めてきましょう。
description.kr: 마스 마인 내에서 부서진 열쇠 조각 5개를 모아 이스틀리 박사에게 돌아가세요.
description.nl: Collect 5 pieces of the broken key in the Mars Mine and return to Dr. Estly.
description.pl: Collect 5 pieces of the broken key in the Mars Mine and return to Dr. Estly.
description.ru: Нужно найти для доктора Если пять частей сломанной шестеренки в Марсовой шахте.
description.sp: Recoge 5 trozos de la llave rota en la Mina Mars y llévaselos al Dr. Estly.
description.sw: Collect 5 pieces of the broken key in the Mars Mine and return to Dr. Estly.
description.th: รวบรวมกุญแจที่หัก 5 ชิ้นใน Mars Mine แล้วกลับไปหา Dr. Estly
description.tw: 在瑪斯礦坑的內部一定可以找的到魔法鑰匙碎塊，總共有 5 個！幫我找齊那 5 個魔法鑰匙碎塊後回到 Dr. 法小林。
description.vi: Thu thập 5 mảnh vỡ của chiếc chìa khóa trong Mars Mine và trả lại cho Tiến sĩ Estly.

dialogsBegin.en: Now I'm sure it's what I feared. I still I can't do anything about it. I need evidence... Hmm...
dialogsBegin.ar: Now I'm sure it's what I feared. I still I can't do anything about it. I need evidence... Hmm...
dialogsBegin.br: Agora tenho certeza, mas ainda não posso fazer nada. Eu preciso de provas... Hmm...
dialogsBegin.cns: 事情还有转寰的余地！！不过，还需要更多的证据才行！
dialogsBegin.de: Nun bin ich mir sicher, aber ich kann nichts tun. Ich brauch einen Beweis.. Hmm..
dialogsBegin.fi: Now I'm sure it's what I feared. I still I can't do anything about it. I need evidence... Hmm...
dialogsBegin.fil: Now I'm sure it's what I feared. I still I can't do anything about it. I need evidence... Hmm...
dialogsBegin.fr: Maintenant j'en suis convaincu... mais je ne peux toujours rien y faire. J'ai besoin de preuves... Hmm...
dialogsBegin.id: Sekarang saya yakin itu yang saya takutkan. Aku masih tidak bisa berbuat apa-apa. Aku butuh bukti... Hmm...
dialogsBegin.it: Now I'm sure it's what I feared. I still I can't do anything about it. I need evidence... Hmm...
dialogsBegin.jp: おかげで確信が持てました。え？確信だけでは動けないって？証拠ですか…かの封印が解かれたと仮定して……ふむふむ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 역시 제 예감이 맞았어요. 하지만 아직 아무것도 확실하지는 않아요. 증거가 필요해요… 흠…
dialogsBegin.nl: Now I'm sure it's what I feared. I still I can't do anything about it. I need evidence... Hmm...
dialogsBegin.pl: Now I'm sure it's what I feared. I still I can't do anything about it. I need evidence... Hmm...
dialogsBegin.ru: Мои опасения подтверждаются... Но все-таки... Все-таки... Осталась последняя надежда...
dialogsBegin.sp: Ahora estoy seguro de que es lo que temía. Todavía no puedo hacer nada al respecto. Necesito pruebas... Mmm...
dialogsBegin.sw: Now I'm sure it's what I feared. I still I can't do anything about it. I need evidence... Hmm...
dialogsBegin.th: ตอนนี้ฉันแน่ใจแล้วว่ามันเป็นสิ่งที่ฉันกลัว ฉันยังไม่สามารถทำอะไรกับมันได้ ฉันต้องการหลักฐาน... อืม...
dialogsBegin.tw: 事情還有轉寰的餘地！！不過，還需要更多的證據才行！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bây giờ tôi chắc chắn đó là điều tôi lo sợ. Tôi vẫn không thể làm bất cứ thứ gì. Tôi cần bằng chứng ... Hừm ...
