dialogsBegin.en: Yes! That's it! There must be evidence in the Mars Mine! We have to find it!
dialogsBegin.ar: Yes! That's it! There must be evidence in the Mars Mine! We have to find it!
dialogsBegin.br: Sim! É isso! Deve haver provas na Masmorra Mars! Nós precisamos encontrá-las!!!
dialogsBegin.cns: Yes! That's it! There must be evidence in the Mars Mine! We have to find it!
dialogsBegin.de: Ja! Das ist es! Es muss einen Beweis im Mas Dungeon geben! Wir müssen ihn finden!!!
dialogsBegin.fi: Yes! That's it! There must be evidence in the Mars Mine! We have to find it!
dialogsBegin.fil: Yes! That's it! There must be evidence in the Mars Mine! We have to find it!
dialogsBegin.fr: Oui ! C'est ça ! Il doit y avoir des preuves disséminées dans la Mine de Mas ! Nous devons les trouver !!!
dialogsBegin.id: Ya! Itu dia! Pasti ada bukti di Mars Mine! Kita harus menemukannya!!!
dialogsBegin.it: Yes! That's it! There must be evidence in the Mars Mine! We have to find it!
dialogsBegin.jp: フラリスダンジョンには、＜恐怖の幻影＞が封印されていました。もし封印が解かれたのなら、封印に使用されていた魔法の鍵が破壊されたはずです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 좋아요! 바로 그거예요! 분명 마스 마인에 증거가 있을 거예요! 그걸 찾아야 해요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Yes! That's it! There must be evidence in the Mars Mine! We have to find it!
dialogsBegin.pl: Yes! That's it! There must be evidence in the Mars Mine! We have to find it!
dialogsBegin.ru: Yes! That's it! There must be evidence in the Mars Mine! We have to find it!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Sí! ¡Eso es! ¡La prueba tiene que estar dentro de la Mina Mars! ¡¡¡Tenemos que encontrarla!!!
dialogsBegin.sw: Yes! That's it! There must be evidence in the Mars Mine! We have to find it!
dialogsBegin.th: ใช่ แค่นั้นแหละ! ต้องมีหลักฐานใน Mars Mine! เราต้องหามัน!!!
dialogsBegin.tw: 沒錯！就是這個！瑪斯礦坑裡一定有證據！我們必須找到它！
dialogsBegin.vi: Đúng! Chính nó! Trong Mars Mine đương nhiên phải còn bằng chứng! Chúng ta phải tìm ra nó!

dialogsBegin.en: If the seal is broken, the broken pieces of the magic key must be there.
dialogsBegin.ar: If the seal is broken, the broken pieces of the magic key must be there.
dialogsBegin.br: Se o selo está quebrado, os fragmentos da chave mágica devem estar lá.
dialogsBegin.cns: 如果封印赛罗斯蛇妖的地方出了问题，那么一定是魔法钥匙碎块在那附近。
dialogsBegin.de: Wenn das Siegel gebrochen wurde, müssen dort Bruchstücke vom Magic Key liegen.
dialogsBegin.fi: If the seal is broken, the broken pieces of the magic key must be there.
dialogsBegin.fil: If the seal is broken, the broken pieces of the magic key must be there.
dialogsBegin.fr: Si le sceau a été brisé, des fragments de la clé magique ont dû y être éparpillés.
dialogsBegin.id: Jika segel rusak, potongan kunci ajaib yang rusak harus ada di sana.
dialogsBegin.it: If the seal is broken, the broken pieces of the magic key must be there.
dialogsBegin.jp: フラリスダンジョン内に散らばった＜鍵の破片＞を集めてきてください。それが私の想像を裏付ける、決定的な証拠になるはずです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 만약 봉인이 풀렸다면, 마법 열쇠가 부서진 조각이 그 근처에 있을 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: If the seal is broken, the broken pieces of the magic key must be there.
dialogsBegin.pl: If the seal is broken, the broken pieces of the magic key must be there.
dialogsBegin.ru: Когда Фобию изгнали из этого мира, ее логово надежно заперли специальным механизмом, вынули из него одну шестеренку и разбили ее на пять частей.
dialogsBegin.sp: Si el sello está roto, los trozos rotos de la llave mágica deben estar allí.
dialogsBegin.sw: If the seal is broken, the broken pieces of the magic key must be there.
dialogsBegin.th: ถ้าผนึกแตก ชิ้นส่วนของกุญแจวิเศษที่หักจะต้องอยู่ที่นั่น
dialogsBegin.tw: 如果封印賽羅斯的地方出了問題，那麼一定是魔法鑰匙碎塊在那附近。
dialogsBegin.vi: Nếu phong ấn bị phá vỡ, các mảnh vỡ của chìa khóa ma thuật ắt hẳn phải ở đó.

dialogsBegin.en: Now I know what we must do! Would you please help me once more, friend?
dialogsBegin.ar: Now I know what we must do! Would you please help me once more, friend?
dialogsBegin.br: Agora vejo o que preciso fazer. Você me ajudaria, por favor?
dialogsBegin.cns: 好人做到底！再帮我这一次吧！
dialogsBegin.de: Nun weiß ich, was ich tun muss. Würdest du mir helfen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Now I know what we must do! Would you please help me once more, friend?
dialogsBegin.fil: Now I know what we must do! Would you please help me once more, friend?
dialogsBegin.fr: Maintenant je vois ce que je dois faire. M'aideras-tu ?
dialogsBegin.id: Sekarang saya tahu apa yang harus kita lakukan! Maukah kamu membantu saya sekali lagi, teman?
dialogsBegin.it: Now I know what we must do! Would you please help me once more, friend?
dialogsBegin.jp: ＜鍵の破片＞を集めてくれますか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 이제 우리가 해야 할 일이 분명해졌네요! 한 번 더 도와주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Now I know what we must do! Would you please help me once more, friend?
dialogsBegin.pl: Now I know what we must do! Would you please help me once more, friend?
dialogsBegin.ru: Обломки должны быть где-то в Марсовой шахте. Попробуешь отыскать их?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Ahora sé lo que debemos hacer! ¿Me ayudarás una vez más, amigo?
dialogsBegin.sw: Now I know what we must do! Would you please help me once more, friend?
dialogsBegin.th: ตอนนี้ฉันรู้แล้วว่าเราต้องทำอะไร! ช่วยฉันอีกได้มั้ย?
dialogsBegin.tw: 好人做到底！再幫我這一次吧！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bây giờ tôi biết chúng ta phải làm gì! Bạn vui lòng giúp tôi một lần nữa được không, người bạn?

dialogsAccept.en: Thank you! Collect the 5 pieces of the broken key somewhere in the Mars Mine, and return to me

dialogsComplete.en: It's all clear now. It is exactly what I was afraid of. Serus Uriel has returned. The Phantom of Fear.
dialogsComplete.ar: It's all clear now. It is exactly what I was afraid of. Serus Uriel has returned. The Phantom of Fear.

dialogsComplete.nl: It's all clear now. It is exactly what I was afraid of. Serus Uriel has returned. The Phantom of Fear.

dialogsComplete.sw: It's all clear now. It is exactly what I was afraid of. Serus Uriel has returned. The Phantom of Fear.
dialogsComplete.th: ทุกอย่างชัดเจนแล้ว มันเป็นสิ่งที่ฉันกลัว Serus Uriel กลับมาแล้ว ปีศาจแห่งความกลัว

dialogsBegin.en: Please take this pendant to Reonan. This will serve as a symbol of my unyielding devotion to our cause…
dialogsBegin.ar: Please take this pendant to Reonan. This will serve as a symbol of my unyielding devotion to our cause…
dialogsBegin.br: Por favor, leve este pingente para Reonan. Isso servirá como um símbolo de minha devoção inflexível à nossa causa…
dialogsBegin.cns: 请把这个吊坠带给瑞尔南。这将作为我对我们不屈不挠的象征...
dialogsBegin.de: Bitte bringen Sie diesen Anhänger zu Reonan. Er wird als Symbol für meine unnachgiebige Hingabe an unsere Sache dienen...
dialogsBegin.fi: Please take this pendant to Reonan. This will serve as a symbol of my unyielding devotion to our cause…
dialogsBegin.fil: Please take this pendant to Reonan. This will serve as a symbol of my unyielding devotion to our cause…
dialogsBegin.fr: Tous les Héros ont fait comme moi dans leur vie précédente. On est jamais trop prudent.
dialogsBegin.id: Silakan bawa pendant ini ke Reonan. Ini akan berfungsi sebagai simbol pengabdian saya yang pantang menyerah untuk tujuan kita ...
dialogsBegin.it: Please take this pendant to Reonan. This will serve as a symbol of my unyielding devotion to our cause…
dialogsBegin.jp: そうだ。そのペンダントをレオナンに渡してください。彼もきっと貴方のことを信頼しているのでしょう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 펜던트를 레오난에게 전해 주세요. 대의를 향해, 절대 꺾이지 않는 우리의 의지를 상징하는 증표니까요...
dialogsBegin.nl: Please take this pendant to Reonan. This will serve as a symbol of my unyielding devotion to our cause…
dialogsBegin.pl: Please take this pendant to Reonan. This will serve as a symbol of my unyielding devotion to our cause…
dialogsBegin.ru: Please take this pendant to Reonan. This will serve as a symbol of my unyielding devotion to our cause…
dialogsBegin.sp: Por favor, llévale este colgante a Reonan. Esto servirá como símbolo de mi inquebrantable devoción a nuestra causa...
dialogsBegin.sw: Please take this pendant to Reonan. This will serve as a symbol of my unyielding devotion to our cause…
dialogsBegin.th: กรุณานำจี้นี้ไปให้ Reonan จี้จะทำหน้าที่เป็นสัญลักษณ์ของความจงรักภักดีไม่ยอมแพ้...
dialogsBegin.tw: 請將墜飾拿去給雷奧南吧。這將成為我們冒險旅程不屈不撓的奉獻精神的象徵……
dialogsBegin.vi: Hãy mang mặt dây chuyền này đến Reonan. Đây sẽ là biểu tượng cho sự tận tâm kiên cường của tôi cho sự nghiệp của chúng ta…

dialogsBegin.en: Oh! You have yet to collect Zoro's pendant! Go and retrieve it from him as well! Once you have done this, please take them both to Reonan.
dialogsBegin.ar: Oh! You have yet to collect Zoro's pendant! Go and retrieve it from him as well! Once you have done this, please take them both to Reonan.
dialogsBegin.br: Oh! Você também precisa coletar o Pingente do Zoro! Vá e pegue o dele também! Depois de fazer isso, leve os dois para Reonan.
dialogsBegin.cns: 哦！你还没有找到佐罗的吊坠！去他那里拿回来吧。当你拿到了，就把它们都带给瑞尔南。
dialogsBegin.de: Oh! Du musst noch den Anhänger von Zoro einsammeln! Geht und holt ihn euch auch von ihm! Sobald du das getan hast, bringst du sie bitte beide zu Reonan.
dialogsBegin.fi: Oh! You have yet to collect Zoro's pendant! Go and retrieve it from him as well! Once you have done this, please take them both to Reonan.
dialogsBegin.fil: Oh! You have yet to collect Zoro's pendant! Go and retrieve it from him as well! Once you have done this, please take them both to Reonan.
dialogsBegin.fr: Cette amulette, une fois utilisée, ne contient plus de pouvoir mais nous allons l'utiliser comme un symbole.
dialogsBegin.id: Oh! Kamu belum mengumpulkan Zoro's pendant! Pergi dan ambil darinya juga! Setelah kamu melakukan ini, bawa keduanya ke Reonan.
dialogsBegin.it: Oh! You have yet to collect Zoro's pendant! Go and retrieve it from him as well! Once you have done this, please take them both to Reonan.
dialogsBegin.jp: ゾロもペンダントを持っていると思います。私達のペンダントを見せればレオナンも安心するでしょう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 오, 아직 조로의 펜던트를 못 받으셨군요? 어서 가서 받아오세요. 펜던트 두 개를 모두 모으면 꼭 레오난에게 전해주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Oh! You have yet to collect Zoro's pendant! Go and retrieve it from him as well! Once you have done this, please take them both to Reonan.
dialogsBegin.pl: Oh! You have yet to collect Zoro's pendant! Go and retrieve it from him as well! Once you have done this, please take them both to Reonan.
dialogsBegin.ru: Oh! You have yet to collect Zoro's pendant! Go and retrieve it from him as well! Once you have done this, please take them both to Reonan.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Oh! ¡Todavía tienes que conseguir el colgante de Zoro! ¡Ve y consigue el suyo también! Una vez que lo hayas hecho, llévaselos a Reonan.
dialogsBegin.sw: Oh! You have yet to collect Zoro's pendant! Go and retrieve it from him as well! Once you have done this, please take them both to Reonan.
dialogsBegin.th: โอ้วว! คุณยังไม่ได้เก็บจี้ Zoro! ไปและเอาคืนมาจากเขาด้วย! เมื่อคุณทำเรียบร้อยแล้วโปรดนำทั้งคู่ไปหา Reonan
dialogsBegin.tw: 哦！你還沒有收集到索羅的墜飾！也要去從他那裡取回！完成此操作後，請將它們都帶到雷奧南。
dialogsBegin.vi: Ồ! Bạn vẫn chưa thu thập được mặt dây chuyền của Zoro! Đi và lấy nó từ anh ta luôn! Khi bạn đã hoàn thành việc này, vui lòng đưa cả hai đến Reonan.

dialogsAccept.en: Zoro is waiting! Please go and gather his pendant as well. I'm sure once you show him mine, he will gladly hand it over.
dialogsAccept.ar: Zoro is waiting! Please go and gather his pendant as well. I'm sure once you show him mine, he will gladly hand it over.
dialogsAccept.br: Zoro está esperando! Por favor, vá e pegue o pingente dele também. Tenho certeza de que, uma vez que você mostre a ele o meu, ele o entregará o dele com prazer.
dialogsAccept.cns: 佐罗在等着呢! 请你也去找他的吊坠。我相信一旦你给他看了我的，他就会高兴地把它交出来。
dialogsAccept.de: Zoro wartet! Bitte geh und hole auch seinen Anhänger. Ich bin sicher, wenn du ihm meinen zeigst, wird er ihn dir gerne geben.
dialogsAccept.fi: Zoro is waiting! Please go and gather his pendant as well. I'm sure once you show him mine, he will gladly hand it over.
dialogsAccept.fil: Zoro is waiting! Please go and gather his pendant as well. I'm sure once you show him mine, he will gladly hand it over.
dialogsAccept.fr: Allez voir Zoro, il doit avoir le même genre de pendentif.
dialogsAccept.id: Zoro sedang menunggu! Silakan pergi dan kumpulkan pendant nya juga. Saya yakin begitu Anda menunjukkan milik saya kepadanya, dia akan dengan senang hati menyerahkannya.
dialogsAccept.it: Zoro is waiting! Please go and gather his pendant as well. I'm sure once you show him mine, he will gladly hand it over.
dialogsAccept.jp: ゾロはまだ山奥にいるようです。さあ、ぜひそのペンダントを渡して下さい。
dialogsAccept.kr: 조로가 당신을 기다리고 있어요! 그의 펜던트도 받아 와 주세요. 제 펜던트를 보여주면, 기꺼이 내줄 거예요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Zoro is waiting! Please go and gather his pendant as well. I'm sure once you show him mine, he will gladly hand it over.
dialogsAccept.pl: Zoro is waiting! Please go and gather his pendant as well. I'm sure once you show him mine, he will gladly hand it over.
dialogsAccept.ru: Zoro is waiting! Please go and gather his pendant as well. I'm sure once you show him mine, he will gladly hand it over.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Zoro te está esperando! Por favor, ve y recupera su colgante también. Estoy seguro de que una vez que le muestres el mío, con mucho gusto te lo entregará.
dialogsAccept.sw: Zoro is waiting! Please go and gather his pendant as well. I'm sure once you show him mine, he will gladly hand it over.
dialogsAccept.th: Zoro กำลังรอ! กรุณาไปและรวบรวมจี้ของเขาเช่นกัน ฉันจะแน่ใจเมื่อคุณแสดงให้เขาเห็น เขายินดีที่จะมอบมันให้
dialogsAccept.tw: 索羅在等！請也去收集他的墜飾。我敢肯定，一旦你把我的給他看，他會很樂意把它交出來的。
dialogsAccept.vi: Zoro đang đợi! Hãy đi và thu thập mặt dây chuyền của anh ấy. Tôi chắc rằng một khi bạn cho anh ấy xem dây chuyền của tôi, anh ấy sẽ sẵn lòng giao nó.

dialogsDecline.en: Please, we must get the pendants to Reonan to let him know we are ready to fight side by side!
dialogsDecline.ar: Please, we must get the pendants to Reonan to let him know we are ready to fight side by side!
dialogsDecline.br: Por favor, devemos levar os pingentes para Reonan para que ele saiba que estamos prontos para lutar lado a lado!
dialogsDecline.cns: 拜托了，我们必须把吊坠送到瑞尔南那里，让他知道我们已经准备好并肩作战了。
dialogsDecline.de: Bitte, wir müssen die Anhänger zu Reonan bringen, um ihn wissen zu lassen, dass wir bereit sind, Seite an Seite zu kämpfen!
dialogsDecline.fi: Please, we must get the pendants to Reonan to let him know we are ready to fight side by side!

dialogsDecline.jp: そのペンダントは英雄の証。私達の誇りなのです。
dialogsDecline.kr: 제발, 펜던트를 레오난에게 전해 주세요. 우리가 함께 싸울 준비가 되었다는 걸 알리고 싶어요!
dialogsDecline.nl: Please, we must get the pendants to Reonan to let him know we are ready to fight side by side!
dialogsDecline.pl: Please, we must get the pendants to Reonan to let him know we are ready to fight side by side!
dialogsDecline.ru: Please, we must get the pendants to Reonan to let him know we are ready to fight side by side!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Tenemos que llevarle los colgantes a Reonan para que sepa que estamos listos para luchar codo con codo!
dialogsDecline.sw: Please, we must get the pendants to Reonan to let him know we are ready to fight side by side!
dialogsDecline.th: เราจะต้องได้รับจี้เพื่อให้กับ Reonan เพื่อให้เขารู้ว่าเราพร้อมที่จะต่อสู้เคียงข้างกัน!
dialogsDecline.tw: 拜託，我們必須把墜飾交給雷奧南，讓他知道我們已經準備好並肩作戰！
dialogsDecline.vi: Làm ơn, chúng ta phải đưa mặt dây chuyền cho Reonan để cho anh ấy biết chúng ta đã sẵn sàng chiến đấu cùng nhau!

dialogsComplete.en: Oh Oh! That is Elaine's pendant! So I see you were able to get him to reconsider?
dialogsComplete.ar: Oh Oh! That is Elaine's pendant! So I see you were able to get him to reconsider?
dialogsComplete.br: Ah! Esse é o pingente de Elaine! Então eu vejo que você foi capaz de convencê-lo!
dialogsComplete.cns: Oh Oh! That is Elaine's pendant! So I see you were able to get him to reconsider?
dialogsComplete.de: Oh, oh! Das ist der Anhänger von Elaine! Wie ich sehe, konntest du ihn dazu bringen, es sich anders zu überlegen?
dialogsComplete.fi: Oh Oh! That is Elaine's pendant! So I see you were able to get him to reconsider?
dialogsComplete.fil: Oh Oh! That is Elaine's pendant! So I see you were able to get him to reconsider?
dialogsComplete.fr: Oooh cette amulette ! Vous avez réussi à convaincre Alain !
dialogsComplete.id: Oh Oh! Itu adalah Elaine's pendant! Jadi kamu benar-benar bisa membuatnya untuk mempertimbangkan kembali??
dialogsComplete.it: Oh Oh! That is Elaine's pendant! So I see you were able to get him to reconsider?
dialogsComplete.jp: おお、君がそのペンダントを持っているということはエルラインを説得できたのだね！
dialogsComplete.kr: 오오! 일레인의 펜던트잖아요! 그의 마음을 돌리는 데 성공했나 보군요?
dialogsComplete.nl: Oh Oh! That is Elaine's pendant! So I see you were able to get him to reconsider?
dialogsComplete.pl: Oh Oh! That is Elaine's pendant! So I see you were able to get him to reconsider?
dialogsComplete.ru: Oh Oh! That is Elaine's pendant! So I see you were able to get him to reconsider?
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Oh vaya! ¡Ese es el colgante de Elaine! Veo que has conseguido convencerlo.
dialogsComplete.sw: Oh Oh! That is Elaine's pendant! So I see you were able to get him to reconsider?
dialogsComplete.th: โอ้ โอ้วว! นั่นคือจี้ของ Elaine! มันน่าจะทำให้เขาคิดใหม่ได้นะ?
dialogsComplete.tw: 喔喔！那是耶拉伊的墜飾！所以你成功讓他重新考慮了？
dialogsComplete.vi: Ồ ồ! Đó là mặt dây chuyền của Elaine mà! Bạn đã khiến anh ta suy nghĩ lại à?

dialogsFail.en: Hurry! I'm sure Zoro is waiting!
dialogsFail.ar: Hurry! I'm sure Zoro is waiting!
dialogsFail.br: Depressa! Tenho certeza que Zoro está esperando!
dialogsFail.cns: 快点！佐罗等不及了!
dialogsFail.de: Beeil dich! Ich bin sicher, Zoro wartet schon!
dialogsFail.fi: Hurry! I'm sure Zoro is waiting!
dialogsFail.fil: Hurry! I'm sure Zoro is waiting!
dialogsFail.fr: Ne faites pas attendre Zoro.
dialogsFail.id: Cepat! Aku yakin Zoro sedang menunggu!
dialogsFail.it: Hurry! I'm sure Zoro is waiting!
dialogsFail.jp: ゾロもペンダントを持っていると思います。私達のペンダントを見せればレオナンも安心するでしょう。
dialogsFail.kr: 서둘러요! 조로가 기다리고 있을 텐데!
dialogsFail.nl: Hurry! I'm sure Zoro is waiting!
dialogsFail.pl: Hurry! I'm sure Zoro is waiting!
dialogsFail.ru: Hurry! I'm sure Zoro is waiting!
dialogsFail.sp: ¡Rápido! ¡Seguro que Zoro está esperando!
dialogsFail.sw: Hurry! I'm sure Zoro is waiting!
dialogsFail.th: รีบหน่อย ! ฉันแน่ใจว่า Zoro กำลังรออยู่!
dialogsFail.tw: 索羅正在等你。
dialogsFail.vi: Nhanh chân lên! Tôi chắc chắn rằng Zoro đang đợi!

name.th: ผู้สืบทอดของฮีโร่ -Guardian-
name.tw: 英雄的繼承者 - 守護者

description.en: Defeat the Venel Guardian, take his heart, and present it to Boneper the Knight Guardian.
description.ar: Defeat the Venel Guardian, take his heart, and present it to Boneper the Knight Guardian.
description.br: Derrote o espírito, Guardião Venel, e obtenha seu coração.  Visite então Boneper, que é a Guardiã Knight.
description.cns: 去圣堂的守护之室打守护兽贝纳卡度温获得他的心脏之后，请你再去找[骑士守护使者]波内佩拉！
description.de: Besiege den Wächtergeist Venel Guardian und beschaffe sein Herz. Dann besuche Boneper, den Knight Wächter.
description.fi: Defeat the Venel Guardian, take his heart, and present it to Boneper the Knight Guardian.
description.fil: Defeat the Venel Guardian, take his heart, and present it to Boneper the Knight Guardian.
description.fr: Vaincre Venel et ramener son cœur à la Gardienne des Chevaliers, Boneper.
description.id: Kalahkan Venel Guardian, ambil hatinya, dan berikan kepada Boneper the Knight Guardian.
description.it: Defeat the Venel Guardian, take his heart, and present it to Boneper the Knight Guardian.
description.jp: ガルディアの守護者の部屋にいる守護精霊＜ヴェネル・ガーディアン＞のハートを手に入れ、ナイト守護者ボネペルに会おう。
description.kr: 수호 정령 베넬가디언을 처치하고 심장을 손에 넣으세요. 그다음, 나이트 수호자 보네페르님께 전달하세요.
description.nl: Defeat the Venel Guardian, take his heart, and present it to Boneper the Knight Guardian.
description.pl: Defeat the Venel Guardian, take his heart, and present it to Boneper the Knight Guardian.
description.ru: Нужно победить Виндигго и принести его сердце вместе со знаком героя Бонни, хранительнице гладиаторов.
description.sp: Derrota al Guardián Venel, consigue su corazón y llévaselo a Boneper, la Guardiana Knight.
description.sw: Defeat the Venel Guardian, take his heart, and present it to Boneper the Knight Guardian.
description.th: เอาชนะ Venel Guardian และเอาหัวใจของมันไปมอบให้ Knight Guardian ที่ชื่อ Boneper
description.tw: 去守護者祭壇的守護者之室打守護獸貝納卡度溫獲得他的心臟之後，請你再去找騎士守護者 [波內佩拉]！
description.vi: Đánh bại Venel Guardian, lấy trái tim của anh ta và đưa nó cho Boneper the Knight Guardian.

dialogsBegin.en: This is the Mark of Heroes. It is a special sigil from the Guardian of the Knight’s Altar that denotes the wearer as a successor of Knight Hero.
dialogsBegin.ar: This is the Mark of Heroes. It is a special sigil from the Guardian of the Knight’s Altar that denotes the wearer as a successor of Knight Hero.
dialogsBegin.br: Aqui está o símbolo do herói. É o comprovante para ser reconhecido pelo guardião do herói como um sucessor.
dialogsBegin.cns: 这能证明你是英雄骑士的继承者，但还需要另一个证明，了解你真正的实力！
dialogsBegin.de: Hier ist das Symbol der Helden. Es ist ein Beleg, dass dich durch den Wächter des Helden als Nachfolger bestätigt.
dialogsBegin.fi: This is the Mark of Heroes. It is a special sigil from the Guardian of the Knight’s Altar that denotes the wearer as a successor of Knight Hero.
dialogsBegin.fil: This is the Mark of Heroes. It is a special sigil from the Guardian of the Knight’s Altar that denotes the wearer as a successor of Knight Hero.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je peux maintenant te confier le Sceau des Héros, qui confirme que tu as relevé avec succès tous les défis qui se sont présentés.
dialogsBegin.id: Ini adalah Tanda Pahlawan. Ini adalah sigil khusus dari Guardian of the Knight's Altar yang menunjukkan pemakainya sebagai penerus Knight Hero.
dialogsBegin.it: This is the Mark of Heroes. It is a special sigil from the Guardian of the Knight’s Altar that denotes the wearer as a successor of Knight Hero.
dialogsBegin.jp: じゃあ、これが英雄の証だよ。これは英雄の守護者に後継者の資格を示す証の一つなのさ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이건 영웅의 증표랍니다. 나이트 제단의 수호자가 주는 특별한 인장이죠. 이 증표를 지니고 있으면, 나이트 영웅의 후계자로 인정받을 수 있어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: This is the Mark of Heroes. It is a special sigil from the Guardian of the Knight’s Altar that denotes the wearer as a successor of Knight Hero.
dialogsBegin.pl: This is the Mark of Heroes. It is a special sigil from the Guardian of the Knight’s Altar that denotes the wearer as a successor of Knight Hero.
dialogsBegin.ru: Это Знак героя. Он означает, что его владелец является истинным наследником героя-гладиатора.
dialogsBegin.sp: Esta es la Marca de los Héroes. Es una marca especial del Altar del Knight que denota al usuario como sucesor del Héroe Knight.
dialogsBegin.sw: This is the Mark of Heroes. It is a special sigil from the Guardian of the Knight’s Altar that denotes the wearer as a successor of Knight Hero.
dialogsBegin.th: นี่คือ Mark of Heroes เป็นสัญลักษณ์พิเศษจาก Guardian of the Knight's Altar ซึ่งหมายถึงผู้สวมใส่มันจะเป็นผู้สืบทอดของ Knight Hero
dialogsBegin.tw: 這是英雄印記，由騎士祭壇守護者授予的特殊徽記，代表持有者是騎士英雄的繼承者。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đây là Dấu ấn của các Heroes. Đó là một biểu tượng đặc biệt từ Guardian of the Knight’s Altar cho thấy người đeo nó là người kế vị của Knight Hero.

dialogsBegin.en: You only need one more item to finally become a Knight. You will find it in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.ar: You only need one more item to finally become a Knight. You will find it in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.br: Para poder ser completamente reconhecido como um sucessor, você precisa de mais um comprovante. Os guardiões ficam em Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.cns: 距离成为骑士只差最后一个物品了。你会在圣堂找到它。
dialogsBegin.de: Um vollständig als Nachfolger anerkannt zu werden, brauchst du noch einen Beleg. Er ist in Guardiane, wo die Wächter sind, zu finden.
dialogsBegin.fi: You only need one more item to finally become a Knight. You will find it in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.fil: You only need one more item to finally become a Knight. You will find it in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.fr: Cependant, tu ne pourras devenir un Chevalier que si tu réussi la dernière épreuve de ton apprentissage.
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu hanya membutuhkan satu item lagi untuk akhirnya menjadi seorang Knight. Kamu akan menemukannya di Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.it: You only need one more item to finally become a Knight. You will find it in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.jp: 後継者として完全に認められるためには、もう一つの証が必要なんだ。それを手に入れるにはガルディアに行かなくちゃね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이제 단 한 가지만 더 있으면 진정한 나이트가 될 수 있답니다. 가르디안으로 가세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: You only need one more item to finally become a Knight. You will find it in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.pl: You only need one more item to finally become a Knight. You will find it in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.ru: Твоя судьба скоро решится. Но не здесь, а в Гардиане.
dialogsBegin.sp: Solo necesitas un objeto más para convertirte en Knight. Lo encontrarás en Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.sw: You only need one more item to finally become a Knight. You will find it in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณต้องการของเพียงแค่อีกอย่างหนึ่งก็สามารถเป็น Knight ได้แล้ว คุณจะพบมันได้ใน Guardiane
dialogsBegin.tw: 為了成為繼承者，還要更艱鉅的挑戰等著你！你要找的最後一樣東西就在守護者祭壇。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn chỉ cần thêm một vật phẩm nữa để cuối cùng trở thành Knight. Bạn sẽ tìm thấy nó trong Guardiane.

dialogsBegin.en: In Guardiane, in the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the Venel Guardian.
dialogsBegin.ar: In Guardiane, in the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the Venel Guardian.
dialogsBegin.br: Há um local em Guardiane chamado Sala do Guardião. Nesse local você encontrará um espírito chamado Guardião Venel.
dialogsBegin.cns: 就在圣堂的守护之室，那里会看到一个叫贝纳卡度温的守护兽！
dialogsBegin.de: In Guardiane, im Raum des Wächters, findest du einen Geist namens Venel Guardian.
dialogsBegin.fi: In Guardiane, in the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the Venel Guardian.
dialogsBegin.fil: In Guardiane, in the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the Venel Guardian.
dialogsBegin.fr: Au sud de Darkon 3, à Gardiane, se trouve un lieu appelé la Chambre du Gardien.
dialogsBegin.id: Di Guardiane, di Guardian's Room, Kamu akan menemukan roh yang disebut Venel Guardian.
dialogsBegin.it: In Guardiane, in the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the Venel Guardian.
dialogsBegin.jp: ガルディアの守護者の部屋には英雄たちの紋章があって、そこには英雄たちの意志が保存されているんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 가르디안에 있는 수호자의 방에, 베넬가디언이라는 수호 정령이 있습니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: In Guardiane, in the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the Venel Guardian.
dialogsBegin.pl: In Guardiane, in the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the Venel Guardian.
dialogsBegin.ru: In Guardiane, in the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the Venel Guardian.
dialogsBegin.sp: En Guardiane, en la Habitación del Guardián, encontrarás un espíritu llamado Guardián Venel.
dialogsBegin.sw: In Guardiane, in the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the Venel Guardian.
dialogsBegin.th: ที่ Guardiane ในห้อง Room of Guardians คุณจะพบวิญญาณที่เรียกว่า Venel Guardian
dialogsBegin.tw: 就在守護者祭壇的守護者之室，那裡保存著英雄的意志！
dialogsBegin.vi: Ở Guardiane, trong Guardian's Room, bạn sẽ tìm thấy một tinh linh được gọi là Venel Guardian.

dialogsBegin.en: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.ar: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.br: Derrote o espírito e obtenha seu coração. O coração será o comprovante do seu último teste.
dialogsBegin.cns: 击败它，拿走它的心脏。这是最后的考验了
dialogsBegin.de: Besiegt diesen Geist und nehmt sein Herz. Dies wird deine letzte Prüfung sein.
dialogsBegin.fi: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.fil: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il te faut y pénétrer et vaincre l'esprit qui s'y trouve. Il s'agit de ta dernière épreuve !
dialogsBegin.id: Kalahkan roh ini, dan ambil hatinya. Ini akan menjadi ujian terakhirmu.
dialogsBegin.it: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.jp: この守護者の部屋にいるヴェネル・ガーディアンを倒して、ヴェネル・ハートを取らなきゃいけないんだ。そしてそのハートが最後の証なのさ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그 정령을 쓰러뜨리고 심장을 손에 넣으세요. 이게 마지막 시험이에요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.pl: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.ru: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.sp: Derrota a ese espíritu y consigue su corazón. Esta es tu prueba final.
dialogsBegin.sw: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.th: เอาชนะวิญญาณตนนี้ และเอาหัวใจของมันมา นี่เป็นการทดสอบครั้งสุดท้ายของคุณ
dialogsBegin.tw: 打敗這個靈魂，奪取他的心。這將是你最後的考驗。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đánh bại tinh linh này, và lấy trái tim của nó. Đây sẽ là bài kiểm tra cuối cùng của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Boneper, the Knight Guardian.
dialogsBegin.ar: Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Boneper, the Knight Guardian.
dialogsBegin.br: Visite então Boneper, que é o guardião Knight.
dialogsBegin.cns: 完成此任务后，将心脏交给[骑士守护使者]波内佩拉 ！
dialogsBegin.de: Dann besuche Boneper, den Knight Wächter.
dialogsBegin.fi: Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Boneper, the Knight Guardian.
dialogsBegin.fil: Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Boneper, the Knight Guardian.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu pourras alors te présenter à la Gardienne des Chevaliers, Boneper.
dialogsBegin.id: Setelah kamu menyelesaikan tugas ini, berikan hati kepada Boneper, Penjaga Ksatria.
dialogsBegin.it: Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Boneper, the Knight Guardian.
dialogsBegin.jp: それを手に入れたらナイト守護者ボネペルのもとに行ってください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 임무를 끝내면, 손에 넣은 심장을 나이트 수호자 보네페르님께 전달하세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Boneper, the Knight Guardian.
dialogsBegin.pl: Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Boneper, the Knight Guardian.
dialogsBegin.ru: Отнеси сердце Бонни, хранительнице гладиаторов. Что скажешь, борец? По плечу ли тебе такая схватка?
dialogsBegin.sp: Una vez que hayas terminado, entrega el Corazón a Boneper, la Guardiana Knight.
dialogsBegin.sw: Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Boneper, the Knight Guardian.
dialogsBegin.th: เมื่อคุณเสร็จสิ้นภารกิจนี้แล้ว จงมอบหัวใจ Knight Guardian ที่ชื่อ Boneper
dialogsBegin.tw: 完成挑戰後，別忘了面見騎士守護者 [波內佩拉]！
dialogsBegin.vi: Khi bạn đã hoàn thành nhiệm vụ này, hãy đưa trái tim cho Boneper, Knight Guardian.

dialogsAccept.en: I wish you luck, Mercenary!
dialogsAccept.ar: I wish you luck, Mercenary!
dialogsAccept.br: Eu lhe desejo sorte.
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你成功喔！
dialogsAccept.de: Ich wünsche dir viel Erfolg.
dialogsAccept.fi: I wish you luck, Mercenary!
dialogsAccept.fil: I wish you luck, Mercenary!

dialogsDecline.en: You’re almost finished, Mercenary. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.ar: You’re almost finished, Mercenary. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.br: Você veio até aqui, e agora está desistindo? Este é o último passo, por favor pense cuidadosamente.
dialogsDecline.cns: 你已经快完成了，战士，不要在此处放弃
dialogsDecline.de: Du bist fast fertig, Mercenary. Geben Sie jetzt nicht auf.
dialogsDecline.fi: You’re almost finished, Mercenary. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.fil: You’re almost finished, Mercenary. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.fr: Après avoir traversé tant d'épreuves, tu es sur le point d'abandonner ? Ceci est la dernière étape, réfléchis bien...
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu hampir selesai, Mercenary. Jangan menyerah sekarang.
dialogsDecline.it: You’re almost finished, Mercenary. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.jp: ここまできて、全部諦めちゃうの？そりゃないよ～。これで最後なんだから、もう一度よく考えなよ！
dialogsDecline.kr: 거의 다 왔어요. 지금 포기하면 아깝잖아요.
dialogsDecline.nl: You’re almost finished, Mercenary. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.pl: You’re almost finished, Mercenary. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.ru: You’re almost finished, Mercenary. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.sp: Ya casi has terminado, Mercenary. No te rindas ahora.
dialogsDecline.sw: You’re almost finished, Mercenary. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณใกล้จะทำสำเร็จแล้วนะ Mercenary อย่าพึ่งยอมแพ้สิ
dialogsDecline.tw: 你快完成了，勇者，現在別放棄。
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn sắp hoàn thành, Mercenary. Đừng bỏ cuộc ngay lúc này.

dialogsComplete.en: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Knight upon you.
dialogsComplete.ar: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Knight upon you.
dialogsComplete.br: Bom trabalho! Agora, oficialmente, concedo a você o título de Knight.
dialogsComplete.cns: 恭喜你！你已经通过最后的测验，你成为骑士的继承者了！
dialogsComplete.de: Willkommen Nachfolger. Du hast den letzten Test bestanden! Du bist nun offiziell ein Nachfolger des Knight.
dialogsComplete.fi: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Knight upon you.
dialogsComplete.fil: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Knight upon you.
dialogsComplete.fr: Bienvenue à Gardiane. Tu as réussi brillamment la dernière épreuve et mérites désormais d'être l'un des successeurs du Héros des Chevaliers.
dialogsComplete.id: Bagus sekali! Saya sekarang secara resmi memberikan gelar Ksatria kepadamu.
dialogsComplete.it: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Knight upon you.
dialogsComplete.jp: 後継者よ。汝は最後の試練を乗り越えた。これからはナイト後継者として新たな道を歩むがよい！奏でる天球の音楽が汝をたたえるであろう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 훌륭하네요! 이제 당신에게 나이트의 칭호를 정식으로 수여하겠습니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Knight upon you.
dialogsComplete.pl: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Knight upon you.
dialogsComplete.ru: Прекрасно! Объявляю тебя гладиатором!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Bien hecho! Ahora te otorgo oficialmente el título de Knight.
dialogsComplete.sw: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Knight upon you.
dialogsComplete.th: ทำได้ดี! ตอนนี้ฉันได้ตำแหน่ง Knight ให้คุณอย่างเป็นทางการแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 恭喜你！你已經通過最後的測驗，你成為騎士的繼承者了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Làm tốt lắm! Bây giờ tôi chính thức ban tặng danh hiệu Knight cho bạn.

dialogsComplete.en: Billaon, please bless and encourage this Knight as they follow your will!
dialogsComplete.ar: Billaon, please bless and encourage this Knight as they follow your will!
dialogsComplete.br: Billaon, por favor abençoe e encoraje esta pessoa que está seguindo a sua vontade!! Knight!
dialogsComplete.cns: 毕雷恩啊！这里有要继承你的人，祝福它吧！
dialogsComplete.de: Billaon, bitte segne und ermutige diese Person, die deinem Willen folgen möchte! Knight!
dialogsComplete.fi: Billaon, please bless and encourage this Knight as they follow your will!
dialogsComplete.fil: Billaon, please bless and encourage this Knight as they follow your will!
dialogsComplete.fr: Billein, puisses-tu bénir et soutenir en tout temps cette personne ici qui dédie sa vie à ta volonté !
dialogsComplete.id: Billaon, tolong berkati dan dorong Ksatria ini saat mereka mengikuti keinginanmu!
dialogsComplete.it: Billaon, please bless and encourage this Knight as they follow your will!
dialogsComplete.jp: ＜鉄壁の豪腕＞ビレリアンよ、今ここに新たな後継者が誕生しました！この者に祝福と勇気を授けたまえ！
dialogsComplete.kr: 빌레이언이시여, 이 나이트가 당신의 뜻을 따를 수 있도록 축복과 격려를 내려주소서!
dialogsComplete.nl: Billaon, please bless and encourage this Knight as they follow your will!
dialogsComplete.pl: Billaon, please bless and encourage this Knight as they follow your will!
dialogsComplete.ru: О, Максимилианус! Дай этому гладиатору сил исполнить твою волю!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Billaon, por favor bendice y dale valor a este Knight que seguirá tu voluntad!
dialogsComplete.sw: Billaon, please bless and encourage this Knight as they follow your will!
dialogsComplete.th: Billaon โปรดอวยพรและให้การช่วยเหลือ Knight คนนี้ตามที่คุณต้องการด้วยเถิด!
dialogsComplete.tw: 畢雷恩啊！這裡有要繼承你的人，祝福它吧！
dialogsComplete.vi: Billaon, hãy chúc phúc và khích lệ Knight khi họ làm theo ý muốn của bạn!

dialogsBegin.en: Still not ringing any bells. Though, the name is familiar… Maybe Master Radeon can tell you something about the name. He took me in over 20 years ago and has been my mentor since.
dialogsBegin.ar: Still not ringing any bells. Though, the name is familiar… Maybe Master Radeon can tell you something about the name. He took me in over 20 years ago and has been my mentor since.
dialogsBegin.br: Ainda não me recordo de nada. No entanto, o nome é familiar... Talvez o Mestre Radeon possa lhe dizer algo sobre o nome. Ele me acolheu há mais de 20 anos e tem sido meu mentor desde então.
dialogsBegin.cns: 还是没能回忆起任何东西。虽然，这个名字很熟悉..可能大师拉迪温可以告诉你关于这个名字的一些事情。他在20多年前接待了我并自那以后就一直是我的导师。
dialogsBegin.de: Da klingelt immer noch nichts. Aber der Name kommt mir bekannt vor... Vielleicht kann dir Meister Radeon etwas über den Namen sagen. Er nahm mich vor über 20 Jahren auf und ist seitdem mein Mentor.
dialogsBegin.fi: Still not ringing any bells. Though, the name is familiar… Maybe Master Radeon can tell you something about the name. He took me in over 20 years ago and has been my mentor since.
dialogsBegin.fil: Still not ringing any bells. Though, the name is familiar… Maybe Master Radeon can tell you something about the name. He took me in over 20 years ago and has been my mentor since.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je ne suis pas convaincu. Je voudrais savoir si ce travail ne va pas me coûter la vie.
dialogsBegin.id: Masih tidak mengingatkan apapun. Padahal, namanya sudah tidak asing lagi... Mungkin Master Radeon dapat memberi tahumu sesuatu tentang nama itu. Dia membawa saya sejak lebih dari 20 tahun yang lalu dan telah menjadi mentor saya sejak saat itu.
dialogsBegin.it: Still not ringing any bells. Though, the name is familiar… Maybe Master Radeon can tell you something about the name. He took me in over 20 years ago and has been my mentor since.
dialogsBegin.jp: なぜだろう。記憶の片隅には残っているようだが思い出せない……。おそらく私の師ラディオン様なら何かわかるのではないだろうか。
dialogsBegin.kr: 아직도 아무 생각이 안 나는데. 하지만 그 이름, 어딘가 낯익어요... 마스터 라데온이라면 뭔가 이야기해 줄 수 있을 거예요. 20여 년 전 저를 거둬주셨고, 지금까지도 제 스승님이거든요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Still not ringing any bells. Though, the name is familiar… Maybe Master Radeon can tell you something about the name. He took me in over 20 years ago and has been my mentor since.
dialogsBegin.pl: Still not ringing any bells. Though, the name is familiar… Maybe Master Radeon can tell you something about the name. He took me in over 20 years ago and has been my mentor since.
dialogsBegin.ru: Still not ringing any bells. Though, the name is familiar… Maybe Master Radeon can tell you something about the name. He took me in over 20 years ago and has been my mentor since.
dialogsBegin.sp: Todavía no suena ninguna campana. Pero, el nombre me resulta familiar... Tal vez el Maestro Radeon pueda decirte algo sobre el nombre. Me acogió hace más de 20 años y ha sido mi mentor desde entonces.
dialogsBegin.sw: Still not ringing any bells. Though, the name is familiar… Maybe Master Radeon can tell you something about the name. He took me in over 20 years ago and has been my mentor since.
dialogsBegin.th: กริ่งระฆังยังไม่ดังเลย  แม้ว่าชื่อที่คุ้นเคย ... บางที Radeon สามารถบอกคุณบางอย่างเกี่ยวกับชื่อ เขาพาฉันไปเมื่อ 20 ปีที่แล้วและเป็นที่ปรึกษาของฉันตั้งแต่นั้นมา
dialogsBegin.tw: 還是什麼都想不起來，不過這名字確實很耳熟……也許拉迪溫大人能告訴你一些線索。二十多年前是他收留了我，從那之後他就一直是我的導師。
dialogsBegin.vi: Vẫn không rung bất kỳ tiếng chuông nào. Mặc dù vậy, cái tên này rất quen thuộc… Có lẽ Master Radeon có thể cho bạn biết điều gì đó về cái tên. Anh ấy đã đưa tôi đến hơn 20 năm trước và là người cố vấn cho tôi kể từ đó.

dialogsBegin.en: I can hardly remember what I had for breakfast. Go talk with Master Radeon alright? I'm sure he might know something…
dialogsBegin.ar: I can hardly remember what I had for breakfast. Go talk with Master Radeon alright? I'm sure he might know something…
dialogsBegin.br: Mal consigo me lembrar do que comi no café da manhã. Vá falar com o Mestre Radeon, beleza? Tenho certeza que ele pode saber de alguma coisa...
dialogsBegin.cns: 我几乎都想不起来我早餐吃了什么了。去和大师拉迪温谈一谈行吗？我相信他应该知道些什么...
dialogsBegin.de: Ich kann mich kaum noch daran erinnern, was ich zum Frühstück hatte. Geh und rede mit Meister Radeon, okay? Ich bin sicher, er weiß etwas...
dialogsBegin.fi: I can hardly remember what I had for breakfast. Go talk with Master Radeon alright? I'm sure he might know something…
dialogsBegin.fil: I can hardly remember what I had for breakfast. Go talk with Master Radeon alright? I'm sure he might know something…
dialogsBegin.fr: Allez donc voir le grand sage Radeon pour qu'il lise mon avenir.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya hampir tidak dapat mengingat apa yang saya makan saat sarapan tado. Bicaralah dengan Master Radeon, oke? Saya yakin dia mungkin tahu sesuatu ...
dialogsBegin.it: I can hardly remember what I had for breakfast. Go talk with Master Radeon alright? I'm sure he might know something…
dialogsBegin.jp: すまない、ラディオン様にこのことを報告してくれないか。師はすぐそばにいるのだが、私は頭痛がひどく動けそうにないのだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 전 아침에 뭘 먹었는지도 가물가물 하다고요. 마스터 라데온에게 가 보시면 어때요? 뭔가 알고 있을지도 몰라요...
dialogsBegin.nl: I can hardly remember what I had for breakfast. Go talk with Master Radeon alright? I'm sure he might know something…
dialogsBegin.pl: I can hardly remember what I had for breakfast. Go talk with Master Radeon alright? I'm sure he might know something…
dialogsBegin.ru: I can hardly remember what I had for breakfast. Go talk with Master Radeon alright? I'm sure he might know something…
dialogsBegin.sp: Apenas puedo recordar lo que desayuné. Ve a hablar con el Maestro Radeon, ¿vale? Estoy seguro de que él sabrá algo...
dialogsBegin.sw: I can hardly remember what I had for breakfast. Go talk with Master Radeon alright? I'm sure he might know something…
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันแทบจะไม่สามารถจำได้ว่าฉันทานอาหารเช้าไปแค่ไหน ไปพูดคุยกับ Master Radeon ใช่มั้ย? ฉันแน่ใจว่าเขาอาจจะรู้อะไรบางอย่าง ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 我連今天早餐吃了什麼都快想不起來了。你去和拉迪溫大人談談，好嗎？我很確定他應該知道些什麼……
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi hầu như không thể nhớ những gì tôi đã ăn sáng. Đi nói chuyện với Master Radeon được không? Tôi chắc rằng anh ấy có thể biết điều gì đó…

dialogsAccept.en: Wow, seems like my headache is already lifting knowing I got you out of my hair. Master Radeon is on the other side of the Fountain of the Dead. Go see him!
dialogsAccept.ar: Wow, seems like my headache is already lifting knowing I got you out of my hair. Master Radeon is on the other side of the Fountain of the Dead. Go see him!
dialogsAccept.br: Uau, parece que minha dor de cabeça já está melhorando sabendo que me livrei de você. Mestre Radeon está do outro lado da Fonte dos Mortos. Vá vê-lo!
dialogsAccept.cns: 哇，当我不再想你的事情之后，我的头就没那么疼了。大师拉迪温就在亡者之泉的另一边。去见他吧！
dialogsAccept.de: Wow, ich glaube, meine Kopfschmerzen sind schon wieder weg, jetzt, wo ich dich los bin. Meister Radeon ist auf der anderen Seite der Fountain of the Dead. Geh zu ihm!
dialogsAccept.fi: Wow, seems like my headache is already lifting knowing I got you out of my hair. Master Radeon is on the other side of the Fountain of the Dead. Go see him!
dialogsAccept.fil: Wow, seems like my headache is already lifting knowing I got you out of my hair. Master Radeon is on the other side of the Fountain of the Dead. Go see him!
dialogsAccept.fr: Sans l'assurance que ça ne va pas me tuer, je n'accepterai pas cette proposition.
dialogsAccept.id: Wow, sepertinya sakit kepalaku sudah sembuh setelah mengetahui aku mengeluarkanmu dari rambutku. Master Radeon berada di sisi lain dari Fountain of the Dead. Pergi temui dia!
dialogsAccept.it: Wow, seems like my headache is already lifting knowing I got you out of my hair. Master Radeon is on the other side of the Fountain of the Dead. Go see him!
dialogsAccept.jp: ひょっとするとこの頭痛の原因もわかるかもしれない。すまないが、頼んだぞ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 휴, 당신이 떠난다고 하니 벌써 두통이 사라지는 기분이에요. 마스터 라데온은 망자의 샘 반대편에 있어요. 어서 가 보세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Wow, seems like my headache is already lifting knowing I got you out of my hair. Master Radeon is on the other side of the Fountain of the Dead. Go see him!
dialogsAccept.pl: Wow, seems like my headache is already lifting knowing I got you out of my hair. Master Radeon is on the other side of the Fountain of the Dead. Go see him!
dialogsAccept.ru: Wow, seems like my headache is already lifting knowing I got you out of my hair. Master Radeon is on the other side of the Fountain of the Dead. Go see him!
dialogsAccept.sp: Wow, parece que mi dolor de cabeza ya se está quitando al saber que te vas a ir. El Maestro Radeon está al otro lado del Manantial de Almas. ¡Ve a verlo!
dialogsAccept.sw: Wow, seems like my headache is already lifting knowing I got you out of my hair. Master Radeon is on the other side of the Fountain of the Dead. Go see him!
dialogsAccept.th: ว้าว ดูเหมือนว่าอาการปวดศีรษะของฉันลุกขึ้นแล้วรู้ว่าฉันได้รับคุณออกจากผม Master Radeon อยู่ด้านอื่น ๆ ของ Fountain of the Dead ไปพบเขา!
dialogsAccept.tw: 哇，光是把你打發走，我的頭痛好像都減輕不少了。拉迪溫大人就在亡者之泉的另一頭，快去見他吧！
dialogsAccept.vi: Chà, có vẻ như cơn đau đầu của tôi đã tăng lên khi biết tôi đã loại bạn khỏi mái tóc của tôi. Master Radeon đang ở phía bên kia của Fountain of the Dead. Đi gặp anh ấy!

dialogsBegin.en: Ahh! So you are here for Elaine? Of course I know who he is, Elaine is the president of our Environmental Group...
dialogsBegin.ar: Ahh! So you are here for Elaine? Of course I know who he is, Elaine is the president of our Environmental Group...
dialogsBegin.br: Ahh! Então você está aqui por Elaine? Claro que eu sei quem ele é, Elaine é o presidente do nosso Grupo Ambiental.
dialogsBegin.cns: Ahh! So you are here for Elaine? Of course I know who he is, Elaine is the president of our Environmental Group...
dialogsBegin.de: Ahh! Du bist also wegen Elaine hier? Natürlich weiß ich, wer das ist, Elaine ist die Vorsitzende unserer Umweltgruppe...
dialogsBegin.fi: Ahh! So you are here for Elaine? Of course I know who he is, Elaine is the president of our Environmental Group...
dialogsBegin.fil: Ahh! So you are here for Elaine? Of course I know who he is, Elaine is the president of our Environmental Group...
dialogsBegin.fr: C'est Alain, le garde forestier qui vous envoie ?
dialogsBegin.id: Ahh! Jadi, kamu di sini untuk Elaine? Tentu saja saya tahu siapa dia, Elaine adalah pimpinan Environmental Group kami..
dialogsBegin.it: Ahh! So you are here for Elaine? Of course I know who he is, Elaine is the president of our Environmental Group...
dialogsBegin.jp: 何ですって、エルラインがそんなことを言っていたの？う～ん、正直なところ彼が会長を辞任してしまうと困るのよね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 아! 일레인 때문에 오셨군요? 당연히 누군지 알죠. 일레인은 우리 환경 단체의 회장이거든요...
dialogsBegin.nl: Ahh! So you are here for Elaine? Of course I know who he is, Elaine is the president of our Environmental Group...
dialogsBegin.pl: Ahh! So you are here for Elaine? Of course I know who he is, Elaine is the president of our Environmental Group...
dialogsBegin.ru: Ahh! So you are here for Elaine? Of course I know who he is, Elaine is the president of our Environmental Group...
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Ah! ¿Así que estás aquí por Elaine? Por supuesto que sé quién es, Elaine es la presidenta de nuestra Asociación Ambiental...
dialogsBegin.sw: Ahh! So you are here for Elaine? Of course I know who he is, Elaine is the president of our Environmental Group...
dialogsBegin.th: อ่า! คุณอยู่ที่นี่เพื่อ Elaine ? แน่นอน ฉันรู้ว่าเขาเป็นใคร, Elaine เป็นประธานกลุ่มสิ่งแวดล้อมของเรา
dialogsBegin.tw: 啊！所以你是來找耶拉伊的？我當然知道他是誰，耶拉伊可是我們環保團體的會長……
dialogsBegin.vi: À! Vậy bạn ở đây để tìm Elaine à? Tất nhiên tôi biết đó là ai, Elaine là chủ tịch của Environmental Group của chúng tôi...

dialogsBegin.en: What? He is resigning as president? Hmm… this is a bad news... He kept things stable around here. What will happen if he is not here!
dialogsBegin.ar: What? He is resigning as president? Hmm… this is a bad news... He kept things stable around here. What will happen if he is not here!
dialogsBegin.br: O que? Ele está renunciando como presidente? Hmm... isso é uma má notícia... Ele manteve as coisas estáveis por aqui. Não sei o que pode acontecer se ele não estiver aqui!
dialogsBegin.cns: What? He is resigning as president? Hmm… this is a bad news... He kept things stable around here. What will happen if he is not here!
dialogsBegin.de: Was? Er tritt als Präsident zurück? Hmm... das ist eine schlechte Nachricht.. Er hat die Dinge hier stabil gehalten. Was wird passieren, wenn er nicht mehr da ist?
dialogsBegin.fi: What? He is resigning as president? Hmm… this is a bad news... He kept things stable around here. What will happen if he is not here!
dialogsBegin.fil: What? He is resigning as president? Hmm… this is a bad news... He kept things stable around here. What will happen if he is not here!
dialogsBegin.fr: Comment ??? Il démissionne ? Mais il faisait un travail excellent, il aime ce métier !
dialogsBegin.id: Apa? Dia mengundurkan diri? Hmm... ini adalah berita buruk.. Dia menjaga semuanya tetap stabil di sini. Apa yang akan terjadi jika dia tidak ada di sini!
dialogsBegin.it: What? He is resigning as president? Hmm… this is a bad news... He kept things stable around here. What will happen if he is not here!
dialogsBegin.jp: そうか、それは悪いニュースだ。彼以上にダーコンの環境のことを考えている人はいない。でも……そうだな、確かに貴方の言う通り。でも彼がいなくなったらどうするんだ？
dialogsBegin.kr: 네? 사임한다고요? 흐음... 안 좋은 소식이네요... 이곳을 잘 이끌어 주셨는데. 앞으로 우린 어떻게 되는 거죠!
dialogsBegin.nl: What? He is resigning as president? Hmm… this is a bad news... He kept things stable around here. What will happen if he is not here!
dialogsBegin.pl: What? He is resigning as president? Hmm… this is a bad news... He kept things stable around here. What will happen if he is not here!
dialogsBegin.ru: What? He is resigning as president? Hmm… this is a bad news... He kept things stable around here. What will happen if he is not here!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Qué? ¿Renuncia como presidente? Hmm... esta es una mala noticia... Mantuvo las cosas muy estables en este tiempo. ¡Qué pasará si él no está aquí!
dialogsBegin.sw: What? He is resigning as president? Hmm… this is a bad news... He kept things stable around here. What will happen if he is not here!
dialogsBegin.th: อะไร? เขาลาออกในตำแหน่งประธาน? อืม ... นี่เป็นข่าวร้าย .. ที่นี่อยู่ได้มาตลอดเพราะเขา จะเกิดอะไรขึ้นถ้าเขาไม่อยู่ที่นี่!
dialogsBegin.tw: 什麼？他要辭去會長職位？嗯……這可不是好消息……一直以來都是他在穩住這裡的局面。要是他不在了，事情會變成怎樣！
dialogsBegin.vi: Gì cơ? Ông ấy sẽ từ chức tổng thống? Hmm… đây là một tin xấu đấy .. Ông ấy đã giữ cho cuộc sống tại nơi đây được yên ổn. Điều gì sẽ xảy ra nếu ông ấy không còn ở đây nữa!

dialogsBegin.en: Hmm... You are right. The preservation of nature doesn't rest in the hands of one man, but with all of us… Could you please bring me some wastebaskets?
dialogsBegin.ar: Hmm... You are right. The preservation of nature doesn't rest in the hands of one man, but with all of us… Could you please bring me some wastebaskets?
dialogsBegin.br: Hmm.. Você está certo(a), afinal sei quem ele realmente é... E a preservação da natureza não está nas mãos de um homem só, mas de todos nós... Você poderia me trazer algumas lixeiras?
dialogsBegin.cns: Hmm... You are right. The preservation of nature doesn't rest in the hands of one man, but with all of us… Could you please bring me some wastebaskets?
dialogsBegin.de: Hmm ... Du hast recht. Die Erhaltung der Natur liegt nicht in den Händen eines einzigen Mannes, sondern bei uns allen... Könntest du mir bitte ein paar Papierkörbe bringen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Hmm... You are right. The preservation of nature doesn't rest in the hands of one man, but with all of us… Could you please bring me some wastebaskets?
dialogsBegin.fil: Hmm... You are right. The preservation of nature doesn't rest in the hands of one man, but with all of us… Could you please bring me some wastebaskets?
dialogsBegin.fr: … hum, je comprends mieux. Je vais devoir lancer une nouvelle campagne pour l'environnement pour compenser son départ. Voulez-vous m'aider ?
dialogsBegin.id: Hmm.. Kamu benar. Pelestarian alam tidak hanya bergantung di tangan satu orang, tetapi kita semua ... Bisakah kamu membawakan saya beberapa wastebaskets?
dialogsBegin.it: Hmm... You are right. The preservation of nature doesn't rest in the hands of one man, but with all of us… Could you please bring me some wastebaskets?
dialogsBegin.jp: わかったわ。今後はみんなでダーコンの環境を守るようにしましょう。そのためにも一つだけお願いがあるの。
dialogsBegin.kr: 흠... 맞아요. 자연을 지키는 일은 한 사람의 책임이 아니라 우리 모두의 몫이죠… 혹시 쓰레기통 몇 개만 가져다주실 수 있을까요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Hmm... You are right. The preservation of nature doesn't rest in the hands of one man, but with all of us… Could you please bring me some wastebaskets?
dialogsBegin.pl: Hmm.. Masz rację. Ochrona przyrody nie spoczywa w rękach jednego człowieka, ale nas wszystkich… Czy mógłbyś mi przynieść Kosze na Śmieci?
dialogsBegin.ru: Hmm... You are right. The preservation of nature doesn't rest in the hands of one man, but with all of us… Could you please bring me some wastebaskets?
dialogsBegin.sp: Hmm.. Tienes razón. La preservación de la naturaleza no está en manos de un solo hombre, sino de todos nosotros… ¿Podrías traerme algunas papeleras?
dialogsBegin.sw: Hmm... You are right. The preservation of nature doesn't rest in the hands of one man, but with all of us… Could you please bring me some wastebaskets?
dialogsBegin.th: อืม .. คุณพูดถูก การรักษาธรรมชาติไม่ได้เป็นหน้าที่ของใครคนใดคนหนึ่ง แต่เป็นหน้าที่ของพวกเราทุกคน ... คุณช่วยเก็บขยะมาได้ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 嗯……你說得對。守護自然從來不是靠一個人，而是靠我們所有人……可以請你幫我帶一些垃圾桶過來嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Hmm .. Bạn nói đúng. Một cánh én không thể làm nên mùa xuân, việc bảo tồn thiên nhiên là của tất cả chúng ta… Bạn có thể mang cho tôi vài túi rác được không?

dialogsAccept.en: Please go and collect 10 Wastebaskets from Garbagespiders. It is the time for a brighter, cleaner Darken City!
dialogsAccept.ar: Please go and collect 10 Wastebaskets from Garbagespiders. It is the time for a brighter, cleaner Darken City!
dialogsAccept.br: Por favor, vá e colete 10 Cestos de Lixo das Lixeiranhas. É a hora de uma Darken mais brilhante e limpa!
dialogsAccept.cns: 请从蛛型处理机身上收集10个废纸篓。现在是建立一个更明亮、更干净的达肯的时候了！
dialogsAccept.de: Bitte geh und sammle 10 Wastebaskets von Garbagespiders. Es ist an der Zeit für eine hellere, sauberere Darken City!
dialogsAccept.fi: Please go and collect 10 Wastebaskets from Garbagespiders. It is the time for a brighter, cleaner Darken City!
dialogsAccept.fil: Please go and collect 10 Wastebaskets from Garbagespiders. It is the time for a brighter, cleaner Darken City!
dialogsAccept.fr: Je vais construire une usine de recyclage. Les Garbagespiders transportent des poubelles géantes. Allez donc en tuer assez pour m'apporter 10 poubelles géantes.
dialogsAccept.id: Silakan pergi dan kumpulkan 10 Wastebaskets dari Garbagespiders. Ini adalah waktu untuk Darken City menjadi lebih cerah dan lebih bersih!
dialogsAccept.it: Please go and collect 10 Wastebaskets from Garbagespiders. It is the time for a brighter, cleaner Darken City!
dialogsAccept.jp: みんなの意識を高めるために街にゴミ箱を設置したいの。ガーベイジパイダーはわかるかしら？　あの背負っているゴミ箱を10個持ってきてくれない？
dialogsAccept.kr: 가비지스파이더에게서 쓰레기통 10개를 수집하세요. 이제 더 밝고, 깨끗한 다켄 시티를 만들어야죠!
dialogsAccept.nl: Please go and collect 10 Wastebaskets from Garbagespiders. It is the time for a brighter, cleaner Darken City!
dialogsAccept.pl: Idź i zbierz 10 Koszy na Śmieci od Pająkoszy. Nadszedł czas na jaśniejsze, czystsze miasto Darken!
dialogsAccept.ru: Please go and collect 10 Wastebaskets from Garbagespiders. It is the time for a brighter, cleaner Darken City!
dialogsAccept.sp: Ve y recoge 10 Papeleras de los Garbagespiders. ¡Es el momento de una Darken más brillante y limpia!
dialogsAccept.sw: Please go and collect 10 Wastebaskets from Garbagespiders. It is the time for a brighter, cleaner Darken City!
dialogsAccept.th: โปรดไปเก็บWastebaskets 10 ใบจากGarbagespiders ถึงเวลาแล้วที่ Darken City ที่สว่างกว่าและสะอาดกว่า!
dialogsAccept.tw: 謝謝！如果想要存放得肯的垃圾量，可能需要很大的垃圾筒。在清道夫機械頭目背上就掛著那樣的垃圾筒。請消滅清道夫機械，然後收集大型垃圾筒 10 個吧。
dialogsAccept.vi: Hãy đi và thu thập 10 Wastebaskets từ Garbagespiders. Đó là thời gian cho một Darken City sáng sủa hơn, sạch sẽ hơn!

dialogsDecline.en: You don't even care about it do you?. If we keep this way, there won't be any hope left.
dialogsDecline.ar: You don't even care about it do you?. If we keep this way, there won't be any hope left.
dialogsDecline.br: Você nem se importa com isso, não é? Se continuarmos assim, não restará nenhuma esperança.
dialogsDecline.cns: 你根本不关心这个问题，是吗？如果我们继续这样下去，就不会有任何希望了。
dialogsDecline.de: Das ist dir doch völlig egal, oder? Wenn wir so weitermachen, wird es keine Hoffnung mehr geben.
dialogsDecline.fi: You don't even care about it do you?. If we keep this way, there won't be any hope left.
dialogsDecline.fil: You don't even care about it do you?. If we keep this way, there won't be any hope left.
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous vous moquez de l'environnement ? Mais si vous laissez Madrigal étouffer sous la pollution, vous ne valez pas mieu que les monstres que vous combattez.
dialogsDecline.id: Anda bahkan tidak peduli tentang itu bukan?. Jika kita tetap seperti ini, tidak akan ada harapan yang tersisa.
dialogsDecline.it: You don't even care about it do you?. If we keep this way, there won't be any hope left.
dialogsDecline.jp: そう、この街のことなど貴方にはどうなっても構わないのね。
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신은 이 일에 관심조차 없죠? 이대로 가다간, 정말 아무런 희망도 없어요.
dialogsDecline.nl: You don't even care about it do you?. If we keep this way, there won't be any hope left.
dialogsDecline.pl: You don't even care about it do you?. If we keep this way, there won't be any hope left.
dialogsDecline.ru: You don't even care about it do you?. If we keep this way, there won't be any hope left.
dialogsDecline.sp: Ni siquiera te importa, ¿verdad? Si seguimos así, no quedará ninguna esperanza.
dialogsDecline.sw: You don't even care about it do you?. If we keep this way, there won't be any hope left.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณไม่ได้สนใจมันใช่หรือไม่ ถ้าเราเก็บแบบนี้จะไม่มีความหวังใด ๆ เลย
dialogsDecline.tw: 你甚至都不在乎它嗎？如果我們一直這樣下去，就沒有希望了。
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn thậm chí không quan tâm đến nó phải không? Nếu chúng ta cứ thế này thì sẽ không còn hy vọng gì nữa.

dialogsComplete.en: Thank you! Now we will do our best to keep the environment clean!
dialogsComplete.ar: Thank you! Now we will do our best to keep the environment clean!
dialogsComplete.br: Obrigada! Agora vamos fazer o nosso melhor para manter o meio ambiente limpo!
dialogsComplete.cns: 谢谢你! 现在我们将尽最大努力保持环境的整洁!
dialogsComplete.de: Ich danke Dir! Jetzt werden wir unser Bestes tun, um die Umwelt sauber zu halten!
dialogsComplete.fi: Thank you! Now we will do our best to keep the environment clean!
dialogsComplete.fil: Thank you! Now we will do our best to keep the environment clean!
dialogsComplete.fr: Merci pour vos efforts.
dialogsComplete.id: Terima kasih! Sekarang kami akan melakukan yang terbaik untuk menjaga lingkungan tetap bersih!
dialogsComplete.it: Thank you! Now we will do our best to keep the environment clean!
dialogsComplete.jp: ありがとう。このゴミ箱があればみんなで今後は環境を守っていくわ！
dialogsComplete.kr: 고마워요! 이제 우리도 최선을 다해 환경을 깨끗하게 지킬게요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Thank you! Now we will do our best to keep the environment clean!
dialogsComplete.pl: Thank you! Now we will do our best to keep the environment clean!
dialogsComplete.ru: Thank you! Now we will do our best to keep the environment clean!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Gracias! ¡Haremos todo lo posible para mantener el medio ambiente limpio!
dialogsComplete.sw: Thank you! Now we will do our best to keep the environment clean!
dialogsComplete.th: ขอขอบคุณ! ตอนนี้เราจะพยายามอย่างดีที่สุดเพื่อรักษาสิ่งแวดล้อมให้สะอาด!
dialogsComplete.tw: 謝謝！現在我們將盡最大努力保持環境清潔！
dialogsComplete.vi: Cảm ơn bạn! Bây giờ chúng tôi sẽ làm hết sức mình để giữ cho môi trường sạch sẽ!
