dialogsFail.it: Wastebaskets can be found from Garbagespiders, located in the Western regions of Darkon 1.
dialogsFail.jp: 大型のゴミ箱を手に入れるには、ダーコン1地区にいるガーベイジパイダーを倒すことね。
dialogsFail.kr: 쓰레기통은 다콘 1 서쪽 지역에 있는 가비지스파이더에게 얻을 수 있답니다.
dialogsFail.nl: Wastebaskets can be found from Garbagespiders, located in the Western regions of Darkon 1.
dialogsFail.pl: Kosze na Śmieci można znaleźć z Pająkoszy, które znajdują się w zachodnich regionach Darkon 1.
dialogsFail.ru: Wastebaskets can be found from Garbagespiders, located in the Western regions of Darkon 1.
dialogsFail.sp: Las Papeleras son soltadas por los Garbagespiders, ubicados en las regiones del Oeste de Darkon 1.
dialogsFail.sw: Wastebaskets can be found from Garbagespiders, located in the Western regions of Darkon 1.
dialogsFail.th: Wastebaskets สามารถพบได้จาก Garbagespiders ซึ่งตั้งอยู่ทางตะวันตกของ Darkon 1
dialogsFail.tw: 大型垃圾筒可以在位於得肯第一區西部地區的清道夫機械中找到。
dialogsFail.vi: Wastebaskets có thể được tìm thấy từ Garbagespiders, nằm ở khu vực phía Tây của Darkon 1.

name.jp: 第二次クロックワークス戦争
name.th: สงคราม Clockworks ครั้งที่ 2
name.tw: 第 2 次時空毀滅者戰爭

description.en: Find 5 War Scars in Darkon 1 and the Plain of Bubble and visit Dr.Estly in Northern Flaris.
description.ar: Find 5 War Scars in Darkon 1 and the Plain of Bubble and visit Dr.Estly in Northern Flaris.
description.br: Por favor, encontre 5 pedaços de evidência em Darkon 1 e na Planície Bubble, e então visite meu irmão, Dr.Estly, que fica no norte de Flaris.
description.cns: 请你先去达肯1和帕里波布尔平原，寻找战争残留碎片5个，再交给Dr.依斯特里！
description.de: Bitte such mir 5 War Scars in Darkon 1 und der Ebene von Bubble, die du dann zu meinem Bruder Dr. Estly bringst. Er steht im Norden von Flaris, nahe bei den Fefern.
description.fi: Find 5 War Scars in Darkon 1 and the Plain of Bubble and visit Dr.Estly in Northern Flaris.
description.fil: Find 5 War Scars in Darkon 1 and the Plain of Bubble and visit Dr.Estly in Northern Flaris.
description.fr: Trouver 5 preuves de la Seconde Guerre à Darkon 1 et dans la Plaine de Bubble, puis rencontrer Dr.Estly au nord de Flaris près de la Rivière de Larmes
description.id: Temukan 5 Bekas Luka Perang di Darkon 1 dan Plain of Bubble dan kunjungi Dr.Estly di Flaris Utara.
description.it: Find 5 War Scars in Darkon 1 and the Plain of Bubble and visit Dr.Estly in Northern Flaris.
description.jp: ダーコン第1地区やバブルの平原に散らばっている＜クロックワークスの破片＞を5つ集めて、フラリスダンジョンの西にいる＜Dr.エストリー＞に渡しましょう。
description.kr: 다콘 제1지구와 버블 평원에 퍼져있는 전쟁의 상흔 5개를 모아, 플라리스 북부에 있는 이스틀리 박사를 찾아가세요.
description.nl: Find 5 War Scars in Darkon 1 and the Plain of Bubble and visit Dr.Estly in Northern Flaris.
description.pl: Find 5 War Scars in Darkon 1 and the Plain of Bubble and visit Dr.Estly in Northern Flaris.
description.ru: Нужно найти пять шрамов войны на Лучистом поле, а потом поговорить с доктором Если в северной Фларинции.
description.sp: Encuentra 5 Cicatrices de Guerra en Darkon 1 o en la Llanura de Bubble y visita a Dr.Estly al Norte de Flaris.
description.sw: Find 5 War Scars in Darkon 1 and the Plain of Bubble and visit Dr.Estly in Northern Flaris.
description.th: ค้นหา 5 War Scars ใน Darkon 1 และ Plain of Bubble และไปหา Dr.Estly ใน Northern Flaris
description.tw: 請你先去得肯 1 和布拉里斯北方巴布樂平原，尋找戰爭殘留碎片 5 個，再交給 Dr. 法小林！
description.vi: Tìm 5 War Scars trong Darkon 1 và Plain of Bubble và đến thăm Dr.Estly ở Northern Flaris.

dialogsBegin.en: Now for the final step! You've already heard about the Great Clockworks War. Actually, there was another Clockworks War after that…
dialogsBegin.ar: Now for the final step! You've already heard about the Great Clockworks War. Actually, there was another Clockworks War after that…
dialogsBegin.br: Agora, aqui está o terceiro passo. Acredito que você já conhece algo a respeito da Grande Guerra de Clockwork. Na verdade, houve mais uma guerra de Clockwork depois daquela.
dialogsBegin.cns: 那么，进行第3个阶段瞜！！在大时空毁灭者战争过后，又发生了一次战争！！
dialogsBegin.de: Nun gehen wir zum dritten Test. Ich denke mal du hast bereits vom großen Clockwork Krieg gehört. Eigentlich gab es noch einen weiteren Krieg mit Clockwork danach.
dialogsBegin.fi: Now for the final step! You've already heard about the Great Clockworks War. Actually, there was another Clockworks War after that…
dialogsBegin.fil: Now for the final step! You've already heard about the Great Clockworks War. Actually, there was another Clockworks War after that…
dialogsBegin.fr: Maintenant voici la troisième étape. Tu as déjà entendu parler de la Grande Guerre de Clockworks, mais en fait... il y a eu une seconde guerre après la première.
dialogsBegin.id: Sekarang untuk langkah terakhir! kamu sudah pernah mendengar tentang Great Clockworks War. Sebenarnya, ada Perang Clockworks lain setelah itu ...
dialogsBegin.it: Now for the final step! You've already heard about the Great Clockworks War. Actually, there was another Clockworks War after that…
dialogsBegin.jp: 兄さんから第一次クロックワークス戦争について聞いたようだな。その後、クロックワークスとの戦争がもう1度あったんだ。フラリスへの侵攻を図ったクロックワークスと、
dialogsBegin.kr: 이제 마지막 단계군요! 이미 위대한 클락워크 전쟁에 대해 들으셨겠죠. 사실, 그 이후에도 또 한 번의 클락워크 전쟁이 있었는데...
dialogsBegin.nl: Now for the final step! You've already heard about the Great Clockworks War. Actually, there was another Clockworks War after that…
dialogsBegin.pl: Now for the final step! You've already heard about the Great Clockworks War. Actually, there was another Clockworks War after that…
dialogsBegin.ru: О Первой Великой Часовой войне ты уже знаешь... Но была и вторая.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Ahora a por el paso final! Ya has oído hablar de la Gran Guerra de Clockworks. En realidad, hubo otra Guerra de Clockworks después de esa...
dialogsBegin.sw: Now for the final step! You've already heard about the Great Clockworks War. Actually, there was another Clockworks War after that…
dialogsBegin.th: สำหรับขั้นตอนสุดท้าย! คุณเคยได้ยินเกี่ยวกับสงคราม Great Clockworks แล้ว ที่จริงแล้วมีสงคราม Clockworks อื่นหลังจากนั้นอีก...
dialogsBegin.tw: 那麼，進行第 3 個階段瞜！！在大時空毀滅者戰爭過後，又發生了一次戰爭！！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bây giờ đến bước cuối cùng! Bạn đã nghe nói về Đại Chiến Clockworks. Trên thực tế, có một cuộc chiến tranh Clockworks khác sau đó…

dialogsBegin.en: That time, Clockworks was defeated and captured.
dialogsBegin.ar: That time, Clockworks was defeated and captured.
dialogsBegin.br: Desta vez os humanos ganharam, e Clockworks foi trancado...
dialogsBegin.cns: 那场战争，是由我们人类打败了时空毁灭者……
dialogsBegin.de: Diesmal haben die Menschen gewonnen und Clockworks wurde in einem Käfig..
dialogsBegin.fi: That time, Clockworks was defeated and captured.
dialogsBegin.fil: That time, Clockworks was defeated and captured.
dialogsBegin.fr: Ce coup-ci nous, les être humains, avons gagné, et Clockworks fut scellé.
dialogsBegin.id: Saat itu, Clockworks dikalahkan dan ditangkap.
dialogsBegin.it: That time, Clockworks was defeated and captured.
dialogsBegin.jp: フラリス、セイントモーニング、ダーコンの連合軍による戦争だ。苛烈な戦いによりおびただしい血をが流されたが、名も無き勇者達の屍を越え、連合軍はついにクロックワークスに打ち勝った。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그 전쟁에서는 클락워크가 패배하고, 잡혔어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: That time, Clockworks was defeated and captured.
dialogsBegin.pl: That time, Clockworks was defeated and captured.
dialogsBegin.ru: В ней верх взяли люди. Часонизм был повержен и пленен.
dialogsBegin.sp: Esa vez, Clockworks fue derrotado y capturado.
dialogsBegin.sw: That time, Clockworks was defeated and captured.
dialogsBegin.th: สงครามครั้งนั้น มนุษย์ได้รับชัยชนะและ ClockWorks ถูกจับ
dialogsBegin.tw: 那場戰爭，是由我們人類打敗了時空毀滅者……
dialogsBegin.vi: Lần đó, Clockworks đã bị đánh bại và bị bắt.

dialogsBegin.en: He was held at the cage where he was defeated by the allied forces of Flarine, Saint City and Darkon.
dialogsBegin.ar: He was held at the cage where he was defeated by the allied forces of Flarine, Saint City and Darkon.
dialogsBegin.br: ... na jaula em que foi derrotado pelas forças aliadas de Flarine, Saint e Darken.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我们将时空毁灭者封印在地牢中，在这次大战，也留下了一些东西！！
dialogsBegin.de: ...mit vereinten Kräften von Flaris, Saint Morning und Darkon versiegelt.
dialogsBegin.fi: He was held at the cage where he was defeated by the allied forces of Flarine, Saint City and Darkon.
dialogsBegin.fil: He was held at the cage where he was defeated by the allied forces of Flarine, Saint City and Darkon.
dialogsBegin.fr: ...dans la cage où il a été battu par les forces alliées de Flaris, Saint Morning et Darkon.
dialogsBegin.id: Dia ditahan di kandang di mana dia dikalahkan oleh pasukan sekutu Flarine, Saint City dan Darkon.
dialogsBegin.it: He was held at the cage where he was defeated by the allied forces of Flarine, Saint City and Darkon.
dialogsBegin.jp: そして、連合軍がクロックワークスを＜奈落～歯車の永久牢獄＞に封印した日、戦争は完全に終結した。これこそが第二次クロックワークス戦争…我々があの超ど級の存在に勝利した戦争だ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 플라리네, 세인트 시티, 다콘의 연합군에게 잡혀 지금은 감옥에 갇히게 되었죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: He was held at the cage where he was defeated by the allied forces of Flarine, Saint City and Darkon.
dialogsBegin.pl: He was held at the cage where he was defeated by the allied forces of Flarine, Saint City and Darkon.
dialogsBegin.ru: Его заключили в клетку и выставили на том самом месте, где объединенные силы Фларинции, Санто и Даркона одержали победу.
dialogsBegin.sp: Fue retenido en la jaula donde fue derrotado por las fuerzas aliadas de Flarine, Saint y Darken.
dialogsBegin.sw: He was held at the cage where he was defeated by the allied forces of Flarine, Saint City and Darkon.
dialogsBegin.th: มันถูกกักขังอยู่ในคุกที่มีกองกำลังพันธมิตรของ Flarine, Saint City และ Darkon
dialogsBegin.tw: 我們將時空毀滅者封印在副本中，在這次大戰，也留下了一些東西！！
dialogsBegin.vi: Anh ta bị giam giữ trong cái lồng, nơi anh ta bị đánh bại bởi các lực lượng đồng minh của Flarine, Saint City và Darkon.

dialogsBegin.en: You can see the evidence of the war in Darkon 1 and at the Plain of Bubble in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.ar: You can see the evidence of the war in Darkon 1 and at the Plain of Bubble in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.br: Você pode ver as evidências da guerra em Darkon 1 e na Planície Bubble, em Flaris.
dialogsBegin.cns: 战争所造成的痕迹！在达肯1及帕里都还看的到……
dialogsBegin.de: Du kannst die Spuren des Krieges in Darkon 1 auf der Ebene von Bubble in Flaris sehen.
dialogsBegin.fi: You can see the evidence of the war in Darkon 1 and at the Plain of Bubble in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.fil: You can see the evidence of the war in Darkon 1 and at the Plain of Bubble in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu peux encore trouver des traces de cette guerre à Darkon 1 et dans la Plaine de Bubble, à Flaris.
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu dapat melihat bukti perang di Darkon 1 dan di Plain of Bubble di Flaris.
dialogsBegin.it: You can see the evidence of the war in Darkon 1 and at the Plain of Bubble in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.jp: ダーコン第1地区や、フラリスにあるバブルの平原には＜クロックワークスの破片＞がまだ残っている。3つ目のステップとして、それを集めてくれ。クロックワークスに勝利した栄光の歴史を君に知ってほしい。
dialogsBegin.kr: 다콘 제1지구와 플라리스의 버블 평원 주변을 살펴보면 아직 전쟁의 흔적들이 남아 있답니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: You can see the evidence of the war in Darkon 1 and at the Plain of Bubble in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.pl: You can see the evidence of the war in Darkon 1 and at the Plain of Bubble in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.ru: Земля Даркона-1 и Лучистого поля до сих пор носит шрамы той битвы.
dialogsBegin.sp: Puedes ver la evidencia de la guerra en Darkon 1 y en la Llanura de Bubble en Flaris.
dialogsBegin.sw: You can see the evidence of the war in Darkon 1 and at the Plain of Bubble in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณไปดูหลักฐานของสงครามใน Darkon 1 และที่ Plain of Bubble ใน Flaris ได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 戰爭所造成的痕跡，在得肯 1 及布拉里斯的巴布樂平原都還看得到……
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có thể thấy bằng chứng về cuộc chiến trong Darkon 1 và tại Plain of Bubble ở Flaris.

dialogsAccept.en: Please find 5 War Scars in Darkon 1 and the Plain of Bubble, and then visit my brother, Dr. Estly, who is in Northern Flaris.
dialogsAccept.ar: Please find 5 War Scars in Darkon 1 and the Plain of Bubble, and then visit my brother, Dr. Estly, who is in Northern Flaris.
dialogsAccept.br: Por favor, encontre 5 pedaços de evidência em Darkon 1 e na Planície Bubble, e então visite meu irmão, Dr.Estly, que fica no norte de Flaris.
dialogsAccept.cns: 要请你先去达肯1和帕里波布尔平原，寻找战争残留碎片5个，再交给Dr.依斯特里！
dialogsAccept.de: Bitte suche 5 War Scars in Darkon 1 und der Ebene von Bubble, die du dann zu meinem Bruder Dr. Estly bringst. Er steht im Norden von Flaris, nahe bei den Fefern.
dialogsAccept.fi: Please find 5 War Scars in Darkon 1 and the Plain of Bubble, and then visit my brother, Dr. Estly, who is in Northern Flaris.
dialogsAccept.fil: Please find 5 War Scars in Darkon 1 and the Plain of Bubble, and then visit my brother, Dr. Estly, who is in Northern Flaris.
dialogsAccept.fr: J'aimerais que tu trouves 5 preuves de cette guerre à Darkon 1 et dans la Plaine de Bubble, puis que tu ailles visiter mon frère, Dr.Estly au nord de Flaris.
dialogsAccept.id: Silakan temukan 5 Bekas Luka Perang di Darkon 1 dan Plain of Bubble, lalu kunjungi saudara saya, Dr. Estly, yang ada di Flaris Utara.
dialogsAccept.it: Please find 5 War Scars in Darkon 1 and the Plain of Bubble, and then visit my brother, Dr. Estly, who is in Northern Flaris.
dialogsAccept.jp: ダーコン第2地区に散らばっている＜クロックワークスの破片＞を5つ集めて、俺の弟＜Dr.エストリー＞に渡してくれ。弟はフラリスダンジョンの西にいるはずだ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 다콘 제1지구, 버블 평원에 퍼져있는 전쟁의 상흔 5개를 모아서, 플라리스 북부에 있는 제 동생 이스틀리 박사를 찾아가세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Please find 5 War Scars in Darkon 1 and the Plain of Bubble, and then visit my brother, Dr. Estly, who is in Northern Flaris.
dialogsAccept.pl: Please find 5 War Scars in Darkon 1 and the Plain of Bubble, and then visit my brother, Dr. Estly, who is in Northern Flaris.
dialogsAccept.ru: Отыщи на Лучистом поле пять шрамов войны, а затем поговори с нашим третьим братом, доктором Если. Он живет в северной Фларинции. Хорошо?
dialogsAccept.sp: Encuentra 5 Cicatrices de Guerra en Darkon 1 o en la Llanura de Bubble, y luego visita a mi hermano, el Dr. Estly, que está al Norte de Flaris.
dialogsAccept.sw: Please find 5 War Scars in Darkon 1 and the Plain of Bubble, and then visit my brother, Dr. Estly, who is in Northern Flaris.
dialogsAccept.th: หา 5 War Scars ใน Darkon 1 และ Plain of Bubble แล้วไปพบน้องชายฉัน Dr. Estly ซึ่งอยู่ใน Northern Flaris
dialogsAccept.tw: 要請你先去得肯第一區和布拉里斯北方巴布樂平原，尋找戰爭殘留碎片 5 個，再交給 Dr. 法小林！
dialogsAccept.vi: Hãy tìm 5 War Scars trong Darkon 1 và Plain of Bubble, sau đó đến thăm anh trai tôi, Dr. Estly, ở miền Bắc Flaris.

dialogsDecline.en: Fine, have it your way. I guess you just aren't ready to face Clockworks.
dialogsDecline.ar: Fine, have it your way. I guess you just aren't ready to face Clockworks.
dialogsDecline.br: Se você tiver algum assunto mais urgente, pode vir me visitar mais tarde. Tudo bem.
dialogsDecline.cns: 看你好像很忙，那我就不耽误你的时间了！
dialogsDecline.de: Wenn du etwas dringenderes zu erledigen hast, komm später nochmal zu mir. Das ist schon ok.
dialogsDecline.fi: Fine, have it your way. I guess you just aren't ready to face Clockworks.
dialogsDecline.fil: Fine, have it your way. I guess you just aren't ready to face Clockworks.
dialogsDecline.fr: Si tu as quelque chose de plus urgent à accomplir tu peux revenir me voir plus tard. Pas de problème.
dialogsDecline.id: Baiklah, lakukan dengan caramu. Saya rasa kamu belum siap menghadapi Clockworks.
dialogsDecline.it: Fine, have it your way. I guess you just aren't ready to face Clockworks.
dialogsDecline.jp: クロックワークスに挑むのは俺じゃなく君だ。都合がついたら、また来るといい。
dialogsDecline.kr: 뭐, 뜻대로 하세요. 아직 클락워크에 맞설 준비가 안 된 것 같네요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Fine, have it your way. I guess you just aren't ready to face Clockworks.
dialogsDecline.pl: Fine, have it your way. I guess you just aren't ready to face Clockworks.
dialogsDecline.ru: Ладно, как знаешь. Видно, Часонизм тебе не по зубам.
dialogsDecline.sp: Vale, hazlo a tu manera. Supongo que no estás listo para enfrentarte a Clockworks.
dialogsDecline.sw: Fine, have it your way. I guess you just aren't ready to face Clockworks.
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันเดาว่าคุณยังไม่พร้อมที่จะเผชิญกับ Clockworks
dialogsDecline.tw: 看你好像很忙，那我就不耽誤你的時間了！
dialogsDecline.vi: Tốt thôi, hãy làm theo cách của bạn. Tôi đoán bạn chưa sẵn sàng đối mặt với Clockworks.

dialogsComplete.en: Oh, did my brothers send you to me? Then you must be the Clockworks challenger! Please, show me the War Scars.
dialogsComplete.ar: Oh, did my brothers send you to me? Then you must be the Clockworks challenger! Please, show me the War Scars.
dialogsComplete.br: Ah, meus irmão o mandaram? Então você deve ser aquele que enfrentará Clockworks. Por favor, me entregue o que você trouxe.
dialogsComplete.cns: 你是我哥派来的人啊？你好~我叫Dr.法小廷！你是为了挑战而来找我的，没错吧？那请给我5个战争残留碎片！
dialogsComplete.de: Oh, mein Bruder hat dich geschickt? Dann musst du der Herausforderer von Clockworks sein. Bitte gib mir was du mitgebracht hast.
dialogsComplete.fi: Oh, did my brothers send you to me? Then you must be the Clockworks challenger! Please, show me the War Scars.
dialogsComplete.fil: Oh, did my brothers send you to me? Then you must be the Clockworks challenger! Please, show me the War Scars.
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh, c'est mon frère qui t'envoie ? Tu dois être celui qui veut défier Clockworks. Montre-moi un peu ce que tu m'as ramené.
dialogsComplete.id: Oh, apakah saudara-saudaraku mengirimmu kepadaku? Maka kamu harus menjadi penantang Clockworks! Tolong, tunjukkan Bekas Luka Perang.
dialogsComplete.it: Oh, did my brothers send you to me? Then you must be the Clockworks challenger! Please, show me the War Scars.
dialogsComplete.jp: あ、兄に言われて来たんですね。あなたがクロックワークスに挑戦される方ですか。たしか、渡していただく物があったはずですけど…。
dialogsComplete.kr: 아, 저희 형들이 보냈다고요. 그렇다면 당신이 클락워크에 도전하려는 분이겠네요. 자, 전쟁의 상흔을 보여주세요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Oh, did my brothers send you to me? Then you must be the Clockworks challenger! Please, show me the War Scars.
dialogsComplete.pl: Oh, did my brothers send you to me? Then you must be the Clockworks challenger! Please, show me the War Scars.
dialogsComplete.ru: Тебя прислали ко мне братья? А, так это ты собираешься бросить вызов Часонизму!
dialogsComplete.sp: Oh, ¿mis hermanos te envían a verme? ¡Entonces debes ser el retador de Clockworks! Por favor, muéstrame las Cicatrices de Guerra.
dialogsComplete.sw: Oh, did my brothers send you to me? Then you must be the Clockworks challenger! Please, show me the War Scars.
dialogsComplete.th: พี่น้องของฉันส่งคุณมาใช่มั้ย งั้นคุณคงเป็นคู่ต่อสู้ของ Clockworks! ขอฉันดู War Scars หน่อยสิ
dialogsComplete.tw: 你是我哥派來的人啊？你好~我叫 Dr. 法小廷！你是為了挑戰而來找我的，沒錯吧？那請給我 5 個戰爭殘留碎片！
dialogsComplete.vi: Ồ, các anh trai của tôi đã gửi bạn cho tôi? Sau đó, bạn hẳn phải là người thách thức Clockworks! Làm ơn, cho tôi xem War Scars.

dialogsComplete.en: Hmmm… everything looks to be in order here! Here, take this book. It is a more detailed study of Clockworks. It goes into detail about his behavior.
dialogsComplete.ar: Hmmm… everything looks to be in order here! Here, take this book. It is a more detailed study of Clockworks. It goes into detail about his behavior.
dialogsComplete.br: Hmm... Uma, duas, três... exatamente cinco evidências! Certo, aqui está. Pegue esse livro. Trata de como Clockworks age, então você pode estudá-lo. Deve ser útil.
dialogsComplete.cns: 没错，是5个！！这个给你！这本书纪录有关时空毁灭者，对你应该会有用的！！
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm.. Eins, zwei, drei.. Alle 5 Beweise genau! Ok, dann mal los. Nimm dieses Buch. Es handelt von dem Verhalten von Clockworks, also lies es. Es sollte nützlich sein.
dialogsComplete.fi: Hmmm… everything looks to be in order here! Here, take this book. It is a more detailed study of Clockworks. It goes into detail about his behavior.
dialogsComplete.fil: Hmmm… everything looks to be in order here! Here, take this book. It is a more detailed study of Clockworks. It goes into detail about his behavior.
dialogsComplete.fr: Hmm... Un, deux, trois... exactement cinq preuves ! Ok, voilà pour toi. Prends cet ouvrage sur Clockworks, je suis sûr que cela t'intéressera.
dialogsComplete.id: Hmmm… semuanya terlihat rapi di sini! Ini, ambil buku ini. Ini adalah studi yang lebih rinci tentang Clockworks. Ini masuk ke detail tentang perilakunya.
dialogsComplete.it: Hmmm… everything looks to be in order here! Here, take this book. It is a more detailed study of Clockworks. It goes into detail about his behavior.
dialogsComplete.jp: クロックワークスの破片を5つ、しっかりと受け取りました。では、これを差し上げます。クロックワークスの生態に関する研究成果をまとめた本です。
dialogsComplete.kr: 흠… 네, 이걸로 충분하겠네요! 이 책을 드릴게요. 클락워크의 행동에 대해 더 자세히 정리된 연구서예요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Hmmm… everything looks to be in order here! Here, take this book. It is a more detailed study of Clockworks. It goes into detail about his behavior.
dialogsComplete.pl: Hmmm… everything looks to be in order here! Here, take this book. It is a more detailed study of Clockworks. It goes into detail about his behavior.
dialogsComplete.ru: Я вижу, тебя не испугали шрамы войны, от которых так и не избавилась земля... Вот, возьми эту книгу. В ней подробно рассказывается о Часонизме и особенностях его поведения.
dialogsComplete.sp: Hmmm... ¡todo parece estar en orden! Toma, quédate este libro. Es un estudio más detallado de Clockworks. Explica en detalle su comportamiento.
dialogsComplete.sw: Hmmm… everything looks to be in order here! Here, take this book. It is a more detailed study of Clockworks. It goes into detail about his behavior.
dialogsComplete.th: อืม… ครบถ้วน! เอาหนังสือเล่มนี้ไปศึกษารายละเอียดเพิ่มเติมของ Clockworks เกี่ยวกับพฤติกรรมของมัน
dialogsComplete.tw: 沒錯，是 5 個！！這個給你！這本書紀錄有關時空毀滅者，對你應該會有用的！！
dialogsComplete.vi: Hmmm… mọi thứ ở đây có vẻ theo trật tự! Đây, lấy cuốn sách này. Đó là một nghiên cứu chi tiết hơn về Clockworks. Nó đi vào chi tiết về hành vi của anh ta.

dialogsFail.en: I'm waiting for someone who is supposed to be bringing me something important.
dialogsFail.ar: I'm waiting for someone who is supposed to be bringing me something important.
dialogsFail.br: Meu segundo irmão não lhe disse nada, disse? Você deve me trazer 5 pedaços de evidência de Darkon 1 e da Planície Bubble.
dialogsFail.cns: 我哥没有跟你说吗？请你先去达肯第1区和帕里波布尔的平原找战争残留碎片5个。
dialogsFail.de: Mein Bruder hat dir wohl nichts erzählt, oder? Du musst mir 5 Scar of War aus Darkon 1 und der Ebene von Bubble bringen.
dialogsFail.fi: I'm waiting for someone who is supposed to be bringing me something important.
dialogsFail.fil: I'm waiting for someone who is supposed to be bringing me something important.
dialogsFail.fr: Mon deuxième frère ne t'as rien dit ? Tu dois m'amener cinq preuves de la Seconde Guerre, provenant de Darkon 1 et de la Plaine de Bubble.
dialogsFail.id: Aku sedang menunggu seseorang yang seharusnya membawakanku sesuatu yang penting.
dialogsFail.it: I'm waiting for someone who is supposed to be bringing me something important.
dialogsFail.jp: あれ？兄から何も言われてませんか？戦争を感じるため、ダーコン第1地区やバブルの平原で＜クロックワークスの破片＞を5つ集めて来てください。
dialogsFail.kr: 중요한 걸 전해줄 사람을 기다리고 있었습니다만.
dialogsFail.nl: I'm waiting for someone who is supposed to be bringing me something important.
dialogsFail.pl: I'm waiting for someone who is supposed to be bringing me something important.
dialogsFail.ru: Я жду человека, который должен принести мне кое-что важное.
dialogsFail.sp: Estoy esperando a alguien que se supone que me trae algo importante.
dialogsFail.sw: I'm waiting for someone who is supposed to be bringing me something important.
dialogsFail.th: ฉันกำลังรอคนที่ควรจะนำสิ่งที่สำคัญมาให้ฉัน
dialogsFail.tw: 我哥沒有跟你說嗎？請你先去得肯第一區和布拉里斯的巴布樂平原找戰爭殘留碎片 5 個。
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi đang đợi một người được cho là sẽ mang lại cho tôi một điều gì đó quan trọng.

description.en: Fight them to get information from them. I will meet you in Darken.
description.ar: Fight them to get information from them. I will meet you in Darken.
description.br: Lute para conseguir informações deles e depois me encontre em Darkon, estarei te aguardando lá.
description.cns: 去帮我查一下他们的动机，我想你去猎杀他们，应该就会知道了。我先回到达肯，你到达肯来找我吧。
description.de: Bitte forsche für mich nach den Informationen der Troupe Leaders und Members. Du kannst die Informationen bekommen in dem du gegen sie kämpfst. Ich gehe nun zurück nach Darkon. Ich werden dorrt auf dich Warten.
description.fi: Fight them to get information from them. I will meet you in Darken.
description.fil: Fight them to get information from them. I will meet you in Darken.
description.fr: Combattre la Troupe des Mages Pourpres, en tuant 10 Mages et un Archimage, puis retourner voir Hachal à Darken.
description.id: Lawan mereka untuk mendapatkan informasi dari mereka. Aku akan menemuimu di Darken.
description.it: Fight them to get information from them. I will meet you in Darken.
description.jp: ＜バイオレットシャドウ・マジシャンズ＞と、そのリーダーの情報を調べよう。彼らと実際に戦えば情報はわかるという。彼らを倒したら、情報を＜ハカル＞に報告するためにダーコンへ戻ろう。
description.kr: 극단과 싸워서 정보를 얻어 주세요. 저는 다켄에서 기다리고 있을게요.
description.nl: Fight them to get information from them. I will meet you in Darken.
description.pl: Fight them to get information from them. I will meet you in Darken.
description.ru: Нужно сразиться с актерами труппы Лилового Фокусника, чтобы узнать правду о них.
description.sp: Lucha contra ellos para obtener la información. Nos vemos en Darken.
description.sw: Fight them to get information from them. I will meet you in Darken.
description.th: ต่อสู้กับพวกเขาเพื่อรับข้อมูลจากพวกเขา ฉันจะไปพบคุณที่ Darken
description.tw: 去幫我查一下他們的動機，我想你去獵殺他們，應該就會知道了。我先回到得肯，你到得肯來找我吧。
description.vi: Chiến đấu với chúng để lấy thông tin từ chúng. Tôi sẽ gặp bạn ở Darken.

dialogsBegin.en: Hmm... I checked the cloth piece you brought me. It seems like the pattern on the cloth piece is the same as the one I saw on the ground.
dialogsBegin.ar: Hmm... I checked the cloth piece you brought me. It seems like the pattern on the cloth piece is the same as the one I saw on the ground.
dialogsBegin.br: Hmm... Vi o pedaço de pano que você trouxe. Parece que a estampa no tecido tem o mesmo formato que vi no terreno.
dialogsBegin.cns: Hmm... I checked the cloth piece you brought me. It seems like the pattern on the cloth piece is the same as the one I saw on the ground.
dialogsBegin.de: Hmm ... Ich habe das Stoffstück, das du mir gebracht hast, überprüft. Es scheint, dass das Muster auf dem Stoffstück dasselbe ist wie das, das ich auf dem Boden gesehen habe.
dialogsBegin.fi: Hmm... I checked the cloth piece you brought me. It seems like the pattern on the cloth piece is the same as the one I saw on the ground.
dialogsBegin.fil: Hmm... I checked the cloth piece you brought me. It seems like the pattern on the cloth piece is the same as the one I saw on the ground.
dialogsBegin.fr: Hmm... Il semble que ce morceau de tissu porte le même motif que celui que j'ai vu sur le sol.
dialogsBegin.id: Hmm.. Aku memeriksa potongan kain yang kau berikan. Sepertinya pola pada potongan kain itu sama dengan yang kulihat di tanah.
dialogsBegin.it: Hmm... I checked the cloth piece you brought me. It seems like the pattern on the cloth piece is the same as the one I saw on the ground.
dialogsBegin.jp: 君が持って来てくれたこの布切れを調べたら、これはある文様の一切れだったことが分かったぞ。大変重要な手がかりだ。そして、君が調べてきてくれた話と照合すると、マドリガルの遺跡などからよく発見される古代文様とは違う、何か特殊な文様のようなんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 흠... 당신이 가져왔던 천 조각을 확인해 봤어요. 천 조각의 무늬가, 땅에서 봤던 것과 같아 보여요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Hmm... I checked the cloth piece you brought me. It seems like the pattern on the cloth piece is the same as the one I saw on the ground.
dialogsBegin.pl: Hmm... I checked the cloth piece you brought me. It seems like the pattern on the cloth piece is the same as the one I saw on the ground.
dialogsBegin.ru: Hmm... I checked the cloth piece you brought me. It seems like the pattern on the cloth piece is the same as the one I saw on the ground.
dialogsBegin.sp: Hmm... He revisado el trozo de tela que me trajiste. Parece que el patrón del trozo de tela es el mismo que vi en el suelo.
dialogsBegin.sw: Hmm... I checked the cloth piece you brought me. It seems like the pattern on the cloth piece is the same as the one I saw on the ground.
dialogsBegin.th: อืม.. ฉันเช็คเสื้อผ้าที่คุณเอามาให้ฉันแล้ว ดูเหมือนว่าลวดลายบนผืนผ้าจะเหมือนกับลวดลายที่ฉันเห็นบนพื้น
dialogsBegin.tw: 嗯……我檢查過你帶回來的布片了。看來上面的紋樣和我在地面上看到的是同一個。
dialogsBegin.vi: Hmm .. Tôi đã kiểm tra mảnh vải mà bạn mang cho tôi. Có vẻ như họa tiết trên mảnh vải giống với họa tiết tôi nhìn thấy trên mặt đất.

dialogsBegin.en: However, there is a mystrious power in this cloth piece. I will check it out some more. By the way, have you ever heard of the Magic Troupe in Purple? I found out about them by chance.
dialogsBegin.ar: However, there is a mystrious power in this cloth piece. I will check it out some more. By the way, have you ever heard of the Magic Troupe in Purple? I found out about them by chance.
dialogsBegin.br: No entanto, há um poder misterioso neste tecido... Vou pesquisar mais. A propósito, você já ouviu falar da Tropa Mago Violeta? Descobri sobre eles por acaso.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我发现这个布条里面，有一种魔法的力量，再调查一下的话，应该就会知道这是什么了。我刚刚研究的时候突然想到..有一个叫做<紫色的魔法团>..
dialogsBegin.de: Es scheint irgendeine mysteriöse Kraft in diesem Stück Stoff zu sein. Ich werde mir das nochmal genau anschauen. Übrigens, hast du jemals von der magischen Truppe in Lila gehört? Ich habe zufällig etwas über sie gelesen.
dialogsBegin.fi: However, there is a mystrious power in this cloth piece. I will check it out some more. By the way, have you ever heard of the Magic Troupe in Purple? I found out about them by chance.
dialogsBegin.fil: However, there is a mystrious power in this cloth piece. I will check it out some more. By the way, have you ever heard of the Magic Troupe in Purple? I found out about them by chance.
dialogsBegin.fr: Ce tissu semble contenir un mystérieux pouvoir… Peut-être que... (réfléchissant) As-tu déjà entendu parler de la Troupe des Mages Pourpres ?
dialogsBegin.id: Namun, ada kekuatan misterius dalam potongan kain ini. Aku akan coba memeriksanya lagi. Omong-omong, apakah kamu pernah mendengar tentang Magic Troupe in Purple? Aku mengetahui tentang mereka secara kebetulan.
dialogsBegin.it: However, there is a mystrious power in this cloth piece. I will check it out some more. By the way, have you ever heard of the Magic Troupe in Purple? I found out about them by chance.
dialogsBegin.jp: この布切れには不思議な力が宿っているらしい。どんな力かは、これから調べてみるつもりだがね。あと、この布切れの模様について調べているうち、偶然つきとめた手がかりなんだが…君、＜バイオレットシャドウ・マジシャンズ＞という名前を聞いたことがあるかね？
dialogsBegin.kr: 하지만 이 천 조각에는 뭔가 수상한 힘이 깃들어 있어요. 좀 더 조사해 봐야겠지만… 혹시 퍼플 매지션 극단에 대해 들어본 적 있으세요? 저도 우연히 알게 되었지만.
dialogsBegin.nl: However, there is a mystrious power in this cloth piece. I will check it out some more. By the way, have you ever heard of the Magic Troupe in Purple? I found out about them by chance.
dialogsBegin.pl: However, there is a mystrious power in this cloth piece. I will check it out some more. By the way, have you ever heard of the Magic Troupe in Purple? I found out about them by chance.
dialogsBegin.ru: А еще от нее веет таинственной силой. Странно, правда? Кстати, доводилось ли тебе слышать о труппе Лилового Фокусника? Я и сам узнал о ней буквально на днях.
dialogsBegin.sp: Sin embargo, hay un poder misterioso en este trozo de tela. Lo comprobaré un poco más. Por cierto, ¿alguna vez has oído hablar de los Magos Violetas? Escuché de ellos por casualidad.
dialogsBegin.sw: However, there is a mystrious power in this cloth piece. I will check it out some more. By the way, have you ever heard of the Magic Troupe in Purple? I found out about them by chance.
dialogsBegin.th: อย่างไรก็ตาม มีพลังลึกลับอยู่ในผ้าชิ้นนี้ ฉันจะตรวจสอบเพิ่มเติม คุณเคยได้ยินเรื่อง Magic Troupe in Purple หรือไม่? ฉันค้นพบเกี่ยวกับพวกเขาโดยบังเอิญ
dialogsBegin.tw: 我發現這個布條裡面，有一種魔法的力量，再調查一下的話，應該就會知道這是什麼了。我剛剛研究的時候突然想到……有一個叫做邪惡魔法團的組織。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tuy nhiên, có một sức mạnh bí ẩn trong mảnh vải này. Tôi sẽ kiểm tra nó. Nhân tiện, bạn đã bao giờ nghe nói về Magic Troupe in Purple chưa? Tôi biết về họ một cách tình cờ.

dialogsBegin.en: I do not know the details, but I know that this group has something to do with the secrets of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.ar: I do not know the details, but I know that this group has something to do with the secrets of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.br: Não conheço os detalhes, mas sei que este grupo tem algo a ver com os segredos de Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你有听说过吗?我猜他们应该跟瑞加大陆的历史有关连性。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich kenne keine Einzelheiten, aber ich weiss, dass diese Truppe etwas mit den Geheimnissen um Madigral zu tun hat.
dialogsBegin.fi: I do not know the details, but I know that this group has something to do with the secrets of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.fil: I do not know the details, but I know that this group has something to do with the secrets of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je ne détiens que très peu d'informations sur eux... mais étant donné qu'ils défendaient ce motif, il doit forcément y avoir un lien.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku tidak tahu detailnya, tapi aku merasa kalau grup ini ada kaitannya dengan dengan rahasia dari Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.it: I do not know the details, but I know that this group has something to do with the secrets of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.jp: 私も詳しくはわからないのだが、マドリガルの隠された秘密と何か深い関わりのある集団らしいということだけはわかっている。
dialogsBegin.kr: 자세한 건 모르지만, 마드리갈에 감춰진 어떤 비밀 연관이 있는 것 같아요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I do not know the details, but I know that this group has something to do with the secrets of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.pl: I do not know the details, but I know that this group has something to do with the secrets of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.ru: Ничего не скажу наверняка, но вроде бы эта труппа как-то связана с тайнами истории Мадригала.
dialogsBegin.sp: No conozco los detalles, pero seguro que este grupo tiene algo que ver con los secretos de Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.sw: I do not know the details, but I know that this group has something to do with the secrets of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันไม่รู้รายละเอียด แต่ฉันรู้ว่ากลุ่มนี้มีบางอย่างเกี่ยวกับความลับของ Madrigal
dialogsBegin.tw: 你有聽說過嗎？我猜他們應該跟瑪德利賈的歷史有關連性。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi không biết chi tiết, nhưng tôi biết rằng nhóm này có liên quan gì đó đến những bí mật của Madrigal.

dialogsBegin.en: I think we need more information about this Troupe. How about helping me once more? Would you do that for me?
dialogsBegin.ar: I think we need more information about this Troupe. How about helping me once more? Would you do that for me?
dialogsBegin.br: Acho que precisamos de mais informações sobre esse Grupo. Que tal me ajudar mais uma vez? Você faria isso por mim?
dialogsBegin.cns: 我要查一下这个魔法团，既然你都来到这里了，可以帮我调查一下吗?
dialogsBegin.de: Da ist einiges, was ich überprüfen muss in dieser Truppe. Was ist, hilfst du mir nocheinmal? Würdest du das für mich tun?
dialogsBegin.fi: I think we need more information about this Troupe. How about helping me once more? Would you do that for me?
dialogsBegin.fil: I think we need more information about this Troupe. How about helping me once more? Would you do that for me?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il faut que j'obtienne plus d'informations ! Je peux toujours compter sur toi ?
dialogsBegin.id: Aku rasa kita membutuhkan lebih banyak informasi tentang ini. Bagaimana jika membantuku sekali lagi? Bisakah?
dialogsBegin.it: I think we need more information about this Troupe. How about helping me once more? Would you do that for me?
dialogsBegin.jp: この謎の集団について、もっと詳しく調べてみたいのだが。君の勇敢な腕を見込んでだが、また手伝ってくれないかね？
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 극단에 대해 더 많은 정보가 필요해요. 한 번만 더 도와주실 수 있을까요?
dialogsBegin.nl: I think we need more information about this Troupe. How about helping me once more? Would you do that for me?
dialogsBegin.pl: I think we need more information about this Troupe. How about helping me once more? Would you do that for me?
dialogsBegin.ru: Надо разузнать об этом Фокуснике побольше. Ты поможешь мне, да?
dialogsBegin.sp: Creo que necesitamos más información sobre ellos. ¿Qué tal si me ayudas una vez más? ¿Lo harías por mí?
dialogsBegin.sw: I think we need more information about this Troupe. How about helping me once more? Would you do that for me?
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันคิดว่าเราต้องการข้อมูลเพิ่มเติมเกี่ยวกับคณะนี้ ช่วยฉันอีกสักครั้งจะเป็นไรไป? คุณจะทำอย่างนั้นเพื่อฉันไหม
dialogsBegin.tw: 我要查一下這個魔法團，既然你都來到這裡了，可以幫我調查一下嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi nghĩ chúng ta cần thêm thông tin về Nhóm này. Làm thế nào về việc giúp tôi một lần nữa? Bạn sẽ làm điều đó cho tôi chứ?

dialogsAccept.en: Great! Please gather information about the Troupe and its members. You will have to fight them to get any information out of them.
dialogsAccept.ar: Great! Please gather information about the Troupe and its members. You will have to fight them to get any information out of them.
dialogsAccept.br: Ótimo! Reúna informações sobre o Grupo e seus membros. Você terá que lutar com eles para conseguir qualquer informação.
dialogsAccept.cns: 好，你去帮我查一下他们的动机，我想你去猎杀他们，应该就会知道了。我先回到达肯，你到达肯来找我吧。
dialogsAccept.de: Schön! Bitte suche für mich nach Informationen über die Violet Magician Troupe. Diese erhälst du, indem du gegen sie kämpfst. Ich erwarte dich dann in Darkon.
dialogsAccept.fi: Great! Please gather information about the Troupe and its members. You will have to fight them to get any information out of them.
dialogsAccept.fil: Great! Please gather information about the Troupe and its members. You will have to fight them to get any information out of them.
dialogsAccept.fr: Bien ! Essaie d'obtenir des informations sur cette troupe, je pense que la seule solution pour cela est de les combattre... Pour ma part je dois retourner à Darkon, rejoins moi ensuite !
dialogsAccept.id: Bagus! Tolong kumpulkan lebih banyak Informasi tentang kelompok itu beserta anggotanya. Kamu mungkin harus bertarung dengan beberapa dari mereka untuk mendapatkan infromasinya.
dialogsAccept.it: Great! Please gather information about the Troupe and its members. You will have to fight them to get any information out of them.
dialogsAccept.jp: 君なら首尾良くやってくれると信じているよ。では＜バイオレットシャドウ・マジシャンズ＞と、リーダーの情報を調べてきてくれ。あいつらと実際に戦えば情報はわかるだろう。私は一足先にダーコンに帰って調査を始める。情報を仕入れたらダーコンまで来てくれ。頼んだぞ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 좋아요! 퍼플 매지션 극단과 극단원들에 대한 정보를 모아주세요. 필요하다면 싸워서라도 정보를 얻어 주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Great! Please gather information about the Troupe and its members. You will have to fight them to get any information out of them.
dialogsAccept.pl: Great! Please gather information about the Troupe and its members. You will have to fight them to get any information out of them.
dialogsAccept.ru: Отлично! Думаю, чтобы узнать хоть что-то об этой труппе, тебе надо будет сразиться с ее актерами.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Genial! Reúne información sobre los Magos Violetas y sus miembros. Tendrás que luchar contra ellos para sacarles algo de información.
dialogsAccept.sw: Great! Please gather information about the Troupe and its members. You will have to fight them to get any information out of them.
dialogsAccept.th: ยอดเยี่ยม! กรุณารวบรวมข้อมูลเกี่ยวกับคณะและสมาชิก คุณจะต้องต่อสู้กับพวกเขาเพื่อรับข้อมูลจากพวกเขา
dialogsAccept.tw: 好，你去幫我查一下他們的動機，我想你去獵殺他們，應該就會知道了。我先回到得肯，你到得肯來找我吧。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tuyệt quá! Vui lòng thu thập thông tin về Nhóm và các thành viên của Nhóm. Bạn sẽ phải chiến đấu với chúng để lấy bất kỳ thông tin nào từ chúng.

dialogsDecline.en: You are afraid of them? I can hardly believe that. Ha ha ha.
dialogsDecline.ar: You are afraid of them? I can hardly believe that. Ha ha ha.
dialogsDecline.br: Tem medo deles? É difícil de acreditar. Ha ha ha.
dialogsDecline.cns: 觉得他们很恐怖所以没办法帮我啊?你真的太懦弱了吧!!这样怎么能够生存在社会上呢..哎呀..
dialogsDecline.de: Hast du Angst vor ihnen? Bist du ein feiges Huhn? Ha ha ha~
dialogsDecline.fi: You are afraid of them? I can hardly believe that. Ha ha ha.
dialogsDecline.fil: You are afraid of them? I can hardly believe that. Ha ha ha.
dialogsDecline.fr: Quoi tu aurais peur d'eux ? Je te pensais vraiment plus courageux…
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu takut dengan mereka? Rasanya susah mempercayai itu. Ha ha ha.
dialogsDecline.it: You are afraid of them? I can hardly believe that. Ha ha ha.
dialogsDecline.jp: 得体の知れない集団を相手にするのは気が引けるのか？見かけによらず臆病なんだなあ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 무서워요? 설마요. 그럴 리 없죠? 하하하.
dialogsDecline.nl: You are afraid of them? I can hardly believe that. Ha ha ha.
dialogsDecline.pl: You are afraid of them? I can hardly believe that. Ha ha ha.
dialogsDecline.ru: Неужели ты трусишь? Вот это комедия! Ха-ха-ха!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Les tienes miedo? Eso no me lo creo. Jajaja.
dialogsDecline.sw: You are afraid of them? I can hardly believe that. Ha ha ha.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณกลัวพวกเขาไหม แทบไม่อยากเชื่อเลย ฮ่าๆๆ
dialogsDecline.tw: 覺得他們很恐怖所以沒辦法幫我啊？你真的太懦弱了吧！！這樣怎麼能夠生存在社會上呢…哎呀…
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn sợ chúng? Tôi khó có thể tin được điều đó. Ha ha ha.

dialogsComplete.en: Hmm... That was exactly what I thought... Now go back and take a rest. But please visit me again later. Thank you very much.
dialogsComplete.ar: Hmm... That was exactly what I thought... Now go back and take a rest. But please visit me again later. Thank you very much.
dialogsComplete.br: Hmm... É exatamente o que eu imaginava... Agora volte e descanse. Venha me visitar mais tarde. Muito obrigado.
dialogsComplete.cns: Hmm... That was exactly what I thought... Now go back and take a rest. But please visit me again later. Thank you very much.
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm.. Das ist genau das, was ich gedacht habe.. Nun gehe zurück und mache eine Pause. Aber vergiss nicht mich wieder zu besuchen. Danke dir vielmals.
dialogsComplete.fi: Hmm... That was exactly what I thought... Now go back and take a rest. But please visit me again later. Thank you very much.
dialogsComplete.fil: Hmm... That was exactly what I thought... Now go back and take a rest. But please visit me again later. Thank you very much.
dialogsComplete.fr: Hmm... C'est exactement ce que je pensais, les Mages Pourpres sont bien impliqués là-dedans... Merci beaucoup pour ces informations !
dialogsComplete.id: Hmm.. Tepat seperti yang kupikirkan.. Terima kasih banyak. Kembalilah dan beristirahat, dan temui aku lagi nanti.
dialogsComplete.it: Hmm... That was exactly what I thought... Now go back and take a rest. But please visit me again later. Thank you very much.
dialogsComplete.jp: おお、戻ってきたね。そうか…やはり私の調べた情報に間違いはなかったな。よくやってくれた、感謝するよ。疲れただろう、今日は帰ってゆっくり休みなさい。十分に体を休めたら、また訪ねてくれたまえ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 흠... 저도 그렇게 생각했어요... 이제 돌아가서 좀 쉬세요. 다음에 다시 찾아주세요. 정말 감사합니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Hmm... That was exactly what I thought... Now go back and take a rest. But please visit me again later. Thank you very much.
dialogsComplete.pl: Hmm... That was exactly what I thought... Now go back and take a rest. But please visit me again later. Thank you very much.
dialogsComplete.ru: Hmm... That was exactly what I thought... Now go back and take a rest. But please visit me again later. Thank you very much.
dialogsComplete.sp: Hmm... Eso es exactamente lo que pensaba... Ahora vete y descansa. Ven a verme más tarde. Muchas gracias.
dialogsComplete.sw: Hmm... That was exactly what I thought... Now go back and take a rest. But please visit me again later. Thank you very much.
dialogsComplete.th: อืม... นั่นแหละที่ฉันคิดไว้ กลับไปพักผ่อนเถอะ แต่โปรดกลับมาหาฉันอีกครั้งในภายหลัง ขอบคุณมาก
dialogsComplete.tw: 嗯……果然和我想的一樣……你先回去休息吧。不過之後請再來找我，真的很謝謝你。
dialogsComplete.vi: Hmm .. Đó chính xác là những gì tôi nghĩ .. Bây giờ hãy quay về và nghỉ ngơi đi. Nhưng xin hãy đến thăm tôi sau đó nhé. Cảm ơn rất nhiều.

dialogsFail.en: Was it too much for you? Ah...but we need information about them.
dialogsFail.ar: Was it too much for you? Ah...but we need information about them.
dialogsFail.br: Foi demais para você? Ah...mas precisamos de informações sobre eles
dialogsFail.cns: 有点麻烦吗?可是我觉得没有一些关于他们的东西的话，我怕很难追查下去呀..
dialogsFail.de: Ist es jenseits deiner Möglichkeit..? Aber wir können nicht weiter machen, ohne diese Informationen über sie.
dialogsFail.fi: Was it too much for you? Ah...but we need information about them.
dialogsFail.fil: Was it too much for you? Ah...but we need information about them.
dialogsFail.fr: C'est au-delà de tes capacités ? Mais nous ne pourrons pas progresser si nous n'en apprenons pas plus à leur sujet...
dialogsFail.id: Apa itu terlalu berat untukmu? Ah...tapi kita butuh informasi tentang mereka.
dialogsFail.it: Was it too much for you? Ah...but we need information about them.
dialogsFail.jp: ご苦労様。謎の集団について調べるのはだいぶ骨が折れただろう？しかしやつらの秘密を解かない限りは、調査が進められない。
dialogsFail.kr: 너무 버거운 일이었나요? 아… 그래도 정보가 꼭 필요한데.
dialogsFail.nl: Was it too much for you? Ah...but we need information about them.
dialogsFail.pl: Was it too much for you? Ah...but we need information about them.
dialogsFail.ru: Неужели они оказались тебе не по зубам? Придумай что-нибудь.
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Ha sido demasiado para ti? Hmm... pero necesitamos esa información sobre ellos.
dialogsFail.sw: Was it too much for you? Ah...but we need information about them.
dialogsFail.th: มันมากเกินไปสำหรับคุณหรือไม่? อา... แต่เราต้องการข้อมูลเกี่ยวกับพวกเขา
dialogsFail.tw: 有點麻煩嗎？可是我覺得沒有一些關於他們的東西的話，我怕很難追查下去呀…
dialogsFail.vi: Nó có quá nhiều cho bạn không? À ... nhưng chúng tôi cần thông tin về họ.

dialogsDecline.en: If you change your mind later, please come back to me!
dialogsDecline.ar: If you change your mind later, please come back to me!
dialogsDecline.br: Se mudar de ideia mais tarde, por favor, volte para falar comigo!
dialogsDecline.cns: 好不容易才帮她弄到了匠人之心，还以为事情就结束了，没想到她还让我去找珍妮，看来想拯救遗址也不是件容易的事。
dialogsDecline.de: Du weißt wo du mich findest, falls du deine Meinung änderst.

dialogsDecline.fil: If you change your mind later, please come back to me!
dialogsDecline.fr: Ann m'a dit d'aller voir Janne.
dialogsDecline.id: Jika nanti kamu berubah pikiran, tolong kembali padaku!
dialogsDecline.it: If you change your mind later, please come back to me!

dialogsDecline.pl: Jeśli później zmienisz zdanie, proszę wróć do mnie!

dialogsDecline.sw: If you change your mind later, please come back to me!
dialogsDecline.th: หากคุณเปลี่ยนใจในภายหลัง โปรดกลับมาหาฉัน!
dialogsDecline.tw: 終於辛苦的把苦命超人的心臟收齊了！還以為這樣就結束了…沒想到還要我去找傑勒…啊！做好人不是這麼簡單滴～～～
dialogsDecline.vi: Nếu sau này bạn đổi ý, hãy quay lại với tôi!

dialogsComplete.en: Thank you! You should really talk to Janne.
dialogsComplete.ar: Thank you! You should really talk to Janne.
dialogsComplete.br: Obrigado! Você realmente deveria falar com a Janne.
dialogsComplete.cns: 谢谢你！你真的应该和珍妮聊聊！
dialogsComplete.de: Vielen Dank! Du solltest auf jeden Fall mit Janne sprechen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Thank you! You should really talk to Janne.
dialogsComplete.fil: Thank you! You should really talk to Janne.
dialogsComplete.fr: Merci ! Tu devrais vraiment parler à Janne.
dialogsComplete.id: Terima kasih! Kamu harus berbicara dengan Janne.
dialogsComplete.it: Thank you! You should really talk to Janne.
dialogsComplete.jp: ありがとう！ジャンヌと話したほうがいい。
dialogsComplete.kr: 정말 감사합니다! 잔느와 대화해보시는 게 좋겠어요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Thank you! You should really talk to Janne.
dialogsComplete.pl: Dziękuję! Powinieneś na prawdę porozmawiać z Janne.
dialogsComplete.ru: Спасибо! Ты должен поговорить с Жанной.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Gracias! Deberías hablar con Janne.
dialogsComplete.sw: Thank you! You should really talk to Janne.
dialogsComplete.th: ขอบคุณ! คุณควรคุยกับ Janne จริงๆ
dialogsComplete.tw: 謝謝！你真的應該跟傑勒聊聊。
dialogsComplete.vi: Cảm ơn bạn! Bạn thực sự nên nói chuyện với Janne.

description.ru: Фуметокса видели на Дарконе-1. Нужно отобрать у него Слезу Киу и отнести ее Хейдане в Грибальский лес на Даркон-3.

description.tw: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 在得肯 1 區。找到他，取回 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$，然後把它交給得肯第三區的海丹。

dialogsBegin.en: Now, since you’re going to become a Ringmaster, you should see the Ringmaster Priest, Heedan, in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.ar: Now, since you’re going to become a Ringmaster, you should see the Ringmaster Priest, Heedan, in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.br: Visite agora, por favor, a sacerdotisa Ringmaster Heedan em Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.cns: 请你去找达肯第3区的守护使者司祭【海登】，她可是绝色美女喔！
dialogsBegin.de: Nun suche die Ringmaster Priesterin Heedan in Darkon3 auf.
dialogsBegin.fi: Now, since you’re going to become a Ringmaster, you should see the Ringmaster Priest, Heedan, in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.fil: Now, since you’re going to become a Ringmaster, you should see the Ringmaster Priest, Heedan, in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu approches de ton but. et la fin de ton apprentissage se passera à Darkon 3 ! Là-bas, tu trouveras l'Autel où siège Heedan, la Doyenne des Prêtres.
dialogsBegin.id: Sekarang, karena kamu akan menjadi Ringmaster, kamu akan melihat Ringmaster Priest, Heedan, di Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.it: Now, since you’re going to become a Ringmaster, you should see the Ringmaster Priest, Heedan, in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.jp: じゃあ、これから司祭に会ってください。司祭ヒエロニム様はダーコン第3地区にあるリングマスター祭壇を管理していらっしゃる。
dialogsBegin.kr: 링마스터가 되기 위해선, 다콘 제3지구에 있는 링마스터 사제 히댄님을 만나야 합니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Now, since you’re going to become a Ringmaster, you should see the Ringmaster Priest, Heedan, in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.pl: Now, since you’re going to become a Ringmaster, you should see the Ringmaster Priest, Heedan, in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.ru: А теперь отправляйся к жрице иллюзионистов Хейдане на Даркон-3.
dialogsBegin.sp: Ahora, ya que te convertirás en Ringmaster, deberías ver a la Sacerdotisa Ringmaster Heedan, en Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.sw: Now, since you’re going to become a Ringmaster, you should see the Ringmaster Priest, Heedan, in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.th: ตั้งแต่คุณจะเป็น Ringmaster คุณจะเห็น Ringmaster Priest Heedan ใน Darkon 3
dialogsBegin.tw: 請你去找得肯第三區的守護者司祭 [海登]，他可是絕色美女喔！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bây giờ, vì bạn sắp trở thành Ringmaster, bạn sẽ thấy Ringmaster Priest, Heedan, trong Darkon 3.

dialogsBegin.en: She’s been trying to track down the Teardrop of Aenn that was stolen by Hunter X.
dialogsBegin.ar: She’s been trying to track down the Teardrop of Aenn that was stolen by Hunter X.
dialogsBegin.br: Heedan tem se esforçado para obter a Lágrima de Aenn, que foi roubada por Hunter X.
dialogsBegin.cns: 海登一直四处找寻艾诺的泪珠的下落！
dialogsBegin.de: Heedan hat sich abgemüht um den Teardrop of Aenn zu bekommen welcher dann von Hunter X gestohlen wurde.
dialogsBegin.fi: She’s been trying to track down the Teardrop of Aenn that was stolen by Hunter X.
dialogsBegin.fil: She’s been trying to track down the Teardrop of Aenn that was stolen by Hunter X.
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais avant cela. Il y a une mission que tu dois accomplir. Heedan recherche une relique perdue : la Larme d'Aenn.
dialogsBegin.id: Dia mencoba melacak Teardrop of Aenn yang dicuri oleh Hunter X.
dialogsBegin.it: She’s been trying to track down the Teardrop of Aenn that was stolen by Hunter X.
dialogsBegin.jp: ヒエロニム様はとっても大事な物を探していらっしゃる。虚人ウィシュパヌアスが盗んだエーエンヌの涙玉石というアイテムなのだが、それを取り戻したいのだそうだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 히댄님은 헌터 X에게 도난당한 에이엔느의 눈물을 찾고 계셨어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: She’s been trying to track down the Teardrop of Aenn that was stolen by Hunter X.
dialogsBegin.pl: She’s been trying to track down the Teardrop of Aenn that was stolen by Hunter X.
dialogsBegin.ru: Кстати, она пытается найти великолепный артефакт - Слезу Киу, украденную Фуметоксом.
dialogsBegin.sp: Ha estado intentando rastrear la Lágrima de Aenn que robó Hunter X.
dialogsBegin.sw: She’s been trying to track down the Teardrop of Aenn that was stolen by Hunter X.
dialogsBegin.th: เธอพยายามติดตาม Teardrop of Aenn ที่ถูกขโมยโดย Hunter X
dialogsBegin.tw: 海登一直四處找尋阿利安諾淚珠的下落！
dialogsBegin.vi: Cô ấy đang cố gắng truy tìm Teardrop of Aenn đã bị Thợ săn X. đánh cắp.

dialogsBegin.en: If you can get it back, you’d help her out a great deal.
dialogsBegin.ar: If you can get it back, you’d help her out a great deal.
dialogsBegin.br: Você deve recuperar o tesouro!
dialogsBegin.cns: 经多方打听，这宝物好像被【猎人X】所持有，你快去找回来吧！
dialogsBegin.de: Du solltest den Schatz von dem Räuber zurückholen.
dialogsBegin.fi: If you can get it back, you’d help her out a great deal.
dialogsBegin.fil: If you can get it back, you’d help her out a great deal.
dialogsBegin.fr: Elle a été volée il y a longtemps par Hunter X, mais nous n'avons jamais pu le localiser précisemment ce voleur.
dialogsBegin.id: Jika kamu bisa mendapatkannya kembali, kamu akan sangat membantunya.
dialogsBegin.it: If you can get it back, you’d help her out a great deal.
dialogsBegin.jp: あれは決して盗賊が持っていていいような宝ではない。何とかして取り戻してくれ！
dialogsBegin.kr: 이걸 되찾는다면, 히댄님께 큰 도움이 될 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: If you can get it back, you’d help her out a great deal.
dialogsBegin.pl: If you can get it back, you’d help her out a great deal.
dialogsBegin.ru: Если ты ей поможешь, она будет благодарна.
dialogsBegin.sp: Si consigues recuperarlo, ayudarías mucho.
dialogsBegin.sw: If you can get it back, you’d help her out a great deal.
dialogsBegin.th: ถ้าคุณเอากลับมาได้ คุณจะช่วยเธอมากทีเดียว
dialogsBegin.tw: 經多方打聽，這寶物好像被 [獵人 X] 所持有，你快去找回來吧！
dialogsBegin.vi: Nếu bạn có thể lấy lại nó, bạn sẽ giúp ích cho cô ấy rất nhiều.

dialogsAccept.en: I wish you luck.
dialogsAccept.ar: I wish you luck.
dialogsAccept.br: Eu lhe desejo sorte.
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你好运
dialogsAccept.de: Ich wünsche Dir viel Glück.
dialogsAccept.fi: Toivotan sinulle onnea.
dialogsAccept.fil: I wish you luck.
dialogsAccept.fr: Je te souhaite que la grâce de Heren t'accompagne.
dialogsAccept.id: Saya berharap Anda beruntung.
dialogsAccept.it: I wish you luck.
dialogsAccept.jp: じゃあ、がんばってね。無事に試練を乗り越えられますように！
dialogsAccept.kr: 승리를 기원하죠.
dialogsAccept.nl: I wish you luck.
dialogsAccept.pl: I wish you luck.
dialogsAccept.ru: I wish you luck.
dialogsAccept.sp: Te deseo suerte.
dialogsAccept.sw: I wish you luck.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้คุณโชคดี
dialogsAccept.tw: 祝你好運！
dialogsAccept.vi: Chúc bạn may mắn.

dialogsDecline.en: But… you must do it if you are to become a Ringmaster.
dialogsDecline.ar: But… you must do it if you are to become a Ringmaster.
dialogsDecline.br: É o tesouro mais importante de Madrigal! Por favor, pegue-o de volta deles. É o seu dever.
dialogsDecline.cns: 这宝物价值连城，无论如何一定非找回来不可， 这就是我想请你帮我做的事情！
dialogsDecline.de: Es ist der wichtigste Schatz in Madrigal! Bitte bring ihn zurück. Es ist deine Pflicht.
dialogsDecline.fi: But… you must do it if you are to become a Ringmaster.
dialogsDecline.fil: But… you must do it if you are to become a Ringmaster.
dialogsDecline.fr: Il faut absolument retrouver cette relique, ceci devrait être ta toute première priorité !
dialogsDecline.id: Tapi ... kamu harus melakukannya jika kamu ingin menjadi seorang Ringmaster.
dialogsDecline.it: But… you must do it if you are to become a Ringmaster.
dialogsDecline.jp: その宝は、マドリガルの至宝とされるほどの価値がある。是非取り戻してくれ！
dialogsDecline.kr: 하지만… 링마스터가 되려면 반드시 해내야 합니다.
dialogsDecline.nl: But… you must do it if you are to become a Ringmaster.
dialogsDecline.pl: But… you must do it if you are to become a Ringmaster.
dialogsDecline.ru: Но без этого тебе никогда не стать иллюзионистом.
dialogsDecline.sp: Pero… lo tienes que hacer si quieres convertirte en un Ringmaster.
dialogsDecline.sw: But… you must do it if you are to become a Ringmaster.
dialogsDecline.th: แต่... คุณต้องทำถ้าอยากเป็น Ringmaster
dialogsDecline.tw: 這寶物價值連城，無論如何一定非找回來不可，這就是我想請你幫我做的事情！
dialogsDecline.vi: Nhưng… bạn phải làm điều đó nếu bạn muốn trở thành Ringmaster.

dialogsComplete.en: Great job, now everything is at it should be.
dialogsComplete.ar: Great job, now everything is at it should be.
dialogsComplete.br: Ótimo trabalho, agora tudo está como deveria estar.
dialogsComplete.cns: 真的辛苦你了！宝物终于回到原来的地方了！
dialogsComplete.de: Gute Arbeit, jetzt ist alles so, wie es sein soll.
dialogsComplete.fi: Great job, now everything is at it should be.
dialogsComplete.fil: Great job, now everything is at it should be.
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh, tu as finalement retrouvé la Larme d'Aenn ! Je ne sais pas par quel miracle tu l'as retrouvée, mais maintenant le trésor est enfin à sa place..
dialogsComplete.id: Kerja bagus, sekarang semuanya sudah seharusnya.
dialogsComplete.it: Great job, now everything is at it should be.
dialogsComplete.jp: ありがとう！貴重な宝をよく取り戻してくれたね！
dialogsComplete.kr: 아주 잘하셨어요. 이제 모든 것이 제자리로 돌아갔군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Great job, now everything is at it should be.
dialogsComplete.pl: Great job, now everything is at it should be.
dialogsComplete.ru: Great job, now everything is at it should be.
dialogsComplete.sp: Bien hecho, ahora todo está como deber estar.
dialogsComplete.sw: Great job, now everything is at it should be.
dialogsComplete.th: ดีมาก ตอนนี้ทุกอย่างเป็นอย่างที่ควรจะเป็นแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 真的辛苦你了！寶物終於回到原來的地方了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Tuyệt lắm, bây giờ mọi thứ là như nó phải vậy ở thời điểm này.

dialogsComplete.en: Thank you very much. I will do my best to keep it safe.
dialogsComplete.ar: Thank you very much. I will do my best to keep it safe.
dialogsComplete.br: Muito obrigado. Farei o meu melhor para mantê-lo seguro. Obrigado.
dialogsComplete.cns: 谢谢!我不会再弄丢了,一定会好好的保管！

description.en: Hunt Down 20 Drillers and return to Ellend in Darken City.
description.ar: Hunt Down 20 Drillers and return to Ellend in Darken City.
description.br: É muito simples. Cace 20 Sondadores em KhipRa, Darkon 1. Não incomode os Pequenos Sondadores ou o Sondador Gigante, ataque apenas os Sondadores.
description.cns: 就是…在达肯1区…打20只钻孔机，记得是钻孔机！
description.de: Wie ich sagte, er ist leicht. Jage 20 Driller in KhipRa, Darkon 1. Keine Small Driller oder Giant Driller, einfach nur Driller.
description.fi: Hunt Down 20 Drillers and return to Ellend in Darken City.
description.fil: Hunt Down 20 Drillers and return to Ellend in Darken City.
description.fr: Tuer 20 Drillers à KhipRa, Darkon 1 et retourner voir le Maître des Prêtres, Ellend à Darken.

description.it: Hunt Down 20 Drillers and return to Ellend in Darken City.

description.pl: Upoluj 20 Wiertników i wróć do Ellend w Darken City.

description.sw: Hunt Down 20 Drillers and return to Ellend in Darken City.
description.th: ล่า 20 Drillers และกลับไปหา Ellend ใน Darken City

dialogsBegin.en: So you think you're ready to become a Ringmaster? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.ar: So you think you're ready to become a Ringmaster? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.br: Você estaria pronto(a) para abençoar como um Ringmaster? Não é nada fácil. Mas eu acho que você está preparado(a), já que veio até aqui.
dialogsBegin.cns: 要成为守护使者英雄的继承者可不简单，你要有心理准备喔！！
dialogsBegin.de: Du glaubst also, du bist bereit, ein Ringmaster zu werden? Es ist nicht leicht, aber da du es bis hierher geschafft hast, denke ich, dass du der Herausforderung gewachsen bist.
dialogsBegin.fi: So you think you're ready to become a Ringmaster? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.fil: So you think you're ready to become a Ringmaster? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.fr: Souhaites-tu succéder à Aenn, Héros des Prêtres ? Ce n'est pas une tâche facile, mais je pense que tu en es capable...
dialogsBegin.id: Jadi kamu pikir kamu siap untuk menjadi Ringmaster? Ini tidak mudah, tetapi karena kamu telah berhasil sejauh ini, saya pikir kamu siap menghadapi tantangan.
dialogsBegin.it: So you think you're ready to become a Ringmaster? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.jp: リングマスター後継者の道を歩む覚悟はできていますか？では、ご案内します。
dialogsBegin.kr: 링마스터가 될 준비가 된 것 같나요? 쉬운 일은 아니지만, 여기까지 온 걸 보면 도전할 자격이 있어 보이는군요.
dialogsBegin.nl: So you think you're ready to become a Ringmaster? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.pl: So you think you're ready to become a Ringmaster? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.ru: So you think you're ready to become a Ringmaster? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Crees que estás listo para convertirte en Ringmaster? No es fácil, pero como has llegado hasta aquí, creo que estás preparado para el desafío.
dialogsBegin.sw: So you think you're ready to become a Ringmaster? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.th: อืมม คุณคิดว่าคุณพร้อมที่จะเป็น Ringmaster แล้วหรือ? มันไม่ใช่เรื่องง่ายหรอก แต่ว่าหากคุณมาได้ไกลขนาดนี้แล้ว ฉันคิดว่าคุณพร้อมสำหรับการท้าทายนี้แล้วล่ะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 要成為守護者英雄的繼承者可不簡單，你要有心理準備喔！！
dialogsBegin.vi: Vì vậy, bạn nghĩ rằng bạn đã sẵn sàng để trở thành một Ringmaster? Nó không dễ dàng, nhưng vì bạn đã thành công từ đó đến nay, tôi nghĩ rằng bạn đã sẵn sàng đến với thử thách.

dialogsBegin.en: First, a simple test of your skills in combat to see if you are qualified.
dialogsBegin.ar: First, a simple test of your skills in combat to see if you are qualified.
dialogsBegin.br: Primeiro, vamos fazer um teste simples para checar se você está qualificado para ser um sucessor. É um teste de habilidade de combate.
dialogsBegin.cns: 首先，测试下你的战斗技巧及能力，看你是否合格
dialogsBegin.de: Zunächst ein einfacher Test deiner Fähigkeiten im Kampf, um festzustellen, ob du qualifiziert bist.

dialogsBegin.fil: First, a simple test of your skills in combat to see if you are qualified.
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais je vais te faire passer une première épreuve pour m'assurer que tu es bien digne de notre classe. Il s'agit de tester ton aptitude au combat.

dialogsBegin.jp: まずあなたが後継者としての資質を持っているか、簡単にテストを行います。この試験によりあなたの戦闘能力を見させてもらいます。
dialogsBegin.kr: 먼저, 전투 실력을 간단히 시험해 볼게요. 자격이 있는지 확인해 보고 싶어서요.

dialogsBegin.th: ขั้นแรกให้ทดสอบทักษะของคุณในการต่อสู้เพื่อดูว่าคุณมีคุณสมบัติเหมาะสมหรือไม่
dialogsBegin.tw: 首先，簡單測試一下你的戰鬥技巧，看看你是否合格。

dialogsFail.jp: 正確に20匹です。そうではないとあなたの資質が判断できません。本当に後継者になりたいのなら、必ず成し遂げてください。
dialogsFail.kr: 정확히 드릴러 20마리여야 합니다. 그 정도는 되어야 링마스터가 되기 위한 첫걸음이라고 할 수 있겠죠.
dialogsFail.nl: Exactly 20 Drillers. That's what you'll need to take your first steps to becoming a Ringmaster.
dialogsFail.pl: Dokładnie 20 Wiertników. To jest to, czego będziesz potrzebować, aby postawić pierwsze kroki, aby zostać Mistrzem Areny.
dialogsFail.ru: Ровно двадцать буров. Это будет твоим первым шагом к званию иллюзиониста.
dialogsFail.sp: Exactamente 20 Drillers. Es lo que tienes que hacer para dar el primer paso para convertirte en Ringmaster.
dialogsFail.sw: Exactly 20 Drillers. That's what you'll need to take your first steps to becoming a Ringmaster.
dialogsFail.th: Drillers 20 คน นั่นคือสิ่งที่คุณจะต้องทำตามขั้นตอนแรกของการเป็น Ringmaster
dialogsFail.tw: 一定要打敗 20 隻暴鑽機械，才能通過測試！！
dialogsFail.vi: Chính xác là 20 Drillers. Đó là những gì bạn cần để thực hiện những bước đầu tiên trở thành Ringmaster.

description.en: Luda at the Shield Shop will give me 10,000 Penya when I hunt 15 Small Mushpang and 15 Mushpang, and then return to him.
description.ar: Luda at the Shield Shop will give me 10,000 Penya when I hunt 15 Small Mushpang and 15 Mushpang, and then return to him.
description.br: Luda da Loja de Escudos lhe dará 10,000 Penyas quando você caçar 15 Mushpangs Pequenos e 15 Mushpangs e reportar a ele.
description.cns: 打倒小嘭嘭菇15只和嘭嘭菇15只后，去盾牌商店找路达给你10000金币。
description.de: Luda will mir 10000 Penya geben, wenn ich 15 Small Mushpang und 15 Mushpang besiegt habe.
description.fi: Luda at the Shield Shop will give me 10,000 Penya when I hunt 15 Small Mushpang and 15 Mushpang, and then return to him.
description.fil: Luda at the Shield Shop will give me 10,000 Penya when I hunt 15 Small Mushpang and 15 Mushpang, and then return to him.
description.fr: Luda du Magasin de Boucliers me donnera 10000 penyas si je vais le voir après avoir terrassé 15 Jeunes Mushpangs et 15 Mushpangs.
description.id: Luda di Shield Shop akan memberiku 10.000 Penya ketika aku berburu 15 Small Mushpang dan 15 Mushpang, lalu kembali padanya.
description.it: Luda at the Shield Shop will give me 10,000 Penya when I hunt 15 Small Mushpang and 15 Mushpang, and then return to him.
description.jp: 「スモール・マッシュファング」15匹と「マッシュファング」15匹を倒して＜シールドショップ＞のルダに報告すると報酬がもらえます。
description.kr: 작은 머쉬팡 15마리와 머쉬팡 15마리를 처치하고 방어구 상점의 루다에게 돌아가면 10,000 페냐를 받을 수 있습니다.
description.nl: Luda at the Shield Shop will give me 10,000 Penya when I hunt 15 Small Mushpang and 15 Mushpang, and then return to him.
description.pl: Luda at the Shield Shop will give me 10,000 Penya when I hunt 15 Small Mushpang and 15 Mushpang, and then return to him.
description.ru: Людор даст мне 10 000 пенни, если я убью 10 слабых и 5 обычных сыробежек.
description.sp: Luda de la Tienda de Escudos me dará 10,000 Penya una vez que derrote a 15 Mushpangs Pequeños y a 15 Mushpangs, y vuelva con él.
description.sw: Luda at the Shield Shop will give me 10,000 Penya when I hunt 15 Small Mushpang and 15 Mushpang, and then return to him.
description.th: Luda ที่ Shield Shop จะให้ฉัน 10,000 Penya ถ้าฉันล่า Small Mushpang 15 ตัว และ Mushpang 15 ตัว แล้วกลับไปหาเขา
description.tw: 狩獵 15 隻小型咚咚菇和 15 隻咚咚菇後回去找盾牌店的路達，他會給我 10,000 金幣。
description.vi: Luda ở Cửa hàng Khiên Chắn sẽ cho tôi 10.000 Penya khi tôi săn được 15 Mushpang nhỏ và 15 Mushpang, sau đó quay trở lại anh ta.

dialogsBegin.en: I didn’t know that you could accomplish so much this fast! How wonderful! I have one more request for you. There are other monsters around Flarine. They are called Mushpangs.
dialogsBegin.ar: I didn’t know that you could accomplish so much this fast! How wonderful! I have one more request for you. There are other monsters around Flarine. They are called Mushpangs.
dialogsBegin.br: Eu não sabia que era possível realizar essa tarefa tão rápido! Que maravilha! Eu tenho mais um pedido a fazer. Existe outro tipo de monstro cercando a cidade - Mushpangs.
dialogsBegin.cns: 实在是没有想到你在这么短的时间里，会有这么大的成长。太了不起啦！最后想要再拜托你一件事情。独眼蝙蝠和其它怪物一起包围我们的村子，他们叫做嘭嘭菇。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich hätte nicht gedacht, dass du dich so schnell weiterentwickelst. Ich habe eine letzte Aufgabe für dich. Eine andere Monsterart belagert die Stadt. Würdest du bitte die Mushpang bekämpfen?
dialogsBegin.fi: I didn’t know that you could accomplish so much this fast! How wonderful! I have one more request for you. There are other monsters around Flarine. They are called Mushpangs.
dialogsBegin.fil: I didn’t know that you could accomplish so much this fast! How wonderful! I have one more request for you. There are other monsters around Flarine. They are called Mushpangs.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je ne pensais pas que vous progresseriez aussi vite. C'est fantastique. J'ai un dernier service à vous demander. Il y a d'autres monstres qui encerclent la ville, les Mushpangs !
dialogsBegin.id: Aku tidak tahu kalau kau dapat menyeledaikan begitu banyak quest secepat ini! Luar biasa! Aku punya satu quest lagi untukmu. Ada monster lain di sekitar Flarine. Mereka disebut Mushpang.
dialogsBegin.it: I didn’t know that you could accomplish so much this fast! How wonderful! I have one more request for you. There are other monsters around Flarine. They are called Mushpangs.
dialogsBegin.jp: あっという間にこんなに成長するとは思わなかったよ。本当にあんたは凄いなぁ、ハハハ。よし、今回この宿題をクリアーできたら、あんたはもう一人前だ。よく聞くんだぞ。フラリスの街を囲んでいるモンスターは「アイバット」の他に、「マッシュファング」というキノコの形をしたモンスターがいるんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 정말 빠르게 임무를 끝내셨더군요! 정말 대단해요! 다른 부탁이 하나 더 있어요. 플라리네 주변에 머쉬팡이라는 몬스터들이 있어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I didn’t know that you could accomplish so much this fast! How wonderful! I have one more request for you. There are other monsters around Flarine. They are called Mushpangs.
dialogsBegin.pl: I didn’t know that you could accomplish so much this fast! How wonderful! I have one more request for you. There are other monsters around Flarine. They are called Mushpangs.
dialogsBegin.ru: Битву со сглазами твое оружие выдержало, но выдержит ли оно бой с сыробежками? Нужно проверить.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡No sabía que podías progresar tan rápido! ¡Qué maravilloso! Tengo una petición más para ti. Hay otros monstruos alrededor de Flarine. Se llaman Mushpangs.
dialogsBegin.sw: I didn’t know that you could accomplish so much this fast! How wonderful! I have one more request for you. There are other monsters around Flarine. They are called Mushpangs.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันไม่รู้ว่าคุณจะทำได้เร็วขนาดนี้! ช่างวิเศษเหลือเกิน! ฉันมีอีกหนึ่งคำขอสำหรับคุณ มีสัตว์ประหลาดตัวอื่นอยู่รอบๆ Flarine พวกมันคือ Muspangs
dialogsBegin.tw: 真沒想到你能這麼快完成這麼多事！太厲害了！我還有一件事想拜託你。布拉里斯周邊還有一種叫做咚菇的魔物。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi không biết rằng bạn có thể đạt được nhiều thành tích nhanh vậy! Thật tuyệt vời! Tôi có một yêu cầu nữa cho bạn. Có những con quái vật khác xung quanh Flarine. Chúng được gọi là Mushpangs.

dialogsBegin.en: Please wipe them out! If you hunt 10 Small Mushpangs and 5 normal Mushpangs, I will give you a reward. Oh, and hold onto any trophies they drop, as they will be very useful in the near future!
dialogsBegin.ar: Please wipe them out! If you hunt 10 Small Mushpangs and 5 normal Mushpangs, I will give you a reward. Oh, and hold onto any trophies they drop, as they will be very useful in the near future!
dialogsBegin.br: Por favor, elimine-os! Se você caçar 10 Mushpangs Pequenos e 5 Mushpangs comuns, eu lhe darei uma recompensa. Ah, e colete os troféus que eles deixam cair, pois serão bem úteis no futuro!
dialogsBegin.cns: 请帮我教训这些怪物吧！打倒10只小嘭嘭菇和5只嘭嘭菇后，再回来找我，我会给你奖励的。打倒怪物会掉下不错的战利品，请你要收集起来喔！
dialogsBegin.de: Bitte löscht sie aus! Wenn ihr 10 small Mushpangs und 5 normale Mushpangs erlegt, erhaltet ihr eine Belohnung. Oh, und behaltet alle Trophäen, die sie fallen lassen, da sie in naher Zukunft sehr nützlich sein werden!
dialogsBegin.fi: Please wipe them out! If you hunt 10 Small Mushpangs and 5 normal Mushpangs, I will give you a reward. Oh, and hold onto any trophies they drop, as they will be very useful in the near future!
dialogsBegin.fil: Please wipe them out! If you hunt 10 Small Mushpangs and 5 normal Mushpangs, I will give you a reward. Oh, and hold onto any trophies they drop, as they will be very useful in the near future!
dialogsBegin.fr: Si vous chassez 10 Jeunes Mushpangs et 5 Mushpangs, je vous récompenserai. J'oubliais, conservez les trophées de vos victoires, ils vous seront utiles très prochainement.
dialogsBegin.id: Tolong musnahkan mereka! Jika Kamu berburu 10 Small Mushpang dan 5 Normal Mushpang, Aku akan memberimu hadiah. Oh, dan ambil drop yang mereka jatuhkan, karena itu akan sangat berguna dalam waktu dekat!
dialogsBegin.it: Please wipe them out! If you hunt 10 Small Mushpangs and 5 normal Mushpangs, I will give you a reward. Oh, and hold onto any trophies they drop, as they will be very useful in the near future!
dialogsBegin.jp: 今度はそいつらを倒してきてくれないか？「スモール・マッシュファング」10匹と「マッシュファング」5匹を倒したら、また俺のところに報告しに来てくれ。報酬もちゃんと用意しているから、頼んだぞ。それと、モンスターを倒した時に出るクエストアイテムは、いつか使う機会が来るから、捨てずに集めておいたほうがいいな。
dialogsBegin.kr: 제발 녀석들을 처치해 주세요! 작은 머쉬팡 10마리와 일반 머쉬팡 5마리를 사냥해 주시면 보상을 드릴게요. 녀석들이 떨어뜨리는 전리품은 유용하게 쓰이니 잘 모아두세요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Please wipe them out! If you hunt 10 Small Mushpangs and 5 normal Mushpangs, I will give you a reward. Oh, and hold onto any trophies they drop, as they will be very useful in the near future!
dialogsBegin.pl: Please wipe them out! If you hunt 10 Small Mushpangs and 5 normal Mushpangs, I will give you a reward. Oh, and hold onto any trophies they drop, as they will be very useful in the near future!
dialogsBegin.ru: Попробуй одолеть 10 слабых и 5 обычных сыробежек, ладно? И собирай трофеи, даже самые странные! Никогда не знаешь, где они пригодятся.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Deshazte de ellos! Si derrotas a 10 Mushpangs Pequeños y a 5 Mushpangs normales, te daré una recompensa. ¡Ah, y quédate con los trofeos que suelten, ya que te serán muy útiles en un futuro cercano!
dialogsBegin.sw: Please wipe them out! If you hunt 10 Small Mushpangs and 5 normal Mushpangs, I will give you a reward. Oh, and hold onto any trophies they drop, as they will be very useful in the near future!
dialogsBegin.th: โปรดกำจัดพวกมัน! หากคุณล่า Small Mushpangs 10 ตัวและ Muspang ปกติ 5 ตัว ฉันจะให้รางวัลคุณ โอ้ และเก็บถ้วยรางวัลที่พวกมันดรอปไว้ เพราะมันจะมีประโยชน์มากในอนาคต!
dialogsBegin.tw: 請幫我教訓這些怪物吧！打倒新鮮的咚咚菇 10 隻和半熟的咚咚菇 5 隻後，再回來找我，我會給你獎勵的。打倒怪物會掉下不錯的戰鬥品，請你要收集起來喔！
dialogsBegin.vi: Hãy xóa sạch chúng! Nếu bạn săn được 10 Mushpangs nhỏ và 5 Mushpangs thường, tôi sẽ tặng bạn một phần thưởng. Ồ, và hãy giữ lấy bất kỳ chiến lợi phẩm nào chúng đánh rơi, vì sẽ rất hữu ích trong tương lai gần!

dialogsAccept.en: Yeah, I knew you could do this!
dialogsAccept.ar: Yeah, I knew you could do this!
dialogsAccept.br: Sim, eu sabia que podia fazer isso!
dialogsAccept.cns: 我果然没有看错人啊。  为了瑞加大陆大陆的和平~~
dialogsAccept.de: Juhu! Ich wusste, dass du es schaffen wirst.
dialogsAccept.fi: Yeah, I knew you could do this!
dialogsAccept.fil: Yeah, I knew you could do this!
dialogsAccept.fr: (sourit) Je savais que vous pouviez le faire.
dialogsAccept.id: Ya, Aku tahu Kamu bisa melakukan ini!
dialogsAccept.it: Yeah, I knew you could do this!
dialogsAccept.jp: 俺の、人を見る目は正しいはずだ。マドリガル大陸の平和のために･･･頼んだぞ！
dialogsAccept.kr: 역시 해냈군요! 믿고 있었어요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Yeah, I knew you could do this!
dialogsAccept.pl: Yeah, I knew you could do this!
dialogsAccept.ru: Ну, держитесь, сыробежки!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Sabía que podía contar contigo!
dialogsAccept.sw: Yeah, I knew you could do this!
dialogsAccept.th: ใช่ ฉันรู้ว่าคุณทำได้!
dialogsAccept.tw: 我果然沒有看錯人啊。為了瑪德利賈大陸的和平~~
dialogsAccept.vi: Vâng, tôi biết bạn có thể làm điều này!

dialogsDecline.en: Mushpangs are very easy for you to hunt! Help protect Flarine from this menace!
dialogsDecline.ar: Mushpangs are very easy for you to hunt! Help protect Flarine from this menace!
dialogsDecline.br: Mushpangs são muito fáceis de caçar! Por favor, ajude-me a proteger a paz em Flarine!
dialogsDecline.cns: 以你现在的实力来看，嘭嘭菇应该是很简单的怪物吧。 拜托你，为了帕里的村民们，使用你的力量吧。
dialogsDecline.de: Mushpangs sind sehr einfach zu jagen. Bitte hilf mir und beschütze Flaris.
dialogsDecline.fi: Mushpangs are very easy for you to hunt! Help protect Flarine from this menace!
dialogsDecline.fil: Mushpangs are very easy for you to hunt! Help protect Flarine from this menace!
dialogsDecline.fr: Il est très facile de chasser les Mushpangs ! Aidez-moi à préserver la paix à Flarine. Revenez me voir si vous changez d'avis.
dialogsDecline.id: Mushpang sangatlah mudah untuk Kamu buru! Bantu lindungi Flarine dari ancaman ini!
dialogsDecline.it: Mushpangs are very easy for you to hunt! Help protect Flarine from this menace!
dialogsDecline.jp: 今のあんたの実力ならマッシュファングくらい簡単に倒せるだろう。フラリスの住民のために力を貸してくれないか？
dialogsDecline.kr: 머쉬팡은 사냥하기 쉬운 몬스터들이에요. 플라리네를 위협하는 녀석들을 없애 주세요!
dialogsDecline.nl: Mushpangs are very easy for you to hunt! Help protect Flarine from this menace!
dialogsDecline.pl: Mushpangs are very easy for you to hunt! Help protect Flarine from this menace!
dialogsDecline.ru: Так дело не пойдет. А если оружие недостаточно крепкое и подведет тебя в бою с кем-нибудь пострашнее сыробежек?
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Los Mushpangs no serán rival para ti! ¡Ayúdame y protege a Flaris de esta amenaza!
dialogsDecline.sw: Mushpangs are very easy for you to hunt! Help protect Flarine from this menace!
dialogsDecline.th: Muspangs ล่าง่ายมาก! ช่วยปกป้อง Flarine จากภัยคุกคามนี้ที!
dialogsDecline.tw: 以你現在的實力來看，半熟的咚咚菇應該是很簡單的怪物吧。拜託你，為了布拉里斯鎮的村民們，使用你的力量吧。
dialogsDecline.vi: Mushpangs rất dễ săn tìm! Hãy bảo vệ Flarine khỏi mối đe dọa này!

dialogsComplete.en: It appears there is no monster that can threaten you around Flarine. It's time for you to step out into the world and show your power! Your adventure has just started!
dialogsComplete.ar: It appears there is no monster that can threaten you around Flarine. It's time for you to step out into the world and show your power! Your adventure has just started!
dialogsComplete.br: Agora não há monstros que podem representar uma ameaça para você em Flarine. Está na hora de você explorar o mundo e mostrar o seu poder!  Sua aventura acabou de começar.
dialogsComplete.cns: 现在帕里周围已经没有可以威胁你的怪物了，现在请你到宽广的外面世界去，让我看看你真正的实力吧。
dialogsComplete.de: Es gibt kein Monster mehr in Flaris, das in irgendeiner Form eine Bedrohung für dich darstellen könnte. Aber dein Abenteuer beginnt hier!
dialogsComplete.fi: It appears there is no monster that can threaten you around Flarine. It's time for you to step out into the world and show your power! Your adventure has just started!
dialogsComplete.fil: It appears there is no monster that can threaten you around Flarine. It's time for you to step out into the world and show your power! Your adventure has just started!
dialogsComplete.fr: Maintenant, il n'y a plus de monstre autour de Flarine pouvant vraiment vous inquiéter. Vous êtes prêt pour explorer ce vaste monde et démontrer votre force. Ce n'est que le début de vos aventures.
dialogsComplete.id: Sepertinya tidak ada monster yang bisa menandingimu di sekitar Flarine. Saatnya bagimu untuk melangkah keluar ke dunia dan menunjukkan kekuatanmu! Petualangan barumu saja dimulai!
dialogsComplete.it: It appears there is no monster that can threaten you around Flarine. It's time for you to step out into the world and show your power! Your adventure has just started!
dialogsComplete.jp: ハハハ、俺の見込んだ通りだ。さすがだな！もうフラリスの周りであんたにかなうモンスターはいないだろう。この世界は広い。ここよりも広いところで、あんたの力を見せてくれ！まだここは出発地点に過ぎない。あんたの冒険はこれからだ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이제 플라리네 주변엔 당신에게 위협이 되는 몬스터가 없어 보이네요. 더 넓은 세상으로 나아가 힘을 보여줄 차례에요! 진짜 모험은 지금부터랍니다!
dialogsComplete.nl: It appears there is no monster that can threaten you around Flarine. It's time for you to step out into the world and show your power! Your adventure has just started!
dialogsComplete.pl: It appears there is no monster that can threaten you around Flarine. It's time for you to step out into the world and show your power! Your adventure has just started!
dialogsComplete.ru: Теперь я спокоен и за тебя, и за твое снаряжение. Не буду больше тебя задерживать. Отправляйся навстречу приключениям. Перед тобой открыт весь мир!
dialogsComplete.sp: Parece que no hay ningún monstruo que pueda hacerte frente cerca de Flarine. ¡Es hora de que salgas al mundo y demuestres tu poder! ¡Tu aventura acaba de comenzar!
dialogsComplete.sw: It appears there is no monster that can threaten you around Flarine. It's time for you to step out into the world and show your power! Your adventure has just started!
dialogsComplete.th: ดูเหมือนว่าไม่มีสัตว์ประหลาดตัวใดที่สามารถคุกคามคุณรอบๆ Flarine ได้ ถึงเวลาที่คุณจะก้าวออกไปสู่โลกกว้างและแสดงพลังของคุณ! การผจญภัยของคุณเพิ่งเริ่มต้นขึ้น!
dialogsComplete.tw: 現在布拉里斯周圍已經沒有可以威脅你的怪物了，現在請你到寬廣的外面世界去，讓我看看你真正的實力吧。
dialogsComplete.vi: Có vẻ như không có con quái vật nào có thể đe dọa bạn xung quanh Flarine. Đã đến lúc bạn bước ra thế giới và thể hiện sức mạnh của mình! Cuộc phiêu lưu của bạn chỉ mới bắt đầu!

dialogsComplete.en: Looks like you're a new comer. Did you pick up the items one-by-one? I'll give you a newcomer's pet for you.
dialogsComplete.ar: Looks like you're a new comer. Did you pick up the items one-by-one? I'll give you a newcomer's pet for you.
dialogsComplete.br: Looks like you're a new comer. Did you pick up the items one-by-one? I'll give you a newcomer's pet for you.
dialogsComplete.cns: Looks like you're a new comer. Did you pick up the items one-by-one? I'll give you a newcomer's pet for you.
dialogsComplete.de: Du scheinst neu hier zu sein. Hast du die Gegenstände einzeln eingesammelt? Ich gebe dir ein Einsteiger-Begleiterpet.
