dialogsBegin.en: I found out the common thing between them based on the data you brought me. I think it has something to do with supernatural power!
dialogsBegin.ar: I found out the common thing between them based on the data you brought me. I think it has something to do with supernatural power!
dialogsBegin.br: Droga! Isso realmente me irrita! Eu descobri o que elas têm em comum com base nos dados que você me trouxe. Acho que tem algo a ver com um poder sobrenatural!
dialogsBegin.cns: 真是的!我用你帮我调查的线索研究了一下，我发现他们有超能力..
dialogsBegin.de: Verdammt! Das stört mich gewaltig! Ich habe die Gemeinsamkeit, basierend auf der Datei die du mir gebracht hast, herausgefunden. Es sind übernatürliche Kräfte!
dialogsBegin.fi: I found out the common thing between them based on the data you brought me. I think it has something to do with supernatural power!
dialogsBegin.fil: I found out the common thing between them based on the data you brought me. I think it has something to do with supernatural power!
dialogsBegin.fr: Mince! Ca me dérange vraiment! J'ai trouvé leur point commun à partir des infos que tu m'a données. C'est un pouvoir surnaturel!
dialogsBegin.id: Saya menemukan kesamaan di antara mereka berdasarkan data yang kamu berikan kepada saya. Saya pikir itu ada hubungannya dengan kekuatan supranatural!
dialogsBegin.it: I found out the common thing between them based on the data you brought me. I think it has something to do with supernatural power!
dialogsBegin.jp: これは大事件だぞ！君が調査してくれた資料から謎の共通点がわかったんだ。それは・・・超能力だったんだ、超能力！
dialogsBegin.kr: 당신이 조사한 자료를 바탕으로, 공통점을 발견했어요. 초자연적인 힘과 관련이 있는 것 같아요!
dialogsBegin.nl: I found out the common thing between them based on the data you brought me. I think it has something to do with supernatural power!
dialogsBegin.pl: I found out the common thing between them based on the data you brought me. I think it has something to do with supernatural power!
dialogsBegin.ru: Мне удалось выяснить, что все девочки незадолго до похищения плакали и говорили родителям, что боятся мэра. Выходит, они чувствовали угрозу! Но родители им, конечно, не поверили.
dialogsBegin.sp: Descubrí lo que tienen en común con los datos que me trajiste. ¡Creo que tiene algo que ver con el poder sobrenatural!
dialogsBegin.sw: I found out the common thing between them based on the data you brought me. I think it has something to do with supernatural power!
dialogsBegin.th: จากสิ่งที่คุณนำมาให้ฉัน ฉันพบบางสิ่งบางอย่างที่คล้ายกัน ฉันคิดว่ามันมีบางอย่างที่เกี่ยวข้องกับพลังเหนือธรรมชาติ!
dialogsBegin.tw: 真是的！我用你幫我調查的線索研究了一下，我發現他們有超能力…
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đã tìm ra điểm chung giữa chúng dựa trên dữ liệu mà bạn mang lại cho tôi. Tôi nghĩ nó có gì đó liên quan đến sức mạnh siêu nhiên!

dialogsBegin.en: These kids were all afraid of the former mayor and their parents for some reason…
dialogsBegin.ar: These kids were all afraid of the former mayor and their parents for some reason…
dialogsBegin.br: Essas crianças tinham medo do ex-prefeito e de seus pais por algum motivo…
dialogsBegin.cns: 因为这些小孩子的超能力的关系，连孩子们的父母与市长也对他们感到恐惧感，
dialogsBegin.de: Diese Kinder hatten vor ihrem ehemaligen Bürgermeister Angst.. und ihren Eltern..
dialogsBegin.fi: These kids were all afraid of the former mayor and their parents for some reason…
dialogsBegin.fil: These kids were all afraid of the former mayor and their parents for some reason…
dialogsBegin.fr: Ces enfants faisaient peur à l'ancien maire et à leurs parents.
dialogsBegin.id: Anak-anak ini semua takut pada mantan walikota dan orang tua mereka karena suatu alasan ...
dialogsBegin.it: These kids were all afraid of the former mayor and their parents for some reason…
dialogsBegin.jp: 失踪した子どもたちは特殊な能力を持っていたため、親でさえ怖がっていた。災いを恐れた元セイントモーニング市長と子どもの親たちは、子どもたちを町から遠く離れた場所に置き去りにし、捨ててしまおうと隠密に画策したという。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 아이들은 모두 예전 시장님과 부모님을 두려워하고 있었어요…
dialogsBegin.nl: These kids were all afraid of the former mayor and their parents for some reason…
dialogsBegin.pl: These kids were all afraid of the former mayor and their parents for some reason…
dialogsBegin.ru: Получается, что все похищенные девочки обладали пси-способностями! Не похоже на простое совпадение, а? Я думаю, что в них специально развивали этот дар, чтобы дети легче подверглись внушению!
dialogsBegin.sp: Estas niñas tenían miedo del ex alcalde y de sus padres por alguna razón...
dialogsBegin.sw: These kids were all afraid of the former mayor and their parents for some reason…
dialogsBegin.th: เด็กเหล่านี้กลัวนายกเทศมนตรีคนก่อนและพ่อแม่ของพวกเขาด้วยเหตุผลบางอย่าง...
dialogsBegin.tw: 因為這些小孩子的超能力的關係，連孩子們的父母與市長也對他們感到恐懼感，
dialogsBegin.vi: Những đứa trẻ này đều sợ cựu thị trưởng và cha mẹ của chúng vì một lý do nào đó…

dialogsBegin.en: They were abandoned and kicked out of the city! Wow, that can't be true, can it?!
dialogsBegin.ar: They were abandoned and kicked out of the city! Wow, that can't be true, can it?!
dialogsBegin.br: Elas foram abandonadas e expulsas da cidade! Uau, isso não pode ser verdade, pode?!
dialogsBegin.cns: 他们的母亲决定要把她们赶走了，所以这些小孩子就被这样遗弃的..真是的..
dialogsBegin.de: ..Sie beschlossen sie aus der Stadt zu werfen. Also waren die Kinder allein. Verdammt!
dialogsBegin.fi: They were abandoned and kicked out of the city! Wow, that can't be true, can it?!
dialogsBegin.fil: They were abandoned and kicked out of the city! Wow, that can't be true, can it?!
dialogsBegin.fr: .. Ils ont décidé de les chasser de la ville. Ils ont abandonné ces enfants. Mince alors!
dialogsBegin.id: Mereka ditinggalkan dan diusir dari kota! Wow, itu tidak mungkin benar, kan?!
dialogsBegin.it: They were abandoned and kicked out of the city! Wow, that can't be true, can it?!
dialogsBegin.jp: しかしジョハさんだけは娘を捨てることを頑なに拒んだ。そこで親たちはジョハさんの留守を狙ってジノを誘い、置き去りにしたという。ジョハさんは事実を何も知らない。結局、あの子達は捨てられたんだよ！子どもを捨てるだなんて、なんてことを！
dialogsBegin.kr: 버림받고 도시에서 쫓겨났고요! 세상에나, 어떻게 그런 일이?!
dialogsBegin.nl: They were abandoned and kicked out of the city! Wow, that can't be true, can it?!
dialogsBegin.pl: They were abandoned and kicked out of the city! Wow, that can't be true, can it?!
dialogsBegin.ru: А теперь посмотрим инструкции, которые тебе удалось достать.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Fueron abandonadas y expulsadas ​​de la ciudad! Wow, no puede ser cierto, ¡¿verdad?!
dialogsBegin.sw: They were abandoned and kicked out of the city! Wow, that can't be true, can it?!
dialogsBegin.th: พวกเขาถูกทิ้งและถูกไล่ออกจากเมือง! โอ้โฮ มันคงไม่เป็นความจริงหรอก ใช่ไหม?!
dialogsBegin.tw: 他們的母親決定要把她們趕走了，所以這些小孩子就被這樣遺棄的…真是的…
dialogsBegin.vi: Chúng đã bị bỏ rơi và đuổi ra khỏi thành phố! Wow, điều đó không thể là sự thật, phải không ?!

dialogsBegin.en: We have to uncover the truth in this case and make sure it never happens again. Will you help me?!
dialogsBegin.ar: We have to uncover the truth in this case and make sure it never happens again. Will you help me?!
dialogsBegin.br: Temos que descobrir a verdade neste caso e garantir que isso nunca aconteça novamente. Poderia me ajudar?!
dialogsBegin.cns: 我要查出真相，可以帮我吗?
dialogsBegin.de: Wir müssen die Wahrheit dieses Falles aufdecken. Bitte helfe mir.
dialogsBegin.fi: We have to uncover the truth in this case and make sure it never happens again. Will you help me?!
dialogsBegin.fil: We have to uncover the truth in this case and make sure it never happens again. Will you help me?!
dialogsBegin.fr: Nous devons faire la lumière sur cette affaire. S'il te plaît aide-moi.
dialogsBegin.id: Kita harus mengungkap kebenaran dalam kasus ini dan memastikan itu tidak akan pernah terjadi lagi. Akankan kamu menolongku?!
dialogsBegin.it: We have to uncover the truth in this case and make sure it never happens again. Will you help me?!
dialogsBegin.jp: こんな事件は、こんなあってはならない事件は、再び事件が繰り返されないためにも、必ず真相を明らかにしなければならない。だから、私に協力してくれ！
dialogsBegin.kr: 이번 사건의 진상을 반드시 밝혀내야 해요. 이런 일이 다시는 벌어지지 않도록. 도와주실 수 있나요?!
dialogsBegin.nl: We have to uncover the truth in this case and make sure it never happens again. Will you help me?!
dialogsBegin.pl: We have to uncover the truth in this case and make sure it never happens again. Will you help me?!
dialogsBegin.ru: Это мы выясним позже. Сейчас важно то, что Миа остались без управления. Они хотят вернуться домой, но не помнят, где их дом… Думаю, пора идти к мэру Клаусу, а?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tenemos que descubrir la verdad de este caso y asegurarnos de que nunca vuelva a suceder. ¡¿Me ayudarás?!
dialogsBegin.sw: We have to uncover the truth in this case and make sure it never happens again. Will you help me?!
dialogsBegin.th: เราต้องค้นหาความจริงในเรื่องนี้และตรวจดูให้แน่ใจว่ามันจะไม่เกิดขึ้นอีกครั้ง คุณจะช่วยฉันได้ไหม!?
dialogsBegin.tw: 我們必須查明這起事件的真相，確保它不會再次發生。你願意幫我嗎？！
dialogsBegin.vi: Chúng ta phải khám phá ra sự thật trong vụ án này và đảm bảo rằng nó sẽ không bao giờ xảy ra nữa. Bạn sẽ giúp tôi chứ?!

dialogsAccept.en: Awesome! Speak with the mayor again, and ask him to review this Disappearance Investigation.
dialogsAccept.ar: Awesome! Speak with the mayor again, and ask him to review this Disappearance Investigation.
dialogsAccept.br: Você é demais! Aqui está. Leve para o prefeito de Saint, e peça a ele para checar o caso novamente.

dialogsAccept.de: Du bist wirklich gut! Hier bitte. Bring es dem Bürgermeister von Saint Morning und bitte ihn, den Fall erneut zu überprüfen.
dialogsAccept.fi: Awesome! Speak with the mayor again, and ask him to review this Disappearance Investigation.
dialogsAccept.fil: Awesome! Speak with the mayor again, and ask him to review this Disappearance Investigation.
dialogsAccept.fr: Tu es trop fort! Voilà c'est pour toi. Ramènes-ça au maire de Saint Morning, et demandes-lui de rouvrir l'enquête.
dialogsAccept.id: Luar biasa! Bicaralah dengan walikota lagi, dan minta dia untuk meninjau Disappearance Investigation ini.
dialogsAccept.it: Awesome! Speak with the mayor again, and ask him to review this Disappearance Investigation.
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとう、君は立派な心を持った冒険者だ。さあ、これを持ってセイントモーニングの市長に会い、女児連続失踪事件に関する再捜査を要請してきてくれ。頼んだぞ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 좋아요! 시장님을 찾아가서 이 실종 사건 보고서를 다시 검토해 달라고 요청해 주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Awesome! Speak with the mayor again, and ask him to review this Disappearance Investigation.
dialogsAccept.pl: Awesome! Speak with the mayor again, and ask him to review this Disappearance Investigation.
dialogsAccept.ru: Отлично! Покажи ему эти инструкции и объясни, как спасти Миа.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Impresionante! Vuelve a hablar con el alcalde y pídele que revise esta Investigación de Desapariciones.
dialogsAccept.sw: Awesome! Speak with the mayor again, and ask him to review this Disappearance Investigation.
dialogsAccept.th: เยี่ยมยอดไปเลย! จงพูดคุยกับนายกเทศมนตรีอีกครั้งและขอให้เขาตรวจสอบการสืบสวนของเคสคนหายอันนี้
dialogsAccept.tw: 你果然很有正義感，拿著這個去找聖音特市長，請他重新調查案件。
dialogsAccept.vi: Đáng kinh ngạc! Nói chuyện với thị trưởng một lần nữa, và yêu cầu ông ta xem xét lại cuộc Điều tra Mất tích này.

dialogsDecline.en: How can you refuse to help when we are so close to discovering the truth!?
dialogsDecline.ar: How can you refuse to help when we are so close to discovering the truth!?
dialogsDecline.br: Como você pode se recusar a ajudar quando estamos tão perto de descobrir a verdade!?
dialogsDecline.cns: 你们不觉得那些小孩子很可怜吗?哼!
dialogsDecline.de: Wie kannst du dich weigern diesen armen Kindern zu helfen? Du bist echt gemein!
dialogsDecline.fi: Kuinka voit kieltäytyä auttamasta, kun olemme niin lähellä totuuden löytämistä!?
dialogsDecline.fil: How can you refuse to help when we are so close to discovering the truth!?
dialogsDecline.fr: Comment peux-tu refuser d'aider ces pauvres enfants? Tu es vraiment décevant!
dialogsDecline.id: Bagaimana kamu bisa menolak untuk membantu ketika kita begitu dekat untuk menemukan kebenaran!?
dialogsDecline.it: How can you refuse to help when we are so close to discovering the truth!?
dialogsDecline.jp: このままでは、罪もないかわいそうな子どもたちの魂が浮かばれることはないだろう。君は、それでも心が痛まないか？
dialogsDecline.kr: 진실에 이렇게 가까운데, 왜 도와주지 않겠다는 거죠!?
dialogsDecline.nl: How can you refuse to help when we are so close to discovering the truth!?
dialogsDecline.pl: How can you refuse to help when we are so close to discovering the truth!?
dialogsDecline.ru: Как ты можешь отказываться? Мы почти у цели!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡¿Cómo puedes negarte a ayudar cuando estamos tan cerca de descubrir la verdad?!
dialogsDecline.sw: How can you refuse to help when we are so close to discovering the truth!?
dialogsDecline.th: คุณจะปฏิเสธที่จะช่วยเหลือได้อย่างไร ในเมื่อเราใกล้จะค้นพบความจริงกันแล้วน่ะ!?
dialogsDecline.tw: 你們不覺得那些小孩子很可憐嗎？哼！
dialogsDecline.vi: Làm sao bạn có thể từ chối giúp đỡ khi chúng ta đã gần phát hiện ra sự thật !?

dialogsComplete.en: Hmm... This is very intriguing new information. Very well, I'll make a special inquiry group and check the case again. Please tell Porgo I said thanks.
dialogsComplete.ar: Hmm... This is very intriguing new information. Very well, I'll make a special inquiry group and check the case again. Please tell Porgo I said thanks.
dialogsComplete.br: Hmm... Eu não sabia disso antes. Certo, deixe-me criar um grupo especial de inquérito e checar o caso novamente. Por favor, diga a Porgo que eu o agradeço.
dialogsComplete.cns: 嗯..原来有这种是啊..好!我会派人进行重新调查这个案子的，帮我向柏洛格说一声谢谢。
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm.. Das wusste ich bisher noch nicht. Okay, wir bilden eine spezielle Nachforschungsgruppe und überprüfen den Fall erneut. Bitte richte Porgo meinen Dank aus.
dialogsComplete.fi: Hmm... This is very intriguing new information. Very well, I'll make a special inquiry group and check the case again. Please tell Porgo I said thanks.
dialogsComplete.fil: Hmm... This is very intriguing new information. Very well, I'll make a special inquiry group and check the case again. Please tell Porgo I said thanks.
dialogsComplete.fr: Hmm.. Je ne savais pas tout ça. Ok, je vais constituer un nouveau groupe d'investigation et rouvrir le dossier. Dis à Porgo que je le remercie grandement.
dialogsComplete.id: Hmm... Ini informasi baru yang sangat menarik. Baiklah, saya akan membuat kelompok penyelidikan khusus dan memeriksa kasusnya lagi. Tolong beri tahu Porgo bahwa saya mengucapkan terima kasih.
dialogsComplete.it: Hmm... This is very intriguing new information. Very well, I'll make a special inquiry group and check the case again. Please tell Porgo I said thanks.
dialogsComplete.jp: なんと！私が市長になる前に、こんな酷い事件があったとは。わかりました、すぐに特別捜査団を結成して再調査を行いましょう。ポルゴにはお疲れさまとお伝えください。では報告ありがとう、感謝します。
dialogsComplete.kr: 흠… 매우 흥미로운 정보군요. 좋습니다. 특별 조사단을 꾸려서 사건을 다시 살펴보도록 하겠습니다. 포르고에게 감사 인사를 전해 주세요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Hmm... This is very intriguing new information. Very well, I'll make a special inquiry group and check the case again. Please tell Porgo I said thanks.
dialogsComplete.pl: Hmm... This is very intriguing new information. Very well, I'll make a special inquiry group and check the case again. Please tell Porgo I said thanks.
dialogsComplete.ru: Ничего себе!.. Кто бы мог подумать?.. Ну, этот негодяй, наш бывший мэр, за все ответит!..
dialogsComplete.sp: Hmm... Esta nueva información es muy intrigante. Muy bien, crearé un grupo de investigación especial y volveré a revisar el caso. Por favor, dile gracias a Porgo.
dialogsComplete.sw: Hmm... This is very intriguing new information. Very well, I'll make a special inquiry group and check the case again. Please tell Porgo I said thanks.
dialogsComplete.th: อืม... นี่เป็นข้อมูลใหม่ที่น่าสนใจมาก ดีมากฉันจะทำการสอบถามกลุ่มพิเศษและตรวจสอบอีกครั้ง กรุณาไปบอก Porgo ว่าฉันขอบคุณ
dialogsComplete.tw: 嗯…原來有這種事啊…好！我會派人進行重新調查這個案子的，幫我向柏洛格說一聲謝謝。
dialogsComplete.vi: Hmm ... Đây là thông tin mới rất hấp dẫn. Rất tốt, tôi sẽ tạo một nhóm điều tra đặc biệt và kiểm tra lại vụ án. Hãy kể với Porgo tôi đã nói lời cảm ơn.

dialogsFail.en: Saint City is being developed even today. By the way, why did Porgo tell you to meet me? Do you have something to show me?
dialogsFail.ar: Saint City is being developed even today. By the way, why did Porgo tell you to meet me? Do you have something to show me?
dialogsFail.br: A cidade está se desenvolvendo todos os dias. Aliás, por que Porgo disse para você me encontrar? Você tem algo para me mostrar?
dialogsFail.cns: 今天的晨光还是很热闹，柏洛格为什么要见我呢?
dialogsFail.de: Saint City wird auch heute noch entwickelt. Übrigens, warum hat Porgo dir gesagt, dass du mich treffen sollst? Hast du mir etwas zu zeigen?
dialogsFail.fi: Saint City is being developed even today. By the way, why did Porgo tell you to meet me? Do you have something to show me?
dialogsFail.fil: Saint City is being developed even today. By the way, why did Porgo tell you to meet me? Do you have something to show me?
dialogsFail.fr: Saint Morning est en plein développement maintenant - Mais, pourquoi Porgo t'as demandé de venir me voir?
dialogsFail.id: Saint City sedang dikembangkan bahkan sampai hari ini. Ngomong-ngomong, kenapa Porgo menyuruhmu menemuiku? Apakah kamu memiliki sesuatu untuk ditunjukkan kepada saya?
dialogsFail.it: Saint City is being developed even today. By the way, why did Porgo tell you to meet me? Do you have something to show me?
dialogsFail.jp: 本日もセイントモーニングは、神聖な朝の都市の名のとおりに美しく栄えています。おや？ポルゴさんから私に会うように言われたのですか？
dialogsFail.kr: 오늘도 세인트 시티는 번창하고 있군요. 근데, 포르고가 왜 저를 만나라고 했죠? 보여주실 게 있나요?
dialogsFail.nl: Saint City is being developed even today. By the way, why did Porgo tell you to meet me? Do you have something to show me?
dialogsFail.pl: Saint City is being developed even today. By the way, why did Porgo tell you to meet me? Do you have something to show me?
dialogsFail.ru: Санто хорошеет день ото дня. Кстати, как идет расследование Тинкертона?
dialogsFail.sp: Saint está en desarrollo hoy. Por cierto, ¿por qué te dijo Porgo que te reunieras conmigo? ¿Tienes algo que enseñarme?
dialogsFail.sw: Saint City is being developed even today. By the way, why did Porgo tell you to meet me? Do you have something to show me?
dialogsFail.th: Saint City กำลังพัฒนาอยู่แม้กระทั่งในปัจจุบัน แล้ว Porgo บอกให้คุณมาพบฉันงั้นเหรอ? คุณมีอะไรจะมาบอกกันล่ะ?
dialogsFail.tw: 即使在今天，聖音特也在發展。對了，柏洛格為什麼要讓你見我？你有什麼要給我看的嗎？
dialogsFail.vi: Saint City đang được phát triển cho đến tận ngày nay. Mà này, tại sao Porgo lại bảo anh gặp tôi? Bạn có cái gì để cho tôi xem à?

dialogsBegin.en: While you were delivering the package, I looked further into this hero that you were inquiring about. A friend of mine, Est, seems to have more information on him.
dialogsBegin.ar: While you were delivering the package, I looked further into this hero that you were inquiring about. A friend of mine, Est, seems to have more information on him.
dialogsBegin.br: Enquanto você estava entregando o pacote, eu procurei saber mais sobre esse herói que você estava me perguntando. Um amigo meu, Est, parece ter mais informações sobre ele.
dialogsBegin.cns: 在你送包裹的时候，我进一步调查了你所询问的这位英雄。我的朋友埃斯特似乎有更多关于他的信息。
dialogsBegin.de: Während Sie das Paket ablieferten, habe ich mir diesen Helden, nach dem Sie sich erkundigt haben, genauer angesehen. Eine Freundin von mir, Est, scheint mehr Informationen über ihn zu haben.
dialogsBegin.fi: While you were delivering the package, I looked further into this hero that you were inquiring about. A friend of mine, Est, seems to have more information on him.
dialogsBegin.fil: While you were delivering the package, I looked further into this hero that you were inquiring about. A friend of mine, Est, seems to have more information on him.
dialogsBegin.fr: Voilà, j'ai plus de temps pour penser maintenant. Je me souviens que le Héros a dit se rendre dans les montagnes du Goutan pour aider Ist.
dialogsBegin.id: Saat Anda mengirimkan paket, saya melihat lebih jauh ke dalam pahlawan yang Anda tanyakan ini. Seorang teman saya, Est, tampaknya memiliki lebih banyak informasi tentang dia.
dialogsBegin.it: While you were delivering the package, I looked further into this hero that you were inquiring about. A friend of mine, Est, seems to have more information on him.
dialogsBegin.jp: さて、そういえば貴方はゾロについて探しているんでしたね。実は私はあまり詳しいことは知らないのですが……あ、待って下さい！　怒らないで！
dialogsBegin.kr: 당신이 물건을 전하는 동안, 당신이 찾고 있던 그 영웅에 대해 좀 더 알아봤어요. 제 친구, 에스트에게 정보가 있는 것 같아요.
dialogsBegin.nl: While you were delivering the package, I looked further into this hero that you were inquiring about. A friend of mine, Est, seems to have more information on him.
dialogsBegin.pl: While you were delivering the package, I looked further into this hero that you were inquiring about. A friend of mine, Est, seems to have more information on him.
dialogsBegin.ru: While you were delivering the package, I looked further into this hero that you were inquiring about. A friend of mine, Est, seems to have more information on him.
dialogsBegin.sp: Mientras entregabas el paquete, he investigado a fondo sobre ese héroe por el que me preguntabas. Un amigo mío, Est, parece tener más información sobre él.
dialogsBegin.sw: While you were delivering the package, I looked further into this hero that you were inquiring about. A friend of mine, Est, seems to have more information on him.
dialogsBegin.th: ขณะที่คุณกำลังส่งมอบแพคเกจนี้ผมมองเข้าไปในฮีโร่ที่คุณต้องการมากขึ้น เพื่อนของฉัน Est ดูเหมือนจะมีข้อมูลเพิ่มเติมเกี่ยวกับเขา
dialogsBegin.tw: 在你運送包裹時，我進一步調查了你詢問的這位英雄。我的一個朋友法小紀似乎有更多關於他的訊息。
dialogsBegin.vi: Trong khi bạn giao gói hàng, tôi đã tìm hiểu sâu hơn về vị anh hùng mà bạn đang thắc mắc. Một người bạn của tôi, Est, dường như đang có thêm thông tin về anh ta.

dialogsBegin.en: Est is conducting research in the Gouthan Mountains, but is currently besieged by monsters. If you were to help him, he will tell you what you need.
dialogsBegin.ar: Est is conducting research in the Gouthan Mountains, but is currently besieged by monsters. If you were to help him, he will tell you what you need.
dialogsBegin.br: Est está realizando pesquisas nas Montanhas Gouthan, mas atualmente está cercado por monstros. Se você o ajudar, ele lhe dirá as informações que você precisa.
dialogsBegin.cns: 埃斯特正在永恒森林进行研究，但目前被怪物围困。如果你要帮助他的话，他会告诉你你需要什么。
dialogsBegin.de: Est forscht in den Gouthan Mountains, wird aber derzeit von Monstern belagert. Wenn du ihm hilfst, wird er dir sagen, was du brauchst.
dialogsBegin.fi: Est is conducting research in the Gouthan Mountains, but is currently besieged by monsters. If you were to help him, he will tell you what you need.
dialogsBegin.fil: Est is conducting research in the Gouthan Mountains, but is currently besieged by monsters. If you were to help him, he will tell you what you need.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il a aussi dit quelque chose à propos des Driller.
dialogsBegin.id: Est sedang melakukan penelitian di Pegunungan Gouthan, tetapi saat ini dikepung oleh monster. Jika Anda membantunya, dia akan memberi tahu Anda apa yang Anda butuhkan.
dialogsBegin.it: Est is conducting research in the Gouthan Mountains, but is currently besieged by monsters. If you were to help him, he will tell you what you need.
dialogsBegin.jp: Dr.エストという人物はご存知ですか？　山奥で研究をしている変わり者ですが、最近ドリルが増えて研究がままならないようです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 에스트는 고우단 산맥에서 연구하고 있는데, 지금 몬스터들에게 포위당해 있어요. 에스트를 도와주면, 원하는 정보를 알려줄 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Est is conducting research in the Gouthan Mountains, but is currently besieged by monsters. If you were to help him, he will tell you what you need.
dialogsBegin.pl: Est is conducting research in the Gouthan Mountains, but is currently besieged by monsters. If you were to help him, he will tell you what you need.
dialogsBegin.ru: Est is conducting research in the Gouthan Mountains, but is currently besieged by monsters. If you were to help him, he will tell you what you need.
dialogsBegin.sp: Est está realizando una investigación en las Montañas Gouthan, pero está rodeado de monstruos. Si vas a ayudarlo, te dirá lo que necesitas.
dialogsBegin.sw: Est is conducting research in the Gouthan Mountains, but is currently besieged by monsters. If you were to help him, he will tell you what you need.
dialogsBegin.th: Est กำลังดำเนินการวิจัยในเทือกเขา Gouthan แต่ปัจจุบันถูกล้อมรอบด้วยมอนสเตอร์ ถ้าคุณจะช่วยเขา เขาจะบอกคุณในสิ่งที่คุณต้องการ
dialogsBegin.tw: 法小紀在古坦山脈進行研究，但目前被怪物包圍。如果你幫助他，他會告訴你你需要什麼。
dialogsBegin.vi: Est đang tiến hành nghiên cứu ở dãy núi Gouthan, nhưng hiện đang bị bao vây bởi lũ quái vật. Nếu bạn giúp anh ấy, anh ấy sẽ cho bạn biết bạn cần gì.

dialogsAccept.en: Please head to the Gouthan Mountains in Northern Darkon and defeat 10 Small Volt and 10 Captain Driller. Then meet with Est.
dialogsAccept.ar: Please head to the Gouthan Mountains in Northern Darkon and defeat 10 Small Volt and 10 Captain Driller. Then meet with Est.
dialogsAccept.br: Por favor, vá para as Montanhas Gouthan no Norte de Darkon e ajude Est. Derrote 10 Volts Pequenos e 10 Sondadores Capitães. Em seguida, fale com ele.
dialogsAccept.cns: 请前往达肯北部的永恒森林，击败10个低压电磁履带车和10个大型自动钻孔机。然后与埃斯特见面。
dialogsAccept.de: Bitte begebt euch zu den Gouthan Mountains im Norden Darkons und besiegt 10 Small Volt and 10 Captain Driller. Triff dich dann mit Est.
dialogsAccept.fi: Please head to the Gouthan Mountains in Northern Darkon and defeat 10 Small Volt and 10 Captain Driller. Then meet with Est.
dialogsAccept.fil: Please head to the Gouthan Mountains in Northern Darkon and defeat 10 Small Volt and 10 Captain Driller. Then meet with Est.
dialogsAccept.fr: Tuez donc 10 Capitaines Driller et 10 jeunes Volt puis allez parler au Dr. Est.
dialogsAccept.id: Silakan pergi ke Gouthan Mountains di Northern Darkon dan kalahkan 10 Small Volt dan 10 Captain Driller. Kemudian bertemu dengan Est.
dialogsAccept.it: Please head to the Gouthan Mountains in Northern Darkon and defeat 10 Small Volt and 10 Captain Driller. Then meet with Est.
dialogsAccept.jp: Dr.エストはダーコンの最東側で研究をしていると思います。何体かドリルを倒して彼の研究を手伝ってあげれば何か教えてくれると思いますよ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 이스트는 다콘 북쪽 고우단 산맥 근처에서 조사를 하고 있답니다. 그 근처에는 볼트와 드릴러들이 많으니 반드시 그들을 처치하고 이스트에게 찾아가세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Please head to the Gouthan Mountains in Northern Darkon and defeat 10 Small Volt and 10 Captain Driller. Then meet with Est.
dialogsAccept.pl: Udaj się proszę w Góry Gouthan w Północnym Darkon i pokonaj 10 Małych Volt i 10 Kapitan Wiertnik. Następnie spotkaj się z Est.
dialogsAccept.ru: Please head to the Gouthan Mountains in Northern Darkon and defeat 10 Small Volt and 10 Captain Driller. Then meet with Est.
dialogsAccept.sp: Dirígete a las Montañas Gouthan del Norte de Darkon y derrota a 10 Volts Pequeños y a 10 Drillers Capitanes. Después reúnete con Est.
dialogsAccept.sw: Please head to the Gouthan Mountains in Northern Darkon and defeat 10 Small Volt and 10 Captain Driller. Then meet with Est.
dialogsAccept.th: โปรดมุ่งหน้าไปยังเทือกเขา Gouthan ใน Northern Darkon และกำจัด Small Volt 10 ตัว และ Captain Driller 10 ตัว จากนั้นไปพบกับ Est
dialogsAccept.tw: 請前往得肯北部的古坦山脈，擊敗 10 個機械戰車嘍囉和 10 個暴鑽機械頭目，然後與法小紀碰面。
dialogsAccept.vi: Hãy đi đến Dãy núi Gouthan ở Northern Darkon và đánh bại 10 Small Volt và 10 Captain Driller. Sau đó gặp Est.

dialogsDecline.en: Oh well, understandable. I'm not much of a fighter myself.
dialogsDecline.ar: Oh well, understandable. I'm not much of a fighter myself.
dialogsDecline.br: Ah, bem, é compreensível. Eu mesmo não sou do tipo lutador.
dialogsDecline.cns: 哦，好吧，可以理解。我自己也不是一个善于战斗的人。
dialogsDecline.de: Na ja, verständlich. Ich bin selbst kein großer Kämpfer.
dialogsDecline.fi: Oh well, understandable. I'm not much of a fighter myself.
dialogsDecline.fil: Oh well, understandable. I'm not much of a fighter myself.
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous ne voulez pas trouver les Héros ?
dialogsDecline.id: Oh yah, bisa dimengerti. Saya sendiri bukan petarung.
dialogsDecline.it: Oh well, understandable. I'm not much of a fighter myself.
dialogsDecline.jp: ゾロをついて調べているのではなかったのですか？
dialogsDecline.kr: 이해해요. 저도 싸움에는 그다지 소질이 없거든요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Oh well, understandable. I'm not much of a fighter myself.
dialogsDecline.pl: Oh well, understandable. I'm not much of a fighter myself.
dialogsDecline.ru: Oh well, understandable. I'm not much of a fighter myself.
dialogsDecline.sp: Oh bueno, es comprensible. Yo tampoco soy muy luchador.
dialogsDecline.sw: Oh well, understandable. I'm not much of a fighter myself.
dialogsDecline.th: โอ้ววว เข้าใจง่าย ฉันไม่ค่อยเป็นนักสู้มากนัก
dialogsDecline.tw: 恩，理解。我自己不是一個戰士。
dialogsDecline.vi: Ồ, xin cảm thông. Bản thân tôi không phải là một chiến binh.

dialogsComplete.en: What!? The Volts and Drillers just suddenly disappeared! Oh, were you responsible for this?
dialogsComplete.ar: What!? The Volts and Drillers just suddenly disappeared! Oh, were you responsible for this?
dialogsComplete.br: Como assim!? Os Volts e os Sondadores simplesmente desapareceram de repente! Ah, você foi o responsável por isso??
dialogsComplete.cns: What!? The Volts and Drillers just suddenly disappeared! Oh, were you responsible for this?
dialogsComplete.de: Was? Die Volts und Drillers sind plötzlich verschwunden! Oh, warst du dafür verantwortlich??
dialogsComplete.fi: What!? The Volts and Drillers just suddenly disappeared! Oh, were you responsible for this?
dialogsComplete.fil: What!? The Volts and Drillers just suddenly disappeared! Oh, were you responsible for this?
dialogsComplete.fr: C'est vous qui avez massacré les Driller et les Volt ?
dialogsComplete.id: Apa!? Volt dan Driller tiba-tiba menghilang! Oh, apakah kamu bertanggung jawab untuk ini??
dialogsComplete.it: What!? The Volts and Drillers just suddenly disappeared! Oh, were you responsible for this?
dialogsComplete.jp: あれ、貴方はこんなところで何をしているのですか？
dialogsComplete.kr: 뭐지!? 볼트와 드릴러가 갑자기 사라졌어요! 오, 당신이 그런 건가요?
dialogsComplete.nl: What!? The Volts and Drillers just suddenly disappeared! Oh, were you responsible for this?
dialogsComplete.pl: Co!? Volty i Wiertniki nagle zniknęły! Och, czy byłeś za to odpowiedzialny?
dialogsComplete.ru: What!? The Volts and Drillers just suddenly disappeared! Oh, were you responsible for this?
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿¡Qué!? ¡Los Volts y los Drillers han desaparecido de repente! Oh, ¿tú eres el responsable?
dialogsComplete.sw: What!? The Volts and Drillers just suddenly disappeared! Oh, were you responsible for this?
dialogsComplete.th: อะไร!? Volts และ Drillers ก็หายตัวไปแล้ว! โอ้ววว คุณช่วยหน่อยได้มั้ย?
dialogsComplete.tw: 什麼！？伏特和鑽地機就這樣突然消失了！喔，這該不會是你做的吧？
dialogsComplete.vi: Gì cơ!? Volts và Drillers đột nhiên biến mất! Ồ, bạn có chịu trách nhiệm về việc này không?

dialogsFail.en: Please hurry to the Gouthan Mountains! I'm worried that if we don't act soon, something bad might happen to Est!
dialogsFail.ar: Please hurry to the Gouthan Mountains! I'm worried that if we don't act soon, something bad might happen to Est!
dialogsFail.br: Por favor, corra para as Montanhas Gouthan! Estou preocupado que, se não agirmos logo, algo ruim possa acontecer com Est!
dialogsFail.cns: 请尽快赶到永恒森林！我担心如果我们不尽快行动，埃斯特可能会发生一些不好的事情!
dialogsFail.de: Bitte beeilt euch zu den Gouthan Mountains! Ich mache mir Sorgen, dass Est etwas Schlimmes zustoßen könnte, wenn wir nicht bald handeln!
dialogsFail.fi: Please hurry to the Gouthan Mountains! I'm worried that if we don't act soon, something bad might happen to Est!
dialogsFail.fil: Please hurry to the Gouthan Mountains! I'm worried that if we don't act soon, something bad might happen to Est!
dialogsFail.fr: Tuez 10 Capitaines Driller et 10 jeunes Volt, puis allez parler au Dr. Est.
dialogsFail.id: Cepat ke Gouthan Mountains! Saya khawatir jika kita tidak segera bertindak, sesuatu yang buruk mungkin terjadi pada Est!
dialogsFail.it: Please hurry to the Gouthan Mountains! I'm worried that if we don't act soon, something bad might happen to Est!
dialogsFail.jp: ここからは結構距離があります。気をつけて下さいね。
dialogsFail.kr: 어서 고우단 산맥으로 가 주세요! 지금 가지 않으면 에스트에게 나쁜 일이 생길 수도 있어요!
dialogsFail.nl: Please hurry to the Gouthan Mountains! I'm worried that if we don't act soon, something bad might happen to Est!
dialogsFail.pl: Please hurry to the Gouthan Mountains! I'm worried that if we don't act soon, something bad might happen to Est!
dialogsFail.ru: Please hurry to the Gouthan Mountains! I'm worried that if we don't act soon, something bad might happen to Est!
dialogsFail.sp: ¡Date prisa en ir a las Montañas Gouthan! ¡Me preocupa que si no actuamos pronto, le pueda pasar algo malo a Est!
dialogsFail.sw: Please hurry to the Gouthan Mountains! I'm worried that if we don't act soon, something bad might happen to Est!
dialogsFail.th: กรุณารีบไปที่ภูเขา Gouthan! ฉันกังวลว่าถ้าเราไม่รีบจัดการ สิ่งที่ไม่ดีอาจเกิดขึ้นกับ Est!
dialogsFail.tw: 請快點到古坦山脈！我擔心如果我們不盡快採取行動，法小紀可能會出事！
dialogsFail.vi: Hãy nhanh chân đến dãy núi Gouthan! Tôi lo lắng rằng nếu chúng tôi không sớm hành động, điều gì đó tồi tệ có thể xảy ra với Est!

description.en: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.ar: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.br: Caçando $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ recuperará seus pontos de Karma.
description.cns: 为了减少你的罪恶值，你要去击杀 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 回来。
description.de: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ jagen wird dein Karma wiederherstellen.
description.fi: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.fil: Ang Pang-huhuli ng $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ay makakapagpanumbalik ng iyong Karma points.
description.fr: Tu devrais chasser des $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s afin de récupérer les points de Karma.
description.id: Berburu $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ akan memulihkan poin-poin Karmamu.
description.it: Stai cacciando $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ per recuperare i tuoi punti Karma.
description.jp: カルマポイントを回復するため、$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を処罰して来てください。
description.nl: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.pl: Polowanie na $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ pozwoli odzyskać punkty Karmy.
description.ru: Твоя цель - $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, только так ты очистишь карму.
description.sp: Cazar $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ recuperará tus puntos de Karma.
description.sw: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.th: การล่า $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ จะกู้คืนคะแนน Karma ของคุณ
description.tw: 狩獵 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 將會恢復你的惡名點數。
description.vi: Săn $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ sẽ phục hồi điểm Karma của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsAccept.br: Cace $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.cns: 击杀 $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.

dialogsAccept.fi: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.

dialogsAccept.it: Caccia $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.

dialogsAccept.kr: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$마리를 사냥하세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.pl: Upoluj $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.ru: Твоя цель - $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$. Требуется покарать не менее $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$.

dialogsAccept.vi: Săn $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.

dialogsDecline.en: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.ar: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.br: Você ainda tem que pagar pelos seus pecados...
dialogsDecline.cns: 你还没有为你的罪恶付出代价...
dialogsDecline.de: Du musst noch immer für deine Sünden bezahlen...
dialogsDecline.fi: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.fil: Di mo pa bayad ang iyong mga kasalanan…
dialogsDecline.fr: Quand expieras-tu tes nombreux crimes ?
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu belum membayar untuk dosa-dosamu…
dialogsDecline.it: Devi ancora pagare per i tuoi peccati...
dialogsDecline.jp: いつになったら、この底知れぬ罪悪感から抜けられるのだろう？
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신은 아직 죗값을 치르지 않았으니...
dialogsDecline.nl: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.pl: Musisz najpierw zapłacić za swoje grzechy…
dialogsDecline.ru: Велики твои грехи…
dialogsDecline.sp: Todavía tienes que pagar por tus pecados...
dialogsDecline.sw: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.th: คุณยังไม้ได้ชดใช้บาปของคุณ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 你還沒有為你的罪付出代價…
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn vẫn chưa phải trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình…

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.br: Sua missão foi concluída. Seus pecados foram perdoados.
dialogsComplete.cns: 任务完成，你的罪恶已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Buße getan. Deine Sünden wurden dir vergeben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Questmu telah tercapai. Dosa-dosamu telah diampuni.
dialogsComplete.it: La Missione è terminata. I tuoi peccati sono stati perdonati.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 끝났습니다. 당신의 죄를 용서하지요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Боги одобрили твое деяние и простили тебе грехи.
dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น บาปของคุณได้รับการอภัยแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nhiệm vụ của bạn đã được hoàn thành. Tội lỗi của bạn đã được tha thứ.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

description.en: Kill 10 Bang & 5 Captain Bang and return to the Mayor of Flarine.
description.ar: Kill 10 Bang & 5 Captain Bang and return to the Mayor of Flarine.
description.br: Elimine 10 Bangs e 5 Bangs Capitães, depois volte para o Prefeito de Flarine.
description.cns: 杀死10个魔导战甲士兵和5个魔导战甲队长后再回来找帕里市长。
description.de: Töte 10 Bang & 5 Captain Bang und kehre zum Bürgermeister von Flarine zurück.
description.fi: Kill 10 Bang & 5 Captain Bang and return to the Mayor of Flarine.
description.fil: Kill 10 Bang & 5 Captain Bang and return to the Mayor of Flarine.
description.fr: Tuez 10 Bang et 5 Capitaines Bang et revenez parler au maire de Flarine.
description.id: Habisi 10 Bang dan 5 Captain Bang lalu kembali ke Mayor of Flarine.
description.it: Kill 10 Bang & 5 Captain Bang and return to the Mayor of Flarine.
description.jp: バン10匹、キャプテンバン5匹を倒して、フラリスの市長に報告せよ。
description.kr: 뱅 10마리와 두목 뱅 5마리를 처치하고 플라리네 시장에게 돌아가세요.
description.nl: Kill 10 Bang & 5 Captain Bang and return to the Mayor of Flarine.

description.sw: Kill 10 Bang & 5 Captain Bang and return to the Mayor of Flarine.
description.th: สังหาร 10 Bang & 5 Captain Bang และกลับไปหานายกเทศมนตรีแห่ง Flarine
description.tw: 殺死 10 個崩崩嘍囉和 5 個崩崩，然後返回布拉里斯市長。
description.vi: Giết 10 Bang & 5 Captain Bang và quay trở lại Thị trưởng Flarine.

dialogsBegin.en: Given your prior victory, I have another favor to ask. An unwieldy group of bangs have really shaken things up in Northern Flaris. Can we count on you to take care of them?
dialogsBegin.ar: Given your prior victory, I have another favor to ask. An unwieldy group of bangs have really shaken things up in Northern Flaris. Can we count on you to take care of them?
dialogsBegin.br: Dada sua vitória anterior, tenho outro favor a pedir. Um grupo pesado de Bangs realmente abalou as coisas no Norte de Flaris. Podemos contar com você para cuidar deles?
dialogsBegin.cns: 考虑到你之前成功的完成了任务，我还有另一个请求。一群笨重的魔导战甲士兵把帕里北部弄得翻天覆地的。请问你能帮我们去给他们一些教训吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Angesichts Eures früheren Sieges möchte ich Euch um einen weiteren Gefallen bitten. Eine unüberschaubare Gruppe von Panzern hat die Dinge in Nordflaris ziemlich durcheinander gebracht. Können wir auf euch zählen, dass ihr euch um sie kümmert?
dialogsBegin.fi: Given your prior victory, I have another favor to ask. An unwieldy group of bangs have really shaken things up in Northern Flaris. Can we count on you to take care of them?
dialogsBegin.fil: Given your prior victory, I have another favor to ask. An unwieldy group of bangs have really shaken things up in Northern Flaris. Can we count on you to take care of them?
dialogsBegin.fr: La population de Flarine ne tarit pas d'éloges sur vous. Continuons à les impressionner, voulez-vous ?
dialogsBegin.id: Mengingat keberhasilanmu sebelumnya, aku memiliki permintaan lain yang ingin kubicarakan. Sekelompok Bangs telah membuat kekacauan di Nothern Flaris. Dapatkah kami mengandalkanmu untuk mengurus mereka?
dialogsBegin.it: Given your prior victory, I have another favor to ask. An unwieldy group of bangs have really shaken things up in Northern Flaris. Can we count on you to take care of them?
dialogsBegin.jp: もう一つお願いがあります。ニャングニャングよりもさらに奥地にヴァンというモンスターがいるのですが、これも最近勢力を拡大し始めています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이전에 보여주신 활약에 더해, 부탁이 하나 더 있답니다. 플라리스 북부에서 뱅 무리가 소란을 피우고 있거든요. 도와주실 수 있을까요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Given your prior victory, I have another favor to ask. An unwieldy group of bangs have really shaken things up in Northern Flaris. Can we count on you to take care of them?
dialogsBegin.pl: Given your prior victory, I have another favor to ask. An unwieldy group of bangs have really shaken things up in Northern Flaris. Can we count on you to take care of them?
dialogsBegin.ru: У меня для тебя есть ещё одна просьба. Зная о твоих прошлых подвигах, не думаю, что она покажется тебе сложной. На севере объявилась банда Громов. Сможешь помочь с ними разобраться?
dialogsBegin.sp: Dada tu victoria anterior, tengo otro favor que pedirte. Un grupo difícil de manejar de Bangs ha estado dando problemas en el Norte de Flaris. ¿Podemos contar contigo para "cuidarlos"?
dialogsBegin.sw: Given your prior victory, I have another favor to ask. An unwieldy group of bangs have really shaken things up in Northern Flaris. Can we count on you to take care of them?
dialogsBegin.th: เมื่อได้รับชัยชนะก่อนหน้านี้ ข้าพเจ้ามีเรื่องจะขอร้องอีก Bang ได้สร้างความสั่นสะเทือนใน Northern Flaris เราไว้ใจให้คุณดูแลพวกเขาได้ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 有鑑於你之前的勝利，我還有一個問題要請教。一群崩崩嘍囉確實驚嚇了布拉里斯北方，我們可以指望你消滅他們嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Với chiến thắng trước của bạn, tôi có một đặc ân khác để yêu cầu. Một nhóm bang khó sử dụng đã thực sự làm chấn động mọi thứ ở Northern Flaris. Chúng tôi có thể tin tưởng vào bạn để chăm sóc họ?

dialogsAccept.en: Bangs can be found in North side of Flaris, near by Nyangnyang. Go kill 10 Bang & 5 Captain Bang and come back.
dialogsAccept.ar: Bangs can be found in North side of Flaris, near by Nyangnyang. Go kill 10 Bang & 5 Captain Bang and come back.
dialogsAccept.br: Os Bangs podem ser encontrados no lado norte de Flaris, perto das Nyangnyangs. Vá e elimine 10 Bangs & 5 Bangs Capitães e volte.
dialogsAccept.cns: 魔导战甲士兵可以在帕里北部，彩冠翎猫栖息地附近找到。去杀死10个魔导战甲士兵和5个魔导战甲队长后再回来。
dialogsAccept.de: Bangs findet man auf der Nordseite von Flaris, in der Nähe von Nyangnyang. Töte 10 Bang und 5 Captain Bang und komm zurück.
dialogsAccept.fi: Bangs can be found in North side of Flaris, near by Nyangnyang. Go kill 10 Bang & 5 Captain Bang and come back.
dialogsAccept.fil: Bangs can be found in North side of Flaris, near by Nyangnyang. Go kill 10 Bang & 5 Captain Bang and come back.
dialogsAccept.fr: Les monstres les plus puissants de Flaris sont les Bang. Ils vivent loin au Nord heureusement. Allez donc en tuer 10 et 5 capitaines pour leur rappeler qu'ils feraient mieux de rester chez eux.
dialogsAccept.id: Bang dapat ditemukan di sisi utara dari Flaris, didekat Nyangnyang. Pergi dan habisi 10 Bang dan 5 Captain Bang lalu kembali kesini.
dialogsAccept.it: Bangs can be found in North side of Flaris, near by Nyangnyang. Go kill 10 Bang & 5 Captain Bang and come back.
dialogsAccept.jp: ヴァンはフラリスの北橋を渡ったところで、ニャングニャングと仲良く生息している。 ヴァン10匹、キャプテン・ヴァン5匹だけ倒して来てくれるか。
dialogsAccept.kr: 플라리스 북부 다리를 지나면 냥냥 서식지 근처에 뱅들이 있답니다. 뱅 10마리와 두목 뱅 5마리를 처치하고 돌아와 주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Bangs can be found in North side of Flaris, near by Nyangnyang. Go kill 10 Bang & 5 Captain Bang and come back.
dialogsAccept.pl: Bangs can be found in North side of Flaris, near by Nyangnyang. Go kill 10 Bang & 5 Captain Bang and come back.
dialogsAccept.ru: Громов можно найти на севере острова, неподалёку от Кисандр. Убей 10 обычных и 5 сильных и возвращайся.
dialogsAccept.sp: Los Bangs se pueden encontrar en el lado Norte de Flaris, cerca de las Nyangnyangs. Derrota a 10 Bangs y a 5 Bangs Capitanes y regresa.
dialogsAccept.sw: Bangs can be found in North side of Flaris, near by Nyangnyang. Go kill 10 Bang & 5 Captain Bang and come back.
dialogsAccept.th: Bang สามารถพบได้ในทางด้านเหนือของ Flaris ใกล้กับ Nyangnyang ไปฆ่า 10 Bang & 5 Captain Bang แล้วกลับมา
dialogsAccept.tw: 崩崩嘍囉位於布拉里斯的北側，靠近裝可愛喵娘。去殺死 10 隻崩崩嘍囉和 5 隻崩崩，然後回來。
dialogsAccept.vi: Bangs có thể được tìm thấy ở phía Bắc của Flaris, gần Nyangnyang. Hãy giết 10 Bang & 5 Captain Bang và quay trở lại.

dialogsDecline.en: Your prior deeds for us are enough to earn my gratitude.
dialogsDecline.ar: Your prior deeds for us are enough to earn my gratitude.
dialogsDecline.br: Seus atos anteriores que fez por nós são suficientes para merecer minha gratidão.
dialogsDecline.cns: 非常感谢你为我们做的所有事情。
dialogsDecline.de: Ihre früheren Taten für uns sind genug, um meine Dankbarkeit zu verdienen.
dialogsDecline.fi: Your prior deeds for us are enough to earn my gratitude.
dialogsDecline.fil: Your prior deeds for us are enough to earn my gratitude.
dialogsDecline.fr: Pardon, je ne voulais pas vous empêcher de continuer votre aventure…
dialogsDecline.id: Aku sangat berterima kasih atas semua yang kamu lakukan selama ini.
dialogsDecline.it: Your prior deeds for us are enough to earn my gratitude.
dialogsDecline.jp: 非常に助かりました。
dialogsDecline.kr: 이전에 보여주신 활약만으로도 깊이 감사드리고 있답니다.
dialogsDecline.nl: Your prior deeds for us are enough to earn my gratitude.
dialogsDecline.pl: Your prior deeds for us are enough to earn my gratitude.
dialogsDecline.ru: Your prior deeds for us are enough to earn my gratitude.
dialogsDecline.sp: Tus anteriores acciones por nosotros son suficientes para ganarte mi gratitud.
dialogsDecline.sw: Your prior deeds for us are enough to earn my gratitude.
dialogsDecline.th: การกระทำก่อนหน้าของคุณสำหรับเรานั้นเพียงพอที่จะได้รับความกตัญญู
dialogsDecline.tw: 你之前為我們所做的一切，足以讓我感激不盡。
dialogsDecline.vi: Những việc làm trước đây của bạn dành cho chúng tôi đủ để khiến tôi biết ơn.

dialogsComplete.en: You've taken care of the issue already!? Astonishing! Now our mining operations in the mountains of Flaris may resume!
dialogsComplete.ar: You've taken care of the issue already!? Astonishing! Now our mining operations in the mountains of Flaris may resume!
dialogsComplete.br: Você já resolveu o problema!? Incrível! Agora nossas operações de mineração nas montanhas de Flaris podem ser retomadas!
dialogsComplete.cns: 你已经处理好这些问题了吗！？真令人难以置信！现在我们终于能继续在帕里的山里采矿了！
dialogsComplete.de: Sie haben sich bereits um das Problem gekümmert!? Erstaunlich! Jetzt können wir unsere Bergbauarbeiten in den Bergen von Flaris wieder aufnehmen!
dialogsComplete.fi: You've taken care of the issue already!? Astonishing! Now our mining operations in the mountains of Flaris may resume!
dialogsComplete.fil: You've taken care of the issue already!? Astonishing! Now our mining operations in the mountains of Flaris may resume!
dialogsComplete.fr: Vois revoilà déjà ? Vous êtes incroyable mon jeune ami.
dialogsComplete.id: Kamu sudah selesai mengurus masalah ini!? Luar biasa! Sekarang operasi penambangan kami di Mountain of Flaris dapat dilanjutkan!
dialogsComplete.it: You've taken care of the issue already!? Astonishing! Now our mining operations in the mountains of Flaris may resume!
dialogsComplete.jp: おお、もう問題が解決できたのですね！ありがとうございます これで、フラリスの山での採掘作業が再開できます。
dialogsComplete.kr: 예상보다 빨리 처리해 주셨군요!? 놀라운데요! 덕분에 플라리스 북부 산맥의 광산 작업이 다시 시작될 수 있겠어요!
dialogsComplete.nl: You've taken care of the issue already!? Astonishing! Now our mining operations in the mountains of Flaris may resume!
dialogsComplete.pl: You've taken care of the issue already!? Astonishing! Now our mining operations in the mountains of Flaris may resume!
dialogsComplete.ru: Ты так быстро разобрался с проблемой? Великолепно! Теперь мы можем возобновить работы в шахтах Фларинции!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿¡Ya te has ocupado del problema!? ¡Asombroso! ¡Ahora nuestras operaciones mineras en las montañas de Flaris se podrán reanudar!
dialogsComplete.sw: You've taken care of the issue already!? Astonishing! Now our mining operations in the mountains of Flaris may resume!
dialogsComplete.th: จัดการปัญหาแล้ว!? น่าทึ่ง! ตอนนี้การขุดของเราบนภูเขา Flaris อาจกลับมาทำงานอีกครั้ง!
dialogsComplete.tw: 你已經解決了這個問題！？真厲害誒！現在我們在布拉里斯山區的採礦作業可能會恢復！
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn đã quan tâm đến vấn đề rồi !? Kinh ngạc! Giờ đây, các hoạt động khai thác của chúng tôi ở vùng núi Flaris có thể sẽ tiếp tục!

dialogsFail.en: Bangs can be found in Northern Flaris near the Nyangnyangs. Removing at least 10 Bangs and 5 Captain Bangs should resolve any issues.
dialogsFail.ar: Bangs can be found in Northern Flaris near the Nyangnyangs. Removing at least 10 Bangs and 5 Captain Bangs should resolve any issues.
dialogsFail.br: Os Bangs podem ser encontrados no Norte de Flaris, perto das Nyangnyangs. Livre-se de pelo menos 10 Bangs e 5 Bangs Capitães, isso deve resolver os problemas.
dialogsFail.cns: 魔导战甲士兵可以在帕里北部，彩冠翎猫附近找到。杀死至少10个魔导战甲士兵和5个魔导战甲队长就可以解决我们的问题。
dialogsFail.de: Bangs sind in Nordflaris in der Nähe der Nyangnyangs zu finden. Das Entfernen von mindestens 10 Bangs und 5 Captain Bangs sollte alle Probleme lösen.
dialogsFail.fi: Bangs can be found in Northern Flaris near the Nyangnyangs. Removing at least 10 Bangs and 5 Captain Bangs should resolve any issues.
dialogsFail.fil: Bangs can be found in Northern Flaris near the Nyangnyangs. Removing at least 10 Bangs and 5 Captain Bangs should resolve any issues.
dialogsFail.fr: Vous trouverez les Bang loin au Nord. Tuez 10 Bang et 5 Capitaines Bang.
dialogsFail.id: Bang dapat ditemukan di dekat Nyangnyang pada Northern Flaris. Menghabisi paling tidak 10 Bang dan 5 Captain Bang akan menyelesaikan masalah ini.
dialogsFail.it: Bangs can be found in Northern Flaris near the Nyangnyangs. Removing at least 10 Bangs and 5 Captain Bangs should resolve any issues.
dialogsFail.jp: ヴァンはニャングニャングよりもさらに奥地に生息しています。バン10匹、キャプテンバン5匹を倒してください！
dialogsFail.kr: 뱅은 플라리스 북부의 냥냥 서식지 근처에서 찾을 수 있어요. 뱅 10마리와 두목 뱅 5마리만 없어져도 문제가 해결될 거예요.
dialogsFail.nl: Bangs can be found in Northern Flaris near the Nyangnyangs. Removing at least 10 Bangs and 5 Captain Bangs should resolve any issues.
dialogsFail.pl: Bangs can be found in Northern Flaris near the Nyangnyangs. Removing at least 10 Bangs and 5 Captain Bangs should resolve any issues.
dialogsFail.ru: Громов можно найти на севере острова, неподалёку от Кисандр. Как обычно, 10 обычных и 5 сильных будет достаточно для решения проблемы.
dialogsFail.sp: Los Bangs se pueden encontrar en el Norte de Flaris cerca de los Nyangnyangs. Eliminar a 10 Bangs y a 5 Bangs Capitanes debería resolver cualquier problema.
dialogsFail.sw: Bangs can be found in Northern Flaris near the Nyangnyangs. Removing at least 10 Bangs and 5 Captain Bangs should resolve any issues.
dialogsFail.th: Bang สามารถพบได้ใน Northern Flaris ใกล้กับ Nyangnyangs กำจัดอย่างน้อย 10 Bangs และ 5 Captain Bangs น่าจะช่วยแก้ไขปัญหา
dialogsFail.tw: 崩崩嘍囉可以在裝可愛喵娘附近的布拉里斯北側中被找到。消滅至少 10 個崩崩嘍囉和 5 個崩崩應該可以解決任何問題。
dialogsFail.vi: Bangs có thể được tìm thấy ở Northern Flaris gần Nyangnyangs. Loại bỏ ít nhất 10 Bangs và 5 Captain Bangs sẽ giải quyết được mọi vấn đề.

description.ar: Kill 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac and return to the Mayor of Saint City.
description.br: Mate 10 Wagsaacs Pequenos e 5 Wagsaacs e reporte ao Prefeito da Cidade de Saint.
description.cns: 杀死10个紫草食人花幼苗和5个紫草食人花后返回晨光市长处。
description.de: Töte 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac und kehre zurück zum Bürgermeister von Saint City.
description.fi: Kill 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac and return to the Mayor of Saint City.
description.fil: Kill 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac and return to the Mayor of Saint City.
description.fr: Tuez 10 Jeunes Wagsaac et 5 Wagsaac.
