description.vi: Giết 10 tiểu Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac và trở lại Thị trưởng thành phố Saint.

dialogsBegin.en: Leann and Reonan have informed me of your imminent arrival. Word of your deeds has also spread amongst our citizens. You must be quite an outstanding person for someone your age.
dialogsBegin.ar: Leann and Reonan have informed me of your imminent arrival. Word of your deeds has also spread amongst our citizens. You must be quite an outstanding person for someone your age.
dialogsBegin.br: Leann e Reonan me informaram de sua chegada iminente. A notícia de suas ações também se espalhou entre nossos cidadãos. Você deve ser uma pessoa extraordinária para alguém da sua idade.
dialogsBegin.cns: 露恩和瑞尔南已经告知我我你的到来。你的事迹早已被晨光镇的居民熟知了。你一定是同龄人中的佼佼者。
dialogsBegin.de: Leann und Reonan haben mich über Eure baldige Ankunft informiert. Ihre Taten haben sich auch unter unseren Bürgern herumgesprochen. Ihr müsst für Euer Alter eine herausragende Persönlichkeit sein.
dialogsBegin.fi: Leann and Reonan have informed me of your imminent arrival. Word of your deeds has also spread amongst our citizens. You must be quite an outstanding person for someone your age.
dialogsBegin.fil: Leann and Reonan have informed me of your imminent arrival. Word of your deeds has also spread amongst our citizens. You must be quite an outstanding person for someone your age.
dialogsBegin.fr: Reonan a toute confiance en vous. Je vais donc vous confier une mission.
dialogsBegin.id: Leann dan Reonan telah memberitahuku tentang kedatanganmu. Berita tentang perbuatanmu telah menyebar di antara warga kami. Pencapaianmu sangat luar biasa mengingat usiamu yang masih muda.
dialogsBegin.it: Leann and Reonan have informed me of your imminent arrival. Word of your deeds has also spread amongst our citizens. You must be quite an outstanding person for someone your age.
dialogsBegin.jp: レオナンより貴方の活躍は耳にしています。彼が褒めるくらいですからよほどの実力なのでしょう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 르앤과 레오난이 곧 오실 거라고 하기에 기다리고 있었습니다. 당신 활약상은 이미 사람들 사이에서도 소문이 자자해요. 이렇게 젊은 나이에 대단하시군요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Leann and Reonan have informed me of your imminent arrival. Word of your deeds has also spread amongst our citizens. You must be quite an outstanding person for someone your age.
dialogsBegin.pl: Leann and Reonan have informed me of your imminent arrival. Word of your deeds has also spread amongst our citizens. You must be quite an outstanding person for someone your age.
dialogsBegin.ru: Лианна и Максимус заранее предупредили меня о твоём приезде. А по городу уже ходят слухи о твоих поступках. Ты явно выдающийся герой для своего уровня.
dialogsBegin.sp: Leann y Reonan me han informado de tu llegada inminente. Tus hazañas también se han extendido entre nuestros ciudadanos. Debes ser una persona bastante destacada para la edad que tienes.
dialogsBegin.sw: Leann and Reonan have informed me of your imminent arrival. Word of your deeds has also spread amongst our citizens. You must be quite an outstanding person for someone your age.
dialogsBegin.th: Leann และ Reonan ได้แจ้งให้ฉันทราบถึงการมาถึงของคุณที่ใกล้จะถึง คำพูดของการกระทำของคุณก็แพร่กระจายในหมู่พลเมืองของเราเช่นกัน คุณต้องค่อนข้างโดดเด่นสำหรับคนที่อายุเท่าคุณ
dialogsBegin.tw: 萊恩和雷奧南已經通知我你即將到來。你的事蹟也在我們的公民中傳播開來，對你這個年紀的人來說，你一定是一個非常優秀的人。
dialogsBegin.vi: Leann và Reonan đã thông báo cho tôi về việc bạn sắp đến. Lời nói về những việc làm của bạn cũng đã lan truyền trong công dân của chúng tôi. Bạn phải là một người khá nổi bật đối với một người ở độ tuổi của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Oh? You want to know about Reonan? He's even sort of a mystery to me. Some say he can slay a Meteonyker with his bare hands. Tall tales aside, I have a request for you…
dialogsBegin.ar: Oh? You want to know about Reonan? He's even sort of a mystery to me. Some say he can slay a Meteonyker with his bare hands. Tall tales aside, I have a request for you…
dialogsBegin.br: Oh? Você quer saber sobre Reonan? Ele é uma espécie de mistério até para mim. Alguns dizem que ele pode matar um Meteonyker com as próprias mãos. Deixando de lado os contos, eu tenho um pedido para você...
dialogsBegin.cns: 噢？你想了解一下瑞尔南吗？他对于我来说也是非常神秘的一个人。有的人说他可以赤手空拳杀死一条飞龙。就先不说废话了，我需要你的帮助...
dialogsBegin.de: Ach? Sie wollen etwas über Reonan wissen? Er ist auch für mich ein Rätsel. Manche sagen, er kann einen Meteonyker mit bloßen Händen erschlagen. Abgesehen von den Märchen, habe ich eine Bitte an dich...
dialogsBegin.fi: Oh? You want to know about Reonan? He's even sort of a mystery to me. Some say he can slay a Meteonyker with his bare hands. Tall tales aside, I have a request for you…
dialogsBegin.fil: Oh? You want to know about Reonan? He's even sort of a mystery to me. Some say he can slay a Meteonyker with his bare hands. Tall tales aside, I have a request for you…
dialogsBegin.fr: Reonan ? Tout le monde le sait, c'est la réincarnation d'un Héros chevalier. Mais nous sommes ici pour parler de vous.
dialogsBegin.id: Oh? Kamu ingin tahu soal Reonan? Aku sendiri tidak tahu banyak soal dia. Bahkan ada rumor mengatakan kalau dia dapat menghabisi meteonyker hanya dengan tangan kosong. Omong-omong, cukup soal itu, aku ada sesuatu yang harus kukatakan padamu...
dialogsBegin.it: Oh? You want to know about Reonan? He's even sort of a mystery to me. Some say he can slay a Meteonyker with his bare hands. Tall tales aside, I have a request for you…
dialogsBegin.jp: え。彼の正体ですか？　私も詳しくは知りませんが、マドリガル各地の問題を解決してまわった英雄だとは聞いています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 오, 레오난에 대해 알고 싶다고요? 사실, 미스터리한 인물이라 저도 잘 모릅니다. 맨손으로 메테오니커를 쓰러뜨릴 수 있다는 말도 있지만... 아무튼, 부탁할 일이 있습니다...
dialogsBegin.nl: Oh? You want to know about Reonan? He's even sort of a mystery to me. Some say he can slay a Meteonyker with his bare hands. Tall tales aside, I have a request for you…
dialogsBegin.pl: Oh? You want to know about Reonan? He's even sort of a mystery to me. Some say he can slay a Meteonyker with his bare hands. Tall tales aside, I have a request for you…
dialogsBegin.ru: Ты хочешь узнать о Максимусе? Извини, его личность даже для меня является загадкой. Говорят, что он может голыми руками победить метеоракона. Но это лишь слухи... Так вот, к делу. У меня есть просьба.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Oh? ¿Quieres que te hable de Reonan? Es un misterio incluso para mí. Algunos dicen que puede matar a un Meteonyker con sus propias manos. Cuentos aparte, tengo una petición para ti...
dialogsBegin.sw: Oh? You want to know about Reonan? He's even sort of a mystery to me. Some say he can slay a Meteonyker with his bare hands. Tall tales aside, I have a request for you…
dialogsBegin.th: โอ้? คุณต้องการที่จะรู้เกี่ยวกับ Reonan? เขาเป็นคนลึกลับสำหรับฉัน บางคนบอกว่าเขาสามารถสังหาร Meteonyker ด้วยมือเปล่าได้ นอกเหนือนิทานฉันมีคำขอสำหรับคุณ ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 哦？你想知道雷奧南嗎？他對我來說甚至是個謎。有人說他可以徒手殺死地炎飛龍。拋開傳奇故事，我有一個請求
dialogsBegin.vi: Ồ? Bạn muốn biết về Reonan? Anh ấy thậm chí còn là một bí ẩn đối với tôi. Một số người nói rằng anh ta có thể giết Meteonyker bằng tay không. Những câu chuyện cao siêu sang một bên, tôi có một yêu cầu cho bạn…

dialogsBegin.en: An army of ravenous plants are emerging and threatening the safety of our citizens. They seem to be the result of some mysterious dark magic.
dialogsBegin.ar: An army of ravenous plants are emerging and threatening the safety of our citizens. They seem to be the result of some mysterious dark magic.
dialogsBegin.br: Um exército de plantas vorazes está surgindo e ameaçando a segurança de nossos cidadãos. Eles parecem ser o resultado de alguma magia negra misteriosa.
dialogsBegin.cns: 一大群邪恶贪婪的植物正在不断出现并且威胁到了我们居民们的安全。它们似乎是受到某种神秘的黑暗魔法所腐化了。
dialogsBegin.de: Eine Armee von gefräßigen Pflanzen taucht auf und bedroht die Sicherheit unserer Bürger. Sie scheinen das Ergebnis einer geheimnisvollen dunklen Magie zu sein.
dialogsBegin.fi: An army of ravenous plants are emerging and threatening the safety of our citizens. They seem to be the result of some mysterious dark magic.
dialogsBegin.fil: An army of ravenous plants are emerging and threatening the safety of our citizens. They seem to be the result of some mysterious dark magic.
dialogsBegin.fr: Nous avons un problème de mauvaises herbes. Ne riez pas ! Ces plantes attaquent vraiment la ville !!
dialogsBegin.id: Sekelompok monster tanaman muncul dan mengancam keselamatan warga kami. Mereka sepertinya tercipta dari eksperimen Dark Magic yang misterius.
dialogsBegin.it: An army of ravenous plants are emerging and threatening the safety of our citizens. They seem to be the result of some mysterious dark magic.
dialogsBegin.jp: そうそう、私からのお願いですが、最近植物による被害が増えているようです。どうやら周辺の植物がモンスター化してしまったようです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 탐욕스러운 식물 무리가 시민의 안전을 위협하고 있는데, 아무래도 정체불명의 어둠의 마법 때문인 것 같더군요.
dialogsBegin.nl: An army of ravenous plants are emerging and threatening the safety of our citizens. They seem to be the result of some mysterious dark magic.
dialogsBegin.pl: An army of ravenous plants are emerging and threatening the safety of our citizens. They seem to be the result of some mysterious dark magic.
dialogsBegin.ru: У нас тут нашествие кровожадных растений, что явно не добавляет спокойствия горожанам. Похоже, здесь замешана какая-то темная магия.
dialogsBegin.sp: Un ejército de plantas hambrientas está amenazando la seguridad de nuestros ciudadanos. Parecen ser el resultado de alguna misteriosa magia oscura.
dialogsBegin.sw: An army of ravenous plants are emerging and threatening the safety of our citizens. They seem to be the result of some mysterious dark magic.
dialogsBegin.th: กองทัพของพืชที่หิวโหยกำลังเกิดขึ้นและคุกคามความปลอดภัยของพลเมืองของเรา ดูเหมือนว่าพวกเขาจะเป็นผลมาจากมนต์ดำลึกลับบางอย่าง
dialogsBegin.tw: 一群貪婪的植物正在出現，威脅著我們人們的安全，它們似乎是某種神秘的黑暗魔法的結果。
dialogsBegin.vi: Một đội quân thực vật hung hãn đang xuất hiện và đe dọa sự an toàn của công dân của chúng tôi. Chúng dường như là kết quả của một phép thuật đen tối bí ẩn nào đó.

dialogsAccept.en: Known as Wagsaac, these plants eat everything standing in their way. Please head south of Saint City and defeat 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac.
dialogsAccept.ar: Known as Wagsaac, these plants eat everything standing in their way. Please head south of Saint City and defeat 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac.
dialogsAccept.br: Conhecidos como Wagsaac, essas plantas comem tudo que está em seu caminho. Vá para a direção sul da Cidade de Saint e derrote 10 Wagsaacs Pequenos e 5 Wagsaacs.
dialogsAccept.cns: 这些植物被称为紫草食人花，它们会吃掉途径的所有的东西。请前往晨光南部，并杀死10个紫草食人花幼苗和5个紫草食人花。
dialogsAccept.de: Diese als Wagsaac bekannten Pflanzen fressen alles, was sich ihnen in den Weg stellt. Bitte gehen Sie südlich von Saint City und besiegen Sie 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac.
dialogsAccept.fi: Known as Wagsaac, these plants eat everything standing in their way. Please head south of Saint City and defeat 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac.
dialogsAccept.fil: Known as Wagsaac, these plants eat everything standing in their way. Please head south of Saint City and defeat 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac.
dialogsAccept.fr: On les appelle des Wagsaac. Ils dévorent tout y compris les pierres des maisons. Allez donc tuer 10 jeunes Wagsaac et 5 Wagsaac pour nous donner un répit.
dialogsAccept.id: Namanya Wagsaac, monster tanaman akan memakan apapun yang ada didekat mereka. Tolong pergilah kebagian selatan dari Saint City dan kalahkan 10 Small Wagsaac serta 5 Wagsaac.
dialogsAccept.it: Known as Wagsaac, these plants eat everything standing in their way. Please head south of Saint City and defeat 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac.
dialogsAccept.jp: 私達はあいつらをワッグサックと呼んでいます。石も噛み砕くほどの力があるよう手に負えないのです。どうか何匹かで構いませんので退治してくれませんか。
dialogsAccept.kr: 와그작이라고 불리는 이 식물들은, 앞에 놓인 건 뭐든 닥치는 대로 먹어 치우죠. 부탁이니, 세인트 시티 남쪽으로 가서 작은 와그작 10마리와 와그작 5마리를 처치해 주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Known as Wagsaac, these plants eat everything standing in their way. Please head south of Saint City and defeat 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac.
dialogsAccept.pl: Known as Wagsaac, these plants eat everything standing in their way. Please head south of Saint City and defeat 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac.
dialogsAccept.ru: Мы называем их злопухами. Они очень злые и пытаются съесть всё, что им подвернётся. Пожалуйста, разберись с 10 слабыми и 5 обычными.
dialogsAccept.sp: Conocidas como Wagsaac, estas plantas comen todo lo que se interpone en su camino. Dirígete al Sur de Saint y derrota a 10 Wagsaacs Pequeños y a 5 Wagsaacs.
dialogsAccept.sw: Known as Wagsaac, these plants eat everything standing in their way. Please head south of Saint City and defeat 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac.
dialogsAccept.th: พืชเหล่านี้รู้จักกันในชื่อ Wagsaac กินทุกอย่างที่ขวางทาง โปรดมุ่งหน้าไปทางใต้ของ Saint City และกำจัด Small Wagsaac 10 ตัว & 5 Wagsaac
dialogsAccept.tw: 這些被稱為拳頭花的植物會吃掉所有擋路的東西。請前往聖音特以南並擊敗 10 個小拳頭花和 5 個拳頭花。
dialogsAccept.vi: Được biết đến với cái tên Wagsaac, những loài thực vật này ăn mọi thứ cản đường chúng. Hãy đi về phía nam của thành phố Saint và đánh bại 10 Wagsaac Nhỏ & 5 Wagsaac.

dialogsDecline.en: Hmm, it appears that the stories of your selfless heroism were a little exaggerated.
dialogsDecline.ar: Hmm, it appears that the stories of your selfless heroism were a little exaggerated.
dialogsDecline.br: Hmm, parece que as histórias de seu heroísmo altruísta foram um pouco exageradas.
dialogsDecline.cns: 嗯...看来你无私的英雄事迹被他们夸大了。
dialogsDecline.de: Hmm, es scheint, dass die Geschichten über Ihr selbstloses Heldentum etwas übertrieben waren.
dialogsDecline.fi: Hmm, it appears that the stories of your selfless heroism were a little exaggerated.
dialogsDecline.fil: Hmm, it appears that the stories of your selfless heroism were a little exaggerated.
dialogsDecline.fr: Reonan ne vous a pas bien jugé…
dialogsDecline.id: Hmm, sepertinya cerita keheroikanmu yang tanpa pamrih itu sedikit dilebih-lebihkan.
dialogsDecline.it: Hmm, it appears that the stories of your selfless heroism were a little exaggerated.
dialogsDecline.jp: うーん、あなたのヒロイズムの話はちょっと大げさだと思います。
dialogsDecline.kr: 흐음, 그 멋진 영웅담은 역시 좀 과장된 거였나 보군요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Hmm, it appears that the stories of your selfless heroism were a little exaggerated.
dialogsDecline.pl: Hmm, it appears that the stories of your selfless heroism were a little exaggerated.
dialogsDecline.ru: Hmm, it appears that the stories of your selfless heroism were a little exaggerated.
dialogsDecline.sp: Hmm, parece que las historias de tu heroísmo desinteresado fueron un poco exageradas.
dialogsDecline.sw: Hmm, it appears that the stories of your selfless heroism were a little exaggerated.
dialogsDecline.th: อืม ดูเหมือนว่าเรื่องราวของความกล้าหาญที่ไม่เห็นแก่ตัวของคุณนั้นเกินจริงไปเล็กน้อย
dialogsDecline.tw: 嗯，看來你的無私英雄事蹟有些誇張了。
dialogsDecline.vi: Hmm, có vẻ như những câu chuyện về chủ nghĩa anh hùng quên mình của bạn đã hơi phóng đại.

dialogsComplete.en: It appears that the tales of your deeds are true! With the Wagsaac threat contained, our guards can once again focus on the defense of Saint City!
dialogsComplete.ar: It appears that the tales of your deeds are true! With the Wagsaac threat contained, our guards can once again focus on the defense of Saint City!
dialogsComplete.br: Parece que as histórias de seus atos são verdadeiras! Com a ameaça dos Wagsaacs contida, nossos guardas podem mais uma vez se concentrar na defesa da cidade!
dialogsComplete.cns: 看来关于你英雄事迹的传说是真的！当紫草食人花的威胁被解决后，我们的防卫力量就可以重新专注于晨光的防守了。
dialogsComplete.de: Es scheint, dass die Erzählungen über eure Taten wahr sind! Nachdem die Bedrohung durch die Wagsaac eingedämmt ist, können sich unsere Wachen wieder auf die Verteidigung der Heiligen Stadt konzentrieren!
dialogsComplete.fi: It appears that the tales of your deeds are true! With the Wagsaac threat contained, our guards can once again focus on the defense of Saint City!
dialogsComplete.fil: It appears that the tales of your deeds are true! With the Wagsaac threat contained, our guards can once again focus on the defense of Saint City!
dialogsComplete.fr: Pendant que vous étiez parti, nous avons reçu une livraison de désherbant. Nous sommes en sécurité de ce point de vue maintenant.
dialogsComplete.id: Tampaknya kisah heroik yang kamu lakukan memang benar! Dengan ancaman Wagsaac berhasil ditanggulangi, penjaga kami dapat sekali lagi fokus pada pertahanan Saint City!
dialogsComplete.it: It appears that the tales of your deeds are true! With the Wagsaac threat contained, our guards can once again focus on the defense of Saint City!
dialogsComplete.jp: あなたの物語は真実ですね！ ワッグサックの脅威が封じ込められたので、私たちの警備員は再びセイントシティーに集中することができます！
dialogsComplete.kr: 그 활약상 이야기가 사실이었군요! 와그작을 막아주신 덕분에, 경비대가 다시 세인트 시티를 지킬 수 있게 되었습니다!
dialogsComplete.nl: It appears that the tales of your deeds are true! With the Wagsaac threat contained, our guards can once again focus on the defense of Saint City!
dialogsComplete.pl: It appears that the tales of your deeds are true! With the Wagsaac threat contained, our guards can once again focus on the defense of Saint City!
dialogsComplete.ru: Похоже, слухи о твоих подвигах оказались правдивыми! Спасибо, после устранения злопухов наши гвардейцы могут сосредоточиться на охране Санто.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Parece que las historias de tus hazañas son ciertas! Con la amenaza de esos Wagsaacs contenida, ¡nuestros guardias pueden concentrarse de nuevo en defender Saint!
dialogsComplete.sw: It appears that the tales of your deeds are true! With the Wagsaac threat contained, our guards can once again focus on the defense of Saint City!
dialogsComplete.th: ดูเหมือนว่านิทานการกระทำของคุณจะเป็นเรื่องจริง! ด้วยภัยคุกคาม Wagsaac ผู้พิทักษ์ของเราสามารถมุ่งเน้นไปที่การป้องกันของ Saint City ได้อีกครั้ง!
dialogsComplete.tw: 看來你的事蹟是真的！拳頭花威脅被遏制，我們的守衛可以再次專注於聖音特的防禦！
dialogsComplete.vi: Có vẻ như những câu chuyện về những việc làm của bạn là có thật! Với mối đe dọa Wagsaac được ngăn chặn, các vệ sĩ của chúng ta một lần nữa có thể tập trung vào việc bảo vệ Thành phố Saint!

dialogsFail.en: Please defeat 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac South of the Town. Our guards are already at working trying to eliminate this menace and could use assistance!
dialogsFail.ar: Please defeat 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac South of the Town. Our guards are already at working trying to eliminate this menace and could use assistance!
dialogsFail.br: Por favor, elimine 10 Wagsaacs Pequenos e 5 Wagsaacs ao Sul da Cidade. Nossos guardas já estão trabalhando para eliminar essa ameaça e precisam de ajuda!
dialogsFail.cns: 请杀死位于城镇南部的10个紫草食人花幼苗和5个紫草食人花。我们的警卫正在那努力消灭这些威胁，他们需要你的援助！
dialogsFail.de: Bitte besiegt 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac südlich der Stadt. Unsere Wachen arbeiten bereits an der Beseitigung dieser Bedrohung und könnten Unterstützung gebrauchen!
dialogsFail.fi: Please defeat 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac South of the Town. Our guards are already at working trying to eliminate this menace and could use assistance!
dialogsFail.fil: Please defeat 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac South of the Town. Our guards are already at working trying to eliminate this menace and could use assistance!
dialogsFail.fr: Vous trouverez les Wagsaac en sortant de la ville.
dialogsFail.id: Mohon kalahkan 10 Small Wagsaac dan 5 Wagsaac yang berada di South of the Town. Para penjaga kota telah berada disana mencoba melawan mereka, segeralah bantu!
dialogsFail.it: Please defeat 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac South of the Town. Our guards are already at working trying to eliminate this menace and could use assistance!
dialogsFail.jp: 町の南にある小さなワグザック10個とワグザックを5個倒してください。私達の警備員もすでに戦ってます。
dialogsFail.kr: 마을 남쪽에서 작은 와그작 10마리, 와그작 5마리를 처치해 주시면 됩니다. 우리 경비대도 열심히 녀석들을 토벌하고 있지만, 지원이 절실한 상황이라서요!
dialogsFail.nl: Please defeat 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac South of the Town. Our guards are already at working trying to eliminate this menace and could use assistance!
dialogsFail.pl: Please defeat 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac South of the Town. Our guards are already at working trying to eliminate this menace and could use assistance!
dialogsFail.ru: Please defeat 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac South of the Town. Our guards are already at working trying to eliminate this menace and could use assistance!
dialogsFail.sp: Derrota a 10 Wagsaacs Pequeños y a 5 Wagsaacs al sur de la ciudad. ¡Nuestros guardias ya están trabajando para eliminar esta amenaza y necesitan ayuda!
dialogsFail.sw: Please defeat 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac South of the Town. Our guards are already at working trying to eliminate this menace and could use assistance!
dialogsFail.th: ได้โปรดกำจัด Small Wagsaac 10 อัน & 5 Wagsaac South of the Town 5 อัน ยามของเรากำลังทำงานเพื่อขจัดภัยคุกคามนี้และสามารถใช้ความช่วยเหลือได้!
dialogsFail.tw: 我請打敗 10 個小拳頭花和 5 個城鎮南側的拳頭花。我們的警衛已經在努力消除這種威脅，可以尋求幫助！
dialogsFail.vi: Hãy đánh bại 10 Wagsaac Nhỏ & 5 Wagsaac Nam của Thị trấn. Các vệ sĩ của chúng tôi đã làm việc để cố gắng loại bỏ mối đe dọa này và có thể sử dụng sự hỗ trợ!

name.jp: 隠された秘密を追って
name.th: พล็อตเริ่มต้น

description.en: Deliver this to Gothante, he is the Chairman of the History Society in Saint City.
description.ar: Deliver this to Gothante, he is the Chairman of the History Society in Saint City.
description.br: Entregue isso a Gothante. Ele é o presidente da Sociedade Histórica da Cidade de Saint.
description.cns: 到晨光的历史协会，找一个叫做扎森特的人之后，把这个交给他。
description.de: Okay. Bringe dies jetzt bitte zu Gothante. Er ist der Vorsitzende der Geschichtsgesellschaft in Saint Morning. Vergiss nicht dich vor den Attentätern in acht zu nehmen.
description.fi: Deliver this to Gothante, he is the Chairman of the History Society in Saint City.
description.fil: Deliver this to Gothante, he is the Chairman of the History Society in Saint City.
description.fr: Remettre la Preuve de la division continentale à Gothante, le Président de la Société d'Histoire, au nord de Saincity.
description.id: Serahkan ini ke Gothante, Dia adalah Chairman dari History Society di Saint City.
description.it: Deliver this to Gothante, he is the Chairman of the History Society in Saint City.
description.jp: マルティニークのレポートをセイントモーニングにいるマドリガル国立歴史協会の＜ゴダンテ＞会長に渡しにいこう。
description.kr: 이걸 세인트 시티 역사학회 회장, 고단테에게 전해주세요.
description.nl: Deliver this to Gothante, he is the Chairman of the History Society in Saint City.
description.pl: Deliver this to Gothante, he is the Chairman of the History Society in Saint City.
description.ru: Нужно отнести доказательства раскола материка Шлесигеру, председателю исторического общества Санто Моргена.
description.sp: Entrégale esto a Gothante, él es el Presidente de la Sociedad de Historia en Saint.
description.sw: Deliver this to Gothante, he is the Chairman of the History Society in Saint City.
description.th: ส่งสิ่งนี้ให้ Gothante เขาเป็นประธานสมาคมประวัติศาสตร์ใน Saint City
description.tw: 到聖音特的歷史協會，找一個叫做高譚提拉的人之後，把這個交給他。
description.vi: Giao cái này cho Gothante, anh ta là Chủ tịch Hiệp hội Lịch sử ở Thành phố Saint.

dialogsBegin.en: This is evidence that the continents were once one land mass. I am trusting you with this information because, well...
dialogsBegin.ar: This is evidence that the continents were once one land mass. I am trusting you with this information because, well...
dialogsBegin.br: Há evidências de que os continentes eram uma única massa de terra. Estou lhe dando essa informação porque... bem,
dialogsBegin.cns: This is evidence that the continents were once one land mass. I am trusting you with this information because, well...
dialogsBegin.de: Dies ist ein Beweis dafür, dass die Kontinente einst eine einzige Landmasse waren. Ich vertraue dir diese Informationen an, weil, nun ja...
dialogsBegin.fi: This is evidence that the continents were once one land mass. I am trusting you with this information because, well...
dialogsBegin.fil: This is evidence that the continents were once one land mass. I am trusting you with this information because, well...
dialogsBegin.fr: Avant de te dire la vérité... Heu... On est dans le même bateau maintenant et tu es donc aussi en danger ! Veux-tu vraiment aller jusqu'au bout avec moi ?
dialogsBegin.id: Ini adalah bukti bahwa benua pernah menjadi satu daratan. Aku mempercayaimu dengan informasi ini karena...
dialogsBegin.it: This is evidence that the continents were once one land mass. I am trusting you with this information because, well...
dialogsBegin.jp: これは集めてきてくれた資料から分かったことをまとめて作成したレポートです。このレポートには、マドリガル大陸の分裂に関する証拠が書かれていますが、これはまだ誰にも知られてはいけない、トップシークレットなのです。これをあなたに見せた理由は…
dialogsBegin.kr: 이건... 각 대륙이 한때 하나의 땅이었다는 증거예요. 제가 당신을 믿고 이 정보를 주는 이유는 말이죠, 음...
dialogsBegin.nl: This is evidence that the continents were once one land mass. I am trusting you with this information because, well...
dialogsBegin.pl: This is evidence that the continents were once one land mass. I am trusting you with this information because, well...
dialogsBegin.ru: This is evidence that the continents were once one land mass. I am trusting you with this information because, well...
dialogsBegin.sp: Esto es evidencia de que los continentes fueron una sola masa de tierra. Te estoy confiando esta información porque, bueno...
dialogsBegin.sw: This is evidence that the continents were once one land mass. I am trusting you with this information because, well...
dialogsBegin.th: นี่เป็นหลักฐานว่าทวีปต่างๆ เคยเป็นมวลแผ่นดินเดียว ฉันไว้วางใจคุณกับข้อมูลนี้เพราะ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 這些證據證明了各個大陸以前原本是連成一片的。我願意把這件事告訴你，是因為……
dialogsBegin.vi: Đây là bằng chứng cho thấy các lục địa đã từng là một khối đất liền. Tôi tin tưởng giao cho bạn thông tin này bởi vì, à thì...

dialogsBegin.en: ...we are in the same boat now. We are in danger together. Would you go through with me to the end?
dialogsBegin.ar: ...we are in the same boat now. We are in danger together. Would you go through with me to the end?
dialogsBegin.br: agora estamos no mesmo barco. Estamos em perigo. Você iria comigo até o final?
dialogsBegin.cns: ...we are in the same boat now. We are in danger together. Would you go through with me to the end?
dialogsBegin.de: ...wir sitzen jetzt im selben Boot. Wir sind gemeinsam in Gefahr. Würdest du mit mir bis zum Ende durchhalten?
dialogsBegin.fi: ...we are in the same boat now. We are in danger together. Would you go through with me to the end?
dialogsBegin.fil: ...we are in the same boat now. We are in danger together. Would you go through with me to the end?
dialogsBegin.fr: Avant de te dire la vérité... Heu... On est dans le même bateau maintenant et tu es donc aussi en danger ! Veux-tu vraiment aller jusqu'au bout avec moi ?
dialogsBegin.id: ..kita berada di situasi yang sama sekarang. Kita sama-sama dalam bahaya. Maukah kamu melewati ini bersamaku sampai akhir?
dialogsBegin.it: ...we are in the same boat now. We are in danger together. Would you go through with me to the end?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたはもう、私と同じ船に乗ったわけですから。ふふふ！最後まで私と一緒に、歴史の謎を解いてくれますよね？
dialogsBegin.kr: ...우린 이제 같은 배를 탔어요. 함께 위험에 처했고요. 저와 함께 끝까지 가주실래요?
dialogsBegin.nl: ...we are in the same boat now. We are in danger together. Would you go through with me to the end?
dialogsBegin.pl: ...we are in the same boat now. We are in danger together. Would you go through with me to the end?
dialogsBegin.ru: ...we are in the same boat now. We are in danger together. Would you go through with me to the end?
dialogsBegin.sp: ...ahora estamos en el mismo barco. Estamos en peligro juntos. ¿Irás conmigo hasta el final?
dialogsBegin.sw: ...we are in the same boat now. We are in danger together. Would you go through with me to the end?
dialogsBegin.th: ตอนนี้เราอยู่ในเรือลำเดียวกัน เราอยู่ในอันตรายด้วยกัน คุณจะไปกับฉันจนจบมั้ย?
dialogsBegin.tw: ……我們現在已經是同一條船上的人了。我們正一起身陷危險。你願意陪我走到最後嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: ..chúng ta đang ở trên cùng một con thuyền. Chúng ta đều gặp nguy hiểm. Bạn sẽ đồng hành với tôi đến giây phút cuối cùng?

dialogsAccept.en: Okay. Now please deliver this to Gothante. He is the chairman of the History Society in Saint City. Do not forget to be aware of the assasins.
dialogsAccept.ar: Okay. Now please deliver this to Gothante. He is the chairman of the History Society in Saint City. Do not forget to be aware of the assasins.
dialogsAccept.br: OK. Entregue isso a Gothante. Ele é o presidente da Sociedade Histórica em Saint. Tome cuidado com os assassinos.
dialogsAccept.cns: 好，现在到晨光的历史协会，找一个叫做扎森特的人之后，把这个交给他。在路上可能会遇到想要暗杀你的人，所以要多注意喔!!
dialogsAccept.de: Bringe dies jetzt bitte zu Gothante. Er ist der Vorsitzende des Historiker Verbandes in Saint Morning.
dialogsAccept.fi: Okay. Now please deliver this to Gothante. He is the chairman of the History Society in Saint City. Do not forget to be aware of the assasins.
dialogsAccept.fil: Okay. Now please deliver this to Gothante. He is the chairman of the History Society in Saint City. Do not forget to be aware of the assasins.
dialogsAccept.fr: J'apprécie ton courage ! Maintenant j'aimerais que tu remettes cette preuve à Gothante, le président de la Société d'Histoire de Saincity. Reste sur tes gardes cependant...
dialogsAccept.id: Oke. Sekarang tolong kirimkan ini ke Gothante. Dia adalah Chairman dari History Society di Saint City. Jangan lupa untuk mewaspadai para assassin.
dialogsAccept.it: Okay. Now please deliver this to Gothante. He is the chairman of the History Society in Saint City. Do not forget to be aware of the assasins.
dialogsAccept.jp: そうこなくっちゃ！あなたは本当に素敵な人だわ！では、このレポートをセイントモーニングにいるマドリガル歴史協会のゴダンテ会長に渡してください。お願いします。道々、どうか気をつけて。
dialogsAccept.kr: 좋아요. 그럼 이걸 세인트 시티 역사학회 회장, 고단테에게 전해주세요. 부디 암살자들을 조심하시길.
dialogsAccept.nl: Okay. Now please deliver this to Gothante. He is the chairman of the History Society in Saint City. Do not forget to be aware of the assasins.
dialogsAccept.pl: Okay. Now please deliver this to Gothante. He is the chairman of the History Society in Saint City. Do not forget to be aware of the assasins.
dialogsAccept.ru: Отлично. Отнести наши доказательства Шлесигеру, председателю исторического общества Санто Моргена. И берегись Черных Фехтовальщиков!
dialogsAccept.sp: Vale. Ahora, por favor, llévale esto a Gothante. Es el presidente de la Sociedad de Historia en Saint. No olvides estar atento a los asesinos.
dialogsAccept.sw: Okay. Now please deliver this to Gothante. He is the chairman of the History Society in Saint City. Do not forget to be aware of the assasins.
dialogsAccept.th: ตกลง กรุณาส่งสิ่งนี้ให้ Gothante ด้วย เขาเป็นประธานสมาคมประวัติศาสตร์ใน Saint City อย่าลืมที่จะตระหนักถึงการลอบสังหาร
dialogsAccept.tw: 好，現在到聖音特的歷史協會，找一個叫做高潭提拉的人之後，把這個交給他。在路上可能會遇到想要暗殺你的人，所以要多注意喔！！
dialogsAccept.vi: Được chứ. Bây giờ hãy giao cái này cho Gothante. Ông là chủ tịch của Hiệp hội Lịch sử ở Thành phố Saint. Đừng quên nhận thức được các assasins.

dialogsDecline.en: I do not want to force you, but never forget that you are in danger.
dialogsDecline.ar: I do not want to force you, but never forget that you are in danger.
dialogsDecline.br: Não quero forçá-lo, mas nunca se esqueça de que está em perigo.
dialogsDecline.cns: 你真的不想帮我的话，那也没办法了..但是，你要记住，你已经有危险了。
dialogsDecline.de: Ich möchte dich nicht dazu zwingen, aber vergiss nie das du in Gefahr bist.
dialogsDecline.fi: I do not want to force you, but never forget that you are in danger.
dialogsDecline.fil: I do not want to force you, but never forget that you are in danger.
dialogsDecline.fr: Je ne veux pas te forcer, je comprends que tu aies peur du danger…
dialogsDecline.id: Aku tidak ingin memaksamu, jangan pernah lupa kalau kamu dalam bahaya.
dialogsDecline.it: I do not want to force you, but never forget that you are in danger.
dialogsDecline.jp: あなたが嫌なら、強要はしません。でも、あなたはすでに私と同じ船に乗ってしまった…。あなたも危険な目に遭うかもしれないということを忘れないでくださいね。
dialogsDecline.kr: 억지로 하라고 하진 않겠지만, 당신이 지금 위험에 놓여 있다는 사실은 잊지 마세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: I do not want to force you, but never forget that you are in danger.
dialogsDecline.pl: I do not want to force you, but never forget that you are in danger.
dialogsDecline.ru: Не хочу на тебя давить, но вообще-то ты уже в смертельной опасности. Хуже некуда.
dialogsDecline.sp: No quiero obligarte, pero no olvides que estás en peligro.
dialogsDecline.sw: I do not want to force you, but never forget that you are in danger.
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันไม่ต้องการที่จะบังคับคุณ แต่อย่าลืมว่าคุณตกอยู่ในอันตราย
dialogsDecline.tw: 你真的不想幫我的話，那也沒辦法了…但是，你要記住，你已經有危險了。
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi không muốn ép buộc bạn, nhưng đừng bao giờ quên rằng bạn đang gặp nguy hiểm.

dialogsComplete.en: This... This is... Bubble protect us. Martinyc has finally crossed the line. It is about time.
dialogsComplete.ar: This... This is... Bubble protect us. Martinyc has finally crossed the line. It is about time.
dialogsComplete.br: Isto... Isto é... Que Bubble nos proteja. Martinyc finalmente cruzou a linha. É hora.
dialogsComplete.cns: This... This is... Bubble protect us. Martinyc has finally crossed the line. It is about time.
dialogsComplete.de: Das.. Das ist.. Oh je. Martinyc hat es letzten Endes doch getan. Oh..
dialogsComplete.fi: This... This is... Bubble protect us. Martinyc has finally crossed the line. It is about time.
dialogsComplete.fil: This... This is... Bubble protect us. Martinyc has finally crossed the line. It is about time.
dialogsComplete.fr: (vraiment surpris) C'est... La... Par Rhisis ! Martinyc est donc parvenue à prouver sa théorie ! C'est... incroyable ! (fermant les yeux et réfléchissant)
dialogsComplete.id: Ini... Ini... Bubble lindungi kami. Martinyc akhirnya melewati batas. Ini sudah waktunya.
dialogsComplete.it: This... This is... Bubble protect us. Martinyc has finally crossed the line. It is about time.
dialogsComplete.jp: こ、これは…！なんと、マルティニークはついに、手がかりをつきとめたのか…ふむ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이건... 이건... 버블님이 우릴 지켜주시겠죠. 마르티닉이 마침내 선을 넘었네요. 때가 됐어요.
dialogsComplete.nl: This... This is... Bubble protect us. Martinyc has finally crossed the line. It is about time.
dialogsComplete.pl: This... This is... Bubble protect us. Martinyc has finally crossed the line. It is about time.
dialogsComplete.ru: This... This is... Bubble protect us. Martinyc has finally crossed the line. It is about time.
dialogsComplete.sp: Esto... Esto es... Bubble protégenos. Martinyc ha cruzado la línea al fin. Ya era hora.
dialogsComplete.sw: This... This is... Bubble protect us. Martinyc has finally crossed the line. It is about time.
dialogsComplete.th: นี่.. นี่มัน.. ขอบับเบิ้ลโปรดปกป้องเรา Martinyc มันล้ำเส้นไปแล้ว ที่เหลือก็ขึ้นกับเวลา
dialogsComplete.tw: 這……這是……願巴布樂保佑我們。馬特尼提特終於越界了。也是時候了。
dialogsComplete.vi: Đây .. Đây là .. Bubble bảo vệ chúng ta. Martinyc cuối cùng đã vượt quá ranh giới. Đã đến lúc rồi.

dialogsComplete.en: Thank you very much. Take this letter of recommendation and visit Hachal in Darkon 1.
dialogsComplete.ar: Thank you very much. Take this letter of recommendation and visit Hachal in Darkon 1.
dialogsComplete.br: Muito obrigado. Pegue esta carta de recomendação e visite Hachal em Darkon 1.
dialogsComplete.cns: 非常感谢你。拿着这个推荐信去达肯1拜访哈查尔吧。
dialogsComplete.de: Auf alle Fälle danke ich dir vielmals. Ich will dir den Letter of Recommendation geben. Bitte bringe diesen zu Hachal in Darkon 1.
dialogsComplete.fi: Thank you very much. Take this letter of recommendation and visit Hachal in Darkon 1.
dialogsComplete.fil: Thank you very much. Take this letter of recommendation and visit Hachal in Darkon 1.
dialogsComplete.fr: Merci infiniment pour tout. Voici une lettre expliquant les faits, j'aimerais que tu ailles à Darkon 1 et que tu la remettes à Hachal.
dialogsComplete.id: Terima kasih banyak. Ambil surat rekomendasi ini dan kunjungi Hachal di Darkon 1.
dialogsComplete.it: Thank you very much. Take this letter of recommendation and visit Hachal in Darkon 1.
dialogsComplete.jp: レポートを届けてくれてご苦労だったね。これから私が推薦状を書いてあげるから、これを持ってキプラ（ダーコン第1地区）に住んでいる＜ハカル＞のもとに行ってくれ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 정말 감사합니다. 이 추천서를 가지고 다콘 제1지구에 있는 헤이첼을 찾아가세요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Thank you very much. Take this letter of recommendation and visit Hachal in Darkon 1.
dialogsComplete.pl: Thank you very much. Take this letter of recommendation and visit Hachal in Darkon 1.
dialogsComplete.ru: Спасибо. Поговори с Гачалео в Дарконе-1. Вот тебе рекомендательное письмо к нему.
dialogsComplete.sp: Muchísimas gracias. Toma esta carta de recomendación y visita a Hachal en Darkon 1.
dialogsComplete.sw: Thank you very much. Take this letter of recommendation and visit Hachal in Darkon 1.
dialogsComplete.th: ขอบคุณมาก ใช้จดหมายแนะนำนี้แล้วไปหา Hachal ใน Darkon 1
dialogsComplete.tw: 辛苦你了！我現在寫一個推薦書給你，你拿著到得肯 1，去找叫做夏格凱巴的人。
dialogsComplete.vi: Cảm ơn rất nhiều. Nhận thư giới thiệu này và đến thăm Hachal trong Darkon 1.

dialogsComplete.en: I am sure he can help you. Take care!
dialogsComplete.ar: I am sure he can help you. Take care!
dialogsComplete.br: Tenho certeza de que ele pode lhe ajudar. Cuide-se!
dialogsComplete.cns: 那个人应该可以帮我们的!那就拜托你了..
dialogsComplete.de: Ich bin sicher er kann dir Helfen. Sei vorsichtig!
dialogsComplete.fi: I am sure he can help you. Take care!
dialogsComplete.fil: I am sure he can help you. Take care!
dialogsComplete.fr: Tu devrais le trouver à l'Usine des Erons de Darkon, et je suis persuadé qu'il pourra t'aider pour la suite. Prend bien soin de toi !
dialogsComplete.id: Aku yakin dia bisa menolongmu. Hati-hati!
dialogsComplete.it: I am sure he can help you. Take care!
dialogsComplete.jp: 歴史学に造詣の深い＜ハカル＞なら、きっと君の力になれると思う。では、気をつけて行ってきてくれ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 도움을 줄 겁니다. 부디 조심하세요!
dialogsComplete.nl: I am sure he can help you. Take care!
dialogsComplete.pl: I am sure he can help you. Take care!
dialogsComplete.ru: Он обо всем тебе расскажет. Удачи!
dialogsComplete.sp: Estoy seguro de que él puede ayudarte. ¡Cuídate!
dialogsComplete.sw: I am sure he can help you. Take care!
dialogsComplete.th: ฉันแน่ใจว่าเขาสามารถช่วยคุณได้ ดูแลตัวเองด้วย!
dialogsComplete.tw: 那個人應該可以幫我們的！那就拜託你了…
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi chắc chắn anh ấy có thể giúp bạn. Bảo trọng!

dialogsDecline.en: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsDecline.ar: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsDecline.br: Você não quer ajudar? Tudo bem. Encontraremos outra pessoa.
dialogsDecline.cns: 你不想帮忙？好吧，那我们找别人了。
dialogsDecline.de: Du willst nicht helfen? Das ist okay. Wir finden jemand anderen.
dialogsDecline.fi: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsDecline.fil: Ayaw mo bang tumulong? Ayos lang. Hahanapan namin ng iba.
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu ne veux pas aider ? Tant pis, nous trouverons quelqu'un d'autre.
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu tidak ingin membantu? Tidak apa. Kita akan orang lain yang mau.
dialogsDecline.it: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsDecline.jp: 手伝わないんですね。大丈夫ですよ、他の人を探します。
dialogsDecline.kr: 도와주기 싫으신가요? 어쩔 수 없죠. 다른 사람을 찾아볼게요.
dialogsDecline.nl: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsDecline.pl: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsDecline.ru: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿No quieres ayudar? De acuerdo. Encontraremos a otra persona.
dialogsDecline.sw: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณไม่อยากช่วยเหรอ? ไม่เป็นไร เราจะหาคนอื่น
dialogsDecline.tw: 你不想幫忙？沒關係。我們會找到其他人的。
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn không muốn giúp đỡ? Không sao đâu. Chúng tôi sẽ tìm người khác.

dialogsComplete.en: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsComplete.ar: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsComplete.br: Muito bem. Você concluiu a quest de forma bem-sucedida.
dialogsComplete.cns: 很好。你已经成功完成任务了。
dialogsComplete.de: Gut gemacht. Du hast die Aufgabe erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsComplete.fil: Magaling. Matagumpay mong natapos ang quest.
dialogsComplete.fr: Excellent travail ! Tu as terminé la quête.
dialogsComplete.id: Bagus sekali. Kamu telah berhasil menyelesaikan quest.
dialogsComplete.it: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsComplete.jp: 見事に依頼を成し遂げましたね。お疲れ様です。さあ、依頼の報酬をお受け取りください。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트를 성공적으로 완료했습니다. 잘하셨어요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsComplete.pl: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsComplete.ru: Отличная работа! Вычеркиваю эту просьбу из списка.
dialogsComplete.sp: Bien hecho. Has completado la misión con éxito.
dialogsComplete.sw: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsComplete.th: ทำได้ดีมาก คุณทำภารกิจสำเร็จแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 做得好！你已成功完成任務。
dialogsComplete.vi: Tốt lắm. Bạn đã hoàn thành nhiệm vụ thành công.

dialogsFail.en: You haven't finished the task yet.
dialogsFail.ar: You haven't finished the task yet.
dialogsFail.br: Você ainda não terminou a tarefa.
dialogsFail.cns: 你尚未完成此任务。
dialogsFail.de: Du hast die Aufgabe noch nicht abgeschlossen.
dialogsFail.fi: You haven't finished the task yet.
dialogsFail.fil: Hindi mo pa natatapos ang gawain.
dialogsFail.fr: Tu n'as pas encore fini ta tâche.
dialogsFail.id: Kamu masih belum menyelesaikan tugasnya.
dialogsFail.it: You haven't finished the task yet.
dialogsFail.jp: まだ終えられていないようですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 아직 임무를 완료하지 않았네요.
dialogsFail.nl: You haven't finished the task yet.
dialogsFail.pl: You haven't finished the task yet.
dialogsFail.ru: You haven't finished the task yet.
dialogsFail.sp: Aún no has terminado la tarea.
dialogsFail.sw: You haven't finished the task yet.
dialogsFail.th: คุณยังทำภารกิจไม่เสร็จเลย
dialogsFail.tw: 你還沒有完成任務。
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn vẫn chưa hoàn thành nhiệm vụ.

name.th: สงครามอันตราย

description.en: Defeat the 5 Veduque Guardians in front of Serus Uriel's Chamber and return to Dr. Estly to acquire the Mars Dungeon Key.
description.ar: Defeat the 5 Veduque Guardians in front of Serus Uriel's Chamber and return to Dr. Estly to acquire the Mars Dungeon Key.
description.br: Derrote as 5 Veduque Guardiãs em frente a câmara de Serus Uriel e volte ao Dr. Estly para adquirir a Chave da Masmorra Mars.
description.cns: 击败魔域密殿最深处的5只守卫蛇妖，然后再回来找我吧
description.de: Ich weiß nicht genau wo sie ist, aber die Kammer von Serus Uriel ist in der Nähe. Im Vorraum sind 5 Wächter, die den Raum bewachen. Bitte besiege sie zuerst.
description.fi: Defeat the 5 Veduque Guardians in front of Serus Uriel's Chamber and return to Dr. Estly to acquire the Mars Dungeon Key.
description.fil: Defeat the 5 Veduque Guardians in front of Serus Uriel's Chamber and return to Dr. Estly to acquire the Mars Dungeon Key.
description.fr: Trouver la chambre de Serus Uriel et vaincre les 5 gardiens qui la protègent pour récupérer la clé.
description.id: Kalahkan 5 Veduque Guardians di depan Serus Uriel's Chamber dan kembali ke Dr. Estly untuk mendapatkan Mars Dungeon Key.
description.it: Defeat the 5 Veduque Guardians in front of Serus Uriel's Chamber and return to Dr. Estly to acquire the Mars Dungeon Key.
description.jp: セラス・ウリエルの部屋を守るヴァイスヴェデュークを倒しましょう。
description.kr: 세루스 우리엘의 은신처 앞에 있는 베듀크 가디언 5마리를 처치하고, 이스틀리 박사에게 돌아가 마스 던전 열쇠를 받으세요.
description.nl: Defeat the 5 Veduque Guardians in front of Serus Uriel's Chamber and return to Dr. Estly to acquire the Mars Dungeon Key.
description.pl: Defeat the 5 Veduque Guardians in front of Serus Uriel's Chamber and return to Dr. Estly to acquire the Mars Dungeon Key.
description.ru: Нужно одолеть пять арахнаг, охраняющих вход в логово Фобии, и вернуться к доктору Если за шестеренкой.
description.sp: Derrota a los 5 Veduques Crueles frente a la cámara de Serus Uriel y regresa con el Dr. Estly para adquirir la Llave de la Mazmorra Mars.
description.sw: Defeat the 5 Veduque Guardians in front of Serus Uriel's Chamber and return to Dr. Estly to acquire the Mars Dungeon Key.
description.th: ปราบ Veduque Guardians 5 ตนที่หน้า Serus Uriel's Chamber และกลับไปหา Dr. Estly เพื่อรับ Mars Dungeon Key
description.tw: 在賽羅斯的密室前擊敗 5 名妒婦守護者，然後返回 Dr. 法小林處取得瑪斯密殿鑰匙。
description.vi: Đánh bại 5 Veduque Guardians trước Phòng của Serus Uriel và quay lại gặp Dr. Estly để lấy Chìa khóa Mars Dungeon.

dialogsBegin.en: As long as Serus Uriel is still alive, it will be impossible to avoid all out war…
dialogsBegin.ar: As long as Serus Uriel is still alive, it will be impossible to avoid all out war…
dialogsBegin.br: Enquanto Serus Uriel estiver lá, é impossível evitar uma guerra contra ela. Só que...
dialogsBegin.cns: 赛罗斯蛇妖再度现身了！一定要阻止他才行！
dialogsBegin.de: Solange Serus Uriel existiert, ist es unmöglich den Krieg zu verhindern. Aber..
dialogsBegin.fi: As long as Serus Uriel is still alive, it will be impossible to avoid all out war…
dialogsBegin.fil: As long as Serus Uriel is still alive, it will be impossible to avoid all out war…
dialogsBegin.fr: Aussi longtemps que Serus Uriel sera là-bas, la guerre semble inévitable. Mais.
dialogsBegin.id: Selama Serus Uriel masih hidup, mustahil untuk menghindari perang habis-habisan…
dialogsBegin.it: As long as Serus Uriel is still alive, it will be impossible to avoid all out war…
dialogsBegin.jp: セラス・ウリエルが目覚めた以上、私達の未来は2つに1つしかありません。勝利か敗北か…いえ、生か死か。そのどちらかです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 세루스 우리엘이 살아 있는 한, 전면전을 피하는 건 어려울 거예요…
dialogsBegin.nl: As long as Serus Uriel is still alive, it will be impossible to avoid all out war…
dialogsBegin.pl: As long as Serus Uriel is still alive, it will be impossible to avoid all out war…
dialogsBegin.ru: Если Фобию не остановить, скоро она опутает Фларинцию сетями страха и недоверия.
dialogsBegin.sp: Mientras Serus Uriel siga con vida, será imposible evitar una guerra total...
dialogsBegin.sw: As long as Serus Uriel is still alive, it will be impossible to avoid all out war…
dialogsBegin.th: ตราบใดที่ Serus Uriel ยังมีชีวิตอยู่ มันจะเป็นไปไม่ได้ที่จะหลีกเลี่ยงสงคราม…
dialogsBegin.tw: 賽羅斯再度現身了！一定要阻止他才行！
dialogsBegin.vi: Miễn là Serus Uriel vẫn còn sống, nếu không sẽ không thể tránh khỏi chiến tranh…

dialogsBegin.en: I do not want to stain Flaris with blood again. That's the last thing we need right now.
dialogsBegin.ar: I do not want to stain Flaris with blood again. That's the last thing we need right now.
dialogsBegin.br: .. eu não quero manchar Flaris com sangue novamente. O que é pior é que ela acabou de reaparecer...
dialogsBegin.cns: 若是不能阻止它，帕里的人民，会面临到很大的威胁。
dialogsBegin.de: .. ich möchte nicht mit ansehen wie Flaris wieder mit Blut getränkt wird. Es ist schlimm genug, dass sie wieder aufgetaucht ist.
dialogsBegin.fi: I do not want to stain Flaris with blood again. That's the last thing we need right now.
dialogsBegin.fil: I do not want to stain Flaris with blood again. That's the last thing we need right now.
dialogsBegin.fr: .mais je ne veux pas voir Flaris souillée de sang une nouvelle fois. Il vient juste de refaire son apparition.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya tidak ingin menodai Flaris dengan darah lagi. Itu hal terakhir yang kita butuhkan saat ini.
dialogsBegin.it: I do not want to stain Flaris with blood again. That's the last thing we need right now.
dialogsBegin.jp: ただ…このフラリスを戦場にするわけにはいかないんです。幸いなことに、セラス・ウリエルはまだ目覚めたばかり。全ての力を取り戻したわけではないでしょう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 플라리스가 다시 피로 물드는 일은 절대로 없었으면 해요. 가장 피하고 싶은 일이죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: I do not want to stain Flaris with blood again. That's the last thing we need right now.
dialogsBegin.pl: I do not want to stain Flaris with blood again. That's the last thing we need right now.
dialogsBegin.ru: Бывшие друзья станут бояться друг друга и подозревать в недобром. Кто-то первым поднимет на соседа меч, и грянет война...
dialogsBegin.sp: No quiero volver a manchar de sangre a todo Flaris. Eso es lo último que necesitamos ahora.
dialogsBegin.sw: I do not want to stain Flaris with blood again. That's the last thing we need right now.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันไม่ต้องการทำให้ Flaris เปื้อนเลือด อีกครั้ง นั่นคือสิ่งสุดท้ายที่เราต้องการในตอนนี้
dialogsBegin.tw: 我不想讓布拉里斯再次染上鮮血。這是我們現在最不願看到的事。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi không muốn làm vấy máu Flaris một lần nữa. Đó là điều cuối cùng chúng ta cần làm ngay.

dialogsBegin.en: Her power can't possibly be as strong as before, otherwise she wouldn't be hiding in the mine.
dialogsBegin.ar: Her power can't possibly be as strong as before, otherwise she wouldn't be hiding in the mine.
dialogsBegin.br: ... só que ela não está tão poderosa quanto antes. Nós realmente precisamos fazer alguma coisa antes que ela recupere todo seu poder.
dialogsBegin.cns: 他的力量不像以前那么强，但是恢复得很快，还是得尽快解决才行！
dialogsBegin.de: Daher ist ihre Kraft nicht so stark wie vorher. Wir müssen etwas unternehmen, bevor sie ihre volle Kraft wieder erlangt.
dialogsBegin.fi: Her power can't possibly be as strong as before, otherwise she wouldn't be hiding in the mine.
dialogsBegin.fil: Her power can't possibly be as strong as before, otherwise she wouldn't be hiding in the mine.
dialogsBegin.fr: .mais il n'est plus aussi puissant qu'auparavant. Nous devons agir vite avant qu'il ne retrouve sa pleine puissance.
dialogsBegin.id: Kekuatannya tidak mungkin sekuat sebelumnya, jika tidak, dia tidak akan bersembunyi di tambang.
dialogsBegin.it: Her power can't possibly be as strong as before, otherwise she wouldn't be hiding in the mine.
dialogsBegin.jp: 今はフラリスダンジョンのどこかに身を潜ませ、力を回復させているはずです。倒すのは今しかありません！
dialogsBegin.kr: 우리엘의 힘이 예전만 못한 건 확실해요. 아니었으면 광산 속에 숨지도 않았겠죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: Her power can't possibly be as strong as before, otherwise she wouldn't be hiding in the mine.
dialogsBegin.pl: Her power can't possibly be as strong as before, otherwise she wouldn't be hiding in the mine.
dialogsBegin.ru: Но  Фобия наверняка еще слаба, иначе она не пряталась бы в шахте, а разбила железные двери и вышла наружу.
dialogsBegin.sp: Su poder no puede ser tan fuerte como antes, de lo contrario no estaría escondida en la mina.
dialogsBegin.sw: Her power can't possibly be as strong as before, otherwise she wouldn't be hiding in the mine.
dialogsBegin.th: พลังของเธอไม่อาจแข็งแกร่งเหมือนเมื่อก่อน ไม่งั้น เธอคงไม่ซ่อนตัวอยู่ในเหมือง
dialogsBegin.tw: 她的力量不可能和從前一樣強大，否則她就不會躲在礦坑裡了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Sức mạnh của cô ấy không thể mạnh như trước, nếu không thì cô ấy sẽ không trốn trong hầm mỏ.

dialogsBegin.en: I need your help again. Can you help me protect our peaceful Flaris?
dialogsBegin.ar: I need your help again. Can you help me protect our peaceful Flaris?
dialogsBegin.br: Você pode proteger nossa pacífica Flaris?
dialogsBegin.cns: 这一切就只能靠你了！
dialogsBegin.de: Kannst du mir helfen das friedliche Flaris zu beschützen?
dialogsBegin.fi: I need your help again. Can you help me protect our peaceful Flaris?
dialogsBegin.fil: I need your help again. Can you help me protect our peaceful Flaris?
dialogsBegin.fr: Peux-tu m'aider à préserver la paix à Flaris ?
dialogsBegin.id: Aku butuh bantuanmu lagi. Bisakah kamu membantu saya melindungi Flaris kita yang damai?
dialogsBegin.it: I need your help again. Can you help me protect our peaceful Flaris?
dialogsBegin.jp: フラリスの平和を守るため、セラス・ウリエル退治に立ち上がってください！
dialogsBegin.kr: 다시 한번 당신의 도움이 필요해요. 평화로운 플라리스를 지켜낼 수 있도록, 도와주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: I need your help again. Can you help me protect our peaceful Flaris?
dialogsBegin.pl: I need your help again. Can you help me protect our peaceful Flaris?
dialogsBegin.ru: Мне нужна твоя помощь. Ты спасешь Фларинцию?
dialogsBegin.sp: Necesito tu ayuda otra vez. ¿Puedes ayudarme a proteger a nuestra pacífica Flaris?
dialogsBegin.sw: I need your help again. Can you help me protect our peaceful Flaris?
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันต้องการความช่วยเหลือของคุณอีกครั้ง คุณช่วยฉันปกป้อง Flaris อันเงียบสงบของเราได้มั้ย
dialogsBegin.tw: 這一切就只能靠你了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi cần sự giúp đỡ của bạn một lần nữa. Bạn có thể giúp tôi bảo vệ Flaris bình yên?

dialogsAccept.en: I do not know exactly where it is, but there is a chamber for Serus Uriel. In front of that room, there are five guardians that protect it. Please defeat them first.
dialogsAccept.ar: I do not know exactly where it is, but there is a chamber for Serus Uriel. In front of that room, there are five guardians that protect it. Please defeat them first.
dialogsAccept.br: Eu não sei exatamente onde fica, mas há uma câmara para a Serus Uriel. Na frente desta sala, há cinco guardiões a protegendo. Por favor, derrote-os primeiro.
dialogsAccept.cns: 赛罗斯蛇妖的出没地点？这我不是很确定，但那周围出现的怪物相当多，你要小心点！
dialogsAccept.de: Ich weiß nicht genau wo es ist, aber es gibt eine Kammer für Serus Uriel. Im Vorraum befinden sich 5 Wächter, die sie beschützen. Besiege sie zuerst.
dialogsAccept.fi: I do not know exactly where it is, but there is a chamber for Serus Uriel. In front of that room, there are five guardians that protect it. Please defeat them first.
dialogsAccept.fil: I do not know exactly where it is, but there is a chamber for Serus Uriel. In front of that room, there are five guardians that protect it. Please defeat them first.
dialogsAccept.fr: Il y a une chambre pour Serus Uriel dans la Mine de Mas, devant se tiennent ses 5 gardiens. S'il te plaît, combat-les en premier.
dialogsAccept.id: Saya tidak tahu persis di mana itu, tetapi ada kamar untuk Serus Uriel. Di depan ruangan itu, ada lima penjaga yang melindunginya. Tolong kalahkan mereka dulu.
dialogsAccept.it: I do not know exactly where it is, but there is a chamber for Serus Uriel. In front of that room, there are five guardians that protect it. Please defeat them first.
dialogsAccept.jp: フラリスダンジョンのどこかに、セラス・ウリエルが身を潜ませている部屋があるはずです。その部屋を守っている＜ヴァイスヴェデューク＞を倒してください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 정확한 위치는 알 수 없지만, 세루스 우리엘을 위한 은신처가 따로 있는 것 같아요. 은신처를 다섯 명의 가디언이 지키고 있으니, 먼저 녀석들을 처치해 주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: I do not know exactly where it is, but there is a chamber for Serus Uriel. In front of that room, there are five guardians that protect it. Please defeat them first.
dialogsAccept.pl: I do not know exactly where it is, but there is a chamber for Serus Uriel. In front of that room, there are five guardians that protect it. Please defeat them first.
dialogsAccept.ru: Логово Фобии находится в глубине Марсовой шахты. Вход в него охраняют пять стражей. Тебе нужно одолеть их.
dialogsAccept.sp: No sé dónde está, pero en lo más profundo hay una cámara dónde reside Serus Uriel. Frente a esa habitación, hay cinco guardianes que la protegen. Derrota a esos primero.
dialogsAccept.sw: I do not know exactly where it is, but there is a chamber for Serus Uriel. In front of that room, there are five guardians that protect it. Please defeat them first.
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันไม่รู้ว่ามันอยู่ที่ไหน แต่มีห้องสำหรับ Serus Uriel หน้าห้องนั้นมีการ์เดี้ยนห้าคนคอยปกป้องอยู่ ได้โปรดปราบพวกมันก่อน
dialogsAccept.tw: 我不太確定她確切的位置，但賽羅斯有一間密室。在那扇門前，有 5 名守護者守著。請先擊敗他們。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi không biết chính xác nó ở đâu, nhưng có một căn phòng dành cho Serus Uriel. Ở phía trước của căn phòng đó, có năm người bảo vệ. Hãy đánh bại chúng trước.

dialogsDecline.en: What the hell is more important than this? I really cannot understand!
dialogsDecline.ar: What the hell is more important than this? I really cannot understand!
dialogsDecline.br: Que diabos é mais importante do que isso? Eu realmente não consigo entender!
dialogsDecline.cns: 有什么事比这件事还重要呢？真是搞不懂！！
dialogsDecline.de: Was zur Hölle ist wichtiger als das? Ich kann das nicht verstehen!
dialogsDecline.fi: What the hell is more important than this? I really cannot understand!
dialogsDecline.fil: What the hell is more important than this? I really cannot understand!
dialogsDecline.fr: Mais qu'est-ce qui peut bien être plus important ?!
dialogsDecline.id: Apa yang lebih penting dari ini? Aku benar-benar tidak bisa mengerti!
dialogsDecline.it: What the hell is more important than this? I really cannot understand!
dialogsDecline.jp: ここまできて、それはないでしょう！あなたという人は…まったくあなたという人は……。
dialogsDecline.kr: 이것보다 더 중요한 게 뭐가 있다는 거죠? 정말 이해가 안 되네요!
dialogsDecline.nl: What the hell is more important than this? I really cannot understand!
dialogsDecline.pl: What the hell is more important than this? I really cannot understand!
dialogsDecline.ru: Не представляю, что может быть важнее, чем спасение целого острова!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Qué narices hay más importante que esto? ¡No lo puedo entender!
dialogsDecline.sw: What the hell is more important than this? I really cannot understand!
dialogsDecline.th: อะไรจะสำคัญไปกว่านี้? ไม่เข้าใจจริงๆ!
dialogsDecline.tw: 有什麼事比這件事還重要呢？真是搞不懂！！
dialogsDecline.vi: Còn cái quái gì quan trọng hơn điều này? Tôi thực sự không thể hiểu được!

dialogsComplete.en: Hmm... You are really great. I will appoint you as a punitive force of Serus Uriel. Here is the key. Please take it.
dialogsComplete.ar: Hmm... You are really great. I will appoint you as a punitive force of Serus Uriel. Here is the key. Please take it.
dialogsComplete.br: Hmm... Você é demais. Eu o nomearei como uma força de punição de Serus Uriel. Aqui está a chave. Por favor, fique com ela.
dialogsComplete.cns: Hmm... You are really great. I will appoint you as a punitive force of Serus Uriel. Here is the key. Please take it.
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm.. Du bist großartig! Ich werde dich als Bestrafer von Serus Uriel ernennen. Hier ist der Schlüssel. Bitte nimm ihn.
dialogsComplete.fi: Hmm... You are really great. I will appoint you as a punitive force of Serus Uriel. Here is the key. Please take it.
dialogsComplete.fil: Hmm... You are really great. I will appoint you as a punitive force of Serus Uriel. Here is the key. Please take it.
dialogsComplete.fr: Merci ! Voici la clé qui devrait te permettre d'entrer dans la chambre. Prends-là.
dialogsComplete.id: Hmm.. Kamu benar-benar hebat. Saya akan menunjukmu sebagai kekuatan hukuman Serus Uriel. Inilah kuncinya. Silakan ambil.
dialogsComplete.it: Hmm... You are really great. I will appoint you as a punitive force of Serus Uriel. Here is the key. Please take it.
dialogsComplete.jp: すごい！あなたにならセラス・ウリエル退治を任せられます。この＜古い鍵＞を受け取ってください。この鍵なら、セラス・ウリエルの部屋に入れるはずです。
dialogsComplete.kr: 흠... 정말 대단하군요. 당신을 세루스 우리엘의 토벌군으로 임명하겠어요. 여기 열쇠예요. 받으세요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Hmm... You are really great. I will appoint you as a punitive force of Serus Uriel. Here is the key. Please take it.
dialogsComplete.pl: Hmm... You are really great. I will appoint you as a punitive force of Serus Uriel. Here is the key. Please take it.
dialogsComplete.ru: Hmm... You are really great. I will appoint you as a punitive force of Serus Uriel. Here is the key. Please take it.
dialogsComplete.sp: Hmm.. Eres genial. Te nombraré como una fuerza punitiva de Serus Uriel. Aquí está la llave. Toma.
dialogsComplete.sw: Hmm... You are really great. I will appoint you as a punitive force of Serus Uriel. Here is the key. Please take it.
dialogsComplete.th: อืม... คุณยอดเยี่ยมจริงๆ ฉันจะแต่งตั้งคุณเป็นกองพิพากษาแห่ง Serus Uriel และนี่คือกุญแจสำคัญ โปรดรับไว้
dialogsComplete.tw: 嗯……你真的很了不起。我任命你為賽羅斯討伐隊的一員。這是鑰匙，請收下。
dialogsComplete.vi: Hmm .. Bạn thực sự giỏi. Tôi giao cho bạn trách nhiệm hoàn thành nhiệm vụ với vai trò là một lực lượng trừng phạt của Serus Uriel. Đây là chìa khoá. Hãy nhận lấy nó.

dialogsComplete.en: From now on, the conflict is with Serus Uriel. Please, head back there and use the key to open the door to her chamber.
dialogsComplete.ar: From now on, the conflict is with Serus Uriel. Please, head back there and use the key to open the door to her chamber.
dialogsComplete.br: De agora em diante, a verdadeira guerra é contra Serus Uriel. Por favor, abra a porta da sala, que a criatura está esperando por você.
dialogsComplete.cns: 马上就要与3只赛罗斯蛇妖正面冲突了，再房门打开后，赛罗斯蛇妖就在前方等着你！
dialogsComplete.de: Von nun an gibt es Krieg mit Serus Uriel. Bitte öffne die Tür zu dem Raum und ich werde auf dich warten.
dialogsComplete.fi: From now on, the conflict is with Serus Uriel. Please, head back there and use the key to open the door to her chamber.
dialogsComplete.fil: From now on, the conflict is with Serus Uriel. Please, head back there and use the key to open the door to her chamber.
dialogsComplete.fr: A partir de maintenant, la véritable guerre est contre Serus Uriel. S'il te plaît, va ouvrir la porte de la chambre, je t'attendrai.
dialogsComplete.id: Mulai sekarang, konfliknya adalah dengan Serus Uriel. Tolong, kembali ke sana dan gunakan kunci untuk membuka pintu kamarnya.
dialogsComplete.it: From now on, the conflict is with Serus Uriel. Please, head back there and use the key to open the door to her chamber.
dialogsComplete.jp: あとはセラス・ウリエルとの対決だけですね。あなたがやつを求めるように、やつもあなたを待ち受けているでしょう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이제부터는 세루스 우리엘과의 본격적인 승부입니다. 문을 열면 세루스 우리엘이 기다리고 있을 거예요.
dialogsComplete.nl: From now on, the conflict is with Serus Uriel. Please, head back there and use the key to open the door to her chamber.
dialogsComplete.pl: From now on, the conflict is with Serus Uriel. Please, head back there and use the key to open the door to her chamber.
dialogsComplete.ru: Осталось одолеть саму Фобию. Отправляйся в шахту и верни шестеренку в механизм.
dialogsComplete.sp: De ahora en adelante, el conflicto es con Serus Uriel. Por favor, vuelve allí y usa la llave para abrir la puerta de su cámara.
dialogsComplete.sw: From now on, the conflict is with Serus Uriel. Please, head back there and use the key to open the door to her chamber.
dialogsComplete.th: จากนี้ไปเริ่มขัดแย้งกับ Serus Uriel ได้โปรด กลับไปที่นั่นแล้วใช้กุญแจเพื่อเปิดประตูห้องของเธอ
dialogsComplete.tw: 接下來就是與賽羅斯的對決了。請回到那裡，用鑰匙打開她密室的門。
dialogsComplete.vi: Kể từ bây giờ, xung đột với Serus Uriel. Làm ơn, quay lại đó và dùng chìa khóa để mở cửa vào buồng của cô ấy.

dialogsComplete.en: Don't give up now, you must defeat her.
dialogsComplete.ar: Don't give up now, you must defeat her.
dialogsComplete.br: É claro que não é nada fácil. Mas por favor, não desista! Lute até o fim! Ah, a chave da sala pode ser obtida com os cinco guardiões. Boa sorte!
dialogsComplete.cns: 这真的不简单！不过希望你不要放弃！祝你好运~打败守护赛罗斯蛇妖的怪物，就能得到魔法钥匙了！
dialogsComplete.de: Natürlich ist es nicht einfach. Bitte gib nicht auf! Kämpf weiter! Den Schlüssel zur Kammer kannst du von den 5 Wächtern erhalten. Viel Glück!
dialogsComplete.fi: Don't give up now, you must defeat her.
dialogsComplete.fil: Don't give up now, you must defeat her.
dialogsComplete.fr: Bien sûr ce ne sera pas facile... mais n'abandonne pas ! Tu devrais trouver la clé sur l'un des 5 gardiens, bonne chance !
dialogsComplete.id: Jangan menyerah sekarang, kamu harus mengalahkannya.
dialogsComplete.it: Don't give up now, you must defeat her.
dialogsComplete.jp: フラリスの命運、あなたに託しましたよ！
dialogsComplete.kr: 인제 와서 포기하면 안 돼요. 반드시 우리엘을 없애야 해요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Don't give up now, you must defeat her.
dialogsComplete.pl: Don't give up now, you must defeat her.
dialogsComplete.ru: Не сдавайся. Фобия должна быть повержена!
dialogsComplete.sp: No te rindas ahora, debes derrotarla.
dialogsComplete.sw: Don't give up now, you must defeat her.
dialogsComplete.th: อย่ายอมแพ้ตอนนี้ คุณต้องเอาชนะเธอให้ได้
dialogsComplete.tw: 現在不能放棄，你必須打倒她。
dialogsComplete.vi: Đừng bỏ cuộc bây giờ, bạn phải đánh bại cô ấy.

dialogsFail.en: Don't underestimate the 5 guardians. They are very powerful.
dialogsFail.ar: Don't underestimate the 5 guardians. They are very powerful.
dialogsFail.br: Você não deve subestimar os cinco guardiões. Eles são definitivamente fortes.
dialogsFail.cns: 千万别小看他们！她们的实力也很强喔！！
dialogsFail.de: Du solltest die 5 Wächter nicht unterschätzen. Sie sind definitiv stark.
dialogsFail.fi: Don't underestimate the 5 guardians. They are very powerful.
dialogsFail.fil: Don't underestimate the 5 guardians. They are very powerful.
dialogsFail.fr: Tu ne devrais pas sous-estimer les 5 gardiens de Serus Uriel. Ils sont très puissants.
dialogsFail.id: Jangan meremehkan 5 wali. Mereka sangat kuat.
dialogsFail.it: Don't underestimate the 5 guardians. They are very powerful.
dialogsFail.jp: ヴァイスヴェデュークをたかが門番とあなどらないでください。恐ろしい連中ですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 가디언 다섯을 만만하게 보면 안 돼요. 굉장히 강하답니다.
dialogsFail.nl: Don't underestimate the 5 guardians. They are very powerful.
dialogsFail.pl: Don't underestimate the 5 guardians. They are very powerful.
dialogsFail.ru: Стражи очень сильны. Не стоит их недооценивать.
dialogsFail.sp: No subestimes a los 5 guardianes. Son muy poderosos.
dialogsFail.sw: Don't underestimate the 5 guardians. They are very powerful.
dialogsFail.th: อย่าดูถูกผู้พิทักษ์ทั้ง 5 ตน พวกเขามีพลังเยอะมาก
dialogsFail.tw: 千萬別小看那 5 名守護者。他們的實力非常強大。
dialogsFail.vi: Đừng đánh giá thấp 5 người bảo vệ. Chúng rất mạnh mẽ.

description.en: Travel to Madren Town, east of the High-Dwarpets, and slay Chaner. Once Chaner is defeated, speak with Assist Instructor Kidmen in Eastern Flarine.
description.ar: Travel to Madren Town, east of the High-Dwarpets, and slay Chaner. Once Chaner is defeated, speak with Assist Instructor Kidmen in Eastern Flarine.
description.br: Ah, antes de visitar o Instrutor, você deve caçar Masquerpets na cidade de Madren. Eles estão atacando as pessoas.
description.cns: 啊，去找助教之前，听说最近迪米村附近出现了一些毒蝎子，好像在欺负人民呢~你去猎杀那个毒蝎子之后拿给那个助教吧，知道吗?
description.de: Oh. Bevor du zum Assist Anweiser gehst, musst du Chaner in Madren jagen.
description.fi: Travel to Madren Town, east of the High-Dwarpets, and slay Chaner. Once Chaner is defeated, speak with Assist Instructor Kidmen in Eastern Flarine.
description.fil: Travel to Madren Town, east of the High-Dwarpets, and slay Chaner. Once Chaner is defeated, speak with Assist Instructor Kidmen in Eastern Flarine.
description.fr: Se débarrasser de Chaner, le monstre rôdant à Madren, puis se présenter à l'Instructrice des Acolytes de Flarine.
description.id: Pergilah ke Kota Madren, di sebelah timur High-Dwarpets, dan bunuh Chaner. Setelah Chaner dikalahkan, bicaralah dengan Assist Instructor Kidmen di Eastern Flarine.
description.it: Travel to Madren Town, east of the High-Dwarpets, and slay Chaner. Once Chaner is defeated, speak with Assist Instructor Kidmen in Eastern Flarine.
description.jp: 最近、マッドランタウンに現れたという凶暴なモンスターを退治してから、アシスト訓練所の助手のところに向かおう。
description.kr: 하이-드워펫의 거주지 동쪽 매드런 타운으로 가서 차네르를 처치하세요. 차네르를 처치하고 나면 플라리네 동부에 있는 훈련 조교 키드먼과 대화하세요.
description.nl: Travel to Madren Town, east of the High-Dwarpets, and slay Chaner. Once Chaner is defeated, speak with Assist Instructor Kidmen in Eastern Flarine.
description.pl: Travel to Madren Town, east of the High-Dwarpets, and slay Chaner. Once Chaner is defeated, speak with Assist Instructor Kidmen in Eastern Flarine.
description.ru: Нужно убить скорпихвоста Циклопиона неподалеку от Мадренбурга, расположенного к востоку от лагеря карликов, а затем поговорить с инструктором Кидмой в восточной Фларинции.
description.sp: Viaja al Pueblo Madren, al este de los Alto-Enanos, y derrota al Chaner. Una vez que Chaner esté muerto, habla con la Instructora Assist Kidmen en Flarine Este.
description.sw: Travel to Madren Town, east of the High-Dwarpets, and slay Chaner. Once Chaner is defeated, speak with Assist Instructor Kidmen in Eastern Flarine.
description.th: เดินทางไป Madren Town ทางตะวันออกของ High-Dwarpets และสังหาร Chaner เมื่อ Chaner พ่ายแพ้ ให้คุยกับ Assist Instructor Kidmen ใน Eastern Flarine
description.tw: 啊，去找助教之前，聽說莫德琳城附近最近出現了一些魔域怪，好像在欺負人民呢~你去獵殺那個魔域怪怪之後拿給那個助教吧，知道嗎？
description.vi: Đi đến Thị trấn Madren, phía đông High-Dwarpets, và giết Chaner. Khi Chaner bị đánh bại, hãy nói chuyện với Assist Instructor Kidmen ở Eastern Flarine.

dialogsBegin.en: Here… take this. It's a Label of Technique. It details what I've told you today.
dialogsBegin.ar: Here… take this. It's a Label of Technique. It details what I've told you today.
dialogsBegin.br: Agora você entendeu, certo? Nunca perca o Pergaminho de Técnica que eu lhe dei, pois ele é muito importante. Entendido?
dialogsBegin.cns: 大概懂了吧?我给你的技能的小纸条绝对不可以弄丢，也不可以丢在地上啊!那是很重要的东西，不然我绝对部会负责啦!
dialogsBegin.de: Jetzt verstehst du es. Nicht wahr? So gut lehrte ich. Verliere ja nicht das Label of Technique, weil es sehr wichtig ist. Es ist unbezahlbar. Verstanden?
dialogsBegin.fi: Here… take this. It's a Label of Technique. It details what I've told you today.
dialogsBegin.fil: Here… take this. It's a Label of Technique. It details what I've told you today.
dialogsBegin.fr: Alors, que penses-tu des techniques de l'Acolyte ? Oui, tu aimerais en apprendre d'autres je te comprends...
dialogsBegin.id: Ambil ini. Ini adalah Label of Technique. Ini menjelaskan apa yang saya katakan padamu hari ini.
dialogsBegin.it: Here… take this. It's a Label of Technique. It details what I've told you today.
dialogsBegin.jp: クックック、ちゃんとわかったか？あ、このスキル事典の破片は失くさないようにしてくれよな。とても大事なものだから。
dialogsBegin.kr: 자, 이걸 받아요. 기술 비전서예요. 오늘 제가 설명한 내용이 담겨 있죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: Here… take this. It's a Label of Technique. It details what I've told you today.
dialogsBegin.pl: Here… take this. It's a Label of Technique. It details what I've told you today.
dialogsBegin.ru: Вот... возьми. Это страницы из книги "Секреты мастерства". Здесь есть все, о чем мы сегодня говорили.
dialogsBegin.sp: Toma… Es un Libro de Técnica. Se detalla todo lo que te he explicado hoy.
dialogsBegin.sw: Here… take this. It's a Label of Technique. It details what I've told you today.
dialogsBegin.th: นี่... เอานี่ไป มันเป็น Label of Technique รายละเอียดที่ฉันบอกคุณวันนี้
dialogsBegin.tw: 大概懂了吧？我給你的技能的小紙條絕對不可以弄丟，也不可以丟在地上啊！那是很重要的東西，不然我絕對不會負責啦！
dialogsBegin.vi: Đây… cầm lấy cái này. Đó là một Label of Technique. Nó nêu chi tiết những gì tôi đã nói với bạn hôm nay.

dialogsBegin.en: Now, for the final leg of your journey, apprentice. A creature called Chaner has been terrorizing the locals near the Demians in Madren Town.
dialogsBegin.ar: Now, for the final leg of your journey, apprentice. A creature called Chaner has been terrorizing the locals near the Demians in Madren Town.
dialogsBegin.br: Agora só falta passar pelo teste final. Você sabe onde os Militares estão, não sabe? Vá té lá e encontre o Instrutor. O nome dele é Kee... Desculpe, eu esqueci. De qualquer maneira, vá visitá-lo.
dialogsBegin.cns: 啊，现在只要去找训练教官旁边的助教就可以了，这是最后一个考验了。不管他说什么你就听着吧!
dialogsBegin.de: Übrig bleibt nun nur die letzte Stufe der Ausbildung. Du weißt doch, wo der Ausbilder zu finden ist, nicht wahr? Dort wirst du die Anweiserin finden. Ihr Name ist Lumarka. Gehe zu ihr!
dialogsBegin.fi: Now, for the final leg of your journey, apprentice. A creature called Chaner has been terrorizing the locals near the Demians in Madren Town.
dialogsBegin.fil: Now, for the final leg of your journey, apprentice. A creature called Chaner has been terrorizing the locals near the Demians in Madren Town.
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais pour l'instant, voici ta dernière épreuve. Te souviens-tu où se trouve le l'Entraîneur des Acolytes à Flarine ? Tu y trouveras aussi une Instructrice, son nom est... Euh en fait j'ai oublié son nom.
dialogsBegin.id: Sekarang, untuk bagian terakhir dari perjalananmu, apprentice. Makhluk bernama Chaner telah meneror penduduk setempat di dekat Demian di Kota Madren.
dialogsBegin.it: Now, for the final leg of your journey, apprentice. A creature called Chaner has been terrorizing the locals near the Demians in Madren Town.
dialogsBegin.jp: じゃ、最後のテストに入ろう。最後のテストは、アシスト訓練所の助手のところへ行けば受けることができる。名前は・・・さて、何だったっけな？覚えていないが。とにかく、その助手のところへ行ってみてくれよ。わかったか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 이제 여정의 마지막이군요. 매드런 타운의 데미안 근처에 있는 차네르라는 녀석이 주민을 괴롭히고 있어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Now, for the final leg of your journey, apprentice. A creature called Chaner has been terrorizing the locals near the Demians in Madren Town.
dialogsBegin.pl: Now, for the final leg of your journey, apprentice. A creature called Chaner has been terrorizing the locals near the Demians in Madren Town.
dialogsBegin.ru: Ну и последний этап твоего пути, юное дарование. Рядом с Мадренбургом, городом злыдней, обитает скорпихвост по имени Циклопион. Фларинтийцы боятся его пуще смерти.
dialogsBegin.sp: Ahora, para el tramo final de tu prueba, aprendiz. Una criatura llamada Chaner ha estado aterrorizando a los lugareños cerca de los Demians en Pueblo Madren.
dialogsBegin.sw: Now, for the final leg of your journey, apprentice. A creature called Chaner has been terrorizing the locals near the Demians in Madren Town.
dialogsBegin.th: ขั้นสุดท้ายของการเดินทางของคุณ เด็กฝึกหัด สิ่งมีชีวิตที่เรียกว่า Chaner ได้สร้างความหวาดกลัวให้กับชาวบ้านที่อยู่ใกล้ Demians ใน Madren Town
dialogsBegin.tw: 現在是你旅程的最後一站。一個名叫撤內勒的怪物一直在恐嚇馬德倫鎮丹丹附近的當地人。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bây giờ là chặng cuối cùng của cuộc hành trình, người tập sự . Một sinh vật tên là Chaner đã khủng bố những người dân địa phương gần Demians ở Thị trấn Madren.

dialogsBegin.en: Slay him, then return to Assist Instructor Kidmen in Eastern Flarine. She will conclude your Assist training.
dialogsBegin.ar: Slay him, then return to Assist Instructor Kidmen in Eastern Flarine. She will conclude your Assist training.
dialogsBegin.br: Antes de visitá-lo, você deve caçar Masquerpets na cidade de Madren. Eles estão atacando pessoas, até mesmo os Demians.
dialogsBegin.cns: 啊，去找助教之前，听说帕里附近最近出现了一些魔域怪，好像在欺负人民呢~你去猎杀那个魔域怪怪之后拿给那个助教吧，知道吗?
dialogsBegin.de: Vorher musst du Chaner jagen, welcher die Menschen in Flaris bedroht.
dialogsBegin.fi: Slay him, then return to Assist Instructor Kidmen in Eastern Flarine. She will conclude your Assist training.
dialogsBegin.fil: Slay him, then return to Assist Instructor Kidmen in Eastern Flarine. She will conclude your Assist training.
dialogsBegin.fr: Quoi qu'il en soit, pour lui prouver ta valeur, tu dois chasser une nouvelle espèce de monstre avant d'aller la voir. Il attaque tout le monde à Madren. Son nom est Chaner.
dialogsBegin.id: Bunuh dia, lalu kembali ke Assist Instructor Kidmen di Eastern Flarine. Dia akan mengakhiri pelatihan Assistmu
dialogsBegin.it: Slay him, then return to Assist Instructor Kidmen in Eastern Flarine. She will conclude your Assist training.
dialogsBegin.jp: 助手のところへに行く前に、最近マッドランタウンに現れた凶暴なモンスターを退治してから行ってくれ。あそこに住んでいるデミアンをはじめ、付近の住民にも迷惑をかけているらしいんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 차네르를 처치한 뒤, 플라리네 동부에 있는 어시스트 훈련 조교 키드먼을 찾아가세요. 마지막 훈련을 도와줄 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Slay him, then return to Assist Instructor Kidmen in Eastern Flarine. She will conclude your Assist training.
dialogsBegin.pl: Slay him, then return to Assist Instructor Kidmen in Eastern Flarine. She will conclude your Assist training.
dialogsBegin.ru: Убей его и поговори с инструктором униформистов Кидмой в восточной Фларинции. Договорились?
dialogsBegin.sp: Derrótalo y vuelve con la Instructora Assist Kidmen en Flarine Este. Ella concluirá con tu entrenamiento de Assist.
dialogsBegin.sw: Slay him, then return to Assist Instructor Kidmen in Eastern Flarine. She will conclude your Assist training.
dialogsBegin.th: สังหารเขา จากนั้นกลับไปที่ Assist Instructor Kidmen ใน Eastern Flarine เธอจะสรุปการฝึกอบรม Assist ของคุณ
dialogsBegin.tw: 啊，去找助教之前，聽說布拉里斯附近最近出現了一些魔域怪，好像在欺負人民呢~你去獵殺那個魔域怪物之後拿給那個助教吧，知道嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Giết anh ta, sau đó quay trở lại Assist Instructor Kidmen ở Eastern Flarine. Cô ấy sẽ kết thúc khóa huấn luyện Assist của bạn.

dialogsAccept.en: Good luck to you, apprentice!

dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你一路顺风啊~

dialogsAccept.fi: Good luck to you, apprentice!

dialogsAccept.fr: Bonne chance. Tu tiens ton destin entre tes mains !
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga berhasil, apprentice!
dialogsAccept.it: Good luck to you, apprentice!
dialogsAccept.jp: せっかくここまで来たんだから、その心意気を無駄にするんじゃないぞ。

dialogsAccept.nl: Good luck to you, apprentice!
dialogsAccept.pl: Good luck to you, apprentice!

dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Buena suerte, aprendiz!
dialogsAccept.sw: Good luck to you, apprentice!
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้โชคดี เด็กฝึกหัด!
