dialogsDecline.en: No? What a shame. Speak to me again if you have a change of heart.
dialogsDecline.ar: No? What a shame. Speak to me again if you have a change of heart.
dialogsDecline.br: Não? Que pena. Fale comigo novamente se você mudar de opinião.
dialogsDecline.cns: 不吗？真丢人。如果你改变主意了再来找我。
dialogsDecline.de: Nein? Das ist schade. Sprich mich wieder an, wenn du deine Meinung geändert hast.
dialogsDecline.fi: No? What a shame. Speak to me again if you have a change of heart.
dialogsDecline.fil: No? What a shame. Speak to me again if you have a change of heart.
dialogsDecline.fr: Bon. Après tout j'en ai pas grand-chose à faire si tu n'y arrives pas ! Ha ha ha !
dialogsDecline.id: Tidak? Sayang sekali. Bicaralah padaku lagi jika kamu berubah pikiran.
dialogsDecline.it: No? What a shame. Speak to me again if you have a change of heart.
dialogsDecline.jp: まあ、君がテストを続けようが諦めようが、オレは関係ないからな。好きにするといいさ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 안 간다고요? 안타깝네요. 생각이 바뀌면 다시 말씀해 주세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: No? What a shame. Speak to me again if you have a change of heart.
dialogsDecline.pl: No? What a shame. Speak to me again if you have a change of heart.
dialogsDecline.ru: Что? Ну нет, так дело не пойдет! Если вдруг передумаешь, возвращайся.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿No? Que pena. Habla conmigo de nuevo si cambias de opinión.
dialogsDecline.sw: No? What a shame. Speak to me again if you have a change of heart.
dialogsDecline.th: ไม่นะ? น่าเสียดาย กลับมาคุยกับฉันอีกครั้งถ้าคุณเปลี่ยนใจ
dialogsDecline.tw: 不？好可惜啊！如果你改變主意了，再跟我說話。
dialogsDecline.vi: Không ư? Thật hổ thẹn. Nói chuyện với tôi một lần nữa nếu bạn đổi ý.

dialogsComplete.en: Chaner is… gone? Great work! Now, listen carefully. I have something very important to tell you.
dialogsComplete.ar: Chaner is… gone? Great work! Now, listen carefully. I have something very important to tell you.
dialogsComplete.br: Chaner se foi? Ótimo trabalho! Ele estava realmente incomodando! Agora, ouça com atenção. Tenho algo muito importante para lhe dizer.
dialogsComplete.cns: 毒蝎子…死了？干得好！现在，仔细听我说，我有一些非常重要的事要告诉你。
dialogsComplete.de: Chaner ist... weg? Gute Arbeit! Hör gut zu. Ich habe dir etwas sehr Wichtiges zu sagen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Chaner is… gone? Great work! Now, listen carefully. I have something very important to tell you.
dialogsComplete.fil: Chaner is… gone? Great work! Now, listen carefully. I have something very important to tell you.
dialogsComplete.fr: Merci beaucoup, il était important de s'occuper de ce monstre. Voici la dernière leçon : elle est sur le rôle de l'Acolyte, écoute-moi bien.
dialogsComplete.id: Chaner pergi? Kerja bagus! Sekarang, dengarkan baik-baik. Aku memiliki sesuatu yang sangat penting untuk diberitahukan padamu.
dialogsComplete.it: Chaner is… gone? Great work! Now, listen carefully. I have something very important to tell you.
dialogsComplete.jp: あら！マッドランタウンに現れたモンスターを退治してきてくださったのですね。あのモンスターにはみんな困っていたのです、ありがとうございます。さあ、最後のテストを始めましょう。最後はアシストの任務に関する情報をお教えしましょう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 차네르가… 사라졌다고요? 정말 잘하셨어요! 이제 잘 들어요. 아주 중요한 이야기가 있어요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Chaner is… gone? Great work! Now, listen carefully. I have something very important to tell you.
dialogsComplete.pl: Chaner is… gone? Great work! Now, listen carefully. I have something very important to tell you.
dialogsComplete.ru: Chaner is… gone? Great work! Now, listen carefully. I have something very important to tell you.
dialogsComplete.sp: Chaner… ¿se acabó? ¡Buen trabajo! Ahora, escucha atentamente. Tengo que decirte algo muy importante.
dialogsComplete.sw: Chaner is… gone? Great work! Now, listen carefully. I have something very important to tell you.
dialogsComplete.th: Chaner… ไปแล้วเหรอ? ทำได้ดีมาก! ทีนี้ฟังให้ดี ฉันมีเรื่องสำคัญมากจะบอกคุณ
dialogsComplete.tw: 撤內勒…走了？做得好！現在，仔細聽，我有很重要的事情要告訴你。
dialogsComplete.vi: Chaner đã… biến mất? Thật tuyệt vời! Bây giờ, hãy lắng nghe cẩn thận. Tôi có một điều rất quan trọng muốn nói với bạn.

dialogsComplete.en: The role of an Assist on the field of combat is primarily party support, however, an Assist can also prove to be a potent fighter as well.
dialogsComplete.ar: The role of an Assist on the field of combat is primarily party support, however, an Assist can also prove to be a potent fighter as well.
dialogsComplete.br: Assist é a classe de apoio durante o combate, mas pode também atacar diretamente o inimigo. Na linha de frente, um Assist se mostra inestimável.
dialogsComplete.cns: 圣职者是一个补助职业，但是也可以自己亲自战斗，可以在前方向战士一样进行近距离攻击，或在后面补助能力。
dialogsComplete.de: Der Beruf des Assist ist ein Hilfsberuf im Kampf, aber er kann die Feinde ebenso gut direkt angreifen. Er unterstützt in der ersten Reihe den Kampf des Mercenary oder anderer Berufe.
dialogsComplete.fi: The role of an Assist on the field of combat is primarily party support, however, an Assist can also prove to be a potent fighter as well.
dialogsComplete.fil: The role of an Assist on the field of combat is primarily party support, however, an Assist can also prove to be a potent fighter as well.
dialogsComplete.fr: L'Acolyte est la seule classe qui te permet de soigner et aider les autres au combat, mais aussi d'attaquer directement l'ennemi. L'Acolyte peut donc jouer un rôle assez polyvalent, j'espère que cela te plaira !
dialogsComplete.id: Peran Assist di medan pertempuran yang utama adalah support party, namun, Assist juga bisa menjadi petarung yang kuat.
dialogsComplete.it: The role of an Assist on the field of combat is primarily party support, however, an Assist can also prove to be a potent fighter as well.
dialogsComplete.jp: アシストは補助型の職業ですが、直接の戦闘もできます。前衛に立てばマーシナリーを手伝って近接戦を行うこともできるし、後衛に回れば、他の仲間が戦う際に必要な補助をかけてバックアップすることができます。
dialogsComplete.kr: 어시스트는 전투 중 주로 다른 사람들을 지원하는 역할을 합니다. 하지만 강력한 직접 전투 능력을 갖추고 있기도 해요.
dialogsComplete.nl: The role of an Assist on the field of combat is primarily party support, however, an Assist can also prove to be a potent fighter as well.
dialogsComplete.pl: The role of an Assist on the field of combat is primarily party support, however, an Assist can also prove to be a potent fighter as well.
dialogsComplete.ru: Униформист в первую очередь заботится о том, чтобы не погибли его товарищи. Но если нужно, мы и сами можем дать врагу отпор!
dialogsComplete.sp: El papel de un Assist en el campo de combate es principalmente de apoyo al grupo, sin embargo, un Assist también puede demostrar ser un luchador potente.
dialogsComplete.sw: The role of an Assist on the field of combat is primarily party support, however, an Assist can also prove to be a potent fighter as well.
dialogsComplete.th: บทบาทของ Assist ในสนามรบนั้นส่วนใหญ่เป็นการสนับสนุนแบบปาร์ตี้ อย่างไรก็ตาม Assist ก็สามารถพิสูจน์ได้ว่าเป็นนักสู้ที่ทรงพลังเช่นกัน
dialogsComplete.tw: 神職者是一個補助職業，但是也可以自己親自戰鬥，可以在前方向勇者一樣進行近距離攻擊，或在後面補助能力。
dialogsComplete.vi: Vai trò của một Assist trên chiến trường chủ yếu là hỗ trợ nhóm, tuy nhiên, Assist cũng có thể chứng tỏ là mình một chiến binh mạnh mẽ.

dialogsComplete.en: Congratulations, my friend! You are now an Assist! Welcome to the fold!
dialogsComplete.ar: Congratulations, my friend! You are now an Assist! Welcome to the fold!
dialogsComplete.br: Parabéns! Agora você é um Assist!
dialogsComplete.cns: 圣职者是一个很重要的补助职业，恭喜你成为圣职者!所有考验结束了~圣职者万岁!
dialogsComplete.de: Der Assist begleitet und hilft anderen, wie der Name schon sagt. Gratulation! Deine Ausbildung ist vollendet. Von jetzt an bist du ein Assist.
dialogsComplete.fi: Congratulations, my friend! You are now an Assist! Welcome to the fold!
dialogsComplete.fil: Congratulations, my friend! You are now an Assist! Welcome to the fold!
dialogsComplete.fr: Toutes mes félicitations ! Tu es maintenant devenu Acolyte et sera d'un grand secours pour tes amis au combat !
dialogsComplete.id: Selamat, temanku! Kamu sekarang menjadi Assist! Selamat datang di fold!
dialogsComplete.it: Congratulations, my friend! You are now an Assist! Welcome to the fold!
dialogsComplete.jp: アシストは職業名からわかるように、他の職業を補助しながらサポートする役割が大きい職業なのです。さあ、これであなたは全てのテストに合格しました。おめでとうございます。ここに誕生した志高きアシストに、リシスの祝福があらんことを！
dialogsComplete.kr: 축하합니다! 이제 정식 어시스트가 되셨어요! 진짜 자리를 찾으셨군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Congratulations, my friend! You are now an Assist! Welcome to the fold!
dialogsComplete.pl: Congratulations, my friend! You are now an Assist! Welcome to the fold!
dialogsComplete.ru: Прими мои искренние поздравления! Теперь ты тоже униформист! Добро пожаловать в нашу дружную компанию!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Felicidades amigo mío! ¡Ahora eres un Assist! ¡Bienvenido al redil!
dialogsComplete.sw: Congratulations, my friend! You are now an Assist! Welcome to the fold!
dialogsComplete.th: ยินดีด้วย เพื่อน! คุณเป็น Assist แล้ว! ยินดีต้อนรับ!
dialogsComplete.tw: 神職者是一個很重要的補助職業，恭喜你成為神職者！所有考驗結束了~神職者萬歲！
dialogsComplete.vi: Xin chúc mừng người bạn của tôi! Bạn hiện là một Assist! Chào mừng đến với nhóm chúng tôi!

dialogsFail.en: I'm waiting for word that Chaner has been destroyed. Last I heard he is still on the loose in Madren Town.
dialogsFail.ar: I'm waiting for word that Chaner has been destroyed. Last I heard he is still on the loose in Madren Town.
dialogsFail.br: Você pode ver que estou muito ocupado agora, não pode? Por favor, me deixe em paz. Droga de Chaner..
dialogsFail.cns: 你现在看不到我很忙吗?我不是解说员啦!没事的话请回吧!
dialogsFail.de: Siehst du nicht, dass ich ziemlich beschäftigt bin? Ich bin keine Auskunft. Wenn sonst nichts weiter ist, störe mich nicht länger und lass mich allein. Verdammt! Chaner.. Warte, du Bösewicht!
dialogsFail.fi: I'm waiting for word that Chaner has been destroyed. Last I heard he is still on the loose in Madren Town.
dialogsFail.fil: I'm waiting for word that Chaner has been destroyed. Last I heard he is still on the loose in Madren Town.
dialogsFail.fr: Tu vois bien que j'ai autre chose à faire que de m'occuper de toi !
dialogsFail.id: Aku menunggu kabar bahwa Chaner telah dihancurkan. Terakhir kudengar dia masih berkeliaran di Kota Madren.
dialogsFail.it: I'm waiting for word that Chaner has been destroyed. Last I heard he is still on the loose in Madren Town.
dialogsFail.jp: ちょっと忙しいので、あなたのお相手をすることはできません。わたしは案内人ではありませんので、ご用がなければおひきとりください。　はぁ、ホントに困ったわ、マッドランタウンに現れたモンスターには・・・・
dialogsFail.kr: 차네르를 전부 처치했다는 소식을 듣고 싶어요. 마지막으로 들은 얘기로는, 아직도 매드런 타운 근처를 돌아다닌다던데.
dialogsFail.nl: I'm waiting for word that Chaner has been destroyed. Last I heard he is still on the loose in Madren Town.
dialogsFail.pl: I'm waiting for word that Chaner has been destroyed. Last I heard he is still on the loose in Madren Town.
dialogsFail.ru: Говорят, скорпихвост Циклопион житья не дает мадренбуржцам. Вот бы кто-нибудь его убил!
dialogsFail.sp: Estoy esperando noticias de que Chaner ha sido derrotado. Lo último que sé es que sigue suelto por Pueblo Madren.
dialogsFail.sw: I'm waiting for word that Chaner has been destroyed. Last I heard he is still on the loose in Madren Town.
dialogsFail.th: ฉันกำลังรอคำว่า Chaner ถูกทำลาย ครั้งสุดท้ายที่ฉันได้ยินมาว่าเขายังคงอยู่ใน Madren Town
dialogsFail.tw: 你現在看不到我很忙嗎？我不是解說員啦！沒事的話請回吧！
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi đang chờ tin Chaner đã bị tiêu diệt. Lần cuối tôi nghe nói rằng anh ta vẫn tự do tự tại ở Madren Town.

dialogsBegin.ar: Pssst, hey you! I'm writing a book and I need your help. I'm having a bit of writer's block and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
dialogsBegin.br: Psss, ei você! Estou escrevendo um livro e preciso da sua ajuda. Estou tendo um pouco de bloqueio criativo e preciso de um corajoso aventureiro para me ajudar a escrevê-lo!
dialogsBegin.cns: 听好我说的话喔~其实啊..我最近在写一本书，写书的时候需要一些材料，但是我自己没办法搞定。
dialogsBegin.de: Hör mir genau zu. Genau genommen schreibe ich grade ein Buch, weil es eine gute Geschichte hat. Aber ich kann es alleine nicht beenden.
dialogsBegin.fi: Pssst, hey you! I'm writing a book and I need your help. I'm having a bit of writer's block and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
dialogsBegin.fil: Pssst, hey you! I'm writing a book and I need your help. I'm having a bit of writer's block and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
dialogsBegin.fr: Ecoute-moi bien. En ce moment, j'écris un livre, parce que j'ai trouvé une très bonne histoire. Mais je ne peux la finir par moi-même.
dialogsBegin.id: Pssst, hai kamu! Saya sedang menulis buku dan saya butuh bantuanmu. Saya mengalami sedikit hambatan penulis dan saya membutuhkan seorang petualang pemberani untuk membantu saya menulisnya!
dialogsBegin.it: Pssst, hey you! I'm writing a book and I need your help. I'm having a bit of writer's block and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
dialogsBegin.jp: 私は小説を書こうとしてるんだが、一人ではどうにもできないのだよ・・・。とてもよい題材があるのに残念だ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 저기, 이봐요! 제가 책을 쓰고 있는데, 도움이 필요해요! 요즘 도통 영감이 떠오르지 않아서, 용감한 모험가님이 도와주시면 정말 좋겠어요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Pssst, hey you! I'm writing a book and I need your help. I'm having a bit of writer's block and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
dialogsBegin.pl: Pssst, hey you! I'm writing a book and I need your help. I'm having a bit of writer's block and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
dialogsBegin.ru: Привет! Я пишу роман, который обещает стать бестселлером, но концовка никак не дается. Мне нужна помощь храброго героя!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Pssst, eh tú! ¡Estoy escribiendo un libro y necesito tu ayuda! ¡Tengo un pequeño bloqueo de escritor y necesito la ayuda de un valiente aventurero!
dialogsBegin.sw: Pssst, hey you! I'm writing a book and I need your help. I'm having a bit of writer's block and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
dialogsBegin.th: ชู่วว นี่คุณ! ฉันกำลังจะเขียนหนังสือสักเล่ม และฉันต้องการความช่วยเหลือจากคุณ ฉันเริ่มจะตันซะแล้วล่ะ ฉันจึงต้องการนักผจญภัยที่กล้าหาญเพื่อช่วยฉันเขียนหนังสือเล่มนี้!
dialogsBegin.tw: 聽好我說的話喔~其實啊…我最近在寫一本書，寫書的時候需要一些材料，但是我自己沒辦法搞定。
dialogsBegin.vi: Pssst, này bạn! Tôi đang viết một cuốn sách và tôi cần sự giúp đỡ của bạn. Tôi đang gặp một chút khó khăn và tôi cần một nhà thám hiểm dũng cảm giúp tôi viết nó!

dialogsBegin.en: Have you ever heard about the Legend of Big Thyred? No? A long long time ago, there was very a famous adventurer named Big Thyred. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure…
dialogsBegin.ar: Have you ever heard about the Legend of Big Thyred? No? A long long time ago, there was very a famous adventurer named Big Thyred. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure…
dialogsBegin.br: Você já ouviu falar a respeito da Lenda do Grande Thyred? Parece que não. Há muito, muito tempo havia um forte aventureiro. Seu nome era Grande Thyred. Um dia, ele encontrou um lugar interessante para se aventurar...
dialogsBegin.cns: 你有听说过特莱特怪物的传说吗?以前有一个大冒险家啦~名子叫<巨大施德利>，有一天，他发现了一个很有趣的事情。
dialogsBegin.de: Hast du je von der Legende der Dreadpet gehört? Es scheint mir als hättest du nicht. Vor langer, langer Zeit, gab es einen berühmten Abenteurer. Sein Name war Big Syred. Eines Tages, fand er einen interessanten Ort für Abenteuer.
dialogsBegin.fi: Have you ever heard about the Legend of Big Thyred? No? A long long time ago, there was very a famous adventurer named Big Thyred. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure…
dialogsBegin.fil: Have you ever heard about the Legend of Big Thyred? No? A long long time ago, there was very a famous adventurer named Big Thyred. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure…
dialogsBegin.fr: As-tu déjà entendu parler de la Légende du Dreadpet ? Apparemment non. Il y a fort longtemps, existait un célèbre aventurier, il s'appelait le Grand Syred.
dialogsBegin.id: Pernahkah kamu mendengar tentang Legenda Big Thyred? Tidak? Dahulu kala, ada seorang petualang yang sangat terkenal bernama Big Thyred. Suatu hari, dia menemukan tempat yang menarik untuk berpetualang…
dialogsBegin.it: Have you ever heard about the Legend of Big Thyred? No? A long long time ago, there was very a famous adventurer named Big Thyred. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure…
dialogsBegin.jp: 君は、シヴァーモンスターの話しを聞いたことがあるか？ふーむ・・。知らないようだな。昔、＜ピク・シレード＞という、とても有名な冒険者がいたのだよ。ある日、彼は得体の知れない何者かに遭遇したというんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 혹시 빅 시레드의 전설을 들어본 적 있으세요? 모르신다고요? 옛날에, 빅 시레드라는 아주 유명한 모험가가 있었어요. 어느 날, 빅은 아주 흥미로운 곳을 발견했죠...
dialogsBegin.nl: Have you ever heard about the Legend of Big Thyred? No? A long long time ago, there was very a famous adventurer named Big Thyred. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure…
dialogsBegin.pl: Have you ever heard about the Legend of Big Thyred? No? A long long time ago, there was very a famous adventurer named Big Thyred. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure…
dialogsBegin.ru: Знаешь легенду о Тирано Далекоходящем? Ну как же! Знаменитый путешественник. Прочти мой роман. Особенно главы "Тирано и лабиринт камнетавра" и "Тирано и три волкопарда".
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Has oído alguna vez sobre la Leyenda de Big Thyred? ¿No? Hace mucho mucho tiempo, había un aventurero muy famoso llamado Big Thyred. Un día, encontró un interesante lugar al que aventurarse...
dialogsBegin.sw: Have you ever heard about the Legend of Big Thyred? No? A long long time ago, there was very a famous adventurer named Big Thyred. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure…
dialogsBegin.th: คุณเคยได้ยินตำนานเกี่ยวกับ Thyred ไหม? ไม่เคยงั้นเรอะ? นานมาแล้วมีนักผจญภัยชื่อดังนามว่า Big Thyred อยู่มาวันหนึ่งเขาได้พบกับสถานที่ที่น่าสนใจในการเริ่มผจญภัย...
dialogsBegin.tw: 你有聽說過特萊特怪物的傳說嗎？以前有一個大冒險家啦~名子叫巨大施德利，有一天，他發現了一個很有趣的事情。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn đã bao giờ nghe Truyền thuyết về Big Thyred chưa? Chưa à? Cách đây rất lâu, có một nhà thám hiểm rất nổi tiếng tên là Big Thyred. Một ngày nọ, anh ấy tìm thấy một nơi thú vị để phiêu lưu…

dialogsBegin.en: It was a cave deep underground, surrounded with this strange, bloody fog. Big Thyred investigated the cave only to become infected by a disease within the cave called Horrible Fear.
dialogsBegin.ar: It was a cave deep underground, surrounded with this strange, bloody fog. Big Thyred investigated the cave only to become infected by a disease within the cave called Horrible Fear.
dialogsBegin.br: Era uma grande caverna no subsolo, cercada por um nevoeiro sangrento. Grande Thyred entrou na caverna para explorá-la e após um tempo dentro da caverna, várias rochas estranhas caíram sobre ele.
dialogsBegin.cns: 听说有一个地下洞穴里，住着一个叫做恐怖的牛呗呗的怪兽。
dialogsBegin.de: Es war eine große Höhle im tiefen Untergrund, der von blutigen Nebeln umgeben war. Da war er, Big Muscle, welcher auch "Grauenhafte Furcht" genannt wurde.
dialogsBegin.fi: It was a cave deep underground, surrounded with this strange, bloody fog. Big Thyred investigated the cave only to become infected by a disease within the cave called Horrible Fear.
dialogsBegin.fil: Isa itong kuweba na nasa napakailalim ng lupa, na napapaligiran ng kakaibang, madugong hamog. Inimbestigahan ni Big Thyred ang kuweba ngunit nahawa lamang ito ng sakit sa loob ng kuweba na tinatawag na Horrible Fear.
dialogsBegin.fr: Toujours en quête d'aventure, Syred découvrit un jour une grande caverne dans les profondeurs de la terre. Là se terrait un monstre effroyable, nommé Big Musclor.
dialogsBegin.id: Itu adalah gua jauh di bawah tanah, dikelilingi oleh kabut berdarah yang aneh ini. Big Thyred menyelidiki gua hanya untuk terinfeksi oleh penyakit di dalam gua yang disebut Horrible Fear.
dialogsBegin.it: It was a cave deep underground, surrounded with this strange, bloody fog. Big Thyred investigated the cave only to become infected by a disease within the cave called Horrible Fear.
dialogsBegin.jp: そこは、深き地に存在し、血色の霧が立ち込めるなんとも異様な洞窟だったそうだ。ここで遭遇したのが、ビグマズールだ。戦慄の恐怖と呼ぶものもいるがね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그곳은 지하 깊숙한 곳, 수상한 핏빛 안개가 감도는 동굴이었어요. 빅머슬은 그 동굴을 탐험하다가 '전율하는 공포'라는 병에 걸렸죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: It was a cave deep underground, surrounded with this strange, bloody fog. Big Thyred investigated the cave only to become infected by a disease within the cave called Horrible Fear.
dialogsBegin.pl: It was a cave deep underground, surrounded with this strange, bloody fog. Big Thyred investigated the cave only to become infected by a disease within the cave called Horrible Fear.
dialogsBegin.ru: Перейду к самому главному. Однажды, путешествуя по Мадригалу, Тирано нашел глубокую пещеру. Он долго спускался по ее лабиринтам под землю и вышел в зал, где клубился кровавый туман.
dialogsBegin.sp: Era una cueva muy profunda, rodeada de una extraña niebla sangrienta. Big Thyred se adentró solo la cueva y se infectó con una enfermedad llamada Miedo Horrible.
dialogsBegin.sw: It was a cave deep underground, surrounded with this strange, bloody fog. Big Thyred investigated the cave only to become infected by a disease within the cave called Horrible Fear.
dialogsBegin.th: มันเป็นถ้ำใต้ดินลึกล้อมรอบด้วยหมอกแปลกๆ ที่มีสีเลือด Big Thyred สำรวจถ้ำเพียงเพื่อที่จะพบว่าตนเองติดเชื้อโรคภายในถ้ำที่มีชื่อเรียกว่า Horrible Fear
dialogsBegin.tw: 那是一座位於地底深處、籠罩著詭異血霧的洞窟。巨大施德利前去調查，卻感染了洞內一種名叫「可怕的恐懼」的疾病。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đó là một hang động sâu dưới lòng đất, được bao quanh bởi màn sương mù đẫm máu kỳ lạ này. Big Thyred điều tra hang động chỉ để bị lây nhiễm bởi một căn bệnh trong hang động có tên là Horrible Fear.

dialogsBegin.en: The disease transformed him into a hideous monster, whom we now call Big Muscle. There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so the story goes…
dialogsBegin.ar: The disease transformed him into a hideous monster, whom we now call Big Muscle. There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so the story goes…
dialogsBegin.br: As rochas o consumiram, o transformando em uma pedra viva sem consciência. Agora o chamamos de Musculão, o Assustador. Praticamente não há mais nada daquele bravo aventureiro além de pedaços de pedra...
dialogsBegin.cns: 可是后来恐怖的牛呗呗不知道到哪里去了，突然消失~反正啦..这是我这次小说的主要内容。
dialogsBegin.de: Big Syred verschwand nachdem er "Das Grauen" gesehen hatte, soweit ich weiß. Tolle Geschichte, hm? Dreadpet, Grauenhafte Furcht. Cooool!
dialogsBegin.fi: The disease transformed him into a hideous monster, whom we now call Big Muscle. There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so the story goes…
dialogsBegin.fil: The disease transformed him into a hideous monster, whom we now call Big Muscle. There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so the story goes…
dialogsBegin.fr: On raconte que le Grand Syred disparu après avoir rencontré Big Musclor... C'est une histoire intrigante, n'est-ce pas ?
dialogsBegin.id: Penyakit itu mengubahnya menjadi monster yang mengerikan, yang sekarang kita sebut Big Muscle. Hampir tidak ada yang tersisa dari petualang pemberani itu kecuali potongan-potongan, atau begitulah ceritanya…
dialogsBegin.it: The disease transformed him into a hideous monster, whom we now call Big Muscle. There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so the story goes…
dialogsBegin.jp: ピクは、このビグマズールに遭遇した後、消息を絶ったとして伝えられている・・・。とまぁ、これが今回の題材なんだ。戦慄の恐怖！伝説のシヴァーモンスター！！どうかね？
dialogsBegin.kr: 그 병에 걸린 뒤, 그는 '빅 머슬'이라는 끔찍한 괴물로 변해버렸어요. 예전의 용감하던 모습은 사라지고, 조각조각 흩어진 흔적만 남았다고들 하죠…
dialogsBegin.nl: The disease transformed him into a hideous monster, whom we now call Big Muscle. There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so the story goes…
dialogsBegin.pl: The disease transformed him into a hideous monster, whom we now call Big Muscle. There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so the story goes…
dialogsBegin.ru: Едва завитки этого тумана коснулись Тирано, его охватил Смертельный Ужас. Он превратился в камнетавра - монстра, с какими когда-то сражался. С тех пор его зовут Тиранотавром.
dialogsBegin.sp: La enfermedad lo transformó en un monstruo horrible, al que ahora llamamos Gran Muscle. Prácticamente no queda nada de aquel valiente aventurero, quizá algunos fragmentos, o eso dice la historia...
dialogsBegin.sw: The disease transformed him into a hideous monster, whom we now call Big Muscle. There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so the story goes…
dialogsBegin.th: โรคนี้ทำให้เขากลายเป็นสัตว์ประหลาดที่น่าเกลียดน่ากลัว หลังจากนั้นเขาก็ถูกเรียกว่า Big Muscle ไม่มีคราบของนักผจญภัยผู้กล้าหาญอีกต่อไป และนี่ก็คือเรื่องราวทั้งหมดที่เกิดขึ้น...
dialogsBegin.tw: 可是後來恐怖的牛唄唄不知道到哪裡去了，突然消失~反正啦…這是我這次小說的主要內容。
dialogsBegin.vi: Căn bệnh đã biến anh ta thành một con quái vật gớm ghiếc, mà ngày nay chúng ta gọi là Big Muscle. Hầu như không còn gì về nhà thám hiểm dũng cảm đó ngoài những thứ linh tinh được kể lại...

dialogsBegin.en: So, here's where you come in. I need to an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Big Muscle. Feel like lending a hand?
dialogsBegin.ar: So, here's where you come in. I need to an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Big Muscle. Feel like lending a hand?
dialogsBegin.br: Então, aqui é onde você entra. Eu preciso de um final para a história e gostaria de saber o que aconteceu com Thyred depois de se tornar o Musculão. Pode me dar uma mão?
dialogsBegin.cns: 所以啊..你可不可以代替我亲自去体验看看啊?然后再把那个体验的结果说给我听。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich möchte, dass du wie Big Syred wirst und die Höhle auskundschaftest, wie er es tat. Dann erzählst du mir deine Geschichte. Okay?
dialogsBegin.fi: So, here's where you come in. I need to an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Big Muscle. Feel like lending a hand?
dialogsBegin.fil: So, here's where you come in. I need to an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Big Muscle. Feel like lending a hand?
dialogsBegin.fr: J'aimerais donc que tu te mettes dans la peau du Grand Syred et que toi aussi tu explores ce lieu. Après tu me raconteras ce que tu as découvert. Qu'en penses-tu ?
dialogsBegin.id: Jadi, di sinilah kamu masuk. Saya perlu mengakhiri cerita dan saya ingin tahu apa yang terjadi dengan Big Muscle. Merasa seperti meminjamkan tangan?
dialogsBegin.it: So, here's where you come in. I need to an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Big Muscle. Feel like lending a hand?
dialogsBegin.jp: そこで君に頼みがあるのだが・・・。この小説が完成できるように、君がピクの代わりに、今話したことを体験し、私に話してほしいのだ。どうだ？やってくれるか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 그래서 부탁인데 말이에요. 이야기의 결말을 써야 하는데... 빅 시레드가 어떻게 되었는지 알고 싶어요. 도와주실래요?
dialogsBegin.nl: So, here's where you come in. I need to an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Big Muscle. Feel like lending a hand?
dialogsBegin.pl: So, here's where you come in. I need to an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Big Muscle. Feel like lending a hand?
dialogsBegin.ru: Что было дальше, неизвестно. Роману нужна эффектная концовка - но ее нужно сперва разыграть. Предлагаю тебе ведущую роль. Что скажешь?
dialogsBegin.sp: Y aquí es donde entras tú. Necesito un final para la historia y me gustaría saber qué ha sido de Gran Muscle. ¿Me echas una mano?
dialogsBegin.sw: So, here's where you come in. I need to an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Big Muscle. Feel like lending a hand?
dialogsBegin.th: แล้วคุณก็ได้เดินทางมา ณ ที่แห่งนี้ ฉันต้องการตอนจบของเรื่องๆ นี้ ดังนั้นอยากจะรู้ว่าเกิดอะไรขึ้นเกี่ยวกับ Big Muscle อยากจะยื่นมือมาช่วยฉันงั้นเหรอ?
dialogsBegin.tw: 所以啊…你可不可以代替我親自去體驗看看啊？然後再把那個體驗的結果說給我聽。
dialogsBegin.vi: Vì vậy, đây là nơi bạn đến. Tôi cần kết thúc câu chuyện và tôi muốn biết điều gì sẽ xảy ra với Big Muscle. Có giúp một tay không nào?

dialogsAccept.en: One of those mangy Organigors ate one of my reference books. Defeat the Organigors at the Plain of Bubble and acquire the Book of Fear 1. While you're there, find the Fortress Map.
dialogsAccept.ar: One of those mangy Organigors ate one of my reference books. Defeat the Organigors at the Plain of Bubble and acquire the Book of Fear 1. While you're there, find the Fortress Map.
dialogsAccept.br: Um daqueles Organigors sarnentos comeu um dos meus livros de referência. Derrote Organigor, que vive na Planície de Bubble. Assim você obterá o Livro do Medo 1. Por favor, encontre também o Mapa da Fortaleza.
dialogsAccept.cns: 战栗毒蝎吃了恐怖之书第1卷，你得去波布尔平原击杀它们并夺回此书。然后在旁边的地上找到 堡垒地图
dialogsAccept.de: Fein. Bitte gehe nun und jage Organigor. Er lebt in der Ebene von Bubble. Dann bekommst du Book of Fear1. Finde bitte auch ihre Festung in dem Feld.
dialogsAccept.fi: One of those mangy Organigors ate one of my reference books. Defeat the Organigors at the Plain of Bubble and acquire the Book of Fear 1. While you're there, find the Fortress Map.
dialogsAccept.fil: One of those mangy Organigors ate one of my reference books. Defeat the Organigors at the Plain of Bubble and acquire the Book of Fear 1. While you're there, find the Fortress Map.
dialogsAccept.fr: Il te faut tout d'abord te rendre à la Plaine de Bubble et te débarrasser des Organigors pour obtenir le Livre de Big Musclor.
dialogsAccept.id: Salah satu Organigor kudis itu memakan salah satu buku referensiku. Kalahkan Organigor di Dataran Gelembung dan dapatkan Book of Fear 1. Saat kamu di sana, temukan Peta Benteng.
dialogsAccept.it: One of those mangy Organigors ate one of my reference books. Defeat the Organigors at the Plain of Bubble and acquire the Book of Fear 1. While you're there, find the Fortress Map.
dialogsAccept.jp: よし！それでは、手始めにバブルの平原に生息するオルガニガーという奴を倒し、恐怖の書を持ってきてほしい。あぁ。それと、平原の何処かにある、彼らの巣窟を見つけることも忘れないでくれよ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 나쁜 오르가니거 중 하나가 제 책을 삼켰어요. 버블 평원의 오르가니거를 처치해서 공포의 서 1권을 되찾아 주세요. 가능하다면 요새 지도도 함께 찾아주시면 좋겠어요.
dialogsAccept.nl: One of those mangy Organigors ate one of my reference books. Defeat the Organigors at the Plain of Bubble and acquire the Book of Fear 1. While you're there, find the Fortress Map.
dialogsAccept.pl: One of those mangy Organigors ate one of my reference books. Defeat the Organigors at the Plain of Bubble and acquire the Book of Fear 1. While you're there, find the Fortress Map.
dialogsAccept.ru: У меня была Книга кошмарищ, где говорилось о Смертельном Ужасе и как его побороть, но ее съел книгожор. Верни книгу и поищи на поле план пещеры - он мог выпасть!
dialogsAccept.sp: Uno de esos Organigors sarnosos se comió uno de mis libros de referencia. Derrota a los Organigors en la Llanura de Bubble y consigue el Libro del Miedo 1. Mientras estás por allí, busca el Mapa de la Fortaleza.
dialogsAccept.sw: One of those mangy Organigors ate one of my reference books. Defeat the Organigors at the Plain of Bubble and acquire the Book of Fear 1. While you're there, find the Fortress Map.
dialogsAccept.th: หนึ่งใน Organigors Mangy กินหนึ่งในหนังสืออ้างอิงของฉัน จงกำจัด Organigors ที่ Plain of Bubble และเอา Book of Fear 1 กลับมา ตอนคุณไปที่นั่นก็มองหา Fortress Map ด้วยล่ะ
dialogsAccept.tw: 好，你首先去巴布樂平原找一個叫做窩樂坎的怪物，他會給你恐怖的書第 1 卷，然後在平原的某處找一下他們的靈源…
dialogsAccept.vi: Một trong những Mangy Organigors đó đã ăn một trong những cuốn sách tham khảo của tôi. Đánh bại Organigors tại Plain of Bubble và nhận được Book of Fear 1. Khi bạn ở đó, hãy tìm Fortress Map.

dialogsDecline.en: Awwww, come on! Look, I'll give you HALF of the sales from my book if you'll help. Still having second thoughts?
dialogsDecline.ar: Awwww, come on! Look, I'll give you HALF of the sales from my book if you'll help. Still having second thoughts?
dialogsDecline.br: Awwww, vamos lá! Olha, eu te dou METADE das vendas do meu livro se você ajudar. Oferta irrecusável não acha?
dialogsDecline.cns: 反正，应该是一个很棒的冒险啦!我会拿我卖书的收入50%给你，好不好?
dialogsDecline.de: Ach, komm schon! Hör zu, ich gebe dir die Hälfte des Umsatzes aus meinem Buch, wenn du mir hilfst. Hast du immer noch Zweifel?
dialogsDecline.fi: Awwww, come on! Look, I'll give you HALF of the sales from my book if you'll help. Still having second thoughts?
dialogsDecline.fil: Awwww, come on! Look, I'll give you HALF of the sales from my book if you'll help. Still having second thoughts?
dialogsDecline.fr: Fouille bien les environs pour trouver la Carte de la grotte... Ce sera une grande aventure, toujours partant ?
dialogsDecline.id: Awwww, ayolah! Dengar, saya akan memberi kamu SETENGAH dari penjualan dari buku saya jika kamu mau membantu. Masih berpikir dua kali?
dialogsDecline.it: Awwww, come on! Look, I'll give you HALF of the sales from my book if you'll help. Still having second thoughts?
dialogsDecline.jp: とてもスリリングで、冒険者にはたまらない話だと思うんだが・・・。私がこの本を出版したら、売り上げの50％をあげよう。どうだい？それでもやらないのかい？
dialogsDecline.kr: 아~ 제발요! 이렇게 하죠. 책이 나오면 매출의 반은 드릴게요! 아직도 망설여지세요?
dialogsDecline.nl: Awwww, come on! Look, I'll give you HALF of the sales from my book if you'll help. Still having second thoughts?
dialogsDecline.pl: Awwww, come on! Look, I'll give you HALF of the sales from my book if you'll help. Still having second thoughts?
dialogsDecline.ru: Awwww, come on! Look, I'll give you HALF of the sales from my book if you'll help. Still having second thoughts?
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Ahhh, venga ya! Mira, si me ayudas te daré la MITAD de lo que gane con las ventas de mi libro. ¿Sigues dudando?
dialogsDecline.sw: Awwww, come on! Look, I'll give you HALF of the sales from my book if you'll help. Still having second thoughts?
dialogsDecline.th: ง่าาาาาา ไม่เอาน่า! เอางี้ ฉันจะให้กำไร 'ครึ่งหนึ่ง' จากยอดขายหนังสือของฉันถ้าคุณตกลงจะช่วย อยากเปลี่ยนใจไหม?
dialogsDecline.tw: 哇，加油！聽著，如果你能幫忙的話，我會給你一半的收入。還在猶豫嗎？
dialogsDecline.vi: Awwww, cố lên! Nghe này, tôi sẽ cho bạn NỬA doanh số từ cuốn sách của tôi nếu bạn giúp. Vẫn đang lưỡng lự à?

dialogsComplete.en: Oh, Rhisis! You've got the Book of Fear! Great work! Alright, sounds like you have what it takes to face Big Muscle.
dialogsComplete.ar: Oh, Rhisis! You've got the Book of Fear! Great work! Alright, sounds like you have what it takes to face Big Muscle.
dialogsComplete.br: Oh, Rhisis! Você conseguiu o Livro do Medo! Ótimo trabalho! Tudo bem, parece que você tem o que é preciso para enfrentar Grande Muscle.
dialogsComplete.cns: 哈哈，这么难的事情都办完了啊?把这个收下吧!这是施德利的心脏，好恶心喔~我不想看。
dialogsComplete.de: Oh, du bist echt gut!! Hier bitte. Dies ist das Herz von Syred. Wie abscheulich es doch ist!
dialogsComplete.fi: Oh, Rhisis! You've got the Book of Fear! Great work! Alright, sounds like you have what it takes to face Big Muscle.
dialogsComplete.fil: Oh, Rhisis! You've got the Book of Fear! Great work! Alright, sounds like you have what it takes to face Big Muscle.
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh, tu es vraiment fort !! Voilà pour toi, il s'agit du cœur de Syred. Un peu dégoûtant, je sais.
dialogsComplete.id: Oh, Rhisis! Kamu memiliki Kitab Ketakutan! Kerja bagus! Baiklah, sepertinya kamu memiliki apa yang diperlukan untuk menghadapi Big Muscle.
dialogsComplete.it: Oh, Rhisis! You've got the Book of Fear! Great work! Alright, sounds like you have what it takes to face Big Muscle.
dialogsComplete.jp: おぉー！君！さすがじゃないか！結構大変だっただろう。よーし、これを受け取ってくれ。これはシレードの心臓だ。とても気持ち悪くて、私は見たくもないがね。
dialogsComplete.kr: 오오! 공포의 서를 가지고 돌아오셨네요! 정말 감사해요! 좋아요, 이제 빅 머슬과 맞설 준비가 된 것 같군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Oh, Rhisis! You've got the Book of Fear! Great work! Alright, sounds like you have what it takes to face Big Muscle.
dialogsComplete.pl: Oh, Rhisis! You've got the Book of Fear! Great work! Alright, sounds like you have what it takes to face Big Muscle.
dialogsComplete.ru: Клянусь Райс, это же книга о Смертельном Ужасе! Теперь ты справишься с Тиранотавром.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Oh, por Rhisis! ¡Tienes el Libro del Miedo! ¡Buen trabajo! Muy bien, parece que tienes lo necesario para enfrentarte al Gran Muscle.
dialogsComplete.sw: Oh, Rhisis! You've got the Book of Fear! Great work! Alright, sounds like you have what it takes to face Big Muscle.
dialogsComplete.th: โอ้ Rhisis! คุณมี Book of Fear! ดีมาก! ดูเหมือนคุณมีทุกสิ่งที่จะต้องเผชิญกับ Big Muscle แล้วล่ะ
dialogsComplete.tw: 哈哈，這麼難的事情都辦完了啊？把這個收下吧！這是施德利的心臟，好噁心喔~我不想看。
dialogsComplete.vi: Ôi, Rhisis! Bạn đã có Book of Fear! Tuyệt vời! Được rồi, có vẻ như bạn đã có những gì cần thiết để đối mặt với Big Muscle.

dialogsComplete.en: Take the heart to the Dreadpet Manager just southwest of here. You'll have to join a party before you face Big Muscle, it's too dangerous to go alone.
dialogsComplete.ar: Take the heart to the Dreadpet Manager just southwest of here. You'll have to join a party before you face Big Muscle, it's too dangerous to go alone.
dialogsComplete.br: Leve o coração para o Gestor de Dreadpet a sudoeste daqui. Você terá que formar um grupo antes de ir enfrentar o Musculão, é muito perigoso ir sozinho. Chame aliados fortes!
dialogsComplete.cns: 你先去找特莱特怪物管理者，他会告诉你一些事情，但是绝对不要自己去体验喔~一定要组剧团进去!
dialogsComplete.de: Nun geh bitte und treffe den Dreadpet Verwalter im Süden des Leren Gebirges, er wird dir den Weg zeigen. Oh und du musst einer Party beitreten bevor du gehst, denn es ist alleine sehr schwer. Okay?
dialogsComplete.fi: Take the heart to the Dreadpet Manager just southwest of here. You'll have to join a party before you face Big Muscle, it's too dangerous to go alone.
dialogsComplete.fil: Take the heart to the Dreadpet Manager just southwest of here. You'll have to join a party before you face Big Muscle, it's too dangerous to go alone.
dialogsComplete.fr: Maintenant va rencontrer le Manager Dreadpet dans la partie sud des montagnes de Leren, il te montrera le chemin. Mais tu devrais d'abord former un groupe .
dialogsComplete.id: Bawa hati ini ke Manajer Dreadpet di barat daya dari sini. Kamu harus bergabung dengan pesta sebelum kamu menghadapi Big Muscle, terlalu berbahaya untuk pergi sendiri.
dialogsComplete.it: Take the heart to the Dreadpet Manager just southwest of here. You'll have to join a party before you face Big Muscle, it's too dangerous to go alone.
dialogsComplete.jp: レルエン山脈南部の何処かにいるという、シヴァーモンスター伝道師の元へ行くといい。彼が案内してくれるはずだ。それと、一人では無理だから、必ずパーティーを組んで行くことだ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이 심장을 여기서 서쪽으로 가면 있는 드래드펫 관리자에게 전달해 주세요. 빅 머슬과 싸우려면 혼자서는 위험하니까, 극단을 구하시는 게 좋을 거예요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Take the heart to the Dreadpet Manager just southwest of here. You'll have to join a party before you face Big Muscle, it's too dangerous to go alone.
dialogsComplete.pl: Take the heart to the Dreadpet Manager just southwest of here. You'll have to join a party before you face Big Muscle, it's too dangerous to go alone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Отнеси сердце вейдеру на юго-запад. С Тиранотавром лучше не встречаться в одиночку. Собери труппу.
dialogsComplete.sp: Lleva el corazón al Mánager Dreadpet justo al suroeste de aquí. Tendrás que unirte a una party para enfrentarte a Gran Muscle, es demasiado peligroso ir solo.
dialogsComplete.sw: Take the heart to the Dreadpet Manager just southwest of here. You'll have to join a party before you face Big Muscle, it's too dangerous to go alone.
dialogsComplete.th: นำหัวใจไปให้ผู้จัดการ Dreadpet ทางตะวันตกเฉียงใต้ของที่นี่ คุณจะต้องเข้าร่วมปาร์ตี้ก่อนที่คุณจะเผชิญหน้ากับ Big Muscle มันอันตรายเกินไปที่จะไปคนเดียว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你先去找特萊特怪物管理者，他會告訴你一些事情，但是絕對不要自己去體驗喔~一定要組劇團進去！
dialogsComplete.vi: Đưa trái tim đến Dreadpet Manager ngay phía tây nam đây. Bạn sẽ phải tham gia một bữa tiệc trước khi đối mặt với Big Muscle, đi một mình quá nguy hiểm.

dialogsFail.en: Look, I know it's scary to face the Organigor, but I believe you can do it. Go, now!
dialogsFail.ar: Look, I know it's scary to face the Organigor, but I believe you can do it. Go, now!
dialogsFail.br: Eu sei que é difícil enfrentar Organigor, mas acredito em você. Boa sorte!
dialogsFail.cns: 战栗毒蝎是有点狡猾啦!可是我相信，如果是你的话，一定没有问题的!
dialogsFail.de: Ich weiß es ist schwierig Organigor zu bekämpfen, weil er von der grauenhaften Furcht infiziert wurde. Aber ich glaube du kannst es schaffen. Viel Glück!
dialogsFail.fi: Look, I know it's scary to face the Organigor, but I believe you can do it. Go, now!
dialogsFail.fil: Look, I know it's scary to face the Organigor, but I believe you can do it. Go, now!
dialogsFail.fr: Je sais qu'il est difficile de se battre contre les Organigors car ils ont été infectés par Big Musclor... Mais je suis sûr que tu peux le faire. Bonne chance !
dialogsFail.id: Dengar, aku tahu menghadapi Organigor itu menakutkan, tapi aku yakin kamu bisa melakukannya. Pergi sekarang!
dialogsFail.it: Look, I know it's scary to face the Organigor, but I believe you can do it. Go, now!
dialogsFail.jp: オルガニガーをあなどってはいかんぞ。なにしろ戦慄の洗礼を受けた奴だからな。でも、君ならきっと大丈夫だろう。頑張ってくれ！
dialogsFail.kr: 오르가니거와 마주하는 게 무섭다는 거 알아요. 하지만 전 당신이라면 해내실 수 있다고 믿어요. 어서 가세요!
dialogsFail.nl: Look, I know it's scary to face the Organigor, but I believe you can do it. Go, now!
dialogsFail.pl: Look, I know it's scary to face the Organigor, but I believe you can do it. Go, now!
dialogsFail.ru: Книгожоры, конечно, звери страшные, но только для книг!
dialogsFail.sp: Mira, sé que da miedo enfrentarse al Organigor, pero creo que puedes hacerlo. ¡Ve a por él!
dialogsFail.sw: Look, I know it's scary to face the Organigor, but I believe you can do it. Go, now!
dialogsFail.th: เอาน่า ฉันรู้ว่ามันน่ากลัวที่จะต้องเผชิญกับ Organigor แต่ฉันเชื่อว่าคุณทำได้ ไปเร็ว!
dialogsFail.tw: 窩樂坎這傢伙是有點狡猾啦！可是我相信，如果是你的話，一定沒有問題的！
dialogsFail.vi: Nghe này, tôi biết thật đáng sợ khi phải đối mặt với Organigor, nhưng tôi tin rằng bạn có thể làm được. Đi ngay!

dialogsBegin.it: Strange Collector needs you to collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ for his collection. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.jp: あるコレクターの方から$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$を集めてほしいとの依頼です。依頼を受けますか？

dialogsBegin.nl: Strange Collector needs you to collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ for his collection. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.pl: Strange Collector needs you to collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ for his collection. Will you help?

dialogsBegin.sw: Strange Collector needs you to collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ for his collection. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.th: นักสะสมของแปลกต้องการให้คุณรวบรวม $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ สำหรับคอลเล็กชันของเขา คุณจะช่วยไหม

dialogsBegin.vi: Strange Collector cần bạn thu thập $ QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME $ cho bộ sưu tập của mình. Bạn sẽ giúp chứ?

dialogsDecline.fi: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsDecline.fil: Ayaw mo bang kolektahin ang mga ito? Sige lang.
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu n'es pas intéressé par cette mission ? Tant pis… Mais si tu changes d'avis, reviens me voir.
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu tidak ingin mengumpulkannya? Oke
dialogsDecline.it: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsDecline.jp: 依頼をキャンセルなさるのですね。あなたならお願い出来ると思ったのですが、残念です。

dialogsDecline.th: คุณไม่ต้องการจะเก็บมันงั้นเรอะ? เข้าใจแล้ว
dialogsDecline.tw: 你不想收集它們嗎？好的。
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn không muốn thu thập chúng? Được thôi.

dialogsComplete.vi: Tốt lắm. Bạn đã hoàn thành nhiệm vụ thành công.

dialogsBegin.en: Oh, Reonan said to return to Flarine after you had completed your duties here. Do not fret about us any longer. Go see Reonan!
dialogsBegin.ar: Oh, Reonan said to return to Flarine after you had completed your duties here. Do not fret about us any longer. Go see Reonan!
dialogsBegin.br: Oh, Reonan disse para retornar a Flarine depois que você tivesse completado seus deveres aqui. Não se preocupe mais conosco. Vá ver Reonan!
dialogsBegin.cns: Oh，瑞尔南说你在这里完成任务后要返回帕里了。不需要再为我们烦恼了。去见瑞尔南吧！
dialogsBegin.de: Oh, Reonan hat gesagt, du sollst nach Flaris zurückkehren, nachdem du deine Pflichten hier erfüllt hast. Mach dir keine Sorgen mehr um uns. Geh zu Reonan!
dialogsBegin.fi: Oh, Reonan said to return to Flarine after you had completed your duties here. Do not fret about us any longer. Go see Reonan!
dialogsBegin.fil: Oh, Reonan said to return to Flarine after you had completed your duties here. Do not fret about us any longer. Go see Reonan!
dialogsBegin.fr: Reonan a dit que vous pouviez retourner à Flarine dès que vous auriez terminé ici. Allez donc le voir.
dialogsBegin.id: Oh, Reonan berkata untuk kembali ke Flarine setelah kamu menyelesaikan tugasmu di sini. Jangan khawatir tentang kita lagi. Pergi temui Reonan!
dialogsBegin.it: Oh, Reonan said to return to Flarine after you had completed your duties here. Do not fret about us any longer. Go see Reonan!
dialogsBegin.jp: レオナンが私の依頼が終わったら戻ってくるようにと言っていましたよ。さあ、ここはもう大丈夫です。どうぞレオナンに貴方の勇士を報告して下さい。
dialogsBegin.kr: 참, 여기 일이 모두 끝나면 서둘러 플라리네로 돌아오라고 레오난이 전하더군요. 이제 여긴 걱정 말고, 어서 레오난에게 가보세요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Oh, Reonan said to return to Flarine after you had completed your duties here. Do not fret about us any longer. Go see Reonan!
dialogsBegin.pl: Oh, Reonan said to return to Flarine after you had completed your duties here. Do not fret about us any longer. Go see Reonan!
dialogsBegin.ru: Максимус просил, чтобы ты вернулся во Фларинцию. Не смею тебя больше задерживать. Удачи!
dialogsBegin.sp: Oh, Reonan dijo que volvieras a Flarine después de que haber completado tus tareas. No te preocupes más por nosotros. ¡Ve a ver a Reonan!
dialogsBegin.sw: Oh, Reonan said to return to Flarine after you had completed your duties here. Do not fret about us any longer. Go see Reonan!
dialogsBegin.th: โอ้ Reonan กล่าวว่าจะกลับไปที่ Flarine หลังจากที่คุณทำหน้าที่ของคุณเสร็จสมบูรณ์แล้ว อย่าหงุดหงิดเลยน่า รีบไปหา Reonan!
dialogsBegin.tw: 對了。雷奧南說這裡的事情結束之後，要你快一點回去布拉里斯。不用在擔心這裡了，快一點回去找雷奧南吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Ồ, Reonan nói hãy trở về Flarine sau khi bạn đã hoàn thành nhiệm vụ của mình ở đây. Đừng băn khoăn về chúng tôi nữa. Đi gặp Reonan ngay nào!

dialogsAccept.en: Thank you for your efforts in Saint City. Your name will be forever praised here. Now, hurry on your way!
dialogsAccept.ar: Thank you for your efforts in Saint City. Your name will be forever praised here. Now, hurry on your way!
dialogsAccept.br: Obrigado por seus esforços na Cidade de Saint. Seu nome será sempre louvado aqui. Agora, continue sua jornada, depressa!
dialogsAccept.cns: 感谢你对晨光的帮助。你的名字将在这里永远被赞美。现在，快点上路吧！
dialogsAccept.de: Ich danke Dir für Deinen Einsatz in Saint City. Dein Name wird hier für immer gepriesen werden. Und jetzt beeile dich auf deinem Weg!
dialogsAccept.fi: Thank you for your efforts in Saint City. Your name will be forever praised here. Now, hurry on your way!
dialogsAccept.fil: Thank you for your efforts in Saint City. Your name will be forever praised here. Now, hurry on your way!
dialogsAccept.fr: Merci de vos efforts pour Saint City. Nous garderons votre nom en nos cœurs pour toujours.
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih atas upaya Anda di Saint City. Namamu akan selamanya dipuji di sini. Sekarang, cepatlah pergi untuk perjalananmu!
dialogsAccept.it: Thank you for your efforts in Saint City. Your name will be forever praised here. Now, hurry on your way!
dialogsAccept.jp: 色々とセイントモーニングを助けて頂きありがとうございました。貴方のお名前は一生忘れません。
dialogsAccept.kr: 그 동안 우리 세인트 시티를 위해 힘써줘서 고맙네. 내 자네 이름은 평생 기억하고 있겠네. 자, 그럼 어서 가보게나.
dialogsAccept.nl: Thank you for your efforts in Saint City. Your name will be forever praised here. Now, hurry on your way!
dialogsAccept.pl: Thank you for your efforts in Saint City. Your name will be forever praised here. Now, hurry on your way!
dialogsAccept.ru: Благодарю тебя за всю твою помощь Санто. Мы тебя не забудем!
dialogsAccept.sp: Gracias por tus esfuerzos en Saint. Tu nombre será recordado para siempre. ¡Ahora, date prisa en seguir por tu camino!
dialogsAccept.sw: Thank you for your efforts in Saint City. Your name will be forever praised here. Now, hurry on your way!
dialogsAccept.th: ขอบคุณสำหรับความพยายามของคุณใน Saint City ชื่อของคุณจะถูกยกย่องตลอดไปที่นี่ รีบไปได้แล้ว!
dialogsAccept.tw: 這段時間，非常謝謝你為了我們聖音特市盡心盡力。我一輩子都不會忘記你的名字的。那麼，快一點過去吧。
dialogsAccept.vi: Cảm ơn bạn vì những nỗ lực của bạn ở Saint City. Tên của bạn sẽ mãi mãi được ca ngợi nơi đây. Bây giờ, tiến bước tiếp con đường của bạn nào!

dialogsDecline.en: Eh? You don't want to go back? Then, plese feel free to join the illustrious ranks of our tourist industry!
dialogsDecline.ar: Eh? You don't want to go back? Then, plese feel free to join the illustrious ranks of our tourist industry!
dialogsDecline.br: Eh? Você não quer voltar? Então, sinta-se à vontade para se juntar às fileiras ilustres da nossa indústria turística!
dialogsDecline.cns: 诶？你不想回去？那么，欢迎随时加入我们哦！
dialogsDecline.de: Was? Sie wollen nicht zurückkehren? Dann können Sie sich gerne in die illustrierten Reihen unserer Tourismusindustrie einreihen!
dialogsDecline.fi: Eh? You don't want to go back? Then, plese feel free to join the illustrious ranks of our tourist industry!
dialogsDecline.fil: Eh? You don't want to go back? Then, plese feel free to join the illustrious ranks of our tourist industry!
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous ne voulez pas repartir à Flarine ? Je comprends que vous vous sentiez bien ici.
dialogsDecline.id: Eh? Anda tidak ingin kembali? Kemudian, jangan ragu untuk bergabung dengan jajaran industri pariwisata kita yang termasyhur!
dialogsDecline.it: Eh? You don't want to go back? Then, plese feel free to join the illustrious ranks of our tourist industry!
dialogsDecline.jp: え、ひょっとしてこのままセイントモーニングの自警団に入って下さるのですか？
dialogsDecline.kr: 음? 레오난에게 돌아가기 싫은 건가? 그럼 평생 여기서 세인트 시티를 위해 봉사해주게.
dialogsDecline.nl: Eh? You don't want to go back? Then, plese feel free to join the illustrious ranks of our tourist industry!
dialogsDecline.pl: Eh? You don't want to go back? Then, plese feel free to join the illustrious ranks of our tourist industry!
dialogsDecline.ru: Eh? You don't want to go back? Then, plese feel free to join the illustrious ranks of our tourist industry!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Eh? ¿No quieres volver? ¡Pues, siéntete libre de unirte a las filas de nuestra industria turística!
dialogsDecline.sw: Eh? You don't want to go back? Then, plese feel free to join the illustrious ranks of our tourist industry!
dialogsDecline.th: เอ๋ ? คุณไม่ต้องการที่จะกลับไป? ถ้างั้น ฉันรู้สึกถึงความเป็นอิสระและอุตสาหกรรมท่องเที่ยวที่มีชื่อเสียง
dialogsDecline.tw: 咦？你不想要回去雷奧南啊？那麼就一輩子在這裡，為了聖音特城做愛心活動吧。
dialogsDecline.vi: Hở? Bạn không muốn quay lại đây sao? Hãy thoải mái tham gia vào hàng ngũ lừng lẫy trong ngành du lịch của chúng tôi!

dialogsComplete.en: I heard of your remarkable activities at Saint City from the Mayor! I have another mission for you... but it's too early right now. Reach level 40, then I will give you the next mission.
dialogsComplete.ar: I heard of your remarkable activities at Saint City from the Mayor! I have another mission for you... but it's too early right now. Reach level 40, then I will give you the next mission.
dialogsComplete.br: Ouvi do Prefeito sobre suas atividades notáveis em Saint! Eu tenho outra missão para você... mas é muito cedo agora. Alcance o nível 40, então eu lhe darei a próxima missão.
dialogsComplete.cns: 我从市长那里听说了您在晨光镇的出色活动！我还有另一个任务要交给你…但现在还为时过早。达到40级，我会给你下一个任务。
dialogsComplete.de: Ich habe vom Bürgermeister von Euren bemerkenswerten Aktivitäten in Saint City gehört! Ich habe eine weitere Mission für Euch... aber es ist noch zu früh. Erreiche Level 40, dann werde ich dir die nächste Mission geben.
dialogsComplete.fi: I heard of your remarkable activities at Saint City from the Mayor! I have another mission for you... but it's too early right now. Reach level 40, then I will give you the next mission.
dialogsComplete.fil: I heard of your remarkable activities at Saint City from the Mayor! I have another mission for you... but it's too early right now. Reach level 40, then I will give you the next mission.
dialogsComplete.fr: Le maire de Saint City vous couvre d'éloges. Vous lui avez vraiment fait une bonne impression. Revenez me voir au niveau 40 pour votre prochaine mission.
dialogsComplete.id: Saya mendengar tentang aktivitas luar biasa Anda di Saint City dari Walikota! Saya punya misi lain untuk Anda ... tapi ini terlalu dini sekarang. Raihlah level 40, maka saya akan memberi Anda misi berikutnya.
dialogsComplete.it: I heard of your remarkable activities at Saint City from the Mayor! I have another mission for you... but it's too early right now. Reach level 40, then I will give you the next mission.
dialogsComplete.jp: おお、戻ったか。セイントモーニングでのお前さんの活躍は風のうわさで聞いたぞ。Lv40に到達すれば次のミッションを話そう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 세인트 시티에서 자네의 활약은 시장을 통해 들었네! 정말 자랑스럽군! 다음 임무를 주고 싶지만.. 아직 자네에게는 이른 것 같군. 40레벨을 달성하고 오게나, 그럼 바로 다음 임무를 내려주겠네.
dialogsComplete.nl: I heard of your remarkable activities at Saint City from the Mayor! I have another mission for you... but it's too early right now. Reach level 40, then I will give you the next mission.
dialogsComplete.pl: I heard of your remarkable activities at Saint City from the Mayor! I have another mission for you... but it's too early right now. Reach level 40, then I will give you the next mission.
dialogsComplete.ru: I heard of your remarkable activities at Saint City from the Mayor! I have another mission for you... but it's too early right now. Reach level 40, then I will give you the next mission.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡El Alcalde me ha explicado tus notables actividades en Saint! Tengo otra misión para ti... pero es demasiado pronto. Alcanza el nivel 40 y te daré la siguiente misión.
dialogsComplete.sw: I heard of your remarkable activities at Saint City from the Mayor! I have another mission for you... but it's too early right now. Reach level 40, then I will give you the next mission.
dialogsComplete.th: ฉันได้ยินมาว่ากิจกรรมของคุณที่ Saint City น่าทึ่งมาก ได้ยินจากนายกเทศมนตรี! ฉันมีภารกิจอื่นให้คุณ ... แต่ตอนนี้อาจเร็วเกินไป รีบเวลให้ถึง 40 แล้วฉันจะให้ภารกิจต่อไป
dialogsComplete.tw: 聖音特城裡都已經透過市長，知道你的活躍了！真的是非常的驕傲！雖然我還想再給你下一個任務…任是對你來說好像還太早。達到 40 級以後，再過來吧。到時候，我會給你下一道的任務。
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi đã nghe Thị trưởng nói về những hoạt động đáng chú ý của bạn tại Saint City! Tôi có một nhiệm vụ khác cho bạn ... nhưng bây giờ còn quá sớm. Đạt cấp 40, sau đó tôi sẽ giao cho bạn nhiệm vụ tiếp theo.

description.en: Go to Saint Hall in Saint City, and meet with Porgo.
description.ar: Go to Saint Hall in Saint City, and meet with Porgo.
description.br: Eu acho que você pode conseguir algumas informações com Porgo, que vive nas proximidades da Prefeitura de Saint. Ele definitivamente saberá de alguma coisa.
description.cns: 晨光圣教堂附近有一个叫做柏洛格的人，他好像知道什么的样子..
description.de: Ich glaube du kannst von Porgo einige Informationen erhalten, er lebt nahe Saint Morning Halle. Er weiß mit Sicherheit etwas.
description.fi: Go to Saint Hall in Saint City, and meet with Porgo.
description.fil: Go to Saint Hall in Saint City, and meet with Porgo.
description.fr: Discuter avec Porgo, qui habite près de Saint Hall, pour obtenir des informations sur les enlèvements.
description.id: Pergi ke Saint Hall di Saint City, dan bertemu dengan Porgo.
description.it: Go to Saint Hall in Saint City, and meet with Porgo.
description.jp: セイントホールの近くに事件をよく知る＜ポルゴ＞という人物がいるらしい。まずは彼に会って、情報を聞いてみよう。
description.kr: 세인트 시티의 세인트 홀로 가서 포르고를 만나세요.
description.nl: Go to Saint Hall in Saint City, and meet with Porgo.
description.pl: Go to Saint Hall in Saint City, and meet with Porgo.
description.ru: Нужно поговорить с Тинкертоном около ратуши Санто.
description.sp: Ves al Ayuntamiento de Saint, y reúnete con Porgo.
description.sw: Go to Saint Hall in Saint City, and meet with Porgo.
description.th: ไปที่ Saint Hall ใน Saint City และพบกับ Porgo
description.tw: 聖音特教堂附近有一個叫做柏洛格的人，他好像知道什麼的樣子…
description.vi: Đi đến Saint Hall ở Saint City, và gặp Porgo.

dialogsBegin.en: Please help me! My daughter has been missing for so long!
dialogsBegin.ar: Please help me! My daughter has been missing for so long!
dialogsBegin.br: Ei! Por favor, me ajude!  Por favor, encontre minha filha. Por favor...
dialogsBegin.cns: 那个!那个!!呜呜..帮我找一下我的女儿好吗?
dialogsBegin.de: Hey! Bitte hilf mir! (weint) Bitte finde meine Tochter. Bitte.. (weint)
dialogsBegin.fi: Please help me! My daughter has been missing for so long!
dialogsBegin.fil: Please help me! My daughter has been missing for so long!
dialogsBegin.fr: Aidez-moi ! (Pleurant) S'il vous plaît, retrouvez ma petite fille. S'il vous plaît.(pleurant)
dialogsBegin.id: Tolong bantu aku! Putriku telah hilang begitu lama!
dialogsBegin.it: Please help me! My daughter has been missing for so long!
dialogsBegin.jp: あの、冒険者の方、お願いがございます！どうか、私の娘…娘を捜してください！ううっ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 도와주세요! 제 딸이 너무 오래, 돌아오지 않고 있어요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Please help me! My daughter has been missing for so long!
dialogsBegin.pl: Please help me! My daughter has been missing for so long!
dialogsBegin.ru: Прошу, помоги мне! Моя дочь пропала!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Por favor, ayúdame! ¡Hace mucho tiempo que mi hija desapareció!
dialogsBegin.sw: Please help me! My daughter has been missing for so long!
dialogsBegin.th: ได้โปรดช่วยฉันด้วยเถอะ! ลูกสาวของฉันหายไปนานแล้ว!
dialogsBegin.tw: 那個！那個！！嗚嗚…幫我找一下我的女兒好嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Làm ơn giúp tôi! Con gái tôi đã mất tích quá lâu!

dialogsBegin.en: My daughter disappeared a few years ago. I have reported her missing to the Public Office and tried to find her myself, but to no avail.
dialogsBegin.ar: My daughter disappeared a few years ago. I have reported her missing to the Public Office and tried to find her myself, but to no avail.
dialogsBegin.br: Minha filha desapareceu há alguns anos. Eu comuniquei o seu dasaparecimento ao gabinete e tentei encontrá-la eu mesma, mas...
dialogsBegin.cns: 我的女儿失踪了好几年了…我找了好几年..但是..
dialogsBegin.de: Meine Tochter verschwand vor ein paar Jahren. Ich habe ihr Verschwinden dem Rathaus mitgeteilt und versucht sie zu finden, aber..
dialogsBegin.fi: My daughter disappeared a few years ago. I have reported her missing to the Public Office and tried to find her myself, but to no avail.
dialogsBegin.fil: My daughter disappeared a few years ago. I have reported her missing to the Public Office and tried to find her myself, but to no avail.
dialogsBegin.fr: Ma fille a disparu il y a quelques années. J'ai fait état de sa disparition à l'office public et essayé de la retrouver toute seule, mais.
dialogsBegin.id: Putriku menghilang beberapa tahun yang lalu. Saya telah melaporkan kehilanganya ke Public Office dan mencoba menemukannya sendiri, tetapi tidak berhasil.
dialogsBegin.it: My daughter disappeared a few years ago. I have reported her missing to the Public Office and tried to find her myself, but to no avail.
dialogsBegin.jp: 私の娘は数年前に突然、失踪してしまったのです。もちろん、シティーホールに失踪届を申告したり、いろいろなところを捜してみたりしたのですが、娘は姿を消したまま今も戻ってきておりません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 몇 년 전에 실종됐어요. 실종 신고도 해보고 직접 찾아도 봤지만 아무 소용이 없었어요...
dialogsBegin.nl: My daughter disappeared a few years ago. I have reported her missing to the Public Office and tried to find her myself, but to no avail.
dialogsBegin.pl: My daughter disappeared a few years ago. I have reported her missing to the Public Office and tried to find her myself, but to no avail.
dialogsBegin.ru: Прошло уже несколько лет… Я и к мэру ходила, и сама ее искала, но Джин как в воду канула…
dialogsBegin.sp: Mi hija desapareció hace unos años. Denuncié su desaparición a la Oficina Pública y traté de encontrarla yo misma, pero fue en vano.
dialogsBegin.sw: My daughter disappeared a few years ago. I have reported her missing to the Public Office and tried to find her myself, but to no avail.
dialogsBegin.th: ลูกสาวของฉันหายตัวไปเมื่อไม่กี่ปีก่อน ฉันได้ไปแจ้งกับ Public Office และพยายามหาเธอด้วยตัวเอง แต่มันก็ไม่ได้ผล
dialogsBegin.tw: 我的女兒幾年前失蹤了。我向城鎮服務處報過案，也親自找了很久，卻始終沒有結果。
dialogsBegin.vi: Con gái tôi đã mất tích cách đây vài năm. Tôi đã báo cáo việc cô ấy mất tích cho Public Office và cố gắng tự tìm kiếm, nhưng vô ích.

dialogsBegin.en: I have done everything I can do so far, but I'm at my wits end. I'm even asking Vagrants for help now!
dialogsBegin.ar: I have done everything I can do so far, but I'm at my wits end. I'm even asking Vagrants for help now!
dialogsBegin.br: Eu fiz tudo o que podia até agora, mas... Mas não pude encontrá-la... Por isso a última coisa que posso fazer agora é pedir a ajuda de Vagrants...
dialogsBegin.cns: 什么方法都是过了..可是..呜呜..可是都找不到..所以我想拜托冒险家…
dialogsBegin.de: Ich habe bisher alles getan, was ich konnte, aber.. ich konnte sie nicht finden.. (weint).. Die letzte Sache die ich tun kann ist Vagrants um Hilfe zu bitten.
dialogsBegin.fi: I have done everything I can do so far, but I'm at my wits end. I'm even asking Vagrants for help now!
dialogsBegin.fil: I have done everything I can do so far, but I'm at my wits end. I'm even asking Vagrants for help now!
dialogsBegin.fr: J'ai vraiment fait tout ce que je pouvais, mais... Mais je n'ai pas réussi à la retrouver...(pleurant)... Mon dernier espoir est de demander aux Vagabonds de m'aider.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya telah melakukan semua yang bisa saya lakukan sejauh ini, tetapi saya kehabisan akal. Aku bahkan meminta bantuan Vagrants sekarang!
dialogsBegin.it: I have done everything I can do so far, but I'm at my wits end. I'm even asking Vagrants for help now!
dialogsBegin.jp: 娘を探すため、できることは全て尽くしましたが見つからないのです。わらにもすがる思いで、冒険者の方々にお願いをしています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 할 수 있는 건 다 해봤어요. 이제는… 방랑자에게까지 도움을 청하고 있네요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I have done everything I can do so far, but I'm at my wits end. I'm even asking Vagrants for help now!
dialogsBegin.pl: I have done everything I can do so far, but I'm at my wits end. I'm even asking Vagrants for help now!
dialogsBegin.ru: Я уже не знаю, к кому и обратиться… Видишь, даже бродяг о помощи прошу!
dialogsBegin.sp: He hecho todo lo que he podido, pero estoy desesperada. ¡Incluso le estoy pidiendo ayuda a los Vagrants!
dialogsBegin.sw: I have done everything I can do so far, but I'm at my wits end. I'm even asking Vagrants for help now!
dialogsBegin.th: ตลอดเวลาที่ผ่านมาฉันทำทุกอย่างเท่าที่ฉันสามารถทำได้แล้ว แต่ฉันจนปัญญาแล้วล่ะ แม้กระทั่งขอร้องให้ Vagrants ช่วยเหลือฉันก็จะทำ!
dialogsBegin.tw: 什麼方法都試過了…可是…嗚嗚…可是都找不到…所以我想拜託冒險家…
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đã làm mọi thứ tôi có thể làm, nhưng tôi bó tay. Tôi thậm chí đang yêu cầu Vagrant giúp đỡ ngay bây giờ!

dialogsBegin.en: Please, will you help me find my daughter?
dialogsBegin.ar: Please, will you help me find my daughter?
dialogsBegin.br: Por favor. Por favor, encontre minha filha. Por favor...
dialogsBegin.cns: 拜托..请帮我找我的女儿好吗?拜托..呜呜..
dialogsBegin.de: Bitte.. Bitte finde meine Tochter.. Bitte.. (weint)
dialogsBegin.fi: Please, will you help me find my daughter?
dialogsBegin.fil: Please, will you help me find my daughter?
dialogsBegin.fr: S'il vous plaît. partez à la recherche de ma fille... s'il vous plaît. (pleurant)
dialogsBegin.id: Tolong, maukah kamu membantu saya menemukan putriku?
dialogsBegin.it: Please, will you help me find my daughter?
dialogsBegin.jp: どうか、どうか私の娘を捜してください。お願いします！涙が…お見苦しいところをお見せしてしまってすみません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 제발, 제 딸을 찾아주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Please, will you help me find my daughter?
dialogsBegin.pl: Please, will you help me find my daughter?
dialogsBegin.ru: Ты не откажешь мне, правда?
dialogsBegin.sp: Por favor, ¿me ayudarás a encontrar a mi hija?
dialogsBegin.sw: Please, will you help me find my daughter?
dialogsBegin.th: ได้โปรดเถอะ คุณช่วยตามหาลูกสาวให้ฉันหน่อยได้ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 拜託…請幫我找我的女兒好嗎？拜託…嗚嗚…
dialogsBegin.vi: Làm ơn, bạn sẽ giúp tôi tìm thấy con gái tôi?

dialogsAccept.en: Thank you. I think you can obtain some information from Porgo, who lives in nearby Saint Hall. He will definitely know something.
dialogsAccept.ar: Thank you. I think you can obtain some information from Porgo, who lives in nearby Saint Hall. He will definitely know something.
dialogsAccept.br: Obrigado, obrigado. Acho que você consegue obter algumas informações com Porgo, que vive nas proximidades da Prefeitura de Saint. Ele definitivamente saberá de alguma coisa.
dialogsAccept.cns: 谢谢你..真的谢谢你…晨光圣教堂附近有一个叫做柏洛格的人，他好像知道什么的样子..
dialogsAccept.de: Danke, danke. Ich glaube du kannst von Porgo einige Informationen erhalten, er lebt nahe Saint Morning Halle. Er weiß mit Sicherheit etwas.
dialogsAccept.fi: Thank you. I think you can obtain some information from Porgo, who lives in nearby Saint Hall. He will definitely know something.
dialogsAccept.fil: Thank you. I think you can obtain some information from Porgo, who lives in nearby Saint Hall. He will definitely know something.
dialogsAccept.fr: Merci infiniment. Je pense que vous pourrez obtenir des informations auprès de Porgo, qui habite près de Saint Hall. Oui, il devrait pourra nous fournir des renseignements.
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih. Saya pikir kamu dapat memperoleh beberapa informasi dari Porgo, yang tinggal di Saint Hall terdekat. Dia pasti mengetahui sesuatu.
dialogsAccept.it: Thank you. I think you can obtain some information from Porgo, who lives in nearby Saint Hall. He will definitely know something.
dialogsAccept.jp: 娘を捜してくださるのですか！ありがとうございます！ではセイントホールの近くに＜ポルゴ＞という人がいます。その人が何かを知っているはずなので、たずねてみてください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 고맙습니다. 세인트 홀 근처에 포르고라는 사람이 있어요. 그를 만나면 뭔가 알고 있을 거예요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Thank you. I think you can obtain some information from Porgo, who lives in nearby Saint Hall. He will definitely know something.
dialogsAccept.pl: Thank you. I think you can obtain some information from Porgo, who lives in nearby Saint Hall. He will definitely know something.
dialogsAccept.ru: Спасибо. Пожалуйста, поговори с Патом Тинкертоном около ратуши Санто. Он - единственный, кто верит, что Джин вернется…
dialogsAccept.sp: Gracias. Creo que podrás obtener algo de información de Porgo, que vive en las cercanías del Ayuntamiento de Saint. Seguro que sabrá algo.
dialogsAccept.sw: Thank you. I think you can obtain some information from Porgo, who lives in nearby Saint Hall. He will definitely know something.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอบคุณนะ ฉันคิดว่าคุณสามารถดูข้อมูลเพิ่มเติมได้จาก Porgo ที่อาศัยอยู่ใกล้ๆ กับ Saint Hall เขารู้อะไรบางอย่างแน่นอน
dialogsAccept.tw: 謝謝你…真的謝謝你…聖音特教堂附近有一個叫做柏洛格的人，他好像知道什麼的樣子…
dialogsAccept.vi: Cảm ơn bạn. Tôi nghĩ bạn có thể lấy một số thông tin từ Porgo, người sống ở Saint Hall. Anh ấy chắc chắn sẽ biết điều gì đó.

dialogsComplete.en: Hmm... JeongHwa has not given up on finding her daughter yet. What a pity, but her daughter is not the only child who has disappeared recently.
dialogsComplete.ar: Hmm... JeongHwa has not given up on finding her daughter yet. What a pity, but her daughter is not the only child who has disappeared recently.
dialogsComplete.br: Hmm... Jeong Hwa ainda não desistiu de encontrar sua filha. É uma pena, mas a filha dela não é a única criança que desapareceu recentemente.
dialogsComplete.cns: 额…吉哈娃还没放弃寻找她的女儿啊。太遗憾了，不过在最近，她的女儿并不是这儿唯一丢失的孩子。
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm.. Natalie hat noch nicht aufgegeben ihre Tochter zu finden. Was für eine Schande, aber ihre Tochter ist nicht das einzige Kind das zu jener Zeit verschwunden ist.
dialogsComplete.fi: Hmm... JeongHwa has not given up on finding her daughter yet. What a pity, but her daughter is not the only child who has disappeared recently.
dialogsComplete.fil: Hmm... JeongHwa has not given up on finding her daughter yet. What a pity, but her daughter is not the only child who has disappeared recently.
dialogsComplete.fr: Hmm.. Junghwa n'a toujours pas abandonné l'espoir de retrouver sa fille. Que c'est triste, mais sa fille n'est pas la seule à avoir disparu.
dialogsComplete.id: Hmm... JeongHwa belum menyerah untuk menemukan putrinya. Sayang sekali, tetapi putrinya bukan satu-satunya anak yang menghilang baru-baru ini.
dialogsComplete.it: Hmm... JeongHwa has not given up on finding her daughter yet. What a pity, but her daughter is not the only child who has disappeared recently.
dialogsComplete.jp: ジョハさんの頼みでやってきたのかい？かわいそうなジョハさん、まだ娘さんを忘れられないのだろう。実をいうと、その当時失踪した子どもはジョハさんの娘さんだけではないんだ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 흠... 정화는 아직도 포기하지 않고 딸을 찾고 있어요. 정말 불쌍하죠. 하지만 최근 정화의 딸만 실종된 게 아니에요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Hmm... JeongHwa has not given up on finding her daughter yet. What a pity, but her daughter is not the only child who has disappeared recently.
dialogsComplete.pl: Hmm... JeongHwa has not given up on finding her daughter yet. What a pity, but her daughter is not the only child who has disappeared recently.
dialogsComplete.ru: Hmm... JeongHwa has not given up on finding her daughter yet. What a pity, but her daughter is not the only child who has disappeared recently.
dialogsComplete.sp: Hmm... JeongHwa aún no ha renunciado a encontrar a su hija. Qué pena, pero su hija no es la única niña que ha desaparecido recientemente.
dialogsComplete.sw: Hmm... JeongHwa has not given up on finding her daughter yet. What a pity, but her daughter is not the only child who has disappeared recently.
dialogsComplete.th: อืม... จองฮวายังไม่ยอมแพ้ในการตามหาลูกสาวของเธอ น่าเสียดาย แต่ลูกสาวของเธอไม่ใช่ลูกคนเดียวที่หายตัวไปเมื่อไม่นานนี้
dialogsComplete.tw: 嗯…真華松她還沒放棄找她的女兒啊，好可憐啊！那時候失蹤的孩子，不是只有她的女兒啦。
dialogsComplete.vi: Hừm ... Jeong Hwa vẫn chưa từ bỏ việc tìm kiếm con gái của mình. Tiếc thật, nhưng con gái bà không phải là đứa trẻ duy nhất mất tích trong thời gian gần đây.

dialogsComplete.en: Lots of the girls from Saint City disappeared. I formed a citizen investigation team, but we failed to discover any clues.
dialogsComplete.ar: Lots of the girls from Saint City disappeared. I formed a citizen investigation team, but we failed to discover any clues.
dialogsComplete.br: Várias garotas da cidade desapareceram. Formei uma equipe de cidadãos para investigar, mas não conseguimos descobrir nenhuma pista.
dialogsComplete.cns: 晨光的所有女孩，几乎全部失踪了，我虽然组了一个团体带领了一群人去找，但是连一个线索都找不到..
dialogsComplete.de: Die meisten Mädchen aus Saint Morning sind verschwunden. Danach gründete ich ein ziviles Untersuchungsteam, aber wir scheiterten.
dialogsComplete.fi: Lots of the girls from Saint City disappeared. I formed a citizen investigation team, but we failed to discover any clues.
dialogsComplete.fil: Lots of the girls from Saint City disappeared. I formed a citizen investigation team, but we failed to discover any clues.
dialogsComplete.fr: La plupart des petites filles de Saint Morning ont disparu en fait. J'ai donc formé un groupe de recherche avec d'autres habitants, mais nous n'avons pas réussi à trouver quelque preuve que ce soit.
dialogsComplete.id: Banyak gadis dari Saint City menghilang. Saya membentuk sebuah tim investigasi, tetapi kami gagal menemukan petunjuk apa pun.
dialogsComplete.it: Lots of the girls from Saint City disappeared. I formed a citizen investigation team, but we failed to discover any clues.
dialogsComplete.jp: 奇妙なことにジョハさんの娘だけでなく、セイントモーニングに住む小さな女の子が多数失踪したんだ。その事件以降、セイントモーニングの住民が団体を作って事件を調査していたが、事件解決の糸口は、何も見つけられなかった。
dialogsComplete.kr: 세인트 시티에서 수많은 여자아이가 사라졌어요. 부랴부랴 수사대를 꾸렸지만, 단서 하나 찾지 못했죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: Lots of the girls from Saint City disappeared. I formed a citizen investigation team, but we failed to discover any clues.
dialogsComplete.pl: Lots of the girls from Saint City disappeared. I formed a citizen investigation team, but we failed to discover any clues.
dialogsComplete.ru: Несколько лет назад в Санто начали пропадать девочки. Я собрал группу поиска, пытался провести расследование, но так ничего и не нашел.
dialogsComplete.sp: Han desaparecido muchas de las niñas de Saint. Formé un equipo de investigación ciudadana, pero no logramos descubrir nada.
dialogsComplete.sw: Lots of the girls from Saint City disappeared. I formed a citizen investigation team, but we failed to discover any clues.
dialogsComplete.th: เหล่าเด็กหญิงมากมายจากเมือง Saint City หายตัวไป ฉันตั้งทีมสืบสวนในเมืองขึ้นมา แต่เราก็ไม่เจอเบาะแสอะไรเลย
dialogsComplete.tw: 聖音特的所有女孩，幾乎全部失蹤了，我雖然組了一個團體帶領了一群人去找，但是連一個線索都找不到…
dialogsComplete.vi: Rất nhiều cô gái từ Saint City đã biến mất. Tôi đã thành lập một nhóm điều tra công dân, nhưng chúng tôi không phát hiện ra bất kỳ manh mối nào.

dialogsComplete.en: Now I am the only one left from the team, but I am still investigating the case because we'd like to bring those kids home.
dialogsComplete.ar: Now I am the only one left from the team, but I am still investigating the case because we'd like to bring those kids home.
dialogsComplete.br: Agora, eu fui o único que restou na equipe, mas ainda estou investigando o caso, pois ele é muito suspeito.
dialogsComplete.cns: 虽然这个组织里现在只剩下我一个人，我现在还是在调查，因为有很多疑问是很不能了解的。
dialogsComplete.de: Ich bin das einzige Überbleibsel des Teams, aber ich untersuche den Fall immernoch weil er immernoch sehr verdächtig ist.
dialogsComplete.fi: Now I am the only one left from the team, but I am still investigating the case because we'd like to bring those kids home.
dialogsComplete.fil: Now I am the only one left from the team, but I am still investigating the case because we'd like to bring those kids home.
dialogsComplete.fr: Maintenant je suis le dernier à poursuivre les recherches. Je continue d'étudier ce qui s'est passé et ça reste très étrange.
dialogsComplete.id: Sekarang saya satu-satunya yang tersisa dari tim, tetapi saya masih menyelidiki kasus ini karena kami ingin membawa pulang anak-anak itu.
dialogsComplete.it: Now I am the only one left from the team, but I am still investigating the case because we'd like to bring those kids home.
dialogsComplete.jp: あれから何年も経って、今もこの事件を調査しているのは、俺1人だけさ。しかし、俺はまだ調査を続けるつもりだ。なにしろこの事件には疑わしい点が多すぎるんだ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이제 남은 팀원은 저 하나뿐이지만, 전 아직 조사를 이어가고 있어요. 언젠가는 아이들을 집으로 보내주고 싶거든요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Now I am the only one left from the team, but I am still investigating the case because we'd like to bring those kids home.
dialogsComplete.pl: Now I am the only one left from the team, but I am still investigating the case because we'd like to bring those kids home.
dialogsComplete.ru: Шли месяцы, и горожане махнули на поиски рукой, но я до сих пор не собираюсь сдаваться - дети должны вернуться домой.
dialogsComplete.sp: Ahora soy el único que queda del equipo, pero todavía estoy investigando el caso porque nos gustaría traer a esas niñas de vuelta a casa.
dialogsComplete.sw: Now I am the only one left from the team, but I am still investigating the case because we'd like to bring those kids home.
dialogsComplete.th: ตอนนี้ฉันเป็นคนเดียวที่เหลืออยู่ในทีม แต่ฉันก็ยังคงสืบสวนคดีนี้ต่อไป เพราะเราต้องการพาเด็กเหล่านี้กลับบ้านของพวกเขา
dialogsComplete.tw: 雖然這個組織裡現在只剩下我一個人，我現在還是在調查，因為有很多疑問是很不能了解的。
dialogsComplete.vi: Bây giờ tôi là người duy nhất còn lại trong đội, nhưng tôi vẫn đang điều tra vụ việc vì chúng tôi muốn đưa những đứa trẻ đó về nhà.

dialogsFail.en: I am the leader of the investigation team that was investigating the missing children. But now, I am the only one left...
dialogsFail.ar: I am the leader of the investigation team that was investigating the missing children. But now, I am the only one left...
dialogsFail.br: Sou o líder da equipe de investigação que estava responsável pelo caso das crianças desaparecidas. Mas agora sou o único que restou...
dialogsFail.cns: 我是跳查晨光儿童失踪协会的会长，虽然现在只剩下我一个人..
dialogsFail.de: Ich bin der Leiter des Untersuchungsteams das verantwortlich für die Suche der entführten Kinder aus Saint Morning war, jetzt bin ich der einzige der übrig geblieben ist.. Phew..
dialogsFail.fi: I am the leader of the investigation team that was investigating the missing children. But now, I am the only one left...
dialogsFail.fil: I am the leader of the investigation team that was investigating the missing children. But now, I am the only one left...
dialogsFail.fr: Cependant étant le dernier membre du groupe de recherche, cela ne me facilite pas la tâche.
dialogsFail.id: Saya adalah pemimpin tim investigasi yang menyelidiki anak-anak yang hilang. Tapi sekarang, hanya aku yang tersisa...
dialogsFail.it: I am the leader of the investigation team that was investigating the missing children. But now, I am the only one left...
dialogsFail.jp: 俺は数年前にセイントモーニングで起きた女児失踪事件を調査している＜セイント連続女児失踪事件・特別市民調査団体＞の会長だ。まぁ、今は1人だけの団体だがね。
dialogsFail.kr: 저는 실종된 아이들을 조사하던 수사팀의 팀장이었어요. 하지만 이제는 저 혼자만 남았네요...
dialogsFail.nl: I am the leader of the investigation team that was investigating the missing children. But now, I am the only one left...
dialogsFail.pl: I am the leader of the investigation team that was investigating the missing children. But now, I am the only one left...
dialogsFail.ru: Я возглавлял группу добровольцев, искавших пропавших девочек. Теперь я ее единственный участник...
dialogsFail.sp: Soy el líder del equipo de investigación que estaba investigando a las niñas desaparecidas. Pero ahora, soy el único que queda...
dialogsFail.sw: I am the leader of the investigation team that was investigating the missing children. But now, I am the only one left...
dialogsFail.th: ฉันเป็นหัวหน้าของทีมสืบสวนที่ตามหาเด็กที่หายไป แต่ตอนนี้ฉันเป็นคนเดียวที่เหลืออยู่ในทีม...
dialogsFail.tw: 我是調查聖音特兒童失蹤協會的會長，雖然現在只剩下我一個人…
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi là trưởng nhóm điều tra, đang điều tra những đứa trẻ mất tích. Nhưng bây giờ, tôi là người duy nhất còn lại ...

description.cns: 猎杀30个熔岩石魔，获得地狱之石，然后和卡帕菲谈谈。

description.fil: Hunt 30 Captain Kern, acquire the Infernal Stone, then talk with Capafe.
