description.tw: 擊敗 30 隻爆炎王並取得地獄之石，然後與卡班沛交談。
description.vi: Săn 30 Captain Kern, lấy được Infernal Stone, sau đó nói chuyện với Capafe.

dialogsBegin.en: In order to complete the process required to create a Shard of Enlightenment, we must first acquire an Infernal Stone
dialogsBegin.ar: In order to complete the process required to create a Shard of Enlightenment, we must first acquire an Infernal Stone
dialogsBegin.br: Para concluir o processo necessário para criar um Fragmento de Iluminação, primeiro devemos adquirir uma Pedra Infernal.
dialogsBegin.cns: 为了制作启迪碎片，我们首先需要获得一块地狱之石
dialogsBegin.de: Um einen Shard of Enlightenment zu erschaffen, müssen wir zunächst einen Infernal Stone erwerben
dialogsBegin.fi: In order to complete the process required to create a Shard of Enlightenment, we must first acquire an Infernal Stone
dialogsBegin.fil: In order to complete the process required to create a Shard of Enlightenment, we must first acquire an Infernal Stone
dialogsBegin.fr: A présent, vous aurez besoin d'une orbe de fierté.
dialogsBegin.id: Untuk menyelesaikan proses yang diperlukan untuk membuat Shard of Enlightenment, pertama-tama kita harus memperoleh Infernal Stone
dialogsBegin.it: In order to complete the process required to create a Shard of Enlightenment, we must first acquire an Infernal Stone
dialogsBegin.jp: さあ、次は媒介となる石を探す必要があります。おおもととなる石はケルンが持っているはずです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 깨달음의 조각은 긍지가 깃들어 있는 돌이 있어야 만들 수 있답니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: In order to complete the process required to create a Shard of Enlightenment, we must first acquire an Infernal Stone
dialogsBegin.pl: In order to complete the process required to create a Shard of Enlightenment, we must first acquire an Infernal Stone
dialogsBegin.ru: In order to complete the process required to create a Shard of Enlightenment, we must first acquire an Infernal Stone
dialogsBegin.sp: Para completar el proceso de crear un Fragmento de la Iluminación, primero debemos conseguir una Piedra Infernal.
dialogsBegin.sw: In order to complete the process required to create a Shard of Enlightenment, we must first acquire an Infernal Stone
dialogsBegin.th: เพื่อที่จะทำให้เสร็จขั้นตอนที่จำเป็นในการสร้าง Shard of Enlightenment เราต้องได้รับหิน Infernal ก่อน
dialogsBegin.tw: 若要完成啟蒙碎片的製作程序，我們必須先取得一顆地獄之石。
dialogsBegin.vi: Để hoàn thành quá trình cần thiết để tạo Shard of Enlightenment, trước tiên chúng ta phải có được viên đá Infernal Stone

dialogsBegin.en: Please defeat 30 Captain Kerns and acquire the Infernal Stone which should be located somewhere around them.
dialogsBegin.ar: Please defeat 30 Captain Kerns and acquire the Infernal Stone which should be located somewhere around them.
dialogsBegin.br: Por favor, derrote 30 Capitães Kerns e adquira a Pedra Infernal que deve estar localizada em algum lugar ao redor deles.
dialogsBegin.cns: 请击败 30 个熔岩石魔并获得位于他们周围某处的地狱之石。
dialogsBegin.de: Besiege 30 Captain Kerns und erhalte den Infernal Stone, der sich irgendwo in ihrer Nähe befinden sollte.
dialogsBegin.fi: Please defeat 30 Captain Kerns and acquire the Infernal Stone which should be located somewhere around them.
dialogsBegin.fil: Please defeat 30 Captain Kerns and acquire the Infernal Stone which should be located somewhere around them.
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous en trouverez sur le territoire des Kerns. Evidemment, il faudra l'arracher aux griffes de 30 Capitaines Kern.
dialogsBegin.id: Tolong kalahkan 30 Captain Kerns dan dapatkan Infernal Stone yang seharusnya terletak di suatu tempat di sekitar mereka.
dialogsBegin.it: Please defeat 30 Captain Kerns and acquire the Infernal Stone which should be located somewhere around them.
dialogsBegin.jp: キャプテン・ケルンを倒した後、その周辺に落ちている気功石を入手してカパぺに持って行ってください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 두목 케른 30마리를 처치하고 긍지의 돌을 찾아 카파페를 찾아가세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Please defeat 30 Captain Kerns and acquire the Infernal Stone which should be located somewhere around them.
dialogsBegin.pl: Please defeat 30 Captain Kerns and acquire the Infernal Stone which should be located somewhere around them.
dialogsBegin.ru: Please defeat 30 Captain Kerns and acquire the Infernal Stone which should be located somewhere around them.
dialogsBegin.sp: Derrota a 30 Kerns Capitanes y consigue la Piedra Infernal que debería estar alrededor de ellos.
dialogsBegin.sw: Please defeat 30 Captain Kerns and acquire the Infernal Stone which should be located somewhere around them.
dialogsBegin.th: โปรดกำจัด 30 Captain Kerns และจะได้รับหิน Infernal ซึ่งมันอยู่รอบ ๆ ตัว
dialogsBegin.tw: 請擊敗 30 隻爆炎王，並在牠們附近找出地獄之石。
dialogsBegin.vi: Hãy đánh bại 30 Captain Kerns và lấy Viên đá Infernal Stone, viên đá này sẽ được đặt ở đâu đó xung quanh họ.

dialogsAccept.en: Great! Once you have acquired the Infernal Stone, take it to Capafe and ask about the next step of the process.
dialogsAccept.ar: Great! Once you have acquired the Infernal Stone, take it to Capafe and ask about the next step of the process.
dialogsAccept.br: Excelente! Depois de adquirir a Pedra Infernal, leve-a para Capafe e pergunte sobre o próximo passo do processo.
dialogsAccept.cns: 太棒了！一旦你获得了地狱之石，就把它带给卡帕菲，然后询问下一步的过程。
dialogsAccept.de: Großartig! Sobald du den Infernal Stone erworben haben, bringe es zu Capafe und fragen ihn nach dem nächsten Schritt des Prozesses.
dialogsAccept.fi: Great! Once you have acquired the Infernal Stone, take it to Capafe and ask about the next step of the process.
dialogsAccept.fil: Great! Once you have acquired the Infernal Stone, take it to Capafe and ask about the next step of the process.
dialogsAccept.fr: Une fois vaincus, dérobez l'orbe du coffre et apportez-la à Capafe. Elle vous attend.
dialogsAccept.id: Hebat! Setelah Anda mendapatkan Infernal Stone, bawa ke Capafe dan tanyakan tentang langkah selanjutnya dari proses tersebut.
dialogsAccept.it: Great! Once you have acquired the Infernal Stone, take it to Capafe and ask about the next step of the process.
dialogsAccept.jp: そうすれば悟りの石を手に入れられると思います。
dialogsAccept.kr: 좋습니다! 긍지의 돌을 손에 넣고 나면, 카파페에게 가서 앞으로 어떻게 해야 하는지 물어보세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Great! Once you have acquired the Infernal Stone, take it to Capafe and ask about the next step of the process.
dialogsAccept.pl: Great! Once you have acquired the Infernal Stone, take it to Capafe and ask about the next step of the process.
dialogsAccept.ru: Great! Once you have acquired the Infernal Stone, take it to Capafe and ask about the next step of the process.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Genial! Una vez que hayas conseguido la Piedra Infernal, llévasela a Capafe y pregúntale sobre el siguiente paso del proceso.
dialogsAccept.sw: Great! Once you have acquired the Infernal Stone, take it to Capafe and ask about the next step of the process.
dialogsAccept.th: เยี่ยม! เมื่อคุณได้รับหิน Infernal แล้ว ให้นำไปให้ Capafe และถามเกี่ยวกับขั้นตอนต่อไป
dialogsAccept.tw: 很好！取得地獄之石後，把它帶給卡班沛，並詢問下一個步驟。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tuyệt quá! Khi bạn đã có được Infernal Stone, hãy mang nó đến Capafe và hỏi về bước tiếp theo của quy trình.

dialogsDecline.en: If you wish Sury to return to her original state, this is the only way.
dialogsDecline.ar: If you wish Sury to return to her original state, this is the only way.
dialogsDecline.br: Se você deseja que Sury retorne ao seu estado original, esta é a única maneira.
dialogsDecline.cns: 如果你希望叙里恢复到初始状态，这是唯一的办法。
dialogsDecline.de: Wenn du möchtest, dass Sury in ihren ursprünglichen Zustand zurückkehrt, ist dies die einzige Möglichkeit.
dialogsDecline.fi: If you wish Sury to return to her original state, this is the only way.
dialogsDecline.fil: If you wish Sury to return to her original state, this is the only way.
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous n'avez pas le droit de vous arrêter si tôt !
dialogsDecline.id: Jika Anda ingin Sury kembali ke keadaan semula, ini adalah satu-satunya cara.
dialogsDecline.it: If you wish Sury to return to her original state, this is the only way.
dialogsDecline.jp: そうですか。残念ですね……。
dialogsDecline.kr: 슈리님을 원래 상태로 돌리려면, 이 방법밖에 없습니다.
dialogsDecline.nl: If you wish Sury to return to her original state, this is the only way.
dialogsDecline.pl: If you wish Sury to return to her original state, this is the only way.
dialogsDecline.ru: If you wish Sury to return to her original state, this is the only way.
dialogsDecline.sp: Si quieres que Sury vuelva a su estado original, esta es la única forma.
dialogsDecline.sw: If you wish Sury to return to her original state, this is the only way.
dialogsDecline.th: ถ้าคุณต้องการให้ Sury กลับสู่ร่างเดิมของเธอ นี่!! เป็นวิธีเดียวเท่านั้น
dialogsDecline.tw: 如果討厭，就沒有辦法了。但是這樣子，修利大人就無法獲得領悟了…
dialogsDecline.vi: Nếu bạn mong muốn Sury trở lại trạng thái ban đầu thì đây là cách duy nhất.

dialogsComplete.en: I have been waiting for you. I see that you have acquired an Infernal Stone.
dialogsComplete.ar: I have been waiting for you. I see that you have acquired an Infernal Stone.
dialogsComplete.br: Eu estive esperando por você. Vejo que você adquiriu uma Pedra Infernal.
dialogsComplete.cns: 我一直在等你。我想你已经拿到了一块地狱之石。
dialogsComplete.de: Ich habe auf dich gewartet. Ich sehe, dass du einen Infernal Stone erworben hast.
dialogsComplete.fi: I have been waiting for you. I see that you have acquired an Infernal Stone.
dialogsComplete.fil: I have been waiting for you. I see that you have acquired an Infernal Stone.
dialogsComplete.fr: Vous voilà enfin. Je m'inquiétais.
dialogsComplete.id: Aku telah menunggumu. Saya melihat bahwa Anda telah memperoleh Infernal Stone.
dialogsComplete.it: I have been waiting for you. I see that you have acquired an Infernal Stone.
dialogsComplete.jp: あら、これは気功石ですね。待ってました！
dialogsComplete.kr: 기다리고 있었습니다. 긍지의 돌을 손에 넣으셨군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: I have been waiting for you. I see that you have acquired an Infernal Stone.
dialogsComplete.pl: I have been waiting for you. I see that you have acquired an Infernal Stone.
dialogsComplete.ru: I have been waiting for you. I see that you have acquired an Infernal Stone.
dialogsComplete.sp: Te he estado esperando. Veo que has conseguido una Piedra Infernal.
dialogsComplete.sw: I have been waiting for you. I see that you have acquired an Infernal Stone.
dialogsComplete.th: ฉันรอคุณอยู่ ฉันเห็นว่าคุณซื้อหิน Infernal แล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 我一直在等你。看來你已經取得地獄之石了。
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi vẫn đang đợi bạn. Tôi thấy rằng bạn đã có được một Viên đá Infernal Stone.

dialogsFail.en: Please hurry, I'm sure Capafe is waiting for us!
dialogsFail.ar: Please hurry, I'm sure Capafe is waiting for us!
dialogsFail.br: Por favor, apresse-se, tenho certeza que Capafe está esperando por nós!
dialogsFail.cns: 请快点！我确信卡帕菲正在等我们！
dialogsFail.de: Bitte beeil dich, ich bin sicher, dass Capafe auf uns wartet!

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.

dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.

dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Ah~! You're the one lookin for that hero! Figured you were here to try some of my world famous cuisine!
dialogsBegin.ar: Ah~! You're the one lookin for that hero! Figured you were here to try some of my world famous cuisine!
dialogsBegin.br: Ah~! Você é a pessoa que está procurando a guerreira! Achei que você estava aqui para experimentar um pouco da minha cozinha mundialmente famosa!
dialogsBegin.cns: 啊~！你是那个寻找那个英雄的人！以为你是来尝试我的一些世界著名美食！
dialogsBegin.de: Ah~! Du bist derjenige, der nach dem Helden sucht! Ich dachte, du wärst hier, um meine weltberühmte Küche zu probieren!
dialogsBegin.fi: Ah~! You're the one lookin for that hero! Figured you were here to try some of my world famous cuisine!
dialogsBegin.fil: Ah~! You're the one lookin for that hero! Figured you were here to try some of my world famous cuisine!
dialogsBegin.fr: Ah !! Vous cherchez un Héros. Et moi qui pensais que vous veniez de loin pour ma cuisine.
dialogsBegin.id: Ah~! Andalah yang mencari pahlawan itu! Anda pikir Anda ada di sini untuk mencoba beberapa masakan saya yang terkenal di dunia!
dialogsBegin.it: Ah~! You're the one lookin for that hero! Figured you were here to try some of my world famous cuisine!
dialogsBegin.jp: え？　英雄を探している？　なあんだ。オイラの料理には興味がないのか。
dialogsBegin.kr: 아, 영웅을 찾고 계신 분이군요! 전 세계적으로 유명한 제 요리를 맛보러 오신 분인 줄 알았는데 말이죠!
dialogsBegin.nl: Ah~! You're the one lookin for that hero! Figured you were here to try some of my world famous cuisine!
dialogsBegin.pl: Ah~! You're the one lookin for that hero! Figured you were here to try some of my world famous cuisine!
dialogsBegin.ru: Ah~! You're the one lookin for that hero! Figured you were here to try some of my world famous cuisine!
dialogsBegin.sp: Ah~! ¡Tú eres el que busca a esa héroe! ¡Pensaba que estabas aquí para probar algo de mi cocina mundialmente famosa!
dialogsBegin.sw: Ah~! You're the one lookin for that hero! Figured you were here to try some of my world famous cuisine!
dialogsBegin.th: Ah ~! คุณเป็นคนที่มองหาฮีโร่ตัวนี้! คิดว่าคุณอยู่ที่นี่เพื่อลองอาหารที่มีชื่อเสียงของโลก!
dialogsBegin.tw: 啊~！你正在找英雄嗎？我以為你是在找吃的東西呢…
dialogsBegin.vi: Ah ~! Bạn là người tìm kiếm anh hùng đó sao! Được biết bạn đã ở đây để thử một số món ăn nổi tiếng thế giới của tôi!

dialogsBegin.en: Haven't heard of me!? Well you my friend, must have been living under a pretty big rock for some time.
dialogsBegin.ar: Haven't heard of me!? Well you my friend, must have been living under a pretty big rock for some time.
dialogsBegin.br: Nunca ouviu falar de mim!? Bem, você amigo(a), deve ter acordado de um coma depois de muito tempo, né?!
dialogsBegin.cns: 没听说过我！？我的朋友，你一定在地底世界下生活了一段时间
dialogsBegin.de: Absolut! Wir, die Khan Handelsgilde, sind für unsere hochwertigen Nahrungsmittel bekannt.
dialogsBegin.fi: Haven't heard of me!? Well you my friend, must have been living under a pretty big rock for some time.
dialogsBegin.fil: Haven't heard of me!? Well you my friend, must have been living under a pretty big rock for some time.
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais bien entendu, ma cuisine est renommée dans tout Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.id: Belum pernah mendengar tentang saya!? Nah, temanku, pasti sudah hidup di bawah batu yang cukup besar selama beberapa waktu.
dialogsBegin.it: Haven't heard of me!? Well you my friend, must have been living under a pretty big rock for some time.
dialogsBegin.jp: ん？　オイラ達は最高級の料理を提供することで有名なんだ。でもいま食材が足りなくなってしまってね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 저를 모르신다고요!? 그런 말을 하다니, 그동안 세상과 단절되어 바위 밑에라도 살았던 건가요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Haven't heard of me!? Well you my friend, must have been living under a pretty big rock for some time.
dialogsBegin.pl: Haven't heard of me!? Well you my friend, must have been living under a pretty big rock for some time.
dialogsBegin.ru: Haven't heard of me!? Well you my friend, must have been living under a pretty big rock for some time.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿¡No has oído hablar de mí!? Bueno, amigo mío, has estado viviendo debajo de una piedra bastante grande durante un buen tiempo por lo que veo.
dialogsBegin.sw: Haven't heard of me!? Well you my friend, must have been living under a pretty big rock for some time.
dialogsBegin.th: ไม่เคยได้ยินชื่อฉันเหรอ!? ดี เพื่อน ต้องได้รับการอาศัยอยู่ภายใต้หินขนาดใหญ่สวยบางครั้ง
dialogsBegin.tw: 沒聽說過我！？好吧，我的朋友，你一定在一塊相當大的岩石下生活了一段時間。
dialogsBegin.vi: Chưa nghe nói về tôi à!? Chà, bạn của tôi, chắc hẳn đã sống trong hang đá xa xưa khá lâu ấy nhỉ.

dialogsBegin.en: Maybe while you adjust to the light, you could do me a little favor? Afterwards I promise to tell you where to find that hero you are looking for!
dialogsBegin.ar: Maybe while you adjust to the light, you could do me a little favor? Afterwards I promise to tell you where to find that hero you are looking for!
dialogsBegin.br: Talvez enquanto você se acostuma com a luz, você poderia me fazer um pequeno favor? Depois eu prometo te dizer onde encontrar aquela guerreira que você está procurando!
dialogsBegin.cns: 也许当你适应光线时，你可以帮我一点忙？之后，我保证告诉你在哪里可以找到你要找的那个英雄！
dialogsBegin.de: Während du dich an das Licht gewöhnst, könntest du mir vielleicht einen kleinen Gefallen tun? Ich denke, ich weiß, wo der Hero ist. Danach verspreche ich dir zu sagen, wo du den Helden findest, den du suchst.!
dialogsBegin.fi: Maybe while you adjust to the light, you could do me a little favor? Afterwards I promise to tell you where to find that hero you are looking for!
dialogsBegin.fil: Maybe while you adjust to the light, you could do me a little favor? Afterwards I promise to tell you where to find that hero you are looking for!
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous ne me croyez pas ? Je vais vous le prouver ! Laissez tomber votre histoire de Héros pour l'instant, je suis en pétard !
dialogsBegin.id: Mungkin saat Anda menyesuaikan diri dengan cahaya, Anda bisa membantu saya sedikit? Setelah itu saya berjanji untuk memberi tahu Anda di mana menemukan pahlawan yang Anda cari!
dialogsBegin.it: Maybe while you adjust to the light, you could do me a little favor? Afterwards I promise to tell you where to find that hero you are looking for!
dialogsBegin.jp: そうだ。英雄の情報と引き換えに、アンタ一つ頼まれごとをしてくれねえか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 오랜만에 올라오신 거라면, 햇빛에 적응하는 동안 부탁 하나만 들어주실래요? 그럼 저도 찾고 계신 그 영웅이 어디 있는지 알려 드리죠!

dialogsBegin.pl: Maybe while you adjust to the light, you could do me a little favor? Afterwards I promise to tell you where to find that hero you are looking for!
dialogsBegin.ru: Maybe while you adjust to the light, you could do me a little favor? Afterwards I promise to tell you where to find that hero you are looking for!
dialogsBegin.sp: Mientras te adaptas a la luz, ¿podrías hacerme un pequeño favor? ¡Después prometo decirte dónde encontrar a esa héroe que estás buscando!
dialogsBegin.sw: Maybe while you adjust to the light, you could do me a little favor? Afterwards I promise to tell you where to find that hero you are looking for!
dialogsBegin.th: บางทีในขณะที่คุณปรับตัวเข้ากับแสงคุณสามารถทำให้ฉันชื่นชอบเล็กน้อย? หลังจากนั้นฉันสัญญาว่าจะบอก ว่าจะหาฮีโร่ที่ ต้องการได้ที่ไหน!
dialogsBegin.tw: 那麼你可以幫我一個忙嗎？那麼我會告訴你最後一個英雄所在之處。
dialogsBegin.vi: Có lẽ trong khi bạn điều chỉnh ánh sáng, bạn có thể giúp tôi một chút? Sau đó, tôi hứa sẽ cho bạn biết nơi để tìm thấy anh hùng mà bạn đang tìm kiếm!

dialogsAccept.en: Thanks!! Well, I'm working on my latest masterpiece dish, but first I need 10 Anti Roots. Please go obtain some from Antiquery!
dialogsAccept.ar: Thanks!! Well, I'm working on my latest masterpiece dish, but first I need 10 Anti Roots. Please go obtain some from Antiquery!
dialogsAccept.br: Obrigado!! Bem, estou trabalhando no meu último prato de obra-prima, mas primeiro preciso de 10 Anti-Raiz. Por favor, vá obter alguns da Antiquery!
dialogsAccept.cns: 谢谢！！好吧，我正在制作我的新杰作，但首先我需要 10 个树根。你可以从树精身上获取！
dialogsAccept.de: Danke!!! Nun, ich arbeite an meinem neuesten Meisterwerk, aber zuerst brauche ich 10 Anti-Wurzeln. Bitte besorgt euch welche von Antiquery!
dialogsAccept.fi: Thanks!! Well, I'm working on my latest masterpiece dish, but first I need 10 Anti Roots. Please go obtain some from Antiquery!
dialogsAccept.fil: Thanks!! Well, I'm working on my latest masterpiece dish, but first I need 10 Anti Roots. Please go obtain some from Antiquery!
dialogsAccept.fr: Je ne vous donnerai aucune indication tant que vous en m'aurez pas apporté 10 racines du néant.
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih!! Yah, saya sedang mengerjakan hidangan mahakarya terbaru saya, tetapi pertama-tama saya membutuhkan 10 Anti Roots. Silakan dapatkan beberapa dari Antiquery!
dialogsAccept.it: Thanks!! Well, I'm working on my latest masterpiece dish, but first I need 10 Anti Roots. Please go obtain some from Antiquery!
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとう。この辺りにアンティクエリーって植物がいるんだが、それの持ってるアンティ根がほしいだよ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 고마워요!! 지금 최신 걸작 요리를 준비 중인데, 우선은 앤티뿌리 10개가 필요해요. 앤티크리를 사냥해 재료를 구해주실 수 있나요?
dialogsAccept.nl: Thanks!! Well, I'm working on my latest masterpiece dish, but first I need 10 Anti Roots. Please go obtain some from Antiquery!
dialogsAccept.pl: Thanks!! Well, I'm working on my latest masterpiece dish, but first I need 10 Anti Roots. Please go obtain some from Antiquery!
dialogsAccept.ru: Thanks!! Well, I'm working on my latest masterpiece dish, but first I need 10 Anti Roots. Please go obtain some from Antiquery!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡¡Gracias!! Bueno, estoy trabajando en mi último plato de obra maestra, pero primero necesito 10 Raíces Anti. ¡Ve a conseguirlas de los Antiquery!
dialogsAccept.sw: Thanks!! Well, I'm working on my latest masterpiece dish, but first I need 10 Anti Roots. Please go obtain some from Antiquery!
dialogsAccept.th: ขอบคุณ !! ดีเลย ฉันกำลังทำงานชิ้นล่าสุดอยู่ แต่ก่อนอื่นฉันต้องใช้ Anti Roots 10 อัน โปรดไปหา Antiquery!!
dialogsAccept.tw: 謝謝！！嗯，我正在製作最新的傑作料理，但首先需要 10 個安地根。請去從安提奎利身上取得一些！
dialogsAccept.vi: Cảm ơn!! Chà, tôi đang làm món ăn kiệt tác mới nhất của mình, nhưng trước tiên tôi cần 10 Anti Roots. Vui lòng lấy một số từ Antiquery!

dialogsDecline.en: Ahh nevermind then! Figured you might do me this one favor!
dialogsDecline.ar: Ahh nevermind then! Figured you might do me this one favor!
dialogsDecline.br: Ahh deixa pra lá então! Achei que você poderia me fazer um favor! Não tenho nada para te contar nesse caso.
dialogsDecline.cns: 啊，那没关系！我想你可以帮我这个忙！
dialogsDecline.de: Ahh, dann ist es ja egal! Ich dachte, du könntest mir diesen einen Gefallen tun!
dialogsDecline.fi: Ahh nevermind then! Figured you might do me this one favor!
dialogsDecline.fil: Ahh nevermind then! Figured you might do me this one favor!
dialogsDecline.fr: C'est votre problème ! Vous ne croyez pas pour la cuisine, pourquoi me croiriez-vous pour le Héros…
dialogsDecline.id: Ahh lupakan! Pikir Anda mungkin membantu saya yang satu ini!
dialogsDecline.it: Ahh nevermind then! Figured you might do me this one favor!
dialogsDecline.jp: そうか。まあオイラには関係ないことだしね。
dialogsDecline.kr: 아아, 그럼 괜찮습니다! 이 정도의 부탁은 들어주시리라 생각했는데!
dialogsDecline.nl: Ahh nevermind then! Figured you might do me this one favor!
dialogsDecline.pl: Ahh nevermind then! Figured you might do me this one favor!
dialogsDecline.ru: Ahh nevermind then! Figured you might do me this one favor!
dialogsDecline.sp: Ahh ¡no importa entonces! ¡Pensaba que podrías hacerme este favor!
dialogsDecline.sw: Ahh nevermind then! Figured you might do me this one favor!
dialogsDecline.th: อ่าา ไม่เป็นไร! คิดว่าคุณอาจจะทำแบบนี้ให้ฉัน!
dialogsDecline.tw: 沒有辦法。對商人來說是沒有白吃的午飯。
dialogsDecline.vi: Ahh đừng bận tâm! Đã biết bạn có thể giúp tôi một việc này!

description.en: Bring Mawrang some of their remains so they can be studied. Maybe we can learn something.
description.ar: Bring Mawrang some of their remains so they can be studied. Maybe we can learn something.
description.br: Traga a Mawrang alguns de seus restos mortais para que possam ser estudados. Talvez possamos aprender alguma coisa.
description.cns: 给玫然带来一些他们的遗骸，以便研究。也许我们可以学到一些东西。
description.de: Bring Mawrang ein paar derer Überreste, damit sie untersucht werden können. Vielleicht können wir etwas davon lernen.
description.fi: Bring Mawrang some of their remains so they can be studied. Maybe we can learn something.
description.fil: Bring Mawrang some of their remains so they can be studied. Maybe we can learn something.
description.fr: Apportez à Mawranleur restes pour pouvoir les étudier. Nous pouvons peut-être en apprendre quelque chose.
description.id: Bawa Mawrang beberapa dari sisa-sisa mereka sehingga mereka dapat dipelajari. Mungkin kita bisa belajar sesuatu.
description.it: Bring Mawrang some of their remains so they can be studied. Maybe we can learn something.
description.jp: 彼らが研究できるように、マウラングに彼らの遺骸の一部を持ってきてください。何かを学ぶことができるかもしれません。
description.kr: 죽은 자들의 유해를 마우랑에게 가져가 조사할 수 있게 해주세요. 뭔가 알아낼 수 있을지도 모르죠.
description.nl: Bring Mawrang some of their remains so they can be studied. Maybe we can learn something.
description.pl: Bring Mawrang some of their remains so they can be studied. Maybe we can learn something.
description.ru: Bring Mawrang some of their remains so they can be studied. Maybe we can learn something.
description.sp: Llévale a Mawrang algunos de sus restos para que puedan ser estudiados. Quizás aprendamos algo.
description.sw: Bring Mawrang some of their remains so they can be studied. Maybe we can learn something.
description.th: นำซากศพของMawrang มาบางส่วนเพื่อศึกษา บางทีเราอาจเรียนรู้อะไรบางอย่าง
description.tw: 給馬巫郎帶來一些他們的遺體，以便研究，也許我們可以學到一些東西。
description.vi: Mang cho Mawrang một số hài cốt của bọn họ để được nghiên cứu. Có lẽ chúng ta có thể học được điều gì đó.

dialogsBegin.en: While we may be safe for now thanks to your help, the armies of Shade are advancing.
dialogsBegin.ar: While we may be safe for now thanks to your help, the armies of Shade are advancing.
dialogsBegin.br: Embora possamos estar seguros por enquanto graças à sua ajuda, os exércitos de Shade estão avançando.
dialogsBegin.cns: 虽然多亏了你的帮助，我们现在可能是安全的，但谢莉德的爪牙正在集结。
dialogsBegin.de: Auch wenn wir dank deiner Hilfe für den Moment sicher sind, rücken die Armeen von Shade stets vor.
dialogsBegin.fi: While we may be safe for now thanks to your help, the armies of Shade are advancing.
dialogsBegin.fil: While we may be safe for now thanks to your help, the armies of Shade are advancing.
dialogsBegin.fr: Bien que nous soyons en sécurité pour le moment grâce à vous, les armées de Shade avancent.
dialogsBegin.id: Sementara kami mungkin aman untuk saat ini berkat bantuan kamu, pasukan Shade maju.
dialogsBegin.it: While we may be safe for now thanks to your help, the armies of Shade are advancing.
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたの助けのおかげで、私たちは今のところ安全かもしれませんが、シェードの軍隊は前進しています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 당신 덕분에 지금은 안전한 것 같지만, 쉐이드의 군대가 진격해 오고 있어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: While we may be safe for now thanks to your help, the armies of Shade are advancing.
dialogsBegin.pl: While we may be safe for now thanks to your help, the armies of Shade are advancing.
dialogsBegin.ru: While we may be safe for now thanks to your help, the armies of Shade are advancing.
dialogsBegin.sp: Aunque ahora podemos estar a salvo gracias a tu ayuda, los ejércitos de Shade siguen avanzando.
dialogsBegin.sw: While we may be safe for now thanks to your help, the armies of Shade are advancing.
dialogsBegin.th: ในขณะที่เราอาจจะปลอดภัยในตอนนี้ด้วยความช่วยเหลือของคุณ กองทัพของ Shade กำลังรุกคืบ
dialogsBegin.tw: 雖然多虧了你的幫助，我們現在可能是安全的，但闇影的軍隊正在前進。
dialogsBegin.vi: Mặc dù bây giờ chúng tôi có thể an toàn nhờ sự giúp đỡ của bạn, nhưng đội quân của Shade đang tiến lên.

dialogsBegin.en: Shade is summoning the very dead to fight against us. Ghosts of the forgotten rulers have completely taken over the old ruins of Azria.
dialogsBegin.ar: Shade is summoning the very dead to fight against us. Ghosts of the forgotten rulers have completely taken over the old ruins of Azria.
dialogsBegin.br: Shade está convocando os mortos para lutar contra nós. Fantasmas dos governantes esquecidos tomaram conta das antigas ruínas de Azria.
dialogsBegin.cns: 谢莉德正在召唤死者与我们作战。被遗忘的幽灵已经完全占领了阿兹利亚雪地的废墟。
dialogsBegin.de: Shade beschwört die Toten um gegen uns zu kämpfen. Geister der vergessenen Herscher haben die alten Ruinen in Azria übernommen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Shade is summoning the very dead to fight against us. Ghosts of the forgotten rulers have completely taken over the old ruins of Azria.
dialogsBegin.fil: Shade is summoning the very dead to fight against us. Ghosts of the forgotten rulers have completely taken over the old ruins of Azria.
dialogsBegin.fr: Shade invoque les morts eux-même pour nous combattre. Des fantômes de dirigeants oubliés ont pris le contrôle des vieilles ruines d'Azria.
dialogsBegin.id: Shade memanggil undead untuk melawan kita. Ghosts of the forgotten rulers telah sepenuhnya mengambil alih ruins of Azria.
dialogsBegin.it: Shade is summoning the very dead to fight against us. Ghosts of the forgotten rulers have completely taken over the old ruins of Azria.
dialogsBegin.jp: シェードは私たちと戦うために死者を召喚しています。忘れ去られた統治者の亡霊がアズリアの古い遺跡を完全に乗っ取った。
dialogsBegin.kr: 쉐이드가 죽은 자들을 소환해 우리와 싸우게 하고 있어요. 잊힌 지배자의 망령들이 아즈리아의 옛 땅을 완전히 장악했죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: Shade is summoning the very dead to fight against us. Ghosts of the forgotten rulers have completely taken over the old ruins of Azria.
dialogsBegin.pl: Shade is summoning the very dead to fight against us. Ghosts of the forgotten rulers have completely taken over the old ruins of Azria.
dialogsBegin.ru: Shade is summoning the very dead to fight against us. Ghosts of the forgotten rulers have completely taken over the old ruins of Azria.
dialogsBegin.sp: Shade está convocando a los muertos para luchar contra nosotros. Los Fantasmas de los Gobernantes Olvidados se han apoderado de las antiguas ruinas de Azria.
dialogsBegin.sw: Shade is summoning the very dead to fight against us. Ghosts of the forgotten rulers have completely taken over the old ruins of Azria.
dialogsBegin.th: Shade กำลังเรียกเหล่าคนตายมาต่อสู้กับเรา วิญญาณของผู้ปกครองที่ถูกลืมได้เข้ายึดซากปรักหักพังเก่าแก่ของ Azria อย่างสมบูรณ์
dialogsBegin.tw: 闇影正在召喚死者與我們作戰，被遺忘的統治者的幽靈已經完全佔領了阿茲里亞的舊廢墟。
dialogsBegin.vi: Shade đang triệu hồi những người đã chết để chiến đấu chống lại chúng ta. Bóng ma của những kẻ thống trị bị lãng quên đã hoàn toàn chiếm lấy những tàn tích cũ của Azria.

description.en: Could you bring a Live Tea to Ann? You can find it the east of the Leren Mountains.
description.ar: Could you bring a Live Tea to Ann? You can find it the east of the Leren Mountains.
description.br: Você poderia trazer um Chá da Vida para Ann? Você pode encontrá-lo a leste das Montanhas Leren.
description.cns: 你能给安带来一杯生命之茶吗？你可以在乐雅山脉的东边找到安。
description.de: Könntest du Ann einen Life Tea bringen? Du findest sie im Zentrum der Stadt Saint Morning.
description.fi: Could you bring a Live Tea to Ann? You can find it the east of the Leren Mountains.
description.fil: Could you bring a Live Tea to Ann? You can find it the east of the Leren Mountains.
description.fr: Pourrais-tu apporter un Thé Vivant à Ann ? Tu peux le trouver à l'est des montagnes de Leren.
description.id: Bisakah kamu membawakan Live Tea untuk Ann? Kamu dapat menemukannya di sebelah timur Leren Mountains.
description.it: Could you bring a Live Tea to Ann? You can find it the east of the Leren Mountains.
description.jp: ＜アン＞に＜ライブティー＞を持って行っていただけないかしら？彼女はレルエン山脈の東部にいるはずだわ。
description.kr: 레르엔 산맥 동쪽에서 구할 수 있는 라이브 티를 앤에게 전달해 주시겠어요?
description.nl: Could you bring a Live Tea to Ann? You can find it the east of the Leren Mountains.
description.pl: Could you bring a Live Tea to Ann? You can find it the east of the Leren Mountains.
description.ru: Ты не мог бы передать Живительный чай Энни? Ты можешь отыскать её на востоке Леренских горок.
description.sp: ¿Podrías llevarle un Té Vivo a Ann? Puedes encontrarlo al este de las Montañas Leren.
description.sw: Could you bring a Live Tea to Ann? You can find it the east of the Leren Mountains.
description.th: คุณช่วยนำ Live Tea ไปให้ Ann ได้ไหม คุณจะพบได้ทางทิศตะวันออกของ Leren Mountains
description.tw: 你能給安妮帶來一杯生命茶嗎？你可以在勒倫山脈的東邊找到它。
description.vi: Bạn có thể mang Live Tea cho Ann được không? Bạn có thể tìm thấy nó ở phía đông của dãy núi Leren.

descriptionComplete.en: I will save the Garden of Rhisis with this tea! Here is an Earring to thank you.
descriptionComplete.ar: I will save the Garden of Rhisis with this tea! Here is an Earring to thank you.
descriptionComplete.br: Vou salvar o Jardim de Rhisis com este chá! Aqui está um brinco para te agradecer.
descriptionComplete.cns: 我会用这杯茶来拯救莱斯花园！送给你一副耳环，来表达我对你的感谢。
descriptionComplete.de: Ich werde den Garten von Rhisis mithilfe dieses Tees retten. Hier ist ein Ohrring als Anerkennung für deine Hilfe.
descriptionComplete.fi: I will save the Garden of Rhisis with this tea! Here is an Earring to thank you.
descriptionComplete.fil: I will save the Garden of Rhisis with this tea! Here is an Earring to thank you.
descriptionComplete.fr: Je vais sauver le Jardin de Rhisis avec ce thé ! Voici des Boucles Plug pour te récompenser.
descriptionComplete.id: Aku akan menyelamatkan Garden of Rhisis dengan teh ini! Ini Anting-anting untuk rasa terima kasih.
descriptionComplete.it: I will save the Garden of Rhisis with this tea! Here is an Earring to thank you.
descriptionComplete.jp: このティーでリシスの庭を救うわ！お礼のイヤリングよ。きっと役に立つはずだわ。
descriptionComplete.kr: 이 차로 리시스의 정원을 구해보겠어요! 고마움의 표시로 귀걸이를 드릴게요.
descriptionComplete.nl: I will save the Garden of Rhisis with this tea! Here is an Earring to thank you.
descriptionComplete.pl: I will save the Garden of Rhisis with this tea! Here is an Earring to thank you.
descriptionComplete.ru: Я спасу Райсский сад этим чаем! Держи, ты заслужил эту серьгу.
descriptionComplete.sp: ¡Salvaré el Jardín de Rhisis con este té! Toma este pendiente como agradecimiento.
descriptionComplete.sw: I will save the Garden of Rhisis with this tea! Here is an Earring to thank you.
descriptionComplete.th: ฉันจะช่วย Garden of Rhisis ด้วยชานี้! นี่คือ Earring เพื่อขอบคุณ
descriptionComplete.tw: 我會用這茶來拯救黎席斯庭院！這是一個耳環來感謝你。
descriptionComplete.vi: Tôi sẽ cứu Khu Vườn của Rhisis bằng loại trà này! Đây là một Bông tai để cảm ơn bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: The Saint City sisters say that the Garden of Rhisis is dying.
dialogsBegin.ar: The Saint City sisters say that the Garden of Rhisis is dying.
dialogsBegin.br: Quando dei a Tigela de Osso e os Corações de Bearers para Ann, ela me deu um Chá da Vida. Devo falar com Ann novamente.
dialogsBegin.cns: 将匠人之心和骨质御碗送给了玛尔琪，她就把散发着奇妙香味的生命之茶拿给了我，并让我回送给安妮。真是很香啊～不知道这东西可不可以吃呢？
dialogsBegin.de: Die Saint Morning Schwestern sagen, der Garten von Rhisis würde sterben.
dialogsBegin.fi: The Saint City sisters say that the Garden of Rhisis is dying.
dialogsBegin.fil: The Saint City sisters say that the Garden of Rhisis is dying.
dialogsBegin.fr: Quand j'ai remis le Bol en os et le Cœur de Bearer à Ann, elle m'a donné un Thé de vie en échange. Je devrais retourner voir Ann.
dialogsBegin.id: Para suster Kota Saint mengatakan bahwa Garden of Rhisis sedang sekarat.
dialogsBegin.it: The Saint City sisters say that the Garden of Rhisis is dying.
dialogsBegin.jp: 「ボーンボール」と「ベアラー・ハート」を渡したら「ライブティー」という独特な香りがするお茶をくれた。これをアンに渡してくれって。しかし、少し、のんだら駄目かなあ？
dialogsBegin.kr: 세인트 시티에 있는 자매들이, 리시스의 정원이 죽어가고 있다고 알려왔어요!
dialogsBegin.nl: The Saint City sisters say that the Garden of Rhisis is dying.
dialogsBegin.pl: Siostry z Saint City mówią, że Ogród Rhisis umiera.
dialogsBegin.ru: Сёстры из Санто говорят, что Райсский сад умирает.
dialogsBegin.sp: Las hermanas de Saint dicen que el Jardín de Rhisis se está muriendo.
dialogsBegin.sw: The Saint City sisters say that the Garden of Rhisis is dying.
dialogsBegin.th: เหล่าซิสเตอร์ของ Saint City บอกว่า Garden of Rhisis กำลังจะตาย
dialogsBegin.tw: 聖城姊妹說，黎席斯庭院快要死了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Các chị em ở Saint City nói rằng Khu Vườn của Rhisis đang chết dần.

dialogsAccept.en: Thank you! If you help her she will give you an Earring.
dialogsAccept.ar: Thank you! If you help her she will give you an Earring.
dialogsAccept.br: Obrigado! Se você ajudá-la, ela lhe dará um brinco.
dialogsAccept.cns: 谢谢！如果你帮助了她，她会送给你一副耳环
dialogsAccept.de: Vielen Dank! Für deine Hilfe bietet sie dir einen Ohrring.
dialogsAccept.fi: Thank you! If you help her she will give you an Earring.
dialogsAccept.fil: Thank you! If you help her she will give you an Earring.
dialogsAccept.fr: Merci ! Si tu l'aides, elle te donnera peut-être des Boucles Plug.
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih! Jika kamu membantunya, dia akan memberimu sebuah Anting.
dialogsAccept.it: Thank you! If you help her she will give you an Earring.
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとう。彼女を手伝ってくれたらお礼にイヤリングを差し上げるわ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 고마워요! 앤을 도와주시면 귀걸이를 받을 수 있을 거예요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Thank you! If you help her she will give you an Earring.
dialogsAccept.pl: Thank you! If you help her she will give you an Earring.
dialogsAccept.ru: Большое спасибо! Если ты ей поможешь, то в подарок получишь серьгу.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Gracias! Si la ayudas, te dará un Pendiente.
dialogsAccept.sw: Thank you! If you help her she will give you an Earring.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอบคุณ! หากคุณช่วยเธอ เธอจะมอบ Earring ให้คุณ
dialogsAccept.tw: 謝謝！如果你幫助她，她會給你一個耳環。
dialogsAccept.vi: Cảm ơn bạn! Nếu bạn giúp cô ấy, cô ấy sẽ tặng bạn một Bông tai.

dialogsDecline.vi: Vấn đề với Khu Vườn của Rhisis có thể chờ đợi. Tôi đoán...

description.en: Take the Successor Scroll of the Jester Hero, slay Sisif to retrieve the Jewel of the Jester Hero, and bring them both to the Jester Priest, Homeit.
description.ar: Take the Successor Scroll of the Jester Hero, slay Sisif to retrieve the Jewel of the Jester Hero, and bring them both to the Jester Priest, Homeit.
description.br: Traga o pergaminho e vá para o altar de Jester em Darkon Magmient. Antes disso, você deve obter a Jóia do Herói que está com Cicipue, que foi visto perto do altar.
description.cns: 去猎杀西西普得到英雄的宝石，然后拿着卷轴去找达肯3的暗杀大师胡梅。
description.de: Nimm die Schriftrolle und erbeute das Juwel des Jester Helden von Sisif. Bring beides anschließend zum Jester Priester Homeit.
description.fi: Take the Successor Scroll of the Jester Hero, slay Sisif to retrieve the Jewel of the Jester Hero, and bring them both to the Jester Priest, Homeit.
description.fil: Take the Successor Scroll of the Jester Hero, slay Sisif to retrieve the Jewel of the Jester Hero, and bring them both to the Jester Priest, Homeit.
description.fr: Récupérer la Pierre des Héros en combattant Cicipue qui erre près de l'Autel des Jesters, et le rapporter à la Doyenne des Jesters Homeit.
description.id: Ambil Successor Scroll of the Jester Hero, bunuh Sisif untuk mengambil Jewel of the Jester Hero, dan bawa keduanya ke Jester Priest, Homeit.
description.it: Take the Successor Scroll of the Jester Hero, slay Sisif to retrieve the Jewel of the Jester Hero, and bring them both to the Jester Priest, Homeit.
description.jp: 巻物を持って、ダーコン＜マグミアント＞のジェスター祭壇に行こう。ただ、その前に祭壇近くで＜シシフ＞というやつを狩って、＜英雄の宝石＞を見つけないといけない。
description.kr: 제스터 영웅의 후계자 두루마리를 가지고 시시프를 처치한 뒤, 제스터 영웅의 보석을 찾아 함께 제스터 사제 호메잇에게 가져다주세요.
description.nl: Take the Successor Scroll of the Jester Hero, slay Sisif to retrieve the Jewel of the Jester Hero, and bring them both to the Jester Priest, Homeit.
description.pl: Take the Successor Scroll of the Jester Hero, slay Sisif to retrieve the Jewel of the Jester Hero, and bring them both to the Jester Priest, Homeit.
description.ru: Нужно убить Руки-крюки, забрать геройский самоцвет шута и поговорить с жрицей шутов Омейтой.
description.sp: Toma el Pergamino de Sucesor del Héroe Jester, vence a Sisif para recuperar la Gema del Héroe Jester, y entrégasela a la Sacerdotisa Jester, Homeit.
description.sw: Take the Successor Scroll of the Jester Hero, slay Sisif to retrieve the Jewel of the Jester Hero, and bring them both to the Jester Priest, Homeit.
description.th: ใช้สกิล Scroll of the Jester Hero สังหาร Sisif เพื่อเรียก Jewel of the Jester Hero และนำพวกเขาไปยัง Jester Priest ที่ Homeit
description.tw: 拿著卷軸去得肯的美格米特找操偶師的集團，在找他們之前，你應該要先去獵殺西西普得到英雄的寶石才行！
description.vi: Lấy Cuộn Giấy kế thừa của Jester Hero, giết Sisif để lấy viên ngọc của Jester Hero, và đưa cả hai đến Jester Priest, Homeit.

dialogsBegin.en: This scroll is the right of passage for those seeking to pursue the path of the Jester Hero. Please, take it and seek the Jester Priest in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.ar: This scroll is the right of passage for those seeking to pursue the path of the Jester Hero. Please, take it and seek the Jester Priest in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.br: Este pergaminho é o direito de passagem para aqueles que desejam seguir o caminho do Herói Jester. Por favor, pegue e encontre a sacerdotisa Jester em Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.cns: 这个卷轴是证明你有资格当暗杀的，拿着这个卷轴去找暗杀的祭司吧！
dialogsBegin.de: Diese Schriftrolle beweist, dass du der Nachfolge würdig bist. Nimm sie und bringe sie der Jester Priesterin in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.fi: This scroll is the right of passage for those seeking to pursue the path of the Jester Hero. Please, take it and seek the Jester Priest in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.fil: This scroll is the right of passage for those seeking to pursue the path of the Jester Hero. Please, take it and seek the Jester Priest in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu approches de ton but. et la fin de ton apprentissage se passera à Darkon 3 ! Là-bas, tu trouveras l'Autel où siège Homeit, la Doyenne des Jesters.
dialogsBegin.id: Scroll ini adalah hak bagi mereka yang ingin mengejar jalan Jester Hero. Tolong, ambillah dan cari Jester Priest di Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.it: This scroll is the right of passage for those seeking to pursue the path of the Jester Hero. Please, take it and seek the Jester Priest in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.jp: この巻物はあなたがジェスター後継者の資格を持っているという証です。これを持って、ジェスター司祭にお会いになって下さい。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 두루마리는 당신이 제스터 영웅 후계자 자격이 있다는 증명이랍니다. 이걸 가지고 다콘 제3지구의 제스터 사제를 찾아가세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: This scroll is the right of passage for those seeking to pursue the path of the Jester Hero. Please, take it and seek the Jester Priest in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.pl: This scroll is the right of passage for those seeking to pursue the path of the Jester Hero. Please, take it and seek the Jester Priest in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.ru: Этот свиток подтверждает твое право встать на Путь шута. Возьми его и разыщи жрицу шутов в Дарконе-3.
dialogsBegin.sp: Este pergamino es lo que necesitan aquellos que buscan seguir el camino del Héroe Jester. Por favor, tómalo y busca a la Sacerdotisa Jester en Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.sw: This scroll is the right of passage for those seeking to pursue the path of the Jester Hero. Please, take it and seek the Jester Priest in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.th: ม้วนกระดาษนี้เป็นทางผ่านที่แท้จริงสำหรับผู้ที่ต้องการเดินตามเส้นทางของ Jester Hero กรุณานำมันไปหา Jester Priest ใน Darkon 3
dialogsBegin.tw: 這個卷軸是證明你有資格當操偶師的，拿著這個卷軸去得肯第三區找操偶師的祭司吧！
dialogsBegin.vi: Cuộn giấy này là quyền đi lại cho những ai muốn theo đuổi con đường của Jester Hero. Hãy cầm lấy nó và tìm kiếm Jester Priest trong Darkon 3.

dialogsBegin.en: The Jester Priest can be found in Magmient in Southern Darkon 3. Present her with the scroll and she will recognize you as a successor to the Jester Hero.
dialogsBegin.ar: The Jester Priest can be found in Magmient in Southern Darkon 3. Present her with the scroll and she will recognize you as a successor to the Jester Hero.
dialogsBegin.br: A sacerdotisa Jester está no altar Jester em Magmient no Sul de Darkon 3. Mostre isto e ela o reconhecerá como um sucessor do Herói Jester.
dialogsBegin.cns: 暗杀的祭司在熔岩火海地区。把这个拿去给她吧！
dialogsBegin.de: Die Jester Priesterin befindet sich am Jester Altar in Darkon 3. Wenn du ihr diese Schriftrolle zeigst wird sie dich als Nachfolger der Helden anerkennen.
dialogsBegin.fi: The Jester Priest can be found in Magmient in Southern Darkon 3. Present her with the scroll and she will recognize you as a successor to the Jester Hero.
dialogsBegin.fil: The Jester Priest can be found in Magmient in Southern Darkon 3. Present her with the scroll and she will recognize you as a successor to the Jester Hero.
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais avant de te présenter à Homeit, il y a une mission que tu dois accomplir.
dialogsBegin.id: Jester Priest dapat ditemukan di Magmient di Southern Darkon 3. Berikan dia scroll tersebut dan dia akan mengenalimu sebagai penerus Jester Hero.
dialogsBegin.it: The Jester Priest can be found in Magmient in Southern Darkon 3. Present her with the scroll and she will recognize you as a successor to the Jester Hero.
dialogsBegin.jp: ジェスター司祭はダーコン＜マグミアント＞地域のジェスター祭壇にいます。彼女にこれを見せれば、あなたを英雄の後継者として認めてくれるはずです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 제스터 사제는 다콘 제3지구 남부의 매그미언트에 있어요. 그분께 이 두루마리를 전하면, 당신을 제스터 영웅의 계승자로 인정해 주실 겁니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: The Jester Priest can be found in Magmient in Southern Darkon 3. Present her with the scroll and she will recognize you as a successor to the Jester Hero.
dialogsBegin.pl: The Jester Priest can be found in Magmient in Southern Darkon 3. Present her with the scroll and she will recognize you as a successor to the Jester Hero.
dialogsBegin.ru: Жрица шутов живет в Магминте - это в южном Дарконе-3. Отдай ей свиток. Она поймет, что у героя, чьей памяти она служит, появился достойный наследник.
dialogsBegin.sp: Puedes encontrar a la Sacerdotisa Jester en Magmient al Sur de Darkon 3. Entrégale el pergamino y te reconocerá como un Sucesor del Héroe Jester.
dialogsBegin.sw: The Jester Priest can be found in Magmient in Southern Darkon 3. Present her with the scroll and she will recognize you as a successor to the Jester Hero.
dialogsBegin.th: สามารถพบ Jester Priest ได้ใน Magmient ที่ Southern Darkon 3 โชว์ม้วนกระดาษให้เธอ แล้วเธอจะรู้ว่าคุณคือทายาทของ Jester Hero
dialogsBegin.tw: 操偶師的祭司在得肯第三區的「美格米特」地區。把這個拿去給她吧！
dialogsBegin.vi: Jester Priest có thể được tìm thấy trong Magmient ở Southern Darkon 3. Đưa cho cô ấy cuộn giấy và cô ấy sẽ công nhận bạn là người kế vị Jester Hero.

dialogsBegin.en: There is one thing you must do before you can speak with the Jester Priest. The Jewels of the Heroes adorn the Altar of Jester. One of these jewels was stolen a few days ago.
dialogsBegin.ar: There is one thing you must do before you can speak with the Jester Priest. The Jewels of the Heroes adorn the Altar of Jester. One of these jewels was stolen a few days ago.
dialogsBegin.br: Ah. Tem algo que você precisa fazer antes de ir ver a sacerdotisa. Os tesouros do Altar Jester são as Jóias dos Heróis. Uma delas foi roubada alguns dias atrás...
dialogsBegin.cns: 你去找祭司之前有一件事情要请你先去做，最近暗杀集团的有一颗宝石被偷走了。
dialogsBegin.de: Oh, bevor du zur Priesterin gehst, musst du noch etwas anderes tun. Die Juwelen der Helden zieren den Altar der Jester. Einer dieser Juwelen wurde wurde kürzlich gestohlen.
dialogsBegin.fi: There is one thing you must do before you can speak with the Jester Priest. The Jewels of the Heroes adorn the Altar of Jester. One of these jewels was stolen a few days ago.
dialogsBegin.fil: There is one thing you must do before you can speak with the Jester Priest. The Jewels of the Heroes adorn the Altar of Jester. One of these jewels was stolen a few days ago.
dialogsBegin.fr: Les trésors de l'Autel des Jesters sont les Pierres des Héros, et l'une d'elle a été volée il y a quelques jours.
dialogsBegin.id: Ada satu hal yang harus kamu lakukan sebelum kamu bisa berbicara dengan Jester Priest. Jewels of the Heroes menghiasi Altar Jester. Salah satu permata ini dicuri beberapa hari yang lalu.
dialogsBegin.it: There is one thing you must do before you can speak with the Jester Priest. The Jewels of the Heroes adorn the Altar of Jester. One of these jewels was stolen a few days ago.
dialogsBegin.jp: あ、司祭の元へ行く前に、もう一つお願いがあるのです。ジェスター祭壇の宝物である「英雄の宝石」の中から1つが盗まれたそうです。最近はどこも物騒なのですね・・・
dialogsBegin.kr: 사제를 방문하기 전에 해주셔야 할 일이 있어요. 제스터 제단의 보물에는 영웅의 보석이 장식되어 있는데, 며칠 전 그 보석 중 하나가 도난당했다는군요.
dialogsBegin.nl: There is one thing you must do before you can speak with the Jester Priest. The Jewels of the Heroes adorn the Altar of Jester. One of these jewels was stolen a few days ago.
dialogsBegin.pl: There is one thing you must do before you can speak with the Jester Priest. The Jewels of the Heroes adorn the Altar of Jester. One of these jewels was stolen a few days ago.
dialogsBegin.ru: Но сначала тебе придется выполнить опасное задание. Алтарь шутов украшен геройскими самоцветами... Был украшен. Один из них украли пару дней назад.
dialogsBegin.sp: Hay una cosa que debes hacer antes de poder hablar con la Sacerdotisa Jester. Las Gemas de los Héroes adornan el Altar del Jester. Una de esas gemas fue robada hace unos días.
dialogsBegin.sw: There is one thing you must do before you can speak with the Jester Priest. The Jewels of the Heroes adorn the Altar of Jester. One of these jewels was stolen a few days ago.
dialogsBegin.th: มีสิ่งหนึ่งที่คุณต้องทำก่อนที่คุณจะสามารถพูดคุยกับ Jester Priest มีอัญมณีของวีรบุรุษประดับแท่นบูชาของ Jester หนึ่งในอัญมณีเหล่านี้โดนขโมยไปเมื่อไม่กี่วันก่อน
dialogsBegin.tw: 你去找祭司之前有一件事情要請你先去做，最近操偶師集團的有一顆寶石被偷走了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Có một điều bạn phải làm trước khi nói chuyện với Jester Priest. Những viên ngọc của các Anh hùng tô điểm cho Altar of Jester. Một trong những viên ngọc này đã bị đánh cắp vài ngày trước.

dialogsBegin.en: The jewels protect the soul of the Jester Hero, but they will not work if one of them is missing. The creature, Sisif, was seen near the alter a few days ago…
dialogsBegin.ar: The jewels protect the soul of the Jester Hero, but they will not work if one of them is missing. The creature, Sisif, was seen near the alter a few days ago…
dialogsBegin.br: As jóias protegem a alma do herói, mas elas não funcionarão se uma estiver faltando. A sacerdotisa disse que Cicipue apareceu perto do altar há alguns dias.
dialogsBegin.cns: 如果英雄宝石中有一个缺失的话，就没办法发挥暗杀集团的能力。听祭司说最近祭坛附近出现了叫做西西普的家伙...
dialogsBegin.de: Die Juwelen beschützen die Jester Helden. Doch der Schutz verliert seine Wirkung, wenn auch nur einer der Juwelen fehlt. Das Masquerpet Sisif wurde erst vor ein paar Tagen in der Nähe des Altars gesehen.
dialogsBegin.fi: The jewels protect the soul of the Jester Hero, but they will not work if one of them is missing. The creature, Sisif, was seen near the alter a few days ago…
dialogsBegin.fil: The jewels protect the soul of the Jester Hero, but they will not work if one of them is missing. The creature, Sisif, was seen near the alter a few days ago…
dialogsBegin.fr: Ces pierres protègent les âmes du Héros, et il nous faut absolument retrouver celle qui manque. Hors le prêtre appelé Cicipue est apparu près de l'autel il y a quelques jours.
dialogsBegin.id: Permata itu melindungi jiwa Jester Hero, tetapi mereka tidak akan berfungsi jika salah satunya hilang. Makhluk itu, Sisif, terlihat di dekat altar beberapa hari yang lalu…
dialogsBegin.it: The jewels protect the soul of the Jester Hero, but they will not work if one of them is missing. The creature, Sisif, was seen near the alter a few days ago…
dialogsBegin.jp: この宝石は英雄の魂を守るもので、1つでも失くしたら、バランスが崩れて危険な状態になってしまうのです。司祭によると、このごろ祭壇近くに＜シシフ＞というものがうろついていて・・・
dialogsBegin.kr: 그 보석들은 제스터 영웅의 혼을 보호하고 있는데, 하나라도 없으면 힘을 잃게 돼요. 며칠 전 이 제단 근처에 시시프라는 몬스터가 있었다고 하는데...
dialogsBegin.nl: The jewels protect the soul of the Jester Hero, but they will not work if one of them is missing. The creature, Sisif, was seen near the alter a few days ago…
dialogsBegin.pl: The jewels protect the soul of the Jester Hero, but they will not work if one of them is missing. The creature, Sisif, was seen near the alter a few days ago…
dialogsBegin.ru: Самоцветы берегут душу героя-шута. Если извлечь хотя бы один, остальные не будут действовать. Несколько дней назад рядом с алтарем видели существо по кличке Руки-крюки...
dialogsBegin.sp: Las gemas protegen el alma del Héroe Jester, pero no servirá si falta una de ellas. La criatura, Sisif, fue vista cerca del altar hacer unos días…
dialogsBegin.sw: The jewels protect the soul of the Jester Hero, but they will not work if one of them is missing. The creature, Sisif, was seen near the alter a few days ago…
dialogsBegin.th: อัญมณีช่วยปกป้องจิตวิญญาณของ Jester Hero แต่พวกมันจะไม่ทำงานถ้าหนึ่งในอัญมณีเหล่านั้นหายไป สิ่งมีชีวิต Sisif ถูกพบในบริเวณใกล้เคียงไม่กี่วันที่ผ่านมา...
dialogsBegin.tw: 如果英雄寶石中，其中一個不見的話，沒辦法發揮操偶師集團的能力。聽祭司說最近集團附近出現了叫做西西普的傢伙…
dialogsBegin.vi: Những viên ngọc bảo vệ linh hồn của Anh hùng Jester, nhưng chúng sẽ không hoạt động nếu thiếu một trong số chúng. Sinh vật Sisif, đã được nhìn thấy gần Altar vài ngày trước…

dialogsBegin.en: It is believed that this creature has stolen the jewel. Find Sisif and return the jewel to the Jester Priest, Homeit.
dialogsBegin.ar: It is believed that this creature has stolen the jewel. Find Sisif and return the jewel to the Jester Priest, Homeit.
dialogsBegin.br: E a sacerdotisa acha que ele roubou a jóia. Por favor, vá atrás dele e verifique se ele está com a Jóia do Herói.
dialogsBegin.cns: 祭司在怀疑是不是这个家伙偷走了英雄宝石，麻烦你去猎杀西西普看看是否他偷走的
dialogsBegin.de: Gerüchten zufolge hat diese Kreatur das Juwel gestohlen. Finde Sisif und bring das Juwel zurück zum Jester Priester Homeit.
dialogsBegin.fi: It is believed that this creature has stolen the jewel. Find Sisif and return the jewel to the Jester Priest, Homeit.
dialogsBegin.fil: It is believed that this creature has stolen the jewel. Find Sisif and return the jewel to the Jester Priest, Homeit.
dialogsBegin.fr: Et la Doyenne pense qu'il a volé la Pierre des Héros. Retrouve la s'il te plaît, et rapporte la à Homeit.
dialogsBegin.id: Diyakini bahwa makhluk ini telah mencuri permata itu. Temukan Sisif dan kembalikan permata itu ke Jester Priest, Homeit.
dialogsBegin.it: It is believed that this creature has stolen the jewel. Find Sisif and return the jewel to the Jester Priest, Homeit.
dialogsBegin.jp: 司祭は＜シシフ＞が犯人ではないかと仰っています。＜シシフ＞を捕まえて、「英雄の宝石」を持っているかどうか、確認してください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그 녀석이 보석을 훔쳐간 것 같아요. 시시프를 찾고 보석을 회수해 제스터 사제 호메잇에게 돌려주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: It is believed that this creature has stolen the jewel. Find Sisif and return the jewel to the Jester Priest, Homeit.
dialogsBegin.pl: It is believed that this creature has stolen the jewel. Find Sisif and return the jewel to the Jester Priest, Homeit.
dialogsBegin.ru: Похоже, он и украл самоцвет. Найди Руки-крюки и верни камень Омейте, жрице шутов. Все ли тебе понятно?
dialogsBegin.sp: Se cree que robo la gema. Busca a Sisif y devuelve la gema a la Sacerdotisa Jester, Homeit.
dialogsBegin.sw: It is believed that this creature has stolen the jewel. Find Sisif and return the jewel to the Jester Priest, Homeit.
dialogsBegin.th: เป็นที่เชื่อกันว่าสัตว์ประหลาดตัวนี้ได้ขโมยอัญมณีไป ค้นหา Sisif และคืนอัญมณีให้กับ Jester Priest, Homeit
dialogsBegin.tw: 祭司在懷疑是不是這個傢伙偷走英雄寶石，麻煩你去獵殺西西普看看是否他偷走的
dialogsBegin.vi: Người ta tin rằng sinh vật này đã đánh cắp viên ngọc. Tìm Sisif và trả lại viên ngọc cho Jester Priest, Homeit.

dialogsAccept.en: Good luck, Acrobat!
dialogsAccept.ar: حظا موفقا، أيها البهلوان!
dialogsAccept.br: Boa sorte, Acrobata!
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你一路顺风喔！
dialogsAccept.de: Viel Glück, Acrobat!
dialogsAccept.fi: Good luck, Acrobat!
dialogsAccept.fil: Good luck, Acrobat!
dialogsAccept.fr: Bonne chance, futur Jester !
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga berhasil, Acrobat!
dialogsAccept.it: Good luck, Acrobat!
dialogsAccept.jp: ジェスターの後継者に栄光あれ！
dialogsAccept.kr: 행운을 빌어요, 아크로뱃!
dialogsAccept.nl: Good luck, Acrobat!
dialogsAccept.pl: Good luck, Acrobat!
dialogsAccept.ru: Удачи, акробат!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Buena suerte, Acrobat!
dialogsAccept.sw: Good luck, Acrobat!
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้โชคดี Acrobat!
dialogsAccept.tw: 祝你一路順風喔！
dialogsAccept.vi: Chúc may mắn, Acrobat!

dialogsDecline.en: The jewel must be returned to the Altar of Jester. We need your help, Acrobat. Speak with me again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.ar: The jewel must be returned to the Altar of Jester. We need your help, Acrobat. Speak with me again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.br: A joia deve ser devolvida ao Altar do Jester. Precisamos de sua ajuda, Acrobata. Fale comigo novamente quando estiver pronto.
dialogsDecline.cns: 嗯...不可以在这里放弃啦！在一点点就完成你的任务了。加油！
dialogsDecline.de: Das Juwel muss unbedingt wieder an seinen Platz. Wir brauchen deine Hilfe, Acrobat. Komm zu mir zurück, sobald du bereit bist.
dialogsDecline.fi: The jewel must be returned to the Altar of Jester. We need your help, Acrobat. Speak with me again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.fil: The jewel must be returned to the Altar of Jester. We need your help, Acrobat. Speak with me again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.fr: Je sais que ça ne va pas être facile avec Cicipue, mais tu n'auras pas achevé ton apprentissage tant que tu n'auras pas ramené la Pierres des Héros.
dialogsDecline.id: Permata itu harus dikembalikan ke Altar of Jester. Kami membutuhkan bantuanmu, Acrobat. Bicaralah denganku lagi ketika kamu sudah siap.
dialogsDecline.it: The jewel must be returned to the Altar of Jester. We need your help, Acrobat. Speak with me again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.jp: えっ？　ここで諦めてしまわれるのですか？もう少しです！力を出して目標を達成しましょう！
dialogsDecline.kr: 제스터의 제단에 보석을 꼭 놀려놓아야 해요. 도와주실 수 있죠? 준비되시면 다시 말씀해 주세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: The jewel must be returned to the Altar of Jester. We need your help, Acrobat. Speak with me again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.pl: The jewel must be returned to the Altar of Jester. We need your help, Acrobat. Speak with me again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.ru: Необходимо вернуть самоцвет на Алтарь шутов. Нужна твоя помощь, акробат. Скажи мне, когда подготовишься.
dialogsDecline.sp: Se debe devolver la gema al Altar del Jester. Necesitamos tu ayuda, Acrobat. Habla conmigo de nuevo cuando estés listo.
dialogsDecline.sw: The jewel must be returned to the Altar of Jester. We need your help, Acrobat. Speak with me again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.th: อัญมณีต้องถูกส่งกลับไปยัง Altar of Jester เราต้องการความช่วยเหลือจากคุณ Acrobat พูดกับฉันอีกครั้งเมื่อคุณพร้อม
dialogsDecline.tw: 嗯…不可以在這裡放棄啦！在一點點就完成你的任務了。加油！
dialogsDecline.vi: Viên ngọc phải được trả lại cho Altar of Jester. Chúng tôi cần sự giúp đỡ của bạn, Acrobat. Nói chuyện với tôi một lần nữa khi bạn đã sẵn sàng.

dialogsComplete.en: This is the Seal of Curenen and the Jewel of the Jester Hero. Thank you for returning this most prized artifact, Acrobat.
dialogsComplete.ar: This is the Seal of Curenen and the Jewel of the Jester Hero. Thank you for returning this most prized artifact, Acrobat.
dialogsComplete.br: Este é o selo de Kerenen e a Jóia do Herói. Então foi o Cicipue que roubou a jóia. Muito obrigado.
dialogsComplete.cns: 这是凯奈的印章..英雄的宝石也在，果然是西西普偷走的。
dialogsComplete.de: Das ist das Siegel von Kerenen und das Juwel vom Jester Helden. Viele Dank! Diese Artefakte sind unbezahlbar, Acrobat.
dialogsComplete.fi: This is the Seal of Curenen and the Jewel of the Jester Hero. Thank you for returning this most prized artifact, Acrobat.
dialogsComplete.fil: This is the Seal of Curenen and the Jewel of the Jester Hero. Thank you for returning this most prized artifact, Acrobat.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tu l'as finalement retrouvée, la Pierre des Héros ! Cicipue... Mais pourquoi donc avoir commis ce vol ? Quoi qu'il en soit, je te remercie !
dialogsComplete.id: Ini adalah Seal of Curenen dan Jewel of the Jester Hero. Terima kasih telah mengembalikan artefak paling berharga ini, Acrobat.
dialogsComplete.it: This is the Seal of Curenen and the Jewel of the Jester Hero. Thank you for returning this most prized artifact, Acrobat.
dialogsComplete.jp: これは、＜カエネン＞の印章。それに英雄の宝石まで・・・。宝石を盗んだのはやっぱり＜シシフ＞の仕業でしたね。感謝いたします。
dialogsComplete.kr: 커에넨의 인장과 제스터 영웅의 보석이군요. 저희의 귀중한 유물을 되찾아주셔서 감사해요, 아크로뱃님.
dialogsComplete.nl: This is the Seal of Curenen and the Jewel of the Jester Hero. Thank you for returning this most prized artifact, Acrobat.
dialogsComplete.pl: This is the Seal of Curenen and the Jewel of the Jester Hero. Thank you for returning this most prized artifact, Acrobat.
dialogsComplete.ru: Геройский самоцвет шута! Спасибо тебе, акробат, за возвращение нашей реликвии.
dialogsComplete.sp: Este es el Sello de Curenen y la Gema del Héroe Jester. Gracias por devolver este artefacto tan preciado, Acrobat.
dialogsComplete.sw: This is the Seal of Curenen and the Jewel of the Jester Hero. Thank you for returning this most prized artifact, Acrobat.
dialogsComplete.th: นี่คือซีลของ Curenen และ Jewel of the Jester Hero ขอบคุณ Acrobat ที่ส่งคืนสิ่งที่มีค่าที่สุดนี้กลับมา
dialogsComplete.tw: 這是凱奈的印章…英雄的寶石也在，果然是西西普偷走的。
dialogsComplete.vi: Đây là Con dấu của Curenen và Viên ngọc của Jester Hero. Cảm ơn bạn đã trả lại cổ vật được đáng giá nhất, Acrobat.

dialogsComplete.en: Now we can protect the Soul of the Hero safely. I am in your debt.
dialogsComplete.ar: Now we can protect the Soul of the Hero safely. I am in your debt.
dialogsComplete.br: Agora podemos proteger a Alma do Herói com segurança. Obrigado. Obrigado.
dialogsComplete.cns: 现在我可以安心的看守英雄的灵魂了，真的很感谢你！
dialogsComplete.de: Nun ist die Seele des Helden wieder sicher. Ich stehe in deiner Schuld.
dialogsComplete.fi: Now we can protect the Soul of the Hero safely. I am in your debt.
dialogsComplete.fil: Now we can protect the Soul of the Hero safely. I am in your debt.
dialogsComplete.fr: Maintenant les âmes des Héros sont en sécurité ! Merci infiniment !
dialogsComplete.id: Sekarang kita bisa melindungi Soul of the Hero dengan aman. Aku berhutang padamu.
dialogsComplete.it: Now we can protect the Soul of the Hero safely. I am in your debt.
dialogsComplete.jp: やっと＜英雄の魂＞を安全に守ることが出来るようになりました。もう一度感謝を申し上げます。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이제 영웅의 혼을 무사히 지킬 수 있겠군요. 정말 감사드립니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Now we can protect the Soul of the Hero safely. I am in your debt.
dialogsComplete.pl: Now we can protect the Soul of the Hero safely. I am in your debt.
dialogsComplete.ru: Теперь душа героя будет надежно защищена.
dialogsComplete.sp: Ahora podemos proteger el Alma del Héroe de forma segura. Estoy en deuda contigo.
dialogsComplete.sw: Now we can protect the Soul of the Hero safely. I am in your debt.
dialogsComplete.th: ตอนนี้เราสามารถปกป้อง Soul of the Hero ได้อย่างปลอดภัย ฉันติดหนี้คุณ
dialogsComplete.tw: 現在我可以安心的看守英雄的靈魂了，真的很感謝你！
dialogsComplete.vi: Bây giờ chúng ta có thể bảo vệ Linh hồn của Anh hùng một cách an toàn. Tôi đang nợ bạn.

dialogsFail.en: I am waiting for someone who will bring me the Jewel of the Jester Hero. Do you have it?
dialogsFail.ar: I am waiting for someone who will bring me the Jewel of the Jester Hero. Do you have it?
dialogsFail.br: Você pode me dizer o motivo de sua visita? Não creio que você tenha um motivo.
dialogsFail.cns: 找我应该有其他事情才对啊？可是我看你不知道为了什么找我ㄟ～
dialogsFail.de: Ich warte auf jemanden, der das Juwel des Jester Helden zurückbringt. Du hast es nicht zufällig bei dir, oder?
dialogsFail.fi: I am waiting for someone who will bring me the Jewel of the Jester Hero. Do you have it?
dialogsFail.fil: I am waiting for someone who will bring me the Jewel of the Jester Hero. Do you have it?
dialogsFail.fr: En ce lieu nous protégeons les âmes des Héros. Mais quelle est la raison de ta venue ?
dialogsFail.id: Aku sedang menunggu seseorang yang akan membawakanku Jewel of the Jester Hero. Apakah kamu memilikinya?
dialogsFail.it: I am waiting for someone who will bring me the Jewel of the Jester Hero. Do you have it?
dialogsFail.jp: 道化師の英雄の宝石を持ってきてくれる人を待っています。 あなたはそれを手に入れましたか？
dialogsFail.kr: 제스터 영웅의 보석을 가져올 누군가를 기다리고 있는데요. 혹시 당신인가요?
dialogsFail.nl: I am waiting for someone who will bring me the Jewel of the Jester Hero. Do you have it?
dialogsFail.pl: I am waiting for someone who will bring me the Jewel of the Jester Hero. Do you have it?
dialogsFail.ru: Удалось ли тебе вернуть геройский самоцвет шута?
dialogsFail.sp: Estoy esperando a que alguien que me traiga la Gema del Héroe Jester. ¿La tienes?
dialogsFail.sw: I am waiting for someone who will bring me the Jewel of the Jester Hero. Do you have it?
dialogsFail.th: ฉันกำลังรอคอยใครสักคนที่จะนำ Jewel of the Jester Hero มาให้ฉัน คุณมีหรือไม่?
dialogsFail.tw: 找我應該有其他事情才對啊？可是我看你不知道為了什麼找我ㄟ～
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi đang chờ đợi một người sẽ mang lại cho tôi Viên ngọc của Jester Hero. Bạn có không?

description.en: Return to Handel and see if she has decrypted the Parchment.
description.ar: Return to Handel and see if she has decrypted the Parchment.
description.br: Volte para Handel e veja se ela decifrou o Pergaminho.
description.cns: 回到汉德尔那里，看看她是否解密了卷轴。

description.fi: Return to Handel and see if she has decrypted the Parchment.
description.fil: Return to Handel and see if she has decrypted the Parchment.
description.fr: Retournez parler à Handel.

description.jp: 冒険家は解読を終えたヘンデルに戻ってください。

description.pl: Return to Handel and see if she has decrypted the Parchment.

dialogsBegin.en: The number of Wheelems has increased so much since I last remember. If it weren't for you, I would have been Dwarpet road kill…
dialogsBegin.ar: The number of Wheelems has increased so much since I last remember. If it weren't for you, I would have been Dwarpet road kill…
dialogsBegin.br: O número de Wheelems aumentou muito desde a última vez que me lembro. Se não fosse por você, eu seria um Dwarpet atropelado...
dialogsBegin.cns: 独轮蒸汽机的数量比上次增长了很多。如果不是你，我估计已经被杀死了...
dialogsBegin.de: Die Zahl der Wheelems hat seit meiner letzten Erinnerung so stark zugenommen. Wenn du nicht gewesen wärst, wäre ich ein Dwarpet geworden...
dialogsBegin.fi: The number of Wheelems has increased so much since I last remember. If it weren't for you, I would have been Dwarpet road kill…
dialogsBegin.fil: The number of Wheelems has increased so much since I last remember. If it weren't for you, I would have been Dwarpet road kill…
dialogsBegin.fr: Je ne comprends pas pourquoi les monstres comme les Wheelem sont toujours plus nombreux.
dialogsBegin.id: Jumlah Wheelems telah meningkat pesat sejak terakhir kali saya ingat. Jika bukan karenamu, saya pasti telah dibabat habis oleh Dwarpet...
dialogsBegin.it: The number of Wheelems has increased so much since I last remember. If it weren't for you, I would have been Dwarpet road kill…
dialogsBegin.jp: 最近、急にモンスターが増えてね。ホイールにも手を焼いていたんだ。助かったよ！
dialogsBegin.kr: 예전보다 휠렘 수가 엄청나게 늘어났어요. 당신이 구해주지 않았다면, 저도 로드킬 신세였을지 모르죠...
dialogsBegin.nl: The number of Wheelems has increased so much since I last remember. If it weren't for you, I would have been Dwarpet road kill…
dialogsBegin.pl: The number of Wheelems has increased so much since I last remember. If it weren't for you, I would have been Dwarpet road kill…
dialogsBegin.ru: The number of Wheelems has increased so much since I last remember. If it weren't for you, I would have been Dwarpet road kill…
dialogsBegin.sp: El número de Wheelems ha aumentado mucho desde la última vez que recuerdo. Si no fuera por ti, me habría convertido en un Enano atropellado...
dialogsBegin.sw: The number of Wheelems has increased so much since I last remember. If it weren't for you, I would have been Dwarpet road kill…
dialogsBegin.th: จำนวน Wheelems เพิ่มมากขึ้นตั้งแต่ฉันจำได้ครั้งสุดท้าย ถ้าไม่ใช่คุณฉันเส้นทางของ Dwarpet...
dialogsBegin.tw: 自從我上次記得以來，單輪機器人的數量增加了很多。如果不是你，我早就被杜爾沛路殺了……
dialogsBegin.vi: Số lượng Wheelems đã tăng lên rất nhiều kể từ lần cuối tôi có thể nhớ được. Nếu không có bạn, tôi đã bị Dwarpet giết trên đường di chuyển tới đây…

dialogsBegin.en: Has Handel finished her research? Oh! She is currently decrypting the Parchment of War? Will you hurry back to her and find if she has finished?
dialogsBegin.ar: Has Handel finished her research? Oh! She is currently decrypting the Parchment of War? Will you hurry back to her and find if she has finished?
dialogsBegin.br: Handel terminou sua pesquisa? Oh! Ela está descriptografando o Pergaminho da Guerra?? Por que não corre de volta para ela para descobrir se ela terminou?!
dialogsBegin.cns: Has Handel finished her research? Oh! She is currently decrypting the Parchment of War? Will you hurry back to her and find if she has finished?
dialogsBegin.de: Hat Händel ihre Forschungen abgeschlossen? Oh! Sie ist gerade dabei, das Pergament des Krieges zu entschlüsseln? Wirst du zu ihr zurückeilen und herausfinden, ob sie fertig ist?
dialogsBegin.fi: Has Handel finished her research? Oh! She is currently decrypting the Parchment of War? Will you hurry back to her and find if she has finished?
dialogsBegin.fil: Has Handel finished her research? Oh! She is currently decrypting the Parchment of War? Will you hurry back to her and find if she has finished?
dialogsBegin.fr: Alors, comme ça vous travaillez avec Handel ? Elle fourre son nez dans les affaires des dieux, vous allez vous attirer des ennuis.
dialogsBegin.id: Apakah Handel sudah menyelesaikan penelitiannya?? Oh! Dia saat ini sedang mendekripsi Parchment of War?? Maukah kamu bergegas kembali padanya dan mengecek apakah dia sudah selesai??
dialogsBegin.it: Has Handel finished her research? Oh! She is currently decrypting the Parchment of War? Will you hurry back to her and find if she has finished?
dialogsBegin.jp: ヘンデルは研究が終わったの？  彼女はいま解析中なのか？ 急いで、彼女が終わったかどうか調べてくれませんか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 헨델은 연구를 끝냈을까요? 오! 지금 전쟁의 양피지를 해독하고 있다고요? 얼른 헨델에게 돌아가 연구가 끝났는지 알아봐 주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Has Handel finished her research? Oh! She is currently decrypting the Parchment of War? Will you hurry back to her and find if she has finished?
dialogsBegin.pl: Has Handel finished her research? Oh! She is currently decrypting the Parchment of War? Will you hurry back to her and find if she has finished?
dialogsBegin.ru: Has Handel finished her research? Oh! She is currently decrypting the Parchment of War? Will you hurry back to her and find if she has finished?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿¿Handel ha terminado su investigación?? ¡Oh! ¿Está descifrando el Pergamino de Guerra? ¿Puedes volver con ella rápidamente y ver si ya ha terminado?
dialogsBegin.sw: Has Handel finished her research? Oh! She is currently decrypting the Parchment of War? Will you hurry back to her and find if she has finished?
dialogsBegin.th: Handel ทำการวิจัยเสร็จหรือยัง? อ้อ! ตอนนี้เธอง่วนอยู่กับการถอดรหัสม้วนคัมภีร์สงครามอยู่เหรอ? คุณช่วยรีบกลับไปหาเธอและดูว่าเธอทำเสร็จหรือยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 韓德爾的研究做完了嗎？喔！她正在解讀《戰爭羊皮卷》？你快回去看看她是不是已經完成了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Handel đã hoàn thành nghiên cứu của mình chưa? Ồ! Cô ấy hiện đang giải mã Parchment of War? Bạn có thể nhanh chóng quay lại chỗ cô ấy và tìm xem cô ấy đã xong việc chưa được không?

dialogsAccept.en: Tell Handel that I said thanks for her concern… If she need my help, feel free to find me at anytime!
dialogsAccept.ar: Tell Handel that I said thanks for her concern… If she need my help, feel free to find me at anytime!
dialogsAccept.br: Diga a Handel que agradeci por sua preocupação... Se ela precisar da minha ajuda, sinta-se à vontade para me procurar a qualquer momento!
dialogsAccept.cns: 请告诉汉德尔我很感谢她的关心... 如果她需要我的帮助，可以随时随地找我！
dialogsAccept.de: Sagen Sie Handel, dass ich mich für ihre Sorge bedanke... Wenn sie meine Hilfe braucht, kann sie sich jederzeit an mich wenden!
dialogsAccept.fi: Tell Handel that I said thanks for her concern… If she need my help, feel free to find me at anytime!
dialogsAccept.fil: Tell Handel that I said thanks for her concern… If she need my help, feel free to find me at anytime!
dialogsAccept.fr: Merci à vous et à Handel pour le coup de main en tout cas !
dialogsAccept.id: Beri tahu Handel bahwa saya mengucapkan terima kasih atas perhatiannya ... Jika dia membutuhkan bantuan saya, jangan ragu untuk menemui saya kapan saja!
dialogsAccept.it: Tell Handel that I said thanks for her concern… If she need my help, feel free to find me at anytime!
dialogsAccept.jp: ヘンデルにもありがとうと伝えてね。私も何か役に立てることがあればいつでも手伝うよ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 헨델에게 신경 써줘서 고맙다고 전해주세요. 도움이 필요하면 언제든 절 찾아오라고도요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Tell Handel that I said thanks for her concern… If she need my help, feel free to find me at anytime!
dialogsAccept.pl: Tell Handel that I said thanks for her concern… If she need my help, feel free to find me at anytime!
dialogsAccept.ru: Tell Handel that I said thanks for her concern… If she need my help, feel free to find me at anytime!
dialogsAccept.sp: Dile a Handel que le agradezco su preocupación... ¡Si necesita mi ayuda, qué no dude en pedírmela en cualquier momento!
dialogsAccept.sw: Tell Handel that I said thanks for her concern… If she need my help, feel free to find me at anytime!
dialogsAccept.th: บอก Handel ว่าฉันกล่าวขอบคุณสำหรับความกังวลของเธอ... ถ้าเธอต้องการความช่วยเหลือของฉันรู้สึกฟรีเพื่อหาฉันได้ตลอดเวลา!
dialogsAccept.tw: 告訴賀丹爾，我對她的關心表示感謝……如果她需要我的幫助，請隨時找我！
dialogsAccept.vi: Nói với Handel rằng tôi cảm ơn vì sự quan tâm của cô ấy… Nếu cô ấy cần tôi giúp đỡ, vui lòng tìm tôi bất cứ lúc nào!

dialogsDecline.en: Look I know I'm great and you would love to spend time with me, but this is sort of important!
dialogsDecline.ar: Look I know I'm great and you would love to spend time with me, but this is sort of important!
dialogsDecline.br: Olha, eu sei que sou ótimo e você adoraria passar um tempo comigo, mas isso é meio importante!
dialogsDecline.cns: 听着，我知道我很棒，你也很想和我在一起，但这件事很重要！
dialogsDecline.de: Ich weiß, dass ich großartig bin und du gerne Zeit mit mir verbringen würdest, aber das ist irgendwie wichtig!
dialogsDecline.fi: Look I know I'm great and you would love to spend time with me, but this is sort of important!
dialogsDecline.fil: Look I know I'm great and you would love to spend time with me, but this is sort of important!
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous faites bien de ne pas vous mouiller dans cette affaire.
dialogsDecline.id: Dengar, saya tahu saya hebat dan kamu akan senang menghabiskan waktu bersamaku, tetapi ini cukup penting!
dialogsDecline.it: Look I know I'm great and you would love to spend time with me, but this is sort of important!
dialogsDecline.jp: 私は素晴らしいと思います。あなたは私と一緒に過ごしたいと思っていますか？
dialogsDecline.kr: 저기, 물론 저와 시간을 보내고 싶으신 마음은 이해하지만, 이게 정말 중요한 일이거든요!
dialogsDecline.nl: Look I know I'm great and you would love to spend time with me, but this is sort of important!
dialogsDecline.pl: Look I know I'm great and you would love to spend time with me, but this is sort of important!
dialogsDecline.ru: Look I know I'm great and you would love to spend time with me, but this is sort of important!
dialogsDecline.sp: Mira, sé que soy genial y que te encantaría pasar más tiempo conmigo, ¡pero esto es algo muy importante!
dialogsDecline.sw: Look I know I'm great and you would love to spend time with me, but this is sort of important!
dialogsDecline.th: ดูสิ ฉันรู้ว่าฉันเก่งและคุณต้องการที่จะใช้เวลากับฉัน แต่นี้เป็นสิ่งที่สำคัญ!
dialogsDecline.tw: 看，我知道我很棒，你很想和我在一起，但這很重要！
dialogsDecline.vi: Nhìn tôi biết tôi rất tuyệt và bạn rất muốn dành thời gian cho tôi, nhưng điều này rất quan trọng!

dialogsComplete.en: I'm glad to see you… I have to finish decrypting the Parchment
dialogsComplete.ar: I'm glad to see you… I have to finish decrypting the Parchment
dialogsComplete.br: Estou feliz em ver você… Tenho que terminar de decifrar o Pergaminho.
dialogsComplete.cns: 很高兴见到你…但我得先破解战争卷轴
dialogsComplete.de: Ich bin froh, dich zu sehen. Ich muss die Entschlüsselung des Pergaments beenden.
dialogsComplete.fi: I'm glad to see you… I have to finish decrypting the Parchment
dialogsComplete.fil: I'm glad to see you… I have to finish decrypting the Parchment
dialogsComplete.fr: Vous arrivez pile au bon moment. Je viens de finir.
dialogsComplete.id: Saya senang melihatmu... Saya harus menyelesaikan dekripsi Parchment
dialogsComplete.it: I'm glad to see you… I have to finish decrypting the Parchment
dialogsComplete.jp: あ…ちょうどよいところに。解析がいま終わったところです。
dialogsComplete.kr: 오, 어서 오세요... 그런데 전 양피지 해독을 끝내야 해서요.
dialogsComplete.nl: I'm glad to see you… I have to finish decrypting the Parchment
dialogsComplete.pl: I'm glad to see you… I have to finish decrypting the Parchment
dialogsComplete.ru: I'm glad to see you… I have to finish decrypting the Parchment
dialogsComplete.sp: Me alegro de verte... Tengo que terminar de descifrar el Pergamino
dialogsComplete.sw: I'm glad to see you… I have to finish decrypting the Parchment
dialogsComplete.th: ฉันดีใจที่ได้พบคุณ ... ฉันต้องถอด decryptioning the Parchment ให้เสร็จ
dialogsComplete.tw: 很高興見到你……我必須完成對紀錄的解密
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi rất vui được gặp bạn ... Tôi phải hoàn thành việc giải mã Parchment

dialogsFail.fil: Go see Handel. She should be done with decrypting the parchment.

dialogsFail.it: Go see Handel. She should be done with decrypting the parchment.
dialogsFail.jp: ヘンデルを見に行きます。今頃、記録の解読が終わっていると思う。
dialogsFail.kr: 헨델에게 가보세요. 지금쯤이면 양피지 해독을 마쳤을 겁니다.
dialogsFail.nl: Go see Handel. She should be done with decrypting the parchment.
dialogsFail.pl: Go see Handel. She should be done with decrypting the parchment.
dialogsFail.ru: Go see Handel. She should be done with decrypting the parchment.
dialogsFail.sp: Ve a ver a Handel. Ya debería haber terminado de descifrar el pergamino.
dialogsFail.sw: Go see Handel. She should be done with decrypting the parchment.
dialogsFail.th: ไปดู Handel เธอควรจะทำกับถอดรหัสกระดาษ
dialogsFail.tw: 去看看賀丹爾。她應該完成解密紀錄的工作。
dialogsFail.vi: Đi gặp Handel. Cô ấy đã phải giải mã xong Parchment.
