description.en: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.ar: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.br: Caçando $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ recuperará seus pontos de Karma.
description.cns: 为了减少你的罪恶值，你要去击杀 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 回来。
description.de: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ jagen wird dein Karma wiederherstellen.
description.fi: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.fil: Ang Pang-huhuli ng $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ay makakapagpanumbalik ng iyong Karma points.
description.fr: Tu devrais chasser des $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s afin de récupérer les points de Karma.
description.id: Berburu $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ akan memulihkan poin-poin Karmamu.
description.it: Stai cacciando $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ per recuperare i tuoi punti Karma.
description.jp: カルマポイントを回復するため、$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を処罰して来てください。
description.nl: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.pl: Polowanie na $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ pozwoli odzyskać punkty Karmy.
description.ru: Твоя цель - $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, только так ты очистишь карму.
description.sp: Cazar $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ recuperará tus puntos de Karma.
description.sw: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.th: การล่า $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ จะกู้คืนคะแนน Karma ของคุณ
description.tw: 狩獵 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 將會恢復你的惡名點數。
description.vi: Săn $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ sẽ phục hồi điểm Karma của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsAccept.en: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.ar: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.br: Cace $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.cns: 击杀 $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.de: Jage $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.fi: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.fil: Manghuli ng $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.fr: Si tu souhaites te faire pardonner tes péchés, tue $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s.
dialogsAccept.id: Berburu $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.it: Caccia $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.jp: では、カルマポイントを回復して差し上げますので、$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を$QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$匹討伐しなさい。
dialogsAccept.kr: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$마리를 사냥하세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.pl: Upoluj $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.ru: Твоя цель - $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$. Требуется покарать не менее $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$.
dialogsAccept.sp: Caza $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.sw: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.th: ล่า $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$
dialogsAccept.tw: 獵殺$QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.vi: Săn $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.

dialogsDecline.en: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.ar: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.br: Você ainda tem que pagar pelos seus pecados...
dialogsDecline.cns: 你还没有为你的罪恶付出代价...
dialogsDecline.de: Du musst noch immer für deine Sünden bezahlen...
dialogsDecline.fi: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.fil: Di mo pa bayad ang iyong mga kasalanan…
dialogsDecline.fr: Quand expieras-tu tes nombreux crimes ?
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu belum membayar untuk dosa-dosamu…
dialogsDecline.it: Devi ancora pagare per i tuoi peccati...
dialogsDecline.jp: いつになったら、この底知れぬ罪悪感から抜けられるのだろう？
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신은 아직 죗값을 치르지 않았으니...
dialogsDecline.nl: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.pl: Musisz najpierw zapłacić za swoje grzechy…
dialogsDecline.ru: Велики твои грехи…
dialogsDecline.sp: Todavía tienes que pagar por tus pecados...
dialogsDecline.sw: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.th: คุณยังไม้ได้ชดใช้บาปของคุณ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 你還沒有為你的罪付出代價…
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn vẫn chưa phải trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình…

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.br: Sua missão foi concluída. Seus pecados foram perdoados.
dialogsComplete.cns: 任务完成，你的罪恶已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Buße getan. Deine Sünden wurden dir vergeben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Questmu telah tercapai. Dosa-dosamu telah diampuni.
dialogsComplete.it: La Missione è terminata. I tuoi peccati sono stati perdonati.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 끝났습니다. 당신의 죄를 용서하지요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Боги одобрили твое деяние и простили тебе грехи.
dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น บาปของคุณได้รับการอภัยแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nhiệm vụ của bạn đã được hoàn thành. Tội lỗi của bạn đã được tha thứ.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

name.jp: 第一次クロックワークス戦争
name.th: สงคราม Clockworks ครั้งที่ 1
name.tw: 第 1 次時空毀滅者戰爭

description.en: Locate 5 pieces War Remnants in Darkon 2 and visit Dr. Estern at the Hill of Shade near Saint Morning
description.ar: Locate 5 pieces War Remnants in Darkon 2 and visit Dr. Estern at the Hill of Shade near Saint Morning
description.br: Por favor, encontre 5 pedaços de evidência da guerra em Darkon 2, e então visite meu irmão, Dr.Estern. Ele está na Colina de Shade, em Saint Morning.
description.cns: 请你去达肯2找战争遗迹碎片5个，再拿给在晨光的Dr.依斯滕！
description.de: Bitte such mir 5 Trace of War vom Krieg in Darkon 2 und dann besuch meinen Bruder Dr. Estern. Er ist auf dem Hügel von Shade in Saint Morning zu finden.
description.fi: Locate 5 pieces War Remnants in Darkon 2 and visit Dr. Estern at the Hill of Shade near Saint Morning
description.fil: Locate 5 pieces War Remnants in Darkon 2 and visit Dr. Estern at the Hill of Shade near Saint Morning
description.fr: Trouver 5 preuves de la Grande Guerre à Darkon 2, puis rencontrer Dr.Estern à la Colline de Shade de Saint Morning.
description.id: Temukan 5 War Remnants di Darkon 2 dan kunjungi Dr. Estern di Hill of Shade dekat Saint Morning
description.it: Locate 5 pieces War Remnants in Darkon 2 and visit Dr. Estern at the Hill of Shade near Saint Morning
description.jp: ダーコン第2地区に散らばっている＜焼けただれた石＞を5つ集めて、セイントモーニング＜シェードの丘＞にいる＜Dr.エスターン＞に渡しましょう。
description.kr: 다콘 제2지구에서 전쟁의 유물 5개를 찾아, 세인트 모닝의 쉐이드 언덕 근처에 있는 제 동생, 이스턴 박사를 찾아가세요.
description.nl: Locate 5 pieces War Remnants in Darkon 2 and visit Dr. Estern at the Hill of Shade near Saint Morning
description.pl: Locate 5 pieces War Remnants in Darkon 2 and visit Dr. Estern at the Hill of Shade near Saint Morning
description.ru: Нужно отыскать пять кусков искореженного металла на Дарконе-2. Доктор То зовет их "эхом войны". Затем надо поговорить с доктором Иначе у Тенистого холма на Санто Моргене.
description.sp: Localiza 5 Restos de Guerra en Darkon 2 y visita al Dr. Estern en la Colina de Shade de Saint Morning.
description.sw: Locate 5 pieces War Remnants in Darkon 2 and visit Dr. Estern at the Hill of Shade near Saint Morning
description.th: ค้นหา War Remnants 5 ชิ้นใน Darkon 2 และไปหา Dr. Estern ที่ Hill of Shade ใกล้ Saint Morning
description.tw: 請你去得肯第二區找戰爭遺跡碎片 5 個，再拿給在聖音特附近闇影丘嶺的 Dr. 法小廷！
description.vi: Tìm 5 mảnh Chứng tích Chiến tranh trong Darkon 2 và đến thăm Dr. Estern tại Hill of Shade gần Saint Morning

dialogsBegin.en: Alright, let's get started. Have you heard of the Great Clockworks War? You'll need to study it before you can challenge Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.ar: Alright, let's get started. Have you heard of the Great Clockworks War? You'll need to study it before you can challenge Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.br: Certo, vamos para o próximo passo. Você já ouviu falar a respeito da Grande Guerra de Clockworks? Você realmente deve se informar a respeito disso antes de desafiar Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.cns: 那么进行下一个阶段！请问你记得大时空毁灭者战争吗？这可是挑战的必备常识！
dialogsBegin.de: Also gut, fangen wir an. Hast du schon vom Großen Clockworks Krieg gehört? Du musst ihn studieren, bevor du Clockworks herausfordern kannst.
dialogsBegin.fi: Alright, let's get started. Have you heard of the Great Clockworks War? You'll need to study it before you can challenge Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.fil: Alright, let's get started. Have you heard of the Great Clockworks War? You'll need to study it before you can challenge Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.fr: Ok, passons à l'étape suivante. As-tu déjà entendu parler de la Grande Guerre de Clockworks ? Hmm... Il faut vraiment que je t'en dise deux mots avant que tu n'ailles défier Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.id: Baiklah, mari kita mulai. Pernahkah kamu mendengar tentang Great Clockworks War? Kamu harus mempelajarinya sebelum kamu dapat menantang Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.it: Alright, let's get started. Have you heard of the Great Clockworks War? You'll need to study it before you can challenge Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.jp: 次のステップに進もうか。君は第一次クロックワースク戦争を知ってるかい？…知らないんだね。クロックワークスに挑むなら、必ず知っておくべきことだよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 좋아요, 그럼 시작해 볼까요. 위대한 클락워크 전쟁에 대해 들어보신 적 있나요? 클락워크에 도전하기 전에 반드시 알아야 할 이야기랍니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Alright, let's get started. Have you heard of the Great Clockworks War? You'll need to study it before you can challenge Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.pl: Alright, let's get started. Have you heard of the Great Clockworks War? You'll need to study it before you can challenge Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.ru: Alright, let's get started. Have you heard of the Great Clockworks War? You'll need to study it before you can challenge Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.sp: Muy bien, comencemos. ¿Has oído hablar de la Gran Guerra de Clockworks? Tendrás que estudiarlo antes de poder desafiar a Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.sw: Alright, let's get started. Have you heard of the Great Clockworks War? You'll need to study it before you can challenge Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.th: สงคราม Clockworks เป็นครั้งแรกที่คนของ Darkon กำลังเผชิญกับอันตรายร้ายแรงที่ Clockworks
dialogsBegin.tw: 那麼進行下一個階段囉！！請問你記得大時空毀滅者戰爭嗎？這可是挑戰的必備常識！
dialogsBegin.vi: Được rồi, chúng ta hãy bắt đầu. Bạn đã nghe nói về Đại Chiến Clockworks chưa? Bạn sẽ cần phải nghiên cứu nó trước khi có thể thách thức Clockworks.

dialogsBegin.en: the Great Clockworks War is the first time the people of Darkon were faced with that terrible menace, Clockworks. The people of Darkon were defeated.
dialogsBegin.ar: the Great Clockworks War is the first time the people of Darkon were faced with that terrible menace, Clockworks. The people of Darkon were defeated.
dialogsBegin.br: Trata-se da primeira guerra em que as pessoas ofereceram resistência a Clockworks depois que ele apareceu em Darkon. Mas Clockworks ganhou essa guerra, e as pessoas de Darkon...
dialogsBegin.cns: 大时空毁灭者战争是时空毁灭者来达肯之后发生的战争，因那次时空毁灭者赢了！
dialogsBegin.de: Es ist der erste Krieg in dem die Leute gegen Clockworks angetreten sind, nachdem er in Darkon aufgetaucht ist. Aber Clockworks hat den Krieg gewonnen und die Leute von Darkon..
dialogsBegin.fi: the Great Clockworks War is the first time the people of Darkon were faced with that terrible menace, Clockworks. The people of Darkon were defeated.
dialogsBegin.fil: the Great Clockworks War is the first time the people of Darkon were faced with that terrible menace, Clockworks. The people of Darkon were defeated.
dialogsBegin.fr: Pendant la première guerre, les habitants se sont opposés à l'arrivée de Clockworks à Darkon. Mais Clockworks a remporté cette guerre, et les habitants de Darkon.
dialogsBegin.id: Great Clockworks War adalah pertama kalinya orang-orang Darkon dihadapkan pada ancaman mengerikan itu, Clockworks. Orang-orang Darkon dikalahkan.
dialogsBegin.it: the Great Clockworks War is the first time the people of Darkon were faced with that terrible menace, Clockworks. The people of Darkon were defeated.
dialogsBegin.jp: ＜奈落～歯車の永久牢獄＞に突如出現したクロックワークスがダーコンに襲来した日、一つの戦争が勃発した。それが第一次クロックワークス戦争だ。…この戦争はダーコンの敗北によって幕が閉じられ……
dialogsBegin.kr: 위대한 클락워크 전쟁은 다콘 사람들이 처음으로 끔찍한 존재, 클락워크에 대항해 싸운 사건이었죠. 이 전쟁에서 다콘 사람들은 패배하고 말았습니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: the Great Clockworks War is the first time the people of Darkon were faced with that terrible menace, Clockworks. The people of Darkon were defeated.
dialogsBegin.pl: the Great Clockworks War is the first time the people of Darkon were faced with that terrible menace, Clockworks. The people of Darkon were defeated.
dialogsBegin.ru: Во время Великой Часовой войны люди первый раз столкнулись с Часонизмом. И проиграли.
dialogsBegin.sp: La Gran Guerra de Clockworks fue la primera vez que la gente de Darkon se enfrentó a esa terrible amenaza, Clockworks. La gente de Darkon fue derrotada.
dialogsBegin.sw: the Great Clockworks War is the first time the people of Darkon were faced with that terrible menace, Clockworks. The people of Darkon were defeated.
dialogsBegin.th: สงคราม Clockworks ใหญ่เป็นครั้งแรกที่คนของ Darkon กำลังเผชิญกับอันตรายร้ายแรงที่ Clockworks
dialogsBegin.tw: 大時空毀滅者戰爭是時空毀滅者來得肯之後發生的戰爭，因那次時空毀滅者贏了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Đại chiến Clockworks là lần đầu tiên người dân Darkon phải đối mặt với mối đe dọa khủng khiếp đó, Clockworks. Người dân Darkon đã bị đánh bại

dialogsBegin.en: They escaped to the Erons Factory. Evidence of this war can be found all over Darkon… Are you ready to continue to the next step?
dialogsBegin.ar: They escaped to the Erons Factory. Evidence of this war can be found all over Darkon… Are you ready to continue to the next step?
dialogsBegin.br: ... tiveram que fugir para a Fábrica Erons. É fácil encontrar evidências da guerra em Darkon. Certo, vamos para o segundo teste. Você está pronto?
dialogsBegin.cns: 达肯所有的人都躲到了绿磷石工厂，去达肯2区可以看到那时的痕迹，第2次测验要开始了！准备好了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Sie entkamen in die Erons-Fabrik. Beweise für diesen Krieg sind überall in Darkon zu finden... Bist du bereit für den nächsten Schritt?
dialogsBegin.fi: They escaped to the Erons Factory. Evidence of this war can be found all over Darkon… Are you ready to continue to the next step?
dialogsBegin.fil: They escaped to the Erons Factory. Evidence of this war can be found all over Darkon… Are you ready to continue to the next step?
dialogsBegin.fr: Ils ont dû fuir dans l'Usine des Erons. Tu peux d'ailleurs encore trouver des indices de cette guerre à Darkon.
dialogsBegin.id: Mereka melarikan diri ke Pabrik Erons. Bukti perang ini dapat ditemukan di seluruh Darkon… Apakah kamu siap untuk melanjutkan ke langkah berikutnya?
dialogsBegin.it: They escaped to the Erons Factory. Evidence of this war can be found all over Darkon… Are you ready to continue to the next step?
dialogsBegin.jp: ダーコン市民はエランパークスまで追いやられた。ダーコン第2地区をよく見ると、あちこちに＜焼けただれた石＞を見ることができる。それでは、二つ目のテストを開始します！
dialogsBegin.kr: 그래서 어쩔 수 없이 에런스 공장으로 도망쳤어요. 다콘 여기저기에는 아직도 전쟁의 흔적들이 남아있답니다... 다음 단계로 넘어갈 준비는 되었나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: They escaped to the Erons Factory. Evidence of this war can be found all over Darkon… Are you ready to continue to the next step?
dialogsBegin.pl: They escaped to the Erons Factory. Evidence of this war can be found all over Darkon… Are you ready to continue to the next step?
dialogsBegin.ru: They escaped to the Erons Factory. Evidence of this war can be found all over Darkon… Are you ready to continue to the next step?
dialogsBegin.sp: La gente escapó hacia la Fábrica de Erons. La evidencia de esta guerra se puede encontrar en todo Darkon... ¿Estás listo para continuar con el siguiente paso?
dialogsBegin.sw: They escaped to the Erons Factory. Evidence of this war can be found all over Darkon… Are you ready to continue to the next step?
dialogsBegin.th: พวกเขาหนีไปที่โรงงาน Erons หลักฐานของสงครามครั้งนี้สามารถพบได้ทั่ว Darkon คุณพร้อมที่จะสู้ต่อไปหรือไม่?
dialogsBegin.tw: 得肯所有的人就躲到艾磷斯工廠，去得肯第二區可以看到那時的痕跡，第 2 次測驗要開始了！準備好了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Họ trốn đến Erons Factory. Bằng chứng về cuộc chiến này có thể được tìm thấy trên khắp Darkon… Bạn đã sẵn sàng để tiếp tục bước tiếp theo chưa?

dialogsAccept.en: Find 5 pieces of War Remnants in Darkon 2, and then visit my brother, Dr. Estern. He is at the Hill of Shade in Saint Morning.
dialogsAccept.ar: Find 5 pieces of War Remnants in Darkon 2, and then visit my brother, Dr. Estern. He is at the Hill of Shade in Saint Morning.
dialogsAccept.br: Ótimo. Por favor, encontre 5 pedaços de evidência da guerra em Darkon 2, e então visite meu irmão, Dr.Estern. Ele está na Colina de Shade, em Saint Morning.
dialogsAccept.cns: 好吧！请你去达肯第2区找战争遗迹碎片5个，再交给Dr.依斯滕。
dialogsAccept.de: Gut. Finde bitte 5 Trace of War vom Krieg in Darkon 2 und besuche dann meinen Bruder Dr. Estern. Er steht auf dem Hügel von Shade in Saint Morning.
dialogsAccept.fi: Find 5 pieces of War Remnants in Darkon 2, and then visit my brother, Dr. Estern. He is at the Hill of Shade in Saint Morning.
dialogsAccept.fil: Find 5 pieces of War Remnants in Darkon 2, and then visit my brother, Dr. Estern. He is at the Hill of Shade in Saint Morning.
dialogsAccept.fr: J'aimerais donc que tu trouves 5 preuves de cette guerre à Darkon 2, puis que tu ailles voir mon frère, Dr.Estern. Il se trouve à la Colline de Shade, à Saint Morning.
dialogsAccept.id: Temukan 5 buah War Remnants di Darkon 2, lalu kunjungi saudaraku, Dr. Estern. Dia berada di Bukit Naungan di Saint Morning.
dialogsAccept.it: Find 5 pieces of War Remnants in Darkon 2, and then visit my brother, Dr. Estern. He is at the Hill of Shade in Saint Morning.
dialogsAccept.jp: ダーコン第2地区に散らばっている＜焼けただれた石＞を5つ集めて、セイントモーニングの＜シェードの丘＞にいる僕の弟＜Dr.エスターン＞に渡してくれ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 그럼 다콘 제2지구에서 전쟁의 유물 5개를 찾아, 세인트 모닝의 쉐이드 언덕에 있는 제 동생, 이스턴 박사를 찾아가세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Find 5 pieces of War Remnants in Darkon 2, and then visit my brother, Dr. Estern. He is at the Hill of Shade in Saint Morning.
dialogsAccept.pl: Find 5 pieces of War Remnants in Darkon 2, and then visit my brother, Dr. Estern. He is at the Hill of Shade in Saint Morning.
dialogsAccept.ru: Разыщи пять кусков искореженного металла на Дарконе-2, а затем отправляйся к моему брату, доктору Иначе. Ищи его у Тенистого холма на Санто Моргене.
dialogsAccept.sp: Encuentra 5 Restos de Guerra en Darkon 2 y cuando los tengas visita a mi hermano, el Dr. Estern. Está en la Colina de Shade en Saint Morning.
dialogsAccept.sw: Find 5 pieces of War Remnants in Darkon 2, and then visit my brother, Dr. Estern. He is at the Hill of Shade in Saint Morning.
dialogsAccept.th: ค้นหา War Remnants 5 ชิ้นใน Darkon 2 จากนั้นไปหาพี่ชายของฉัน Dr. Estern เขาอยู่ที่ Hill of Shade ใน Saint Morning
dialogsAccept.tw: 好吧！請你去得肯第二區找戰爭遺跡碎片 5 個，再交給 Dr. 法小廷，他在聖音特的闇影丘嶺。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tìm 5 mảnh Chứng tích Chiến tranh trong Darkon 2, và sau đó đến thăm anh trai tôi, Dr. Estern. Anh ấy đang ở Hill of Shade ở Saint Morning.

dialogsDecline.en: I guess you truly aren't ready to face Clockworks. Why did you waste my time?
dialogsDecline.ar: I guess you truly aren't ready to face Clockworks. Why did you waste my time?
dialogsDecline.br: Eu acho que você realmente não está pronto para enfrentar Clockworks. Por que você desperdiçou meu tempo?
dialogsDecline.cns: 看你好像很忙，那我就不耽误你的时间了！
dialogsDecline.de: Okay, wenn du etwas hast, dass wichtiger ist als das, dann erledige es zuerst. Das ist nicht sehr dringend.
dialogsDecline.fi: I guess you truly aren't ready to face Clockworks. Why did you waste my time?
dialogsDecline.fil: I guess you truly aren't ready to face Clockworks. Why did you waste my time?
dialogsDecline.fr: Tant pis, si tu as quelque chose de plus urgent en cours...
dialogsDecline.id: Saya kira kamu benar-benar tidak siap menghadapi Clockworks. Mengapa kamu membuang waktu saya?
dialogsDecline.it: I guess you truly aren't ready to face Clockworks. Why did you waste my time?
dialogsDecline.jp: 何か忙しいことでもあるのかい？まあ、そんなに急な用じゃないから、また後で話そう。ね？
dialogsDecline.kr: 클락워크에 도전할 준비가 안 되셨나 보군요. 왜 제 시간을 낭비하신 거죠?
dialogsDecline.nl: I guess you truly aren't ready to face Clockworks. Why did you waste my time?
dialogsDecline.pl: I guess you truly aren't ready to face Clockworks. Why did you waste my time?
dialogsDecline.ru: Значит, на самом деле ты вовсе не горишь желанием сразиться с Часонизмом? Я так и думал.
dialogsDecline.sp: Supongo que en realidad no estás listo para enfrentarte a Clockworks. ¿Por qué me haces perder el tiempo?
dialogsDecline.sw: I guess you truly aren't ready to face Clockworks. Why did you waste my time?
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันเดาว่าคุณยังไม่พร้อมที่จะเผชิญกับ Clockworks มาทำให้ฉันเสียเวลาทำไม
dialogsDecline.tw: 看你好像很忙，那我就不耽誤你的時間了！
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi đoán bạn thực sự chưa sẵn sàng đối mặt với Clockworks. Tại sao bạn lại lãng phí thời gian của tôi?

dialogsComplete.en: My brother sent you, right? Nice to meet you! My name is Dr. Estern, Dr. Est's younger brother. Why did he send... Oh, you're going to challenge Clockworks? Okay, do you have the War Remnants?
dialogsComplete.ar: My brother sent you, right? Nice to meet you! My name is Dr. Estern, Dr. Est's younger brother. Why did he send... Oh, you're going to challenge Clockworks? Okay, do you have the War Remnants?
dialogsComplete.br: Ah, meu irmão o mandou, não foi? Prazer em conhecê-lo! Meu nome é Dr. Estern, o irmão mais novo do Dr. Est. A propósito, por que ele o mandou aqui? Oh, você enfrentará Clockworks? Certo, então por favor me dê a evidência.
dialogsComplete.cns: 你是我哥派来的？你好，我叫Dr.依斯滕！你是为了挑战时空而来找我的！是吗？那请给我五个战争遗迹碎片！！
dialogsComplete.de: Oh, mein Bruder hat dich zu mir geschickt? Angenehm! Mein Name ist Dr. Estern, der jüngere Bruder von Dr. Est. Warum? Oh du willst Clockworks herausfordern? Okay, dann zeig mir bitte die Beweise.
dialogsComplete.fi: My brother sent you, right? Nice to meet you! My name is Dr. Estern, Dr. Est's younger brother. Why did he send... Oh, you're going to challenge Clockworks? Okay, do you have the War Remnants?
dialogsComplete.fil: My brother sent you, right? Nice to meet you! My name is Dr. Estern, Dr. Est's younger brother. Why did he send... Oh, you're going to challenge Clockworks? Okay, do you have the War Remnants?
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh, c'est mon frère qui t'envoie ? Ravi de te rencontrer ! Mon nom est Dr.Estern, le frère cadet du Dr.Est. Ah tu m'as ramené les preuves de la Grande Guerre de Clockworks.
dialogsComplete.id: Kakakku mengirimmu, kan? Senang bertemu denganmu! Nama saya Dr. Estern, adik Dr. Est. Kenapa dia mengirim... Oh, kau akan menantang Clockworks? Oke, apakah kamu memiliki Sisa Perang?
dialogsComplete.it: My brother sent you, right? Nice to meet you! My name is Dr. Estern, Dr. Est's younger brother. Why did he send... Oh, you're going to challenge Clockworks? Okay, do you have the War Remnants?
dialogsComplete.jp: ＜Dr.エスターン＞を知ってるかって？ふふっ、俺が＜Dr.エスターン＞だが何のようだ？俺に会うよう兄さんに言われたって？そうか……クロックワークスに挑むんだな。勇敢だな。
dialogsComplete.kr: 아, 형이 보낸 분이시군요? 만나서 반갑습니다! 저는 이스트 박사의 동생 이스턴 박사입니다. 그런데, 저한테 오신 이유가... 아, 클락워크에 도전하시려고요? 전쟁의 유물은 가지고 계신가요?
dialogsComplete.nl: My brother sent you, right? Nice to meet you! My name is Dr. Estern, Dr. Est's younger brother. Why did he send... Oh, you're going to challenge Clockworks? Okay, do you have the War Remnants?
dialogsComplete.pl: My brother sent you, right? Nice to meet you! My name is Dr. Estern, Dr. Est's younger brother. Why did he send... Oh, you're going to challenge Clockworks? Okay, do you have the War Remnants?
dialogsComplete.ru: Тебя прислал мой брат? Приятно познакомиться! Меня зовут доктор Иначе, я младший брат доктора То. А зачем он... Ты хочешь бросить вызов Часонизму? Я вижу, эхо войны тебя не испугало...
dialogsComplete.sp: Mi hermano te ha enviado, ¿verdad? ¡Un placer conocerte! Mi nombre es Dr. Estern, el hermano menor del Dr. Est. ¿Por qué te envía... Oh, vas a desafiar a Clockworks? Vale, ¿tienes los Restos de Guerra?
dialogsComplete.sw: My brother sent you, right? Nice to meet you! My name is Dr. Estern, Dr. Est's younger brother. Why did he send... Oh, you're going to challenge Clockworks? Okay, do you have the War Remnants?
dialogsComplete.th: พี่ชายฉันส่งคุณมาใช่มั้ย? ยินดีที่ได้พบคุณ! ฉันชื่อ Dr.Estern น้องชายของ Dr. Est ทำไมเขาถึงส่ง... โอ้ คุณจะสู้กับ Clockworks เหรอ?
dialogsComplete.tw: 你是我哥派來的？你好，我叫 Dr. 法小廷！法小紀的兄弟。你是為了挑戰而來找我的！是嗎？那請給我五個戰爭遺跡碎片！！
dialogsComplete.vi: Anh trai tôi đã gửi cho bạn, phải không? Rất vui được gặp bạn! Tên tôi là Dr. Estern, em trai của Dr. Estern. Tại sao anh ta lại gửi ... Ồ, bạn sẽ thách đấu với Clockworks sao? Được rồi, bạn có Chứng tích Chiến tranh không?

dialogsComplete.en: Hmm... Five, exactly! Okay, here you are. This book is about the study of Clockworks. It will be really useful in learning about your opponent.
dialogsComplete.ar: Hmm... Five, exactly! Okay, here you are. This book is about the study of Clockworks. It will be really useful in learning about your opponent.
dialogsComplete.br: Hmm... Exatamente cinco. Certo, aqui está. Este livro está relacionado ao estudo de Clockworks. Ele será realmente útil.
dialogsComplete.cns: 没错，的确是5个战争遗迹碎片！！这个给你！这本书纪录有关时空毁灭者，对你应该会有用的！！
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm.. Genau 5 Stück. Okay bitte schön. Dieses Buch beinhaltet die Studien über Clockworks. Es wird sehr nützlich sein.
dialogsComplete.fi: Hmm... Five, exactly! Okay, here you are. This book is about the study of Clockworks. It will be really useful in learning about your opponent.
dialogsComplete.fil: Hmm... Five, exactly! Okay, here you are. This book is about the study of Clockworks. It will be really useful in learning about your opponent.
dialogsComplete.fr: Hmm... Cinq, le compte est bon. Voilà pour toi donc. C'est un livre sur l'étude de Clockworks, ça te sera très utile.
dialogsComplete.id: Hmm... Lima, tepatnya! Oke, di sini kamu. Buku ini adalah tentang studi Clockworks. Ini akan sangat berguna dalam mempelajari lawanmu.
dialogsComplete.it: Hmm... Five, exactly! Okay, here you are. This book is about the study of Clockworks. It will be really useful in learning about your opponent.
dialogsComplete.jp: では見せてもらおう、君が集めた焼けただれた石を。……1、2、3、4、5…確かに5つ、受け取った。替わりにこの本を持って行くといい。クロックワークスの行動に関する研究成果が記録してある。
dialogsComplete.kr: 흠... 정확히 다섯 개군요! 좋아요. 클락워크를 연구한 이 책을 드릴게요. 클락워크를 이해하고 맞서 싸우는 데 큰 도움이 될 겁니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Hmm... Five, exactly! Okay, here you are. This book is about the study of Clockworks. It will be really useful in learning about your opponent.
dialogsComplete.pl: Hmm... Five, exactly! Okay, here you are. This book is about the study of Clockworks. It will be really useful in learning about your opponent.
dialogsComplete.ru: Искореженный металл до сих пор то тут, то там попадается в Дарконе, не давая людям забыть о войне. Вот, держи. Это книга о Часонизме. Она поможет тебе изучить противника.
dialogsComplete.sp: Hmm... ¡Cinco, exactamente! Vale, todo correcto. Este libro trata sobre el estudio de Clockworks. Te será muy útil para aprender sobre tu oponente.
dialogsComplete.sw: Hmm... Five, exactly! Okay, here you are. This book is about the study of Clockworks. It will be really useful in learning about your opponent.
dialogsComplete.th: อืม... 5 อัน ครบถ้วน! เอานี่ หนังสือเล่มนี้เกี่ยวกับการศึกษาของ Clockworks มันจะมีประโยชน์มากในการเรียนรู้เกี่ยวกับฝ่ายตรงข้ามของคุณ
dialogsComplete.tw: 沒錯，的確是 5 個戰爭遺跡碎片！！這個給你！這本書紀錄有關時空毀滅者，對你應該會有用的！！
dialogsComplete.vi: Hmm ... Chính xác là năm! Được rồi, của bạn đây. Cuốn sách này nói về nghiên cứu Clockworks. Nó sẽ thực sự hữu ích cho việc tìm hiểu về đối thủ của bạn.

dialogsFail.en: Yes? I'm sorry, I think I'm waiting for someone else.
dialogsFail.ar: Yes? I'm sorry, I think I'm waiting for someone else.
dialogsFail.br: Sim? Desculpe, acho que estou esperando por uma pessoa.
dialogsFail.cns: 我哥没有跟你说吗？请你先去达肯第2区找战争遗迹碎片5个。
dialogsFail.de: Ja? Tut mir leid, ich glaube, ich warte auf jemand anderen.
dialogsFail.fi: Yes? I'm sorry, I think I'm waiting for someone else.
dialogsFail.fil: Yes? I'm sorry, I think I'm waiting for someone else.
dialogsFail.fr: Mon frère ne t'a rien dit ? Tu dois m'apporter des preuves de la Grande Guerre de Clockworks, que tu trouveras à Darkon 2.
dialogsFail.id: Ya? Maaf, saya pikir saya sedang menunggu orang lain.
dialogsFail.it: Yes? I'm sorry, I think I'm waiting for someone else.
dialogsFail.jp: はい？ すみません、他の誰かを待っていると思います。
dialogsFail.kr: 네? 저는 다른 사람을 기다리는 중인데요.
dialogsFail.nl: Yes? I'm sorry, I think I'm waiting for someone else.
dialogsFail.pl: Yes? I'm sorry, I think I'm waiting for someone else.
dialogsFail.ru: Yes? I'm sorry, I think I'm waiting for someone else.
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Sí? Lo siento, creo que estoy esperando a alguien más.
dialogsFail.sw: Yes? I'm sorry, I think I'm waiting for someone else.
dialogsFail.th: ใช่? ฉันขอโทษ ฉันคิดว่าฉันกำลังรอคนอื่น
dialogsFail.tw: 是的？對不起，我想我在等別人。
dialogsFail.vi: Đúng? Tôi xin lỗi, tôi nghĩ rằng tôi đang đợi một người khác.

dialogsBegin.en: 8 legendary heroes? Hmm… Maybe… I have a person in my mind… but, I can't tell you so easily. First you must do something to show you are worthy of such information.
dialogsBegin.ar: 8 legendary heroes? Hmm… Maybe… I have a person in my mind… but, I can't tell you so easily. First you must do something to show you are worthy of such information.
dialogsBegin.br: Os 8 heróis lendários? Entendo… Talvez… eu tenha uma pessoa em mente… mas, não posso te dizer tão facilmente. Primeiro você deve fazer algo para mostrar que você é digno de tal informação.
dialogsBegin.cns: 8位传奇英雄？嗯…好像…我脑子里有一个人…但是，我不能这么轻易地告诉你。首先，你必须做点什么来证明你值得这样的信息。
dialogsBegin.de: 8 legendäre Helden? Hmm... Vielleicht... Ich habe da eine Person im Kopf... aber ich kann es dir nicht so einfach sagen. Zuerst müsst Ihr etwas tun, um zu zeigen, dass Ihr einer solchen Information würdig seid.
dialogsBegin.fi: 8 legendary heroes? Hmm… Maybe… I have a person in my mind… but, I can't tell you so easily. First you must do something to show you are worthy of such information.
dialogsBegin.fil: 8 legendary heroes? Hmm… Maybe… I have a person in my mind… but, I can't tell you so easily. First you must do something to show you are worthy of such information.
dialogsBegin.fr: Des Héros réincarnés dites-vous ? Oui, ça me dit quelque chose… mais vous allez devoir stimuler ma mémoire ! *se frotte les mains*
dialogsBegin.id: 8 pahlawan legendaris? Hmm... Mungkin... Saya memiliki seseorang dalam pikiran saya... tapi, aku tidak bisa memberitahumu dengan mudah. Pertama, kau harus melakukan sesuatu untuk menunjukkan bahwa engkau layak untuk mendapatkan informasi tersebut.
dialogsBegin.it: 8 legendary heroes? Hmm… Maybe… I have a person in my mind… but, I can't tell you so easily. First you must do something to show you are worthy of such information.
dialogsBegin.jp: 8人の英雄の転生について……ふむ。思い当たることはありますが、君は情報をタダで受け取ろうとするのですか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 8명의 전설 영웅? 흠… 어쩌면… 떠오르는 사람이 있긴 한데... 그렇게 쉽게 알려 드릴 순 없어요. 먼저, 정보를 드릴 만한 자격이 있다는 걸 증명해 보세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: 8 legendary heroes? Hmm… Maybe… I have a person in my mind… but, I can't tell you so easily. First you must do something to show you are worthy of such information.
dialogsBegin.pl: 8 legendary heroes? Hmm… Maybe… I have a person in my mind… but, I can't tell you so easily. First you must do something to show you are worthy of such information.
dialogsBegin.ru: 8 legendary heroes? Hmm… Maybe… I have a person in my mind… but, I can't tell you so easily. First you must do something to show you are worthy of such information.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿8 héroes legendarios? Hmm… Tal vez… Tengo a una persona en mente… pero, no puedo decírtelo tan fácilmente. Primero debes hacer algo para demostrar que eres digno de tal información.
dialogsBegin.sw: 8 legendary heroes? Hmm… Maybe… I have a person in my mind… but, I can't tell you so easily. First you must do something to show you are worthy of such information.
dialogsBegin.th: วีรบุรุษในตำนาน 8 คน ? อืม ... บางที ... ฉันมีคนอยู่ในใจฉันอยู่แล้ว ... แต่ฉันไม่สามารถบอกคุณได้ง่ายๆ อันดับแรกคุณต้องทำอะไรบางอย่างเพื่อแสดงว่าคุณมีคุณค่าของข้อมูลดังกล่าว
dialogsBegin.tw: 8 位傳奇英雄？嗯…也許…我心裡有個人選…但我不能這麼輕易告訴你。首先，你必須做些事來證明自己配得上這份情報。

dialogsBegin.en: Sury is currently in a perpetual state of self doubt. Despite her unyielding dedication to her training, there is a self-realization she alone will have to make…

dialogsBegin.cns: 叙里现在正处于一个持续的自我怀疑状态。尽管她在坚持不懈的训练，但她仍不得不独自实现自我救赎……

dialogsBegin.id: Sury saat ini dalam keadaan ragu-ragu diri yang terus-menerus. Terlepas dari dedikasinya yang pantang menyerah pada pelatihannya, ada kesadaran diri yang harus dia buat sendiri ...

dialogsBegin.jp: ええ……みなまで申さずともわかります。シュリ様はいま大変にお悩みのようですね。心は生まれ変わっても肉体との接点がないのでしょう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 슈리님께선 끝없는 자기 의심 속에 빠져 있습니다. 끊임없는 수행에 매진하고 계시지만, 더 깨달아야 할 무언가가 있는 거겠죠...

dialogsBegin.th: ปัจจุบัน Sury อยู่ในสถานะที่ไม่ต้องสงสัยเลย แม้จะมีการอุทิศตนอย่างไม่หยุดยั้งในการฝึกซ้อม
dialogsBegin.tw: 修利目前一直深陷自我懷疑。儘管她始終不懈地投入訓練，仍有一道必須由她自己領悟的課題……

dialogsBegin.en: Ahh so you need me to grind these Steel Pieces you say? Piece of cake, just give me a moment.
dialogsBegin.ar: Ahh so you need me to grind these Steel Pieces you say? Piece of cake, just give me a moment.
dialogsBegin.br: Ahh então você precisa de mim para moer essas peças de aço que você diz? Moleza, só me dê um momento por favor.
dialogsBegin.cns: Ahh so you need me to grind these Steel Pieces you say? Piece of cake, just give me a moment.
dialogsBegin.de: Ich soll also diese Stahlstücke schleifen, sagst du? Das ist ein Kinderspiel, gib mir nur einen Moment.

dialogsBegin.fil: Ahh so you need me to grind these Steel Pieces you say? Piece of cake, just give me a moment.

dialogsBegin.nl: Ahh so you need me to grind these Steel Pieces you say? Piece of cake, just give me a moment.
dialogsBegin.pl: Ach, więc potrzebujesz mnie do zmielenia Kawałków Stali? Bułka z masłem, daj mi chwilę.

dialogsBegin.sp: Ahh, ¿entonces me necesitas para moler estas Piezas de Acero dices? Pan comido, dame un momento.

dialogsBegin.th: อ่าา คุณอยากให้ฉันบด Steel Pieces เหล่านี้? ง่ายมาก ขอเวลาฉันสักครู่

dialogsBegin.th: เสร็จแล้ว! คุณไปที่นี่ เครื่องจักรใน Darkon เป็นเครื่องที่ดีที่สุดใน Madrigal! บอกเพื่อนของคุณเกี่ยวกับบริการของเรา!
dialogsBegin.tw: 都完成了。得肯的機械技術原本就很發達，要把這樣的鐵碎片製作成鐵粉末只不過是時間問題。快收下這些鐵粉末吧。雖然不知道你要使用在那裡，但是希望你使用在有用的地方。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tất cả đã hoàn thành! Của bạn đây. Máy móc trong Darkon tốt nhất ở Madrigal! Hãy giới thiệu với bạn bè của bạn về các dịch vụ của chúng tôi!

dialogsAccept.sw: Well hurry on now! You obviously have something important that you require the Steel Powder for!

dialogsAccept.tw: 回去找在等待鐵粉末的人吧。看到像這樣漂亮的鐵粉末，就算說它不是灰塵也會相信呢。哈哈哈哈！
dialogsAccept.vi: Nhanh lên nào! Rõ ràng là bạn có một thứ quan trọng mà bạn cần đến Steel Powder!

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsDecline.en: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.ar: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.br: Você ainda tem que pagar pelos seus pecados...
dialogsDecline.cns: 你还没有为你的罪恶付出代价...
dialogsDecline.de: Du musst noch immer für deine Sünden bezahlen...
dialogsDecline.fi: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.fil: Di mo pa bayad ang iyong mga kasalanan…
dialogsDecline.fr: Quand expieras-tu tes nombreux crimes ?

dialogsDecline.it: Devi ancora pagare per i tuoi peccati...
dialogsDecline.jp: いつになったら、この底知れぬ罪悪感から抜けられるのだろう？
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신은 아직 죗값을 치르지 않았으니...
dialogsDecline.nl: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.pl: Musisz najpierw zapłacić za swoje grzechy…

dialogsDecline.sp: Todavía tienes que pagar por tus pecados...

dialogsDecline.th: คุณยังไม้ได้ชดใช้บาปของคุณ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 你還沒有為你的罪付出代價…
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn vẫn chưa phải trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình…

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.br: Sua missão foi concluída. Seus pecados foram perdoados.
dialogsComplete.cns: 任务完成，你的罪恶已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Buße getan. Deine Sünden wurden dir vergeben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Questmu telah tercapai. Dosa-dosamu telah diampuni.
dialogsComplete.it: La Missione è terminata. I tuoi peccati sono stati perdonati.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 끝났습니다. 당신의 죄를 용서하지요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Боги одобрили твое деяние и простили тебе грехи.
dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น บาปของคุณได้รับการอภัยแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nhiệm vụ của bạn đã được hoàn thành. Tội lỗi của bạn đã được tha thứ.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Hey you... It's no use talking to my mommy right now. When she gets angry, she gets ANGRY.*giggle* Give her some time!
dialogsBegin.ar: Hey you... It's no use talking to my mommy right now. When she gets angry, she gets ANGRY.*giggle* Give her some time!
dialogsBegin.br: Ei você.. Não adianta falar com minha mamãe agora. Quando ela fica com raiva, ela se torna A RAIVA. *Kkkk* Dê algum tempo para ela!
dialogsBegin.cns: Hey you... It's no use talking to my mommy right now. When she gets angry, she gets ANGRY.*giggle* Give her some time!
dialogsBegin.de: Hey du... Es hat keinen Sinn, jetzt mit meiner Mami zu reden. Wenn sie wütend wird, wird sie wütend. *kicher* Gib ihr etwas Zeit!
dialogsBegin.fi: Hey you... It's no use talking to my mommy right now. When she gets angry, she gets ANGRY.*giggle* Give her some time!
dialogsBegin.fil: Hey you... It's no use talking to my mommy right now. When she gets angry, she gets ANGRY.*giggle* Give her some time!
dialogsBegin.fr: Ça ne sert à rien de parler à maman quand elle est dans cet état… mais vous pourriez me rendre un service…
dialogsBegin.id: Hei kau.. Tidak ada gunanya berbicara dengan ibuku sekarang. Ketika dia marah, dia benar-benar MARAH.*tertawa* Beri dia waktu!
dialogsBegin.it: Hey you... It's no use talking to my mommy right now. When she gets angry, she gets ANGRY.*giggle* Give her some time!
dialogsBegin.jp: あのね..！今私のママと話しても意味ないよ！ ママが怒ると周りが見えなくなるの。ほっといた方がいいの！
dialogsBegin.kr: 저기요... 지금은 엄마랑 얘기해도 소용없어요. 엄마가 화나면 아무도 못 건드려요. *키득* 잠시 내버려두세요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Hey you... It's no use talking to my mommy right now. When she gets angry, she gets ANGRY.*giggle* Give her some time!
dialogsBegin.pl: Hey you... It's no use talking to my mommy right now. When she gets angry, she gets ANGRY.*giggle* Give her some time!
dialogsBegin.ru: Hey you... It's no use talking to my mommy right now. When she gets angry, she gets ANGRY.*giggle* Give her some time!
dialogsBegin.sp: Oye tú... Ahora mismo no sirve de nada hablar con mi mami. Cuando se enfada, se ENFADA. *risita* ¡Dale un poco de tiempo!
dialogsBegin.sw: Hey you... It's no use talking to my mommy right now. When she gets angry, she gets ANGRY.*giggle* Give her some time!
dialogsBegin.th: เฮ้ คุณ... การพูดกับแม่ของฉันตอนนี้มันป่วยการ ถ้าเธอโกรธใครซักคนมากๆ ให้เธอเวลาอีกสักพักเถอะ!
dialogsBegin.tw: 欸，你啊……現在去跟我媽媽說也沒用。她一生氣起來可是真的很可怕。*嘻嘻* 先讓她冷靜一下啦！
dialogsBegin.vi: Này bạn .. Bạn không nói chuyện với mẹ tôi được vào lúc này đâu. Khi bà ấy bực bội, cơn giận của bà ấy sẽ rất ĐÁNG SỢ. * Cười khúc khích * Hãy cho bà ấy một chút thời gian nhé!

dialogsBegin.en: Since you aren't busy now, I know you would looooooove to do me a favor! *giggle* A few days ago I lost my favorite Marble Hair band outside of the town. Please please find it?
dialogsBegin.ar: Since you aren't busy now, I know you would looooooove to do me a favor! *giggle* A few days ago I lost my favorite Marble Hair band outside of the town. Please please find it?
dialogsBegin.br: Já que você não está ocupado agora, eu sei que você amaariaaaa me fazer um favor! *risadinha* Há alguns dias eu perdi minha tiara favorita fora da cidade, é uma Tiara Mármore lindíssima! Por favor, você poderia encontrá-la???
dialogsBegin.cns: Since you aren't busy now, I know you would looooooove to do me a favor! *giggle* A few days ago I lost my favorite Marble Hair band outside of the town. Please please find it?
dialogsBegin.de: Da du jetzt nicht beschäftigt bist, weiß ich, dass du mir liebend gerne einen Gefallen tun würdest! *kicher* Vor ein paar Tagen habe ich mein Lieblings-Marmor-Haarband außerhalb der Stadt verloren. Kannst du es bitte wiederfinden?
dialogsBegin.fi: Since you aren't busy now, I know you would looooooove to do me a favor! *giggle* A few days ago I lost my favorite Marble Hair band outside of the town. Please please find it?
dialogsBegin.fil: Since you aren't busy now, I know you would looooooove to do me a favor! *giggle* A few days ago I lost my favorite Marble Hair band outside of the town. Please please find it?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il y a quelques jours je suis allée danser à la fête de la ville et j'ai perdu mon bandeau en perles. C'est mon accessoire de mode préféré…
dialogsBegin.id: Karena senggang sekarang, Aku yakin kamu akan senang membantuku! *tertawa* Beberapa hari yang lalu aku kehilangan Marble Hair Band favoritku di luar kota. Tolong tolong temukan ya???
dialogsBegin.it: Since you aren't busy now, I know you would looooooove to do me a favor! *giggle* A few days ago I lost my favorite Marble Hair band outside of the town. Please please find it?
dialogsBegin.jp: よかったら、その間に私のお願いを聞いてくれないかな？　ほら、この耳あてなんだけど、古くなってぼろぼろになっちゃったの。新しいのがほしいなぁ…
dialogsBegin.kr: 지금 바쁘지 않으시면, 부탁 하나만 들어주세요! *키득* 며칠 전에 마을 밖에서 제가 좋아하는 마블 헤어 밴드를 잃어버렸어요. 부디 찾아주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Since you aren't busy now, I know you would looooooove to do me a favor! *giggle* A few days ago I lost my favorite Marble Hair band outside of the town. Please please find it?
dialogsBegin.pl: Ponieważ nie jesteś teraz zajęty, wiem, że chciałbyś mi wyświadczyć przysługę! *chichot* Kilka dni temu, poza miastem, zgubiłem moją ulubioną Marmurową opaskę do włosów. Proszę, możesz ją odnaleźć???
dialogsBegin.ru: Since you aren't busy now, I know you would looooooove to do me a favor! *giggle* A few days ago I lost my favorite Marble Hair band outside of the town. Please please find it?
dialogsBegin.sp: Como ahora no estás ocupado, ¡sé que te mueres por hacerme un favor! *risita* Hace unos días perdí mi Coletero de Mármol favorito fuera de la ciudad. Por favor, ¿¿¿lo vas a buscar???
dialogsBegin.sw: Since you aren't busy now, I know you would looooooove to do me a favor! *giggle* A few days ago I lost my favorite Marble Hair band outside of the town. Please please find it?
dialogsBegin.th: แม้ว่าตอนนี้คุณจะไม่ว่าง แต่ฉันรู้ว่าคุณอยากช่วยฉัน! *หัวเราะคิกคัก* เมื่อไม่กี่วันก่อน ฉันทำผมทรงโปรดของ Marble หายนอกเมืองไป กรุณาช่วยหามันที???
dialogsBegin.tw: 既然你現在也不忙，我知道你一定超想幫我一個忙的！*嘻嘻* 前幾天我把最喜歡的大理石髮箍弄丟在鎮外了。拜託你幫我找回來，好嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Vì bây giờ bạn không bận, tôi biết bạn sẽ rất muốnnnnnn làm giúp tôi một việc này đấy! * cười khúc khích * Cách đây vài ngày, tôi đã đánh mất chiếc Marble Hair yêu thích của mình bên ngoài thị trấn. Bạn tìm nó giùm tôi nhé, làm ơn đấy?

dialogsAccept.en: Yay! Thank you so much! You are super awesome. If I remember right, I lost it playing hide and seek with Nerco near the Pumpkin Village.
dialogsAccept.ar: Yay! Thank you so much! You are super awesome. If I remember right, I lost it playing hide and seek with Nerco near the Pumpkin Village.
dialogsAccept.br: Ebaaa! Obrigadinha! Você é super incrível!! Se bem me lembro, perdi o controle brincando de esconde-esconde com Nerco perto da Vila das Abóboras.
dialogsAccept.cns: 吖！非常谢谢你！你真是个超级大好人。如果我记得没错的话，我是在南瓜村和尼尔科玩躲猫猫的时候弄丢的。
dialogsAccept.de: Juhu! Ich danke euch so sehr! Ihr seid super toll. Wenn ich mich richtig erinnere, habe ich ihn beim Versteckspielen mit Nerco in der Nähe des Pumpkin Village verloren..
dialogsAccept.fi: Yay! Thank you so much! You are super awesome. If I remember right, I lost it playing hide and seek with Nerco near the Pumpkin Village.
dialogsAccept.fil: Yay! Thank you so much! You are super awesome. If I remember right, I lost it playing hide and seek with Nerco near the Pumpkin Village.
dialogsAccept.fr: Le maire a raison, vous êtes un chic type. Je pense que j'ai perdu le bandeau vers le village Pumpkin.
dialogsAccept.id: Yay! Terima kasih banyak! Kamu Keren. Seingatku, aku kehilangan bermain petak umpet dengan Nerco di dekat Pumpkin Village.
dialogsAccept.it: Yay! Thank you so much! You are super awesome. If I remember right, I lost it playing hide and seek with Nerco near the Pumpkin Village.
dialogsAccept.jp: ほんと！？　ありがとう！　前ね、お兄ちゃんと一緒にカボチャ男爵のいるところで、失くしたと思うの！
dialogsAccept.kr: 와아 정말 고마워요! 정말 멋진 분이네요! 제 기억이 맞는다면, 펌킨 마을 근처에서 네르코 오빠랑 숨바꼭질하다가 잃어버렸던 것 같아요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Yay! Thank you so much! You are super awesome. If I remember right, I lost it playing hide and seek with Nerco near the Pumpkin Village.
dialogsAccept.pl: Tak! Bardzo dziękuję! Jesteś super super. Jeśli dobrze pamiętam, zgubiłem ją bawiąc się w chowanego z Nerco w pobliżu Dyniowej Wioski.
dialogsAccept.ru: Вау! Спасибо тебе! Ты прямо супер крутой! Если я правильно помню, то я потеряла резинку, пока играла с Нерко где-то в городе Тыкверов.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Hurra! ¡Muchas gracias! Eres súper increíble. Si no recuerdo mal, me perdí jugando al escondite con Nerco cerca de la Villa Calabaza.
dialogsAccept.sw: Yay! Thank you so much! You are super awesome. If I remember right, I lost it playing hide and seek with Nerco near the Pumpkin Village.
dialogsAccept.th: เย้! ขอบคุณมาก! คุณสุดยอดมาก ถ้าฉันจำไม่ผิด ฉันแพ้ในการเล่นซ่อนหากับ Nerco ใกล้หมู่บ้านฟักทอง
dialogsAccept.tw: 耶！太感謝了！你太棒了。如果我沒記錯的話，我在南瓜村附近和尼羅可玩捉迷藏弄丟了。
dialogsAccept.vi: Yay! Cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều! Bạn thật tuyệt vời. Nếu tôi nhớ không lầm, tôi đã đánh mất nó khi chơi trốn tìm với Nerco gần Làng Bí ngô.

dialogsDecline.vi: Nhưng nhưng, đó là món ăn yêu thích nhất của tôi… bố tôi đã mua nó cho tôi !!!

dialogsFail.en: Be careful! Pumpkin Village has lots of scary Mr.Pumpkins. When I saw one, I ran as fast as I could and lost my scrunchie!
dialogsFail.ar: Be careful! Pumpkin Village has lots of scary Mr.Pumpkins. When I saw one, I ran as fast as I could and lost my scrunchie!
dialogsFail.br: Cuidado tá?! A Vila das Abóboras tem muitos Srs. Abóboras assustadores. Quando vi um, corri o mais rápido que pude e perdi meu arquinho!
dialogsFail.cns: 小心！南瓜村有很多恐怖的南瓜精。每次当我看到一个南瓜精，我都会飞速的逃走，也正是这个原因我才弄丢了我的发带！
dialogsFail.de: Seien Sie vorsichtig! Im Pumpkin Village gibt es viele gruselige Mr. Pumpkins. Als ich einen sah, rannte ich so schnell ich konnte und verlor mein Haargummi!
dialogsFail.fi: Be careful! Pumpkin Village has lots of scary Mr.Pumpkins. When I saw one, I ran as fast as I could and lost my scrunchie!
dialogsFail.fil: Be careful! Pumpkin Village has lots of scary Mr.Pumpkins. When I saw one, I ran as fast as I could and lost my scrunchie!
dialogsFail.fr: Le village Pumpkin est un peu effrayant, les jeunes du village y vont pour jouer à se faire peur.
dialogsFail.id: Hati-hati! Ada banyak Mr.Pumpkin menakutkan di Pumpkin Village. Aku masih ingat sewaktu bertemu dengan satu dari mereka, aku langsung lari secepat-cepatnya!
dialogsFail.it: Be careful! Pumpkin Village has lots of scary Mr.Pumpkins. When I saw one, I ran as fast as I could and lost my scrunchie!
dialogsFail.jp: 気をつけて！ カボチャ村には怖いカボチャさんがたくさんいます。 私は怖くて急いで逃げたのですが、ヘアーバンドを失くしてしまいました。
dialogsFail.kr: 조심하세요! 펌킨 마을에는 무시무시한 미스터 펌킨들이 엄청나게 많아요. 미스터 펌킨을 보고 도망치느라 머리끈을 잃어버렸어요!
dialogsFail.nl: Be careful! Pumpkin Village has lots of scary Mr.Pumpkins. When I saw one, I ran as fast as I could and lost my scrunchie!
dialogsFail.pl: Bądź ostrożny! W Dyniowej Wiosce kręci się wiele przerażających Dyni. Kiedy ich zobaczyłem, uciekałem tak szybko, że zgubiłem moją gumkę!
dialogsFail.ru: Be careful! Pumpkin Village has lots of scary Mr.Pumpkins. When I saw one, I ran as fast as I could and lost my scrunchie!
dialogsFail.sp: ¡Ten cuidado! En la Villa Calabaza hay muchos Mr. Pumpkins aterradores. ¡Al ver a uno, corrí lo más rápido que pude y perdí mi Coletero!
dialogsFail.sw: Be careful! Pumpkin Village has lots of scary Mr.Pumpkins. When I saw one, I ran as fast as I could and lost my scrunchie!
dialogsFail.th: ระวัง! หมู่บ้านฟักทองมีนายฟักทองที่น่ากลัวมากมาย เมื่อฉันเห็นมัน ฉันวิ่งให้เร็วที่สุดเท่าที่จะทำได้
dialogsFail.tw: 當心！南瓜村有很多可怕的南瓜先生。當我看到它時，我就用最快的速度跑走，然後把我的髮圈弄丟了！
dialogsFail.vi: Hãy cẩn thận! Làng Bí ngô có rất nhiều Mr.Pumpkins đáng sợ. Khi tôi nhìn thấy một con, tôi đã chạy nhanh hết mức có thể và đánh mất con scrunchie của mình!

dialogsBegin.en: Just like armor, weapons differ by the job. You don't have the experence to wield anything in my shop yet, but look around Madrigal, I'm sure you'll find something.
dialogsBegin.ar: Just like armor, weapons differ by the job. You don't have the experence to wield anything in my shop yet, but look around Madrigal, I'm sure you'll find something.
dialogsBegin.br: Armas são diferentes de acordo com sua Classe. Não tenho nenhuma arma que possa usar, mas aconselho você a dar uma olhada.
dialogsBegin.cns: 武器随着职业不同，所使用的武器种类也会不同。在我所贩卖的武器中，还没有你能够使用的武器，但是你可以看看我这有哪些武器。
dialogsBegin.de: Waffen sind abhängig von der Jobklasse. Diese Waffen kannst du jetzt noch nicht nutzen, aber warum wirfst du nicht einen Blick darauf?
dialogsBegin.fi: Just like armor, weapons differ by the job. You don't have the experence to wield anything in my shop yet, but look around Madrigal, I'm sure you'll find something.
dialogsBegin.fil: Just like armor, weapons differ by the job. You don't have the experence to wield anything in my shop yet, but look around Madrigal, I'm sure you'll find something.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il y a des armes différentes en fonction de votre métier et de votre style de combat. Vous ne trouverez rien ici qui vous convienne pour le moment, je vous conseille de regarder ma marchandise par curiosité.
dialogsBegin.id: Sama seperti Armor, senjata berbeda tergantung dari Job. Kamu belum memiliki pengalaman untuk menggunakan apa pun di tokoku saat ini, tetapi melihat-lihatlah sekitar Madrigal, Aku yakin Kau akan menemukan sesuatu
dialogsBegin.it: Just like armor, weapons differ by the job. You don't have the experence to wield anything in my shop yet, but look around Madrigal, I'm sure you'll find something.
dialogsBegin.jp: 武器は職業によって使える種類が違うんだ。俺が販売している武器の中には、今のあんたが使える武器はないが、どんな武器があるか見てみるといい。
dialogsBegin.kr: 방어구처럼 무기도 직업에 따라 종류가 달라요. 지금은 여기 파는 것 중에서 당신이 쓸 수 있는 무기가 없지만, 마드리갈 곳곳을 다니다 보면 적당한 걸 찾을 수 있을 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Just like armor, weapons differ by the job. You don't have the experence to wield anything in my shop yet, but look around Madrigal, I'm sure you'll find something.
dialogsBegin.pl: Just like armor, weapons differ by the job. You don't have the experence to wield anything in my shop yet, but look around Madrigal, I'm sure you'll find something.
dialogsBegin.ru: Оружие, как и доспехи, для каждого амплуа свое. Пока что мои клинки тебе не по росту, ну да ничего - в других лавках есть то, что тебе наверняка подойдет.
dialogsBegin.sp: Al igual que las armaduras, las armas difieren según la clase. Todavía no tienes la experiencia para empuñar nada de mi tienda, pero busca por Madrigal, seguro de que encontrarás algo.
dialogsBegin.sw: Just like armor, weapons differ by the job. You don't have the experence to wield anything in my shop yet, but look around Madrigal, I'm sure you'll find something.
dialogsBegin.th: เช่นเดียวกับชุดเกราะ อาวุธต่างกันไปตามอาชีพ คุณยังไม่มีประสบการณ์ที่จะควงอะไรในร้านของฉันเลย แต่มองไปรอบๆ Madrigal ฉันแน่ใจว่าคุณจะพบบางสิ่งบางอย่าง
dialogsBegin.tw: 武器隨著職業不同，所使用的武器種類也會不同。在我所販賣的武器中，還沒有你能夠使用的武器，但是你可以看看我這有哪些武器。
dialogsBegin.vi: Cũng giống như áo giáp, vũ khí khác nhau tùy loại. Bạn chưa có đủ kinh nghiệm để sử dụng bất cứ thứ gì trong cửa hàng của tôi, nhưng hãy nhìn quanh Madrigal, tôi chắc chắn bạn sẽ tìm thấy thứ gì đó.

dialogsBegin.en: As a Vagrant, you can use a sword in one hand and a shield in the other. Equip them by double-clicking them or dragging them into the appropriate slot in your inventory.
dialogsBegin.ar: As a Vagrant, you can use a sword in one hand and a shield in the other. Equip them by double-clicking them or dragging them into the appropriate slot in your inventory.
dialogsBegin.br: Vagrants iguais a você podem usar escudos e escolher entre espadas ou machados. Você pode usar estes itens se apertar duas vezes neles ou arrastá-los para o espaço adequando em seu inventário.
dialogsBegin.cns: 初心者的你可以使用剑或斧头，也可以装备盾牌。装备的方法只要将点两下物品栏内的武器或拖曳到装备视窗上对应的部位，就可以了。
dialogsBegin.de: Du kannst Schwerter und Äxte verwenden. Auch einen Schild kannst du tragen. Du kannst diese Gegenstände verwenden indem du einen Doppelklick darauf machst oder in das Feld bei deiner Ausrüstung ziehst.
dialogsBegin.fi: As a Vagrant, you can use a sword in one hand and a shield in the other. Equip them by double-clicking them or dragging them into the appropriate slot in your inventory.
dialogsBegin.fil: As a Vagrant, you can use a sword in one hand and a shield in the other. Equip them by double-clicking them or dragging them into the appropriate slot in your inventory.
dialogsBegin.fr: Un Vagabond, comme vous, peut manier une épée ou une hache, vous pouvez utiliser un bouclier aussi. Pour vous en équiper, double-cliquez sur l'arme dans votre inventaire ou faite la glisser dans l'emplacement.
dialogsBegin.id: Sebagai Vagrant, Kamu dapat menggunakan pedang di satu tangan dan perisai di tangan lainnya. Kamu bisa memakainya dengan mengklik dua kali atau menyeretnya ke slot yang sesuai di inventorymu.
dialogsBegin.it: As a Vagrant, you can use a sword in one hand and a shield in the other. Equip them by double-clicking them or dragging them into the appropriate slot in your inventory.
dialogsBegin.jp: 今のあんたは＜放浪者＞だな。それだと、「片手剣」や「片手斧」が扱えて、盾も装備できるな。ん？装備方法？＜I＞キーでインベントリを開いて、装備したい武器、防具、ファッションアイテムのアイコンをダブルクリックするか、装備スロットに直接ドラッグ＆ドロップすれば装備することができるぜ。あ、会話中は開けないから注意しろよ！
dialogsBegin.kr: 방랑자는 한 손에 검, 다른 손엔 방패를 착용할 수 있답니다. 무기를 더블 클릭하거나 인벤토리 슬롯으로 드래그해서 장착하면 돼요.
dialogsBegin.nl: As a Vagrant, you can use a sword in one hand and a shield in the other. Equip them by double-clicking them or dragging them into the appropriate slot in your inventory.
dialogsBegin.pl: As a Vagrant, you can use a sword in one hand and a shield in the other. Equip them by double-clicking them or dragging them into the appropriate slot in your inventory.
dialogsBegin.ru: Бродячие артисты, или просто бродяги, сражаются, вооружившись мечом и щитом. Чтобы взять в руки оружие, дважды щелкни по нему или перетащи в подходящую ячейку инвентаря.
dialogsBegin.sp: Como Vagrant, puedes usar una espada en una mano y un escudo en la otra. Equípatelos haciendo doble clic en ellos o arrastrándolos a la ranura correspondiente del inventario.
dialogsBegin.sw: As a Vagrant, you can use a sword in one hand and a shield in the other. Equip them by double-clicking them or dragging them into the appropriate slot in your inventory.
dialogsBegin.th: ในฐานะ Vagrant คุณสามารถใช้ดาบในมือข้างหนึ่งและอีกมือหนึ่งเป็นโล่ได้ ติดตั้งโดยดับเบิลคลิก หรือลากเข้าไปใน inventory ของคุณ
dialogsBegin.tw: 見習生的你可以使用劍或斧頭，也可以裝備盾牌。裝備的方法只要將點兩下物品欄內的武器或拖曳到裝備視窗上對應的部位，就可以了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Là một Vagrant, bạn có thể sử dụng kiếm bằng một tay và khiên ở tay kia. Trang bị cho chúng bằng cách nhấp đúp vào chúng hoặc kéo chúng vào vị trí thích hợp trong hành trang của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Now you're ready to look at shields. Go see Luda next door at the Shield Shop and he'll take care of you.
dialogsBegin.ar: Now you're ready to look at shields. Go see Luda next door at the Shield Shop and he'll take care of you.
dialogsBegin.br: Bem, vamos dar uma olhada nos escudos. Por favor, visite Luda da Loja de Escudos, ele irá explicá-los com detalhes.
dialogsBegin.cns: 关于武器的说明，这样子就可以了。接着你要了解有关盾牌方面的事情。请你去盾牌商店找路达吧，他会特别对你说明的。
dialogsBegin.de: Ok, nun werden wir uns den Schilden zuwenden. Besuche Luda und sieh dir seinen Laden an. Er wird dir alles erklären.
dialogsBegin.fi: Now you're ready to look at shields. Go see Luda next door at the Shield Shop and he'll take care of you.
dialogsBegin.fil: Now you're ready to look at shields. Go see Luda next door at the Shield Shop and he'll take care of you.
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous aurez besoin d'une épée et d'un bouclier, je vous suggère de rencontrer #cffffdd66Luda, le Marchand de Boucliers#nc.
dialogsBegin.id: Sekarang Kamu siap untuk mencari perisai. Temui Luda di Shield Shop sebelah dan dia yang akan mengurusnya.
dialogsBegin.it: Now you're ready to look at shields. Go see Luda next door at the Shield Shop and he'll take care of you.
dialogsBegin.jp: 武器についての説明はこれで終わりだ。次は盾について教えてもらった方がいいな。＜シールドショップ＞のルダに話かけてみてくれ。親切に教えてくれると思うぜ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 음, 이제 방패를 살펴볼 차례군요. 바로 옆 방어구 상점에 있는 루다를 찾아가면 친절히 알려줄 겁니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Now you're ready to look at shields. Go see Luda next door at the Shield Shop and he'll take care of you.
dialogsBegin.pl: Now you're ready to look at shields. Go see Luda next door at the Shield Shop and he'll take care of you.
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь подобрать себе щит? Зайди к Людору - его лавка находится по соседству.
dialogsBegin.sp: Ya estás preparado para echarle un vistazo a los escudos. Ves a ver a Luda en la Tienda de Escudos de aquí al lado y él te atenderá.
dialogsBegin.sw: Now you're ready to look at shields. Go see Luda next door at the Shield Shop and he'll take care of you.
dialogsBegin.th: ตอนนี้คุณพร้อมที่จะดูโล่แล้ว ไปหา Luda ข้างๆ ที่ Shield Shop แล้วเขาจะดูแลคุณ
dialogsBegin.tw: 關於武器的說明，這樣子就可以了。接著你要了解有關盾牌方面的事情。請你去盾牌店找路達吧，他會特別對你說明的。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bây giờ bạn đã sẵn sàng để xem xét các tấm khiên chắn. Hãy đến gặp Luda bên cạnh tại Cửa hàng Khiên Chắn và anh ấy sẽ chăm sóc bạn.

dialogsAccept.en: Luda's Shield Shop is just next door. Have fun, kid! Stop by anytime you need a good weapon!
dialogsAccept.ar: Luda's Shield Shop is just next door. Have fun, kid! Stop by anytime you need a good weapon!
dialogsAccept.br: Luda da Loja de Escudos está ao meu lado. Divirta-se garoto(a)! Passe aqui sempre que precisar de uma boa arma!
dialogsAccept.cns: 盾牌商店的路达就在我的旁边。他是个有趣的人，你一定要去见他。
dialogsAccept.de: Luda steht direkt neben mir. Er ist ein sehr lustiger Geselle. Du solltest ihn unbedingt kennenlernen.
dialogsAccept.fi: Luda's Shield Shop is just next door. Have fun, kid! Stop by anytime you need a good weapon!
dialogsAccept.fil: Luda's Shield Shop is just next door. Have fun, kid! Stop by anytime you need a good weapon!
dialogsAccept.fr: #cffffdd66Luda du Magasin de Boucliers#nc se trouve à côté. C'est un petit plaisantin mais il est très généreux.
dialogsAccept.id: Luda Shield Shop tepat ada disebelah. Selamat bersenang-senang, Nak! Mampirlah kapan saja jika Kau membutuhkan senjata yang bagus!
dialogsAccept.it: Luda's Shield Shop is just next door. Have fun, kid! Stop by anytime you need a good weapon!
dialogsAccept.jp: ＜シールドショップ＞のルダは俺の隣にいるだろう？いい奴だから、気軽に声をかけてみな。
dialogsAccept.kr: 루다의 방어구 상점은 바로 옆에 있어요. 재미있을 거예요! 좋은 무기가 필요하면 언제든 들러도 좋아요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Luda's Shield Shop is just next door. Have fun, kid! Stop by anytime you need a good weapon!
dialogsAccept.pl: Luda's Shield Shop is just next door. Have fun, kid! Stop by anytime you need a good weapon!
dialogsAccept.ru: Лавка Людора следующая по улице. Удачи, бродяга! Если понадобится хорошее оружие, заходи!
dialogsAccept.sp: La Tienda de Escudos de Luda está justo aquí al lado. ¡Diviértete, chaval! ¡Vuelve siempre que necesites una buena arma!
dialogsAccept.sw: Luda's Shield Shop is just next door. Have fun, kid! Stop by anytime you need a good weapon!
dialogsAccept.th: Luda's Shield Shop อยู่ถัดไป ขอให้สนุกนะ! แวะมาได้ทุกเมื่อที่คุณต้องการอาวุธดีๆ!
dialogsAccept.tw: 盾牌店的路達就在我的旁邊。他是個有趣的人，你一定要去見他。
dialogsAccept.vi: Cửa hàng Khiên Chắn của Luda nằm ngay bên cạnh. Chúc vui nhé! Ghé lại bất cứ lúc nào bạn cần một vũ khí tốt!

dialogsDecline.en: Look, I know it's not as exciting as axes and swords, but you'll need one just the same. Plus he's got plenty of other stuff for sale, so pay him a visit.
dialogsDecline.ar: Look, I know it's not as exciting as axes and swords, but you'll need one just the same. Plus he's got plenty of other stuff for sale, so pay him a visit.
dialogsDecline.br: Oh, ele não vende só escudos, ele também tem alguns itens para Vagrants.  Então você irá conhecê-lo melhor durante o seu tempo aqui.
dialogsDecline.cns: 不只是盾牌而已，他也卖一些初心者专用的装备。他是你一定要知道的NPC。
dialogsDecline.de: Ach ja, er verkauft nicht nur Schilde, sondern auch Rüstungen und Waffen für Vagranten. Daher solltest du den Laden unbedingt aufsuchen.
dialogsDecline.fi: Look, I know it's not as exciting as axes and swords, but you'll need one just the same. Plus he's got plenty of other stuff for sale, so pay him a visit.
dialogsDecline.fil: Look, I know it's not as exciting as axes and swords, but you'll need one just the same. Plus he's got plenty of other stuff for sale, so pay him a visit.
dialogsDecline.fr: J'oubliais, il ne vend pas uniquement que des boucliers, il propose aussi de l'équipement pour les Vagabonds. Il est donc incontournable. Si vous changez d'avis, revenez me voir.
dialogsDecline.id: Dengar, aku tahu ini tidak semenarik kapak dan pedang, tapi kamu juga membutuhkannya. Ditambah dia punya banyak barang lain untuk dijual, jadi mampirlah ketempatnya.
dialogsDecline.it: Look, I know it's not as exciting as axes and swords, but you'll need one just the same. Plus he's got plenty of other stuff for sale, so pay him a visit.
dialogsDecline.jp: あいつは盾だけじゃなく、放浪者用の装備も取り扱っているんだ。あんたがもっと強くなるまで暫く世話になると思うから、ちゃんと挨拶しとけよ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 음, 도끼나 검처럼 멋지진 않지만, 방패도 꼭 필요한 아이템이에요. 다른 아이템도 많이 팔고 있으니 한 번 들러보세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Look, I know it's not as exciting as axes and swords, but you'll need one just the same. Plus he's got plenty of other stuff for sale, so pay him a visit.
dialogsDecline.pl: Look, I know it's not as exciting as axes and swords, but you'll need one just the same. Plus he's got plenty of other stuff for sale, so pay him a visit.
dialogsDecline.ru: Послушай, ты только не думай, что настоящий герой всегда нападает и никогда не защищается. Ты все-таки присмотри себе щит. И что-нибудь еще - у Людора товаров много.
dialogsDecline.sp: Mira, sé que no son tan emocionantes como las hachas y las espadas, pero igualmente necesitarás uno. Además, tiene muchas otras cosas a la venta, así que visítalo.
dialogsDecline.sw: Look, I know it's not as exciting as axes and swords, but you'll need one just the same. Plus he's got plenty of other stuff for sale, so pay him a visit.
dialogsDecline.th: ฟังนะ ฉันรู้ว่ามันไม่น่าตื่นเต้นเท่าขวานกับดาบ แต่คุณก็ต้องใช้เหมือนกัน นอกจากนี้ เขามีสินค้าอื่นๆ มากมายขาย ดังนั้นควรไปเยี่ยมชมเขา
dialogsDecline.tw: 不只是盾牌而已，他也賣一些見習生專用的裝備。他是你一定要知道的 NPC。
dialogsDecline.vi: Nhìn này, tôi biết nó không thú vị bằng rìu và kiếm, nhưng bạn sẽ cần một thứ giống vậy. Thêm vào đó, anh ấy bán nhiều thứ khác vì vậy hãy đến thăm anh ấy.

dialogsComplete.en: Haha, nice to meet ya, name's Luda! I'm in charge of shields and other equipment for Vagrants here in Madrigal. Let's get you set up to fight, shall we?
dialogsComplete.ar: Haha, nice to meet ya, name's Luda! I'm in charge of shields and other equipment for Vagrants here in Madrigal. Let's get you set up to fight, shall we?
dialogsComplete.br: Há há. Prazer em te conhecer! Meu nome é Luda e eu tomo conta dos escudos e itens para Vagrant. Eu irei iniciar a liçao quando você me visitar novamente!
dialogsComplete.cns: 哈哈哈~欢迎你啊。我是负责盾牌和初心者专用装备的路达。下次找我，那时我会对你做一些教育！
dialogsComplete.de: Hallo. Ich bin Luda und verkaufe Vagrantenausrüstung und Schilde. Komm erneut zu mir und wir starten mit der nächsten Lektion.
dialogsComplete.fi: Haha, nice to meet ya, name's Luda! I'm in charge of shields and other equipment for Vagrants here in Madrigal. Let's get you set up to fight, shall we?
dialogsComplete.fil: Haha, nice to meet ya, name's Luda! I'm in charge of shields and other equipment for Vagrants here in Madrigal. Let's get you set up to fight, shall we?
dialogsComplete.fr: (rire) heureux de vous connaître ! Je suis Luda, j'ai dans mes rayons des boucliers mais aussi de l'équipement de Vagabond. Laissez-moi vous expliquer quelques petites choses.
dialogsComplete.id: Haha, senang bertemu denganmu, namaku Luda! Aku menyediakan perisai dan peralatan lainnya untuk Vagrant di Madrigal. Mari kita buat dirimu agar siap dalam pertarungan, oke?
dialogsComplete.it: Haha, nice to meet ya, name's Luda! I'm in charge of shields and other equipment for Vagrants here in Madrigal. Let's get you set up to fight, shall we?
dialogsComplete.jp: ハハハ、いらっしゃい。話は聞いていたよ！俺は、盾と放浪者用の装備を販売しているルダだ。装備品について知りたいのかい？
dialogsComplete.kr: 하하, 만나서 반가워요. 마드리갈에서 방랑자를 위한 방패와 장비를 팔고 있는 루다라고 합니다. 이제, 싸울 준비를 해볼까요?
dialogsComplete.nl: Haha, nice to meet ya, name's Luda! I'm in charge of shields and other equipment for Vagrants here in Madrigal. Let's get you set up to fight, shall we?
dialogsComplete.pl: Haha, nice to meet ya, name's Luda! I'm in charge of shields and other equipment for Vagrants here in Madrigal. Let's get you set up to fight, shall we?
dialogsComplete.ru: Ха-ха! Рад встрече. У меня полным-полно оружия для бродячих артистов. Сейчас подберем тебе что-нибудь.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Jaja, es un gusto conocerte, me llamo Luda! Estoy a cargo de los escudos y otros equipos para Vagrants aquí en Madrigal. Vamos a prepararte para pelear, ¿de acuerdo?
dialogsComplete.sw: Haha, nice to meet ya, name's Luda! I'm in charge of shields and other equipment for Vagrants here in Madrigal. Let's get you set up to fight, shall we?
dialogsComplete.th: ฮาฮา ยินดีที่ได้รู้จัก ฉันชื่อลูด้า! ฉันดูแลโล่และอุปกรณ์อื่นๆ สำหรับ Vagrants ที่นี่ใน Madrigal มาเตรียมตัวให้พร้อมสำหรับการต่อสู้กันไหม
dialogsComplete.tw: 哈哈哈~歡迎你啊。我是負責盾牌和見習生專用裝備的路達。下次找我，那時我會對你做一些教育！
dialogsComplete.vi: Haha, rất vui được gặp bạn, tôi tên là Luda! Tôi phụ trách khiên chắn và các thiết bị khác cho Vagrant ở Madrigal. Hãy chuẩn bị để chiến đấu, nhé?

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsComplete.cns: 任务完成，你的罪恶已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Buße getan. Deine Sünden wurden dir vergeben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.

dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 끝났습니다. 당신의 죄를 용서하지요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Боги одобрили твое деяние и простили тебе грехи.
dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น บาปของคุณได้รับการอภัยแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nhiệm vụ của bạn đã được hoàn thành. Tội lỗi của bạn đã được tha thứ.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.
