description.en: Hunt Down 20 Drillers and return to Corel in Darken City.
description.ar: Hunt Down 20 Drillers and return to Corel in Darken City.
description.br: Esta tarefa é simples. Cace 20 Sondadores em KhipRa, Darkon 1. Não incomode os Pequenos Sondadores ou o Sondador Gigante, ataque apenas os Sondadores. Depois retorne a Corel em Darken.
description.cns: 测验的内容很简单，在达肯1区，打20只钻孔机就可以了
description.de: Wie ich sagte, er ist leicht. Jage 20 Driller in KhipRa, Darkon 1. Keine Small Driller oder Giant Driller, einfach nur Driller.
description.fi: Hunt Down 20 Drillers and return to Corel in Darken City.
description.fil: Hunt Down 20 Drillers and return to Corel in Darken City.
description.fr: Tuer 20 Drillers à KhipRa, Darkon 1 et retourner voir le Maître des Assassins, Corel à Darken.
description.id: Buru 20 Pengebor dan kembali ke Corel di Darken City.
description.it: Hunt Down 20 Drillers and return to Corel in Darken City.
description.jp: ダーコン1地区、キプラと言われている地域に棲息しているドリラーを20匹狩りましょう。
description.kr: 드릴러 20마리를 처치한 뒤, 다켄 시티의 코렐에게 돌아가세요.
description.nl: Hunt Down 20 Drillers and return to Corel in Darken City.
description.pl: Upoluj 20 Wiertników i wróć do Corel w Darken City.
description.ru: Нужно одолеть двадцать обычных буров и вернуться к Корелии в Даркенбург.
description.sp: Derrota a 20 Drillers y vuelve con Corel en Darken.
description.sw: Hunt Down 20 Drillers and return to Corel in Darken City.
description.th: ไล่ล่า Drillers 20 ตัว แล้งกลับไปที่ Corel ในเมือง Darken City
description.tw: 測驗的內容很簡單，在得肯第 1 地區的奇帕拉，打 20 隻暴鑽機械就可以了
description.vi: Săn lùng 20 Drillers và trở về Corel tại Darken City.

dialogsBegin.en: So you think you're ready to become a Blade? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.ar: So you think you're ready to become a Blade? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.br: Você deseja se tornar um Blade? Não é uma tarefa fácil. Mas acho que você está preparado, já que veio até aqui para se tornar um Blade.
dialogsBegin.cns: 要成为刀锋战士英雄的继承者可不简单，你要有心理准备喔！
dialogsBegin.de: Du glaubst also, du bist bereit, ein Blade zu werden? Es ist nicht leicht, aber da du es bis hierher geschafft hast, denke ich, dass du der Herausforderung gewachsen bist.
dialogsBegin.fi: So you think you're ready to become a Blade? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.fil: So you think you're ready to become a Blade? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu aimerais succéder à Heren, Héros des Assassins ? Ce n'est pas une tâche facile, mais je pense que tu en es capable...
dialogsBegin.id: Jadi kamu pikir kamu siap untuk menjadi Blade? Ini tidak mudah, tetapi karena kamu telah berhasil sejauh ini, saya pikir kamu siap menghadapi tantangan.
dialogsBegin.it: So you think you're ready to become a Blade? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.jp: ブレード後継者の道は茨の道だ。それでも行こうというならば止めはしないが、覚悟はいいか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 블레이드가 될 준비가 된 것 같나요? 쉬운 일은 아니지만, 여기까지 온 걸 보면 도전할 자격이 있어 보이는군요.
dialogsBegin.nl: So you think you're ready to become a Blade? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.pl: So you think you're ready to become a Blade? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.ru: So you think you're ready to become a Blade? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Así que crees que estás listo para convertirte en Blade? No es fácil, pero como has llegado hasta aquí, creo que estás preparado para el desafío.
dialogsBegin.sw: So you think you're ready to become a Blade? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณคิดว่าคุณพร้อมที่จะกลายเป็น Blade แล้วหรือไม่? ไม่ใช่เรื่องง่ายหรอกนะ แต่ว่าหากคุณมาได้ไกลขนาดนี้แล้ว ฉันคิดว่าคุณพร้อมสำหรับการท้าทายนี้แล้วล่ะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 要成為暗殺者英雄的繼承者可不簡單，你要有心理準備喔！
dialogsBegin.vi: Vì vậy, bạn nghĩ rằng bạn đã sẵn sàng để trở thành một Blade? Nó không dễ dàng, nhưng vì bạn đã luôn thành công đến nay, tôi nghĩ bạn đã sẵn sàng với thử thách.

dialogsBegin.en: First, a simple test of your skills in combat to see if you are qualified.
dialogsBegin.ar: First, a simple test of your skills in combat to see if you are qualified.
dialogsBegin.br: Primeiro, vamos fazer um teste simples para checar se você está qualificado para ser um sucessor. É um teste de habilidade de combate.
dialogsBegin.cns: 首先，测试下你的战斗技巧及能力，看你是否合格
dialogsBegin.de: Zunächst ein einfacher Test deiner Fähigkeiten im Kampf, um festzustellen, ob du qualifiziert bist.
dialogsBegin.fi: First, a simple test of your skills in combat to see if you are qualified.
dialogsBegin.fil: First, a simple test of your skills in combat to see if you are qualified.
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais je vais te faire passer une première épreuve pour m'assurer que tu es bien digne de notre classe. Il s'agit de tester ton aptitude au combat.
dialogsBegin.id: Pertama, tes sederhana keterampilanmu dalam pertempuran untuk melihat apakah kamu memenuhi syarat.
dialogsBegin.it: First, a simple test of your skills in combat to see if you are qualified.
dialogsBegin.jp: まずあなたが後継者としての資質を持っているか、簡単にテストを行います。この試験によりあなたの戦闘能力を見させてもらいます。
dialogsBegin.kr: 먼저, 전투 실력을 간단히 시험해 볼게요. 자격이 있는지 확인해 보고 싶어서요.
dialogsBegin.nl: First, a simple test of your skills in combat to see if you are qualified.
dialogsBegin.pl: First, a simple test of your skills in combat to see if you are qualified.
dialogsBegin.ru: Для начала испытаем тебя в бою.
dialogsBegin.sp: Primero, una simple prueba de tus habilidades en combate para ver si estás calificado.
dialogsBegin.sw: First, a simple test of your skills in combat to see if you are qualified.
dialogsBegin.th: ขั้นแรกให้ทดสอบทักษะของคุณในการต่อสู้เพื่อดูว่าคุณมีคุณสมบัติเหมาะสมหรือไม่
dialogsBegin.tw: 首先，簡單測試一下你的戰鬥技巧，看看你是否合格。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đầu tiên, một bài kiểm tra đơn giản về kỹ năng của bạn trong chiến đấu để xem bạn có đủ tiêu chuẩn hay không.

dialogsBegin.ru: Go to KhipRa and hunt down $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. Not the Small ones, or the Giants, just regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. That should be easy enough.

dialogsComplete.en: Hmm... Good job, I knew you could do this! Now you are qualified as a successor.
dialogsComplete.ar: Hmm... Good job, I knew you could do this! Now you are qualified as a successor.
dialogsComplete.br: Hmm... Parabéns, eu sabia que você conseguiria! Agora você está qualificado para ser um sucessor.
dialogsComplete.cns: 虽然对你的成果不是很满意，不过，你可以成为继承者了！
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm.. Gute Arbeit. Ich wusste, dass du es kannst! Nun bist du als Nachfolger qualifiziert.
dialogsComplete.fi: Hmm... Good job, I knew you could do this! Now you are qualified as a successor.
dialogsComplete.fil: Hmm... Good job, I knew you could do this! Now you are qualified as a successor.
dialogsComplete.fr: Je pensais que cette mission ne te ferait pas peur. Préfères-tu abandonner ?
dialogsComplete.id: Hmm... Kerja bagus, aku tahu kamu bisa melakukan ini! Sekarang kamu memenuhi syarat sebagai penerus.
dialogsComplete.it: Hmm... Good job, I knew you could do this! Now you are qualified as a successor.

dialogsComplete.nl: Hmm... Good job, I knew you could do this! Now you are qualified as a successor.

dialogsComplete.ru: Хм-м... Неплохо, борец! Думаю, в тебе есть задатки фехтовальщика.
dialogsComplete.sp: Hmm… ¡Buen trabajo, sabía que podrías hacerlo! Ya estas calificado como un sucesor.
dialogsComplete.sw: Hmm... Good job, I knew you could do this! Now you are qualified as a successor.
dialogsComplete.th: อืม... ดีมาก ฉันรู้ว่าคุณทำได้! ตอนนี้คุณมีคุณสมบัติเป็นผู้สืบทอดแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 雖然對你的成果不是很滿意，不過，你可以成為繼承者了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Hmm ... Làm tốt lắm, tôi biết bạn có thể làm được điều này! Bây giờ bạn đã đủ phẩm chất trở thành người kế nhiệm.

dialogsFail.en: Exactly 20 Drillers, Mercenary. That's what you'll need to take your first steps to becoming a Blade.
dialogsFail.ar: Exactly 20 Drillers, Mercenary. That's what you'll need to take your first steps to becoming a Blade.

dialogsBegin.en: As Kumah may have told you, our power is not as strong as it once was. This place takes a toll on your strength.
dialogsBegin.ar: As Kumah may have told you, our power is not as strong as it once was. This place takes a toll on your strength.
dialogsBegin.br: Como Kumah deve ter dito a você, nosso poder não é tão forte quanto antes. Este lugar cobra um preço de sua força.
dialogsBegin.cns: 正如库马所言，我们的力量不像以前那么强大了。这个地方会消耗你的力量。
dialogsBegin.de: Wie Kumah dir vielleicht gesagt hat, unsere Kraft ist nicht mehr so stark wie sie einst war. Dieser Ort fordert viel unserer Stärke.
dialogsBegin.fi: As Kumah may have told you, our power is not as strong as it once was. This place takes a toll on your strength.
dialogsBegin.fil: As Kumah may have told you, our power is not as strong as it once was. This place takes a toll on your strength.
dialogsBegin.fr: Comme Kumah te l'a peut-être dit, nos pouvoirs ont diminué. Ce lieu a tendance à saper les forces de quiconque y reste.
dialogsBegin.id: Seperti yang Kumah katakan padamu, kekuatan kami tidak sekuat dulu. Tempat ini membebani kekuatan kita.
dialogsBegin.it: As Kumah may have told you, our power is not as strong as it once was. This place takes a toll on your strength.
dialogsBegin.jp: クマーが言ったように、私たちの力はかつてほど強力ではない。ここは体力の消耗が激しくてな。
dialogsBegin.kr: 쿠마가 말했겠지만, 우리 힘은 예전만큼 강하지 않아요. 이곳도 힘에 큰 타격을 주죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: As Kumah may have told you, our power is not as strong as it once was. This place takes a toll on your strength.
dialogsBegin.pl: As Kumah may have told you, our power is not as strong as it once was. This place takes a toll on your strength.
dialogsBegin.ru: As Kumah may have told you, our power is not as strong as it once was. This place takes a toll on your strength.
dialogsBegin.sp: Como ya te habrá dicho Kumah, nuestro poder no es tan fuerte como antes. Este lugar afecta tu fuerza.
dialogsBegin.sw: As Kumah may have told you, our power is not as strong as it once was. This place takes a toll on your strength.
dialogsBegin.th: อย่างที่คูมาห์เคยบอกคุณ พลังของเราไม่ได้แข็งแกร่งอย่างที่เคยเป็นมา สถานที่แห่งนี้ต้องแลกมาด้วยความแข็งแกร่งของคุณ
dialogsBegin.tw: 正如庫瑪可能告訴你的那樣，我們的力量不像以前那麼強大了。這個地方會消耗你的力量。
dialogsBegin.vi: Như Kumah đã nói với bạn, sức mạnh của chúng ta không còn mạnh như trước đây. Nơi này sẽ ảnh hưởng đến sức mạnh của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: I have unfortunately been trapped in this spot for a while. I can take on Meteonykers, but some powerful Berserk Meteonykers have been swarming the place in search of us guardians.
dialogsBegin.ar: I have unfortunately been trapped in this spot for a while. I can take on Meteonykers, but some powerful Berserk Meteonykers have been swarming the place in search of us guardians.
dialogsBegin.br: Infelizmente, fiquei preso neste local por um tempo. Eu posso enfrentar Meteonykers, mas alguns poderosos Meteonykers Furiosos estão invadindo o lugar em busca de nós, guardiões.
dialogsBegin.cns: 不幸的是，我被困在这个地方有一段时间了。我可以对付一些飞龙，但一些强大的狂暴飞龙已经蜂拥而至，在寻找我们的守护者。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich bin leider schon eine Weile an diesem Ort gefangen. Ich kann es mit Meteonykern aufnehmen, aber einige mächtige Berserk Meteonyker haben den Ort auf der Suche nach uns Wächtern umschwärmt.
dialogsBegin.fi: I have unfortunately been trapped in this spot for a while. I can take on Meteonykers, but some powerful Berserk Meteonykers have been swarming the place in search of us guardians.
dialogsBegin.fil: I have unfortunately been trapped in this spot for a while. I can take on Meteonykers, but some powerful Berserk Meteonykers have been swarming the place in search of us guardians.
dialogsBegin.fr: Malheureusement, cela fait longtemps que je suis coincé ici. Je peux vaincre les Meteonykers, mais il existent de puissants monstres appelés Meteonkyers Berserk qui errent ce lieu à notre recherche.
dialogsBegin.id: Sayangnya saya telah terjebak di tempat ini untuk sementara waktu. Saya dapat menghadapi Meteonykers, tetapi beberapa Berserk Meteonykers yang kuat telah mengerumuni tempat itu untuk mencari kami para penjaga.
dialogsBegin.it: I have unfortunately been trapped in this spot for a while. I can take on Meteonykers, but some powerful Berserk Meteonykers have been swarming the place in search of us guardians.
dialogsBegin.jp: 残念だが、私はしばらくこの場所に閉じ込められている。メテオニカならなんとか引き受けることができるが、バーサクメテオニカが私たち守護者を見つけては囲んでしまうんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 불행하게도, 저는 한동안 이곳에 갇혀 있었답니다. 저도 메테오니커를 상대할 수는 있지만, 강력한 광란의 메테오니커들까지 우리 가디언들을 찾아 이곳에 몰려들었죠.

dialogsBegin.sp: Desafortunadamente he estado atrapado en este lugar por un tiempo. Puedo enfrentarme a Meteonykers, pero algunos Meteonykers Enloquecidos muy poderosos han invadido el lugar para encontrarnos a nosotros, los guardianes.
dialogsBegin.sw: I have unfortunately been trapped in this spot for a while. I can take on Meteonykers, but some powerful Berserk Meteonykers have been swarming the place in search of us guardians.
dialogsBegin.th: โชคไม่ดีที่ฉันถูกขังอยู่ในจุดนี้มาระยะหนึ่งแล้ว ฉันสามารถจัดการกับ Meteonykers ได้ แต่ Berserk Meteonykers ที่ทรงพลังบางคนได้รวบรวมสถานที่เพื่อค้นหาพวกเราผู้พิทักษ์
dialogsBegin.tw: 不幸的是，我被困在這個地方有一段時間了。我可以對付 地炎飛龍，但一些強大的狂暴地炎飛龍 已經蜂擁而至，尋找我們的守護者。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi không may bị mắc kẹt ở chỗ này trong một thời gian. Tôi có thể đối đầu với Meteonyker, nhưng một số Berserk Meteonyker mạnh mẽ đã tràn đến nơi này để tìm kiếm các guardian.

dialogsBegin.en: Can you help me escape? In return, I will give you the second piece of the key you will need to enter the lair of the Red Meteonyker.
dialogsBegin.ar: Can you help me escape? In return, I will give you the second piece of the key you will need to enter the lair of the Red Meteonyker.
dialogsBegin.br: Você pode me ajudar a escapar? Em troca, darei a você a segunda parte da chave que você precisará para entrar no covil do Meteonyker Vermelho.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你能帮我脱离危险吗？作为回报，我会给你第二把钥匙。
dialogsBegin.de: Kannst du mir helfen zu entkommen? Dafür bekommst du den zweiten Teil des Schlüssels für den Bau des Red Meteonyker.
dialogsBegin.fi: Can you help me escape? In return, I will give you the second piece of the key you will need to enter the lair of the Red Meteonyker.
dialogsBegin.fil: Can you help me escape? In return, I will give you the second piece of the key you will need to enter the lair of the Red Meteonyker.
dialogsBegin.fr: Peux-tu m'aider à m'échapper ? En retour, je te donnerai le deuxième morceau de clé dont tu auras besoin pour entrer dans le repaire du Meteonyker Rouge.
dialogsBegin.id: Bisakah kamu membantuku melarikan diri? Sebagai imbalannya, aku akan memberimu bagian kedua dari kunci yang kau perlukan untuk memasuki sarang Red Meteonyker.
dialogsBegin.it: Can you help me escape? In return, I will give you the second piece of the key you will need to enter the lair of the Red Meteonyker.
dialogsBegin.jp: 脱出を手伝ってくれないか？その代わりと言ったらなんだが、レッドメテオニカの部屋へ入るために必要な鍵の欠片を渡そう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 탈출하도록 도와주실 수 있나요? 대신 빨강 메테오니커의 은신처에 들어가는 데 필요한 두 번째 열쇠 조각을 드릴게요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Can you help me escape? In return, I will give you the second piece of the key you will need to enter the lair of the Red Meteonyker.
dialogsBegin.pl: Can you help me escape? In return, I will give you the second piece of the key you will need to enter the lair of the Red Meteonyker.
dialogsBegin.ru: Can you help me escape? In return, I will give you the second piece of the key you will need to enter the lair of the Red Meteonyker.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Podrías ayudarme a escapar? A cambio, te daré la segunda pieza de la llave que necesitas para entrar en la guarida del Meteonyker Rojo.
dialogsBegin.sw: Can you help me escape? In return, I will give you the second piece of the key you will need to enter the lair of the Red Meteonyker.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณช่วยฉันหนีได้ไหม ในทางกลับกัน ฉันจะให้กุญแจชิ้นที่สองแก่คุณ ซึ่งคุณจะต้องเข้าไปในถ้ำ Red Meteonyker
dialogsBegin.tw: 你能幫我逃跑嗎？作為回報，我會給你第二把鑰匙，你需要進入炙焰飛龍的巢穴。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có thể giúp tôi thoát được không? Đổi lại, tôi sẽ đưa cho bạn mảnh chìa khóa thứ hai mà bạn sẽ cần để vào hang ổ của Red Meteonyker.

dialogsAccept.en: Why thank you, kind stranger. I will wait here for you.
dialogsAccept.ar: Why thank you, kind stranger. I will wait here for you.

dialogsAccept.cns: 谢谢你，善良的陌生人。我会在这里等你。
dialogsAccept.de: Danke, Fremder. Ich werde hier auf dich warten.
dialogsAccept.fi: Why thank you, kind stranger. I will wait here for you.
dialogsAccept.fil: Why thank you, kind stranger. I will wait here for you.
dialogsAccept.fr: Merci, étranger. Je t'attendrai ici.
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih, orang asing yang baik hati. Aku akan menunggumu disini.
dialogsAccept.it: Why thank you, kind stranger. I will wait here for you.
dialogsAccept.jp: すまないな、親切な冒険者。ここで待っているぞ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 정말 감사합니다, 낯선 분이여. 여기서 기다릴게요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Why thank you, kind stranger. I will wait here for you.
dialogsAccept.pl: Why thank you, kind stranger. I will wait here for you.
dialogsAccept.ru: Why thank you, kind stranger. I will wait here for you.
dialogsAccept.sp: Gracias, amable extranjero. Te esperaré aquí.
dialogsAccept.sw: Why thank you, kind stranger. I will wait here for you.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอบคุณทำไม คนแปลกหน้าใจดี ฉันจะรอคุณที่นี่
dialogsAccept.tw: 為什麼謝謝你，善良的陌生人。我會在這裡等你。
dialogsAccept.vi: Sao lại cảm ơn, người lạ tốt bụng. Tôi sẽ đợi bạn ở đây.

dialogsComplete.en: There is only one piece left, in the hands of our fellow guardian Airon. She is stubborn though, and you might need to convince her... if you can find her.
dialogsComplete.ar: There is only one piece left, in the hands of our fellow guardian Airon. She is stubborn though, and you might need to convince her... if you can find her.
dialogsComplete.br: Resta apenas uma parte, que está nas mãos da nossa colega guardiã Airon. Ela é teimosa, então, talvez você irá precisar convencê-la... se você puder encontrá-la.
dialogsComplete.cns: 只剩下最后一把了，它在我们的守护者艾隆手中。不过她很固执，你可能需要说服她……如果你能找到她的话。
dialogsComplete.de: Es ist nur ein Stück übrig. Es befindet sich in den Händen von Beschützer Airon. Sie ist stur, und du wirst sie überzeugen müssen... wenn du sie finden kannst.
dialogsComplete.fi: There is only one piece left, in the hands of our fellow guardian Airon. She is stubborn though, and you might need to convince her... if you can find her.
dialogsComplete.fil: There is only one piece left, in the hands of our fellow guardian Airon. She is stubborn though, and you might need to convince her... if you can find her.
dialogsComplete.fr: Il ne manque plus qu'un morceau, qui est entre les mains de la gardienne Airon. Mais elle est très têtue, il te faudra sans doute la convaincre... Si tu arrives à la trouver.
dialogsComplete.id: Hanya ada satu bagian yang tersisa, di tangan rekan Guardian kita, Airon. Dia keras kepala, dan kamu mungkin perlu meyakinkannya... jika kamu bisa menemukannya.
dialogsComplete.it: There is only one piece left, in the hands of our fellow guardian Airon. She is stubborn though, and you might need to convince her... if you can find her.
dialogsComplete.jp: 私たちの仲間の守護者アイロンが持っているのが最後の1つです。彼女は頑固なので、説得する必要があるかもしれません...彼女を見つけることができればですが。
dialogsComplete.kr: 마지막 한 조각은 우리 동료 가디언 에어론의 손에 있어요. 하지만 에어론은 고집이 세서 잘 설득해야 할 겁니다... 찾을 수 있다면 말이죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: There is only one piece left, in the hands of our fellow guardian Airon. She is stubborn though, and you might need to convince her... if you can find her.
dialogsComplete.pl: There is only one piece left, in the hands of our fellow guardian Airon. She is stubborn though, and you might need to convince her... if you can find her.
dialogsComplete.ru: There is only one piece left, in the hands of our fellow guardian Airon. She is stubborn though, and you might need to convince her... if you can find her.
dialogsComplete.sp: Solo queda una pieza, en manos de nuestra compañera guardián Airon. Sin embargo, es terca y es posible que tengas que convencerla... si puedes encontrarla.
dialogsComplete.sw: There is only one piece left, in the hands of our fellow guardian Airon. She is stubborn though, and you might need to convince her... if you can find her.
dialogsComplete.th: เหลือเพียงชิ้นเดียวในมือของ Airon ผู้พิทักษ์ของเรา เธอเป็นคนดื้อรั้น และคุณอาจต้องโน้มน้าวเธอ... ถ้าคุณหาเธอเจอ
dialogsComplete.tw: 只剩下一件，在我們的守護者艾倫手中，不過她很固執，你可能需要說服她……如果你能找到她的話。
dialogsComplete.vi: Chỉ còn một mảnh chìa khóa, nằm trong tay guardian, Airon của chúng ta. Tuy nhiên, cô ấy rất cứng đầu, và bạn cần phải thuyết phục cô ấy ... nếu bạn tìm thấy cô ấy.

description.en: The Glacial Augu is now overpowered from all of this crystal essence and has become nearly unstoppable. Can you help us defeat it and retrieve its crystal essence?
description.ar: The Glacial Augu is now overpowered from all of this crystal essence and has become nearly unstoppable. Can you help us defeat it and retrieve its crystal essence?
description.br: O Augu Glacial agora é dominado por toda essa essência de cristal e se tornou quase imparável. Você pode nos ajudar a derrotá-lo e recuperar sua essência de cristal?
description.cns: 冰川尖角蜥现在被水晶精华强化了，变得几乎不可阻挡。你能帮助我们打败它并取回它的水晶精华吗？
description.de: Der Glacial Augu ist nun verstärkt durch die Kristallessenz und ist fast unaufhaltbar. Kannst du uns helfen es zu besiegen und die Kristallessenz zu holen?
description.fi: The Glacial Augu is now overpowered from all of this crystal essence and has become nearly unstoppable. Can you help us defeat it and retrieve its crystal essence?
description.fil: The Glacial Augu is now overpowered from all of this crystal essence and has become nearly unstoppable. Can you help us defeat it and retrieve its crystal essence?
description.fr: Toute cette essence de cristaux à rendu l'Augu Glacial surpuissant, il est presque impossible de l'arrêter. Pouvez-vous nous aider à le tuer et à récupérer cette essence ?
description.id: The Glacial Augu sekarang dikuasai dari semua crystal essence ini dan telah menjadi hampir tak terbendung. Bisakah kamu membantu kami mengalahkannya dan mengambil esensi kristalnya?
description.it: The Glacial Augu is now overpowered from all of this crystal essence and has become nearly unstoppable. Can you help us defeat it and retrieve its crystal essence?
description.jp: 狂ったアウグは今、クリスタルによって力を蓄え、無敵とも言える状態となってしまいました。もう私たちにはどうすることもできません。アウグらを倒し、クリスタル本来の姿を取り戻す力添えをいただけないでしょうか。
description.kr: 크리스탈 정수 때문에 빙하 아우구가 막을 수 없을 정도로 강력해져 버렸어요. 빙하 아우구를 처치하고 크리스탈 정수를 되찾아주실 수 있나요?
description.nl: The Glacial Augu is now overpowered from all of this crystal essence and has become nearly unstoppable. Can you help us defeat it and retrieve its crystal essence?
description.pl: The Glacial Augu is now overpowered from all of this crystal essence and has become nearly unstoppable. Can you help us defeat it and retrieve its crystal essence?
description.ru: The Glacial Augu is now overpowered from all of this crystal essence and has become nearly unstoppable. Can you help us defeat it and retrieve its crystal essence?
description.sp: El Augu Glacial ahora está dominado por toda esta esencia de cristal y se ha vuelto casi imparable. ¿Puedes ayudarnos a derrotarlo y recuperar la Esencia de Cristal?
description.sw: The Glacial Augu is now overpowered from all of this crystal essence and has become nearly unstoppable. Can you help us defeat it and retrieve its crystal essence?
description.th: Glacial Augu ได้รับพลังจากคริสตัลทั้งหมดและเกือบจะผ่านพ้นไม่ได้ คุณช่วยเราเอาชนะมันและดึงแก่นคริสตัลของมันกลับมาได้ไหม?
description.tw: 冰川奧古現在被所有這些水晶精華所壓倒，幾乎不可阻擋。你能幫助我們打敗它並取回它的水晶精華嗎？
description.vi: Glacial Augu hiện đã bị chế ngự bởi tất cả tinh chất pha lê này và gần như liên tục. Bạn có thể giúp chúng tôi đánh bại nó và lấy lại tinh chất pha lê của nó không?

dialogsBegin.en: Now our town is stronger than ever! Unfortunately, we are still lacking a lot of resources.
dialogsBegin.ar: Now our town is stronger than ever! Unfortunately, we are still lacking a lot of resources.
dialogsBegin.br: Agora nossa cidade está mais forte do que nunca! Infelizmente, ainda nos faltam muitos recursos.
dialogsBegin.cns: 现在我们的城镇比以往任何时候都坚固！不幸的是，我们仍然缺乏很多资源。
dialogsBegin.de: Die Stadt ist stärker denn je. Leider brauchen wir immer noch viele Resourcen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Now our town is stronger than ever! Unfortunately, we are still lacking a lot of resources.
dialogsBegin.fil: Now our town is stronger than ever! Unfortunately, we are still lacking a lot of resources.
dialogsBegin.fr: Notre village est désormais plus fort que jamais ! Malheureusement, nous manquons encore de ressources.
dialogsBegin.id: Sekarang kota kami lebih kuat dari sebelumnya! Sayangnya, kami masih kekurangan banyak sumber daya.
dialogsBegin.it: Now our town is stronger than ever! Unfortunately, we are still lacking a lot of resources.
dialogsBegin.jp: 今、私たちの町はかつてないほど強くなりました！しかし残念ながら、まだ多くの素材が不足しています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이제 우리 마을은 그 어느 때보다도 튼튼해요! 어쩌죠? 아직도 자원이 많이 부족해요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Now our town is stronger than ever! Unfortunately, we are still lacking a lot of resources.
dialogsBegin.pl: Now our town is stronger than ever! Unfortunately, we are still lacking a lot of resources.
dialogsBegin.ru: Now our town is stronger than ever! Unfortunately, we are still lacking a lot of resources.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Ahora nuestro pueblo es más fuerte que nunca! Desafortunadamente, todavía nos faltan muchos recursos.
dialogsBegin.sw: Now our town is stronger than ever! Unfortunately, we are still lacking a lot of resources.
dialogsBegin.th: ตอนนี้เมืองของเราแข็งแกร่งกว่าที่เคย! ขออภัย เรายังขาดทรัพยากรจำนวนมาก
dialogsBegin.tw: 現在我們的城鎮比以往任何時候都強大！不幸的是，我們仍然缺乏很多資源。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bây giờ thị trấn của chúng tôi mạnh mẽ hơn bao giờ hết! Thật không may, chúng ta vẫn đang thiếu rất nhiều tài nguyên.

dialogsBegin.en: Azria used to have a field of crystals that we would use for energy and magic, but these have been devoured by a crazed Augu that has gone absolutely mad.
dialogsBegin.ar: Azria used to have a field of crystals that we would use for energy and magic, but these have been devoured by a crazed Augu that has gone absolutely mad.
dialogsBegin.br: Azria costumava ter um campo de cristais que usaríamos para energia e magia, mas eles foram devorados por um Augu furioso que enlouqueceu completamente.
dialogsBegin.cns: 阿兹利亚曾经有一片水晶，我们可以用它来制造能量和魔法，但这些已经被一个疯狂的尖角蜥吞噬了。
dialogsBegin.de: Azria hatte einst ein Feld voller Kristalle, welche wir für Energie und Magie verwendet haben. Diese wurden von einem wildgewordenen Augu verspeist.
dialogsBegin.fi: Azria used to have a field of crystals that we would use for energy and magic, but these have been devoured by a crazed Augu that has gone absolutely mad.
dialogsBegin.fil: Azria used to have a field of crystals that we would use for energy and magic, but these have been devoured by a crazed Augu that has gone absolutely mad.
dialogsBegin.fr: Azria avait jadis un champ de cristaux que nous utilisions pour avoir de l'énergie et de la magie, mais ils ont été dévoré par un Augu devenu complètement fou.
dialogsBegin.id: Azria dulu memiliki bidang kristal yang akan kita gunakan untuk energi dan sihir, tetapi ini telah dimakan oleh Augu gila yang benar-benar gila.
dialogsBegin.it: Azria used to have a field of crystals that we would use for energy and magic, but these have been devoured by a crazed Augu that has gone absolutely mad.
dialogsBegin.jp: アズリアには、エネルギーと魔法に使うクリスタルのフィールドがありましたが、完全に気が狂ったアウグらによって蝕まれてしまいました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 아즈리아에는 에너지와 마법에 사용하던 크리스탈 장이 있었지만, 완전히 미쳐버린 아우구가 전부 삼켜버리고 말았어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Azria used to have a field of crystals that we would use for energy and magic, but these have been devoured by a crazed Augu that has gone absolutely mad.
dialogsBegin.pl: Azria used to have a field of crystals that we would use for energy and magic, but these have been devoured by a crazed Augu that has gone absolutely mad.
dialogsBegin.ru: Azria used to have a field of crystals that we would use for energy and magic, but these have been devoured by a crazed Augu that has gone absolutely mad.
dialogsBegin.sp: Azria solía tener un campo de cristales que usábamos para obtener energía y magia, pero estos han sido devorados por un Augu Enloquecido que se ha vuelto completamente loco.
dialogsBegin.sw: Azria used to have a field of crystals that we would use for energy and magic, but these have been devoured by a crazed Augu that has gone absolutely mad.
dialogsBegin.th: Azria เคยมีทุ่งคริสตัลที่เราจะใช้เป็นพลังงานและเวทย์มนตร์ แต่สิ่งเหล่านี้ถูกกินโดย Augu ที่บ้าคลั่งซึ่งคลั่งไคล้อย่างแน่นอน
dialogsBegin.tw: 阿茲里亞曾經有一塊水晶領域，我們可以用它來製造能量和魔法，但這些已經被一個瘋狂的奧古吞噬了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Azria từng có một mỏ pha lê mà chúng ta sẽ sử dụng cho năng lượng và ma thuật, nhưng chúng đã bị nuốt chửng bởi một Augu điên cuồng.

dialogsComplete.ar: Amazing! And you did that all by yourself I bet!

dialogsComplete.en: Now that we have all of this crystal essence, we can enforce our town and create a magical barrier that no monster, Violet or not, can ever break through.
dialogsComplete.ar: Now that we have all of this crystal essence, we can enforce our town and create a magical barrier that no monster, Violet or not, can ever break through.
dialogsComplete.br: Agora que temos toda essa essência de cristal, podemos reforçar nossa cidade e criar uma barreira mágica que nenhum monstro, Violeta ou não, poderá quebrar.
dialogsComplete.cns: 既然我们拥有了所有这些水晶精华，我们就可以强化我们的城镇并创造一个魔法屏障。这个屏障，任何怪物，包括紫罗兰，都无法突破。
dialogsComplete.de: Da wir nun diese Kristallessenz haben, können wir unsere Stadt verstärken und eine magische Barriere erschaffen, welche kein Monster, Violet oder ähnlich, jemals durchbrechen kann.
dialogsComplete.fi: Now that we have all of this crystal essence, we can enforce our town and create a magical barrier that no monster, Violet or not, can ever break through.
dialogsComplete.fil: Now that we have all of this crystal essence, we can enforce our town and create a magical barrier that no monster, Violet or not, can ever break through.
dialogsComplete.fr: Maintenant que nous avons toute cette essence de cristal, nous pouvons renforcer notre village à l'aide d'une barrière magique qu'aucun monstre ne pourra pénétrer.
dialogsComplete.id: Sekarang setelah kita memiliki semua esensi kristal ini, kita dapat menegakkan kota kita dan menciptakan penghalang ajaib yang tidak dapat ditembus oleh monster, Violet atau bukan.
dialogsComplete.it: Now that we have all of this crystal essence, we can enforce our town and create a magical barrier that no monster, Violet or not, can ever break through.
dialogsComplete.jp: このクリスタル・エッセンスをすべて手に入れた今、町の防衛を強化し、ヴァイオレットモンスターであろうと、突破できない魔法の障壁を張り巡らせることができるはずです。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이제 크리스탈 정수를 모두 얻었으니, 어떤 몬스터도, 심지어 보라 몬스터조차도 뚫을 수 없는 마법 방어막을 만들어 마을을 강화할 수 있겠어요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Now that we have all of this crystal essence, we can enforce our town and create a magical barrier that no monster, Violet or not, can ever break through.
dialogsComplete.pl: Now that we have all of this crystal essence, we can enforce our town and create a magical barrier that no monster, Violet or not, can ever break through.
dialogsComplete.ru: Now that we have all of this crystal essence, we can enforce our town and create a magical barrier that no monster, Violet or not, can ever break through.
dialogsComplete.sp: Ahora que tenemos toda esta Esencia de Cristal, podemos reforzar nuestra ciudad y crear una barrera mágica que ningún monstruo, ya sea Violeta o no, podrá atravesar.
dialogsComplete.sw: Now that we have all of this crystal essence, we can enforce our town and create a magical barrier that no monster, Violet or not, can ever break through.
dialogsComplete.th: ตอนนี้เรามีผลึกคริสตัลทั้งหมดแล้ว เราสามารถบังคับใช้เมืองของเราและสร้างบาเรียเวทย์มนตร์ที่ไม่มีมอนสเตอร์ ไวโอเล็ต หรืออะไรก็ตามก็ตาม สามารถทะลุทะลวงได้
dialogsComplete.tw: 既然我們擁有了所有這些水晶精華，我們就可以強化我們的城鎮並創造一個魔法屏障，任何怪物，無論是否紫精靈，都無法突破。
dialogsComplete.vi: Bây giờ chúng ta có tất cả tinh chất pha lê này, chúng ta có thể cưỡng chế thị trấn của mình và tạo ra một kết giới ma thuật mà không một con quái vật nào, Violet hay không, có thể phá vỡ.

dialogsComplete.en: We thank you for all of your help! Stay safe out there.
dialogsComplete.ar: We thank you for all of your help! Stay safe out there.
dialogsComplete.br: Agradecemos por toda a sua ajuda! Não abaixe sua guarda lá fora.
dialogsComplete.cns: 我们感谢您的所有帮助！在外面注意安全。
dialogsComplete.de: Wir danken dir für all deine Hilfe! Bleib sicher da draußen.
dialogsComplete.fi: We thank you for all of your help! Stay safe out there.
dialogsComplete.fil: We thank you for all of your help! Stay safe out there.
dialogsComplete.fr: Nous vous remercions pour toute votre aide ! Faites attention à vous.
dialogsComplete.id: Kami berterima kasih atas semua bantuan kamu! Tetap aman di luar sana.
dialogsComplete.it: We thank you for all of your help! Stay safe out there.
dialogsComplete.jp: 皆様のご協力に感謝いたします。
dialogsComplete.kr: 도와주셔서 정말 감사해요! 부디 몸조심하세요.
dialogsComplete.nl: We thank you for all of your help! Stay safe out there.
dialogsComplete.pl: We thank you for all of your help! Stay safe out there.
dialogsComplete.ru: We thank you for all of your help! Stay safe out there.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Te agradecemos tu ayuda! Mantente a salvo.
dialogsComplete.sw: We thank you for all of your help! Stay safe out there.
dialogsComplete.th: เราขอขอบคุณสำหรับความช่วยเหลือของคุณ! อยู่ข้างนอกอย่างปลอดภัย
dialogsComplete.tw: 我們感謝你的所有幫助！在外請小心安全。
dialogsComplete.vi: Cảm ơn sự giúp đỡ của bạn! Hãy giữ an toàn ngoài đó.

dialogsFail.en: Keep trying! I believe in you!
dialogsFail.ar: Keep trying! I believe in you!
dialogsFail.br: Continue tentando! Eu acredito em você!
dialogsFail.cns: 不要放弃！我相信你！
dialogsFail.de: Versuch es nur weiter! Ich glaub an dich!
dialogsFail.fi: Keep trying! I believe in you!
dialogsFail.fil: Keep trying! I believe in you!
dialogsFail.fr: Continuez d'essayer ! Je crois en vous !
dialogsFail.id: Teruslah mencoba! Aku percaya padamu!
dialogsFail.it: Keep trying! I believe in you!
dialogsFail.jp: 努力は実を結ぶはずです。私はあなたを心から誇りに思っています。
dialogsFail.kr: 계속해요! 전 당신을 믿어요!
dialogsFail.nl: Keep trying! I believe in you!
dialogsFail.pl: Keep trying! I believe in you!
dialogsFail.ru: Keep trying! I believe in you!
dialogsFail.sp: ¡Sigue intentándolo! ¡Creo en ti!
dialogsFail.sw: Keep trying! I believe in you!
dialogsFail.th: พยายามต่อไป! ฉันเชื่อในตัวคุณ!
dialogsFail.tw: 繼續加油！我相信你！
dialogsFail.vi: Tiếp tục cố gắng! Tôi tin bạn!

description.en: Bring Handel the Parchment of War after defeating 10 Iblis Crashers and an Iblis Guardian.
description.ar: Bring Handel the Parchment of War after defeating 10 Iblis Crashers and an Iblis Guardian.
description.br: Consiga o Pergaminho da Guerra para Handel depois de derrotar 10 Iblis Esmagadores e um Guardião Iblis.
description.cns: Bring Handel the Parchment of War after defeating 10 Iblis Crashers and an Iblis Guardian.
description.de: Bringe Handel das Parchment of War, nachdem du 10 Ivillis-Crasher und einen Ivillis-Guardian besiegt hast.
description.fi: Bring Handel the Parchment of War after defeating 10 Iblis Crashers and an Iblis Guardian.
description.fil: Bring Handel the Parchment of War after defeating 10 Iblis Crashers and an Iblis Guardian.
description.fr: Tuez 10 Ivillis Crashter and un Ivillis Guarder et rapportez la supplique d'Ivillis.
description.id: Bawa Parchment of War untuk Handel setelah mengalahkan 10 Iblis Crashers dan Iblis Guardian.
description.it: Bring Handel the Parchment of War after defeating 10 Iblis Crashers and an Iblis Guardian.
description.jp: イブル・クラッシャーを10体、イブル・ガーディアンを1体倒した後、ヘンデルに戦争の羊皮紙へ渡せ。
description.kr: 이블리스 크래셔 10마리와 이블리스 가디언을 처치한 후, 헨델에게 전쟁의 양피지를 가져다주세요.
description.nl: Bring Handel the Parchment of War after defeating 10 Iblis Crashers and an Iblis Guardian.
description.pl: Bring Handel the Parchment of War after defeating 10 Iblis Crashers and an Iblis Guardian.
description.ru: Bring Handel the Parchment of War after defeating 10 Iblis Crashers and an Iblis Guardian.
description.sp: Lleva a Handel el Pergamino de Guerra después de derrotar a 10 Iblis Crashers y un Iblis Guardian.
description.sw: Bring Handel the Parchment of War after defeating 10 Iblis Crashers and an Iblis Guardian.
description.th: นำ Handel the Parchment of War มาหลังจากเอาชนะ Iblis Crashers 10 ตัวและ Iblis Guardian หนึ่งตัว
description.tw: 擊敗 10 個地穴妖獸和 1 個地穴護獸後帶伊普里司的紀錄給賀丹爾。
description.vi: Mang Handel the Parchment of War sau khi đánh bại 10 Iblis Crashers và một Iblis Guardian.

dialogsBegin.en: This essence of Shade is concerning… After the 8 Heroes had defeated Shade, all remnants of her existence were to be purged to prevent her return.
dialogsBegin.ar: This essence of Shade is concerning… After the 8 Heroes had defeated Shade, all remnants of her existence were to be purged to prevent her return.
dialogsBegin.br: Essa essência de Shade é preocupante... Depois que os 8 Heróis derrotaram Shade, todos os resquícios de sua existência deveriam ter sido expurgados para evitar seu retorno.
dialogsBegin.cns: 在八大英雄击败谢莉德后，谢莉德意识的存在仍让人担忧....为了防止她的回归，她存在的所有残余都需要被清除。
dialogsBegin.de: Diese Essenz von Shade ist besorgniserregend... Nachdem die 8 Helden Shade besiegt hatten, sollten alle Überreste ihrer Existenz beseitigt werden, um ihre Rückkehr zu verhindern.
dialogsBegin.fi: This essence of Shade is concerning… After the 8 Heroes had defeated Shade, all remnants of her existence were to be purged to prevent her return.
dialogsBegin.fil: This essence of Shade is concerning… After the 8 Heroes had defeated Shade, all remnants of her existence were to be purged to prevent her return.
dialogsBegin.fr: Ce sceau est ancien et puissant. Mais il va falloir le recharger.
dialogsBegin.id: Esensi Shade ini mengkhawatirkan... Setelah 8 Pahlawan mengalahkan Shade, semua sisa-sisa keberadaannya harus dibersihkan untuk mencegahnya kembali.
dialogsBegin.it: This essence of Shade is concerning… After the 8 Heroes had defeated Shade, all remnants of her existence were to be purged to prevent her return.
dialogsBegin.jp: 8人の英雄がシェードを倒した後、彼女の存在のすべての残党は彼女の復帰を防ぐために一掃されることになっていた。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 흔적은… 오래 된 것이긴 하지만 아직도 미미하게 사악한 기운이 느껴지는 군요. 어쩌면.. 어쩌면 영웅 전쟁에서 이블리스가 소멸하지 않은 걸지도 몰라요.
dialogsBegin.nl: This essence of Shade is concerning… After the 8 Heroes had defeated Shade, all remnants of her existence were to be purged to prevent her return.
dialogsBegin.pl: This essence of Shade is concerning… After the 8 Heroes had defeated Shade, all remnants of her existence were to be purged to prevent her return.
dialogsBegin.ru: This essence of Shade is concerning… After the 8 Heroes had defeated Shade, all remnants of her existence were to be purged to prevent her return.
dialogsBegin.sp: Esta esencia de Shade es preocupante... Después de que los 8 Héroes derrotaron a Shade, todos los restos de su existencia debían ser purgados para evitar su regreso.
dialogsBegin.sw: This essence of Shade is concerning… After the 8 Heroes had defeated Shade, all remnants of her existence were to be purged to prevent her return.
dialogsBegin.th: สาระสำคัญของ Shade นี้เกี่ยวข้องกับ ... หลังจากที่วีรบุรุษทั้ง 8 คนแพ้ Shade แล้วเศษของชีวิตทั้งหมดจะถูกกำจัดออกเพื่อป้องกันไม่ให้เธอกลับมา
dialogsBegin.tw: 這闇影的精華令人擔憂……在八位英雄擊敗闇影之後，她的所有殘餘都將被清除，以防止她回歸。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bản chất của Shade này là liên quan đến… Sau khi 8 Anh hùng đã đánh bại Shade, tất cả những gì còn sót lại của cô ấy sẽ bị thanh trừng để ngăn cản sự trở lại của cô ấy.

dialogsBegin.en: If her essence remains, this is very bad… Stored in the Temple of Iblis is the Parchment of War. Please head there and retrieve it for me.
dialogsBegin.ar: If her essence remains, this is very bad… Stored in the Temple of Iblis is the Parchment of War. Please head there and retrieve it for me.
dialogsBegin.br: Se a essência dela permanecer, isso é muito ruim... Existe um Pergaminho da Guerra armazenado no Templo de Iblis. Por favor, vá até lá e traga-o para mim.
dialogsBegin.cns: If her essence remains, this is very bad… Stored in the Temple of Iblis is the Parchment of War. Please head there and retrieve it for me.
dialogsBegin.de: Wenn ihre Essenz bleibt, ist das sehr schlecht... Im Tempel von Ivillis wird das Parchment of War aufbewahrt. Bitte geht dorthin und holt es für mich.
dialogsBegin.fi: If her essence remains, this is very bad… Stored in the Temple of Iblis is the Parchment of War. Please head there and retrieve it for me.
dialogsBegin.fil: If her essence remains, this is very bad… Stored in the Temple of Iblis is the Parchment of War. Please head there and retrieve it for me.
dialogsBegin.fr: C'est très simple, il suffit de pratiquer quelques sacrifices au nom d'Ivillis et de lire la supplique d'Ivillis.
dialogsBegin.id: Jika esensinya tetap ada, ini sangat buruk... Parchment of War disimpan di Temple of Iblis. Silakan pergi ke sana dan ambilkan untuk saya.
dialogsBegin.it: If her essence remains, this is very bad… Stored in the Temple of Iblis is the Parchment of War. Please head there and retrieve it for me.
dialogsBegin.jp: 彼女の本質が残っているとしたら、これは非常に悪いことです…イブリスの神殿に保管されているイブリスの記録を手に入れて頂けませんか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 그 정수가 남아 있다면, 이건 정말 심각한 일이에요…이블리스 신전에 전쟁의 양피지가 있어요. 가서 가져다주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: If her essence remains, this is very bad… Stored in the Temple of Iblis is the Parchment of War. Please head there and retrieve it for me.
dialogsBegin.pl: If her essence remains, this is very bad… Stored in the Temple of Iblis is the Parchment of War. Please head there and retrieve it for me.
dialogsBegin.ru: If her essence remains, this is very bad… Stored in the Temple of Iblis is the Parchment of War. Please head there and retrieve it for me.
dialogsBegin.sp: Si su esencia permanece, es muy malo... El Pergamino de Guerra está almacenado en el Templo de Iblis. Por favor, dirígete allí y recupéralo por mí.
dialogsBegin.sw: If her essence remains, this is very bad… Stored in the Temple of Iblis is the Parchment of War. Please head there and retrieve it for me.
dialogsBegin.th: หากแก่นแท้ของเธอยังคงอยู่ นี่มันแย่มาก… ที่เก็บไว้ในวิหารอิบลิสคือกระดาษแห่งสงคราม โปรดไปที่นั่นและดึงมันมาให้ฉัน
dialogsBegin.tw: 如果她的精華還在，那就很糟糕了……伊普里司神殿中存放著伊普里司的記錄。請前往那里為我取回它。
dialogsBegin.vi: Nếu bản thể vẫn còn, điều này rất tệ… Được cất giữ trong Temple of Iblis là Parchment of War. Hãy đến đó và lấy nó cho tôi.

dialogsAccept.en: The Temple of Iblis is in the Southern most region of Saint Morning. The records are guarded by both Iblis Crashers and an Iblis Guardian so please defeat them to obtain it!
dialogsAccept.ar: The Temple of Iblis is in the Southern most region of Saint Morning. The records are guarded by both Iblis Crashers and an Iblis Guardian so please defeat them to obtain it!
dialogsAccept.br: O Templo de Iblis fica na região mais ao sul de Saint Morning. Os registros são guardados tanto por Iblis Esmagadores e um Guardião Iblis, então, por favor, derrote-os para obtê-lo!
dialogsAccept.cns: 依普利神殿就在晨光的最南部的地区。记录中所描述的伊普里斯神庙由秘殿破坏者和秘殿警戒者共同守卫，所以请击败他们拿到羊皮纸！
dialogsAccept.de: Der Tempel von Ivillis befindet sich in der südlichsten Region von Saint Morning. Die Aufzeichnungen werden sowohl von Ivillis-Crasher als auch von einem Ivillis-Guardian bewacht, also besiege sie bitte, um sie zu erhalten!
dialogsAccept.fi: The Temple of Iblis is in the Southern most region of Saint Morning. The records are guarded by both Iblis Crashers and an Iblis Guardian so please defeat them to obtain it!
dialogsAccept.fil: The Temple of Iblis is in the Southern most region of Saint Morning. The records are guarded by both Iblis Crashers and an Iblis Guardian so please defeat them to obtain it!
dialogsAccept.fr: Par chance il y a des Ivillis Crasher et des Ivillis Guarder pas loin.Tuez-en une dizaine et rapportez-moi une supplique d'Ivillis.
dialogsAccept.id: Temple of Iblis berada di wilayah paling selatan Saint Morning. Catatan tersebut dijaga oleh Iblis Crashers dan Iblis Guardian jadi tolong kalahkan mereka untuk mendapatkannya!
dialogsAccept.it: The Temple of Iblis is in the Southern most region of Saint Morning. The records are guarded by both Iblis Crashers and an Iblis Guardian so please defeat them to obtain it!
dialogsAccept.jp: イブリスの記録は聖朝の最南端にあります。記録はイブル・ドロイゼンやイブル・プレジャーが持っていると思います。何匹か倒せればわかるかもしれません。
dialogsAccept.kr: 이블리스 신전은 세인트 모닝 가장 남쪽 지역에 있답니다. 이블리스 크래셔와 이블리스 가디언들이 양피지를 지키고 있어요. 쓰러뜨리고 얻는 수밖에요!
dialogsAccept.nl: The Temple of Iblis is in the Southern most region of Saint Morning. The records are guarded by both Iblis Crashers and an Iblis Guardian so please defeat them to obtain it!
dialogsAccept.pl: The Temple of Iblis is in the Southern most region of Saint Morning. The records are guarded by both Iblis Crashers and an Iblis Guardian so please defeat them to obtain it!
dialogsAccept.ru: The Temple of Iblis is in the Southern most region of Saint Morning. The records are guarded by both Iblis Crashers and an Iblis Guardian so please defeat them to obtain it!
dialogsAccept.sp: El Templo de Iblis se encuentra en la región más al sur de Mañana Santa. Los registros están protegidos tanto por Iblis Crashers como por un Iblis Guardian, ¡Derrótalos para obtenerlos!
dialogsAccept.sw: The Temple of Iblis is in the Southern most region of Saint Morning. The records are guarded by both Iblis Crashers and an Iblis Guardian so please defeat them to obtain it!
dialogsAccept.th: Temple of Iblisอยู่ทางตอนใต้สุดของเซนต์มอร์นิ่ง บันทึกได้รับการปกป้องโดยทั้ง Iblis Crashers และ Iblis Guardian ดังนั้นโปรดเอาชนะพวกเขาเพื่อรับมัน!
dialogsAccept.tw: 伊普里司神殿位於聖音特最南端。記錄由地穴妖獸和地穴護獸守衛，所以請擊敗他們以獲得它！
dialogsAccept.vi: Temple of Iblis nằm ở vùng gần phía Nam nhất của Saint Morning. Các di tích được bảo vệ bởi cả Iblis Crashers và một Iblis Guardian, vì vậy hãy đánh bại chúng để lấy được nó!

dialogsDecline.en: We've come too far to just quit now! Please reconsider!!
dialogsDecline.ar: We've come too far to just quit now! Please reconsider!!
dialogsDecline.br: Chegamos longe demais para desistir agora! Por favor reconsidere!!
dialogsDecline.cns: 我们已经做了那么多，不能现在退出！请重新考虑！！
dialogsDecline.de: Wir sind zu weit gekommen, um jetzt einfach aufzugeben! Bitte überlegen Sie es sich noch einmal!
dialogsDecline.fi: We've come too far to just quit now! Please reconsider!!
dialogsDecline.fil: We've come too far to just quit now! Please reconsider!!
dialogsDecline.fr: … parce que c'est comme ça ! Arrêtez de poser des questions !
dialogsDecline.id: Kami telah melangkah terlalu jauh untuk berhenti sekarang! Mohon dipertimbangkan kembali!!
dialogsDecline.it: We've come too far to just quit now! Please reconsider!!
dialogsDecline.jp: 遠すぎて今すぐやめられません！ 考え直してください!!
dialogsDecline.kr: 여기까지 와 놓고 포기할 순 없어요! 부탁이니 다시 생각해 주세요!!
dialogsDecline.nl: We've come too far to just quit now! Please reconsider!!
dialogsDecline.pl: We've come too far to just quit now! Please reconsider!!
dialogsDecline.ru: We've come too far to just quit now! Please reconsider!!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Hemos llegado demasiado lejos como para renunciar ahora! ¡¡Por favor reconsidéralo!!
dialogsDecline.sw: We've come too far to just quit now! Please reconsider!!
dialogsDecline.th: เรามาไกลเกินกว่าจะเลิกได้แล้ว! กรุณาคิดใหม่อีกครั้ง!!
dialogsDecline.tw: 我們已經走得太遠了，現在就退出！請重新考慮！！
dialogsDecline.vi: Chúng ta đã đi quá xa không thể từ bỏ bây giờ! Xin hãy cân nhắc!!

dialogsComplete.ar: You've made it back with the Parchment!
dialogsComplete.br: Você conseguiu voltar com o Pergaminho!
dialogsComplete.cns: 你带着战争卷轴回来了！
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast es mit dem Pergament zurückgeschafft!
dialogsComplete.fi: You've made it back with the Parchment!
dialogsComplete.fil: You've made it back with the Parchment!
dialogsComplete.fr: Vous êtes incroyable !
dialogsComplete.id: Kau telah berhasil kembali dengan Parchment!
dialogsComplete.it: You've made it back with the Parchment!
dialogsComplete.jp: お待ちしておりました！本当にイブリスの記録を持ち帰って下さったのですね！
dialogsComplete.kr: 대단하세요! 정말 양피지를 구해왔군요?
dialogsComplete.nl: You've made it back with the Parchment!
dialogsComplete.pl: You've made it back with the Parchment!
dialogsComplete.ru: You've made it back with the Parchment!

dialogsComplete.sw: You've made it back with the Parchment!
dialogsComplete.th: คุณทำได้ กลับมาพร้อมกับ Parchment!
dialogsComplete.tw: 你帶伊普里司的記錄回來了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn đã trở lại cùng với Parchment!
