dialogsFail.vi: Hãy mang theo Parchment of War sau khi đánh bại 10 Iblis Crashers và một Iblis Guardian.

name.th: ภัยคุกคามขนยาว

description.en: Kill 10 Cute Nyangnyang & 5 Nyangnyang and return to the Mayor of Flarine.
description.ar: Kill 10 Cute Nyangnyang & 5 Nyangnyang and return to the Mayor of Flarine.
description.br: Elimine 10 Nyangnyangs Fofinhas e 5 Nyangnyangs e reporte para o Prefeito de Flarine.
description.cns: 杀死10只彩冠翎猫仔和5只彩冠翎猫后再回去找帕里市长。
description.de: Töte 10 Cute Nyangnyang & 5 Nyangnyang und kehre anschliessend zum Bürgermeister von Flaris zurück.
description.fi: Kill 10 Cute Nyangnyang & 5 Nyangnyang and return to the Mayor of Flarine.
description.fil: Kill 10 Cute Nyangnyang & 5 Nyangnyang and return to the Mayor of Flarine.
description.fr: Tuez 10 Jeunes Nyangnyang et 5 Nyangnyang, et faites votre rapport au maire de Flarine.
description.id: Habisi 10 Cute Nyangnyang & 5 Nyangnyang lalu kembali ke Mayor of Flarine.
description.it: Kill 10 Cute Nyangnyang & 5 Nyangnyang and return to the Mayor of Flarine.
description.jp: キュート・ニャングニャング10匹、ニャングニャング5匹を倒して、フラリス市長に報告せよ。
description.kr: 귀여운 냥냥 10마리와 냥냥 5마리를 처치하고 플라리네 시장에게 돌아가세요.
description.nl: Kill 10 Cute Nyangnyang & 5 Nyangnyang and return to the Mayor of Flarine.
description.pl: Kill 10 Cute Nyangnyang & 5 Nyangnyang and return to the Mayor of Flarine.
description.ru: Kill 10 Cute Nyangnyang & 5 Nyangnyang and return to the Mayor of Flarine.
description.sp: Derrota a 10 Nyangnyangs Lindas y a 5 Nyangnyangs y vuelve con el Alcalde de Flarine.
description.sw: Kill 10 Cute Nyangnyang & 5 Nyangnyang and return to the Mayor of Flarine.
description.th: สังหาร Cute Nyangnyang 10 คน & 5 Nyangnyang และกลับไปหา Mayor of Flarine
description.tw: 殺死 10 個可愛喵娘和 5 個裝可愛喵娘，然後返回布拉里斯市長那裡。
description.vi: Giết 10 Nyangnyang dễ thương & 5 Nyangnyang và trở lại Thị trưởng Flarine.

dialogsBegin.en: I wanted to meet you personally to thank you for all you have done for us. I don't wish to impose, but I hoped you could again call upon your courage.
dialogsBegin.ar: I wanted to meet you personally to thank you for all you have done for us. I don't wish to impose, but I hoped you could again call upon your courage.
dialogsBegin.br: Queria conhecê-lo(a) pessoalmente para agradecer por tudo o que você fez por nós. Não desejo impor, mas espero que você possa apelar novamente à sua coragem.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我想亲自见你来感谢你为我们做的所有事情。我不想强迫你，但我仍然希望你能再次使用你的勇气帮助我们。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich wollte Sie persönlich treffen, um Ihnen für alles zu danken, was Sie für uns getan haben. Ich möchte mich nicht aufdrängen, aber ich hatte gehofft, dass Sie Ihren Mut noch einmal unter Beweis stellen könnten.
dialogsBegin.fi: I wanted to meet you personally to thank you for all you have done for us. I don't wish to impose, but I hoped you could again call upon your courage.
dialogsBegin.fil: I wanted to meet you personally to thank you for all you have done for us. I don't wish to impose, but I hoped you could again call upon your courage.
dialogsBegin.fr: J'ai une mission pour vous au nom des citoyens de Flarine.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku ingin bertemu denganmu secara langsung untuk berterimakasih akan semua yang telah kamu lakukan untuk kami. Aku tidak bermaksud untuk memaksa, tapi aku berharap kamu bersedia kembali menunjukkan keberanianmu.
dialogsBegin.it: I wanted to meet you personally to thank you for all you have done for us. I don't wish to impose, but I hoped you could again call upon your courage.
dialogsBegin.jp: いつもありがとうございます。市民を代表して御礼申し上げます。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그동안 마을을 위해 애써주셔서, 직접 감사 인사를 드리고 싶었어요. 혹시 폐가 되지 않는다면, 다시 한 번만 용기를 내어주시길 부탁할니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: I wanted to meet you personally to thank you for all you have done for us. I don't wish to impose, but I hoped you could again call upon your courage.
dialogsBegin.pl: I wanted to meet you personally to thank you for all you have done for us. I don't wish to impose, but I hoped you could again call upon your courage.
dialogsBegin.ru: Я хотел лично поблагодарить тебя за помощь всем нам. Не хочу показаться навязчивым, но я надеюсь и дальше рассчитывать на тебя.
dialogsBegin.sp: Quería conocerte personalmente para agradecerte todo lo que has hecho por nosotros. No quiero imponerme, pero me gustaría que pudieras recurrir nuevamente a tu coraje.
dialogsBegin.sw: I wanted to meet you personally to thank you for all you have done for us. I don't wish to impose, but I hoped you could again call upon your courage.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันอยากพบคุณเป็นการส่วนตัวเพื่อขอบคุณสำหรับทุกสิ่งที่คุณทำเพื่อเรา ฉันไม่ต้องการที่จะบังคับ แต่ฉันหวังว่าคุณจะเรียกความกล้าหาญของคุณอีกครั้ง
dialogsBegin.tw: 我想親自見到你，感謝你為我們所做的一切。我不想強加，但我希望你能再次鼓起勇氣。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi muốn gặp riêng bạn để cảm ơn bạn vì tất cả những gì bạn đã làm cho chúng tôi. Tôi không muốn áp đặt, nhưng tôi hy vọng bạn có thể kêu gọi sự can đảm của mình một lần nữa.

dialogsBegin.en: Our town guard was once sizeable enough to fend off most of Shade's masquerpets. Now, with each passing day their numbers and power increases, while ours dwindles.
dialogsBegin.ar: Our town guard was once sizeable enough to fend off most of Shade's masquerpets. Now, with each passing day their numbers and power increases, while ours dwindles.
dialogsBegin.br: Nossa guarda da cidade já foi grande o suficiente para afastar a maioria dos Masquerpets de Shade. Agora, a cada dia que passa, seus números e poder aumentam, enquanto o nosso diminui.
dialogsBegin.cns: 曾经我们镇子的防卫力量足够强大，可以抵御很多谢德莉的怪物。但随着怪物们的数量的增加以及变强，我们的防卫力量开始在慢慢变弱，渐渐无法抵御它们的攻击。
dialogsBegin.de: Unsere Stadtwache war einst groß genug, um die meisten masquerpets von Shade abzuwehren. Doch mit jedem Tag, der vergeht, wächst ihre Zahl und Macht, während unsere schwindet.
dialogsBegin.fi: Our town guard was once sizeable enough to fend off most of Shade's masquerpets. Now, with each passing day their numbers and power increases, while ours dwindles.
dialogsBegin.fil: Our town guard was once sizeable enough to fend off most of Shade's masquerpets. Now, with each passing day their numbers and power increases, while ours dwindles.
dialogsBegin.fr: Certains monstres perturbent les échanges commerciaux de Flarine avec les autres villes.
dialogsBegin.id: Penjaga kota kami dulunya cukup kuat untuk menangkis serangan Shade Masquerpets. Sekarang, jumlah dan kekuatan mereka semakin meningkat, sementara kita semakin melemah.
dialogsBegin.it: Our town guard was once sizeable enough to fend off most of Shade's masquerpets. Now, with each passing day their numbers and power increases, while ours dwindles.
dialogsBegin.jp: 以前から自警団の手によってフラリスは守られていたのですが、最近急激にモンスターが増え始めました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 한때 우리 도시 경비대는 쉐이드의 마스커펫도 충분히 막아낼 수 있을 만큼 강력했답니다. 하지만 날이 갈수록 적들은 강력해지고, 우리는 점점 약해지고 있어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Our town guard was once sizeable enough to fend off most of Shade's masquerpets. Now, with each passing day their numbers and power increases, while ours dwindles.
dialogsBegin.pl: Our town guard was once sizeable enough to fend off most of Shade's masquerpets. Now, with each passing day their numbers and power increases, while ours dwindles.
dialogsBegin.ru: Наша городская стража когда-то была больше и справлялась с нашествиями марионеток Тени. К сожалению, этих злобных созданий меньше не становится, чего не сказать о добровольцах.
dialogsBegin.sp: Nuestra guardia de la ciudad era lo suficientemente grande como para defenderse de la mayoría de los masquerpets de Shade. Pero ahora, cada día que pasa, su número y poder aumenta, mientras que el nuestro disminuye.
dialogsBegin.sw: Our town guard was once sizeable enough to fend off most of Shade's masquerpets. Now, with each passing day their numbers and power increases, while ours dwindles.
dialogsBegin.th: ยามเมืองของเราครั้งหนึ่งเคยมีขนาดใหญ่พอที่จะป้องกันหน้ากากส่วนใหญ่ของ Shade ทุกวันนี้จำนวนและพลังของพวกเขาเพิ่มขึ้น ในขณะที่พวกเราลดน้อยลง
dialogsBegin.tw: 我們鎮守的規模曾經足以抵擋闇影的大部分假面舞會。現在，隨著時間的流逝，他們的人數和力量每天都在增加，而我們的人數和力量卻在減少。
dialogsBegin.vi: Người bảo vệ thị trấn của chúng tôi đã từng đủ lớn để chống đỡ hầu hết các masquerpets của Shade. Giờ đây, mỗi ngày trôi qua, số lượng và sức mạnh của chúng tăng lên, trong khi của chúng ta lại giảm dần.

dialogsBegin.en: With that said, could you please help us to exterminate a particularly vicious group of Nyangnyang roaming the lands?
dialogsBegin.ar: With that said, could you please help us to exterminate a particularly vicious group of Nyangnyang roaming the lands?
dialogsBegin.br: Dito isso, você poderia nos ajudar a exterminar um grupo particularmente cruel de Nyangnyangs que vagam por essas terras?
dialogsBegin.cns: 话说到这，请问你可以帮助我们消灭游荡在这片土地的非常邪恶的彩冠翎猫吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Könntest du uns bitte helfen, eine besonders bösartige Gruppe von Nyangnyang auszurotten, die das Land durchstreift?
dialogsBegin.fi: With that said, could you please help us to exterminate a particularly vicious group of Nyangnyang roaming the lands?
dialogsBegin.fil: With that said, could you please help us to exterminate a particularly vicious group of Nyangnyang roaming the lands?
dialogsBegin.fr: Je vous demande donc d'éliminer 10 Jeune Nyangnyang et 5 Nyangnyang au Nord de Flaris.
dialogsBegin.id: Jadi, bisakah kamu membantu kami untuk memusnahkan kelompok Nyangnyang yang kejam yang berkeliaran di sekitar?
dialogsBegin.it: With that said, could you please help us to exterminate a particularly vicious group of Nyangnyang roaming the lands?
dialogsBegin.jp: 大変恐縮ですが猫の手も借りたい状態なのです。もしよければニャングニャング討伐を手伝って頂けませんか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 최근 특히 사나운 냥냥 무리가 부근을 돌아다닌다고 하는데, 혹시 처치해 주실 수 있을까요?
dialogsBegin.nl: With that said, could you please help us to exterminate a particularly vicious group of Nyangnyang roaming the lands?
dialogsBegin.pl: With that said, could you please help us to exterminate a particularly vicious group of Nyangnyang roaming the lands?
dialogsBegin.ru: Не мог бы ты помочь нам разобраться с особо злобной группой Кисандр, расхаживающей по этим землям?
dialogsBegin.sp: Dicho esto, ¿podrías ayudarnos a exterminar a un grupo particularmente despiadado de Nyangnyangs que deambulan por el continente?
dialogsBegin.sw: With that said, could you please help us to exterminate a particularly vicious group of Nyangnyang roaming the lands?
dialogsBegin.th: จากที่กล่าวมา คุณช่วยเรากำจัดกลุ่ม Nyangnyang ที่ชั่วร้ายที่สัญจรไปมาในดินแดนได้ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 話雖如此，請你幫助我們消滅在這片土地上漫遊的特別惡毒的裝可愛喵娘集團嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Với những gì đã nói, bạn có thể vui lòng giúp chúng tôi tiêu diệt một nhóm đặc biệt hung ác của Nyangnyang đang lang thang trên các vùng đất không?

dialogsAccept.en: Nyangnyang can be found in Northern Flaris, right after crossing the bridge. Killing 10 Cute Nyangnyang & 5 Nyangnyang should be sufficient to aid us.
dialogsAccept.ar: Nyangnyang can be found in Northern Flaris, right after crossing the bridge. Killing 10 Cute Nyangnyang & 5 Nyangnyang should be sufficient to aid us.
dialogsAccept.br: Nyangnyangs podem ser encontradas no Norte de Flaris, logo após cruzar a ponte. Elimine 10 Nyangnyangs Fofinhas e 5 Nyangnyangs, deve ser o suficiente para nos ajudar.
dialogsAccept.cns: 彩冠翎猫可以在帕里北部，过了桥之后找到。杀死10个彩冠翎猫仔和5个彩冠翎猫就足够帮助我们了。
dialogsAccept.de: Nyangnyang findet man in Nordflaris, gleich nachdem man die Brücke überquert hat. Das Töten von 10 Cute Nyangnyang & 5 Nyangnyang sollte ausreichen, um uns zu helfen.
dialogsAccept.fi: Nyangnyang can be found in Northern Flaris, right after crossing the bridge. Killing 10 Cute Nyangnyang & 5 Nyangnyang should be sufficient to aid us.
dialogsAccept.fil: Nyangnyang can be found in Northern Flaris, right after crossing the bridge. Killing 10 Cute Nyangnyang & 5 Nyangnyang should be sufficient to aid us.
dialogsAccept.fr: J'ai confiance en vos aptitudes.
dialogsAccept.id: Nyangnyang dapat ditemui di Nothern Flaris tepat setelah menyeberangi jembatan. Kami akan sangat terbantu jika kamu dapat menghabisi 10 Cute Nyangnyang dan 5 Nyangnyang.
dialogsAccept.it: Nyangnyang can be found in Northern Flaris, right after crossing the bridge. Killing 10 Cute Nyangnyang & 5 Nyangnyang should be sufficient to aid us.
dialogsAccept.jp: ニャングニャングらは北のフラリス橋を渡ってすぐのところにいます。スモール・ニャングニャングは5匹、ニャングニャングを10匹ほど倒してきていただけますか。
dialogsAccept.kr: 플라리스 북부에서 다리를 건너면 바로 냥냥을 찾으실 수 있을 거예요. 귀여운 냥냥 10마리와 냥냥 5마리를 처치하면, 정말 큰 도움이 될 것 같아요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Nyangnyang can be found in Northern Flaris, right after crossing the bridge. Killing 10 Cute Nyangnyang & 5 Nyangnyang should be sufficient to aid us.
dialogsAccept.pl: Nyangnyang can be found in Northern Flaris, right after crossing the bridge. Killing 10 Cute Nyangnyang & 5 Nyangnyang should be sufficient to aid us.
dialogsAccept.ru: Кисандры облюбовали северную Фларинцию. Иди прямо на север от города, пересеки мост через ущелье - и сразу их увидишь. Думаю, поразить 10 слабых и 5 обычных будет достаточно, чтобы стража отбила нападение.
dialogsAccept.sp: Los Nyangnyang se pueden encontrar al Norte de Flaris, justo después de cruzar el puente. Con derrotar a 10 Nyangnyangs Lindas y a 5 Nyangnyangs debería ser suficiente para ayudarnos.
dialogsAccept.sw: Nyangnyang can be found in Northern Flaris, right after crossing the bridge. Killing 10 Cute Nyangnyang & 5 Nyangnyang should be sufficient to aid us.
dialogsAccept.th: Nyangnyang สามารถพบได้ใน Northern Flaris ทันทีหลังจากข้ามสะพาน ฆ่า 10 Nyangnyang น่ารัก & 5 Nyangnyang น่าจะเพียงพอแล้วที่จะช่วยพวกเรา
dialogsAccept.tw: 裝可愛喵娘可以在布拉里斯北方找到，就在過橋之後。殺死 10 個可愛喵娘和 5 個裝可愛喵娘，應該足以幫助我們。
dialogsAccept.vi: Nyangnyang có thể được tìm thấy ở Northern Flaris, ngay sau khi đi qua cầu. Giết 10 Nyangnyang dễ thương & 5 Nyangnyang sẽ đủ để hỗ trợ chúng tôi.

dialogsDecline.en: I understand your apprehension, but I do hope you will reconsider your decision.
dialogsDecline.ar: I understand your apprehension, but I do hope you will reconsider your decision.
dialogsDecline.br: Eu entendo sua apreensão, mas espero que você reconsidere sua decisão.
dialogsDecline.cns: 我理解你的担心，但我还是希望你能再考虑下你的决定。
dialogsDecline.de: Ich verstehe Ihre Befürchtungen, aber ich hoffe, dass Sie Ihre Entscheidung noch einmal überdenken werden.
dialogsDecline.fi: I understand your apprehension, but I do hope you will reconsider your decision.
dialogsDecline.fil: I understand your apprehension, but I do hope you will reconsider your decision.
dialogsDecline.fr: Bien entendu, si vous êtes trop occupé ça peut attendre.
dialogsDecline.id: Aku mengerti akan kekhawatiranmu, tapi aku berharap agar kamu dapat mempertimbangkannya kembali.
dialogsDecline.it: I understand your apprehension, but I do hope you will reconsider your decision.
dialogsDecline.jp: そうですか。いえ、残念ですが貴方もご予定があるのでしょう。
dialogsDecline.kr: 망설임도 이해하지만, 도와주시길 간곡히 부탁할게요.
dialogsDecline.nl: I understand your apprehension, but I do hope you will reconsider your decision.
dialogsDecline.pl: I understand your apprehension, but I do hope you will reconsider your decision.
dialogsDecline.ru: I understand your apprehension, but I do hope you will reconsider your decision.
dialogsDecline.sp: Entiendo tu aprensión, pero espero que reconsideres tu decisión.
dialogsDecline.sw: I understand your apprehension, but I do hope you will reconsider your decision.
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันเข้าใจความเข้าใจของคุณ แต่ฉันหวังว่าคุณจะพิจารณาการตัดสินใจของคุณใหม่
dialogsDecline.tw: 我理解你的擔憂，但我希望你能重新考慮你的決定。
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi hiểu sự e ngại của bạn, nhưng tôi hy vọng bạn sẽ xem xét lại quyết định của mình.

dialogsComplete.en: Hah! It is as the citizens have said, you ARE truly a great warrior.
dialogsComplete.ar: Hah! It is as the citizens have said, you ARE truly a great warrior.
dialogsComplete.br: Haha! É como os cidadãos disseram, você realmente é um(a) grande guerreiro(a).
dialogsComplete.cns: 好！正如居民们所说的，你是一个真正伟大的战士。
dialogsComplete.de: Hah! Es ist, wie die Bürger gesagt haben, du bist wirklich ein großer Krieger.
dialogsComplete.fi: Hah! It is as the citizens have said, you ARE truly a great warrior.
dialogsComplete.fil: Hah! It is as the citizens have said, you ARE truly a great warrior.
dialogsComplete.fr: Déjà de retour ? Vous n'avez pas volé votre réputation.
dialogsComplete.id: Hah! Tepat seperti yang dikatakan warga, Kamu benar-benar pejuang yang hebat.
dialogsComplete.it: Hah! It is as the citizens have said, you ARE truly a great warrior.
dialogsComplete.jp: おお、やはり噂通りの実力ですね。ありがとうございます。
dialogsComplete.kr: 와앗! 시민 말대로 정말 대단한 워리어시군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Hah! It is as the citizens have said, you ARE truly a great warrior.
dialogsComplete.pl: Hah! It is as the citizens have said, you ARE truly a great warrior.
dialogsComplete.ru: Ха! Значит слухи не врали, ты действительно стоящий боец.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Ja! Es como han dicho los ciudadanos, de verdad ERES un gran guerrero.
dialogsComplete.sw: Hah! It is as the citizens have said, you ARE truly a great warrior.
dialogsComplete.th: ฮะ! อย่างที่ชาวเมืองกล่าวไว้ คุณเป็นนักรบที่ยิ่งใหญ่อย่างแท้จริง
dialogsComplete.tw: 哈！正如市民所說，你是真正的偉大戰士。
dialogsComplete.vi: Hả! Như người dân đã nói, bạn thực sự là một chiến binh vĩ đại.

dialogsFail.en: The Nyangnyang roam the lands right across the bridge of Northern Flaris. Please help us to decrease their numbers!
dialogsFail.ar: The Nyangnyang roam the lands right across the bridge of Northern Flaris. Please help us to decrease their numbers!
dialogsFail.br: As Nyangnyangs vagam pelas terras do outro lado da ponte de Flaris, ao Norte. Por favor, ajude-nos a diminuir seus números!
dialogsFail.cns: 彩冠翎猫游荡在帕里北部的桥对面。请帮助我们消灭它们。
dialogsFail.de: Die Nyangnyang durchstreifen das Land direkt hinter der Brücke von Nordflaris. Bitte helft uns, ihre Zahl zu verringern!
dialogsFail.fi: The Nyangnyang roam the lands right across the bridge of Northern Flaris. Please help us to decrease their numbers!
dialogsFail.fil: The Nyangnyang roam the lands right across the bridge of Northern Flaris. Please help us to decrease their numbers!
dialogsFail.fr: Ne vous laissez pas attendrir par leur apparence, ce sont de vraies tigresses !
dialogsFail.id: Nyangnyang berkeliaran tepat di seberang jembatan Northern Flaris. Tolong bantu kami untuk mengurangi jumlah mereka!
dialogsFail.it: The Nyangnyang roam the lands right across the bridge of Northern Flaris. Please help us to decrease their numbers!
dialogsFail.jp: ニャングニャングは見た目の可愛らしさとは裏腹に残忍な性格をしています。このままでは村人が危険ですのでどうかよろしくお願いします。
dialogsFail.kr: 플라리스 북부 다리 너머에 냥냥이 돌아다니고 있어요. 냥냥의 머릿수가 줄어든다면 큰 도움이 될 거예요!
dialogsFail.nl: The Nyangnyang roam the lands right across the bridge of Northern Flaris. Please help us to decrease their numbers!
dialogsFail.pl: The Nyangnyang roam the lands right across the bridge of Northern Flaris. Please help us to decrease their numbers!
dialogsFail.ru: The Nyangnyang roam the lands right across the bridge of Northern Flaris. Please help us to decrease their numbers!
dialogsFail.sp: Los Nyangnyang están al otro lado del puente al Norte de Flaris. ¡Por favor ayúdanos a disminuir sus números!
dialogsFail.sw: The Nyangnyang roam the lands right across the bridge of Northern Flaris. Please help us to decrease their numbers!
dialogsFail.th: ชาว Nyangnyang ท่องไปทั่วดินแดนตรงข้ามสะพาน Northern Flaris โปรดช่วยเราลดจำนวนของพวกเขา!
dialogsFail.tw: 裝可愛喵娘穿過布拉禮斯北方的橋，在這片土地上漫遊。請幫助我們減少它們的數量！
dialogsFail.vi: Nyangnyang đi lang thang trên các vùng đất ngay bên kia cầu Bắc Flaris. Hãy giúp chúng tôi giảm số lượng của họ!

name.jp: 放浪者マスター（アシスト）

description.en: Slay 10 Small Mushpangs and 10 Small Burudengs just north of Eastern Flarine then return to Assist Drillmaster Elic.
description.ar: Slay 10 Small Mushpangs and 10 Small Burudengs just north of Eastern Flarine then return to Assist Drillmaster Elic.
description.br: Cace 10 Mushpangs Pequenos e 10 Burudengs Pequenos ao nordeste de Flarine e então volte para o Assist Militar Elic.
description.cns: 击杀10只小嘭嘭菇和10只小象牙甲虫，完成后去帕里东广场找圣职教官埃里克！
description.de: Jage 10 Small Mushpangs und 10 Small Burudengs nördlich von Ost-Flaris und kehre zu Assist Ausbilder Elic zurück.
description.fi: Slay 10 Small Mushpangs and 10 Small Burudengs just north of Eastern Flarine then return to Assist Drillmaster Elic.
description.fil: Slay 10 Small Mushpangs and 10 Small Burudengs just north of Eastern Flarine then return to Assist Drillmaster Elic.
description.fr: Tuer 10 Jeunes Mushpangs et 10 Jeunes Burudengs puis retourner voir Elic à Flarine Est pour passer le premier test de la voie de l'Acolyte.
description.id: Bunuh 10 Small Mushpangs dan 10 Small Burudengsl di utara Flarine Timur lalu kembali ke Assist Drillmaster Elic.
description.it: Slay 10 Small Mushpangs and 10 Small Burudengs just north of Eastern Flarine then return to Assist Drillmaster Elic.
description.jp: スモール・マッシュファング、スモール・ブルデングを10匹狩ってくること。
description.kr: 플라리네 동북부에 있는 작은 머쉬팡 10마리와 작은 부루뎅 10마리를 처치한 후, 어시스트 훈련 조교 엘릭에게 돌아가세요.
description.nl: Slay 10 Small Mushpangs and 10 Small Burudengs just north of Eastern Flarine then return to Assist Drillmaster Elic.
description.pl: Slay 10 Small Mushpangs and 10 Small Burudengs just north of Eastern Flarine then return to Assist Drillmaster Elic.
description.ru: Нужно убить десяток слабых сглазов и десяток слабых жукорогов чуть севернее восточной Фларинции и вернуться к вербовщику униформистов Элю.
description.sp: Derrota a 10 Mushpangs Pequeños y a 10 Burudengs Pequeños al norte desde Flarine Este y vuelve con la Instructora Assist Elic.
description.sw: Slay 10 Small Mushpangs and 10 Small Burudengs just north of Eastern Flarine then return to Assist Drillmaster Elic.
description.th: สังหาร Small Mushpangs 10 ตัว และ Small Burudengs 10 ตัว ทางเหนือของ Eastern Flarine จากนั้นกลับไปที่ Assist Drillmaster Elic
description.tw: 擊殺 10 隻新鮮的咚咚菇和 10 隻小藍甲蟲，完成後去布拉里斯東廣場找神職教官艾里維得！(任務失敗時，可以重新挑戰)
description.vi: Giết 10 Small Mushpangs và 10 Small Burudengs ở ngay phía bắc của Eastern Flarine, sau đó quay trở lại Assist Drillmaster Elic.

dialogsBegin.en: So you want to be an Assist, huh? I don't blame you. It's the best job in Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.ar: So you want to be an Assist, huh? I don't blame you. It's the best job in Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.br: Então você quer ser um Assist, hein? Te entendo, é a melhor classe de Madrigal! Mas tenha em mente que não é nada fácil. Devo lhe passar um teste simples. Você está pronto?
dialogsBegin.cns: 所以你想成为一名圣职者，嗯哼？我不责怪你，圣职者是瑞加大陆最好的职业。
dialogsBegin.de: Du willst also Assist werden, was? Kann ich dir nicht verdenken. Das ist der beste Job in Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.fi: So you want to be an Assist, huh? I don't blame you. It's the best job in Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.fil: So you want to be an Assist, huh? I don't blame you. It's the best job in Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu souhaites donc devenir Acolyte, c'est un très bon choix ! Cependant tu dois mériter cette classe, et je vais donc te faire passer quelques tests.
dialogsBegin.id: Jadi kamu ingin menjadi Assist, ya? Aku tidak menyalahkanmu. Ini pekerjaan terbaik di Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.it: So you want to be an Assist, huh? I don't blame you. It's the best job in Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.jp: ほほう、アシストを志したいとな！君の選択には敬意を表しよう。しかし、アシストへの道はそんなに甘くないことを覚えておいてくれ。では早速、簡単なテストを行うことにしよう。心の準備は出来ているかな？
dialogsBegin.kr: 어시스트가 되고 싶으시다고요? 잘 선택하셨어요. 마드리갈에서 가장 멋진 직업이거든요!
dialogsBegin.nl: So you want to be an Assist, huh? I don't blame you. It's the best job in Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.pl: So you want to be an Assist, huh? I don't blame you. It's the best job in Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.ru: So you want to be an Assist, huh? I don't blame you. It's the best job in Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.sp: Así que quieres ser Assist, ¿eh? No te culpo. ¡Es la mejor clase de Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.sw: So you want to be an Assist, huh? I don't blame you. It's the best job in Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.th: ดังนั้นคุณจึงต้องการเป็น Assist ใช่มั้ย? ฉันไม่โทษคุณ นี่เป็นอาชีพที่ดีที่สุดในเมือง Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.tw: 所以你想成為助理，對吧？我不怪你。這是瑪德利賈最好的工作！
dialogsBegin.vi: Vì vậy, bạn muốn trở thành một Assist, hử? Tôi không trách bạn. Đó là công việc tốt nhất ở Madrigal!

dialogsBegin.en: First, I want you to take care of a little something for me. Small Mushpangs have been eating our crops lately.
dialogsBegin.ar: First, I want you to take care of a little something for me. Small Mushpangs have been eating our crops lately.
dialogsBegin.br: Vou testar a rapidez e precisão com as quais você completa o teste, levando em consideração seu curto tempo como Vagrant.
dialogsBegin.cns: 现在开始要进行考验了，这个训练主要是，看你在初心者的时候，有没有努力的练功，也要见识一下你的速度。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich möchte sehen, wie schnell und präzise du deine Aufgaben mit deiner geringen Erfahrung als Vagrant erfüllst.
dialogsBegin.fi: First, I want you to take care of a little something for me. Small Mushpangs have been eating our crops lately.
dialogsBegin.fil: First, I want you to take care of a little something for me. Small Mushpangs have been eating our crops lately.
dialogsBegin.fr: Pour commencer, j'aimerais évaluer ta vivacité. Dernièrement, de Jeunes Mushpangs dévorent nos cultures. Rien d'impossible, n'est-ce pas ?
dialogsBegin.id: Pertama, aku ingin kamu mengurus sesuatu untukku. Small Mushpangs telah memakan hasil panen kami akhir-akhir ini.
dialogsBegin.it: First, I want you to take care of a little something for me. Small Mushpangs have been eating our crops lately.
dialogsBegin.jp: 心の準備はできたか？では、最初の課題だ。これは諸君が放浪者としてどのくらい熟練したかを評価するものだ。これから指示したことを、どれくらい早く正確に遂行できるかを試させてもらおう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 먼저, 간단한 일을 좀 부탁할게요. 요즘 작은 머쉬팡들이 사람들이 키우는 작물을 먹어치우고 있어서요.
dialogsBegin.nl: First, I want you to take care of a little something for me. Small Mushpangs have been eating our crops lately.
dialogsBegin.pl: First, I want you to take care of a little something for me. Small Mushpangs have been eating our crops lately.
dialogsBegin.ru: Униформист всегда помогает другим. Вот и ты помоги жителям нашего города. В полях завелись слабые сглазы. Людей они не трогают, а урожай страдает.
dialogsBegin.sp: Primero, quiero que te encargues de algo para mi. Los Mushpangs Pequeños se han estado comiendo nuestras cosechas.
dialogsBegin.sw: First, I want you to take care of a little something for me. Small Mushpangs have been eating our crops lately.
dialogsBegin.th: ขั้นแรก ฉันต้องการให้คุณจัดการเรื่องเล็กน้อยให้ฉันหน่อย Small Mushpangs ได้กินพืชของเราเมื่อเร็วๆ นี้
dialogsBegin.tw: 現在開始要進行考驗了，這個訓練主要是，看你在見習生的時候，有沒有努力的練功，也要見識一下你的速度。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đầu tiên, tôi muốn bạn quan tâm một chút gì đó cho tôi. Những con Small Mushpangs gần đây đã ăn hoa màu của chúng ta.

dialogsBegin.en: Just north of here, there are several Small Mushpangs. Slay 10 of them with 10 Small Burudengs and return to me as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.ar: Just north of here, there are several Small Mushpangs. Slay 10 of them with 10 Small Burudengs and return to me as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.br: Ao norte daqui, existem vários Mushpangs Pequenos. Cace 10 deles e 10 Burudengs Pequenos e volte para mim o mais rápido possível.
dialogsBegin.cns: 从现在开始，你要去猎杀10只独小嘭嘭菇和10只小象牙甲虫回来!
dialogsBegin.de: Nördlich von hier gibt es viele Small Mushpangs. Jage 10 von ihnen und ebenfalls 10 Small Burudengs. Kehre dann sobald möglich zurück!
dialogsBegin.fi: Just north of here, there are several Small Mushpangs. Slay 10 of them with 10 Small Burudengs and return to me as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.fil: Just north of here, there are several Small Mushpangs. Slay 10 of them with 10 Small Burudengs and return to me as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.fr: Va tuer 10 Jeunes Mushpangs et 10 Jeunes Burudengs. Si tu restes concentré, cela sera une formalité tu verras.
dialogsBegin.id: Di utara sini, ada beberapa Small Mushpangs. Bunuh 10 dari mereka dengan 10 Small Burudengs dan kembalikan padaku secepat mungkin.
dialogsBegin.it: Just north of here, there are several Small Mushpangs. Slay 10 of them with 10 Small Burudengs and return to me as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.jp: スモール・マッシュファングを10匹、スモール・ブルデングを10匹狩ってきたまえ！わかったかな？では、テスト開始だ！
dialogsBegin.kr: 이곳에서 북쪽으로 가면 작은 머쉬팡들이 있어요. 작은 머쉬팡 10마리와 작은 부루뎅 10마리를 처치하고 바로 돌아오세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Just north of here, there are several Small Mushpangs. Slay 10 of them with 10 Small Burudengs and return to me as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.pl: Just north of here, there are several Small Mushpangs. Slay 10 of them with 10 Small Burudengs and return to me as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.ru: Отправляйся на север от города - и увидишь слабых сыробежек. Убей десяток их, потом ещё десяток слабых жукорогов и возвращайся. Хорошо?
dialogsBegin.sp: Justo al norte de aquí, hay varios Mushpangs Pequeños. Caza a 10 de ellos y a 10 Burudengs Pequeños y vuelve lo más rápido posible.
dialogsBegin.sw: Just north of here, there are several Small Mushpangs. Slay 10 of them with 10 Small Burudengs and return to me as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.th: ในทางเหนือของที่นี่มี Small Mushpangs หลายตัว ฆ่าพวกมัน 10 ตัว กับ Small Burudengs 10 ตัว แล้วกลับมาหาฉันโดยเร็วที่สุด
dialogsBegin.tw: 從現在開始，你要去獵殺 10 隻新鮮的咚咚菇和 10 隻小藍甲蟲回來！請在時間限制內 盡快回到我身邊。(任務失敗時，可以重新挑戰)
dialogsBegin.vi: Ngay phía bắc đây, có một số Small Mushpangs. Giết 10 Small Mushpangs với 10 Small Burudengs và quay trở lại tôi càng sớm càng tốt.

dialogsAccept.en: Good luck, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.ar: Good luck, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.br: Boa sorte, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你好运，初心者！
dialogsAccept.de: Viel Glück, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.fi: Good luck, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.fil: Good luck, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.fr: Allez, je compte sur toi !
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga berhasil, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.it: Good luck, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.jp: 最後まで慎重に、速やかに、そして正確に課題をやりとげるのだ。では、行ってきたまえ！
dialogsAccept.kr: 행운을 빌어요, 방랑자님!
dialogsAccept.nl: Good luck, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.pl: Good luck, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.ru: Good luck, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Buena suerte, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.sw: Good luck, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้โชคดี Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.tw: 好運，見習生！
dialogsAccept.vi: Chúc may mắn, Vagrant!

dialogsDecline.en: Having a change of heart? That's alright, come speak to me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ar: Having a change of heart? That's alright, come speak to me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.br: Mudou de ideia? Tudo bem, venha falar comigo novamente quando quiser.
dialogsDecline.cns: 想法有所改变了？没事，等你改变主意了再回来找我。
dialogsDecline.de: Hast du deine Meinung geändert? Das ist in Ordnung, sprich mich wieder an, wenn du deine Meinung nochmal änderst.
dialogsDecline.fi: Having a change of heart? That's alright, come speak to me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fil: Having a change of heart? That's alright, come speak to me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu ne souhaites pas devenir Acolyte ? Dommage, mais tu es le seul responsable de ton avenir.
dialogsDecline.id: Ada perubahan? Tidak apa-apa, datang dan bicaralah lagi jika kamu berubah pikiran.
dialogsDecline.it: Having a change of heart? That's alright, come speak to me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.jp: おや？もう最初の課題で怖気づいたのか？本官は志の弱い者には用がない。諦めたのであれば、さっさと帰りなさい。以上！
dialogsDecline.kr: 마음이 바뀌셨나요? 괜찮아요. 생각이 바뀌면 언제든 다시 와주세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Having a change of heart? That's alright, come speak to me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.pl: Having a change of heart? That's alright, come speak to me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ru: Что, больше не хочешь быть униформистом? Подумай еще. Если что - приходи.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Estás cambiando de planes? Está bien, ven a hablarme de nuevo si cambias de opinión.
dialogsDecline.sw: Having a change of heart? That's alright, come speak to me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.th: เปลี่ยนใจเหรอ? ไม่เป็นไร มาพูดกับฉันอีกครั้งถ้าคุณเปลี่ยนใจ
dialogsDecline.tw: 改變心意了？沒關係，如果你改變主意，再來找我說話。
dialogsDecline.vi: Đổi ý à? Được rồi, hãy đến nói chuyện với tôi lần nữa nếu bạn đổi ý.

dialogsComplete.en: Excellent work! Hopefully they'll stay away from our crops now.
dialogsComplete.ar: Excellent work! Hopefully they'll stay away from our crops now.
dialogsComplete.br: Parabéns! Mas você ainda tem muito o que fazer. Tornar-se um Assist não é tão fácil assim.
dialogsComplete.cns: 厉害!但是不是这样就结束的，要成为一个真正的圣职者的话，还要接受很多的考验。
dialogsComplete.de: Gut gemacht. Aber denke daran, das ist noch nicht das Ende. Du musst weitere Dinge erledigen. Es ist nicht einfach Assist zu werden.
dialogsComplete.fi: Excellent work! Hopefully they'll stay away from our crops now.
dialogsComplete.fil: Excellent work! Hopefully they'll stay away from our crops now.
dialogsComplete.fr: Bien joué. Mais tu as encore beaucoup à faire. Devenir Acolyte c'est loin d'être chose facile.
dialogsComplete.id: Kerja bagus! Semoga mereka akan menjauh dari tanaman kita sekarang.
dialogsComplete.it: Excellent work! Hopefully they'll stay away from our crops now.
dialogsComplete.jp: よくやってくれた、諸君！しかしこれで終わりではないぞ。諸君がやり遂げなければならないことは、まだまだたくさんある。アシストの道は険しいのだ、覚悟したまえ。よろしいかな？
dialogsComplete.kr: 훌륭해요! 이젠 녀석들이 작물 근처엔 얼씬도 못 하겠네요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Excellent work! Hopefully they'll stay away from our crops now.
dialogsComplete.pl: Excellent work! Hopefully they'll stay away from our crops now.
dialogsComplete.ru: Отлично! Надеюсь, больше они не будут досаждать нам.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Excelente trabajo! Esperemos que se mantengan alejados de nuestras cosechas.
dialogsComplete.sw: Excellent work! Hopefully they'll stay away from our crops now.
dialogsComplete.th: ทำงานได้ดีเยี่ยม! หวังว่าต่อจากนี้พวกมันจะอยู่ห่างจากพืชของเรา
dialogsComplete.tw: 厲害！但是不是這樣就結束的，要成為一個真正的神職者的話，還要接受很多的考驗。
dialogsComplete.vi: Xuất sắc lắm! Hy vọng rằng chúng sẽ tránh xa cây trồng của chúng tôi bây giờ.

dialogsComplete.en: You've done very well so far. Keep up the good work!
dialogsComplete.ar: You've done very well so far. Keep up the good work!
dialogsComplete.br: Estou certo de que você já está pronto para isso. Boa sorte!
dialogsComplete.cns: 我相信你一定可以办得到的，有心理准备了吗?请你继续加油!
dialogsComplete.de: Ich bin sicher, dass du bereit dafür bist. Hoffentlich wirst du die nächste Prüfung mit ebenso viel Mut angehen. Viel Glück!
dialogsComplete.fi: You've done very well so far. Keep up the good work!
dialogsComplete.fil: You've done very well so far. Keep up the good work!
dialogsComplete.fr: Allez bonne chance !
dialogsComplete.id: Kamu telah melakukannya dengan sangat baik sejauh ini. Pertahankan kerja bagus!
dialogsComplete.it: You've done very well so far. Keep up the good work!
dialogsComplete.jp: 諸君の心にはすでに、厳しく険しい道を歩んでいく覚悟は出来ているだろう。次のテストも高い志を持って頑張るのだ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 지금까지 아주 잘 해오셨어요. 이대로 계속 힘내세요!
dialogsComplete.nl: You've done very well so far. Keep up the good work!
dialogsComplete.pl: You've done very well so far. Keep up the good work!
dialogsComplete.ru: Ну что же, великолепно! Уверен, мы еще будем тобой гордиться.
dialogsComplete.sp: Lo has hecho muy bien hasta ahora. ¡Sigue así!
dialogsComplete.sw: You've done very well so far. Keep up the good work!
dialogsComplete.th: คุณทำได้ดีมากแล้ว จงทำดีต่อไป!
dialogsComplete.tw: 我相信你一定可以辦得到的，有心理準備了嗎？請你繼續加油！
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn đã làm rất tốt. Hãy tiếp tục phát huy!

dialogsFail.en: Hurry! There isn't much time!
dialogsFail.ar: Hurry! There isn't much time!
dialogsFail.br: Depressa! Você não tem tempo suficiente!
dialogsFail.cns: 你所剩下的时间不多了，请你赶快去吧!不然时间会不够的!
dialogsFail.de: Wenn du nur leichtfertig an diese Aufgabe gehst, kannst du nicht erwarten, sie zu bestehen.
dialogsFail.fi: Hurry! There isn't much time!
dialogsFail.fil: Hurry! There isn't much time!
dialogsFail.fr: Dépêche-toi, tu prends trop ton temps pour un objectif aussi simple !
dialogsFail.id: Cepatlah! Tidak ada banyak waktu!
dialogsFail.it: Hurry! There isn't much time!
dialogsFail.jp: 諸君にはあまり時間が無いはずだぞ？こうしている余裕があるとはたいしたものだ。しかし、いい加減な態度ではテストに合格することはできないぞ。気をひきしめたまえ。
dialogsFail.kr: 서둘러 주세요! 시간이 많지 않아요!
dialogsFail.nl: Hurry! There isn't much time!
dialogsFail.pl: Hurry! There isn't much time!
dialogsFail.ru: Быстрее! Времени не так-то много!
dialogsFail.sp: ¡Date prisa! ¡No hay mucho tiempo!
dialogsFail.sw: Hurry! There isn't much time!
dialogsFail.th: รีบหน่อย! มีเวลาไม่มากนะ!
dialogsFail.tw: 你所剩下的時間不多了，請你趕快去吧！不然時間會不夠的！
dialogsFail.vi: Nhanh lên! Không có nhiều thời gian!

description.en: Collect 5 Syliaca Fillet and 5 Greemong Jelly, then bring them to Rankashu in the Western region of Darkon 1.
description.ar: Collect 5 Syliaca Fillet and 5 Greemong Jelly, then bring them to Rankashu in the Western region of Darkon 1.
description.br: Colete 5 Filés de Syliaca e 5 Geleias de Greemong, depois leve-os para Rankashu na região Oeste de Darkon 1.
description.cns: 收集5个绿鳞片和5个绿泥液，然后把它们交给达肯1西部的小草儿。
description.de: Sammel 5 Syliaca Fish und 5 Greemog Jelly, gehe dann zu Rankashu in der westlichen Region von Darkon 1.
description.fi: Collect 5 Syliaca Fillet and 5 Greemong Jelly, then bring them to Rankashu in the Western region of Darkon 1.
description.fil: Collect 5 Syliaca Fillet and 5 Greemong Jelly, then bring them to Rankashu in the Western region of Darkon 1.
description.fr: Apportez 5 filets de Syliaca et 5 gelées de Greemong à Rankashu.
description.id: Kumpulkan 5 Syliaca Fillet dan 5 Greemong Jelly, lalu bawa mereka ke Rankashu di wilayah Barat Darkon 1.
description.it: Collect 5 Syliaca Fillet and 5 Greemong Jelly, then bring them to Rankashu in the Western region of Darkon 1.
description.jp: シーラカの肉とグリーモンゼリーを入手した後、ランカシュを訪ねよ。
description.kr: 실리아카 스테이크 5개와 그리몽 젤리 5개를 모아, 다콘 제1지구 서쪽 지역에 있는 랑카슈에게 가져가세요.
description.nl: Collect 5 Syliaca Fillet and 5 Greemong Jelly, then bring them to Rankashu in the Western region of Darkon 1.
description.pl: Collect 5 Syliaca Fillet and 5 Greemong Jelly, then bring them to Rankashu in the Western region of Darkon 1.
description.ru: Collect 5 Syliaca Fillet and 5 Greemong Jelly, then bring them to Rankashu in the Western region of Darkon 1.
description.sp: Consigue 5 Filetes de Syliaca y 5 Gelatinas de Greemongs, después llévaselos a Rankashu al Oeste de Darkon 1.
description.sw: Collect 5 Syliaca Fillet and 5 Greemong Jelly, then bring them to Rankashu in the Western region of Darkon 1.
description.th: เก็บ Syliaca Fillet 5 และ Greemong Jelly 5 แล้วนำไปให้ Rankashu ในพื้นที่ทางตะวันตกของ Darkon 1.
description.tw: 收集 5 份獅頭魚肉與 5 份史萊膿果醬，交給得肯第一區西部的小草兒。
description.vi: Thu thập 5 Syliaca Fillet và 5 Greemong Jelly, sau đó mang chúng đến Rankashu ở phía Tây của Darkon 1.

dialogsBegin.en: Oh! Haha, why I haven't changed yet you ask? I'm not entirely sure. I feel that the curse should have let up by now…
dialogsBegin.ar: Oh! Haha, why I haven't changed yet you ask? I'm not entirely sure. I feel that the curse should have let up by now…
dialogsBegin.br: Oh! Haha, por que eu não mudei ainda, você pergunta? Eu não tenho certeza. Eu sinto que a maldição deveria ter cessado agora…
dialogsBegin.cns: 哦！哈哈，你问我为什么还没有改变？我也不清楚。但我觉得诅咒应该已经减弱了...
dialogsBegin.de: Oh! Haha, Sie fragen sich, warum ich mich noch nicht umgezogen habe? Ich bin mir nicht ganz sicher. Ich habe das Gefühl, dass der Fluch inzwischen nachgelassen haben sollte...
dialogsBegin.fi: Oh! Haha, why I haven't changed yet you ask? I'm not entirely sure. I feel that the curse should have let up by now…
dialogsBegin.fil: Oh! Haha, why I haven't changed yet you ask? I'm not entirely sure. I feel that the curse should have let up by now…
dialogsBegin.fr: Malgré tous mes efforts je n'ai pas réussi à me débarrasser de cette malédiction !
dialogsBegin.id: Oh! Haha, kenapa aku belum berubah kamu bilang? Saya tidak sepenuhnya yakin. Saya merasa bahwa kutukan itu seharusnya sudah menyerah sekarang ...
dialogsBegin.it: Oh! Haha, why I haven't changed yet you ask? I'm not entirely sure. I feel that the curse should have let up by now…
dialogsBegin.jp: む、まだどうしてこの姿のままなのかって？　ふん、こっちが聞きたいくらいだ。何をどう間違えているのか……
dialogsBegin.kr: 오! 하하, 왜 아직 변하지 않았느냐고요? 저도 잘 모르겠어요. 지금쯤이면 저주가 풀렸어야 정상인데...
dialogsBegin.nl: Oh! Haha, why I haven't changed yet you ask? I'm not entirely sure. I feel that the curse should have let up by now…
dialogsBegin.pl: Oh! Haha, why I haven't changed yet you ask? I'm not entirely sure. I feel that the curse should have let up by now…
dialogsBegin.ru: Oh! Haha, why I haven't changed yet you ask? I'm not entirely sure. I feel that the curse should have let up by now…
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Oh! Jaja, ¿que por qué no he cambiado todavía, dices? No lo tengo claro. Creo que la maldición ya debería haber cesado...
dialogsBegin.sw: Oh! Haha, why I haven't changed yet you ask? I'm not entirely sure. I feel that the curse should have let up by now…
dialogsBegin.th: โอ้ว ! ฮ่า ๆ ทำไมฉันยังไม่ได้เปลี่ยนคุณถาม? ฉันไม่แน่ใจเลย ฉันรู้สึกว่าการสาปแช่งควรจะให้ขึ้นโดยขณะนี้ ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 你問為什麼我會變成這樣子？你說到我的痛處了…不管怎麼等待，我身上的詛咒都無法解除，我正在煩惱呢。
dialogsBegin.vi: Ồ! Haha, tại sao tôi vẫn chưa thay đổi mà bạn hỏi? Tôi không hoàn toàn chắc chắn. Tôi cảm thấy rằng lời nguyền đáng lẽ đã từ bỏ ngay bây giờ…

dialogsBegin.en: I do know someone who may be of assistance. His name is Rankashu, a descendent of Shamanistic Dwarpets who have lived in Darkon longer than man.
dialogsBegin.ar: I do know someone who may be of assistance. His name is Rankashu, a descendent of Shamanistic Dwarpets who have lived in Darkon longer than man.
dialogsBegin.br: Conheço alguém que pode ajudar. Seu nome é Rankashu, um descendente de Anões Xamânicos que viveram em Darkon por mais tempo que o homem.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我认识一个人，他可能会有所帮助。他的名字叫小草儿，是萨满教矮人族的后裔，他们在达肯生活的时间比人类长。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich kenne jemanden, der uns vielleicht helfen kann. Sein Name ist Rankashu, ein Nachkomme der schamanistischen Dwarpets, die schon länger in Darkon leben als die Menschen.
dialogsBegin.fi: I do know someone who may be of assistance. His name is Rankashu, a descendent of Shamanistic Dwarpets who have lived in Darkon longer than man.
dialogsBegin.fil: I do know someone who may be of assistance. His name is Rankashu, a descendent of Shamanistic Dwarpets who have lived in Darkon longer than man.
dialogsBegin.fr: Rankashu est un descendant des anciens Dwarpets. C'est un expert en malédictions, j'imagine qu'il aurait une idée sur la question.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya mengenal seseorang yang mungkin bisa membantu. Namanya Rankashu, keturunan Shamanistic Dwarpets yang telah tinggal di Darkon lebih lama dari manusia.
dialogsBegin.it: I do know someone who may be of assistance. His name is Rankashu, a descendent of Shamanistic Dwarpets who have lived in Darkon longer than man.
dialogsBegin.jp: なあ、ランカシュって知ってるかい？　ダーコン地区に古くから生息している一族の子孫らしいんだが、彼ならこの呪いについて詳しいかもしれない。
dialogsBegin.kr: 도움이 될 만한 자를 알고 있어요. 랑카슈라는 이름의, 인간보다 먼저 다콘에 자리 잡고 살아온 샤먼 드워펫의 후예죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: I do know someone who may be of assistance. His name is Rankashu, a descendent of Shamanistic Dwarpets who have lived in Darkon longer than man.
dialogsBegin.pl: I do know someone who may be of assistance. His name is Rankashu, a descendent of Shamanistic Dwarpets who have lived in Darkon longer than man.
dialogsBegin.ru: I do know someone who may be of assistance. His name is Rankashu, a descendent of Shamanistic Dwarpets who have lived in Darkon longer than man.
dialogsBegin.sp: Conozco a alguien que puede ser de ayuda. Su nombre es Rankashu, un descendiente de los Enanos Chamanes que han vivido en Darkon por más tiempo que el hombre.
dialogsBegin.sw: I do know someone who may be of assistance. His name is Rankashu, a descendent of Shamanistic Dwarpets who have lived in Darkon longer than man.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันรู้จักใครบางคนที่อาจได้รับความช่วยเหลือ ชื่อของเขาคือ Rankashu ซึ่งสืบเชื้อสายมาจาก Shamanistic Dwarpets ที่อาศัยอยู่ใน Darkon นานกว่ามนุษย์
dialogsBegin.tw: 所以…你可以去找一下小草兒，幫我問他為什麼我的詛咒無法解開嗎？小草兒是在得肯大陸長久扎根存活下來的杜爾沛的後代。我想說不定他會知道。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi biết ai đó có thể giúp đỡ. Tên anh ta là Rankashu, hậu duệ của Người lùn Shamanistic, những người đã sống trong Darkon lâu hơn con người.

dialogsBegin.en: He might have some useful information pertaining to this curse and what else I need to do! Will you seek him out for me?
dialogsBegin.ar: He might have some useful information pertaining to this curse and what else I need to do! Will you seek him out for me?
dialogsBegin.br: Ele pode ter alguma informação útil referente a essa maldição e o que mais eu preciso fazer! Você pode procurá-lo para mim??
dialogsBegin.cns: He might have some useful information pertaining to this curse and what else I need to do! Will you seek him out for me?
dialogsBegin.de: Er könnte nützliche Informationen über diesen Fluch haben und darüber, was ich sonst noch tun muss! Wirst du ihn für mich aufsuchen?
dialogsBegin.fi: He might have some useful information pertaining to this curse and what else I need to do! Will you seek him out for me?
dialogsBegin.fil: He might have some useful information pertaining to this curse and what else I need to do! Will you seek him out for me?
dialogsBegin.fr: Pourriez-vous aller le voir pour moi ?
dialogsBegin.id: Dia mungkin memiliki beberapa informasi berguna yang berkaitan dengan kutukan ini dan hal lainnya yang perlu aku lakukan! Maukah kamu mencarinya untukku??
dialogsBegin.it: He might have some useful information pertaining to this curse and what else I need to do! Will you seek him out for me?
dialogsBegin.jp: え、なぜそんなことをしなければならないかって？　ああ、ランカシュはこの地の風土にも詳しいからな。英雄についても何かわかるかもしれんぞ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 저주에 관한 유용한 정보가 있을지도 모르고, 제가 뭘 하면 될지도 알고 있을 거예요! 절 위해서 좀 찾아주실래요?
dialogsBegin.nl: He might have some useful information pertaining to this curse and what else I need to do! Will you seek him out for me?
dialogsBegin.pl: He might have some useful information pertaining to this curse and what else I need to do! Will you seek him out for me?
dialogsBegin.ru: He might have some useful information pertaining to this curse and what else I need to do! Will you seek him out for me?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Puede qué el tenga información útil relacionada con esta maldición y con lo qué debo hacer! ¿Lo irás a buscar por mí?
dialogsBegin.sw: He might have some useful information pertaining to this curse and what else I need to do! Will you seek him out for me?
dialogsBegin.th: เขาอาจมีข้อมูลที่เป็นประโยชน์เกี่ยวกับคำสาปนี้! คุณจะช่วยหาเขาให้ฉันได้มั้ย?
dialogsBegin.tw: 他或許知道一些和這個詛咒有關的情報，也知道我下一步該做什麼！你願意替我去找他嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Anh ta có thể có một số thông tin hữu ích liên quan đến lời nguyền này và những việc tôi cần làm tiếp theo! Bạn sẽ tìm anh ta cho tôi chứ?

dialogsAccept.en: OH! OH! Thank you! I know that Rankashu can't resist Syliaca Fillet and Greemong Jelly. I'm sure if you brought some of these, he'd spill whatever information you wanted!
dialogsAccept.ar: OH! OH! Thank you! I know that Rankashu can't resist Syliaca Fillet and Greemong Jelly. I'm sure if you brought some of these, he'd spill whatever information you wanted!
dialogsAccept.br: OH! OH! Obrigado! Eu sei que Rankashu não resiste a Filé Syliaca e Geleia de Greemong. Tenho certeza de que se você trouxesse alguns desses, ele derramaria qualquer informação que você quisesse!
dialogsAccept.cns: 噢! 噢! 谢谢你 我知道小草儿无法抗拒绿鳞片和绿泥液。我敢肯定，如果你带来这些东西，他就会说出你想要的任何信息!
dialogsAccept.de: OH! OH! Ich danke dir! Ich weiß, dass Rankashu Syliaca-Filet und Greemong-Gelee nicht widerstehen kann. Ich bin sicher, wenn du ihm etwas davon mitbringst, wird er dir alles erzählen, was du willst!
dialogsAccept.fi: OH! OH! Thank you! I know that Rankashu can't resist Syliaca Fillet and Greemong Jelly. I'm sure if you brought some of these, he'd spill whatever information you wanted!
dialogsAccept.fil: OH! OH! Thank you! I know that Rankashu can't resist Syliaca Fillet and Greemong Jelly. I'm sure if you brought some of these, he'd spill whatever information you wanted!
dialogsAccept.fr: Rankashu aime les filets de Syliaca à la gelée de Greemong, apportez-lui donc 5 de chaque.
dialogsAccept.id: OH! OH! Terima kasih! Saya tahu bahwa Rankashu tidak dapat menahan Syliaca Fillet dan Greemong Jelly. Saya yakin jika Anda membawa beberapa di antaranya, dia akan memberikan informasi apa pun yang Anda inginkan!
dialogsAccept.it: OH! OH! Thank you! I know that Rankashu can't resist Syliaca Fillet and Greemong Jelly. I'm sure if you brought some of these, he'd spill whatever information you wanted!
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとう。ランカシュはシーラカの肉やグリーモンゼリーが好きだからな。手土産に持っていくといいだろう。
dialogsAccept.kr: 오오! 정말 고마워요! 랑카슈는 실리아카 스테이크랑 그리몽 젤리에 정말 약하거든요. 몇 개 가져가면, 원하는 정보를 술술 알려줄 거예요!
dialogsAccept.nl: OH! OH! Thank you! I know that Rankashu can't resist Syliaca Fillet and Greemong Jelly. I'm sure if you brought some of these, he'd spill whatever information you wanted!
dialogsAccept.pl: OH! OH! Thank you! I know that Rankashu can't resist Syliaca Fillet and Greemong Jelly. I'm sure if you brought some of these, he'd spill whatever information you wanted!
dialogsAccept.ru: OH! OH! Thank you! I know that Rankashu can't resist Syliaca Fillet and Greemong Jelly. I'm sure if you brought some of these, he'd spill whatever information you wanted!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡OH! ¡OH! ¡Gracias! Sé que Rankashu no se puede resistir a los Filetes de Syliaca y a la Gelatina de Greemong. ¡Estoy seguro de que si le llevas algunos, te dirá toda la información que quieras!
dialogsAccept.sw: OH! OH! Thank you! I know that Rankashu can't resist Syliaca Fillet and Greemong Jelly. I'm sure if you brought some of these, he'd spill whatever information you wanted!
dialogsAccept.th: โอ้ว ! โอ้ว ! ขอขอบคุณ! ฉันรู้ว่า Rankashu ไม่สามารถต่อต้าน Syliaca Fillet และ Greemong Jelly ได้
dialogsAccept.tw: 喔喔！真的是很謝謝！小草兒很喜歡獅頭魚肉和一陀史萊膿果醬，如果可以收集一些，我想他應該會告訴你一些事情。
dialogsAccept.vi: OH! OH! Cảm ơn bạn! Tôi biết rằng Rankashu không thể chống lại Syliaca Fillet và Greemong Jelly. Tôi chắc rằng nếu bạn mang theo những thứ này, anh ta sẽ tung ra bất cứ thông tin gì bạn muốn!

dialogsDecline.en: Hmph! Well, you could be missing out on a chance to not only help me, but possibly learn of the location of the other 2 heroes as well!
dialogsDecline.ar: Hmph! Well, you could be missing out on a chance to not only help me, but possibly learn of the location of the other 2 heroes as well!
dialogsDecline.br: Hmph! Bem, você pode estar perdendo a chance de não apenas me ajudar, mas possivelmente descobrir a localização dos outros 2 heróis também!
dialogsDecline.cns: 啊哈! 好吧，你可能会错过一个机会，不仅能帮助到我，还有可能知道其他两位英雄的位置！
dialogsDecline.de: Hmpf! Nun, du könntest dir die Chance entgehen lassen, nicht nur mir zu helfen, sondern vielleicht auch den Aufenthaltsort der anderen beiden Helden zu erfahren!
dialogsDecline.fi: Hmph! Well, you could be missing out on a chance to not only help me, but possibly learn of the location of the other 2 heroes as well!
dialogsDecline.fil: Hmph! Well, you could be missing out on a chance to not only help me, but possibly learn of the location of the other 2 heroes as well!
dialogsDecline.fr: Par pitié, je n'en peux plus de cette malédiction.
dialogsDecline.id: Hmph! Anda bisa kehilangan kesempatan tidak hanya untuk membantu saya, tetapi mungkin juga untuk mengetahui lokasi 2 pahlawan lainnya!
dialogsDecline.it: Hmph! Well, you could be missing out on a chance to not only help me, but possibly learn of the location of the other 2 heroes as well!
dialogsDecline.jp: ふん、これくらい手伝ってくれてもいいじゃないか。
dialogsDecline.kr: 흥! 쳇, 저를 도와줄 기회는 물론이고, 남은 두 영웅의 행방까지 알 기회를 놓칠 수도 있어요!
dialogsDecline.nl: Hmph! Well, you could be missing out on a chance to not only help me, but possibly learn of the location of the other 2 heroes as well!
dialogsDecline.pl: Hmph! Well, you could be missing out on a chance to not only help me, but possibly learn of the location of the other 2 heroes as well!
dialogsDecline.ru: Hmph! Well, you could be missing out on a chance to not only help me, but possibly learn of the location of the other 2 heroes as well!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Pfff! Bueno, no solo estás perdiendo la oportunidad de ayudarme, ¡sino también de conocer la ubicación de los otros 2 héroes!
dialogsDecline.sw: Hmph! Well, you could be missing out on a chance to not only help me, but possibly learn of the location of the other 2 heroes as well!
dialogsDecline.th: ฮึ่ม! ดีคุณอาจจะพลาดโอกาสที่จะไม่เพียง แต่ช่วยฉัน แต่อาจจะเรียนรู้เกี่ยวกับตำแหน่งของวีรบุรุษอีก 2 ตัวด้วยเช่นกัน!
dialogsDecline.tw: 哼！好吧，你可能會錯過一個不只幫得上我的機會，甚至還可能得知另外 2 位英雄的位置！
dialogsDecline.vi: Hừm! Chà, bạn có thể bỏ lỡ một cơ hội không chỉ giúp tôi mà còn có thể tìm hiểu về vị trí của 2 người hùng khác!

dialogsComplete.th: ว่ายังไงงงงงง นั่นคือเนื้อ Syliaca และ Greemong Jelly กลิ่นอะไรอะ? โอ้ว! แน่นอนว่าคำขอเป็นอันดับแรกคือ อาหารฟรี ฮ่า!
dialogsComplete.tw: 喔你好啊！*聞聞* 這味道……是希莉卡魚片和古利蒙果凍嗎？喔！不過照慣例，果然還是得先幫個忙才行。免費食物？哈！
dialogsComplete.vi: Ái chà chà xin chào! *hít hà* Đó có phải là Syliaca fillet và Greemong Jelly không?? Ồ! À thì, đương nhiên là PHẢI CÓ một điều kiện gì đó trước rồi. Thức ăn miễn phí à, HA!

dialogsFail.en: Have you gathered the Syliaca fish and Greemong Jelly? You can find them by killing both Syliaca fish and Greemongs
dialogsFail.ar: Have you gathered the Syliaca fish and Greemong Jelly? You can find them by killing both Syliaca fish and Greemongs
dialogsFail.br: Você já conseguiu o Filés de Syliaca e as Geleias de Greemong? Você pode obter matando os peixes Syliaca e Greemongs respectivamente.
dialogsFail.cns: 你收集了绿鳞片和绿泥液吗？你可以通过杀死食人鱼和绿泥怪找到它们。
dialogsFail.de: Hast du die Syliaca-Fische und das Greemong-Gelee gesammelt? Du kannst sie finden, indem du sowohl Syliaca-Fische als auch Greemongs tötest
dialogsFail.fi: Have you gathered the Syliaca fish and Greemong Jelly? You can find them by killing both Syliaca fish and Greemongs
dialogsFail.fil: Have you gathered the Syliaca fish and Greemong Jelly? You can find them by killing both Syliaca fish and Greemongs
dialogsFail.fr: Je vous l'ai dit, il vous faut 5 filets de Syliaca et 5 gelées de Greemong. Apportez le tout à Rankashu.
dialogsFail.id: Sudahkah Anda mengumpulkan ikan Syliaca dan Greemong Jelly? Anda dapat menemukannya dengan membunuh ikan Syliaca dan Greemongs
dialogsFail.it: Have you gathered the Syliaca fish and Greemong Jelly? You can find them by killing both Syliaca fish and Greemongs
dialogsFail.jp: ランカシュはシーラカの肉やグリーモンゼリーが好きだからな。手土産に持っていくといいだろう。
dialogsFail.kr: 실리아카 스테이크랑 그리몽 젤리는 구했어요? 실리아카 물고기와 그리몽을 죽이면 얻을 수 있답니다.
dialogsFail.nl: Have you gathered the Syliaca fish and Greemong Jelly? You can find them by killing both Syliaca fish and Greemongs
dialogsFail.pl: Have you gathered the Syliaca fish and Greemong Jelly? You can find them by killing both Syliaca fish and Greemongs
dialogsFail.ru: Have you gathered the Syliaca fish and Greemong Jelly? You can find them by killing both Syliaca fish and Greemongs
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Has conseguido los Filetes de Syliaca y la Gelatina de Greemong? Puedes encontrarlos matando tanto a los peces Syliaca como a los Greemongs.
dialogsFail.sw: Have you gathered the Syliaca fish and Greemong Jelly? You can find them by killing both Syliaca fish and Greemongs
dialogsFail.th: คุณได้รวบรวมปลา Syliaca และ Greemong Jelly แล้วหรือยัง? คุณสามารถหาได้โดยการฆ่าทั้ง Syliaca และ Greemongs
dialogsFail.tw: 獅頭魚肉和一陀史萊膿果醬都拿回來了嗎？快一點收集，拿去給小草兒吧。
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn đã thu thập được cá Syliaca và Greemong Jelly chưa? Bạn có thể tìm thấy chúng bằng cách giết cả cá Syliaca và Greemongs

name.th: ความจริงของ Mia

description.en: Speak with the Mayor of Saint City and give him the evidence from the Mias.
description.ar: Speak with the Mayor of Saint City and give him the evidence from the Mias.
description.br: Ótimo. Por favor, leve você estas informações para o Prefeito de Saint em vez de mim, dê a ele as evidências das Mias.
description.cns: 好了，你帮我把这个拿去给他看好吗?他经常到外面巡逻，所以可能不在位子上，就等到他回去之后，再给他看吧!
description.de: Gut, bitte bringe dem Bürgermeisterin diese Daten. Vielleicht solltest du warten bis er von der Tour durch die Stadt zurückkehrt.
description.fi: Speak with the Mayor of Saint City and give him the evidence from the Mias.
description.fil: Speak with the Mayor of Saint City and give him the evidence from the Mias.
description.fr: Apporter les nouvelles informations sur les enlèvements au maire de Saincity, à la place de Porgo.
description.id: Bicaralah dengan Walikota Saint City dan berikan dia bukti dari Mias.
description.it: Speak with the Mayor of Saint City and give him the evidence from the Mias.
description.jp: 受け取った資料を持って、市長に会いに行こう。市長は街の視察で席を外していることが多いらしいので、居なかったらしばらく待ってみよう。
description.kr: 세인트 시티의 시장을 만나 대화하고, 미아에게 얻은 증거를 전달하세요.
description.nl: Speak with the Mayor of Saint City and give him the evidence from the Mias.
description.pl: Speak with the Mayor of Saint City and give him the evidence from the Mias.
description.ru: Нужно поговорить с мэром Санто и рассказать ему о Миа.
description.sp: Habla con el alcalde de Saint y dale la prueba sobre las Mias.
description.sw: Speak with the Mayor of Saint City and give him the evidence from the Mias.
description.th: พูดคุยกับนายกเทศมนตรีของ Saint City และนำหลักฐานจาก Mias ไปให้เขา
description.tw: 與聖音特市長交談，並把來自米兒的證據交給他。
description.vi: Nói chuyện với Thị trưởng của Saint City và cung cấp cho ông ta bằng chứng từ Mias.

dialogsBegin.en: Argh! Curse that darn mayor! He won't even listen to me!
dialogsBegin.ar: Argh! Curse that darn mayor! He won't even listen to me!
dialogsBegin.br: Argh! Aquela droga de prefeito! Eu fiz o melhor que pude para conseguir as informações, mas...!! Ugh!!!
dialogsBegin.cns: 哇啊!!这个臭市长!我为了找这些多么的辛苦啊..太过分了。
dialogsBegin.de: Verdammt! (wütend) Verdammter Bürgermeister! Ich habe mein Bestes gegeben um an die Informationen zu kommen, aber..!! Mist!!!
dialogsBegin.fi: Argh! Curse that darn mayor! He won't even listen to me!
dialogsBegin.fil: Argh! Curse that darn mayor! He won't even listen to me!
dialogsBegin.fr: Mince ! (en colère) Ahlala. le Maire ! J'ai fait de mon mieux pour avoir ces infos, mais..!! Mince alors !!
dialogsBegin.id: Argh! Terkutuklah walikota sialan itu! Dia bahkan tidak mau mendengarkanku!
dialogsBegin.it: Argh! Curse that darn mayor! He won't even listen to me!
dialogsBegin.jp: なんてことだ！チクショウ！！ あのバカな市長め！！ せっかく私が集めた情報を読みもせずに！
dialogsBegin.kr: 아악! 저 시장이란 사람! 말은 들으려고도 안 해요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Argh! Curse that darn mayor! He won't even listen to me!
dialogsBegin.pl: Argh! Curse that darn mayor! He won't even listen to me!
dialogsBegin.ru: Черт! Проклятый мэр! Он не хочет даже выслушать меня!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Argh! ¡Maldito sea el alcalde! ¡Ni siquiera me escucha!
dialogsBegin.sw: Argh! Curse that darn mayor! He won't even listen to me!
dialogsBegin.th: ฮึ่ย! ฉันขอสาปแช่งเจ้านายกนิสัยไม่ดีนั่น! เขาไม่คิดจะฟังฉัน!
dialogsBegin.tw: 哇啊！！這個臭市長！我為了找這些多麼的辛苦啊…太過分了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Argh! Nguyền rủa tên thị trưởng khốn kiếp! Ông ấy thậm chí sẽ không nghe tôi!

dialogsBegin.en: What's the matter, you ask? I brought him the evidence you obtained for me. I was told it was too long ago and that nobody cares about the case anymore.
dialogsBegin.ar: What's the matter, you ask? I brought him the evidence you obtained for me. I was told it was too long ago and that nobody cares about the case anymore.
dialogsBegin.br: Qual é o problema, você pergunta? Bem, eu levei a ele as informações que recebi de você. Só que ela me disse que o caso aconteceu há muito tempo e ninguém se preocupa mais com isso.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我拿这些证据去找他，他既然对我说，已经不处理这些案子了，叫我回去啊!怎么可以这样啦。
dialogsBegin.de: Nun, ich erklärte ihm dass ich die Beweise gebracht habe. Dann sagte er mir dass sich niemand mehr für den Fall interessieren würde, da er zu weit zurück liegt.
dialogsBegin.fi: What's the matter, you ask? I brought him the evidence you obtained for me. I was told it was too long ago and that nobody cares about the case anymore.
dialogsBegin.fil: What's the matter, you ask? I brought him the evidence you obtained for me. I was told it was too long ago and that nobody cares about the case anymore.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je lui ai ramené toutes les preuves. Mais elle m'a dit qu'il y avait prescription et que plus personne ne se souciait de cette affaire.
dialogsBegin.id: Ada apa, kamu bertanya? Saya membawakan dia bukti yang kamu peroleh untuk saya. Saya diberitahu itu sudah terlalu lama dan tidak ada yang peduli tentang kasus ini lagi.
dialogsBegin.it: What's the matter, you ask? I brought him the evidence you obtained for me. I was told it was too long ago and that nobody cares about the case anymore.
dialogsBegin.jp: 聞いてくれ、まったくふざけた話だ！さっき、長い間俺が調査してまとめた資料を市長のもとへ持って行ったのさ。すると、その事件はすでに捜査を終了しているので、おひきとりください、だとよ！
dialogsBegin.kr: 무슨 일이냐고요? 당신이 모아주신 증거를 가지고 시장님께 갔는데, 이제는 오래된 일인데 누가 신경을 쓰느냐고 그러더군요.
dialogsBegin.nl: What's the matter, you ask? I brought him the evidence you obtained for me. I was told it was too long ago and that nobody cares about the case anymore.
dialogsBegin.pl: What's the matter, you ask? I brought him the evidence you obtained for me. I was told it was too long ago and that nobody cares about the case anymore.
dialogsBegin.ru: Что случилось, говоришь? Я принес ему рапорт о наших находках, а он заявил, что прошло слишком много лет, и это уже никому не интересно.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Qué pasa, preguntas? Le traje la prueba que obtuviste para mí. Me dijeron que fue hace mucho tiempo y que ya nadie se preocupa por el caso.
dialogsBegin.sw: What's the matter, you ask? I brought him the evidence you obtained for me. I was told it was too long ago and that nobody cares about the case anymore.
dialogsBegin.th: จะเรื่องอะไรล่ะ? ก็ฉันนำหลักฐานที่คุณได้มาไปให้เขา แต่เขากลับบอกฉันว่ามันนานเกินไปจนไม่มีใครสนใจเรื่องนี้อีกแล้ว
dialogsBegin.tw: 我拿這些證據去找他，他既然對我說，已經不處理這些案子了，叫我回去啊！怎麼可以這樣啦。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn hỏi có chuyện gì vậy? Tôi đã mang anh ta bằng chứng mà bạn giao cho tôi. Tôi đã được thông báo là đã quá lâu rồi và không ai còn quan tâm đến vụ việc nữa.

dialogsBegin.en: How could he be so heartless? These are children we are talking about, here! I need to find a way to get him to look at this evidence.
dialogsBegin.ar: How could he be so heartless? These are children we are talking about, here! I need to find a way to get him to look at this evidence.
dialogsBegin.br: Como ele pode ser tão sem coração? São sobre crianças que estamos falando, aqui! Eu preciso encontrar uma maneira de fazê-lo olhar para esta evidência.
dialogsBegin.cns: 怎么可以这样对我啊!我要怎么把这些证据拿给他看呢..啊!对了。
dialogsBegin.de: Wie konnte er so herzlos sein? Wir reden hier über Kinder! Ich muss einen Weg finden, ihn dazu zu bringen, sich diese Beweise anzusehen.
dialogsBegin.fi: How could he be so heartless? These are children we are talking about, here! I need to find a way to get him to look at this evidence.
dialogsBegin.fil: How could he be so heartless? These are children we are talking about, here! I need to find a way to get him to look at this evidence.
dialogsBegin.fr: C'est tout ce qu'elle m'a dit... Mince... Comment lui montrer ces nouvelles preuves... Hmm... (réfléchissant un instant) Bien sûr ! Voilà comment faire !
dialogsBegin.id: Bagaimana dia bisa begitu tidak berperasaan? Ini adalah anak-anak yang sedang kita bicarakan, di sini! Saya perlu menemukan cara untuk membuatnya melihat bukti ini.
dialogsBegin.it: How could he be so heartless? These are children we are talking about, here! I need to find a way to get him to look at this evidence.
dialogsBegin.jp: チクショウ！この資料をどうやったら、市長に読ませることができるんだろうか・・・。そうだ！
dialogsBegin.kr: 어떻게 그렇게 무정할 수 있죠? 아이들이 불쌍하지도 않나! 어떻게든 시장님이 이 증거를 보게 해야 해요.
dialogsBegin.nl: How could he be so heartless? These are children we are talking about, here! I need to find a way to get him to look at this evidence.
dialogsBegin.pl: How could he be so heartless? These are children we are talking about, here! I need to find a way to get him to look at this evidence.
dialogsBegin.ru: Как можно быть таким бессердечным? Это же дети! Надо как-то заставить его прочитать рапорт.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Cómo puede ser tan despiadado? ¡Estamos hablando de niñas! Necesito encontrar una manera de hacer que mire esta prueba.
dialogsBegin.sw: How could he be so heartless? These are children we are talking about, here! I need to find a way to get him to look at this evidence.
dialogsBegin.th: ทำไมเขาถึงใจดำแบบนี้? เรากำลังพูดถึงเด็กอยู่นะ! ฉันต้องหาวิธีที่จะทำให้เขาดูหลักฐานชิ้นนี้ให้ได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 他怎麼可以這麼沒心沒肺？這些是我們正在談論的孩子，在這裡！我需要想辦法讓他查看這些證據。
dialogsBegin.vi: Sao anh có thể nhẫn tâm như vậy? Đây là những đứa trẻ mà chúng ta đang nói đến, ở đây! Tôi cần tìm cách bắt anh ta xem bằng chứng này.

dialogsBegin.en: Would you mind helping me once more?
dialogsBegin.ar: Would you mind helping me once more?
dialogsBegin.br: Ei, você por acaso me ajudaria mais uma vez?
dialogsBegin.cns: 喂!帮我一下好吗?
dialogsBegin.de: Hey, würdest du mir ein weiteres Mal helfen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Would you mind helping me once more?
dialogsBegin.fil: Would you mind helping me once more?
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu pourrais m'aider à nouveau s'il te plaît ?
dialogsBegin.id: Maukah kamu membantu saya sekali lagi?
dialogsBegin.it: Would you mind helping me once more?
dialogsBegin.jp: もう一度だけ俺に協力してくれないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 저를 한 번 더 도와주실 수 있을까요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Would you mind helping me once more?
dialogsBegin.pl: Would you mind helping me once more?
dialogsBegin.ru: Ты поможешь мне еще раз?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Te importaría ayudarme una vez más?
dialogsBegin.sw: Would you mind helping me once more?
dialogsBegin.th: คุณช่วยฉันช่วยฉันอีกครั้งได้ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 喂！幫我一下好嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có thể giúp tôi một lần nữa được không?

dialogsAccept.en: If you bring him the evidence instead of me, maybe he will take a look at it. I've bugged him enough about this over the years, but maybe a fresh face will do the trick!
dialogsAccept.ar: If you bring him the evidence instead of me, maybe he will take a look at it. I've bugged him enough about this over the years, but maybe a fresh face will do the trick!
dialogsAccept.br: Se você levar as provas para ele em vez de mim, talvez ele dê uma olhada. Eu o incomodei o suficiente sobre isso ao longo dos anos, mas talvez uma cara nova resolva o problema!
dialogsAccept.cns: 好了，你帮我把这个拿去给他看好吗?他经常到外面巡逻，所以可能不在位子上，就等到他回去之后，再给他看吧!
dialogsAccept.de: Gut, bitte bringe dem Bürgermeister diese Daten. Vielleicht solltest du warten bis er von der Tour durch die Stadt zurückkehrt.
dialogsAccept.fi: If you bring him the evidence instead of me, maybe he will take a look at it. I've bugged him enough about this over the years, but maybe a fresh face will do the trick!
dialogsAccept.fil: If you bring him the evidence instead of me, maybe he will take a look at it. I've bugged him enough about this over the years, but maybe a fresh face will do the trick!
dialogsAccept.fr: Bien, j'aimerais simplement que tu apportes ces informations au maire à ma place. Tu devrais sans doute attendre qu'il ait fini son tour de la ville.
dialogsAccept.id: Jika Anda memberinya bukti, selain saya, mungkin dia akan melihatnya. Saya sudah cukup mengganggunya tentang ini selama bertahun-tahun, tetapi mungkin wajah yang segar akan berhasil!
dialogsAccept.it: If you bring him the evidence instead of me, maybe he will take a look at it. I've bugged him enough about this over the years, but maybe a fresh face will do the trick!
dialogsAccept.jp: よし、俺の代わりにこの資料を持って、市長に会いに行ってくれ。市長は街の視察で席を外していることが多いから、もし居なかったらしばらくそこで待つのがいいだろう。
dialogsAccept.kr: 혹시 당신이 가져가면, 시장님도 다시 들여다보지 않을까요? 저는 오랫동안 시장님을 귀찮게 했으니, 새로운 사람이 나타나면 더 효과가 있을지도 몰라요!
dialogsAccept.nl: If you bring him the evidence instead of me, maybe he will take a look at it. I've bugged him enough about this over the years, but maybe a fresh face will do the trick!
dialogsAccept.pl: If you bring him the evidence instead of me, maybe he will take a look at it. I've bugged him enough about this over the years, but maybe a fresh face will do the trick!
dialogsAccept.ru: На меня у него уже условный рефлекс выработался. А вот если рапорт принесешь ты, он, возможно, от него так легко не отмахнется!
dialogsAccept.sp: Si le llevas las pruebas a él en lugar de a mí, tal vez las mire. Lo he molestado demasiado con esto a lo largo de los años, ¡pero tal vez una cara nueva sea suficiente!
dialogsAccept.sw: If you bring him the evidence instead of me, maybe he will take a look at it. I've bugged him enough about this over the years, but maybe a fresh face will do the trick!
dialogsAccept.th: ถ้าคุณเป็นคนเอาหลักฐานไปให้เขาดูแทนฉัน บางทีเขาอาจจะลองดูก็ได้นะ ฉันโดนบ่นเรื่องนี้มาตลอดหลายปีที่ผ่านมาแล้ว แต่บางทีพวกหน้าใหม่ก็อาจจะมีเคล็ดลับ!
dialogsAccept.tw: 好了，你幫我把這個拿去給他看好嗎？他經常到外面巡邏，所以可能不在位子上，就等到他回去之後，再給他看吧！
dialogsAccept.vi: Nếu bạn mang chứng cứ cho ông ta thay vì tôi, có lẽ ông ta sẽ xem xét nó. Tôi đã nghe trộm ông ấy về điều này trong những năm qua, nhưng có lẽ một khuôn mặt tươi tắn sẽ làm được điều đó!

dialogsDecline.en: But… please, think of the children.
dialogsDecline.ar: But… please, think of the children.
dialogsDecline.br: Por favor, pense nas pobres crianças desaparecidas.
dialogsDecline.de: .....(starrt mich wütend an)
dialogsDecline.fi: But… please, think of the children.
dialogsDecline.fil: But… please, think of the children.
dialogsDecline.fr: .....(te regardant avec fureur)
dialogsDecline.id: Tapi… tolong, pikirkan tentang anak-anak.
dialogsDecline.it: But… please, think of the children.
dialogsDecline.jp: そうか、用がないならどっかに行ってくれ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 하지만… 제발, 아이들을 생각해 주세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: But… please, think of the children.
dialogsDecline.pl: But… please, think of the children.
dialogsDecline.ru: Прошу тебя, подумай о детях.
dialogsDecline.sp: Pero… por favor, piensa en las niñas.
dialogsDecline.sw: But… please, think of the children.
dialogsDecline.th: แต่... ได้โปรดคิดถึงเด็กๆ ด้วยนะ
dialogsDecline.tw: …(瞪著我)
dialogsDecline.vi: Nhưng… làm ơn, hãy nghĩ đến những đứa trẻ.

dialogsComplete.en: Oh for Madrigal's sake! Porgo never gives up! Okay, please bring this to him and tell him never to bring this case up to me again!
dialogsComplete.ar: Oh for Madrigal's sake! Porgo never gives up! Okay, please bring this to him and tell him never to bring this case up to me again!
dialogsComplete.br: Ah, pelo amor da Deusa! Porgo nunca desiste! Ok, por favor, leve isso para ele e diga a ele para nunca mais trazer este caso para mim novamente!
dialogsComplete.cns: 嗯..柏洛格这个人真麻烦啊，把这个拿去给他吧!然后叫他不要再为这种事情烦我了。
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm.. Porgo gab nie auf.. Nun, dann bitte bring dies zu ihm und sag ihm dass er nie wieder zu mir kommen soll, wenn es um diesen Fall geht. Nie wieder!
dialogsComplete.fi: Oh for Madrigal's sake! Porgo never gives up! Okay, please bring this to him and tell him never to bring this case up to me again!
dialogsComplete.fil: Oh for Madrigal's sake! Porgo never gives up! Okay, please bring this to him and tell him never to bring this case up to me again!
dialogsComplete.fr: Hmm... Porgo est têtu... Bon, apporte-lui cela et dis-lui de ne jamais revenir me voir pour cette affaire. Jamais.
dialogsComplete.id: Demi Madrigal! Porgo tidak pernah menyerah! Oke, tolong bawakan ini padanya dan katakan padanya untuk tidak pernah membawa kasus ini padaku lagi!
dialogsComplete.it: Oh for Madrigal's sake! Porgo never gives up! Okay, please bring this to him and tell him never to bring this case up to me again!
dialogsComplete.jp: ポルゴって人はしつこいですね。仕方ない…では、これをポルゴに渡してください。渡すときに、もうこれ以上この件で私を訪ねてこないように、とお伝えください。では、わたしは忙しいので。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이런, 맙소사! 포르고는 포기를 모르네요! 좋아요, 이걸 포르고에게 가져다주시고, 다시는 이 사건으로 저를 찾지 말라고 전해 주세요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Oh for Madrigal's sake! Porgo never gives up! Okay, please bring this to him and tell him never to bring this case up to me again!
dialogsComplete.pl: Oh for Madrigal's sake! Porgo never gives up! Okay, please bring this to him and tell him never to bring this case up to me again!
dialogsComplete.ru: Да что ж такое-то! Этот Тинкертон от меня когда-нибудь отстанет?! Ладно, передай ему папку с материалами дела, пусть он успокоится!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Oh, por el amor de Madrigal! ¡Porgo nunca se rinde! ¡Vale, por favor, llévale esto y dile que no me vuelva a hablar de este caso nunca más!
dialogsComplete.sw: Oh for Madrigal's sake! Porgo never gives up! Okay, please bring this to him and tell him never to bring this case up to me again!
dialogsComplete.th: โอ้ พระเจ้าแห่ง Madrigal! Porgo ไม่คิดจะยอมแพ้! ได้โปรดนำสิ่งนี้ไปให้เขา และบอกเขาว่าอย่านำคดีนี้มาให้ฉันอีก!
dialogsComplete.tw: 嗯…柏洛格這個人真麻煩啊，把這個拿去給他吧！然後叫他不要再為這種事情煩我了。
dialogsComplete.vi: Ôi vì lợi ích của Madrigal! Porgo không bao giờ bỏ cuộc! Được rồi, hãy đem chuyện này cho ông ấy và nói với ông ấy rằng đừng bao giờ kể lại vụ này với tôi nữa!

dialogsFail.en: I tour the city everyday in order to listen the opinions of the citizens. Have a wonderful adventure in our fair city!
dialogsFail.ar: I tour the city everyday in order to listen the opinions of the citizens. Have a wonderful adventure in our fair city!
dialogsFail.br: Viajo pela cidade todos os dias para ouvir as opiniões dos cidadãos. Tenha uma excelente aventura na nossa agradável cidade!
dialogsFail.cns: 哈哈哈，我为了聆听市民的心声，所以都会这样巡逻~祝你一路顺风喔~
dialogsFail.de: Ich gehe jeden Tag durch die Stadt, um mir die Meinung der Bürger anzuhören. Ein schönes Abenteuer wünsche ich dir noch!
dialogsFail.fi: I tour the city everyday in order to listen the opinions of the citizens. Have a wonderful adventure in our fair city!
dialogsFail.fil: I tour the city everyday in order to listen the opinions of the citizens. Have a wonderful adventure in our fair city!
dialogsFail.fr: Ha ha ha! Je fais le tour de la ville tous les jours pour écouter les doléances des citoyens. J'ai de grandes responsabilités.
dialogsFail.id: Saya berkeliling kota setiap hari untuk mendengarkan pendapat warga. Memiliki petualangan yang indah di kota kami yang adil!
dialogsFail.it: I tour the city everyday in order to listen the opinions of the citizens. Have a wonderful adventure in our fair city!
dialogsFail.jp: わたしは市長になってからも、いつも市民の身近な声を聞こうと、一日3回は町を視察しているのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 저는 매일 시내를 정찰하며 시민의 의견을 듣고 있어요. 세인트 시티에서 멋진 모험을 즐기시길 바랄게요!
dialogsFail.nl: I tour the city everyday in order to listen the opinions of the citizens. Have a wonderful adventure in our fair city!
dialogsFail.pl: I tour the city everyday in order to listen the opinions of the citizens. Have a wonderful adventure in our fair city!
dialogsFail.ru: Я каждый день встречаюсь с жителями города и выслушиваю их жалобы и предложения. Надеюсь, тебе у нас понравится!
dialogsFail.sp: Recorro la ciudad todos los días para escuchar las opiniones de los ciudadanos. ¡Qué tengas una maravillosa aventura en nuestra bella ciudad!
dialogsFail.sw: I tour the city everyday in order to listen the opinions of the citizens. Have a wonderful adventure in our fair city!
dialogsFail.th: ฉันตรวจตาเมืองทุกวันเพื่อฟังความคิดเห็นของประชาชน ขอให้สนุกกับการผจญภัยในเมืองที่แสนงดงามของเรานะ!
dialogsFail.tw: 哈哈哈，我爲了聆聽市民的心聲，所以都會這樣巡邏~祝你一路順風喔~
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi đi tham quan thành phố hàng ngày để lắng nghe ý kiến ​​của người dân. Có một cuộc phiêu lưu tuyệt vời trong thành phố công bằng của chúng tôi!

name.th: บททดสอบความแข็งแกร่ง

description.en: Weaken the armies of the Cyclops X and defeat their lieutenant to obtain one of their life gems and bring it to me.
description.ar: Weaken the armies of the Cyclops X and defeat their lieutenant to obtain one of their life gems and bring it to me.
description.br: Enfraqueça os exércitos dos Ciclopes X e derrote seu comandante para obter uma de suas Gemas de Vida e trazê-la para mim.
description.cns: 削弱独眼巨人的军队力量并击败他们的中尉，以获得他们的一颗生命宝石并将其带给我。
description.de: Schwäche die Armeen von Cyclops X und besiege den Leutnant um einen deren Lebenssteine zu bekommen und bringe diesen zu mir.
description.fi: Weaken the armies of the Cyclops X and defeat their lieutenant to obtain one of their life gems and bring it to me.
description.fil: Weaken the armies of the Cyclops X and defeat their lieutenant to obtain one of their life gems and bring it to me.
description.fr: Affaiblis les armées de Cyclopes X et vaincs leur lieutenant pour obtenir une de leur gemmes de vie. Puis ramène-la moi.
description.id: Lemahkan pasukan Cyclops X dan kalahkan letnan mereka untuk mendapatkan salah satu permata kehidupan mereka dan membawanya kepadaku.
description.it: Weaken the armies of the Cyclops X and defeat their lieutenant to obtain one of their life gems and bring it to me.
description.jp: サイクロプス Xを弱体化させ、ジャイアントを倒しライフジェムを1つ手に入れ、私のところに持ってきてください。
description.kr: 사이클롭스 X 부대를 약화시키고, 그들의 부관을 처치해 획득한 사이클롭스 X 라이프 젬을 제게 가져다주세요.
description.nl: Weaken the armies of the Cyclops X and defeat their lieutenant to obtain one of their life gems and bring it to me.
description.pl: Weaken the armies of the Cyclops X and defeat their lieutenant to obtain one of their life gems and bring it to me.
description.ru: Weaken the armies of the Cyclops X and defeat their lieutenant to obtain one of their life gems and bring it to me.
description.sp: Debilita los ejércitos de Cyclops X y derrota a su lugarteniente para obtener una de sus gemas de Vida y tráemela.
description.sw: Weaken the armies of the Cyclops X and defeat their lieutenant to obtain one of their life gems and bring it to me.
description.th: ทำให้กองทัพของCyclops X อ่อนแอลงและปราบ lieutenantเพื่อรับอัญมณีแห่งชีวิตและนำมาให้ฉัน
description.tw: 削弱鐳射眼 X 的軍隊並擊敗他們的中尉，以獲得他們的一顆生命寶石並將其帶給我。
description.vi: Làm suy yếu quân đội của Cyclops X và đánh bại trung úy của họ để lấy một trong những viên ngọc quý và mang nó cho tôi.
