dialogsBegin.en: Airon sent you? And I see you have all three pieces of the key. Then there is no time to waste.
dialogsBegin.ar: Airon sent you? And I see you have all three pieces of the key. Then there is no time to waste.
dialogsBegin.br: Airon mandou você? Já entendi, vejo que você tem todas as três partes da chave. Então não há tempo a perder.
dialogsBegin.cns: 艾隆派你来的？我看到你拥有三把钥匙。那么就没必要浪费时间了。
dialogsBegin.de: Airon sendet dich? Oh, du hast alle 3 Stücke vom Schlüssel. Dann dürfen wir keine Zeit verlieren.
dialogsBegin.fi: Airon sent you? And I see you have all three pieces of the key. Then there is no time to waste.
dialogsBegin.fil: Airon sent you? And I see you have all three pieces of the key. Then there is no time to waste.
dialogsBegin.fr: Airon t'a envoyé ? Et je vois que tu as les trois morceaux de clé. Dans ce cas, il n'y a pas de temps à perdre.
dialogsBegin.id: Airon mengirimmu? Aku lihat kamu memiliki ketiga bagian kunci. Tidak ada waktu untuk disia-siakan.
dialogsBegin.it: Airon sent you? And I see you have all three pieces of the key. Then there is no time to waste.
dialogsBegin.jp: アリオンがお前をここまで？おいおい、鍵の欠片3つの部分をすべて持っているな。無駄にするような時間は今はなさそうだな。
dialogsBegin.kr: 에어론이 보낸 분인가요? 열쇠 세 조각을 전부 가지고 계시군요. 그렇다면 시간 낭비 말고 서두르죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: Airon sent you? And I see you have all three pieces of the key. Then there is no time to waste.
dialogsBegin.pl: Airon sent you? And I see you have all three pieces of the key. Then there is no time to waste.
dialogsBegin.ru: Airon sent you? And I see you have all three pieces of the key. Then there is no time to waste.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Te envió Airon? Y veo que tienes las tres piezas de la llave. Entonces no hay tiempo que perder.
dialogsBegin.sw: Airon sent you? And I see you have all three pieces of the key. Then there is no time to waste.
dialogsBegin.th: Aironส่งคุณมา? และฉันเห็นคุณมีกุญแจทั้งสามชิ้น แล้วไม่มีเวลาให้เสีย
dialogsBegin.tw: 艾倫派你來的？我看到你擁有所有三把鑰匙。那麼就沒有時間可以浪費了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Airon đã gửi bạn đến sao? Và tôi thấy bạn có tất cả ba mảnh chìa khóa. Vậy thì không lãng phí thời gian nữa.

dialogsBegin.en: I can reforge the key for you, but I require a lot of life source to do so.
dialogsBegin.ar: I can reforge the key for you, but I require a lot of life source to do so.
dialogsBegin.br: Posso reforjar a chave para você, mas preciso de muita fonte de vida para fazer isso.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我可以为你重铸钥匙，但我需要大量的生命本源。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich kann den Schlüssel für dich wiederherstellen, aber ich brauche viel Lebensenergie dafür.
dialogsBegin.fi: I can reforge the key for you, but I require a lot of life source to do so.
dialogsBegin.fil: I can reforge the key for you, but I require a lot of life source to do so.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je peux reconstituer la clé, mais j'ai besoin pour cela d'essence de vie.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku dapat reforge kunci untuk kamu, tetapi aku membutuhkan banyak sumber kehidupan untuk melakukannya.
dialogsBegin.it: I can reforge the key for you, but I require a lot of life source to do so.
dialogsBegin.jp: 鍵をつなぎ合わせることはできだろうが、多くの生命エネルギーが必要になる。
dialogsBegin.kr: 열쇠를 다시 제련할 수 있지만, 그러려면 상당한 생명력이 필요해요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I can reforge the key for you, but I require a lot of life source to do so.
dialogsBegin.pl: I can reforge the key for you, but I require a lot of life source to do so.
dialogsBegin.ru: I can reforge the key for you, but I require a lot of life source to do so.
dialogsBegin.sp: Puedo volver a forjar la llave para ti, pero necesito mucha Esencia de Vida para hacerlo.
dialogsBegin.sw: I can reforge the key for you, but I require a lot of life source to do so.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันสามารถหลอมกุญแจให้กับคุณได้ แต่ฉันต้องการแหล่งชีวิตมากมายในการทำเช่นนั้น
dialogsBegin.tw: 我可以為你重鑄鑰匙，但我需要大量的生命本源。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi có thể rèn lại chìa khóa cho bạn, nhưng tôi cần rất nhiều nguồn sống để làm như vậy.

dialogsBegin.en: Ever since the Red Meteonyker has been wreaking havoc in his chamber, the armies of Shade have swarmed this place. Cyclops X are everywhere, and the entrance is now kept by undead guardians.
dialogsBegin.ar: Ever since the Red Meteonyker has been wreaking havoc in his chamber, the armies of Shade have swarmed this place. Cyclops X are everywhere, and the entrance is now kept by undead guardians.
dialogsBegin.br: Desde que o Meteonyker Vermelho começou a causar estragos em sua câmara, os exércitos de Shade começaram a invadir este lugar. Os Ciclopes X estão por toda parte, e a entrada agora é mantida por guardiões mortos-vivos.
dialogsBegin.cns: Ever since the Red Meteonyker has been wreaking havoc in his chamber, the armies of Shade have swarmed this place. Cyclops X are everywhere, and the entrance is now kept by undead guardians.
dialogsBegin.de: Seit Red Meteonyker in seinem Bau ein Chaos angerichtet wimmelt es an diesem Ort von Armeen von Shade. Cyclops X sind überall und der Eingang wird nun von untoten Beschützern beschützt.
dialogsBegin.fi: Ever since the Red Meteonyker has been wreaking havoc in his chamber, the armies of Shade have swarmed this place. Cyclops X are everywhere, and the entrance is now kept by undead guardians.
dialogsBegin.fil: Ever since the Red Meteonyker has been wreaking havoc in his chamber, the armies of Shade have swarmed this place. Cyclops X are everywhere, and the entrance is now kept by undead guardians.
dialogsBegin.fr: Depuis que le Meteonyker Rouge sème le chaos dans son repaire, les armées de Shade ont envahi ce lieu. Les Cyclopes X sont partout, et l'entrée est gardée par des gardiens mort-vivants ramenés à la vie.
dialogsBegin.id: Sejak Red Meteonyker membuat kekacauan di kamarnya, pasukan Shade telah mengerumuni tempat ini. Cyclops X ada di mana-mana, dan pintu masuknya sekarang dijaga oleh penjaga mayat hidup.
dialogsBegin.it: Ever since the Red Meteonyker has been wreaking havoc in his chamber, the armies of Shade have swarmed this place. Cyclops X are everywhere, and the entrance is now kept by undead guardians.
dialogsBegin.jp: レッドメテオニカが彼の部屋を破壊して以来、シェイドの軍隊がこの場所に群がっている。サイクロプスXはいたるところにいるし、入り口はアンデッド ガーディアンによって守られています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 빨강 메테오니커가 혼란을 불러일으킨 후, 쉐이드의 군대가 이곳에 몰려들었어요. 사이클롭스 X가 사방에 널려 있고, 입구는 언데드 가디언들이 지키고 있죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: Ever since the Red Meteonyker has been wreaking havoc in his chamber, the armies of Shade have swarmed this place. Cyclops X are everywhere, and the entrance is now kept by undead guardians.
dialogsBegin.pl: Ever since the Red Meteonyker has been wreaking havoc in his chamber, the armies of Shade have swarmed this place. Cyclops X are everywhere, and the entrance is now kept by undead guardians.
dialogsBegin.ru: Ever since the Red Meteonyker has been wreaking havoc in his chamber, the armies of Shade have swarmed this place. Cyclops X are everywhere, and the entrance is now kept by undead guardians.
dialogsBegin.sp: Desde que el Meteonyker Rojo alborotó su cámara, los ejércitos de Shade han invadido este lugar. Los Cyclops X están por todas partes, y la entrada está a cargo de guardianes muertos vivientes.
dialogsBegin.sw: Ever since the Red Meteonyker has been wreaking havoc in his chamber, the armies of Shade have swarmed this place. Cyclops X are everywhere, and the entrance is now kept by undead guardians.
dialogsBegin.th: นับตั้งแต่ Red Meteonyker สร้างความหายนะให้กับห้องของเขา กองทัพของ Shade ก็ได้รุมล้อมสถานที่แห่งนี้ Cyclops X มีอยู่ทุกหนทุกแห่ง และตอนนี้ทางเข้าได้รับการปกป้องโดยundead guardians
dialogsBegin.tw: 自從炙焰飛龍在他的房間裡肆虐以來，闇影的軍隊就蜂擁到了這個地方。鐳射眼 X 無處不在，入口現在由複活的不死守護者守衛。
dialogsBegin.vi: Kể từ khi Red Meteonyker tàn phá căn phòng của hắn, quân đội của Shade đã tràn đến nơi này. Cyclops X ở khắp mọi nơi, và lối vào giờ đã được canh giữ bởi những guardians đã hồi sinh.

dialogsBegin.en: Thank you! You found my son and also helped my daughter. Now I can momentarily feel relieved. Let me treat you to a home cooked meal! Hold on...
dialogsBegin.ar: Thank you! You found my son and also helped my daughter. Now I can momentarily feel relieved. Let me treat you to a home cooked meal! Hold on...
dialogsBegin.br: Obrigada! Você encontrou meu filho e também ajudou minha filha. Agora posso sentir um alívio momentâneo. Deixe-me te agradecer com uma refeição caseira! Espera aí..
dialogsBegin.cns: Thank you! You found my son and also helped my daughter. Now I can momentarily feel relieved. Let me treat you to a home cooked meal! Hold on...
dialogsBegin.de: Ich danke dir! Du hast meinen Sohn gefunden und auch meiner Tochter geholfen. Jetzt kann ich für einen Moment erleichtert sein. Lass mich dich zu einem hausgemachten Essen einladen! Warte mal...
dialogsBegin.fi: Thank you! You found my son and also helped my daughter. Now I can momentarily feel relieved. Let me treat you to a home cooked meal! Hold on...
dialogsBegin.fil: Thank you! You found my son and also helped my daughter. Now I can momentarily feel relieved. Let me treat you to a home cooked meal! Hold on...
dialogsBegin.fr: Pardon, j'étais tellement inquiète pour Nerco… vous ne faites que nous rendre service depuis le début.
dialogsBegin.id: Terima kasih banyak! Kamu membantu menemukan anak laki-lakiku dan juga membantu anak perempuanku. Aku bisa sedikit tengan sekarang. Biarkan aku mentraktirmu dengan masakanku! Tunggu sebentar..
dialogsBegin.it: Thank you! You found my son and also helped my daughter. Now I can momentarily feel relieved. Let me treat you to a home cooked meal! Hold on...
dialogsBegin.jp: バカ息子だけじゃなく娘のお願いまで聞いて頂けたようで本当にありがとうございます。そうだ。よかったら何か御馳走させて頂きたいのですが、ちょっと待って下さいね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 고마워요! 아들도 찾아주시고, 딸도 도와주시다니. 이제야 잠시나마 안심이 되네요. 제가 집밥을 대접할게요! 잠시만요...
dialogsBegin.nl: Thank you! You found my son and also helped my daughter. Now I can momentarily feel relieved. Let me treat you to a home cooked meal! Hold on...
dialogsBegin.pl: Thank you! You found my son and also helped my daughter. Now I can momentarily feel relieved. Let me treat you to a home cooked meal! Hold on...
dialogsBegin.ru: Thank you! You found my son and also helped my daughter. Now I can momentarily feel relieved. Let me treat you to a home cooked meal! Hold on...
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Gracias! Has encontrado a mi hijo y también has ayudado a mi hija. Puedo estar tranquila durante un rato. ¡Deja que te invite a una comida casera! Espera...
dialogsBegin.sw: Thank you! You found my son and also helped my daughter. Now I can momentarily feel relieved. Let me treat you to a home cooked meal! Hold on...
dialogsBegin.th: ขอบคุณ! คุณพบลูกชายของฉันและช่วยลูกสาวของฉันด้วย ตอนนี้ฉันรู้สึกโล่งใจได้ได้เปลาะนึง ให้ฉันเลี้ยงข้าวคุณซักมื้อที่บ้าน! รอเดี๋ยวนะ..
dialogsBegin.tw: 謝謝你！你不但找到我兒子，還幫了我女兒。這下我總算能稍微放心一下了。來吧，讓我請你吃頓家常菜！等等喔……
dialogsBegin.vi: Cảm ơn! Bạn đã tìm thấy con trai tôi và cũng đã giúp đỡ con gái tôi. Bây giờ tôi có thể cảm thấy nhẹ nhõm trong giây lát rồi. Để tôi đãi bạn một bữa cơm nhà nấu nhé! Chờ tôi một chút..

dialogsBegin.en: Ah!!! All of my kitchen knives got rusty. I just wanted to treat you a good meal to show my appreciation... Now, I can't even feed my children!
dialogsBegin.ar: Ah!!! All of my kitchen knives got rusty. I just wanted to treat you a good meal to show my appreciation... Now, I can't even feed my children!
dialogsBegin.br: Ah!!! Todas as minhas facas de cozinha enferrujaram. Eu só queria te dar uma boa refeição para mostrar o minha gratidão... Agora, eu não posso nem cozinhar para meus filhos!
dialogsBegin.cns: 啊！！！我所有的菜刀都生锈了。我还想通过给你做一份大餐来表示我的感谢呢...现在，我甚至都不能为我的孩子们准备饭菜了！
dialogsBegin.de: Ah!!! Meine Küchenmesser sind alle rostig geworden. Ich wollte dir nur mit einem guten Essen meine Wertschätzung zeigen... Jetzt kann ich nicht einmal meine Kinder ernähren!
dialogsBegin.fi: Ah!!! All of my kitchen knives got rusty. I just wanted to treat you a good meal to show my appreciation... Now, I can't even feed my children!
dialogsBegin.fil: Ah!!! All of my kitchen knives got rusty. I just wanted to treat you a good meal to show my appreciation... Now, I can't even feed my children!
dialogsBegin.fr: Je voulais vous faire un bon petit plat pour vous remercier mais mon couteau ne coupe plus assez pour la viande.
dialogsBegin.id: Ah!!! Semua pisau dapurku karatan. Aku ingin mentraktirmu makanan yang enak untuk menunjukkan rasa terimakasihku... Tapi sekarang, aku bahkan tidak bisa memberi makan anak-anakku!
dialogsBegin.it: Ah!!! All of my kitchen knives got rusty. I just wanted to treat you a good meal to show my appreciation... Now, I can't even feed my children!
dialogsBegin.jp: あら……どうしましょう。料理でも振舞おうと思ったのですが、包丁が……このままだとせっかくの料理が作れないわ……
dialogsBegin.kr: 이를 어째!!! 부엌칼이 전부 녹슬어 있네요. 감사의 의미로 따뜻한 집밥 한 끼 대접하려 했는데... 이제 우리 애들 밥도 못하게 생겼어요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Ah!!! All of my kitchen knives got rusty. I just wanted to treat you a good meal to show my appreciation... Now, I can't even feed my children!
dialogsBegin.pl: Ah!!! All of my kitchen knives got rusty. I just wanted to treat you a good meal to show my appreciation... Now, I can't even feed my children!
dialogsBegin.ru: Ааа!!! Все мои кухонные ножи заржавели! Я только хотела отрезать тебе кусочек... И детей покормить..
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡¡¡Ay!!! Todos mis cuchillos de cocina se oxidado. Solo quería invitarte a una buena comida para mostrarte mi gratitud... ¡Ahora ni siquiera puedo alimentar a mis hijos!
dialogsBegin.sw: Ah!!! All of my kitchen knives got rusty. I just wanted to treat you a good meal to show my appreciation... Now, I can't even feed my children!
dialogsBegin.th: อา!!! มีดทำครัวทั้งหมดของฉันขึ้นสนิม ฉันแค่อยากจะเลี้ยงอาหารดีๆ สักมื้อเพื่อแสดงความขอบคุณ... ตอนนี้ ฉันยังให้อาหารลูกๆ ไม่ได้ด้วยซ้ำ!
dialogsBegin.tw: 啊！！！我所有的廚刀都生鏽了。我只是想請你吃一頓以表達我的感激之情……現在，我連孩子們也都吃不了飯了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Ah!!! Tất cả những con dao làm bếp của tôi đều bị gỉ. Tôi đã muốn đãi bạn một bữa ăn ngon để thể hiện sự cảm kích của tôi ... Bây giờ, tôi thậm chí không thể nấu cho con tôi ăn!

dialogsBegin.en: You've helped our family so much already, but can I ask you for a favor also?
dialogsBegin.ar: You've helped our family so much already, but can I ask you for a favor also?
dialogsBegin.br: Você já ajudou tanto nossa família, mas posso pedir um pequeno favor também?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你已经为我的家庭做了那么多，我能不能再请你帮一个忙？
dialogsBegin.de: Sie haben unserer Familie schon so viel geholfen, aber kann ich Sie auch um einen Gefallen bitten?
dialogsBegin.fi: You've helped our family so much already, but can I ask you for a favor also?
dialogsBegin.fil: You've helped our family so much already, but can I ask you for a favor also?
dialogsBegin.fr: Les couteaux traditionnels de Saincity sont fait avec les pattes des Mantis qui vivent non loin du village Pumpkin.
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu telah banyak membantu keluargaku, tapi bolehkah aku meminta tolong lagi?
dialogsBegin.it: You've helped our family so much already, but can I ask you for a favor also?
dialogsBegin.jp: 君はすでに私の家族のお願いを色々と聞いて頂きました、、でも、また、、お願いしても良いですか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 우리 가족을 벌써 많이 도와주셨지만… 한 가지만 더 부탁해도 될까요?
dialogsBegin.nl: You've helped our family so much already, but can I ask you for a favor also?
dialogsBegin.pl: You've helped our family so much already, but can I ask you for a favor also?
dialogsBegin.ru: Ты уже столько нам помог, но можно ещё раз попросить об одолжении?
dialogsBegin.sp: Ya has ayudado mucho a nuestra familia, pero ¿puedo pedirte otro favor?
dialogsBegin.sw: You've helped our family so much already, but can I ask you for a favor also?
dialogsBegin.th: คุณช่วยครอบครัวของเรามามากแล้ว แต่ฉันขอความกรุณาจากคุณด้วยได้ไหม
dialogsBegin.tw: 你已經幫了我們家這麼多，但我還可請你幫忙嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn đã giúp đỡ gia đình chúng tôi rất nhiều rồi, nhưng tôi có thể nhờ bạn giúp nữa được không?

dialogsBegin.en: If I had some Sharp Edge pieces, I could make a knife and once again be a fit mother! Would you please gather some for me?
dialogsBegin.ar: If I had some Sharp Edge pieces, I could make a knife and once again be a fit mother! Would you please gather some for me?
dialogsBegin.br: Se eu tivesse algumas peças de Gume Afiado, eu poderia fazer uma faca e mais uma vez ser uma mãe em forma! Você poderia, por favor, reunir alguns para mim?
dialogsBegin.cns: 如果我有一些利刃碎片，我就可以做一把刀，并且能继续做一位合格的母亲了！你愿意帮我收集它们吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Wenn ich ein paar Sharp Edge Teile hätte, könnte ich ein Messer machen und wieder eine fitte Mutter sein! Würden Sie bitte einige für mich sammeln?
dialogsBegin.fi: If I had some Sharp Edge pieces, I could make a knife and once again be a fit mother! Would you please gather some for me?
dialogsBegin.fil: If I had some Sharp Edge pieces, I could make a knife and once again be a fit mother! Would you please gather some for me?
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous seriez un amour si vous me rapportiez des tranchants de Mantis pour fabriquer des nouveaux couteaux.
dialogsBegin.id: Jika aku memiliki Sharp Edge, aku dapat membuat pisau dan sekali lagi menjadi ibu yang baik! Maukah kau mengumpulkan beberapa untukku?
dialogsBegin.it: If I had some Sharp Edge pieces, I could make a knife and once again be a fit mother! Would you please gather some for me?
dialogsBegin.jp: レッドマンティスを倒して刃をとってきて頂けませんか？そうすれば、ナイフを作って、料理もできます！ 集めてくれませんか？！
dialogsBegin.kr: 날카로운 날 조각만 있으면 칼을 만들 수 있어요. 그럼 좋은 엄마로 남을 수 있겠죠! 날카로운 다리 조각 좀 구해다 주시겠어요?
dialogsBegin.nl: If I had some Sharp Edge pieces, I could make a knife and once again be a fit mother! Would you please gather some for me?
dialogsBegin.pl: If I had some Sharp Edge pieces, I could make a knife and once again be a fit mother! Would you please gather some for me?
dialogsBegin.ru: Если мы у меня было несколько острых осколков, я мигом бы со всем разобралась! Соберёшь их для меня?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Si tuviera algunas Garras Afiladas, podría hacer un cuchillo y volver a ser una madre cocinera! ¿Podrías conseguir unas cuantas para mí?
dialogsBegin.sw: If I had some Sharp Edge pieces, I could make a knife and once again be a fit mother! Would you please gather some for me?
dialogsBegin.th: ถ้าฉันมีชิ้นส่วน Sharp Edge ฉันสามารถทำมีดและเป็นแม่ที่ฟิตได้อีกครั้ง! คุณช่วยรวบรวมบางอย่างให้ฉันได้ไหม
dialogsBegin.tw: 如果我有一些銳利的刀刃碎片，我可以做一把刀，再次成為一個好母親！你能幫我收集一些嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Nếu tôi có một số mảnh Sharp Edge, tôi có thể làm một con dao và một lần nữa trở thành một người mẹ phù hợp! Bạn có thể vui lòng thu thập một số cho tôi?

dialogsAccept.en: You are really too kind! You can collect Sharp Edge pieces by killing some Red Mantis… and pulling off their legs. Yes, yes, so it sounds a little vicious. It's ok, you will get over it! Haha!
dialogsAccept.ar: You are really too kind! You can collect Sharp Edge pieces by killing some Red Mantis… and pulling off their legs. Yes, yes, so it sounds a little vicious. It's ok, you will get over it! Haha!
dialogsAccept.br: Você é realmente muito gentil! Você pode coletar peças de Gume Afiado matando alguns Louva-deus… e arrancando suas pernas. Sim, sim, soa um pouco cruel, eu sei. Mas tudo bem, você vai superar! Haha!
dialogsAccept.cns: 你真的是太善良了！你可以通过杀死一些蟹足螳螂...然后拔掉他们的腿来收集利刃碎片。对的，对的，拔掉他们的腿。这听着是不是太残忍了？没事的，你会克服这种想法的！哈哈！
dialogsAccept.de: Du bist wirklich zu nett! Du kannst Sharp Edge sammeln, indem du eine Red Mantis ... und ihr die Beine abreißt. Ja, ja, das klingt ein bisschen bösartig. Ist schon okay, du kommst schon drüber weg! Haha!
dialogsAccept.fi: You are really too kind! You can collect Sharp Edge pieces by killing some Red Mantis… and pulling off their legs. Yes, yes, so it sounds a little vicious. It's ok, you will get over it! Haha!
dialogsAccept.fil: You are really too kind! You can collect Sharp Edge pieces by killing some Red Mantis… and pulling off their legs. Yes, yes, so it sounds a little vicious. It's ok, you will get over it! Haha!
dialogsAccept.fr: Vous êtes vraiment adorable !
dialogsAccept.id: Kamu sangat baik sekali! Kamu dapat mengumpulkan Sharp Edge dengan mengalahkan Red Mantis... dan memotong kakinya. Mungkin terdengar menyeramkan, tapi tak apa, kamu akan terbiasa! Haha!
dialogsAccept.it: You are really too kind! You can collect Sharp Edge pieces by killing some Red Mantis… and pulling off their legs. Yes, yes, so it sounds a little vicious. It's ok, you will get over it! Haha!
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとうございます！　やはり噂通り親切なお方ですね。レッドマンティスはこの大陸の南の外れに生息していますよ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 정말 너무 감사해요! 레드맨티스를 처치해서 다리를 뽑아내면, 날카로운 날 조각을 얻을 수 있어요… 네, 좀 잔인하게 들릴 수도 있지만... 금방 익숙해지실 거예요! 하하!
dialogsAccept.nl: You are really too kind! You can collect Sharp Edge pieces by killing some Red Mantis… and pulling off their legs. Yes, yes, so it sounds a little vicious. It's ok, you will get over it! Haha!
dialogsAccept.pl: You are really too kind! You can collect Sharp Edge pieces by killing some Red Mantis… and pulling off their legs. Yes, yes, so it sounds a little vicious. It's ok, you will get over it! Haha!
dialogsAccept.ru: Ты такой покладистый! Ты сможешь раздобыть их, убивая красных богомолов... Наверное они вкусные... Ой, что это я! Хаха!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Eres demasiado amable! Puedes conseguir las Garras Afiladas matando a algunas Red Mantis... y arrancándoles las piernas. Sí, sí, se suena un poco mal. Pero ¡lo superarás! ¡Jaja!
dialogsAccept.sw: You are really too kind! You can collect Sharp Edge pieces by killing some Red Mantis… and pulling off their legs. Yes, yes, so it sounds a little vicious. It's ok, you will get over it! Haha!
dialogsAccept.th: คุณใจดีเกินไปจริงๆ! คุณสามารถรวบรวมชิ้นส่วน Sharp Edge ได้โดยการฆ่าตั๊กแตนตำข้าวแดง… และดึงขาของพวกมันออก ใช่ใช่ ดังนั้นมันฟังดูเลวร้ายเล็กน้อย ไม่เป็นไร คุณจะผ่านมันไปได้! ฮาฮา!
dialogsAccept.tw: 你真的太好心了！擊敗赤螳螂並扯下牠們的腿，就能收集銳利刀刃碎片。是、是，聽起來有點殘忍。沒關係，你很快就會習慣的！哈哈！
dialogsAccept.vi: Bạn thực sự quá tốt bụng! Bạn có thể thu thập các mảnh Sharp Edge bằng cách giết một số Red Mantis… và nhổ chân của chúng. Vâng, vâng, vì vậy nó nghe có vẻ hơi luẩn quẩn. Không sao đâu, bạn sẽ vượt qua được thôi! Haha!

dialogsDecline.en: Oh dear! Now my children shall surely starve! Children's services will take them away and I will be all alone…
dialogsDecline.ar: Oh dear! Now my children shall surely starve! Children's services will take them away and I will be all alone…
dialogsDecline.br: Oh céus! Agora meus filhos certamente morrerão de fome! Os serviços infantis os levarão embora e eu ficarei sozinha...
dialogsDecline.cns: 噢，亲爱的！现在我的孩子真的要挨饿了！儿童保护机构会将他们从我身边带走，然后只留下我一个人的...
dialogsDecline.de: Oh je! Jetzt werden meine Kinder sicher verhungern! Das Kinderhilfswerk wird sie mir wegnehmen und ich werde ganz allein sein...
dialogsDecline.fi: Oh dear! Now my children shall surely starve! Children's services will take them away and I will be all alone…
dialogsDecline.fil: Oh dear! Now my children shall surely starve! Children's services will take them away and I will be all alone…
dialogsDecline.fr: Mais je ne peux pas vous servir de la viande crue !
dialogsDecline.id: Ya ampun! Sekarang anak-anakku pasti akan kelaparan! Children Services akan membawa mereka pergi dan aku akan sendirian…
dialogsDecline.it: Oh dear! Now my children shall surely starve! Children's services will take them away and I will be all alone…
dialogsDecline.jp: そんな！私の子供たちはお腹を空かせます！ お願いを聞いて頂けないでしょうか。
dialogsDecline.kr: 세상에! 우리 애들이 굶게 생겼잖아요! 혹시라도 보호소에서 데려가 버리면 저 혼자 남는다고요…
dialogsDecline.nl: Oh dear! Now my children shall surely starve! Children's services will take them away and I will be all alone…
dialogsDecline.pl: Oh dear! Now my children shall surely starve! Children's services will take them away and I will be all alone…
dialogsDecline.ru: Oh dear! Now my children shall surely starve! Children's services will take them away and I will be all alone…
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Oh querido! ¡Mis hijos morirán de hambre! Los servicios sociales se llevarán a los niños y me quedaré sola…
dialogsDecline.sw: Oh dear! Now my children shall surely starve! Children's services will take them away and I will be all alone…
dialogsDecline.th: โอ้ที่รัก! ตอนนี้ลูก ๆ ของฉันจะต้องอดตายอย่างแน่นอน! บริการของเด็กๆ จะพาพวกเขาไป และฉันจะอยู่คนเดียว…
dialogsDecline.tw: 哦天啊！現在我的孩子們一定會餓死的！兒童社福會將他們帶走，我將獨自一人……
dialogsDecline.vi: Ôi chao! Bây giờ các con tôi chắc chắn sẽ chết đói! Các dịch vụ dành cho trẻ em sẽ mang chúng đi và tôi sẽ đơn độc…

dialogsComplete.en: How very kind of you! Hope this task wasn't too much of a burden for you. Rest a little now!
dialogsComplete.ar: How very kind of you! Hope this task wasn't too much of a burden for you. Rest a little now!
dialogsComplete.br: Como você é gentil! Espero que esta tarefa não tenha sido um fardo demais para você. Descanse um pouco agora!
dialogsComplete.cns: 你真的太善良了！希望这个任务对你来说不会是太大的负担。请你先休息一下吧！
dialogsComplete.de: Das ist sehr nett von Ihnen! Ich hoffe, diese Aufgabe war keine zu große Belastung für Sie. Ruhen Sie sich jetzt ein wenig aus!
dialogsComplete.fi: How very kind of you! Hope this task wasn't too much of a burden for you. Rest a little now!
dialogsComplete.fil: How very kind of you! Hope this task wasn't too much of a burden for you. Rest a little now!
dialogsComplete.fr: *Inspecte les tranchants* Parfaits, vous avez l'œil !
dialogsComplete.id: Betapa baik hati dirimu! Semoga tugas ini tidak terlalu membebanimu. Istirahatlah sedikit sekarang!
dialogsComplete.it: How very kind of you! Hope this task wasn't too much of a burden for you. Rest a little now!
dialogsComplete.jp: ありがとうございます！やっぱり助けてくださった！さすがは英雄と呼ばれた方ですね！
dialogsComplete.kr: 정말 친절하시네요! 혹시 너무 무리하신 건 아닌지… 조금 쉬고 가세요!
dialogsComplete.nl: How very kind of you! Hope this task wasn't too much of a burden for you. Rest a little now!
dialogsComplete.pl: How very kind of you! Hope this task wasn't too much of a burden for you. Rest a little now!
dialogsComplete.ru: Как любезно с твоей стороны! Надеюсь, ты не сильно устал. Посиди, отдохни!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Qué amable eres! Espero que esta tarea no haya sido una carga demasiado grande para ti. ¡Ya puedes descansar un poco!
dialogsComplete.sw: How very kind of you! Hope this task wasn't too much of a burden for you. Rest a little now!
dialogsComplete.th: คุณใจดีจัง! หวังว่างานนี้จะไม่เป็นภาระของคุณมากเกินไป พักผ่อนเถอะตอนนี้!
dialogsComplete.tw: 你真是太好心了！希望這項任務對你來說不是太大的負擔。現在休息一下！
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn thật sự rất tốt! Hy vọng nhiệm vụ này không quá nặng nề đối với bạn. Hãy nghỉ ngơi một chút!

dialogsFail.en: Unfortunately, you won't be able to pull the legs off all the Red Mantis. Some of them are attached too tightly. Just keep killing them and you will eventually succeed!
dialogsFail.ar: Unfortunately, you won't be able to pull the legs off all the Red Mantis. Some of them are attached too tightly. Just keep killing them and you will eventually succeed!
dialogsFail.br: Infelizmente, você não conseguirá puxar as pernas de todo Louva-deus Vermelho. Alguns deles estão presos com muita força. Continue os caçando e você terá sucesso!
dialogsFail.cns: 不幸的是，你没办法把所有蟹足螳螂的腿都拔下来。因为有些蟹足螳螂的腿和身体连接得非常的紧。就一直猎杀它们直到你的收集足够多的利刃碎片吧！
dialogsFail.de: Leider können Sie nicht allen Red Mantis die Beine abziehen. Einige von ihnen sind zu fest angewachsen. Töte sie einfach weiter und du wirst schließlich Erfolg haben!
dialogsFail.fi: Unfortunately, you won't be able to pull the legs off all the Red Mantis. Some of them are attached too tightly. Just keep killing them and you will eventually succeed!
dialogsFail.fil: Unfortunately, you won't be able to pull the legs off all the Red Mantis. Some of them are attached too tightly. Just keep killing them and you will eventually succeed!
dialogsFail.fr: Allez vite chasser les Mantis, c'est presque l'heure du dîner !
dialogsFail.id: Sayangnya, Kamu tidak akan bisa melepaskan semua kaki Red Mantis. Beberapa dari mereka melekat terlalu erat. Terus bunuh mereka sampai kamu berhasil!
dialogsFail.it: Unfortunately, you won't be able to pull the legs off all the Red Mantis. Some of them are attached too tightly. Just keep killing them and you will eventually succeed!
dialogsFail.jp: 全てのレッドマンティスの刃が鋭いわけではないので、何匹か倒して見比べてみて下さいね。
dialogsFail.kr: 모든 레드맨티스에게서 날카로운 날이 나오는 건 아니에요. 어떤 다리는 너무 단단하게 붙어 있어서요. 계속 잡다 보면 다 모을 수 있을 거예요!
dialogsFail.nl: Unfortunately, you won't be able to pull the legs off all the Red Mantis. Some of them are attached too tightly. Just keep killing them and you will eventually succeed!
dialogsFail.pl: Unfortunately, you won't be able to pull the legs off all the Red Mantis. Some of them are attached too tightly. Just keep killing them and you will eventually succeed!
dialogsFail.ru: Unfortunately, you won't be able to pull the legs off all the Red Mantis. Some of them are attached too tightly. Just keep killing them and you will eventually succeed!
dialogsFail.sp: Desafortunadamente, no podrás quitarle las piernas a todas las Red Mantis. Algunas están demasiado apretadas. ¡Sigue matándolas y eventualmente lo conseguirás!
dialogsFail.sw: Unfortunately, you won't be able to pull the legs off all the Red Mantis. Some of them are attached too tightly. Just keep killing them and you will eventually succeed!
dialogsFail.th: น่าเสียดายที่คุณไม่สามารถดึงขาของ Red Mantis ทั้งหมดออกได้ บางส่วนติดแน่นเกินไป แค่ฆ่าพวกมันไปเรื่อยๆ แล้วคุณจะสำเร็จในที่สุด!
dialogsFail.tw: 不幸的是，你不能把所有赤螳螂的腿都拉下來，其中一些連接得太緊。只要繼續殺死他們，你終究會成功的！
dialogsFail.vi: Thật không may, bạn sẽ không thể kéo chân khỏi tất cả Bọ ngựa đỏ. Một trong số chúng được gắn quá chặt chẽ. Chỉ cần tiếp tục giết chúng cuối cùng bạn sẽ thành công!

dialogsBegin.en: I've heard that the warrior in question is supposedly a powerful Billposter…
dialogsBegin.ar: I've heard that the warrior in question is supposedly a powerful Billposter…
dialogsBegin.br: Ouvi dizer que o guerreira em questão é supostamente uma poderosa Billposter…
dialogsBegin.cns: 我听说这位勇士是一位强大的暴力技师。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich habe gehört, dass der betreffende Krieger angeblich ein mächtiger Billposter ist...
dialogsBegin.fi: I've heard that the warrior in question is supposedly a powerful Billposter…
dialogsBegin.fil: I've heard that the warrior in question is supposedly a powerful Billposter…
dialogsBegin.fr: Il y a dans la région un Héros moine qui s'entraine… je ne peux pas vous dire où elle est en ce moment mais…
dialogsBegin.id: Saya pernah mendengar bahwa prajurit yang dimaksud seharusnya adalah Billposter yang kuat ...
dialogsBegin.it: I've heard that the warrior in question is supposedly a powerful Billposter…
dialogsBegin.jp: さて、英雄の話でしたね。この地で修行しているビルポスターの方がそのような話をしていたと思います。
dialogsBegin.kr: 전해 듣기로, 그 전사는 강력한 빌포스터라고 하던데요…
dialogsBegin.nl: I've heard that the warrior in question is supposedly a powerful Billposter…
dialogsBegin.pl: I've heard that the warrior in question is supposedly a powerful Billposter…
dialogsBegin.ru: I've heard that the warrior in question is supposedly a powerful Billposter…
dialogsBegin.sp: He oído que la guerrera en cuestión es una poderosa Billposter...
dialogsBegin.sw: I've heard that the warrior in question is supposedly a powerful Billposter…
dialogsBegin.th: ถ้าคุณต้องการทราบว่าเขาอยู่ที่ไหน ไปหา Genie ฉันไม่รู้อะไรเพราะฉันเป็นชาวพื้นเมืองที่นี่
dialogsBegin.tw: 聽你說在這地方修練的人好像是爆咒師英雄的轉生。我想他應該就在某一個地方修練，但是我不知道正確的位置。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi nghe nói rằng chiến binh được đề cập là Billposter hùng dũng…

dialogsBegin.en: If you are looking for further information on them then please go to my friend Jinitte. He has traveled the continent of Darkon extensively and knows much of its happenings.
dialogsBegin.ar: If you are looking for further information on them then please go to my friend Jinitte. He has traveled the continent of Darkon extensively and knows much of its happenings.
dialogsBegin.br: Se você está procurando mais informações sobre ela, por favor, vá encontrar o meu amigo Jinitte. Ele viajou extensivamente pelo continente de Darkon e conhece muitos de seus acontecimentos.
dialogsBegin.cns: 如果你在进一步寻找他们的信息，请去找我的朋友杰奴塔。他已经走遍了达肯大陆，对发生了什么事情很了解。
dialogsBegin.de: Wenn du weitere Informationen über sie suchst, wende dich bitte an meinen Freund Jinitte. Er hat den Kontinent Darkon ausgiebig bereist und weiß viel über seine Geschehnisse.
dialogsBegin.fi: If you are looking for further information on them then please go to my friend Jinitte. He has traveled the continent of Darkon extensively and knows much of its happenings.
dialogsBegin.fil: If you are looking for further information on them then please go to my friend Jinitte. He has traveled the continent of Darkon extensively and knows much of its happenings.
dialogsBegin.fr: Jinitte qui habite dans cette zone pourra vous donner cette information.
dialogsBegin.id: Jika Anda mencari informasi lebih lanjut tentang mereka maka silakan pergi ke teman saya Jinitte. Dia telah melakukan perjalanan ke benua Darkon secara ekstensif dan mengetahui banyak kejadiannya.
dialogsBegin.it: If you are looking for further information on them then please go to my friend Jinitte. He has traveled the continent of Darkon extensively and knows much of its happenings.
dialogsBegin.jp: ただ、ごめんなさい。私も今どこにいるかまではわからないのです。ジニートなら詳しいことがわかるかもしれません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 정보를 더 원하신다면 제 친구 지니뜨를 찾아가 보세요. 다콘 대륙을 두루 여행했고, 이곳 사정에도 아주 밝거든요.
dialogsBegin.nl: If you are looking for further information on them then please go to my friend Jinitte. He has traveled the continent of Darkon extensively and knows much of its happenings.
dialogsBegin.pl: If you are looking for further information on them then please go to my friend Jinitte. He has traveled the continent of Darkon extensively and knows much of its happenings.
dialogsBegin.ru: If you are looking for further information on them then please go to my friend Jinitte. He has traveled the continent of Darkon extensively and knows much of its happenings.
dialogsBegin.sp: Si estás buscando más información sobre ella, busca a mi amigo Jinitte. Ha viajado por todo el continente de Darkon y sabe mucho de todo lo que pasa en él.
dialogsBegin.sw: If you are looking for further information on them then please go to my friend Jinitte. He has traveled the continent of Darkon extensively and knows much of its happenings.
dialogsBegin.th: หากคุณกำลังมองหาข้อมูลเกี่ยวกับพวกเขาโปรดไปที่ Jinitte เขาเป็นเพื่อนของฉัน เขาเดินทางไปทั่วทวีป Darkon และรู้ถึงเหตุการณ์ที่เกิดขึ้นมากมาย
dialogsBegin.tw: 如果你想知道他在哪裡，你可以去找傑奴塔。他是在這地方土生土長的人，所以沒有不知道的事情。
dialogsBegin.vi: Nếu bạn đang tìm kiếm thêm thông tin về chúng thì hãy đến gặp người bạn Jinitte của tôi. Anh ta đã đi khắp lục địa Darkon và biết nhiều diễn biến về nó.

dialogsAccept.en: Jinitte might just know where this hero is hiding out.
dialogsAccept.ar: Jinitte might just know where this hero is hiding out.
dialogsAccept.br: Jinitte pode saber onde essa guerreira está se escondendo.
dialogsAccept.cns: 杰奴塔可能知道这位英雄的藏身之处。
dialogsAccept.de: Vielleicht weiß Jinitte ja, wo sich der Held versteckt hält.
dialogsAccept.fi: Jinitte might just know where this hero is hiding out.
dialogsAccept.fil: Jinitte might just know where this hero is hiding out.
dialogsAccept.fr: Allez donc trouver Jinitte si vous voulez rencontrer un héros.
dialogsAccept.id: Jinitte mungkin hanya tahu di mana pahlawan ini bersembunyi.
dialogsAccept.it: Jinitte might just know where this hero is hiding out.
dialogsAccept.jp: ジニートはこの大陸の中央にいると思います。キャンプをしているのですぐにわかるはずです。
dialogsAccept.kr: 지니뜨라면 영웅이 어디에 숨어 있는지 알고 있을지도 몰라요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Jinitte might just know where this hero is hiding out.
dialogsAccept.pl: Jinitte might just know where this hero is hiding out.
dialogsAccept.ru: Jinitte might just know where this hero is hiding out.
dialogsAccept.sp: Jinitte podría saber dónde se esconde la héroe.
dialogsAccept.sw: Jinitte might just know where this hero is hiding out.
dialogsAccept.th: Jinitte ก็อาจรู้ว่าฮีโร่คนนี้ซ่อนตัวอยู่ที่ไหน
dialogsAccept.tw: 他一定知道最後一個英雄在哪。快一點過去找傑奴塔吧。
dialogsAccept.vi: Jinitte có thể biết các anh hùng này đang ấn náu ở đâu.

dialogsDecline.en: Rather hang around and help me garden? Haha I'm joking! I know you probably have much more important work to attend to!
dialogsDecline.ar: Rather hang around and help me garden? Haha I'm joking! I know you probably have much more important work to attend to!
dialogsDecline.br: Em vez de ficar parado por aí, que tal ajudar no jardim? Haha brincadeirinha! Eu sei que você provavelmente tem um trabalho muito mais importante para fazer!
dialogsDecline.cns: 宁愿在附近闲逛，帮我种花？哈哈，开个玩笑！我知道你可能有更重要的工作要做!
dialogsDecline.de: Willst du lieber hier bleiben und mir im Garten helfen? Haha, das war ein Scherz! Ich weiß, dass du wahrscheinlich viel wichtigere Aufgaben zu erledigen hast!
dialogsDecline.fi: Rather hang around and help me garden? Haha I'm joking! I know you probably have much more important work to attend to!
dialogsDecline.fil: Rather hang around and help me garden? Haha I'm joking! I know you probably have much more important work to attend to!
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous préférez ne pas rechercher le Héros après tout ?
dialogsDecline.id: Alih-alih berkeliaran dan membantu saya berkebun? Haha aku bercanda! Saya tahu Anda mungkin memiliki pekerjaan yang jauh lebih penting untuk diperhatikan
dialogsDecline.it: Rather hang around and help me garden? Haha I'm joking! I know you probably have much more important work to attend to!
dialogsDecline.jp: そうですか……残念ですね。
dialogsDecline.kr: 여기 머물면서 정원 손질이나 도와줄래요? 하하, 농담이에요! 분명 더 중요한 일이 있으시겠죠!
dialogsDecline.nl: Rather hang around and help me garden? Haha I'm joking! I know you probably have much more important work to attend to!
dialogsDecline.pl: Rather hang around and help me garden? Haha I'm joking! I know you probably have much more important work to attend to!
dialogsDecline.ru: Rather hang around and help me garden? Haha I'm joking! I know you probably have much more important work to attend to!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Prefieres quedarte y ayudarme con el jardín? ¡Jajaja es broma! ¡Sé que tienes algo más importante de lo que ocuparte!
dialogsDecline.sw: Rather hang around and help me garden? Haha I'm joking! I know you probably have much more important work to attend to!
dialogsDecline.th: คุณต้องการลิ้มรสอาหารที่ดีที่สุดเพียงครั้งเดียวหรือไม่?
dialogsDecline.tw: 寧願閒逛幫我種菜？哈哈我開玩笑的！我知道你可能有更重要的工作要處理！
dialogsDecline.vi: Thay vì đi loanh quanh thì vào giúp tôi làm vườn đi? Haha tôi đang nói đùa đấy! Tôi biết bạn có thể có nhiều việc quan trọng hơn phải tham gia!

dialogsComplete.en: Greetings Sir! You lookin to try my world famous cuisine!
dialogsComplete.ar: Greetings Sir! You lookin to try my world famous cuisine!
dialogsComplete.br: Saudações jovem! Você está querendo experimentar minha cozinha mundialmente famosa?!
dialogsComplete.cns: 向您问候! 你想尝尝我做的美味佳肴吗？
dialogsComplete.de: Seid gegrüßt, Herr! Willst du meine weltberühmte Küche probieren?
dialogsComplete.fi: Greetings Sir! You lookin to try my world famous cuisine!
dialogsComplete.fil: Greetings Sir! You lookin to try my world famous cuisine!
dialogsComplete.fr: Sentez-moi ça. Je suis certain que ça vous donne faim !
dialogsComplete.id: Salam Pak! Anda melihat untuk mencoba masakan terkenal dunia saya!

name.jp: 英雄の後継者-ヘルメット-
name.th: ผู้สืบทอดของ Hero -Helmet-
name.tw: 英雄的繼承者 - 帽子

description.en: Find Kindler and use whatever information he has to locate the Golden Helmet. Then take it, and your letter, to Hormes, the Knight Sage at the The Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
description.ar: Find Kindler and use whatever information he has to locate the Golden Helmet. Then take it, and your letter, to Hormes, the Knight Sage at the The Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
description.br: Cace Kidler, que fica perto da jaula de Clockwork em Darken e obtenha a pista. Então encontre o Elmo Dourado e visite Hormes, o sábio Knight, na Fonte das Pessoas Mortas em Flaris.
description.cns: 从齐德勒那找到黄金帽的下落后，请你去帕里的亡者之潭找[骑士贤者]霍鲁美斯·凯德。
description.de: Jage Kidster, der in der Nähe der Clockwork Arena in Darkon ist und besorge mir Hinweise. Dann finde den Golden Helmet und besuche Hormes, den Knight Weisen an der Quelle der verstorbenen Seelen in Flaris.
description.fi: Find Kindler and use whatever information he has to locate the Golden Helmet. Then take it, and your letter, to Hormes, the Knight Sage at the The Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
description.fil: Find Kindler and use whatever information he has to locate the Golden Helmet. Then take it, and your letter, to Hormes, the Knight Sage at the The Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
description.fr: Chercher Kidler près de la Cage de Clockworks au sud de Darkon, et retrouver le Heaume de Billein. Puis le rapporter au Sage des Chevaliers Hormes, à la Fontaine des Défunts de Flaris.
description.id: Temukan Kindler dan gunakan informasi apa pun yang dia miliki untuk menemukan Helm Emas. Kemudian ambil, dan suratmu, untuk Hormes, Knight Sage di The Fountain of Dead Person di Flaris.
description.it: Find Kindler and use whatever information he has to locate the Golden Helmet. Then take it, and your letter, to Hormes, the Knight Sage at the The Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
description.jp: ダーコンのクロックワークス檻の近くで盗掘師モモガンを狩って、黄金のヘルメットを取り戻し、フラリスの魂の泉にいるナイト賢者ホロメスに持っていってください。
description.kr: 킨들러를 찾고, 그에게서 얻어낸 정보로 황금 헬멧의 위치를 알아내세요. 헬멧과 추천서를 플라리스 망자의 샘에 있는 나이트 현자 호르메스에게 전달하세요.
description.nl: Find Kindler and use whatever information he has to locate the Golden Helmet. Then take it, and your letter, to Hormes, the Knight Sage at the The Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
description.pl: Find Kindler and use whatever information he has to locate the Golden Helmet. Then take it, and your letter, to Hormes, the Knight Sage at the The Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
description.ru: Нужно найти Шиндлера и отыскать Золотой шлем, а затем отнести его вместе с рекомендательным письмом старейшине гладиаторов Гермесу. Гермеса можно найти у фонтана Мертвеца во Фларинции.
description.sp: Encuentra a Kindler y usa la información que tenga para localizar el Casco Dorado. Luego llévalo, junto con tu carta, a Hormes, el Sabio Knight en el Manantial de Almas en Flaris.
description.sw: Find Kindler and use whatever information he has to locate the Golden Helmet. Then take it, and your letter, to Hormes, the Knight Sage at the The Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
description.th: ค้นหา Kindler แล้วเค้นข้อมูลเพื่อค้นหา Golden Helmet จากนั้นนำหมวกและจดหมายไปให้ Knight Sage ที่ชื่อ Hormes ที่อาศัยอยู่ใน The Fountain of Dead Person ในเมือง Flaris
description.tw: 從齊德勒那找到黃金帽的下落後，請你去布拉里斯的亡者之泉找騎士賢者 [霍魯美斯‧凱德]。
description.vi: Tìm Kindler và sử dụng bất kỳ thông tin nào anh ta có để xác định vị trí của Golden Helmet. Sau đó, hãy mang nó và lá thư của bạn cho Hormes, Knight Sage tại The Fountain of Dead Person ở Flaris.

dialogsBegin.en: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements thus far. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.ar: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements thus far. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.br: Esta é a carta de recomendação que mostra que o mestre o reconhece como um sucessor. Por favor, guarde-a com sua vida. Se você perdê-la, não poderá provar que é reconhecido.
dialogsBegin.cns: 这推荐书表示首领认定你具有继承者的能力，没有推荐书认定形同无效，所以要好好保管喔！
dialogsBegin.de: Dieses Empfehlungsschreiben beweist, das dich der Meister als Nachfolger akzeptiert hat. Bitte beschütze es mit deinem Leben. Wenn du ihn verlierst, kannst du nicht beweisen, dass du anerkannt wurdest.
dialogsBegin.fi: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements thus far. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.fil: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements thus far. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.fr: Félicitations, voici une lettre de recommandation confirmant que tu es sur la voie de devenir Chevalier.
dialogsBegin.id: Surat rekomendasi ini adalah bukti pencapaianmu selama ini. Jaga itu seperti kamu menjaga hidupmu sendiri.
dialogsBegin.it: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements thus far. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.jp: これはマスターが後継者としての資質を認めたという推薦書です。あなたの資質が認められるものですから大事にしてください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 추천서는 지금까지 당신이 거둔 성과를 증명하는 증명서랍니다. 목숨처럼 소중히 간직하세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements thus far. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.pl: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements thus far. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.ru: Это рекомендательное письмо - доказательство того, что тебе удалось пройти мое испытание. Береги его как зеницу ока.
dialogsBegin.sp: Esta carta de recomendación es prueba de tus progresos. Guárdala como si fuera tu propia vida.
dialogsBegin.sw: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements thus far. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.th: จดหมายแนะนำนี้เป็นข้อพิสูจน์ถึงความสำเร็จของคุณจวบจนถึงบัดนี้ ปกป้องมันให้เหมือนกับการรักษาชีวิตของคุณเอง
dialogsBegin.tw: 這推薦書表示首領認定你具有繼承者的能力，沒有推薦書認定形同無效，所以要好好保管喔！
dialogsBegin.vi: Thư giới thiệu này là bằng chứng về thành tích của bạn cho đến nay. Hãy bảo vệ nó như chính cuộc sống của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Take it to Hormes, the Knight Sage. He resides at the The Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.ar: Take it to Hormes, the Knight Sage. He resides at the The Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.br: Por favor, entregue a carta de recomendação para Hormes, que é o sábio Knight. Ele fica na Fonte das Pessoas Mortas, ao norte, nas Montanhas Leren.
dialogsBegin.cns: 请把那推荐书拿给位于乐雅山脉北部亡者之泉的[骑士贤者]霍鲁美斯·凯德。
dialogsBegin.de: Bitte bringe das Empfehlungsschreiben zu Hormes, dem Knight Weisen. Er steht an der Quelle der verstorbenen Seelen im Norden der Leren Gebirges.
dialogsBegin.fi: Take it to Hormes, the Knight Sage. He resides at the The Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.fil: Take it to Hormes, the Knight Sage. He resides at the The Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il faut que tu l'apportes à Hormes, le Sage des Chevaliers qui se trouve à la Fontaine des Défunts de Flaris.
dialogsBegin.id: Bawa ke Hormes, Knight Sage. Dia tinggal di The Fountain of Dead Person di Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.it: Take it to Hormes, the Knight Sage. He resides at the The Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.jp: それではフラリスのレルエン山脈北部にある魂の泉に行って、ナイト賢者ホロメスにその推薦書を渡してください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 추천서를 플라리스 레르엔 산맥 북부 망자의 샘에 있는 나이트 현자, 호르메스님께 전달하세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Take it to Hormes, the Knight Sage. He resides at the The Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.pl: Take it to Hormes, the Knight Sage. He resides at the The Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.ru: Отнеси его старейшине гладиаторов Гермесу. Его можно найти у фонтана Мертвеца на севере Леренских горок.
dialogsBegin.sp: Llévaselo a Hormes, el Sabio Knight. Está en el Manantial de Almas al Norte de las Montañas Leren.
dialogsBegin.sw: Take it to Hormes, the Knight Sage. He resides at the The Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.th: นำมันไปให้ Knight Sage ที่ชื่อ Hormes เขาอาศัยอยู่ที่ The Fountain of Dead Person ในเทือกเขา Northern Leren Mountains
dialogsBegin.tw: 請把那推薦書拿給位於勒倫山脈北部亡者之泉的騎士賢者 [霍魯美斯‧凱德]。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đưa nó đến Hormes, Knight Sage. Anh ta cư trú tại The Fountain of Dead Person ở Northern Leren Mountains.

dialogsBegin.en: Before you go, though, I want you to find Kindler, a grave-robber. He's hiding out near the Clockworks' Cage, South of Darken City.
dialogsBegin.ar: Before you go, though, I want you to find Kindler, a grave-robber. He's hiding out near the Clockworks' Cage, South of Darken City.
dialogsBegin.br: Antes de ir, quero que encontre Kindler, um ladrão de túmulos. Ele está escondido perto da Cela de Clockworks, ao sul da cidade de Darken.
dialogsBegin.cns: 不过，你得先去达肯找囚禁之地附近的齐德勒，找出英雄遗物的线索…
dialogsBegin.de: Bevor du gehst, möchte ich aber, dass du Kindler, einen Grabräuber, findest. Er versteckt sich in der Nähe des Clockworks' Cage, südlich von Darkon City.
dialogsBegin.fi: Before you go, though, I want you to find Kindler, a grave-robber. He's hiding out near the Clockworks' Cage, South of Darken City.
dialogsBegin.fil: Before you go, though, I want you to find Kindler, a grave-robber. He's hiding out near the Clockworks' Cage, South of Darken City.
dialogsBegin.fr: Cependant avant de t'adresser à Hormes, pars à la rencontre de Kidler. Il se cache près de la Cage de Clockworks, au sud de Darken.
dialogsBegin.id: Namun, sebelum kamu pergi, saya ingin kamu menemukan Kindler, perampok kuburan. Dia bersembunyi di dekat Clockworks' Cage, South of Darken City.
dialogsBegin.it: Before you go, though, I want you to find Kindler, a grave-robber. He's hiding out near the Clockworks' Cage, South of Darken City.
dialogsBegin.jp: あ、その前にダーコンの北側の＜奈落～歯車の永久牢獄＞近くにいる盗掘師モモガンを探し、彼から手掛かりを手に入れてください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 하지만 그 전에, 킨들러라는 도굴꾼을 먼저 찾아야 해요. 다켄 시티 남쪽의 클락워크 감옥 근처에 숨어 있어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Before you go, though, I want you to find Kindler, a grave-robber. He's hiding out near the Clockworks' Cage, South of Darken City.
dialogsBegin.pl: Before you go, though, I want you to find Kindler, a grave-robber. He's hiding out near the Clockworks' Cage, South of Darken City.
dialogsBegin.ru: Но сначала найди Шиндлера, разорителя захоронений. В последний раз его видели на юге от Даркенбурга, около Часовой клетки.
dialogsBegin.sp: Antes de que te vayas, quiero que encuentres a Kindler, un ladrón de tumbas. Se esconde cerca de la Jaula de Clockworks, al Sur de Darken.
dialogsBegin.sw: Before you go, though, I want you to find Kindler, a grave-robber. He's hiding out near the Clockworks' Cage, South of Darken City.
dialogsBegin.th: ก่อนที่คุณจะไป ฉันต้องการให้คุณไปหา grave-robber ที่ชื่อ Kindler เขากำลังหลบซ่อนตัวอยู่ใกล้ๆ Clockwork's Cage ที่ South of Darken City
dialogsBegin.tw: 不過，在你走之前，你得先去得肯南方、時空毀滅者囚籠附近找盜墓賊 [齊德勒]，找出英雄遺物的線索…
dialogsBegin.vi: Tuy nhiên, trước khi bạn đi, tôi muốn bạn tìm thấy Kindler, một tên cướp mộ. Anh ta đang trốn gần Clockworks 'Cage, phía Nam của Darken City.

dialogsBegin.en: I believe he has information on the Golden Helmet of Billaon. Retrieve it by any means, and take it to Hormes along with your letter.
dialogsBegin.ar: I believe he has information on the Golden Helmet of Billaon. Retrieve it by any means, and take it to Hormes along with your letter.
dialogsBegin.br: Kidler lhe dará informações a respeito do Elmo Dourado. Obtenha o elmo e entregue para Hormes.
dialogsBegin.cns: 那线索有记录"毕雷恩的黄金帽"的地点，要记得喔！
dialogsBegin.de: Kidster besitzt Informationen über den Golden Helmet. Besorg den Helm und bring ihn zu Hormes.
dialogsBegin.fi: I believe he has information on the Golden Helmet of Billaon. Retrieve it by any means, and take it to Hormes along with your letter.
dialogsBegin.fil: I believe he has information on the Golden Helmet of Billaon. Retrieve it by any means, and take it to Hormes along with your letter.
dialogsBegin.fr: Kidler te fournira des informations à propos du Heaume de Billein, le Héros des Chevaliers. Trouve ce heaume et rapporte-le à Hormes.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya percaya dia memiliki informasi tentang Helm Emas Billaon. Ambil dengan cara apapun, dan bawa ke Hormes bersama dengan suratmu.
dialogsBegin.it: I believe he has information on the Golden Helmet of Billaon. Retrieve it by any means, and take it to Hormes along with your letter.
dialogsBegin.jp: その手掛かりに書かれてあるビレリアンの黄金のヘルメットを見つけ出し、持って行ってください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 분명 빌레이언의 황금 헬멧에 대한 정보를 가지고 있을 겁니다. 어떤 수단을 써서라도 헬멧을 회수해서, 추천서와 함께 호르메스님께 전달하세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I believe he has information on the Golden Helmet of Billaon. Retrieve it by any means, and take it to Hormes along with your letter.
dialogsBegin.pl: I believe he has information on the Golden Helmet of Billaon. Retrieve it by any means, and take it to Hormes along with your letter.
dialogsBegin.ru: Говорят, у него есть информация о Золотом шлеме гладиатора Максимилиануса. Отыщи этот шлем и отнеси его Гермесу вместе с письмом. Справишься?
dialogsBegin.sp: Creo que tiene información sobre el Casco Dorado de Billaon. Recupéralo por cualquier medio y llévaselo a Hormes junto con la carta.
dialogsBegin.sw: I believe he has information on the Golden Helmet of Billaon. Retrieve it by any means, and take it to Hormes along with your letter.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันเชื่อว่าเขามีข้อมูลเกี่ยวกับ Helmet สีทองของ Billaon นำมันกลับมาไม่ว่าต้องอย่างไรก็ตาม และนำไปให้ Hormes พร้อมกับจดหมายของคุณ
dialogsBegin.tw: 那線索有記錄"畢雷恩的黃金帽"的地點，要記得喔！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi tin rằng anh ta có thông tin về Golden Helmet của Billaon. Lấy nó bằng mọi cách, và đưa nó đến Hormes cùng với lá thư của bạn.

dialogsAccept.en: May the courage of Billaon be with you always.
dialogsAccept.ar: May the courage of Billaon be with you always.
dialogsAccept.br: Desejo que a coragem de Billaon esteja sempre com você.
dialogsAccept.cns: 毕雷恩与你同在，请努力下去！
dialogsAccept.de: Ich hoffe, das der Mut von Billaon ewig mit dir sein wird.
dialogsAccept.fi: May the courage of Billaon be with you always.
dialogsAccept.fil: May the courage of Billaon be with you always.
dialogsAccept.fr: Je souhaite que le courage de Billein soit toujours avec toi.
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga keberanian Billaon selalu bersamamu.
dialogsAccept.it: May the courage of Billaon be with you always.
dialogsAccept.jp: ビレリアンの勇気が共にありますように！
dialogsAccept.kr: 빌레이언의 용기가 언제나 당신과 함께하길.
dialogsAccept.nl: May the courage of Billaon be with you always.
dialogsAccept.pl: May the courage of Billaon be with you always.
dialogsAccept.ru: Да пребудет с тобой храбрость Максимилиануса.
dialogsAccept.sp: Que el valor de Billaon te acompañe siempre.
dialogsAccept.sw: May the courage of Billaon be with you always.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้ความกล้าหาญของ Billaon อยู่กับคุณเสมอ
dialogsAccept.tw: 畢雷恩與你同在，請努力下去！
dialogsAccept.vi: Cầu mong sự dũng cảm của Billaon luôn ở bên bạn.

dialogsDecline.en: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.ar: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.br: Não se subestime. Você deve ser forte, ou não poderá se tornar um sucessor. Por que desistir agora?
dialogsDecline.cns: 你已经做到这了，为什么还要放弃呢？
dialogsDecline.de: Du bist schon so weit gekommen, warum solltest du jetzt aufgeben?
dialogsDecline.fi: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.fil: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.fr: Ne sous-estime jamais tes capacités ! Tu dois être fort, ou tu ne deviendras jamais un Héros.
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu sudah sampai sejauh ini, mengapa menyerah sekarang?
dialogsDecline.it: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.jp: 自分に勇気がないなどと思わないでください。あなたには力がある･･･。そんな簡単に諦めてはいけません。
dialogsDecline.kr: 여기까지 왔는데, 왜 그만두시려 하시죠?
dialogsDecline.nl: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.pl: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.ru: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.sp: Ya has llegado muy lejos, ¿te vas a rendir ahora?
dialogsDecline.sw: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.th: คุณมาได้ไกลแล้ว ทำไมถึงคิดจะยอมแพ้ในตอนนี้?
dialogsDecline.tw: 已經走到這一步了，為什麼要放棄呢？
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn đã đi quá xa, tại sao bây giờ lại từ bỏ?

dialogsComplete.en: My word! This… this is the Golden Helmet of Billaon! We thought it had been lost forever!
dialogsComplete.ar: My word! This… this is the Golden Helmet of Billaon! We thought it had been lost forever!
dialogsComplete.br: Hmm? Este, este é o Elmo Dourado de Billaon! Ah, como você o recuperou?! Obrigado! Este é o elmo que Billaon, o herói Knight, usou durante a Guerra do Herói.
dialogsComplete.cns: 没错！这就是"毕雷恩黄金帽"！终于找回来了！你真的很厉害！这帽子可是骑士英雄毕雷恩在英雄战争时使用过的黄金帽呢！
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm? Das, das ist der Golden Helmet of Billaon! Wie hast du ihn beschaffen können! Danke! Dieser Helm wurde von Billaon, dem Knight Hero während des Hero Wars getragen.
dialogsComplete.fi: My word! This… this is the Golden Helmet of Billaon! We thought it had been lost forever!
dialogsComplete.fil: My word! This… this is the Golden Helmet of Billaon! We thought it had been lost forever!
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh ! C'est... c'est le heaume en or que portait Billein pendant la Grande Guerre ! Où l'as-tu retrouvé ?!
dialogsComplete.id: Ucapanku! Ini ... ini adalah Helm Emas Billaon! Kami pikir itu telah hilang selamanya!
dialogsComplete.it: My word! This… this is the Golden Helmet of Billaon! We thought it had been lost forever!
dialogsComplete.jp: こ、これは幻の聖遺物、ビレリアンの黄金のヘルメット！取り戻してくれたのか！このヘルメットはナイト英雄ビレリアンが英雄戦争の時に使っていたものじゃ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 세상에나! 이게… 이게 바로 빌레이언의 황금 헬멧로군요! 완전히 잃어버린 줄로만 알았어요!
dialogsComplete.nl: My word! This… this is the Golden Helmet of Billaon! We thought it had been lost forever!
dialogsComplete.pl: My word! This… this is the Golden Helmet of Billaon! We thought it had been lost forever!
dialogsComplete.ru: Не может быть! Это и в самом деле Золотой шлем Максимилиануса! А ведь мы думали, что он утрачен навсегда!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡No puede ser! ¡Esto... esto es el Casco Dorado de Billaon! ¡Pensábamos que se había perdido para siempre!
dialogsComplete.sw: My word! This… this is the Golden Helmet of Billaon! We thought it had been lost forever!
dialogsComplete.th: แม่เจ้า! นี่คือหมวกนิรภัยสีทองของ Billaon! เราคิดว่ามันหายไปนานแล้ว!
dialogsComplete.tw: 沒錯！這就是"畢雷恩黃金帽"！終於找回來了！你真的很厲害！這帽子可是騎士英雄畢雷恩在英雄戰爭時使用過的黃金帽呢！
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi đảm bảo đây… đây là Golden Helmet của Billaon! Chúng tôi nghĩ rằng nó đã bị mất vĩnh viễn!

dialogsComplete.en: No one had seen it since that grave-robbing scoundrel Kindler stole it and hid it away. Thank you, you're truly remarkable!
dialogsComplete.ar: No one had seen it since that grave-robbing scoundrel Kindler stole it and hid it away. Thank you, you're truly remarkable!
dialogsComplete.br: Mas nós o perdemos desde que Kidler, o ladrão de túmulos, o levou e o escondeu. Ninguém havia conseguido encontrá-lo desde então... Obrigado, muito obrigado! Ha ha ha!
dialogsComplete.cns: 不过，盗墓者齐德勒把这黄金帽藏起来后，这英雄遗物还以为就这么失传了，但总算是找回来了！
dialogsComplete.de: Wir hatten ihn verloren nachdem Kidster, der Grabräuber, ihn an sich genommen hatte und versteckte. Niemand war in der Lage ihn zu finden.. Vielen Dank. Vielen vielen Dank!
dialogsComplete.fi: No one had seen it since that grave-robbing scoundrel Kindler stole it and hid it away. Thank you, you're truly remarkable!
dialogsComplete.fil: No one had seen it since that grave-robbing scoundrel Kindler stole it and hid it away. Thank you, you're truly remarkable!
dialogsComplete.fr:
Nous l'avions perdu depuis que Kidler, le pilleur de tombes, l'avait dérobé et caché. Personne n'avait réussi à le retrouver à ce jour.
Merci, merci infiniment en tout cas !
dialogsComplete.id: Tidak ada yang melihatnya sejak bajingan Kindler perampok kuburan itu mencurinya dan menyembunyikannya. Terima kasih, Kamu benar-benar luar biasa!
dialogsComplete.it: No one had seen it since that grave-robbing scoundrel Kindler stole it and hid it away. Thank you, you're truly remarkable!
dialogsComplete.jp: ヘルメットは代々霊廟に収められていたのじゃが、盗掘師モモガンが盗み出し、その後の所在が分からなくなっておったのじゃ。英雄に仕える者としてこれほどうれしいことはない。心より礼をいうぞ！
dialogsComplete.kr: 그 도굴꾼 킨들러란 놈이 훔쳐가서 숨긴 이후론 아무도 헬멧을 본 사람이 없었어요. 찾아주셔서 감사합니다. 정말 대단하시군요!
dialogsComplete.nl: No one had seen it since that grave-robbing scoundrel Kindler stole it and hid it away. Thank you, you're truly remarkable!
dialogsComplete.pl: No one had seen it since that grave-robbing scoundrel Kindler stole it and hid it away. Thank you, you're truly remarkable!
dialogsComplete.ru: Его никто не видел с тех пор, как негодяй Шиндлер украл и спрятал его. Большое спасибо, ты  - исключительный человек!
dialogsComplete.sp: Nadie lo había visto desde que ese sinvergüenza de Kindler lo robó y lo escondió. ¡Gracias, eres increíble!
dialogsComplete.sw: No one had seen it since that grave-robbing scoundrel Kindler stole it and hid it away. Thank you, you're truly remarkable!
dialogsComplete.th: ไม่มีใครได้เห็นมันมาตั้งแต่ที่ Kindler ขโมยมันและเอามันไปซ่อนไว้ ขอบคุณจริงๆ คุณเก่งมาก!
dialogsComplete.tw: 不過，盜墓者齊德勒把這黃金帽藏起來後，這英雄遺物還以為就這麼失傳了，但總算是找回來了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Không ai nhìn thấy nó từ khi tên cướp mộ vô lại Kindler đã lấy trộm và giấu nó đi. Cảm ơn bạn, bạn thực sự xuất sắc!

dialogsFail.en: You have a question? Out with it, quickly. I have no time to waste with idle chatter.
dialogsFail.ar: You have a question? Out with it, quickly. I have no time to waste with idle chatter.
dialogsFail.br: Você tem uma pergunta? Faça logo. Não tenho tempo a perder com conversa fiada.
dialogsFail.cns: 嗯？找我有什么事情吗？
dialogsFail.de: Du hast eine Frage? Raus damit, schnell. Ich habe keine Zeit für müßiges Geschwätz.
dialogsFail.fi: You have a question? Out with it, quickly. I have no time to waste with idle chatter.
dialogsFail.fil: You have a question? Out with it, quickly. I have no time to waste with idle chatter.
dialogsFail.fr: Les âmes de nombreuses personnes vont et viennent ici à la Fontaine des Défunts. C'est ici la limite entre la vie et la mort.
dialogsFail.id: Kamu punya pertanyaan? Keluar dengan itu, cepat. Saya tidak punya waktu untuk disia-siakan dengan obrolan kosong.
dialogsFail.it: You have a question? Out with it, quickly. I have no time to waste with idle chatter.
dialogsFail.jp: 何か用事か？私は忙しいので早くしてください。
dialogsFail.kr: 질문이라도 있나요? 빨리 말하세요. 잡담할 시간이 없어요.
dialogsFail.nl: You have a question? Out with it, quickly. I have no time to waste with idle chatter.
dialogsFail.pl: You have a question? Out with it, quickly. I have no time to waste with idle chatter.
dialogsFail.ru: You have a question? Out with it, quickly. I have no time to waste with idle chatter.
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Tienes alguna pregunta? Suéltalo ya, rápido. No tengo tiempo que perder con charla ociosa.
dialogsFail.sw: You have a question? Out with it, quickly. I have no time to waste with idle chatter.
dialogsFail.th: คุณมีคำถามงั้นเหรอ? งั้นก็ออกไปตามหามันเร็วๆ เลย ฉันไม่มีเวลาที่จะมาพูดไร้สาระหรอกนะ
dialogsFail.tw: 你有什麼問題？快點提出來，我沒有時間浪費在聊天上。

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsDecline.en: You have yet to pay for your sins…

dialogsDecline.cns: 你还没有为你的罪恶付出代价...

dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn vẫn chưa phải trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình…

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.br: Sua missão foi concluída. Seus pecados foram perdoados.
dialogsComplete.cns: 任务完成，你的罪恶已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Buße getan. Deine Sünden wurden dir vergeben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Questmu telah tercapai. Dosa-dosamu telah diampuni.
dialogsComplete.it: La Missione è terminata. I tuoi peccati sono stati perdonati.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 끝났습니다. 당신의 죄를 용서하지요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Боги одобрили твое деяние и простили тебе грехи.
dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น บาปของคุณได้รับการอภัยแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nhiệm vụ của bạn đã được hoàn thành. Tội lỗi của bạn đã được tha thứ.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

name.cns: 第一章 波布尔的平原 < 波布尔的平原>
name.jp: バブルの平原にまつわる謎
name.th: บทที่ 1 ทุ่งฟองสบู่
name.tw: 第一章 巴布樂平原巴布樂平原

description.en: You know the Field of Bubble, right? I think we can find some evidence there. Lets go! Hurry up!
description.ar: You know the Field of Bubble, right? I think we can find some evidence there. Lets go! Hurry up!
description.br: Você conhece a Planície de Bubble, certo? Acho que podemos encontrar evidências lá. Vamos! Depressa!
description.cns: 你知道波布尔的平原吧?我看了这些之后才想到的，你到那边的话，或许可以找到一些线索..快去吧!
description.de: Du kennst die Ebene von Bubble, oder? Ich denke wir können dort ein paar Beweise finden. Lass uns gehen! Schnell!
description.fi: You know the Field of Bubble, right? I think we can find some evidence there. Lets go! Hurry up!
description.fil: You know the Field of Bubble, right? I think we can find some evidence there. Lets go! Hurry up!
description.fr: Retrouver Hachal à la Plaine de Bubble pour poursuivre l'enquête sur l'histoire de Madrigal.
description.id: Kamu tahu Field Bubble kan? Aku rasa kita bisa menemukan beberapa bukti disana. Ayo cepat!
description.it: You know the Field of Bubble, right? I think we can find some evidence there. Lets go! Hurry up!
description.jp: ハカルを追って＜バブルの平原＞へいこう。そこでハカルが次の指示を教えてくれるはずだ。
description.kr: 버블의 장 아시죠? 거기 가면 뭔가 단서가 있을 거예요. 자아, 서둘러요!
description.nl: You know the Field of Bubble, right? I think we can find some evidence there. Lets go! Hurry up!
description.pl: You know the Field of Bubble, right? I think we can find some evidence there. Lets go! Hurry up!
description.ru: Ты знаешь дорогу к Лучистому полю? Нас там ждет удивительное открытие! Поторопись!
description.sp: ¿Conoces la Llanura de Bubble, verdad? Creo que podemos encontrar algunas pruebas por allí. ¡Vamos! ¡Date prisa!
description.sw: You know the Field of Bubble, right? I think we can find some evidence there. Lets go! Hurry up!
description.th: คุณรู้จัก Field of Bubble ใช่ไหม? ฉันคิดว่าเราสามารถหาหลักฐานได้ที่นั่น ไปกันเถอะ! รีบไป!
description.tw: 你知道巴布樂平原吧？我看了這些之後才想到的，你到那邊的話，或許可以找到一些線索…快去吧！
description.vi: Bạn biết Cánh đồng bong bóng, phải không? Tôi nghĩ chúng ta có thể tìm thấy một số bằng chứng ở đó. Đi nào! Nhanh lên!

dialogsBegin.en: Hmm? Did Gothante tell you to visit me? Why?
dialogsBegin.ar: Hmm? Did Gothante tell you to visit me? Why?
dialogsBegin.br: Hmm? Gothante disse para você me visitar? Por que?
dialogsBegin.cns: 嗯？是扎森特叫你来见我的吗？为什么？
dialogsBegin.de: Hm? Sagte dir Gothante, dass du mich aufsuchen sollst? (Du übergibst ihm die Daten und den Letter of Recommendation) Was? Was ist das?
dialogsBegin.fi: Hmm? Did Gothante tell you to visit me? Why?
dialogsBegin.fil: Hmm? Did Gothante tell you to visit me? Why?
dialogsBegin.fr: Hmm ? Gothante t'a dit de venir me voir, pourquoi ? (remettant la lettre) Que contient donc cette lettre ?
dialogsBegin.id: Hmm? Apa Gothante menuruhmu untuk menemuiku? Ada apa?
dialogsBegin.it: Hmm? Did Gothante tell you to visit me? Why?
dialogsBegin.jp: おや、見たことのない顔だが、君は誰だ？
dialogsBegin.kr: 흠? 고단테가 절 찾아가라고 보냈다고요? 왜요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Hmm? Did Gothante tell you to visit me? Why?
dialogsBegin.pl: Hmm? Did Gothante tell you to visit me? Why?
dialogsBegin.ru: Что такое? Шлесигер велел тебе поговорить со мной? О чем же?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Mmm? ¿Gothante te dijo que me visitaras? ¿Por qué?
dialogsBegin.sw: Hmm? Did Gothante tell you to visit me? Why?
dialogsBegin.th: อืม? Gothante บอกให้คุณมาเยี่ยมฉันเหรอ เพราะอะไร
dialogsBegin.tw: 嗯？高譚提拉叫你來找我的啊？他有什麼事情要交代嗎？啊…這個是…
dialogsBegin.vi: Hmm? Gothante có bảo bạn đến thăm tôi không? Tại sao?

dialogsBegin.en: Oh, I see. Iblis watch over me, what is this information!? Who could have dug up this much of the past? Only one person?
dialogsBegin.ar: Oh, I see. Iblis watch over me, what is this information!? Who could have dug up this much of the past? Only one person?
dialogsBegin.br: Ah, entendo. Que Iblis me proteja! O que significa essa informação!? Quem poderia ter descoberto tanto sobre o passado? Apenas uma pessoa...
dialogsBegin.cns: 嗯，是高潭提拉的签名没有错。啊..!这个是!!
dialogsBegin.de: (Er liest den Letter of Recommendation) Ja. Das ist definitiv das Siegel von Gothante. (Überprüft die Daten) Hmm.. Oh mein Gott! Das!
dialogsBegin.fi: Oh, I see. Iblis watch over me, what is this information!? Who could have dug up this much of the past? Only one person?
dialogsBegin.fil: Oh, I see. Iblis watch over me, what is this information!? Who could have dug up this much of the past? Only one person?
dialogsBegin.fr: Hmm ? Gothante t'a dit de venir me voir, pourquoi ? (remettant la lettre) Que contient donc cette lettre ?
dialogsBegin.id: Oh aku mengerti. Iblis mengawasiku, informasi apa ini!?Siapa yang bisa menggali masa lalu sebanyak ini?Hanya satu orang?
dialogsBegin.it: Oh, I see. Iblis watch over me, what is this information!? Who could have dug up this much of the past? Only one person?
dialogsBegin.jp: その封筒がどうかしたのか？おや、これは確かに＜ゴダンテの推薦状＞に間違いない。ん、この資料は？…ふむ。おお、これは！
dialogsBegin.kr: 아, 그렇군요. 이블리스님… 이건 도대체 무슨 정보죠!? 이렇게 역사를 깊이 파헤친 사람이 대체 누구죠? 심지어 혼자서?
dialogsBegin.nl: Oh, I see. Iblis watch over me, what is this information!? Who could have dug up this much of the past? Only one person?
dialogsBegin.pl: Oh, I see. Iblis watch over me, what is this information!? Who could have dug up this much of the past? Only one person?
dialogsBegin.ru: Святая Параллельна! Откуда у тебя эти доказательства?! Кто сумел их раскопать?! Впрочем, я и сам догадываюсь…
dialogsBegin.sp: Oh, ya veo. ¡Iblis, vela por mí! ¿¡Qué es esta información!? ¿Quién puede haber desenterrado tanta información del pasado? ¿Una sola persona?
dialogsBegin.sw: Oh, I see. Iblis watch over me, what is this information!? Who could have dug up this much of the past? Only one person?
dialogsBegin.th: อ้อ เข้าใจแล้ว Iblis คอยดูแลข้า ข้อมูลนี้มันคืออะไร!? ใครจะขุดอดีตได้มากขนาดนี้ ด้วยคนคนเดียวเนี่ยนะ?
dialogsBegin.tw: 嗯，是高潭提拉的簽名沒有錯。啊…！這個是！！
dialogsBegin.vi: Ồ, tôi hiểu rồi. Iblis trông chừng tôi, thông tin này là gì !? Ai có thể đã đào lên những điều này trong quá khứ? Chỉ một người?

dialogsBegin.en: Martinyc of course. She has finally done what we all knew she would. She does not fear death like she should. The young are too fearless these days.
dialogsBegin.ar: Martinyc of course. She has finally done what we all knew she would. She does not fear death like she should. The young are too fearless these days.
dialogsBegin.br: Martinyc, claro. Ela finalmente fez o que todos sabíamos que faria. Ela não tem medo da morte como deveria. Os jovens de hoje são muito destemidos.
dialogsBegin.cns: 这..这是玛缇雅克，这个人终于闯祸了。他以为他有几条命啊!!
dialogsBegin.de: Oh.. Marinyc hat es letzten endes getan.. Letzen endes.. Hatte er sich nicht gefürchtet getötet zu werden? Die Jugend ist heutzutage zu furchtlos.
dialogsBegin.fi: Martinyc of course. She has finally done what we all knew she would. She does not fear death like she should. The young are too fearless these days.
dialogsBegin.fil: Martinyc of course. She has finally done what we all knew she would. She does not fear death like she should. The young are too fearless these days.
dialogsBegin.fr: Oh... Martinyc a obtenu des preuves de son invraisemblable théorie ! C'est vraiment une historienne de grand talent…
dialogsBegin.id: Martinyc. Dia akhirnya melakukan apa yang kita semua tahu dia akan melakukannya. Dia tidak takut mati seperti yang seharusnya. Para anak muda terlalu tak kenal takut akhir-akhir ini.
dialogsBegin.it: Martinyc of course. She has finally done what we all knew she would. She does not fear death like she should. The young are too fearless these days.
dialogsBegin.jp: マルティニーク…ここまでつきとめたとは、ずいぶん勇敢な子だよ！無鉄砲といえばいいのかね。命が何個あっても足りないな、最近の若者は。ハハッ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 마르티닉이라니! 그럼 그렇죠. 결국 해냈군요. 그 애는 죽음도 불사하죠… 요즘 젊은이들은 너무 겁이 없어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Martinyc of course. She has finally done what we all knew she would. She does not fear death like she should. The young are too fearless these days.
dialogsBegin.pl: Martinyc of course. She has finally done what we all knew she would. She does not fear death like she should. The young are too fearless these days.
dialogsBegin.ru: Мартиника, кто же еще. Собственно, мы в ней и не сомневались. Вот же молодежь пошла - никакого страха перед смертью!
dialogsBegin.sp: Martinyc por supuesto. Finalmente ha hecho lo que todos sabíamos que haría. No le teme a la muerte como debería. Los jóvenes son demasiado intrépidos últimamente.
dialogsBegin.sw: Martinyc of course. She has finally done what we all knew she would. She does not fear death like she should. The young are too fearless these days.
dialogsBegin.th: Martinyc แน่นอน ในที่สุดเธอก็ทำในสิ่งที่เราทุกคนรู้ว่าเธอจะทำ เธอไม่กลัวความตาย เด็กสมัยนี้กล้าหาญเกินไป
dialogsBegin.tw: 當然是馬特尼提特，她終於做了我們都知道她會做的事，她沒有像她應該的那樣害怕死亡，現在的年輕人太無所畏懼了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tất nhiên là Martinyc. Cuối cùng cô ấy đã làm được những gì mà tất cả chúng ta đều biết cô ấy sẽ làm. Cô ấy không sợ cái chết như cô ấy nên làm. Những người trẻ ngày nay quá sợ hãi.

dialogsBegin.en: Aw well we all knew that the true history of Madrigal would be discovered eventually. And we all knew that Martinyc would be the one to uncover it.
dialogsBegin.ar: Aw well we all knew that the true history of Madrigal would be discovered eventually. And we all knew that Martinyc would be the one to uncover it.
dialogsBegin.br: Ah, bem, todos sabíamos que a verdadeira História de Madrigal seria descoberta um dia. E todos sabíamos que Martinyc a descobriria.
dialogsBegin.cns: 可是，这才是杰作啦!瑞加终于要露出它的真相了。
dialogsBegin.de: Jedoch, das ist wirklich eine große Sache! Nun ist es uns möglich die umfassende Vergangeheit von Madigral zu erfahren! Ha ha ha~
dialogsBegin.fi: Aw well we all knew that the true history of Madrigal would be discovered eventually. And we all knew that Martinyc would be the one to uncover it.
dialogsBegin.fil: Aw well we all knew that the true history of Madrigal would be discovered eventually. And we all knew that Martinyc would be the one to uncover it.
dialogsBegin.fr: Quelle affaire ! Nous allons peut-être enfin réussir à percer tous les mystères de l'histoire de Madrigal ! C'est passionnant !
dialogsBegin.id: yah... Kita semua tahu kalau Sejarah yang sebenarnya dari Madrigal akan terbongkar juga suatu hari nanti. Dan sekarang kita semua tahu kalau Matinyclah yang akan membongkarnya.
dialogsBegin.it: Aw well we all knew that the true history of Madrigal would be discovered eventually. And we all knew that Martinyc would be the one to uncover it.
dialogsBegin.jp: まったくたいしたもんだよ。ひょっとすると、これで隠されていたマドリガルの歴史が明らかになるかもしれないぞ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 뭐, 우리 모두 언젠가는 마드리갈의 진짜 역사가 밝혀질 거라는 걸 알고 있었죠. 그리고 그걸 밝혀낼 사람은 마르티닉일 거란 사실도.
dialogsBegin.nl: Aw well we all knew that the true history of Madrigal would be discovered eventually. And we all knew that Martinyc would be the one to uncover it.
dialogsBegin.pl: Aw well we all knew that the true history of Madrigal would be discovered eventually. And we all knew that Martinyc would be the one to uncover it.
dialogsBegin.ru: Ну, теперь уж ничего не попишешь. Да мы, признаться честно, давно этого ждали. Упорнее Мартиники в ученом мире нет! Если что вбила себе в голову…
dialogsBegin.sp: Bueno, todos sabíamos que la verdadera historia de Madrigal se descubriría tarde o temprano. Y todos sabíamos que Martinyc sería quien lo destaparía.
dialogsBegin.sw: Aw well we all knew that the true history of Madrigal would be discovered eventually. And we all knew that Martinyc would be the one to uncover it.
dialogsBegin.th: เราทุกคนรู้ดีว่าในที่สุดประวัติศาสตร์ที่แท้จริงของ Madrigal จะถูกค้นพบ และเราทุกคนรู้ว่า Martinyc จะเป็นผู้ค้นพบมัน
dialogsBegin.tw: 好吧，我們都知道瑪德利賈的真實歷史最終會被發現。我們都知道馬特尼提特會是揭開它的人。
dialogsBegin.vi: Ồ, tất cả chúng ta đều biết rằng lịch sử thực sự của Madrigal cuối cùng sẽ được khám phá. Và tất cả chúng tôi đều biết rằng Martinyc sẽ là người phát hiện ra nó.

dialogsBegin.en: By the way... Are you going to continue with this?
dialogsBegin.ar: By the way... Are you going to continue with this?

dialogsBegin.cns: 好!这个就这样吧!你还要继续做下去吗?

dialogsBegin.fil: By the way... Are you going to continue with this?
