dialogsAccept.en: Good. We will go to the Field of Bubble. There is more evidence to be found there. Hurry.
dialogsAccept.ar: Good. We will go to the Field of Bubble. There is more evidence to be found there. Hurry.
dialogsAccept.br: Bom. Iremos à Planície de Bubble. Há mais evidências a encontrar lá. Apresse-se.
dialogsAccept.cns: 好吧，你知道波布尔的平原吧?我看了这些之后才想到的，你到那边的话，或许可以找到一些线索..快去吧!
dialogsAccept.de: Schön. Du kennst die Ebene von Bubble, oder? Ich denke wir können dort ein paar Beweise finden. Lass uns gehen Schnell!
dialogsAccept.fi: Good. We will go to the Field of Bubble. There is more evidence to be found there. Hurry.
dialogsAccept.fil: Good. We will go to the Field of Bubble. There is more evidence to be found there. Hurry.
dialogsAccept.fr: Parfait ! A la lumière de ces faits, je pense que l'on pourrait trouver de nouveaux éléments dans la Plaine de Bubble. Je pars là-bas de ce pas, rejoins moi.
dialogsAccept.id: Bagus. Kita akan pergi ke Field of Bubble. Ada banyak bukti yang bisa ditemukan di sana. Cepat.
dialogsAccept.it: Good. We will go to the Field of Bubble. There is more evidence to be found there. Hurry.
dialogsAccept.jp: このレポートを読んでピンときたが、そこに行けば何か手がかりが見つかると思う。調べたいことがあるから、私はこれからそこへ向かうつもりだ。良かったら、君も一緒に来るといい。
dialogsAccept.kr: 좋아요. 버블의 장으로 갑시다. 아직 증거를 더 찾아야 해. 서두르세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Good. We will go to the Field of Bubble. There is more evidence to be found there. Hurry.
dialogsAccept.pl: Good. We will go to the Field of Bubble. There is more evidence to be found there. Hurry.
dialogsAccept.ru: Отлично. Тогда отправимся на Лучистое поле. Там тебя ждет интересное открытие.
dialogsAccept.sp: Bien. Iremos a la Llanura de Bubble. Hay más pruebas que se pueden encontrar en esa zona. Date prisa.
dialogsAccept.sw: Good. We will go to the Field of Bubble. There is more evidence to be found there. Hurry.
dialogsAccept.th: ดี เราจะไปที่ทุ่งฟองสบู่ มีหลักฐานเพิ่มเติมที่จะพบได้ที่นั่น รีบไปเถอะ
dialogsAccept.tw: 好吧，你知道巴布樂平原吧？我看了這些之後才想到的，你到那邊的話，或許可以找到一些線索…快去吧！
dialogsAccept.vi: Tốt. Chúng ta sẽ đến Cánh đồng bong bóng. Có nhiều bằng chứng hơn được tìm thấy ở đó. Nhanh lên.

dialogsDecline.fil: What? No, you cannot stop now. You have come so far.
dialogsDecline.fr: Quoi ? Tu ne peux pas abandonner maintenant... S'il te plaît réfléchis-y encore.

dialogsDecline.it: What? No, you cannot stop now. You have come so far.
dialogsDecline.jp: なんと、もうこの話には興味がないと？言いにくいが、君はもう危険な船に片足をつっこんでしまったんだよ。ここで降りるのは…少し考え直した方がいいと思うがね。
dialogsDecline.kr: 뭐라고요? 지금 멈출 순 없어요. 여기까지 와 놓고선.

dialogsDecline.vi: Gì? Không, bạn không thể dừng lại bây giờ. Bạn đã đi rất xa rồi.

dialogsDecline.en: You have yet to pay for your sins…

dialogsDecline.fi: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.fil: Di mo pa bayad ang iyong mga kasalanan…
dialogsDecline.fr: Quand expieras-tu tes nombreux crimes ?
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu belum membayar untuk dosa-dosamu…
dialogsDecline.it: Devi ancora pagare per i tuoi peccati...
dialogsDecline.jp: いつになったら、この底知れぬ罪悪感から抜けられるのだろう？
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신은 아직 죗값을 치르지 않았으니...
dialogsDecline.nl: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.pl: Musisz najpierw zapłacić za swoje grzechy…
dialogsDecline.ru: Велики твои грехи…
dialogsDecline.sp: Todavía tienes que pagar por tus pecados...
dialogsDecline.sw: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.th: คุณยังไม้ได้ชดใช้บาปของคุณ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 你還沒有為你的罪付出代價…
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn vẫn chưa phải trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình…

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.br: Sua missão foi concluída. Seus pecados foram perdoados.
dialogsComplete.cns: 任务完成，你的罪恶已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Buße getan. Deine Sünden wurden dir vergeben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Questmu telah tercapai. Dosa-dosamu telah diampuni.
dialogsComplete.it: La Missione è terminata. I tuoi peccati sono stati perdonati.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 끝났습니다. 당신의 죄를 용서하지요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Боги одобрили твое деяние и простили тебе грехи.
dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น บาปของคุณได้รับการอภัยแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nhiệm vụ của bạn đã được hoàn thành. Tội lỗi của bạn đã được tha thứ.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

name.jp: デェカネス鉱山への道

description.en: Visit the Dwarpet Rankashu and get the information Cell wanted.
description.ar: Visit the Dwarpet Rankashu and get the information Cell wanted.
description.br: Visite o Dwarpet Rankashu e obtenha a Informação que Cell deseja.
description.cns: 去找小草儿之后，帮飞儿询问消息。
description.de: Besuche Dwarpet Rankashu und besorge die Neuigkeiten für Cell.
description.fi: Visit the Dwarpet Rankashu and get the information Cell wanted.
description.fil: Bisitahin ang Dwarpet Rankashu at kunin ang information Cell na kailangan.
description.fr: Rencontrer le Dwarpet Rankashu et obtenir la réponse que Cell attend
description.id: Kunjungi Dwarpet Rankashu and dapatkan informasi yang diinginkan oleh Cell.
description.it: Visita il Dwarpet Rankashu e ottieni le informazioni.
description.jp: ドワーフのランカシュに会って、セルに頼まれたことを教えてもらおう。
description.kr: 드워펫 랑카슈를 만나 셀이 부탁한 소식을 얻으세요.
description.nl: Visit the Dwarpet Rankashu and get the information Cell wanted.
description.pl: Odwiedź krasnoluda Rankashu i zdobądź informacje, których potrzebował Cell.
description.ru: Нужно поговорить с карликом Ранкашем и получить нужные Селлу сведения.
description.sp: Visita al Enano Rankashu y consigue la información que quiere Cell.
description.sw: Visit the Dwarpet Rankashu and get the information Cell wanted.
description.th: ไปที่ Dwarpet Rankashu และรับ Cell information ที่ต้องการ
description.tw: 去找小草兒之後，幫飛兒詢問消息。
description.vi: Ghé thăm Dwarpet Rankashu và nhận thông tin Cell muốn.

descriptionComplete.en: You have the Mine Entrance Card. Now to find out what everyone is so afraid of.
descriptionComplete.ar: You have the Mine Entrance Card. Now to find out what everyone is so afraid of.
descriptionComplete.br: Você tem o Cartão de Entrada da Mina. Agora é hora de descobrir do que é que todos têm tanto medo.
descriptionComplete.cns: 终于拿到可以进入达肯矿洞的道具了.为什么大家都很讨厌进入这里呢？难道有什么秘密吗？
descriptionComplete.de: Nun hast du die ID Karte um in die Dekane Mine zu kommen. Was um alles in der Welt könnte die Leute an der Mine so beunruhigen?
descriptionComplete.fi: You have the Mine Entrance Card. Now to find out what everyone is so afraid of.
descriptionComplete.fil: Mayroon kang Mine Entrace Card. Ngayon hanapin mo kung ano ang rason bat natatakot ang lahat.
descriptionComplete.fr: Vous avez obtenu la carte d'accès de la Mine de Dekanes. Au nom du ciel, quel est donc le secret de cette mine qui provoque autant de peur chez les gens ?!
descriptionComplete.id: Kamu mempunyai Mine Entrance Card. Sekarang cari tahu apa yang orang-orang takutkan.
descriptionComplete.it: Hai la Tessera d'Ingresso alla Miniera. Ora puoi scoprire di cosa hanno così paura tutti.
descriptionComplete.jp: ＜デェカネス鉱山＞ に入れるIDカードを手に入れた。みんな恐れているこの鉱山には、どんな秘密が隠されているんだろう？
descriptionComplete.kr: 데카네 광산 출입 카드를 얻었습니다. 이제 모두가 광산을 두려워하는 이유를 알아볼 차례입니다.
descriptionComplete.nl: You have the Mine Entrance Card. Now to find out what everyone is so afraid of.
descriptionComplete.pl: Masz kartę wstępu do kopalni. Teraz dowiedz się, czego wszyscy się tak boją.
descriptionComplete.ru: Карта доступа в Шахту Распада получена. Теперь можно выяснить, почему все боятся спускаться туда…
descriptionComplete.sp: Ya tienes la Tarjeta de Entrada a la Mina. Ahora a descubrir a qué le tienen tanto miedo todos.
descriptionComplete.sw: You have the Mine Entrance Card. Now to find out what everyone is so afraid of.
descriptionComplete.th: คุณมี Mine Entrance Card ตอนนี้ก็ตามหาสิ่งที่ทุกคนกลัว
descriptionComplete.tw: 終於拿到可以進入迪坎礦坑的道具了.為什麼大家都很討厭進入這裡呢？難道有什麼秘密嗎？
descriptionComplete.vi: Bạn có Thẻ vào Hầm mỏ. Bây giờ để tìm hiểu những gì tất cả mọi người rất sợ.

dialogsBegin.en: You are really willing to enter the Dekane Mine?
dialogsBegin.ar: You are really willing to enter the Dekane Mine?
dialogsBegin.br: Você deseja realmente entrar na Mina Dekane?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你真的想进入达肯矿洞吗?
dialogsBegin.de: Hast du gesagt, dass du zur gefürchteten Dekane Mine gehen willst?
dialogsBegin.fi: You are really willing to enter the Dekane Mine?
dialogsBegin.fil: Handa kaba pumasok ng Dekane Mine?
dialogsBegin.fr: Es-tu en train de me dire que tu as pour but d'aller rencontrer le dangereux et puissant Dekanes?
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu benar-benar bersedia untuk memasuki Dekane Mine?
dialogsBegin.it: Sei davvero disposto ad entrare nella miniera di Dekane?
dialogsBegin.jp: もしかして、死の ＜デェカネス鉱山＞ へ入ろうとしているのか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 정말 그 데카네 광산에 들어가려는 건가요?
dialogsBegin.nl: You are really willing to enter the Dekane Mine?
dialogsBegin.pl: Naprawdę chcesz wejść do Kopalni Dekane?
dialogsBegin.ru: Подумай: ты и правда хочешь отправиться в Шахту Распада?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Seguro que estás dispuesto a entrar a la Mina Dekane?
dialogsBegin.sw: You are really willing to enter the Dekane Mine?
dialogsBegin.th: คุณยินดีจะเข้า Dekane Mine งั้นเรอะ?
dialogsBegin.tw: 難道你想進入迪坎礦坑嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có thực sự muốn tiến vào hầm mỏ Dekane?

dialogsAccept.en: Then visit the Dwarpet, Rankashu, in front of the Dekane Mine.
dialogsAccept.ar: Then visit the Dwarpet, Rankashu, in front of the Dekane Mine.
dialogsAccept.br: Então fale com Rankashu, o Dwarpet em frente à Mina Dekane.
dialogsAccept.cns: 帮我去找“小草儿”询问一下关于矿山的事情好吗？你去达肯矿洞前面就会找到他了。
dialogsAccept.de: In dem Fall solltest du den Dwarpet Rankashu aufsuchen. Er befindet sich am Eingang der Mine.
dialogsAccept.fi: Then visit the Dwarpet, Rankashu, in front of the Dekane Mine.
dialogsAccept.fil: Tapos bisitahin ang Dwarpet, Rankashu, sa harap ng Dekane Mine.
dialogsAccept.fr: Dans ce cas rend visite au Dwarpet nommé Rankashu et dis-lui que tu viens de ma part. Demande-lui de te fournir la réponse à ma requête. Tu le trouveras dans les profondeurs de la mine de Dekanes.
dialogsAccept.id: Setelah itu kunjungi Dwarpet, Rankashu, didepan Dekane Mine.
dialogsAccept.it: Quindi visita il Dwarpet, Rankashu, di fronte alla miniera di Dekane.
dialogsAccept.jp: だったら、私の使いをちょっと頼まれてくれないか？　＜ランカシュ＞ というドワーフに鉱山ついての調査を依頼しているのだが、その結果を聞いてきてほしいのだ。やつなら、＜デェカネス鉱山＞ の隣にいるはずだ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 그렇다면 데카네 광산 앞에 있는 드워펫, 랑카슈를 찾아가세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Then visit the Dwarpet, Rankashu, in front of the Dekane Mine.
dialogsAccept.pl: Następnie odwiedź krasnoluda Rankashu przed Kopalnią Dekane.
dialogsAccept.ru: Поговори с карликом Ранкашем у входа в Шахту.
dialogsAccept.sp: Después visita al Enano, Rankashu, frente a la Mina Dekane.
dialogsAccept.sw: Then visit the Dwarpet, Rankashu, in front of the Dekane Mine.
dialogsAccept.th: จากนั้นไปเยี่ยม Dwarpet Rankashu หน้า Dekane Mine
dialogsAccept.tw: 幫我去找『小草兒』詢問一下關於礦坑的事情好嗎？你去迪坎礦坑前面就會找到他了。
dialogsAccept.vi: Sau đó đến thăm Dwarpet, Rankashu, ở phía trước của hầm mỏ Dekane

dialogsDecline.en: Ha ha ha. Of course not. It is far too frightening.

dialogsDecline.br: Ha ha ha. É claro que não. É muito mais amedrontador.
dialogsDecline.cns: 噗！我就知道你会这样。你觉得很恐怖吧！
dialogsDecline.de: Ha ha ha. Ich wusste du würdest nein sagen. Es wäre viel zu gruselig.
dialogsDecline.fi: Ha ha ha. Of course not. It is far too frightening.
dialogsDecline.fil: Ha ha ha. Siyempre naman hindi. Masyado itong nakakatakot.
dialogsDecline.fr: Ha ha… Je savais que tu allais dire non ! C'est effrayant comme mission, je l'avoue…
dialogsDecline.id: Ha ha ha. Tentu saja tidak. Itu terlalu menakutkan.
dialogsDecline.it: Hahaha. Ovviamente no. È troppo spaventoso.
dialogsDecline.jp: はははっ！　そうだろうと思った。まあ、怖気づくのも仕方ない。
dialogsDecline.kr: 훗~ 그럴 줄 알았어. 뭐 겁낼 만하지.
dialogsDecline.nl: Ha ha ha. Of course not. It is far too frightening.
dialogsDecline.pl: Ha ha ha. Oczywiście że nie. To zbyt przerażające.
dialogsDecline.ru: Ха-ха-ха! Я так и думал. Боязно стало, да?
dialogsDecline.sp: Ja ja ja. Por supuesto que no. Es demasiado aterrador.
dialogsDecline.sw: Ha ha ha. Of course not. It is far too frightening.
dialogsDecline.th: ฮ่าๆ แน่นอน มันน่ากลัวสุดๆ
dialogsDecline.tw: 噗！我就知道你會這樣。你覺得很恐怖吧！
dialogsDecline.vi: Ha ha ha. Dĩ nhiên là không. Nó quá đáng sợ.

dialogsComplete.en: Here is the Mine Entrance Card. It is up to you to enter but I advise against it. You may die.
dialogsComplete.ar: Here is the Mine Entrance Card. It is up to you to enter but I advise against it. You may die.
dialogsComplete.br: Aqui está o Cartão de Entrada da Mina. Você decide se deseja entrar. Porém, não recomendo. Você poderá morrer.
dialogsComplete.cns: 谢谢你啦～这是可以进入矿山的通行卡到时候.变成灵魂出来也不要埋怨我喔～
dialogsComplete.de: Danke. Hier ist die ID Karte für die Mine. Denke nicht schlecht von mir, wenn du stirbst und zu einem rachsüchtigen Geist wirst.
dialogsComplete.fi: Here is the Mine Entrance Card. It is up to you to enter but I advise against it. You may die.
dialogsComplete.fil: Eto ang Mine Entrance Card. Nasasaiyo na ang desisyon kung papasok ka pero kontra ako dito. Pwede kang mamatay.
dialogsComplete.fr: Je t'en remercie. Ceci est la carte d'accès de la mine. Ne reviens pas me voir en te plaignant du non fonctionnement de celle-ci lorsque tu seras mort et que tu auras soif de vengeance !
dialogsComplete.id: Ini Mine Entrance Card. Terserah kamu jika ingin masuk tetapi aku menyarankan untuk tidak melakukannya. Kamu mungkin mati.
dialogsComplete.it: Ecco la tessera d'ingresso alla miniera. Scegli se entrare ma io lo sconsiglio. Potresti morire.
dialogsComplete.jp: おお、ありがとう。では、鉱山へ入れるIDカード ＜鉱山入場証＞ を渡すから、よろしく頼むよ。もし死ぬことになったりしても、私を恨まないでほしい。鉱山に行くと言ったのは君なのだからな！では、気をつけて！
dialogsComplete.kr: 자, 광산 출입 카드예요. 들어갈지는 당신이 결정할 일이지만, 말리고 싶네요. 죽을 수도 있다고요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Here is the Mine Entrance Card. It is up to you to enter but I advise against it. You may die.
dialogsComplete.pl: Oto karta wstępu do kopalni. Wejście do niej zależy od Ciebie, ale odradzam. Możesz umrzeć.
dialogsComplete.ru: Держи карту. И все-таки... не советую я тебе туда ходить. Там бродит смерть…
dialogsComplete.sp: Esta es la Tarjeta de Entrada a la Mina. Es tu decision entrar ahí pero te lo advierto una vez más. Puedes morir ahí dentro.
dialogsComplete.sw: Here is the Mine Entrance Card. It is up to you to enter but I advise against it. You may die.
dialogsComplete.th: นี่ Mine Entrance Card มันขึ้นอยู่กับว่าคุณจะเข้ามาไปไหม แต่แนะนำว่าอย่าเลย คุณอาจตายได้นะ
dialogsComplete.tw: 謝謝你啦～這是可以進入礦坑的通行卡到時候.變成靈魂出來也不要埋怨我喔～
dialogsComplete.vi: Đây là Thẻ vào cửa của Hầm mỏ. Bạn có thể vào nhưng tôi khuyên bạn không nên làm như vậy. Bạn có thể chết

dialogsFail.en: Is it so hard to tell me what I want to know? Leave quickly.
dialogsFail.ar: Is it so hard to tell me what I want to know? Leave quickly.
dialogsFail.br: É tão difícil assim me dizer o que você deseja saber? Saia rapidamente.
dialogsFail.cns: 帮我问个事情有那么难吗？真是一个无能的家伙啊！快去问一问回来好不好啊？
dialogsFail.de: Was ist so schwer daran an ein paar Neuigkeiten zu kommen? Du bist außergewöhnlich inkompetent. Sieh zu, dass du Land gewinnst!
dialogsFail.fi: Is it so hard to tell me what I want to know? Leave quickly.
dialogsFail.fil: Masyado ba mahirap sabihin sakin ang gusto ko malaman? Lumayas ka.
dialogsFail.fr: Pourquoi est-ce qu'il est aussi difficile d'avoir quelques nouvelles ? Tu es incompétent à un point… Va... Va t'en vite !
dialogsFail.id: Apakah begitu sulit untuk memberi tahu aku apa yang ingin aku ketahui? Pergilah secepatnya.
dialogsFail.it: È così difficile dirmi quello che voglio sapere? Vattene velocemente.
dialogsFail.jp:
ちょっと話を聞いて来る事がそんなに面倒なのか？　まあ、だったら仕方ない。他の冒険者に頼むとするか。じゃあな。
…用がないなら早くこんなところからは立ち去るといい。
dialogsFail.kr: 소식 좀 알아봐 주는게 어렵다니. 보기 드물게 무능한 녀석이군. 재빨리 다녀오는 것이 어때?
dialogsFail.nl: Is it so hard to tell me what I want to know? Leave quickly.
dialogsFail.pl: Czy tak trudno powiedzieć mi to, co chcę wiedzieć? Wyjdź szybko.
dialogsFail.ru: Что, так трудно выполнить простейшее поручение? Иди уже, а.
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Es tan difícil decirme lo que quiero saber? Lárgate, rápido.
dialogsFail.sw: Is it so hard to tell me what I want to know? Leave quickly.
dialogsFail.th: มันยากนะที่ฉันจะบอกว่าฉันอยากรู้อะไรบ้าง รีบไปดีกว่า
dialogsFail.tw: 幫我問個事情有那麼難嗎？真是一個無能的傢伙啊！快去問一問回來好不好啊？
dialogsFail.vi: Thật khó để nói cho tôi biết những gì tôi muốn biết? Rời khỏi đây nhanh.

name.cns: 统一!红色魔导战甲强盗团
name.jp: 盗賊団の本拠地を探せ！
name.th: คณะสหพันธ์ Red Bang

description.en: Locate the Red bang Troupe base in Erons Factory 2, Darkon 1, and report back to Amadolka with anything you find.
description.ar: Locate the Red bang Troupe base in Erons Factory 2, Darkon 1, and report back to Amadolka with anything you find.
description.br: Localize a base dos Bangs Vermelhos na Fábrica Erons 2, Darkon 1, e reporte a Amadolka com qualquer coisa que encontrar.
description.cns: 他们的主要居住地，应该在绿磷石工厂第2地区的某处，你帮我查一下那个地方在哪里，拜托了!
description.de: Ich bin mir sicher dass ihre Basis irgendwie in den Tiefen von Darkon 1 ist. Bitte finde es heraus und lasse es mich wissen.
description.fi: Locate the Red bang Troupe base in Erons Factory 2, Darkon 1, and report back to Amadolka with anything you find.
description.fil: Locate the Red bang Troupe base in Erons Factory 2, Darkon 1, and report back to Amadolka with anything you find.
description.fr: Trouver la base des Big Bangs au sud de l'usine des Erons, puis retourner voir Amadolka.
description.id: Temukan markas Red bang Troupe di Erons Factory 2, Darkon 1, dan laporkan kembali ke Amadolka dengan apa pun yang kamu temukan.
description.it: Locate the Red bang Troupe base in Erons Factory 2, Darkon 1, and report back to Amadolka with anything you find.
description.jp: 盗賊団の本拠地は、エイエンブルケープ（ダーコン第2地区）の近辺にあるそうだ。そこを重点的に探索し、見つけた盗賊団とボスをやっつけよう。
description.kr: 다콘 제1지구 에런스 공장 2단지에 있는 레드 뱅 도적단의 본거지를 찾고, 알아낸 것을 아마돌카에게 보고하세요.
description.nl: Locate the Red bang Troupe base in Erons Factory 2, Darkon 1, and report back to Amadolka with anything you find.
description.pl: Locate the Red bang Troupe base in Erons Factory 2, Darkon 1, and report back to Amadolka with anything you find.
description.ru: Нужно отыскать логово "Труппы товарищей" на Эрониевой фактории Даркона-1 и рассказать о нем Амадолару.
description.sp: Encuentra la base de los Bangs Rojos en la Fábrica de Erons 2, en Darkon 1, e infórmale a Amadolka todo lo que descubras.
description.sw: Locate the Red bang Troupe base in Erons Factory 2, Darkon 1, and report back to Amadolka with anything you find.
description.th: หาฐาน Red Bang Troupe ใน Erons Factory 2 ที่ Darkon 1 และรายงานสิ่งที่คุณพบกับ Amadolka
description.tw: 他們的主要居住地，應該在第 2 地區的某處，你幫我查一下那個地方在哪裡，拜託了！
description.vi: Tìm căn cứ của Red bang Troupe ở Erons Factory 2, Darkon 1 và báo cáo lại cho Amadolka với bất cứ thứ gì bạn tìm thấy.

dialogsBegin.en: They have occupied almost half of Erons Factory. I didn't realize how strong they really were.
dialogsBegin.ar: They have occupied almost half of Erons Factory. I didn't realize how strong they really were.
dialogsBegin.br: Logo ali, perto da entrada. Eles ocuparam quase metade da Fábrica Erons. Droga, ninguém sabia que eles eram tão fortes!
dialogsBegin.cns: 他们已经占领了绿磷石工厂的一半了。真没想到他们有这么厉害。
dialogsBegin.de: (Zeigt auf den Eingang der Erons Fabrik) Sie haben schon fast die Hälfte von der Erons Fabrik besetzt. Mist, niemand wusste dass sie so stark sein würden!
dialogsBegin.fi: They have occupied almost half of Erons Factory. I didn't realize how strong they really were.
dialogsBegin.fil: They have occupied almost half of Erons Factory. I didn't realize how strong they really were.
dialogsBegin.fr: (Montrant l'entrée de l'usine des Erons) Ils occupent la moitié de l'Usine des Erons. Mais personne ne se doutait qu'ils étaient si forts !
dialogsBegin.id: Mereka telah menempati hampir setengah dari Pabrik Erons. Saya tidak menyadari betapa kuatnya mereka sebenarnya.
dialogsBegin.it: They have occupied almost half of Erons Factory. I didn't realize how strong they really were.
dialogsBegin.jp: …ちくしょう！たった今、復活した赤いヴァン盗賊団の奴らがエランパークス地域の半分を制圧したとの連絡が入った！ああ、なんてことだ…！
dialogsBegin.kr: 녀석들이 에런스 공장을 절반 가까이 점령했어요. 이렇게 강한 도적단일 줄은 몰랐네요.
dialogsBegin.nl: They have occupied almost half of Erons Factory. I didn't realize how strong they really were.
dialogsBegin.pl: They have occupied almost half of Erons Factory. I didn't realize how strong they really were.
dialogsBegin.ru: Они заняли почти половину фактории. Я и не ожидал, что они так сильны.
dialogsBegin.sp: Han ocupado casi la mitad de la Fábrica de Erons. No sabía que eran tan fuertes.
dialogsBegin.sw: They have occupied almost half of Erons Factory. I didn't realize how strong they really were.
dialogsBegin.th: พวกมันยึด Erons Factory ไปมากกว่าครึ่งแล้ว ฉันไม่ได้ตระหนักถึงความแข็งแกร่งของพวกมันจริงๆ
dialogsBegin.tw: 他們已經佔領了艾磷斯工廠的一半了。真沒想到他們有這麼厲害。
dialogsBegin.vi: Họ đã chiếm gần một nửa Erons Factory. Tôi không nhận ra họ thực sự mạnh đến mức nào.

dialogsBegin.en: We are having a hard time defending this narrow entrance, they will get through here in no time unless we do something about it.
dialogsBegin.ar: We are having a hard time defending this narrow entrance, they will get through here in no time unless we do something about it.
dialogsBegin.br: Nós estamos com dificuldade para defender esta entrada estreita. Eles entrarão aqui em pouco tempo a menos que façamos algo a respeito.
dialogsBegin.cns: 这里的入口很窄，所以还可以挡的住，但是我觉得没办法撑很久。总有一天会被他们攻击的。
dialogsBegin.de: Wir verlassen uns auf diesen engen Eingang, aber es wird nicht lange dauern bis sie hier durchkommen.
dialogsBegin.fi: We are having a hard time defending this narrow entrance, they will get through here in no time unless we do something about it.
dialogsBegin.fil: We are having a hard time defending this narrow entrance, they will get through here in no time unless we do something about it.
dialogsBegin.fr: Nous défendons de notre mieux cet endroit, mais dans peu de temps ils auront réussi à passer.
dialogsBegin.id: Kami mengalami kesulitan mempertahankan pintu masuk sempit ini, mereka akan melewati sini dalam waktu singkat kecuali kita melakukan sesuatu tentang hal itu.
dialogsBegin.it: We are having a hard time defending this narrow entrance, they will get through here in no time unless we do something about it.
dialogsBegin.jp: この地域へ進入する道はとても狭いからなんとか守れているはいるが、あいつらの数は多すぎる！ここですら、いつ破られるかわからない状況だ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 좁은 길 하나 방어하는 것도 힘겨운 상황이에요. 조처하지 않으면 금세 뚫리고 말 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: We are having a hard time defending this narrow entrance, they will get through here in no time unless we do something about it.
dialogsBegin.pl: We are having a hard time defending this narrow entrance, they will get through here in no time unless we do something about it.
dialogsBegin.ru: Мы пытаемся перекрыть этот вход, но их слишком много. Рано или поздно они прорвутся сюда.
dialogsBegin.sp: Estamos teniendo dificultades para defender esta entrada, pasarán por aquí en poco tiempo a menos que hagamos algo para impedirlo.
dialogsBegin.sw: We are having a hard time defending this narrow entrance, they will get through here in no time unless we do something about it.
dialogsBegin.th: มันยากมากที่เราต้องคอยปกป้องทางเข้าแคบๆ นี่ พวกมันจะผ่านเข้ามาในนี้ได้แน่ เว้นแต่เราจะทำอะไรสักอย่างกับมัน
dialogsBegin.tw: 這裡的入口很窄，所以還可以擋的住，但是我覺得沒辦法撐很久。總有一天會被他們攻擊的。
dialogsBegin.vi: Chúng tôi đang gặp khó khăn trong việc bảo vệ lối vào chật hẹp này, họ sẽ đi qua đây ngay lập tức trừ khi chúng tôi làm gì đó.

dialogsBegin.en: We need more information! We need a scout to survey their base and let us know what we're really up against.
dialogsBegin.ar: We need more information! We need a scout to survey their base and let us know what we're really up against.
dialogsBegin.br: Temos que conseguir um pouco de tempo para nos prepararmos. Precisamos de mais informações! Precisamos de alguém para inspecionar sua base e nos informar o que realmente estamos enfrentando.
dialogsBegin.cns: 只要把他们引诱到其他地方的话，应该也可以找时间重新建设的。
dialogsBegin.de: Wir hätten Zeit um uns vorzubereiten, wenn sie jemand ablenken würde.
dialogsBegin.fi: We need more information! We need a scout to survey their base and let us know what we're really up against.
dialogsBegin.fil: We need more information! We need a scout to survey their base and let us know what we're really up against.
dialogsBegin.fr: Nous aurons le temps de préparer une défense si quelqu'un arrive à les distraire...
dialogsBegin.id: Kami membutuhkan lebih banyak informasi! Kami membutuhkan mata - mata untuk survei markas mereka dan memberi tahu kami apa yang sebenarnya kami hadapi.
dialogsBegin.it: We need more information! We need a scout to survey their base and let us know what we're really up against.
dialogsBegin.jp: ふむ…あいつらの勢力を少しでも分散させることができたら多少は安心できるのだが。あいつらがまとまって攻めてきたら、ここの警護も非常に危険になってくる。
dialogsBegin.kr: 도적단에 대한 정보가 필요해요! 누군가 도적단 본거지에 몰래 들어가 뒷조사를 해주면 좋을 텐데.
dialogsBegin.nl: We need more information! We need a scout to survey their base and let us know what we're really up against.
dialogsBegin.pl: We need more information! We need a scout to survey their base and let us know what we're really up against.
dialogsBegin.ru: Информация! Нам нужна информация! Но где найти шпиона, который согласится проникнуть в их логово?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Necesitamos más información! Necesitamos un explorador que inspeccione su base y que nos diga a qué nos enfrentamos realmente.
dialogsBegin.sw: We need more information! We need a scout to survey their base and let us know what we're really up against.
dialogsBegin.th: เราต้องการข้อมูลเพิ่มเติม! เราต้องการสายสืบเพื่อสำรวจฐานที่มั่นของพวกมัน และแจ้งให้เรารู้ว่าเรากำลังเจอกับอะไร
dialogsBegin.tw: 只要把他們引誘到其他地方的話，應該也可以找時間重新建設的。
dialogsBegin.vi: Chúng tôi cần thêm thông tin! Chúng tôi cần một trinh sát để khảo sát căn cứ của họ và cho chúng tôi biết những gì chúng tôi thực sự chống lại.

dialogsBegin.en: You seem like a good candidate for the job. What do you say? Want to help the people of Erons Factory?
dialogsBegin.ar: You seem like a good candidate for the job. What do you say? Want to help the people of Erons Factory?
dialogsBegin.br: Você parece ser um bom candidato para o trabalho. O que você diz? Quer ajudar as pessoas da Fábrica Erons?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你可以为了绿磷石工厂的人民帮我吗?
dialogsBegin.de: Du scheinst ein guter Kandidat für die Stelle zu sein. Was sagst du dazu? Willst du den Menschen in Erons Factory helfen?
dialogsBegin.fi: You seem like a good candidate for the job. What do you say? Want to help the people of Erons Factory?
dialogsBegin.fil: You seem like a good candidate for the job. What do you say? Want to help the people of Erons Factory?
dialogsBegin.fr: Veux-tu bien aider les personnes de l'usine des Erons pour moi ?
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu tampak seperti kandidat yang baik untuk pekerjaan itu. Apa yang kamu katakan? Ingin membantu orang-orang di Pabrik Erons?
dialogsBegin.it: You seem like a good candidate for the job. What do you say? Want to help the people of Erons Factory?
dialogsBegin.jp: お願いだ、君！どうかこのエランパークスの住民のため、力を貸してくれないだろうか？これは緊急事態なんだ！
dialogsBegin.kr: 당신이 적임자일 것 같은데. 어떤가요? 에런스 공장의 사람들을 도와주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: You seem like a good candidate for the job. What do you say? Want to help the people of Erons Factory?
dialogsBegin.pl: You seem like a good candidate for the job. What do you say? Want to help the people of Erons Factory?
dialogsBegin.ru: You seem like a good candidate for the job. What do you say? Want to help the people of Erons Factory?
dialogsBegin.sp: Pareces un buen candidato para el trabajo. ¿Qué me dices? ¿Quieres ayudar a la gente de la Fábrica de Erons?
dialogsBegin.sw: You seem like a good candidate for the job. What do you say? Want to help the people of Erons Factory?
dialogsBegin.th: คุณเหมาะที่จะรับงานนี้นะ คุณพูดว่าไงนะ? ต้องการช่วยคนของ Erons Factory งั้นเหรอ?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你似乎是這任務的好人選。你說什麼？想幫助艾磷斯工廠的人們嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có vẻ như là một ứng cử viên sáng giá cho công việc. Bạn nói gì? Bạn muốn giúp đỡ mọi người của Erons Factory?

dialogsAccept.en: Great! I am sure their base is somewhere in the depths of Darkon 1. Let me know what you find out!
dialogsAccept.ar: Great! I am sure their base is somewhere in the depths of Darkon 1. Let me know what you find out!
dialogsAccept.br: Ótimo! Estou certo de que a base deles fica em algum lugar de Darkon 1. Por favor, encontre-a e me avise.
dialogsAccept.cns: 好，他们的主要居住地，应该在第2地区的某处，你帮我查一下那个地方在哪里，拜托了!
dialogsAccept.de: Gut! Ich bin mir sicher dass ihre Basis irgendwie in den Tiefen von Darkon 1 ist. Bitte finde es heraus und lasse es mich wissen.
dialogsAccept.fi: Great! I am sure their base is somewhere in the depths of Darkon 1. Let me know what you find out!
dialogsAccept.fil: Great! I am sure their base is somewhere in the depths of Darkon 1. Let me know what you find out!
dialogsAccept.fr: Bien ! Je suis sûr que leur base se trouve quelque part au sud de l'usine des Erons... S'il te plaît trouve-la et reviens me voir.
dialogsAccept.id: Baiklah! Saya yakin markas mereka ada di suatu tempat di kedalaman Darkon 1. Beri tahu saya apa yang kamu temukan!
dialogsAccept.it: Great! I am sure their base is somewhere in the depths of Darkon 1. Let me know what you find out!
dialogsAccept.jp: 力を貸してくれるのか、ありがとう！奴らの本拠地はエイエンブルケープ（ダーコン第2地区）にあるとの話だ。そこを重点的に探して、やつらとやつらのボスをやっつけてきてくれ！
dialogsAccept.kr: 좋아요! 분명 다콘 제1지구 어딘가 깊은 곳에 도적단의 본거지가 있을 거예요. 알아낸 건 뭐든 알려주세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Great! I am sure their base is somewhere in the depths of Darkon 1. Let me know what you find out!
dialogsAccept.pl: Great! I am sure their base is somewhere in the depths of Darkon 1. Let me know what you find out!
dialogsAccept.ru: Отлично! Уверен, их логово где-то на Дарконе-1. Возвращайся, когда найдешь его.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Genial! Estoy seguro de que su base está en las profundidades de Darkon 1. ¡Avísame cuando averigües algo!
dialogsAccept.sw: Great! I am sure their base is somewhere in the depths of Darkon 1. Let me know what you find out!
dialogsAccept.th: เยี่ยม! ฉันแน่ใจว่าฐานของพวกมันอยู่ที่ไหนสักแห่งในส่วนลึกของ Darkon 1 แจ้งให้เราทราบด้วยว่าคุณพบอะไร!
dialogsAccept.tw: 好，他們的主要居住地，應該在第 2 地區的某處，你幫我查一下那個地方在哪裡，拜託了！
dialogsAccept.vi: Tuyệt quá! Tôi chắc chắn rằng căn cứ của họ nằm ở đâu đó trong sâu thẳm của Darkon 1. Hãy cho tôi biết những gì bạn tìm ra!

dialogsDecline.en: No? Fine… We will have to deal with it ourselves.
dialogsDecline.ar: No? Fine… We will have to deal with it ourselves.
dialogsDecline.br: Não? Tudo bem… Teremos que lidar com isso nós mesmos.
dialogsDecline.cns: 这样啊..好吧!你已经帮路达把话传给我了，这样我也很感谢你了。
dialogsDecline.de: Nein? Gut... Dann müssen wir uns eben selbst darum kümmern.
dialogsDecline.fi: No? Fine… We will have to deal with it ourselves.
dialogsDecline.fil: No? Fine… We will have to deal with it ourselves.
dialogsDecline.fr: Oh... Je vais bien. Merci en tout cas pour m'avoir raconté ce que Luda t'avait dit.
dialogsDecline.id: Tidak? Baik... Kita harus menghadapinya sendiri.
dialogsDecline.it: No? Fine… We will have to deal with it ourselves.
dialogsDecline.jp: そうか、残念だ。しかし、ルダの話を伝えてくれただけでも感謝するよ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 싫다고요? 어쩔 수 없네요. 저희가 직접 하는 수밖에.
dialogsDecline.nl: No? Fine… We will have to deal with it ourselves.
dialogsDecline.pl: No? Fine… We will have to deal with it ourselves.
dialogsDecline.ru: No? Fine… We will have to deal with it ourselves.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿No? Bueno… Tendremos que lidiar con esto nosotros mismos.
dialogsDecline.sw: No? Fine… We will have to deal with it ourselves.
dialogsDecline.th: ไม่งั้นเหรอ? ก็ได้... เราคงต้องรับมือกับมันเอง
dialogsDecline.tw: 不？好吧……我們將不得不自己處理。
dialogsDecline.vi: Không? Được thôi… Chúng tôi sẽ phải tự mình giải quyết.

dialogsComplete.en: Excellent work! So now we know where exactly their base is located and what we're up against with their new leader.
dialogsComplete.ar: Excellent work! So now we know where exactly their base is located and what we're up against with their new leader.
dialogsComplete.br: Excelente trabalho! Então agora sabemos exatamente onde a base deles está localizada e o que estamos enfrentando com seu novo líder.
dialogsComplete.cns: 是啊?原来在那边啊..我一定会报答你的，一定会!
dialogsComplete.de: Bist du dir sicher? Ja, es ist da! Ich habe es!! Danke, danke sehr. Ich werde dich entlohnen, versprochen!
dialogsComplete.fi: Excellent work! So now we know where exactly their base is located and what we're up against with their new leader.
dialogsComplete.fil: Excellent work! So now we know where exactly their base is located and what we're up against with their new leader.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tu es sûr ? Oui, c'est là ! Ha ha ha! Merci, merci mille fois. Je te récompenserai, c'est promis !
dialogsComplete.id: Kerja bagus! Jadi sekarang kita tahu di mana tepatnya markas mereka berada dan apa yang kita hadapi dengan pemimpin baru mereka.
dialogsComplete.it: Excellent work! So now we know where exactly their base is located and what we're up against with their new leader.
dialogsComplete.jp: やはりあそこが本拠地だったか。無事に帰ってきてくれて良かった。これでエランパークスの人々も安心して眠ることができるだろう。多くの人命を守った君に、本当に感謝するよ！
dialogsComplete.kr: 훌륭해요! 이제 정확히 어디에 본거지가 있는지, 새로운 두목이 어떤 녀석인지 알게 되었네요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Excellent work! So now we know where exactly their base is located and what we're up against with their new leader.
dialogsComplete.pl: Excellent work! So now we know where exactly their base is located and what we're up against with their new leader.
dialogsComplete.ru: Отлично! Теперь мы знаем, где их логово и кто их новый лидер.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Excelente trabajo! Ahora sabemos dónde está exactamente su base y a lo qué nos enfrentamos con su nuevo líder.
dialogsComplete.sw: Excellent work! So now we know where exactly their base is located and what we're up against with their new leader.
dialogsComplete.th: ทำงานได้ดีมาก! ตอนนี้เรารู้ว่าฐานของพวกเขาตั้งอยู่ตรงไหน และสิ่งที่เรากำลังต่อสู้ด้วยก็คือผู้นำคนใหม่ของพวกมัน
dialogsComplete.tw: 是啊？原來在那邊啊…我一定會報答你的，一定會！
dialogsComplete.vi: Công việc xuất sắc! Vì vậy, bây giờ chúng tôi biết chính xác căn cứ của họ nằm ở đâu và chúng tôi đang chống lại nhà thủ lĩnh mới của họ.

dialogsFail.en: Have you found it yet? We don't have much time! Please, hurry!
dialogsFail.ar: Have you found it yet? We don't have much time! Please, hurry!
dialogsFail.br: Você já a encontrou? Não temos tempo o suficiente. Por favor, depressa!
dialogsFail.cns: 还没帮我找到吗?可以快一点帮我找吗?真的很急!!
dialogsFail.de: Hast du es schon gefunden? Wir haben nicht genug Zeit. Bitte beeile dich!
dialogsFail.fi: Have you found it yet? We don't have much time! Please, hurry!
dialogsFail.fil: Have you found it yet? We don't have much time! Please, hurry!
dialogsFail.fr: Tu n'as pas encore trouvé leur repaire ? Nous avons peu de temps. Dépêche-toi !
dialogsFail.id: Apakah kamu sudah menemukannya? Kami tidak punya banyak waktu! Tolong, cepat!
dialogsFail.it: Have you found it yet? We don't have much time! Please, hurry!
dialogsFail.jp: まだか？もうあまり時間がない、できるだけ早くあいつらの本拠地を調べて、ボスもろともやっつけてきてくれ！
dialogsFail.kr: 아직도 못 찾으셨어요? 시간이 없어요! 부탁이니 서둘러 주세요!
dialogsFail.nl: Have you found it yet? We don't have much time! Please, hurry!
dialogsFail.pl: Have you found it yet? We don't have much time! Please, hurry!
dialogsFail.ru: Тебе уже удалось найти логово разбойников? У нас не так много времени! Поспеши!
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Ya lo has encontrado? ¡No tenemos mucho tiempo! ¡Por favor, date prisa!
dialogsFail.sw: Have you found it yet? We don't have much time! Please, hurry!
dialogsFail.th: คุณพบมันแล้วหรือยัง? เราไม่มีเวลามากแล้ว! กรุณารีบไป!
dialogsFail.tw: 還沒幫我找到嗎？可以快一點幫我找嗎？真的很急！！
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn đã tìm thấy nó chưa? Chúng tôi không có nhiều thời gian! Xin hãy nhanh lên!

name.cns: 英雄的足迹 - 守护者
name.th: ผู้สืบทอดวีรบุรุษ - Guardian
name.tw: 英雄的繼任者 - 守護者

description.en: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Mark of the Hero and the Venel heart to the Ranger Guardian, Kailreard, in Guardiane.
description.ar: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Mark of the Hero and the Venel heart to the Ranger Guardian, Kailreard, in Guardiane.
description.br: Vá encontrar o guardião Jester Kailreard de Guardiane. Mas antes disso você deve conseguir o coração do Guardião Venel na Sala de Guardiane.
description.cns: 请你去<圣堂>找<卡伊雷雅德>，找到他之前你要先去<守护之室>与<贝纳卡度温>对战才行。
description.de: Besiege Venel Guardian und erbeute das Venel Heart. Bring anschließend das Mark of Hero und das Venel Heart zu Ranger Wächter Kailreard in Guardiane.
description.fi: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Mark of the Hero and the Venel heart to the Ranger Guardian, Kailreard, in Guardiane.
description.fil: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Mark of the Hero and the Venel heart to the Ranger Guardian, Kailreard, in Guardiane.
description.fr: Vaincre Venel et ramener son cœur à la Gardienne des Rangers, Kailreard.
description.id: Kalahkan Venel Guardian, dan berikan Mark of the Hero dan Venel heart ke Ranger Guardian, Kailreard, di Guardiane.
description.it: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Mark of the Hero and the Venel heart to the Ranger Guardian, Kailreard, in Guardiane.
description.jp: ＜ガルディア＞のレンジャー守護者＜カイレアド＞の元に行こう。ただその前に、＜守護者の部屋＞にいる守護精霊＜べネルガーディアン＞と対決し、勝たなきゃいけない。
description.kr: 베넬가디언을 처치하고, 영웅의 증표와 베넬의 심장을 가르디안에 있는 레인저 수호자 카일레아드에게 전달하세요.
description.nl: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Mark of the Hero and the Venel heart to the Ranger Guardian, Kailreard, in Guardiane.
description.pl: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Mark of the Hero and the Venel heart to the Ranger Guardian, Kailreard, in Guardiane.
description.ru: Нужно победить Виндигго и принести его сердце вместе со знаком героя в Гардиану Калиарде, хранительнице стрелков.
description.sp: Derrota al Guardián Venel y entrega la Marca del Héroe y el Corazón de Venel a la Guardiana Ranger, Kailreard, en Guardiane.
description.sw: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Mark of the Hero and the Venel heart to the Ranger Guardian, Kailreard, in Guardiane.
description.th: กำจัด Venel Guardian และส่ง Mark of the Hero และ Venel Heart ไปให้กับ Ranger Guardian ชื่อ Kailreard ใน Guardiane
description.tw: 請你去守護者祭壇找卡伊雷雅德，找到他之前你要先去守護者之室與貝納卡度溫對戰才行。
description.vi: Đánh bại Venel Guardian, và giao Dấu ấn Anh hùng và trái tim Venel cho Ranger Guardian, Kailreard, trong Guardiane.

dialogsBegin.en: Great job, Acrobat. For the final leg of your journey, you must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.ar: Great job, Acrobat. For the final leg of your journey, you must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.br: Ótimo trabalho, Acrobata. Para a etapa final de sua jornada, você deve enfrentar o $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.cns: 做得真棒，我的弓箭手。请以猎杀$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$来结束你的旅程吧。
dialogsBegin.de: Gut gemacht, Acrobat. Für die letzte Etappe deiner Reise musst du dich dem $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ stellen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Great job, Acrobat. For the final leg of your journey, you must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fil: Great job, Acrobat. For the final leg of your journey, you must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je peux maintenant te confier le Sceau des Héros, qui confirme que tu as relevé avec succès tous les défis qui se sont présentés. Mais il te faut encore tuer $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.id: Kerja bagus, Acrobat. Untuk babak terakhir perjalananmu, kamu harus menghadapi $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.it: Great job, Acrobat. For the final leg of your journey, you must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.jp: これから守護者に会ってください。そして、これを守護者に伝えてください。ただし、守護者に会う前にひとつ、やらねばならないことがあります。
dialogsBegin.kr: 잘하셨어요, 아크로뱃. 이제 여정의 마지막 단계군요. $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$에 맞서야 합니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Great job, Acrobat. For the final leg of your journey, you must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.pl: Great job, Acrobat. For the final leg of your journey, you must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.ru: Отлично. Твоя судьба скоро решится. Но не здесь, а в Гардиане, где тебя ждёт $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.sp: Gran trabajo, Acrobat. En la prueba final, debes enfrentarte al $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.sw: Great job, Acrobat. For the final leg of your journey, you must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.th: ดีมาก Acrobat สำหรับงานชิ้นสุดท้ายของการผจญภัย คุณต้องเผชิญหน้ากับ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$
dialogsBegin.tw: 幹得好雜技師 在旅程的最後一站，你必需面對 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$。
dialogsBegin.vi: Làm tốt lắm, Acrobat. Đối với chặng cuối cùng của hành trình, bạn phải đối đầu với $ QUEST_END_KILL_NAME $.

dialogsBegin.en: The will of the heroes is preserved in the Room of the Guardian in Guardiane. This is where you will find the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.ar: The will of the heroes is preserved in the Room of the Guardian in Guardiane. This is where you will find the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.br: A vontade dos heróis é preservada na Sala do Guardião em Guardiane. É lá que você encontrará o $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.cns: 英雄的意志一直留存于圣堂的守护之室。你将会在那找到 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$。
dialogsBegin.de: Der Raum des Wächters in Guardiane birgt den letzten Willen der Helden. Dort findest du auch den $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fi: The will of the heroes is preserved in the Room of the Guardian in Guardiane. This is where you will find the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fil: The will of the heroes is preserved in the Room of the Guardian in Guardiane. This is where you will find the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fr: Au sud de Darkon 3, à Gardiane, se trouve un lieu appelé la Chambre du Gardien. Tu y trouveras $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.id: Surat wasiat para pahlawan disimpan di Room of the Guardian di Guardiane. Di sinilah kamu akan menemukan $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.it: The will of the heroes is preserved in the Room of the Guardian in Guardiane. This is where you will find the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.jp: ＜ガルディア＞には＜守護者の部屋＞というのがあります。ここに$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$があります。
dialogsBegin.kr: 가르디안에는 영웅들의 의지를 수호하고 있는 수호자의 방이란 것이 있죠. 이곳에서 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$에 맞서야 합니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: The will of the heroes is preserved in the Room of the Guardian in Guardiane. This is where you will find the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.pl: The will of the heroes is preserved in the Room of the Guardian in Guardiane. This is where you will find the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.ru: The will of the heroes is preserved in the Room of the Guardian in Guardiane. This is where you will find the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.sp: La voluntad de los héroes se conserva en la Sala del Guardián en Guardiane. Allí es donde encontrarás al $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.sw: The will of the heroes is preserved in the Room of the Guardian in Guardiane. This is where you will find the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.th: เจตจำนงของฮีโร่ยังคงอยู่ในห้องของผู้พิทักษ์ใน Guardiane นี่คือที่ที่คุณจะได้พบกับ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$
dialogsBegin.tw: 英雄的意志被保存在守護者祭壇的守護者之室裡。你可以在此處找到 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$。
dialogsBegin.vi: Ý chí của các anh hùng được lưu giữ trong Căn phòng của Guardian ở Guardiane. Đây là nơi bạn sẽ tìm thấy $ QUEST_END_KILL_NAME $.

dialogsBegin.en: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ is a soul that protects the will of the heroes. Defeat him, and obtain the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.ar: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ is a soul that protects the will of the heroes. Defeat him, and obtain the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.br: O $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ é uma alma que protege a vontade dos heróis. Derrote-o e obtenha o $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.cns: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 是一直保卫着英雄意志的灵魂。请击败他，获取$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$。
dialogsBegin.de: Der $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ist eine Seele, die den Willen der Helden schützt. Besiege ihn, und du erhältst das $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fi: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ is a soul that protects the will of the heroes. Defeat him, and obtain the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fil: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ is a soul that protects the will of the heroes. Defeat him, and obtain the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il te faut y pénétrer et vaincre $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$. Ta dernière épreuve sera de lui prendre son $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ !
dialogsBegin.id: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ adalah jiwa yang melindungi surat wasiat para pahlawan. Kalahkan dia, dan dapatkan $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.it: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ is a soul that protects the will of the heroes. Defeat him, and obtain the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.jp: ここに＜ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$＞という守護精霊がいます。英雄の意志を守っている精霊ですが、この精霊と戦って、その精霊のハート＜$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$＞を持ってきてください。
dialogsBegin.kr: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$... 영웅들의 의지를 지키는 정령인데, 이 정령을 처치하고 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$를 획득하세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ is a soul that protects the will of the heroes. Defeat him, and obtain the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.pl: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ is a soul that protects the will of the heroes. Defeat him, and obtain the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.ru: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ is a soul that protects the will of the heroes. Defeat him, and obtain the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.sp: El $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ es un alma que protege la voluntad de los héroes. Derrótalo y consigue el $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.sw: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ is a soul that protects the will of the heroes. Defeat him, and obtain the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.th: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ เป็นวิญญาณที่ปกป้องเจตจำนงของเหล่าฮีโร่ เอาชนะเขา และรับ $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$
dialogsBegin.tw: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$是守護英雄意志的靈魂。擊敗他可獲得 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$。
dialogsBegin.vi: $ QUEST_END_KILL_NAME $ là linh hồn bảo vệ ý chí của các anh hùng. Đánh bại anh ta và nhận $ QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME $.

dialogsBegin.en: Take this. It is a Mark of the Hero. Once you have confronted the Venel Guardian and retrieved the Venel Heart, bring both of these to the Ranger Guardian, Kailreard.
dialogsBegin.ar: Take this. It is a Mark of the Hero. Once you have confronted the Venel Guardian and retrieved the Venel Heart, bring both of these to the Ranger Guardian, Kailreard.
dialogsBegin.br: O guardião somente o reconhecerá como um Ranger se você conseguir este coração. Portanto, este é o último teste para se tornar um Ranger. Você precisa passar por ele.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你得到这个心脏的话，他一定会承认你做游侠，也就是说这是给你的最后一个考验了。
dialogsBegin.de: Nimm dieses Mark of Hero. Nun erbeute das Venel Heart vom Venel Guardian. Bring anschließend beide Gegenstände zu Ranger Wächter Kailreard. Das ist deine letzte Prüfung, Acrobat.
dialogsBegin.fi: Take this. It is a Mark of the Hero. Once you have confronted the Venel Guardian and retrieved the Venel Heart, bring both of these to the Ranger Guardian, Kailreard.
dialogsBegin.fil: Take this. It is a Mark of the Hero. Once you have confronted the Venel Guardian and retrieved the Venel Heart, bring both of these to the Ranger Guardian, Kailreard.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu pourras alors te présenter à la Gardienne des Rangers, Kailreard.
dialogsBegin.id: Ambil ini. Itu adalah Mark of the Hero. Setelah kamu menghadapi Venel Guardian dan mengambil Venel Heart, bawa keduanya ke Ranger Guardian, Kailreard.
dialogsBegin.it: Take this. It is a Mark of the Hero. Once you have confronted the Venel Guardian and retrieved the Venel Heart, bring both of these to the Ranger Guardian, Kailreard.
dialogsBegin.jp: この＜ヴェネルハート＞が得られなければ、守護者からレンジャーとして認めてもらうことが出来ません。つまり、レンジャーになるための最後の試練だと言えます。必ず成し遂げてください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 여기, 영웅의 증표를 받으세요. 베넬가디언과 싸워 베넬의 심장을 손에 넣고 나면, 그 심장과 이 영웅의 증표를 레인저 수호자 카일레아드에게 전달하세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Take this. It is a Mark of the Hero. Once you have confronted the Venel Guardian and retrieved the Venel Heart, bring both of these to the Ranger Guardian, Kailreard.
dialogsBegin.pl: Take this. It is a Mark of the Hero. Once you have confronted the Venel Guardian and retrieved the Venel Heart, bring both of these to the Ranger Guardian, Kailreard.
dialogsBegin.ru: Вот, возьми. Это знак героя. Когда убьешь Виндигго, отнеси его сердце и этот знак Калиарде, хранительнице стрелков. Как думаешь, по плечу тебе такое испытание?
dialogsBegin.sp: Toma esto. Es una Marca del Héroe. Una vez que hayas derrotado al Guardián Venel y hayas recuperado el Corazón de Venel, entrégale ambos a la Guardiana Ranger, Kailreard.
dialogsBegin.sw: Take this. It is a Mark of the Hero. Once you have confronted the Venel Guardian and retrieved the Venel Heart, bring both of these to the Ranger Guardian, Kailreard.
dialogsBegin.th: เอานี่ไป มันคือ Mark of the Hero เมื่อคุณได้เผชิญหน้า Venel Guardian และเอา Venel Heart กลับคืนมาแล้ว ให้นำทั้งคู่ไปให้ Ranger Guardian ชื่อ Kailreard
dialogsBegin.tw: 你得到這個心臟的話，他一定會承認你做浪人，也就是說這是給你的最後一個考驗了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Hãy làm việc này. Đó là một Dấu ấn của Anh hùng. Khi bạn đã đối mặt với Venel Guardian và lấy lại Venel Heart, hãy mang cả hai thứ này đến Ranger Guardian, Kailreard.

dialogsAccept.en: I wish you luck, Acrobat.
dialogsAccept.ar: I wish you luck, Acrobat.
dialogsAccept.br: Eu lhe desejo sorte, Acrobata.
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你好运，弓箭手
dialogsAccept.de: Ich wünsche dir Glück, Acrobat.
dialogsAccept.fi: I wish you luck, Acrobat.
dialogsAccept.fil: I wish you luck, Acrobat.
dialogsAccept.fr: Je te souhaite que la chance de Kerenen t'accompagne !
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga berhasil, Acrobat.
dialogsAccept.it: I wish you luck, Acrobat.
dialogsAccept.jp: アクロバットあなたに＜カエネン＞のご加護がありますように。
dialogsAccept.kr: 행운을 빌어요, 아크로뱃.
dialogsAccept.nl: I wish you luck, Acrobat.
dialogsAccept.pl: I wish you luck, Acrobat.
dialogsAccept.ru: I wish you luck, Acrobat.
dialogsAccept.sp: Te deseo suerte, Acrobat.
dialogsAccept.sw: I wish you luck, Acrobat.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้โชคดี Acrobat
dialogsAccept.tw: 祝你好運，雜技師。
dialogsAccept.vi: Chúc may mắn, Acrobat.

dialogsDecline.en: This is the final test to becoming a successor of the Jester Hero. You can't give up now. Speak with me again when you are ready to continue.
dialogsDecline.ar: This is the final test to becoming a successor of the Jester Hero. You can't give up now. Speak with me again when you are ready to continue.
dialogsDecline.br: Este é o teste final para se tornar um sucessor do Herói Jester. Você não pode desistir agora. Fale comigo novamente quando estiver pronto(a) para continuar.
dialogsDecline.cns: 这是成为暗杀的最后一步，现在放弃太可惜了。准备好后再来找我吧
dialogsDecline.de: Nur eine Prüfung steht noch aus. Wäre es nicht schade, wenn du jetzt aufgibst? Komm wieder wenn du bereit bist.
dialogsDecline.fi: This is the final test to becoming a successor of the Jester Hero. You can't give up now. Speak with me again when you are ready to continue.
dialogsDecline.fil: This is the final test to becoming a successor of the Jester Hero. You can't give up now. Speak with me again when you are ready to continue.
dialogsDecline.fr: Après avoir traversé tant d'épreuves, tu es sur le point d'abandonner ? Ceci est la dernière étape, réfléchis bien...
dialogsDecline.id: Ini adalah ujian terakhir untuk menjadi penerus Jester Hero. Kamu tidak boleh menyerah sekarang. Bicaralah denganku lagi ketika kamu sudah siap untuk melanjutkan.
dialogsDecline.it: This is the final test to becoming a successor of the Jester Hero. You can't give up now. Speak with me again when you are ready to continue.
dialogsDecline.jp: ここまできてあきらめるのならば、今まで歩んできた道は何だったのですか？　もう一度よくご自分の心に聞いてみて下さい。
dialogsDecline.kr: 이건 제스터 영웅의 후계자가 되기 위한 마지막 시험이라고요. 여기서 포기할 순 없죠. 계속할 준비가 되었다면 다시 말씀하세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: This is the final test to becoming a successor of the Jester Hero. You can't give up now. Speak with me again when you are ready to continue.
dialogsDecline.pl: This is the final test to becoming a successor of the Jester Hero. You can't give up now. Speak with me again when you are ready to continue.
dialogsDecline.ru: Это последнее испытание, которое покажет, быть тебе шутом или нет. Сдаваться поздно. Подготовься к сражению и скажи об этом мне.
dialogsDecline.sp: Esta es la prueba final para convertirte en Sucesor del Héroe Jester. No te puedes rendir ahora. Habla conmigo cuando estés listo para continuar.
dialogsDecline.sw: This is the final test to becoming a successor of the Jester Hero. You can't give up now. Speak with me again when you are ready to continue.
dialogsDecline.th: นี่คือการทดสอบครั้งสุดท้ายที่จะกลายเป็นทายาทของ Jester Hero คุณไม่สามารถยอมแพ้ได้ในตอนนี้ พูดกับฉันอีกครั้งเมื่อคุณพร้อมที่จะดำเนินการต่อ
dialogsDecline.tw: 這是成為操偶師英雄繼任者的最後考驗。你現在不能放棄。當你準備好繼續時，再次與我交談。
dialogsDecline.vi: Đây là bài kiểm tra cuối cùng để trở thành người kế nhiệm của Jester Hero. Bạn không thể từ bỏ bây giờ. Nói chuyện lại với tôi khi bạn sẵn sàng tiếp tục.

dialogsComplete.en: Congratulations, young Acrobat. I've heard many great things about you. You've completed the final test. You will now become a Successor of the Ranger Hero!
dialogsComplete.ar: Congratulations, young Acrobat. I've heard many great things about you. You've completed the final test. You will now become a Successor of the Ranger Hero!
dialogsComplete.br: Parabéns, jovem Acrobata. Eu ouvi muitas coisas boas sobre você. Você passou no último teste. Agora eu nomeio você um sucessor do herói Ranger!
dialogsComplete.cns: 欢迎你来到这里～你已经通过最后一个考验了，你现在成为真正的游侠了！
dialogsComplete.de: Meinen Glückwunsch, junger Acrobat. Ich hörte, du hast Großes vollbracht. Du hast den die letzte Prüfung gemeistert. Nun besteht kein Zweifel mehr; du bist der Nachfolger des Ranger Helden.
dialogsComplete.fi: Congratulations, young Acrobat. I've heard many great things about you. You've completed the final test. You will now become a Successor of the Ranger Hero!
dialogsComplete.fil: Congratulations, young Acrobat. I've heard many great things about you. You've completed the final test. You will now become a Successor of the Ranger Hero!
dialogsComplete.fr: Bienvenue à Gardiane. Tu as réussi brillamment la dernière épreuve et mérites désormais d'être l'un des successeurs du Héros des Rangers.
dialogsComplete.id: Selamat, Acrobat muda. Aku telah mendengar banyak hal hebat tentangmu. Kamu telah menyelesaikan ujian akhir. Kamu sekarang akan menjadi Successor of the Ranger Hero!
dialogsComplete.it: Congratulations, young Acrobat. I've heard many great things about you. You've completed the final test. You will now become a Successor of the Ranger Hero!
dialogsComplete.jp: よくぞここへ辿りつきました、レンジャーの後継者よ。　最後の試練を乗り越えました。これからあなたをレンジャーの後継者とし、正式に任命します。
dialogsComplete.kr: 축하합니다, 젊은 아크로뱃. 당신에 대해 좋은 소문을 많이 들었지요. 마지막 시험을 끝내셨습니다. 이제 레인저 영웅의 계승자가 되시겠군요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Congratulations, young Acrobat. I've heard many great things about you. You've completed the final test. You will now become a Successor of the Ranger Hero!
dialogsComplete.pl: Congratulations, young Acrobat. I've heard many great things about you. You've completed the final test. You will now become a Successor of the Ranger Hero!
dialogsComplete.ru: Поздравляю. Не зря тебя так хвалили. Последнее испытание позади. Быть тебе стрелком!
dialogsComplete.sp: Felicidades, joven Acrobat. He escuchado muchas cosas buenas de ti. Has completado la prueba final. ¡Ahora te convertirás en Sucesor del Héroe Ranger!
dialogsComplete.sw: Congratulations, young Acrobat. I've heard many great things about you. You've completed the final test. You will now become a Successor of the Ranger Hero!
dialogsComplete.th: ขอแสดงความยินดี Acrobat หนุ่ม ฉันเคยได้ยินสิ่งดีๆ มากมายเกี่ยวกับคุณ คุณได้ทำการทดสอบครั้งสุดท้ายแล้ว ตอนนี้คุณจะกลายเป็นผู้สืบทอดตำแหน่งของ Ranger Hero!
dialogsComplete.tw: 歡迎你來到這裡～你已經通過最後一個考驗了，你現在成為真正的浪人了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Xin chúc mừng, Acrobat trẻ. Tôi đã nghe nhiều điều tuyệt vời về bạn. Bạn đã hoàn thành bài kiểm tra cuối cùng. Bây giờ bạn sẽ trở thành Người kế vị của Ranger Hero!

dialogsComplete.en: Wise Hynan! This Acrobat wishes to follow your path! Grant them your blessing and power, Ranger Hero!
dialogsComplete.ar: Wise Hynan! This Acrobat wishes to follow your path! Grant them your blessing and power, Ranger Hero!
dialogsComplete.br: Hynan! Sua vontade! Eis aqui alguém que quer seguir seus passos. Por favor, os abençoe e lhes dê coragem! Ranger!
dialogsComplete.cns: 游侠的英雄海楠啊～这里有一位勇士要跟随你的后迹，请赐给他祝福的神力吧！
dialogsComplete.de: Oh weiser Hynan! Dieser Acrobat möchte in deine Fußstapfen treten. Gewähre ihnen deinen Segen und deine Kraft, oh Held der Ranger!
dialogsComplete.fi: Wise Hynan! This Acrobat wishes to follow your path! Grant them your blessing and power, Ranger Hero!
dialogsComplete.fil: Wise Hynan! This Acrobat wishes to follow your path! Grant them your blessing and power, Ranger Hero!
dialogsComplete.fr: Hynan, puisses-tu bénir et soutenir en tout temps cette personne ici qui dédie sa vie à ta volonté !
dialogsComplete.id: Wise Hynan! Acrobat ini ingin mengikuti jalanmu! Berikan mereka berkat dan kekuatanmu, Ranger Hero!
dialogsComplete.it: Wise Hynan! This Acrobat wishes to follow your path! Grant them your blessing and power, Ranger Hero!
dialogsComplete.jp: ＜ハイナン＞様、ここにあなたの魂に従おうとしている者がいます。この人に祝福と勇気を与えてください。レンジャーに栄光あれ！
dialogsComplete.kr: 현명한 하이난이시여! 이 아크로뱃이 당신의 길을 따르고자 합니다! 레인저 영웅의 축복과 힘을 내려주소서!
dialogsComplete.nl: Wise Hynan! This Acrobat wishes to follow your path! Grant them your blessing and power, Ranger Hero!
dialogsComplete.pl: Wise Hynan! This Acrobat wishes to follow your path! Grant them your blessing and power, Ranger Hero!
dialogsComplete.ru: О, не знающий промаха Робин Тель! Взгляни на акробата, что желает пойти по твоим стопам! Благослови его и надели отвагой!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Sabio Hynan! ¡Este Acrobat desea seguir tu camino! ¡Concédele tu bendición y tu poder, Héroe Ranger!
dialogsComplete.sw: Wise Hynan! This Acrobat wishes to follow your path! Grant them your blessing and power, Ranger Hero!
dialogsComplete.th: Hynan ผู้ปราดเปรื่อง! Acrobat ผู้นี้มีความประสงค์ที่จะปฏิบัติตามเส้นทางของคุณ! โปรดให้พรและอำนาจแก่พวกเขา Ranger Hero!
dialogsComplete.tw: 浪人的英雄海楠啊～這裡有一位勇士要跟你的後跡，請賜給他祝福的神力吧！
dialogsComplete.vi: Wise Hynan! Acrobat này mong muốn đi theo con đường của bạn! Ban cho họ phước lành và sức mạnh của bạn, Ranger Hero!

dialogsFail.en: You have not completed the tasks given to you by the Jester Priest. Return to me when you have done so.
dialogsFail.ar: You have not completed the tasks given to you by the Jester Priest. Return to me when you have done so.
dialogsFail.br: Eu acredito que você tenha vindo me ver porque a sacerdotisa lhe enviou. Mas você ainda não completou sua última tarefa. Volte para mim quando tiver feito isso.
dialogsFail.cns: 你还没有完成之前的任务，完成后再来找我吧
dialogsFail.de: Deine Aufgaben vom Jester Priester sind noch nicht erfüllt. Kehre zurück, sobald du dich als würdig erwiesen hast.
dialogsFail.fi: You have not completed the tasks given to you by the Jester Priest. Return to me when you have done so.
dialogsFail.fil: You have not completed the tasks given to you by the Jester Priest. Return to me when you have done so.
dialogsFail.fr: Seuls ceux reconnus comme successeurs de Kerenen sont admis ici. Poursuis ton apprentissage...
dialogsFail.id: Kamu belum menyelesaikan tugas yang diberikan oleh Jester Priest. Kembalilah padaku ketika kamu sudah selesai.
dialogsFail.it: You have not completed the tasks given to you by the Jester Priest. Return to me when you have done so.
dialogsFail.jp: 私を尋ねて来たということは、司祭には会ったのですね？　あなたには最後の試練が残されているはずです。
dialogsFail.kr: 제스터 사제가 준 임무를 아직 완수하지 않으셨군요. 전부 끝나면 다시 오세요.
dialogsFail.nl: You have not completed the tasks given to you by the Jester Priest. Return to me when you have done so.
dialogsFail.pl: You have not completed the tasks given to you by the Jester Priest. Return to me when you have done so.
dialogsFail.ru: You have not completed the tasks given to you by the Jester Priest. Return to me when you have done so.
dialogsFail.sp: No has completado las tareas que te asignó la Sacerdotisa Jester. Vuelve cuando las hayas terminado.
dialogsFail.sw: You have not completed the tasks given to you by the Jester Priest. Return to me when you have done so.
dialogsFail.th: คุณยังไม่เสร็จสิ้นภารกิจที่ Jester Priest มอบให้คุณ กลับมาหาฉันเมื่อคุณได้ทำภารกิจเรียบร้อยแล้ว
dialogsFail.tw: 你還沒有完成操偶師牧師交給你的任務。完成後返回給我。
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn chưa hoàn thành các nhiệm vụ mà Jester Priest giao cho bạn. Hãy quay trở lại tôi khi bạn đã hoàn thành.

dialogsBegin.en: I've been training up here so long. I feel that I'm so close to achieving a heightened level of power, but there is something missing…
dialogsBegin.ar: I've been training up here so long. I feel that I'm so close to achieving a heightened level of power, but there is something missing…
dialogsBegin.br: Eu tenho treinado aqui há tanto tempo. Sinto que estou tão perto de alcançar um nível superior de poder, mas falta algo…
dialogsBegin.cns: 我在这上面训练了这么久。我觉得我的力量达到了更高水平了，但还缺少一些东西......
dialogsBegin.de: Ich habe so lange hier oben trainiert. Ich fühle, dass ich so kurz davor bin, ein höheres Maß an Macht zu erlangen, aber es fehlt etwas...
dialogsBegin.fi: I've been training up here so long. I feel that I'm so close to achieving a heightened level of power, but there is something missing…
dialogsBegin.fil: I've been training up here so long. I feel that I'm so close to achieving a heightened level of power, but there is something missing…
dialogsBegin.fr: Maintenant je peux vous parler franchement.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya sudah berlatih di sini begitu lama. Saya merasa bahwa saya sangat dekat untuk mencapai tingkat kekuatan yang tinggi, tetapi ada sesuatu yang hilang ...
dialogsBegin.it: I've been training up here so long. I feel that I'm so close to achieving a heightened level of power, but there is something missing…
dialogsBegin.jp: なるほど。君は英雄を探しているとのことだが私は残念ながら英雄の生まれ変わりかどうかが自信がない。いくら修行をしても悟りが開けぬのだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 전 오랜 세월 수행해 왔습니다. 곧 더 높은 경지에 이를 수 있을 것만 같은데... 뭔가가 빠진 기분이 들어요...
dialogsBegin.nl: I've been training up here so long. I feel that I'm so close to achieving a heightened level of power, but there is something missing…
dialogsBegin.pl: I've been training up here so long. I feel that I'm so close to achieving a heightened level of power, but there is something missing…
dialogsBegin.ru: I've been training up here so long. I feel that I'm so close to achieving a heightened level of power, but there is something missing…
dialogsBegin.sp: He estado entrenando aquí durante mucho tiempo. Siento que estoy muy cerca de alcanzar un nivel de poder superior, pero falta algo...
dialogsBegin.sw: I've been training up here so long. I feel that I'm so close to achieving a heightened level of power, but there is something missing…
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันฝึกซ้อมที่นี่มานานแล้ว ฉันรู้สึกว่าฉันใกล้บรรลุระดับพลังที่เพิ่มสูงขึ้น แต่มีบางอย่างที่หายไป
dialogsBegin.tw: 呼…現在我可以向你傾訴我的煩惱了。事實上這麼長的事情，我只是為了一件事情在修練。但是不管我怎麼修練，都還是無法達到領悟的境界。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đã tập luyện ở đây rất lâu. Tôi đã gần đạt được mức sức mạnh tối cao, nhưng cảm thấy vẫn còn thiếu một thứ gì đó…

dialogsBegin.en: I don't know why… I just feel like there is something missing… and this "thing" is keeping me from realizing my true inner potential.
dialogsBegin.ar: I don't know why… I just feel like there is something missing… and this "thing" is keeping me from realizing my true inner potential.
dialogsBegin.br: Não sei por que... apenas sinto que falta alguma coisa... e essa "coisa" está me impedindo de encontrar meu verdadeiro potencial interior.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我不知道为什么......我只是觉得缺少一些东西......而这个 "东西 "使我无法激发我真正的内在潜力。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich weiß nicht warum... Ich habe einfach das Gefühl, dass etwas fehlt... und dieses "Ding" hält mich davon ab, mein wahres inneres Potenzial zu verwirklichen.
dialogsBegin.fi: I don't know why… I just feel like there is something missing… and this "thing" is keeping me from realizing my true inner potential.
dialogsBegin.fil: I don't know why… I just feel like there is something missing… and this "thing" is keeping me from realizing my true inner potential.
dialogsBegin.fr: Quelque chose d'important, de grave, se trame et nous allons tous voir si notre entrainement a été assez intensif.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya tidak tahu mengapa ... Saya hanya merasa ada sesuatu yang hilang ... dan "hal" ini membuat saya tidak menyadari potensi batin saya yang sebenarnya.
dialogsBegin.it: I don't know why… I just feel like there is something missing… and this "thing" is keeping me from realizing my true inner potential.
dialogsBegin.jp: 何か重要なことを見落としているのかもしれない。とはいえ、もし私が英雄の生まれ変わりであるならば、このようなことを尋ねるわけにもいかん。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이유를 모르겠지만... 중요한 게 빠져 있는 기분이랄까요. 이 "무언가"가 제 안에 잠든 진짜 힘이 깨어나지 못하게 막고 있어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I don't know why… I just feel like there is something missing… and this "thing" is keeping me from realizing my true inner potential.
dialogsBegin.pl: I don't know why… I just feel like there is something missing… and this "thing" is keeping me from realizing my true inner potential.
dialogsBegin.ru: I don't know why… I just feel like there is something missing… and this "thing" is keeping me from realizing my true inner potential.
dialogsBegin.sp: No sé por qué... pero siento que falta algo... y esa "cosa" me impide alcanzar mi verdadero potencial interior.
dialogsBegin.sw: I don't know why… I just feel like there is something missing… and this "thing" is keeping me from realizing my true inner potential.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันไม่รู้ว่าทำไม ฉันแค่รู้สึกว่ามีบางอย่างหายไป ... และ "สิ่งนี้" ทำให้ฉันตระหนักถึงศักยภาพที่แท้จริงของฉัน
dialogsBegin.tw: 根本就不知道理由…我覺得好像忘了什麼重要的事情。以前的我所擁有，但現在卻沒有的某個東西…
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi không biết lý do tại sao… Tôi chỉ cảm thấy như thiếu thiếu một cái gì đó… và “thứ” này đang ngăn tôi nhận ra tiềm năng thực sự ẩn chứa bên trong.

dialogsBegin.en: Could you please seek my mentor (Billposter Guardian) Capafe and explain my dilemma. He will surely understand…
dialogsBegin.ar: Could you please seek my mentor (Billposter Guardian) Capafe and explain my dilemma. He will surely understand…
dialogsBegin.br: Você poderia, por favor, procurar minha mentora Capafe e explicar meu dilema. Com certeza ela vai entender...
dialogsBegin.cns: 你能不能找我的导师（暴力技师守护使者）卡帕菲，并向他阐述我的困境。他一定会理解的...
dialogsBegin.de: Könnten Du  bitte meinen Mentor (Billposter Wächter) Capafe aufsuchen und ihm mein Dilemma erklären. Er wird es sicher verstehen...
dialogsBegin.fi: Could you please seek my mentor (Billposter Guardian) Capafe and explain my dilemma. He will surely understand…
dialogsBegin.fil: Could you please seek my mentor (Billposter Guardian) Capafe and explain my dilemma. He will surely understand…
dialogsBegin.fr: Pourriez-vous parler de ça à Capafe ? Elle pourra peut-être nous dire ce qui ne va pas en Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.id: Bisakah Anda mencari mentor saya (Billposter Guardian) Capafe dan menjelaskan dilema saya. Dia pasti akan mengerti ...
dialogsBegin.it: Could you please seek my mentor (Billposter Guardian) Capafe and explain my dilemma. He will surely understand…
dialogsBegin.jp: そこでだ、南端にいるカペーペに君の悩みとして打ち明け、アドバイスをもらえないだろうか？
dialogsBegin.kr: (빌포스터 수호자) 카파페 스승님께 제 고민을 전해주실 수 있을까요? 분명 이해해 주실 텐데...
dialogsBegin.nl: Could you please seek my mentor (Billposter Guardian) Capafe and explain my dilemma. He will surely understand…
dialogsBegin.pl: Could you please seek my mentor (Billposter Guardian) Capafe and explain my dilemma. He will surely understand…
dialogsBegin.ru: Could you please seek my mentor (Billposter Guardian) Capafe and explain my dilemma. He will surely understand…
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Podrías ir a buscar a mi mentora, la Guardiana Billposter Capafe, y explicarle mi dilema? Seguro que lo entenderá...
dialogsBegin.sw: Could you please seek my mentor (Billposter Guardian) Capafe and explain my dilemma. He will surely understand…
dialogsBegin.th: คุณช่วยไปหาที่ปรึกษาของฉัน (Billposter Guardian) Capafe และบอกถึงอาการกลืนไม่เข้าคายไม่ออกของฉันได้ไหม เขาอาจจะเข้าใจ
dialogsBegin.tw: 所以，可以請你將我的苦惱轉達給位於得肯第三區南部的卡班沛，然後詢問他有什麼建議嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có thể vui lòng tìm người cố vấn của tôi (Billposter Guardian) Capafe và giải thích tình huống khó xử của tôi. Anh ấy chắc chắn sẽ hiểu…

dialogsAccept.en: Thank you! Please get advice from (Billposter Guardian) Capafe.
dialogsAccept.ar: Thank you! Please get advice from (Billposter Guardian) Capafe.
dialogsAccept.br: Obrigada! Por favor, obtenha os conselhos da Guardiã Billposter, Capafe.
dialogsAccept.cns: 谢谢！请从（暴力技师守护使者）卡帕菲那里得到一些建议。
dialogsAccept.de: Ich danke Dir! Bitte lass Dich von (Billposter Guardian) Capafe beraten.
dialogsAccept.fi: Thank you! Please get advice from (Billposter Guardian) Capafe.
dialogsAccept.fil: Thank you! Please get advice from (Billposter Guardian) Capafe.
dialogsAccept.fr: Merci, allez voir Capafe et ne traînez pas en route. J'ai un mauvais pressentiment.
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih! Silakan dapatkan saran dari (Billposter Guardian) Capafe.
dialogsAccept.it: Thank you! Please get advice from (Billposter Guardian) Capafe.
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとう。私はこのまま修行を続けることにする。頼んだぞ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 정말 고마워요! (빌포스터 수호자) 카파페 스승님께 조언을 구해 주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Thank you! Please get advice from (Billposter Guardian) Capafe.
dialogsAccept.pl: Thank you! Please get advice from (Billposter Guardian) Capafe.
dialogsAccept.ru: Thank you! Please get advice from (Billposter Guardian) Capafe.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Gracias! Pídele consejo a la Guardiana Billposter Capafe.
dialogsAccept.sw: Thank you! Please get advice from (Billposter Guardian) Capafe.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอบคุณ! โปรดรับคำแนะนำจาก (Billposter Guardian) Capafe
dialogsAccept.tw: 真的是很謝謝你！請你去向卡班沛問一下建議吧。
dialogsAccept.vi: Cảm ơn bạn! Vui lòng nhận lời khuyên từ (Billposter Guardian) Capafe.

dialogsDecline.en: You can't possibly stop now. You play an important role in things to come!
dialogsDecline.ar: You can't possibly stop now. You play an important role in things to come!
dialogsDecline.br: Depois de conseguir minha confiança, já está pronto(a) para perdê-la?!
dialogsDecline.cns: 你不能现在就停下来。你的行为将会影响未来的事情!
dialogsDecline.de: Du kannst jetzt unmöglich aufhören. Du spielst eine wichtige Rolle für die Zukunft!
dialogsDecline.fi: You can't possibly stop now. You play an important role in things to come!
dialogsDecline.fil: You can't possibly stop now. You play an important role in things to come!
dialogsDecline.fr: Abandonnez maintenant et vous ne saurez jamais le fin mot de l'histoire.
dialogsDecline.id: Anda tidak mungkin berhenti sekarang. Anda memainkan peran penting dalam hal-hal yang akan datang!
dialogsDecline.it: You can't possibly stop now. You play an important role in things to come!
dialogsDecline.jp: あなたはおそらく今やめることはできません。君の役目は重要だからな！
dialogsDecline.kr: 이젠 멈출 수 없습니다. 당신은 앞으로 벌어질 일에서 중요한 역할을 맡을 사람이니까요!
dialogsDecline.nl: You can't possibly stop now. You play an important role in things to come!
dialogsDecline.pl: You can't possibly stop now. You play an important role in things to come!
dialogsDecline.ru: You can't possibly stop now. You play an important role in things to come!
dialogsDecline.sp: No te puedes detener ahora. ¡Tú juegas un papel importante en lo que se avecina!
dialogsDecline.sw: You can't possibly stop now. You play an important role in things to come!
dialogsDecline.th: ตอนนี้คุณไม่สามารถหยุดได้ คุณเป็นคนที่สำคัญที่สุดในสิ่งที่กำลังจะมาถึง!!
dialogsDecline.tw: 你現在不可能停下來。你在未來的事情中扮演著重要的角色！
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn không thể dừng lại bây giờ đâu. Bạn đóng một vai trò quan trọng trong những điều sắp tới!

dialogsComplete.en: Welcome, I have been expecting you.
dialogsComplete.ar: Welcome, I have been expecting you.
dialogsComplete.br: Bem-vindo(a) viajante, as estrelas indicaram a sua chegada.

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.

dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.

dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。

dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.

dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

description.cns: 请你帮我去查一下紫色的剧团。不管去哪里都可以，只要帮我找到线索就好了。
description.de: Bitte untersuche den Altar in lila, bis du ein paar Beweise gefunden hast.
description.fi: Please check the altar until you find out something of importance.
description.fil: Please check the altar until you find out something of importance.
description.fr: Partir à la recherche d'un indice, aux Autels Pourpres de Flaris, Saint Morning et Darkon.
description.id: Tolong periksa altar sampai Kamu menemukan sesuatu yang penting.
