dialogsBegin.en: Hmm... I have some good theories but we are going to need more information about the altar and the Magic Troupe.
dialogsBegin.ar: Hmm... I have some good theories but we are going to need more information about the altar and the Magic Troupe.
dialogsBegin.br: Hmm... Tenho algumas teorias boas, mas precisaremos de mais informações sobre o altar e a Tropa Mágica.
dialogsBegin.cns: Hmm... I have some good theories but we are going to need more information about the altar and the Magic Troupe.
dialogsBegin.de: Hmm ... Ich habe ein paar gute Theorien, aber wir brauchen mehr Informationen über den Altar und die Magische Truppe.
dialogsBegin.fi: Hmm... I have some good theories but we are going to need more information about the altar and the Magic Troupe.
dialogsBegin.fil: Hmm... I have some good theories but we are going to need more information about the altar and the Magic Troupe.
dialogsBegin.fr: Hmm… Il nous faut encore collecter quelques informations sur ce mystérieux symbole et la troupe des Mages Pourpres.
dialogsBegin.id: Hmm.. Aku punya beberapa teori bagus tapi kita akan membutuhkan lebih banyak informasi tentang Altar dan The Magic Troupe.
dialogsBegin.it: Hmm... I have some good theories but we are going to need more information about the altar and the Magic Troupe.
dialogsBegin.jp: ふむ、調査書はすみずみまで読ませてもらったよ。しかし、ここに書かれている＜バイオレットシャドウ・マジシャンズ＞と＜紫闇の祭壇＞に関するもっと詳細な情報が欲しい。残念だがこれだけでは、裏付けにはならない。
dialogsBegin.kr: 흠... 몇 가지 이론이 떠오르긴 하지만, 제단과 마법단에 관한 정보가 더 필요해요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Hmm... I have some good theories but we are going to need more information about the altar and the Magic Troupe.
dialogsBegin.pl: Hmm... I have some good theories but we are going to need more information about the altar and the Magic Troupe.
dialogsBegin.ru: Hmm... I have some good theories but we are going to need more information about the altar and the Magic Troupe.
dialogsBegin.sp: Hmm... Tengo algunas buenas teorías, pero vamos a necesitar más información sobre el altar y los Magos Violetas.
dialogsBegin.sw: Hmm... I have some good theories but we are going to need more information about the altar and the Magic Troupe.
dialogsBegin.th: อืม... ฉันมีทฤษฎีที่ดีอยู่บ้าง แต่เราต้องการข้อมูลเพิ่มเติมเกี่ยวกับแท่นบูชาและคณะละครเวทมนตร์
dialogsBegin.tw: 嗯……我有一些不錯的推論，不過我們還需要更多關於祭壇和魔法團的情報。
dialogsBegin.vi: Hmm .. Tôi có một số giả thuyết hay nhưng chúng ta sẽ cần thêm thông tin về điện thờ và Magic Troupe.

dialogsBegin.en: I think there is something in the altar. I have a strong feeling that we could find something there if we look closely enough.
dialogsBegin.ar: I think there is something in the altar. I have a strong feeling that we could find something there if we look closely enough.
dialogsBegin.br: Acho que há algo no altar... Tenho a impressão de que podemos encontrar algo ali se procurarmos bem.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我觉得祭团那边应该会有一些线索才对，仔细的去找找的话，或许会找的到吧。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich denke da ist etwas in den Altaren... Ich habe die starke Vermutung, dass wir dort ein paar Beweise finden, wenn wir sie gründlich untersuchen.
dialogsBegin.fi: I think there is something in the altar. I have a strong feeling that we could find something there if we look closely enough.
dialogsBegin.fil: I think there is something in the altar. I have a strong feeling that we could find something there if we look closely enough.
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais oui… les Autels Pourpres… Tout est lié ! Il doit forcément y avoir un indice là-bas, il faut enquêter.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku pikir ada sesuatu di altar. Aku memiliki firasat kuat kalau kita dapat menemukan sesuatu di sana jika kita memeriksa lebih dekat.
dialogsBegin.it: I think there is something in the altar. I have a strong feeling that we could find something there if we look closely enough.
dialogsBegin.jp: おそらく＜紫闇の祭壇＞という場所に隠された秘密がありそうだ。きっとそこに行けば、何かしら手がかりがみつかるだろう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 제 짐작으로는, 그 제단이라는 곳에 뭔가 있을 것 같아요. 그곳을 자세히 찾아본다면 단서를 발견할 수 있을 것 같다는 예감이 들어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I think there is something in the altar. I have a strong feeling that we could find something there if we look closely enough.
dialogsBegin.pl: I think there is something in the altar. I have a strong feeling that we could find something there if we look closely enough.
dialogsBegin.ru: Сдается мне, что разгадка скрыта в самом алтаре. Надо бы подобраться к нему поближе…
dialogsBegin.sp: Creo que hay algo en el altar. Tengo la fuerte sensación de que podríamos encontrar algo allí si nos acercamos lo suficiente.
dialogsBegin.sw: I think there is something in the altar. I have a strong feeling that we could find something there if we look closely enough.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันคิดว่ามีบางอย่างอยู่ในแท่นบูชา ฉันมีความรู้สึกอย่างแรงกล้าว่าเราสามารถหาบางอย่างที่นั่นได้ ถ้าเรามองอย่างใกล้ชิดพอ
dialogsBegin.tw: 我覺得祭團那邊應該會有一些線索才對，仔細的去找找的話，或許會找的到吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi nghĩ rằng có một cái gì đó trong altar. Tôi có cảm giác mạnh mẽ rằng chúng ta có thể tìm thấy thứ gì đó ở đó nếu chúng ta quan sát đủ kỹ.

dialogsBegin.en: Listen. This is very important. Just stick with this until the end. Would you?
dialogsBegin.ar: Listen. This is very important. Just stick with this until the end. Would you?
dialogsBegin.br: Ouça. Isto é muito importante. Fique conosco até o final. Tudo bem?
dialogsBegin.cns: 哎唷~~你到现在都一直帮我们了啊，所以这次也帮我一下吧。
dialogsBegin.de: Hör mir zu. Das ist sehr wichtig. Bitte tue mir diesen Gefallen wenn du soweit bist. Okay?
dialogsBegin.fi: Listen. This is very important. Just stick with this until the end. Would you?
dialogsBegin.fil: Listen. This is very important. Just stick with this until the end. Would you?
dialogsBegin.fr: C'est vraiment très important tu sais. Et je peux compter sur toi n'est-ce pas ?
dialogsBegin.id: Dengarkan. Ini sangat penting. Kamu akan melakukannya sampai akhirkan?
dialogsBegin.it: Listen. This is very important. Just stick with this until the end. Would you?
dialogsBegin.jp: これは大変重要な問題だ。せっかくここまで調べあげたのだから、君の協力を仰ぎたいのだ。頼む。
dialogsBegin.kr: 잘 들어요. 정말 중요한 일이에요. 마지막까지 이 일에 집중해 주실 수 있겠어요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Listen. This is very important. Just stick with this until the end. Would you?
dialogsBegin.pl: Listen. This is very important. Just stick with this until the end. Would you?
dialogsBegin.ru: Это очень важно. Осталось совсем немного - и мы сорвем завесу с тайны! Ты пойдешь к алтарю?
dialogsBegin.sp: Escucha. Esto es muy importante. Quédate hasta el final. ¿Vale?
dialogsBegin.sw: Listen. This is very important. Just stick with this until the end. Would you?
dialogsBegin.th: ฟังนะ นี่เป็นสิ่งสำคัญมาก อยู่กับสิ่งนี้จนจบ ตกลงมั้ย?
dialogsBegin.tw: 哎唷~~你到現在都一直幫我們了啊，所以這次也幫我一下吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Nghe. Cái này rất quan trọng. Chỉ cần gắn bó với điều này cho đến khi kết thúc. Bạn có muốn không?

dialogsAccept.en: Please check the altar until you can find some evidence.
dialogsAccept.ar: Please check the altar until you can find some evidence.
dialogsAccept.br: Verifique o altar até encontrar alguma evidência.
dialogsAccept.cns: 我刚刚也说过了，请你帮我去查一下紫色的剧团。不管去哪里都可以，只要帮我找到线索就好了。
dialogsAccept.de: Bitte untersuche den Altar in lila, bis du ein paar Beweise gefunden hast.
dialogsAccept.fi: Please check the altar until you can find some evidence.
dialogsAccept.fil: Please check the altar until you can find some evidence.
dialogsAccept.fr: S'il te plaît, pars enquêter aux Autels Pourpres, je suis sûr que tu vas trouver un nouvel indice pour nous guider sur le chemin de la vérité.
dialogsAccept.id: Tolong periksa Altar sampai kamu bisa menemukan beberapa bukti.
dialogsAccept.it: Please check the altar until you can find some evidence.
dialogsAccept.jp: ＜紫闇の祭壇＞を探し出し、調べてくれ。＜紫闇の祭壇＞の近辺で、おそらく手がかりになるものがみつかるだろう。
dialogsAccept.kr: 제단을 계속 조사해 주세요. 증거가 나올 때까지요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Please check the altar until you can find some evidence.
dialogsAccept.pl: Please check the altar until you can find some evidence.
dialogsAccept.ru: Отлично. Уверен, разгадка близко!
dialogsAccept.sp: Por favor revisa el altar hasta que puedas encontrar alguna prueba.
dialogsAccept.sw: Please check the altar until you can find some evidence.
dialogsAccept.th: กรุณาตรวจสอบแท่นบูชาจนกว่าจะพบหลักฐาน
dialogsAccept.tw: 我剛剛也說過了，請你幫我去查一下赤色的劇團。不管去哪裡都可以，只要幫我找到線索就好了。
dialogsAccept.vi: Vui lòng kiểm tra altar cho đến khi bạn có thể tìm thấy một số bằng chứng.

dialogsDecline.en: What could be more important than this? Oh fine, just go.
dialogsDecline.ar: What could be more important than this? Oh fine, just go.
dialogsDecline.br: O que pode ser mais importante do que isto? Está bem, vá.
dialogsDecline.cns: 除了这个还有其他更重要的事情吗?真是的..除了去厕所之外，应该没有比这个更重要的事情吧..
dialogsDecline.de: Was in aller Welt kann dem noch in die Quere kommen? Durchfall?
dialogsDecline.fi: What could be more important than this? Oh fine, just go.
dialogsDecline.fil: What could be more important than this? Oh fine, just go.
dialogsDecline.fr: La vérité sur l'histoire de Madrigal devrait être ta priorité !
dialogsDecline.id: Memangnya ada yang lebih penting dari ini? Baiklah, pergi saja.
dialogsDecline.it: What could be more important than this? Oh fine, just go.
dialogsDecline.jp: ふむ、何か急用があるのか。では、速やかに終わらせて戻ってきてくれ。待ってるよ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 이것보다 중요한 일이 있나요? …어휴, 그냥 가보세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: What could be more important than this? Oh fine, just go.
dialogsDecline.pl: What could be more important than this? Oh fine, just go.
dialogsDecline.ru: Неужели у тебя есть более важные дела?! Эх. Ну что ж, нет - так нет.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Qué podría ser más importante que esto? En fin, vete entonces.
dialogsDecline.sw: What could be more important than this? Oh fine, just go.
dialogsDecline.th: อะไรจะสำคัญไปกว่านี้? โอเค ไปเถอะ
dialogsDecline.tw: 除了這個還有其他更重要的事情嗎？真是的…除了去廁所之外，應該沒有比這個更重要的事情吧…
dialogsDecline.vi: Điều gì có thể quan trọng hơn điều này? Tốt thôi, đi thôi.

dialogsComplete.en: Hmm... Everything is written in an ancient language. But we can translate it. Thanks.
dialogsComplete.ar: Hmm... Everything is written in an ancient language. But we can translate it. Thanks.
dialogsComplete.br: Hmm... Está tudo escrito em uma língua antiga. Mas podemos traduzir. Obrigado.
dialogsComplete.cns: Hmm... Everything is written in an ancient language. But we can translate it. Thanks.
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm ... Alles ist in einer alten Sprache geschrieben. Aber wir können es übersetzen. Ich danke dir.
dialogsComplete.fi: Hmm... Everything is written in an ancient language. But we can translate it. Thanks.
dialogsComplete.fil: Hmm... Everything is written in an ancient language. But we can translate it. Thanks.
dialogsComplete.fr: (observant le manuscrit) Oh merci ! Hmm... C'est écrit dans un dialecte très ancien, je ne pensais pas qu'un tel document pouvais encore exister.
dialogsComplete.id: Hmm.. Semuanya tertulis dalam bahasa Kuno. Untungnya kita dapat menerjemahkannya. Terima kasih.
dialogsComplete.it: Hmm... Everything is written in an ancient language. But we can translate it. Thanks.
dialogsComplete.jp: おお、これは！手がかりを見つけてきてくれたか、ありがとう。装丁から見ても、重要な内容が書かれた書物のようだな。ふむ…たしかに全て古代語で記述されている。よし、さっそく解釈にとりかかろう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 흠... 모든 것이 고대 언어로 적혀 있네요. 하지만 우리가 번역할 수 있죠. 고마워요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Hmm... Everything is written in an ancient language. But we can translate it. Thanks.
dialogsComplete.pl: Hmm... Everything is written in an ancient language. But we can translate it. Thanks.
dialogsComplete.ru: Hmm... Everything is written in an ancient language. But we can translate it. Thanks.
dialogsComplete.sp: Hmm... Todo está escrito en un idioma antiguo. Pero podemos traducirlo. Gracias.
dialogsComplete.sw: Hmm... Everything is written in an ancient language. But we can translate it. Thanks.
dialogsComplete.th: อืม.. ทุกอย่างเขียนด้วยภาษาโบราณ แต่เราสามารถถอดความได้ ขอบคุณ
dialogsComplete.tw: 嗯……這上面全都用古代語言寫的。不過我們應該有辦法翻譯出來，謝謝你。
dialogsComplete.vi: Hmm .. Mọi thứ đều được viết bằng cổ ngữ. Nhưng chúng tôi có thể dịch nó. Cảm ơn nhé.

dialogsComplete.en: Please come back to me after the translation is over. Let me bring this book to the translator.
dialogsComplete.ar: Please come back to me after the translation is over. Let me bring this book to the translator.
dialogsComplete.br: Dê um retorno depois que acabar a tradução. Vou levar este livro ao tradutor.
dialogsComplete.cns: 等我翻一好这本书之后再来找我吧，我要去把这本书交给翻译社了。
dialogsComplete.de: Bitte komm wieder wenn die Übersetzung fertig ist. Ich bringe es zu einem Übersetzer.
dialogsComplete.fi: Please come back to me after the translation is over. Let me bring this book to the translator.
dialogsComplete.fil: Please come back to me after the translation is over. Let me bring this book to the translator.
dialogsComplete.fr: Mais heureusement je suis en mesure de le traduire. Accorde-moi un instant…
dialogsComplete.id: Biarkan aku yang membawa buku ini ke penerjemah. Kembalilah lagi nanti saat selesai.
dialogsComplete.it: Please come back to me after the translation is over. Let me bring this book to the translator.
dialogsComplete.jp: 申し訳ないが古代語の翻訳は難解なので、少し時間がかかりそうだ。　しばらくしたら、また来てくれないか。
dialogsComplete.kr: 제가 번역가에게 책을 맡기고 올게요. 이 책의 번역이 모두 끝나면 그때 다시 와 주세요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Please come back to me after the translation is over. Let me bring this book to the translator.
dialogsComplete.pl: Please come back to me after the translation is over. Let me bring this book to the translator.
dialogsComplete.ru: Отыщи того, кто владеет этим древним языком, и попроси его растолковать нам смысл книги.
dialogsComplete.sp: Vuelve cuando haya terminado la traducción. Déjame llevar este libro al traductor.
dialogsComplete.sw: Please come back to me after the translation is over. Let me bring this book to the translator.
dialogsComplete.th: โปรดกลับมาหาฉันหลังจากการแปลเสร็จสิ้น ให้ฉันนำหนังสือเล่มนี้ไปให้นักแปล
dialogsComplete.tw: 等我翻譯好這本書之後再來找我吧，我要去把這本書交給翻譯社了。
dialogsComplete.vi: Vui lòng quay lại với tôi sau khi dịch xong. Để tôi mang cuốn sách này đến cho người dịch.

dialogsFail.en: You can check all of the 3 altars, bring any evidence you find at any of them.
dialogsFail.ar: You can check all of the 3 altars, bring any evidence you find at any of them.
dialogsFail.br: Você pode observar os 3 altares. Traga qualquer evidência que encontrar neles
dialogsFail.cns: 把3个祭团全部找一下也是可以啦，可是如果知道哪里会有线索的话，不需要多跑到其他地方了。
dialogsFail.de: Du kannst alle drei Altare untersuchen, aber du braucht die anderen nicht untersuchen, wenn du den Beweis bei einen der drei findest.
dialogsFail.fi: You can check all of the 3 altars, bring any evidence you find at any of them.
dialogsFail.fil: You can check all of the 3 altars, bring any evidence you find at any of them.
dialogsFail.fr: Il faut que tu inspectes les trois Autels Pourpres, il devrait bien y avoir un indice quelque part…
dialogsFail.id: Kamu bisa memeriksa ketiga Altar itu dan bawa bukti apapun yang kamu temukan disana.
dialogsFail.it: You can check all of the 3 altars, bring any evidence you find at any of them.
dialogsFail.jp: 残念だが＜紫闇の祭壇＞の詳しい場所はわからない。手間はかかるが、各大陸のどこかにあるという3つの祭壇を全て調べてくれ。もし3つの祭壇のどこかで手がかりをみつけたら、そこが＜紫闇の祭壇＞だ。それを手に入れたら他の祭壇へ行く必要はない。
dialogsFail.kr: 세 개의 제단 모두를 조사해 주세요. 어디에서든 증거가 발견되면 가져와 주세요.
dialogsFail.nl: You can check all of the 3 altars, bring any evidence you find at any of them.
dialogsFail.pl: You can check all of the 3 altars, bring any evidence you find at any of them.
dialogsFail.ru: Осмотри все три алтаря. Если найдешь что-нибудь необычное, сразу же расскажи.
dialogsFail.sp: Puedes ir a comprobar los 3 altares, traer cualquier prueba que encuentres en cualquiera de ellos.
dialogsFail.sw: You can check all of the 3 altars, bring any evidence you find at any of them.
dialogsFail.th: คุณสามารถตรวจสอบแท่นบูชาทั้ง 3 แท่น นำหลักฐานที่คุณพบมาที่แท่นบูชาใดก็ได้
dialogsFail.tw: 把 3 個祭團全部找一下也是可以啦，可是如果知道哪裡會有線索的話，不需要多跑到其他地方了。
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn có thể kiểm tra tất cả 3 nơi, mang theo bất kỳ bằng chứng nào bạn tìm thấy ở bất kỳ bàn thờ nào.

name.th: ความใฝ่ฝันของ Lord Bang

description.en: Defeat 35 Red Bang Troupe Leaders and speak with Amadolka at the Erons Factory in Darkon 1.
description.ar: Defeat 35 Red Bang Troupe Leaders and speak with Amadolka at the Erons Factory in Darkon 1.
description.br: Por favor, derrote 35 Líderes da Trupe dos Bangs Vermelhos e visite Amatolka, um líder dos guardas na Fábrica Erons, e conte a ele a respeito de meu pesadelo. Depressa!
description.cns: 打败35个红色魔导战甲团头目，在达肯1区的绿磷石工厂与艾玛都卡对话。
description.de: Bitte gehe nun und besuche Amadolka, er ist Anführer der Wachen in Erons Fabrik, erzähl ihm von meinem Traum. Beeile dich!
description.fi: Defeat 35 Red Bang Troupe Leaders and speak with Amadolka at the Erons Factory in Darkon 1.
description.fil: Defeat 35 Red Bang Troupe Leaders and speak with Amadolka at the Erons Factory in Darkon 1.
description.fr: Parler du rêve à Amadolka, le responsable de la sécurité de l'usine des Erons de Darkon 1.
description.id: Kalahkan 35 Red Bang Troupe Leaders dan bicaralah dengan Amadolka di Pabrik Erons di Darkon 1.
description.it: Defeat 35 Red Bang Troupe Leaders and speak with Amadolka at the Erons Factory in Darkon 1.
description.jp: エランパークスの警備長＜アマドルカー＞に会い、ルダの夢の話を伝えよう。
description.kr: 레드 뱅 도적 대장을 35명 처치하고, 다콘 제1지구의 에런스 공장에 있는 아마돌카에게 말을 거세요.
description.nl: Defeat 35 Red Bang Troupe Leaders and speak with Amadolka at the Erons Factory in Darkon 1.
description.pl: Defeat 35 Red Bang Troupe Leaders and speak with Amadolka at the Erons Factory in Darkon 1.
description.ru: Нужно победить тридцать пять главарей "Труппы" - все, они, разумеется, фальшивые - и поговорить с Амадоларом на Эрониевой фактории в Дарконе-1.
description.sp: Derrota a 35 Líderes de los Bangs Rojos y habla con Amadolka en la Fábrica de Erons en Darkon 1.
description.sw: Defeat 35 Red Bang Troupe Leaders and speak with Amadolka at the Erons Factory in Darkon 1.
description.th: กำจัดผู้นำกลุ่ม Red Bang 35 คน และพูดคุยกับ Amadolka ที่ Erons Factory ใน Darkon 1
description.tw: 擊敗 35 名紅色崩崩團長，並與得肯 1 艾磷斯工廠的亞瑪多卡交談。
description.vi: Đánh bại 35 thủ lĩnh của Red Bang Troupe và nói chuyện với Amadolka tại Erons Factory trong Darkon 1.

dialogsBegin.en: The new leader of the Red Bang Troupe must be at the Erons Factory location you discovered before.
dialogsBegin.ar: The new leader of the Red Bang Troupe must be at the Erons Factory location you discovered before.
dialogsBegin.br: Ei! Espere! Por favor, me ajude! Por favor! O novo líder dos Bangs Vermelhos deve estar no local da Fábrica Erons que você descobriu antes.
dialogsBegin.cns: 请等一下!!发生很恐怖的事情了。
dialogsBegin.de: Hey! Warte! Bitte helfe mir! Bitte!
dialogsBegin.fi: The new leader of the Red Bang Troupe must be at the Erons Factory location you discovered before.
dialogsBegin.fil: The new leader of the Red Bang Troupe must be at the Erons Factory location you discovered before.
dialogsBegin.fr: (T'appelant en criant) Hé ! Attends ! Aide-moi s'il te plaît!
dialogsBegin.id: Pemimpin baru dari Red Bang Troupe harus berada di lokasi Erons Factory yang kamu temukan sebelumnya.
dialogsBegin.it: The new leader of the Red Bang Troupe must be at the Erons Factory location you discovered before.
dialogsBegin.jp: 君！君、いつかはありがとう。困ったことに、また大変なことが起きたんだ。とにかく、俺の話を聞いてくれないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 예전에 찾아냈던 에런스 공장에 레드 뱅 도적단의 새로운 두목이 있을 겁니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: The new leader of the Red Bang Troupe must be at the Erons Factory location you discovered before.
dialogsBegin.pl: The new leader of the Red Bang Troupe must be at the Erons Factory location you discovered before.
dialogsBegin.ru: Раз в горном укрытии главаря не оказалось, он может быть только в одном месте. На Эрониевой фактории!
dialogsBegin.sp: El nuevo líder de los Bangs Rojos debe estar en la zona de la Fábrica de Erons que descubriste antes.
dialogsBegin.sw: The new leader of the Red Bang Troupe must be at the Erons Factory location you discovered before.
dialogsBegin.th: ผู้นำคนใหม่ของกลุ่มโจร Red Bang ต้องอยู่ใน Erons Factory ที่คุณเคยไปมาก่อน
dialogsBegin.tw: 紅衣竊賊團的新首領一定就在你之前發現的艾磷斯工廠。
dialogsBegin.vi: Thủ lĩnh mới của Red Bang Troupe phải ở vị trí Erons Factory mà bạn đã phát hiện trước đó.

dialogsBegin.en: We need to strike a blow to his troupe and cripple his operations in Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin.ar: We need to strike a blow to his troupe and cripple his operations in Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin.br: Tive uma visão ontem a noite. Eu vi um lugar cheio de máquinas queimando, e onde tudo estava vermelho. As pessoas estavam gritando e todos estavam em pânico.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我昨天做了一个梦，一片红色，被很多火包围着，那边有很多恐怖的尖叫声。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich hatte letzte Nacht einen Traum. Ein Ort der voll mit Maschinen ist, die brannten, alles war rot. Leute gerieten in Panik und schrien.
dialogsBegin.fi: We need to strike a blow to his troupe and cripple his operations in Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin.fil: We need to strike a blow to his troupe and cripple his operations in Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin.fr: J'ai fait un rêve la nuit dernière. J'ai vu un endroit plein de machines en train de brûler, tout était rouge. Les gens criaient, tout le monde était pris de panique.
dialogsBegin.id: Kita perlu menyerang rombongannya dan melumpuhkan operasinya di Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin.it: We need to strike a blow to his troupe and cripple his operations in Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin.jp: 昨晩、機械や煙がもうもうとたちこめている地域が真っ赤な炎に包まれている夢を見たんだ。そこは地獄と化して、恐怖と人々の泣き叫ぶ悲鳴で満ちていた。そして放火と殺戮と略奪を繰り返しているあいつらの姿が…
dialogsBegin.kr: 도적단에 타격을 줘야 해요. 다콘 제1지구에서 도적단의 작전을 마비시켜야 합니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: We need to strike a blow to his troupe and cripple his operations in Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin.pl: We need to strike a blow to his troupe and cripple his operations in Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin.ru: Мы вернулись туда, откуда начали. Нужно прогнать разбойников с Даркона-1!
dialogsBegin.sp: Necesitamos dar un golpe a los Bangs Rojos y paralizar sus operaciones en Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin.sw: We need to strike a blow to his troupe and cripple his operations in Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin.th: เราจำเป็นต้องโจมตีคณะละครของเขาและขัดขวางการทำงานของเขาใน Darkon 1
dialogsBegin.tw: 我昨天做了一個夢，一片紅色，被很多火包圍著，那邊有很多恐怖的尖叫聲。
dialogsBegin.vi: Chúng ta cần giáng một đòn vào nhóm của anh ta và làm tê liệt hoạt động của anh ta trong Darkon 1.

dialogsBegin.en: I know what to do! You need to visit Amadolka. But first, defeat 35 Red bang Troupe Leaders southwest of the Erons Factory.
dialogsBegin.ar: I know what to do! You need to visit Amadolka. But first, defeat 35 Red bang Troupe Leaders southwest of the Erons Factory.
dialogsBegin.br: Foi realmente horrível. Depois que acordei, percebi que era a Fábrica Erons de Darkon 1. Eu sei o que fazer! Você precisa visitar Amadolka. Mas primeiro, derrote 35 Líderes dos Bangs Vermelhos a sudoeste da Fábrica Erons.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我知道该怎么做! 你需要去找艾玛都卡。但首先要打败绿磷石工厂西南面的35个魔导战甲强盗团头目。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich weiß, was zu tun ist! Du musst Amadolka besuchen. Aber zuerst musst du 35 Anführer der Red-Bang-Truppe südwestlich der Erons-Fabrik besiegen.
dialogsBegin.fi: I know what to do! You need to visit Amadolka. But first, defeat 35 Red bang Troupe Leaders southwest of the Erons Factory.
dialogsBegin.fil: I know what to do! You need to visit Amadolka. But first, defeat 35 Red bang Troupe Leaders southwest of the Erons Factory.
dialogsBegin.fr: C'était horrible. Après m'être réveillé, j'ai réalisé qu'il s'agissait l'usine des Erons de Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya tahu apa yang harus dilakukan! Kamu perlu mengunjungi Amadolka. Tapi pertama-tama, kalahkan 35 Red bang Troupe Leaders di southwest of the Erons Factory.
dialogsBegin.it: I know what to do! You need to visit Amadolka. But first, defeat 35 Red bang Troupe Leaders southwest of the Erons Factory.
dialogsBegin.jp: 私は何をすべきか知っています！ あなたはアマドルカを訪問する必要があります。 しかし、最初に、エラン工場の南西にある35人の赤いヴァン盗賊団の連中を倒して！
dialogsBegin.kr: 아, 좋은 생각이 있어요! 아마돌카를 만나 보세요. 하지만 그 전에, 우선 에런스 공장 남서쪽에 있는 레드 뱅 도적 대장 35명을 처치하세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I know what to do! You need to visit Amadolka. But first, defeat 35 Red bang Troupe Leaders southwest of the Erons Factory.
dialogsBegin.pl: I know what to do! You need to visit Amadolka. But first, defeat 35 Red bang Troupe Leaders southwest of the Erons Factory.
dialogsBegin.ru: Я знаю, что делать. Поговори с Амадоларом. Чтобы пробиться к нему, тебе придется одолеть проходимцев на юго-западе от Эрониевой фактории.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Sé lo que hay que hacer! Tienes que visitar a Amadolka. Pero primero, derrota a 35 Líderes de los Bangs Rojos al suroeste de la Fábrica de Erons.
dialogsBegin.sw: I know what to do! You need to visit Amadolka. But first, defeat 35 Red bang Troupe Leaders southwest of the Erons Factory.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันรู้ว่าต้องทำอะไร! คุณต้องไปหา Amadolka แต่ก่อนอื่นให้กำจัด 35 Red Bang Group ทางตะวันตกเฉียงใต้ของ Erons Factory
dialogsBegin.tw: 我知道要做什麼！你需要訪問亞瑪多吧。但要先擊敗艾磷斯工廠西南的 35 名紅蹦蹦團長。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi biết phải làm gì! Bạn cần đến thăm Amadolka. Nhưng trước tiên, hãy đánh bại 35 thủ lĩnh của Red bang Troupe ở phía tây nam Erons Factory.

dialogsBegin.en: Will you help me once more, friend?
dialogsBegin.ar: Will you help me once more, friend?
dialogsBegin.br: Por favor, me ajude. Muitas pessoas estão em perigo.
dialogsBegin.cns: 拜托你帮我好吗?很多人的生命就在你手上了。
dialogsBegin.de: Bitte helfe mir. Eine menge Leute sind in Gefahr.
dialogsBegin.fi: Will you help me once more, friend?
dialogsBegin.fil: Will you help me once more, friend?
dialogsBegin.fr: Peux-tu me venir en aide, s'il te plaît ?
dialogsBegin.id: Maukah kamu membantu saya sekali lagi, teman?
dialogsBegin.it: Will you help me once more, friend?
dialogsBegin.jp: 昨日見た夢は何かが違っていて、とても不吉な予感がするんだよ。エランパークス地域の警備長をしている＜アマドルカー＞に急いでこの夢の話を伝えたいのだが、君、頼まれてくれるかい？
dialogsBegin.kr: 한 번만 더 도와주실 수 있죠?
dialogsBegin.nl: Will you help me once more, friend?
dialogsBegin.pl: Will you help me once more, friend?
dialogsBegin.ru: Надеюсь, тебе хватит храбрости?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Me ayudarás una vez más, amigo?
dialogsBegin.sw: Will you help me once more, friend?
dialogsBegin.th: คุณจะช่วยฉันอีกครั้งได้ไหม เพื่อน?
dialogsBegin.tw: 拜託你幫我好嗎？很多人的生命就在你手上了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn sẽ giúp tôi một lần nữa được không, bạn?

dialogsAccept.en: Great! Now please go and visit Amadolka, who is a guard leader at Erons Factory.
dialogsAccept.ar: Great! Now please go and visit Amadolka, who is a guard leader at Erons Factory.
dialogsAccept.br: Ótimo! Por favor, vá e visite Amatolka, um líder dos guardas da Fábrica Erons, e conte a ele a respeito de meu sonho. Depressa!
dialogsAccept.cns: 好，那你现在赶快到绿磷石工厂，找那边的警卫队队长艾玛都卡，把我的梦说给他听。
dialogsAccept.de: Gut. Bitte gehe nun und besuche Amadolka, er ist Anführer der Wachen in Erons Fabrik, erzähl ihm von meinem Traum. Beeile dich!
dialogsAccept.fi: Great! Now please go and visit Amadolka, who is a guard leader at Erons Factory.
dialogsAccept.fil: Great! Now please go and visit Amadolka, who is a guard leader at Erons Factory.
dialogsAccept.fr: Merci ! Va voir Amadolka qui s'occupe de la sécurité l'usine des Erons, et raconte-lui mon rêve. Dépêche-toi j'ai peur que le danger soit proche !
dialogsAccept.id: Baik! Sekarang silakan pergi dan kunjungi Amadolka, yang merupakan pemimpin penjaga di Pabrik Erons.
dialogsAccept.it: Great! Now please go and visit Amadolka, who is a guard leader at Erons Factory.
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとう！じゃ、今からすぐにでもエランパークスに行って警備長の＜アマドルカー＞に俺の夢の話を伝えてくれないか？できるだけ急いでくれ。頼んだよ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 좋아요! 그럼 이제 에런스 공장의 경비대장 아마돌카를 만나보세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Great! Now please go and visit Amadolka, who is a guard leader at Erons Factory.
dialogsAccept.pl: Great! Now please go and visit Amadolka, who is a guard leader at Erons Factory.
dialogsAccept.ru: Прекрасно! Победи тридцать пять фальшивых главарей "Труппы" и поговори с Амадоларом, начальником охраны фактории.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Estupendo! Ahora visita a Amadolka, líder de la guardia en la Fábrica de Erons.
dialogsAccept.sw: Great! Now please go and visit Amadolka, who is a guard leader at Erons Factory.
dialogsAccept.th: เยี่ยม! กรุณาไปหา Amadolka ซึ่งเป็นหัวหน้ายามที่ Erons Factory
dialogsAccept.tw: 好，那你現在趕快到艾磷斯工廠，找那邊的警衛隊隊長亞瑪多，把我的夢說給他聽。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tuyệt quá! Bây giờ hãy đến thăm Amadolka, người là trưởng nhóm bảo vệ tại Erons Factory.

dialogsDecline.en: You have to believe me! A lot of people are in danger! Do you understand?
dialogsDecline.ar: You have to believe me! A lot of people are in danger! Do you understand?
dialogsDecline.br: Você precisa acreditar em mim! Muitas pessoas estão em perigo! Você entendeu??
dialogsDecline.cns: You have to believe me! A lot of people are in danger! Do you understand?
dialogsDecline.de: Du musst mir glauben! Es sind viele Menschen in Gefahr! Verstehen Sie das?
dialogsDecline.fi: You have to believe me! A lot of people are in danger! Do you understand?
dialogsDecline.fil: You have to believe me! A lot of people are in danger! Do you understand?
dialogsDecline.fr: Je suis sûr que des personnes sont en danger ! J'ai besoin de ton aide !
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu harus percaya padaku! Banyak orang dalam bahaya! Apakah kamu mengerti??
dialogsDecline.it: You have to believe me! A lot of people are in danger! Do you understand?
dialogsDecline.jp: 君は多くの命がかけられている問題を無視するつもりか？大変なことになってからでは、もう手遅れなんだぞ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 믿어주세요! 사람들이 위험에 처해 있어요! 이해하시겠어요?
dialogsDecline.nl: You have to believe me! A lot of people are in danger! Do you understand?
dialogsDecline.pl: You have to believe me! A lot of people are in danger! Do you understand?
dialogsDecline.ru: You have to believe me! A lot of people are in danger! Do you understand?
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Me tienes que creer! ¡Hay mucha gente en peligro! ¿¿Te enteras o no??
dialogsDecline.sw: You have to believe me! A lot of people are in danger! Do you understand?
dialogsDecline.th: คุณต้องเชื่อฉันสิ! มีหลายคนกำลังตกอยู่ในอันตราย! คุณเข้าใจไหม?
dialogsDecline.tw: 你一定要相信我！很多人正身陷危險！你明白嗎？
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn phải tin tôi! Rất nhiều người đang gặp nguy hiểm! Bạn có hiểu vấn đề không?

dialogsComplete.en: What? Really? Good job thinning the herd a bit.
dialogsComplete.ar: What? Really? Good job thinning the herd a bit.
dialogsComplete.br: O que? Sério? Hmm... Talvez o pesadelo se torne realidade...
dialogsComplete.cns: 什么?是这样啊..如果在这样下去的话，那个梦可能会成为现实了。
dialogsComplete.de: Was? Ja, wirklich? Gute Arbeit, um die Herde ein wenig auszudünnen.
dialogsComplete.fi: What? Really? Good job thinning the herd a bit.
dialogsComplete.fil: What? Really? Good job thinning the herd a bit.
dialogsComplete.fr: Quoi ? Vraiment ? Hmm... Peut-être que c'était un rêve prémonitoire.
dialogsComplete.id: Apa? Betulkah? Kerja bagus menipiskan kawanan sedikit.
dialogsComplete.it: What? Really? Good job thinning the herd a bit.
dialogsComplete.jp: 何？ 本当に？ 群れを少し間伐するのは良い事です。
dialogsComplete.kr: 뭐라고요? 정말요? 일부라도 줄었다니 잘하셨네요.
dialogsComplete.nl: What? Really? Good job thinning the herd a bit.
dialogsComplete.pl: What? Really? Good job thinning the herd a bit.
dialogsComplete.ru: What? Really? Good job thinning the herd a bit.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿Qué? ¿En serio? Buen trabajo reduciendo un poco la manada.
dialogsComplete.sw: What? Really? Good job thinning the herd a bit.
dialogsComplete.th: อะไรนะ? จริงเหรอ? ดีมาก โลกเราก็สะอาดขึ้นอีกนิดแล้วล่ะ
dialogsComplete.tw: 什麼？真的嗎？做得好！威脅變少了。
dialogsComplete.vi: Gì? Có thật không? Cố gắng hết sức làm tốt công việc.

dialogsComplete.en: Hmmm... you may prove useful.
dialogsComplete.ar: Hmmm... you may prove useful.
dialogsComplete.br: Hmmm... você pode ser útil.
dialogsComplete.cns: 哎呀..真是不知道什么是什么啦。
dialogsComplete.de: Nun, nun.. Ich bin nicht sicher.
dialogsComplete.fi: Hmmm... you may prove useful.
dialogsComplete.fil: Hmmm... you may prove useful.
dialogsComplete.fr: Bon, bon... Je ne suis pas sûr.
dialogsComplete.id: Hmm... Kamu mungkin terbukti berguna.
dialogsComplete.it: Hmmm... you may prove useful.
dialogsComplete.jp: 私がエランパークスの警護をしている〈アマドルカー〉だ。ルダの知り合いか？ルダは昔からの友人だが…何だって？！そ、その夢は予知夢かもしれないぞ！もっと警護を強化しなければ…
dialogsComplete.kr: 흠… 꽤 쓸모 있는 분 같은데.
dialogsComplete.nl: Hmmm... you may prove useful.
dialogsComplete.pl: Hmmm... you may prove useful.
dialogsComplete.ru: Думаю, я знаю, что нужно делать.
dialogsComplete.sp: Hmmm... puedes ser útil.
dialogsComplete.sw: Hmmm... you may prove useful.
dialogsComplete.th: อืมมมม... คุณอาจพิสูจน์ว่ามันได้ผล
dialogsComplete.tw: 哎呀…真是不知道什麼是什麼啦。
dialogsComplete.vi: Hmmm ... bạn có thể thấy hữu ích.

dialogsFail.en: I am in charge of security in Erons Factory. Do you know Luda? How is he doing?
dialogsFail.ar: I am in charge of security in Erons Factory. Do you know Luda? How is he doing?
dialogsFail.br: Sou responsável pela segurança na Fábrica Erons. Você conhece Luda? Como ele está?
dialogsFail.cns: 我在管理绿磷石工厂的治安。你认识路达吗?路达最近过的好吗?
dialogsFail.de: Ich habe die Leitung der Sicherheit in der Erons Fabrik. Kennst du Luda? Wie geht es ihm?
dialogsFail.fi: I am in charge of security in Erons Factory. Do you know Luda? How is he doing?
dialogsFail.fil: I am in charge of security in Erons Factory. Do you know Luda? How is he doing?
dialogsFail.fr: Je suis le responsable de la sécurité à l'usine des Erons. Tu connais Luda ? Qu'est-ce qu'il devient ?
dialogsFail.id: Saya bertanggung jawab atas keamanan di Pabrik Erons. Kamu kenal Luda? Bagaimana kabarnya?
dialogsFail.it: I am in charge of security in Erons Factory. Do you know Luda? How is he doing?
dialogsFail.jp: 最近、凶悪な盗賊団の奴らが勢力を増していて、この辺は今、大変危険な状態だ。気をつけてくれ。
dialogsFail.kr: 저는 이 에런스 공장의 치안을 담당하고 있답니다. 루다를 아시나요? 루다는 어떻게 지내죠?
dialogsFail.nl: I am in charge of security in Erons Factory. Do you know Luda? How is he doing?
dialogsFail.pl: I am in charge of security in Erons Factory. Do you know Luda? How is he doing?
dialogsFail.ru: Я - начальник охраны на этой фактории. Ты знаешь Людора? Как поживает мой старый друг?
dialogsFail.sp: Estoy a cargo de la seguridad en la Fábrica de Erons. ¿Conoces a Luda? ¿Cómo está?
dialogsFail.sw: I am in charge of security in Erons Factory. Do you know Luda? How is he doing?
dialogsFail.th: ฉันคือผู้รักษาความปลอดภัยของ Erons Factory คุณรู้จัก Luda มั้ย? เขาเป็นไงบ้าง?
dialogsFail.tw: 我在管理艾磷斯工廠的治安。你認識路達嗎？路達最近過的好嗎？
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi phụ trách an ninh trong Nhà máy Erons. Bạn có biết Luda? Anh ấy như thế nào rồi?

dialogsBegin.en: Oh yeah! Hah, about that… for some reason my concoction didn't seem to break the curse. Could just be a delayed effect! Heh, wishful thinking, right?
dialogsBegin.ar: Oh yeah! Hah, about that… for some reason my concoction didn't seem to break the curse. Could just be a delayed effect! Heh, wishful thinking, right?
dialogsBegin.br: Oh sim! Ahh, sobre isso... por alguma razão minha mistura não pareceu quebrar a maldição. Pode ser apenas um efeito lento! Heh, pensamento positivo, certo??
dialogsBegin.cns: Oh yeah! Hah, about that… for some reason my concoction didn't seem to break the curse. Could just be a delayed effect! Heh, wishful thinking, right?
dialogsBegin.de: Oh ja! Hah, was das angeht... aus irgendeinem Grund scheint mein Gebräu den Fluch nicht zu brechen. Könnte nur eine verzögerte Wirkung sein! Heh, Wunschdenken, oder??
dialogsBegin.fi: Oh yeah! Hah, about that… for some reason my concoction didn't seem to break the curse. Could just be a delayed effect! Heh, wishful thinking, right?
dialogsBegin.fil: Oh yeah! Hah, about that… for some reason my concoction didn't seem to break the curse. Could just be a delayed effect! Heh, wishful thinking, right?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il y a un moyen pour dissiper ma malédiction ! Mais nous verrons ça en temps voulu.
dialogsBegin.id: Oh ya! Hah, tentang itu... untuk beberapa alasan ramuan saya tampaknya tidak mematahkan kutukan. Bisa jadi efek tertunda! Heh, angan-angan, kan??
dialogsBegin.it: Oh yeah! Hah, about that… for some reason my concoction didn't seem to break the curse. Could just be a delayed effect! Heh, wishful thinking, right?
dialogsBegin.jp: ふん、それは私が聞きたいくらいだ。私の調合に間違いはないはずなのだが……遅効性なのか！？
dialogsBegin.kr: 아 맞다! 그거 말이죠… 이상하게도 제 제조약이 저주를 풀지 못했어요. 그냥 효과가 늦게 나타나는 거면 좋겠어요! 너무 낙관적인 생각이겠죠?
dialogsBegin.nl: Oh yeah! Hah, about that… for some reason my concoction didn't seem to break the curse. Could just be a delayed effect! Heh, wishful thinking, right?
dialogsBegin.pl: Oh yeah! Hah, about that… for some reason my concoction didn't seem to break the curse. Could just be a delayed effect! Heh, wishful thinking, right?
dialogsBegin.ru: Oh yeah! Hah, about that… for some reason my concoction didn't seem to break the curse. Could just be a delayed effect! Heh, wishful thinking, right?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Ah sí! Ja, sobre eso… por alguna razón mi brebaje no parece romper la maldición. ¡Puede que tenga un efecto retardado! Je, que iluso, ¿no?
dialogsBegin.sw: Oh yeah! Hah, about that… for some reason my concoction didn't seem to break the curse. Could just be a delayed effect! Heh, wishful thinking, right?
dialogsBegin.th: อ๋อ ใช่! ฮ่าๆ เกี่ยวกับเรื่องนั้น… ไม่รู้ทำไม ส่วนผสมของฉันดูเหมือนจะไม่สามารถแก้คำสาปได้ หรือมันอาจจะค่อยๆแสดงผลก็ได้! ฮะๆ คิดเข้าข้างตัวเองใช่ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 喔對！哈，關於那個……不知道為什麼，我調的藥好像沒有解除詛咒。也可能只是效果延遲而已！呵，這只是我在自我安慰吧？
dialogsBegin.vi: Ồ vâng! Hah, về chuyện đó… vì vài lý do nào đó mà cách pha chế của tôi dường như không phá được lời nguyền. Hoặc có thể là hiệu quả đang đến chậm một chút! Heh, đâu có mất mát gì nếu chúng ta suy nghĩ tích cực đâu ha?!

dialogsBegin.en: Anyway! You came at just the right time! I've heard that a man named Achaben has reported seeing who I believe to be one of the 8 missing heroes. Will you go talk with him?
dialogsBegin.ar: Anyway! You came at just the right time! I've heard that a man named Achaben has reported seeing who I believe to be one of the 8 missing heroes. Will you go talk with him?
dialogsBegin.br: De qualquer forma! Você veio na hora certa! Ouvi dizer que um homem chamado Achaben relatou ter visto quem eu acredito ser um dos 8 heróis desaparecidos. Poderia falar com ele??
dialogsBegin.cns: Anyway! You came at just the right time! I've heard that a man named Achaben has reported seeing who I believe to be one of the 8 missing heroes. Will you go talk with him?
dialogsBegin.de: Wie auch immer! Du kommst genau zur richtigen Zeit! Ich habe gehört, dass ein Mann namens Achaben berichtet hat, dass er einen der acht vermissten Helden gesehen hat. Wirst du mit ihm reden?
dialogsBegin.fi: Anyway! You came at just the right time! I've heard that a man named Achaben has reported seeing who I believe to be one of the 8 missing heroes. Will you go talk with him?
dialogsBegin.fil: Anyway! You came at just the right time! I've heard that a man named Achaben has reported seeing who I believe to be one of the 8 missing heroes. Will you go talk with him?
dialogsBegin.fr: Pendant que vous vous entrainiez, j'ai effectué des recherches. Vous devriez parler à un marchand nommé Achaben.
dialogsBegin.id: Ngomong-ngomong! Anda datang pada waktu yang tepat! Saya pernah mendengar bahwa seorang pria bernama Achaben telah melaporkan melihat siapa yang saya yakini sebagai salah satu dari 8 pahlawan yang hilang. Maukah kamu berbicara dengannya??
dialogsBegin.it: Anyway! You came at just the right time! I've heard that a man named Achaben has reported seeing who I believe to be one of the 8 missing heroes. Will you go talk with him?
dialogsBegin.jp: まあ、その話はいい。それより君は他の英雄を探しているのだろう？雑貨屋を営んでいるアチャベンという男は知っているか？英雄の一人と思われる男を見たらしいんだ。彼と話をしてくれないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 어쨌든! 딱 필요할 때 오셨네요! 아카벤이라는 남자가, 실종된 영웅 8명 중 하나로 추정되는 사람을 봤다고 보고했다고 해요. 가서 물어보실래요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Anyway! You came at just the right time! I've heard that a man named Achaben has reported seeing who I believe to be one of the 8 missing heroes. Will you go talk with him?
dialogsBegin.pl: Anyway! You came at just the right time! I've heard that a man named Achaben has reported seeing who I believe to be one of the 8 missing heroes. Will you go talk with him?
dialogsBegin.ru: Anyway! You came at just the right time! I've heard that a man named Achaben has reported seeing who I believe to be one of the 8 missing heroes. Will you go talk with him?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Tema aparte! ¡Llegas en el momento justo! He escuchado que un hombre llamado Achaben dice haber visto a quien creo que es uno de los 8 héroes desaparecidos. ¿¿Vas a hablar con él??
dialogsBegin.sw: Anyway! You came at just the right time! I've heard that a man named Achaben has reported seeing who I believe to be one of the 8 missing heroes. Will you go talk with him?
dialogsBegin.th: เอาล่ะ! คุณมาทันเวลาพอดี ! ฉันได้ยินมาว่าชายคนหนึ่งชื่อ Achaben ได้รายงานว่าพบหนึ่งในฮีโร่ที่สูญหายไป 8 คน คุณจะไปพูดคุยกับเขาหรือไม่?
dialogsBegin.tw: 總之，你來得正好！我聽說一位名叫安迪的人聲稱見過失蹤的八英雄之一。你願意去找他談談嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Dẫu sao thì! Bạn đã đến rất đúng lúc! Tôi nghe nói rằng một người đàn ông tên là Achaben báo cáo rằng đã nhìn thấy người mà tôi tin là một trong 8 vị anh hùng mất tích. Bạn có thể đi tìm hiểu thêm từ anh ấy chứ?

dialogsAccept.en: Achaben is the owner of the General Shop in Darken. Please go meet with him and see what he has to say!
dialogsAccept.ar: Achaben is the owner of the General Shop in Darken. Please go meet with him and see what he has to say!
dialogsAccept.br: Achaben é o dono da Loja Geral em Darken. Por favor, vá se encontrar com ele e veja o que ele tem a dizer!
dialogsAccept.cns: 雅察本是达肯杂货店的老板。请去见见他，看看他有什么要说的！
dialogsAccept.de: Achaben ist der Besitzer des Gemischtwarenladens in Darken. Bitte trefft euch mit ihm und schaut, was er zu sagen hat!

dialogsAccept.fil: Achaben is the owner of the General Shop in Darken. Please go meet with him and see what he has to say!
dialogsAccept.fr: Achaben m'a parlé d'une personne à Darkon qui se vante d'être un Héros. Vous devriez commencer par cette piste.
dialogsAccept.id: Achaben adalah pemilik Toko Umum di Darken. Silakan pergi menemuinya dan lihat apa yang dia katakan!
dialogsAccept.it: Achaben is the owner of the General Shop in Darken. Please go meet with him and see what he has to say!
dialogsAccept.jp: その男の話によると、ダーコンの雑貨屋のアチャベンだそうだ。詳しくは彼に話を聞くといい。
dialogsAccept.kr: 아카벤이 그러더군 요즘 다콘에 슈퍼 영웅이라 불리는 자가 활약을 하고 다닌다고. 그에게 가면 자세한 얘기를 들을 수 있을 거야.
dialogsAccept.nl: Achaben is the owner of the General Shop in Darken. Please go meet with him and see what he has to say!
dialogsAccept.pl: Achaben is the owner of the General Shop in Darken. Please go meet with him and see what he has to say!
dialogsAccept.ru: Achaben is the owner of the General Shop in Darken. Please go meet with him and see what he has to say!
dialogsAccept.sp: Achaben es el dueño de la Tienda General de Darken. ¡Por favor, reúnete con él y escucha lo que tiene que decir!
dialogsAccept.sw: Achaben is the owner of the General Shop in Darken. Please go meet with him and see what he has to say!
dialogsAccept.th: Achaben เป็นเจ้าของ General Shop ใน Darken กรุณาไปพบเขาและดูว่าเขาพูดอะไร!
dialogsAccept.tw: 安迪是得肯雜貨店的老闆。請去找他，看看他知道些什麼！
dialogsAccept.vi: Achaben là chủ sở hữu của General Shop ở Darken. Hãy đến gặp anh ấy và xem anh ấy nói gì nhé!

dialogsDecline.sw: Still 4 more heroes to find! Lets not just call it quits now!
dialogsDecline.th: ยังมีฮีโร่อีก 4 คนที่ต้องหา! ช่วยรีบไปตอนนี้!

dialogsDecline.vi: Vẫn còn 4 anh hùng nữa để tìm! Đừng chỉ gọi nó là thoát ngay bây giờ!

description.en: Losha at the Food Shop will give me a Green Shield and 1,200 Penya when I visit her.
description.ar: Losha at the Food Shop will give me a Green Shield and 1,200 Penya when I visit her.
description.br: Losha da Loja de Alimentos lhe dará um Escudo Verde 1,200 de Penyas quando a visitar.
description.cns: 你就去饮食店找萝夏，就给你高级木盾和1200金币。
description.de: Losha vom Nahrungsmittel Laden will mir ein Green Shield und 1200 Penya geben, wenn ich zu ihr komme.
description.fi: Losha at the Food Shop will give me a Green Shield and 1,200 Penya when I visit her.
description.fil: Losha at the Food Shop will give me a Green Shield and 1,200 Penya when I visit her.
description.fr: Losha la marchande d'aliments me donnera un Bouclier Vert et 1200 penyas si je lui rends visite.
description.id: Losha di Food Shop akan memberiku Green Shield dan 1.200 Penya saat aku mengunjunginya
description.it: Losha at the Food Shop will give me a Green Shield and 1,200 Penya when I visit her.
description.jp: フードショップのロシャに会いに行くと、ルダからのプレゼントをもらえるらしい。
description.kr: 식료품 상점의 로샤에게서 그린 방패와 1,200 페냐를 받을 수 있습니다.
description.nl: Losha at the Food Shop will give me a Green Shield and 1,200 Penya when I visit her.
description.pl: Losha at the Food Shop will give me a Green Shield and 1,200 Penya when I visit her.
description.ru: Нужно поговорить с Люшей, владелицей продуктовой лавки. Она даст мне прочный деревянный щит и 1 200 пенни!
description.sp: Losha, de la Tienda de Comida, me dará un Escudo Verde y 1,200 Penya cuando la visite.
description.sw: Losha at the Food Shop will give me a Green Shield and 1,200 Penya when I visit her.
description.th: Losha ที่ร้านอาหารจะให้ Green Shield และ 1,200 Penya แก่ฉันเมื่อฉันไปเยี่ยมเธอ
description.tw: 去餐飲店找蘿夏時，她會給我綠色盾牌和 1,200 金幣。
description.vi: Losha ở Cửa hàng Thực phẩm sẽ tặng tôi một Green Shield và 1.200 Penya khi tôi đến thăm cô ấy.

dialogsBegin.en: Hahaha! Welcome to the Shield Shop! You can buy shields, weapons, and armor for Vagrants here. I stock all the equipment that you need prior to your first job change at level 15.
dialogsBegin.ar: Hahaha! Welcome to the Shield Shop! You can buy shields, weapons, and armor for Vagrants here. I stock all the equipment that you need prior to your first job change at level 15.
dialogsBegin.br: Hahaha! Bem-vindo(a) à Loja de Escudos! Você pode comprar escudos, armas e armaduras para Vagrants aqui. Eu tenho todos os equipamentos que você precisa antes de sua primeira mudança de Classe no Nível 15.
dialogsBegin.cns: 哈哈哈~欢迎来到盾牌商店。这里不只盾牌，还有贩卖初心者专用武器和防具。在到达等级15第1次转职以前，来我这里可以购买你需要的装备。
dialogsBegin.de: Willkommen in meinem Laden! Hier kannst du nicht nur Schilde, sondern auch Waffen und Rüstungen für den Vagrant erstehen. Bevor du also Level 15 wirst, kannst du ruhig zu mir kommen und einkaufen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Hahaha! Welcome to the Shield Shop! You can buy shields, weapons, and armor for Vagrants here. I stock all the equipment that you need prior to your first job change at level 15.
dialogsBegin.fil: Hahaha! Welcome to the Shield Shop! You can buy shields, weapons, and armor for Vagrants here. I stock all the equipment that you need prior to your first job change at level 15.
dialogsBegin.fr: (rire) Bienvenue au Magasin de Boucliers. Vous trouverez des boucliers mais aussi armes et armures pour Vagabond. Avant de choisir un métier au niveau 15, vous pourrez vous équiper ici.
dialogsBegin.id: Hahaha! Selamat datang di Shield Shop! Kamu bisa membeli perisai, senjata, dan armor untuk Vagrants di sini. Aku menyediakan semua peralatan yang Kamu butuhkan sebelum perubahan job pertamamu di level 15.
dialogsBegin.it: Hahaha! Welcome to the Shield Shop! You can buy shields, weapons, and armor for Vagrants here. I stock all the equipment that you need prior to your first job change at level 15.
dialogsBegin.jp: ここは、盾だけじゃなく放浪者用の武器と防具を販売しているんだ。レベル15になって1次転職をするまでは、俺の店で装備を整えることになるだろう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 하하하! 방어구 상점에 온 걸 환영해요! 여기선 방랑자님들을 위한 방패, 무기, 방어구를 팔고 있어요. 15레벨이 되어 1차 전직을 하기 전까지 필요한 장비는 전부 있답니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Hahaha! Welcome to the Shield Shop! You can buy shields, weapons, and armor for Vagrants here. I stock all the equipment that you need prior to your first job change at level 15.
dialogsBegin.pl: Hahaha! Welcome to the Shield Shop! You can buy shields, weapons, and armor for Vagrants here. I stock all the equipment that you need prior to your first job change at level 15.
dialogsBegin.ru: Я торгую не только щитами. У меня здесь есть все, что может пригодиться бродяге. Пока не достигнешь пятнадцатого уровня и не выберешь себе амплуа, одевайся у меня!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Jajaja! ¡Te doy la bienvenida a la Tienda de Escudos! Aquí puedes comprar escudos, armas y armaduras para Vagrant. Tengo todo el equipo que necesitas hasta que cambies de clase al alcanzar el nivel 15.
dialogsBegin.sw: Hahaha! Welcome to the Shield Shop! You can buy shields, weapons, and armor for Vagrants here. I stock all the equipment that you need prior to your first job change at level 15.
dialogsBegin.th: ฮ่าๆๆๆ! ยินดีต้อนรับสู่ร้านโล่! คุณสามารถซื้อโล่ อาวุธ และชุดเกราะสำหรับ Vagrants ได้ที่นี่ ฉันมีอุปกรณ์ทั้งหมดที่คุณต้องการก่อนเปลี่ยนอาชีพครั้งแรกที่เลเวล 15
dialogsBegin.tw: 哈哈哈~歡迎來到盾牌店。這裡不只盾牌，還有販賣見習生專用武器和防具。在到達等級 15 第 1 次轉職以前，來我這裡可以購買你需要的裝備。
dialogsBegin.vi: Hahaha! Chào mừng bạn đến với Cửa hàng khiên chắn! Bạn có thể mua khiên, vũ khí và áo giáp cho Vagrant tại đây. Tôi tích trữ tất cả các thiết bị mà bạn cần trước khi thay đổi nhiệm vụ đầu tiên của bạn ở cấp độ 15.

dialogsBegin.en: Why don't you buy a Long Sword with the Penya you've collected? You can buy it by double tapping on it or dragging it into your inventory.
dialogsBegin.ar: Why don't you buy a Long Sword with the Penya you've collected? You can buy it by double tapping on it or dragging it into your inventory.
dialogsBegin.br: Porque você não compra uma Espada Longa usando a Penya que você coletou? Você pode comprá-la clicando duas vezes no item ou arrastando-a para o seu inventário.
dialogsBegin.cns: 即然来到这里，就用你拿到的金币和我买长剑吧。购买方法在道具目录栏上，将你想买的道具拖曳到你的物品栏里，就可以了。
dialogsBegin.de: Warum kaufst du nicht ein Long Sword mit dem Penya, das du gesammelt hast? Du kannst es kaufen, indem du doppelt auf es tippst oder es in dein Inventar ziehst.
dialogsBegin.fi: Why don't you buy a Long Sword with the Penya you've collected? You can buy it by double tapping on it or dragging it into your inventory.
dialogsBegin.fil: Why don't you buy a Long Sword with the Penya you've collected? You can buy it by double tapping on it or dragging it into your inventory.
dialogsBegin.fr: Achetez votre première arme pour Vagabond, une Epée Longue dans ma boutique.
dialogsBegin.id: Mengapa Kau tidak membeli Long Sword dengan Penya yang telah Kau kumpulkan? Kau dapat membelinya dengan mengkliknya dua kali atau menyeretnya ke inventorymu.
dialogsBegin.it: Why don't you buy a Long Sword with the Penya you've collected? You can buy it by double tapping on it or dragging it into your inventory.
dialogsBegin.jp: あんた、俺のところに来るまでに色んな奴に小遣いをもらっただろう？その金(ペニャ)で俺が販売しているロング・ソードを買ってみてくれ。購入の仕方は、俺を左クリックした時のメニューで＜取引＞を選んで「商店ウィンドウ」のアイテムリストで欲しいアイテムを自分のインベントリにドラッグ＆ドロップするだけ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 모은 페냐로 롱 소드를 사 보는 건 어때요? 아이템을 더블 클릭하거나 인벤토리로 드래그해서 구매하시면 된답니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Why don't you buy a Long Sword with the Penya you've collected? You can buy it by double tapping on it or dragging it into your inventory.
dialogsBegin.pl: Why don't you buy a Long Sword with the Penya you've collected? You can buy it by double tapping on it or dragging it into your inventory.
dialogsBegin.ru: Бубохан с Бобоханом дали тебе деньжат на первое время, угадал? Советую потратить их с толком - купить у меня длинный меч! Просто перетащи его в свой инвентарь.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Por qué no compras una espada larga con la Penya que has conseguido? Puedes comprarla dándole dos veces o arrastrándola a tu inventario.
dialogsBegin.sw: Why don't you buy a Long Sword with the Penya you've collected? You can buy it by double tapping on it or dragging it into your inventory.
dialogsBegin.th: ทำไมไม่ซื้อดาบยาวด้วย Penya ที่สะสมมาล่ะ? คุณสามารถซื้อได้โดยแตะสองครั้งที่มันหรือลากเข้าไปในคลังของคุณ
dialogsBegin.tw: 不妨用收集到的金幣買一把長劍吧。點選兩下商品，或將它拖進背包即可購買。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tại sao bạn không mua một thanh kiếm dài với Penya bạn đã thu thập? Bạn có thể mua nó bằng cách nhấn đúp vào nó hoặc kéo nó vào kho của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Also, you can sell an item by dragging it into the shop window. Pretty easy, huh? Okay, after buying it, please visit Losha at the Food Shop.
dialogsBegin.ar: Also, you can sell an item by dragging it into the shop window. Pretty easy, huh? Okay, after buying it, please visit Losha at the Food Shop.
dialogsBegin.br: Você também pode vender itens arrastando-os para a janela da Loja. Muito fácil, não? Certo, depois de comprar, visite Rosha da Loja de Alimentos.
dialogsBegin.cns: 贩卖方法在物品栏里拖曳到道具目录栏里，就可以。非常简单吧？如果你都购买好了，就去饮食店找萝夏吧。
dialogsBegin.de: Ebenso kannst du Gegenstände an mich verkaufen, indem du sie in meinen Laden ziehst. Einfach, oder? So, nun solltest du Losha vom Nahrungsladen aufsuchen
dialogsBegin.fi: Also, you can sell an item by dragging it into the shop window. Pretty easy, huh? Okay, after buying it, please visit Losha at the Food Shop.
dialogsBegin.fil: Also, you can sell an item by dragging it into the shop window. Pretty easy, huh? Okay, after buying it, please visit Losha at the Food Shop.
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous pouvez aussi me vendre des objets en les glissant de votre inventaire dans la fenêtre de mon magasin. Enfantin, n'est ce pas ? Allez discuter avec #cffffdd66Losha la vendeuse d'aliments#nc.
dialogsBegin.id: Juga, Kau dapat menjual item dengan menyeretnya ke shop window. Cukup mudahkan? Oke, setelah membelinya silahkan kunjungi Losha di Food Shop.
dialogsBegin.it: Also, you can sell an item by dragging it into the shop window. Pretty easy, huh? Okay, after buying it, please visit Losha at the Food Shop.
dialogsBegin.jp: もし、自分の持っているアイテムを売りたい時は、インベントリから「商店ウィンドウ」のアイテムリスト欄に売りたいアイテムをドラッグ＆ドロップすれば売ることができるぜ。くれぐれも売るアイテムは間違えないようにな！さてと･･･ロング・ソードを買ったら、フードショップのロシャに会いに行ってくれないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 아이템을 상점 창에 드래그해서 팔 수도 있어요. 간단하죠? 롱 소드를 샀다면, 식료품 상점의 로샤를 방문해 주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Also, you can sell an item by dragging it into the shop window. Pretty easy, huh? Okay, after buying it, please visit Losha at the Food Shop.
dialogsBegin.pl: Also, you can sell an item by dragging it into the shop window. Pretty easy, huh? Okay, after buying it, please visit Losha at the Food Shop.
dialogsBegin.ru: А если хочешь продать что-нибудь мне, перетащи вещь в окно моего магазина. Как купишь меч, загляни к Люше в продуктовую лавку, хорошо?
dialogsBegin.sp: También puedes vender artículos arrastrándolos a la ventana de la tienda. ¿Fácil, no? Muy bien, después de que compres, visita a Losha en la Tienda de Comida.
dialogsBegin.sw: Also, you can sell an item by dragging it into the shop window. Pretty easy, huh? Okay, after buying it, please visit Losha at the Food Shop.
dialogsBegin.th: นอกจากนี้คุณยังสามารถขายสินค้าโดยลากไปที่หน้าต่างร้านค้า ค่อนข้างง่ายใช่มั้ย โอเค ซื้อเสร็จแล้วแวะหา Losha ที่ Food Shop ได้นะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 販賣方法在物品欄裡拖曳到道具目錄欄裡，就可以。非常簡單吧？如果你都購買好了，就去餐飲店找蘿夏吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Ngoài ra, bạn có thể bán một mặt hàng bằng cách kéo nó vào cửa sổ cửa hàng. Khá dễ dàng, phải không? Được rồi, sau khi mua nó, vui lòng ghé thăm Losha tại Cửa hàng thực phẩm.

dialogsAccept.en: Losha at the Food Shop is staying in Eastern Flarine which is located to the east of here. You'll have to cross the bridge to get there.
dialogsAccept.ar: Losha at the Food Shop is staying in Eastern Flarine which is located to the east of here. You'll have to cross the bridge to get there.
dialogsAccept.br: Losha da Loja de Alimentos se localiza a Leste de Flarine. Você deve atravessar a ponte para chegar lá.
dialogsAccept.cns: 饮食店萝夏就在东边的帕里 ，那边会有一座桥，所以你不需要担心。
dialogsAccept.de: Loshas Nahrungsmittelgeschäft ist in Ost-Flaris. Gehe einfach nach Osten über die Brücke.
dialogsAccept.fi: Losha at the Food Shop is staying in Eastern Flarine which is located to the east of here. You'll have to cross the bridge to get there.
dialogsAccept.fil: Losha at the Food Shop is staying in Eastern Flarine which is located to the east of here. You'll have to cross the bridge to get there.
dialogsAccept.fr: L'Epicerie de Losha se situe dans Flarine Est. Il vous faudra traverser le pont. N'oubliez pas votre épée longue.
dialogsAccept.id: Losha dari Food Shop tinggal di Eastern Flarine yang terletak di sebelah timur dari sini. Kau harus menyeberangi jembatan untuk sampai ke sana
dialogsAccept.it: Losha at the Food Shop is staying in Eastern Flarine which is located to the east of here. You'll have to cross the bridge to get there.
dialogsAccept.jp: フードショップは東広場にあるぜ。そこではHPを回復させる食べ物を売っているんだ。ロシャはまだ子供だが、意外としっかり者だし、すぐに仲良くなれるさ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 식료품 상점으로 가려면, 여기서 동쪽으로 가야 해요. 플라리네 동부로 가는 다리를 건너야 한답니다.
dialogsAccept.nl: Losha at the Food Shop is staying in Eastern Flarine which is located to the east of here. You'll have to cross the bridge to get there.
dialogsAccept.pl: Losha at the Food Shop is staying in Eastern Flarine which is located to the east of here. You'll have to cross the bridge to get there.
dialogsAccept.ru: Люша живет в восточной части города, за мостом.
dialogsAccept.sp: Losha, de la Tienda de Comida, se encuentra en Flarine Este, ubicado al este de aquí. Debes cruzar el puente para llegar hasta allí.
dialogsAccept.sw: Losha at the Food Shop is staying in Eastern Flarine which is located to the east of here. You'll have to cross the bridge to get there.
dialogsAccept.th: Food Shop ของ Losha อยู่ใน Eastern Flarine ซึ่งตั้งอยู่ทางทิศตะวันออกของที่นี่ คุณจะต้องข้ามสะพานเพื่อไปที่นั่น
dialogsAccept.tw: 餐飲店蘿夏就在東邊的布拉里斯，那邊會有一座橋，所以你不需要擔心。
dialogsAccept.vi: Losha tại Cửa hàng thực phẩm ở Eastern Flarine, nằm ở phía đông. Bạn sẽ phải băng qua cây cầu để đến đó.

dialogsDecline.en: What, you think it's too far? The Food Shop is very important for your journey, you should definitely check it out.
dialogsDecline.ar: What, you think it's too far? The Food Shop is very important for your journey, you should definitely check it out.
dialogsDecline.br: Você acha que é longe? A Loja de Alimentos é muito importante na sua jornada, recomendo que você a conheça.
dialogsDecline.cns: 你觉得远吗？不过饮食店是卖饮食的重要地方，你一定要知道。
dialogsDecline.de: Du glaubst, das ist zu weit weg? Allerdings ist Loshas Laden sehr wichtig für dich, daher solltest du sie unbedingt einmal besuchen.
dialogsDecline.fi: What, you think it's too far? The Food Shop is very important for your journey, you should definitely check it out.
dialogsDecline.fil: What, you think it's too far? The Food Shop is very important for your journey, you should definitely check it out.
dialogsDecline.fr: Peut-être pensez vous que c'est un peu loin, mais croyez-moi, on ne fait rien de bien le ventre vide. L'épicerie est donc une adresse à connaître.
dialogsDecline.id: Apa, menurutmu itu terlalu jauh? Food Shop sangat penting untuk perjalananmu, pastikan kamu mampir kesana.
dialogsDecline.it: What, you think it's too far? The Food Shop is very important for your journey, you should definitely check it out.
dialogsDecline.jp: なに、めんどくさい？そんなこと言うなよ。誰かが言ってたろ？「マドリガル大陸のみんなが、あんたを歓迎してる」ってな。ロシャも待ってるから、早く会いにいってやりな！
dialogsDecline.kr: 뭐라고요, 너무 멀다고요? 식료품 상점은 모험에 꼭 필요한 곳이에요. 꼭 들러보세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: What, you think it's too far? The Food Shop is very important for your journey, you should definitely check it out.
dialogsDecline.pl: What, you think it's too far? The Food Shop is very important for your journey, you should definitely check it out.
dialogsDecline.ru: Напрасно, напрасно. Даже самому отважному герою нужно время от времени подкрепиться!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Crees que está muy lejos? La Tienda de Comida será muy importante en tu aventura, ¡así que debes conocerla muy bien!
dialogsDecline.sw: What, you think it's too far? The Food Shop is very important for your journey, you should definitely check it out.
dialogsDecline.th: อะไร คุณคิดว่ามันไกลเกินไปเหรอ? ร้านอาหารเป็นสิ่งสำคัญมากสำหรับการเดินทางของคุณ คุณควรลองไปดู
dialogsDecline.tw: 你覺得遠嗎？不過餐飲店是購買食物的重要地方，你一定要知道。
dialogsDecline.vi: Sao, bạn nghĩ nó quá xa? Cửa hàng thực phẩm rất quan trọng cho hành trình của bạn, bạn nhất định nên kiểm tra.

dialogsComplete.en: You are new to Madrigal, right? Hi! I have heard a lot about you already! Here, take this. It's a gift from Luda. Talk to me again for you next task!
dialogsComplete.ar: You are new to Madrigal, right? Hi! I have heard a lot about you already! Here, take this. It's a gift from Luda. Talk to me again for you next task!
dialogsComplete.br: Você é novo em Madrigal, certo? Oi! Eu já ouvi falar de você! Aqui, este é um presente de Luda da Loja de Escudos. Fale comigo novamente para a sua próxima tarefa.
dialogsComplete.cns: 哎唷！是新来到飞飞世界的见习者吗？你好啊，请收下盾牌商店路达大人准备的礼物！如果下次再来找我，就会是最后的见习者教育了。
dialogsComplete.de: Du bist neu bei Madrigal, richtig? Hallo! Ich habe schon viel von dir gehört! Hier, nimm das. Es ist ein Geschenk von Luda. Melde dich wieder bei mir für deine nächste Aufgabe!
dialogsComplete.fi: You are new to Madrigal, right? Hi! I have heard a lot about you already! Here, take this. It's a gift from Luda. Talk to me again for you next task!
dialogsComplete.fil: You are new to Madrigal, right? Hi! I have heard a lot about you already! Here, take this. It's a gift from Luda. Talk to me again for you next task!
dialogsComplete.fr: Mon dieu, vous êtes un débutant dans Flyff, pas vrai ? Bonjour, on m'a déjà parlé de vous. Tenez, voilà la récompense promise par Luda !
dialogsComplete.id: Kau baru di Madrigal, kan? Hai! Aku sudah mendengar banyak tentangmu! Ambil ini. Ini pemberian dari Luda. Bicaralah padaku lagi untuk tugasmu selanjutnya!
dialogsComplete.it: You are new to Madrigal, right? Hi! I have heard a lot about you already! Here, take this. It's a gift from Luda. Talk to me again for you next task!
dialogsComplete.jp: あら！あなたが噂の、新しく来た冒険者のひと？わたしはロシャ、よろしくね！あ、ちょっと待ってね。＜シールドショップ＞のルダさんが用意してくれたプレゼントがあるの。はいっどうぞ！今度はロシャから冒険の宿題を出すね！
dialogsComplete.kr: 어머! 마드리갈에 온 지 얼마 안 된 분이죠? 안녕하세요! 벌써 당신 이야기를 많이 들었어요! 자, 이거 받아요. 루다가 보낸 선물이에요. 다음 과제를 받고 싶으시면 다시 말을 걸어주세요!
dialogsComplete.nl: You are new to Madrigal, right? Hi! I have heard a lot about you already! Here, take this. It's a gift from Luda. Talk to me again for you next task!
dialogsComplete.pl: You are new to Madrigal, right? Hi! I have heard a lot about you already! Here, take this. It's a gift from Luda. Talk to me again for you next task!
dialogsComplete.ru: Я смотрю, в Мадригале появился новый бродячий артист! И знаешь, Людор о тебе уже очень высокого мнения. Держи, он просил передать тебе вот этот щит.
dialogsComplete.sp: Eres nuevo en Madrigal, ¿verdad? ¡Hola! ¡Ya he oído hablar mucho de ti! Mira, ten esto. Es un regalo de Luda. ¡Háblame de nuevo para tu siguiente tarea!
dialogsComplete.sw: You are new to Madrigal, right? Hi! I have heard a lot about you already! Here, take this. It's a gift from Luda. Talk to me again for you next task!
dialogsComplete.th: คุณยังใหม่กับ Madrigal ใช่ไหม สวัสดี! ฉันได้ยินมามากมายเกี่ยวกับคุณแล้ว! เอานี่เลย เป็นของขวัญจากลูด้า มาคุยกับฉันอีกครั้งสำหรับงานต่อไป!
dialogsComplete.tw: 哎唷！是新來到飛飛世界的見習者嗎？你好啊，請收下盾牌店路達大人準備的禮物！如果下次再來找我，就會是最後的見習者教育了。
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn là người mới đến Madrigal, phải không? Xin chào! Tôi đã nghe rất nhiều về bạn rồi! Đây, cầm lấy cái này. Đó là một món quà từ Luda. Nói chuyện với tôi một lần nữa cho nhiệm vụ tiếp theo!

dialogsBegin.de: Der Madrigal-Schönheitswettbewerb benötigt Eronsimint für die Erstellung eines Preises. Wirst du helfen?
dialogsBegin.fi: The Madrigal Beauty Contest needs Eronsimint for making an award. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.fil: Kailangan ng Madrigal Beauty Contest ang Eronsimint para gumawa ng award. Tutulungan mo ba?
dialogsBegin.fr: Les organisateurs du concours de beauté de Madrigal ont besoin d'Eronsimint pour fabriquer des récompense. Peux-tu les aider ?
dialogsBegin.id: The Madrigal Beauty Contest membutuhkan Eronsimint untuk membuat Penghargaan. Bisakah Kamu bantu?
dialogsBegin.it: The Madrigal Beauty Contest needs Eronsimint for making an award. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.jp: ミス・マドリガルコンテストでは、優勝賞品としてなんと優勝者の胸像を作るそうです。私も出ようかしら…。ああ、えっと。そこで、胸像の材料になるイロンシムの収集を依頼しました。依頼を受け取りますか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 마드리갈 미인대회 주최 측에서 우승 상품을 위해 에런시민트를 구해 달라고 부탁합니다. 도와주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: The Madrigal Beauty Contest needs Eronsimint for making an award. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.pl: The Madrigal Beauty Contest needs Eronsimint for making an award. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.ru: The Madrigal Beauty Contest needs Eronsimint for making an award. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.sp: Se necesitan Eronsimints para los premios del Concurso de Belleza de Madrigal. ¿Aceptas esta misión?
dialogsBegin.sw: The Madrigal Beauty Contest needs Eronsimint for making an award. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.th: งานประกวดนางงาม Madrigal ต้องการ Eronsimint สำหรับทำรางวัล คุณจะช่วยไหม
dialogsBegin.tw: 瑪德利賈為了製造美少女選拔賽要使用的獎盃，委託了蒐集材料『綠方石』，你要接受委託嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Cuộc thi Người đẹp Madrigal cần Ironsimint để trao giải. Bạn sẽ giúp chứ?

dialogsBegin.en: Now that you have your very own flying device, I'm going to assign you a test. That's right, a test! Just for fun of course. Hehe~
dialogsBegin.ar: Now that you have your very own flying device, I'm going to assign you a test. That's right, a test! Just for fun of course. Hehe~
dialogsBegin.br: Agora que você tem seu próprio dispositivo voador, vamos para um teste. Isso mesmo, um teste! Só por diversão, é claro. Hehe~
dialogsBegin.cns: 现在你拥有了你自己的飞行器。我将交给你一个测试。没错，一个测试！当然，这只是闹着玩的。哈哈哈~
dialogsBegin.de: Jetzt, da du deinen eigenen Flugapparat hast, werde ich dich einem Test unterziehen. Richtig, ein Test! Natürlich nur zum Spaß. Hehe~
dialogsBegin.fi: Now that you have your very own flying device, I'm going to assign you a test. That's right, a test! Just for fun of course. Hehe~
dialogsBegin.fil: Now that you have your very own flying device, I'm going to assign you a test. That's right, a test! Just for fun of course. Hehe~
dialogsBegin.fr: Maintenant que tu as ton propre engin de vol, je vais te faire passer un test. Oui, c'est ça, un test ! Juste pour s'amuser, bien sûr. Héhé~
dialogsBegin.id: Karena sekarang kamu telah memiliki Flying Devicemu sendiri, aku akan mencoba memberimu sebuah tes. Yup benar, sebuah tes! Tentunya hanya untuk bersenang-senang. Hehe~
dialogsBegin.it: Now that you have your very own flying device, I'm going to assign you a test. That's right, a test! Just for fun of course. Hehe~
dialogsBegin.jp: さてと、君自身の飛行アイテムを手に入れたことだし、あるチャレンジをしてもらいます！そう、テストみたいなものよ！お遊び気分で臨んでもらえたらいいわ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이제 비행 장치까지 구매했으니, 작은 시험을 드릴게요. 맞아요, 시험이에요! 물론 재미 삼아 드리는 거니 걱정은 마세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Now that you have your very own flying device, I'm going to assign you a test. That's right, a test! Just for fun of course. Hehe~
dialogsBegin.pl: Now that you have your very own flying device, I'm going to assign you a test. That's right, a test! Just for fun of course. Hehe~
dialogsBegin.ru: Now that you have your very own flying device, I'm going to assign you a test. That's right, a test! Just for fun of course. Hehe~
dialogsBegin.sp: Ahora que tienes tu propio dispositivo volador, te voy a asignar una prueba. ¡Exactamente, una prueba! Solo por diversión, por supuesto. Jeje~
dialogsBegin.sw: Now that you have your very own flying device, I'm going to assign you a test. That's right, a test! Just for fun of course. Hehe~
dialogsBegin.th: ตอนนี้คุณมีอุปกรณ์บินของตัวเองแล้ว ฉันจะมอบหมายการทดสอบให้คุณ ถูกต้อง การทดสอบ! แน่นอนเพื่อความสนุกสนาน ฮิฮิ~
dialogsBegin.tw: 現在你有了自己的飛行裝置，我要給你安排一個測試。沒錯，就是測試！當然只是為了好玩。呵呵~
dialogsBegin.vi: Bây giờ bạn đã có thiết bị bay của riêng mình, tôi sẽ giao cho bạn một bài kiểm tra. Đúng vậy, một bài kiểm tra! tất nhiên chỉ để cho vui. Hehe ~

dialogsBegin.en: I want you to fly to the North of Saint City, and meet my associate Tina. Once you've arrived, let her know I sent you. She'll know what to do from there. I've sent countless travelers before you!
dialogsBegin.ar: I want you to fly to the North of Saint City, and meet my associate Tina. Once you've arrived, let her know I sent you. She'll know what to do from there. I've sent countless travelers before you!
dialogsBegin.br: Quero que você voe em direção leste até a Cidade de Saint e conheça minha sócia Tina. Assim que você chegar, diga a ela que eu te enviei. Ela saberá o que fazer a partir daí. Já enviei incontáveis viajantes iguais a você!
dialogsBegin.cns: 我希望你飞去晨光的东部，并且与我的助手蒂娜见面。当你到达时，让她知道是我派你过来的。她将会知道后面继续该怎么做。因为在你之前我已经将数不清的旅行者派送过去了。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich möchte, dass du in den Norden von Saint City fliegst und dort meine Mitarbeiterin Tina triffst. Sobald Du angekommen bist, lass sie wissen, dass ich Dich geschickt habe. Sie wird dann wissen, was zu tun ist. Ich habe schon unzählige Reisende vor dir geschickt!
dialogsBegin.fi: I want you to fly to the North of Saint City, and meet my associate Tina. Once you've arrived, let her know I sent you. She'll know what to do from there. I've sent countless travelers before you!
dialogsBegin.fil: I want you to fly to the North of Saint City, and meet my associate Tina. Once you've arrived, let her know I sent you. She'll know what to do from there. I've sent countless travelers before you!
dialogsBegin.fr: Je veux que tu voles vers l'est jusqu'à Saincity, et que tu rencontres ma collègue Tina. Dis-lui que je t'ai envoyé. Elle saura quoi faire ensuite. Je lui ai envoyé plein d'autres voyageurs avant toi !
dialogsBegin.id: Aku ingin kamu terbang menuju Utara dari Saint City dan bertemu dengan rekanku Tina. Saat bertemu dengannya, bilang padanya jika aku yang mengirimmu. Dia telah tahu apa yang harus dilakukan. Aku telah mengirim banyak sekali Traveler sebelum dirimu.
dialogsBegin.it: I want you to fly to the North of Saint City, and meet my associate Tina. Once you've arrived, let her know I sent you. She'll know what to do from there. I've sent countless travelers before you!
dialogsBegin.jp: 東のセイントモーニングに飛んで、街の北にいる同じステーションの＜ティナ＞に会ってきて。到着したらチャレンジだということを伝えてね。きっとたどり着けるはずよ。きっと・・・ね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 세인트 시티 북쪽으로 날아가서 티나를 만나보세요. 도착하면 제가 보냈다고 전해 주세요. 그다음은 티나가 알아서 할 거예요. 지금까지도 수많은 모험가님을 보냈거든요!
dialogsBegin.nl: I want you to fly to the North of Saint City, and meet my associate Tina. Once you've arrived, let her know I sent you. She'll know what to do from there. I've sent countless travelers before you!
dialogsBegin.pl: I want you to fly to the North of Saint City, and meet my associate Tina. Once you've arrived, let her know I sent you. She'll know what to do from there. I've sent countless travelers before you!
dialogsBegin.ru: I want you to fly to the North of Saint City, and meet my associate Tina. Once you've arrived, let her know I sent you. She'll know what to do from there. I've sent countless travelers before you!
dialogsBegin.sp: Quiero que vueles hacia el Norte de Saint y conozcas a mi socia Tina. Cuando llegues, hazle saber que te he enviado yo. Ella sabrá qué hacer a partir de ahí. ¡Ya he enviado a innumerables viajeros antes que a ti!
dialogsBegin.sw: I want you to fly to the North of Saint City, and meet my associate Tina. Once you've arrived, let her know I sent you. She'll know what to do from there. I've sent countless travelers before you!
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันต้องการให้คุณบินไปทางเหนือของ Saint City และพบกับ Tina เพื่อนร่วมงานของฉัน เมื่อคุณมาถึงแล้ว บอกให้เธอรู้ว่าฉันส่งคุณไป เธอจะรู้ว่าต้องทำอะไรจากที่นั่น ฉันได้ส่งนักเดินทางมานับไม่ถ้วนก่อนคุณ!
dialogsBegin.tw: 我要你飛到聖音特北部，見見我的同事蒂娜。一旦你到達，讓她知道我派你來的。從那裡她會知道該怎麼做。在你之前，我已經派出了無數的旅行者！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi muốn bạn bay đến phía Bắc thành phố Saint, và gặp Tina, cộng sự của tôi. Khi bạn đã đến nơi, hãy cho cô ấy biết tôi đã gửi bạn đến. Cô ấy sẽ biết phải làm gì. Tôi đã gửi vô số khách du lịch trước bạn!

dialogsAccept.en: Tina is at Saint City Station. That's the most northern part of Saint City. It's the biggest Station in Madrigal, I'm sure you won't miss it!
dialogsAccept.ar: Tina is at Saint City Station. That's the most northern part of Saint City. It's the biggest Station in Madrigal, I'm sure you won't miss it!
dialogsAccept.br: Tina está na Estação da Cidade de Saint. Fica na parte mais ao norte da cidade. É a maior estação de Madrigal, tenho certeza que você não vai errar!
dialogsAccept.cns: 蒂娜在晨光最北边的晨光飞行站。晨光飞行站是瑞加大陆最大的飞行站，我相信你会找到它的。
dialogsAccept.de: Tina ist am Bahnhof von Saint Morning. Das ist der nördlichste Teil von Saint Morning. Es ist der größte Bahnhof in Madrigal, ich bin sicher, du wirst ihn nicht übersehen!
dialogsAccept.fi: Tina is at Saint City Station. That's the most northern part of Saint City. It's the biggest Station in Madrigal, I'm sure you won't miss it!
dialogsAccept.fil: Tina is at Saint City Station. That's the most northern part of Saint City. It's the biggest Station in Madrigal, I'm sure you won't miss it!
dialogsAccept.fr: Tina est à la Station de Vol de Saincity. Elle est tout au nord de la ville. C'est la plus grande Station de Vol de Madrigal, je suis sûr que tu la trouveras !
dialogsAccept.id: Tina ada di Saint City Station. Tempat itu terletak di bagian paling utara dari Saint City. Aku yakin kamu tidak akan kelewatan karena itu adalah Station terbesar di Madrigal.
dialogsAccept.it: Tina is at Saint City Station. That's the most northern part of Saint City. It's the biggest Station in Madrigal, I'm sure you won't miss it!
dialogsAccept.jp: ＜ティナ＞はセイントモーニングの最北端にあるステーションにいるわ。そうね、マドリガルで一番大きいステーションだからすぐに見つかるはずよ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 티나는 세인트 시티 정류장에 있어요. 세인트 시티 가장 북쪽에 있죠. 마드리갈에서 가장 큰 정류장이니 지나칠 수는 없을 거예요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Tina is at Saint City Station. That's the most northern part of Saint City. It's the biggest Station in Madrigal, I'm sure you won't miss it!
dialogsAccept.pl: Tina is at Saint City Station. That's the most northern part of Saint City. It's the biggest Station in Madrigal, I'm sure you won't miss it!
dialogsAccept.ru: Tina is at Saint City Station. That's the most northern part of Saint City. It's the biggest Station in Madrigal, I'm sure you won't miss it!
dialogsAccept.sp: Tina está en la Estación de Saint. Esa es la parte más al Norte de Saint. Es la Estación más grande de Madrigal, ¡es imposible que te pierdas!
dialogsAccept.sw: Tina is at Saint City Station. That's the most northern part of Saint City. It's the biggest Station in Madrigal, I'm sure you won't miss it!
dialogsAccept.th: Tina อยู่ที่ สถานี Saint City นั่นคือส่วนเหนือสุดของ Saint City มันเป็นสถานีที่ใหญ่ที่สุดใน Madrigal ฉันแน่ใจว่าคุณจะไม่พลาดมัน!
dialogsAccept.tw: 蒂娜在聖音特站，那是聖音特的最北端，這是瑪德利賈最大的車站，我相信你不會錯過的！
dialogsAccept.vi: Tina đang ở Saint City Station. Đó là khu vực nằm hẳn phía bắc của Saint City. Đó là Nhà ga lớn nhất ở Madrigal, tôi chắc chắn bạn sẽ không bỏ lỡ nó!

dialogsDecline.en: Not ready yet? That's fine. Just let me know when you're up to the task.
dialogsDecline.ar: Not ready yet? That's fine. Just let me know when you're up to the task.
dialogsDecline.br: Não se sente pronto(a)? Tudo bem. Quando estiver confiante para fazer a tarefa é só me avisar.
dialogsDecline.cns: 还没准备好？好吧。当你准备好执行任务的时候请告诉我。
dialogsDecline.de: Noch nicht bereit? Das ist kein Problem. Lass mich einfach wissen, wenn du der Aufgabe gewachsen bist.
dialogsDecline.fi: Not ready yet? That's fine. Just let me know when you're up to the task.
dialogsDecline.fil: Not ready yet? That's fine. Just let me know when you're up to the task.
dialogsDecline.fr: Pas encore prêt ? Pas de problème. Reviens me voir quand tu te sentiras prêt.
dialogsDecline.id: Masih belum siap? Tidak apa. Beritahu saja aku saat kamu telah siap.
dialogsDecline.it: Not ready yet? That's fine. Just let me know when you're up to the task.
dialogsDecline.jp: 焦らなくていいわ。初めては怖いわよね。心の準備ができたら教えてね。
dialogsDecline.kr: 아직 준비가 안 되셨나요? 괜찮아요. 준비되셨을 때 말씀해 주세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Not ready yet? That's fine. Just let me know when you're up to the task.
dialogsDecline.pl: Not ready yet? That's fine. Just let me know when you're up to the task.
dialogsDecline.ru: Not ready yet? That's fine. Just let me know when you're up to the task.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿No estás listo todavía? Está bien. Avísame cuando estés preparado para la tarea.
dialogsDecline.sw: Not ready yet? That's fine. Just let me know when you're up to the task.
dialogsDecline.th: ยังไม่พร้อมเหรอ? ไม่เป็นไร ถ้าคุณพร้อมเมื่อไหร่ก็บอกเรา
dialogsDecline.tw: 還沒有準備好？沒關係。當你完成任務時告訴我。
dialogsDecline.vi: Chưa sẵn sàng? Được rồi. Chỉ cần cho tôi biết khi nào bạn hoàn thành nhiệm vụ.

dialogsComplete.en: What's this? Dior sent you? Another traveler taking Diors Flying test? You're the first one in a while! Just give me a moment. I'll be with you shortly.
dialogsComplete.ar: What's this? Dior sent you? Another traveler taking Diors Flying test? You're the first one in a while! Just give me a moment. I'll be with you shortly.
dialogsComplete.br: Huh? A Dior mandou você? Outro viajante fazendo o teste de voo da Dior? Já faz um tempo desde o último viajante! Apenas me dê um momentinho. Te atenderei rapidinho!
dialogsComplete.cns: 这是什么？是迪奥派你来的吗？又一个接受了迪奥飞行测试的旅行者吗？你是这段时间第一个到达我这里的人！请等我一会，我马上就过来。
dialogsComplete.de: Was ist los? Dior schickt dich? Noch ein Reisender, der Diors Flugtest macht? Du bist der Erste seit langem! Gib mir nur einen Moment. Ich bin gleich bei dir.
dialogsComplete.fi: What's this? Dior sent you? Another traveler taking Diors Flying test? You're the first one in a while! Just give me a moment. I'll be with you shortly.
dialogsComplete.fil: What's this? Dior sent you? Another traveler taking Diors Flying test? You're the first one in a while! Just give me a moment. I'll be with you shortly.
dialogsComplete.fr: Hum, oui ? Dior t'a envoyé ? Tu es un voyageur et tu as passé son test ? Ah, ça faisait longtemps que je n'en avais pas eu ! Donne moi un moment, je suis presque prêt.
dialogsComplete.id: Ada apa ini? Dior mengirimmu? Traveler lain yang mengikuti tes terbang DIor? Kamu adalah yang pertama dalam beberapa saat ini! Beri aku waktu sebentar. Aku akan menemanimu setelah ini.
dialogsComplete.it: What's this? Dior sent you? Another traveler taking Diors Flying test? You're the first one in a while! Just give me a moment. I'll be with you shortly.
dialogsComplete.jp: あらどうしたの？ディオールからのチャレンジですって？わぁ！久しぶりだわ！少し待ってね、すぐ行くわ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 네? 디올이 보냈다고요? 새롭게 비행 시험을 치르는 분이군요. 한동안 안 보이더니! 잠시만 기다려주세요. 금방 준비할게요.
dialogsComplete.nl: What's this? Dior sent you? Another traveler taking Diors Flying test? You're the first one in a while! Just give me a moment. I'll be with you shortly.
dialogsComplete.pl: What's this? Dior sent you? Another traveler taking Diors Flying test? You're the first one in a while! Just give me a moment. I'll be with you shortly.
dialogsComplete.ru: What's this? Dior sent you? Another traveler taking Diors Flying test? You're the first one in a while! Just give me a moment. I'll be with you shortly.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿Qué es esto? ¿Dior te ha enviado? ¿Otro viajero que realiza la Prueba Voladora de Dior? ¡Eres el primero en mucho tiempo! Dame un momento. Estaré contigo en breve.
dialogsComplete.sw: What's this? Dior sent you? Another traveler taking Diors Flying test? You're the first one in a while! Just give me a moment. I'll be with you shortly.
dialogsComplete.th: อะไรนะ? Dior ส่งคุณมาเหรอ? นักเดินทางหน้าใหม่ทำการทดสอบการบินของ Dior? คุณเป็นคนแรกในรอลนานมาแล้ว! ฉันขอเวลาสักครู่ แล้วฉันจะมาคุยกับคุณ
dialogsComplete.tw: 這是什麼？寶雅送你來的？另一位參加寶雅飛行測試的旅行者？你是一段時間內的第一個！給我一點時間，我很快就會和你在一起。
dialogsComplete.vi: Đây là gì? Dior đã gửi cho bạn đến? Một du khách khác đang thực hiện bài thi Diors Flying? Đôi khi bạn là người đầu tiên! Chờ tôi chút. Tôi sẽ đến với bạn ngay thôi.
