description.en: Defeat Clocks, who is caged just outside of Darken. You may need some help.
description.ar: Defeat Clocks, who is caged just outside of Darken. You may need some help.
description.br: A jaula de Clocks fica fora de Darken. Você deve derrotá-lo, mas não pense que pode fazer isso sozinho.
description.cns: 克拉斯位于达肯3！你必须组队一起去挑战才行！
description.de: Der Käfig von Clocks ist außerhalb von Darkon City. Du musst ihn besiegen, aber ich glaube nicht, dass du das alleine schaffst.
description.fi: Defeat Clocks, who is caged just outside of Darken. You may need some help.
description.fil: Defeat Clocks, who is caged just outside of Darken. You may need some help.
description.fr: Vaincre Clocks qui est enfermé à l'extérieur de Darken.
description.id: Kalahkan Clocks, yang dikurung di luar Darken. Kamu mungkin membutuhkan bantuan.
description.it: Defeat Clocks, who is caged just outside of Darken. You may need some help.
description.jp: ダーコン第2地区の西側にある外壁近くに用意された＜クロックス＞を倒しましょう。
description.kr: 다켄 외곽에 갇혀 있는 클락스를 처치하세요. 혼자서 힘들다면 도움을 받으세요.
description.nl: Defeat Clocks, who is caged just outside of Darken. You may need some help.
description.pl: Defeat Clocks, who is caged just outside of Darken. You may need some help.
description.ru: Нужно одолеть Миничаса на окраине Даркенбурга. Скорее всего, мне понадобится помощь.
description.sp: Derrota a Clocks, que está enjaulado a las afueras de Darken. Puede que necesites algo de ayuda.
description.sw: Defeat Clocks, who is caged just outside of Darken. You may need some help.
description.th: เอาชนะ Clocks ซึ่งถูกขังอยู่นอก Darken คุณอาจต้องการความช่วยเหลือ
description.tw: 克拉斯位於時空毀滅者囚籠！你必須組隊一起去挑戰才行！
description.vi: Đánh bại Clocks, kẻ bị nhốt ngay bên ngoài Darken. Bạn có thể cần một số trợ giúp.

dialogsBegin.en: Well, it looks like you have all the information you need about Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.ar: Well, it looks like you have all the information you need about Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.br: Agora você tem todas as informações a respeito de Clockworks. Mas se não usá-las, você as perderá!
dialogsBegin.cns: 你对时空毁灭者应该有一定程度的了解，现在就要来真的了！
dialogsBegin.de: Jetzt hast du alle Informationen über Clockworks. Wenn du sie nicht nutzt, wirst du verlieren!
dialogsBegin.fi: Well, it looks like you have all the information you need about Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.fil: Well, it looks like you have all the information you need about Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu détiens maintenant toutes les informations nécessaires sur Clockworks. Mais avant cela.
dialogsBegin.id: Sepertinya kamu memiliki semua informasi yang kamu butuhkan tentang Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.it: Well, it looks like you have all the information you need about Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.jp: クロックワークスに関する理論はこれにて終了です。最後のステップは実践編です。どんな理論も活用しなければ無駄になりますからね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이제 클락워크에 대해 충분히 알게 되셨겠죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: Well, it looks like you have all the information you need about Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.pl: Well, it looks like you have all the information you need about Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.ru: Ну, теперь ты знаешь о Часонизме все, что нужно.
dialogsBegin.sp: Bueno, parece que tienes toda la información que necesitas sobre Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.sw: Well, it looks like you have all the information you need about Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.th: ดูเหมือนว่าคุณมีข้อมูลทั้งหมดที่คุณต้องการเกี่ยวกับ Clockworks
dialogsBegin.tw: 你對時空毀滅者應該有一定程度的了解，現在就要來真的囉！
dialogsBegin.vi: Có vẻ như bạn có tất cả thông tin cần thiết về Clockworks.

dialogsBegin.en: So, after all that, the masterpiece of Darkon was created, Clocks! What? You don't know what Clocks is?
dialogsBegin.ar: So, after all that, the masterpiece of Darkon was created, Clocks! What? You don't know what Clocks is?
dialogsBegin.br: Então, depois de tudo isso, a obra-prima de Darkon, Clocks foi criada! Hum? Você não sabe o que é Clocks?
dialogsBegin.cns: 【克拉斯】！！你知道是什么吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Ich hab das gebaut. Das Meisterstück von Darkon, Clocks! Huch? Du weißt nicht was Clocks ist?
dialogsBegin.fi: So, after all that, the masterpiece of Darkon was created, Clocks! What? You don't know what Clocks is?
dialogsBegin.fil: So, after all that, the masterpiece of Darkon was created, Clocks! What? You don't know what Clocks is?
dialogsBegin.fr: J'aimerais que tu me prouves que tu es en mesure de vaincre Clockworks. Pour cela j'ai conçu ce que je considère être mon chef d'oeuvre : Clocks.
dialogsBegin.id: Jadi, setelah semua itu, mahakarya Darkon telah dibuat, Jam! Apa? Kamu tidak tahu apa itu Jam?
dialogsBegin.it: So, after all that, the masterpiece of Darkon was created, Clocks! What? You don't know what Clocks is?
dialogsBegin.jp: そこで用意しましたよ。ダーコンの誇る科学技術の結晶＜クロックス＞を！これを見事討ち破ってください！……え？クロックスを知らない？
dialogsBegin.kr: 하여튼 그렇게, 다콘의 걸작이라 불리는 클락스가 만들어졌답니다. 뭐라고요? 클락스가 뭔지 모른다고요?
dialogsBegin.nl: So, after all that, the masterpiece of Darkon was created, Clocks! What? You don't know what Clocks is?
dialogsBegin.pl: So, after all that, the masterpiece of Darkon was created, Clocks! What? You don't know what Clocks is?
dialogsBegin.ru: По образу и подобию гигантского монстра был создан Миничас - механическое чудо Даркона. Как, ты не знаешь, кто такой Миничас?!
dialogsBegin.sp: Así que, después de todo, la obra maestra de Darkon fue creada, ¡Clocks! ¿Qué? ¿No sabes qué es Clocks?
dialogsBegin.sw: So, after all that, the masterpiece of Darkon was created, Clocks! What? You don't know what Clocks is?
dialogsBegin.th: หลังจากทั้งหมดที่ผลงานชิ้นเอกของ Darkon ถูกสร้างขึ้น Clocks! อะไร? คุณไม่รู้ว่า Clocks คืออะไร?
dialogsBegin.tw: 就這樣，得肯的傑作「克拉斯」終於誕生了！什麼？你不知道克拉斯是什麼？
dialogsBegin.vi: Vì vậy, sau tất cả, kiệt tác của Darkon đã được tạo ra, Clocks! Gì cơ? Bạn không biết Clocks là gì?

dialogsBegin.en: It's like a small version of Clockworks. We made it for the people who want to challenge Clockworks, so they can practice first!
dialogsBegin.ar: It's like a small version of Clockworks. We made it for the people who want to challenge Clockworks, so they can practice first!
dialogsBegin.br: É como uma versão pequena de Clockworks. Nós o fizemos para que as pessoas que queiram enfrentar Clockworks possam treinar primeiro.
dialogsBegin.cns: 那是为了挑战时空毁灭者的人，而准备的人工魔域怪！
dialogsBegin.de: Es ist eine kleinere Variante von Clockworks. Wir haben sie für die Leute gebaut, die gegen Clockworks antreten wollen damit sie damit trainieren können.
dialogsBegin.fi: It's like a small version of Clockworks. We made it for the people who want to challenge Clockworks, so they can practice first!
dialogsBegin.fil: It's like a small version of Clockworks. We made it for the people who want to challenge Clockworks, so they can practice first!
dialogsBegin.fr: C'est comme une version miniature de Clockworks. Je l'ai imaginé pour que ceux qui veulent défier Clockworks puissent s'entraîner au préalable.
dialogsBegin.id: Ini seperti versi kecil dari Clockworks. Kami membuatnya untuk orang-orang yang ingin menantang Clockworks, sehingga mereka dapat berlatih terlebih dahulu!
dialogsBegin.it: It's like a small version of Clockworks. We made it for the people who want to challenge Clockworks, so they can practice first!
dialogsBegin.jp: クロックスは、クロックワークスから集めたデータを元に作られた第2のクロックワークスです。……まあ、かなり縮小、弱体化していますけど。
dialogsBegin.kr: 클락스는 클락워크의 축소판 같은 존재예요. 클락워크에 도전하고 싶은 사람들을 위해 연습용으로 만든 녀석이랍니다!
dialogsBegin.nl: It's like a small version of Clockworks. We made it for the people who want to challenge Clockworks, so they can practice first!
dialogsBegin.pl: It's like a small version of Clockworks. We made it for the people who want to challenge Clockworks, so they can practice first!
dialogsBegin.ru: Это уменьшенная копия Часонизма. Вроде тренажера для тех, кто хочет сразиться с гигантом.
dialogsBegin.sp: Es como una versión pequeña de Clockworks. ¡Lo creamos para las personas que quieren desafiar a Clockworks, para que puedan practicar primero!
dialogsBegin.sw: It's like a small version of Clockworks. We made it for the people who want to challenge Clockworks, so they can practice first!
dialogsBegin.th: เหมือนกับ Clockworks รุ่นเล็กๆ เราทำมันขึ้นสำหรับคนที่ต้องการที่จะท้าทาย Clockworks เพื่อให้พวกเขาสามารถฝึกฝนได้ในครั้งแรก!
dialogsBegin.tw: 那是為了挑戰時空毀滅者的人，而準備的人工魔域怪！
dialogsBegin.vi: Nó giống như một phiên bản nhỏ của Clockworks. Chúng tôi tạo ra nó cho những người muốn thách thức Clockworks, vì vậy họ có thể thực hành trước!

dialogsBegin.en: Since you're on your way to becoming the next challenger, why don't you practice a bit, first?
dialogsBegin.ar: Since you're on your way to becoming the next challenger, why don't you practice a bit, first?
dialogsBegin.br: Por que você não pratica com ele?
dialogsBegin.cns: 请做好准备~加油！
dialogsBegin.de: Nun, warum willst du nicht mal üben?
dialogsBegin.fi: Since you're on your way to becoming the next challenger, why don't you practice a bit, first?
dialogsBegin.fil: Since you're on your way to becoming the next challenger, why don't you practice a bit, first?
dialogsBegin.fr: Penses-tu être capable de battre mon chef d'oeuvre ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karena kamu sedang dalam perjalanan untuk menjadi penantang berikutnya, mengapa kamu tidak berlatih sedikit dulu?
dialogsBegin.it: Since you're on your way to becoming the next challenger, why don't you practice a bit, first?
dialogsBegin.jp: クロックワークスの全貌はまだ未知のベールに覆い隠されていますからね。それでも、クロックワークスとの模擬戦にはもってこいの相手です。どうです？戦ってみませんか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 클락워크에 도전할 거라면, 먼저 연습부터 해보는 게 어때요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Since you're on your way to becoming the next challenger, why don't you practice a bit, first?
dialogsBegin.pl: Since you're on your way to becoming the next challenger, why don't you practice a bit, first?
dialogsBegin.ru: Потренируйся-ка и ты. Отваги хватит?
dialogsBegin.sp: Ya que vas a convertirte en el próximo retador, ¿por qué no practicas un poco primero?
dialogsBegin.sw: Since you're on your way to becoming the next challenger, why don't you practice a bit, first?
dialogsBegin.th: ทำไมคุณถึงไม่ฝึกซ้อมก่อนล่ะ?
dialogsBegin.tw: 既然你正朝下一位挑戰者的目標前進，何不先練習一下？
dialogsBegin.vi: Vì bạn đang trên đường trở thành người thách thức tiếp theo, tại sao bạn không luyện tập một chút trước?

dialogsAccept.en: Clocks' Cage is outside of Darken. You'll have to defeat it, but you'll probably need some help.
dialogsAccept.ar: Clocks' Cage is outside of Darken. You'll have to defeat it, but you'll probably need some help.

dialogsAccept.fil: Clocks' Cage is outside of Darken. You'll have to defeat it, but you'll probably need some help.
dialogsAccept.fr: Clocks est enfermé juste à l'extérieur de Darken. Tu dois le vaincre, mais tes chances d'accomplir ce miracle seul sont très faibles !
dialogsAccept.id: Clocks' Cage berada di luar Darken. Kamu harus mengalahkannya, tetapi kamu mungkin membutuhkan bantuan.

dialogsAccept.kr: 다켄 외곽에 클락스의 감옥이 있어요. 혼자서 힘들다면 다른 이의 도움을 받도록 하세요.

dialogsAccept.pl: Clocks' Cage is outside of Darken. You'll have to defeat it, but you'll probably need some help.
dialogsAccept.ru: Миничаса держат в Часовой клетке на окраине Даркенбурга. Советую идти на него с труппой хороших и опытных артистов.
dialogsAccept.sp: La Jaula de Clocks está a las afueras de Darken. Tendrás que derrotarlo, pero seguramente necesitarás ayuda.
dialogsAccept.sw: Clocks' Cage is outside of Darken. You'll have to defeat it, but you'll probably need some help.
dialogsAccept.th: Clocks อยู่ด้านนอกของ Darken คุณจะต้องกำจัดมัน แต่คุณอาจต้องการความช่วยเหลือจากเพื่อนๆ ในปาร์ตี้
dialogsAccept.tw: 克拉斯位於時空毀滅者囚籠！你必須組隊一起去挑戰才行，加油吧！！
dialogsAccept.vi: Clocks' Cage nằm ngoài Darken. Bạn sẽ phải đánh bại nó, nhưng có thể bạn sẽ cần một số trợ giúp.

dialogsDecline.fi: I knew you were a coward! Hahaha!
dialogsDecline.fil: I knew you were a coward! Hahaha!
dialogsDecline.fr: Aurais-tu peur ? Ha ha ha ! Ok, alors reviens me voir quand tu seras prêt.
dialogsDecline.id: Aku tahu kamu pengecut! Hahaha!
dialogsDecline.it: I knew you were a coward! Hahaha!
dialogsDecline.jp: あなたという人は…クロックスまで作り上げて、冒険者を鍛えているダーコン市長の気持ちがわからないのですか？
dialogsDecline.kr: 역시 실전은 겁이 나시나요? 하하하!
dialogsDecline.nl: I knew you were a coward! Hahaha!
dialogsDecline.pl: I knew you were a coward! Hahaha!
dialogsDecline.ru: Я так и знал, что ты струсишь! Ха-ха-ха!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Sabía que eras un cobarde! ¡Jajaja!
dialogsDecline.sw: I knew you were a coward! Hahaha!
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันรู้ว่าคุณเป็นคนขี้ขลาด! ฮ่าๆๆ!
dialogsDecline.tw: 感到恐懼害怕了嗎？哈哈哈！那下次再來找我吧！

dialogsComplete.en: Congratulations! Now, you are ready to challenge Clockworks. You better be prepared or you'll get squished!
dialogsComplete.ar: Congratulations! Now, you are ready to challenge Clockworks. You better be prepared or you'll get squished!
dialogsComplete.br: Ah, eu sabia que você não era uma pessoa comum. Que maravilha! Agora você pode desafiar Clockworks! Parabéns!!
dialogsComplete.cns: 恭喜你！你真厉害，已经有资格参加挑战时空毁灭者了！
dialogsComplete.de: Oh, ich wuste dass du keine gewöhnliche Person bist. Wie toll!! Nun kannst du Clockworks herausfordern. Gratulation!!
dialogsComplete.fi: Congratulations! Now, you are ready to challenge Clockworks. You better be prepared or you'll get squished!
dialogsComplete.fil: Congratulations! Now, you are ready to challenge Clockworks. You better be prepared or you'll get squished!
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh, je savais bien que tu avais quelque chose de différent des gens ordinaires. Magnifique! Maintenant tu peux défier les Clockworks! Félicitations!!
dialogsComplete.id: Selamat! Sekarang, kamu siap untuk menantang Clockworks. Kamu sebaiknya bersiap-siap atau kamu akan terjepit!
dialogsComplete.it: Congratulations! Now, you are ready to challenge Clockworks. You better be prepared or you'll get squished!
dialogsComplete.jp: おほほほっ。よくってよ！あなたにクロックワークスへの挑戦権を与えますわ！南にある＜奈落～歯車の永久牢獄＞へお行きなさい。……うふふ。また一人、マドリカルに戦士が誕生したようですわね。
dialogsComplete.kr: 축하해요! 이제 클락워크에 도전할 자격을 갖췄네요. 제대로 준비하지 않으면 한순간에 당할 수도 있으니 조심하세요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Congratulations! Now, you are ready to challenge Clockworks. You better be prepared or you'll get squished!
dialogsComplete.pl: Congratulations! Now, you are ready to challenge Clockworks. You better be prepared or you'll get squished!
dialogsComplete.ru: Отлично. Теперь ты знаешь все. Можешь смело бросать вызов Часонизму. Удачи!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Felicidades! Ahora, estás listo para desafiar a Clockworks. ¡Será mejor que te prepares o te aplastará!
dialogsComplete.sw: Congratulations! Now, you are ready to challenge Clockworks. You better be prepared or you'll get squished!
dialogsComplete.th: ขอแสดงความยินดี! ตอนนี้คุณพร้อมที่จะท้าทาย Clockworks แล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 恭喜你！你真厲害，已經有資格參加挑戰時空毀滅者囉！！
dialogsComplete.vi: Xin chúc mừng! Bây giờ, bạn đã sẵn sàng để thách thức Clockworks. Bạn nên chuẩn bị tốt nếu không bạn sẽ bị nghiền nát!

dialogsFail.en: Don't be fooled by his size, Clocks is almost as powerful as Clockworks.
dialogsFail.ar: Don't be fooled by his size, Clocks is almost as powerful as Clockworks.
dialogsFail.br: Não é fácil derrotar Clocks. Ele é pequeno, mas tem quase o mesmo poder que Clockworks.
dialogsFail.cns: 千万不可以小看克拉斯喔！他力量可不输时空毁灭者呢！
dialogsFail.de: Es ist nicht einfach Clocks zu besiegen. Er ist klein, aber er hat beinahe genauso viel Kraft wie Clockworks.
dialogsFail.fi: Don't be fooled by his size, Clocks is almost as powerful as Clockworks.
dialogsFail.fil: Don't be fooled by his size, Clocks is almost as powerful as Clockworks.
dialogsFail.fr: Attention car il n'est pas si facile de battre le mini Clockworks. Il est petit, mais dispose d'une grande puissance.
dialogsFail.id: Jangan terkecoh dengan ukurannya, Clocks hampir sekuat Clockworks.
dialogsFail.it: Don't be fooled by his size, Clocks is almost as powerful as Clockworks.
dialogsFail.jp: 愛しいダーコン市民が心血を注いだ＜クロックス＞を甘く見ないことですわ。クロックワークス並の性能を誇る自律型の破壊兵器ですわよ。ちなみに、あの可愛らしい姿は私のデザインですわ。おほほほ。
dialogsFail.kr: 클락스를 너무 만만하게 보시면 안 됩니다. 모습은 작아도 위력은 클락워크만큼이나 강력하거든요.
dialogsFail.nl: Don't be fooled by his size, Clocks is almost as powerful as Clockworks.
dialogsFail.pl: Don't be fooled by his size, Clocks is almost as powerful as Clockworks.
dialogsFail.ru: Не смотри, что он маленький - Миничас почти так же силен, как сам Часонизм.
dialogsFail.sp: No te dejes engañar por su tamaño, Clocks es casi tan poderoso como Clockworks.
dialogsFail.sw: Don't be fooled by his size, Clocks is almost as powerful as Clockworks.
dialogsFail.th: อย่าประมาทขนาดของ Clocks เพราะมันมีพละกำลังเท่า Clockworks เลยนะ
dialogsFail.tw: 千萬不可以小看克拉斯喔！他力量可不輸時空毀滅者呢！
dialogsFail.vi: Đừng để bị lừa bởi kích thước của anh ta, Clocks có sức mạnh gần như Clockworks.

dialogsBegin.en: Oh that little brat! He is out of his mind! That’s it, when I find him he is getting a spanking more terrifying than Shade's fury!!!
dialogsBegin.ar: Oh that little brat! He is out of his mind! That’s it, when I find him he is getting a spanking more terrifying than Shade's fury!!!
dialogsBegin.br: Oh aquele pirralho! Ele está louco! Já deu, quando eu encontrá-lo, ele vai levar uma surra mais terrível do que a fúria de Shade!!!
dialogsBegin.cns: 这个小家伙！他真的是疯了！当我找到他，我一定会狠狠的教训他，让他知道我比幽影谢莉德还要恐怖！！！
dialogsBegin.de: Oh, dieser kleine Bengel! Er hat den Verstand verloren! Das war's, wenn ich ihn finde, bekommt er eine Tracht Prügel, die furchterregender ist als Shades Wut!!!
dialogsBegin.fi: Oh that little brat! He is out of his mind! That’s it, when I find him he is getting a spanking more terrifying than Shade's fury!!!
dialogsBegin.fil: Oh that little brat! He is out of his mind! That’s it, when I find him he is getting a spanking more terrifying than Shade's fury!!!
dialogsBegin.fr: Ce gosse va me faire devenir chèvre.
dialogsBegin.id: Dasar bocah tengik! Dia sudah gila ya! Saat saya menemukannya, dia akan mendapatkan pukulan yang lebih menakutkan daripada kemarahan Shade!!!
dialogsBegin.it: Oh that little brat! He is out of his mind! That’s it, when I find him he is getting a spanking more terrifying than Shade's fury!!!
dialogsBegin.jp: あの子ったらいつのまに大人になって……オロロロロロロロ（ルジナはとても号泣している
dialogsBegin.kr: 이놈의 자식! 완전히 정신이 나갔네! 이번에 잡히기만 해 봐라! 쉐이드의 분노보다 더 무섭게 혼쭐을 내주겠어!!!
dialogsBegin.nl: Oh that little brat! He is out of his mind! That’s it, when I find him he is getting a spanking more terrifying than Shade's fury!!!
dialogsBegin.pl: Oh that little brat! He is out of his mind! That’s it, when I find him he is getting a spanking more terrifying than Shade's fury!!!
dialogsBegin.ru: Что за негодник! Он совсем с ума сошёл! Доберусь я до него - получит трёпку похуже гнева Тени!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Uy, ese mocoso! ¡No sabe lo que está haciendo! ¡¡¡Cuando lo encuentre va a recibir una paliza más aterradora que la furia de Shade!!!
dialogsBegin.sw: Oh that little brat! He is out of his mind! That’s it, when I find him he is getting a spanking more terrifying than Shade's fury!!!
dialogsBegin.th: โอ้ เจ้าหนูน้อยนั่น! เขาเสียสติไปแล้ว! แค่นั้นแหละ พอฉันเจอเขา เขาก็โดนตบอย่างน่ากลัวยิ่งกว่าความโกรธของเชดเสียอีก!!!
dialogsBegin.tw: 哦，那個小傢伙！他瘋了！就是這樣，當我找到他時，他被打得比闇影的憤怒還可怕！！！
dialogsBegin.vi: Ôi con nhóc đó! Anh ấy mất trí rồi! Vậy đó, khi tôi tìm thấy anh ấy, anh ấy sẽ nhận được một đòn đánh còn kinh hoàng hơn cả cơn thịnh nộ của Shade !!!

dialogsBegin.en: Oh, by the way! The Mayor of Saint City is looking for you in hurry. I really should go find my son now. I still owe you a meal sometime so come back and see us!
dialogsBegin.ar: Oh, by the way! The Mayor of Saint City is looking for you in hurry. I really should go find my son now. I still owe you a meal sometime so come back and see us!
dialogsBegin.br: Ah, a propósito! O Prefeito está te procurando, ele parecia estar com pressa. Eu realmente deveria ir encontrar meu filho agora. Eu ainda te devo uma refeição algum dia, então nos visite qualquer dia!
dialogsBegin.cns: 噢，顺便说一句！晨光市长正在焦急的找你。我现在真得去找我的儿子了。我还欠你一顿饭喔，记得偶尔回来看看我们！
dialogsBegin.de: Ach, übrigens! Der Bürgermeister von Saint City sucht dich dringend. Ich sollte jetzt wirklich meinen Sohn suchen gehen. Ich schulde dir noch ein Essen, also komm wieder und besuch uns!
dialogsBegin.fi: Oh, by the way! The Mayor of Saint City is looking for you in hurry. I really should go find my son now. I still owe you a meal sometime so come back and see us!
dialogsBegin.fil: Oh, by the way! The Mayor of Saint City is looking for you in hurry. I really should go find my son now. I still owe you a meal sometime so come back and see us!
dialogsBegin.fr: J'allais oublier, le maire de Saincity vous cherchait tout à l'heure. Vous commencez à vraiment devenir quelqu'un d'important.
dialogsBegin.id: Ngomong-ngomong, Walikota Saint City sedang mencarimu dengan tergesa-gesa. Saya harus segera mencari anak saya sekarang. Saya masih berhutang makan padamu, jadi kapan-kapan kembalilah dan temui kami!
dialogsBegin.it: Oh, by the way! The Mayor of Saint City is looking for you in hurry. I really should go find my son now. I still owe you a meal sometime so come back and see us!
dialogsBegin.jp: あら、いやだ。私ったら親バカみたいね。そうだ。貴方のことを市長が探していたわよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 아, 맞다! 세인트 시티 시장님께서 급히 찾으시더군요. 전 이만 제 아들을 찾으러 가 볼게요. 밥이라도 사드려야 하는데... 나중에 꼭 다시 들러주세요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Oh, by the way! The Mayor of Saint City is looking for you in hurry. I really should go find my son now. I still owe you a meal sometime so come back and see us!
dialogsBegin.pl: Oh, by the way! The Mayor of Saint City is looking for you in hurry. I really should go find my son now. I still owe you a meal sometime so come back and see us!
dialogsBegin.ru: Кстати, тебя тут мэр Санто искал. Он спешил и был очень взволнован! А я пойду за сыном. Заходи как-нибудь пообедать, я твоя должница.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Ah por cierto! El Alcalde de Saint te está buscando urgentemente. Yo debería ir a buscar a mi hijo. Todavía te debo una comida, ¡así que vuelve a visitarnos en otro momento!
dialogsBegin.sw: Oh, by the way! The Mayor of Saint City is looking for you in hurry. I really should go find my son now. I still owe you a meal sometime so come back and see us!
dialogsBegin.th: อ้อ อีกอย่าง! นายกเทศมนตรีเมืองเซนต์กำลังมองหาคุณอย่างเร่งรีบ ฉันควรไปหาลูกชายของฉันตอนนี้จริงๆ ฉันยังเป็นหนี้คุณอยู่บ้าง กลับมาหาเรานะ!
dialogsBegin.tw: 哦，順便說一句！聖音特市長急著找你。我現在真的應該去找我兒子了，我還欠你一頓飯，所以你要回來看看我們喔！
dialogsBegin.vi: À, nhân tiện! Thị trưởng thành phố Saint đang gấp rút tìm anh. Tôi thực sự nên đi tìm con trai tôi bây giờ. Tôi vẫn còn nợ bạn một bữa ăn đôi khi trở lại và gặp chúng tôi!

dialogsAccept.nl: Go see the Mayor of Saint City. I gotta go now. See you!
dialogsAccept.pl: Go see the Mayor of Saint City. I gotta go now. See you!

dialogsAccept.sw: Go see the Mayor of Saint City. I gotta go now. See you!

dialogsAccept.tw: 去見聖音特市長。我得走了。再見！
dialogsAccept.vi: Đi gặp Thị trưởng thành phố Saint. Tôi phải đi ngay bây giờ. Hẹn gặp bạn!

dialogsDecline.ru: Well, that’s up to you! Either way, I have to rush off now!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Bueno, eso depende de ti! De todos modos, ¡yo me voy corriendo a por mi hijo!
dialogsDecline.sw: Well, that’s up to you! Either way, I have to rush off now!
dialogsDecline.th: มันขึ้นอยู่กับคุณแล้ว! ฉันต้องไปแล้วตอนนี้!

dialogsDecline.vi: Vâng, điều đó tùy thuộc vào bạn! Dù thế nào, tôi cũng phải đi ngay!

dialogsComplete.en: Oh! There you are! I've been waiting for you!. We are in great need of your abilities!
dialogsComplete.ar: Oh! There you are! I've been waiting for you!. We are in great need of your abilities!
dialogsComplete.br: Oh! Aí está você! Eu estive esperando por você! Precisamos muito de suas habilidades!
dialogsComplete.cns: 噢！你在这啊！我一直在等你呢！我们现在非常需要你的帮助！
dialogsComplete.de: Oh! Da bist du ja! Ich habe auf dich gewartet!. Wir brauchen deine Fähigkeiten dringend!
dialogsComplete.fi: Oh! There you are! I've been waiting for you!. We are in great need of your abilities!
dialogsComplete.fil: Oh! There you are! I've been waiting for you!. We are in great need of your abilities!
dialogsComplete.fr: Ah, vous voilà enfin, j'avais peur que vous soyez déjà parti.
dialogsComplete.id: Oh! Akhirnya kamu datang juga! Aku sudah menunggumu!. Kami sangat membutuhkan kemampuanmu!
dialogsComplete.it: Oh! There you are! I've been waiting for you!. We are in great need of your abilities!
dialogsComplete.jp: おお、お待ちしておりましたぞ。貴方の活躍はこの街でも幅広く知れ渡って参りました。実は緊急な依頼がありまして、パーティーを組んだ状態でまたお越し願えませんか。
dialogsComplete.kr: 오! 여기 계셨네요! 한참 기다렸어요! 지금 도움이 절실하다고요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Oh! There you are! I've been waiting for you!. We are in great need of your abilities!
dialogsComplete.pl: Oh! There you are! I've been waiting for you!. We are in great need of your abilities!
dialogsComplete.ru: Oh! There you are! I've been waiting for you!. We are in great need of your abilities!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Oh! ¡Ahí estás! ¡Te he estado esperando! ¡Necesitamos tus habilidades urgentemente!
dialogsComplete.sw: Oh! There you are! I've been waiting for you!. We are in great need of your abilities!
dialogsComplete.th: โอ้ว ! นั่นแหละ! ฉันรอคุณอยู่พอดี
dialogsComplete.tw: 哦！原來你在這！我一直在等你！。我們非常需要你的能力！
dialogsComplete.vi: Ồ! Bạn đây rồi! Tôi đã đợi bạn !. Chúng tôi đang rất cần khả năng của bạn!

dialogsFail.pl: Hmm, what to spank him with? OH! You are still here? The mayor is looking for you. Please go see him!
dialogsFail.ru: Hmm, what to spank him with? OH! You are still here? The mayor is looking for you. Please go see him!

dialogsBegin.en: Magician Master requested you to collect Merahook which is a magic material. Will you accept this request?

dialogsBegin.en: Psssst! Hey... You there! Over here! Sorry for whispering, but this is a secret from the Lab of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.ar: Psssst! Hey... You there! Over here! Sorry for whispering, but this is a secret from the Lab of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.br: Ei.. você tem um minuto? Desculpe por sussurrar, mas é um segredo...do Laboratório de Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.cns: 这是一个很隐密的事情啦~所以要很小声..现在瑞加大陆铼瀑里喔..
dialogsBegin.de: (geheim flüsternd) Hey.. Moment.. (sieht sich um) Verzeihe mir dass ich flüstere, aber dies ist ein Geheimnis. Genauer gesagt ein Labor in Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.fi: Psssst! Hey... You there! Over here! Sorry for whispering, but this is a secret from the Lab of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.fil: Psssst! Hey... You there! Over here! Sorry for whispering, but this is a secret from the Lab of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.fr: (Chuchotant discrètement) Tu aurais un instant? (Regardant autour) Désolé de chuchoter, mais il s'agit d'un secret. du laboratoire de Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.id: Sssst! Hei kamu yang disana! Disini! Maaf karena berbisik, tapi ini rahasia dari Lab Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.it: Psssst! Hey... You there! Over here! Sorry for whispering, but this is a secret from the Lab of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.jp: あのぅ、ちょっとすみません。大きな声では言えない話なので、ひそひそ話になってしまいますがよろしいですか？実は私が所属している＜マドリガル王立研究室＞では、とある秘密のプロジェクトを進めています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 스읍, 이봐요… 거기! 여기에요! 작은 목소리로 말해서 미안해요, 마드리갈 연구소가 알면 안 되거든요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Psssst! Hey... You there! Over here! Sorry for whispering, but this is a secret from the Lab of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.pl: Psssst! Hey... You there! Over here! Sorry for whispering, but this is a secret from the Lab of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.ru: Эй... Только тс-с! Иди сюда… И, пожалуйста, говори шепотом. В мадригальской лаборатории запущен новый сверхсекретный проект…
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Pssst! Oye... ¡Tú! ¡Aquí! Perdón por susurrar, pero es un secreto del Laboratorio de Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.sw: Psssst! Hey... You there! Over here! Sorry for whispering, but this is a secret from the Lab of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.th: เฮ้... คุณตรงนั้น! ทางนี้! ขออภัยที่กระซิบ แต่นี่เป็นความลับจาก Lab of Madrigal
dialogsBegin.tw: 這是一個很隱密的事情啦~所以要很小聲…現在瑪德利賈錸瀑裡喔…
dialogsBegin.vi: Psssst! Này ... Bạn ở đó! Đằng này! Xin lỗi vì đã xì xào, nhưng đây là bí mật từ Lab of Madrigal.

dialogsBegin.en: In the Lab of Madrigal, a secret project is underway. This is actually a disguise I'm wearing, hahaha! This secret project has to do with cloning monsters!
dialogsBegin.ar: In the Lab of Madrigal, a secret project is underway. This is actually a disguise I'm wearing, hahaha! This secret project has to do with cloning monsters!
dialogsBegin.br: Há um projeto secreto em andamento no Laboratório de Madrigal. É por isso que estou disfarçado. He he he! O projeto secreto tem a ver com a clonagem de monstros!
dialogsBegin.cns: 正在进行很隐密的研究，那个研究就是复制魔域怪物..
dialogsBegin.de: ..in diesem Labor in Madrigal geht ein Geheimprojekt vor sich. Deswegen bin ich auch maskiert. ~he he he~ Das Geheimprojekt klont das Monster Wagsaac
dialogsBegin.fi: In the Lab of Madrigal, a secret project is underway. This is actually a disguise I'm wearing, hahaha! This secret project has to do with cloning monsters!
dialogsBegin.fil: In the Lab of Madrigal, a secret project is underway. This is actually a disguise I'm wearing, hahaha! This secret project has to do with cloning monsters!
dialogsBegin.fr: Au laboratoire de Madrigal, nous travaillons sur un projet top secret. C'est pourquoi je me suis déguisé. Ce projet secret est en rapport avec le clonage des monstres.
dialogsBegin.id: Di Lab of Madrigal, sebuah proyek rahasia sedang berlangsung. Ini sebenarnya penyamaran yang aku pakai, hahaha! Proyek rahasia ini ada hubungannya dengan monster kloning!
dialogsBegin.it: In the Lab of Madrigal, a secret project is underway. This is actually a disguise I'm wearing, hahaha! This secret project has to do with cloning monsters!
dialogsBegin.jp: このプロジェクトはあらゆるプロジェクトの中でも非常に重要なのですが、それが何かといいますと…ちょっと他の人に聞こえないように耳を貸してください。…実は、モンスターを複製する研究なのです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 마드리갈 연구소에서, 비밀 실험을 하고 있어요. 지금 제 모습도 변장이랍니다, 하하하! 사실, 몬스터 복제 실험을 하고 있는데요.
dialogsBegin.nl: In the Lab of Madrigal, a secret project is underway. This is actually a disguise I'm wearing, hahaha! This secret project has to do with cloning monsters!
dialogsBegin.pl: In the Lab of Madrigal, a secret project is underway. This is actually a disguise I'm wearing, hahaha! This secret project has to do with cloning monsters!
dialogsBegin.ru: Кстати, это не мое настоящее лицо. Это маска! Я же говорю, проект сверхсекретный. Мы… клонируем монстров!
dialogsBegin.sp: En el Laboratorio de Madrigal, se está llevando a cabo un proyecto secreto. Esto en realidad es un disfraz que estoy usando, ¡jajaja! ¡Este proyecto secreto tiene que ver con la clonación de monstruos!
dialogsBegin.sw: In the Lab of Madrigal, a secret project is underway. This is actually a disguise I'm wearing, hahaha! This secret project has to do with cloning monsters!
dialogsBegin.th: ใน Lab of Madrigal มีโครงการลับกำลังดำเนินการอยู่ ฉันกำลังปลอมตัวอยู่ล่ะฮ่าๆๆ โครงการลับนี้เกี่ยวข้องกับการโคลนนิ่งมอนสเตอร์!
dialogsBegin.tw: 瑪德利賈實驗室正在進行一項祕密計畫。我現在這副模樣其實只是偽裝，哈哈哈！那項祕密計畫和複製怪物有關！
dialogsBegin.vi: Trong Lab of Madrigal, một dự án bí mật đang được tiến hành. Tôi thực sự đang mặc một bộ đồ cải trang, hahaha! Dự án bí mật này liên quan đến những quái vật nhân bản!

dialogsBegin.en: Why are we cloning them? Because we can, obviously! What kind of question is that? Muahahaha! Okay, listen. I need something for our cloning study.
dialogsBegin.ar: Why are we cloning them? Because we can, obviously! What kind of question is that? Muahahaha! Okay, listen. I need something for our cloning study.
dialogsBegin.br: Você está me perguntando porque estamos clonando monstros? Eu não posso dizer. Mas eu posso dizer que preciso de uma coisa muito difícil de obter para nosso estudo de clonagem.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我们为什么要克隆它们？显而易见，因为我们有这个能力！这算什么问题？哇哈哈哈！好了，听着。我们的克隆研究需要一些材料。
dialogsBegin.de: Du fragst dich sicher warum wir es klonen, richtig? Natürlich ist es geheim. Übrigens, ich brauche etwas, dass sehr schwierig zu bekommen ist ... Für die Klonstudie.
dialogsBegin.fi: Why are we cloning them? Because we can, obviously! What kind of question is that? Muahahaha! Okay, listen. I need something for our cloning study.
dialogsBegin.fil: Why are we cloning them? Because we can, obviously! What kind of question is that? Muahahaha! Okay, listen. I need something for our cloning study.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu te demandes pourquoi les cloner ? C'est un secret bien sûr. Ha ha ha! Mais j'ai besoin de quelque chose de très difficile à obtenir pour avancer dans cette étude sur le clonage.
dialogsBegin.id: Mengapa kita mengkloning mereka? Karena kita pasti bisa! Pertanyaan macam apa itu? Muahahaha!! Oke, dengarkan. Aku butuh sesuatu untuk studi kloning kita.
dialogsBegin.it: Why are we cloning them? Because we can, obviously! What kind of question is that? Muahahaha! Okay, listen. I need something for our cloning study.
dialogsBegin.jp: びっくりするのも無理はありません。モンスターを複製してどうするのかと？それは当然秘密です、ハハッ。ごく一部の人間しか知ることができません。しかし研究に必要な材料があるのですが、それがなかなか簡単に手に入らない物なのです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 왜 복제하느냐고요? 당연히, 할 수 있으니까죠! 무슨 질문이 그래요? 음하하하! 좋아요, 들어보세요. 복제 연구를 하려면 필요한 게 있어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Why are we cloning them? Because we can, obviously! What kind of question is that? Muahahaha! Okay, listen. I need something for our cloning study.
dialogsBegin.pl: Why are we cloning them? Because we can, obviously! What kind of question is that? Muahahaha! Okay, listen. I need something for our cloning study.
dialogsBegin.ru: Why are we cloning them? Because we can, obviously! What kind of question is that? Muahahaha! Okay, listen. I need something for our cloning study.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Por qué los clonamos? ¡Porque podemos, obviamente! ¿Qué clase de pregunta es esa? ¡¡Muajajaja!! Está bien, escucha. Necesito algo para nuestro estudio de clonación.
dialogsBegin.sw: Why are we cloning them? Because we can, obviously! What kind of question is that? Muahahaha! Okay, listen. I need something for our cloning study.
dialogsBegin.th: ทำไมเราถึงโคลนนิ่งพวกมัน? เพราะเราทำได้ไงล่ะ! คำถามอะไรกันเนี่ย? อุวะฮะฮ่า!! เอาล่ะ ฟังนะ ฉันต้องการอะไรบางอย่างสำหรับศึกษาการโคลนนิ่ง
dialogsBegin.tw: 你問我們為什麼要複製牠們？當然是因為我們做得到啊！這算什麼問題？哇哈哈哈！好了，聽著。我需要一些東西來進行我們的複製研究。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tại sao chúng ta lại nhân bản chúng? Rõ ràng là vì chúng ta có thể rồi! Đó mà cũng là câu hỏi à? Muahahaha! Được rồi, nghe đây. Tôi cần một cái gì đó cho nghiên cứu nhân bản của chúng tôi.

dialogsBegin.en: You think you might be able to help me out?
dialogsBegin.ar: You think you might be able to help me out?
dialogsBegin.br: Você poderia talvez trazê-la para mim, por favor?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你觉得你能够帮我吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Würdest du es vielleicht für mich beschaffen?
dialogsBegin.fi: You think you might be able to help me out?
dialogsBegin.fil: You think you might be able to help me out?
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu pourrais m'aider s'il te plaît ?
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu mungkin bisa membantu saya?
dialogsBegin.it: You think you might be able to help me out?
dialogsBegin.jp: そこで、あなたにお願いしたいのですが。この研究材料を探して、わたしのところに持ってきてくれませんか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 혹시 이걸 구해주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: You think you might be able to help me out?
dialogsBegin.pl: You think you might be able to help me out?
dialogsBegin.ru: Ты поможешь?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Crees que podrías ayudarme?
dialogsBegin.sw: You think you might be able to help me out?
dialogsBegin.th: คุณคิดว่าคุณจะช่วยฉันได้งั้นเหรอ?
dialogsBegin.tw: 可以幫我找這個嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn nghĩ bạn có thể giúp tôi?

dialogsAccept.en: Perrrrfect! In the interest of furthering our studies on Wagsaac DNA, I need some of their bones. Bring me 10 Wagsaac Bones.
dialogsAccept.ar: Perrrrfect! In the interest of furthering our studies on Wagsaac DNA, I need some of their bones. Bring me 10 Wagsaac Bones.
dialogsAccept.br: Ótimo. Para poder terminar de estudar a clonagem de Wagsaacs, eu preciso dos ossos deles. Por favor, me traga 10 pedaços de ossos de Wagsaac.
dialogsAccept.cns: 好!我想第一个现尝试复制食人花，所以帮我找10个食人花的骨头碎片好吗?
dialogsAccept.de: Gut. Um die Studie des Klonens von Wagsaac fertigzustellen, brauche ich ihren Knochen. Bitte bringe mir 10 Knochenstücke von Wagsaac.
dialogsAccept.fi: Perrrrfect! In the interest of furthering our studies on Wagsaac DNA, I need some of their bones. Bring me 10 Wagsaac Bones.
dialogsAccept.fil: Perrrrfect! In the interest of furthering our studies on Wagsaac DNA, I need some of their bones. Bring me 10 Wagsaac Bones.
dialogsAccept.fr: Bien. Pour finir mon étude sur le clonage des Wagsaac, j'ai besoin de leurs os. Ramènes-moi s'il te plaît 10 Os de Wagsaac.
dialogsAccept.id: Sempurna! Untuk kepentingan melanjutkan studi kami tentang DNA Wagsaac, aku membutuhkan beberapa tulang mereka. Bawakan saya 10 Wagsaac Bones.
dialogsAccept.it: Perrrrfect! In the interest of furthering our studies on Wagsaac DNA, I need some of their bones. Bring me 10 Wagsaac Bones.
dialogsAccept.jp: 私たちは最初の目標としてワッグサックを複製しようとしているのですが、そのためには＜ワッグサックの骨の欠片＞が必要なのです。　＜ワッグサックの骨の欠片＞を10個、集めてきていただけませんか？
dialogsAccept.kr: 아주 좋아요! 와그작의 유전자를 자세히 분석하려면 뼈가 필요하거든요. 와그작의 뼈 10개만 구해주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Perrrrfect! In the interest of furthering our studies on Wagsaac DNA, I need some of their bones. Bring me 10 Wagsaac Bones.
dialogsAccept.pl: Perrrrfect! In the interest of furthering our studies on Wagsaac DNA, I need some of their bones. Bring me 10 Wagsaac Bones.
dialogsAccept.ru: Замечательно! Сейчас мы исследуем ДНК злопухов, и нам нужны косточки этих монстров. Примерно десяток.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Peeeerfecto! Para avanzar en nuestros estudios sobre el ADN de Wagsaac, necesito algunos de sus huesos. Tráeme 10 Huesos de Wagsaac.
dialogsAccept.sw: Perrrrfect! In the interest of furthering our studies on Wagsaac DNA, I need some of their bones. Bring me 10 Wagsaac Bones.
dialogsAccept.th: ดีมากกก! เพื่อการศึกษาในอนาคตของดีเอ็นเอ Wagsaac ฉันต้องการกระดูกบางส่วนของพวกเขา นำกระดูก Wagsaac มาให้ฉัน 10 อัน
dialogsAccept.tw: 好！我想第一個先嘗試複製拳頭花，所以幫我找 10 個拳頭花的骨頭碎片好嗎？
dialogsAccept.vi: Hoàn hảo! Để thúc đẩy các nghiên cứu của chúng tôi trên Wagsaac DNA, tôi cần một số xương của chúng. Mang cho tôi 10 chiếc Wagsaac Bones.

dialogsDecline.en: You don't want to do it, eh? Fine, I'll find someone else.
dialogsDecline.ar: You don't want to do it, eh? Fine, I'll find someone else.
dialogsDecline.br: Hmm... Parece que você está duvidando de mim. Você não precisa fazer isso se não quiser. Posso pedir para outra pessoa.
dialogsDecline.cns: 如果不想帮我就算了!我还可以找其他人帮我!
dialogsDecline.de: Du willst es nicht tun? Gut, dann finde ich jemand anderen.
dialogsDecline.fi: You don't want to do it, eh? Fine, I'll find someone else.
dialogsDecline.fil: You don't want to do it, eh? Fine, I'll find someone else.
dialogsDecline.fr: (En faisant une grimace) Hmm.. Tu sembles douter de moi. Tu n'es pas obligé de le faire si tu ne veux pas. Je demanderai à quelqu'un d'autre.
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu tidak ingin melakukannya, kan? Baiklah, aku akan mencari orang lain.
dialogsDecline.it: You don't want to do it, eh? Fine, I'll find someone else.
dialogsDecline.jp: むむ、何かいぶかしそうな目つきですね。まあ、嫌であれば引き受けてくれなくても構いません、他の人にお願いするので。
dialogsDecline.kr: 싫다고요? 쳇, 다른 사람한테 부탁하죠 뭐.
dialogsDecline.nl: You don't want to do it, eh? Fine, I'll find someone else.
dialogsDecline.pl: You don't want to do it, eh? Fine, I'll find someone else.
dialogsDecline.ru: You don't want to do it, eh? Fine, I'll find someone else.
dialogsDecline.sp: No quieres hacerlo, ¿eh? Bueno, encontraré a otro.
dialogsDecline.sw: You don't want to do it, eh? Fine, I'll find someone else.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณไม่ต้องการจะทำใช่มั้ย? ก็ได้ ฉันจะหาคนอื่นแทน
dialogsDecline.tw: 如果不想幫我就算了！我還可以找其他人幫我！
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn không muốn làm điều đó, hả? Tốt thôi, tôi sẽ tìm người khác.

dialogsComplete.en: Hmmm *Sniff* *Sniff*... Yep! This is prime grade-A Wagsaac Bone right here. Good job, sport!
dialogsComplete.ar: Hmmm *Sniff* *Sniff*... Yep! This is prime grade-A Wagsaac Bone right here. Good job, sport!
dialogsComplete.br: Ah, esses são definitivamente ossos de Wagsaac. Parabéns. Talvez eu peça sua ajuda novamente. Até mais.
dialogsComplete.cns: 嘻嘻，真的是他们的骨头耶~希望下次再见喔~
dialogsComplete.de: Oh, das sind auf jeden Fall ihre Knochen. Gute Arbeit. Vielleicht werde ich dich nochmal um Hilfe bitten. Bis dann.
dialogsComplete.fi: Hmmm *Sniff* *Sniff*... Yep! This is prime grade-A Wagsaac Bone right here. Good job, sport!
dialogsComplete.fil: Hmmm *Sniff* *Sniff*... Yep! This is prime grade-A Wagsaac Bone right here. Good job, sport!
dialogsComplete.fr: C'est bien leurs os. Bon travail. Je te redemanderai peut-être ton aide. A la revoyure.
dialogsComplete.id: Hmmm *Mengendus* *Mengendus*... Ya! Ini adalah Wagsaac Bone kelas-A prima. Kerja bagus!
dialogsComplete.it: Hmmm *Sniff* *Sniff*... Yep! This is prime grade-A Wagsaac Bone right here. Good job, sport!
dialogsComplete.jp: おお！これは確かに＜ワッグサックの骨の欠片＞ですね。ありがとうございます。また今度、あなたに頼むことがあるかもしれませんのでよろしくお願いします。本当に助かりました。
dialogsComplete.kr: 흠… *킁킁*… 네! 최상급 와그작 뼈 맞네요. 고생하셨어요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Hmmm *Sniff* *Sniff*... Yep! This is prime grade-A Wagsaac Bone right here. Good job, sport!
dialogsComplete.pl: Hmmm *Sniff* *Sniff*... Yep! This is prime grade-A Wagsaac Bone right here. Good job, sport!
dialogsComplete.ru: Ну-ка, ну-ка.. Ага! Первоклассные злопушиные косточки. Из тебя вышел бы отличный лаборант.
dialogsComplete.sp: Hmmm *Sniff* *Sniff*... ¡Sí! Esto es Hueso de Wagsaac de grado A. ¡Buen trabajo, crack!
dialogsComplete.sw: Hmmm *Sniff* *Sniff*... Yep! This is prime grade-A Wagsaac Bone right here. Good job, sport!
dialogsComplete.th: หืมมมมมม *ดม* *ดม*... ใช่เลย! นี่คือกระดูก Wagsaac เกรด A คุณทำได้ดีมาก!
dialogsComplete.tw: 嘻嘻，真的是他們的骨頭耶~希望下次再見喔~
dialogsComplete.vi: Hmmm * Hít * * Hít * ... Yep! Đây chính là Wagsaac Bone hạng A. Làm tốt lắm!

dialogsFail.en: We've got all the time in the world. Take your time. We're busy developing a mix between a Mushpang and an Aibatt. We're calling them Mushbatts!
dialogsFail.ar: We've got all the time in the world. Take your time. We're busy developing a mix between a Mushpang and an Aibatt. We're calling them Mushbatts!
dialogsFail.br: Você não precisa se apressar porque nós temos bastante tempo. Apenas assegure-se de me trazer 10 pedaços.
dialogsFail.cns: 我们有大把时光，慢慢来。我们正忙着独眼蝠和嘭嘭菇的混合，我们称之为嘭嘭蝠！
dialogsFail.de: Du brauchst dich nicht beeilen, wir haben genug Zeit. Stelle nur sicher dass du mir 10 Stücke bringst.
dialogsFail.fi: We've got all the time in the world. Take your time. We're busy developing a mix between a Mushpang and an Aibatt. We're calling them Mushbatts!
dialogsFail.fil: We've got all the time in the world. Take your time. We're busy developing a mix between a Mushpang and an Aibatt. We're calling them Mushbatts!
dialogsFail.fr: Tu n'as pas besoin de te presser, nous avons tout notre temps. Ramènes-moi juste 10 Os de Wagsaac.
dialogsFail.id: Kita punya semua waktu di dunia. Gunakan waktumu. Kami sibuk mengembangkan campuran antara Mushpang dan Aibatt. Kami menyebutnya Mushbatts!
dialogsFail.it: We've got all the time in the world. Take your time. We're busy developing a mix between a Mushpang and an Aibatt. We're calling them Mushbatts!
dialogsFail.jp: そんなに急がなくても大丈夫ですよ。個数だけ正確であれば、問題はありません。よろしくお願いしますね。
dialogsFail.kr: 급한 일은 아니니 천천히 가져다주세요. 저희는 지 머쉬팡과 아이바트를 섞은 새로운 생물, 머쉬뱃을 만들고 있답니다.
dialogsFail.nl: We've got all the time in the world. Take your time. We're busy developing a mix between a Mushpang and an Aibatt. We're calling them Mushbatts!
dialogsFail.pl: We've got all the time in the world. Take your time. We're busy developing a mix between a Mushpang and an Aibatt. We're calling them Mushbatts!
dialogsFail.ru: Можешь не спешить. Времени у нас полно. Сейчас мы выводим новую породу монстров на основе ДНК сыробежек и сглазов. Рабочее название - "Проект "Сыроглазы".
dialogsFail.sp: Tenemos todo el tiempo del mundo. Tómate tu tiempo. Estamos ocupados desarrollando una mezcla entre Mushpang y Aibatt. ¡Los llamamos Mushbatts!
dialogsFail.sw: We've got all the time in the world. Take your time. We're busy developing a mix between a Mushpang and an Aibatt. We're calling them Mushbatts!
dialogsFail.th: เรามีเวลาเสมอ แล้วแต่คุณเลย เรายุ่งอยู่กับการพัฒนาส่วนผสมระหว่าง Mushpang กับ Aibatt เราเรียกมันว่า Mushbatts!
dialogsFail.tw: 我們時間多得很，你慢慢來。我們正忙著培育咚咚菇和獨眼蝙蝠的混合體，打算叫牠們「菇蝙蝠」！
dialogsFail.vi: Chúng tôi thoải mái về mặt thời gian. Cứ từ từ làm. Chúng tôi đang bận rộn phát triển sự pha trộn giữa Mushpang và Aibatt. Chúng tôi đang gọi chúng là Mushbatts!

dialogsBegin.ar: Excellent job raising your pet so far, my friend. You two certainly look happy together!

dialogsBegin.fil: Excellent job raising your pet so far, my friend. You two certainly look happy together!

dialogsBegin.it: Excellent job raising your pet so far, my friend. You two certainly look happy together!

dialogsBegin.sp: Excelente trabajo criando a tu mascota, amigo. ¡Se les ve realmente felices juntos!
dialogsBegin.sw: Excellent job raising your pet so far, my friend. You two certainly look happy together!
dialogsBegin.th: เยี่ยมมาก เลี้ยงสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณจนถึงตอนนี้ เพื่อนของฉัน คุณสองคนดูมีความสุขด้วยกันอย่างแน่นอน!
dialogsBegin.tw: 我的朋友，到目前為止，你的寵物做得很好。你們兩個在一起肯定很幸福！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn đã nuôi thú cưng của mình rất tốt đến thời điểm hiện tại, bạn tôi. Hai bạn chắc chắn trông rất vui khi ở cùng nhau!

dialogsBegin.en: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.ar: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.br: Você e seu Pet passaram por várias aventuras juntos. Tenho certeza que você já percebeu que quanto maior o nível concedido para um determinado grau, maior o benefício para seus atributos.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我相信您现在已经注意到，特定等级授予的级别越高，对您的属性的好处就越高。
dialogsBegin.de: Du hast sicher bereits gemerkt, dass der Bonus für eine bestimmte Klasse umso höher ist, wenn sie einen hohen Level hat.
dialogsBegin.fi: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.fil: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.fr: Ton familier et toi avez vécu bien des choses ensemble. C'est bon de vous revoir tous les deux à nouveau.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku yakin kamu telah menyadari bahwa semakin tinggi level yang diberikan tier tertentu, semakin tinggi manfaaatnya pada stats kamu.
dialogsBegin.it: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.jp: ペットの経験値を100％にしたら、レベルアップと共に見た目も変わります。今度こそ大人のペットになりますね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 특정 등급에 부여된 레벨이 높을수록 스탯에 들어가는 혜택도 더 크다는 걸 알아차리셨겠죠?
dialogsBegin.nl: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.pl: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.ru: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.sp: Estoy seguro de que ya habrá notado que cuanto mayor sea el nivel otorgado para un nivel en particular, mayor será el beneficio para sus estadísticas.
dialogsBegin.sw: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันแน่ใจว่าคุณสังเกตเห็นแล้วว่ายิ่งเลเวลที่ได้รับสำหรับระดับใดระดับหนึ่งสูงเท
dialogsBegin.tw: 你現在應該已經發現，同一階級獲得的等級越高，能力值加成就越多。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi chắc rằng bạn đã nhận thấy cấp độ được cấp cho một cấp cụ thể càng cao, thì lợi ích đối với chỉ số Stats của bạn càng cao.

dialogsAccept.en: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.ar: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.br: Para ficar forte, é preciso suar a camisa. A essa altura, tenho certeza que você já conhece o treinamento. Aumente a Experiência do seu Pet até 99,99% e traga-o de volta para mim. Avaliarei o nível dele quando você tiver terminado.
dialogsAccept.cns: 一分耕耘一分收获。我敢肯定你现在已经知道这个了。把你宠物的经验提升到 99.99% 再来找我。你完成后我会升级它。
dialogsAccept.de: Ohne Fleiß kein Preis! Ich muss dir das weitere Vorgehen mittlerweile sicher nicht mehr erklären. Steigere die Erfahrung deines Pets auf 99,99% und bringe es zu mir zurück.
dialogsAccept.fi: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.fil: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.fr: Tu connais la musique, amène l'expérience de ton familier à 99,99% et reviens me voir pour que je le fasse évoluer.
dialogsAccept.id: Tanpa usaha tak akan ada hasil. Aku yakin kamu sudah cukup paham sekarang. Naikkan EXP pet menjadi 99,99% lalu. Aku akan mengupgradenya..
dialogsAccept.it: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.jp: ペット経験値を100％にしてから私のところに来てください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 고통 없이는 얻는 것도 없죠. 이제 어떻게 해야 하는지 잘 아시겠죠? 펫의 경험치를 99.99%까지 올려 제게 데려오세요. 경험치가 충분하면 업그레이드해 드릴게요.
dialogsAccept.nl: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.pl: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.ru: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.sp: Sin dolor no hay ganancia. Estoy seguro de que ya conoces el proceso. Lleva la experiencia de tu mascota al 99,99% y devuélvemelo. Lo actualizaré encantado.
dialogsAccept.sw: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.th: ไม่มีความเจ็บปวดก็เหมือนไมไ่ด้อะไร ฉันแน่ใจว่าคุณรู้การฝึกซ้อมแล้ว นำEXPสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณไปให้ถึง 99.99% แล้วนำกลับมาให้ฉัน ฉันจะอัปเกรดเมื่อคุณทำเสร็จแล้ว
dialogsAccept.tw: 一分耕耘一分收穫。我敢肯定你現在已經知道這個練習了。把你寵物的經驗提升到 99.99% 還給我。你完成後我會升級它。
dialogsAccept.vi: Không gì dễ dàng cả. Tôi chắc rằng bây giờ bạn đã biết về cuộc diễn tập. Đem điểm experience thú cưng của bạn đến 99,99% và mang nó về lại cho tôi. Tôi sẽ nâng cấp nó khi bạn hoàn thành.

dialogsComplete.en: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to C tier now!
dialogsComplete.ar: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to C tier now!
dialogsComplete.br: Vocês dois estão se tornando mais fortes juntos, e parece que vocês se tornaram bons amigos no processo. Excelente! Vou promover seu pet para o grau C agora!
dialogsComplete.cns: 你们两个一起变得越来越强大，看起来你们在这个过程中成为了很好的朋友。很棒！我现在就把你的宠物升级到C级！
dialogsComplete.de: Gemeinsam werdet ihr beide immer stärker. Es sieht so aus, als wärt ihr auch ziemlich gute Freunde geworden. Exzellent! Ich werde dein Pet nun zur C Klasse aufwerten!
dialogsComplete.fi: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to C tier now!
dialogsComplete.fil: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to C tier now!
dialogsComplete.fr: Bon boulot, je vais faire évoluer ton familier à la classe C !
dialogsComplete.id: Kalian berdua menjadi lebih kuat bersama, dan sepertinya kalian telah menjadi teman yang baik. Bagus sekali! Aku akan mengupgrade pet yang kamu miliki ke tingkat C sekarang!
dialogsComplete.it: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to C tier now!
dialogsComplete.jp: 素敵なペットになりましたね！
dialogsComplete.kr: 둘은 함께 성장하며 강해지고 있고, 그 과정에서 꽤 좋은 친구가 된 것 같네요. 훌륭해요! 이제 펫을 C급으로 업그레이드해 드릴게요!
dialogsComplete.nl: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to C tier now!
dialogsComplete.pl: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to C tier now!
dialogsComplete.ru: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to C tier now!
dialogsComplete.sp: Los dos se están volviendo más fuertes juntos y parece que se han convertido en buenos amigos en el proceso. ¡Excelente! ¡Actualizaré tu mascota al nivel C!
dialogsComplete.sw: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to C tier now!
dialogsComplete.th: คุณสองคนแข็งแกร่งขึ้นด้วยกัน และดูเหมือนว่าพวกคุณจะกลายเป็นเพื่อนที่ดีต่อกัน ยอดเยี่ยม! ฉันจะอัปเกรดสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณเป็นระดับ C ทันที!
dialogsComplete.tw: 你們兩個一起變得越來越強大，看起來你們在這個過程中成為了很好的朋友。太強了！我現在就把你的寵物升級到 C 級！
dialogsComplete.vi: Hai bạn đang cùng mạnh hơn, và các bạn đã trở thành những người bạn tốt trong quá trình này. Xuất sắc! Tôi sẽ nâng cấp thú cưng của bạn lên cấp C ngay bây giờ!

dialogsFail.ar: Not quite there… your pet needs more experience. I'm sure you already knew that.

dialogsFail.cns: 还不够……你的宠物需要更多的经验。我相信你已经知道了。
dialogsFail.de: Du bist noch nicht ganz fertig... Dein Pet benötigt mehr Erfahrung. Aber das wusstest du sicher bereits.
dialogsFail.fi: Not quite there… your pet needs more experience. I'm sure you already knew that.
dialogsFail.fil: Not quite there… your pet needs more experience. I'm sure you already knew that.
dialogsFail.fr: Ton familier a encore besoin d'expérience. Je pensais que tu saurais ce genre de choses maintenant !
dialogsFail.id: Masih belum cukup... Pet kamu membutuhkan lebih banyak EXP. Aku yakin Kamu sudah mengetahuinya.
dialogsFail.it: Not quite there… your pet needs more experience. I'm sure you already knew that.

dialogsFail.th: ไม่ค่อยมี… สัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณต้องการ EXP มากกว่านี้ ฉันแน่ใจว่าคุณรู้อยู่แล้วว่า
dialogsFail.tw: 別離開那裡……你的寵物需要更多的經驗。我相信你已經知道了。
dialogsFail.vi: Khôngphải thế… thú cưng của bạn cần thêm experience. Tôi chắc rằng bạn đã biết điều đó.

dialogsBegin.en: Rooney wants you to collect Nyanyangs for her party. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.ar: Rooney wants you to collect Nyanyangs for her party. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.br: A Rooney quer que você colete Nyanyangs para a festa dela. Você poderia ajudar?
dialogsBegin.cns: 鲁尼想要为哥哥煮一锅彩色野果浓汤，所以请本中心去收集彩色野果。您要接受委托吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Rooney möchte, dass du Nyanyangs für ihre Party sammelst. Wirst du ihr helfen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Rooney wants you to collect Nyanyangs for her party. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.fil: Kailangan ni Rooney na kolektahin mo ang Nyanyangs para sa kanyang party. Tutulungan mo ba?
dialogsBegin.fr: Rooney aimerait que tu trouves du Nyang pour son groupe. Acceptes-tu cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Rooney ingin kamu mengumpulkan Nyanyangs untuk partynya. Bsiakah kamu membantu?
dialogsBegin.it: Rooney wants you to collect Nyanyangs for her party. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.jp: ルニから、お兄さんのルイにプレゼントするニャングラタンを作るために必要なニャンプラー収集の依頼がありました。依頼を受けますか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 루니가 파티에 쓸 냥그라탕을 만들 냐냥을 구해 달라고 부탁합니다. 도와주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Rooney wants you to collect Nyanyangs for her party. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.pl: Rooney wants you to collect Nyanyangs for her party. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.ru: Ну-ка, поглядим… 'Руни устраивает вечеринку, и ему нужен вискис.' Поможешь?
dialogsBegin.sp: Rooney quiere que consigas Nyanyangs para su fiesta. ¿Ayudarás?
dialogsBegin.sw: Rooney wants you to collect Nyanyangs for her party. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.th: Rooney ต้องการให้คุณรวบรวม Nyanyang สำหรับงานปาร์ตี้ของเธอ คุณจะช่วยไหม
dialogsBegin.tw: 魯尼想要為哥哥煮一鍋娘娘果濃湯，所以請本中心去收集娘娘果。你要接受委託嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Rooney muốn bạn thu thập Nyanyangs cho bữa tiệc của cô ấy. Bạn sẽ giúp chứ?

description.en: Travel to the Plain of Bubble, defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and retrieve both the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ for Novelist Gergantes in Northern Flarine.
description.ar: Travel to the Plain of Bubble, defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and retrieve both the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ for Novelist Gergantes in Northern Flarine.
description.br: Viaje para a Planície de Bubble, derrote $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ e recupere o $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ e o $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ para o Novelista Gergantes que está na Zona Norte de Flarine.
description.cns: 首先去波布尔平原击败$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$，获得$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$和$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ ，然后再回来找我
description.de: Reist zur Ebene von Bubble, besiegt $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ und holt euch sowohl das $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ als auch das $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ für den Novellisten Gergantes in Nordflarine.
description.fi: Travel to the Plain of Bubble, defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and retrieve both the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ for Novelist Gergantes in Northern Flarine.
description.fil: Travel to the Plain of Bubble, defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and retrieve both the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ for Novelist Gergantes in Northern Flarine.
description.fr: Allez sur la Plaine de Shade, tuez des $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, et récupérez le $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ et le $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ pour l'écrivain Gergantes à Flarine Nord.
description.id: Perjalanan ke Plain of Bubble, kalahkan $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, dan ambil $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ dan $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ untuk Novelist Gergantes di Northern Flarine.
description.it: Travel to the Plain of Bubble, defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and retrieve both the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ for Novelist Gergantes in Northern Flarine.
description.jp: ＜バブルの平原＞に生息する＜$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$＞というモンスターを倒し、＜$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$＞と、＜$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$＞を持ってこよう。手に入れたらフラリス北広場のゲルガンデスに渡しにいこう。
description.kr: 버블 평원으로 가서 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$를 처치하고, $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ 두 가지를 회수해 플라리네 북부에 사는 소설가 게르간테스에게 가져가세요.
