description.th: เดินทางไป Plain of Bubble เอาชนะ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ และนำทั้ง $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ และ $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ ให้กับนักเขียนนวนิยาย Gergantes ใน Northern Flarine
description.tw: 前往巴布樂平原，擊敗 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$，並幫布拉里斯廣場的小說家凱樂刊特斯取回 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ 和 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$。
description.vi: Đi đến Plain of Bubble, đánh bại $ QUEST_END_KILL_NAME $ và lấy cả $ QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME $ và $ QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME, 2 $ cho Tiểu thuyết gia Gergantes (Novelist Gergantes) ở Northern Flarine.

dialogsBegin.en: Pssst, hey you! I'm writing a book and I need your help! I'm having a bit of writer's block and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
dialogsBegin.ar: Pssst, hey you! I'm writing a book and I need your help! I'm having a bit of writer's block and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
dialogsBegin.br: Ei conhecido! Estou escrevendo outro livro e preciso de sua ajuda, pois há uma ótima história para ser contada. Mas não posso terminá-la sozinho.
dialogsBegin.cns: 听好我说的话喔~其实啊..我最近在写一本书，写书的时候需要一些材料，但是我自己没办法搞定。
dialogsBegin.de: Hör mir genau zu. Genau genommen schreibe ich grade ein Buch, weil es eine gute Geschichte hat. Aber ich kann es alleine nicht beenden.
dialogsBegin.fi: Pssst, hey you! I'm writing a book and I need your help! I'm having a bit of writer's block and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
dialogsBegin.fil: Pssst, hey you! I'm writing a book and I need your help! I'm having a bit of writer's block and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
dialogsBegin.fr: Ecoute-moi bien. En ce moment, j'écris un livre, parce que j'ai trouvé une très bonne histoire. Mais je ne peux la finir par moi-même.
dialogsBegin.id: Pssst, hai kamu! Saya sedang menulis buku dan saya butuh bantuanmu! Saya mengalami sedikit hambatan penulis dan saya membutuhkan seorang petualang pemberani untuk membantu saya menulisnya!
dialogsBegin.it: Pssst, hey you! I'm writing a book and I need your help! I'm having a bit of writer's block and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
dialogsBegin.jp:
私は小説を書こうとしてるんだが、一人ではどうにもできないのだよ・・・。
とてもよい題材があるのに残念だ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 저기, 이봐요! 제가 책을 쓰고 있는데, 도움이 필요해요! 요즘 도통 영감이 떠오르지 않아서, 용감한 모험가님이 도와주시면 정말 좋겠어요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Pssst, hey you! I'm writing a book and I need your help! I'm having a bit of writer's block and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
dialogsBegin.pl: Pssst, hey you! I'm writing a book and I need your help! I'm having a bit of writer's block and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
dialogsBegin.ru: Привет! Я пишу новый роман - вот увидишь, его будут расхватывать, как горячие пирожки! - но концовка никак не дается. Мне нужна помощь храброго героя!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Pssst, eh tú! ¡Estoy escribiendo un libro y necesito tu ayuda! ¡Tengo un pequeño bloqueo de escritor y necesito la ayuda de un valiente aventurero!
dialogsBegin.sw: Pssst, hey you! I'm writing a book and I need your help! I'm having a bit of writer's block and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
dialogsBegin.th: ชู่วว นี่คุณ! ฉันกำลังจะเขียนหนังสือสักเล่ม และฉันต้องการความช่วยเหลือจากคุณ ฉันเริ่มจะตันซะแล้วล่ะ ดังนั้นฉันจึงต้องการนักผจญภัยที่กล้าหาญเพื่อช่วยฉันเขียนหนังสือเล่มนี้!
dialogsBegin.tw: 聽好我說的話喔~其實啊…我最近在寫一本書，寫書的時候需要一些材料，但是我自己沒辦法搞定。
dialogsBegin.vi: Pssst, này bạn! Tôi đang viết một cuốn sách và tôi cần sự giúp đỡ của bạn! Tôi đang gặp một chút khó khăn và tôi cần một nhà thám hiểm dũng cảm giúp tôi viết nó!

dialogsBegin.en: Have you ever heard about the legend of Krren Dacid? A long long time ago, there was a very famous adventurer. His name was Krren Dacid. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure…
dialogsBegin.ar: Have you ever heard about the legend of Krren Dacid? A long long time ago, there was a very famous adventurer. His name was Krren Dacid. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure…
dialogsBegin.br: Dessa vez é sobre a Lenda de Krren Dacid. Deixe-me lhe contar. Há muito, muito tempo havia um famoso aventureiro que era fascinado por coisas místicas. O seu nome era Krren Dacid.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你有听说过特莱特怪物的传说吗?以前有一个大冒险家啦~名子叫<克安达施德>，有一天，他发现了一个很有趣的事情。
dialogsBegin.de: Hast du je von der Legende der Dreadpet gehört? Es scheint mir als hättest du nicht. Vor langer, langer Zeit, gab es einen berühmten Abenteurer. Sein Name war Krren Dacid. Eines Tages, fand er einen interessanten Ort für Abenteuer.
dialogsBegin.fi: Have you ever heard about the legend of Krren Dacid? A long long time ago, there was a very famous adventurer. His name was Krren Dacid. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure…
dialogsBegin.fil: Have you ever heard about the legend of Krren Dacid? A long long time ago, there was a very famous adventurer. His name was Krren Dacid. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure…
dialogsBegin.fr: As-tu déjà entendu parler de la Légende du Dreadpet ? Apparemment non. Il y a fort longtemps, existait un célèbre aventurier, il s'appelait Krren Dacid.
dialogsBegin.id: Pernahkah kamu mendengar tentang legenda Keren David? Dahulu kala, ada seorang petualang yang sangat terkenal. Namanya Karen David. Suatu hari, dia menemukan tempat yang menarik untuk berpetualang…
dialogsBegin.it: Have you ever heard about the legend of Krren Dacid? A long long time ago, there was a very famous adventurer. His name was Krren Dacid. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure…
dialogsBegin.jp: 君は、シヴァーモンスターの話しを聞いたことがあるか？　ふーむ・・。知らないようだな。昔、＜クルエンダ・シード＞という、とても有名な冒険者がいたのだよ。ある日、彼は得体の知れない何者かに遭遇したというんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 혹시 크르엔 다시드의 전설을 들어본 적 있으세요? 모르신다고요? 옛날에, 크르엔 다시드라는 아주 유명한 모험가가 있었어요. 어느 날, 크르엔은 아주 흥미로운 곳을 발견했죠...
dialogsBegin.nl: Have you ever heard about the legend of Krren Dacid? A long long time ago, there was a very famous adventurer. His name was Krren Dacid. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure…
dialogsBegin.pl: Have you ever heard about the legend of Krren Dacid? A long long time ago, there was a very famous adventurer. His name was Krren Dacid. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure…
dialogsBegin.ru: Жил-был на свете отважный искатель приключений по имени Кррен Дацид. Однажды он решил отправиться в неизведанное место...
dialogsBegin.sp: Alguna vez has oído sobre la leyenda de Krren Dacid? Hace mucho mucho tiempo, había un aventurero muy famoso. Su nombre era Krren Dacid. Un día, encontró un lugar interesante al que aventurarse...
dialogsBegin.sw: Have you ever heard about the legend of Krren Dacid? A long long time ago, there was a very famous adventurer. His name was Krren Dacid. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure…
dialogsBegin.th: คุณเคยได้ยินเกี่ยวกับตำนานของ Krren Dacid ไหม? นานมาแล้วมีนักผจญภัยที่มีชื่อเสียงมาก ชื่อของเขาคือ Krren Dacid อยู่มาวันหนึ่ง เขาได้พบกับสถานที่ที่น่าสนใจในการผจญภัย...
dialogsBegin.tw: 你有聽說過特萊特怪物的傳說嗎？以前有一個大冒險家啦~名子叫克安達施德，有一天，他發現了一個很有趣的事情。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn đã bao giờ nghe truyền thuyết về Krren Dacid chưa? Cách đây rất lâu, có một nhà thám hiểm rất nổi tiếng. Tên anh ta là Krren Dacid. Một ngày nọ, anh ấy tìm thấy một nơi thú vị để phiêu lưu…

dialogsBegin.en: It was a huge temple in the sky. Krren investigated the temple only to become infected by a disease within the cave called Cold Fear.
dialogsBegin.ar: It was a huge temple in the sky. Krren investigated the temple only to become infected by a disease within the cave called Cold Fear.
dialogsBegin.br: Após vários anos investigando casos de misticismo, ele encontrou um lugar, um enorme templo no céu. Krren investigou o templo mas acabou sendo surpreendido por uma magia amedrontadora que estava selada no templo.
dialogsBegin.cns: 那是天空中的一座巨大的神庙。克安调查了这座寺庙，却被洞中一种名为 冷酷恐怖的疾病所感染。
dialogsBegin.de: Es war ein riesiger Tempel im Himmel. Krren untersuchte den Tempel, nur um sich in der Höhle mit einer Krankheit namens "Kalte Furcht" zu infizieren.
dialogsBegin.fi: It was a huge temple in the sky. Krren investigated the temple only to become infected by a disease within the cave called Cold Fear.
dialogsBegin.fil: It was a huge temple in the sky. Krren investigated the temple only to become infected by a disease within the cave called Cold Fear.
dialogsBegin.fr: Toujours en quête d'aventure, Dacid découvrit un jour un immense temple perché dans les cieux. Là se trouvait un monstre abominable, nommé Krrr.
dialogsBegin.id: Itu adalah kuil besar di langit. Krren menyelidiki kuil hanya untuk terinfeksi oleh penyakit di dalam gua yang disebut Cold Fear.
dialogsBegin.it: It was a huge temple in the sky. Krren investigated the temple only to become infected by a disease within the cave called Cold Fear.
dialogsBegin.jp: そこは、このマドリガルより遥か天空にある漆黒の闇につつまれた巨大な神殿だったそうだ。ここで遭遇したのが、グルングだ。闇黒の恐怖と呼ぶものもいるがね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그곳은 하늘 위에 떠 있는 거대한 신전이었어요. 크르엔은 그 신전을 탐험하다가, '냉한의 공포'라는 동굴 안의 병에 걸렸죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: It was a huge temple in the sky. Krren investigated the temple only to become infected by a disease within the cave called Cold Fear.
dialogsBegin.pl: It was a huge temple in the sky. Krren investigated the temple only to become infected by a disease within the cave called Cold Fear.
dialogsBegin.ru: It was a huge temple in the sky. Krren investigated the temple only to become infected by a disease within the cave called Cold Fear.
dialogsBegin.sp: Era un gran templo en el cielo. Krren investigó el templo pero solo consiguió infectarse con una enfermedad llamada Miedo Frío.
dialogsBegin.sw: It was a huge temple in the sky. Krren investigated the temple only to become infected by a disease within the cave called Cold Fear.
dialogsBegin.th: มันเป็นวัดขนาดใหญ่บนท้องฟ้า Krren ตรวจสอบวัดเพียงเพื่อที่จะพบว่าตนเองติดเชื้อโรคภายในวัดที่มีชื่อเรียกว่า Horrible Fear
dialogsBegin.tw: 聽說有一個地下洞穴裡，住著一個叫做咕咕噥噥的怪獸。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đó là một ngôi đền khổng lồ trên bầu trời. Krren điều tra ngôi đền chỉ để bị lây nhiễm một căn bệnh trong hang động có tên là Cold Fear.

dialogsBegin.en: The disease transformed him into a hideous monster, whom we now call Krrr. There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so they say…
dialogsBegin.ar: The disease transformed him into a hideous monster, whom we now call Krrr. There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so they say…
dialogsBegin.br: Essa magia consumiu sua alma, o transformando em um monstro hediondo, a quem agora chamamos de Krrr, o Amedrontador. Segundo a lenda, não sobrou nada daquele bravo aventureiro e ele nunca retornou a si.
dialogsBegin.cns: 可是后来咕咕哝哝不知道到哪里去了，突然消失~反正啦..这是我这次小说的主要内容。
dialogsBegin.de: Krren verschwand nachdem er der "Kalten Furcht" begegnet war, soweit ich weiß. Tolle Geschichte, hm? Dreadpet, Kalte Furcht. Cooool!!
dialogsBegin.fi: The disease transformed him into a hideous monster, whom we now call Krrr. There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so they say…
dialogsBegin.fil: The disease transformed him into a hideous monster, whom we now call Krrr. There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so they say…
dialogsBegin.fr: On raconte que Krren Dacid disparu après avoir rencontré Krrr... C'est une histoire intrigante, n'est-ce pas ?
dialogsBegin.id: Penyakit itu mengubahnya menjadi monster yang mengerikan, yang sekarang kita sebut Krrr. Hampir tidak ada yang tersisa dari petualang pemberani itu kecuali potongan-potongan, atau begitulah kata mereka…
dialogsBegin.it: The disease transformed him into a hideous monster, whom we now call Krrr. There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so they say…
dialogsBegin.jp:
クルエンダは、このグルングに遭遇した後、消息を絶ったとして伝えられている・・・
とまぁ、これが今回の題材なんだ。闇黒の恐怖！伝説のシヴァーモンスター！！
どうかね？
dialogsBegin.kr: 그 병에 걸린 뒤, 그는 '크르르'이라는 끔찍한 괴물로 변해버렸어요. 예전의 용감하던 모습은 사라지고, 조각조각 흩어진 흔적만 남았다고들 하죠…
dialogsBegin.nl: The disease transformed him into a hideous monster, whom we now call Krrr. There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so they say…
dialogsBegin.pl: The disease transformed him into a hideous monster, whom we now call Krrr. There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so they say…
dialogsBegin.ru: Эта болезнь превратила его в ужасного монстра. С тех пор он даже имени своего сказать не мог - только хрипел: Кр-р да Кр-р. Так его и прозвали…
dialogsBegin.sp: La enfermedad lo transformó en un horrible monstruo, al que ahora llamamos Krrr. Prácticamente no queda nada de aquel valiente aventurero, quizá algunos fragmentos, o eso dicen...
dialogsBegin.sw: The disease transformed him into a hideous monster, whom we now call Krrr. There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so they say…
dialogsBegin.th: โรคนี้ทำให้เขากลายเป็นสัตว์ประหลาดที่น่าเกลียดน่ากลัว หลังจากนั้นเขาก็ถูกเรียกว่า Krrr ไม่มีคราบของนักผจญภัยผู้กล้าหาญอีกต่อไป และนี่ก็คือเรื่องราวทั้งหมดที่เกิดขึ้น...
dialogsBegin.tw: 可是後來咕咕噥噥不知道到哪裡去了，突然消失~反正啦…這是我這次小說的主要內容。
dialogsBegin.vi: Căn bệnh đã biến anh ta thành một con quái vật gớm ghiếc, mà chúng ta gọi là Krrr. Hầu như không còn gì về nhà thám hiểm dũng cảm đó ngoài những thứ linh tinh người ta kể…

dialogsBegin.en: So, here's where you come in. I need an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Krrr. So whaddya' say?
dialogsBegin.ar: So, here's where you come in. I need an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Krrr. So whaddya' say?
dialogsBegin.br: Então, aqui é onde você entra. Eu preciso de um final para a história e gostaria de saber o que aconteceu com Krrr depois disso. Então o que diz?
dialogsBegin.cns: 所以啊..你可不可以代替我亲自去体验看看啊?然后再把那个体验的结果说给我听。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich möchte dass du wie Krren Dacid wirst und den Tempel auskundschaftest, wie er es tat. Dann erzählst du mir deine Geschichte. Okay?
dialogsBegin.fi: So, here's where you come in. I need an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Krrr. So whaddya' say?
dialogsBegin.fil: So, here's where you come in. I need an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Krrr. So whaddya' say?
dialogsBegin.fr: J'aimerais donc que tu te mettes dans la peau de Krren Dacid et que toi aussi tu explores ce lieu. Après tu me raconteras ce que tu as découvert. Qu'en penses-tu ?
dialogsBegin.id: Jadi, di sinilah kamu masuk. Saya perlu akhir cerita dan saya ingin tahu apa yang terjadi dengan Krrr. Jadi apa katamu?
dialogsBegin.it: So, here's where you come in. I need an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Krrr. So whaddya' say?
dialogsBegin.jp: そこで君に頼みがあるのだが・・・。この小説が完成できるように、君がクルエンダの代わりに、今話したことを体験し、私に話してほしいのだ。どうだ？やってくれるか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 그래서 부탁인데 말이에요. 이야기의 결말을 써야 하는데... 크르르가 어떻게 되었는지 알고 싶어요. 도와주실래요?
dialogsBegin.nl: So, here's where you come in. I need an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Krrr. So whaddya' say?
dialogsBegin.pl: So, here's where you come in. I need an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Krrr. So whaddya' say?
dialogsBegin.ru: Что было дальше, неизвестно. Роману нужна эффектная концовка, причем правдоподобная! Предлагаю тебе ведущую роль. Что скажешь?
dialogsBegin.sp: Y aquí es donde entras tú. Necesito un final para la historia y me gustaría saber qué ha sido de Krrr. Entonces, ¿qué me dices?
dialogsBegin.sw: So, here's where you come in. I need an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Krrr. So whaddya' say?
dialogsBegin.th: แล้วคุณก็ได้เดินทางมา ณ ที่แห่งนี้ ฉันต้องการตอนจบของเรื่องๆ นี้ ดังนั้นฉันจึงอยากรู้ว่าเกิดอะไรขึ้นกับ Krrr คุณจะว่ายังไงล่ะ?
dialogsBegin.tw: 所以啊…你可不可以代替我親自去體驗看看啊？然後再把那個體驗的結果說給我聽。
dialogsBegin.vi: Vì vậy, đây là nơi bạn đến. Tôi cần một đoạn kết cho câu chuyện và tôi muốn biết Krrr sẽ ra sao. Bạn nói gì?

dialogsAccept.en: Great! One of those Gangards at the Plain of Bubble scooped up one of my reference books. Defeat the Gangards and acquire the Book of Fear 2. While you're there, try to find the Temple Map.
dialogsAccept.ar: Great! One of those Gangards at the Plain of Bubble scooped up one of my reference books. Defeat the Gangards and acquire the Book of Fear 2. While you're there, try to find the Temple Map.
dialogsAccept.br: Perdi meu livro de referência para outro bicho enquanto vagava pela Planície de Bubble, Gangards. Sim eles pegaram! Cace os Gangards e adquira o Livro do Medo 2. Enquanto estiver lá, tente encontrar o Mapa do Templo.
dialogsAccept.cns: 好，恐怖之书第2卷在冰色巨眼怪身上，你得去波布尔平原击败冰色巨眼怪并获得书籍，然后在旁边的地上找一下寺庙地图
dialogsAccept.de: Fein. Bitte gehe nun und jage Gangard, er lebt in der Ebene von Bubble. Dann bekommst du Book of Fear2. Finde bitte auch ihr heiliges Land in dem Feld.
dialogsAccept.fi: Great! One of those Gangards at the Plain of Bubble scooped up one of my reference books. Defeat the Gangards and acquire the Book of Fear 2. While you're there, try to find the Temple Map.
dialogsAccept.fil: Great! One of those Gangards at the Plain of Bubble scooped up one of my reference books. Defeat the Gangards and acquire the Book of Fear 2. While you're there, try to find the Temple Map.
dialogsAccept.fr: Il te faut tout d'abord te rendre à la Plaine de Bubble, et te débarrasser des Gangards pour obtenir le Livre de Krrr.
dialogsAccept.id: Bagus! Salah satu Gangards at the Plain of Bubble itu mengambil salah satu buku referensi saya. Kalahkan Gangard dan dapatkan Book of Fear 2. Saat berada di sana, cobalah untuk menemukan Temple Map.
dialogsAccept.it: Great! One of those Gangards at the Plain of Bubble scooped up one of my reference books. Defeat the Gangards and acquire the Book of Fear 2. While you're there, try to find the Temple Map.
dialogsAccept.jp: よし！それでは、手始めにバブルの平原に生息するガンガードという奴を倒し、恐怖の書を持ってきてほしい。あぁ。それと、平原の何処かにある、彼らの聖地を見つけることも忘れないでくれよ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 좋아요! 버블 평원에 있는 간가드 중 하나가 제 작법서를 훔쳐갔어요. 간가드를 처치하고 공포의 서 2권을 회수해 주세요. 가능하다면, 그 근처에서 신전 지도도 찾아주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Great! One of those Gangards at the Plain of Bubble scooped up one of my reference books. Defeat the Gangards and acquire the Book of Fear 2. While you're there, try to find the Temple Map.
dialogsAccept.pl: Great! One of those Gangards at the Plain of Bubble scooped up one of my reference books. Defeat the Gangards and acquire the Book of Fear 2. While you're there, try to find the Temple Map.
dialogsAccept.ru: У меня была Книга кошмарищ, где говорилось о Ледяном Кошмаре и как его побороть, но ее съел ганмар. Верни книгу и поищи на поле план храма - он мог выпасть!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Genial! Uno de esos Gangards en la Llanura de Bubble robó uno de mis libros de referencia. Derrota a los Gangards y consigue el Libro del Miedo 2. Mientras estás allí, intenta encontrar el Mapa del Templo.
dialogsAccept.sw: Great! One of those Gangards at the Plain of Bubble scooped up one of my reference books. Defeat the Gangards and acquire the Book of Fear 2. While you're there, try to find the Temple Map.
dialogsAccept.th: เยี่ยม! หนึ่งในแก๊งค์ของ Plain of Bubble กินหนึ่งในหนังสืออ้างอิงของฉัน กำจัด Gangards และนำ Book of Fear 2 กลับมา ตอนคุณไปที่นั่นก็มองหา Temple Map ด้วยล่ะ
dialogsAccept.tw: 好，你首先去巴布樂平原找一個叫做坎哥德的人，他會給你恐怖的書第 2 卷，然後在平原的某處找一下他們的聖地…
dialogsAccept.vi: Tuyệt quá! Một trong những Gangards ở Plain of Bubble đã cuỗm mất một trong những cuốn sách tham khảo của tôi. Hãy đánh bại các Gangards và nhận được Quyển sách sợ hãi 2 (Book of Fear 2). Khi bạn ở đó, hãy cố gắng tìm ra Temple Map.

dialogsDecline.en: Oh, come on now! Tell you what, I'll give you 50% of the proceeds from the sale of my book when I release it! How does that sound? Bah!
dialogsDecline.ar: Oh, come on now! Tell you what, I'll give you 50% of the proceeds from the sale of my book when I release it! How does that sound? Bah!
dialogsDecline.br: Ah, vamos lá! Achei que éramos parceiros de negócios... Olha só, eu lhe darei 50% dos lucros da venda do meu livro quando o lançar! Não é bom pra você? Bah!
dialogsDecline.cns: 反正，应该是一个很棒的冒险啦!我会拿我卖书的收入50%给你，好不好?
dialogsDecline.de: Ach, kommen Sie schon! Ich sag dir was, ich gebe dir 50% der Einnahmen aus dem Verkauf meines Buches, wenn ich es herausbringe! Wie hört sich das an? Bah!
dialogsDecline.fi: Oh, come on now! Tell you what, I'll give you 50% of the proceeds from the sale of my book when I release it! How does that sound? Bah!
dialogsDecline.fil: Oh, come on now! Tell you what, I'll give you 50% of the proceeds from the sale of my book when I release it! How does that sound? Bah!
dialogsDecline.fr: Aussi, fouille bien les environs pour trouver la Carte du temple. Ce sera une grande aventure, toujours partant ?
dialogsDecline.id: Ayo sekarang! Katakan apa, saya akan memberimu 50% dari hasil penjualan buku saya ketika saya merilisnya! Bagaimana itu terdengar? Bah!
dialogsDecline.it: Oh, come on now! Tell you what, I'll give you 50% of the proceeds from the sale of my book when I release it! How does that sound? Bah!
dialogsDecline.jp:
とてもスリリングで、冒険者にはたまらない話だと思うんだが・・・。私がこの本を出版したら、売り上げの50％をあげよう。
どうだい？それでもやらないのかい？
dialogsDecline.kr: 아, 그러지 말고요! 그럼 이렇게 하죠. 제 책 출간되면 수익의 50%를 드릴게요! 괜찮죠? 참나!
dialogsDecline.nl: Oh, come on now! Tell you what, I'll give you 50% of the proceeds from the sale of my book when I release it! How does that sound? Bah!
dialogsDecline.pl: Oh, come on now! Tell you what, I'll give you 50% of the proceeds from the sale of my book when I release it! How does that sound? Bah!
dialogsDecline.ru: Oh, come on now! Tell you what, I'll give you 50% of the proceeds from the sale of my book when I release it! How does that sound? Bah!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Oh, venga ya! ¡Te daré el 50% de las ganancias de la venta de mi libro cuando lo publique! ¿Qué te parece eso? ¡Bah!
dialogsDecline.sw: Oh, come on now! Tell you what, I'll give you 50% of the proceeds from the sale of my book when I release it! How does that sound? Bah!
dialogsDecline.th: ง่าาาาาา ไม่เอาน่า! จะบอกอะไรให้นะ ฉันจะให้ 50% ของเงินที่ได้จากการขายหนังสือของฉันตอนปล่อยขายเลยนะ! คุณคิดว่าดีไหมล่ะ? อุบ๊ะ!
dialogsDecline.tw: 反正，應該是一個很棒的冒險啦！我會拿我賣書的收入 50% 給你，好不好？
dialogsDecline.vi: Ồ, đi ngay! Nói bạn biết, tôi sẽ chia cho bạn 50% số tiền thu được từ việc bán sách của tôi khi tôi phát hành nó! Nghe như thế nào? Ô hay!

dialogsComplete.en: Blessings from Bubble, you've got it! It looks like you do indeed have what it takes to face Krrr.
dialogsComplete.ar: Blessings from Bubble, you've got it! It looks like you do indeed have what it takes to face Krrr.
dialogsComplete.br: Bênçãos de Bubble, você conseguiu! Parece que você realmente tem o que é preciso para enfrentar Krrr, o Amedrontador.
dialogsComplete.cns: 哈哈，这么难的事情都办完了啊?把这个收下吧!这是克安达施德的心脏，好恶心喔~我不想看。
dialogsComplete.de: Oh, du bist echt gut!! Hier bitte. Dies ist das Herz von Krren. Wie abscheulich es doch ist!
dialogsComplete.fi: Blessings from Bubble, you've got it! It looks like you do indeed have what it takes to face Krrr.
dialogsComplete.fil: Blessings from Bubble, you've got it! It looks like you do indeed have what it takes to face Krrr.
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh, tu es vraiment fort !! Voilà pour toi, il s'agit du cœur de Dacid. Un peu dégoûtant, je sais.
dialogsComplete.id: Anugrah dari Bubble, kamu mendapatkannya! Sepertinya kamu memang memiliki apa yang diperlukan untuk menghadapi Krrr.
dialogsComplete.it: Blessings from Bubble, you've got it! It looks like you do indeed have what it takes to face Krrr.
dialogsComplete.jp: おぉー！君！さすがじゃないか！結構大変だっただろう。よーし、これを受け取ってくれ。これはシードの心臓だ。とても気持ち悪くて、私は見たくもないがね。
dialogsComplete.kr: 버블의 축복이 함께하시길! 당신이라면 충분히 크르르와 맞설 수 있을 것 같아요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Blessings from Bubble, you've got it! It looks like you do indeed have what it takes to face Krrr.
dialogsComplete.pl: Blessings from Bubble, you've got it! It looks like you do indeed have what it takes to face Krrr.
dialogsComplete.ru: Да-да, это та самая книга, благослови тебя Лучик! Теперь ты справишься с Кр-ром.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Bendiciones de Bubble, lo tienes! Parece que tienes todo lo necesario para enfrentarte a Krrr.
dialogsComplete.sw: Blessings from Bubble, you've got it! It looks like you do indeed have what it takes to face Krrr.
dialogsComplete.th: คุณหามันมาได้เหรอ Blessings from Bubble น่ะ! ดูเหมือนว่าคุณมีสิ่งที่จะไปเผชิญหน้ากับ Krrr แล้วล่ะ
dialogsComplete.tw: 哈哈，連巴布樂的祝福都降臨了！看來你確實有本事面對 Krrr。
dialogsComplete.vi: Phước lành từ Bubble, bạn đã có nó! Có vẻ như bạn thực sự có những gì cần thiết để đối mặt với Krrr.

dialogsComplete.en: If you're done being sick, take the heart to the Dreadpet Manager in Madren Town. You'll have to join a party to enter the temple, it's way too dangerous to go alone.
dialogsComplete.ar: If you're done being sick, take the heart to the Dreadpet Manager in Madren Town. You'll have to join a party to enter the temple, it's way too dangerous to go alone.
dialogsComplete.br: Se já acabou de vomitar, leve o coração para o Gestor de Dreadpet na Vila Madren. Você terá que juntar um grupo para entrar no templo, é muito perigoso ir sozinho.
dialogsComplete.cns: 你先去找特莱特怪物管理者，他会告诉你一些事情，但是绝对不要自己去体验喔~一定要组剧团进去!
dialogsComplete.de: Nun geh bitte und treffe den Dreadpet Verwalter im Dorf Madren, er wird dir den Weg zeigen. Oh und du musst einer Party beitreten bevor du gehst, es ist alleine sehr schwer. Okay?
dialogsComplete.fi: If you're done being sick, take the heart to the Dreadpet Manager in Madren Town. You'll have to join a party to enter the temple, it's way too dangerous to go alone.
dialogsComplete.fil: If you're done being sick, take the heart to the Dreadpet Manager in Madren Town. You'll have to join a party to enter the temple, it's way too dangerous to go alone.
dialogsComplete.fr: Maintenant va rencontrer le Manager Dreadpet à Madren, il te montrera le chemin. Mais tu devrais d'abord former un groupe...
dialogsComplete.id: Jika kamu sudah selesai sakit, bawa hati ke Manajer Dreadpet di Kota Madren. Kamu harus bergabung dalam pesta untuk memasuki kuil, terlalu berbahaya untuk pergi sendiri.
dialogsComplete.it: If you're done being sick, take the heart to the Dreadpet Manager in Madren Town. You'll have to join a party to enter the temple, it's way too dangerous to go alone.
dialogsComplete.jp: マッドランタウンの何処かにいるという、シヴァーモンスター伝道師の元へ行くといい。彼が案内してくれるはずだ。それと、一人では無理だから、必ずパーティーを組んで行くことだ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이제 좀 괜찮으신가요? 이 심장을 매드런 타운 드래드펫 관리자에게 전달해 주세요. 혼자 가기엔 위험하니까, 극단을 구하시는 게 좋을 거예요.
dialogsComplete.nl: If you're done being sick, take the heart to the Dreadpet Manager in Madren Town. You'll have to join a party to enter the temple, it's way too dangerous to go alone.
dialogsComplete.pl: If you're done being sick, take the heart to the Dreadpet Manager in Madren Town. You'll have to join a party to enter the temple, it's way too dangerous to go alone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Как почувствуешь себя лучше, отнеси сердце вейдеру в Мадренбург. В храм лучше не соваться в одиночку, так что собери труппу.
dialogsComplete.sp: Si has terminado de vomitar, llévale el corazón al Mánager Dreadpet en Pueblo Madren. Tendrás que unirte a una party para entrar al templo, es demasiado peligroso ir solo.
dialogsComplete.sw: If you're done being sick, take the heart to the Dreadpet Manager in Madren Town. You'll have to join a party to enter the temple, it's way too dangerous to go alone.
dialogsComplete.th: ถ้าเลิกป่วยแล้วก็เอาหัวใจไปหา Dreadpet Manager ในเมือง Madren คุณจะต้องเข้าร่วมงานปาร์ตี้เพื่อเข้าไปในวิหารซึ่งเป็นวิธีที่อันตรายเกินกว่าที่จะไปคนเดียว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你先去找特萊特怪物管理者，他會告訴你一些事情，但是絕對不要自己去體驗喔~一定要組劇團進去！
dialogsComplete.vi: Nếu bạn bị ốm xong, hãy mang trái tim tới Dreadpet Manager ở Thị trấn Madren. Bạn sẽ phải tham gia một bữa tiệc để vào đền thờ, quá nguy hiểm nếu đi một mình.

dialogsFail.en: Look, I know Ganguard's smell bad and all that, so I understand your reservations… but I really need that book.
dialogsFail.ar: Look, I know Ganguard's smell bad and all that, so I understand your reservations… but I really need that book.
dialogsFail.br: Olha, eu sei que os Ganguards cheiram mal e tudo mais, então eu entendo seu recuo... mas eu realmente preciso daquele livro.
dialogsFail.cns: 坎哥德这家伙是有点狡猾啦!可是我相信，如果是你的话，一定没有问题的!
dialogsFail.de: Ich weiß es ist schwierig Gangard zu bekämpfen, weil er von der kalten Furcht infiziert wurde. Aber ich glaube du kannst es schaffen. Viel Glück!
dialogsFail.fi: Look, I know Ganguard's smell bad and all that, so I understand your reservations… but I really need that book.
dialogsFail.fil: Look, I know Ganguard's smell bad and all that, so I understand your reservations… but I really need that book.
dialogsFail.fr: Je sais qu'il est difficile de se battre contre les Gangards car ils ont été infectés par Krrr... Mais je suis sûr que tu peux le faire. Bonne chance !
dialogsFail.id: Dengar, aku tahu bau Ganguard tidak enak dan sebagainya, jadi aku mengerti keberatanmu… tapi aku sangat membutuhkan buku itu.
dialogsFail.it: Look, I know Ganguard's smell bad and all that, so I understand your reservations… but I really need that book.
dialogsFail.jp: ガンガードをあなどってはいかんぞ。なにしろ闇黒の洗礼を受けた奴だからな。でも、君ならきっと大丈夫だろう。頑張ってくれ！
dialogsFail.kr: 간가드는 냄새도 지독하고, 거부감이 드는 건 알아요. 하지만 그 책이 정말 꼭 필요해요.
dialogsFail.nl: Look, I know Ganguard's smell bad and all that, so I understand your reservations… but I really need that book.
dialogsFail.pl: Look, I know Ganguard's smell bad and all that, so I understand your reservations… but I really need that book.
dialogsFail.ru: Нет, ганмары, конечно, существа мерзкие, да и храм в небесах, а у тебя вестибулярный аппарат никуда не годится… Но все-таки раздобудь книгу.
dialogsFail.sp: Mira, sé que los Gangards huelen mal y todo eso, así que entiendo que no te guste... pero realmente necesito ese libro.
dialogsFail.sw: Look, I know Ganguard's smell bad and all that, so I understand your reservations… but I really need that book.
dialogsFail.th: ฟังนะ ฉันรู้ว่ากลิ่น Ganguard ไม่ดีแต่ก็มีแค่นั้นแหละ ฉันจึงเข้าใจสถานการณ์ของคุณนะ... แต่ฉันก็ต้องการหนังสือเล่มนั้นจริงๆ นี่นา
dialogsFail.tw: 坎哥德這傢伙是有點狡猾啦！可是我相信，如果是你的話，一定沒有問題的！
dialogsFail.vi: Này, tôi biết Ganguard có mùi hôi, vì vậy tôi hiểu sự dè dặt của bạn… nhưng tôi thực sự cần cuốn sách đó.

description.en: Go meet the Mayor of Darken and inform him of Elaine's departure.
description.ar: Go meet the Mayor of Darken and inform him of Elaine's departure.
description.br: Vá encontrar o Prefeito de Darken e informe para ele sobre da partida de Elaine.
description.cns: 去见达肯市长，告诉他伊莲即将离开。
description.de: Gehen Sie zum Bürgermeister von Darken und informieren Sie ihn über Elaines Abreise.
description.fi: Go meet the Mayor of Darken and inform him of Elaine's departure.
description.fil: Go meet the Mayor of Darken and inform him of Elaine's departure.
description.fr: Parlez au maire de Darkon.
description.id: Temui Mayor of Darken dan beri tahu dia tentang kepergian Elaine.
description.it: Go meet the Mayor of Darken and inform him of Elaine's departure.
description.jp: ダーコン市長に報告せよ。
description.kr: 다켄의 시장을 찾아가 일레인의 사임을 알려주세요.
description.nl: Go meet the Mayor of Darken and inform him of Elaine's departure.
description.pl: Go meet the Mayor of Darken and inform him of Elaine's departure.
description.ru: Go meet the Mayor of Darken and inform him of Elaine's departure.
description.sp: Reúnete con el Alcalde de Darken e infórmale de la renuncia de Elaine.
description.sw: Go meet the Mayor of Darken and inform him of Elaine's departure.
description.th: ไปพบกับนายกเทศมนตรีแห่ง Darken และแจ้งให้เขาทราบถึงการที่ Elaine ออกเดินทาง
description.tw: 去見得肯市長，告知他耶拉伊即將離開。
description.vi: Đến gặp Thị trưởng của Darken và thông báo cho ông ta về sự ra đi của Elaine.

dialogsBegin.en: This ring is... Where did you find this!? Yes... You are right. This ring belong to my sister. This is my only reminder of a past I've since tried to forget…
dialogsBegin.ar: This ring is... Where did you find this!? Yes... You are right. This ring belong to my sister. This is my only reminder of a past I've since tried to forget…
dialogsBegin.br: Este anel é..!! Onde você achou isso!? Sim.. você está certo. Este anel pertenceu à minha irmã. Este é o meu único lembrete de um passado que desde então tentei esquecer...
dialogsBegin.cns: This ring is... Where did you find this!? Yes... You are right. This ring belong to my sister. This is my only reminder of a past I've since tried to forget…
dialogsBegin.de: Dieser Ring ist...! Wo hast du den denn gefunden? Ja, du hast recht. Dieser Ring gehörte meiner Schwester. Er ist meine einzige Erinnerung an eine Vergangenheit, die ich seither zu vergessen versucht habe...
dialogsBegin.fi: This ring is... Where did you find this!? Yes... You are right. This ring belong to my sister. This is my only reminder of a past I've since tried to forget…
dialogsBegin.fil: This ring is... Where did you find this!? Yes... You are right. This ring belong to my sister. This is my only reminder of a past I've since tried to forget…
dialogsBegin.fr: Cette bague… où avez-vous trouvé ça ? Oui c'était à ma sœur, la seule chose que j'ai trouvé d'elle en revenant de la guerre.
dialogsBegin.id: Cincin ini adalah ..!! Di mana Anda menemukan ini !? Ya.. Kamu benar. Cincin ini milik saudara perempuanku. Ini adalah satu-satunya pengingat tentang masa lalu yang sejak saat itu saya coba lupakan ...
dialogsBegin.it: This ring is... Where did you find this!? Yes... You are right. This ring belong to my sister. This is my only reminder of a past I've since tried to forget…
dialogsBegin.jp: この指輪は！　どこで見つけたのです？　ええ……この指輪は妹のハイネルのものです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 반지는... 이걸 어디서 찾으신 거죠!? 그래요… 맞아요. 이건 제 여동생의 반지예요. 잊으려고 애썼던 제 과거의 유일한 흔적이죠…
dialogsBegin.nl: This ring is... Where did you find this!? Yes... You are right. This ring belong to my sister. This is my only reminder of a past I've since tried to forget…
dialogsBegin.pl: This ring is... Where did you find this!? Yes... You are right. This ring belong to my sister. This is my only reminder of a past I've since tried to forget…
dialogsBegin.ru: This ring is... Where did you find this!? Yes... You are right. This ring belong to my sister. This is my only reminder of a past I've since tried to forget…
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡¡Este anillo es...!! ¿¡Dónde lo has encontrado!? Sí, tienes razón. Este anillo pertenecía a mi hermana. Es el único recuerdo que queda de un pasado que he intentado olvidar...
dialogsBegin.sw: This ring is... Where did you find this!? Yes... You are right. This ring belong to my sister. This is my only reminder of a past I've since tried to forget…
dialogsBegin.th: แหวนนี้ .. !! คุณพบที่ไหน? อา..ใช่ แหวนนี้เป็นของพี่สาวของฉัน มันเป็นสิ่งที่ตอกย้ำในอดีตที่ฉันพยายามจะลืม ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 這枚戒指是……你是在哪裡找到的！？沒錯……你說得對。這枚戒指是我妹妹的。這是我唯一還留著、能讓我想起那段我一直想忘記的過去的東西……
dialogsBegin.vi: Chiếc nhẫn này... Bạn tìm thấy cái này ở đâu!? Ừ .. Bạn đúng rồi đấy. Chiếc nhẫn này thuộc về em gái tôi. Đây là kỷ niệm duy nhất của tôi về quá khứ mà tôi đã cố gắng quên đi…

dialogsBegin.en: I gave this ring to her as promise to always be there for her, but I couldn't fulfill that promise… I will forever blame myself for the events that befell her…
dialogsBegin.ar: I gave this ring to her as promise to always be there for her, but I couldn't fulfill that promise… I will forever blame myself for the events that befell her…
dialogsBegin.br: Eu dei este anel para ela como promessa de sempre estar lá para protegê-la, mas eu não pude cumprir essa promessa... Eu sempre me culparei pelos eventos que aconteceram com ela...
dialogsBegin.cns: 我把这枚戒指送给她，作为永远陪伴她的承诺，但我没能实现这个承诺......我将永远为她所遭遇的事情而自责...…
dialogsBegin.de: Ich gab ihr diesen Ring als Versprechen, immer für sie da zu sein, aber ich konnte dieses Versprechen nicht einlösen... Ich werde mir für immer die Schuld an den Ereignissen geben, die ihr widerfahren sind...
dialogsBegin.fi: I gave this ring to her as promise to always be there for her, but I couldn't fulfill that promise… I will forever blame myself for the events that befell her…
dialogsBegin.fil: I gave this ring to her as promise to always be there for her, but I couldn't fulfill that promise… I will forever blame myself for the events that befell her…
dialogsBegin.fr: *prend une air pensif* Pourquoi m'envoyer cette bague maintenant Zoro… que veux-tu me faire comprendre mon ami ?
dialogsBegin.id: Saya memberikan cincin ini kepadanya sebagai janji untuk selalu ada untuknya, tetapi saya tidak dapat memenuhi janji itu ... Saya akan selamanya menyalahkan diri sendiri atas peristiwa yang telah menimpanya...
dialogsBegin.it: I gave this ring to her as promise to always be there for her, but I couldn't fulfill that promise… I will forever blame myself for the events that befell her…
dialogsBegin.jp: ゾロがそんなことを言っていたのですね……。確かに、このままマドリガルの危機を見過ごしていては新たな悲しみが生まれてしまうかもしれません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 언제나 곁에 있겠다고 약속하며 이 반지를 건넸어요. 하지만 전 약속을 지키지 못했죠… 전 그 일을 평생 후회하며 살게 될 겁니다...
dialogsBegin.nl: I gave this ring to her as promise to always be there for her, but I couldn't fulfill that promise… I will forever blame myself for the events that befell her…
dialogsBegin.pl: I gave this ring to her as promise to always be there for her, but I couldn't fulfill that promise… I will forever blame myself for the events that befell her…
dialogsBegin.ru: I gave this ring to her as promise to always be there for her, but I couldn't fulfill that promise… I will forever blame myself for the events that befell her…
dialogsBegin.sp: Le di este anillo como símbolo de la promesa que le hice de estar siempre ahí para protegerla, pero no pude cumplir esa promesa... Siempre me culparé por lo que le sucedió...
dialogsBegin.sw: I gave this ring to her as promise to always be there for her, but I couldn't fulfill that promise… I will forever blame myself for the events that befell her…
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันให้แหวนนี้กับเธอเป็นสัญญาว่าจะอยู่กับเธอเสมอ แต่ฉันไม่สามารถปฏิบัติตามคำมั่นสัญญานั้นได้ ... ฉันโทษตัวเองในทุกๆเหตุการณ์ที่เกิดขึ้นกับเธอ ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 好的，我知道了。將我的妹妹逼死的不是我，而是那不得已狀況。如果我們能夠快一點消滅伊普里司，我的妹妹就不會遭遇到那樣的事情了吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đã trao chiếc nhẫn này cho cô ấy như một lời hứa sẽ luôn ở bên cô ấy, nhưng tôi đã không thể thực hiện lời hứa đó… Tôi sẽ mãi mãi tự trách mình về những sự kiện xảy đến với cô ấy…

dialogsBegin.en: You are right… I can't keep hiding forever. I need to take a stand. I need to prevent a situation like this from ever occurring again.
dialogsBegin.ar: You are right… I can't keep hiding forever. I need to take a stand. I need to prevent a situation like this from ever occurring again.
dialogsBegin.br: Mas... Você está certo… Não posso continuar me escondendo para sempre. Eu preciso me posicionar. Eu preciso evitar que uma situação como essa ocorra novamente.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你是对的...我不能永远逃避下去。我需要表明立场。我要防止像这样的情况再次发生。
dialogsBegin.de: Du hast Recht... Ich kann mich nicht ewig verstecken. Ich muss einen Standpunkt einnehmen. Ich muss verhindern, dass sich eine solche Situation jemals wieder ereignet.
dialogsBegin.fi: You are right… I can't keep hiding forever. I need to take a stand. I need to prevent a situation like this from ever occurring again.
dialogsBegin.fil: You are right… I can't keep hiding forever. I need to take a stand. I need to prevent a situation like this from ever occurring again.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je… je crois que je comprends le message. D'autres innocents mourront si je ne me joins pas à vous.
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu benar... Saya tidak bisa terus bersembunyi selamanya. Saya harus mengambil sikap. Saya perlu mencegah situasi seperti ini terjadi lagi.
dialogsBegin.it: You are right… I can't keep hiding forever. I need to take a stand. I need to prevent a situation like this from ever occurring again.
dialogsBegin.jp: ……わかりました。隠居して暮らすにはまだ早いようです。私も微力ながら貴方達に力をお貸ししましょう。二度と起こらないようにしなければならない。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그 말이 맞아요… 언제까지고 숨어 있을 순 없습니다. 일어나 맞서야 해요. 다시는 이런 일이 벌어지지 않도록.
dialogsBegin.nl: You are right… I can't keep hiding forever. I need to take a stand. I need to prevent a situation like this from ever occurring again.
dialogsBegin.pl: You are right… I can't keep hiding forever. I need to take a stand. I need to prevent a situation like this from ever occurring again.
dialogsBegin.ru: You are right… I can't keep hiding forever. I need to take a stand. I need to prevent a situation like this from ever occurring again.
dialogsBegin.sp: Tienes razón... No puedo seguir escondiéndome para siempre. Tengo que posicionarme. Hay que evitar que vuelva a ocurrir una situación como aquella.
dialogsBegin.sw: You are right… I can't keep hiding forever. I need to take a stand. I need to prevent a situation like this from ever occurring again.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณมีสิทธิ์ ... ฉันไม่สามารถซ่อนตัวได้ตลอดไป ฉันต้องการที่จะยืน ฉันต้องการที่จะป้องกันไม่ให้สถานการณ์เช่นนี้เกิดขึ้นอีกครั้ง
dialogsBegin.tw: 沒有錯。如果想要阻止和妹妹一樣的無辜犧牲，一定要和危險正面交鋒。之前我的想法好像是錯的，不是我想要逃避，就可以逃避的吧…
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn nói đúng… Tôi không thể tiếp tục trốn tránh mãi được. Tôi cần phải có lập trường. Tôi cần ngăn tình huống như thế này xảy ra lần nữa.

dialogsBegin.en: I will join alongside Zoro and Reonan. Before this, I need to wrap up some work. Could you please assist me this one last time?
dialogsBegin.ar: I will join alongside Zoro and Reonan. Before this, I need to wrap up some work. Could you please assist me this one last time?
dialogsBegin.br: Eu me juntarei ao lado de Zoro e Reonan. Antes disso, preciso encerrar um trabalho. Você poderia me ajudar com isso uma última vez?
dialogsBegin.cns: 我将与佐罗和瑞尔南一起加入。在这之前，我需要完成一些事情。能否请你最后一次协助我？
dialogsBegin.de: Ich werde zusammen mit Zoro und Reonan teilnehmen. Vorher muss ich noch einige Arbeiten abschließen. Könnten Sie mir bitte ein letztes Mal dabei helfen?
dialogsBegin.fi: I will join alongside Zoro and Reonan. Before this, I need to wrap up some work. Could you please assist me this one last time?
dialogsBegin.fil: I will join alongside Zoro and Reonan. Before this, I need to wrap up some work. Could you please assist me this one last time?
dialogsBegin.fr: Je combattrai donc aux côtés de Zoro et Reonan une fois de plus. Pouvez-vous m'aider une fois de plus ?
dialogsBegin.id: Aku akan bergabung bersama Zoro dan Reonan. Sebelum ini, saya perlu menyelesaikan beberapa pekerjaan. Bisakah Anda membantu saya kali ini untuk terakhir kalinya?
dialogsBegin.it: I will join alongside Zoro and Reonan. Before this, I need to wrap up some work. Could you please assist me this one last time?
dialogsBegin.jp: すぐにでも協力をしたいのですが、最後に一つだけお願いがあります。私はダーコンの環境保護団体の会長を兼務していました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 저도 조로와 함께 레오난과 뜻을 함께하겠습니다. 하지만 그 전에, 제 뒷정리는 마무리하고 가고 싶군요.. 좀 도와주겠습니까?
dialogsBegin.nl: I will join alongside Zoro and Reonan. Before this, I need to wrap up some work. Could you please assist me this one last time?
dialogsBegin.pl: I will join alongside Zoro and Reonan. Before this, I need to wrap up some work. Could you please assist me this one last time?
dialogsBegin.ru: I will join alongside Zoro and Reonan. Before this, I need to wrap up some work. Could you please assist me this one last time?
dialogsBegin.sp: Me uniré a Zoro y a Reonan. Antes de eso, necesito hacer algo que tengo pendiente. ¿Podrías ayudarme por última vez?
dialogsBegin.sw: I will join alongside Zoro and Reonan. Before this, I need to wrap up some work. Could you please assist me this one last time?
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันจะเข้าร่วมกับ Zoro และ Reonan ก่อนหน้านี้ฉันต้องตัดงานบางอย่าง คุณกรุณาช่วยฉันครั้งนี้ได้ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 我會加入索羅和雷奧南。不過在那之前，我得先把一些工作收尾。可以再幫我最後一次嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi sẽ tham gia cùng với Zoro và Reonan. Trước khi làm việc này, tôi cần phải hoàn thành một số công việc. Bạn có thể vui lòng giúp tôi điều này lần cuối được không?

dialogsAccept.en: I oversaw the Darkon Environmental Association. Unfortunately, if I am to prepare for battle, I will no longer be able to fulfill my duties. Could you inform the Mayor of my departure?
dialogsAccept.ar: I oversaw the Darkon Environmental Association. Unfortunately, if I am to prepare for battle, I will no longer be able to fulfill my duties. Could you inform the Mayor of my departure?
dialogsAccept.br: Eu sou Presidente da Associação Ambiental Darkon. Infelizmente, se devo me preparar para a batalha, não poderei mais cumprir meus deveres. Você poderia informar o Prefeito da minha partida?
dialogsAccept.cns: 我监督着达肯环境协会的工作。不幸的是，如果我要准备参加战斗，我将无法再履行我的职责。你能通知市长我的离开吗？
dialogsAccept.de: Ich leitete die Darkon Environmental Association. Wenn ich mich auf die Schlacht vorbereite, werde ich leider nicht mehr in der Lage sein, meine Pflichten zu erfüllen. Könntet Ihr den Bürgermeister über mein Ausscheiden informieren?
dialogsAccept.fi: I oversaw the Darkon Environmental Association. Unfortunately, if I am to prepare for battle, I will no longer be able to fulfill my duties. Could you inform the Mayor of my departure?
dialogsAccept.fil: I oversaw the Darkon Environmental Association. Unfortunately, if I am to prepare for battle, I will no longer be able to fulfill my duties. Could you inform the Mayor of my departure?
dialogsAccept.fr: Il faudrait faire savoir au maire de Darkon que je dois me préparer au combat. Il faudra donc lui dire de chercher un nouveau garde forestier.
dialogsAccept.id: Saya mengawasi Darkon Environmental Association. Sayangnya, jika saya ingin bersiap untuk pertempuran, saya tidak akan lagi dapat memenuhi tugas saya. Bisakah Anda memberi tahu Mayor tentang kepergian saya?
dialogsAccept.it: I oversaw the Darkon Environmental Association. Unfortunately, if I am to prepare for battle, I will no longer be able to fulfill my duties. Could you inform the Mayor of my departure?
dialogsAccept.jp: これからの闘いを考えるとこの任務は誰かに引き継がねばなりません。市長にその旨を伝えて頂けませんか。
dialogsAccept.kr: 어려운 일은 아닙니다. 제가 다콘에서 다콘 자연 사랑 이라는 환경 단체에 회장을 맡고 있었는데, 이제 동료들과 전쟁을 준비하려면 이 일을 계속 할 수가 없어서요...다콘 시장님께 환경단체 회장직을 물러나겠노라 좀 전해 주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: I oversaw the Darkon Environmental Association. Unfortunately, if I am to prepare for battle, I will no longer be able to fulfill my duties. Could you inform the Mayor of my departure?
dialogsAccept.pl: I oversaw the Darkon Environmental Association. Unfortunately, if I am to prepare for battle, I will no longer be able to fulfill my duties. Could you inform the Mayor of my departure?
dialogsAccept.ru: I oversaw the Darkon Environmental Association. Unfortunately, if I am to prepare for battle, I will no longer be able to fulfill my duties. Could you inform the Mayor of my departure?
dialogsAccept.sp: Superviso la Asociación Ambiental de Darkon. Pero, si tengo que prepararme para la batalla, ya no podré cumplir con mis deberes. ¿Podrías informar al Alcalde de mi renuncia?
dialogsAccept.sw: I oversaw the Darkon Environmental Association. Unfortunately, if I am to prepare for battle, I will no longer be able to fulfill my duties. Could you inform the Mayor of my departure?
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันเป็นผู้ดูแลสมาคมสิ่งแวดล้อมของ Darkon แต่ถ้าผมเตรียมพร้อมสำหรับการสู้รบผมจะไม่สามารถปฏิบัติหน้าที่ของผมได้อีกต่อไป คุณสามารถแจ้งนายกเทศมนตรีของการเดินทางของฉันได้หรือไม่?
dialogsAccept.tw: 這不是困難的事情。我在得肯擔任名為得肯自然愛護的環境團體的會長一職。如果現在要和同伴們一起準備，這無法再接受這份差事。請你幫我向得肯市長轉達我要放棄環境團體會長一職。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi giám sát Hiệp hội Môi trường Darkon. Thật không may, nếu tôi chuẩn bị cho trận chiến, tôi sẽ không thể hoàn thành nhiệm vụ của mình nữa. Bạn có thể thông báo cho Thị trưởng về sự rời đi của tôi không?

dialogsDecline.en: I would do it myself, but it will take up even more of my time…
dialogsDecline.ar: I would do it myself, but it will take up even more of my time…
dialogsDecline.br: Eu poderia ir resolver isso, mas vai tomar ainda mais do meu tempo...
dialogsDecline.cns: 我想自己做，但这将占用我很多的时间...
dialogsDecline.de: Ich würde es selbst tun, aber das würde noch mehr Zeit in Anspruch nehmen...
dialogsDecline.fi: I would do it myself, but it will take up even more of my time…
dialogsDecline.fil: I would do it myself, but it will take up even more of my time…
dialogsDecline.fr: Je vous en prie, j'ai beaucoup de retard dans mon entrainement.
dialogsDecline.id: Saya akan melakukannya sendiri, tetapi itu akan memakan lebih banyak waktu saya...
dialogsDecline.it: I would do it myself, but it will take up even more of my time…
dialogsDecline.jp: そうですか。いえ、貴方とはわかりあえてきたと思いましたが残念です。
dialogsDecline.kr: 제가 직접 전하고 싶지만, 시간이 더 걸릴 것 같아서요...
dialogsDecline.nl: I would do it myself, but it will take up even more of my time…
dialogsDecline.pl: I would do it myself, but it will take up even more of my time…
dialogsDecline.ru: I would do it myself, but it will take up even more of my time…
dialogsDecline.sp: Lo haría yo mismo, pero me haría perder más tiempo...
dialogsDecline.sw: I would do it myself, but it will take up even more of my time…
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันจะทำมันเอง แต่มันจะใช้เวลามากกว่านี้ เวลาของฉัน ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 如果只有我一個人做，時間會花費很久吧…
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi sẽ tự làm, nhưng nó sẽ chiếm nhiều thời gian của tôi hơn…

dialogsComplete.ar: Oh, you are that adventurer. What are you doing back this way?
dialogsComplete.br: Oh, você é aquele(a) aventureiro(a). O que você está fazendo de volta aqui?
dialogsComplete.cns: 哦，你就是那个冒险家。你回来做什么？
dialogsComplete.de: Oh, Du bist dieser Abenteurer. Was machst du denn hier hinten?
dialogsComplete.fi: Oh, you are that adventurer. What are you doing back this way?
dialogsComplete.fil: Oh, you are that adventurer. What are you doing back this way?
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh, encore vous ? Qu'est-ce qui vous amène cette fois ?
dialogsComplete.id: Oh, kamu adalah petualang itu. Apa yang kamu lakukan dengan kembali ke sini?
dialogsComplete.it: Oh, you are that adventurer. What are you doing back this way?
dialogsComplete.jp: あら、貴方はいつぞやの冒険者さんじゃない。ずいぶんとたくましくなったわね！
dialogsComplete.kr: 오, 그때 그 모험가 아닌가요. 무슨 일로 왔습니까?
dialogsComplete.nl: Oh, you are that adventurer. What are you doing back this way?
dialogsComplete.pl: Oh, you are that adventurer. What are you doing back this way?
dialogsComplete.ru: Oh, you are that adventurer. What are you doing back this way?
dialogsComplete.sp: Oh, tú eres ese aventurero. ¿Qué haces por aquí de nuevo?
dialogsComplete.sw: Oh, you are that adventurer. What are you doing back this way?
dialogsComplete.th: โอ้ว คุณเป็นนักผจญภัยคนนั้น คุณมาทำอะไรที่นี่ ?
dialogsComplete.tw: 喔喔，你不是那個冒險家嗎？是什麼風把你吹來的啊？
dialogsComplete.vi: Ồ, bạn là nhà thám hiểm. Bạn đang làm gì trở lại theo cách này?

dialogsFail.en: It will be great if the Mayor of Darken understands my decision...
dialogsFail.ar: It will be great if the Mayor of Darken understands my decision...
dialogsFail.br: Será ótimo se o prefeito de Darken entender minha decisão..
dialogsFail.cns: It will be great if the Mayor of Darken understands my decision...
dialogsFail.de: Es wäre toll, wenn der Bürgermeister von Darken meine Entscheidung verstehen würde.
dialogsFail.fi: It will be great if the Mayor of Darken understands my decision...
dialogsFail.fil: It will be great if the Mayor of Darken understands my decision...
dialogsFail.fr: J'espère que le maire comprendra ma décision.
dialogsFail.id: Akan sangat bagus jika Mayor of Darken memahami keputusan saya..
dialogsFail.it: It will be great if the Mayor of Darken understands my decision...
dialogsFail.jp: 市長が私の気持ちを汲んでくださればよいのですが。
dialogsFail.kr: 다켄 시장님이 제 결정을 이해해 주시면 좋겠네요...
dialogsFail.nl: It will be great if the Mayor of Darken understands my decision...
dialogsFail.pl: It will be great if the Mayor of Darken understands my decision...
dialogsFail.ru: It will be great if the Mayor of Darken understands my decision...
dialogsFail.sp: Sería genial que el Alcalde de Darken entienda mi decisión...
dialogsFail.sw: It will be great if the Mayor of Darken understands my decision...
dialogsFail.th: จะดีมากถ้านายกเทศมนตรีแห่งเมือง Darken เข้าใจการตัดสินใจของฉัน ..
dialogsFail.tw: 如果得肯市長能理解我的決定就好了……
dialogsFail.vi: Sẽ thật tuyệt nếu the Mayor of Darken hiểu được quyết định của tôi...

description.ar: Go meet the Mayor of Darken located in Darkon 2. Maybe he will have more information on the missing heroes.
description.br: Conheça o Prefeito de Darken localizado em Darkon 2. Talvez ele tenha mais informações sobre os heróis desaparecidos.
description.cns: 去见达肯 2的达肯市长。也许他会有更多关于失踪英雄的信息。
description.de: Triff dich mit dem Bürgermeister von Darken in Darkon 2. Vielleicht hat er mehr Informationen über die vermissten Helden.
description.fi: Go meet the Mayor of Darken located in Darkon 2. Maybe he will have more information on the missing heroes.
description.fil: Go meet the Mayor of Darken located in Darkon 2. Maybe he will have more information on the missing heroes.
description.fr: Allez vite chercher l'aide du maire de Darkon.
description.id: Temui Mayor of Darken yang terletak di Darkon 2. Mungkin dia akan memiliki lebih banyak informasi tentang pahlawan yang hilang.
description.it: Go meet the Mayor of Darken located in Darkon 2. Maybe he will have more information on the missing heroes.
description.jp: ダーコンの市長を訪ねよ。
description.kr: 또 다른 영웅의 환생들이 등장했다는 소문이 있다. 다콘 제 2지구에 있는 다콘 시장에게 찾아가라.
