description.ru: Go meet the Mayor of Darken located in Darkon 2. Maybe he will have more information on the missing heroes.
description.sp: Reúnete con el Alcalde de Darken ubicado en Darkon 2. Puede que tenga más información sobre los héroes desaparecidos.
description.sw: Go meet the Mayor of Darken located in Darkon 2. Maybe he will have more information on the missing heroes.
description.th: ไปพบกับนายกเทศมนตรีแห่ง Darken ที่ตั้งอยู่ใน Darkon 2 บางทีเขาอาจจะมีข้อมูลเพิ่มเติมเกี่ยวกับฮีโร่ที่หายไป
description.tw: 去見位於得肯第二區的市長，也許他會有更多關於失蹤英雄的訊息。
description.vi: Đi gặp Thị trưởng của Darken trong Darkon 2. Có thể ông ta sẽ có thêm thông tin về những anh hùng mất tích.

dialogsBegin.en: This is more urgent that I thought… I was aware of the impending return of Shade, but this soon? I'm sorry I had to hide so much from you. Here is the truth…
dialogsBegin.ar: This is more urgent that I thought… I was aware of the impending return of Shade, but this soon? I'm sorry I had to hide so much from you. Here is the truth…
dialogsBegin.br: Isso é mais urgente do que eu pensava… Eu estava ciente do iminente retorno de Shade, mas tão cedo?? Me desculpe, eu tive que esconder tanto de você. Aqui está a verdade…
dialogsBegin.cns: This is more urgent that I thought… I was aware of the impending return of Shade, but this soon? I'm sorry I had to hide so much from you. Here is the truth…
dialogsBegin.de: Es ist dringender, als ich dachte... Ich wusste von der bevorstehenden Rückkehr von Shade, aber so schnell? Es tut mir leid, dass ich so viel vor dir verbergen musste. Hier ist die Wahrheit...
dialogsBegin.fi: This is more urgent that I thought… I was aware of the impending return of Shade, but this soon? I'm sorry I had to hide so much from you. Here is the truth…
dialogsBegin.fil: This is more urgent that I thought… I was aware of the impending return of Shade, but this soon? I'm sorry I had to hide so much from you. Here is the truth…
dialogsBegin.fr: Je dois vous faire un aveu. Je vous ai caché beaucoup de choses… mais cette prophétie change la donne.
dialogsBegin.id: Ini lebih mendesak yang saya sangka... Saya menyadari bahwa Shade akan kembali, tapi ini terlalu cepat?? Maaf saya harus menyembunyikan begitu banyak hal darimu. Inilah kebenarannya...
dialogsBegin.it: This is more urgent that I thought… I was aware of the impending return of Shade, but this soon? I'm sorry I had to hide so much from you. Here is the truth…
dialogsBegin.jp: 思ったよりも話がおおごとになってきたね。すまない……君をだますつもりはなかったのだが……。
dialogsBegin.kr: 생각보다 훨씬 시급한 일이네요… 쉐이드의 귀환이 임박했다는 건 알고 있었지만, 이렇게 빨리 올 줄은... 지금까지 많은 걸 숨겨서 죄송해요. 결국 진실은 이 모양이네요...
dialogsBegin.nl: This is more urgent that I thought… I was aware of the impending return of Shade, but this soon? I'm sorry I had to hide so much from you. Here is the truth…
dialogsBegin.pl: This is more urgent that I thought… I was aware of the impending return of Shade, but this soon? I'm sorry I had to hide so much from you. Here is the truth…
dialogsBegin.ru: This is more urgent that I thought… I was aware of the impending return of Shade, but this soon? I'm sorry I had to hide so much from you. Here is the truth…
dialogsBegin.sp: Esto es más urgente de lo que pensaba… Estaba al tanto del inminente regreso de Shade, pero ¿¿tan pronto?? Lamento haber tenido que ocultar tanta información. Aquí está la verdad…
dialogsBegin.sw: This is more urgent that I thought… I was aware of the impending return of Shade, but this soon? I'm sorry I had to hide so much from you. Here is the truth…
dialogsBegin.th: เรื่องนี้เร่งด่วนกว่าที่ฉันคิดไว้มาก... ฉันรู้ว่าการกลับมาของเงามืดกำลังจะเกิดขึ้น แต่เร็วขนาดนี้เลยเหรอ? ฉันขอโทษที่ต้องปิดบังคุณไว้มากมาย นี่คือความจริง...
dialogsBegin.tw: 事情比我想的還緊急……我原本就知道闇影即將回歸，但會這麼快？抱歉，我之前隱瞞了你很多事。現在我把真相告訴你……
dialogsBegin.vi: Điều này cấp bách hơn tôi nghĩ… Tôi đã biết về sự trở lại sắp tới của Shade, nhưng điều này xảy ra sớm như thế này sao? Tôi xin lỗi vì tôi đã phải giấu bạn quá nhiều.Thật ra sự thật là như thế này

dialogsBegin.en: Handel, Hael and I share a common past. We are all reincarnations of the 8 original heroes to defeat Shade in the War of the Gods. I was the first Knight Hero...
dialogsBegin.ar: Handel, Hael and I share a common past. We are all reincarnations of the 8 original heroes to defeat Shade in the War of the Gods. I was the first Knight Hero...
dialogsBegin.br: Handel, Hael e eu compartilhamos um passado em comum. Somos todos reencarnações dos 8 heróis originais para derrotar Shade na Guerra dos Deuses. Eu fui o primeiro Herói Knight...
dialogsBegin.cns: 汉德尔、海尔和我有着共同的过去。我们都是在众神之战中击败谢莉德的8位初始英雄的转世。我就是第一个骑士英雄...
dialogsBegin.de: Handel, Hael und ich haben eine gemeinsame Vergangenheit. Wir sind alle Reinkarnationen der 8 ursprünglichen Helden, die Shade im Krieg der Götter besiegten. Ich war der erste Knight Hero...
dialogsBegin.fi: Handel, Hael and I share a common past. We are all reincarnations of the 8 original heroes to defeat Shade in the War of the Gods. I was the first Knight Hero...
dialogsBegin.fil: Handel, Hael and I share a common past. We are all reincarnations of the 8 original heroes to defeat Shade in the War of the Gods. I was the first Knight Hero...
dialogsBegin.fr: Je suis la réincarnation d'un des héros qui a combattu les monstres au côté de Bubble et d'Ivillis pendant la guerre des Héros.
dialogsBegin.id: Handel, Hael dan saya berbagi masa lalu yang sama. Kami semua adalah reinkarnasi dari 8 pahlawan asli yang mengalahkan Shade dalam War of the Gods. Aku adalah Knight Hero yang pertama...
dialogsBegin.it: Handel, Hael and I share a common past. We are all reincarnations of the 8 original heroes to defeat Shade in the War of the Gods. I was the first Knight Hero...
dialogsBegin.jp: ヘンデル、ハエル、私たちには同じ過去があります。私たちは皆、神々の戦争でシェイドを倒した8人のヒーローの生まれ変わりなのです。その時私は、ナイトのヒーローだったのです......。
dialogsBegin.kr: 사실 나는 오랜 옛날 영웅 전쟁에서 이블리스를 소멸시켰던 여덟 영웅 중  한명이네. 무슨 이유에서인지 모르지만 난 전생의 영웅이었던 기억을 갖은 채 환생하였지.
dialogsBegin.nl: Handel, Hael and I share a common past. We are all reincarnations of the 8 original heroes to defeat Shade in the War of the Gods. I was the first Knight Hero...
dialogsBegin.pl: Handel, Hael and I share a common past. We are all reincarnations of the 8 original heroes to defeat Shade in the War of the Gods. I was the first Knight Hero...
dialogsBegin.ru: Handel, Hael and I share a common past. We are all reincarnations of the 8 original heroes to defeat Shade in the War of the Gods. I was the first Knight Hero...
dialogsBegin.sp: Handel, Hael y yo compartimos un pasado en común. Los tres somos reencarnaciones de los 8 héroes originales que derrotaron a Shade en la Guerra de los Dioses. Yo fui el primer Héroe Knight...
dialogsBegin.sw: Handel, Hael and I share a common past. We are all reincarnations of the 8 original heroes to defeat Shade in the War of the Gods. I was the first Knight Hero...
dialogsBegin.th: Handel, Hael และฉันแบ่งปันกันในอดีต เราเป็นวีรบุรุษทั้งหมดของวีรบุรุษดั้งเดิม 8 ตัวเพื่อเอาชนะ Shade ในสงครามแห่งเทพ ฉันเป็นฮีโร่อัศวินคนแรก ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 賀丹爾、哈爾和我有著共同的過去。我們都是在諸神之戰中擊敗闇影的 8 位原創英雄的轉世。我是第一個騎士英雄…
dialogsBegin.vi: Handel, Hael và tôi có chung một quá khứ. Tất cả chúng ta đều là sự tái sinh của 8 anh hùng thuở sơ khai để đánh bại Shade trong War of the Gods. Tôi là Knight Hero đầu tiên ...

dialogsBegin.en: We were all appointed by Bubble as champions of our respective classes, and led the armies of mankind against Shade and her masquerpets.
dialogsBegin.ar: We were all appointed by Bubble as champions of our respective classes, and led the armies of mankind against Shade and her masquerpets.
dialogsBegin.br: Todos nós fomos nomeados por Bubble como campeões de nossas respectivas classes, e lideramos os exércitos da humanidade contra Shade e seus masquerpets.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我们都被波布尔任命为各自职业的领袖，带领人类军队对抗谢莉德和她的怪物军队。
dialogsBegin.de: Wir alle wurden von Bubble zum Champion unserer jeweiligen Klasse ernannt und führten die Armeen der Menschheit gegen Shade und ihre Masquerpets an.
dialogsBegin.fi: We were all appointed by Bubble as champions of our respective classes, and led the armies of mankind against Shade and her masquerpets.
dialogsBegin.fil: We were all appointed by Bubble as champions of our respective classes, and led the armies of mankind against Shade and her masquerpets.
dialogsBegin.fr: Handel et Hael ne font qu'un. Elle est la réincarnation du Héros prêtre qui nous accompagnait. Il doit y avoir une raison pour laquelle nous sommes tous renés à cette époque.
dialogsBegin.id: Kami semua ditunjuk oleh Bubble sebagai juara dari kelas kami masing-masing, dan memimpin pasukan umat manusia melawan Shade dan penyamarannya.
dialogsBegin.it: We were all appointed by Bubble as champions of our respective classes, and led the armies of mankind against Shade and her masquerpets.
dialogsBegin.jp: 私たちは皆、バブルによって各職業の賢者として任命され、軍勢を率いてシェイドとイブリスと闘いを繰り広げたのだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 우리는 모두 버블에 의해 각자의 직업을 대표하는 챔피언으로 임명되었고, 인류의 군대를 이끌고 쉐이드와 그녀의 마스커펫들과 맞서 싸웠었지.
dialogsBegin.nl: We were all appointed by Bubble as champions of our respective classes, and led the armies of mankind against Shade and her masquerpets.
dialogsBegin.pl: We were all appointed by Bubble as champions of our respective classes, and led the armies of mankind against Shade and her masquerpets.
dialogsBegin.ru: We were all appointed by Bubble as champions of our respective classes, and led the armies of mankind against Shade and her masquerpets.
dialogsBegin.sp: Todos fuimos designados por Bubble como campeones de nuestras respectivas clases, y lideramos los ejércitos de la humanidad contra Shade y sus masquerpets.
dialogsBegin.sw: We were all appointed by Bubble as champions of our respective classes, and led the armies of mankind against Shade and her masquerpets.
dialogsBegin.th: เราได้รับการแต่งตั้งจาก Bubble ให้เป็นตัวแทนของชั้นเรียนของเราและนำกองกำลังของมนุษยชาติต่อต้าน Shade และ masquerpets ของเธอ
dialogsBegin.tw: 我們都被巴布樂任命，並帶領人類軍隊對抗闇影和她的怪物。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tất cả chúng tôi đều được Bubble bổ nhiệm làm nhà vô địch của các lớp tương ứng và lãnh đạo đội quân của nhân loại chống lại Shade và những con masquerpets của bà ấy.

dialogsBegin.en: I feel it is due time for a reunification of the original 8 heroes... I know the other reincarnations are out there. I just hope we will be able to convince the rest of them. We don't have much time…
dialogsBegin.ar: I feel it is due time for a reunification of the original 8 heroes... I know the other reincarnations are out there. I just hope we will be able to convince the rest of them. We don't have much time…
dialogsBegin.br: Eu sinto que é a hora certa para reunir os 8 Heróis originais... Eu sei que as outras reencarnações estão por aí. Só espero que consigamos convencer todos eles. Não temos muito tempo…
dialogsBegin.cns: 我觉得是时候让初始的8位英雄回归了...我知道其他转世者也在那里。我只希望我们能说服其他人。我们没有太多时间了…
dialogsBegin.de: Ich denke, es ist an der Zeit für eine Wiedervereinigung der ursprünglichen 8 Helden... Ich weiß, dass die anderen Reinkarnationen da draußen sind. Ich hoffe nur, dass wir in der Lage sein werden, den Rest von ihnen zu überzeugen. Wir haben nicht viel Zeit...
dialogsBegin.fi: I feel it is due time for a reunification of the original 8 heroes... I know the other reincarnations are out there. I just hope we will be able to convince the rest of them. We don't have much time…
dialogsBegin.fil: I feel it is due time for a reunification of the original 8 heroes... I know the other reincarnations are out there. I just hope we will be able to convince the rest of them. We don't have much time…
dialogsBegin.fr: On dirait qu'une fois encore, les Héros du passé vont devoir unir leurs forces.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya merasa sudah waktunya untuk penyatuan kembali dari 8 pahlawan asli... Saya tahu reinkarnasi lain ada di luar sana. Saya hanya berharap kita bisa meyakinkan mereka semua. Kami tidak punya banyak waktu...
dialogsBegin.it: I feel it is due time for a reunification of the original 8 heroes... I know the other reincarnations are out there. I just hope we will be able to convince the rest of them. We don't have much time…
dialogsBegin.jp: 元の8人のヒーローの再集結の時が来たと感じています...。他の転生者がいるのは知っています。 過去の英雄を一刻も早く集めねばならないですね。 とにかく時間がないのです...。
dialogsBegin.kr: 8인의 영웅이 다시 모일 때인 것 같아요... 다른 환생자들도 어딘가 있을 겁니다. 전부 설득할 수 있길 바랄 뿐입니다. 시간이 많지 않거든요…
dialogsBegin.nl: I feel it is due time for a reunification of the original 8 heroes... I know the other reincarnations are out there. I just hope we will be able to convince the rest of them. We don't have much time…
dialogsBegin.pl: I feel it is due time for a reunification of the original 8 heroes... I know the other reincarnations are out there. I just hope we will be able to convince the rest of them. We don't have much time…
dialogsBegin.ru: I feel it is due time for a reunification of the original 8 heroes... I know the other reincarnations are out there. I just hope we will be able to convince the rest of them. We don't have much time…
dialogsBegin.sp: Ha llegado la hora de reunir a los 8 héroes originales... Sé que las otras reencarnaciones están por ahí fuera. Espero que podamos convencer al resto. No tenemos mucho tiempo…
dialogsBegin.sw: I feel it is due time for a reunification of the original 8 heroes... I know the other reincarnations are out there. I just hope we will be able to convince the rest of them. We don't have much time…
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันรู้สึกว่าถึงเวลาแล้วที่จะรวมตัวของวีรบุรุษทั้ง 8 ตัวเข้าด้วยกัน ... ฉันหวังว่าเราจะสามารถโน้มน้าวคนอื่น ๆ ได้ทั้งหมด เราไม่มีเวลามาก ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 我覺得是時候重新重組最初的 8 位英雄了……我知道其他轉世都在那裡。我只希望我們能夠說服其他人。我們沒有太多時間……
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi cảm thấy đã đến lúc phải tái hợp 8 anh hùng thuở sơ khai lại ... Tôi biết những sự tái sinh khác vẫn còn đó. Tôi chỉ hy vọng chúng tôi sẽ thuyết phục được những người còn lại. Chúng ta không có nhiều thời gian…

dialogsBegin.en: It has come to my attention that several of the other heroes are currently residing in a large continent known as Darkon. For Madrigal's sake, would you be able to track them down?
dialogsBegin.ar: It has come to my attention that several of the other heroes are currently residing in a large continent known as Darkon. For Madrigal's sake, would you be able to track them down?
dialogsBegin.br: Chegou ao meu conhecimento que vários dos outros heróis estão atualmente residindo em um grande continente conhecido como Darkon. Pelo bem de Madrigal, você seria capaz de localizá-los?
dialogsBegin.cns: 我注意到，其他几位英雄目前居住在一个被称为达肯的大陆上。为了瑞加大陆，你能找到他们吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Mir ist zu Ohren gekommen, dass sich mehrere der anderen Helden derzeit auf einem großen Kontinent namens Darkon aufhalten. Könntet Ihr sie um Madrigals willen aufspüren?
dialogsBegin.fi: It has come to my attention that several of the other heroes are currently residing in a large continent known as Darkon. For Madrigal's sake, would you be able to track them down?
dialogsBegin.fil: It has come to my attention that several of the other heroes are currently residing in a large continent known as Darkon. For Madrigal's sake, would you be able to track them down?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il va falloir aller les prévenir les uns après les autres et nous assurer de leur coopération.
dialogsBegin.id: Telah menjadi perhatian saya bahwa beberapa pahlawan lain saat ini tinggal di benua besar yang dikenal sebagai Darkon. Demi Madrigal, apakah kamu dapat melacaknya?
dialogsBegin.it: It has come to my attention that several of the other heroes are currently residing in a large continent known as Darkon. For Madrigal's sake, would you be able to track them down?
dialogsBegin.jp: 私の知る限り、他のヒーローの何人かは現在、ダーコンと呼ばれる大きな大陸に住んでいるようです。マドリガルのために、彼らを探してきてはもらえないでしょうか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 다콘이라는 거대한 대륙에 다른 영웅 몇몇이 머물고 있다는 소문을 들었는데요. 마드리갈을 위해, 그곳에 가서 좀 알아봐 주시겠어요?
dialogsBegin.nl: It has come to my attention that several of the other heroes are currently residing in a large continent known as Darkon. For Madrigal's sake, would you be able to track them down?
dialogsBegin.pl: It has come to my attention that several of the other heroes are currently residing in a large continent known as Darkon. For Madrigal's sake, would you be able to track them down?
dialogsBegin.ru: It has come to my attention that several of the other heroes are currently residing in a large continent known as Darkon. For Madrigal's sake, would you be able to track them down?
dialogsBegin.sp: Me he enterado de que varios de los otros héroes residen en el gran continente de Darkon. Por el bien de Madrigal, ¿serás capaz de localizarlos?
dialogsBegin.sw: It has come to my attention that several of the other heroes are currently residing in a large continent known as Darkon. For Madrigal's sake, would you be able to track them down?
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันได้ทราบว่าวีรบุรุษคนอื่น ๆ กำลังอาศัยอยู่ในทวีปใหญ่ที่รู้จักกันในชื่อ Darkon สำหรับ Madrigal คุณจะสามารถติดตามพวกเขาได้หรือไม่?
dialogsBegin.tw: 我注意到其他幾位英雄目前居住在一個名為得肯的大大陸。看在瑪德利賈的份上，你能找到他們嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi nhận ra rằng một số anh hùng khác hiện đang cư trú tại một lục địa rộng lớn được gọi là Darkon. Vì lợi ích của Madrigal, bạn có thể truy vết tìm họ không?

dialogsAccept.en: Make haste to meet the Mayor of Darkon. He sees over the main industrial town located in Darkon 2. Maybe he will have further information about the missing heroes.
dialogsAccept.ar: Make haste to meet the Mayor of Darkon. He sees over the main industrial town located in Darkon 2. Maybe he will have further information about the missing heroes.
dialogsAccept.br: Apresse-se e encontre o Prefeito de Darken. Ele administra a cidade industrial localizada em Darkon 2. Talvez ele tenha mais informações sobre os heróis restantes.
dialogsAccept.cns: 赶快去见达肯市长。他位于达肯2的主要工业城镇。也许他会有更多关于失踪英雄的信息。
dialogsAccept.de: Beeilen Sie sich, den Bürgermeister von Darkon zu treffen. Er wacht über die wichtigste Industriestadt in Darkon 2. Vielleicht hat er weitere Informationen über die vermissten Helden.
dialogsAccept.fi: Make haste to meet the Mayor of Darkon. He sees over the main industrial town located in Darkon 2. Maybe he will have further information about the missing heroes.
dialogsAccept.fil: Make haste to meet the Mayor of Darkon. He sees over the main industrial town located in Darkon 2. Maybe he will have further information about the missing heroes.
dialogsAccept.fr: Le maire de Darkon connaît bien ses citoyens. Il devrait pouvoir vous aider.
dialogsAccept.id: Segeralah bertemu Mayor of Darkon. Dia ada di atas kota industri utama yang terletak di Darkon 2. Mungkin dia akan memiliki informasi lebih lanjut tentang pahlawan yang hilang.
dialogsAccept.it: Make haste to meet the Mayor of Darkon. He sees over the main industrial town located in Darkon 2. Maybe he will have further information about the missing heroes.
dialogsAccept.jp: ダーコン市長を訪ねてください。 彼はダーコン2にある主要都市にいると思います。たぶん彼は行方不明の英雄についてのなにか情報を持っているはずです。
dialogsAccept.kr: 다콘 제 2지구에 있는 다콘 시장을 찾아가 보게나. 그곳 시장이라면 영웅에 대해 잘 알고 있겠지.
dialogsAccept.nl: Make haste to meet the Mayor of Darkon. He sees over the main industrial town located in Darkon 2. Maybe he will have further information about the missing heroes.
dialogsAccept.pl: Make haste to meet the Mayor of Darkon. He sees over the main industrial town located in Darkon 2. Maybe he will have further information about the missing heroes.
dialogsAccept.ru: Make haste to meet the Mayor of Darkon. He sees over the main industrial town located in Darkon 2. Maybe he will have further information about the missing heroes.
dialogsAccept.sp: Date prisa en reunirte con el Alcalde de Darken. Es la principal ciudad industrial ubicada en Darkon 2. Puede que allí obtengas más información sobre los héroes desaparecidos.
dialogsAccept.sw: Make haste to meet the Mayor of Darkon. He sees over the main industrial town located in Darkon 2. Maybe he will have further information about the missing heroes.
dialogsAccept.th: รีบ รีบหน่อย ไปพบกับนายกเทศมนตรีเมือง Darkon เขาผ่านเมืองอุตสาหกรรมหลักที่ตั้งอยู่ใน Darkon 2 บางทีเขาอาจจะมีข้อมูลเพิ่มเติมเกี่ยวกับฮีโร่ที่หายไป
dialogsAccept.tw: 趕快去見得肯市長。他管理著位於得肯第二區的主要工業城鎮，也許他會知道更多有關失蹤英雄的訊息。
dialogsAccept.vi: Hãy nhanh chóng đến gặp Thị trưởng của Darkon. Anh ta nhìn thấy thị trấn công nghiệp chính nằm trong Darkon 2. Có thể anh ta sẽ có thêm thông tin về những anh hùng mất tích.

dialogsDecline.en: I know it is a lot to take in, but you are going to have to trust me on this one. We don't have any time to waste.
dialogsDecline.ar: I know it is a lot to take in, but you are going to have to trust me on this one. We don't have any time to waste.
dialogsDecline.br: Eu sei que é muito para absorver, mas você vai ter que confiar em mim. Não temos tempo a perder.
dialogsDecline.cns: 我知道这很难接受，但在这件事上你必须相信我。我们没时间浪费了。
dialogsDecline.de: Ich weiß, das ist eine Menge, aber Sie müssen mir in diesem Fall vertrauen. Wir haben keine Zeit zu verlieren.
dialogsDecline.fi: I know it is a lot to take in, but you are going to have to trust me on this one. We don't have any time to waste.
dialogsDecline.fil: I know it is a lot to take in, but you are going to have to trust me on this one. We don't have any time to waste.
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous trouvez cette histoire abracadabrantesque ? C'est pourtant la vérité, j'ai des témoins pour le prouver !
dialogsDecline.id: Saya tahu bahwa memang banyak yang harus diterima, tetapi kamu harus mempercayai saya tentang yang satu ini. Kami tidak punya banyak waktu.
dialogsDecline.it: I know it is a lot to take in, but you are going to have to trust me on this one. We don't have any time to waste.
dialogsDecline.jp: 色々と分からない事も多いと思うが、これについては私を信頼して欲しい。あまり時間が無いのです。
dialogsDecline.kr: 다 이해하기엔 버거우실 테지만, 이번만큼은 저를 믿어 주세요. 지체할 시간이 없어요.
dialogsDecline.nl: I know it is a lot to take in, but you are going to have to trust me on this one. We don't have any time to waste.
dialogsDecline.pl: I know it is a lot to take in, but you are going to have to trust me on this one. We don't have any time to waste.
dialogsDecline.ru: I know it is a lot to take in, but you are going to have to trust me on this one. We don't have any time to waste.
dialogsDecline.sp: Sé que tienes mucho para asimilar, pero tendrás que confiar en mí. No tenemos tiempo que perder.
dialogsDecline.sw: I know it is a lot to take in, but you are going to have to trust me on this one. We don't have any time to waste.
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันรู้มาว่ามีจำนวนมากที่จะเข้ามาที่นี่ แต่คุณจะต้องเชื่อใจฉันในเรื่องนี้ เราไม่มีเวลาแล้ว
dialogsDecline.tw: 你不得不相信我這一點，我知道有很多東西需要吸收，我們沒有任何時間可以浪費。
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi biết là có rất nhiều thứ để tham gia, nhưng bạn sẽ phải tin tưởng vào tôi về điều này. Chúng ta không có bất kỳ thời gian nào để lãng phí.

dialogsComplete.en: Oh! Hello young adventurer. You shouldn't sneak up on a man my age, nearly gave me a heart attack. Hahaha!!
dialogsComplete.ar: Oh! Hello young adventurer. You shouldn't sneak up on a man my age, nearly gave me a heart attack. Hahaha!!
dialogsComplete.br: Oh! Olá jovem aventureiro(a). Você não deveria se aproximar de um homem da minha idade dessa maneira, quase me deu um ataque cardíaco. Hahaha!!
dialogsComplete.cns: 噢！！你好，年轻的冒险家。你不应该偷偷靠近我这个年纪的男人，这差点让我的心脏病发作。哈哈哈！！
dialogsComplete.de: Oh! Hallo, junger Abenteurer. Du solltest dich nicht an einen Mann meines Alters heranschleichen, ich hätte fast einen Herzinfarkt bekommen. Hahaha!!
dialogsComplete.fi: Oh! Hello young adventurer. You shouldn't sneak up on a man my age, nearly gave me a heart attack. Hahaha!!
dialogsComplete.fil: Oh! Hello young adventurer. You shouldn't sneak up on a man my age, nearly gave me a heart attack. Hahaha!!
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh, mais j'ai entendu parler de vous. Comment puis-je vous aider ?
dialogsComplete.id: Oh! Halo petualang muda. Kamu tidak boleh menyelinap pada pria seusia saya, hampir membuat saya terkena serangan jantung. Hahaha!!
dialogsComplete.it: Oh! Hello young adventurer. You shouldn't sneak up on a man my age, nearly gave me a heart attack. Hahaha!!
dialogsComplete.jp: おー！ こんにちは若い冒険家。 私の年齢の男性に忍び寄ってはいけません。心臓発作を起こしそうになりました。 ハハハ！！
dialogsComplete.kr: 오오! 당신이 세인트 시티와 플라리네에서 유명을 떨치던 그 모험가로군! 근데, 이곳엔 어쩐 일인가?
dialogsComplete.nl: Oh! Hello young adventurer. You shouldn't sneak up on a man my age, nearly gave me a heart attack. Hahaha!!
dialogsComplete.pl: Oh! Hello young adventurer. You shouldn't sneak up on a man my age, nearly gave me a heart attack. Hahaha!!
dialogsComplete.ru: Oh! Hello young adventurer. You shouldn't sneak up on a man my age, nearly gave me a heart attack. Hahaha!!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Oh! Hola joven aventurero. No deberías acercarte sigilosamente a un hombre de mi edad, casi me da un infarto. ¡¡Jajaja!!
dialogsComplete.sw: Oh! Hello young adventurer. You shouldn't sneak up on a man my age, nearly gave me a heart attack. Hahaha!!
dialogsComplete.th: Oh! สวัสดีหนุ่มนักผจญภัย คุณไม่ควรแอบมาแบบนี้ อายุของฉันเกือบจะทำให้ฉันหัวใจวายนะ ฮ่า ๆ ๆ ๆ!!
dialogsComplete.tw: 哦！你好年輕的冒險家。你不應該偷偷摸摸，我這大把年紀的男人，差點讓我心髒病發作。哈哈哈！！
dialogsComplete.vi: Ồ! Xin chào nhà thám hiểm trẻ. Bạn không nên lén lút với một người đàn ông bằng tuổi tôi, điều này suýt khiến tôi đau tim. Hahaha !!

dialogsFail.en: You must locate the heroes of the past, so that Madrigal might have a future. Please speak with the Mayor of Darkon. I guarantee he will know something…
dialogsFail.ar: You must locate the heroes of the past, so that Madrigal might have a future. Please speak with the Mayor of Darkon. I guarantee he will know something…
dialogsFail.br: Você deve localizar os heróis do passado, para que Madrigal possa ter um futuro. Por favor, fale com o Prefeito de Darken. Garanto que ele saberá de alguma coisa...
dialogsFail.cns: 你必须找到过去的英雄，这样瑞加大陆才可能有未来。请跟达尔肯市长谈谈。我保证他会知道一些事情…
dialogsFail.de: Sie müssen die Helden der Vergangenheit ausfindig machen, damit Madrigal eine Zukunft haben kann. Bitte sprechen Sie mit dem Bürgermeister von Darkon. Ich garantiere, dass er etwas weiß...
dialogsFail.fi: You must locate the heroes of the past, so that Madrigal might have a future. Please speak with the Mayor of Darkon. I guarantee he will know something…
dialogsFail.fil: You must locate the heroes of the past, so that Madrigal might have a future. Please speak with the Mayor of Darkon. I guarantee he will know something…
dialogsFail.fr: Vous devez m'aider à recruter les Héros du passé pour sauver Madrigal. Allez vite chercher l'aide du maire de Darkon.
dialogsFail.id: Kau harus menemukan pahlawan masa lalu, sehingga Madrigal mungkin bisa memiliki masa depan. Silakan berbicara dengan Mayor of Darkon. Saya jamin dia tahu sesuatu...
dialogsFail.it: You must locate the heroes of the past, so that Madrigal might have a future. Please speak with the Mayor of Darkon. I guarantee he will know something…
dialogsFail.jp: マドリガルに未来の為に、過去の英雄を見つけねばなりません。 まずはダーコン市長を訪ねてください。 彼は何かを知っているはずです。
dialogsFail.kr: 마드리갈의 미래를 위해서는 반드시 과거의 영웅들을 찾아야 해요. 다콘 시장을 찾아가 보세요. 분명 무언가 알고 있을 겁니다...
dialogsFail.nl: You must locate the heroes of the past, so that Madrigal might have a future. Please speak with the Mayor of Darkon. I guarantee he will know something…
dialogsFail.pl: You must locate the heroes of the past, so that Madrigal might have a future. Please speak with the Mayor of Darkon. I guarantee he will know something…
dialogsFail.ru: You must locate the heroes of the past, so that Madrigal might have a future. Please speak with the Mayor of Darkon. I guarantee he will know something…
dialogsFail.sp: Debes localizar a los héroes del pasado, para que Madrigal pueda tener un futuro. Por favor, habla con el Alcalde de Darken. Te garantizo que él sabrá algo...
dialogsFail.sw: You must locate the heroes of the past, so that Madrigal might have a future. Please speak with the Mayor of Darkon. I guarantee he will know something…
dialogsFail.th: คุณต้องค้นหาฮีโร่ของอดีตเพื่อให้ Madrigal มีอนาคตที่ดีต่อไป กรุณาพูดคุยกับนายกเทศมนตรีเมือง Darkon ฉันรับประกันได้เลยว่าเขาจะรู้อะไรบางอย่าง ...
dialogsFail.tw: 你必須找到過去的英雄，這樣瑪德利賈才有未來。請與得肯第二區市長交談。我保證他會知道些什麼……
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn phải xác định vị trí của những anh hùng trong quá khứ, để Madrigal có thể có một tương lai sáng lạn. Hãy nói chuyện với Thị trưởng của Darkon. Tôi đảm bảo anh ấy sẽ biết điều gì đó…

name.cns: 死亡的矿山与巨械毒花（上）
name.sp: Mina de la Muerte y Roaches (1)
name.tw: 死亡的礦坑與巨械毒花 (1)
name.vi: Hầm mỏ chết và những con rắn (1)

description.en: Bring the blood of Roaches by destroying their eggs and defeating Roach Larva.
description.ar: Bring the blood of Roaches by destroying their eggs and defeating Roach Larva.
description.br: Traga o sangue das Baratas, destruindo seus ovos e derrotando as larvas.
description.cns: 经过奇昆地区之后，打碎粉红毒花与蓝毒花的卵，搜集它们的血液。
description.de: Besorge das Blut der Roaches, indem du ihre Eier zerstörst und Roach Larven besiegst.
description.fi: Bring the blood of Roaches by destroying their eggs and defeating Roach Larva.
description.fil: Bring the blood of Roaches by destroying their eggs and defeating Roach Larva.
description.fr: Collecter le fluide des Jeunes Tyroglyphes Roses et Bleus en ouvrant les œufs.
description.id: Bawakan darah Roaches dengan menghancurkan telurnya dan mengalahkan Roach Larva.
description.it: Bring the blood of Roaches by destroying their eggs and defeating Roach Larva.
description.jp: キクンゾーンを過ぎ、ローチフル・ゾーンに行きローチフルエッグを割ってから、ピンクとブルーの ローチ水を持って行く。
description.kr: 로치 퀸들의 알을 파괴하고 로치 애벌레를 처치해 로치 퀸의 피를 모아오세요.
description.nl: Bring the blood of Roaches by destroying their eggs and defeating Roach Larva.
description.pl: Sprowadź krew Roachów, niszcząc ich jaja.
description.ru: Добыть кровь кукарачей: разбивай их яйца и убивай личинок.
description.sp: Trae la sangre de las Cucarachas destruyendo sus huevos y derrotando a Larva Cucaracha.
description.sw: Bring the blood of Roaches by destroying their eggs and defeating Roach Larva.
description.th: หาเลือดแมลงสาบได้จากการทำลายไข่และตัวอ่อนของพวกมัน
description.tw: 經過奇昆地區之後，打碎粉紅毒花與藍毒花的卵，蒐集『乳蟲樹液』。
description.vi: Mang dòng máu của Roaches bằng cách phá hủy trứng của chúng và đánh bại Roach Larva.

descriptionComplete.en: Looks like he still has a need of you.
descriptionComplete.ar: Looks like he still has a need of you.
descriptionComplete.br: Parece que ele ainda precisa de você.
descriptionComplete.cns: 搜集“乳虫树液”拿给他之后，他好像要拜托我其他的事情呢...
descriptionComplete.de: Es scheint, als würde er deine weitere Hilfe benötigen.
descriptionComplete.fi: Looks like he still has a need of you.
descriptionComplete.fil: Mukhang mayroon pa siyang pangangailangan sa iyo.
descriptionComplete.fr:
Retourner voir Bernard à Darkon.
Il pourrait avoir un autre service à vous demander après avoir étudié le fluide des Jeunes Tyroglyphes…
descriptionComplete.id: Sepertinya dia masih membutuhkanmu.
descriptionComplete.it: Looks like he still has a need of you.

dialogsBegin.en: Hmm… Is that the ring of Nevil around your finger?
dialogsBegin.ar: Hmm… Is that the ring of Nevil around your finger?
dialogsBegin.br: Hmm… Esse anel em seu dedo não é o anel de Nevil?
dialogsBegin.cns: 嗯...你手上带的戒指，那个不是蓝彼的戒指吗？嗯... 你把蓝彼救出来了，对吧！
dialogsBegin.de: Hmm... Ist das der Ring von Nevil da an deinem Finger?
dialogsBegin.fi: Hmm… Is that the ring of Nevil around your finger?
dialogsBegin.fil: Hmm... Yan ba ang singsing ni Nevil sa iyong daliri?
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais… c'est bien l'Anneau du Grand Chef Nevil que je vois à ton doigt ?! As-tu réussi à libérer Nevil et apaiser la rébellion des Keakoons ?!
dialogsBegin.id: Hmm…Apakah itu cincin Nevil dijarimu?
dialogsBegin.it: Hmm… Is that the ring of Nevil around your finger?
dialogsBegin.jp: ん？　君のそのリングは、もしかしてキクン族長ネビルのリングじゃないか？　ということは、君がネビルを救い出し、キクンの反乱を鎮めた英雄ってことか！
dialogsBegin.kr: 흠… 당신이 끼고 있는 건, 혹시 네빌의 반지인가요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Hmm… Is that the ring of Nevil around your finger?
dialogsBegin.pl: Hmm… Czy to pierścień Nevila na twoim palcu?
dialogsBegin.ru: Ну-ка, ну-ка… Да никак это кольцо Невила!
dialogsBegin.sp: Hmm… ¿Ese anillo, es el de Nevil?
dialogsBegin.sw: Hmm… Is that the ring of Nevil around your finger?
dialogsBegin.th: หืมมม นั่นแหวนของ Nevil เหรอ?
dialogsBegin.tw: 嗯…你手上帶的戒指，那個不是藍彼的戒指嗎？嗯…你把藍彼救出來了，對吧！
dialogsBegin.vi: Hmm… Đó có phải là chiếc nhẫn của Nevil quanh ngón tay của bạn không?

dialogsBegin.en: Your strength has been proven then. Would you prove yourself further? The Roach is somehow connected to the death of people in the mine.
dialogsBegin.ar: Your strength has been proven then. Would you prove yourself further? The Roach is somehow connected to the death of people in the mine.
dialogsBegin.br: Sua força foi comprovada. Você poderia passar por mais um teste? As Baratas estão de alguma maneira ligado à morte das pessoas na mina.
dialogsBegin.cns: 那你可以帮我一件事情吗？以前有很多人死在矿山里面，我想应该是跟巨械毒花有关系。
dialogsBegin.de: Du hast deine Stärke bewiesen. Suchst du eine weitere Herausforderung?Die Roaches haben irgendwas mit den Todesfällen in der Mine zu tun.
dialogsBegin.fi: Your strength has been proven then. Would you prove yourself further? The Roach is somehow connected to the death of people in the mine.
dialogsBegin.fil: Napatunayan mo na malakas ka. Kaya mo ba patunayan pa lalo ang sarili mo? Ang Roach ay konektado sa pagkamatay ng mga tao sa minahan.
dialogsBegin.fr: Dans ce cas, pourrais-tu me rendre un service ? Les Tyroglyphes semblent être impliqués dans la mort de différentes personnes dans la mine.
dialogsBegin.id: Kekuatanmu telah terbukti saat itu. Maukah kamu membuktikan dirimu lebih jauh? Entah bagaimana The Roach terhubung dengan kematian orang-orang di tambang.
dialogsBegin.it: Your strength has been proven then. Would you prove yourself further? The Roach is somehow connected to the death of people in the mine.
dialogsBegin.jp: なあ、俺の頼みも聞いてくれないか？　過去、人間達がこの ＜デェカネス鉱山＞ で次々と倒れていった理由は、＜ローチフル＞ という生物と関係があるらしいんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 당신의 실력은 벌써 증명됐네요. 좀 더 깊이 조사해 볼 의향은 없으신가요? 이 로치들은 광산에서 일어난 죽음과 분명히 관련이 있어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Your strength has been proven then. Would you prove yourself further? The Roach is somehow connected to the death of people in the mine.
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja siła została wtedy udowodniona. Udowodniłbyś ją dalej? Roach jest w jakiś sposób związana ze śmiercią ludzi w kopalni.
dialogsBegin.ru: Других доказательств твоей силы мне не требуется. Хочешь разгадать тайну Шахты? Есть у меня кое-какие подозрения, но нужно бы их проверить.
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu fuerza ha sido probada entonces. ¿Quieres probarte a ti mismo un poco más? Las Roaches están relacionadas de alguna manera con la muerte de las personas en la mina.
dialogsBegin.sw: Your strength has been proven then. Would you prove yourself further? The Roach is somehow connected to the death of people in the mine.
dialogsBegin.th: ความแข็งแกร่งของคุณได้รับการพิสูจน์แล้ว คุณจะพิสูจน์ตัวเองต่อไปหรือไม่? The Roach มีส่วนเกี่ยวข้องกับการตายของผู้คนในเหมือง
dialogsBegin.tw: 那你可以幫我一件事情嗎？以前有很多人死在礦坑裡面，我想應該是跟巨械毒花有關係。
dialogsBegin.vi: Sức mạnh của bạn đã được chứng minh sau đó. Bạn sẽ chứng minh mình hơn nữa? Rắn bằng cách nào đó có liên quan đến cái chết của những người trong mỏ.

dialogsBegin.en: There is a mystery to be unlocked here. Would you bring me the blood of the Roach larva?
dialogsBegin.ar: There is a mystery to be unlocked here. Would you bring me the blood of the Roach larva?
dialogsBegin.br: Existe um mistério a ser desvendado aqui. Você poderia me trazer o sangue da Barata Larva?
dialogsBegin.cns: 我为了研究巨械毒花所以需要他的血液，你可以帮我搜集吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Ich brauche die Flüssigkeit der Larven, um den Zusammenhang zwischen den Roach und dem Tod der Menschen näher zu untersuchen.
dialogsBegin.fi: There is a mystery to be unlocked here. Would you bring me the blood of the Roach larva?
dialogsBegin.fil: Mayroong kababalaghan na makikita dito. Pwede ba dalihin mo sakin ang dugo ng Roach larva?
dialogsBegin.fr: J'ai besoin du fluide des Tyroglyphes afin de découvrir la relation qu'il y a entre ces monstres et la mort de ces gens. Peux-tu m'en ramener s'il te plaît ?
dialogsBegin.id: Ada misteri yang harus dibuka di sini. Maukah kamu membawakanku darah larva Roach?
dialogsBegin.it: There is a mystery to be unlocked here. Would you bring me the blood of the Roach larva?
dialogsBegin.jp: ここには解かねばならない問題がたくさんあるんだ。ローチフルの幼虫の血を持って来てはくれないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 숨겨진 비밀을 밝혀내야만 해요. 로치 애벌레의 혈액을 가져와 주시겠어요?
dialogsBegin.nl: There is a mystery to be unlocked here. Would you bring me the blood of the Roach larva?
dialogsBegin.pl: Jest tu tajemnica do odkrycia. Czy przyniesiesz mi krew larwy Roach?
dialogsBegin.ru: Не побоишься отправиться в Шахту и принести мне крови личинок кукарачей?
dialogsBegin.sp: Hay un misterio que resolver aquí. ¿Me traerías la sangre de las larvas de Roach?
dialogsBegin.sw: There is a mystery to be unlocked here. Would you bring me the blood of the Roach larva?
dialogsBegin.th: มีเรื่องลึกลับที่จะปลดล็อกได้ที่นี่ คุณช่วยนำเลือดของตัวอ่อนแมลงสาบมาให้ฉันได้มั้ย?
dialogsBegin.tw: 我為了研究巨械毒花所以需要他的血液，你可以幫我蒐集嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Có một bí ẩn cần được mở khóa ở đây. Bạn có mang cho tôi máu của ấu trùng Rắn không?

dialogsAccept.en: Thank you. There are two kinds of Roach - Pink and Blue. Break open their eggs and hunt down the larva.
dialogsAccept.ar: Thank you. There are two kinds of Roach - Pink and Blue. Break open their eggs and hunt down the larva.
dialogsAccept.br: Obrigado. Existem dois tipos de Baratas - Rosa e Azul. Quebre seus ovos e caçe as larvas.
dialogsAccept.cns: 谢谢你喔！毒花有分２种，一种是粉红毒花、另一种是蓝毒花。只要找到他们的卵并打开，将卵里面的乳虫打败就可以得到它们的血液了。
dialogsAccept.de: Danke. Es gibt zwei Arten von Roaches - pinke und blaue. Brich die Eier auf und besiege die Larven.
dialogsAccept.fi: Thank you. There are two kinds of Roach - Pink and Blue. Break open their eggs and hunt down the larva.
dialogsAccept.fil: Thank you. There are two kinds of Roach - Pink and Blue. Break open their eggs and hunt down the larva.
dialogsAccept.fr: Je t'en remercie, c'est très généreux de ta part. Bien… en fait il y a deux genres de Tyroglyphes - des roses et des bleus. Tu peux récupérer leur fluide en ouvrant les œufs qu'ils pondent et en te débarrassant des Jeunes Tyroglyphes.
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih. Ada 2 jenis Roach - Pink dan Blue. Pecahkan telurnya dan buru larvanya.
dialogsAccept.it: Thank you. There are two kinds of Roach - Pink and Blue. Break open their eggs and hunt down the larva.
dialogsAccept.jp: ＜ローチフルエッグ＞ から孵化したての＜ローチフル虫＞を狩ってきてほしい。ブルーとピンクの２種類いるはずだ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 고마워요. 로치에는 분홍과 파랑 두 종류가 있습니다. 알을 깨고 애벌레를 사냥하세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Thank you. There are two kinds of Roach - Pink and Blue. Break open their eggs and hunt down the larva.
dialogsAccept.pl: Dziękuję Ci. Istnieją dwa rodzaje Roach - Pinky i Blue. Rozbij jajka i poluj na nie.
dialogsAccept.ru: Спасибо. Кукарачи бывают двух видов — розовые и синие. Разбей их яйца и уничтожь личинок.
dialogsAccept.sp: Gracias. Hay dos tipos de Cucarachas: Rosa y Azul. Abre sus huevos y caza la larva.
dialogsAccept.sw: Thank you. There are two kinds of Roach - Pink and Blue. Break open their eggs and hunt down the larva.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอบคุณ แมลงสาบมี 2 ประเภทคือ Pink และ Blue ตีไข่พวกมันให้แตกแล้วก็ล่าตัวอ่อนพวกมันซะให้หมด
dialogsAccept.tw: 謝謝你喔！巨械毒花有分２種，一種是粉紅毒花、另一種是藍毒花。只要得到他們的卵，在卵裡面的乳蟲就可以得到他們的血液了。
dialogsAccept.vi: Cảm ơn. Có hai loại Roach - Pink và Blue. Phá vỡ trứng của chúng và săn lùng larva.

dialogsDecline.en: There will be no revelation without danger.
dialogsDecline.ar: There will be no revelation without danger.
dialogsDecline.br: Não haverá nenhuma revelação sem perigo.
dialogsDecline.cns: 没有危险就没有启示
dialogsDecline.de: Du wirst das Geheimnis nicht lüften, wenn du der Gefahr entfliehst.
dialogsDecline.fi: There will be no revelation without danger.
dialogsDecline.fil: Walang mailalabas kung walang panganib.
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu ne pourras pas trouver le vrai trésor si tu cherches à éviter le danger.
dialogsDecline.id: Tidak ada tindakan tanpa bahaya.
dialogsDecline.it: There will be no revelation without danger.
dialogsDecline.jp: 「虎穴に入らずんば虎児を得ず」ってことわざ知ってるかい？　危険を乗り越えてこそ、本当の宝物が手に入るのさ！
dialogsDecline.kr: 위험 없이는 진실도 없는 법이죠.
dialogsDecline.nl: There will be no revelation without danger.
dialogsDecline.pl: Nie będzie objawienia bez niebezpieczeństwa.
dialogsDecline.ru: Не подвергая себя опасности, открытий не совершить.
dialogsDecline.sp: Sin peligro no hay premio.
dialogsDecline.sw: There will be no revelation without danger.
dialogsDecline.th: จะไม่มีการสำแดงใดๆ ที่ปราศจากอันตราย
dialogsDecline.tw: 一旦進入了那麼危險的地區，你應該要得到最重要的寶，這樣才有意義啦…
dialogsDecline.vi: Sẽ không có tiết lộ nào mà không có nguy hiểm.

dialogsComplete.en: Ahh, there is much to be learned from the blood of these Roaches.
dialogsComplete.ar: Ahh, there is much to be learned from the blood of these Roaches.
dialogsComplete.br: Ahh, há muito o que se aprender com o sangue dessas Baratas.
dialogsComplete.cns: 真的很谢谢你啊～现在我把关于巨械毒花的资料全部都搜集好了。
dialogsComplete.de: Ahh... wir können so viel vom Blut der Larven lernen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Ahh, there is much to be learned from the blood of these Roaches.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ahh, mayroong maraming pwede matutunan sa dugo ng mga ipis na ito.
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh, merci beaucoup ! Maintenant, j'ai collecté tous les éléments pour comprendre leurs habitudes et leur caractère.
dialogsComplete.id: Ahh, ada banyak yang bisa dipelajari dari darah Roaches ini.
dialogsComplete.it: Ahh, there is much to be learned from the blood of these Roaches.
dialogsComplete.jp:
やあ、ありがとう！　本当に感謝するよ。
これでやつらの習性と正体に関する全ての資料の収集ができたぞ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 아, 로치들의 혈액에서 알아내야 할 것이 많아요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Ahh, there is much to be learned from the blood of these Roaches.
dialogsComplete.pl: Ahh, wiele można się nauczyć z krwi tych Roachów.
dialogsComplete.ru: Проверим мою догадку…
dialogsComplete.sp: Ahh, hay mucho que aprender de la sangre de estas Roaches.
dialogsComplete.sw: Ahh, there is much to be learned from the blood of these Roaches.
dialogsComplete.th: อ่า มีหลายสิ่งให้เรียนรู้จากเลือดของแมลงสาบพวกนี้
dialogsComplete.tw: 真的很謝謝你啊～現在我把關於巨械毒花的資料全部都蒐集好了。
dialogsComplete.vi: Ahh, có rất nhiều điều phải học được từ máu của những con rắn này.

dialogsBegin.en: Could you do me a favor? I need Phanbubble. Can you help me please?
dialogsBegin.ar: Could you do me a favor? I need Phanbubble. Can you help me please?
dialogsBegin.br: Você poderia me fazer um favor? Eu preciso de Bolhas Fantasma. Você pode me ajudar por favor?
dialogsBegin.cns: 我想拜托你一件事情，我需要“皮皮珠”，可以接受我的委托吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Könntest du mir einen Gefallen tun? Ich brauche. Würdest du meiner Bitte nachkommen??
dialogsBegin.fi: Could you do me a favor? I need Phanbubble. Can you help me please?
dialogsBegin.fil: Pwede mo ba akong tulungan? Kailangan ko ng Phanbubble. Matutulungan mo ba ako?
dialogsBegin.fr: Peux-tu me faire une faveur ? J'ai besoin de Bullephans. Peux-tu m'aider s'il te plaît ?
dialogsBegin.id: Bisakah Kamu membantuku? Aku butuh Phanbubble. Kumohon tolong bantu aku?
dialogsBegin.it: Could you do me a favor? I need Phanbubble. Can you help me please?
dialogsBegin.jp: 私のお願いを聞いてください。 ファンブブルが100個必要なのです。何に使うかって？　…それを聞かずに、黙って依頼を受けていただけませんか？　もちろん報酬は払います
dialogsBegin.kr: 혹시, 부탁 하나 들어주실래요? 판버블이 필요한데, 구해주실 수 있을까요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Could you do me a favor? I need Phanbubble. Can you help me please?
dialogsBegin.pl: Could you do me a favor? I need Phanbubble. Can you help me please?
dialogsBegin.ru: А эта просьба лично от меня. Мне нужна эктоплазма. Выручишь?

description.en: Hunt down 8 regular Wheelems (not Bouncing or Rough) and retrieve 8 Soulstones from them.
description.ar: Hunt down 8 regular Wheelems (not Bouncing or Rough) and retrieve 8 Soulstones from them.
description.br: Recupere 8 Pedras de Alma dos Wheelems comuns e leve-as para a Sacerdotisa. Não incomode os Wheelems Brutos ou Wheelems Vigorosos, vá até os Wheelems.
description.cns: 打中型独轮蒸汽机取得8个灵魂之石拿给在达肯第3地区的骑士祭坛祭司，记的喔~是打中型独轮蒸汽机喔！
description.de: Beschaffe 8 Soulstone von den Wheelems und bring sie zur Priesterin. Keine Rough Wheelems oder Bouncing Wheelems, einfach nur Wheelems.
description.fi: Hunt down 8 regular Wheelems (not Bouncing or Rough) and retrieve 8 Soulstones from them.
description.fil: Hunt down 8 regular Wheelems (not Bouncing or Rough) and retrieve 8 Soulstones from them.
description.fr: Récupérer les 8 Pierres des Héros en combattant les Wheelems et les rapporter à Lobiet, à l'Autel des Chevaliers de Darkon 3.
description.id: Memburu 8 Wheelems biasa (bukan Bouncing atau Rough) dan mengambil 8 Soulstones dari mereka.
description.it: Hunt down 8 regular Wheelems (not Bouncing or Rough) and retrieve 8 Soulstones from them.
description.jp: ホイールから8個のソウルストーンを取り戻して、ダーコン第3地区のマグミアントにいるナイト司祭に持って行こう。ホイールです。ジャイアントやスモールではないです。
description.kr: 일반 휠렘 8마리를 처치하고, 소울스톤 8개를 수집하세요. 펄쩍 휠렘이나 거친 휠렘은 포함되지 않습니다.
description.nl: Hunt down 8 regular Wheelems (not Bouncing or Rough) and retrieve 8 Soulstones from them.
description.pl: Hunt down 8 regular Wheelems (not Bouncing or Rough) and retrieve 8 Soulstones from them.
description.ru: Нужно отобрать у обычных ушатронов восемь душ героев, заключенных в камнях, а затем поговорить с жрицей гладиаторов Лобейтой.
description.sp: Caza a 8 Wheelems, (ni a los Brutos ni a los Rebotadores) y consigue las 8 Piedras de Alma.
description.sw: Hunt down 8 regular Wheelems (not Bouncing or Rough) and retrieve 8 Soulstones from them.
description.th: ไล่ตาม Regular Wheelems 8 ตัว (ไม่ใช่ Big หรือ Rough) และนำ Soulstones 8 อันมาจากพวกมัน
description.tw: 打單輪機器人取得 8 個靈魂之石拿給在得肯第三區的騎士祭壇祭司，記的喔~是打單輪機器人喔！
description.vi: Săn lùng 8 Wheelems thông thường (không nảy cũng không thô) và lấy 8 Soulstones từ chúng.

dialogsBegin.en: To show my gratitude, I’ll help you further along your way towards becoming a Knight.

dialogsBegin.sw: You’ll need to visit the Altar of Knight at Magmient in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณจะต้องไปที่ Altar of Knight ที่ Magmient ในเมือง Darkon 3
dialogsBegin.tw: 去得肯第三區的美格米特，騎士祭壇就在那附近！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn sẽ cần đến thăm Altar of Knight tại Magmient trong Darkon 3.

dialogsBegin.en: Lobiet, the Knight Priest, will recognize the scroll I’ve given you…
dialogsBegin.ar: Lobiet, the Knight Priest, will recognize the scroll I’ve given you…
dialogsBegin.br: Visite então, por favor, a Sacerdotisa Lobiet e entregue o pergaminho. Ela então irá reconhecê-lo(a) como um sucessor.
dialogsBegin.cns: 继承者，去找骑士祭司，他会认出我给你的卷轴……
dialogsBegin.de: Dann besuche bitte Priesterin Lobiet und bring ihr die Schriftrolle. Sie wird dich dann als Nachfolger anerkennen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Lobiet, the Knight Priest, will recognize the scroll I’ve given you…
dialogsBegin.fil: Lobiet, the Knight Priest, will recognize the scroll I’ve given you…
dialogsBegin.fr: Remet lui le parchemin que je t'ai confié, il te reconnaîtra alors comme un digne successeur d'Aenn. Mais avant de te présenter à Lobiet.
dialogsBegin.id: Lobiet, Knight Priest, akan mengenali gulungan yang kuberikan padamu…
dialogsBegin.it: Lobiet, the Knight Priest, will recognize the scroll I’ve given you…
dialogsBegin.jp: そこで祭壇を管理している司祭ロビエトにこの巻物を渡してね。そうすれば新たな試練を受けることができるでしょう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 나이트 사제 로비에트님께 이 두루마리를 보여주세요...
dialogsBegin.nl: Lobiet, the Knight Priest, will recognize the scroll I’ve given you…
dialogsBegin.pl: Lobiet, the Knight Priest, will recognize the scroll I’ve given you…
dialogsBegin.ru: Лобейта, жрица, узнает свиток, который я дала тебе... Она поймет, что у героя-гладиатора появился достойный наследник.
dialogsBegin.sp: Lobiet, la Sacerdotisa Knight, reconocerá el pergamino que te di…
dialogsBegin.sw: Lobiet, the Knight Priest, will recognize the scroll I’ve given you…
dialogsBegin.th: Knight Priest ที่ชือ Lobiet จะจำสกรอลล์ที่ฉันมอบให้คุณได้...
dialogsBegin.tw: 把卷軸拿給管理祭壇的祭司 [拉薇特‧黎]，他看到這個就會認定你是繼承者。
dialogsBegin.vi: Lobiet, Knight Priest, sẽ nhận ra Scroll mà tôi đã đưa cho bạn…

dialogsBegin.en: Retrieve the 8 Soulstones from regular Wheelems and take them to Lobiet.
dialogsBegin.ar: Retrieve the 8 Soulstones from regular Wheelems and take them to Lobiet.
dialogsBegin.br: Recupere 8 Pedras de Alma dos Wheelems comuns e leve-as para a Sacerdotisa.
dialogsBegin.cns: 打中型独轮蒸汽机取得8个灵魂之石交给祭司，记的喔！要打中型独轮蒸汽机喔！！
dialogsBegin.de: Beschaffe 8 Soulstones von den Wheelems und bring sie zur Priesterin. Keine Rough Wheelems oder Bouncing Wheelems, einfach nur Wheelems.
dialogsBegin.fi: Retrieve the 8 Soulstones from regular Wheelems and take them to Lobiet.
dialogsBegin.fil: Retrieve the 8 Soulstones from regular Wheelems and take them to Lobiet.
dialogsBegin.fr: Récupère les 8 Pierres des Héros auprès des Wheelems et apporte-les au Doyen des Chevaliers Lobiet.
dialogsBegin.id: Ambil 8 Soulstones dari Wheelem biasa dan bawa ke Lobiet.
dialogsBegin.it: Retrieve the 8 Soulstones from regular Wheelems and take them to Lobiet.
dialogsBegin.jp: ホイールから8個のソウルストーンを取り戻して、司祭に持って行ってください。ホイールです。ジャイアントやスモールではないですよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 일반 휠렘을 처치하고 소울 스톤 8개를 모아 로비에트님께 전달하세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Retrieve the 8 Soulstones from regular Wheelems and take them to Lobiet.
dialogsBegin.pl: Retrieve the 8 Soulstones from regular Wheelems and take them to Lobiet.
dialogsBegin.ru: Нужно отобрать их у марионеток и отнеси Лобейте. По плечу ли тебе такое задание?
dialogsBegin.sp: Consigue 8 Piedras de Alma de los Wheelems y entrégaselas a Lobiet.
dialogsBegin.sw: Retrieve the 8 Soulstones from regular Wheelems and take them to Lobiet.
dialogsBegin.th: นำ Soulstones กลับมา จาก Regular Wheelems และนำพวกมันไปให้ Lobiet
dialogsBegin.tw: 打單輪機器人取得 8 個靈魂之石交給祭司，記的喔！要打單輪機器人喔！！
dialogsBegin.vi: Lấy 8 Soulstone từ Wheelems thông thường và đưa chúng đến Lobiet.

dialogsAccept.en: Good luck, Mercenary.
dialogsAccept.ar: Good luck, Mercenary.
dialogsAccept.br: Boa sorte, Mercenário(a).
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你好运，战士
dialogsAccept.de: Viel Glück, Mercenary.
dialogsAccept.fi: Good luck, Mercenary.
dialogsAccept.fil: Good luck, Mercenary.
dialogsAccept.fr: Bonne chance, Mercenaire !
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga berhasil, Mercenary.
dialogsAccept.it: Good luck, Mercenary.
dialogsAccept.jp: では、幸運をお祈りします。
dialogsAccept.kr: 그럼 행운을 빌어요, 머서너리님.
dialogsAccept.nl: Good luck, Mercenary.
dialogsAccept.pl: Good luck, Mercenary.
dialogsAccept.ru: Good luck, Mercenary.
dialogsAccept.sp: Buena suerte, Mercenary.
dialogsAccept.sw: Good luck, Mercenary.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้โชคดี Mercenary
dialogsAccept.tw: 祝你好運！勇者
dialogsAccept.vi: Chúc may mắn, Mercenary.

dialogsDecline.en: I know it’s a challenge, but I assure you, the reward is worth it.
dialogsDecline.ar: I know it’s a challenge, but I assure you, the reward is worth it.
dialogsDecline.br: Sei que não é fácil lidar com Wheelems, mas você não pode fazer o teste de sucessor até que traga as Pedras de Alma de volta. Por favor, me ajude.
dialogsDecline.cns: 一定要打单轮机器人，才可以拿灵魂之石，要不然没资格通过英雄继承者的测验喔~
dialogsDecline.de: Ich weiß, das die Wheelems nicht einfach sind, aber du kannst den Nachfolger Test nicht absolvieren, solange du mir nicht die Soulstones zurückbringst. Bitte hilf mir.
dialogsDecline.fi: I know it’s a challenge, but I assure you, the reward is worth it.
dialogsDecline.fil: I know it’s a challenge, but I assure you, the reward is worth it.
dialogsDecline.fr: Je sais que ça ne va pas être facile avec les Wheelems, mais tu n'auras pas achevé ton apprentissage tant que tu n'auras pas ramené les Pierres des Héros.
dialogsDecline.id: Saya tahu ini sebuah tantangan, tetapi saya jamin, hadiahnya sepadan.
dialogsDecline.it: I know it’s a challenge, but I assure you, the reward is worth it.
dialogsDecline.jp: ホイールを相手にするのは大変だろうけど、ソウルストーンを取り戻さないと新たな試練を受けることが出来ないそうです。どうかお願いします。
dialogsDecline.kr: 힘든 일인 건 알지만, 꽤 괜찮은 보상이 기다리고 있다고요.
dialogsDecline.nl: I know it’s a challenge, but I assure you, the reward is worth it.
dialogsDecline.pl: I know it’s a challenge, but I assure you, the reward is worth it.
dialogsDecline.ru: Понимаю, это нелегкое задание, но звание гладиатора не дается просто так.
dialogsDecline.sp: Sé que es un gran desafío, pero te aseguro que la recompensa vale la pena.
dialogsDecline.sw: I know it’s a challenge, but I assure you, the reward is worth it.
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันรู้ว่ามันท้าทาย แต่ฉันมั่นใจว่ารางวัลจะคุ้มค่ากับสิ่งที่คุณได้ทำ
dialogsDecline.tw: 一定要打單輪機器人，才可以拿靈魂之石，要不然沒資格通過英雄繼承者的測驗喔~
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi biết đó là một thách thức, nhưng tôi đảm bảo với bạn, phần thưởng cho nó cũng xứng đáng.

dialogsComplete.en: I haven’t a clue why those Wheelems took the stones, but nevertheless, thank Billaon you’ve returned them.
dialogsComplete.ar: I haven’t a clue why those Wheelems took the stones, but nevertheless, thank Billaon you’ve returned them.
dialogsComplete.br: Ah, você finalmente as trouxe de volta! Pedra de Alma... Wheelem.. Porque será que eles pegaram essas pedras? De qualquer maneira, muito obrigado!
dialogsComplete.cns: 啊~终于找回来了，独轮蒸汽机为何偷灵魂之石了呢 ？算了，东西能找回来就好！
dialogsComplete.de: Oh, du hast sie endlich gebracht! Soulstone.. Wheelem.. Warum in aller Welt haben sie diese genommen? Jedenfalls vielen Dank!
dialogsComplete.fi: I haven’t a clue why those Wheelems took the stones, but nevertheless, thank Billaon you’ve returned them.
dialogsComplete.fil: I haven’t a clue why those Wheelems took the stones, but nevertheless, thank Billaon you’ve returned them.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tu les as finalement ramenées, les Pierres des Héros ! Les Wheelem.. Mais pourquoi donc les avaient-ils volées ? Quoi qu'il en soit, je te remercie !
dialogsComplete.id: Saya tidak tahu mengapa Wheelems itu mengambil batu-batu itu, tetapi bagaimanapun, terima kasih kepada Billaon kamu telah mengembalikannya.
dialogsComplete.it: I haven’t a clue why those Wheelems took the stones, but nevertheless, thank Billaon you’ve returned them.
dialogsComplete.jp: ソウルストーンを取り戻してくれたんだね！ありがとう！しかし、ホイールは一体何のつもりでこれを盗んだんだろうなあ？でも本当によかった！
dialogsComplete.kr: 휠렘들이 왜 스톤을 가져갔는지 모르겠지만… 아무튼 정말 감사드려요.
dialogsComplete.nl: I haven’t a clue why those Wheelems took the stones, but nevertheless, thank Billaon you’ve returned them.
dialogsComplete.pl: I haven’t a clue why those Wheelems took the stones, but nevertheless, thank Billaon you’ve returned them.
dialogsComplete.ru: Хвала Максимилианусу, тебе удалось вернуть камни! Не понимаю только, зачем они понадобились ушатронам?..
dialogsComplete.sp: No tengo ni idea de por qué esos Wheelem se llevaron las piedras, pero, gracias a Billaon que las has devuelto.
dialogsComplete.sw: I haven’t a clue why those Wheelems took the stones, but nevertheless, thank Billaon you’ve returned them.
dialogsComplete.th: ฉันไม่เข้าใจว่าทำไม Wheelems เหล่านี้ถึงได้เอาก้อนหินไป แต่อย่างไรก็ตามขอขอบคุณ Billaon ที่คุณได้ส่งคืนให้เขา
dialogsComplete.tw: 啊~終於找回來了，單輪機器人為何偷靈魂之石了呢？算了，東西能找回來就好！
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi không biết tại sao những Wheelems đó lại lấy những viên đá, nhưng tuy nhiên, cảm ơn Billaon, bạn đã trả lại chúng.

dialogsComplete.en: The Souls of the Heroes can rest, thanks to you.
dialogsComplete.ar: The Souls of the Heroes can rest, thanks to you.
dialogsComplete.br: Agora as almas dos heróis estão de volta! Obrigado!
dialogsComplete.cns: 终于可以找回英雄的灵魂了！真的很谢谢你！
dialogsComplete.de: Nun sind die Seelen der Helden zurück! Danke!
dialogsComplete.fi: The Souls of the Heroes can rest, thanks to you.
dialogsComplete.fil: The Souls of the Heroes can rest, thanks to you.
dialogsComplete.fr: Maintenant les âmes des Héros sont revenues ! Merci infiniment !
dialogsComplete.id: Jiwa Pahlawan bisa beristirahat, terima kasih.
dialogsComplete.it: The Souls of the Heroes can rest, thanks to you.
dialogsComplete.jp: 英雄たちの魂を取り戻すことができたよ。本当にありがとう！
dialogsComplete.kr: 덕분에 영웅들의 영혼이 편히 잠들 수 있게 되었답니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: The Souls of the Heroes can rest, thanks to you.
dialogsComplete.pl: The Souls of the Heroes can rest, thanks to you.
dialogsComplete.ru: Теперь души героев будут покоиться с миром.
dialogsComplete.sp: Las Almas de los Héroes pueden descansar, gracias a ti.
dialogsComplete.sw: The Souls of the Heroes can rest, thanks to you.
dialogsComplete.th: วิญญาณของวีรบุรุษจะได้พักผ่อนเสียทีขอบคุณนะ
dialogsComplete.tw: 終於可以找回英雄的靈魂了！真的很謝謝你！
dialogsComplete.vi: Linh hồn của các Heroes có thể yên nghỉ, nhờ bạn

dialogsFail.en: What brings you to this holy Altar for the souls of Heroes?
dialogsFail.ar: What brings you to this holy Altar for the souls of Heroes?
dialogsFail.br: Aqui é o local de proteção das almas dos heróis. O que o trouxe aqui?
dialogsFail.cns: 是什么指引你来到这神圣的英雄祭坛
dialogsFail.de: Was führt dich zu diesem heiligen Altar für die Seelen der Helden?
dialogsFail.fi: What brings you to this holy Altar for the souls of Heroes?
dialogsFail.fil: What brings you to this holy Altar for the souls of Heroes?
dialogsFail.fr: En ce lieu nous protégeons les âmes des Héros. Mais quelle est la raison de ta venue ?
dialogsFail.id: Apa yang membawamu ke Altar suci ini untuk jiwa Pahlawan?
dialogsFail.it: What brings you to this holy Altar for the souls of Heroes?
dialogsFail.jp: ここは英雄たちの魂を守る祭壇です。何か用かい？
dialogsFail.kr: 영웅들의 영혼이 잠들어 있는 이 성스러운 제단에 무슨 일로 오셨지요?
dialogsFail.nl: What brings you to this holy Altar for the souls of Heroes?
dialogsFail.pl: What brings you to this holy Altar for the souls of Heroes?
dialogsFail.ru: What brings you to this holy Altar for the souls of Heroes?
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Qué te trae a este Altar sagrado de las Almas de los Héroes?
dialogsFail.sw: What brings you to this holy Altar for the souls of Heroes?
dialogsFail.th: อะไรนำให้คุณยังแท่นบูชาแห่งวิญญาณของเหล่าฮีโร่กันล่ะ?
dialogsFail.tw: 是什麼讓你來到這個英雄靈魂的神聖祭壇？
dialogsFail.vi: Điều gì đưa bạn đến Altar linh thiêng dành cho linh hồn của các Heroes?

description.ar: Kill 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems and report to Bowler.
description.br: Ajude Bowler! Mate 20 Wheelems Brutos e 10 Wheelems e depois reporte para ele.
description.cns: 杀死20个轻型独轮蒸汽机和10个中型独轮蒸汽机后向保罗克汇报。
description.de: Töte 20 Rough Wheelems und 10 Wheelems und melde dich bei Bowler.
description.fi: Kill 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems and report to Bowler.
description.fil: Kill 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems and report to Bowler.
description.fr: Tuez 20 Jeunes Wheelem et 10 Wheelem et rencontrez Bowler.
description.id: Bunuh 20 Rough Wheelems &10 Wheelems dan laporkan ke Bowler.
description.it: Kill 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems and report to Bowler.
description.jp: ラフ・ホイール20体と、ホイール10体を倒し、ボウラーを訪ねよ。
description.kr: 거친 휠렘 20마리와 휠렘 10마리를 처치하고 보울러에게 가보세요.
description.nl: Kill 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems and report to Bowler.
description.pl: Kill 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems and report to Bowler.
description.ru: Kill 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems and report to Bowler.
description.sp: Derrota a 20 Wheelems Brutos y a 10 Wheelems y vuelve con Bowler.
description.sw: Kill 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems and report to Bowler.
description.th: ฆ่า 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems และรายงานให้ Bower
description.tw: 殺死 20 個小單輪機器人和 10 個單輪機器人並向保羅克報告。
description.vi: Giết 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems và báo cáo cho Bowler.

dialogsBegin.en: Please you must quickly hurry to Bowler! It seems the Wheelems near him have grown increasingly aggressive and he has grown quite fearful!
dialogsBegin.ar: Please you must quickly hurry to Bowler! It seems the Wheelems near him have grown increasingly aggressive and he has grown quite fearful!
dialogsBegin.br: Por favor, você deve se apressar para ajudar o Bowler! Parece que Wheelems perto dele ficaram mais agressivos e ele está com muito medo!
dialogsBegin.cns: 你必须赶紧去保罗克那！他身边的独轮蒸汽机似乎变得越来越有攻击性，他现在非常害怕！
dialogsBegin.de: Bitte, ihr müsst schnell zu Bowler eilen! Es scheint, dass die Wheelems in seiner Nähe immer aggressiver werden und er ziemlich ängstlich geworden ist!
dialogsBegin.fi: Please you must quickly hurry to Bowler! It seems the Wheelems near him have grown increasingly aggressive and he has grown quite fearful!
dialogsBegin.fil: Please you must quickly hurry to Bowler! It seems the Wheelems near him have grown increasingly aggressive and he has grown quite fearful!
dialogsBegin.fr: Hum, la supplique est écrite dans un dialecte étrange, ça va me prendre un peu de temps à traduire.
dialogsBegin.id: Tolong kau harus segera bergegas ke Bowler! Tampaknya Wheelems di dekatnya telah tumbuh semakin agresif dan dia telah tumbuh cukup mengerikan!
dialogsBegin.it: Please you must quickly hurry to Bowler! It seems the Wheelems near him have grown increasingly aggressive and he has grown quite fearful!
dialogsBegin.jp: 私はこれからこの記録を解析しようと思います。先ほどボウラーがここに来ていたのですが、どうやら悩みがあるようでした。
dialogsBegin.kr: 제발, 어서 보울러에게 가 주세요! 근처의 휠렘들이 점점 더 흉포해지고 있어요. 분명 겁에 질려 있을 거예요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Please you must quickly hurry to Bowler! It seems the Wheelems near him have grown increasingly aggressive and he has grown quite fearful!
dialogsBegin.pl: Please you must quickly hurry to Bowler! It seems the Wheelems near him have grown increasingly aggressive and he has grown quite fearful!
dialogsBegin.ru: Please you must quickly hurry to Bowler! It seems the Wheelems near him have grown increasingly aggressive and he has grown quite fearful!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Por favor, ves rápidamente con Bowler! ¡Parece que los Wheelems que hay cerca suyo se han vuelto más agresivos y tiene bastante miedo!
dialogsBegin.sw: Please you must quickly hurry to Bowler! It seems the Wheelems near him have grown increasingly aggressive and he has grown quite fearful!
dialogsBegin.th: ได้โปรดรีบรีบไปหาโบว์ลิ่ง! ดูเหมือนว่า Wheelems ใกล้ๆ เขาเติบโตขึ้นเรื่อยๆ และเขาก็เติบโตขึ้นมากทีเดียว!
dialogsBegin.tw: 在我解讀記錄的時候，可以幫我跑一趟保羅克那裡嗎？最近單輪機器人的數量急劇的增加，他說生活上很不方便。
dialogsBegin.vi: Xin bạn nhanh chóng đến Bowler! Có vẻ như lũ Wheelems đang tiến gần anh ta ngày càng hung dữ và anh ta khá sợ hãi!

dialogsBegin.en: Will you hurry to his aid? In the meanwhile, I will attempt to decrypt these records. I know they contain something worthwhile!!
dialogsBegin.ar: Will you hurry to his aid? In the meanwhile, I will attempt to decrypt these records. I know they contain something worthwhile!!
dialogsBegin.br: Pode correr para ajudá-lo? Enquanto isso, tentarei descriptografar esses registros. Eu sei que eles contêm algo que vale a pena!!
dialogsBegin.cns: Will you hurry to his aid? In the meanwhile, I will attempt to decrypt these records. I know they contain something worthwhile!!
dialogsBegin.de: Wirst du ihm zu Hilfe eilen? In der Zwischenzeit werde ich versuchen, diese Aufzeichnungen zu entschlüsseln. Ich weiß, dass sie etwas Wertvolles enthalten!
dialogsBegin.fi: Will you hurry to his aid? In the meanwhile, I will attempt to decrypt these records. I know they contain something worthwhile!!
dialogsBegin.fil: Will you hurry to his aid? In the meanwhile, I will attempt to decrypt these records. I know they contain something worthwhile!!
dialogsBegin.fr: Bowler aurait besoin de votre assistance. Il voudrait que vous tuiez 20 Jeunes Wheelem et 10 Wheelem.
dialogsBegin.id: Maukah kamu bergegas membantunya?? Sementara itu, saya akan mencoba mendekripsi catatan-catatan ini. Saya tahu mereka mengandung sesuatu yang berharga!!
dialogsBegin.it: Will you hurry to his aid? In the meanwhile, I will attempt to decrypt these records. I know they contain something worthwhile!!
dialogsBegin.jp: 彼を急いで助けてくれませんか？ その間、私はこれらの記録の復号化を試みます。
dialogsBegin.kr: 어서 그를 도와주세요. 그동안, 저는 이 기록들을 해독해 볼게요. 뭔가 가치 있는 게 있을 거예요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Will you hurry to his aid? In the meanwhile, I will attempt to decrypt these records. I know they contain something worthwhile!!
dialogsBegin.pl: Will you hurry to his aid? In the meanwhile, I will attempt to decrypt these records. I know they contain something worthwhile!!
dialogsBegin.ru: Will you hurry to his aid? In the meanwhile, I will attempt to decrypt these records. I know they contain something worthwhile!!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Apúrate con tu ayuda? Mientras tanto, intentaré descifrar estos registros. ¡Seguro que contienen algo que vale la pena!
dialogsBegin.sw: Will you hurry to his aid? In the meanwhile, I will attempt to decrypt these records. I know they contain something worthwhile!!
dialogsBegin.th: คุณจะรีบไปช่วยเขาหน่อย? ในระหว่างนี้ ฉันจะพยายามถอดรหัสบันทึกเหล่านี้ ฉันส่ามันต้องมีประโยชน์กับเราแน่!!
dialogsBegin.tw: 你能快去幫他嗎？這段時間我會試著解讀這些紀錄。我知道裡面一定藏著有價值的情報！！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn sẽ nhanh chóng đến viện trợ cho anh ấy chứ? Trong khi đó, tôi sẽ cố gắng giải mã các bản ghi này. Tôi biết chúng chứa một cái gì đó đáng giá!

dialogsAccept.en: Your assistance is truly appreciated! Hurry and defeat 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems then report to Bowler!
dialogsAccept.ar: Your assistance is truly appreciated! Hurry and defeat 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems then report to Bowler!
dialogsAccept.br: Sua ajuda é realmente apreciada! Depressa, derrote 20 Wheelems Brutos e 10 Wheelems e depois informe ao Bowler!
dialogsAccept.cns: 非常感谢你的帮助！请尽快杀死20个轻型独轮蒸汽机和10个中型独轮蒸汽机后向保罗克报告！
dialogsAccept.de: Deine Hilfe wird sehr geschätzt! Beeilt euch und besiegt 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems und meldet euch dann bei Bowler!
dialogsAccept.fi: Your assistance is truly appreciated! Hurry and defeat 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems then report to Bowler!
dialogsAccept.fil: Your assistance is truly appreciated! Hurry and defeat 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems then report to Bowler!
dialogsAccept.fr: Ça vous occupera pendant que je traduis. Allez le voir pour lui dire que vous acceptez sa mission.
dialogsAccept.id: Bantuanmu benar-benar kuhargai! Cepat kalahkan 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems lalu lapor ke Bowler!
dialogsAccept.it: Your assistance is truly appreciated! Hurry and defeat 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems then report to Bowler!
dialogsAccept.jp: 本当にありがたいです！ 急いで20個のラフウィーレムと10個のウィーレムを倒し、ボウラーに報告してください！
dialogsAccept.kr: 보울러가 위험한 것 같으니, 거친 휠렘 20마리와 일반 휠렘 10마리를 처치하고 어서 그에게 가보세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Your assistance is truly appreciated! Hurry and defeat 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems then report to Bowler!
dialogsAccept.pl: Your assistance is truly appreciated! Hurry and defeat 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems then report to Bowler!
dialogsAccept.ru: Your assistance is truly appreciated! Hurry and defeat 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems then report to Bowler!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Agradezco tu ayuda! ¡Date prisa y derrota a 20 Wheelems Brutos y a 10 Wheelems y luego informa a Bowler!
dialogsAccept.sw: Your assistance is truly appreciated! Hurry and defeat 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems then report to Bowler!
dialogsAccept.th: ความช่วยเหลือของคุณได้รับความนิยมอย่างแท้จริง! รีบและเอาชนะ 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems จากนั้นรายงานไปยัง Bowler!
dialogsAccept.tw: 非常感謝你的幫助！快點擊敗 20 個小單輪機器人和 10 個單輪機器人，然後向保羅克報告！
dialogsAccept.vi: Sự trợ giúp của bạn thực sự được đánh giá cao! Hãy nhanh tay hạ gục 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems rồi báo cho Bowler!

dialogsDecline.en: Oh no!! You must help him! Bowler doesn't stand a chance against those vicious Wheelems!
dialogsDecline.ar: Oh no!! You must help him! Bowler doesn't stand a chance against those vicious Wheelems!
dialogsDecline.br: Oh não!! Você deve ajudá-lo! Bowler não tem chance contra aqueles Wheelems violentos!
dialogsDecline.cns: 哦，不！！你必须帮助他！保罗克根本没有能力对抗那些恶毒的独轮蒸汽机！
dialogsDecline.de: Oh nein!! Du musst ihm helfen! Bowler hat keine Chance gegen diese bösartigen Wheelems!
dialogsDecline.fi: Oh no!! You must help him! Bowler doesn't stand a chance against those vicious Wheelems!
dialogsDecline.fil: Oh no!! You must help him! Bowler doesn't stand a chance against those vicious Wheelems!
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous préférez buller ? Pas de souci pour moi.
dialogsDecline.id: Oh tidak!! Kau harus membantunya! Bowler tidak memiliki kesempatan melawan Wheelems yang kejam itu!
dialogsDecline.it: Oh no!! You must help him! Bowler doesn't stand a chance against those vicious Wheelems!
dialogsDecline.jp: あなたは彼を助けなければなりません！ ボウラーはきっと耐えられません！
dialogsDecline.kr: 이런! 보울러를 도와야 해요! 혼자서는 저 사나운 휠렘들을 상대할 수 없을 텐데!
dialogsDecline.nl: Oh no!! You must help him! Bowler doesn't stand a chance against those vicious Wheelems!
dialogsDecline.pl: Oh no!! You must help him! Bowler doesn't stand a chance against those vicious Wheelems!
dialogsDecline.ru: Oh no!! You must help him! Bowler doesn't stand a chance against those vicious Wheelems!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡¡Oh no!! ¡Debes ayudarlo! ¡Bowler no tiene ninguna posibilidad contra esos malvados Wheelems!
dialogsDecline.sw: Oh no!! You must help him! Bowler doesn't stand a chance against those vicious Wheelems!
dialogsDecline.th: ไม่นะ!! คุณต้องช่วยเขา! โบว์ลิ่งไม่ได้มีโอกาสกับ Wheelems ที่เลวร้ายเหล่านี้!
dialogsDecline.tw: 不好了！！你必須幫助他！保羅克沒有機會對抗那些惡毒的單輪機器人！
dialogsDecline.vi: Ôi không!! Bạn phải giúp anh ta! Bowler không có khả năng chống lại những Wheelems hung ác đó!

dialogsComplete.en: That was too close of a call! The Wheelems generally left me alone. For whatever reason, they suddenly grew violent and attempted to attack me while I was out near their territory.
dialogsComplete.ar: That was too close of a call! The Wheelems generally left me alone. For whatever reason, they suddenly grew violent and attempted to attack me while I was out near their territory.
dialogsComplete.br: Isso foi muito perto de um desastre! Os Wheelem geralmente me deixavam em paz. Por alguma razão, eles de repente ficaram violentos e tentaram me atacar enquanto eu estava passando perto do território deles.
dialogsComplete.cns: 你来得太及时了！独轮蒸汽机怪物们一般都会让我一个人呆着。不知出于什么原因，当我在他们的地盘附近时，他们突然变得暴力起来，并试图攻击我。
dialogsComplete.de: Das war eine zu knappe Entscheidung! Die Wheelems ließen mich im Allgemeinen in Ruhe. Aus irgendeinem Grund wurden sie plötzlich gewalttätig und versuchten, mich anzugreifen, als ich mich in der Nähe ihres Territoriums aufhielt.
dialogsComplete.fi: That was too close of a call! The Wheelems generally left me alone. For whatever reason, they suddenly grew violent and attempted to attack me while I was out near their territory.
dialogsComplete.fil: That was too close of a call! The Wheelems generally left me alone. For whatever reason, they suddenly grew violent and attempted to attack me while I was out near their territory.
dialogsComplete.fr: Je parie que vous leur avez mis la pâtée !
dialogsComplete.id: Itu tadi hampir saja! Wheelems akhirnya meninggalkan saya sendirian. Untuk alasan apa pun, mereka tiba-tiba menjadi kejam dan berusaha menyerang saya saat saya berada di dekat wilayah mereka.
dialogsComplete.it: That was too close of a call! The Wheelems generally left me alone. For whatever reason, they suddenly grew violent and attempted to attack me while I was out near their territory.
dialogsComplete.jp: 近すぎた！ ホイールいつも私を攻撃しなかったが、突然暴力的になり、私を攻撃しようとしました。
dialogsComplete.kr: 오오! 고마워! 덕분에 위기를 넘겼어. 휠렘들은 대체로 나를 내버려 뒀지. 그런데 무슨 이유에서인지 갑자기 폭력적으로 변해서, 내가 그들 영토 근처에 있을 때 공격하려 들었어.
dialogsComplete.nl: That was too close of a call! The Wheelems generally left me alone. For whatever reason, they suddenly grew violent and attempted to attack me while I was out near their territory.
dialogsComplete.pl: That was too close of a call! The Wheelems generally left me alone. For whatever reason, they suddenly grew violent and attempted to attack me while I was out near their territory.
dialogsComplete.ru: That was too close of a call! The Wheelems generally left me alone. For whatever reason, they suddenly grew violent and attempted to attack me while I was out near their territory.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Ha estado demasiado cerca! Hasta ahora los Wheelems me dejaban en paz. Pero por alguna razón, de repente se han vuelto violentos y han intentado atacarme mientras estaba cerca de su territorio.
dialogsComplete.sw: That was too close of a call! The Wheelems generally left me alone. For whatever reason, they suddenly grew violent and attempted to attack me while I was out near their territory.
dialogsComplete.th: นั่นใกล้เกินไปแล้ว! The Wheelems ส่วนใหญ่ทิ้งฉันไว้ตามลำพัง ด้วยเหตุผลใดก็ตามพวกเขาก็เริ่มมีความรุนแรงและพยายามที่จะโจมตีฉันขณะที่ฉันอยู่ใกล้ดินแดนของพวกเขา
dialogsComplete.tw: 那太接近了！單輪機器人通常讓我一個人呆著。無論出於何種原因，當我在他們的領土附近時，他們突然變得暴力並試圖攻擊我。
dialogsComplete.vi: Sém chút gặp nguy! Các Wheelems thường để tôi một mình. Vì bất cứ lý do gì, chúng đột nhiên trở nên bạo lực và cố gắng tấn công tôi khi tôi đang ở gần lãnh thổ của chúng.

dialogsBegin.en: Ahh I see Cell has given you the code to enter the dungeon!
dialogsBegin.ar: Ahh I see Cell has given you the code to enter the dungeon!
dialogsBegin.br: Hm, vejo que Cell deu a você o código para entrar na masmorra!
dialogsBegin.cns: 啊，我看到飞儿已经给了你进入地牢的卡片！我想这是一个很好的机会。
dialogsBegin.de: Ahh, ich sehe, Cell hat dir den Code zum Betreten der Mine gegeben!
dialogsBegin.fi: Ahh I see Cell has given you the code to enter the dungeon!
dialogsBegin.fil: Ahh I see Cell has given you the code to enter the dungeon!
dialogsBegin.fr: Je présume que vous pouvez entrer dans la mine de Dekanes maintenant.
dialogsBegin.id: Ahh jadi Cell telah memberi Anda kode untuk memasuki ruang bawah tanah!
dialogsBegin.it: Ahh I see Cell has given you the code to enter the dungeon!
dialogsBegin.jp: セルに会ってきたようだね。注意事項は既に聞いただろうから早速入ってみるといいよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 아, 셀에게 던전에 들어갈 수 있는 암호를 받아왔군요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Ahh I see Cell has given you the code to enter the dungeon!
dialogsBegin.pl: Ahh I see Cell has given you the code to enter the dungeon!
dialogsBegin.ru: Ahh I see Cell has given you the code to enter the dungeon!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Ahh, veo que Cell te ha dado el código para entrar a la mazmorra!
dialogsBegin.sw: Ahh I see Cell has given you the code to enter the dungeon!
dialogsBegin.th: อ่า ฉันเห็น Cell ได้ให้รหัสที่คุณเพื่อเข้าดันเจี้ยน!
dialogsBegin.tw: 你和飛兒見過面了嗎？如果你都知道注意事項，就快一點進去吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Ahh, tôi thấy Cell đã cung cấp cho bạn mật mã để vào ngục tối!

dialogsBegin.en: Just to be warned, the monsters in the dungeon are quite terrifying! If you feel you aren't prepared for the quest, please go train some more!
dialogsBegin.ar: Just to be warned, the monsters in the dungeon are quite terrifying! If you feel you aren't prepared for the quest, please go train some more!
dialogsBegin.br: Apenas para te avisar, os monstros na masmorra são bastante aterrorizantes! Se você sente que não está preparado para a missão, por favor, vá treinar um pouco mais!
dialogsBegin.cns: 需要提醒的是，地牢里的怪物是相当可怕的！如果你觉得自己没有做好准备，请再去训练一下！
dialogsBegin.de: Seid gewarnt, die Monster in der Mine sind ziemlich furchterregend! Wenn du das Gefühl hast, dass du nicht auf die Quest vorbereitet bist, trainiere bitte noch etwas mehr!
dialogsBegin.fi: Just to be warned, the monsters in the dungeon are quite terrifying! If you feel you aren't prepared for the quest, please go train some more!
dialogsBegin.fil: Just to be warned, the monsters in the dungeon are quite terrifying! If you feel you aren't prepared for the quest, please go train some more!
dialogsBegin.fr: Attention à vous, les monstres de la mine sont très puissants.
dialogsBegin.id: Hanya memperingatkan, monster di ruang bawah tanah cukup menakutkan! Jika Anda merasa tidak siap untuk quest, silakan berlatih lagi!
dialogsBegin.it: Just to be warned, the monsters in the dungeon are quite terrifying! If you feel you aren't prepared for the quest, please go train some more!
dialogsBegin.jp: このダンジョンはこれまでのモンスターよりも強力だからね。実力不足の場合は鍛練することだね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 미리 경고하자면, 이 던전의 몬스터들은 꽤 강력하답니다. 겁이 난다면 좀 더 수련한 뒤에 들어가는 게 좋을 겁니다!
dialogsBegin.nl: Just to be warned, the monsters in the dungeon are quite terrifying! If you feel you aren't prepared for the quest, please go train some more!
dialogsBegin.pl: Just to be warned, the monsters in the dungeon are quite terrifying! If you feel you aren't prepared for the quest, please go train some more!
dialogsBegin.ru: Just to be warned, the monsters in the dungeon are quite terrifying! If you feel you aren't prepared for the quest, please go train some more!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Sólo para que estés al tanto, los monstruos de la mazmorra son bastante aterradores! Si crees que no estás preparado para la misión, ¡entrena un poco más!
dialogsBegin.sw: Just to be warned, the monsters in the dungeon are quite terrifying! If you feel you aren't prepared for the quest, please go train some more!
dialogsBegin.th: จะเตือนเท่านั้น มอนสเตอร์ในดันเจี้ยนจะค่อนข้างน่ากลัว! ถ้าคุณรู้สึกว่าคุณไม่ได้เตรียมพร้อมมา โปรดไปฝึกเพิ่ม!
dialogsBegin.tw: 對了，這副本裡的怪物們比你目前所知道的怪物還要強上許多。如果你害怕，最好再去修練一下，然後再進去吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Cảnh báo bạn trước, những con quái vật trong ngục tối khá đáng sợ! Nếu bạn cảm thấy mình chưa chuẩn bị sẵn sàng cho nhiệm vụ, hãy tập luyện thêm!

dialogsBegin.en: Are you going to enter then and look for that woman?
dialogsBegin.ar: Are you going to enter then and look for that woman?
dialogsBegin.br: Você vai entrar então e procurar aquela mulher?
dialogsBegin.cns: 那你要不要进去找那个女人呢？
dialogsBegin.de: Werden Sie hineingehen und nach dieser Frau suchen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Are you going to enter then and look for that woman?
dialogsBegin.fil: Are you going to enter then and look for that woman?

dialogsBegin.id: Apakah Anda akan masuk dan mencari wanita itu?
dialogsBegin.it: Are you going to enter then and look for that woman?
dialogsBegin.jp: その女の人はたぶんまだ出てきていないよ。何してるんだろうね。

dialogsAccept.en: Well, you are the bravest fool I've ever met. Let's hope this woman is worth all the effort! Hah!
dialogsAccept.ar: Well, you are the bravest fool I've ever met. Let's hope this woman is worth all the effort! Hah!
dialogsAccept.br: Bem, você é o tolo mais corajoso que eu já conheci. Vamos torcer para que essa mulher valha todo o esforço! Haha!
dialogsAccept.cns: 好吧，你是我见过的最勇敢的傻瓜。我希望你为了这个女人付出的努力是值得的! 哈!
dialogsAccept.de: Sie sind der mutigste Narr, den ich je getroffen habe. Hoffen wir, dass diese Frau die ganze Mühe wert ist! Hah!
dialogsAccept.fi: Well, you are the bravest fool I've ever met. Let's hope this woman is worth all the effort! Hah!
dialogsAccept.fil: Well, you are the bravest fool I've ever met. Let's hope this woman is worth all the effort! Hah!
dialogsAccept.fr: Vous y allez directement ?
dialogsAccept.id: Anda adalah orang bodoh paling berani yang pernah saya temui. Mari kita berharap wanita ini sepadan dengan semua usaha yang telah kita lakukan! Hah!
dialogsAccept.it: Well, you are the bravest fool I've ever met. Let's hope this woman is worth all the effort! Hah!
dialogsAccept.jp: ダンジョンの扉の前の装置をクリックすれば中に入れるよ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 당신처럼 용감한 바보는 처음이군요. 그 여자가 이 모든 수고를 들일 만한 사람이길 빌게요! 하하!
dialogsAccept.nl: Well, you are the bravest fool I've ever met. Let's hope this woman is worth all the effort! Hah!
