dialogsAccept.ru: Well, you are the bravest fool I've ever met. Let's hope this woman is worth all the effort! Hah!
dialogsAccept.sp: Bueno, eres el tonto más valiente que he conocido. ¡Esperemos que el esfuerzo por encontrar a esa mujer valga la pena! ¡Jaja!
dialogsAccept.sw: Well, you are the bravest fool I've ever met. Let's hope this woman is worth all the effort! Hah!
dialogsAccept.th: เยี่ยม คุณเป็นคนโง่ที่สุดที่ฉันเคยพบ หวังว่าผู้หญิงคนนี้มีค่าความพยายามทั้งหมด! ฮะ!
dialogsAccept.tw: 現在就要立刻進去？真的是非常有勇氣的年輕人啊？只要在副本的門口前點選裝置，就可以進入到裡面。
dialogsAccept.vi: Chà, bạn là kẻ ngốc dũng cảm nhất mà tôi từng gặp. Hãy hy vọng người phụ nữ này xứng đáng với tất cả nỗ lực bạn bỏ ra! Hah!

dialogsDecline.en: Changed your mind? Well if you aren't busy, maybe you could go bring me some more Greemong Jelly and Syliaca Fillets! I kid I kid! Haha!
dialogsDecline.ar: Changed your mind? Well if you aren't busy, maybe you could go bring me some more Greemong Jelly and Syliaca Fillets! I kid I kid! Haha!
dialogsDecline.br: Mudou de ideia? Bem, se você não estiver ocupado, talvez você possa me trazer mais um pouco de Geleia de Greemong e Filés de Syliaca! Tô brincando, tô brincando! Haha!
dialogsDecline.cns: 你改变主意了吗？好吧，如果你不忙，也许你可以去给我带来更多的绿泥液和绿鳞片! 开玩笑啦! 哈哈!
dialogsDecline.de: Hast du deine Meinung geändert? Nun, wenn du nicht beschäftigt bist, könntest du mir vielleicht noch etwas Greemong-Gelee und Syliaca-Filets bringen! Ich scherze, ich scherze! Haha!
dialogsDecline.fi: Changed your mind? Well if you aren't busy, maybe you could go bring me some more Greemong Jelly and Syliaca Fillets! I kid I kid! Haha!
dialogsDecline.fil: Changed your mind? Well if you aren't busy, maybe you could go bring me some more Greemong Jelly and Syliaca Fillets! I kid I kid! Haha!
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous avez raison, retournez-vous entrainer un peu avant d'y aller…
dialogsDecline.id: Berubah pikiran? Jika Anda tidak sibuk, mungkin Anda bisa membawakan saya beberapa Greemong Jelly dan Syliaca Fillets lagi! Saya suka saya suka! Haha!
dialogsDecline.it: Changed your mind? Well if you aren't busy, maybe you could go bring me some more Greemong Jelly and Syliaca Fillets! I kid I kid! Haha!
dialogsDecline.jp: 暇なら、もっとグリンモンゼリーとシｰラカの肉を持って来てくれないかな。なんつって、冗談だよ！
dialogsDecline.kr: 생각이 바뀌었나요? 바쁘지 않다면 제게 그리몽 젤리랑 실리아카 스테이크나 좀 더 가져다주면 좋을 텐데요! 농담이에요, 농담! 하하!
dialogsDecline.nl: Changed your mind? Well if you aren't busy, maybe you could go bring me some more Greemong Jelly and Syliaca Fillets! I kid I kid! Haha!
dialogsDecline.pl: Changed your mind? Well if you aren't busy, maybe you could go bring me some more Greemong Jelly and Syliaca Fillets! I kid I kid! Haha!
dialogsDecline.ru: Changed your mind? Well if you aren't busy, maybe you could go bring me some more Greemong Jelly and Syliaca Fillets! I kid I kid! Haha!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Has cambiado de opinión? Bueno, si no estás ocupado, ¡podrías traerme más Gelatina de Greemong y unos Filetes de Syliaca! ¡Es broma, es broma! ¡Jaja!
dialogsDecline.sw: Changed your mind? Well if you aren't busy, maybe you could go bring me some more Greemong Jelly and Syliaca Fillets! I kid I kid! Haha!
dialogsDecline.th: เปลี่ยนความคิดไหม? ถ้าคุณไม่ยุ่งอยู่ คุณอาจจะพาฉันไปหา Greemong Jelly และ Syliaca Fillets อีก! เด็กฉัน! ฮ่าฮ่า!
dialogsDecline.tw: 改變主意了？好吧，如果你不忙，也許你可以去給我多帶些一陀史萊膿東果醬和獅頭魚肉！我小子小子！哈哈！
dialogsDecline.vi: Đổi ý rồi sao? Chà, nếu bạn không bận, có thể bạn có thể mang thêm cho tôi một ít Greemong Jelly và Syliaca Fillets! Tôi thích thích lắm! Haha!

dialogsComplete.en: Woah! Surprised me! Shouldn't sneak up on a lady like that! Hehe.
dialogsComplete.ar: Woah! Surprised me! Shouldn't sneak up on a lady like that! Hehe.
dialogsComplete.br: Woah! Me assustou! Não deveria se aproximar de uma dama assim! Hehe.
dialogsComplete.cns: 哇哦! 让我吃惊！不应该这样偷偷摸摸地接近一位女士! 嘿嘿。
dialogsComplete.de: Puh! Das hat mich überrascht! Man sollte sich nicht so an eine Dame heranschleichen! Hehe.
dialogsComplete.fi: Woah! Surprised me! Shouldn't sneak up on a lady like that! Hehe.
dialogsComplete.fil: Woah! Surprised me! Shouldn't sneak up on a lady like that! Hehe.
dialogsComplete.fr: Incroyable ! Vous êtes revenu vivant de la mine !
dialogsComplete.id: Woah! Kau mengejutkanku! Kau tak seharusnya tidak menyelinap seperti itu pada seorang wanita! Hehe.
dialogsComplete.it: Woah! Surprised me! Shouldn't sneak up on a lady like that! Hehe.
dialogsComplete.jp: あら、びっくりした。貴方こんなところで何をしているの？
dialogsComplete.kr: 어머! 깜짝 놀랐네! 숙녀에게 그렇게 몰래 다가오면 안 되죠! 후훗.
dialogsComplete.nl: Woah! Surprised me! Shouldn't sneak up on a lady like that! Hehe.
dialogsComplete.pl: Woah! Surprised me! Shouldn't sneak up on a lady like that! Hehe.
dialogsComplete.ru: Woah! Surprised me! Shouldn't sneak up on a lady like that! Hehe.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Guau! ¡Me has asustado! ¡No deberías acercarte sigilosamente a una dama de esa manera! Jeje.
dialogsComplete.sw: Woah! Surprised me! Shouldn't sneak up on a lady like that! Hehe.
dialogsComplete.th: ว้าว! แปลกใจจัง! ไม่ควรแอบขึ้นไปบนผู้หญิงอย่างนั้น! ฮิฮิ
dialogsComplete.tw: 啊？嚇我一跳。可以不要無聲無息的突然出現嗎？
dialogsComplete.vi: Chà! Bạn làm tôi ngạc nhiên đấy! Không nên tiếp cận phụ nữ một cách lén lút như vậy chứ! Hehe.

dialogsFail.ar: Well, are you going to head into the mine or are you reconsidering already?

dialogsFail.fi: Well, are you going to head into the mine or are you reconsidering already?
dialogsFail.fil: Well, are you going to head into the mine or are you reconsidering already?

name.th: ผู้สืบทอดวีรบุรุษ - จดหมาย

description.en: You need to speak with Kimel, the Ranger Wise Man at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris. First, though, you must retrieve the Letter of hynan from the creature, Rubo, East of Darken.
description.ar: You need to speak with Kimel, the Ranger Wise Man at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris. First, though, you must retrieve the Letter of hynan from the creature, Rubo, East of Darken.
description.br: Vá encontrar Kimel, o sábio Ranger, que vive na Fonte dos Mortos em Flaris. Mas antes você deve recuperar a carta de Hynan da criatura, Rubo, ao Leste de Darken.
description.cns: 你去亡者之泉找奇美吧！可是找他之前，你应该要先去达肯东部猎杀路宝。
description.de: Geh und finde den Ranger Weisen Kimel an der Quelle der verstorbenen Seelen in Flaris. Doch zuerst musst du Rubo zur Strecke bringen und den Brief von Hynan erbeuten. Rubo lebt bei den Syliaca, östlich von Darkon City.
description.fi: You need to speak with Kimel, the Ranger Wise Man at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris. First, though, you must retrieve the Letter of hynan from the creature, Rubo, East of Darken.
description.fil: You need to speak with Kimel, the Ranger Wise Man at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris. First, though, you must retrieve the Letter of hynan from the creature, Rubo, East of Darken.
description.fr: Récupérer la Lettre de Hynan auprès de Rubo à l'est de Darken, dans une grotte où vivent les Syliacas, puis la rapporter au Sage des Rangers Kimel à la Fontaine des Défunts de Flaris.
description.id: Kamu perlu berbicara dengan Kimel, Ranger Wise Man di Fountain of Dead Person di Flaris. Namun, pertama-tama, kamu harus mengambil Letter of hynan dari makhluk itu, Rubo, East of Darken.
description.it: You need to speak with Kimel, the Ranger Wise Man at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris. First, though, you must retrieve the Letter of hynan from the creature, Rubo, East of Darken.
description.jp: フラリスの＜魂の泉＞にいるレンジャー賢者＜キメル＞の元に行こう。ただ、その前にダーコン2地域洞窟＜シーラカ＞生息地に住んでいる＜ルボ＞を狩って、手紙を取り返さないといけないな。
description.kr: 플라리스 망자의 샘에 있는 레인저 현자 키멜님을 만나보세요. 하지만 그 전에 먼저, 다켄 동부에 있는 루보를 처치하고 하이난의 편지를 되찾아 주셔야 합니다.
description.nl: You need to speak with Kimel, the Ranger Wise Man at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris. First, though, you must retrieve the Letter of hynan from the creature, Rubo, East of Darken.
description.pl: You need to speak with Kimel, the Ranger Wise Man at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris. First, though, you must retrieve the Letter of hynan from the creature, Rubo, East of Darken.
description.ru: Нужно поговорить с мудрецом Киммелом у фонтана Мертвеца во Фларинции. Но сначала придется отобрать письмо Робина Теля у эктора по имени Руколоб, обитающего к востоку от Даркенбурга.
description.sp: Necesitas hablar con Kimel, el Sabio Ranger en el Manantial de Almas en Flaris. Primero, debes conseguir la Carta de Hynan derrotando a Rubo, al Este desde Darken.
description.sw: You need to speak with Kimel, the Ranger Wise Man at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris. First, though, you must retrieve the Letter of hynan from the creature, Rubo, East of Darken.
description.th: คุณต้องพูดคุยกับ Ranger Wise Man ชื่อ Kimel ที่ Fountain of Dead Person ใน Flaris ประการแรกคุณต้องเอาจดหมาย Hynan จาก Rubo ที่ East of Darken คืนมาก่อน
description.tw: 你去亡者之泉找基梅爾吧！可是找他之前，你應該要先去獅頭魚的居住地附近獵殺路寶
description.vi: Bạn cần nói chuyện với Kimel, Ranger Wise Man tại Fountain of Dead Person ở Flaris. Tuy nhiên, trước tiên, bạn phải lấy Thư hynan từ sinh vật, Rubo, phía đông Darken.

dialogsBegin.en: Here is a Letter of Recommendation. You will need to give this to Kimel, the Ranger Wise Man in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.ar: Here is a Letter of Recommendation. You will need to give this to Kimel, the Ranger Wise Man in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.br: Parabéns! Você passou no teste! Leve esta carta de recomendação e vá encontrar Kimel, sábio Ranger, na Fonte dos Mortos em Flaris.
dialogsBegin.cns: 恭喜你通过测试。拿这个“推荐书”去<亡者之泉>找游侠贤者<奇美>吧！
dialogsBegin.de: Hier hast du ein Empfehlungsschreiben. Geh damit zu Kimel, dem Ranger Weisen, bei der Quelle der verstorbenen Seelen in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.fi: Here is a Letter of Recommendation. You will need to give this to Kimel, the Ranger Wise Man in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.fil: Here is a Letter of Recommendation. You will need to give this to Kimel, the Ranger Wise Man in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.fr: Félicitations, voici une lettre de recommandation confirmant que tu es sur la voie de devenir Ranger. Il faut que tu l'apportes à Kimel, le Sage des Rangers qui se trouve à la Fontaine des Défunts de Flaris.
dialogsBegin.id: Ini Letter of Recommendation. Kamu harus memberikan ini ke Kimel, Ranger Wise Man di Flaris.
dialogsBegin.it: Here is a Letter of Recommendation. You will need to give this to Kimel, the Ranger Wise Man in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.jp: テストは終了しました。あなたの資質を認めます。どうぞこの推薦書を受け取ってください。これを持って、フラリス＜魂の泉＞にいるレンジャー賢者＜キメル＞の元へ行ってください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 자아, 추천서입니다. 플라리스에 있는 레인저 현자 키멜님께 드리세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Here is a Letter of Recommendation. You will need to give this to Kimel, the Ranger Wise Man in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.pl: Here is a Letter of Recommendation. You will need to give this to Kimel, the Ranger Wise Man in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.ru: Вот тебе рекомендательное письмо. Отправляйся с ним во Фларинцию, к мудрецу Кимелу.
dialogsBegin.sp: Toma esta Carta de Recomendación. Tendrás que entregársela a Kimel, el Sabio Ranger en Flaris.
dialogsBegin.sw: Here is a Letter of Recommendation. You will need to give this to Kimel, the Ranger Wise Man in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.th: นี่คือจดหมายแนะนำตัว คุณจะต้องมอบสิ่งนี้ให้แก่ Ranger Wise Man ชื่อ Kimel ใน Flaris
dialogsBegin.tw: 恭喜你通過測試。拿這個『推薦書』去亡者之泉找浪人賢者基梅爾吧！
dialogsBegin.vi: Đây là một lá thư giới thiệu. Bạn sẽ cần đưa cái này cho Kimel, Ranger Wise Man ở Flaris.

dialogsBegin.en: However, first you must retrieve the Letter of Hynan from Rubo, a creature found to be living with Syliacas, east of Darken. Locals caim Rubo has been seen with the letter.
dialogsBegin.ar: However, first you must retrieve the Letter of Hynan from Rubo, a creature found to be living with Syliacas, east of Darken. Locals caim Rubo has been seen with the letter.
dialogsBegin.br: Mas antes encontre Rubo, que vive em Syliaca, na caverna de Darkon 2. Rubo levou a carta de Kimel embora.
dialogsBegin.cns: 然而，首先你必须从路宝那里取回海楠的信，路宝是一种被发现于达肯东部的与食人鱼在一起的生物。 当地人声称路宝已经看了这封信。
dialogsBegin.de: Zuvor musst du jedoch  Rubo finden. Er lebt bei den Syliaca östlich von Darkon City. Du musst den Letter of Hynan von ihm erhalten. Er wird ihn dir allerdings nicht kampflos überlassen.
dialogsBegin.fi: However, first you must retrieve the Letter of Hynan from Rubo, a creature found to be living with Syliacas, east of Darken. Locals caim Rubo has been seen with the letter.
dialogsBegin.fil: However, first you must retrieve the Letter of Hynan from Rubo, a creature found to be living with Syliacas, east of Darken. Locals caim Rubo has been seen with the letter.
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais avant cela. J'aimerais que tu retrouves une relique sacrée du Héros des Rangers. Il s'agit de la Lettre de Hynan, qui a été volée il y a bien longtemps par un dénommé Rubo.
dialogsBegin.id: Namun, pertama-tama kamu harus mengambil Letter of Hynan dari Rubo, makhluk yang ditemukan tinggal bersama Syliacas, di sebelah timur Darken. Warga setempat melihat Rubo membawa surat itu.
dialogsBegin.it: However, first you must retrieve the Letter of Hynan from Rubo, a creature found to be living with Syliacas, east of Darken. Locals caim Rubo has been seen with the letter.
dialogsBegin.jp: あ、その前に。ダーコン2地域洞窟の＜シーラカ＞生息地に住んでいる＜ルボ＞の所に行ってください。＜キメル＞が＜ルボ＞に手紙を奪われたそうです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 하지만 먼저 루보라는 녀석을 처치하고 하이난의 편지를 되찾아야 해요. 루보는 실리아카들과 함께 다켄 동쪽에 서식하고 있어요. 현지인들이, 루보가 그 편지를 가지고 있는 걸 봤다고 하네요.
dialogsBegin.nl: However, first you must retrieve the Letter of Hynan from Rubo, a creature found to be living with Syliacas, east of Darken. Locals caim Rubo has been seen with the letter.
dialogsBegin.pl: However, first you must retrieve the Letter of Hynan from Rubo, a creature found to be living with Syliacas, east of Darken. Locals caim Rubo has been seen with the letter.
dialogsBegin.ru: Но сначала отбери письмо Робина Теля у Руколоба, эктора, обитающего среди зубаток к востоку от Даркенбурга. Говорят, что Руколоб похитил письмо героя-стрелка и носит его при себе.
dialogsBegin.sp: Sin embargo, primero debes recuperar la Carta de Hynan derrotando a Rubo, una criatura que vive con los Syliacas, al este de Darken. Los lugareños dicen que Rubo se ha dejado ver con la carta.
dialogsBegin.sw: However, first you must retrieve the Letter of Hynan from Rubo, a creature found to be living with Syliacas, east of Darken. Locals caim Rubo has been seen with the letter.
dialogsBegin.th: อย่างไรก็ตามก่อนอื่นคุณต้องนำจดหมาย Hynan จาก Rubo คืน ซึ่งเป็นสัตว์ที่อาศัยอยู่กับ Syliacas ทางตะวันออกของ Darken ชาวบ้านบอกว่าเห็น Rubo มีจดหมาย
dialogsBegin.tw: 在那之前你應該要先去獅頭魚的居住地找路寶，聽說他的信件被路寶偷走了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tuy nhiên, trước tiên bạn phải lấy được Lá thư of Hynan từ Rubo, một sinh vật được tìm thấy đang sống cùng Syliacas, phía đông của Darken. Locals caim Rubo đã được nhìn thấy cùng với lá thư.

dialogsBegin.en: Once you've slain Rubo, bring the Letter of Recommendation and the Letter of Hynan to Sage Kimel at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.ar: Once you've slain Rubo, bring the Letter of Recommendation and the Letter of Hynan to Sage Kimel at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.br: Obtenha a carta e leve-a até ele.
dialogsBegin.cns: 去猎杀路宝之后帮他把信件找回来吧！并把海楠的信交给位于帕里亡者之泉的贤者奇美。
dialogsBegin.de: Sobald du Rubo bezwungen hast, bringst du das Emfpehlungsschreiben und den Brief zu Kimel an der Quelle der verstorbenen Seelen in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.fi: Once you've slain Rubo, bring the Letter of Recommendation and the Letter of Hynan to Sage Kimel at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.fil: Once you've slain Rubo, bring the Letter of Recommendation and the Letter of Hynan to Sage Kimel at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.fr: J'ai entendu dire qu'il habitait dans une grotte de Darkon où l'on trouve des Syliacas. Retrouve la lettre perdue, et rapporte la à Kimel s'il te plaît.
dialogsBegin.id: Setelah kamu membunuh Rubo, bawa Letter of Recommendation dan Letter of Hynan ke Sage Kimel di Fountain of Dead Person di Flaris.
dialogsBegin.it: Once you've slain Rubo, bring the Letter of Recommendation and the Letter of Hynan to Sage Kimel at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.jp: ＜ルボ＞を狩り、手紙を手に入れ「魂の泉」のいる＜賢者キメル＞の元へ持っていってください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 루보를 처치하고 나면 추천서와 하이난의 편지를 플라리스의 망자의 샘에 있는 현자 키멜님께 가져가세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Once you've slain Rubo, bring the Letter of Recommendation and the Letter of Hynan to Sage Kimel at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.pl: Once you've slain Rubo, bring the Letter of Recommendation and the Letter of Hynan to Sage Kimel at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.ru: Затем отнеси оба письма мудрецу Киммелу. Он будет ждать у фонтана Мертвеца во Фларинции. Договорились?
dialogsBegin.sp: Una vez que hayas derrotado a Rubo, entrega la Carta de Recomendación y la Carta de Hynan al Sabio Kimel en el Manantial de Almas en Flaris.
dialogsBegin.sw: Once you've slain Rubo, bring the Letter of Recommendation and the Letter of Hynan to Sage Kimel at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.th: เมื่อคุณฆ่า Rubo แล้วนำจดหมายแนะนำและหนังสือ Hynan ไปให้ Sage Kimel ที่ Fountain of Dead Person ใน Flaris
dialogsBegin.tw: 擊敗路寶後，把推薦信與希南之信帶給布拉里斯亡者之泉的賢者奇梅爾。
dialogsBegin.vi: Khi bạn đã giết được Rubo, hãy mang Thư giới thiệu và Thư của Hynan cho Hiền nhân Sage Kimel tại Fountain of Dead Person ở Flaris.

dialogsDecline.en: I guess I was wrong about you. You're not ready to walk the path of the successor of the Ranger hero. See me again when you think you're ready.
dialogsDecline.ar: I guess I was wrong about you. You're not ready to walk the path of the successor of the Ranger hero. See me again when you think you're ready.
dialogsDecline.br: Você não tem confiança? Não há nada que você possa fazer se não tiver confiança. Espero que você faça a escolha sábia.
dialogsDecline.cns: 没信心吗？只要有信心没有不可能的任务啦！我相信你一定可以的！
dialogsDecline.de: Hast du denn kein Selbstvertrauen? Nichts ist unmöglich, solange du nur Selbstvertrauen besitzt. Ich hoffe, du wirst eine weise Entscheidung treffen.
dialogsDecline.fi: I guess I was wrong about you. You're not ready to walk the path of the successor of the Ranger hero. See me again when you think you're ready.
dialogsDecline.fil: I guess I was wrong about you. You're not ready to walk the path of the successor of the Ranger hero. See me again when you think you're ready.
dialogsDecline.fr: Ne sous-estime jamais tes capacités ! Tu dois être fort, ou tu ne deviendras jamais un Héros.
dialogsDecline.id: Kurasa aku salah tentangmu. Kamu belum siap untuk melewati perjalanan penerus Ranger hero. Temui aku lagi ketika kamu sudah siap.
dialogsDecline.it: I guess I was wrong about you. You're not ready to walk the path of the successor of the Ranger hero. See me again when you think you're ready.
dialogsDecline.jp: 自信がないのですか？　時には困難に立ち向かう事も必要ですよ。勇気ある判断をしていただきたいですね。
dialogsDecline.kr: 제가 잘못 봤네요. 당신은 레인저 영웅의 계승자가 될 준비가 안 된 것 같군요. 준비되었을 때 다시 찾아오세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: I guess I was wrong about you. You're not ready to walk the path of the successor of the Ranger hero. See me again when you think you're ready.
dialogsDecline.pl: I guess I was wrong about you. You're not ready to walk the path of the successor of the Ranger hero. See me again when you think you're ready.
dialogsDecline.ru: Видно, рано тебе на Путь стрелка. Возвращайся, когда наберешься сил и смелости.
dialogsDecline.sp: Supongo que me equivoqué contigo. No estás listo para recorrer el camino del sucesor del Héroe Ranger. Vuelve a verme cuando creas que estás listo.
dialogsDecline.sw: I guess I was wrong about you. You're not ready to walk the path of the successor of the Ranger hero. See me again when you think you're ready.
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันเดาว่าฉันมองคุณผิด คุณยังไม่พร้อมที่จะเดินไปตามเส้นทางผู้สืบทอดของ Ranger Hero มาพบฉันอีกครั้งเมื่อคุณคิดว่าคุณพร้อม
dialogsDecline.tw: 沒信心嗎？只要有信心沒有不可能的任務啦！我相信你一定可以的！
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi đoán tôi đã sai về bạn. Bạn chưa sẵn sàng để bước đi trên con đường của người kế vị anh hùng Ranger. Hãy gặp lại tôi khi bạn nghĩ rằng bạn đã sẵn sàng.

dialogsComplete.en: Is that… the Letter of Hynan? My goodness, this is wonderful! Thank you so much, Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.ar: Is that… the Letter of Hynan? My goodness, this is wonderful! Thank you so much, Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.br: Isso é... a Carta de Hynan? Meu Deus, isso é maravilhoso! Muito obrigado, Acrobata!
dialogsComplete.cns: 那就是…[海楠]的信吗？我的天，太好了！谢谢你，弓箭手！
dialogsComplete.de: Ist das... der Brief von Hynan? Meine Güte, das ist ja wunderbar! Vielen Dank, Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.fi: Is that… the Letter of Hynan? My goodness, this is wonderful! Thank you so much, Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.fil: Is that… the Letter of Hynan? My goodness, this is wonderful! Thank you so much, Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh ! C'est... c'est la Lettre de Hynan ! Comment l'as-tu retrouvée ?! Le Héros des Rangers avait écrit cette lettre pour ses parents décédés avant de partir pour la Grande Guerre...
dialogsComplete.id: Apakah itu… Letter of Hynan? Ya ampun, ini luar biasa! Terima kasih banyak, Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.it: Is that… the Letter of Hynan? My goodness, this is wonderful! Thank you so much, Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.jp: いやあ、よかったよかった。実はこの手紙、レンジャー英雄である＜ハイナン＞様の手紙なんだ。＜ハイナン＞様が戦争に旅立つ際に、天にいる両親宛に書いた感動的な手紙だ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 혹시 그게… 하이난의 편지인가요? 세상에, 다행이에요! 정말 감사합니다!
dialogsComplete.nl: Is that… the Letter of Hynan? My goodness, this is wonderful! Thank you so much, Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.pl: Is that… the Letter of Hynan? My goodness, this is wonderful! Thank you so much, Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.ru: Is that… the Letter of Hynan? My goodness, this is wonderful! Thank you so much, Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.sp: Esa es… ¿la Carta de Hynan? ¡Dios mío, esto es maravilloso! ¡Muchas gracias, Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.sw: Is that… the Letter of Hynan? My goodness, this is wonderful! Thank you so much, Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.th: นั่นคือ... จดหมายของ Hynan เหรอ? โอ้พระเจ้า นั่นมันยอดมาก! ขอบคุณมากครับ Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.tw: 對啊！就是這個東西。哈哈，其實這是浪人的英雄海楠在過是之前，寫給父母的一封信。
dialogsComplete.vi: Đó có phải là… Thư của Hynan? Chúa ơi, điều này thật tuyệt vời! Cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều, Acrobat!

dialogsComplete.en: Hynan lost this letter during the war. There were rumors that a creature named Rubo was in possession of it. Thank you for retrieving it for me.
dialogsComplete.ar: Hynan lost this letter during the war. There were rumors that a creature named Rubo was in possession of it. Thank you for retrieving it for me.
dialogsComplete.br: Mas Hynan perdeu esta carta durante a guerra. E ouvi dizer que Rubo estava com a carta alguns dias atrás.
dialogsComplete.cns: 海楠在战争中把这封信遗失，那之后听说被路宝偷走了!谢谢你为我找了回来。
dialogsComplete.de: Während des Krieges verlor Hynan diesen Brief. Aber vor ein paar Tagen kam mir zu Ohren, dass Rubo diesen Brief besitzen soll.
dialogsComplete.fi: Hynan lost this letter during the war. There were rumors that a creature named Rubo was in possession of it. Thank you for retrieving it for me.
dialogsComplete.fil: Hynan lost this letter during the war. There were rumors that a creature named Rubo was in possession of it. Thank you for retrieving it for me.
dialogsComplete.fr: Mais cette lettre a été perdue depuis, et j'avais entendu dire que Rubo l'avait retrouvée il y a quelques jours.
dialogsComplete.id: Hynan kehilangan surat ini selama perang. Ada rumor bahwa makhluk bernama Rubo memilikinya. Terima kasih telah mengambilkannya untukku.
dialogsComplete.it: Hynan lost this letter during the war. There were rumors that a creature named Rubo was in possession of it. Thank you for retrieving it for me.
dialogsComplete.jp: しかし、その戦いのさなかで＜ハイナン＞様はこの手紙を失くしたと伝えられていたが、この前＜ルボ＞というやつがこの手紙を隠し持っている、ということを風の噂で聞いたのだ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 하이난이 전쟁 중에 이 편지를 잃었는데, 루보가 가지고 있다는 소문이 들리더라고요. 되찾아주셔서 감사합니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Hynan lost this letter during the war. There were rumors that a creature named Rubo was in possession of it. Thank you for retrieving it for me.
dialogsComplete.pl: Hynan lost this letter during the war. There were rumors that a creature named Rubo was in possession of it. Thank you for retrieving it for me.
dialogsComplete.ru: Робин Тель потерял это письмо во время войны. Прошел слух, будто его украл эктор по имени Руколоб. И вот оно вернулось к людям!
dialogsComplete.sp: Hynan perdió esta carta durante la guerra. Había rumores de que ese tal Rubo estaba en posesión de ella. Gracias por devolvérmela.
dialogsComplete.sw: Hynan lost this letter during the war. There were rumors that a creature named Rubo was in possession of it. Thank you for retrieving it for me.
dialogsComplete.th: Hynan ทำจดหมายฉบับนี้หายไปในระหว่างสงคราม มีข่าวลือว่าสัตว์ตัวหนึ่งชื่อ Rubo ครอบครองจดหมายอยู่ ขอบคุณที่นำจดหมายมาคืนให้ฉัน
dialogsComplete.tw: 海楠在戰爭中把這封信遺失，那之後聽說被路寶偷走了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Hynan đã đánh mất bức thư này trong cuộc chiến. Có tin đồn rằng một sinh vật tên Rubo đang sở hữu nó. Cảm ơn bạn đã lấy nó cho tôi.

dialogsComplete.en: My sincerest gratitude.
dialogsComplete.ar: My sincerest gratitude.
dialogsComplete.br: Minha mais sincera gratidão.
dialogsComplete.cns: 真的很感谢你～
dialogsComplete.de: Meinen aufrichtigen Dank.
dialogsComplete.fi: My sincerest gratitude.
dialogsComplete.fil: My sincerest gratitude.
dialogsComplete.fr: Quoi qu'il en soit, j'apprécie vraiment les efforts que tu as fournis pour la retrouver. Merci, merci infiniment !
dialogsComplete.id: Terima kasih banyak.
dialogsComplete.it: My sincerest gratitude.
dialogsComplete.jp: とにかくありがとう。ありがとう！！
dialogsComplete.kr: 정말 감사해요.
dialogsComplete.nl: My sincerest gratitude.
dialogsComplete.pl: My sincerest gratitude.
dialogsComplete.ru: Прими мою глубочайшую благодарность.
dialogsComplete.sp: Mis agradecimientos más sinceros.
dialogsComplete.sw: My sincerest gratitude.
dialogsComplete.th: ฉันขอขอบคุณอย่างสุดซึ้ง
dialogsComplete.tw: 真的很感謝你～
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi thật lòng biết ơn.

dialogsFail.en: I'm waiting for someone to bring me a letter. There are rumors that a creature named Rubo who lives with the Syliacas east of Darken was last seen with it.
dialogsFail.ar: I'm waiting for someone to bring me a letter. There are rumors that a creature named Rubo who lives with the Syliacas east of Darken was last seen with it.
dialogsFail.br: Estou aguardando alguém me trazer uma carta. Há rumores de que uma criatura chamada Rubo que vive com os Syliacas a leste de Darken foi vista pela última vez com ela.
dialogsFail.cns: 我在等有人给我带来一封信。有传言说，名为路宝的生物正在和达肯东部的食人鱼一起生活。
dialogsFail.de: Ich warte auf jemanden, der mir einen Brief bringt. Es gibt Gerüchte, dass eine Kreatur namens Rubo, die bei den Syliacas östlich von Darkon City lebt, zuletzt mit ihm gesehen wurde.
dialogsFail.fi: I'm waiting for someone to bring me a letter. There are rumors that a creature named Rubo who lives with the Syliacas east of Darken was last seen with it.
dialogsFail.fil: I'm waiting for someone to bring me a letter. There are rumors that a creature named Rubo who lives with the Syliacas east of Darken was last seen with it.
dialogsFail.fr: Les âmes de nombreuses personnes vont et viennent ici à la Fontaine des Défunts. C'est ici la limite entre la vie et la mort.
dialogsFail.id: Aku sedang menunggu seseorang untuk membawakanku surat. Ada rumor bahwa makhluk bernama Rubo yang tinggal bersama Syliacas di sebelah timur Darken terakhir kali terlihat bersamanya.
dialogsFail.it: I'm waiting for someone to bring me a letter. There are rumors that a creature named Rubo who lives with the Syliacas east of Darken was last seen with it.
dialogsFail.jp: ＜エリフ＞に会ったのだよな？　どうして手ぶらなのだ？　彼女から何か聞いておらんのか？　そんなはずはないだろう・・・
dialogsFail.kr: 편지를 가지고 올 사람을 기다리고 있어요. 다켄 동부에서 실리아카들과 함께 사는 루보라는 생물이 있는데, 마지막으로 그 편지를 들고 있었다고 하더라고요.
dialogsFail.nl: I'm waiting for someone to bring me a letter. There are rumors that a creature named Rubo who lives with the Syliacas east of Darken was last seen with it.
dialogsFail.pl: I'm waiting for someone to bring me a letter. There are rumors that a creature named Rubo who lives with the Syliacas east of Darken was last seen with it.
dialogsFail.ru: I'm waiting for someone to bring me a letter. There are rumors that a creature named Rubo who lives with the Syliacas east of Darken was last seen with it.
dialogsFail.sp: Estoy esperando a que alguien me traiga una carta. Hay rumores de que una criatura llamada Rubo que vive con las Syliacas al este de Darken fue vista por última vez con dicha carta.
dialogsFail.sw: I'm waiting for someone to bring me a letter. There are rumors that a creature named Rubo who lives with the Syliacas east of Darken was last seen with it.
dialogsFail.th: ฉันกำลังรอให้ใครสักคนนำจดหมายมาให้ฉัน มีข่าวลือว่ามีสัตว์ที่ชื่อ Robu ที่อาศัยอยู่กับ Syliacas ทางตะวันออกของ Darken มีมันอยู่
dialogsFail.tw: 你有見到艾梨布嗎？那怎麼什麼都沒帶來呢？嗯…他應該會叫你拿東西給我的啊～仔細的想一下啦！
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi đang đợi ai đó mang thư cho tôi. Có tin đồn rằng một sinh vật tên Rubo sống cùng Syliacas phía đông Darken đã được nhìn thấy lần cuối cùng với lá thư.

description.fil: Bring your pet's experience to 99.99% and the Pet Tamer will upgrade it for you!

dialogsBegin.en: Excellent job raising your pet so far, my friend. You two certainly look happy together!
dialogsBegin.ar: Excellent job raising your pet so far, my friend. You two certainly look happy together!
dialogsBegin.br: É bom vê-lo novamente! Nossa! Seu Pet parece bem forte agora. Vocês certamente parecem felizes juntos!
dialogsBegin.cns: 我的朋友，到目前为止，做得很好。你们两个在一起肯定很幸福！
dialogsBegin.de: Sehr gute Arbeit! Ihr beide seht zusammen sehr glücklich aus.
dialogsBegin.fi: Excellent job raising your pet so far, my friend. You two certainly look happy together!
dialogsBegin.fil: Excellent job raising your pet so far, my friend. You two certainly look happy together!
dialogsBegin.fr: Je suis content de te revoir ! Wow, ton familier a l'air fort maintenant ! Encore un peu d'entraînement et tu vas y arriver !
dialogsBegin.id: Pekerjaan yang baik berhasil membesarkan pet kamu sejauh ini kawan. Kalian berdua terlihat bahagia saat bersama!
dialogsBegin.it: Excellent job raising your pet so far, my friend. You two certainly look happy together!
dialogsBegin.jp: とても力強く見えるようになりましたね。でも私の目にはまだペットの本当の能力を引き出したとは思えませんね。これからもペットのレベルアップのため頑張りましょう！
dialogsBegin.kr: 펫을 훌륭하게 잘 키우고 계시네요. 둘이 정말 행복해 보여요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Excellent job raising your pet so far, my friend. You two certainly look happy together!
dialogsBegin.pl: Excellent job raising your pet so far, my friend. You two certainly look happy together!
dialogsBegin.ru: Excellent job raising your pet so far, my friend. You two certainly look happy together!
dialogsBegin.sp: Excelente trabajo criando a tu mascota, amigo. ¡Se les ve realmente felices juntos!
dialogsBegin.sw: Excellent job raising your pet so far, my friend. You two certainly look happy together!
dialogsBegin.th: เยี่ยมมาก เลี้ยงสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณจนถึงตอนนี้ เพื่อนของฉัน คุณสองคนดูมีความสุขด้วยกันอย่างแน่นอน!
dialogsBegin.tw: 我的朋友，到目前為止，你的寵物做得很好。你們兩個在一起肯定很幸福！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn đã nuôi thú cưng của mình rất tốt đến thời điểm hiện tại, bạn tôi. Hai bạn chắc chắn trông rất vui khi ở cùng nhau!

dialogsBegin.en: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.ar: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.br: Você e seu Pet passaram por várias aventuras juntos. Tenho certeza que você já percebeu que quanto maior o nível concedido para um determinado grau, maior o benefício para seus atributos.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我相信您现在已经注意到，特定等级授予的级别越高，对您的属性的好处就越高。
dialogsBegin.de: Du hast sicher bereits gemerkt, dass der Bonus für eine bestimmte Klasse umso höher ist, wenn sie einen hohen Level hat.
dialogsBegin.fi: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.fil: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.fr: Ton familier et toi avez vécu bien des choses ensemble. C'est bon de vous revoir tous les deux à nouveau.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku yakin kamu telah menyadari bahwa semakin tinggi level yang diberikan tier tertentu, semakin tinggi manfaaatnya pada stats kamu.
dialogsBegin.it: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.jp: ペットの経験値を100％にしたら、レベルアップと共に見た目も変わります。今度こそ大人のペットになりますね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 특정 등급에 부여된 레벨이 높을수록 스탯에 들어가는 혜택도 더 크다는 걸 알아차리셨겠죠?
dialogsBegin.nl: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.pl: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.ru: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.sp: Estoy seguro de que ya habrá notado que cuanto mayor sea el nivel otorgado para un nivel en particular, mayor será el beneficio para sus estadísticas.
dialogsBegin.sw: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันแน่ใจว่าคุณสังเกตเห็นแล้วว่ายิ่งเลเวลที่ได้รับสำหรับระดับใดระดับหนึ่งสูงเท
dialogsBegin.tw: 你現在應該已經發現，同一階級獲得的等級越高，能力值加成就越多。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi chắc rằng bạn đã nhận thấy cấp độ được cấp cho một cấp cụ thể càng cao, thì lợi ích đối với chỉ số Stats của bạn càng cao.

dialogsAccept.en: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.ar: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.br: Para ficar forte, é preciso suar a camisa. A essa altura, tenho certeza que você já conhece o treinamento. Aumente a Experiência do seu Pet até 99,99% e traga-o de volta para mim. Avaliarei o nível dele quando você tiver terminado.
dialogsAccept.cns: 一分耕耘一分收获。我敢肯定你现在已经知道这个了。把你宠物的经验提升到 99.99% 再来找我。你完成后我会升级它。
dialogsAccept.de: Ohne Fleiß kein Preis! Ich muss dir das weitere Vorgehen mittlerweile sicher nicht mehr erklären. Steigere die Erfahrung deines Pets auf 99,99% und bringe es zu mir zurück.
dialogsAccept.fi: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.fil: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.fr: Tu connais la musique, amène l'expérience de ton familier à 99,99% et reviens me voir pour que je le fasse évoluer.
dialogsAccept.id: Tanpa usaha tak akan ada hasil. Aku yakin kamu sudah cukup paham sekarang. Naikkan EXP pet menjadi 99,99% lalu. Aku akan mengupgradenya..
dialogsAccept.it: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.jp: ペット経験値を100％にしてから私のところに来てください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 고통 없이는 얻는 것도 없죠. 이제 어떻게 해야 하는지 잘 아시겠죠? 펫의 경험치를 99.99%까지 올려 제게 데려오세요. 경험치가 충분하면 업그레이드해 드릴게요.
dialogsAccept.nl: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.pl: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.ru: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.sp: Sin dolor no hay ganancia. Estoy seguro de que ya conoces el proceso. Lleva la experiencia de tu mascota al 99,99% y devuélvemelo. Lo actualizaré encantado.
dialogsAccept.sw: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.th: ไม่มีความเจ็บปวดก็เหมือนไมไ่ด้อะไร ฉันแน่ใจว่าคุณรู้การฝึกซ้อมแล้ว นำEXPสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณไปให้ถึง 99.99% แล้วนำกลับมาให้ฉัน ฉันจะอัปเกรดเมื่อคุณทำเสร็จแล้ว
dialogsAccept.tw: 一分耕耘一分收穫。我敢肯定你現在已經知道這個練習了。把你寵物的經驗提升到 99.99% 還給我。你完成後我會升級它。
dialogsAccept.vi: Không gì dễ dàng cả. Tôi chắc rằng bây giờ bạn đã biết về cuộc diễn tập. Đem điểm experience thú cưng của bạn đến 99,99% và mang nó về lại cho tôi. Tôi sẽ nâng cấp nó khi bạn hoàn thành.

dialogsDecline.en: Don't give up now, you're doing such a great job!
dialogsDecline.ar: Don't give up now, you're doing such a great job!
dialogsDecline.br: Não desista agora, você está fazendo um ótimo trabalho!
dialogsDecline.cns: 不要现在放弃，你做得很好！
dialogsDecline.de: Gib jetzt nicht auf. Du machst deine Sache wirklich gut!
dialogsDecline.fi: Don't give up now, you're doing such a great job!
dialogsDecline.fil: Don't give up now, you're doing such a great job!
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu abandonnes déjà ?
dialogsDecline.id: Jangan menyerah sekarang, Kamu melakukan pekerjaan yang hebat!
dialogsDecline.it: Don't give up now, you're doing such a great job!
dialogsDecline.jp: ペットをもっと成長させたくないのですか？
dialogsDecline.kr: 포기하지 마세요! 아주 잘하고 있어요!
dialogsDecline.nl: Don't give up now, you're doing such a great job!
dialogsDecline.pl: Don't give up now, you're doing such a great job!
dialogsDecline.ru: Don't give up now, you're doing such a great job!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡No te rindas todavía, estás haciendo un gran trabajo!
dialogsDecline.sw: Don't give up now, you're doing such a great job!
dialogsDecline.th: อย่ายอมแพ้ตอนนี้ คุณทำได้ดีมาก!
dialogsDecline.tw: 現在不要放棄，你做得很好！
dialogsDecline.vi: Đừng bỏ cuộc bây giờ, bạn đang rất tuyệt!

dialogsComplete.en: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to A tier now!
dialogsComplete.ar: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to A tier now!
dialogsComplete.br: Vocês dois estão se tornando mais fortes juntos, e parece que vocês se tornaram bons amigos no processo. Excelente! Vou promover seu pet para o grau A agora!
dialogsComplete.cns: 你们两个一起变得越来越强大，看起来你们在这个过程中成为了很好的朋友。很好！我现在就把你的宠物升级到A级！
dialogsComplete.de: Gemeinsam werdet ihr beide immer stärker. Es sieht so aus, als wärt ihr auch ziemlich gute Freunde geworden. Exzellent! Ich werde dein Pet nun zur A Klasse aufwerten!
dialogsComplete.fi: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to A tier now!
dialogsComplete.fil: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to A tier now!
dialogsComplete.fr: Toi et ton familier devenez de plus en plus forts ensemble, et on dirait que vous êtes devenus très proche. Excellent ! Je vais faire évoluer ton familier à la classe A maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Kalian berdua menjadi lebih kuat bersama, dan sepertinya kalian telah menjadi teman yang baik. Bagus sekali! Aku akan mengupgrade pet yang kamu miliki ke tingkat A sekarang!
dialogsComplete.it: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to A tier now!
dialogsComplete.jp: 2人でどんどん強くなっていく過程で、かなり仲良しになったようです。優秀な！今すぐあなたのペットをA等級にアップグレードします！
dialogsComplete.kr: 둘은 함께 성장하며 강해지고 있고, 그 과정에서 꽤 좋은 친구가 된 것 같네요. 훌륭해요! 이제 펫을 A급으로 업그레이드해 드릴게요!
dialogsComplete.nl: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to A tier now!
dialogsComplete.pl: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to A tier now!
dialogsComplete.ru: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to A tier now!
dialogsComplete.sp: Los dos se están fortaleciendo juntos y parece que se han hecho buenos amigos en el proceso. ¡Excelente! ¡Actualizaré tu mascota al Nivel A!
dialogsComplete.sw: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to A tier now!
dialogsComplete.th: คุณสองคนแข็งแกร่งขึ้นด้วยกัน และดูเหมือนว่าพวกคุณจะกลายเป็นเพื่อนที่ดีต่อกันในกระบวนการนี้ ยอดเยี่ยม! ฉันจะอัปเกรดสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณเป็นระดับ A ทันที!
dialogsComplete.tw: 你們兩個一起變得越來越強大，看起來你們在這個過程中成為了很好的朋友。太強了！我現在就把你的寵物升級到 A 級！
dialogsComplete.vi: Hai bạn đang cùng mạnh hơn, và các bạn đã trở thành bạn tốt trong quá trình này. Xuất sắc! Tôi sẽ nâng cấp thú cưng của bạn lên cấp A ngay bây giờ!

dialogsFail.en: Not quite there… your pet needs more experience. I'm sure you already knew that.
dialogsFail.ar: Not quite there… your pet needs more experience. I'm sure you already knew that.
dialogsFail.br: Ainda não... seu Pet precisa de mais experiência. Estou certo de que você sabia disso.
dialogsFail.cns: 还不够……你的宠物需要更多的经验。我相信你已经知道了。
dialogsFail.de: Du bist noch nicht ganz fertig... Dein Pet benötigt mehr Erfahrung. Aber das wusstest du sicher bereits.
dialogsFail.fi: Not quite there… your pet needs more experience. I'm sure you already knew that.
dialogsFail.fil: Not quite there… your pet needs more experience. I'm sure you already knew that.
dialogsFail.fr: Ton familier a encore besoin d'expérience. Je pensais que tu saurais ce genre de choses maintenant !
dialogsFail.id: Masih belum cukup... Pet kamu membutuhkan lebih banyak EXP. Aku yakin Kamu sudah mengetahuinya.
dialogsFail.it: Not quite there… your pet needs more experience. I'm sure you already knew that.
dialogsFail.jp: まだです。もう少し成長させてください。
dialogsFail.kr: 아직 부족하네요… 펫이 더 많은 경험치를 쌓아야 해요. 이미 알고 계셨겠지만요.
dialogsFail.nl: Not quite there… your pet needs more experience. I'm sure you already knew that.
dialogsFail.pl: Not quite there… your pet needs more experience. I'm sure you already knew that.
dialogsFail.ru: Not quite there… your pet needs more experience. I'm sure you already knew that.
dialogsFail.sp: Todavía no… tu mascota necesita más experiencia. Seguro de que ya lo sabías.
dialogsFail.sw: Not quite there… your pet needs more experience. I'm sure you already knew that.
dialogsFail.th: ไม่ค่อยมี… สัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณต้องการ EXP มากกว่านี้ ฉันแน่ใจว่าคุณรู้อยู่แล้วว่า
dialogsFail.tw: 別離開那裡……你的寵物需要更多的經驗。我相信你已經知道了。
dialogsFail.vi: Khôngphải thế… thú cưng của bạn cần thêm experience. Tôi chắc rằng bạn đã biết điều đó.

name.th: อาวุธของ Magician

description.en: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts near Flarine, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Slain from Lawolf then speak with Magician Master Hee in Northern Flarine.
description.ar: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts near Flarine, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Slain from Lawolf then speak with Magician Master Hee in Northern Flarine.
description.br: Reúna 10 Pedras Cintilantes de Aibatts próximos de Flarine, 5 Chupims de Pukepukes e 1 Canino de Lawolf e fale com a Mestra Maga Hee no Norte de Flarine.
description.cns: 材料是10个独眼蝠的发光石10个，5个邪精灵的坚果和1个山地野狼的狼趾甲。收集到这个材料后，去找魔导士大师海恩。
description.de: Sammle 10 Twinkle Stones von Aibatts in der Nähe von Flaris, 5 Chupims von Pukepukes und 1 Slain von Lawolf und spreche dann mit Magician Master Hee im nördlichen Flaris.
description.fi: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts near Flarine, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Slain from Lawolf then speak with Magician Master Hee in Northern Flarine.
description.fil: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts near Flarine, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Slain from Lawolf then speak with Magician Master Hee in Northern Flarine.
description.fr: Collecter 10 Pierres Brillantes sur des Aibatts, 5 Chupims sur des Pukepukes et 1 Griffe sur un Lawolf puis les rapporter au Maître des Magiciens Hee à Flarine Nord.
description.id: Kumpulkan 10 Twinkle Stones dari Aibatts dekat Flarine, 5 Chupim dari Pukepukes dan 1 Slain dari Lawolf lalu bicara dengan Magician Master Hee di Northern Flarine.
description.it: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts near Flarine, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Slain from Lawolf then speak with Magician Master Hee in Northern Flarine.
description.jp: フラリス近くのアイバットからトゥインクル ストーンを 10 個、プケプケスからチュピムを 5 個、ラウルフからスレインを 1 個集め、フラリス北部にいるマジシャン マスター ヒーと話します。
description.kr: 플라리네 근처의 아이바트에게서 반짝이는 돌 10개, 푸케푸케에게서 츄핌 5개, 로울프에게서 슬레인 1개를 모은 후, 북부 플라리네에 있는 매지션 마스터 희와 대화하세요.
description.nl: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts near Flarine, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Slain from Lawolf then speak with Magician Master Hee in Northern Flarine.
description.pl: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts near Flarine, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Slain from Lawolf then speak with Magician Master Hee in Northern Flarine.
description.ru: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts near Flarine, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Slain from Lawolf then speak with Magician Master Hee in Northern Flarine.
description.sp: Consigue 10 Piedras Centelleantes de los Aibatts cerca de Flarine, 5 Chupims de los Pukepukes y 1 Slain de los Lawolfs. Después habla con la Maestra Maga Hee en el Norte de Flarine.
description.sw: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts near Flarine, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Slain from Lawolf then speak with Magician Master Hee in Northern Flarine.
description.th: รวบรวม Twinkle Stone 10 อันจาก Aibatts ใกล้ Flarine, Chupims 5 อัน จาก Pukepukes และ Slain 1 อัน จาก Lawolf จากนั้นพูดคุยกับ Magician Master Hee ใน ทางเหนือของ Flarine
description.tw: 從布拉里斯附近的獨眼蝙蝠收集 10 個閃耀石，從噗卡噗卡收集 5 個生果實，從布魯狼收集 1 個賤狼指甲，然後與布拉里斯北方的魔法使大師喜雷交談。
description.vi: Thu thập 10 Twinkle Stone từ Aibatts gần Flarine, 5 Chupims từ Pukepukes và 1 Slain từ Lawolf sau đó nói chuyện với Magician Master Hee ở Northern Flarine.

dialogsBegin.en: Nice work taking care of those Captain Aibatts for us. Now, on to your next task!
dialogsBegin.ar: Nice work taking care of those Captain Aibatts for us. Now, on to your next task!
dialogsBegin.br: Você passou no 1° teste. Mesmo assim, ainda há muitas coisas para fazer.
dialogsBegin.cns: 为我们照顾那些大独眼蝠的工作做得很好。现在，继续你的下一个任务！
dialogsBegin.de: Ich gratuliere dir zum Bestehen der ersten Prüfung! Aber die Ausbildung hat gerade erst begonnen. Versuche die Sache ernster zu nehmen!
dialogsBegin.fi: Nice work taking care of those Captain Aibatts for us. Now, on to your next task!
dialogsBegin.fil: Nice work taking care of those Captain Aibatts for us. Now, on to your next task!
dialogsBegin.fr: Bien joué, le premier test est un succès. Maintenant passons à la prochaine étape de ton entraînement.
dialogsBegin.id: Kerja bagus dalam mengurus Captain Aibatts itu untuk kita. Sekarang, lanjutkan ke tugasmu berikutnya!
dialogsBegin.it: Nice work taking care of those Captain Aibatts for us. Now, on to your next task!
dialogsBegin.jp: おめでとう、初めてのテストは合格です。でもまだまだ先は長いですよ。覚悟はよろしいですか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 두목 아이바트들을 처치해줘서 고마워요. 이제 다음 임무로 넘어가 볼까요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Nice work taking care of those Captain Aibatts for us. Now, on to your next task!
dialogsBegin.pl: Nice work taking care of those Captain Aibatts for us. Now, on to your next task!
dialogsBegin.ru: Ну вот, больше сглазы не будут досаждать фларинтийцам. А я за это расскажу тебе, какие материалы нужны для оружия фокусника.
dialogsBegin.sp: Buen trabajo con los Aibatts Capitanes. Ahora, ¡a por tu siguiente tarea!
dialogsBegin.sw: Nice work taking care of those Captain Aibatts for us. Now, on to your next task!
dialogsBegin.th: ทำได้ดีมากในการกำจัด Captain Aibatts เหล่านั้นให้เรา ไปทำภารกิจต่อไปกันเถอะ!
dialogsBegin.tw: 為我們解決獨眼蝙蝠船長，做得很好。現在，開始你的下一個任務！
dialogsBegin.vi: Rất tốt khi chăm sóc Captain Aibatts cho chúng tôi. Bây giờ, hãy chuyển sang nhiệm vụ tiếp theo của bạn!

dialogsBegin.en: I need you to collect some materials for me and deliver them to Hee, the Magician Master. She will instruct you on the use of Magician weaponry.
dialogsBegin.ar: I need you to collect some materials for me and deliver them to Hee, the Magician Master. She will instruct you on the use of Magician weaponry.
dialogsBegin.br: O 2° teste é a respeito de armas. Você deve obter 3 tipos de material, assim como as informações a respeito das armas que um Mago deve usar.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我需要你为我收集所有材料然后把它们带给魔法大师海恩。她会向你介绍魔法武器的用途。
dialogsBegin.de: Thema der zweiten Prüfung ist die Waffe. Ziel dieser Ausbildung ist der Einblick in die Waffe des Magicians. Du musst einen wichtigen Gegenstand finden.
dialogsBegin.fi: I need you to collect some materials for me and deliver them to Hee, the Magician Master. She will instruct you on the use of Magician weaponry.
dialogsBegin.fil: I need you to collect some materials for me and deliver them to Hee, the Magician Master. She will instruct you on the use of Magician weaponry.
dialogsBegin.fr: Bon, le deuxième test consiste à trouver les matériaux nécessaires pour fabriquer les armes du Magicien et par la même occasion en apprendre plus sur celles-ci..
dialogsBegin.id: Aku ingin kamu mengumpulkan beberapa bahan untukku dan mengirimkannya kepada Hee, Magician Maste. Dia akan menginstruksikanmu tentang penggunaan persenjataan Magician.
dialogsBegin.it: I need you to collect some materials for me and deliver them to Hee, the Magician Master. She will instruct you on the use of Magician weaponry.
dialogsBegin.jp: 2番目のテストは、武器に関するテストです。マジシャンの使う武器について理解を深めるのがこのテストの目的です。さて、これからマジシャンの武器を製作するための材料を3種類集めなくてはなりません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 필요한 재료를 모아서 매지션 마스터 희님께 전해주세요. 그러면 희님이 매지션 무기에 대해 알려주실 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I need you to collect some materials for me and deliver them to Hee, the Magician Master. She will instruct you on the use of Magician weaponry.
dialogsBegin.pl: I need you to collect some materials for me and deliver them to Hee, the Magician Master. She will instruct you on the use of Magician weaponry.
dialogsBegin.ru: Нам понадобятся десять мерцающих камней. Добыть их можно... у сглазов, только обычных, а не сильных. Теперь мы знаем, что это тебе по силам!
dialogsBegin.sp: Necesito que consigas algunos materiales y se los entregues a Hee, la Maestra Magician. Ella te instruirá en el uso de las armas de Magician.
dialogsBegin.sw: I need you to collect some materials for me and deliver them to Hee, the Magician Master. She will instruct you on the use of Magician weaponry.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันต้องการให้คุณรวบรวมวัสดุบางอย่างให้ฉันและส่งให้กับ Hee ปรมาจารย์ Magician เธอจะแนะนำคุณเกี่ยวกับการใช้อาวุธของ Magician
dialogsBegin.tw: 我需要你替我收集一些材料，再交給魔法使首領何依。她會教你如何使用魔法使武器。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi cần bạn thu thập một số nguyên liệu cho tôi và giao chúng cho Hee, Magician Master. Cô ấy sẽ hướng dẫn bạn cách sử dụng vũ khí của Magician.

dialogsBegin.en: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts near Flarine, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Slain from Lawolf then you may speak with Hee.
dialogsBegin.ar: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts near Flarine, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Slain from Lawolf then you may speak with Hee.
dialogsBegin.br: Adquira 10 Pedras Cintilantes de Aibatts próximos de Flarine, 5 Chupims de Pukepukes e 1 Canino de Lawolf, e então você pode falar com a Hee.
dialogsBegin.cns: 从帕里镇附近的独眼蝠那收集10个发光石，从邪精灵那收集5个坚果，从山地野狼收集1个狼趾甲，收集到这个材料后，去找魔导士大师海恩。
dialogsBegin.de: Es gibt einen wichtigen Gegenstand, den du brauchst: 10 Twinkle Stone. Bringe diese zum Magician Meister!
dialogsBegin.fi: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts near Flarine, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Slain from Lawolf then you may speak with Hee.
dialogsBegin.fil: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts near Flarine, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Slain from Lawolf then you may speak with Hee.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il y a des matériaux en particulier dont tu as besoin : 10 Pierres Brillantes que portent les Aibatts, 5 Chupims de Pukepukes et 1 Griffe de Lawolf.
dialogsBegin.id: Kumpulkan 10 Twinkle Stones dari Aibatts dekat Flarine, 5 Chupim dari Pukepukes dan 1 Slain dari Lawolf lalu kamu bisa berbicara dengan Hee.
dialogsBegin.it: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts near Flarine, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Slain from Lawolf then you may speak with Hee.
dialogsBegin.jp: マジシャンの武器を製作する材料は以下の3種類です。アイバットを倒して輝く石を10個、プケプケを倒してチュピム5個、ラーウルフを倒して勾玉の1個集めてください。そろったら、マジシャンマスターのところへ向かうのです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 플라리네 근처의 아이바트에게서 반짝이는 돌 10개, 푸케푸케에게서 츄핌 5개, 로울프에게서 슬레인 1개를 모은 뒤, 마스터 희님과 대화하세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts near Flarine, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Slain from Lawolf then you may speak with Hee.
dialogsBegin.pl: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts near Flarine, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Slain from Lawolf then you may speak with Hee.
dialogsBegin.ru: Отправляйся во Фларинцию, раздобудь камни и поговори с магистром Хией.
dialogsBegin.sp: Consigue 10 Piedras Centelleantes de los Aibatts cerca de Flarine, 5 Chupims de los Pukepukes y 1 Slain de los Lawolfs. Luego ve a hablar con Hee.
dialogsBegin.sw: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts near Flarine, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Slain from Lawolf then you may speak with Hee.
dialogsBegin.th: รวบรวม Twinkle Stone 10 อันจาก Aibatts ใกล้กับ Flarine, 5 Chupims จาก Pukepukes และ 1 Slain จาก Lawolf จากนั้นไปพูดคุยกับ Hee
dialogsBegin.tw: 從布拉里斯附近的獨眼蝙蝠收集 10 個閃耀石、從噗卡噗卡收集 5 個生果實，並從布魯狼取得 1 個賤狼指甲，之後就可以和喜雷交談。
dialogsBegin.vi: Thu thập 10 Twinkle Stone từ Aibatts gần Flarine, 5 Chupims từ Pukepukes và 1 Slain từ Lawolf, sau đó bạn nói chuyện với Hee.

dialogsBegin.en: The Magician Master is located just north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.ar: The Magician Master is located just north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.br: A Mestra Maga está está localizada ao norte de Flarine.
dialogsBegin.cns: 魔导士的转职教官，应该在帕里北广场，一定要拿这个材料喔!
dialogsBegin.de: Der Magician Master befindet sich direkt nördlich von Flaris.
dialogsBegin.fi: The Magician Master is located just north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.fil: The Magician Master is located just north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.fr: Ensuite présente-toi à Hee, le Maître des Magiciens que tu trouveras au nord de Flarine.
dialogsBegin.id: Magician Master terletak tepat di utara Flarine.
dialogsBegin.it: The Magician Master is located just north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.jp: マジシャン マスターは、フラリスのすぐ北にあります。
dialogsBegin.kr: 매지션 마스터는 플라리네 북쪽에 있습니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: The Magician Master is located just north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.pl: The Magician Master is located just north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.ru: The Magician Master is located just north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.sp: La Maestra Maga se encuentra al Norte de Flarine.
dialogsBegin.sw: The Magician Master is located just north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.th: ปรมาจารย์ Magician อยู่ทางเหนือของ Flarine
dialogsBegin.tw: 魔法使大師位於布拉里斯以北。
dialogsBegin.vi: Magician Master nằm ngay phía bắc của Flarine.

dialogsAccept.en: Good luck to you, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.ar: Good luck to you, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.br: Boa sorte, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你好运，初心者！
dialogsAccept.de: Viel Glück für Sie, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.fi: Good luck to you, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.fil: Good luck to you, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.fr: Bonne chance !
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga berhasil, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.it: Good luck to you, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.jp: マジシャンへの道のりはまだまだ遠いですが…頑張ってくださいね。
dialogsAccept.kr: 행운을 빌어요, 방랑자님!
dialogsAccept.nl: Good luck to you, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.pl: Good luck to you, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.ru: Good luck to you, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Buena suerte, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.sw: Good luck to you, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้โชคดี Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.tw: 祝你好運，見習生！
dialogsAccept.vi: Chúc bạn may mắn, Vagrant!

dialogsDecline.en: I see you're not quite ready to continue down the path to becoming a Magician. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ar: I see you're not quite ready to continue down the path to becoming a Magician. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.br: Bem, cabe a você desistir ou não. Espero que você não se arrependa depois.
dialogsDecline.cns: 如果在这里放弃的话不绝得很可惜吗?不要后悔自己所选择的路~
dialogsDecline.de: Obwohl es schade wäre, wenn du jetzt aufgeben würdest, würde ich dich nicht davon abhalten. Hoffentlich bereust du deinen Entschluss nicht.
dialogsDecline.fi: I see you're not quite ready to continue down the path to becoming a Magician. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fil: I see you're not quite ready to continue down the path to becoming a Magician. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fr: Bon, cela te regarde si tu veux abandonner. J'espère juste que tu ne vas pas le regretter par la suite.
dialogsDecline.id: Aku melihatmu belum siap untuk melanjutkan perjalanan untuk menjadi seorang Magician. Bicaralah denganku lagi jika kamu berubah pikiran.
dialogsDecline.it: I see you're not quite ready to continue down the path to becoming a Magician. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.jp: ここまでやってきたのに、諦めてしまうとはもったいないですね。しかし、あなたの選んだ道であれば仕方のないことでしょう。
dialogsDecline.kr: 아직 매지션의 길을 걷기엔 준비가 덜 된 것 같네요. 생각이 바뀌면 다시 찾아오세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: I see you're not quite ready to continue down the path to becoming a Magician. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.pl: I see you're not quite ready to continue down the path to becoming a Magician. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ru: Пропало желание становиться фокусником? Ну что ж, если вернется - возвращайся и ты.
dialogsDecline.sp: Veo que no estás listo para seguir el camino de convertirte en Magician. Habla conmigo si cambias de opinión.
dialogsDecline.sw: I see you're not quite ready to continue down the path to becoming a Magician. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันเห็นว่าคุณยังไม่พร้อมที่จะก้าวไปสู่การเป็น Magician กลับมาคุยกับฉันอีกครั้งถ้าคุณเปลี่ยนใจ
dialogsDecline.tw: 如果在這裡放棄的話不絕得很可惜嗎？不要後悔自己所選擇的路~
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi thấy bạn chưa sẵn sàng để tiếp tục con đường trở thành một Magician. Nói chuyện lại với tôi nếu bạn thay đổi ý định.

dialogsComplete.en: Thank you for delivering the Twinkle Stones, Vagrant. Wingyei has told me a lot about you. Now, let me tell you a little something about Magician weaponry.
dialogsComplete.ar: Thank you for delivering the Twinkle Stones, Vagrant. Wingyei has told me a lot about you. Now, let me tell you a little something about Magician weaponry.
dialogsComplete.br: Obrigada por entregar as Pedras Cintilantes, jovem Vagrant. Wingyei me falou muito sobre você. Agora, deixe-me contar a respeito dos 2 tipos de arma que os Magos usam: o Cetro e o Cajado.
dialogsComplete.cns: 初心者，谢谢你带来的发光石。艾文已经向我详细的介绍了你。现在让我来告诉你一些关于魔导士武器的事情吧。
dialogsComplete.de: Danke für deinen Besuch. Du hast dich sehr angestrengt, hierher zu kommen. Höre mir aufmerksam zu. Ich werde von den 2 Arten von Waffen berichten, die Magician benutzen - den Wand und den Staff.
dialogsComplete.fi: Thank you for delivering the Twinkle Stones, Vagrant. Wingyei has told me a lot about you. Now, let me tell you a little something about Magician weaponry.
dialogsComplete.fil: Thank you for delivering the Twinkle Stones, Vagrant. Wingyei has told me a lot about you. Now, let me tell you a little something about Magician weaponry.
dialogsComplete.fr: Merci d'être venu me voir, tu as passé le test avec succès. Maintenant je vais t'en apprendre davantage sur les 2 types d'armes utilisées par le Magicien, la Baguette et le Bâton.
dialogsComplete.id: Terima kasih telah mengantarkan Twinkle Stones, Vagrant. Wingyei telah bercerita banyak tentangmu. Sekarang, izinkan aku memberi tahu kamu sedikit tentang persenjataan Magician.
dialogsComplete.it: Thank you for delivering the Twinkle Stones, Vagrant. Wingyei has told me a lot about you. Now, let me tell you a little something about Magician weaponry.
dialogsComplete.jp: 秘められた魔力を自在に操るマジシャンを目指す者よ、よくやり遂げました。では、これからマジシャンが使う2種類の武器であるワンドとスタッフについて、お教えしましょう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 반짝이는 돌을 가져와 주셔서 감사해요, 방랑자님. 윙예이가 당신 이야기를 많이 했답니다. 이제, 매지션들이 쓰 무기에 대해 간단히 설명해 드릴게요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Thank you for delivering the Twinkle Stones, Vagrant. Wingyei has told me a lot about you. Now, let me tell you a little something about Magician weaponry.
dialogsComplete.pl: Thank you for delivering the Twinkle Stones, Vagrant. Wingyei has told me a lot about you. Now, let me tell you a little something about Magician weaponry.
dialogsComplete.ru: Я слышала о тебе от Брисеиды, бродяга. Спасибо за мерцающие камни. Что ж, давай я расскажу тебе об оружии фокусника.
dialogsComplete.sp: Gracias por entregar las Piedras Centelleantes, Vagrant. Wingyei me ha contado mucho sobre ti. Ahora, deja que te cuente algo sobre las armas de Magician.
dialogsComplete.sw: Thank you for delivering the Twinkle Stones, Vagrant. Wingyei has told me a lot about you. Now, let me tell you a little something about Magician weaponry.
dialogsComplete.th: ขอบคุณที่ส่ง Twinkle Stones ให้นะ Vagrant Wingyei บอกฉันมากมายเกี่ยวกับคุณ ฉันจะบอกคุณเล็กน้อยเกี่ยวกับอาวุธของ Magician
dialogsComplete.tw: 你好！辛苦了~我現在開始要說明魔法師的武器，魔法師使用的武器有魔杖與法杖，仔細聽好喔~
dialogsComplete.vi: Cảm ơn bạn đã giao Twinkle Stones, Vagrant. Wingyei đã kể cho tôi nghe rất nhiều về bạn. Bây giờ, hãy để tôi kể cho bạn nghe một chút về vũ khí của Magician

dialogsComplete.en: Magicians can use both wands and staves. A wand allows the magician to attack from a distance with a charged up attack that deals additional damage while a staff can be used as a melee weapon.
dialogsComplete.ar: Magicians can use both wands and staves. A wand allows the magician to attack from a distance with a charged up attack that deals additional damage while a staff can be used as a melee weapon.
dialogsComplete.br: O Cetro é uma arma mágica. Ele permite que você ataque de longe. Formidável, não é? Você pode realizar ataques corpo-a-corpo com um cajado...
dialogsComplete.cns: 法杖主要使用魔法攻击，连基本攻击都要使用魔法~帅吧?权杖可以进行近距离攻击
dialogsComplete.de: Mit Wands kann man elementare Angriffe ausüben. Der Staff ist bei elementaren Angriffen schwach.
dialogsComplete.fi: Magicians can use both wands and staves. A wand allows the magician to attack from a distance with a charged up attack that deals additional damage while a staff can be used as a melee weapon.
dialogsComplete.fil: Magicians can use both wands and staves. A wand allows the magician to attack from a distance with a charged up attack that deals additional damage while a staff can be used as a melee weapon.
dialogsComplete.fr: La Baguette est une arme magique qui permet d'attaquer à distance, alors que le Bâton est utilisé pour se défendre en combat rapproché mais de faible puissance.
dialogsComplete.id: Magician dapat menggunakan tongkat sihir dan tongkat. Tongkat sihir memungkinkan magician untuk menyerang dari jarak jauh dengan serangan yang dibebankan yang memberikan damage tambahan sementara tongkat dapat digunakan sebagai senjata jarak dekat.
dialogsComplete.it: Magicians can use both wands and staves. A wand allows the magician to attack from a distance with a charged up attack that deals additional damage while a staff can be used as a melee weapon.
dialogsComplete.jp: ワンドは魔法専門の武器なので、ワンドを装備した場合、基本攻撃はすべて魔法攻撃となります。一方、スタッフは基本攻撃が打撃ですので、弱いながらも接近戦が可能です。
dialogsComplete.kr: 매지션은 완드와 스태프, 두 가지 무기를 사용할 수 있어요. 완드는 에너지를 모아 원거리에서 강력한 공격을 할 수 있고, 스태프는 근접 무기로도 사용할 수 있답니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Magicians can use both wands and staves. A wand allows the magician to attack from a distance with a charged up attack that deals additional damage while a staff can be used as a melee weapon.
dialogsComplete.pl: Magicians can use both wands and staves. A wand allows the magician to attack from a distance with a charged up attack that deals additional damage while a staff can be used as a melee weapon.
dialogsComplete.ru: Конечно, по большей части мы полагаемся в бою на наши фокусы - некоторые называют их магией. Но и об оружии забывать ни в коем случае нельзя.
dialogsComplete.sp: Los Magicians pueden usar tanto varitas como bastones. Una varita le permite al Magician atacar a distancia con un ataque cargado que inflige daño adicional, mientras que un bastón se puede usar como arma cuerpo a cuerpo.
dialogsComplete.sw: Magicians can use both wands and staves. A wand allows the magician to attack from a distance with a charged up attack that deals additional damage while a staff can be used as a melee weapon.
dialogsComplete.th: Magicians ใช้ได้ทั้งไม้คฑาและไม้พลอง คฑาช่วยให้ Magicians สามารถโจมตีจากระยะไกลด้วยการโจมตีแบบชาร์จที่สร้างความเสียหายเพิ่มเติมในขณะที่ไม้พลองสามารถใช้เป็นอาวุธระยะประชิดได้
dialogsComplete.tw: 法杖主要使用魔法攻擊，連基本攻擊都要使用魔法~帥吧？法杖可以進行近距離攻擊
dialogsComplete.vi: Magicians có thể sử dụng cả đũa phép và gậy. Đũa phép cho phép Magician tấn công từ xa với một đòn tấn công dồn lên gây thêm sát thương trong khi gậy có thể được sử dụng như một vũ khí cận chiến.

dialogsComplete.en: You will find that Magicians primarily rely on magic spells to deal damage. However, it is important to know how these weapons work.
dialogsComplete.ar: You will find that Magicians primarily rely on magic spells to deal damage. However, it is important to know how these weapons work.
dialogsComplete.br: ...mas a força do ataque é muito baixa. Aprender a equilibrar estas duas armas é a chave para ser um(a) ótimo(a) Mago(a).
dialogsComplete.cns: 但是，打击力比较弱，如果有效的使用这2种武器的话，一定可以成为一个很棒的魔导士喔~嘻嘻嘻。
dialogsComplete.de: Aber die Angriffskraft ist nicht sehr stark. Wenn du die beiden Waffenarten gut benutzt, wirst du gewiss rasch zu einem guten Magician aufsteigen. Ich drücke dir die Daumen, Zauberlehrling!
dialogsComplete.fi: You will find that Magicians primarily rely on magic spells to deal damage. However, it is important to know how these weapons work.
dialogsComplete.fil: You will find that Magicians primarily rely on magic spells to deal damage. However, it is important to know how these weapons work.
dialogsComplete.fr: Il te faudra bien savoir utiliser ces 2 armes si tu veux devenir un grand Magicien !
dialogsComplete.id: Kamu akan tahu bahwa Magician akan mengandalkan magic spell untuk memberikan damage. Namun, penting untuk mengetahui cara kerja senjata ini.
dialogsComplete.it: You will find that Magicians primarily rely on magic spells to deal damage. However, it is important to know how these weapons work.
dialogsComplete.jp: 接近戦はできますが、打撃力は弱いので注意してください。この2つの武器を戦略的に使いこなすことで、必ず素晴らしいマジシャンになれることでしょう。頑張ってくださいね。
dialogsComplete.kr: 매지션은 주로 마법 주문을 사용해 공격하지만, 무기가 어떻게 작동하는지 아는 것도 중요하죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: You will find that Magicians primarily rely on magic spells to deal damage. However, it is important to know how these weapons work.
dialogsComplete.pl: You will find that Magicians primarily rely on magic spells to deal damage. However, it is important to know how these weapons work.
dialogsComplete.ru: Мы пользуемся палочками и посохами. Если враг далеко, вынимай палочку, а если подошел вплотную - доставай посох.
dialogsComplete.sp: Descubrirás que los Magicians usan principalmente hechizos mágicos para causar daño. Sin embargo, es importante saber cómo funcionan estas armas.
dialogsComplete.sw: You will find that Magicians primarily rely on magic spells to deal damage. However, it is important to know how these weapons work.
dialogsComplete.th: คุณจะพบว่า Magicians ใช้เวทมนตร์เป็นหลักในการสร้างความเสียหาย อย่างไรก็ตาม สิ่งสำคัญคือต้องรู้ว่าอาวุธเหล่านี้ทำงานอย่างไร
dialogsComplete.tw: 但是，打擊力比較弱，如果有效的使用這 2 種武器的話，一定可以成為一個很棒的魔法師喔~嘻嘻嘻。
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn sẽ thấy rằng các Magicians chủ yếu dựa vào bùa phép để gây sát thương. Tuy nhiên, điều quan trọng là phải biết cách thức hoạt động của những vũ khí này.

dialogsFail.en: I am waiting for someone to deliver some materials I require for Magician weaponry.
dialogsFail.ar: I am waiting for someone to deliver some materials I require for Magician weaponry.
dialogsFail.br: Hum? Wingyei não pediu para que você fizesse algo antes de me visitar? Ou você esqueceu?
dialogsFail.cns: 啊?你说韦依叫你来的喔?那他应该有交代你一些事情才对啊!难道忘记了吗?所以啊…
dialogsFail.de: Wie? Gab dir Wingyei nicht einen Auftrag, bevor du mich aufsuchen solltest. Hast du in schon vergessen? Mit diesem Alter schon so vergesslich? Bla.. bla.. bla..
dialogsFail.fi: I am waiting for someone to deliver some materials I require for Magician weaponry.
dialogsFail.fil: I am waiting for someone to deliver some materials I require for Magician weaponry.
dialogsFail.fr: Comment ? Winyei ne t'a pas confié une tâche avant de te recommander à moi ? Cela m'étonne.
dialogsFail.id: Aku sedang menunggu seseorang untuk mengirimkan beberapa bahan yang aku butuhkan untuk persenjataan Magician.
dialogsFail.it: I am waiting for someone to deliver some materials I require for Magician weaponry.
dialogsFail.jp: あら？ウィンギー様の紹介で来たのですか？でしたら、何か指示されたことがあるはずですよ。思い出してみてください。
dialogsFail.kr: 매지션 무기 제작에 필요한 재료를 기다리고 있는데요.
dialogsFail.nl: I am waiting for someone to deliver some materials I require for Magician weaponry.
dialogsFail.pl: I am waiting for someone to deliver some materials I require for Magician weaponry.
dialogsFail.ru: Я жду одного бродягу. Он должен принести мне материалы для оружия фокусника.
dialogsFail.sp: Estoy esperando a alguien que me va a entregar los materiales que necesito para hacer armas de Magician.
dialogsFail.sw: I am waiting for someone to deliver some materials I require for Magician weaponry.
dialogsFail.th: ฉันกำลังรอคนส่งวัสดุบางอย่างที่ฉันต้องการสำหรับอาวุธของ Magician
dialogsFail.tw: 啊？你說偉依叫你來的喔？那他應該有交代你一些事情才對啊！難道忘記了嗎？所以啊…
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi đang đợi ai đó giao một số nguyên liệu mà tôi cần cho vũ khí của Magician.
