dialogsBegin.en: This Shard, it has made everything so much clearer! I have recovered the part of myself that I lost along the way. I was once Roentel, Hero Billposter…
dialogsBegin.ar: This Shard, it has made everything so much clearer! I have recovered the part of myself that I lost along the way. I was once Roentel, Hero Billposter…
dialogsBegin.br: Este Fragmento... Tornou tudo muito mais claro! Recuperei a parte de mim que perdi ao longo da minha jornada. Eu já fui Roentel, o Herói Billposter…
dialogsBegin.cns: 这个碎片，它让一切变得更加清晰了！我已经找回了这一路上我遗失的那部分自己。 我曾经是罗瓦特，暴力技师英雄……
dialogsBegin.de: Dieser Splitter hat alles so viel klarer gemacht! Ich habe den Teil von mir wiedergefunden, den ich auf dem Weg verloren hatte. Ich war einst Roentel, Hero Billposter...
dialogsBegin.fi: This Shard, it has made everything so much clearer! I have recovered the part of myself that I lost along the way. I was once Roentel, Hero Billposter…
dialogsBegin.fil: This Shard, it has made everything so much clearer! I have recovered the part of myself that I lost along the way. I was once Roentel, Hero Billposter…
dialogsBegin.fr: Voyons voir. Il faut que je le place sur mon front…
dialogsBegin.id: Shardini, itu telah membuat segalanya jauh lebih jelas! Saya telah memulihkan bagian dari diri saya yang hilang di sepanjang jalan. Saya pernah menjadi Roentel, Hero Billposter…
dialogsBegin.it: This Shard, it has made everything so much clearer! I have recovered the part of myself that I lost along the way. I was once Roentel, Hero Billposter…
dialogsBegin.jp: ああ……この石を見ていると遠い頃の記憶が甦る。……そうだ。私は八英雄の一人としてビルポスターでイブリスと闘っていた。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 파편 덕분에 모든 것이 훨씬 명확해졌습니다! 그동안 잃어버렸던 제 일부를 찾은 것 같은... 저는 한때 로엔텔이었어요... 영웅 빌포스터...
dialogsBegin.nl: This Shard, it has made everything so much clearer! I have recovered the part of myself that I lost along the way. I was once Roentel, Hero Billposter…
dialogsBegin.pl: This Shard, it has made everything so much clearer! I have recovered the part of myself that I lost along the way. I was once Roentel, Hero Billposter…
dialogsBegin.ru: This Shard, it has made everything so much clearer! I have recovered the part of myself that I lost along the way. I was once Roentel, Hero Billposter…
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Este Fragmento, me lo ha dejado todo mucho más claro! He recuperado la parte de mí que perdí por el camino. Una vez fui Roentel, Héroe Billposter...
dialogsBegin.sw: This Shard, it has made everything so much clearer! I have recovered the part of myself that I lost along the way. I was once Roentel, Hero Billposter…
dialogsBegin.th: นี่คือ Shard มันจะทำให้ทุกอย่างชัดเจนมากขึ้น! ฉันได้ฟื้นฟูส่วนหนึ่งของฉันที่ฉันสูญเสียไป ฉันเคยเป็น Roentel, Hero Billposter ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 這塊碎片讓一切都清晰起來了！我找回了沿途遺失的那部分自我。我曾經是爆咒師英雄羅瓦特……
dialogsBegin.vi: Với Shard này đã làm cho mọi thứ trở nên rõ ràng hơn rất nhiều! Tôi đã tìm lại được phần bản thân mà tôi đã đánh mất trên đường đi. Tôi đã từng là Roentel, Anh hùng Billposter…

dialogsBegin.en: I now see the gravity of this situation…the peril that Madrigal is truly in. I understand why Reonan is seeking us out!
dialogsBegin.ar: I now see the gravity of this situation…the peril that Madrigal is truly in. I understand why Reonan is seeking us out!
dialogsBegin.br: Agora vejo a gravidade desta situação... o perigo em que Madrigal realmente está. Eu entendo por que Reonan está nos procurando!
dialogsBegin.cns: 我现在意识到了这种情况的严重性…瑞加大陆现在是真的处于危险之中。我明白瑞尔南为什么要找我们了！
dialogsBegin.de: Ich erkenne jetzt den Ernst der Lage ... die Gefahr, in der sich Madrigal wirklich befindet. Ich verstehe, warum Reonan uns aufgesucht hat!
dialogsBegin.fi: I now see the gravity of this situation…the peril that Madrigal is truly in. I understand why Reonan is seeking us out!
dialogsBegin.fil: I now see the gravity of this situation…the peril that Madrigal is truly in. I understand why Reonan is seeking us out!
dialogsBegin.fr: Les armées d'Ishtar… la mort marche sur Flarine… Noooon !! Il faut prévenir Reonan !
dialogsBegin.id: Saya sekarang melihat gravitasi situasi ini ... bahaya yang benar-benar dialami Madrigal. Saya mengerti mengapa Reonan mencari kita!
dialogsBegin.it: I now see the gravity of this situation…the peril that Madrigal is truly in. I understand why Reonan is seeking us out!
dialogsBegin.jp: ふむ……、私もすぐにでもレオナンと合流すべきだろうが、まだ十分に力を取り戻していないのだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이제야 상황의 무게가 실감 나네요... 마드리갈이 얼마나 위기에 처해 있는지 말이죠. 레오난이 왜 우리를 찾아다니는지 알 것 같군요!
dialogsBegin.nl: I now see the gravity of this situation…the peril that Madrigal is truly in. I understand why Reonan is seeking us out!
dialogsBegin.pl: I now see the gravity of this situation…the peril that Madrigal is truly in. I understand why Reonan is seeking us out!
dialogsBegin.ru: I now see the gravity of this situation…the peril that Madrigal is truly in. I understand why Reonan is seeking us out!
dialogsBegin.sp: Ahora veo la gravedad de esta situación... el peligro en el que se encuentra Madrigal. ¡Entiendo por qué Reonan nos busca!
dialogsBegin.sw: I now see the gravity of this situation…the peril that Madrigal is truly in. I understand why Reonan is seeking us out!
dialogsBegin.th: ตอนนี้ฉันเห็นสถานการณ์ที่ย่ำแย่ อันตรายกำลังจะเกิดที่ Madrigal ฉันเข้าใจว่าทำไม Reonan กำลังหาทางให้เราออกไปจากเมืองนี้
dialogsBegin.tw: 瑪德利賈正遭遇到危險…雷奧南會找我們也是當然的事情吧。我也要和他在一起。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bây giờ tôi thấy mức độ nghiêm trọng của tình cảnh này… nguy cơ mà Madrigal đang thực sự phải đối mặt. Tôi hiểu tại sao Reonan lại tìm kiếm chúng tôi!

dialogsBegin.en: First, could you perhaps complete one favor for me? I left my pendant to Capafe before I decided to isolate myself up here on this mountain to train.
dialogsBegin.ar: First, could you perhaps complete one favor for me? I left my pendant to Capafe before I decided to isolate myself up here on this mountain to train.
dialogsBegin.br: Primeiro, você poderia completar um favor para mim? Deixei meu pingente com a Capafe antes de decidir me isolar aqui nesta montanha para treinar.
dialogsBegin.cns: 首先，你能不能帮我办个事？ 在我决定将自己隔离在这座山上训练之前，我把我的吊坠交给了卡帕菲。
dialogsBegin.de: Könnten du mir vielleicht zuerst einen Gefallen tun? Ich habe meinen Anhänger bei Capafe gelassen, bevor ich beschlossen habe, mich hier oben auf diesem Berg zu isolieren, um zu trainieren.
dialogsBegin.fi: First, could you perhaps complete one favor for me? I left my pendant to Capafe before I decided to isolate myself up here on this mountain to train.
dialogsBegin.fil: First, could you perhaps complete one favor for me? I left my pendant to Capafe before I decided to isolate myself up here on this mountain to train.
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous vous sentez d'attaque pour repousser les armées du mal à mes côtés ?
dialogsBegin.id: Pertama, bisakah Anda menyelesaikan satu bantuan untuk saya? Saya meninggalkan liontin saya ke Capafe sebelum saya memutuskan untuk mengisolasi diri di sini di gunung ini untuk berlatih.
dialogsBegin.it: First, could you perhaps complete one favor for me? I left my pendant to Capafe before I decided to isolate myself up here on this mountain to train.
dialogsBegin.jp: すまないが一つ頼まれてほしい。ここで修行する前にカペーペに私の大切なペンダントを預けているんだ。それを取ってきてくれないか。
dialogsBegin.kr: 하지만 그전에, 제 부탁 하나만 들어주시겠어요? 사실 이 산에서 홀로 수련을 시작하기 전에, 펜던트를 카파페에게 맡겨두었거든요.
dialogsBegin.nl: First, could you perhaps complete one favor for me? I left my pendant to Capafe before I decided to isolate myself up here on this mountain to train.
dialogsBegin.pl: First, could you perhaps complete one favor for me? I left my pendant to Capafe before I decided to isolate myself up here on this mountain to train.
dialogsBegin.ru: First, could you perhaps complete one favor for me? I left my pendant to Capafe before I decided to isolate myself up here on this mountain to train.
dialogsBegin.sp: Primero, ¿podrías hacerme un pequeño favor? Le dejé mi colgante a Capafe antes de decidir aislarme en esta montaña para entrenar.
dialogsBegin.sw: First, could you perhaps complete one favor for me? I left my pendant to Capafe before I decided to isolate myself up here on this mountain to train.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันทิ้งจี้ของฉันไว้ที่ Capafe ก่อนที่ฉันจะตัดสินใจแยกตัวออกมาเพื่อฝึกฝนบนภูเขาแห่งนี้
dialogsBegin.tw: 不過，能先幫我一個忙嗎？我決定獨自上山修練前，把墜飾交給了卡班沛。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đầu tiên, bạn có thể giúp đỡ tôi không? Tôi đã để lại mặt dây chuyền của mình cho Capafe trước khi quyết định tự cô lập mình trên ngọn núi này để luyện tập.

dialogsAccept.en: Thank you yet again! Capafe should have the pendant. Go and ask her if she could return it.
dialogsAccept.ar: Thank you yet again! Capafe should have the pendant. Go and ask her if she could return it.
dialogsAccept.br: Obrigada mais uma vez! Capafe deve ter o pingente. Vá e diga que ela pode devolver.
dialogsAccept.cns: 再次感谢你！卡帕菲现在应该拿着吊坠。去问问她能不能将吊坠交还给我。
dialogsAccept.de: Nochmals vielen Dank! Capafe sollte den Anhänger haben. Geh und frag sie, ob sie ihn zurückgeben kann.
dialogsAccept.fi: Thank you yet again! Capafe should have the pendant. Go and ask her if she could return it.
dialogsAccept.fil: Thank you yet again! Capafe should have the pendant. Go and ask her if she could return it.
dialogsAccept.fr: Je vais y aller moi-même. De votre côté allez récupérer le pendentif que j'ai laissé à Capafe avant d'aller m'entrainer.
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih sekali lagi! Capafe harus memiliki liontin itu. Pergi dan tanyakan padanya apakah dia bisa mengembalikannya.
dialogsAccept.it: Thank you yet again! Capafe should have the pendant. Go and ask her if she could return it.
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとう。カペーペのことだ。きっとこの会話も把握しているのだろう。いけばすぐにわかると思う。
dialogsAccept.kr: 정말 감사드려요! 펜던트는 카파페가 가지고 있을 겁니다. 가서 돌려줄 수 있는지 물어보세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Thank you yet again! Capafe should have the pendant. Go and ask her if she could return it.
dialogsAccept.pl: Thank you yet again! Capafe should have the pendant. Go and ask her if she could return it.
dialogsAccept.ru: Thank you yet again! Capafe should have the pendant. Go and ask her if she could return it.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Gracias una vez más! Capafe debería tener el colgante. Ve y pregúntale si te lo puede devolver.
dialogsAccept.sw: Thank you yet again! Capafe should have the pendant. Go and ask her if she could return it.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอบคุณอีกครั้ง! Capafe น่าจะมีจี้ ลองไปถามเธอว่าสามารถทวงจี้คืนมาได้หรือไม่
dialogsAccept.tw: 再次謝謝你！墜飾應該在卡班沛手上，去問她能否歸還吧。
dialogsAccept.vi: Cảm ơn bạn một lần nữa! Capafe nên có mặt dây chuyền. Đi hỏi cô ấy xem cô ấy có thể trả lại không.

dialogsDecline.en: This pendant is an important symbol of trust, you must acquire it!
dialogsDecline.ar: This pendant is an important symbol of trust, you must acquire it!
dialogsDecline.br: Este pingente é um importante símbolo de confiança, você deve adquiri-lo!
dialogsDecline.cns: 这条吊坠是信任的重要象征，你必须拿到它！
dialogsDecline.de: Dieser Anhänger ist ein wichtiges Vertrauenssymbol, du musst ihn unbedingt holen.!
dialogsDecline.fi: This pendant is an important symbol of trust, you must acquire it!
dialogsDecline.fil: This pendant is an important symbol of trust, you must acquire it!
dialogsDecline.fr: Ce pendentif est réellement essentiel. C'est la clé du savoir de ma précédante incarnation...
dialogsDecline.id: Liontin ini adalah simbol kepercayaan yang penting, Anda harus mendapatkannya!
dialogsDecline.it: This pendant is an important symbol of trust, you must acquire it!
dialogsDecline.jp: あのペンダントがなければ私は……。
dialogsDecline.kr: 이 펜던트는 중요한 신뢰의 상징입니다. 반드시 되찾아야 해요!
dialogsDecline.nl: This pendant is an important symbol of trust, you must acquire it!
dialogsDecline.pl: This pendant is an important symbol of trust, you must acquire it!
dialogsDecline.ru: Этот кулон - очень важный символ нашего доверия! Ты должен заполучить его!
dialogsDecline.sp: Este colgante es un importante símbolo de confianza, ¡debes ir a por él!
dialogsDecline.sw: This pendant is an important symbol of trust, you must acquire it!
dialogsDecline.th: จี้นี้เป็นสัญลักษณ์ที่สำคัญของความไว้ใจ คุณต้องรีบไปเอามันมา
dialogsDecline.tw: 如果沒有墜飾，就算我獲得領悟，我也沒有辦法去見我的同伴。
dialogsDecline.vi: Mặt dây chuyền này là một biểu tượng quan trọng của sự tin tưởng, bạn phải có được nó!

dialogsComplete.en: I'm glad to hear that Sury has reached this realization.
dialogsComplete.ar: I'm glad to hear that Sury has reached this realization.
dialogsComplete.br: Fico feliz em saber que Sury chegou a essa conclusão.
dialogsComplete.cns: 我很高兴听到叙里已经实现了突破。
dialogsComplete.de: Es freut mich zu hören, dass Sury zu dieser Erkenntnis gelangt ist.
dialogsComplete.fi: I'm glad to hear that Sury has reached this realization.
dialogsComplete.fil: I'm glad to hear that Sury has reached this realization.
dialogsComplete.fr: Sury a eu une vision ?
dialogsComplete.id: Saya senang mendengar bahwa Sury telah mencapai kesadaran ini.
dialogsComplete.it: I'm glad to hear that Sury has reached this realization.
dialogsComplete.jp: まあ、シュリ様がついに悟りの境地を取り戻されたのですね。ありがとうございます。
dialogsComplete.kr: 슈리님이 깨달음을 얻으셨다니 정말 다행입니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: I'm glad to hear that Sury has reached this realization.
dialogsComplete.pl: I'm glad to hear that Sury has reached this realization.
dialogsComplete.ru: I'm glad to hear that Sury has reached this realization.
dialogsComplete.sp: Me alegra saber que Sury ha alcanzado la realización.
dialogsComplete.sw: I'm glad to hear that Sury has reached this realization.
dialogsComplete.th: ฉันดีใจที่ได้รู้ว่า Sury รู้จักสำนึกแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 修利大人獲得領悟了，真的是太好了。
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi rất vui khi biết rằng Sury đã đạt được nhận thức này.

dialogsBegin.en: Level 40 eh? You've really grown since our last meeting! Hmm, have you heard of a man named "Ghost" Hael? He is one of Madrigal's best known bounty hunters.
dialogsBegin.ar: Level 40 eh? You've really grown since our last meeting! Hmm, have you heard of a man named "Ghost" Hael? He is one of Madrigal's best known bounty hunters.
dialogsBegin.br: Nível 40 é? Você realmente cresceu desde nosso último encontro! Hmm, você já ouviu falar de um homem chamado Hael "O Fantasma"? Ele é um dos caçadores de recompensas mais reconhecidos de Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.cns: 40级了吗？在我们没有见面的这段时间，你真的成长了不少啊！嗯，你有没有听过一个叫"幽灵"海尔的男人？他是瑞加大陆最知名的赏金猎人之一。
dialogsBegin.de: Level 40, was? Du bist wirklich gewachsen seit unserem letzten Treffen! Hmm, hast du schon von einem Mann namens "Ghost" Hael gehört? Er ist einer von Madrigals bekanntesten Kopfgeldjägern.
dialogsBegin.fi: Level 40 eh? You've really grown since our last meeting! Hmm, have you heard of a man named "Ghost" Hael? He is one of Madrigal's best known bounty hunters.
dialogsBegin.fil: Level 40 eh? You've really grown since our last meeting! Hmm, have you heard of a man named "Ghost" Hael? He is one of Madrigal's best known bounty hunters.
dialogsBegin.fr: Déjà niveau 40 ? Vous êtes incroyable. Je vais donc vous donner une nouvelle mission.
dialogsBegin.id: Level 40 ya? Kamu telah banyak berkembang sejak terakhir kali kita bertemu! Hmm, pernahkah kamu mendengar tentang seorang pria bernama "Ghost" Hael? Dia adalah salah satu pemburu hadiah Madrigal yang paling terkenal.
dialogsBegin.it: Level 40 eh? You've really grown since our last meeting! Hmm, have you heard of a man named "Ghost" Hael? He is one of Madrigal's best known bounty hunters.
dialogsBegin.jp: ずいぶんとたくましく成長したようだな。そろそろ次の任務もこなせそうだ。お前さん、隠密のハエルは知っているかい？　マドリガルを蔭ながら支えてくれている同士だ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 레벨 40이라니, 마지막으로 만났을 때보다 훨씬 성장했군요! 그나저나, ‘고스트’ 하엘이라는 이름, 들어본 적 있어요? 마드리갈에서 가장 유명한 현상금 사냥꾼 중 한 명인데.
dialogsBegin.nl: Level 40 eh? You've really grown since our last meeting! Hmm, have you heard of a man named "Ghost" Hael? He is one of Madrigal's best known bounty hunters.
dialogsBegin.pl: Level 40 eh? You've really grown since our last meeting! Hmm, have you heard of a man named "Ghost" Hael? He is one of Madrigal's best known bounty hunters.
dialogsBegin.ru: Level 40 eh? You've really grown since our last meeting! Hmm, have you heard of a man named "Ghost" Hael? He is one of Madrigal's best known bounty hunters.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Nivel 40 eh? ¡Has mejorado mucho desde nuestro último encuentro! Hmm, ¿has oído hablar de un hombre llamado "Fantasma" Hael? Es uno de los cazarrecompensas más conocidos de Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.sw: Level 40 eh? You've really grown since our last meeting! Hmm, have you heard of a man named "Ghost" Hael? He is one of Madrigal's best known bounty hunters.
dialogsBegin.th: เลเวล 40 เอ๊ะ? คุณโตขึ้นตั้งแต่การประชุมครั้งล่าสุด! อืมคุณเคยได้ยินชื่อคนหนึ่งชื่อ "Ghost" Hael หรือไม่? เขาเป็นหนึ่งในนักล่าเงินรางวัลที่เป็นที่รู้จักกันดีที่สุดของ Madrigal
dialogsBegin.tw: 40 級了吧？自從我們上次見面以來，你真的長大了！嗯，你聽說過一個叫“幽靈”哈爾的人嗎？他是瑪德利賈最著名的賞金獵人之一。
dialogsBegin.vi: Cấp 40 hả? Bạn đã thực sự trưởng thành kể từ lần gặp cuối cùng của chúng ta! Hmm, bạn đã nghe nói về một người tên là "Ghost" Hael chưa? Anh ta là một trong những thợ săn tiền thưởng nổi tiếng nhất Madrigal.

dialogsBegin.en: His cold and mysterious demeanor have earned him the title "Ghost". I've heard from sources that he might be traveling through Flaris today.
dialogsBegin.ar: His cold and mysterious demeanor have earned him the title "Ghost". I've heard from sources that he might be traveling through Flaris today.
dialogsBegin.br: Seu comportamento frio e misterioso lhe rendeu o título de "O Fantasma". Ouvi de fontes que ele pode estar viajando por Flaris hoje.
dialogsBegin.cns: 他冷酷和神秘的气质让他获得了"幽灵"的称号。我从消息源处获知他今天将游历帕里。
dialogsBegin.de: Sein kaltes und geheimnisvolles Auftreten hat ihm den Titel "Geist" eingebracht. Ich habe von Quellen gehört, dass er heute vielleicht durch Flaris reist.
dialogsBegin.fi: His cold and mysterious demeanor have earned him the title "Ghost". I've heard from sources that he might be traveling through Flaris today.
dialogsBegin.fil: His cold and mysterious demeanor have earned him the title "Ghost". I've heard from sources that he might be traveling through Flaris today.
dialogsBegin.fr: Est-ce que vous connaissez Hael le chasseur de monstres ? Allez le voir à la fontaine des défunts à Flaris. Faites ce qu'il vous demande.
dialogsBegin.id: Sikapnya yang dingin dan misterius telah membuatnya mendapatkan gelar "Hantu". Saya telah mendengar dari berbagai sumber bahwa dia mungkin bepergian melalui Flaris hari ini.
dialogsBegin.it: His cold and mysterious demeanor have earned him the title "Ghost". I've heard from sources that he might be traveling through Flaris today.
dialogsBegin.jp: 彼はなかなかこういった街中には立ち寄らないんだが、どうもいまレルエン山脈のふもとにいるらしくてね。これからは彼の力が必要なんだ。よければ自己紹介も兼ねて会ってみないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 차갑고 신비한 분위기 때문에 다들 하엘을 "고스트"라고 부르죠. 오늘 플라리스에 온다는 소문을 전해 들었어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: His cold and mysterious demeanor have earned him the title "Ghost". I've heard from sources that he might be traveling through Flaris today.
dialogsBegin.pl: His cold and mysterious demeanor have earned him the title "Ghost". I've heard from sources that he might be traveling through Flaris today.
dialogsBegin.ru: His cold and mysterious demeanor have earned him the title "Ghost". I've heard from sources that he might be traveling through Flaris today.
dialogsBegin.sp: Su comportamiento frío y misterioso le ha dado el título de "Fantasma". Mis fuentes me han dicho que podría estar viajando por Flaris hoy.
dialogsBegin.sw: His cold and mysterious demeanor have earned him the title "Ghost". I've heard from sources that he might be traveling through Flaris today.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันเคยได้ยินจากแหล่งต่างๆ ที่เขาอาจเดินทางผ่าน Flaris วันนี้
dialogsBegin.tw: 他冷酷而神秘的舉止為他贏得了“幽靈”的稱號，我從消息來源聽說他今天可能正在穿越布拉里斯。
dialogsBegin.vi: Phong thái lạnh lùng và bí ẩn của anh đã mang lại cho anh danh hiệu "Ghost". Tôi đã nghe từ các nguồn tin rằng anh ấy có thể sẽ đi du lịch qua Flaris hôm nay.

dialogsBegin.en: Would you perhaps seek him out for me? If you tell him my name, perhaps it will jog his memory…
dialogsBegin.ar: Would you perhaps seek him out for me? If you tell him my name, perhaps it will jog his memory…
dialogsBegin.br: Você poderia procurá-lo para mim? Se você disser meu nome a ele, talvez refresque sua memória...
dialogsBegin.cns: 你愿意替我把他找出来吗？如果你告诉他我们名字，有可能会唤醒他的记忆...
dialogsBegin.de: Würdet Ihr ihn vielleicht für mich aufsuchen? Wenn Sie ihm meinen Namen sagen, wird er sich vielleicht erinnern...
dialogsBegin.fi: Would you perhaps seek him out for me? If you tell him my name, perhaps it will jog his memory…
dialogsBegin.fil: Would you perhaps seek him out for me? If you tell him my name, perhaps it will jog his memory…
dialogsBegin.fr: Dites-lui que c'est moi qui vous envoie si vous tenez à la vie.
dialogsBegin.id: Apakah kamu mau mencarinya untuk saya? Jika kamu memberi tahu dia nama saya, mungkin itu akan memicu ingatannya.
dialogsBegin.it: Would you perhaps seek him out for me? If you tell him my name, perhaps it will jog his memory…
dialogsBegin.jp: 私の名前を出せばすぐにわかってくれると思う。頼んだぞ！
dialogsBegin.kr: 혹시 저 대신 하엘을 찾아가 주실 수 있나요? 제 이름을 말하면, 어쩌면 기억이 떠오를지도 몰라요…
dialogsBegin.nl: Would you perhaps seek him out for me? If you tell him my name, perhaps it will jog his memory…
dialogsBegin.pl: Would you perhaps seek him out for me? If you tell him my name, perhaps it will jog his memory…
dialogsBegin.ru: Would you perhaps seek him out for me? If you tell him my name, perhaps it will jog his memory…
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Lo irías a buscar por mí? Si le dices mi nombre, tal vez le refresque la memoria...
dialogsBegin.sw: Would you perhaps seek him out for me? If you tell him my name, perhaps it will jog his memory…
dialogsBegin.th: ถ้าคุณบอกชื่อของฉันบางทีมันอาจจะช่วยเรื่องความทรงจำของเขา ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 你能不能幫我找他？如果你告訴他我的名字，也許會喚起他的記憶……
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có lẽ sẽ tìm kiếm anh ta cho tôi? Nếu bạn nói cho anh ấy biết tên tôi, có lẽ nó sẽ khiến anh ấy nhớ lại…

dialogsAccept.en: Appreciate it! He will be appearing at Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern part of Flaris. Please find him.
dialogsAccept.ar: Appreciate it! He will be appearing at Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern part of Flaris. Please find him.
dialogsAccept.br: Agradeço! Ele aparecerá na Fonte dos Mortos na parte norte de Flaris. Por favor, encontre-o.
dialogsAccept.cns: 非常感谢！他将会在帕里北部的亡者之泉出现。请去那找他。
dialogsAccept.de: Vielen Dank! Er wird am Fountain of Dead Person im nördlichen Teil von Flaris auftauchen. Bitte finden Sie ihn.
dialogsAccept.fi: Appreciate it! He will be appearing at Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern part of Flaris. Please find him.
dialogsAccept.fil: Appreciate it! He will be appearing at Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern part of Flaris. Please find him.
dialogsAccept.fr: Parfait, n'oubliez pas. La fontaine des défunts au Nord de Flaris. Et mentionnez mon nom !
dialogsAccept.id: Hargai itu! Dia akan muncul di Fountain of Dead Person di bagian utara Flaris. Tolong temukan dia.
dialogsAccept.it: Appreciate it! He will be appearing at Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern part of Flaris. Please find him.
dialogsAccept.jp: レルエン山脈の麓の湖だ。ぜひ彼の話も聞いてやってほしい。
dialogsAccept.kr: 고마워요! 하엘은 오늘 플라리스 북부에 있는 망자의 샘에 나타날 거예요. 꼭 하엘을 만나 주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Appreciate it! He will be appearing at Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern part of Flaris. Please find him.
dialogsAccept.pl: Appreciate it! He will be appearing at Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern part of Flaris. Please find him.
dialogsAccept.ru: Appreciate it! He will be appearing at Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern part of Flaris. Please find him.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Te lo agradezco! Aparecerá por el Manantial de Almas en la parte Norte de Flaris. Por favor, encuéntralo.
dialogsAccept.sw: Appreciate it! He will be appearing at Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern part of Flaris. Please find him.
dialogsAccept.th: เขาจะปรากฏตัวในงาน Fountain of the Dead ในภาคเหนือของ Flaris โปรดหาเขา
dialogsAccept.tw: 真感謝！他將出現在布拉里斯北部的亡者之泉。請找到他。
dialogsAccept.vi: Thật sự cảm kích! Anh ta sẽ xuất hiện tại Fountain of Dead Person ở phần phía Bắc của Flaris. Hãy tìm anh ta.

dialogsDecline.en: What are you scared? I mean, he's not REALLY a ghost.
dialogsDecline.ar: What are you scared? I mean, he's not REALLY a ghost.
dialogsDecline.br: Do que você está com medo? Digo, ele não é REALMENTE um fantasma.
dialogsDecline.cns: 你在怕什么？我的意思是，他并不是真的幽灵。
dialogsDecline.de: Wovor hast du Angst? Ich meine, er ist nicht WIRKLICH ein Geist.
dialogsDecline.fi: What are you scared? I mean, he's not REALLY a ghost.
dialogsDecline.fil: What are you scared? I mean, he's not REALLY a ghost.
dialogsDecline.fr: Je vous sens indécis pour une fois…
dialogsDecline.id: Apa yang kau takutkan? Maksudku, dia bukan BENAR-BENAR hantu.
dialogsDecline.it: What are you scared? I mean, he's not REALLY a ghost.
dialogsDecline.jp: ふむ、まだまだお前さんは世界を救う気構えに欠けるようだな。
dialogsDecline.kr: 왜, 겁이 나나요? 진짜 '고스트'는 아니라고요.
dialogsDecline.nl: What are you scared? I mean, he's not REALLY a ghost.
dialogsDecline.pl: What are you scared? I mean, he's not REALLY a ghost.
dialogsDecline.ru: What are you scared? I mean, he's not REALLY a ghost.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Qué tienes miedo? Pero, él NO es un fantasma de verdad.
dialogsDecline.sw: What are you scared? I mean, he's not REALLY a ghost.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณกลัวอะไร ฉันหมายความว่าเขาไม่ใช่ผีจริงๆ
dialogsDecline.tw: 你害怕什麼？我的意思是，他真的不是鬼。
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn đang sợ hãi điều gì? Ý tôi là, anh ta THỰC SỰ không phải là một con ma.

dialogsComplete.en: Sure is awfully hard to concentrate with you standing right there. What do you want?
dialogsComplete.ar: Sure is awfully hard to concentrate with you standing right there. What do you want?
dialogsComplete.br: É terrivelmente difícil se concentrar com você parado bem aí. O que você quer??
dialogsComplete.cns: Sure is awfully hard to concentrate with you standing right there. What do you want?
dialogsComplete.de: Es ist sehr schwer, sich zu konzentrieren, wenn du da stehst. Was willst du eigentlich?
dialogsComplete.fi: Sure is awfully hard to concentrate with you standing right there. What do you want?
dialogsComplete.fil: Sure is awfully hard to concentrate with you standing right there. What do you want?
dialogsComplete.fr: Reonan vous envoie ? Je vous écoute.
dialogsComplete.id: Tentu sangat sulit untuk berkonsentrasi saat kamu berdiri di sana. Apa yang kamu inginkan?
dialogsComplete.it: Sure is awfully hard to concentrate with you standing right there. What do you want?
dialogsComplete.jp: む……お主何者だ？
dialogsComplete.kr: 당신이 거기에 서 있으면 집중하기 힘들다고요. 원하는 게 뭐예요?
dialogsComplete.nl: Sure is awfully hard to concentrate with you standing right there. What do you want?
dialogsComplete.pl: Sure is awfully hard to concentrate with you standing right there. What do you want?
dialogsComplete.ru: Sure is awfully hard to concentrate with you standing right there. What do you want?
dialogsComplete.sp: De verdad que es terriblemente difícil concentrarse contigo parado ahí delante. ¿¿Qué quieres??
dialogsComplete.sw: Sure is awfully hard to concentrate with you standing right there. What do you want?
dialogsComplete.th: มันรวบรวมสมาธิยาก ถ้าคุณยังอยู่ตรงนี้ แล้วคุณต้องการอะไร??
dialogsComplete.tw: 你站在那裡害我根本沒辦法專心。你到底要做什麼？
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn đứng ngay đó làm tôi mất tập trung quá đấy. Bạn muốn gì?

dialogsFail.en: You haven't met Hael yet? He should be at the Fountain of Dead Person.
dialogsFail.ar: You haven't met Hael yet? He should be at the Fountain of Dead Person.
dialogsFail.br: Você ainda não conheceu Hael? Ele deve estar na Fonte dos Mortos.
dialogsFail.cns: 你还没见到海尔吗？他应该在亡者之泉的。
dialogsFail.de: Du hast Hael noch nicht getroffen? Er sollte am Fountain of Dead Person sein.
dialogsFail.fi: You haven't met Hael yet? He should be at the Fountain of Dead Person.
dialogsFail.fil: You haven't met Hael yet? He should be at the Fountain of Dead Person.
dialogsFail.fr: Allez, filez retrouver hael à la fontaine des défunts !
dialogsFail.id: Kamu belum bertemu Hael? Dia seharusnya berada di Fountain of Dead Person.
dialogsFail.it: You haven't met Hael yet? He should be at the Fountain of Dead Person.
dialogsFail.jp: ハエルは見つかったかい？　レルエン山脈の麓の湖だぞ。
dialogsFail.kr: 아직 하엘을 만나지 못했어요? 망자의 샘에 있을 거예요.
dialogsFail.nl: You haven't met Hael yet? He should be at the Fountain of Dead Person.
dialogsFail.pl: You haven't met Hael yet? He should be at the Fountain of Dead Person.
dialogsFail.ru: You haven't met Hael yet? He should be at the Fountain of Dead Person.
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Aún no conoces a Hael? Debería estar en el Manantial de Almas.
dialogsFail.sw: You haven't met Hael yet? He should be at the Fountain of Dead Person.
dialogsFail.th: คุณยังไม่ได้เจอ Hael? เขาควรจะอยู่ในช่วงฤดูใบไม้ผลิแห่งความตาย
dialogsFail.tw: 你還沒見過哈爾？他應該在亡者之泉。
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn chưa gặp Hael? Anh ta nên ở Đài phun nước của Người chết.

description.ar: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.

description.cns: 为了减少你的罪恶值，你要去击杀 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 回来。
description.de: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ jagen wird dein Karma wiederherstellen.
description.fi: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.fil: Ang Pang-huhuli ng $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ay makakapagpanumbalik ng iyong Karma points.
description.fr: Tu devrais chasser des $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s afin de récupérer les points de Karma.
description.id: Berburu $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ akan memulihkan poin-poin Karmamu.
description.it: Stai cacciando $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ per recuperare i tuoi punti Karma.
description.jp: カルマポイントを回復するため、$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を処罰して来てください。
description.nl: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.pl: Polowanie na $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ pozwoli odzyskać punkty Karmy.
description.ru: Твоя цель - $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, только так ты очистишь карму.
description.sp: Cazar $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ recuperará tus puntos de Karma.
description.sw: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.th: การล่า $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ จะกู้คืนคะแนน Karma ของคุณ
description.tw: 狩獵 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 將會恢復你的惡名點數。
description.vi: Săn $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ sẽ phục hồi điểm Karma của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsDecline.en: You have yet to pay for your sins…

dialogsDecline.cns: 你还没有为你的罪恶付出代价...
dialogsDecline.de: Du musst noch immer für deine Sünden bezahlen...
dialogsDecline.fi: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.fil: Di mo pa bayad ang iyong mga kasalanan…
dialogsDecline.fr: Quand expieras-tu tes nombreux crimes ?
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu belum membayar untuk dosa-dosamu…
dialogsDecline.it: Devi ancora pagare per i tuoi peccati...
dialogsDecline.jp: いつになったら、この底知れぬ罪悪感から抜けられるのだろう？
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신은 아직 죗값을 치르지 않았으니...
dialogsDecline.nl: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.pl: Musisz najpierw zapłacić za swoje grzechy…
dialogsDecline.ru: Велики твои грехи…
dialogsDecline.sp: Todavía tienes que pagar por tus pecados...
dialogsDecline.sw: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.th: คุณยังไม้ได้ชดใช้บาปของคุณ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 你還沒有為你的罪付出代價…
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn vẫn chưa phải trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình…

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.br: Sua missão foi concluída. Seus pecados foram perdoados.
dialogsComplete.cns: 任务完成，你的罪恶已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Buße getan. Deine Sünden wurden dir vergeben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Questmu telah tercapai. Dosa-dosamu telah diampuni.
dialogsComplete.it: La Missione è terminata. I tuoi peccati sono stati perdonati.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 끝났습니다. 당신의 죄를 용서하지요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Боги одобрили твое деяние и простили тебе грехи.
dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น บาปของคุณได้รับการอภัยแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nhiệm vụ của bạn đã được hoàn thành. Tội lỗi của bạn đã được tha thứ.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: A great terror lies within this volcano. A cataclysmic maelstrom is said to have erupted this volcano and carved out these caverns.
dialogsBegin.ar: A great terror lies within this volcano. A cataclysmic maelstrom is said to have erupted this volcano and carved out these caverns.
dialogsBegin.br: Um grande terror reside dentro deste vulcão. Dizem que um redemoinho cataclísmico entrou em erupção neste vulcão e esculpiu essas cavernas.
dialogsBegin.cns: 这座火山是危险之地。据说是一场灾难性的大漩涡喷发形成了这座火山和这些洞穴。
dialogsBegin.de: Ein großes Grauen liegt in diesem Vulkan. Ein kataklysmischer Mahlstrom soll diesen Vulkan zum Ausbruch gebracht und diese Höhlen ausgehöhlt haben.
dialogsBegin.fi: A great terror lies within this volcano. A cataclysmic maelstrom is said to have erupted this volcano and carved out these caverns.
dialogsBegin.fil: A great terror lies within this volcano. A cataclysmic maelstrom is said to have erupted this volcano and carved out these caverns.
dialogsBegin.fr: Une terreur sans nom hante ce volcan. On raconte que son éruption a jadis causé un maelström cataclysmique et creusé ces cavernes.
dialogsBegin.id: Sebuah teror besar terletak di dalam gunung berapi ini. Sebuah pusaran dahsyat dikatakan telah meletuskan gunung berapi ini dan mengukir gua-gua ini.
dialogsBegin.it: A great terror lies within this volcano. A cataclysmic maelstrom is said to have erupted this volcano and carved out these caverns.
dialogsBegin.jp: この火山には恐怖そのものが潜んでいる。激動の大渦が火山を噴火させ、ついにはこの洞窟そのものを創り上げてしまった。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 화산 속에는 거대한 공포가 도사리고 있습니다. 어마어마한 격변의 소용돌이로 화산이 폭발하면서 이 동굴들이 생겨났다고 해요.
dialogsBegin.nl: A great terror lies within this volcano. A cataclysmic maelstrom is said to have erupted this volcano and carved out these caverns.
dialogsBegin.pl: A great terror lies within this volcano. A cataclysmic maelstrom is said to have erupted this volcano and carved out these caverns.
dialogsBegin.ru: A great terror lies within this volcano. A cataclysmic maelstrom is said to have erupted this volcano and carved out these caverns.
dialogsBegin.sp: Un gran horror yace en este volcán. Se dice que un torbellino cataclísmico hizo estallar este volcán y esculpió estas cavernas.
dialogsBegin.sw: A great terror lies within this volcano. A cataclysmic maelstrom is said to have erupted this volcano and carved out these caverns.
dialogsBegin.th: ความน่าสะพรึงกลัวอันยิ่งใหญ่อยู่ภายในภูเขาไฟแห่งนี้ กล่าวกันว่ามหาภัยพิบัติได้ปะทุภูเขาไฟนี้และแกะสลักถ้ำเหล่านี้
dialogsBegin.tw: 巨大的恐怖存在於這座火山之中，據說一場災難性的大漩渦噴發了這座火山並挖出了這些洞穴。
dialogsBegin.vi: Một nỗi kinh hoàng nằm trong ngọn núi lửa này. Một trận đại hồng thủy được cho là đã phun trào núi lửa và khoét sâu những hang động này.

dialogsBegin.en: The Red Meteonyker is one of the most dangerous Masquerpets in all of Madrigal. As a fearsome creation of Shade, I do not know of many who have survived his fiery breath. This abomination has been sealed away for many ages.
dialogsBegin.ar: The Red Meteonyker is one of the most dangerous Masquerpets in all of Madrigal. As a fearsome creation of Shade, I do not know of many who have survived his fiery breath. This abomination has been sealed away for many ages.
dialogsBegin.br: O Meteonyker Vermelho é um dos Masquerpets mais perigosos de toda Madrigal. Como uma criação assustadora de Shade, não conheço muitos que tenham sobrevivido ao seu sopro de fogo. Esta abominação foi selada por muitas eras.
dialogsBegin.cns: 红龙是整个瑞加中最危险的怪物之一。作为一个可怕的谢莉德创造物，我不知道有没有人能在它炽热的呼吸中活下来。这个可憎的东西已经被封印了很多年。
dialogsBegin.de: Der Red Meteonyker ist eines der gefärhlichsten Monster in ganz Madrigal. Eine fürchterregende Schöpfung von Shade. Ich kenne nicht viele, die seinen feurigen Atem überlebt haben. Diese Abscheulichkeit wurde seit ewigen Zeiten weggesperrt.
dialogsBegin.fi: The Red Meteonyker is one of the most dangerous Masquerpets in all of Madrigal. As a fearsome creation of Shade, I do not know of many who have survived his fiery breath. This abomination has been sealed away for many ages.
dialogsBegin.fil: The Red Meteonyker is one of the most dangerous Masquerpets in all of Madrigal. As a fearsome creation of Shade, I do not know of many who have survived his fiery breath. This abomination has been sealed away for many ages.
dialogsBegin.fr: Le Meteonyker Rouge est l'un des monstres les plus dangereux de tout Madrigal. Je connais peu de guerriers assez vaillants pour avoir survécu au souffle ardent de cette redoutable création de Shade. Heureusement, cette abomination est scellée depuis des années.
dialogsBegin.id: Red Meteonyker adalah Masquerpet paling berbahaya di sleuruh Madrigal. Ciptaan Shade yang menakutkan. Tidak banyak orang yang selamat dari semburan apinya. Makhluk keji ini telah disegel selama berabad-abad
dialogsBegin.it: The Red Meteonyker is one of the most dangerous Masquerpets in all of Madrigal. As a fearsome creation of Shade, I do not know of many who have survived his fiery breath. This abomination has been sealed away for many ages.
dialogsBegin.jp: レッド・メテオニカは、マドリガル全土で最も危険なモンスターとも言われている。シェードが創ったとされる大きな恐怖の1つ、奴のブレスから生き延びた者を私は多くないと言う。この忌まわしい存在は、長い年月の間封印されてきた。
dialogsBegin.kr: 빨강 메테오니커는 마드리갈 전체에서 위험하기로 손꼽히는 마스커펫입니다. 쉐이드의 무시무시한 창조물인 만큼, 그 불타는 숨결을 견디고 살아남은 자는 거의 없다고 들었어요. 이 혐오스러운 존재들은 오랜 세월 봉인되어 있었죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: The Red Meteonyker is one of the most dangerous Masquerpets in all of Madrigal. As a fearsome creation of Shade, I do not know of many who have survived his fiery breath. This abomination has been sealed away for many ages.
dialogsBegin.pl: The Red Meteonyker is one of the most dangerous Masquerpets in all of Madrigal. As a fearsome creation of Shade, I do not know of many who have survived his fiery breath. This abomination has been sealed away for many ages.
dialogsBegin.ru: The Red Meteonyker is one of the most dangerous Masquerpets in all of Madrigal. As a fearsome creation of Shade, I do not know of many who have survived his fiery breath. This abomination has been sealed away for many ages.
dialogsBegin.sp: El Meteonyker Rojo es uno de los Masquerpets más peligrosos de todo Madrigal. Una temible creación de Shade, no sé de muchos que hayan sobrevivido a su aliento de fuego. Esta abominación ha estado sellada por muchas eras.
dialogsBegin.sw: The Red Meteonyker is one of the most dangerous Masquerpets in all of Madrigal. As a fearsome creation of Shade, I do not know of many who have survived his fiery breath. This abomination has been sealed away for many ages.
dialogsBegin.th: Red Meteonyker เป็นหนึ่งใน Masquerpet ที่อันตรายที่สุดใน Madrigal ในฐานะที่เป็นการสร้างที่น่ากลัวของ Shade ฉันไม่รู้ว่าหลายคนรอดชีวิตจากลมหายใจที่ร้อนแรงของเขา สิ่งที่น่าสะอิดสะเอียนนี้ถูกผนึกไว้นานหลายชั่วอายุคน
dialogsBegin.tw: 炙焰飛龍是整個瑪德利賈中最危險的怪物之一。作為一個可怕的闇影創造物，我不知道有多少人在他熾熱的呼吸中倖存下來。這個可憎的東西已經被封印了很多年。
dialogsBegin.vi: Red Meteonyker là một trong những Masquerpets nguy hiểm nhất ở Madrigal. Là tác phẩm đáng sợ của Shade, tôi không biết có bao nhiêu người đã sống sót sau hơi thở rực lửa của anh ta. Hành động ghê tởm này đã bị phong ấn trong nhiều thời đại.

dialogsBegin.en: Many adventurers like yourself who battle Masquerpets in Darkon are unaware of the grave danger that lies below them. The walls are giving way and the Red Meteonyker may not be tempered much longer.
dialogsBegin.ar: Many adventurers like yourself who battle Masquerpets in Darkon are unaware of the grave danger that lies below them. The walls are giving way and the Red Meteonyker may not be tempered much longer.
dialogsBegin.br: Muitos aventureiros como você que lutam contra Masquerpets em Darkon não estão cientes do grave perigo que está abaixo deles. As paredes estão cedendo e o Meteonyker Vermelho não poderá ser detido por muito mais tempo.
dialogsBegin.cns: 许多像你一样在达肯与怪物战斗的冒险家都没有意识到他们身下的大危机。墙壁正在坍塌，红龙可能要解除封印了。
dialogsBegin.de: Viele Abenteurer wie du bekämpfen Monster in Darkon, wissen aber nicht von der lebensgefährlichen Bedrohung unter deren Füßen. Die Wände werden schwach und Red Meteonyker kann womöglich nicht mehr länger gebändigt werden.
dialogsBegin.fi: Many adventurers like yourself who battle Masquerpets in Darkon are unaware of the grave danger that lies below them. The walls are giving way and the Red Meteonyker may not be tempered much longer.
dialogsBegin.fil: Many adventurers like yourself who battle Masquerpets in Darkon are unaware of the grave danger that lies below them. The walls are giving way and the Red Meteonyker may not be tempered much longer.
dialogsBegin.fr: De nombreux aventuriers tels que toi combattent les monstres de Darkon sans avoir conscience du grave danger qui repose sous leur pieds. Les murs commencent à faiblir, et le Meteonyker Rouge ne pourra pas être retenu très longtemps.
dialogsBegin.id: Banyak petualang seperti anda yang melawan Masquerpets di Darkon tidak menyadari bahaya besar yang ada di bawah mereka. Dindingnya memberi jalan dan Red Meteonyker mungkin tidak akan marah lebih lama lagi.
dialogsBegin.it: Many adventurers like yourself who battle Masquerpets in Darkon are unaware of the grave danger that lies below them. The walls are giving way and the Red Meteonyker may not be tempered much longer.
dialogsBegin.jp: ダーコンでモンスターに挑む冒険者たちは、水面下に潜むこの重大な危機を知らない。壁が崩れ、レッドメテオニカが外に出て言ってしまうだろう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 당신처럼 다콘에서 마스커펫들과 싸우는 모험가들은, 그 아래에 얼마나 심각한 위험이 도사리고 있는지 몰라요. 벽이 무너지고 있어요. 빨강 메테오니커를 더는 제어할 수 없을지도 몰라요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Many adventurers like yourself who battle Masquerpets in Darkon are unaware of the grave danger that lies below them. The walls are giving way and the Red Meteonyker may not be tempered much longer.
dialogsBegin.pl: Many adventurers like yourself who battle Masquerpets in Darkon are unaware of the grave danger that lies below them. The walls are giving way and the Red Meteonyker may not be tempered much longer.
dialogsBegin.ru: Many adventurers like yourself who battle Masquerpets in Darkon are unaware of the grave danger that lies below them. The walls are giving way and the Red Meteonyker may not be tempered much longer.
dialogsBegin.sp: Muchos aventureros como tú, que luchan contra Masquerpets en Darkon, no son conscientes del grave peligro que se esconde debajo de ellos. Las paredes están cediendo y es posible que el Meteonyker Rojo no se contenga por mucho más tiempo.
dialogsBegin.sw: Many adventurers like yourself who battle Masquerpets in Darkon are unaware of the grave danger that lies below them. The walls are giving way and the Red Meteonyker may not be tempered much longer.
dialogsBegin.th: นักผจญภัยหลายคนเช่นคุณที่ต่อสู้กับ Masquerpets ใน Darkon นั้นไม่รู้ถึงอันตรายร้ายแรงที่อยู่ด้านล่างพวกเขา กำแพงกำลังเปิดทางและ Red Meteonyker อาจไม่ดีอีกต่อไป
dialogsBegin.tw: 許多像你一樣在得肯與怪物戰鬥的冒險家都沒有意識到他們身下的嚴重危險。牆壁正在坍塌，炙焰飛龍 可能不會再被磨平了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Nhiều nhà thám hiểm như bạn chiến đấu với Masquerpets trong Darkon không nhận thức được mối nguy hiểm nghiêm trọng đang nằm bên dưới họ. Các bức tường đang nhường chỗ và Red Meteonyker không ôn hòa nữa.

dialogsBegin.en: You think you can face the Red Meteonyker? I do not wish such a grim fate on anyone. However... you have survived the horrors of Darkon, so you must be very strong. Maybe I am being too skeptical. There may be some hope after all.
dialogsBegin.ar: You think you can face the Red Meteonyker? I do not wish such a grim fate on anyone. However... you have survived the horrors of Darkon, so you must be very strong. Maybe I am being too skeptical. There may be some hope after all.
dialogsBegin.br: Você acha que pode enfrentar o Meteonyker Vermelho? Não desejo um destino tão sombrio para ninguém. No entanto... você sobreviveu aos horrores de Darkon, então deve ser muito forte. Talvez eu esteja sendo muito cético. Afinal, pode haver alguma esperança.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你认为你可以挑战红龙？我不希望有人承受如此严峻的命运。但是……你在达肯的恐怖地带中存活了下来，所以你一定很强。也许是我多虑了。毕竟这也不是不可能。
dialogsBegin.de: Du glaubst, du kannst Red Meteonyker gegenüberstehen? Ich würde so ein düsteres Schicksal niemanden wünschen. Aber.... Du hast die Gefahren von Darkon überstanden, also musst du sehr stark sein. Vielleicht bin ich ein bisschen zu skeptisch. Vielleicht gibt es doch noch Hoffnung.
dialogsBegin.fi: You think you can face the Red Meteonyker? I do not wish such a grim fate on anyone. However... you have survived the horrors of Darkon, so you must be very strong. Maybe I am being too skeptical. There may be some hope after all.
dialogsBegin.fil: You think you can face the Red Meteonyker? I do not wish such a grim fate on anyone. However... you have survived the horrors of Darkon, so you must be very strong. Maybe I am being too skeptical. There may be some hope after all.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu penses pouvoir faire face au Meteonyker Rouge ? Je ne souhaite un tel destin à personne. Pourtant... Tu as survécu aux horreurs de Darkon, tu dois donc être très fort. Peut-être suis-je trop sceptique... Il y a peut-être de l'espoir après tout.
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu pikir bisa menghadapi Red Meteonyker? Aku tidak berharap nasib buruk seperti itu pada siapa pun. Namun... kamu telah selamat dari kengerian Darkon, jadi kamu pasti sangat kuat. Mungkin saya terlalu skeptis. Mungkin ada beberapa harapan setelah semua.
dialogsBegin.it: You think you can face the Red Meteonyker? I do not wish such a grim fate on anyone. However... you have survived the horrors of Darkon, so you must be very strong. Maybe I am being too skeptical. There may be some hope after all.
dialogsBegin.jp: レッドメテオニカに立ち向かうつもりか？きっと過酷になるに違いない..。しかし、ダーコンに潜む恐怖に打ち勝っているお前は強い。っと...考えすぎか...。私はとっくに希望は捨ててきてるしな。
dialogsBegin.kr: 빨강 메테오니커에 맞설 수 있다고 생각하시나요? 저는 누구에게도 그런 끔찍한 일이 생기길 바라지 않아요. 하지만... 무시무시한 다콘에게서도 살아남았으니, 분명히 강한 분이겠죠. 제가 너무 회의적인 걸지도 모르겠네요. 희망이 있을지도 모르는 일이죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: You think you can face the Red Meteonyker? I do not wish such a grim fate on anyone. However... you have survived the horrors of Darkon, so you must be very strong. Maybe I am being too skeptical. There may be some hope after all.
dialogsBegin.pl: You think you can face the Red Meteonyker? I do not wish such a grim fate on anyone. However... you have survived the horrors of Darkon, so you must be very strong. Maybe I am being too skeptical. There may be some hope after all.
dialogsBegin.ru: You think you can face the Red Meteonyker? I do not wish such a grim fate on anyone. However... you have survived the horrors of Darkon, so you must be very strong. Maybe I am being too skeptical. There may be some hope after all.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Crees que puedes enfrentarte al Meteonyker Rojo? No se lo deseo a nadie. Sin embargo... has sobrevivido a los horrores de Darkon, así que debes ser muy fuerte. Tal vez soy demasiado escéptico. Puede haber algo de esperanza después de todo.
dialogsBegin.sw: You think you can face the Red Meteonyker? I do not wish such a grim fate on anyone. However... you have survived the horrors of Darkon, so you must be very strong. Maybe I am being too skeptical. There may be some hope after all.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณคิดว่าคุณสามารถเผชิญหน้ากับ Red Meteonyker ได้หรือไม่? ฉันไม่ต้องการให้ใครมีชะตากรรมที่เลวร้ายเช่นนี้ อย่างไรก็ตาม... คุณรอดชีวิตจากความน่ากลัวของ Darkon ดังนั้นคุณต้องแข็งแกร่งมาก บางทีฉันอาจจะสงสัยเกินไป อาจจะมีความหวังหลังจากทั้งหมด
dialogsBegin.tw: 你認為你可以面對炙焰飛龍嗎？我不希望任何人遭受如此嚴峻的命運。但是……你在得肯的恐怖中倖存下來，所以你一定很堅強。也許我太懷疑了。畢竟可能還有一些希望。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn nghĩ bạn có thể đối mặt với Red Meteonyker? Tôi không muốn ai phải chịu số phận nghiệt ngã. Tuy nhiên ... bạn đã sống sót sau nỗi kinh hoàng của Darkon, vì vậy bạn hẳn rất mạnh mẽ. Có lẽ tôi đang quá đa nghi. Hi vọng thế.

dialogsBegin.en: Many of us guardians were annihilated when sealing the Red Meteonyker away. Only three of us are left, and each of us holds a piece of the key needed to enter the lair of the Red Meteonyker. You must find them and obtain each piece.
dialogsBegin.ar: Many of us guardians were annihilated when sealing the Red Meteonyker away. Only three of us are left, and each of us holds a piece of the key needed to enter the lair of the Red Meteonyker. You must find them and obtain each piece.
dialogsBegin.br: Muitos de nós, guardiões, foram aniquilados ao selar o Meteonyker Vermelho. Restam apenas três de nós, e cada um de nós tem um pedaço da chave necessária para entrar no covil do Meteonyker Vermelho. Você deve encontrá-los e obter cada parte.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我们中的许多守护者在封印红龙时牺牲了。最后只剩下三个人了，我们每个人都拿着一把进入红龙巢穴所需的钥匙。你必须找齐它们。
dialogsBegin.de: Viele von uns Beschützern wurden vernichtet als wir Red Meteonyker weggesperrt haben. Nur drei von uns sind übrig, und jeder von uns hat einen Teil des Schlüssels zum Betreten des Baus des Red Meteonyker. Du musst sie finden und die Teile holen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Many of us guardians were annihilated when sealing the Red Meteonyker away. Only three of us are left, and each of us holds a piece of the key needed to enter the lair of the Red Meteonyker. You must find them and obtain each piece.
dialogsBegin.fil: Many of us guardians were annihilated when sealing the Red Meteonyker away. Only three of us are left, and each of us holds a piece of the key needed to enter the lair of the Red Meteonyker. You must find them and obtain each piece.
dialogsBegin.fr: La plupart des gardiens ont été annihilés en scellant le Meteonyker Rouge. Il ne reste plus que trois d'entre nous, et nous possédons chacun un morceau de la clé nécessaire pour entrer dans son repaire. Tu dois les trouver et obtenir leurs morceaux de clé.
dialogsBegin.id: Banyak dari kami para penjaga dimusnahkan saat menyegel Red Meteonyker. Hanya kami bertiga yang tersisa, dan masing-masing dari kami memegang sepotong kunci yang dibutuhkan untuk memasuki sarang Red Meteonyker. Kamu harus menemukan mereka dan mendapatkan setiap bagian.
dialogsBegin.it: Many of us guardians were annihilated when sealing the Red Meteonyker away. Only three of us are left, and each of us holds a piece of the key needed to enter the lair of the Red Meteonyker. You must find them and obtain each piece.
dialogsBegin.jp: 守護者たちはレッドメテオニカを封印したときに全滅だ。残っているのは 3人だけだ。まずはカギの手がかりを見つけねばならんな。きっと3人がそれぞれレッドメテオニカの住処に入るための鍵のかけらを持っているはずだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 빨강 메테오니커를 봉인할 때 수호자들이 수도 없이 쓰러졌었죠. 살아남은 건 우리 셋뿐이고, 각자 빨강 메테오니커의 은신처에 들어가는 데 필요한 열쇠 조각을 하나씩 나눠 가졌답니다. 그들을 찾아서 열쇠 조각을 손에 넣어야 해요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Many of us guardians were annihilated when sealing the Red Meteonyker away. Only three of us are left, and each of us holds a piece of the key needed to enter the lair of the Red Meteonyker. You must find them and obtain each piece.
dialogsBegin.pl: Many of us guardians were annihilated when sealing the Red Meteonyker away. Only three of us are left, and each of us holds a piece of the key needed to enter the lair of the Red Meteonyker. You must find them and obtain each piece.
dialogsBegin.ru: Many of us guardians were annihilated when sealing the Red Meteonyker away. Only three of us are left, and each of us holds a piece of the key needed to enter the lair of the Red Meteonyker. You must find them and obtain each piece.
dialogsBegin.sp: Muchos de nosotros, los guardianes, fuimos aniquilados cuando sellamos el Meteonyker Rojo. Solo quedamos tres, y cada uno de nosotros tiene una pieza de la llave necesaria para entrar en la guarida del Meteonyker Rojo. Debes encontrarlos y obtener cada pieza.
dialogsBegin.sw: Many of us guardians were annihilated when sealing the Red Meteonyker away. Only three of us are left, and each of us holds a piece of the key needed to enter the lair of the Red Meteonyker. You must find them and obtain each piece.
dialogsBegin.th: พวกเราผู้พิทักษ์หลายคนถูกทำลายล้างเมื่อผนึก Red Meteonyker ออกไป เหลือพวกเราเพียงสามคน และเราแต่ละคนถือกุญแจที่จำเป็นในการเข้าไปในถ้ำของ Red Meteonyker คุณต้องค้นหาพวกเขาและได้รับแต่ละชิ้น
dialogsBegin.tw: 我們中的許多守護者在封印炙焰飛龍時被殲滅。我們只剩下三個人了，我們每個人都拿著一把進入炙焰飛龍巢穴所需的鑰匙。你必須找到它們並獲得每一件。
dialogsBegin.vi: Nhiều guardian đã bị tiêu diệt khi phong ấn Red Meteonyker. Chỉ còn lại ba người chúng tôi, và mỗi người chúng tôi nắm giữ một mảnh chìa khóa vào hang ổ của Red Meteonyker. Bạn phải tìm chúng và lấy từng mảnh.

dialogsAccept.en: Very well. Here is the first piece of the key. There are threats in this cavern other than the Red Meteonyker. Good luck.
dialogsAccept.ar: Very well. Here is the first piece of the key. There are threats in this cavern other than the Red Meteonyker. Good luck.
dialogsAccept.br: Muito bem. Aqui está a primeira parte da chave. Existem ameaças nesta caverna além do Meteonyker Vermelho. Boa sorte.
dialogsAccept.cns: 很好。这是钥匙的第一部分。除了红龙，这里还有其他威胁。祝你好运。
dialogsAccept.de: Also gut. Hier ist das erste Stück des Schlüssels. In dieser Höhle sind weitere Gefahren. Viel Glück.
dialogsAccept.fi: Very well. Here is the first piece of the key. There are threats in this cavern other than the Red Meteonyker. Good luck.
dialogsAccept.fil: Very well. Here is the first piece of the key. There are threats in this cavern other than the Red Meteonyker. Good luck.
dialogsAccept.fr: Très bien. Voici le premier morceau de la clé. Attention, cette caverne contient bien des dangers, pas seulement le Meteonyker Rouge. Bonne chance.
dialogsAccept.id: Baik. Inilah bagian pertama dari kuncinya. Ada ancaman di gua ini selain Red Meteonyker. Semoga beruntung.
dialogsAccept.it: Very well. Here is the first piece of the key. There are threats in this cavern other than the Red Meteonyker. Good luck.
dialogsAccept.jp: さすがだ。これが鍵の最初の欠片だ。この洞窟にはレッドメテオニカ以外にも恐ろしいモンスターはいる。気を付けてくれ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 좋아요. 여기 열쇠의 첫 번째 조각이에요. 이 동굴에는 빨강 메테오니커 말고도 위협적인 존재들이 많아요. 행운을 빌어요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Very well. Here is the first piece of the key. There are threats in this cavern other than the Red Meteonyker. Good luck.
dialogsAccept.pl: Very well. Here is the first piece of the key. There are threats in this cavern other than the Red Meteonyker. Good luck.
dialogsAccept.ru: Very well. Here is the first piece of the key. There are threats in this cavern other than the Red Meteonyker. Good luck.
dialogsAccept.sp: Muy bien. Aquí está la primera pieza de la llave. Hay otras amenazas en esta caverna aparte del Meteonyker Rojo. Buena suerte.
dialogsAccept.sw: Very well. Here is the first piece of the key. There are threats in this cavern other than the Red Meteonyker. Good luck.
dialogsAccept.th: ดีมาก. นี่คือกุญแจชิ้นแรก มีภัยคุกคามในถ้ำนี้นอกเหนือจาก Red Meteonyker ขอให้โชคดี.
dialogsAccept.tw: 很好。這是鑰匙的第一部分。除了炙焰飛龍，這個洞穴裡還有其他威脅。祝你好運。
dialogsAccept.vi: Rất tốt. Đây là mảnh đầu tiên của chìa khóa. Có những mối đe dọa trong hang động này ngoài Red Meteonyker. Chúc may mắn.

dialogsDecline.en: Wise decision. Stay safe, traveler.
dialogsDecline.ar: Wise decision. Stay safe, traveler.
dialogsDecline.br: Sábia decisão. Fique seguro, viajante.
dialogsDecline.cns: 明智的决定。注意安全，旅行者。
dialogsDecline.de: Weise Entscheidung. Bleib sicher, Reisender.
dialogsDecline.fi: Wise decision. Stay safe, traveler.
dialogsDecline.fil: Wise decision. Stay safe, traveler.
dialogsDecline.fr: C'est une décision sage. Reste en sécurité, voyageur.
dialogsDecline.id: Keputusan yang bijaksana. Jaga diri, traveler.
dialogsDecline.it: Wise decision. Stay safe, traveler.
dialogsDecline.jp: 賢明な決断。旅人よ、安全を保て。
dialogsDecline.kr: 현명한 결정입니다. 몸조심하세요, 여행자님.
dialogsDecline.nl: Wise decision. Stay safe, traveler.
dialogsDecline.pl: Wise decision. Stay safe, traveler.
dialogsDecline.ru: Wise decision. Stay safe, traveler.
dialogsDecline.sp: Sabia decisión. Mantente a salvo, viajero.
dialogsDecline.sw: Wise decision. Stay safe, traveler.
dialogsDecline.th: ตัดสินใจที่ชาญฉลาด. อยู่อย่างปลอดภัยนักเดินทาง
dialogsDecline.tw: 明智的決定，保持安全，旅行者。
dialogsDecline.vi: Quyết định khôn ngoan. Giữ an toàn, du khách.

dialogsComplete.en: Kumah is alive? I see. And I see you have one of the three pieces of the key with you. You must be fearless for wanting to face the Red Meteonyker alone.
dialogsComplete.ar: Kumah is alive? I see. And I see you have one of the three pieces of the key with you. You must be fearless for wanting to face the Red Meteonyker alone.
dialogsComplete.br: Kumah está vivo? Eu vejo. E vejo que você tem uma das três partes da chave com você. Você deve ser destemido por querer enfrentar o Meteonyker Vermelho sozinho(a).
dialogsComplete.cns: 库马还活着？我懂了。我看到你随身带着三把钥匙之一。想要独自面对 Red Meteonyker，你必须无所畏惧。
dialogsComplete.de: Kumah lebt? Ah, okay. Und ich sehe du hast einen der drei Schlüsselstücke dabei. Du musst echt furchlos sein um Red Meteonyker alleine gegenüberzustehen zu wollen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Kumah is alive? I see. And I see you have one of the three pieces of the key with you. You must be fearless for wanting to face the Red Meteonyker alone.
dialogsComplete.fil: Kumah is alive? I see. And I see you have one of the three pieces of the key with you. You must be fearless for wanting to face the Red Meteonyker alone.
dialogsComplete.fr: Kumah est en vie ? Je vois. Et tu possède un des trois morceaux de clé. Tu dois vraiment être sans peur pour vouloir faire face au Meteonyker Rouge.
dialogsComplete.id: Kumah masih hidup? Aku mengerti. Dan melihat kamu memiliki salah satu dari tiga buah kunci itu. Kamu harus berani karena ingin menghadapi Red Meteonyker sendirian.
dialogsComplete.it: Kumah is alive? I see. And I see you have one of the three pieces of the key with you. You must be fearless for wanting to face the Red Meteonyker alone.
dialogsComplete.jp: クマーが生きて..いる？本当か！そうか、そうか。鍵を探しているんだな。ここに欠片が1つある。持って行ってくれ。レッドメテオニカに1人で立ち向かうとは、恐れ入ったぞ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 쿠마가 살아있다고요? 그렇군요. 당신, 열쇠의 세 조각 중 하나를 가지고 있네요. 혼자서 빨강 메테오니커와 맞서겠다니 용기가 대단하시군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Kumah is alive? I see. And I see you have one of the three pieces of the key with you. You must be fearless for wanting to face the Red Meteonyker alone.
dialogsComplete.pl: Kumah is alive? I see. And I see you have one of the three pieces of the key with you. You must be fearless for wanting to face the Red Meteonyker alone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Kumah is alive? I see. And I see you have one of the three pieces of the key with you. You must be fearless for wanting to face the Red Meteonyker alone.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿Kumah está vivo? Ya veo. Y veo que tienes una de las tres piezas de la llave. Debes ser muy intrépido para enfrentarte solo al Meteonyker Rojo.
dialogsComplete.sw: Kumah is alive? I see. And I see you have one of the three pieces of the key with you. You must be fearless for wanting to face the Red Meteonyker alone.
dialogsComplete.th: Kumah ยังมีชีวิตอยู่? เข้าใจแล้ว และฉันเห็นคุณมีกุญแจหนึ่งในสามชิ้นติดตัวไปด้วย คุณต้องกล้าหาญที่จะเผชิญหน้ากับ Red Meteonyker เพียงลำพัง
dialogsComplete.tw: 庫瑪還活著？我懂了。我看到你隨身帶著三把鑰匙之一。想要獨自面對炙焰飛龍，你必須無所畏懼。
dialogsComplete.vi: Kumah còn sống? Tôi biết. Và tôi thấy bạn có một trong ba mảnh chìa khóa. Bạn chắc hẳn không sợ hãi khi muốn đối mặt với Red Meteonyker một mình.

dialogsFail.en: You have not found any guardians yet? That is fine. We will find them eventually.
dialogsFail.ar: You have not found any guardians yet? That is fine. We will find them eventually.
dialogsFail.br: Você ainda não encontrou nenhum guardião? Está bem. Nós os encontraremos eventualmente.
dialogsFail.cns: 还没找到守护者？别灰心。我们一定会找到他们的。
dialogsFail.de: Du hast noch keine Beschützer gefunden? Das ist okay. Wir werden sie schon finden.
dialogsFail.fi: You have not found any guardians yet? That is fine. We will find them eventually.
dialogsFail.fil: You have not found any guardians yet? That is fine. We will find them eventually.
dialogsFail.fr: Tu n'as pas encore trouvé de gardiens ? Ce n'est pas grave. Nous finirons bien par les trouver.
dialogsFail.id: Kamu masih belum menemukan guardian? Tidak apa-apa. Kita akan menemukan mereka pada akhirnya nanti.
dialogsFail.it: You have not found any guardians yet? That is fine. We will find them eventually.
dialogsFail.jp: まだ守護者を見つけていないだと？ここにはおらん。残り2人を探してきてくれ。
dialogsFail.kr: 아직 가디언을 못 찾았나요? 괜찮아요. 언젠가는 찾겠죠.
dialogsFail.nl: You have not found any guardians yet? That is fine. We will find them eventually.
dialogsFail.pl: You have not found any guardians yet? That is fine. We will find them eventually.
dialogsFail.ru: You have not found any guardians yet? That is fine. We will find them eventually.
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Aún no has encontrado a ningún guardián? No te preocupes. Los encontraremos.
dialogsFail.sw: You have not found any guardians yet? That is fine. We will find them eventually.
dialogsFail.th: คุณยังไม่พบผู้พิทักษ์ใด ๆ เลย? นั่นเป็นเรื่องปกติ เราจะพบพวกเขาในที่สุด
dialogsFail.tw: 還沒找到守護者？那也行。我們最終會找到他們。
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn vẫn chưa tìm thấy guardian nào? Tốt thôi, cuối cùng rồi chúng tôi sẽ tìm thấy chúng thôi.

dialogsBegin.en: The higher the level granted for a particular tier (F, E, D, C, B, A or S), the higher the affected character statistic will be. The level granted is always random. Cool huh?
dialogsBegin.ar: The higher the level granted for a particular tier (F, E, D, C, B, A or S), the higher the affected character statistic will be. The level granted is always random. Cool huh?
dialogsBegin.br: Seu Pet é bonitinho, mas você consegue perceber que ele está ficando mais forte? Quanto maior o nível concedido para um grau específico (F, E, D, C, B, A ou S), maior será o atributo do personagem afetado. O nível concedido é sempre aleatório. Legal né?
dialogsBegin.cns: 授予特定等级（F、E、D、C、B、A 或 S）的级别越高，受影响的角色属性点就越高。授予的级别始终是随机的。酷吧？
dialogsBegin.de: Je höher das Level der jeweiligen Klasse (F, E, D, C, B, A oder S), desto höher der Bonus für den Statuswert. Der Level, den das Pet beim Aufwerten auf eine neue Klasse bekommt, ist zufällig. Ziemlich cool, oder?
dialogsBegin.fi: The higher the level granted for a particular tier (F, E, D, C, B, A or S), the higher the affected character statistic will be. The level granted is always random. Cool huh?
dialogsBegin.fil: The higher the level granted for a particular tier (F, E, D, C, B, A or S), the higher the affected character statistic will be. The level granted is always random. Cool huh?
dialogsBegin.fr: Plus le niveau que ton familier obtient à une classe donnée (F, E, D, C, B, A ou S), plus la statistique qu'il augmente sera renforcée. Le niveau obtenu est toujours aléatoire. Pas mal, non ?
dialogsBegin.id: Semakin tinggi level yang diberikan untuk tier tertentu (F, E, D, C, B, A atau S), semakin tinggi statistik karakter yang terpengaruh. Level yang diberikan selalu acak. Keren ya?
dialogsBegin.it: The higher the level granted for a particular tier (F, E, D, C, B, A or S), the higher the affected character statistic will be. The level granted is always random. Cool huh?
dialogsBegin.jp: 可愛いペットですね。でもまだまだって感じかな。ペットが持っている本当の能力を引き出すためには、もっと長い時間を一緒に冒険する必要があります。
dialogsBegin.kr: 특정 등급(F, E, D, C, B, A, S)에 부여된 레벨이 높을수록, 영향을 받는 캐릭터 스탯도 높아집니다. 레벨은 항상 무작위로 부여됩니다. 멋지죠?
dialogsBegin.nl: The higher the level granted for a particular tier (F, E, D, C, B, A or S), the higher the affected character statistic will be. The level granted is always random. Cool huh?
dialogsBegin.pl: The higher the level granted for a particular tier (F, E, D, C, B, A or S), the higher the affected character statistic will be. The level granted is always random. Cool huh?
dialogsBegin.ru: The higher the level granted for a particular tier (F, E, D, C, B, A or S), the higher the affected character statistic will be. The level granted is always random. Cool huh?
dialogsBegin.sp: Cuanto mayor sea el nivel otorgado para un nivel en particular (F, E, D, C, B, A o S), mayor será la estadística añadida. El nivel otorgado es siempre aleatorio. Genial, ¡¿no?!
dialogsBegin.sw: The higher the level granted for a particular tier (F, E, D, C, B, A or S), the higher the affected character statistic will be. The level granted is always random. Cool huh?
dialogsBegin.th: ยิ่งระดับที่ได้รับสูงสำหรับระดับใดระดับหนึ่ง (F, E, D, C, B, A หรือ S) stat ตัวละครที่ได้รับผลกระทบก็จะยิ่งสูงขึ้น เลเวลที่ได้รับจะเป็นแบบสุ่มเสมอ เจ๋งป่ะ?
dialogsBegin.tw: 對特定階級（F、E、D、C、B、A 或 S）而言，獲得的等級越高，提升的角色能力值就越多。獲得的等級完全隨機，很酷吧？
dialogsBegin.vi: Cấp độ được cấp cho một cấp cụ thể (F, E, D, C, B, A hoặc S) càng cao, thì chỉ số nhân vật bị ảnh hưởng sẽ càng cao. Cấp độ được cấp luôn là ngẫu nhiên. Tuyệt không?

dialogsBegin.en: E Tier Pets such as this one have 2 levels available (1 - 2) and you achieved a random level during the last upgrade. Will you see me when your pet reaches 99.99% experience again?
dialogsBegin.ar: E Tier Pets such as this one have 2 levels available (1 - 2) and you achieved a random level during the last upgrade. Will you see me when your pet reaches 99.99% experience again?
dialogsBegin.br: Pets de Grau E como este têm 2 níveis disponíveis (1 - 2) e você alcançou um nível aleatório durante a última promoção. Você deve me visitar novamente quando seu pet atingir 99,99% de experiência novamente, beleza?
dialogsBegin.cns: 像这样的E 级宠物有2个可用级别（1 - 2），您在上次升级期间获得了一个随机级别。当你的宠物再次达到 99.99% 经验时，还会见我吧？
dialogsBegin.de: E-Klasse-Pets, wie deins, können zwei Level haben (1 - 2). Während des Upgrades auf die E-Klasse hat es zufällig eines dieser beiden Levelstufen erhalten. Wirst du mich wieder aufsuchen, wenn dein Pet erneut 99,99% EXP erhalten hat?
dialogsBegin.fi: E Tier Pets such as this one have 2 levels available (1 - 2) and you achieved a random level during the last upgrade. Will you see me when your pet reaches 99.99% experience again?
dialogsBegin.fil: E Tier Pets such as this one have 2 levels available (1 - 2) and you achieved a random level during the last upgrade. Will you see me when your pet reaches 99.99% experience again?
dialogsBegin.fr: Les familiers de classe E comme le tien peuvent avoir le niveau 1 ou 2, et un niveau aléatoire a été choisi pendant la dernière évolution. Reviens me voir quand tu auras à nouveau fait progresser l'expérience de ton familier à 99,99%.
dialogsBegin.id: E Tier Pet seperti ini memiliki 2 level yang tersedia (1 - 2) dan kamu mencapai level acak selama peningkatan terakhir. Maukah kamu menemuiku ketika pet mencapai EXP 99,99% lagi?
dialogsBegin.it: E Tier Pets such as this one have 2 levels available (1 - 2) and you achieved a random level during the last upgrade. Will you see me when your pet reaches 99.99% experience again?
dialogsBegin.jp: ペットと共にマドリガル大陸を探検して来てください。ペットの経験値が100％になったらまた来てください。ペットのレベルをアップさせてあげます。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 펫과 같은 E급 펫에는 2레벨(1~2)이 있어요. 마지막 업그레이드에서 무작위 레벨을 달성하셨네요. 펫 경험치가 99.99%에 도달하면 다시 찾아오시겠어요?
dialogsBegin.nl: E Tier Pets such as this one have 2 levels available (1 - 2) and you achieved a random level during the last upgrade. Will you see me when your pet reaches 99.99% experience again?
dialogsBegin.pl: E Tier Pets such as this one have 2 levels available (1 - 2) and you achieved a random level during the last upgrade. Will you see me when your pet reaches 99.99% experience again?
dialogsBegin.ru: E Tier Pets such as this one have 2 levels available (1 - 2) and you achieved a random level during the last upgrade. Will you see me when your pet reaches 99.99% experience again?
dialogsBegin.sp: Las mascotas de Nivel E tienen 2 niveles disponibles (1 - 2) y alcanzaste un nivel aleatorio durante la última actualización. ¿Me verás cuando tu mascota vuelva a alcanzar el 99,99 % de experiencia?
dialogsBegin.sw: E Tier Pets such as this one have 2 levels available (1 - 2) and you achieved a random level during the last upgrade. Will you see me when your pet reaches 99.99% experience again?
dialogsBegin.th: สัตว์เลี้ยงระดับ E เช่นนี้จะมี 2 ระดับให้เลือก (1 - 2) และคุณได้รับระดับแบบสุ่มระหว่างการอัปเกรดครั้งล่าสุด คุณจะเห็นฉันเมื่อสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณมี EXP ถึง 99.99% อีกครั้งหรือไม่?
dialogsBegin.tw: 像這隻 E 階寵物共有 2 個等級（1 至 2），上次升階時會隨機獲得其中一個。等寵物經驗值再次達到 99.99% 後，還會來找我嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Thú cưng cấp E, chẳng hạn như thú cưng này có sẵn 2 cấp độ (1 - 2) và bạn đã đạt được cấp độ ngẫu nhiên trong lần nâng cấp cuối cùng. Bạn sẽ gặp lại tôi khi thú cưng của bạn đạt 99,99% điểm experience lần nữa chứ?

dialogsAccept.en: Great! I'll see you when you get back. Good luck, and don't forget to feed your pet!
dialogsAccept.ar: Great! I'll see you when you get back. Good luck, and don't forget to feed your pet!
dialogsAccept.br: Excelente! Vejo você quando voltar. Boa sorte e não se esqueça de alimentar seu pet!
dialogsAccept.cns: 很好！期待下次见面。祝你好运，别忘了喂你的宠物！
dialogsAccept.de: Großartig! Wir sehen uns dann, sobald du zurückkehrst. Viel Erfolg, und vergiss nicht, dein Pet zu füttern!
dialogsAccept.fi: Great! I'll see you when you get back. Good luck, and don't forget to feed your pet!
dialogsAccept.fil: Great! I'll see you when you get back. Good luck, and don't forget to feed your pet!
dialogsAccept.fr: La difficulté va en augmentant au fil du temps, mais tu ne regretteras pas tes efforts quand tu verras ton familier évoluer. Prends bien soin de lui !
dialogsAccept.id: Besar! Temui aku saaat kamu kembali. Semoga berhasil, dan jangan lupa memberi makan pet kamu!
dialogsAccept.it: Great! I'll see you when you get back. Good luck, and don't forget to feed your pet!
dialogsAccept.jp: もっともっと多くの時間を一緒に過ごしてください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 좋아요! 돌아오시면 다시 만나죠. 행운을 빌어요, 펫에게 먹이 주는 것 잊지 마세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Great! I'll see you when you get back. Good luck, and don't forget to feed your pet!
dialogsAccept.pl: Great! I'll see you when you get back. Good luck, and don't forget to feed your pet!
dialogsAccept.ru: Great! I'll see you when you get back. Good luck, and don't forget to feed your pet!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Estupendo! Te veré cuando regreses. ¡Buena suerte y no olvides alimentar a tu mascota!
dialogsAccept.sw: Great! I'll see you when you get back. Good luck, and don't forget to feed your pet!
dialogsAccept.th: ยอดเยี่ยม! ฉันจะพบคุณเมื่อคุณกลับมา ขอให้โชคดีและอย่าลืมให้อาหารสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณ!
dialogsAccept.tw: 太棒了！你回來的時候我會見到你的。祝你好運，別忘了餵你的寵物！
dialogsAccept.vi: Tuyệt quá! Tôi sẽ gặp bạn khi bạn trở lại. Chúc may mắn, và đừng quên cho thú cưng của bạn ăn!

dialogsDecline.en: Don't give up now, you're doing such a great job!
dialogsDecline.ar: Don't give up now, you're doing such a great job!
dialogsDecline.br: Não desista agora, você está fazendo um ótimo trabalho!
dialogsDecline.cns: 不要现在放弃，你做得很好！
dialogsDecline.de: Gib jetzt nicht auf. Du machst deine Sache wirklich gut!
dialogsDecline.fi: Don't give up now, you're doing such a great job!
dialogsDecline.fil: Don't give up now, you're doing such a great job!
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu abandonnes déjà ?
dialogsDecline.id: Jangan menyerah sekarang, Kamu melakukan pekerjaan yang hebat!
dialogsDecline.it: Don't give up now, you're doing such a great job!
dialogsDecline.jp: ペットをもっと成長させたくないのですか？
dialogsDecline.kr: 포기하지 마세요! 아주 잘하고 있어요!
dialogsDecline.nl: Don't give up now, you're doing such a great job!
dialogsDecline.pl: Don't give up now, you're doing such a great job!
dialogsDecline.ru: Don't give up now, you're doing such a great job!

dialogsDecline.th: อย่ายอมแพ้ตอนนี้ คุณทำได้ดีมาก!
dialogsDecline.tw: 現在不要放棄，你做得很好！
dialogsDecline.vi: Đừng bỏ cuộc bây giờ, bạn đang rất tuyệt!

dialogsComplete.en: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to D tier now!
dialogsComplete.ar: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to D tier now!
dialogsComplete.br: Vocês dois estão se fortalecendo juntos. Excelente! Agora elevarei o seu Pet para o grau B!
dialogsComplete.cns: 你们两个一起变得越来越强大，看起来你们在这个过程中成为了很好的朋友。很好！我现在就把你的宠物升级到D级！
dialogsComplete.de: Gemeinsam werdet ihr beide immer stärker. Es sieht so aus, als wärt ihr auch ziemlich gute Freunde geworden. Exzellent! Ich werde dein Pet nun zur D Klasse aufwerten!
dialogsComplete.fi: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to D tier now!
dialogsComplete.fil: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to D tier now!
dialogsComplete.fr: Vous deux devenez plus forts ensemble ! Excellent ! Je vais pouvoir faire évoluer ton familier à la classe D.
dialogsComplete.id: Kalian berdua menjadi lebih kuat bersama, dan sepertinya kalian telah menjadi teman yang cukup baik. Bagus sekali! Aku akan mengupgrade pet yang kamu miliki ke tingkat D sekarang!
dialogsComplete.it: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to D tier now!
dialogsComplete.jp: ペットと共にした時間が短くはありませんよね。ペットのレベルをアップさせてあげましょう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 둘은 함께 성장하며 강해지고 있고, 그 과정에서 꽤 좋은 친구가 된 것 같네요. 훌륭해요! 이제 펫을 D급으로 업그레이드해 드릴게요!
dialogsComplete.nl: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to D tier now!
dialogsComplete.pl: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to D tier now!
dialogsComplete.ru: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to D tier now!
dialogsComplete.sp: Ambos se están volviendo más fuertes y parece que se han hecho buenos amigos. ¡Excelente! ¡Actualizaré tu mascota al nivel D!
dialogsComplete.sw: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to D tier now!
dialogsComplete.th: คุณสองคนแข็งแกร่งขึ้นด้วยกัน และดูเหมือนว่าพวกคุณจะกลายเป็นเพื่อนที่ดีต่อกัน ยอดเยี่ยม! ฉันจะอัพเกรดสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณเป็นระดับ D ทันที!
dialogsComplete.tw: 你們兩個一起變得越來越強大，看起來你們在這個過程中成為了很好的朋友。出色的！我現在就把你的寵物升級到 D 級！
dialogsComplete.vi: Hai bạn đang mạnh mẽ hơn cùng với nhau, và có vẻ như các bạn đã trở thành bạn tốt trong quá trình này. Xuất sắc! Tôi sẽ nâng cấp thú cưng của bạn lên cấp D ngay bây giờ!

dialogsFail.ar: Stop back by when your pet reaches 99.99% experience.

dialogsFail.cns: 当您的宠物达到 99.99% 的经验值时再回来。
dialogsFail.de: Schau wieder vorbei, sobald dein Pet 99,99% EXP erreicht hat.
dialogsFail.fi: Stop back by when your pet reaches 99.99% experience.
dialogsFail.fil: Stop back by when your pet reaches 99.99% experience.

dialogsFail.it: Stop back by when your pet reaches 99.99% experience.

dialogsFail.kr: 펫의 경험치가 99.99%에 도달하면 제게 들르세요.
