description.en: There are ancient altars on each continent. Please bring me 5 rocks from each contient.
description.ar: There are ancient altars on each continent. Please bring me 5 rocks from each contient.
description.br: Há altares antigos em cada continente. Traga 5 pedras de cada continente.
description.cns: 3个大陆里，有古代的祭团。请帮我到各大陆的祭团，找5个岩石回来。
description.de: Es gibt auf jedem Kontinent einen Altar. Bring mir von jedem Altar 5 Steine. 5 aus Flaris, 5 aus Darkon und 5 aus Saint Morning.
description.fi: There are ancient altars on each continent. Please bring me 5 rocks from each contient.
description.fil: There are ancient altars on each continent. Please bring me 5 rocks from each contient.
description.fr: Collecter 5 Pierres de Flaris, 5 Pierres de Saint Morning, et 5 Pierres de Darkon, près des Autels Pourpres de chaque continent.
description.id: Ada altar kuno di setiap benua. Tolong bawakan Aku 5 batu dari setiap benua.
description.it: There are ancient altars on each continent. Please bring me 5 rocks from each contient.
description.jp: フラリス、ダーコン、セイントモーニングの3大陸に散らばる＜岩石の欠片＞を各5個づつ集めてこよう。それらは祭壇と呼ばれる場所の近くで見つかるそうだ。
description.kr: 각 대륙에는 고대 제단이 있어요. 각 제단의 돌을 5개씩 가져와 주세요.
description.nl: There are ancient altars on each continent. Please bring me 5 rocks from each contient.
description.pl: There are ancient altars on each continent. Please bring me 5 rocks from each contient.
description.ru: На каждом острове есть древний алтарь. Нужно собрать камни рядом с алтарями и принести их Мартинике.
description.sp: Hay altares antiguos en cada continente. Tráeme 5 rocas de cada continente por favor.
description.sw: There are ancient altars on each continent. Please bring me 5 rocks from each contient.
description.th: มีแท่นบูชาโบราณในแต่ละเมือง โปรดนำหิน 5 ก้อนจากแต่ละเมืองมาให้ข้าด้วย
description.tw: 3 個大陸裡，有古代的祭團。請幫我到各大陸的祭團，找 5 個岩石回來。
description.vi: Có những bàn thờ cổ ở mỗi lục địa. Hãy mang cho tôi 5 tảng đá từ mỗi lục địa.

dialogsBegin.en: Thank you very much for your help! I received plenty of money to study history thanks to you. Listen, it looks like all of the data about Madrigal is distorted.
dialogsBegin.ar: Thank you very much for your help! I received plenty of money to study history thanks to you. Listen, it looks like all of the data about Madrigal is distorted.
dialogsBegin.br: Muito obrigada por sua ajuda! Recebi muito dinheiro para estudar História graças a você. Olha, parece que todos os dados sobre Madrigal são distorcidos, mas parece que ninguém sabe.
dialogsBegin.cns: 研究费用已经收到了!我发现一个很可疑的事情耶..我跟你说喔..关于瑞加大陆的历史纪录，好像不太对耶..
dialogsBegin.de: Vielen vielen Dank für deine Hilfe! Dank dir habe ich die Studiengebühren erstattet bekommen. In Wirklichkeit gibt es aber ein Problem. Alle Daten zur Geschichte Madrigals wurden durcheinander gebracht.
dialogsBegin.fi: Thank you very much for your help! I received plenty of money to study history thanks to you. Listen, it looks like all of the data about Madrigal is distorted.
dialogsBegin.fil: Thank you very much for your help! I received plenty of money to study history thanks to you. Listen, it looks like all of the data about Madrigal is distorted.
dialogsBegin.fr: Parfait, je peux donc poursuivre mes recherches ! (chuchotant, en surveillant aux alentours) En fait... j'ai découvert que toutes les informations au sujet de l'histoire de Madrigal sont fausses !
dialogsBegin.id: Terima kasih banyak atas bantuanmu! Karenamu, aku sekarang memiliki cukup uang untuk melanjutkan study tentang sejarah. Omong-omong, sepertinya banyak sejarah tentang Madrigal yang terdistorsi.
dialogsBegin.it: Thank you very much for your help! I received plenty of money to study history thanks to you. Listen, it looks like all of the data about Madrigal is distorted.
dialogsBegin.jp: 研究費はちゃんといただきました、ありがとう。これで安心して研究が進められます。あの…まだ、誰にも話してないことですが…ええ、信じてくださらない方もいるでしょうけど…。実は、今のマドリガルの歴史に関する資料は、全て歪曲されているのです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 정말 고마워요! 당신 덕분에 역사 연구 자금을 충분히 확보했네요. 음, 그런데... 마드리갈의 역사 자료가 모두 왜곡된 것 같아요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Thank you very much for your help! I received plenty of money to study history thanks to you. Listen, it looks like all of the data about Madrigal is distorted.
dialogsBegin.pl: Thank you very much for your help! I received plenty of money to study history thanks to you. Listen, it looks like all of the data about Madrigal is distorted.
dialogsBegin.ru: Еще раз спасибо! Теперь у меня есть деньги, чтобы начать исследования. Хочешь, расскажу о них?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Muchas gracias por tu ayuda! He recibido mucho dinero para poderme dedicar a estudiar historia gracias a ti. Escucha, parece que todos los datos sobre Madrigal están distorsionados.
dialogsBegin.sw: Thank you very much for your help! I received plenty of money to study history thanks to you. Listen, it looks like all of the data about Madrigal is distorted.
dialogsBegin.th: ขอบคุณมากสำหรับความช่วยเหลือของคุณ! ฉันได้รับเงินมากมายเพื่อศึกษาประวัติศาสตร์เพราะคุณช่วย ฟังนะ ดูเหมือนว่าข้อมูลทั้งหมดเกี่ยวกับ Madrigal จะผิดเพี้ยนไป
dialogsBegin.tw: 研究費用已經收到了！我發現一個很可疑的事情耶…我跟你說喔…關於瑪德利賈的歷史紀錄，好像不太對耶…
dialogsBegin.vi: Cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều vì đã giúp đỡ của bạn! Tôi đã nhận được rất nhiều tiền để học lịch sử nhờ bạn. Nghe này, có vẻ như tất cả dữ liệu về Madrigal đều bị bóp méo.

dialogsBegin.en: I have been studying Madrigal history apart from the History Society and it seems that they do not want to correct the distorted history in these books.
dialogsBegin.ar: I have been studying Madrigal history apart from the History Society and it seems that they do not want to correct the distorted history in these books.
dialogsBegin.br: Tenho estudado a história de Madrigal separado da Sociedade Histórica e parece que eles não querem corrigir a história distorcida nesses livros.
dialogsBegin.cns: 有很多可疑的地方呢..不知道为什么历史协会的人知道此事实也不会想去修改..所以我就自己调查了一下喔~
dialogsBegin.de: Ich bin sehr skeptisch. Ich bezweifle, dass die Gesellschaft für Geschichte diesen Fehler beheben wird, obwohl sie davon wissen. Aus diesem Grund habe ich es selbst überprüft.
dialogsBegin.fi: I have been studying Madrigal history apart from the History Society and it seems that they do not want to correct the distorted history in these books.
dialogsBegin.fil: I have been studying Madrigal history apart from the History Society and it seems that they do not want to correct the distorted history in these books.
dialogsBegin.fr: Parfait, je peux donc poursuivre mes recherches ! (chuchotant, en surveillant aux alentours) En fait... j'ai découvert que toutes les informations au sujet de l'histoire de Madrigal sont fausses !
dialogsBegin.id: Aku telah mempelajari sejarah Madrigal selain dari History Society dan tampaknya mereka tidak ingin mengoreksi sejarah yang terdistorsi dalam buku-buku ini.
dialogsBegin.it: I have been studying Madrigal history apart from the History Society and it seems that they do not want to correct the distorted history in these books.
dialogsBegin.jp: マドリガルの歴史を詳しく調べると、おかしなところがたくさんあるんです。でも、マドリガル歴史協会は矛盾点を知っているにも関わらず、修正しようとしないのです。私はそれが何だか気になって…それで一人でいろいろ調べてみたのです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 전 역사학회와 별개로 마드리갈의 역사를 조사하고 있어요. 그런데 역사학회는 왜곡된 기록을 고치려 하지 않더군요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I have been studying Madrigal history apart from the History Society and it seems that they do not want to correct the distorted history in these books.
dialogsBegin.pl: I have been studying Madrigal history apart from the History Society and it seems that they do not want to correct the distorted history in these books.
dialogsBegin.ru: В учебниках истории очень много недомолвок и белых пятен. Готова спорить, наши академики нарочно замалчивают правду!
dialogsBegin.sp: He estado estudiando la historia de Madrigal por separado de los que están en la Sociedad de Historia y parece que no quieren corregir la historia distorsionada de estos libros.
dialogsBegin.sw: I have been studying Madrigal history apart from the History Society and it seems that they do not want to correct the distorted history in these books.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันได้ศึกษาประวัติศาสตร์ Madrigal นอกเหนือจากสมาคมประวัติศาสตร์ และดูเหมือนว่าพวกเขาไม่ต้องการแก้ไขประวัติศาสตร์ที่บิดเบี้ยวในหนังสือเหล่านี้
dialogsBegin.tw: 有很多可疑的地方呢…不知道爲什麼歷史協會的人知道此事實也不會想去修改…所以我就自己調查了一下喔~
dialogsBegin.vi: I have been studying Madrigal history apart from the History Society and it seems that they do not want to correct the distorted history in these books.

dialogsBegin.en: The other day I was almost killed by renegade Blades but I cannot stop now. No matter what the History Society wants.
dialogsBegin.ar: The other day I was almost killed by renegade Blades but I cannot stop now. No matter what the History Society wants.
dialogsBegin.br: Outro dia, quase fui morta por Blades Renegados, mas não posso parar agora. Não importa o que a Sociedade Histórica quer.
dialogsBegin.cns: 有一天，我差一点被杀了呢~~那时候我才知道，历史协会的人为什么不去修改了。可是，我绝对不会在这里放弃。
dialogsBegin.de: An einem anderen Tag wurde ich beinahe getötet. Im späteren Verlauf habe ich herausgefunden, warum die Gesellschaft für Geschichte den Fehler nicht beheben will.
dialogsBegin.fi: The other day I was almost killed by renegade Blades but I cannot stop now. No matter what the History Society wants.
dialogsBegin.fil: The other day I was almost killed by renegade Blades but I cannot stop now. No matter what the History Society wants.
dialogsBegin.fr: L'autre jour j'ai presque été tuée par des assassins, j'ai alors réalisé la raison pour laquelle la Société d'Histoire ne veux pas poursuivre ses recherches… mais je n'abandonnerai jamais !
dialogsBegin.id: Pernah suatu hari aku hampir dibunuh oleh pemberontak Blades. Tapi aku tidak bisa berhenti sekarang. Tidak peduli apa yang diinginkan oleh History Society.
dialogsBegin.it: The other day I was almost killed by renegade Blades but I cannot stop now. No matter what the History Society wants.
dialogsBegin.jp: 調査を始めて少し経った頃でしょうか…恐ろしいことに、ある日私は何者かによって命を狙われそうになりました。何となくそれが、私の調べている歴史の事に関係しているような気がしてならないのです。何か私の知らない大きな力が動いているような…
dialogsBegin.kr: 심지어 얼마 전엔 암살자 블레이드에게 죽임당할 뻔했죠. 그래도 멈출 수 없어요. 역사학회가 뭐라고 하든지.
dialogsBegin.nl: The other day I was almost killed by renegade Blades but I cannot stop now. No matter what the History Society wants.
dialogsBegin.pl: The other day I was almost killed by renegade Blades but I cannot stop now. No matter what the History Society wants.
dialogsBegin.ru: Подозреваю, это они подослали ко мне Черных Фехтовальщиков - как я только ноги унесла! Но им не заставить меня прекратить исследования.
dialogsBegin.sp: El otro día casi me matan unos Blades renegados, pero no puedo parar ahora. No importa lo que quiera la Sociedad de Historia.
dialogsBegin.sw: The other day I was almost killed by renegade Blades but I cannot stop now. No matter what the History Society wants.
dialogsBegin.th: เมื่อวันก่อนฉันเกือบถูก Blades คนทรยศฆ่า แต่ตอนนี้ฉันไม่สามารถหยุดได้ ไม่ว่าสมาคมประวัติศาสตร์ต้องการอะไร
dialogsBegin.tw: 有一天，我差一點被殺了呢~~那時候我才知道，歷史協會的人為什麼不去修改了。可是，我絕對不會在這裡放棄。
dialogsBegin.vi: Hôm trước tôi đã suýt bị giết bởi Blades phản bội nhưng tôi không thể dừng lại bây giờ. Không cần biết Hội Sử học muốn gì.

dialogsBegin.en: I will find out the true history of Madrigal, I have to. Would you please help me? The danger for you could be great however.
dialogsBegin.ar: I will find out the true history of Madrigal, I have to. Would you please help me? The danger for you could be great however.

dialogsBegin.jp: I will find out the true history of Madrigal, I have to. Would you please help me? The danger for you could be great however.
dialogsBegin.kr: 전 마드리갈의 진짜 역사를 반드시 밝혀낼 거예요. 도와주실 수 있나요? 정말 위험한 일이 되긴 하겠지만.
dialogsBegin.nl: I will find out the true history of Madrigal, I have to. Would you please help me? The danger for you could be great however.
dialogsBegin.pl: I will find out the true history of Madrigal, I have to. Would you please help me? The danger for you could be great however.

dialogsBegin.th: I will find out the true history of Madrigal, I have to. Would you please help me? The danger for you could be great however.
dialogsBegin.tw: 我一定要查出瑪德利賈真正的歷史。你願意幫我嗎？不過，這件事對你來說可能也很危險。
dialogsBegin.vi: I will find out the true history of Madrigal, I have to. Would you please help me? The danger for you could be great however.

dialogsBegin.en: Will you help me regardless of the danger?
dialogsBegin.ar: Will you help me regardless of the danger?
dialogsBegin.br: Você me ajudaria, independentemente do perigo?
dialogsBegin.cns: 这样你也会为了正义来帮我吗?
dialogsBegin.de: Bist du bereit, dieses Risiko für mich einzugehen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Will you help me regardless of the danger?
dialogsBegin.fil: Will you help me regardless of the danger?
dialogsBegin.fr: S'il te plaît, peux-tu m'aider ? Sois prêt à encourir de grands dangers cependant…
dialogsBegin.id: Maukah kamu membantuku terlepas dari bahayanya?
dialogsBegin.it: Will you help me regardless of the danger?
dialogsBegin.jp: マドリガルの真実を知るため、そして正義のために。どうかお願いします。
dialogsBegin.kr: 위험하긴 하지만, 혹시 도와주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Will you help me regardless of the danger?
dialogsBegin.pl: Will you help me regardless of the danger?
dialogsBegin.ru: Ты даже можешь погибнуть… Но это тебя не пугает, правда?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Me ayudarás sin importar el peligro?
dialogsBegin.sw: Will you help me regardless of the danger?
dialogsBegin.th: คุณจะช่วยฉันโดยไม่คำนึงถึงอันตรายหรือไม่?
dialogsBegin.tw: 這樣你也會爲了正義來幫我嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn sẽ giúp tôi bất chấp nguy hiểm chứ?

dialogsAccept.en: I knew you would! First, bring me 5 rocks from each of the 3 inhabited continents. Each continent has an Altar, bring me the rocks from each of these.
dialogsAccept.ar: I knew you would! First, bring me 5 rocks from each of the 3 inhabited continents. Each continent has an Altar, bring me the rocks from each of these.
dialogsAccept.br: Eu sabia que você aceitaria! Primeiro, traga 5 pedras de cada um dos 3 continentes habitados. Cada um tem um Altar. Traga as pedras de cada altar.
dialogsAccept.cns: 果然，我没有看错人。首先3个大陆里，有古代的祭团。请帮我到各大陆的祭团，找5个岩石回来。
dialogsAccept.de: Ich wusste, dass du mir helfen würdest. Bitte besuche die 3 Altäre von Violet. Auf jedem Kontinent ist einer der Altäre versteckt. Bringe mir von jedem Altar 5 Steine.
dialogsAccept.fi: I knew you would! First, bring me 5 rocks from each of the 3 inhabited continents. Each continent has an Altar, bring me the rocks from each of these.
dialogsAccept.fil: I knew you would! First, bring me 5 rocks from each of the 3 inhabited continents. Each continent has an Altar, bring me the rocks from each of these.
dialogsAccept.fr: Merci !! Alors tout d'abord il me faut des pierres spéciales que l'on trouve sur chaque continent. Tu les trouveras près des Autels Pourpres des trois îles et il m'en faut 5 de chaque.
dialogsAccept.id: Aku tahu kamu pasti mau! Pertama, bawakan aku 5 batu dari masing-masing 3 benua. Setiap benua memiliki Altar, bawakan aku batu dari masing-masingnya.
dialogsAccept.it: I knew you would! First, bring me 5 rocks from each of the 3 inhabited continents. Each continent has an Altar, bring me the rocks from each of these.
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとうございます、とても心強いです。さて、マドリガルに存在する３つの大陸には古代のものと思われる、奇妙で神秘的な祭壇があります。そこにある＜岩石の欠片＞を5個づつ集めてきてくれませんか？それぞれの大陸ごとに、5個づつです。宜しくお願いしますね。
dialogsAccept.kr: 역시 도와주실 줄 알았어요! 먼저, 세 대륙의 각 제단에서 돌을 5개씩 가져와 주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: I knew you would! First, bring me 5 rocks from each of the 3 inhabited continents. Each continent has an Altar, bring me the rocks from each of these.
dialogsAccept.pl: I knew you would! First, bring me 5 rocks from each of the 3 inhabited continents. Each continent has an Altar, bring me the rocks from each of these.
dialogsAccept.ru: Я так и знала! Принеси мне по пять камней с каждого из трех основных островов. Ищи их у алтарей.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Sabía que lo harías! Para empezar, tráeme 5 rocas de cada uno de los 3 continentes habitados. Cada continente tiene un Altar, tráeme las rocas que hay en cada uno de estos.
dialogsAccept.sw: I knew you would! First, bring me 5 rocks from each of the 3 inhabited continents. Each continent has an Altar, bring me the rocks from each of these.
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันรู้ว่าคุณจะทำ! ขั้นแรก นำหิน 5 ก้อนมาให้ฉันจากแต่ละทวีปที่มีผู้คนอาศัยอยู่ 3 แห่ง แต่ละทวีปมีแท่นบูชา นำหินจากแต่ละแห่งมาให้ฉัน
dialogsAccept.tw: 果然，我沒有看錯人。首先 3 個大陸裡，有古代的祭團。請幫我到各大陸的祭團，找 5 個岩石回來。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi biết bạn sẽ làm! Đầu tiên, hãy mang cho tôi 5 tảng đá từ mỗi lục địa trong số 3 lục địa có người sinh sống. Mỗi lục địa có một Altar, hãy mang cho tôi những tảng đá từ mỗi lục địa này.

dialogsDecline.en: Thanks for listening to me anyway. I understand if you are unwilling to risk your life.
dialogsDecline.ar: Thanks for listening to me anyway. I understand if you are unwilling to risk your life.
dialogsDecline.br: Obrigada por me ouvir. Entendo que você não queira arriscar sua vida.
dialogsDecline.cns: 嗯..你觉得不值得为这种事情牺牲生命啊..那就没办法了~我去找其他人来帮我好了!
dialogsDecline.de: Wenn du nicht dein Leben riskieren möchtest, will ich dich nicht zwingen. Danke, dass du mir zugehört hast.
dialogsDecline.fi: Thanks for listening to me anyway. I understand if you are unwilling to risk your life.
dialogsDecline.fil: Thanks for listening to me anyway. I understand if you are unwilling to risk your life.
dialogsDecline.fr: Si tu penses que ça ne vaut pas le coup de risquer ta vie, je ne te blâmerais pas. Merci m'avoir écoutée néanmoins.
dialogsDecline.id: Terima kasih telah mendengarkanku. Aku paham jika kamu tidak ingin membahayakan nyawamu.
dialogsDecline.it: Thanks for listening to me anyway. I understand if you are unwilling to risk your life.
dialogsDecline.jp: そうですか。命をかけるほどの問題ではない、ということですね？ご理解いただけないのは仕方ないです。話だけでも聞いてくれてありがとう。
dialogsDecline.kr: 이야기를 들어주셔서 고마워요. 목숨을 걸고 도와달라는 건 좀 무리한 부탁이겠네요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Thanks for listening to me anyway. I understand if you are unwilling to risk your life.
dialogsDecline.pl: Thanks for listening to me anyway. I understand if you are unwilling to risk your life.
dialogsDecline.ru: Понимаю, тебя пугает риск… Ну что ж, я хотя бы высказала все, что на душе накипело.
dialogsDecline.sp: Gracias por escucharme de todos modos. Entiendo que no estés dispuesto a arriesgar tu vida.
dialogsDecline.sw: Thanks for listening to me anyway. I understand if you are unwilling to risk your life.
dialogsDecline.th: ขอบคุณที่รับฟังฉัน ฉันเข้าใจถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจที่จะเสี่ยงชีวิตของคุณ
dialogsDecline.tw: 嗯…你覺得不值得爲這種事情犧牲生命啊…那就沒辦法囉~我去找其他人來幫我好了！
dialogsDecline.vi: Cảm ơn vì đã lắng nghe tôi. Tôi hiểu nếu bạn không muốn mạo hiểm mạng sống của mình.

dialogsComplete.en: Hmm... This is exactly what I expected. I will study these some more but before you go please...
dialogsComplete.ar: Hmm... This is exactly what I expected. I will study these some more but before you go please...
dialogsComplete.br: Hmm... É exatamente o que eu esperava. Estudarei um pouco mais. Mas antes de ir, saiba que...

dialogsComplete.de: Das ist genau das, was ich erwartet habe. Ich werde das noch weiter studieren, aber bevor du gehst, bitte...

dialogsComplete.fil: Hmm... This is exactly what I expected. I will study these some more but before you go please...
dialogsComplete.fr: (observant les pierres) Hmm… c'est exactement ce que je pensais. Bien, il faut que je poursuive mes recherches… Merci en tout cas !
dialogsComplete.id: Hmm.. Aku sudah menduga ini. Akan coba kupelajari ini lagi, tapi sebelum kamu pergi tolong..
dialogsComplete.it: Hmm... This is exactly what I expected. I will study these some more but before you go please...
dialogsComplete.jp: なるほど。やはり私の考えと一致しているようです。もっと多くの調査を行わないと、詳しいことはわかりませんが…。どうもありがとうございます。あ！それと…
dialogsComplete.kr: 흠... 제가 예상했던 대로군요. 이걸 좀 더 연구해 볼게요. 그렇지만 가시기 전에...
dialogsComplete.nl: Hmm... This is exactly what I expected. I will study these some more but before you go please...
dialogsComplete.pl: Hmm... This is exactly what I expected. I will study these some more but before you go please...
dialogsComplete.ru: Hmm... This is exactly what I expected. I will study these some more but before you go please...
dialogsComplete.sp: Hmm... Esto es exactamente lo que esperaba. Las estudiaré más, pero antes de que te vayas, por favor...
dialogsComplete.sw: Hmm... This is exactly what I expected. I will study these some more but before you go please...
dialogsComplete.th: อืม... เป็นตามที่ฉันคาดไว้ ฉันอยากจะศึกษามันเพิ่มเติม แต่ก่อนที่คุณจะไป ได้โปรด...
dialogsComplete.tw: 嗯……果然和我想的一樣。我得再研究一下，不過在你走之前……
dialogsComplete.vi: Hmm .. Đây chính xác là những gì tôi mong đợi. Tôi sẽ tìm hiểu thêm về chuyện này nhưng trước khi bạn đi thì xin hãy...

dialogsComplete.en: ...you should be very, very careful. I am almost sure that the assassins that tried to kill me will come after you.
dialogsComplete.ar: ...you should be very, very careful. I am almost sure that the assassins that tried to kill me will come after you.
dialogsComplete.br: ...você deve tomar muito cuidado. Tenho quase certeza de que os assassinos que tentaram me matar irão atrás de você.
dialogsComplete.cns: ...you should be very, very careful. I am almost sure that the assassins that tried to kill me will come after you.
dialogsComplete.de: ...du solltest sehr, sehr vorsichtig sein. Ich bin mir fast sicher, dass die Attentäter, die versucht haben, mich zu töten, hinter euch her sein werden.
dialogsComplete.fi: ...you should be very, very careful. I am almost sure that the assassins that tried to kill me will come after you.
dialogsComplete.fil: ...you should be very, very careful. I am almost sure that the assassins that tried to kill me will come after you.
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh, attends... (silence bref) Maintenant tu dois faire très, très attention. Je crains que les assassins à qui j'ai eu affaire s'en prennent à toi...
dialogsComplete.id: ..kamu harus sangat, sangat berhati-hati. Aku sangat yakin assassin yang mencoba membunuhku akan datang padamu juga.
dialogsComplete.it: ...you should be very, very careful. I am almost sure that the assassins that tried to kill me will come after you.
dialogsComplete.jp: これからは気をつけてください。何をって？私を狙っていた暗殺者が今度はあなたを狙うかもしれませんから。あなたのような強い人なら、心配するようなことはないかもしれませんが。どうぞ、お気をつけて。
dialogsComplete.kr: ...정말, 정말 조심해야 해요. 절 죽이려던 암살자들이 당신을 노릴 게 분명해요.
dialogsComplete.nl: ...you should be very, very careful. I am almost sure that the assassins that tried to kill me will come after you.
dialogsComplete.pl: ...you should be very, very careful. I am almost sure that the assassins that tried to kill me will come after you.
dialogsComplete.ru: ...you should be very, very careful. I am almost sure that the assassins that tried to kill me will come after you.
dialogsComplete.sp: ...debes tener mucho, mucho cuidado. Estoy segura de que los asesinos que intentaron matarme irán a por ti.
dialogsComplete.sw: ...you should be very, very careful. I am almost sure that the assassins that tried to kill me will come after you.
dialogsComplete.th: คุณควรระวังให้มาก ฉันแน่ใจว่ามีนักฆ่าที่พยายามจะฆ่าฉัน และคุณคือรายถัดไป
dialogsComplete.tw: ……你一定要非常、非常小心。我幾乎可以肯定，那些之前想殺我的刺客也會盯上你。
dialogsComplete.vi: ...bạn phải thật sự cẩn thận đấy. Tôi khá chắc rồi bạn cũng sẽ vào tầm ngắm của bọn sát thủ từng cố gắng ám sát tôi thôi.

description.en: Hunt 60 Captain Glaphans, acquire the Angelic Stone, then take it to Capafe for transmutation.

description.de: Jage 60 Captain Glaphans, erhalte den Angelic Stone und bringe ihn zur Umwandlung zu Capafe.
description.fi: Hunt 60 Captain Glaphans, acquire the Angelic Stone, then take it to Capafe for transmutation.

dialogsBegin.en: Oh! Of course! It was an Angelic Stone that we require to complete the transmutation!
dialogsBegin.ar: Oh! Of course! It was an Angelic Stone that we require to complete the transmutation!
dialogsBegin.br: Oh! Claro! É uma Pedra Angelical que precisamos para completar a transmutação!
dialogsBegin.cns: 哦！当然！天使之石是我们完成突破所必需的物品！
dialogsBegin.de: Oh, natürlich! Es war ein Angelic Stone, den wir brauchen, um die Verwandlung zu vollenden!
dialogsBegin.fi: Oh! Of course! It was an Angelic Stone that we require to complete the transmutation!
dialogsBegin.fil: Oh! Of course! It was an Angelic Stone that we require to complete the transmutation!
dialogsBegin.fr: Milles excuses je suis vraiment tête en l'air parfois !
dialogsBegin.id: Oh! Tentu saja! Itu adalah Angelic Stone yang kita butuhkan untuk menyelesaikan transmutasi!
dialogsBegin.it: Oh! Of course! It was an Angelic Stone that we require to complete the transmutation!
dialogsBegin.jp: あ……すみません。確かにカペーペ様の言う通り、気力の源のことをすっかりと忘れておりました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 아! 깜빡하고 있었네요! 변환을 완료하려면 천사의 돌이 필요하답니다!
dialogsBegin.nl: Oh! Of course! It was an Angelic Stone that we require to complete the transmutation!
dialogsBegin.pl: Oh! Of course! It was an Angelic Stone that we require to complete the transmutation!
dialogsBegin.ru: Oh! Of course! It was an Angelic Stone that we require to complete the transmutation!

dialogsBegin.sw: Oh! Of course! It was an Angelic Stone that we require to complete the transmutation!
dialogsBegin.th: โอ้วว ! แน่นอน! มันเป็นหิน Angelic ที่เราต้องการเพื่อใช้ในการแปลงร่าง!
dialogsBegin.tw: 啊！對了！要完成轉化，還需要天堂之石！
dialogsBegin.vi: Ồ! Tất nhiên! Đó là một Viên đá Angelic Stone mà chúng tôi yêu cầu để hoàn thành quá trình biến đổi!

dialogsBegin.ar: You can find Angelic Stones in Southern Darkon 3 near the Captain Glaphans. Will you please defeat them and acquire the stone?

dialogsBegin.it: You can find Angelic Stones in Southern Darkon 3 near the Captain Glaphans. Will you please defeat them and acquire the stone?
dialogsBegin.jp: 気力の源はキャプテン・グラファンが生息している地域で見つけられると思います。キャプテン・グラファンを倒すことで気が満ちるとか。
dialogsBegin.kr: 천사의 돌은 남부 다콘 제3지구의 두목 글라판들의 서식지 근처에서 찾을 수 있을 겁니다. 녀석들을 처치하고 돌을 되찾아 주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: You can find Angelic Stones in Southern Darkon 3 near the Captain Glaphans. Will you please defeat them and acquire the stone?

dialogsBegin.sw: You can find Angelic Stones in Southern Darkon 3 near the Captain Glaphans. Will you please defeat them and acquire the stone?
dialogsBegin.th: คุณสามารถหาหิน Angelic ใน Southern Darkon 3 ใกล้ๆ กับ Captain Glaphans คุณจะช่วยได้ไหม
dialogsBegin.tw: 得肯第三區南部的魔巫皮皮附近可以找到天堂之石。可以擊敗牠們並取得石頭嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có thể tìm thấy Angelic Stone trong Southern Darkon 3 gần Captain Glaphans. Bạn có thể đánh bại chúng và lấy được viên đá không?

dialogsAccept.en: Good! Please defeat 60 Captain Glaphan and acquire the Angelic Stone. Once the stone is in your possession, return to Capafe!
dialogsAccept.ar: Good! Please defeat 60 Captain Glaphan and acquire the Angelic Stone. Once the stone is in your possession, return to Capafe!
dialogsAccept.br: Boa! Por favor, derrote 60 Glaphans Capitães e adquira a Pedra Angelical. Assim que a pedra estiver em sua posse, volte para Capafe!
dialogsAccept.cns: 不错！请击杀60个变异食人鱼并获取天使之石。一旦你拿到了这块石头，返回卡帕菲处！
dialogsAccept.de: Gut! Bitte besiege 60 Captain Glaphan und erhalte den Angelic Stone. Sobald der Stein in deinem Besitz ist, kehre zu Capafe zurück!
dialogsAccept.fi: Good! Please defeat 60 Captain Glaphan and acquire the Angelic Stone. Once the stone is in your possession, return to Capafe!
dialogsAccept.fil: Good! Please defeat 60 Captain Glaphan and acquire the Angelic Stone. Once the stone is in your possession, return to Capafe!

dialogsAccept.sw: Good! Please defeat 60 Captain Glaphan and acquire the Angelic Stone. Once the stone is in your possession, return to Capafe!
dialogsAccept.th: เยี่ยม! ช่วยกำจัด Captain Glaphan จำนวน 60 ตัว และจะได้รับหิน Angelic เมื่อคุณได้รับหิิน ให้คุณกลับไปหา Capafe!
dialogsAccept.tw: 很好！請擊敗 60 隻魔巫皮皮並取得天堂之石，拿到後就回去找卡班沛！
dialogsAccept.vi: Tốt! Hãy đánh bại 60 Captain Glaphan và lấy được Viên đá Angelic Stone. Khi viên đá đã thuộc quyền sở hữu của bạn, hãy quay trở lại Capafe!

description.cns: 完成二转任务后与里奥多斯相见。
description.de: Schließen Sie den 2. Jobtransfer ab und treffen Sie sich dann mit Reodos.
description.fi: Complete the 2nd job transfer then meet with Reodos.
description.fil: Complete the 2nd job transfer then meet with Reodos.
description.fr: Retournez parler à Reodos après votre second changement de classe.
description.id: Selesaikan 2nd job transfer lalu bertemu dengan Reodos.
description.it: Complete the 2nd job transfer then meet with Reodos.
description.jp: 二次転職をした後、レオドスを訪ねよ。
description.nl: Complete the 2nd job transfer then meet with Reodos.
description.pl: Complete the 2nd job transfer then meet with Reodos.
description.ru: Complete the 2nd job transfer then meet with Reodos.

description.sw: Complete the 2nd job transfer then meet with Reodos.
description.th: เสร็จสิ้นการเปลี่ยนอาชีพครั้งที่ 2 แล้วไปพบกับ Reodos
description.tw: 完成二轉，然後與列奧德斯會面。
description.vi: Hoàn thành lần chuyển việc thứ 2 sau đó gặp Reodos.

dialogsBegin.en: Oh! This pendant belonged to Reodos! So you found him after all? This is indeed great news!
dialogsBegin.ar: Oh! This pendant belonged to Reodos! So you found him after all? This is indeed great news!
dialogsBegin.br: Oh! Este pingente pertencia a Reodos! Então você o encontrou afinal?? Isso sim é uma ótima notícia!
dialogsBegin.cns: Oh! This pendant belonged to Reodos! So you found him after all? This is indeed great news!
dialogsBegin.de: Oh! Dieser Anhänger gehörte Reodos! Du hast ihn also doch gefunden?? Das ist in der Tat eine tolle Nachricht!
dialogsBegin.fi: Oh! This pendant belonged to Reodos! So you found him after all? This is indeed great news!
dialogsBegin.fil: Oh! This pendant belonged to Reodos! So you found him after all? This is indeed great news!
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous avez rencontré Reodos l'Elémentaliste ? Il était le plus actif de notre petite bande.
dialogsBegin.id: Oh! Liontin ini milik Reodos! Jadi, anda menemukannya ?? Ini memang berita bagus!
dialogsBegin.it: Oh! This pendant belonged to Reodos! So you found him after all? This is indeed great news!
dialogsBegin.jp: このペンダントはレオドスのものだったんだ！彼を見つけた！？彼も過去の戦争で活躍した一人だ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 오! 이 펜던트, 레오도스의 것이었군요! 그를 찾아낸 건가요? 정말 좋은 소식이네요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Oh! This pendant belonged to Reodos! So you found him after all? This is indeed great news!
dialogsBegin.pl: Oh! This pendant belonged to Reodos! So you found him after all? This is indeed great news!
dialogsBegin.ru: Oh! This pendant belonged to Reodos! So you found him after all? This is indeed great news!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Oh! ¡Este colgante pertenecía a Reodos! ¿¿Así que lo encontraste después de todo?? ¡Esta sí que es una gran noticia!
dialogsBegin.sw: Oh! This pendant belonged to Reodos! So you found him after all? This is indeed great news!
dialogsBegin.th: โอ้ว! จี้นี้เป็นของ Reodos! คุณเจอเขาหลังจากนั้นหรอ ? นี่ถือเป็นข่าวดี!
dialogsBegin.tw: 喔！這條墜飾是雷奧多斯的！所以你最後還是找到他了？這真的是好消息！
dialogsBegin.vi: Ồ! Đây là mặt dây chuyền thuộc về Reodos! Vậy là bạn đã tìm thấy anh ấy rồi sao? Đây quả thực là một tin tức tuyệt vời!

dialogsBegin.en: I'm sure we will be able to break his curse and shall all once again be reunited. It is time we began the search for the other 4 heroes.
dialogsBegin.ar: I'm sure we will be able to break his curse and shall all once again be reunited. It is time we began the search for the other 4 heroes.
dialogsBegin.br: Tenho certeza de que seremos capazes de quebrar sua maldição e todos seremos novamente reunidos. É hora de começarmos a busca pelos outros 4 heróis.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我相信我们会打破他的诅咒的，所有人将再次团聚。现在是我们开始寻找其他四位英雄的时候了。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich bin sicher, dass es uns gelingen wird, seinen Fluch zu brechen, und wir werden alle wieder vereint sein. Es wird Zeit, dass wir uns auf die Suche nach den anderen 4 Helden machen.
dialogsBegin.fi: I'm sure we will be able to break his curse and shall all once again be reunited. It is time we began the search for the other 4 heroes.
dialogsBegin.fil: I'm sure we will be able to break his curse and shall all once again be reunited. It is time we began the search for the other 4 heroes.
dialogsBegin.fr: Oh, il s'est réincarné sous forme d'un monstre... Bah, vous trouverez bien un moyen de l'aider.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya yakin kita akan dapat mematahkan kutukannya dan akan sekali lagi dipersatukan kembali. Sudah saatnya kita mulai mencari 4 pahlawan lainnya.
dialogsBegin.it: I'm sure we will be able to break his curse and shall all once again be reunited. It is time we began the search for the other 4 heroes.
dialogsBegin.jp: 獣の姿になってしまったとは……他にも転生した英雄の身にはイブリスの呪いが掛けられているのかもしれないな。あと4人の英雄を見つけるしかないな。
dialogsBegin.kr: 분명 레오도스의 저주를 풀고 하나로 모일 길이 있을 거예요. 이제 나머지 4명의 영웅을 찾을 시간이군요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I'm sure we will be able to break his curse and shall all once again be reunited. It is time we began the search for the other 4 heroes.
dialogsBegin.pl: I'm sure we will be able to break his curse and shall all once again be reunited. It is time we began the search for the other 4 heroes.
dialogsBegin.ru: I'm sure we will be able to break his curse and shall all once again be reunited. It is time we began the search for the other 4 heroes.
dialogsBegin.sp: Estoy seguro de que podremos romper su maldición y todos nos reuniremos de nuevo. Es hora de que comencemos la búsqueda de los otros 4 héroes.
dialogsBegin.sw: I'm sure we will be able to break his curse and shall all once again be reunited. It is time we began the search for the other 4 heroes.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันแน่ใจว่าเราสามารถล้างคำสาปแช่งของเขาได้และจะได้รวมตัวกันอีกครั้ง ถึงเวลาแล้วเราเริ่มค้นหาฮีโร่อีก 4 คน
dialogsBegin.tw: 我相信我們將能夠打破他的詛咒，並再次團聚。現在是我們開始尋找其他 4 位英雄的時候了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi chắc rằng chúng ta sẽ có thể phá bỏ lời nguyền của anh ta và tất cả sẽ một lần nữa được đoàn tụ. Đã đến lúc chúng tôi bắt đầu cuộc tìm kiếm 4 anh hùng còn lại.

dialogsBegin.en: Before this though, it is time you continued your own personal training. It seems you are ready to accept your second job class. This will mark an important step in your path so choose wisely!
dialogsBegin.ar: Before this though, it is time you continued your own personal training. It seems you are ready to accept your second job class. This will mark an important step in your path so choose wisely!
dialogsBegin.br: Antes disso, é hora de você continuar sua própria evolução pessoal. Parece que você está pronto para aceitar sua segunda classe. Isso marcará um passo importante em seu caminho, então escolha sabiamente!
dialogsBegin.cns: 但在此之前，是时候继续你自己的个人训练了。看来你已经准备好接受你的进阶职业了。这标志着你到了你的人生道路上非常重要的一步，所以明智地做出你的选择吧！
dialogsBegin.de: Vorher ist es jedoch an der Zeit, dass Sie sich persönlich weiterbilden. Es scheint, dass Sie bereit sind, Ihre zweite Berufsklasse anzunehmen. Dies wird ein wichtiger Schritt auf Ihrem Weg sein, also wählen Sie mit Bedacht!
dialogsBegin.fi: Before this though, it is time you continued your own personal training. It seems you are ready to accept your second job class. This will mark an important step in your path so choose wisely!
dialogsBegin.fil: Before this though, it is time you continued your own personal training. It seems you are ready to accept your second job class. This will mark an important step in your path so choose wisely!
dialogsBegin.fr: Pour le moment vous avez fait tout ce que vous pouvez pour Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.id: Namun sebelum ini, inilah saatnya Anda melanjutkan pelatihan pribadi Anda sendiri. Sepertinya Anda siap menerima second job class Anda. Ini akan menandai langkah penting di jalan Anda, jadi pilihlah dengan bijak!
dialogsBegin.it: Before this though, it is time you continued your own personal training. It seems you are ready to accept your second job class. This will mark an important step in your path so choose wisely!
dialogsBegin.jp: まだ、お前さんはマドリガルを救うには力が足りぬな。過去の私達と同じように新しい職業に就く必要があるだろう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그 전에, 이제 당신도 본격적인 수련을 계속해야 할 때랍니다. 2차 전직을 받아들일 준비가 된 것 같네요. 앞으로의 길에 있어 중요한 결정이 될 테니, 신중하게 선택하세요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Before this though, it is time you continued your own personal training. It seems you are ready to accept your second job class. This will mark an important step in your path so choose wisely!
dialogsBegin.pl: Before this though, it is time you continued your own personal training. It seems you are ready to accept your second job class. This will mark an important step in your path so choose wisely!
dialogsBegin.ru: Before this though, it is time you continued your own personal training. It seems you are ready to accept your second job class. This will mark an important step in your path so choose wisely!
dialogsBegin.sp: Pero, antes de eso, tienes que continuar con tu propio entrenamiento personal. Ya estás listo para pasar a la segunda clase. Esto marcará un paso importante en tu camino, ¡así que elige sabiamente!
dialogsBegin.sw: Before this though, it is time you continued your own personal training. It seems you are ready to accept your second job class. This will mark an important step in your path so choose wisely!
dialogsBegin.th: ก่อนหน้านี้แม้ว่าคุณจะยังคงฝึกฝนมาเองอยู่เรื่อยๆ ดูเหมือนว่าคุณพร้อมที่จะรับชั้นเรียนที่สองแล้ว นี้จะทำเครื่องหมายขั้นตอนที่สำคัญในเส้นทางของคุณเพื่อเลือกอย่างชาญฉลาด!
dialogsBegin.tw: 不過，在此之前，是時候繼續自己的個人訓練了。看來你已經準備好接受你的二轉課程了。這將你冒險旅程上的重要一步，因此請明智地選擇！
dialogsBegin.vi: Trước khi điều này xảy ra, đã đến lúc bạn tiếp tục việc đào tạo bản thân. Có vẻ như bạn đã sẵn sàng để chấp nhận hạng công việc thứ hai của mình. Điều này sẽ đánh dấu một bước quan trọng trong con đường của bạn, vì vậy hãy lựa chọn một cách sáng suốt!

dialogsBegin.en: Please complete your second job quest. Once you have done this, go and meet Reodos again. Hopefully he has broken out of his curse by now.
dialogsBegin.ar: Please complete your second job quest. Once you have done this, go and meet Reodos again. Hopefully he has broken out of his curse by now.
dialogsBegin.br: Por favor, complete sua segunda Quest de classe. Depois de ter feito isso, vá e reencontre Reodos. Espero que ele tenha conseguido quebrar a maldição.
dialogsBegin.cns: 请完成你的职业二转。完成后，再去见里奥多斯。希望他现在已经摆脱了诅咒。
dialogsBegin.de: Bitte erledigen Sie Ihre zweite Aufgabe. Sobald Sie dies getan haben, treffen Sie Reodos wieder. Hoffentlich ist er inzwischen von seinem Fluch befreit worden.
dialogsBegin.fi: Please complete your second job quest. Once you have done this, go and meet Reodos again. Hopefully he has broken out of his curse by now.
dialogsBegin.fil: Please complete your second job quest. Once you have done this, go and meet Reodos again. Hopefully he has broken out of his curse by now.
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous pourrez nous rejoindre quand vous serez niveau 60 et que vous aurez effectué votre changement de classe.
dialogsBegin.id: Harap selesaikan second job quest Anda. Setelah Anda melakukan ini, pergi dan temui Reodos lagi. Mudah-mudahan dia sudah keluar dari kutukannya sekarang.
dialogsBegin.it: Please complete your second job quest. Once you have done this, go and meet Reodos again. Hopefully he has broken out of his curse by now.
dialogsBegin.jp: 2次転職を終えてからきてください。その頃にはきっとレオドスの呪いも解けるだろう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 2차 전직 퀘스트를 완료한 다음, 다시 레오도스를 만나러 가세요. 그쯤 되면 레오도스의 저주가 풀렸을지도 모르죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: Please complete your second job quest. Once you have done this, go and meet Reodos again. Hopefully he has broken out of his curse by now.
dialogsBegin.pl: Please complete your second job quest. Once you have done this, go and meet Reodos again. Hopefully he has broken out of his curse by now.
dialogsBegin.ru: Please complete your second job quest. Once you have done this, go and meet Reodos again. Hopefully he has broken out of his curse by now.
dialogsBegin.sp: Por favor completa tu cambio a segunda clase. Una vez que lo hayas conseguido, reúnete con Reodos de nuevo. Esperemos que para entonces ya haya escapado de su maldición.
dialogsBegin.sw: Please complete your second job quest. Once you have done this, go and meet Reodos again. Hopefully he has broken out of his curse by now.
dialogsBegin.th: กรุณาเปลี่ยนอาชีพครั้งที่ 2 ให้เสร็จ เมื่อคุณทำแล้วไปพบ Reodos อีกครั้ง หวังว่าเขาจะหลุดพ้นจากคำสาปของเขาตอนนี้
dialogsBegin.tw: 請完成你的二轉任務。完成此操作後，再去見列奧德斯。希望他現在已經擺脫了他的詛咒。
dialogsBegin.vi: Vui lòng hoàn thành nhiệm vụ công việc thứ hai của bạn. Khi bạn đã hoàn thành việc này, hãy đến và gặp lại Reodos. Hy vọng rằng anh ấy đã thoát khỏi lời nguyền của mình.

dialogsAccept.en: Please go and meet Reodos as soon as you have finished with your quest!
dialogsAccept.ar: Please go and meet Reodos as soon as you have finished with your quest!
dialogsAccept.br: Por favor, encontre Reodos assim que terminar sua missão!
dialogsAccept.cns: 完成二转后，请尽快去见里奥多斯！
dialogsAccept.de: Bitte geh zu Reodos, sobald du deine Aufgabe erledigt hast!
dialogsAccept.fi: Please go and meet Reodos as soon as you have finished with your quest!
dialogsAccept.fil: Please go and meet Reodos as soon as you have finished with your quest!
dialogsAccept.fr: Passez donc niveau 60, changez de classe et reparlez à Reodos.
dialogsAccept.id: Silakan pergi dan temui Reodos segera setelah Anda selesai dengan pencarian Anda!
dialogsAccept.it: Please go and meet Reodos as soon as you have finished with your quest!
dialogsAccept.jp: クエストが終えたらレオドスをもう一度訪れるのだ。彼ならさらに何か発見しているかもしれんぞ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 퀘스트를 끝내는 대로, 곧바로 레오도스를 찾아가 주세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Please go and meet Reodos as soon as you have finished with your quest!
dialogsAccept.pl: Please go and meet Reodos as soon as you have finished with your quest!
dialogsAccept.ru: Please go and meet Reodos as soon as you have finished with your quest!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Reúnete con Reodos tan pronto como cambies a la segunda clase!
dialogsAccept.sw: Please go and meet Reodos as soon as you have finished with your quest!
dialogsAccept.th: โปรดไปพบ Reodos ทันทีที่เสร็จสิ้นภารกิจ!
dialogsAccept.tw: 完成任務後，請盡快去見列奧德斯！
dialogsAccept.vi: Hãy đến gặp Reodos ngay sau khi bạn hoàn thành nhiệm vụ của mình!

dialogsDecline.en: It is imperative that you complete your second job quest. This will mark another step in your journey to becoming a true warrior!
dialogsDecline.ar: It is imperative that you complete your second job quest. This will mark another step in your journey to becoming a true warrior!
dialogsDecline.br: É imperativo que você complete sua segunda missão de classe. Isso marcará mais um passo em sua jornada para se tornar um verdadeiro guerreiro!
dialogsDecline.cns: 你必须完成你的职业二转。这将标志着你在成为一名真正的勇士的征程上又迈进了一步！
dialogsDecline.de: Es ist unerlässlich, dass du deine zweite Aufgabe erfüllst. Dies ist ein weiterer Schritt auf dem Weg zu einem wahren Krieger!
dialogsDecline.fi: It is imperative that you complete your second job quest. This will mark another step in your journey to becoming a true warrior!
dialogsDecline.fil: It is imperative that you complete your second job quest. This will mark another step in your journey to becoming a true warrior!
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous vous feriez massacrer si je vous laissais continuer maintenant.
dialogsDecline.id: Sangat penting bagi Anda untuk menyelesaikan second job quest Anda. Ini akan menandai langkah lain dalam perjalanan Anda untuk menjadi pejuang sejati!
dialogsDecline.it: It is imperative that you complete your second job quest. This will mark another step in your journey to becoming a true warrior!
dialogsDecline.jp: ふむ、まだそこまで修行をする気にはならんというのか。まあ、言わんでもわかるだろうが、先に2次転職を終えることだな。
dialogsDecline.kr: 반드시 2차 전직 퀘스트를 마무리해야 해요. 진정한 전사로 나아가는 또 하나의 중요한 걸음이 될 겁니다!
dialogsDecline.nl: It is imperative that you complete your second job quest. This will mark another step in your journey to becoming a true warrior!
dialogsDecline.pl: It is imperative that you complete your second job quest. This will mark another step in your journey to becoming a true warrior!
dialogsDecline.ru: It is imperative that you complete your second job quest. This will mark another step in your journey to becoming a true warrior!
dialogsDecline.sp: Es imperativo que completes tu cambio a la segunda clase. ¡Esto marcará otro paso en tu viaje para convertirte en un verdadero guerrero!
dialogsDecline.sw: It is imperative that you complete your second job quest. This will mark another step in your journey to becoming a true warrior!
dialogsDecline.th: จำเป็นมาก คุณต้องเปลี่ยนอาชีพครั้งที่ 2 ให้เสร็จ นี้ถึงจะเป็นเครื่องหมายว่าคุณเป็นนักรบที่แท้จริง
dialogsDecline.tw: 你必須完成二轉任務。這將意味著你成為真正戰士的目標又邁進了一步！
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn bắt buộc phải hoàn thành nhiệm vụ thứ hai của mình. Điều này sẽ đánh dấu một bước nữa trong hành trình trở thành một chiến binh thực thụ!

dialogsComplete.en: Oh! I see you have completed your second job change quests!
dialogsComplete.ar: Oh! I see you have completed your second job change quests!
dialogsComplete.br: Oh! Vejo que você completou sua missão de mudança de segunda classe!
dialogsComplete.cns: 噢！我看你已经完成了二转的任务！
dialogsComplete.de: Oh! Wie ich sehe, hast du deine zweite Jobwechsel-Aufgabe abgeschlossen!
dialogsComplete.fi: Oh! I see you have completed your second job change quests!
dialogsComplete.fil: Oh! I see you have completed your second job change quests!
dialogsComplete.fr: Vous avez bien progressé. Faites voir vos biceps ? Ah non, toujours rien. Ça viendra peut-être...
dialogsComplete.id: Oh! Saya melihat Anda telah menyelesaikan second job change quests!
dialogsComplete.it: Oh! I see you have completed your second job change quests!
dialogsComplete.jp: おお、君はずいぶんと成長したようだな。ん？　何？　なぜまだ私はこのままの姿なのかって？
dialogsComplete.kr: 오오! 2차 전직 퀘스트를 완료하셨군요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Oh! I see you have completed your second job change quests!
dialogsComplete.pl: Oh! I see you have completed your second job change quests!
dialogsComplete.ru: Oh! I see you have completed your second job change quests!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Oh! ¡Veo que has completado las misiones de cambio a la segunda clase!
dialogsComplete.sw: Oh! I see you have completed your second job change quests!
dialogsComplete.th: โอ้วว ! ฉันเห็นว่าคุณได้เปลี่ยนอาชีพครั้งที่สองของคุณเสร็จแล้ว!
dialogsComplete.tw: 哦！我看到你已經完成了你的二轉任務！
dialogsComplete.vi: Ồ! Tôi thấy bạn đã hoàn thành nhiệm vụ thay đổi công việc thứ hai của mình!

dialogsFail.en: Best of luck in the completion of the trials that lay before you!
dialogsFail.ar: Best of luck in the completion of the trials that lay before you!
dialogsFail.br: Boa sorte na conclusão das provações que lhe aguardam!
dialogsFail.cns: 祝你能顺利完成摆在你面前的考验！
dialogsFail.de: Ich wünsche Ihnen viel Glück bei der Bewältigung der vor Ihnen liegenden Prüfungen!
dialogsFail.fi: Best of luck in the completion of the trials that lay before you!
dialogsFail.fil: Best of luck in the completion of the trials that lay before you!
dialogsFail.fr: J'espère que vous atteindrez le niveau 60 avant que Madrigal ne soit attaqué !
dialogsFail.id: Semoga sukses dalam penyelesaian trials yang ada di hadapan Anda!
dialogsFail.it: Best of luck in the completion of the trials that lay before you!
dialogsFail.jp: 試練をクリアするのは容易ではないかもしれないが、お前さんなら大丈夫さ。
dialogsFail.kr: 앞으로 펼쳐질 시련을, 부디 잘 이겨내시길!
dialogsFail.nl: Best of luck in the completion of the trials that lay before you!
dialogsFail.pl: Best of luck in the completion of the trials that lay before you!
dialogsFail.ru: Best of luck in the completion of the trials that lay before you!
dialogsFail.sp: ¡La mejor de las suertes en las pruebas que se te presentan!
dialogsFail.sw: Best of luck in the completion of the trials that lay before you!
dialogsFail.th: โชคดีที่สุดในการเสร็จสิ้นการทดลองที่วางไว้ก่อนคุณ!

dialogsBegin.en: The name is Ainher. Yes, try not to let the pure beauty of it make you go completely deaf. I'm sure you didn't just come all this way to learn my name though, so what DID you come here for?
dialogsBegin.ar: The name is Ainher. Yes, try not to let the pure beauty of it make you go completely deaf. I'm sure you didn't just come all this way to learn my name though, so what DID you come here for?
dialogsBegin.br: O meu nome é Ainher! Sim, tente não deixar que a pura beleza da melodia faça você ficar completamente surdo. Tenho certeza que você não veio de tão longe para aprender meu nome, então para que você veio aqui?
dialogsBegin.cns: The name is Ainher. Yes, try not to let the pure beauty of it make you go completely deaf. I'm sure you didn't just come all this way to learn my name though, so what DID you come here for?
dialogsBegin.de: Der Name ist Ainher. Ja, versuch, dich von seiner reinen Schönheit nicht völlig taub machen zu lassen. Ich bin mir sicher, dass du nicht den ganzen Weg hierher gekommen bist, um meinen Namen zu erfahren, also warum bist du hierher gekommen?
dialogsBegin.fi: The name is Ainher. Yes, try not to let the pure beauty of it make you go completely deaf. I'm sure you didn't just come all this way to learn my name though, so what DID you come here for?
dialogsBegin.fil: The name is Ainher. Yes, try not to let the pure beauty of it make you go completely deaf. I'm sure you didn't just come all this way to learn my name though, so what DID you come here for?
dialogsBegin.fr: Quoi, vous ne voulez pas vraiment être mon disciple ? (Vous n'aviez pas réussi à lui faire comprendre avant…) Alors que me voulez-vous ?
dialogsBegin.id: Namaku Ainher. Ya, cobalah untuk tidak membiarkan keindahan murni itu membuat kamu benar-benar tuli. Aku yakin kamu tidak hanya datang jauh-jauh untuk mempelajari namaku, jadi untuk apa datang ke sini??
dialogsBegin.it: The name is Ainher. Yes, try not to let the pure beauty of it make you go completely deaf. I'm sure you didn't just come all this way to learn my name though, so what DID you come here for?
dialogsBegin.jp: え？　弟子になりにきたんじゃないの？　ふ～ん、ストーカーでもなさそうだし、あなた何なの？
dialogsBegin.kr: 전 아인헤르예요. 그래요. 너무 순수하고 아름다운 이름이라 귀가 먹을 것 같지 않나요? 제 이름을 들으러 여기까지 온 건 아닐 테고, 무슨 일로 오셨죠?
dialogsBegin.nl: The name is Ainher. Yes, try not to let the pure beauty of it make you go completely deaf. I'm sure you didn't just come all this way to learn my name though, so what DID you come here for?
dialogsBegin.pl: The name is Ainher. Yes, try not to let the pure beauty of it make you go completely deaf. I'm sure you didn't just come all this way to learn my name though, so what DID you come here for?
dialogsBegin.ru: The name is Ainher. Yes, try not to let the pure beauty of it make you go completely deaf. I'm sure you didn't just come all this way to learn my name though, so what DID you come here for?
dialogsBegin.sp: Mi nombre es Ainher. Sí, intenta que su pura belleza no te haga quedar completamente sordo. Estoy segura de que no has venido hasta aquí solo para saber mi nombre, así que, ¿para qué has venido?
dialogsBegin.sw: The name is Ainher. Yes, try not to let the pure beauty of it make you go completely deaf. I'm sure you didn't just come all this way to learn my name though, so what DID you come here for?
dialogsBegin.th: ชื่อคือ Ainher และใช่ พยายามอย่าปล่อยให้ความงามอันบริสุทธิ์ของมันทำให้คุณหลงเสน่ห์ ฉันคิดว่าคุณคงไม่ได้ดั้นด้นมาเพื่อถามชื่อ แล้วคุณมาที่นี่เพื่ออะไร?
dialogsBegin.tw: 我的名字是艾因赫。對，盡量別因為這個充滿純粹美感的名字而聽到失神。我想你大老遠來這裡應該不只是想知道我的名字，所以你到底是為了什麼而來？
dialogsBegin.vi: Tên tôi là Ainher. Đúng rồi đấy, ráng đừng để vẻ đẹp thuần khiết của cái tên này lấy đi hoàn toàn thính giác của bạn. Tôi chắc rằng bạn không chỉ đến đây để biết tên của tôi, vậy bạn đến để làm gì?

dialogsBegin.en: Hehe, how did you know about the original 8 heroes? Ah it's ok, I've had creepier stalkers! I am the reincarnation of the original Psykeeper Hero Offerep…
dialogsBegin.ar: Hehe, how did you know about the original 8 heroes? Ah it's ok, I've had creepier stalkers! I am the reincarnation of the original Psykeeper Hero Offerep…
dialogsBegin.br: Heeee, como você sabe sobre Os 8 Heróis Originais?? Ah está tudo bem, eu já tive stalkers mais assustadores! Eu sou a reencarnação do original Herói Psykeeper, Offereop…
dialogsBegin.cns: Hehe, how did you know about the original 8 heroes? Ah it's ok, I've had creepier stalkers! I am the reincarnation of the original Psykeeper Hero Offerep…
dialogsBegin.de: Hehe, woher wusstest du von den acht Originalhelden? Ach, ist schon okay, ich hatte schon unheimlichere Stalker! Ich bin die Reinkarnation des Psykeeper Hero Offerep...
dialogsBegin.fi: Hehe, how did you know about the original 8 heroes? Ah it's ok, I've had creepier stalkers! I am the reincarnation of the original Psykeeper Hero Offerep…
dialogsBegin.fil: Hehe, how did you know about the original 8 heroes? Ah it's ok, I've had creepier stalkers! I am the reincarnation of the original Psykeeper Hero Offerep…
dialogsBegin.fr: Ohhh, vous cherchez des Héros réincarnés ! Vous avez la chance, je suis la réincarnation du Héros sorcier Operab.
dialogsBegin.id: Hehe, bagaimana kamu tahu tentang 8 hero aslinya?? Ah tidak apa-apa, aku punya penguntit yang lebih menyeramkan! Aku adalah reinkarnasi dari Psykeeper Hero Offerep yang asli ...
dialogsBegin.it: Hehe, how did you know about the original 8 heroes? Ah it's ok, I've had creepier stalkers! I am the reincarnation of the original Psykeeper Hero Offerep…
dialogsBegin.jp: わたくしが、過去の英雄の生まれ変わりじゃないか……ふうん。（ちょっと考えているようだ）
dialogsBegin.kr: 흐음, 8명의 영웅 이야기를 어떻게 알았죠? 뭐 괜찮아요, 더 무서운 스토커도 있었는데요! 저는 사이키퍼 영웅, 오퍼엡이 환생한 존재예요…
dialogsBegin.nl: Hehe, how did you know about the original 8 heroes? Ah it's ok, I've had creepier stalkers! I am the reincarnation of the original Psykeeper Hero Offerep…
dialogsBegin.pl: Hehe, how did you know about the original 8 heroes? Ah it's ok, I've had creepier stalkers! I am the reincarnation of the original Psykeeper Hero Offerep…
dialogsBegin.ru: Hehe, how did you know about the original 8 heroes? Ah it's ok, I've had creepier stalkers! I am the reincarnation of the original Psykeeper Hero Offerep…
dialogsBegin.sp: Jeje, ¿¿cómo sabes acerca de los 8 héroes originales?? ¡Ah, está bien, he tenido acosadores más espeluznantes! Soy la reencarnación de la Héroe Psykeeper Offerep original...
dialogsBegin.sw: Hehe, how did you know about the original 8 heroes? Ah it's ok, I've had creepier stalkers! I am the reincarnation of the original Psykeeper Hero Offerep…
dialogsBegin.th: อิอิ คุณรู้เกี่ยวกับผู้กล้าทั้ง 8 คนได้อย่างไร? อ่า ไม่เป็นไร ฉันก็มีสตอล์กเกอร์ที่น่าขนลุก! ฉันคือ Psykeeper Hero Offerep กลับชาติมาเกิด...
dialogsBegin.tw: 呵呵，你怎麼會知道最初的八英雄？啊沒關係，我遇過更可怕的跟蹤狂！我是最初念力使英雄歐菲瑞普的轉世……
dialogsBegin.vi: Hehe, làm thế nào mà bạn biết về 8 Người hùng thuở sơ khai chứ?? À không sao, tôi biết nhiều kẻ do thám đáng sợ hơn cơ! Tôi chính là hiện thân của Psykeeper Hero Offerep nguyên bản…

dialogsBegin.en: I see. So Reonan looks to reunite the original heroes. If t his is the case, then something important must be going on! Unfortunately, I am rather tied down at the moment with research…
dialogsBegin.ar: I see. So Reonan looks to reunite the original heroes. If t his is the case, then something important must be going on! Unfortunately, I am rather tied down at the moment with research…
dialogsBegin.br: Humm... Então Reonan quer reunir a galerinha heroica de novo. Se for esse o caso, então algo importante deve estar acontecendo! Infelizmente, estou bastante presa no momento com uma pesquisa…
dialogsBegin.cns: 我明白了。因此瑞尔南期待着与原来的英雄们重新团聚。如果是这样的话，那么一定是有什么重要的事情发生了! 不幸的是，我现在被研究工作束缚住了...
dialogsBegin.de: Ich verstehe. Reonan will also die ursprünglichen Helden wieder zusammenbringen. Wenn das der Fall ist, dann muss etwas Wichtiges vor sich gehen! Leider bin ich im Moment mit meinen Recherchen ziemlich eingespannt...
dialogsBegin.fi: I see. So Reonan looks to reunite the original heroes. If t his is the case, then something important must be going on! Unfortunately, I am rather tied down at the moment with research…
dialogsBegin.fil: I see. So Reonan looks to reunite the original heroes. If t his is the case, then something important must be going on! Unfortunately, I am rather tied down at the moment with research…
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous parlez de Reonan comme si je devais le connaître. Oh, il est la réincarnation de Billein, le Héros chevalier. Si vous m'aidez à terminer ce que je fais ici, je me joindrai à votre cause.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya mengerti. Jadi Reonan mencari untuk menyatukan kembali pahlawan aslinya. Jika dia masalahnya, maka sesuatu yang penting pasti sedang terjadi! Sayangnya, saya agak terikat saat ini dengan penelitian...
dialogsBegin.it: I see. So Reonan looks to reunite the original heroes. If t his is the case, then something important must be going on! Unfortunately, I am rather tied down at the moment with research…
dialogsBegin.jp: レオナンって名前は知らないけどナイトならビレリアンの転生でしょうね。うん。確かに最近のただならぬ気配は感じていたわ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 레오난이 날 찾는다구? 이 몸을 필요로 하는 건 알겠지만, 내가 지금 매우 중요한 연구 중인데...
dialogsBegin.nl: I see. So Reonan looks to reunite the original heroes. If t his is the case, then something important must be going on! Unfortunately, I am rather tied down at the moment with research…
dialogsBegin.pl: I see. So Reonan looks to reunite the original heroes. If t his is the case, then something important must be going on! Unfortunately, I am rather tied down at the moment with research…
dialogsBegin.ru: I see. So Reonan looks to reunite the original heroes. If t his is the case, then something important must be going on! Unfortunately, I am rather tied down at the moment with research…
dialogsBegin.sp: Ya veo. Entonces, Reonan busca reunir a los héroes originales. Si este es el caso, ¡debe estar pasando algo importante! Por desgracia, ahora mismo estoy bastante ocupada con la investigación...
dialogsBegin.sw: I see. So Reonan looks to reunite the original heroes. If t his is the case, then something important must be going on! Unfortunately, I am rather tied down at the moment with research…
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันเห็น. ดังนั้น Reonan ดูเหมือนเหล่าวีรบุรุษจะรวมตัว ถ้าเป็นกรณีของเขาแล้วสิ่งที่สำคัญจะต้องเกิดขึ้น!
dialogsBegin.tw: 你說雷奧南在找我嗎？聽這個名字，他應該是騎士英雄畢雷恩的轉生吧？嗯…雖然我知道你需要這身體，但是我正在進行很重要的研究。在研究結束以前，我沒有要離開的打算。
dialogsBegin.vi: Theo tôi thấy. Reonan tìm cách tái hợp các anh hùng thuở sơ khai. Nếu đúng như vậy thì chắc chắn một điều gì đó quan trọng đang xảy ra! Thật không may, vào lúc này, tôi khá bề tắc với việc nghiên cứu…

dialogsBegin.en: I guess if you maybe helped me to finish my research I would consider joining up. If you want to be of assistance to me, then please go talk to Drico and collect the Agony Ore.
dialogsBegin.ar: I guess if you maybe helped me to finish my research I would consider joining up. If you want to be of assistance to me, then please go talk to Drico and collect the Agony Ore.
dialogsBegin.br: Eu acho que se você talvez me ajudasse a terminar minha pesquisa eu consideraria me juntar ao bando ;p. Se você quiser me ajudar, por favor, vá falar com Drico e colete o Minério da Agonia.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我想如果你能帮助我完成研究，我会考虑加入的。如果你想对我有所帮助，那么请你去和德里科谈谈，并收集痛苦之石。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich denke, wenn ihr mir vielleicht dabei helft, meine Forschungen zu beenden, würde ich in Betracht ziehen, mich euch anzuschließen. Wenn ihr mir helfen wollt, dann sprecht bitte mit Drico und sammelt das Agony Ore ein.
dialogsBegin.fi: I guess if you maybe helped me to finish my research I would consider joining up. If you want to be of assistance to me, then please go talk to Drico and collect the Agony Ore.
dialogsBegin.fil: I guess if you maybe helped me to finish my research I would consider joining up. If you want to be of assistance to me, then please go talk to Drico and collect the Agony Ore.
dialogsBegin.fr: Si vous voulez m'aider, demandez du minerai d'agonie à Drico.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya rasa jika Anda membantu saya menyelesaikan penelitian saya, maka saya akan mempertimbangkan untuk bergabung. Jika Anda ingin membantu saya, silakan bicara dengan Drico dan kumpulkan Agony Ore.
dialogsBegin.it: I guess if you maybe helped me to finish my research I would consider joining up. If you want to be of assistance to me, then please go talk to Drico and collect the Agony Ore.
dialogsBegin.jp: 残念だけどすぐには合流できないわ。わたくしも調べ物がまだあるの。そうだ、ものはついでだし、あなた、手伝ってくれない？
dialogsBegin.kr: 만약 당신이 내 연구를 끝낼 수 있도록 도와준다면, 뭐. 그럼, 이 던전에 있는 드리코를 찾아가 고뇌의 광석이란걸 가져와줘.
dialogsBegin.nl: I guess if you maybe helped me to finish my research I would consider joining up. If you want to be of assistance to me, then please go talk to Drico and collect the Agony Ore.
dialogsBegin.pl: I guess if you maybe helped me to finish my research I would consider joining up. If you want to be of assistance to me, then please go talk to Drico and collect the Agony Ore.
dialogsBegin.ru: I guess if you maybe helped me to finish my research I would consider joining up. If you want to be of assistance to me, then please go talk to Drico and collect the Agony Ore.
dialogsBegin.sp: Supongo que si me ayudas a terminar mi investigación, podría considerar unirme. Si quieres ayudarme, ve a hablar con Drico y consigue el Mineral de la Agonía.
dialogsBegin.sw: I guess if you maybe helped me to finish my research I would consider joining up. If you want to be of assistance to me, then please go talk to Drico and collect the Agony Ore.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันเดาว่าถ้าคุณอาจช่วยฉันให้เสร็จการวิจัยของฉันได้ ถ้าคุณต้องการความช่วยเหลือจากฉันโปรดไปคุยกับ Drico และรวบรวมแร่ Agony
dialogsBegin.tw: 你說你要幫助我完成研究嗎？呵呵呵！很好，我當然是沒有差吧。那麼，你就去找尋在副本裡的德里克，把苦惱的礦石拿回來給我吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đoán nếu bạn có thể giúp tôi hoàn thành nghiên cứu của mình, tôi sẽ cân nhắc tham gia. Nếu bạn muốn giúp đỡ tôi, hãy nói chuyện với Drico và thu thập Agony Ore.

dialogsAccept.en: Agony Ore is quite rare, so I'm sure Drico won't be willing to hand it over right away… But, I guess that is now your problem! Hehe.
dialogsAccept.ar: Agony Ore is quite rare, so I'm sure Drico won't be willing to hand it over right away… But, I guess that is now your problem! Hehe.
dialogsAccept.br: O Minério da Agonia é bastante raro, então tenho certeza que Drico não estará disposto a entregá-lo de mão beijada... Mas, acho que agora é problema seu! Hehehe.
dialogsAccept.cns: 痛苦之石是相当罕见的，所以我肯定德里科不愿意马上交出它...但是，我想这现在是你的问题了！呵呵
dialogsAccept.de: Agony Ore ist ziemlich selten, also bin ich mir sicher, dass Drico es nicht sofort aushändigen wird... Aber das ist jetzt wohl dein Problem! Hehe.
dialogsAccept.fi: Agony Ore is quite rare, so I'm sure Drico won't be willing to hand it over right away… But, I guess that is now your problem! Hehe.
dialogsAccept.fil: Agony Ore is quite rare, so I'm sure Drico won't be willing to hand it over right away… But, I guess that is now your problem! Hehe.
dialogsAccept.fr: Le minerai d'agonie est rare et précieux, ça ne sera pas simple de s'en procurer.
dialogsAccept.id: Agony Ore cukup langka, jadi saya yakin Drico tidak akan mau segera menyerahkannya... Tapi, kurasa itu sekarang masalahmu! Hehe.
dialogsAccept.it: Agony Ore is quite rare, so I'm sure Drico won't be willing to hand it over right away… But, I guess that is now your problem! Hehe.
dialogsAccept.jp: この鉱山の中にドゥリコってモンスターがいるわ。悪い子じゃないの。研究に必要な苦悩の鉱石を貰ってきてほしいのよ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 고뇌의 광석은 흔한 광석이 아니라 쉽게 주지는 않을 테지만, 뭐~ 구해 오는건 당신의 문제니깐. 호호홋!
dialogsAccept.nl: Agony Ore is quite rare, so I'm sure Drico won't be willing to hand it over right away… But, I guess that is now your problem! Hehe.
dialogsAccept.pl: Agony Ore is quite rare, so I'm sure Drico won't be willing to hand it over right away… But, I guess that is now your problem! Hehe.
dialogsAccept.ru: Agony Ore is quite rare, so I'm sure Drico won't be willing to hand it over right away… But, I guess that is now your problem! Hehe.
dialogsAccept.sp: El Mineral de la Agonía es bastante raro, así que estoy segura de que Drico no estará dispuesto a entregártelo de inmediato... ¡Pero supongo que ahora ese es tu problema! Jeje.
dialogsAccept.sw: Agony Ore is quite rare, so I'm sure Drico won't be willing to hand it over right away… But, I guess that is now your problem! Hehe.
dialogsAccept.th: แร่ Agony เป็นของหายากมาก ดังนั้นฉันแน่ใจว่า Drico จะไม่เต็มใจที่จะส่งมอบให้ได้ทันที ... แต่ฉันเดาว่าตอนนี้มันคือปัญหาของคุณ! ฮิฮิ.
dialogsAccept.tw: 苦惱的礦石是很罕見的礦石，所以不會這麼輕易給你的。反正~ 收集回來就是你的問題。呵呵呵！
dialogsAccept.vi: Agony Ore khá hiếm, vì vậy tôi chắc chắn rằng Drico sẽ không sẵn sàng giao nó ngay lập tức… Nhưng, tôi đoán đây là vấn đề của bạn! Hehe.

dialogsDecline.en: Change your mind so quickly I see? Guess you weren't in that much of a hurry to get my help then! Hehe.
dialogsDecline.ar: Change your mind so quickly I see? Guess you weren't in that much of a hurry to get my help then! Hehe.
dialogsDecline.br: Mudou de ideia tão rapidamente assim? Acho que você não estava com tanta pressa para obter minha ajuda então! Hehe.
dialogsDecline.cns: 我看你这么快就改变主意了？所以你根本没有那么急着让我帮忙! 呵呵。
dialogsDecline.de: Du hast deine Meinung so schnell geändert, wie ich sehe? Dann hattest du es wohl nicht so eilig, meine Hilfe zu bekommen! Hehe.
dialogsDecline.fi: Change your mind so quickly I see? Guess you weren't in that much of a hurry to get my help then! Hehe.
dialogsDecline.fil: Change your mind so quickly I see? Guess you weren't in that much of a hurry to get my help then! Hehe.
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous me laissez tomber comme ça ?
dialogsDecline.id: Berubah pikiran begitu cepat ya sepertinya? Nampaknya Anda tidak terburu-buru untuk mendapatkan bantuan saya saat itu! Hehe.
dialogsDecline.it: Change your mind so quickly I see? Guess you weren't in that much of a hurry to get my help then! Hehe.
dialogsDecline.jp: あっそ、まあいいけどね。
dialogsDecline.kr: 그 새 마음이 바뀐 건가요? 제 도움이 그렇게 급한 건 아니었나 보죠? 후후.

dialogsBegin.en: I knew there was something special about you. After reading this letter it seems Tina has taken a liking to you too! What does the letter say, you ask? That's a secret!
dialogsBegin.ar: I knew there was something special about you. After reading this letter it seems Tina has taken a liking to you too! What does the letter say, you ask? That's a secret!
dialogsBegin.br: Eu sabia que havia algo especial em você. Depois de ler esta carta, parece que a Tina também gostou de você! O que a carta diz, você pergunta? Isso é segredo!
dialogsBegin.cns: 我就知道你是有过人之处的。看完这封信后，我发现蒂娜也喜欢上你了！噢？你问信里写了什么？这可是秘密！
dialogsBegin.de: Ich wusste, dass du etwas Besonderes bist. Nachdem ich diesen Brief gelesen habe, scheint es, als ob auch Tina Gefallen an dir gefunden hat! Was in dem Brief steht, fragst du? Das ist ein Geheimnis!
dialogsBegin.fi: I knew there was something special about you. After reading this letter it seems Tina has taken a liking to you too! What does the letter say, you ask? That's a secret!
dialogsBegin.fil: I knew there was something special about you. After reading this letter it seems Tina has taken a liking to you too! What does the letter say, you ask? That's a secret!
dialogsBegin.fr: Je sentais que tu étais une personne exceptionnelle. Après avoir lu cette lettre, je vois que Tina aussi est fan de toi ! Quoi, tu me demandes ce qu'il y a dans cette lettre ? C'est un secret !
dialogsBegin.id: Aku tahu ada sesuatu yang istimewa darimu. Setelah membaca surat ini, sepertinya Tina juga tertarik padamu! Kamu tanya apa isi surat itu? rahasia!
dialogsBegin.it: I knew there was something special about you. After reading this letter it seems Tina has taken a liking to you too! What does the letter say, you ask? That's a secret!
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたには才能があると思っていました。ティナもあなたのことが気に入ったみたいですよ。あら、この推薦状何が書いてあるかって？教えないわ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 처음부터 뭔가 특별하다고 생각했어요. 티나도 당신을 꽤 마음에 들어 한 것 같네요! 편지 내용이 뭐냐고요? 그건 비밀이에요!
dialogsBegin.nl: I knew there was something special about you. After reading this letter it seems Tina has taken a liking to you too! What does the letter say, you ask? That's a secret!

dialogsBegin.sp: Sabía que había algo especial en ti. ¡Por lo que veo al leer esta carta, parece que Tina también te ha tomado cariño! ¿Qué dice la carta, preguntas? ¡Eso es un secreto!

dialogsBegin.th: ฉันรู้ว่ามีบางอย่างพิเศษเกี่ยวกับคุณ หลังอ่านจดหมายฉบับนี้แล้ว ดูเหมือนว่า Tina ก็ชอบคุณเหมือนกัน! จดหมายว่าไงบ้างเหรอ ถามมาได้? นั่นเป็นความลับ!
dialogsBegin.tw: 我知道你有什麼特別之處。看完這封信，蒂娜似乎也喜歡上了你！你問，這封信說了什麼？那是個秘密！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi biết có điều gì đó đặc biệt ở bạn. Sau khi đọc bức thư này, có vẻ như Tina cũng thích bạn! Bạn hỏi bức thư nói gì à? Đó là một bí mật!

dialogsBegin.en: Congratulations on passing the Initial Test. I'll prepare a reward. It's an experimental fuel that gives your flying device a temporary speed boost!
dialogsBegin.ar: Congratulations on passing the Initial Test. I'll prepare a reward. It's an experimental fuel that gives your flying device a temporary speed boost!

dialogsBegin.jp: ご褒美は何がいいかしら・・・？じゃあ、もっと気持ちよくなれるようにこれを渡しておくわ。勘違いしないでよね。飛行アイテムがスピードアップするターボ・エランサーよ！空をもっと、もっと早く飛べるようになるはずよ！

dialogsBegin.th: ขอแสดงความยินดีที่ผ่านการทดสอบเบื้องต้น ฉันจะเตรียมรางวัลให้ เป็นเชื้อเพลิงทดลองที่ช่วยให้อุปกรณ์บินของคุณมีความเร็วเพิ่มขึ้นชั่วคราว!

dialogsBegin.en: What brings you here? I am sure you know of the many deaths surrounding this place.
dialogsBegin.ar: What brings you here? I am sure you know of the many deaths surrounding this place.
dialogsBegin.br: O que o traz aqui? Estou certo de que você está ciente das muitas mortes que rondam esse lugar.
dialogsBegin.cns: 嗯～你来这里干吗？难道你不知道以前这里死了很多人吗？这里不是人类可以进入的地方啦！滚！呵呵～我懂了你是来调查以前为什么有那么多人在这里死亡的，对吧！
dialogsBegin.de: Was machst du hier? Weißt du nicht, dass hier viele Menschen in der Vergangenheit gestorben sind?
dialogsBegin.fi: What brings you here? I am sure you know of the many deaths surrounding this place.
dialogsBegin.fil: Ano ang kailangan mo dito? Sigurado ako alam mo na maraming namatay sa lugar na ito.
dialogsBegin.fr: Que fais-tu ici ? Ne sais-tu pas qu'un grand nombre de personnes sont mortes en ces lieux ? Oh, serais-tu ici pour enquêter sur la mort de ces gens ?
dialogsBegin.id: Apa yang membawamu kesini? Aku yakin kamu tahu banyak kematian disekitar tempat ini.
dialogsBegin.it: What brings you here? I am sure you know of the many deaths surrounding this place.
dialogsBegin.jp: 人間がこんなところへ何の用だ？ここは人間が足を踏み入れたが最後、決して帰れない場所だぞ。ああ、そうか！ひょっとして、その事件について調べに来たのか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 이곳에는 무슨 일이죠? 이곳을 둘러싼 수많은 죽음에 대해 들어보셨을 텐데요.
dialogsBegin.nl: What brings you here? I am sure you know of the many deaths surrounding this place.
dialogsBegin.pl: Co Cię tu sprowadza? Jestem pewien, że wiesz jak wiele umarłych otacza to miejsce.
dialogsBegin.ru: Чего тебе нужно? Тут смерть, смерть и ничего, кроме смерти!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Qué te trae por aquí? Estoy seguro de que conoces las muchas muertes de este lugar.
dialogsBegin.sw: What brings you here? I am sure you know of the many deaths surrounding this place.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณมีธุระอะไรที่นี่? ฉันแน่ใจว่าคุณคงรู้ว่ารอบๆ สถานที่นี้มีแต่ความตาย
dialogsBegin.tw: 嗯～你來這裡幹嗎？難道你不知道以前這裡死了很多人嗎？這裡不是人類可以進入的地方啦！滾！呵呵～我懂了你是來調查以前為什麼有那麼多人在這裡死亡的，對吧！
dialogsBegin.vi: Điều gì mang bạn đến đây? Tôi chắc rằng bạn biết về nhiều cái chết xung quanh nơi này.

dialogsBegin.en: You will not be able to find out what happened here without my help. I will tell you what you want to know if you do me a favor. What do you think?
dialogsBegin.ar: You will not be able to find out what happened here without my help. I will tell you what you want to know if you do me a favor. What do you think?
dialogsBegin.br: Você não poderá descobrir o que ocorreu aqui sem a minha ajuda. Eu lhe direi o que você deseja saber se me fizer um favor. O que você acha?
dialogsBegin.cns: 这样的话～你没有我的帮助应该是很难知道的啦！不然你帮我一件事情好了，那我就告诉你一些情报。如何啊？要帮我吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Ohne meine Hilfe wirst du nicht herausfinden, was hier passiert ist.Ich helfe dir, wenn du mir einen Gefallen tust. Was hältst du davon?
dialogsBegin.fi: You will not be able to find out what happened here without my help. I will tell you what you want to know if you do me a favor. What do you think?
dialogsBegin.fil: Di mo makikita kung ano nangyari dito kung di kita tutulungan. Sasabihin ko sayo kung ano gusto mo malaman if gagawan mo ako ng pabor. Ano sa tingin mo?
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu ne peux pas découvrir le cours des événements sans mon aide. Si tu me rends certains services, je t'apprendrais quelque chose. Es-tu prêt à m'aider ?
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu tidak diperbolehkan untuk mencari tahu apa yang terjadi disini tanpa bantuanku. Aku akan memberitahumu apa yang ingin kamu ketahui jika kamu membantuku. Bagaimana menurutmu?
dialogsBegin.it: You will not be able to find out what happened here without my help. I will tell you what you want to know if you do me a favor. What do you think?
dialogsBegin.jp: だったら、俺がその事件の顛末を教えてやってもいいぜ。ただし、その前に片付けてほしい事があるんだが、どうだ？　取引といかないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 여기서 무슨 일이 있었는지 알고 싶으시겠죠? 제 도움 없이는 전말을 알기 어려울 거예요. 제가 부탁하는 일 하나만 해주시면 사건의 전말을 알려 드릴게요. 어때요?
dialogsBegin.nl: You will not be able to find out what happened here without my help. I will tell you what you want to know if you do me a favor. What do you think?
dialogsBegin.pl: Bez mojej pomocy nie dowiesz się, co się tutaj wydarzyło. Powiem ci to, co chcesz wiedzieć, jeśli wyświadczysz mi przysługę. Co myślisz?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь знать, что произошло? Узнаешь. Если я тебе помогу. А если не помогу - ни за что не узнаешь. Хочешь, чтобы я тебе помог? Тогда помоги мне!
dialogsBegin.sp: No podrás averiguar qué pasó aquí sin mi ayuda. Te diré lo que quieres saber si me haces un favor. ¿Qué te parece?
dialogsBegin.sw: You will not be able to find out what happened here without my help. I will tell you what you want to know if you do me a favor. What do you think?
dialogsBegin.th: คุณจะไม่รู้เลยว่าเกิดอะไรขึ้นที่นี่ถ้าไม่ได้รับความช่วยเหลือจากฉัน ฉันจะบอกสิ่งที่คุณต้องการ ถ้าคุณช่วยฉัน คุณว่าไง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 這樣的話～你沒有我的幫助應該是很難知道的啦！不然你幫我一件事情好了，那我就告訴你一些情報。如何啊？要幫我嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn sẽ không thể tìm ra những gì đã xảy ra ở đây nếu không có sự giúp đỡ của tôi. Tôi sẽ cho bạn biết những gì bạn muốn biết nếu bạn giúp tôi. Bạn nghĩ sao?

dialogsAccept.en: Bring me 30 Cillin and I will tell you everything you need to know.
dialogsAccept.ar: Bring me 30 Cillin and I will tell you everything you need to know.
dialogsAccept.br: Traga-me 30 Cillins e eu contarei tudo o que você deseja saber.
dialogsAccept.cns: 呼～好！可是我要先测试一下，你是不是有能力可以帮我。这矿库里有一个叫做矽磷的东西，你去搜集30个回来给我吧！
dialogsAccept.de: Bring mir 30 Cillin und ich beantworte dir all deine Fragen.
dialogsAccept.fi: Bring me 30 Cillin and I will tell you everything you need to know.
dialogsAccept.fil: Bigyan mo ako ng 30 Cillin at sasabihin ko sayo lahat ng gusto mo malaman.
dialogsAccept.fr: Bien. Mais je dois tout d'abord te soumettre à un petit test. Ici dans la mine il y a des pierres qu'on nomme des Cillins. J'aimerais que tu m'en ramènes 30 exemplaires.
dialogsAccept.id: Bawakan aku 30 Cillin dan aku akan memberitahumu semuanya yang ingin kamu ketahui.
dialogsAccept.it: Bring me 30 Cillin and I will tell you everything you need to know.
dialogsAccept.jp: よし、取引成立だ！だが、簡単な頼みじゃないから、まずは小手調べといこうじゃないか。この辺りに落ちている＜シルリン＞という鉱物の結晶を30個、集めて来てくれないか。
dialogsAccept.kr: 실린 30개를 가져오면, 궁금해하는 걸 전부 알려 드릴게요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Bring me 30 Cillin and I will tell you everything you need to know.
dialogsAccept.pl: Przynieś mi 30 Cillinów, a powiem ci wszystko, co musisz wiedzieć.
dialogsAccept.ru: Принеси мне тридцать осколков силлиния. Тогда и поговорим.
dialogsAccept.sp: Tráeme 30 Cillin y te diré todo lo que necesitas saber.
dialogsAccept.sw: Bring me 30 Cillin and I will tell you everything you need to know.
dialogsAccept.th: นำ Cillin มาให้ฉัน 30 ชิ้นแล้วฉันจะบอกทุกอย่าง
dialogsAccept.tw: 呼～好！可是我要先測試一下，你是不是有能力可以幫我。這礦庫裡有一個叫做矽磷的東西，你去蒐集 30 個回來給我吧！
dialogsAccept.vi: Hãy mang cho tôi 30 Cillin và tôi sẽ cho bạn biết mọi thứ bạn cần biết.

dialogsDecline.en: Pssh, some great hero, you cannot even bring me some simple stones.
dialogsDecline.ar: Pssh, some great hero, you cannot even bring me some simple stones.
dialogsDecline.br: Humpf, grande herói! Você nem mesmo é capaz de me trazer algumas pedrinhas.
dialogsDecline.cns: 连帮我捡个石头都那么难喔！那你还想知道矿山的秘密？好笑勒！滚回家啦你～
dialogsDecline.de: Hmpf... so ein großer Held kann nicht mal ein paar Steine besorgen?
dialogsDecline.fi: Pssh, some great hero, you cannot even bring me some simple stones.
dialogsDecline.fil: Pssh, isang magaling na bayani, pero di mo mabigay sakin ang simpleng bato.
dialogsDecline.fr: Si tu n'es même pas capable de me ramener ces quelques pierres, tu ferais mieux de rentrer chez toi et de piquer un somme… Non, mais franchement...
dialogsDecline.id: Pssh, pahlawan hebat, kamu bahkan tidak bisa membawakanku beberapa batu sederhana.
dialogsDecline.it: Pssh, some great hero, you cannot even bring me some simple stones.
dialogsDecline.jp:
石拾いさえ出来ないで、この鉱山の秘密を調べるつもりか？
生きてるうちに引き返した方がいいんじゃないか？
dialogsDecline.kr: 쳇, 무슨 대단한 영웅이라더니, 돌 몇 개도 못 가져오고 말이죠.
dialogsDecline.nl: Pssh, some great hero, you cannot even bring me some simple stones.
dialogsDecline.pl: Pssh, jakiś wielki bohater, nie możesz mi nawet przynieść prostych kamieni.
dialogsDecline.ru: Фи! Тоже мне еще, герой! Камни собрать, и то боится!
dialogsDecline.sp: Pssh, especie de gran héroe, ni siquiera puedes traerme unas simples piedras.
dialogsDecline.sw: Pssh, some great hero, you cannot even bring me some simple stones.
dialogsDecline.th: ฮีโร่บางคนเก่งมากนะ แต่ก็ยังไม่สามารถนำหินมาได้ง่ายๆ
dialogsDecline.tw: 連幫我撿個石頭都那麼難喔！那你還想知道礦坑的秘密？好笑勒！滾回家啦你～
dialogsDecline.vi: Pssh, một số anh hùng vĩ đại, bạn thậm chí không thể mang lại cho tôi một số viên đá đơn giản.

dialogsComplete.en: Hmm… I did not think you would be back so soon. Take this money as a gift.
dialogsComplete.ar: Hmm… I did not think you would be back so soon. Take this money as a gift.
dialogsComplete.br: Hmm…Eu não pensava que você voltaria tão cedo. Pegue este dinheiro como um presente.
dialogsComplete.cns: 嗯...虽然是很简单的事情，可以你还是帮我搜集好了，好吧！从现在开始要进行重要的事情了，这是我的一点小心意，你就先收下吧！
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm… so schnell hab ich dich nicht zurück erwartet. Nimm das als Geschenk.
dialogsComplete.fi: Hmm… I did not think you would be back so soon. Take this money as a gift.
dialogsComplete.fil: Hmm… I did not think you would be back so soon. Take this money as a gift.
dialogsComplete.fr: Hmm… Bon, ok… On va dire que tu as réussi le test. Mais ne t'en vantes pas, il était trop facile. Mais bon, voici ta récompense. Accepte cet argent en remerciement.
dialogsComplete.id: Hmm…Aku menyangka kamu kembali begitu cepat. Ambil uang ini sebagai hadiah.
dialogsComplete.it: Hmm… I did not think you would be back so soon. Take this money as a gift.
dialogsComplete.jp: うーん...こんなに早く戻ってくるとは思わなかった。このお金を贈り物として送ろう
dialogsComplete.kr: 흐음... 이렇게 빨리 돌아오실 줄은 몰랐네요. 이 돈은 선물이에요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Hmm… I did not think you would be back so soon. Take this money as a gift.
dialogsComplete.pl: Hmm… nie sądziłem, że wrócisz tak szybko. Weź te pieniądze w prezencie.
dialogsComplete.ru: Хм… Не думал, что ты вернёшься так скоро. Возьми эти деньги в подарок.
dialogsComplete.sp: Hmm... No pensé que volverías tan pronto. Toma este dinero como regalo.
dialogsComplete.sw: Hmm… I did not think you would be back so soon. Take this money as a gift.
dialogsComplete.th: อืม... ฉันไม่คิดว่าคุณจะกลับเร็วขนาดนี้ รับเงินนี้เป็นของขวัญ
dialogsComplete.tw: 嗯……沒想到你這麼快就回來了。這些錢就當作送你的禮物吧。
dialogsComplete.vi: Hmm… Tôi không nghĩ rằng bạn sẽ trở lại sớm như vậy. Hãy chấp nhận số tiền này như một món quà nhé.

dialogsFail.en: I said 30. Not 29 or 28. Bring me 30 Cillin.
dialogsFail.ar: I said 30. Not 29 or 28. Bring me 30 Cillin.
dialogsFail.br: Eu disse 30 e não 29 ou 28. Traga-me 30 Cillins.
dialogsFail.cns: 30个啦！不是29个、也不是28个，是30个。听懂了没有！
dialogsFail.de: Ich sagte 30. nicht 29 oder 28. Bring mir 30 Cillin.
dialogsFail.fi: I said 30. Not 29 or 28. Bring me 30 Cillin.
dialogsFail.fil: Sabi ko 30. Hindi 29 o 28. Bigyan mo ako ng 30 Cillin.
dialogsFail.fr: J'avais dit 30 ! Pas 28, pas 29, mais 30 ! Ce n'est pourtant pas compliqué non ? 30 Cillins !
dialogsFail.id: Aku bilang 30. Bukan 29 atau 28. Bawakan aku 30 Cillin.
dialogsFail.it: I said 30. Not 29 or 28. Bring me 30 Cillin.
dialogsFail.jp: 30個だ。29個じゃないぞ！正確に30個を持ってきてくれ。
dialogsFail.kr: 실린 30개라고 했잖아요. 29개, 28개는 안 돼요. 30개여야 해요.
dialogsFail.nl: I said 30. Not 29 or 28. Bring me 30 Cillin.
dialogsFail.pl: Powiedziałem 30. Nie 29 czy 28. Przynieś mi 30 Cilin.
dialogsFail.ru: Тридцать! Неужели так трудно запомнить?! Не двадцать восемь! Не двадцать девять! Тридцать!!!
dialogsFail.sp: He dicho 30. Ni 29 ni 28. Tráeme 30 Cillin.
dialogsFail.sw: I said 30. Not 29 or 28. Bring me 30 Cillin.
dialogsFail.th: ฉันบอกแล้วว่า 30 ไม่ใช่ 29 หรือ 28 นำ Cillin มา 30 รายการ
dialogsFail.tw: 30 個啦！不是 29 個、也不是 28 個，是 30 個。聽懂了沒有！
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi nói 30. Không phải 29 hay 28. Mang cho tôi 30 Cillin.
