description.en: Keep gathering your beads.
description.ar: Keep gathering your beads.
description.br: Continue juntando suas pérolas.
description.cns: 收集旁边地上的珠子（盒子
description.de: Sammle 10 Gem of Sin, um dein Karma zu bereinigen.
description.fi: Keep gathering your beads.
description.fil: Ituloy ang pag iipon ng iyong bulitas.

description.id: Terus kumpulkan manik-manikmu.
description.it: Continua a raccogliere le perle.
description.jp: 「罪業の珠」を集めてきなさい。
description.nl: Keep gathering your beads.
description.pl: Zbieraj dalej swoje koraliki
description.ru: Собирай бусы…
description.sp: Sigue recolectando tus perlas.
description.sw: Keep gathering your beads.
description.th: ไปเก็บลูกปัดของคุณต่อไป
description.tw: 繼續收集你的晶球。
description.vi: Tiếp tục thu thập các hạt của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: You can warp away from here at the Warp Zone but you need the Key. Are you ready to earn it?
dialogsBegin.ar: You can warp away from here at the Warp Zone but you need the Key. Are you ready to earn it?
dialogsBegin.br: É possível sair daqui pela Zona de Escape, mas você precisará da chave. Você está pronto(a) para recebê-la?
dialogsBegin.cns: 有钥匙的话可以在路两边的尽头传送出岛，你准备好去获取钥匙了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Du kannst diesen Ort über die Warp Zone verlassen. Du brauchst jedoch den Schlüssel. Bist du bereit, ihn dir zu verdienen?
dialogsBegin.fi: You can warp away from here at the Warp Zone but you need the Key. Are you ready to earn it?
dialogsBegin.fil: Makakawarp ka paalis dito sa Warp Zone ngunit kailangan mo ng susi. Handa kaba pagtrabahuhan ito?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu bisa berbelok dari sini di Warp Zone tapi kamu membutuhkan kunci. Kamu siap untuk mendapatkannya?
dialogsBegin.it: Puoi andartene da qui verso la Zona Warp ma hai bisogno della chiave. Sei pronto a guadagnartela?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 워프 존을 통해 여기서 탈출할 수 있지만, 그러려면 열쇠가 필요해요. 열쇠를 얻을 준비, 되셨나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: You can warp away from here at the Warp Zone but you need the Key. Are you ready to earn it?
dialogsBegin.pl: Możesz się teleportować stąd ze Strefy Teleportacji, ale potrzebujesz Klucza. Czy jesteś gotów go zdobyć?
dialogsBegin.ru: На большую землю ведут порталы, но их не активировать без ключа. Хочешь заработать ключ?
dialogsBegin.sp: Puedes teletransportarte lejos de aquí en la Zona de Teletransporte, pero necesitas la Llave. ¿Estás listo para ganártela?
dialogsBegin.sw: You can warp away from here at the Warp Zone but you need the Key. Are you ready to earn it?
dialogsBegin.th: คุณสามารถวาร์ปออกไปจากที่นี่ได้ที่ Warp Zone แต่คุณต้องมีกุญแจ คุณพร้อมที่จะรับมันหรือไม่?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你可以在扭曲區從這裡出去，但你需要鑰匙。你準備好要贏得它了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có thể di chuyển khỏi đây tại Warp Zone nhưng bạn cần có Chìa khóa. Bạn đã sẵn sàng để kiếm được nó chưa?

dialogsAccept.en: I will give you the Key if you can bring me $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Beads of Sin. You can get the beads in the empty lot beside the campsite.
dialogsAccept.ar: I will give you the Key if you can bring me $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Beads of Sin. You can get the beads in the empty lot beside the campsite.
dialogsAccept.br: Te darei a Chave se você puder me trazer $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Pérolas do Pecado. Você poderá obter as pérolas no terreno vazio atrás da área de acampamento.
dialogsAccept.cns: 拿来$QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$解脱水晶球，我就带你离开这。你可以在营地旁边找到它。
dialogsAccept.de: Ich werde dir den Schlüssel geben, wenn du mir $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Beads of Sin bringst. Du kannst sie in dem Feld neben dem Camp sammeln.
dialogsAccept.fi: I will give you the Key if you can bring me $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Beads of Sin. You can get the beads in the empty lot beside the campsite.
dialogsAccept.fil: Handa kitang bigyan ng susi basta dalahan mo ako ng $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Beads of Sin. Makakakuha ka ng beads sa isang bakanteng lote tabi ng campsite.
dialogsAccept.fr: Trouve $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Gemmes du péché et je t'offrirai la Clé pour sortir d'ici. Tu peux trouver les Gemmes derrière le camp.
dialogsAccept.id: Aku akan memberikanmu kunci jika kamu bisa membawakan aku $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Beads of Sin. Kamu bisa mendapatkan manik-manik itu ditempat kosong disamping perkemahan.
dialogsAccept.it: Ti darò la chiave se mi porti $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Perle del peccato. Puoi prendere le perle nel posto vuoto accanto al campeggio.
dialogsAccept.jp: 罪業の珠を$QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$個持ってきていただければ鍵を差し上げます。このキャンプ場付近で見つかるはずですよ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 죄의 구슬 $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$개를 가져오면 열쇠를 드리겠습니다. 구슬은 야영지 옆 공터에서 얻을 수 있어요.
dialogsAccept.nl: I will give you the Key if you can bring me $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Beads of Sin. You can get the beads in the empty lot beside the campsite.
dialogsAccept.pl: Dam ci Klucz, jeśli przyniesiesz mi $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Beads of Sin. Koraliki możesz zdobyć na pustej parceli obok kempingu.
dialogsAccept.ru: Я дам тебе ключ в обмен на $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ бус греха. Ищи бусы на пустыре за лагерем.
dialogsAccept.sp: Te daré la Llave si me traes $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Perlas del Pecado. Puedes conseguir las perlas en el terreno vacío al lado del campamento.
dialogsAccept.sw: I will give you the Key if you can bring me $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Beads of Sin. You can get the beads in the empty lot beside the campsite.
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันจะให้กุญแจคุณ ถ้าคุณนำ Beads of Sin มา $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ คุณจะหา Beads of Sin ได้ในพื้นที่ว่างข้างแคมป์
dialogsAccept.tw: 如果你能給我帶來 $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ 解脫罪過的晶球，我將會給你鑰匙。你可在露營地旁邊的空地上獲得晶球。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi sẽ đưa cho bạn Chìa khóa nếu bạn có thể mang lại cho tôi $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Hạt tội lỗi. Bạn có thể lấy các hạt ở bãi đất trống bên cạnh khu cắm trại.

dialogsDecline.en: How long until you are ready to leave this place?
dialogsDecline.ar: How long until you are ready to leave this place?
dialogsDecline.br: Quanto tempo até você estar pronto para deixar esse local?
dialogsDecline.cns: 不知道你何时可以逃脱这个阴暗之地...
dialogsDecline.de: Wie lange wird es dauern, bis du diesen Ort verlassen kannst?
dialogsDecline.fi: How long until you are ready to leave this place?
dialogsDecline.fil: Gano pa katagal bago ikaw ay maging handa para umalis sa lugar na ito?
dialogsDecline.fr: Quand expieras-tu tes nombreux crimes ?
dialogsDecline.id: Berapa lama lagi sampai kamu siap untuk meninggalkan tempat ini?
dialogsDecline.it: Quanto tempo manca prima che tu sia pronto ad andartene da qui?
dialogsDecline.jp: いつになったら、この底知れぬ罪悪感から抜けられるのだろう？
dialogsDecline.kr: 언제 여기서 벗어날 수 있을지...
dialogsDecline.nl: How long until you are ready to leave this place?
dialogsDecline.pl: Ile potrzebujesz czasu aby być gotowy do opuszczenia tego miejsca?
dialogsDecline.ru: Тебе тут так понравилось, что уходить не хочется?..
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Cuánto tiempo va a pasar hasta que estés listo para salir de aquí?
dialogsDecline.sw: How long until you are ready to leave this place?
dialogsDecline.th: ิเมื่อไหร่คุณจะพร้อมไปจากที่นี่สักที
dialogsDecline.tw: 不知道你何時可以逃脫這個陰暗的罪過…
dialogsDecline.vi: Bao lâu cho đến khi bạn sẵn sàng rời khỏi nơi này?

dialogsComplete.en: Here is the Key. Now go and never return.
dialogsComplete.ar: Here is the Key. Now go and never return.
dialogsComplete.br: Aqui está a Chave. Agora vá e não retorne nunca mais.
dialogsComplete.cns: 钥匙给你，走吧，别再让我看到你。
dialogsComplete.de: Hier hast du  den Schlüssel. Nun geh und komm niemals zurück.
dialogsComplete.fi: Here is the Key. Now go and never return.
dialogsComplete.fil: Eto ang susi. Ngayon umalis kana at wag kana bumalik.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Ini kuncinya. Sekarang pergi dan jangan kembali.
dialogsComplete.it: Ecco la Chiave. Ora vattene e non tornare mai più.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 임무를 완수 했으니 열쇠를 주겠네. 앞으로는 착하게 살게.
dialogsComplete.nl: Here is the Key. Now go and never return.
dialogsComplete.pl: Tutaj masz Klucz. Teraz idź i nigdy nie wracaj
dialogsComplete.ru: Вот ключ. Уходи - и не возвращайся!
dialogsComplete.sp: Aquí está la Llave. Ahora vete y no vuelvas.
dialogsComplete.sw: Here is the Key. Now go and never return.
dialogsComplete.th: นี่กุญแจ ทีนี้ก็ไปซะ แล้วไม่ต้องกลับมาอีกนะ
dialogsComplete.tw: 鑰匙在這裡。現在去，永遠不要回來。
dialogsComplete.vi: Đây là chìa khoá. Bây giờ đi và không bao giờ trở lại.

dialogsFail.en: I will give you your freedom for only $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ beads. How could you pass on an offer like that?
dialogsFail.ar: I will give you your freedom for only $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ beads. How could you pass on an offer like that?
dialogsFail.br: Concederei a sua liberdade por apenas $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ pérolas. Como você pode ignorar uma oferta como essa?
dialogsFail.cns: 只有拿来$QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$解脱水晶，我才会给你自由。
dialogsFail.de: Ich gebe dir deine Freiheit für nur $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Beads. Wie könnte man ein solches Angebot ausschlagen?
dialogsFail.fi: I will give you your freedom for only $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ beads. How could you pass on an offer like that?
dialogsFail.fil: Bibigyan kita ng kalayaan para sa $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ beads. Pano mo hindi tatanggapin ang usapan na yan?
dialogsFail.fr: Je peux te rendre ta liberté pour seulement $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Gemmes du Péché. Comment peux-tu ignorer une telle offre ?
dialogsFail.id: Aku akan memberikanmu kebebasan hanya untuk $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ manik-manik. Bagaimana kamu bisa memberikan tawaran seperti itu?
dialogsFail.it: Ti darò la tua libertà solo per $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ perle. Come potresti rifiutare un'offerta del genere?
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志はあるか？ならば「罪業の珠」を$QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$個集めろ。ここから脱出はさせないぞ。
dialogsFail.kr: $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$개의 구슬만 주면 자유를 드리죠. 이런 제안을 마다할 이유가 있을까요?
dialogsFail.nl: I will give you your freedom for only $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ beads. How could you pass on an offer like that?
dialogsFail.pl: Dam ci wolność za jedyne $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ beads. Jak mógłbyś przegapić taką ofertę?
dialogsFail.ru: Свобода в обмен на какие-то несчастные $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ бус… Кто же отказывается от такого предложения?..
dialogsFail.sp: Te daré tu libertad por solo $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ perlas. ¿Cómo pudiste pasar una oferta así?
dialogsFail.sw: I will give you your freedom for only $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ beads. How could you pass on an offer like that?
dialogsFail.th: ฉันจะให้อิสระคุณในราคาแค่ $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ เม็ด คุณบอกปัดข้อเสนอแบบนั้นได้งั้นเหรอ?
dialogsFail.tw: 只要 $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ 顆晶球，我就還你自由。這麼好的條件，你怎麼可能拒絕？
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi sẽ cho bạn sự tự do chỉ với $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ hạt. Làm thế nào bạn có thể chuyển một đề nghị như vậy?

description.en: Defeat Seido near the west of Flarine. Speak with Magician Instructor Lopaze once he has been defeated.
description.ar: Defeat Seido near the west of Flarine. Speak with Magician Instructor Lopaze once he has been defeated.
description.br: Derrote Seido ao oeste de Flarine. Fale com a Instrutora Mago Lopaze assim que derrotar o monstro.
description.cns: Defeat Seido near the west of Flarine. Speak with Magician Instructor Lopaze once he has been defeated.
description.de: Besiege Seido in der Nähe des westlichen Flaris. Spreche mit Magician Instructor Lopaze sobald er besiegt wurde.
description.fi: Defeat Seido near the west of Flarine. Speak with Magician Instructor Lopaze once he has been defeated.
description.fil: Defeat Seido near the west of Flarine. Speak with Magician Instructor Lopaze once he has been defeated.
description.fr: Se débarrasser de Seido, le monstre rôdant à l'ouest de Flarine, puis se présenter à l'Instructrice des Magiciens de Flarine.
description.id: Kalahkan Seido di dekat barat Flarine. Bicaralah dengan Magician Instructor Lopaze setelah dia dikalahkan.
description.it: Defeat Seido near the west of Flarine. Speak with Magician Instructor Lopaze once he has been defeated.
description.jp: フラリスの西に現れたという邪悪なセイムを倒してから、マジシャン訓練所の助手のところへ向かおう。
description.kr: 플라리네 서쪽에서 세이도를 처치하세요. 세이도를 처치한 후, 매지션 교관 로파즈와 대화하세요.
description.nl: Defeat Seido near the west of Flarine. Speak with Magician Instructor Lopaze once he has been defeated.
description.pl: Defeat Seido near the west of Flarine. Speak with Magician Instructor Lopaze once he has been defeated.
description.ru: Defeat Seido near the west of Flarine. Speak with Magician Instructor Lopaze once he has been defeated.
description.sp: Derrota al Seido que esta cerca de Flarine. Habla con la Instructora Maga Lopaze cuando lo derrotes.
description.sw: Defeat Seido near the west of Flarine. Speak with Magician Instructor Lopaze once he has been defeated.
description.th: กำจัด Seido ใกล้ ทางตะวันตกของ Flarine คุยกับ Magician Instructor Lopaze เมื่อเขาพ่ายแพ้
description.tw: 擊敗布拉里斯西部附近的賽多，擊敗後與魔法使訓練助教螺波提尼交談。
description.vi: Đánh bại Seido gần phía tây của Flarine. Nói chuyện với Magician Instructor Lopaze khi nó đã bị đánh bại.

dialogsBegin.en: You learn quickly, Vagrant! Perhaps you will be a great Magician one day! Here, take this. It is a Label of Technique that details what I've explained to you today.
dialogsBegin.ar: You learn quickly, Vagrant! Perhaps you will be a great Magician one day! Here, take this. It is a Label of Technique that details what I've explained to you today.
dialogsBegin.br: Você aprende rápido, Vagrant! Talvez você seja um(a) grande mago(a) um dia! Aqui, pegue isso. É um Pergaminho de Técnica que detalha o que expliquei a você hoje.
dialogsBegin.cns: 大概懂了吧?我给你的技能的小纸条绝对不可以弄丢，也不可以丢在地上啊!那是很重要的东西，不然我绝对部会负责啦!
dialogsBegin.de: Jetzt verstehst du es. Nicht wahr? So gut lehrte ich. Verliere ja nicht das Label of Technique, weil es sehr wichtig ist. Ich trage keine Verantwortung für ihn. Verstanden?
dialogsBegin.fi: You learn quickly, Vagrant! Perhaps you will be a great Magician one day! Here, take this. It is a Label of Technique that details what I've explained to you today.
dialogsBegin.fil: You learn quickly, Vagrant! Perhaps you will be a great Magician one day! Here, take this. It is a Label of Technique that details what I've explained to you today.
dialogsBegin.fr: Voilà, je t'ai enseigné tout ce que je savais. Et surtout, n'oublie jamais cette technique, compris?
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu belajar dengan cepat, Vagrant! Mungkin kamu akan menjadi Magician yang hebat suatu hari nanti! Ambil ini. Ini adalah Label of Technique yang menjelaskan apa yang telah aku jelaskan hari ini.
dialogsBegin.it: You learn quickly, Vagrant! Perhaps you will be a great Magician one day! Here, take this. It is a Label of Technique that details what I've explained to you today.
dialogsBegin.jp: クククッ、ちゃんとわかったか？このスキル事典の破片は、くれぐれも失くさないようにしてくれよ！とても大事なものだからな。
dialogsBegin.kr: 배움이 빠르네요, 방랑자님! 대매지션이 될 소질이 있어요. 자, 이걸 드릴게요. 오늘 알려 드린 내용을 담은 기술 비전서랍니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: You learn quickly, Vagrant! Perhaps you will be a great Magician one day! Here, take this. It is a Label of Technique that details what I've explained to you today.
dialogsBegin.pl: You learn quickly, Vagrant! Perhaps you will be a great Magician one day! Here, take this. It is a Label of Technique that details what I've explained to you today.
dialogsBegin.ru: А ты быстро учишься, бродяга! Возможно, однажды из тебя получится великий фокусник! Вот, возьми. Это страницы из "Секретов мастерства", книги, в которой есть все, о чем мы сегодня говорили.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Aprendes muy rápido, Vagrant! ¡Puede que algún día llegues a ser un gran Magician! Toma esto. Es un Libro de Técnica en el que se detalla todo lo que te he explicado.
dialogsBegin.sw: You learn quickly, Vagrant! Perhaps you will be a great Magician one day! Here, take this. It is a Label of Technique that details what I've explained to you today.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณเรียนรู้ได้อย่างรวดเร็ว Vagrant! บางทีคุณอาจจะเป็น Magician ที่ยิ่งใหญ่ในวันหนึ่ง! เอานี่เลย เป็นฉลากของเทคนิคที่ให้รายละเอียดเกี่ยวกับสิ
dialogsBegin.tw: 大概懂了吧？我給你的技能的小紙條絕對不可以弄丟，也不可以丟在地上啊！那是很重要的東西，不然我絕對不會負責啦！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn học nhanh thôi, Vagrant! Có lẽ một ngày nào đó bạn sẽ là một Magician vĩ đại! Đây, cầm lấy cái này. Đây là một Label of Technique trình bày chi tiết những gì tôi đã giải thích cho bạn hôm nay.

dialogsBegin.en: For your final task, I want you to travel to the west of Flaris and defeat the creature known as Seido. He has been harassing some of the residents of Flarine as of late.
dialogsBegin.ar: For your final task, I want you to travel to the west of Flaris and defeat the creature known as Seido. He has been harassing some of the residents of Flarine as of late.
dialogsBegin.br: Para sua tarefa final, quero que você vá para o oeste de Flaris e derrote a criatura conhecida como Seido. Ele tem assediado alguns dos residentes de Flarine recentemente.
dialogsBegin.cns: For your final task, I want you to travel to the west of Flaris and defeat the creature known as Seido. He has been harassing some of the residents of Flarine as of late.
dialogsBegin.de: Als letzte Aufgabe möchte ich, dass du in den Westen von Flaris reist und die Kreatur namens Seide besiegst. Er hat in letzter Zeit einige Bewohner von Flaris belästigt.
dialogsBegin.fi: For your final task, I want you to travel to the west of Flaris and defeat the creature known as Seido. He has been harassing some of the residents of Flarine as of late.
dialogsBegin.fil: For your final task, I want you to travel to the west of Flaris and defeat the creature known as Seido. He has been harassing some of the residents of Flarine as of late.
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais pour l'instant, voici ta dernière épreuve. Te souviens-tu où se trouve le l'Entraîneur des Magiciens à Flarine ? Tu y trouveras aussi une Instructrice, son nom est... Euh en fait j'ai oublié son nom.
dialogsBegin.id: Untuk tugas terakhirmu, aku ingin kamu melakukan perjalanan ke arah selatan Flaris dan mengalahkan makhluk yang dikenal sebagai Seido. Dia telah melecehkan beberapa penduduk Flarin akhir-akhir ini.
dialogsBegin.it: For your final task, I want you to travel to the west of Flaris and defeat the creature known as Seido. He has been harassing some of the residents of Flarine as of late.
dialogsBegin.jp: 最後の任務として、フラリスの西へ行き、セイムと呼ばれるモンスターを倒してください。最近、フラリスの住民に嫌がらせをしているようなんです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 마지막 임무를 드리죠. 플라리스 서쪽으로 가서 세이도라는 생명체를 처치하세요. 최근 플라리네 주민을 괴롭힌다고들 하더군요.
dialogsBegin.nl: For your final task, I want you to travel to the west of Flaris and defeat the creature known as Seido. He has been harassing some of the residents of Flarine as of late.
dialogsBegin.pl: For your final task, I want you to travel to the west of Flaris and defeat the creature known as Seido. He has been harassing some of the residents of Flarine as of late.
dialogsBegin.ru: For your final task, I want you to travel to the west of Flaris and defeat the creature known as Seido. He has been harassing some of the residents of Flarine as of late.
dialogsBegin.sp: Para tu tarea final, quiero que viajes al Oeste de Flaris y derrotes a la criatura conocida como Seido. Últimamente ha estado acosando a algunos de los residentes de Flarine.
dialogsBegin.sw: For your final task, I want you to travel to the west of Flaris and defeat the creature known as Seido. He has been harassing some of the residents of Flarine as of late.
dialogsBegin.th: สำหรับงานสุดท้ายของคุณ ฉันต้องการให้คุณเดินทางไปยังทางตะวันตกของ Flaris และกำจัดสิ่งมีชีวิตที่รู้จักกันในชื่อ Seido เขาได้รังควานชาวเมือง Flarine บางส่วนแล้ว
dialogsBegin.tw: 為了你的最後一個任務，我希望你前往布拉里斯的西部並擊敗名為塞多的怪物。他最近一直在騷擾布拉里斯的一些居民。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đối với nhiệm vụ cuối cùng, tôi muốn bạn đi đến phía tây của Flaris và đánh bại sinh vật được gọi là Seido. Gần đây nó đã quấy rối một số cư dân của Flarine.

dialogsBegin.en: Once Seido is defeated, speak with Magician Instructor Lopaze in Eastern Flarine. She will conclude your training.
dialogsBegin.ar: Once Seido is defeated, speak with Magician Instructor Lopaze in Eastern Flarine. She will conclude your training.
dialogsBegin.br: Assim que Seido for derrotado, fale com a Instrutora dos Magos, Lopaze no Leste de Flarine. Ela concluirá seu treinamento.
dialogsBegin.cns: Once Seido is defeated, speak with Magician Instructor Lopaze in Eastern Flarine. She will conclude your training.
dialogsBegin.de: Sobald Seido besiegt wurde spreche mit Magician Instructor Lopaze in Ost-Flaris. Sie wird dein Training abschließen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Once Seido is defeated, speak with Magician Instructor Lopaze in Eastern Flarine. She will conclude your training.
dialogsBegin.fil: Once Seido is defeated, speak with Magician Instructor Lopaze in Eastern Flarine. She will conclude your training.
dialogsBegin.fr: Quoi qu'il en soit, pour lui prouver ta valeur, tu dois chasser une nouvelle espèce de monstre avant d'aller la voir. Il attaque les gens près du Saint Arbre. son nom est Seido.
dialogsBegin.id: Setelah Seido dikalahkan, bicaralah dengan Magician Instructor Lopaze di Eastern Flarine. Dia akan mengakhiri pelatihanmu.
dialogsBegin.it: Once Seido is defeated, speak with Magician Instructor Lopaze in Eastern Flarine. She will conclude your training.
dialogsBegin.jp: 青道を倒したら、東フラリスにいる魔術師教官ロパーゼに話しかける。彼女はあなたのトレーニングを終了します。
dialogsBegin.kr: 세이도를 처치한 후, 플라리네 동쪽에 있는 매지션 교관 로파즈와 대화하세요. 로파즈가 훈련을 마무리해 줄 것입니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Once Seido is defeated, speak with Magician Instructor Lopaze in Eastern Flarine. She will conclude your training.
dialogsBegin.pl: Once Seido is defeated, speak with Magician Instructor Lopaze in Eastern Flarine. She will conclude your training.
dialogsBegin.ru: Once Seido is defeated, speak with Magician Instructor Lopaze in Eastern Flarine. She will conclude your training.
dialogsBegin.sp: Una vez que hayas derrotado a Seido, habla con la Instructora Maga Lopaze en Flarine Oriental. Ella concluirá tu entrenamiento.
dialogsBegin.sw: Once Seido is defeated, speak with Magician Instructor Lopaze in Eastern Flarine. She will conclude your training.
dialogsBegin.th: เมื่อ Seido พ่ายแพ้ ให้คุยกับ Magician Instructor Lopaze ใน Eastern Flarine เธอจะสรุปการฝึกอบรมของคุณ
dialogsBegin.tw: 一旦塞多被擊敗，與布拉里斯東部的魔法使訓練助教螺波提尼 交談。她會結束你的訓練。
dialogsBegin.vi: Khi Seido bị đánh bại, hãy nói chuyện với Magician Instructor Lopaze ở Eastern Flarine. Cô ấy sẽ kết thúc quá trình huấn luyện của bạn.

dialogsAccept.en: You've done very well so far, young one. Keep up the great work!
dialogsAccept.ar: You've done very well so far, young one. Keep up the great work!
dialogsAccept.br: Vá! Estou cheio de ficar com você.
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你一路顺风啊~
dialogsAccept.de: Nun gehe! Ich bin deiner überdrüssig. Gehe schnell fort!
dialogsAccept.fi: You've done very well so far, young one. Keep up the great work!
dialogsAccept.fil: You've done very well so far, young one. Keep up the great work!
dialogsAccept.fr: Bonne chance !
dialogsAccept.id: Kamu telah melakukannya dengan sangat baik sejauh ini, anak muda. Pertahankan!
dialogsAccept.it: You've done very well so far, young one. Keep up the great work!
dialogsAccept.jp: 次にやるべきことはわかったよな？じゃ、健闘を祈るぜ！
dialogsAccept.kr: 지금까지 아주 잘하셨어요. 계속 그렇게만 하세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: You've done very well so far, young one. Keep up the great work!
dialogsAccept.pl: You've done very well so far, young one. Keep up the great work!
dialogsAccept.ru: Пока что у тебя все идет отлично. Продолжай в том же духе!
dialogsAccept.sp: Lo has hecho muy bien hasta ahora, joven. ¡Continúa así!
dialogsAccept.sw: You've done very well so far, young one. Keep up the great work!
dialogsAccept.th: คุณทำได้ดีมากจนถึงตอนนี้ หนุ่มน้อย ทำดีต่อไป!
dialogsAccept.tw: 你目前做得非常好，年輕人。繼續保持！
dialogsAccept.vi: Bạn đã làm rất tốt, bạn trẻ. Tiếp tục làm tốt thế nhé!

dialogsDecline.en: You've come a long way just to give up when you're so close to the end. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ar: You've come a long way just to give up when you're so close to the end. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.br: Você percorreu um longo caminho apenas para desistir quando está tão perto do fim. Fale comigo novamente se mudar de ideia.
dialogsDecline.cns: 是吗?看你要不要继续做下去啦~反正对我来说无所谓啊!嘻嘻嘻。
dialogsDecline.de: Belastet es dich? Gut, es liegt bei dir. Das ist nicht meine Angelegenheit. Es ist mir gleich, ob du aufhörst oder weitermachst.
dialogsDecline.fi: You've come a long way just to give up when you're so close to the end. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fil: You've come a long way just to give up when you're so close to the end. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu n'es pas intéressé ? Tant pis, je ne peux pas le faire pour toi de toute façon.
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu telah menempuh perjalanan jauh hanya untuk menyerah ketika kamu sudah sangat dekat dengan akhir. Bicaralah denganku lagi jika kamu berubah pikiran.
dialogsDecline.it: You've come a long way just to give up when you're so close to the end. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.jp: 面倒くさくなったのか。まあ、おまえがテストを諦めようが諦めなかろうが、オレには関係ない話さ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 이만큼이나 해놓고 인제 와서 포기하실 건가요? 생각이 바뀌면 언제든 다시 말씀하세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: You've come a long way just to give up when you're so close to the end. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.pl: You've come a long way just to give up when you're so close to the end. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ru: Стоило ли тратить столько сил, чтобы сдаться у самого финиша? Если передумаешь, возвращайся.
dialogsDecline.sp: Has recorrido un largo camino para rendirte cuando estás tan cerca del final. Habla conmigo de nuevo si cambias de opinión.
dialogsDecline.sw: You've come a long way just to give up when you're so close to the end. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณมาไกลเพียงเพื่อยอมแพ้เมื่อคุณใกล้ถึงจุดจบ พูดกับฉันอีกครั้งถ้าคุณเปลี่ยนใจ
dialogsDecline.tw: 是嗎？看你要不要繼續做下去啦~反正對我來說無所謂啊！嘻嘻嘻。
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn đã trải qua một chặng đường dài chỉ để từ bỏ khi bạn sắp hoàn thành sao. Nói chuyện lại với tôi nếu bạn thay đổi ý định.

dialogsComplete.en: Great job, young Vagrant! I think you'll make a fine Magician.
dialogsComplete.ar: Great job, young Vagrant! I think you'll make a fine Magician.
dialogsComplete.br: Bom trabalho, jovem Vagrant! Acredito que serás um(a) ótimo(a) Mago(a).
dialogsComplete.cns: 做得好，年轻的初心者！你会成为卓越的魔导士的
dialogsComplete.de: Gut gemacht, junger Vagrant! Ich glaube, du wirst ein guter Magier werden.
dialogsComplete.fi: Great job, young Vagrant! I think you'll make a fine Magician.
dialogsComplete.fil: Great job, young Vagrant! I think you'll make a fine Magician.
dialogsComplete.fr: Merci beaucoup, il était important de s'occuper de ce monstre. Voici la dernière leçon : elle est sur le rôle du Magicien, écoute-moi bien.
dialogsComplete.id: Kerja bagus, Vagrant muda! Aku pikir kamu akan menjadi Magician yang baik.
dialogsComplete.it: Great job, young Vagrant! I think you'll make a fine Magician.
dialogsComplete.jp: 無事にテストを終わらせることができましたね。この調子で次のテストも頑張ってください。
dialogsComplete.kr: 훌륭해요, 젊은 방랑자님! 훌륭한 매지션이 될 자질이 있군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Great job, young Vagrant! I think you'll make a fine Magician.
dialogsComplete.pl: Great job, young Vagrant! I think you'll make a fine Magician.
dialogsComplete.ru: Great job, young Vagrant! I think you'll make a fine Magician.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Excelente trabajo, joven Vagrant! Creo que serás un buen Magician.
dialogsComplete.sw: Great job, young Vagrant! I think you'll make a fine Magician.
dialogsComplete.th: ทำได้ดีมาก Vagrant! ฉันคิดว่าคุณจะเป็น Magician ที่ดีได้
dialogsComplete.tw: 做得好，年輕的見習生！我想你會成為一名優秀的魔法使。
dialogsComplete.vi: Làm tốt lắm, Vagrant trẻ! Tôi nghĩ bạn sẽ trở thành một Magician giỏi.

dialogsComplete.en: As Magicians, we are most effective when attacking at long range. Many of our skills employ the power of the elements.
dialogsComplete.ar: As Magicians, we are most effective when attacking at long range. Many of our skills employ the power of the elements.
dialogsComplete.br: Ser um Mago consiste em travar combates de longa distância, por isso a fraqueza no combate corpo-a-corpo. Mas ele pode atacar vários inimigos distantes de uma só vez.
dialogsComplete.cns: 魔导士主要使用远距离攻击，因为魔导士的体力很弱，所以必须进行远距离攻击，而且魔导士也可以进行大范围的范围性攻击。
dialogsComplete.de: Der Magician ist zwar schwach im Nahkampf, aber sehr stark beim Angriff aus der Entfernung. Viele unserer Fähigkeiten ziehen ihre Stärke aus den Elementen.
dialogsComplete.fi: As Magicians, we are most effective when attacking at long range. Many of our skills employ the power of the elements.
dialogsComplete.fil: As Magicians, we are most effective when attacking at long range. Many of our skills employ the power of the elements.
dialogsComplete.fr: Le Magicien à la particularité d'utiliser des sorts pour se battre à distance, mais se montre très faible au corps-à-corps. Heureusement une Téléportation te permettra de rester en sécurité.
dialogsComplete.id: Sebagai Magician, kami paling efektif saat menyerang jarak jauh. Banyak dari skill kami yang menggunakan kekuatan elemen.
dialogsComplete.it: As Magicians, we are most effective when attacking at long range. Many of our skills employ the power of the elements.
dialogsComplete.jp: マジシャンはその名のとおり、遠距離戦闘型の職業です。接近戦は向いていないので、遠い場所から魔法を使い強力な攻撃をする戦闘スタイルとなります。また、魔法によっては周囲にいる複数の敵を1回の攻撃で倒すこともできます。
dialogsComplete.kr: 매지션은 원거리 공격에 특화되어 있어요. 그리고 많은 기술이 속성에 깃 힘을 이용하죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: As Magicians, we are most effective when attacking at long range. Many of our skills employ the power of the elements.
dialogsComplete.pl: As Magicians, we are most effective when attacking at long range. Many of our skills employ the power of the elements.
dialogsComplete.ru: Мы, фокусники, предпочитаем сражаться издалека. В основе наших трюков лежит сила стихий.
dialogsComplete.sp: Como Magician, somos más eficaces cuando atacamos a larga distancia. Muchas de nuestras habilidades utilizan los poderes de los elementos.
dialogsComplete.sw: As Magicians, we are most effective when attacking at long range. Many of our skills employ the power of the elements.
dialogsComplete.th: ในฐานะ Magicians เรามีประสิทธิภาพสูงสุดในการโจมตีระยะไกล ทักษะหลายอย่างของเราใช้พลังของธาตุต่างๆ
dialogsComplete.tw: 魔法師主要使用遠距離攻擊，因為魔法師的體力很弱，所以必須進行遠距離攻擊，而且魔法師也可以進行大範圍的範圍性攻擊。
dialogsComplete.vi: Là Magicians, chúng tôi hiệu quả nhất khi tấn công ở tầm xa. Nhiều kỹ năng của chúng tôi sử dụng sức mạnh của các yếu tố đó.

dialogsComplete.en: This allows us to take advantage of elemental vulnerabilities that our enemies may have. Congratulations, young one! You are now a Magician!
dialogsComplete.ar: This allows us to take advantage of elemental vulnerabilities that our enemies may have. Congratulations, young one! You are now a Magician!
dialogsComplete.br: Além disso, é mais útil em um combate em conjunto do que em combates individuais. Parabéns! Agora você é um(a) Mago(a)!
dialogsComplete.cns: 而且，在混合战斗中，可以使出良好的威力。恭喜你成为魔导士!魔导士加油!
dialogsComplete.de: Im Vergleich zu anderen Kampfberufen ist der Magician sehr viel stärker im Einzelkampf. Gratulation! Deine Ausbildung ist vollendet. Von jetzt an bist du ein Magician!
dialogsComplete.fi: This allows us to take advantage of elemental vulnerabilities that our enemies may have. Congratulations, young one! You are now a Magician!
dialogsComplete.fil: This allows us to take advantage of elemental vulnerabilities that our enemies may have. Congratulations, young one! You are now a Magician!
dialogsComplete.fr: Toutes mes félicitations ! Tu es désormais Magicien ! N'oublies pas d'utiliser les éléments de tes sorts pour exploiter la faiblesse de tes ennemis.
dialogsComplete.id: Ini memungkinkan kita untuk memanfaatkan kerentanan elemen yang mungkin dimiliki musuh kita. Selamat, anak muda! Kamu sekarang adalah seorang Magician!
dialogsComplete.it: This allows us to take advantage of elemental vulnerabilities that our enemies may have. Congratulations, young one! You are now a Magician!
dialogsComplete.jp: マジシャンは一人で戦うよりも、仲間と一緒に戦うことでその威力を発揮します。さあ、これで全てのテストが終わりました。おめでとうございます！これからもより知識を深め、より大きな魔力を自在に操る優秀なマジシャンへと成長してくださいね。
dialogsComplete.kr: 적의 속성 약점을 이용하면 전투를 유리하게 이끌 수 있답니다. 축하합니다, 젊은이. 이제 매지션이에요!
dialogsComplete.nl: This allows us to take advantage of elemental vulnerabilities that our enemies may have. Congratulations, young one! You are now a Magician!
dialogsComplete.pl: This allows us to take advantage of elemental vulnerabilities that our enemies may have. Congratulations, young one! You are now a Magician!
dialogsComplete.ru: Самый верный способ победить врага - понять, перед какой стихией он уязвим, и выбрать нужный прием. Поздравляю тебя! Отныне ты - фокусник.
dialogsComplete.sp: Esto nos permite tomar ventaja de las vulnerabilidades elementales que tienen los enemigos. ¡Felicidades, joven! ¡Ahora ya eres un Magician!
dialogsComplete.sw: This allows us to take advantage of elemental vulnerabilities that our enemies may have. Congratulations, young one! You are now a Magician!
dialogsComplete.th: สิ่งนี้ทำให้เราสามารถใช้ประโยชน์จากจุดอ่อนของธาตุที่ศัตรูของเราอาจมี ขอแสดงความยินดี เจ้าหนู! ตอนนี้คุณเป็น Magician แล้ว!
dialogsComplete.tw: 而且，在混合戰鬥中，可以使出良好的威力。恭喜你成為魔法師！魔法師加油！
dialogsComplete.vi: Điều này cho phép chúng tôi tận dụng các lỗ hổng cơ bản mà kẻ thù của chúng tôi có. Xin chúc mừng, bạn trẻ! Bạn bây giờ là một Magician!

dialogsFail.en: I sure wish someone would take care of that Seido creature near Flarine… Oh, hello! Did you need something?
dialogsFail.ar: I sure wish someone would take care of that Seido creature near Flarine… Oh, hello! Did you need something?
dialogsFail.br: Eu realmente gostaria que alguém tomasse conta daquela criatura chamado Seido perto de Flarine... Oh, olá! Você precisava de algo?
dialogsFail.cns: 我真希望有人能教训一下帕里的那只小依蛾啊…哦，你好！你需要什么吗？
dialogsFail.de: Ich wünschte, jemand würde sich dieser Kreatur namens Seido in der Nähe von Flaris annehmen... Oh hallo! Brauchst du etwas?
dialogsFail.fi: I sure wish someone would take care of that Seido creature near Flarine… Oh, hello! Did you need something?
dialogsFail.fil: I sure wish someone would take care of that Seido creature near Flarine… Oh, hello! Did you need something?
dialogsFail.fr: Je n'ai pas le temps de m'occuper de toi désolé, les monstres n'attendent pas.
dialogsFail.id: Aku sangat berharap seseorang akan merawat makhluk Seido dekat Flarine itu… Oh, halo! Apakah kamu membutuhkan sesuatu?
dialogsFail.it: I sure wish someone would take care of that Seido creature near Flarine… Oh, hello! Did you need something?
dialogsFail.jp: 誰かがフラリスの近くにいる青道の生き物の世話をしてくれたらいいのに…ああ、こんにちは！何か必要でしたか？
dialogsFail.kr: 누가 플라리네 근처의 세이도 녀석들을 처리해줬으면 좋겠네요… 어, 안녕하세요! 무슨 일로 오셨나요?
dialogsFail.nl: I sure wish someone would take care of that Seido creature near Flarine… Oh, hello! Did you need something?
dialogsFail.pl: I sure wish someone would take care of that Seido creature near Flarine… Oh, hello! Did you need something?
dialogsFail.ru: I sure wish someone would take care of that Seido creature near Flarine… Oh, hello! Did you need something?
dialogsFail.sp: Ojalá que alguien se haga cargo de esa criatura llamada Seido que está cerca de Flarine... ¡Oh, hola! ¿Necesitas algo?
dialogsFail.sw: I sure wish someone would take care of that Seido creature near Flarine… Oh, hello! Did you need something?
dialogsFail.th: ฉันหวังว่าจะมีคนดูแล Seido ที่อยู่ใกล้กับFlarine… โอ้ สวัสดี! คุณต้องการอะไร?
dialogsFail.tw: 我真希望有人能照顧布拉里斯附近的那個塞多……哦，你好！你需要什麼嗎？
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi chắc là tôi ước ai đó sẽ chăm sóc sinh vật Seido đó gần Flarine… Ồ, xin chào! Bạn cần gì sao?

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsDecline.ar: You have yet to pay for your sins…

dialogsDecline.cns: 你还没有为你的罪恶付出代价...
dialogsDecline.de: Du musst noch immer für deine Sünden bezahlen...
dialogsDecline.fi: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.fil: Di mo pa bayad ang iyong mga kasalanan…

dialogsDecline.it: Devi ancora pagare per i tuoi peccati...
dialogsDecline.jp: いつになったら、この底知れぬ罪悪感から抜けられるのだろう？
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신은 아직 죗값을 치르지 않았으니...
dialogsDecline.nl: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.pl: Musisz najpierw zapłacić za swoje grzechy…
dialogsDecline.ru: Велики твои грехи…
dialogsDecline.sp: Todavía tienes que pagar por tus pecados...
dialogsDecline.sw: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.th: คุณยังไม้ได้ชดใช้บาปของคุณ...

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.br: Sua missão foi concluída. Seus pecados foram perdoados.
dialogsComplete.cns: 任务完成，你的罪恶已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Buße getan. Deine Sünden wurden dir vergeben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Questmu telah tercapai. Dosa-dosamu telah diampuni.
dialogsComplete.it: La Missione è terminata. I tuoi peccati sono stati perdonati.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 끝났습니다. 당신의 죄를 용서하지요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Боги одобрили твое деяние и простили тебе грехи.
dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น บาปของคุณได้รับการอภัยแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nhiệm vụ của bạn đã được hoàn thành. Tội lỗi của bạn đã được tha thứ.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Oh, nice to see you again. I have found something based on the data you gave me. You know more than most about the Clowns at this point.
dialogsBegin.ar: Oh, nice to see you again. I have found something based on the data you gave me. You know more than most about the Clowns at this point.
dialogsBegin.br: Ah, é bom vê-lo novamente. Encontrei algo com base nos dados que você me deu. Você já sabe mais do que a maioria sobre os Palhaços.
dialogsBegin.cns: 啊，你来了啊。我用你帮我找来的资料研究了下..你知道小丑吗?还是有听过他的事情吗?
dialogsBegin.de: Oh, schön dich wiederzusehen. Durch die Daten, die du mir gegeben hast, habe ich etwas gefunden. Hast du jemals was von den Clowns gehört?
dialogsBegin.fi: Oh, nice to see you again. I have found something based on the data you gave me. You know more than most about the Clowns at this point.
dialogsBegin.fil: Oh, nice to see you again. I have found something based on the data you gave me. You know more than most about the Clowns at this point.
dialogsBegin.fr: J'ai bien étudié le Livre de Laola, mais je n'aurai jamais pensé que la légende des Clowns était réelle !
dialogsBegin.id: Ah, senang bertemu denganmu lagi. Aku telah menemukan sesuatu berdasarkan data yang kau berikan padaku. Kamu tahu lebih banyak tentang Clown pada titik ini.
dialogsBegin.it: Oh, nice to see you again. I have found something based on the data you gave me. You know more than most about the Clowns at this point.
dialogsBegin.jp: あ、君か。ちょうど良いところに来た。このまえ君から届けてもらった資料からわかったことがある。君は＜いにしえのピエロ＞について聞いたことがあるだろう？
dialogsBegin.kr: 아, 다시 뵙게 되어 반가워요. 전에 주신 자료를 바탕으로 뭔가를 찾아냈어요. 이제는 당신이 광대에 대해 더 잘 알고 있겠지만.
dialogsBegin.nl: Oh, nice to see you again. I have found something based on the data you gave me. You know more than most about the Clowns at this point.
dialogsBegin.pl: Oh, nice to see you again. I have found something based on the data you gave me. You know more than most about the Clowns at this point.
dialogsBegin.ru: А, это ты! Как раз вовремя: последний кусочек картинки встал на место. Позволь, я расскажу, как все было. Во время Геройской войны Арлакин бился плечом к плечу с героями…
dialogsBegin.sp: Oh, me alegra verte de nuevo. He encontrado algo basado en los datos que me diste. Ya sabes mucho más que la mayoría de la gente sobre los Payasos.
dialogsBegin.sw: Oh, nice to see you again. I have found something based on the data you gave me. You know more than most about the Clowns at this point.
dialogsBegin.th: โอ้ ยินดีที่ได้พบคุณอีกครั้ง ฉันพบบางอย่างจากข้อมูลที่คุณให้ฉัน คุณรู้มากกว่าคนส่วนใหญ่เกี่ยวกับตัวตลก ณ จุดนี้
dialogsBegin.tw: 啊，你來了啊。我用你幫我找來的資料研究了一下…你知道小丑嗎？還是有聽過他的事情嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Ồ, rất vui được gặp lại bạn. Tôi đã tìm thấy một cái gì đó dựa trên dữ liệu bạn cung cấp cho tôi. Bạn biết nhiều hơn hầu hết về những chú hề vào thời điểm này.

dialogsBegin.en: People have been talking about them for some time now. They are known as three devils that created our continents on accident and are bent on destroying them. During the Hero War, they were said to stand against the heroes of our land.
dialogsBegin.ar: People have been talking about them for some time now. They are known as three devils that created our continents on accident and are bent on destroying them. During the Hero War, they were said to stand against the heroes of our land.
dialogsBegin.br: As pessoas vêm falando sobre eles há algum tempo. Eles são conhecidos como os três demônios que criaram nossos continentes acidentalmente e querem destruí-los. Durante a Guerra dos Heróis, diz-se que eles ficaram contra os heróis de nossa terra.
dialogsBegin.cns: 一直以来，人们一直在谈论他们。 被称为三个恶魔的他们，在无意间创造了我们的大陆，然后又一心要摧毁它。 在英雄战争期间，据说他们与我们的英雄为敌。
dialogsBegin.de: Die Leute reden schon seit einiger Zeit über sie. Sie sind als die 3 Teufel bekannt, die unsere Kontinente aus Versehen erschaffen haben, und nun alles tun wollen um sie wieder zu zerstören. Man sagt dass sie sich während des Heldenkriegs gegen die Helden unseres Landes gestellt haben.
dialogsBegin.fi: People have been talking about them for some time now. They are known as three devils that created our continents on accident and are bent on destroying them. During the Hero War, they were said to stand against the heroes of our land.
dialogsBegin.fil: People have been talking about them for some time now. They are known as three devils that created our continents on accident and are bent on destroying them. During the Hero War, they were said to stand against the heroes of our land.
dialogsBegin.fr: Oui, parce que des gens en ont parlé, mais tout le monde sait qu'ils étaient les diables qui ont menacé Madrigal durant la Guerre des Héros.
dialogsBegin.id: Orang-orang telah membicarakan mereka akhir-akhir ini. Mereka dikenal sebagai tiga iblis yang menciptakan benua kita secara tidak sengaja dan bertekad untuk menghancurkannya. Menurut rumor, selama Hero War, mereka menjadi lawan dari pahlawan kita.
dialogsBegin.it: People have been talking about them for some time now. They are known as three devils that created our continents on accident and are bent on destroying them. During the Hero War, they were said to stand against the heroes of our land.
dialogsBegin.jp: 人々の間では恐ろしい悪魔として古くから言い伝えられているからな。しかしその存在については、決め手となる証拠がなかった。フラリス地方にいくつか伝説に絡む名残があったが、歴史的観点からは名ばかりの伝説として考えられていた。
dialogsBegin.kr: 사람들은 꽤 오래전부터 광대에 대해 이야기했어요. 실수로 대륙을 만들어낸 뒤, 지금은 다시 파괴하려는 세 악마죠. 영웅 전쟁 당시, 우리 영웅들에 맞서 싸운 존재들이라고 하더군요.
dialogsBegin.nl: People have been talking about them for some time now. They are known as three devils that created our continents on accident and are bent on destroying them. During the Hero War, they were said to stand against the heroes of our land.
dialogsBegin.pl: People have been talking about them for some time now. They are known as three devils that created our continents on accident and are bent on destroying them. During the Hero War, they were said to stand against the heroes of our land.
dialogsBegin.ru: Но злая Тень подчинила себе его душу. Объединив свою силу с силой фокусника, она попыталась уничтожить Лучик - и потерпела поражение.
dialogsBegin.sp: La gente ha estado hablando de ellos desde hace algún tiempo. Se conocen como los tres Dioses que crearon nuestros continentes por accidente. Y ahora Shade está empeñada en destruir el mundo. Se dice que durante la Guerra de los Héroes estaba en contra de los héroes.
dialogsBegin.sw: People have been talking about them for some time now. They are known as three devils that created our continents on accident and are bent on destroying them. During the Hero War, they were said to stand against the heroes of our land.
dialogsBegin.th: มีคนพูดถึงพวกเขามาระยะหนึ่งแล้ว พวกมันเป็นที่รู้จักในนามมารสามตัวที่สร้างทวีปของเราโดยบังเอิญและตั้งใจที่จะทำลายพวกมัน ในช่วงสงครามฮีโร่ พวกเขาถูกกล่าวขานว่ายืนหยัดต่อสู้กับวีรบุรุษแห่งแผ่นดินของเรา
dialogsBegin.tw: 嗯，你應該也有聽說啦，因為很多人都會提到…大概只知道他是恐嚇人類的一個惡魔吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Mọi người đã nói về chúng trong một thời gian. Họ được biết đến như ba ác quỷ đã tạo ra lục địa của chúng ta một cách tình cờ và đang muốn phá hủy chúng. Trong Chiến tranh Anh hùng, họ được cho là đứng chống lại những anh hùng của đất nước chúng ta.

dialogsBegin.en: Lapranche was there, at the end of the Hero War, she was made the slave of One of the three Clown Gods. Shade, Goddess of Evil. Shade, marrying her Godly presence to the great power of Laola, attempted to destroy Bubble, God of Good, while Iblis, God of Neutrality, watched unmoved. Bubble rallied the heroes of Madrigal and stood against Shade with the strongest army our world has ever know at her back.
dialogsBegin.ar: Lapranche was there, at the end of the Hero War, she was made the slave of One of the three Clown Gods. Shade, Goddess of Evil. Shade, marrying her Godly presence to the great power of Laola, attempted to destroy Bubble, God of Good, while Iblis, God of Neutrality, watched unmoved. Bubble rallied the heroes of Madrigal and stood against Shade with the strongest army our world has ever know at her back.
dialogsBegin.br: Lapranche estava ali. No final da Guerra dos Heróis, foi escravizada por um dos três Deuses Curingas, Shade, A Deusa do Mal. Unindo sua presença divina ao grande poder de Laola, tentou destruir Bubble, O Deus do Bem, enquanto Iblis, Deus da Neutralidade, assistia indiferente. Bubble reuniu os heróis de Madrigal e enfrentou Shade com o exército mais forte que nosso mundo já conheceu.

dialogsBegin.de: Lapranche war dabei, als sie am Ende des Heldenkriegs zur Sklavin eines der drei Clown-Götter gemacht wurde. Shade, Göttin des Bösen. Shade verband ihre göttliche Präsenz mit der großen Macht von Laola und versuchte, Bubble, den Gott des Guten, zu vernichten, während Iblis, der Gott der Neutralität, ungerührt zusah. Bubble rief die Helden von Madrigal zusammen und stellte sich Shade mit der stärksten Armee, die unsere Welt je gesehen hat, in den Weg.

dialogsBegin.fr: Bien qu'ils aient créé Madrigal, ils se sont opposés à Rhisis, et ont provoqué son courroux. Au final c'est Madrigal qui a souffert, ainsi que ses habitants…
dialogsBegin.id: Lapranche ada di sana, di akhir Hero War, dia dijadikan budak salah satu dari tiga Clown Gods, Shade. Goddess of Evil Shade, menyatukan kekuatan Dewanya dengan kekuatan besar Laola, untuk menghancurkan God of Good Bubble. Sementara God of Neutrality, Iblis, hanya diam menyaksikan. Bubble mengumpulkan para pahlawan Madrigal dibelakangnya dan melawan Shade dengan pasukan terkuat yang pernah ada di dunia kita.

dialogsBegin.jp: ロアラはそこにいました、英雄戦争の終わりに、彼女は3つのピエロの神のうちの1人の奴隷にされました。 シェード、悪の女神。 シェードは、彼女の敬虔な存在をラオラの大国と結婚させ、善の神であるバブルを破壊しようとしましたが、中立の神であるイブリスは動かずに見守っていました。 バブルはマドリガルの英雄を結集し、私たちの世界がこれまでに知っていた最強の軍隊を背負ってシェードに立ち向かいました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 영웅 전쟁이 끝날 무렵, 라프란체는 세 광대신 중 하나의 노예로 만들어졌어요. 악의 여신 쉐이드였죠. 라올라의 강력한 힘까지 손에 넣은 쉐이드는 선의 신 버블을 파괴하려 했고, 중립의 신 이블리스는 그걸 방관했죠. 버블은 마드리갈의 영웅들을 모은 세계 최강의 군대를 이끌고 쉐이드에 맞섰어요.

Shade, marrying her Godly presence to the great power of Laola, attempted to destroy Bubble, God of Good, while Iblis, God of Neutrality, watched unmoved. Bubble rallied the heroes of Madrigal and stood against Shade with the strongest army our world has ever know at her back.
dialogsBegin.th: Lapranche อยู่ที่นั่น เมื่อสิ้นสุดสงครามฮีโร่ เธอกลายเป็นทาสของหนึ่งในสามเทพเจ้าตัวตลก Shade เทพธิดาแห่งความชั่วร้าย Shade แต่งงานกับการปรากฏตัวของพระเจ้ากับพลังอันยิ่งใหญ่ของ Laola พยายามทำลาย Bubble เทพเจ้าแห่งความดี ในขณะที่ Iblis เทพเจ้าแห่งความเป็นกลางมองดูอย่างไม่หวั่นไหว Bubble รวบรวมเหล่าฮีโร่ของ Madrigal และยืนหยัดต่อสู้กับ Shade ด้วยกองทัพที่แข็งแกร่งที่สุดที่โลกของเราเคยรู้จักอยู่ข้างหลังเธอ
dialogsBegin.tw: 拉普朗什在那裡，在英雄戰爭結束時，她成為了三個小丑神之一的奴隸。闇影，邪惡女神，闇影將她的神性與拉宇的強大力量結合起來，試圖摧毀善良之神巴布樂，而中立之神伊普里司則無動於衷。巴布樂召集了瑪德利賈的英雄，並以我們世界所知道的最強大的軍隊在她背後對抗闇影。
dialogsBegin.vi: Lapranche đã ở đó, vào cuối cuộc Hero War, cô ấy bị biến thành nô lệ của Một trong ba Clown Gods. Shade, Goddess of Evil. Shade, kết hợp nhuần nhuyễn sự hiện diện thần thánh của mình với sức mạnh vĩ đại của Laola, cố gắng tiêu diệt Bubble, God of Good, trong khi Iblis, God of Neutrality, đứng nhìn không thấy động tĩnh gì. Bubble tập hợp các anh hùng của Madrigal và chống lại Shade với đội quân mạnh nhất mà thế giới của chúng ta từng biết.

dialogsBegin.en: Poor Lapranche, the things she must have gone through And all this history has been distorted by the History Society. Curse them!
dialogsBegin.ar: Poor Lapranche, the things she must have gone through And all this history has been distorted by the History Society. Curse them!
dialogsBegin.br: Pobre Lapranche, deve ter sofrido muito. Toda esta história foi distorcida pela Sociedade Histórica. Malditos sejam!
dialogsBegin.cns: Poor Lapranche, the things she must have gone through And all this history has been distorted by the History Society. Curse them!
dialogsBegin.de: Die arme Lapranche, was sie alles durchgemacht haben muss. Und all diese Geschichte wurde von der Geschichtsgesellschaft entstellt. Verflucht seien sie!
dialogsBegin.fi: Poor Lapranche, the things she must have gone through And all this history has been distorted by the History Society. Curse them!
dialogsBegin.fil: Poor Lapranche, the things she must have gone through And all this history has been distorted by the History Society. Curse them!
dialogsBegin.fr: Et le Magicien Pourpre était leur sous-fifre, qui a essayé à tout prix de cacher ce qui s'est véritablement passé aux origines de Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.id: Lapranche yang malang, hal yang dulu pernah dia lalui dan semua sejarah telah di distorsi oleh History Society. Terkutuklah mereka!
dialogsBegin.it: Poor Lapranche, the things she must have gone through And all this history has been distorted by the History Society. Curse them!
dialogsBegin.jp: ＜バイオレットシャドウ・マジシャンズ＞は、その忌まわしき存在の手下として動いている異端の魔法結社だったのだ。今まで明らかにされなかった真実が姿を現してきたぞ…
dialogsBegin.kr: 불쌍한 라프란체, 대체 어떤 일을 겪었을지.... 이 모든 역사는 역사 학회가 왜곡한 거라고요. 저주를 내려야 해요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Poor Lapranche, the things she must have gone through And all this history has been distorted by the History Society. Curse them!
dialogsBegin.pl: Poor Lapranche, the things she must have gone through And all this history has been distorted by the History Society. Curse them!
dialogsBegin.ru: Poor Lapranche, the things she must have gone through And all this history has been distorted by the History Society. Curse them!
dialogsBegin.sp: Pobre Lapranche, las cosas por las que debe haber pasado. Y toda esta historia ha sido distorsionada por la Sociedad de Historia. ¡Malditos!
dialogsBegin.sw: Poor Lapranche, the things she must have gone through And all this history has been distorted by the History Society. Curse them!
dialogsBegin.th: Lapranche น่าสงสาร สิ่งที่เธอต้องเคยผ่านมา และประวัติศาสตร์ทั้งหมดนี้ได้ถูกบิดเบือนโดยสมาคมประวัติศาสตร์ สาปแช่งพวกเขา!
dialogsBegin.tw: 可憐的拉普朗什，她一定經歷過什麼事情，這一切都被歷史學會歪曲了。詛咒他們！
dialogsBegin.vi: Lapranche tội nghiệp, những điều cô ấy phải trải qua Và tất cả lịch sử này đã bị bóp méo bởi History Society. Hãy nguyền rủa họ!

dialogsBegin.en: *sigh* Would you help me return this to Martinyc. She deserves to know what she helped uncover.
dialogsBegin.ar: *sigh* Would you help me return this to Martinyc. She deserves to know what she helped uncover.
dialogsBegin.br: *uff* Você me ajudaria a devolver isso a Martinyc? Ela merece saber o que ajudou a descobrir.
dialogsBegin.cns: 反正不管怎样，你可以把这个帮我拿给玛缇雅克吗?
dialogsBegin.de: (Er gewinnt seine Fassung wieder) Jedenfalls, würdest du mir einen Gefallen tun? Könntest du nochmal zu Martinyc gehen?
dialogsBegin.fi: *sigh* Would you help me return this to Martinyc. She deserves to know what she helped uncover.
dialogsBegin.fil: *sigh* Would you help me return this to Martinyc. She deserves to know what she helped uncover.
dialogsBegin.fr: (retrouvant son calme) Peux-tu me rendre ce dernier service ?
dialogsBegin.id: *haah* Maukah Kamu membantuku mengembalikan ini ke Martinyc. Dia berhak tahu apa yang sedang dia bantu.
dialogsBegin.it: *sigh* Would you help me return this to Martinyc. She deserves to know what she helped uncover.
dialogsBegin.jp: とりあえずはマルティニークが調査結果を首を長くして待っているだろう。君、これをマルティニークに届けてもらえないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: *한숨* 이걸 마르티닉에게 돌려보낼 건데, 도와주시겠어요? 마르티닉도 자신의 발견이 궁금할 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: *sigh* Would you help me return this to Martinyc. She deserves to know what she helped uncover.
dialogsBegin.pl: *sigh* Would you help me return this to Martinyc. She deserves to know what she helped uncover.
dialogsBegin.ru: Отнесешь эту книгу Мартинике? Мы у нее в долгу: без нее мы бы не начали это расследование и не установили бы истину.
dialogsBegin.sp: *suspiro* ¿Puedes devolverle esto a Martinyc? Merece saber lo que se ha conseguido descubrir gracias a ella.
dialogsBegin.sw: *sigh* Would you help me return this to Martinyc. She deserves to know what she helped uncover.
dialogsBegin.th: *ถอนหายใจ* คุณช่วยฉันคืนสิ่งนี้ให้ Martinyc ได้ไหม เธอสมควรที่จะรู้ว่าเธอช่วยเปิดเผยอะไร
dialogsBegin.tw: *嘆息* 你能幫我把這個還給馬特尼提特嗎？她應該知道她幫助發現了什麼。
dialogsBegin.vi: * thở dài * Bạn có thể giúp tôi trả lại cái này cho Martinyc. Cô ấy xứng đáng được biết những gì cô ấy đã giúp khám phá ra.

dialogsAccept.en: Here is all the data I have. Please deliver this to Martinyc.
dialogsAccept.ar: Here is all the data I have. Please deliver this to Martinyc.
dialogsAccept.br: Aqui estão todos os dados que tenho. Entregue isto a Martinyc.
dialogsAccept.cns: 把这个东西帮我拿去给玛缇雅克吧。这是我整理出来的结果。拜托你了。
dialogsAccept.de: Hier sind alle Daten, die ich habe. Bitte bringe sie zu Martinyc.
dialogsAccept.fi: Here is all the data I have. Please deliver this to Martinyc.
dialogsAccept.fil: Here is all the data I have. Please deliver this to Martinyc.
dialogsAccept.fr: Révéler la vérité sur l'histoire de Madrigal à Martinyc, l'historienne de Flarine.
dialogsAccept.id: Ini semua data yang kumiliki. Tolong kirimkan ini ke Martinyc.
dialogsAccept.it: Here is all the data I have. Please deliver this to Martinyc.
dialogsAccept.jp: ゴタンテが今までの調査をまとめて書き綴った巻物を、マルティニークへ届けに行こう。
dialogsAccept.kr: 제가 가진 자료 전부예요. 드릴 테니, 마르티닉에게 전해 주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Here is all the data I have. Please deliver this to Martinyc.
dialogsAccept.pl: Here is all the data I have. Please deliver this to Martinyc.
dialogsAccept.ru: Нужно отнести книгу Лолы Мартинике.
dialogsAccept.sp: Aquí están todos los datos que tengo. Por favor, entrégaselo a Martinyc.
dialogsAccept.sw: Here is all the data I have. Please deliver this to Martinyc.
dialogsAccept.th: นี่คือข้อมูลทั้งหมดที่ฉันมี โปรดส่งสิ่งนี้ให้ Martinyc
dialogsAccept.tw: 這是我所有的資訊，請把它交給馬特尼提特吧。
dialogsAccept.vi: Đây là tất cả dữ liệu tôi có. Vui lòng giao cái này cho Martinyc.

dialogsDecline.en: I see, you have something important to do. Would you come back to me after finishing that?
dialogsDecline.ar: I see, you have something important to do. Would you come back to me after finishing that?
dialogsDecline.br: Sei, você tem algo importante a fazer. Você me daria um retorno depois de terminar isso?
dialogsDecline.cns: 你现在有急事啊，好吧!等你忙完的再过来找我吧!
dialogsDecline.de: Ja, du hast wichtiges zu erledigen. Würdest du zu mir zurückkommen, wenn du damit fertig bist?
dialogsDecline.fi: I see, you have something important to do. Would you come back to me after finishing that?
dialogsDecline.fil: I see, you have something important to do. Would you come back to me after finishing that?
dialogsDecline.fr: Oh, tu as quelque chose d'important à faire ? Reviens une fois que tu auras fini.
dialogsDecline.id: Aku mengerti kamu memiliki urusan yang penting untuk dilakukan. Maukah kamu kembali menemuiku setelah urusanmu itu?
dialogsDecline.it: I see, you have something important to do. Would you come back to me after finishing that?
dialogsDecline.jp: おや、何か急用があるようだね。では、その用事が済んだら、また来てくれ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 중요한 일이 있는 것 같군요. 그 일이 끝나면 다시 와주시겠어요?
dialogsDecline.nl: I see, you have something important to do. Would you come back to me after finishing that?
dialogsDecline.pl: I see, you have something important to do. Would you come back to me after finishing that?
dialogsDecline.ru: Хорошо. Закончи свои дела. А потом все-таки выполни мою просьбу, ладно?
dialogsDecline.sp: Ya veo, tienes algo importante que hacer. ¿Volverás después de terminar eso?
dialogsDecline.sw: I see, you have something important to do. Would you come back to me after finishing that?
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันเข้าใจ คุณมีบางสิ่งที่สำคัญที่ต้องทำ คุณจะกลับมาหาฉันหลังจากทำเสร็จแล้ว?
dialogsDecline.tw: 你現在有急事啊，好吧！等你忙完的再過來找我吧！
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi hiểu rồi, bạn có việc quan trọng phải làm. Bạn có quay lại với tôi sau khi kết thúc việc đó không?

dialogsComplete.en: Long time no see! Are you coming back to let me know that I was right?
dialogsComplete.ar: Long time no see! Are you coming back to let me know that I was right?
dialogsComplete.br: Há quanto tempo! Você está voltando para me dizer que eu estava certa?
dialogsComplete.cns: 啊!好久不见啊，要拿新消息给我吗?
dialogsComplete.de: Lange nicht gesehen! Bist du zurückgekommen, um mich wissen zu lassen das ich Recht hatte?
dialogsComplete.fi: Long time no see! Are you coming back to let me know that I was right?
dialogsComplete.fil: Long time no see! Are you coming back to let me know that I was right?
dialogsComplete.fr: Ca faisait longtemps ! As-tu découvert quelque chose finalement ?
dialogsComplete.id: Lama tidak bertemu! Apakah Kamu kembali untuk memberi tahuku bahwa aku benar?
dialogsComplete.it: Long time no see! Are you coming back to let me know that I was right?
dialogsComplete.jp: お久しぶり！ようやく戻ってきましたね、待ってましたよ。私の調査が真実だったというニュースを持ってきてくれましたか？
dialogsComplete.kr: 오랜만이네요! 제가 옳았다는 걸 알려주러 오신 건가요?
dialogsComplete.nl: Long time no see! Are you coming back to let me know that I was right?
dialogsComplete.pl: Long time no see! Are you coming back to let me know that I was right?
dialogsComplete.ru: Давно не виделись! Ну как, подтвердились мои догадки?
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Cuanto tiempo sin verte! ¿Vuelves para decirme que tenía razón?
dialogsComplete.sw: Long time no see! Are you coming back to let me know that I was right?
dialogsComplete.th: ไม่ได้เจอกันนานเลยนะ! คุณกลับมาเพื่อบอกฉันว่าคิดถูกไหม
dialogsComplete.tw: 啊！好久不見啊，要拿新消息給我嗎？
dialogsComplete.vi: Lâu rồi không gặp! Bạn quay lại để cho tôi biết rằng tôi đã đúng?

dialogsComplete.en: Yeah! I knew it! By the way, what is that?
dialogsComplete.ar: Yeah! I knew it! By the way, what is that?
dialogsComplete.br: Sim! Eu sabia! Aliás, o que é isso?
dialogsComplete.cns: 耶!!我就知道会这样，哈哈哈。咦?这是什么啊?
dialogsComplete.de: (Ich nicke) Ja!! Ich wusste es!! Ho ho ho~ Nebenbei, was hast du da?
dialogsComplete.fi: Yeah! I knew it! By the way, what is that?
dialogsComplete.fil: Yeah! I knew it! By the way, what is that?
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh… je savais que je pouvais compter sur toi ! Mais qu'as-tu donc découvert ? (lisant le parchemin de Gothante)
dialogsComplete.id: Ya! Aku tahu itu! Ngomong-ngomong, apa itu?
dialogsComplete.it: Yeah! I knew it! By the way, what is that?
dialogsComplete.jp: わあ！やっぱり、やっぱりわたしの見解は真実だったのですね！ようやく人に信じてもらえることができたわ！嬉しい！
dialogsComplete.kr: 맞았죠! 역시나였어요! 근데 그건 뭔가요?
dialogsComplete.nl: Yeah! I knew it! By the way, what is that?
dialogsComplete.pl: Yeah! I knew it! By the way, what is that?
dialogsComplete.ru: Я так и знала! Расскажи все-все - от начала и до конца!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Sí! ¡Lo sabía! Por cierto, ¿qué es eso?
dialogsComplete.sw: Yeah! I knew it! By the way, what is that?
dialogsComplete.th: ใช่! ฉันกะแล้ว! ว่าแต่มันคืออะไร?
dialogsComplete.tw: 耶！！我就知道會這樣，哈哈哈。咦？這是什麼啊？
dialogsComplete.vi: Ừ! Tôi biết mà! Nhân tiện, đó là gì?

dialogsComplete.en: Oh, now I wish I had been wrong! Thank you for bringing this to me. We will see each other again. Goodbye.
dialogsComplete.ar: Oh, now I wish I had been wrong! Thank you for bringing this to me. We will see each other again. Goodbye.
dialogsComplete.br: Ah, agora queria estar errada. Obrigada por me trazer isso. Nós nos veremos novamente. Adeus.
dialogsComplete.cns: 嗯..啊?这是..谢谢你啦。下次应该还有机会碰面的，再见~
dialogsComplete.de: Oh wow! Jetzt wünschte ich, dass ich falsch gelegen hätte.. Danke, dass du mir das gebracht hast. Wir sehen uns irgendwann einmal wieder. Auf Wiedersehen!
dialogsComplete.fi: Oh, now I wish I had been wrong! Thank you for bringing this to me. We will see each other again. Goodbye.
dialogsComplete.fil: Oh, now I wish I had been wrong! Thank you for bringing this to me. We will see each other again. Goodbye.
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh !! Les Clowns… Rhisis.. Les trois îles… c'est incroyable ! Tout ce mystère est enfin éclairci ! Je te remercie infiniment, au nom de tous les habitants.
dialogsComplete.id: Oh, sekarang aku harap aku salah! Terima kasih telah membawakan ini untukku. Kita akan bertemu lagi. Selamat tinggal.
dialogsComplete.it: Oh, now I wish I had been wrong! Thank you for bringing this to me. We will see each other again. Goodbye.
dialogsComplete.jp: あら？これは？これまでの調査をまとめたゴタンテ会長の調書ですね、さっそく読んでみます！本当にありがとう！
dialogsComplete.kr: 아, 차라리 제 예감이 틀렸으면 좋았을 텐데요! 전해 주셔서 정말 감사합니다. 또 뵐 수 있겠죠. 안녕히 가세요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Oh, now I wish I had been wrong! Thank you for bringing this to me. We will see each other again. Goodbye.
dialogsComplete.pl: Oh, now I wish I had been wrong! Thank you for bringing this to me. We will see each other again. Goodbye.
dialogsComplete.ru: Ох, лучше бы я ошибалась!.. И все-таки спасибо за книгу. Надеюсь, мы останемся хорошими друзьями. Удачи тебе.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Oh, ahora desearía haberme equivocado! Gracias por traerme esto. Nos veremos de nuevo. Adiós.
dialogsComplete.sw: Oh, now I wish I had been wrong! Thank you for bringing this to me. We will see each other again. Goodbye.
dialogsComplete.th: โอ้ ตอนนี้ฉันหวังว่าฉันผิด! ขอบคุณที่นำสิ่งนี้มาให้ฉัน เราจะได้พบกันอีก ลาก่อน
dialogsComplete.tw: 嗯…啊？這是…謝謝你啦。下次應該還有機會碰面的，再見囉~
dialogsComplete.vi: Ồ, giờ tôi ước gì mình đã sai! Cảm ơn bạn đã mang điều này đến cho tôi. Chúng ta sẽ còn gặp lại nhau. Tạm biệt.

dialogsFail.en: Have you brought something from the History Society? No? Then are you coming back just to talk to me? I am too shy for that.
dialogsFail.ar: Have you brought something from the History Society? No? Then are you coming back just to talk to me? I am too shy for that.
dialogsFail.br: Trouxe algo da Sociedade Histórica? Não? Está voltando só para falar comigo? Sou tímida demais para isso
dialogsFail.cns: 历史协会有东西要给我吗?不是啊?不然呢..因为你太想我了吗?唉唷~~讨厌啦..
dialogsFail.de: Hast du etwas von der Geschichtsgesellschaft mitgebracht? Nein? Dann kommst du zu mir zurück? Ich bin schüchtern~
dialogsFail.fi: Have you brought something from the History Society? No? Then are you coming back just to talk to me? I am too shy for that.
dialogsFail.fil: Have you brought something from the History Society? No? Then are you coming back just to talk to me? I am too shy for that.
dialogsFail.fr: As-tu quelque chose à me confier ? Non ? Donc tu viens juste pour me rendre visite ? Je suis timide tu sais ~
dialogsFail.id: Apakah kamu membawa sesuatu dari History Society? Tidak ada? Apa kamu kembali hanya untuk berbicara denganku? Aku terlalu malu untuk itu.
dialogsFail.it: Have you brought something from the History Society? No? Then are you coming back just to talk to me? I am too shy for that.
dialogsFail.jp: 歴史協会から何か返事を貰ってきてくれましたか？あら、まだなのですね。ひょっとして、私に会いにきたとか？うふふ。
dialogsFail.kr: 역사협회에서 소식이 있나요? 아니에요? 그럼 왜... 혹시 제가 보고 싶어서? 세상에, 부끄럽게.
dialogsFail.nl: Have you brought something from the History Society? No? Then are you coming back just to talk to me? I am too shy for that.
dialogsFail.pl: Have you brought something from the History Society? No? Then are you coming back just to talk to me? I am too shy for that.
dialogsFail.ru: Что сказали в Историческом обществе? Ничего?.. А зачем ты тогда здесь? Поговорить? Ох, не знаю, я так редко говорю с людьми. Мои лучшие друзья - книги…
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Has traído algo de la Sociedad de Historia? ¿No? Entonces, ¿sólo vienes para hablar conmigo? Soy demasiado tímida para eso.
dialogsFail.sw: Have you brought something from the History Society? No? Then are you coming back just to talk to me? I am too shy for that.
dialogsFail.th: คุณนำอะไรมาจากสมาคมประวัติศาสตร์หรือไม่? ไม่? แล้วคุณจะกลับมาเพื่อคุยกับฉันไหม ฉันอายเกินไปสำหรับเรื่องนั้น
dialogsFail.tw: 歷史協會有東西要給我嗎？不是啊？不然呢…因為你太想我了嗎？唉唷~~討厭啦…

description.en: Dior asked for help with reducing the Rockepeller population as they're causing problems with transport between Darkon & Flaris. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.ar: Dior asked for help with reducing the Rockepeller population as they're causing problems with transport between Darkon & Flaris. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.br: A Dior pediu ajuda para reduzir a população de Rockepellers, pois eles estão causando problemas com o transporte entre Darkon e Flaris. Você poderia matar 15 deles?
description.cns: 螺旋飞行人太烦人了，他们妨碍了达肯和帕里镇之间的交通。你能杀掉15个螺旋飞行人吗？
description.de: Dior hat um Hilfe bei der Reduzierung der Rockepeller-Population gebeten, da sie Probleme beim Transport zwischen Darkon und Flaris verursachen. Könntest du 15 von ihnen töten?
description.fi: Dior asked for help with reducing the Rockepeller population as they're causing problems with transport between Darkon & Flaris. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.fil: Humiling si Dior ng tulong para bawasan ang populasyon ng Rockepeller dahil nagdudulot sila ng problema sa transportasyon sa pagitan ng Darkon at Flaris. Puwede mo bang patayin ang 15 sa kanila?
description.fr: Dior a besoin d'aide pour réduire la population de Rockepeller, car ils causent des problèmes de transport entre Darkon et Flaris. Peux-tu en tuer 15 ?
description.id: Dior meminta bantuan untuk mengurangi populasi Rockpeller karena mereka mulai mengganggu transportasi antara Darkon & Flaris. Bisakah kamu habisi 15 dari mereka?
description.it: Dior asked for help with reducing the Rockepeller population as they're causing problems with transport between Darkon & Flaris. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.jp: ディオールから、ロケッペラーの数を減らしてほしいと頼まれています。ダーコンとフラリス間の輸送に支障をきたしているとのことです。15体討伐していただけませんか？
description.kr: 디올이 로케펠러의 수를 줄여 달라고 부탁했어요. 다콘과 플라리스 사이 교통에 문제가 될 정도라는군요. 로케펠러 15마리만 잡아주실 수 있나요?
description.nl: Dior asked for help with reducing the Rockepeller population as they're causing problems with transport between Darkon & Flaris. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.pl: Dior poprosił o pomoc w zmniejszeniu populacji Śmigłowników, ponieważ powodują problemy z transportem między Darkon i Flaris. Czy możesz zabić 15 z nich?
description.ru: Dior asked for help with reducing the Rockepeller population as they're causing problems with transport between Darkon & Flaris. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.sp: Dior ha pedido ayuda para reducir la población de Rockepellers, ya que están causando problemas con el transporte entre Darkon y Flaris. ¿Podrías derrotar a 15 de ellos?
description.sw: Dior asked for help with reducing the Rockepeller population as they're causing problems with transport between Darkon & Flaris. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.th: Dior ขอความช่วยเหลือเกี่ยวกับการลดจำนวน Rockepeller เนื่องจากพวกเขากำลังสร้างปัญหากับการขนส่งระหว่าง Darkon และ Flaris คุณสามารถฆ่าพวกมัน 15 ตัวได้หรือไม่?
description.tw: 寶雅尋求幫助，想減少飛行胖波尼的數量，因為牠們正在造成得肯與布拉里斯之間的交通問題。你能幫忙擊殺 15 隻嗎？
description.vi: Dior đã yêu cầu trợ giúp để giảm dân số Rockepeller vì chúng đang gây ra vấn đề với giao thông giữa Darkon và Flaris. Bạn có thể giết 15 trong số chúng không?

dialogsAccept.nl: You can collect Unknown Certificates near the Bangs.
dialogsAccept.pl: You can collect Unknown Certificates near the Bangs.

dialogsDecline.fr: Tu n'es pas intéressé par cette mission ? Tant pis… Mais si tu changes d'avis, reviens me voir.
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu tidak ingin mengumpulkannya? Oke
dialogsDecline.it: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsDecline.jp: 依頼をキャンセルなさるのですね。あなたならお願い出来ると思ったのですが、残念です。

dialogsDecline.pl: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsDecline.ru: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
