description.en: Defeat Iblis Guardian and enter the altar.
description.ar: Defeat Iblis Guardian and enter the altar.
description.br: Derrote o Guardião Iblis e entre no altar.
description.cns: 击败秘殿警戒者，进入祭坛。
description.de: Besiege Ivillis Guarder und gelange zum Altar.
description.fi: Defeat Iblis Guardian and enter the altar.
description.fil: Talunin ang Iblis Guardian at pumasok sa altar.
description.fr: Vaincre le Ivillis Guarder pour atteindre l'autel.
description.id: Kalahkan Iblis Guardian dan masuk ke altar.
description.it: Defeat Iblis Guardian and enter the altar.
description.jp: イブリス神殿内にいるイブル・プレジャーを倒し、イブリスの紋章を手に入れましょう。
description.kr: 이블리스 가디언을 처치하고 제단 안으로 들어가세요.
description.nl: Defeat Iblis Guardian and enter the altar.
description.pl: Pokonaj Iblis Guardian i wejdź do ołtarza.
description.ru: Чтобы пройти к алтарю, нужно убить Ужассного стража.
description.sp: Derrota al Guardián de Iblis y entra al altar.
description.sw: Defeat Iblis Guardian and enter the altar.
description.th: เอาชนะ Iblis Guardian และเข้าไปแท่นบูชา
description.tw: 從拓本的內文來看，這地穴赤焰鳳凰，就是維護祭團的怪物！
description.vi: Đánh bại Người canh gác Iblis và tiến vào tế đàn

dialogsBegin.en: Hi. I have studied the information you brought me and I have found that there is an altar in the Iblis Temple. There is also evidence that there are masquerpets guarding the altar.
dialogsBegin.ar: Hi. I have studied the information you brought me and I have found that there is an altar in the Iblis Temple. There is also evidence that there are masquerpets guarding the altar.
dialogsBegin.br: Oi. Estudei as informações trazidas por você e descobri que existe um altar no Templo Iblis. Também há evidências de que existem masquerpets guardando o altar.
dialogsBegin.cns: 以你找到的相关消息来看，这幻魔依普利神殿里真的有祭团的存在……
dialogsBegin.de: Hallo! Ich habe deine Informationen sorgfältig überprüft und fand heraus, dass es einen Altar im Ivillis Temple gibt. Es gibt zudem Hinweise auf Masquerpets, die diesen Altar bewachen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Hi. I have studied the information you brought me and I have found that there is an altar in the Iblis Temple. There is also evidence that there are masquerpets guarding the altar.
dialogsBegin.fil: Hi. Inaral ko ang impormasyong dinala mo at natuklasan kong may isang altar sa Iblis Temple. May ebidensya rin na may mga masquerpets na nagbabantay sa altar.
dialogsBegin.fr: Bienvenue ! J’ai vérifié avec soin les informations que tu as collectées pour moi. J’ai découvert qu’il existe un autel au sein du temple. Par ailleurs…
dialogsBegin.id: Hai. Aku telah mempelajari informasi yang kamu berikan kepadaku dan aku telah menemukan bahwa ada sebuah altar di Iblis Temple. Ada juga bukti bahwa ada topeng yang menjaga altar.
dialogsBegin.it: Hi. I have studied the information you brought me and I have found that there is an altar in the Iblis Temple. There is also evidence that there are masquerpets guarding the altar.
dialogsBegin.jp: 黙示録の写本を解読したところ、神殿のどこかに祭壇があること、その祭壇はイブリスに魅入られしもの達によって守られていることがわかりました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 안녕하세요. 당신이 주신 정보를 토대로 검토한 결과, 이블리스 신전에 제단이 있다는 게 밝혀졌어요. 그리고 그 제단을 지키는 마스커펫들이 있다는 것도요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Hi. I have studied the information you brought me and I have found that there is an altar in the Iblis Temple. There is also evidence that there are masquerpets guarding the altar.
dialogsBegin.pl: Cześć. Przestudiowałem informacje, które mi przyniosłeś i odkryłem, że w świątyni Iblis znajduje się ołtarz. Istnieją również dowody na to, że ołtarza strzegą masquerpets.
dialogsBegin.ru: Я поразмыслил, полистал архивы и узнал, что в глубине Храма Ужосса должен быть алтарь. Его-то и стерегут марионетки.
dialogsBegin.sp: Hola. Estudié la información que me trajiste y descubrí que hay un altar en el Templo de Iblis. También hay evidencia de que hay masquerpets custodiando el altar.
dialogsBegin.sw: Hi. I have studied the information you brought me and I have found that there is an altar in the Iblis Temple. There is also evidence that there are masquerpets guarding the altar.
dialogsBegin.th: สวัสดี ฉันได้ศึกษาข้อมูลที่คุณนำมา และฉันได้พบว่ามีแท่นบูชาอยู่ในวิหาร Iblis นอกจากนี้ยังมีหลักฐานว่ามี masquerpets เฝ้าแท่นบูชาอยู่
dialogsBegin.tw: 從你帶回來的資訊看來，伊普里司神殿裡確實有一座祭壇，而且似乎還有假面怪在守著它……
dialogsBegin.vi: Chào. Tôi đã nghiên cứu thông tin mà bạn mang đến cho tôi và tôi thấy rằng có một tế đàn trong Đền Iblis. Cũng có bằng chứng cho thấy rằng có những con masquerpets canh giữ tế đàn.

dialogsBegin.en: Do you see? They do not want anyone to interupt the revival of Iblis. We need to do something. We need to stop them!
dialogsBegin.ar: Do you see? They do not want anyone to interupt the revival of Iblis. We need to do something. We need to stop them!
dialogsBegin.br: Você percebe? Eles não querem que ninguém interrompa a ressurreição de Iblis. Precisamos fazer alguma coisa. Precisamos pará-los!
dialogsBegin.cns: 祭团的存在，也与拓本里的内文相符，这绝不是巧合！
dialogsBegin.de: Verstehst du? Sie wollen verhindern, dass jemand die Auferstehung von Ivillis stört. Wir müssen etwas unternehmen! Wir müssen sie aufhalten!
dialogsBegin.fi: Do you see? They do not want anyone to interupt the revival of Iblis. We need to do something. We need to stop them!
dialogsBegin.fil: Nakikita mo? Ayaw nila ng sinuman na makagambala sa pagbabangon ni Iblis. Kailangan nating kumilos. Kailangan natin silang pigilin!
dialogsBegin.fr: … des gardes protègent cet autel. Ceci prouve que la prophétie contenue dans la Révélation d’Ivillis est réellement en train de se réaliser. Nous devons absolument faire quelque chose !
dialogsBegin.id: Apakah kamu lihat? Mereka tidak ingin ada orang yang mengganggu kebangkitan Iblis. Kita perlu melakukan sesuatu. Kita harus menghentikan mereka!
dialogsBegin.it: Do you see? They do not want anyone to interupt the revival of Iblis. We need to do something. We need to stop them!
dialogsBegin.jp: これまでの調査結果と黙示録の内容とは完全に一致しています……。残念ながら、黙示録の内容は事実のようですね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 모르시겠어요? 이블리스가 부활할 때 방해받지 않으려고 하는 거예요. 우리가 막아야 해요! 반드시!
dialogsBegin.nl: Do you see? They do not want anyone to interupt the revival of Iblis. We need to do something. We need to stop them!
dialogsBegin.pl: Czy ty to widzisz? Nie chcą, aby ktokolwiek przerwał odrodzenie Iblisa. Musimy coś zrobić. Musimy ich powstrzymać!
dialogsBegin.ru: Понимаешь, что это значит? Они следят, чтобы никто не помешал воскрешению их хозяина!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Lo ves? No quieren que nadie interrumpa el renacimiento de Iblis. Necesitamos hacer algo. ¡Tenemos que detenerlos!
dialogsBegin.sw: Do you see? They do not want anyone to interupt the revival of Iblis. We need to do something. We need to stop them!
dialogsBegin.th: คุณเข้าใจไหม? พวกเขาไม่ต้องการให้ใครขัดขวางการฟื้นตัวของ Iblis เราต้องทำอะไรบางอย่าง เราจำเป็นต้องหยุดพวกเขา!
dialogsBegin.tw: 祭團的存在，也與拓本裡的內文相符，這絕不是巧合！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có thấy không? Họ không muốn bất cứ ai làm gián đoạn sự hồi sinh của Iblis. Chúng ta cần phải làm một điều gì đó. Chúng ta cần phải ngăn chặn chúng!

dialogsBegin.en: Are you ready for one last journey into the dark?
dialogsBegin.ar: Are you ready for one last journey into the dark?
dialogsBegin.br: Você está preparado para uma última incursão nas trevas?
dialogsBegin.cns: 可得要消灭祭团才行，这只能靠你帮忙了！
dialogsBegin.de: Bist du bereit für eine letzte Reise in die Finsternis?
dialogsBegin.fi: Are you ready for one last journey into the dark?
dialogsBegin.fil: Handa ka na ba para sa huling paglalakbay sa dilim?
dialogsBegin.fr: Pour commencer, nous devons localiser cet autel. Accepterais-tu de m’aider une dernière fois pour résoudre ce problème une bonne fois pour tout ?
dialogsBegin.id: Apakah kamu siap untuk satu perjalanan terakhir ke dalam kegelapan?
dialogsBegin.it: Are you ready for one last journey into the dark?
dialogsBegin.jp: こうなったら直接祭壇に乗り込んで、復活を阻止するしかないようですね。非常に危険なことですけど、どうかお願いします。
dialogsBegin.kr: 준비되셨나요? 마지막 어둠 속 여정이 될지도 몰라요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Are you ready for one last journey into the dark?
dialogsBegin.pl: Czy jesteś gotowy na ostatnią podróż w ciemność?
dialogsBegin.ru: Думаю, ты не откажешься нанести Храму Ужосса еще один визит?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Estás listo para un último viaje a la oscuridad?
dialogsBegin.sw: Are you ready for one last journey into the dark?
dialogsBegin.th: คุณพร้อมสำหรับการเดินทางครั้งสุดท้ายสู่ความมืดหรือไม่?
dialogsBegin.tw: 可得要消滅祭團才行，這只能靠你幫忙了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn đã sẵn sàng cho một cuộc hành trình cuối cùng vào bóng tối?

dialogsAccept.en: I knew you would be. There is a masquerpet name Iblis Guardian. If you can defeat it, you can enter the altar.
dialogsAccept.ar: I knew you would be. There is a masquerpet name Iblis Guardian. If you can defeat it, you can enter the altar.
dialogsAccept.br: Eu sabia que você estaria. Há um masquerpet chamado Guardião Iblis. Se você derrotá-lo, então poderá entrar no altar.
dialogsAccept.cns: 我就知道你会的。有一个怪物叫做秘殿警戒者，如果你可以打败它，你就能进入祭坛。
dialogsAccept.de: Ich wusste du würdest mich nicht hängen lassen. Es gibt ein Masquerpet namens Ivillis Guarder. Besiege es und du kannst zum Altar gelangen.
dialogsAccept.fi: I knew you would be. There is a masquerpet name Iblis Guardian. If you can defeat it, you can enter the altar.
dialogsAccept.fil: Alam kong sasabihin mo 'oo'. May masquerpet na tinatawag na Iblis Guardian. Kung mapapabagsak mo ito, makakapunta ka sa altar.
dialogsAccept.fr: Bon, mettons-nous au travail ! Il existe un monstre qu’on appelle Ivillis Guarder. Tu dois le battre afin de pouvoir accéder à l’autel.
dialogsAccept.id: Aku tahu kamu akan begitu. Ada topeng bernama Iblis Guardian. Jika kamu bisa mengalahkannya, kamu bisa memasuki altar.
dialogsAccept.it: I knew you would be. There is a masquerpet name Iblis Guardian. If you can defeat it, you can enter the altar.
dialogsAccept.jp: 祭壇への道は＜イブリスの紋章＞によって開かれます。＜イブル・プレジャー＞を倒しイブリスの紋章を手に入れてください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 역시 그럴 줄 알았어요. 이블리스 가디언이라는 마스커펫이 있어요. 그 녀석을 쓰러뜨릴 수 있다면, 제단으로 들어갈 수 있을 거예요.
dialogsAccept.nl: I knew you would be. There is a masquerpet name Iblis Guardian. If you can defeat it, you can enter the altar.
dialogsAccept.pl: Wiedziałem, że wrócisz. Istnieje potwór nazywający się Iblis Guardian. Jeśli zdołasz go pokonać, będziesz mógł wejść do ołtarza.
dialogsAccept.ru: Я знал, что ты не побоишься! В темноте Храма затаилась кошмарная марионетка - Ужассный страж. Его придется убить, чтобы пройти к алтарю.
dialogsAccept.sp: Sabía que lo estarías. Hay un masquerpet llamado Guardián de Iblis. Si consigues vencerlo, podrás entrar al altar.
dialogsAccept.sw: I knew you would be. There is a masquerpet name Iblis Guardian. If you can defeat it, you can enter the altar.
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันรู้ว่าคุณจะเป็น มีชื่อ masquerpet ชื่อ Iblis Guardian ถ้าสามารถเอาชนะได้ คุณสามารถเข้าแท่นบูชาได้
dialogsAccept.tw: 從拓本的內文來看，這地穴赤焰鳳凰，就是維護祭團的怪物！要先消滅牠才行……
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi biết bạn sẽ như vậy. Có một con quái tên Người canh gác Iblis. Nếu bạn có thể đánh bại nó, bạn có thể vào tế đàn.

dialogsDecline.en: Are you serious? What could be more important than saving the world?
dialogsDecline.ar: Are you serious? What could be more important than saving the world?
dialogsDecline.br: Você está falando sério? O que poderia ser mais importante do que salvar o mundo?
dialogsDecline.cns: 事况紧急……该怎么办才好！？
dialogsDecline.de: Ist das dein Ernst?! Was ist wichtiger als die Rettung der Welt?
dialogsDecline.fi: Are you serious? What could be more important than saving the world?
dialogsDecline.fil: Seryoso ka ba? Ano pa ang mas mahalaga kaysa iligtas ang mundo?
dialogsDecline.fr: Mais, ne veux-tu pas comprendre ? Il n’existe rien de plus important au monde que cela !!!
dialogsDecline.id: Apakah kamu serius? Apa yang bisa lebih penting daripada menyelamatkan dunia?
dialogsDecline.it: Are you serious? What could be more important than saving the world?
dialogsDecline.jp: 一刻の猶予もないんですよ。わかっていただけませんか？
dialogsDecline.kr: 정말요? 세상을 구하는 것보다 더 중요한 일이 뭐가 있나요?
dialogsDecline.nl: Are you serious? What could be more important than saving the world?
dialogsDecline.pl: Mówisz poważnie? Co może być ważniejsze niż ratowanie świata?
dialogsDecline.ru: Шутишь? Что может быть важнее судьбы мира?
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Lo dices en serio? ¿Qué podría ser más importante que salvar el mundo?
dialogsDecline.sw: Are you serious? What could be more important than saving the world?
dialogsDecline.th: พูดจริงเหรอ มีอะไรที่มันสำคัญกว่าการช่วยเหลือโลกเราไว้
dialogsDecline.tw: 事況緊急……該怎麼辦才好！？
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn nghiêm túc chứ? Điều gì có thể quan trọng hơn việc giải cứu thế giới?

dialogsComplete.en: Great job, now you can enter the altar. I am counting on you to defeat the followers of Iblis... we all are. Go to the altar now.
dialogsComplete.ar: Great job, now you can enter the altar. I am counting on you to defeat the followers of Iblis... we all are. Go to the altar now.
dialogsComplete.br: Bom trabalho, agora você já pode entrar no altar. Estou contando com você para derrotar os seguidores de Iblis. Todos nós estamos. Vá até o altar agora.
dialogsComplete.cns: 辛苦你了！这地牢有太多诡异的地方，可要多留意才行！
dialogsComplete.de: Großartig! Nun kannst du zum Altar gelangen. Wir müssen die Anhänger von Ivillis besiegen... Bitte geh nun zum Altar.
dialogsComplete.fi: Great job, now you can enter the altar. I am counting on you to defeat the followers of Iblis... we all are. Go to the altar now.
dialogsComplete.fil: Magaling na trabaho, ngayon makakapasok ka sa altar. Umaasa ako sa'yo na talunin ang mga tagasunod ni Iblis... tayo lahat. Punta ka na sa altar.
dialogsComplete.fr: Excellent, maintenant tu peux accéder à l’autel. Nous devons vaincre les fidèles d’Ivillis ! S’il te plaît, entre dans l’autel.
dialogsComplete.id: Kerja bagus, sekarang kamu bisa memasuki altar. Aku mengandalkanmu untuk mengalahkan para pengikut Iblis... kita semua. Pergi ke altar sekarang.
dialogsComplete.it: Great job, now you can enter the altar. I am counting on you to defeat the followers of Iblis... we all are. Go to the altar now.
dialogsComplete.jp: 祭壇への道は開かれました。あとは祭壇に乗り込むだけです。ただ…その方法は黙示録に記されていないんですよ。神殿の奥深くにいるというイブリスの神官なら、あなたを祭壇へ導くことができるかもしれません。
dialogsComplete.kr: 잘했어요. 이제 제단에 들어갈 수 있어요. 이블리스의 추종자들을 처치해 주세요… 당신만 믿어요. 당장 제단으로 가 주세요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Great job, now you can enter the altar. I am counting on you to defeat the followers of Iblis... we all are. Go to the altar now.
dialogsComplete.pl: Świetna robota, teraz możesz wejść do ołtarza. Liczę, że pokonasz wyznawców Iblisa... wszyscy liczymy. Idź teraz do ołtarza.
dialogsComplete.ru: Превосходно! Теперь ты сможешь пройти к алтарю и уничтожить последователей Ужосса. Помни: судьба мира в твоих руках.
dialogsComplete.sp: Buen trabajo, ahora puedes entrar al altar. Cuento contigo para derrotar a los seguidores de Iblis... todos contamos contigo. Ve al altar.
dialogsComplete.sw: Great job, now you can enter the altar. I am counting on you to defeat the followers of Iblis... we all are. Go to the altar now.
dialogsComplete.th: เยี่ยมมาก ตอนนี้คุณสามารถเข้าแท่นบูชาได้ ข้ากำลังพ่ายแพ้ให้กับสาวกของ Iblis... ไปที่แท่นบูชาเดี๋ยวนี้
dialogsComplete.tw: 辛苦你了！這神殿有太多詭異的地方，可要多留意才行！
dialogsComplete.vi: Làm tốt lắm, bây giờ bạn có thể vào tế đàn. Tôi trông cậy vào bạn để đánh bại những người theo Iblis ... tất cả chúng ta đều như vậy. Tiến đến tế đàn ngay.

dialogsFail.en: I do not know exactly where Iblis Guardian is. But we have to find it and destroy it.
dialogsFail.ar: I do not know exactly where Iblis Guardian is. But we have to find it and destroy it.
dialogsFail.br: Eu não sei o local exato onde o Guardião Iblis se encontra. Mas temos que encontrá-lo e destruí-lo.
dialogsFail.cns: 我不确定秘殿警戒者具体在哪，但是我们必须得找到并杀死它。
dialogsFail.de: Ich habe keine Ahnung, wo sich der Ivillis Guarder aufhält. Aber wir müssen ihn finden und besiegen!
dialogsFail.fi: I do not know exactly where Iblis Guardian is. But we have to find it and destroy it.
dialogsFail.fil: Hindi ko tiyak kung nasaan ang Iblis Guardian. Pero kailangan natin itong hanapin at sirain.
dialogsFail.fr: Je n'ai absolument aucune idée du lieu où le Ivillis Guarder se trouve... On doit le découvrir et le vaincre !
dialogsFail.id: Aku tidak tahu persis di mana Iblis Guardian berada. Tapi kita harus menemukannya dan menghancurkannya.
dialogsFail.it: I do not know exactly where Iblis Guardian is. But we have to find it and destroy it.
dialogsFail.jp: イブル・プレジャーの正確な居場所はわかりません。ですが必ず探し出して、倒してください。
dialogsFail.kr: 이블리스 가디언이 정확히 어디 있는지는 모르지만, 반드시 이블리스 가디언을 찾아서 쓰러뜨려야 해요.
dialogsFail.nl: I do not know exactly where Iblis Guardian is. But we have to find it and destroy it.
dialogsFail.pl: Nie wiem dokładnie, gdzie znajduje się Iblis Guardian. Musimy go znaleźć i zniszczyć.
dialogsFail.ru: Я не знаю, где искать Ужассного стража. Но не убив его, к алтарю не пройти.
dialogsFail.sp: No sé exactamente dónde está el Guardián de Iblis. Pero tenemos que encontrarlo y derrotarlo.
dialogsFail.sw: I do not know exactly where Iblis Guardian is. But we have to find it and destroy it.
dialogsFail.th: ฉันไม่รู้ว่า Iblis Guardian อยู่ที่ไหน แต่เราต้องพบและทำลายมัน
dialogsFail.tw: 神殿裡跟迷宮一樣，我也不知道地穴赤焰鳳凰的所在確切位置！你一定要打敗牠才行！
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi không biết chính xác Người canh gác Iblis ở đâu. Nhưng chúng ta phải tìm ra nó và tiêu diệt nó.

dialogsBegin.en: I'm very close to reaching a perpetual state of enlightenment. It is crucial that you don't…
dialogsBegin.ar: I'm very close to reaching a perpetual state of enlightenment. It is crucial that you don't…
dialogsBegin.br: Estou muito perto de alcançar um estado perpétuo de iluminação. É fundamental que você não…
dialogsBegin.cns: 我离永恒状态的启迪非常近了。 关键是你不能...
dialogsBegin.de: Ich stehe kurz davor, einen immerwährenden Zustand der Erleuchtung zu erreichen. Es ist wichtig, dass du nicht...
dialogsBegin.fi: I'm very close to reaching a perpetual state of enlightenment. It is crucial that you don't…
dialogsBegin.fil: I'm very close to reaching a perpetual state of enlightenment. It is crucial that you don't…
dialogsBegin.fr: J'ai presque terminé mon entraînement de la journée. Restez tranquille encore quelques instants.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya sangat dekat untuk mencapai tataran pencerahan yang abadi. Sangat penting bahwa Anda tidak...
dialogsBegin.it: I'm very close to reaching a perpetual state of enlightenment. It is crucial that you don't…
dialogsBegin.jp: 私はいま長きに渡る修行の日々を続けている。どうか邪魔をしないでほしい。
dialogsBegin.kr: 저는 오랜 시간 수행해 온 깨달음의 경지에 도달하려는 참입니다. 부디 방해하지 마시길...
dialogsBegin.nl: I'm very close to reaching a perpetual state of enlightenment. It is crucial that you don't…
dialogsBegin.pl: I'm very close to reaching a perpetual state of enlightenment. It is crucial that you don't…
dialogsBegin.ru: I'm very close to reaching a perpetual state of enlightenment. It is crucial that you don't…
dialogsBegin.sp: Estoy muy cerca de alcanzar un estado perpetuo de iluminación. Es crucial que no…
dialogsBegin.sw: I'm very close to reaching a perpetual state of enlightenment. It is crucial that you don't…
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันใกล้จะถึงจุดสิ้นสุดของการตรัสรู้ เป็นเรื่องสำคัญที่คุณไม่...
dialogsBegin.tw: 我花了很長的時間在修練，現在正在進行最後的階段。所以你不要妨礙我。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi rất gần đạt đến trạng thái giác ngộ vĩnh viễn. Điều quan trọng là bạn thì không…

dialogsBegin.en: Reonan!? He sent you? You seem rather weak for someone Reonan has supposedly entrusted so much knowledge to…
dialogsBegin.ar: Reonan!? He sent you? You seem rather weak for someone Reonan has supposedly entrusted so much knowledge to…
dialogsBegin.br: Reonan!? Ele te mandou? Você parece um pouco fraco para alguém que Reonan supostamente confiou tanto conhecimento para tal…
dialogsBegin.cns: 瑞尔南!?他派你来的？瑞尔南把这么多知识交付给了你，这让你看起来很虚弱.....
dialogsBegin.de: Reonan!? Er hat dich geschickt? Für jemanden, dem Reonan angeblich so viel Wissen anvertraut hat, wirkst du ziemlich schwach...
dialogsBegin.fi: Reonan!? He sent you? You seem rather weak for someone Reonan has supposedly entrusted so much knowledge to…
dialogsBegin.fil: Reonan!? He sent you? You seem rather weak for someone Reonan has supposedly entrusted so much knowledge to…
dialogsBegin.fr: QUOI ?? C'est Reonan qui vous envoie ? J'ai du mal à le croire.
dialogsBegin.id: Reonan!? Dia mengirimmu? Anda tampak agak lemah untuk seseorang yang reonan seharusnya mempercayakan begitu banyak pengetahuan kepada ...
dialogsBegin.it: Reonan!? He sent you? You seem rather weak for someone Reonan has supposedly entrusted so much knowledge to…
dialogsBegin.jp: 何……レオナンからの遣いだと？　ふむ、しかしその言葉をそのまま鵜呑みにはできんな。
dialogsBegin.kr: 레오난!? 레오난이 보내서 왔다고요? 그렇게 중요한 일을 맡기기엔, 그리 강해 보이지는 않는데...
dialogsBegin.nl: Reonan!? He sent you? You seem rather weak for someone Reonan has supposedly entrusted so much knowledge to…
dialogsBegin.pl: Reonan!? He sent you? You seem rather weak for someone Reonan has supposedly entrusted so much knowledge to…
dialogsBegin.ru: Reonan!? He sent you? You seem rather weak for someone Reonan has supposedly entrusted so much knowledge to…
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿¡Reonan!? ¿Él te envía? Pareces bastante débil para alguien a quien supuestamente Reonan le ha confiado tanto conocimiento...
dialogsBegin.sw: Reonan!? He sent you? You seem rather weak for someone Reonan has supposedly entrusted so much knowledge to…
dialogsBegin.th: Reonan!? เขาส่งคุณมาเหรอ? คุณดูอ่อนแอสำหรับคนที่ Reonan ให้ความไว้วางใจ
dialogsBegin.tw: 雷奧南！？是他派你來的？他既然將這麼多知識託付給你，你看起來卻有點弱啊……
dialogsBegin.vi: Reonan !? Anh ấy đã gửi cho bạn? Bạn có vẻ khá yếu đối với một người mà Reonan được cho là đã tin tưởng giao quá nhiều kiến ​​thức cho…

dialogsBegin.en: We will prove just what you are capable of. If you are successful in carrying out 3 tests, then our conversation will resume…
dialogsBegin.ar: We will prove just what you are capable of. If you are successful in carrying out 3 tests, then our conversation will resume…
dialogsBegin.br: Vamos provar do que você é capaz. Se você for bem sucedido em realizar 3 testes, nossa conversa será retomada…
dialogsBegin.cns: 我们将证实你的能力。如果你成功地通过了3次测试，那么我们的对话才能继续…
dialogsBegin.de: Wir werden beweisen, wozu du fähig bist. Wenn du 3 Tests erfolgreich absolviert hast, wird unser Gespräch fortgesetzt...
dialogsBegin.fi: We will prove just what you are capable of. If you are successful in carrying out 3 tests, then our conversation will resume…
dialogsBegin.fil: We will prove just what you are capable of. If you are successful in carrying out 3 tests, then our conversation will resume…
dialogsBegin.fr: Votre histoire est étrange, je ne sais pas si je peux vous faire confiance.
dialogsBegin.id: Kami akan membuktikan apa yang Anda mampu. Jika Anda berhasil melakukan 3 tes, maka percakapan kami akan dilanjutkan...
dialogsBegin.it: We will prove just what you are capable of. If you are successful in carrying out 3 tests, then our conversation will resume…
dialogsBegin.jp: レオナンの遣いであれば多少の武芸はできるのだろう？　まずはそれを見せてみるがよい。3つのテストを行います。
dialogsBegin.kr: 당신의 진짜 실력을 확인하겠습니다. 세 가지 시험을 모두 완수한다면, 그때 다시 얘기해 보죠...
dialogsBegin.nl: We will prove just what you are capable of. If you are successful in carrying out 3 tests, then our conversation will resume…
dialogsBegin.pl: We will prove just what you are capable of. If you are successful in carrying out 3 tests, then our conversation will resume…
dialogsBegin.ru: We will prove just what you are capable of. If you are successful in carrying out 3 tests, then our conversation will resume…
dialogsBegin.sp: Comprobaremos de lo que eres capaz. Si tienes éxito en las 3 pruebas, nuestra conversación se reanudará...
dialogsBegin.sw: We will prove just what you are capable of. If you are successful in carrying out 3 tests, then our conversation will resume…
dialogsBegin.th: เราจะพิสูจน์ว่าคุณมีความสามารถเพียงใด หากคุณประสบความสำเร็จในการดำเนินการทดสอบ 3 ครั้ง การสนทนาของเราจะดำเนินต่อไป
dialogsBegin.tw: 我們會證明你究竟有多少本事。如果你成功完成 3 項測試，我們就繼續談…
dialogsBegin.vi: Chúng tôi sẽ chứng minh khả năng của bạn. Nếu bạn thực hiện thành công 3 bài kiểm tra, thì cuộc trò chuyện của chúng ta sẽ tiếp tục…

dialogsBegin.en: First, please go and defeat 50 Small Luias & 35 Luias. This should be sufficient to prove to me that you are a worthy disciple of Reonan.
dialogsBegin.ar: First, please go and defeat 50 Small Luias & 35 Luias. This should be sufficient to prove to me that you are a worthy disciple of Reonan.
dialogsBegin.br: Primeiro, por favor, derrote 50 Luias Pequenas e 35 Luias. Isso deve ser suficiente para me provar que você é um discípulo digno de Reonan.
dialogsBegin.cns: 首先，请去打败50只小火鸟和35只火鸟。这应该足以向我证明你是一个当之无愧的瑞尔南的徒弟。
dialogsBegin.de: Bitte besiege zuerst 50 Small Luias und 35 Luias. Das sollte ausreichen, um mir zu beweisen, dass du ein würdiger Schüler von Reonan bist.
dialogsBegin.fi: First, please go and defeat 50 Small Luias & 35 Luias. This should be sufficient to prove to me that you are a worthy disciple of Reonan.
dialogsBegin.fil: First, please go and defeat 50 Small Luias & 35 Luias. This should be sufficient to prove to me that you are a worthy disciple of Reonan.
dialogsBegin.fr: Allez donc chasser 50 Jeunes Luia et 35 Luia. On continuera cette discussion après.
dialogsBegin.id: Pertama, silakan pergi dan kalahkan 50 Small Luias & 35 Luias. Ini seharusnya cukup untuk membuktikan kepada saya bahwa Anda adalah murid Reonan yang layak.
dialogsBegin.it: First, please go and defeat 50 Small Luias & 35 Luias. This should be sufficient to prove to me that you are a worthy disciple of Reonan.
dialogsBegin.jp: そうだな、スモール・ルイア50匹、ルイア35匹を倒して来い。さすればレオナンの弟子としてふさわしいことを証明できるはず。
dialogsBegin.kr: 먼저, 작은 루이아 50마리와 루이아 35마리를 처치하세요. 그 정도면 레오난의 제자라 부를 자격이 있을지 확인할 수 있겠죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: First, please go and defeat 50 Small Luias & 35 Luias. This should be sufficient to prove to me that you are a worthy disciple of Reonan.
dialogsBegin.pl: First, please go and defeat 50 Small Luias & 35 Luias. This should be sufficient to prove to me that you are a worthy disciple of Reonan.
dialogsBegin.ru: First, please go and defeat 50 Small Luias & 35 Luias. This should be sufficient to prove to me that you are a worthy disciple of Reonan.
dialogsBegin.sp: Primero, ve y derrota a 50 Luias Pequeñas y a 35 Luias. Esto debería ser suficiente para demostrarme que eres un digno discípulo de Reonan.
dialogsBegin.sw: First, please go and defeat 50 Small Luias & 35 Luias. This should be sufficient to prove to me that you are a worthy disciple of Reonan.
dialogsBegin.th: ก่อนอื่น โปรดไปฆ่า 50 Small Luias & 35 Luias เท่านี้ก็เพียงพอที่จะพิสูจน์ให้ฉันเห็นว่าคุณเป็นสาวกของ Reonan
dialogsBegin.tw: 先去擊敗 50 隻小鳳鳳和 35 隻赤焰鳳凰。這應該足以證明你配得上雷奧南弟子的身分。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đầu tiên, hãy đi và đánh bại 50 Luias Nhỏ & 35 Luias. Điều này đủ để chứng minh với tôi rằng bạn là một đệ tử xứng đáng của Reonan.

dialogsAccept.en: Well, you talk a big game. But remember, actions do speak louder than words. Lets see if you can complete the quest.
dialogsAccept.ar: Well, you talk a big game. But remember, actions do speak louder than words. Lets see if you can complete the quest.
dialogsAccept.br: Bem, você fala com confiança. Mas lembre-se, as ações falam mais alto que as palavras. Vamos ver se você consegue completar a missão.
dialogsAccept.cns: 别说大话了。请记住，行动胜于雄辩。让我们看看你是否能完成任务。
dialogsAccept.de: Nun, Du hast große Töne gespuckt. Aber denk daran, dass Taten mehr sagen als Worte. Mal sehen, ob du die Aufgabe erfüllen kannst.
dialogsAccept.fi: Well, you talk a big game. But remember, actions do speak louder than words. Lets see if you can complete the quest.
dialogsAccept.fil: Well, you talk a big game. But remember, actions do speak louder than words. Lets see if you can complete the quest.
dialogsAccept.fr: Bien, je n'ai donc pas affaire à un lâche. Je vous attends ici.
dialogsAccept.id: Nah, Anda berbicara tentang pertandingan besar. Tapi ingat, tindakan memang berbicara lebih keras daripada kata-kata. Mari kita lihat apakah Anda dapat menyelesaikan pencarian.
dialogsAccept.it: Well, you talk a big game. But remember, actions do speak louder than words. Lets see if you can complete the quest.

dialogsBegin.fil: *Reading letter* Hmm... I see. There is a reason he refuses to fight. Elaine had a sister, Hannah, for whom he cared very dearly…
dialogsBegin.fr: *lit la lettre* Alain dans son incarnation précédente a perdu sa sœur Hindel.
dialogsBegin.id: *Membaca surat* Hmm.. Saya mengerti. Ada alasan dia menolak untuk bertarung. Elaine memiliki seorang saudara perempuan, Hannah, yang sangat dia sayangi...
dialogsBegin.it: *Reading letter* Hmm... I see. There is a reason he refuses to fight. Elaine had a sister, Hannah, for whom he cared very dearly…
dialogsBegin.jp: ふむ……やはりそうか。エルラインには妹のハンナがいたのだが、戦争の際に病気で寝込んでしまっていてね。
dialogsBegin.kr: *편지를 읽으며* 흠… 그렇군요. 그가 싸우길 거부하는 데 이유가 있었네요. 일레인의 여동생, 한나를 무척 아꼈던 모양이에요…
dialogsBegin.nl: *Reading letter* Hmm... I see. There is a reason he refuses to fight. Elaine had a sister, Hannah, for whom he cared very dearly…
dialogsBegin.pl: *Reading letter* Hmm... I see. There is a reason he refuses to fight. Elaine had a sister, Hannah, for whom he cared very dearly…
dialogsBegin.ru: *Reading letter* Hmm... I see. There is a reason he refuses to fight. Elaine had a sister, Hannah, for whom he cared very dearly…
dialogsBegin.sp: *Leyendo la carta* Hmm... Ya veo. Hay una razón por la que se niega a luchar. Elaine tenía una hermana, Hannah, a quien él quería mucho...
dialogsBegin.sw: *Reading letter* Hmm... I see. There is a reason he refuses to fight. Elaine had a sister, Hannah, for whom he cared very dearly…
dialogsBegin.th: *อ่านจดหมาย* อืมม .. มีเหตุผลที่จะปฏิเสธการต่อสู้ Elaine มีพี่สาวคนหนึ่งชื่อ Hannah ซึ่งเขารักเธอมาก ...
dialogsBegin.tw: *看信中* 嗯……原來如此。他不願意戰鬥是有原因的。耶拉伊曾有個妹妹，叫漢娜，而他一直非常在意她……
dialogsBegin.vi: *Đọc thư* Hmm .. Tôi hiểu rồi. Anh ta có lý do để không tham gia vào cuộc chiến. Elaine có một người em gái, Hannah, người mà anh ấy rất mực yêu quý…

dialogsBegin.en: She was killed during the war… Only, Elaine didn't learn of any of this until after everything was over. He blamed himself for it all…
dialogsBegin.ar: She was killed during the war… Only, Elaine didn't learn of any of this until after everything was over. He blamed himself for it all…
dialogsBegin.br: Ela foi morta durante a guerra... Só que Elaine não soube de nada disso até depois que tudo acabou. Ele se culpou por tudo...
dialogsBegin.cns: 她在战争中被杀......只是，伊莲直到一切都结束后才知道。所以他因为这一切非常自责...
dialogsBegin.de: Sie wurde während des Krieges getötet... Nur erfuhr Elaine nichts davon, bis alles vorbei war. Er gab sich selbst die Schuld an allem...
dialogsBegin.fi: She was killed during the war… Only, Elaine didn't learn of any of this until after everything was over. He blamed himself for it all…
dialogsBegin.fil: She was killed during the war… Only, Elaine didn't learn of any of this until after everything was over. He blamed himself for it all…
dialogsBegin.fr: Il a eu la nouvelle après une bataille monumentale et il s'en veut encore de ne pas avoir été là pour sa famille. De rage, il a jeté la bague de sa sœur.
dialogsBegin.id: Dia terbunuh selama perang... Hanya saja, Elaine tidak mengetahui semua ini sampai setelah semuanya selesai. Dia menyalahkan dirinya sendiri atas itu semua...
dialogsBegin.it: She was killed during the war… Only, Elaine didn't learn of any of this until after everything was over. He blamed himself for it all…
dialogsBegin.jp: 戦争は知っての通り私達が勝利したが、闘いの最中に妹が亡くなってしまい、彼は死に目に立ち会うことができなかったのだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그의 동생은 전쟁 중에 목숨을 잃었습니다... 하지만 일레인은 모든 일이 끝난 뒤에야 그 사실을 알게 되었죠... 일레인은 자기 탓이라며 자책했습니다...
dialogsBegin.nl: She was killed during the war… Only, Elaine didn't learn of any of this until after everything was over. He blamed himself for it all…
dialogsBegin.pl: She was killed during the war… Only, Elaine didn't learn of any of this until after everything was over. He blamed himself for it all…
dialogsBegin.ru: She was killed during the war… Only, Elaine didn't learn of any of this until after everything was over. He blamed himself for it all…
dialogsBegin.sp: Fue asesinada durante la guerra... Elaine no se enteró de nada hasta que todo terminó. Se culpó a sí mismo por todo...
dialogsBegin.sw: She was killed during the war… Only, Elaine didn't learn of any of this until after everything was over. He blamed himself for it all…
dialogsBegin.th: เธอถูกสังหารในระหว่างสงคราม ... เฉพาะ Elaine ไม่ได้เรียนรู้เรื่องนี้จนกระทั่งทุกอย่างจบลงแล้ว เขาตำหนิตัวเองทั้งหมด ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 她在戰爭中喪生了……但耶拉伊直到一切結束後才得知此事，因此把所有責任都怪在自己身上……
dialogsBegin.vi: Cô ấy đã bị giết trong chiến tranh… Chỉ có điều, Elaine đã không biết về điều này cho đến khi mọi thứ kết thúc. Anh ấy đã tự trách mình vì tất cả…

dialogsBegin.en: In a fit of rage, he threw her ring, the last memento he had of her, into the air somewhere in Western Darkon 1. If you could retrieve it maybe he would reconsider?
dialogsBegin.ar: In a fit of rage, he threw her ring, the last memento he had of her, into the air somewhere in Western Darkon 1. If you could retrieve it maybe he would reconsider?
dialogsBegin.br: Em um momento de raiva e tristeza, ele jogou o anel dela, era a última lembrança que ele tinha dela, no ar em algum lugar ao Oeste de Darkon 1. Se você conseguir recuperar, talvez ele reconsidere.
dialogsBegin.cns: 愤怒之下，他把她的戒指，也就是他对她最后的纪念品，扔到了达肯西部某处。如果你能把它找回来，也许他会重新考虑？
dialogsBegin.de: In einem Wutanfall warf er ihren Ring, das letzte Andenken, das er an sie hatte, irgendwo im Westen von Darkon 1 in die Luft. Wenn du ihn zurückholen könntest, würde er es sich vielleicht noch einmal überlegen?
dialogsBegin.fi: In a fit of rage, he threw her ring, the last memento he had of her, into the air somewhere in Western Darkon 1. If you could retrieve it maybe he would reconsider?
dialogsBegin.fil: In a fit of rage, he threw her ring, the last memento he had of her, into the air somewhere in Western Darkon 1. If you could retrieve it maybe he would reconsider?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il a fait ça sous le coup de la colère mais je suis certain qu'il regrette. Il faut que vous l'aidiez à comprendre que ce qui se prépare fera du mal à de nombreuses familles.
dialogsBegin.id: Dalam kemarahan, dia melemparkan cincinnya, kenang-kenangan terakhir yang dia miliki darinya, ke udara di suatu tempat di Western Darkon 1. Jika Anda bisa mengambilnya mungkin dia akan mempertimbangkannya kembali?
dialogsBegin.it: In a fit of rage, he threw her ring, the last memento he had of her, into the air somewhere in Western Darkon 1. If you could retrieve it maybe he would reconsider?
dialogsBegin.jp: しかも形見の指輪をモンスターに奪われてしまったようだね。西のダーコン1のどこかで見つけられるかもしれない。せめて指輪は返してあげたい。
dialogsBegin.kr: 당시, 일레인은 분노해서 동생의 반지를 다콘 제1지구 서쪽 어딘가로 던져버렸다고 하더군요. 혹시 그 반지를 찾아올 수 있다면, 그의 생각도 바뀌지 않을까요?
dialogsBegin.nl: In a fit of rage, he threw her ring, the last memento he had of her, into the air somewhere in Western Darkon 1. If you could retrieve it maybe he would reconsider?
dialogsBegin.pl: In a fit of rage, he threw her ring, the last memento he had of her, into the air somewhere in Western Darkon 1. If you could retrieve it maybe he would reconsider?
dialogsBegin.ru: In a fit of rage, he threw her ring, the last memento he had of her, into the air somewhere in Western Darkon 1. If you could retrieve it maybe he would reconsider?
dialogsBegin.sp: En un ataque de ira, lanzó su anillo al aire, el último recuerdo que tenía de ella, en algún lugar al Oeste de Darkon 1. Si lo recuperas, puede que lo reconsidere.
dialogsBegin.sw: In a fit of rage, he threw her ring, the last memento he had of her, into the air somewhere in Western Darkon 1. If you could retrieve it maybe he would reconsider?
dialogsBegin.th: เขาโผล่พ้นจากความโกรธ เขาโยนแหวนของเธอเป็นอนุสรณ์สุดท้ายที่เขามีเธอเข้าไปในอากาศที่แห่งหนึ่งใน Western Darkon 1 ถ้าคุณสามารถเรียกคืนได้บางทีเขาอาจจะพิจารณาใหม่
dialogsBegin.tw: 他盛怒之下，把她的戒指──也是他僅存的遺物──扔到了得肯第一區西部某處。如果你能找回戒指，也許他會改變心意？
dialogsBegin.vi: Trong cơn tức giận, anh đã ném chiếc nhẫn của em gái, kỷ vật cuối cùng anh có của Hannah, lên không trung ở một nơi nào đó ở Western Darkon 1. Nếu bạn lấy lại được, có lẽ anh sẽ cân nhắc lại?

dialogsAccept.en: I guarantee you a Garbagespider ate the ring. They eat anything and everything! Please head to Western Darkon and defeat Garbagespiders until you can recover the ring!
dialogsAccept.ar: I guarantee you a Garbagespider ate the ring. They eat anything and everything! Please head to Western Darkon and defeat Garbagespiders until you can recover the ring!
dialogsAccept.br: Tenho certeza que alguma Lixeiranha comeu o anel. Elas comem qualquer coisa e tudo! Por favor, vá para Oeste de Darkon e derrote as Lixeiranhas até que você consiga recuperar o anel!
dialogsAccept.cns: I guarantee you a Garbagespider ate the ring. They eat anything and everything! Please head to Western Darkon and defeat Garbagespiders until you can recover the ring!
dialogsAccept.de: Ich garantiere dir, dass eine Garbagespider den Ring gefressen hat. Sie fressen alles und jeden! Bitte begebe dich nach West-Darkon und besiege Garbagespiders, bis du den Ring wiederfindest!
dialogsAccept.fi: I guarantee you a Garbagespider ate the ring. They eat anything and everything! Please head to Western Darkon and defeat Garbagespiders until you can recover the ring!
dialogsAccept.fil: I guarantee you a Garbagespider ate the ring. They eat anything and everything! Please head to Western Darkon and defeat Garbagespiders until you can recover the ring!
dialogsAccept.fr: Un Garbagespider a aspiré la bague de Hindel. Chassez donc ces créatures jusqu'à retrouver la bague.
dialogsAccept.id: Saya yakin Garbagespider memakan cincin itu. Mereka makan apa saja dan segalanya! Pergilah ke Western Darkon dan kalahkan Garbagespiders sampai Anda bisa mendapatkan kembali cincin itu!
dialogsAccept.it: I guarantee you a Garbagespider ate the ring. They eat anything and everything! Please head to Western Darkon and defeat Garbagespiders until you can recover the ring!
dialogsAccept.jp: ハイネルの指輪はガーベイジパイダーに奪われてしまったそうだ。ガーベイジパイダーを倒せば見つかるかもしれない。協力してくれないか？
dialogsAccept.kr: 가비지스파이더가 반지를 먹은 게 분명해요. 뭐든지 먹어치우거든요! 서쪽 다콘으로 가서 가비지스파이더를 처치하고 반지를 되찾으세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: I guarantee you a Garbagespider ate the ring. They eat anything and everything! Please head to Western Darkon and defeat Garbagespiders until you can recover the ring!
dialogsAccept.pl: Gwarantuję, że pierścionek zjadł Pająkosz. Jedzą wszystko i wszystko! Udaj się do Zachodniego Darkon i pokonuj Pająkosze, aż odzyskasz pierścień!
dialogsAccept.ru: I guarantee you a Garbagespider ate the ring. They eat anything and everything! Please head to Western Darkon and defeat Garbagespiders until you can recover the ring!
dialogsAccept.sp: Te garantizo que un Garbagespider se ha comido el anillo. ¡Se comen cualquier cosa! ¡Dirígete al Oeste de Darkon 1 y derrota a los Garbagespiders hasta que recuperes el anillo!
dialogsAccept.sw: I guarantee you a Garbagespider ate the ring. They eat anything and everything! Please head to Western Darkon and defeat Garbagespiders until you can recover the ring!
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันรับประกันว่า Garbagespider กินแหวน พวกเขากินอะไรก็ได้และทุกอย่าง! กรุณามุ่งหน้าไปยัง Western Darkon และกำจัด Garbagespiders จนกว่าคุณจะสามารถกู้คืนแหวนได้!
dialogsAccept.tw: 海奈爾的戒指被不管是什麼東西都會吞食的清道夫機械給吞下去了。消滅清道夫機械，然後找回海奈爾的戒指吧。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi đảm bảo với bạn một Garbagespider đã ăn chiếc nhẫn. Chúng ăn bất cứ thứ gì và mọi thứ! Hãy đến Western Darkon và đánh bại Garbagespiders cho đến khi bạn có thể khôi phục lại chiếc nhẫn!

dialogsBegin.en: The Bone Bowl was created by a black magician a long long time ago. In a town, a woman lived with her little pet, who was named Baby.
dialogsBegin.ar: The Bone Bowl was created by a black magician a long long time ago. In a town, a woman lived with her little pet, who was named Baby.
dialogsBegin.br: A Tigela de Osso foi criada, há muito tempo, por um mago que utilizava magia negra. Em uma cidade, uma mulher vivia com seu bichinho de estimação chamado Baby.
dialogsBegin.cns: 骨制御碗这个东西是，在很久以前，有一个黑暗没法师所做出来的。据说在很久以前，人民与魔域怪物都住在一起，但是..
dialogsBegin.de: Die Bone Bowl wurde vor langer langer Zeit von einem schwarzen Magier hergestellt. In einem Dorf wo Monster und Menschen gemeinsam lebten, vor dem Krieg der Helden.
dialogsBegin.fi: The Bone Bowl was created by a black magician a long long time ago. In a town, a woman lived with her little pet, who was named Baby.
dialogsBegin.fil: The Bone Bowl was created by a black magician a long long time ago. In a town, a woman lived with her little pet, who was named Baby.
dialogsBegin.fr: Le bol maudit fut créé il y a fort longtemps... Dans une ancienne ville, une femme vivait avec son petit animal, qui s'appelait Baby. Mais ce dernier perdit la raison et se mis à attaquer les habitants.
dialogsBegin.id: Bone Bowl dibuat dengan sihir hitam dalam waktu yang sangat lama, seorang perempuan hidup dengan hewan peliharannya, yang diberi nama Baby.
dialogsBegin.it: The Bone Bowl was created by a black magician a long long time ago. In a town, a woman lived with her little pet, who was named Baby.
dialogsBegin.jp: ＜ボーンボール＞は大昔＜ブラックマジシャン＞と呼ばれた魔術師によって作られたらしい。英雄戦争前、モンスターと人間が一緒に暮らしている村があったそうだ。その頃はモンスターと人間は敵対関係ではなく、うまく共存していたといわれている。
dialogsBegin.kr: 본보울은 아주 오래전, 블랙 매지션이 만들었어요. 어떤 마을에, 한 소녀가 '베이비'라는 귀여운 애완동물과 함께 살고 있었죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: The Bone Bowl was created by a black magician a long long time ago. In a town, a woman lived with her little pet, who was named Baby.
dialogsBegin.pl: The Bone Bowl was created by a black magician a long long time ago. In a town, a woman lived with her little pet, who was named Baby.
dialogsBegin.ru: В черном-черном городе стоял черный-черный дом. В нем жила старушка с белым пуделем - Крошкой. Однажды старушка уехала из города, а соседке сказала: "Только не корми Крошку сырым мясом".
dialogsBegin.sp: El Cuenco de Hueso fue creado por una maga negra hace mucho, mucho tiempo. En un pueblo vivía una mujer con su pequeña mascota, que se llamaba Baby.
dialogsBegin.sw: The Bone Bowl was created by a black magician a long long time ago. In a town, a woman lived with her little pet, who was named Baby.
dialogsBegin.th: Bone Bowl ถูกสร้างขึ้นโดยศาสตร์มืดเป็นเวลานานมาแล้ว ในเมืองที่มีผู้หญิงคนหนึ่งอาศัยอยู่กับสัตว์ตัวเล็กๆของเธอซึ่งมีชื่อว่า Baby
dialogsBegin.tw: 情盆這個東西是，在很久以前，有一個黑暗沒法師所做出來的。據說在很久以前，人民與魔域怪物都住在一起，但是…
dialogsBegin.vi: Bone Bowl được tạo ra bởi một hắc đạo sư cách đây rất lâu. Trong một thị trấn, một người phụ nữ sống với thú cưng bé nhỏ của mình, tên là Baby.

dialogsBegin.en: The pet went crazy and began attacking townsfolk. As a result, both of them were kicked out of the town.
dialogsBegin.ar: The pet went crazy and began attacking townsfolk. As a result, both of them were kicked out of the town.
dialogsBegin.br: O animal enlouqueceu e começou a atacar os habitantes da cidade. Como resultado, ambos foram expulsos da cidade.
dialogsBegin.cns: 有一个女子爱上了一个魔域怪，后来这个女子怀了魔域怪的孩子，之后被赶出村外。没多久魔域怪死亡之后，
dialogsBegin.de: Eine Frau verliebte sich in ein Monster und wurde schwanger. Daraufhin wurden die beiden aus dem Dorf geworfen und letzten Endes starb das Monster.
dialogsBegin.fi: The pet went crazy and began attacking townsfolk. As a result, both of them were kicked out of the town.
dialogsBegin.fil: The pet went crazy and began attacking townsfolk. As a result, both of them were kicked out of the town.
dialogsBegin.fr: La seule solution fût alors de les chasser de la ville, pour quelques temps. Car cette femme revint un jour, estimant son expulsion injustifiée.
dialogsBegin.id: Hewan peliharaan itu menggila dan mulai menyerang townsfolk. Dan hasilnya, mereka berdua di keluarkan dari kota.
dialogsBegin.it: The pet went crazy and began attacking townsfolk. As a result, both of them were kicked out of the town.
dialogsBegin.jp: ある時、モンスターと村の女性の間に子供ができたが、その子どもを恐れて忌み嫌った村人たちは、モンスターと女性と子どもを村から追放してしまった。それから月日が流れてモンスターは死に、頼るところがなくなった女性は子供を連れて再び村に戻って来た。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그런데 그 동물이 미치더니 마을 사람들을 공격하기 시작했어요. 결국, 소녀와 동물은 함께 마을에서 쫓겨났죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: The pet went crazy and began attacking townsfolk. As a result, both of them were kicked out of the town.
dialogsBegin.pl: The pet went crazy and began attacking townsfolk. As a result, both of them were kicked out of the town.
dialogsBegin.ru: Но соседка забыла и накормила Крошку сырым мясом. Крошка доел, облизнулся и запел: "Урчу, ворчу, человечины хочу!" Соседка решила, что ей показалось. Утром она узнала, что мясник пропал.
dialogsBegin.sp: La mascota se volvió loca y comenzó a atacar a la gente del pueblo. Como resultado, ambos fueron expulsados ​​​​de la ciudad.
dialogsBegin.sw: The pet went crazy and began attacking townsfolk. As a result, both of them were kicked out of the town.
dialogsBegin.th: สัตว์เลี้ยงคลุ้มคลั่งแล้วเริ่มโจมตีชาวเมือง ทำให้ทั้งสองถูกไล่ออกจากเมือง
dialogsBegin.tw: 有一個女子愛上了一個魔域怪，後來這個女子懷了魔域怪的孩子，之後被趕出村外。沒多久魔域怪死亡之後，
dialogsBegin.vi: Thú cưng trở nên điên loạn và bắt đầu tấn công người dân trong thị trấn. Kết quả là cả hai đều bị đuổi ra khỏi thị trấn.

dialogsBegin.en: The woman came back to the town, but the people in town killed her pet! Then the black magician made a bowl out of the skull of her pet and cursed it!
dialogsBegin.ar: The woman came back to the town, but the people in town killed her pet! Then the black magician made a bowl out of the skull of her pet and cursed it!
dialogsBegin.br: A mulher retornou para a cidade, mas o povo matou seu Pet. Então o mago fez uma tigela com o crânio do animal dela e amaldiçoou esta tigela.
dialogsBegin.cns: 女子抱着孩子回到村子，但是村民把女子跟孩子全都杀掉了。黑暗魔导士就利用孩子的头骨，做了一个情盆，而在这个情盆里下了诅咒。
dialogsBegin.de: ...und die Frau kam ins Dorf zurück. Aber die Menschen im Dorf töteten die Frau und ihr Baby. Der schwarze Magier machte eine Schüssel aus dem Schädel ihres Babys und verfluchte ihn.
dialogsBegin.fi: The woman came back to the town, but the people in town killed her pet! Then the black magician made a bowl out of the skull of her pet and cursed it!
dialogsBegin.fil: The woman came back to the town, but the people in town killed her pet! Then the black magician made a bowl out of the skull of her pet and cursed it!
dialogsBegin.fr: Les habitants craignant le pire tuèrent alors son animal de compagnie ! Outrée, la femme se confia à un puissant mage noir, qui créa un bol d'os avec le crâne de l'animal, et lui lança une puissante malédiction !
dialogsBegin.id: Seorang wanita kembali ke sebuah kota, tapi orang - orang di kota membunuh peliharan wanita tersebut! Dan seorang black magician membuat mangkuk menggunakan tulang dari peliharannya dan mengutuknya!
dialogsBegin.it: The woman came back to the town, but the people in town killed her pet! Then the black magician made a bowl out of the skull of her pet and cursed it!
dialogsBegin.jp: ところが、村人たちは忌むべき存在が戻ってきたことを恐れ、その女性と子どもを惨殺し、斬りおとした子どもの頭を見せしめとして村の広場に晒したんだそうだ。この事件がきっかけでモンスターと人間は敵対関係になったと伝えられている。
dialogsBegin.kr: 소녀가 다시 마을로 돌아오자, 마을 사람들은 애완동물을 죽여버리고 말았어요! 블랙 매지션은 동물의 두개골로 그릇을 만들고, 여기에 저주를 걸었죠!
dialogsBegin.nl: The woman came back to the town, but the people in town killed her pet! Then the black magician made a bowl out of the skull of her pet and cursed it!
dialogsBegin.pl: The woman came back to the town, but the people in town killed her pet! Then the black magician made a bowl out of the skull of her pet and cursed it!
dialogsBegin.ru: Но она ничего не заподозрила и опять накормила Крошку мясом. Крошка поел, облизнулся и запел: "Урчу, ворчу, человечины хочу!" Соседка опять решила, что ей показалось. Утром пропал мэр…
dialogsBegin.sp: La mujer volvió al pueblo, ¡pero la gente del pueblo mató a su mascota! ¡Entonces la maga negra hizo un cuenco con el cráneo de su mascota y lo maldijo!
dialogsBegin.sw: The woman came back to the town, but the people in town killed her pet! Then the black magician made a bowl out of the skull of her pet and cursed it!
dialogsBegin.th: ผู้หญิงคนนั้นกลับมาที่เมือง แต่คนในเมืองฆ่าสัตว์เลี้ยงของเธอ! หลังจากนั้นนักเวทย์มนตร์ดำจึงนำกะโหลกศรีษะของสัตว์เลี้ยงของเธอมาทำชามแล้วจึงสาปมันไว้!
dialogsBegin.tw: 女子抱著孩子回到村子，但是村民把女子跟孩子全都殺掉了。黑暗魔法師就利用孩子的頭骨，做了一個情盆，而在這個情盆裡下了詛咒。
dialogsBegin.vi: Người phụ nữ đã trở lại thị trấn, nhưng những người trong thị trấn đã giết chết thú cưng của cô ấy! Sau đó, hắc đạo sư đã làm một cái bát từ hộp sọ của con thú cưng và nguyền rủa nó!

dialogsBegin.en: The town disappeared because of the curse, and so did the bowl…but there are some that say…Well, I've already said too much.
dialogsBegin.ar: The town disappeared because of the curse, and so did the bowl…but there are some that say…Well, I've already said too much.
dialogsBegin.br: A cidade desapareceu por causa da maldição. E a tigela também...mas há quem diga que...Bem, estou falando demais.
dialogsBegin.cns: 之后村子因为情盆的诅咒而消失了，得到这个情盆的人民也没有一个生存下来。
dialogsBegin.de: Aufgrund des Fluches verschwand das Dorf jedoch. Jeder, der den Schlüssel hat, kann nicht ankommen. Denn das Dorf verschwand wegen des Fluches. Das sind die Fakten. (Nach einer Minute Schweigen) ..Nun, ich rede zuviel.
dialogsBegin.fi: The town disappeared because of the curse, and so did the bowl…but there are some that say…Well, I've already said too much.
dialogsBegin.fil: The town disappeared because of the curse, and so did the bowl…but there are some that say…Well, I've already said too much.
dialogsBegin.fr: La malédiction fit alors disparaître la ville de Madrigal, ainsi que tous ceux qui entrèrent en contact avec le bol maudit. (Pensif) Voilà ce que raconte la légende du bol maudit.
dialogsBegin.id: Kota tersebut menghilang karena kutukan, dan juga dengan mangkuk…tapi ada beberapa yang mengatakan…Baiklah, aku sudah menceritakan terlalu banyak.
dialogsBegin.it: The town disappeared because of the curse, and so did the bowl…but there are some that say…Well, I've already said too much.
dialogsBegin.jp: ある日、惨殺された母子の話を聞いた＜ブラックマジシャン＞が村を訪れ、殺された子供の頭蓋骨を使って呪術用の器を作り、呪いをかけたところ、その村は跡形もなく滅びてしまったと伝えられている。これが＜ボーンボール＞の由来さ。なかなかいわくつきだろう？フフフ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이후 저주가 퍼져 마을은 사라졌고, 그 그릇도 함께 사라졌어요… 아직 어딘가 있을 거라고 하는 사람도 있지만... 아차, 제가 너무 말이 많았네요.
dialogsBegin.nl: The town disappeared because of the curse, and so did the bowl…but there are some that say…Well, I've already said too much.
dialogsBegin.pl: The town disappeared because of the curse, and so did the bowl…but there are some that say…Well, I've already said too much.
dialogsBegin.ru: Короче говоря, за пару недель глупая тетка погубила весь город! Потом, конечно, вернулась старушка, пришла в ужас, обернулась ведьмой, которой она на самом деле была…
dialogsBegin.sp: El pueblo desapareció a causa de la maldición, y también el cuenco... pero hay algunos que dicen... Bueno, ya he hablado demasiado.
dialogsBegin.sw: The town disappeared because of the curse, and so did the bowl…but there are some that say…Well, I've already said too much.
dialogsBegin.th: เมืองหายไปเพราะคำสาปแช่งพร้อมๆกับชามใบนั้น... แต่มีบ้างก็บอกว่า... อืม ฉันเริ่มพูดมากเกินไปแล้วล่ะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 之後村子因為情盆的詛咒而消失了，得到這個情盆的人民也沒有一個生存下來。
dialogsBegin.vi: Thị trấn đã biến mất vì lời nguyền, và cái bát cũng vậy… nhưng có một số người nói rằng… Chà, tôi đã nói quá nhiều rồi.

dialogsBegin.en: So you want the real Bone Bowl, right? Well, you'll have to do something for me first. Nothing in this world is free, right? Hahaha!
dialogsBegin.ar: So you want the real Bone Bowl, right? Well, you'll have to do something for me first. Nothing in this world is free, right? Hahaha!
dialogsBegin.br: Então você me disse que quer a verdadeira Tigela de Osso, não é? Bem, você terá que fazer algo para mim primeiro. Nada neste mundo vem de graça, certo? Hahaha!
dialogsBegin.cns: 你说想要真的骨制御碗吗?那帮我找一些东西好吗?
dialogsBegin.de: Du willst also die echte Bone Bowl, richtig? Nun, dann musst du zuerst etwas für mich tun. Nichts auf dieser Welt ist umsonst, stimmt's? Hahaha!
dialogsBegin.fi: So you want the real Bone Bowl, right? Well, you'll have to do something for me first. Nothing in this world is free, right? Hahaha!
dialogsBegin.fil: So you want the real Bone Bowl, right? Well, you'll have to do something for me first. Nothing in this world is free, right? Hahaha!
dialogsBegin.fr: Alors, tu es bien sûr que tu es toujours intéressé par ce bol maudit ? Dans ce cas peux-tu me ramener quelques objets ?
dialogsBegin.id: Jadi kamu menginginkan sebuah Bone Bowl yang asli, bukan? Baiklah, kamu harus melakukan sesuatu untukku terlebih dahulu. Tidak ada didunia ini yang gratis, bukan? Hahaha!
dialogsBegin.it: So you want the real Bone Bowl, right? Well, you'll have to do something for me first. Nothing in this world is free, right? Hahaha!
dialogsBegin.jp: ふむ、本物の＜ボーンボール＞がほしいのか？ふむ。じゃ、俺が注文する材料を集めてきてくれ。話はそれからだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그러니까, 그 진짜 본보울을 찾고 있다는 거죠. 우선 해 주실 일이 있어요. 세상에 공짜는 없다고요, 하하하!
dialogsBegin.nl: So you want the real Bone Bowl, right? Well, you'll have to do something for me first. Nothing in this world is free, right? Hahaha!
dialogsBegin.pl: So you want the real Bone Bowl, right? Well, you'll have to do something for me first. Nothing in this world is free, right? Hahaha!
dialogsBegin.ru: …приструнила своего вурдалака, а соседку убила и вырезала из ее черепа костяную миску. Ну как, все еще хочешь найти ТУ САМУЮ Миску?
dialogsBegin.sp: Así que quieres el Cuenco de Hueso verdadero, ¿eh? Bueno, primero tendrás que hacer algo por mí. Nada en este mundo es gratis, ¿verdad? ¡Jajaja!
dialogsBegin.sw: So you want the real Bone Bowl, right? Well, you'll have to do something for me first. Nothing in this world is free, right? Hahaha!
dialogsBegin.th: คุณต้องการ Bone Bowl จริงๆใช่มั้ย? ก็ได้ คุณต้องทำบางสิ่งบางอย่างให้ฉันก่อน ไม่มีอะไรในโลกนี้ฟรีใช่มั้ยล่ะ? ฮ่าฮ่าฮ่า!
dialogsBegin.tw: 所以你想要真正的情盆，對吧？好吧，你得先為我做點什麼。這個世界上沒有什麼是免費的，對吧？哈哈哈！
dialogsBegin.vi: Vì vậy, bạn muốn Bone Bowl thật, phải không? Vâng, bạn sẽ phải làm gì đó cho tôi trước. Trên đời này không có gì là miễn phí cả, đúng không? Hahaha!

dialogsAccept.en: Good! Bring me 10 Black Tombmarbles from Tombstone Bearers, 5 Black Spell Books and 5 Black Heroka Grass from somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis.
dialogsAccept.ar: Good! Bring me 10 Black Tombmarbles from Tombstone Bearers, 5 Black Spell Books and 5 Black Heroka Grass from somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis.
dialogsAccept.br: Ótimo. Traga para mim 10 Lápides Negras dos Portadores de Lápide, 5 Livros de Feitiços Negros e 5 mudas de Heroca Negra de algum lugar no Jardim de Rhisis.
dialogsAccept.cns: 好，请帮我找碑石工匠的10个黑色石柱碎片，在莱斯庭院里就可以找到的黑色诅咒书5个，黑色毒草5个。
dialogsAccept.de: Gut. Bringe mir 10 Black Tomb Marbles von Tombstonebearers, 5 Black Spell Books und 5 Black Heroka Grass aus dem Garten von Rhisis.
dialogsAccept.fi: Good! Bring me 10 Black Tombmarbles from Tombstone Bearers, 5 Black Spell Books and 5 Black Heroka Grass from somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis.
dialogsAccept.fil: Good! Bring me 10 Black Tombmarbles from Tombstone Bearers, 5 Black Spell Books and 5 Black Heroka Grass from somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis.
dialogsAccept.fr: Comme tu voudras. Il me faudrait 10 morceaux de Marbre tombal noir provenant de Tombstone, 5 Grimoires et 5 Héroscas noires que tu devrais trouver dans le jardin de Rhisis.
dialogsAccept.id: Bagus! Berikan kepadaku 10 Black Tombmarbles dari Tombstone Beares, 5 Bllack Spell Books dan 5 Black Heroka Grass dari tempat di Garden of Rhisis.
dialogsAccept.it: Good! Bring me 10 Black Tombmarbles from Tombstone Bearers, 5 Black Spell Books and 5 Black Heroka Grass from somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis.
dialogsAccept.jp: 集めてきてくれるかい？じゃ、トムストンベアラーから黒い大理石の欠片を10個、リシスの庭の何処かにある黒い呪文書を5個、黒いヘルカーフルを5個、集めてきてくれ。頼んだぜ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 그럼 툼스톤 베어러에게서 검은 툼마블 10개, 리시스 정원 어딘가에서 검은 마법서 5권과 검은 헤로카 풀 5개를 구해주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Good! Bring me 10 Black Tombmarbles from Tombstone Bearers, 5 Black Spell Books and 5 Black Heroka Grass from somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis.
dialogsAccept.pl: Dobrze! Przynieś mi 10 Czarnych Nagrobków od Targaczy Nagrobków, 5 Czarnych Książek Zaklęć i 5 Traw Czarnej Heroki z Ogrodu Rhisis.
dialogsAccept.ru: Отлично. Принеси мне десять обломков черной могильной плиты, пять черных книг проклятий и пять пучков ойры из Райсского сада.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Bien! Tráeme 10 Tumbas de Mármol Negras de los Tombstone Bearers, 5 Libros de Hechizos Negros y 5 Hierbas Negras de Heroka de algún lugar del Jardín de Rhisis.
dialogsAccept.sw: Good! Bring me 10 Black Tombmarbles from Tombstone Bearers, 5 Black Spell Books and 5 Black Heroka Grass from somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis.
dialogsAccept.th: ดี! นำ Black Tombmarbles 10 อันจาก Tombstone Bearers, Black Spell Books 5 อันและ Black Heroka Grass 5 อันจากที่ไหนสักแห่งใน Garden of Rhisis
dialogsAccept.tw: 好，請幫我找苦命超人的 10 個黑色石柱碎片，在黎席斯庭院裡就可以找到的黑色詛咒書 5 個，黑色毒草 5 個。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tốt! Mang cho tôi 10 Black Tombmarbles từ Tombstone Bearers, 5 Black Spell Books và 5 Black Heroka Grass từ đâu đó trong Garden of Rhisis.

dialogsDecline.en: Hey, it's up to you. Too bad though, I could have used those items to help you with your problem…
dialogsDecline.ar: Hey, it's up to you. Too bad though, I could have used those items to help you with your problem…
dialogsDecline.br: Bem, você decide. É uma pena, eu poderia ter utilizado esses itens para ajudar com seu problema…
dialogsDecline.cns: 他应该会很难过吧!我猜应该还有其他喜欢钱的玩家会帮他吧!
dialogsDecline.de: Nun.. der seltsame Sammler ist nicht glücklich. Aber er kann sich jemand anderes suchen der Geld mag.
dialogsDecline.fi: Hey, it's up to you. Too bad though, I could have used those items to help you with your problem…
dialogsDecline.fil: Hey, it's up to you. Too bad though, I could have used those items to help you with your problem…
dialogsDecline.fr: Bon... Le Collectionneur mystérieux n'a pas de bol... Mais il peut bien trouver quelqu'un d'autre qui aime l'argent. Ha ha ha ha

dialogsBegin.en: Hello Adventurer. Although you don't know me, I must ask a favor of you. I have found something… incredible. Bring it to the Mayor of Darkon right away.
dialogsBegin.ar: Hello Adventurer. Although you don't know me, I must ask a favor of you. I have found something… incredible. Bring it to the Mayor of Darkon right away.
dialogsBegin.br: Olá Aventureiro(a). Embora você não me conheça, devo pedir-lhe um favor. Eu encontrei algo... incrível. Leve-o imediatamente ao Prefeito de Darken.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你好，冒险者。我知道你不认识我，但我需要你的帮助。我发现了一些...非常难以置信的事情。请你马上将它交给达肯市长。
dialogsBegin.de: Hallo Abenteurer. Obwohl du mich nicht kennst, muss ich dich um einen Gefallen bitten. Ich habe etwas... Unglaubliches gefunden. Bring es sofort zum Bürgermeister von Darkon.
dialogsBegin.fi: Hello Adventurer. Although you don't know me, I must ask a favor of you. I have found something… incredible. Bring it to the Mayor of Darkon right away.
dialogsBegin.fil: Hello Adventurer. Although you don't know me, I must ask a favor of you. I have found something… incredible. Bring it to the Mayor of Darkon right away.
dialogsBegin.fr: Bonjour. J'ai ici un livre que le maire de Darkon m'a demandé mais je croule sous le travail. Pourriez-vous jouer les livreurs ?
dialogsBegin.id: Halo Adventurer. Meskipun Kamu tidak mengenaliku, Aku harus meminta bantuanmu. Aku telah menemukan sesuatu… luar biasa. Bawa ke Mayor Darkon segera.
dialogsBegin.it: Hello Adventurer. Although you don't know me, I must ask a favor of you. I have found something… incredible. Bring it to the Mayor of Darkon right away.
dialogsBegin.jp: そこの君！急で申し訳ないが、１つ頼まれてくれないか？ダーコン市長が依頼していた書物をやっと手に入れたんだが、オイラは店を空ける事ができないんだ。オイラの代わりに君がこの本を渡してくれないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 안녕하세요, 모험가님. 저를 모르시겠지만, 부탁할 게 있어요. 정말 믿기 힘든 걸 발견했어요. 이걸 다켄 시장님께 바로 전달해 주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Hello Adventurer. Although you don't know me, I must ask a favor of you. I have found something… incredible. Bring it to the Mayor of Darkon right away.
dialogsBegin.pl: Hello Adventurer. Although you don't know me, I must ask a favor of you. I have found something… incredible. Bring it to the Mayor of Darkon right away.
dialogsBegin.ru: Привет! Я обнаружил кое-что невероятное. И это кое-что нужно немедленно показать мэру Даркенбурга. Справишься?
dialogsBegin.sp: Hola aventurero. Aunque no me conoces, tengo que pedirte un favor. He encontrado algo... increíble. Llévaselo al alcalde de Darken de inmediato.
dialogsBegin.sw: Hello Adventurer. Although you don't know me, I must ask a favor of you. I have found something… incredible. Bring it to the Mayor of Darkon right away.
dialogsBegin.th: สวัสดีนักผจญภัย แม้ว่าคุณจะไม่รู้จักฉัน แต่ฉันต้องขอความกรุณาจากคุณ ฉันได้พบบางสิ่ง… เหลือเชื่อ นำไปให้นายกเทศมนตรีดาร์คอนทันที
dialogsBegin.tw: 你好冒險家，雖然你不認識我，但我必須請你幫個忙。我發現了一些……不可思議。馬上把它帶給得肯市長。
dialogsBegin.vi: Xin chào nhà thám hiểm. Dù bạn không biết tôi, tôi cũng phải nhờ bạn giúp đỡ. Tôi đã tìm thấy một cái gì đó… không thể tin được. Mang nó cho Thị trưởng của Darkon ngay lập tức.

dialogsBegin.en: Bolpor requested you to collect Rincruet for making some special food. Will you accept this request?
dialogsBegin.ar: Bolpor requested you to collect Rincruet for making some special food. Will you accept this request?
dialogsBegin.br: Bolpor pediu que você coletasse Rincruet para fazer uma comida especial. Você vai aceitar este pedido?
dialogsBegin.cns: 沃尔波尔委托你去收集麻普调味桶来制作一些特别的食物。你要接收这个委托吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Bolpor hat dich gebeten, Rincruet für die Zubereitung eines besonderen Essens zu sammeln. Wirst du dieser Bitte nachkommen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Bolpor requested you to collect Rincruet for making some special food. Will you accept this request?
dialogsBegin.fil: Inutusan ka ni Bolpor na kolektahin ang Rincruet para gumawa ng espesyal na pagkain. Tatanggapin mo ba ang kahilingan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Pouvez-vous rassembler des Rincruets pour moi sans chercher à en savoir plus sur mes intentions ?
dialogsBegin.id: Bolpor memintamu mengumpulkan Rincruet untuk membuat beberapa makanan spesial. Maukah kamu menerima quest ini?

dialogsBegin.en: Nonetheless, because of your work, it appears peace has finally been restored to Flarine. Alas, Madrigal is a world ripe with distress.
dialogsBegin.ar: Nonetheless, because of your work, it appears peace has finally been restored to Flarine. Alas, Madrigal is a world ripe with distress.
dialogsBegin.br: No entanto, por causa de seu trabalho, parece que a paz foi finalmente foi restaurada em Flarine. Infelizmente, Madrigal é um mundo repleto de angústia.
dialogsBegin.cns: 因为你的付出，帕里终于恢复了和平。但是瑞加大陆是一个充满着痛苦的世界。
dialogsBegin.de: Dennoch scheint es, dass dank Ihrer Arbeit endlich wieder Frieden in Flarine eingekehrt ist. Leider ist die Welt von Madrigal voll von Unglück.
dialogsBegin.fi: Nonetheless, because of your work, it appears peace has finally been restored to Flarine. Alas, Madrigal is a world ripe with distress.
dialogsBegin.fil: Nonetheless, because of your work, it appears peace has finally been restored to Flarine. Alas, Madrigal is a world ripe with distress.
dialogsBegin.fr: Les échos de vos exploits résonnent haut et fort. A tel point qu'on est venu me donner une mission spécialement pour vous !
dialogsBegin.id: Karena jasamulah Flarine dapat menemukan kedamaian yang mereka idamkan di Madrigal, dunia yang penuh dengan kekacauan.
dialogsBegin.it: Nonetheless, because of your work, it appears peace has finally been restored to Flarine. Alas, Madrigal is a world ripe with distress.
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたのおかげで、平和なフラリーヌになりました。今、マドリガルは苦痛に満ちた世界です。
dialogsBegin.kr: 당신의 활약 덕분에, 플라리네에 마침내 평화가 찾아온 것 같네요. 하지만 마드리갈은 여전히 문제가 많답니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Nonetheless, because of your work, it appears peace has finally been restored to Flarine. Alas, Madrigal is a world ripe with distress.
dialogsBegin.pl: Nonetheless, because of your work, it appears peace has finally been restored to Flarine. Alas, Madrigal is a world ripe with distress.
dialogsBegin.ru: Тем не менее, благодаря тебе жизнь во Фларинции начала налаживаться. Но Мадригал в целом всё ещё в опасности.
dialogsBegin.sp: Gracias a tu trabajo, parece que al fin se ha restaurado la paz en Flarine. Por desgracia, Madrigal es un mundo lleno de angustia.
dialogsBegin.sw: Nonetheless, because of your work, it appears peace has finally been restored to Flarine. Alas, Madrigal is a world ripe with distress.
dialogsBegin.th: อย่างไรก็ตาม เนื่องจากงานของคุณ ดูเหมือนว่าความสงบสุขกลับคืนสู่ Flarine ในที่สุด อนิจจา Madrigal เป็นโลกที่เต็มไปด้วยความทุกข์
dialogsBegin.tw: 儘管如此，由於你的工作，布拉里斯似乎終於恢復了平靜。唉，瑪德利賈是一個充滿痛苦的世界。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tuy nhiên, vì công việc của bạn, có vẻ như hòa bình cuối cùng đã được khôi phục cho Flarine. Than ôi, Madrigal là một thế giới chín muồi đầy đau khổ.

dialogsBegin.en: I have received word from a contact in Saint City that masquerpet attacks are steadily on the rise. It also seems that the concerns of the towns people go unheeded.
dialogsBegin.ar: I have received word from a contact in Saint City that masquerpet attacks are steadily on the rise. It also seems that the concerns of the towns people go unheeded.
dialogsBegin.br: Recebi uma notícia de um contato em Saint, que ataques de Masquerpets estão aumentando constantemente. Parece também que as preocupações das pessoas da cidade passam despercebidas.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我从晨光的线人处听说晨光受怪物攻击的频率正在增加。似乎没有人帮助晨光的居民。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich habe von einem Kontakt in Saint City erfahren, dass die Angriffe durch masquerpet stetig zunehmen. Es scheint auch, dass die Sorgen der Stadtbewohner ungehört bleiben.
dialogsBegin.fi: I have received word from a contact in Saint City that masquerpet attacks are steadily on the rise. It also seems that the concerns of the towns people go unheeded.
dialogsBegin.fil: I have received word from a contact in Saint City that masquerpet attacks are steadily on the rise. It also seems that the concerns of the towns people go unheeded.
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous allez donc travailler pour Saincity dans la région de Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku mendapatkan laporan dari Saint City jika serangan Masquerpet disana semakin meningkat. Sepertinya kekhawatiran orang-orang kota juga tidak dihiraukan.
dialogsBegin.it: I have received word from a contact in Saint City that masquerpet attacks are steadily on the rise. It also seems that the concerns of the towns people go unheeded.
dialogsBegin.jp: セントシティからの連絡で、マスカペット攻撃が増加しているとの連絡がありました。 また、町の人々の懸念が高まっています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 세인트 시티에 있는 지인에게서 연락이 왔는데, 마스커펫의 공격이 점점 심해져 마을 사람들이 불안에 떨고 있는데도 마땅한 대응책이 없는 상황이라고 하더군요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I have received word from a contact in Saint City that masquerpet attacks are steadily on the rise. It also seems that the concerns of the towns people go unheeded.
dialogsBegin.pl: I have received word from a contact in Saint City that masquerpet attacks are steadily on the rise. It also seems that the concerns of the towns people go unheeded.
dialogsBegin.ru: Мои агенты в Санто сообщают о росте атак марионеток на город. И похоже, их мэр слишком занят, чтоб заниматься просьбами горожан.
dialogsBegin.sp: He recibido noticias de un contacto de Saint y parece que los ataques de masquerpets están aumentando constantemente. Aunque parece que las preocupaciones de la gente del pueblo pasan desapercibidas.
dialogsBegin.sw: I have received word from a contact in Saint City that masquerpet attacks are steadily on the rise. It also seems that the concerns of the towns people go unheeded.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันได้รับแจ้งจากผู้ติดต่อใน Saint City ว่าการโจมตีของ masquerpet กำลังเพิ่มขึ้นอย่างต่อเนื่อง ดูเหมือนว่าความกังวลของชาวเมืองจะไม่ได้รับความสนใจ
dialogsBegin.tw: 我從聖音特的一位聯繫人那裡得到消息，怪物的襲擊正在逐步升高，似乎鎮上人們的擔憂也被忽視了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đã nhận được tin từ một người liên lạc ở Thành phố Saint rằng các cuộc tấn công bằng masquerpet đang gia tăng đều đặn. Có vẻ như mối quan tâm của người dân thị trấn không được quan tâm.

dialogsBegin.en: It looks like this could once again be your chance to prove your true worth. Make haste to Saint City and meet my contact Leann!
dialogsBegin.ar: It looks like this could once again be your chance to prove your true worth. Make haste to Saint City and meet my contact Leann!
dialogsBegin.br: Parece que mais uma vez você pode ter a chance de provar seu verdadeiro valor. Corra para a Cidade de Saint e encontre o meu contato, ela se chama Leann!
dialogsBegin.cns: 这看起来又是一个能证明你真正价值的机会。请你马上动身前去晨光与我的线人露恩见面吧！
dialogsBegin.de: Es sieht so aus, als ob dies wieder einmal deine Chance sein könnte, deinen wahren Wert zu beweisen. Beeilen Sie sich nach Saint City und treffen Sie meine Kontaktperson Leann!
dialogsBegin.fi: It looks like this could once again be your chance to prove your true worth. Make haste to Saint City and meet my contact Leann!
dialogsBegin.fil: It looks like this could once again be your chance to prove your true worth. Make haste to Saint City and meet my contact Leann!
dialogsBegin.fr: Allez donc parler à Leann à Saincity.
dialogsBegin.id: Sepertinya ini sekali lagi bisa menjadi kesempatan untuk membuktikan kemampuanmu yang sebenarnya. Bergegaslah ke Saint City dan temui Leann!
dialogsBegin.it: It looks like this could once again be your chance to prove your true worth. Make haste to Saint City and meet my contact Leann!
dialogsBegin.jp: セイントモーニングの広場にルアンという案内人がいる。まずはルアンに話を聞いてみてくれないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 어쩌면 이번 기회에 당신의 진정한 가치를 증명할 수 있을지도 몰라요. 서둘러 세인트 시티로 가서, 제 지인 르앤을 만나 주세요!
dialogsBegin.nl: It looks like this could once again be your chance to prove your true worth. Make haste to Saint City and meet my contact Leann!
dialogsBegin.pl: It looks like this could once again be your chance to prove your true worth. Make haste to Saint City and meet my contact Leann!
dialogsBegin.ru: Это может быть твоим шансом ещё раз проявить свою доблесть. Поспеши в Санто и разыщи Лианну. Скажи ей, что ты от меня.
dialogsBegin.sp: Parece que esta podría ser otra oportunidad de demostrar tu verdadero valor. ¡Date prisa, ve a Saint y reúnete con mi contacto Leann!
dialogsBegin.sw: It looks like this could once again be your chance to prove your true worth. Make haste to Saint City and meet my contact Leann!
dialogsBegin.th: ดูเหมือนว่านี่อาจเป็นโอกาสของคุณที่จะพิสูจน์คุณค่าที่แท้จริงของคุณอีกครั้ง รีบไปที่ Saint City และพบกับ Leann ผู้ติดต่อของฉัน!
dialogsBegin.tw: 看起來這可能再次成為你證明自己真正價值的機會。趕緊去聖音特見我的聯絡人萊恩！
dialogsBegin.vi: Có vẻ đây là cơ hội để bạn chứng minh giá trị thực sự của mình. Hãy nhanh chóng đến thành phố Saint và gặp người liên hệ của tôi Leann!

dialogsAccept.en: You can reach Saint City by flying west from this location using an Airship from Central Flarine or your own Flying device. You may also purchase a blinkwing of Saint Morning from Marche, the resident magician.
dialogsAccept.ar: You can reach Saint City by flying west from this location using an Airship from Central Flarine or your own Flying device. You may also purchase a blinkwing of Saint Morning from Marche, the resident magician.
dialogsAccept.br: Você pode chegar na Cidade de Saint voando em direção oeste a partir deste local, use um Barco Voador do Centro de Flarine ou seu próprio Dispositivo Voador. Você também pode comprar um Teleporte para Saint com a Marche, a maga residente.
dialogsAccept.cns: 你可以通过乘坐帕里镇中心的飞船或是自己的飞行器前往这个位置的西边来抵达晨光。你可能需要从魔导士玛尔琪处购买晨光翅膀。
dialogsAccept.de: Ihr könnt die Stadt Saint City erreichen, indem ihr von diesem Ort aus mit einem Luftschiff von Central Flarine oder mit eurem eigenen Fluggerät nach Westen fliegt. Ihr könnt auch einen Blinkwing des Saint Monring von Marche, dem ansässigen Magier, kaufen.
dialogsAccept.fi: You can reach Saint City by flying west from this location using an Airship from Central Flarine or your own Flying device. You may also purchase a blinkwing of Saint Morning from Marche, the resident magician.
dialogsAccept.fil: You can reach Saint City by flying west from this location using an Airship from Central Flarine or your own Flying device. You may also purchase a blinkwing of Saint Morning from Marche, the resident magician.
dialogsAccept.fr: Vous ne pouvez pas voler vers Saint Morning ? Mais allez-vous acheter un balai !
dialogsAccept.id: Kamu dapat mencapai Saint City dari sini dengan terbang kearah barat menggunakan Airship dari Central Flarine atau menggunakan Flying Devicemu sendiri. Kamu juga dapat membeli Blinkwing of Saint Morning dari Marche.
dialogsAccept.it: You can reach Saint City by flying west from this location using an Airship from Central Flarine or your own Flying device. You may also purchase a blinkwing of Saint Morning from Marche, the resident magician.
dialogsAccept.jp: セントラルフラリーヌからの飛行船またはあなた自身の飛行装置を使用して、この場所から西に飛ぶことによって聖都市に到達することができます。 レジデントマジシャンのマルシェから聖朝の瞬きを購入することもできます。
dialogsAccept.kr: 세인트 시티는 여기서 서쪽으로 가면 돼요. 플라리네 중부에서 비행선을 이용하거나, 직접 만든 비행 장치를 타고 이동할 수도 있죠. 이곳 매지션인 마르셰에게 세인트 모닝 블링크윙을 구매해 사용해도 되고요.
dialogsAccept.nl: You can reach Saint City by flying west from this location using an Airship from Central Flarine or your own Flying device. You may also purchase a blinkwing of Saint Morning from Marche, the resident magician.
dialogsAccept.pl: You can reach Saint City by flying west from this location using an Airship from Central Flarine or your own Flying device. You may also purchase a blinkwing of Saint Morning from Marche, the resident magician.
dialogsAccept.ru: Есть три варианта добраться до Санто. Можешь воспользоваться летающими кораблями, их стоянка прямо в центре Фларинции. Или можешь приобрести личный летающий скейт или метлу. Ну или самый быстрый вариант - купить гипер-блик в лавке магии.
dialogsAccept.sp: Puedes llegar a Saint volando hacia el oeste desde aquí utilizando un Barco Volador desde Flarine Central o con tu propio dispositivo volador. También puedes comprar un parpadeo de Saint Morning en la tienda de Marche.
dialogsAccept.sw: You can reach Saint City by flying west from this location using an Airship from Central Flarine or your own Flying device. You may also purchase a blinkwing of Saint Morning from Marche, the resident magician.
dialogsAccept.th: คุณสามารถเข้าถึง Saint City ได้โดยบินไปทางตะวันตกจากตำแหน่งนี้โดยใช้เรือเหาะจาก Central Flarine หรืออุปกรณ์ Flying ของคุณเอง นอกจากนี้คุณยังสามารถซื้อ Saint Morning จาก Marche นักเวทย์ประจำบ้านได้อีกด้วย
dialogsAccept.tw: 你可以使用來自布拉里斯的飛艇或你自己的飛行設備從該位置向西飛抵聖音特。你也可以從駐地魔法師魔力夢夢那裡購買聖音特城傳送卷軸。
dialogsAccept.vi: Bạn có thể đến Thành phố Saint bằng cách bay về phía Tây từ vị trí này bằng Phi thuyền từ Central Flarine hoặc thiết bị Bay của riêng bạn. Bạn cũng có thể mua một nháy mắt của Saint Morning từ Marche, pháp sư thường trú.

dialogsDecline.en: Hmm, I guess this worlds call for heroes is currently falling upon deaf ears.
dialogsDecline.ar: Hmm, I guess this worlds call for heroes is currently falling upon deaf ears.
dialogsDecline.br: Hmm, eu acho que este mundo que clama por heróis está caindo em ouvidos surdos.
dialogsDecline.cns: 嗯... 我猜这个世界对英雄的呼唤现在被置若罔闻了。
dialogsDecline.de: Ich glaube, der Ruf dieser Welt nach Helden stößt derzeit auf taube Ohren.
dialogsDecline.fi: Hmm, I guess this worlds call for heroes is currently falling upon deaf ears.
dialogsDecline.fil: Hmm, I guess this worlds call for heroes is currently falling upon deaf ears.
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous savez, devenir un héros est une occupation à plein temps. C'est un sacerdoce.
dialogsDecline.id: Hmm, aku kira panggilan dunia untuk pahlawan ini saat ini tidak didengarkan.
dialogsDecline.it: Hmm, I guess this worlds call for heroes is currently falling upon deaf ears.
dialogsDecline.jp: そうか、英雄とは人々のためにその力を発揮してこそ英雄だぞ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 으음... 영웅을 필요로 하는 세상의 부름에 귀 기울이고 싶지 않은 건가요...
dialogsDecline.nl: Hmm, I guess this worlds call for heroes is currently falling upon deaf ears.
dialogsDecline.pl: Hmm, I guess this worlds call for heroes is currently falling upon deaf ears.
dialogsDecline.ru: Hmm, I guess this worlds call for heroes is currently falling upon deaf ears.
dialogsDecline.sp: Hmm, supongo que este llamamiento mundial a los héroes está cayendo en oídos sordos.
dialogsDecline.sw: Hmm, I guess this worlds call for heroes is currently falling upon deaf ears.
dialogsDecline.th: อืม ฉันเดาว่าการเรียกร้องของฮีโร่ในโลกนี้กำลังตกเป็นเป้าของคนหูหนวก
dialogsDecline.tw: 嗯，我想這個世界對英雄的呼喚目前被置若罔聞。
dialogsDecline.vi: Hmm, tôi đoán thế giới này kêu gọi anh hùng hiện đang rơi vào tai điếc.

dialogsComplete.en: Where is the savior that Reonan was talking about? I don't have time to talk to you. This is not a good time for me to guide you around!! Traveler!!.
dialogsComplete.ar: Where is the savior that Reonan was talking about? I don't have time to talk to you. This is not a good time for me to guide you around!! Traveler!!.
dialogsComplete.br: Onde está o salvador de que Reonan estava falando? Não tenho tempo para falar com você. Este não é um bom momento para guiar você por aí!! Viajante!!
dialogsComplete.cns: 瑞尔南说的救世主在哪？我没有空和你闲谈。旅行者！！这并不是适合给你指路的时间！！
dialogsComplete.de: Wo ist der Retter, von dem Reonan gesprochen hat? Ich habe keine Zeit, mit dir zu reden. Das ist kein guter Zeitpunkt für mich, dich herumzuführen!! Reisender!!!
dialogsComplete.fi: Where is the savior that Reonan was talking about? I don't have time to talk to you. This is not a good time for me to guide you around!! Traveler!!.
dialogsComplete.fil: Where is the savior that Reonan was talking about? I don't have time to talk to you. This is not a good time for me to guide you around!! Traveler!!.
dialogsComplete.fr: Bonjour, vous êtes l'apprenti de Reonan ?
dialogsComplete.id: Di mana pahlawan yang dibicarakan Reonan? Aku tidak punya waktu untuk berbicara denganmu. Ini bukan saat yang tepat untuk memandumu berkeliling pengelana!!.
dialogsComplete.it: Where is the savior that Reonan was talking about? I don't have time to talk to you. This is not a good time for me to guide you around!! Traveler!!.
dialogsComplete.jp: ふう……レオナン様の仰っていた冒険者はいつ来て下さるのでしょう。ん？　貴方は……
dialogsComplete.kr: 도대체 그 구세주는 언제 오는 거죠? 죄송하지만, 지금은 안내해 드릴 수 있는 상황이 아니에요! 귀찮게 하지 마세요, 여행자님!!
dialogsComplete.nl: Where is the savior that Reonan was talking about? I don't have time to talk to you. This is not a good time for me to guide you around!! Traveler!!.
dialogsComplete.pl: Where is the savior that Reonan was talking about? I don't have time to talk to you. This is not a good time for me to guide you around!! Traveler!!.
dialogsComplete.ru: У меня нет времени с тобой говорить! Я жду спасителя Мадригала, о котором мне поведал Максимус. У меня нет времени на помощь обычным путешественникам!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿Dónde está el salvador del que hablaba Reonan? No tengo tiempo para hablar contigo. ¡Este no es un buen momento para hacerte de guía, viajero!
dialogsComplete.sw: Where is the savior that Reonan was talking about? I don't have time to talk to you. This is not a good time for me to guide you around!! Traveler!!.
dialogsComplete.th: ผู้ช่วยให้รอดที่ Reonan กำลังพูดถึงอยู่ที่ไหน ฉันไม่มีเวลาคุยกับคุณ นี่ไม่ใช่เวลาที่ดีสำหรับฉันที่จะนำทางคุณไปรอบๆ!! นักเดินทาง!!
dialogsComplete.tw: 雷奧南所說的救世主在哪裡？我沒時間和你說話。現在不是我指導你的好時機！！旅行者！！。
dialogsComplete.vi: Vị cứu tinh mà Reonan đang nói đến ở đâu? Tôi không có thời gian để nói chuyện với bạn. Đây không phải là thời điểm tốt để tôi hướng dẫn bạn đi xung quanh !! Khách du lịch !!.
