dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.br: Sua missão foi concluída. Seus pecados foram perdoados.
dialogsComplete.cns: 任务完成，你的罪恶已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Buße getan. Deine Sünden wurden dir vergeben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Questmu telah tercapai. Dosa-dosamu telah diampuni.
dialogsComplete.it: La Missione è terminata. I tuoi peccati sono stati perdonati.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 끝났습니다. 당신의 죄를 용서하지요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.

dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น บาปของคุณได้รับการอภัยแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nhiệm vụ của bạn đã được hoàn thành. Tội lỗi của bạn đã được tha thứ.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

description.ar: Find Elaine.
description.br: Encontre Elaine.
description.cns: 寻找伊莲。
description.de: Finde Elaine.
description.fi: Find Elaine.
description.fil: Find Elaine.
description.fr: Trouvez Alain.
description.id: Temukan Elaine.
description.it: Find Elaine.
description.jp: エルラインを訪ねろ。
description.nl: Find Elaine.
description.pl: Find Elaine.
description.ru: Find Elaine.
description.sp: Encuentra a Elaine.
description.sw: Find Elaine.
description.th: ค้นหา Elaine
description.tw: 去找耶拉伊
description.vi: Tìm Elaine.

dialogsBegin.en: Since you have my trust, I will give you another piece of information. There is another hero hiding out here in Darkon. His name is Elaine, Hero Ranger.
dialogsBegin.ar: Since you have my trust, I will give you another piece of information. There is another hero hiding out here in Darkon. His name is Elaine, Hero Ranger.
dialogsBegin.br: Já que você tem minha confiança, eu lhe darei outra informação. Há outro Herói escondido aqui em Darkon. Seu nome é Elaine, o Herói Ranger.
dialogsBegin.cns: 既然你得到了我的信任，我就再给你一个信息。有另一位英雄在达肯，他的名字叫伊莲，英雄游侠。
dialogsBegin.de: Da du mein Vertrauen hast, werde ich dir eine weitere Information geben. Es gibt einen weiteren Helden, der sich hier in Darkon versteckt. Sein Name ist Elaine, Hero Ranger.
dialogsBegin.fi: Since you have my trust, I will give you another piece of information. There is another hero hiding out here in Darkon. His name is Elaine, Hero Ranger.
dialogsBegin.fil: Since you have my trust, I will give you another piece of information. There is another hero hiding out here in Darkon. His name is Elaine, Hero Ranger.
dialogsBegin.fr: Comme vous m'avez convaincu, je vais vous guider vers un autre Héros réincarné à Darkon. Il se nomme Alain, Héros Ranger.
dialogsBegin.id: Karena Anda memiliki kepercayaan saya, saya akan memberi Anda informasi lain. Ada pahlawan lain yang bersembunyi di sini di Darkon. Namanya Elaine, Hero Ranger.
dialogsBegin.it: Since you have my trust, I will give you another piece of information. There is another hero hiding out here in Darkon. His name is Elaine, Hero Ranger.
dialogsBegin.jp: 英雄を探していると言ったね。この近くの山の中にエルラインという人物が暮らしている。いつだか彼は自分をレンジャーの英雄の生まれ変わりだと言っていた。
dialogsBegin.kr: 당신을 믿게 됐으니, 하나 더 알려 드리죠. 이 다콘 어딘가에 또 다른 영웅이 숨어있습니다. 이름은 일레인, 영웅 레인저죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: Since you have my trust, I will give you another piece of information. There is another hero hiding out here in Darkon. His name is Elaine, Hero Ranger.
dialogsBegin.pl: Since you have my trust, I will give you another piece of information. There is another hero hiding out here in Darkon. His name is Elaine, Hero Ranger.
dialogsBegin.ru: Since you have my trust, I will give you another piece of information. There is another hero hiding out here in Darkon. His name is Elaine, Hero Ranger.
dialogsBegin.sp: Ya que tienes mi confianza, te daré un dato más. Hay otro héroe escondido aquí en Darkon. Su nombre es Elaine, el Héroe Ranger.
dialogsBegin.sw: Since you have my trust, I will give you another piece of information. There is another hero hiding out here in Darkon. His name is Elaine, Hero Ranger.
dialogsBegin.th: เนื่องจากคุณมีความไว้วางใจฉันจะให้ข้อมูลอีกชิ้นหนึ่ง มีฮีโร่อื่นซ่อนตัวอยู่ที่นี่ใน Darkon ชื่อของเขาคือ Elaine ฮีโร่เรนเจอร์
dialogsBegin.tw: 既然你已取得我的信任，我再告訴你一件事。得肯還藏著另一位英雄，他叫耶拉伊，是浪人英雄。
dialogsBegin.vi: Vì bạn đã tin tưởng tôi, tôi sẽ cung cấp cho bạn một thông tin khác. Có một anh hùng khác đang ẩn dật ở đây trong Darkon. Tên anh ta là Elaine, Anh hùng Ranger.

dialogsBegin.en: After the war, and our reincarnation, both Elaine and I fled up here to the mountains.
dialogsBegin.ar: After the war, and our reincarnation, both Elaine and I fled up here to the mountains.
dialogsBegin.br: Depois da guerra e de nossa reencarnação, Elaine e eu viemos para cá, para as montanhas.
dialogsBegin.cns: 战争结束后，我们就转生了，伊莲和我都逃到了这里的山上。
dialogsBegin.de: Nach dem Krieg und unserer Wiedergeburt flohen Elaine und ich hierher in die Berge.
dialogsBegin.fi: After the war, and our reincarnation, both Elaine and I fled up here to the mountains.
dialogsBegin.fil: After the war, and our reincarnation, both Elaine and I fled up here to the mountains.
dialogsBegin.fr: Alain et moi sommes amis depuis longtemps. Jusqu'à ce que vous me trouviez, je pensais que seuls Alain et moi avions été réincarnés.
dialogsBegin.id: Setelah perang, dan reinkarnasi kami, baik Elaine dan saya melarikan diri ke sini ke pegunungan.
dialogsBegin.it: After the war, and our reincarnation, both Elaine and I fled up here to the mountains.
dialogsBegin.jp: 私は彼と古くから付き合いがあってね。君の話を聞くまでは転生した過去の英雄は私達だけだと思っていたよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 전생이 끝나고 환생한 뒤, 일레인과 저는 이 산으로 도망쳐 올라왔습니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: After the war, and our reincarnation, both Elaine and I fled up here to the mountains.
dialogsBegin.pl: After the war, and our reincarnation, both Elaine and I fled up here to the mountains.
dialogsBegin.ru: After the war, and our reincarnation, both Elaine and I fled up here to the mountains.
dialogsBegin.sp: Después de la guerra y de nuestra reencarnación, tanto Elaine como yo huimos a las montañas.
dialogsBegin.sw: After the war, and our reincarnation, both Elaine and I fled up here to the mountains.
dialogsBegin.th: หลังจากสงครามและการกลับชาติมาเกิดขึ้นทั้ง Elaine และฉันก็หนีไปที่ภูเขา
dialogsBegin.tw: 戰爭結束並轉生後，耶拉伊和我都逃到了這片山區。
dialogsBegin.vi: Sau chiến tranh, và sự tái sinh của chúng tôi, cả tôi và Elaine đều ẩn trốn lên núi.

dialogsBegin.en: If Reonan is trying so hard to reach out to us, then I guess it might be time again. You should go to find Elaine.
dialogsBegin.ar: If Reonan is trying so hard to reach out to us, then I guess it might be time again. You should go to find Elaine.
dialogsBegin.br: Se Reonan está se esforçando tanto para entrar em contato conosco, acho que talvez chegou a hora. Você deve ir encontrar Elaine.
dialogsBegin.cns: 如果瑞尔南这么努力地想找到我们，那么我想可能又是时候了。你去找伊莲吧。
dialogsBegin.de: Wenn Reonan sich so sehr bemüht, auf uns zuzugehen, dann wird es wohl mal wieder Zeit. Du solltest Elaine suchen gehen.
dialogsBegin.fi: If Reonan is trying so hard to reach out to us, then I guess it might be time again. You should go to find Elaine.
dialogsBegin.fil: If Reonan is trying so hard to reach out to us, then I guess it might be time again. You should go to find Elaine.
dialogsBegin.fr: Puisque vous cherchez des Héros, allez le voir et dites-lui que je me battrai à vos côtés.
dialogsBegin.id: Jika Reonan berusaha keras untuk menjangkau kami, maka saya kira ini mungkin sudah waktunya. Kamu harus pergi mencari Elaine.
dialogsBegin.it: If Reonan is trying so hard to reach out to us, then I guess it might be time again. You should go to find Elaine.
dialogsBegin.jp: もし君がレオナンに頼まれて過去の英雄を探しているのであればぜひ会ってみるといい。
dialogsBegin.kr: 레오난이 그렇게까지 우리를 찾으려 한다면, 다시 때가 온 걸지도 모르죠. 일레인을 찾아가 보세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: If Reonan is trying so hard to reach out to us, then I guess it might be time again. You should go to find Elaine.
dialogsBegin.pl: If Reonan is trying so hard to reach out to us, then I guess it might be time again. You should go to find Elaine.
dialogsBegin.ru: If Reonan is trying so hard to reach out to us, then I guess it might be time again. You should go to find Elaine.
dialogsBegin.sp: Si Reonan se está esforzando tanto por comunicarse con nosotros, supongo que podría ser el momento de volver. Deberías ir a buscar a Elaine.
dialogsBegin.sw: If Reonan is trying so hard to reach out to us, then I guess it might be time again. You should go to find Elaine.
dialogsBegin.th: ถ้า Reonan กำลังพยายามอย่างหนักที่จะติดต่อเราเราก็คิดว่ามันอาจถึงเวลาแล้ว คุณควรไปหา Elaine
dialogsBegin.tw: 如果雷奧南如此努力地聯繫我們，那麼我想可能是時候再來一次了。你應該去找耶拉伊。
dialogsBegin.vi: Nếu Reonan đang cố gắng hết sức để liên hệ với chúng tôi, thì tôi đoán có lẽ đã đến lúc. Bạn nên đi tìm Elaine.

dialogsAccept.en: He lives west of this current location. Be warned. Since the war, he has retired his weapons and become a self proclaimed pacifist. I'm not sure how willing he will be to join with the rest…
dialogsAccept.ar: He lives west of this current location. Be warned. Since the war, he has retired his weapons and become a self proclaimed pacifist. I'm not sure how willing he will be to join with the rest…
dialogsAccept.br: Ele vive a Oeste desta localização atual. Esteja avisado. Desde a guerra, ele aposentou suas armas e se tornou um pacifista autoproclamado. Não tenho certeza de como ele estará disposto a se juntar ao pessoal…
dialogsAccept.cns: 他住在这里的西边。但请你知道。战争结束后，他已经退役了他的武器，自称是一位和平主义者。所以我不确定他是否愿意与其他人一起...
dialogsAccept.de: Er lebt westlich von diesem Ort. Seien Sie gewarnt. Seit dem Krieg hat er seine Waffen an den Nagel gehängt und ist ein erklärter Pazifist. Ich bin mir nicht sicher, ob er bereit ist, sich den anderen anzuschließen...
dialogsAccept.fi: He lives west of this current location. Be warned. Since the war, he has retired his weapons and become a self proclaimed pacifist. I'm not sure how willing he will be to join with the rest…
dialogsAccept.fil: He lives west of this current location. Be warned. Since the war, he has retired his weapons and become a self proclaimed pacifist. I'm not sure how willing he will be to join with the rest…
dialogsAccept.fr: Il habite au milieu des montagnes à Erunfax. Je vais vous donner une lettre d'introduction.
dialogsAccept.id: Dia tinggal di sebelah barat lokasi saat ini. Berhati-hatilah. Semenjak perang, ia telah mempensiunkan senjatanya dan menjadi pasifis yang memproklamirkan diri. Saya tidak yakin seberapa bersedia dia untuk bergabung dengan yang lain...
dialogsAccept.it: He lives west of this current location. Be warned. Since the war, he has retired his weapons and become a self proclaimed pacifist. I'm not sure how willing he will be to join with the rest…
dialogsAccept.jp: ただ……彼は昔から平和主義者だからな。闘いのために英雄を集めているとなると協力してくれないかもしれん。私からも一筆書いておこう。
dialogsAccept.kr: 일레인은 서쪽에 살고 있습니다. 조심하세요. 전쟁 이후로 무기를 내려놓고 스스로 평화주의자라며 은둔하고 있거든요. 다시 함께하려 할지 잘 모르겠네요...
dialogsAccept.nl: He lives west of this current location. Be warned. Since the war, he has retired his weapons and become a self proclaimed pacifist. I'm not sure how willing he will be to join with the rest…
dialogsAccept.pl: He lives west of this current location. Be warned. Since the war, he has retired his weapons and become a self proclaimed pacifist. I'm not sure how willing he will be to join with the rest…
dialogsAccept.ru: He lives west of this current location. Be warned. Since the war, he has retired his weapons and become a self proclaimed pacifist. I'm not sure how willing he will be to join with the rest…
dialogsAccept.sp: Vive al Oeste de aquí. Ten cuidado. Desde la guerra, ha retirado sus armas y se ha convertido en un pacifista autoproclamado. No estoy seguro de cuán dispuesto estará a unirse con el resto...
dialogsAccept.sw: He lives west of this current location. Be warned. Since the war, he has retired his weapons and become a self proclaimed pacifist. I'm not sure how willing he will be to join with the rest…
dialogsAccept.th: เขาอาศัยอยู่ทางตะวันตกของตำแหน่งปัจจุบันนี้ (คำเตือน) ตั้งแต่สงครามเขาได้ปลดเกษียณอาวุธและกลายเป็นผู้สันติสุขที่เรียกตัวเอง ฉันไม่แน่ใจว่ายินดีที่เขาจะเข้าร่วมกับส่วนที่เหลือไหม ...
dialogsAccept.tw: 他在艾磷斯工廠西南邊的山腰上蓋了房間，安靜地住在那裡。他原本就是和平主義者，如果告訴他是為了要戰鬥才集合英雄，他應該不會願意聽你的。首先把這封信交給他吧。如果讀了這一封信，他應該會回心轉意的。
dialogsAccept.vi: Anh ấy sống ở phía tây của vị trí hiện tại. Kể từ sau chiến tranh, anh ta đã từ bỏ vũ khí của mình và trở thành một người theo chủ nghĩa hòa bình tự xưng. Tôi không chắc anh ấy sẽ sẵn sàng tham gia với những người còn lại như thế nào…

dialogsDecline.en: Well, you know where he is. Whenever you have the time, seek him out.
dialogsDecline.ar: Well, you know where he is. Whenever you have the time, seek him out.
dialogsDecline.br: Bem, você sabe onde ele está. Se é um pedido de Reonan, é melhor você encontrar Elaine o quanto antes.
dialogsDecline.cns: 嗯，你知道他在哪里。只要你有时间，就去找他。
dialogsDecline.de: Nun, Sie wissen, wo er ist. Wann immer Sie Zeit haben, suchen Sie ihn auf.
dialogsDecline.fi: Well, you know where he is. Whenever you have the time, seek him out.
dialogsDecline.fil: Well, you know where he is. Whenever you have the time, seek him out.
dialogsDecline.fr: Ne perdez pas courage mon ami.
dialogsDecline.id: Kau tahu di mana dia berada. Kapan pun kau punya waktu, carilah dia.
dialogsDecline.it: Well, you know where he is. Whenever you have the time, seek him out.
dialogsDecline.jp: そうか。まあ、君の好きにするがよいさ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 음, 어디에 있는지는 아실 테죠. 시간이 생기면 일단 그를 찾으세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Well, you know where he is. Whenever you have the time, seek him out.
dialogsDecline.pl: Well, you know where he is. Whenever you have the time, seek him out.
dialogsDecline.ru: Well, you know where he is. Whenever you have the time, seek him out.
dialogsDecline.sp: Bueno, ya sabes dónde está. Cuando tengas tiempo, ve a buscarlo.
dialogsDecline.sw: Well, you know where he is. Whenever you have the time, seek him out.
dialogsDecline.th: ดี คุณรู้ว่าเขาอยู่ที่ไหน เมื่อไหร่ก็ตามที่คุณมีเวลา ค้นหาเขาและออกไป
dialogsDecline.tw: 你不是在尋找英雄的重生嗎？如果你願意，我可以再告訴你。
dialogsDecline.vi: Vâng, bạn biết vị trí anh ta ở đâu. Bất cứ khi nào bạn có thời gian, hãy tìm kiếm anh ấy.

dialogsComplete.en: Greetings stranger! My name is Elaine. What brings you all the way up here?
dialogsComplete.ar: Greetings stranger! My name is Elaine. What brings you all the way up here?
dialogsComplete.br: Saudações jovem! Meu nome é Elaine. O que te traz até aqui?
dialogsComplete.cns: 你好啊陌生人! 我的名字是伊莲。什么风把你吹到这里来了？
dialogsComplete.de: Grüße Fremder! Mein Name ist Elaine. Was führt dich hierher?
dialogsComplete.fi: Greetings stranger! My name is Elaine. What brings you all the way up here?
dialogsComplete.fil: Greetings stranger! My name is Elaine. What brings you all the way up here?
dialogsComplete.fr: Qu'est-ce qui vous amène dans mes montagnes ?
dialogsComplete.id: Salam, orang asing! Nama saya Elaine. Apa yang membawamu sampai ke sini?
dialogsComplete.it: Greetings stranger! My name is Elaine. What brings you all the way up here?
dialogsComplete.jp: このようなところで人に会うとは珍しい。貴方はここで何をしているのですか？
dialogsComplete.kr: 안녕하세요, 낯선 방랑자! 제 이름은 일레인입니다. 무슨 일로 이 가파른 산속까지 오셨나요?
dialogsComplete.nl: Greetings stranger! My name is Elaine. What brings you all the way up here?
dialogsComplete.pl: Greetings stranger! My name is Elaine. What brings you all the way up here?
dialogsComplete.ru: Greetings stranger! My name is Elaine. What brings you all the way up here?
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Saludos extraño! Mi nombre es Elaine. ¿Qué te trae hasta aquí?
dialogsComplete.sw: Greetings stranger! My name is Elaine. What brings you all the way up here?
dialogsComplete.th: ทักทายคนแปลกหน้า! ฉันชื่อ Elaine อะไรทำให้คุณมาที่นี่?
dialogsComplete.tw: 你好陌生人！我的名字是耶拉伊。是什麼把你帶到了這裡？
dialogsComplete.vi: Chào người lạ! Tên tôi là Elaine. Điều gì đưa bạn đến đây?

dialogsFail.en: Elaine lives just West of this location. Please go and find him!
dialogsFail.ar: Elaine lives just West of this location. Please go and find him!
dialogsFail.br: Elaine mora a Oeste deste local. Por favor, vá encontrá-lo!
dialogsFail.cns: 伊莲就住在这里的西边。请去找他吧!
dialogsFail.de: Elaine wohnt gleich westlich von diesem Ort. Bitte gehen Sie und finden Sie ihn!
dialogsFail.fi: Elaine lives just West of this location. Please go and find him!
dialogsFail.fil: Elaine lives just West of this location. Please go and find him!
dialogsFail.fr: Alain vit au Sud d'Erunfax.
dialogsFail.id: Elaine tinggal tepat di sebelah barat lokasi ini. Pergi dan temukan dia!
dialogsFail.it: Elaine lives just West of this location. Please go and find him!
dialogsFail.jp: エルラインとは会えたかい？
dialogsFail.kr: 서쪽으로 가면 일레인이 사는 곳이에요. 가서 일레인을 찾아주세요!
dialogsFail.nl: Elaine lives just West of this location. Please go and find him!
dialogsFail.pl: Elaine lives just West of this location. Please go and find him!
dialogsFail.ru: Elaine lives just West of this location. Please go and find him!
dialogsFail.sp: Elaine vive justo al Oeste de aquí. ¡Por favor ve y encuéntralo!
dialogsFail.sw: Elaine lives just West of this location. Please go and find him!
dialogsFail.th: Elaine อาศัยอยู่ทางตะวันตกของสถานที่แห่งนี้ โปรดไปหาเขา!
dialogsFail.tw: 耶拉伊住在這個位置的西邊。請去找他！
dialogsFail.vi: Elaine sống ngay phía Tây của địa điểm này. Hãy đi tìm anh ấy!

description.en: Erons want Droils.
description.ar: Erons want Droils.
description.br: Os Erons querem Droils.
description.cns: 绿磷石开采集团为了修复开采起重机,委托了搜集润滑油的任务
description.de: Der Manager von Erons Industriegebiet braucht Droil als Treibstoff für seine Kräne.

dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: It seems as though the masquerpets are a greater threat than I thought. We will need to fortify our town as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.ar: It seems as though the masquerpets are a greater threat than I thought. We will need to fortify our town as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.br: Parece que os masquerpets são uma ameaça maior do que eu pensava. Precisamos fortalecer nosso vilarejo o mais rápido possível.
dialogsBegin.cns: 看起来怪物的威胁比我想象的要大。我们需要尽快巩固我们的城镇。
dialogsBegin.de: Es schaut so aus als wären die Monster eine größere Bedrohung als ich dachte. Wir werden den Ort befestigen müssen.
dialogsBegin.fi: It seems as though the masquerpets are a greater threat than I thought. We will need to fortify our town as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.fil: It seems as though the masquerpets are a greater threat than I thought. We will need to fortify our town as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.fr: J'ai réfléchi, et les monstres sont désormais une menace trop grande. Nous devons fortifier le village au plus vite.
dialogsBegin.id: Sepertinya topeng adalah ancaman yang lebih besar dari yang kukira. Kita perlu membentengi kota kita secepat mungkin.
dialogsBegin.it: It seems as though the masquerpets are a greater threat than I thought. We will need to fortify our town as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.jp: モンスターは思った以上に脅威のようです。できるだけ早く町を強化する必要があります。
dialogsBegin.kr: 마스커펫이 생각보다 더 위협적이군요. 최대한 빨리 마을을 보강해 요새로 만들어야겠어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: It seems as though the masquerpets are a greater threat than I thought. We will need to fortify our town as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.pl: It seems as though the masquerpets are a greater threat than I thought. We will need to fortify our town as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.ru: It seems as though the masquerpets are a greater threat than I thought. We will need to fortify our town as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.sp: Parece que los Masquerpets son una amenaza mayor de lo que pensaba. Tendremos que fortificar nuestra ciudad lo antes posible.
dialogsBegin.sw: It seems as though the masquerpets are a greater threat than I thought. We will need to fortify our town as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.th: ดูเหมือนว่าmasquerpets จะเป็นภัยคุกคามมากกว่าที่ฉันคิด เราจะต้องเสริมกำลังเมืองของเราโดยเร็วที่สุด
dialogsBegin.tw: 看起來怪物的威脅比我想像的要大，我們需要盡快鞏固我們的城鎮。
dialogsBegin.vi: Có vẻ như masquerpets là một mối đe dọa lớn hơn tôi nghĩ. Chúng tôi cần củng cố thị trấn của mình càng sớm càng tốt.

dialogsBegin.en: Bring us some wood and stone. We can make good use of it and reinforce our buildings and fences.
dialogsBegin.ar: Bring us some wood and stone. We can make good use of it and reinforce our buildings and fences.
dialogsBegin.br: Traga-nos um pouco de madeira e pedra. Podemos fazer bom uso dela e reforçar nossas casas e cercas.
dialogsBegin.cns: 带一些木头和石头给我们。我们可以利用它们来加固建筑物和围栏。
dialogsBegin.de: Bring uns Holz und Stein. Wir werden es verwenden um die Gebäude und Zäune zu verstärken.
dialogsBegin.fi: Bring us some wood and stone. We can make good use of it and reinforce our buildings and fences.
dialogsBegin.fil: Bring us some wood and stone. We can make good use of it and reinforce our buildings and fences.
dialogsBegin.fr: Amenez-nous du bois et de la pierre. Nous pourrons l'utiliser pour renforcer nos bâtiments et murs.
dialogsBegin.id: Bawakan kami kayu dan batu. Kita dapat memanfaatkannya dengan baik dan memperkuat bangunan dan pagar kita.
dialogsBegin.it: Bring us some wood and stone. We can make good use of it and reinforce our buildings and fences.
dialogsBegin.jp: 木と石を持ってきてください。それをうまく活用して、建物やフェンスを補強することができます。
dialogsBegin.kr: 나무와 돌이 필요해요. 나무와 돌이 있으면 건물과 울타리를 강화할 수 있을 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Bring us some wood and stone. We can make good use of it and reinforce our buildings and fences.
dialogsBegin.pl: Bring us some wood and stone. We can make good use of it and reinforce our buildings and fences.
dialogsBegin.ru: Bring us some wood and stone. We can make good use of it and reinforce our buildings and fences.
dialogsBegin.sp: Tráenos algo de madera y piedra. Podemos aprovecharlo para reforzar nuestros edificios y cercas.
dialogsBegin.sw: Bring us some wood and stone. We can make good use of it and reinforce our buildings and fences.
dialogsBegin.th: นำไม้และหินมาให้เรา เราสามารถใช้ประโยชน์จากมันและเสริมกำลังอาคารและรั้วของเราได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 給我們帶來一些木頭和石頭，我們可以充分利用它，加固我們的建築物和圍欄。
dialogsBegin.vi: Mang cho chúng tôi một ít gỗ và đá. Chúng ta có thể tận dụng nó và gia cố các công trình và hàng rào của chúng ta.

dialogsBegin.en: Two more pendants!? Ah Elaine and Zoro. It's been awhile… Thought I might never see them again… Knowing they stand by my side, I feel a renewed sense of determination!
dialogsBegin.ar: Two more pendants!? Ah Elaine and Zoro. It's been awhile… Thought I might never see them again… Knowing they stand by my side, I feel a renewed sense of determination!
dialogsBegin.br: Mais dois pingentes!? Ah Elaine e Zoro. Já faz tanto tempo... Pensei que nunca mais os veria... Sabendo que eles estarão ao meu lado, sinto minha determinação renovada!
dialogsBegin.cns: 还有两个吊坠！？啊，伊莲和佐罗。有一段时间了...还以为我再也见不到他们了...知道他们站在我身边，我感到了一股新的力量！
dialogsBegin.de: Zwei weitere Anhänger!? Ah, Elaine und Zoro. Es ist schon eine Weile her... Ich dachte, ich würde sie nie wieder sehen... Zu wissen, dass sie an meiner Seite stehen, gibt mir ein neues Gefühl der Entschlossenheit!
dialogsBegin.fi: Two more pendants!? Ah Elaine and Zoro. It's been awhile… Thought I might never see them again… Knowing they stand by my side, I feel a renewed sense of determination!
dialogsBegin.fil: Two more pendants!? Ah Elaine and Zoro. It's been awhile… Thought I might never see them again… Knowing they stand by my side, I feel a renewed sense of determination!
dialogsBegin.fr: Oh vous avez réussi à convaincre Alain et Zoro ! Je commence à croire que nous avons nos chances.
dialogsBegin.id: Dua pendants lagi!? Ah Elaine dan Zoro. Sudah lama ... Kupikir aku mungkin tidak akan pernah melihat mereka lagi ... Mengetahui mereka berdiri di sisi saya, saya merasakan suatu tekad yang diperbarui!
dialogsBegin.it: Two more pendants!? Ah Elaine and Zoro. It's been awhile… Thought I might never see them again… Knowing they stand by my side, I feel a renewed sense of determination!
dialogsBegin.jp: おお、そのペンダントは！　何と、二人も同時に探してきてくれたのか！
dialogsBegin.kr: 펜던트가 두 개나 더!? 일레인과 조로... 정말 오랜만이군요... 다시는 못 볼 줄 알았는데… 모두가 제 곁에 있다는 걸 알게 되니 다시금 의지가 샘솟는 기분이 드네요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Two more pendants!? Ah Elaine and Zoro. It's been awhile… Thought I might never see them again… Knowing they stand by my side, I feel a renewed sense of determination!
dialogsBegin.pl: Two more pendants!? Ah Elaine and Zoro. It's been awhile… Thought I might never see them again… Knowing they stand by my side, I feel a renewed sense of determination!
dialogsBegin.ru: Two more pendants!? Ah Elaine and Zoro. It's been awhile… Thought I might never see them again… Knowing they stand by my side, I feel a renewed sense of determination!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿¡Dos colgantes más!? Ah Elaine y Zoro. Ha pasado tiempo... Pensaba que nunca los volvería a ver... Sabiendo que están a mi lado, ¡tengo una renovada sensación de determinación!
dialogsBegin.sw: Two more pendants!? Ah Elaine and Zoro. It's been awhile… Thought I might never see them again… Knowing they stand by my side, I feel a renewed sense of determination!
dialogsBegin.th: จี้อีกสองอัน!? Elaine และ Zoro ได้รับสักครู่ ... ฉันไม่เคยเห็นพวกเขาอีก...
dialogsBegin.tw: 那個墜飾！而且你還拿了兩個過來！這次你是和誰見了面呢？喔喔，是耶拉伊和索羅！光是聽到名字，就可以感受到過去同伴的氣息！真的是做得太好了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Hai mặt dây chuyền nữa !? Ah Elaine và Zoro. Đã lâu lắm rồi… Cứ tưởng rằng tôi có thể không bao giờ gặp lại họ nữa… Biết họ luôn bên cạnh mình, tôi cảm thấy một lòng quyết tâm mới!

dialogsBegin.en: Now 6 heroes are gathered! I, Handel, Hael, Reodos, Zoro, Elaine are gathered. We just need to find the last 2! Before this, I feel it is time for you to hone in on your own skills!
dialogsBegin.ar: Now 6 heroes are gathered! I, Handel, Hael, Reodos, Zoro, Elaine are gathered. We just need to find the last 2! Before this, I feel it is time for you to hone in on your own skills!
dialogsBegin.br: Agora 6 heróis estão reunidos! Eu, Handel, Hael, Reodos, Zoro, Elaine estamos reunidos. Só precisamos encontrar os 2 últimos! Antes disso, sinto que é hora de você aprimorar suas próprias habilidades!
dialogsBegin.cns: 现在6位英雄齐聚一堂! 我、汉德尔、海尔、里奥多斯、佐罗、伊莲已经聚齐。还要找到最后两位! 在这之前，我觉得是时候让你们磨练一下自己的技能了!
dialogsBegin.de: Jetzt sind 6 Helden versammelt! Ich, Händel, Hael, Reodos, Zoro und Elaine sind versammelt. Wir müssen nur noch die letzten 2 finden! Vorher ist es an der Zeit, dass Du an Deinen eigenen Fähigkeiten feilst!
dialogsBegin.fi: Now 6 heroes are gathered! I, Handel, Hael, Reodos, Zoro, Elaine are gathered. We just need to find the last 2! Before this, I feel it is time for you to hone in on your own skills!
dialogsBegin.fil: Now 6 heroes are gathered! I, Handel, Hael, Reodos, Zoro, Elaine are gathered. We just need to find the last 2! Before this, I feel it is time for you to hone in on your own skills!
dialogsBegin.fr: Nous avons réuni 6 Héros grâce à vous. Avant de passer à la suite vous allez devoir continuer à vous entrainer.
dialogsBegin.id: Sekarang 6 pahlawan telah berkumpul! Aku, Handel, Hael, Reodos, Zoro, Elaine berkumpul. Kita hanya perlu menemukan 2 yang terakhir! Sebelum ini, saya merasa sudah waktunya bagi Anda untuk mengasah keterampilan Anda sendiri!
dialogsBegin.it: Now 6 heroes are gathered! I, Handel, Hael, Reodos, Zoro, Elaine are gathered. We just need to find the last 2! Before this, I feel it is time for you to hone in on your own skills!
dialogsBegin.jp: これで私とヘンデル、ハエル、レオドス、そしてエルラインとゾロ。過去の英雄は六人も連絡が取れるようになった。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이제 영웅 여섯이 모였군요! 나와 헨델, 하엘, 레오도스, 조로, 일레인까지. 이제 남은 둘만 찾으면 되겠어요! 그 전에, 당신도 실력을 갈고닦을 시간이 온 것 같군요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Now 6 heroes are gathered! I, Handel, Hael, Reodos, Zoro, Elaine are gathered. We just need to find the last 2! Before this, I feel it is time for you to hone in on your own skills!
dialogsBegin.pl: Now 6 heroes are gathered! I, Handel, Hael, Reodos, Zoro, Elaine are gathered. We just need to find the last 2! Before this, I feel it is time for you to hone in on your own skills!
dialogsBegin.ru: Now 6 heroes are gathered! I, Handel, Hael, Reodos, Zoro, Elaine are gathered. We just need to find the last 2! Before this, I feel it is time for you to hone in on your own skills!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Ya se han reunido 6 héroes! Handel, Hael, Reodos, Zoro, Elaine y Yo estamos reunidos. ¡Solo tenemos que encontrar a los últimos 2! ¡Pero antes de eso, creo que es hora de que perfecciones tus propias habilidades!
dialogsBegin.sw: Now 6 heroes are gathered! I, Handel, Hael, Reodos, Zoro, Elaine are gathered. We just need to find the last 2! Before this, I feel it is time for you to hone in on your own skills!
dialogsBegin.th: ตอนนี้มี 6 วีรบุรุษมารวมกัน! ฉัน Handel Hael, Reodos, Zoro, Elaine กำลังรวบรวมอยู่ เราแค่ต้องหาคนสุดท้าย 2 คน! ก่อนหน้านี้ฉันรู้สึกว่าถึงเวลาแล้วที่คุณจะได้ฝึกฝนทักษะของคุณเอง
dialogsBegin.tw: 現在聚集了 6 位英雄！我、賀丹爾、哈爾、列奧德斯、索羅、耶拉伊都聚集了。我們只需要找到最後兩個！在此之前，我覺得是時候磨練自己的技能了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bây giờ 6 anh hùng đã tề tựu ở đây! Tôi, Handel, Hael, Reodos, Zoro, Elaine được tập hợp lại. Chúng ta chỉ cần tìm 2 cuối cùng! Trước khi điều này xảy ra, tôi cảm thấy đã đến lúc bạn cần trau dồi kỹ năng của chính mình!

dialogsBegin.en: We will need the assistance of warriors like yourself! But, you still have plenty of room to grow! Are you ready to further ascend your path to glory?
dialogsBegin.ar: We will need the assistance of warriors like yourself! But, you still have plenty of room to grow! Are you ready to further ascend your path to glory?
dialogsBegin.br: Precisaremos da ajuda de guerreiros como você! Mas você ainda tem muito espaço para crescer! Você está pronto para ascender ainda mais em seu caminho para a glória?
dialogsBegin.cns: 我们需要你这样的勇士的帮助！但是，你仍有很大的成长空间。你准备好进一步前进你的荣耀之路了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Wir werden die Unterstützung von Kriegern wie dir brauchen! Aber du hast noch viel Raum zum Wachsen! Bist du bereit, deinen Weg zum Ruhm weiter zu beschreiten?
dialogsBegin.fi: We will need the assistance of warriors like yourself! But, you still have plenty of room to grow! Are you ready to further ascend your path to glory?
dialogsBegin.fil: We will need the assistance of warriors like yourself! But, you still have plenty of room to grow! Are you ready to further ascend your path to glory?
dialogsBegin.fr: Si vous voulez vous battre à nos côtés, vous devrez être niveau 80 au minimum.
dialogsBegin.id: Kami akan membutuhkan bantuan prajurit seperti Anda! Tapi, Anda masih memiliki banyak ruang untuk tumbuh! Apakah Anda siap untuk mendaki jalan Anda lebih jauh menuju kemenangan?
dialogsBegin.it: We will need the assistance of warriors like yourself! But, you still have plenty of room to grow! Are you ready to further ascend your path to glory?
dialogsBegin.jp: ふむ、君もなかなか成長したようだが、これから先、かなり闘いは激しさを増すであろう。レベル80ほどになるまで準備をするといい。
dialogsBegin.kr: 우리와 함께 전쟁에 참여하기 위해선 지금보다 더욱 강해져야 하지. 이제는 자네 스스로 수련을 통해 70lv까지 성장해 보게나.
dialogsBegin.nl: We will need the assistance of warriors like yourself! But, you still have plenty of room to grow! Are you ready to further ascend your path to glory?
dialogsBegin.pl: We will need the assistance of warriors like yourself! But, you still have plenty of room to grow! Are you ready to further ascend your path to glory?
dialogsBegin.ru: We will need the assistance of warriors like yourself! But, you still have plenty of room to grow! Are you ready to further ascend your path to glory?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Necesitaremos la ayuda de guerreros como tú! ¡Pero todavía tienes mucho margen para crecer! ¿Estás listo para seguir ascendiendo en tu camino hacia la gloria?
dialogsBegin.sw: We will need the assistance of warriors like yourself! But, you still have plenty of room to grow! Are you ready to further ascend your path to glory?
dialogsBegin.th: เราจะต้องได้รับความช่วยเหลือจากนักรบอย่างตัวคุณเอง! คุณพร้อมที่จะก้าวขึ้นสู่เส้นทางสู่ความรุ่งโรจน์แล้วหรือยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 如果要和我們一起參與戰爭，必須變得比現在更強。現在你透過自行修練成長吧。對了！列奧德斯的詛咒不知道怎麼樣了？結束修練之後，就再過去找一趟列奧德斯吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Chúng tôi sẽ cần sự hỗ trợ của những chiến binh như chính bạn! Nhưng, bạn vẫn còn nhiều chỗ để phát triển! Bạn đã sẵn sàng để tiến xa hơn trên con đường đến với vinh quang?

dialogsAccept.kr: 레벨70이 되면 레오도스를 한 번 다시 찾아가 보게나.

dialogsAccept.ru: Please train to level 70, then talk with Reodos!

dialogsAccept.vi: Hãy luyện đến cấp 70, sau đó nói chuyện với Reodos!

dialogsDecline.en: Real champions are born by pushing one's own skill to the limit. I know you have it in you to overcome the odds…
dialogsDecline.ar: Real champions are born by pushing one's own skill to the limit. I know you have it in you to overcome the odds…
dialogsDecline.br: Os verdadeiros campeões nascem levando a própria habilidade ao limite. Eu sei que você tem em você o necessário para superar as probabilidades...
dialogsDecline.cns: 厉害的人都是将自己的技能训练到极限的。我知道你有这个能力克服困难...
dialogsDecline.de: Echte Champions werden geboren, indem man seine eigenen Fähigkeiten bis an die Grenzen ausreizt. Ich weiß, dass du es in dir hast, die Widrigkeiten zu überwinden...
dialogsDecline.fi: Real champions are born by pushing one's own skill to the limit. I know you have it in you to overcome the odds…
dialogsDecline.fil: Real champions are born by pushing one's own skill to the limit. I know you have it in you to overcome the odds…
dialogsDecline.fr: C'est la vie ! Parfois il faut attendre de grandir pour atteindre l'étagère des confitures...
dialogsDecline.id: Juara sejati lahir dengan memaksimalkan keterampilannya hingga batas maksimalnya. Saya tahu Anda memilikinya di dalam diri Anda untuk mengatasi keanehan ini...
dialogsDecline.it: Real champions are born by pushing one's own skill to the limit. I know you have it in you to overcome the odds…
dialogsDecline.jp: ふむ、まだその時期ではないと申すのか。
dialogsDecline.kr: 진정한 챔피언은 자신의 한계를 넘으며 탄생하는 법이죠. 당신이라면 어떤 역경도 이겨낼 수 있을 거예요...
dialogsDecline.nl: Real champions are born by pushing one's own skill to the limit. I know you have it in you to overcome the odds…
dialogsDecline.pl: Real champions are born by pushing one's own skill to the limit. I know you have it in you to overcome the odds…
dialogsDecline.ru: Real champions are born by pushing one's own skill to the limit. I know you have it in you to overcome the odds…
dialogsDecline.sp: Los verdaderos campeones nacen cuando llevan sus propias habilidades al límite. Sé que tienes lo necesario para superarte...
dialogsDecline.sw: Real champions are born by pushing one's own skill to the limit. I know you have it in you to overcome the odds…
dialogsDecline.th: ตัวแทนที่แท้จริงเกิดจากการผลักดันทักษะของตัวเองไปสู่ขีด จำกัด ฉันรู้ว่าคุณมีมันอยู่ในตัวคุณที่จะเอาชนะอัตราเดิมพัน ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 有的時候必須懂得獨立自己。沒有這種程度的膽量，要怎麼做大事呢。
dialogsDecline.vi: Những nhà vô địch thực sự được sinh ra bằng cách đẩy kỹ năng của chính mình đến giới hạn. Tôi biết bạn có nội lực để vượt qua những khó khăn…

dialogsComplete.en: Oh! Impressive! You have grown quite a bit stronger since we last met!
dialogsComplete.ar: Oh! Impressive! You have grown quite a bit stronger since we last met!
dialogsComplete.br: Oh! Impressionante! Você ficou um pouco mais forte desde a última vez que nos encontramos!

dialogsComplete.fr: Je vois bien que vous vous êtes amélioré.
dialogsComplete.id: Oh! Mengesankan! Kamu telah tumbuh lebih kuat sejak terakhir kali kita bertemu!
dialogsComplete.it: Oh! Impressive! You have grown quite a bit stronger since we last met!
dialogsComplete.jp: お、見違えたぞ！　しばらく会わぬ間にずいぶんと成長したではないか！

dialogsComplete.nl: Oh! Impressive! You have grown quite a bit stronger since we last met!

dialogsComplete.sw: Oh! Impressive! You have grown quite a bit stronger since we last met!

dialogsComplete.tw: 嗯？一段時間不見，你又成長啦？

description.en: Tina asked for help with reducing the Mothbee population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.ar: Tina asked for help with reducing the Mothbee population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.br: Tina pediu ajuda para reduzir a população de Maribelhas, pois elas estão causando problemas com o transporte aéreo. Você poderia matar 15 delas?
description.cns: 蒂娜请求帮她减少苍翼蜂蛾的数量，因为它们给运输带来了问题。你能杀15只苍翼蜂蛾吗？
description.de: Tina bittet um Hilfe bei der Reduzierung der Mothbee-Population, da diese Probleme beim Transport verursacht. Könnten Sie 15 von ihnen töten?
description.fi: Tina asked for help with reducing the Mothbee population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.fil: Hiningi ni Tina ang tulong para bawasan ang populasyon ng Mothbee dahil nagdudulot sila ng problema sa transportasyon. Puwede mo bang patayin ang 15 sa kanila?
description.fr: Tina a demandé de l'aide pour éliminer des Mothbee, car ils posent problèmes aux voyageurs. Peux-tu en tuer 15 ?
description.id: Tina meminta tolong untuk mengurangi populasi Mothbee dikarenakan mereka memulai mengganggu transportasi. Bisakah kamu memusnahkan 15 dari mereka?
description.it: Tina asked for help with reducing the Mothbee population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.jp: ティナから、輸送経路に＜モスビー＞が大量発生して問題になっているので、数を減らしてほしいという依頼がありました。15匹ほど討伐してきていただけませんか？
description.kr: 티나가 교통에 문제가 되고 있는 모스비의 수를 줄여 달라고 부탁했어요. 모스비 15마리만 잡아주실 수 있나요?
description.nl: Tina asked for help with reducing the Mothbee population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.pl: Tina asked for help with reducing the Mothbee population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.ru: Тина просит помочь с уменьшением численности Мухаонов, из-за которых становится сложно выполнять полёты. Можешь убить 15 штук?
description.sp: Tina ha pedido ayuda para reducir la población de Mothbees, ya que están causando problemas con el transporte. ¿Podrías eliminar a 15?
description.sw: Tina asked for help with reducing the Mothbee population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.th: Tina ขอความช่วยเหลือเรื่องการลดจำนวนของ Mothbee เนื่องจากพวกมันกำลังสร้างปัญหาในการขนส่ง คุณสามารถฆ่าพวกมัน 15 ตัวได้หรือไม่?
description.tw: 蒂娜尋求幫助以減少魔斯蜂空軍的數量，因為它們正在造成交通問題。你能殺死他們中的 15 個嗎？
description.vi: Tina đã yêu cầu giúp đỡ để giảm dân số Mothbee vì chúng đang gây ra các vấn đề về giao thông. Bạn có thể giết 15 Mothbee không?

dialogsDecline.en: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsDecline.ar: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsDecline.br: Você não quer ajudar? Tudo bem. Encontraremos outra pessoa.
dialogsDecline.cns: 你不想帮忙？好吧，那我们找别人了。
dialogsDecline.de: Du willst nicht helfen? Das ist okay. Wir finden jemand anderen.
dialogsDecline.fi: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsDecline.fil: Ayaw mo bang tumulong? Ayos lang. Hahanapan namin ng iba.
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu ne veux pas aider ? Tant pis, nous trouverons quelqu'un d'autre.

dialogsDecline.jp: 手伝わないんですね。大丈夫ですよ、他の人を探します。
dialogsDecline.kr: 도와주기 싫으신가요? 어쩔 수 없죠. 다른 사람을 찾아볼게요.

dialogsDecline.sw: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณไม่อยากช่วยเหรอ? ไม่เป็นไร เราจะหาคนอื่น
dialogsDecline.tw: 你不想幫忙？沒關係。我們會找到其他人的。
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn không muốn giúp đỡ? Không sao đâu. Chúng tôi sẽ tìm người khác.

dialogsBegin.en: Lost memory you say? Must have been hard for him wandering around so aimlessly with no true identity. We will give him time to gather his thoughts…
dialogsBegin.ar: Lost memory you say? Must have been hard for him wandering around so aimlessly with no true identity. We will give him time to gather his thoughts…
dialogsBegin.br: Memória perdida, você diz? Deve ter sido difícil para ele vagar sem rumo, sem identidade verdadeira. Vamos dar tempo para ele reunir seus pensamentos…
dialogsBegin.cns: 你提到了失忆？对他来说，记不起自己是谁，只能漫无目地四处游荡，肯定很难。我们还是给他留一点时间让他整理一下他的记忆吧...
dialogsBegin.de: Gedächtnisverlust, sagen Sie? Es muss schwer für ihn gewesen sein, so ziellos umherzuwandern, ohne seine wahre Identität zu kennen. Wir werden ihm Zeit geben, seine Gedanken zu sammeln...
dialogsBegin.fi: Lost memory you say? Must have been hard for him wandering around so aimlessly with no true identity. We will give him time to gather his thoughts…
dialogsBegin.fil: Lost memory you say? Must have been hard for him wandering around so aimlessly with no true identity. We will give him time to gather his thoughts…
dialogsBegin.fr: Bon, nous avons un héros de plus avec nous. Mais maintenant nous avons besoin d'informations.
dialogsBegin.id: Kehilangan ingatan kau bilang? Pasti sulit baginya untuk berkeliaran tanpa tujuan tanpa identitas asli. Kami akan memberinya waktu untuk mengumpulkan pikirannya...
dialogsBegin.it: Lost memory you say? Must have been hard for him wandering around so aimlessly with no true identity. We will give him time to gather his thoughts…
dialogsBegin.jp: ハエルが記憶を失っていたのか。ふむ……記憶を失いながら活動を続けるのは大変なことだっただろうな。
dialogsBegin.kr: 기억을 잃었었다고요? 자신의 정체도 모르고 떠도느라 힘들었겠군요. 생각을 정리할 수 있게 조금 시간을 줘야겠어요...
dialogsBegin.nl: Lost memory you say? Must have been hard for him wandering around so aimlessly with no true identity. We will give him time to gather his thoughts…
dialogsBegin.pl: Lost memory you say? Must have been hard for him wandering around so aimlessly with no true identity. We will give him time to gather his thoughts…
dialogsBegin.ru: Lost memory you say? Must have been hard for him wandering around so aimlessly with no true identity. We will give him time to gather his thoughts…
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Memoria perdida dices? Debe haber sido difícil para él deambular sin rumbo fijo y sin una verdadera identidad. Le daremos tiempo para ordenar sus pensamientos...
dialogsBegin.sw: Lost memory you say? Must have been hard for him wandering around so aimlessly with no true identity. We will give him time to gather his thoughts…
dialogsBegin.th: ลืมความทรงจำที่คุณพูด? ต้องเป็นเรื่องยากสำหรับเขาที่เดินไปรอบ ๆ อย่างไร้จุดหมายโดยไม่มีตัวตนที่แท้จริง เราจะให้เวลาในการรวบรวมความคิดของเขา ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 你說失憶了？沒有真實身份，漫無目的地四處遊蕩，一定很難受。我們會給他時間來整理他的思緒……
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn nói mất trí nhớ? Chắc hẳn anh ta khó mà lang thang khắp nơi không mục đích mà không có danh tính thực sự. Chúng tôi sẽ cho anh ấy thời gian để thu thập suy nghĩ của mình…

dialogsBegin.en: In the meantime, are you aware of the Garden of Rhisis? It is the landmass Northeast of Saint Morning. My friend Handel is currently conducting research there.
dialogsBegin.ar: In the meantime, are you aware of the Garden of Rhisis? It is the landmass Northeast of Saint Morning. My friend Handel is currently conducting research there.
dialogsBegin.br: Enquanto isso, você conhece o Jardim de Rhisis? É um continente a nordeste de Saint Morning. Minha amiga Handel está realizando algumas pesquisas lá.
dialogsBegin.cns: 与此同时，你注意到了莱斯庭院吗？他是晨光东北部的陆地。我的朋友汉德尔正在那里做研究。
dialogsBegin.de: Kennen Sie in der Zwischenzeit the Garden of Rhisis? Das ist die Landmasse nordöstlich von Saint Morning. Mein Freund Händel führt dort derzeit Forschungen durch.
dialogsBegin.fi: In the meantime, are you aware of the Garden of Rhisis? It is the landmass Northeast of Saint Morning. My friend Handel is currently conducting research there.
dialogsBegin.fil: In the meantime, are you aware of the Garden of Rhisis? It is the landmass Northeast of Saint Morning. My friend Handel is currently conducting research there.
dialogsBegin.fr: Ma partenaire de toujours Handel pense que des informations précieuses sont cachées au jardin de Rhisis.
dialogsBegin.id: Sementara itu, apakah kau tahu Garden of Rhisis? Ini adalah daratan Northeast of Saint Morning. Teman saya Handel saat ini sedang melakukan penelitian di sana.
dialogsBegin.it: In the meantime, are you aware of the Garden of Rhisis? It is the landmass Northeast of Saint Morning. My friend Handel is currently conducting research there.
dialogsBegin.jp: ところで、ちょうどよいところに来てくれた。リシスの庭は知っているか？私の同胞ヘンデルがそこで探索活動をしている。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그나저나, 리시스의 정원에 대해 들어보셨나요? 세인트 모닝 북동쪽에 있는 곳이죠. 제 친구 핸델이 거기서 연구하고 있답니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: In the meantime, are you aware of the Garden of Rhisis? It is the landmass Northeast of Saint Morning. My friend Handel is currently conducting research there.
dialogsBegin.pl: In the meantime, are you aware of the Garden of Rhisis? It is the landmass Northeast of Saint Morning. My friend Handel is currently conducting research there.
dialogsBegin.ru: Кстати, ты в курсе про Райсский сад? Это остров к северо-востоку от Санто. Моя подруга Гандель там сейчас занимается исследованиями.
dialogsBegin.sp: Mientras tanto, ¿conoces el Jardín de Rhisis? Es la masa de tierra al noreste de Saint Morning. Mi amiga Handel está investigando allí.
dialogsBegin.sw: In the meantime, are you aware of the Garden of Rhisis? It is the landmass Northeast of Saint Morning. My friend Handel is currently conducting research there.
dialogsBegin.th: ในระหว่างนี้คุณรู้ถึง Garden of Rhisis หรือไม่? เป็นภาคพื้นตะวันออกเฉียงเหนือของ Saint Morning เพื่อนของฉัน Handel กำลังทำการวิจัยอยู่ที่นั่น
dialogsBegin.tw: 同時，你知道黎席斯庭院嗎？它是聖音特的東北部陸地。我的朋友賀丹爾目前正在那裡進行研究。
dialogsBegin.vi: Trong khi chờ đợi, bạn có biết đến Garden of Rhisis không? Đây là vùng đất Đông Bắc của Saint Morning. Bạn của tôi, Handel hiện đang tiến hành nghiên cứu ở đó.

dialogsBegin.en: Her work takes much time and the constant threat of masquerpet attacks doesn't help the process. Will you please go and assist her?
dialogsBegin.ar: Her work takes much time and the constant threat of masquerpet attacks doesn't help the process. Will you please go and assist her?
dialogsBegin.br: Seu trabalho leva muito tempo e a constante ameaça de ataques de masquerpets atrapalha o processo. Você poderia ir e ajudá-la?
dialogsBegin.cns: 她的工作花了很多时间，同时因为怪物们的持续威胁攻击让这个过程越发困难。你愿意前去帮助她吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Ihre Arbeit nimmt viel Zeit in Anspruch, und die ständige Bedrohung durch masquerpet attacken ist nicht gerade hilfreich. Würden Sie bitte gehen und ihr helfen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Her work takes much time and the constant threat of masquerpet attacks doesn't help the process. Will you please go and assist her?
dialogsBegin.fil: Her work takes much time and the constant threat of masquerpet attacks doesn't help the process. Will you please go and assist her?
dialogsBegin.fr: Pourriez-vous l'aider dans sa quête de vérité ?
dialogsBegin.id: Pekerjaannya membutuhkan banyak waktu dan ancaman serangan dari masquerpet yang konstan tidak membantu prosesnya. Maukah kau pergi dan membantunya?
dialogsBegin.it: Her work takes much time and the constant threat of masquerpet attacks doesn't help the process. Will you please go and assist her?
dialogsBegin.jp: 一人では手が足りないようでな。もしよければ君が彼女を手伝ってくれないか。
dialogsBegin.kr: 워낙 시간이 걸리는 연구인 데다, 마스커펫들의 끊임없는 위협 때문에 계속 일이 늘어난다고 하더군요. 헨델을 좀 도와주실 수 있을까요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Her work takes much time and the constant threat of masquerpet attacks doesn't help the process. Will you please go and assist her?
dialogsBegin.pl: Her work takes much time and the constant threat of masquerpet attacks doesn't help the process. Will you please go and assist her?
dialogsBegin.ru: Her work takes much time and the constant threat of masquerpet attacks doesn't help the process. Will you please go and assist her?
dialogsBegin.sp: Su trabajo lleva mucho tiempo y la constante amenaza de ataques de masquerpets no ayuda en el proceso. ¿Podrías ir y ayudarla?
dialogsBegin.sw: Her work takes much time and the constant threat of masquerpet attacks doesn't help the process. Will you please go and assist her?
dialogsBegin.th: งานของเธอต้องใช้เวลามากและการคุกคามแบบ masquerpet อย่างต่อเนื่องจะไม่สามารถช่วยได้ คุณจะไปช่วยเธอได้ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 她的工作需要很多時間，而不斷受到怪物攻擊的威脅對工作進行沒有幫助。請你去幫助她好嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Công việc của cô mất nhiều thời gian và mối đe dọa liên tục của các cuộc tấn công masquerpet không giúp ích gì cho quá trình đó. Bạn sẽ vui lòng đi và hỗ trợ cô ấy?

dialogsAccept.en: You can reach the Garden of Rhisis by flying Northeast from the continent of Saint Morning. Please go there and meet up with Handel
dialogsAccept.ar: You can reach the Garden of Rhisis by flying Northeast from the continent of Saint Morning. Please go there and meet up with Handel
dialogsAccept.br: Você pode chegar ao Jardim de Rhisis voando em direção nordeste do continente de Saint Morning. Por favor, vá e encontre Handel.
dialogsAccept.cns: 你可以从晨光东北部飞到莱斯庭院。请去那里与汉德尔见面。
dialogsAccept.de: Ihr könnt the Garden of Rhisis erreichen, indem ihr vom Kontinent Saint Morning nach Nordosten fliegt. Bitte gehen Sie dorthin und treffen Sie sich mit Handel
dialogsAccept.fi: You can reach the Garden of Rhisis by flying Northeast from the continent of Saint Morning. Please go there and meet up with Handel
dialogsAccept.fil: You can reach the Garden of Rhisis by flying Northeast from the continent of Saint Morning. Please go there and meet up with Handel
dialogsAccept.fr: C'est à l'Est de Saint Morning sur une île flottante. Handel est déjà sur place.
dialogsAccept.id: Kau dapat mencapai Garden of Rhisis dengan terbang ke Timur Laut dari benua Saint Morning. Silakan pergi ke sana dan temui Handel
dialogsAccept.it: You can reach the Garden of Rhisis by flying Northeast from the continent of Saint Morning. Please go there and meet up with Handel
dialogsAccept.jp: リシスの庭はセイントモーニングよりさらに東にある空中庭園だ。ヘンデルは島のどこかにいると思う。
dialogsAccept.kr: 세인트 모닝 대륙에서 북동쪽으로 날아가면 리시스의 정원에 도착해요. 그곳에 있는 헨델을 만나 보세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: You can reach the Garden of Rhisis by flying Northeast from the continent of Saint Morning. Please go there and meet up with Handel
dialogsAccept.pl: You can reach the Garden of Rhisis by flying Northeast from the continent of Saint Morning. Please go there and meet up with Handel
dialogsAccept.ru: Ты можешь попасть в Райсский сад полетев от Санто на северо-восток. Пожалуйста, отправляйся туда и встреться с Гандель.
dialogsAccept.sp: Puedes llegar al Jardín de Rhisis volando hacia el Noreste desde el continente de Saint Morning. Por favor, ve allí y reúnete con Handel.
dialogsAccept.sw: You can reach the Garden of Rhisis by flying Northeast from the continent of Saint Morning. Please go there and meet up with Handel
dialogsAccept.th: คุณสามารถเข้าถึง Garden of Rhisis โดยการบิน Northeast จากทวีป Saint Morning โปรดไปที่นั่นและพบกับ Handel
dialogsAccept.tw: 從聖音特大陸向東北方向前行，可以到達黎席斯庭院。請去那裡與賀丹爾會面

dialogsBegin.en: Well… was a mighty Elementor Hero… Shade cursed me. Trapping me in this cute furry little body was apparently the only way to contain all this power! Bwahaha!

dialogsBegin.th: โอ้! ฉันแทบจะคิดอะไรไม่ออกเลย เพราะเสียงเดินของพวก Steel Knights โง่ๆ นั่น คุณช่วยกำจัดพวกมันซักหน่อยได้ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 天啊！那些愚蠢的騎士機械叮叮噹噹地到處走，我連自己的思緒都快聽不見了。可以請你幫我清掉幾隻嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Trời ạ! Tôi thậm chí khó có thể nghe thấy được chính bản thân nếu tiếng lanh canh của những gã Hiệp sĩ Thép ngu ngốc này tiếp tục kêu xung quanh. Bạn có thể làm ơn dẹp những tên đó đi không?

dialogsAccept.en: Awesome!! I'm trying to research into removing this curse but UGHHH those stupid Steel Knights! Kill like 20 Small Steel Knights & 10 Steel Knights. and I will be one happy unicorn, dog thing…
dialogsAccept.ar: Awesome!! I'm trying to research into removing this curse but UGHHH those stupid Steel Knights! Kill like 20 Small Steel Knights & 10 Steel Knights. and I will be one happy unicorn, dog thing…
dialogsAccept.br: Legal!! Estou tentando pesquisar para remover essa maldição, mas UGHHH esses estúpidos de lata. Mate 20 Cavaleirinhos de Aço e 10 Cavaleiros de Aço. e eu serei um unicórnio feliz, ou unicachorro...
dialogsAccept.cns: 完美！！我正试图研究如何消除这个诅咒，但是，啊啊啊啊，这些愚蠢的钢甲骑士们。杀死20个钢甲见习骑士和10个钢甲骑士。然后我将成为一只快乐的独角兽，一只快乐的狗…
dialogsAccept.de: Wahnsinn!!! Ich versuche zu erforschen, wie man diesen Fluch entfernen kann, aber UGHHH diese dummen Steel Knights. Töte 20 Small Steel Knights & 10 Steel Knights, und ich werde ein glückliches Einhorn sein...…
dialogsAccept.fi: Awesome!! I'm trying to research into removing this curse but UGHHH those stupid Steel Knights! Kill like 20 Small Steel Knights & 10 Steel Knights. and I will be one happy unicorn, dog thing…
dialogsAccept.fil: Awesome!! I'm trying to research into removing this curse but UGHHH those stupid Steel Knights! Kill like 20 Small Steel Knights & 10 Steel Knights. and I will be one happy unicorn, dog thing…
dialogsAccept.fr: Merci ! Je ne peux pas me concentrer sur mes recherches à cause d'eux. Va en tuer, disons, 20 jeunes et 10 adultes ? Mes oreilles te remercient déjà...
dialogsAccept.id: Keren!! Saya mencoba meneliti untuk menghilangkan kutukan ini tetapi UGHHH Steel Knights bodoh itu. Bunuh seperti 20 Small Steel Knights &10 Steel Knights. dan saya akan menjadi satu unicorn yang bahagia, hal anjing ...
dialogsAccept.it: Awesome!! I'm trying to research into removing this curse but UGHHH those stupid Steel Knights! Kill like 20 Small Steel Knights & 10 Steel Knights. and I will be one happy unicorn, dog thing…
dialogsAccept.jp: すまんが、この周囲にいる＜スモール・スチールナイト＞を20体、＜スチールナイト＞を10体掃除してきてくれんか？　レオナンの名を知っているくらいだ。少しは腕も立つのだろう？
dialogsAccept.kr: 굉장해요!! 저도 이 저주를 풀 방법을 연구 중인데, 으으, 그놈의 스틸 나이트들 때문에 집중을 못 하겠어요! 작은 스틸 나이트 20마리와 스틸 나이트 10마리를 처치해 주세요. 그렇게만 되면 전 아주아주 행복한 유니콘… 멍멍이가 될 거예요…
dialogsAccept.nl: Awesome!! I'm trying to research into removing this curse but UGHHH those stupid Steel Knights! Kill like 20 Small Steel Knights & 10 Steel Knights. and I will be one happy unicorn, dog thing…

dialogsAccept.ru: Awesome!! I'm trying to research into removing this curse but UGHHH those stupid Steel Knights! Kill like 20 Small Steel Knights & 10 Steel Knights. and I will be one happy unicorn, dog thing…
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡¡Increíble!! Estoy investigando para ver como puedo eliminar esta maldición, ¡pero UGHHH esos estúpidos Steel Knights! Derrota a 20 Steel Knights Pequeños y a 10 Steel Knights. Así seré un unicornio, y especie de perro feliz...
dialogsAccept.sw: Awesome!! I'm trying to research into removing this curse but UGHHH those stupid Steel Knights! Kill like 20 Small Steel Knights & 10 Steel Knights. and I will be one happy unicorn, dog thing…
dialogsAccept.th: น่ากลัว!! ฉันพยายามที่จะค้นคว้าในการลบคำสาปแช่งนี้ แต่เหล่าคนโง่เขลา Steel Knights ฆ่า 20 Small Steel Knights & 10 Steel Knights และฉันจะเป็นหนึ่งในยูนิคอร์นที่มีความสุข ...
dialogsAccept.tw: 太好了！！我正努力研究怎麼解除這個詛咒，可那些愚蠢的騎士機械實在太煩人了！去幫我解決 20 隻騎士機械嘍囉和 10 隻騎士機械吧，這樣我這隻……獨角獸狗？總之就會很開心……
dialogsAccept.vi: Đáng kinh ngạc!! Tôi đang cố gắng nghiên cứu để loại bỏ lời nguyền này nhưng UGHHH những Hiệp sĩ thép ngu ngốc đó! Giết như 20 Hiệp sĩ thép nhỏ & 10 Hiệp sĩ thép. và tôi sẽ là một con kỳ lân hạnh phúc, thứ gì...

dialogsComplete.en: Ah! Now I can collect my thoughts. What? You look at me like you've never met an Elementor before. Er… we are all a little eccentric I guess you could say.
dialogsComplete.ar: Ah! Now I can collect my thoughts. What? You look at me like you've never met an Elementor before. Er… we are all a little eccentric I guess you could say.
dialogsComplete.br: Ah! Agora posso organizar meus pensamentos. Que foi? Você me olha como se nunca tivesse conhecido um Elementor antes. Er… somos todos um pouco excêntricos, eu diria.
dialogsComplete.cns: 啊！现在我终于可以集中注意力了。干嘛啊？你看着我，就像你从未见过元素使者一样。呃…我想你可以说我们都有点古怪。
dialogsComplete.de: Ah! Jetzt kann ich meine Gedanken sammeln. Was? Du siehst mich an, als ob du noch nie einen Elementor getroffen hättest. Äh... wir sind alle ein wenig exzentrisch, könnte man sagen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Ah! Now I can collect my thoughts. What? You look at me like you've never met an Elementor before. Er… we are all a little eccentric I guess you could say.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ah! Now I can collect my thoughts. What? You look at me like you've never met an Elementor before. Er… we are all a little eccentric I guess you could say.
dialogsComplete.fr: Ah, désormais on s'entend parler ici !
dialogsComplete.id: Ah! Sekarang saya dapat mengumpulkan pikiran saya. Apa? Anda melihat saya seperti Anda belum pernah bertemu Elementor sebelumnya. Selain itu... kita semua sedikit eksentrik, saya kira Anda bisa mengatakannya.
dialogsComplete.it: Ah! Now I can collect my thoughts. What? You look at me like you've never met an Elementor before. Er… we are all a little eccentric I guess you could say.
dialogsComplete.jp: ふう、少しは気が晴れたな。考えをまとめることができそうだ。ありがとう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 휴우.. 눈앞에 안보이니 이제 좀 살 것 같군. 뭐야? 마치 엘레멘터를 처음 보는 사람처럼 쳐다보는군. 음… 뭐, 우리 모두가 조금 괴짜 같은 면이 있긴 하지.
dialogsComplete.nl: Ah! Now I can collect my thoughts. What? You look at me like you've never met an Elementor before. Er… we are all a little eccentric I guess you could say.
dialogsComplete.pl: Ah! Now I can collect my thoughts. What? You look at me like you've never met an Elementor before. Er… we are all a little eccentric I guess you could say.
dialogsComplete.ru: Ах! Наконец-то я могу собраться с мыслями. Что? Не смотри на меня так, будто никогда не видет факира. Эмм... Мы все немного необычные, да.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Ay! Ahora puedo ordenar mis pensamientos. ¿Qué? Me miras como si nunca antes hubieras conocido a un Elementor. Emm... todos somos un poco excéntricos, supongo que se podría decir.
dialogsComplete.sw: Ah! Now I can collect my thoughts. What? You look at me like you've never met an Elementor before. Er… we are all a little eccentric I guess you could say.
dialogsComplete.th: Ah! ตอนนี้ฉันสามารถรวบรวมความคิดของฉันได้ อะไร? คุณมองมาที่ฉันเหมือนที่คุณไม่เคยเจอ Elementor มาก่อน เอ่อ ... ฉันเดาได้
dialogsComplete.tw: 啊！這下我總算能好好整理思緒了。怎麼？你那表情像是從沒見過元素使一樣。呃……你也可以說，我們這一類人多少都有點古怪。
dialogsComplete.vi: Ah! Bây giờ tôi có thể thu thập những suy nghĩ của mình. Gì? Bạn nhìn tôi như thể bạn chưa từng gặp Elementor trước đây. Er… tất cả chúng ta đều hơi lập dị, tôi đoán bạn có thể nói vậy.
