dialogsBegin.en: Wha? Someone named Reonan is looking for me? Sounds familiar but… UGH! I've got way too bad of a headache to be thinking about things right now.
dialogsBegin.ar: Wha? Someone named Reonan is looking for me? Sounds familiar but… UGH! I've got way too bad of a headache to be thinking about things right now.
dialogsBegin.br: Hm? Alguém chamado Reonan está procurando por mim? Parece familiar, mas... UGH! Estou com uma dor de cabeça muito forte para pensar nas coisas agora.
dialogsBegin.cns: 哈？一个叫瑞尔南的人正在找我？这个名字听着很熟悉...啊！我现在一想这些事情我就头疼。
dialogsBegin.de: Was? Jemand namens Reonan ist auf der Suche nach mir? Kommt mir bekannt vor, aber... UGH! Ich habe viel zu starke Kopfschmerzen, um jetzt darüber nachzudenken.
dialogsBegin.fi: Wha? Someone named Reonan is looking for me? Sounds familiar but… UGH! I've got way too bad of a headache to be thinking about things right now.
dialogsBegin.fil: Wha? Someone named Reonan is looking for me? Sounds familiar but… UGH! I've got way too bad of a headache to be thinking about things right now.
dialogsBegin.fr: Pourquoi avez-vous l'air si angoissé ? Je parie que Reonan a encore dit des bêtises sur moi !!
dialogsBegin.id: Apa? Seseorang bernama Reonan sedang mencariku? Kedengarannya tidak asing tapi ... UGH! Saya terlalu sakit kepala untuk memikirkan banyak hal saat ini.
dialogsBegin.it: Wha? Someone named Reonan is looking for me? Sounds familiar but… UGH! I've got way too bad of a headache to be thinking about things right now.
dialogsBegin.jp: レオナン……どこかで聞いたことが……うっ、頭が……頭が……
dialogsBegin.kr: 뭐라고요? 레오난이라는 사람이 절 찾는다고요? 친숙한 이름이긴 한데… 으윽! 지금은 머리가 너무 아파서 아무 생각도 안 나요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Wha? Someone named Reonan is looking for me? Sounds familiar but… UGH! I've got way too bad of a headache to be thinking about things right now.
dialogsBegin.pl: Wha? Someone named Reonan is looking for me? Sounds familiar but… UGH! I've got way too bad of a headache to be thinking about things right now.
dialogsBegin.ru: Wha? Someone named Reonan is looking for me? Sounds familiar but… UGH! I've got way too bad of a headache to be thinking about things right now.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Qué? ¿Alguien llamado Reonan me está buscando? Me resulta familiar pero... ¡UGH! Me duele demasiado la cabeza como para estar pensando en cosas ahora mismo.
dialogsBegin.sw: Wha? Someone named Reonan is looking for me? Sounds familiar but… UGH! I've got way too bad of a headache to be thinking about things right now.
dialogsBegin.th: อะ? คนที่ชื่อ Reonan กำลังมองหาฉันอยู่หรือ? เสียงคุ้นเคย แต่ ... UGH! ตอนนี้ฉันปวดหัวมากจนต้องคิดถึงสิ่งต่างๆ
dialogsBegin.tw: 什麼？有人叫雷奧南在找我？這名字聽起來有點耳熟……呃！我現在頭痛得太厲害了，根本沒辦法好好想事情。
dialogsBegin.vi: Gì? Ai đó tên là Reonan đang tìm tôi? Nghe có vẻ quen thuộc nhưng… UGH! Tôi cảm thấy rất đau đầu khi phải suy nghĩ về mọi thứ ngay bây giờ.

dialogsBegin.en: Reonan... It's the first time hearing that name, but it is familiar... He said its time? Time for what, I wonder…
dialogsBegin.ar: Reonan... It's the first time hearing that name, but it is familiar... He said its time? Time for what, I wonder…
dialogsBegin.br: Reonan... É a primeira vez que ouço esse nome, mas parece familiar... Ele disse que está na hora? Hora de quê, eu me pergunto...
dialogsBegin.cns: 瑞尔南...我第一次听到这个名字，但又如此熟悉...他说是时候了吗？我想知道，是时候是指什么？
dialogsBegin.de: Reonan... Es ist das erste Mal, dass ich diesen Namen höre, aber er kommt mir bekannt vor... Er sagte, es sei Zeit? Zeit für was, frage ich mich...
dialogsBegin.fi: Reonan... It's the first time hearing that name, but it is familiar... He said its time? Time for what, I wonder…
dialogsBegin.fil: Reonan... It's the first time hearing that name, but it is familiar... He said its time? Time for what, I wonder…
dialogsBegin.fr: Il veut que je me batte pour lui ? Je ne suis pas certain de vouloir. C'est que j'ai du travail moi !
dialogsBegin.id: Reonan... Ini pertama kalinya saya mendengar nama itu, tapi nama itu terdengar tidak asing ... Dia mengatakan ini sudah saatnya? Saatnya untuk apa, saya penasaran ...
dialogsBegin.it: Reonan... It's the first time hearing that name, but it is familiar... He said its time? Time for what, I wonder…
dialogsBegin.jp: むう……初めて聞く名前だがどこか懐かしいような気がする……。うう、思い出そうとすると頭が割れそうだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 레오난… 처음 듣는 이름인데 이상하게 낯이 익네요... 때가 됐다고 했다고요? 무슨… 무슨 때가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Reonan... It's the first time hearing that name, but it is familiar... He said its time? Time for what, I wonder…
dialogsBegin.pl: Reonan... It's the first time hearing that name, but it is familiar... He said its time? Time for what, I wonder…
dialogsBegin.ru: Reonan... It's the first time hearing that name, but it is familiar... He said its time? Time for what, I wonder…
dialogsBegin.sp: Reonan... Es la primera vez que escucho ese nombre, pero me resulta familiar... ¿Dijo que era la hora? La hora de qué, me pregunto...
dialogsBegin.sw: Reonan... It's the first time hearing that name, but it is familiar... He said its time? Time for what, I wonder…
dialogsBegin.th: Reonan ... นี่เป็นครั้งแรกที่ได้ยินชื่อนี้ แต่คุ้นเคย ... เขากล่าวว่าเวลาของมัน? เวลาสำหรับสิ่งที่ฉันสงสัย ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 雷奧南……明明像是第一次聽到這名字，卻又覺得很熟悉……他說時候到了？到底是什麼時候到了呢……
dialogsBegin.vi: Reonan ... Lần đầu tiên nghe thấy cái tên đó, nhưng cũng quen thuộc ... Anh ấy nói đã đến lúc chưa? Giờ để làm gì, tôi tự hỏi…

dialogsBegin.en: Regardless! I have my own goals and limited time so move along! There is a foul demon lurking in the Mars Mine with a bounty on its head JUST waiting to be claimed *sneer*
dialogsBegin.ar: Regardless! I have my own goals and limited time so move along! There is a foul demon lurking in the Mars Mine with a bounty on its head JUST waiting to be claimed *sneer*
dialogsBegin.br: De qualquer forma! Eu tenho meus próprios objetivos e tempo limitado, então siga em frente! Há um demônio asqueroso à espreita na Masmorra Mars com uma recompensa por sua cabeça PRONTINHO pra ser morto *Zomba*
dialogsBegin.cns: 无所谓！我有自己的目标并且我的时间很有限，所以请你走开。一个正潜伏在魔域密殿的被悬赏了的邪恶的怪物正等着被我狩猎呢*嘲笑*。
dialogsBegin.de: Das ist egal! Ich habe meine eigenen Ziele und nur wenig Zeit, also macht weiter! In der Mars-Mine lauert ein böser Dämon, auf den ein Kopfgeld ausgesetzt ist, das nur darauf wartet, eingefordert zu werden *schnauf*
dialogsBegin.fi: Regardless! I have my own goals and limited time so move along! There is a foul demon lurking in the Mars Mine with a bounty on its head JUST waiting to be claimed *sneer*
dialogsBegin.fil: Regardless! I have my own goals and limited time so move along! There is a foul demon lurking in the Mars Mine with a bounty on its head JUST waiting to be claimed *sneer*
dialogsBegin.fr: Aujourd'hui je dois par exemple aller tuer des Vice Veduque au plus profond de la Temple d'Ivillis.
dialogsBegin.id: Terlepas dari apapun itu! Saya memiliki tujuan saya sendiri dan waktu yang terbatas, jadi lanjutkan! Ada iblis busuk yang bersembunyi di Mars Mine dengan hadiah di kepalanya DAN menunggu untuk diklaim *mencibir*
dialogsBegin.it: Regardless! I have my own goals and limited time so move along! There is a foul demon lurking in the Mars Mine with a bounty on its head JUST waiting to be claimed *sneer*
dialogsBegin.jp: すまないが私はいま任務中でね。フラリスダンジョン奥に生息するヴァイスヴェデュークを倒さねばならないのだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 어쨌든! 저도 한번 목표를 정하면 빨리해내야 하는 사람이에요. 그러니까 비켜요! 마스 마인에는 끔찍한 악마가 숨어 있는데, 혀상금까지 걸려 있단 말이죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: Regardless! I have my own goals and limited time so move along! There is a foul demon lurking in the Mars Mine with a bounty on its head JUST waiting to be claimed *sneer*
dialogsBegin.pl: Regardless! I have my own goals and limited time so move along! There is a foul demon lurking in the Mars Mine with a bounty on its head JUST waiting to be claimed *sneer*
dialogsBegin.ru: Regardless! I have my own goals and limited time so move along! There is a foul demon lurking in the Mars Mine with a bounty on its head JUST waiting to be claimed *sneer*
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Cambiando de tema! Tengo mis propios objetivos y tiempo limitado, ¡así que sigue por tu camino! Hay un bicho asqueroso acechando en la Mina Mars, con una recompensa por su cabeza esperando ser reclamada. *burla*
dialogsBegin.sw: Regardless! I have my own goals and limited time so move along! There is a foul demon lurking in the Mars Mine with a bounty on its head JUST waiting to be claimed *sneer*
dialogsBegin.th: โดยไม่คำนึงถึง! ฉันมีเป้าหมายของตัวเองและมีเวลา จำกัด เพื่อให้เดินไป! มีปีศาจร้ายที่ซุ่มซ่อนอยู่ในวิหาร Ivillis ด้วยความโปรดปรานบนศีรษะของมันก็ต้องรอการอ้างสิทธิ์ * เยาะเย้ย *
dialogsBegin.tw: 算了！我有自己的目標，時間也不多，你快往前走吧！瑪斯礦坑裡有個邪惡的惡魔，牠頭上的賞金正等著人去領呢。*冷笑*
dialogsBegin.vi: Bất kể! Tôi có mục tiêu của riêng mình và thời gian có hạn, vì vậy hãy di chuyển theo! Có một con quỷ hôi đang ẩn nấp trong Mỏ sao Hỏa với tiền thưởng trên đầu CHỈ đang chờ được tuyên bố * chế nhạo *

dialogsBegin.en: UGH! Headache…getting…worse! OK look, here's the deal. You take out that Vice Veduque, give me the reward and I will meet your Reonan. Deal?
dialogsBegin.ar: UGH! Headache…getting…worse! OK look, here's the deal. You take out that Vice Veduque, give me the reward and I will meet your Reonan. Deal?
dialogsBegin.br: Aii! A dor de cabeça... está ficando... pior! OK, olha, o negócio é o seguinte. Acabe com aquelas Veduques Corruptas, me dê a recompensa e eu falarei com esse Reonan. Fechado?
dialogsBegin.cns: 啊！头疼愈发严重了！好吧，看来只能这样了，我们来做个交易吧。你杀死蛇妖女，然后把奖励给我，我就和你去见瑞尔南。
dialogsBegin.de: UGH! Kopfschmerzen...werden...schlimmer! Okay, hör zu, hier ist der Deal. Du schaltest diesen Vice Veduque aus, gibst mir die Belohnung und ich treffe deinen Reonan. Abgemacht?
dialogsBegin.fi: UGH! Headache…getting…worse! OK look, here's the deal. You take out that Vice Veduque, give me the reward and I will meet your Reonan. Deal?
dialogsBegin.fil: UGH! Headache…getting…worse! OK look, here's the deal. You take out that Vice Veduque, give me the reward and I will meet your Reonan. Deal?
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous aussi vous voulez tuer des Vice Veduque ? Bien ! Si vous leur faites la peau avant moi, je reconsidérerai l'offre de Reonan.
dialogsBegin.id: UGH! Sakit kepala... Makin... Parah! Ok dengar, ini kesepakatannya. Kamu bawa Vice Veduque itu, beri saya hadiahnya dan saya akan menemui Reonan. Setuju?
dialogsBegin.it: UGH! Headache…getting…worse! OK look, here's the deal. You take out that Vice Veduque, give me the reward and I will meet your Reonan. Deal?
dialogsBegin.jp: うう……頭が割れそうだ。君は私に用があると言ったね。すまないが、私の代わりにヴァイスヴェデュークを倒してくれないか。その間には頭痛も少しは回復するだろう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 으윽… 두통이… 점점 심해지는데! 음, 이렇게 하자고요. 당신이 바이스 베듀크를 처치하고 보상을 가져오면, 그 레오난이라는 자를 만나보겠어요. 어때요?
dialogsBegin.nl: UGH! Headache…getting…worse! OK look, here's the deal. You take out that Vice Veduque, give me the reward and I will meet your Reonan. Deal?
dialogsBegin.pl: UGH! Headache…getting…worse! OK look, here's the deal. You take out that Vice Veduque, give me the reward and I will meet your Reonan. Deal?
dialogsBegin.ru: UGH! Headache…getting…worse! OK look, here's the deal. You take out that Vice Veduque, give me the reward and I will meet your Reonan. Deal?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡UGH! ¡Qué dolor de cabeza... empeorando...! Vale mira, este es el trato. Te cargas a esos Veduques Crueles, me das la recompensa y yo me reúno con tu querido Reonan. ¿Trato hecho?
dialogsBegin.sw: UGH! Headache…getting…worse! OK look, here's the deal. You take out that Vice Veduque, give me the reward and I will meet your Reonan. Deal?
dialogsBegin.th: ฮึ! ปวดหัว ... รับ ... เลว! ตกลงดูนี่คือข้อตกลง คุณจะออกว่ารอง Verduque ให้ฉันรางวัลและฉันจะได้พบกับ Reonan ของคุณ จัดการ?
dialogsBegin.tw: 啊！頭痛……越來越……嚴重了！好吧，這樣吧。你去幹掉那個扒爾斯，把賞金拿來給我，我就去見你的雷奧南。成交嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: UGH! Nhức đầu… ngày càng… tồi tệ hơn! Được rồi, đây là thỏa thuận. Bạn hạ gục Phó Veduque đó, đưa tôi phần thưởng và tôi sẽ gặp Reonan của bạn. Thỏa thuận?

dialogsAccept.en: Well, never expected you to accept THAT offer? Well anyway, go kill 10 Vice Veduque in Mars Mine then return to me!
dialogsAccept.ar: Well, never expected you to accept THAT offer? Well anyway, go kill 10 Vice Veduque in Mars Mine then return to me!
dialogsAccept.br: Oxe, pensei que você nunca aceitaria uma oferta como essa. Bem, de qualquer forma, vá matar 10 Veduques Corruptas na Masmorra Mars e depois volte para mim!
dialogsAccept.cns: 真没想到你会接受这个条件。不管怎样，去魔域密殿杀死10个蛇妖女后回来见我！
dialogsAccept.de: Nun, ich hätte nie erwartet, dass du DIESES Angebot annimmst? Wie auch immer, töte 10 Vice Veduque in der Mars Mine und komm dann zu mir zurück!
dialogsAccept.fi: Well, never expected you to accept THAT offer? Well anyway, go kill 10 Vice Veduque in Mars Mine then return to me!
dialogsAccept.fil: Well, never expected you to accept THAT offer? Well anyway, go kill 10 Vice Veduque in Mars Mine then return to me!
dialogsAccept.fr: Allez, c'est parti ! Le premier qui tue 10 Vice Veduque à la Temple d'Ivillis a gagné !
dialogsAccept.id: Sejujurnya, saya tidak pernah menyangka bahwa kamu akan menerima tawaran ITU? Yah bagaimanapun, bunuh 10 Vice Veduque di Mars Mine lalu kembali padaku!
dialogsAccept.it: Well, never expected you to accept THAT offer? Well anyway, go kill 10 Vice Veduque in Mars Mine then return to me!
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとう。フラリスダンジョンの奥地まで行くのは大変だろうが頼んだぞ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 설마, 그 제안을 받아들일 줄은 몰랐는데요? 뭐, 좋아요. 마스 마인에 있는 바이스 베듀크 10마리를 처치하고 돌아오세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Well, never expected you to accept THAT offer? Well anyway, go kill 10 Vice Veduque in Mars Mine then return to me!
dialogsAccept.pl: Well, never expected you to accept THAT offer? Well anyway, go kill 10 Vice Veduque in Mars Mine then return to me!
dialogsAccept.ru: Well, never expected you to accept THAT offer? Well anyway, go kill 10 Vice Veduque in Mars Mine then return to me!
dialogsAccept.sp: Bueno, no esperaba que aceptaras ESA oferta. ¡En fin, ve a matar a 10 Veduques Crueles de la Mina Mars y vuelve conmigo!
dialogsAccept.sw: Well, never expected you to accept THAT offer? Well anyway, go kill 10 Vice Veduque in Mars Mine then return to me!
dialogsAccept.th: ดี ไม่เคยคาดว่าคุณจะยอมรับข้อเสนอนั้น? ดี , ไปฆ่า Vice Verduque 5 ในวัด Ivillis แล้วกลับมาหาฉัน!
dialogsAccept.tw: 好吧，真沒想到你會接受這筆交易？總之，去瑪斯礦坑殺掉 10 隻扒爾斯，再回來找我！
dialogsAccept.vi: Chà, không bao giờ mong đợi bạn chấp nhận lời đề nghị ĐÓ? Dù sao thì, hãy giết 10 con Phó Veduque ở Mars Mine rồi trở về với tôi!

dialogsDecline.en: No skin off my back! Planned to do it myself anyway. Just gotta, ya know, rest a minute or two…or three…
dialogsDecline.ar: No skin off my back! Planned to do it myself anyway. Just gotta, ya know, rest a minute or two…or three…
dialogsDecline.br: Quem não tem cão, caça com gato! Planejava fazer isso sozinho de qualquer maneira. Só tenho que, você sabe... descansar um minutinho ou dois... ou três...
dialogsDecline.cns: 这对我没什么影响！我自己会计划好然后完成任务。只是，你知道的，我需要休息1分钟或者2分钟...或者3分钟吧...
dialogsDecline.de: Das macht mir nichts aus! Ich hatte sowieso vor, es selbst zu tun. Ich muss mich nur ein, zwei Minuten ausruhen ... oder drei ...
dialogsDecline.fi: No skin off my back! Planned to do it myself anyway. Just gotta, ya know, rest a minute or two…or three…
dialogsDecline.fil: No skin off my back! Planned to do it myself anyway. Just gotta, ya know, rest a minute or two…or three…
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous avez peur ? Tant pis pour Reonan !
dialogsDecline.id: Itu bukan urusanku! Toh saya berencana untuk melakukannya sendiri. Saya hanya perlu, tahu lah, istirahat sekitar satu atau dua menit ... atau tiga ...
dialogsDecline.it: No skin off my back! Planned to do it myself anyway. Just gotta, ya know, rest a minute or two…or three…
dialogsDecline.jp: そうか……仕方がない。やはり私がやらなければならないか。
dialogsDecline.kr: 뭐, 상관없어요! 어차피 직접 하려고 했던 일이니까. 그냥, 어, 한두... 아니... 3분만 눈 붙이고 나서…
dialogsDecline.nl: No skin off my back! Planned to do it myself anyway. Just gotta, ya know, rest a minute or two…or three…
dialogsDecline.pl: No skin off my back! Planned to do it myself anyway. Just gotta, ya know, rest a minute or two…or three…
dialogsDecline.ru: No skin off my back! Planned to do it myself anyway. Just gotta, ya know, rest a minute or two…or three…
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡No doy crédito! Planeaba hacerlo yo mismo de todos modos. Solo tengo que, ya sabes, descansar un minuto o dos... o tres...
dialogsDecline.sw: No skin off my back! Planned to do it myself anyway. Just gotta, ya know, rest a minute or two…or three…
dialogsDecline.th: วางแผนที่จะทำมันเองต่อไป แค่ต้องไปสักพักหนึ่งนาทีหรือสองนาที ... หรือสามนาที ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 這對我可沒差！反正我本來就打算自己去做。只是嘛，你也知道，我得先休息個一兩分鐘……或者三分鐘……
dialogsDecline.vi: Không có da ra khỏi lưng của tôi! Có kế hoạch để làm điều đó cho bản thân mình. Chỉ cần thôi, bạn biết đấy, hãy nghỉ ngơi một hoặc hai phút… hoặc ba…

dialogsComplete.en: Hmpf killed them huh? Well aren't we proud of ourselves. Anyway, while you were in Mars Mine, I thought again about this here… Reonan, or whatever his name is.
dialogsComplete.ar: Hmpf killed them huh? Well aren't we proud of ourselves. Anyway, while you were in Mars Mine, I thought again about this here… Reonan, or whatever his name is.
dialogsComplete.br: Hmpf matou elas né? Bem, não estamos orgulhosos de nós mesmos? Enfim, enquanto você estava na Masmorra Mars, pensei novamente sobre esse... Reonan, ou seja lá qual for o nome dele.
dialogsComplete.cns: 已经杀死他们了？我们不应该为自己感到骄傲吗。不管怎样，当你在魔域密殿时，我在这又想了想...瑞尔南，或者不管他叫什么名字。
dialogsComplete.de: Hmpf hat sie getötet, was? Na, da sind wir aber stolz auf uns. Wie auch immer, während du in der Mars-Mine warst, habe ich wieder an diesen hier gedacht... Reonan, oder wie auch immer er heißt.
dialogsComplete.fi: Hmpf killed them huh? Well aren't we proud of ourselves. Anyway, while you were in Mars Mine, I thought again about this here… Reonan, or whatever his name is.
dialogsComplete.fil: Hmpf killed them huh? Well aren't we proud of ourselves. Anyway, while you were in Mars Mine, I thought again about this here… Reonan, or whatever his name is.
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh, vous avez gagné ! (Bien entendu je me la suis coulé douce pendant que vous courriez dans tous les sens !)
dialogsComplete.id: Hmpf membunuh mereka? Bukankah kita bangga pada diri kita sendiri. Ngomong-ngomong, ketika kamu di Mars Mine, saya memikirkan lagi tentang ini di sini ... Reonan, atau apalah namanya itu.
dialogsComplete.it: Hmpf killed them huh? Well aren't we proud of ourselves. Anyway, while you were in Mars Mine, I thought again about this here… Reonan, or whatever his name is.
dialogsComplete.jp: 約束通り、倒してきてくれたようだね。君を待っている間にレオナンという名前について思い返してみたよ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 흥, 녀석들을 처치했군요? 꽤 자랑스럽나 보네요. 어쨌든, 당신이 마스 마인에 간 동안 저도 다시 생각해봤어요... 레오난인가 뭔가 하는 사람 말이죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: Hmpf killed them huh? Well aren't we proud of ourselves. Anyway, while you were in Mars Mine, I thought again about this here… Reonan, or whatever his name is.
dialogsComplete.pl: Hmpf killed them huh? Well aren't we proud of ourselves. Anyway, while you were in Mars Mine, I thought again about this here… Reonan, or whatever his name is.
dialogsComplete.ru: Hmpf killed them huh? Well aren't we proud of ourselves. Anyway, while you were in Mars Mine, I thought again about this here… Reonan, or whatever his name is.
dialogsComplete.sp: Uhmm los has matado, ¿eh? Bueno, podemos estar orgullosos de nosotros mismos. De todos modos, mientras estabas en la Mina Mars, volví a pensar en eso... Reonan, o como se llame.
dialogsComplete.sw: Hmpf killed them huh? Well aren't we proud of ourselves. Anyway, while you were in Mars Mine, I thought again about this here… Reonan, or whatever his name is.
dialogsComplete.th: Hmpf ฆ่าพวกเขาเหรอ? เราไม่รู้สึกภาคภูมิใจกับตัวเอง อย่างไรก็ตามในขณะที่คุณอยู่ในวิหาร Ivillis ฉันคิดอีกครั้งเกี่ยวกับเรื่องนี้ที่นี่ ... Reonan หรือชื่อของเขาคืออะไร
dialogsComplete.tw: 哼，原來你把它們殺了啊？看來還真有兩下子。不過，趁你在瑪斯礦坑的時候，我又想起了那個……雷奧南，還是什麼名字來著。
dialogsComplete.vi: Hmpf đã giết họ hả? Chúng ta không tự hào về bản thân mình. Dù sao đi nữa, khi bạn ở Mars Mine, tôi đã nghĩ lại về điều này ở đây… Reonan, hay tên của anh ấy là gì.

dialogsFail.fil: *snores* huh!? What!? I was awake, just resting my eyes!

dialogsFail.it: *snores* huh!? What!? I was awake, just resting my eyes!

dialogsFail.nl: *snores* huh!? What!? I was awake, just resting my eyes!
dialogsFail.pl: *snores* huh!? What!? I was awake, just resting my eyes!
dialogsFail.ru: *snores* huh!? What!? I was awake, just resting my eyes!
dialogsFail.sp: *ronca* ¿¡Eh!? ¿¡Qué!? ¡Estaba despierto, solo estaba descansando los ojos!
dialogsFail.sw: *snores* huh!? What!? I was awake, just resting my eyes!
dialogsFail.th: * คร่อกกก * ฮะ!? อะไร!? ฉันไม่ได้นอนแต่หลับตาอยู่!

description.ru: Нужно отыскать 'расхитителя могил на ужасной паровой машине'. Сдается мне, это паробот.
description.sp: Busca la máquina que echa vapor por alrededor y que está siendo controlada por un ladrón de tumbas. Puede que tengas que usar la fuerza...
description.sw: Look around for the machine spouting steam that is being controlled by a grave robber. You may have to use force…
description.th: ลองตามหาเครื่องพ่นไอน้ำที่ถูกควบคุมโดยโจรร้าย คุณอาจจะต้องใช้กำลัง ...
description.tw: 四處找找那台由盜墓賊操控、不斷噴出蒸氣的機器。你可能得動用武力……
description.vi: Nhìn xung quanh xem chiếc máy phun ra hơi nước đang được điều khiển bởi một tên cướp mộ. Bạn có thể phải sử dụng vũ lực…

dialogsBegin.en: Hey! I am not lying! Why on earth do you not believe me? Okay, yes, I stole the play script, but it was for revenge!
dialogsBegin.ar: Hey! I am not lying! Why on earth do you not believe me? Okay, yes, I stole the play script, but it was for revenge!
dialogsBegin.br: Ei! Não estou mentindo! Por que é que você não acredita em mim? Sim, roubei o roteiro da peça, mas foi simplesmente por vingança!
dialogsBegin.cns: 我说的是真的啦!虽然当初我偷了剧本，但是那时候只是想报仇，没有别的意思啦!
dialogsBegin.de: Hey! Ich lüge nicht! Ich habe das Skript gestohlen, aber nur aus Rache!
dialogsBegin.fi: Hey! I am not lying! Why on earth do you not believe me? Okay, yes, I stole the play script, but it was for revenge!
dialogsBegin.fil: Hey! I am not lying! Why on earth do you not believe me? Okay, yes, I stole the play script, but it was for revenge!
dialogsBegin.fr: Hé ! Je ne mens pas ! Pourquoi ne veux-tu pas me croire ?! Oui, j'ai volé cette pièce de théâtre, mais bon c'était juste une revanche !
dialogsBegin.id: Hei! Aku tidak berbohong! Kenapa kamu tidak percaya padaku? Oke, ya, aku mencuri naskah drama, tapi itu untuk balas dendam!
dialogsBegin.it: Hey! I am not lying! Why on earth do you not believe me? Okay, yes, I stole the play script, but it was for revenge!
dialogsBegin.jp: 本当です、信じてください！　私は台本を盗みはしましたが、それはあくまでも劇団を追い出された腹いせだったのです。困らせようとして、つい・・・
dialogsBegin.kr: 거짓말 안 했다니까요! 왜 다들 절 안 믿는 거예요? 그래요, 대본 훔친 건 맞아요! 하지만… 복수하려고 그랬던 거라고요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Hey! I am not lying! Why on earth do you not believe me? Okay, yes, I stole the play script, but it was for revenge!
dialogsBegin.pl: Hey! I am not lying! Why on earth do you not believe me? Okay, yes, I stole the play script, but it was for revenge!
dialogsBegin.ru: Да не вру я, не вру, Лучик свидетель! Почему ты не веришь мне? Да, я хотел отомстить "Погорелому театру", но теперь и думать об этом забыл!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Oye! ¡No estoy mintiendo! ¿Por qué razón no me crees? Vale, sí, robé el guión de la obra, ¡pero fue por venganza!
dialogsBegin.sw: Hey! I am not lying! Why on earth do you not believe me? Okay, yes, I stole the play script, but it was for revenge!
dialogsBegin.th: เฮ้! ฉันไม่ได้โกหก! ทำไมไม่เชื่อฉันสักทีล่ะ? เอาล่ะ ใช่ ฉันขโมยบทละคร แต่มันเป็นการแก้แค้น!
dialogsBegin.tw: 我說的是真的啦！雖然當初我偷了劇本，但是那時候只是想報仇，沒有別的意思啦！
dialogsBegin.vi: Chào! Tôi không nói dối! Tại sao bạn không tin tôi? Được rồi, vâng, tôi đã ăn cắp kịch bản vở kịch, nhưng đó là để trả thù!

dialogsBegin.en: There is no evidence that I'm a liar, right? In that case, if you want to find the play script...
dialogsBegin.ar: There is no evidence that I'm a liar, right? In that case, if you want to find the play script...
dialogsBegin.br: Não há evidências que provem que eu estou mentindo, certo? Portanto, se você quer encontrar o roteiro da peça...
dialogsBegin.cns: 没有证据能证明我是个骗子对吧？那么的话，如果你想找到剧本…..
dialogsBegin.de: Es gibt keine Beweise dafür, dass ich ein Lügner bin, richtig? In diesem Fall, wenn du das Drehbuch des Stücks finden willst...
dialogsBegin.fi: There is no evidence that I'm a liar, right? In that case, if you want to find the play script...
dialogsBegin.fil: There is no evidence that I'm a liar, right? In that case, if you want to find the play script...
dialogsBegin.fr: Il n'y a rien qui prouve que je te mente, ok ? Donc si tu veux retrouver cette fameuse pièce de théâtre.
dialogsBegin.id: Tidak ada bukti bahwa aku pembohong, kan? Dalam hal ini, jika kamu ingin menemukan skrip drama ...
dialogsBegin.it: There is no evidence that I'm a liar, right? In that case, if you want to find the play script...
dialogsBegin.jp: 私は嘘をついていません。本当に台本を持っていないのです。どうか、信じてください。あの台本は変な蒸気を出すロボットに乗った盗賊に奪われてしまいました。台本を取り戻すのなら、まず、そいつらを探してください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 제가 거짓말쟁이라는 증거는 없잖아요? 그렇다면, 대본을 찾고 싶다면…
dialogsBegin.nl: There is no evidence that I'm a liar, right? In that case, if you want to find the play script...
dialogsBegin.pl: There is no evidence that I'm a liar, right? In that case, if you want to find the play script...
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь найти свой сценарий? Тогда разыщи вора!
dialogsBegin.sp: No hay evidencias de que sea un mentiroso, ¿verdad? Pues, si quieres encontrar el guión de la obra...
dialogsBegin.sw: There is no evidence that I'm a liar, right? In that case, if you want to find the play script...
dialogsBegin.th: ไม่มีหลักฐานว่าฉันโกหกใช่มั้ย? ในกรณีนี้ หากคุณต้องการหาสคริปต์บทละคร ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 沒有證據證明我是騙子，對吧？在那種情況下，如果你想找到腳本…
dialogsBegin.vi: Không có bằng chứng nào cho thấy tôi là kẻ nói dối, phải không? Trong trường hợp đó, nếu bạn muốn tìm kịch bản vở kịch...

dialogsBegin.fi: I think someone among them has it.
dialogsBegin.fil: I think someone among them has it.

dialogsBegin.it: I think someone among them has it.

dialogsBegin.kr: 저 사람 중 누군가가 가지고 있는 것 같아요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I think someone among them has it.
dialogsBegin.pl: I think someone among them has it.
dialogsBegin.ru: Расхитителя могил на ужасной паровой машине.
dialogsBegin.sp: Creo que lo tiene alguno de ellos.
dialogsBegin.sw: I think someone among them has it.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันคิดว่าหนึ่งในพวกเขามีมัน
dialogsBegin.tw: 我猜他們其中一個拿著吧！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi nghĩ ai đó trong số họ có nó.

dialogsAccept.en: Hey! You there! Let me out of here! Help me, please!
dialogsAccept.ar: Hey! You there! Let me out of here! Help me, please!

dialogsAccept.fi: Hey! You there! Let me out of here! Help me, please!
dialogsAccept.fil: Hey! You there! Let me out of here! Help me, please!

dialogsAccept.it: Hey! You there! Let me out of here! Help me, please!

dialogsAccept.kr: 이봐요! 거기! 여기서 좀 꺼내줘요! 제발 도와주세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Hey! You there! Let me out of here! Help me, please!
dialogsAccept.pl: Hey! You there! Let me out of here! Help me, please!

dialogsDecline.en: Look, I know it's none of your business. Will you help me anyway? Please!?
dialogsDecline.ar: Look, I know it's none of your business. Will you help me anyway? Please!?
dialogsDecline.br: Sim, sei que não é problema seu. De qualquer jeito, me ajude. Hum? Por favor!
dialogsDecline.cns: 没必要去管其他人的事啦!不是吗?好啦!你先来救救我啦!
dialogsDecline.de: Yes, ich weiß, das ist nicht den Problem, aber bitte hilf mir!
dialogsDecline.fi: Look, I know it's none of your business. Will you help me anyway? Please!?
dialogsDecline.fil: Look, I know it's none of your business. Will you help me anyway? Please!?
dialogsDecline.fr: Oui, je sais que ce ne sont pas tes affaires... Mais donne-moi un coup de main s'il te plaît.
dialogsDecline.id: Dengar, aku tahu itu bukan urusanmu. Maukah kamu membantuku? Aku mohon!?
dialogsDecline.it: Look, I know it's none of your business. Will you help me anyway? Please!?
dialogsDecline.jp: 所詮、他人事ってことですか…。わかりました。しかし私は、本当に台本を持っていないのです。残念ながら。
dialogsDecline.kr: 그래요, 남의 일에 끼어들긴 싫겠지만… 이번만 도와주실 수 있나요? 제발요!
dialogsDecline.nl: Look, I know it's none of your business. Will you help me anyway? Please!?
dialogsDecline.pl: Look, I know it's none of your business. Will you help me anyway? Please!?
dialogsDecline.ru: Я понимаю, что тебе нет до меня никакого дела. Но, может, все-таки поможешь?
dialogsDecline.sp: Mira, ya sé que no es asunto tuyo. ¿Pero me ayudarás igualmente? ¿¡Por favor!?
dialogsDecline.sw: Look, I know it's none of your business. Will you help me anyway? Please!?
dialogsDecline.th: ฟังนะ ฉันรู้ว่านี่ไม่ใช่เรื่องของคุณ คุณจะช่วยฉันได้หรือไม่? ได้โปรด!?
dialogsDecline.tw: 沒必要去管其他人的事啦！不是嗎？好啦！你先來救救我啦！
dialogsDecline.vi: Này, tôi biết đó không phải việc của bạn. Dù gì bạn cũng sẽ giúp tôi chứ? Làm ơn mà!?

dialogsComplete.en: Oh thank goodness! Finally I got it back! Thank you so very much!
dialogsComplete.ar: Oh thank goodness! Finally I got it back! Thank you so very much!
dialogsComplete.br: Obrigado, obrigado... Finalmente o recuperei. Muito obrigado...
dialogsComplete.cns: 真的..感谢你..感谢你..终于找回来了，在晚一步我话，我就..呜呜
dialogsComplete.de: (weint) ..danke, danke, ..
dialogsComplete.fi: Oh thank goodness! Finally I got it back! Thank you so very much!
dialogsComplete.fil: Oh thank goodness! Finally I got it back! Thank you so very much!
dialogsComplete.fr: (Pleurant) Merci, merci...tu l'as finalement retrouvée. Merci du fond du cœur...
dialogsComplete.id: Oh syukurlah! Akhirnya aku mendapatkannya kembali! Terima kasih banyak!
dialogsComplete.it: Oh thank goodness! Finally I got it back! Thank you so very much!
dialogsComplete.jp: こ、これは！ありがとう、ありがとう！たしかにこの台本です！ちゃんと探してきてくれたんだね。
dialogsComplete.kr: 아, 정말 다행이에요! 드디어 되찾았어요! 정말 정말 감사해요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Oh thank goodness! Finally I got it back! Thank you so very much!
dialogsComplete.pl: Oh thank goodness! Finally I got it back! Thank you so very much!
dialogsComplete.ru: Хвала Лучик! Огромное спасибо!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Oh, gracias a Dios! ¡Al fin lo recuperé! ¡Muchas gracias!
dialogsComplete.sw: Oh thank goodness! Finally I got it back! Thank you so very much!
dialogsComplete.th: โอ้ ขอบคุณพระเจ้า! ในที่สุดฉันก็ได้มันกลับคืนมา! ขอบคุณมาก!
dialogsComplete.tw: 真的…感謝你…感謝你…終於找回來了，在晚一步我話，我就…嗚嗚
dialogsComplete.vi: Ôi, cảm ơn trời đất! Cuối cùng thì tôi cũng lấy lại được! Cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều!

dialogsComplete.en: If you would have been 5 minutes longer, I would have been fired. Whew! That was a close one!
dialogsComplete.ar: If you would have been 5 minutes longer, I would have been fired. Whew! That was a close one!
dialogsComplete.br: Se você tivesse demorado mais um pouco eu teria sido despedido. Essa foi por pouco!
dialogsComplete.cns: 再晚一步的话，我就要被团长开除了，呜呜..
dialogsComplete.de: Wärst du später gekommen, hätte jeder von meiner Entlassung gewusst.
dialogsComplete.fi: If you would have been 5 minutes longer, I would have been fired. Whew! That was a close one!
dialogsComplete.fil: If you would have been 5 minutes longer, I would have been fired. Whew! That was a close one!
dialogsComplete.fr: Si tu étais revenu un peu plus tard, la nouvelle se serait répandue et j'aurai été renvoyé.

dialogsComplete.it: If you would have been 5 minutes longer, I would have been fired. Whew! That was a close one!
dialogsComplete.jp: もう少し時間が経っていたら、団長に知られてしまうところだった。もしそうなったら・・・きっとボクは劇団を追い出されたと思うんだ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 5분만 더 늦었어도 해고당했을 거예요. 휴… 아슬아슬했네요!
dialogsComplete.nl: If you would have been 5 minutes longer, I would have been fired. Whew! That was a close one!
dialogsComplete.pl: If you would have been 5 minutes longer, I would have been fired. Whew! That was a close one!
dialogsComplete.ru: Еще пять минут - и директор труппы меня бы уволил. Уф! Как гора с плеч.

dialogsComplete.sw: If you would have been 5 minutes longer, I would have been fired. Whew! That was a close one!
dialogsComplete.th: ถ้าคุณมาช้ากว่านี้สักห้านาที ฉันคงโดนไล่ออกไปแล้ว เฮ่อ! เกือบไปเลยนะนั่น!
dialogsComplete.tw: 如果你再晚 5 分鐘，我就要被開除了。呼！真是好險！
dialogsComplete.vi: Chỉ cần chậm 5 phút nữa thôi, tôi đã bị sa thải rồi. Chà! Hú hồn!

dialogsComplete.en: I have a gift for you for helping me out. Please, take it.

dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi có một món quà cho bạn vì đã giúp tôi. Hãy nhận lấy nó.

dialogsBegin.en: You can warp away from here at the Warp Zone but you need the Key. Are you ready to earn it?
dialogsBegin.ar: You can warp away from here at the Warp Zone but you need the Key. Are you ready to earn it?
dialogsBegin.br: É possível sair daqui pela Zona de Escape, mas você precisará da chave. Você está pronto(a) para recebê-la?
dialogsBegin.cns: 有钥匙的话可以在路两边的尽头传送出岛，你准备好去获取钥匙了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Du kannst diesen Ort über die Warp Zone verlassen. Du brauchst jedoch den Schlüssel. Bist du bereit, ihn dir zu verdienen?
dialogsBegin.fi: You can warp away from here at the Warp Zone but you need the Key. Are you ready to earn it?
dialogsBegin.fil: Makakawarp ka paalis dito sa Warp Zone ngunit kailangan mo ng susi. Handa kaba pagtrabahuhan ito?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu bisa berbelok dari sini di Warp Zone tapi kamu membutuhkan kunci. Kamu siap untuk mendapatkannya?
dialogsBegin.it: Puoi andartene da qui verso la Zona Warp ma hai bisogno della chiave. Sei pronto a guadagnartela?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 워프 존을 통해 여기서 탈출할 수 있지만, 그러려면 열쇠가 필요해요. 열쇠를 얻을 준비, 되셨나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: You can warp away from here at the Warp Zone but you need the Key. Are you ready to earn it?
dialogsBegin.pl: Możesz się teleportować stąd ze Strefy Teleportacji, ale potrzebujesz Klucza. Czy jesteś gotów go zdobyć?
dialogsBegin.ru: На большую землю ведут порталы, но их не активировать без ключа. Хочешь заработать ключ?
dialogsBegin.sp: Puedes teletransportarte lejos de aquí en la Zona de Teletransporte, pero necesitas la Llave. ¿Estás listo para ganártela?
dialogsBegin.sw: You can warp away from here at the Warp Zone but you need the Key. Are you ready to earn it?
dialogsBegin.th: คุณสามารถวาร์ปออกไปจากที่นี่ได้ที่ Warp Zone แต่คุณต้องมีกุญแจ คุณพร้อมที่จะรับมันหรือไม่?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你可以在扭曲區從這裡出去，但你需要鑰匙。你準備好要贏得它了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có thể di chuyển khỏi đây tại Warp Zone nhưng bạn cần có Chìa khóa. Bạn đã sẵn sàng để kiếm được nó chưa?

dialogsAccept.en: I will give you the Key if you can bring me $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Beads of Sin. You can get the beads in the empty lot beside the campsite.
dialogsAccept.ar: I will give you the Key if you can bring me $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Beads of Sin. You can get the beads in the empty lot beside the campsite.
dialogsAccept.br: Te darei a Chave se você puder me trazer $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Pérolas do Pecado. Você poderá obter as pérolas no terreno vazio atrás da área de acampamento.
dialogsAccept.cns: 拿来$QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$解脱水晶球，我就带你离开这。你可以在营地旁边找到它。
dialogsAccept.de: Ich werde dir den Schlüssel geben, wenn du mir $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Beads of Sin bringst. Du kannst sie in dem Feld neben dem Camp sammeln.
dialogsAccept.fi: I will give you the Key if you can bring me $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Beads of Sin. You can get the beads in the empty lot beside the campsite.
dialogsAccept.fil: Handa kitang bigyan ng susi basta dalahan mo ako ng $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Beads of Sin. Makakakuha ka ng beads sa isang bakanteng lote tabi ng campsite.
dialogsAccept.fr: Trouve $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Gemmes du péché et je t'offrirai la Clé pour sortir d'ici. Tu peux trouver les Gemmes derrière le camp.
dialogsAccept.id: Aku akan memberikanmu kunci jika kamu bisa membawakan aku $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Beads of Sin. Kamu bisa mendapatkan manik-manik itu ditempat kosong disamping perkemahan.
dialogsAccept.it: Ti darò la chiave se mi porti $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Perle del peccato. Puoi prendere le perle nel posto vuoto accanto al campeggio.
dialogsAccept.jp: 罪業の珠を$QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$個持ってきていただければ鍵を差し上げます。このキャンプ場付近で見つかるはずですよ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 죄의 구슬 $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$개를 가져오면 열쇠를 드리겠습니다. 구슬은 야영지 옆 공터에서 얻을 수 있어요.
dialogsAccept.nl: I will give you the Key if you can bring me $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Beads of Sin. You can get the beads in the empty lot beside the campsite.
dialogsAccept.pl: Dam ci Klucz, jeśli przyniesiesz mi $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Beads of Sin. Koraliki możesz zdobyć na pustej parceli obok kempingu.
dialogsAccept.ru: Я дам тебе ключ в обмен на $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ бус греха. Ищи бусы на пустыре за лагерем.
dialogsAccept.sp: Te daré la Llave si me traes $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Perlas del Pecado. Puedes conseguir las perlas en el terreno vacío al lado del campamento.
dialogsAccept.sw: I will give you the Key if you can bring me $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Beads of Sin. You can get the beads in the empty lot beside the campsite.
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันจะให้กุญแจคุณ ถ้าคุณนำ Beads of Sin มา $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ คุณจะหา Beads of Sin ได้ในพื้นที่ว่างข้างแคมป์
dialogsAccept.tw: 如果你能給我帶來 $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ 解脫罪過的晶球，我將會給你鑰匙。你可在露營地旁邊的空地上獲得晶球。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi sẽ đưa cho bạn Chìa khóa nếu bạn có thể mang lại cho tôi $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Hạt tội lỗi. Bạn có thể lấy các hạt ở bãi đất trống bên cạnh khu cắm trại.

dialogsDecline.en: You are welcome to stay for as long as you would like.
dialogsDecline.ar: You are welcome to stay for as long as you would like.
dialogsDecline.br: Você é bem-vindo(a) a permanecer o tempo que desejar.
dialogsDecline.cns: 难道你这么喜欢这个岛屿吗?那~你就继续留下来吧!
dialogsDecline.de: Du darfst uns Gesellschaft leisten so lange du möchtest.
dialogsDecline.fi: You are welcome to stay for as long as you would like.
dialogsDecline.fil: Pwede ka manatili kahit gano pa katagal ang gusto mo.
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu peux évidemment rester sur cette île si le paysage te plaît.
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu dipersilahkan untuk tinggal selama yang kamu inginkan.
dialogsDecline.it: Sei il benvenuto per tutto il tempo che desideri.
dialogsDecline.jp: この罪深き島が気に入ったと言うのでしたら、居てもかまいませんが…。
dialogsDecline.kr: 이 섬이 좋다면 계속 머물러도 좋아.
dialogsDecline.nl: You are welcome to stay for as long as you would like.
dialogsDecline.pl: Możesz zostać tak długo, jak chcesz.
dialogsDecline.ru: Тебе тут так понравилось, что уходить не хочется?..
dialogsDecline.sp: Eres bienvenido a quedarte todo el tiempo que quieras.
dialogsDecline.sw: You are welcome to stay for as long as you would like.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณจะอยู่นานเท่าไหร่ก็ได้
dialogsDecline.tw: 難道你這麼喜歡這個島嶼嗎？那~你就繼續留下來吧！
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn có thể ở lại bao lâu tùy thích.

dialogsComplete.en: Here is the Key. Now go and never return.
dialogsComplete.ar: Here is the Key. Now go and never return.
dialogsComplete.br: Aqui está a Chave. Agora vá e não retorne nunca mais.
dialogsComplete.cns: 钥匙给你，走吧，别再让我看到你。
dialogsComplete.de: Hier hast du  den Schlüssel. Nun geh und komm niemals zurück.
dialogsComplete.fi: Here is the Key. Now go and never return.
dialogsComplete.fil: Eto ang susi. Ngayon umalis kana at wag kana bumalik.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Ini kuncinya. Sekarang pergi dan jangan kembali.
dialogsComplete.it: Ecco la Chiave. Ora vattene e non tornare mai più.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 임무를 완수 했으니 열쇠를 주겠네. 앞으로는 착하게 살게.
dialogsComplete.nl: Here is the Key. Now go and never return.
dialogsComplete.pl: Tutaj masz Klucz. Teraz idź i nigdy nie wracaj
dialogsComplete.ru: Вот ключ. Уходи - и не возвращайся!
dialogsComplete.sp: Aquí está la Llave. Ahora vete y no vuelvas.
dialogsComplete.sw: Here is the Key. Now go and never return.
dialogsComplete.th: นี่กุญแจ ทีนี้ก็ไปซะ แล้วไม่ต้องกลับมาอีกนะ
dialogsComplete.tw: 鑰匙在這裡。現在去，永遠不要回來。
dialogsComplete.vi: Đây là chìa khoá. Bây giờ đi và không bao giờ trở lại.

dialogsFail.en: I will give you your freedom for only $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ beads. How could you pass on an offer like that?
dialogsFail.ar: I will give you your freedom for only $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ beads. How could you pass on an offer like that?
dialogsFail.br: Concederei a sua liberdade por apenas $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ pérolas. Como você pode ignorar uma oferta como essa?
dialogsFail.cns: 只有拿来$QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$解脱水晶，我才会给你自由。
dialogsFail.de: Ich gebe dir deine Freiheit für nur $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Beads. Wie könnte man ein solches Angebot ausschlagen?
dialogsFail.fi: I will give you your freedom for only $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ beads. How could you pass on an offer like that?
dialogsFail.fil: Bibigyan kita ng kalayaan para sa $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ beads. Pano mo hindi tatanggapin ang usapan na yan?
dialogsFail.fr: Je peux te rendre ta liberté pour seulement $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Gemmes du Péché. Comment peux-tu ignorer une telle offre ?
dialogsFail.id: Aku akan memberikanmu kebebasan hanya untuk $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ manik-manik. Bagaimana kamu bisa memberikan tawaran seperti itu?
dialogsFail.it: Ti darò la tua libertà solo per $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ perle. Come potresti rifiutare un'offerta del genere?
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志はあるか？ならば「罪業の珠」を$QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$個集めろ。ここから脱出はさせないぞ。
dialogsFail.kr: $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$개의 구슬만 주면 자유를 드리죠. 이런 제안을 마다할 이유가 있을까요?
dialogsFail.nl: I will give you your freedom for only $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ beads. How could you pass on an offer like that?
dialogsFail.pl: Dam ci wolność za jedyne $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ beads. Jak mógłbyś przegapić taką ofertę?
dialogsFail.ru: Свобода в обмен на какие-то несчастные $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ бус… Кто же отказывается от такого предложения?..
dialogsFail.sp: Te daré tu libertad por solo $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ perlas. ¿Cómo pudiste pasar una oferta así?
dialogsFail.sw: I will give you your freedom for only $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ beads. How could you pass on an offer like that?
dialogsFail.th: ฉันจะให้อิสระคุณในราคาแค่ $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ เม็ด คุณบอกปัดข้อเสนอแบบนั้นได้งั้นเหรอ?
dialogsFail.tw: 只要 $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ 顆晶球，我就還你自由。這麼好的條件，你怎麼可能拒絕？
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi sẽ cho bạn sự tự do chỉ với $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ hạt. Làm thế nào bạn có thể chuyển một đề nghị như vậy?

dialogsBegin.en: Well, I should hurry and get dinner going. Would you please fetch Nerco for me? I'm sure if I saw him right now, I'd kick his little butt from here to Darkon!
dialogsBegin.ar: Well, I should hurry and get dinner going. Would you please fetch Nerco for me? I'm sure if I saw him right now, I'd kick his little butt from here to Darkon!
dialogsBegin.br: Bem, eu deveria me apressar e começar o jantar. Você poderia, por favor, buscar o Nerco para mim?? Tenho certeza de que se eu visse ele agora, chutaria a bundinha dele daqui até Darken!
dialogsBegin.cns: Well, I should hurry and get dinner going. Would you please fetch Nerco for me? I'm sure if I saw him right now, I'd kick his little butt from here to Darkon!
dialogsBegin.de: Nun, ich sollte mich beeilen und das Abendessen vorbereiten. Würdest du bitte Nerco für mich holen? Ich bin mir sicher, wenn ich ihn jetzt sehen würde, würde ich ihm von hier bis Darkon in den Hintern treten!
dialogsBegin.fi: Well, I should hurry and get dinner going. Would you please fetch Nerco for me? I'm sure if I saw him right now, I'd kick his little butt from here to Darkon!
dialogsBegin.fil: Well, I should hurry and get dinner going. Would you please fetch Nerco for me? I'm sure if I saw him right now, I'd kick his little butt from here to Darkon!
dialogsBegin.fr: Pendant que je prépare le repas, vous seriez gentil d'aller chercher mon garnement de fils.
dialogsBegin.id: Ah ok, aku harus bergegas menyiapkan makan malam. Bisakah tolong panggilkan Nerco?? Jika aku melihatnya sekarang, rasanya aku tak akan bisa menahan diri untuk menendangnya sampai terlempar ke Darkon!
dialogsBegin.it: Well, I should hurry and get dinner going. Would you please fetch Nerco for me? I'm sure if I saw him right now, I'd kick his little butt from here to Darkon!
dialogsBegin.jp: さあ、腕をふるって料理を作らないと。あ、そうだ。ネルコったらまだ森で遊んでいるのかしら？　よかったら料理ができるまでの間に迎えに行ってもらえませんか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 전 서둘러서 저녁을 준비해야겠네요. 혹시 네르코 좀 데려다 주실 수 있나요? 네르코가 여기 있었다면, 여기서 다콘까지 엉덩이를 걷어차 버렸을 거예요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Well, I should hurry and get dinner going. Would you please fetch Nerco for me? I'm sure if I saw him right now, I'd kick his little butt from here to Darkon!
dialogsBegin.pl: Well, I should hurry and get dinner going. Would you please fetch Nerco for me? I'm sure if I saw him right now, I'd kick his little butt from here to Darkon!
dialogsBegin.ru: Well, I should hurry and get dinner going. Would you please fetch Nerco for me? I'm sure if I saw him right now, I'd kick his little butt from here to Darkon!
dialogsBegin.sp: Bueno, debería darme prisa y preparar la cena. ¿Podrías traerme a Nerco por favor? ¡Estoy segura de que si lo viera ahora mismo, le patearía el trasero de aquí a Darkon!
dialogsBegin.sw: Well, I should hurry and get dinner going. Would you please fetch Nerco for me? I'm sure if I saw him right now, I'd kick his little butt from here to Darkon!
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันจะรีบไปกินข้าวเย็น ช่วยเรียก Nerco ให้ฉันหน่อยได้ไหม?? ฉันแน่ใจว่าถ้าฉันเห็นเขาตอนนี้ ฉันจะเตะก้นเล็กๆ ของเขาจากนี่ไปยัน Darkon!
dialogsBegin.tw: 好，我也該趕快去準備晚餐了。可以請你幫我把尼羅可找回來嗎？如果我現在看到那臭小子，我一定會一路把他踹到得肯去！
dialogsBegin.vi: Chà, tôi nên nhanh chóng đi ăn tối thôi. Bạn vui lòng tìm Nerco và mang nó đến giúp tôi được không? Tôi chắc rằng nếu tôi nhìn thấy nó ngay bây giờ, tôi sẽ cho nó một trận từ đây tới Darkon!

dialogsAccept.en: Thank you so much! I'm sure that crafty little liar is still where you last saw him!
dialogsAccept.ar: Thank you so much! I'm sure that crafty little liar is still where you last saw him!
dialogsAccept.br: Muito obrigada! Tenho certeza de que aquele mentiroso astuto ainda está onde você o viu pela última vez!
dialogsAccept.cns: 实在太感谢你了！我敢肯定那个狡猾的小骗子还在你上次见到他的地方！
dialogsAccept.de: Ich danke Ihnen vielmals! Ich bin sicher, dass der schlaue kleine Lügner immer noch da ist, wo du ihn zuletzt gesehen hast!
dialogsAccept.fi: Thank you so much! I'm sure that crafty little liar is still where you last saw him!
dialogsAccept.fil: Thank you so much! I'm sure that crafty little liar is still where you last saw him!
dialogsAccept.fr: Il doit encore être là où vous l'avez laissé.
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih banyak! Aku sangat yakin bajingan kecil itu masih ada ditempat terakhir kau melihatnya!
dialogsAccept.it: Thank you so much! I'm sure that crafty little liar is still where you last saw him!
dialogsAccept.jp: あの子のことだからずっと同じ所で遊んでいると思います。お願いしますね。
dialogsAccept.kr: 오, 정말 감사해요! 그 약삭빠른 거짓말쟁이 녀석, 분명 마지막으로 봤던 자리에 아직도 있을 거예요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Thank you so much! I'm sure that crafty little liar is still where you last saw him!
dialogsAccept.pl: Thank you so much! I'm sure that crafty little liar is still where you last saw him!
dialogsAccept.ru: Спасибо огромное! Надеюсь, этот маленький врунишка всё ещё там, где ты его встретил!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Muchas gracias! ¡Estoy segura de que ese astuto crío mentiroso todavía está donde lo viste por última vez!
dialogsAccept.sw: Thank you so much! I'm sure that crafty little liar is still where you last saw him!
dialogsAccept.th: ขอบคุณมาก! ฉันแน่ใจว่าเจ้าเล่ห์ตัวน้อยเจ้าเล่ห์ยังคงอยู่ที่ที่คุณเห็นเขาครั้งสุดท้าย!
dialogsAccept.tw: 太感謝了！我敢肯定，那個狡猾的小騙子還在你最後一次見到他的地方！
dialogsAccept.vi: Cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều! Tôi chắc rằng kẻ dối trá xảo quyệt vẫn ở nơi lần cuối cùng bạn nhìn thấy hắn!

dialogsDecline.en: Well, looks like someone is going to bed on an empty stomach then!
dialogsDecline.ar: Well, looks like someone is going to bed on an empty stomach then!
dialogsDecline.br: Bem, parece que alguém vai dormir com o estômago vazio então!
dialogsDecline.cns: 看起来有人得饿着肚子睡觉了！
dialogsDecline.de: Sieht so aus, als würde jemand mit leerem Magen ins Bett gehen!
dialogsDecline.fi: Well, looks like someone is going to bed on an empty stomach then!
dialogsDecline.fil: Well, looks like someone is going to bed on an empty stomach then!
dialogsDecline.fr: On ne va quand même pas manger sans lui !
dialogsDecline.id: Rasanya akan ada seseorang yang pergi tidur dengan perut kosong nanti!
dialogsDecline.it: Well, looks like someone is going to bed on an empty stomach then!
dialogsDecline.jp: まさか、うちの子を放っておくわけではありませんよね？
dialogsDecline.kr: 저녁도 못 먹고 굶주린 배로 자고 싶은 것인지 원!
dialogsDecline.nl: Well, looks like someone is going to bed on an empty stomach then!
dialogsDecline.pl: Well, looks like someone is going to bed on an empty stomach then!
dialogsDecline.ru: Well, looks like someone is going to bed on an empty stomach then!
dialogsDecline.sp: Bueno, ¡pues parece que alguien se va a la cama con el estómago vacío!
dialogsDecline.sw: Well, looks like someone is going to bed on an empty stomach then!
dialogsDecline.th: ดูเหมือนว่ามีคนกำลังจะเข้านอนในขณะท้องว่าง!
dialogsDecline.tw: 好吧，看來有人要空腹睡覺了！
dialogsDecline.vi: Chà, có vẻ như ai đó sẽ đi ngủ khi bụng đói!

dialogsComplete.en: You again? I said I would be home soon enough! Don't tell me my mother sent you!?
dialogsComplete.ar: You again? I said I would be home soon enough! Don't tell me my mother sent you!?
dialogsComplete.br: Você de novo?? Eu disse que logo estaria em casa! Não me diga que minha mãe mandou você vir me buscar!? Ai ai..
dialogsComplete.cns: You again? I said I would be home soon enough! Don't tell me my mother sent you!?
dialogsComplete.de: Du schon wieder? Ich sagte, ich würde früh genug nach Hause kommen! Sag mir nicht, dass meine Mutter dich geschickt hat!?
dialogsComplete.fi: You again? I said I would be home soon enough! Don't tell me my mother sent you!?
dialogsComplete.fil: You again? I said I would be home soon enough! Don't tell me my mother sent you!?
dialogsComplete.fr: Encore vous ? Ma mère est très fâchée ?
dialogsComplete.id: Kau lagi? Aku bilang aku akan segera pulang! Jangan bilang ibuku mengirimmu!?
dialogsComplete.it: You again? I said I would be home soon enough! Don't tell me my mother sent you!?
dialogsComplete.jp: お、ちょうどよかった！　みてくれよ！　ついに鬼の子を倒したんだよ！
dialogsComplete.kr: 또 당신인가요? 곧 집에 가겠다고 했잖아요! 혹시 우리 어머니의 부탁을 받고 온 건가요?
dialogsComplete.nl: You again? I said I would be home soon enough! Don't tell me my mother sent you!?
dialogsComplete.pl: You again? I said I would be home soon enough! Don't tell me my mother sent you!?
dialogsComplete.ru: You again? I said I would be home soon enough! Don't tell me my mother sent you!?
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿¿Tú otra vez?? ¡Ya te he dicho que llegaría a casa pronto! ¡¿No me digas que te ha enviado mi madre?!
dialogsComplete.sw: You again? I said I would be home soon enough! Don't tell me my mother sent you!?
dialogsComplete.th: อีกแล้วเหรอ?? ฉันบอกว่าฉันจะกลับบ้านเร็ว ๆ นี้แหละ! ยะ..อย่าบอกนะว่าแม่ส่งมา!?
dialogsComplete.tw: 又是你？我不是說我很快就會回去了嗎！別跟我說是我媽派你來的！？
dialogsComplete.vi: Lại là bạn à? Tôi đã nói tôi sẽ về nhà sớm thôi! Đừng nói với tôi là mẹ tôi đã nhắn bạn đến nhé!?

dialogsFail.en: Please go tell Nerco to come home for dinner!
dialogsFail.ar: Please go tell Nerco to come home for dinner!
dialogsFail.br: Por favor, diga ao Nerco para vir para casa jantar!
dialogsFail.cns: 请去叫尼尔科回家吃晚饭！
dialogsFail.de: Bitte sagen Sie Nerco, dass er zum Abendessen nach Hause kommen soll!
dialogsFail.fi: Please go tell Nerco to come home for dinner!
dialogsFail.fil: Please go tell Nerco to come home for dinner!
dialogsFail.fr: Dites à Nerco de venir manger.
dialogsFail.id: Tolong beritahu Nerco untuk pulang makan malam!
dialogsFail.it: Please go tell Nerco to come home for dinner!
dialogsFail.jp: ネルコに早く帰ってくるよう伝えて下さいね。
dialogsFail.kr: 네르코에게 저녁 먹으러 오라고 좀 전해주세요!
dialogsFail.nl: Please go tell Nerco to come home for dinner!
dialogsFail.pl: Please go tell Nerco to come home for dinner!
dialogsFail.ru: Please go tell Nerco to come home for dinner!
dialogsFail.sp: ¡Por favor, dile a Nerco que venga a casa a cenar!
dialogsFail.sw: Please go tell Nerco to come home for dinner!
dialogsFail.th: ไปบอก Nerco ให้กลับบ้านไปกินข้าวกันเถอะ!
dialogsFail.tw: 請去告訴尼羅可回家吃飯！
dialogsFail.vi: Hãy bảo Nerco về nhà ăn tối!

name.th: ตุ๊กตาของ Mia

description.en: Speak with JeongHwa in Saint City.
description.ar: Speak with JeongHwa in Saint City.
description.br: JeongHwa tinha uma filha chamada Jinyoung. Ela amava muito sua boneca. Talvez eu possa convencer JeongHwan se eu puder encontrar a sua boneca entre as Mias.
description.cns: 去晨光找吉哈娃对话。
description.de: Sprech mit Natalie in Saint Morning.
description.fi: Speak with JeongHwa in Saint City.
description.fil: Speak with JeongHwa in Saint City.
description.fr: Junghwa avait une fille nommée Jinyoung. Elle aimait beaucoup sa peluche apparemment. Je pourrai convaincre Junghwa avec cette peluche peut-être.
description.id: Bicaralah dengan JeongHwa di Saint City.
description.it: Speak with JeongHwa in Saint City.
description.jp: ジョハさんの娘ジノは人形が好きで、いつも大事に持ち歩いていたそうだ。もう一度＜ミーア＞を探してジノの人形を見つけたら、ジョハさんに渡しにいこう。
description.nl: Speak with JeongHwa in Saint City.
description.pl: Speak with JeongHwa in Saint City.
description.ru: Нужно поговорить с Ингой в Санто.
description.sp: Habla con JeongHwa en Saint.
description.sw: Speak with JeongHwa in Saint City.
description.th: คุยกับ JeongHwa ใน Saint City
description.tw: 向聖音特市的真華對話。
description.vi: Nói chuyện với JeongHwa ở Saint City.

dialogsBegin.en: What? It worked? What do you have there? Oh my… then this means… That's horrible!
dialogsBegin.ar: What? It worked? What do you have there? Oh my… then this means… That's horrible!
dialogsBegin.br: Que? Funcionou? O que você tem aí? Ai meu Deus... então isso significa... Isso é horrível!
dialogsBegin.cns: 嗯..对!就是这个。米儿就是那些失踪的孩子们。
dialogsBegin.de: Was? Es hat funktioniert? Was hast du denn da? Oh je... dann bedeutet das... Das ist ja furchtbar!
dialogsBegin.fi: What? It worked? What do you have there? Oh my… then this means… That's horrible!
dialogsBegin.fil: What? It worked? What do you have there? Oh my… then this means… That's horrible!
dialogsBegin.fr: Hmm.. C'est bien ça? (Verifie un peu). Oui, c'est ça! C'est ce que je pensais! Les Mias sont les petites-filles disparues!
dialogsBegin.id: Apa? Itu berhasil? Apa yang kamu miliki di sana? Ya ampun… kalau begitu ini berarti… Itu mengerikan!
dialogsBegin.it: What? It worked? What do you have there? Oh my… then this means… That's horrible!
dialogsBegin.jp: ふむ！なるほど！そうだ、これだぞ。ミーアの正体は、行方不明になった女の子たちだったんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 뭐라고요? 정말요? 그건 뭐죠? 세상에나! 그렇다면 이건… 너무 끔찍하네요!
dialogsBegin.nl: What? It worked? What do you have there? Oh my… then this means… That's horrible!
dialogsBegin.pl: What? It worked? What do you have there? Oh my… then this means… That's horrible!
dialogsBegin.ru: What? It worked? What do you have there? Oh my… then this means… That's horrible!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Qué? ¿Funcionó? ¿Qué tienes ahí? Oh… esto significa que… ¡Eso es horrible!
dialogsBegin.sw: What? It worked? What do you have there? Oh my… then this means… That's horrible!
dialogsBegin.th: อะไรนะ? มันใช้ได้เหรอ? คุณมาทำอะไรที่นี่? โอ้ ไม่... งั้นก็หมายความว่า... นั่นมันน่ากลัวจัง!
dialogsBegin.tw: 什麼？可以了？你有什麼？哦，我的……那麼這意味著……太可怕了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Gì? Nó đã hoạt động? Bạn có gì ở đó? Ôi trời… thì điều này có nghĩa là… Thật kinh khủng!

dialogsBegin.en: Thank you very much for bringing this to me, adventurer. I need to tell JeongHwa right away.
dialogsBegin.ar: Thank you very much for bringing this to me, adventurer. I need to tell JeongHwa right away.
dialogsBegin.br: Muito obrigado por trazer isso para mim, aventureiro(a). Eu preciso informar a JeongHwa imediatamente.
dialogsBegin.cns: 冒险者，非常感谢你把它带过来。我马上就告诉吉哈娃。
dialogsBegin.de: Wie können sie dieses Geheimnis bewahren.. (untersucht es aufmerksamer) Oh, ich vergaß fast Natalie hiervon zu erzählen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Thank you very much for bringing this to me, adventurer. I need to tell JeongHwa right away.
dialogsBegin.fil: Thank you very much for bringing this to me, adventurer. I need to tell JeongHwa right away.
dialogsBegin.fr: Comment ont-ils pu garder ce secret.. (Regardant plus attentivement). Oh, j'allais oublier de raconter ça à Junghwa.
dialogsBegin.id: Terima kasih banyak telah membawakan ini padaku, adventurer. Aku harus memberitahu JeongHwa segera.
dialogsBegin.it: Thank you very much for bringing this to me, adventurer. I need to tell JeongHwa right away.
dialogsBegin.jp: こんな事実を知っていて、隠そうとしていたとはな。あのかわいそうなジョハさんに、この事実を知らせてあげないと。
dialogsBegin.kr: 정말 감사합니다, 모험가님. 정화에게 알려 줘야겠어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Thank you very much for bringing this to me, adventurer. I need to tell JeongHwa right away.
dialogsBegin.pl: Thank you very much for bringing this to me, adventurer. I need to tell JeongHwa right away.
dialogsBegin.ru: Спасибо тебе за помощь! Нужно рассказать Инге, что стало с ее дочерью…
dialogsBegin.sp: Muchas gracias por traerme esto, aventurero. Necesito decírselo a JeongHwa de inmediato.
dialogsBegin.sw: Thank you very much for bringing this to me, adventurer. I need to tell JeongHwa right away.
dialogsBegin.th: ขอบคุณมากนะนักผจญภัยที่นำสิ่งนี้มาให้กับฉัน ฉันต้องไปบอก JeongHwa ทันที
dialogsBegin.tw: 謝謝你把這個帶給我，冒險者，我要立刻把這件事情告訴真華。
dialogsBegin.vi: Cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều vì đã mang điều này đến với tôi, nhà thám hiểm. Tôi cần nói với JeongHwa ngay lập tức.

dialogsBegin.en: Wait a minute, she's not going to believe me unless I have some proof. Where can I get some proof? Yes… That's it!
dialogsBegin.ar: Wait a minute, she's not going to believe me unless I have some proof. Where can I get some proof? Yes… That's it!
dialogsBegin.br: Espere um pouco, ela não vai acreditar em mim a menos que eu tenha alguma prova… Hmm… Como posso conseguir uma prova? … Sim… É isso!
dialogsBegin.cns: 可是只有这个东西的话，她应该不会相信我说的，如果米儿里面有真华松的孩子的话，
dialogsBegin.de: Moment mal, sie wird mir nicht glauben, wenn ich keinen Beweis habe. Wo kann ich einen Beweis finden? Ja... Das ist es!
dialogsBegin.fi: Wait a minute, she's not going to believe me unless I have some proof. Where can I get some proof? Yes… That's it!
dialogsBegin.fil: Wait a minute, she's not going to believe me unless I have some proof. Where can I get some proof? Yes… That's it!
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais elle ne me croira pas avec cette seule preuve..(Réfléchissant) Hmm.. Hmm.. Aha! Si sa fille était parmi les Mias.
dialogsBegin.id: Tunggu sebentar, dia tidak akan percaya padaku kecuali aku punya bukti. Di mana saya bisa mendapatkan beberapa bukti? Ya… Itu dia!
dialogsBegin.it: Wait a minute, she's not going to believe me unless I have some proof. Where can I get some proof? Yes… That's it!
dialogsBegin.jp: しかし、この調査書だけでは彼女も信じないだろう。もし彷徨うミーアの中にジョハさんの娘が見つかれば、そのミーアはきっと人間だった時に大事にしていた物を、今も大事に持っているはず。
dialogsBegin.kr: 잠깐만요, 정화는 증거가 없으면 믿지 않을 거예요. 어디서 증거를 구할 수 있을까… 아, 그래! 그거면 돼요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Wait a minute, she's not going to believe me unless I have some proof. Where can I get some proof? Yes… That's it!
dialogsBegin.pl: Wait a minute, she's not going to believe me unless I have some proof. Where can I get some proof? Yes… That's it!
dialogsBegin.ru: Wait a minute, she's not going to believe me unless I have some proof. Where can I get some proof? Yes… That's it!
dialogsBegin.sp: Espera un minuto, no me va a creer a menos que tenga alguna prueba. ¿Dónde puedo conseguir alguna prueba? Sí... ¡Ya lo tengo!
dialogsBegin.sw: Wait a minute, she's not going to believe me unless I have some proof. Where can I get some proof? Yes… That's it!
dialogsBegin.th: รอสักครู่นะ เธอคงจะไม่เชื่อฉัน เว้นแต่ฉันมีหลักฐานบางอย่าง ฉันจะหาหลักฐานอะไรได้บ้าง? ใช่... นั่นแหละ!
dialogsBegin.tw: 等一下，除非我有證據，否則她不會相信我的。我在哪裡可以得到一些證據？對，就是那樣！
dialogsBegin.vi: Chờ một chút, cô ấy sẽ không tin tôi trừ khi tôi có một số bằng chứng. Tôi có thể lấy một số bằng chứng ở đâu? Vâng… Nó đó!

dialogsBegin.en: If her daughter is still amongst Mias, then she would still have her most prized possession. I need it in order to persuade JeongHwa. Would you bring it to me, please?
dialogsBegin.ar: If her daughter is still amongst Mias, then she would still have her most prized possession. I need it in order to persuade JeongHwa. Would you bring it to me, please?
dialogsBegin.br: Mesmo que sua filha estivesse entre as Mias, ela ainda teria seu bem mais precioso. Preciso dele para persuadir JeongHwa. Você poderia trazê-lo para mim, por favor?
dialogsBegin.cns: 如果它的女儿还是找不着，那么她仍将非常珍贵。我需要它来说服吉哈娃，你可以把它带给我吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Wenn ihre Tochter unter den Mias ist, würde sie immernoch die Sache besitzen, die sie am meisten mag. Hey, ich brauche es um Natalie zu überzeugen. Würdest du sie mir bitte bringen?
dialogsBegin.fi: If her daughter is still amongst Mias, then she would still have her most prized possession. I need it in order to persuade JeongHwa. Would you bring it to me, please?
dialogsBegin.fil: If her daughter is still amongst Mias, then she would still have her most prized possession. I need it in order to persuade JeongHwa. Would you bring it to me, please?
dialogsBegin.fr: Si sa fille est toujours avec les Mias, elle aura toujours l'objet qu'elle aimait le plus. J'en ai besoin pour convaincre Junghwa. Pourras-tu me le ramener?
dialogsBegin.id: Jika putrinya masih berada di antara Mias, maka dia akan tetap memiliki miliknya yang paling berharga. Aku membutuhkannya untuk membujuk JeongHwa. Maukah kamu membawanya kepada saya, tolong?
dialogsBegin.it: If her daughter is still amongst Mias, then she would still have her most prized possession. I need it in order to persuade JeongHwa. Would you bring it to me, please?
dialogsBegin.jp: ジョハさんに事実を伝えて説得するためには、それが必要だ。すまんが、もう一度ミーアを捜して証拠を持ってきてくれないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 진영이 미아인 채 남아있다면, 분명 가장 아끼던 물건을 가지고 있을 거예요. 정화를 설득하려면 그 인형이 꼭 필요해요. 인형을 찾아 주시겠어요?
dialogsBegin.nl: If her daughter is still amongst Mias, then she would still have her most prized possession. I need it in order to persuade JeongHwa. Would you bring it to me, please?
dialogsBegin.pl: If her daughter is still amongst Mias, then she would still have her most prized possession. I need it in order to persuade JeongHwa. Would you bring it to me, please?
dialogsBegin.ru: Внешне Миа повзрослели, но разум у них как у шестилетних. Если Джин стала Миа, она наверняка по-прежнему носит с собой любимую куклу. Ты отыщешь ее?
dialogsBegin.sp: Si su hija todavía está entre las Mias, todavía tendrá su posesión más preciada. Lo necesito para persuadir a JeongHwa. ¿Me lo traes, por favor?
dialogsBegin.sw: If her daughter is still amongst Mias, then she would still have her most prized possession. I need it in order to persuade JeongHwa. Would you bring it to me, please?
dialogsBegin.th: ถ้าลูกสาวเธอยังคงอยู่ในหมู่ Mias งั้นเธอก็ยังมีสมบัติที่แสนล้ำค่าอยู่ล่ะ ฉันต้องการมันเพื่อเกลี้ยกล่อม JeongHwa คุณจะนำมันมาให้ฉันได้ไหม ได้โปรดเถอะนะ?
dialogsBegin.tw: 如果她的女兒還在米兒其中的話，那麼她仍然擁有她最心愛的寶貝。我需要用它來說服真華，請把它帶來給我好嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Nếu con gái của cô ấy ẫn còn ở trong các Mias, thì cô ấy sẽ vẫn có vật sở hữu quý giá nhất của mình. Tôi cần nó để thuyết phục JeongHwa. Bạn có thể mang nó cho tôi, làm ơn?

dialogsAccept.en: JeongHwa had a daughter whose name was Jinyoung. Jinyoung loved her doll very much. Perhaps I can convince JeongHwa if I can find her doll amongst the Mias...
dialogsAccept.ar: JeongHwa had a daughter whose name was Jinyoung. Jinyoung loved her doll very much. Perhaps I can convince JeongHwa if I can find her doll amongst the Mias...
dialogsAccept.br: JeongHwa tinha uma filha chamada Jinyoung. Ela amava muito sua boneca. Talvez eu possa convencer JeongHwa se eu puder encontrar a sua boneca entre as Mias.
dialogsAccept.cns: 吉哈娃的女儿叫真英。她非常喜欢娃娃，如果我能在米娅娃娃那找到她女儿的玩具，说不定我就能说服吉哈娃了。
dialogsAccept.de: Natalie hatte eine Tochter, deren Name Jinyoung war. Sie mochte ihre Puppe sehr, wie ich hörte. Ich kann Natalie mit der Puppe überzeugen, denk ich.
dialogsAccept.fi: JeongHwa had a daughter whose name was Jinyoung. Jinyoung loved her doll very much. Perhaps I can convince JeongHwa if I can find her doll amongst the Mias...
dialogsAccept.fil: JeongHwa had a daughter whose name was Jinyoung. Jinyoung loved her doll very much. Perhaps I can convince JeongHwa if I can find her doll amongst the Mias...
dialogsAccept.fr: Junghwa avait une fille nommée Jinyoung. Elle aimait beaucoup sa peluche apparemment. Je pourrai convaincre Junghwa avec cette peluche peut-être.
dialogsAccept.id: JeongHwa memiliki seorang putri bernama Jinyoung. Jinyoung sangat menyukai bonekanya. Mungkin aku bisa meyakinkan JeongHwa jika aku bisa menemukan bonekanya di antara para Mia...
dialogsAccept.it: JeongHwa had a daughter whose name was Jinyoung. Jinyoung loved her doll very much. Perhaps I can convince JeongHwa if I can find her doll amongst the Mias...
dialogsAccept.jp: ジョハさんには、ジノという娘がいた。聞いたところでは人形が好きでいつも大事に持ち歩いていたそうだ。その人形を見ればきっと、ジョハさんもこの話を信じてくれるだろう。
dialogsAccept.kr: 정화에게는 진영이라는 딸이 있었어요. 그 애는 자기 인형을 정말 아꼈죠. 혹시 미아 사이에서 그 인형을 찾을 수 있다면, 정화를 설득할 수 있을지도 몰라요...
dialogsAccept.nl: JeongHwa had a daughter whose name was Jinyoung. Jinyoung loved her doll very much. Perhaps I can convince JeongHwa if I can find her doll amongst the Mias...
dialogsAccept.pl: JeongHwa had a daughter whose name was Jinyoung. Jinyoung loved her doll very much. Perhaps I can convince JeongHwa if I can find her doll amongst the Mias...
dialogsAccept.ru: Постарайся найти среди Миа ту, которую когда-то звали Джин, и забери у нее куклу. Мы покажем ее Инге, и тогда она поверит…
dialogsAccept.sp: JeongHwa tenía una hija cuyo nombre era Jinyoung. A Jinyoung le encantaba su muñeca. Tal vez pueda convencer a JeongHwa si encuentro su muñeca entre las Mias...
dialogsAccept.sw: JeongHwa had a daughter whose name was Jinyoung. Jinyoung loved her doll very much. Perhaps I can convince JeongHwa if I can find her doll amongst the Mias...
dialogsAccept.th: JeongHwa มีลูกสาวชื่อ Jinyoung แกรักตุ๊กตาของแกมาก บางทีฉันสามารถโน้มน้าว JeongHwa ได้ ถ้าฉันสามารถหาตุ๊กตาของเธอใน Mias...
dialogsAccept.tw: 真華有個女兒叫做真英，我記得她很喜歡她的娃娃。如果能在米兒那裡找到娃娃的話，也許我可以說服真華。
dialogsAccept.vi: JeongHwa có một cô con gái tên là Jinyoung. Jinyoung yêu búp bê của cô ấy rất nhiều. Có lẽ tôi có thể thuyết phục JeongHwa rằng tôi có thể tìm thấy con búp bê của cô ấy trong số các Mias ...

dialogsDecline.en: You must not know what it is like to lose a child. JeongHwa may never know the truth about her daughter.
dialogsDecline.ar: You must not know what it is like to lose a child. JeongHwa may never know the truth about her daughter.
dialogsDecline.br: Você não deve saber o que é perder um filho. JeongHwa pode nunca saber a verdade sobre sua filha. Pense cuidadosamente a respeito disso.
dialogsDecline.cns: 你肯定不会知道失去一个孩子到底是什么感觉。吉哈娃也许永远不会知道她女儿的真相。
dialogsDecline.de: Du weißt wohl nicht, wie es ist, ein Kind zu verlieren. Natalie wird vielleicht nie die Wahrheit über ihre Tochter erfahren.
dialogsDecline.fi: Sinun ei tarvitse tietää, millaista on menettää lapsi. JeongHwa ei ehkä koskaan tiedä totuutta tyttärestään.
dialogsDecline.fil: You must not know what it is like to lose a child. JeongHwa may never know the truth about her daughter.
dialogsDecline.fr: Hé, si tu ne m'aides pas, Junghwa risque de mourir de tristesse. Comme ce serait triste! Réfléchis bien à ça.
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu pasti tidak tahu bagaimana rasanya kehilangan seorang anak. JeongHwa mungkin tidak pernah tahu kebenaran tentang putrinya.
dialogsDecline.it: You must not know what it is like to lose a child. JeongHwa may never know the truth about her daughter.
dialogsDecline.jp: あなたは子供を失う悲しみを知りませんね。 ジョンファは娘の真実を知らないかもしれません。
dialogsDecline.kr: 아이를 잃는다는 게 어떤 기분인지, 모르시겠죠. 정화는 평생 딸이 어떻게 됐는지 모른 채 살아가야 할 수도 있어요.
dialogsDecline.nl: You must not know what it is like to lose a child. JeongHwa may never know the truth about her daughter.
dialogsDecline.pl: You must not know what it is like to lose a child. JeongHwa may never know the truth about her daughter.
dialogsDecline.ru: Знаешь, как это страшно - потерять ребенка?! Неужели Инга так и не узнает правду?..
dialogsDecline.sp: No sabes lo que es perder a una hija. Es posible que JeongHwa nunca sepa la verdad sobre su hija.
dialogsDecline.sw: You must not know what it is like to lose a child. JeongHwa may never know the truth about her daughter.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณต้องรู้ว่าการสูยเสียลูกไปมันรู้สึกอย่างไร JeongHwa อาจไม่เคยรู้จักความจริงเกี่ยวกับลูกสาวของเธอก็ได้
dialogsDecline.tw: 你一定不知道失去孩子那是什麼樣的感覺。真華可能永遠都不知道關於她女兒的真相。
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn không được biết cảm giác mất con là như thế nào. JeongHwa có lẽ không bao giờ biết sự thật về con gái mình.

dialogsComplete.en: What… do you have there? My daughter's doll? My poor, sweet Jinyoung. Now I can begin to mourn. Thank you, young one. For bringing this to me.
dialogsComplete.ar: What… do you have there? My daughter's doll? My poor, sweet Jinyoung. Now I can begin to mourn. Thank you, young one. For bringing this to me.
dialogsComplete.br: Espere... o que você tem aí?... esta boneca... definitivamente é a boneca da minha filha... Oh, minha pobre Jinyoung. Agora posso começar a chorar. Obrigado, jovem. Por trazer isso para mim.
dialogsComplete.cns: 这..是我女儿的娃娃..我的真英..
dialogsComplete.de: Was... hast du da? Die Puppe meiner Tochter? Meine arme, süße Jinyoung. Jetzt kann ich endlich trauern. Ich danke dir mein Junge, dass du mir das gebracht hast.
dialogsComplete.fi: What… do you have there? My daughter's doll? My poor, sweet Jinyoung. Now I can begin to mourn. Thank you, young one. For bringing this to me.
dialogsComplete.fil: What… do you have there? My daughter's doll? My poor, sweet Jinyoung. Now I can begin to mourn. Thank you, young one. For bringing this to me.
dialogsComplete.fr: (commençant à pleurer en voyant la peluche). C'est.. C'est bien la peluche de ma fille.. Oh, ma pauvre Jinyoung.. (Pleurant).
dialogsComplete.id: Apa… ada di sana? Boneka putriku? Jinyoungku yang malang dan manis. Sekarang saya bisa mulai berduka. Terima kasih, anak muda. Untuk membawa ini padaku.
dialogsComplete.it: What… do you have there? My daughter's doll? My poor, sweet Jinyoung. Now I can begin to mourn. Thank you, young one. For bringing this to me.
dialogsComplete.jp: あっ！こ、この人形は、私の娘がとても大事にしていたものです、間違いありません！ジノ！どうしてこれを？
dialogsComplete.kr: 그… 그게 뭐죠? 딸의 인형인가요? 불쌍한 우리 딸… 이제 아이를 애도할 수 있겠어요. 인형을 가져다주어 고마워요, 젊은이.
dialogsComplete.nl: What… do you have there? My daughter's doll? My poor, sweet Jinyoung. Now I can begin to mourn. Thank you, young one. For bringing this to me.
dialogsComplete.pl: What… do you have there? My daughter's doll? My poor, sweet Jinyoung. Now I can begin to mourn. Thank you, young one. For bringing this to me.
dialogsComplete.ru: Что это? Это же кукла Джин! Ах, бедная моя девочка… Как же я тебя не уберегла…
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿Qué tienes ahí? ¿La muñeca de mi hija? Mi pobre y dulce Jinyoung. Ahora puedo empezar a llorar. Gracias por traerme esto, joven.
dialogsComplete.sw: What… do you have there? My daughter's doll? My poor, sweet Jinyoung. Now I can begin to mourn. Thank you, young one. For bringing this to me.
dialogsComplete.th: คุณมาทำอะไรที่นี่? ตุ๊กตาของลูกสาวฉัน? จินยองที่แสนอ่อนหวานและน่าสงสารของฉัน ตอนนี้ฉันคงเศร้าได้แล้วล่ะ ขอบคุณนะพ่อหนุ่ม สำหรับการนำสิ่งนี้มาให้ฉัน
dialogsComplete.tw: 什麼……你有嗎？我女兒的娃娃？我可憐的又可愛的真英。現在我可以開始哀悼了。謝謝你年輕人把這個帶給我。
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn có gì ở đó? Búp bê của con gái tôi? Jinyoung ngọt ngạo tội nghiệp của tôi. Bây giờ tôi có thể bắt đầu than khóc. Cảm ơn bạn trẻ. Vì đã mang điều này cho tôi.

dialogsFail.en: Have you found my daughter yet? Please don't give up! I'd give anything to see her again.
dialogsFail.ar: Have you found my daughter yet? Please don't give up! I'd give anything to see her again.
dialogsFail.br: Você já encontrou minha filha? Por favor, não desista! Eu daria tudo para vê-la novamente.
dialogsFail.cns: 还没找到我的女儿吗?她长的很可爱，应该一眼就会认出来才对啊。
dialogsFail.de: Hast du meine Tochter schon gefunden? Bitte gib nicht auf! Ich würde alles dafür geben, sie wiederzusehen.
dialogsFail.fi: Have you found my daughter yet? Please don't give up! I'd give anything to see her again.
dialogsFail.fil: Have you found my daughter yet? Please don't give up! I'd give anything to see her again.
dialogsFail.fr: Tu n'as pas encore retrouvé ma petite fille? Elle est si mignonne, si adorable, que tu la reconnaîtras tout de suite.
dialogsFail.id: Apa kamu sudah menemukan putriku? Tolong jangan menyerah! Aku akan memberikan apa saja untuk melihatnya lagi.
dialogsFail.it: Have you found my daughter yet? Please don't give up! I'd give anything to see her again.
dialogsFail.jp: 冒険者の方、まだわたしの娘は見つからないのでしょうか？本当に、本当にジノはかわいい子なのです。きっと、一目見ればすぐにわかると思います。ううっ。
dialogsFail.kr: 제 딸을 찾으셨나요? 제발 포기하지 마세요! 그 애를 다시 볼 수 있다면 뭐든지 할게요.
dialogsFail.nl: Have you found my daughter yet? Please don't give up! I'd give anything to see her again.
dialogsFail.pl: Have you found my daughter yet? Please don't give up! I'd give anything to see her again.
dialogsFail.ru: Ох, дочка моя, доченька... Пожалуйста, не сдавайся! Я отдам все на свете, лишь бы еще раз увидеть ее…
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Ya encontraste a mi hija? ¡Por favor, no te rindas! Daría cualquier cosa por volver a verla.
dialogsFail.sw: Have you found my daughter yet? Please don't give up! I'd give anything to see her again.
dialogsFail.th: คุณพบลูกสาวของฉันแล้วหรือยัง? กรุณาอย่ายอมแพ้! ฉันจะให้คุณทุกอย่างเลยเพื่อให้ได้เจอลูกสาวฉัน
dialogsFail.tw: 你找到我女兒了嗎？請不要放棄！為了再次見到她，我願意付出一切。
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn đã tìm thấy con gái của tôi chưa? Xin đừng bỏ cuộc! Tôi muốn cho đi bất cứ điều gì để gặp lại con bé.

dialogsBegin.en: A widow has asked that you collect Eronior so that she can re-make the ring of her husband. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.ar: A widow has asked that you collect Eronior so that she can re-make the ring of her husband. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.br: Uma viúva pediu que você colete Eronior para que ela possa refazer o anel de seu marido. Você poderia ajudar?
dialogsBegin.cns: 有一个流浪人，遗失了老公戒指上的一个宝石，为了制造宝石，流浪人委托了搜集制造宝石材料的“风化结晶”，您要接受委托吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Eine Witwe verlor das Relikt ihres Ehemannes welches ein Juwel an ihren Ring war. Sie bat uns Eronior zu sammeln, welches das Material des Ring Juwels war. Willst du den Auftrag annehmen?
dialogsBegin.fi: A widow has asked that you collect Eronior so that she can re-make the ring of her husband. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.fil: Isang balo ang humiling na kolektahin mo ang Eronior para muling gawin ang singsing ng kanyang asawa. Tutulungan mo ba?
dialogsBegin.fr:
Une veuve a perdu la relique de son mari, une pierre précieuse, et nous demande donc de trouver de l'Eronior, la matière première du joyau.
Acceptes-tu de lui rendre ce service ?
dialogsBegin.id: Seorang Widow memintamu untuk mengumpulkan Eronior agar dia bisa membuat kembali cincin peninggalan suaminya. Bisakah kamu membantu?
dialogsBegin.it: A widow has asked that you collect Eronior so that she can re-make the ring of her husband. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.jp: あるセレブな奥様が趣味の宝石集めをしているのですが、今度はエラニアーでネックレスを作るとの事で45個を依頼してきました。優雅でいいですねぇ。依頼を受けますか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 한 미망인이 남편의 반지를 다시 만들기 위해 에로니어를 구해 달라고 부탁했습니다. 도와주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: A widow has asked that you collect Eronior so that she can re-make the ring of her husband. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.pl: A widow has asked that you collect Eronior so that she can re-make the ring of her husband. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.ru: Так-так… 'Вдове нужен эроний, чтобы переделать кольцо покойного мужа в медальон.' Поможешь?
dialogsBegin.sp: Una viuda ha pedido Eroniors para poder rehacer el anillo de su marido. ¿Aceptas esta misión?
dialogsBegin.sw: A widow has asked that you collect Eronior so that she can re-make the ring of her husband. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.th: หญิงม่ายขอให้คุณรวบรวม Eronior เพื่อที่เธอจะได้ทำแหวนให้สามีของเธอใหม่ คุณจะช่วยไหม
dialogsBegin.tw: 有一個流浪人，遺失了老公戒指上的一個寶石，為了製造寶石，流浪人委託了蒐集製造寶石材料的『風化結晶』，你要接受委託嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Một góa phụ đã yêu cầu bạn thu thập Eronior để cô ấy có thể làm lại chiếc nhẫn của chồng mình. Bạn sẽ giúp chứ?
