description.en: Kill 15 Phantom Basques & 7 Basques and find the Bubble Trace and bring it to Bowler.
description.ar: Kill 15 Phantom Basques & 7 Basques and find the Bubble Trace and bring it to Bowler.
description.br: Mate 15 Basques Fantasmas e 7 Basques, consiga a Essência de Bubble e leve para o Bowler.
description.cns: 杀死15个轻量级巴斯克斗士和7个巴斯克斗士，并找到波布尔的踪迹后交给保罗克。
description.de: Töte 15 Phantom Basques & 7 Basques, finde Bubble Trace und bringe sie zu Bowler.
description.fi: Kill 15 Phantom Basques & 7 Basques and find the Bubble Trace and bring it to Bowler.
description.fil: Kill 15 Phantom Basques & 7 Basques and find the Bubble Trace and bring it to Bowler.
description.fr: Tuez 15 Jeunes Bask et 7 Bask et retrouvez le sceau de Rhisis.
description.id: Bunuh 15 Phantom Basques & 7 Basques dan temukan Bubble Trace dan bawa ke Bowler.
description.it: Kill 15 Phantom Basques & 7 Basques and find the Bubble Trace and bring it to Bowler.
description.jp: ファントム・バスキュー15匹、バスキュー7匹を倒せ。そして、いずれかのバスキューからリシスの痕跡を入手した後、ボウラーを訪ねよ。
description.kr: 팬텀 바스크 15마리와 바스크 7마리를 처치하고, 버블의 흔적을 찾아 정원의 오랜 지킴이인 보울상인 보울러에게 가져가라.
description.nl: Kill 15 Phantom Basques & 7 Basques and find the Bubble Trace and bring it to Bowler.
description.pl: Kill 15 Phantom Basques & 7 Basques and find the Bubble Trace and bring it to Bowler.
description.ru: Kill 15 Phantom Basques & 7 Basques and find the Bubble Trace and bring it to Bowler.
description.sp: Derrota a 15 Basques Fantasma y a 7 Basques. Encuentra el Símbolo de Bubble y llévaselo a Bowler.
description.sw: Kill 15 Phantom Basques & 7 Basques and find the Bubble Trace and bring it to Bowler.
description.th: ฆ่า 15 Phantom Basques & 7 Basques และเก็บ Bubble Trace นำไปให้ Bowler
description.tw: 殺死 15 巴斯克小砲和 7 巴斯克，找到巴布樂的痕跡並將其帶給保羅克。
description.vi: Giết 15 Phantom Basques & 7 Basques và tìm Bubble Trace và mang nó đến Bowler.

dialogsBegin.en: It's of no use… The stamp is just too damaged to gather much significant information. It did allude to the War of the Gods though…
dialogsBegin.ar: It's of no use… The stamp is just too damaged to gather much significant information. It did allude to the War of the Gods though…
dialogsBegin.br: Não adianta... O selo está muito danificado para reunir informações muito significativas. Ele faz alusão à Guerra dos Deuses embora…
dialogsBegin.cns: 这没用...这个印记被破坏得太严重了，我没法从中收集足够多的重要信息。但它确实暗指了神的战争...
dialogsBegin.de: Es ist sinnlos... Der Stempel ist einfach zu beschädigt, um viele wichtige Informationen zu erhalten. Er spielte allerdings auf den Krieg der Götter an...
dialogsBegin.fi: It's of no use… The stamp is just too damaged to gather much significant information. It did allude to the War of the Gods though…
dialogsBegin.fil: It's of no use… The stamp is just too damaged to gather much significant information. It did allude to the War of the Gods though…
dialogsBegin.fr: Raaah, j'y croyais pourtant. La raison est manquante. Par contre j'ai trouvé quelque chose d'étrange gribouillé en bas.
dialogsBegin.id: Tidak ada gunanya ... Stempelnya sudah terlalu rusak untuk mengumpulkan banyak informasi penting. Itu akan menyinggung War of the Gods...
dialogsBegin.it: It's of no use… The stamp is just too damaged to gather much significant information. It did allude to the War of the Gods though…
dialogsBegin.jp: 残念ながら奴隷の証からは全てを把握することはできませんでした。ただ、イブリスが消滅したにも関わらず、この地に新たな危機が迫っているようです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 소용없군요… 인장이 너무 상해서 중요한 정보를 알아내긴 어렵겠어요. 그래도 신들의 전쟁에 대한 암시는 남아 있었죠...
dialogsBegin.nl: It's of no use… The stamp is just too damaged to gather much significant information. It did allude to the War of the Gods though…
dialogsBegin.pl: It's of no use… The stamp is just too damaged to gather much significant information. It did allude to the War of the Gods though…
dialogsBegin.ru: It's of no use… The stamp is just too damaged to gather much significant information. It did allude to the War of the Gods though…
dialogsBegin.sp: No sirve de nada... El sello está demasiado dañado como para recopilar mucha información que sea significativa. Sin embargo, aludía a la Guerra de los Dioses...
dialogsBegin.sw: It's of no use… The stamp is just too damaged to gather much significant information. It did allude to the War of the Gods though…
dialogsBegin.th: ใช้ไม่ได้เลย ... แสตมป์เป็นเพียงความเสียหายมากเกินไปในการรวบรวมข้อมูลที่สำคัญมาก มันได้กล่าวอ้างถึงสงครามของพระเจ้า แต่ ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 沒用……印記損壞嚴重，無法收集更多重要訊息。它確實暗示了眾神之戰……
dialogsBegin.vi: Nó không có ích lợi gì… Con tem quá hư nên không thể thu thập được nhiều thông tin quan trọng. Tuy nhiên, nó ám chỉ đến Chiến tranh của các vị thần…

dialogsBegin.en: I know from lore that, during this time, Bubble decided to take action against Shade and her masquerpet army. A battle occurred between the gods at this very location.
dialogsBegin.ar: I know from lore that, during this time, Bubble decided to take action against Shade and her masquerpet army. A battle occurred between the gods at this very location.
dialogsBegin.br: Eu sei pela lenda que, durante esse tempo, Bubble decidiu agir contra Shade e seu exército de masquerpets. Uma batalha ocorreu entre os deuses neste mesmo local.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我从传说中了解到，在那段时期，波布尔决定采取行动对抗谢莉德和她的怪物军团。就在这个地方，众神之间发生了一场战斗。
dialogsBegin.de: Aus den Inschriften weiß ich, dass Bubble in dieser Zeit beschloss, gegen Shade und ihre Masquerpet Armee vorzugehen. An diesem Ort fand eine Schlacht zwischen den Göttern statt.
dialogsBegin.fi: I know from lore that, during this time, Bubble decided to take action against Shade and her masquerpet army. A battle occurred between the gods at this very location.
dialogsBegin.fil: I know from lore that, during this time, Bubble decided to take action against Shade and her masquerpet army. A battle occurred between the gods at this very location.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il semble qu'un grand malheur soit sur le point de s'abattre sur madrigal, les monstres préparent quelque chose.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya tahu dari pengetahuan bahwa, selama waktu ini, Bubble memutuskan untuk mengambil tindakan terhadap Shade dan pasukan penyamarannya. Pertempuran terjadi antara para dewa di lokasi ini.
dialogsBegin.it: I know from lore that, during this time, Bubble decided to take action against Shade and her masquerpet army. A battle occurred between the gods at this very location.
dialogsBegin.jp: 全ては神々の戦争に起因しているようです。マドリガルの不均衡はリシスとイブリスの衝突により発生しましたから。どうやら他のモンスターも調査する必要があるようですね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 전설 속에서, 이 시기 버블은 쉐이드와 그녀의 마스커펫 군단에 맞서기로 했다고 해요. 바로 이곳에서 두 신의 전투가 벌어졌다고 하죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: I know from lore that, during this time, Bubble decided to take action against Shade and her masquerpet army. A battle occurred between the gods at this very location.
dialogsBegin.pl: I know from lore that, during this time, Bubble decided to take action against Shade and her masquerpet army. A battle occurred between the gods at this very location.
dialogsBegin.ru: I know from lore that, during this time, Bubble decided to take action against Shade and her masquerpet army. A battle occurred between the gods at this very location.
dialogsBegin.sp: Sé sabe que, durante aquel tiempo, Bubble decidió tomar medidas contra Shade y su ejército de masquerpets. Hubo una batalla entre los dioses en este mismo lugar.
dialogsBegin.sw: I know from lore that, during this time, Bubble decided to take action against Shade and her masquerpet army. A battle occurred between the gods at this very location.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันรู้มาว่าในช่วงเวลานี้ Bubble ตัดสินใจที่จะดำเนินการกับ Shade และกองทัพสวมหน้ากากของเธอ การสู้รบจึงเกิดขึ้นระหว่างเทพแห่งนี้
dialogsBegin.tw: 我從傳說中得知，在此期間，巴布樂決定對闇影和她的怪物採取行動。就在這個地方，眾神之間發生了一場戰鬥。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi biết từ truyền thuyết rằng, trong thời gian này, Bubble quyết định hành động chống lại Shade và đội quân đeo mặt nạ của cô ấy. Một trận chiến đã xảy ra giữa các vị thần tại chính địa điểm này.

dialogsBegin.en: It is rumored that the essence of both gods remains in this garden till this day. Could you please find the Bubble Trace for me?
dialogsBegin.ar: It is rumored that the essence of both gods remains in this garden till this day. Could you please find the Bubble Trace for me?
dialogsBegin.br: Há rumores de que a essência de ambos os deuses permanecem neste jardim até hoje. Você poderia, por favor, encontrar a Essência de Bubble para mim?
dialogsBegin.cns: 据传，这两位神的意识至今仍留在这座花园里。请问你可以为我寻找到波布尔的踪迹吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Es wird gemunkelt, dass die Essenz der beiden Götter bis heute in diesem Garten verweilt. Könnten Sie bitte Bubble Trace für mich finden?
dialogsBegin.fi: It is rumored that the essence of both gods remains in this garden till this day. Could you please find the Bubble Trace for me?
dialogsBegin.fil: It is rumored that the essence of both gods remains in this garden till this day. Could you please find the Bubble Trace for me?
dialogsBegin.fr: Nous allons avoir besoin d'un puissant artefact. Je pense que les Bask ici même ont en leur possession le sceau de Rhisis.
dialogsBegin.id: Dikabarkan bahwa kedua dewa tetap ada di taman ini sampai hari ini. Bisakah kau menemukan Bubble Trace untukku?
dialogsBegin.it: It is rumored that the essence of both gods remains in this garden till this day. Could you please find the Bubble Trace for me?
dialogsBegin.jp: これは私一人では難しい問題ですね。この地にボウラーという人物がおります。彼なら何かわかるかもしれません。バスキューを倒しリシスの痕跡を見つけてもらえませんか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 전해지는 말로는, 지금도 이 정원 어딘가에 두 신의 정수가 남아 있다고 하더라고요. 버블의 흔적을 꼭 찾아주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: It is rumored that the essence of both gods remains in this garden till this day. Could you please find the Bubble Trace for me?
dialogsBegin.pl: It is rumored that the essence of both gods remains in this garden till this day. Could you please find the Bubble Trace for me?
dialogsBegin.ru: It is rumored that the essence of both gods remains in this garden till this day. Could you please find the Bubble Trace for me?
dialogsBegin.sp: Se rumorea que la esencia de ambos dioses permanece en este jardín hasta el día de hoy. ¿Podrías encontrar el Símbolo de Bubble por mí?
dialogsBegin.sw: It is rumored that the essence of both gods remains in this garden till this day. Could you please find the Bubble Trace for me?
dialogsBegin.th: มีข่าวลือว่าสาระสำคัญของเทพทั้งสองยังคงอยู่ในสวนแห่งนี้จนถึงวันนี้ คุณช่วยหา Bubble Trace ให้ฉันได้ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 傳聞這兩位神明的精華一直留在這花園裡一直到今天。你能幫我找到巴布樂的痕跡嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Người ta đồn rằng bản chất của cả hai vị thần vẫn còn trong khu vườn này cho đến ngày nay. Bạn có thể vui lòng tìm Dấu vết bong bóng cho tôi được không?

dialogsAccept.en: Please defeat the Basques in the North and acquire the Bubble Trace. Once you have this, take it to Bowler. He knows much more ancient lore than myself.
dialogsAccept.ar: Please defeat the Basques in the North and acquire the Bubble Trace. Once you have this, take it to Bowler. He knows much more ancient lore than myself.
dialogsAccept.br: Por favor, derrote os Basques no Norte e adquira a Essência de Bubble. Depois de ter isso, leve-o para Bowler. Ele tem muito mais sabedoria antiga do que eu.
dialogsAccept.cns: 请击杀北部的巴斯克斗士并获取波布尔的踪迹。当你拿到后，请将它带给保罗克。他比我知道更多古代传说。
dialogsAccept.de: Bitte besiegen Sie die Basques im Norden und erwerbe Bubble Trace. Sobald Ihr diese habt, bringt sie zu Bowler. Er kennt viel mehr alte Inschriften als ich.
dialogsAccept.fi: Please defeat the Basques in the North and acquire the Bubble Trace. Once you have this, take it to Bowler. He knows much more ancient lore than myself.
dialogsAccept.fil: Please defeat the Basques in the North and acquire the Bubble Trace. Once you have this, take it to Bowler. He knows much more ancient lore than myself.
dialogsAccept.fr: Malgré la disparition de son propriétaire, le sceau contient assez de pouvoir au moins pour ralentir les monstres.
dialogsAccept.id: Tolong kalahkan Basque di Utara dan dapatkan Bubble Trace. Setelah memiliki ini, bawa ke Bowler. Dia tahu lebih banyak pengetahuan kuno daripada diriku.
dialogsAccept.it: Please defeat the Basques in the North and acquire the Bubble Trace. Once you have this, take it to Bowler. He knows much more ancient lore than myself.
dialogsAccept.jp: ボウラーは古来よりこの庭園を管理していた一族の子孫です。彼なら何かわかるかもしれません。
dialogsAccept.kr: 북쪽에 있는 바스크들을 처치하고 버블의 흔적을 손에 넣으세요. 그걸 보울러에게 가져가 보세요. 보울러는 오래된 고대 지식에 해박하거든요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Please defeat the Basques in the North and acquire the Bubble Trace. Once you have this, take it to Bowler. He knows much more ancient lore than myself.
dialogsAccept.pl: Please defeat the Basques in the North and acquire the Bubble Trace. Once you have this, take it to Bowler. He knows much more ancient lore than myself.
dialogsAccept.ru: Please defeat the Basques in the North and acquire the Bubble Trace. Once you have this, take it to Bowler. He knows much more ancient lore than myself.
dialogsAccept.sp: Derrota a los Basques que hay al Norte y consigue el Símbolo de Bubble. Una vez que lo tengas, llévaselo a Bowler. Conoce la historia antigua mucho mejor que yo.
dialogsAccept.sw: Please defeat the Basques in the North and acquire the Bubble Trace. Once you have this, take it to Bowler. He knows much more ancient lore than myself.
dialogsAccept.th: โปรดกำจัด Basques ในภาคเหนือและได้รับ Bubble Trace เมื่อคุณได้รับนี้นำไป Bowler เขารู้จักมากกว่าตัวฉัน
dialogsAccept.tw: 請擊敗北方的巴斯克並獲得巴布樂的痕跡。一旦你有了這個，把它帶到保羅克。他比我知道的更古老的傳說。
dialogsAccept.vi: Hãy đánh bại Basques ở phía Bắc và lấy Bubble Trace. Khi bạn có cái này, hãy mang nó đến Bowler. Anh ấy biết nhiều truyền thuyết cổ xưa hơn tôi.

dialogsDecline.en: You don't want to help me? Oh well... Then I will go myself...
dialogsDecline.ar: You don't want to help me? Oh well... Then I will go myself...
dialogsDecline.br: Você não quer me ajudar? Ah tá bem.. Eu mesmo vou..
dialogsDecline.cns: You don't want to help me? Oh well... Then I will go myself...
dialogsDecline.de: Willst du mir nicht helfen? Tja... Dann werde ich selbst gehen...
dialogsDecline.fi: You don't want to help me? Oh well... Then I will go myself...
dialogsDecline.fil: You don't want to help me? Oh well... Then I will go myself...
dialogsDecline.fr: Oh, vous ne voulez pas vous mêler de cette affaire ? Mais il est trop tard pour ça !
dialogsDecline.id: Kau tidak ingin membantuku? Baiklah.. Aku akan pergi sendiri..
dialogsDecline.it: You don't want to help me? Oh well... Then I will go myself...
dialogsDecline.jp: そうですか……ちっ（普通ここまできて断る？　意味分かんないわ
dialogsDecline.kr: 도와주고 싶지 않다고요? 뭐, 그렇다면... 직접 가야겠네요...
dialogsDecline.nl: You don't want to help me? Oh well... Then I will go myself...
dialogsDecline.pl: You don't want to help me? Oh well... Then I will go myself...
dialogsDecline.ru: You don't want to help me? Oh well... Then I will go myself...
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿No quieres ayudarme? Ah bueno... Entonces iré yo misma...
dialogsDecline.sw: You don't want to help me? Oh well... Then I will go myself...
dialogsDecline.th: คุณไม่ต้องการที่จะช่วยฉัน? ได้สิ .. ฉันจะไปทำมันเอง ..
dialogsDecline.tw: 你不願意幫我嗎？唉……那我只好自己去了……
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn không muốn giúp tôi sao? Vậy thôi .. Tôi sẽ tự đi vậy ..

dialogsComplete.en: Hmm? Yes I am Bowler, last keeper of the lore of this continent. WHAT!? You come bearing the Bubble Trace!?
dialogsComplete.ar: Hmm? Yes I am Bowler, last keeper of the lore of this continent. WHAT!? You come bearing the Bubble Trace!?
dialogsComplete.br: Hum? Sim, eu sou Bowler, o último guardião da lenda deste continente. QUE!? Você trouxe a Essência de Bubble!?
dialogsComplete.cns: 嗯?是的，我就是保罗克，这个大陆上最后的传说的守护者。什么！？你带着波布尔的踪迹来的！？
dialogsComplete.de: Hm? Ja, ich bin Bowler, der letzte Bewahrer der Inschriften dieses Kontinents. WAS!? Ihr kommt mit Bubble Trace!?
dialogsComplete.fi: Hmm? Yes I am Bowler, last keeper of the lore of this continent. WHAT!? You come bearing the Bubble Trace!?
dialogsComplete.fil: Hmm? Yes I am Bowler, last keeper of the lore of this continent. WHAT!? You come bearing the Bubble Trace!?
dialogsComplete.fr: Vous n'avez pas traîné, c'est bien.
dialogsComplete.id: Hmm? Ya saya Bowler, penjaga terakhir dari pengetahuan benua ini. APA!? Kau datang membawa Bubble Trace!?
dialogsComplete.it: Hmm? Yes I am Bowler, last keeper of the lore of this continent. WHAT!? You come bearing the Bubble Trace!?
dialogsComplete.jp: ん？　この庭園について調査していると……う～ん、これは確かにリシス様の力を感じるな。
dialogsComplete.kr: 흠? 그래, 내가 보울러지. 뭐!? 버블에 흔적에 대해 조사하고 있다고?
dialogsComplete.nl: Hmm? Yes I am Bowler, last keeper of the lore of this continent. WHAT!? You come bearing the Bubble Trace!?
dialogsComplete.pl: Hmm? Yes I am Bowler, last keeper of the lore of this continent. WHAT!? You come bearing the Bubble Trace!?
dialogsComplete.ru: Hmm? Yes I am Bowler, last keeper of the lore of this continent. WHAT!? You come bearing the Bubble Trace!?
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿Mmm? Sí, soy Bowler, el último guardián de la historia de este continente. ¿¡QUÉ!? ¿¡Vienes con el Símbolo de Bubble!?
dialogsComplete.sw: Hmm? Yes I am Bowler, last keeper of the lore of this continent. WHAT!? You come bearing the Bubble Trace!?
dialogsComplete.th: อืม? ใช่ฉันเป็น Bowler . ผู้รักษาประตูคนสุดท้ายของตำนานแห่งทวีปนี้ อะไร!? คุณ Bubble Trace !?
dialogsComplete.tw: 唔？是的，我是保羅克，這個大陸傳說的最後守護者。什麼！？你帶著巴布樂的痕跡來了！？
dialogsComplete.vi: Hmm? Vâng, tôi là Bowler, người giữ truyền thuyết cuối cùng của lục địa này. GÌ!? Bạn đến mang theo Dấu vết bong bóng !?

dialogsFail.jp: バスキューというモンスターを倒してリシスの痕跡を集め、ボウラーに調査を依頼してみて下さい。お願いします。
dialogsFail.kr: 바스크 15마리를 처치하고, 그들 주변에 있는 버블의 흔적을 찾아 보울러에게 전해주세요.

dialogsBegin.en: Good to see you again! Glad to see some new faces in Madrigal, what with all the Masquerpets around. Let's see what we can do to get you ready to face them.
dialogsBegin.ar: Good to see you again! Glad to see some new faces in Madrigal, what with all the Masquerpets around. Let's see what we can do to get you ready to face them.
dialogsBegin.br: Bom te ver de novo! Fico feliz em ver alguns rostos novos em Madrigal, com todos os Masquerpets ao redor. Vamos ver o que podemos fazer para prepará-lo(a) para enfrentá-los.
dialogsBegin.cns: 再次欢迎你来到飞飞世界！除了我以外，在瑞加大陆大陆上的所有人们也都非常的欢迎你。现在做好要和怪物战斗的准备了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Willkommen! Jeder in Madrigal freut sich über deinen Besuch. Nun, du solltest auf den Kampf mit den Monstern vorbereitet sein.
dialogsBegin.fi: Good to see you again! Glad to see some new faces in Madrigal, what with all the Masquerpets around. Let's see what we can do to get you ready to face them.
dialogsBegin.fil: Good to see you again! Glad to see some new faces in Madrigal, what with all the Masquerpets around. Let's see what we can do to get you ready to face them.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tout Madrigal se réjouit de votre arrivée. Pour commencer, vous devriez vous préparer pour les combats qui vous attendent.
dialogsBegin.id: Senang bertemu denganmu lagi! Senang melihat beberapa wajah baru di Madrigal, dengan semua Masquerpet di sekitar. Mari kita lihat apa yang bisa kita lakukan untuk membuatmu siap menghadapi mereka.
dialogsBegin.it: Good to see you again! Glad to see some new faces in Madrigal, what with all the Masquerpets around. Let's see what we can do to get you ready to face them.
dialogsBegin.jp: マドリガル大陸のみんなが、あんたを歓迎してるってこと、忘れんなよ！よし、俺からもこの世界での生き方ってのを教えてやるぜ。そうだな、まずはモンスターと戦うための準備をしようか。何も装備しないで戦ったら、アイバットにだってすぐにやられちまうぜ！
dialogsBegin.kr: 다시 만나서 반가워요! 마드리갈에 새 얼굴이 보이니 기쁘네요. 특히나 요즘은 마스커펫들이 많아서 말이죠. 자, 이제 녀석들과 싸울 수 있도록, 전투를 준비해 볼까요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Good to see you again! Glad to see some new faces in Madrigal, what with all the Masquerpets around. Let's see what we can do to get you ready to face them.
dialogsBegin.pl: Good to see you again! Glad to see some new faces in Madrigal, what with all the Masquerpets around. Let's see what we can do to get you ready to face them.
dialogsBegin.ru: Ага! Ты все еще тут? Ну что же, проходимцев в последнее время столько развелось, что новый герой нам будет только кстати! Давай-ка посмотрим, чем тебя снарядить.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Me alegra verte de nuevo! Me gusta ver algunas caras nuevas en Madrigal, con todos esos Masquerpets por alrededor. Veamos que podemos hacer para prepararte para la lucha.
dialogsBegin.sw: Good to see you again! Glad to see some new faces in Madrigal, what with all the Masquerpets around. Let's see what we can do to get you ready to face them.
dialogsBegin.th: ดีที่ได้พบคุณอีกครั้ง! ดีใจที่ได้เห็นหน้าใหม่ๆ ใน Madrigal สิ่งที่มี Masquerpets อยู่รอบๆ ลองดูสิ่งที่เราสามารถทำได้เพื่อให้คุณพร้อมที่จะเผชิญกับพวกเขา
dialogsBegin.tw: 再次歡迎你來到飛飛世界！除了我以外，在瑪德利賈大陸上的所有人們也都非常的歡迎你。現在做好要和怪物戰鬥的準備了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Rất vui khi gặp bạn! Rất vui khi thấy một số gương mặt mới ở Madrigal, cùng với tất cả các Masquerpets xung quanh. Hãy xem chúng tôi có thể làm gì để bạn sẵn sàng đối mặt với chúng.

dialogsBegin.en: This is the Armor Shop. Here, you can buy the armor crafted by my family once you meet the requirements for it. There are 4 armor slots in your inventory - Helmet, Suit, Gauntlet, and Boots.
dialogsBegin.ar: This is the Armor Shop. Here, you can buy the armor crafted by my family once you meet the requirements for it. There are 4 armor slots in your inventory - Helmet, Suit, Gauntlet, and Boots.
dialogsBegin.br: Esta é a Loja de Armaduras. Aqui, você pode comprar a armadura feita por minha família assim que atender aos requisitos para ela. Existem 4 slots de armadura em seu inventário - Capacete, Traje, Manopla e Botas.
dialogsBegin.cns: 这里是防具商店，虽然还没有卖能够让你穿戴的防具，不过早晚可以让你穿戴的。防具有头盔、上衣、手套、鞋子共4种。
dialogsBegin.de: Dies ist der Rüstungsladen. Noch kannst du keine dieser Rüstungen tragen, aber das wird nicht mehr lange dauern. Es gibt 4 Arten von Rüstungen - Helme, Handschuhe, Stiefel und Körperschutz.
dialogsBegin.fi: This is the Armor Shop. Here, you can buy the armor crafted by my family once you meet the requirements for it. There are 4 armor slots in your inventory - Helmet, Suit, Gauntlet, and Boots.
dialogsBegin.fil: This is the Armor Shop. Here, you can buy the armor crafted by my family once you meet the requirements for it. There are 4 armor slots in your inventory - Helmet, Suit, Gauntlet, and Boots.
dialogsBegin.fr: Ici, c'est le magasin d'armures. Il n'y a pas d'armure que vous puissiez porter à ce stade, mais cela viendra vite. Il y a quatre pièces dans un set d'armure : le casque, la cuirasse, les gants et les bottes.
dialogsBegin.id: Ini adalah Armor Shop. Di sini, kamu dapat membeli armor yang dibuat oleh keluargaku setelah kamu memenuhi persyaratan yang dibutuhkan. Ada 4 slot armor di inventorymu - Helmet, Suit, Gauntlet, dan Boots.
dialogsBegin.it: This is the Armor Shop. Here, you can buy the armor crafted by my family once you meet the requirements for it. There are 4 armor slots in your inventory - Helmet, Suit, Gauntlet, and Boots.
dialogsBegin.jp: 見ての通り、ここは防具店だ。だが俺んとこじゃ、今のあんたが装備できそうな防具はちょっと置いてないんだよなぁ。もう少し強くなったら、うちの防具を装備できるようになるかもな。防具の種類にはヘルメット、スーツ、ガントレット、ブーツ、全部で4種類あるんだぜ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 여긴 방어구 상점이에요. 조건을 충족하면 우리 가문이 만든 방어구를 살 수 있죠. 인벤토리에는 헬멧, 수트, 건틀릿, 부츠 이렇게 4종의 슬롯이 있어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: This is the Armor Shop. Here, you can buy the armor crafted by my family once you meet the requirements for it. There are 4 armor slots in your inventory - Helmet, Suit, Gauntlet, and Boots.
dialogsBegin.pl: This is the Armor Shop. Here, you can buy the armor crafted by my family once you meet the requirements for it. There are 4 armor slots in your inventory - Helmet, Suit, Gauntlet, and Boots.
dialogsBegin.ru: Я торгую доспехами. Мастерю их сам, а как же! Для героев любого возраста и амплуа. Хороший комплект снаряжения состоит из четырех предметов - шлема, костюма, перчаток и сапог.
dialogsBegin.sp: Esta es la Tienda de Armaduras. Aquí, puedes comprar armaduras creadas por mi familia y equipártelas una vez cumplas los requisitos. Hay 4 huecos de armadura en tu inventario: Casco, Traje, Guanteletes y Botas.
dialogsBegin.sw: This is the Armor Shop. Here, you can buy the armor crafted by my family once you meet the requirements for it. There are 4 armor slots in your inventory - Helmet, Suit, Gauntlet, and Boots.
dialogsBegin.th: นี่คือเกราะ Shop ที่นี่คุณสามารถซื้อชุดเกราะที่สร้างขึ้นมาจากครอบครัวของฉัน เมื่อคุณมีคุณสมบัติครบถ้วนแล้ว มีช่องใส่เกราะ 4 ชุดใน inventory ของคุณ ได้แก่ หมวกนิรภัย ชุดสูท ถุงมือและรองเท้าบู๊ต
dialogsBegin.tw: 這裡是防具店，雖然還沒有賣能夠讓你穿戴的防具，不過早晚可以讓你穿戴的。防具有頭盔、上衣、手套、鞋子共 4 種。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đây là Cửa hàng Áo giáp. Tại đây, bạn có thể mua áo giáp do gia đình tôi chế tác một khi bạn đáp ứng các yêu cầu của nó. Có 4 khe cắm áo giáp trong hành trang của bạn - Mũ bảo hiểm, Bộ quần áo, Găng tay và Giày cao cổ.

dialogsBegin.en: You'll find that different jobs and levels have access to different kinds of armor. 'Course, you probably already knew that. Now, go talk with my brother Boboku next door at his Weapon Shop.
dialogsBegin.ar: You'll find that different jobs and levels have access to different kinds of armor. 'Course, you probably already knew that. Now, go talk with my brother Boboku next door at his Weapon Shop.
dialogsBegin.br: Armaduras são diferentes de acordo com sua Classe e Nível. Claro, você provavelmente já sabia disso. Agora, por favor converse com o meu irmão Boboku, ele é dono da Loja de Armas ao meu lado. Ele irá explicar as Armas para você.
dialogsBegin.cns: 随着职业不同，也各自穿戴不同的防具，越好的防具就需要越高的等级才可以穿戴。你去找在我旁边的武器商店波哥吧。他会告诉你有关武器的说明。
dialogsBegin.de: Du wirst feststellen, dass verschiedene Berufe und Stufen Zugang zu verschiedenen Arten von Rüstungen haben. Aber das wusstet du wahrscheinlich schon. Jetzt geh und rede mit meinem Bruder Boboku nebenan in seinem Waffenladen.
dialogsBegin.fi: You'll find that different jobs and levels have access to different kinds of armor. 'Course, you probably already knew that. Now, go talk with my brother Boboku next door at his Weapon Shop.
dialogsBegin.fil: You'll find that different jobs and levels have access to different kinds of armor. 'Course, you probably already knew that. Now, go talk with my brother Boboku next door at his Weapon Shop.
dialogsBegin.fr: Plus le niveau de l'armure est élevé, plus elle vous protège. Maintenant, allez voir #cffffdd66Boboku, le vendeur d'armes#nc.
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu akan menemukan jika pekerjaan dan level yang berbeda akan memiliki akses ke jenis armor yang berbeda pula. Tentu saja, Kau mungkin sudah tahu itu. Sekarang, bicaralah dengan saudaraku Boboku di sebelah Weapon Shop ini.
dialogsBegin.it: You'll find that different jobs and levels have access to different kinds of armor. 'Course, you probably already knew that. Now, go talk with my brother Boboku next door at his Weapon Shop.
dialogsBegin.jp: 職業によって装備できる防具が違うんだ。それぞれの防具には装備レベルってのがあって、いい品ほど防御力は高いが、装備するには装備レベル以上のレベルになってないと装備できないから注意しろよ！さてと･･･俺に教えられるのはこれくらいだな。そうだ、今度は俺の隣にいる＜武器＞店のボボクに話かけてみな。
dialogsBegin.kr: 직업과 레벨에 따라 사용할 수 있는 방어구가 달라요. 뭐, 이미 알고 계시겠지만요. 자아, 이제 제 동생 보보쿠가 운영하는 옆의 무기 상점으로 가보세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: You'll find that different jobs and levels have access to different kinds of armor. 'Course, you probably already knew that. Now, go talk with my brother Boboku next door at his Weapon Shop.
dialogsBegin.pl: You'll find that different jobs and levels have access to different kinds of armor. 'Course, you probably already knew that. Now, go talk with my brother Boboku next door at his Weapon Shop.
dialogsBegin.ru: Вскоре ты разберешься, какой комплект на какой уровень и для какого амплуа - иначе говоря, класса. А пока зайди к моему брату Бобохану, он оружейник. Хорошо?
dialogsBegin.sp: Verás que diferentes clases y niveles tienen acceso a diferentes tipos de armaduras. Por supuesto, probablemente ya lo sabías. Ahora, ve a hablar con mi hermano Boboku, está aquí al lado en su Tienda de Armas.
dialogsBegin.sw: You'll find that different jobs and levels have access to different kinds of armor. 'Course, you probably already knew that. Now, go talk with my brother Boboku next door at his Weapon Shop.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณจะพบว่างานและระดับต่างๆ มีการเข้าถึงเกราะที่แตกต่างกัน แน่นอนคุณคงจะรู้แล้วล่ะ ตอนนี้ไปคุยกับพี่ชาย Boboku ที่อยู่ถัดไปที่ Weapon Shop ของเขา
dialogsBegin.tw: 隨著職業不同，也各自穿戴不同的防具，越好的防具就需要越高的等級才可以穿戴。你去找在我旁邊的武器店波哥吧。他會告訴你有關武器的說明。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn sẽ thấy rằng các công việc và cấp độ khác nhau tiếp cận các loại áo giáp khác nhau. 'Tất nhiên, bạn có thể đã biết điều đó rồi. Bây giờ, hãy nói chuyện với anh trai tôi Boboku ở kế bên tại Cửa hàng vũ khí của anh ấy.

dialogsAccept.en: I know it's loud over here, but didn't you see me pointin'? Boboku's Weapon Shop is right next door!
dialogsAccept.ar: I know it's loud over here, but didn't you see me pointin'? Boboku's Weapon Shop is right next door!
dialogsAccept.br: Eu sei que está barulhento aqui, mas você não me viu apontando?  A loja de armas do Boboku fica bem ao lado!
dialogsAccept.cns: 武器商店波哥就在我的旁边，你没有看到吗？
dialogsAccept.de: Ich weiß, es ist laut hier, aber hast du nicht gesehen, worauf ich zeige? Bobokus Waffenladen ist gleich nebenan!
dialogsAccept.fi: I know it's loud over here, but didn't you see me pointin'? Boboku's Weapon Shop is right next door!
dialogsAccept.fil: I know it's loud over here, but didn't you see me pointin'? Boboku's Weapon Shop is right next door!
dialogsAccept.fr: Boboku, le vendeur d'armes, est juste à côté.
dialogsAccept.id: Aku tahu di sini berisik, tapi tidakkah Kau melihatku menunjuk? Boboku Weapon Shop tepat di sebelah!
dialogsAccept.it: I know it's loud over here, but didn't you see me pointin'? Boboku's Weapon Shop is right next door!
dialogsAccept.jp: ほら、俺のすぐ隣にいるだろう？大丈夫、吠えられたりはしないさ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 여기가 시끄럽긴 하지만, 제가 손가락으로 알려 드렸잖아요? 보보쿠의 무기 상점은 바로 옆이에요!
dialogsAccept.nl: I know it's loud over here, but didn't you see me pointin'? Boboku's Weapon Shop is right next door!
dialogsAccept.pl: I know it's loud over here, but didn't you see me pointin'? Boboku's Weapon Shop is right next door!
dialogsAccept.ru: Бо-бо-хану! Во-он туда! Слышишь? Ладно, не буду пытаться перекричать шум кузницы. Лучше рукой покажу!
dialogsAccept.sp: Sé que esto hace demasiado ruido, pero ¿no ves que estoy apuntando? ¡La Tienda de Armas de Boboku está justo al lado!
dialogsAccept.sw: I know it's loud over here, but didn't you see me pointin'? Boboku's Weapon Shop is right next door!
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันรู้ว่ามันดังอยู่นี่ แต่คุณไม่เห็นฉันชี้เหรอ? Weapon Shop ของ Boboku อยู่ติดกัน!
dialogsAccept.tw: 武器店波哥就在我的旁邊，你沒有看到嗎？
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi biết nó ồn ào ở đây, nhưng bạn không thấy tôi đang chỉ tay sao? Cửa hàng vũ khí của Boboku ở ngay bên cạnh!

dialogsDecline.en: You sure? Well if you change your mind, nobody knows weapons like my brother Boboku.
dialogsDecline.ar: You sure? Well if you change your mind, nobody knows weapons like my brother Boboku.
dialogsDecline.br: Tem certeza que? Bem, se você mudar de ideia, ninguém conhece mais sobre armas que meu irmão Boboku.
dialogsDecline.cns: 对于武器，波哥是最懂的。你一定要去找他。
dialogsDecline.de: Bist du sicher? Falls du deine Meinung änderst: Niemand kennt sich mit Waffen so gut aus wie mein Bruder Boboku.
dialogsDecline.fi: You sure? Well if you change your mind, nobody knows weapons like my brother Boboku.
dialogsDecline.fil: You sure? Well if you change your mind, nobody knows weapons like my brother Boboku.
dialogsDecline.fr: Boboku est le meilleur dès qu'il s'agit d'armes. Revenez me voir si vous changez d'avis !
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu yakin? Oke, jika Kau berubah pikiran, tak ada yang paham soal senjata melebihi saudaraku Boboku.
dialogsDecline.it: You sure? Well if you change your mind, nobody knows weapons like my brother Boboku.
dialogsDecline.jp: 武器についてはボボクが最高です。 一度会いましょう。
dialogsDecline.kr: 정말 괜찮으세요? 마음이 바뀌면 말하세요. 제 동생 보보쿠만큼 무기를 잘 아는 사람은 없답니다.
dialogsDecline.nl: You sure? Well if you change your mind, nobody knows weapons like my brother Boboku.
dialogsDecline.pl: You sure? Well if you change your mind, nobody knows weapons like my brother Boboku.
dialogsDecline.ru: Тебе не нужно оружие? Странно. Ну, если передумаешь, приходи к Бобохану - лучше него оружейника нет.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Seguro? Bueno, si cambias de opinión, nadie conoce las armas tan bien como mi hermano Boboku.
dialogsDecline.sw: You sure? Well if you change your mind, nobody knows weapons like my brother Boboku.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณแน่ใจเหรอ? ถ้าคุณเปลี่ยนใจ ไม่มีใครรู้จักอาวุธดีเหมือนพี่ Boboku
dialogsDecline.tw: 對於武器，波哥是最懂的。你一定要去找他。
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn chắc chắn? Nếu bạn thay đổi quyết định, không ai biết đến vũ khí như anh trai tôi Boboku.

dialogsComplete.en: Well hello there! Good of you to stop by. Here, take this, and the next time I see ya we'll get you up to speed on weapons.
dialogsComplete.ar: Well hello there! Good of you to stop by. Here, take this, and the next time I see ya we'll get you up to speed on weapons.
dialogsComplete.br: Olá! Prazer em te conhecer! É muito bom você vir me visitar.... Isto é um presente, aceite! Se você me visitar novamente, eu irei explicar sobre as armas.
dialogsComplete.cns: 你好，太高兴了！想不到你会来找我…这分礼物是我的一点心意，请你收下吧！如果下次再来找我，我会告诉你有关武器的说明。
dialogsComplete.de: Hallo, schön dich zu sehen. Ich freue mich über deinen Besuch. Hier ist ein kleines Geschenk. Wenn du mich erneut besuchst, beginne ich mit der Waffenkunde.
dialogsComplete.fi: Well hello there! Good of you to stop by. Here, take this, and the next time I see ya we'll get you up to speed on weapons.
dialogsComplete.fil: Well hello there! Good of you to stop by. Here, take this, and the next time I see ya we'll get you up to speed on weapons.
dialogsComplete.fr: Bonjour, enchanté de vous connaître ! J'ai un cadeau pour vous, voici 500 penyas. Je vais vous expliquer le maniement des armes.
dialogsComplete.id: Oh, Halo disana! Baik sekali Kau mau mampir. Ambil ini, dan lain kali aku melihatmu, kita akan membantumu mempercepat senjatamu.
dialogsComplete.it: Well hello there! Good of you to stop by. Here, take this, and the next time I see ya we'll get you up to speed on weapons.
dialogsComplete.jp: よく来たな、隣で話は聞いてたぜ。なに？弟に小遣いをもらっただと？チッ、しょうがねぇな。ほら、取っとけ。それじゃ、今度は俺がありがたい話を聞かせてやるよ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 오, 안녕하세요! 들러주셔서 감사해요. 자, 이거 받으세요. 다시 절 찾아오시면 무기에 대해 더 알려 드릴게요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Well hello there! Good of you to stop by. Here, take this, and the next time I see ya we'll get you up to speed on weapons.
dialogsComplete.pl: Well hello there! Good of you to stop by. Here, take this, and the next time I see ya we'll get you up to speed on weapons.
dialogsComplete.ru: Добро пожаловать! Вот, возьми подарок и от меня. Если хочешь, я расскажу тебе об оружии.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Pero bueno, hola! Me alegra verte por aquí. Mira, toma esto, y la próxima vez que te vea te pondremos al día con las armas.
dialogsComplete.sw: Well hello there! Good of you to stop by. Here, take this, and the next time I see ya we'll get you up to speed on weapons.
dialogsComplete.th: สวัสดี! ดีที่คุณแวะมา เอานี่ไป แล้วเจอกันใหม่คราวหน้า เราจะแจ้งให้คุณทราบเกี่ยวกับอาวุธ
dialogsComplete.tw: 你好，太高興了！想不到你會來找我…這分禮物是我的一點心意，請你收下吧！如果下次再來找我，我會告訴你有關武器的說明。
dialogsComplete.vi: Xin chào! Thật tốt nếu bạn ghé qua. Đây, cầm lấy cái này, và lần sau khi gặp lại, chúng tôi sẽ giúp bạn tăng tốc độ vũ khí.

name.br: Caçando Monstros para recuperar o Karma
name.cns: 击杀怪物以减少罪恶值
name.fil: Mangaso ng Halimaw para makarecover ng Karma
name.jp: モンスターを狩ってカルマを回復させる
name.pl: Polowanie na potwory aby odzyskać Karmę
name.sp: Derrota a los Monstruos para recuperar Karma.
name.th: ล่ามอนสเตอร์เพื่อฟื้นค่า Karma
name.tw: 狩獵怪物以讓紅人狀態消失
name.vi: Săn quái vật để phục hồi Karma

description.en: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.ar: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.br: Caçando $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ recuperará seus pontos de Karma.
description.cns: 为了减少你的罪恶值，你要去击杀 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 回来。
description.de: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ jagen wird dein Karma wiederherstellen.
description.fi: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.fil: Ang Pang-huhuli ng $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ay makakapagpanumbalik ng iyong Karma points.
description.fr: Tu devrais chasser des $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s afin de récupérer les points de Karma.
description.id: Berburu $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ akan memulihkan poin-poin Karmamu.
description.it: Stai cacciando $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ per recuperare i tuoi punti Karma.
description.jp: カルマポイントを回復するため、$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を処罰して来てください。
description.nl: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.pl: Polowanie na $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ pozwoli odzyskać punkty Karmy.
description.ru: Твоя цель - $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, только так ты очистишь карму.
description.sp: Cazar $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ recuperará tus puntos de Karma.
description.sw: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.th: การล่า $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ จะกู้คืนคะแนน Karma ของคุณ
description.tw: 狩獵 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 將會恢復你的惡名點數。
description.vi: Săn $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ sẽ phục hồi điểm Karma của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsDecline.en: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.ar: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.br: Você ainda tem que pagar pelos seus pecados...
dialogsDecline.cns: 你还没有为你的罪恶付出代价...
dialogsDecline.de: Du musst noch immer für deine Sünden bezahlen...
dialogsDecline.fi: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.fil: Di mo pa bayad ang iyong mga kasalanan…
dialogsDecline.fr: Quand expieras-tu tes nombreux crimes ?
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu belum membayar untuk dosa-dosamu…
dialogsDecline.it: Devi ancora pagare per i tuoi peccati...
dialogsDecline.jp: いつになったら、この底知れぬ罪悪感から抜けられるのだろう？
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신은 아직 죗값을 치르지 않았으니...
dialogsDecline.nl: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.pl: Musisz najpierw zapłacić za swoje grzechy…
dialogsDecline.ru: Велики твои грехи…
dialogsDecline.sp: Todavía tienes que pagar por tus pecados...
dialogsDecline.sw: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.th: คุณยังไม้ได้ชดใช้บาปของคุณ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 你還沒有為你的罪付出代價…
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn vẫn chưa phải trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình…

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.br: Sua missão foi concluída. Seus pecados foram perdoados.
dialogsComplete.cns: 任务完成，你的罪恶已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Buße getan. Deine Sünden wurden dir vergeben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Questmu telah tercapai. Dosa-dosamu telah diampuni.
dialogsComplete.it: La Missione è terminata. I tuoi peccati sono stati perdonati.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 끝났습니다. 당신의 죄를 용서하지요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Боги одобрили твое деяние и простили тебе грехи.
dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น บาปของคุณได้รับการอภัยแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nhiệm vụ của bạn đã được hoàn thành. Tội lỗi của bạn đã được tha thứ.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

name.cns: 嗨！看呐！一只会飞的老鼠！
name.de: Hey, schaut mal, eine fliegende Ratte!
name.jp: ほら見てみろ！ねずみが空を飛んでんぞ！
name.th: ดูสิ หนูบินได้!

description.en: Almani asked for Longwings to be exterminated, as they have been attacking civilians. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.ar: Almani asked for Longwings to be exterminated, as they have been attacking civilians. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.br: Almani pediu que os Longwings fossem exterminados, pois estão atacando civis. Você poderia matar 15 deles?
description.cns: 亚尔玛尼要求消灭魔翼兵，因为它们一直在攻击平民。你能杀掉15个魔翼兵吗？
description.de: Almani forderte die Ausrottung der Longwings, da sie Zivilisten angreifen. Kannst du 15 von ihnen töten?
description.fi: Almani asked for Longwings to be exterminated, as they have been attacking civilians. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.fil: Hiniling ni Almani na lipulin ang Longwings dahil inaatake nila ang mga sibilyan. Puwede mo bang patayin ang 15 sa kanila?
description.fr: Almani a besoin d'aide pour exterminer des Longwings, car ils attaquent des civils. Peux-tu en tuer 15 ?
description.id: Almain meminta agar Longwings dimusnahkan karena mereka mulai menyerang penduduk sipil. Bisakah kamu habisi 15 dari mereka?
description.it: Almani asked for Longwings to be exterminated, as they have been attacking civilians. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.jp: アルマーニから、＜ロングウィング＞が民間人を攻撃しているので駆除してほしいと依頼を受けています。15体討伐していただけませんか？
description.kr: 알마니가 사람들을 공격하는 롱윙을 없애 달라고 부탁했어요. 롱윙 15마리만 잡아주실 수 있나요?
description.nl: Almani asked for Longwings to be exterminated, as they have been attacking civilians. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.pl: Almani asked for Longwings to be exterminated, as they have been attacking civilians. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.ru: Almani asked for Longwings to be exterminated, as they have been attacking civilians. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.sp: Almani ha pedido que se extermine a los Longwings, ya que han estado atacando a civiles. ¿Podrías deshacerte de 15 de ellos?
description.sw: Almani asked for Longwings to be exterminated, as they have been attacking civilians. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.th: Almani ขอให้ Longwings ถูกกำจัดเนื่องจากพวกมันโจมตีชาวเมือง คุณสามารถฆ่าพวกมัน 15 ตัวได้หรือไม่?
description.tw: 阿爾瑪尼要求清剿長翼，因為牠們一直在襲擊平民。你能幫忙擊殺 15 隻嗎？
description.vi: Almani yêu cầu tiêu diệt Longwings, vì chúng đã tấn công dân thường. Bạn có thể giết 15 trong số chúng không?

descriptionComplete.ar: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.

descriptionComplete.de: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ war froh, dass die Aufgabe abgeschlossen wurde.
descriptionComplete.fi: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
descriptionComplete.fil: Masayang-masaya si $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ na nakumpleto ang quest.
descriptionComplete.fr: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ était heureuse d'apprendre que cette quête était terminée.
descriptionComplete.id: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ senang sekali melihat quest telah selesai.
descriptionComplete.it: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
descriptionComplete.jp: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$は依頼の完了を喜び、依頼の書かれた書類に完了のサインをした。
descriptionComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 완료된 것을 본 $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$의 기쁨이 전해집니다.
descriptionComplete.nl: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
descriptionComplete.pl: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
descriptionComplete.ru: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
descriptionComplete.sp: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ se alegra de ver la que la misión está completada.
descriptionComplete.sw: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
descriptionComplete.th: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ มีความสุขที่ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น
descriptionComplete.vi: $ QUEST_END_NPC_NAME $ rất vui khi thấy nhiệm vụ đã hoàn thành.

dialogsAccept.en: You can find Longwings flying South-East of the Clockworks Cage in the mountains.
dialogsAccept.ar: You can find Longwings flying South-East of the Clockworks Cage in the mountains.
dialogsAccept.br: Você pode encontrar Longwings voando a sudeste da Prisão de Clockworks, nas montanhas.
dialogsAccept.cns: 你会发现魔翼兵在山区的囚禁之地东南方向飞来飞去。
dialogsAccept.de: Sie finden Longwings südöstlich des Clockworks Cage in den Bergen.
dialogsAccept.fi: You can find Longwings flying South-East of the Clockworks Cage in the mountains.
dialogsAccept.fil: Makikita mo ang Longwings na lumilipad sa timog-silangan ng Clockworks Cage sa kabundukan.
dialogsAccept.fr: Tu peux trouver les Longwings volant au sud-est de la Cage de Clockworks dans les montagnes.
dialogsAccept.id: Kamu bisa menemukan Longwings beterbangan ditenggara dari Clockworks Cage di gunung.

description.en: Deliver the Magic Underwear of Power to Ryupang in Madren Town.

dialogsBegin.en: Alright, so let's move on. Deliver the Magic Underwear of Power to Ryupang in Madren Town
dialogsBegin.ar: Alright, so let's move on. Deliver the Magic Underwear of Power to Ryupang in Madren Town
dialogsBegin.br: Agora deixe-me dizer o que você deve fazer a partir de agora. Por favor, entregue esta Roupa Íntima Mágica do Poder para Ryupang, o líder dos soldados na cidade de Madren.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你要帮忙做的事…就是，把这魔法衬衣拿给义贼团首领【鲁班】。
dialogsBegin.de: Nun, lass mich dir erklären was du tun musst. Bitte bring die Unterwäsche zu Ryupang, dem Anführer der Soldaten im Dorf Madren.
dialogsBegin.fi: Alright, so let's move on. Deliver the Magic Underwear of Power to Ryupang in Madren Town
dialogsBegin.fil: Alright, so let's move on. Deliver the Magic Underwear of Power to Ryupang in Madren Town
dialogsBegin.fr: Maintenant je dois rendre cette tunique magique à son propriétaire. Son premier propriétaire était Offerep bien sûr, mais désormais une personne s'occupe des reliques du Héros des Sorciers.
dialogsBegin.id: Baiklah, jadi mari kita lanjutkan. Kirimkan Magic Underwear of Power ke Ryupang di Kota Madren
dialogsBegin.it: Alright, so let's move on. Deliver the Magic Underwear of Power to Ryupang in Madren Town
dialogsBegin.jp: それではこれからしなければならんことを伝えよう。この魔力強化の護符をフラリスにおる義賊団の団長リュハンに渡すのじゃ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 좋아요, 다음으로 넘어가죠. 이 강화 마법 속옷을 매드런 타운의 류팡에게 전해주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Alright, so let's move on. Deliver the Magic Underwear of Power to Ryupang in Madren Town
dialogsBegin.pl: Alright, so let's move on. Deliver the Magic Underwear of Power to Ryupang in Madren Town
dialogsBegin.ru: Эх… Не хочу я тебя отдавать, но надо. Фокусник! Отнеси Пояс Рональду в Мадренбург, хорошо?
dialogsBegin.sp: Muy bien, sigamos adelante. Entrega la Ropa Interior Mágica del Poder a Ryupang en Pueblo Madren.
dialogsBegin.sw: Alright, so let's move on. Deliver the Magic Underwear of Power to Ryupang in Madren Town
dialogsBegin.th: เอาล่ะเรามากันเถอะ มอบชุดเครื่องแบบ Magic of Power ให้กับ Ryupang ในเมือง Madren
dialogsBegin.tw: 你要幫忙做的事…就是，把這魔法襯衣拿給義賊團首領 [魯班]。
dialogsBegin.vi: Được rồi, vậy hãy tiếp tục. Giao Magic Underwear of Power đến Ryupang ở Madren Town

dialogsAccept.fi: Make haste, Magician!

dialogsDecline.en: Ryupang NEEDS that underwear! Please, think it over!
dialogsDecline.ar: Ryupang NEEDS that underwear! Please, think it over!

dialogsDecline.cns: 这…这…我又不是变态拿着这个东西做啥？我看你还是帮我拿给他吧！
dialogsDecline.de: Verdammt.. Wenn du es nicht machen willst, dann kann ich dich nicht zwingen aber.. Bitte denk nochmal nach und bring es zu Ryupang. Das ist ein wichtiges Relikt.
dialogsDecline.fi: Ryupang NEEDS that underwear! Please, think it over!
dialogsDecline.fil: Ryupang NEEDS that underwear! Please, think it over!
dialogsDecline.fr: Rapporter cette tunique à Ryupang est vraiment important... Ce n'est pas très loin d'ici, va lui remettre s'il te plaît
dialogsDecline.id: Ryupang MEMBUTUHKAN pakaian dalam itu! Tolong, pikirkan!
dialogsDecline.it: Ryupang NEEDS that underwear! Please, think it over!
dialogsDecline.jp: なんと！いやじゃと！？とても大事なものだということが分からんのか？
dialogsDecline.kr: 류팡에게 그 속옷이 필요하다고요! 다시 생각해 보세요!

dialogsDecline.pl: Ryupang NEEDS that underwear! Please, think it over!

dialogsDecline.sw: Ryupang NEEDS that underwear! Please, think it over!
dialogsDecline.th: Ryupang ต้องการชุดชั้นใน! ได้โปรดลองคิดดูสิ!
dialogsDecline.tw: 這…這…我又不是變態拿著這個東西做啥？我看你還是幫我拿給他吧！
dialogsDecline.vi: Ryupang CẦN đồ lót đó! Làm ơn, hãy suy nghĩ lại!

dialogsComplete.en: Hmmm… yes? What've you go there, young Magician?
dialogsComplete.ar: Hmmm… yes? What've you go there, young Magician?
dialogsComplete.br: Hmm? Como você a encontrou? Todos os soldados tentaram encontrá-la, mas falhamos. O que? Caçador de tesouros?
dialogsComplete.cns: 你真厉害耶~没有你帮忙，我还真不知道该怎么办才好！
dialogsComplete.de: Hmmm... ja? Was hast du denn da, junger Magier?
dialogsComplete.fi: Hmmm… yes? What've you go there, young Magician?
dialogsComplete.fil: Hmmm… yes? What've you go there, young Magician?
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh... C'est la... Merci infiniment ! Je la cherchais depuis des années.
dialogsComplete.id: Hmm… ya? Apa yang kamu pergi ke sana, Penyihir muda?
dialogsComplete.it: Hmmm… yes? What've you go there, young Magician?
dialogsComplete.jp: うん？義賊団最高の諜報員が見つけ出せなかったものを見つけてくるなんて･･･君･･･やるね！
dialogsComplete.kr: 흠… 네? 거기 젊은 매지션, 뭐 줄 거라도 있나요?

dialogsComplete.pl: Hmmm… yes? What've you go there, young Magician?

dialogsComplete.th: อืม... ว่าไง? คุณไปที่นั่นเหรอ Magician?
dialogsComplete.tw: 你真厲害耶~沒有你幫忙，我還真不知道該怎麼辦才好！
dialogsComplete.vi: Hmmm… vâng? Bạn đã đến đó làm gì, Magician trẻ?

dialogsComplete.en: The Magic Underwear of Power! Where did you find them? No matter, the important thing is that we now have this very important relic.
dialogsComplete.ar: The Magic Underwear of Power! Where did you find them? No matter, the important thing is that we now have this very important relic.
dialogsComplete.br: A Roupa Íntima Mágica do Poder! Onde você encontrou? Não importa, o importante é que agora temos essa relíquia muito importante.
dialogsComplete.cns: 不管怎么样还是谢谢你喔！这是给你的谢礼，请收下吧！
dialogsComplete.de: Die magische Unterwäsche der Macht! Wo habt ihr sie gefunden? Egal, wichtig ist, dass wir jetzt dieses sehr wichtige Relikt haben.
dialogsComplete.fi: The Magic Underwear of Power! Where did you find them? No matter, the important thing is that we now have this very important relic.
dialogsComplete.fil: The Magic Underwear of Power! Where did you find them? No matter, the important thing is that we now have this very important relic.
dialogsComplete.fr: J'apprécie énormément ce que tu as fait ! Mon devoir est enfin accompli ! Voici quelque chose pour te récompenser de tes efforts.
dialogsComplete.id: Kekuatan Pakaian Dalam Ajaib! Di mana kamu menemukan mereka? Tidak masalah, yang penting sekarang kita memiliki relik yang sangat penting ini.
dialogsComplete.it: The Magic Underwear of Power! Where did you find them? No matter, the important thing is that we now have this very important relic.
dialogsComplete.jp: ああ、ありがとう！そうだ、これを受け取ってくれ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이게 바로 강화 마법 속옷이군요! 어디서 구하신 거예요? 뭐, 중요한 건 우리가 이 귀중한 성물을 얻게 되었다는 점이죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: The Magic Underwear of Power! Where did you find them? No matter, the important thing is that we now have this very important relic.
dialogsComplete.pl: The Magic Underwear of Power! Where did you find them? No matter, the important thing is that we now have this very important relic.
dialogsComplete.ru: The Magic Underwear of Power! Where did you find them? No matter, the important thing is that we now have this very important relic.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡La Ropa Interior Mágica! ¿Dónde la has encontrado? Da igual, lo que importa es que tenemos esta reliquia tan importante.
dialogsComplete.sw: The Magic Underwear of Power! Where did you find them? No matter, the important thing is that we now have this very important relic.
dialogsComplete.th: The Magic Underwear of Power! คุณเจอมันที่ไหน? ไม่สำคัญ สิ่งสำคัญคือตอนนี้เราได้เรลิคสำคัญมาแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 不管怎麼樣還是謝謝你喔！這是給你的謝禮，請收下吧！
dialogsComplete.vi: Magic Underwear of Power! Bạn đã tìm thấy chúng ở đâu? Không có vấn đề gì, điều quan trọng là bây giờ chúng ta có di vật rất quan trọng này.

dialogsComplete.en: Take this, my friend. This Stamped Scroll will prove you are worthy to become a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsComplete.ar: Take this, my friend. This Stamped Scroll will prove you are worthy to become a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsComplete.br: Aqui está. Este é o pergaminho que somente os sucessores na minha família podem ter. Agora eu o estou entregando a você. Será o comprovante que mostra que você é reconhecido como um sucessor.
dialogsComplete.cns: 这卷轴表示首领肯定继承者的能力！
dialogsComplete.de: Diese Schriftrolle können nur die Nachfolger meiner Familie erhalten. Nun werde ich sie dir geben. Ist ist der Beweis, das du als Nachfolger anerkannt wurdest.
dialogsComplete.fi: Take this, my friend. This Stamped Scroll will prove you are worthy to become a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsComplete.fil: Take this, my friend. This Stamped Scroll will prove you are worthy to become a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsComplete.fr: Ceci est le Parchemin que seuls les descendants de ma famille peuvent obtenir. Il t'appartient désormais.
dialogsComplete.id: Ambil ini, temanku. Gulungan Stempel ini akan membuktikan bahwa kamu layak menjadi Penerus Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsComplete.it: Take this, my friend. This Stamped Scroll will prove you are worthy to become a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsComplete.jp: これは後継者に差し上げる巻物だ、サイキーパー後継者を目指すものに、次の道を指し示すだろう。どうか受け取ってくれ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이걸 받으세요. 당신이 사이키퍼 영웅의 후계자임을 증명하는 봉인된 두루마리랍니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Take this, my friend. This Stamped Scroll will prove you are worthy to become a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsComplete.pl: Weź to, mój przyjacielu. Ten Zapieczętowany Zwój udowodni, że jesteś godny zostania następcą bohatera Czarodzieja.
dialogsComplete.ru: Возьми этот свиток. Он доказывает, что его носитель достоин стать наследником героя-манипулятора.
dialogsComplete.sp: Toma esto, amigo mío. Este Pergamino Estampado demostrará que eres digno de convertirte en Sucesor de la Héroe Psykeeper.
dialogsComplete.sw: Take this, my friend. This Stamped Scroll will prove you are worthy to become a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsComplete.th: รับไป เพื่อน Stamped Scroll นี้จะพิสูจน์ว่าคุณสมควรที่จะเป็นผู้สืบทอดฮีโร่ Psykeeper
dialogsComplete.tw: 朋友，收下這個。這份蓋章卷軸能證明你有資格成為念力師英雄的繼承者。
dialogsComplete.vi: Cầm lấy cái này, bạn tôi. Stamped Scroll này sẽ chứng minh bạn xứng đáng trở thành Người kế vị Anh hùng Psykeeper.

dialogsFail.en: We are the survivors of the Massacre of the Mr. Pumpkins. We became soldiers to fight back and seek our revenge. Curse those Pumpkin-heads!
dialogsFail.ar: We are the survivors of the Massacre of the Mr. Pumpkins. We became soldiers to fight back and seek our revenge. Curse those Pumpkin-heads!
dialogsFail.br: Na verdade, nós somos os sobreviventes do Massacre dos Srs. Abóboras. Nós nos tornamos soldados para conseguir nossa vingança.
dialogsFail.cns: 我们义贼团是为了对抗南瓜先生而组成的！
dialogsFail.de: Eigentlich sind wir Überlebende vom Massaker durch die Mr Pumpkin. Wir wurden Soldaten um uns zu rächen.
dialogsFail.fi: We are the survivors of the Massacre of the Mr. Pumpkins. We became soldiers to fight back and seek our revenge. Curse those Pumpkin-heads!
dialogsFail.fil: We are the survivors of the Massacre of the Mr. Pumpkins. We became soldiers to fight back and seek our revenge. Curse those Pumpkin-heads!
dialogsFail.fr: Nous sommes les survivants du massacre suite à l'attaque des Pumpkins, et sommes devenus soldats pour pouvoir résister à tout nouvel assaut.
dialogsFail.id: Kami adalah orang-orang yang selamat dari Pembantaian Mr. Pumpkins. Kami menjadi tentara untuk melawan dan membalas dendam. Terkutuklah para kepala Labu itu!
dialogsFail.it: We are the survivors of the Massacre of the Mr. Pumpkins. We became soldiers to fight back and seek our revenge. Curse those Pumpkin-heads!
dialogsFail.jp: 義賊団はかの忌まわしき「血のハロウィン事件」の生存者たちがカボチャ男爵に復讐するため結成したのさ、今は義賊団として活動しているけどな。
dialogsFail.kr: 저흰 미스터 펌킨 대학살에서 살아남은 생존자들입니다. 펌킨에게 복수하기 위해 병사가 되었죠. 저 호박 머리 녀석들, 용서할 수 없어요!
dialogsFail.nl: We are the survivors of the Massacre of the Mr. Pumpkins. We became soldiers to fight back and seek our revenge. Curse those Pumpkin-heads!
dialogsFail.pl: Jesteśmy ocalałymi z Masakry Pana Dyni. Zostaliśmy żołnierzami, by walczyć i szukać zemsty. Przeklinam te Dyniowe głowy!
dialogsFail.ru: Мы чудом выжили в резне, устроенной Тыкверами. Чтобы отомстить им, мы стали солдатами. Чтоб вас черви съели, проклятые тыквоголовые!
dialogsFail.sp: Somos los sobrevivientes de la Masacre de los Mr. Pumpkins. Nos convertimos en soldados para contraatacar y buscar nuestra venganza. ¡Malditos sean esos cabeza de calabaza!
dialogsFail.sw: We are the survivors of the Massacre of the Mr. Pumpkins. We became soldiers to fight back and seek our revenge. Curse those Pumpkin-heads!
dialogsFail.th: เราเป็นผู้รอดชีวิตจากการสังหารหมู่ของ Mr. Pumpkins เรากลายเป็นทหารเพื่อสู้รบและหาทางแก้แค้นของเรา สาปแช่งหัวฟักทองเหล่านั้น!
dialogsFail.tw: 我們是南瓜先生大屠殺的倖存者。為了反擊與復仇，我們成為了戰士。那些該死的南瓜頭！
dialogsFail.vi: Chúng tôi là những người sống sót sau Thảm sát Mr. Pumpkins. Chúng tôi đã trở thành những người lính để chống lại và trả thù. Hãy nguyền rủa kẻ ngu đần Pumpkins!

dialogsBegin.en: There is very dark and evil power behind these masquerpets. I fear my suspicions are correct.
dialogsBegin.ar: There is very dark and evil power behind these masquerpets. I fear my suspicions are correct.
dialogsBegin.br: Há um poder muito sombrio e maligno por trás desses masquerpets. Temo que minhas suspeitas estejam corretas.
dialogsBegin.cns: 在这些怪物背后，有着非常黑暗和邪恶的力量。我担心我的怀疑是正确的。
dialogsBegin.de: Da ist eine sehr dunkle und böse Kraft hinter diesen Monstern. Ich fürchte, meine Befürchtungen waren korrekt.

dialogsBegin.fr: J'ai peur que mes doutes ne soient corrects. Il y a une puissance très sombre et malicieuse derrière ces monstres.
dialogsBegin.id: Ada kekuatan yang sangat gelap dan jahat di balik masquerpet ini. Aku takut kecurigaanku benar.
dialogsBegin.it: There is very dark and evil power behind these masquerpets. I fear my suspicions are correct.
dialogsBegin.jp: このモンスターの背後には、非常に暗く邪悪な力があります。私の疑念が的中したようです。

dialogsBegin.th: เบื้องหลังหน้ากากนี้มีพลังมืดมนและชั่วร้าย ฉันกลัวความสงสัยของฉันถูกต้อง

dialogsBegin.th: masquerpets เหล่านี้ บางตัวได้รับพลังจากตัวแปรยักษ์ สิ่งนี้ทำให้พวกเขามีพลังมากพอที่จะทำลายบาเรียของเราได้!

dialogsComplete.en: Our barrier is safe for now, but there appears to be another army approaching much closer now. This one is a far graver threat than any we have ever faced.
dialogsComplete.ar: Our barrier is safe for now, but there appears to be another army approaching much closer now. This one is a far graver threat than any we have ever faced.
dialogsComplete.br: Nossa barreira está segura por enquanto, mas parece haver outro exército se aproximando muito mais perto agora. Esta é uma ameaça muito mais grave do que qualquer outra que já enfrentamos.
dialogsComplete.cns: 我们的屏障目前是安全的，但现在似乎有另一支军队正在逼近。这个威胁比我们之前所面临的任何威胁都要严重得多。
dialogsComplete.de: Unsere Barriere ist nun sicher, aber es scheint eine andere Armee ist näher. Diese ist eine viel größere Gefahr.
dialogsComplete.fi: Our barrier is safe for now, but there appears to be another army approaching much closer now. This one is a far graver threat than any we have ever faced.
dialogsComplete.fil: Our barrier is safe for now, but there appears to be another army approaching much closer now. This one is a far graver threat than any we have ever faced.
dialogsComplete.fr: Notre barrière est sûre pour le moment, mais une autre armée s'approche à grande vitesse maintenant. Il s'agit d'une plus grande menace que toutes les précédentes.
dialogsComplete.id: Penghalang kita aman untuk saat ini, tetapi tampaknya ada pasukan lain yang mendekat lebih dekat sekarang. Yang ini adalah ancaman yang jauh lebih parah daripada yang pernah kita hadapi.
dialogsComplete.it: Our barrier is safe for now, but there appears to be another army approaching much closer now. This one is a far graver threat than any we have ever faced.
dialogsComplete.jp: 私たちの結界は今のところ安全ですが、別のモンスターがさらに接近しているようです。これは、これまでに直面したどの脅威よりもはるかに深刻な問題です。
dialogsComplete.kr: 방어막이 안전하긴 하지만, 다른 군대가 훨씬 가까이 다가오고 있는 것 같아요. 이번 적은 지금까지 우리가 맞닥뜨린 어느 적들보다도 무서운 녀석들이에요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Our barrier is safe for now, but there appears to be another army approaching much closer now. This one is a far graver threat than any we have ever faced.
dialogsComplete.pl: Our barrier is safe for now, but there appears to be another army approaching much closer now. This one is a far graver threat than any we have ever faced.
dialogsComplete.ru: Our barrier is safe for now, but there appears to be another army approaching much closer now. This one is a far graver threat than any we have ever faced.
dialogsComplete.sp: Nuestra defensa es segura por ahora, pero parece que hay otro ejército acercándose. Esta es una amenaza mucho más seria que cualquier otra a la que nos hayamos enfrentado.
dialogsComplete.sw: Our barrier is safe for now, but there appears to be another army approaching much closer now. This one is a far graver threat than any we have ever faced.
dialogsComplete.th: บาเรียของเราปลอดภัยแล้ว แต่ดูเหมือนว่าจะมีกองทัพอื่นเข้ามาใกล้กว่านี้มาก นี่เป็นภัยคุกคามที่ร้ายแรงกว่าที่เราเคยเผชิญมา
dialogsComplete.tw: 我們的屏障目前是安全的，但現在似乎有另一支軍隊正在逼近，這威脅比我們所面臨的任何威脅都要嚴重得多。
dialogsComplete.vi: Kết giới của chúng ta hiện tại đã an toàn, nhưng có vẻ như có một đội quân khác đang tiến đến gần hơn nhiều. Đây là một mối đe dọa lớn hơn bất kỳ mối đe dọa nào mà chúng ta từng đối mặt.

dialogsBegin.de: Ich habe gehört, dass du immer noch auf der Suche nach den legendären Helden seid, oder? Ich habe von einem mächtigen Krieger gehört, der in Darkon 3 eine umfangreiche Ausbildung absolviert. Das könnte einer der Krieger sein, nach den du suchst.
dialogsBegin.fi: I've heard you are still in search of the legendary heroes, no? I've heard of a powerful warrior undergoing extensive training in Darkon 3. This might be one of the warriors for which you are searching.
dialogsBegin.fil: I've heard you are still in search of the legendary heroes, no? I've heard of a powerful warrior undergoing extensive training in Darkon 3. This might be one of the warriors for which you are searching.
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous cherchez des Héros ? Je n'en ai pas vu depuis longtemps mais… c'est à Darkon 3 qu'ils s'entrainent.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya pernah mendengar Anda masih mencari pahlawan legendaris, bukan? Saya pernah mendengar tentang seorang pejuang yang kuat menjalani pelatihan ekstensif di Darkon 3. Ini mungkin salah satu pejuang yang Anda cari.
dialogsBegin.it: I've heard you are still in search of the legendary heroes, no? I've heard of a powerful warrior undergoing extensive training in Darkon 3. This might be one of the warriors for which you are searching.
dialogsBegin.jp: あら、まだ英雄を探していたのですね。 強力な戦士がダーコン3地域で大規模な訓練を受けていると聞いたことがあります。ひょっとすると、あなたが探している戦士の1人かもしれません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 여전히 영웅에 관심이 많으시군요? 네, 물론 알고 있죠. 마지막 영웅으로 보이는 사람이 다콘 3지구에서 수련을 하고 있다는 소문을 들은 적이 있어요. 당신이 찾는 분이실지도 모르겠네요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I've heard you are still in search of the legendary heroes, no? I've heard of a powerful warrior undergoing extensive training in Darkon 3. This might be one of the warriors for which you are searching.
dialogsBegin.pl: I've heard you are still in search of the legendary heroes, no? I've heard of a powerful warrior undergoing extensive training in Darkon 3. This might be one of the warriors for which you are searching.
dialogsBegin.ru: I've heard you are still in search of the legendary heroes, no? I've heard of a powerful warrior undergoing extensive training in Darkon 3. This might be one of the warriors for which you are searching.
dialogsBegin.sp: He escuchado que todavía estás en busca de los héroes legendarios, ¿no? He oído hablar de una poderosa guerrera que se sometió a un extenso entrenamiento en Darkon 3. Podría ser una de los guerreros que estás buscando.
dialogsBegin.sw: I've heard you are still in search of the legendary heroes, no? I've heard of a powerful warrior undergoing extensive training in Darkon 3. This might be one of the warriors for which you are searching.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันได้ยินมาว่าคุณยังคงค้นหาตำนานวีรบุรุษหรือเปล่า ฉันได้ยินเกี่ยวกับนักรบที่ทรงพลังที่ได้รับการฝึกใน Darkon 3 ซึ่งอาจเป็นหนึ่งในนักรบที่คุณกำลังค้นหาอยู่
dialogsBegin.tw: 聽說你還在尋找傳說中的英雄，對吧？我聽聞得肯第三區有位強大的戰士正進行嚴格訓練，也許就是你要找的人之一。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi nghe nói bạn vẫn đang tìm kiếm những anh hùng huyền thoại, phải không? Tôi đã nghe nói về một chiến binh mạnh mẽ đang trải qua quá trình huấn luyện sâu rộng trong Darkon 3. Đây có thể là một trong những chiến binh mà bạn đang tìm kiếm.

dialogsBegin.en: I was informed of this warrior by my friend Laola, who works in Darkon 3. Please go meet with her for further details!
dialogsBegin.ar: I was informed of this warrior by my friend Laola, who works in Darkon 3. Please go meet with her for further details!
dialogsBegin.br: Fui informado sobre esse guerreiro pela minha amiga Laola, que trabalha em Darkon 3. Por favor, vá se encontrar com ela para mais detalhes!
dialogsBegin.cns: 我的朋友拉宇告诉我这个勇士，她在达肯3，请去见她，了解更多细节！
dialogsBegin.de: Ich wurde von meiner Freundin Laola, die in Darkon 3 arbeitet, über diesen Krieger informiert. Bitte sprecht mit ihr, um weitere Einzelheiten zu erfahren!
dialogsBegin.fi: I was informed of this warrior by my friend Laola, who works in Darkon 3. Please go meet with her for further details!
dialogsBegin.fil: I was informed of this warrior by my friend Laola, who works in Darkon 3. Please go meet with her for further details!
dialogsBegin.fr: Laola connait beaucoup de monde. Elle saura sans doute vous aider.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya diberitahu tentang prajurit ini oleh teman saya Laola, yang bekerja di Darkon 3. Silakan temui dia untuk detail lebih lanjut!
dialogsBegin.it: I was informed of this warrior by my friend Laola, who works in Darkon 3. Please go meet with her for further details!
dialogsBegin.jp: いやいや、今回は無償でお伝えしますって。大魔導師ラオラはご存知ですか？　彼女を訪れてみて下さい。
dialogsBegin.kr: 다콘 3지구에서 연구를 하고 있는 라올라라면 아마 근처에서 수련하고 있는 모습을 봤을지도 모르겠네요. 라올라를 찾아가 보세요!
dialogsBegin.nl: I was informed of this warrior by my friend Laola, who works in Darkon 3. Please go meet with her for further details!
dialogsBegin.pl: I was informed of this warrior by my friend Laola, who works in Darkon 3. Please go meet with her for further details!
dialogsBegin.ru: I was informed of this warrior by my friend Laola, who works in Darkon 3. Please go meet with her for further details!
dialogsBegin.sp: Mi amiga Laola, que está en Darkon 3, me informó sobre esa guerrera. ¡Reúnete con ella para que te dé más detalles!
dialogsBegin.sw: I was informed of this warrior by my friend Laola, who works in Darkon 3. Please go meet with her for further details!
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันได้ยินมาจากเพื่อนของฉันว่า. Laola ทำงานใน Darkon 3 โปรดไปพบกับเธอเพื่อดูรายละเอียดเพิ่มเติม!
dialogsBegin.tw: 這位戰士的消息是我那位在得肯第三區工作的朋友拉宇告訴我的。請去找她了解詳情！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đã được thông báo về chiến binh này bởi người bạn của tôi, Laola, người làm việc trong Darkon 3. Vui lòng đến gặp cô ấy để biết thêm chi tiết!

dialogsAccept.en: Laola should be at her house in the forests of Darkon 3, where she works as a gardener. Just be aware, the area is overrun with many monsters!
dialogsAccept.ar: Laola should be at her house in the forests of Darkon 3, where she works as a gardener. Just be aware, the area is overrun with many monsters!
dialogsAccept.br: Laola deve estar na casa dela nas florestas de Darkon 3, onde trabalha como jardineira. Apenas esteja ciente, a área está rodeada por muitos monstros!
dialogsAccept.cns: 拉宇应该在达肯3森林的房子里，她在那里当园丁。但是要注意，这个地区有很多怪物!
dialogsAccept.de: Laola sollte in ihrem Haus in den Wäldern von Darkon 3 sein, wo sie als Gärtnerin arbeitet. Aber Vorsicht, in der Gegend wimmelt es nur so von Monstern!
dialogsAccept.fi: Laola should be at her house in the forests of Darkon 3, where she works as a gardener. Just be aware, the area is overrun with many monsters!
dialogsAccept.fil: Laola should be at her house in the forests of Darkon 3, where she works as a gardener. Just be aware, the area is overrun with many monsters!
dialogsAccept.fr: Attention quand même, les monstres de Darkon 3 sont violents.
dialogsAccept.id: Laola seharusnya berada di rumahnya di hutan Darkon 3, tempat dia bekerja sebagai tukang kebun. Perlu diketahui, area ini dibanjiri dengan banyak monster!
dialogsAccept.it: Laola should be at her house in the forests of Darkon 3, where she works as a gardener. Just be aware, the area is overrun with many monsters!
dialogsAccept.jp: ラオラは、庭師として働いているダーコン3地域の森にある家にいるはずです。 このエリアは多くのモンスターで溢れていることに注意してください！
dialogsAccept.kr: 라올라는 다콘 3지구의 자기 집에서 연구하고 있답니다. 근처에 험악한 몬스터가 많을 테니 조심해서 가세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Laola should be at her house in the forests of Darkon 3, where she works as a gardener. Just be aware, the area is overrun with many monsters!
dialogsAccept.pl: Laola should be at her house in the forests of Darkon 3, where she works as a gardener. Just be aware, the area is overrun with many monsters!
dialogsAccept.ru: Laola should be at her house in the forests of Darkon 3, where she works as a gardener. Just be aware, the area is overrun with many monsters!
dialogsAccept.sp: Laola debería estar en su casa en los bosques de Darkon 3, donde trabaja como jardinera. ¡Ten en cuenta que el área está invadida por los monstruos!
dialogsAccept.sw: Laola should be at her house in the forests of Darkon 3, where she works as a gardener. Just be aware, the area is overrun with many monsters!
dialogsAccept.th: Laola คงอยู่ที่บ้านของเธอในป่าที่ Darkon 3 ซึ่งเธอเป็นคนทำสวน เพียงแค่ตระหนักไว้ว่า พื้นที่ดังกล่าวจะมีมอนสเตอร์จำนวนมากมาบุกรุก
dialogsAccept.tw: 拉宇應該在得肯第三區森林裡的家中，她在那裡從事園藝工作。要小心，附近到處都是怪物！
dialogsAccept.vi: Laola nên ở nhà của cô ấy trong khu rừng của Darkon 3, nơi cô ấy làm việc như một người làm vườn. Chỉ cần lưu ý, khu vực này đang tràn ngập nhiều loại quái vật!

dialogsDecline.en: Too bad! Well if you are free, wanna help me complete some more deliveries?
dialogsDecline.ar: Too bad! Well if you are free, wanna help me complete some more deliveries?
dialogsDecline.br: Que pena! Bem, se você está livre, quer me ajudar a completar mais algumas entregas???
dialogsDecline.cns: Too bad! Well if you are free, wanna help me complete some more deliveries?
dialogsDecline.de: Schade! Wenn du Zeit hast, kannst du mir helfen, noch ein paar Lieferungen zu erledigen.
dialogsDecline.fi: Too bad! Well if you are free, wanna help me complete some more deliveries?
dialogsDecline.fil: Too bad! Well if you are free, wanna help me complete some more deliveries?
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous avez raison, faire vos courses ici est beaucoup plus sûr… pour le moment.
dialogsDecline.id: Sayang sekali! Jika kamu ada waktu luang, apakah ingin membantuku menyelesaikan beberapa pengiriman lagi???
dialogsDecline.it: Too bad! Well if you are free, wanna help me complete some more deliveries?
dialogsDecline.jp: そうですか？　あ、暇なら、配達手伝ってくれませんか？
dialogsDecline.kr: 저런! 한가하시다면, 배달할 물건이 더 있는데 도와주실래요?
dialogsDecline.nl: Too bad! Well if you are free, wanna help me complete some more deliveries?
dialogsDecline.pl: Too bad! Well if you are free, wanna help me complete some more deliveries?
dialogsDecline.ru: Too bad! Well if you are free, wanna help me complete some more deliveries?
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Qué mal! Bueno, si estás libre, ¿¿¿quieres ayudarme con algunas entregas más???
dialogsDecline.sw: Too bad! Well if you are free, wanna help me complete some more deliveries?
dialogsDecline.th: แย่หน่อยนะ! แต่ ถ้าคุณอยากเป็นอิสระ คุณต้องช่วยฉันส่งบางอย่างให้หน่อย
dialogsDecline.tw: 真可惜！不過如果你有空，要不要再幫我跑幾趟送貨？
dialogsDecline.vi: Tệ quá! Chà nếu bạn rảnh, có muốn giúp tôi hoàn thành thêm một số chuyến giao hàng không?

dialogsComplete.en: Hey now! Who are you? Why are you coming to my flower garden without any permission?
dialogsComplete.ar: Hey now! Who are you? Why are you coming to my flower garden without any permission?
dialogsComplete.br: Ei! Quem é Você?? Por que você está vindo ao meu jardim de flores sem qualquer permissão?
dialogsComplete.cns: Hey now! Who are you? Why are you coming to my flower garden without any permission?
dialogsComplete.de: Hey du! Wer bist du? Warum kommst du ohne Erlaubnis in meinen Blumengarten?
dialogsComplete.fi: Hey now! Who are you? Why are you coming to my flower garden without any permission?
dialogsComplete.fil: Hey now! Who are you? Why are you coming to my flower garden without any permission?
dialogsComplete.fr: Hep là-bas, qui va là ? Vous êtes sur mon spot !
dialogsComplete.id: Hei! Siapa kamu?? Mengapa datang ke taman bungaku tanpa izin??
dialogsComplete.it: Hey now! Who are you? Why are you coming to my flower garden without any permission?
dialogsComplete.jp: あら……貴方はどこかでお会いしたことがありましたか？
dialogsComplete.kr: 이봐요! 누구시죠? 왜 허락도 없이 제 꽃밭에 들어와 있는 거예요?
dialogsComplete.nl: Hey now! Who are you? Why are you coming to my flower garden without any permission?
dialogsComplete.pl: Hej Ty! Kim jesteś? Dlaczego przyszedłeś do mojego ogrodu bez mojej zgody?
dialogsComplete.ru: Hey now! Who are you? Why are you coming to my flower garden without any permission?
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Eh tú! ¿¿Quién eres?? ¿¿Por qué vienes a mi jardín de flores sin permiso??
dialogsComplete.sw: Hey now! Who are you? Why are you coming to my flower garden without any permission?
dialogsComplete.th: เฮ้! คุณคือใคร?? ทำไมคุณเข้ามาในสวนดอกไม้ของฉันโดยไม่ได้รับอนุญาต?
dialogsComplete.tw: 喂喂！你是誰？沒經過允許，怎麼跑進我的花園來了？
dialogsComplete.vi: Này này! Bạn là ai?? Tại sao bạn tự ý đến vườn hoa của tôi mà không được cho phép vậy??

dialogsFail.ar: Laola will be in Darkon 3. Please go find her!
dialogsFail.br: Laola estará em Darkon 3. Por favor, vá encontrá-la!
dialogsFail.cns: 拉宇在达肯3。请去找她!
dialogsFail.de: Laola wird in Darkon 3 sein. Bitte geh und finde sie!
dialogsFail.fi: Laola will be in Darkon 3. Please go find her!
dialogsFail.fil: Laola will be in Darkon 3. Please go find her!
dialogsFail.fr: Laola s'entraine à Darkon 3. Allez la voir vite.
dialogsFail.id: Laola akan berada di Darkon 3. Silakan cari dia!
dialogsFail.it: Laola will be in Darkon 3. Please go find her!
dialogsFail.jp: ラオラはダーコン3地域に住み、色々な研究をしているそうです。
dialogsFail.kr: 라올라는 다콘 제3지구에 있을 겁니다. 가서 라올라를 찾아 주세요!
dialogsFail.nl: Laola will be in Darkon 3. Please go find her!
dialogsFail.pl: Laola will be in Darkon 3. Please go find her!
dialogsFail.ru: Laola will be in Darkon 3. Please go find her!
dialogsFail.sp: Encontrarás a Laola en Darkon 3. ¡Ve y encuéntrala!
dialogsFail.sw: Laola will be in Darkon 3. Please go find her!
dialogsFail.th: Laola จะอยู่ใน Darkon 3. ไปพบเธอ!
dialogsFail.tw: 拉宇就在得肯第三區，請去找她！
dialogsFail.vi: Laola sẽ ở Darkon 3. Hãy đi tìm cô ấy!

description.en: Slay 20 Small Mias and return to Porgo, in Saint City.
description.ar: Slay 20 Small Mias and return to Porgo, in Saint City.
description.br: Ótimo. Então por favor lute com 20 Pequenas Mias e me fale a respeito delas.
description.cns: 好，你去猎杀20只粗布米娅娃娃之后，告诉我他们的特征吧!
description.de: Gut. Dann kämpfe mit 20 Small Mias und erzähle mir von ihrem Charakter.
description.fi: Slay 20 Small Mias and return to Porgo, in Saint City.
description.fil: Slay 20 Small Mias and return to Porgo, in Saint City.
description.fr: Affronter 20 Jeune Mias afin de mieux comprendre leur caractère.
description.id: Bunuh 20 Mia Kecil dan kembali ke Porgo, di Saint City.
description.it: Slay 20 Small Mias and return to Porgo, in Saint City.
description.jp: ＜スモール・ミーア＞20匹と戦って、彼らの特徴を観察し、ポルゴに報告しよう。
description.kr: 작은 미아 20마리를 처치하고, 세인트 시티의 포르고에게 돌아가세요.
