description.ru: Нужно сразиться с двадцатью юными Миа и поговорить с Патом Тинкертоном в Санто.
description.sp: Derrota a 20 Mias Pequeñas y regresa con Porgo, en Saint.
description.sw: Slay 20 Small Mias and return to Porgo, in Saint City.
description.th: ฆ่า Small Mias 20 ตัว และกลับไปที่ Porgo ใน Saint City
description.tw: 好，你去獵殺 20 隻米兒妹妹之後，告訴我他們的特徵吧！
description.vi: Giết 20 Small Mias và trở về Porgo, ở Saint City.

dialogsBegin.en: The case of the missing children? Hmm... Well a few years ago, a group of young, six year old girls suddenly disappeared from Saint City.
dialogsBegin.ar: The case of the missing children? Hmm... Well a few years ago, a group of young, six year old girls suddenly disappeared from Saint City.
dialogsBegin.br: O caso das crianças desaparecidas? Hmm... Bem, alguns anos atrás um grupo de jovens garotas de seis anos desapareceu de repente de Saint.
dialogsBegin.cns: The case of the missing children? Hmm... Well a few years ago, a group of young, six year old girls suddenly disappeared from Saint City.
dialogsBegin.de: Der Fall der verschwundenen Kinder? Hmm.. Vor ein paar Jahren, sind einige Mädchen unter 6 Jahren plötzlich aus Saint Morning verschwunden.
dialogsBegin.fi: The case of the missing children? Hmm... Well a few years ago, a group of young, six year old girls suddenly disappeared from Saint City.
dialogsBegin.fil: The case of the missing children? Hmm... Well a few years ago, a group of young, six year old girls suddenly disappeared from Saint City.
dialogsBegin.fr: Hmm... Il y a quelques années, un grand nombre de petites filles de moins de 6 ans ont soudainement disparu de Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.id: Kasus anak hilang? Hmm.. beberapa tahun yang lalu, sekelompok gadis muda berusia enam tahun tiba-tiba menghilang dari Saint City.
dialogsBegin.it: The case of the missing children? Hmm... Well a few years ago, a group of young, six year old girls suddenly disappeared from Saint City.
dialogsBegin.jp: 失踪事件について詳しく聞かせてくれって？オーケー、これから話してあげよう。そう、今から数年前。セイントモーニングに住む満6歳以下の小さな女の子たちが突然理由もなく、大勢失踪してしまう事件が発生したんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 실종된 아이들의 이야기를 아세요? 흠... 몇 년 전, 세인트 시티에서 여섯 살 여자아이들이 갑자기 실종되었어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: The case of the missing children? Hmm... Well a few years ago, a group of young, six year old girls suddenly disappeared from Saint City.
dialogsBegin.pl: The case of the missing children? Hmm... Well a few years ago, a group of young, six year old girls suddenly disappeared from Saint City.
dialogsBegin.ru: The case of the missing children? Hmm... Well a few years ago, a group of young, six year old girls suddenly disappeared from Saint City.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿El caso de las niñas desaparecidas? Hmm... Bueno, hace unos años, un grupo de niñas de seis años desapareció repentinamente de Saint.
dialogsBegin.sw: The case of the missing children? Hmm... Well a few years ago, a group of young, six year old girls suddenly disappeared from Saint City.
dialogsBegin.th: เรื่อวเด็กหายน่ะเหรอ? อืม... เมื่อไม่กี่ปีก่อน จู่ๆ พวกเด็กสาวสาวอายุ 6 ขวบก็หายไปจาก Saint City
dialogsBegin.tw: 失蹤孩童的事件？嗯……幾年前，聖城有一群年僅六歲的小女孩突然失蹤了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Vụ án những đứa trẻ mất tích? Hmm .. Chà vài năm trước, một nhóm các bé gái sáu tuổi đột nhiên biến mất khỏi Saint City.

dialogsBegin.en: Everyone attempted to find the kids, but they all failed.
dialogsBegin.ar: Everyone attempted to find the kids, but they all failed.
dialogsBegin.br: Todos tentaram encontrar as crianças, mas falharam.
dialogsBegin.cns: 当时，城镇管理所与其他机构都去查询，但是找不到任何线索，后续就处理为未解决事件。
dialogsBegin.de: Jeder Versuch die Kinder zu finden, scheiterte jedoch.
dialogsBegin.fi: Everyone attempted to find the kids, but they all failed.
dialogsBegin.fil: Everyone attempted to find the kids, but they all failed.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tous les habitants sont partis à la recherche des enfants, mais tous ont échoué.
dialogsBegin.id: Semua orang berusaha menemukan anak-anak itu, tetapi mereka semua gagal.
dialogsBegin.it: Everyone attempted to find the kids, but they all failed.
dialogsBegin.jp: 当時はシティーホールを始めいろんな機関で調査を行っていたんだが、全く成果がなく、事件は迷宮入りとして処理されてしまった。
dialogsBegin.kr: 사람들은 아이들을 찾으려고 여러 방면으로 노력했지만, 전부 실패로 끝났어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Everyone attempted to find the kids, but they all failed.
dialogsBegin.pl: Everyone attempted to find the kids, but they all failed.
dialogsBegin.ru: Все поиски оказались бесплодными.
dialogsBegin.sp: Todos intentaron encontrar a las niñas, pero todos fallaron.
dialogsBegin.sw: Everyone attempted to find the kids, but they all failed.
dialogsBegin.th: ทุกคนพยายามที่จะตามหาเด็กๆ แต่พวกเขาทั้งหมดก็ล้มเหลว
dialogsBegin.tw: 當時，城鎮管理所與其他機構都去查詢，但是找不到任何線索，後續就處理為未解決事件。
dialogsBegin.vi: Mọi người đều cố gắng tìm kiếm những đứa trẻ, nhưng tất cả đều thất bại.

dialogsBegin.en: I never gave up and I kept trying to solve the case. I had discovered many things, and reported them to the Public Office.
dialogsBegin.ar: I never gave up and I kept trying to solve the case. I had discovered many things, and reported them to the Public Office.
dialogsBegin.br: Mas nunca desisti e ainda estou tentando resolver o caso. Descobri várias coisas, e as relatei ao gabinete.
dialogsBegin.cns: 可是，我发现了一些可疑的事情，后来提出给城镇管理所。
dialogsBegin.de: Aber ich habe nie aufgegeben und versuchte weiterhin den Fall zu lösen. Schließlich fand ich jede Menge Informationen und meldete sie dem Rathaus.
dialogsBegin.fi: I never gave up and I kept trying to solve the case. I had discovered many things, and reported them to the Public Office.
dialogsBegin.fil: I never gave up and I kept trying to solve the case. I had discovered many things, and reported them to the Public Office.
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais je n'ai jamais abandonné, j'ai toujours essayé de résoudre cette affaire. Finalement j'ai trouvé pas mal d'éléments que j'ai rapporté à l'office public.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya tidak pernah menyerah dan saya terus berusaha untuk menyelesaikan kasus ini. Saya telah menemukan banyak hal, dan melaporkannya ke Public Office.
dialogsBegin.it: I never gave up and I kept trying to solve the case. I had discovered many things, and reported them to the Public Office.
dialogsBegin.jp: しかし、俺には何か気になる部分があった。独自で調査を続け、たくさんの情報を集めることができたんだが、その事実をまとめて、シティーホールへ報告書を提出したのさ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 하지만 전 포기하지 않았어요. 계속 사건을 파헤쳐서, 알아낸 사실들을 모두 관공서에 제출했죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: I never gave up and I kept trying to solve the case. I had discovered many things, and reported them to the Public Office.
dialogsBegin.pl: I never gave up and I kept trying to solve the case. I had discovered many things, and reported them to the Public Office.
dialogsBegin.ru: Но я не сдался. Я провел собственное расследование и узнал несколько очень странных фактов… Я сообщил о них мэру.
dialogsBegin.sp: Nunca me rendí y seguí buscando pistas para resolver el caso. Descubrí muchas cosas, y se las informé a la Oficina Pública.
dialogsBegin.sw: I never gave up and I kept trying to solve the case. I had discovered many things, and reported them to the Public Office.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันไม่เคยยอมแพ้ และฉันก็พยายามที่จะแก้ปัญหานี้ให้ได้ ฉันค้นพบหลายสิ่งหลายอย่างและได้รายงานไปยัง Public Office แล้ว
dialogsBegin.tw: 可是，我發現了一些可疑的事情，後來提出給城鎮管理所。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi không bao giờ bỏ cuộc và tôi tiếp tục cố gắng giải quyết vụ án. Tôi phát hiện ra nhiều thứ, và đã báo cáo cho Public Office.

dialogsBegin.en: However, they rejected my findings due to the lack of evidence. So as I was gathering evidence, I suddenly came up with an idea when I saw those strange Masquerpets; Mia.
dialogsBegin.ar: However, they rejected my findings due to the lack of evidence. So as I was gathering evidence, I suddenly came up with an idea when I saw those strange Masquerpets; Mia.
dialogsBegin.br: No entanto minhas descobertas foram rejeitadas devido à falta de provas. Eu estava reunindo evidências quando de repente tive uma idéia quando vi um Masquerpet esquisito chamada Mia.
dialogsBegin.cns: 可是，他们说证据不足，所以被退回来了，我看到怪物米娅娃娃之后才想到了一些东西..
dialogsBegin.de: Jedenfalls wurde ich abgelehnt, aufgrund mangelnder Beweise. Also sammelte ich die Beweise und plötzlich kam mir eine Idee als ich die Mias sah.
dialogsBegin.fi: However, they rejected my findings due to the lack of evidence. So as I was gathering evidence, I suddenly came up with an idea when I saw those strange Masquerpets; Mia.
dialogsBegin.fil: However, they rejected my findings due to the lack of evidence. So as I was gathering evidence, I suddenly came up with an idea when I saw those strange Masquerpets; Mia.
dialogsBegin.fr: Malgré cela j'ai été éconduit en raison du manque de preuves. Alors que je rassemblais d'autres indices, une idée m'a traversé l'esprit quand j'ai vu un étrange monstre, Mia.
dialogsBegin.id: Namun, mereka menolak temuan saya karena kurangnya bukti. Jadi ketika saya sedang mengumpulkan bukti, saya tiba-tiba mendapat ide ketika saya melihat Masquerpet yang aneh itu; Mia.
dialogsBegin.it: However, they rejected my findings due to the lack of evidence. So as I was gathering evidence, I suddenly came up with an idea when I saw those strange Masquerpets; Mia.
dialogsBegin.jp: しかし、その書類は証拠不十分という理由であっさり棄却されてしまった。理由はわからない。それで再び証拠を集めようと、ミーアというモンスターについて調べていたところ、あることに気がついた。
dialogsBegin.kr: 하지만 제 주장은 증거 부족을 이유로 전부 기각당했어요. 증거를 모으던 중, 미아라는 이상한 마스커펫들을 보고 문득 떠오른 게 있었죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: However, they rejected my findings due to the lack of evidence. So as I was gathering evidence, I suddenly came up with an idea when I saw those strange Masquerpets; Mia.
dialogsBegin.pl: However, they rejected my findings due to the lack of evidence. So as I was gathering evidence, I suddenly came up with an idea when I saw those strange Masquerpets; Mia.
dialogsBegin.ru: Но у меня не было доказательств - одни подозрения. Мэр прочитал рапорт и отмахнулся. Тогда я начал собирать улики. Я столкнулся с марионетками, которых называют Миа, и…
dialogsBegin.sp: Sin embargo, rechazaron mis conclusiones debido a la falta de pruebas. Entonces, mientras estaba reuniendo pruebas, se me ocurrió una idea al ver a esos extraños Masquerpets llamados Mia.
dialogsBegin.sw: However, they rejected my findings due to the lack of evidence. So as I was gathering evidence, I suddenly came up with an idea when I saw those strange Masquerpets; Mia.
dialogsBegin.th: แต่ว่าพวกเขากลับปฏิเสธสิ่งที่ฉันหาไป เพราะว่ามันขาดหลักฐาน ฉันก็เลยรวบรวมพยานหลักฐาน แล้วฉันก็เกิดมีความคิดขึ้นมาตอนที่เห็น Masquerpets แปลกๆ นั่นก็คือ Mia
dialogsBegin.tw: 可是，他們說證據不足，所以被退回來了，我看到一個叫米兒的稀奇怪物之後才想到了一些東西…
dialogsBegin.vi: Tuy nhiên, họ đã bác bỏ phát hiện của tôi do thiếu bằng chứng. Vì vậy, khi đang thu thập bằng chứng, tôi chợt nảy ra ý tưởng khi nhìn thấy những con Masquerpets kỳ lạ đó; Mia.

dialogsBegin.en: Anyway, will you help me?
dialogsBegin.ar: Anyway, will you help me?
dialogsBegin.br: Então... Você me ajudaria, por favor?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你可以帮我吗?
dialogsBegin.de: Also... würdest du mir bitte helfen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Anyway, will you help me?
dialogsBegin.fil: Anyway, will you help me?
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu voudrais bien m'aider?
dialogsBegin.id: Bagaimanapun juga, maukah kamu membantuku?
dialogsBegin.it: Anyway, will you help me?
dialogsBegin.jp: どうだい？この話を聞いて、私に協力してくれる気になったかい？
dialogsBegin.kr: 그나저나… 도와주실 수 있겠어요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Anyway, will you help me?
dialogsBegin.pl: Anyway, will you help me?
dialogsBegin.ru: Все равно не поверишь. Лучше посмотри собственными глазами. Договорились?
dialogsBegin.sp: Bueno, ¿me ayudarás?
dialogsBegin.sw: Anyway, will you help me?
dialogsBegin.th: อย่างไรก็ตาม คุณจะช่วยฉันได้ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你可以幫我嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Dù sao, bạn sẽ giúp tôi?

dialogsAccept.en: Great! Slay 20 Small Mias and tell me what you make of them.
dialogsAccept.ar: Great! Slay 20 Small Mias and tell me what you make of them.
dialogsAccept.br: Ótimo. Então lute com 20 Pequenas Mias e me diga o que você descobre a respeito delas.
dialogsAccept.cns: 好，你去猎杀20只粗布米娅娃娃之后，告诉我他们的特征好吗?
dialogsAccept.de: Gut. Dann bekämpfe 20 Small Mias und erzähle mir von ihrem Charakter.
dialogsAccept.fi: Great! Slay 20 Small Mias and tell me what you make of them.
dialogsAccept.fil: Great! Slay 20 Small Mias and tell me what you make of them.
dialogsAccept.fr: Bien. Alors va affronter 20 Jeunes Mias et dis-m'en plus sur leur caractère.
dialogsAccept.id: Bagus! Bunuh 20 Little Mia dan ceritakan pendapatmu tentang mereka.
dialogsAccept.it: Great! Slay 20 Small Mias and tell me what you make of them.
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとう、協力してくれるんだね。じゃあ、スモール・ミーア20匹と戦って、彼らの特徴を観察し、私に報告してくれ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 감사해요! 작은 미아 20마리를 처치하고, 어떤 느낌이었는 저에게 알려주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Great! Slay 20 Small Mias and tell me what you make of them.
dialogsAccept.pl: Great! Slay 20 Small Mias and tell me what you make of them.
dialogsAccept.ru: Отлично. Сразись с двадцатью юными Миа и скажи, не заметишь ли ты в них одной странности… Какой, я пока не скажу.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Estupendo! Derrota a 20 Mias Pequeñas y dime qué piensas de ellas.
dialogsAccept.sw: Great! Slay 20 Small Mias and tell me what you make of them.
dialogsAccept.th: ดีมาก! จงฆ่า Small Mias 20 ตัว แล้วบอกฉันว่าคุณคิดยังไงกับพวกมัน
dialogsAccept.tw: 好，你去獵殺 20 隻米兒妹妹之後，告訴我他們的特徵好嗎？
dialogsAccept.vi: Tuyệt quá! Giết 20 Small Mias và cho tôi bằng chứng.

dialogsDecline.en: That's a shame. I guess there's no hope for those girls…
dialogsDecline.ar: That's a shame. I guess there's no hope for those girls…
dialogsDecline.br: Devo pedir isso a você porque não acredito que eu consiga fazer eu mesmo. Mas não posso e não forçarei você a fazer isso.
dialogsDecline.cns: 因为对我来说是很困难的事情，所以才请你帮我的。如果你也不想帮我的话，也没办法啦。
dialogsDecline.de: Ich bitte dich etwas zu tun weil es für mich zu schwierig ist. Aber ich kann dich nicht zwingen... Puh..
dialogsDecline.fi: That's a shame. I guess there's no hope for those girls…
dialogsDecline.fil: That's a shame. I guess there's no hope for those girls…
dialogsDecline.fr: Je te demande de le faire car moi-même j'en serai incapable. Mais je ne peux pas te forcer.
dialogsDecline.id: Sangat memalukan. menurutku tidak ada harapan untuk gadis-gadis itu…
dialogsDecline.it: That's a shame. I guess there's no hope for those girls…
dialogsDecline.jp: そうか。そうそう簡単な事件ではないからな。残念だが、仕方ない。別の人にでも頼むさ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 그렇게 되었군요… 그 아이들에게 희망은 없겠네요…
dialogsDecline.nl: That's a shame. I guess there's no hope for those girls…
dialogsDecline.pl: That's a shame. I guess there's no hope for those girls…
dialogsDecline.ru: Жаль. Значит, девочек уже не спасти…
dialogsDecline.sp: Es una pena. Supongo que no hay esperanza para esas niñas...
dialogsDecline.sw: That's a shame. I guess there's no hope for those girls…
dialogsDecline.th: น่าเสียดายจริงๆ คงไม่มีหวังที่จะตามหาเด็กสาวเหล่านั้นแล้วล่ะ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 因為對我來說是很困難的事情，所以才請你幫我的。如果你也不想幫我的話，也沒辦法啦。
dialogsDecline.vi: Thật là xấu hổ. Tôi đoán không có hy vọng cho những bé gái đó…

dialogsBegin.kr: 발린이 쿠키 제조기 가동을 위해 슬레인을 구해 달라고 부탁합니다. 도와주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Valin needs you to collect Slain to fuel his Cookie Machine. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.pl: Valin needs you to collect Slain to fuel his Cookie Machine. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.ru: Так-так, посмотрим…  'Валину нужны клыки волкопардов, чтобы собрать автомат, перемалывающий шоколадную крошку для печенья.' Возьмешься?

dialogsBegin.th: Valin ต้องการให้คุณรวบรวม Slain เพื่อเติมเชื้อเพลิงให้กับ Cookie Machine ของเขา คุณจะช่วยไหม
dialogsBegin.tw: 巴陵為了製造麵包，需要一些餅乾製造機的燃料，所以委託本中心去收集『賤狼指甲』。你要接受嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Valin cần bạn thu thập Slain để cung cấp nhiên liệu cho Máy làm bánh quy của anh ta. Bạn sẽ giúp chứ?

description.en: Find the Disappearance Investigation report buried somewhere near Saint Hall and bring it to Porgo.
description.ar: Find the Disappearance Investigation report buried somewhere near Saint Hall and bring it to Porgo.
description.br: Se isso for verdade, o relatório original foi enterrado em algum lugar perto da Prefeitura de Saint. Por favor, traga-o para mim.
description.cns: 如果这纸条里面写的是真相的话，在晨光圣教堂附近一定有真实的内容书籍。去找吧。
description.de: Wenn das wahr ist, dann wurde der echte Bericht irgendwo in der Nähe von Saint Morning Halle vergraben. Bitte bring ihn mir.
description.fi: Find the Disappearance Investigation report buried somewhere near Saint Hall and bring it to Porgo.
description.fil: Find the Disappearance Investigation report buried somewhere near Saint Hall and bring it to Porgo.
description.fr: Si c'est vrai, le rapport original a été enterré quelque part près de Saint Hall. s'il te plaît ramènes-le moi.
description.id: Temukan laporan Investigasi Penghilangan yang terkubur di suatu tempat dekat Saint Hall dan bawa ke Porgo.
description.it: Find the Disappearance Investigation report buried somewhere near Saint Hall and bring it to Porgo.
description.jp: セイントホール近くのどこかに本物の調査書が埋めてあるという。セイントホール周辺を探して調査書を探し、ポルゴに渡そう。
description.kr: 세인트 홀 근처에 묻혀 있는 실종 사건 조사 보고서를 찾아 포르고에게 가져가세요.
description.nl: Find the Disappearance Investigation report buried somewhere near Saint Hall and bring it to Porgo.
description.pl: Find the Disappearance Investigation report buried somewhere near Saint Hall and bring it to Porgo.
description.ru: Нужно найти за ратушей материалы, изъятые из дела о пропавших девочках, и отнести их Тинкертону.
description.sp: Encuentra el informe de Investigación de Desaparición que está enterrado en algún lugar cerca del Ayuntamiento de Saint y llévaselo a Porgo.
description.sw: Find the Disappearance Investigation report buried somewhere near Saint Hall and bring it to Porgo.
description.th: ค้นหารายงานการตรวจสอบการหายตัวไปฝังอยู่ที่ไหนสักแห่งที่อยู่ใกล้กับ Saint Hall และนำไปให้ Porgo
description.tw: 如果這紙條裡面寫的是真相的話，在聖音特教堂附近一定有真實的內容書籍。去找吧。
description.vi: Tìm bản báo cáo Điều tra Biến mất được chôn cất ở đâu đó gần Saint Hall và mang nó cho Porgo.

dialogsBegin.en: Yes! This is it! The report was definitely written with all the facts, but not all the facts were ever proven.
dialogsBegin.ar: Yes! This is it! The report was definitely written with all the facts, but not all the facts were ever proven.
dialogsBegin.br: Sim! É isso! O relatório foi definitivamente escrito, mas não se sabiam de todos os fatos para que tudo fosse provado.
dialogsBegin.cns: 对!就是这个，调查书里面都会记录真相，但是不一定完全是真的。
dialogsBegin.de: Ja! Das ist es! Dieser Bericht hat alle Fakten in sich, aber nicht alle davon konnten bisher bewiesen werden.
dialogsBegin.fi: Yes! This is it! The report was definitely written with all the facts, but not all the facts were ever proven.
dialogsBegin.fil: Yes! This is it! The report was definitely written with all the facts, but not all the facts were ever proven.
dialogsBegin.fr: Oui! C'est cela! Le rapport contient bien tous les faits, mais tous n'ont pas pu être complètement prouvés
dialogsBegin.id: Ya! Ini dia! Laporan itu pasti ditulis dengan semua fakta, tetapi tidak semua fakta terbukti.
dialogsBegin.it: Yes! This is it! The report was definitely written with all the facts, but not all the facts were ever proven.
dialogsBegin.jp: そうそう、これこれ。この調査書に書かれていることが事実なのは明らかなんだが、完全な事実ではない。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그래요! 이제 알겠어요! 이 보고서가 사실을 기록한 건 분명하지만, 그렇다고 완전한 사실을 기록한 것도 아니었어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Yes! This is it! The report was definitely written with all the facts, but not all the facts were ever proven.
dialogsBegin.pl: Yes! This is it! The report was definitely written with all the facts, but not all the facts were ever proven.
dialogsBegin.ru: Пока тебя не было, я просмотрел материалы дела. Мэр, конечно, прав: доказательств мало, такое обвинение ни один судья рассматривать не станет!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Sí! ¡Eso es! El informe se ha escrito con todos los hechos, pero no todos se han probado.
dialogsBegin.sw: Yes! This is it! The report was definitely written with all the facts, but not all the facts were ever proven.
dialogsBegin.th: ใช่ นี่ไง! รายงานถูกเขียนด้วยข้อเท็จจริงทั้งหมด แต่ไม่ใช่ทั้งหมดที่ได้รับการพิสูจน์
dialogsBegin.tw: 對！就是這個，調查書裡面都會記錄真相，但是不一定完全是真的。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đúng! Nó đấy! Báo cáo chắc chắn được viết với tất cả các sự kiện, nhưng không phải tất cả các sự kiện đều đã được chứng minh.

dialogsBegin.en: And the color of some of the pages in the report are slightly different. They must have been added later…
dialogsBegin.ar: And the color of some of the pages in the report are slightly different. They must have been added later…
dialogsBegin.br: E a coloração de alguns papéis do relatório é um pouco diferente. Parece que foram adicionados posteriormente...
dialogsBegin.cns: 还有几张纸的颜色有些不同，感觉像是后来再补贴的感觉。
dialogsBegin.de: Die Farbe einiger Blätter in dem Bericht sieht ein bisschen anders aus. Scheint so als wären sie erst später hinzugefügt worden.
dialogsBegin.fi: And the color of some of the pages in the report are slightly different. They must have been added later…
dialogsBegin.fil: And the color of some of the pages in the report are slightly different. They must have been added later…
dialogsBegin.fr: Et la couleur de certaines feuilles est différente. Elles ont dû être ajoutées plus tard.
dialogsBegin.id: Dan warna beberapa halaman dalam laporan sedikit berbeda. Mereka pasti telah ditambahkan nantinya…
dialogsBegin.it: And the color of some of the pages in the report are slightly different. They must have been added later…
dialogsBegin.jp: ほら、ここを見てくれ！他のページと比べて明らかに紙の色が違う部分があるだろう？ここだけ新しくページを差し替えているんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그리고 보고서 중 몇 장은 색이 살짝 달라요. 나중에 추가된 게 틀림없어요…
dialogsBegin.nl: And the color of some of the pages in the report are slightly different. They must have been added later…
dialogsBegin.pl: And the color of some of the pages in the report are slightly different. They must have been added later…
dialogsBegin.ru: И еще, смотри: дело-то старое, и страницы успели пожелтеть. А вот эти - видишь? - белые! Их добавили позже!
dialogsBegin.sp: Y el color de algunas de las páginas del informe es ligeramente diferente. Deben haberlas agregado más tarde...
dialogsBegin.sw: And the color of some of the pages in the report are slightly different. They must have been added later…
dialogsBegin.th: แล้วสีของหน้าบางหน้าในรายงานก็ต่างกันเล็กน้อย มันต้องถูกเพิ่มมาที่หลังแน่ๆ ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 還有幾張紙的顏色有些不同，感覺像是後來再補貼的感覺。
dialogsBegin.vi: Và màu sắc của một số trang trong báo cáo hơi khác một chút. Chúng phải được thêm sau…

dialogsBegin.en: It must be because they are trying to keep this whole thing a secret. This is a memo that proves what has been done.
dialogsBegin.ar: It must be because they are trying to keep this whole thing a secret. This is a memo that proves what has been done.
dialogsBegin.br: Deve ser porque eles estão tentando manter isso tudo em segredo. Mas eu obtive a prova exata. Parece que eles não encontraram o memorando. Por favor, observe.
dialogsBegin.cns: 一定有什么问题，我找到了一个证据，可能他们在制造的时候，忘了这张纸条的存在吧..上面写着
dialogsBegin.de: Das liegt daran weil sie etwas verheimlichen. Aber ich habe den exakten Beweis. Es scheint so als hätten sie diese Notiz übersehen. Sieh mal.
dialogsBegin.fi: It must be because they are trying to keep this whole thing a secret. This is a memo that proves what has been done.
dialogsBegin.fil: It must be because they are trying to keep this whole thing a secret. This is a memo that proves what has been done.
dialogsBegin.fr: C'est parce qu'il garde quelque chose de secret. Mais j'en ai la preuve. Regardes on dirait qu'ils n'ont pas vu le post-it. va-y regardes.
dialogsBegin.id: Pasti karena mereka berusaha merahasiakan semua ini. Ini adalah memo yang membuktikan apa yang telah dilakukan.
dialogsBegin.it: It must be because they are trying to keep this whole thing a secret. This is a memo that proves what has been done.
dialogsBegin.jp: きっとまだ何か隠されていることがあるんだ。あいつら、おかしなことが書いてあるページまではちゃんとチェックしなかったようだ。ほら、ここのページだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 분명 무언가 감추는 게 있어. 작업을 하면서 이 쪽지는 미처 발견하지 못했던 것 같아요.
dialogsBegin.nl: It must be because they are trying to keep this whole thing a secret. This is a memo that proves what has been done.
dialogsBegin.pl: It must be because they are trying to keep this whole thing a secret. This is a memo that proves what has been done.
dialogsBegin.ru: Похоже, кто-то очень хотел сохранить всю эту историю в тайне. Но он забыл уничтожить памятку!
dialogsBegin.sp: Debe ser porque están tratando de mantener todo esto en secreto. Esta es una nota que prueba lo que se ha hecho.
dialogsBegin.sw: It must be because they are trying to keep this whole thing a secret. This is a memo that proves what has been done.
dialogsBegin.th: ต้องเป็นเพราะพวกเขากำลังพยายามทำให้ทั้งหมดนี้เป็นความลับ นี่คือบันทึกที่ได้รับการพิสูจน์แล้ว
dialogsBegin.tw: 一定有什麼問題，我找到了一個證據，可能他們在製造的時候，忘了這張紙條的存在吧…上面寫著
dialogsBegin.vi: Chắc là vì họ đang cố giữ bí mật toàn bộ chuyện này. Đây là một bản ghi nhớ chứng minh những điều đã thực hiện.

dialogsBegin.en: The memo instructs them to change the pages in the official report and bury the original behind Saint Hall. We're about to uncover the truth to this mystery!
dialogsBegin.ar: The memo instructs them to change the pages in the official report and bury the original behind Saint Hall. We're about to uncover the truth to this mystery!
dialogsBegin.br: O memorando diz para alterar os papéis e enterrar o original atrás da Prefeitura de Saint. Eles são bobos! Estamos prestes a descobrir a verdade desse mistério!
dialogsBegin.cns: <…掉换书页，然后把真实的东西埋到晨光圣教堂附近>。这些傻瓜，所谓太阳底下无新事。
dialogsBegin.de: ...tausch die Seiten aus und vergrab die echte in der Nähe von der Saint Morning Halle. Sie sind dumm! Man kann die Wahrheit nicht verheimlichen.
dialogsBegin.fi: The memo instructs them to change the pages in the official report and bury the original behind Saint Hall. We're about to uncover the truth to this mystery!
dialogsBegin.fil: The memo instructs them to change the pages in the official report and bury the original behind Saint Hall. We're about to uncover the truth to this mystery!
dialogsBegin.fr: ..Changez les pages, et enterrez les originaux près de Saint Hall. Ils sont vraiment stupides! Ha ha ha! La vérité doit toujours éclater au grand jour.
dialogsBegin.id: Memo itu menginstruksikan mereka untuk mengubah halaman dalam laporan resmi dan mengubur yang asli di belakang Saint Hall. Kami akan mengungkap kebenaran misteri ini!
dialogsBegin.it: The memo instructs them to change the pages in the official report and bury the original behind Saint Hall. We're about to uncover the truth to this mystery!
dialogsBegin.jp: ＜（注）ここのページを差し替えること。調査書の原本はセイントホールの近くに埋めること＞って書いてあるだろう？バカなやつらだ。隠したって真実はいつか明らかになるものなのに。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 쪽지에, 보고서의 일부 페이지를 바꾸고, 원본은 세인트 홀 뒤편에 묻어두라는 지시가 적혀있어요. 진실에 가까워지고 있어요!
dialogsBegin.nl: The memo instructs them to change the pages in the official report and bury the original behind Saint Hall. We're about to uncover the truth to this mystery!
dialogsBegin.pl: The memo instructs them to change the pages in the official report and bury the original behind Saint Hall. We're about to uncover the truth to this mystery!
dialogsBegin.ru: В ней сказано, что нужно подменить некоторые страницы дела, а оригиналы закопать за ратушей! Кажется, мы близки к разгадке тайны!
dialogsBegin.sp: La nota indica que se cambien las páginas del informe oficial y que se entierre el original detrás del Ayuntamiento de Saint. ¡Estamos a punto de descubrir la verdad de este misterio!
dialogsBegin.sw: The memo instructs them to change the pages in the official report and bury the original behind Saint Hall. We're about to uncover the truth to this mystery!
dialogsBegin.th: ในบันทึกแนะนำให้เราเปลี่ยนหน้าในรายงานฉบับจริง และฝังต้นฉบับไว้ด้านหลังของ Saint Hall เราใกล้จะค้นพบความจริงที่เกี่ยวข้องกับเรื่องลึกลับนี้แล้วล่ะ!
dialogsBegin.tw: …掉換書頁，然後把真實的東西埋到聖音特教堂附近。這些傻瓜，天下事沒有秘密的啦。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bản ghi nhớ hướng dẫn họ thay đổi các trang trong báo cáo chính thức và chôn bản gốc phía sau Saint Hall. Chúng tôi sắp phát hiện sự thật cho bí ẩn này!

dialogsBegin.en: You think you can give me a hand with this? We're close to finding the truth!
dialogsBegin.ar: You think you can give me a hand with this? We're close to finding the truth!
dialogsBegin.br: Você acha que pode me dar uma ajudinha com isso? Estamos perto de encontrar a verdade!
dialogsBegin.cns: 喂!~你可以帮我一下吗?有一个很重大的事情。
dialogsBegin.de: Kannst Du mir dabei helfen? Wir sind kurz davor, die Wahrheit zu finden!
dialogsBegin.fi: You think you can give me a hand with this? We're close to finding the truth!
dialogsBegin.fil: You think you can give me a hand with this? We're close to finding the truth!
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu voudras bien me donner un coup de main? Cette affaire est très importante.
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu pikir kamu bisa membantu saya dengan ini? Kami hampir menemukan kebenaran!
dialogsBegin.it: You think you can give me a hand with this? We're close to finding the truth!
dialogsBegin.jp: 読み終わったかい？では、また私に協力してくれないか？これは、おそらくかなり大きい事件だぞ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이번 일, 도와주실 수 있나요? 진실에 거의 가까워진 것 같은데!
dialogsBegin.nl: You think you can give me a hand with this? We're close to finding the truth!
dialogsBegin.pl: You think you can give me a hand with this? We're close to finding the truth!
dialogsBegin.ru: You think you can give me a hand with this? We're close to finding the truth!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Crees que puedes echarme una mano con esto? ¡Estamos a punto de encontrar la verdad!
dialogsBegin.sw: You think you can give me a hand with this? We're close to finding the truth!
dialogsBegin.th: คุณคิดว่าคุณสามารถช่วยฉันในเรื่องนี้ได้หรือไม่? เราใกล้จะค้นพบความจริงแล้ว!
dialogsBegin.tw: 你認為你可以幫我解決這個問題嗎？我們快要找到真相了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn nghĩ bạn có thể giúp tôi một tay không? Chúng ta sắp tìm ra sự thật!

dialogsAccept.en: Thank you! If this is true, the original report was buried somewhere near Saint Hall. Please bring it to me. Hurry!
dialogsAccept.ar: Thank you! If this is true, the original report was buried somewhere near Saint Hall. Please bring it to me. Hurry!
dialogsAccept.br: Ótimo. Se isso for verdade, o relatório original foi enterrado em algum lugar perto da Prefeitura de Saint. Por favor, traga-o para mim.
dialogsAccept.cns: 好了，如果这纸条里面写的是真相的话，再晨光圣教堂附近一定有真实的内容书籍。帮我找一下好吗?
dialogsAccept.de: Also gut. Wenn das wahr ist, dann wurde der echte Bericht irgendwo in der Nähe von Saint Morning Halle vergraben. Bitte bring ihn mir.
dialogsAccept.fi: Thank you! If this is true, the original report was buried somewhere near Saint Hall. Please bring it to me. Hurry!
dialogsAccept.fil: Thank you! If this is true, the original report was buried somewhere near Saint Hall. Please bring it to me. Hurry!
dialogsAccept.fr: Bon. Si c'est vrai, le rapport original a été enterré quelque part près de Saint Hall. S'il te plaît ramène-le moi.
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih! Jika ini benar, laporan aslinya dikubur di suatu tempat di dekat Saint Hall. Tolong bawakan padaku. Buru-buru!
dialogsAccept.it: Thank you! If this is true, the original report was buried somewhere near Saint Hall. Please bring it to me. Hurry!
dialogsAccept.jp: ここに書かれた内容が確かなら、セイントホール近くのどこかに本物の調査書が埋めてあるはずだ。それを見つけて、持ってきてくれ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 고맙습니다! 이게 사실이라면, 원본 보고서는 세인트 홀 근처 어딘가에 묻혀 있는 거예요. 보고서를 찾아주세요. 빨리요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Thank you! If this is true, the original report was buried somewhere near Saint Hall. Please bring it to me. Hurry!
dialogsAccept.pl: Thank you! If this is true, the original report was buried somewhere near Saint Hall. Please bring it to me. Hurry!
dialogsAccept.ru: Отлично! Если неизвестные сделали так, как им велели, изъятые материалы должны быть закопаны где-то за ратушей. Найди их!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Gracias! Si esto es cierto, el informe original fue enterrado en algún lugar cerca del Ayuntamiento de Saint. Por favor tráemelo. ¡Date prisa!
dialogsAccept.sw: Thank you! If this is true, the original report was buried somewhere near Saint Hall. Please bring it to me. Hurry!
dialogsAccept.th: ขอบคุณ! หากเป็นเช่นนั้นรายงานต้นฉบับถูกฝังไว้ที่ไหนสักแห่งใกล้ Saint Hall กรุณานำมันมาให้ฉัน เร็วเข้า!
dialogsAccept.tw: 好了，如果這紙條裡面寫的是真相的話，在聖音特教堂附近一定有真實的內容書籍。幫我找一下好嗎？
dialogsAccept.vi: Cảm ơn bạn! Nếu đây là sự thật thì báo cáo ban đầu đã được chôn cất ở đâu đó gần Saint Hall. Hãy mang nó cho tôi. Nhanh lên nào!

dialogsDecline.en: I know you don't want to get involved, but please. Think of the children.
dialogsDecline.ar: I know you don't want to get involved, but please. Think of the children.
dialogsDecline.br: Eu sei que você não quer se envolver, mas por favor. Pense nas crianças.
dialogsDecline.cns: 我知道不是很好的事情啦~可是我都一把年纪了，所以找那个有点困难呢..
dialogsDecline.de: Ich weiß, dass Du Dich nicht einmischen willst, aber bitte. Denk an die Kinder.
dialogsDecline.fi: I know you don't want to get involved, but please. Think of the children.
dialogsDecline.fil: I know you don't want to get involved, but please. Think of the children.
dialogsDecline.fr: Je sais que ça ne te dis rien de faire ça. Mais je me fais vieux et.. Bla bla bla..
dialogsDecline.id: Aku tahu kamu tidak ingin terlibat, tapi tolong. Pikirkan anak-anak.
dialogsDecline.it: I know you don't want to get involved, but please. Think of the children.
dialogsDecline.jp: まあ、嫌ならしかたないな。子供たちのことも考えてほしい...。
dialogsDecline.kr: 관여하고 싶지 않으신 거 알아요. 하지만… 아이들을 생각해 주세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: I know you don't want to get involved, but please. Think of the children.
dialogsDecline.pl: I know you don't want to get involved, but please. Think of the children.
dialogsDecline.ru: I know you don't want to get involved, but please. Think of the children.
dialogsDecline.sp: Sé que no quieres involucrarte, pero por favor. Piensa en las niñas.
dialogsDecline.sw: I know you don't want to get involved, but please. Think of the children.
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันรู้ว่าคุณไม่ต้องการมีส่วนร่วม แต่ได้โปรด คิดถึงเด็กๆ ด้วยเถอะ
dialogsDecline.tw: 我知道你不想參與，但請想想孩子們。
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi biết bạn không muốn tham gia, nhưng làm ơn. Hãy nghĩ đến những đứa trẻ.

dialogsComplete.en: You found it! I will do my best to uncover the truth and bring those responsible for hiding this to justice!
dialogsComplete.ar: You found it! I will do my best to uncover the truth and bring those responsible for hiding this to justice!
dialogsComplete.br: Você finalmente o encontrou! Muito obrigado. Farei o meu melhor para descobrir a verdade e levar os responsáveis por esconder isso à justiça!
dialogsComplete.cns: 呵呵呵，你帮我找来了啊?辛苦你了!我一定会揭露出真相的。
dialogsComplete.de: Oh, ja, ja. Du hast es endlich gefunden. Danke sehr. Ich werde mein bestes tun die Wahrheit aufzudecken. Gute Arbeit!
dialogsComplete.fi: You found it! I will do my best to uncover the truth and bring those responsible for hiding this to justice!
dialogsComplete.fil: You found it! I will do my best to uncover the truth and bring those responsible for hiding this to justice!
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh, oui, oui! Tu l'as finalement trouvé! Merci beaucoup. Je vais faire de mon mieux pour que l'on sache la vérité. Bien joué.
dialogsComplete.id: Kamu menemukannya! Saya akan melakukan yang terbaik untuk mengungkap kebenaran dan membawa mereka yang bertanggung jawab menyembunyikan ini ke pengadilan!
dialogsComplete.it: You found it! I will do my best to uncover the truth and bring those responsible for hiding this to justice!
dialogsComplete.jp: そうそう、この書類だよ。やっぱり書かれた場所に埋められていたのか。おかげで重要な書類も見つかったことだし、失踪事件の真相の解明に力を注ぐさ。協力してくれてありがとう、感謝するよ！
dialogsComplete.kr: 찾으셨군요! 반드시 진실을 밝히고, 이 사실을 은폐하려 한 사람들에게 책임을 묻겠어요!
dialogsComplete.nl: You found it! I will do my best to uncover the truth and bring those responsible for hiding this to justice!
dialogsComplete.pl: You found it! I will do my best to uncover the truth and bring those responsible for hiding this to justice!
dialogsComplete.ru: Ого! Здесь же все доказательства того, что за исчезновениями стоит… бывший мэр! Ничего, теперь он у меня отправится на скамью подсудимых!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Lo has encontrado! ¡Haré todo lo posible para descubrir la verdad y llevar a los responsables de ocultar todo esto ante la justicia!
dialogsComplete.sw: You found it! I will do my best to uncover the truth and bring those responsible for hiding this to justice!
dialogsComplete.th: คุณพบมันแล้ว! ฉันจะพยายามอย่างเต็มที่เพื่อค้นพบความจริง และนำผู้ที่ซ่อนสิ่งเหล่านี้ไว้เบื้องหลังมาสู่กระบวนการยุติธรรม!
dialogsComplete.tw: 呵呵呵，你幫我找來了啊？辛苦你了！我一定會揭露出真相的。
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn đã tìm thấy nó! Tôi sẽ cố gắng hết sức để phanh phui sự thật và đưa những kẻ có trách nhiệm che giấu điều này ra trước công lý!

dialogsFail.en: You didn't find it? It has to be there. Check again!
dialogsFail.ar: You didn't find it? It has to be there. Check again!
dialogsFail.br: Você não encontrou? Tem que estar lá. Por favor, procure novamente naquela área. Deve haver algum tipo de marca que você consiga enxergar.
dialogsFail.cns: 嗯..我猜应该不会埋在很好找的地方啦，所以仔细的找找看，一定有一些不同的地方吧。
dialogsFail.de: Du hast es nicht gefunden? Er muss da sein. Schau noch einmal nach!
dialogsFail.fi: You didn't find it? It has to be there. Check again!
dialogsFail.fil: You didn't find it? It has to be there. Check again!
dialogsFail.fr: Hmm. Il ne doit pas être facile à trouver. Vérifie dans ce coin-là encore une fois. Il doit y avoir des traces que tu pourras repérer.
dialogsFail.id: Kamu tidak menemukannya? Itu harus ada. Periksa lagi!
dialogsFail.it: You didn't find it? It has to be there. Check again!
dialogsFail.jp: そうだな。あんなに重要な証拠は見つかりやすいところには埋めてないはずだ。くまなく見回してみて、おかしなところを探してみてくれ。
dialogsFail.kr: 못 찾으셨다고요? 분명히 그 근처 어딘가에 있어요! 다시 봐 주세요!
dialogsFail.nl: You didn't find it? It has to be there. Check again!
dialogsFail.pl: You didn't find it? It has to be there. Check again!
dialogsFail.ru: You didn't find it? It has to be there. Check again!
dialogsFail.sp: ¿No lo has encontrado? Tiene que estar allí. ¡Búscalo otra vez!
dialogsFail.sw: You didn't find it? It has to be there. Check again!
dialogsFail.th: คุณไม่พบมันงั้นหรือ? มันจะต้องอยู่ที่นั่นสิ ได้โปรดตรวจสอบอีกครั้ง!
dialogsFail.tw: 你沒找到？它必須在那裡。再檢查一遍！
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn không tìm thấy nó à? Nó phải ở đó. Kiểm tra lại xem!

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.br: Sua missão foi concluída. Seus pecados foram perdoados.
dialogsComplete.cns: 任务完成，你的罪恶已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Buße getan. Deine Sünden wurden dir vergeben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Questmu telah tercapai. Dosa-dosamu telah diampuni.
dialogsComplete.it: La Missione è terminata. I tuoi peccati sono stati perdonati.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 끝났습니다. 당신의 죄를 용서하지요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Боги одобрили твое деяние и простили тебе грехи.
dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น บาปของคุณได้รับการอภัยแล้ว

dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: There is no time to waste. We must strengthen our magic barrier and gather materials. Slay some Augu and gather what little Crystal Essence they may have shared from the Glacial Augu.
dialogsBegin.ar: There is no time to waste. We must strengthen our magic barrier and gather materials. Slay some Augu and gather what little Crystal Essence they may have shared from the Glacial Augu.
dialogsBegin.br: Não há tempo a perder. Devemos fortalecer nossa barreira mágica e reunir materiais. Mate alguns Augus e reúna um pouco da Essência de Cristal que eles possam ter recebido do Augu Glacial.
dialogsBegin.cns: 没有时间可以浪费了。我们必须加强我们的魔法屏障并收集材料。杀死一些尖角蜥并收集他们可能从冰川尖角蜥得到的少量水晶精华。
dialogsBegin.de: Wir haben keine Zeit zu verlieren. Wir müssen unsere magische Barriere stärken und weiter Materialien sammeln. Besiege ein paar Augu und sammle Kristallessenz, welche sie von Glacial Augu bekommen haben könnten.
dialogsBegin.fi: There is no time to waste. We must strengthen our magic barrier and gather materials. Slay some Augu and gather what little Crystal Essence they may have shared from the Glacial Augu.
dialogsBegin.fil: There is no time to waste. We must strengthen our magic barrier and gather materials. Slay some Augu and gather what little Crystal Essence they may have shared from the Glacial Augu.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il n'y a pas de temps à perdre. Nous devons renforcer notre barrière magique et récupérer des matériaux. Allez tuer des Augu et récupérez de l'Essence de Cristal qu'ils ont pu obtenir de l'Augu Glacial.
dialogsBegin.id: Tidak ada waktu untuk di sia-siakan. Kita harus memperkuat penghalang sihir kita dan mengumpulkan material. Bunuh beberapa Augu dan kumpulkan Crystal Essence kecil yang mungkin telah mereka bagikan dari Glacial Augu.
dialogsBegin.it: There is no time to waste. We must strengthen our magic barrier and gather materials. Slay some Augu and gather what little Crystal Essence they may have shared from the Glacial Augu.
dialogsBegin.jp: 無駄にする時間はありません。素材を集め、魔法障壁を強化しなければなりません。グレイシャルアウグを倒し、クリスタルエッセンスを集めてください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 낭비할 시간이 없어요. 마법 방어막을 강화하고 재료를 모아야 해요. 아우구를 처치하고, 빙하 아우구에게 받은 것으로 보이는 크리스탈 정수를 모으세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: There is no time to waste. We must strengthen our magic barrier and gather materials. Slay some Augu and gather what little Crystal Essence they may have shared from the Glacial Augu.
dialogsBegin.pl: There is no time to waste. We must strengthen our magic barrier and gather materials. Slay some Augu and gather what little Crystal Essence they may have shared from the Glacial Augu.

dialogsBegin.sw: There is no time to waste. We must strengthen our magic barrier and gather materials. Slay some Augu and gather what little Crystal Essence they may have shared from the Glacial Augu.
dialogsBegin.th: ไม่มีเวลาให้เสียดาย เราต้องเสริมความแข็งแกร่งให้บาเรียเวทมนตร์และรวบรวมวัตถุดิบ สังหาร Augu และรวบรวม Crystal Essence เล็กน้อยที่พวกเขาอาจแบ่งปันจาก Glacial Augu
dialogsBegin.tw: 沒有時間可以浪費了，我們必須加強我們的魔法屏障並收集材料。殺死一些奧古並收集他們可能從冰川奧古分享的少量水晶精華。
dialogsBegin.vi: Không lãng phí thời gian nữa. Chúng ta phải củng cố kết giới ma thuật của mình và thu thập nguyên liệu. Giết một số Augu và thu thập những Tinh chất Pha lê nhỏ mà chúng đã chia sẻ từ Glacial Augu.

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?

dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?

dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?

dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Excellent job raising your pet so far, my friend. You two certainly look happy together!
dialogsBegin.ar: Excellent job raising your pet so far, my friend. You two certainly look happy together!
dialogsBegin.br: É bom vê-lo novamente! Nossa! Seu Pet parece bem forte agora. Vocês certamente parecem felizes juntos!
dialogsBegin.cns: 我的朋友，到目前为止，做得很好。你们两个在一起肯定很幸福！
dialogsBegin.de: Sehr gute Arbeit! Ihr beide seht zusammen sehr glücklich aus.
dialogsBegin.fi: Excellent job raising your pet so far, my friend. You two certainly look happy together!
dialogsBegin.fil: Excellent job raising your pet so far, my friend. You two certainly look happy together!
dialogsBegin.fr: Je suis content de te revoir ! Wow, ton familier a l'air fort maintenant ! Encore un peu d'entraînement et tu vas y arriver !
dialogsBegin.id: Pekerjaan yang baik berhasil membesarkan pet kamu sejauh ini kawan. Kalian berdua terlihat bahagia saat bersama!
dialogsBegin.it: Excellent job raising your pet so far, my friend. You two certainly look happy together!
dialogsBegin.jp: とても力強く見えるようになりましたね。でも私の目にはまだペットの本当の能力を引き出したとは思えませんね。これからもペットのレベルアップのため頑張りましょう！
dialogsBegin.kr: 펫을 훌륭하게 잘 키우고 계시네요. 둘이 정말 행복해 보여요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Excellent job raising your pet so far, my friend. You two certainly look happy together!
dialogsBegin.pl: Excellent job raising your pet so far, my friend. You two certainly look happy together!
dialogsBegin.ru: Excellent job raising your pet so far, my friend. You two certainly look happy together!
dialogsBegin.sp: Excelente trabajo criando a tu mascota, amigo. ¡Se les ve realmente felices juntos!
dialogsBegin.sw: Excellent job raising your pet so far, my friend. You two certainly look happy together!
dialogsBegin.th: เยี่ยมมาก เลี้ยงสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณจนถึงตอนนี้ เพื่อนของฉัน คุณสองคนดูมีความสุขด้วยกันอย่างแน่นอน!
dialogsBegin.tw: 我的朋友，到目前為止，你的寵物做得很好。你們兩個在一起肯定很幸福！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn đã nuôi thú cưng của mình rất tốt đến thời điểm hiện tại, bạn tôi. Hai bạn chắc chắn trông rất vui khi ở cùng nhau!

dialogsBegin.en: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.ar: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.br: Você e seu Pet passaram por várias aventuras juntos. Tenho certeza que você já percebeu que quanto maior o nível concedido para um determinado grau, maior o benefício para seus atributos.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我相信您现在已经注意到，特定等级授予的级别越高，对您的属性的好处就越高。
dialogsBegin.de: Du hast sicher bereits gemerkt, dass der Bonus für eine bestimmte Klasse umso höher ist, wenn sie einen hohen Level hat.
dialogsBegin.fi: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.fil: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.fr: Ton familier et toi avez vécu bien des choses ensemble. C'est bon de vous revoir tous les deux à nouveau.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku yakin kamu telah menyadari bahwa semakin tinggi level yang diberikan tier tertentu, semakin tinggi manfaaatnya pada stats kamu.
dialogsBegin.it: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.jp: ペットの経験値を100％にしたら、レベルアップと共に見た目も変わります。今度こそ大人のペットになりますね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 특정 등급에 부여된 레벨이 높을수록 스탯에 들어가는 혜택도 더 크다는 걸 알아차리셨겠죠?
dialogsBegin.nl: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.pl: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.ru: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.sp: Estoy seguro de que ya habrá notado que cuanto mayor sea el nivel otorgado para un nivel en particular, mayor será el beneficio para sus estadísticas.
dialogsBegin.sw: I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันแน่ใจว่าคุณสังเกตเห็นแล้วว่ายิ่งเลเวลที่ได้รับสำหรับระดับใดระดับหนึ่งสูงเท
dialogsBegin.tw: 你現在應該已經發現，同一階級獲得的等級越高，能力值加成就越多。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi chắc rằng bạn đã nhận thấy cấp độ được cấp cho một cấp cụ thể càng cao, thì lợi ích đối với chỉ số Stats của bạn càng cao.

dialogsAccept.en: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.ar: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.br: Para ficar forte, é preciso suar a camisa. A essa altura, tenho certeza que você já conhece o treinamento. Aumente a Experiência do seu Pet até 99,99% e traga-o de volta para mim. Avaliarei o nível dele quando você tiver terminado.
dialogsAccept.cns: 一分耕耘一分收获。我敢肯定你现在已经知道这个了。把你宠物的经验提升到 99.99% 再来找我。你完成后我会升级它。
dialogsAccept.de: Ohne Fleiß kein Preis! Ich muss dir das weitere Vorgehen mittlerweile sicher nicht mehr erklären. Steigere die Erfahrung deines Pets auf 99,99% und bringe es zu mir zurück.
dialogsAccept.fi: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.fil: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.fr: Tu connais la musique, amène l'expérience de ton familier à 99,99% et reviens me voir pour que je le fasse évoluer.
dialogsAccept.id: Tanpa usaha tak akan ada hasil. Aku yakin kamu sudah cukup paham sekarang. Naikkan EXP pet menjadi 99,99% lalu. Aku akan mengupgradenya..
dialogsAccept.it: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.jp: ペット経験値を100％にしてから私のところに来てください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 고통 없이는 얻는 것도 없죠. 이제 어떻게 해야 하는지 잘 아시겠죠? 펫의 경험치를 99.99%까지 올려 제게 데려오세요. 경험치가 충분하면 업그레이드해 드릴게요.
dialogsAccept.nl: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.pl: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.ru: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.sp: Sin dolor no hay ganancia. Estoy seguro de que ya conoces el proceso. Lleva la experiencia de tu mascota al 99,99% y devuélvemelo. Lo actualizaré encantado.
dialogsAccept.sw: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsAccept.th: ไม่มีความเจ็บปวดก็เหมือนไมไ่ด้อะไร ฉันแน่ใจว่าคุณรู้การฝึกซ้อมแล้ว นำEXPสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณไปให้ถึง 99.99% แล้วนำกลับมาให้ฉัน ฉันจะอัปเกรดเมื่อคุณทำเสร็จแล้ว
dialogsAccept.tw: 一分耕耘一分收穫。我敢肯定你現在已經知道這個練習了。把你寵物的經驗提升到 99.99% 還給我。你完成後我會升級它。
dialogsAccept.vi: Không gì dễ dàng cả. Tôi chắc rằng bây giờ bạn đã biết về cuộc diễn tập. Đem điểm experience thú cưng của bạn đến 99,99% và mang nó về lại cho tôi. Tôi sẽ nâng cấp nó khi bạn hoàn thành.

dialogsComplete.en: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to B tier now!
dialogsComplete.ar: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to B tier now!
dialogsComplete.br: Vocês dois estão se tornando mais fortes juntos, e parece que vocês se tornaram bons amigos no processo. Excelente! Vou promover seu pet para o grau B agora!
dialogsComplete.cns: 你们两个一起变得越来越强大，看起来你们在这个过程中成为了很好的朋友。很好！我现在就把你的宠物升级到B级！
dialogsComplete.de: Gemeinsam werdet ihr beide immer stärker. Es sieht so aus, als wärt ihr auch ziemlich gute Freunde geworden. Exzellent! Ich werde dein Pet nun zur B Klasse aufwerten!
dialogsComplete.fi: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to B tier now!
dialogsComplete.fil: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to B tier now!
dialogsComplete.fr: Toi et ton familier devenez de plus en plus forts ensemble, et on dirait que vous êtes devenus très proche. Excellent ! Je vais faire évoluer ton familier à la classe B maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Kalian berdua menjadi lebih kuat bersama, dan sepertinya kalian telah menjadi teman yang baik. Bagus sekali! Aku akan mengupgrade pet yang kamu miliki ke tingkat B sekarang!
dialogsComplete.it: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to B tier now!
dialogsComplete.jp: 2人でどんどん強くなっていく過程で、かなり仲良しになったようです。優秀な！今すぐあなたのペットを B等級にアップグレードします!
dialogsComplete.kr: 둘은 함께 성장하며 강해지고 있고, 그 과정에서 꽤 좋은 친구가 된 것 같네요. 훌륭해요! 이제 펫을 B급으로 업그레이드해 드릴게요!
dialogsComplete.nl: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to B tier now!
dialogsComplete.pl: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to B tier now!
dialogsComplete.ru: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to B tier now!
dialogsComplete.sp: Los dos se están fortaleciendo juntos y parece que se han hecho buenos amigos en el proceso. ¡Excelente! ¡Actualizaré tu mascota al Nivel B!
dialogsComplete.sw: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to B tier now!
dialogsComplete.th: คุณสองคนแข็งแกร่งขึ้นด้วยกัน และดูเหมือนว่าพวกคุณจะกลายเป็นเพื่อนที่ดีต่อกัน ยอดเยี่ยม! ฉันจะอัปเกรดสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณเป็นระดับ B ทันที!
dialogsComplete.tw: 你們兩個一起變得越來越強大，看起來你們在這個過程中成為了很好的朋友。太強了！我現在就把你的寵物升級到 B 級！
dialogsComplete.vi: Hai bạn đang cùng mạnh hơn, và các bạn đã trở thành bạn tốt trong quá trình này. Xuất sắc! Tôi sẽ nâng cấp thú cưng của bạn lên cấp B ngay bây giờ!

dialogsFail.en: Not quite there… your pet needs more experience. I'm sure you already knew that.
dialogsFail.ar: Not quite there… your pet needs more experience. I'm sure you already knew that.
dialogsFail.br: Ainda não... seu Pet precisa de mais experiência. Estou certo de que você sabia disso.
dialogsFail.cns: 还不够……你的宠物需要更多的经验。我相信你已经知道了。
dialogsFail.de: Du bist noch nicht ganz fertig... Dein Pet benötigt mehr Erfahrung. Aber das wusstest du sicher bereits.
dialogsFail.fi: Not quite there… your pet needs more experience. I'm sure you already knew that.
dialogsFail.fil: Not quite there… your pet needs more experience. I'm sure you already knew that.
dialogsFail.fr: Ton familier a encore besoin d'expérience. Je pensais que tu saurais ce genre de choses maintenant !
dialogsFail.id: Masih belum cukup... Pet kamu membutuhkan lebih banyak EXP. Aku yakin Kamu sudah mengetahuinya.
