dialogsFail.sw: Not quite there… your pet needs more experience. I'm sure you already knew that.
dialogsFail.th: ไม่ค่อยมี… สัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณต้องการ EXP มากกว่านี้ ฉันแน่ใจว่าคุณรู้อยู่แล้วว่า
dialogsFail.tw: 別離開那裡……你的寵物需要更多的經驗。我相信你已經知道了。
dialogsFail.vi: Khôngphải thế… thú cưng của bạn cần thêm experience. Tôi chắc rằng bạn đã biết điều đó.

description.en: Slay Mias and Captain Mias and return to Porgo with any information you gather.
description.ar: Slay Mias and Captain Mias and return to Porgo with any information you gather.
description.br: Lute com Mias e Mias Capitãs, e reporte para Porgo qualquer informação que você conseguir.
description.cns: 先去猎杀米娅娃娃，丝绸米娅娃娃之后，把他们的共同点告诉我。
description.de: Bitte gehe und kämpfe mit Mia und Captain Mia, und lass mich die Zusammenhänge wissen.
description.fi: Slay Mias and Captain Mias and return to Porgo with any information you gather.
description.fil: Slay Mias and Captain Mias and return to Porgo with any information you gather.
description.fr: Va combattre des Mias et Capitaine Mia, et fais moi savoir ce qu'ils ont en commun.
description.id: Bunuh Mias dan Kapten Mias dan kembali ke Porgo dengan informasi apa pun yang kamu kumpulkan.
description.it: Slay Mias and Captain Mias and return to Porgo with any information you gather.
description.jp: ＜ミーア＞と＜キャプテン・ミーア＞を倒し、彼らから見つかった共通点を観察し、ポルゴのところに戻ろう。
description.kr: 미아와 두목 미아를 처치하고, 얻은 정보를 포르고에게 전달하세요.
description.nl: Slay Mias and Captain Mias and return to Porgo with any information you gather.
description.pl: Slay Mias and Captain Mias and return to Porgo with any information you gather.
description.ru: Нужно сразиться с ужасными и обычными Миа и раздобыть новые улики для Тинкертона.
description.sp: Derrota a las Mias y a las Mias Capitanas y vuelve con Porgo con la información que recopiles.
description.sw: Slay Mias and Captain Mias and return to Porgo with any information you gather.
description.th: ฆ่า Mias และ Captain Mias แล้วกลับไปที่ Porgo ด้วยข้อมูลที่คุณรวบรวมได้
description.tw: 先去獵殺米兒，米兒姊姊之後，把他們的共同點告訴我。
description.vi: Giết Mias và Captain Mias và trở về Porgo với bất kỳ thông tin nào bạn thu thập được.

dialogsBegin.en: Hey! I have some new findings in the case of the missing girls!
dialogsBegin.ar: Hey! I have some new findings in the case of the missing girls!
dialogsBegin.br: Você! Há quanto tempo! Eu descobri novas evidências do caso dos desaparecimentos.
dialogsBegin.cns: 喔~好久不见啊..这是失踪事件的新线索。
dialogsBegin.de: Du! Lange nicht gesehen! Ich habe neue Beweise zum Verschwinden der Kinder gefunden.
dialogsBegin.fi: Hey! I have some new findings in the case of the missing girls!
dialogsBegin.fil: Hey! I have some new findings in the case of the missing girls!
dialogsBegin.fr: Toi! Ca faisait longtemps! J'ai découvert de nouveaux indices dans l'enquête sur les disparitions.
dialogsBegin.id: Hey! Saya memiliki beberapa temuan baru dalam kasus gadis-gadis yang hilang!
dialogsBegin.it: Hey! I have some new findings in the case of the missing girls!
dialogsBegin.jp: 久しぶりじゃないか、元気だったか？実はあの忌まわしい女児連続失踪事件について新しい事実を見つけたんだ。聞いてくれるかい？
dialogsBegin.kr: 이봐요! 실종된 여자아이들 사건에 대해 새로 알아낸 게 있어요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Hey! I have some new findings in the case of the missing girls!
dialogsBegin.pl: Hey! I have some new findings in the case of the missing girls!
dialogsBegin.ru: Привет! Улик против бывшего мэра у нас теперь достаточно. Но я хочу помочь Миа вернуться домой.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Ey! ¡He descubierto nuevos hallazgos en el caso de las niñas desaparecidas!
dialogsBegin.sw: Hey! I have some new findings in the case of the missing girls!
dialogsBegin.th: เฮ้! ฉันค้นพบอะไรใหม่ๆ เกี่ยวกับเคสเด็กสาวที่หายไปแล้วล่ะ!
dialogsBegin.tw: 喔~好久不見啊…這是失蹤事件的新線索。
dialogsBegin.vi: Chào! Tôi có một số phát hiện mới trong vụ án các bé gái mất tích!

dialogsBegin.en: According to this report, there is one more thing in common with the kids who disappeared from Saint City. They were all girls.
dialogsBegin.ar: According to this report, there is one more thing in common with the kids who disappeared from Saint City. They were all girls.
dialogsBegin.br: De acordo com este relatório, há mais uma coisa em comum entre as crianças que desapareceram em Saint. Todas são meninas.
dialogsBegin.cns: 依照这个报告书写的，失踪的那些小孩共同点是..都是女孩之外，还有一个共同点。
dialogsBegin.de: Diesem Bericht zufolge, gibt es eine weitere Gemeinsamkeit mit den Kindern die aus Saint Morning verschwunden sind. Es waren alles Mädchen.
dialogsBegin.fi: According to this report, there is one more thing in common with the kids who disappeared from Saint City. They were all girls.
dialogsBegin.fil: According to this report, there is one more thing in common with the kids who disappeared from Saint City. They were all girls.
dialogsBegin.fr: Selon ce rapport, il y a un autre lien entre les enfants qui ont disparus à Saint Morning. Ce ne sont que des filles.
dialogsBegin.id: Menurut laporan ini, ada satu kesamaan lagi dengan anak-anak yang menghilang dari Saint City. Mereka semua perempuan.
dialogsBegin.it: According to this report, there is one more thing in common with the kids who disappeared from Saint City. They were all girls.
dialogsBegin.jp: こないだ君に探してきてもらった報告書によると、セイントモーニングで失踪した子供たちは全員女の子であること以外にもう一つ、共通点があったんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 보고서에 따르면, 세인트 시티에서 사라진 아이들은 전부 여자애들이었단 것 말고도 또 하나의 공통점이 있었어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: According to this report, there is one more thing in common with the kids who disappeared from Saint City. They were all girls.
dialogsBegin.pl: According to this report, there is one more thing in common with the kids who disappeared from Saint City. They were all girls.
dialogsBegin.ru: Почему именно шестилетние девочки? Кто сделал их марионетками? И как?
dialogsBegin.sp: Según este informe, hay una cosa más en común con los niños que desaparecieron de Saint. Eran todas niñas.
dialogsBegin.sw: According to this report, there is one more thing in common with the kids who disappeared from Saint City. They were all girls.
dialogsBegin.th: ตามรายงานฉบับนี้ มีอีกสิ่งหนึ่งเด็กๆ ที่หายตัวไปจากเมืองเซนต์นั้นมีเหมือนกัน คือพวกเขาเป็นผู้หญิงทั้งหมด
dialogsBegin.tw: 依照這個報告書寫的，失蹤的那些小孩共同點是…都是女孩之外，還有一個共同點。
dialogsBegin.vi: Theo báo cáo này, có một điểm chung nữa với những đứa trẻ đã biến mất khỏi Saint City. Chúng đều là con gái.

dialogsBegin.en: But I cannot find out what the similarity is in this report. It's really frustrating!
dialogsBegin.ar: But I cannot find out what the similarity is in this report. It's really frustrating!
dialogsBegin.br: Mas não consigo descobrir as coisas em comum com este relatório. Então eu preciso descobrir por mim mesmo...
dialogsBegin.cns: 可是啊..那个共同点我就是找不到耶..
dialogsBegin.de: Aber ich weiß nicht was die Gemeinsamkeit in diesem Bericht ist. Ich muss es wohl selbst herausfinden..
dialogsBegin.fi: But I cannot find out what the similarity is in this report. It's really frustrating!
dialogsBegin.fil: But I cannot find out what the similarity is in this report. It's really frustrating!
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais je n'ai pu retrouver ce point commun dans ce rapport. J'ai du rassembler les indices par moi-même..
dialogsBegin.id: Tapi saya tidak bisa menemukan kesamaan apa dalam laporan ini. Ini benar-benar membuat frustrasi!
dialogsBegin.it: But I cannot find out what the similarity is in this report. It's really frustrating!
dialogsBegin.jp: ところが、その共通点が何かというのがわからなかった。いくら入念に読み直してもな。読むだけじゃなく、直接調べてみないとわからない状況なんだよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 하지만 이 보고서에는 그 공통점이 뭔지 나와 있질 않아요. 너무 답답하네요…
dialogsBegin.nl: But I cannot find out what the similarity is in this report. It's really frustrating!
dialogsBegin.pl: But I cannot find out what the similarity is in this report. It's really frustrating!
dialogsBegin.ru: В деле об этом, конечно же, ничего нет.
dialogsBegin.sp: Pero no puedo averiguar cuál es la similitud en este informe. ¡Es realmente frustrante!
dialogsBegin.sw: But I cannot find out what the similarity is in this report. It's really frustrating!
dialogsBegin.th: แต่ฉันไม่สามารถหาสิ่งที่มีความคล้ายคลึงกันในรายงานนี้ มันน่าหงุดหงิดจริงๆ!
dialogsBegin.tw: 可是啊…那個共同點我就是找不到耶…
dialogsBegin.vi: Nhưng tôi không thể tìm ra điểm tương đồng trong báo cáo này. Thật là bực mình!

dialogsBegin.en: Will you help me find out what's going on here?
dialogsBegin.ar: Will you help me find out what's going on here?
dialogsBegin.br: Então... Você me ajudaria, por favor?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你既然都来了，所以可以帮我一下吗?
dialogsBegin.de: So.. Würdest du mir helfen...bitte?
dialogsBegin.fi: Will you help me find out what's going on here?
dialogsBegin.fil: Will you help me find out what's going on here?
dialogsBegin.fr: Alors.. Tu va m'aider?
dialogsBegin.id: Maukah kamu membantu saya mencari tahu apa yang terjadi di sini?
dialogsBegin.it: Will you help me find out what's going on here?
dialogsBegin.jp: そこでお願いがある。また、君の力を貸してもらいたいんだ。協力してくれないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 공통점이 뭔지 알아내고 싶은데, 도와주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Will you help me find out what's going on here?
dialogsBegin.pl: Will you help me find out what's going on here?
dialogsBegin.ru: Ты поможешь мне разобраться?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Me ayudarás a averiguar qué es lo que está pasando aquí?
dialogsBegin.sw: Will you help me find out what's going on here?
dialogsBegin.th: คุณช่วยฉันหาหน่อยได้ไหมว่าเกิดอะไรขึ้นที่นี่?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你既然都來了，所以可以幫我一下嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn sẽ giúp tôi tìm hiểu những gì đang xảy ra ở đây?

dialogsAccept.en: I need you to fight with Captain Mias and Mias and look for similarities between them, or anything you might find strange about them.
dialogsAccept.ar: I need you to fight with Captain Mias and Mias and look for similarities between them, or anything you might find strange about them.
dialogsAccept.br: Eu realmente gosto da sua personalidade!! Por favor, vá e lute contra as Mias e as Mias Capitãs, e me diga se há algo em comum entre elas ou qualquer coisa que você possa achar estranho sobre elas.
dialogsAccept.cns: 哈哈哈，果然..你先去猎杀丝绸米娅娃娃，米娅娃娃之后，把他们的共同点告诉我。
dialogsAccept.de: Mir gefällt deine Persönlichkeit ... ehrlich!! Bitte gehe und kämpfe mit Mia und Captain Mia, und lass mich die Zusammenhänge wissen.
dialogsAccept.fi: I need you to fight with Captain Mias and Mias and look for similarities between them, or anything you might find strange about them.
dialogsAccept.fil: I need you to fight with Captain Mias and Mias and look for similarities between them, or anything you might find strange about them.
dialogsAccept.fr: Ha ha ha! Toi j' t'adore!! Va combattre des Mias et Capitaine Mia, et fais moi savoir ce qu'ils ont en commun.
dialogsAccept.id: Saya ingin kamu bertarung dengan Kapten Mias dan Mias dan mencari kesamaan di antara mereka, atau apa pun yang kamu anggap aneh tentang mereka.
dialogsAccept.it: I need you to fight with Captain Mias and Mias and look for similarities between them, or anything you might find strange about them.
dialogsAccept.jp: 君はやっぱり頼りになるな、そこらの冒険者とは全く違うよ。それじゃ、ミーアとキャプテン・ミーアを倒して、彼らから見つかった共通点を書き込んで俺のところに持ってきてくれないか？
dialogsAccept.kr: 미아와 두목 미아를 상대하면서 그들 사이에 어떤 공통점이 있는지, 이상한 점은 없는지 확인해 주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: I need you to fight with Captain Mias and Mias and look for similarities between them, or anything you might find strange about them.
dialogsAccept.pl: I need you to fight with Captain Mias and Mias and look for similarities between them, or anything you might find strange about them.
dialogsAccept.ru: Попробуй сразиться с ужасными и обычными Миа. Мне кажется, это самые первые марионетки, созданные мэром и его людьми. Я сам не знаю, что искать, поэтому смотри в оба!
dialogsAccept.sp: Necesito que pelees contra las Mias Capitanas y las Mias y busques similitudes entre ellas, o cualquier cosa extraña que puedas averiguar sobre ellas.
dialogsAccept.sw: I need you to fight with Captain Mias and Mias and look for similarities between them, or anything you might find strange about them.
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันต้องการให้คุณต่อสู้กับ Captain Mias และ Mias และมองหาสิ่งที่คล้ายคลึงกันระหว่างพวกมัน หรืออะไรที่คุณรู้สึกว่ามันแปลกประหลาดเกี่ยวกับพวกมัน
dialogsAccept.tw: 哈哈哈，果然…你先去獵殺米兒，米兒姊姊之後，把他們的共同點告訴我。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi cần bạn chiến đấu với Captain Mias và Mias và tìm kiếm những điểm tương đồng giữa chúng, hoặc bất cứ điều gì bạn có thể thấy lạ về chúng.

dialogsDecline.en: You won't? Please, help me. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ar: You won't? Please, help me. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.br: Eu ficaria agradecido se você me ajudasse... Por favor, me avise caso mude de ideia.
dialogsDecline.cns: 我真的很希望你可以帮我的忙，可是你有其他事情要忙的话，我就不打扰你了..再见吧!
dialogsDecline.de: Du willst nicht? Bitte, hilf mir. Sprich noch einmal mit mir, wenn du deine Meinung änderst.
dialogsDecline.fi: You won't? Please, help me. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fil: You won't? Please, help me. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fr: J'apprécierais beaucoup que tu puisses m'aider.. Mais bon tu dois avoir plus urgent.. Je comprends. Ciao, à plus.
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu tidak akan? Tolong bantu aku. Bicaralah dengan saya lagi jika kamu berubah pikiran.
dialogsDecline.it: You won't? Please, help me. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.jp: 仕方ない。協力してくれる気になったら、また来てくれ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 도와주지 않으시겠다고요? 제발, 부탁해요. 마음이 바뀌면 다시 와 주세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: You won't? Please, help me. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.pl: You won't? Please, help me. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ru: Ты не хочешь помочь? Прошу тебя, подумай!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿No lo harás? Por favor, ayúdame. Habla conmigo de nuevo si cambias de opinión.
dialogsDecline.sw: You won't? Please, help me. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณจะไม่ทำงั้นเหรอ? ได้โปรดช่วยฉัน คุยกับฉันอีกครั้งถ้าคุณเปลี่ยนใจ
dialogsDecline.tw: 你不會嗎？請幫我！如果你改變主意，請再次與我交談。
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn sẽ không ư? Làm ơn giúp tôi. Nói chuyện lại với tôi nếu bạn thay đổi ý định.

dialogsComplete.en: Oh, thank you so much! You've been such a great help so far! I couldn't have made it this far without you!
dialogsComplete.ar: Oh, thank you so much! You've been such a great help so far! I couldn't have made it this far without you!
dialogsComplete.br: Oh, muito obrigado! Você tem sido uma grande ajuda até agora! Eu não teria chegado tão longe sem você!
dialogsComplete.cns: 哈哈，你的实力果然让人家佩服。
dialogsComplete.de: Gut. Du bist wirklich gut. Danke!
dialogsComplete.fi: Oh, thank you so much! You've been such a great help so far! I couldn't have made it this far without you!
dialogsComplete.fil: Oh, thank you so much! You've been such a great help so far! I couldn't have made it this far without you!
dialogsComplete.fr: Génial. T'es trop bon!! Ha ha ha! Merci!
dialogsComplete.id: Oh terimakasih banyak! Kamu telah sangat membantu sejauh ini! Aku tidak bisa sejauh ini tanpamu!
dialogsComplete.it: Oh, thank you so much! You've been such a great help so far! I couldn't have made it this far without you!
dialogsComplete.jp: おお、戻ってきたね！これだけ調べてきてくれれば、資料としては十分だよ。ありがとう！
dialogsComplete.kr: 오, 정말 감사해요! 너무 큰 도움을 주셨어요! 당신이 없었다면 저도 여기까지 오지 못했을 거예요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Oh, thank you so much! You've been such a great help so far! I couldn't have made it this far without you!
dialogsComplete.pl: Oh, thank you so much! You've been such a great help so far! I couldn't have made it this far without you!
dialogsComplete.ru: Ого! Инструкции по использованию?.. Как для… техники... или роботов?..
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Oh muchas gracias! ¡Has sido de mucha ayuda hasta ahora! ¡No podría haber llegado tan lejos sin ti!
dialogsComplete.sw: Oh, thank you so much! You've been such a great help so far! I couldn't have made it this far without you!
dialogsComplete.th: โอ้ ขอบคุณมาก! คุณช่วยฉันได้เยอะมากเลย! ฉันคงทำมันไม่ได้ขนาดนี้ถ้าไม่มีคุณ!
dialogsComplete.tw: 喔，真的非常謝謝你！一路上你幫了大忙，沒有你，我不可能走到這一步！
dialogsComplete.vi: Ồ cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều! Bạn đã được giúp đỡ rất nhiều! Tôi đã không thể đi xa đến mức này nếu không có bạn!

dialogsFail.en: Have you seen any strange similarities between them? Keep looking! I'm counting on you!
dialogsFail.ar: Have you seen any strange similarities between them? Keep looking! I'm counting on you!
dialogsFail.br: Você descobriu o que elas têm em comum? Bem, eu sei que não é fácil, mas sei que você consegue descobrir.
dialogsFail.cns: 还没找到他们的共同点吗?也对啦~应该没有这么简单，可是你仔细的查看看的话，应该找得到的。
dialogsFail.de: Hast du irgendwelche seltsamen Ähnlichkeiten zwischen ihnen entdeckt? Such weiter! Ich zähle auf dich!
dialogsFail.fi: Have you seen any strange similarities between them? Keep looking! I'm counting on you!
dialogsFail.fil: Have you seen any strange similarities between them? Keep looking! I'm counting on you!
dialogsFail.fr: As-tu trouvé leur point commun? Bon, je sais que ce n'est pas facile, mais tu finiras bien par trouver.
dialogsFail.id: Pernahkah kamu melihat kesamaan aneh di antara mereka? Tetap mencari! Aku mengandalkanmu!
dialogsFail.it: Have you seen any strange similarities between them? Keep looking! I'm counting on you!
dialogsFail.jp: ところが、その共通点が何かというのがわからなかった。いくら入念に読み直してもな。読むだけじゃなく、直接調べてみないとわからない状況なんだよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 둘 사이에 이상하게 닮은 점이 보이지 않나요? 계속 찾아보세요. 전 당신을 믿어요!
dialogsFail.nl: Have you seen any strange similarities between them? Keep looking! I'm counting on you!
dialogsFail.pl: Have you seen any strange similarities between them? Keep looking! I'm counting on you!
dialogsFail.ru: Have you seen any strange similarities between them? Keep looking! I'm counting on you!
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Has visto alguna extraña similitud entre ellas? ¡Sigue investigando! ¡Cuento contigo!
dialogsFail.sw: Have you seen any strange similarities between them? Keep looking! I'm counting on you!
dialogsFail.th: คุณเห็นสิ่งแปลกๆ ระหว่างพวกเขาที่มีเหมือนกันหรือไม่? ตามหาต่อไป! ฉันฝากความหวังไว้ที่คุณนะ!
dialogsFail.tw: 你有沒有看到他們之間有什麼奇怪的相似之處？繼續尋找！我靠你了！
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn đã thấy điểm giống nhau kỳ lạ nào giữa chúng chưa? Cứ tìm xem! Tôi trông cậy vào bạn!

name.th: หน้าที่ของ Acrobat

description.en: There is a creature named Shuraiture in the north of Flarine. I want you to go there and put an end to him. Bring news of your victory to Tailer the Acrobat Instructor in Flarine.
description.ar: There is a creature named Shuraiture in the north of Flarine. I want you to go there and put an end to him. Bring news of your victory to Tailer the Acrobat Instructor in Flarine.
description.br: Há uma criatura chamada Shuraiture no norte de Flarine. Quero que você vá lá e acabe com ele. Traga notícias de sua vitória para Tailer, a Instrutora Acrobata em Flarine.
description.cns: There is a creature named Shuraiture in the north of Flarine. I want you to go there and put an end to him. Bring news of your victory to Tailer the Acrobat Instructor in Flarine.
description.de: Im Norden von Flaris gibt es eine Kreatur namens Shuraiture. Ich möchte, dass du dorthin gehst und ihm ein Ende bereitest. Bringt die Nachricht von deinem Sieg zu Tailer, dem Acrobat in Flaris.
description.fi: There is a creature named Shuraiture in the north of Flarine. I want you to go there and put an end to him. Bring news of your victory to Tailer the Acrobat Instructor in Flarine.
description.fil: There is a creature named Shuraiture in the north of Flarine. I want you to go there and put an end to him. Bring news of your victory to Tailer the Acrobat Instructor in Flarine.
description.fr: Se débarrasser de Shuraiture, le monstre rôdant au nord de Flarine, puis se présenter à l'Instructrice des Acrobates de Flarine.
description.id: Ada makhluk bernama Shuraiture di dekat pintu masuk Flarine. Aku ingin kamu pergi ke sana dan memusnahkannya. Bawa berita kemenanganmu ke Tailer Acrobat Instructor di Flarine.
description.it: There is a creature named Shuraiture in the north of Flarine. I want you to go there and put an end to him. Bring news of your victory to Tailer the Acrobat Instructor in Flarine.
description.jp: フラリスの北にシュライトゥーレという生き物がいます。そこに行って彼を始末してほしい。勝利のニュースをフラリスのアクロバット インストラクターのテイラーに届けましょう。
description.kr: 플라리네 북부에, 슈라이투레라는 생명체가 있어요. 거기로 가서, 슈라이투레를 끝장내 주세요. 플라리네의 아크로뱃 교관 테일러에게 승리의 소식을 전해주세요.
description.nl: There is a creature named Shuraiture in the north of Flarine. I want you to go there and put an end to him. Bring news of your victory to Tailer the Acrobat Instructor in Flarine.
description.pl: There is a creature named Shuraiture in the north of Flarine. I want you to go there and put an end to him. Bring news of your victory to Tailer the Acrobat Instructor in Flarine.
description.ru: There is a creature named Shuraiture in the north of Flarine. I want you to go there and put an end to him. Bring news of your victory to Tailer the Acrobat Instructor in Flarine.
description.sp: Hay una criatura llamada Shuraiture en el Norte de Flarine. Quiero que pongas fin de una vez por todas. Comunícale tu victoria a Tailer, la Instructora Acróbata en Flarine.
description.sw: There is a creature named Shuraiture in the north of Flarine. I want you to go there and put an end to him. Bring news of your victory to Tailer the Acrobat Instructor in Flarine.
description.th: Shuraiture ได้คุกคามชาวบ้านบางส่วนของเมือง Flarine ฉันต้องการให้คุณไปที่นั่นและกำจัดมันไปตลอดการ แล้วนำชัยชนะของคุณไปบอกกับผู้ฝึกอบรม Acrobat ที่ชื่อ Tailer ในเมือง Flarine
description.tw: 布拉里斯北部有一種怪物，名叫休賴扎。我要你去那裡結束他。把你勝利的消息告訴布拉里斯的雜技訓練教官塔利爾。
description.vi: Có một sinh vật tên là Shuraiture tại phía bắc Flarine. Tôi muốn bạn đến đó và kết liễu nó. Hãy mang tin tức về chiến thắng của bạn đến Tailer the Acrobat Instructor ở Flarine.

dialogsBegin.en: You've learned many things since your journey began.
dialogsBegin.ar: You've learned many things since your journey began.
dialogsBegin.br: Você aprendeu muitas coisas desde que sua jornada começou.
dialogsBegin.cns: 自从你的旅程开始后你已经学到了很多东西。
dialogsBegin.de: Du hast seit Beginn deiner Reise viel gelernt.
dialogsBegin.fi: You've learned many things since your journey began.
dialogsBegin.fil: You've learned many things since your journey began.
dialogsBegin.fr: Alors que penses-tu des compétences de l'Acrobate ? Sympa, non ?
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu telah belajar banyak hal sejak perjalananmu dimulai.
dialogsBegin.it: You've learned many things since your journey began.
dialogsBegin.jp: 旅が始まって以来、あなたは多くのことを学びました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 여정이 시작된 이후로, 정말 많은 걸 배우셨네요.
dialogsBegin.nl: You've learned many things since your journey began.
dialogsBegin.pl: You've learned many things since your journey began.
dialogsBegin.ru: Об умениях я тебе рассказал? Рассказал. Книжку подарил? Подарил.
dialogsBegin.sp: Has aprendido muchas cosas desde que comenzó tu viaje.
dialogsBegin.sw: You've learned many things since your journey began.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณได้เรียนรู้หลายสิ่งตั้งแต่ได้เริ่มการผจญภัยของคุณ
dialogsBegin.tw: 聽完雜技師的技能之後，感覺如何啊？很感動吧！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn đã học được nhiều điều kể từ khi cuộc hành trình của bạn bắt đầu.

dialogsBegin.en: Now for the next step in your training. There is a creature named Shuraiture in the north of Flarine who is causing some trouble for residents there.
dialogsBegin.ar: Now for the next step in your training. There is a creature named Shuraiture in the north of Flarine who is causing some trouble for residents there.
dialogsBegin.br: Agora eu lhe contarei sobre o próximo passo do treinamento. Há uma criatura chamada Shuraiture no norte de Flarine que está causando alguns problemas para os residentes de lá.
dialogsBegin.cns: Now for the next step in your training. There is a creature named Shuraiture in the north of Flarine who is causing some trouble for residents there.
dialogsBegin.de: Und nun der nächste Schritt in deiner Ausbildung. Im Norden von Flaris gibt es eine Kreatur namens Shuraiture, die den Bewohnern dort einige Schwierigkeiten bereitet.
dialogsBegin.fi: Now for the next step in your training. There is a creature named Shuraiture in the north of Flarine who is causing some trouble for residents there.
dialogsBegin.fil: Now for the next step in your training. There is a creature named Shuraiture in the north of Flarine who is causing some trouble for residents there.
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais pour l'instant, voici ta dernière épreuve. Tu te souviens où se trouve le l'Entraîneur des Acrobates à Flarine ? Tu y trouveras aussi une Instructrice, son nom est... Euh en fait j'ai oublié son nom.
dialogsBegin.id: Sekarang untuk langkah selanjutnya dalam pelatihanmu. Ada makhluk bernama Shuraiture di utara Flarine yang menyebabkan masalah bagi penduduk di sana.
dialogsBegin.it: Now for the next step in your training. There is a creature named Shuraiture in the north of Flarine who is causing some trouble for residents there.
dialogsBegin.jp: トレーニングの次のステップに進みましょう。フラリーネの北にシュライトゥレという生き物がいて、住民に迷惑をかけている。
dialogsBegin.kr: 자, 이제 다음 훈련입니다. 플라리네 북쪽에 주민을 괴롭히는 슈라이투레라는 생명체가 있어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Now for the next step in your training. There is a creature named Shuraiture in the north of Flarine who is causing some trouble for residents there.
dialogsBegin.pl: Now for the next step in your training. There is a creature named Shuraiture in the north of Flarine who is causing some trouble for residents there.
dialogsBegin.ru: Now for the next step in your training. There is a creature named Shuraiture in the north of Flarine who is causing some trouble for residents there.
dialogsBegin.sp: Ahora al siguiente paso de tu entrenamiento. Hay una criatura llamada Shuraiture en el Norte de Flarine que esta causando problemas a los residentes de allí.
dialogsBegin.sw: Now for the next step in your training. There is a creature named Shuraiture in the north of Flarine who is causing some trouble for residents there.
dialogsBegin.th: ตอนนี้สำหรับขั้นตอนต่อไปในการฝึกฝนของคุณ มีสิ่งมีชีวิตชื่อ Shuraiture อยู่ในทางตอนเหนือของ Flarine กำลังก่อปัญหาให้กับชาวเมือง
dialogsBegin.tw: 現在是你培訓的下一步。布拉里斯北部有一種叫做休賴扎的怪物，它給那裡的居民帶來了一些麻煩。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bước tiếp theo trong quá trình đào tạo của bạn. Có một sinh vật tên là Shuraiture tại phía bắc Flarine, kẻ đang gây ra một số rắc rối cho cư dân ở đó.

dialogsBegin.en: Shuraiture has been terrorizing some of the locals in Flaris. I want you to go there and put an end to him once and for all. Bring news of your victory to Tailer, the Acrobat Instructor in Flarine.
dialogsBegin.ar: Shuraiture has been terrorizing some of the locals in Flaris. I want you to go there and put an end to him once and for all. Bring news of your victory to Tailer, the Acrobat Instructor in Flarine.
dialogsBegin.br: Shuraiture está aterrorizando alguns dos moradores locais de Flaris. Quero que você vá lá e acabe com ele de uma vez por todas. Leve notícias de sua vitória para Tailer, a Instrutora Acrobata em Flarine.
dialogsBegin.cns: Shuraiture has been terrorizing some of the locals in Flaris. I want you to go there and put an end to him once and for all. Bring news of your victory to Tailer, the Acrobat Instructor in Flarine.
dialogsBegin.de: Shuraiture hat einige Einwohner von Flaris terrorisiert. Ich möchte, dass du dorthin gehst und ihm ein für alle Mal ein Ende bereitest. Bringe die Nachricht von deinem Sieg zu Tailer, dem Acrobat Lehrer in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.fi: Shuraiture has been terrorizing some of the locals in Flaris. I want you to go there and put an end to him once and for all. Bring news of your victory to Tailer, the Acrobat Instructor in Flarine.
dialogsBegin.fil: Shuraiture has been terrorizing some of the locals in Flaris. I want you to go there and put an end to him once and for all. Bring news of your victory to Tailer, the Acrobat Instructor in Flarine.
dialogsBegin.fr: Quoi qu'il en soit, pour lui prouver ta valeur, tu dois chasser une nouvelle espèce de monstre avant d'aller la voir. Il attaque les gens au nord de Flarine. Son nom est Shuraiture.
dialogsBegin.id: Shuraiture telah meneror beberapa penduduk lokal di Flaris. Aku ingin kamu pergi ke sana dan memusnahkan dia untuk selamanya. Bawa berita kemenanganmu ke Tailer, Acrobat Instructor di Flarine.
dialogsBegin.it: Shuraiture has been terrorizing some of the locals in Flaris. I want you to go there and put an end to him once and for all. Bring news of your victory to Tailer, the Acrobat Instructor in Flarine.
dialogsBegin.jp: シュライツレ は フラリス の地元住民の何人かを恐怖に陥れています。そこに行って、彼をきっぱりと終わらせてほしい。勝利の知らせを、フラリスのアクロバット インストラクターであるテイラーに届けてください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 슈라이투레가 플라리스 주민을 위협하고 있다고 하더군요. 거기로 가서, 슈라이투레를 완전히 끝장내 주세요. 플라리네의 아크로뱃 교관, 테일러에게 승리 소식을 전해주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Shuraiture has been terrorizing some of the locals in Flaris. I want you to go there and put an end to him once and for all. Bring news of your victory to Tailer, the Acrobat Instructor in Flarine.
dialogsBegin.pl: Shuraiture has been terrorizing some of the locals in Flaris. I want you to go there and put an end to him once and for all. Bring news of your victory to Tailer, the Acrobat Instructor in Flarine.
dialogsBegin.ru: Shuraiture has been terrorizing some of the locals in Flaris. I want you to go there and put an end to him once and for all. Bring news of your victory to Tailer, the Acrobat Instructor in Flarine.
dialogsBegin.sp: Shuraiture ha estado aterrorizando a los habitantes de Flaris. Quiero que le pongas fin de una vez por todas. Comunícale tu victoria a Tailer, la Instructora Acróbata en Flarine.
dialogsBegin.sw: Shuraiture has been terrorizing some of the locals in Flaris. I want you to go there and put an end to him once and for all. Bring news of your victory to Tailer, the Acrobat Instructor in Flarine.
dialogsBegin.th: Shuraiture ได้คุกคามชาวบ้านบางส่วนของเมือง Flaris ฉันต้องการให้คุณไปที่นั่นและกำจัดมันไปตลอดการ แจ้งข่าวชัยชนะของคุณไปที่ Tailer ผู้สอน Acrobat ใน Flarine
dialogsBegin.tw: 休賴扎一直在恐嚇布拉里斯的一些當地人。我要你去那裡一勞永逸地結束他。將你的勝利消息告訴布拉里斯的雜技訓練教官塔利爾。
dialogsBegin.vi: Shuraiture đã khủng bố một số người dân địa phương ở Flaris. Tôi muốn bạn đến đó và tiêu diệt hắn ta một lần và mãi mãi. Mang tin tức về chiến thắng của bạn cho Tailer, Acrobat Instructor ở Flarine.

dialogsAccept.en: Good luck, you'll need it!
dialogsAccept.ar: حظا موفقا، سوف تحتاجها!
dialogsAccept.br: Boa sorte!
dialogsAccept.cns: 加油！
dialogsAccept.de: Viel Glück! Du wirst es brauchen.
dialogsAccept.fi: Good luck, you'll need it!
dialogsAccept.fil: Good luck, you'll need it!
dialogsAccept.fr: Bonne chance !
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga berhasil, kamu akan membutuhkannya!
dialogsAccept.it: Good luck, you'll need it!
dialogsAccept.jp: 検討を祈る！
dialogsAccept.kr: 행운을 빌게요. 정말 필요할 거예요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Good luck, you'll need it!
dialogsAccept.pl: Good luck, you'll need it!
dialogsAccept.ru: Удачи - она тебе пригодится!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Buena suerte! ¡La necesitaras!
dialogsAccept.sw: Good luck, you'll need it!
dialogsAccept.th: โชคดี คุณจะต้องการมัน!
dialogsAccept.tw: 加油！
dialogsAccept.vi: Chúc may mắn, bạn sẽ cần nó!

dialogsDecline.en: What's the matter? Chicken?
dialogsDecline.ar: What's the matter? Chicken?
dialogsDecline.br: Qual é o problema? É um Frango?
dialogsDecline.cns: 有什么事吗，胆小鬼？
dialogsDecline.de: Was ist los mit dir? Bist du ein Feigling?
dialogsDecline.fi: What's the matter? Chicken?
dialogsDecline.fil: What's the matter? Chicken?
dialogsDecline.fr: Pourquoi les humains abandonnent t-ils toujours si facilement !
dialogsDecline.id: Apa masalahnya? Ayam?
dialogsDecline.it: What's the matter? Chicken?
dialogsDecline.jp: だから、人間ってやつは嫌いなんだ。なんでもすぐ諦めるからな。
dialogsDecline.kr: 왜요? 겁먹으신 건가요?
dialogsDecline.nl: What's the matter? Chicken?
dialogsDecline.pl: What's the matter? Chicken?
dialogsDecline.ru: Что такое? Трусишь?
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Que te pasa? ¿Eres un gallina?
dialogsDecline.sw: What's the matter? Chicken?
dialogsDecline.th: เกิดอะไรขึ้น? ไก่เหรอ?
dialogsDecline.tw: 怎麼回事？害怕了嗎？
dialogsDecline.vi: Có chuyện gì vậy? Gà?

dialogsComplete.en: Shuraiture is… no more? What great news! Thank you so much! I see that you've also spoken with Tucani. Here is your reward for defeating Shuraiture.
dialogsComplete.ar: Shuraiture is… no more? What great news! Thank you so much! I see that you've also spoken with Tucani. Here is your reward for defeating Shuraiture.
dialogsComplete.br: Shuraiture não é… mais um incômodo? Que ótima notícia! Muito obrigado! Vejo que você também falou com Tucani. Aqui está sua recompensa por derrotar Shuraiture.
dialogsComplete.cns: 休赖扎…不复存在了？多么好的一个消息！太感谢你了！我看到你已经和哆卡交谈过了，这是你击败休赖扎的奖励。
dialogsComplete.de: Shuraiture ist... nicht mehr? Das ist großartig! Vielen Dank! Wie ich sehe, hast du auch schon Tucani gesprochen. Hier ist deine Belohnung.
dialogsComplete.fi: Shuraiture is… no more? What great news! Thank you so much! I see that you've also spoken with Tucani. Here is your reward for defeating Shuraiture.
dialogsComplete.fil: Shuraiture is… no more? What great news! Thank you so much! I see that you've also spoken with Tucani. Here is your reward for defeating Shuraiture.
dialogsComplete.fr: Merci beaucoup, il était important de s'occuper de ce monstre. Voici la dernière leçon : elle est sur le rôle des Acrobates, écoute-moi bien.
dialogsComplete.id: Shuraiture adalah ... tidak lebih? Sungguh berita bagus! Terima kasih banyak! Aku melihat bahwa kamu juga telah berbicara dengan Tucani. Ini hadiahmu karena telah mengalahkan Shuraiture.
dialogsComplete.it: Shuraiture is… no more? What great news! Thank you so much! I see that you've also spoken with Tucani. Here is your reward for defeating Shuraiture.
dialogsComplete.jp: ＜シュライチャー＞を捕らえて来たのですか！　すばらしいわ。ありがとうございます。もう、本当に気がかりで困っていたのです。それでは最後の訓練をパスしましたので、私が転職の完了を認証します。
dialogsComplete.kr: 슈라이투레가… 죽었다고요? 정말 좋은 소식이에요! 고맙습니다! 투카니와 이미 이야기를 나눈 모양이군요. 자, 이건 슈라이투르를 처치해 주신 보상이에요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Shuraiture is… no more? What great news! Thank you so much! I see that you've also spoken with Tucani. Here is your reward for defeating Shuraiture.
dialogsComplete.pl: Shuraiture is… no more? What great news! Thank you so much! I see that you've also spoken with Tucani. Here is your reward for defeating Shuraiture.
dialogsComplete.ru: Шушура... мертва? Прекрасно! Вот твоя награда. Тукани рассказал тебе о наших умениях? А книгу дал? Отлично…
dialogsComplete.sp: Shuraiture… ¿ya no existe? ¡Qué gran noticia! ¡Muchas gracias! Veo que también has hablado con Tucani. Aquí esta tu recompensa por derrotar a Shuraiture.
dialogsComplete.sw: Shuraiture is… no more? What great news! Thank you so much! I see that you've also spoken with Tucani. Here is your reward for defeating Shuraiture.
dialogsComplete.th: Shuraiture ถูกกำจัดแล้วเหรอ? ช่างเป็นข่าวดี! ขอบคุณมาก! ฉันเห็นว่าคุณได้พูดคุยกับ Tucani ด้วย นี่เป็นรางวัลสำหรับการกำจัด Shuraiture
dialogsComplete.tw: 啊，這是…還幫我抓了休賴扎…真的很感謝你啊～你通過最後一個訓練了，我給你一個禮物好了。
dialogsComplete.vi: Shuraiture không còn nữa? Tin tức tuyệt vời! Cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều! Tôi thấy rằng bạn cũng đã nói chuyện với Tucani. Đây là phần thưởng của bạn khi đánh bại Shuraiture.

dialogsComplete.en: Acrobats are very versatile. We can fight at long range or in close quarters! We also have a special ability which allows us to pull an enemy target up close.
dialogsComplete.ar: Acrobats are very versatile. We can fight at long range or in close quarters! We also have a special ability which allows us to pull an enemy target up close.
dialogsComplete.br: Os Acrobatas são muito versáteis. Podemos lutar a longa distância ou de perto! Também temos uma habilidade especial que nos permite puxar um alvo inimigo para perto.
dialogsComplete.cns: 弓箭手的能力很丰富，我们可以远距离攻击，也可以近距离对敌人绞杀。我们有一项特殊的能力就是可以将敌人拉进到身边进行攻击。
dialogsComplete.de: Acrobats sind sehr vielseitig. Wir beherrschen sowohl den Nah- als auch den Fernkampf! Wir haben auch eine besondere Fähigkeit, mit der wir ein feindliches Ziel an uns heranziehen können.
dialogsComplete.fi: Acrobats are very versatile. We can fight at long range or in close quarters! We also have a special ability which allows us to pull an enemy target up close.
dialogsComplete.fil: Acrobats are very versatile. We can fight at long range or in close quarters! We also have a special ability which allows us to pull an enemy target up close.
dialogsComplete.fr: Contrairement aux autres classes, les Acrobates peuvent attaquer au corps-à-corps, à mi-distance et à longue distance.
dialogsComplete.id: Acrobats sangat serbaguna. Kita bisa bertarung dalam jarak jauh atau dalam jarak dekat! Kami juga memiliki kemampuan khusus yang memungkinkan kami untuk menarik target musuh dari dekat.
dialogsComplete.it: Acrobats are very versatile. We can fight at long range or in close quarters! We also have a special ability which allows us to pull an enemy target up close.
dialogsComplete.jp: アクロバットは近距離、中距離、遠距離攻撃が全部可能な職業です。アクロバットは身を隠すことも出来ますし、遠距離の敵を自分の前に引き寄せることも出来ます。
dialogsComplete.kr: 아크로뱃은 다양한 전투 방식에 능해요. 원거리에서 싸울 수도 있고, 근거리 전투도 가능하죠! 게다가 멀리 있는 적을 끌어당기는 특별한 능력도 있어요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Acrobats are very versatile. We can fight at long range or in close quarters! We also have a special ability which allows us to pull an enemy target up close.
dialogsComplete.pl: Acrobats are very versatile. We can fight at long range or in close quarters! We also have a special ability which allows us to pull an enemy target up close.
dialogsComplete.ru: Что же еще тебе рассказать… Акробаты - гибкий народ. Мы умеем бить как издалека, так и вблизи. А если надо, мы можем даже подтянуть врага к себе!
dialogsComplete.sp: Los Acrobats son muy versátiles. ¡Podemos luchar en distancias largas o en espacios reducidos! También tenemos una habilidad que nos permite atraer a un enemigo.
dialogsComplete.sw: Acrobats are very versatile. We can fight at long range or in close quarters! We also have a special ability which allows us to pull an enemy target up close.
dialogsComplete.th: Acrobats มีหลากหลายแบบมาก เราสามารถต่อสู้ทั้งในระยะใกล้และไกล! เรายังมีความสามารถพิเศษที่ช่วยให้เราสามารถดึงเป้าหมายเข้ามาใกล้ได้
dialogsComplete.tw: 雜技師可以中、遠距離攻擊，又可以隱身。也可以把遠遠的怪偷到自己前面呢～
dialogsComplete.vi: Acrobats rất linh hoạt. Chúng ta có thể chiến đấu ở tầm xa hoặc trong khoảng cách gần! Chúng tôi cũng có một khả năng đặc biệt cho phép chúng tôi kéo mục tiêu của kẻ thù đến gần.

dialogsComplete.en: You've done well. I sense great potential in you. Congratulations, Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.ar: عمل جيد! اني أرى فيك قوة كامنة رهيبة. تهانينا، أيها البهلوان!
dialogsComplete.br: Não há nenhuma classe como a de um Acrobata, pois há tantas possibilidades. Eu espero que você compreenda totalmente esta classe e não se arrependa de sua escolha.
dialogsComplete.cns: 我想应该没有其他职业这么厉害啦～我相信你已经了解弓箭手了，希望你不要后悔你所选择的路。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast dich gut geschlagen. Ich sehe großes Potenzial in dir. Glückwunsch!
dialogsComplete.fi: You've done well. I sense great potential in you. Congratulations, Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.fil: You've done well. I sense great potential in you. Congratulations, Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.fr: Je te félicite, te voici désormais Acrobate ! Tu ne devrais pas le regretter, aucune classe ne lui est semblable
dialogsComplete.id: Kamu telah melakukannya dengan baik. Aku merasakan potensi besar dalam dirimu. Selamat, Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.it: You've done well. I sense great potential in you. Congratulations, Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.jp: あなたはよくやった。 私はあなたに大きな可能性を感じます。 おめでとう、アクロバット！
dialogsComplete.kr: 잘해냈군요. 엄청난 가능성이 느껴지네요. 축하해요, 아크로뱃!
dialogsComplete.nl: You've done well. I sense great potential in you. Congratulations, Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.pl: You've done well. I sense great potential in you. Congratulations, Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.ru: Остальное узнаешь на практике. Добро пожаловать в нашу дружную семью!
dialogsComplete.sp: Lo has hecho bien. Veo un gran potencial en ti. ¡Felicidades, Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.sw: You've done well. I sense great potential in you. Congratulations, Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.th: คุณทำได้ดีแล้ว ฉันรู้สึกถึงศักยภาพที่ดีในตัวคุณ ขอแสดงความยินดี Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.tw: 我想應該沒有其他職業這麼厲害啦～我相信你已經瞭解雜技師了，希望你不要後悔你所選擇的路。
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn đã làm tốt. Tôi cảm nhận được tiềm năng lớn trong bạn. Xin chúc mừng, Acrobat!

dialogsFail.en: Why have you come to see me? Did Tucani send you?
dialogsFail.ar: Why have you come to see me? Did Tucani send you?
dialogsFail.br: Há alguma razão para você vir aqui? Foi Tucani que lhe mandou? Hmm.. então por que veio?
dialogsFail.cns: 找我有什么事？哆卡叫你来的吗？
dialogsFail.de: Was führt dich zu mir? Hat Tucani dich geschickt?
dialogsFail.fi: Why have you come to see me? Did Tucani send you?
dialogsFail.fil: Why have you come to see me? Did Tucani send you?
dialogsFail.fr: Qu'est-ce qui t'amène ? Ah, c'est Tucani qui t'envoie ? Ok... Mais pourquoi es-tu venu me voir ?
dialogsFail.id: Mengapa kamu datang menemuiku? Apakah Tucani yang mengirimmu?
dialogsFail.it: Why have you come to see me? Did Tucani send you?
dialogsFail.jp: 何か御用ですか？　＜トゥカニ＞から何か聞きませんでしたか？
dialogsFail.kr: 왜 절 찾아오셨죠? 투카니가 보낸 건가요?
dialogsFail.nl: Why have you come to see me? Did Tucani send you?
dialogsFail.pl: Why have you come to see me? Did Tucani send you?
dialogsFail.ru: Что тебе от меня нужно? Тебя прислал Тукани?
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Por que has venido a verme? ¿Te ha enviado Tucani?
dialogsFail.sw: Why have you come to see me? Did Tucani send you?
dialogsFail.th: ทำไมคุณถึงมาพบฉัน Tucani ส่งคุณมาหรือไม่?
dialogsFail.tw: 找我有什麼事嗎？哆卡請你來找我的啊？嗯…沒有東西要給我嗎？
dialogsFail.vi: Tại sao bạn đến gặp tôi? Tucani gửi bạn đến?

name.fr: A la recherche de l'œuvre d'art
name.th: รับรูปกลับมา

description.en: Travel to the Red Bang Troup camp northeast of the Mars Mine and recover the Portrait of Radion. Return it to Rudvihil once you find it.
description.ar: Travel to the Red Bang Troup camp northeast of the Mars Mine and recover the Portrait of Radion. Return it to Rudvihil once you find it.
description.br: Os 2 pedaços de evidência estão relacionados entre si. É simples: ambos podem ser encontrados naquele lugar. Entendido? Então vá encontrá-lo!
description.cns: 这2个线索是有关连性的，到这个地方就可以找得到了!
description.de: Die 2 Beweise beziehen sich aufeinander, ja? Simpel, beide können an diesem Ort gefunden werden. Verstanden? Dann geh und finde es!
description.fi: Travel to the Red Bang Troup camp northeast of the Mars Mine and recover the Portrait of Radion. Return it to Rudvihil once you find it.
description.fil: Travel to the Red Bang Troup camp northeast of the Mars Mine and recover the Portrait of Radion. Return it to Rudvihil once you find it.
description.fr: Utiliser les indices pour retrouver le lieu où se trouve le portrait, puis le ramener à son propriétaire
description.id: Perjalanan ke kamp Red Bang Troup di timur laut Mars Mine dan pulihkan Potret Radion. Kembalikan ke Rudvihil setelah kamu menemukannya.
description.it: Travel to the Red Bang Troup camp northeast of the Mars Mine and recover the Portrait of Radion. Return it to Rudvihil once you find it.
description.jp: 2つのヒントを読んで、よ～く考えてみよう。その場所に行けば何かわかるはず。
description.kr: 마스 마인 북동쪽에 있는 레드 뱅 도적단 본거지로 가서 라디온의 초상화를 찾은 뒤, 루드비힐에게 돌려주세요.
description.nl: Travel to the Red Bang Troup camp northeast of the Mars Mine and recover the Portrait of Radion. Return it to Rudvihil once you find it.
description.pl: Travel to the Red Bang Troup camp northeast of the Mars Mine and recover the Portrait of Radion. Return it to Rudvihil once you find it.
description.ru: Нужно отобрать портрет Энвидия у проходимцев из "Труппы товарищей" к юго-западу от Марсовой шахты и вернуть его Сотби.
description.sp: Viaja al campamento de los Bangs Rojos al noreste de la Mina Mars y recupera el Retrato de Radion. Devuélveselo a Rudvihil una vez que lo encuentres.
description.sw: Travel to the Red Bang Troup camp northeast of the Mars Mine and recover the Portrait of Radion. Return it to Rudvihil once you find it.
description.th: เดินทางไปยังค่าย Red Bang Troup ทางตะวันออกเฉียงเหนือของ Mars Mine และเมื่อพบแล้วให้นำภาพ Portrait of Radion กลับไปให้ Rudvihil
description.tw: 這 2 個線索是有關連性的，到這個地方就可以找得到了！
description.vi: Đi đến trại Red Bang Troup ở phía đông bắc của Mars Mine và thu hồi Bức chân dung of Radion. Hãy trả lại cho Rudvihil khi bạn tìm thấy nó.

dialogsBegin.en: Be careful, I hear those Red Bang Troupe members pack quite a punch. I never liked them anyway. They don't tell good jokes.
dialogsBegin.ar: Be careful, I hear those Red Bang Troupe members pack quite a punch. I never liked them anyway. They don't tell good jokes.
dialogsBegin.br: Oh, estamos tão perto. Estou começando a me preoucupar. Será que vamos conseguir recuperá-lo? Depois de tanto trabalho, falhar agora seria....*uff*
dialogsBegin.cns: 要小心，我听说那些红色魔导战甲强盗团的成员有相当大的破坏力。反正我从来都不喜欢他们，他们不是善茬。
dialogsBegin.de: Was? Du verstehst nicht? Hmm.. (nickt) Okay. Du hast 2 Beweise, richtig? Lass es mir dir erklären.
dialogsBegin.fi: Be careful, I hear those Red Bang Troupe members pack quite a punch. I never liked them anyway. They don't tell good jokes.
dialogsBegin.fil: Be careful, I hear those Red Bang Troupe members pack quite a punch. I never liked them anyway. They don't tell good jokes.
dialogsBegin.fr: Quoi ? Tu ne comprends pas ? Hmm...(inclinant la tête) Ok, tu as déjà deux indices. Je vais t'expliquer.
dialogsBegin.id: Hati-hati, kudengar anggota Red Bang Troupe itu cukup kuat. Lagipula aku tidak pernah menyukai mereka. Mereka tidak menceritakan lelucon yang bagus.
dialogsBegin.it: Be careful, I hear those Red Bang Troupe members pack quite a punch. I never liked them anyway. They don't tell good jokes.
dialogsBegin.jp: ええ～っ！これだけヒントを持っててまだ解決できないの～ぉ？君って本当に頭が悪いんだね～ぇ。クッククク～。
dialogsBegin.kr: 조심하세요. 레드 뱅 도적단 녀석들, 생각보다 강하다고 들었거든요. 뭐, 전 걔네 별로 안 좋아해요. 농담도 재미없고요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Be careful, I hear those Red Bang Troupe members pack quite a punch. I never liked them anyway. They don't tell good jokes.
dialogsBegin.pl: Be careful, I hear those Red Bang Troupe members pack quite a punch. I never liked them anyway. They don't tell good jokes.
dialogsBegin.ru: Осторожнее. С проходимцами из "Труппы товарищей" шутить не стоит. Вот за это я их и не люблю!
dialogsBegin.sp: Ten cuidado, he escuchado que los Miembros de los Bangs Rojos tienen mucha fuerza. Nunca me han gustado. No cuentan buenos chistes.
dialogsBegin.sw: Be careful, I hear those Red Bang Troupe members pack quite a punch. I never liked them anyway. They don't tell good jokes.
dialogsBegin.th: ระวังตัวไว้ให้ดี ฉันได้ยินมาว่าสมาชิกกลุ่ม Red Bang เหล่านี้สามารถน็อคคุณได้ ฉันไม่เคยชอบพวกเขาหรอก พวกเขาไม่ได้เล่าเรื่องตลกดีๆ ให้ฉันฟัง
dialogsBegin.tw: 什麼？還是不知道喔？你手上有 2 個線索了吧？好吧！我來告訴你好了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Hãy cẩn thận, tôi nghe nói các thành viên của Red Bang Troupe có một cú đấm khá mạnh. Tôi không bao giờ thích họ. Họ không giỏi kể chuyện cười.

dialogsBegin.en: I grow tired of those who are all work and no play. Kind of like you. Do you ever just have fun? Or is everything always work, work, work?
dialogsBegin.ar: I grow tired of those who are all work and no play. Kind of like you. Do you ever just have fun? Or is everything always work, work, work?
dialogsBegin.br: Eu me canso daqueles que são só trabalho e nada de diversão. Tipo como você é. Você alguma vez tenta se divertir? Ou tudo é sempre trabalho, trabalho e trabalho?
dialogsBegin.cns: 我厌倦了那些只工作不玩耍的人。有点像你。 你曾经开心过吗？ 还是一切都是工作，工作，工作？
dialogsBegin.de: Ich habe genug von denen, die nur arbeiten und nicht spielen. So wie du. Hast du manchmal einfach nur Spaß? Oder ist alles immer nur Arbeit, Arbeit, Arbeit?
dialogsBegin.fi: I grow tired of those who are all work and no play. Kind of like you. Do you ever just have fun? Or is everything always work, work, work?
dialogsBegin.fil: I grow tired of those who are all work and no play. Kind of like you. Do you ever just have fun? Or is everything always work, work, work?
dialogsBegin.fr: Relis bien les deux indices, ils ont un lien entre eux. Ils devraient te conduire à ceux qui ont volé le portrait.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku bosan dengan mereka yang semuanya bekerja dan tidak bermain. Seperti kamu. Apakah Kamu pernah bersenang-senang? Atau selalu bekerja, bekerja, bekerja?
dialogsBegin.it: I grow tired of those who are all work and no play. Kind of like you. Do you ever just have fun? Or is everything always work, work, work?
dialogsBegin.jp: その2つのヒントを読んで、よ～く考えてみるといいよ～ぉ。簡単に言えば、その場所に行けばそいつらがいるんじゃな～ぃ？
dialogsBegin.kr: 일밖에 모르는 사람들은 너무 재미없어요. 당신도 그럴 것 같은데. 가끔은 그냥 놀기도 하나요? 아니면 항상 일, 일, 일만 하시나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: I grow tired of those who are all work and no play. Kind of like you. Do you ever just have fun? Or is everything always work, work, work?
dialogsBegin.pl: I grow tired of those who are all work and no play. Kind of like you. Do you ever just have fun? Or is everything always work, work, work?
dialogsBegin.ru: Все такие из себя крутые и серьезные, фу-ты-ну-ты. Прямо как ты. Ты отдыхать умеешь? Или с утра до вечера дела, дела, дела?
dialogsBegin.sp: Me canso de aquellos que son todo trabajo y nada de diversión. Algo así como tú. ¿Alguna vez te diviertes? ¿O todo es siempre trabajo, trabajo, trabajo?
dialogsBegin.sw: I grow tired of those who are all work and no play. Kind of like you. Do you ever just have fun? Or is everything always work, work, work?
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันเบื่อหน่ายกับคนที่ทำแต่งานแล้วไม่เล่นอะไรเลย เช่น คุณไงล่ะ คุณเคยเล่นสนุกบ้างไหม? หรือทุกสิ่งทุกอย่างคือการทำงาน ทำงาน ทำงาน งั้นหรือ?
dialogsBegin.tw: 我厭倦了那些只工作不玩耍的人。有點像你。你只是玩得開心嗎？還是一切總是工作，工作，工作？
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi cảm thấy mệt mỏi với những người chỉ làm việc và không vui chơi. Kiểu như bạn. Bạn có bao giờ có niềm vui? Hay mọi thứ luôn là công việc, công việc, công việc?

dialogsAccept.en: Ugh… well unless you have something funny to say, I think our business is concluded. I need to rest now. Black Magic takes a lot out of me.
dialogsAccept.ar: Ugh… well unless you have something funny to say, I think our business is concluded. I need to rest now. Black Magic takes a lot out of me.
dialogsAccept.br: Sim. Encontre-o. E volte correndo...Eu quero que isso terrmine para que possamos seguir caminhos diferentes.
dialogsAccept.cns: 呃...除非你有好笑的事情要说，我想我们的交易已经结束了。我现在需要休息，黑魔法让我精疲力尽。
dialogsAccept.de: Ja. Finde es und tu was immer du willst. Und besuche mich nie nie wieder und frage mich nach dieser witzlosen Sache. NIEMALS!
dialogsAccept.fi: Ugh… well unless you have something funny to say, I think our business is concluded. I need to rest now. Black Magic takes a lot out of me.
dialogsAccept.fil: Ugh… well unless you have something funny to say, I think our business is concluded. I need to rest now. Black Magic takes a lot out of me.
dialogsAccept.fr: Maintenant, pars retrouver le portrait. Avec les indices dont tu disposes cela ne devrait plus être trop compliqué.
dialogsAccept.id: Ugh… kecuali ada sesuatu yang lucu untuk dikatakan, kupikir urusan kita sudah selesai. Aku perlu istirahat sekarang. Black Magic menyerapku cukup banyak.
dialogsAccept.it: Ugh… well unless you have something funny to say, I think our business is concluded. I need to rest now. Black Magic takes a lot out of me.
dialogsAccept.jp: こんなところでもたもたしてると時間の無駄だよ～ぉ。とりあえず心当たりの場所を探してみれば～ぁ？
dialogsAccept.kr: 하아… 재미있는 이야기가 없으면 됐어요. 전 좀 쉬어야겠네요. 흑마법은 꽤 체력을 소모하거든요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Ugh… well unless you have something funny to say, I think our business is concluded. I need to rest now. Black Magic takes a lot out of me.
dialogsAccept.pl: Ugh… well unless you have something funny to say, I think our business is concluded. I need to rest now. Black Magic takes a lot out of me.
dialogsAccept.ru: Знаешь свежий анекдот? Новую игру? Веселый фокус? Нет? Тогда прости-прощай. Буду дальше думать, как справиться с этими замками.
dialogsAccept.sp: Ugh... bueno, a menos que tengas algo gracioso que decir, creo que nuestro negocio está cerrado. Necesito descansar ahora. La magia negra me cansa mucho.
dialogsAccept.sw: Ugh… well unless you have something funny to say, I think our business is concluded. I need to rest now. Black Magic takes a lot out of me.
dialogsAccept.th: อืม... ก็ดี เว้นแต่คุณจะมีเรื่องตลกที่อยากจะเล่า ฉันคิดว่าเรื่องของเราจะจบลง ตอนนี้ฉันต้องการพักผ่อนแล้ว Black Magic ดูดกลืนฉันเยอะแล้ว
dialogsAccept.tw: 呃……除非你有什麼好笑的話要說，不然我們應該談完了。我得休息一下，黑魔法會消耗我很多力量。
dialogsAccept.vi: Ugh… thôi trừ khi bạn có điều gì đó buồn cười để nói, tôi nghĩ việc của chúng ta đã kết thúc. Tôi cần phải nghỉ ngơi ngay bây giờ. Black Magic lấy đi của tôi rất nhiều.

dialogsDecline.en: What do you mean? I'm not in a bad mood. I'm like this to everyone. Unless you can make me laugh!
dialogsDecline.ar: What do you mean? I'm not in a bad mood. I'm like this to everyone. Unless you can make me laugh!
dialogsDecline.br: O que você quer dizer? Não estou de mau humor. Estou apenas bravo com tudo que está acontecendo.
dialogsDecline.cns: 你什么意思？我没有心情不好。我对每个人都是这样的。除非你能逗我笑起来！
dialogsDecline.de: Verstehst du das immernoch nicht? Bist du dumm? Finde es selbst heraus!
dialogsDecline.fi: What do you mean? I'm not in a bad mood. I'm like this to everyone. Unless you can make me laugh!
dialogsDecline.fil: What do you mean? I'm not in a bad mood. I'm like this to everyone. Unless you can make me laugh!
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu n'as pas encore compris ? Tant pis. je ne t'aiderai pas désolé.
dialogsDecline.id: Maksud kamu apa? Aku tidak dalam suasana hati yang buruk. Aku seperti ini pada semua orang. Kecuali kamu bisa membuatku tertawa!
dialogsDecline.it: What do you mean? I'm not in a bad mood. I'm like this to everyone. Unless you can make me laugh!
dialogsDecline.jp: もう教えることはないよ～ぉ。　あとは自分で考えて～ぇ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 무슨 말이에요? 제 태도가 기분 나쁘다고요? 전 원래 모두에게 이래요. 싫으면 웃겨주시던가요!
dialogsDecline.nl: What do you mean? I'm not in a bad mood. I'm like this to everyone. Unless you can make me laugh!
dialogsDecline.pl: What do you mean? I'm not in a bad mood. I'm like this to everyone. Unless you can make me laugh!
dialogsDecline.ru: Плохое настроение? У меня?! Нет, совершенно нормальное. Я со всеми так разговариваю. Со всеми занудами-трудоголиками!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Qué quieres decir? No estoy de mal humor. Soy así con todos. ¡A menos que puedas hacerme reír!
dialogsDecline.sw: What do you mean? I'm not in a bad mood. I'm like this to everyone. Unless you can make me laugh!
dialogsDecline.th: คุณหมายถึงอะไร? ฉันไม่ได้อารมณ์ไม่ดี ฉันเป็นแบบนี้กับทุกคน ถ้าคุณไม่สามารถทำให้ฉันหัวเราะได้!
dialogsDecline.tw: 這樣也不知道嗎？我真的沒看過像你這麼笨的人耶！
dialogsDecline.vi: Ý anh là gì? Tâm trạng tôi không tệ. Tôi như thế này với tất cả mọi người. Trừ khi bạn có thể khiến tôi cười!

dialogsComplete.en: Is that my portrait?! Give it here!
dialogsComplete.ar: Is that my portrait?! Give it here!
dialogsComplete.br: Oh! Obrigado, Deus! Obrigado... Muito obrigado... Agora estou aliviado...
dialogsComplete.cns: 那是我的画像吗？！快拿过来！
dialogsComplete.de: (Beginnt zu weinen als er das Portrait sieht) Oh! Danke, Gott! Dank dir.. Danke vielmals.. Jetzt bin ich erleichtert.
dialogsComplete.fi: Is that my portrait?! Give it here!
dialogsComplete.fil: Is that my portrait?! Give it here!
dialogsComplete.fr: (commençant à pleurer en voyant le portrait). Oh ! Par Rhisis ! Merci... Merci beaucoup. Je revis.
dialogsComplete.id: Apakah itu potretku?! Berikan di sini!
dialogsComplete.it: Is that my portrait?! Give it here!
dialogsComplete.jp: おお！まさしくこれは消えた肖像画に間違いない！取り戻してくれたんだね、ありがとう。　おお、良かった良かった！！
dialogsComplete.kr: 그건 제 초상화인가요?! 이리 주세요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Is that my portrait?! Give it here!
dialogsComplete.pl: Is that my portrait?! Give it here!
dialogsComplete.ru: Моя картина! Скорее, давай ее сюда!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡¿Ese es mi retrato?! ¡Déjalo aquí!
dialogsComplete.sw: Is that my portrait?! Give it here!
dialogsComplete.th: นั่นภาพของฉันหรือ?! เอามันมา!
dialogsComplete.tw: 嗚嗚…好開心喔~我的畫像~我終於可以安心的睡覺了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Đó có phải là bức chân dung của tôi không ?! Đưa nó đây!

dialogsComplete.en: Wait, what? What reward? I never said anything about a reward. Begone, pest!
dialogsComplete.ar: Wait, what? What reward? I never said anything about a reward. Begone, pest!
dialogsComplete.br: Espere, o quê? Que recompensa? Eu disse alguma coisa sobre uma recompensa? Você me ajudou porque queria, não foi? Vá embora, peste!
dialogsComplete.cns: 等等，什么？酬劳？我从没有说过任何关于奖励的事情。滚开，害人精！
dialogsComplete.de: Moment, was? Welche Belohnung? Ich habe nie etwas von einer Belohnung gesagt. Verschwinde, du Nervensäge!
dialogsComplete.fi: Wait, what? What reward? I never said anything about a reward. Begone, pest!
dialogsComplete.fil: Wait, what? What reward? I never said anything about a reward. Begone, pest!
dialogsComplete.fr: (Avec un regard insatisfait) Quoi ? Une récompense ? Je t'ai parlé d'une récompense ? Tu m'as aidé parce que tu le voulais, pas vrai ?
dialogsComplete.id: Tunggu apa? Hadiah apa? Aku tidak pernah mengatakan apa pun tentang hadiah. Pergilah, hama!
dialogsComplete.it: Wait, what? What reward? I never said anything about a reward. Begone, pest!
dialogsComplete.jp: 何だ？報酬はないのかと？ いつ私がそんなことを言ったかね？君の善意で取り戻してくれたんだろう？まったく欲張りなやつだ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 뭐라고요? 보상? 전 보상 준다고 한 적 없는데요. 저리 가요, 귀찮게 굴지 말고!
dialogsComplete.nl: Wait, what? What reward? I never said anything about a reward. Begone, pest!
dialogsComplete.pl: Wait, what? What reward? I never said anything about a reward. Begone, pest!
dialogsComplete.ru: Что-что? Награда? Я никакой награды не обещал. Все, все, кыш отсюда!
dialogsComplete.sp: Espera, ¿qué? ¿Qué recompensa? Nunca dije nada sobre una recompensa. ¡Vete, peste!
dialogsComplete.sw: Wait, what? What reward? I never said anything about a reward. Begone, pest!
dialogsComplete.th: อะไรนะ? รางวัลอะไร? ฉันไม่เคยพูดอะไรเกี่ยวกับรางวัล ไปซะ คนนิสัยไม่ดี!
dialogsComplete.tw: 什麼？酬勞？我什麼時候要說給你酬勞啦？我從來沒有說過任何關於酬勞的事情。走開，害蟲！
dialogsComplete.vi: Chờ đã, cái gì? Phần thưởng gì? Tôi chưa bao giờ nói bất cứ điều gì về phần thưởng. Bỏ đi, đồ chết tiệt!

dialogsComplete.en: Let this be a lesson to you. Before helping someone, make sure you find out upfront whether or not there is a reward being offered. Hahaha!
dialogsComplete.ar: Let this be a lesson to you. Before helping someone, make sure you find out upfront whether or not there is a reward being offered. Hahaha!
dialogsComplete.br: Você é muito indelicado! Vá embora! Não preciso mais de você!
dialogsComplete.cns: 让这成为你的教训吧。在帮助别人之前，一定要提前查清楚出是否有奖励提供。哈哈哈！
dialogsComplete.de: Du bist sehr unfreundlich! Jetzt verschwinde von hier!! Ich brauche dich nicht mehr!!
dialogsComplete.fi: Let this be a lesson to you. Before helping someone, make sure you find out upfront whether or not there is a reward being offered. Hahaha!
dialogsComplete.fil: Let this be a lesson to you. Before helping someone, make sure you find out upfront whether or not there is a reward being offered. Hahaha!
dialogsComplete.fr: Quelle impolitesse ! File, je n'ai plus besoin de toi!!
dialogsComplete.id: Biarlah ini menjadi pelajaran bagimu. Sebelum membantu seseorang, pastikan kamu mengetahui terlebih dahulu apakah ada hadiah yang ditawarkan atau tidak. Ha ha ha!
dialogsComplete.it: Let this be a lesson to you. Before helping someone, make sure you find out upfront whether or not there is a reward being offered. Hahaha!
dialogsComplete.jp: 君にはもう用事はない。　もう帰ってくれたまえ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이번 일을 교훈 삼아, 누굴 도와주기 전에 보상이 있는지 먼저 확인하는 습관을 들이면 되겠네요. 하하하!
dialogsComplete.nl: Let this be a lesson to you. Before helping someone, make sure you find out upfront whether or not there is a reward being offered. Hahaha!
dialogsComplete.pl: Let this be a lesson to you. Before helping someone, make sure you find out upfront whether or not there is a reward being offered. Hahaha!
dialogsComplete.ru: Пусть это будет тебе уроком. Сначала договаривайся о награде, а потом уж берись за дело!
dialogsComplete.sp: Que esto sea una lección para ti. Antes de ayudar a alguien, asegúrate de saber por adelantado si se ofrece una recompensa o no. ¡Jajaja!
dialogsComplete.sw: Let this be a lesson to you. Before helping someone, make sure you find out upfront whether or not there is a reward being offered. Hahaha!
dialogsComplete.th: ให้เรื่องนี้เป็นบทเรียนแก่คุณ ก่อนที่จะช่วยใครสักคนต้องแน่ใจว่าคุณจะได้รางวัลหรือไม่ ฮ่าๆ!
dialogsComplete.tw: 把這次當成教訓吧。幫助別人之前，記得先問清楚有沒有獎勵。哈哈哈！
dialogsComplete.vi: Hãy coi đó là một bài học cho bạn. Trước khi giúp đỡ ai đó, hãy nhớ tìm hiểu trước xem có phần thưởng nào được đưa ra hay không. Hahaha!
