dialogsFail.ar: You haven't found it yet? Well keep looking!
dialogsFail.br: Você ainda não encontrou? Bem, continue procurando!
dialogsFail.cns: 你还没找到吗?那继续寻找吧！
dialogsFail.de: Du konntest es noch nicht finden? Dann such weiter!
dialogsFail.fi: You haven't found it yet? Well keep looking!
dialogsFail.fil: You haven't found it yet? Well keep looking!
dialogsFail.fr: Tu n'as pas encore retrouvé le portrait ?! S'il te plaît dépêche-toi !
dialogsFail.id: Kamu belum menemukannya? Teruslah mencari!
dialogsFail.it: You haven't found it yet? Well keep looking!
dialogsFail.jp: わしの肖像画は、まだ見つからないのか？必ず見つけだしてくれ。頼んだぞ。
dialogsFail.kr: 아직 못 찾았어요? 계속 찾아보세요!
dialogsFail.nl: You haven't found it yet? Well keep looking!
dialogsFail.pl: You haven't found it yet? Well keep looking!
dialogsFail.ru: You haven't found it yet? Well keep looking!
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Aún no lo has encontrado? ¡Pues sigue buscando!
dialogsFail.sw: You haven't found it yet? Well keep looking!
dialogsFail.th: คุณยังหาไม่เจอเหรอ? งั้นก็หาต่อไป!
dialogsFail.tw: 還沒找到嗎？拜託快點幫我找回來啦~
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn vẫn chưa tìm thấy nó? Hãy tiếp tục tìm kiếm!

name.th: ผู้สืบทอดของฮีโร่ -Guardian-
name.tw: 英雄的繼承者 - 守護者

description.en: Defeat the Cardinal Guardian in Guardiane and retrieve his heart. Then visit Romvoette, the Ringmaster Guardian in Guardiane
description.ar: Defeat the Cardinal Guardian in Guardiane and retrieve his heart. Then visit Romvoette, the Ringmaster Guardian in Guardiane
description.br: Derrote o espírito, Guardião Cardeal, e obtenha seu coração. Então por favor visite Romvoette, a Guardiã Ringmaster em Guardiane.
description.cns: 去打倒守护兽贝纳卡蒂诺，并取得他的心脏，再去找守护使者隆波艾达！
description.de: Besiege den Wächtergeist, Venel Guardian und nimm sein Herz. Dann besuche Romvoette, den Ringmaster Wächter.
description.fi: Defeat the Cardinal Guardian in Guardiane and retrieve his heart. Then visit Romvoette, the Ringmaster Guardian in Guardiane
description.fil: Defeat the Cardinal Guardian in Guardiane and retrieve his heart. Then visit Romvoette, the Ringmaster Guardian in Guardiane
description.fr: Vaincre le Cardinal Venel et ramener son cœur à la Gardienne des Prêtres, Romvoette.
description.id: Kalahkan Venel Cardinal di Guardiane dan ambil jantungnya. Kemudian kunjungi Romvoette, Penjaga Ringmaster di Guardiane
description.it: Defeat the Cardinal Guardian in Guardiane and retrieve his heart. Then visit Romvoette, the Ringmaster Guardian in Guardiane
description.jp: ガルディアの守護者の部屋にいる守護精霊＜ヴェネル・ガーディアン＞のハートを手に入れ、リングマスター守護者ロモボエトに会おう。
description.kr: 가르디안에 있는 카디널 가디언을 처치하고 심장을 회수하세요. 그다음, 링마스터 수호자 롬보에트를 찾아가세요.
description.nl: Defeat the Cardinal Guardian in Guardiane and retrieve his heart. Then visit Romvoette, the Ringmaster Guardian in Guardiane
description.pl: Defeat the Cardinal Guardian in Guardiane and retrieve his heart. Then visit Romvoette, the Ringmaster Guardian in Guardiane
description.ru: Defeat the Cardinal Guardian in Guardiane and retrieve his heart. Then visit Romvoette, the Ringmaster Guardian in Guardiane
description.sp: Derrota al Guardián Cardenal en Guardiane y consigue su corazón. Después visita a Romvoette, la Guardiana Ringmaster en Guardiane.
description.sw: Defeat the Cardinal Guardian in Guardiane and retrieve his heart. Then visit Romvoette, the Ringmaster Guardian in Guardiane
description.th: กำจัด Venel Guardian ใน Guardiane และกู้หัวใจของมันมา จากนั้นไปที่ Romvoette Ringmaster Guardian ใน Guardiane
description.tw: 去打倒守護者祭壇的守護獸貝納卡度溫，並取得他的心臟，再去找守護者祭壇的守護者隆波艾達！
description.vi: Đánh bại Cardinal Guardian ở Guardiane và lấy lại trái tim của anh ta. Sau đó đến thăm Romvoette, Ringmaster Guardian ở Guardiane

dialogsBegin.en: Here is the Symbol of the Hero. You have to complete one more task in order to be recognized as a Successor of the Hero.
dialogsBegin.ar: Here is the Symbol of the Hero. You have to complete one more task in order to be recognized as a Successor of the Hero.
dialogsBegin.br: Aqui está o símbolo do herói. Você precisa de mais um comprovante para ser reconhecido como um sucessor do herói.
dialogsBegin.cns: 这标志是证明你是英雄守护使者的继承者，不过还需要另一个证明！
dialogsBegin.de: Das ist das Symbol der Helden. Du brauchst einen weiteren Beleg um zu beweisen, dass du als Nachfolger des Helden anerkannt wurdest.
dialogsBegin.fi: Here is the Symbol of the Hero. You have to complete one more task in order to be recognized as a Successor of the Hero.
dialogsBegin.fil: Here is the Symbol of the Hero. You have to complete one more task in order to be recognized as a Successor of the Hero.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je peux maintenant te confier le Sceau des Héros, qui confirme que tu as relevé avec succès tous les défis qui se sont présentés. Mais il te faut encore réussir l'épreuve finale.
dialogsBegin.id: Berikut adalah Simbol Pahlawan. Kamu harus menyelesaikan satu tugas lagi agar bisa diakui sebagai Penerus Pahlawan.
dialogsBegin.it: Here is the Symbol of the Hero. You have to complete one more task in order to be recognized as a Successor of the Hero.
dialogsBegin.jp: じゃあ、これが英雄の証だよ。実は、このほかにもうひとつ証が必要なんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이거야말로 영웅의 증표죠. 영웅의 후계자가 되려면, 마지막 임무가 하나 더 남았습니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Here is the Symbol of the Hero. You have to complete one more task in order to be recognized as a Successor of the Hero.
dialogsBegin.pl: Here is the Symbol of the Hero. You have to complete one more task in order to be recognized as a Successor of the Hero.
dialogsBegin.ru: Это Знак героя. Он означает, что его владелец является истинным наследником героя-иллюзиониста.
dialogsBegin.sp: Aquí está el Símbolo del Héroe. Tienes que completar una tarea más para ser reconocido como Sucesor de la Héroe.
dialogsBegin.sw: Here is the Symbol of the Hero. You have to complete one more task in order to be recognized as a Successor of the Hero.
dialogsBegin.th: นี่คือสัญลักษณ์ของฮีโร่ คุณต้องทำอีกหนึ่งเรื่องเพื่อที่จะได้รับการยอมรับว่าเป็นผู้สืบทอดฮีโร่
dialogsBegin.tw: 這標誌是證明你是英雄守護者的繼承者，不過還需要另一個證明！
dialogsBegin.vi: Đây là Biểu Tượng của Anh hùng. Bạn phải hoàn thành một nhiệm vụ nữa để được công nhận là Người kế vị Anh hùng.

dialogsBegin.en: There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You can find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of Heroes is protected.
dialogsBegin.ar: There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You can find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of Heroes is protected.
dialogsBegin.br: Há um local chamado de Sala do Guardião. Você a encontrará em Guardiane. Nesse local, a vontade dos heróis está sendo protegida.
dialogsBegin.cns: 圣堂的守护之室，去吧，去打倒那继承着英雄的意志的灵魂！
dialogsBegin.de: Da ist ein Ort, den man Raum des Wächters nennt. Du kannst ihn in Guardiane finden. An diesem Ort wird der Geist der Helden bewacht.
dialogsBegin.fi: There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You can find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of Heroes is protected.
dialogsBegin.fil: There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You can find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of Heroes is protected.
dialogsBegin.fr: Au sud de Darkon 3, à Gardiane, se trouve un lieu appelé la Chambre du Gardien.
dialogsBegin.id: Ada tempat yang disebut Kamar Penjaga. Kamu dapat menemukannya di Guardian. Di sana, Kehendak Pahlawan dilindungi.
dialogsBegin.it: There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You can find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of Heroes is protected.
dialogsBegin.jp: ガルディアの守護者の部屋には英雄たちの紋章があって、そこには英雄たちの意志が保存されているんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 가르디안에는 수호자의 방이 있어요. 영웅들의 의지를 보존하고 있는 곳이죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You can find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of Heroes is protected.
dialogsBegin.pl: There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You can find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of Heroes is protected.
dialogsBegin.ru: Твоя судьба скоро решится. Но не здесь, а в Гардиане. Там, в Зале хранителей, ты найдешь великого духа - Виндигго.
dialogsBegin.sp: Hay un lugar llamado la Habitación del Guardián. Puedes encontrarla en Guardiane. Allí se protege la Voluntad de los Héroes.
dialogsBegin.sw: There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You can find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of Heroes is protected.
dialogsBegin.th: มีสถานที่ที่เรียกว่า Room of the Guardian คุณสามารถหาได้ใน Guardiane เจตจำนงของวีรบุรุษได้รับการคุ้มครอง
dialogsBegin.tw: 有個地方叫做守護者之室，你可以在守護者祭壇找到它。那裡保存著英雄的意志！
dialogsBegin.vi: Có một nơi được gọi là Room of the Guardian. Bạn có thể tìm thấy nó trong Guardiane. Ở đó, Ý chí của các Anh hùng được bảo vệ.

dialogsBegin.en: Defeat the guardian spirit, Cardinal Guardian, and retrieve his heart.
dialogsBegin.ar: Defeat the guardian spirit, Cardinal Guardian, and retrieve his heart.
dialogsBegin.br: Derrote o espírito, Guardião Cardeal, e obtenha seu coração.
dialogsBegin.cns: 打倒守护之室的守护兽贝纳卡蒂诺，取得他的心脏，这是最后一个证明！！
dialogsBegin.de: Besiege den Schutzgeist Venel Cardinal und hole sein Herz zurück.
dialogsBegin.fi: Defeat the guardian spirit, Cardinal Guardian, and retrieve his heart.
dialogsBegin.fil: Defeat the guardian spirit, Cardinal Guardian, and retrieve his heart.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il te faut y pénétrer et vaincre le Cardinal Venel. Ta dernière épreuve sera de lui prendre son cœur !
dialogsBegin.id: Kalahkan roh penjaga, Venel Cardinal, dan ambil kembali jantungnya.
dialogsBegin.it: Defeat the guardian spirit, Cardinal Guardian, and retrieve his heart.
dialogsBegin.jp: この守護者の部屋にいるヴェネル・ガーディアンを倒して、ヴェネル・ハートを手にいれてください。そのハートが最後の証なのさ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 수호 정령 카디널 가디언을 처치하고, 그 심장을 손에 넣으세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Defeat the guardian spirit, Cardinal Guardian, and retrieve his heart.
dialogsBegin.pl: Defeat the guardian spirit, Cardinal Guardian, and retrieve his heart.
dialogsBegin.ru: Defeat the guardian spirit, Cardinal Guardian, and retrieve his heart.
dialogsBegin.sp: Vence al espíritu guardián, Guardián Cardenal, y consigue su corazón.
dialogsBegin.sw: Defeat the guardian spirit, Cardinal Guardian, and retrieve his heart.
dialogsBegin.th: เอาชนะวิญญาณผู้พิทักษ์ Venel Guardian และนำหัวใจมันมา
dialogsBegin.tw: 打倒守護者之室的守護獸貝納卡度，取得他的心臟，這是最後一個證明！！
dialogsBegin.vi: Đánh bại linh hồn người giám hộ, Cardinal Guardian, và lấy lại trái tim của anh ta.

dialogsBegin.en: Then, deliver the heart to Romvoette, the Ringmaster Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.ar: Then, deliver the heart to Romvoette, the Ringmaster Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.br: Por favor, entregue o coração para Romvoette, o guardião Ringmaster.
dialogsBegin.cns: 然后，请你把这心脏拿给圣堂的守护使者[隆波艾达]。
dialogsBegin.de: Bitte bring das Herz zu Romvoette, dem Ringmaster Wächter.
dialogsBegin.fi: Then, deliver the heart to Romvoette, the Ringmaster Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.fil: Then, deliver the heart to Romvoette, the Ringmaster Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu pourras alors te présenter à la Gardienne des Prêtres, Romvoette.
dialogsBegin.id: Kemudian, berikan hati itu ke Romvoette, Penjaga Ringmaster di Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.it: Then, deliver the heart to Romvoette, the Ringmaster Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.jp: それを手に入れたらリングマスター守護者ロモボエトのもとに行ってください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그 심장을 가르디안의 링마스터 수호자, 롬보에트님에게 전해주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Then, deliver the heart to Romvoette, the Ringmaster Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.pl: Then, deliver the heart to Romvoette, the Ringmaster Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.ru: Отнеси сердце Ромветте, хранительнице иллюзионистов. Справишься?
dialogsBegin.sp: Después, entrega el corazón a Romvoette, la Guardiana Ringmaster en Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.sw: Then, deliver the heart to Romvoette, the Ringmaster Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.th: จากนั้นส่งมอบหัวใจให้กับ Romvoette Ringmaster Guardian ใน Guardiane
dialogsBegin.tw: 然後，請你把這心臟拿給守護者祭壇守護者 [隆波艾達]。
dialogsBegin.vi: Sau đó, giao trái tim cho Romvoette, Ringmaster Guardian ở Guardiane.

dialogsAccept.en: I wish you luck, Assist.
dialogsAccept.ar: I wish you luck, Assist.
dialogsAccept.br: Eu lhe desejo sorte.
dialogsAccept.cns: 希望你能成为真正的英雄继承者，加油！
dialogsAccept.de: Viel Erfolg.
dialogsAccept.fi: I wish you luck, Assist.
dialogsAccept.fil: I wish you luck, Assist.
dialogsAccept.fr: Je te souhaite que la sagesse de Aenn t'accompagne !
dialogsAccept.id: Saya berharap Anda beruntung, Asisten.
dialogsAccept.it: I wish you luck, Assist.
dialogsAccept.jp: じゃあ、がんばってね。無事に試練を乗り越えられますように！
dialogsAccept.kr: 행운을 빌어요.
dialogsAccept.nl: I wish you luck, Assist.
dialogsAccept.pl: I wish you luck, Assist.
dialogsAccept.ru: Удачи тебе, униформист.
dialogsAccept.sp: Te deseo suerte, Assist.
dialogsAccept.sw: I wish you luck, Assist.
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันขอให้คุณโชคดี Assist
dialogsAccept.tw: 希望你能成為真正的英雄繼承者，加油！
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi chúc bạn may mắn, Assist..

dialogsDecline.en: You've come all this way just to give up? This is the last step. Please, think this through.
dialogsDecline.ar: You've come all this way just to give up? This is the last step. Please, think this through.
dialogsDecline.br: Você veio até aqui, e agora está desistindo? Este é o último passo, por favor pense cuidadosamente.
dialogsDecline.cns: 你要放弃？都已经成为了英雄的继承者，我没听错吧？！
dialogsDecline.de: Du bist den ganzen Weg hierher gekommen, nur um aufzugeben? Dies ist der letzte Schritt. Bitte, überlege es dir gut.
dialogsDecline.fi: You've come all this way just to give up? This is the last step. Please, think this through.
dialogsDecline.fil: You've come all this way just to give up? This is the last step. Please, think this through.
dialogsDecline.fr: Après avoir traversé tant d'épreuves, tu es sur le point d'abandonner ? Ceci est la dernière étape, réfléchis bien...
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu datang sejauh ini hanya untuk menyerah? Ini adalah langkah terakhir. Tolong, pikirkan ini baik-baik.
dialogsDecline.it: You've come all this way just to give up? This is the last step. Please, think this through.
dialogsDecline.jp: えー！こまできてやめちゃうのかい？せっかくここまでがんばったのに。もう一度よく考えなよ！
dialogsDecline.kr: 여기까지 와서 포기하겠다니요? 지금이 마지막 단계예요. 다시 생각해 보세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: You've come all this way just to give up? This is the last step. Please, think this through.
dialogsDecline.pl: You've come all this way just to give up? This is the last step. Please, think this through.
dialogsDecline.ru: You've come all this way just to give up? This is the last step. Please, think this through.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Has venido hasta aquí sólo para rendirte? Este es el último paso. Por favor, piénsatelo.
dialogsDecline.sw: You've come all this way just to give up? This is the last step. Please, think this through.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณมาไกลขนาดนี้เพื่อจะยอมแพ้เหรอ? นี่เป็นขั้นตอนสุดท้ายแล้ว คิดให้ดีก่อน
dialogsDecline.tw: 你要放棄？都已經成為了英雄的繼承者，我沒聽錯吧？！
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn đã cố gắng như thế chỉ để từ bỏ sao? Đây là bước cuối cùng rồi. Làm ơn, hãy nghĩ kỹ.

dialogsComplete.en: Welcome, Assist. You've done very well! Now, I appoint you the Successor of the Ringmaster Hero!
dialogsComplete.ar: Welcome, Assist. You've done very well! Now, I appoint you the Successor of the Ringmaster Hero!
dialogsComplete.br: Bem-vindo(a), Assist. Você foi muito bem! Agora eu lhe nomeio como Sucessor do Herói Ringmaster!
dialogsComplete.cns: 恭喜你喔！你已经通过最后的测验，你已经成为了守护使者的继承者了！
dialogsComplete.de: Willkommen Nachfolger. Du hast den letzten Test bestanden! Nun werde ich dich zum Nachfolger des Ringmaster Hero ernennen!
dialogsComplete.fi: Welcome, Assist. You've done very well! Now, I appoint you the Successor of the Ringmaster Hero!
dialogsComplete.fil: Welcome, Assist. You've done very well! Now, I appoint you the Successor of the Ringmaster Hero!
dialogsComplete.fr: Bienvenue à Gardiane. Tu as réussi brillamment la dernière épreuve et mérites désormais d'être l'un des successeurs du Héros des Prêtres.
dialogsComplete.id: Selamat datang, Asisten. Kamu telah melakukannya dengan sangat baik! Sekarang, saya menunjuk kamu sebagai Penerus Ringmaster Hero!
dialogsComplete.it: Welcome, Assist. You've done very well! Now, I appoint you the Successor of the Ringmaster Hero!
dialogsComplete.jp: 後継者よ。汝は最後の試練を乗り越えた。これからはリングマスター後継者として新たな道を歩むがよい！運命の女神の紡ぐ糸は、汝の運命に新たな綾を織り成すであろう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 환영합니다. 훌륭히 해내셨군요! 이제 당신을 링마스터 영웅의 후계자로 임명하겠습니다!
dialogsComplete.nl: Welcome, Assist. You've done very well! Now, I appoint you the Successor of the Ringmaster Hero!
dialogsComplete.pl: Welcome, Assist. You've done very well! Now, I appoint you the Successor of the Ringmaster Hero!
dialogsComplete.ru: Прекрасно! Объявляю тебя иллюзионистом!
dialogsComplete.sp: Bienvenido, Assist. ¡Lo has hecho muy bien! ¡Ahora, te nombro Sucesor de la Héroe Ringmaster!
dialogsComplete.sw: Welcome, Assist. You've done very well! Now, I appoint you the Successor of the Ringmaster Hero!
dialogsComplete.th: ยินดีต้อนรับ Assist คุณทำได้ดีมาก! ตอนนี้ฉันแต่งตั้งคุณเป็นผู้สืบทอดฮีโร่ของ Ringmaster!
dialogsComplete.tw: 恭喜你喔！你已經通過最後的測驗，你已經成為了守護者的繼承者了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Chào mừng, Assist. Bạn đã làm rất tốt! Bây giờ, tôi chỉ định bạn là Người kế vị Anh hùng Ringmaster!

dialogsComplete.en: Aenn, bless and watch over this person who is following your will, Ringmaster!
dialogsComplete.ar: Aenn, bless and watch over this person who is following your will, Ringmaster!
dialogsComplete.br: Aenn, por favor abençoe e encoraje esta pessoa que está seguindo a sua vontade!! Ringmaster!
dialogsComplete.cns: 艾诺啊！这里有要继承你意志的人，请祝福他！
dialogsComplete.de: Aenn, bitte segne und ermutige diese Person, die deinem Geist folgen möchte! Ringmaster!
dialogsComplete.fi: Aenn, bless and watch over this person who is following your will, Ringmaster!
dialogsComplete.fil: Aenn, bless and watch over this person who is following your will, Ringmaster!
dialogsComplete.fr: Aenn, puisses-tu bénir et soutenir en tout temps cette personne ici qui dédie sa vie à ta volonté !
dialogsComplete.id: Aenn, berkati dan awasi orang yang mengikuti kehendakmu ini, Ringmaster!
dialogsComplete.it: Aenn, bless and watch over this person who is following your will, Ringmaster!
dialogsComplete.jp: ＜神の声を聞く者＞エーエンヌよ、今ここに新たな後継者が誕生しました！この者に祝福と勇気を授けたまえ！
dialogsComplete.kr: 에이엔느시여, 당신의 뜻을 따르는 이에게 축복을 내려주소서, 링마스터!
dialogsComplete.nl: Aenn, bless and watch over this person who is following your will, Ringmaster!
dialogsComplete.pl: Aenn, bless and watch over this person who is following your will, Ringmaster!
dialogsComplete.ru: О, великий Киу! Благослови этого человека и дай ему силы исполнить твою волю!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Aenn, por favor bendice y dale valor a este Ringmaster que seguirá tu voluntad!
dialogsComplete.sw: Aenn, bless and watch over this person who is following your will, Ringmaster!
dialogsComplete.th: Aenn อวยพรและเฝ้าติดตามคนที่ติดตามความตั้งใจของคุณ Ringmaster!
dialogsComplete.tw: 阿利安諾啊！這裡有要繼承你的人，祝福它吧！
dialogsComplete.vi: Aenn, hãy chúc phúc và dõi theo người đang làm theo ý muốn của bạn, Ringmaster!

dialogsFail.en: I believe you've come here by mistake, Assist. Have you forgotten your task?
dialogsFail.ar: I believe you've come here by mistake, Assist. Have you forgotten your task?
dialogsFail.br: Somente aquele que for reconhecido como um sucessor poderá entrar aqui. Volte.
dialogsFail.cns: 这里只有英雄的继承者才可以进入喔，请回吧！
dialogsFail.de: Nur derjenige, der als Nachfolger anerkannt wurde, darf passieren. Geh zurück.
dialogsFail.fi: I believe you've come here by mistake, Assist. Have you forgotten your task?
dialogsFail.fil: I believe you've come here by mistake, Assist. Have you forgotten your task?
dialogsFail.fr: Seuls ceux reconnus comme successeurs de Aenn sont admis ici. Poursuis ton apprentissage...
dialogsFail.id: Saya yakin kamu datang ke sini karena kesalahan, Assist. Apakah kamu lupa tugasmu?
dialogsFail.it: I believe you've come here by mistake, Assist. Have you forgotten your task?
dialogsFail.jp: ここは英雄の後継者として認められた者のみが立ち入ることを許される、資格のないものは即刻立ち去るがよい･･･。
dialogsFail.kr: 잘못 오신 것 같아요. 임무를 잊으신 건 아니죠?
dialogsFail.nl: I believe you've come here by mistake, Assist. Have you forgotten your task?
dialogsFail.pl: I believe you've come here by mistake, Assist. Have you forgotten your task?
dialogsFail.ru: Что-то не так, униформист? Тебе напомнить о твоем задании?
dialogsFail.sp: Creo que has venido aquí por error, Assist. ¿Has olvidado tu tarea?
dialogsFail.sw: I believe you've come here by mistake, Assist. Have you forgotten your task?
dialogsFail.th: ฉันเชื่อว่าคุณมาที่นี่โดยไม่ได้ตั้งใจ Assist คุณลืมงานของคุณแล้วหรือยัง?
dialogsFail.tw: 這裡只有英雄的繼承者才可以進入喔，請回吧！
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi tin rằng bạn đã đến đây tình cờ, Assist. Bạn đã quên nhiệm vụ của mình rồi sao?

dialogsBegin.en: I have known Hael many years. When I first discovered him, he was laying there unconscious. I was able to nurse him back to health, but still he had no recollection of his memory. There is a way to recover it though…
dialogsBegin.ar: I have known Hael many years. When I first discovered him, he was laying there unconscious. I was able to nurse him back to health, but still he had no recollection of his memory. There is a way to recover it though…
dialogsBegin.br: Conheço Hael há muitos anos. Quando o descobri pela primeira vez, ele estava deitado inconsciente. Eu fui capaz de cuidar dele de volta à saúde, mas ele ainda não tinha recordações de sua memória. Existe uma maneira de recuperá-la…
dialogsBegin.cns: 我已经认识海尔很多年了。当我第一次找到他，他躺在地上不省人事，我可以照顾他使他恢复健康，但他却丢失了记忆。不过有一种方法可以让他恢复记忆...
dialogsBegin.de: Ich kenne Hael seit vielen Jahren. Als ich ihn das erste Mal entdeckte, lag er bewusstlos da. Ich konnte ihn wieder gesund pflegen, aber er hatte immer noch keine Erinnerung an sein Gedächtnis. Es gibt jedoch einen Weg, sie wiederzuerlangen...
dialogsBegin.fi: I have known Hael many years. When I first discovered him, he was laying there unconscious. I was able to nurse him back to health, but still he had no recollection of his memory. There is a way to recover it though…
dialogsBegin.fil: I have known Hael many years. When I first discovered him, he was laying there unconscious. I was able to nurse him back to health, but still he had no recollection of his memory. There is a way to recover it though…
dialogsBegin.fr: L'art de la divination est très complexe…
dialogsBegin.id: Saya telah mengenal Hael bertahun-tahun. Ketika saya pertama kali menemukannya, dia terbaring di sana tidak sadarkan diri. Saya dapat merawatnya kembali hingga dia sehat, tetapi tetap saja dia tidak memiliki ingatan tentang ingatannya. Namun, sebenarnya ada cara untuk memulihkannya ...
dialogsBegin.it: I have known Hael many years. When I first discovered him, he was laying there unconscious. I was able to nurse him back to health, but still he had no recollection of his memory. There is a way to recover it though…
dialogsBegin.jp: そう……ハエルはワシがこの地に連れてきたのじゃ。どのような理由かはわからんが、記憶を失っておった。
dialogsBegin.kr: 저는 오래전부터 하엘을 알았어요. 처음 발견했을 땐 의식을 잃고 쓰러져 있었죠. 열심히 간호해서 건강을 회복했지만, 기억은 돌아오지 않더군요. 하지만 기억을 되찾을 방법이 있어요...
dialogsBegin.nl: I have known Hael many years. When I first discovered him, he was laying there unconscious. I was able to nurse him back to health, but still he had no recollection of his memory. There is a way to recover it though…
dialogsBegin.pl: I have known Hael many years. When I first discovered him, he was laying there unconscious. I was able to nurse him back to health, but still he had no recollection of his memory. There is a way to recover it though…
dialogsBegin.ru: I have known Hael many years. When I first discovered him, he was laying there unconscious. I was able to nurse him back to health, but still he had no recollection of his memory. There is a way to recover it though…
dialogsBegin.sp: Conozco a Hael desde hace muchos años. Cuando lo vi por primera vez, estaba inconsciente. Lo cuidé hasta que recuperó la salud, pero no acordaba de nada. Aunque hay una forma de recuperarla…
dialogsBegin.sw: I have known Hael many years. When I first discovered him, he was laying there unconscious. I was able to nurse him back to health, but still he had no recollection of his memory. There is a way to recover it though…
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันรู้จัก Hael มาหลายปี เมื่อครั้งแรกที่ฉันค้นพบเขาเขากำลังนอนหมดสติอยู่ ฉันสามารถให้เขากลับมามีสุขภาพดีได้ แต่ฉันว่าเขายังจำไม่ได้ มีวิธีการกู้คืนแม้ว่าจะ ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 我認識哈爾很多年了。當我第一次發現他時，他正昏倒在地。我雖然把他救了回來，但他依然失去了所有記憶。不過，還是有辦法讓他恢復記憶的……
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đã biết Hael nhiều năm. Khi tôi lần đầu tiên phát hiện ra anh ấy, anh ấy đã nằm đó trong tình trạng bất tỉnh. Tôi đã có thể điều dưỡng cho anh ấy khỏe mạnh trở lại, nhưng anh ấy vẫn không nhớ gì về trí nhớ của mình. Có một cách để khôi phục nó mặc dù…

dialogsBegin.en: I feel there might be something important lost in his past. The only way to recover it would be by using a Memory Shard. This should allow Hael to uncover his past.
dialogsBegin.ar: I feel there might be something important lost in his past. The only way to recover it would be by using a Memory Shard. This should allow Hael to uncover his past.
dialogsBegin.br: Eu sinto que pode haver algo importante perdido em seu passado. A única maneira de recuperá-lo seria usando um Resquício de Memória. Isso deve permitir que Hael descubra sobre seu passado.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我推测他过去可能丢失了什么非常重要的东西。唯一恢复他记忆的办法就是使用记忆碎片。这将会揭开海尔的过去。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich habe das Gefühl, dass in seiner Vergangenheit etwas Wichtiges verloren gegangen sein könnte. Die einzige Möglichkeit, es wiederzuerlangen, wäre die Verwendung eines Memory Shard. Dies sollte es Hael ermöglichen, seine Vergangenheit aufzudecken.
dialogsBegin.fi: I feel there might be something important lost in his past. The only way to recover it would be by using a Memory Shard. This should allow Hael to uncover his past.
dialogsBegin.fil: I feel there might be something important lost in his past. The only way to recover it would be by using a Memory Shard. This should allow Hael to uncover his past.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tout au Nord de Flaris, vous trouverez des visions du futur. Mais ces visions sont souvent corrompues.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya merasa mungkin ada sesuatu yang penting hilang di masa lalunya. Satu-satunya cara untuk memulihkannya adalah dengan menggunakan Memory Shard. Ini seharusnya memungkinkan Hael untuk mengungkap masa lalunya.
dialogsBegin.it: I feel there might be something important lost in his past. The only way to recover it would be by using a Memory Shard. This should allow Hael to uncover his past.
dialogsBegin.jp: フラリスの北東にある祭壇に記憶のかけらという石がある。ただし、これだけでは足りぬぞ。記憶を戻すにはさらにひと手間必要じゃ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 하엘의 과거에, 뭔가 중요한 게 숨겨져 있는 것 같아요. 기억을 되찾을 유일한 방법은 기억의 파편뿐이에요. 파편이 있다면 하엘도 과거 기억을 되찾을 수 있을 테죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: I feel there might be something important lost in his past. The only way to recover it would be by using a Memory Shard. This should allow Hael to uncover his past.
dialogsBegin.pl: I feel there might be something important lost in his past. The only way to recover it would be by using a Memory Shard. This should allow Hael to uncover his past.
dialogsBegin.ru: I feel there might be something important lost in his past. The only way to recover it would be by using a Memory Shard. This should allow Hael to uncover his past.
dialogsBegin.sp: Siento que podría haber algo importante perdido en su pasado. La única forma de recuperarla sería utilizando un Fragmento de Memoria. Esto debería permitir a Hael descubrir su pasado.
dialogsBegin.sw: I feel there might be something important lost in his past. The only way to recover it would be by using a Memory Shard. This should allow Hael to uncover his past.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันรู้สึกว่าอาจมีบางสิ่งที่สำคัญหายไปในอดีตของเขา วิธีเดียวที่จะกู้คืนก็จะโดยใช้หน่วยความจำ Shard สิ่งนี้ทำให้ Hael ต้องค้นพบอดีตของเขา
dialogsBegin.tw: 我覺得他的過去一定遺失了某些重要的東西。想讓那些記憶回來，唯一的方法就是使用記憶碎片。這應該能幫哈爾找回自己的過往。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi cảm thấy có thể có một cái gì đó quan trọng bị mất trong quá khứ của anh ấy. Cách duy nhất để khôi phục nó là sử dụng Memory Shard. Điều này sẽ cho phép Hael khám phá quá khứ của mình.

dialogsBegin.en: First, you will need to purify the shard by bringing it to the Magic Box Ancimys. Will you retrieve the purified Memory shard and bring it to Hael?
dialogsBegin.ar: First, you will need to purify the shard by bringing it to the Magic Box Ancimys. Will you retrieve the purified Memory shard and bring it to Hael?
dialogsBegin.br: Primeiro, você precisará purificar o resquício, levando-o para a Caixa Mágica Ancimys. Pode fazer isso pelo bem de Hael?
dialogsBegin.cns: 首先，你需要将碎片带去[魔盒] 安瑟麦斯处进行净化。你愿意取回纯净的记忆碎片并带给海尔吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Zuerst musst du den Memory shard reinigen, indem du ihn in die Magic Box Ancimys bringst. Wirst du den gereinigten Memory shard holen und ihn zu Hael bringen?
dialogsBegin.fi: First, you will need to purify the shard by bringing it to the Magic Box Ancimys. Will you retrieve the purified Memory shard and bring it to Hael?
dialogsBegin.fil: First, you will need to purify the shard by bringing it to the Magic Box Ancimys. Will you retrieve the purified Memory shard and bring it to Hael?
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous devrez apporter une vision corrompue à Ancimys pour qu'il la purifie.
dialogsBegin.id: Pertama, kau perlu memurnikan pecahan ini dengan membawanya ke Magic Box Ancimys. Maukah kamu mengambil pecahan Memori yang telah dimurnikan dan membawanya ke Hael?
dialogsBegin.it: First, you will need to purify the shard by bringing it to the Magic Box Ancimys. Will you retrieve the purified Memory shard and bring it to Hael?
dialogsBegin.jp: 記憶のかけらを手に入れることができたら、魔法の箱アンシミスに持っていくとよい。そうすれば石の不純物を浄化し使えるようになるじゃろう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 먼저 마법의 상자 앙키미스에게 파편을 가져가 정화해야 해요. 정화가 끝나면, 그 파편을 하엘에게 가져가 주시겠어요?
dialogsBegin.nl: First, you will need to purify the shard by bringing it to the Magic Box Ancimys. Will you retrieve the purified Memory shard and bring it to Hael?
dialogsBegin.pl: First, you will need to purify the shard by bringing it to the Magic Box Ancimys. Will you retrieve the purified Memory shard and bring it to Hael?
dialogsBegin.ru: First, you will need to purify the shard by bringing it to the Magic Box Ancimys. Will you retrieve the purified Memory shard and bring it to Hael?
dialogsBegin.sp: Primero, deberás purificar el fragmento llevándoselo a la Caja Mágica Ancimys. ¿Recuperarás el Fragmento de Memoria purificado y se lo llevarás a Hael?
dialogsBegin.sw: First, you will need to purify the shard by bringing it to the Magic Box Ancimys. Will you retrieve the purified Memory shard and bring it to Hael?
dialogsBegin.th: ขั้นแรกคุณจะต้องทำความสะอาดเศษชิ้นส่วนโดยการนำไปใส่กล่อง Magic Box Ancimys คุณจะดึงเมมโมรี่การ์ดที่บริสุทธิ์และนำมาให้ Hael หรือไม่?
dialogsBegin.tw: 首先，你得把記憶碎片帶去給魔法箱安奇米斯淨化。你願意把淨化後的記憶碎片帶回來交給哈爾嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Đầu tiên, bạn sẽ cần thanh tẩy mảnh vỡ bằng cách đưa nó đến Hộp ma thuật Ancimys. Bạn sẽ lấy mảnh ký ức đã được thanh lọc và mang nó cho Hael?

dialogsAccept.en: Please locate the Memory Shard which should be somewhere around the Altar of Violet in Northern Flaris. There are Violet Magician Troupe patrolling the area.
dialogsAccept.ar: Please locate the Memory Shard which should be somewhere around the Altar of Violet in Northern Flaris. There are Violet Magician Troupe patrolling the area.
dialogsAccept.br: Por favor, localize o Resquício de Memória que deve estar em algum lugar ao redor do Altar da Violeta no norte de Flaris. Há Membros da Tropa dos Magos Violetas patrulhando a área.
dialogsAccept.cns: 记忆碎片可能在帕里北部的紫色的祭团处。那里游荡着紫色魔法剧团长。
dialogsAccept.de: Bitte suchen Sie den Memory Shard, der sich irgendwo in der Nähe Altar of Violet in Nordflaris befinden sollte. Die Violet Magician Troupe patrouilliert in der Gegend.
dialogsAccept.fi: Please locate the Memory Shard which should be somewhere around the Altar of Violet in Northern Flaris. There are Violet Magician Troupe patrolling the area.
dialogsAccept.fil: Please locate the Memory Shard which should be somewhere around the Altar of Violet in Northern Flaris. There are Violet Magician Troupe patrolling the area.
dialogsAccept.fr: La vision du future révèle l'avenir de celui qui la tient dans sa paume.
dialogsAccept.id: Temukan Memory Shard yang seharusnya berada di suatu tempat di sekitar Altar of Violet di Northern Flaris. Ada Violet Magician Troupe yang berpatroli di daerah tersebut.
dialogsAccept.it: Please locate the Memory Shard which should be somewhere around the Altar of Violet in Northern Flaris. There are Violet Magician Troupe patrolling the area.
dialogsAccept.jp: いつかハエルの記憶を取り戻そうとする者にこの方法は伝えようと思っていたのじゃ。頼むぞ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 플라리스 북부에 있는 보라색 제단 근처 어딘가에서 기억의 파편을 찾아줘. 퍼플 매지션 부대가 그 근처를 지키고 있지.
dialogsAccept.nl: Please locate the Memory Shard which should be somewhere around the Altar of Violet in Northern Flaris. There are Violet Magician Troupe patrolling the area.
dialogsAccept.pl: Please locate the Memory Shard which should be somewhere around the Altar of Violet in Northern Flaris. There are Violet Magician Troupe patrolling the area.
dialogsAccept.ru: Please locate the Memory Shard which should be somewhere around the Altar of Violet in Northern Flaris. There are Violet Magician Troupe patrolling the area.
dialogsAccept.sp: Localiza el Fragmento de Memoria que debería estar en algún lugar alrededor del Altar Violeta al Norte de Flaris. Los Magos Violetas están patrullando el área.
dialogsAccept.sw: Please locate the Memory Shard which should be somewhere around the Altar of Violet in Northern Flaris. There are Violet Magician Troupe patrolling the area.
dialogsAccept.th: กรุณาหา Memory Shard ซึ่งควรจะอยู่ที่ไหนสักแห่งรอบ ๆ Altar of Violet ใน Northern Flaris
dialogsAccept.tw: 請找到記憶碎片，它應該在布拉里斯北方的邪惡祭壇附近。有邪惡魔法團在附近巡邏。
dialogsAccept.vi: Hãy xác định Mảnh ký ức sẽ ở đâu đó xung quanh Altar of Violet ở Northern Flaris. Có Violet Magician Troupe đang tuần tra trong khu vực đó.

dialogsDecline.fi: If you wish Hael's assistance, this might be the only chance you have…
dialogsDecline.fil: If you wish Hael's assistance, this might be the only chance you have…
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous avez peut-être raison, Hael est parfois un peu lâche.
dialogsDecline.id: Jika kamu menginginkan bantuan Hael, ini mungkin satu-satunya kesempatan yang kamu miliki ...
dialogsDecline.it: If you wish Hael's assistance, this might be the only chance you have…
dialogsDecline.jp: ふむ……。苦しむハエルを何とかしてあげたいとは思わんのかのう。
dialogsDecline.kr: 하엘의 도움을 받고 싶다면… 이번이 유일한 기회일지도 모르죠...
dialogsDecline.nl: If you wish Hael's assistance, this might be the only chance you have…

dialogsDecline.sp: Si deseas la ayuda de Hael, esta podría ser tu única oportunidad...
dialogsDecline.sw: If you wish Hael's assistance, this might be the only chance you have…
dialogsDecline.th: หากคุณต้องการความช่วยเหลือของ Hael นี่อาจเป็นโอกาสเดียวที่คุณมี ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 如果你希望哈爾的幫助，這可能是你唯一的機會……
dialogsDecline.vi: Nếu bạn muốn sự trợ giúp của Hael, đây có thể là cơ hội duy nhất mà bạn có…

dialogsComplete.en: Hey! You act like you haven't seen a man trapped in a treasure chest before. Oh you come bearing Memory Shards to be purified?
dialogsComplete.ar: Hey! You act like you haven't seen a man trapped in a treasure chest before. Oh you come bearing Memory Shards to be purified?
dialogsComplete.br: Ei! Você age como se nunca tivesse visto um homem preso em um baú de tesouro antes. Oh, você vem carregando Resquícios de Memória para serem purificados?
dialogsComplete.cns: 嘿！你没见过被困在宝箱里的人吗？噢，你带着记忆碎片来净化了吗？
dialogsComplete.de: Hey! Du tust so, als hättest du noch nie einen Mann gesehen, der in einer Schatztruhe gefangen ist. Oh, du kommst mit Memory Shards, um gereinigt zu werden?
dialogsComplete.fi: Hey! You act like you haven't seen a man trapped in a treasure chest before. Oh you come bearing Memory Shards to be purified?
dialogsComplete.fil: Hey! You act like you haven't seen a man trapped in a treasure chest before. Oh you come bearing Memory Shards to be purified?
dialogsComplete.fr: Que je purifie une vision du futur ? Le premier nettoyage est offert !
dialogsComplete.id: Hei! Reaksimu seolah belum pernah melihat orang yang terjebak dalam peti harta karun sebelumnya. Oh, kau datang membawa Memory Shards untuk dimurnikan?
dialogsComplete.it: Hey! You act like you haven't seen a man trapped in a treasure chest before. Oh you come bearing Memory Shards to be purified?
dialogsComplete.jp: ケラケラケラ。人間があたしに何の用だい？　ん？　この記憶の欠片を浄化させてほしいだって？　ケラケラケラ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 헤이! 보물 상자에 갇힌 사람은 처음 보나요? 아, 정화가 필요한 기억의 파편을 가져온 거군요?
dialogsComplete.nl: Hey! You act like you haven't seen a man trapped in a treasure chest before. Oh you come bearing Memory Shards to be purified?
dialogsComplete.pl: Hey! You act like you haven't seen a man trapped in a treasure chest before. Oh you come bearing Memory Shards to be purified?
dialogsComplete.ru: Hey! You act like you haven't seen a man trapped in a treasure chest before. Oh you come bearing Memory Shards to be purified?
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Oye! Actúas como si no hubieras visto a un hombre atrapado en un cofre del tesoro antes. Oh, ¿traes Fragmentos de Memoria para purificar?
dialogsComplete.sw: Hey! You act like you haven't seen a man trapped in a treasure chest before. Oh you come bearing Memory Shards to be purified?
dialogsComplete.th: เฮ้! คุณทำตัวเหมือนที่คุณไม่ได้เห็นชายคนหนึ่งติดอยู่ในหีบสมบัติมาก่อน โอ้ คุณมาแบกหน่วยความจำที่จะบริสุทธิ์?
dialogsComplete.tw: 嘿！你那表情好像從沒見過有人被困在寶箱裡似的。喔，你是帶記憶碎片來淨化的嗎？
dialogsComplete.vi: Chào! Bạn hành động như thể bạn chưa từng thấy một người đàn ông nào bị mắc kẹt trong một rương kho báu trước đây. Ồ, bạn đến mang Mảnh ký ức để được thanh tẩy?

dialogsComplete.en: Huh? You want me to show you the most powerful skill of mine? Hmm... If you want to see it, I can show you. Here! Put those pieces into my mouth. ah~~
dialogsComplete.ar: Huh? You want me to show you the most powerful skill of mine? Hmm... If you want to see it, I can show you. Here! Put those pieces into my mouth. ah~~
dialogsComplete.br: Huh? Você quer que eu lhe mostre a minha habilidade mais poderosa? Hmm.. Se você quiser ver, eu posso te mostrar. Aqui! Coloque esses pedaços na minha boca. aahh~ *O*
dialogsComplete.cns: Huh? You want me to show you the most powerful skill of mine? Hmm... If you want to see it, I can show you. Here! Put those pieces into my mouth. ah~~
dialogsComplete.de: Hm? Du willst, dass ich dir meine mächtigste Fähigkeit zeige? Hmm... Wenn du sie sehen willst, kann ich sie dir zeigen. Hier, nimm! Steck diese Stücke in meinen Mund. Ah~~
dialogsComplete.fi: Huh? You want me to show you the most powerful skill of mine? Hmm... If you want to see it, I can show you. Here! Put those pieces into my mouth. ah~~
dialogsComplete.fil: Huh? You want me to show you the most powerful skill of mine? Hmm... If you want to see it, I can show you. Here! Put those pieces into my mouth. ah~~
dialogsComplete.fr: Hum ? Vous voulez voir mon plus beau coup ? Je peux vous montrer, pas de souci !
dialogsComplete.id: Huh? Kamu ingin saya menunjukkan keterampilan saya yang paling kuat kepadamu? Hmm.. Jika kamu ingin melihatnya, saya dapat menunjukkannya kepadamu. Sini! Masukkan potongan-potongan itu ke dalam mulutku. ah~~
dialogsComplete.it: Huh? You want me to show you the most powerful skill of mine? Hmm... If you want to see it, I can show you. Here! Put those pieces into my mouth. ah~~
dialogsComplete.jp: うん？世界で最も偉大な私の能力を一度見せてくれって？ふうんー君がそう言えば見せてあげるのも悪くはないぞ。さあ！私の口にその破片を入れて。あーん
dialogsComplete.kr: 네? 네? 제 가장 강력한 기술을 보여달라고요? 흠... 보고 싶다면, 보여 드리죠. 자아! 제 입에 넣으세요. 아~~
dialogsComplete.nl: Huh? You want me to show you the most powerful skill of mine? Hmm... If you want to see it, I can show you. Here! Put those pieces into my mouth. ah~~
dialogsComplete.pl: Huh? You want me to show you the most powerful skill of mine? Hmm... If you want to see it, I can show you. Here! Put those pieces into my mouth. ah~~
dialogsComplete.ru: Huh? You want me to show you the most powerful skill of mine? Hmm... If you want to see it, I can show you. Here! Put those pieces into my mouth. ah~~
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿Eh? ¿Quieres que te muestre mi habilidad más poderosa? Hmm.. Si quieres verla, puedo mostrártela. ¡Ven! Pon esos trozos en mi boca. ah~~
dialogsComplete.sw: Huh? You want me to show you the most powerful skill of mine? Hmm... If you want to see it, I can show you. Here! Put those pieces into my mouth. ah~~
dialogsComplete.th: ฮะ? คุณต้องการให้ฉันแสดงทักษะที่ทรงพลังที่สุดของฉัน? อืม .. ถ้าคุณต้องการเห็นมันล่ะก็ ฉันก็แสดงให้เห็นที่นี่! ว่าแล้วก็ใส่ชิ้นส่วนเหล่านั้นเข้าไปในปากของฉัน อา ~~
dialogsComplete.tw: 蛤？你想看我最強的絕招？嗯……你想看的話，我可以表演給你看。來，把那些碎片放進我嘴裡。啊~~
dialogsComplete.vi: Huh? Bạn muốn tận mục sở thị kỹ năng hùng mạnh nhất của tôi? Hmm .. Nếu bạn muốn được chứng kiến nó, tôi có thể cho bạn xem. Đây! Đưa những miếng đó vào miệng tôi. a~~

dialogsFail.en: Please acquire the Memory Shard located at the Altar of Violet, and bring it to Ancimys for purification.
dialogsFail.ar: Please acquire the Memory Shard located at the Altar of Violet, and bring it to Ancimys for purification.
dialogsFail.br: Por favor, adquira o Resquício de Memória localizado no Altar de Violeta e leve-o a Ancimys para ser purificado.
dialogsFail.cns: 请去取得位于紫色的祭团的记忆碎片，然后带去给安瑟麦斯进行净化。
dialogsFail.de: Bitte besorgt euch den Memory Shard, der sich am Altar of Violet befindet, und bringt ihn zu Ancimys, damit er gereinigt werden kann.
dialogsFail.fi: Please acquire the Memory Shard located at the Altar of Violet, and bring it to Ancimys for purification.
dialogsFail.fil: Please acquire the Memory Shard located at the Altar of Violet, and bring it to Ancimys for purification.

dialogsFail.id: Dapatkan Memory Shard yang terletak di Altar of Violet, dan bawa ke Ancimys untuk pemurnian.
dialogsFail.it: Please acquire the Memory Shard located at the Altar of Violet, and bring it to Ancimys for purification.
dialogsFail.jp: 北東の祭壇にある記憶のかけらをもって、アンシミスの元を訪ねるのじゃぞ。
dialogsFail.kr: 보라색 제단 근처에 있는 기억의 파편을 찾아 앙키미스에게 가져가면 정화해 줄 거예요.
dialogsFail.nl: Please acquire the Memory Shard located at the Altar of Violet, and bring it to Ancimys for purification.
dialogsFail.pl: Please acquire the Memory Shard located at the Altar of Violet, and bring it to Ancimys for purification.
dialogsFail.ru: Please acquire the Memory Shard located at the Altar of Violet, and bring it to Ancimys for purification.
dialogsFail.sp: Consigue el Fragmento de Memoria que se encuentra en el Altar Violeta y llévaselo a Ancimys para su purificación.
dialogsFail.sw: Please acquire the Memory Shard located at the Altar of Violet, and bring it to Ancimys for purification.
dialogsFail.th: กรุณาเก็บ Memory Shard ไว้ที่ Altar of Violet และนำมาให้ Ancimys เพื่อทำให้บริสุทธิ์
dialogsFail.tw: 請取得位於邪惡祭壇的記憶碎片，並將其帶到安奇米斯進行淨化。
dialogsFail.vi: Vui lòng lấy Mảnh ký ức ở Altar of Violet, và mang nó đến Ancimys để thanh tẩy.

name.jp: フリビーリーズンの大群

description.en: Tina asked for help with reducing the Flybrigen population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.ar: Tina asked for help with reducing the Flybrigen population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.br: Tina pediu ajuda para reduzir a população de Flybrigens, pois estão causando problemas de transporte aéreo. Você poderia matar 15 deles?
description.cns: 蒂娜请求减少飞翼魔灯的数量，因为它们给运输带来了问题。你能杀15只飞翼魔灯吗？
description.de: Tina bat um Hilfe bei der Reduzierung der Flybrigen-Population, da sie Transportprobleme verursachen. Könntest du 15 von ihnen töten?
description.fi: Tina asked for help with reducing the Flybrigen population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.fil: Hiningi ni Tina ang tulong para bawasan ang populasyon ng Flybrigen dahil nagdudulot sila ng problema sa transportasyon. Puwede mo bang patayin ang 15 sa kanila?
description.fr: Tina a demandé de l'aide pour tuer des Flybrigen, car ils posent problème aux voyageurs. Peux-tu en tuer 15 ?
description.id: Tina meminta bantuan untuk mengurangi populasi Flybrigen karena mereka mulai mengganggu transportasi. Bisakah kamu memusnahkan 15 dari mereka?
description.it: Tina asked for help with reducing the Flybrigen population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.jp: ティナから、輸送経路に＜フリビーリーズン＞が大量発生して問題になっているので、数を減らしてほしいという依頼がありました。15匹ほど討伐してきていただけませんか？
description.kr: 티나가 교통에 문제가 되고 있는 플라브리즌의 수를 줄여 달라고 부탁했어요. 플라브리즌 15마리만 잡아주실 수 있나요?
description.nl: Tina asked for help with reducing the Flybrigen population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.pl: Tina asked for help with reducing the Flybrigen population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.ru: Тина просит помочь с уменьшением численности Хвостоколов, из-за которых становится сложно выполнять полёты. Можешь убить 15 штук?
description.sp: Tina ha pedido ayuda para reducir la población de Flybrigens, ya que están causando problemas con el transporte. ¿Podrías derrotar a 15?
description.sw: Tina asked for help with reducing the Flybrigen population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.th: Tina ขอความช่วยเหลือเกี่ยวกับการลดจำนวน Flybrigen เนื่องจากปัญหาในการคมนาคมขนส่ง คุณสามารถฆ่าพวกมัน 15 ตัวได้หรือไม่?
description.tw: 蒂娜請求幫助減少骷髏魔翼的數量，因為他們正在造成交通問題。你能殺死他們中的 15 個嗎？
description.vi: Tina đã yêu cầu giúp đỡ để giảm số lượng Flybrigen vì chúng đang gây ra các vấn đề về giao thông. Bạn có thể giết 15 trong số chúng không?

dialogsBegin.id: Pergilah ke Fera, Pendeta Billposter. Dia mengelola Altar mereka di Arians, Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.it: Head on over to Fera, the Billposter Priest. She manages their Altar in Arians, Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.jp: じゃぁ、これから司祭様に会ってくんろ。司祭ぺラ様はダーコン第3地区(アリアンス)地域にあるビルポスターの祭壇を管理してらっしゃるだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 다콘 제3지구 아리안스에서 제단을 관리하는 빌포스터 사제 페라님을 찾아가세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Head on over to Fera, the Billposter Priest. She manages their Altar in Arians, Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.pl: Head on over to Fera, the Billposter Priest. She manages their Altar in Arians, Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.ru: Отправляйся к жрице атлетов Фаре. Она следит за алтарем в Арианских впадинах на Дарконе-3.
dialogsBegin.sp: Dirígete a Fera, la Sacerdotisa Billposter. Ella vigila su Altar en Arians, Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.sw: Head on over to Fera, the Billposter Priest. She manages their Altar in Arians, Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.th: มุ่งหน้าไปยัง Fera นักบวช Billposter เธอดูแลแท่นบูชาของพวกเขาใน Arians ที่ Darkon 3
dialogsBegin.tw: 請你去找祭司 [菲拉]，她在得肯第三區亞利安澤地管理爆咒師的祭壇。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đi tới Fera, Billposter Priest. Cô ấy quản lý Altar của họ ở Arians, Darkon 3.

dialogsBegin.en: She’s been looking for the Poster of Skill which contains Shadow Avatar, Roentel’s most devastating technique.
dialogsBegin.ar: She’s been looking for the Poster of Skill which contains Shadow Avatar, Roentel’s most devastating technique.
dialogsBegin.br: Aliás, a sacerdotisa Fera está procurando por algo muito importante. É o Pôster de Habilidade, que é o pôster de Shadow Avatar, a habilidade do herói Billposter Roentel.
dialogsBegin.cns: 【菲拉】在找很重要的东西，叫技能魔法符咒，听说那是只有英雄罗瓦特才可以用的技术……
dialogsBegin.de: Ach so, Priesterin Fera sucht etwas besonderes. Es ist das Poster of Skill(Master), ein Poster von Shadow Avatar, der Skill von Billposter Hero Roentel.
dialogsBegin.fi: She’s been looking for the Poster of Skill which contains Shadow Avatar, Roentel’s most devastating technique.
dialogsBegin.fil: She’s been looking for the Poster of Skill which contains Shadow Avatar, Roentel’s most devastating technique.
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais avant de te présenter à Fera. Il y a une mission que tu dois accomplir. Fera recherche une relique perdue : le Mantra de Roentel qui permet d'apprendre la compétence légendaire de Roentel.
dialogsBegin.id: Dia sedang mencari Poster of Skill yang berisi Shadow Avatar, teknik paling menghancurkan Roentel.
dialogsBegin.it: She’s been looking for the Poster of Skill which contains Shadow Avatar, Roentel’s most devastating technique.
dialogsBegin.jp: あ、ぺラ様はとっても大事な物を探しとるだ。ニーベルン・ポスターつうもんで、これは英雄ロエンテール様だけが使えたという封印奥義、シャドウアバターのポスターだっちゅう話じゃ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 페라님은 섀도의 분신이 담긴 스킬 포스터를 찾고 계셨습니다. 로엔텔의 가장 강력한 기술이지요.
dialogsBegin.nl: She’s been looking for the Poster of Skill which contains Shadow Avatar, Roentel’s most devastating technique.
dialogsBegin.pl: She’s been looking for the Poster of Skill which contains Shadow Avatar, Roentel’s most devastating technique.
dialogsBegin.ru: Кстати, Фара ищет Афишу мастера. Эта афиша позволяет атлету применять давно забытую и очень опасную технику, придуманную Арнолли. Техника называется "Темный близнец".
dialogsBegin.sp: Ha estado buscando el Póster de Habilidad que contiene la Sombra del Avatar, la técnica más devastadora de Roentel.
dialogsBegin.sw: She’s been looking for the Poster of Skill which contains Shadow Avatar, Roentel’s most devastating technique.
dialogsBegin.th: เธอกำลังมองหา Poster of Skill ที่มี Shadow Avatar เทคนิคการทำลายล้างที่ยิ่งใหญ่ที่สุดของ Roentel
dialogsBegin.tw: [菲拉] 在找很重要的東西，叫技能魔法符咒，聽說那是只有英雄羅瓦特才可以用的技術……
dialogsBegin.vi: Cô ấy đang tìm kiếm Poster of Skill có chứa Shadow Avatar, kỹ thuật tàn khốc nhất của Roentel.

dialogsBegin.en: Rumor has it that grave-robbers controlling the Steam Walkers have gotten a hold of it. Take it back from them, and get it into Fera’s hands.
dialogsBegin.ar: Rumor has it that grave-robbers controlling the Steam Walkers have gotten a hold of it. Take it back from them, and get it into Fera’s hands.
dialogsBegin.br: Ouvi dizer que os ladrões de túmulos que controlam os Andarilhos a Vapor estão com ele. Por favor, recupere o Pôster de Habilidade dos Andarilhos e leve-o para a sacerdotisa Fera em Arianos.
dialogsBegin.cns: Rumor has it that grave-robbers controlling the Steam Walkers have gotten a hold of it. Take it back from them, and get it into Fera’s hands.
dialogsBegin.de: Gerüchten zufolge haben die Grabräuber, die die Steamwalker kontrollieren, es in die Hände bekommen. Nimm es ihnen ab und bring es zu Fera.
dialogsBegin.fi: Rumor has it that grave-robbers controlling the Steam Walkers have gotten a hold of it. Take it back from them, and get it into Fera’s hands.
dialogsBegin.fil: Rumor has it that grave-robbers controlling the Steam Walkers have gotten a hold of it. Take it back from them, and get it into Fera’s hands.
dialogsBegin.fr: On dit que les Steamwalkers de Darkon 1 seraient parvenus à le retrouver, il faut vraiment le retrouver au plus vite et le rapporter à Fera !
dialogsBegin.id: Rumor mengatakan bahwa perampok kuburan yang mengendalikan Steamwalker telah menguasainya. Ambil kembali dari mereka, dan serahkan ke tangan Fera.
dialogsBegin.it: Rumor has it that grave-robbers controlling the Steam Walkers have gotten a hold of it. Take it back from them, and get it into Fera’s hands.
dialogsBegin.jp: 噂によると、スチームウォーカーを操る墓泥棒がそれを手に入れたという。彼らからそれを取り戻し、ベラの手に渡せ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 소문으로는, 스팀 워커를 조종하는 도굴꾼들이 그걸 손에 넣었다고 해요. 되찾아서 페라에게 전달하세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Rumor has it that grave-robbers controlling the Steam Walkers have gotten a hold of it. Take it back from them, and get it into Fera’s hands.
dialogsBegin.pl: Plotka głosi, że przejęli go rabusie grobów, kontrolujących przez Parochodziarzy. Odbierz go, i przekaż w ręce Fera.
dialogsBegin.ru: Rumor has it that grave-robbers controlling the Steam Walkers have gotten a hold of it. Take it back from them, and get it into Fera’s hands.
dialogsBegin.sp: Se rumorea que los ladrones de tumbas que controlaban a los Caminantes Vapor se han apoderado de él. Retíralo y ponlo en manos de Fera.
dialogsBegin.sw: Rumor has it that grave-robbers controlling the Steam Walkers have gotten a hold of it. Take it back from them, and get it into Fera’s hands.
dialogsBegin.th: มีข่าวลือว่าโจรผู้ควบคุม Steam Walkers ได้ยึดมันไว้ เอากลับมาจากพวกมันและส่งให้กับ Fera
dialogsBegin.tw: 聽說操控 蒸氣機械 的盜墓賊拿到了它。把它奪回來，交到費菈手上。
dialogsBegin.vi: Có tin đồn rằng những kẻ cướp mộ điều khiển Steamwalker đã nắm giữ nó. Hãy giành nó lại từ bọn chúng và đưa nó cho Fera nắm giữ.

dialogsAccept.en: Good luck, friend!
dialogsAccept.ar: حظا موفقا، يا صديقي!
dialogsAccept.br: Boa sorte, amigo(a)!
dialogsAccept.cns: 一切辛苦你了！再见！
dialogsAccept.de: Viel Glück. Bye.
dialogsAccept.fi: Good luck, friend!
dialogsAccept.fil: Good luck, friend!
dialogsAccept.fr: Bonne chance, futur Moine !
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga beruntung, teman!
dialogsAccept.it: Good luck, friend!
dialogsAccept.jp: んだば！たのんだど！
dialogsAccept.kr: 행운을 빌어요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Good luck, friend!
dialogsAccept.pl: Good luck, friend!
dialogsAccept.ru: Удачи тебе!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Buena suerte, amigo!
dialogsAccept.sw: Good luck, friend!
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้โชคดี เพื่อน!
dialogsAccept.tw: 一切辛苦你了！再見！
dialogsAccept.vi: Chúc may mắn, người bạn!

dialogsDecline.en: Someone with evil intentions using Shadow Avatar could lead to catastrophe. Please, reconsider!
dialogsDecline.ar: Someone with evil intentions using Shadow Avatar could lead to catastrophe. Please, reconsider!
dialogsDecline.br: O Pôster da Habilidade pode acionar uma habilidade muito perigosa. Nós não poderemos pará-la se começar a ser abusada, então por favor traga o pôster de volta. Isso é muito sério.
dialogsDecline.cns: 技能魔法符咒'它会发动危险的法术效果，所以必需要找它并且阻止它被使用，否则后果不勘设想！
dialogsDecline.de: Das Poster of Skill(Master) kann einen gefährlichen Skill aktivieren. Wir können ihn dann nicht mehr aufhalten, also bring es bitte zurück. Das ist ernst gemeint.
dialogsDecline.fi: Someone with evil intentions using Shadow Avatar could lead to catastrophe. Please, reconsider!
dialogsDecline.fil: Someone with evil intentions using Shadow Avatar could lead to catastrophe. Please, reconsider!
dialogsDecline.fr: Le Mantra de Roentel peut s'avérer extrêmement dangereux si il est entre de mauvaises mains. Il est vraiment important de le retrouver...
dialogsDecline.id: Seseorang dengan niat jahat menggunakan Shadow Avatar dapat menyebabkan malapetaka. Tolong, pertimbangkan kembali!
dialogsDecline.it: Someone with evil intentions using Shadow Avatar could lead to catastrophe. Please, reconsider!
dialogsDecline.jp: ニーベルン・ポスターは封印奥義シャドウ・アバターを発動するために作られたんだども、万が一悪用されると大変なことになっちまうんだ･･･。そうなる前に見つけてくんろ！
dialogsDecline.kr: 섀도의 분신을 악의적으로 사용하려는 자가 있다면 큰 재앙이 일어날지도 모른다고요. 다시 생각해 주세요!
dialogsDecline.nl: Someone with evil intentions using Shadow Avatar could lead to catastrophe. Please, reconsider!
dialogsDecline.pl: Someone with evil intentions using Shadow Avatar could lead to catastrophe. Please, reconsider!
dialogsDecline.ru: Прошу тебя, одумайся! Ты не представляешь, что случится, если у гробокопателей появятся "Темные близнецы"!
dialogsDecline.sp: Alguien con intenciones malas que use la Sombra del Avatar podría causar una catástrofe. ¡Por favor, reconsidéralo!
dialogsDecline.sw: Someone with evil intentions using Shadow Avatar could lead to catastrophe. Please, reconsider!
dialogsDecline.th: คนที่มีเจตนาร้ายอาจใช้ Shadow Avatar ให้เกิดภัยพิบัติ ได้โปรดพิจารณาอีกครั้ง!
dialogsDecline.tw: 若心懷惡意的人使用闇影化身，恐怕會釀成大禍。請再考慮一下！
dialogsDecline.vi: Ai đó có ý định xấu xa trong việc sử dụng Shadow Avatar có thể dẫn đến thảm họa. Xin hãy cân nhắc!

dialogsComplete.en: Well done! People say that only Roentel can use this, but with Billposters like you around, who knows?
dialogsComplete.ar: Well done! People say that only Roentel can use this, but with Billposters like you around, who knows?
dialogsComplete.br: Oh... Você fez um ótimo trabalho. As pessoas dizem que ninguém exceto Roentel pode usar isso, mas quem sabe?
dialogsComplete.cns: 请帮我找回技能魔法符咒，虽然只有罗瓦特才会使用，不过，为了以防万一…
dialogsComplete.de: Oh.. Da hast du gute Arbeit geleistet. Die Leute sagen, das keiner außer Roentel es benutzen kann, aber wer weiß es noch?
dialogsComplete.fi: Well done! People say that only Roentel can use this, but with Billposters like you around, who knows?
dialogsComplete.fil: Well done! People say that only Roentel can use this, but with Billposters like you around, who knows?
dialogsComplete.fr: Tu as retrouvé le Mantra de Roentel ! On dit que seul Roentel pouvait l'utiliser, mais qui sait.
dialogsComplete.id: Bagus sekali! Orang bilang hanya Roentel yang bisa menggunakan ini, tapi dengan billposter sepertimu, siapa tahu?
dialogsComplete.it: Well done! People say that only Roentel can use this, but with Billposters like you around, who knows?
dialogsComplete.jp: あぁ、本当に見つけてくれたんだね。ありがとう！今までロエンテール様以外にこれの使い方がわかる人がいませんでしたが、これからもいないわけではないからね。
dialogsComplete.kr: 잘하셨어요! 사람들은 오직 로엔텔님만이 사용할 수 있는 거라고 했지만, 당신 같은 빌포스터가 있다면 어떻게 될지 모르죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: Well done! People say that only Roentel can use this, but with Billposters like you around, who knows?
dialogsComplete.pl: Well done! People say that only Roentel can use this, but with Billposters like you around, who knows?
dialogsComplete.ru: Спасибо! Вообще-то говорят, что эту Афишу мог использовать только сам Арнолли, но в последнее время такие талантливые атлеты пошли - посмотреть хотя бы на тебя!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Bien hecho! La gente dice que solo Roentel puede usar esto, pero con Billposters como tú, ¿quién sabe?
dialogsComplete.sw: Well done! People say that only Roentel can use this, but with Billposters like you around, who knows?
dialogsComplete.th: ทำได้ดี! คนบอกว่ามีเพียง Roentel สามารถใช้สิ่งนี้ได้ แต่กับ Billposters เช่นคุณ ใครจะรู้ว่าจะเกิดอะไรขึ้นกันล่ะ?
dialogsComplete.tw: 請幫我找回技能魔法符咒，雖然只有羅瓦特才會使用，不過，為了以防萬一…
dialogsComplete.vi: Làm tốt lắm! Mọi người nói rằng chỉ có Roentel mới có thể sử dụng cái này, nhưng với các Billposter giống như bạn quanh đây, ai biết được?

dialogsComplete.en: Until then though, I’ll do my best to protect it.
dialogsComplete.ar: Until then though, I’ll do my best to protect it.
dialogsComplete.br: Muito obrigado. Farei o meu melhor para mantê-lo seguro.
dialogsComplete.cns: 谢谢你，我以后会小心保管它~
dialogsComplete.de: Vielen Dank. Ich werde mein Bestes tun um es zu beschützen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Until then though, I’ll do my best to protect it.
dialogsComplete.fil: Until then though, I’ll do my best to protect it.
dialogsComplete.fr: Quoiqu'il en soit, merci infiniment ! Je ferai de mon mieux pour le garder en sécurité.
dialogsComplete.id: Sampai saat itu, saya akan melakukan yang terbaik untuk melindunginya.
dialogsComplete.it: Until then though, I’ll do my best to protect it.
dialogsComplete.jp: ありがとうございます。悪用されないよう、これからは厳重に保管するよ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 그때까지는 제가 잘 지키고 있겠습니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Until then though, I’ll do my best to protect it.
dialogsComplete.pl: Until then though, I’ll do my best to protect it.
dialogsComplete.ru: А пока что я буду хранить ее как зеницу ока.
dialogsComplete.sp: Hasta entonces, haré todo lo posible para protegerlo.
dialogsComplete.sw: Until then though, I’ll do my best to protect it.
dialogsComplete.th: จนถึงตอนนั้น ฉันจะพยายามอย่างสุดความสามารถเพื่อปกป้องมัน
dialogsComplete.tw: 謝謝你，我以後會小心保管它~
dialogsComplete.vi: Tuy nhiên, cho đến lúc đó, tôi sẽ cố gắng hết sức để bảo vệ nó.

dialogsFail.en: What brings you to this holy Altar for the souls of Heroes?
dialogsFail.ar: What brings you to this holy Altar for the souls of Heroes?
dialogsFail.br: Aqui é o local de proteção das almas dos heróis. O que o trouxe aqui?
dialogsFail.cns: 是什么指引你来到这神圣的英雄祭坛
dialogsFail.de: Was führt dich zu diesem heiligen Altar für die Seelen der Helden?
dialogsFail.fi: What brings you to this holy Altar for the souls of Heroes?
dialogsFail.fil: What brings you to this holy Altar for the souls of Heroes?
dialogsFail.fr: En ce lieu nous protégeons les âmes des Héros. Mais quelle est la raison de ta venue ?
dialogsFail.id: Apa yang membawamu ke Altar suci ini untuk jiwa Pahlawan?
dialogsFail.it: What brings you to this holy Altar for the souls of Heroes?
dialogsFail.jp: ここは英雄たちの魂を守る祭壇です。何か用かい？
dialogsFail.kr: 영웅들의 영혼이 잠들어 있는 이 성스러운 제단에 무슨 일로 오셨지요?
dialogsFail.nl: What brings you to this holy Altar for the souls of Heroes?
dialogsFail.pl: What brings you to this holy Altar for the souls of Heroes?
dialogsFail.ru: What brings you to this holy Altar for the souls of Heroes?
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Qué te trae a este Altar sagrado de las Almas de los Héroes?
dialogsFail.sw: What brings you to this holy Altar for the souls of Heroes?
dialogsFail.th: อะไรนำให้คุณยังแท่นบูชาแห่งวิญญาณของเหล่าฮีโร่กันล่ะ?
dialogsFail.tw: 是什麼讓你來到這個英雄靈魂的神聖祭壇？
dialogsFail.vi: Điều gì đưa bạn đến Altar linh thiêng dành cho linh hồn của các Heroes?

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?

dialogsDecline.en: You have yet to pay for your sins…

dialogsDecline.cns: 你还没有为你的罪恶付出代价...
dialogsDecline.de: Du musst noch immer für deine Sünden bezahlen...
dialogsDecline.fi: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.fil: Di mo pa bayad ang iyong mga kasalanan…
dialogsDecline.fr: Quand expieras-tu tes nombreux crimes ?
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu belum membayar untuk dosa-dosamu…
dialogsDecline.it: Devi ancora pagare per i tuoi peccati...
dialogsDecline.jp: いつになったら、この底知れぬ罪悪感から抜けられるのだろう？
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신은 아직 죗값을 치르지 않았으니...
dialogsDecline.nl: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.pl: Musisz najpierw zapłacić za swoje grzechy…
dialogsDecline.ru: Велики твои грехи…
dialogsDecline.sp: Todavía tienes que pagar por tus pecados...
dialogsDecline.sw: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.th: คุณยังไม้ได้ชดใช้บาปของคุณ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 你還沒有為你的罪付出代價…
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn vẫn chưa phải trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình…

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.br: Sua missão foi concluída. Seus pecados foram perdoados.
dialogsComplete.cns: 任务完成，你的罪恶已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Buße getan. Deine Sünden wurden dir vergeben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Questmu telah tercapai. Dosa-dosamu telah diampuni.
dialogsComplete.it: La Missione è terminata. I tuoi peccati sono stati perdonati.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 끝났습니다. 당신의 죄를 용서하지요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Боги одобрили твое деяние и простили тебе грехи.
dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น บาปของคุณได้รับการอภัยแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nhiệm vụ của bạn đã được hoàn thành. Tội lỗi của bạn đã được tha thứ.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

description.en: Gather 10 Forforms from Mushpangs, 5 Peakyrinds from Peakyturtles and 1 Poporam from Doridoma then deliver them to Maki, the Assist Master in Northern Flarine.
description.ar: Gather 10 Forforms from Mushpangs, 5 Peakyrinds from Peakyturtles and 1 Poporam from Doridoma then deliver them to Maki, the Assist Master in Northern Flarine.
description.br: Reúna 10 Forforms de Mushpangs, 5 Peakyrinds de Peakyturtles e 1 Poporam de Doridoma e entregue-os a Maki, o Mestre Assist ao Norte de Flarine.
description.cns: 寻找材料!!10个蘑菇孢子，5个坚硬背壳，1个紫晶球。找到材料后，去找圣职者大师马奇。
description.de: Es gibt einen wichtigen Gegenstand, den du brauchst: 5 Forform von Mushpang. Bringe diese zum Assist Meister!
description.fi: Gather 10 Forforms from Mushpangs, 5 Peakyrinds from Peakyturtles and 1 Poporam from Doridoma then deliver them to Maki, the Assist Master in Northern Flarine.
description.fil: Gather 10 Forforms from Mushpangs, 5 Peakyrinds from Peakyturtles and 1 Poporam from Doridoma then deliver them to Maki, the Assist Master in Northern Flarine.
description.fr: Collecter 10 Forforms sur des Mushpangs, 5 Carapaces sur des Peakyturtles et 1 Poporam sur un Doridoma puis les rapporter au Maître des Acolytes Maki à Flarine Nord.
description.id: Kumpulkan 10 Forforms dari Mushpangs, 5 Peakyrinds dari Peakyrinds dan 1 Poporam dari Doridoma lalu kirimkan ke Maki, Assist Master di Northern Flarine.
description.it: Gather 10 Forforms from Mushpangs, 5 Peakyrinds from Peakyturtles and 1 Poporam from Doridoma then deliver them to Maki, the Assist Master in Northern Flarine.
description.jp: 集める材料は、マッシュファングを倒してポポム10個、ピーキータートルを倒してピーキーリングを5個、ドリドマを倒してポポラム1個集めたら、アシストマスターの元へ向かおう。
description.kr: 머쉬팡에게서 포폼 10개, 피키터틀에게서 피키린드 5개, 도리도마에게서 포포람 1개를 모아 플라리네 북부에 있는 어시스트 마스터 마키에게 전달하세요.
description.nl: Gather 10 Forforms from Mushpangs, 5 Peakyrinds from Peakyturtles and 1 Poporam from Doridoma then deliver them to Maki, the Assist Master in Northern Flarine.
description.pl: Gather 10 Forforms from Mushpangs, 5 Peakyrinds from Peakyturtles and 1 Poporam from Doridoma then deliver them to Maki, the Assist Master in Northern Flarine.
description.ru: Нужно добыть пять грибных мешочков у сыробежек и отнести их Макею, магистру униформистов из северной Фларинции.
description.sp: Consigue 10 Forforms de los Mushpangs, 5 Peakyrinds de los Peakyturtles y 1 Poporam de los Doridomas. Entrégaselos a Maki, el Maestro Assist en Flarine Norte.
description.sw: Gather 10 Forforms from Mushpangs, 5 Peakyrinds from Peakyturtles and 1 Poporam from Doridoma then deliver them to Maki, the Assist Master in Northern Flarine.
description.th: รวบรวม 10 Forforms จาก Mushpangs, 5 Peakyrinds จาก Peakyturtles และ 1 Poporam จาก Doridoma จากนั้นนำไปให้ Maki ซึ่งเป็น Assist Master ใน Northern Flarine
description.tw: 從咚咚菇收集 10 個咚咚菇粉末、從尖刺烏龜收集 5 個尖刺犰狳硬皮，並從多利多瑪收集 1 個紫寶石，然後交給布拉里斯北部的神職者大師瑪琪。
description.vi: Thu thập 10 Forforms từ Mushpangs, 5 Peakyrinds từ Peakyturtles và 1 Poporam từ Doridoma sau đó giao chúng cho Maki, Assist Master ở Northern Flarine.

dialogsBegin.en: You've done well so far, Vagrant. But I have another task for you if you are willing.
dialogsBegin.ar: You've done well so far, Vagrant. But I have another task for you if you are willing.
dialogsBegin.br: Parabéns por passar no 1° teste! Mas tudo está apenas começando.
dialogsBegin.cns: 厉害!你已经通过第一个考验了。但是不是这样就结束的，要成为一个真正的圣职者的话，还要接受很多的考验。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich gratuliere dir zum Bestehen der ersten Prüfung! Aber die Ausbildung hat gerade erst begonnen. Versuche die Sache ernster zu nehmen. Ich glaube, dass du bereit bist.
dialogsBegin.fi: You've done well so far, Vagrant. But I have another task for you if you are willing.
dialogsBegin.fil: You've done well so far, Vagrant. But I have another task for you if you are willing.
dialogsBegin.fr: Félicitations pour avoir réussi le premier test ! Mais cela ne fait que commencer.
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu telah melakukannya dengan baik sejauh ini, Vagrant. Tapi aku punya tugas lain untukmu jika kamu bersedia.
dialogsBegin.it: You've done well so far, Vagrant. But I have another task for you if you are willing.
dialogsBegin.jp: 最初のテストは合格だ。おめでとう！しかしこれからが本番だ。次のテストを受ける準備はできたかな？
dialogsBegin.kr: 지금까지 잘하셨어요, 수련생님. 괜찮다면 다음 과제도 부탁할게요.
dialogsBegin.nl: You've done well so far, Vagrant. But I have another task for you if you are willing.
dialogsBegin.pl: You've done well so far, Vagrant. But I have another task for you if you are willing.
dialogsBegin.ru: Пока что, бродяга, ты отлично справляешься с заданиями. Но это только начало. Продолжим?
dialogsBegin.sp: Lo has hecho muy bien hasta ahora, Vagrant. Pero tengo otra tarea para ti, si estás dispuesto.
dialogsBegin.sw: You've done well so far, Vagrant. But I have another task for you if you are willing.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณทำได้ดีมากแล้ว Vagrant แต่ฉันมีงานอื่นสำหรับคุณถ้าคุณยินดีที่จะทำ
dialogsBegin.tw: 厲害！你已經通過第一個考驗了。但是不是這樣就結束的，要成為一個真正的神職者的話，還要接受很多的考驗。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn đã làm rất tốt, Vagrant. Nhưng tôi có một nhiệm vụ khác cho bạn nếu bạn sẵn lòng.

dialogsBegin.en: For your next task, I need you to gather some materials which are used to create Assist weapons.
dialogsBegin.ar: For your next task, I need you to gather some materials which are used to create Assist weapons.
dialogsBegin.br: O 2° teste é obter todos os materiais para fazer armas de Assist, e então obter, em troca, informações a respeito das armas.
dialogsBegin.cns: 第2个训练就是，要去找制作战士武器的材料。
dialogsBegin.de: Die zweite Prüfung besteht darin alle notwendigen Dinge für die Waffen zu sammeln. Dann erhältst du eine Einweisung in die Waffe. Das ist das gesteckte Ausbildungsziel.
dialogsBegin.fi: For your next task, I need you to gather some materials which are used to create Assist weapons.
dialogsBegin.fil: For your next task, I need you to gather some materials which are used to create Assist weapons.
dialogsBegin.fr: Le deuxième test consiste à trouver les matériaux nécessaires pour fabriquer les armes de l'Acolyte, et par la même occasion en apprendre plus sur celles-ci.
dialogsBegin.id: Untuk tugasmu selanjutnya, aku ingin kamu mengumpulkan beberapa bahan yang digunakan untuk membuat senjata Assist.
dialogsBegin.it: For your next task, I need you to gather some materials which are used to create Assist weapons.
dialogsBegin.jp: 2番目のテストを教えよう。これから諸君は、アシストの武器の製作に必要な材料を集めてこなければならない。全ての材料を無事に集めてこれたら、アシストの武器に関する情報を教えよう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이번 과제는 어시스트 무기를 만드는 데 쓰이는 재료를 모아오는 일이에요.
dialogsBegin.nl: For your next task, I need you to gather some materials which are used to create Assist weapons.
dialogsBegin.pl: For your next task, I need you to gather some materials which are used to create Assist weapons.
dialogsBegin.ru: Нужно собрать материалы, из которых делают оружие униформиста.
dialogsBegin.sp: Para tu siguiente tarea, necesito que consigas los materiales que se usan para crear armas de Assist.
dialogsBegin.sw: For your next task, I need you to gather some materials which are used to create Assist weapons.
dialogsBegin.th: สำหรับภารกิจต่อไปของคุณ ฉันต้องการให้คุณรวบรวมวัตถุดิบบางอย่างที่ใช้ในการสร้างอาวุธ Assist
dialogsBegin.tw: 第 2 個訓練就是，要去找製作勇者武器的材料。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đối với nhiệm vụ tiếp theo của bạn, tôi cần bạn thu thập một số nguyên liệu được sử dụng để tạo vũ khí của Assist.

dialogsBegin.ar: The Assist Master is with the Madrigal Job Masters in North-Fl. Go!
