dialogsBegin.fi: The Assist Master is with the Madrigal Job Masters in North-Fl. Go!
dialogsBegin.fil: The Assist Master is with the Madrigal Job Masters in North-Fl. Go!
dialogsBegin.fr: Puis apporte tout ça à Maki, le Maître des Acolytes que tu trouveras au nord de Flarine.
dialogsBegin.id: Assist Master bersama Madrigal Job Masters di North-Fl. Pergi!
dialogsBegin.it: The Assist Master is with the Madrigal Job Masters in North-Fl. Go!
dialogsBegin.jp: アシストマスターは北広場にあるマドリガル職業マスターズにいるはずだ。準備が整ったら、すぐに出発するといい。
dialogsBegin.kr: 어시스트 마스터는 플라리네 북부의 마드리갈 직업 마스터즈에 있답니다. 가실 수 있죠?
dialogsBegin.nl: The Assist Master is with the Madrigal Job Masters in North-Fl. Go!
dialogsBegin.pl: The Assist Master is with the Madrigal Job Masters in North-Fl. Go!
dialogsBegin.ru: Как думаешь, по плечу тебе такое задание?
dialogsBegin.sp: El Maestro Assist está con los demás Maestros de Clase de Madrigal en Flarine Norte. ¡En marcha!
dialogsBegin.sw: The Assist Master is with the Madrigal Job Masters in North-Fl. Go!
dialogsBegin.th: Assist Master อยู่กับ Madrigal Job Masters ใน North-Fl ไป!
dialogsBegin.tw: 神職者轉職教官在布拉里斯北部的瑪德利賈專業轉職中心，沒時間亂晃了，趕快出發吧！
dialogsBegin.vi: Assist Master ở cùng với các Madrigal Job Masters tại North-Fl. Đi nào!

dialogsAccept.en: Good luck, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.ar: Good luck, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.br: Boa sorte, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你好运，初心者！
dialogsAccept.de: Viel Glück, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.fi: Good luck, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.fil: Good luck, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.fr: Allez, je compte sur toi !
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga berhasil, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.it: Good luck, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.jp: 最後まで慎重に、速やかに、そして正確に課題をやりとげるのだ。では、行ってきたまえ！
dialogsAccept.kr: 행운을 빌어요, 방랑자님!
dialogsAccept.nl: Good luck, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.pl: Good luck, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.ru: Good luck, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Buena suerte, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.sw: Good luck, Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้โชคดี Vagrant!
dialogsAccept.tw: 好運，見習生！
dialogsAccept.vi: Chúc may mắn, Vagrant!

dialogsDecline.en: I guess some people just aren't suited to be an Assist. That's alright, young one. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ar: I guess some people just aren't suited to be an Assist. That's alright, young one. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.br: Se desistir, eu vou me livrar de você! Entendido?!!
dialogsDecline.cns: 如果你要放弃的话，我一定会找你算帐的，知道了吗!
dialogsDecline.de: Wenn du jetzt aufgibst, dann werde ich dich, egal wie, finden und beseitigen. Verstehst du?!!
dialogsDecline.fi: I guess some people just aren't suited to be an Assist. That's alright, young one. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fil: I guess some people just aren't suited to be an Assist. That's alright, young one. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fr: Si tu abandonnes, ne compte plus sur moi pour la suite.
dialogsDecline.id: Aku kira beberapa orang tidak cocok untuk menjadi Assist. Tidak apa-apa, anak muda. Bicaralah denganku lagi jika kamu berubah pikiran.
dialogsDecline.it: I guess some people just aren't suited to be an Assist. That's alright, young one. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.jp: アシストへの道を諦めるのか？私は君の志を見損なったぞ。しかしそれも仕方あるまい。アシストの道は厳しいと言っただろう。
dialogsDecline.kr: 어시스트는 아무나 할 수 있는 직업은 아니에요. 괜찮아요. 마음이 바뀌면 언제든 다시 찾아오세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: I guess some people just aren't suited to be an Assist. That's alright, young one. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.pl: I guess some people just aren't suited to be an Assist. That's alright, young one. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ru: Не каждому дано быть униформистом. И в этом нет ничего страшного. Но если вдруг передумаешь - возвращайся.
dialogsDecline.sp: Creo que algunas personas simplemente no están hechas para ser Assist. Esta bien, joven. Habla conmigo de nuevo si cambias de opinión.
dialogsDecline.sw: I guess some people just aren't suited to be an Assist. That's alright, young one. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันเดาว่าบางคนไม่เหมาะที่จะเป็น Assist ไม่เป็นไร เจ้าหนุ่ม มาคุยกับฉันอีกครั้งถ้าคุณเปลี่ยนใจ
dialogsDecline.tw: 如果你要放棄的話，我一定會找你算帳的，知道了嗎！
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi đoán một số người không phù hợp để trở thành một Assist. Không sao đâu, bạn trẻ. Nói chuyện lại với tôi nếu bạn thay đổi ý định.

dialogsComplete.en: Thank you for delivering the Forform, Vagrant. Now, on to your next lesson. Assist weapons include Knuckles or Sticks.
dialogsComplete.ar: Thank you for delivering the Forform, Vagrant. Now, on to your next lesson. Assist weapons include Knuckles or Sticks.
dialogsComplete.br: Obrigado por entregar o Forform, Vagrant. Agora, vamos para a sua próxima lição. As armas para Assists incluem Punhos ou Bastões.
dialogsComplete.cns: 辛苦你了。从现在开始要仔细的听我所说的话。圣职者有2种武器，一个是拳套、另外一个是魔棒。
dialogsComplete.de: Vielen Dank für die Forform, Vagrant. Und nun zu deiner nächsten Lektion. Zu den Assist-Waffen gehören Knuckles oder Sticks.
dialogsComplete.fi: Thank you for delivering the Forform, Vagrant. Now, on to your next lesson. Assist weapons include Knuckles or Sticks.
dialogsComplete.fil: Thank you for delivering the Forform, Vagrant. Now, on to your next lesson. Assist weapons include Knuckles or Sticks.
dialogsComplete.fr: Merci d'être venu jusqu'ici, c'est parfait ! Bon, écoute-moi attentivement maintenant. Un Acolyte utilise deux types d'armes : les armes de poing ou les sceptres.
dialogsComplete.id: Terima kasih telah mengirimkan Forform, Vagrant. Sekarang, ke pelajaran berikutnya. Senjata Assist termasuk Knuckles ataupun Sticks.
dialogsComplete.it: Thank you for delivering the Forform, Vagrant. Now, on to your next lesson. Assist weapons include Knuckles or Sticks.
dialogsComplete.jp: 献身に身を捧げる心広きアシスト志望者よ、お疲れさまでした。では、テストをクリアした勇敢な志望者に、アシストの武器について説明いたしましょう。アシストは、ナックルとスティックという2つの武器を使います。
dialogsComplete.kr: 포폼을 구해 오셨군요, 감사합니다. 그럼 다음 수업으로 넘어갈까요. 어시스트 무기로는 너클과 스틱이 있어요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Thank you for delivering the Forform, Vagrant. Now, on to your next lesson. Assist weapons include Knuckles or Sticks.
dialogsComplete.pl: Thank you for delivering the Forform, Vagrant. Now, on to your next lesson. Assist weapons include Knuckles or Sticks.
dialogsComplete.ru: Спасибо за грибные мешочки, бродяга. Итак, слушай внимательно: униформисты пользуются перчатками и жезлами.
dialogsComplete.sp: Gracias por entregar los Forforms, Vagrant. Ahora, tu próxima lección. Las armas de Assist incluyen Nudillos y Varas.
dialogsComplete.sw: Thank you for delivering the Forform, Vagrant. Now, on to your next lesson. Assist weapons include Knuckles or Sticks.
dialogsComplete.th: ขอบคุณที่ส่ง Forform ให้ Vagrant ไปที่บทเรียนต่อไปของคุณ อาวุธของ Assist ได้แก่ Knuckles หรือ Sticks
dialogsComplete.tw: 辛苦你了。從現在開始要仔細的聽我所說的話。神職者有 2 種武器，一個是拳套、另外一個是法棒。
dialogsComplete.vi: Cảm ơn bạn đã cung cấp Forform, Vagrant. Bây giờ, sang bài học tiếp theo của bạn. Vũ khí của Assist bao gồm Knuckles hoặc Sticks.

dialogsComplete.en: A Knuckle is a fist weapon used for close-quarters combat, and the Stick is used to perform certain Assist skills, such as healing.
dialogsComplete.ar: A Knuckle is a fist weapon used for close-quarters combat, and the Stick is used to perform certain Assist skills, such as healing.
dialogsComplete.br: O Punho é uma arma estilo luva e é perfeito para combates corpo-a-corpo. O Bastão é necessário para se usar algumas das habilidades de Assist, como Curar por exemplo.
dialogsComplete.cns: 拳套是一种近战攻击武器，而魔棒则是施展一些圣职者技能用的，比如治疗。
dialogsComplete.de: Der Knuckle ist eine Faustwaffe, die im Nahkampf eingesetzt wird, und der Stick wird für bestimmte Fertigkeiten verwendet, wie z.B. das Heilen.
dialogsComplete.fi: A Knuckle is a fist weapon used for close-quarters combat, and the Stick is used to perform certain Assist skills, such as healing.
dialogsComplete.fil: A Knuckle is a fist weapon used for close-quarters combat, and the Stick is used to perform certain Assist skills, such as healing.
dialogsComplete.fr: Les armes de poing sont efficaces en combat rapproché, alors que le sceptre est nécessaire pour utiliser les sorts de l'Acolyte.
dialogsComplete.id: Knuckle adalah senjata tinju yang digunakan untuk pertempuran jarak dekat, dan Stick digunakan untuk melakukan Assist skill tertentu, seperti penyembuhan.
dialogsComplete.it: A Knuckle is a fist weapon used for close-quarters combat, and the Stick is used to perform certain Assist skills, such as healing.
dialogsComplete.jp: ナックルは接近戦が可能な武器です。スティックを装備すれば、補助スキルを使うことができます。アシストはこの補助スキルをどのように組み合わせるかが重要なのです。
dialogsComplete.kr: 너클은 근접 전투용으로 쓸 수 있는 주먹 무기고, 스틱은 치유 같은 어시스트 스킬을 쓸 때 사용한답니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: A Knuckle is a fist weapon used for close-quarters combat, and the Stick is used to perform certain Assist skills, such as healing.
dialogsComplete.pl: A Knuckle is a fist weapon used for close-quarters combat, and the Stick is used to perform certain Assist skills, such as healing.
dialogsComplete.ru: Перчатки - кистевое оружие ближнего боя. А жезл нужен для особых умений, например, для лечения себя и товарищей.
dialogsComplete.sp: Los Nudillos son un arma en forma de puño que se usan para el combate cuerpo a cuerpo, y la Vara se usa para realizar ciertas habilidades de Assist, como la curación.
dialogsComplete.sw: A Knuckle is a fist weapon used for close-quarters combat, and the Stick is used to perform certain Assist skills, such as healing.
dialogsComplete.th: Knuckle เป็นอาวุธหมัดที่ใช้สำหรับการต่อสู้ระยะประชิด ส่วน Stick จะใช้เพื่อแสดงทักษะการช่วยเหลือบางอย่าง เช่น การรักษา
dialogsComplete.tw: 拳套可以使神職者進行近距離攻擊，法棒可以使神職者使用補助技能，例如治療。
dialogsComplete.vi: Knuckle là một vũ khí nắm đấm được sử dụng để chiến đấu gần và Stick được sử dụng để thực hiện một số kỹ năng Assist, chẳng hạn như chữa lành.

dialogsComplete.en: It's important to remember that you must have the right weapon equipped to perform certain abilities. With enough practice, a good Assist can switch weapons in combat seamlessly.
dialogsComplete.ar: It's important to remember that you must have the right weapon equipped to perform certain abilities. With enough practice, a good Assist can switch weapons in combat seamlessly.
dialogsComplete.br: A capacidade de mudar rapidamente de punho para bastão o tornará um oponente verdadeiramente perigoso. Você entendeu?
dialogsComplete.cns: 可以帮助其他玩家使用补助技能，也可以在自己使用拳套前，补助自己的功能，这样一来要快速的变换自己的武器，这才是重点。懂了吗?
dialogsComplete.de: Um anderen Berufsgruppen zu helfen oder den Nahkampf effektiv auszuführen, müssen die beiden Waffenarten rasch gewechselt werden können. Das ist das Wesentliche. Versteht du?
dialogsComplete.fi: It's important to remember that you must have the right weapon equipped to perform certain abilities. With enough practice, a good Assist can switch weapons in combat seamlessly.
dialogsComplete.fil: It's important to remember that you must have the right weapon equipped to perform certain abilities. With enough practice, a good Assist can switch weapons in combat seamlessly.
dialogsComplete.fr: Changer d'arme rapidement au cours du combat permet à l'Acolyte d'assister les membres de son groupe tout en participant au combat. Là est le secret.
dialogsComplete.id: Penting untuk diingat bahwa kamu harus memiliki senjata yang tepat untuk melakukan kemampuan tertentu. Dengan latihan yang cukup, Assist yang baik dapat mengganti senjata dalam pertempuran dengan mulus.
dialogsComplete.it: It's important to remember that you must have the right weapon equipped to perform certain abilities. With enough practice, a good Assist can switch weapons in combat seamlessly.
dialogsComplete.jp: 他の仲間に補助をかけたり、近接戦を効率的におこなうためには、この2つの武器を素早く交換しながら戦うことがポイントです。ナックルとスティックの使い方について、理解できましたか？
dialogsComplete.kr: 스킬에 따라 장착해야 하는 무기가 다르다는 걸 기억하세요. 숙련된 어시스트는 전투 중에도 능숙하게 무기를 바꿔 낄 수 있어야 해요.
dialogsComplete.nl: It's important to remember that you must have the right weapon equipped to perform certain abilities. With enough practice, a good Assist can switch weapons in combat seamlessly.
dialogsComplete.pl: It's important to remember that you must have the right weapon equipped to perform certain abilities. With enough practice, a good Assist can switch weapons in combat seamlessly.
dialogsComplete.ru: Для некоторых умений требуется определенное оружие. Опытный униформист умеет молниеносно менять в бою перчатку на жезл и обратно.
dialogsComplete.sp: Es importante recordar que debes tener el arma adecuada equipada para realizar ciertas habilidades. Con suficiente práctica, un buen Assist puede cambiar de arma en combate sin problemas.
dialogsComplete.sw: It's important to remember that you must have the right weapon equipped to perform certain abilities. With enough practice, a good Assist can switch weapons in combat seamlessly.
dialogsComplete.th: สิ่งสำคัญคือต้องจำไว้ว่าคุณต้องมีอาวุธที่เหมาะสมเพื่อใช้แสดงความสามารถบางอย่าง ด้วยการฝึกฝนที่เพียงพอ Assist ที่ดีสามารถเปลี่ยนอาวุธในการต่อสู้ได้อย่างราบรื่น
dialogsComplete.tw: 可以幫助其他玩家使用補助技能，也可以在自己使用拳套前，補助自己的功能，這樣一來要快速的變換自己的武器，這才是重點。懂了嗎？
dialogsComplete.vi: Điều quan trọng cần nhớ là bạn phải trang bị vũ khí phù hợp để thực hiện một số khả năng nhất định. Nếu thực tập đủ, một Assist tốt có thể chuyển đổi vũ khí liên tục trong trận chiến.

dialogsFail.en: I'm sorry, I'm waiting for someone to bring something very important. Is that you? I didn't think so.
dialogsFail.ar: I'm sorry, I'm waiting for someone to bring something very important. Is that you? I didn't think so.
dialogsFail.br: Desculpe, estou esperando que alguém traga algo muito importante. É você? Eu acho que não.
dialogsFail.cns: 我很抱歉，我在等一个能帮我传递非常重要东西的人。你行吗？我可不这么认为。
dialogsFail.de: Tut mir leid, ich warte auf jemanden, der etwas sehr wichtiges mitbringt. Bist du das? Hätte ich auch nicht gedacht.
dialogsFail.fi: I'm sorry, I'm waiting for someone to bring something very important. Is that you? I didn't think so.
dialogsFail.fil: I'm sorry, I'm waiting for someone to bring something very important. Is that you? I didn't think so.
dialogsFail.fr: Oh. Tu dois en premier lieu accomplir ce que t'as demandé Elic. Sinon tu ne pourras pas accéder à l'épreuve suivante.
dialogsFail.id: Maaf, aku sedang menunggu seseorang membawa sesuatu yang sangat penting. Apa itu kamu? Aku tidak berpikir begitu.
dialogsFail.it: I'm sorry, I'm waiting for someone to bring something very important. Is that you? I didn't think so.
dialogsFail.jp: エリック様から指示されたことを終わらせないと、次のテストは受けられませんよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄송하지만, 지금 중요한 걸 가지고 오는 누군가를 기다리고 있어서요. 혹시 당신인가요? 아닌 것 같네요.
dialogsFail.nl: I'm sorry, I'm waiting for someone to bring something very important. Is that you? I didn't think so.
dialogsFail.pl: I'm sorry, I'm waiting for someone to bring something very important. Is that you? I didn't think so.
dialogsFail.ru: I'm sorry, I'm waiting for someone to bring something very important. Is that you? I didn't think so.
dialogsFail.sp: Lo siento, estoy esperando a alguien que me traiga algo muy importante. ¿Eres tú? No lo creo.
dialogsFail.sw: I'm sorry, I'm waiting for someone to bring something very important. Is that you? I didn't think so.
dialogsFail.th: ฉันขอโทษ ฉันกำลังรอใครสักคนนำสิ่งที่สำคัญมากมาให้ ใช่คุณรึเปล่า? ฉันไม่ได้คิดอย่างนั้นนะ
dialogsFail.tw: 對不起，我在等人帶來很重要的東西。那是你嗎？我不這麼認為。
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi xin lỗi, tôi đang đợi ai đó mang đến một thứ rất quan trọng. Có phải bạn không? Tôi không nghĩ vậy.

dialogsBegin.fr: Apportez-le à Sury aussi vite que possible.

dialogsBegin.sp: Esta terminado. Lleva el Fragmento de la Iluminación a Sury tan rápido como puedas.

dialogsBegin.cns: 我已经检查过哈查尔提供的资料了。把这个带给他吧。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich bin fertig mit dem überprüfen der Daten, die Hachal angefordert hat. Bitte bringe sie zu Hachal.
dialogsBegin.fi: I finished checking the data that Hachal provided. Please deliver this to Hachal.
dialogsBegin.fil: I finished checking the data that Hachal provided. Please deliver this to Hachal.
dialogsBegin.fr: Ce que tu as trouvé à la Colline de Shade est vraiment intéressant. J'ai détaillé tout ce que j'avais pu trouver dans ce livre.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku selesai memeriksa data yang diberikan Hachal. Tolong kirimkan ini ke Dia.
dialogsBegin.it: I finished checking the data that Hachal provided. Please deliver this to Hachal.
dialogsBegin.jp: ご協力おつかれさまでした。要請のあった資料の調査が終わりましたので、この調査書をハカル氏に渡してくださいね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 헤이첼이 준 자료 검토를 모두 마쳤어요. 이걸 헤이첼에게 전해 주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I finished checking the data that Hachal provided. Please deliver this to Hachal.
dialogsBegin.pl: I finished checking the data that Hachal provided. Please deliver this to Hachal.
dialogsBegin.ru: Ну вот я и закончила. Отнесешь мои записи Гачалео?
dialogsBegin.sp: He terminado de verificar los datos que proporcionó Hachal. Por favor, entrégale esto a Hachal.
dialogsBegin.sw: I finished checking the data that Hachal provided. Please deliver this to Hachal.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันตรวจสอบข้อมูลที่ฮาชาลให้เสร็จแล้ว โปรดส่งสิ่งนี้ไปที่ Hachal
dialogsBegin.tw: 首先夏格凱巴要我幫他調查的，我已經調查好了。你把這個交給夏格凱巴吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đã kiểm tra xong dữ liệu mà Hachal cung cấp. Vui lòng giao cái này cho Hachal.

dialogsAccept.en: I hope you will continue to be as lucky as you have been.
dialogsAccept.ar: I hope you will continue to be as lucky as you have been.
dialogsAccept.br: Espero que você continue tendo a mesma sorte.
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你一路顺风~
dialogsAccept.de: Ich hoffe, dass du erfolgreich sein wirst, wenn du soweit bist.
dialogsAccept.fi: I hope you will continue to be as lucky as you have been.
dialogsAccept.fil: I hope you will continue to be as lucky as you have been.
dialogsAccept.fr: S'il te plaît, apporte vite le fruit de mes découvertes à Hachal à Darkon 1.
dialogsAccept.id: Aku harap Kamu akan terus beruntung seperti ini seterusnya.
dialogsAccept.it: I hope you will continue to be as lucky as you have been.
dialogsAccept.jp: 勇気ある冒険者の方、ご協力ありがとうございました。あなたのおかげでマドリガルの歴史について非常に有意義な事実が発見されることでしょう。感謝いたします。
dialogsAccept.kr: 지금까지 꽤 운이 좋으셨던 것 같은데, 앞으로도 그 운이 계속되기를 바랄게요.
dialogsAccept.nl: I hope you will continue to be as lucky as you have been.
dialogsAccept.pl: I hope you will continue to be as lucky as you have been.
dialogsAccept.ru: Надеюсь, удача от тебя не отвернется.
dialogsAccept.sp: Espero que sigas teniendo la suerte que has tenido.
dialogsAccept.sw: I hope you will continue to be as lucky as you have been.
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันหวังว่าคุณจะยังคงโชคดีเหมือนที่เคยเป็นมา
dialogsAccept.tw: 祝你一路順風~
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi hy vọng bạn sẽ tiếp tục may mắn như bạn đã từng có nó.

dialogsDecline.en: If not you then who? No one can take this job!
dialogsDecline.ar: If not you then who? No one can take this job!
dialogsDecline.br: Se não for você, então quem? Ninguém pode pegar este serviço!
dialogsDecline.cns: …真的没办法帮我转达给他吗?
dialogsDecline.de: ..Du willst es ihm wirklich nicht bringen? hmm..
dialogsDecline.fi: If not you then who? No one can take this job!
dialogsDecline.fil: If not you then who? No one can take this job!
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu ne veux vraiment pas faire cela pour moi ?
dialogsDecline.id: Kalau bukan kamu lalu siapa? Tak ada lagi yang dapat menyelesaikan pekerjaan ini!
dialogsDecline.it: If not you then who? No one can take this job!
dialogsDecline.jp: ええ？渡してくれないのですか？そんなことおっしゃらずに、お願いします。
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신이 아니면 누가 하겠어요? 아무도 할 수 없는 일이라고요!
dialogsDecline.nl: If not you then who? No one can take this job!
dialogsDecline.pl: If not you then who? No one can take this job!
dialogsDecline.ru: Но кто, если не ты? Кому такое по зубам?
dialogsDecline.sp: Si no lo haces tú, ¿entonces quién? ¡Nadie puede hacer este trabajo!
dialogsDecline.sw: If not you then who? No one can take this job!
dialogsDecline.th: ถ้าไม่ใช่คุณแล้วใคร? งานนี้ไม่มีใครทำได้!
dialogsDecline.tw: …真的沒辦法幫我轉達給他嗎？
dialogsDecline.vi: Nếu không phải bạn thì ai? Không ai có thể nhận công việc này!

dialogsComplete.en: Hmm... History of Hardship. So did he give this to you? Excellent. If he says this will be useful then I am sure it will.
dialogsComplete.ar: Hmm... History of Hardship. So did he give this to you? Excellent. If he says this will be useful then I am sure it will.
dialogsComplete.br: Hmm... História de Dificuldades. Então ele lhe deu isso? Excelente. Se ele diz que isso será útil, tenho certeza que sim.
dialogsComplete.cns: Hmm... History of Hardship. So did he give this to you? Excellent. If he says this will be useful then I am sure it will.
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm.. Geschichte von Hardship. Also hat er es dir gegeben? Gute Arbeit. Dies sollte seiner Meinung nach sehr hilfreich sein.
dialogsComplete.fi: Hmm... History of Hardship. So did he give this to you? Excellent. If he says this will be useful then I am sure it will.
dialogsComplete.fil: Hmm... History of Hardship. So did he give this to you? Excellent. If he says this will be useful then I am sure it will.
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh… Rovanett a vraiment réalisé un travail incroyable en écrivant ce livre !
dialogsComplete.id: Hmm.. History of Hardship. Jadi dia memberikan ini padamu? Bagus sekali. Jika dia mengatakan ini akan berguna maka aku yakin itu akan berguna.
dialogsComplete.it: Hmm... History of Hardship. So did he give this to you? Excellent. If he says this will be useful then I am sure it will.
dialogsComplete.jp: おお、戻ってきたな。ロバネットからの資料、たしかに受け取ったよ。古文書の知識においてはマドリガル一だろうと言われる博識な彼女が作成した調査書だから、興味深い情報が書かれているだろう。さっそく読ませてもらうよ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 흠... 고난의 역사. 이걸 줬단 말인가요? 훌륭한데요. 이게 유용할 거라고 말했다면, 분명 유용하겠죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: Hmm... History of Hardship. So did he give this to you? Excellent. If he says this will be useful then I am sure it will.
dialogsComplete.pl: Hmm... History of Hardship. So did he give this to you? Excellent. If he says this will be useful then I am sure it will.
dialogsComplete.ru: Hmm... History of Hardship. So did he give this to you? Excellent. If he says this will be useful then I am sure it will.
dialogsComplete.sp: Hmm.. Historia de Dificultades. ¿Te lo ha dado ella? Excelente. Si ella dice que esto será útil, seguro que lo será.
dialogsComplete.sw: Hmm... History of Hardship. So did he give this to you? Excellent. If he says this will be useful then I am sure it will.
dialogsComplete.th: อืม... เป็นเรื่องราวแห่งความความยากลำบาก เขาให้สิ่งนี้กับคุณหรือ? ยอดเยี่ยม ถ้าเขาบอกว่าสิ่งนี้จะเป็นประโยชน์ ฉันก็คิดว่างั้น
dialogsComplete.tw: 嗯……《苦難的歷史》嗎？所以真的是他交給你的？很好。如果他說這東西有用，那就一定有價值。
dialogsComplete.vi: Hmm .. History of Hardship. Vậy anh ấy có đưa cái này cho bạn không? Tuyệt lắm. Nếu anh ấy cho rằng nó có ích thì tôi chắc chắn là nó sẽ như thế.

dialogsComplete.en: See you later. Take care.
dialogsComplete.ar: See you later. Take care.
dialogsComplete.br: Até mais tarde. Cuide-se.
dialogsComplete.cns: 过几天再见吧!!
dialogsComplete.de: Ich sehe dich später. Sei vorsichtig.
dialogsComplete.fi: See you later. Take care.
dialogsComplete.fil: See you later. Take care.
dialogsComplete.fr: Nous approchons du but ! Bientôt la véritable histoire de Madrigal sera enfin connue de tous.
dialogsComplete.id: Sampai ketemu lagi. Jaga dirimu.
dialogsComplete.it: See you later. Take care.
dialogsComplete.jp: 君はとても素晴らしい冒険者だ。感謝しているよ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 그럼, 나중에 뵈어요. 몸조심하세요.
dialogsComplete.nl: See you later. Take care.
dialogsComplete.pl: See you later. Take care.
dialogsComplete.ru: Еще увидимся. Береги себя!
dialogsComplete.sp: Nos vemos. Ten cuidado.
dialogsComplete.sw: See you later. Take care.
dialogsComplete.th: แล้วพบกันใหม่ ดูแลตัวเองด้วย
dialogsComplete.tw: 過幾天再見吧！！
dialogsComplete.vi: Hẹn gặp lại. Bảo trọng.

dialogsFail.en: Did Rovanett say anything? That makes no sense. Please visit her again. She must have something to say to you.
dialogsFail.ar: Did Rovanett say anything? That makes no sense. Please visit her again. She must have something to say to you.
dialogsFail.br: Rovanett não disse nada? Isso não faz sentido... Visite-a novamente. Ela deve ter algo a lhe dizer.
dialogsFail.cns: 鲁巴迦丽没给你任何答案吗？不可能啊，请再去找她，她一定有些事要告诉你。
dialogsFail.de: Hat Rovanett etwas gesagt? Das ergibt keinen Sinn. Bitte besuche ihn noch einmal. Er hat Dir bestimmt etwas zu sagen.
dialogsFail.fi: Did Rovanett say anything? That makes no sense. Please visit her again. She must have something to say to you.
dialogsFail.fil: Did Rovanett say anything? That makes no sense. Please visit her again. She must have something to say to you.
dialogsFail.fr: Rovanett ne t'a donc rien dit ? Retourne la voir s'il te plaît, elle est la seule à pouvoir nous aider désormais.
dialogsFail.id: Apakah Rovanett mengatakan sesuatu? Itu tidak masuk akal. Tolong temui dia lagi. Dia pasti memiliki sesuatu untuk dikatakan padamu.
dialogsFail.it: Did Rovanett say anything? That makes no sense. Please visit her again. She must have something to say to you.
dialogsFail.jp: ロバネットは、何も答えなかったのか？そんなはずはない、もう一度会ってみてくれ。きっと彼女から何か話があるだろうから。
dialogsFail.kr: 로바네트가 아무 말 안 하던가요? 말도 안 되잖아요. 한번 찾아가 보세요. 당신에게 할 말이 있을 거예요.
dialogsFail.nl: Did Rovanett say anything? That makes no sense. Please visit her again. She must have something to say to you.
dialogsFail.pl: Did Rovanett say anything? That makes no sense. Please visit her again. She must have something to say to you.
dialogsFail.ru: Did Rovanett say anything? That makes no sense. Please visit her again. She must have something to say to you.
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Rovanett dijo algo? Eso no tiene sentido. Por favor, visítela de nuevo. Ella debe tener algo que decirte.
dialogsFail.sw: Did Rovanett say anything? That makes no sense. Please visit her again. She must have something to say to you.
dialogsFail.th: โรวาเนตต์พูดอะไรหรือเปล่า? นั่นไม่สมเหตุสมผลเลย โปรดมาเยี่ยมเธออีกครั้ง เธอคงมีอะไรจะพูดกับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 魯巴迦麗沒給你任何答案嗎？不可能啊…再去找他問問看啦，他一定有話要對你說。
dialogsFail.vi: Rovanett có nói gì không? Điều đó không có ý nghĩa. Hãy đến thăm cô ấy một lần nữa. Cô ấy phải có điều gì đó muốn nói với bạn.

description.en: Tina asked for help with reducing the Neparuba population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.ar: Tina asked for help with reducing the Neparuba population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.br: Tina pediu ajuda para reduzir a população de Neparubas, pois estão causando problemas de transporte aéreo. Você poderia matar 15 deles?
description.cns: 蒂娜请求减少变异刀尾蚊的数量，因为它们给运输带来了问题。你能杀掉15只变异刀尾蚊吗？
description.de: Tina bat um Hilfe bei der Reduzierung der Neparuba-Population, da sie Transportprobleme verursacht. Könntest du 15 von ihnen töten?
description.fi: Tina asked for help with reducing the Neparuba population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.fil: Hiningi ni Tina ang tulong para bawasan ang populasyon ng Neparuba dahil nagdudulot sila ng problema sa transportasyon. Puwede mo bang patayin ang 15 sa kanila?
description.fr: Tina a demandé de l'aide pour tuer des Neparuba, car ils posent problème aux voyageurs. Peux-tu en tuer 15 ?
description.id: Tina meminta bantuan untuk mengurangi populasi Neparuba karena mereka mulai mengganggu transportasi. Bisakah kamu memusnahkan 15 dari mereka?
description.it: Tina asked for help with reducing the Neparuba population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.jp: ティナから、輸送経路に＜ネパルバ＞が大量発生して問題になっているので、数を減らしてほしいという依頼がありました。15匹ほど討伐してきていただけませんか？
description.kr: 티나가 교통에 문제가 되고 있는 네파루바의 수를 줄여 달라고 부탁했어요. 네파루바 15마리만 잡아주실 수 있나요?
description.nl: Tina asked for help with reducing the Neparuba population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.pl: Tina asked for help with reducing the Neparuba population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.ru: Тина просит помочь с уменьшением численности Комарищ, из-за которых становится сложно выполнять полёты. Можешь убить 15 штук?
description.sp: Tina ha pedido ayuda para reducir la población de Neparubas ya que están causando problemas con el transporte. ¿Podrías derrotar a 15?
description.sw: Tina asked for help with reducing the Neparuba population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.th: Tina ขอความช่วยเหลือในการลดจำนวน Neparuba เนื่องจากพวกมันกำลังก่อให้เกิดปัญหากับการขนส่ง คุณสามารถฆ่าพวกมัน 15 ตัวได้หรือไม่?
description.tw: 蒂娜請求幫助減少尼帕魯巴數量，因為他們正在造成交通問題，你能殺死他們中的 15 個嗎？
description.vi: Tina đã yêu cầu giúp đỡ để giảm số lượng Neparuba vì chúng đang gây ra các vấn đề về giao thông. Bạn có thể giết 15 Neparuba không?

dialogsAccept.cns: 你可以找到变异刀尾蚊在帕里和晨光大陆之间飞行。

dialogsAccept.fi: You can find Neparuba flying between Flaris and Saint morning continents.

dialogsAccept.kr: 네파루바는 플라리스와 세인트 모닝 대륙 사이를 날아다닌답니다.

dialogsAccept.sp: Puedes encontrar a las Neparubas volando entre los continentes de Flaris y Saint Morning.

dialogsBegin.en: Have you ever heard the horrible sound from Mars Mine? That strange and hair-raising sound… It's spooky!
dialogsBegin.ar: Have you ever heard the horrible sound from Mars Mine? That strange and hair-raising sound… It's spooky!
dialogsBegin.br: Você já ouviu o horrível som que vem da Masmorra Mars? Aquele som estranho e arrepiante...
dialogsBegin.cns: 你有听到吗？从魔域密殿出来的怪声…好可怕喔！！
dialogsBegin.de: Hast du jemals diese schrecklichen Geräusche aus Mas Gewölbe gehört? Ein haarsträubendes Geräusch..
dialogsBegin.fi: Have you ever heard the horrible sound from Mars Mine? That strange and hair-raising sound… It's spooky!
dialogsBegin.fil: Have you ever heard the horrible sound from Mars Mine? That strange and hair-raising sound… It's spooky!
dialogsBegin.fr: As-tu déjà entendu le son horrible provenant de la Mine de Mas ? Ce son étrange et effrayant.
dialogsBegin.id: Pernahkah kamu mendengar suara mengerikan dari Tambang Mars? Suara aneh dan menggelitik itu… Seram!
dialogsBegin.it: Have you ever heard the horrible sound from Mars Mine? That strange and hair-raising sound… It's spooky!
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたにも聞こえましたか？フラリスダンジョンの奥底から響いてくる、あの恐ろしい音のことですよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 마스 마인에서 이상한, 등골이 오싹해지는 소리를 들어본 적 있나요? 정말이지... 머리가 삐죽 선다고요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Have you ever heard the horrible sound from Mars Mine? That strange and hair-raising sound… It's spooky!
dialogsBegin.pl: Have you ever heard the horrible sound from Mars Mine? That strange and hair-raising sound… It's spooky!
dialogsBegin.ru: А приходилось ли тебе слышать леденящий душу звук, доносящийся из Марсовой шахты? От него поджилки трясутся!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Alguna vez has escuchado el horrible sonido de la Mina Mars? Ese sonido extraño y espeluznante... ¡Da miedo!
dialogsBegin.sw: Have you ever heard the horrible sound from Mars Mine? That strange and hair-raising sound… It's spooky!
dialogsBegin.th: คุณเคยได้ยินเสียงน่ากลัวๆ จาก Mars Mine มั้ย? เสียงแปลกๆ และน่าขนลุก... หลอนมาก!
dialogsBegin.tw: 你有聽到嗎？從瑪斯礦坑出來的怪聲…好可怕喔！！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn đã bao giờ nghe thấy âm thanh khủng khiếp từ Mars Mine chưa? Âm thanh kỳ lạ và dựng tóc gáy đó… Thật là ma quái!

dialogsBegin.en: Maybe you haven't, but you will. Muahahaha! I heard it clearly! I hope it's not the sound I think it is...
dialogsBegin.ar: Maybe you haven't, but you will. Muahahaha! I heard it clearly! I hope it's not the sound I think it is...
dialogsBegin.br: Talvez você não tenha ouvido,  mas eu o ouvi claramente!! Espero que não seja o som que penso que é...
dialogsBegin.cns: Maybe you haven't, but you will. Muahahaha! I heard it clearly! I hope it's not the sound I think it is...
dialogsBegin.de: Vielleicht hast du noch nicht, aber ich habe es deutlich gehört!! Ich hoffe es ist nicht das was ich denke...
dialogsBegin.fi: Maybe you haven't, but you will. Muahahaha! I heard it clearly! I hope it's not the sound I think it is...
dialogsBegin.fil: Maybe you haven't, but you will. Muahahaha! I heard it clearly! I hope it's not the sound I think it is...
dialogsBegin.fr: Sans doute que non. Mais moi je l'ai entendu bien distinctement !! J'espère que ce n'est pas le bruit auquel je pense.
dialogsBegin.id: Mungkin kamu belum melakukannya, tetapi kamu akan melakukannya. Muahahaha! Aku mendengarnya dengan jelas!!! Saya harap itu bukan suara yang saya kira ...
dialogsBegin.it: Maybe you haven't, but you will. Muahahaha! I heard it clearly! I hope it's not the sound I think it is...
dialogsBegin.jp: 聞こえませんか…。私にはハッキリと聞こえます。私の気のせいならいいんですけど…。ただ、私の想像がもし現実になってしまったら……。
dialogsBegin.kr: 못 들었을 수도 있지만, 곧 듣게 되실 걸요! 음하하하! 전 똑똑히 들었어요! 제가 생각하는 소리가 아니길 바라지만…
dialogsBegin.nl: Maybe you haven't, but you will. Muahahaha! I heard it clearly! I hope it's not the sound I think it is...
dialogsBegin.pl: Maybe you haven't, but you will. Muahahaha! I heard it clearly! I hope it's not the sound I think it is...
dialogsBegin.ru: Maybe you haven't, but you will. Muahahaha! I heard it clearly! I hope it's not the sound I think it is...
dialogsBegin.sp: Puede que aún no, pero lo harás. ¡Muajajaja! ¡¡¡Lo he escuchado claramente!!! Espero que no sea el sonido que creo que es...
dialogsBegin.sw: Maybe you haven't, but you will. Muahahaha! I heard it clearly! I hope it's not the sound I think it is...
dialogsBegin.th: คุณอาจไม่เคยได้ยิน แต่คุณจะได้ยินแน่ วะฮ่าฮ่า! ฉันได้ยินชัดเลย!!! หวังว่ามันคงไม่ใช่เสียงของสิ่งที่ฉันคิดนะ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 也許你現在還沒聽見，但你很快就會了。哇哈哈哈！我聽得很清楚！希望那不是我想的那種聲音……
dialogsBegin.vi: Có thể bây giờ bạn chưa, nhưng rồi bạn sẽ làm được. Muahahaha! Tôi nghe rõ rồi! Tôi hy vọng đó không phải là âm thanh mà tôi nghĩ ...

dialogsBegin.en: (After a long hesitation...) Listen, if it is the sound I think it is, we have a big problem. Well, more like a disaster.
dialogsBegin.ar: (After a long hesitation...) Listen, if it is the sound I think it is, we have a big problem. Well, more like a disaster.
dialogsBegin.br: (Depois de grande hesitação) Ah... se for o som que penso que é, nós estamos encrencados. Ou pior, estamos perdidos.
dialogsBegin.cns: (犹豫一下！！)如果…！我越想越觉得可怕……
dialogsBegin.de: (Nach langem zögern) Uh.. wenn das Geräusch das ist was ich denke, dann haben wir ein großes Problem. Wohl eher eine Katastrophe.
dialogsBegin.fi: (After a long hesitation...) Listen, if it is the sound I think it is, we have a big problem. Well, more like a disaster.
dialogsBegin.fil: (After a long hesitation...) Listen, if it is the sound I think it is, we have a big problem. Well, more like a disaster.
dialogsBegin.fr: (Après une longue hésitation) Oui...si c'est à quoi je pense, nous avons vraiment un gros problème. Ce serait un désastre même !
dialogsBegin.id: (Setelah ragu-ragu lama...) Dengar, jika itu suara yang saya pikir itu, kita punya masalah besar. Yah, lebih seperti bencana.
dialogsBegin.it: (After a long hesitation...) Listen, if it is the sound I think it is, we have a big problem. Well, more like a disaster.
dialogsBegin.jp: 脅威？そんな甘いものじゃありません。絶望…。絶望が世界を覆うでしょう……。音の正体をつきとめたいんですが、洞窟内は危険の巣窟です。
dialogsBegin.kr: (한참을 망설이다가)저기... 그게 제가 생각한 소리라면 큰일이에요. 아니, 재앙에 가까워요.
dialogsBegin.nl: (After a long hesitation...) Listen, if it is the sound I think it is, we have a big problem. Well, more like a disaster.
dialogsBegin.pl: (After a long hesitation...) Listen, if it is the sound I think it is, we have a big problem. Well, more like a disaster.
dialogsBegin.ru: ...Послушай, если это тот звук, о котором я думаю, у нас большие неприятности. Я бы даже сказал, огромные.
dialogsBegin.sp: (Después de dudar mucho...) Escucha, si es el sonido que creo que es, tenemos un gran problema. Bueno, más bien un desastre.
dialogsBegin.sw: (After a long hesitation...) Listen, if it is the sound I think it is, we have a big problem. Well, more like a disaster.
dialogsBegin.th: (หลังลังเลอยู่นาน...) ฟังนะ ถ้าเป็นเสียงที่ฉันคิด เราก็มีปัญหาใหญ่แล้วล่ะ งานช้างเลย
dialogsBegin.tw: (長時間猶豫後……) 聽著，如果那真是我想到的聲音，我們就有大麻煩了。不，應該說是一場災難。
dialogsBegin.vi: (Sau một hồi lưỡng lự ...) Nghe này, nếu đó là âm thanh mà tôi nghĩ, chúng ta đang gặp rắc rối. Chà, trông như một thảm họa hơn.

dialogsBegin.ar: (Holds your hands suddenly… creepy, right?) So, please, will you do me a favor?
dialogsBegin.br: (De repente segura a sua mão) Então, você me faria um favor?
dialogsBegin.cns: (紧握着手)我要托你一件事情！
dialogsBegin.de: (Ergreift plötzlich deine Hand) Also würdest du mir bitte einen Gefallen tun?
dialogsBegin.fi: (Holds your hands suddenly… creepy, right?) So, please, will you do me a favor?
dialogsBegin.fil: (Holds your hands suddenly… creepy, right?) So, please, will you do me a favor?
dialogsBegin.fr: (Prenant soudainement tes mains) Voudrais-tu, s'il te plaît, m'accorder une faveur ?
dialogsBegin.id: (Menggenggam tanganmu tiba-tiba… menyeramkan, kan?) Jadi, tolong, maukah kamu membantuku?
dialogsBegin.it: (Holds your hands suddenly… creepy, right?) So, please, will you do me a favor?
dialogsBegin.jp: 力のある冒険者に調査を依頼したいところですが、誰に依頼すればいいんだろう？…ん？あなたがいたじゃないですか！私のお願いを聞いてくれませんか？
dialogsBegin.kr: (갑자기 두 손을 덥석 잡으며) 그래서 말인데요. 제 부탁 하나만 들어주시겠어요?
dialogsBegin.nl: (Holds your hands suddenly… creepy, right?) So, please, will you do me a favor?
dialogsBegin.pl: (Holds your hands suddenly… creepy, right?) So, please, will you do me a favor?
dialogsBegin.ru: (Доктор Если неожиданно хватает вас за руки. Вы отшатываетесь.) Ты окажешь мне услугу, правда?
dialogsBegin.sp: (Toma tus manos de repente...) Espeluznante, ¿verdad? Por favor, ¿me harías un favor?
dialogsBegin.sw: (Holds your hands suddenly… creepy, right?) So, please, will you do me a favor?
dialogsBegin.th: (จู่ๆ ก็จับมือคุณกระทันหัน... น่ากลัวใช่มั้ยล่ะ) เพราะงั้นช่วยฉันด้วยนะ
dialogsBegin.tw: (緊握著手) 我要託你一件事情！
dialogsBegin.vi: (Đột ngột nắm lấy tay bạn… giật mình, phải không?) Vì vậy, làm ơn, bạn sẽ giúp tôi một việc được không?

dialogsComplete.cns: 事情应该没我所想像的那么糟糕！我们还可以努力看看！
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm.. Leider ist es genau das was ich dachte.. Mist, ich brauche immernoch etwas.
dialogsComplete.fi: Unfortunately it's exactly what I thought... Darn, I am still missing something.
dialogsComplete.fil: Unfortunately it's exactly what I thought... Darn, I am still missing something.
dialogsComplete.fr: Hmm... Malheureusement, c'est exactement ce à quoi je pensais... Mince, il me manque toujours quelque chose.

dialogsComplete.jp: ふむふむ。…なるほど。どうやら私の想像が現実になりつつあるようですね。恐ろしい事ですが…。でも、まだ情報が足りませんね。

dialogsComplete.sp: Por desgracia, es exactamente lo que pensaba... Rayos, todavía se me escapa algo.

dialogsComplete.th: น่าเสียดายที่มันเป็นอย่างที่ฉันคิดไว้... แย่จัง ฉันยังขาดอะไรบางอย่างไป

dialogsComplete.vi: Không may, đó chính xác là những gì tôi nghĩ ... Chết tiệt, tôi vẫn còn thiếu một cái gì đó.

dialogsBegin.en: So you want to be an Acrobat, huh? You won't regret it! I have a simple test for you before starting the training. Are you ready? …hic!
dialogsBegin.ar: So you want to be an Acrobat, huh? You won't regret it! I have a simple test for you before starting the training. Are you ready? …hic!
dialogsBegin.br: Então você quer ser um Acrobata, hein? Espero que você nunca se arrependa disso. Há um teste simples antes de iniciar o treinamento. Você está pronto(a)? …hic!
dialogsBegin.cns: 所以你想成为一名弓箭手喔？我发誓你绝对不会后悔的！在开始训练之前我有一个小测验给你，你准备好了吗？…嗝
dialogsBegin.de: Du möchtest also ein Acrobat werden, hm? Du wirst es nicht bereuen! Es gibt einen einfachen Test, bevor wir das Training beginnen. Bist du bereit?
dialogsBegin.fi: So you want to be an Acrobat, huh? You won't regret it! I have a simple test for you before starting the training. Are you ready? …hic!
dialogsBegin.fil: So you want to be an Acrobat, huh? You won't regret it! I have a simple test for you before starting the training. Are you ready? …hic!
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu as donc choisi de devenir Acrobate, tu ne devrais pas le regretter. Cependant tu dois mériter cette classe, et je vais donc te faire passer quelques tests... Hic !
dialogsBegin.id: Jadi kamu ingin menjadi Acrobat, ya? Kamu tidak akan menyesalinya! Aku memiliki tes sederhana untuk kamu sebelum memulai pelatihan. Apakah kamu siap? … hic!
dialogsBegin.it: So you want to be an Acrobat, huh? You won't regret it! I have a simple test for you before starting the training. Are you ready? …hic!
dialogsBegin.jp: 諸君はアクロバットへの道を選んだ。後悔なんぞしていないだろうな？　まず訓練の前に簡単なテストを行うよ。心の準備は出来ているか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 아크로뱃이 되고 싶으시다고요? 후회하지 않으실 거예요! 훈련을 시작하기 전에 간단한 시험을 치르려고 하는데요, 준비되셨나요? …히익!
dialogsBegin.nl: So you want to be an Acrobat, huh? You won't regret it! I have a simple test for you before starting the training. Are you ready? …hic!
dialogsBegin.pl: So you want to be an Acrobat, huh? You won't regret it! I have a simple test for you before starting the training. Are you ready? …hic!
dialogsBegin.ru: Тебе, значит, нравятся акробаты, и ты хочешь к ним присоединиться? Поверь, не пожалеешь! Вот только для начала у меня для тебя есть маленькая проверочка... ик!..
dialogsBegin.sp: Así que quieres ser un Acrobat, ¿eh? ¡No te arrepentirás! Tengo una prueba simple para ti antes de comenzar el entrenamiento. ¿Estás listo?… ¡hic!
dialogsBegin.sw: So you want to be an Acrobat, huh? You won't regret it! I have a simple test for you before starting the training. Are you ready? …hic!
dialogsBegin.th: อา... คุณต้องการที่จะเป็น Acrobat หรือ? คุณจะไม่เสียใจ! ฉันมีการทดสอบแบบง่ายๆ สำหรับคุณก่อนเริ่มการฝึก คุณพร้อมไหม? ...ฮิค!
dialogsBegin.tw: 你現在選擇的雜技師的路，希望你不要有所後悔，首先我要進行一些測試，你準備好了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn muốn trở thành một Acrobat, huh? Bạn sẽ không hối tiếc! Tôi có một bài kiểm tra đơn giản cho bạn trước khi bắt đầu khóa đào tạo. Bạn đã sẵn sàng chưa? … Hic!

dialogsDecline.en: What are you afraid of? The path to become an Acrobat may be difficult for some, but it's so worth it! Come back if you change your mind, friend.
dialogsDecline.ar: What are you afraid of? The path to become an Acrobat may be difficult for some, but it's so worth it! Come back if you change your mind, friend.
dialogsDecline.br: Do que você tem medo? O caminho para se tornar um Acrobata pode ser difícil para alguns, mas vale a pena! Volte se mudar de ideia, amigo(a).
dialogsDecline.cns: 你在害怕什么？在成为一名弓箭手的道路上的确有一些东西很困难，但是它值得呀！朋友如果你回心转意了请回来找我。
dialogsDecline.de: Wovor hast du Angst? Der Weg zum Acrobat mag für manche schwierig sein, aber er ist es wert! Komm zurück, wenn du deine Meinung änderst, mein Freund.
dialogsDecline.fi: What are you afraid of? The path to become an Acrobat may be difficult for some, but it's so worth it! Come back if you change your mind, friend.
dialogsDecline.fil: What are you afraid of? The path to become an Acrobat may be difficult for some, but it's so worth it! Come back if you change your mind, friend.
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu ne souhaites pas devenir Acrobate? Dommage, mais tu es le seul responsable de ton avenir. Reviens si tu changes d'avis !
dialogsDecline.id: Apa yang kamu takutkan? Jalan untuk menjadi Acrobat mungkin sulit bagi sebagian orang, tetapi itu sangat berharga! Kembalilah jika kamu berubah pikiran, teman.
dialogsDecline.it: What are you afraid of? The path to become an Acrobat may be difficult for some, but it's so worth it! Come back if you change your mind, friend.
dialogsDecline.jp: アクロバットにならないだと？　まあいい。どんな職業を選ぼうとも、自分の世界は自分で切り開くものだということを忘れないように。以上だ、さらば！
dialogsDecline.kr: 뭘 그렇게 망설이세요? 아크로뱃이 되는 길은 어려울 수도 있지만, 그만한 가치가 있답니다. 마음이 바뀌면 언제든지 다시 찾아오세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: What are you afraid of? The path to become an Acrobat may be difficult for some, but it's so worth it! Come back if you change your mind, friend.
dialogsDecline.pl: What are you afraid of? The path to become an Acrobat may be difficult for some, but it's so worth it! Come back if you change your mind, friend.
dialogsDecline.ru: Ты что, боишься?! Может, акробатом быть не так уж легко, но оно того стоит! Если передумаешь - возвращайся.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿De qué tienes miedo? El camino para convertirse en Acrobat puede ser difícil para algunos, ¡pero vale la pena! Vuelve si cambias de opinión, amigo.
dialogsDecline.sw: What are you afraid of? The path to become an Acrobat may be difficult for some, but it's so worth it! Come back if you change your mind, friend.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณจะกลัวอะไรล่ะ? เส้นทางที่จะกลายเป็น Acrobat อาจเป็นเรื่องยากสำหรับบางคน แต่มันก็คุ้มค่า! กลับมาถ้าคุณเปลี่ยนใจนะ เพื่อน
dialogsDecline.tw: 你說不要走雜技師的路嗎？好吧！反正請你仔細的考慮你要走的路吧！
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn sợ cái gì? Con đường trở thành một Acrobat có thể khó đối với một số người, nhưng nó rất xứng đáng! Hãy quay lại nếu bạn thay đổi ý định của mình, bạn ạ.

description.en: Travel to the Plain of Bubble, defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and retrieve both the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ for Novelist Gergantes in Northern Flarine.
description.ar: Travel to the Plain of Bubble, defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and retrieve both the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ for Novelist Gergantes in Northern Flarine.
description.br: Viaje para a Planície de Bubble, derrote $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ e recupere o $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ e o $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ para o Novelista Gergantes que está na Zona Norte de Flarine.
description.cns: 首先去波布尔平原击败$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$，获得$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$和$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ ，然后再回来找我
description.de: Reist zur Ebene von Bubble, besiegt $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ und holt euch sowohl das $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ als auch das $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ für den Novellisten Gergantes in Nordflarine.
description.fi: Travel to the Plain of Bubble, defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and retrieve both the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ for Novelist Gergantes in Northern Flarine.
description.fil: Travel to the Plain of Bubble, defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and retrieve both the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ for Novelist Gergantes in Northern Flarine.
description.fr: Allez sur la Plaine de Shade, tuez des $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, et récupérez le $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ et le $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ pour l'écrivain Gergantes à Flarine Nord.
description.id: Perjalanan ke Plain of Bubble, kalahkan $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, dan ambil $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ dan $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ untuk Novelist Gergantes di Northern Flarine.
description.it: Travel to the Plain of Bubble, defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and retrieve both the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ for Novelist Gergantes in Northern Flarine.
description.jp: ＜バブルの平原＞に生息する＜$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$＞というモンスターを倒し、＜$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$＞と、＜$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$＞を持ってこよう。手に入れたらフラリス北広場のゲルガンデスに渡しにいこう。
description.kr: 버블 평원으로 가서 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$를 처치하고, $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ 두 가지를 회수해 플라리네 북부에 사는 소설가 게르간테스에게 가져가세요.
description.nl: Travel to the Plain of Bubble, defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and retrieve both the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ for Novelist Gergantes in Northern Flarine.
description.pl: Travel to the Plain of Bubble, defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and retrieve both the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ for Novelist Gergantes in Northern Flarine.
description.ru: Travel to the Plain of Bubble, defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and retrieve both the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ for Novelist Gergantes in Northern Flarine.
description.sp: Viaja a la Llanura de Bubble, derrota a $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ y recupera tanto el $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ como el $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ para el Novelista Gergantes en Flarine Norte.
description.sw: Travel to the Plain of Bubble, defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and retrieve both the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ for Novelist Gergantes in Northern Flarine.
description.th: เดินทางไป Plain of Bubble เอาชนะ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ และนำทั้ง $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ และ $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ ให้กับนักเขียนนวนิยาย Gergantes ใน Northern Flarine
description.tw: 前往巴布樂平原，擊敗 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$，並幫布拉里斯廣場的小說家凱樂刊特斯取回 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ 和 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$。
description.vi: Đi đến Plain of Bubble, đánh bại $ QUEST_END_KILL_NAME $ và lấy cả $ QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME $ và $ QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME, 2 $ cho Tiểu thuyết gia Gergantes (Novelist Gergantes) ở Northern Flarine.

dialogsBegin.en: Pssst, hey you! I am writing a book and I need your help! I've had a little writers block lately and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
dialogsBegin.ar: Pssst, hey you! I am writing a book and I need your help! I've had a little writers block lately and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
dialogsBegin.br: Ei parceiro(a)! Estou escrevendo mais um livro e preciso da sua ajuda novamente! Preciso de você para desvendar mais uma lenda, assim vou conseguir terminar mais um sucesso.
dialogsBegin.cns: 听好我说的话喔~其实啊..我最近在写一本书，写书的时候需要一些材料，但是我自己没办法搞定。
dialogsBegin.de: Hör mir genau zu. Genau genommen schreibe ich grade ein Buch, weil es eine gute Geschichte hat. Aber ich kann es alleine nicht beenden.
dialogsBegin.fi: Pssst, hey you! I am writing a book and I need your help! I've had a little writers block lately and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
dialogsBegin.fil: Pssst, hey you! I am writing a book and I need your help! I've had a little writers block lately and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
dialogsBegin.fr: Ecoute-moi bien. En ce moment, j'écris un livre, parce que j'ai trouvé une très bonne histoire. Mais je ne peux la finir par moi-même.
dialogsBegin.id: Pssst, hai kamu! Saya sedang menulis buku dan saya butuh bantuanmu! Akhir-akhir ini saya mengalami sedikit hambatan penulis dan saya membutuhkan seorang petualang pemberani untuk membantu saya menulisnya!
dialogsBegin.it: Pssst, hey you! I am writing a book and I need your help! I've had a little writers block lately and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
dialogsBegin.jp:
私は小説を書こうとしてるんだが、一人ではどうにもできないのだよ・・・。
とてもよい題材があるのに残念だ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 저기, 이봐요! 저는 책을 쓰고 있는데, 도움이 필요해요! 요즘 도통 영감이 떠오르지 않아서요… 용감한 모험가님이 도와주시면 정말 좋겠어요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Pssst, hey you! I am writing a book and I need your help! I've had a little writers block lately and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
dialogsBegin.pl: Pssst, hey you! I am writing a book and I need your help! I've had a little writers block lately and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
dialogsBegin.ru: Привет! Я пишу очередной бестселлер, но концовка никак не дается. Мне нужна помощь храброго героя!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Pssst, eh tú! ¡Estoy escribiendo un libro y necesito tu ayuda! ¡Tengo un pequeño bloqueo de escritor y necesito la ayuda de un valiente aventurero!
dialogsBegin.sw: Pssst, hey you! I am writing a book and I need your help! I've had a little writers block lately and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
dialogsBegin.th: ชู่วว นี่คุณ! ฉันกำลังจะเขียนหนังสือสักเล่ม และฉันต้องการความช่วยเหลือจากคุณ ฉันเริ่มจะตันซะแล้วล่ะ ฉันจึงต้องการนักผจญภัยที่กล้าหาญเพื่อช่วยฉันเขียนหนังสือเล่มนี้!
dialogsBegin.tw: 聽好我說的話喔~其實啊…我最近在寫一本書，寫書的時候需要一些材料，但是我自己沒辦法搞定。
dialogsBegin.vi: Pssst, này anh bạn! Tôi đang viết một cuốn sách và tôi cần sự giúp đỡ của bạn! Gần đây, tôi bị mất ý tưởng để sáng tác và tôi cần một nhà thám hiểm dũng cảm giúp tôi viết ra những ý tưởng đó!

dialogsBegin.en: Have you ever heard of the legend of Moot Arvan? No? A long time ago, there was very a famous adventurer, Moot Arvan. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure...
dialogsBegin.ar: Have you ever heard of the legend of Moot Arvan? No? A long time ago, there was very a famous adventurer, Moot Arvan. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure...
dialogsBegin.br: Vamos lá, agora é a respeito da Lenda de Moot Arvan. Há um tempo havia esse aventureiro, Moot Arvan, ele adorava encontrar coisas raras de civilizações antigas. Certo dia, ele foi se aventurar no meio de um pântano...
dialogsBegin.cns: 你有听说过特莱特怪物的传说吗？没有吗？很久以前，有位名叫穆特阿尔温的大冒险家，某天他发现了一个神秘的冒险地...
dialogsBegin.de: Hast du jemals von der Legende von Moot Arvan gehört? Nein? Vor langer Zeit gab es einen sehr berühmten Abenteurer, Moot Arvan. Eines Tages fand er einen interessanten Ort für ein Abenteuer...
dialogsBegin.fi: Have you ever heard of the legend of Moot Arvan? No? A long time ago, there was very a famous adventurer, Moot Arvan. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure...
dialogsBegin.fil: Have you ever heard of the legend of Moot Arvan? No? A long time ago, there was very a famous adventurer, Moot Arvan. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure...
dialogsBegin.fr: As-tu déjà entendu parler de la Légende du Dreadpet ? Apparemment non. Il y a fort longtemps, existait un célèbre aventurier, il s'appelait Moot Arvan.
dialogsBegin.id: Pernahkah kamu mendengar tentang legenda Moot Arvan? Tidak? Dahulu kala, ada seorang petualang yang sangat terkenal, Moot Arvan. Suatu hari, dia menemukan tempat yang menarik untuk berpetualang...
dialogsBegin.it: Have you ever heard of the legend of Moot Arvan? No? A long time ago, there was very a famous adventurer, Moot Arvan. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure...
dialogsBegin.jp:
君は、シヴァーモンスターの話しを聞いたことがあるか？　ふーむ・・。知らないようだな。
昔、＜ムト・アールバン＞という、とても有名な冒険者がいたのだよ。ある日、彼は得体の知れない何者かに遭遇したというんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 혹시 무트 아르반의 전설을 들어본 적 있으세요? 모르신다고요? 옛날에, 아주 유명한 모험가 무트 아르반이라는 사람이 있었어요. 어느 날, 무트는 아주 흥미로운 곳을 발견했죠...
dialogsBegin.nl: Have you ever heard of the legend of Moot Arvan? No? A long time ago, there was very a famous adventurer, Moot Arvan. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure...
dialogsBegin.pl: Have you ever heard of the legend of Moot Arvan? No? A long time ago, there was very a famous adventurer, Moot Arvan. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure...
dialogsBegin.ru: Have you ever heard of the legend of Moot Arvan? No? A long time ago, there was very a famous adventurer, Moot Arvan. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure...
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Has oído alguna vez sobre la Leyenda de Moot Arvan? ¿No? Hace mucho mucho tiempo, había un aventurero muy famoso llamado Moot Arvan. Un día, encontró un interesante lugar al que aventurarse...
dialogsBegin.sw: Have you ever heard of the legend of Moot Arvan? No? A long time ago, there was very a famous adventurer, Moot Arvan. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure...
dialogsBegin.th: คุณเคยได้ยินเกี่ยวกับตำนานของ Moot Arvan หรือไม่? นานมาแล้วมีนักผจญภัยที่มีชื่อเสียงมาก ชื่อของเขาคือ Moot Arvan อยู่มาวันหนึ่งเขาได้พบกับสถานที่ที่น่าสนใจในการผจญภัย...
dialogsBegin.tw: 你有聽說過特萊特怪物的傳說嗎？以前有一個大冒險家啦~名子叫姆特牙勒斑，有一天，他發現了一個很有趣的事情。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn đã bao giờ nghe về truyền thuyết của Moot Arvan chưa? Chưa à? Cách đây rất lâu, có một nhà thám hiểm rất nổi tiếng, Moot Arvan. Một ngày nọ, anh tìm thấy một nơi thú vị để phiêu lưu tới...

dialogsBegin.en: It was a strange, wet marsh. Moot explored the marsh only to become infested with a disease called Unpleasant Fear.
dialogsBegin.ar: It was a strange, wet marsh. Moot explored the marsh only to become infested with a disease called Unpleasant Fear.
dialogsBegin.br: Era um pântano estranho e úmido. Moot foi explorar pântano, pois ele havia escutado que lá poderia encontrar evidências de uma tribo milenar. Após vários dias no local, ele não percebeu que contraiu uma doença misteriosa.
dialogsBegin.cns: 听说有一个很潮湿的地区，住着一个叫做恐怖的菇菇的怪兽。
dialogsBegin.de: Es war ein feuchter Sumpf. Da war er, Mushmoot, welcher auch "Unangenehme Furcht" genannt wurde.
dialogsBegin.fi: It was a strange, wet marsh. Moot explored the marsh only to become infested with a disease called Unpleasant Fear.
dialogsBegin.fil: It was a strange, wet marsh. Moot explored the marsh only to become infested with a disease called Unpleasant Fear.
dialogsBegin.fr: Toujours en quête d'aventure, Arvan découvrit un jour un marais putride... Là se trouvait un monstre effroyable, nommé Mushmoot.
dialogsBegin.id: Itu adalah rawa basah yang aneh. Moot menjelajahi rawa hanya untuk terserang penyakit yang disebut Unpleasant Fear.
dialogsBegin.it: It was a strange, wet marsh. Moot explored the marsh only to become infested with a disease called Unpleasant Fear.
dialogsBegin.jp: そこは、とてつもない湿りを帯び、ひとたびも陽の光射すことのないおどろおどろしい湿地帯だったそうだ。ここで遭遇したのが、マージュムートだ。陰鬱の恐怖と呼ぶものもいるがね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이상하고 축축한 늪이었어요. 무트는 그곳을 탐험하다가 '불쾌한 공포’라는 병에 걸렸죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: It was a strange, wet marsh. Moot explored the marsh only to become infested with a disease called Unpleasant Fear.
dialogsBegin.pl: It was a strange, wet marsh. Moot explored the marsh only to become infested with a disease called Unpleasant Fear.
dialogsBegin.ru: Не зря из этого болота никто не возвращался. Джулиан заразился странной болезнью, которую называют Парализующим Страхом.
dialogsBegin.sp: Era un pantano extraño y húmedo. Moot exploró el pantano sólo y se infectó con una enfermedad llamada Miedo Paralizante.
dialogsBegin.sw: It was a strange, wet marsh. Moot explored the marsh only to become infested with a disease called Unpleasant Fear.
dialogsBegin.th: มันเป็นบึงที่แปลกและเฉอะแฉะ Moot ตรวจสอบบึงเพียงเพื่อที่จะพบว่าตนเองติดเชื้อโรคภายในบึงที่มีชื่อเรียกว่า Unpleasant Fear
dialogsBegin.tw: 聽說有一個很潮濕的地區，住著一個叫做恐怖的菇菇的怪獸。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đó là một đầm lầy ẩm ướt kỳ lạ. Moot khám phá đầm lầy chỉ để bị lây nhiễm một căn bệnh có tên là Unpleasant Fear.

dialogsBegin.en: The disease transformed him into a hideous monster known as Mushmoot! There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so they say…
dialogsBegin.ar: The disease transformed him into a hideous monster known as Mushmoot! There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so they say…
dialogsBegin.br: Esta doença o consumia a cada dia até transformá-lo em um grande monstro conhecido como Mushmoot, o Horripilador! Eventualmente, ele perdeu sua consciência e nada mais restou de Moot Arvan.
dialogsBegin.cns: 可是后来恐怖的菇菇不知道到哪里去了，突然消失~反正啦..这是我这次小说的主要内容。
dialogsBegin.de: Moot verschwand nachdem er der "unangenehmen Furcht" begegnet war, soviel ich weiß. Tolle Geschichte, hm? Dreadpet, Unangenehme Furcht. Cooool!!
dialogsBegin.fi: The disease transformed him into a hideous monster known as Mushmoot! There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so they say…
dialogsBegin.fil: The disease transformed him into a hideous monster known as Mushmoot! There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so they say…
dialogsBegin.fr: On raconte que Moot Arvan disparu après avoir rencontré Mushmoot... C'est une histoire intrigante, n'est-ce pas ?
dialogsBegin.id: Penyakit itu mengubahnya menjadi monster mengerikan yang dikenal sebagai Mushmoot! Hampir tidak ada yang tersisa dari petualang pemberani itu kecuali potongan-potongan, atau begitulah kata mereka…
dialogsBegin.it: The disease transformed him into a hideous monster known as Mushmoot! There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so they say…
dialogsBegin.jp:
ムトは、このマージュムートに遭遇した後、消息を絶ったとして伝えられている・・・。
とまぁ、これが今回の題材なんだ。陰鬱の恐怖！伝説のシヴァーモンスター！！
どうかね？
dialogsBegin.kr: 그 병에 걸린 뒤, 그는 '머쉬무트'라는 끔찍한 괴물로 변해버렸어요. 예전의 용감하던 모습은 사라지고, 조각조각 흩어진 흔적만 남았다고들 하죠…
dialogsBegin.nl: The disease transformed him into a hideous monster known as Mushmoot! There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so they say…
dialogsBegin.pl: The disease transformed him into a hideous monster known as Mushmoot! There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so they say…
dialogsBegin.ru: Эта болезнь превратила его в ужасного монстра, похожего на гигантский гриб. Так Джулиан стал Жюльеном. Вот и вся легенда.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡La enfermedad lo transformó en un horrible monstruo conocido como Mushmoot! Prácticamente no queda nada de aquel valiente aventurero, quizá algunos fragmentos, o eso dicen...
dialogsBegin.sw: The disease transformed him into a hideous monster known as Mushmoot! There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so they say…
dialogsBegin.th: โรคนี้ทำให้เขากลายเป็นสัตว์ประหลาดที่น่าเกลียดน่ากลัว หลังจากนั้นเขาก็ถูกเรียกว่า Mushmoot! ไม่มีคราบของนักผจญภัยผู้กล้าหาญอีกต่อไป และนี่ก็คือเรื่องราวทั้งหมดที่เกิดขึ้น...
dialogsBegin.tw: 可是後來恐怖的菇菇不知道到哪裡去了，突然消失~反正啦…這是我這次小說的主要內容。
dialogsBegin.vi: Căn bệnh đã biến anh ta thành một con quái vật gớm ghiếc được gọi là Mushmoot! Hầu như không còn gì về nhà thám hiểm dũng cảm đó ngoài những thứ linh tinh người ta kể lại...

dialogsBegin.en: So, here's where you come in. I need an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Mushmoot. Feel like helping?
dialogsBegin.ar: So, here's where you come in. I need an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Mushmoot. Feel like helping?
dialogsBegin.br: Nesse ponto você já deve saber o que desejo. Eu preciso de um desfecho para a história e gostaria de saber o que aconteceu com Mushmoot. Poderia me ajudar?
dialogsBegin.cns: 所以啊..你可不可以代替我亲自去体验看看啊?然后再把那个体验的结果说给我听。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich möchte dass du wie Moot Arvan wirst und den kalten Sumpf auskundschaftest, wie er es tat. Dann erzählst du mir deine Geschichte. Okay?
dialogsBegin.fi: So, here's where you come in. I need an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Mushmoot. Feel like helping?
dialogsBegin.fil: So, here's where you come in. I need an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Mushmoot. Feel like helping?
dialogsBegin.fr: J'aimerais donc que tu te mettes dans la peau de Moot Arvan et que toi aussi tu explores ce lieu. Après tu me raconteras ce que tu as découvert. Qu'en penses-tu ?
dialogsBegin.id: Jadi, di sinilah kamu masuk. Saya perlu akhir cerita dan saya ingin tahu apa yang terjadi dengan Mushmoot. Merasa ingin membantu?
dialogsBegin.it: So, here's where you come in. I need an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Mushmoot. Feel like helping?
dialogsBegin.jp: そこで君に頼みがあるのだが・・・。この小説が完成できるように、君がムトの代わりに、今話したことを体験し、私に話してほしいのだ。どうだ？やってくれるか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 그래서 부탁인데 말이에요. 이야기의 결말을 써야 하는데... 머쉬무트가 어떻게 되었는지 알고 싶어요. 도와주실래요?
dialogsBegin.nl: So, here's where you come in. I need an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Mushmoot. Feel like helping?
dialogsBegin.pl: So, here's where you come in. I need an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Mushmoot. Feel like helping?
dialogsBegin.ru: Что было дальше, неизвестно. Ну что же, разыграем финал самостоятельно! Предлагаю тебе ведущую роль. Что скажешь?
dialogsBegin.sp: Y aquí es donde entras tú. Necesito un final para la historia y me gustaría saber qué ha pasado con Mushmoot. ¿Te ves con ganas de ayudar?
dialogsBegin.sw: So, here's where you come in. I need an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Mushmoot. Feel like helping?
dialogsBegin.th: แล้วคุณก้ได้เดินทางมา ณ ที่แห่งนี้ ฉันต้องการตอนจบของเรื่องๆ นี้ ฉันจึงอยากจะรู้ว่าเกิดอะไรขึ้นเกี่ยวกับ Mushmoot อยากจะช่วยไหมล่ะ?
dialogsBegin.tw: 所以啊…你可不可以代替我親自去體驗看看啊？然後再把那個體驗的結果說給我聽。
dialogsBegin.vi: Vì vậy, đây là nơi bạn đến. Tôi cần một đoạn kết cho câu chuyện và tôi muốn biết chuyện gì sẽ xảy ra với Mushmoot. Bạn muốn giúp đỡ chứ?

dialogsAccept.en: Great! One of those pesky Hadeseors at the Plain of Bubble has stolen one of my reference books! Find and recover the book for me and see if you can locate the Boggy Map while you're there.
dialogsAccept.ar: Great! One of those pesky Hadeseors at the Plain of Bubble has stolen one of my reference books! Find and recover the book for me and see if you can locate the Boggy Map while you're there.
dialogsAccept.br: Ótimo! Um daqueles Hadeseors irritantes na Planície de Bubble roubou um dos meus livros de referência enquanto eu bebia! Recupere o livro para mim e veja se consegue localizar o Mapa do Pântano enquanto estiver lá.
dialogsAccept.cns: 好，你首先去波布尔平原击杀暴戾矿工幽魂并获得恐怖之书第3卷，然后旁边找一下沼泽地图
dialogsAccept.de: Fein. Bitte gehe nun und jage Hadeseor, er lebt in der Ebene von Bubble. Dann bekommst du 3rd Book of Dread. Finde bitte auch ihren Sumpf in dem Feld.
dialogsAccept.fi: Great! One of those pesky Hadeseors at the Plain of Bubble has stolen one of my reference books! Find and recover the book for me and see if you can locate the Boggy Map while you're there.
dialogsAccept.fil: Great! One of those pesky Hadeseors at the Plain of Bubble has stolen one of my reference books! Find and recover the book for me and see if you can locate the Boggy Map while you're there.
dialogsAccept.fr: Il te faut tout d'abord te rendre à la Plaine de Bubble et te débarrasser des Hadeseors pour obtenir le Livre de Mushmoot. Aussi j'aimerais que tu trouves leur marais dans la plaine.
dialogsAccept.id: Baik! Salah satu Hadeseor sial di Plain of Bubble itu telah mencuri salah satu buku referensiku! Temukan dan pulihkan buku untuk saya dan lihat apakah kamu dapat menemukan Peta Boggy saat kamu berada di sana.
dialogsAccept.it: Great! One of those pesky Hadeseors at the Plain of Bubble has stolen one of my reference books! Find and recover the book for me and see if you can locate the Boggy Map while you're there.
dialogsAccept.jp: よし！それでは、手始めにバブルの平原に生息するハデュサという奴を倒し、恐怖の書を持ってきてほしい。あぁ。それと、平原の何処かにある、彼らの湿原を見つけることも忘れないでくれよ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 좋아요! 버블 평원에 있는 성가신 하데서 중 하나가 제 참고용 책을 훔쳐 갔거든요! 책을 되찾아주시고, 가능하다면 그 근처에서 습지 지도도 찾아주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Great! One of those pesky Hadeseors at the Plain of Bubble has stolen one of my reference books! Find and recover the book for me and see if you can locate the Boggy Map while you're there.
dialogsAccept.pl: Great! One of those pesky Hadeseors at the Plain of Bubble has stolen one of my reference books! Find and recover the book for me and see if you can locate the Boggy Map while you're there.
dialogsAccept.ru: Третью Книгу кошмарищ я дал почитать бригадиру забойщиков из шахты Распада... или, вернее сказать, уже зомбойщиков. Верни книгу и поищи на поле карту болота.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Genial! ¡Uno de esos molestos Hadeseors de la Llanura de Bubble ha robado uno de mis libros de referencia! Encuentra y recupera el libro para mí y ve si puedes localizar el Mapa Pantanoso mientras estás por allí.
dialogsAccept.sw: Great! One of those pesky Hadeseors at the Plain of Bubble has stolen one of my reference books! Find and recover the book for me and see if you can locate the Boggy Map while you're there.
dialogsAccept.th: เยี่ยม! หนึ่งใน Hadeseors ที่น่ารำคาญที่อยุ่ใน Plain of Bubble ได้ขโมยหนังสืออ้างอิงเล่มหนึ่งของฉันไป! ค้นหามันและนำหนังสือกลับมา ลองดูว่าคุณสามารถหา Boggy Map ได้หรือไม่ในขณะที่คุณอยู่ที่นั่น
dialogsAccept.tw: 好，你首先去巴布樂平原找一個叫做瑕德西的人，他會給你恐怖的書第 3 卷，然後在平原的某處找一下他們的氣息地。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tuyệt quá! Một trong những người Hadeseors cáu kỉnh ở Plain of Bubble đã đánh cắp một trong những cuốn sách tham khảo của tôi! Tìm và thu hồi cuốn sách cho tôi và xem liệu bạn có thể định vị Boggy Map khi bạn ở đó không.

dialogsDecline.en: Don't be a scaredy-cat! Look, I'll even give you 50% of the proceeds from my book sales if you help. Okay?
dialogsDecline.ar: Don't be a scaredy-cat! Look, I'll even give you 50% of the proceeds from my book sales if you help. Okay?
dialogsDecline.br: Não seja medroso(a). Olha, eu lhe darei 50% do lucro das vendas do livro se me ajudar. Beleza?
dialogsDecline.cns: 反正，应该是一个很棒的冒险啦!我会拿我卖书的收入50%给你，好不好?
dialogsDecline.de: Es wird ein großes Abenteuer werden. Ich werde dir die Hälfte des Einkommens von meinem Buch geben. Möchtest du es immernoch versuchen?
dialogsDecline.fi: Don't be a scaredy-cat! Look, I'll even give you 50% of the proceeds from my book sales if you help. Okay?
dialogsDecline.fil: Don't be a scaredy-cat! Look, I'll even give you 50% of the proceeds from my book sales if you help. Okay?
dialogsDecline.fr: Fouille bien les environs pour trouver la Carte du marais. Ce sera une grande aventure, toujours partant ?
dialogsDecline.id: Jangan menjadi kucing penakut! Dengar, aku bahkan akan memberimu 50% dari hasil penjualan bukuku jika kau membantu. Oke?
dialogsDecline.it: Don't be a scaredy-cat! Look, I'll even give you 50% of the proceeds from my book sales if you help. Okay?
dialogsDecline.jp:
とてもスリリングで、冒険者にはたまらない話だと思うんだが・・・。私がこの本を出版したら、売り上げの50％をあげよう。
どうだい？それでもやらないのかい？
dialogsDecline.kr: 겁쟁이처럼 굴지 마세요! 도와주시면 책 인세의 절반을 드릴게요. 어때요?
dialogsDecline.nl: Don't be a scaredy-cat! Look, I'll even give you 50% of the proceeds from my book sales if you help. Okay?
dialogsDecline.pl: Don't be a scaredy-cat! Look, I'll even give you 50% of the proceeds from my book sales if you help. Okay?
dialogsDecline.ru: Да ладно тебе! Обещаю, ты получишь ПОЛОВИНУ прибыли от книги! Что теперь скажешь?
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡No seas como un gato asustadizo! Mira, si me ayudas te daré el 50% de las ganancias de las ventas de mis libros. ¿Vale?
dialogsDecline.sw: Don't be a scaredy-cat! Look, I'll even give you 50% of the proceeds from my book sales if you help. Okay?
dialogsDecline.th: อย่าป๊อดไปหน่อยเลยน่า! ฟังนะ ฉันจะให้คุณ 50% ของรายได้จากการขายหนังสือของฉันเลยนะ ถ้าคุณช่วยฉัน โอเคมะ?
dialogsDecline.tw: 反正，應該是一個很棒的冒險啦！我會拿我賣書的收入 50% 給你，好不好？
dialogsDecline.vi: Đừng sợ hãi! Nghe này, tôi thậm chí sẽ chia cho bạn 50% số tiền thu được từ việc bán sách của tôi nếu bạn giúp. Được chứ?

dialogsComplete.en: Yes, great work! I knew you could do it!
dialogsComplete.ar: Yes, great work! I knew you could do it!
dialogsComplete.br: Sim, ótimo trabalho! Eu sabia que voce poderia fazer isso!
dialogsComplete.cns: 哈哈，这么难的事情都办完了啊?把这个收下吧!这是达施德的心脏，好恶心喔~我不想看。
dialogsComplete.de: Oh, du bist echt gut!! Hier bitte. Dies ist das Herz von Moot. Wie abscheulich es doch ist!
dialogsComplete.fi: Yes, great work! I knew you could do it!
dialogsComplete.fil: Yes, great work! I knew you could do it!
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh, tu es vraiment fort !! Voilà pour toi, il s'agit du cœur de Arvan. Un peu dégoûtant, je sais.
dialogsComplete.id: Ya, kerja bagus! Aku tahu kamu bisa melakukannya!
dialogsComplete.it: Yes, great work! I knew you could do it!
dialogsComplete.jp: おぉー！君！さすがじゃないか！結構大変だっただろう。よーし、これを受け取ってくれ。これはアールバンの心臓だ。とても気持ち悪くて、私は見たくもないがね。
dialogsComplete.kr: 좋아요, 훌륭해요! 해내실 줄 알았어요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Yes, great work! I knew you could do it!
dialogsComplete.pl: Yes, great work! I knew you could do it!
dialogsComplete.ru: Отлично! Я знал, что ты справишься!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Sí, buen trabajo! ¡Sabía que podrías hacerlo!
dialogsComplete.sw: Yes, great work! I knew you could do it!
dialogsComplete.th: นั่นแหละ เยี่ยมมาก! ฉันรู้ว่าคุณสามารถทำมันได้!
dialogsComplete.tw: 哈哈，這麼難的事情都辦完了啊？把這個收下吧！這是達施德的心臟，好噁心喔~我不想看。
dialogsComplete.vi: Đúng rồi, làm tốt lắm! Tôi biết bạn có thể làm được mà!

dialogsComplete.en: Take that heart to the Dreadpet Manager at the Eastern River of Weeping. You'll need to form a party first, it's way too dangerous to go in there alone.
dialogsComplete.ar: Take that heart to the Dreadpet Manager at the Eastern River of Weeping. You'll need to form a party first, it's way too dangerous to go in there alone.
dialogsComplete.br: Leve esse coração para o Gestor de Dreadpet no Leste do Rio das Lágrimas. Você precisará formar um grupo primeiro, é muito perigoso entrar lá sozinho.
dialogsComplete.cns: 你先去找特莱特怪物管理者，他会告诉你一些事情，但是绝对不要自己去体验喔~一定要组剧团进去!
dialogsComplete.de: Bringt das Herz zum Dreadpet-Manager am östlichen Fluss der Tränen. Ihr müsst zuerst eine Gruppe bilden, denn es ist viel zu gefährlich, dort alleine hinzugehen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Take that heart to the Dreadpet Manager at the Eastern River of Weeping. You'll need to form a party first, it's way too dangerous to go in there alone.
dialogsComplete.fil: Dalhin ang pusong iyon sa Dreadpet Manager sa Silangang Ilog ng Pag-iyak. Kailangan mo munang mag-party, masyadong delikado kung mag-isa kang pumasok doon.
dialogsComplete.fr: Maintenant va rencontrer le Manager Dreadpet à l'est de la Rivière de Larmes, il te montrera le chemin. Mais tu devrais d'abord former un groupe.
dialogsComplete.id: Bawa hati itu ke Manajer Dreadpet di Eastern River of Weeping. Kamu harus membentuk pesta terlebih dahulu, terlalu berbahaya untuk masuk ke sana sendirian.
dialogsComplete.it: Take that heart to the Dreadpet Manager at the Eastern River of Weeping. You'll need to form a party first, it's way too dangerous to go in there alone.
dialogsComplete.jp: 勇気の谷の何処かにいるという、シヴァーモンスター伝道師の元へ行くといい。彼が案内してくれるはずだ。それと、一人では無理だから、必ずパーティーを組んで行くことだ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이 심장을 낙루의 강 동쪽에 있는 드래드펫 관리자에게 전달해 주세요. 혼자 가기엔 위험하니까, 극단을 구하시는 게 좋을 거예요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Take that heart to the Dreadpet Manager at the Eastern River of Weeping. You'll need to form a party first, it's way too dangerous to go in there alone.
dialogsComplete.pl: Take that heart to the Dreadpet Manager at the Eastern River of Weeping. You'll need to form a party first, it's way too dangerous to go in there alone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Take that heart to the Dreadpet Manager at the Eastern River of Weeping. You'll need to form a party first, it's way too dangerous to go in there alone.
dialogsComplete.sp: Lleva ese corazón al Mánager Dreadpet al Este del Río del Llanto. Primero tendrás que formar una party, es demasiado peligroso entrar allí solo.
dialogsComplete.sw: Take that heart to the Dreadpet Manager at the Eastern River of Weeping. You'll need to form a party first, it's way too dangerous to go in there alone.
dialogsComplete.th: ถ้าเลิกป่วยแล้วก็เอาหัวใจไปหา Dreadpet Manager ที่ Eastern River of Weeping ซะ คุณจะต้องเข้าร่วมงานปาร์ตี้เพื่อเข้าไปในบึง ซึ่งเป็นวิธีที่อันตรายเกินกว่าที่จะไปคนเดียว
dialogsComplete.tw: 把那顆心交給特萊特怪物管理者。你得先組個劇團，一個人進去太危險了。
dialogsComplete.vi: Hãy dành trái tim đó cho Dreadpet Manager tại East River of Weeping. Trước tiên bạn cần tổ chức một bữa tiệc, sẽ quá nguy hiểm nếu vào đó một mình.

dialogsFail.en: Ah geez! What are you afraid of? A Hadeseor? Psht! I guess you aren't as brave as I thought you were.
dialogsFail.ar: Ah geez! What are you afraid of? A Hadeseor? Psht! I guess you aren't as brave as I thought you were.
dialogsFail.br: Ai ai! Do que você tem medo? Do Hadeseor? Psht! Acho que você não é tão corajoso quanto eu pensei que fosse.
dialogsFail.cns: 瑕德西这家伙是有点狡猾啦!可是我相信，如果是你的话，一定没有问题的!
dialogsFail.de: Ach herrje! Wovor hast du Angst? Einem Hadeseor? Pscht! Du bist wohl doch nicht so mutig, wie ich dachte.
dialogsFail.fi: Ah geez! What are you afraid of? A Hadeseor? Psht! I guess you aren't as brave as I thought you were.
dialogsFail.fil: Ah geez! What are you afraid of? A Hadeseor? Psht! I guess you aren't as brave as I thought you were.
dialogsFail.fr: Je sais qu'il est difficile de se battre contre les Hadeseors car ils ont été infectés par Mushmoot... Mais je suis sûr que tu peux le faire. Bonne chance !
dialogsFail.id: Ah astaga! Apa yang kamu takutkan? Seorang Hadesor? Sst! Saya kira kamu tidak seberani yang saya kira.
dialogsFail.it: Ah geez! What are you afraid of? A Hadeseor? Psht! I guess you aren't as brave as I thought you were.
dialogsFail.jp: ハデュサをあなどってはいかんぞ。なにしろ陰鬱の洗礼を受けた奴だからな。でも、君ならきっと大丈夫だろう。頑張ってくれ！
dialogsFail.kr: 아, 참나! 뭐가 무서운 거예요? 하데서가 무서워서요? 치, 생각보다 겁이 많으시네요.
dialogsFail.nl: Ah geez! What are you afraid of? A Hadeseor? Psht! I guess you aren't as brave as I thought you were.
dialogsFail.pl: Ah geez! What are you afraid of? A Hadeseor? Psht! I guess you aren't as brave as I thought you were.
dialogsFail.ru: Ah geez! What are you afraid of? A Hadeseor? Psht! I guess you aren't as brave as I thought you were.
dialogsFail.sp: ¡Pero bueno! ¿De que estás asustado? ¿De un Hadeseor? ¡Psht! Supongo que no eres tan valiente como pensaba.
dialogsFail.sw: Ah geez! What are you afraid of? A Hadeseor? Psht! I guess you aren't as brave as I thought you were.
dialogsFail.th: อา พระเจ้าช่วย! กลัวอะไรไปล่ะ? Hadeseorงั้นเรอะ? โธ่! ฉันเดาว่าคุณน่าจะขี้ขลาดกว่าที่คิดนะเนี่ย
dialogsFail.tw: 啊，天哪！你有什麼好怕的？瑕德西？噓！我想你並沒有我想像的那麼勇敢。
dialogsFail.vi: Ôi trời! Bạn sợ cái gì? Một Hadeseor? Psht! Tôi đoán bạn không dũng cảm như tôi nghĩ.

dialogsBegin.th: ในที่สุดคุณก็ถึงเลเวล 20 แล้ว! นี่เป็นเวลาเหมาะสมที่สุดในการเรียนรู้วิธีการใช้งานอุปกรณ์บินของคุณเอง

dialogsBegin.en: The first thing you need to do is buy a flying device. Come back to me when you have one. I sell Boards & Brooms so take a look in my Store.

dialogsBegin.cns: 你需要做的第一件事就是购买一个飞行器。当你拥有一个飞行器的时候再回来找我吧。正好我的商店销售滑板和扫帚飞行器，你可以看看。
dialogsBegin.de: Als Erstes musst du dir einen Flugapparat kaufen. Melde dich bei mir, wenn du einen hast. Ich verkaufe Bretter und Besen, also wirf einen Blick in meinen Shop.
dialogsBegin.fi: The first thing you need to do is buy a flying device. Come back to me when you have one. I sell Boards & Brooms so take a look in my Store.
dialogsBegin.fil: The first thing you need to do is buy a flying device. Come back to me when you have one. I sell Boards & Brooms so take a look in my Store.
dialogsBegin.fr: La première chose qu'il te faut est un engin volant. Reviens me voir quand tu en auras un. Je vends des planches et des balais, donc n'hésite pas à jeter un coup d'œil à ma boutique.
dialogsBegin.id: Hal pertama yang perlu kamu lakukan adalah membeli Flying Device. Kembali padaku saat kamu telah memilikinya. Aku menjual Boards & Brooms, silakan melihat-lihat.
dialogsBegin.it: The first thing you need to do is buy a flying device. Come back to me when you have one. I sell Boards & Brooms so take a look in my Store.
dialogsBegin.jp: まずは飛行アイテムを手に入れるところからですね。手に入れたらまた声をかけてくださいね。私のお店で買ってくれたら嬉しいなぁ..？
dialogsBegin.kr: 제일 먼저 비행 장치를 구매해야겠군요. 구매하신 다음에 다시 오세요. 제 상점에서 보드와 빗자루를 판매하고 있답니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: The first thing you need to do is buy a flying device. Come back to me when you have one. I sell Boards & Brooms so take a look in my Store.

dialogsBegin.sp: Lo primero que tienes que hacer es comprar un dispositivo volador. Vuelve a hablar conmigo cuando tengas uno. Yo vendo Tablas y Escobas, así que echa un vistazo en mi Tienda.
dialogsBegin.sw: The first thing you need to do is buy a flying device. Come back to me when you have one. I sell Boards & Brooms so take a look in my Store.
dialogsBegin.th: สิ่งแรกที่คุณต้องทำคือซื้ออุปกรณ์การบิน กลับมาหาฉันเมื่อคุณมีอุปกรณ์แล้ว ฉันขายบอร์ดและไม้กวาด ลองดูในร้านของฉันสิ
dialogsBegin.tw: 你需要做的第一件事是購買飛行設備。有空就回來找我。我賣飛行板和掃帚，所以看看我的商店。
dialogsBegin.vi: Điều đầu tiên bạn cần làm là mua một thiết bị bay. Hãy quay lại với tôi khi bạn có thiết bị bay. Tôi bán Boards & Brooms nên hãy xem trong Cửa hàng của tôi.
