name.th: เลี้ยงสัตว์เลี้ยง 1 (ไข่ -> ระดับ F)

description.en: The Pet Tamer has asked you to feed your egg some Pet Candy until it reaches 99.99% EXP. Once you've done that, return to him and he will hatch it for you!
description.ar: The Pet Tamer has asked you to feed your egg some Pet Candy until it reaches 99.99% EXP. Once you've done that, return to him and he will hatch it for you!
description.br: O Domador pediu para você alimentar seu Ovo com Doce para Pet até ele atingir 99.99% de experiência. Depois de fazer isso, volte para ele e ele chocará para você!
description.cns: 宠物驯兽师要求你给你的蛋喂一些宠物糖果，直到它达到 99.99% 的经验值。完成后，回到他身边，他会为你孵化！
description.de: Verwende Pet Candy (F), um die Erfahrung von deinem Egg auf 99,99% zu bringen und kehre anschließend zum Pet Tamer zurück.
description.fi: The Pet Tamer has asked you to feed your egg some Pet Candy until it reaches 99.99% EXP. Once you've done that, return to him and he will hatch it for you!
description.fil: The Pet Tamer has asked you to feed your egg some Pet Candy until it reaches 99.99% EXP. Once you've done that, return to him and he will hatch it for you!
description.fr: Nourrir l’œuf pour que son expérience atteigne 99,99% puis retourner voir l'éleveur de familiers.
description.id: Pet Tamer memintamu untuk memberi makan telur dengan Pet Candy sampai mencapai 99,99% EXP. Setelah kamu melakukan itu, kembali padanya dan dia akan menetaskannya untukmu!
description.it: The Pet Tamer has asked you to feed your egg some Pet Candy until it reaches 99.99% EXP. Once you've done that, return to him and he will hatch it for you!
description.jp: ペットテイマーに経験値が100％になった卵を持って行くと、ペットに孵化させてくれるそうだ。
description.kr: 펫 조련사가 알에게 펫 캔디를 먹여 경험치를 99.99%로 만들어 달라고 부탁했습니다. 캔디를 먹인 후 조련사에게 돌아가면 알을 부화시킬 수 있습니다!
description.nl: The Pet Tamer has asked you to feed your egg some Pet Candy until it reaches 99.99% EXP. Once you've done that, return to him and he will hatch it for you!
description.pl: The Pet Tamer has asked you to feed your egg some Pet Candy until it reaches 99.99% EXP. Once you've done that, return to him and he will hatch it for you!
description.ru: The Pet Tamer has asked you to feed your egg some Pet Candy until it reaches 99.99% EXP. Once you've done that, return to him and he will hatch it for you!
description.sp: El domador de mascotas te ha pedido que alimentes al huevo con Caramelos de Mascotas hasta que alcance el 99,99 % de EXP. ¡Una vez que hayas hecho eso, vuelve a verlo y él lo empollará!
description.sw: The Pet Tamer has asked you to feed your egg some Pet Candy until it reaches 99.99% EXP. Once you've done that, return to him and he will hatch it for you!
description.th: Pet Tamer ขอให้คุณป้อน Pet Candy ให้กับไข่ของคุณจนกว่าจะถึง 99.99% EXP เมื่อคุณทำเสร็จแล้ว กลับไปหาเขา แล้วเขาจะฟักไข่ให้คุณ!
description.tw: 寵物馴獸師要求你給你的蛋餵一些寵物糖果，直到它達到 99.99% 的經驗值。完成後，回到他身邊，他會為你孵化！
description.vi: Pet Tamer đã yêu cầu bạn cho trứng ăn một ít Kẹo thú cưng cho đến khi nó đạt 99,99% EXP. Khi bạn đã hoàn thành điều đó, hãy quay lại với anh ấy và anh ấy sẽ ấp nó cho bạn!

dialogsBegin.en: Nice egg, stranger. I'm sure you're wondering what kind of pet you'll get from it. Well, don't get too far ahead of yourself now. I can't guarantee you're going to be able to hatch it.
dialogsBegin.ar: Nice egg, stranger. I'm sure you're wondering what kind of pet you'll get from it. Well, don't get too far ahead of yourself now. I can't guarantee you're going to be able to hatch it.
dialogsBegin.br: Belo ovo. Estou certo de que você está se perguntando que tipo de Pet nascerá dele. Bem, não fique agitado. Não posso garantir que você tem a habilidade para chocá-lo
dialogsBegin.cns: 好蛋，陌生人。我敢肯定你想知道你会从中得到什么样的宠物。好吧，现在还为时过早。我不能保证你能孵化它。
dialogsBegin.de: Ist das ein Egg an deiner Seite? Du bist sicher neugierig, was für ein Pet daraus schlüpfen wird. Nun, mute dir jetzt nicht zu viel zu. Ich weiß nicht, ob du es von alleine zum schlüpfen bringen kannst.
dialogsBegin.fi: Nice egg, stranger. I'm sure you're wondering what kind of pet you'll get from it. Well, don't get too far ahead of yourself now. I can't guarantee you're going to be able to hatch it.
dialogsBegin.fil: Nice egg, stranger. I'm sure you're wondering what kind of pet you'll get from it. Well, don't get too far ahead of yourself now. I can't guarantee you're going to be able to hatch it.
dialogsBegin.fr: Joli œuf ! Je suis sûr que tu te demandes ce qui va en sortir ! Mais pas la peine de s'emballer, il est possible que tu ne puisses pas le faire éclore.
dialogsBegin.id: Telur yang bagus, orang asing. Saya yakin kamu bertanya-tanya hewan peliharaan seperti apa yang akan kamu dapatkan darinya. Nah, jangan terlalu jauh di depan diri sendiri sekarang. Saya tidak bisa menjamin kamu akan bisa menetaskannya.
dialogsBegin.it: Nice egg, stranger. I'm sure you're wondering what kind of pet you'll get from it. Well, don't get too far ahead of yourself now. I can't guarantee you're going to be able to hatch it.
dialogsBegin.jp: 素敵な卵をお持ちですね。その卵からどんなペットがでるのか気になりませんか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 좋은 알이네요. 어떤 펫이 나올지 엄청 궁금하시겠죠? 벌써 너무 앞서나가지는 마세요. 부화할 수 있을지는 아직 장담할 수 없답니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Nice egg, stranger. I'm sure you're wondering what kind of pet you'll get from it. Well, don't get too far ahead of yourself now. I can't guarantee you're going to be able to hatch it.
dialogsBegin.pl: Nice egg, stranger. I'm sure you're wondering what kind of pet you'll get from it. Well, don't get too far ahead of yourself now. I can't guarantee you're going to be able to hatch it.
dialogsBegin.ru: Nice egg, stranger. I'm sure you're wondering what kind of pet you'll get from it. Well, don't get too far ahead of yourself now. I can't guarantee you're going to be able to hatch it.
dialogsBegin.sp: Buen huevo, extranjero. Seguro que te estás preguntando qué tipo de mascota saldrá de él. Bueno, no te apresures. No puedo garantizar que podrás eclosionarlo.
dialogsBegin.sw: Nice egg, stranger. I'm sure you're wondering what kind of pet you'll get from it. Well, don't get too far ahead of yourself now. I can't guarantee you're going to be able to hatch it.
dialogsBegin.th: ไข่สวยนี่ คนแปลกหน้า ฉันแน่ใจว่าคุณกำลังสงสัยว่าคุณจะได้สัตว์เลี้ยงชนิดใดจากมัน ดีแล้ว อย่าเพิ่งไปไกลกว่าตัวเองตอนนี้ ฉันไม่สามารถรับประกันได้ว่าคุณจะสามารถฟักไข่ได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 好蛋，陌生人。我敢肯定你想知道你會從中得到什麼樣的寵物。好吧，現在不要太過分了。我不能保證你能孵化它。
dialogsBegin.vi: Quả trứng đẹp. Tôi chắc rằng bạn đang tự hỏi bạn sẽ nhận được loại thú cưng nào từ quả trứng. Chà, đừng phấn khích quá. Tôi không đảm bảo bạn có thể ấp nở nó.

dialogsBegin.en: However, if you really take care of the egg there shouldn't be a problem. All you need to do is get the egg's experience (EXP) to 99.99% and then bring it back to me. Think you can do that?
dialogsBegin.ar: However, if you really take care of the egg there shouldn't be a problem. All you need to do is get the egg's experience (EXP) to 99.99% and then bring it back to me. Think you can do that?
dialogsBegin.br: Entretanto, se você cuidar bem do ovo, não deverá haver problemas. Tudo o que você precisa fazer é aumentar a Experiência do ovo até 99.99%, e então o traga para mim. Você pode fazer isso?
dialogsBegin.cns: 但是，如果你真的照顾好宠物蛋，那就没有问题。你需要做的就是把蛋的经验（EXP）提高到99.99%，然后把它带回来给我。你觉得你能做到吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Wie auch immer. Du bist sicher in der Lage, dich um das Egg zu kümmern. Du musst nur die dessen EXP auf 99,99% bringen und wieder zu mir kommen. Schaffst du das?
dialogsBegin.fi: However, if you really take care of the egg there shouldn't be a problem. All you need to do is get the egg's experience (EXP) to 99.99% and then bring it back to me. Think you can do that?
dialogsBegin.fil: However, if you really take care of the egg there shouldn't be a problem. All you need to do is get the egg's experience (EXP) to 99.99% and then bring it back to me. Think you can do that?
dialogsBegin.fr: Ceci dit, si tu en prends vraiment soin, ça devrait aller. Tout ce que tu as à faire est de monter l'expérience de l’œuf à 99,99% et me le ramener. Es-tu intéressé ?
dialogsBegin.id: Namun, jika kamu benar-benar merawat telurnya seharusnya tidak menjadi masalah. Yang perlu dilakukan adalah mendapatkan egg experience (EXP) menjadi 99,99% dan kemudian mengembalikannya kepadaku. Bisakah kamu melakukan itu?
dialogsBegin.it: However, if you really take care of the egg there shouldn't be a problem. All you need to do is get the egg's experience (EXP) to 99.99% and then bring it back to me. Think you can do that?
dialogsBegin.jp: ペットを愛する気持ちがあれば、素敵なペットが生まれるはずです。卵の経験値を100％にする自信がありますか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 어쨌든, 알을 잘 돌본다면 문제 될 것은 없답니다. 알의 경험치(EXP)를 99.99%까지 끌어올려 다시 제게 알을 가져다주시면 돼요. 하실 수 있겠죠?
dialogsBegin.nl: However, if you really take care of the egg there shouldn't be a problem. All you need to do is get the egg's experience (EXP) to 99.99% and then bring it back to me. Think you can do that?
dialogsBegin.pl: However, if you really take care of the egg there shouldn't be a problem. All you need to do is get the egg's experience (EXP) to 99.99% and then bring it back to me. Think you can do that?
dialogsBegin.ru: However, if you really take care of the egg there shouldn't be a problem. All you need to do is get the egg's experience (EXP) to 99.99% and then bring it back to me. Think you can do that?
dialogsBegin.sp: Sin embargo, si cuidas bien del huevo, no debería haber ningún problema. Todo lo que tienes que hacer es aumentar la experiencia del huevo (EXP) a 99,99 % y luego traérmelo. ¿Crees que puedes hacerlo?
dialogsBegin.sw: However, if you really take care of the egg there shouldn't be a problem. All you need to do is get the egg's experience (EXP) to 99.99% and then bring it back to me. Think you can do that?
dialogsBegin.th: อย่างไรก็ตาม หากคุณดูแลไข่จริงๆ ก็ไม่น่าจะมีปัญหาอะไร สิ่งที่คุณต้องทำคือรับประสบการณ์ของไข่ (EXP) เป็น 99.99% แล้วนำกลับมาให้ฉัน คิดว่าคุณทำได้ไหม
dialogsBegin.tw: 但是，如果你真的照顧好蛋，那應該沒有問題。你需要做的就是把蛋的經驗 (EXP) 提高到 99.99%，然後把它帶回來給我。你覺得你能做到嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Tuy nhiên, nếu bạn thực sự chăm sóc trứng thì sẽ không có vấn đề gì. Tất cả những gì bạn cần làm là đạt điểm experience (EXP) của quả trứng lên 99,99% rồi mang nó về cho tôi. Bạn nghĩ rằng bạn có thể làm được điều đó?

dialogsAccept.en: Sounds good! Alright, listen. In order to bring your egg's experience to full, you're going to need to feed it while it's summoned. Find yourself some Pet Candy (F) and get started!
dialogsAccept.ar: Sounds good! Alright, listen. In order to bring your egg's experience to full, you're going to need to feed it while it's summoned. Find yourself some Pet Candy (F) and get started!
dialogsAccept.br: Ótimo! Certo, ouça. A fim de trazer a experiência do seu ovo ao máximo, você precisará alimentá-lo enquanto ele é convocado. Encontre alguns Doces para Pets (F) e comece!
dialogsAccept.cns: 听起来不错！好吧，听着。为了让你的蛋的获得经验，你需要在它被召唤时喂它。先给自己找点宠物糖果 (F) 吧！
dialogsAccept.de: Klingt gut! Alles klar, hör zu. Um die Erfahrung von einem Egg auf das Maximum zu bringen, musst du es füttern, während es beschworen ist. Besorg dir ein paar Pet Candy (F) und leg los!
dialogsAccept.fi: Sounds good! Alright, listen. In order to bring your egg's experience to full, you're going to need to feed it while it's summoned. Find yourself some Pet Candy (F) and get started!
dialogsAccept.fil: Sounds good! Alright, listen. In order to bring your egg's experience to full, you're going to need to feed it while it's summoned. Find yourself some Pet Candy (F) and get started!
dialogsAccept.fr: Parfait. Maintenant, prend bien soin de ton œuf et nourris-le. Le nourrir monte son expérience, mais tu ne peux le faire que lorsqu'il est invoqué. Tu auras besoin de Bonbons pour Familier (F).
dialogsAccept.id: Kedengarannya bagus! Baiklah, dengarkan. Untuk meningkatkan EXP telur sampai penuh, Kamu harus memberinya makan saat dipanggil. Temukan Pet Candy (F) dan mulailah!
dialogsAccept.it: Sounds good! Alright, listen. In order to bring your egg's experience to full, you're going to need to feed it while it's summoned. Find yourself some Pet Candy (F) and get started!
dialogsAccept.jp: これからあなたは卵に愛情を注がないといけません。卵に一定のえさをあげると、孵化されます。卵を召喚した状態でえさを与えてください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 좋은데요! 좋아요, 잘 들어요. 알의 경험치를 가득 채우려면 알을 소환해 먹이를 주어야 합니다. 펫 캔디(F)를 찾아 알 키우기를 시작하세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Sounds good! Alright, listen. In order to bring your egg's experience to full, you're going to need to feed it while it's summoned. Find yourself some Pet Candy (F) and get started!
dialogsAccept.pl: Sounds good! Alright, listen. In order to bring your egg's experience to full, you're going to need to feed it while it's summoned. Find yourself some Pet Candy (F) and get started!
dialogsAccept.ru: Sounds good! Alright, listen. In order to bring your egg's experience to full, you're going to need to feed it while it's summoned. Find yourself some Pet Candy (F) and get started!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Suena bien! Muy bien, escucha. Para alcanzar la experiencia de tu huevo al máximo, necesitarás alimentarlo mientras está invocado. ¡Búscate algunos Caramelos de Mascota (F) para empezar!
dialogsAccept.sw: Sounds good! Alright, listen. In order to bring your egg's experience to full, you're going to need to feed it while it's summoned. Find yourself some Pet Candy (F) and get started!
dialogsAccept.th: ฟังดูเข้าท่า! ได้เลย ฟังนะ ในการที่จะทำให้ประสบการณ์ของไข่ของคุณเต็มอิ่ม คุณจะต้องให้อาหารมันในขณะที่มันถูกเรียกออกมา ค้นหา Pet Candy (F) ให้ตัวเองแล้วเริ่มเลย!
dialogsAccept.tw: 聽起來不錯！好吧，聽著。為了讓你的蛋的經驗滿分，你需要在它被召喚時餵牠。給自己找點寵物糖果 (F) 開始吧！
dialogsAccept.vi: Nghe hay đấy! Được rồi, nghe này. Để mang lại điểm experience cao nhất cho quả trứng của bạn, bạn sẽ cần phải cho nó ăn trong khi nó được gọi đến. Tìm cho mình một số Pet Candy (F) và bắt đầu!

dialogsDecline.en: Well that's a shame. I can't say I'm surprised, though. From the looks of you, you probably couldn't even keep a cactus alive.
dialogsDecline.ar: Well that's a shame. I can't say I'm surprised, though. From the looks of you, you probably couldn't even keep a cactus alive.
dialogsDecline.br: Bem, isso é uma pena. Você tem certeza? Ter um Pet será uma grande vantagem.
dialogsDecline.cns: 好吧，真可惜。不过，我不能说我很惊讶。因为从你的样子看，你可能连仙人掌都养不活。
dialogsDecline.de: Was für eine Schande. Allerdings bin ich nicht überrascht. So wie du aussiehst, könntest du wahrscheinlich nicht mal einen Kaktus am Leben halten.
dialogsDecline.fi: Well that's a shame. I can't say I'm surprised, though. From the looks of you, you probably couldn't even keep a cactus alive.
dialogsDecline.fil: Well that's a shame. I can't say I'm surprised, though. From the looks of you, you probably couldn't even keep a cactus alive.
dialogsDecline.fr: Vraiment ? Avoir un familier procure de grands avantages tu sais !
dialogsDecline.id: Nah itu memalukan. meskipun aku tidak bisa mengatakan kalau aku terkejut. Dari penampilanmu, kamu mungkin bahkan tidak bisa memelihara kaktus.
dialogsDecline.it: Well that's a shame. I can't say I'm surprised, though. From the looks of you, you probably couldn't even keep a cactus alive.
dialogsDecline.jp: もう一回考え直してください。あなたにとってペットの存在はとても大きな力になりますよ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 아쉽네요. 어쨌든, 놀랍진 않군요. 당신 모습을 언뜻 보면 선인장도 하나 키우지 못할 것 같긴 해서요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Well that's a shame. I can't say I'm surprised, though. From the looks of you, you probably couldn't even keep a cactus alive.
dialogsDecline.pl: Well that's a shame. I can't say I'm surprised, though. From the looks of you, you probably couldn't even keep a cactus alive.
dialogsDecline.ru: Well that's a shame. I can't say I'm surprised, though. From the looks of you, you probably couldn't even keep a cactus alive.
dialogsDecline.sp: Bueno, eso es una pena. Aunque no me sorprende. Por tu apariencia, probablemente ni siquiera podrías mantener vivo a un cactus.
dialogsDecline.sw: Well that's a shame. I can't say I'm surprised, though. From the looks of you, you probably couldn't even keep a cactus alive.
dialogsDecline.th: น่าเสียดาย ฉันไม่สามารถพูดได้ว่าฉันประหลาดใจ จากรูปลักษณ์ของคุณ คุณอาจไม่สามารถแม้แต่จะเก็บกระบองเพชรให้มีชีวิตอยู่ได้
dialogsDecline.tw: 好吧，這是一種恥辱。不過，我不能說我很驚訝。從你的樣子看，你可能連仙人掌都養不活。
dialogsDecline.vi: Thật là xấu hổ. Tuy nhiên, tôi ngạc nhiên. Trông bạn dường như còn thậm chí không thể giữ cho một cây xương rồng sống nổi nữa là.

dialogsComplete.en: Great job with the egg, stranger! Tell you what, I'll take over from here. It's hatching time!
dialogsComplete.ar: Great job with the egg, stranger! Tell you what, I'll take over from here. It's hatching time!
dialogsComplete.br: Você fez um ótimo trabalho cuidando do seu Ovo. Eu assumo a partir daqui. É hora de chocar!
dialogsComplete.cns: 做得很好，陌生人！那么，我会从这开始接管。孵化时间到！
dialogsComplete.de: Gute Arbeit mit dem Egg, Fremder! Ab hier übernehme ich. Zeit zum Schlüpfen!
dialogsComplete.fi: Great job with the egg, stranger! Tell you what, I'll take over from here. It's hatching time!
dialogsComplete.fil: Great job with the egg, stranger! Tell you what, I'll take over from here. It's hatching time!
dialogsComplete.fr: Ton œuf semble prêt à éclore ! Laisse-moi voir ça.
dialogsComplete.id: Kerja bagus dengan telurnya, orang asing! Kamu tahu, aku akan mengambil alih dari sini. Saatnya menetas!
dialogsComplete.it: Great job with the egg, stranger! Tell you what, I'll take over from here. It's hatching time!
dialogsComplete.jp: よく育ちましたね。ではこれから私がこの卵を孵化させてあげましょう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 알을 잘 보살폈군요, 낯선 분! 이제부턴 제가 맡을게요. 부화할 시간입니다!
dialogsComplete.nl: Great job with the egg, stranger! Tell you what, I'll take over from here. It's hatching time!
dialogsComplete.pl: Great job with the egg, stranger! Tell you what, I'll take over from here. It's hatching time!
dialogsComplete.ru: Great job with the egg, stranger! Tell you what, I'll take over from here. It's hatching time!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Has hecho un buen trabajo con el huevo, extranjero! Me encargaré del resto. ¡Es la hora de eclosionar!
dialogsComplete.sw: Great job with the egg, stranger! Tell you what, I'll take over from here. It's hatching time!
dialogsComplete.th: เก่งมากกับไข่นะ คนแปลกหน้า! บอกฉันสิ ฉันจะรับช่วงต่อจากนี้ ได้เวลาฟักแล้ว!
dialogsComplete.tw: 做得很好，陌生人！跟你說，我會從這裡接管。孵化時間到了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Làm rất tốt với quả trứng! Tôi có ý kiến này, tôi sẽ tiếp quản từ đây. Đó là thời gian trứng nở!

dialogsFail.en: You're going to need to get your egg's experience to 99.99% in order for me to hatch it for you. Feel free to stop by again once you've done this!
dialogsFail.ar: You're going to need to get your egg's experience to 99.99% in order for me to hatch it for you. Feel free to stop by again once you've done this!

dialogsFail.cns: 你需要让你的蛋的经验达到 99.99% 才能让我为你孵化它。完成此操作后，请随时再次光临！
dialogsFail.de: Du musst die EXP von deinem Egg auf 99,99% bringen, damit ich es für dich ausbrüten kann. Komm wieder, wenn du das geschafft hast!
dialogsFail.fi: You're going to need to get your egg's experience to 99.99% in order for me to hatch it for you. Feel free to stop by again once you've done this!
dialogsFail.fil: You're going to need to get your egg's experience to 99.99% in order for me to hatch it for you. Feel free to stop by again once you've done this!
dialogsFail.fr: Tu n'as pas encore assez monté l'expérience de ton œuf, reviens me voir plus tard.
dialogsFail.id: Kamu perlu untuk membuat EXP dari telur itu menjadi 99,99% agar aku dapat menetaskannya. Kmebalilah kapanpun kamu selesai melakukan itu!
dialogsFail.it: You're going to need to get your egg's experience to 99.99% in order for me to hatch it for you. Feel free to stop by again once you've done this!
dialogsFail.jp: まだペットに対する熱情が足りないようです。
dialogsFail.kr: 알을 부화시키려면 알 경험치를 99.99%까지 올려야 합니다. 경험치를 달성하면 언제든 방문해 주세요!
dialogsFail.nl: You're going to need to get your egg's experience to 99.99% in order for me to hatch it for you. Feel free to stop by again once you've done this!
dialogsFail.pl: You're going to need to get your egg's experience to 99.99% in order for me to hatch it for you. Feel free to stop by again once you've done this!

dialogsFail.sw: You're going to need to get your egg's experience to 99.99% in order for me to hatch it for you. Feel free to stop by again once you've done this!
dialogsFail.th: คุณจะต้องได้รับประสบการณ์ไข่(EXP)ของคุณถึง 99.99% เพื่อที่ฉันจะได้ฟักไข่ให้คุณ อย่าลังเลที่จะแวะมาอีกครั้งเมื่อคุณทำเสร็จแล้ว!

dialogsFail.vi: Bạncần phải đạt điểm experience của quả trứng đến 99,99% để tôi có thể ấp nó cho bạn. Vui lòng ghé lại một lần nữa khi bạn đã hoàn thành việc này!

name.br: Encontre os Ladrões dos Bangs Vermelhos
name.cns: 追杀红色魔导战甲强盗团
name.jp: 赤いヴァン盗賊団を探せ！
name.sp: Encuentra a los Bangs Rojos ladrones

description.en: Find the thieves west of the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris and return with evidence.
description.ar: Find the thieves west of the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris and return with evidence.
description.br: Por favor, encontre os ladrões nas Montanhas Leren, ao norte, e me traga a prova.
description.cns: 找到居住在乐雅山脉西部的强盗团，并且拿证据回来!
description.de: Finde bitte die Diebe im Norden des Leren Gebirges und beschaffe mir die Beweise!
description.fi: Find the thieves west of the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris and return with evidence.
description.fil: Find the thieves west of the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris and return with evidence.
description.fr: Se rendre aux Montagnes nord de Leren et rapporter une preuve de l'existence de voleurs dans cette région
description.id: Temukan pencuri itu di sebelah barat Fountain of Dead Person di Flaris dan kembalilah dengan bukti.
description.it: Find the thieves west of the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris and return with evidence.
description.jp: レルエン山脈の北部に拠点を置いている盗賊団を探して、彼らが存在しているという証拠になる物を持ってこよう。
description.kr: 플라리스의 망자의 샘 서쪽에서 도적들을 찾아 증거를 확보하세요.
description.nl: Find the thieves west of the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris and return with evidence.
description.pl: Find the thieves west of the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris and return with evidence.
description.ru: Нужно выяснить, действительно ли на западе от фонтана Мертвеца есть разбойники, и принести Людору доказательства.
description.sp: Encuentra a los ladrones al oeste del Manantial de Almas en Flaris y vuelve con pruebas.
description.sw: Find the thieves west of the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris and return with evidence.
description.th: ค้นหาโจรทางตะวันตกของ Fountain of Dead Person ใน Flaris และกลับมาพร้อมหลักฐาน
description.tw: 尋找居住在勒倫山脈北部的竊盜團之後，拿證據回來！
description.vi: Tìm những tên trộm tại phía tây Fountain of Dead Person ở Flaris và quay trở lại cùng với bằng chứng.

dialogsBegin.en: Help! Help me! My cash box... My money... It's all gone! Someone stole my cash box! Iblis watch over me!
dialogsBegin.ar: Help! Help me! My cash box... My money... It's all gone! Someone stole my cash box! Iblis watch over me!
dialogsBegin.br: Socorro! Socorro! Meu cofre... Meu dinheiro... Ahhh! Alguém roubou meu cofre! Iblis, me proteja!!!
dialogsBegin.cns: Help! Help me! My cash box... My money... It's all gone! Someone stole my cash box! Iblis watch over me!
dialogsBegin.de: Hilfe! Hilfe! Mein Safe.. Mein Geld.. Ach!!! Was soll ich tun? Jemand hat meinen Safe gestohlen! Oh mein Gott!
dialogsBegin.fi: Help! Help me! My cash box... My money... It's all gone! Someone stole my cash box! Iblis watch over me!
dialogsBegin.fil: Help! Help me! My cash box... My money... It's all gone! Someone stole my cash box! Iblis watch over me!
dialogsBegin.fr: A l'aide ! A l'aide ! Ma tirelire. Mon argent !! Quelqu'un a volé ma tirelire ! Aidez-moi !!
dialogsBegin.id: Tolong! Tolong aku! Kotak uangku... Uangku... Semuanya hilang! Seseorang mencuri kotak uangku! Iblis mengintaiku!!!
dialogsBegin.it: Help! Help me! My cash box... My money... It's all gone! Someone stole my cash box! Iblis watch over me!
dialogsBegin.jp: 大変なことが起きてしまった！おれの金庫が、大事な金庫が盗まれてしまったんだ！はぁ～、一体どうしたものか…
dialogsBegin.kr: 도와줘요! 도와주세요! 내 돈통... 내 돈... 전부 사라졌어요! 누가 돈통을 훔쳐 갔어요! 이블리스님이 보고 계신다!
dialogsBegin.nl: Help! Help me! My cash box... My money... It's all gone! Someone stole my cash box! Iblis watch over me!
dialogsBegin.pl: Help! Help me! My cash box... My money... It's all gone! Someone stole my cash box! Iblis watch over me!
dialogsBegin.ru: Help! Help me! My cash box... My money... It's all gone! Someone stole my cash box! Iblis watch over me!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Ayuda! ¡Que alguien me ayude! Mi caja registradora... Mi dinero... ¡Se lo han llevado todo! ¡Alguien ha robado mi caja registradora! ¡¡¡Iblis cuida de mí!!!
dialogsBegin.sw: Help! Help me! My cash box... My money... It's all gone! Someone stole my cash box! Iblis watch over me!
dialogsBegin.th: ช่วยด้วย! ช่วยฉันด้วย! กล่องเงินสดของฉัน... เงินของฉัน... หายไปหมดแล้ว! มีคนขโมยกล่องเงินสดของฉันไป!
dialogsBegin.tw: 救命！救命啊！我的錢箱……我的錢……全都不見了！有人偷了我的錢箱！願伊普里司保佑我！
dialogsBegin.vi: Giúp tôi! Giúp tôi với! Thùng tiền của tôi ... Tiền của tôi ... Tất cả đã biến mất rồi! Có kẻ đã lấy trộm thùng tiền của tôi! Thần Iblis xin hãy cứu tôi!!!

dialogsBegin.en: I was saving money in my cash box in order to buy a present for my girlfriend, but it disappeared this morning.
dialogsBegin.ar: I was saving money in my cash box in order to buy a present for my girlfriend, but it disappeared this morning.
dialogsBegin.br: Eu estava guardando dinheiro no meu cofre para comprar um presente para minha namorada, mas a quantia desapareceu nesta manhã.
dialogsBegin.cns: 其实那金库里面的钱是，为了买礼物送给女朋友存下来的，可是今天早上看的时候，既然不见了..
dialogsBegin.de: In meinem Safe sparte ich eigentlich mein ganzes Geld, um meiner Freundin davon ein Geschenk zu kaufen. Heute Morgen aber entdeckte ich, dass er verschwunden ist.
dialogsBegin.fi: I was saving money in my cash box in order to buy a present for my girlfriend, but it disappeared this morning.
dialogsBegin.fil: I was saving money in my cash box in order to buy a present for my girlfriend, but it disappeared this morning.
dialogsBegin.fr: (Retrouvant son calme) Je gardais de l'argent pour acheter un cadeau à ma petite amie, mais ma précieuse tirelire a disparu ce matin.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku menyimpan uang di kotak uang untuk membeli hadiah untuk kekasihku, tetapi menghilang pagi ini.
dialogsBegin.it: I was saving money in my cash box in order to buy a present for my girlfriend, but it disappeared this morning.
dialogsBegin.jp: 実は婚約者にバースデープレゼントをあげようと思って、ひそかに貯金していたのさ。しかし今朝、あったはずの金庫がなくなっていたんだよ！
dialogsBegin.kr: 여자친구에게 줄 선물을 사려고, 조금씩 돈을 모아서 금고에 넣어뒀는데… 오늘 아침 그 금고 사라졌어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I was saving money in my cash box in order to buy a present for my girlfriend, but it disappeared this morning.
dialogsBegin.pl: I was saving money in my cash box in order to buy a present for my girlfriend, but it disappeared this morning.
dialogsBegin.ru: Я копил на подарок подружке, и вот просыпаюсь - а кубышка исчезла!
dialogsBegin.sp: Estaba guardando dinero en mi caja registradora para comprarle un regalo a mi novia, pero desapareció esta mañana.
dialogsBegin.sw: I was saving money in my cash box in order to buy a present for my girlfriend, but it disappeared this morning.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันกำลังเก็บเงินในกล่องเงินสดเพื่อซื้อของขวัญให้แฟน แต่มันหายไปเมื่อเช้านี้
dialogsBegin.tw: 其實那金庫裡面的錢是，為了買禮物送給女朋友存下來的，可是今天早上看的時候，既然不見了…
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đang để dành tiền trong thùng tiền mặt để mua quà cho bạn gái, nhưng nó đã biến mất vào sáng nay.

dialogsBegin.en: So I have asked people, and they said that there are unknown thieves just west of the Fountain of Dead Person these days. I'm not sure I believe them though…
dialogsBegin.ar: So I have asked people, and they said that there are unknown thieves just west of the Fountain of Dead Person these days. I'm not sure I believe them though…
dialogsBegin.br: Então eu falei com algumas pessoas e me disseram que hoje em dia há ladrões desconhecidos nas Montanhas Leren, ao norte. Mas eu não acredito nisso....
dialogsBegin.cns: 后来我打听了一下，听说在乐雅山脉西边出现了一个不明的强盗团，我怀疑是不是他们做的!
dialogsBegin.de: Daher fragte ich einige Leute, die dann sagten, dass es zur Zeit unbekannte Diebe im Norden des Leren Gebirges gäbe. Deshalb verdächtige ich diese Diebesbande.
dialogsBegin.fi: So I have asked people, and they said that there are unknown thieves just west of the Fountain of Dead Person these days. I'm not sure I believe them though…
dialogsBegin.fil: So I have asked people, and they said that there are unknown thieves just west of the Fountain of Dead Person these days. I'm not sure I believe them though…
dialogsBegin.fr: J'ai demandé à tout le monde, et on m'a dit qu'il y avait des voleurs qui se cachaient au nord des montagnes de Leren depuis quelques temps...
dialogsBegin.id: Jadi aku telah bertanya kepada orang-orang, dan mereka mengatakan bahwa ada pencuri tak dikenal di sebelah barat Fountain of Dead Person akhir-akhir ini. Aku tidak terlalu percaya mereka…
dialogsBegin.it: So I have asked people, and they said that there are unknown thieves just west of the Fountain of Dead Person these days. I'm not sure I believe them though…
dialogsBegin.jp: 聞いた話によると最近、レルエン山脈の北部に何とかっていう盗賊団が現れたらしいんだ。金庫泥棒はそいつらの仕業ではないかと噂があってな。
dialogsBegin.kr: 사람들한테 물어보니까, 요즘 망자의 샘 서쪽에서 정체불명의 도적단이 돌아다닌다고 하더라고요. 그 말을 믿을 수 있을지 모르겠지만...
dialogsBegin.nl: So I have asked people, and they said that there are unknown thieves just west of the Fountain of Dead Person these days. I'm not sure I believe them though…
dialogsBegin.pl: So I have asked people, and they said that there are unknown thieves just west of the Fountain of Dead Person these days. I'm not sure I believe them though…
dialogsBegin.ru: Я, конечно, кинулся расспрашивать горожан и узнал, что к западу от фонтана Мертвеца видели разбойников. Может, врут люди, а может, и нет, кто разберет?
dialogsBegin.sp: Así que le pregunté a la gente, y dijeron que hay unos ladrones desconocidos justo al oeste del Manantial de Almas desde hace unos días. Aunque no se si creérmelo...
dialogsBegin.sw: So I have asked people, and they said that there are unknown thieves just west of the Fountain of Dead Person these days. I'm not sure I believe them though…
dialogsBegin.th: ดังนั้นฉันจึงถามผู้คน และพวกเขาบอกว่าทุกวันนี้มีโจรที่ไม่รู้จักอยู่ทางตะวันตกของ Fountain of Dead Person ฉันไม่แน่ใจว่าฉันเชื่อพวกเขา ถึงแม้ว่า...
dialogsBegin.tw: 後來我打聽了一下，聽說勒倫山脈北部出現了一些竊盜團，我正在懷疑是不是做的！
dialogsBegin.vi: Vì vậy, tôi đã hỏi mọi người, và họ nói rằng có những tên trộm vô danh ở ngay phía tây của Fountain of Dead Person những ngày gần đây. Tôi không chắc tôi tin họ mặc dù…

dialogsBegin.en: Can you investigate and let me know?
dialogsBegin.ar: Can you investigate and let me know?
dialogsBegin.br: Você poderia ir checar para que eu não tenha que ir? Por favor?
dialogsBegin.cns: 在我亲自用我的眼睛确认之前，我真的没办法相信有那种强盗团，可以帮我调查一下吗?
dialogsBegin.de: Ich kann es nicht eher glauben, bis ich es mit meinen eigenen Augen gesehen habe. Könntest du das anstelle meiner überprüfen? Bitte!
dialogsBegin.fi: Voitko tutkia ja kertoa minulle?
dialogsBegin.fil: Can you investigate and let me know?
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais je ne crois que ce que je vois. Tu pourrais aller vérifier pour moi peut-être ? S'il te plaît ?
dialogsBegin.id: Bisakah kamu menyelidiki dan memberi tahuku?
dialogsBegin.it: Can you investigate and let me know?
dialogsBegin.jp: でも実際にそんな盗賊にあったこともないし、フラリスに盗賊団があること自体、信じることができないんだ。そんなわけで、オレの代わりに盗賊団が本当に存在しているのかどうか、確認してきてくれないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 조사해보시고 알려주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Can you investigate and let me know?
dialogsBegin.pl: Can you investigate and let me know?
dialogsBegin.ru: Окажи услугу, сходи туда да погляди, ладно?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Puedes ir a investigar y avisarme?
dialogsBegin.sw: Can you investigate and let me know?
dialogsBegin.th: คุณช่วยสืบดูและแจ้งให้เราทราบได้ไหม
dialogsBegin.tw: 在我親自用我的眼睛確認之前，我真的沒辦法相信有那種竊盜團，可以幫我調查一下嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có thể điều tra và cho tôi biết?

dialogsAccept.en: Thank you! Please bring me the evidence which proves they really exist. If you find them, that is.
dialogsAccept.ar: Thank you! Please bring me the evidence which proves they really exist. If you find them, that is.
dialogsAccept.br: Obrigado! Por favor, me traga uma prova de que eles realmente existem. Isto é, se você encontrá-los.
dialogsAccept.cns: 谢谢你~如果看到他们的话，请拿一点证据来，让我知道真的有强盗团的存在!
dialogsAccept.de: Danke! Beschaffe mir bitte einen Beweis dessen, dass sie wirklich existieren. Ich bitte dich!
dialogsAccept.fi: Thank you! Please bring me the evidence which proves they really exist. If you find them, that is.
dialogsAccept.fil: Thank you! Please bring me the evidence which proves they really exist. If you find them, that is.
dialogsAccept.fr: Merci ! Rapporte-moi la preuve que ces voleurs existent bel et bien, et reviens me voir au plus vite.
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih! Tolong bawakan aku bukti yang membuktikan bahwa mereka benar-benar ada. Jika kamu menemukan mereka, ya itu benar.
dialogsAccept.it: Thank you! Please bring me the evidence which proves they really exist. If you find them, that is.
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとう！そいつらを見つけたら、証拠になれるような物を持って来てくれないか？頼んだぞ～！
dialogsAccept.kr: 정말 감사합니다! 도적단이 실제로 존재한다는 걸 증명할 수 있는 증거를 꼭 찾아주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Thank you! Please bring me the evidence which proves they really exist. If you find them, that is.
dialogsAccept.pl: Thank you! Please bring me the evidence which proves they really exist. If you find them, that is.
dialogsAccept.ru: Спасибо! И знаешь… Я тебе, конечно, на слово верю, но лучше принеси мне доказательство того, что воры и впрямь существуют.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Gracias! Por favor, tráeme una prueba que demuestre que realmente existen. Si los encuentras, avísame.
dialogsAccept.sw: Thank you! Please bring me the evidence which proves they really exist. If you find them, that is.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอบคุณ! โปรดนำหลักฐานที่พิสูจน์ว่ามีจริงมาให้ฉันด้วย หากคุณพบพวกเขา
dialogsAccept.tw: 謝謝你~如果看到他們的話，請拿一點證據來，讓我知道真的有竊盜團的存在！
dialogsAccept.vi: Cảm ơn bạn! Hãy mang cho tôi bằng chứng chứng minh những tên trộm thực sự tồn tại nếu bạn tìm thấy chúng.

dialogsDecline.en: You only care about yourself. Fine, I'll find someone else.
dialogsDecline.ar: You only care about yourself. Fine, I'll find someone else.
dialogsDecline.br: Você está dizendo que não é problerma seu? Bem, posso pedir para outra pessoa. Não preciso de você!
dialogsDecline.cns: 果然因为是别人自己的事情，所以不想帮忙啊…好吧!我去找其他人来帮我好了!
dialogsDecline.de: Du willst meine Bitte ignorieren, weil es nicht deine Angelegenheit ist? Du bist böse! Ich kann vielleicht jemand anders darum bitten. Ich brauche deine Hilfe nicht!
dialogsDecline.fi: Sinä välität vain itsestäsi. Okei, etsin jonkun muun.
dialogsDecline.fil: You only care about yourself. Fine, I'll find someone else.
dialogsDecline.fr: Quoi ! Tu dis que t'en as rien à faire ? C'est bon je vais demander à quelqu'un d'autre. J'ai pas besoin de toi de toute façon...
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu hanya peduli pada diri sendiri. Baiklah, aku akan mencari orang lain.
dialogsDecline.it: You only care about yourself. Fine, I'll find someone else.
dialogsDecline.jp: おや、他人事には興味が無いってことか？冷たいなあ。まあいいさ、他の人に頼むから。
dialogsDecline.kr: 남 일이다 이건가요? 됐어요, 딴 사람에게 부탁할게요.
dialogsDecline.nl: You only care about yourself. Fine, I'll find someone else.
dialogsDecline.pl: You only care about yourself. Fine, I'll find someone else.
dialogsDecline.ru: Ты думаешь только о себе! Хорошо, я найду другого помощника.
dialogsDecline.sp: Solo te preocupas por ti. Bueno, encontraré a otra persona.
dialogsDecline.sw: You only care about yourself. Fine, I'll find someone else.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณสนใจแต่ตัวเองเท่านั้น ก็ได้ ฉันจะหาคนอื่น
dialogsDecline.tw: 果然是別人的事情，所以不想幫忙啊…好吧！我去找其他人來幫我好了！
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn chỉ quan tâm đến bản thân mình. Tốt thôi, tôi sẽ tìm người khác.

dialogsComplete.en: So they really do exist!
dialogsComplete.ar: So they really do exist!
dialogsComplete.br: Hmm? Então os ladrões realmente existem. Muito obrigado.
dialogsComplete.cns: 嗯?果然有强盗团啊!真的谢谢你啊!
dialogsComplete.de: Wie bitte? Es gibt die Diebe also wirklich. Ich danke dir vielmals.
dialogsComplete.fi: Joten ne ovat todella olemassa!
dialogsComplete.fil: So they really do exist!
dialogsComplete.fr: Alors ?! Oh donc ces voleurs Big Bang existent bien ! Merci beaucoup..
dialogsComplete.id: Jadi mereka benar-benar ada!
dialogsComplete.it: So they really do exist!
dialogsComplete.jp: なるほど。やはり盗賊団はいるんだな。ありがとう！感謝するよ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 도적단이 정말 있었군요!
dialogsComplete.nl: So they really do exist!
dialogsComplete.pl: So they really do exist!
dialogsComplete.ru: Ого! Выходит, у нас и правда воры завелись.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Así que existen de verdad!
dialogsComplete.sw: So they really do exist!
dialogsComplete.th: พวกมันมีอยู่จริงๆ!
dialogsComplete.tw: 嗯？果然有竊盜團啊！真的謝謝你啊！
dialogsComplete.vi: Vì vậy, họ thực sự tồn tại!

dialogsFail.en: I think this is good evidence, but... I want something more conclusive!
dialogsFail.ar: I think this is good evidence, but... I want something more conclusive!
dialogsFail.br: Eu acho que é uma boa prova, mas.. Eu quero algo mais conclusivo!
dialogsFail.cns: 嗯..虽然这是一个不错的证据，但是我需要更详细一点的证据。
dialogsFail.de: Meiner Meinung nach sind das starke Beweise, aber.. ich möchte noch mehr!
dialogsFail.fi: I think this is good evidence, but... I want something more conclusive!
dialogsFail.fil: I think this is good evidence, but... I want something more conclusive!
dialogsFail.fr: C'est une bonne preuve, mais. je veux du concret !
dialogsFail.id: Aku pikir ini adalah bukti yang bagus, tapi... Aku ingin sesuatu yang lebih meyakinkan!
dialogsFail.it: I think this is good evidence, but... I want something more conclusive!
dialogsFail.jp: これも証拠にはなるが、もっと決め手になる証拠がほしい。悪いがまた探してきてくれないか？
dialogsFail.kr: 괜찮긴 하지만… 조금 더 확실한 증거가 있었으면 좋겠어요!
dialogsFail.nl: I think this is good evidence, but... I want something more conclusive!
dialogsFail.pl: I think this is good evidence, but... I want something more conclusive!
dialogsFail.ru: Я же говорил: я тебе верю, и все же с доказательствами мне спокойнее было бы.
dialogsFail.sp: Creo que esta es una buena prueba, pero... ¡Quiero algo más concluyente!
dialogsFail.sw: I think this is good evidence, but... I want something more conclusive!
dialogsFail.th: ฉันคิดว่านี่เป็นหลักฐานที่ดี แต่... ฉันต้องการข้อสรุปมากกว่านี้!
dialogsFail.tw: 嗯…雖然這是一個不錯的證據，但是我需要更詳細一點的證據。
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi nghĩ đây là bằng chứng xác đáng, nhưng ... tôi muốn có điều gì đó thuyết phục hơn!

description.en: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones, 5 Peakyrinds and 1 Slain then deliver them to Acrobat Master Pyre near the Darken City Quest Office.
description.ar: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones, 5 Peakyrinds and 1 Slain then deliver them to Acrobat Master Pyre near the Darken City Quest Office.
description.br: Obtenha 10 Pedras Cintilantes, 5 Peakyrinds e 1 Canino e entregue-os para o Mestre Acrobata Pyre perto da Central de Quest da cidade Darken.
description.cns: 搜集10个发光石，5个坚硬贝壳和一个狼趾甲，然后交给在达肯任务委托所旁边的弓箭手大师飞蕊。
description.de: Sammle 10 Twinkle Stone, 5 Peakyrind und 1 Slain. Bring diese Gegenstände anschließend zu [Acrobat Meister] Pyre in Darkon City.
description.fi: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones, 5 Peakyrinds and 1 Slain then deliver them to Acrobat Master Pyre near the Darken City Quest Office.
description.fil: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones, 5 Peakyrinds and 1 Slain then deliver them to Acrobat Master Pyre near the Darken City Quest Office.
description.fr: Collecter 10 Pierres Brillantes sur les Aibatts, 5 Carapaces sur des Peakyturtles et 1 Griffe sur un Lawolf puis les rapporter au Maître des Acrobates Pyre à Flarine Nord.
description.id: Kumpulkan 10 Twinkle Stones, 5 Peakyrinds dan 1 Slain lalu kirimkan ke Acrobat Master Pyre di dekat Darken City Quest Office.
description.it: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones, 5 Peakyrinds and 1 Slain then deliver them to Acrobat Master Pyre near the Darken City Quest Office.
description.jp: 輝く石10個を集めて、アクロバットマスターの＜ピレ＞に行こう。＜ピレ＞は依頼所近くにいるそうだ。
description.kr: 반짝이는 돌 10개, 피키린드 5개, 슬레인 1개를 수집하여 다켄 시티 퀘스트 의뢰소 근처에 있는 아크로뱃 마스터 파이어에게 가져가세요.
description.nl: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones, 5 Peakyrinds and 1 Slain then deliver them to Acrobat Master Pyre near the Darken City Quest Office.
description.pl: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones, 5 Peakyrinds and 1 Slain then deliver them to Acrobat Master Pyre near the Darken City Quest Office.
description.ru: Нужно собрать 10 мерцающих камней, 5 осколков панциря и 1 клык и отнести их магистру акробатов Пайру. Он где-то неподалеку от даркенбуржского бюро помощи.
description.sp: Consigue 10 Piedras Centelleantes, 5 Peakyrinds y 1 Slain y entrégaselos al Maestro Acrobat Pyre cerca de la Oficina de Misiones de Darken.
description.sw: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones, 5 Peakyrinds and 1 Slain then deliver them to Acrobat Master Pyre near the Darken City Quest Office.
description.th: รวบรวม 10 Twinkle Stones และส่งให้กับ Acrobat Master Pyre ใกล้ๆ กับ Quest Office ในเมือง Darken City
description.tw: 收集 10 個閃耀石、5 個尖刺犰狳硬皮和 1 個賤狼指甲，然後交給得肯城委託事務所附近的雜技大師飛蕊。
description.vi: Thu thập 10 Twinkle Stones, 5 Peakyrinds và 1 Slain sau đó giao chúng cho Acrobat Master Pyre gần Văn phòng Nhiệm vụ Thành phố Darken.

dialogsBegin.en: Now it's time for the next step on your path to becoming an Acrobat.
dialogsBegin.ar: Now it's time for the next step on your path to becoming an Acrobat.
dialogsBegin.br: Parabéns! Agora é o momento do próximo passo em seu treinamento.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你已经通过第一个测试了，辛苦你了！好，现在开始要进行第2个测试了！
dialogsBegin.de: Es ist Zeit für den nächsten Schritt auf deinem Pfad zum Acrobat.
dialogsBegin.fi: Now it's time for the next step on your path to becoming an Acrobat.
dialogsBegin.fil: Now it's time for the next step on your path to becoming an Acrobat.
dialogsBegin.fr: Bien joué. Maintenant passons à la prochaine étape de ton entraînement.
dialogsBegin.id: Sekarang saatnya untuk langkah selanjutnya di jalanmu untuk menjadi seorang Acrobat.
dialogsBegin.it: Now it's time for the next step on your path to becoming an Acrobat.
dialogsBegin.jp: 諸君、ご苦労だった！これから諸君に次の訓練を指示する。
dialogsBegin.kr: 아크로뱃이 되기 위한 다음 단계로 넘어갈 차례군요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Now it's time for the next step on your path to becoming an Acrobat.
dialogsBegin.pl: Now it's time for the next step on your path to becoming an Acrobat.
dialogsBegin.ru: Ну что ж, перейдем к следующему этапу твоего обучения акробатике.
dialogsBegin.sp: Es el momento de dar el siguiente paso en tu camino para convertirte en Acrobat.
dialogsBegin.sw: Now it's time for the next step on your path to becoming an Acrobat.
dialogsBegin.th: ตอนนี้ก็ถึงเวลาสำหรับขั้นตอนต่อไปในเส้นทางของคุณในการเป็น Acrobat
dialogsBegin.tw: 你已經通過第一個測試了，辛苦你了！好，現在開始要進行第 2 個測試了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bây giờ là bước tiếp theo trên con đường trở thành một Acrobat của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: I want you to return to collect 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts in the area, 5 Peakyrinds from Peakyturtles and 1 Slain from Lawolf.

dialogsBegin.cns: I want you to return to collect 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts in the area, 5 Peakyrinds from Peakyturtles and 1 Slain from Lawolf.
dialogsBegin.de: Ich möchte, dass du nach Flaris zurückkehrst und 10 Twinkle Stone von den Aibatt, 5 Peakyrind von den Peakyturtle und 1 Slain von den Lawolf sammelst.
dialogsBegin.fi: I want you to return to collect 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts in the area, 5 Peakyrinds from Peakyturtles and 1 Slain from Lawolf.
dialogsBegin.fil: I want you to return to collect 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts in the area, 5 Peakyrinds from Peakyturtles and 1 Slain from Lawolf.
dialogsBegin.fr: J'aimerais que tu collectes quelques matériaux : 10 Pierres Brillantes sur les Aibatts, 5 Carapaces de Peakyturtles et 1 Griffe de Lawolf.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku ingin kamu kembali untuk mengumpulkan 10 Twinkle Stones dari Aibatts di area, 5 Peakyrinds dari Peakyturtles dan 1 Slain dari Lawolf.
dialogsBegin.it: I want you to return to collect 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts in the area, 5 Peakyrinds from Peakyturtles and 1 Slain from Lawolf.
dialogsBegin.jp: エリア内のアイバットからトゥインクル ストーンを 10 個、ピーキータートルズからピーキリンドを 5 個、ラウルフからスレインを 1 個集めに戻ってほしい。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그곳에 있는 아이바트에게서 반짝이는 돌 10개, 피키터틀에게서 피키린드 5개, 로울프에게서 슬레인 1개를 수집해 돌아오세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I want you to return to collect 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts in the area, 5 Peakyrinds from Peakyturtles and 1 Slain from Lawolf.
dialogsBegin.pl: I want you to return to collect 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts in the area, 5 Peakyrinds from Peakyturtles and 1 Slain from Lawolf.
dialogsBegin.ru: I want you to return to collect 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts in the area, 5 Peakyrinds from Peakyturtles and 1 Slain from Lawolf.
dialogsBegin.sp: Quiero que vuelvas a recoger 10 Pidra Centelleante de Aibatts, 5 Peakyrinds de Tortugapico y 1 Slain de Lawolf.
dialogsBegin.sw: I want you to return to collect 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts in the area, 5 Peakyrinds from Peakyturtles and 1 Slain from Lawolf.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันต้องการให้คุณกลับไปเก็บ Twinkle Stones 10 ชิ้น จาก Aibatts ในพื้นที่, Peakyrinds 5 ชิ้น จาก Peakyturtles และ Slain 1 ชิ้น จาก Lawolf
dialogsBegin.tw: 我要你回來，從該地區的獨眼蝙蝠那裡收集 10 個閃耀石，從尖刺犰狳那裡收集 5 個尖刺犰狳硬皮，從布魯狼那裡收集 1 個賤狼指甲。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi muốn bạn quay trở lại và thu thập 10 Twinkle Stones từ Aibatts trong khu vực, 5 viên Peakyrinds từ Peakyturtles và 1 Slain từ Lawolf.

dialogsBegin.en: Once you've gathered the Twinkle Stones, bring them to Pyre in the north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.ar: Once you've gathered the Twinkle Stones, bring them to Pyre in the north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.br: Então vá e encontre Pyre, o Mestre Acrobata, e leve os itens para ele. Pyre está ao norte de Flarine, você pode encontrá-lo facilmente.
dialogsBegin.cns: 收集完足够的发光石就把它们带给飞蕊吧，他就在帕里北广场。
dialogsBegin.de: Sobald ihr die Twinkle Stones gesammelt habt, bringt sie zu Pyre im Norden von Flaris.
dialogsBegin.fi: Once you've gathered the Twinkle Stones, bring them to Pyre in the north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.fil: Once you've gathered the Twinkle Stones, bring them to Pyre in the north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.fr: Cherche ensuite Pyre, le Maître des Acrobates, et ramène-lui ces objets. Tu le trouveras au nord de Flarine.
dialogsBegin.id: Setelah kamu mengumpulkan Twinkle Stones, bawa ke Pyre di utara Flarine.
dialogsBegin.it: Once you've gathered the Twinkle Stones, bring them to Pyre in the north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.jp: トゥインクルストーンを集めたら、フラリーンの北にあるパイアに持っていきましょう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 반짝이는 돌을 모아, 플라리네 북부에 있는 파이어에게 가져가세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Once you've gathered the Twinkle Stones, bring them to Pyre in the north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.pl: Once you've gathered the Twinkle Stones, bring them to Pyre in the north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.ru: Once you've gathered the Twinkle Stones, bring them to Pyre in the north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.sp: Una vez que hayas reunido las Piedras Centelleantes, llévaselas a Pyre en el Norte de Flarine.
dialogsBegin.sw: Once you've gathered the Twinkle Stones, bring them to Pyre in the north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.th: หลังจากที่คุณได้รวบรวม Twinkle Stones แล้วนำสิ่งเหล่านั้นไปที่ Pyre ในทางตอนเหนือของ Flarine.
dialogsBegin.tw: 收集完閃耀之石後，將它們帶到布拉里斯北部的飛蕊。
dialogsBegin.vi: Khi bạn đã thu thập được các Twinkle Stones, hãy mang chúng đến Pyre tại phía bắc Flarine.

dialogsAccept.en: Good luck! You're going to need it!
dialogsAccept.ar: حظا موفقا! سوف تحتاجها!
dialogsAccept.br: Boa sorte! Você vai precisar!
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你一路顺风喔～
dialogsAccept.de: Viel Glück! Du wirst es brauchen.
dialogsAccept.fi: Good luck! You're going to need it!
dialogsAccept.fil: Good luck! You're going to need it!
dialogsAccept.fr: Bonne chance dans ta quête !
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga beruntung! Kamu akan membutuhkannya!
dialogsAccept.it: Good luck! You're going to need it!
dialogsAccept.jp: では諸君、健闘を祈る！
dialogsAccept.kr: 꽤 고생할 수도 있지만, 행운을 빌어요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Good luck! You're going to need it!
dialogsAccept.pl: Good luck! You're going to need it!
dialogsAccept.ru: Удачи! Она тебе пригодится!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Buena suerte! ¡La vas a necesitar!
dialogsAccept.sw: Good luck! You're going to need it!
dialogsAccept.th: โชคดี! คุณจะต้องใช้มัน!
dialogsAccept.tw: 祝你一路順風喔～
dialogsAccept.vi: Chúc may mắn! Bạn sẽ cần nó!

dialogsDecline.en: You must like being a Vagrant. It would certainly be a shame if you quit now. I'll be here if you have a change of heart.
dialogsDecline.ar: You must like being a Vagrant. It would certainly be a shame if you quit now. I'll be here if you have a change of heart.
dialogsDecline.br: Você deve gostar de ser um Vagrant. Certamente seria uma pena se você desistisse agora. Eu estarei aqui se você mudar de ideia.
dialogsDecline.cns: 你要继续当初心者吗？如果你这么觉得初心者好的话，我也没意见啦！可是、你要记住机会是很难得的喔！
dialogsDecline.de: Du magst es wohl ein Vagrant zu sein? Es wäre eine Schande, wenn du jetzt aufgibst. Ich werde hier sein, falls du deine Meinung änderst.
dialogsDecline.fi: You must like being a Vagrant. It would certainly be a shame if you quit now. I'll be here if you have a change of heart.
dialogsDecline.fil: You must like being a Vagrant. It would certainly be a shame if you quit now. I'll be here if you have a change of heart.
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu aimes être un Vagabond ? Alors je ne veux pas te forcer... Mais il ne te sera pas facile de retrouver une telle opportunité.
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu pasti suka menjadi seorang Vagrant. Tentu akan sangat disayangkan jika kamu berhenti sekarang. Aku akan berada di sini jika kamu berubah pikiran.
dialogsDecline.it: You must like being a Vagrant. It would certainly be a shame if you quit now. I'll be here if you have a change of heart.
dialogsDecline.jp: 諸君はそれほどまでに放浪者が気に入っているのか？　ならば転職を強要するつもりはない。だが、己を鍛えるチャンスというものはなかなか見つからないものだぞ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 방랑자로 사는 게 꽤 마음에 드시나 보네요? 지금 그만두기엔 아쉽지 않아요? 마음이 바뀌면 언제든지 다시 오세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: You must like being a Vagrant. It would certainly be a shame if you quit now. I'll be here if you have a change of heart.
dialogsDecline.pl: You must like being a Vagrant. It would certainly be a shame if you quit now. I'll be here if you have a change of heart.
dialogsDecline.ru: Неужто хочешь всю жизнь прожить бродягой? Если передумаешь, я буду здесь.
dialogsDecline.sp: Debe gustarte ser un Vagrant. Sin duda, sería una pena que renunciaras ahora. Estaré aquí si cambias de opinión.
dialogsDecline.sw: You must like being a Vagrant. It would certainly be a shame if you quit now. I'll be here if you have a change of heart.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณต้องชอบที่เป็น Vagrant มันคงน่าเสียดายถ้าคุณจะเลิกตอนนี้ ฉันจะอยู่ที่นี่ถ้าคุณเปลี่ยนใจ
dialogsDecline.tw: 你要繼續當見習生嗎？如果你這麼覺得見習生好的話，我也沒意見啦！可是、你要記住機會是很難得的喔！
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn phải thích trở thành một Vagrant. Chắc chắn sẽ rất tiếc nếu bạn từ bỏ lúc này. Tôi sẽ ở đây nếu bạn thay đổi suy nghĩ.

dialogsComplete.en: Thank you for the Twinkle Stones, Apprentice. I will cover Acrobat weaponry with you now. Acrobats are able to wield both Bows and Yo-Yos.
dialogsComplete.ar: Thank you for the Twinkle Stones, Apprentice. I will cover Acrobat weaponry with you now. Acrobats are able to wield both Bows and Yo-Yos.
dialogsComplete.br: Já que você me trouxe estes itens, parece que você passou no primeiro teste. Agora lhe direi sobre as armas. Acrobatas usam 2 armas, o arco e o ioiô.
dialogsComplete.cns: 呵呵...看你拿这些东西来，这代表你已经通过训练了，我告诉你关于武器的事情好了。弓箭手的武器有2种，一种是飞轮、另一种是弓箭。
dialogsComplete.de: Danke für die Gegenstände, Neuling. Ich werde dich nun über die Waffen der Acrobat aufklären. Sie können sowohl den Bogen, als auch das Yo-Yo tragen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Thank you for the Twinkle Stones, Apprentice. I will cover Acrobat weaponry with you now. Acrobats are able to wield both Bows and Yo-Yos.
dialogsComplete.fil: Thank you for the Twinkle Stones, Apprentice. I will cover Acrobat weaponry with you now. Acrobats are able to wield both Bows and Yo-Yos.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tu as passé le test avec succès. Je vais te parler des armes maintenant : les Acrobates utilisent 2 types d'armes, les arcs et les yo-yos.
dialogsComplete.id: Terima kasih untuk Twinkle Stones, Apprentice. Aku akan menutupi persenjataan Acrobat denganmu sekarang. Acrobat dapat menggunakan Bows dan Yo-Yos.
dialogsComplete.it: Thank you for the Twinkle Stones, Apprentice. I will cover Acrobat weaponry with you now. Acrobats are able to wield both Bows and Yo-Yos.
dialogsComplete.jp: ほっほう～、私の元に来たということは、初めての訓練は無事パスしたらしいのう。では、武器のことを教えてしんぜよう。アクロバットはボウとヨーヨーという二つの武器を使うのじゃ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 반짝이는 돌을 가져와 주셔서 고마워요. 이제 아크로뱃 무기에 대해 알려 드릴게요. 아크로뱃은 활과 요요, 두 가지 무기를 사용할 수 있어요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Thank you for the Twinkle Stones, Apprentice. I will cover Acrobat weaponry with you now. Acrobats are able to wield both Bows and Yo-Yos.
dialogsComplete.pl: Thank you for the Twinkle Stones, Apprentice. I will cover Acrobat weaponry with you now. Acrobats are able to wield both Bows and Yo-Yos.
dialogsComplete.ru: Один… два… три… десять. Отлично. Сейчас мы с тобой займемся оружием акробата. Как известно, мы можем пользоваться и луками, и йо-йо.
dialogsComplete.sp: Gracias por las Piedras Centelleantes, Aprendiz. Te enseñaré sobre las armas de Acrobat. Los Acrobats son capaces de utilizar los Arcos y los Yo-Yos.
dialogsComplete.sw: Thank you for the Twinkle Stones, Apprentice. I will cover Acrobat weaponry with you now. Acrobats are able to wield both Bows and Yo-Yos.
dialogsComplete.th: ขอขอบคุณสำหรับ Twinkle Stones เด็กฝึกหัด ตอนนี้ฉันจะมาพร้อมกับอาวุธของ Acrobat Acrobat สามารถใช้ได้ทั้ง Bows และ Yo-Yos
dialogsComplete.tw: 呵呵…看你拿這些東西來，這代表你已經通過訓練了，我告訴你關於武器的事情好了。雜技師的武器有 2 種，一種是溜刃、另一種是弓箭。
dialogsComplete.vi: Cảm ơn bạn vì Twinkle Stones, Người tập sự. Tôi sẽ trang bị vũ khí Acrobat với bạn ngay bây giờ. Acrobats có thể sử dụng cả Cung và Yo-Yos.

dialogsComplete.en: Bows are long range weapons that consume arrows for each shot. The strength of the basic shot is determined by how long you wait before releasing the arrow.
dialogsComplete.ar: Bows are long range weapons that consume arrows for each shot. The strength of the basic shot is determined by how long you wait before releasing the arrow.
dialogsComplete.br: O Arco é uma arma de longo alcance que consome 1 flecha por cada ataque. A força do tiro básico é determinada pelo tempo que você espera antes de soltar a flecha.
dialogsComplete.cns: 弓箭是远程攻击武器，每一次射击都要消耗弓箭。基础射击的伤害取决于你释放攻击前的蓄力时间。
dialogsComplete.de: Der Bogen ist eine Distanzwaffe, der für jeden Schuss einen Pfeil verbraucht. Die Stärke vom Grundschuss hängt davon ab, wie lange man den Bogen spannt.
dialogsComplete.fi: Bows are long range weapons that consume arrows for each shot. The strength of the basic shot is determined by how long you wait before releasing the arrow.
dialogsComplete.fil: Bows are long range weapons that consume arrows for each shot. The strength of the basic shot is determined by how long you wait before releasing the arrow.
dialogsComplete.fr: L'arc est une arme d'attaque à distance qui utilise des flèches. La puissance de l'attaque dépend du temps que tu attendras avant de relâcher la corde de ton arc.
dialogsComplete.id: Bows adalah senjata jarak jauh yang menggunakan panah untuk setiap tembakan. Kekuatan tembakan dasar ditentukan oleh berapa lama kamu menunggu sebelum melepaskan panah.
dialogsComplete.it: Bows are long range weapons that consume arrows for each shot. The strength of the basic shot is determined by how long you wait before releasing the arrow.
dialogsComplete.jp: ボウは遠距離攻撃武器で、弓を一度に1個ずつ使うのじゃ。攻撃方式は1から4段階に分けられ、段階が上がるほど敵に与える打撃もまた上がるのじゃ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 활은 원거리 무기로, 한 번 쏠 때마다 화살을 소모해요. 기본 사격의 위력은 화살을 얼마나 오래 당겼느냐에 따라 결정되죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: Bows are long range weapons that consume arrows for each shot. The strength of the basic shot is determined by how long you wait before releasing the arrow.
dialogsComplete.pl: Bows are long range weapons that consume arrows for each shot. The strength of the basic shot is determined by how long you wait before releasing the arrow.
dialogsComplete.ru: Лук - оружие дальнего боя. При каждом выстреле расходуются стрелы. Сила выстрела зависит от того, как долго натягивать тетиву.
dialogsComplete.sp: Los Arcos son armas de larga distancia que consumen flechas por cada disparo. La fuerza del tiro básico esta determinado por el tiempo de carga antes de soltar la flecha.
dialogsComplete.sw: Bows are long range weapons that consume arrows for each shot. The strength of the basic shot is determined by how long you wait before releasing the arrow.
dialogsComplete.th: ธนูเป็นอาวุธระยะไกลที่ใช้ลูกศรสำหรับการยิงแต่ละครั้ง ความแรงของการยิงขั้นพื้นฐานจะพิจารณาจากระยะเวลาที่คุณรอก่อนปล่อยลูกศร
dialogsComplete.tw: 弓箭是當你使用一次就會消耗一根箭。攻擊方式是第一階段到第四階段，階段越高攻擊力就越高了。
dialogsComplete.vi: Cung tên là vũ khí tầm xa tiêu hao mũi tên cho mỗi lần bắn. Độ mạnh của 1 phát bắn cơ bản được xác định bằng cách bạn đợi bao lâu trước khi thả mũi tên.

dialogsComplete.en: Yo-Yos are also long range weapons. However, the strength of the basic attack only changes depending on special skills used in conjunction with them.
dialogsComplete.ar: Yo-Yos are also long range weapons. However, the strength of the basic attack only changes depending on special skills used in conjunction with them.
dialogsComplete.br: Ioiôs são discos duplos que você pode segurar. O ataque é esplêndido, mas não há estágios de ataque. E então, o que você acha?
dialogsComplete.cns: 飞轮是可以双手使用，虽然没有阶段性的攻击，可是是一个很轻巧的武器喔～这样懂了吗？
dialogsComplete.de: Das Yo-Yo ist ebenfalls eine Distanzwaffe. Allerdings hängt die Stärke der Basisangriffe von den speziellen Fähigkeiten ab, die du in Kombination damit verwendest.
dialogsComplete.fi: Yo-Yos are also long range weapons. However, the strength of the basic attack only changes depending on special skills used in conjunction with them.
dialogsComplete.fil: Yo-Yos are also long range weapons. However, the strength of the basic attack only changes depending on special skills used in conjunction with them.
dialogsComplete.fr: Les yo-yos sont deux disques, tu peux en prendre un dans chaque main et attaquer avec les deux.
dialogsComplete.id: Yo-Yos juga merupakan senjata jarak jauh. Namun, kekuatan serangan dasar hanya berubah tergantung pada keterampilan khusus yang digunakan bersama dengan mereka.
dialogsComplete.it: Yo-Yos are also long range weapons. However, the strength of the basic attack only changes depending on special skills used in conjunction with them.
dialogsComplete.jp: ヨーヨーは双原盤の形で、両手に装着して攻撃するのじゃ。段階的な攻撃方式はないが、そのユニークな攻撃形はカッコイイのじゃ。どうじゃ、イカスじゃろう？
dialogsComplete.kr: 요요도 원거리 무기예요. 다만, 기본 공격력은 함께 사용하는 특수 스킬에 따라 달라지곤 하죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: Yo-Yos are also long range weapons. However, the strength of the basic attack only changes depending on special skills used in conjunction with them.
dialogsComplete.pl: Yo-Yos are also long range weapons. However, the strength of the basic attack only changes depending on special skills used in conjunction with them.
dialogsComplete.ru: Йо-йо - тоже оружие дальнего боя. Но сила удара меняется только при использовании дополнительных умений.
dialogsComplete.sp: Los Yo-Yos también son armas de larga distancia. Sin embargo, la fuerza de ataque básico cambia dependiendo de las habilidades especiales que se utilizan en combinación.
dialogsComplete.sw: Yo-Yos are also long range weapons. However, the strength of the basic attack only changes depending on special skills used in conjunction with them.
dialogsComplete.th: Yo-Yos ก็เป็นอาวุธระยะไกล อย่างไรก็ตามความแรงของการโจมตีขั้นพื้นฐานจะเปลี่ยนแปลงไปขึ้นอยู่กับทักษะพิเศษที่ใช้ร่วมกัน
dialogsComplete.tw: 溜刃是可以雙手使用，雖然沒有階段性的攻擊，可是是一個很輕巧的武器喔～這樣懂了嗎？
dialogsComplete.vi: Yo-Yos cũng là vũ khí tầm xa. Tuy nhiên, sức mạnh của đòn tấn công cơ bản chỉ thay đổi tùy thuộc vào các kỹ năng đặc biệt được sử dụng kết hợp với chúng.

dialogsFail.en: If you met with Hent, then you should probably have something for me, hmm?
dialogsFail.ar: If you met with Hent, then you should probably have something for me, hmm?
dialogsFail.br: Acho que você deveria me trazer algo se por acaso encontrar o Hent. Ele deveria lhe dizer alguma coisa. Hmm...
dialogsFail.cns: 嗯？你没有东西要给我吗？“亨特”没请你拿东西给我吗？
dialogsFail.de: Triff dich mit Hent. Er sollte dir etwas für mich mitgeben.
dialogsFail.fi: If you met with Hent, then you should probably have something for me, hmm?
dialogsFail.fil: If you met with Hent, then you should probably have something for me, hmm?
dialogsFail.fr: Je pense que tu as quelque chose pour moi si tu as rencontré Hent.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu bertemu dengan Hent, maka kamu mungkin harus memiliki sesuatu untukku, hmm?
dialogsFail.it: If you met with Hent, then you should probably have something for me, hmm?
dialogsFail.jp: むむ・・・？　何にも持ってきてないのじゃ。＜ヘント＞にきっと何か指示されたはずなのに・・・むむう・・・
dialogsFail.kr: 헨트를 만났다면, 제게 줄 무언가를 받지 않으셨어요, 흐음?
dialogsFail.nl: If you met with Hent, then you should probably have something for me, hmm?
dialogsFail.pl: If you met with Hent, then you should probably have something for me, hmm?
dialogsFail.ru: Брендис наверняка говорил тебе, какую плату я беру за обучение, да?
dialogsFail.sp: Si te has reunido con Hent, probablemente tengas algo para mí, ¿hmm?
dialogsFail.sw: If you met with Hent, then you should probably have something for me, hmm?
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณได้พบกับ Hent แล้วคุณอาจจะมีบางอย่างสำหรับฉัน หืมมม?
dialogsFail.tw: 嗯？你沒有東西要給我嗎？涵特沒請你拿東西給嗎？
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn gặp Hent, thì bạn có lẽ nên có một cái gì đó cho tôi, hmm?

description.de: Sammle 30 Blood Trillipy Shells von den Bloody Trillipy und töte 3 Mutant Keakoon Workers.
description.fi: Collect 30 Blood Trillipy Shells from the Bloody Trillipy and kill 3 Mutant Keakoon Workers.
description.fil: Mangolekta ng 30 Blood Trillipy Shells mula sa Bloody Trillipy at pumatay ng 3 Mutant Keakoon Worker.
description.fr: Récupère 30 butins sur les Trillipy Sanguin et tue 3 Ouvriers Keakoon Mutant.
description.id: Kumpulkan 30 Blood Trillipy Shells dari Bloody Trilipy dan bunuh 3 Mutant Keakoon Workers.
description.it: Collect 30 Blood Trillipy Shells from the Bloody Trillipy and kill 3 Mutant Keakoon Workers.
description.jp: ＜へジャード血のトリルピ＞を30個集め＜ゲリラ・キクンワーカー＞を3体討伐しよう。
description.kr: 블러드 트릴리피에게서 블러드 트릴리피 껍데기 30개를 수집하고, 변종 키쿤 일꾼 3마리를 처치하세요.
description.nl: Collect 30 Blood Trillipy Shells from the Bloody Trillipy and kill 3 Mutant Keakoon Workers.
description.pl: Zbierz 30 łupów z Bloody Trilipy i zabij 3 Mutant Keakoon Workers.
description.ru: Собери 30 панцирей кровавых хватоглотов и убей 3 мутировавших рабочих-свинов.
description.sp: Recoge 30 Conchas de Trillipy Sangriento y mata 3 Trabajadores Keakoon Mutantes.
description.sw: Collect 30 Blood Trillipy Shells from the Bloody Trillipy and kill 3 Mutant Keakoon Workers.
description.th: รวบรวมของ 30 Blood Shells จาก Bloody Trilipy และสังหาร Mutant Keakoon Workers 30 ตัว
description.tw: 從噬血蜈蚣身上收集 30 件背甲並殺死 3 名模範奇昆工頭。
description.vi: Thu thập 30 Blood Trillipy Shells từ Bloody Trilipy và giết 3 Mutant Keakoon Workers.

dialogsBegin.en: Hello, if you're here it's because you've defeated all the known monsters in the mine. I'm Dekane, the creator of this mine. Now that you've proven yourself, I'll be able to tell you the real problem that lies at the bottom of the mine. In a secret room sleep dragons from ancient times created by Shade ages ago.
dialogsBegin.ar: Hello, if you're here it's because you've defeated all the known monsters in the mine. I'm Dekane, the creator of this mine. Now that you've proven yourself, I'll be able to tell you the real problem that lies at the bottom of the mine. In a secret room sleep dragons from ancient times created by Shade ages ago.
dialogsBegin.br: Olá, se você está aqui é porque derrotou todos os monstros conhecidos da mina. Sou Dekane, o criador desta mina. Agora que você provou seu valor, poderei lhe contar o verdadeiro problema que está no fundo da mina. Em uma sala secreta, dormem dragões dos tempos antigos criados por Shade há tempos atrás.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你好，你能出现在这里，说明你已经击败了矿洞中所有的怪物。我是德卡内，这个矿洞的开拓者。既然你已经证明了自己，我就可以告诉你矿洞深处的真相了——神秘房间里沉睡着远古时代由谢莉德创造的龙。
dialogsBegin.de: Hallo, du bist sicherlich hier, weil du alle uns bekannten Monster in der Mine besiegt hast. Ich bin Dekane, der Erbauer dieser Mine. Nun, da du dich bewiesen hast, werde ich dir vom wahren Problem erzählen, das sich am tiefsten Punkt der Mine befindet. In einem geheimen Raum schlafen Drachen aus uralter Zeit, die vor ewigen Jahren von Shade erschaffen wurden.
dialogsBegin.fi: Hello, if you're here it's because you've defeated all the known monsters in the mine. I'm Dekane, the creator of this mine. Now that you've proven yourself, I'll be able to tell you the real problem that lies at the bottom of the mine. In a secret room sleep dragons from ancient times created by Shade ages ago.
dialogsBegin.fil: Hello, kung nandito ka ibig sabihin natalo mo na ang lahat ng kilalang halimaw sa mina. Ako si Dekane, ang gumawa ng minahang ito. Ngayon na napatunayan mo na ang sarili mo, masasabi ko na sa'yo ang totoong problema na nasa kailaliman ng mina. Sa isang lihim na silid natutulog ang mga dragon mula pa sa sinaunang panahon na nilikha ni Shade noon.
dialogsBegin.fr: Bonjour, si tu es là, c'est que tu as vaincu tous les monstres connus de la mine. Je suis Dekane, le créateur de cette mine. Maintenant que tu as fait tes preuves, je vais pouvoir te révéler le véritable problème qui se cache au fond de la mine. Dans une salle secrète sommeillent des dragons des temps anciens, créés par Shade il y a des lustres.
dialogsBegin.id: Halo, jika kamu di sini, itu karena kamu telah mengalahkan semua monster yang dikenal di tambang. Aku Dekane, pencipta tambang ini. Sekarang setelah kamu membuktikan diri, aku akan memberi tahu kamu masalah sebenarnya yang ada di dasar tambang. Di ruang rahasia naga tidur dari zaman kuno yang diciptakan oleh Shade berabad-abad yang lalu.
dialogsBegin.it: Hello, if you're here it's because you've defeated all the known monsters in the mine. I'm Dekane, the creator of this mine. Now that you've proven yourself, I'll be able to tell you the real problem that lies at the bottom of the mine. In a secret room sleep dragons from ancient times created by Shade ages ago.
dialogsBegin.jp: よくぞきた。君がここにいるということは、鉱山に潜むすべてモンスターを倒したからだろう。私はこの鉱山を作ったデェカネスだ。さて、君の実力を証明したところで、地底深き鉱山に潜む「本当の問題」を教えてあげよう。とある部屋には、昔シェイドが作った古代のドラゴンが眠っているそうだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 안녕하세요. 여기까지 오셨다는 건 광산에 있는 모든 몬스터들을 해치웠다는 뜻이겠죠. 제 이름은 데카네, 이 광산을 만든 설립자입니다. 이제 자격이 충분하다는 걸 증명했으니, 광산 깊은 곳에 숨겨진 진짜 문제에 대해 말씀드릴 수 있겠네요. 이 광산 비밀의 방에는 쉐이드가 고대에 만들어 둔 드래곤들이 잠들어 있어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Hello, if you're here it's because you've defeated all the known monsters in the mine. I'm Dekane, the creator of this mine. Now that you've proven yourself, I'll be able to tell you the real problem that lies at the bottom of the mine. In a secret room sleep dragons from ancient times created by Shade ages ago.
dialogsBegin.pl: Witam, jeśli tu jesteś, to dlatego, że pokonałeś wszystkie znane potwory w kopalni. Jestem Dekane, twórca tej kopalni. Teraz, kiedy już się sprawdziłeś, będę mógł ci powiedzieć, jaki jest prawdziwy problem, który leży na dnie kopalni. W sekretnym pokoju śpią smoki z czasów starożytnych stworzone przez Shade wieki temu.
dialogsBegin.ru: Приветствую! Раз ты здесь, значит окрестности очищены от всех марионеток. Я Распад, создатель этой шахты. Ты доказал, чего стоишь, поэтому достоин рассказа о секретах этого места. В тайной комнате в глубинах шахты с самых древних времён спят драконы, когда-то созданные Тенью.
dialogsBegin.sp: Hola, si estás aquí es porque has derrotado a todos los monstruos conocidos en la mina. Soy Dekane, el creador de esta mina. Ahora que te has probado a ti mismo, podré decirte el verdadero problema que se encuentra en lo más profundo de la mina. En una habitación secreta duermen dragones de la antigüedad creados por Shade hace mucho tiempo.
dialogsBegin.sw: Hello, if you're here it's because you've defeated all the known monsters in the mine. I'm Dekane, the creator of this mine. Now that you've proven yourself, I'll be able to tell you the real problem that lies at the bottom of the mine. In a secret room sleep dragons from ancient times created by Shade ages ago.
dialogsBegin.th: สวัสดี ถ้าคุณมาอยู่ที่นี่ นั่นเป็นเพราะคุณเอาชนะสัตว์ประหลาดที่รู้จักทั้งหมดในเหมือง ฉันชื่อ Dekane ผู้สร้างเหมืองนี้ ตอนนี้คุณได้พิสูจน์ตัวเองแล้ว ฉันสามารถบอกคุณถึงปัญหาที่แท้จริงที่อยู่ก้นบึ้งของเหมือง ในห้องลับมังกรหลับจากสมัยโบราณที่ Shade สร้างขึ้นเมื่อหลายปีก่อน
dialogsBegin.tw: 你好，如果你在這裡，那是因為你已經擊敗了礦井中所有已知的怪物。我是德卡內，這個礦井的創造者。既然你已經證明了自己，我就可以告訴你礦井底部的真正問題。在一個秘密房間裡，沉睡於很久以前由陰影創造的遠古時代的龍。
dialogsBegin.vi: Xin chào, nếu bạn ở đây là vì bạn đã đánh bại tất cả những con quái vật đã biết trong hầm mỏ. Tôi là Dekane, người tạo ra cái hầm mỏ này. Bây giờ bạn đã chứng minh được bản thân, tôi sẽ có thể cho bạn biết vấn đề thực sự nằm ở đáy của hầm mỏ. Trong một căn phòng bí mật, những con rồng từ thời cổ đại được tạo ra bởi Shade từ nhiều năm trước.

dialogsBegin.en: To defeat them, you'll need a well-armed team. Ah, but there's one detail I forgot to mention. You'll need 1,000,000 Penya to open the door, but for now, collecting 30 Blood Trillipy Shells and defeating 3 Mutant Keakoon Workers will be enough. Are you ready to accept this challenge?
dialogsBegin.ar: To defeat them, you'll need a well-armed team. Ah, but there's one detail I forgot to mention. You'll need 1,000,000 Penya to open the door, but for now, collecting 30 Blood Trillipy Shells and defeating 3 Mutant Keakoon Workers will be enough. Are you ready to accept this challenge?
dialogsBegin.br: Para derrotá-los, você precisará de uma equipe bem armada. Ah, mas há um detalhe que esqueci de mencionar. Você precisará de 1.000.000 Penya para abrir a porta, mas por agora, coletar 30 Conchas de Trillipy Sangrento e derrotar 3 Trabalhadores Keakoon Mutantes será o suficiente. Você está pronto para aceitar este desafio?
dialogsBegin.cns: 要打败他们，你需要一支装备精良的队伍。哈，还有个细节：你需要 1,000,000 金币才能打开它的大门，但现在，30个血腥蜥蜴的战利品和3个奇昆模范劳工就足够了。你准备好接受这个挑战了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Um sie zu besiegen, brauchst du ein gut bewaffnetes Team. Ah, aber ein Detail habe ich vergessen zu erwähnen. Du brauchst 1.000.000 Penya, um die Tür zu öffnen, aber für den Moment reicht es aus, 30 Blood Trillipy Shells zu sammeln und 3 Mutant Keakoon Workers zu besiegen. Bist du bereit, diese Herausforderung anzunehmen?
dialogsBegin.fi: To defeat them, you'll need a well-armed team. Ah, but there's one detail I forgot to mention. You'll need 1,000,000 Penya to open the door, but for now, collecting 30 Blood Trillipy Shells and defeating 3 Mutant Keakoon Workers will be enough. Are you ready to accept this challenge?
dialogsBegin.fil: Para talunin sila, kakailanganin mo ng maayos na armadong koponan. Ah, may isang detalye akong nakalimutan banggitin. Kakailanganin mo ng 1,000,000 Penya para mabuksan ang pinto, pero sa ngayon, sapat na ang pagkuha ng 30 Blood Trillipy Shells at pagpatay ng 3 Mutant Keakoon Workers. Handang tanggapin ang hamon na ito?
dialogsBegin.fr: Pour les vaincre, il te faudra une équipe bien armée. Ah, mais il y a un détail que j'ai omis de préciser : il te faudra 1 000 000 de Penyas pour ouvrir la porte. Pour le moment, obtenir 30 butins de Trillipys sanguin et tuer 3 Ouvriers Keakoon Mutant suffira. Es-tu prêt à accepter ce défi ?
dialogsBegin.id: Untuk mengalahkan mereka, Anda membutuhkan tim yang bersenjata lengkap. Ah, tapi ada satu detail yang lupa saya sebutkan. Anda akan membutuhkan 1.000.000 Penya untuk membuka pintu, tetapi untuk saat ini, mengumpulkan 30 Blood Trillipy Shells dan mengalahkan 3 Mutant Keakoon Workers sudah cukup. Apakah Anda siap untuk menerima tantangan ini?
dialogsBegin.it: To defeat them, you'll need a well-armed team. Ah, but there's one detail I forgot to mention. You'll need 1,000,000 Penya to open the door, but for now, collecting 30 Blood Trillipy Shells and defeating 3 Mutant Keakoon Workers will be enough. Are you ready to accept this challenge?
dialogsBegin.jp: あいつらを倒すなら強化した装備が必要だろうな。あーそうそう、言い忘れてたわ。奥の扉を開けるには100万ペニャが必要だったんだよな～。まあでも、今ならへジャード血のトリルピを3個、ゲリラ・キクンワーカーを倒してきてくれたら十分だ。こんなお得な挑戦、受けない奴はおらんだろ？
dialogsBegin.kr: 처치하려면 잘 무장된 팀이 필요하겠어요. 아, 말씀드리는 걸 깜빡 잊었네요. 문을 열려면 1,000,000페냐가 필요하지만, 지금은 블러드 트릴리피 껍데기 30개를 수집하고 변종 키쿤 일꾼 3마리를 처치하는 정도로 충분합니다. 도전을 받아들이시겠어요?
dialogsBegin.nl: To defeat them, you'll need a well-armed team. Ah, but there's one detail I forgot to mention. You'll need 1,000,000 Penya to open the door, but for now, collecting 30 Blood Trillipy Shells and defeating 3 Mutant Keakoon Workers will be enough. Are you ready to accept this challenge?
dialogsBegin.pl: Aby ich pokonać, potrzebujesz dobrze uzbrojonej drużyny. Ach, ale jest jeden szczegół, o którym zapomniałem wspomnieć: do otwarcia drzwi potrzebujesz 1,000,000 Penyas, ale na razie wystarczy 30 blood Trillipys i 3 Keakoon Mutant Workers. Czy jesteś gotów podjąć to wyzwanie?
dialogsBegin.ru: Чтобы одолеть их, тебе понадобится хорошо вооружённая команда. Ах да, ещё одна деталь, которую я забыл упомянуть: чтобы открыть дверь, понадобится 1 000 000 Пенья. Но пока достаточно собрать 30 панцирей кровавых хватоглотов и убить 3 мутировавших рабочих-свинов. Готов принять вызов?
dialogsBegin.sp: Para derrotarlos, necesitarás un equipo bien armado. Ah, me olvidé mencionar un detalle. Necesitarás 1.000.000 de Penya para abrir la puerta, pero por ahora con recoger 30 Conchas de Trillipy Sangriento y derrotar 3 Trabajadores Keakoon Mutantes será suficiente. ¿Estás listo para aceptar este desafío?
dialogsBegin.sw: To defeat them, you'll need a well-armed team. Ah, but there's one detail I forgot to mention. You'll need 1,000,000 Penya to open the door, but for now, collecting 30 Blood Trillipy Shells and defeating 3 Mutant Keakoon Workers will be enough. Are you ready to accept this challenge?
dialogsBegin.th: เพื่อเอาชนะพวกมัน คุณจะต้องมีทีมติดอาวุธที่ดี อ้อ แต่มีรายละเอียดหนึ่งที่ฉันลืมพูดถึง: คุณจะต้องใช้ 1,000,000 Penyas เพื่อเปิดประตู แต่สำหรับตอนนี้แค่เก็บ 30 Blood Trillipy Shells และกำจัด Mutant Keakoon Workers 3 ตัว ก็เพียงพอแล้ว คุณพร้อมที่จะยอมรับความท้าทายนี้หรือไม่?
dialogsBegin.tw: 要打敗他們，你需要一支裝備精良的隊伍。啊，但是有一個細節我忘了說：你需要 1,000,000 金幣才能打開門，但現在，30 個噬血蜈蚣背甲和 3 個模範奇昆工頭就足夠了。你準備好接受這個挑戰了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Để đánh bại chúng, bạn sẽ cần một đội được vũ trang tốt. Ah, nhưng có một chi tiết tôi quên đề cập đến. Bạn sẽ cần 1.000.000 Penya để mở cửa, nhưng hiện tại, thu thập 30 Blood Trilipy Shells và đánh bại 3 Mutant Keakoon worker là đủ. Bạn đã sẵn sàng chấp nhận thử thách này chưa?

dialogsAccept.en: Good luck!
dialogsAccept.ar: Good luck!
dialogsAccept.br: Boa sorte!
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你好运！
dialogsAccept.de: Viel Glück!
dialogsAccept.fi: Good luck!
dialogsAccept.fil: Sana suwertehin ka!
dialogsAccept.fr: Bonne chance !
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga berhasil!
dialogsAccept.it: Good luck!
dialogsAccept.jp: では、頼んだぞ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 행운을 빌어요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Good luck!
dialogsAccept.pl: Powodzenia!
dialogsAccept.ru: Удачи!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Buena suerte!
dialogsAccept.sw: Good luck!
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้โชคดี!
dialogsAccept.tw: 好運！
dialogsAccept.vi: Chúc bạn may mắn!

dialogsDecline.en: It is true that this is not an easy thing for an adventurer. Come and try your luck again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.ar: It is true that this is not an easy thing for an adventurer. Come and try your luck again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.br: É verdade que isso não é uma coisa fácil para um aventureiro. Venha e tente a sua sorte novamente quando estiver pronto(a).
dialogsDecline.cns: 诚然，这对于冒险者来说并非易事。 准备好后再来试试吧。
dialogsDecline.de: Mir ist bewusst, dass es für einen Abenteurer keine leichte Sache ist.Komm wieder sobald du bereit dafür bist.
dialogsDecline.fi: It is true that this is not an easy thing for an adventurer. Come and try your luck again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.fil: Totoo na hindi ito madaling gawain para sa isang adventurer. Bumalik at subukan muli ang swerte mo kapag handa ka na.
dialogsDecline.fr: Il est vrai que ce n'est pas une chose facile pour un aventurier. Reviens tenter ta chance quand tu seras prêt.
dialogsDecline.id: Memang benar bahwa ini bukan hal yang mudah bagi seorang petualang. Datanglah dan coba keberuntunganmu lagi ketika kamu siap.
dialogsDecline.it: It is true that this is not an easy thing for an adventurer. Come and try your luck again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.jp: 冒険者にとっては簡単なことではありませんよね。気が向いたときに、また挑戦してください。
dialogsDecline.kr: 모험가 혼자서 해내기엔 절대 쉬운 일이 아니죠. 준비가 되면 다시 도전해서 운을 시험해 보세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: It is true that this is not an easy thing for an adventurer. Come and try your luck again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.pl: To prawda, że nie jest to łatwe zadanie dla poszukiwacza przygód. Przyjdź i spróbuj ponownie, gdy będziesz gotów.
dialogsDecline.ru: Это и вправду непростая задача для искателя приключений. Возвращайся, когда будешь готов, и попробуй снова.
dialogsDecline.sp: Es cierto que esto no es cosa fácil para un aventurero. Ven y prueba tu suerte de nuevo cuando estés listo.
dialogsDecline.sw: It is true that this is not an easy thing for an adventurer. Come and try your luck again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.th: จริงอยู่ว่านี่ไม่ใช่เรื่องง่ายสำหรับนักผจญภัย มาลองเสี่ยงโชคกันอีกครั้งเมื่อคุณพร้อม
dialogsDecline.tw: 說實在的，這對於冒險者來說並不是一件容易的事。準備好後再來試試運氣。
dialogsDecline.vi: Có 1 sự thật là đây không phải là một điều dễ dàng đối với một nhà thám hiểm. Hãy đến và thử vận may của bạn một lần nữa khi bạn đã sẵn sàng.

dialogsComplete.en: So you really did kill them all... Thank you very much.
dialogsComplete.ar: لقد قتلهم كلهم بالفعل... شكرا جزيلا لك.
dialogsComplete.br: Então você realmente matou todos eles... Muito obrigado.
dialogsComplete.cns: 所以你真的把他们都杀了……非常感谢
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast also wirklich alle von ihnen besiegt... Vielen Dank.
dialogsComplete.fi: So you really did kill them all... Thank you very much.
dialogsComplete.fil: Kaya pala talagang pinatay mo silang lahat... Maraming salamat.
dialogsComplete.fr: Alors comme ça tu les as vraiment tous  tués... Merci infiniment.
dialogsComplete.id: Jadi kamu benar-benar membunuh mereka semua... Terima kasih banyak.
dialogsComplete.it: So you really did kill them all... Thank you very much.
dialogsComplete.jp: では、本当に全員倒してきたのですね...。本当に助かりました。
dialogsComplete.kr: 진짜로 모두 처치했군요… 이거 정말 감사합니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: So you really did kill them all... Thank you very much.
dialogsComplete.pl: Więc naprawdę zabiłeś ich wszystkich... Dziękuję bardzo.
dialogsComplete.ru: Так ты действительно со всеми ними расправился... Огромное спасибо.
dialogsComplete.sp: Así que los has derrotado a todos... Muchísimas gracias.
dialogsComplete.sw: So you really did kill them all... Thank you very much.
dialogsComplete.th: คุณฆ่าพวกมันทั้งหมดจริงๆ... ขอบคุณมาก
dialogsComplete.tw: 所以你真的把他們都殺了……非常感謝。
dialogsComplete.vi: Vì vậy, bạn thực sự đã giết tất cả họ ... Cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều.

dialogsFail.ru: Это и вправду непростая задача для искателя приключений. Возвращайся, когда будешь готов, и попробуй снова.
dialogsFail.sp: Es cierto que esto no es cosa fácil para un aventurero. Ven y prueba tu suerte de nuevo cuando estés listo.
dialogsFail.sw: It is true that this is not an easy thing for an adventurer. Come and try your luck again when you are ready.
dialogsFail.th: จริงอยู่ว่านี่ไม่ใช่เรื่องง่ายสำหรับนักผจญภัย มาลองเสี่ยงโชคกันอีกครั้งเมื่อคุณพร้อม
dialogsFail.tw: 說實在的，這對於冒險者來說並不是一件容易的事。準備好後再來試試運氣。
dialogsFail.vi: Có 1 sự thật là đây không phải là một điều dễ dàng đối với một nhà thám hiểm. Hãy đến và thử vận may của bạn một lần nữa khi bạn đã sẵn sàng.

description.sw: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
