description.vi: Săn $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ sẽ phục hồi điểm Karma của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsAccept.nl: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.pl: Upoluj $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.ru: Твоя цель - $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$. Требуется покарать не менее $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$.

dialogsAccept.vi: Săn $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.

dialogsDecline.en: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.ar: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.br: Você ainda tem que pagar pelos seus pecados...
dialogsDecline.cns: 你还没有为你的罪恶付出代价...
dialogsDecline.de: Du musst noch immer für deine Sünden bezahlen...
dialogsDecline.fi: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.fil: Di mo pa bayad ang iyong mga kasalanan…
dialogsDecline.fr: Quand expieras-tu tes nombreux crimes ?
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu belum membayar untuk dosa-dosamu…
dialogsDecline.it: Devi ancora pagare per i tuoi peccati...
dialogsDecline.jp: いつになったら、この底知れぬ罪悪感から抜けられるのだろう？
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신은 아직 죗값을 치르지 않았으니...
dialogsDecline.nl: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.pl: Musisz najpierw zapłacić za swoje grzechy…
dialogsDecline.ru: Велики твои грехи…
dialogsDecline.sp: Todavía tienes que pagar por tus pecados...
dialogsDecline.sw: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.th: คุณยังไม้ได้ชดใช้บาปของคุณ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 你還沒有為你的罪付出代價…
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn vẫn chưa phải trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình…

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.br: Sua missão foi concluída. Seus pecados foram perdoados.
dialogsComplete.cns: 任务完成，你的罪恶已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Buße getan. Deine Sünden wurden dir vergeben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Questmu telah tercapai. Dosa-dosamu telah diampuni.
dialogsComplete.it: La Missione è terminata. I tuoi peccati sono stati perdonati.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 끝났습니다. 당신의 죄를 용서하지요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Боги одобрили твое деяние и простили тебе грехи.
dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น บาปของคุณได้รับการอภัยแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nhiệm vụ của bạn đã được hoàn thành. Tội lỗi của bạn đã được tha thứ.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

description.en: Travel to the Erons Factory in Darkon 1 and search for evidence of Red Bang Troupe activity.
description.ar: Travel to the Erons Factory in Darkon 1 and search for evidence of Red Bang Troupe activity.
description.br: Viaje para a Fábrica Erons em Darkon 1 e procure evidências de atividade dos Bangs Vermelhos.
description.cns: 依照那些人的说法，那些强盗团好像居住在达肯1的绿磷石工厂第2区域，帮我去看看那边吧。
description.de: Gut. Es gibt einen zwielichtigen Ort. Der Ort ist nahe der zweiten stillgelegten Erons Fabrik in Darkon 1. Bitte untersuche den Ort.
description.fi: Travel to the Erons Factory in Darkon 1 and search for evidence of Red Bang Troupe activity.
description.fil: Travel to the Erons Factory in Darkon 1 and search for evidence of Red Bang Troupe activity.

description.id: Pergi ke Pabrik Erons di Darkon 1 dan cari bukti aktivitas Red Bang Troupe.
description.it: Travel to the Erons Factory in Darkon 1 and search for evidence of Red Bang Troupe activity.
description.jp: 盗賊団の本拠地は、キプラ（ダーコン第1地区）のエランパークス近辺だそうだ。そこを探索し、うろついている盗賊団を倒して情報を得よう。
description.kr: 다콘 제1지구의 에런스 공장으로 가서 레드 뱅 도적단이 활동한 증거를 찾아주세요.
description.nl: Travel to the Erons Factory in Darkon 1 and search for evidence of Red Bang Troupe activity.
description.pl: Travel to the Erons Factory in Darkon 1 and search for evidence of Red Bang Troupe activity.
description.ru: Нужно поискать на Эрониевой фактории, что на Дарконе-1, следы деятельности "Труппы товарищей".
description.sp: Viaja a la Fábrica de Erons en Darkon 1 y busca pruebas de actividad de los Bangs Rojos.

description.tw: 依照那些人的說法，那些竊盜團好像居住在得肯 1 的艾磷斯工廠第二區域，幫我去看看那邊吧。
description.vi: Đi đến Erons Factory ở Darkon 1 và tìm kiếm bằng chứng về hoạt động của Red Bang Troupe.

dialogsBegin.en: Listen, I've been talking to some townsfolk…
dialogsBegin.ar: Listen, I've been talking to some townsfolk…
dialogsBegin.br: Ei! É você! Eu estava procurando você. Parece que nós somos ligados um ao outro.
dialogsBegin.cns: 嗨，原来是你啊，我总觉得我跟你很有缘份呢。
dialogsBegin.de: Hey! Du bist es! Ich habe nach dir gesucht. Es scheint so als wärt ihr miteinander verbunden..
dialogsBegin.fi: Listen, I've been talking to some townsfolk…
dialogsBegin.fil: Listen, I've been talking to some townsfolk…
dialogsBegin.fr: Hé ! Je te cherchais. Apparemment tu connais tout le monde.
dialogsBegin.id: Dengar, aku telah berbicara dengan beberapa penduduk kota...
dialogsBegin.it: Listen, I've been talking to some townsfolk…
dialogsBegin.jp: 君！君！このまえは助けてくれてありがとう。実はあれから君のことをずっと捜していたんだ。そしたら偶然会えるなんて。何か不思議な縁で繋がっているのかもしれないな！
dialogsBegin.kr: 저기, 마을 사람들과 얘기를 좀 나눠봤는데...
dialogsBegin.nl: Listen, I've been talking to some townsfolk…
dialogsBegin.pl: Listen, I've been talking to some townsfolk…
dialogsBegin.ru: Послушай, я тут разговаривал с людьми...
dialogsBegin.sp: Escucha, he estado hablando con algunos habitantes del pueblo...
dialogsBegin.sw: Listen, I've been talking to some townsfolk…
dialogsBegin.th: ฟังนะ ฉันได้พูดคุยกับชาวเมืองบางคน...
dialogsBegin.tw: 哈囉~~原來是你啊…我總覺得我跟你很有緣份呢~
dialogsBegin.vi: Nghe này, tôi đã nói chuyện với một số người dân trong thị trấn…

dialogsBegin.en: After Lord Bang died, I have heard various rumors about the Red Bang Troupe that lead me to believe they are still around.
dialogsBegin.ar: After Lord Bang died, I have heard various rumors about the Red Bang Troupe that lead me to believe they are still around.
dialogsBegin.br: Depois que o Lorde Bang morreu, ouvi vários rumores a respeito dos Bangs Vermelhos, que eu pensei que tivesse desaparecido há algum tempo atrás.
dialogsBegin.cns: 在魔导战甲王被杀之后，我以为那些强盗团已经消失了，可是最近偶尔会听到有人再说他们的事情耶。
dialogsBegin.de: Nachdem Lord Bang starb, habe ich Gerüchte über die Red Bang Truppe gehört, von denen ich dachte, dass sie verschwunden waren. Es gibt verschiedene Gerüchte.
dialogsBegin.fi: After Lord Bang died, I have heard various rumors about the Red Bang Troupe that lead me to believe they are still around.
dialogsBegin.fil: After Lord Bang died, I have heard various rumors about the Red Bang Troupe that lead me to believe they are still around.
dialogsBegin.fr: Après la mort de Lord Bang, j'ai entendu pas mal d'histoires sur la bande des Big Bang qui, je pensais, avait disparu depuis quelques temps.
dialogsBegin.id: Setelah Lord Bang meninggal, saya telah mendengar berbagai rumor tentang Red Bang Troupe yang membuat saya percaya bahwa mereka masih ada.
dialogsBegin.it: After Lord Bang died, I have heard various rumors about the Red Bang Troupe that lead me to believe they are still around.
dialogsBegin.jp: 実はロードヴァンが姿を消してからは暫く平和だったのだが、最近また、赤いヴァン盗賊団に対する良くない噂が、ちょこちょこ耳に入るんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 로드 뱅이 죽은 후에도, 레드 뱅 도적단이 암암리에 활동하고 있다는 소문을 들었어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: After Lord Bang died, I have heard various rumors about the Red Bang Troupe that lead me to believe they are still around.
dialogsBegin.pl: After Lord Bang died, I have heard various rumors about the Red Bang Troupe that lead me to believe they are still around.
dialogsBegin.ru: Похоже, что поражение Папаши Грома не остановило "Труппу товарищей". Они продолжают разбойничать!
dialogsBegin.sp: Después de la muerte del Señor Bang, escuché varios rumores sobre los Bangs Rojos que me llevan a creer que todavía están activos.
dialogsBegin.sw: After Lord Bang died, I have heard various rumors about the Red Bang Troupe that lead me to believe they are still around.
dialogsBegin.th: หลังจาก Lord Bang เสียชีวิต ฉันได้ยินข่าวลือต่างๆ เกี่ยวกับแก๊งโจร Red Bang ที่ทำให้ฉันเชื่อว่าพวกเขายังอยู่รอบๆ เมืองของเรา
dialogsBegin.tw: 在崩崩領主被殺之後，我以為那些竊盜團已經消失了，可是最近偶爾會聽到有人再說他們的事情耶。
dialogsBegin.vi: Sau khi Lord Bang qua đời, tôi đã nghe nhiều tin đồn về Red Bang Troupe khiến tôi tin rằng họ vẫn còn xung quanh đây.

dialogsBegin.en: I can't ignore these rumors. If there is any chance that the Red bang Troup is still in existence, we need to take care of it immediately.
dialogsBegin.ar: I can't ignore these rumors. If there is any chance that the Red bang Troup is still in existence, we need to take care of it immediately.
dialogsBegin.br: Mas não posso mais ignorar os rumores pois realmente tenho medo deles...
dialogsBegin.cns: 你会觉得只是一个谣言，可是对我来说只要是关于他们的事情，就会让我觉得很不安。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich kann die Gerüchte nicht einfach ignorieren denn ich habe wirklich Angst vor ihnen..
dialogsBegin.fi: I can't ignore these rumors. If there is any chance that the Red bang Troup is still in existence, we need to take care of it immediately.
dialogsBegin.fil: I can't ignore these rumors. If there is any chance that the Red bang Troup is still in existence, we need to take care of it immediately.
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais il y a des rumeurs qui courent et ça me terrifie en fait. On dit que les Bigs Bang sont toujours en activité !
dialogsBegin.id: Saya tidak bisa mengabaikan rumor ini. Jika ada kemungkinan bahwa Red bang Troup masih ada, kita harus segera menanganinya.
dialogsBegin.it: I can't ignore these rumors. If there is any chance that the Red bang Troup is still in existence, we need to take care of it immediately.
dialogsBegin.jp: そんなのは噂にすぎんと無視しても構わないのだが、なんとなく気になってしまってな。
dialogsBegin.kr: 소문이라 해도 마음에 걸려요. 레드 뱅 도적단이 아직도 건재하다면, 어떻게든 조처를 해야 해요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I can't ignore these rumors. If there is any chance that the Red bang Troup is still in existence, we need to take care of it immediately.
dialogsBegin.pl: I can't ignore these rumors. If there is any chance that the Red bang Troup is still in existence, we need to take care of it immediately.
dialogsBegin.ru: Я горожанам верю. И если "товарищи" не хотят остановиться сами, надо сделать так, чтобы от их труппы остались только трупы!
dialogsBegin.sp: No puedo ignorar estos rumores. Si existe alguna posibilidad de que el grupo de los Bangs Rojos todavía exista, debemos ocuparnos de inmediato.
dialogsBegin.sw: I can't ignore these rumors. If there is any chance that the Red bang Troup is still in existence, we need to take care of it immediately.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันไม่สามารถละเลยข่าวลือเหล่านี้ได้ ถ้ามีโอกาสที่ Red Bang Troup ยังคงมีอยู่ เราจำเป็นต้องจัดการมันทันที
dialogsBegin.tw: 你會覺得只是一個謠言，可是對我來說只要是關於他們的事情，就會讓我覺得很不安。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi không thể bỏ qua những tin đồn này. Nếu có bất kỳ cơ hội nào cho thấy Red bang Troup vẫn còn tồn tại, chúng ta cần phải xử lý ngay lập tức.

dialogsBegin.en: Will you help an old friend once again?
dialogsBegin.ar: Will you help an old friend once again?
dialogsBegin.br: Então me ajude, por favor. Você poderia?
dialogsBegin.cns: 可以麻烦你帮帮我吗?
dialogsBegin.de: Bitte helfe mir. Würdest du?
dialogsBegin.fi: Will you help an old friend once again?
dialogsBegin.fil: Will you help an old friend once again?
dialogsBegin.fr: S'il te plaît, peux-tu m'aider dans les recherches ?
dialogsBegin.id: Maukah kamu membantu sekali lagi teman lama?
dialogsBegin.it: Will you help an old friend once again?
dialogsBegin.jp: そこで、また俺の頼みを聞いてくれないだろうか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 한 번 더 부탁을 들어주실 수 있을까요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Will you help an old friend once again?
dialogsBegin.pl: Will you help an old friend once again?
dialogsBegin.ru: Ты поможешь старому другу?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Ayudarás a un viejo amigo una vez más?
dialogsBegin.sw: Will you help an old friend once again?
dialogsBegin.th: คุณจะช่วยเพื่อนเก่าอีกครั้งได้หรือไม่?
dialogsBegin.tw: 可以麻煩你幫幫我嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn sẽ giúp người bạn cũ một lần nữa chứ?

dialogsAccept.en: Thank you, friend. There are reports of Red Bang Troupe activity near the Erons Factory in Darkon 1. I need you to investigate!
dialogsAccept.ar: Thank you, friend. There are reports of Red Bang Troupe activity near the Erons Factory in Darkon 1. I need you to investigate!
dialogsAccept.br: Ótimo. Existe um lugar que me preocupa. O local fica perto da Fábrica Erons em Darkon 1. Por favor, vá lá e cheque.
dialogsAccept.cns: 好!依照那些人的说法，那些强盗团好像居住在达肯1的绿磷石工厂第2区域，帮我去看看那边吧。
dialogsAccept.de: Gut. Es gibt einen zwielichtigen Ort. Der Ort ist nahe der zweiten stillgelegten Erons Fabrik in Darkon 1. Bitte untersuche den Ort.
dialogsAccept.fi: Thank you, friend. There are reports of Red Bang Troupe activity near the Erons Factory in Darkon 1. I need you to investigate!
dialogsAccept.fil: Thank you, friend. There are reports of Red Bang Troupe activity near the Erons Factory in Darkon 1. I need you to investigate!
dialogsAccept.fr: Bien. Il y a un endroit en particulier qui m'inquiète. Cet endroit est près de l'Usine des Erons de Darkon 1. S'il te plaît va voir ce qui s'y passe.
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih teman. Ada laporan tentang aktivitas Red Bang Troupe di dekat Pabrik Erons di Darkon 1. Aku ingin kamu menyelidikinya!
dialogsAccept.it: Thank you, friend. There are reports of Red Bang Troupe activity near the Erons Factory in Darkon 1. I need you to investigate!
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとう、君は本当に勇敢だな！やつらのいる場所を調べたところ、見当がついた地域がある。ダーコン第1地区のエランパークス近辺だそうだ。そこを探してみてくれないか？
dialogsAccept.kr: 정말 고마워요. 다콘 제1지구의 에런스 공장 근처에서 레드 뱅 도적단이 활동한다는 제보가 있었어요. 가서 조사해 주세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Thank you, friend. There are reports of Red Bang Troupe activity near the Erons Factory in Darkon 1. I need you to investigate!
dialogsAccept.pl: Thank you, friend. There are reports of Red Bang Troupe activity near the Erons Factory in Darkon 1. I need you to investigate!
dialogsAccept.ru: Спасибо тебе. Говорят, что разбойников видели недалеко от Эрониевой фактории на Дарконе-1. Нужно проверить!
dialogsAccept.sp: Gracias amigo. Hay informes de actividad de que los Bangs Rojos están cerca de la Fábrica de Erons en Darkon 1. ¡Necesito que lo investigues!
dialogsAccept.sw: Thank you, friend. There are reports of Red Bang Troupe activity near the Erons Factory in Darkon 1. I need you to investigate!
dialogsAccept.th: ขอบคุณ เพื่อน มีรายงานเกี่ยวกับการเคลื่อนไหวของ Red Bang Troupe ใกล้โรงงาน Erons ใน Darkon 1 ฉันต้องการให้คุณตรวจสอบ!
dialogsAccept.tw: 好！依照那些人的說法，那些竊盜團好像居住在得肯 1 的艾磷斯工廠第二區域，幫我去看看那邊吧。
dialogsAccept.vi: Cảm ơn bạn. Có báo cáo về hoạt động của Red Bang Troupe gần Erons Factory ở Darkon 1. Tôi cần bạn điều tra!

dialogsDecline.en: I can't ignore these rumors. Please help me!
dialogsDecline.ar: I can't ignore these rumors. Please help me!
dialogsDecline.br: Não podemos simplesmente ignorar os rumores. Se eles ainda existirem, nós corremos grande perigo!
dialogsDecline.cns: 他们还生存着，这不是一个随随便便可以忽略的事情啦。
dialogsDecline.de: Wir können die Gerüchte nicht einfach ignorieren. Wenn es sie wirklich noch gibt, sind wir in großer Gefahr!
dialogsDecline.fi: I can't ignore these rumors. Please help me!
dialogsDecline.fil: I can't ignore these rumors. Please help me!
dialogsDecline.fr: Nous ne pouvons ignorer ces rumeurs. S'ils existent toujours, nous sommes en grand danger !
dialogsDecline.id: Saya tidak bisa mengabaikan rumor ini. Tolong bantu aku!
dialogsDecline.it: I can't ignore these rumors. Please help me!
dialogsDecline.jp: 赤いヴァン盗賊団…あいつらが復活したかどうかは、とても重要な問題なんだ。どうか真実を調べてきてくれないか？頼むよ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 이 소문을 그냥 넘길 순 없어요. 제발, 도와주세요!
dialogsDecline.nl: I can't ignore these rumors. Please help me!
dialogsDecline.pl: I can't ignore these rumors. Please help me!
dialogsDecline.ru: Нужно остановить разбойников! Прошу, помоги!
dialogsDecline.sp: No puedo ignorar estos rumores. ¡Por favor, ayúdame!
dialogsDecline.sw: I can't ignore these rumors. Please help me!
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันไม่สามารถละเลยต่อข่าวลือเหล่านี้ได้ กรุณาช่วยฉันด้วย!
dialogsDecline.tw: 他們還生存著，這不是一個隨隨便便可以忽略的事情啦。
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi không thể bỏ qua những tin đồn này. Làm ơn giúp tôi!

dialogsComplete.en: Then it's true. It's worse than I thought. Thank you for bringing me this information.
dialogsComplete.ar: Then it's true. It's worse than I thought. Thank you for bringing me this information.
dialogsComplete.br: Verdade? Então eu estava certo.. Eles realmente ainda existem. Hmm...
dialogsComplete.cns: 真的吗?代表他们还存在…
dialogsComplete.de: Wirklich? Dann hatte ich Recht.. Sie existieren tatsächlich noch.. Hmm..
dialogsComplete.fi: Then it's true. It's worse than I thought. Thank you for bringing me this information.
dialogsComplete.fil: Then it's true. It's worse than I thought. Thank you for bringing me this information.
dialogsComplete.fr: Vraiment ?! Alors c'était vrai... Ils sont toujours là... Hmm.
dialogsComplete.id: Maka itu benar. Ini lebih buruk dari yang saya kira. Terima kasih telah membawakan saya informasi ini.
dialogsComplete.it: Then it's true. It's worse than I thought. Thank you for bringing me this information.
dialogsComplete.jp: なるほど。噂は本当だったようだな。赤いヴァン盗賊団がまだ壊滅せず、ひそかに活動しているという情報は。
dialogsComplete.kr: 그 소문... 사실이었군요. 생각보다 상황이 더 나쁘네요. 알려주셔서 감사합니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Then it's true. It's worse than I thought. Thank you for bringing me this information.
dialogsComplete.pl: Then it's true. It's worse than I thought. Thank you for bringing me this information.
dialogsComplete.ru: Значит, это правда. Все гораздо хуже, чем я думал. Спасибо за помощь.
dialogsComplete.sp: Entonces es verdad. Es peor de lo que pensaba. Gracias por informarme.
dialogsComplete.sw: Then it's true. It's worse than I thought. Thank you for bringing me this information.
dialogsComplete.th: และแล้วมันก็เป็นความจริงสินะ มันแย่กว่าที่ฉันคิดเสียอีก ขอบคุณที่นำข้อมูลเหล่านี้มาให้เรา
dialogsComplete.tw: 果然是真的，情況比我想像的還糟。謝謝你帶回這項消息。
dialogsComplete.vi: Vậy nó là sự thật. Tồi tệ hơn tôi nghĩ. Cảm ơn bạn đã mang đến cho tôi thông tin này.

dialogsFail.en: You didn't find anything? These rumors are unsubstantiated, but I believe them to be true.
dialogsFail.ar: You didn't find anything? These rumors are unsubstantiated, but I believe them to be true.
dialogsFail.br: Você descobriu alguma coisa? Esses rumores são infundados, mas acredito que sejam verdadeiros.
dialogsFail.cns: 没发现任何线索吗?应该不可能的，再去帮我仔细的看看好吗?
dialogsFail.de: Du hast nichts gefunden? Diese Gerüchte sind unbestätigt, aber ich glaube, dass sie wahr sind.
dialogsFail.fi: You didn't find anything? These rumors are unsubstantiated, but I believe them to be true.
dialogsFail.fil: You didn't find anything? These rumors are unsubstantiated, but I believe them to be true.
dialogsFail.fr: Tu n'as rien trouvé ? C'est étrange. S'il te plaît, retourne poursuivre tes recherches.
dialogsFail.id: Anda tidak menemukan apa-apa? Desas-desus ini tidak berdasar, tetapi saya percaya itu benar.
dialogsFail.it: You didn't find anything? These rumors are unsubstantiated, but I believe them to be true.
dialogsFail.jp: ん？手がかりは見つからなかったのか？そんなはずはない、もう一度、調べてみてくれ。
dialogsFail.kr: 아무것도 못 찾으셨어요? 아직 확인된 바는 없지만, 저는 그 소문이 사실 같던데.
dialogsFail.nl: You didn't find anything? These rumors are unsubstantiated, but I believe them to be true.
dialogsFail.pl: You didn't find anything? These rumors are unsubstantiated, but I believe them to be true.
dialogsFail.ru: You didn't find anything? These rumors are unsubstantiated, but I believe them to be true.
dialogsFail.sp: ¿No has encontrado nada? Estos rumores no tienen fundamento, pero aún así creo que son ciertos.
dialogsFail.sw: You didn't find anything? These rumors are unsubstantiated, but I believe them to be true.
dialogsFail.th: คุณไม่พบอะไรเลยเหรอ? ข่าวลือเหล่านี้ไม่มีมูลความจริง แต่ผมเชื่อว่ามันเป็นความจริง
dialogsFail.tw: 你什麼都沒找到？這些謠言是沒有根據的，但我相信它們是真的。
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn không tìm thấy bất cứ điều gì? Những tin đồn này là không có cơ sở, nhưng tôi tin chúng là sự thật.

dialogsBegin.en: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.ar: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.br: Bem-vindo de volta aventureiro! Há relatos de uma nova ameaça na Torre Abandonada. Procure e livre-se de $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.cns: 欢迎回来，英雄！据报告，深渊之塔中出现了新的威胁。请前去找到并消灭 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$
dialogsBegin.de: Willkommen zurück, Held! Berichte zufolge wartet im Verlassenen Turm eine neue Bedrohung. Suche und töte die $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fi: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fil: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fr: Content de te revoir, héros ! Des rapports indiquent la présence d'une nouvelle menace dans la Tour Oubliée. S'il te plaît, cherche et élimine le $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.id: Selamat datang kembali pahlawan! Ada laporan ancaman baru di Forsaken Tower. Silakan cari dan singkirkan $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.it: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.jp: おかえりヒーロー！忘却の塔に新たな脅威の報告がありました。$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を探して一掃してきてください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 돌아온 걸 환영해요, 용사님! 버려진 탑에 위협이 발생했다는 보고를 받았어요. 버려진 탑에서 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$을(를) 찾아 없애주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.

dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Bienvenido, héroe! Hay informes de una nueva amenaza en la Torre de los Desamparados. Por favor, busca y deshazte del $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.sw: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.th: ยินดีต้อนรับกลับมาฮีโร่! มีรายงานมาว่าพบกันอันตรายใหม่เกิดขึ้นที่ Forsaken Tower โปรดไปค้นหาและทำลาย $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ให้สิ้นซาก
dialogsBegin.tw: 歡迎回來的英雄！有報告稱深淵之塔出現了新的威脅。請找出並擺脫 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$。
dialogsBegin.vi: Chào mừng trở lại hero! Có báo cáo về một mối đe dọa mới trong Forsaken Tower. Vui lòng tìm kiếm và loại bỏ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.

dialogsDecline.en: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.ar: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.br: A Torre está infestada de masquerpets perigosos. Entendo se não quiser correr o risco.
dialogsDecline.cns: 这座塔里到处都是危险的假面怪。如果你不想冒这个险，我完全理解。
dialogsDecline.de: Der Turm ist voller gefährlicher Masquerpets. Ich verstehe es, wenn du das Risiko nicht eingehen willst.
dialogsDecline.fi: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.fil: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.fr: La Tour est remplies de monstres dangereux. Je comprends que tu ne veuilles pas prendre ce risque.
dialogsDecline.id: Menara dipenuhi dengan masquerpets berbahaya. Saya mengerti jika Anda tidak ingin mengambil risiko.
dialogsDecline.it: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.jp: タワーは危険なモンスターでいっぱいです。あなたがリスクを冒したくないのなら、私は理解しています。

dialogsFail.de: Du hast es nicht geschafft, $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ zu töten? Das stimmt, komm wieder, sobald du gegen den Giant gewonnen hast!
dialogsFail.fi: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.fil: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!

dialogsFail.th: คุณไม่ยังสามาถจัดการ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ได้อีกรึ? ไม่เป็นไรกลับมาเมื่อคุณจัดการพวกไจแอนท์พวกนั้นสำเร็จนะ!

dialogsBegin.en: What? You came here to find me? You must have me confused with someone else. I'm not a lost child, I'm a mighty warrior!!!
dialogsBegin.ar: What? You came here to find me? You must have me confused with someone else. I'm not a lost child, I'm a mighty warrior!!!
dialogsBegin.br: O que está dizendo? Você veio aqui para me encontrar? Você deve ter me confundido com outra pessoa. Não sou uma criança perdida, sou um poderoso guerreiro!!!
dialogsBegin.cns: 什么？你是来找我的？你一定是被其他人迷惑了。我不是一个走丢的孩子，我是一个强大的战士！！！
dialogsBegin.de: Was? Du bist hergekommen, um mich zu finden? Ihr müsst mich mit jemand anderem verwechseln. Ich bin kein verlorenes Kind, ich bin eine mächtige Kriegerin!!!
dialogsBegin.fi: What? You came here to find me? You must have me confused with someone else. I'm not a lost child, I'm a mighty warrior!!!
dialogsBegin.fil: What? You came here to find me? You must have me confused with someone else. I'm not a lost child, I'm a mighty warrior!!!
dialogsBegin.fr: Je sais il est tard et je me suis un peu perdu…
dialogsBegin.id: Apa? Kamu datang kemari mencariku? Kamu pasti salah orang. Aku bukanlah anak yang hilang, aku adalah pahlawan yang kuat!!!
dialogsBegin.it: What? You came here to find me? You must have me confused with someone else. I'm not a lost child, I'm a mighty warrior!!!
dialogsBegin.jp: ん？　僕が行方不明だって？　ふふん。ネルコ様がそんな簡単に迷子になったりするもんかい！
dialogsBegin.kr: 뭐라고요? 절 찾으러 왔다고요? 누구랑 착각하신 거 아닌가요? 전 길 잃은 애가 아니라, 위대한 전사인데요!!!
dialogsBegin.nl: What? You came here to find me? You must have me confused with someone else. I'm not a lost child, I'm a mighty warrior!!!
dialogsBegin.pl: What? You came here to find me? You must have me confused with someone else. I'm not a lost child, I'm a mighty warrior!!!
dialogsBegin.ru: Что? Ты разыскиваешь меня? Видимо, ты обознался. Я не потеряшка, Я ВЕЛИКИЙ ВОИН!!!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Qué? ¿Has venido aquí a buscarme? Debes haberme confundido con otra persona. ¡¡¡No soy un niño perdido, soy un poderoso guerrero!!!
dialogsBegin.sw: What? You came here to find me? You must have me confused with someone else. I'm not a lost child, I'm a mighty warrior!!!
dialogsBegin.th: อะไร คุณมาที่นี่เพื่อมาหาฉันเหรอ คุณคงทำให้ฉันสับสนกับคนอื่น ฉันไม่ใช่เด็กหลง ฉันคือนักรบผู้แข็งแกร่ง!!!
dialogsBegin.tw: 什麼？你是來找我的？你一定把我和別人搞混了。我不是迷路的孩子，我是強大的戰士！！！
dialogsBegin.vi: Gì? Bạn đến đây để tìm tôi? Bạn phải làm cho tôi nhầm lẫn với một người khác. Tôi không phải là một đứa trẻ lạc loài, tôi là một chiến binh dũng mãnh !!!

dialogsBegin.en: Ok, so maybe I did get just a little lost. WHAT!? My mom already reported me missing!? Oh am I in trouble. Mom is gonna take my upgraded wooden sword!!!
dialogsBegin.ar: Ok, so maybe I did get just a little lost. WHAT!? My mom already reported me missing!? Oh am I in trouble. Mom is gonna take my upgraded wooden sword!!!
dialogsBegin.br: Tá bom, talvez eu tenha me perdido só um pouquinho. QUEE!? Minha mãe já me reportou como desaparecido!? Eita, tô lascado. Mamãe vai pegar minha espada de madeira fortalecida!!!
dialogsBegin.cns: 好吧，我可能确实有点迷路了。什么！？我妈妈已经上报我走丢了吗！？完蛋了，我的超级无敌木剑要被我妈妈没收了！！！
dialogsBegin.de: Ok, vielleicht habe ich mich doch ein wenig verirrt. WAS!? Meine Mutter hat mich schon als vermisst gemeldet!? Oh, ich bin in Schwierigkeiten. Mom wird mir mein verbessertes Holzschwert wegnehmen!!!
dialogsBegin.fi: Ok, so maybe I did get just a little lost. WHAT!? My mom already reported me missing!? Oh am I in trouble. Mom is gonna take my upgraded wooden sword!!!
dialogsBegin.fil: Ok, so maybe I did get just a little lost. WHAT!? My mom already reported me missing!? Oh am I in trouble. Mom is gonna take my upgraded wooden sword!!!
dialogsBegin.fr: QUOI ?? Maman a posté des avis de recherche en ville ? Je suis dans un sacré pétrin…
dialogsBegin.id: Oke, jadi mungkin aku sedikit tersesat. APA!? Ibuku sudah melaporkan kalau aku hilang!? Oh tidak, Ibu akan menyita pedang kayu yang susah payah kupgrade ini!!!
dialogsBegin.it: Ok, so maybe I did get just a little lost. WHAT!? My mom already reported me missing!? Oh am I in trouble. Mom is gonna take my upgraded wooden sword!!!
dialogsBegin.jp: ちょっと道がわからなくなっただけさ。ふ、ふん。もう帰るつもりだったから心配ないよ。え？　お母さんが迷子捜索を依頼したの？　う～ん……
dialogsBegin.kr: 그래요, 조금 길을 잃긴 했어요. 뭐라고요!? 엄마가 벌써 실종 신고를 했다고요!? 큰일 났다. 엄마가 제 나무 검을 뺏어갈 거예요!!!
dialogsBegin.nl: Ok, so maybe I did get just a little lost. WHAT!? My mom already reported me missing!? Oh am I in trouble. Mom is gonna take my upgraded wooden sword!!!
dialogsBegin.pl: Ok, so maybe I did get just a little lost. WHAT!? My mom already reported me missing!? Oh am I in trouble. Mom is gonna take my upgraded wooden sword!!!
dialogsBegin.ru: Ладно, возможно я немного заблудился. ЧТО!? Мама уже заявила о моей пропаже? Ух, вот я влип.. Мама точно отберёт мой любимый меч!!!
dialogsBegin.sp: Vale, tal vez me perdí un poco. ¿¡QUÉ!? ¿¡Mi mamá ya ha reportado mi desaparición!? Oh, estoy en problemas. ¡¡¡Se llevará mi espada de madera!!!
dialogsBegin.sw: Ok, so maybe I did get just a little lost. WHAT!? My mom already reported me missing!? Oh am I in trouble. Mom is gonna take my upgraded wooden sword!!!
dialogsBegin.th: โอเค บางทีฉันอาจจะหลงทางนิดหน่อย อะไร!? แม่แจ้งความหายแล้ว!? โอ้ ฉันอยู่ในปัญหา แม่จะเอาดาบไม้ที่อัพเกรดของฉันไป!!!
dialogsBegin.tw: 好的，所以也許我確實有點迷路了。什麼！？我媽已經報我失蹤了！？哦，我有麻煩了。媽媽要拿走我升級後的木劍！！！
dialogsBegin.vi: Được rồi, có lẽ tôi đã bị lạc một chút. GÌ!? Mẹ tôi đã báo cáo tôi mất tích !? Ồ, tôi đang gặp rắc rối. Mẹ sẽ lấy thanh kiếm gỗ nâng cấp của tôi !!!

dialogsBegin.en: Hey... um... YOU!! I need a favor. Please go and tell my mom I'm at a friend's house and will be home for dinner! If not, I am going to throw such a tantrum.
dialogsBegin.ar: Hey... um... YOU!! I need a favor. Please go and tell my mom I'm at a friend's house and will be home for dinner! If not, I am going to throw such a tantrum.
dialogsBegin.br: Ei.. hum.. VOCÊ!! Eu preciso de um favorzinho. Dá pra você ir e dizer à minha mãe que estou na casa de um amigo? Logo estarei em casa para o jantar! Ei, por favor. Se não, vou fazer uma bagunça.
dialogsBegin.cns: Hey... um... YOU!! I need a favor. Please go and tell my mom I'm at a friend's house and will be home for dinner! If not, I am going to throw such a tantrum.
dialogsBegin.de: Hey... ähm... DU!! Du musst mir einen Gefallen tun. Bitte geh und sag meiner Mutter, dass ich bei einem Freund bin und zum Abendessen zu Hause sein werde! Wenn nicht, werde ich einen Wutanfall bekommen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Hey... um... YOU!! I need a favor. Please go and tell my mom I'm at a friend's house and will be home for dinner! If not, I am going to throw such a tantrum.
dialogsBegin.fil: Hey... um... YOU!! I need a favor. Please go and tell my mom I'm at a friend's house and will be home for dinner! If not, I am going to throw such a tantrum.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je vous en prie, allez parler à ma mère et dites-lui que tout va bien. J'ai juste besoin d'un peu de temps.
dialogsBegin.id: Hei.. um.. KAMU!! Aku butuh bantuan. Tolong pergi dan beri tahu ibuku kalau aku di rumah teman dan akan pulang untuk makan malam! Jika tidak, Aku akan berulah.
dialogsBegin.it: Hey... um... YOU!! I need a favor. Please go and tell my mom I'm at a friend's house and will be home for dinner! If not, I am going to throw such a tantrum.
dialogsBegin.jp: ねえ、ちょっとお願いだけど、先に僕のお母さんにあって、すぐに帰ると伝えてくれないかな？いまもう少しで鬼の子の正体が突き止められそうなんだよね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 저기요... 음... 저기!!! 부탁이 있어요. 제발 저희 엄마한테 제가 친구네 집에 있고 곧 저녁 먹으러 집에 간다고 전해 주실래요? 안 해주시면 해줄 때까지 떼쓸 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Hey... um... YOU!! I need a favor. Please go and tell my mom I'm at a friend's house and will be home for dinner! If not, I am going to throw such a tantrum.
dialogsBegin.pl: Hey... um... YOU!! I need a favor. Please go and tell my mom I'm at a friend's house and will be home for dinner! If not, I am going to throw such a tantrum.
dialogsBegin.ru: Hey... um... YOU!! I need a favor. Please go and tell my mom I'm at a friend's house and will be home for dinner! If not, I am going to throw such a tantrum.
dialogsBegin.sp: Oye.. hmm.. ¡¡¡TÚ!! Necesito un favor. ¡Por favor ve y dile a mi mamá que estoy en la casa de un amigo y que estaré en casa para la cena! Si no, voy a hacer un berrinche.
dialogsBegin.sw: Hey... um... YOU!! I need a favor. Please go and tell my mom I'm at a friend's house and will be home for dinner! If not, I am going to throw such a tantrum.
dialogsBegin.th: เฮ้... เอ่อ... คุณ!! ฉันต้องการความช่วยเหลือหน่อย ได้โปรดไปบอกแม่ของฉันว่าฉันอยู่ที่บ้านเพื่อนและจะกลับบ้านมาทานข้าวเย็น! ถ้าไม่ ฉันจะโวยวายให้ดู!
dialogsBegin.tw: 欸……嗯……就是你！！我需要你幫個忙。拜託你去告訴我媽媽，就說我在朋友家，晚餐前會回去！不然我可要大鬧一場了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Này .. ừm .. BẠN ĐÓ!! Tôi cần bạn giúp.. Hãy đi và nói với mẹ tôi rằng tôi đang ở nhà một người bạn và sẽ về nhà ăn tối! Nếu không, tôi sẽ quậy một trận đấy.

dialogsAccept.en: Hehe, I knew you would accept my request. Please tell my mom everything is fine. Don't worry about me, I will go back soon enough!
dialogsAccept.ar: Hehe, I knew you would accept my request. Please tell my mom everything is fine. Don't worry about me, I will go back soon enough!
dialogsAccept.br: Hehe, eu sabia que você aceitaria meu pedido. Por favor, diga a minha mãe que está tudo bem. Não se preocupe comigo, voltarei em breve!
dialogsAccept.cns: 嘿嘿，我就知道你会接受我的请求。请告诉我妈妈我一切安好，不需要担心我，我会马上回家的！
dialogsAccept.de: Hehe, ich wusste, du würdest meine Bitte annehmen. Bitte sagen Sie meiner Mutter, dass alles in Ordnung ist. Mach dir keine Sorgen um mich, ich werde noch früh genug zurückkehren!
dialogsAccept.fi: Hehe, I knew you would accept my request. Please tell my mom everything is fine. Don't worry about me, I will go back soon enough!
dialogsAccept.fil: Hehe, I knew you would accept my request. Please tell my mom everything is fine. Don't worry about me, I will go back soon enough!
dialogsAccept.fr: Merci, merci, merci. Un jour je serai fort comme vous.
dialogsAccept.id: Hehe, aku tahu kamu akan menerimanya. Tolong beritahu ibuku kalau semuanya baik-baik saja. Jangan khawatir, aku akan kembali segera!
dialogsAccept.it: Hehe, I knew you would accept my request. Please tell my mom everything is fine. Don't worry about me, I will go back soon enough!
dialogsAccept.jp: へへ、ありがとう！お母さんには夕飯までには帰るから心配しないよう伝えてよ！
dialogsAccept.kr: 헤헤. 제 부탁, 들어주실 줄 알았어요. 엄마한테는 아무 문제 없다고 전해 주세요. 걱정하지 마세요, 곧 돌아갈게요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Hehe, I knew you would accept my request. Please tell my mom everything is fine. Don't worry about me, I will go back soon enough!
dialogsAccept.pl: Hehe, I knew you would accept my request. Please tell my mom everything is fine. Don't worry about me, I will go back soon enough!
dialogsAccept.ru: Хехе! Я знал, что ты согласишься. Передай маме, что всё в порядке. Обо мне не беспокойся, я уже скоро здесь закончу!
dialogsAccept.sp: Jeje, sabía que aceptarías. Por favor, dile a mi mamá que todo está bien. No te preocupes por mí, ¡volveré pronto!
dialogsAccept.sw: Hehe, I knew you would accept my request. Please tell my mom everything is fine. Don't worry about me, I will go back soon enough!
dialogsAccept.th: ฮิฮิ ฉันรู้ว่าคุณจะยอมรับคำขอของฉัน โปรดบอกแม่ของฉันว่าทุกอย่างเรียบร้อยดี ไม่ต้องห่วงฉัน ฉันจะรีบกลับมา!
dialogsAccept.tw: 呵呵，我就知道你會接受我的請求。請告訴我媽媽一切都很好。不用擔心我，我很快就會回去的！
dialogsAccept.vi: Hehe, tôi biết bạn sẽ chấp nhận yêu cầu của tôi. Hãy nói với mẹ là mọi thứ vẫn ổn. Đừng lo lắng cho tôi, tôi sẽ quay lại sớm thôi!

dialogsDecline.en: No! No! I won't go! I won't go! I won't go! You can't make me!
dialogsDecline.ar: No! No! I won't go! I won't go! I won't go! You can't make me!
dialogsDecline.br: Nananina Não! Eu não vou! Eu não vou! Eu não vou! Você não pode me obrigar!
dialogsDecline.cns: 不！不！我不会离开的！我不走！我不走！你不能强迫我离开！
dialogsDecline.de: Nein! Nein! Ich werde nicht gehen! Ich werde nicht gehen! Ich werde nicht gehen! Ihr könnt mich nicht zwingen!
dialogsDecline.fi: No! No! I won't go! I won't go! I won't go! You can't make me!
dialogsDecline.fil: No! No! I won't go! I won't go! I won't go! You can't make me!
dialogsDecline.fr: Noooooon, ne partez pas comme ça, ou je retiens ma respiration jusqu'à ce que vous reveniez !!
dialogsDecline.id: Tidak! Tidak! Aku tidak mau pergi! Aku tidak mau pergi! Aku tidak akan pergi! Kamu tidak bisa membuatku pergi!
dialogsDecline.it: No! No! I won't go! I won't go! I won't go! You can't make me!
dialogsDecline.jp: え～どうしても連れて帰るつもり？　ふん、僕はここを梃子でも動かないぞ！
dialogsDecline.kr: 싫어! 싫다고요! 안 가요! 안 간다고 했잖아요!

description.fil: Visit Dr. Est near the Gouthan Mountains in Darkon 1.

dialogsBegin.en: So you're interested in challenging Clockworks, huh? What are you, nuts?!
dialogsBegin.ar: So you're interested in challenging Clockworks, huh? What are you, nuts?!
dialogsBegin.br: Então você está interessado em desafiar Clockworks, han? O que você é, maluco(a)?!
dialogsBegin.cns: 你要挑战时空毁灭者？我以达肯市长的身分授与你挑战的权限！
dialogsBegin.de: Du bist also daran interessiert, Clockworks herauszufordern, was? Bist du verrückt?
dialogsBegin.fi: So you're interested in challenging Clockworks, huh? What are you, nuts?!
dialogsBegin.fil: So you're interested in challenging Clockworks, huh? What are you, nuts?!
dialogsBegin.fr: Hmm.. Apparemment tu veux défier Clockworks ! Ha ha ha ! Et bien je suis ravi de te rencontrer.
dialogsBegin.id: Jadi kamu tertarik untuk menantang Clockworks, ya? Apa yang kamu, gila?!
dialogsBegin.it: So you're interested in challenging Clockworks, huh? What are you, nuts?!
dialogsBegin.jp: ハハハっ…ハ……えっ？ 今なんと!?　ク、クロックワークスに挑戦したい!?……よろしい。そこまで言うなら、ダーコン市長の名において、君に挑戦権を与えようではないか。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그러니까, 클락워크에 도전하고 싶다고요? 제정신이세요?!
dialogsBegin.nl: So you're interested in challenging Clockworks, huh? What are you, nuts?!
dialogsBegin.pl: So you're interested in challenging Clockworks, huh? What are you, nuts?!
dialogsBegin.ru: Значит, ты хочешь сразиться с Часонизмом? Тебе, наверное, жить надоело.
dialogsBegin.sp: Así que estás interesado en desafiar a Clockworks, ¿eh? ¡¿Qué estás, loco?!
dialogsBegin.sw: So you're interested in challenging Clockworks, huh? What are you, nuts?!
dialogsBegin.th: คุณสนใจจะท้าทาย Clockworks งั้นเหรอ? คุณบ้าไปแล้วเหรอ!
dialogsBegin.tw: 你要挑戰時空毀滅者？我以得肯市長的身分授與你挑戰的權限！
dialogsBegin.vi: Vậy bạn có hứng thú với việc thử thách Clockworks không? Bạn dở hơi à?

dialogsBegin.en: Okay...if you insist. However before I help you, I need to make sure you aren't just going to walk in there and fall over dead. I need to make sure you're worthy. Okay?
dialogsBegin.ar: Okay...if you insist. However before I help you, I need to make sure you aren't just going to walk in there and fall over dead. I need to make sure you're worthy. Okay?
dialogsBegin.br: Mas... Nada vem de graça, não é? Então eu gostaria de checar se você é digno. Será que eu poderia?
dialogsBegin.cns: 首先！我要测验你的能力！！你觉得如何呢？
dialogsBegin.de: Aber! Das kannst du nicht umsonst! Daher würde ich deine Fähigkeiten testen. Darf ich?
dialogsBegin.fi: Okay...if you insist. However before I help you, I need to make sure you aren't just going to walk in there and fall over dead. I need to make sure you're worthy. Okay?
dialogsBegin.fil: Okay...if you insist. However before I help you, I need to make sure you aren't just going to walk in there and fall over dead. I need to make sure you're worthy. Okay?
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu sais Clockworks est redoutable. Es-tu sûr de vouloir l'affronter ?
dialogsBegin.id: Oke ... jika kamu bersikeras. Namun sebelum saya membantumu, saya perlu memastikan kamu tidak hanya akan berjalan di sana dan jatuh mati. Saya perlu memastikanmu layak. Oke?
dialogsBegin.it: Okay...if you insist. However before I help you, I need to make sure you aren't just going to walk in there and fall over dead. I need to make sure you're worthy. Okay?
dialogsBegin.jp: ただし！ 檻に閉じ込められているとはいえ、あの破壊の化身クロックワークスに挑む力が君に備わっているのかな？まずはそれを見極めねばならん。いいかね？
dialogsBegin.kr: 정말 하시겠다고요? 좋아요... 하지만 도와드리기 전에, 당신이 그냥 뛰어들었다 죽어버릴 사람은 아닌지 확인하고 싶어요. 실력이 있는지 확인하고 싶다고요. 어때요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Okay...if you insist. However before I help you, I need to make sure you aren't just going to walk in there and fall over dead. I need to make sure you're worthy. Okay?
dialogsBegin.pl: Okay...if you insist. However before I help you, I need to make sure you aren't just going to walk in there and fall over dead. I need to make sure you're worthy. Okay?
dialogsBegin.ru: Дело твое... И все-таки я не хочу отправлять тебя на верную смерть. Давай подготовим тебя к встрече с Часонизмом. Что скажешь?
dialogsBegin.sp: Vale... si insistes. Pero, antes de ayudarte, necesito asegurarme de que no vas a entrar y caer muerto. Necesito asegurarme de que eres digno. ¿Vale?
dialogsBegin.sw: Okay...if you insist. However before I help you, I need to make sure you aren't just going to walk in there and fall over dead. I need to make sure you're worthy. Okay?
dialogsBegin.th: โอเค... ถ้าคุณยืนกราน แต่ก่อนที่ฉันจะช่วยคุณ ฉันต้องแน่ใจว่าคุณจะไม่เดินเข้าไปในนั้นและล้มตาย ฉันต้องแน่ใจว่าคุณคู่ควร ตกลงมั้ย?
dialogsBegin.tw: 好吧……既然你堅持。不過在幫你之前，我得先確認你不會一走進去就倒地送命，也得確定你有這個資格。明白嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Được rồi ... nếu bạn cứ khăng khăng. Tuy nhiên, trước khi giúp bạn, tôi cần đảm bảo rằng bạn sẽ không bước vào đó và ngã lăn ra chết. Tôi cần chắc chắn rằng bạn có giá trị. Được chứ?

dialogsAccept.en: Great! Please visit Dr. Est. He is studying the ecology of Darkon, in the nearby Gouthan Mountains of Darkon1.
dialogsAccept.ar: Great! Please visit Dr. Est. He is studying the ecology of Darkon, in the nearby Gouthan Mountains of Darkon1.

dialogsAccept.cns: 好的！那请你去达肯1附近找到Dr.依斯特。

dialogsAccept.id: Besar! Silakan kunjungi Dr. Est. Dia sedang mempelajari ekologi Darkon, di dekat Gouthan Mountains di Darkon1.
dialogsAccept.it: Great! Please visit Dr. Est. He is studying the ecology of Darkon, in the nearby Gouthan Mountains of Darkon1.
dialogsAccept.jp: ハハハっ、いいだろう！ まずはダーコン生物学を研究している＜Dr.エスト＞を訪ねなさい。彼はダーコン第一区にある＜ゴウダン山脈＞付近にいる。
dialogsAccept.kr: 좋아요! 그럼 다콘 제1지구 고우단 산맥 근처에서 다콘의 생태계를 연구 중인 이스트 박사를 찾아가세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Great! Please visit Dr. Est. He is studying the ecology of Darkon, in the nearby Gouthan Mountains of Darkon1.
dialogsAccept.pl: Great! Please visit Dr. Est. He is studying the ecology of Darkon, in the nearby Gouthan Mountains of Darkon1.
dialogsAccept.ru: Отлично! Отправляйся в доктору То. Он большой специалист по экологии Мадригала. Ищи его в Гутанских горах на Дарконе-1.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Genial! Por favor visita al Dr. Est. Está estudiando la ecología de Darkon, cerca de las Montañas Gouthan de Darkon 1.
dialogsAccept.sw: Great! Please visit Dr. Est. He is studying the ecology of Darkon, in the nearby Gouthan Mountains of Darkon1.
dialogsAccept.th: ยอดเยี่ยม! ไปหา Dr.Est. เขากำลังศึกษานิเวศวิทยาของ Darkon ในภูเขา Gouthan Mountains ที่ Darkon1
dialogsAccept.tw: 好的！那請你去得肯 1 區附近古坦山脈找到 Dr. 法小紀。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tuyệt quá! Vui lòng đến thăm Dr. Est. Anh ta đang nghiên cứu hệ sinh thái của Darkon, gần Gouthan Mountains của Darkon1.

dialogsDecline.en: Backing out already? Hahaha! I knew you were all talk…
dialogsDecline.ar: Backing out already? Hahaha! I knew you were all talk…
dialogsDecline.br: Já está recuando? Hahaha! Eu sabia que você só falácia...
dialogsDecline.cns: 怕什么呢？这样怎么跟时空毁灭者对决呢？
dialogsDecline.de: Machst' schon einen Rückzieher? Hahaha! Ich wusste, dass du nur redest...
dialogsDecline.fi: Backing out already? Hahaha! I knew you were all talk…
dialogsDecline.fil: Backing out already? Hahaha! I knew you were all talk…
dialogsDecline.fr: Ha ha ha ! Nous commencions juste, tu ne devrais pas t'inquiéter pour si peu, sinon tu ne seras plus jamais à même de t'approcher de Clockworks.
dialogsDecline.id: Sudah mundur? Hahaha! Saya tahu kamu semua berbicara ...
dialogsDecline.it: Backing out already? Hahaha! I knew you were all talk…
dialogsDecline.jp: なんだ、もう怖気づいたのかね？ それでよくクロックワークスに挑戦したいなどと言えたものだね。ハハハ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 벌써 포기하려고요? 하하하! 그래서 처음부터 말만 번지르르한 사람 같더라니...
dialogsDecline.nl: Backing out already? Hahaha! I knew you were all talk…
dialogsDecline.pl: Backing out already? Hahaha! I knew you were all talk…
dialogsDecline.ru: Backing out already? Hahaha! I knew you were all talk…
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Ya estás retrocediendo? ¡Jajaja! Sabía que eras todo palabrería...
dialogsDecline.sw: Backing out already? Hahaha! I knew you were all talk…
dialogsDecline.th: ยอมแพ้แล้วเหรอ? ฮ่าๆๆๆ! กะแล้วว่าคุณแค่อวดเก่ง...
dialogsDecline.tw: 怕什麼呢？這樣怎麼跟時空毀滅者對決呢？
dialogsDecline.vi: Nuốt lời rồi sao? Hahaha! Tôi biết bạn chỉ có nói thôi…

dialogsComplete.en: Oh, did the Mayor of Darkon send you? You must be the one he was talking about that's crazy enough to challenge Clockworks. Here, you'll need this book.
dialogsComplete.ar: Oh, did the Mayor of Darkon send you? You must be the one he was talking about that's crazy enough to challenge Clockworks. Here, you'll need this book.
dialogsComplete.br: Ah, o Prefeito de Darkon o enviou? Hmm... Então você realmente quer desafiá-lo, não é? Aqui está. Pegue esse livro.
dialogsComplete.cns: 你是达肯市长派来的吗？请收下这本书吧！！
dialogsComplete.de: Oh, hat dich der Bürgermeister von Darkon geschickt? Hmm... Also willst du Clockworks wirklich herausfordern, richtig? Also gut. Nimm dieses Buch.
dialogsComplete.fi: Oh, did the Mayor of Darkon send you? You must be the one he was talking about that's crazy enough to challenge Clockworks. Here, you'll need this book.
dialogsComplete.fil: Oh, did the Mayor of Darkon send you? You must be the one he was talking about that's crazy enough to challenge Clockworks. Here, you'll need this book.
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh, est-ce le Maire de Darkon qui t'envoies ?? Hmm.. Alors tu veux vraiment le défier, c'est ça ? Voilà pour toi, prends ce livre.
dialogsComplete.id: Oh, apakah Walikota Darkon mengirimmu? Kamu pasti orang yang dia bicarakan yang cukup gila untuk menantang Clockworks. Di sini, kamu akan membutuhkan buku ini.
dialogsComplete.it: Oh, did the Mayor of Darkon send you? You must be the one he was talking about that's crazy enough to challenge Clockworks. Here, you'll need this book.
dialogsComplete.jp: ん？ダーコン市長に命じられて、ここまで来たのかい？ということは、クロックワークスに挑戦するんだね。じゃあ、この本を持って行きなよ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 오, 다콘 시장님이 보내셨군요? 클락워크에 도전할 만큼 미친 용기를 가진 사람이 바로 당신인가 보네요. 자, 이 책을 드릴게요. 필요하실 거예요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Oh, did the Mayor of Darkon send you? You must be the one he was talking about that's crazy enough to challenge Clockworks. Here, you'll need this book.
dialogsComplete.pl: Oh, did the Mayor of Darkon send you? You must be the one he was talking about that's crazy enough to challenge Clockworks. Here, you'll need this book.
dialogsComplete.ru: А, тебя прислал ко мне мэр Даркона? Так значит, это ты - "безумный самоубийца, который хочет бросить вызов Часонизму"? Вот, держи, эта книга тебе пригодится.
dialogsComplete.sp: Oh, ¿te envía el Alcalde de Darken? Debes ser tú el loco del que me hablaba, tan loco como para desafiar a Clockworks. Toma, necesitarás este libro.
dialogsComplete.sw: Oh, did the Mayor of Darkon send you? You must be the one he was talking about that's crazy enough to challenge Clockworks. Here, you'll need this book.
dialogsComplete.th: โอ้ นายกเทศมนตรี Darkon ส่งคุณมาเหรอ? คุณต้องเป็นคนที่เขาพูดถึงที่บ้าพอที่จะท้าทาย Clockworks ที่นี่ คุณจะต้องการหนังสือเล่มนี้
dialogsComplete.tw: 喔，是得肯市長派你來的嗎？你一定就是他提過、瘋狂到敢挑戰時空毀滅者的人。來，這本書你會用得上。
dialogsComplete.vi: Ồ, có phải Thị trưởng Darkon đã gửi cho bạn không? Bạn hẳn là người mà anh ấy kể về điều đủ điên rồ để thách thức Clockworks. Đây, bạn sẽ cần cuốn sách này.

dialogsComplete.en: It contains information about how Clockworks appeared here in Madrigal. It's a good read, but not for the faint of heart.
dialogsComplete.ar: It contains information about how Clockworks appeared here in Madrigal. It's a good read, but not for the faint of heart.
dialogsComplete.br: Ele contém informações de como Clockworks apareceu aqui em Madrigal. Por favor, leia-o mais tarde, será muito útil.
dialogsComplete.cns: 这本书在研究有关时空毁灭者的研究结果！对你会有帮助的，拿去参考吧！
dialogsComplete.de: Es enthält alle Informationen wie Clockworks in Madrigal aufgetaucht ist. Bitte lies es, es könnte später hilfreich sein.
dialogsComplete.fi: It contains information about how Clockworks appeared here in Madrigal. It's a good read, but not for the faint of heart.
dialogsComplete.fil: It contains information about how Clockworks appeared here in Madrigal. It's a good read, but not for the faint of heart.
dialogsComplete.fr: Il contient des informations sur l'apparition de Clockworks à Madrigal. Lis-le quand tu auras un peu de temps, ça te sera trèèèès utile.
dialogsComplete.id: Ini berisi informasi tentang bagaimana Clockworks muncul di sini di Madrigal. Ini bacaan yang bagus, tapi tidak untuk yang lemah hati.
dialogsComplete.it: It contains information about how Clockworks appeared here in Madrigal. It's a good read, but not for the faint of heart.
dialogsComplete.jp: この本はクロックワークスがなぜマドリカルに現れたのか？その研究成果をまとめた本なんだ。君の助けになるはずだよ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이 책에는 클락워크가 마드리갈에 어떻게 나타나게 되었는지 담겨 있어요. 읽을 만한 가치는 있지만, 마음이 여리다면 읽기 힘들 거예요.
dialogsComplete.nl: It contains information about how Clockworks appeared here in Madrigal. It's a good read, but not for the faint of heart.
dialogsComplete.pl: It contains information about how Clockworks appeared here in Madrigal. It's a good read, but not for the faint of heart.
dialogsComplete.ru: В ней рассказано о том, как Часонизм появился в Мадригале. Очень интересно, но на ночь лучше не читать.
dialogsComplete.sp: Contiene información sobre cómo Clockworks apareció en Madrigal. Es una buena lectura, pero no para los débiles de corazón.
dialogsComplete.sw: It contains information about how Clockworks appeared here in Madrigal. It's a good read, but not for the faint of heart.
dialogsComplete.th: มันมีข้อมูลเกี่ยวกับวิธีที่ Clockworks ปรากฏใน Madrigal เป็นเรื่องที่น่าอ่าน แต่ไม่เหมาะกับคนใจอ่อน
dialogsComplete.tw: 這本書在研究有關時空毀滅者的研究結果！對你會有幫助的，拿去參考吧！
dialogsComplete.vi: Nó chứa thông tin về cách Clockworks xuất hiện ở đây ở Madrigal. Đây là một cuốn sách hay, nhưng không dành cho những người yếu tim.

dialogsFail.en: Clockworks is one of the most dangerous monsters in Madrigal! He's huge! I have been studying him for 4 years now, but I still don't know everything about him.
dialogsFail.ar: Clockworks is one of the most dangerous monsters in Madrigal! He's huge! I have been studying him for 4 years now, but I still don't know everything about him.
dialogsFail.br: Clockworks é um monstro enorme e muito perigoso. Eu venho estudando Clockworks por 4 anos, mas há muitas coisas que ainda não sei.
dialogsFail.cns: 时空毁灭者真的很厉害~我研究它已经快4年了，但依然还有很多不了解的地方！
dialogsFail.de: Clockworks ist ein riesiges und gefährliches Monster. Ich studiere ihn schon seit 4 Jahren, aber es gibt immernoch viele Dinge die ich nicht verstehe.
dialogsFail.fi: Clockworks is one of the most dangerous monsters in Madrigal! He's huge! I have been studying him for 4 years now, but I still don't know everything about him.
dialogsFail.fil: Clockworks is one of the most dangerous monsters in Madrigal! He's huge! I have been studying him for 4 years now, but I still don't know everything about him.
dialogsFail.fr: Clockworks est un monstre gigantesque et terrifiant ! Je l'étudie depuis 4 ans, mais il y a encore beaucoup de choses que j'ignore à son sujet.
dialogsFail.id: Clockworks adalah salah satu monster paling berbahaya di Madrigal! Dia besar! Saya telah mempelajarinya selama 4 tahun sekarang, tetapi saya masih belum tahu segalanya tentang dia.
dialogsFail.it: Clockworks is one of the most dangerous monsters in Madrigal! He's huge! I have been studying him for 4 years now, but I still don't know everything about him.
dialogsFail.jp: クロックワークスかぁ…まさしく超ど級の存在だね。研究を始めて、もう4年になるけど、わからない事だらけで…やんなっちゃうよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 클락워크는 마드리갈에서 가장 위험한 몬스터 중 하나랍니다! 엄청나게 크죠! 4년 동안 그에 관해 연구해 왔지만, 아직도 모르는 게 많아요.
dialogsFail.nl: Clockworks is one of the most dangerous monsters in Madrigal! He's huge! I have been studying him for 4 years now, but I still don't know everything about him.
dialogsFail.pl: Clockworks is one of the most dangerous monsters in Madrigal! He's huge! I have been studying him for 4 years now, but I still don't know everything about him.
dialogsFail.ru: Часонизм - один из самых ужасных механизмов Мадригала. Я изучаю его уже четыре года, но до сих пор знаю далеко не все.
dialogsFail.sp: ¡Clockworks es uno de los monstruos más peligrosos de Madrigal! ¡Es enorme! Lo he estado estudiando durante 4 años, pero todavía no lo sé todo sobre él.
dialogsFail.sw: Clockworks is one of the most dangerous monsters in Madrigal! He's huge! I have been studying him for 4 years now, but I still don't know everything about him.
dialogsFail.th: Clockworks เป็นหนึ่งในสัตว์ประหลาดที่อันตรายที่สุดใน Madrigal! มันตัวใหญ่มาก! ฉันศึกษามันมา 4 ปีแล้ว แต่ฉันยังไม่รู้ทุกอย่างเกี่ยวกับมันเลย
dialogsFail.tw: 時空毀滅者真的很厲害~我研究它已經快 4 年了，但依然還有很多不了解的地方！
dialogsFail.vi: Clockworks là một trong những quái vật nguy hiểm nhất ở Madrigal! Anh ấy rất to lớn! Tôi đã tìm hiểu anh ấy 4 năm nay, nhưng tôi vẫn chưa biết nhiều về anh ấy.

description.en: Bring the seal of the chief and the package that Drian is holding back to Nevil.
description.ar: Bring the seal of the chief and the package that Drian is holding back to Nevil.
description.br: Traga o símbolo do chefe e o pacote que Drian está guardando de volta para Nevil.
description.cns: 将德里安身上的“族长的印章”与“行李箱”带回给蓝彼。
description.de: Bring das Siegel des Häuptlings und das Paket, das Drian aufbewahrt, zurück zu Nevil.
description.fi: Bring the seal of the chief and the package that Drian is holding back to Nevil.
description.fil: Dalhin ang seal of the chief at ang packagee na tinatago ni Drian kay Nevil.
description.fr: Trouver le Sceau de Nevil sur les Sentinelles Keakoons Elite, et récupérer les Affaires de Nevil auprès de Drian.
description.id: Bawa stempel ketua dan paket yang dipegang Drian ke Nevil.
description.it: Bring the seal of the chief and the package that Drian is holding back to Nevil.
description.jp: ＜キクン族長の印＞ と ＜ドリアンの荷物＞ をネビルに持っていく。
description.kr: 족장의 인장과, 드리안이 들고 있는 패키지를 네빌에게 돌려주세요.
description.nl: Bring the seal of the chief and the package that Drian is holding back to Nevil.
description.pl: Przynieś pieczęć szefa i paczkę, którą trzyma Drian.
description.ru: Принеси Невилу печать вождя и свёрток, который хранит Драйн.
description.sp: Lleva el Sello del Jefe y el paquete que Drian está guardando a Nevil.
description.sw: Bring the seal of the chief and the package that Drian is holding back to Nevil.
description.th: นำตราประทับของหัวหน้าและแพ็คเกจที่ Drian ถืออยู่มายัง Nevil
description.tw: 把族長的印章和得安保管的包裹帶回去交給藍彼。
description.vi: Mang con dấu của chief và gói hàng mà Drian đang giữ lại cho Nevil.

descriptionComplete.en: You rescued Nevil, chief of the Keakoon. You can feel the secrets around this place. Maybe you can get some information from Bernard.
descriptionComplete.ar: You rescued Nevil, chief of the Keakoon. You can feel the secrets around this place. Maybe you can get some information from Bernard.
descriptionComplete.br: Você salvou Nevil, chefe dos Keakoon. Você poderá sentir os segredos em torno desse lugar. Talvez você obtenha algumas informações de Bernard.
descriptionComplete.cns: 一进矿山就见到奇昆族，帮他们解决问题了，以蓝彼说的来看，这个矿山好像还有很多秘密...我应该要去找番若迪问问看才对。
descriptionComplete.de: Du hast den Häuptling der Keakoon gerettet. Dieser Ort scheint aber noch weitere Geheimnisse zu haben. Vielleicht weiß Bernard mehr darüber.
descriptionComplete.fi: You rescued Nevil, chief of the Keakoon. You can feel the secrets around this place. Maybe you can get some information from Bernard.
descriptionComplete.fil: Niligtas mo si Nevil, kapitan ng Keakoon. Nararamdaman mo ang mga lihim sa lugar na ito. Baka makakuha ka ng impormasyon kay Bernard.
descriptionComplete.fr: Nevil, le Grand Chef des Keakons, est sain et sauf, mais il semble que la mine recèle encore bien des secrets... Bernard à Darkon devrait en savoir plus.
descriptionComplete.id: Kamu menyelamatkan Nevil, kepala Keakoon. Kamu bisa merasakan rahasia disekitar tempat ini. Mungkin kamu akan mendapatkan beberapa informasi dari Bernard.
descriptionComplete.it: You rescued Nevil, chief of the Keakoon. You can feel the secrets around this place. Maybe you can get some information from Bernard.
descriptionComplete.jp: 鉱山の入り口で出会ったキクン族のドリアンのお父さんで族長でもある、ネビルを救ってあげた。ネビルによると、この鉱山にはまだ秘密が多いらしいが…まずがバナードに会ってからだな。
descriptionComplete.kr: 당신은 키쿤의 추장, 네빌을 구했습니다. 이곳에는 무언가 비밀이 감돌고 있습니다. 어쩌면 버나드에게서 무언가 알아낼 수 있을지도 모르죠.
descriptionComplete.nl: You rescued Nevil, chief of the Keakoon. You can feel the secrets around this place. Maybe you can get some information from Bernard.
descriptionComplete.pl: Uratowałeś Nevila, wodza Keakoon. Wokół tego miejsca można poczuć tajemnice. Może uzyskasz jakieś informacje od Bernarda.
descriptionComplete.ru: Невил, вождь хряков, спасен, но тайна Шахты Распада осталась неразгаданной. Возможно, Бернард подскажет, как ее разгадать.
descriptionComplete.sp: Rescataste a Nevil, jefe de los Keakoon. Puedes sentir los secretos de este lugar. Tal vez puedas obtener algo de información de Bernard.
descriptionComplete.sw: You rescued Nevil, chief of the Keakoon. You can feel the secrets around this place. Maybe you can get some information from Bernard.
descriptionComplete.th: คุณช่วย Nevil หัวหน้า Keakoon คุณสัมผัสความลับรอบๆ นี้ได้ บางทีคุณอาจได้รับข้อมูลบางอย่างจาก Bernard
descriptionComplete.tw: 一進礦坑就見到奇昆族，幫他們解決問題了，以藍彼說的來看，這個礦坑好像還有很多秘密…我應該要去找番若迪問問看才對。
descriptionComplete.vi: Bạn đã giải cứu Nevil, tộc trưởng Keakoon. Bạn có thể cảm nhận được những bí mật xung quanh nơi này. Có lẽ bạn có thể nhận được một số thông tin từ Bernard.

dialogsBegin.en: Many thanks, friend. You have done so much for us but would you do something more?
dialogsBegin.ar: Many thanks, friend. You have done so much for us but would you do something more?
dialogsBegin.br: Muito obrigado, amigo. Você fez muito por nós, mas será que faria algo mais?
dialogsBegin.cns: 真的是很感谢你啦～看你能够把我救出来，你一定是一个很厉害的战士。所以啊～你可以在帮我一件事情吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Ich danke dir sehr. Du hast bereits so viel für uns getan, aber würdest du uns noch einen weiteren Gefallen tun?
dialogsBegin.fi: Many thanks, friend. You have done so much for us but would you do something more?
dialogsBegin.fil: Maraming salamat, kaibigan. Marami kang nagawa para sa amin, ngunit pwede ba na may magawa kapa?
dialogsBegin.fr: Merci infiniment ! C'est tellement courageux de ta part de m'avoir tiré de cette infâme prison ! Je vois que tu es vraiment brave, pourrais-tu encore me faire une faveur s'il te plaît ?
dialogsBegin.id: Terima kasih banyak, teman. Kamu telah melakukan banyak hal untuk kami tetapi apakah kamu akan melakukan hal lainnya?
dialogsBegin.it: Many thanks, friend. You have done so much for us but would you do something more?
dialogsBegin.jp:
カッカッカッ。いやあ、どうもありがとう。私を助けてくれたことからみて、誠に勇気があって優秀な勇者だ！
そんなオヌシに、実はもう一つ頼みたい事があるんだが、引き受けてはくださらんか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 정말 고맙습니다, 친구. 이미 많은 걸 해주신 걸 알지만, 한 가지만 더 부탁해도 될까요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Many thanks, friend. You have done so much for us but would you do something more?
dialogsBegin.pl: Wielkie dzięki, przyjacielu. Tyle dla nas zrobiłeś, ale czy zrobiłbyś coś więcej?
dialogsBegin.ru: Спасибо тебе, друг благородных хряков. Возьмешься исполнить небольшое поручение?
dialogsBegin.sp: Muchas gracias, amigo. Has hecho tanto por nosotros, pero ¿harías algo más?
dialogsBegin.sw: Many thanks, friend. You have done so much for us but would you do something more?
dialogsBegin.th: ขอบคุณมาก สหาย คุณทำเพื่อพวกเรามามากแล้ว แต่คุณยังอยากทำอะไรมากกว่านี้อีกมั้ย?
dialogsBegin.tw: 真的是很感謝你啦～看你能夠把我救出來，你一定是一個很厲害的戰士。所以啊～你可以在幫我一件事情嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Cảm ơn rất nhiều, bạn của tôi. Bạn đã làm rất nhiều cho chúng tôi nhưng bạn có muốn làm gì hơn nữa không?

dialogsAccept.en: Please defeat the Elite Keakoon Guard Leader and bring me the Chief Sign that proves I am the one true Chief of the Keakoon. Would you also please bring me the cargo my son Drian is keeping safe for me?
dialogsAccept.ar: Please defeat the Elite Keakoon Guard Leader and bring me the Chief Sign that proves I am the one true Chief of the Keakoon. Would you also please bring me the cargo my son Drian is keeping safe for me?
dialogsAccept.br: Por favor, derrote o líder da Elite Keakoon Guard e traga-me o Símbolo do Chefe que prova que sou o verdadeiro chefe dos Keakoon. Também poderia trazer-me a carga que meu filho Drian está guardando para mim?
dialogsAccept.cns: 我有两件事情想拜托你，首先、我要证明我是奇昆族的族长，需要猎杀[精英奇昆警卫队长]帮我找回印章。第2件事情就是，请你去找我儿子，拿回我的行李。
dialogsAccept.de: Bitte besiege den Anführer der Keakoon-Elitewache und bring mir das Häuptlingszeichen, das beweist, dass ich der einzig wahre Häuptling der Keakoon bin. Würdest du mir bitte auch die Fracht bringen, die mein Sohn Drian sicher für mich aufbewahrt?
dialogsAccept.fi: Please defeat the Elite Keakoon Guard Leader and bring me the Chief Sign that proves I am the one true Chief of the Keakoon. Would you also please bring me the cargo my son Drian is keeping safe for me?
dialogsAccept.fil: Pakiusap talunin mo ang Elite Keakoon Guard Leader at dalihin mo ang Chief Sign na nagpapatunay na ako ang tunay na Kapitan ng mga Keakoon. At pwede rin ba madala mo sa akin ang bagay na tinatago ng aking anak na si Drian para sa akin?
dialogsAccept.fr: Alors, j'aimerais que tu fasses deux choses pour moi. Premièrement, chasse les Sentinelles Keakoon Elite et trouve le Sceau qui prouve que je suis bien leur Grand Chef. Puis retourne voir mon fils et ramène mes affaires qu'il conserve précieusement.
dialogsAccept.id: Tolong kalahkan Elite Keakoon Guard Leader dan bawakan saya Tanda Utama yang membuktikan bahwa saya adalah satu-satunya Kepala Keakoon yang sebenarnya. Maukah Anda juga membawakan saya kargo yang disimpan anak saya Drian untuk saya?
dialogsAccept.it: Please defeat the Elite Keakoon Guard Leader and bring me the Chief Sign that proves I am the one true Chief of the Keakoon. Would you also please bring me the cargo my son Drian is keeping safe for me?
dialogsAccept.jp: まず、私がキクン族の大族長ということを証明する ＜キクン族長の印＞ を探してほしい。現在のエリートキクンガードリーダーを倒してが持っているだろう。もうひとつは息子のドリアンに預けてある荷物をここへ持ってきてほしい。カッカッカッ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 정예 키쿤 경비대장을 처치하고, 제가 진정한 키쿤의 족장임을 증명하는 족장의 인장을 가져와 주시죠. 그리고 우리 아들 드리안이 안전하게 보관하고 있는 화물도 가져다줄 수 있는지?
dialogsAccept.nl: Please defeat the Elite Keakoon Guard Leader and bring me the Chief Sign that proves I am the one true Chief of the Keakoon. Would you also please bring me the cargo my son Drian is keeping safe for me?
dialogsAccept.pl: Proszę, przynieś mi pieczęć, która dowodzi, że jestem jedynym prawdziwym wodzem Keakoon. Czy mógłbyś również przynieść mi paczkę, którą mój syn przechowuje dla mnie w bezpiecznym miejscu?
dialogsAccept.ru: Одолей Элитного предводителя стражи хряков и принеси мне Знак вождя — он докажет, что я единственный законный вождь хряков. И еще: не передашь ли мне груз, который хранит мой сын Драйн?
dialogsAccept.sp: Por favor, derrota al líder Guardia Élite Keakoon y tráeme el Muestra Jefe que prueba que soy el verdadero Jefe de Keakoon. ¿Podrías también traerme la carga que mi hijo Drian guarda para mí?
dialogsAccept.sw: Please defeat the Elite Keakoon Guard Leader and bring me the Chief Sign that proves I am the one true Chief of the Keakoon. Would you also please bring me the cargo my son Drian is keeping safe for me?
dialogsAccept.th: โปรดช่วยข้ากำจัด Elite Keakoon Guard Leader และนำตราประทับที่พิสูจน์ให้เห็นว่าฉันเป็นหัวหน้าที่แท้จริงของ Keakoon มาให้ฉัน แล้วก็ช่วยนำแพ็คเกจที่ลูกชายข้า Drain เก็บไว้ให้ฉันมาด้วยได้มั้ย
dialogsAccept.tw: 我有 2 件事情想拜託你，首先、我要證明我是奇昆族的族長，需要獵殺奇昆的頭目幫我找回印章。第 2 件事情就是，請你去找我兒子，拿回我的行李。
dialogsAccept.vi: Hãy đánh bại Elite Keakoon Guard Leader và mang cho tôi Chief Sign chứng minh rằng tôi là Chief of the Keakoon thực sự duy nhất. Bạn vui lòng mang cho tôi cargo mà con trai tôi, Drian, đang giữ an toàn cho tôi?

dialogsDecline.en: What kind of person are you if you refuse to help those with less power than you?
dialogsDecline.ar: What kind of person are you if you refuse to help those with less power than you?
dialogsDecline.br: Que tipo de pessoa é você, que recusa ajuda àqueles mais fracos que você.
dialogsDecline.cns: 你有实力，可是不帮弱者，这哪叫做是一个勇士呢......
dialogsDecline.de: Du kannst kein tapferer Mensch sein, wenn du nicht den schwächeren hilfst, obwohl du die Kraft dazu hast.
dialogsDecline.fi: What kind of person are you if you refuse to help those with less power than you?
dialogsDecline.fil: Anong klaseng tao ka na ayaw tumulong sa mga mas mahina sa iyo?
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu ne peux pas être qualifié de courageux si tu détiens la force, mais que tu n'aides pas ton prochain.
dialogsDecline.id: Orang macam apa kamu jika kamu menolak untuk membantu mereka yang memiliki kekuatan lebih kecil dari kamu?
dialogsDecline.it: What kind of person are you if you refuse to help those with less power than you?
dialogsDecline.jp: カッカッカッ。力のみ強くても、弱いものを救う気持ちがなければ、勇者とは呼べないのだが…
dialogsDecline.kr: 힘이 있어도 약자를 돕지 않으면 어찌 용사라고 할 수 있는가?
dialogsDecline.nl: What kind of person are you if you refuse to help those with less power than you?
dialogsDecline.pl: Jakim jesteś człowiekiem, jeśli odmawiasz pomocy tym, którzy mają mniej mocy niż ty?
dialogsDecline.ru: Увы мне! Что же ты за человек, если не хочешь помочь слабому, попавшему в беду?..
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Qué tipo de persona eres si te niegas a ayudar a aquellos con menos poder que tú?
dialogsDecline.sw: What kind of person are you if you refuse to help those with less power than you?
dialogsDecline.th: คุณเป็นคนแบบไหนถึงปฏิเสธที่จะช่วยเหลือผู้ที่อ่อนแอกว่า
dialogsDecline.tw: 你有實力，卻不幫弱者，這那能稱作是一個勇士呢？
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn là người như thế nào nếu bạn từ chối giúp đỡ những người có quyền lực kém hơn mình?

dialogsComplete.en: Thank you. It is my great hope that Keakoon and human can thrive together once again. Take this ring as a gift.
dialogsComplete.ar: Thank you. It is my great hope that Keakoon and human can thrive together once again. Take this ring as a gift.
dialogsComplete.br: Obrigado. Minha maior esperança é que Keakoons e humanos possam prosperar juntos novamente. Pegue este anel como um presente.
dialogsComplete.cns: 谢谢你啦～真希望我们可以像以前一样，可以与人类好好相处，这是我送你的礼物，收下吧！看你来到这么危险的达肯矿洞...你应该很喜欢挑战冒险吧～
dialogsComplete.de: Ich danke dir. Ich hoffe, die Keakoons und die Menschen können erneut zu Freunden werden. Bitte nimm diesen Ring als mein Geschenk an dich.
dialogsComplete.fi: Thank you. It is my great hope that Keakoon and human can thrive together once again. Take this ring as a gift.
dialogsComplete.fil: Salamat. Ito ay isang pag asa na ang Keakoon at sangkatauhan ay mamumuhay ng matiwasay ulit. Kunin mo ang singsing na ito bilang regalo.
dialogsComplete.fr: Je te suis infiniment reconnaissant ! J'espère que les Keakoons et les humains entretiendront bientôt des relations amicales à nouveau... Accepte cet Anneau en gage de ma reconnaissance, bien que ce soit très peu pour le courageux aventurier que tu es.
dialogsComplete.id: Terima kasih. Ini adalah harapan besarku bahwa Keakoon dan manusia dapat berkembang bersama sekali lagi. Ambil cincin ini sebagai hadiah.
dialogsComplete.it: Thank you. It is my great hope that Keakoon and human can thrive together once again. Take this ring as a gift.
dialogsComplete.jp: ありがとう。昔のように人間達とキクン族が、再び仲良くなる日が来ると、私は信じている。このリングはその気持ちだ。受け取ってくれ。カッカッカッ。ところでオヌシ、この ＜デェカネス鉱山＞ に入ってくるとは、筋金入りの冒険者だな。
dialogsComplete.kr: 고맙습니다. 키쿤과 인간이 다시 함께 평화롭게 살아갈 수 있기를 진심으로 바랍니다. 이 반지를 선물로 드릴게요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Thank you. It is my great hope that Keakoon and human can thrive together once again. Take this ring as a gift.
dialogsComplete.pl: Dziękuję Ci. Mam wielką nadzieję, że Keakoon i ludzie znów będą się dobrze rozwijać. Weź ten pierścionek jako prezent.
dialogsComplete.ru: Надеюсь, придет день, и наши народы вновь будут рыть землю бок о бок. Прими в подарок это кольцо.
dialogsComplete.sp: Gracias. Es mi gran esperanza que Keakoon y humanos puedan prosperar juntos una vez más. Llévate este anillo como regalo.
dialogsComplete.sw: Thank you. It is my great hope that Keakoon and human can thrive together once again. Take this ring as a gift.
dialogsComplete.th: ขอบคุณมาก คุณเป็นความหวังเดียวที่จะทำให้ Keakoon และชาวเมืองเจริญรุ่งเรืองได้อีกครั้ง รับแหวนนี้เป็นของขวัญสิ
dialogsComplete.tw: 謝謝你啦～真希望我們可以像以前一樣，可以與人類好好相處，這是我送你的禮物，收下吧！看你來到這麼危險的迪肯…你應該很喜歡挑戰冒險囉～
dialogsComplete.vi: Cảm ơn bạn. Tôi hy vọng rất lớn rằng Keakoon và loài người có thể phát triển cùng nhau một lần nữa. Hãy lấy chiếc nhẫn này như một món quà.

dialogsComplete.en: If, by any chance, you want more adventure visit Bernard in Darken. Be careful. I would hate for something to happen to you.
dialogsComplete.ar: If, by any chance, you want more adventure visit Bernard in Darken. Be careful. I would hate for something to happen to you.
dialogsComplete.br: Se, por acaso, você quiser mais aventuras, visite Bernard em Darken. Tome cuidado. Eu odiaria se algo acontecesse com você.
dialogsComplete.cns: 一说到冒险啊～也没有比这里还要棒的地方了。如果你要继续挑战冒险的话，可以去村庄找“番若迪”喔～说不定你可以抢救这个矿山。这是到下一个地区钥匙，收下吧！
dialogsComplete.de: Besuche Bernard in Darkon, falls dir der Sinn nach weiteren Abenteuern steht. Aber sei vorsichtig und pass auf dich auf.
dialogsComplete.fi: If, by any chance, you want more adventure visit Bernard in Darken. Be careful. I would hate for something to happen to you.
dialogsComplete.fil: Kung, sakali man, gusto mo ng paglalakbay bisitahin mo si Bernard sa Darken. Mag-iingat ka. Ayaw ko may mangyari sa iyo.
dialogsComplete.fr: Si tu recherches une autre poussée d'adrénaline, rends visite à Bernard à Darken, il pourra peut-être t'aider à résoudre le mystère de cette maudite mine. Prends cette clé, elle te servira pour pénétrer dans les tréfonds de la mine... Soit prudent !
dialogsComplete.id: Jika, kebetulan, kamu ingin lebih banyak petualangan kunjungi Bernard di Darken. Hati-hati. Aku benci jika sesuatu terjadi padamu.
dialogsComplete.it: If, by any chance, you want more adventure visit Bernard in Darken. Be careful. I would hate for something to happen to you.
dialogsComplete.jp: カッカッカッ。さらなる冒険を求めるのであれば、＜ダーコン＞ のバナードという人物をたずねてみるといい。さあ、この鍵は次のゾーンへ移動させてくれる鍵だ。受け取るがいい、冒険者よ！
dialogsComplete.kr: 혹시 더 많은 모험을 원하신다면, 다켄에 있는 버나드를 찾아가보세요. 조심하세요. 당신에게 무슨 일이 생기는 건 싫으니까요.
dialogsComplete.nl: If, by any chance, you want more adventure visit Bernard in Darken. Be careful. I would hate for something to happen to you.
dialogsComplete.pl: Jeśli przypadkiem masz ochotę na więcej przygód, odwiedź Bernard w Darken. Bądź ostrożny. Nie chciałbym, żeby coś ci się stało.
dialogsComplete.ru: Если приключения и опасности тебе еще не наскучили, поговори с Бернардом в Дарконе. Береги себя. Нам жаль будет потерять верного друга.
dialogsComplete.sp: Si, por casualidad, quieres más aventuras, visita a Bernard en Darken. Ten cuidado. No me gustaría que te pasara algo.
dialogsComplete.sw: If, by any chance, you want more adventure visit Bernard in Darken. Be careful. I would hate for something to happen to you.
dialogsComplete.th: ถ้าคุณอยากได้โอกาสอีกครั้ง ไปหา Bernard ใน Darken ระวังตัวด้วย
dialogsComplete.tw: 一說到冒險啊～也沒有比這裡還要棒的地方了。如果你要繼續挑戰冒險的話，可以去村莊找『番若迪』喔～說不定你可以搶救這個礦坑。這是到下一個地區鑰匙，收下吧！
dialogsComplete.vi: Nếu, có cơ hội, bạn muốn có nhiều cuộc phiêu lưu hơn, hãy đến thăm Bernard ở Darken. Hãy cẩn thận. Tôi sẽ ghét điều gì đó xảy ra với bạn.

dialogsFail.en: Hrmm… It might not be that dangerous for someone as strong as you.
dialogsFail.ar: Hrmm… It might not be that dangerous for someone as strong as you.
dialogsFail.br: Hrmm… Pode não ser tão perigoso para alguém tão forte como você.
dialogsFail.cns: 嗯...你都可以把我从大牢里救出来了，所以对你来说应该不是一件困难的事情啦！
dialogsFail.de: Hmm… Für jemanden mit deiner Stärke sollte es nicht gefährlich sein.
dialogsFail.fi: Hrmm… It might not be that dangerous for someone as strong as you.
dialogsFail.fil: Hrmm... Di naman siguro ito ganito kadelikado para sa taong kasinglakas mo.
dialogsFail.fr: Hmmm, ce que je te demande ne devrait pas te poser de difficultés, puisque tu as réussi à me libérer.
dialogsFail.id: Hrmm…Mungkin tidak terlalu berbahaya bagi seseorang yang sekuat dirimu.
dialogsFail.it: Hrmm… It might not be that dangerous for someone as strong as you.
dialogsFail.jp: 私を助けてくれるほどの勇者なら、きっと謎を解いてくれるだろう。カッカッカッ。
dialogsFail.kr: 음... 나를 구할 정도의 인간이라면 결코 어려운 일이 아닐 거야.
dialogsFail.nl: Hrmm… It might not be that dangerous for someone as strong as you.
dialogsFail.pl: Hrmm… To może nie być takie niebezpieczne dla kogoś tak silnego jak ty.
dialogsFail.ru: Хрюк!.. Тебе это должно быть по силам…
dialogsFail.sp: Hrmm... Puede que no sea tan peligroso para alguien tan fuerte como tú.
dialogsFail.sw: Hrmm… It might not be that dangerous for someone as strong as you.
dialogsFail.th: หืมมม คุณดูแข็งแรงมาก ไม่น่าจะเป็นอันตรายได้นะ
dialogsFail.tw: 嗯…你都可以把我從大牢裡救出來了，所以對你來說應該不是一件困難的事情啦！
dialogsFail.vi: Hrmm...Nó có thể không nguy hiểm cho một người mạnh mẽ như bạn

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?
