dialogsDecline.en: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.ar: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.br: Você ainda tem que pagar pelos seus pecados...
dialogsDecline.cns: 你还没有为你的罪恶付出代价...
dialogsDecline.de: Du musst noch immer für deine Sünden bezahlen...
dialogsDecline.fi: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.fil: Di mo pa bayad ang iyong mga kasalanan…
dialogsDecline.fr: Quand expieras-tu tes nombreux crimes ?
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu belum membayar untuk dosa-dosamu…
dialogsDecline.it: Devi ancora pagare per i tuoi peccati...
dialogsDecline.jp: いつになったら、この底知れぬ罪悪感から抜けられるのだろう？
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신은 아직 죗값을 치르지 않았으니...
dialogsDecline.nl: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.pl: Musisz najpierw zapłacić za swoje grzechy…
dialogsDecline.ru: Велики твои грехи…
dialogsDecline.sp: Todavía tienes que pagar por tus pecados...
dialogsDecline.sw: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.th: คุณยังไม้ได้ชดใช้บาปของคุณ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 你還沒有為你的罪付出代價…
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn vẫn chưa phải trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình…

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.br: Sua missão foi concluída. Seus pecados foram perdoados.
dialogsComplete.cns: 任务完成，你的罪恶已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Buße getan. Deine Sünden wurden dir vergeben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Questmu telah tercapai. Dosa-dosamu telah diampuni.
dialogsComplete.it: La Missione è terminata. I tuoi peccati sono stati perdonati.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 끝났습니다. 당신의 죄를 용서하지요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Боги одобрили твое деяние и простили тебе грехи.
dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น บาปของคุณได้รับการอภัยแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nhiệm vụ của bạn đã được hoàn thành. Tội lỗi của bạn đã được tha thứ.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Well fine fine! Guess I did finish eating now. Anyway! I saw this particular woman entering the Dekane Dungeon by herself. By the look of her outfit, she may have been a Psykeeper or something.
dialogsBegin.ar: Well fine fine! Guess I did finish eating now. Anyway! I saw this particular woman entering the Dekane Dungeon by herself. By the look of her outfit, she may have been a Psykeeper or something.
dialogsBegin.br: Tá bem, tá bem! Acho que acabei de comer agora. De qualquer forma! Eu vi essa mulher em particular entrando na Masmorra Dekane sozinha. Pela aparência de sua roupa, ela pode ter sido uma Psykeeper ou algo assim.
dialogsBegin.cns: 好吧，好吧! 我现在确实吃完了。不管怎么说！我看到这个特别的女人独自进入达肯地牢。从她的装束来看，她可能是一位精神使者。
dialogsBegin.de: Nun gut, gut! Ich glaube, ich habe jetzt aufgegessen. Wie auch immer! Ich habe diese Frau gesehen, wie sie den Dekane Dungeon alleine betreten hat. Ihrer Kleidung nach zu urteilen, könnte sie eine Psykeeperin oder so etwas sein.
dialogsBegin.fi: Well fine fine! Guess I did finish eating now. Anyway! I saw this particular woman entering the Dekane Dungeon by herself. By the look of her outfit, she may have been a Psykeeper or something.
dialogsBegin.fil: Well fine fine! Guess I did finish eating now. Anyway! I saw this particular woman entering the Dekane Dungeon by herself. By the look of her outfit, she may have been a Psykeeper or something.
dialogsBegin.fr: Oh, Reodos a aussi vu cette drôle de femme ? A sa façon de s'habiller, je dirais que c'est une magicienne.
dialogsBegin.id: Baiklah baiklah! Kurasa aku sudah selesai makan sekarang. Ngomong-ngomong! Saya melihat wanita ini memasuki Dekane Dungeon sendirian. Dari tampilan pakaiannya, dia mungkin seorang Psykeeper atau semacamnya.
dialogsBegin.it: Well fine fine! Guess I did finish eating now. Anyway! I saw this particular woman entering the Dekane Dungeon by herself. By the look of her outfit, she may have been a Psykeeper or something.
dialogsBegin.jp: う～ん、そうだな。身だしなみはローブを身にまとっていたから魔法使いかもしれないな。確かにただならぬ雰囲気に満ち溢れていたけど。
dialogsBegin.kr: 좋아요, 좋아요. 어차피 막 식사를 끝냈으니까요. 아무튼! 어떤 여자가 혼자서 데카네 던전 안으로 들어가는 걸 봤어요. 차림새로 봐서는, 사이키퍼 같은 거였을지도 모르겠네요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Well fine fine! Guess I did finish eating now. Anyway! I saw this particular woman entering the Dekane Dungeon by herself. By the look of her outfit, she may have been a Psykeeper or something.
dialogsBegin.pl: Well fine fine! Guess I did finish eating now. Anyway! I saw this particular woman entering the Dekane Dungeon by herself. By the look of her outfit, she may have been a Psykeeper or something.
dialogsBegin.ru: Well fine fine! Guess I did finish eating now. Anyway! I saw this particular woman entering the Dekane Dungeon by herself. By the look of her outfit, she may have been a Psykeeper or something.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Bueno vale vale! Ya he terminado de comer. ¡A ver! Vi a esa mujer en particular entrar sola en la Mina Dekane. Por el aspecto de su indumentaria, puede que sea una Psykeeper o algo así.
dialogsBegin.sw: Well fine fine! Guess I did finish eating now. Anyway! I saw this particular woman entering the Dekane Dungeon by herself. By the look of her outfit, she may have been a Psykeeper or something.
dialogsBegin.th: เยี่ยม ตอนนี้ฉันกินเสร็จแล้ว อย่างไรก็ตาม! ฉันเห็นหญิงคนนี้เข้าไปในคุกใต้ดิน Dekane ด้วยตัวเอง ด้วยรูปลักษณ์ของเครื่องแต่งกายของเธอเธออาจได้รับ Mentalist หรือบางสิ่งบางอย่าง
dialogsBegin.tw: 啊~ 你是在說那個奇特女人嗎？我所知道的也只有獨自一人進入迪坎礦坑而已…從服裝還有氣氛上來看，應該像是魔法師吧？
dialogsBegin.vi: Tốt tốt tốt! Tôi đoán tôi đã ăn xong bây giờ. Dẫu sao thì! Tôi đã thấy người phụ nữ đặc biệt này tự mình bước vào Ngục tối Dekane. Nhìn vào trang phục của cô ấy, cô ấy có thể là một Psykeeper hoặc một cái gì đó.

dialogsBegin.en: Oh! You want to go in after her? Unfortunately, you can't just enter like that. You have to know how exactly!
dialogsBegin.ar: Oh! You want to go in after her? Unfortunately, you can't just enter like that. You have to know how exactly!
dialogsBegin.br: Oh! Você quer ir atrás dela? Infelizmente, você não pode simplesmente entrar assim. Você tem que saber exatamente como!
dialogsBegin.cns: 哦！你想跟着她进去？不好意思，你不能就这样进入。你必须知道具体的方法!
dialogsBegin.de: Oh! Du willst ihr nachgehen? Leider kann man nicht einfach so reingehen. Du musst genau wissen, wie!
dialogsBegin.fi: Oh! You want to go in after her? Unfortunately, you can't just enter like that. You have to know how exactly!
dialogsBegin.fil: Oh! You want to go in after her? Unfortunately, you can't just enter like that. You have to know how exactly!
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous voulez la retrouver dans la mine de Dekanes ? On n'entre pas dans la mine comme ça.
dialogsBegin.id: Oh! Anda ingin mengejarnya? Sayangnya, Anda tidak bisa begitu saja masuk seperti itu. Lebih tepatnya Anda harus tahu bagaimana caranya!
dialogsBegin.it: Oh! You want to go in after her? Unfortunately, you can't just enter like that. You have to know how exactly!
dialogsBegin.jp: ん？　君もダンジョンに入るつもりなの？　残念だけどすぐには無理だよ。このダンジョンは特別な入り方があるんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 오! 그 여자를 따라 들어가고 싶다고요? 미안하지만, 그냥 들어갈 수는 없어요. 정확한 방법을 알아야 하거든요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Oh! You want to go in after her? Unfortunately, you can't just enter like that. You have to know how exactly!
dialogsBegin.pl: Oh! You want to go in after her? Unfortunately, you can't just enter like that. You have to know how exactly!
dialogsBegin.ru: Oh! You want to go in after her? Unfortunately, you can't just enter like that. You have to know how exactly!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Oh! ¿Quieres ir tras ella? Desafortunadamente, no puedes entrar así como así. ¡Tienes que saber cómo exactamente!
dialogsBegin.sw: Oh! You want to go in after her? Unfortunately, you can't just enter like that. You have to know how exactly!
dialogsBegin.th: โอ้ว ! คุณต้องการไปหลังจากที่เธอ? แต่น่าเสียดายที่คุณไม่สามารถแม้แต่เข้าไปได้ คุณต้องรู้ว่า!
dialogsBegin.tw: 你也要進入副本嗎？不行，現在沒有辦法進入副本。那個副本是必須知道進出方法，才能夠進入的地方。
dialogsBegin.vi: Ồ! Bạn muốn đuổi theo cô ấy? Thật không may, bạn không thể chỉ tiến vào như vậy. Bạn phải biết chính xác cách làm thế nào !

dialogsBegin.en: If you want to learn how to enter the dungeon, you will need the key code from Cell back at the Erons Factory. He will tell you how to do it!
dialogsBegin.ar: If you want to learn how to enter the dungeon, you will need the key code from Cell back at the Erons Factory. He will tell you how to do it!
dialogsBegin.br: Se você quiser aprender como entrar na masmorra, você precisará do código-chave de Cell na Fábrica Erons. Ele lhe dirá como fazê-lo!
dialogsBegin.cns: 如果你想进入矿洞的话，需要从绿磷石工厂的飞儿那里得到门卡。他会告诉你怎么做!
dialogsBegin.de: Wenn ihr lernen wollt, wie man die Mine betritt, braucht ihr den Schlüsselcode von Cell in der Erons Factory. Er wird dir sagen, wie es geht!
dialogsBegin.fi: If you want to learn how to enter the dungeon, you will need the key code from Cell back at the Erons Factory. He will tell you how to do it!
dialogsBegin.fil: If you want to learn how to enter the dungeon, you will need the key code from Cell back at the Erons Factory. He will tell you how to do it!
dialogsBegin.fr: Cell à l'usine des Erons vous aidera à entrer dans la mine.
dialogsBegin.id: Jika Anda ingin mempelajari cara memasuki ruang bawah tanah, Anda memerlukan kode kunci dari Cell di Erons Factory. Dia akan memberi tahu Anda bagaimana melakukannya!
dialogsBegin.it: If you want to learn how to enter the dungeon, you will need the key code from Cell back at the Erons Factory. He will tell you how to do it!
dialogsBegin.jp: ん～、出入りについてはキプラのセルが詳しいよ。一度セルに話を聞いてみたら？
dialogsBegin.kr: 출입 방법은 에런팩스에 셀이 데카네스 던전을 잘 아니까 그에게 한번 가보는 게 어때? 그와 대화하면 출입방법에 대해 알려 줄거야.
dialogsBegin.nl: If you want to learn how to enter the dungeon, you will need the key code from Cell back at the Erons Factory. He will tell you how to do it!
dialogsBegin.pl: If you want to learn how to enter the dungeon, you will need the key code from Cell back at the Erons Factory. He will tell you how to do it!
dialogsBegin.ru: If you want to learn how to enter the dungeon, you will need the key code from Cell back at the Erons Factory. He will tell you how to do it!
dialogsBegin.sp: Si quieres entrar a la mazmorra, necesitarás el código que tiene Cell en la Fábrica de Erons. ¡Él te dirá cómo hacerlo!
dialogsBegin.sw: If you want to learn how to enter the dungeon, you will need the key code from Cell back at the Erons Factory. He will tell you how to do it!
dialogsBegin.th: หากต้องการเรียนรู้วิธีเข้าสู่ดันเจี้ยนคุณจะต้องใช้กุญแจจาก Cell ที่โรงงาน Erons เขาจะบอกคุณว่าควรทำอย่างไร
dialogsBegin.tw: 艾磷斯工廠的飛兒知道迪坎礦坑副本的出入方法，所以先去找他怎麼樣？和他對話之後，他會告訴你出入方法吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Nếu bạn muốn học cách vào ngục tối, bạn sẽ cần mã khóa từ Cell ở Erons Factory. Anh ấy sẽ cho bạn biết cách để làm điều đó!

dialogsAccept.en: Cell is at the Erons Factory, go ask him how to enter the dungeon.
dialogsAccept.ar: Cell is at the Erons Factory, go ask him how to enter the dungeon.
dialogsAccept.br: Cell está na Fábrica de Erons, pergunte para ele sobre como entrar na masmorra.
dialogsAccept.cns: 飞儿在绿磷石工厂，去问他如何进入矿洞。
dialogsAccept.de: Cell ist in Erons Factory, frag ihn, wie man die Mine betritt.
dialogsAccept.fi: Cell is at the Erons Factory, go ask him how to enter the dungeon.
dialogsAccept.fil: Cell is at the Erons Factory, go ask him how to enter the dungeon.
dialogsAccept.fr: Ne me regardez pas comme ça, je suis un expert en malédictions, pas en mines.
dialogsAccept.id: Cell ada di Erons Factory, tanyakan padanya bagaimana cara memasuki ruang bawah tanah.
dialogsAccept.it: Cell is at the Erons Factory, go ask him how to enter the dungeon.
dialogsAccept.jp: キプラはここよりもう少し東にいったところだよ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 셀은 에런스 공장에 있어요. 가서 던전에 어떻게 들어가는지 물어보세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Cell is at the Erons Factory, go ask him how to enter the dungeon.
dialogsAccept.pl: Cell is at the Erons Factory, go ask him how to enter the dungeon.
dialogsAccept.ru: Cell is at the Erons Factory, go ask him how to enter the dungeon.

dialogsAccept.sw: Cell is at the Erons Factory, go ask him how to enter the dungeon.
dialogsAccept.th: Cell อยู่ที่โรงงาน Erons ไปถามเขาว่าจะเข้าไปในคุกใต้ดินได้อย่างไร
dialogsAccept.tw: 飛兒就在艾磷斯工廠，你去問他如何進入副本吧。
dialogsAccept.vi: Cell đang ở Erons Factory, hãy hỏi anh ta cách vào ngục tối.

dialogsDecline.en: Well, there is no other way to get in! Don't look at me! It's not like I know anything!
dialogsDecline.ar: Well, there is no other way to get in! Don't look at me! It's not like I know anything!
dialogsDecline.br: Ué, não há outra maneira de entrar! Não olhe para mim! Não é como se eu soubesse de alguma coisa!
dialogsDecline.cns: 好吧，没有其他方法可以进入! 别看我！我什么都不知道！
dialogsDecline.de: Nun, es gibt keinen anderen Weg, um hineinzukommen! Schauen Sie mich nicht an! Es ist nicht so, dass ich etwas weiß!
dialogsDecline.fi: Well, there is no other way to get in! Don't look at me! It's not like I know anything!
dialogsDecline.fil: Well, there is no other way to get in! Don't look at me! It's not like I know anything!
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous ne pourrez pas entrer dans la mine sans l'aide de Cell.
dialogsDecline.id: Tidak ada cara lain untuk masuk! Jangan lihat aku! Aku benar-benar tidak tahu apa-apa!
dialogsDecline.it: Well, there is no other way to get in! Don't look at me! It's not like I know anything!
dialogsDecline.jp: このダンジョンは意外と複雑なんだ。大人しくセルに聞いた方がいいよ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 글쎄요, 그 방법밖에 없어요! 저한텐 묻지 마세요! 저도 잘 모른다고요!
dialogsDecline.nl: Well, there is no other way to get in! Don't look at me! It's not like I know anything!
dialogsDecline.pl: Well, there is no other way to get in! Don't look at me! It's not like I know anything!
dialogsDecline.ru: Well, there is no other way to get in! Don't look at me! It's not like I know anything!
dialogsDecline.sp: Bueno, ¡no hay otra forma de entrar! ¡No me mires así! ¡No es como si yo supiera algo!
dialogsDecline.sw: Well, there is no other way to get in! Don't look at me! It's not like I know anything!
dialogsDecline.th: ดีไม่มีทางอื่นที่จะได้ได้มันมา ! อย่ามองฉัน ! ฉันไม่รู้อะไรเลย!
dialogsDecline.tw: 什麼都不知道就要進入副本，根本就是笨蛋一樣的行為吧。
dialogsDecline.vi: Chà, không có cách nào khác để vào được! Đừng nhìn tôi như vậy! Tôi đâu phải người cái gì cũng biết chứ!

dialogsComplete.en: Ah… I remember you from before... Why do you come to see me? Dekanes dungeon? Why would you want to enter that cursed mine?
dialogsComplete.ar: Ah… I remember you from before... Why do you come to see me? Dekanes dungeon? Why would you want to enter that cursed mine?
dialogsComplete.br: Ah! Eu me lembro de você de antes.. Precisa de mais Pó de Aço? ... A Masmorra de Dekane? Por que você iria querer entrar nessa mina amaldiçoada??
dialogsComplete.cns: Ah… I remember you from before... Why do you come to see me? Dekanes dungeon? Why would you want to enter that cursed mine?
dialogsComplete.de: Ah... Ich erinnere mich an dich von früher... Warum kommst du zu mir? Dekanes Mine? Warum willst du diese verfluchte Mine betreten?
dialogsComplete.fi: Ah… I remember you from before... Why do you come to see me? Dekanes dungeon? Why would you want to enter that cursed mine?
dialogsComplete.fil: Ah… I remember you from before... Why do you come to see me? Dekanes dungeon? Why would you want to enter that cursed mine?
dialogsComplete.fr: On se connaît, non ?
dialogsComplete.id: Ah... Aku ingat kamu dari pertemuan sebelumnya ... Mengapa kamu datang menemuiku? Penjara bawah tanah Dekanes? Mengapa kamu ingin memasuki tambang terkutuk itu??
dialogsComplete.it: Ah… I remember you from before... Why do you come to see me? Dekanes dungeon? Why would you want to enter that cursed mine?
dialogsComplete.jp: ん？　デェカネスダンジョン？その鉱山になぜ入りたいのか？私は知らない、、何もしらない。
dialogsComplete.kr: 아… 전에 뵌 적이 있었죠… 왜 절 찾아오셨죠? 데카네 던전? 왜 그런 저주받은 광산에 들어가려는 거죠?
dialogsComplete.nl: Ah… I remember you from before... Why do you come to see me? Dekanes dungeon? Why would you want to enter that cursed mine?
dialogsComplete.pl: Ah… I remember you from before... Why do you come to see me? Dekanes dungeon? Why would you want to enter that cursed mine?
dialogsComplete.ru: Ah… I remember you from before... Why do you come to see me? Dekanes dungeon? Why would you want to enter that cursed mine?
dialogsComplete.sp: Ah… me acuerdo de ti… ¿Por qué vienes a verme? ¿La mazmorra Dekane? ¿¿Por qué quieres entrar en esa mina maldita??
dialogsComplete.sw: Ah… I remember you from before... Why do you come to see me? Dekanes dungeon? Why would you want to enter that cursed mine?
dialogsComplete.th: อ่า ... ฉันจำคุณได้ ... ว่าแต่มีธุระอะไร? หืม ดันเจี้ยน Dekanes ? ทำไมคุณถึงอยากไปสถานที่ที่ถูกสาปแช่งล่ะ?
dialogsComplete.tw: 啊……我記得你……你來找我做什麼？迪坎副本？你為什麼想進那個被詛咒的礦坑？
dialogsComplete.vi: À… Tôi nhớ tôi đã gặp bạn trước đây rồi… Bạn đến gặp tôi làm gì? Hầm ngục Dekanes? Tại sao bạn lại muốn đến chỗ cái mỏ bị nguyền rủa đó?

dialogsBegin.en: But, let us not be too hasty as arrogance may lead to an early grave. Though vicious, slaying a few lawolves is just the beginning…
dialogsBegin.ar: But, let us not be too hasty as arrogance may lead to an early grave. Though vicious, slaying a few lawolves is just the beginning…
dialogsBegin.br: Mas não sejamos precipitados, pois a arrogância pode levar à morte prematura. Embora cruel, matar alguns Lawolfs é apenas o começo...
dialogsBegin.cns: 但是，傲慢会让我们提前陷入绝境，我们必须谨慎不能仓促行事。虽然很残忍，但是杀几只山地野狼仅仅只是开始...
dialogsBegin.de: Aber wir sollten nicht zu voreilig sein, denn Arroganz kann zu einem frühen Tod führen. Obwohl bösartig, ist das Töten von ein paar Lawolves  nur der Anfang...
dialogsBegin.fi: But, let us not be too hasty as arrogance may lead to an early grave. Though vicious, slaying a few lawolves is just the beginning…
dialogsBegin.fil: But, let us not be too hasty as arrogance may lead to an early grave. Though vicious, slaying a few lawolves is just the beginning…
dialogsBegin.fr: C’est fou ce que vous avez l’air fier d’avoir tué quelques Lawolf ! Ne vous emballez pas trop. Vous avez encore du chemin avant de devenir professionnel, comme moi.
dialogsBegin.id: Tapi, janganlah kita terlalu tergesa-gesa karena kesombongan dapat menyebabkan kematian dini. Meskipun kejam, membunuh beberapa Lawolves hanyalah permulaan ...
dialogsBegin.it: But, let us not be too hasty as arrogance may lead to an early grave. Though vicious, slaying a few lawolves is just the beginning…
dialogsBegin.jp: ふむ、しかしラーウルフ程度で満足してはいかんな。その程度で英雄になれるくらいならフラリスは英雄だらけになるだろう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 뭐어, 너무 자만하지는 마세요. 냉혹하게 들릴진 몰라도 로울프 몇 마리 처치한 건 시작에 불과하다고요...
dialogsBegin.nl: But, let us not be too hasty as arrogance may lead to an early grave. Though vicious, slaying a few lawolves is just the beginning…
dialogsBegin.pl: But, let us not be too hasty as arrogance may lead to an early grave. Though vicious, slaying a few lawolves is just the beginning…
dialogsBegin.ru: But, let us not be too hasty as arrogance may lead to an early grave. Though vicious, slaying a few lawolves is just the beginning…
dialogsBegin.sp: Pero no nos apresuremos demasiado, ya que la arrogancia puede conducir a una tumba prematura. Aunque cruel, matar a algunos Lawolfs es solo el comienzo...
dialogsBegin.sw: But, let us not be too hasty as arrogance may lead to an early grave. Though vicious, slaying a few lawolves is just the beginning…
dialogsBegin.th: แต่อย่ารีบร้อนเกินไป เพราะความเย่อหยิ่งอาจนำไปสู่หลุมฝังศพแต่เนิ่นๆ แม้ว่าจะโหดร้าย แต่การสังหารนักกฎหมายสองสามคนเป็นเพียงจุดเริ่มต้น…
dialogsBegin.tw: 但是，讓我們不要太倉促，因為傲慢可能導致早期墳墓。雖然惡毒，但殺死幾個狼人只是個開始……
dialogsBegin.vi: Tuy nhiên, chúng ta đừng quá vội vàng vì kiêu ngạo có thể dẫn đến mồ chôn sớm. Mặc dù hung ác, việc tiêu diệt một vài con sói mới chỉ là bước khởi đầu…

dialogsDecline.en: What? I know I ask much of you, but I never thought you would turn down a chance to prove your worth.
dialogsDecline.ar: What? I know I ask much of you, but I never thought you would turn down a chance to prove your worth.
dialogsDecline.br: É sério? Sei que peço muito a você, mas nunca pensei que recusaria uma chance de provar seu valor.
dialogsDecline.cns: 什么？我知道我对你要求太多了，但我从没想过你会拒绝证明你的价值的机会。
dialogsDecline.de: Ich weiß, dass ich viel von dir verlange, aber ich hätte nie gedacht, dass du eine Chance ausschlagen würdest, deinen Wert zu beweisen.
dialogsDecline.fi: What? I know I ask much of you, but I never thought you would turn down a chance to prove your worth.
dialogsDecline.fil: What? I know I ask much of you, but I never thought you would turn down a chance to prove your worth.
dialogsDecline.fr: Quoi ? Je sais que je te demande beaucoup, mais je n'aurais jamais pensé que tu refuserais une chance de prouver ta valeur.
dialogsDecline.id: Apa? Aku mungkin meminta terlalu banyak, tapi aku tidak pernah berpikir kalau kau akan menolak kesempatan untuk membuktikan nilaimu.
dialogsDecline.it: What? I know I ask much of you, but I never thought you would turn down a chance to prove your worth.
dialogsDecline.jp: そうか、この程度で怖気づくようじゃとても英雄は目指せんな。
dialogsDecline.kr: 네? 무리한 부탁이긴 해도, 설마 자신의 가치를 증명할 기회를 거절할 줄은 몰랐네요.
dialogsDecline.nl: What? I know I ask much of you, but I never thought you would turn down a chance to prove your worth.

dialogsDecline.ru: What? I know I ask much of you, but I never thought you would turn down a chance to prove your worth.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Qué? Sé que pido mucho de ti, pero no pensaba que rechazarías una oportunidad de demostrar tu valía.
dialogsDecline.sw: What? I know I ask much of you, but I never thought you would turn down a chance to prove your worth.
dialogsDecline.th: อะไร ฉันรู้ว่าฉันถามคุณมาก แต่ฉันไม่เคยคิดว่าคุณจะปฏิเสธโอกาสที่จะพิสูจน์คุณค่าของคุณ
dialogsDecline.tw: 什麼？我知道我對你有很多要求，但我從沒想過你會拒絕證明自己價值的機會。
dialogsDecline.vi: Gì cơ? Tôi biết tôi đòi hỏi bạn rất nhiều, nhưng tôi chưa bao giờ nghĩ rằng bạn sẽ từ chối một cơ hội để chứng minh giá trị của mình như vậy.

dialogsBegin.en: Welcome, traveler! By the look of you, I'd say you're getting ready for an adventure, am I right? Well then you've come to the right place!
dialogsBegin.ar: Welcome, traveler! By the look of you, I'd say you're getting ready for an adventure, am I right? Well then you've come to the right place!
dialogsBegin.br: Bem-vindo(a), viajante! Pela sua aparência, diria que você está se preparando para uma aventura, correto?  Bom, então você veio ao lugar certo!
dialogsBegin.cns: 欢迎来到飞飞世界！这里是第一次来到飞飞世界，所必经的大陆啊~！现在你要猎杀怪物，让自己慢慢变强了！
dialogsBegin.de: Willkommen, Reisender! So wie du aussiehst, würde ich sagen, dass du dich auf ein Abenteuer vorbereitest, habe ich recht? Dann bist du hier genau richtig!
dialogsBegin.fi: Welcome, traveler! By the look of you, I'd say you're getting ready for an adventure, am I right? Well then you've come to the right place!
dialogsBegin.fil: Welcome, traveler! By the look of you, I'd say you're getting ready for an adventure, am I right? Well then you've come to the right place!
dialogsBegin.fr: Bienvenue dans Flyff ! Vos aventures commencent ici. Vous deviendrez plus fort en chassant des monstres.
dialogsBegin.id: Selamat datang, Traveler! Jika melihat penampilanmu, Aku bisa bilang jika Kau telah siap untuk berpetualang, benarkan? Kau datang ke tempat yang tepat!
dialogsBegin.it: Welcome, traveler! By the look of you, I'd say you're getting ready for an adventure, am I right? Well then you've come to the right place!
dialogsBegin.jp: ようこそFlyffワールドへ！ここはマドリガル大陸のフラリス。初めての冒険者が必ず立ち寄る街だ。このFlyffワールドでは、困った人を助けたり、モンスターを倒すことでどんどん強くなれるんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 어서 오세요, 여행자님! 보아하니 이제 모험을 떠날 준비가 된 것 같네요, 맞죠? 그렇다면 제대로 찾아오셨어요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Welcome, traveler! By the look of you, I'd say you're getting ready for an adventure, am I right? Well then you've come to the right place!
dialogsBegin.pl: Witaj podróżniku! Patrząc na ciebie, powiedziałbym, że przygotowujesz się na wielką przygodę, mam rację? Trafiłeś we właściwe miejsce!
dialogsBegin.ru: Привет! Сразу видно, что приключения для тебя - дело привычное, я угадал? Что ж, здесь для них самое подходящее место!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Bienvenido, viajero! Por tu aspecto, diría que te estás preparando para una aventura, ¿verdad? ¡Pues has venido al lugar correcto!
dialogsBegin.sw: Welcome, traveler! By the look of you, I'd say you're getting ready for an adventure, am I right? Well then you've come to the right place!
dialogsBegin.th: ยินดีต้อนรับ นักเดินทาง! ถ้าดูจากท่าทางคุณแล้ว ฉันว่าคุณพร้อมสำหรับการผจญภัยแล้วใช่มั้ย? ถ้างั้นคุณมาถูกที่แล้ว!
dialogsBegin.tw: 歡迎你，旅行者！看你的樣子，你應該是準備好要冒險了吧？那麼你來對地方了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Xin chào, du khách! Nhìn vào bạn, tôi muốn nói rằng bạn đã sẵn sàng cho một cuộc phiêu lưu, tôi nói đúng chứ? Vậy thì bạn đã đến đúng nơi!

dialogsBegin.en: There are plenty of dangerous monsters out there to battle, and my shop will help you get prepared for the fight!
dialogsBegin.ar: There are plenty of dangerous monsters out there to battle, and my shop will help you get prepared for the fight!
dialogsBegin.br: Existem muitos monstros perigosos lá fora para lutar, e minha loja irá te ajudar a se preparar para a luta!
dialogsBegin.cns: 在战斗之前，我要介绍一些NPC给你吧。
dialogsBegin.de: Monster bedrohen den Frieden dieser Welt und wir sollten sie bekämpfen. Bevor du beginnst zu kämpfen, stelle ich dich einem NPC vor, welcher für dich sehr wichtig sein wird.
dialogsBegin.fi: There are plenty of dangerous monsters out there to battle, and my shop will help you get prepared for the fight!
dialogsBegin.fil: There are plenty of dangerous monsters out there to battle, and my shop will help you get prepared for the fight!
dialogsBegin.fr: Les monstres menacent la paix de ce monde, vous devez donc les affronter et les éliminer. Avant de vous lancer dans la bataille, j'aimerais vous présenter les PNJ qui pourraient vous être d'un grand secours.
dialogsBegin.id: Ada banyak monster berbahaya di luar sana untuk dihajar, dan tokoku akan setia membantumu mempersiapkan diri sebelum pertarungan!
dialogsBegin.it: There are plenty of dangerous monsters out there to battle, and my shop will help you get prepared for the fight!
dialogsBegin.jp: 今はモンスターがこの世界の至るところにいるぜ。昔はあんなに平和だったのによ･･･。あいつらは俺たちの平和を奪おうとしているんだ。なぁ、平和のためにモンスターをこの世界から追い出してくれないか？そうだ、その前にこの世界で生きるために必要なことを教えてくれる連中を紹介してやる･･･いや、紹介させてくれ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 밖에는 정말 위험한 몬스터들이 많다고요. 우리 가게에서, 위험한 전투 준비를 도와드릴 수 있답니다!
dialogsBegin.nl: There are plenty of dangerous monsters out there to battle, and my shop will help you get prepared for the fight!
dialogsBegin.pl: Mnóstwo niebezpiecznych potworów czekan na Ciebie, mój sklep pomoże ci przygotować się do walki!
dialogsBegin.ru: Куда ни глянь - всюду злобные проходимцы и марионетки, так что скучать не будешь! Если хочешь как следует подготовиться к встрече с ними - мой магазин к твоим услугам!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Hay muchos monstruos peligrosos por ahí contra los que luchar, y mi tienda te ayudará a prepararte para la pelea!
dialogsBegin.sw: There are plenty of dangerous monsters out there to battle, and my shop will help you get prepared for the fight!
dialogsBegin.th: มีมอนสเตอร์อันตรายมากมายให้ต่อกรด้วย และร้านของฉันจะช่วยคุณเตรียมพร้อมสำหรับการต่อสู้!
dialogsBegin.tw: 外面有很多危險的怪物等著你去挑戰，我的店裡有很多東西可以幫助你做好準備！
dialogsBegin.vi: Có rất nhiều quái vật nguy hiểm ngoài kia để chiến đấu, và cửa hàng của tôi sẽ giúp bạn chuẩn bị cho cuộc chiến!

dialogsBegin.en: You'll be seeing me a lot later on, I'm sure, but for now why don't you pay our local smith Boboko a visit?
dialogsBegin.ar: You'll be seeing me a lot later on, I'm sure, but for now why don't you pay our local smith Boboko a visit?
dialogsBegin.br: Minha Loja Geral vende armas e itens mágicos que irão te ajudar em suas batalhas. Aconselho visitar minha loja assim que transferir para sua primeira Classe.
dialogsBegin.cns: 杂货商店会卖在战斗中所需要的辅助武器和魔法用品，你以后会经常光顾的哦
dialogsBegin.de: Beim Waffenladen bekommst du Waffen. Du wirst dort sehr oft vorbeischauen, wenn du deine Job Quest absolviert hast.
dialogsBegin.fi: You'll be seeing me a lot later on, I'm sure, but for now why don't you pay our local smith Boboko a visit?
dialogsBegin.fil: You'll be seeing me a lot later on, I'm sure, but for now why don't you pay our local smith Boboko a visit?
dialogsBegin.fr: Le Bazar vend les fournitures de combat. Vous y viendrez souvent dès que vous aurez choisi votre première profession.
dialogsBegin.id: Kita akan sering bertemu nanti, Aku yakin itu, tapi untuk saat ini mengapa kamu tidak coba mampir ke tukang besi lokal Boboko?
dialogsBegin.it: You'll be seeing me a lot later on, I'm sure, but for now why don't you pay our local smith Boboko a visit?
dialogsBegin.jp: 俺が経営している＜雑貨＞店は、戦闘に必要な補助武器(矢・ポスター)やMPを回復するアイテムを売っているんだ。お前さんにゃまだ必要ないと思うが、1次転職したら必要になってくるかもな。
dialogsBegin.kr: 앞으로 저랑 자주 만나시게 될 거예요. 그전에 마을의 대장장이 보보코에게 한번 들러보는 게 어때요?
dialogsBegin.nl: You'll be seeing me a lot later on, I'm sure, but for now why don't you pay our local smith Boboko a visit?
dialogsBegin.pl: Jestem pewien, że spotkasz się ze mną dużo później, ale na razie może złożysz wizytę naszemu miejscowemu kowalowi Boboko?
dialogsBegin.ru: Думаю, мы с тобой еще не раз увидимся. А пока загляни к нашему кузнецу Бубохану.
dialogsBegin.sp: Me vas a ver muchas veces, estoy seguro, pero por ahora, ¿por qué no le haces una visita a nuestro herrero Boboko?
dialogsBegin.sw: You'll be seeing me a lot later on, I'm sure, but for now why don't you pay our local smith Boboko a visit?
dialogsBegin.th: เราจะได้เจอกันอีกบ่อยๆ ในภายหลัง ฉันแน่ใจ แต่ตอนนี้ คุณลองไปเยี่ยม Boboko ช่างตีเหล็กประจำเมืองของเราดูสิ
dialogsBegin.tw: 你以後會常常看到我的，不過現在先去找我們的鐵匠波弟吧！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi chắc chắn bạn sẽ gặp tôi rất nhiều sau này, nhưng bây giờ tại sao bạn không đến thăm thợ rèn địa phương Boboko của chúng tôi?

dialogsBegin.en: Boboko owns the Armor Shop near here, and I think he might have something special for you.
dialogsBegin.ar: Boboko owns the Armor Shop near here, and I think he might have something special for you.
dialogsBegin.br: Por favor, visite Boboko, o dono da Loja de Armaduras. Ele terá o maior prazer em recebê-lo e você pode até ganhar algo!
dialogsBegin.cns: 在了解杂货商店之后，现在就去找负责防具的NPC吧，你到防具商店波弟会很高兴的。虽然对你来说很少，不过这些零钱给你！
dialogsBegin.de: Nun werden wir uns dem Rüstungsladen von Boboko zuwenden. Er wird sehr erfreut sein, wenn du auftauchst und vielleicht gibt er dir sogar etwas Geld.
dialogsBegin.fi: Boboko owns the Armor Shop near here, and I think he might have something special for you.
dialogsBegin.fil: Boboko owns the Armor Shop near here, and I think he might have something special for you.
dialogsBegin.fr: Bien, maintenant que vous avez découvert le Bazar, allez rendre visite à Boboko, le vendeur d'Armures. Il sera enchanté et vous donnera quelques penyas si vous allez le voir.
dialogsBegin.id: Boboko memiliki Armor Shop di dekat sini, dan Aku rasa Dia mungkin memiliki sesuatu yang istimewa untukmu.
dialogsBegin.it: Boboko owns the Armor Shop near here, and I think he might have something special for you.
dialogsBegin.jp: ＜雑貨＞についてはもう分かったな？あと、＜防具＞店を経営するボボコってオッサンがいるんだが、あいつは冒険者が好きみたいだからな。顔を出してやると喜ぶと思うぜ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 보보코는 근처에 있는 방어구 상점 주인이에요. 여행자님을 위해 뭔가 특별한 걸 준비해 둔 것 같던데요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Boboko owns the Armor Shop near here, and I think he might have something special for you.
dialogsBegin.pl: Boboko jest właścicielem pobliskiego Sklepu ze Zbroją i myślę, że może mieć dla ciebie, coś specjalnego.
dialogsBegin.ru: У него своя лавка неподалеку отсюда. Он продает оружие и наверняка подберет то, что тебе нужно! Тебе ведь не помешает хорошее снаряжение, верно?
dialogsBegin.sp: Boboko tiene su Tienda de Armaduras cerca de aquí, y creo que puede tener algo especial para ti.
dialogsBegin.sw: Boboko owns the Armor Shop near here, and I think he might have something special for you.
dialogsBegin.th: Boboko เป็นเจ้าของ Armor Shop ใกล้ๆ ที่นี่ และฉันคิดว่าเขาอาจมีของบางอย่างที่พิเศษสำหรับคุณ
dialogsBegin.tw: 波弟是這附近防具店的老闆，我想他可能會有一些特別的東西給你。
dialogsBegin.vi: Boboko sở hữu Cửa hàng áo giáp gần đây, và tôi nghĩ anh ấy có thể có thứ gì đó đặc biệt dành cho bạn.

dialogsAccept.en: Boboko's right nearby, you can't miss him with all the hammering! Oh, and welcome to Madrigal!
dialogsAccept.ar: Boboko's right nearby, you can't miss him with all the hammering! Oh, and welcome to Madrigal!
dialogsAccept.br: Boboko está aqui perto, então você pode achá-lo facilmente! Ele está sempre com um martelo na mão. Ah, e bem-vindo(a) à Madrigal!
dialogsAccept.cns: 防具商店的波弟正望着我这边，因为距离很近，所以不会太难找！他总是很认真的在敲锤子。
dialogsAccept.de: Boboko ist den ganzen Tag am Hämmern, daher musst du nur den Klängen des Hammers folgen.
dialogsAccept.fi: Boboko's right nearby, you can't miss him with all the hammering! Oh, and welcome to Madrigal!
dialogsAccept.fil: Boboko's right nearby, you can't miss him with all the hammering! Oh, and welcome to Madrigal!
dialogsAccept.fr: Boboko est à côté, il sera donc très aisé de le trouver ! Il a toujours un marteau à la main.
dialogsAccept.id: Toko Boboko ada disekitar sini, Tidak mungkin kau akan kelewatan dengan semua suara palu itu! Oh, dan selamat datang di Madrigal!
dialogsAccept.it: Boboko's right nearby, you can't miss him with all the hammering! Oh, and welcome to Madrigal!
dialogsAccept.jp: ＜防具＞店のボボコは俺の向かい側、ちょうど反対側にいるぜ。ホラ、お前の後ろだよ後ろ！なに？わからないだと？まぁ近くにいるからすぐ見つかるだろ。ボボコは何兄弟だったかなぁ･･･あいつら24時間ハンマーで武器だか防具だかを鍛えていてうるさいんだ。おかげで寝不足、美男子が台無しだぜ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 보보코는 바로 근처에 있어요. 망치질 소리가 들리니까 금방 찾을 수 있을 거예요! 아, 그리고 마드리갈에 온 걸 환영해요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Boboko's right nearby, you can't miss him with all the hammering! Oh, and welcome to Madrigal!
dialogsAccept.pl: Boboko jest tuż obok, nie możesz go przegapić z tym młotkiem w ręku! Zapomniałem, witaj w Madrigal!
dialogsAccept.ru: Вон он, Бубохан. Иди на грохот молота - не ошибешься! Стой... Чуть не забыл: добро пожаловать в Мадригал!
dialogsAccept.sp: Boboko está cerca. ¡Es imposible que te pierdas con todo el martilleo! ¡Oh, y bienvenido a Madrigal!
dialogsAccept.sw: Boboko's right nearby, you can't miss him with all the hammering! Oh, and welcome to Madrigal!
dialogsAccept.th: Boboko อยู่ใกล้ๆ นี่เอง คุณไม่ควรไปหาเขาถ้าเป็นเรื่องตีเหล็ก! โอ้ แล้วก็ยินดีต้อนรับสู่ Madrigal นะ
dialogsAccept.tw: 波弟就在附近，你一定會看到他在那裡敲打著鐵器的！哦，歡迎來到飛飛世界！
dialogsAccept.vi: Boboko đang ở ngay gần đó, bạn dễ dàng tìm thấy anh ấy cùng với tất cả các búa! Ồ, và chào mừng đến với Madrigal!

dialogsDecline.en: Packing it in so soon? But the day's just started! You have so much to do!
dialogsDecline.ar: Packing it in so soon? But the day's just started! You have so much to do!
dialogsDecline.br: O dia está apenas começando! Você tem muito o que fazer!
dialogsDecline.cns: 为了要让初心者可以在飞飞世界里存活下去，进行这个任务对你会有很大的帮助！
dialogsDecline.de: So früh schon aufgeben? Aber der Tag hat doch gerade erst begonnen! Du hast noch so viel zu tun!
dialogsDecline.fi: Packing it in so soon? But the day's just started! You have so much to do!
dialogsDecline.fil: Packing it in so soon? But the day's just started! You have so much to do!
dialogsDecline.fr: Les débutants devraient terminer cette quête afin de survivre dans Flyff !
dialogsDecline.id: Sudah mulai berkemas? hari baru saja dimulai! Kau masih memiliki begitu banyak hal yang harus dilakukan!
dialogsDecline.it: Packing it in so soon? But the day's just started! You have so much to do!
dialogsDecline.jp: とりあえず、このクエストを達成できれば、基本はOKってところだ。簡単だから、やってみて！
dialogsDecline.kr: 벌써 그만두려는 건가요? 이제 막 하루가 시작됐잖아요! 할 일이 정말 많다고요!
dialogsDecline.nl: Packing it in so soon? But the day's just started! You have so much to do!
dialogsDecline.pl: Packing it in so soon? But the day's just started! You have so much to do!
dialogsDecline.ru: Packing it in so soon? But the day's just started! You have so much to do!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Empaquetando tan pronto? ¡Pero si el día acaba de empezar! ¡Tienes mucho que hacer!
dialogsDecline.sw: Packing it in so soon? But the day's just started! You have so much to do!
dialogsDecline.th: กำลังบรรจุในเร็วๆ นี้? แต่วันนี้เพิ่งเริ่มต้นเอง! คุณยังมีอะไรให้ทำอีกมากมาย!
dialogsDecline.tw: 為了要讓見習生可以在飛飛世界裡存活下去，進行這個任務對你會有很大的幫助！
dialogsDecline.vi: Ngừng sớm vậy? Ngày chỉ mới bắt đầu! Bạn có rất nhiều việc phải làm!

dialogsComplete.en: Howdy! Lui told me you'd be coming! Here, this should help you get started. Next time you come by, we'll get you underway on your Vagrant training.
dialogsComplete.ar: Howdy! Lui told me you'd be coming! Here, this should help you get started. Next time you come by, we'll get you underway on your Vagrant training.
dialogsComplete.br: Oh, você é um dos iniciantes! Bem-vindo(a), bem-vindo(a)! Pegue isso, isso será útil pra você. Da próxima vez que você vier, nós colocaremos em prática o seu treinamento Vagrant.
dialogsComplete.cns: 你是这次的新初心者！欢迎来到飞飞世界。虽然只有一点点，但请你收下吧。在紧急的时候，可以使用它。如果下次你再过来找我，我们就开始初心者教育。
dialogsComplete.de: Oh, du scheinst neu hier zu sein. Herzlich willkommen! Nimm dies. Es ist nicht viel, aber es sollte dir viel nützen. Wenn du mich nochmal besuchst, werde ich die Vagranteneinweisung beginnen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Howdy! Lui told me you'd be coming! Here, this should help you get started. Next time you come by, we'll get you underway on your Vagrant training.
dialogsComplete.fil: Howdy! Lui told me you'd be coming! Here, this should help you get started. Next time you come by, we'll get you underway on your Vagrant training.
dialogsComplete.fr: Soyez le bienvenu ! Tenez voici 100 penyas, c'est trois fois rien, mais vous en aurez besoin. Je vais vous expliquer les ficelles du métier de Vagabond.
dialogsComplete.id: Halo! Lui bilang kau akan datang! Ambil, ini akan membantumu memulai. Lain kali Kau mampir, kita akan membantumu mengikuti pelatihan Vagrant.
dialogsComplete.it: Howdy! Lui told me you'd be coming! Here, this should help you get started. Next time you come by, we'll get you underway on your Vagrant training.
dialogsComplete.jp: お、あんたが新しい冒険者かい？そうか、ルイに紹介されて来たのか。まぁこれは小遣いだ、記念にとっておきな。少ないけど気にすんなって！そうだな･･･俺からも何かクエストを出してやるか。
dialogsComplete.kr: 안녕하세요! 루이가 올 거라고 말해주더군요! 자, 시작에 도움이 될 거예요. 다음에 다시 들리면, 함께 방랑자가 되기 위한 훈련을 시작해 보자고요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Howdy! Lui told me you'd be coming! Here, this should help you get started. Next time you come by, we'll get you underway on your Vagrant training.
dialogsComplete.pl: Howdy! Lui told me you'd be coming! Here, this should help you get started. Next time you come by, we'll get you underway on your Vagrant training.
dialogsComplete.ru: Здравствуй, здравствуй! Луи говорил, что ты зайдешь! Я тут приготовил для тебя подарок. Держи. Как освоишься в городе - возвращайся, расскажу тебе о доспехах!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Hola! ¡Lui me dijo que vendrías! Toma, esto debería ayudarte a comenzar. La próxima vez que vengas, pondremos en marcha tu entrenamiento de Vagrant.
dialogsComplete.sw: Howdy! Lui told me you'd be coming! Here, this should help you get started. Next time you come by, we'll get you underway on your Vagrant training.
dialogsComplete.th: เฮ้! Lui บอกว่าคุณจะมา! รับไป มันจะช่วยให้คุณเริ่มต้นได้ ครั้งต่อไปที่คุณมา เราจะพาคุณไปฝึกการเป็น Vagrant
dialogsComplete.tw: 你好！路達說你會來找我！這個應該可以幫助你開始冒險了！下次再來找我，我會對你進行見習生的教育！
dialogsComplete.vi: Chào! Lui nói với tôi rằng bạn sẽ đến! Đây, điều này sẽ giúp bạn bắt đầu. Lần tới khi bạn ghé qua, chúng tôi sẽ bắt đầu chương trình huấn luyện Vagrant của bạn.

description.en: Bring your pet's experience to 99.99% and the Pet Tamer will upgrade it for you!
description.ar: Bring your pet's experience to 99.99% and the Pet Tamer will upgrade it for you!
description.br: Aumente a experiência de seu Pet até 99,99% e o domador irá promovê-lo!
description.cns: 将宠物的经验提升至 99.99%，驯宠师会为你升级！
description.de: Steigere die EXP deines Pets auf 99,99% und bringe es zurück zum Pet Tamer.
description.fi: Bring your pet's experience to 99.99% and the Pet Tamer will upgrade it for you!
description.fil: Bring your pet's experience to 99.99% and the Pet Tamer will upgrade it for you!
description.fr: Monter l'expérience de votre familier à 99,99%, puis le ramener à l’Éleveur de familiers pour qu'il le fasse évoluer.
description.id: Naikkan pet EXp sampai 99,99% dan Pet Tamer akan mengupgradenya untukmu!
description.it: Bring your pet's experience to 99.99% and the Pet Tamer will upgrade it for you!
description.jp: ペットテイマーに経験値が100％になったグレードDのペットを持って行くと、グレードCのペットにレベルアップさせてくれるそうだ。
description.kr: 펫 경험치를 99.99%까지 올리면 펫 조련사가 펫을 업그레이드해 줍니다!
description.nl: Bring your pet's experience to 99.99% and the Pet Tamer will upgrade it for you!
description.pl: Bring your pet's experience to 99.99% and the Pet Tamer will upgrade it for you!
description.ru: Bring your pet's experience to 99.99% and the Pet Tamer will upgrade it for you!
description.sp: ¡Lleva la experiencia de tu mascota al 99,99 % y el Domador de Mascotas la mejorará por ti!
description.sw: Bring your pet's experience to 99.99% and the Pet Tamer will upgrade it for you!
description.th: เพิ่มประสบการณ์สัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณเป็น 99.99% แล้ว Pet Tamer จะอัปเกรดให้คุณ
description.tw: 將寵物的經驗提升至 99.99%，馴寵師會為你升級！
description.vi: Mang điểm experience của thú cưng lên đến 99,99% và Pet Tamer sẽ nâng cấp nó cho bạn!

dialogsBegin.en: I can see that you and your pet have been through a great deal together. You're almost there!
dialogsBegin.ar: I can see that you and your pet have been through a great deal together. You're almost there!
dialogsBegin.br: Vejo que você e seu Pet passaram por muita coisa juntos. Deixe-me fazer algo para ajudá-los.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我看到你和你的宠物一起经历了很多。就快到了！
dialogsBegin.de: Ich sehe euch beiden an, dass ihr bereits viel miteinander durchgemacht habt. Wir sind fast am Ziel!
dialogsBegin.fi: I can see that you and your pet have been through a great deal together. You're almost there!
dialogsBegin.fil: I can see that you and your pet have been through a great deal together. You're almost there!
dialogsBegin.fr: Ton familier et toi avez traversé bien des épreuves ensemble. Laissez-moi vous aider.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku dapat melihat kalau kamu dan petmu telah melalui banyak hal bersama. Kamu hampir sampai!
dialogsBegin.it: I can see that you and your pet have been through a great deal together. You're almost there!
dialogsBegin.jp: 今までよく育てましたね。私がやってあげることも今回で最後です。
dialogsBegin.kr: 펫과 함께 많은 경험을 하신 것 같네요. 거의 다 왔어요!
dialogsBegin.nl: I can see that you and your pet have been through a great deal together. You're almost there!
dialogsBegin.pl: I can see that you and your pet have been through a great deal together. You're almost there!
dialogsBegin.ru: I can see that you and your pet have been through a great deal together. You're almost there!
dialogsBegin.sp: Puedo ver que usted y su mascota han pasado por muchas cosas juntos. ¡Ya casi lo han conseguido!
dialogsBegin.sw: I can see that you and your pet have been through a great deal together. You're almost there!
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันเห็นว่าคุณและสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณผ่านอะไรมาด้วยกันมากมาย คุณเกือบจะอยู่ที่นั่นแล้ว!
dialogsBegin.tw: 我可以看到你和你的寵物一起經歷了很多，你快做到了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi thấy rằng bạn và thú cưng của bạn đã cùng nhau trải qua rất nhiều điều. Bạn sắp hoàn thành rồi!

dialogsBegin.en: I'll upgrade your pet to *S level* using magic handed down through my family. All you have to do is get the experience of your pet to 99.99%. You've done it before, will you do it the one last time?
dialogsBegin.ar: I'll upgrade your pet to *S level* using magic handed down through my family. All you have to do is get the experience of your pet to 99.99%. You've done it before, will you do it the one last time?
dialogsBegin.br: Elevarei o seu Pet para o grau S usando a magia transmitida pela minha família. Tudo o que você precisa fazer é aumentar a Experiência do seu Pet para 99,99%. Você já fez isso antes. Não faria uma última vez?
dialogsBegin.cns: 我会用我家传下来的魔法把你的宠物升级到*S级*。您所要做的就是让您的宠物的经验达到99.99％。你以前做过，你会做最后一次吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Meine Familie kennt das magische Handwerk, um Pets in die S Klasse aufzuwerten. Ihr beide scheint fast bereit dafür zu sein. Allerdings musst du noch einmal die Erfahrung deines Pets auf 99,99% bringen.
dialogsBegin.fi: I'll upgrade your pet to *S level* using magic handed down through my family. All you have to do is get the experience of your pet to 99.99%. You've done it before, will you do it the one last time?
dialogsBegin.fil: I'll upgrade your pet to *S level* using magic handed down through my family. All you have to do is get the experience of your pet to 99.99%. You've done it before, will you do it the one last time?
dialogsBegin.fr: Je peux faire évoluer ton familier à son stade ultime en utilisant une magie qui se transmet dans ma famille. Tout ce que tu as à faire est d'augmenter son expérience à 99,99% et revenir me voir.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku akan meningkatkan petmu ke * level S * menggunakan sihir yang diturunkan melalui keluargaku. Yang harus kamu lakukan adalah mendapatkan pet experience hingga 99,99%. Kamu telah melakukannya sebelumnya, apakah kamu akan melakukannya untuk terakhir kalinya?
dialogsBegin.it: I'll upgrade your pet to *S level* using magic handed down through my family. All you have to do is get the experience of your pet to 99.99%. You've done it before, will you do it the one last time?
dialogsBegin.jp: うちの家に代々伝わってくる秘法で、ペットの能力値を引き上げます。ペットの経験値を100％にした後、私のところへ持ってきてください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 제가 가문 대대로 내려오는 마법을 써서 펫을 *S급*으로 업그레이드해 드리죠. 펫 경험치를 99.99%로 올리기만 하면 된답니다. 전에도 해봤으니, 이번에 한 번 더 하실 수 있겠죠?
dialogsBegin.nl: I'll upgrade your pet to *S level* using magic handed down through my family. All you have to do is get the experience of your pet to 99.99%. You've done it before, will you do it the one last time?
dialogsBegin.pl: I'll upgrade your pet to *S level* using magic handed down through my family. All you have to do is get the experience of your pet to 99.99%. You've done it before, will you do it the one last time?
dialogsBegin.ru: I'll upgrade your pet to *S level* using magic handed down through my family. All you have to do is get the experience of your pet to 99.99%. You've done it before, will you do it the one last time?
dialogsBegin.sp: Actualizaré tu mascota al *Nivel S* usando la magia de mi familia. Lo único que tienes que hacer es llevar la experiencia de tu mascota al 99,99%. Lo has hecho antes, ¿Lo harás una vez más?
dialogsBegin.sw: I'll upgrade your pet to *S level* using magic handed down through my family. All you have to do is get the experience of your pet to 99.99%. You've done it before, will you do it the one last time?
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันจะอัพเกรดสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณเป็น *ระดับ S * โดยใช้เวทมนตร์ที่สืบทอดมาจากครอบครัวของฉัน สิ่งที่คุณต้องทำคือมีEXPสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณถึง 99.99% คุณเคยทำมาก่อน คุณจะทำเป็นครั้งสุดท้ายหรือไม่?
dialogsBegin.tw: 我會用家傳魔法把你的寵物升級到 *S 級*。你只需要讓寵物經驗值達到 99.99%。你以前做過，這最後一次也願意再做嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi sẽ nâng cấp thú cưng của bạn lên * cấp độ S * bằng phép thuật được truyền lại từ gia đình tôi. Tất cả những gì bạn phải làm là đạt điểm experience thú cưng của bạn đến 99,99%. Bạn đã làm điều đó trước đây, bạn sẽ làm điều đó lần cuối cùng chứ?

dialogsAccept.en: I knew you would. It looks like both you and your pet are ready to begin.
dialogsAccept.ar: I knew you would. It looks like both you and your pet are ready to begin.
dialogsAccept.br: Eu sabia que você faria. Parece que você e seu Pet estão prontos para começar.
dialogsAccept.cns: 我知道你会的。看起来您和您的宠物都准备好开始了。
dialogsAccept.de: Ich wusste du würdest zustimmen! Du und dein Pet seid definitiv bereit dafür.
dialogsAccept.fi: I knew you would. It looks like both you and your pet are ready to begin.
dialogsAccept.fil: I knew you would. It looks like both you and your pet are ready to begin.
dialogsAccept.fr: Je le savais. Vous avez tous les deux l'air prêts désormais !
dialogsAccept.id: Aku tahu kamu dapat melakukannya. Sepertinya Kamu dan pet kamu siap untuk memulai.
dialogsAccept.it: I knew you would. It looks like both you and your pet are ready to begin.
dialogsAccept.jp: 本当にペットが好きなんですね。いつものようにペットを成長させたら、私のところに持って来てください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 그럴 줄 알았어요. 당신과 펫 모두, 시작할 준비가 된 것 같네요.
dialogsAccept.nl: I knew you would. It looks like both you and your pet are ready to begin.
dialogsAccept.pl: I knew you would. It looks like both you and your pet are ready to begin.
dialogsAccept.ru: I knew you would. It looks like both you and your pet are ready to begin.
dialogsAccept.sp: Sabía que lo harías. Parece que tanto tu como tu mascota están listos para comenzar.
dialogsAccept.sw: I knew you would. It looks like both you and your pet are ready to begin.
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันรู้ว่าคุณจะ ดูเหมือนว่าทั้งคุณและสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณพร้อมที่จะเริ่มต้นแล้ว
dialogsAccept.tw: 我知道你會的。看起來你和你的寵物都準備好開始了。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi biết bạn sẽ làm. Có vẻ như cả bạn và thú cưng của bạn đều đã sẵn sàng để bắt đầu.

dialogsDecline.en: Does this mean you are giving up on your pet?
dialogsDecline.ar: Does this mean you are giving up on your pet?
dialogsDecline.br: Isso significa que você está desistindo de seu Pet?
dialogsDecline.cns: 这是否意味着你放弃了你的宠物？
dialogsDecline.de: Heißt das, du gibst dich und dein Pet wirklich auf?
dialogsDecline.fi: Does this mean you are giving up on your pet?
dialogsDecline.fil: Does this mean you are giving up on your pet?
dialogsDecline.fr: Est-ce que ça veut dire que tu abandonnes, si près du but ?
dialogsDecline.id: Apakah ini berarti Anda menyerah pada pet kamu?
dialogsDecline.it: Does this mean you are giving up on your pet?
dialogsDecline.jp: ペットへの愛情はここまでなのですか？
dialogsDecline.kr: 펫을 포기하겠다는 말씀인가요?
dialogsDecline.nl: Does this mean you are giving up on your pet?
dialogsDecline.pl: Does this mean you are giving up on your pet?
dialogsDecline.ru: Does this mean you are giving up on your pet?
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Significa que estás renunciando a tu mascota?
dialogsDecline.sw: Does this mean you are giving up on your pet?
dialogsDecline.th: นี่หมายความว่าคุณกำลังยอมแพ้สัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณหรือไม่?
dialogsDecline.tw: 這是否意味著你放棄了你的寵物？
dialogsDecline.vi: Điều này có nghĩa là bạn đang từ bỏ thú cưng của mình?

dialogsComplete.en: Congratulations! As long as you have your pet, you will never be alone. Your pet seems to be very happy, you've done a great job. Now allow me to apply the final upgrade!
dialogsComplete.ar: Congratulations! As long as you have your pet, you will never be alone. Your pet seems to be very happy, you've done a great job. Now allow me to apply the final upgrade!
dialogsComplete.br: Meus Parabéns! Agora você e seu Pet são mais do que treinador e animal. Vocês são parceiros. Enquanto estiverem juntos, nunca estarão sozinhos. Seu pet parece estar muito feliz, você fez um ótimo trabalho. Agora permita-me aplicar a promoção final!
dialogsComplete.cns: 恭喜！只要你有你的宠物，你就永远不会孤单。你的宠物似乎很高兴，你做得很好。现在请允许我完成最终的升级！
dialogsComplete.de: Herzlichen Glückwunsch, ihr habt es geschafft! Solange du dein Pet hast, wirst du niemals allein sein. Auch dein Pet scheint sehr glücklich zu sein. Ihr habt hart an eurem Fortschritt gearbeitet. Lass mich nun das letzte Upgrade vollziehen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Congratulations! As long as you have your pet, you will never be alone. Your pet seems to be very happy, you've done a great job. Now allow me to apply the final upgrade!
dialogsComplete.fil: Congratulations! As long as you have your pet, you will never be alone. Your pet seems to be very happy, you've done a great job. Now allow me to apply the final upgrade!
dialogsComplete.fr: Magnifique ! Félicitations ! Ton familier et toi êtes maintenant de vrais partenaires. Les gens ont de quoi être jaloux de vous !
dialogsComplete.id: Selamat! Selama kamu memiliki pet, kamu tidak akan pernah sendirian. Petmu tampaknya sangat bahagia, Kamu telah merawatnya dengan baik. Sekarang izinkan aku untuk melakukan upgrade terakhir!
dialogsComplete.it: Congratulations! As long as you have your pet, you will never be alone. Your pet seems to be very happy, you've done a great job. Now allow me to apply the final upgrade!
dialogsComplete.jp: ペットは素敵に成長しました。誰が見てもあなたのペットを素晴らしいと思うはずです。
dialogsComplete.kr: 축하합니다! 펫이 있는 한, 당신은 결코 혼자가 아니랍니다. 펫이 정말 행복한 것 같네요. 아주 훌륭해요. 이제 마지막 업그레이드를 하겠습니다!
dialogsComplete.nl: Congratulations! As long as you have your pet, you will never be alone. Your pet seems to be very happy, you've done a great job. Now allow me to apply the final upgrade!
dialogsComplete.pl: Congratulations! As long as you have your pet, you will never be alone. Your pet seems to be very happy, you've done a great job. Now allow me to apply the final upgrade!
dialogsComplete.ru: Congratulations! As long as you have your pet, you will never be alone. Your pet seems to be very happy, you've done a great job. Now allow me to apply the final upgrade!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Enhorabuena! Con tu mascota, nunca estarás solo. Tu mascota parece estar muy contenta, has hecho un gran trabajo. ¡Permíteme realizar la actualización final!
dialogsComplete.sw: Congratulations! As long as you have your pet, you will never be alone. Your pet seems to be very happy, you've done a great job. Now allow me to apply the final upgrade!
dialogsComplete.th: ยินดีด้วย! ตราบใดที่คุณมีสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณ คุณจะไม่มีวันอยู่คนเดียว ดูเหมือนว่าสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณจะมีความสุขมาก คุณทำได้ดีมาก ตอนนี้ให้ฉันใช้การอัปเกรดขั้นสุดท้าย!
dialogsComplete.tw: 恭喜！只要你有你的寵物，你就永遠不會孤單。你的寵物似乎很高興，你做得很好。現在請允許我應用最終升級！
dialogsComplete.vi: Xin chúc mừng! Miễn là bạn có thú cưng của mình, bạn sẽ không bao giờ cô đơn. Thú cưng của bạn có vẻ rất hạnh phúc, bạn đã hoàn thành xuất sắc nhiệm vụ. Bây giờ cho phép tôi áp dụng lần nâng cấp cuối cùng!

dialogsFail.en: You are so close to getting your pet to its ultimate level. Do not give up now.
dialogsFail.ar: You are so close to getting your pet to its ultimate level. Do not give up now.
dialogsFail.br: Você está tão perto de levar o seu Pet para o nível mais alto. Não desista agora.
dialogsFail.cns: 你让你的宠物离最高水平如此接近。现在不要放弃。
dialogsFail.de: Du hast es fast geschafft. Das ultimative Level deines Pets ist nicht mehr fern. Gib jetzt nicht auf!
dialogsFail.fi: You are so close to getting your pet to its ultimate level. Do not give up now.
dialogsFail.fil: You are so close to getting your pet to its ultimate level. Do not give up now.
dialogsFail.fr: Tu es si près du but, ceci est l'évolution ultime ! N'abandonne pas maintenant !
dialogsFail.id: Kamu sangat dekat untuk membawa pet kamu ke level tertingginya. Jangan menyerah sekarang.
dialogsFail.it: You are so close to getting your pet to its ultimate level. Do not give up now.
dialogsFail.jp: もう少し頑張ってください。完全に成長したペットの姿を見たくはないのですか？
dialogsFail.kr: 펫이 최대 레벨에 거의 도달했습니다. 포기하지 말고 조금만 더!
dialogsFail.nl: You are so close to getting your pet to its ultimate level. Do not give up now.
dialogsFail.pl: You are so close to getting your pet to its ultimate level. Do not give up now.
dialogsFail.ru: You are so close to getting your pet to its ultimate level. Do not give up now.
dialogsFail.sp: Estás muy cerca de alcanzar el Nivel máximo de tu Mascota. No te rindas ahora.
dialogsFail.sw: You are so close to getting your pet to its ultimate level. Do not give up now.
dialogsFail.th: คุณใกล้ที่จะนำสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณไปสู่ระดับสูงสุดแล้ว อย่ายอมแพ้ตอนนี้
dialogsFail.tw: 你離讓你的寵物達到終極水平如此接近。現在不要放棄。
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn đang tiến gần đến việc đưa thú cưng của mình lên cấp độ tối cao. Đừng từ bỏ lúc này.

name.jp: 伝説のレッドマンティス(下編)
name.th: ตำนาน Redmantis (ตอนที่ 3)

description.en: The Emerald Mantis is located somewhere near the Central Hillid Mountains. Defeat her, retrieve the Emerald Mantis Egg, then return to Rudvihil.
description.ar: The Emerald Mantis is located somewhere near the Central Hillid Mountains. Defeat her, retrieve the Emerald Mantis Egg, then return to Rudvihil.
description.br: A Louva-deus Esmeralda vive em algum lugar no meio das Montanhas Hillid. Derrote-a, recupere o Ovo da Louva-deus Esmeralda e volte para Rudvihil.
description.cns: 产卵的母亲居住在龙脊山脉中部附近，现在正好是产卵时期，找到之后交给萝特泰斯。
description.de: Die Emerald Mantis befindet sich irgendwo in der Nähe des zentralen Hillidgebirges. Besiege sie, sammle das Ei der Emerald Mantis ein und kehre dann zu Rudvihil zurück.
description.fi: The Emerald Mantis is located somewhere near the Central Hillid Mountains. Defeat her, retrieve the Emerald Mantis Egg, then return to Rudvihil.
description.fil: The Emerald Mantis is located somewhere near the Central Hillid Mountains. Defeat her, retrieve the Emerald Mantis Egg, then return to Rudvihil.
description.fr: Les mères pondeuses vivent quelque part au centre des montagnes de Hillid. Tuez-en une, obtenez son œuf, et revenez voir Rudvihil.
description.id: Emerald Mantis terletak di suatu tempat di dekat Pegunungan Central Hillid. Kalahkan dia, ambil Telur Emerald Mantis, lalu kembali ke Rudvihil.
description.it: The Emerald Mantis is located somewhere near the Central Hillid Mountains. Defeat her, retrieve the Emerald Mantis Egg, then return to Rudvihil.
description.jp: この卵を産むレッドマンティスは、ヒルリド山脈中部のどこかに巣を作っているそうだ。ちょうど今が産卵期だから、卵が取れるはずだ。運が良かったな。
description.kr: 힐리드 산맥 중부 근처에 있는 에메랄드 맨티스를 찾아 처치하고, 에메랄드 맨티스의 알을 찾아 루드비힐에게 전달하세요.
description.nl: The Emerald Mantis is located somewhere near the Central Hillid Mountains. Defeat her, retrieve the Emerald Mantis Egg, then return to Rudvihil.
description.pl: The Emerald Mantis is located somewhere near the Central Hillid Mountains. Defeat her, retrieve the Emerald Mantis Egg, then return to Rudvihil.
description.ru: Изумрудные богомолы обитают в Холмистых горах. Нужно отыскать кладку, победить самку, забрать яйцо и отнести его Сотби.
description.sp: La Mantis Esmeralda está cerca del Centro de las Montañas Hillid. Derrótala, consigue el Huevo Esmeralda y vuelve con Rudvihil.
description.sw: The Emerald Mantis is located somewhere near the Central Hillid Mountains. Defeat her, retrieve the Emerald Mantis Egg, then return to Rudvihil.
description.th: Emerald Mantis อยู่ใกล้เทือกเขา Central Hillid Mountains เอาชนะเธอแล้วเอาไข่มรกตมรกตมา จากนั้นกลับไปหา Rudvihil
description.tw: 赤螳螂位於中央希爾德山脈附近的某個地方。找到並擊敗她，然後取回卵給蘿特泰斯！
description.vi: Emerald Mantis nằm ở đâu đó gần Central Hillid Mountains. Đánh bại nó, lấy Emerald Mantis Egg, sau đó quay trở lại Rudvihil.

dialogsBegin.en: Well, I have good news and bad news. The bad news is, the Redyspawn is not that valuable. The good news, is that I believe I know what Rudvihil is searching for.
dialogsBegin.ar: Well, I have good news and bad news. The bad news is, the Redyspawn is not that valuable. The good news, is that I believe I know what Rudvihil is searching for.
dialogsBegin.br: Agora entendi! Esse Ovo Avermelhado é raro, mas não tão valioso. Enquanto isso, encontrei algo no velho livro do julgamento.
dialogsBegin.cns: 知道了!蟹足螳螂卵虽然是很稀有的东西，但是没有想像中那么珍贵，我刚刚在翻看书籍的时候发现了一个事情。
dialogsBegin.de: Nun, ich habe eine gute und eine schlechte Nachricht. Die schlechte Nachricht ist, dass der Redyspawn nicht so wertvoll ist. Die gute Nachricht ist, dass ich vermutlich weiß, wonach Rudvihil sucht.
dialogsBegin.fi: Well, I have good news and bad news. The bad news is, the Redyspawn is not that valuable. The good news, is that I believe I know what Rudvihil is searching for.
dialogsBegin.fil: Well, I have good news and bad news. The bad news is, the Redyspawn is not that valuable. The good news, is that I believe I know what Rudvihil is searching for.
dialogsBegin.fr: J'ai trouvé! Cet Oeufantis est rare mais n'a pas de grande valeur. Cependant, j'ai trouvé quelque chose dans l'ancien Livre du Jugement.
dialogsBegin.id: Yah, aku punya kabar baik dan kabar buruk. Kabar buruknya, Redyspawn tidak begitu berharga. Kabar baiknya, saya yakin saya tahu apa yang dicari Rudvihil.
dialogsBegin.it: Well, I have good news and bad news. The bad news is, the Redyspawn is not that valuable. The good news, is that I believe I know what Rudvihil is searching for.
dialogsBegin.jp: 鑑定結果を教えよう。この＜マンティス・エッグ＞は珍しい物ではあるんだが、伝説中に出てくると言われる噂の卵ではないようだ。ところがこの噂の卵について新しく情報を発見したんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 좋은 소식과 나쁜 소식이 있어요. 나쁜 소식은, 레디스폰은 그리 귀한 것들이 아니었단 사실이죠. 좋은 소식은, 루드비힐이 진짜 찾고 있는 게 뭔지 알 것 같아요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Well, I have good news and bad news. The bad news is, the Redyspawn is not that valuable. The good news, is that I believe I know what Rudvihil is searching for.
dialogsBegin.pl: Well, I have good news and bad news. The bad news is, the Redyspawn is not that valuable. The good news, is that I believe I know what Rudvihil is searching for.
dialogsBegin.ru: У меня есть две новости: хорошая и плохая. К сожалению, среди яиц красных богомолов не нашлось по-настоящему ценного. Зато я, кажется, знаю, что ищет Сотби.
dialogsBegin.sp: Bueno, tengo buenas noticias y malas noticias. La mala noticia es que los Huevos de Red Mantis no son tan valiosos. La buena noticia es que creo que sé lo que está buscando Rudvihil.
dialogsBegin.sw: Well, I have good news and bad news. The bad news is, the Redyspawn is not that valuable. The good news, is that I believe I know what Rudvihil is searching for.
dialogsBegin.th: เอาล่ะ ฉันมีทั้งข่าวดีและข่าวร้าย ข่าวร้ายคือ Redyspawn ไม่ได้มีค่าขนาดนั้น ข่าวดีก็คือฉันว่าฉันรู้ว่า Rudvihil กำลังค้นหาอะไรอยู่
dialogsBegin.tw: 知道了！赤螳螂卵雖然是很稀有的東西，但是沒有想像中那麼珍貴，我剛剛在翻看書籍的時候發現了一個事情。
dialogsBegin.vi: Vâng, tôi có một tin tốt và một tin xấu. Tin xấu là Redyspawn không có giá trị như vậy. Tin tốt là tôi tin tôi biết những gì Rudvihil đang tìm kiếm.

dialogsBegin.en: It's Emeraldispawn. It is extremely difficult to acquire, as you can only get it once a year.
dialogsBegin.ar: It's Emeraldispawn. It is extremely difficult to acquire, as you can only get it once a year.
dialogsBegin.br: Chama-se Ovo Esmeralda. É extremamente difícil de adquirir. Como você só pode obtê-lo uma vez por ano, tornou-se muito valioso.
dialogsBegin.cns: 就是奇异蟹足螳螂的卵。这个东西很难获取，有时一年里连一个都找不到。
dialogsBegin.de: Das ist Emeraldispawn. Er ist extrem schwer zu bekommen, da man ihn nur einmal im Jahr bekommen kann.
dialogsBegin.fi: It's Emeraldispawn. It is extremely difficult to acquire, as you can only get it once a year.
dialogsBegin.fil: It's Emeraldispawn. It is extremely difficult to acquire, as you can only get it once a year.
dialogsBegin.fr: C'est appelé l'Oeufemeraude. Tu ne peux le trouver qu'une fois par an. Comme il est si difficile à avoir, il est devenu très cher.
dialogsBegin.id: Itu adalah Emeraldspawn. Sangat sulit untuk mendapatkannya, karena kamu hanya bisa mendapatkannya setahun sekali.
dialogsBegin.it: It's Emeraldispawn. It is extremely difficult to acquire, as you can only get it once a year.
dialogsBegin.jp: それは＜エメラディス・エッグ＞と呼ばれている卵らしい。この卵は1年にたった1個しか取れない、相当な価値を持つ卵だといわれている。
dialogsBegin.kr: 에머랄디스폰이었어요! 일 년에 한 번만 얻을 수 있어서, 구하기가 하늘의 별 따기죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: It's Emeraldispawn. It is extremely difficult to acquire, as you can only get it once a year.
dialogsBegin.pl: It's Emeraldispawn. It is extremely difficult to acquire, as you can only get it once a year.
dialogsBegin.ru: It's Emeraldispawn. It is extremely difficult to acquire, as you can only get it once a year.
dialogsBegin.sp: Se llama Huevo Esmeralda. Solo se puede conseguir una vez al año. Como es tan difícil de obtener, se ha vuelto muy valioso.
dialogsBegin.sw: It's Emeraldispawn. It is extremely difficult to acquire, as you can only get it once a year.
dialogsBegin.th: มันคือ Emeraldispawn มันเป็นเรื่องยากมากที่จะได้รับมัน เพราะว่าคุณจะรับมันได้แค่ปีละครั้ง
dialogsBegin.tw: 就是珍珠赤螳螂的卵，這個東西一年只會出現一個，有的時候連一個都找不到，所以擁有很高的價值。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đó là Emeraldispawn. Nó cực kỳ khó để có được, vì bạn chỉ có thể lấy nó mỗi năm một lần.

dialogsBegin.en: In addition, it's mother is rather… protective of her eggs. However, we're in luck! It's breeding season!
dialogsBegin.ar: In addition, it's mother is rather… protective of her eggs. However, we're in luck! It's breeding season!
dialogsBegin.br: O motivo de ser tão raro é por causa de sua mãe. Eu acho que esse é o tesouro que Rudvihil está procurando.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我觉得它的珍贵关键原因在于母的身上，我想萝特泰斯想要找的应该也是这个东西。
dialogsBegin.de: Der Grund für die Seltenheit liegt an der Mutter. Ich glaube, dies ist der seltene und wertvolle Gegenstand, den Rudvihil sucht.
dialogsBegin.fi: In addition, it's mother is rather… protective of her eggs. However, we're in luck! It's breeding season!
dialogsBegin.fil: In addition, it's mother is rather… protective of her eggs. However, we're in luck! It's breeding season!
dialogsBegin.fr: Il est aussi rare à cause de sa mère. Je pense que c'est cet objet rare et précieux que cherche Rudvihil.
dialogsBegin.id: Selain itu, induknya agak… protektif terhadap telurnya. Namun, kami beruntung! Ini musim kawin!
dialogsBegin.it: In addition, it's mother is rather… protective of her eggs. However, we're in luck! It's breeding season!
dialogsBegin.jp: 手に入れるのが大変な理由のひとつに、希少性が高いだけでなく、この卵を産むレッドマンティスの数がとても少ないらしいんだ。ルードヴィヒが探している卵は、おそらくこの卵だろう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 게다가 어미는… 알에 집착이 심해요. 어쨌든 운이 좋아요! 지금이 마침 산란기거든요!
dialogsBegin.nl: In addition, it's mother is rather… protective of her eggs. However, we're in luck! It's breeding season!
dialogsBegin.pl: In addition, it's mother is rather… protective of her eggs. However, we're in luck! It's breeding season!
dialogsBegin.ru: К тому же, самка готова защищать кладку любой ценой! Однако нам повезло. Сейчас у богомолов сезон размножения.
dialogsBegin.sp: Además, la madre es bastante... protectora con sus huevos. Sin embargo, ¡estamos de suerte! ¡Es temporada de cría!
dialogsBegin.sw: In addition, it's mother is rather… protective of her eggs. However, we're in luck! It's breeding season!
dialogsBegin.th: นอกจากนี้ ตัวแม่ก็ค่อนข้างจะ... หวงไข่ของเธอ อย่างไรก็ตามนี่เป็นโชคดีของเรา! เพราะตอนนี้เป็นฤดูผสมพันธุ์!
dialogsBegin.tw: 我覺得它的珍貴關鍵原因在於母的身上，我想蘿特泰斯想要找的應該也是這個東西。
dialogsBegin.vi: Ngoài ra, nó là mẹ đang… bảo vệ trứng của mình. Tuy nhiên, chúng tôi đang gặp may! Đang là mùa sinh sản!

dialogsBegin.en: Now is our chance! Will you retrieve this egg for Rudvihil?
dialogsBegin.ar: Now is our chance! Will you retrieve this egg for Rudvihil?
dialogsBegin.br: Você poderia trazê-lo para mim, por favor?
dialogsBegin.cns: 要帮忙找吗?
dialogsBegin.de: Würdest du es mir bitte bringen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Now is our chance! Will you retrieve this egg for Rudvihil?
dialogsBegin.fil: Now is our chance! Will you retrieve this egg for Rudvihil?
dialogsBegin.fr: Voudrais-tu me le ramener?
dialogsBegin.id: Sekarang adalah kesempatan kita! Maukah kamu mengambil telur ini untuk Rudvihil?
dialogsBegin.it: Now is our chance! Will you retrieve this egg for Rudvihil?
dialogsBegin.jp: そのレッドマンティスを探すのは骨が折れるかもしれないが、頼まれてくれるかい？
dialogsBegin.kr: 지금이 기회예요! 루드비힐을 위해 알을 구해오실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Now is our chance! Will you retrieve this egg for Rudvihil?
dialogsBegin.pl: Now is our chance! Will you retrieve this egg for Rudvihil?
dialogsBegin.ru: Такой шанс нельзя упускать! Ты добудешь яйцо для Сотби?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Es nuestra oportunidad! ¿Conseguirás ese huevo para Rudvihil?
dialogsBegin.sw: Now is our chance! Will you retrieve this egg for Rudvihil?
dialogsBegin.th: นี่เป็นโอกาสของเรา! คุณจะนำไข่ใบนี้ไปให้ Rudvihil หรือไม่?
dialogsBegin.tw: 要幫忙找嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bây giờ là cơ hội của chúng tôi! Bạn sẽ lấy quả trứng này cho Rudvihil chứ?

dialogsAccept.en: I knew you would! The mother, Emerald Mantis, is located somewhere near the Central Hillid Mountains. Find and defeat her, then retrieve the egg!
dialogsAccept.ar: I knew you would! The mother, Emerald Mantis, is located somewhere near the Central Hillid Mountains. Find and defeat her, then retrieve the egg!
dialogsAccept.br: A mãe, Louva-deus Esmeralda, vive em algum lugar no Centro das Montanhas Hillid. Agora é o momento certo, derrote-a! E talvez você consiga obter o ovo!
dialogsAccept.cns: 这个产卵的母亲居住在龙脊山脉中部附近，现在正好是产卵时期，或许可以找得到。
dialogsAccept.de: Ich wusste, dass Du es schaffst! Die Mutter, Emerald Mantis, befindet sich irgendwo in der Nähe der Central Hillid Mountains. Findet und besiegt sie und holt euch dann das Ei!
dialogsAccept.fi: I knew you would! The mother, Emerald Mantis, is located somewhere near the Central Hillid Mountains. Find and defeat her, then retrieve the egg!
dialogsAccept.fil: I knew you would! The mother, Emerald Mantis, is located somewhere near the Central Hillid Mountains. Find and defeat her, then retrieve the egg!
dialogsAccept.fr: Les mères pondeuses vivent quelque part au centre des montagnes de Hillid. C'est la saison des pontes en ce moment, peut-être pourras-tu trouver l'oeuf.
dialogsAccept.id: Saya tahu kamu akan melakukannya! Sang ibu, Emerald Mantis, terletak di suatu tempat di dekat Pegunungan Central Hillid. Temukan dan kalahkan dia, lalu ambil telurnya!
dialogsAccept.it: I knew you would! The mother, Emerald Mantis, is located somewhere near the Central Hillid Mountains. Find and defeat her, then retrieve the egg!
dialogsAccept.jp: この卵を産むレッドマンティスは、ヒルリド山脈中部のどこかに巣を作っているそうだ。ちょうど今が産卵期だから卵が取れるはずだ。運が良かったな。
dialogsAccept.kr: 그럴 줄 알았어요! 에메랄드 맨티스는 힐리드 산맥 중부 어딘가에 있어요. 에메랄드 맨티스를 찾아 처치하고, 알을 가져오세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: I knew you would! The mother, Emerald Mantis, is located somewhere near the Central Hillid Mountains. Find and defeat her, then retrieve the egg!
dialogsAccept.pl: I knew you would! The mother, Emerald Mantis, is located somewhere near the Central Hillid Mountains. Find and defeat her, then retrieve the egg!
dialogsAccept.ru: I knew you would! The mother, Emerald Mantis, is located somewhere near the Central Hillid Mountains. Find and defeat her, then retrieve the egg!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Sabía que lo harías! La madre, Mantis Esmeralda, está cerca del Centro de las Montañas Hillid. ¡Encuéntrala, derrótala y consigue el huevo!
dialogsAccept.sw: I knew you would! The mother, Emerald Mantis, is located somewhere near the Central Hillid Mountains. Find and defeat her, then retrieve the egg!
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันรู้ว่าคุณจะทำ! ตัวแม่ Emerald Mantis อยู่ที่ไหนสักแห่งใกล้เทือกเขา Central Hillid ลองค้นหาดูและเอาชนะเธอ แล้วเอาไข่กลับมา!
dialogsAccept.tw: 我就知道你會的！產卵的赤螳螂媽媽位於中央希爾德山脈附近的某個地方。找到並擊敗她，然後取回卵！
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi biết bạn sẽ làm! Con mẹ, Emerald Mantis, nằm ở đâu đó gần Central Hillid Mountains. Tìm và đánh bại nó, sau đó lấy quả trứng!

dialogsDecline.en: What? Why? We're so close to uncovering a precious artifact? Rudvihil will be disappointed.
dialogsDecline.ar: What? Why? We're so close to uncovering a precious artifact? Rudvihil will be disappointed.
dialogsDecline.br: Que? Por quê? Estamos tão perto de descobrir um artefato precioso! Rudvihil ficará desapontado.
dialogsDecline.cns: 我想萝特泰斯一定会付很多酬劳给你的，所以请放心吧。
dialogsDecline.de: Wie? Was? Warum? Wir sind so kurz davor, ein wertvolles Artefakt zu finden? Rudvihil wird enttäuscht sein.
dialogsDecline.fi: What? Why? We're so close to uncovering a precious artifact? Rudvihil will be disappointed.
dialogsDecline.fil: What? Why? We're so close to uncovering a precious artifact? Rudvihil will be disappointed.
dialogsDecline.fr: Comme je t'ai dit..Hmm.. Rudvihil te récompensera plus que nécessaire. Il n'est pas si près de ses sous.
dialogsDecline.id: Apa? Mengapa? Kami begitu dekat untuk mengungkap artefak berharga? Rudvihil akan kecewa.
dialogsDecline.it: What? Why? We're so close to uncovering a precious artifact? Rudvihil will be disappointed.
dialogsDecline.jp: ルードヴィヒからの報酬は心配しなくて大丈夫だと思うぜ。あいつの性格には問題があると思うが、けちな人間ではないからな。
dialogsDecline.kr: 엥? 왜요? 보물이 코앞에 있는데? 루드비힐이 실망할 거예요.
dialogsDecline.nl: What? Why? We're so close to uncovering a precious artifact? Rudvihil will be disappointed.
dialogsDecline.pl: What? Why? We're so close to uncovering a precious artifact? Rudvihil will be disappointed.
dialogsDecline.ru: Неужели ты откажешься? Сотби будет разочарован.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Qué? ¿Por qué? Estamos muy cerca de descubrir un objeto precioso. Rudvihil se va a decepcionar.
dialogsDecline.sw: What? Why? We're so close to uncovering a precious artifact? Rudvihil will be disappointed.
dialogsDecline.th: อะไรนะ? ทำไมล่ะ? เรากำลังเข้าใกล้สิ่งประดิษฐ์ที่แสนล้ำค่านั่นแล้วนะ? Rudvihil จะต้องผิดหวังแน่ๆ
dialogsDecline.tw: 什麼？為什麼？蘿特泰斯會失望的，我們離發現一件珍貴的神器如此接近？
dialogsDecline.vi: Gì? Tại sao? Chúng ta sắp khám phá ra một hiện vật quý giá? Rudvihil sẽ thất vọng.

dialogsComplete.en: Do you have it? Let me see it! Oh my… it is everything I dreamed it would be. Thank you very much, stranger! My collection is getting better and better!
dialogsComplete.ar: Do you have it? Let me see it! Oh my… it is everything I dreamed it would be. Thank you very much, stranger! My collection is getting better and better!
dialogsComplete.br: Você conseguiu? Deixe-me ver! Oh que magnífico... é tudo o que eu sonhei que seria. Muito obrigado, estranho(a)! Minha coleção está cada vez melhor!
dialogsComplete.cns: 哇!就是这个吗?散发出绿色的光芒。
dialogsComplete.de: Hast du es? Zeig es mir! Oh je... es ist genau so, wie ich es mir erträumt habe. Vielen Dank, Fremder! Meine Sammlung wird immer besser und besser!
dialogsComplete.fi: Do you have it? Let me see it! Oh my… it is everything I dreamed it would be. Thank you very much, stranger! My collection is getting better and better!
dialogsComplete.fil: Do you have it? Let me see it! Oh my… it is everything I dreamed it would be. Thank you very much, stranger! My collection is getting better and better!
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh ! (Admiratif) C'est.. C'est si.. C'est beau.. Si beau..
dialogsComplete.id: Apakah kamu memilikinya? Coba kulihat! Ya ampun ... itu semua yang saya impikan. Terima kasih banyak, orang asing! Koleksi saya menjadi lebih baik dan lebih baik!
dialogsComplete.it: Do you have it? Let me see it! Oh my… it is everything I dreamed it would be. Thank you very much, stranger! My collection is getting better and better!
dialogsComplete.jp: おお！これが噂の卵か！ほう、この深くて美しいグリーンのなんと綺麗なこと…！ため息が出るよ。本当にありがとう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 가져오셨나요? 어서 보여 주세요! 오… 제가 꿈에서 그리던 바로 그 알이에요. 정말 감사합니다, 낯선 분! 제 컬렉션이 점점 완벽해지고 있어요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Do you have it? Let me see it! Oh my… it is everything I dreamed it would be. Thank you very much, stranger! My collection is getting better and better!
dialogsComplete.pl: Do you have it? Let me see it! Oh my… it is everything I dreamed it would be. Thank you very much, stranger! My collection is getting better and better!
dialogsComplete.ru: Тебе удалось его добыть? Дай сюда! О!.. Чистый изумруд!.. Оно еще прекраснее, чем я думал. Это яйцо будет жемчужиной моей коллекции!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿Lo tienes? ¡Déjame verlo! Oh... es como soñé que sería. ¡Muchas gracias, forastero! ¡Mi colección es cada vez mejor!
dialogsComplete.sw: Do you have it? Let me see it! Oh my… it is everything I dreamed it would be. Thank you very much, stranger! My collection is getting better and better!
dialogsComplete.th: คุณได้มาแล้วเหรอ? ให้ฉันดูสิ! โอ้ นี่มัน... มันคือทุกสิ่งทุกอย่างที่ฉันฝันไว้เลย ขอบคุณมากคนแปลกหน้า! คอลเล็กชันของฉันเริ่มดูดีขึ้นและดียิ่งขึ้นไปอีก!
dialogsComplete.tw: 你有嗎？讓我看看！哦，我的……這就是我夢寐以求的一切。非常感謝你，陌生人！我的收藏越來越好！
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn có không? Hãy để tôi nhìn nào! Ôi trời… đó là tất cả những gì tôi mơ ước. Cảm ơn người lạ rất nhiều! Bộ sưu tập của tôi ngày càng tốt hơn!

dialogsComplete.en: Here's a little something for you. Call it a tip! Thanks again!
dialogsComplete.ar: Here's a little something for you. Call it a tip! Thanks again!
dialogsComplete.br: Oh, obrigado. Este é meu presente para você. Não é útil para mim, mas acho que será muito útil para você.
dialogsComplete.cns: 啊，这是给你的酬劳，对我来说没有多少钱，但是对你这种家伙来说应该是满多的啦。
dialogsComplete.de: Oh, Danke sehr! Hier ist ein Geschenk für dich. Es ist für mich nicht von Nutzen, aber für dich vielleicht.
dialogsComplete.fi: Here's a little something for you. Call it a tip! Thanks again!
dialogsComplete.fil: Here's a little something for you. Call it a tip! Thanks again!
dialogsComplete.fr: (Te regardant) Oh, merci. C'est mon cadeau pour toi. Ca ne m'est pas très utile mais ça te le sera. Ha ha ha!
dialogsComplete.id: Ini sedikit sesuatu untukmu. Sebut saja tip! Terima kasih lagi!
dialogsComplete.it: Here's a little something for you. Call it a tip! Thanks again!
dialogsComplete.jp: この卵はわしの想像以上に美しい…！探してきてくれて感謝するよ。さあ、これはわしからの報酬だ、受け取ってくれ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 여기요. 사례라고 생각하세요! 정말 고마워요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Here's a little something for you. Call it a tip! Thanks again!
dialogsComplete.pl: Here's a little something for you. Call it a tip! Thanks again!
dialogsComplete.ru: Вот плата за работу. Я редко это говорю, но… спасибо!
dialogsComplete.sp: Esto es para ti. ¡Considéralo una propina! ¡Gracias de nuevo!
dialogsComplete.sw: Here's a little something for you. Call it a tip! Thanks again!
dialogsComplete.th: นี่เป็นสิ่งเล็กน้อยสำหรับคุณ เรียกว่าทิป! ขอบคุณอีกครั้ง!
dialogsComplete.tw: 啊，這是給你的酬勞，對我來說沒有多少錢，但是對你這種傢伙來說應該是滿多的啦。
dialogsComplete.vi: Đây là một vài thứ cho bạn. Gọi nó là một mẹo! Cảm ơn một lần nữa!

dialogsFail.en: Do you have it? No? Then get back to work!
dialogsFail.ar: Do you have it? No? Then get back to work!
dialogsFail.br: Já conseguiu? Não? Então de volta ao trabalho!
dialogsFail.cns: 你已经找到它了？还没有？那还不快去工作
dialogsFail.de: Hast du es? Nein? Dann geh zurück an die Arbeit!
dialogsFail.fi: Do you have it? No? Then get back to work!
dialogsFail.fil: Do you have it? No? Then get back to work!
dialogsFail.fr: L'avez-vous ? Non ? Alors retournez au travail !
dialogsFail.id: Apakah kamu memilikinya? Tidak? Kemudian kembali bekerja!
dialogsFail.it: Do you have it? No? Then get back to work!
dialogsFail.jp: 持ってない・・・かしら？そうだわ、仕事に戻らなくちゃ。
dialogsFail.kr: 가져오셨나요? 아니에요? 그럼 다시 다녀오세요!
dialogsFail.nl: Do you have it? No? Then get back to work!
dialogsFail.pl: Do you have it? No? Then get back to work!
dialogsFail.ru: Do you have it? No? Then get back to work!
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Lo tienes? ¿No? ¡Pues vuelve al trabajo!
dialogsFail.sw: Do you have it? No? Then get back to work!
dialogsFail.th: คุณได้มันแล้วหรือ? ยังหรือ? งั้นก็กลับไปทำงานซะสิ!
dialogsFail.tw: 你有嗎？不？回去繼續努力吧！
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn có không? Không? Vậy thì quay trở lại làm việc!
