description.en: Travel to the middle of Leren Mountains, near the Grownup Lawolfs. Find Losha's lost puppy, and return to Loyah.
description.ar: Travel to the middle of Leren Mountains, near the Grownup Lawolfs. Find Losha's lost puppy, and return to Loyah.
description.br: Ela trouxe o cãozinho de algum lugar no meio das Montanhas Leren, onde vivem os Lawolfs Adultos. Acho que talvez você possa encontrá-lo lá.
description.cns: 那只小狗在乐雅山脉发现的，说不定它就在那里！
description.de: Sie hat ihn in der Mitte des Leren Gebirges gesehen, wo die Grownup Lawolf leben. Dort kannst du ihn finden.
description.fi: Travel to the middle of Leren Mountains, near the Grownup Lawolfs. Find Losha's lost puppy, and return to Loyah.
description.fil: Travel to the middle of Leren Mountains, near the Grownup Lawolfs. Find Losha's lost puppy, and return to Loyah.
description.fr: Retrouver Yorrn, disparu dans les Montagnes centrales de Leren où vivent les Géants Lawolfs.
description.id: Perjalanan ke tengah Leren Mountains, dekat Grownup Lawolfs. Temukan anak anjing Losha yang hilang, dan kembali ke Loyah.
description.it: Travel to the middle of Leren Mountains, near the Grownup Lawolfs. Find Losha's lost puppy, and return to Loyah.
description.jp: ヨールンはレルエン山脈中部にあるグロウアップ・ラーウルフの生息地にいます。探しに行きましょう。
description.kr: 레르엔 산맥 중부 성체 로울프 서식지 근처에서 로샤의 잃어버린 강아지를 찾아 로야에게 돌아가세요.
description.nl: Travel to the middle of Leren Mountains, near the Grownup Lawolfs. Find Losha's lost puppy, and return to Loyah.
description.pl: Travel to the middle of Leren Mountains, near the Grownup Lawolfs. Find Losha's lost puppy, and return to Loyah.
description.ru: Нужно пойти в Леренские горки, туда, где живут сильные волкопарды, найти Плюшу и вернуться к Леле.
description.sp: Viaja al Centro de las Montañas Leren, cerca de los Lawolfs Adultos. Encuentra el cachorro perdido de Losha y vuelve con Loyah.
description.sw: Travel to the middle of Leren Mountains, near the Grownup Lawolfs. Find Losha's lost puppy, and return to Loyah.
description.th: เดินทางไปยังฟาร์ม Grownup Lawolfs กลาง Leren Mountains ค้นหาลูกสุนัขที่หายไปของ Losha และกลับไปหา Loyah
description.tw: 那隻小狗在勒倫山脈發現的，說不定牠就在那裡！
description.vi: Đi đến giữa Leren Mountains, gần Grownup Lawolfs. Tìm con chó con bị lạc của Losha, và trở lại Loyah.

dialogsBegin.en: Excuse me, can I talk to you for a moment?
dialogsBegin.ar: Excuse me, can I talk to you for a moment?
dialogsBegin.br: Com licença, você poderia chegar mais perto de mim? Hmm... Bem, acho que talvez você possa me ajudar.
dialogsBegin.cns: 请问~请问？！是我在跟你说话啦！
dialogsBegin.de: Entschuldigung, könntest du näher kommen? Hmm.. Nun, ich glaube du kannst mir helfen, vielleicht.
dialogsBegin.fi: Excuse me, can I talk to you for a moment?
dialogsBegin.fil: Excuse me, can I talk to you for a moment?
dialogsBegin.fr: Excuse-moi, tu pourrais t'approcher un peu ? Hmm... (regardant attentivement) Bon, je pense que tu pourras m'être utile, enfin j'espère.
dialogsBegin.id: Permisi, bisakah saya berbicara denganmu sebentar?
dialogsBegin.it: Excuse me, can I talk to you for a moment?
dialogsBegin.jp: こんにちは♪私の名前は＜ロコ＞。隣にいるのは＜ロシャ＞お姉ちゃんだよ。よろしくね♪
dialogsBegin.kr: 실례지만, 잠시 저희 이야기 좀 들어주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Excuse me, can I talk to you for a moment?
dialogsBegin.pl: Excuse me, can I talk to you for a moment?
dialogsBegin.ru: Можно тебя кое о чем попросить?
dialogsBegin.sp: Disculpa, ¿puedo hablar contigo un momento?
dialogsBegin.sw: Excuse me, can I talk to you for a moment?
dialogsBegin.th: ขอโทษนะ ฉันสามารถคุยกับคุณสักครู่ได้มั้ย?
dialogsBegin.tw: 請問~請問？！是我在跟你說話啦！
dialogsBegin.vi: Xin lỗi, tôi có thể nói chuyện với bạn một chút được không?

dialogsBegin.en: The pretty lady beside me is Losha, my elder sister. I am her younger sister, Loyah.
dialogsBegin.ar: The pretty lady beside me is Losha, my elder sister. I am her younger sister, Loyah.
dialogsBegin.br: A bela dama a meu lado é Losha, minha irmã mais velha. E eu sou a irmãzinha querida dela, Loyah. Aliás...
dialogsBegin.cns: 旁边的这位小姐就是我姊姊萝夏，我是她妹妹乐亚。
dialogsBegin.de: Die hübsche Frau neben mir ist Losha, meine ältere Schwester. Ich bin ihre jüngere Schwester, Loyah.
dialogsBegin.fi: The pretty lady beside me is Losha, my elder sister. I am her younger sister, Loyah.
dialogsBegin.fil: The pretty lady beside me is Losha, my elder sister. I am her younger sister, Loyah.
dialogsBegin.fr: La jolie fille à côté de moi, c'est Losha, ma grande soeur. Je suis Loyah sa cadette. Et donc.
dialogsBegin.id: Wanita cantik di sampingku adalah Losha, kakak perempuanku. Saya adiknya, Loyah.
dialogsBegin.it: The pretty lady beside me is Losha, my elder sister. I am her younger sister, Loyah.
dialogsBegin.jp: 隣にいる女性が私の姉のロシャです。 私は弟のロヤです。 本論に入りますが..
dialogsBegin.kr: 제 옆의 예쁜 아가씨가 언니, 로샤예요. 저는 동생, 로야고요.
dialogsBegin.nl: The pretty lady beside me is Losha, my elder sister. I am her younger sister, Loyah.
dialogsBegin.pl: The pretty lady beside me is Losha, my elder sister. I am her younger sister, Loyah.
dialogsBegin.ru: Я Леля, а это Люша, моя старшая сестра. Правда же, она у меня красавица?
dialogsBegin.sp: La chica guapa que hay a mi lado es Losha, mi hermana mayor. Soy su hermana menor, Loyah.
dialogsBegin.sw: The pretty lady beside me is Losha, my elder sister. I am her younger sister, Loyah.
dialogsBegin.th: หญิงสาวแสนสวยข้างๆ ฉันคือ Losha เป็นพี่สาวของฉันเอง ฉันเป็นน้องสาวของเธอชื่อ Loyah
dialogsBegin.tw: 旁邊的這位小姐就是我姊姊蘿夏，我是她妹妹樂亞。
dialogsBegin.vi: Quý cô xinh đẹp đứng cạnh tôi là Losha, chị gái của tôi. Còn tôi là Loyah, em gái của cô ấy.

dialogsBegin.en: My sister has a very cute puppy, but unfortunately, he's gone missing! She originally found the puppy up in the mountains.
dialogsBegin.ar: My sister has a very cute puppy, but unfortunately, he's gone missing! She originally found the puppy up in the mountains.
dialogsBegin.br: Minha irmã tem um cãozinho muito fofo, mas infelizmente ele se perdeu. Na verdade, ela o resgatou em uma montanha pois, ...
dialogsBegin.cns: 我姊姊原本有养一只从山上捡到的小狗，但小狗突然不见了……
dialogsBegin.de: Meine Schwester hat einen sehr süßen Welpen, aber leider ist er verschwunden! Ursprünglich hat sie den Welpen oben in den Bergen gefunden.
dialogsBegin.fi: My sister has a very cute puppy, but unfortunately, he's gone missing! She originally found the puppy up in the mountains.
dialogsBegin.fil: My sister has a very cute puppy, but unfortunately, he's gone missing! She originally found the puppy up in the mountains.
dialogsBegin.fr: Ma soeur avait un petit chiot, Yorrn. Elle l'avait trouvé en se balladant dans les montagnes de Leren.
dialogsBegin.id: Adikku memiliki anak anjing yang sangat lucu, tapi sayangnya, dia hilang! Dia awalnya menemukan anak anjing di pegunungan.
dialogsBegin.it: My sister has a very cute puppy, but unfortunately, he's gone missing! She originally found the puppy up in the mountains.
dialogsBegin.jp: 姉が新たに子犬を一つ育てているのですが、その子犬がなくなりました。 もともと山に捨てられていた子犬だったのに…
dialogsBegin.kr: 우리 언니가 새로 강아지를 한 마리 키우기 시작했는데, 그 녀석을 잃어버렸어요!
dialogsBegin.nl: My sister has a very cute puppy, but unfortunately, he's gone missing! She originally found the puppy up in the mountains.
dialogsBegin.pl: My sister has a very cute puppy, but unfortunately, he's gone missing! She originally found the puppy up in the mountains.
dialogsBegin.ru: Сестренка обожает Плюшу, своего щенка. Она нашла его в горах. Бедняжка дрожал от холода и голода.
dialogsBegin.sp: Mi hermana tiene un cachorrito muy lindo, pero desafortunadamente, ¡ha desaparecido! Se encontró al cachorro en las montañas por primera vez.
dialogsBegin.sw: My sister has a very cute puppy, but unfortunately, he's gone missing! She originally found the puppy up in the mountains.
dialogsBegin.th: พี่สาวของฉันมีลูกสุนัขที่น่ารักมาก แต่น่าเสียดายที่มันหายไป! ในตอนแรกพี่สาวของฉันเจอมันบนภูเขา
dialogsBegin.tw: 我姊姊原本有養一隻從山上撿到的小狗，但小狗突然不見了……
dialogsBegin.vi: Em gái tôi có một con chó con rất dễ thương, nhưng thật không may, nó đã mất tích! Cô ấy ban đầu đã tìm thấy con chó con trên núi.

dialogsBegin.en: When she first saw the puppy, it was cold and starving. So she brought it home and took care of it, but suddenly it disappeared one day.
dialogsBegin.ar: When she first saw the puppy, it was cold and starving. So she brought it home and took care of it, but suddenly it disappeared one day.
dialogsBegin.br: ... ele parecia estar com fome e frio. Então ela o trouxe para casa e passou a tomar conta dele. Mas um dia ele desapareceu de repente. Desde então...
dialogsBegin.cns: 听我姊姊说，在山上发现这只小狗时，好像已经饿了很久没吃东西，那模样真是可怜。
dialogsBegin.de: Als sie den Welpen das erste Mal sah, war ihm kalt und er hatte Hunger. Also nahm sie ihn mit nach Hause und kümmerte sich um ihn, doch eines Tages war er plötzlich verschwunden.
dialogsBegin.fi: When she first saw the puppy, it was cold and starving. So she brought it home and took care of it, but suddenly it disappeared one day.
dialogsBegin.fil: When she first saw the puppy, it was cold and starving. So she brought it home and took care of it, but suddenly it disappeared one day.
dialogsBegin.fr: .il était vraiment frigorifié et apeuré. Elle l'a alors ramené à la maison et en a pris soin, mais un jour il a soudainement disparu.
dialogsBegin.id: Ketika dia pertama kali melihat anak anjing itu, dia kedinginan dan kelaparan. Jadi dia membawanya pulang dan merawatnya, tapi tiba-tiba menghilang suatu hari.
dialogsBegin.it: When she first saw the puppy, it was cold and starving. So she brought it home and took care of it, but suddenly it disappeared one day.
dialogsBegin.jp: 姉が可哀想で連れて来て育てたんですけど、ある日その子犬がいなくなってしまって。 それからというもの、私たちの姉は…
dialogsBegin.kr: 원래는 산에서 우연히 발견한 아이였어요. 덜덜 떠는 모습이 불쌍해서 데려다 키운 거죠. 데려와서 정성껏 돌봤는데, 어느 날 갑자기 사라져 버렸어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: When she first saw the puppy, it was cold and starving. So she brought it home and took care of it, but suddenly it disappeared one day.
dialogsBegin.pl: When she first saw the puppy, it was cold and starving. So she brought it home and took care of it, but suddenly it disappeared one day.
dialogsBegin.ru: Люша принесла его домой, отогрела и вылечила. С тех пор они были неразлучны. И вот Плюша пропал…
dialogsBegin.sp: Cuando vio al cachorro por primera vez, tenía frío y hambre. Así que se lo llevó a casa y lo cuidó, pero de repente, un día desapareció.
dialogsBegin.sw: When she first saw the puppy, it was cold and starving. So she brought it home and took care of it, but suddenly it disappeared one day.
dialogsBegin.th: ตอนที่พี่สาวฉันเจอลูกหมาตัวนี้ ตอนแรกมันทั้งหนาวและหิวโหย ดังนั้นเธอจึงพามันกลับมาและเลี้ยงดูมัน แต่แล้วจู่ๆ วันหนึ่งมันก็หายไป
dialogsBegin.tw: 聽我姊姊說，在山上發現這隻小狗時，好像已經餓了很久沒吃東西，那模樣真是可憐。
dialogsBegin.vi: Khi lần đầu tiên cô nhìn thấy con chó con, nó lạnh và đói. Vì vậy, cô đã mang nó về nhà và chăm sóc, nhưng bỗng một ngày nó biến mất.

dialogsBegin.en: Since then, my sister has been looking everywhere for the puppy. She doesn't eat or drink or sleep. Would you please help my sister find her lost puppy?
dialogsBegin.ar: Since then, my sister has been looking everywhere for the puppy. She doesn't eat or drink or sleep. Would you please help my sister find her lost puppy?
dialogsBegin.br: ... minha irmã não come, nem bebe e o está procurando em toda parte. Você poderia, por favor, ajudar minha irmã a encontrar seu cachorrinho perdido? Por favor?
dialogsBegin.cns: 姊姊很有爱心的把他带回家好好照顾，但现在小狗失踪了，我姊姊着急地吃不下饭，真不知道该怎么办才好。
dialogsBegin.de: Seitdem hat meine Schwester überall nach dem Welpen gesucht. Sie isst, trinkt und schläft nicht. Würdest du meiner Schwester bitte helfen, ihren verlorenen Welpen zu finden?
dialogsBegin.fi: Since then, my sister has been looking everywhere for the puppy. She doesn't eat or drink or sleep. Would you please help my sister find her lost puppy?
dialogsBegin.fil: Since then, my sister has been looking everywhere for the puppy. She doesn't eat or drink or sleep. Would you please help my sister find her lost puppy?
dialogsBegin.fr: Depuis ma soeur a arrêté de boire et manger et le cherche partout. Pourrais-tu aider ma sœur, s'il te plaît ?
dialogsBegin.id: Sejak itu, saudara perempuan saya mencari anak anjing itu ke mana-mana. Dia tidak makan atau minum atau tidur. Maukah kamu membantu saudara perempuan saya menemukan anak anjingnya yang hilang?
dialogsBegin.it: Since then, my sister has been looking everywhere for the puppy. She doesn't eat or drink or sleep. Would you please help my sister find her lost puppy?
dialogsBegin.jp: 水も口にしません。私の姉を助けてください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그 후로 언니는 온 산을 뒤지고 있어요. 밥도 안 먹고, 물도 안 마시고, 잠도 못 자고요. 제발, 언니를 도와 강아지를 찾아주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Since then, my sister has been looking everywhere for the puppy. She doesn't eat or drink or sleep. Would you please help my sister find her lost puppy?
dialogsBegin.pl: Since then, my sister has been looking everywhere for the puppy. She doesn't eat or drink or sleep. Would you please help my sister find her lost puppy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Сестренка не ест, не спит, только ищет Плюшу и плачет. Ты поможешь его найти, правда?
dialogsBegin.sp: Desde entonces, mi hermana ha estado buscando al cachorro por todas partes. No come ni bebe ni duerme. ¿Podrías ayudar a mi hermana a encontrar a su cachorro perdido?
dialogsBegin.sw: Since then, my sister has been looking everywhere for the puppy. She doesn't eat or drink or sleep. Would you please help my sister find her lost puppy?
dialogsBegin.th: ตั้งแต่นั้นเป็นต้นมา พี่สาวของฉันก็ตามหามันจนทั่วไปหมด เธอกินไม่ได้นอนไม่หลับเลย คุณช่วยตามหาลูกหมาของพี่สาวฉันที่หายไปให้หน่อยได้ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 姊姊很有愛心的把他帶回家好好照顧，但現在小狗失蹤了，我姊姊著急地吃不下飯，真不知道該怎麼辦才好。你可以幫她找回失蹤的小狗嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Kể từ đó, em gái tôi đã đi tìm khắp nơi để tìm con chó con. Cô ấy không ăn uống, không ngủ. Bạn có vui lòng giúp em gái tôi tìm thấy con chó con bị mất của cô ấy không?

dialogsAccept.en: Great! She found the puppy somewhere in the middle of Leren Mountains where the Grownup Lawolfs live. Maybe the puppy is trying to find it's way home?
dialogsAccept.ar: Great! She found the puppy somewhere in the middle of Leren Mountains where the Grownup Lawolfs live. Maybe the puppy is trying to find it's way home?
dialogsAccept.br: Ótimo! Ela trouxe o cãozinho de algum lugar no meio das Montanhas Leren , onde vivem os Lawolfs Adultos. Acho que talvez você possa encontrá-lo lá.
dialogsAccept.cns: 太好了！你可以帮忙找找小狗的下落吗？小狗是在乐雅山脉发现的，或许它自己又跑回去那里也是有可能的说。
dialogsAccept.de: Danke! Sie hat das Hündchen in der Mitte des Leren Gebirges gefunden, wo die Grownup Lawolfs leben. Ich glaube du kannst ihn vielleicht dort finden.
dialogsAccept.fi: Great! She found the puppy somewhere in the middle of Leren Mountains where the Grownup Lawolfs live. Maybe the puppy is trying to find it's way home?
dialogsAccept.fil: Great! She found the puppy somewhere in the middle of Leren Mountains where the Grownup Lawolfs live. Maybe the puppy is trying to find it's way home?
dialogsAccept.fr: Génial ! Losha se promenait avec Yorrn dans les Montagnes centrales de Leren, là où vivent les Géants Lawolfs... C'est dans cette zone qu'il a disparu...
dialogsAccept.id: Besar! Dia menemukan anak anjing itu di suatu tempat di tengah Leren Mountains tempat para Grownup Lawolfs tinggal. Mungkin anak anjing itu mencoba mencari jalan pulang?
dialogsAccept.it: Great! She found the puppy somewhere in the middle of Leren Mountains where the Grownup Lawolfs live. Maybe the puppy is trying to find it's way home?
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとう！ヨールンはお姉ちゃんの匂いがする毛布にくるまって、いつもおねんねしてたんだよ。その毛布を見つければ、きっとヨールンが飛びついてくるよ！……約束だよ。きっとヨールンを連れ帰ってね。
dialogsAccept.kr: 감사해요! 언니가 강아지를 처음 찾았던 곳은 레르엔 산맥 중부, 성체 로울프들이 사는 곳 근처였어요. 강아지가 집을 찾아 돌아간 걸까요?
dialogsAccept.nl: Great! She found the puppy somewhere in the middle of Leren Mountains where the Grownup Lawolfs live. Maybe the puppy is trying to find it's way home?
dialogsAccept.pl: Great! She found the puppy somewhere in the middle of Leren Mountains where the Grownup Lawolfs live. Maybe the puppy is trying to find it's way home?
dialogsAccept.ru: Спасибо! Люша нашла его в Леренских горках, где водятся сильные волкопарды. Может, он опять пошел гулять туда и забыл дорогу домой?
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Estupendo! Encontró al cachorro en algún lugar del Centro de las Montañas Leren, donde viven los Lawolfs Adultos. Quizá el cachorro está intentando encontrar el camino a casa.
dialogsAccept.sw: Great! She found the puppy somewhere in the middle of Leren Mountains where the Grownup Lawolfs live. Maybe the puppy is trying to find it's way home?
dialogsAccept.th: ดีมาก! เธอพบลูกสุนัขตัวหนึ่งอยู่ที่ฟาร์ม Grownup Lawolfs กลาง Leren Mountains บางทีลูกสุนัขอาจจะพยายามหาทางกลับบ้าน?
dialogsAccept.tw: 你可以幫忙找找小狗的下落嗎？小狗是在勒倫山脈發現的，或許牠自己又跑回去那裡也有可能說。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tuyệt quá! Cô tìm thấy con chó con ở đâu đó giữa Leren Mountains, nơi gia đình Grownup Lawolf sinh sống. Có lẽ con chó con đang cố gắng tìm đường về nhà?

dialogsDecline.en: How could you refuse the request from a lady? You have no social manners! Have you no shame?!
dialogsDecline.ar: How could you refuse the request from a lady? You have no social manners! Have you no shame?!
dialogsDecline.br: Como você pode recusar uma solicitação de uma dama? Parece que você não sabe nada de etiqueta social!
dialogsDecline.cns: 你真的不能帮这个忙吗？哼！我讨厌你！
dialogsDecline.de: Wie kannst du es wagen die Bitte einer Dame auszuschlagen? Es scheint, du hast nie Manieren gelernt!
dialogsDecline.fi: How could you refuse the request from a lady? You have no social manners! Have you no shame?!
dialogsDecline.fil: How could you refuse the request from a lady? You have no social manners! Have you no shame?!
dialogsDecline.fr: Comment peux-tu refuser les requêtes d'une petite fille ? Tu es vraiment sans cœur.
dialogsDecline.id: Bagaimana kamu bisa menolak permintaan dari seorang wanita? Kamu tidak memiliki sopan santunl! Apa kau tidak malu?!
dialogsDecline.it: How could you refuse the request from a lady? You have no social manners! Have you no shame?!
dialogsDecline.jp: レディーの頼みを断るなんて、マナーがなっていないわ。プンプン！
dialogsDecline.kr: 아가씨의 부탁을 거절하다니! 너무하시네요. 측은지심도 없나요?!
dialogsDecline.nl: How could you refuse the request from a lady? You have no social manners! Have you no shame?!
dialogsDecline.pl: How could you refuse the request from a lady? You have no social manners! Have you no shame?!
dialogsDecline.ru: Как не стыдно! Тебя же девушка просит!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Cómo puedes rechazar la petición de una dama? ¡No tienes ni idea sobre modales! ¿No te da vergüenza?
dialogsDecline.sw: How could you refuse the request from a lady? You have no social manners! Have you no shame?!
dialogsDecline.th: คุณปฏิเสธคำขอของสุภาพสตรีได้ไงกัน? คุณช่างไม่มีมารยาท! คุณไม่มีความอับอายเลยงั้นหรือ?!
dialogsDecline.tw: 你真的不能幫這個忙嗎？哼！我討厭你！
dialogsDecline.vi: Làm sao bạn có thể từ chối yêu cầu từ một người phụ nữ? Bạn không biết ứng xử xã hội! Bạn không xấu hổ à?!

dialogsComplete.en: Yorrn! Where did you find him? In the mountains!? I knew it! He was probably trying to find his way home! Welcome back, Yorrn!
dialogsComplete.ar: Yorrn! Where did you find him? In the mountains!? I knew it! He was probably trying to find his way home! Welcome back, Yorrn!
dialogsComplete.br: Yorrnnnn! Onde você o encontrou? Nas montanhas? Ha ha, eu sabia!! Ele provavelmente estava tentando encontrar o caminho de casa! Bem-vindo de volta, Yorrnzinho!
dialogsComplete.cns: Yorrn! Where did you find him? In the mountains!? I knew it! He was probably trying to find his way home! Welcome back, Yorrn!
dialogsComplete.de: Oh mein, Yorrn! Wo hast du ihn gefunden? Oh, dort wo ich sagte? Ich wusste es!! Willkommen zurück, Yorrn.
dialogsComplete.fi: Yorrn! Where did you find him? In the mountains!? I knew it! He was probably trying to find his way home! Welcome back, Yorrn!
dialogsComplete.fil: Yorrn! Where did you find him? In the mountains!? I knew it! He was probably trying to find his way home! Welcome back, Yorrn!
dialogsComplete.fr: Par Rhisis ! Yorrn ! Où l'as-tu retrouvé, là où je te l'avais indiqué ? Je le savais !! Je suis si heureuse de te revoir Yornn ~
dialogsComplete.id: Yorrn! Di mana kamu menemukannya? Di pegunungan!? Aku tahu itu!! Dia mungkin berusaha menemukan jalan pulang! Selamat datang kembali, Yorn!
dialogsComplete.it: Yorrn! Where did you find him? In the mountains!? I knew it! He was probably trying to find his way home! Welcome back, Yorrn!
dialogsComplete.jp: あっ……ヨールン！どこに行ってたの！？どれだけ心配…心配したか……！これからはずーと一緒だよ。ねっ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 요른! 어디서 찾으셨어요? 산에서요!? 세상에! 집에 가는 길을 찾으려던 거겠죠! 잘 돌아왔어, 요른!
dialogsComplete.nl: Yorrn! Where did you find him? In the mountains!? I knew it! He was probably trying to find his way home! Welcome back, Yorrn!
dialogsComplete.pl: Yorrn! Where did you find him? In the mountains!? I knew it! He was probably trying to find his way home! Welcome back, Yorrn!
dialogsComplete.ru: Yorrn! Where did you find him? In the mountains!? I knew it! He was probably trying to find his way home! Welcome back, Yorrn!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Yorrn! ¿Dónde lo has encontrado? ¿¡En las montañas!? ¡¡Lo sabía!! ¡Seguro que estaba intentando encontrar el camino a casa! ¡Bienvenido de nuevo, Yorrn!
dialogsComplete.sw: Yorrn! Where did you find him? In the mountains!? I knew it! He was probably trying to find his way home! Welcome back, Yorrn!
dialogsComplete.th: Yorrn! คุณเจอเขาที่ไหนงั้นหรือ? ในภูเขาเหรอ!? ฉันว่าแล้ว!! เขาอาจจะพยายามหาทางกลับบ้าน! ยินดีต้อนรับกลับบ้านนะ Yorrn!
dialogsComplete.tw: Yorrn！你在哪裡找到他的？在山裡！？我就知道！他一定是在想辦法回家！歡迎回來，Yorrn！
dialogsComplete.vi: Yorrn! Bạn đã tìm thấy em ấy ở đâu? Trên núi à!? Tôi biết mà!! Em ấy có lẽ đang cố gắng tìm đường về nhà! Chào mừng trở lại, Yorrn!

dialogsFail.en: Have you found Yorrn? No? Well, please keep looking! I'm worried about my sister!
dialogsFail.ar: Have you found Yorrn? No? Well, please keep looking! I'm worried about my sister!
dialogsFail.br: Você conseguiu achar o Yorrn? Não? Bem, por favor, continue procurando! Estou preocupado com minha irmã!
dialogsFail.cns: 还没有露露的下落？那…是不是…你根本没有去找过啊！(讨厌的眼神瞪着你@@)
dialogsFail.de: Hast du Yorrn gefunden? Nein? Dann such bitte weiter! Ich mache mir Sorgen um meine Schwester!
dialogsFail.fi: Have you found Yorrn? No? Well, please keep looking! I'm worried about my sister!
dialogsFail.fil: Have you found Yorrn? No? Well, please keep looking! I'm worried about my sister!
dialogsFail.fr: Tu ne l'as pas trouvé là-bas ? Ou. tu ne l'a même pas cherché, c'est ça? (lançant un regard glacial)
dialogsFail.id: Sudahkah kamu menemukan Yorn? Tidak? Nah, silakan terus mencari! Aku khawatir tentang adikku!
dialogsFail.it: Have you found Yorrn? No? Well, please keep looking! I'm worried about my sister!
dialogsFail.jp: 本当にいなかったの？もうっ！ちゃんと探してくれなきゃダメじゃない！
dialogsFail.kr: 요른을 찾으셨나요? 아직이요? 계속 찾아봐 주세요! 언니가 걱정되어서요!
dialogsFail.nl: Have you found Yorrn? No? Well, please keep looking! I'm worried about my sister!
dialogsFail.pl: Have you found Yorrn? No? Well, please keep looking! I'm worried about my sister!
dialogsFail.ru: Тебе удалось найти Плюшу? Пожалуйста, поищи его! Сестренка все время плачет.
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Has encontrado a Yorrn? ¿No? Bueno, ¡sigue buscando por favor! ¡Estoy preocupada por mi hermana!
dialogsFail.sw: Have you found Yorrn? No? Well, please keep looking! I'm worried about my sister!
dialogsFail.th: คุณหา Yorrn พบแล้วหรือยัง? ยังไม่เจองั้นเหรอ? งั้นก็โปรดมองหาดูดีๆ สิ! ฉันเป็นห่วงพี่สาวของฉัน!
dialogsFail.tw: 還沒有露露的下落？那…是不是…你根本沒有去找過啊！(討厭的眼神瞪著你@@)
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn đã tìm thấy Yorrn chưa? Không không? Vâng, xin hãy tiếp tục tìm kiếm! Tôi lo lắng cho em gái bé bỏng của mình quá!

dialogsBegin.en: Why am I looking so distraught after analyzing the text you ask? Well… I guess the results are not what I would have wanted…
dialogsBegin.ar: Why am I looking so distraught after analyzing the text you ask? Well… I guess the results are not what I would have wanted…
dialogsBegin.br: Por que estou tão perturbada após analisar o texto você pergunta? Bem… Acho que os resultados não são bem o que eu gostaria…
dialogsBegin.cns: 为什么在分析了你问的文字后我看起来如此心烦意乱？嗯…我想这不是我想要的结果…
dialogsBegin.de: Sie fragen sich, warum ich nach der Analyse des Textes so verzweifelt aussehe? Nun... ich schätze, die Ergebnisse sind nicht das, was ich mir gewünscht hätte...
dialogsBegin.fi: Why am I looking so distraught after analyzing the text you ask? Well… I guess the results are not what I would have wanted…
dialogsBegin.fil: Why am I looking so distraught after analyzing the text you ask? Well… I guess the results are not what I would have wanted…
dialogsBegin.fr: Oui, j'ai l'air troublée… la supplique n'est qu'une prière ancienne pour demander la clémence divine.
dialogsBegin.id: Mengapa saya terlihat begitu putus asa setelah menganalisis teks yang kau tanyakan? Kurasa karena hasilnya bukanlah apa yang saya inginkan...
dialogsBegin.it: Why am I looking so distraught after analyzing the text you ask? Well… I guess the results are not what I would have wanted…
dialogsBegin.jp: 解読を終えたのになぜこんなに暗い表情なのですかって？　ふう……実は私の想像とは異なる結果だったのです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 해독을 마쳤는데 제 표정이 왜 어둡냐고요? 해독된 내용이 기뻐할 만한 내용이 아니어서 그렇답니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Why am I looking so distraught after analyzing the text you ask? Well… I guess the results are not what I would have wanted…
dialogsBegin.pl: Why am I looking so distraught after analyzing the text you ask? Well… I guess the results are not what I would have wanted…
dialogsBegin.ru: Why am I looking so distraught after analyzing the text you ask? Well… I guess the results are not what I would have wanted…
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Que por qué tengo esta cara de preocupación después de analizar el pergamino dices? Bueno... supongo que los resultados no son los que yo hubiera querido...
dialogsBegin.sw: Why am I looking so distraught after analyzing the text you ask? Well… I guess the results are not what I would have wanted…
dialogsBegin.th: ทำไมฉันจึงมองหาความหวังดังนั้นหลังจากวิเคราะห์ข้อความที่คุณต้องการ? ดี ... ฉันเดาผลลัพท์ที่จะเกิดขึ้นไม่ได้...
dialogsBegin.tw: 為什麼我在分析了你問的文字後看起來如此心煩意亂？嗯……我想結果不是我想要的……
dialogsBegin.vi: Tại sao tôi trông rất quẫn trí sau khi phân tích đoạn văn bản mà bạn hỏi? Chà… tôi đoán kết quả không như tôi mong muốn…

dialogsBegin.en: The records indicate that despite the efforts made by the 8 heroes to expunge any trace of Shade's existence, her essence still persists throughout this world.
dialogsBegin.ar: The records indicate that despite the efforts made by the 8 heroes to expunge any trace of Shade's existence, her essence still persists throughout this world.
dialogsBegin.br: Os registros indicam que, apesar dos esforços feitos pelos 8 heróis para expurgar qualquer vestígio da existência de Shade, sua essência ainda persiste por todo este mundo.
dialogsBegin.cns: 记录显示，尽管8位英雄努力抹去了谢莉德存在的所有痕迹，但她的意识仍然存在于世界各地。
dialogsBegin.de: Aus den Aufzeichnungen geht hervor, dass trotz der Bemühungen der 8 Helden, jede Spur von Shades Existenz zu verwischen, ihre Essenz immer noch in dieser Welt vorhanden ist.
dialogsBegin.fi: The records indicate that despite the efforts made by the 8 heroes to expunge any trace of Shade's existence, her essence still persists throughout this world.
dialogsBegin.fil: The records indicate that despite the efforts made by the 8 heroes to expunge any trace of Shade's existence, her essence still persists throughout this world.
dialogsBegin.fr: Elle fait référence à la malédiction qui touche les monstres et à la prophétie de la libération.
dialogsBegin.id: Catatan menunjukkan bahwa terlepas dari upaya yang dilakukan oleh 8 pahlawan untuk menghapus jejak keberadaan Shade, esensinya masih bertahan di seluruh dunia ini.
dialogsBegin.it: The records indicate that despite the efforts made by the 8 heroes to expunge any trace of Shade's existence, her essence still persists throughout this world.
dialogsBegin.jp: 記録によると、シェードの存在の痕跡を消すために8人の英雄が努力したにもかかわらず、彼女の本質はこの世界全体に残っています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이블리스의 기록은 이블리스가 소멸하기 전 남겼다고 전해지는 기록이죠. 그곳에 써있는 내용은, 이블리스의 예언, 또는 저주 같은 거였어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: The records indicate that despite the efforts made by the 8 heroes to expunge any trace of Shade's existence, her essence still persists throughout this world.
dialogsBegin.pl: The records indicate that despite the efforts made by the 8 heroes to expunge any trace of Shade's existence, her essence still persists throughout this world.
dialogsBegin.ru: The records indicate that despite the efforts made by the 8 heroes to expunge any trace of Shade's existence, her essence still persists throughout this world.
dialogsBegin.sp: Los registros indican que a pesar de los esfuerzos realizados por los 8 héroes para eliminar cualquier rastro de la existencia de Shade, su esencia continúa en este mundo.
dialogsBegin.sw: The records indicate that despite the efforts made by the 8 heroes to expunge any trace of Shade's existence, her essence still persists throughout this world.
dialogsBegin.th: ระเบียนแสดงให้เห็นว่าแม้จะมีความพยายามของวีรบุรุษทั้ง 8 ตัวเพื่อขจัดร่องรอยการดำรงอยู่ของ Shade แต่สาระสำคัญของเธอยังคงมีอยู่ทั่วโลกนี้
dialogsBegin.tw: 記錄表明，儘管 8 位英雄努力抹去闇影存在的任何痕跡，但她的本質仍然存在於這個世界上。
dialogsBegin.vi: Các ghi chép chỉ ra rằng bất chấp những nỗ lực của 8 anh hùng để xóa bỏ bất kỳ dấu vết nào về sự tồn tại của Shade, nhưng bản chất của bà ấy vẫn tồn tại trên khắp thế giới này.

dialogsBegin.en: When the time is right, she will regain her physical form and return anew to command her masquerpet army. It is her intention to reclaim the known world as her own…
dialogsBegin.ar: When the time is right, she will regain her physical form and return anew to command her masquerpet army. It is her intention to reclaim the known world as her own…
dialogsBegin.br: Quando for a hora certa, ela recuperará sua forma física e retornará novamente para comandar seu exército de masquerpets. E sua intenção é recuperar o mundo que ela proclamou ser seu…
dialogsBegin.cns: 当时机成熟时，她将恢复她的肉身，然后重新回来指挥她的怪物军队。她想把现在这个世界变成她能独自霸权的世界…
dialogsBegin.de: Wenn die Zeit reif ist, wird sie ihre körperliche Gestalt wiedererlangen und erneut zurückkehren, um ihre Maskerettenarmee zu befehligen. Es ist ihre Absicht, die bekannte Welt als ihre eigene zurückzuerobern...
dialogsBegin.fi: When the time is right, she will regain her physical form and return anew to command her masquerpet army. It is her intention to reclaim the known world as her own…
dialogsBegin.fil: When the time is right, she will regain her physical form and return anew to command her masquerpet army. It is her intention to reclaim the known world as her own…
dialogsBegin.fr: Selon le texte le jour de la libération se rapproche. Ça explique sans doute l'agitation des monstres.
dialogsBegin.id: Ketika waktunya tepat, dia akan mendapatkan kembali bentuk fisiknya dan kembali lagi untuk memimpin pasukan penyamarannya. Ini adalah niatnya untuk merebut kembali dunia sebagai miliknya...
dialogsBegin.it: When the time is right, she will regain her physical form and return anew to command her masquerpet army. It is her intention to reclaim the known world as her own…
dialogsBegin.jp: 時が来れば、彼女は体の形を取り戻し、新たに戻ってマスカペット軍を指揮します。 既知の世界を自分のものにすることが彼女の目的です。
dialogsBegin.kr: 때가 되면, 이블리스는 다시 육체를 되찾아 마스커펫 군단을 이끌고 돌아올 거예요. 이 세상을 다시 자신의 손아귀에 넣으려는 거죠...
dialogsBegin.nl: When the time is right, she will regain her physical form and return anew to command her masquerpet army. It is her intention to reclaim the known world as her own…
dialogsBegin.pl: When the time is right, she will regain her physical form and return anew to command her masquerpet army. It is her intention to reclaim the known world as her own…
dialogsBegin.ru: When the time is right, she will regain her physical form and return anew to command her masquerpet army. It is her intention to reclaim the known world as her own…
dialogsBegin.sp: Cuando sea el momento adecuado, recuperará su forma física y regresará de nuevo para liderar su ejército de masquerpets. Su intención es reclamar el mundo como su propiedad...
dialogsBegin.sw: When the time is right, she will regain her physical form and return anew to command her masquerpet army. It is her intention to reclaim the known world as her own…
dialogsBegin.th: เมื่อถึงเวลาเหมาะสมแล้วเธอจะฟื้นร่างกายของเธอ และกลับมาใหม่เพื่อสั่งให้กองทัพสวมหน้ากากของเธอ เป็นความตั้งใจของเธอที่จะเรียกคืนโลกที่รู้จักกันเป็นของเธอเอง ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 時機成熟的時候，她會恢復肉身，重新回來指揮她的怪物。她打算將已知的世界奪回自己的世界……
dialogsBegin.vi: Khi đến thời điểm thích hợp, bà ấy sẽ lấy lại hình dạng thật của mình và trở lại một lần nữa để chỉ huy đội quân masquerpet của bà ta. Ý định của bà ấy là đòi lại thế giới của riêng mình…

dialogsBegin.en: You must go and talk to Reonan as soon as possible. We no longer have time to waste. Please find him!
dialogsBegin.ar: You must go and talk to Reonan as soon as possible. We no longer have time to waste. Please find him!
dialogsBegin.br: Você deve ir falar com Reonan o mais rápido possível. Não temos mais tempo a perder. Por favor, encontre-o!
dialogsBegin.cns: 你必须尽快去和瑞尔南谈谈。我们没多少时间可以浪费了。请尽快找到他！
dialogsBegin.de: Sie müssen so schnell wie möglich mit Reonan sprechen. Wir haben keine Zeit mehr zu verlieren. Bitte finden Sie ihn!
dialogsBegin.fi: You must go and talk to Reonan as soon as possible. We no longer have time to waste. Please find him!
dialogsBegin.fil: You must go and talk to Reonan as soon as possible. We no longer have time to waste. Please find him!
dialogsBegin.fr: Allez vite mettre Reonan au courant. Il va falloir rassembler des champions pour affronter le chaos qui nous menace.
dialogsBegin.id: Kau harus pergi dan berbicara dengan Reonan sesegera mungkin. Kita tidak lagi punya waktu untuk disia-siakan. Tolong temukan dia!
dialogsBegin.it: You must go and talk to Reonan as soon as possible. We no longer have time to waste. Please find him!
dialogsBegin.jp: レオナンにこの事実を伝えて下さい。一刻も早く英雄を見つけなければ再び戦争になるかもしれません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 어서 빨리 레오난에게 이 사실을 전해주세요. 그리고 한 시 빨리 과거의 영웅들을 모아야 한다고도 전해주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: You must go and talk to Reonan as soon as possible. We no longer have time to waste. Please find him!
dialogsBegin.pl: You must go and talk to Reonan as soon as possible. We no longer have time to waste. Please find him!
dialogsBegin.ru: You must go and talk to Reonan as soon as possible. We no longer have time to waste. Please find him!
dialogsBegin.sp: Debes ir y hablar con Reonan lo antes posible. No tenemos tiempo que perder. ¡Por favor encuéntralo!
dialogsBegin.sw: You must go and talk to Reonan as soon as possible. We no longer have time to waste. Please find him!
dialogsBegin.th: คุณต้องไปคุยกับ Reonan โดยเร็วที่สุด เราไม่มีเวลาแล้ว กรุณารีบไปหาเขา!
dialogsBegin.tw: 你必須盡快去和雷奧南談談。我們再也沒有時間可以浪費了。請找到他！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn phải đến và nói chuyện với Reonan càng sớm càng tốt. Chúng tôi không còn thời gian để lãng phí. Hãy tìm anh ta!

dialogsAccept.en: Reonan still hasn't explained to you the exact nature of the 8 heroes has he? I feel you are ready to know the truth and the role you play in this all…
dialogsAccept.ar: Reonan still hasn't explained to you the exact nature of the 8 heroes has he? I feel you are ready to know the truth and the role you play in this all…
dialogsAccept.br: Reonan ainda não explicou a natureza exata dos 8 heróis para você, não é? Eu sinto que você está pronto(a) para saber a verdade e o papel que você desempenha em tudo isso…
dialogsAccept.cns: 瑞尔南还没有向你解释8个英雄的真实本质，对吗？我觉得你已经准备好了解真相以及你在这一切中所扮演的角色…
dialogsAccept.de: Reonan hat dir immer noch nicht erklärt, was genau die 8 Helden sind, oder? Ich spüre, dass du bereit bist, die Wahrheit zu erfahren und die Rolle, die du in all dem spielst...
dialogsAccept.fi: Reonan still hasn't explained to you the exact nature of the 8 heroes has he? I feel you are ready to know the truth and the role you play in this all…
dialogsAccept.fil: Reonan still hasn't explained to you the exact nature of the 8 heroes has he? I feel you are ready to know the truth and the role you play in this all…
dialogsAccept.fr: Reonan vous donnera les détails qu'il juge nécessaires. Nous n'avons plus le temps.
dialogsAccept.id: Reonan masih belum menjelaskan kepadamu sifat dari 8 hero tersebut? Saya merasa kau sudah siap untuk mengetahui kebenaran dan peran yang kau mainkan dalam kasus ini...
dialogsAccept.it: Reonan still hasn't explained to you the exact nature of the 8 heroes has he? I feel you are ready to know the truth and the role you play in this all…
dialogsAccept.jp: え、まだ、8人の英雄を集めていることについて何も聞かされていなかったのですか。ふうん……まあ、それもレオナンと話せばわかると思いますよ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 레오난이 아직 8인의 영웅에 대한 진실을 정확히 밝히지 않았군요? 이제 진실을 받아들일 준비가 되지 않으셨나요? 이 모든 일에서 당신이 맡을 역할도...
dialogsAccept.nl: Reonan still hasn't explained to you the exact nature of the 8 heroes has he? I feel you are ready to know the truth and the role you play in this all…
dialogsAccept.pl: Reonan still hasn't explained to you the exact nature of the 8 heroes has he? I feel you are ready to know the truth and the role you play in this all…
dialogsAccept.ru: Reonan still hasn't explained to you the exact nature of the 8 heroes has he? I feel you are ready to know the truth and the role you play in this all…
dialogsAccept.sp: ¿Reonan no te ha explicado la identidad de los 8 héroes, verdad? Creo que estás listo para saber la verdad y el papel que juegas en todo esto…
dialogsAccept.sw: Reonan still hasn't explained to you the exact nature of the 8 heroes has he? I feel you are ready to know the truth and the role you play in this all…
dialogsAccept.th: Reonan ยังไม่ได้อธิบายให้คุณเห็นลักษณะที่แท้จริงของวีรบุรุษทั้ง 8 ตัว? ฉันรู้สึกว่าคุณพร้อมที่จะรู้ความจริงและบทบาทที่คุณเล่นในทั้งหมดนี้ ...
dialogsAccept.tw: 雷奧南還沒有向你解釋過 8 位英雄的確切性質吧？我覺得你已經準備好了解真相以及你在這一切中扮演的角色……
dialogsAccept.vi: Reonan vẫn chưa giải thích cho bạn bản chất chính xác của 8 anh hùng phải không? Tôi cảm thấy bạn đã sẵn sàng để biết sự thật và vai trò của bạn trong tất cả sự việc này…

dialogsDecline.en: I'm sorry if you feel uncertain about this all. Take some time to think it over…
dialogsDecline.ar: I'm sorry if you feel uncertain about this all. Take some time to think it over…
dialogsDecline.br: Sinto muito se você se sente inseguro sobre tudo isso. Tire um tempo para pensar sobre isso…
dialogsDecline.cns: 如果你对这一切感到不坚定，我为此感到抱歉。但请你花点时间考虑一下…
dialogsDecline.de: Es tut mir leid, wenn Sie sich bei all dem unsicher fühlen. Nehmen Sie sich etwas Zeit, um darüber nachzudenken...
dialogsDecline.fi: I'm sorry if you feel uncertain about this all. Take some time to think it over…
dialogsDecline.fil: I'm sorry if you feel uncertain about this all. Take some time to think it over…
dialogsDecline.fr: Il est trop tard pour hésiter à s'impliquer !!
dialogsDecline.id: Saya minta maaf jika kau merasa tidak yakin tentang ini semua. Luangkan waktu untuk memikirkannya...
dialogsDecline.it: I'm sorry if you feel uncertain about this all. Take some time to think it over…
dialogsDecline.jp: 不確かな点がありましたらごめんなさい。 考えてみてください…
dialogsDecline.kr: 두렵게 느껴지신다면 죄송해요. 천천히 생각해 보셔도 괜찮으니...
dialogsDecline.nl: I'm sorry if you feel uncertain about this all. Take some time to think it over…
dialogsDecline.pl: I'm sorry if you feel uncertain about this all. Take some time to think it over…
dialogsDecline.ru: I'm sorry if you feel uncertain about this all. Take some time to think it over…
dialogsDecline.sp: Lo siento si no te sientes seguro con todo esto. Tómate tu tiempo para pensarlo bien...
dialogsDecline.sw: I'm sorry if you feel uncertain about this all. Take some time to think it over…
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันขอโทษถ้าคุณรู้สึกไม่แน่ใจเกี่ยวกับเรื่องนี้ทั้งหมด ใช้เวลาทั้งหมดนี้คิดถึงมัน ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 如果你對這一切感到不確定，請花點時間想一下…
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi xin lỗi nếu bạn cảm thấy không chắc chắn về tất cả những điều này. Hãy dành một chút thời gian để suy nghĩ lại…

dialogsComplete.en: Greetings again! Ohhh…so this is what Handel has brought to light.
dialogsComplete.ar: Greetings again! Ohhh…so this is what Handel has brought to light.
dialogsComplete.br: Saudações novamente! Ohhh... então é isso que Handel trouxe à tona.
dialogsComplete.cns: 再次见面了！噢... 所以这就是汉德尔所发现的真相。
dialogsComplete.de: Nochmals Grüße! Ohhh... das ist es also, was der Handel ans Licht gebracht hat.
dialogsComplete.fi: Greetings again! Ohhh…so this is what Handel has brought to light.
dialogsComplete.fil: Greetings again! Ohhh…so this is what Handel has brought to light.
dialogsComplete.fr: Racontez-moi tout. Handel a trouvé quelque chose d'intéressant ?
dialogsComplete.id: Hai kita bertemu lagi! Ohhh... jadi ini yang dibawa Handel.
dialogsComplete.it: Greetings again! Ohhh…so this is what Handel has brought to light.
dialogsComplete.jp: お、戻ったか。ヘンデルの調査は進んだかい？　……ふむ、そんなことがあったのか。
dialogsComplete.kr: 또 만나는군요! 오오… 그러니까 헨델이 밝혀낸 게 바로 이거였군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Greetings again! Ohhh…so this is what Handel has brought to light.
dialogsComplete.pl: Greetings again! Ohhh…so this is what Handel has brought to light.
dialogsComplete.ru: Greetings again! Ohhh…so this is what Handel has brought to light.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Hola de nuevo! Ohhh... así que esto es lo que Handel ha sacado a la luz.
dialogsComplete.sw: Greetings again! Ohhh…so this is what Handel has brought to light.
dialogsComplete.th: ทักทายอีกครั้ง! Ohhh ... ดังนั้นนี่คือสิ่งที่ Hande ได้นำมาสู่แสงสว่าง
dialogsComplete.tw: 再次問候！哦……這就是賀丹爾所帶來的提示。
dialogsComplete.vi: Xin một lần nữa! Ohhh… vậy đây là những gì Handel đã muốn làm sáng tỏ.

dialogsFail.en: Please hurry back to Reonan. I'm sure he will explain everything!
dialogsFail.ar: Please hurry back to Reonan. I'm sure he will explain everything!
dialogsFail.br: Por favor, se encontre logo com Reonan. Tenho certeza que ele vai explicar tudo!
dialogsFail.cns: 请快回到瑞尔南身边。我相信他会解释一切的！
dialogsFail.de: Bitte eile zurück zu Reonan. Ich bin sicher, er wird Ihnen alles erklären!
dialogsFail.fi: Please hurry back to Reonan. I'm sure he will explain everything!
dialogsFail.fil: Please hurry back to Reonan. I'm sure he will explain everything!
dialogsFail.fr: Allez vite raconter ça à Reonan.
dialogsFail.id: Tolong cepat kembali kepada Reonan. Saya yakin dia akan menjelaskan semuanya!
dialogsFail.it: Please hurry back to Reonan. I'm sure he will explain everything!
dialogsFail.jp: レオナンはまだフラリスにいると思います。急いでお願いしますね。
dialogsFail.kr: 어서 레오난에게 돌아가세요. 그가 전부 설명해 줄 거예요!
dialogsFail.nl: Please hurry back to Reonan. I'm sure he will explain everything!
dialogsFail.pl: Please hurry back to Reonan. I'm sure he will explain everything!
dialogsFail.ru: Please hurry back to Reonan. I'm sure he will explain everything!
dialogsFail.sp: Por favor, apresúrate a volver con Reonan. ¡Seguro que te lo explicará todo!
dialogsFail.sw: Please hurry back to Reonan. I'm sure he will explain everything!
dialogsFail.th: กรุณารีบกลับไปที่ Reonan ฉันแน่ใจว่าเขาจะอธิบายทุกอย่าง!
dialogsFail.tw: 請快點回到雷奧南。我相信他會解釋一切的！
dialogsFail.vi: Hãy nhanh chóng trở lại tìm Reonan. Tôi chắc chắn rằng anh ấy sẽ giải thích tất cả mọi thứ!

description.en: Visit Helgar, the connoisseur of rare and expensive items in the Saint City Square.
description.ar: Visit Helgar, the connoisseur of rare and expensive items in the Saint City Square.
description.br: Visite Helgar, o conhecedor de itens raros e caros na Praça da Cidade.
description.cns: 去晨光找一个叫做海格乐的鉴定师，他一定有办法帮我解决的。
description.de: Bitte besuche Helgar, den Kunstkritiker in Saint Morning.
description.fi: Visit Helgar, the connoisseur of rare and expensive items in the Saint City Square.
description.fil: Visit Helgar, the connoisseur of rare and expensive items in the Saint City Square.
description.fr: Rendre visite à Helgar, le critique d'art de Saincity, pour discuter du portrait de Radéon

description.sw: Visit Helgar, the connoisseur of rare and expensive items in the Saint City Square.
description.th: ไปหา Helgar นักประเมิณราคาของหายากและมีราคาแพงในจตุรัส Saint City
description.tw: 去聖音特找一個叫做海佳樂的鑑定師，他一定有辦法幫我解決的。
description.vi: Ghé thăm Helgar, người sành về những món đồ quý hiếm và đắt tiền ở Saint City Square.

dialogsBegin.en: Hey! You there! I don't know what to do. My drawing... My best drawing has disappeared!
dialogsBegin.ar: Hey! You there! I don't know what to do. My drawing... My best drawing has disappeared!
dialogsBegin.br: Ei! Ei! Estou muito encrencado! Meu desenho... Meu melhor desenho desapareceu!
dialogsBegin.cns: 啊..我的天啊..我的自画像怎么不见了!!
dialogsBegin.de: Hey! Hey! Ich habe Probleme. Meine Zeichnung.. sie ist verschwunden.
dialogsBegin.fi: Hey! You there! I don't know what to do. My drawing... My best drawing has disappeared!
dialogsBegin.fil: Hey! You there! I don't know what to do. My drawing... My best drawing has disappeared!
dialogsBegin.fr: Aide-moi s'il te plaît, j'ai un gros souci ! Mon dessin... mon plus beau dessin a disparu !! (commençant à pleurer)
dialogsBegin.id: Hei! Kau disana! Aku tidak tahu harus berbuat apa. Gambaranku... Gambar terbaikku telah hilang!
dialogsBegin.it: Hey! You there! I don't know what to do. My drawing... My best drawing has disappeared!
dialogsBegin.jp: おーい、おーい！わしの大事な絵が、大切なコレクションが、今朝になって忽然と消えてしまったんだ！なんということだ！一体どこに行ってしまったんだ！？
dialogsBegin.kr: 저기, 이봐요! 어떡하죠? 제 초상화가... 그 엄청난 명작이 감쪽같이 사라졌어요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Hey! You there! I don't know what to do. My drawing... My best drawing has disappeared!
dialogsBegin.pl: Hey! You there! I don't know what to do. My drawing... My best drawing has disappeared!
dialogsBegin.ru: Эй! Эй! Помоги! Моя картина... Моя самая ценная картина пропала!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Oye! ¡Tú! No se que hacer. Mi dibujo... ¡Mi mejor dibujo ha desaparecido!
dialogsBegin.sw: Hey! You there! I don't know what to do. My drawing... My best drawing has disappeared!
dialogsBegin.th: เฮ้! คุณอยู่ที่นั่น! ผมไม่ทราบว่าจะทำอย่างไรดี ภาพวาดของฉัน... ภาพวาดที่ดีที่สุดของฉันหายไปแล้ว!
dialogsBegin.tw: 啊…我的天啊…我的自畫像怎麼不見了！！
dialogsBegin.vi: Chào! Bạn ở đó! Tôi không biết phải làm gì. Bản vẽ của tôi ... Bản vẽ đẹp nhất của tôi đã biến mất!

dialogsBegin.en: My hobby is collecting rare and expensive artwork. This morning I redecorating my house and I realized my most prized drawing was gone!
dialogsBegin.ar: My hobby is collecting rare and expensive artwork. This morning I redecorating my house and I realized my most prized drawing was gone!
dialogsBegin.br: Meu hobby é colecionar desenhos e fotografias raras e caras. Mas meu item mais caro desapareceu.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我是专门搜集稀有物品的人，可是我这次买来的自画像既然不见了!
dialogsBegin.de: Ich sammle seltene und teure Zeichnungen, aber meine teuerste ist verschwunden.
dialogsBegin.fi: My hobby is collecting rare and expensive artwork. This morning I redecorating my house and I realized my most prized drawing was gone!
dialogsBegin.fil: My hobby is collecting rare and expensive artwork. This morning I redecorating my house and I realized my most prized drawing was gone!
dialogsBegin.fr: (les larmes aux yeux) Ma passion est de collectionner des oeuvres d'art très rares et très chères, mais l'une des plus coûteuses vient de disparaître.
dialogsBegin.id: Hobiku adalah mengoleksi karya seni yang langka dan mahal. Pagi ini aku mendekorasi ulang rumah dan menyadari bahwa gambarku yang paling berharga telah hilang!
dialogsBegin.it: My hobby is collecting rare and expensive artwork. This morning I redecorating my house and I realized my most prized drawing was gone!
dialogsBegin.jp: あの絵は大変な名作と言われている絵だったのに…！わしはフラリス一の富豪で知られているが、美術品の蒐集家としても知られている。しかし今朝、とても高い値段で購入した名作が大切なコレクションケースから跡形もなく消えていたのだよ！
dialogsBegin.kr: 저는 진귀하고 비싼 예술품을 수집하는 취미가 있습니다. 오늘 아침 집 안을 새로 단장하다가, 가장 아끼던 그림이 사라진 걸 알게 됐죠!
dialogsBegin.nl: My hobby is collecting rare and expensive artwork. This morning I redecorating my house and I realized my most prized drawing was gone!
dialogsBegin.pl: My hobby is collecting rare and expensive artwork. This morning I redecorating my house and I realized my most prized drawing was gone!
dialogsBegin.ru: Я коллекционирую живопись. Утром, протирая пыль, я заметил, что самое дорогое полотно исчезло!
dialogsBegin.sp: Mi pasatiempo es coleccionar obras de arte raras y caras. ¡Esta mañana estaba redecorando mi casa y me di cuenta de que mi dibujo más preciado había desaparecido!
dialogsBegin.sw: My hobby is collecting rare and expensive artwork. This morning I redecorating my house and I realized my most prized drawing was gone!
dialogsBegin.th: งานอดิเรกของฉันคือการรวบรวมงานศิลปะที่หายากและราคาแพง เช้านี้ฉันตกแต่งบ้านของฉันและฉันก็พบว่าภาพวาดที่มีค่าที่สุดของฉันได้หายไป!
dialogsBegin.tw: 我是專門蒐集稀有物品的人，可是我這次買來的自畫像竟然不見了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Sở thích của tôi là sưu tập các tác phẩm nghệ thuật hiếm và đắt tiền. Sáng nay, tôi đang trang trí lại ngôi nhà của mình và tôi nhận ra rằng bức vẽ đáng giá nhất của tôi đã biến mất!

dialogsBegin.en: It is the portrait of the wise man, Radion. There are a number of suspects and I have no idea where to begin. What should I do?
dialogsBegin.ar: It is the portrait of the wise man, Radion. There are a number of suspects and I have no idea where to begin. What should I do?
dialogsBegin.br: É o retrato de Radion. Suspeito de muitas pessoas. Como posso encontrá-lo e recuperá-lo? Oh...
dialogsBegin.cns: 就是贤者拉迪温的自画像，虽然有很多让我感到怀疑的人，可是太多了不知道，到底是谁偷走的啊…
dialogsBegin.de: Es ist ein Portrait Radions, welches nur wenige kennen, ich muss es wieder haben
dialogsBegin.fi: It is the portrait of the wise man, Radion. There are a number of suspects and I have no idea where to begin. What should I do?
dialogsBegin.fil: It is the portrait of the wise man, Radion. There are a number of suspects and I have no idea where to begin. What should I do?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il s'agit du portrait de Radéon. Je suspecte tout le monde maintenant... Mais comment retrouver mon œuvre d'art à présent ?
dialogsBegin.id: Itu adalah potret orang bijak, Radion. Ada sejumlah tersangka dan aku tidak tahu harus mulai dari mana. Apa yang harus aku lakukan?
dialogsBegin.it: It is the portrait of the wise man, Radion. There are a number of suspects and I have no idea where to begin. What should I do?
dialogsBegin.jp: どんな絵だったかって？君も聞いたことがあるだろう、＜大賢者＞ラディオンの肖像画だよ。わしのコレクションを羨む人はとても多いし、疑わしい奴は居るんだが、あまりに多すぎてさっぱり見当もつかん。
dialogsBegin.kr: 대현자 라디온님의 초상화입니다. 의심 가는 사람은 여럿 있지만, 어디서부터 시작해야 할지 감도 안 잡히는군. 어떡하죠?
dialogsBegin.nl: It is the portrait of the wise man, Radion. There are a number of suspects and I have no idea where to begin. What should I do?
dialogsBegin.pl: It is the portrait of the wise man, Radion. There are a number of suspects and I have no idea where to begin. What should I do?
dialogsBegin.ru: Это был портрет мудреца Энвидия. Мне завидовали все коллекционеры - даже не знаю, кого в первую очередь подозревать! Что же делать?..
dialogsBegin.sp: Es el retrato del sabio Radion. Hay varios sospechosos y no tengo ni idea de por dónde empezar. ¿Qué debería hacer?
dialogsBegin.sw: It is the portrait of the wise man, Radion. There are a number of suspects and I have no idea where to begin. What should I do?
dialogsBegin.th: เป็นภาพของชายที่ฉลาดเฉลียวชื่อ Radion มีผู้ต้องสงสัยจำนวนหนึ่งและฉันไม่รู้จะเริ่มต้นอย่างไรดี ฉันควรทำอย่างไร?
dialogsBegin.tw: 舊識賢者拉迪溫的自畫像，雖然有很多讓我感到懷疑的人，可是太多了不知道，到底是誰偷走的！啊…
dialogsBegin.vi: Đó là chân dung của nhà thông thái, Radion. Có một số nghi phạm và tôi không biết bắt đầu từ đâu. Tôi nên làm gì?

dialogsBegin.en: Wait a minute… I have an idea. Will you do me a favor?
dialogsBegin.ar: Wait a minute… I have an idea. Will you do me a favor?
dialogsBegin.br: Espere um minuto… eu tenho uma ideia. Você poderia me fazer um favor?
dialogsBegin.cns: 怎么办..啊..对了!就是这个!你可以帮我吗?
dialogsBegin.de: Moment mal... Ich habe eine Idee. Würdest du mir einen Gefallen tun?
dialogsBegin.fi: Wait a minute… I have an idea. Will you do me a favor?
dialogsBegin.fil: Wait a minute… I have an idea. Will you do me a favor?
dialogsBegin.fr: (réfléchissant) Oh ! J'ai une idée ! Veux-tu bien me donner un coup de main ?
dialogsBegin.id: Tunggu sebentar… Aku punya ide. Maukah kamu membantuku?
dialogsBegin.it: Wait a minute… I have an idea. Will you do me a favor?
dialogsBegin.jp: あの貴重な肖像画はどこに行ったのやら…。あ、キミ！ちょっと待ってくれたまえ。ここを通ったのも何かの縁。わしの肖像画を探してきてはくれんかね？
dialogsBegin.kr: 잠깐만요… 좋은 생각이 났어요. 제 부탁 하나만 들어주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Wait a minute… I have an idea. Will you do me a favor?
dialogsBegin.pl: Wait a minute… I have an idea. Will you do me a favor?
dialogsBegin.ru: Погоди... Есть у меня одна мысль. Ты поможешь?
dialogsBegin.sp: Espera un momento... tengo una idea. ¿Me harías un favor?
dialogsBegin.sw: Wait a minute… I have an idea. Will you do me a favor?
dialogsBegin.th: รอสักครู่... ฉันมีไอเดีย คุณช่วยอะไรฉันหน่อยได้ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 等一下……我有個主意。你能幫我個忙嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Chờ một chút… Tôi có một ý tưởng. Bạn sẽ giúp tôi một việc chứ?

dialogsAccept.en: You will?! Thank you! I need you to speak with Helgar in Saint City. He is a connoisseur of rare and precious items. Perhaps he knows something.
dialogsAccept.ar: You will?! Thank you! I need you to speak with Helgar in Saint City. He is a connoisseur of rare and precious items. Perhaps he knows something.
dialogsAccept.br: Ótimo! Eu preciso que você fale com Helgar em Saint. Ele é um conhecedor de itens raros e preciosos. Talvez ele saiba de alguma coisa.
dialogsAccept.cns: 好!那你先去晨光找一个叫做海格乐的鉴定师，他一定有办法帮我解决的。
dialogsAccept.de: Toll, gehe zuerst zu Helgar, dem Kunstkritiker in Saint Morning.
dialogsAccept.fi: You will?! Thank you! I need you to speak with Helgar in Saint City. He is a connoisseur of rare and precious items. Perhaps he knows something.
dialogsAccept.fil: You will?! Thank you! I need you to speak with Helgar in Saint City. He is a connoisseur of rare and precious items. Perhaps he knows something.
dialogsAccept.fr: Excellent ! J'aimerais que tu ailles voir Helgar, le critique d'art de Saincity. Je suis sûr qu'il pourra nous aider.
dialogsAccept.id: Kamu mau?! Terima kasih! Aku ingin kamu berbicara dengan Helgar di Saint City. Dia adalah penikmat barang langka dan berharga. Mungkin dia tahu sesuatu.
dialogsAccept.it: You will?! Thank you! I need you to speak with Helgar in Saint City. He is a connoisseur of rare and precious items. Perhaps he knows something.
dialogsAccept.jp: そうか、感謝するぞ。ではセイントモーニングで鑑定士として働いているヘルガースに会いに行ってくれ。彼ならきっと良い方法を教えてくれるはずだ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 도와주신다고요?! 정말 감사해요! 그럼 세인트 시티에 있는 헬가르에게 가주세요. 진귀하고 비싼 보물을 감정하는 사람이니, 뭔가 알고 있을지도 모르죠.
dialogsAccept.nl: You will?! Thank you! I need you to speak with Helgar in Saint City. He is a connoisseur of rare and precious items. Perhaps he knows something.
dialogsAccept.pl: You will?! Thank you! I need you to speak with Helgar in Saint City. He is a connoisseur of rare and precious items. Perhaps he knows something.
dialogsAccept.ru: Отлично! Поговори с Ольгердом в Санто. Он большой знаток редкостей и антиквариата. Может, кто-то в последнее время расспрашивал его о портрете…
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡¿Lo harás?! ¡Gracias! Necesito que hables con Helgar en Saint. Es un experto en objetos raros y preciosos. Quizá sepa algo.
dialogsAccept.sw: You will?! Thank you! I need you to speak with Helgar in Saint City. He is a connoisseur of rare and precious items. Perhaps he knows something.
dialogsAccept.th: คุณจะช่วยเหรอ?! ขอบคุณ! ฉันต้องการให้คุณคุยกับ Helgar ใน Saint City เขาเป็นนักเลงของหายากและล้ำค่า บางทีเขาอาจจะรู้อะไรบางอย่าง
dialogsAccept.tw: 好！那你先去聖音特找一個叫做海佳樂的鑑定師，他一定有辦法幫我解決的。
dialogsAccept.vi: Bạn sẽ giúp chứ?! Cảm ơn bạn! Tôi cần bạn nói chuyện với Helgar ở Saint City. Anh là người sành chơi đồ quý hiếm. Có lẽ anh ấy biết điều gì đó.

dialogsDecline.en: No, please! You must help me! I don't know what else to do!
dialogsDecline.ar: No, please! You must help me! I don't know what else to do!
dialogsDecline.br: Não! Eu tenho que recuperá-lo! Ajude-me!!
dialogsDecline.cns: 别！拜托！你一定要帮我！我现在已经不知道还能做些什么了！
dialogsDecline.de: (greift mir an den Hals) Nein! Ich muss es wieder haben, Hilfe!
dialogsDecline.fi: No, please! You must help me! I don't know what else to do!
dialogsDecline.fil: No, please! You must help me! I don't know what else to do!
dialogsDecline.fr: (près à vous tordre le cou) Non, non ! Je dois le retrouver absolument ! Aide-moi !
dialogsDecline.id: Tidak, tolong! Kamu harus membantuku! Aku tidak tahu harus berbuat apalagi!
dialogsDecline.it: No, please! You must help me! I don't know what else to do!
dialogsDecline.jp: なんだって？人のことには興味がないだと？そんなこと言わずに頼む！どうか探してきてくれ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 안 돼요, 제발! 도와주세요! 다 방법이 없다고요!
dialogsDecline.nl: No, please! You must help me! I don't know what else to do!
dialogsDecline.pl: No, please! You must help me! I don't know what else to do!
dialogsDecline.ru: Помоги, пожалуйста! Если ты откажешь, я не знаю, к кому обратиться!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡No por favor! ¡Me tienes qué ayudar! ¡No sé qué más hacer!
dialogsDecline.sw: No, please! You must help me! I don't know what else to do!
dialogsDecline.th: ไม่! คุณต้องช่วยฉัน! ฉันไม่รู้ว่าจะทำยังไงแล้ว!
dialogsDecline.tw: 不可以！你知道那是怎麼找到的嗎？你一定要幫我找回來！
dialogsDecline.vi: Không, làm ơn! Bạn phải giúp tôi! Tôi không biết phải làm gì khác!

dialogsComplete.en: What? The portrait disappeared? Hmm... I knew this was going to happen.
dialogsComplete.ar: What? The portrait disappeared? Hmm... I knew this was going to happen.
dialogsComplete.br: O que? O retrato desapareceu? Hmm... Eu sabia que algum dia Rudvihil o pegaria...
dialogsComplete.cns: 什么?你说画不见了..我就知道是萝特泰斯做的..可是为什么对象是一幅画呢..
dialogsComplete.de: Das Bild ist verschwunden? Hmm.. ich dachte immer, Rudvihil würde es eines Tages stehlen...
dialogsComplete.fi: What? The portrait disappeared? Hmm... I knew this was going to happen.
dialogsComplete.fil: What? The portrait disappeared? Hmm... I knew this was going to happen.
dialogsComplete.fr: Quoi ? Le portrait de Radéon a disparu ? Hmm... Rudvihil doit être vraiment fou de rage.
dialogsComplete.id: Apa? Potretnya menghilang? Hmm... Aku tahu ini akan terjadi.
dialogsComplete.it: What? The portrait disappeared? Hmm... I knew this was going to happen.
dialogsComplete.jp: はい？何のご用かな？ふむ、肖像画が消えてしまったって？ハハッ、あいつなら、いつかそんな目にあうだろうと思っていたが、よりによってその絵だとはなあ！ワッハハハ！
dialogsComplete.kr: 뭐라고요? 초상화가 사라졌다고요? 흠… 그럴 줄 알았어요.
dialogsComplete.nl: What? The portrait disappeared? Hmm... I knew this was going to happen.
dialogsComplete.pl: What? The portrait disappeared? Hmm... I knew this was going to happen.
dialogsComplete.ru: Что? Портрет исчез? Хммм... Я подозревал, что это случится.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿Qué? ¿El retrato desapareció? Hmm... Sabía que esto iba a pasar.
dialogsComplete.sw: What? The portrait disappeared? Hmm... I knew this was going to happen.
dialogsComplete.th: อะไรนะ? ภาพหายไป? อืม... ฉันว่าแล้วว่ามันจะเกิดขึ้น
dialogsComplete.tw: 什麼？你說畫不見了…我就知道是蘿特泰斯做的…可是怎麼對象是畫呢…
dialogsComplete.vi: Gì? Bức chân dung biến mất? Hmm ... Tôi biết điều này sẽ xảy ra.

dialogsComplete.en: Rudvihil has a taste for rare and expensive things. He's also very greedy, and lacks values.
dialogsComplete.ar: Rudvihil has a taste for rare and expensive things. He's also very greedy, and lacks values.
dialogsComplete.br: Rudvihil é tão mau que faria qualquer coisa para conseguir coisas raras e caras. Ele também é muito ganancioso e carece de valores.
dialogsComplete.cns: 萝特泰斯本来就是一个很贱的人，只要是他喜欢的，不管是用什么样的手段，一定都会得到。
dialogsComplete.de: Rudvihil hat eine Vorliebe für seltene und teure Dinge. Er ist auch sehr gierig, und es fehlt ihm an Werten.
dialogsComplete.fi: Rudvihil has a taste for rare and expensive things. He's also very greedy, and lacks values.
dialogsComplete.fil: Rudvihil has a taste for rare and expensive things. He's also very greedy, and lacks values.
dialogsComplete.fr: Rudvihil est si fou qu'il veut posséder tout ce qui est rare et cher... Il est vraiment malade.
dialogsComplete.id: Rudvihil memiliki selera untuk hal-hal langka dan mahal. Dia juga sangat serakah, dan sifatnya buruk.
dialogsComplete.it: Rudvihil has a taste for rare and expensive things. He's also very greedy, and lacks values.
dialogsComplete.jp: ルードヴィヒはフラリス一の富豪だが、珍しいモノや価値のあるものなら手段を問わず、どんなことをしてでも自分の手に入れてしまう卑怯な奴なのさ。そんな性格だから、やつを快く思わない人はかなり多いと思うぜ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 루드비힐은 진귀하고 값비싼 물건을 좋아하지만, 욕심도 많고 비열한 사람이죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: Rudvihil has a taste for rare and expensive things. He's also very greedy, and lacks values.
dialogsComplete.pl: Rudvihil has a taste for rare and expensive things. He's also very greedy, and lacks values.
dialogsComplete.ru: Сотби? Да, этот жадина знает толк в старинных и дорогих вещах! Его коллекции нет равных.
dialogsComplete.sp: Rudvihil tiene gusto por las cosas raras y caras. También es muy codicioso y carece de valores.
dialogsComplete.sw: Rudvihil has a taste for rare and expensive things. He's also very greedy, and lacks values.
dialogsComplete.th: Rudvihil มีเซนส์สำหรับของที่หายากและมีราคาแพง เขายังเป็นคนโลภมากและไม่มีศีลธรรม
dialogsComplete.tw: 蘿特泰斯是一個很貪婪的人，只要是他喜歡的，不管是用什麼樣的手段，一定都會得到。
dialogsComplete.vi: Rudvihil có sở thích về những thứ quý hiếm và đắt tiền. Anh ấy cũng rất tham lam và thiếu giá trị.

dialogsComplete.en: If he truly has lost it, I'll do what I can to help.
dialogsComplete.ar: If he truly has lost it, I'll do what I can to help.
dialogsComplete.br: Agora é hora da vingança.
dialogsComplete.cns: 说不定这样也好!那个人一定要尝试一下苦头才可以!
dialogsComplete.de: Jetzt ist die Zeit der Rache
dialogsComplete.fi: If he truly has lost it, I'll do what I can to help.
dialogsComplete.fil: If he truly has lost it, I'll do what I can to help.
dialogsComplete.fr: Il est temps de se venger.
dialogsComplete.id: Jika dia benar-benar kehilangan, aku akan melakukan apa yang aku bisa untuk membantu.
dialogsComplete.it: If he truly has lost it, I'll do what I can to help.
dialogsComplete.jp: むしろ肖像画がなくなって良かったんじゃないか？ワハハハ。あいつは一度、ひどい目にあったほうが懲りるだろう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 정말로 잃어버린 거라면, 저도 최대한 도와드릴게요.
dialogsComplete.nl: If he truly has lost it, I'll do what I can to help.
dialogsComplete.pl: If he truly has lost it, I'll do what I can to help.
dialogsComplete.ru: Я не знаю, кто мог украсть у него картину, но попробую помочь.
dialogsComplete.sp: Si de verdad lo ha perdido, haré lo que pueda para ayudarlo.
dialogsComplete.sw: If he truly has lost it, I'll do what I can to help.
dialogsComplete.th: ถ้าเขาทำมันหายจริงๆ ฉันจะช่วยเท่าที่ฉันสามารถช่วยได้
dialogsComplete.tw: 說不定這樣也好！那個人一定要嘗試一下苦頭才可以！
dialogsComplete.vi: Nếu anh ấy thực sự làm mất nó, tôi sẽ làm những gì có thể để giúp đỡ.

dialogsFail.en: Do you have something that needs my appraisal? Let me see.
dialogsFail.ar: Do you have something that needs my appraisal? Let me see.
dialogsFail.br: Você tem algo que precisa de minha avaliação? Deixe-me ver.
dialogsFail.cns: 喔~你有什么特别的物品吗?我来看看值多少钱好了!
dialogsFail.de: Hast du etwas, das ich beurteilen soll? Lass mich mal sehen.
dialogsFail.fi: Do you have something that needs my appraisal? Let me see.
dialogsFail.fil: Do you have something that needs my appraisal? Let me see.
dialogsFail.fr: Oh, as-tu quelque chose à identifier ? Montre-moi ça.
dialogsFail.id: Apakah kamu memiliki sesuatu yang membutuhkan penilaian saya? Biarku lihat.

dialogsBegin.en: We have went ahead and processed Elaine's resignation. Go and tell him about it.
dialogsBegin.ar: We have went ahead and processed Elaine's resignation. Go and tell him about it.
dialogsBegin.br: Prosseguimos e seguimos com a renúncia de Elaine. Vá e conte a ele sobre isso.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我们已经提前处理了伊莲的辞职报告。去告诉他这件事吧。
dialogsBegin.de: Wir haben den Rücktritt von Elaine bereits bearbeitet. Geh und erzähl ihm davon.
dialogsBegin.fi: We have went ahead and processed Elaine's resignation. Go and tell him about it.
dialogsBegin.fil: We have went ahead and processed Elaine's resignation. Go and tell him about it.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tout est en ordre, dites à Alain que nous pourrons nous débrouiller sans lui.
dialogsBegin.id: Kami telah melanjutkan dan memproses pengunduran diri Elaine. Pergi dan ceritakan padanya tentang hal itu.
dialogsBegin.it: We have went ahead and processed Elaine's resignation. Go and tell him about it.
dialogsBegin.jp: エルラインの気持ちはわかったわ。貴方のおかげでゴミ箱も揃えられたし、辞任の旨も了解よ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 일레인의 사임은 이미 처리됐어요. 가서 직접 전해주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: We have went ahead and processed Elaine's resignation. Go and tell him about it.
dialogsBegin.pl: We have went ahead and processed Elaine's resignation. Go and tell him about it.
dialogsBegin.ru: We have went ahead and processed Elaine's resignation. Go and tell him about it.
dialogsBegin.sp: Nos apañaremos con la renuncia de Elaine. Ves y cuéntaselo.
dialogsBegin.sw: We have went ahead and processed Elaine's resignation. Go and tell him about it.
dialogsBegin.th: เราได้เดินหน้าและดำเนินการหนังสือลาออกของ Elaine ไปบอกเขาเกี่ยวกับเรื่องนี้
dialogsBegin.tw: 我們已經辦妥耶拉伊的辭職手續。去告訴他吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Chúng tôi đã tiếp tục và xử lý đơn từ chức của Elaine. Đi và nói với anh ta về nó.

dialogsAccept.en: Let him know not to worry about us. We understand that whatever it is he is up to must be of the utmost importance.
dialogsAccept.ar: Let him know not to worry about us. We understand that whatever it is he is up to must be of the utmost importance.
dialogsAccept.br: Avise para ele não se preocupar conosco. Entendemos que o que quer que ele esteja fazendo deve ser de maior importância.
dialogsAccept.cns: 让他不要为我们担心。我们明白，无论他在做什么，都是最重要的。
dialogsAccept.de: Lassen Sie ihn wissen, dass er sich keine Sorgen um uns machen muss. Wir verstehen, dass das, was er vorhat, von größter Bedeutung sein muss.
dialogsAccept.fi: Let him know not to worry about us. We understand that whatever it is he is up to must be of the utmost importance.
dialogsAccept.fil: Let him know not to worry about us. We understand that whatever it is he is up to must be of the utmost importance.
dialogsAccept.fr: Nous vous souhaitons que votre quête aboutisse. Il peut revenir travailler pour nous quand il veut.
dialogsAccept.id: Beri tahu dia untuk tidak mengkhawatirkan kita. Kami memahami bahwa apa pun yang dia lakukan adalah yang paling penting.
dialogsAccept.it: Let him know not to worry about us. We understand that whatever it is he is up to must be of the utmost importance.
dialogsAccept.jp: 後のことは心配しないでとエルラインにも伝えてくれるかしら。
dialogsAccept.kr: 우리는 괜찮다고, 걱정하지 말라고 해주세요. 일레인이 하려는 일이 아주 중요하다는 걸 잘 알고 있다고 말이에요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Let him know not to worry about us. We understand that whatever it is he is up to must be of the utmost importance.
dialogsAccept.pl: Let him know not to worry about us. We understand that whatever it is he is up to must be of the utmost importance.
dialogsAccept.ru: Let him know not to worry about us. We understand that whatever it is he is up to must be of the utmost importance.
dialogsAccept.sp: Dile que no se preocupe por nosotros. Entendemos que lo que ti me en mente debe ser de suma importancia.
dialogsAccept.sw: Let him know not to worry about us. We understand that whatever it is he is up to must be of the utmost importance.
dialogsAccept.th: ให้เขารู้ว่าไม่ต้องห่วงเรา เราเข้าใจดีว่าสิ่งที่เขาต้องการจะต้องเป็นสิ่งที่สำคัญที่สุด
dialogsAccept.tw: 請你轉答他後面的事情不要擔心，祝他能夠達到想要的目標。
dialogsAccept.vi: Hãy để anh ấy biết rằng đừng lo lắng về chúng tôi. Chúng tôi hiểu rằng bất cứ điều gì anh ấy làm đều phải là điều quan trọng hàng đầu.

dialogsDecline.en: Please let him know at some point at least!
dialogsDecline.ar: Please let him know at some point at least!
dialogsDecline.br: Por favor, deixe-o saber em algum momento pelo menos!
dialogsDecline.cns: 请至少在某些时候让他知道！
dialogsDecline.de: Bitte lassen Sie es ihn wenigstens irgendwann wissen!
dialogsDecline.fi: Please let him know at some point at least!
dialogsDecline.fil: Please let him know at some point at least!
dialogsDecline.fr: Filez lui dire que nous sommes avec lui de tout cœur.
dialogsDecline.id: Tolong setidaknya biarkan dia mengetahui beberapa hal!
dialogsDecline.it: Please let him know at some point at least!
dialogsDecline.jp: そう？　私としてはエルラインがこのまま会長を続けてくれる方が嬉しいんだけどね。
dialogsDecline.kr: 언젠가 꼭 전해주세요, 부탁할게요!
dialogsDecline.nl: Please let him know at some point at least!
dialogsDecline.pl: Please let him know at some point at least!
dialogsDecline.ru: Please let him know at some point at least!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Por favor, díselo cuando puedas al menos!
dialogsDecline.sw: Please let him know at some point at least!
dialogsDecline.th: กรุณาแจ้งให้เขาทราบอย่างน้อยบางจุด!!
dialogsDecline.tw: 請至少在某個時候讓他知道！
dialogsDecline.vi: Ít nhất hãy cho anh ấy biết!
