dialogsBegin.en: I am here in Dekane mining for Ribenuum. In all of Madrigal Ribenuum can only be found in the Darkon area.
dialogsBegin.ar: I am here in Dekane mining for Ribenuum. In all of Madrigal Ribenuum can only be found in the Darkon area.
dialogsBegin.br: Estou aqui na mineração de Dekane à procura de Ribenuum. De toda a Madrigal, Ribenuum só pode ser encontrado nas áreas de Darkon.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我来到达肯矿洞的理由是，为了采集沛拉磷啦！沛拉磷只有在这里才可以采集到的啦！
dialogsBegin.de: Ich bin hier, um Ribenuum zu schürfen. In ganz Madrigal kann man es nur in der Darkon Region finden.
dialogsBegin.fi: I am here in Dekane mining for Ribenuum. In all of Madrigal Ribenuum can only be found in the Darkon area.
dialogsBegin.fil: Andito ako sa Dekane para magmina ng Ribenuum. Sa lahat ng Madrigal ang Ribenuum ay mahahanap lamang sa Darkon.
dialogsBegin.fr: En fait je suis venu dans cette mine à cause du Ribenuum ! Ce métal est très précieux, et on n'en trouve qu'à un seul endroit dans tout Madrigal… ici ! Car les Trillipys Verdâtres des environs se nourrissent des pierres...
dialogsBegin.id: Aku disini di tambang Dekane untuk Ribenuum. Di seluruh Madrigal Ribenuum hanya bisa ditemukan di area Darkon.
dialogsBegin.it: I am here in Dekane mining for Ribenuum. In all of Madrigal Ribenuum can only be found in the Darkon area.
dialogsBegin.jp: 俺がこの ＜デェカネス鉱山＞にいる理由は、＜リベニウム＞ という鉱物を掘り出すためだ。＜リベニウム＞ は広いダーコン地域大陸の中でも、唯一ここでしか採れない、貴重な鉱物なんだ
dialogsBegin.kr: 전 이곳 데카네 강산에서 리베늄을 채굴하고 있어요. 리베늄은 마드리갈 대륙에서도 오직 다콘에서만 발견되는 광물이죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: I am here in Dekane mining for Ribenuum. In all of Madrigal Ribenuum can only be found in the Darkon area.
dialogsBegin.pl: Jestem tutaj, w kopalni Dekane dla Ribenuum. W całym Madrigal Ribenuum można znaleźć tylko w obszarze Darkon.
dialogsBegin.ru: Силлиний добыть просто, ты попробуй добыть рибений! Кроме Даркона, он не встречается нигде.
dialogsBegin.sp: Estoy en la Mina Dekane buscando Ribenuum. De todo Madrigal, solo se puede encontrar Ribenuum en el área de Darkon.
dialogsBegin.sw: I am here in Dekane mining for Ribenuum. In all of Madrigal Ribenuum can only be found in the Darkon area.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันอยู่ในเหมืองแร่ Dekane คุณสามารถพบ Madrigal Ribenuum ได้ในเฉพาะพื้นที่ Dekane เท่านั้น
dialogsBegin.tw: 我來到迪坎礦坑的理由是，為了採集沛拉磷啦！沛拉磷只有在這裡才可以採集到的啦！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đang ở đây để khai thác Dekane cho Ribenuum. Trong tất cả Madrigal Ribenuum chỉ có thể được tìm thấy trong khu vực Darkon.

dialogsBegin.en: Ribenuum is made when a Green Trillipy eats a stone and metabolizes it.
dialogsBegin.ar: Ribenuum is made when a Green Trillipy eats a stone and metabolizes it.
dialogsBegin.br: Ribenuum é produzido quando um Trillipy verde come uma pedra e a metaboliza.
dialogsBegin.cns: 因为啊～沛拉磷是绿色蜥蜴吃了岩石之后，而产生的一个矿石。而且蜥蜴只会在这里出现啦！
dialogsBegin.de: Die Green Trillipy essen Steine und wandeln sie in Ribenuum um.
dialogsBegin.fi: Ribenuum is made when a Green Trillipy eats a stone and metabolizes it.
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang Ribenuum ay nagagawa pag ang isang Green Trillipy ay lumunok ng isang bato at pinababa ito.
dialogsBegin.fr: Qu'est-ce que les Trillipys Verdâtres ont à voir dans cette histoire ? Eh bien comment t'expliquer ça … Hmmm disons qu'ils mangent des pierres, et qu'ils… enfin…, ils rendent du métal. Hmmm… tu vois ce que je veux dire ?
dialogsBegin.id: Ribenuum dibuat ketika Green Trillipy memakan batu dan memetabolismenya.
dialogsBegin.it: Ribenuum is made when a Green Trillipy eats a stone and metabolizes it.
dialogsBegin.jp: 何故そんなに貴重かって？＜リベニウム＞ は ＜グリーントリルピ＞ という昆虫が岩石を食って、自分の甲殻を作ってるうちに生成される金属だから、わずかしか採れないんだ。しかも ＜グリーントリルピ＞ はここにだけしか棲息していないってわけさ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 리베늄은 그린 트릴리피가 암석을 먹고 소화할 때 만들어지는 물질이거든요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Ribenuum is made when a Green Trillipy eats a stone and metabolizes it.
dialogsBegin.pl: Ribenuum powstaje, gdy Zielony Trillipy zjada kamień i metabolizuje go.
dialogsBegin.ru: А знаешь, почему? Ты вообще знаешь, что такое рибений? Пф-ф! Это же булыжник, как следует переваренный зеленым хватоглотом!
dialogsBegin.sp: El Ribenuum se crea cuando un Trillipy Verde se come una piedra y la metaboliza.
dialogsBegin.sw: Ribenuum is made when a Green Trillipy eats a stone and metabolizes it.
dialogsBegin.th: Ribenuum ถูกสร้างขึ้นเมื่อ Green Trillipy กินหินและเผาผลาญมัน
dialogsBegin.tw: 因為啊～沛拉磷是綠色毒甲蜈蚣吃了岩石之後，而產生的一個礦石。而且毒甲蜈蚣只會在這裡出現啦！
dialogsBegin.vi: Ribenuum được tạo ra khi Green Trillipy ăn một viên đá và chuyển hóa nó.

dialogsBegin.en: Would you bring me some Ribenuum? A Green Tillipy is dangerous but you look equally as dangerous.
dialogsBegin.ar: Would you bring me some Ribenuum? A Green Tillipy is dangerous but you look equally as dangerous.
dialogsBegin.br: Você me traria um pouco de Ribenuum? Um Tillipy Verde é perigoso, mas você também parece ser.
dialogsBegin.cns: 可是啊～蜥蜴很恶劣啦！可是说到恶劣又没有比人类还要恶劣的动物了啦！所以你去帮我搜集好吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Bringst du mir etwas Ribenuum? Die Green Trillipy sind zwar bedrohlich, aber du siehst nicht weniger bedrohlich aus.
dialogsBegin.fi: Would you bring me some Ribenuum? A Green Tillipy is dangerous but you look equally as dangerous.
dialogsBegin.fil: Pwede mo ba ako dalahan ng Ribenuum? Ang isang Green Trillipy ay mapanganib ngunit ikaw ay kasing panganib neto.
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais attention car ils sont vraiment dangereux. Remarque un être humain peut aussi se montrer dangereux, donc pourquoi ne m'en ramènerais-tu pas ?
dialogsBegin.id: Maukah kamu membawakan aku beberapa Ribenuum? Green Tillipy berbahaya tetapi kamu terlihat sama berbahayanya.
dialogsBegin.it: Would you bring me some Ribenuum? A Green Tillipy is dangerous but you look equally as dangerous.
dialogsBegin.jp: その上＜グリーントリルピ＞はとても凶暴だ。だから危険なことが好きなオマエが ＜リベニウム＞ を採って俺に渡してくれるのは、いいアイデアだと思わないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 리베늄을 좀 가져다주시겠어요? 그린 트릴리피가 위험하긴 하지만, 당신도 만만치 않게 위험해 보이네요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Would you bring me some Ribenuum? A Green Tillipy is dangerous but you look equally as dangerous.
dialogsBegin.pl: Przyniesiesz mi trochę Ribenuum? Zielony Tillipy jest niebezpieczny, ale wyglądasz równie niebezpiecznie.
dialogsBegin.ru: Принесешь мне три десятка… гм… самородков? Хватоглоты опасны, но ты же любишь опасность - я в тебе не ошибся?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Me traerías un poco de Ribenuum? Los Green Tillipy son peligrosos, pero tú te ves igual de peligroso.
dialogsBegin.sw: Would you bring me some Ribenuum? A Green Tillipy is dangerous but you look equally as dangerous.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณนำ Ribenuum มาให้ฉันได้ไหม? Green Tillipy ก็ดูอันตรายอยู่เหมือนกัน
dialogsBegin.tw: 可是啊～毒甲蜈蚣很惡劣列啦！可是說到惡劣又沒有比人類還要惡劣的動物了啦！所以你去幫我蒐集好嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có thể mang cho tôi một ít Ribenuum? Green Tillipy nguy hiểm nhưng bạn trông cũng nguy hiểm không kém.

dialogsAccept.en: Green Trillipy are down the hall to the right. The room to the left is blocked.
dialogsAccept.ar: Green Trillipy are down the hall to the right. The room to the left is blocked.
dialogsAccept.br: Trillipy Verdes estão no fundo do corredor à direita. A sala à esquerda está bloqueada.
dialogsAccept.cns: 绿色蜥蜴出没在，你进来的反方向那边的通路，再往右边进去就会看到它们了，应该是不难找啦！
dialogsAccept.de: Die grünen Trillipy befinden sich den Gang hinunter auf der rechten Seite. Der Raum auf der linken Seite ist blockiert.
dialogsAccept.fi: Green Trillipy are down the hall to the right. The room to the left is blocked.
dialogsAccept.fil: Green Trillipy are down the hall to the right. The room to the left is blocked.
dialogsAccept.fr: Tu trouveras des Trillipys Verdâtres Perfides dans la salle sur la droite, en sortant par le passage opposé à celui par lequel tu es arrivé.
dialogsAccept.id: Green Trillipy ada di lorong sebelah kanan. Ruangan disebelah kiri diblokir.
dialogsAccept.it: Green Trillipy are down the hall to the right. The room to the left is blocked.
dialogsAccept.jp: ＜グリーントリルピ＞はこの付近にはいない。この先の通路に出て、右の部屋に棲息している。
dialogsAccept.kr: 초록 트릴리피는 복도를 따라 오른쪽으로 내려가면 있습니다. 왼쪽 방은 막혀 있습니다.
dialogsAccept.nl: Green Trillipy are down the hall to the right. The room to the left is blocked.
dialogsAccept.pl: Zielonego Trillipy znajdziesz w pomieszczeniu na prawo od wyjścia z kopalni. Pokój po lewej jest zablokowany.
dialogsAccept.ru: Зелёные хватоглоты — вниз по коридору направо. Комната слева завалена.
dialogsAccept.sp: Los Trillipy Verdes están al final del pasillo a la derecha. La habitación de la izquierda está bloqueada.
dialogsAccept.sw: Green Trillipy are down the hall to the right. The room to the left is blocked.
dialogsAccept.th: Green Trillipy อยู่ทางด้านขวาของห้องโถง แต่ห้องทางด้านซ้ายถูกปิดไว้
dialogsAccept.tw: 綠色毒甲蜈蚣出沒在，你進來的反方向那邊的通路，再往右邊進去就會看到牠們了，應該是不難找啦！
dialogsAccept.vi: Green Trillipy đang ở hành lang bên phải. Căn phòng bên trái bị chặn.

dialogsDecline.en: Are you kidding me? Go on and get out of here, I may not look it but I am an old Dwarpet and I do not have time for games.
dialogsDecline.ar: Are you kidding me? Go on and get out of here, I may not look it but I am an old Dwarpet and I do not have time for games.
dialogsDecline.br: Você está brincando comigo? Saia daqui. Pode não parecer, mas sou um velho Dwarpet e não tenho tempo para jogos.
dialogsDecline.cns: 你现在是跟我开玩笑吗?你现在故意要耍我是吗?
dialogsDecline.de: Ist das dein Ernst? Geh lieber nach Hause. Ich sehe vielleicht nicht so aus, aber ich bin schon ein sehr alter Dwarpet und habe keine Zeit für Spielchen.
dialogsDecline.fi: Are you kidding me? Go on and get out of here, I may not look it but I am an old Dwarpet and I do not have time for games.
dialogsDecline.fil: Niloloko mo ba ako? Lumayas ka dito, di mo lang namumukhaan, pero ako ay isang matandang Dwarpet at wala akong oras makipaglaro.
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu te fiches de moi ? Ben rentre chez toi ! Et ne te moque plus jamais d'un Dwarpet de mon genre !
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu bercanda? Pergi dari sini, aku mungkin tidak melihatnya, tetapi aku adalah Dwarpet tua dan aku tidak punya waktu untuk bermain game.
dialogsDecline.it: Are you kidding me? Go on and get out of here, I may not look it but I am an old Dwarpet and I do not have time for games.
dialogsDecline.jp: ああ、そうかい？　なら取引は中止だな。
dialogsDecline.kr: 장난하시는 건가요? 저리 꺼지세요. 이래 봬도 전 생각보다 나이가 많아서 시간 낭비할 여유 따윈 없다고요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Are you kidding me? Go on and get out of here, I may not look it but I am an old Dwarpet and I do not have time for games.
dialogsDecline.pl: Czy ty żartujesz? Idź i wynoś się stąd, może na to nie wyglądam, ale jestem starym krasnoludem i nie mam czasu na gry.
dialogsDecline.ru: Ты что, шутишь? Ну и проваливай отсюда! Может, с виду по мне не скажешь, но я карлик пожилой и уважаемый! Я твои игры терпеть не намерен!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Me estás tomando el pelo? Anda y sal de aquí, puede que no lo parezca pero soy un Enano viejo y no tengo tiempo para juegos.
dialogsDecline.sw: Are you kidding me? Go on and get out of here, I may not look it but I am an old Dwarpet and I do not have time for games.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณล้อเล่นหรือเปล่า ออกไปจากที่นี่เถอะ ฉันอาจจะมองไม่เห็น แต่ฉันเป็น Dwarpet และไม่มีเวลาเล่นเกม
dialogsDecline.tw: 你在跟我開玩笑嗎？快走吧。別看我不像，我可是上了年紀的矮人，沒時間陪你玩遊戲。
dialogsDecline.vi: Đùa tôi à? Tiếp tục và ra khỏi đây, tôi có thể không nhìn nó nhưng tôi là một Người lùn già và tôi không có thời gian cho trò chơi.

dialogsComplete.en: Ahhh...you brought the Ribenuum. But what is this? It is flawed!
dialogsComplete.ar: Ahhh...you brought the Ribenuum. But what is this? It is flawed!
dialogsComplete.br: Ahhh...você trouxe o Ribenuum. Mas, o que é isso? Está com defeito!
dialogsComplete.cns: 嗯...你有拿30个沛拉磷回来喔～咦？可是这个沛拉磷好像不是好货喔！
dialogsComplete.de: Ahh... du hast das Ribenuum. Aber was ist das? Es sieht falsch aus!
dialogsComplete.fi: Ahhh...you brought the Ribenuum. But what is this? It is flawed!
dialogsComplete.fil: Ahhh...nagdala ka ng Ribenuum. Pero ano to? Me sira!
dialogsComplete.fr: Tu as finalement trouvé les 30 morceaux de Ribenuum. Mais malheureusement ce Ribenuum comporte des défauts…
dialogsComplete.id: Ahhh...kamu membawakan Ribenuum. Tapi apa ini? Itu cacat!
dialogsComplete.it: Ahhh...you brought the Ribenuum. But what is this? It is flawed!
dialogsComplete.jp: ちゃんと30個持ってきたな。でもこの＜リベニウム＞ は混じりモノが多くて価値が低いな。
dialogsComplete.kr: 아아… 리베늄을 가져오셨군요. 그런데 이건 뭐죠? 하자가 있잖아요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Ahhh...you brought the Ribenuum. But what is this? It is flawed!
dialogsComplete.pl: Ahhh...przyniosłeś Ribenuum. Ale co to jest? To jest wadliwe!
dialogsComplete.ru: Ага! Тебе удалось раздобыть рибений! Но… фу! Сколько в нем примесей! Похоже, хватоглоты не успели как следует переварить проглоченное.
dialogsComplete.sp: Ahhh... has traído el Ribenuum. ¿Pero qué es esto? ¡Es defectuoso!
dialogsComplete.sw: Ahhh...you brought the Ribenuum. But what is this? It is flawed!
dialogsComplete.th: อ่า...คุณเอา Ribenuum มาด้วย แต่นี่คืออะไร? มันมีข้อบกพร่อง!
dialogsComplete.tw: 嗯…你有拿 30 個沛拉磷回來喔～咦？可是這個沛拉磷好像不是好貨喔！
dialogsComplete.vi: Ahhh...bạn đã mang Ribenuum. Nhưng cái này là gì? Thật là thiếu sót!

dialogsFail.en: How hard is it to bring me what I asked for? 30 pieces of Ribenuum?
dialogsFail.ar: How hard is it to bring me what I asked for? 30 pieces of Ribenuum?
dialogsFail.br: Qual é a dificuldade para me trazer o que eu pedi? 30 pedaços de Ribenuum?
dialogsFail.cns: 搜集30个沛拉磷，对你们人类来说应该是很简单的事情吧？
dialogsFail.de: Ist es wirklich so schwer, mir 30 Ribenuum zu besorgen?
dialogsFail.fi: How hard is it to bring me what I asked for? 30 pieces of Ribenuum?
dialogsFail.fil: Gano kahirap ba na dalihin mo ang sinasabi ko? 30 piraso ng Ribenuum?
dialogsFail.fr: C'est pas trop compliqué, ramener 30 Ribenuum…
dialogsFail.id: Seberapa sulitkah untuk membawakan apa yang aku minta? 30 buah Ribenuum?
dialogsFail.it: How hard is it to bring me what I asked for? 30 pieces of Ribenuum?
dialogsFail.jp: ＜リベニウム＞ 30個を持って来るのは、簡単な事だろ？
dialogsFail.kr: 리베늄 30개 가져오는 것 정도는 인간 말로 누워서 떡 먹기 아닌가요?
dialogsFail.nl: How hard is it to bring me what I asked for? 30 pieces of Ribenuum?
dialogsFail.pl: Jak trudno jest mi przynieść to, o co prosiłem? 30 kawałków Ribenuum?
dialogsFail.ru: Что, так трудно раздобыть тридцать несчастных камней из желудков хватоглотов?!
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Tan difícil es traerme lo que pedí? ¿30 piezas de Ribenuum?
dialogsFail.sw: How hard is it to bring me what I asked for? 30 pieces of Ribenuum?
dialogsFail.th: มันยากขนาดนั้นเลยเหรอที่จะนำ Ribenuum มาให้ฉัน 30 รายการ???
dialogsFail.tw: 蒐集 30 個沛拉磷，對你們人類來說應該是很簡單的事情吧？
dialogsFail.vi: Thật khó để mang lại cho tôi những gì tôi đã yêu cầu? 30 miếng Ribenuum?

description.en: Acquire an Ancient Inscription from one of the Tombstone Bearers.
description.ar: Acquire an Ancient Inscription from one of the Tombstone Bearers.
description.br: Adquira uma Inscrição Antiga de um dos Portadores de Lápides.
description.cns: 从碑石工匠中获取古代铭文。
description.de: Erwerben Sie eine uralte Inschrift von einem der Tombstone Bearers.
description.fi: Acquire an Ancient Inscription from one of the Tombstone Bearers.
description.fil: Acquire an Ancient Inscription from one of the Tombstone Bearers.
description.fr: Tuez un Tombstone et obtenez la Condamnation à l'Esclavage.
description.id: Dapatkan Ancient Inscription dari salah satu Tombstone Bearers.
description.it: Acquire an Ancient Inscription from one of the Tombstone Bearers.
description.jp: キャプテン・トムストンベアラーを倒して奴隷の証を入手し報告せよ。
description.kr: 툼스톤 베어러를 처치하고 고대의 비문을 획득하세요.
description.nl: Acquire an Ancient Inscription from one of the Tombstone Bearers.
description.pl: Zdobądź Starożytną Inskrypcję od jednego z Targaczy Nagrobków.
description.ru: Acquire an Ancient Inscription from one of the Tombstone Bearers.
description.sp: Consigue una Inscripción Antigua de uno de los Tombstone Bearers.
description.sw: Acquire an Ancient Inscription from one of the Tombstone Bearers.
description.th: ได้รับจารึกโบราณจากหนึ่งในกัปตัน Tombstone Bearers
description.tw: 從一位苦命超人處獲得一份奴隸的印章。
description.vi: Nhận được Chữ khắc cổ từ một trong những Người mang bia mộ.

dialogsBegin.en: While conducting my research, I found something of interest about the pillars carried by the Tombstone Bearers. It looks similar to those of Shade's temple.
dialogsBegin.ar: While conducting my research, I found something of interest about the pillars carried by the Tombstone Bearers. It looks similar to those of Shade's temple.
dialogsBegin.br: Enquanto conduzia minha pesquisa, encontrei algo interessante sobre os pilares carregados pelos Portadores de Lápides. Parecem ser semelhantes aos do templo de Shade.
dialogsBegin.cns: 在进行研究时，我发现在碑石工匠携带的石碑上有一些很有趣的东西。它看起来和谢莉德的神殿很像。
dialogsBegin.de: Bei meinen Nachforschungen fand ich etwas Interessantes über die Säulen, die von den Tombstone Bearers getragen werden. Sie sehen ähnlich aus wie die des Schattentempels.
dialogsBegin.fi: While conducting my research, I found something of interest about the pillars carried by the Tombstone Bearers. It looks similar to those of Shade's temple.
dialogsBegin.fil: While conducting my research, I found something of interest about the pillars carried by the Tombstone Bearers. It looks similar to those of Shade's temple.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je viens de trouver quelque chose d'intéressant. La pierre que portait ce Tombstone porte le même type d'inscriptions que les piliers du temple d'Ivillis.
dialogsBegin.id: Saat melakukan penelitian, saya menemukan sesuatu yang menarik tentang pilar-pilar yang dibawa oleh Tombstone Bearers. Ini terlihat mirip dengan kuil Shade.
dialogsBegin.it: While conducting my research, I found something of interest about the pillars carried by the Tombstone Bearers. It looks similar to those of Shade's temple.
dialogsBegin.jp: 調査をしたところ、偶然貴方が倒したトムストンベアラーの遺体から特異な点を見つけました。それは、彼らが持っている巨大な柱です。その柱の模様がイブリス寺院の柱と同じでした。
dialogsBegin.kr: 조사하다가 툼스톤 베어러들이 들고 있던 기둥에서 흥미로운 점을 발견했답니다. 쉐이드의 신전에 있던 기둥과 비슷하더군요.
dialogsBegin.nl: While conducting my research, I found something of interest about the pillars carried by the Tombstone Bearers. It looks similar to those of Shade's temple.
dialogsBegin.pl: Podczas moich poszukiwań znalazłem coś interesującego w filarach niesionych przez Targaczy Nagrobków. Wygląda podobnie do Świątyni Shade.
dialogsBegin.ru: While conducting my research, I found something of interest about the pillars carried by the Tombstone Bearers. It looks similar to those of Shade's temple.
dialogsBegin.sp: Mientras realizaba la investigación, encontré algo interesante sobre los pilares que llevan los Tombstone Bearers. Se parecen a los del templo de Shade.
dialogsBegin.sw: While conducting my research, I found something of interest about the pillars carried by the Tombstone Bearers. It looks similar to those of Shade's temple.
dialogsBegin.th: ในระหว่างการทำวิจัยของฉันฉันพบบางสิ่งบางอย่างที่น่าสนใจเกี่ยวกับเสาหลักที่ถือโดย Tombstone Bearers ดูเหมือนกับวิหารของ Shade
dialogsBegin.tw: 在進行研究時，我發現了一些關於苦命超人攜帶的柱子的有趣之處。它看起來與闇影的神殿相似。
dialogsBegin.vi: Trong khi thực hiện nghiên cứu của mình, tôi đã tìm thấy một số điều thú vị về những cây cột do Những người mang bia mộ mang theo. Nó trông giống với những ngôi đền của Shade.

dialogsBegin.en: Upon looking further into the information, I found that Tombstone Bearers were actually slaves of Shade that built her temple. But why would they be here in the Garden of Rhisis?
dialogsBegin.ar: Upon looking further into the information, I found that Tombstone Bearers were actually slaves of Shade that built her temple. But why would they be here in the Garden of Rhisis?
dialogsBegin.br: Ao analisar mais as informações, descobri que os Portadores de Lápides eram, na verdade, escravos de Shade que construíram seu templo. Mas por que eles estariam aqui no Jardim de Rhisis??
dialogsBegin.cns: Upon looking further into the information, I found that Tombstone Bearers were actually slaves of Shade that built her temple. But why would they be here in the Garden of Rhisis?
dialogsBegin.de: Als ich mich näher mit den Informationen befasste, fand ich heraus, dass die Tombstone Bearers eigentlich Sklaven von Shade waren, die ihren Tempel bauten. Aber warum sollten sie hier im Garden of Rhisis sein?
dialogsBegin.fi: Upon looking further into the information, I found that Tombstone Bearers were actually slaves of Shade that built her temple. But why would they be here in the Garden of Rhisis?
dialogsBegin.fil: Upon looking further into the information, I found that Tombstone Bearers were actually slaves of Shade that built her temple. But why would they be here in the Garden of Rhisis?
dialogsBegin.fr: Si on en croit ce texte, les Tombstone sont condamnés à l'esclavage…
dialogsBegin.id: Setelah melihat indormasi lebih jauh, saya menemukan bahwa Tombstone Bearers sebenarnya adalah budak Shade yang membangun kuilnya. Tapi mengapa mereka ada di sini di Garden of Rhisis??
dialogsBegin.it: Upon looking further into the information, I found that Tombstone Bearers were actually slaves of Shade that built her temple. But why would they be here in the Garden of Rhisis?
dialogsBegin.jp: どうやら彼らはイブリス寺院を建築する際に奴隷として働かされていたようです。しかし、イブリス神殿の奴隷がなぜこのような場所にまで来ているのでしょうか。
dialogsBegin.kr: 더 자세히 살펴보니, 툼스톤 베어러들은 사실 쉐이드의 노예 역할을 하며 신전을 지었더군요. 도대체 리시스의 정원에서 뭘 하려는 걸까요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Upon looking further into the information, I found that Tombstone Bearers were actually slaves of Shade that built her temple. But why would they be here in the Garden of Rhisis?
dialogsBegin.pl: Po dokładniejszym zapoznaniu się z informacjami odkryłem, że Targacze Nagrobków byli w rzeczywistości niewolnikami Cienia, który zbudował jej świątynię. Ale dlaczego znaleźli się tutaj, w Ogrodzie Rhisis?
dialogsBegin.ru: Upon looking further into the information, I found that Tombstone Bearers were actually slaves of Shade that built her temple. But why would they be here in the Garden of Rhisis?
dialogsBegin.sp: Al indagar más en la información, he descubierto que los Tombstone Bearers en realidad eran esclavos de Shade que construyeron su templo. ¿¿Pero por qué estarán aquí en el Jardín de Rhisis??
dialogsBegin.sw: Upon looking further into the information, I found that Tombstone Bearers were actually slaves of Shade that built her temple. But why would they be here in the Garden of Rhisis?
dialogsBegin.th: จากข้อมูลเพิ่มเติม ฉันพบว่า Tombstone Bearers นั้นเป็นทาสของ Shade ที่สร้างวิหารให้เธอ แต่ทำไมพวกเขาถึงมาอยู่ที่ Garden of Rhisis?
dialogsBegin.tw: 我再深入調查後發現，墓碑搬運者其實是闇影的奴僕，負責替她建造神殿。可他們為什麼會出現在黎席斯庭院？
dialogsBegin.vi: Khi đào sâu hơn về thông tin này, tôi biết được rằng Tombstone Bearers thật ra là những nô lệ xây dựng đền thờ cho Shade. Nhưng tại sao họ lại ở đây ngay tại Garden of Rhisis?

dialogsBegin.en: I need to acquire more data! Would you help me further by acquiring an Ancient Inscription? This might provide the insight I'm looking for!
dialogsBegin.ar: I need to acquire more data! Would you help me further by acquiring an Ancient Inscription? This might provide the insight I'm looking for!
dialogsBegin.br: Preciso adquirir mais dados! Você me ajudaria adquirindo uma Inscrição Antiga? Isso pode fornecer a visão que estou procurando!
dialogsBegin.cns: 我需要获得更多的数据！你愿意进一步帮助我获得一个古代铭文吗？这可能会让我获得一直寻找的灵感！
dialogsBegin.de: Ich muss mehr Daten sammeln! Würden Sie mir weiterhelfen, indem Sie eine antike Inschrift beschaffen? Das könnte mir den gewünschten Einblick verschaffen!
dialogsBegin.fi: I need to acquire more data! Would you help me further by acquiring an Ancient Inscription? This might provide the insight I'm looking for!
dialogsBegin.fil: I need to acquire more data! Would you help me further by acquiring an Ancient Inscription? This might provide the insight I'm looking for!
dialogsBegin.fr: Je suppose qu'il faudrait plus de texte pour connaître la cause de cette sanction. Je parie que la plaque d'un Capitaine Tombstone contient cette information.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya perlu memperoleh lebih banyak data! Maukah kau membantu saya lebih jauh dengan memperoleh Ancient Inscription? Ini mungkin bisa memberikan wawasan yang sedang saya cari!
dialogsBegin.it: I need to acquire more data! Would you help me further by acquiring an Ancient Inscription? This might provide the insight I'm looking for!
dialogsBegin.jp: もう少し調査が必要なようです。何度も申し訳ありませんが、彼らの長、キャプテンを倒してさらに調査させて頂けませんか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 좀 더 확실한 자료가 필요해요! 고대의 비문을 한 번만 더 구해 주실 수 있나요? 그러면 확실히 단서를 얻을 수 있을지도 모르겠어요!
dialogsBegin.nl: I need to acquire more data! Would you help me further by acquiring an Ancient Inscription? This might provide the insight I'm looking for!
dialogsBegin.pl: Muszę zdobyć więcej danych! Czy pomożesz mi dalej, zdobywając Starożytną Inskrypcję? To może dostarczyć informacji, których szukam!
dialogsBegin.ru: I need to acquire more data! Would you help me further by acquiring an Ancient Inscription? This might provide the insight I'm looking for!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Necesito conseguir más datos! ¿Me ayudarás a adquirir una Inscripción Antigua? ¡Eso me podría proporcionar la información que estoy buscando!
dialogsBegin.sw: I need to acquire more data! Would you help me further by acquiring an Ancient Inscription? This might provide the insight I'm looking for!
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันต้องการได้รับข้อมูลเพิ่มเติม! คุณช่วยฉันได้อีกหรือไม่โดยการได้รับการจารึกโบราณ? นี้อาจให้ข้อมูลเชิงลึกที่ฉันกำลังมองหา!
dialogsBegin.tw: 我需要更多資料！你願意進一步協助我，取得一份古代銘文嗎？它或許能提供我需要的線索！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi cần thu thập thêm dữ liệu! Bạn có thể giúp tôi thêm bằng cách có được một Ancient Inscription không? Điều này có thể cung cấp thông tin chi tiết mà tôi đang tìm kiếm!

dialogsAccept.en: I knew you would have accepted. You too yearn to discover the truth! You can find a Ancient Inscription by defeating any of the Tombstone Bearers
dialogsAccept.ar: I knew you would have accepted. You too yearn to discover the truth! You can find a Ancient Inscription by defeating any of the Tombstone Bearers
dialogsAccept.br: Eu sabia que você teria aceitado. Você também anseia por descobrir a verdade! Você pode encontrar uma Inscrição Antiga derrotando qualquer um dos Portadores de Lápides.
dialogsAccept.cns: 我知道你会接受的。你太渴望发现真相了！你可以通过杀死任何一个碑石工匠拿到古代铭文。
dialogsAccept.de: Ich wusste, dass du das akzeptiert hättest. Auch du sehnst dich danach, die Wahrheit zu erfahren! Du kannst eine uralte Inschrift finden, indem du einen der Tombstone Bearers besiegst.
dialogsAccept.fi: I knew you would have accepted. You too yearn to discover the truth! You can find a Ancient Inscription by defeating any of the Tombstone Bearers
dialogsAccept.fil: I knew you would have accepted. You too yearn to discover the truth! You can find a Ancient Inscription by defeating any of the Tombstone Bearers
dialogsAccept.fr: Allez donc tuer un Capitaine Tombstone pour que nous puissions étudier sa plaque.
dialogsAccept.id: Saya tahu kau akan menerimanya. Kau terlalu rindu untuk menemukan kebenaran! Kau akan dapat menemukan Ancient Inscription dengan mengalahkan salah satu Tombstone Bearers
dialogsAccept.it: I knew you would have accepted. You too yearn to discover the truth! You can find a Ancient Inscription by defeating any of the Tombstone Bearers
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとうございます。トムストンベアラーの中でもキャプテンと冠名されているモンスターをお願いします。
dialogsAccept.kr: 수락하실 줄 알았어요. 당신도 진실이 궁금하시겠죠! 툼스톤 베어러를 처치하면 고대의 비문을 찾을 수 있어요.
dialogsAccept.nl: I knew you would have accepted. You too yearn to discover the truth! You can find a Ancient Inscription by defeating any of the Tombstone Bearers
dialogsAccept.pl: Wiedziałem, że się zgodzisz. Ty też pragniesz odkryć prawdę! Starożytną inskrypcję możesz znaleźć, pokonując któregokolwiek z Targaczy Nagrobków.
dialogsAccept.ru: I knew you would have accepted. You too yearn to discover the truth! You can find a Ancient Inscription by defeating any of the Tombstone Bearers
dialogsAccept.sp: Sabía que aceptarías. ¡Tú también quieres descubrir la verdad! Podrás encontrar una Inscripción Antigua al derrotar a cualquiera de los Tombstone Bearers.
dialogsAccept.sw: I knew you would have accepted. You too yearn to discover the truth! You can find a Ancient Inscription by defeating any of the Tombstone Bearers
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันรู้ว่าคุณจะยอมรับ คุณโหยหาที่จะค้นพบความจริง! คุณสามารถหาจารึกโบราณได้โดยการเอาชนะ Captain Tombstone Bearers
dialogsAccept.tw: 我就知道你會接受，你也渴望查明真相！擊敗任何苦命超人，都有機會找到古代銘文。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi biết bạn sẽ chấp nhận. Bạn cũng khao khát khám phá sự thật! Bạn có thể tìm thấy Chữ khắc cổ bằng cách đánh bại bất kỳ Kẻ mang bia mộ nào

dialogsDecline.en: How could you decline? This could potentially reveal so much to us about Shade's masquerpets and their growing strength!
dialogsDecline.ar: How could you decline? This could potentially reveal so much to us about Shade's masquerpets and their growing strength!
dialogsDecline.br: Como você pode recusar?? Isso poderia revelar muito sobre os masquerpets de Shade e sua força crescente!
dialogsDecline.cns: How could you decline? This could potentially reveal so much to us about Shade's masquerpets and their growing strength!
dialogsDecline.de: Wie konntest du ablehnen? Dies könnte uns möglicherweise so viel über Shades Masquerpets und ihre wachsende Stärke verraten!
dialogsDecline.fi: How could you decline? This could potentially reveal so much to us about Shade's masquerpets and their growing strength!
dialogsDecline.fil: How could you decline? This could potentially reveal so much to us about Shade's masquerpets and their growing strength!
dialogsDecline.fr: En fin de compte vous n'avez pas de cran !
dialogsDecline.id: Bagaimana kau bisa menolak?? Ini berpotensi mengungkapkan begitu banyak tentang penyamaran Shade kepada kita dan kekuatan mereka yang semakin besar!
dialogsDecline.it: How could you decline? This could potentially reveal so much to us about Shade's masquerpets and their growing strength!
dialogsDecline.jp: そうですか……ちっ（この程度で断るようじゃ使えないわね
dialogsDecline.kr: 어떻게 거절할 수 있어요? 이걸로 쉐이드의 마스커펫과 그들의 힘에 대해 많은 걸 알 수 있겠어요!
dialogsDecline.nl: How could you decline? This could potentially reveal so much to us about Shade's masquerpets and their growing strength!
dialogsDecline.pl: How could you decline? This could potentially reveal so much to us about Shade's masquerpets and their growing strength!
dialogsDecline.ru: How could you decline? This could potentially reveal so much to us about Shade's masquerpets and their growing strength!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿¿Cómo puedes rechazar?? ¡Esto podría revelarnos mucha información sobre los masquerpets de Shade y su creciente fuerza!
dialogsDecline.sw: How could you decline? This could potentially reveal so much to us about Shade's masquerpets and their growing strength!
dialogsDecline.th: คุณจะปฏิเสธได้อย่างไร? สิ่งนี้อาจทำให้เรารู้ความลับของ Shade's masquerpets และที่มาของความแข็งแกร่ง
dialogsDecline.tw: 你怎麼能拒絕？這件事很可能會揭露更多關於闇影的怪物，以及牠們力量日益壯大的真相！
dialogsDecline.vi: Sao bạn có thể từ chối được chứ? Điều này có thể tiết lộ rất nhiều cho chúng ta về vây cánh của Shade và sức mạnh đang lớn dần của chúng!

dialogsComplete.fil: You got it!! Please hand it over quickly for me to analyze!
dialogsComplete.fr: Vous avez trouvé la condamnation à l'esclavage ! Je vais devoir la traduire.
dialogsComplete.id: Kau mendapatkannya!! Tolong serahkan dengan cepat untuk saya analisis!
dialogsComplete.it: You got it!! Please hand it over quickly for me to analyze!
dialogsComplete.jp: おお、持ってきて下さったのですね。早速これを元に分析してみましょう！
dialogsComplete.kr: 찾아오셨군요!! 분석해야 하니 얼른 이리 주세요!

dialogsComplete.th: คุณได้รับมัน! โปรดส่งมันมาเร็วๆ เพื่อวิเคราะห์!
dialogsComplete.tw: 你說對了！！請速交給我分析！
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn hiểu rồi !! Hãy nhanh tay giao cho tôi để tôi phân tích!

dialogsFail.en: Even if you don't initially receive an Ancient Inscription, keep defeating them! I'm sure one of these Tombstone Bearers is bound to have the Ancient Inscription!
dialogsFail.ar: Even if you don't initially receive an Ancient Inscription, keep defeating them! I'm sure one of these Tombstone Bearers is bound to have the Ancient Inscription!
dialogsFail.br: Mesmo se você não receber inicialmente uma Inscrição Antiga, continue os caçando! Tenho certeza de que um desses Portadores de Lápides deve ter a Inscrição Antiga!
dialogsFail.cns: 如果你第一次没能拿到古代铭文，那就继续击杀他们！我相信这些碑石工匠中肯定有一个会掉落古代铭文的！
dialogsFail.de: Auch wenn ihr anfangs keine Alte Inschrift erhaltet, besiegt sie weiter! Ich bin mir sicher, dass einer dieser Tombstone Bearers die uralte Inschrift haben wird!
dialogsFail.fi: Even if you don't initially receive an Ancient Inscription, keep defeating them! I'm sure one of these Tombstone Bearers is bound to have the Ancient Inscription!
dialogsFail.fil: Even if you don't initially receive an Ancient Inscription, keep defeating them! I'm sure one of these Tombstone Bearers is bound to have the Ancient Inscription!
dialogsFail.fr: Vous trouverez la condamnation à l'esclavage des Tombstone sur la plaque d'un Tombstone.
dialogsFail.id: Bahkan jika kau awalnya tidak menerima Ancient Inscription, teruslah mengalahkan mereka! Saya yakin salah satu Tombstone Bearers ini pasti memiliki Ancient Inscription!
dialogsFail.it: Even if you don't initially receive an Ancient Inscription, keep defeating them! I'm sure one of these Tombstone Bearers is bound to have the Ancient Inscription!
dialogsFail.jp: キャプテンと冠名されているモンスターですよ。お願いしますね。
dialogsFail.kr: 고대의 비문을 바로 얻지 못하신대도, 계속 툼스톤 베어러들을 처치해 보세요! 그중 하나는 분명 고대의 비문을 가지고 있을 거예요!
dialogsFail.nl: Even if you don't initially receive an Ancient Inscription, keep defeating them! I'm sure one of these Tombstone Bearers is bound to have the Ancient Inscription!
dialogsFail.pl: Nawet jeśli początkowo nie otrzymasz starożytnej inskrypcji, musisz walczyć dalej! Jestem pewien, że jeden z tych Targaczy Nagrobków będzie miał Starożytną Inskrypcję!
dialogsFail.ru: Even if you don't initially receive an Ancient Inscription, keep defeating them! I'm sure one of these Tombstone Bearers is bound to have the Ancient Inscription!
dialogsFail.sp: Si no consigues una Inscripción Antigua a la primera, ¡sigue derrotándolos! ¡Estoy segura de que uno de los Tombstone Bearers tiene la Inscripción Antigua!
dialogsFail.sw: Even if you don't initially receive an Ancient Inscription, keep defeating them! I'm sure one of these Tombstone Bearers is bound to have the Ancient Inscription!
dialogsFail.th: แม้ว่าคุณจะไม่ได้รับจารึกโบราณ แต่ชนะพวกเขาให้ได้! ฉันแน่ใจว่าหนึ่งใน Captain Tombstone Bearers เหล่านี้ถูกผูกไว้กับหินจารึกโบราณ!
dialogsFail.tw: 即使你最初沒有收到奴隸的印章，也要繼續擊敗他們！我敢肯定，這些苦命超人中的一個必定擁有奴隸的印章！
dialogsFail.vi: Ngay cả khi ban đầu bạn không nhận được Chữ khắc cổ, hãy tiếp tục đánh bại chúng! Tôi chắc rằng một trong những Người mang bia mộ này nhất định phải có Dòng chữ Cổ!

dialogsBegin.en: Hah! I never thought Elaine would change his mind so easily. This pendant here, well, it definitely shows that he means business!
dialogsBegin.ar: Hah! I never thought Elaine would change his mind so easily. This pendant here, well, it definitely shows that he means business!
dialogsBegin.br: Ah! Nunca pensei que Elaine mudaria de ideia tão facilmente. Este pingente, bem, definitivamente mostra que ele está falando sério!
dialogsBegin.cns: 哈! 我从未想过伊莲会如此轻易地改变他的想法。这个吊坠，嗯，他绝对是在做正事!
dialogsBegin.de: Hah! Ich hätte nie gedacht, dass Elaine seine Meinung so schnell ändern würde. Dieser Anhänger hier zeigt, dass er es ernst meint!
dialogsBegin.fi: Hah! I never thought Elaine would change his mind so easily. This pendant here, well, it definitely shows that he means business!
dialogsBegin.fil: Hah! I never thought Elaine would change his mind so easily. This pendant here, well, it definitely shows that he means business!
dialogsBegin.fr: Il vous a confié son amulette en symbole de confiance, vous avez dû l'impressionner.
dialogsBegin.id: Hah! Saya tidak pernah berpikir Elaine akan berubah pikiran dengan mudah. Pendant ini di sini, yah, itu pasti menunjukkan bahwa dia bersungguh-sungguh!
dialogsBegin.it: Hah! I never thought Elaine would change his mind so easily. This pendant here, well, it definitely shows that he means business!
dialogsBegin.jp: ふむ。エルラインがここまで君を信頼するとは思わなかったよ。きっと相当な苦労を重ねたのだろう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 허! 일레인이 그렇게 쉽게 마음을 바꿀 줄은 몰랐네요. 이 펜던트는, 음, 이번엔 각오를 단단히 다졌다는 뜻이겠죠!
dialogsBegin.nl: Hah! I never thought Elaine would change his mind so easily. This pendant here, well, it definitely shows that he means business!
dialogsBegin.pl: Hah! I never thought Elaine would change his mind so easily. This pendant here, well, it definitely shows that he means business!
dialogsBegin.ru: Hah! I never thought Elaine would change his mind so easily. This pendant here, well, it definitely shows that he means business!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Ja! No pensaba que Elaine fuera a cambiar de opinión tan fácilmente. ¡Este colgante, sin duda demuestra que está hablando en serio!
dialogsBegin.sw: Hah! I never thought Elaine would change his mind so easily. This pendant here, well, it definitely shows that he means business!
dialogsBegin.th: ฮะ! ฉันไม่เคยคิดว่าอีเลนจะเปลี่ยนความคิดของเขาได้อย่างง่ายดาย นี่จี้ มันแสดงให้เห็นว่าเขาหมายถึงธุรกิจ!
dialogsBegin.tw: 他能夠改變心意，都是多虧有你！他拿出墜飾就是要展現出自己的信義。
dialogsBegin.vi: Hả! Tôi chưa bao giờ nghĩ Elaine lại đổi ý dễ dàng như vậy. Mặt dây chuyền này ở đây, tốt, nó chắc chắn cho thấy rằng anh ấy có ý nghĩa kinh doanh!

dialogsBegin.en: I'm glad to see that the old Elaine has returned! Here, take my pendant as well! Now take them to Reonan and let him know we are ready to stand united!
dialogsBegin.ar: I'm glad to see that the old Elaine has returned! Here, take my pendant as well! Now take them to Reonan and let him know we are ready to stand united!
dialogsBegin.br: Fico feliz em ver que o velho Elaine voltou! Aqui, pegue meu pingente também! Agora leve para Reonan e deixe ele saber que estamos prontos para nos unir!
dialogsBegin.cns: 我很高兴看到老伊莲回来了! 给你，把我的吊坠也拿去吧! 现在把它们带到瑞尔南那里，让他知道我们已经准备好团结起来了!
dialogsBegin.de: Ich freue mich, dass die alte Elaine wieder da ist! Hier, nimm auch meinen Anhänger! Bringt sie jetzt zu Reonan und sagt ihm, dass wir bereit sind, uns zu vereinen!
dialogsBegin.fi: I'm glad to see that the old Elaine has returned! Here, take my pendant as well! Now take them to Reonan and let him know we are ready to stand united!
dialogsBegin.fil: I'm glad to see that the old Elaine has returned! Here, take my pendant as well! Now take them to Reonan and let him know we are ready to stand united!
dialogsBegin.fr: Je vais faire comme lui. Apportez nos pendentifs à Reonan pour lui assurer notre coopération.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya senang melihat Elaine tua telah kembali! Nih, ambil pendant ku juga! Sekarang bawa mereka ke Reonan dan beri tahu dia bahwa kita siap untuk bersatu!
dialogsBegin.it: I'm glad to see that the old Elaine has returned! Here, take my pendant as well! Now take them to Reonan and let him know we are ready to stand united!
dialogsBegin.jp: よし、そんな君になら私も託すことができる。レオナンの元へ戻る際には、この、私のペンダントも渡してくれないか。
dialogsBegin.kr: 예전의 일레인이 돌아오다니 정말 기쁘네요! 여기, 제 펜던트도 받으세요! 이제 이 모든 걸 레오난에게 전하고, 우리가 함께 맞설 준비가 되었다고 알려주세요!
dialogsBegin.nl: I'm glad to see that the old Elaine has returned! Here, take my pendant as well! Now take them to Reonan and let him know we are ready to stand united!
dialogsBegin.pl: I'm glad to see that the old Elaine has returned! Here, take my pendant as well! Now take them to Reonan and let him know we are ready to stand united!
dialogsBegin.ru: I'm glad to see that the old Elaine has returned! Here, take my pendant as well! Now take them to Reonan and let him know we are ready to stand united!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Me alegra ver que el viejo Elaine ha vuelto! ¡Toma, toma mi colgante también! ¡Llévaselos a Reonan y hazle saber que estamos listos para permanecer unidos!
dialogsBegin.sw: I'm glad to see that the old Elaine has returned! Here, take my pendant as well! Now take them to Reonan and let him know we are ready to stand united!
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันดีใจที่ได้เห็นว่า Elaine กลับมาแล้ว! ที่นี่เอาจี้ของมาฉันด้วย! ตอนนี้พาพวกเขาไปหา Reonan และแจ้งให้เขารู้ว่าเราพร้อมที่จะยืนหยัดต่อสู้กัน!
dialogsBegin.tw: 很好。耶拉伊也積極的挺身而出，我怎麼能不做一點表示呢。把我的墜飾也拿去吧。這樣雷奧南就得到兩位過去的英雄了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi rất vui khi thấy Elaine cũ đã trở lại! Đây, lấy cả mặt dây chuyền của tôi nữa! Bây giờ hãy đưa họ đến Reonan và cho anh ấy biết chúng ta đã sẵn sàng đoàn kết!

dialogsDecline.en: Well, whatever you wish, but I don't think we have much time to mess around!
dialogsDecline.ar: Well, whatever you wish, but I don't think we have much time to mess around!
dialogsDecline.br: Bem, leve quando quiser, mas acho que não temos muito tempo para brincar!
dialogsDecline.cns: 好吧，随你怎么想，但我认为我们没有太多的时间来瞎胡闹！
dialogsDecline.de: Nun, was auch immer du wünschst, aber ich glaube nicht, dass wir viel Zeit haben, um herumzualbern!
dialogsDecline.fi: Well, whatever you wish, but I don't think we have much time to mess around!
dialogsDecline.fil: Well, whatever you wish, but I don't think we have much time to mess around!
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous avez l'impression de ne pas être à la hauteur ? Ne dites pas de bêtises.
dialogsDecline.id: Yah, apa pun yang Anda inginkan, tetapi saya rasa kita tidak punya banyak waktu untuk bermain-main!
dialogsDecline.it: Well, whatever you wish, but I don't think we have much time to mess around!
dialogsDecline.jp: む、どうした？　遠慮することはないのだぞ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 뭐, 원하시는 대로 하세요. 하지만 지금은 여유 부릴 시간이 많지 않다고요!

dialogsDecline.sp: Bueno, lo que quieras, ¡pero no creo que tengamos mucho tiempo que perder!
dialogsDecline.sw: Well, whatever you wish, but I don't think we have much time to mess around!
dialogsDecline.th: ดี, สิ่งที่คุณต้องการ แต่ฉันคิดว่าเรามีเวลาไม่มาก!
dialogsDecline.tw: 好吧，隨你決定，但我想我們沒多少時間可以耽擱了！

dialogsComplete.en: Oh! I see you have returned! You come bearing good news I hope?

dialogsBegin.en: We meet again, traveler. We need more help. Rumor has it that the Yetti are becoming more aggressive towards humans. We can't allow this to continue happening.
dialogsBegin.ar: We meet again, traveler. We need more help. Rumor has it that the Yetti are becoming more aggressive towards humans. We can't allow this to continue happening.
dialogsBegin.br: Nos encontramos de novo, viajante. Precisamos de mais ajuda. Há rumores de que os Yetti estão se tornando mais agressivos com os humanos. Não podemos permitir que isso continue acontecendo.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我们又见面了，旅行者。我们需要更多帮助。有传言说，怪力羊对人类的攻击性越来越强。我们不能让这种情况继续发生。
dialogsBegin.de: Wir begegnen einander erneut, Reisender. Wir benötigen mehr Hilfe. Gerüchten zufolge werden die Yetis Menschen gegenüber aggressiver. Wir können nicht zulassen, dass das so weiter geht.
dialogsBegin.fi: We meet again, traveler. We need more help. Rumor has it that the Yetti are becoming more aggressive towards humans. We can't allow this to continue happening.
dialogsBegin.fil: We meet again, traveler. We need more help. Rumor has it that the Yetti are becoming more aggressive towards humans. We can't allow this to continue happening.
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous revoilà, voyageur. Nous avons besoin de plus d'aide. Une rumeur circule, selon laquelle les Yétis deviennent de plus en plus agressifs. Cela ne peut continuer.
dialogsBegin.id: Kita bertemu lagi, musafir. Kami membutuhkan lebih banyak bantuan. Rumor mengatakan bahwa Yetti menjadi lebih agresif terhadap manusia. Kami tidak bisa membiarkan ini terus terjadi.
dialogsBegin.it: We meet again, traveler. We need more help. Rumor has it that the Yetti are becoming more aggressive towards humans. We can't allow this to continue happening.
dialogsBegin.jp: イエティが人間に対してより攻撃的になっているという噂があります。これ以上続くようだと、私たちにも被害が出ると思うんです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 또 만났네요, 여행자님. 도움이 더 필요해요. 예티가 인간에게 더 공격적으로 덤빈다는 소문을 들었어요. 이대로 두고 볼 순 없어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: We meet again, traveler. We need more help. Rumor has it that the Yetti are becoming more aggressive towards humans. We can't allow this to continue happening.
dialogsBegin.pl: We meet again, traveler. We need more help. Rumor has it that the Yetti are becoming more aggressive towards humans. We can't allow this to continue happening.
dialogsBegin.ru: We meet again, traveler. We need more help. Rumor has it that the Yetti are becoming more aggressive towards humans. We can't allow this to continue happening.
dialogsBegin.sp: Nos volvemos a encontrar, viajero. Necesitamos tu ayuda. Se rumorea que los Yetti se están volviendo más agresivos con los humanos. No podemos permitir que esto siga pasando.
dialogsBegin.sw: We meet again, traveler. We need more help. Rumor has it that the Yetti are becoming more aggressive towards humans. We can't allow this to continue happening.
dialogsBegin.th: เจอกันอีกแล้วนักเดินทาง เราต้องการความช่วยเหลือเพิ่มเติม มีข่าวลือว่า Yetti ก้าวร้าวต่อมนุษย์มากขึ้น เราไม่สามารถปล่อยให้สิ่งนี้เกิดขึ้นต่อไปได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 我們又見面了，旅行者，我們需要更多幫助。有傳言說雪人對人類的攻擊性越來越強。我們不能讓這種情況繼續發生。
dialogsBegin.vi: Chúng ta gặp lại nhau, du khách. Chúng tôi cần thêm sự giúp đỡ. Có tin đồn rằng Yetti đang trở nên hung dữ hơn đối với con người. Chúng tôi không thể cho phép điều này tiếp tục xảy ra.

dialogsBegin.en: Will you lend me a hand once more, traveler?
dialogsBegin.ar: Will you lend me a hand once more, traveler?
dialogsBegin.br: Você pode me dar uma mão mais uma vez, viajante?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你能再帮我一次吗，旅行者？

dialogsBegin.jp: もう一度手を貸してくれませんか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 한 번 더 도와주시겠어요, 여행자님?

dialogsBegin.pl: Will you lend me a hand once more, traveler?
dialogsBegin.ru: Will you lend me a hand once more, traveler?

dialogsBegin.tw: 你能再幫我一次，旅行者？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn sẽ giúp tôi một tay chứ, du khách?

dialogsBegin.en: Ahh the Pendant. When Sury left it to me a long time ago, I kept it in a barren desert, untraversed by man.
dialogsBegin.ar: Ahh the Pendant. When Sury left it to me a long time ago, I kept it in a barren desert, untraversed by man.
dialogsBegin.br: Ahhh o Pingente. Quando Sury o deixou para mim há muito tempo, eu o guardei em um deserto árido, não atravessado pelo homem.
dialogsBegin.cns: 啊，吊坠。很久以前，叙里把它留给我时，我把它放在一片荒芜的沙漠中。
dialogsBegin.de: Ahh der Anhänger. Als Sury ihn mir vor langer Zeit hinterließ, bewahrte ich ihn in einer kargen Wüste auf, die von Menschen nicht durchquert wurde.
dialogsBegin.fi: Ahh the Pendant. When Sury left it to me a long time ago, I kept it in a barren desert, untraversed by man.
dialogsBegin.fil: Ahh the Pendant. When Sury left it to me a long time ago, I kept it in a barren desert, untraversed by man.
dialogsBegin.fr: Arf, elle veut son pendentif… Il va y avoir un petit souci dans ce cas.
dialogsBegin.id: Ahh liontin itu. Ketika Sury menyerahkannya kepada saya sejak lama, saya menyimpannya di gurun tandus, tidak terlacak oleh manusia.
dialogsBegin.it: Ahh the Pendant. When Sury left it to me a long time ago, I kept it in a barren desert, untraversed by man.
dialogsBegin.jp: ペンダントのことですよね……。ああ、私は何とシュリ様にお詫びをすればよいのでしょう。未開の地にある砂漠に置いたんです......。
dialogsBegin.kr: 아아, 그 펜던트요. 오래전 슈리님께서 제게 펜던트를 맡기셨을 때, 사람이 오가지 않는 황량한 사막에 숨겨두었어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Ahh the Pendant. When Sury left it to me a long time ago, I kept it in a barren desert, untraversed by man.
dialogsBegin.pl: Ahh the Pendant. When Sury left it to me a long time ago, I kept it in a barren desert, untraversed by man.
dialogsBegin.ru: Ahh the Pendant. When Sury left it to me a long time ago, I kept it in a barren desert, untraversed by man.
dialogsBegin.sp: Ahh el Colgante. Cuando Sury me lo dejó hace mucho tiempo, lo guardé en un desierto árido por donde no había pasado nadie.
dialogsBegin.sw: Ahh the Pendant. When Sury left it to me a long time ago, I kept it in a barren desert, untraversed by man.
dialogsBegin.th: อ่าาา เรื่องจี้ Sury ไปจากฉันเป็นเวลานานมากแล้ว แต่ฉันก็ยังเก็บมันไว้ในทะเลทรายที่แห้งแล้ง
dialogsBegin.tw: 以前修利大人交付墜飾給我時，我把墜飾保管在人煙罕至的荒涼沙漠裡。
dialogsBegin.vi: Ahh Mặt dây chuyền. Khi Sury để lại nó cho tôi cách đây rất lâu, tôi đã giữ nó trong một sa mạc cằn cỗi, không được con người chăm sóc.

dialogsBegin.en: Unfortunately at some point, Chimeradons came to discover it and took it for their own. Since then, I have been unable to locate it…
dialogsBegin.ar: Unfortunately at some point, Chimeradons came to discover it and took it for their own. Since then, I have been unable to locate it…
dialogsBegin.br: Infelizmente, em algum momento, Quimeradons descobriram e o levaram. Desde então não consigo localizar...
dialogsBegin.cns: 不幸的是，在某个时候，变种蝙蝠们发现了它并将其据为己有。从那以后，我一直找不到它……
dialogsBegin.de: Leider entdeckten es irgendwann Chimeradons und machten es sich zu eigen. Seitdem habe ich es nicht mehr finden können...
dialogsBegin.fi: Unfortunately at some point, Chimeradons came to discover it and took it for their own. Since then, I have been unable to locate it…
dialogsBegin.fil: Unfortunately at some point, Chimeradons came to discover it and took it for their own. Since then, I have been unable to locate it…
dialogsBegin.fr: Après qu'elle me l'a donné, je me suis faite attaquer et des Kimeradons l'ont dérobé.
dialogsBegin.id: Sayangnya pada titik tertentu, Chimeradons datang untuk menemukannya dan mengambilnya sendiri. Sejak itu, saya tidak dapat menemukannya ...
dialogsBegin.it: Unfortunately at some point, Chimeradons came to discover it and took it for their own. Since then, I have been unable to locate it…
dialogsBegin.jp: ごめんなさい、実を言うと以前、デッドウィルダニスを訪れた時、ペンダントを保管していたバッグごと盗賊に盗まれ、それがアバドンの餌食となってしまったのです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 하지만 안타깝게도, 키메라돈이 펜던트를 발견하고 가져가 버렸어요. 그 이후로는 찾을 수가 없었죠...
dialogsBegin.nl: Unfortunately at some point, Chimeradons came to discover it and took it for their own. Since then, I have been unable to locate it…
dialogsBegin.pl: Unfortunately at some point, Chimeradons came to discover it and took it for their own. Since then, I have been unable to locate it…
dialogsBegin.ru: Unfortunately at some point, Chimeradons came to discover it and took it for their own. Since then, I have been unable to locate it…
dialogsBegin.sp: Desafortunadamente, uno de los Chimeradons lo descubrió y se lo quedo. Desde entonces no he podido localizarlo…
dialogsBegin.sw: Unfortunately at some point, Chimeradons came to discover it and took it for their own. Since then, I have been unable to locate it…
dialogsBegin.th: น่าเสียดายที่จะพบ Chimeradons ได้บางจุด ฉันไม่สามารถหาตำแหน่งได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 不幸的是，在某個時候，變種蝙蝠俠發現了它並將其據為己有。從那以後，我一直找不到它……
dialogsBegin.vi: Thật không may tại một thời điểm nào đó, Chimeradons đã phát hiện ra và giữ lấy nó cho riêng mình. Kể từ đó, tôi đã không thể tìm thấy được…

dialogsBegin.en: Could you please find the pendant for me?
dialogsBegin.ar: Could you please find the pendant for me?
dialogsBegin.br: Você poderia, por favor, encontrar o pingente para mim?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你能帮我找回吊坠吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Könnten Sie bitte den Anhänger für mich finden?
dialogsBegin.fi: Could you please find the pendant for me?
dialogsBegin.fil: Could you please find the pendant for me?
dialogsBegin.fr: Je n'ai pas réussi à le leur reprendre mais vous qui êtes si plein de ressources devriez pouvoir y arriver.
dialogsBegin.id: Bisakah Anda menemukan liontin itu untuk saya?
dialogsBegin.it: Could you please find the pendant for me?
dialogsBegin.jp: このようなお願いは大変恐縮ですが、どうかペンダントを取り返して頂けませんか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 모험가님께서 그 팬던트를 제 대신 구해와 주시겠습니까?
dialogsBegin.nl: Could you please find the pendant for me?
dialogsBegin.pl: Could you please find the pendant for me?
dialogsBegin.ru: Could you please find the pendant for me?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Podrías encontrar el colgante por mí?
dialogsBegin.sw: Could you please find the pendant for me?
dialogsBegin.th: คุณช่วยหาจี้ให้ฉันได้ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 冒險家大人可以代替我，去把那個墜飾找回來嗎？雖然我也想去，但是這裡的事情很忙所以沒有辦法…
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có thể vui lòng tìm cho tôi mặt dây chuyền được không?

dialogsAccept.en: Thank you for your assistance. I feel that the pendant is currently being held by a Chimeradon. Please reclaim it from him then show me so I may rest assured it is returned.
dialogsAccept.ar: Thank you for your assistance. I feel that the pendant is currently being held by a Chimeradon. Please reclaim it from him then show me so I may rest assured it is returned.
dialogsAccept.br: Obrigado pela sua ajuda. Eu sinto que o pingente está atualmente nas mãos de um Quimeradon. Por favor, recupere dele e me mostre para que eu possa ter certeza de que foi devolvido.
dialogsAccept.cns: 谢谢你的帮助。我觉得这个项链被变种蝙蝠拿走了，请从他那里收回，然后给我。
dialogsAccept.de: Ich danke Dir für Deine Hilfe. Ich habe das Gefühl, dass der Anhänger derzeit von einem Chimeradon gehalten wird. Bitte fordert ihn von ihm zurück und zeigt ihn mir, damit ich sicher sein kann, dass er zurückgegeben wird.
dialogsAccept.fi: Thank you for your assistance. I feel that the pendant is currently being held by a Chimeradon. Please reclaim it from him then show me so I may rest assured it is returned.
dialogsAccept.fil: Thank you for your assistance. I feel that the pendant is currently being held by a Chimeradon. Please reclaim it from him then show me so I may rest assured it is returned.
dialogsAccept.fr: Je suis persuadée que c'est un Kimeradon qui l'a.
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih atas bantuan Anda. Saya merasa liontin itu saat ini dipegang oleh Chimeradon. Tolong reklamasi darinya kemudian tunjukkan kepada saya sehingga saya dapat yakin itu dikembalikan.
dialogsAccept.it: Thank you for your assistance. I feel that the pendant is currently being held by a Chimeradon. Please reclaim it from him then show me so I may rest assured it is returned.
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとうございます。ペンダントはアバドンがバッグごと持って行きました。彼らは砂漠を寝床にしていると思います。
dialogsAccept.kr: 도와주셔서 고맙습니다. 펜던트는 키메라돈이 들고 있을 것 같은데... 펜던트를 되찾아 와서 제게 보여주시면 안심이 될 것 같네요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Thank you for your assistance. I feel that the pendant is currently being held by a Chimeradon. Please reclaim it from him then show me so I may rest assured it is returned.
dialogsAccept.pl: Thank you for your assistance. I feel that the pendant is currently being held by a Chimeradon. Please reclaim it from him then show me so I may rest assured it is returned.
dialogsAccept.ru: Thank you for your assistance. I feel that the pendant is currently being held by a Chimeradon. Please reclaim it from him then show me so I may rest assured it is returned.
dialogsAccept.sp: Gracias por tu ayuda. Creo que el colgante está en manos de un Chimeradon. Por favor, recupéralo y tráemelo para que pueda descansar sabiendo que se ha recuperado.
dialogsAccept.sw: Thank you for your assistance. I feel that the pendant is currently being held by a Chimeradon. Please reclaim it from him then show me so I may rest assured it is returned.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอบคุณสำหรับความช่วยเหลือ. ฉันรู้สึกว่าจี้อยู่ที่ Chimeradon กรุณาทวงคืนจากเขาแล้วแสดงให้ฉันเห็น ฉันมั่นใจว่าคุณจะกลับมา
dialogsAccept.tw: 謝謝你的幫助。我覺得這個吊墜目前正被一隻變種蝙蝠俠所持有。請從他那裡收回它然後給我看，這樣我就可以放心它會被退回。
dialogsAccept.vi: Cám ơn sự giúp đỡ của bạn. Tôi cảm thấy rằng mặt dây chuyền hiện đang được giữ bởi một Chimeradon. Vui lòng đòi lại nó từ sinh vật đó và cho tôi xem để tôi có thể yên tâm rằng nó sẽ được hoàn trả.

dialogsDecline.en: Please find the pendant. I feel it is partly my responsibility for the pendants disappearance…
dialogsDecline.ar: Please find the pendant. I feel it is partly my responsibility for the pendants disappearance…
dialogsDecline.br: Por favor, encontre o pingente. Eu sinto que em parte é minha responsabilidade pelo desaparecimento dos pingentes…
dialogsDecline.cns: 请找到这个吊坠。我觉得我对吊坠的失踪要负部分责任...
dialogsDecline.de: Bitte finden Sie den Anhänger. Ich fühle mich für das Verschwinden des Anhängers mitverantwortlich...
dialogsDecline.fi: Please find the pendant. I feel it is partly my responsibility for the pendants disappearance…
dialogsDecline.fil: Please find the pendant. I feel it is partly my responsibility for the pendants disappearance…
dialogsDecline.fr: Mais Sury a besoin de ce pendentif !!!
dialogsDecline.id: Silakan temukan liontinnya. Saya merasa itu sebagian tanggung jawab saya atas hilangnya liontin ...
dialogsDecline.it: Please find the pendant. I feel it is partly my responsibility for the pendants disappearance…
dialogsDecline.jp: 私が悪いんですが、、取り返してくださいませんか。ああ……私はどのようにシュリ様にお詫びをすれば……。
dialogsDecline.kr: 펜던트를 찾아주세요. 펜던트가 사라진 데는 부분적으로 제 책임도 있는 것 같아서...
dialogsDecline.nl: Please find the pendant. I feel it is partly my responsibility for the pendants disappearance…
dialogsDecline.pl: Please find the pendant. I feel it is partly my responsibility for the pendants disappearance…
dialogsDecline.ru: Please find the pendant. I feel it is partly my responsibility for the pendants disappearance…
dialogsDecline.sp: Por favor, encuentra el colgante. Siento que es en parte mi responsabilidad por la desaparición de los colgantes...
dialogsDecline.sw: Please find the pendant. I feel it is partly my responsibility for the pendants disappearance…
dialogsDecline.th: ช่วยค้นหาจี้ที ฉันรู้สึกว่ามันเป็นความรับผิดชอบส่วนหนึ่งของฉัน เพราะฉันทำมันหายไป...
dialogsDecline.tw: 要是墜飾不見了，修利大人就…
dialogsDecline.vi: Vui lòng tìm mặt dây chuyền. Tôi cảm thấy đó là một phần trách nhiệm của tôi đối với sự biến mất của mặt dây chuyền này…

dialogsComplete.en: You have returned. I hope you have succeeded in acquiring the pendant.
dialogsComplete.ar: You have returned. I hope you have succeeded in acquiring the pendant.
dialogsComplete.br: Você retornou. Espero que tenha conseguido recuperar o pingente.
dialogsComplete.cns: 你回来了，我希望你已经成功地找到了吊坠。
dialogsComplete.de: Ihr seid zurückgekehrt. Ich hoffe, es ist dir gelungen, den Anhänger zu erwerben.
dialogsComplete.fi: You have returned. I hope you have succeeded in acquiring the pendant.
dialogsComplete.fil: You have returned. I hope you have succeeded in acquiring the pendant.
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh vous l'avez trouvé, Bubble soit loué !
dialogsComplete.id: Anda telah kembali. Saya harap Anda telah berhasil mendapatkan liontin itu.
dialogsComplete.it: You have returned. I hope you have succeeded in acquiring the pendant.
dialogsComplete.jp: おお、これは確かにペンダントです！　本当にありがとうございます！ああ、本当に良かった。
dialogsComplete.kr: 돌아오셨군요. 부디 펜던트를 손에 넣으셨길 바랍니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: You have returned. I hope you have succeeded in acquiring the pendant.
dialogsComplete.pl: You have returned. I hope you have succeeded in acquiring the pendant.
dialogsComplete.ru: You have returned. I hope you have succeeded in acquiring the pendant.
dialogsComplete.sp: Has vuelto. Tengo la esperanza de que hayas conseguido el colgante.
dialogsComplete.sw: You have returned. I hope you have succeeded in acquiring the pendant.
dialogsComplete.th: คุณกลับมาแล้ว! ฉันหวังว่าคุณจะหาจี้ได้สำเร็จนะ
dialogsComplete.tw: 謝謝你幫我拿回來。真的是很謝謝。
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn đã trở lại. Tôi hy vọng bạn đã thành công trong việc mua lại mặt dây chuyền.

dialogsFail.en: The pendant is currently held by a Chimeradon. Go and retrieve it from his undeserving hands!
dialogsFail.ar: The pendant is currently held by a Chimeradon. Go and retrieve it from his undeserving hands!
dialogsFail.br: O pingente está atualmente mantido por um Quimeradon. Vá encontrá-lo e recupere o pingente de suas garras indignas!
dialogsFail.cns: 该吊坠目前被变种蝙蝠夺走了，请从他那污浊的手中将吊坠拿回来！
dialogsFail.de: Der Anhänger wird derzeit von einem Chimeradon gehalten. Geh und hole ihn aus seinen unwürdigen Händen!
dialogsFail.fi: The pendant is currently held by a Chimeradon. Go and retrieve it from his undeserving hands!
dialogsFail.fil: The pendant is currently held by a Chimeradon. Go and retrieve it from his undeserving hands!
dialogsFail.fr: Commencez à chercher du côté des Kimeradon.
dialogsFail.id: Liontin itu saat ini dipegang oleh chimeradon. Pergi dan ambil dari tangannya yang tidak pantas!
dialogsFail.it: The pendant is currently held by a Chimeradon. Go and retrieve it from his undeserving hands!
dialogsFail.jp: ペンダントはアバドンが持っているはずです。ああ……私はどのようにシュリ様にお詫びをすれば……。
dialogsFail.kr: 팬던트는 키메라돈이 가지고 있습니다. 팬던트를 되찾아오세요!
dialogsFail.nl: The pendant is currently held by a Chimeradon. Go and retrieve it from his undeserving hands!
dialogsFail.pl: The pendant is currently held by a Chimeradon. Go and retrieve it from his undeserving hands!
dialogsFail.ru: The pendant is currently held by a Chimeradon. Go and retrieve it from his undeserving hands!
dialogsFail.sp: El colgante está en manos de un Chimeradon. ¡Ve y recupéralo de sus sucias manos!
dialogsFail.sw: The pendant is currently held by a Chimeradon. Go and retrieve it from his undeserving hands!
dialogsFail.th: ขณะนี้จี้อยู่ที่ Chimeradon ไปจำกัดและเอามาจากมัน
dialogsFail.tw: 該吊墜目前由一隻變種蝙蝠俠持有。去從他不配的手中取回它！
dialogsFail.vi: Mặt dây chuyền hiện đang được giữ bởi một Chimeradon. Đi và lấy nó từ tay của anh ta!

descriptionComplete.de: Du hast Nevil gerettet. Geh und sprich mit ihm.
descriptionComplete.fi: You have saved Nevil. Go and talk to him.
descriptionComplete.fil: Nailigtas mo si Nevil. Kausapin mo siya.
descriptionComplete.fr: Parler à Nevil, le père de Drian, pour s'assurer qu'il va bien
descriptionComplete.id: Kamu telah menyelamatkan Nevil. Pergi dan berbicaralah dengannya.
descriptionComplete.it: You have saved Nevil. Go and talk to him.
descriptionComplete.jp: ドリアンのお父さんであるネビルを救った。ネビルと話してみよう。
descriptionComplete.kr: 네빌을 구했습니다. 가서 그와 대화하세요.

descriptionComplete.pl: Uratowałeś Nevila. Idź i porozmawiaj z nim.
descriptionComplete.ru: Невил освобожден. Стоит поговорить с ним.
descriptionComplete.sp: Has salvado a Nevil. Ve y habla con el.
descriptionComplete.sw: You have saved Nevil. Go and talk to him.
descriptionComplete.th: คุณได้ช่วย Nevil ไว้ เข้าไปคุยกับเขา
descriptionComplete.tw: 把得安的父親藍彼救出來了，向藍彼對話看看好了。
descriptionComplete.vi: Bạn đã cứu Nevil. Đi và nói chuyện với anh ta

dialogsBegin.en: I still have a need for you. Would you help me yet again?
dialogsBegin.ar: I still have a need for you. Would you help me yet again?
dialogsBegin.br: Eu ainda preciso de você. Você poderia me ajudar mais uma vez?
dialogsBegin.cns: 其实......还有一件事情想拜托你，可以帮我救出大牢里的我爸爸吗？拜托啦～
dialogsBegin.de: Entschuldige mein Freund, aber ich habe eine weiteres Anliegen. Würdest du mir erneut helfen?
dialogsBegin.fi: I still have a need for you. Would you help me yet again?
dialogsBegin.fil: Kailangan pa kita. Pwede mo ba ako matulungan ulit?
dialogsBegin.fr: Pour être honnête, j'ai encore une faveur à te demander. Tu as retrouvé la clé de la prison mais... s'il te plaît, va libérer mon père maintenant
dialogsBegin.id: Aku masih membutuhkanmu. Maukah kamu untuk membantuku lagi?
dialogsBegin.it: I still have a need for you. Would you help me yet again?
dialogsBegin.jp: クックックッ、ところで心の友よ！　実は、お願いがもう１つあるんだ。私の代わりに監獄の親父を助けに行ってくれないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 아직 도움이 더 필요해요. 부디 도와주시겠어요?
dialogsBegin.nl: I still have a need for you. Would you help me yet again?
dialogsBegin.pl: Nadal cię potrzebuję. Czy pomożesz mi jeszcze raz?
dialogsBegin.ru: Могу ли я вновь просить тебя о помощи?..
dialogsBegin.sp: Todavía necesito tu ayuda. ¿Me ayudarías una vez más?
dialogsBegin.sw: I still have a need for you. Would you help me yet again?
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันยังอยากให้คุณช่วยอยู่ คุณช่วยฉันอีกครั้งได้มั้ย?
dialogsBegin.tw: 其實…還有一件事情想拜託你，可以幫我救出大牢裡的我爸爸嗎？拜託啦～
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi vẫn cần bạn. Bạn có thể giúp tôi một lần nữa?

dialogsAccept.en: You are a true friend. Take this key and free my father. I am not strong enough. Please.
dialogsAccept.ar: You are a true friend. Take this key and free my father. I am not strong enough. Please.
dialogsAccept.br: Você é um amigo de verdade. Pegue esta chave e liberte meu pai. Não sou forte o bastante. Por favor.
dialogsAccept.cns: 你真是我的好朋友啊！这是大牢的钥匙，帮我就回我爸爸的话，我一定会报答你的.拜托你了。
dialogsAccept.de: Du bist ein echter Freund. Nimm diesen Schlüssel und befreie meinen Vater. Bitte... ich bin einfach nicht stark genug.
dialogsAccept.fi: You are a true friend. Take this key and free my father. I am not strong enough. Please.
dialogsAccept.fil: Ikaw ay isang tunay na kaibigan. Kunin mo ang susi na ito at palayain mo ang aking tatay. Mahina lang ako. Pakiusap.
dialogsAccept.fr: Tu es vraiment extraordinaire ! Prend cette clé et libère mon père sil te plaît. Ensuite, reviens me voir et je te donnerai la récompense que tu mérites.
dialogsAccept.id: Kamu benar-benar teman yang baik. Ambil kunci ini dan bebaskan ayahku. Aku tidak cukup kuat. Tolonglah.
dialogsAccept.it: You are a true friend. Take this key and free my father. I am not strong enough. Please.
dialogsAccept.jp: クックックッ、ありがとう、オマエは本当に友達がいのある奴だ！　この鍵を持って行って、親父を助け出してくれれば、必ず恩返しするぞ。クックックッ。頼んだぞ、友よ！
dialogsAccept.kr: 정말 진정한 친구시군요. 이 열쇠를 가져가서 아버지를 구해주세요. 제 힘만으로는 부족해요. 제발 부탁해요.
dialogsAccept.nl: You are a true friend. Take this key and free my father. I am not strong enough. Please.
dialogsAccept.pl: Jesteś prawdziwym przyjacielem. Weź ten klucz i uwolnij mojego ojca. Nie jestem wystarczająco silny. Proszę.
dialogsAccept.ru: Ты не зря носишь гордое звание человека! Вызволи моего отца из темницы. Сам я не справлюсь.
dialogsAccept.sp: Eres un verdadero amigo. Toma esta llave y libera a mi padre. No soy lo suficientemente fuerte. Por favor.
dialogsAccept.sw: You are a true friend. Take this key and free my father. I am not strong enough. Please.
dialogsAccept.th: คุณคือเพื่อนแท้เลย ใช้กุญแจนี้ปล่อยพ่อฉันให้เป็นอิสระ ฉันยังไม่แข็งแรงพอจะไปช่วยท่าน ขอร้องล่ะ
dialogsAccept.tw: 你真是我的好朋友啊！這是大牢的鑰匙，幫我就回我爸爸的話，我一定會報答你的.拜託你了。
dialogsAccept.vi: Bạn là một người bạn thực sự. Lấy chìa khóa này và giải thoát cho cha tôi. Tôi không đủ mạnh mẽ. Làm ơn.

dialogsDecline.en: You show yourself to be no better than the fiends that imprisoned my father.
dialogsDecline.ar: You show yourself to be no better than the fiends that imprisoned my father.
dialogsDecline.br: Você mostrou que não é melhor que os selvagens que aprisionaram meu pai.
dialogsDecline.cns: 难道人类真的这么不可信任吗？

dialogsDecline.fi: You show yourself to be no better than the fiends that imprisoned my father.
dialogsDecline.fil: Pinapakita mo ang sarili mo na mas malala ka pa sa mga halimaw na nagkulong sa aking tatay.
dialogsDecline.fr: Au final, l'être humain peut s'avérer être un ami pour le meilleur et pour le pire, tu ne penses pas ?
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu menunjukkan dirimu tidak lebih baik dari iblis yang memenjarakan ayahku.
dialogsDecline.it: You show yourself to be no better than the fiends that imprisoned my father.
dialogsDecline.jp: クックックッ、やっぱり人間なんか信用するもんじゃないな。あばよ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신도 제 아버지를 가둔 악당들과 다를 게 없군요.
dialogsDecline.nl: You show yourself to be no better than the fiends that imprisoned my father.
dialogsDecline.pl: Pokazujesz, że nie jesteś lepszy od przyjaciół, którzy uwięzili mojego ojca.
dialogsDecline.ru: Ты ничем не лучше злокозненных свинов.
dialogsDecline.sp: No demuestras ser mejor que los demonios que encarcelaron a mi padre.
dialogsDecline.sw: You show yourself to be no better than the fiends that imprisoned my father.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณแสดงให้เห็นว่าตัวเองไม่ได้ดีไปกว่าพวกมอนสเตอร์ที่ขังพ่อฉันไว้เลย
dialogsDecline.tw: 難道人類真的這麼不可信任嗎？
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn cho thấy mình không tốt hơn những tên yêu quái đã bỏ tù cha tôi.

dialogsFail.en: My father is in a prison on the outskirts of Keakoon village. Please hurry he cannot last much longer.

dialogsFail.sw: My father is in a prison on the outskirts of Keakoon village. Please hurry he cannot last much longer.
dialogsFail.th: พ่อฉันอยู่ในคุกที่ชานเมือง Keakoon ได้โปรดรีบไป เขาคงมีชีวิตอยู่ได้อีกไม่นาน

dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.br: Sua missão foi concluída. Seus pecados foram perdoados.
dialogsComplete.cns: 任务完成，你的罪恶已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Buße getan. Deine Sünden wurden dir vergeben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Questmu telah tercapai. Dosa-dosamu telah diampuni.
dialogsComplete.it: La Missione è terminata. I tuoi peccati sono stati perdonati.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 끝났습니다. 당신의 죄를 용서하지요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Боги одобрили твое деяние и простили тебе грехи.
dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น บาปของคุณได้รับการอภัยแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nhiệm vụ của bạn đã được hoàn thành. Tội lỗi của bạn đã được tha thứ.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: We have very little time. Even as we speak, I can sense the growing darkness around us…
dialogsBegin.ar: We have very little time. Even as we speak, I can sense the growing darkness around us…
dialogsBegin.br: Temos pouco tempo. Mesmo enquanto falamos, posso sentir a crescente escuridão ao nosso redor…
dialogsBegin.cns: 时间越来越紧迫了。即使在我们说话的这小段时间，我都能感觉到黑暗逐渐包围了我们的四周…
dialogsBegin.de: Wir haben sehr wenig Zeit. Selbst während wir sprechen, kann ich die wachsende Dunkelheit um uns herum spüren...
dialogsBegin.fi: We have very little time. Even as we speak, I can sense the growing darkness around us…
dialogsBegin.fil: We have very little time. Even as we speak, I can sense the growing darkness around us…
dialogsBegin.fr: Il reste très peu de temps et je dois rester ici, pour attendre les monstres.
dialogsBegin.id: Kami memiliki sedikit waktu. Bahkan sewaktu kita berbicara, saya dapat merasakan kegelapan yang tumbuh di sekitar kita...
dialogsBegin.it: We have very little time. Even as we speak, I can sense the growing darkness around us…
dialogsBegin.jp: あまり長く待たせても申し訳ないな。
dialogsBegin.kr: 더 이상 지체할 시간이 없겠어. 지금 이 순간에도 어둠의 세력이 우리 주위에 느껴져...
dialogsBegin.nl: We have very little time. Even as we speak, I can sense the growing darkness around us…
dialogsBegin.pl: We have very little time. Even as we speak, I can sense the growing darkness around us…
dialogsBegin.ru: We have very little time. Even as we speak, I can sense the growing darkness around us…
dialogsBegin.sp: Tenemos muy poco tiempo. Incluso mientras hablamos, puedo sentir la creciente oscuridad a nuestro alrededor...
dialogsBegin.sw: We have very little time. Even as we speak, I can sense the growing darkness around us…
dialogsBegin.th: เรามีเวลาน้อยมาก ในขณะที่เราพูด เราสามารถรู้สึกถึงความมืดที่กำลังรายล้อมรอบตัวเรา
dialogsBegin.tw: 已經沒有時間可以耽誤了。就算是只有一天，你可以幫我快一點將墜飾交給雷奧南嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Chúng ta còn rất ít thời gian. Ngay cả khi chúng ta nói chuyện, tôi có thể cảm nhận được bóng tối ngày càng lớn và bao trùm xung quanh…

dialogsAccept.en: Will you bring my pendant to Reonan? Please let him know that the time is now for us to unite.
dialogsAccept.ar: Will you bring my pendant to Reonan? Please let him know that the time is now for us to unite.
dialogsAccept.br: Poderia levar meu pingente para Reonan? Por favor, deixe-o saber que agora é a hora de nos unirmos.
dialogsAccept.cns: 你能把我的吊坠带给瑞尔南吗？请让他知道现在是时候让我们团结起来了。
dialogsAccept.de: Bringst du meinen Anhänger zu Reonan? Bitte lass ihn wissen, dass die Zeit für unsere Vereinigung gekommen ist.
dialogsAccept.fi: Will you bring my pendant to Reonan? Please let him know that the time is now for us to unite.
dialogsAccept.fil: Will you bring my pendant to Reonan? Please let him know that the time is now for us to unite.
dialogsAccept.fr: Allez dire à Reonan que j'attends les monstres de pied ferme.
dialogsAccept.id: Maukah Anda membawa liontin saya ke Reonan? Tolong beri tahu dia bahwa saatnya sekarang bagi kita untuk bersatu.
dialogsAccept.it: Will you bring my pendant to Reonan? Please let him know that the time is now for us to unite.
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとう。レオナンには来るべき時にはすぐに馳せ参じると伝えてくれ。このペンダントを私の代わりにレオナンに渡してくれないか？
dialogsAccept.kr: 이 펜던트를 레오난에게 가져다주겠어? 그리고 레오난에게 이젠 함께할 때라고 전해주면 좋겠어.
dialogsAccept.nl: Will you bring my pendant to Reonan? Please let him know that the time is now for us to unite.
dialogsAccept.pl: Will you bring my pendant to Reonan? Please let him know that the time is now for us to unite.
dialogsAccept.ru: Will you bring my pendant to Reonan? Please let him know that the time is now for us to unite.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¿Le llevarás mi colgante a Reonan? Por favor, hazle saber que ahora es el momento de unirnos.
dialogsAccept.sw: Will you bring my pendant to Reonan? Please let him know that the time is now for us to unite.
dialogsAccept.th: คุณจะนำจี้ของฉันไปให้ Reonan เหรอ? โปรดแจ้งให้เขาทราบว่าถึงเวลาแล้วที่เราต้องรวมตัวกัน
dialogsAccept.tw: 可以把我的墜飾帶給雷奧南嗎？請告訴他，我們團結的時候到了。
dialogsAccept.vi: Bạn sẽ mang mặt dây chuyền của tôi đến Reonan chứ? Xin hãy cho anh ấy biết rằng bây giờ là lúc chúng ta phải đoàn kết lại.

dialogsDecline.en: Now that you have the pendant, hurry and give it to Reonan!
dialogsDecline.ar: Now that you have the pendant, hurry and give it to Reonan!
dialogsDecline.br: Agora que você tem o pingente, apresse-se e mostre para Reonan!
dialogsDecline.cns: 现在你拿到了吊坠，请尽快交给瑞尔南。
dialogsDecline.de: Jetzt, wo du den Anhänger hast, musst du dich beeilen und ihn Reonan geben!
dialogsDecline.fi: Now that you have the pendant, hurry and give it to Reonan!
dialogsDecline.fil: Now that you have the pendant, hurry and give it to Reonan!
dialogsDecline.fr: Non, vous ne pouvez pas attendre ici pour me voir combattre !!

dialogsDecline.it: Now that you have the pendant, hurry and give it to Reonan!
dialogsDecline.jp: いやいや、これは君にしか頼めないのだ。できるだけ急いでほしい！
dialogsDecline.kr: 팬던트를 빨리 레오난에게 전해줘!!
dialogsDecline.nl: Now that you have the pendant, hurry and give it to Reonan!
dialogsDecline.pl: Now that you have the pendant, hurry and give it to Reonan!
dialogsDecline.ru: Now that you have the pendant, hurry and give it to Reonan!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Ahora que tienes el colgante, date prisa y dáselo a Reonan!
dialogsDecline.sw: Now that you have the pendant, hurry and give it to Reonan!
dialogsDecline.th: ตอนนี้คุณมีจี้แล้ว รีบนำไปมอบให้ Reonan!
dialogsDecline.tw: 既然拿到墜飾了，就快把它交給雷奧南！
dialogsDecline.vi: Bây giờ bạn đã có mặt dây chuyền, hãy nhanh tay trao nó cho Reonan nhé!

dialogsComplete.en: Ahh this is Sury's pendant! The time has once again come that we rise to the challenge before us! With allies like you by our side, we will be prepared for challenges Shade presents us with!
dialogsComplete.ar: Ahh this is Sury's pendant! The time has once again come that we rise to the challenge before us! With allies like you by our side, we will be prepared for challenges Shade presents us with!
dialogsComplete.br: Magnífico! Esse é o pingente da Sury! Mais uma vez chegou a hora de enfrentarmos o desafio diante de nós! Com aliados como você ao nosso lado, estaremos preparados para os desafios que Shade nos apresentará!
dialogsComplete.cns: 啊，这是叙里的吊坠！是时候正面迎接我们面前的挑战了！有你们这样的盟友在身边，我们就能做好万全的准备来迎接挑战！
dialogsComplete.de: Ahh, das ist der Anhänger von Sury! Es ist wieder einmal an der Zeit, dass wir uns der Herausforderung stellen, die vor uns liegt! Mit Verbündeten wie euch an unserer Seite werden wir auf die Herausforderungen, die Shade uns stellt, vorbereitet sein!
dialogsComplete.fi: Ahh this is Sury's pendant! The time has once again come that we rise to the challenge before us! With allies like you by our side, we will be prepared for challenges Shade presents us with!
dialogsComplete.fil: Ahh this is Sury's pendant! The time has once again come that we rise to the challenge before us! With allies like you by our side, we will be prepared for challenges Shade presents us with!
dialogsComplete.fr: Parfait, vous avez joué un rôle très important, vous êtes un peu un héros dans votre genre.
dialogsComplete.id: Ahh ini liontin Sury! Waktunya sekali lagi telah tiba bahwa kita bangkit menghadapi tantangan di hadapan kita! Dengan sekutu seperti Anda di sisi kami, kami akan siap menghadapi tantangan yang diberikan Shade kepada kami!
dialogsComplete.it: Ahh this is Sury's pendant! The time has once again come that we rise to the challenge before us! With allies like you by our side, we will be prepared for challenges Shade presents us with!
dialogsComplete.jp: お、お前さん。ついにやったな！我々は挑戦するのだ！これで八人全員と連絡が取れるようになったぞ！
dialogsComplete.kr: 오오! 이건 슈리의 팬던트가 아닌가! 드디어 다시 한번 도전에 맞설 때가 왔군! 자네와 함께라면 쉐이드에 대비할 수 있을 것 같군!
dialogsComplete.nl: Ahh this is Sury's pendant! The time has once again come that we rise to the challenge before us! With allies like you by our side, we will be prepared for challenges Shade presents us with!
dialogsComplete.pl: Ahh this is Sury's pendant! The time has once again come that we rise to the challenge before us! With allies like you by our side, we will be prepared for challenges Shade presents us with!
dialogsComplete.ru: Ahh this is Sury's pendant! The time has once again come that we rise to the challenge before us! With allies like you by our side, we will be prepared for challenges Shade presents us with!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Ahh, este es el colgante de Sury! ¡Una vez más, ha llegado el momento de enfrentarnos al desafío que se nos presenta! ¡Con aliados como tú a nuestro lado, estamos listos para los desafíos que Shade tenga preparados!
dialogsComplete.sw: Ahh this is Sury's pendant! The time has once again come that we rise to the challenge before us! With allies like you by our side, we will be prepared for challenges Shade presents us with!
dialogsComplete.th: อ่า นี่เป็นจี้ของ Sury! เวลาได้มาอีกครั้งที่เราเพิ่มขึ้นเพื่อความท้าทายก่อนที่เรา! กับพันธมิตรเช่นคุณโดยด้านข้างของเรา เราจะเตรียมไว้สำหรับความท้าทาย Shade นำเสนอเราด้วย!
dialogsComplete.tw: 喔喔！這個不是最後的英雄墜飾嗎！終於所有的英雄們都可以團圓了。真的是辛苦你了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Ahh đây là mặt dây chuyền của Sury! Đã đến lúc một lần nữa chúng ta phải vượt lên thử thách trước mắt! Với những đồng minh như bạn ở bên cạnh, chúng tôi sẽ chuẩn bị sẵn sàng cho những thử thách mà Shade đưa ra!
