description.id: Buru Keakoon dan dapatkan semua ketiga kunci penjaranya.
description.it: Hunt Keakoon and get all 3 pieces of the prison key.
description.jp: 見張りのキクンが持っている ＜ネヴィルの鍵の破片＞ を三種類集めよう。
description.kr: 키쿤을 사냥하고 감옥 열쇠 3조각을 전부 모으세요.
description.nl: Hunt Keakoon and get all 3 pieces of the prison key.
description.pl: Upoluj Keakoony i zdobądź wszystkie 3 części klucza do więzienia.
description.ru: Нужно отобрать три части ключа у злокозненных свинов.
description.sp: Derrota a los Kaekoons y consigue los 3 trozos de la llave de la prisión.
description.sw: Hunt Keakoon and get all 3 pieces of the prison key.
description.th: ล่า Keakoon และจะได้รับกุญแจคุก 3 ชิ้น
description.tw: 獵殺奇昆後，蒐集 3 塊不同的鑰匙片回來。
description.vi: Săn Keakoon và lấy cả 3 mảnh chìa khóa nhà tù.

descriptionComplete.en: You have delivered all the pieces of the key but it looks like he still has something to say.
descriptionComplete.ar: You have delivered all the pieces of the key but it looks like he still has something to say.
descriptionComplete.br: Você entregou todos os pedaços da chave, mas parece que ele ainda tem algo a dizer.
descriptionComplete.cns: 搜集到3块钥匙了，他好像还有些话想对我说的感觉呢...
descriptionComplete.de: Du hast alle Teile des Schlüssels übergeben. Es scheint jedoch, als hätte er noch immer etwas zu sagen.
descriptionComplete.fi: You have delivered all the pieces of the key but it looks like he still has something to say.
descriptionComplete.fil: Naibigay mo lahat ng tatlong piraso ng susi, ngunit mukhang may sasabihin pa siya.
descriptionComplete.fr: Rapporter les 3 fragments de clé obtenus à Drian
descriptionComplete.id: Kamu telah mengirimkan semua kuncinya tetapi sepertinya ada hal yang masih ingin dia katakan.
descriptionComplete.it: You have delivered all the pieces of the key but it looks like he still has something to say.
descriptionComplete.jp: ＜ネヴィルの鍵の破片＞ を集めてドリアンに渡してあげた。何かもっとあるはずだけど…？
descriptionComplete.kr: 열쇠 조각을 전부 가져왔으나, 그는 무언가 할 말이 더 있는 듯합니다.
descriptionComplete.nl: You have delivered all the pieces of the key but it looks like he still has something to say.
descriptionComplete.pl: Dostarczyłeś wszystkie kawałki klucza, ale wygląda na to, że wciąż ma coś do powiedzenia.
descriptionComplete.ru: Три части ключа собраны. Похоже, надо поговорить с Драйном.
descriptionComplete.sp: Has entregado todos las trozos de la llave pero parece que todavía tiene algo que decir.
descriptionComplete.sw: You have delivered all the pieces of the key but it looks like he still has something to say.
descriptionComplete.th: คุณได้ส่งกุญแจทุกชิ้นแล้ว แต่ดูเหมือนว่าเขายังมีอะไรจะพูด
descriptionComplete.tw: 蒐集到 3 塊鑰匙了，他好像還有些話想對我說的感覺呢…
descriptionComplete.vi: Bạn đã giao tất cả các mảnh của chìa khóa nhưng có vẻ như anh ấy vẫn còn điều gì đó để nói

dialogsBegin.en: I am Drian son of Nevil, great chief of the original Keakoon. We were once friendly with the humans.
dialogsBegin.ar: I am Drian son of Nevil, great chief of the original Keakoon. We were once friendly with the humans.
dialogsBegin.br: Sou Drian, filho de Nevil, o grande chefe da Keakoon original. Já fomos amigáveis com os seres humanos.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我是奇昆族族长蓝彼的儿子德里安.呵呵～我们奇昆族在很久以前与人类相处的很好呢～
dialogsBegin.de: Ich bin Drian, Sohn des Nevil, großer Häuptling der Keakoon. Wir waren den Menschen einst freundlich gesinnt.
dialogsBegin.fi: I am Drian son of Nevil, great chief of the original Keakoon. We were once friendly with the humans.
dialogsBegin.fil: Ako si Drian anak ni Nevil, kapitan ng orihinal na Keakoon. Kami ay palakaibigan dati sa mga tao.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je suis le fils de Nevil, qui était le Grand Chef des Keakoons. Nous étions amicaux envers les êtres humains.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku Drian putra Nevil, kepala agung dari Keakoon asli. Kami pernah bersahabat dengan manusia.
dialogsBegin.it: Sono Drian, figlio di Nevil, grande capo dell'originale Keakoon. Una volta eravamo amichevoli con gli umani.
dialogsBegin.jp: 俺はキクン族の大族長ネビルの息子ドリアンだ！　クックックッ。　まあ、怖がるなよ。俺たちキクン族は、かつて人間達とは仲良くやっていたんだぜ。クックックッ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 저는 드리안, 최초 키쿤의 대추장 네빌의 아들입니다. 우리도 한때는 인간들과 우호적으로 지냈어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I am Drian son of Nevil, great chief of the original Keakoon. We were once friendly with the humans.
dialogsBegin.pl: Jestem Drian, syn Nevila, wielki wódz oryginalnego Keakoon. Kiedyś przyjaźniliśmy się z ludźmi.
dialogsBegin.ru: Я Драйн, сын Невила, великого вождя благородных хряков. Наш народ жил в дружбе с вашим народом.
dialogsBegin.sp: Soy Drian hijo de Nevil, gran jefe de los Keakoon originales. Una vez fuimos amigos de los humanos.
dialogsBegin.sw: I am Drian son of Nevil, great chief of the original Keakoon. We were once friendly with the humans.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันคือ Drian บุตรของ Nevil หัวหน้าผู้ยิ่งใหญ่ของ Keakoon ดั้งเดิม ครั้งหนึ่งเราเคยเป็นมิตรกับมนุษย์
dialogsBegin.tw: 我是奇昆王族的族長藍彼的兒子.呵呵～我們奇昆族在很久以前與人類相處的很好呢～
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi là Drian con trai của Nevil, thủ lĩnh vĩ đại của Keakoon chính gốc. Chúng tôi đã từng thân thiện với con người.

dialogsBegin.en: We helped humans develop the mine long ago but when they left some of us were locked up by a new breed of Keakoons.
dialogsBegin.ar: We helped humans develop the mine long ago but when they left some of us were locked up by a new breed of Keakoons.
dialogsBegin.br: Ajudamos os humanos a desenvolverem a mina há muito tempo. Porém, quando eles se foram, alguns de nós foram aprisionados por uma nova raça de Keakoons.
dialogsBegin.cns: 当时、矿山正在开发，与人类相处的很好。可是我们现在离开了人类，过着很悲惨的生活。
dialogsBegin.de: Wir haben Menschen vor langer Zeit geholfen, diese Mine zu bauen. Als sie uns aber verließen, wurden wir von einer neuen Keakoon-Rasse eingesperrt.
dialogsBegin.fi: We helped humans develop the mine long ago but when they left some of us were locked up by a new breed of Keakoons.
dialogsBegin.fil: Tinulungan namin ang mga tao na itayo ang minahan noong unang panahon, ngunit noong sila ay lumisan, kami ay kinulong ng bagong lahi ng Keakoons.
dialogsBegin.fr: Nous avons aidé les humains à creuser la mine, mais nous sommes devenus si malheureux après leur départ...
dialogsBegin.id: Kami membantu manusia untuk mengembangkan tambang sejak zaman dahulu tetapi mereka pergi beberapa dari kami dikurung oleh generasi baru Keakoon.
dialogsBegin.it: Abbiamo aiutato gli umani a sviluppare la miniera molto tempo fa, ma quando se ne sono andati alcuni di noi sono stati rinchiusi da una nuova razza di Keakoon.
dialogsBegin.jp: 鉱山を開発し始めた頃は、俺たちと人間が協力して、このあたりも発展したものだったが、人間がこの土地を離れてしまってから、こんな惨めなありさまだ。クックックッ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 오래전, 우리는 인간들이 광산을 개발할 수 있도록 도와줬어요. 하지만 인간들이 떠난 뒤, 새로운 키쿤 무리가 나타나 우리를 가두었죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: We helped humans develop the mine long ago but when they left some of us were locked up by a new breed of Keakoons.
dialogsBegin.pl: Dawno temu pomogliśmy ludziom rozwinąć kopalnię, ale kiedy odeszli, niektórzy z nas zostali zamknięci przez nową rasę Keakoonów.
dialogsBegin.ru: Давным-давно мы помогли вам вырыть эту шахту. Но потом люди ушли, а вместо них пришли злокозненные свины. Они схватили отца и увели его прочь.
dialogsBegin.sp: Ayudamos a los humanos a desarrollar la mina hace mucho tiempo, pero cuando se fueron, algunos de nosotros fuimos encerrados por una nueva raza de Keakoons.
dialogsBegin.sw: We helped humans develop the mine long ago but when they left some of us were locked up by a new breed of Keakoons.
dialogsBegin.th: เมื่อนานมาแล้วเราช่วยพวกมนุษย์พัฒนาเหมือง แต่พอพวกเขาจากไป พวกเราบางคนก็ถูกกักขังโดย Keakoons สายพันธุ์ใหม่
dialogsBegin.tw: 當時、礦坑正在開發，與人類相處的很好。可是我們現在離開了人類，過著很悲慘的生活。
dialogsBegin.vi: Chúng tôi đã giúp con người phát triển hầm mỏ từ lâu nhưng khi họ rời đi, một số người trong chúng tôi đã bị nhốt bởi một giống Keakoons mới.

dialogsBegin.en: My father is old and cannot last much longer in his prison. Please help me rescue him.
dialogsBegin.ar: My father is old and cannot last much longer in his prison. Please help me rescue him.
dialogsBegin.br: Meu pai já está velho e não poderá suportar muito mais tempo em sua prisão. Ajude-me a resgatá-lo.
dialogsBegin.cns: 而且我老爸现在年纪也不少了，可是在牢里受困，你可以救出我的爸爸吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Meinen Vater ist alt und hält nicht mehr lange in Gefangenschaft durch.Bitte hilf mir, ihn zu retten.
dialogsBegin.fi: My father is old and cannot last much longer in his prison. Please help me rescue him.
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang tatay ko ay matanda na at di na magtatagal sa kanyang kulungan. Tulungan mo ako iligtas siya.
dialogsBegin.fr: Mon père se retrouve dans une situation extrêmement triste, car il vit des moments très difficiles en prison, surtout vu son grand âge. S'il te plaît, aide-moi et sauve-le.
dialogsBegin.id: Ayahku sudah tua dan tidak bisa bertahan terlalu lama lagi dipenjara. Bantu aku untuk menyelamatkannya.
dialogsBegin.it: Mio padre è vecchio e non può durare ancora a lungo nella sua prigione. Per favore, aiutami a salvarlo.
dialogsBegin.jp: 族長だった俺の親父は、人間と仲良くすることに反感を持っていた一味の罠にはめられて、今では監獄へ閉じ込められてしまった…。オマエ、俺の親父を助けてくれないか？　クックックッ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 특히 아버지는 나이도 많은데 감옥에서 고초가 심하다. 인간아 우리 아버지 구하는 것을 도와줄 수 있냐? 크킁~
dialogsBegin.nl: My father is old and cannot last much longer in his prison. Please help me rescue him.
dialogsBegin.pl: Mój ojciec jest stary i nie może dłużej wytrzymać w więzieniu. Proszę pomóż mi go uratować.
dialogsBegin.ru: Отец уже стар. В плену он зачахнет. Ты поможешь мне спасти его?
dialogsBegin.sp: Mi padre es viejo y no podrá aguantar mucho más en su prisión. Por favor, ayúdame a rescatarlo.
dialogsBegin.sw: My father is old and cannot last much longer in his prison. Please help me rescue him.
dialogsBegin.th: พ่อฉันแก่แล้ว ท่านอยู่ในคุกต่อไปไม่ไหวแล้ว ช่วยฉันช่วยพ่อด้วยเถอะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 而且我老爸現在年紀也不少了，可是在牢裡受困，你可以救出我的爸爸嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Cha tôi đã già và không thể ở trong tù được bao lâu nữa. Xin hãy giúp tôi giải cứu ông ấy

dialogsAccept.en: The key to the cell where my father is being kept has three pieces. These false Keakoons are inside, keeping them hidden. Go and bring them to me.
dialogsAccept.ar: The key to the cell where my father is being kept has three pieces. These false Keakoons are inside, keeping them hidden. Go and bring them to me.
dialogsAccept.br: A chave para a cela onde meu pai está preso tem três partes. Esses falsos Keakoons estão aí dentro, mantendo-as escondidas. Vá e traga-as para mim.
dialogsAccept.cns: 关押我父亲的牢房的钥匙有三片，被假奇昆们藏起来了。去把它们带给我吧。
dialogsAccept.de: Der Schlüssel zur Zelle meines Vaters besteht aus drei Teilen. Diese falschen Keakoons halten sie unter Verschluss. Geh und bring sie mir!
dialogsAccept.fi: The key to the cell where my father is being kept has three pieces. These false Keakoons are inside, keeping them hidden. Go and bring them to me.
dialogsAccept.fil: Ang susi sa kulungan kung saan nakakulong ang tatay ko ay mayroong tatlong piraso. Ang mga pekeng Keakoons ay nasa loob, tinatago ito. Dalihin mo ito sa akin.
dialogsAccept.fr: Il nous faut la clé permettant d'ouvrir les portes de la prison où est retenu mon père. Par sécurité, les Keakoons ont brisé la clé en 3 fragments, conservés par certains d'entre eux… S'il te plaît, pars vite à leur recherche !
dialogsAccept.id: Kunci sel tempat aku disimpan ada tiga bagian. Keakoon palsu ini ada di dalam, menyembunyikannya. Pergi dan bawa mereka padaku.
dialogsAccept.it: The key to the cell where my father is being kept has three pieces. These false Keakoons are inside, keeping them hidden. Go and bring them to me.
dialogsAccept.jp: 親父が閉じ込められている監獄の扉を開くには、鍵が必要なんだ。だが、見張りのキクンたちが、その鍵をわざわざ三つに分けて保管しているんだ。それを持ってきてくれないか？　クックックッ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 아버지가 갇혀 계시는 감옥의 열쇠는 3조각으로 나뉘어 있어요. 안쪽의 나쁜 키쿤들이 잘 숨기고 있죠. 가서 열쇠를 찾아주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: The key to the cell where my father is being kept has three pieces. These false Keakoons are inside, keeping them hidden. Go and bring them to me.
dialogsAccept.pl: Klucz do celi, w której przetrzymywany jest mój ojciec, ma trzy części. Te fałszywe Keakony są w środku, ukrywając ich. Idź i przynieś mi je.
dialogsAccept.ru: Ключ от темницы, где держат моего отца, разломан на три части. Злокозненные свины спрятали их у себя. Иди и принеси их мне.
dialogsAccept.sp: La llave de la celda dónde estoy atrapado está dividida en tres trozos. Estos Keakoons falsos están adentro, manteniéndolos ocultos. Ve y tráemelos.
dialogsAccept.sw: The key to the cell where my father is being kept has three pieces. These false Keakoons are inside, keeping them hidden. Go and bring them to me.
dialogsAccept.th: กุญแจไปห้องขังพ่อฉันที่ถูกเก็บไว้มี 3 ชิ้น Keakoon พวกนี้เอาไปซ่อนไว้ข้างใน หาให้เจอ แล้วเอามาให้ฉัน
dialogsAccept.tw: 為了打開大牢的門，需要一把鑰匙，可是住在裡面的那些奇昆把鑰匙分成 3 塊保管著。你可以幫我拿到那 3 塊分開的鑰匙嗎？
dialogsAccept.vi: Chìa khóa phòng giam nơi cha tôi đang bị giam giữ có ba mảnh. Những Keakoon giả này ở bên trong, giấu chúng đi. Đi và mang chúng cho tôi.

dialogsDecline.en: How could you? To think I thought to count you as a friend.
dialogsDecline.ar: How could you? To think I thought to count you as a friend.
dialogsDecline.br: Como você pôde...? E pensar que eu via você como um amigo.
dialogsDecline.cns: 你怎么能这样？我竟然还把你当朋友。
dialogsDecline.de: Wie kannst du nur...?! Ich dachte, ich kann auf dich zählen.
dialogsDecline.fi: How could you? To think I thought to count you as a friend.
dialogsDecline.fil: How could you? To think I thought to count you as a friend.
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu es un menteur ! Je pensais être ton ami !!!
dialogsDecline.id: Bagaimana bisa? Tidak kusangka aku berpikir untuk menganggapmu sebagai teman.
dialogsDecline.it: How could you? To think I thought to count you as a friend.
dialogsDecline.jp: そうか、人間はみんなそうやって去っていけばいいさ。クックックッ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 어떻게 그런 짓을? 전 당신을 친구로 생각했었는데.
dialogsDecline.nl: How could you? To think I thought to count you as a friend.
dialogsDecline.pl: Keakoon Mine (1)
dialogsDecline.ru: Как же так?.. А я-то считал тебя другом.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Cómo pudiste…? Y pensar que te quería como un amigo.
dialogsDecline.sw: How could you? To think I thought to count you as a friend.
dialogsDecline.th: อย่าบอกนะว่า…? คุณคิดว่าฉันจะนับว่าคุณเป็นเพื่อนแล้วงั้นเรอะ
dialogsDecline.tw: 你怎麼能這樣？我還以為能把你當成朋友。
dialogsDecline.vi: Làm sao bạn có thể…? Vậy mà tôi nghĩ tôi có thể xem bạn là một người bạn.

dialogsComplete.en: Oh… Thank you… so much. I could never repay you fully. Thank you so much.
dialogsComplete.ar: Oh… Thank you… so much. I could never repay you fully. Thank you so much.
dialogsComplete.br: Oh… muito… obrigado. Nunca poderei pagar pelo que você me fez. Muito obrigado.
dialogsComplete.cns: 呜...呜...真的谢谢你啊～
dialogsComplete.de: Oh... Ich danke dir... so sehr. Ich kann das niemals wieder gut machen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Oh… Thank you… so much. I could never repay you fully. Thank you so much.
dialogsComplete.fil: Oh… Thank you… so much. I could never repay you fully. Thank you so much.
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh ! Merci (versant des larmes) ! Merci infiniment pour ton aide.
dialogsComplete.id: Oh…Terima kasih…banyak. Aku tidak akan pernah bisa membalasmu. Terima kasih banyak.
dialogsComplete.it: Oh… Thank you… so much. I could never repay you fully. Thank you so much.
dialogsComplete.jp: あぁ..なんといったらよいか...。ありがとう。ほんとうにありがとう。心からありがとう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 오... 정말... 감사합니다. 이 빚을 어떻게 갚아야 할지. 정말 고마워요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Oh… Thank you… so much. I could never repay you fully. Thank you so much.
dialogsComplete.pl: Oh...Dziękuję bardzo. Nigdy Ci za to nie wynagrodzę. Bardzo dziękuję.
dialogsComplete.ru: Ох… Спасибо тебе… огромное. Я никогда не смогу отплатить тебе сполна. Спасибо тебе, друг.
dialogsComplete.sp: Oh... Muchas... gracias. Nunca podría pagarte por todo. Muchas gracias.
dialogsComplete.sw: Oh… Thank you… so much. I could never repay you fully. Thank you so much.
dialogsComplete.th: โอ้ ขอบคุณมาก ฉันไม่รู้จะตอบแทนคุณยังไงให้สมกับการช่วยเหลือ แต่ก็ขอบคุณมาก
dialogsComplete.tw: 喔……真的非常感謝你……我無法完全報答你的恩情。真的非常謝謝你。
dialogsComplete.vi: Ồ...Cảm ơn bạn...rất nhiều. Ơn này tôi không bao giờ có thể báo đáp được hết cho bạn. Cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều

dialogsFail.en: You have to gather all three pieces of the Key.
dialogsFail.ar: You have to gather all three pieces of the Key.
dialogsFail.br: Você terá que juntar os três pedaços da Chave.
dialogsFail.cns: 3块钥匙片长的不同，所以你要得到3块不同的钥匙块才可以，谢谢你啦～
dialogsFail.de: Du musst alle drei Teile des Schlüssels finden.
dialogsFail.fi: You have to gather all three pieces of the Key.
dialogsFail.fil: Kailangan mo kunin ang lahat ng tatlong piraso ng susi.
dialogsFail.fr: Tu dois trouver les 3 morceaux de la clé. Ça ne sera pas simple !
dialogsFail.id: Kamu harus mengumpulkan ketiga keping Kunci tersebut.
dialogsFail.it: You have to gather all three pieces of the Key.
dialogsFail.jp: 鍵の欠片は、三つそれぞれが全部違うんだ。クックックッ。大変だろうが、頼んだぞ、友よ！
dialogsFail.kr: 세 조각의 열쇠를 전부 모아야 해요.
dialogsFail.nl: You have to gather all three pieces of the Key.
dialogsFail.pl: Musisz zebrać wszystkie trzy części Klucza.
dialogsFail.ru: Нужно собрать три части ключа.
dialogsFail.sp: Tienes que conseguir los tres trozos de la Llave.
dialogsFail.sw: You have to gather all three pieces of the Key.
dialogsFail.th: คุณต้องรวบรวมกุญแจทั้งสามชิ้น
dialogsFail.tw: 3 塊鑰匙片長的不同，所以你要得到 3 塊不同的鑰匙塊才可以，謝謝你啦～
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn phải thu thập tất cả ba mảnh của Chìa khóa.

name.jp: ゼンマイ仕掛けの心臓
name.th: หัวใจที่อ่อนแอ

description.en: Helena wants $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

description.en: Locate the Feather of Magic Power and present it to Cuzrill, the Elementor Wiseman near the Fountain of Dead person in Flaris.
description.ar: Locate the Feather of Magic Power and present it to Cuzrill, the Elementor Wiseman near the Fountain of Dead person in Flaris.
description.br: Você deve encontrar a Pena do Poder Mágico em algum lugar de Magmient, Darkon 3, onde vivem as Luias. Visite então Cuzrill, o sábio Elementor. Ele fica na Fonte das Pessoas Mortas, na parte norte das Montanhas Leren.
description.cns: 请先去达肯第3地区美格米昂的赤焰凤凰栖息地，取得魔力羽毛，再把它拿给可滋利！
description.de: Du musst die Feather of Magic Power, die irgendwo in Magmient Darkon3 versteckt ist, finden. Die Luias leben dort. Dann besuche Cuzrill, den Elementor Weisen. Er steht an der Quelle der verstorbenen Seelen im Norden des Leren Gebirges.
description.fi: Locate the Feather of Magic Power and present it to Cuzrill, the Elementor Wiseman near the Fountain of Dead person in Flaris.
description.fil: Locate the Feather of Magic Power and present it to Cuzrill, the Elementor Wiseman near the Fountain of Dead person in Flaris.
description.fr: Retrouver la Plume de Lillip perdue à Darkon 3, dans la zone de Magmient, puis la rapporter au Sage des Elémentalistes Cuzrill, à la Fontaine des Défunts de Flaris.
description.id: Temukan Feather of Magic Power dan berikan kepada Cuzrill, Elementor Wiseman di dekat Fountain of Dead person in Flaris.
description.it: Locate the Feather of Magic Power and present it to Cuzrill, the Elementor Wiseman near the Fountain of Dead person in Flaris.
description.jp: ダーコン第3地区（マグミアント）のルイア棲息地で魔力増加の羽飾りを取り戻してから、フラリスの魂の泉にいるエレメンター賢者カズリルに持っていってください。
description.kr: 마력 증가 깃털을 찾고, 플라리스 망자의 샘 근처에 있는 엘리멘터 현자 커즈릴님에게 전달하세요.
description.nl: Locate the Feather of Magic Power and present it to Cuzrill, the Elementor Wiseman near the Fountain of Dead person in Flaris.
description.pl: Locate the Feather of Magic Power and present it to Cuzrill, the Elementor Wiseman near the Fountain of Dead person in Flaris.
description.ru: Нужно найти Волшебное перо и отнести его старейшине факиров Казрелу к фонтану Мертвеца во Фларинции.
description.sp: Localiza la Pluma del Poder Mágico y dásela a Cuzrill, el Sabio Elementor cerca del Manantial de Almas en Flaris.
description.sw: Locate the Feather of Magic Power and present it to Cuzrill, the Elementor Wiseman near the Fountain of Dead person in Flaris.
description.th: ค้นหา Feather of Magic Power และนำไปให้ Cuzrill Elementer Wiseman ใกล้ Fountain of Dead คนใน Flaris
description.tw: 請先去得肯第三區美格米特的赤焰鳳凰棲息地，取得魔力羽毛，再把它拿給可滋利！
description.vi: Tìm Feather of Magic Power và đưa nó cho Cuzrill, Elementor Wiseman gần Fountain of Dead Person ở Flaris.

dialogsBegin.en: Here is your Letter of Recommendation. This shows that the master recognizes your potential. Do not lose this document.
dialogsBegin.ar: Here is your Letter of Recommendation. This shows that the master recognizes your potential. Do not lose this document.
dialogsBegin.br: Esta é a carta de recomendação que mostra que o mestre o reconhece como um sucessor. Por favor, proteja-a com sua vida. Se você perdê-la, não poderá provar que é reconhecido.
dialogsBegin.cns: 这推廌书表示首领认定继承者的能力，若没有推荐书认定形同无效，所以，要好好保管！！
dialogsBegin.de: Dieses Empfehlungsschreiben beweist, dass dich der Meister als Nachfolger akzeptiert hat. Bitte beschütze es mit deinem Leben. Wenn du ihn verlierst, kannst du nicht beweisen, dass du anerkannt wurdest.

dialogsBegin.th: นี่คือจดหมายแนะนำของคุณ นี่แสดงให้เห็นว่าเจ้านายตระหนักถึงศักยภาพของคุณ อย่าทำเอกสารหายล่ะ

dialogsBegin.fr: Mais avant d'aller t'adresser à Cuzrill, j'aimerais que tu retrouves la Plume de Lillip qui a été égarée après la Grande Guerre.
dialogsBegin.id: Setelah kamu menemukan bulunya, berikan kepada Cuzrill, Elementor Wiseman di dekat Fountain of Dead person in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.it: Once you've located the feather, present it to Cuzrill, the Elementor Wiseman near the Fountain of Dead person in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.jp: あ、その前にダーコン第3地区（マグミアント）のルイア棲息地で魔力増加の羽飾りを獲得してください。それを持ってカズリルに会ってください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 깃털을 찾으면, 플라리스 망자의 샘 근처에 있는 엘리멘터 현자 커즈릴님께 가져가세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Once you've located the feather, present it to Cuzrill, the Elementor Wiseman near the Fountain of Dead person in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.pl: Once you've located the feather, present it to Cuzrill, the Elementor Wiseman near the Fountain of Dead person in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.ru: Отнеси перо старейшине факиров Казрелу. Его можно найти у фонтана Мертвеца во Фларинции. Справишься?
dialogsBegin.sp: Una vez que hayas localizado la Pluma, llévasela a Cuzrill, el Sabio Elementor cerca del Manantial de Almas en Flaris.
dialogsBegin.sw: Once you've located the feather, present it to Cuzrill, the Elementor Wiseman near the Fountain of Dead person in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.th: เมื่อคุณได้พบกับขนแล้ว นำไปให้ Cuzrill Elementor Wiseman ใกล้ Fountain of Dead ใน Flaris
dialogsBegin.tw: 請先去得肯第三區美格米特的赤焰鳳凰棲息地取得魔力羽毛，再把它拿給可滋利。
dialogsBegin.vi: Khi bạn đã định vị được feather, hãy đưa nó cho Cuzrill, Elementor Wiseman ở gần Fountain of Dead Person ở Flaris.

dialogsAccept.en: I pray the mercy of Lillip will always be with you.
dialogsAccept.ar: I pray the mercy of Lillip will always be with you.
dialogsAccept.br: Desejo que a piedade de Lillip esteja sempre com você.
dialogsAccept.cns: 莉莉普与你同在，他会祝福你的！
dialogsAccept.de: Ich wünsche dir , das die Gnade von Lillip ewig mit dir ist.
dialogsAccept.fi: I pray the mercy of Lillip will always be with you.
dialogsAccept.fil: I pray the mercy of Lillip will always be with you.
dialogsAccept.fr: On raconte qu'elle serait dans la zone de Magmient à Darkon 3.
dialogsAccept.id: Aku berdoa rahmat Lilip akan selalu bersamamu.
dialogsAccept.it: I pray the mercy of Lillip will always be with you.
dialogsAccept.jp: リリプ様の知恵が共にありますように。
dialogsAccept.kr: 릴립의 자비가 늘 당신과 함께하길...
dialogsAccept.nl: I pray the mercy of Lillip will always be with you.
dialogsAccept.pl: I pray the mercy of Lillip will always be with you.
dialogsAccept.ru: Да пребудет с тобой милость Гэндальфи.
dialogsAccept.sp: Rezo para que la misericordia de Lillip esté siempre contigo.
dialogsAccept.sw: I pray the mercy of Lillip will always be with you.
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันภาวนาขอให้ความเมตตาของ Lillip อยู่กับคุณเสมอ
dialogsAccept.tw: 黎利與你同在，他會祝福你的！
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi cầu nguyện lòng nhân từ của Lillip sẽ luôn ở bên bạn.

dialogsDecline.en: Don't underestimate yourself, Magician. The path is meant to be difficult. Let me know if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ar: Don't underestimate yourself, Magician. The path is meant to be difficult. Let me know if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.br: Não se subestime. Você deve ser forte, ou não poderá se tornar um sucessor.
dialogsDecline.cns: 你觉得你的智慧不足吗?不会的！！你的能力已经够好了！请好好接受试炼的挑战吧！
dialogsDecline.de: Unterschätze dich nicht selbst. Du musst stark sein oder du wirst niemals ein Nachfolger.
dialogsDecline.fi: Don't underestimate yourself, Magician. The path is meant to be difficult. Let me know if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fil: Don't underestimate yourself, Magician. The path is meant to be difficult. Let me know if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fr: Ne sous-estime jamais tes capacités ! Tu dois être fort, ou tu ne deviendras jamais un Héros.
dialogsDecline.id: Jangan meremehkan diri sendiri, Penyihir. Jalan itu dimaksudkan untuk menjadi sulit. Beri tahu saya jika kamu berubah pikiran.
dialogsDecline.it: Don't underestimate yourself, Magician. The path is meant to be difficult. Let me know if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.jp: あなたの知恵は十分ですよ、既にその資格を認められてるのですから。もっと自信をもって！
dialogsDecline.kr: 자신을 과소평가하지 마세요, 매지션님. 원래 힘든 길이에요. 마음이 바뀌면 말씀해 주세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Don't underestimate yourself, Magician. The path is meant to be difficult. Let me know if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.pl: Don't underestimate yourself, Magician. The path is meant to be difficult. Let me know if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ru: Ты недооцениваешь свои силы. Этот путь сложен, но тебе он по плечу. Приходи, если передумаешь.
dialogsDecline.sp: No te subestimes, Magician. El camino está destinado a ser difícil. Hazme saber si cambias de opinión.
dialogsDecline.sw: Don't underestimate yourself, Magician. The path is meant to be difficult. Let me know if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.th: อย่าประเมินตัวเองต่ำไป Magician เส้นทางนี้เป็นเรื่องยาก แจ้งให้เราทราบหากคุณเปลี่ยนใจ
dialogsDecline.tw: 你覺得你的智慧不足嗎？不會的！！你的能力已經夠好了！請好好接受試煉的挑戰吧！
dialogsDecline.vi: Đừng đánh giá thấp bản thân, Magician. Con đường dường như khó khăn. Hãy cho tôi biết nếu bạn thay đổi ý định.

dialogsComplete.en: An, yes. The Feather of Magic power! It is said that this was crafted by Lillip and made from the feather of a Luia. It can double your magic power.
dialogsComplete.ar: An, yes. The Feather of Magic power! It is said that this was crafted by Lillip and made from the feather of a Luia. It can double your magic power.
dialogsComplete.br: Ha ha ha. Você a encontrou! Ha ha ha. Essa é uma ferramenta mágica de Lillip, que foi feita com penas de Luia. Ela aumenta em duas vezes o poder mágico.
dialogsComplete.cns: 呵呵呵！！找到了！听说英雄战争时，莉莉普使用羽毛制作的魔法道具，能增加魔法力约200%！
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast sie gefunden! Das ist ein sehr mysteriöses Magiewerkzeug von Lillip, welches sie aus der Feder eines Luia erstellt hat. Sie verstärkt die magische Kraft fast um das Doppelte.
dialogsComplete.fi: An, yes. The Feather of Magic power! It is said that this was crafted by Lillip and made from the feather of a Luia. It can double your magic power.
dialogsComplete.fil: An, yes. The Feather of Magic power! It is said that this was crafted by Lillip and made from the feather of a Luia. It can double your magic power.
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh ! C'est... c'est la plume de puissance magique que portait Lillip pendant la Grande Guerre ! Où l'as-tu retrouvé ?!
dialogsComplete.id: Sebuah, ya. Feather of Magic power! Dikatakan bahwa ini dibuat oleh Lillip dan terbuat dari bulu Luia. Itu bisa menggandakan kekuatan sihirmu.
dialogsComplete.it: An, yes. The Feather of Magic power! It is said that this was crafted by Lillip and made from the feather of a Luia. It can double your magic power.
dialogsComplete.jp: おお、見つけおったのぅ。これはリリプがルイアの羽で作った魔力増幅術具で、自分の魔力を2倍ほど増加させてくれる効果があると言われているんじゃよ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 그래요, 마력 증가 깃털! 릴립이 루이아의 깃털로 만들었다고들 해요. 마력을 두 배로 높여준다고 하더군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: An, yes. The Feather of Magic power! It is said that this was crafted by Lillip and made from the feather of a Luia. It can double your magic power.
dialogsComplete.pl: An, yes. The Feather of Magic power! It is said that this was crafted by Lillip and made from the feather of a Luia. It can double your magic power.
dialogsComplete.ru: А, Волшебное перо! Перо лавлина, заговоренное самим Гэндальфи! Оно вдвое усиливает магические способности.
dialogsComplete.sp: Ah, sí. ¡La Pluma del Poder Mágico! Se dice que fue creada por Lillip y hecha con una pluma de Luia. Puede duplicar tu poder mágico.
dialogsComplete.sw: An, yes. The Feather of Magic power! It is said that this was crafted by Lillip and made from the feather of a Luia. It can double your magic power.
dialogsComplete.th: ใช่แล้ว Feather of Magic! มีเรื่องเล่าว่านี่เป็นงานฝีมือของ Lillip และทำจากขนนกของ Luia สามารถเพิ่มพลังเวทย์ได้สองเท่า
dialogsComplete.tw: 呵呵呵！！找到了！聽說英雄戰爭時，黎利使用羽毛製作的魔法道具，能增加魔法力約 200%！
dialogsComplete.vi: An, vâng. Feather of Magic power! Người ta nói rằng nó được chế tác bởi Lillip và được làm từ lông của một con Luia. Nó có thể tăng gấp đôi sức mạnh ma thuật của bạn.

dialogsComplete.en: I sure know a lot about it, don't I? Hahaha! Thank you for finding this, Magician.
dialogsComplete.ar: I sure know a lot about it, don't I? Hahaha! Thank you for finding this, Magician.
dialogsComplete.br: Eu com certeza sei muito sobre isso, não é? Hahaha! Obrigado por encontrar isso, Mago(a).
dialogsComplete.cns: 我知道的很多吧！呵呵呵~我很聪明吧！！总之，一切辛苦你了！
dialogsComplete.de: Ich weiß wirklich eine Menge darüber, nicht wahr? Hahaha! Danke, dass Sie das gefunden haben, Magier.
dialogsComplete.fi: I sure know a lot about it, don't I? Hahaha! Thank you for finding this, Magician.
dialogsComplete.fil: I sure know a lot about it, don't I? Hahaha! Thank you for finding this, Magician.
dialogsComplete.fr: Quoi qu'il en soit, j'apprécie vraiment les efforts que tu as fournis pour la retrouver. Merci, merci infiniment !
dialogsComplete.id: Saya yakin tahu banyak tentang itu, bukan? Hahaha! Terima kasih telah menemukan ini, Penyihir.
dialogsComplete.it: I sure know a lot about it, don't I? Hahaha! Thank you for finding this, Magician.
dialogsComplete.jp: どうだ？詳しいじゃろ？カッカッカッ。でもよく見つけたのう、大変じゃっただろ？
dialogsComplete.kr: 저, 생각보다 똑똑하죠? 하하하! 찾아줘서 고마워요, 매지션님.
dialogsComplete.nl: I sure know a lot about it, don't I? Hahaha! Thank you for finding this, Magician.
dialogsComplete.pl: I sure know a lot about it, don't I? Hahaha! Thank you for finding this, Magician.
dialogsComplete.ru: Разумеется, я давно о нем знаю. Я знаю обо всем на свете! Ха-ха! Спасибо за помощь, фокусник.
dialogsComplete.sp: Sé mucho al respecto, ¿o no? ¡Jajaja! Gracias por encontrarla, Magician.
dialogsComplete.sw: I sure know a lot about it, don't I? Hahaha! Thank you for finding this, Magician.
dialogsComplete.th: ฉันแน่ใจว่ารู้มากเกี่ยวกับเรื่องนี้ว่ามั้ย? ฮ่าๆ! ขอบคุณสำหรับการค้นพบนี้ Magician
dialogsComplete.tw: 我知道的很多吧！呵呵呵~我很聰明吧！！總之，一切辛苦你了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi chắc chắn biết rất nhiều về nó, phải không? Hahaha! Cảm ơn bạn đã tìm thấy nó, Magician.

dialogsFail.en: I am just as clever as the Elementor Priest! Maybe I'm even more clever than her! I am surrounded by jealous people!
dialogsFail.ar: I am just as clever as the Elementor Priest! Maybe I'm even more clever than her! I am surrounded by jealous people!
dialogsFail.br: Eu sou tão inteligente quanto a Sacerdotisa Elementora. Talvez eu seja ainda mais inteligente que elas. Mas as pessoas não reconhecem porque têm inveja.
dialogsFail.cns: 我很聪明，跟祭司他们有得比，不过没人肯承认，我想应该是嫉妒吧！呵呵呵！
dialogsFail.de: Ich bin genau so schlau wie der Elementor-Priester! Vielleicht bin ich sogar klüger als sie! Ich bin von neidischen Menschen umgeben!
dialogsFail.fi: I am just as clever as the Elementor Priest! Maybe I'm even more clever than her! I am surrounded by jealous people!
dialogsFail.fil: I am just as clever as the Elementor Priest! Maybe I'm even more clever than her! I am surrounded by jealous people!
dialogsFail.fr: Les âmes de nombreuses personnes vont et viennent ici à la Fontaine des Défunts. C'est ici la limite entre la vie et la mort.
dialogsFail.id: Aku sama pintarnya dengan Elementor Priest! Mungkin aku bahkan lebih pintar darinya! Saya dikelilingi oleh orang-orang yang cemburu!
dialogsFail.it: I am just as clever as the Elementor Priest! Maybe I'm even more clever than her! I am surrounded by jealous people!
dialogsFail.jp: エレメンターのことならわしになんでもきくがいい。司祭様と同じくらい知ってるぞ。カッカッカッ、こんなこといってると、調子に乗るなといわれそうじゃな。カッカッカッ。
dialogsFail.kr: 전 엘리멘터 사제만큼 똑똑해요! 아니, 어쩌면 더 똑똑할지도 모르죠! 다들 절 질투하긴 하지만!
dialogsFail.nl: I am just as clever as the Elementor Priest! Maybe I'm even more clever than her! I am surrounded by jealous people!
dialogsFail.pl: I am just as clever as the Elementor Priest! Maybe I'm even more clever than her! I am surrounded by jealous people!
dialogsFail.ru: Я ничуть не глупее жрицы факиров! А может, и умнее! Но меня окружают завистники!
dialogsFail.sp: ¡Soy tan inteligente como la Sacerdotisa Elementor! ¡Puede que sea incluso más inteligente que ella! ¡Me rodea mucha gente celosa!
dialogsFail.sw: I am just as clever as the Elementor Priest! Maybe I'm even more clever than her! I am surrounded by jealous people!
dialogsFail.th: ฉันฉลาดพอ ๆ กับ Elementor Priest! บางทีฉันอาจฉลาดกว่าเธอ! ฉันล้อมรอบไปด้วยคนขี้อิจฉา!
dialogsFail.tw: 我很聰明，跟祭司他們有得比，不過沒人肯承認，我想應該是嫉妒吧！呵呵呵！
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi cũng thông minh như Elementor Priest! Có lẽ tôi còn thông minh hơn cô ấy! Tôi đang bị mọi người xung quanh ghen tị!

description.cns: 启程去南瓜村然后寻找吉哈娃的儿子，马润。
description.de: Reise nach Pumpkin Town und suche Mayun, den Sohn von Natalie.
description.fi: Travel to Pumpkin Town and search for Mayun, JeongHwa's son.
description.fil: Travel to Pumpkin Town and search for Mayun, JeongHwa's son.

dialogsBegin.en: Hey there, I have a problem. Can you help me?
dialogsBegin.ar: Hey there, I have a problem. Can you help me?
dialogsBegin.br: Ei... Olá... Se tiver tempo, você pode ouvir minha história? Eu realmente preciso que alguém a ouça.
dialogsBegin.cns: 请问，能跟你说说话吗？有些问题我真的不知道该找谁说才好……
dialogsBegin.de: Hey.. Hallo.. Würdest du dir vielleicht meine Geschichte anhören? Ich muss sie unbedingt jemandem erzählen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Hey there, I have a problem. Can you help me?
dialogsBegin.fil: Hey there, I have a problem. Can you help me?
dialogsBegin.fr: Bonjour... Tu pourrais écouter mon histoire si tu as le temps ? J'ai vraiment besoin d'en parler à quelqu'un.
dialogsBegin.id: Hei, aku punya masalah. Bisakah kamu membantuku?
dialogsBegin.it: Hey there, I have a problem. Can you help me?
dialogsBegin.jp: ああ、あの子はどこにいったのかしら？誰か私の息子を見ませんでしたか？お願いです、誰か…。
dialogsBegin.kr: 저기요, 부탁이 하나 있는데요. 도와주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Hey there, I have a problem. Can you help me?
dialogsBegin.pl: Hey there, I have a problem. Can you help me?
dialogsBegin.ru: Прости, можно с тобой поговорить? Ты мне не поможешь?
dialogsBegin.sp: Hola, tengo un problema. ¿Me puedes ayudar?
dialogsBegin.sw: Hey there, I have a problem. Can you help me?
dialogsBegin.th: เฮ้ คุณตรงนั้นน่ะ ฉันมีปัญหานิดหน่อย คุณสามารถช่วยฉันได้ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 請問，能跟你說說話嗎？有些問題我真的不知道該找誰說才好……
dialogsBegin.vi: Này anh bạn, tôi có chút vấn đề. Bạn có thể giúp tôi được chứ?

dialogsBegin.en: Actually I have 2 kids, one daughter and one son. My daughter has gone missing!
dialogsBegin.ar: Actually I have 2 kids, one daughter and one son. My daughter has gone missing!
dialogsBegin.br: Eu tenho 2 filhos, uma menina e um menino. Minha filha desapareceu
dialogsBegin.cns: (叹气~)其实我有两个孩子，姊姊是老大，儿子是老么！不过，我的女儿几年前……
dialogsBegin.de: Nun, ich habe 2 Kinder, eine Tochter und einen Sohn. Meine Tochter ist verschwunden.
dialogsBegin.fi: Actually I have 2 kids, one daughter and one son. My daughter has gone missing!
dialogsBegin.fil: Actually I have 2 kids, one daughter and one son. My daughter has gone missing!
dialogsBegin.fr: (Inspirant profondément) J'ai deux enfants, une fille et un garçon. Ma fille a disparu il y a de cela quelques années avec d'autres enfants...
dialogsBegin.id: Sebenarnya saya punya 2 anak, satu putri dan satu putra. Putri saya telah hilang!
dialogsBegin.it: Actually I have 2 kids, one daughter and one son. My daughter has gone missing!
dialogsBegin.jp: 何年か前、街の子供達が失踪する事件が起きました。それ以来、私の可愛い娘は行方不明のまま……まだ帰ってきていません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 사실 제게는 아이가 둘 있어요. 딸과 아들이요. 그런데 딸아이가 실종됐어요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Actually I have 2 kids, one daughter and one son. My daughter has gone missing!
dialogsBegin.pl: Actually I have 2 kids, one daughter and one son. My daughter has gone missing!
dialogsBegin.ru: У меня было двое детей, сын и дочка. А потом Джун пропала...
dialogsBegin.sp: En realidad tengo 2 hijos, una hija y un hijo. ¡Mi hija ha desaparecido!
dialogsBegin.sw: Actually I have 2 kids, one daughter and one son. My daughter has gone missing!
dialogsBegin.th: ที่จริงแล้วฉันมีลูก 2 คน ลูกสาวหนึ่งคนและลูกชายคนหนึ่ง ลูกสาวของฉันหายตัวไป!
dialogsBegin.tw: (嘆氣~) 其實我有兩個孩子，姊姊是老大，兒子是老么！不過，我的女兒幾年前……
dialogsBegin.vi: Thực ra tôi có 2 đứa con, một con gái và một con trai. Con gái tôi đã mất tích!

dialogsBegin.en: This was several years ago with some other missing children... So, my son is the only child I have left. However today... Today he disappeared too!
dialogsBegin.ar: This was several years ago with some other missing children... So, my son is the only child I have left. However today... Today he disappeared too!
dialogsBegin.br: Há muitos anos, com outras crianças desaparecidas... Então meu filho é a única criança que tenho, mas ele... Hoje ele desapareceu também!! ....
dialogsBegin.cns: This was several years ago with some other missing children... So, my son is the only child I have left. However today... Today he disappeared too!
dialogsBegin.de: Sie verschwand vor einigen Jahren mit anderen Kindern.. Mein Sohn ist mein einziges Kind, aber.. Heute ist auch er verschwunden!!
dialogsBegin.fi: This was several years ago with some other missing children... So, my son is the only child I have left. However today... Today he disappeared too!
dialogsBegin.fil: This was several years ago with some other missing children... So, my son is the only child I have left. However today... Today he disappeared too!
dialogsBegin.fr: Mon fils est le seul enfant qui me reste, mais... Aujourd'hui, lui aussi a disparu !! Je... Je.
dialogsBegin.id: Ini beberapa tahun yang lalu dengan beberapa anak lain yang hilang... Jadi, anakku adalah satu-satunya anak yang tersisa. Namun hari ini... Hari ini dia juga menghilang!!
dialogsBegin.it: This was several years ago with some other missing children... So, my son is the only child I have left. However today... Today he disappeared too!
dialogsBegin.jp: それから今日まで、息子と2人でなんとか耐えてきたのに…。もし息子まで行方不明になってしまったら……。
dialogsBegin.kr: 몇 년 전, 아이들 몇 명이 실종되었어요... 그래서 남은 건 제 아들 하나뿐이었죠. 그런데 오늘... 제 아들까지 사라졌어요!
dialogsBegin.nl: This was several years ago with some other missing children... So, my son is the only child I have left. However today... Today he disappeared too!
dialogsBegin.pl: This was several years ago with some other missing children... So, my son is the only child I have left. However today... Today he disappeared too!
dialogsBegin.ru: This was several years ago with some other missing children... So, my son is the only child I have left. However today... Today he disappeared too!
dialogsBegin.sp: Hace varios años, desaparecieron algunos niños... Así que, mi niño es el único hijo que me queda. Pero hoy... ¡¡Él también ha desaparecido!!
dialogsBegin.sw: This was several years ago with some other missing children... So, my son is the only child I have left. However today... Today he disappeared too!
dialogsBegin.th: เหมือนกับเด็กคนอื่นที่หายไปเมื่อหลายปีก่อน... ตอนนี้ฉันเหลือลูกชายอยู่คนเดียว แต่แล้ววันนี้... เขาก็หายตัวไปด้วย!!
dialogsBegin.tw: 這件事發生在好幾年前，和其他失蹤的孩子有關……所以，我現在只剩下這個兒子了。可是今天……今天他也失蹤了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Việc những đứa trẻ này mất tích đã xảy ra cách đây vài năm rồi ... Con trai tôi là đứa con duy nhất còn lại của tôi. Tuy nhiên hôm nay ... Hôm nay thằng bé cũng biến mất rồi!!

dialogsBegin.en: Both of my kids are now missing. I feel like I can't go on living. Please, will you help me find my son?
dialogsBegin.ar: Both of my kids are now missing. I feel like I can't go on living. Please, will you help me find my son?
dialogsBegin.br: Os meus dois filhos estão desaparecidos. Não consigo mais viver... Por favor, por favor me ajude. Por favor!!
dialogsBegin.cns: 连儿子也失踪了，我真的不知道该怎么活下去了，你能不能帮帮我呀！拜托你！！
dialogsBegin.de: Meine beiden Kinder sind verschollen und so kann ich nicht weiterleben. Bitte.. Bitte, hilf mir. Bitte!!
dialogsBegin.fi: Both of my kids are now missing. I feel like I can't go on living. Please, will you help me find my son?
dialogsBegin.fil: Both of my kids are now missing. I feel like I can't go on living. Please, will you help me find my son?
dialogsBegin.fr: (Les larmes aux yeux) Mes deux enfants ont disparu, je ne pourrai y survivre.. s'il te plaît, s'il te plaît aide-moi!
dialogsBegin.id: Kedua anak saya sekarang hilang. Saya merasa tidak bisa melanjutkan hidup. Tolong, maukah kamu membantu saya menemukan anak saya?
dialogsBegin.it: Both of my kids are now missing. I feel like I can't go on living. Please, will you help me find my son?
dialogsBegin.jp: 私にはもう耐えられません。どうかお願いです、息子を助けてください！繊細な子なんです。きっと一人で不安に震えているはずです！
dialogsBegin.kr: 아이 둘이 전부 실종되다니, 더는 살 힘도 없어요. 제발, 저희 아들을 찾아주실 수 있을까요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Both of my kids are now missing. I feel like I can't go on living. Please, will you help me find my son?
dialogsBegin.pl: Both of my kids are now missing. I feel like I can't go on living. Please, will you help me find my son?
dialogsBegin.ru: Дети мои, дети! Мне больше незачем жить! Ты поможешь мне отыскать Мая?.. Я очень тебя прошу...
dialogsBegin.sp: Ahora mis dos hijos están desaparecidos. No puedo seguir viviendo así. Por favor, ¿me ayudarás a encontrar a mi hijo?
dialogsBegin.sw: Both of my kids are now missing. I feel like I can't go on living. Please, will you help me find my son?
dialogsBegin.th: ลูกทั้งสองของฉันหายไปแล้ว ฉันไม่อยากจะมีชีวิตอยู่อีกต่อไปแล้ว ได้โปรดช่วยฉันหาลูกชายของฉันหน่อยได้ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 連兒子也失蹤了，我真的不知道該怎麼活下去了，你能不能幫幫我呀！拜託你！！
dialogsBegin.vi: Cả hai đứa con của tôi hiện đã mất tích. Tôi cảm thấy mình không thể tiếp tục sống. Làm ơn, giúp tôi tìm ra con trai tôi với?

dialogsAccept.en: You're amazing! My son used to love the Pumpkin Patch. You should start your search there.
dialogsAccept.ar: You're amazing! My son used to love the Pumpkin Patch. You should start your search there.
dialogsAccept.br: Muito obrigada! Acho que talvez você deva procurar pela Vila das Abóboras, porque meu filho sempre teve curiosidade a respeito daquele lugar.
dialogsAccept.cns: 谢谢，我的孩子之前似乎对南瓜村很好奇的样子，或许他有可能会在那里 ……
dialogsAccept.de: Vielen Dank! Ich gaube du solltest das Kürbisdorf überprüfen, weil mein Sohn immer sehr interessiert daran war.
dialogsAccept.fi: You're amazing! My son used to love the Pumpkin Patch. You should start your search there.
dialogsAccept.fil: You're amazing! My son used to love the Pumpkin Patch. You should start your search there.
dialogsAccept.fr: Merci beaucoup ! Je pense que tu devrais aller voir au Village Pumpkin, mon fils a toujours été intrigué par cet endroit.
dialogsAccept.id: Kamu menakjubkan! Anak saya dulu suka Labu Patch. kamu harus memulai pencarianmu di sana.
dialogsAccept.it: You're amazing! My son used to love the Pumpkin Patch. You should start your search there.
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとうございます。あの子は以前から＜カボチャ男爵の居住地＞に行きたがっていました。そこに行けば、会えるかもしれません。
dialogsAccept.kr: 정말 고맙습니다. 저희 아이는 예전부터 펌킨 밭을 무척 좋아했어요. 그곳부터 찾아보시면 좋을 것 같아요.
dialogsAccept.nl: You're amazing! My son used to love the Pumpkin Patch. You should start your search there.
dialogsAccept.pl: You're amazing! My son used to love the Pumpkin Patch. You should start your search there.
dialogsAccept.ru: Спасибо! Май любил играть на тыквенном поле. Начни поиски там.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Eres increíble! A mi hijo le encantaba el Huerto de Calabazas. Deberías comenzar tu búsqueda por allí.
dialogsAccept.sw: You're amazing! My son used to love the Pumpkin Patch. You should start your search there.
dialogsAccept.th: คุณช่างเยี่ยมยอดไปเลย! ลูกชายของฉันชอบไปไร่ฟักทอง คุณควรเริ่มต้นการค้นหาจากที่นั่น
dialogsAccept.tw: 謝謝，我的孩子之前似乎對南瓜村很好奇的樣子，或許他有可能會在那裡……
dialogsAccept.vi: Bạn thật tuyệt vời! Con trai tôi từng rất thích Pumpkin Patch. Bạn nên bắt đầu tìm kiếm ở đó.

dialogsDecline.en: If you will not help me, then I have no other choice…
dialogsDecline.ar: If you will not help me, then I have no other choice…
dialogsDecline.br: Oh, meu Deus... Não consigo mais viver...
dialogsDecline.cns: 我真的不知道要怎么活下去了(哭)……
dialogsDecline.de: Oh mein Gott.. Ich kann so nicht weiterleben..
dialogsDecline.fi: If you will not help me, then I have no other choice…
dialogsDecline.fil: If you will not help me, then I have no other choice…
dialogsDecline.fr: (Pleurant amèrement) Tu es vraiment sans cœur... Et je ne me sens plus la force de vivre à présent...
dialogsDecline.id: Jika kamu tidak membantu saya, maka saya tidak punya pilihan lain ...
dialogsDecline.it: If you will not help me, then I have no other choice…
dialogsDecline.jp: そうですか…娘だけでなく息子まで……私はこれからどうやって生きていけばいいんでしょう……。
dialogsDecline.kr: 도와주시지 않겠다면… 전 어떻게 살아가야 하죠...
dialogsDecline.nl: If you will not help me, then I have no other choice…
dialogsDecline.pl: If you will not help me, then I have no other choice…
dialogsDecline.ru: Что же мне... что же мне делать?..
dialogsDecline.sp: Si no me ayudas, no me quedan más opciones...
dialogsDecline.sw: If you will not help me, then I have no other choice…
dialogsDecline.th: ถ้าคุณไม่ช่วยฉัน ฉันก็ไม่มีทางเลือกอื่นอีกต่อไปแล้ว
dialogsDecline.tw: 我真的不知道要怎麼活下去了 (哭)……
dialogsDecline.vi: Nếu bạn không giúp tôi, thì tôi không còn lựa chọn nào khác…

dialogsComplete.en: Hey, who are you? What? My mom is worried about me? What else is new…? Ugh, fine. I'll go back and let her know I'm okay.
dialogsComplete.ar: Hey, who are you? What? My mom is worried about me? What else is new…? Ugh, fine. I'll go back and let her know I'm okay.
dialogsComplete.br: Hum? Quem é você? O que? Minha mãe mandou você me procurar? Certo, certo. Ela é sempre tão preocupada. Certo, avise para ela que estou bem e voltarei para casa em breve.
dialogsComplete.cns: 咦？你是谁啊？我妈请你来这里找我喔…我妈老是瞎操心，我看我还是先回去得好，那就先这样了，再见~
dialogsComplete.de: Hey, wer bist du? Was ist? Meine Mutter macht sich Sorgen um mich? Was gibt es sonst noch Neues...? Ugh, gut. Ich gehe zurück und sage ihr, dass es mir gut geht.
dialogsComplete.fi: Hey, who are you? What? My mom is worried about me? What else is new…? Ugh, fine. I'll go back and let her know I'm okay.
dialogsComplete.fil: Hey, who are you? What? My mom is worried about me? What else is new…? Ugh, fine. I'll go back and let her know I'm okay.
dialogsComplete.fr: Hein ? Qui es-tu ? Quoi, ma mère t'a envoyé me chercher ? Elle balise toujours pour un rien... Et bien rassure la et dis lui que je serais de retour bientôt. A plus !
dialogsComplete.id: Hei, siapa kamu? Apa? Ibuku mengkhawatirkanku? Apalagi yang baru…? Baik. Saya akan kembali dan memberi tahu dia bahwa saya baik-baik saja.
dialogsComplete.it: Hey, who are you? What? My mom is worried about me? What else is new…? Ugh, fine. I'll go back and let her know I'm okay.
dialogsComplete.jp: 誰？母に頼まれたの？もぅ、ママったら心配性だなぁ。ボクだって一人前の男の子なのに！わたったよ。すぐ戻るって。
dialogsComplete.kr: 어, 누구세요? 네? 엄마가 절 걱정하신다고요? 항상 그런데요. 하아, 알겠어요. 곧 돌아갈게요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Hey, who are you? What? My mom is worried about me? What else is new…? Ugh, fine. I'll go back and let her know I'm okay.
dialogsComplete.pl: Hey, who are you? What? My mom is worried about me? What else is new…? Ugh, fine. I'll go back and let her know I'm okay.
dialogsComplete.ru: Hey, who are you? What? My mom is worried about me? What else is new…? Ugh, fine. I'll go back and let her know I'm okay.
dialogsComplete.sp: Ey ¿Quién eres tú? ¿Qué? ¿Mi mamá está preocupada por mí? ¿Crees que eso es algo nuevo…? Uf, vale. Volveré para que sepa que estoy bien.
dialogsComplete.sw: Hey, who are you? What? My mom is worried about me? What else is new…? Ugh, fine. I'll go back and let her know I'm okay.
dialogsComplete.th: เฮ้ คุณเป็นใคร? อะไรนะ? แม่ของฉันเป็นห่วงฉันงั้นเหรอ? มีอะไรใหม่กว่านี้อีกมั้ย? เฮ้อ ก็ได้ ฉันจะกลับไปเพื่อให้แม่รู้ว่าฉันยังสบายดี
dialogsComplete.tw: 咦？你是誰啊？我媽請你來這裡找我喔…我媽老是瞎操心，我看我還是先回去得好，那就先這樣了，再見~
dialogsComplete.vi: Này bạn là ai? Sao cơ? Mẹ tôi đang rất lo lắng cho tôi? Cái gì mới lạ ...? Ugh, tốt thôi. Tôi sẽ quay lại và cho mẹ tôi biết tôi không sao.

dialogsFail.en: I am just watching those pumpkin heads. Aren't they cool? I wish I had one!
dialogsFail.ar: I am just watching those pumpkin heads. Aren't they cool? I wish I had one!
dialogsFail.br: Só estou vendo aquelas cabeças de abóbora. Não são legais? Eu queria uma para mim...
dialogsFail.cns: 我在这里偷偷观察它们耶！不会觉得很棒吗？尤其是南瓜的头！我真的很想要那个南瓜头耶…
dialogsFail.de: Ich beobachte gerade diese Kürbisköpfe. Sind die nicht cool? Ich wünschte, ich hätte einen!
dialogsFail.fi: I am just watching those pumpkin heads. Aren't they cool? I wish I had one!
dialogsFail.fil: I am just watching those pumpkin heads. Aren't they cool? I wish I had one!
dialogsFail.fr: Je regarde juste ces têtes de citrouille. J'espère que je pourrai en avoir.
dialogsFail.id: Saya hanya menonton kepala labu itu. Bukankah mereka keren? Saya berharap saya punya satu!
dialogsFail.it: I am just watching those pumpkin heads. Aren't they cool? I wish I had one!
dialogsFail.jp: ボクさ、ここでカボチャ達を見てたんだ。イカスだろ。あんなカボチャ頭、ボクも欲しいなぁ。
dialogsFail.kr: 호박을 보고 있었어요. 멋지지 않나요? 저도 하나 갖고 싶은데!
dialogsFail.nl: I am just watching those pumpkin heads. Aren't they cool? I wish I had one!
dialogsFail.pl: I am just watching those pumpkin heads. Aren't they cool? I wish I had one!
dialogsFail.ru: I am just watching those pumpkin heads. Aren't they cool? I wish I had one!
dialogsFail.sp: Solo estoy viendo esas cabezas de calabaza. ¿No son geniales? ¡Ojalá tuviera una!
dialogsFail.sw: I am just watching those pumpkin heads. Aren't they cool? I wish I had one!
dialogsFail.th: ฉันก็แค่เฝ้าพวกหัวฟักทองพวกนี้เท่านั้นเอง เจ๋งมั้ยล่ะ? ฉันอยากจะมีสักอันบ้างจัง!
dialogsFail.tw: 我在這裡偷偷觀察它們耶！不會覺得很棒嗎？尤其是南瓜的頭！我真的很想要那個南瓜頭耶…
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi chỉ đang xem những cái đầu bí ngô kia. Chúng thật tuyệt phải không? Tôi ước gì mình có một cái!

description.en: Defeat 5 Red Bang Troupe Members, 1 Red Bang Troupe Leader, and retrieve 7 Symbols of the Red bang Troupe.
description.ar: Defeat 5 Red Bang Troupe Members, 1 Red Bang Troupe Leader, and retrieve 7 Symbols of the Red bang Troupe.
description.br: Por favor, derrote todos eles e me traga uma prova. Isso é tudo que quero.
description.cns: 把他们全部灭杀之后，拿证据给我看就可以了。
description.de: Bitte beseitige jeden einzelnen von ihnen und bringe mir den Beweis. Das ist alles.
description.fi: Defeat 5 Red Bang Troupe Members, 1 Red Bang Troupe Leader, and retrieve 7 Symbols of the Red bang Troupe.
description.fil: Defeat 5 Red Bang Troupe Members, 1 Red Bang Troupe Leader, and retrieve 7 Symbols of the Red bang Troupe.
description.fr: S'il te plaît, bat-les tous et rapporte-moi une preuve. C'est tout ce que je veux.
description.id: Kalahkan 5 Red Bang Troupe Members, 1 Red Bang Troupe Leader, dan ambil 7 Simbol Red bang Troupe.
description.it: Defeat 5 Red Bang Troupe Members, 1 Red Bang Troupe Leader, and retrieve 7 Symbols of the Red bang Troupe.
description.jp: 赤いヴァン盗賊団の野営地に向かい、連中をやっつけよう。首尾よくやっつけたら、証拠の品を持ってルダのところへ戻ろう。
description.kr: 레드 뱅 도적단원 5명과 레드 뱅 도적 대장 1명을 처치하고, 레드 뱅 도적단의 문양 7개를 회수하세요.
description.nl: Defeat 5 Red Bang Troupe Members, 1 Red Bang Troupe Leader, and retrieve 7 Symbols of the Red bang Troupe.
description.pl: Defeat 5 Red Bang Troupe Members, 1 Red Bang Troupe Leader, and retrieve 7 Symbols of the Red bang Troupe.
description.ru: Нужно победить пятерых "товарищей", главаря труппы и принести Людору семь значков.
description.sp: Derrota a 5 Miembros de los Bangs Rojos, a 1 Líder de los Bangs Rojos y consigue 7 Símbolos de los Bangs Rojos.
description.sw: Defeat 5 Red Bang Troupe Members, 1 Red Bang Troupe Leader, and retrieve 7 Symbols of the Red bang Troupe.
description.th: จัดการ Red Bang Members 5 ตัว Red Bang Leader 1 ตัว และนำสัญลักษณ์ของ Red Bang Troupe 7 อันกลับมา
description.tw: 擊敗 5 名紅色崩崩團員和 1 名紅色崩崩團長，並取得 7 個紅色崩崩團標誌。
description.vi: Đánh bại 5 thành viên của Red Bang Troupe, 1 thủ lĩnh của Red Bang Troupe và lấy lại 7 biểu tượng của Red Bang Troupe.

dialogsBegin.en: I will never forgive them for what they have done. I'm literally fuming with anger right now!
dialogsBegin.ar: I will never forgive them for what they have done. I'm literally fuming with anger right now!
dialogsBegin.br: Eu nunca os perdoarei! Como eles podem insultar minha família...
dialogsBegin.cns: 我真的不能原谅他们，欺负我都不够..还要把我们家..
dialogsBegin.de: (macht eine Faust) Ich werde ihnen nie vergeben! Wie können die nur meine Familie beleidigen.
dialogsBegin.fi: I will never forgive them for what they have done. I'm literally fuming with anger right now!
dialogsBegin.fil: I will never forgive them for what they have done. I'm literally fuming with anger right now!
dialogsBegin.fr: (Serrant le poing) Je ne les oublierai jamais! Comment ont-ils pu salir l'honneur de ma famille..
dialogsBegin.id: Saya tidak akan pernah memaafkan mereka atas apa yang telah mereka lakukan. Aku benar-benar marah dengan kemarahan sekarang!
dialogsBegin.it: I will never forgive them for what they have done. I'm literally fuming with anger right now!
dialogsBegin.jp: もう勘弁ならない！俺は断じてこいつらを許さないぞ。家宝を奪い、嫌がらせを繰り返すばかりかうちまで壊していったんだ。おかげさまで家の中はめちゃめちゃだよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 도적단이 저지른 짓, 절대 용서할 수 없어요. 분노가 치밀어 오르네요!
dialogsBegin.nl: I will never forgive them for what they have done. I'm literally fuming with anger right now!
dialogsBegin.pl: I will never forgive them for what they have done. I'm literally fuming with anger right now!
dialogsBegin.ru: Меч мы вернули, но этого мало. Ох, как я зол на "Труппу товарищей"!
dialogsBegin.sp: Nunca los perdonaré por lo que han hecho. ¡Estoy echando humo de la rabia que tengo!
dialogsBegin.sw: I will never forgive them for what they have done. I'm literally fuming with anger right now!
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันจะไม่ยกโทษให้พวกเขาสำหรับสิ่งที่พวกเขาได้ทำ ตอนนี้ฉันเต็มไปด้วยความโกรธสุดๆ เลยล่ะ!
dialogsBegin.tw: 我真的不能原諒他們，欺負我都不夠…還要把我們家…
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi sẽ không bao giờ tha thứ cho họ vì những gì họ đã làm. Ngay bây giờ tôi thực sự đang rất tức giận!

dialogsBegin.en: Now that their leader has been defeated, I think this is a good opportunity to hit them where it hurts and end this once and for all!
dialogsBegin.ar: Now that their leader has been defeated, I think this is a good opportunity to hit them where it hurts and end this once and for all!
dialogsBegin.br: Agora que o líder foi derrotado, acho que esta é uma boa oportunidade para acertá-los onde dói mais e acabar com isso de uma vez por todas!
dialogsBegin.cns: 头目都死了，他们现在应该会很混乱，趁这个机会我要一网打进!
dialogsBegin.de: Jetzt da ihr Anführer besiegt wurde, wird es nicht schwer sein alle loszuwerden.
dialogsBegin.fi: Now that their leader has been defeated, I think this is a good opportunity to hit them where it hurts and end this once and for all!
dialogsBegin.fil: Now that their leader has been defeated, I think this is a good opportunity to hit them where it hurts and end this once and for all!
dialogsBegin.fr: Maintenant que leur chef a été vaincu il sera plus facile de tous les chasser d'ici!
dialogsBegin.id: Sekarang pemimpin mereka telah dikalahkan, saya pikir ini adalah kesempatan yang baik untuk memukul mereka di tempat yang menyakitkan dan mengakhiri ini sekali dan untuk selamanya!
dialogsBegin.it: Now that their leader has been defeated, I think this is a good opportunity to hit them where it hurts and end this once and for all!
dialogsBegin.jp: しかし君のおかげであいつらのボスをやっつけたことだし、結束力は今、弱まってるはず。そう、やつらを一網打尽にできる絶好のチャンスなのさ！
dialogsBegin.kr: 두목이 쓰러진 지금이야말로, 녀석들을 일망타진할 수 있는 절호의 기회예요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Now that their leader has been defeated, I think this is a good opportunity to hit them where it hurts and end this once and for all!
dialogsBegin.pl: Now that their leader has been defeated, I think this is a good opportunity to hit them where it hurts and end this once and for all!
dialogsBegin.ru: Я им обиды не спущу! Они ответят мне за все оскорбления!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Ahora que su líder ha sido derrotado, creo que esta es una buena oportunidad para golpearlos donde más les duele y terminar con esto de una vez por todas!
dialogsBegin.sw: Now that their leader has been defeated, I think this is a good opportunity to hit them where it hurts and end this once and for all!
dialogsBegin.th: ตอนนี้หัวหน้าโจรก็ถูกกำจัดแล้ว ผมคิดว่านี่เป็นโอกาสดีที่จะทำลายพวกมันให้สิ้นซากตลอดไป!
dialogsBegin.tw: 頭目都死了，他們現在應該會很混亂，趁這個機會我要一網打盡！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bây giờ thủ lĩnh của họ đã bị đánh bại, tôi nghĩ đây là cơ hội tốt để đánh họ vào những vết thương và kết thúc điều này một lần và mãi mãi!

dialogsBegin.en: I have a plan, but I will need your help again, my friend. Are you up to it?
dialogsBegin.ar: I have a plan, but I will need your help again, my friend. Are you up to it?
dialogsBegin.br: Eu tenho um plano, mas irei precisar de sua ajuda novamente. Você me ajudaria? É claro que eu o recompensarei.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我要把我所有的东西拿出来，灭杀他们，可以帮我吗?当然不是免费帮我!
dialogsBegin.de: Ich werde tun was nötig ist um sie alle zu beseitigen. Würdest du mir helfen? Ich werde dich natürlich entlohnen.
dialogsBegin.fi: I have a plan, but I will need your help again, my friend. Are you up to it?
dialogsBegin.fil: I have a plan, but I will need your help again, my friend. Are you up to it?
dialogsBegin.fr: Je ferai tout ce qui est possible pour les vaincre tous. M'aideras-tu ? Bien sûr, une récompense est à la clé...
dialogsBegin.id: Aku punya rencana, tapi aku butuh bantuanmu lagi, temanku. Apakah kamu sanggup melakukannya?
dialogsBegin.it: I have a plan, but I will need your help again, my friend. Are you up to it?
dialogsBegin.jp: どうか、私に力を貸してくれないか？もちろん、ただでお願いするわけじゃない、お礼はしっかりさせてもらうつもりだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 계획이 있긴 한데, 당신의 도움이 필요해요. 도와주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: I have a plan, but I will need your help again, my friend. Are you up to it?
dialogsBegin.pl: I have a plan, but I will need your help again, my friend. Are you up to it?
dialogsBegin.ru: Я знаю, как их наказать, но без тебя не справлюсь. Ты поможешь?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tengo un plan, pero volveré a necesitar tu ayuda, amigo. ¿Estás preparado?
dialogsBegin.sw: I have a plan, but I will need your help again, my friend. Are you up to it?
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันมีแผน แต่ฉันจะต้องการความช่วยเหลือของคุณอีกครั้งนะ เพื่อน คุณช่วยฉันได้ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 我要把我所有的東西拿出來，滅殺他們，可以幫我嗎？當然不是免費幫我！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi có một kế hoạch, nhưng tôi sẽ cần sự giúp đỡ của bạn một lần nữa, bạn của tôi. Bạn có muốn không?

dialogsAccept.en: I knew you would do it! Travel back to their camp, and defeat 5 Red Bang Troupe Members, 1 Red bang Troupe Leader, and bring me 7 of their symbols.
dialogsAccept.ar: I knew you would do it! Travel back to their camp, and defeat 5 Red Bang Troupe Members, 1 Red bang Troupe Leader, and bring me 7 of their symbols.
dialogsAccept.br: Eu sabia que você faria isso! Viaje de volta para o acampamento deles e derrote 5 membros da Tropa dos Bangs Vermelhos, 1 líder da Tropa dos Bangs Vermelhos e me traga 7 de seus símbolos.
dialogsAccept.cns: 我知道你会这么做的! 回到他们的阵地，打败5个红色魔导战甲强盗团成员，1个红色魔导战甲强盗团头目，并给我带来他们的7个符号。
dialogsAccept.de: Ich wusste du liebst die Gerechtigkeit. Bitte beseitige jeden einzelnen von ihnen und bringe mir den Beweis. Das ist alles.
dialogsAccept.fi: I knew you would do it! Travel back to their camp, and defeat 5 Red Bang Troupe Members, 1 Red bang Troupe Leader, and bring me 7 of their symbols.
dialogsAccept.fil: I knew you would do it! Travel back to their camp, and defeat 5 Red Bang Troupe Members, 1 Red bang Troupe Leader, and bring me 7 of their symbols.
dialogsAccept.fr: Je savais bien que tu aimais la justice! S'il te plaît, bats-les tous et rapporte-moi une preuve. C'est tout ce que je veux.
dialogsAccept.id: Saya tahu kamu akan melakukannya! Perjalanan kembali ke kamp mereka, dan kalahkan 5 Red Bang Troupe Members, 1 Red bang Troupe Leader, dan bawakan saya 7 simbol mereka.
dialogsAccept.it: I knew you would do it! Travel back to their camp, and defeat 5 Red Bang Troupe Members, 1 Red bang Troupe Leader, and bring me 7 of their symbols.
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとう、正義感あふれる冒険者よ！あいつらを一網打尽にして、その証拠を持って来てくれ、お願いだ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 그럴 줄 알았어요! 그럼 녀석들의 본거지로 가서, 레드 뱅 도적단원 5명과 레드 뱅 도적 대장 1명을 처치하고, 레드 뱅 도적단 문양 7개를 가져와 주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: I knew you would do it! Travel back to their camp, and defeat 5 Red Bang Troupe Members, 1 Red bang Troupe Leader, and bring me 7 of their symbols.
dialogsAccept.pl: I knew you would do it! Travel back to their camp, and defeat 5 Red Bang Troupe Members, 1 Red bang Troupe Leader, and bring me 7 of their symbols.
dialogsAccept.ru: Возвращайся в их лагерь, победи пятерых проходимцев и их главаря. Второе поражение для него будет еще обиднее первого! Отбери у них их гордость - значки труппы.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Sabía que lo harías! Vuelve a su campamento y derrota a 5 Miembros de los Bangs Rojos, a 1 Líder de los Bangs Rojos y tráeme 7 de sus símbolos.
dialogsAccept.sw: I knew you would do it! Travel back to their camp, and defeat 5 Red Bang Troupe Members, 1 Red bang Troupe Leader, and bring me 7 of their symbols.
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันรู้ว่าคุณจะทำมัน! กลับไปที่ค่ายของพวกโจรและจัดการ Red Bang Members 5 ตัว Red Bang Leader 1 ตัว และนำสัญลักษณ์ของพวกมัน 7 อันกลับมาให้ฉัน
dialogsAccept.tw: 我就知道你辦得到！回到他們的營地，擊敗 5 名紅色崩崩團員和 1 名紅色崩崩團長，並帶回 7 個他們的標誌。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi biết bạn sẽ làm điều đó! Quay trở lại trại của họ, và đánh bại 5 thành viên của Red Bang Troupe, 1 thủ lĩnh Red Bang Troupe, và mang về cho tôi 7 biểu tượng của họ.

dialogsDecline.en: Will you not help me finally rid our town of this nuisance? Speak with me again if you have a change of heart.
dialogsDecline.ar: Will you not help me finally rid our town of this nuisance? Speak with me again if you have a change of heart.
dialogsDecline.br: Você não vai me ajudar a livrar nossa cidade desse incômodo de uma vez por todas? Bem, você me ajudou bastante. Talvez isso seja o suficiente. Mas se mudar de ideia estou aqui...
dialogsDecline.cns: 嗯..你已经帮我很多事了，我也不能在逼你去帮我了..谢谢.
dialogsDecline.de: Du wirst mir nicht helfen, unsere Stadt endlich von diesem Ärgernis zu befreien? Sprich noch einmal mit mir, wenn Du es Dir anders überlegt hast.
dialogsDecline.fi: Will you not help me finally rid our town of this nuisance? Speak with me again if you have a change of heart.
dialogsDecline.fil: Will you not help me finally rid our town of this nuisance? Speak with me again if you have a change of heart.
dialogsDecline.fr: Génial, tu m'as beaucoup aidé. Je pense que ce sera suffisant. Merci. J'y ferai plus attention désormais.
dialogsDecline.id: Maukah kamu tidak membantu saya akhirnya menyingkirkan kota kita dari gangguan ini? Bicaralah dengan saya lagi jika kamu memiliki perubahan hati.
dialogsDecline.it: Will you not help me finally rid our town of this nuisance? Speak with me again if you have a change of heart.
dialogsDecline.jp: そうか・・・今までも君には世話になりっぱなしだったもんなあ。これ以上は頼めないか、仕方ない。
dialogsDecline.kr: 이 머리아픈 녀석들을 없애고 싶지 않으신가요? 마음이 바뀌면 다시 찾아와 주세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Will you not help me finally rid our town of this nuisance? Speak with me again if you have a change of heart.
dialogsDecline.pl: Will you not help me finally rid our town of this nuisance? Speak with me again if you have a change of heart.
dialogsDecline.ru: Неужели ты не хочешь помочь мне отомстить проходимцам? Возвращайся, если передумаешь.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿No me ayudarás a liberar a nuestra ciudad de esta situación de una vez por todas? Habla conmigo de nuevo si cambias de opinión.
dialogsDecline.sw: Will you not help me finally rid our town of this nuisance? Speak with me again if you have a change of heart.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณจะไม่ช่วยฉันกำจัดเรื่องที่น่ารำคาญนี้หรือ? คุยกับฉันอีกครั้งถ้าคุณเกิดเปลี่ยนใจ
dialogsDecline.tw: 你能不能幫我最終擺脫我們鎮上的這種麻煩？如果你改變主意了，再和我談談。
dialogsDecline.vi: Cuối cùng là bạn không giúp tôi thoát khỏi thị trấn phiền toái này à? Nói chuyện với tôi một lần nữa nếu bạn đổi ý.

dialogsComplete.en: Very good! Excellent work! They're probably tucking their tails between their legs now! Muahaha!
dialogsComplete.ar: Very good! Excellent work! They're probably tucking their tails between their legs now! Muahaha!
dialogsComplete.br: Este é o símbolo deles?... Muito bom! Excelente trabalho! Eles provavelmente estão enfiando o rabo entre as pernas agora! Muahaha!
dialogsComplete.cns: 嗯..这是他们的象征啊..他们长的不怎样，既然有这么棒的象征啊..这是回礼，请收下吧。
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm.. is das ihr Symbol? Hmm.. Hmm.. es ist komplizierter als ich dachte. Bitte sehr. Mein Geschenk an dich.
dialogsComplete.fi: Very good! Excellent work! They're probably tucking their tails between their legs now! Muahaha!
dialogsComplete.fil: Very good! Excellent work! They're probably tucking their tails between their legs now! Muahaha!
dialogsComplete.fr: Hmm.. C'est leur symbole? Hmm.. Hmm.. Il est plus complexe que je ne l'aurais imaginé. Voilà pour toi. Ta récompense.
dialogsComplete.id: Sangat bagus! Kerja bagus! Mereka mungkin menyelipkan ekor mereka di antara kaki mereka sekarang! Muahahaha!
dialogsComplete.it: Very good! Excellent work! They're probably tucking their tails between their legs now! Muahaha!
dialogsComplete.jp: これが彼らの持っていたエンブレムか。見かけによらず結構繊細なエンブレムを持ってるんだなぁ。じゃ、これは俺からのお礼だ。どうか受け取ってくれ。ありがとう！
dialogsComplete.kr: 아주 잘하셨어요! 정말 훌륭하네요! 녀석들, 꼬리를 말고 도망치고 있겠군요! 무하하하!
dialogsComplete.nl: Very good! Excellent work! They're probably tucking their tails between their legs now! Muahaha!
dialogsComplete.pl: Very good! Excellent work! They're probably tucking their tails between their legs now! Muahaha!
dialogsComplete.ru: Прекрасно! Теперь пускай их гордость страдает, а не моя. Ха-ха-ха!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Muy bien! ¡Excelente trabajo! ¡Seguro que ahora están con la cola entre las piernas! ¡Muajajaja!
dialogsComplete.sw: Very good! Excellent work! They're probably tucking their tails between their legs now! Muahaha!
dialogsComplete.th: ดีมาก! ทำงานได้ดีเยี่ยม! ตอนนี้พวกมันคงสะดุดหางตัวเองแล้วล่ะ! อุวะฮะฮ่า!
dialogsComplete.tw: 嗯…這是他們的象徵啊…他們長的不怎樣，既然有這麼棒的象徵啊…這是回禮，請收下吧。
dialogsComplete.vi: Tốt lắm! Xuất sắc! Có lẽ bây giờ chúng đang thấy xấu hổ và mất mặt! Muahaha!

dialogsFail.en: Have you defeated them all yet? Do you have any symbols? No? Then you better get going!
dialogsFail.ar: Have you defeated them all yet? Do you have any symbols? No? Then you better get going!
dialogsFail.br: Ainda não? Eu sei que derrotar todos leva tempo. Você não precisa se apressar.
dialogsFail.cns: 还没灭杀他们吗?可能没那么简单啦，慢慢来没关系，只要把他们杀光光就好了。
dialogsFail.de: Hast du sie schon alle besiegt? Habt ihr irgendwelche Symbole? Nein? Dann solltest du besser loslegen!
dialogsFail.fi: Have you defeated them all yet? Do you have any symbols? No? Then you better get going!
dialogsFail.fil: Have you defeated them all yet? Do you have any symbols? No? Then you better get going!
dialogsFail.fr: Pas encore fini? Je saïs que tous les vaincre prendra du temps. Tu n'as pas besoin de te presser.
dialogsFail.id: Sudahkah kamu mengalahkan mereka semua? Apakah kamu memiliki simbol? Tidak? Kalau begitu sebaiknya kamu pergi!
dialogsFail.it: Have you defeated them all yet? Do you have any symbols? No? Then you better get going!
dialogsFail.jp: 彼らをすべてをもう倒しましたか？ 何かシンボルはありますか？ ないなら、今からでも彼らを倒してください。
dialogsFail.kr: 처치하셨나요? 문양은요? 아직 인가요? 서둘러 주세요!
dialogsFail.nl: Have you defeated them all yet? Do you have any symbols? No? Then you better get going!
dialogsFail.pl: Have you defeated them all yet? Do you have any symbols? No? Then you better get going!
dialogsFail.ru: Ну как, удалось наказать проходимцев? Покажи значки! Нет? Тогда не мешкай!
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Ya los has derrotado a todos? ¿Tienes los símbolos? ¿No? ¡Entonces ves a por ellos!
dialogsFail.sw: Have you defeated them all yet? Do you have any symbols? No? Then you better get going!
dialogsFail.th: คุณได้กำจัดพวกมันทั้งหมดหรือยัง? คุณได้รับสัญลักษณ์มาแล้วหรือไม่? ไม่มีงั้นเหรอ?
dialogsFail.tw: 你打敗他們了嗎？你有什麼線索嗎？不？那你最好出發！
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn đã đánh bại tất cả chúng chưa? Bạn có biểu tượng nào không? Không? Vậy thì tốt hơn hết bạn nên đi!

dialogsBegin.en: Haven needs you to collect Sycale to re-model the Magic Shop. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.ar: Haven needs you to collect Sycale to re-model the Magic Shop. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.br: Haven precisa que você colete Sycale para remodelar a Loja Mágica. Você poderia ajudar?
dialogsBegin.cns: 哈本为了整修魔法商店，委托了搜集制造壁纸用的“蓝光鳞片”，您要接受委托吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Heaven hat uns gebeten ihr Sycale zu sammeln welches sie für Tapeten braucht mit denen sie ihren Magieladen verschönern möchte. Willst du den Auftrag annehmen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Haven needs you to collect Sycale to re-model the Magic Shop. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.fil: Kailangan ng Haven na kolektahin mo ang Sycale para i-remodel ang Magic Shop. Tutulungan mo ba?
dialogsBegin.fr:
Heaven nous demande de trouver du Sycale, afin d'en faire un papier peint pour redécorer la boutique de magie.
Acceptes-tu cette mission ?
dialogsBegin.id: Haven membutuhkanmu untuk mengumpulkan Sycale untuk mengubah kembali penampilan Magic Shop. Bisakah kamu membantu?
dialogsBegin.it: Haven needs you to collect Sycale to re-model the Magic Shop. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.jp: ヘブンがこのたび魔法ショップの内装をリフォームをするそうです。そこで壁紙に使用するためのシケイル45個を依頼しました。シケイルの壁紙なんて神秘的ですね。依頼を受けますか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 헤븐이 마법 상점을 새로 단장하기 위해 시케일을 구해 달라고 부탁합니다. 도와주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Haven needs you to collect Sycale to re-model the Magic Shop. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.pl: Haven needs you to collect Sycale to re-model the Magic Shop. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.ru: Ну-ка, ну-ка… 'Амфоре нужна чешуя для нового дизайна Магозина.' Поможешь?
dialogsBegin.sp: Heaven necesita Sycales para reformar las paredes de su Tienda de Magia. ¿Aceptas esta misión?
dialogsBegin.sw: Haven needs you to collect Sycale to re-model the Magic Shop. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.th: Haven ต้องการให้คุณรวบรวม Sycale เพื่อสร้างโมเดล Magic Shop ใหม่ คุณจะช่วยไหม
dialogsBegin.tw: 海音為了整修魔法店，委託了蒐集製造壁紙用的『藍光鱗片』，你要接受委託嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Haven cần bạn thu thập Sycale để sửa sang lại Magic Shop. Bạn sẽ giúp chứ?

dialogsBegin.en: Something still bothers me... why are these storms happening at all? Maybe the Chairman of the History Society, Gothante, might know.
dialogsBegin.ar: Something still bothers me... why are these storms happening at all? Maybe the Chairman of the History Society, Gothante, might know.
dialogsBegin.br: Algo tá me incomodando... por que essas tempestades tão rolando? Talvez o Presidente da Sociedade Histórica, Gothante, tenha umas respostas pra nós.
dialogsBegin.cns: Something still bothers me... why are these storms happening at all? Maybe the Chairman of the History Society, Gothante, might know.
dialogsBegin.de: Etwas beunruhigt mich immer noch... warum gibt es diese Stürme überhaupt? Vielleicht weiß der Vorsitzender des Historiker Verbands Gothante etwas darüber.
dialogsBegin.fi: Something still bothers me... why are these storms happening at all? Maybe the Chairman of the History Society, Gothante, might know.
dialogsBegin.fil: Something still bothers me... why are these storms happening at all? Maybe the Chairman of the History Society, Gothante, might know.
dialogsBegin.fr: Quelque chose me tracasse encore... pourquoi ces tempêtes ont-elles lieu ? Le président de la Société d'histoire, Gothante, pourrait peut-être le savoir.
dialogsBegin.id: Sesuatu masih menggangguku... mengapa badai ini terjadi? Mungkin Ketua Masyarakat Sejarah, Gothante, mungkin tahu.
dialogsBegin.it: Something still bothers me... why are these storms happening at all? Maybe the Chairman of the History Society, Gothante, might know.
dialogsBegin.jp: 何かがまだ私を悩ませています...なぜこれらの嵐が起こっているのですか?たぶん、歴史協会の会長であるゴサンテは知っているかもしれません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 여전히 마음에 걸리네요... 왜 이런 폭풍이 일어나는 거죠? 역사학회 회장인 고단테라면 알고 있을지도 몰라요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Something still bothers me... why are these storms happening at all? Maybe the Chairman of the History Society, Gothante, might know.
dialogsBegin.pl: Something still bothers me... why are these storms happening at all? Maybe the Chairman of the History Society, Gothante, might know.
dialogsBegin.ru: Something still bothers me... why are these storms happening at all? Maybe the Chairman of the History Society, Gothante, might know.
dialogsBegin.sp: Todavía hay algo que me preocupa... ¿por qué se producen estas tormentas? Tal vez el Presidente de la Sociedad de Historia, Gothante, podría saber.
dialogsBegin.sw: Something still bothers me... why are these storms happening at all? Maybe the Chairman of the History Society, Gothante, might know.
dialogsBegin.th: บางอย่างยังกวนใจข้าอยู่...ทำไมพายุพวกนี้ถึงเกิดขึ้นมาล่ะ? บางทีประธานของ History Society, Gothante อาจจะรู้ก็ได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 有些事情仍然困擾著我……為什麼會發生這些風暴？說不定歷史學會會長高譚提拉知道。
dialogsBegin.vi: Có điều gì đó vẫn làm tôi băn khoăn... tại sao những cơn bão này lại xảy ra? Có lẽ Chairman of the History Society, Gothante, có thể biết.

dialogsDecline.en: Well... at least the airships are safe for now. I wonder why all the bad weather, though?
dialogsDecline.ar: Well... at least the airships are safe for now. I wonder why all the bad weather, though?
dialogsDecline.br: Nossa, pelo menos as aeronaves não vão cair agora! Mas me diz aí, o que será que tá causando esse tempo todo maluco?
dialogsDecline.cns: Well... at least the airships are safe for now. I wonder why all the bad weather, though?
dialogsDecline.de: Nun, zumindest sind die Luftschiffe jetzt sicher. Ich frage mich allerdings, warum das ganze schlechte Wetter?
dialogsDecline.fi: Well... at least the airships are safe for now. I wonder why all the bad weather, though?
dialogsDecline.fil: Well... at least the airships are safe for now. I wonder why all the bad weather, though?
dialogsDecline.fr: Au moins, les dirigeables sont en sécurité pour l'instant. Mais je me demande pourquoi tout ce mauvais temps ?
dialogsDecline.id: Yah.. setidaknya kapal udara aman untuk saat ini. Aku bertanya-tanya mengapa semua cuaca buruk?
dialogsDecline.it: Well... at least the airships are safe for now. I wonder why all the bad weather, though?
dialogsDecline.jp: まぁ。。少なくとも飛行船は今のところ安全です。しかし、なぜすべての悪天候なのかしら?
dialogsDecline.kr: 으음... 어쨌든 이제 비행선은 안전하지만. 그런데 날씨가 왜 이렇게 나쁜 걸까요?
dialogsDecline.nl: Well... at least the airships are safe for now. I wonder why all the bad weather, though?
dialogsDecline.pl: Well... at least the airships are safe for now. I wonder why all the bad weather, though?
dialogsDecline.ru: Well... at least the airships are safe for now. I wonder why all the bad weather, though?
dialogsDecline.sp: Bueno... al menos los dirigibles están a salvo por ahora. Me pregunto por qué todo el mal tiempo, sin embargo?
dialogsDecline.sw: Well... at least the airships are safe for now. I wonder why all the bad weather, though?
dialogsDecline.th: เอาล่ะ อย่างน้อยตอนนี้เรือเหาะก็ปลอดภัยแล้ว แต่ข้าก็ยังแปลกใจทำไมสภาพอากาศมันถึงเลวร้ายแบบนี้?
dialogsDecline.tw: 唔……至少現在飛艇暫時安全了。不過我還是很在意，最近這些壞天氣到底是怎麼回事？
dialogsDecline.vi: Chà.. ít nhất thì các khinh khí cầu vẫn an toàn vào lúc này. Tại sao thời tiết lại xấu thế nhỉ?

dialogsComplete.en: The storms lately have raged on for far too long! I have a feeling I know what has caused these storms.
dialogsComplete.ar: The storms lately have raged on for far too long! I have a feeling I know what has caused these storms.
dialogsComplete.br: Wow, essas tempestades estão demorando horrores! Mas eu tenho um palpite do que pode ter causado isso.
dialogsComplete.cns: The storms lately have raged on for far too long! I have a feeling I know what has caused these storms.
dialogsComplete.de: Die Stürme haben in letzter Zeit schon viel zu lange gewütet! Ich glaube, ich weiß, was diese Stürme verursacht hat.
dialogsComplete.fi: The storms lately have raged on for far too long! I have a feeling I know what has caused these storms.
dialogsComplete.fil: The storms lately have raged on for far too long! I have a feeling I know what has caused these storms.
dialogsComplete.fr: Ces derniers temps, les tempêtes font rage depuis bien trop longtemps ! J'ai le sentiment de connaître la cause de ces tempêtes.
dialogsComplete.id: Badai akhir-akhir ini mengamuk terlalu lama! Aku punya perasaan aku tahu penyebab dari badai ini.
dialogsComplete.it: The storms lately have raged on for far too long! I have a feeling I know what has caused these storms.
dialogsComplete.jp: 最近の嵐はあまりにも長い間猛威を振るっています!私はこれらの嵐の原因を知っていると感じています。
dialogsComplete.kr: 최근 오랫동안 폭풍이 몰아치고 있죠! 제가 이 폭풍의 원인을 알고 있을 것 같다는 느낌이 드네요.
dialogsComplete.nl: The storms lately have raged on for far too long! I have a feeling I know what has caused these storms.
dialogsComplete.pl: The storms lately have raged on for far too long! I have a feeling I know what has caused these storms.
dialogsComplete.ru: The storms lately have raged on for far too long! I have a feeling I know what has caused these storms.
dialogsComplete.sp: Últimamente, las tormentas se han prolongado demasiado. Tengo la sensación de que sé lo que ha causado estas tormentas.
dialogsComplete.sw: The storms lately have raged on for far too long! I have a feeling I know what has caused these storms.
dialogsComplete.th: ช่วงหลังพายุมันรุนแรงมานานมากเกินไปแล้ว! ข้ารู้สึกว่าข้ารุ้ว่าทำไมมันถึงเกิดพายุขึ้นนะ
dialogsComplete.tw: 近來這場風暴持續得太久了！我有種感覺，我大概知道是什麼引起這些暴風雨。
dialogsComplete.vi: Những cơn bão gần đây đã hoành hành quá lâu! Tôi cảm giác mình biết điều gì đã gây ra những cơn bão này.
