dialogsBegin.en: Oh, back already? That was fast! You sure made quick work of those Mothbees.
dialogsBegin.ar: Oh, back already? That was fast! You sure made quick work of those Mothbees.
dialogsBegin.br: Oh, já está de volta? Isso foi rápido! Você com certeza fez um ótimo trabalho com aquelas Maribelhas.
dialogsBegin.cns: 噢，这就回来了？实在是太快了吧！你肯定很快就搞定了哪些苍翼蜂蛾。
dialogsBegin.de: Oh, du bist schon zurück? Das ging aber schnell! Die Mothbees hast du aber schnell erledigt.
dialogsBegin.fi: Oh, back already? That was fast! You sure made quick work of those Mothbees.
dialogsBegin.fil: Oh, back already? That was fast! You sure made quick work of those Mothbees.
dialogsBegin.fr: Oh, déjà de retour ? C'était rapide ! Tu n'as fait qu'une bouchée de ces Mothbees.
dialogsBegin.id: Sudah kembali? Cepat sekali! Sepertinya kamu cukup bersemangat menghajar Mothbees itu.
dialogsBegin.it: Oh, back already? That was fast! You sure made quick work of those Mothbees.
dialogsBegin.jp: あら、もう終わっちゃったの？早かったのね。モスビーはどうだった？
dialogsBegin.kr: 어머, 벌써 돌아오셨어요? 정말 빠르네요! 모스비 처리를 그렇게 금방 해내시다니요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Oh, back already? That was fast! You sure made quick work of those Mothbees.
dialogsBegin.pl: Oh, back already? That was fast! You sure made quick work of those Mothbees.
dialogsBegin.ru: Oh, back already? That was fast! You sure made quick work of those Mothbees.
dialogsBegin.sp: Oh, ¿ya has vuelto? ¡Eso ha sido rápido! Seguro que has hecho un buen trabajo con esos Mothbees.
dialogsBegin.sw: Oh, back already? That was fast! You sure made quick work of those Mothbees.
dialogsBegin.th: กลับมาแล้วเหรอ เร็วมากเลย! คุณจัดการพวก Mothbees นั้นได้ง่ายๆ เลยสินะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 哦，回來了？那太快了！你肯定很快就解決了那些飛蛾。
dialogsBegin.vi: Ồ, trở lại rồi à? Thật nhanh chóng! Bạn chắc chắn đã xử lý nhanh chóng những con Mothbees đó.

dialogsBegin.en: Here, take this letter. Please deliver it to Dior in Flarine. It's a Letter of Recommendation. Once she reads it I'm sure she'll give you a reward! Hehe~
dialogsBegin.ar: Here, take this letter. Please deliver it to Dior in Flarine. It's a Letter of Recommendation. Once she reads it I'm sure she'll give you a reward! Hehe~
dialogsBegin.br: Aqui, pegue esta carta. Entregue para Dior em Flarine. É uma Carta de Recomendação. Assim que ela ler, tenho certeza de que ela lhe dará uma recompensa! Hehe ~
dialogsBegin.cns: 请收下这封信。请将它交给帕里镇的迪奥。这是一封推荐信，当她读了信后就会给你奖励的！嘿嘿嘿~
dialogsBegin.de: Hier, nimm diesen Brief. Bitte bring ihn zu Dior in Flarine. Es ist ein Empfehlungsschreiben. Wenn sie es gelesen hat, wird sie dir sicher eine Belohnung geben! Hehe~
dialogsBegin.fi: Here, take this letter. Please deliver it to Dior in Flarine. It's a Letter of Recommendation. Once she reads it I'm sure she'll give you a reward! Hehe~
dialogsBegin.fil: Here, take this letter. Please deliver it to Dior in Flarine. It's a Letter of Recommendation. Once she reads it I'm sure she'll give you a reward! Hehe~
dialogsBegin.fr: Tiens, prends cette Lettre de Recommandation et amène-la à Dior à Flarine. Je suis sûr qu'elle t'offrira une récompense en la lisant ! Héhé~
dialogsBegin.id: Ambil surat ini. Tolong kirimkan ke Dior di Flarine. Itu adalah Letter of Recommendation. Begitu dia membacanya, Aku yakin dia akan memberimu hadiah! Hehe~
dialogsBegin.it: Here, take this letter. Please deliver it to Dior in Flarine. It's a Letter of Recommendation. Once she reads it I'm sure she'll give you a reward! Hehe~
dialogsBegin.jp: はい、推薦状を受け取って。フラリスの＜ディオール＞にちゃんと届けてね。きっと見たことのないご褒美をくれるはずよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 자, 이 편지를 받으세요. 플라리네에 있는 디올에게 전달해 주세요. 추천서랍니다. 읽고 나면 디올이 보상을 줄 거예요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Here, take this letter. Please deliver it to Dior in Flarine. It's a Letter of Recommendation. Once she reads it I'm sure she'll give you a reward! Hehe~
dialogsBegin.pl: Here, take this letter. Please deliver it to Dior in Flarine. It's a Letter of Recommendation. Once she reads it I'm sure she'll give you a reward! Hehe~
dialogsBegin.ru: Here, take this letter. Please deliver it to Dior in Flarine. It's a Letter of Recommendation. Once she reads it I'm sure she'll give you a reward! Hehe~
dialogsBegin.sp: Ten, toma esta carta. Entrégasela a Dior en Flarine. Es una Carta de Recomendación. ¡Una vez que la lea, estoy segura de que te dará una recompensa! Jeje~
dialogsBegin.sw: Here, take this letter. Please deliver it to Dior in Flarine. It's a Letter of Recommendation. Once she reads it I'm sure she'll give you a reward! Hehe~
dialogsBegin.th: เอาจดหมายนี้ไป ส่งให้ Dior ใน Flarine มันเป็นจดหมายรับรอง ถ้าเธออ่านแล้ว ฉันแน่ใจว่าเธอจะให้รางวัลคุณ! ฮิฮิ~
dialogsBegin.tw: 來，收下這封信。請把它送到布拉里斯的寶雅。是推薦信。一旦她讀到它，我相信她會給你一個報酬！呵呵~
dialogsBegin.vi: Đây, cầm lấy lá thư này. Hãy giao nó cho Dior ở Flarine. Đó là một Thư giới thiệu. Khi cô ấy đọc nó, tôi chắc chắn rằng cô ấy sẽ thưởng cho bạn! Hehe ~

dialogsAccept.en: Have a safe journey back to Flaris. See you again soon! Tell my sweetie Dior I said hi!
dialogsAccept.ar: Have a safe journey back to Flaris. See you again soon! Tell my sweetie Dior I said hi!
dialogsAccept.br: Tenha uma boa viagem de volta para Flaris. Vejo você novamente em breve! Diga a minha querida Dior que eu mandei um beijo!
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你去帕里时一路顺风。期待下次与你见面！麻烦你替我向我的宝贝迪奥打声招呼！
dialogsAccept.de: Ich wünsche dir eine gute Heimreise nach Flaris. Wir sehen uns bald wieder! Grüße meine süße Dior von mir!
dialogsAccept.fi: Have a safe journey back to Flaris. See you again soon! Tell my sweetie Dior I said hi!
dialogsAccept.fil: Have a safe journey back to Flaris. See you again soon! Tell my sweetie Dior I said hi!
dialogsAccept.fr: Bon voyage, et à bientôt ! Ah, et passe le bonjour à ma chérie Dior de ma part !
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga kamu kembali ke Flaris dengan selamat. Sampai jumpa lagi! Titip salamku pada Dior tersayang!
dialogsAccept.it: Have a safe journey back to Flaris. See you again soon! Tell my sweetie Dior I said hi!
dialogsAccept.jp: じゃあね。無事にフラリスに帰れるように祈っているわ。ディオールによろしく伝えてね！
dialogsAccept.kr: 플라리스까지 안전한 여행 되세요. 또 뵐 수 있으면 좋겠네요! 제 사랑스러운 디올에게 안부도 꼭 전해 주세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Have a safe journey back to Flaris. See you again soon! Tell my sweetie Dior I said hi!
dialogsAccept.pl: Have a safe journey back to Flaris. See you again soon! Tell my sweetie Dior I said hi!
dialogsAccept.ru: Have a safe journey back to Flaris. See you again soon! Tell my sweetie Dior I said hi!
dialogsAccept.sp: Que tengas un buen viaje de regreso a Flaris. ¡Nos vemos pronto! ¡Dale saludos a mi querida Dior!
dialogsAccept.sw: Have a safe journey back to Flaris. See you again soon! Tell my sweetie Dior I said hi!
dialogsAccept.th: เดินทางกลับ Flaris อย่างปลอดภัย แล้วเจอกันใหม่เร็วๆ นี้! ฝากทักทาย Dior เพื่อนรักของฉันด้วย!
dialogsAccept.tw: 安全返回布拉里斯。很快再見！告訴我親愛的寶雅我打過招呼！
dialogsAccept.vi: Chúc an toàn trở về Flaris. Hẹn gặp lại các bạn trong thời gian sớm nhất! Hãy nói với người yêu Dior của tôi rằng tôi chào nhé!

dialogsDecline.en: There's no rush. Just talk to me again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.ar: There's no rush. Just talk to me again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.br: Sem pressa. Fale comigo novamente quando estiver pronto(a).
dialogsDecline.cns: 现在也不着急。当你准备好了后就告诉我吧。
dialogsDecline.de: Keinen Grund zur Eile. Sprich einfach wieder mit mir, wenn du bereit bist.
dialogsDecline.fi: There's no rush. Just talk to me again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.fil: There's no rush. Just talk to me again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.fr: Il n'y a pas le feu, pas besoin de te presser. Reviens me voir quand tu te sentiras prêt.
dialogsDecline.id: Tak perlu buru-buru. Beritahu saja aku jika kamu telah siap.
dialogsDecline.it: There's no rush. Just talk to me again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.jp: 急がなくてもいいわ。気が向いたらまた相談してね。
dialogsDecline.kr: 서두르지 않으셔도 괜찮아요. 준비되셨을 때 다시 말씀해 주세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: There's no rush. Just talk to me again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.pl: There's no rush. Just talk to me again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.ru: There's no rush. Just talk to me again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.sp: No hay prisa. Hábla conmigo cuando estés listo.
dialogsDecline.sw: There's no rush. Just talk to me again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.th: ไม่ต้องเร่งรีบ แค่กลับมาคุยกับฉันอีกครั้งเมื่อคุณพร้อม
dialogsDecline.tw: 不用著急。等你準備好了再跟我說話。
dialogsDecline.vi: Không có gì vội vàng. Hãy nói chuyện với tôi một lần nữa khi bạn đã sẵn sàng.

dialogsComplete.en: Welcome back traveler. What's this? A letter of recommendation? Let's see... *mumble mumble* ...wow! Passed with flying colors I see! Well done!
dialogsComplete.ar: Welcome back traveler. What's this? A letter of recommendation? Let's see... *mumble mumble* ...wow! Passed with flying colors I see! Well done!
dialogsComplete.br: Bem-vindo(a) de volta, viajante. O que é isso? Uma carta de recomendação? Vamos ver ... *hummm uhum* ... uau! Uma aprovação com certa folga! Mandou bem!
dialogsComplete.cns: 欢迎回来，我的旅行者。这是什么？一封推荐信？我看看...*咕哝声*...哇噢！你的测试完成得如此快速！干的真棒！
dialogsComplete.de: Willkommen zurück, Reisender. Was ist das? Ein Empfehlungsschreiben? Schauen wir mal... *hmm* ...wow! Mit Bravour bestanden, wie ich sehe! Gut gemacht!
dialogsComplete.fi: Welcome back traveler. What's this? A letter of recommendation? Let's see... *mumble mumble* ...wow! Passed with flying colors I see! Well done!
dialogsComplete.fil: Welcome back traveler. What's this? A letter of recommendation? Let's see... *mumble mumble* ...wow! Passed with flying colors I see! Well done!
dialogsComplete.fr: Te revoilà donc, voyageur. Qu'est-ce que c'est ? Une lettre de recommandation ? Voyons voir... *marmonne* ...Woah ! Passé avec distinction, je vois ! Bien joué !
dialogsComplete.id: Selamat datang kembali Traveler. Apa ini? Letter of Recommendation? Coba kulihat... *bergumam* ...wow! Lulus dengan memuaskan! Bagus sekali!
dialogsComplete.it: Welcome back traveler. What's this? A letter of recommendation? Let's see... *mumble mumble* ...wow! Passed with flying colors I see! Well done!
dialogsComplete.jp: おかえりなさ～い！帰ってきてくれたのね！！えっー、なに？推薦状？！すっごい、クリアしたのね！よくがんばりました！えらいえらい！
dialogsComplete.kr: 돌아오셨군요, 모험가님. 이건 뭐죠? 추천서인가요? 어디 볼까요... *중얼중얼* …우와! 아주 우수한 성적으로 통과하셨네요! 대단한데요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Welcome back traveler. What's this? A letter of recommendation? Let's see... *mumble mumble* ...wow! Passed with flying colors I see! Well done!
dialogsComplete.pl: Welcome back traveler. What's this? A letter of recommendation? Let's see... *mumble mumble* ...wow! Passed with flying colors I see! Well done!
dialogsComplete.ru: Welcome back traveler. What's this? A letter of recommendation? Let's see... *mumble mumble* ...wow! Passed with flying colors I see! Well done!
dialogsComplete.sp: Bienvenido de nuevo viajero. ¿Qué es esto? ¿Una carta de recomendación? Veamos... *vaya vaya...* ¡Wow! ¡Aprobado con gran éxito por lo que veo! ¡Bien hecho!
dialogsComplete.sw: Welcome back traveler. What's this? A letter of recommendation? Let's see... *mumble mumble* ...wow! Passed with flying colors I see! Well done!
dialogsComplete.th: ยินดีต้อนรับกลับนะ นักเดินทาง อะไรเหรอ? จดหมายรับรอง? ไหนดูซิ... *พึมพำพึมพำ* ...ว้าว! ทดสอบการบินผ่าน ทำได้ดีมาก!
dialogsComplete.tw: 歡迎回來，旅人。這是什麼？推薦信？讓我看看……*喃喃自語*……哇！看來你以優異成績通過了！做得好！
dialogsComplete.vi: Chào mừng du khách trở lại. Đây là gì? Thư giới thiệu à? Để xem nào ... * lầm bầm lẩm bẩm * ... wow! Bạn đã bay qua những màu sắc mà tôi nhìn thấy! Làm tốt lắm!

name.cns: 强盗团头目，魔导战甲王
name.th: หัวหน้าแก๊ง Lord Bang

description.en: Travel to Darkon 2 and defeat Lord Bang. He was last seen somewhere near the Gouthan Mountains.
description.ar: Travel to Darkon 2 and defeat Lord Bang. He was last seen somewhere near the Gouthan Mountains.
description.br: Viaje para Darkon 2 e derrote o Lorde Bang. Ele foi visto pela última vez em algum lugar perto das montanhas Gouthan.
description.cns: 他叫魔导战甲王，听说在达肯，去达肯永恒森林找找吧。
description.de: Sein Name ist Lord Bang, er lebt irgendwo in Darkon. Bitte gehe dort hin und mache ihn ausfindig.
description.fi: Travel to Darkon 2 and defeat Lord Bang. He was last seen somewhere near the Gouthan Mountains.
description.fil: Travel to Darkon 2 and defeat Lord Bang. He was last seen somewhere near the Gouthan Mountains.
description.fr: Son nom est Lord Bang Nayonah et il vit quelque part dans Darkon. Va là-bas et trouve-le.
description.id: Bepergian ke Darkon 2 dan kalahkan Lord Bang. Dia terakhir terlihat di suatu tempat dekat Gouthan Mountains.
description.it: Travel to Darkon 2 and defeat Lord Bang. He was last seen somewhere near the Gouthan Mountains.
description.jp: ロードヴァンと呼ばれる盗賊団のボスは、ダーコン地区の山のどこかに潜んでいるという噂だ。
description.kr: 다콘 제2지구로 가서 로드 뱅을 처치하세요. 마지막으로 목격된 곳은 고우단 산맥 근처였습니다.
description.nl: Travel to Darkon 2 and defeat Lord Bang. He was last seen somewhere near the Gouthan Mountains.
description.pl: Travel to Darkon 2 and defeat Lord Bang. He was last seen somewhere near the Gouthan Mountains.
description.ru: Нужно отправиться на Даркон-1, в Гутанские горы, и победить Папашу Грома.
description.sp: Viaja a Darkon 2 y derrota al Señor Bang. Fue visto por última vez cerca de las Montañas Gouthan.
description.sw: Travel to Darkon 2 and defeat Lord Bang. He was last seen somewhere near the Gouthan Mountains.
description.th: เดินทางไป Darkon 2 และกำจัด Lord Bang พบเห็นเขาครั้งสุดท้ายที่ Gouthan Mountains
description.tw: 前往得肯第二區並擊敗崩崩領主。他最後一次出現在古坦山脈附近。
description.vi: Du hành đến Darkon 2 và đánh bại Lord Bang. Lần cuối cùng anh ta được nhìn thấy ở đâu đó gần Gouthan Mountains.

dialogsBegin.en: This… this symbol… it is very intriguing. If I'm right, the real leader of the Red bang Troupe is not the one you defeated.
dialogsBegin.ar: This… this symbol… it is very intriguing. If I'm right, the real leader of the Red bang Troupe is not the one you defeated.
dialogsBegin.br: Este... Este símbolo... Eu me lembro dele... Se estou certo, o verdadeiro líder do grupo não é aquele que você derrotou.
dialogsBegin.cns: 这..好像在哪里看过了..如果我记的没错的话，他们的头目另有其人。
dialogsBegin.de: Dieses... dieses Symbol... es ist sehr faszinierend. Wenn ich richtig liege, ist der wahre Anführer der Red-Bang-Truppe nicht der, den Ihr besiegt habt.
dialogsBegin.fi: This… this symbol… it is very intriguing. If I'm right, the real leader of the Red bang Troupe is not the one you defeated.
dialogsBegin.fil: This… this symbol… it is very intriguing. If I'm right, the real leader of the Red bang Troupe is not the one you defeated.
dialogsBegin.fr: Ce.. Ce symbole.. Je m'en souviens.. Si je ne me trompe pas le vrai chef de la bande n'est pas celui que tu as vaincu.
dialogsBegin.id: Ini ... simbol ini ... sangat menarik. Jika saya benar, pemimpin sebenarnya dari Red bang Troupe bukanlah yang kamu kalahkan.
dialogsBegin.it: This… this symbol… it is very intriguing. If I'm right, the real leader of the Red bang Troupe is not the one you defeated.
dialogsBegin.jp: このエンブレムだが、何処かで見覚えがあるんだ。うーん、たしか記憶によると、赤いヴァン盗賊団の本当のボスは別のやつだったと思うんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이... 문양은... 정말 수상하군요. 제 추측이 맞는다면, 당신이 쓰러트린 건 레드 뱅 도적 대장이 아니었던 모양입니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: This… this symbol… it is very intriguing. If I'm right, the real leader of the Red bang Troupe is not the one you defeated.
dialogsBegin.pl: This… this symbol… it is very intriguing. If I'm right, the real leader of the Red bang Troupe is not the one you defeated.
dialogsBegin.ru: Хм... Не нравятся мне эти значки. Что у главаря, что у простых разбойников - у всех одинаковые. Сдается мне, главарь-то липовый!
dialogsBegin.sp: Este... este símbolo... es muy intrigante. Si no me equivoco, el verdadero líder de los Bangs Rojos no es el que derrotaste.
dialogsBegin.sw: This… this symbol… it is very intriguing. If I'm right, the real leader of the Red bang Troupe is not the one you defeated.
dialogsBegin.th: นี่... สัญลักษณ์นี้... มันเป็นอุบาย ถ้าฉันคิดถูก คนที่คุณได้กำจัดไปไม่ใช่หัวหน้าที่แท้จริงของแก๊ง Red Bang
dialogsBegin.tw: 這個……這個線索……很耐人尋味。如果我是對的，紅蹦蹦劇團的真正領袖不是你打敗的那個。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đây… biểu tượng này… nó rất hấp dẫn. Nếu tôi nói đúng, thủ lĩnh thực sự của Red bang Troupe không phải là người mà bạn đã đánh bại.

dialogsBegin.en: This symbol has been found in Darkon 2 as well. Could the real leader of the Red Bang Troupe be hiding there?
dialogsBegin.ar: This symbol has been found in Darkon 2 as well. Could the real leader of the Red Bang Troupe be hiding there?
dialogsBegin.br: Este símbolo também foi encontrado em Darkon 2. Será que verdadeiro líder dos Bangs Vermelhos poderia estar escondido lá?
dialogsBegin.cns: 如果那是我知道的家伙的话，一定要找出来把他杀掉，不然的话..不然的话..
dialogsBegin.de: (Zittert vor Angst) Wenn es der ist den ich kenne.. Wenn ich recht habe.. Musst du ihn wirklich finden und besiegen!! Tust du dies nicht.. Dann..
dialogsBegin.fi: This symbol has been found in Darkon 2 as well. Could the real leader of the Red Bang Troupe be hiding there?
dialogsBegin.fil: This symbol has been found in Darkon 2 as well. Could the real leader of the Red Bang Troupe be hiding there?
dialogsBegin.fr: (Tremblant de peur) Si c'est celui auquel je pense.. Si j'ai raison.. Tu dois vraiment le retrouver et le vaincre!! Sinon..
dialogsBegin.id: Simbol ini telah ditemukan di Darkon 2 juga. Mungkinkah pemimpin sebenarnya dari Red Bang Troupe bersembunyi di sana?
dialogsBegin.it: This symbol has been found in Darkon 2 as well. Could the real leader of the Red Bang Troupe be hiding there?
dialogsBegin.jp: そいつが、私の知ってるそいつだったとしたら！必ずやっつけなければ。そうしないと・・・ああ！考えただけでも恐ろしい。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 문양은 다콘 제2지구에도 있었는데. 진짜 레드 뱅 도적단의 새 대장이 거기 숨어 있는 걸까요?
dialogsBegin.nl: This symbol has been found in Darkon 2 as well. Could the real leader of the Red Bang Troupe be hiding there?
dialogsBegin.pl: This symbol has been found in Darkon 2 as well. Could the real leader of the Red Bang Troupe be hiding there?
dialogsBegin.ru: Такие же значки видели у Громов на Дарконе-1. Может, настоящий лидер скрывается там? Нужно докопаться до правды, иначе разбойники так и будут обижать простой народ!
dialogsBegin.sp: Este símbolo también se ha encontrado en Darkon 2. ¿Podría estar allí escondido el verdadero líder de los Bangs Rojos?
dialogsBegin.sw: This symbol has been found in Darkon 2 as well. Could the real leader of the Red Bang Troupe be hiding there?
dialogsBegin.th: สัญลักษณ์นี้ถูกพบใน Darkon 2 เช่นกัน หัวหน้าที่แท้จริงของ Red Bang อาจซ่อนตัวอยู่ที่นั่นได้ไหมนะ?
dialogsBegin.tw: 這個線索在得肯第二區也有出現。真正的紅蹦蹦劇團首領會不會就躲在那裡？
dialogsBegin.vi: Biểu tượng này cũng đã được tìm thấy trong Darkon 2. Có thể nào thủ lĩnh thực sự của Red Bang Troupe đang ẩn náu ở đó?

dialogsBegin.en: We must find out. The leader must be defeated or this will never end.
dialogsBegin.ar: We must find out. The leader must be defeated or this will never end.
dialogsBegin.br: Não quero nem pensar no que pode acontecer... Devemos descobrir. O líder deve ser derrotado ou isso nunca vai acabar.
dialogsBegin.cns: 反正，等到他找到我之前，我一定要先把他找出来杀掉，帮我好吗?
dialogsBegin.de: (Schüttelt den Kopf) Wie auch immer! Wir müssen ihn besiegen bevor er uns ertappt! Bitte helf mir!!
dialogsBegin.fi: We must find out. The leader must be defeated or this will never end.
dialogsBegin.fil: We must find out. The leader must be defeated or this will never end.
dialogsBegin.fr: (Secouant la tête) Non, jamais! Nous devons le vaincre avant qu'il nous retrouve! S'il te plaît aide-moi!
dialogsBegin.id: Kita harus mencari tahu. Pemimpin harus dikalahkan atau ini tidak akan pernah berakhir.
dialogsBegin.it: We must find out. The leader must be defeated or this will never end.
dialogsBegin.jp: 詳しいことは言えないが、そいつはかなり凶悪なやつなんだ。そいつがここへ復讐にくる前に、やっつけてくれないだろうか？どうか俺を助けてくれ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 반드시 밝혀내야 해요. 진짜 두목을 처치하지 않으면 끝나지 않을 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: We must find out. The leader must be defeated or this will never end.
dialogsBegin.pl: We must find out. The leader must be defeated or this will never end.
dialogsBegin.ru: Дарконский кузнец, мой большой приятель, которому я жаловался на "товарищей", написал, что видел в Гутанских горах громилу с большим красным значком на груди.
dialogsBegin.sp: Debemos averiguarlo. Hay que derrotar al líder o esto nunca terminará.
dialogsBegin.sw: We must find out. The leader must be defeated or this will never end.
dialogsBegin.th: เราต้องค้นหาความจริง ต้องจัดการหัวหน้าพวกนั้น ไม่งั้นเรื่องนี้ก็ไม่มีวันจบ
dialogsBegin.tw: 反正，等到他找到我之前，我一定要先把他找出來殺掉，幫我好嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Chúng ta phải tìm ra. Người đứng đầu phải bị đánh bại nếu không chuyện này sẽ không bao giờ kết thúc.

dialogsBegin.en: I've just received information from one of my colleagues in Darkon 2. I believe we've identified him. Will you help me once again, my friend?
dialogsBegin.ar: I've just received information from one of my colleagues in Darkon 2. I believe we've identified him. Will you help me once again, my friend?
dialogsBegin.br: Nós realmente precisamos derrotá-lo. Acabei de receber informações de um de meus colegas em Darkon 2. Acho que o identificamos. Você pode me ajudar mais uma vez, amigo(a)?
dialogsBegin.cns: 拜托!一定要把他找出来杀掉，这是我最后拜托你的了，拜托帮我好吗?
dialogsBegin.de: Bitte.. wir müssen ihn wirklich besiegen.. Dies ist mein letzter Wunsch.
dialogsBegin.fi: I've just received information from one of my colleagues in Darkon 2. I believe we've identified him. Will you help me once again, my friend?
dialogsBegin.fil: I've just received information from one of my colleagues in Darkon 2. I believe we've identified him. Will you help me once again, my friend?
dialogsBegin.fr: s'il te plaît.. Nous devons vraiment le vaincre.. C'est mon dernier souhait.. s'il te plaît..
dialogsBegin.id: Saya baru saja menerima informasi dari salah satu rekan saya di Darkon 2. Saya yakin kami telah mengidentifikasi dia. Maukah kamu membantu saya sekali lagi, temanku?
dialogsBegin.it: I've just received information from one of my colleagues in Darkon 2. I believe we've identified him. Will you help me once again, my friend?
dialogsBegin.jp: そいつが復讐にくる前に、やっつけてほしいんだ！僕は君ほど腕っぷしに自信がないから、力を貸してくれるとありがたい。
dialogsBegin.kr: 방금 다콘 제2지구에 있는 동료에게 정보를 받았어요. 그놈을 찾은 것 같아요. 한 번만 더 도와주실 수 없을까요?
dialogsBegin.nl: I've just received information from one of my colleagues in Darkon 2. I believe we've identified him. Will you help me once again, my friend?
dialogsBegin.pl: I've just received information from one of my colleagues in Darkon 2. I believe we've identified him. Will you help me once again, my friend?
dialogsBegin.ru: Уж не наш ли это главарь?.. Надо бы проверить, а?
dialogsBegin.sp: Acabo de recibir información de uno de mis colegas de Darkon 2. Creo que lo hemos identificado. ¿Me ayudarás una vez más, amigo mío?
dialogsBegin.sw: I've just received information from one of my colleagues in Darkon 2. I believe we've identified him. Will you help me once again, my friend?
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันเพิ่งได้รับข้อมูลจากเพื่อนร่วมงานคนหนึ่งใน Darkon 2 ฉันว่าเรารู้ตัวจริงของเขาแล้ว คุณจะช่วยฉันอีกครั้งได้ไหม เพื่อน?
dialogsBegin.tw: 我剛收到一位在得肯第二區的同僚傳來的消息。我想我們已經鎖定他了。你願意再幫我一次嗎，我的朋友？
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi vừa nhận được thông tin từ một trong những đồng nghiệp của tôi trong Darkon 2. Tôi tin rằng chúng tôi đã xác định được anh ta. Bạn sẽ giúp tôi một lần nữa được không, bạn của tôi?

dialogsAccept.en: Thank you! The information I gathered is that his name is Lord Bang. He was last seen near the Gouthan Mountains in Darkon 2.
dialogsAccept.ar: Thank you! The information I gathered is that his name is Lord Bang. He was last seen near the Gouthan Mountains in Darkon 2.
dialogsAccept.br: Obrigado! A informação que recebi é que seu nome é Lorde Bang. Ele foi visto pela última vez perto das montanhas Gouthan em Darkon 2.
dialogsAccept.cns: 谢谢你!他叫魔导战甲王，听说在达肯，去达肯永恒森林找找吧。
dialogsAccept.de: Danke, danke sehr! Sein Name ist Lord Bang, er lebt irgendwo in Darkon. Bitte gehe dort hin und mache ihn ausfindig.
dialogsAccept.fi: Thank you! The information I gathered is that his name is Lord Bang. He was last seen near the Gouthan Mountains in Darkon 2.
dialogsAccept.fil: Thank you! The information I gathered is that his name is Lord Bang. He was last seen near the Gouthan Mountains in Darkon 2.
dialogsAccept.fr: Merci, merci. Son nom est Lord Bang Nayonah et il vit quelque part dans Darkon. Va là-bas et trouve-le.
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih! Informasi yang saya kumpulkan adalah bahwa namanya adalah Lord Bang. Dia terakhir terlihat di dekat Pegunungan Gouthan di Darkon 2.
dialogsAccept.it: Thank you! The information I gathered is that his name is Lord Bang. He was last seen near the Gouthan Mountains in Darkon 2.
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとう！そいつは＜ロードヴァン＞と呼ばれていて、ダーコン地区の山のどこかに潜んでいるという噂がある。ダーコンへ行ってみてくれないか？
dialogsAccept.kr: 고마워요! 제가 모은 정보에 따르면, 그의 이름은 로드 뱅이고, 다콘 제2지구의 고우단 산맥 근처에서 마지막으로 목격됐다더군요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Thank you! The information I gathered is that his name is Lord Bang. He was last seen near the Gouthan Mountains in Darkon 2.
dialogsAccept.pl: Thank you! The information I gathered is that his name is Lord Bang. He was last seen near the Gouthan Mountains in Darkon 2.
dialogsAccept.ru: Отлично! Зовут этого громилу Папашей Громом. Кузнец видел его в Гутанских горах на Дарконе-1.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Gracias! La información que he conseguido es que se llama Señor Bang. Fue visto por última vez cerca de las Montañas Gouthan en Darkon 2.
dialogsAccept.sw: Thank you! The information I gathered is that his name is Lord Bang. He was last seen near the Gouthan Mountains in Darkon 2.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอบคุณ! ข้อมูลที่ฉันได้มา ชื่อของเขาคือ Lord Bang พบเห็นเขาครั้งสุดท้ายที่ Gouthan Mountains ใน Darkon 2
dialogsAccept.tw: 謝謝你！我收集的訊息指出他叫崩崩領主。聽說最後出沒在得肯第二區，古坦山脈附近。
dialogsAccept.vi: Cảm ơn bạn! Thông tin tôi thu thập được anh ta tên là Lord Bang. Lần cuối cùng anh ta được nhìn thấy ở gần Gouthan Mountains trong Darkon 2.

dialogsDecline.en: We are so close to putting an end to this nuisance for good! Please, help us!
dialogsDecline.ar: We are so close to putting an end to this nuisance for good! Please, help us!
dialogsDecline.br: Estamos tão perto de acabar com esse incômodo para sempre! Por favor nos ajude!
dialogsDecline.de: ......(Weinend)
dialogsDecline.fi: We are so close to putting an end to this nuisance for good! Please, help us!
dialogsDecline.fil: We are so close to putting an end to this nuisance for good! Please, help us!
dialogsDecline.fr: ......(Pleurant)
dialogsDecline.id: Kami sangat dekat untuk mengakhiri gangguan ini untuk selamanya! Tolong bantu kami!
dialogsDecline.it: We are so close to putting an end to this nuisance for good! Please, help us!
dialogsDecline.jp: あいつは本当に恐ろしいやつなんだよ。困ったものだ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 정말 끝을 볼 수 있어요. 이 귀찮은 문제를 완전히 해결할 기회예요. 도와주세요!
dialogsDecline.nl: We are so close to putting an end to this nuisance for good! Please, help us!
dialogsDecline.pl: We are so close to putting an end to this nuisance for good! Please, help us!
dialogsDecline.ru: Прошу, помоги! Иначе "Труппа товарищей" так и будет обижать жителей Фларинции.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Estamos tan cerca de acabar con esta situación para siempre! ¡Por favor ayúdanos!
dialogsDecline.sw: We are so close to putting an end to this nuisance for good! Please, help us!
dialogsDecline.th: เราใกล้จะจบเรื่องนี้ได้ด้วยดีแล้วล่ะนะ! ได้โปรดช่วยเราด้วยเถอะ!
dialogsDecline.tw: 我們就快能徹底解決這個麻煩了！請幫幫我們！
dialogsDecline.vi: Chúng ta sắp kết thúc tốt đẹp sự phiền toái này rồi! Làm ơn giúp chúng tôi!

dialogsComplete.en: You defeated Lord Bang? Thank goodness! Now we can live without fear of his retaliation. Thank you so much, my friend.
dialogsComplete.ar: You defeated Lord Bang? Thank goodness! Now we can live without fear of his retaliation. Thank you so much, my friend.
dialogsComplete.br: Você derrotou o Lorde Bang? Que glória! Agora podemos viver sem medo de sua retaliação. Muito obrigado, amigo(a).
dialogsComplete.cns: 嗯..果然是我知道的家伙..现在我就安心了。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Lord Bang besiegt? Dem Himmel sei Dank! Jetzt können wir ohne Angst vor seiner Vergeltung leben. Ich danke dir sehr, mein Freund.
dialogsComplete.fi: You defeated Lord Bang? Thank goodness! Now we can live without fear of his retaliation. Thank you so much, my friend.
dialogsComplete.fil: You defeated Lord Bang? Thank goodness! Now we can live without fear of his retaliation. Thank you so much, my friend.
dialogsComplete.fr: Hmm.. C'est bien celui auquel je pensais.. Maintenant nous pouvons vivre normalement, il n'est plus de ce monde. Pfiou!
dialogsComplete.id: kamu mengalahkan Tuan Bang? Untunglah! Sekarang kita bisa hidup tanpa takut akan pembalasannya. Terimakasih banyak temanku.
dialogsComplete.it: You defeated Lord Bang? Thank goodness! Now we can live without fear of his retaliation. Thank you so much, my friend.
dialogsComplete.jp: やっぱり俺の知っていたやつだったよ。でも、勇敢な君がやっつけてくれたおかげでもう安心だ。本当にありがとう！
dialogsComplete.kr: 로드 뱅을 물리쳤다고요? 정말 다행이군요! 이제 우리도 보복을 두려워하지 않고 살 수 있겠어요. 정말 고마워요, 친구.
dialogsComplete.nl: You defeated Lord Bang? Thank goodness! Now we can live without fear of his retaliation. Thank you so much, my friend.
dialogsComplete.pl: You defeated Lord Bang? Thank goodness! Now we can live without fear of his retaliation. Thank you so much, my friend.
dialogsComplete.ru: You defeated Lord Bang? Thank goodness! Now we can live without fear of his retaliation. Thank you so much, my friend.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿Derrotaste al Señor Bang? ¡Gracias a Dios! Ahora podremos vivir sin temor a sus represalias. Muchas gracias amigo mío.
dialogsComplete.sw: You defeated Lord Bang? Thank goodness! Now we can live without fear of his retaliation. Thank you so much, my friend.
dialogsComplete.th: คุณจัดการ Lord Bang แล้วเหรอ? ขอบคุณพระเจ้า! ตอนนี้เราสามารถมีชีวิตอยู่ได้โดยไม่ต้องกลัวการแก้แค้นของเขา ขอบคุณมากๆ เพื่อน
dialogsComplete.tw: 你打敗了崩崩領主了？謝天謝地！現在我們可以不用擔心被他報復了。非常謝謝你，我的朋友。
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn đã đánh bại Lord Bang? Ơn Chúa! Bây giờ chúng tôi có thể sống mà không sợ bị trả thù. Cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều bạn của tôi.

dialogsFail.en: You must hurry! He has to be defeated before he retaliates! Go to Darkon 2 and find him now!
dialogsFail.ar: You must hurry! He has to be defeated before he retaliates! Go to Darkon 2 and find him now!
dialogsFail.br: Depressa! Nós não temos tempo a perder! Não vai demorar muito até que ele nos encontre. Nós temos que derrotá-lo o mais rápido possível para prevenir o desastre.
dialogsFail.cns: 快..没多少时间了，他应该快找到这里了，等他找到这里的话，会发生很多灾难的..
dialogsFail.de: Beeilung! Wir haben wenig Zeit! Es wird nicht lange dauern, bis er uns findet. Wir müssen ihn so bald wie möglich besiegen um ein Desaster verhindern zu können.
dialogsFail.fi: You must hurry! He has to be defeated before he retaliates! Go to Darkon 2 and find him now!
dialogsFail.fil: You must hurry! He has to be defeated before he retaliates! Go to Darkon 2 and find him now!
dialogsFail.fr: Dépêches-toi! Nous avons peu de temps! Il ne mettra pas longtemps à nous trouver. Nous devons le battre aussi vite que possible pour empêcher un vrai carnage..
dialogsFail.id: kamu harus cepat! Dia harus dikalahkan sebelum dia membalas! Pergi ke Darkon 2 dan temukan dia sekarang!
dialogsFail.it: You must hurry! He has to be defeated before he retaliates! Go to Darkon 2 and find him now!
dialogsFail.jp: なるだけ早く見つけてやっつけてくれ、時間がないんだ。もう少しで彼がここを見つけてしまう、その前に早く！
dialogsFail.kr: 서둘러야 해요! 녀석이 보복하기 전에 먼저 처치하세요! 당장 다콘 제2지구로 가서 로드 뱅을 찾으세요!
dialogsFail.nl: You must hurry! He has to be defeated before he retaliates! Go to Darkon 2 and find him now!
dialogsFail.pl: You must hurry! He has to be defeated before he retaliates! Go to Darkon 2 and find him now!
dialogsFail.ru: Поспеши! Пока главарь чувствует за собой силу, этот кошмар не кончится. Отправляйся на Даркон-1 и найди его!
dialogsFail.sp: ¡Hay que darse prisa! ¡Hay que derrotarlo antes de que tome represalias! ¡Ve a Darkon 2 y encuéntralo ya!
dialogsFail.sw: You must hurry! He has to be defeated before he retaliates! Go to Darkon 2 and find him now!
dialogsFail.th: คุณต้องรีบหน่อย! เขาต้องถูกกำจัดก่อนที่เขาจะตอบโต้กลับมา! ไปที่ Darkon 2 และตามหาเขาซะ!
dialogsFail.tw: 快，沒多少時間了！他必須在報復之前被打倒，快去得肯第二區找到他！
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn phải nhanh lên! Anh ta phải bị đánh bại trước khi trả đũa! Đi đến Darkon 2 và tìm anh ta ngay bây giờ!

name.vi: Hành Trình của một nhà thám hiểm (2)

description.en: Find the Sage Radion to decode the writing in the Diary.
description.ar: Find the Sage Radion to decode the writing in the Diary.
description.br: Precisamos achar o Sábio Radion para decifrar isto.
description.cns: 找到大贤者拉迪温来解码日记的内容。
description.de: Finde den Sage Radion, um die Schrift im Tagebuch zu entziffern.
description.fi: Find the Sage Radion to decode the writing in the Diary.
description.fil: Find the Sage Radion to decode the writing in the Diary.
description.fr: Vous devez trouver le très sage Radéon pour décoder le journal.
description.id: Temukan Sage Radion untuk memecahkan tulisan kode didalam Diary.
description.it: Find the Sage Radion to decode the writing in the Diary.
description.jp: 暗号の解読のため、冒険者の手記を｢大賢者｣ラディオンに渡そう。
description.kr: 현자 라디온을 찾아, 일기장에 무엇이 쓰여 있는지 알아보세요.
description.nl: Find the Sage Radion to decode the writing in the Diary.
description.pl: Find the Sage Radion to decode the writing in the Diary.
description.ru: Нужно найти мудреца Энвидия и расшифровать текст дневника.
description.sp: Encuentra al Sabio Radion para descodificar el Diario.
description.sw: Find the Sage Radion to decode the writing in the Diary.
description.th: ค้นหา Sage Radion เพื่อถอดรหัสงานเขียนในไดอารี่
description.tw: 找到大賢者拉迪溫來解碼日記中的文字。
description.vi: Tìm Sage Radion để giải mã chữ viết trong Nhật ký.

dialogsBegin.en: You should hear this. This is the diary of the adventurer Bartholomew Hunt. My grand father knew of him, he was a legend at one time…
dialogsBegin.ar: You should hear this. This is the diary of the adventurer Bartholomew Hunt. My grand father knew of him, he was a legend at one time…
dialogsBegin.br: Você deveria ouvir isso. Este é o diário do aventureiro Bartholomew Hunt. Meu avô sabia dele, ele foi uma lenda um dia…
dialogsBegin.cns: 听着。这是冒险者巴塞洛缪·亨特的日记。我的祖父知道他，他是那个时代的传奇...
dialogsBegin.de: Das sollten Sie hören. Dies ist das Tagebuch des Abenteurers Bartholomew Hunt. Mein Großvater kannte ihn, er war einst eine Legende...
dialogsBegin.fi: You should hear this. This is the diary of the adventurer Bartholomew Hunt. My grand father knew of him, he was a legend at one time…
dialogsBegin.fil: You should hear this. This is the diary of the adventurer Bartholomew Hunt. My grand father knew of him, he was a legend at one time…
dialogsBegin.fr: Avez-vous quelques instants pour écouter cette histoire ? Voici le journal de Harmonin l'Aventurier. Mon grand-père parle de lui tout le temps. Ils étaient amis.
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu harusnya pernah mendengar ini. Ini adalah Diary dari Adventurer Bartholomew Hunt. Kakekku kenal dengannya, Dia adalah legenda pada saat itu...
dialogsBegin.it: You should hear this. This is the diary of the adventurer Bartholomew Hunt. My grand father knew of him, he was a legend at one time…
dialogsBegin.jp: ちょっと聞いてくれ。実は、これはハーモニンという探検家が書いた日記なのだ。私の祖父が彼と友達で、幼い頃私にいつも冒険談を聞かせてくれたことを今でも覚えているよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 들어보세요. 이건 바솔로뮤 헌트라는 모험가의 일기장이었어요. 우리 할아버지께 들은 적이 있어요, 한때 전설 같은 인물이었죠...
dialogsBegin.nl: You should hear this. This is the diary of the adventurer Bartholomew Hunt. My grand father knew of him, he was a legend at one time…
dialogsBegin.pl: You should hear this. This is the diary of the adventurer Bartholomew Hunt. My grand father knew of him, he was a legend at one time…
dialogsBegin.ru: You should hear this. This is the diary of the adventurer Bartholomew Hunt. My grand father knew of him, he was a legend at one time…
dialogsBegin.sp: Deberías escuchar esto. Este es el diario del aventurero Bartholomew Hunt. Mi abuelo lo conocía, fue una leyenda en su momento…
dialogsBegin.sw: You should hear this. This is the diary of the adventurer Bartholomew Hunt. My grand father knew of him, he was a legend at one time…
dialogsBegin.th: คุณควรได้ยินสิ่งนี้ นี่คือไดอารี่ของนักผจญภัย Bartholomew Hunt ปู่ของฉันรู้จักเขา เขาเป็นตำนานในคราวเดียว...
dialogsBegin.tw: 你應該聽到這個。這是冒險家巴塞洛繆·亨特的日誌，我的祖父認識他，他曾經是一個傳奇……
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn nên nghe điều này. Đây là nhật ký của nhà thám hiểm Bartholomew Hunt. Ông nội của tôi biết về ông ấy, ông ấy đã là một huyền thoại một thời…

dialogsBegin.en: HA! Look at this… he is claiming that he discovered a new continent. New continent? How absurd!
dialogsBegin.ar: HA! Look at this… he is claiming that he discovered a new continent. New continent? How absurd!
dialogsBegin.br: HA! Olhe para isso... ele está afirmando que descobriu um novo continente. Novo continente? Que absurdo!
dialogsBegin.cns: 哈！快看...他声称他发现了新大陆。新大陆？这可太荒谬了！
dialogsBegin.de: HA! Sieh dir das an... er behauptet, er habe einen neuen Kontinent entdeckt. Einen neuen Kontinent? Wie absurd!
dialogsBegin.fi: HA! Look at this… he is claiming that he discovered a new continent. New continent? How absurd!
dialogsBegin.fil: HA! Look at this… he is claiming that he discovered a new continent. New continent? How absurd!
dialogsBegin.fr: Ainsi, il a découvert un nouveau continent. Vous rendez-vous compte, tout un continent !!
dialogsBegin.id: HA! Liat ini... Dia mengklaim bahwa dia menemukan continent baru. Continent baru? Tidak masuk akal!
dialogsBegin.it: HA! Look at this… he is claiming that he discovered a new continent. New continent? How absurd!
dialogsBegin.jp: その冒険談の中で新しい大陸を発見したという嘘みたいな話もしてくれた。新しい大陸？そんなバカな！と思ったものだよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 하! 여길 좀 보세요… 새로운 대륙을 발견했다고 주장하고 있어요. 새로운 대륙이라니요? 말도 안 되죠!
dialogsBegin.nl: HA! Look at this… he is claiming that he discovered a new continent. New continent? How absurd!
dialogsBegin.pl: HA! Look at this… he is claiming that he discovered a new continent. New continent? How absurd!
dialogsBegin.ru: HA! Look at this… he is claiming that he discovered a new continent. New continent? How absurd!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡AJA! Mira esto... Aquí está afirmando que descubrió un nuevo continente. ¿Un nuevo continente? ¡Qué absurdo!
dialogsBegin.sw: HA! Look at this… he is claiming that he discovered a new continent. New continent? How absurd!
dialogsBegin.th: ฮา! ดูนี่สิ… เขาอ้างว่าเขาค้นพบทวีปใหม่ ทวีปใหม่? ช่างไร้สาระเหลือเกิน!
dialogsBegin.tw: 哈！看這個……他說他發現了一個新大陸。新大陸？多麼荒謬！
dialogsBegin.vi: Chà! Nhìn này ... anh ấy đang tuyên bố rằng anh ấy đã khám phá ra một lục địa mới. Lục địa mới? Thật là ngớ ngẩn!

dialogsBegin.en: I can't read the writing here, it appears to be a code of some sort. Maybe the Sage Radion can figure out what this writing is. Please bring him the diary.
dialogsBegin.ar: I can't read the writing here, it appears to be a code of some sort. Maybe the Sage Radion can figure out what this writing is. Please bring him the diary.
dialogsBegin.br: Não consigo ler esta escrita, parece ser algum tipo de código. Talvez o Sábio Radion possa descobrir o que é. Por favor, leve o diário até ele.
dialogsBegin.cns: 这部分内容看起来像是某种代码，我没办法理解。大贤者拉迪温可能能认出这写的是什么。请将日记带给他。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich kann die Schrift hier nicht lesen, es scheint eine Art Code zu sein. Vielleicht kann der Sage Radion herausfinden, was diese Schrift bedeutet. Bitte bringt ihm das Tagebuch.
dialogsBegin.fi: I can't read the writing here, it appears to be a code of some sort. Maybe the Sage Radion can figure out what this writing is. Please bring him the diary.
dialogsBegin.fil: I can't read the writing here, it appears to be a code of some sort. Maybe the Sage Radion can figure out what this writing is. Please bring him the diary.
dialogsBegin.fr: Hum. Vous avez lu ce qui est écrit dans le journal ? On dirait une sorte de code… Je vais avoir besoin de l'aide du très sage Radéon. Pourriez-vous lui apporter ce journal ?
dialogsBegin.id: Aku tidak bisa membaca tulisan ini, sepertinya ini semacam kode. Mungkin Sage Radion bisa menerjemahkan tulisan apa ini. Tolong bawa Diary ini padanya.
dialogsBegin.it: I can't read the writing here, it appears to be a code of some sort. Maybe the Sage Radion can figure out what this writing is. Please bring him the diary.
dialogsBegin.jp: この日記を見たまえ。この文字は何かの暗号のようだが…｢大賢者｣ラディオンなら読むことができるかもしれない。君、この日記を｢大賢者｣ラディオンに渡してくれないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 여기 적힌 문장은 읽을 수가 없네요. 무슨 암호 같은데. 현자 라디온이라면 해독할 수 있을지도 몰라요. 라디온에게 이 일지를 보여주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I can't read the writing here, it appears to be a code of some sort. Maybe the Sage Radion can figure out what this writing is. Please bring him the diary.
dialogsBegin.pl: I can't read the writing here, it appears to be a code of some sort. Maybe the Sage Radion can figure out what this writing is. Please bring him the diary.
dialogsBegin.ru: Не могу прочитать, что тут написано - наверное, какой-то шифр. Если кто и знает ключ, то только мудрец Энвидий. Отнесешь дневник ему?
dialogsBegin.sp: No puedo leerlo, parece ser un código de algún tipo. Tal vez el Sabio Radion pueda descubrirlo. Por favor llévale el diario.
dialogsBegin.sw: I can't read the writing here, it appears to be a code of some sort. Maybe the Sage Radion can figure out what this writing is. Please bring him the diary.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันไม่สามารถอ่านการเขียนที่นี่ ดูเหมือนว่าจะเป็นรหัสบางอย่าง บางทีนักปราชญ์เรดิโอนอาจรู้ว่างานเขียนนี้คืออะไร กรุณานำไดอารี่มาให้เขาด้วย
dialogsBegin.tw: 我看不懂這裡的文字，它似乎是某種代碼。也許大賢者拉迪溫可以弄清楚這篇文章是什麼。請把日誌帶給他。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi không thể đọc chữ viết ở đây, nó có vẻ là một đoạn mã nào đó. Có lẽ Sage Radion có thể tìm ra cách viết này. Hãy mang cho anh ấy cuốn nhật ký.

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?

dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？

dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?

dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Marche wants you to collect Starstones to make a 10 year anniversary gift. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.ar: Marche wants you to collect Starstones to make a 10 year anniversary gift. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.br: Marche quer que você colete Pedras-Estrelas para fazer um presente de 10º aniversário. Você poderia ajudar?

description.en: Investigate the inside of the Mars Mine. Once inside, investigate the masquerpets you find.
description.ar: Investigate the inside of the Mars Mine. Once inside, investigate the masquerpets you find.
description.br: Por favor, desta vez investigue o interior da Masmorra Mars. Por favor, investigue também os Masquerpets de lá.

description.de: Bitte untersuche das Innere des Mas Dungeons und schau dir die Monster genauer an, die dort leben.
description.fi: Investigate the inside of the Mars Mine. Once inside, investigate the masquerpets you find.
description.fil: Investigate the inside of the Mars Mine. Once inside, investigate the masquerpets you find.
description.fr: Étudier l'intérieur de la Mine de Mas ainsi que les monstres s'y trouvant.
description.id: Selidiki bagian dalam Tambang Mars. Begitu masuk, selidiki topeng yang kamu temukan.
description.it: Investigate the inside of the Mars Mine. Once inside, investigate the masquerpets you find.
description.jp: フラリスダンジョンの奥深くまで探索しましょう。また、指定されたモンスターを倒してましょう。
description.kr: 마스 마인 내부를 조사하세요. 안에서 마주치는 마스커펫들도 함께 조사해 주세요.
description.nl: Investigate the inside of the Mars Mine. Once inside, investigate the masquerpets you find.
description.pl: Investigate the inside of the Mars Mine. Once inside, investigate the masquerpets you find.

description.sw: Investigate the inside of the Mars Mine. Once inside, investigate the masquerpets you find.
description.th: สำรวจด้านในของ Mars Mine ตรวจสอบ masquerpets ที่คุณพบ

dialogsBegin.en: I cannot be sure by only investigating the entrance. I need more detailed information…
dialogsBegin.ar: I cannot be sure by only investigating the entrance. I need more detailed information…
dialogsBegin.br: Ainda não tenho certeza apenas com a investigação da entrada. Preciso de informações mais detalhadas...
dialogsBegin.cns: 只探索魔域密殿入口附近还是不够！！
dialogsBegin.de: Ich kann leider nicht sicher sein, wenn wir nur den Eingang überprüfen. Ich brauche mehr Informationen..
dialogsBegin.fi: I cannot be sure by only investigating the entrance. I need more detailed information…
dialogsBegin.fil: I cannot be sure by only investigating the entrance. I need more detailed information…
dialogsBegin.fr: C'est toujours pareil, je ne pourrai être sûr de rien en examinant uniquement l'entrée. J'ai besoin d'informations plus détaillées.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya tidak bisa memastikan dengan hanya menyelidiki pintu masuk. Saya butuh informasi lebih detail…
dialogsBegin.it: I cannot be sure by only investigating the entrance. I need more detailed information…
dialogsBegin.jp: 入口周辺の情報だけでは、洞窟内で何が起きているのか、核心に迫ることはできません。もっと多くの情報がどうしても欲しいですね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 아무리 생각해 봐도, 입구만 조사해서는 확신할 수 없어요. 더 자세한 정보가 필요한데…
dialogsBegin.nl: I cannot be sure by only investigating the entrance. I need more detailed information…
dialogsBegin.pl: I cannot be sure by only investigating the entrance. I need more detailed information…
dialogsBegin.ru: Нет, так дело не пойдет... Мало! Мало информации!
dialogsBegin.sp: No puedo estar seguro con sólo investigar la entrada. Necesito información más detallada...
dialogsBegin.sw: I cannot be sure by only investigating the entrance. I need more detailed information…
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันไม่สามารถแน่ใจได้ด้วยการตรวจสอบทางเข้าอย่างเดียว ฉันต้องการข้อมูลเพิ่มเติม...
dialogsBegin.tw: 只探索瑪斯礦坑入口附近還是不夠！！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi chắc chắn không thể chỉ điều tra lối vào. Tôi cần thêm thông tin chi tiết…

dialogsBegin.en: (Looks at you imploringly) Would you please, please bring me more detailed information?
dialogsBegin.ar: (Looks at you imploringly) Would you please, please bring me more detailed information?
dialogsBegin.br: (Olha para você, implorando) Você poderia, por favor, me trazer informações mais detalhadas? Eu nunca pediria desta maneira a você se...
dialogsBegin.cns: (露出哀怨的眼神)可以帮我多搜集一些资料吗？如果你没有很重要的事的话……
dialogsBegin.de: (Sieht dich flehend an) Würdest du mir bitte, bitte genauere Informationen bringen?
dialogsBegin.fi: (Looks at you imploringly) Would you please, please bring me more detailed information?
dialogsBegin.fil: (Looks at you imploringly) Would you please, please bring me more detailed information?
dialogsBegin.fr: (Avec un regard suppliant) Tu voudrais bien me ramener davantage d'informations, s'il te plaît? Je ne te demanderais jamais une telle chose si.
dialogsBegin.id: (Melihat Anda memohon) Tolong, tolong berikan saya informasi yang lebih rinci?
dialogsBegin.it: (Looks at you imploringly) Would you please, please bring me more detailed information?
dialogsBegin.jp: （お悔やみ申し上げます）詳しい情報を教えていただけませんか。
dialogsBegin.kr: (애절한 눈빛으로 바라보며) 좀 더 자세한 자료를 구해 주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: (Looks at you imploringly) Would you please, please bring me more detailed information?
dialogsBegin.pl: (Looks at you imploringly) Would you please, please bring me more detailed information?
dialogsBegin.ru: (Доктор просительно смотрит на вас.) Помоги мне, пожалуйста!
dialogsBegin.sp: (Te mira suplicantemente) ¿Podrías traerme información más detallada porfi?
dialogsBegin.sw: (Looks at you imploringly) Would you please, please bring me more detailed information?
dialogsBegin.th: (มองคุณอย่างอ้อนวอน) คุณช่วยนำข้อมูลเพิ่มเติมมาให้ฉันได้มั้ย
dialogsBegin.tw: (露出哀怨的眼神) 可以幫我多蒐集一些資料嗎？如果你沒有很重要的事的話……
dialogsBegin.vi: (Nhìn bạn cầu xin) Bạn vui lòng cho mình xin thông tin chi tiết hơn được không?

dialogsBegin.en: I wouldn't ask if it weren't very, very important. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.ar: I wouldn't ask if it weren't very, very important. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.br: ...se não fosse tão importante. Você poderia me ajudar mais uma vez, por favor?
dialogsBegin.cns: 就再帮我一次，拜托你了！
dialogsBegin.de: ..so wichtig wäre. Würdest du mir bitte noch einmal helfen?
dialogsBegin.fi: I wouldn't ask if it weren't very, very important. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.fil: I wouldn't ask if it weren't very, very important. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.fr: ...si ce n'était pas si important. Pourrais-tu m'apporter ton aide une fois de plus ?
dialogsBegin.id: Saya tidak akan bertanya apakah itu tidak terlalu, sangat penting. Maukah kamu membantu?
dialogsBegin.it: I wouldn't ask if it weren't very, very important. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.jp: あれ？あなたがいたじゃないですか！お願いです！もう一度、調査に協力していただけませんか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 정말 중요한 일이라 부탁하는 거예요. 도와주실 거죠?
dialogsBegin.nl: I wouldn't ask if it weren't very, very important. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.pl: I wouldn't ask if it weren't very, very important. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.ru: Не будь это так важно, я бы не стал умолять. Ты мне поможешь?
dialogsBegin.sp: No te lo pediría si no fuera muy, muy importante. ¿Me ayudarás?
dialogsBegin.sw: I wouldn't ask if it weren't very, very important. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันจะไม่ขอร้องให้ช่วยถ้ามันไม่สำคัญ คุณช่วยได้มั้ย
dialogsBegin.tw: 就再幫我一次，拜託你了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi sẽ không nhờ giúp đỡ nếu đó không phải rất, rất quan trọng. Bạn sẽ giúp chứ?

dialogsAccept.en: Thank you! This time, investigate the inside of the Mars Mine. Also, please investigate the masquerpets there.
dialogsAccept.ar: Thank you! This time, investigate the inside of the Mars Mine. Also, please investigate the masquerpets there.
dialogsAccept.br: Obrigado! Por favor, desta vez investigue o interior da Masmorra Mars. Por favor, investigue também os Masquerpets de lá.
dialogsAccept.cns: 谢谢！这次帮我探索一下魔域密殿入的内部好吗？顺便调查一下魔域密殿里的魔域怪！！
dialogsAccept.de: Danke! Bitte untersuche diesmal das Innere des Mas Dungeons. Bei dieser Gelegenheit kannst du auch gleich mal die Monster dort unter die Lupe nehmen.
dialogsAccept.fi: Thank you! This time, investigate the inside of the Mars Mine. Also, please investigate the masquerpets there.
dialogsAccept.fil: Thank you! This time, investigate the inside of the Mars Mine. Also, please investigate the masquerpets there.
dialogsAccept.fr: Merci ! S'il te plaît va étudier l'intérieur de Mine de Mas cette fois-ci, ainsi que les monstres s'y trouvant.
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih! Kali ini, selidiki bagian dalam Tambang Mars. Juga, tolong selidiki topeng-topeng di sana.
dialogsAccept.it: Thank you! This time, investigate the inside of the Mars Mine. Also, please investigate the masquerpets there.
dialogsAccept.jp: 助かります。今回はフラリスダンジョンの奥まで探索し、モンスターの調査を行ってください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 고마워요! 이번엔 마스 마인 내부를 조사해 주세요. 거기 있는 마스커펫들도 함께 조사해 주시고요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Thank you! This time, investigate the inside of the Mars Mine. Also, please investigate the masquerpets there.
dialogsAccept.pl: Thank you! This time, investigate the inside of the Mars Mine. Also, please investigate the masquerpets there.
dialogsAccept.ru: Спасибо! На этот раз спустись в шахту. И хорошенько присмотрись к ее обитателям.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Gracias! Esta vez, investiga el interior de la Mina Mars. De paso investiga los masquerpets que hay allí.
dialogsAccept.sw: Thank you! This time, investigate the inside of the Mars Mine. Also, please investigate the masquerpets there.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอบคุณ! ทีนี้ก็ไปสำรวจภายใน Mars Mine กรุณาตรวจมอนสเตอร์ในนั่นด้วย
dialogsAccept.tw: 謝謝！這次幫我探索一下瑪斯礦坑的內部好嗎？順便調查一下瑪斯礦坑裡的怪物！！
dialogsAccept.vi: Cảm ơn bạn! Lần này, hãy điều tra bên trong Mars Mine. Ngoài ra, vui lòng điều tra masquerpets ở đó.

dialogsDecline.en: It's not like I'm asking you for your first born child…
dialogsDecline.ar: It's not like I'm asking you for your first born child…
dialogsDecline.br: É tão difícil assim me ajudar mais uma vez? Por que você é tão mesquinho?
dialogsDecline.cns: 再帮我一次有这么难吗?你怎么这么小气啊？
dialogsDecline.de: Ist es so schwer mir nochmal zu helfen? Warum bist du so stur?
dialogsDecline.fi: It's not like I'm asking you for your first born child…
dialogsDecline.fil: It's not like I'm asking you for your first born child…
dialogsDecline.fr: C'est si dur de m'aider une nouvelle fois ?
dialogsDecline.id: Bukannya aku memintamu untuk anak sulungmu…
dialogsDecline.it: It's not like I'm asking you for your first born child…
dialogsDecline.jp: ダメですか…。フラリスダンジョンの奥にまで足を踏み入れるのが怖いんですね。あなたという人は…その程度の人だったんですか？
dialogsDecline.kr: 도와주시는 김에 한 번 더 도와주는 게 그렇게 어렵나요?
dialogsDecline.nl: It's not like I'm asking you for your first born child…
dialogsDecline.pl: It's not like I'm asking you for your first born child…
dialogsDecline.ru: Можно подумать, я тебя прошу о чем-то страшном.
dialogsDecline.sp: No es como si te estuviera preguntando por tu primer hijo…
dialogsDecline.sw: It's not like I'm asking you for your first born child…
dialogsDecline.th: ไม่ใช่ว่าฉันจะขอลูกคนแรกของคุณ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 再幫我一次有這麼難嗎？你怎麼這麼小氣啊？
dialogsDecline.vi: Nó không giống như tôi đang hỏi bạn về đứa con đầu lòng của bạn…

dialogsComplete.en: Oh no… We're doomed! What are we going to do!?
dialogsComplete.ar: Oh no… We're doomed! What are we going to do!?
dialogsComplete.br: Oh, não... Estamos condenados! O que iremos fazer?!
dialogsComplete.cns: 事有蹊翘，这下该怎么办才好…？
dialogsComplete.de: Oh nein... Wir sind dem Untergang geweiht! Was sollen wir nur tun?
dialogsComplete.fi: Oh no… We're doomed! What are we going to do!?
dialogsComplete.fil: Oh no… We're doomed! What are we going to do!?
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh mon Dieu... C'est le désastre que je redoutais... Que faire maintenant...
dialogsComplete.id: Oh tidak… Kita ditakdirkan! Apa yang akan kita lakukan!?
dialogsComplete.it: Oh no… We're doomed! What are we going to do!?
dialogsComplete.jp: 私の想像を超える最悪のシナリオです。
dialogsComplete.kr: 아… 이런… 이제 끝장이에요! 어떻게 하면 좋죠!?
dialogsComplete.nl: Oh no… We're doomed! What are we going to do!?
dialogsComplete.pl: Oh no… We're doomed! What are we going to do!?
dialogsComplete.ru: О нет! Нам конец! Что же делать?
dialogsComplete.sp: Oh no... ¡Estamos condenados! ¿¡Qué vamos a hacer!?
dialogsComplete.sw: Oh no… We're doomed! What are we going to do!?
dialogsComplete.th: ไม่จริง... เราจบเห่แล้ว! เราจะทำยังไงดี!?
dialogsComplete.tw: 事有蹊蹺，這下該怎麼辦才好…？
dialogsComplete.vi: Ồ không… Chúng ta bị tiêu diệt! Chúng ta sẽ làm gì đây!?

dialogsFail.en: I know it sounds dangerous, but you've got to be brave. This is very important.
dialogsFail.ar: I know it sounds dangerous, but you've got to be brave. This is very important.
dialogsFail.br: Sei que é muito difícil e perigoso investigar o interior da masmorra, mas você precisa fazê-lo! Por favor!
dialogsFail.cns: 我也知道调查魔域密殿入的内部并不简单，但是，除了你没有其他人能够胜任！
dialogsFail.de: Ich weiß das es sehr schwer und gefährlich ist das Innere der Mine zu untersuchen, aber du musst es tun! Bitte!
dialogsFail.fi: I know it sounds dangerous, but you've got to be brave. This is very important.
dialogsFail.fil: I know it sounds dangerous, but you've got to be brave. This is very important.
dialogsFail.fr: Je sais qu'il est difficile et dangereux d'explorer l'intérieur, mais c'est vraiment important.
dialogsFail.id: Saya tahu kedengarannya berbahaya, tetapi kamu harus berani. Ini sangat penting.
dialogsFail.it: I know it sounds dangerous, but you've got to be brave. This is very important.
dialogsFail.jp: フラリスダンジョンの内部調査です。楽じゃないことはわかっています。でも、あなたの調査結果が必要なんですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 위험하다는 거 알아요. 하지만 용기를 내야 해요. 정말 중요한 일이라고요.
dialogsFail.nl: I know it sounds dangerous, but you've got to be brave. This is very important.
dialogsFail.pl: I know it sounds dangerous, but you've got to be brave. This is very important.
dialogsFail.ru: Понимаю, что это опасно, поэтому и рассчитываю на твою храбрость. Это очень важно.
dialogsFail.sp: Sé que suena peligroso, pero tienes que ser valiente. Esto es muy importante.
dialogsFail.sw: I know it sounds dangerous, but you've got to be brave. This is very important.
dialogsFail.th: ฉันรู้ว่ามันฟังดูอันตราย แต่คุณต้องกล้าหาญ นี่สำคัญมาก
dialogsFail.tw: 我也知道調查瑪斯礦坑的內部並不簡單，但是，除了你沒有其他人能夠勝任！
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi biết điều đó nghe có vẻ nguy hiểm, nhưng bạn phải dũng cảm lên. Điều này rất quan trọng.

dialogsBegin.en: Well, here's to hoping! Hmm, Rankashu mentioned something about a strange woman. I wonder who it could be...
dialogsBegin.ar: Well, here's to hoping! Hmm, Rankashu mentioned something about a strange woman. I wonder who it could be...
dialogsBegin.br: Bem, há esperança! Hmm, Rankashu mencionou algo sobre uma mulher estranha. Eu me pergunto quem poderia ser...
dialogsBegin.cns: 好吧，为希望干杯! 嗯，小草儿提到了关于一个陌生女人的事情。我想知道这个人可能是谁...
dialogsBegin.de: Nun, wir wollen es hoffen! Hmm, Rankashu erwähnte etwas von einer seltsamen Frau. Ich frage mich, wer das sein könnte...
dialogsBegin.fi: Well, here's to hoping! Hmm, Rankashu mentioned something about a strange woman. I wonder who it could be...
dialogsBegin.fil: Well, here's to hoping! Hmm, Rankashu mentioned something about a strange woman. I wonder who it could be...
dialogsBegin.fr: J'espère que ça sera efficace... pendant que vous étiez parti, j'ai vu une femme entrer seule dans la mine de Dekanes. Je me demande si c'était un Héros.
dialogsBegin.id: Inilah harapannya! Hmm, Rankashu menyebutkan sesuatu tentang wanita aneh. Saya ingin tahu siapa itu...
dialogsBegin.it: Well, here's to hoping! Hmm, Rankashu mentioned something about a strange woman. I wonder who it could be...
dialogsBegin.jp: まあ、とにかくありがとう。気休めでも嬉しいものだ。ところで英雄についてはどうだ？　ん……なるほど。その女性は確かに怪しいな。
dialogsBegin.kr: 뭐, 잘 되길 바라야죠! 흠, 랑카슈가 수상한 여자에 대해 무슨 말을 했다고 하던데요. 과연 정체가 뭘까요…
dialogsBegin.nl: Well, here's to hoping! Hmm, Rankashu mentioned something about a strange woman. I wonder who it could be...
dialogsBegin.pl: Well, here's to hoping! Hmm, Rankashu mentioned something about a strange woman. I wonder who it could be...
dialogsBegin.ru: Well, here's to hoping! Hmm, Rankashu mentioned something about a strange woman. I wonder who it could be...
dialogsBegin.sp: Bueno, ¡hay que mantener la esperanza! Hmm, Rankashu mencionó algo sobre una mujer extraña. Me pregunto quién podría ser...
dialogsBegin.sw: Well, here's to hoping! Hmm, Rankashu mentioned something about a strange woman. I wonder who it could be...
dialogsBegin.th: ดี นี่คือการหวัง! อืม Rankashu กล่าวถึงบางอย่างเกี่ยวกับผู้หญิงแปลก ฉันสงสัยว่าใครจะทำได้ .. AHH เหล่า Carrierbombs ที่โง่เขลากลับมาแล้ว !!
dialogsBegin.tw: 總而言之，謝謝你了。我要快點熬煮來吃。咦？你說有一個女人獨自進入迪坎礦坑嗎？雖然還無法斷定他就是英雄，但確認一下應該沒有關係吧？請你再去向小草兒吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Chà, đây là hy vọng nhỏ nhoi! Hmm, Rankashu đã đề cập đến điều gì đó về một người phụ nữ lạ. Tôi tự hỏi đó có thể là ai ...

dialogsBegin.en: I'm trying to think who this strange woman could be!! In the meantime could you please go kill some Carrierbombs and then return to Rankashu!! I need more time to think!
dialogsBegin.ar: I'm trying to think who this strange woman could be!! In the meantime could you please go kill some Carrierbombs and then return to Rankashu!! I need more time to think!
dialogsBegin.br: Estou tentando pensar quem essa mulher estranha poderia ser!! Enquanto isso, você poderia matar alguns Carrierbombs e depois voltar para Rankashu!! Preciso de mais tempo para pensar!
dialogsBegin.cns: 我在想这个奇怪的女人会是谁！？在此期间，你能不能去杀一些爆破者，然后找到小草儿！！我需要一些的时间来思考！！
dialogsBegin.de: Ich überlege gerade, wer diese seltsame Frau sein könnte!! Könntest du in der Zwischenzeit bitte ein paar Carrierbombs töten und dann nach Rankashu zurückkehren?! Ich brauche mehr Zeit zum Nachdenken!
dialogsBegin.fi: I'm trying to think who this strange woman could be!! In the meantime could you please go kill some Carrierbombs and then return to Rankashu!! I need more time to think!
dialogsBegin.fil: I'm trying to think who this strange woman could be!! In the meantime could you please go kill some Carrierbombs and then return to Rankashu!! I need more time to think!
dialogsBegin.fr: Les Caboom à côté me dérangent. Si vous alliez en tuer quelques-uns et assurer à Rankashu que je prends sa potion ?
dialogsBegin.id: Saya mencoba menebak siapa wanita aneh ini!! Sementara itu bisakah Anda membunuh beberapa Carrierbombs dan kemudian kembali ke Rankashu!! Saya perlu lebih banyak waktu untuk berpikir!
dialogsBegin.it: I'm trying to think who this strange woman could be!! In the meantime could you please go kill some Carrierbombs and then return to Rankashu!! I need more time to think!
dialogsBegin.jp: あ、その前にすまん。またキャリアボム倒してくれないか？　最近また増え始めてどうも落ち着かないんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 도대체 그 이상한 여자가 누구인지 생각해 보려는 중이에요! 그동안 당신은 캐리어밤을 처치하고 랑카슈에게 돌아가 주세요! 저는 생각할 시간이 필요하니까!
dialogsBegin.nl: I'm trying to think who this strange woman could be!! In the meantime could you please go kill some Carrierbombs and then return to Rankashu!! I need more time to think!
dialogsBegin.pl: I'm trying to think who this strange woman could be!! In the meantime could you please go kill some Carrierbombs and then return to Rankashu!! I need more time to think!
dialogsBegin.ru: I'm trying to think who this strange woman could be!! In the meantime could you please go kill some Carrierbombs and then return to Rankashu!! I need more time to think!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Estoy pensando en quién podría ser esa extraña mujer! Mientras tanto, ¿podrías ir a derrotar algunos Carrierbombs y volver con Rankashu? ¡Necesito más tiempo para pensar!
dialogsBegin.sw: I'm trying to think who this strange woman could be!! In the meantime could you please go kill some Carrierbombs and then return to Rankashu!! I need more time to think!
dialogsBegin.th: โอ้เสียงแย่~ ที่พวกเขาทำให้ฉันเติมด้วยความโกรธผ่านพ้น RAWRRR! คุณช่วยกำจัดสถานที่แห่งนี้ได้ไหม? ฉันกำลังพยายามคิดว่าใครเป็นคนแปลกหน้าที่นี่
dialogsBegin.tw: 我在想這個奇怪的女人會是誰！！在此期間，你能不能去殺掉一些轟炸兵，然後返回小草兒！！我需要更多時間思考！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đang cố nghĩ xem người phụ nữ kỳ lạ này có thể là ai !! Trong thời gian chờ đợi, bạn có thể giết một số Carrierbombs và sau đó quay trở lại Rankashu !! Tôi cần thêm thời gian để suy nghĩ!

dialogsBegin.en: Thank you thank you thank you!! Go kill 20 Small Carrierbombs & 15 Carrierbombs then return to Rankashu!
dialogsBegin.ar: Thank you thank you thank you!! Go kill 20 Small Carrierbombs & 15 Carrierbombs then return to Rankashu!
dialogsBegin.br: Obrigado, obrigado, obrigado!! Elimine 20 Carrierbombs Pequenos e 15 Carrierbombs e depois encontre Rankashu!
dialogsBegin.cns: 谢谢，非常感谢你！去杀20个小爆破者和15个爆破者，然后找到小草儿!
dialogsBegin.de: Danke, ich wusste, dass du mir hilfst. Töte 20 Small Carrierbombs & 15 Carrierbombs und besuche dann Rankashu.
dialogsBegin.fi: Thank you thank you thank you!! Go kill 20 Small Carrierbombs & 15 Carrierbombs then return to Rankashu!
dialogsBegin.fil: Thank you thank you thank you!! Go kill 20 Small Carrierbombs & 15 Carrierbombs then return to Rankashu!
dialogsBegin.fr: Merci de votre aide en tout cas.
dialogsBegin.id: Terima kasih terima kasih terima kasih!! Bunuh 20 Small Carrierbombs &15 Carrierbombs lalu kembali ke Rankashu!
dialogsBegin.it: Thank you thank you thank you!! Go kill 20 Small Carrierbombs & 15 Carrierbombs then return to Rankashu!
dialogsBegin.jp: ん？　だんだんなれなれしくなっているだって？　いやいや、私と君の仲じゃないか。なっ！小型キャリアボム20匹とキャリアボム15匹を倒しておいてくれ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 역시, 우리 사이에 이 정도 부탁쯤은 들어 줄 줄 알았어. 그럼 랑카슈에게 가는 김에 부하 캐리아봄 20 마리, 캐리아봄 15마리 처리 좀 부탁해.
dialogsBegin.nl: Thank you thank you thank you!! Go kill 20 Small Carrierbombs & 15 Carrierbombs then return to Rankashu!
dialogsBegin.pl: Thank you thank you thank you!! Go kill 20 Small Carrierbombs & 15 Carrierbombs then return to Rankashu!
dialogsBegin.ru: Thank you thank you thank you!! Go kill 20 Small Carrierbombs & 15 Carrierbombs then return to Rankashu!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡¡Gracias, gracias, gracias!! ¡Ve a derrotar a 20 Carrierbombs Pequeños y a 15 Carrierbombs y luego vuelve con Rankashu!
dialogsBegin.sw: Thank you thank you thank you!! Go kill 20 Small Carrierbombs & 15 Carrierbombs then return to Rankashu!
dialogsBegin.th: ขอบคุณ ขอบคุณ ขอบคุณมาก !! ไปฆ่า 20 Small Carrierbombs & 15 Carrierbombs แล้วกลับไปหา Rankashu!
dialogsBegin.tw: 謝謝你，謝謝你，謝謝你！！去殺死 20 個小賓拉當轟炸兵和 15 個轟炸兵，然後返回小草兒！
dialogsBegin.vi: Cảm ơn, cảm ơn, cảm ơn bạn!! Tiêu diệt 20 Small Carrierbombs & 15 Carrierbombs sau đó quay trở lại Rankashu!

dialogsAccept.th: โอ้วว ฉันควรจะมุ่งไปกับเหล่าคนโง่ Carrierbombs อยู่รอบๆ !!!
dialogsAccept.tw: 哦，我要怎麼能專注於這些愚蠢的轟炸兵！！！！
dialogsAccept.vi: Ôi làm sao tôi có thể tập trung với những trò gian lận mà lũ Carrierbombs ngu ngốc này đang làm chứ!!!

description.en: Speak with Porgo and tell him the good news.
