dialogsBegin.en: We made an inquiry group and started to review the case again. I can't believe something this horrific has happened in Saint City.
dialogsBegin.ar: We made an inquiry group and started to review the case again. I can't believe something this horrific has happened in Saint City.
dialogsBegin.br: Nós criamos um grupo de inquérito e começamos a checar o caso novamente. Não posso acreditar que algo tão trágico tenha acontecido na Cidade de Saint.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我已经派人重新进行调查了，这种可悲的事情怎么会出现在晨光呢..真的好遗憾啊.
dialogsBegin.de: Wir haben eine Nachforschungsgruppe gebildet und angefangen den Fall neu aufzurollen. Ich kann nicht fassen, dass diese Tragödie in Saint Morning geschehen ist.
dialogsBegin.fi: We made an inquiry group and started to review the case again. I can't believe something this horrific has happened in Saint City.
dialogsBegin.fil: We made an inquiry group and started to review the case again. I can't believe something this horrific has happened in Saint City.
dialogsBegin.fr: Nous avons créé un groupe d'investigation et commencé à réétudier le dossier. Je ne peux croire que quelque chose de si tragique se soit produit à Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.id: Kami membuat kelompok penyelidikan dan mulai meninjau kasus itu lagi. Aku tidak percaya sesuatu yang mengerikan ini telah terjadi di Saint City.
dialogsBegin.it: We made an inquiry group and started to review the case again. I can't believe something this horrific has happened in Saint City.
dialogsBegin.jp: 速やかに特別捜査団を結成し、再調査を行うことを決定しましたよ。こんなにむごたらしい事件がこのセイントモーニングで起きたとは。市長としてとても心が痛みます。
dialogsBegin.kr: 조사단을 꾸려서 재수사를 하고 있어요. 세인트 시티에서 이런 끔찍한 일이 벌어졌다는 게 믿기지 않네요.
dialogsBegin.nl: We made an inquiry group and started to review the case again. I can't believe something this horrific has happened in Saint City.
dialogsBegin.pl: We made an inquiry group and started to review the case again. I can't believe something this horrific has happened in Saint City.
dialogsBegin.ru: Бывший мэр получит по заслугам. Это надо же, вынашивать план захвата мира, используя детей!..
dialogsBegin.sp: Hicimos un grupo de investigación y comenzamos a revisar el caso de nuevo. No puedo creer que algo tan horrible haya sucedido en Saint.
dialogsBegin.sw: We made an inquiry group and started to review the case again. I can't believe something this horrific has happened in Saint City.
dialogsBegin.th: เราได้สอบถามกลุ่มและเริ่มตรวจสอบเคสนี้อีกครั้ง ฉันไม่สามารถเชื่อได้ว่าสิ่งที่น่ากลัวนี้เกิดขึ้นใน Saint City
dialogsBegin.tw: 我已經派人重新進行調查了，這種可悲的事情怎麼會出現在聖音特呢…真的好遺憾啊.
dialogsBegin.vi: Chúng tôi đã lập một nhóm điều tra và bắt đầu xem xét lại vụ việc. Tôi không thể tin được một điều gì đó kinh khủng đã xảy ra ở Saint City.

dialogsBegin.en: I suppose it's better late than never. Will you return to Porgo and let him know that we are investigating the case again? His cooperation is appreciated.
dialogsBegin.ar: I suppose it's better late than never. Will you return to Porgo and let him know that we are investigating the case again? His cooperation is appreciated.
dialogsBegin.br: Mas antes tarde do que nunca. Você poderia avisar a Porgo que nós começamos a investigar o caso dos desaparecimentos novamente? A cooperação dele é importante.
dialogsBegin.cns: 至少在现在已经知道事实了，所以帮我传达给柏洛格说，我已经重新进行调查了。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich denke, besser spät als nie. Kehre zu Porgo zurück und lass ihn wissen, dass wir den Fall erneut untersuchen? Wir wissen seine Mitarbeit zu schätzen.
dialogsBegin.fi: I suppose it's better late than never. Will you return to Porgo and let him know that we are investigating the case again? His cooperation is appreciated.
dialogsBegin.fil: I suppose it's better late than never. Will you return to Porgo and let him know that we are investigating the case again? His cooperation is appreciated.
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais mieux vaut tard que jamais. Voudrais-tu rapporter à Porgo que nous avons réouvert l'enquête sur les disparitions?
dialogsBegin.id: Kurasa lebih baik terlambat daripada tidak sama sekali. Apakah kamu akan kembali ke Porgo dan memberi tahu dia bahwa kami sedang menyelidiki kasus ini lagi? Kerjasamanya diapresiasi.
dialogsBegin.it: I suppose it's better late than never. Will you return to Porgo and let him know that we are investigating the case again? His cooperation is appreciated.
dialogsBegin.jp: 真相がわかったのも、ポルゴの執念の調査のおかげです。彼に女児連続失踪事件の再捜査を開始したことをお伝えいただけますか？宜しくお願いします。
dialogsBegin.kr: 늦었지만, 지금이라도 다행이에요. 포르고에게 돌아가서 사건 재조사가 시작됐다고 꼭 전해주세요. 협조에 감사드린다고도 말이죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: I suppose it's better late than never. Will you return to Porgo and let him know that we are investigating the case again? His cooperation is appreciated.
dialogsBegin.pl: I suppose it's better late than never. Will you return to Porgo and let him know that we are investigating the case again? His cooperation is appreciated.
dialogsBegin.ru: Обещаю, мы снимем с Миа оковы и вернем девочек домой! Пожалуйста, передай это Тинкертону. Если бы не он, мы бы никогда не узнали правды.
dialogsBegin.sp: Supongo que es mejor tarde que nunca. ¿Volverás con Porgo y le dirás que estamos investigando el caso nuevamente? Se aprecia su cooperación.
dialogsBegin.sw: I suppose it's better late than never. Will you return to Porgo and let him know that we are investigating the case again? His cooperation is appreciated.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันคิดว่าสายไปก็ยังดีกว่าไม่เคยเลยนะ คุณจะกลับไปหา Porgo และแจ้งให้เขาทราบว่าเรากำลังสืบสวนคดีนี้อีกครั้งหรือไม่? เราอยากให้เขาร่วมด้วย
dialogsBegin.tw: 我想遲到總比沒有好，你會回到柏洛格，讓他知道我們正在再次調查此案嗎？他的合作值得讚賞。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi cho rằng muộn còn hơn không. Bạn sẽ trở lại Porgo và cho anh ta biết rằng chúng tôi đang điều tra lại vụ án chứ? Sự hợp tác của anh ấy được đánh giá cao.

dialogsAccept.en: Thank you. I will do everything I can to make Saint City more beautiful and peaceful than it already is.
dialogsAccept.ar: Thank you. I will do everything I can to make Saint City more beautiful and peaceful than it already is.
dialogsAccept.br: Obrigada. Farei o meu melhor para tornar a Cidade de Saint mais bonita e pacífica do que já é.
dialogsAccept.cns: 谢谢你!我会让晨光成为一个美丽的都市。
dialogsAccept.de: Hab dank. Ich werde mein Bestes tun um Saint Morning noch schöner und friedvoller zu gestalten.
dialogsAccept.fi: Thank you. I will do everything I can to make Saint City more beautiful and peaceful than it already is.
dialogsAccept.fil: Thank you. I will do everything I can to make Saint City more beautiful and peaceful than it already is.
dialogsAccept.fr: Merci. Je ferai de mon mieux pour rendre Saint Morning toujours plus belle et paisible.
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih. Saya akan melakukan semua yang saya bisa untuk membuat Saint City lebih indah dan damai dari sebelumnya.
dialogsAccept.it: Thank you. I will do everything I can to make Saint City more beautiful and peaceful than it already is.
dialogsAccept.jp: ご協力ありがとう。これからはこんな忌まわしい事件が起こらない、明るい笑顔の溢れるセイントモーニングになるように頑張るつもりです。
dialogsAccept.kr: 고맙습니다. 세인트 시티가 지금보다 더 아름답고 평화로운 곳이 되도록 최선을 다할게요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Thank you. I will do everything I can to make Saint City more beautiful and peaceful than it already is.
dialogsAccept.pl: Thank you. I will do everything I can to make Saint City more beautiful and peaceful than it already is.
dialogsAccept.ru: Спасибо! Я сделаю все, что в моих силах, ради спокойствия и благополучия жителей Санто.
dialogsAccept.sp: Gracias. Haré todo lo posible para que Saint sea más hermosa y pacífica de lo que ya es.
dialogsAccept.sw: Thank you. I will do everything I can to make Saint City more beautiful and peaceful than it already is.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอบคุณ ฉันจะทำทุกอย่างที่ทำได้เพื่อให้ Saint City สวยงามและเงียบสงบกว่าที่เป็นอยู่
dialogsAccept.tw: 謝謝你！我會讓聖音特成為一個美麗的都市。
dialogsAccept.vi: Cảm ơn bạn. Tôi sẽ làm tất cả những gì có thể để Saint City đẹp hơn và yên bình hơn hiện tại.

dialogsDecline.en: I tour the city every day, so I am extremely busy. Please tell him what I said.
dialogsDecline.ar: I tour the city every day, so I am extremely busy. Please tell him what I said.
dialogsDecline.br: Eu viajo pela cidade todos os dias, então eu não posso ir dizer a ele pessoalmente. Por favor, conte a ele o que eu disse.
dialogsDecline.cns: 因为我要巡逻都市，所以经常会不在位子上，所以麻烦你把这个转交给他。
dialogsDecline.de: Ich bin jeden Tag in der Stadt unterwegs, also kann ich es ihm nicht selbst sagen. Bitte richte ihm aus was ich gesagt habe.
dialogsDecline.fi: I tour the city every day, so I am extremely busy. Please tell him what I said.
dialogsDecline.fil: I tour the city every day, so I am extremely busy. Please tell him what I said.
dialogsDecline.fr: Je visite la ville tous les jours, je ne peux donc aller lui dire moi-même. Dis-le lui pour moi.
dialogsDecline.id: Saya berkeliling kota setiap hari, jadi saya sangat sibuk. Tolong katakan padanya apa yang saya katakan.
dialogsDecline.it: I tour the city every day, so I am extremely busy. Please tell him what I said.
dialogsDecline.jp: 私は市内の視察がありますので離席していることも多いですが、どうぞ代わりにお伝えください。
dialogsDecline.kr: 저는 매일 도시를 순찰하느라 바빠요. 제 말, 꼭 전달해 주세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: I tour the city every day, so I am extremely busy. Please tell him what I said.
dialogsDecline.pl: I tour the city every day, so I am extremely busy. Please tell him what I said.
dialogsDecline.ru: У меня с утра до вечера открыт прием горожан, и отлучиться с площади я никак не могу. Пожалуйста, сходи к Тинкертону.
dialogsDecline.sp: Recorro la ciudad todos los días, así que estoy muy ocupado. Por favor, dile lo que te he dicho.
dialogsDecline.sw: I tour the city every day, so I am extremely busy. Please tell him what I said.
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันตรวจตาเมืองทุกวัน ดังนั้นฉันจึงยุ่งมาก กรุณาบอกเขาว่าฉันพูดอะไร
dialogsDecline.tw: 因為我要巡邏都市，所以經常會不在位子上，所以麻煩你把這個轉交給他。
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi đi tham quan thành phố mỗi ngày, vì vậy tôi cực kỳ bận rộn. Hãy kể cho anh ấy những gì tôi đã nói.

dialogsComplete.en: Has the truth finally been revealed? It has?! I am so glad to hear that the case has been reopened.
dialogsComplete.ar: Has the truth finally been revealed? It has?! I am so glad to hear that the case has been reopened.
dialogsComplete.br: A decisão foi finalmente revelada? Sim?! Fico muito feliz em saber que o caso foi reaberto.
dialogsComplete.cns: 好了!真是太好了…现在这样就好了..
dialogsComplete.de: Ist die Wahrheit endlich ans Licht gekommen? Ist sie das?! Ich bin so froh zu hören, dass der Fall wieder aufgerollt wurde.
dialogsComplete.fi: Onko totuus vihdoin paljastunut? Siinä on?! Olen erittäin iloinen kuullessani, että tapaus on avattu uudelleen.
dialogsComplete.fil: Has the truth finally been revealed? It has?! I am so glad to hear that the case has been reopened.
dialogsComplete.fr: Oui.. J'ai fait ce que j'avais à faire.. Oui.. (Il regarde le ciel et verse une larme)
dialogsComplete.id: Apakah kebenaran akhirnya terungkap? Memiliki?! Saya sangat senang mendengar bahwa kasus telah dibuka kembali.
dialogsComplete.it: Has the truth finally been revealed? It has?! I am so glad to hear that the case has been reopened.
dialogsComplete.jp: これでようやく、事件の全容が明らかになったのだな…。なんだか今日の空は、とても哀しい色をしているように感じるのだが。
dialogsComplete.kr: 진실이… 드디어 밝혀진 건가요? 정말요?! 사건이 다시 수사된다니… 정말 기쁜 일이에요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Has the truth finally been revealed? It has?! I am so glad to hear that the case has been reopened.
dialogsComplete.pl: Has the truth finally been revealed? It has?! I am so glad to hear that the case has been reopened.
dialogsComplete.ru: Отлично! Клаус хороший и честный человек. Если он пообещал спасти девочек, значит, так и будет.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿Se ha revelado finalmente la verdad? ¡¿Sí?! Estoy muy contento de saber que el caso ha sido reabierto.
dialogsComplete.sw: Has the truth finally been revealed? It has?! I am so glad to hear that the case has been reopened.
dialogsComplete.th: ความจริงได้ถูกเปิดเผยหรือไม่? ถูกเปิดเผยแล้วงั้นหรือ?! ฉันดีใจมากที่รู้ว่าเคสนี้ได้ถูกรื้อขึ้นมา
dialogsComplete.tw: 真相終於大白了嗎？有嗎？！我很高興聽到此案已重新審理。
dialogsComplete.vi: Sự thật cuối cùng đã bị tiết lộ? Nó đã bị tiết lộ?! Tôi rất vui khi biết rằng vụ án đã được mở lại.

dialogsComplete.en: Thank you so much for your help, young one. I couldn't have done all this alone. The girls thank you, as well.
dialogsComplete.ar: Thank you so much for your help, young one. I couldn't have done all this alone. The girls thank you, as well.
dialogsComplete.br: Eu senti pena de todas aquelas crianças que foram expulsas... Mas muito obrigado pela ajuda, jovem. Eu não poderia ter feito tudo isso sozinho. As meninas também agradecem.
dialogsComplete.cns: 这或许是对那些孩子们的遗憾吧..
dialogsComplete.de: (Es scheint als würde es ihr leid tun, dass die unschuldigen Kinder ausgestoßen wurden..)
dialogsComplete.fi: Kiitos paljon avustasi, nuori. En olisi voinut tehdä kaikkea tätä yksin. Tytötkin kiittävät.
dialogsComplete.fil: Thank you so much for your help, young one. I couldn't have done all this alone. The girls thank you, as well.
dialogsComplete.fr: (Il semble très triste pour les enfants qui ont été abandonnés)
dialogsComplete.id: Terima kasih banyak atas bantuanmu, anak muda. Aku tidak bisa melakukan semua ini sendirian. Gadis-gadis itu juga berterima kasih.
dialogsComplete.it: Thank you so much for your help, young one. I couldn't have done all this alone. The girls thank you, as well.
dialogsComplete.jp: 浮かばれないままモンスターになってしまった哀れな子どもたちを想うとやりきれないよ。しかし君がいなかったら事件の全容は明らかにならなかった、感謝するよ。俺にできることはせめて、子どもたちの魂が安らかに眠れるように祈ることくらいだ。可哀想な子どもたちよ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 도와주셔서 정말 감사해요. 혼자 힘으로는 절대 할 수 없었을 거예요. 아이들도 정말 고마워하고 있어요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Thank you so much for your help, young one. I couldn't have done all this alone. The girls thank you, as well.
dialogsComplete.pl: Thank you so much for your help, young one. I couldn't have done all this alone. The girls thank you, as well.
dialogsComplete.ru: Конечно, поначалу и Миа, и их родителям будет непросто - представь себе взрослую девушку, которая считает себя шестилетней малышкой! Но, думаю, они наверстают упущенное.
dialogsComplete.sp: Muchas gracias por tu ayuda, jovencito. No podría haber hecho todo esto solo. Las niñas también te lo agradecen.
dialogsComplete.sw: Thank you so much for your help, young one. I couldn't have done all this alone. The girls thank you, as well.
dialogsComplete.th: ขอบคุณมากสำหรับความช่วยเหลือของคุณ ฉันไม่สามารถทำทั้งหมดนี้คนเดียว พวกเธอก็ขอบคุณเช่นกัน
dialogsComplete.tw: 這或許是對那些無辜被流放，變成怪物的孩子們的遺憾吧…
dialogsComplete.vi: Cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều vì sự giúp đỡ của bạn, một người trẻ tuổi. Tôi không thể làm tất cả những điều này một mình. Các bé gái cũng cảm ơn bạn.

dialogsFail.en: Have you spoken to the Mayor? Please hurry, this case needs to be reopened!
dialogsFail.ar: Have you spoken to the Mayor? Please hurry, this case needs to be reopened!
dialogsFail.br: Já falou com o prefeito? Por favor, depressa, este caso precisa ser reaberto!
dialogsFail.cns: 还没好吗?真的希望赶快重新的进行调查。
dialogsFail.de: Hast du mit dem Bürgermeister gesprochen? Bitte beeile dich, dieser Fall muss neu aufgerollt werden!
dialogsFail.fi: Have you spoken to the Mayor? Please hurry, this case needs to be reopened!
dialogsFail.fil: Have you spoken to the Mayor? Please hurry, this case needs to be reopened!
dialogsFail.fr: Ils planchent de nouveau sur le dossier? J'espère qu'ils se dépêcheront..
dialogsFail.id: Apakah kamu sudah berbicara dengan Walikota? Tolong cepat, kasus ini perlu dibuka kembali!
dialogsFail.it: Have you spoken to the Mayor? Please hurry, this case needs to be reopened!
dialogsFail.jp: 市長からの返事はまだか？事実が明らかになったのだから、一刻も早く再調査に取り掛かってもらわねば。
dialogsFail.kr: 시장님을 만나보셨나요? 제발 서두르세요. 반드시 재조사해야 해요!
dialogsFail.nl: Have you spoken to the Mayor? Please hurry, this case needs to be reopened!
dialogsFail.pl: Have you spoken to the Mayor? Please hurry, this case needs to be reopened!
dialogsFail.ru: Have you spoken to the Mayor? Please hurry, this case needs to be reopened!
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Has hablado con el alcalde? ¡Date prisa, este caso se tiene que reabrir!
dialogsFail.sw: Have you spoken to the Mayor? Please hurry, this case needs to be reopened!
dialogsFail.th: คุณได้พูดคุยกับนายกเทศมนตรีหรือไม่? ได้โปรดทำโดยเร็วด้วยเถิด เคสนี้ต้องถูกรื้อขึ้นมาอีกครั้ง!
dialogsFail.tw: 你和市長談過了嗎？請快點，這個案子需要重新的進行調查。
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn đã nói chuyện với Thị trưởng chưa? Hãy nhanh lên, vụ án này cần phải được mở lại!

dialogsBegin.en: A toy merchant requested you to collect Popshift for making fancy toys. Will you accept this request?
dialogsBegin.ar: A toy merchant requested you to collect Popshift for making fancy toys. Will you accept this request?
dialogsBegin.br: Um Mercador de Brinquedos pediu que você colecionasse Popshift para fazer brinquedos de cera. Você vai aceitar este pedido?
dialogsBegin.cns: 玩具商人委托你去收集回转控制杆来制作花式蜡质玩具。你要接受这个委托吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Ein Spielzeughändler bittet dich, Popshift für die Herstellung ausgefallener Spielzeuge zu sammeln. Wirst du diese Bitte annehmen?
dialogsBegin.fi: A toy merchant requested you to collect Popshift for making fancy toys. Will you accept this request?
dialogsBegin.fil: Hiniling sa iyo ng isang toy merchant na kolektahin ang Popshift para gumawa ng magagarbong laruan. Tatanggapin mo ba?
dialogsBegin.fr: Pouvez-vous rassembler des Articulations pour moi sans chercher à en savoir plus sur mes intentions ?
dialogsBegin.id: Seorang Toy Merchant memintamu mengumpulkan Popshift untuk membuat beberapa Fancy Toy. Maukah kamu menerima Quest ini?
dialogsBegin.it: A toy merchant requested you to collect Popshift for making fancy toys. Will you accept this request?
dialogsBegin.jp: ･･･何も理由は聞かないでくださいです。私のためにハーレーシフトを集めてきてもらえますか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 한 장난감 상인이 화려한 장난감을 만들 재료로 팝시프트를 구해 달라고 하는데, 도와주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: A toy merchant requested you to collect Popshift for making fancy toys. Will you accept this request?
dialogsBegin.pl: A toy merchant requested you to collect Popshift for making fancy toys. Will you accept this request?
dialogsBegin.ru: A toy merchant requested you to collect Popshift for making fancy toys. Will you accept this request?
dialogsBegin.sp: Un mercader de juguetes necesita Popshifts para hacer unos juguetes de lujo. ¿Aceptas esta misión?
dialogsBegin.sw: A toy merchant requested you to collect Popshift for making fancy toys. Will you accept this request?
dialogsBegin.th: พ่อค้าของเล่นขอให้คุณรวบรวม Popshift เพื่อทำของเล่นแฟนซี คุณจะยอมรับคำขอนี้หรือไม่?
dialogsBegin.tw: 一個玩具商人要求你收集迴轉控制桿來製作精美的玩具。你會接受這個請求嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Một thương gia đồ chơi đã yêu cầu bạn thu thập Popshift để làm đồ chơi lạ mắt. Bạn sẽ chấp nhận yêu cầu này chứ?

dialogsBegin.en: Here is your Letter of Recommendation. This shows that I have recognized your potential. Do not lose this document.
dialogsBegin.ar: Here is your Letter of Recommendation. This shows that I have recognized your potential. Do not lose this document.
dialogsBegin.br: Esta é a carta de recomendação que mostra que o mestre o reconhece como um sucessor. Por favor, proteja-a com sua vida. Se você perdê-la, não poderá provar que é reconhecido.
dialogsBegin.cns: 这推廌书表示首领认定继承者的能力，若没有推荐书认定形同无效，所以，要好好保管！！
dialogsBegin.de: Dieses Empfehlungsschreiben beweist, dass dich der Meister als Nachfolger akzeptiert hat. Bitte beschütze es mit deinem Leben. Wenn du ihn verlierst, kannst du nicht beweisen, dass du anerkannt wurdest.
dialogsBegin.fi: Here is your Letter of Recommendation. This shows that I have recognized your potential. Do not lose this document.
dialogsBegin.fil: Here is your Letter of Recommendation. This shows that I have recognized your potential. Do not lose this document.
dialogsBegin.fr: Félicitations, voici une lettre de recommandation confirmant que tu es sur la voie de devenir Sorcier.
dialogsBegin.id: Ini Surat Rekomendasimu. Ini menunjukkan bahwa saya telah mengenali potensimu. Jangan sampai dokumen ini hilang.
dialogsBegin.it: Here is your Letter of Recommendation. This shows that I have recognized your potential. Do not lose this document.
dialogsBegin.jp: これはマスターが後継者としての資質を認めたという推薦書です。あなたの資質が認められるものですから大事にしてください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 여기 추천서입니다.제가 당신의 가능성을 인정했다는 증표예요. 중요한 서류니 절대 잃어버리지 마세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Here is your Letter of Recommendation. This shows that I have recognized your potential. Do not lose this document.
dialogsBegin.pl: Here is your Letter of Recommendation. This shows that I have recognized your potential. Do not lose this document.
dialogsBegin.ru: Это рекомендательное письмо - доказательство того, что тебе удалось пройти мое испытание. Береги его как зеницу ока.
dialogsBegin.sp: Aquí está tu Carta de Recomendación. Esto demuestra que he reconocido tu potencial. No la pierdas.
dialogsBegin.sw: Here is your Letter of Recommendation. This shows that I have recognized your potential. Do not lose this document.
dialogsBegin.th: นี่คือจดหมายแนะนำของคุณ นี้แสดงให้เห็นว่าฉันได้รับการยอมรับศักยภาพของคุณ อย่าสูญเสียเอกสารนี้
dialogsBegin.tw: 這推廌書表示首領認定繼承者的能力，若沒有推薦書認定形同無效，所以，要好好保管！！
dialogsBegin.vi: Đây là Thư giới thiệu của bạn. Điều này cho thấy tôi đã nhận ra tiềm năng của bạn. Đừng làm mất lá thư này.

dialogsBegin.en: For your next assignment, I need you to retrieve the Magic Underwear of Power from Kynsy who is hiding somewhere near the Erons Factory in Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin.ar: For your next assignment, I need you to retrieve the Magic Underwear of Power from Kynsy who is hiding somewhere near the Erons Factory in Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin.br: Para sua próxima tarefa, preciso que você recupere a Roupa Íntima Mágica do Poder de Kynsy, que está escondida em algum lugar perto da Fábrica Erons em Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin.cns: 请把那推荐书拿给位于莱乐安山脉亡者之潭的精神使者贤者【可林】。
dialogsBegin.de: Bitte bring das Empfehlungsschreiben zu Cuarine, dem Psykeeper Weisen. Er ist an der Quelle der verstorbenen Seelen im Norden des Leren Gebirges.
dialogsBegin.fi: For your next assignment, I need you to retrieve the Magic Underwear of Power from Kynsy who is hiding somewhere near the Erons Factory in Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin.fil: For your next assignment, I need you to retrieve the Magic Underwear of Power from Kynsy who is hiding somewhere near the Erons Factory in Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il faut que tu l'apportes à Cuarine, le Sage des Sorciers qui se trouve à la Fontaine des Défunts de Flaris.
dialogsBegin.id: Untuk tugasmu selanjutnya, aku ingin kamu mengambil Magic Underwear of Power dari Kynsy yang bersembunyi di suatu tempat di dekat Pabrik Erons di Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin.it: For your next assignment, I need you to retrieve the Magic Underwear of Power from Kynsy who is hiding somewhere near the Erons Factory in Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin.jp: それではフラリスのレルエン山脈北部にある魂の泉に行って、サイキーパー賢者クリサリスにその推薦書を渡してください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 다음 임무는 강화 마법 속옷을 찾는 거랍니다. 다콘 제1지구의 에런스 공장 근처에 숨어 있는 킨시를 찾아 회수해 주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: For your next assignment, I need you to retrieve the Magic Underwear of Power from Kynsy who is hiding somewhere near the Erons Factory in Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin.pl: For your next assignment, I need you to retrieve the Magic Underwear of Power from Kynsy who is hiding somewhere near the Erons Factory in Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin.ru: Теперь тебе нужно добыть Пояс Всевластья. Отбери его у Кисы. Она скрывается неподалеку от Эрониевой фактории на Дарконе-1.
dialogsBegin.sp: Para tu próxima tarea, necesito que recuperes la Ropa Interior Mágica del Poder que tiene Kynsy. Se esconde en algún lugar cerca de la Fábrica de Erons en Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin.sw: For your next assignment, I need you to retrieve the Magic Underwear of Power from Kynsy who is hiding somewhere near the Erons Factory in Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin.th: สำหรับภารกิจต่อไปของคุณ ฉันต้องการให้คุณดึง Magic Underwear of Power จาก Kynsy ที่ซ่อนอยู่ใกล้กับโรงงาน Erons ใน Darkon 1
dialogsBegin.tw: 下一個任務，我需要你從藏在得肯 1 艾磷斯工廠附近某處的奇撒易手中取回魔法襯衣。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đối với nhiệm vụ tiếp theo của bạn, tôi cần bạn lấy Magic Underwear of Power từ Kynsy, người đang trốn ở đâu đó gần Erons Factory trong Darkon 1.

dialogsDecline.en: Are you afraid to walk the path of the Psykeeper? Sure, it's not easy, but I think you have what it takes. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ar: Are you afraid to walk the path of the Psykeeper? Sure, it's not easy, but I think you have what it takes. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.br: Você tem medo de trilhar o caminho do Psykeeper? Claro, não é fácil, mas acho que você tem o que é preciso. Fale comigo novamente se mudar de ideia.
dialogsDecline.cns: 你在害怕什么！为了要成为真正的精神使者，请坚强一点！
dialogsDecline.de: Hast du Angst, den Weg des Psykekeepers zu gehen? Sicher, es ist nicht einfach, aber ich glaube, du hast das Zeug dazu. Sprich noch einmal mit mir, wenn du deine Meinung änderst.
dialogsDecline.fi: Are you afraid to walk the path of the Psykeeper? Sure, it's not easy, but I think you have what it takes. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fil: Are you afraid to walk the path of the Psykeeper? Sure, it's not easy, but I think you have what it takes. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fr: Ne sous-estime jamais tes capacités ! Tu dois être fort, ou tu ne deviendras jamais un Héros.
dialogsDecline.id: Apakah kamu takut untuk berjalan di jalur Psykeeper? Tentu, itu tidak mudah, tetapi saya pikir kamu memiliki apa yang diperlukan. Bicaralah dengan saya lagi jika kamu berubah pikiran.
dialogsDecline.it: Are you afraid to walk the path of the Psykeeper? Sure, it's not easy, but I think you have what it takes. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.jp: 何を恐れているのですか？恐怖を克服しないと本物のサイキーパーにはなれませんよ！
dialogsDecline.kr: 사이키퍼의 길이 두려우신가요? 쉬운 길은 아니지만, 당신이라면 충분히 해낼 수 있어요. 마음이 바뀌면 저를 다시 찾아주세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Are you afraid to walk the path of the Psykeeper? Sure, it's not easy, but I think you have what it takes. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.pl: Are you afraid to walk the path of the Psykeeper? Sure, it's not easy, but I think you have what it takes. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ru: Are you afraid to walk the path of the Psykeeper? Sure, it's not easy, but I think you have what it takes. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Tienes miedo de recorrer el camino del Psykeeper? Claro, no es fácil, pero creo que tienes lo que se necesita. Habla conmigo de nuevo si cambias de opinión.
dialogsDecline.sw: Are you afraid to walk the path of the Psykeeper? Sure, it's not easy, but I think you have what it takes. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณกลัวที่จะเดินไปตามเส้นทางของ Psykeeper หรือไม่? แน่นอนไม่ใช่เรื่องง่าย แต่ฉันคิดว่าคุณมีสิ่งที่ต้องใช้ พูดกับฉันอีกครั้งถ้าคุณเปลี่ยนใจ
dialogsDecline.tw: 你害怕踏上念力師之路嗎？這條路確實不容易，但我相信你有足夠的能力。如果改變心意，再來找我談談。
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn có sợ đi trên con đường của Psykeeper không? Chắc chắn, nó không dễ dàng, nhưng tôi nghĩ bạn có những gì cần thiết. Nói chuyện lại với tôi nếu bạn thay đổi ý định.

dialogsBegin.en: Ahh so the curse was not released yet? The curse WAS in his body a long time… We need a powerful catalyst to speed up the process. 10 Boo Petals should do the trick!
dialogsBegin.ar: Ahh so the curse was not released yet? The curse WAS in his body a long time… We need a powerful catalyst to speed up the process. 10 Boo Petals should do the trick!
dialogsBegin.br: Ahh então a maldição ainda não foi desfeita?? A maldição estava em seu corpo há muito tempo... Precisamos de um poderoso catalisador para acelerar o processo. 10 Pétalas de Boo devem fazer o truque!
dialogsBegin.cns: Ahh so the curse was not released yet? The curse WAS in his body a long time… We need a powerful catalyst to speed up the process. 10 Boo Petals should do the trick!
dialogsBegin.de: Ah, der Fluch wurde also noch nicht gelöst?? Der Fluch war schon lange in seinem Körper... Wir brauchen einen starken Katalysator, um den Prozess zu beschleunigen. 10 Boo Petals sollten ausreichen!
dialogsBegin.fi: Ahh so the curse was not released yet? The curse WAS in his body a long time… We need a powerful catalyst to speed up the process. 10 Boo Petals should do the trick!
dialogsBegin.fil: Ahh so the curse was not released yet? The curse WAS in his body a long time… We need a powerful catalyst to speed up the process. 10 Boo Petals should do the trick!
dialogsBegin.fr: Reodos vous dites ? Oui, je l'ai déjà vu. Il est victime d'une ancienne malédiction. Rien de bien grave pourtant, je me demande pourquoi il n'est pas encore venu m'en parler en personne.
dialogsBegin.id: Ahh jadi kutukan itu belum dilepaskan?? Kutukan itu ada di tubuhnya sejak lama ... Kita membutuhkan katalis yang kuat untuk mempercepat prosesnya. 10 Boo Petals sepertinya bisa digunakan sebagai katalis!
dialogsBegin.it: Ahh so the curse was not released yet? The curse WAS in his body a long time… We need a powerful catalyst to speed up the process. 10 Boo Petals should do the trick!
dialogsBegin.jp: ふうん、呪いを解く薬を煎じているのに呪いが解けないって？　まあ、呪いにも色々な種類があるからなぁ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 아직도 저주가 풀리지 않은 건가요? 그 저주는 오랫동안 몸에 스며 있었죠… 좀 더 강력한 촉매제가 필요해요. 부우 꽃잎 10개면 충분할 거예요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Ahh so the curse was not released yet? The curse WAS in his body a long time… We need a powerful catalyst to speed up the process. 10 Boo Petals should do the trick!
dialogsBegin.pl: Ahh so the curse was not released yet? The curse WAS in his body a long time… We need a powerful catalyst to speed up the process. 10 Boo Petals should do the trick!
dialogsBegin.ru: Ahh so the curse was not released yet? The curse WAS in his body a long time… We need a powerful catalyst to speed up the process. 10 Boo Petals should do the trick!
dialogsBegin.sp: Ahh, ¿entonces la maldición aún no se ha ido? La maldición ESTUVO en su cuerpo durante mucho tiempo... Necesitamos un poderoso catalizador para acelerar el proceso. ¡10 Pétalos de Boo deberían servir!
dialogsBegin.sw: Ahh so the curse was not released yet? The curse WAS in his body a long time… We need a powerful catalyst to speed up the process. 10 Boo Petals should do the trick!
dialogsBegin.th: อ่าาา คำสาปก็ยังไม่ได้หมดไป? คำสาปอยู่ในร่างกายของเขาเป็นเวลานาน ... เราจำเป็นต้องมีตัวเร่งปฏิกิริยาที่มีประสิทธิภาพมากพอเพื่อเร่งกระบวน การเก็บ Boo Petals 10 อัน น่าจะช่วยได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 啊，所以詛咒還沒解除嗎？這詛咒在他體內已經待了很久……我們需要一種強力催化劑來加快過程。10 朵布布花瓣應該就夠了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Vậy là lời nguyền vẫn chưa được giải phóng à? Lời nguyền ĐÃ tồn tại trong cơ thể anh ta một thời gian dài rồi… Chúng ta cần một chất xúc tác mạnh mẽ để đẩy nhanh quá trình. 10 Boo Petals có thể làm được chuyện đó!

dialogsBegin.en: Another question? 8 Heroes huh? Well, I did see a strange looking woman enter this dungeon alone several days ago. Not sure if that will help or not!
dialogsBegin.ar: Another question? 8 Heroes huh? Well, I did see a strange looking woman enter this dungeon alone several days ago. Not sure if that will help or not!
dialogsBegin.br: Outra pergunta?? Os 8 Heróis?? Hm, eu vi uma mulher de aparência estranha entrar nesta masmorra sozinha vários dias atrás. Não tenho certeza se isso vai ajudar ou não, ela parecia poderosa!
dialogsBegin.cns: Another question? 8 Heroes huh? Well, I did see a strange looking woman enter this dungeon alone several days ago. Not sure if that will help or not!
dialogsBegin.de: Noch eine Frage? 8 Helden, was? Nun, ich habe vor ein paar Tagen eine seltsam aussehende Frau gesehen, die diese Mine alleine betreten hat. Ich bin mir nicht sicher, ob das hilfreich ist oder nicht!
dialogsBegin.fi: Another question? 8 Heroes huh? Well, I did see a strange looking woman enter this dungeon alone several days ago. Not sure if that will help or not!
dialogsBegin.fil: Another question? 8 Heroes huh? Well, I did see a strange looking woman enter this dungeon alone several days ago. Not sure if that will help or not!
dialogsBegin.fr: De la fierté mal placée de la part d'un Héros réincarné ? Possible….
dialogsBegin.id: Pertanyaan lain?? 8 Pahlawan ya?? Yah, aku memang melihat seorang wanita yang tampak aneh memasuki penjara bawah tanah ini sendirian beberapa hari yang lalu. Tidak yakin apakah itu akan membantu atau tidak!
dialogsBegin.it: Another question? 8 Heroes huh? Well, I did see a strange looking woman enter this dungeon alone several days ago. Not sure if that will help or not!
dialogsBegin.jp: ん？　他にも英雄について聞きたい？　んん～、思い当たることとしては、見かけない女がこの間このダンジョンに入ってたけど……
dialogsBegin.kr: 또 질문 있나요? 8명의 영웅 말인가요? 글쎄요, 며칠 전에 이 던전에 혼자 들어온 이상한 여자를 본 적은 있어요. 도움이 될지는 모르겠지만!
dialogsBegin.nl: Another question? 8 Heroes huh? Well, I did see a strange looking woman enter this dungeon alone several days ago. Not sure if that will help or not!

dialogsBegin.ru: Another question? 8 Heroes huh? Well, I did see a strange looking woman enter this dungeon alone several days ago. Not sure if that will help or not!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿¿Otra pregunta?? ¿¿8 Héroes dices?? Bueno, vi a una mujer de aspecto extraño entrar sola en esta mazmorra hace varios días. ¡No se si eso te sirve de ayuda o no!
dialogsBegin.sw: Another question? 8 Heroes huh? Well, I did see a strange looking woman enter this dungeon alone several days ago. Not sure if that will help or not!
dialogsBegin.th: คำถามอีกข้อ? 8 ผู้กล้า ห๊ะะ ?? เยี่ยม ฉันเห็นผู้หญิงที่ดูแปลก ๆ เข้าไปในดันเจี้ยนนี้เพียงลำพังเมื่อหลายวันก่อน ไม่แน่ใจว่าข้อมูลนี้จะช่วยได้ไหม!
dialogsBegin.tw: 還有別的問題？八英雄啊？嗯，我幾天前確實看到一個長相奇怪的女人獨自進入這個副本。不知道這對你有沒有幫助！
dialogsBegin.vi: Lại thêm một câu hỏi nữa? 8 Heroes hả? Chà, tôi có nhìn thấy một người phụ nữ trông kỳ lạ bước vào ngục tối này một mình vài ngày trước. Tôi không chắc thông tin này có ích cho bạn đâu đấy nhé!

dialogsBegin.ar: Anyway! I told you what you need to know. Will you go get the petals now and let me eat in peace?
dialogsBegin.br: De qualquer forma! Eu disse o que você precisa saber. Pode ir pegar as pétalas agora e me deixar comer em paz??
dialogsBegin.cns: Anyway! I told you what you need to know. Will you go get the petals now and let me eat in peace?
dialogsBegin.de: Wie auch immer! Ich habe dir gesagt, was du wissen musst. Holst du jetzt die Petals und lässt mich in Ruhe essen?

dialogsBegin.fil: Anyway! I told you what you need to know. Will you go get the petals now and let me eat in peace?

dialogsBegin.jp: まあ、とにかく。呪いについてはブウの花びらを飲むのがいいんじゃない？　昔から薬剤として有名な材料だよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 어쨌든! 알아야 하는 건 다 말해 드렸어요. 이제 꽃잎이나 가져오시죠. 조용히 식사 좀 하게 내버려두실래요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Anyway! I told you what you need to know. Will you go get the petals now and let me eat in peace?
dialogsBegin.pl: Anyway! I told you what you need to know. Will you go get the petals now and let me eat in peace?
dialogsBegin.ru: Anyway! I told you what you need to know. Will you go get the petals now and let me eat in peace?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Pues eso! Te he dicho lo que necesitas saber. ¿¿Ahora te irás a buscar los pétalos y me dejarás comer en paz??
dialogsBegin.sw: Anyway! I told you what you need to know. Will you go get the petals now and let me eat in peace?
dialogsBegin.th: เอาล่ะ! ฉันบอกสิ่งที่คุณต้องการรู้ไปแล้ว คุณจะไปหา Petals ตอนนี้และปล่อยให้ฉันกินอย่างสงบได้รึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 總之，我該說的都說了。你現在可以去幫我拿花瓣，讓我安安靜靜吃飯了吧？
dialogsBegin.vi: Dẫu sao thì! Tôi đã nói với bạn những gì bạn cần biết. Bây giờ bạn sẽ đi lấy những cánh hoa đó và để yên cho tôi ăn chứ?

dialogsAccept.en: Yes Yes, acquire 10 Boo Petals from the Boos in the forests of Darkon 3. This should take care of your problem!
dialogsAccept.ar: Yes Yes, acquire 10 Boo Petals from the Boos in the forests of Darkon 3. This should take care of your problem!
dialogsAccept.br: Sim Sim, adquira 10 Pétalas dos Boos nas florestas de Darkon 3. Isso deve resolver seu problema!
dialogsAccept.cns: 没错，在达肯3森林中的毒花兽那里获得10个花兽花瓣。这应该可以解决你的问题了。
dialogsAccept.de: Ja Ja, sammle 10 Boo Petals von den Boos in den Wäldern von Darkon 3. Damit sollte das Problem gelöst sein!
dialogsAccept.fi: Yes Yes, acquire 10 Boo Petals from the Boos in the forests of Darkon 3. This should take care of your problem!
dialogsAccept.fil: Yes Yes, acquire 10 Boo Petals from the Boos in the forests of Darkon 3. This should take care of your problem!
dialogsAccept.fr: …pour une tisane…
dialogsAccept.id: Ya Ya, dapatkan 10 Boo Petals dari Boo di hutan Darkon 3. Ini seharusnya bisa mengatasi masalah Anda!
dialogsAccept.it: Yes Yes, acquire 10 Boo Petals from the Boos in the forests of Darkon 3. This should take care of your problem!
dialogsAccept.jp: よくわからないけどアンタもお使いばかりで大変なんだろうな。花びらは10枚もあれば十分だと思うよ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 그래요, 다콘 제3지구 숲에 있는 부우에서 부우 꽃잎 10장을 구해 오세요. 그럼 문제가 해결될 거예요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Yes Yes, acquire 10 Boo Petals from the Boos in the forests of Darkon 3. This should take care of your problem!
dialogsAccept.pl: Yes Yes, acquire 10 Boo Petals from the Boos in the forests of Darkon 3. This should take care of your problem!
dialogsAccept.ru: Yes Yes, acquire 10 Boo Petals from the Boos in the forests of Darkon 3. This should take care of your problem!
dialogsAccept.sp: Sí sí, consigue los 10 Pétalos de Boo de los Boos en los bosques de Darkon 3. ¡Eso debería resolver tu problema!
dialogsAccept.sw: Yes Yes, acquire 10 Boo Petals from the Boos in the forests of Darkon 3. This should take care of your problem!
dialogsAccept.th: ใช่ ใช่แล้ว ซื้อ Boo Petals 10 จาก Boos ในป่า Darkon 3
dialogsAccept.tw: 快回去吧。只要從得肯第三區森林裡的布布身上取得 10 個兩棲毒花葉，熬煮後吃下，詛咒的解除速度應該會加快吧。
dialogsAccept.vi: Vâng vâng, hãy mua 10 Boo Petals từ Boo trong những cánh rừng của Darkon 3. Việc này sẽ giải quyết vấn đề của bạn!

dialogsDecline.en: Ahh! Can't you see I'm trying to eat. Please don't disturb me right now!!

dialogsDecline.fil: Ahh! Can't you see I'm trying to eat. Please don't disturb me right now!!
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous me prenez pour un charlatan ? C'est vous qui voyez.
dialogsDecline.id: Ahh! Tidak bisakah kamu melihat aku mencoba makan. Tolong jangan ganggu saya sekarang!!
dialogsDecline.it: Ahh! Can't you see I'm trying to eat. Please don't disturb me right now!!
dialogsDecline.jp: よくわからないけどアンタもお使いばかりで大変なんだろうな。
dialogsDecline.kr: 아아! 지금 밥 먹는 거 안 보이세요? 제발 방해 좀 하지 마세요!!
dialogsDecline.nl: Ahh! Can't you see I'm trying to eat. Please don't disturb me right now!!

dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Ah! ¿No ves que estoy intentando comer? ¡¡Por favor no me molestes más!!
dialogsDecline.sw: Ahh! Can't you see I'm trying to eat. Please don't disturb me right now!!
dialogsDecline.th: อ่า! คุณไม่เห็นว่าฉันกำลังพยายามรีบกินอยู่หรอ กรุณาอย่ารบกวนฉันตอนนี้!
dialogsDecline.tw: 你不知道吃飯的時候，連狗都不敢過來招惹嗎？我吃飯完以後，你再過來吧。
dialogsDecline.vi: Ahh! Bạn không thấy tôi đang cố ăn sao. Xin đừng làm phiền tôi ngay bây giờ !!

dialogsComplete.en: Aha! I knew Rankashu would spill the information for an easy meal. So these leaves will speed up the process you say?
dialogsComplete.ar: Aha! I knew Rankashu would spill the information for an easy meal. So these leaves will speed up the process you say?

dialogsComplete.de: Aha! Ich wusste, dass Rankashu die Informationen für eine einfache Mahlzeit weitergeben würde. Diese Blätter beschleunigen also den Prozess, sagst du?

dialogsComplete.fr: Une tisane pour être débarrassé de la malédiction ? Sérieusement ?
dialogsComplete.id: Aha! Saya tahu Rankashu akan memberikan informasi untuk makanan yang dia dapat. Jadi menurutmu daun-daun ini akan mempercepat prosesnya?
dialogsComplete.it: Aha! I knew Rankashu would spill the information for an easy meal. So these leaves will speed up the process you say?
dialogsComplete.jp: この花びらを食べれば解呪が早くなるって……？　ふん、気休め程度にしかならん。
dialogsComplete.kr: 아하! 랑카슈는 한 끼 식사에도 금세 정보를 흘릴 줄 예상했죠. 그래서 이 꽃잎이 저주를 더 빨리 풀어준다고요?
dialogsComplete.nl: Aha! I knew Rankashu would spill the information for an easy meal. So these leaves will speed up the process you say?
dialogsComplete.pl: Aha! I knew Rankashu would spill the information for an easy meal. So these leaves will speed up the process you say?
dialogsComplete.ru: Aha! I knew Rankashu would spill the information for an easy meal. So these leaves will speed up the process you say?
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Ajá! Sabía que Rankashu soltaría la información por una deliciosa comida. ¿Entonces estos pétalos acelerarán el proceso?
dialogsComplete.sw: Aha! I knew Rankashu would spill the information for an easy meal. So these leaves will speed up the process you say?
dialogsComplete.th: อ่าาา ! ฉันรู้ Rakashu จะทำอาหารหกง่าย ดังนั้นใบเหล่านี้จะเร่งกระบวนการที่คุณพูด?
dialogsComplete.tw: 只要將這花朵熬煮來吃，就能夠盡快解除詛咒嗎？天哪…不是立刻解除嗎？
dialogsComplete.vi: Aha! Tôi biết Rankashu sẽ cung cấp thông tin chỉ với một bữa ăn. Vậy những chiếc lá này sẽ đẩy nhanh quá trình bạn cần?

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

description.jp: キプラのセルを訪ねよ。
description.nl: Seek out Cell and ask him to grind the Steel Pieces.
description.pl: Odszukaj Cella i poproś go o zmielenie Kawałków Stali.
description.ru: Отыскать Селла и попросить измельчить кусочек металла.

dialogsBegin.en: Ahh~ turning Steel Pieces into Hard Steel Powder? Actually, I will unfortunately be unable to complete such a request, for my machinery currently is not operational.
dialogsBegin.ar: Ahh~ turning Steel Pieces into Hard Steel Powder? Actually, I will unfortunately be unable to complete such a request, for my machinery currently is not operational.
dialogsBegin.br: Ahh~ transformar pedaços de aço em Pó de Aço Reforçado? Na verdade, infelizmente não poderei concluir tal solicitação, pois meu maquinário atualmente não está operacional.
dialogsBegin.cns: 啊~把钢铁片变成硬钢粉？事实上，很遗憾，我无法完成这样的要求，因为我的机器目前还不能运行。
dialogsBegin.de: Ahh~ Steel Pieces in Hard Steel Powder verwandeln? Ich bin leider nicht in der Lage, eine solche Anfrage zu erfüllen, da meine Maschinen derzeit nicht einsatzbereit sind.
dialogsBegin.fi: Ahh~ turning Steel Pieces into Hard Steel Powder? Actually, I will unfortunately be unable to complete such a request, for my machinery currently is not operational.
dialogsBegin.fil: Ahh~ turning Steel Pieces into Hard Steel Powder? Actually, I will unfortunately be unable to complete such a request, for my machinery currently is not operational.
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous voulez de la poudre d'acier trempé, c'est ça ?
dialogsBegin.id: Ahh ~ mengubah Steel Pieces menjadi Hard Steel Powder? Sebenarnya, sayangnya saya tidak akan dapat menyelesaikan permintaan seperti itu, karena mesin saya saat ini tidak berfungsi.
dialogsBegin.it: Ahh~ turning Steel Pieces into Hard Steel Powder? Actually, I will unfortunately be unable to complete such a request, for my machinery currently is not operational.
dialogsBegin.jp: さて、これで鉄板は磨かれて輝きを取り戻したな。ところでこれを何に使うのだ？　ん、なるほど。そういう事情があったのか。
dialogsBegin.kr: 자~ 여기 있네! 철조각으로 단련시켰네. 근데 이건 무엇에다 쓰려고 하는 건가? 음? 단단한 철가루로 만들어 가야 한다고?
dialogsBegin.nl: Ahh~ turning Steel Pieces into Hard Steel Powder? Actually, I will unfortunately be unable to complete such a request, for my machinery currently is not operational.
dialogsBegin.pl: Ahh! Przekształcanie Stalowych Kawałków w Stalowy Twardy Proszek? Właściwie, niestety nie będę w stanie zrealizować tej prośby, moja maszyna obecnie nie działa.
dialogsBegin.ru: Ахх... Измельчить металл в пыль? Извини, не выйдет - нужный для этого станок вышел из строя.
dialogsBegin.sp: Ahh~ ¿convertir las Piezas de Acero en Polvo de Acero Duro? Lo siento pero no podré hacerlo porque mi maquinaria no está operativa.
dialogsBegin.sw: Ahh~ turning Steel Pieces into Hard Steel Powder? Actually, I will unfortunately be unable to complete such a request, for my machinery currently is not operational.
dialogsBegin.th: Ahh ~ เปลี่ยนชิ้นส่วนเหล็กเป็น Hard Steel Powder? อันที่จริงฉันโชคร้ายที่ไม่สามารถดำเนินการตามคำขอดังกล่าวได้เนื่องจากเครื่องจักรของฉันยังไม่สามารถใช้งานได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 就是這個！我已經鍛鍊成非常堅硬的鐵碎片了。不過你要使用什麼地方呢？嗯？你說要製作成堅硬的鐵粉末啊？
dialogsBegin.vi: Ahh ~ biến các Steel Pieces thành Hard Steel Powder? Trên thực tế, tôi rất tiếc sẽ không thể hoàn thành một yêu cầu như vậy được vì máy móc của tôi hiện không có khả năng đáp ứng được.

dialogsBegin.en: The only other person I can think of with machinery powerful enough to grind the Steel Pieces to Powder would be cell at the Erons Factory. Seek him out and ask for his help!
dialogsBegin.ar: The only other person I can think of with machinery powerful enough to grind the Steel Pieces to Powder would be cell at the Erons Factory. Seek him out and ask for his help!
dialogsBegin.br: A única outra pessoa em que consigo pensar com maquinário poderoso o suficiente para transformar as Peças de Aço em Pó seria Cell da Fábrica Erons. Procure-o e peça sua ajuda!
dialogsBegin.cns: 我能想到的唯一一个拥有足以将钢片磨成粉末的机器的人是绿磷石工厂的飞儿。去找他，寻求他的帮助吧!
dialogsBegin.de: Die einzige andere Person, die über Maschinen verfügt, die stark genug sind, um die Steel Pieces zu Pulver zu mahlen, ist Cell in der Erons Factory. Sucht ihn auf und bittet ihn um Hilfe!
dialogsBegin.fi: The only other person I can think of with machinery powerful enough to grind the Steel Pieces to Powder would be cell at the Erons Factory. Seek him out and ask for his help!
dialogsBegin.fil: The only other person I can think of with machinery powerful enough to grind the Steel Pieces to Powder would be cell at the Erons Factory. Seek him out and ask for his help!
dialogsBegin.fr: Cell à l'usine des Erons possède des outils nécessaires pour cette opération. Il se fera un plaisir de faire de la poudre avec vos morceaux.
dialogsBegin.id: Satu-satunya orang lain yang dapat saya pikirkan dengan mesin yang cukup kuat untuk menggiling Steel Pieces menjadi Powder adalah Cell di Erons Factory. Carilah dia dan minta bantuannya!
dialogsBegin.it: The only other person I can think of with machinery powerful enough to grind the Steel Pieces to Powder would be cell at the Erons Factory. Seek him out and ask for his help!
dialogsBegin.jp: この鉄板をさらに粉末にするには私の力では足りないな。キプラにセルという男がいる。彼ならばそういう作業もできると思うぞ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 단단한 철조각을 철가루로 분쇄시키려면 에렌펙스에 있는 관리소장 셀에게 가야하네. 그라면 에렌팩스의 기계로 이 단단한 철조각을 가루로 만들어 줄 수 있을 거야.
dialogsBegin.nl: The only other person I can think of with machinery powerful enough to grind the Steel Pieces to Powder would be cell at the Erons Factory. Seek him out and ask for his help!
dialogsBegin.pl: Jedyną osobą, która przychodzi mi do głowy, z maszynami wystarczająco potężnymi, by zmielić Kawałki Stali na Proszek, byłaby komórka w Fabryce Eronsa. Odszukaj go i poproś o pomoc!
dialogsBegin.ru: Единственный, кто ещё может тебе с этим помочь, обитает на Эрониевой фактории. Отыщи его!
dialogsBegin.sp: Creo que la única persona que tiene una maquinaria lo suficientemente potente como para convertir las Piezas de Acero en Polvo es Cell, que está en la Fábrica de Erons. ¡Búscalo y pídele ayuda!
dialogsBegin.sw: The only other person I can think of with machinery powerful enough to grind the Steel Pieces to Powder would be cell at the Erons Factory. Seek him out and ask for his help!
dialogsBegin.th: คนอื่น ๆ ที่ฉันสามารถคิดกับเครื่องจักรที่มีพลังมากพอที่จะบดชิ้นส่วนเหล็กให้เป็นผงจะเป็น cell ที่โรงงาน Erons ขอให้เขาออกไปและขอความช่วยเหลือจากเขา!
dialogsBegin.tw: 如果想要把這個堅硬的鐵碎片粉碎為鐵粉末，必須去找在艾磷斯工廠的管理所長飛兒。因為他是那工業園區的負責人。他可以用艾磷斯工廠的機器，將那堅硬的鐵碎片製作鐵粉末。
dialogsBegin.vi: Người duy nhất mà tôi có thể nghĩ đến với máy móc đủ mạnh để nghiền các Steel Pieces thành Powder sẽ là Cell tại Erons Factory. Tìm kiếm anh ta và yêu cầu sự giúp đỡ từ anh ấy!

dialogsAccept.en: I have little to no clue what you intend to do with the Hard Steel Powder, but I wish you luck!
dialogsAccept.ar: I have little to no clue what you intend to do with the Hard Steel Powder, but I wish you luck!
dialogsAccept.br: Eu tenho pouca ou nenhuma ideia do que você pretende fazer com o Pó de Aço Reforçado, mas desejo-lhe sorte!
dialogsAccept.cns: 我不知道你打算用硬钢粉做什么，但我祝你好运!
dialogsAccept.de: Ich habe wenig bis gar keine Ahnung, was Sie mit dem Hard Steel Powder vorhaben, aber ich wünsche Ihnen viel Glück!
dialogsAccept.fi: I have little to no clue what you intend to do with the Hard Steel Powder, but I wish you luck!
dialogsAccept.fil: I have little to no clue what you intend to do with the Hard Steel Powder, but I wish you luck!
dialogsAccept.fr: J'espère que vous savez ce que vous faites…
dialogsAccept.id: Saya tidak tahu apa yang ingin Anda lakukan dengan Hard Steel Powder, tetapi saya berharap Anda beruntung!
dialogsAccept.it: I have little to no clue what you intend to do with the Hard Steel Powder, but I wish you luck!
dialogsAccept.jp: どのような事情かわからんが、君もきっと鉄の魅力に取りつかれた一人なのだろう。私は鉄愛好者を応援しているぞ！
dialogsAccept.kr: 단단한 강철 가루로 뭘 하려는 건지는 모르겠지만, 행운을 빌어요!
dialogsAccept.nl: I have little to no clue what you intend to do with the Hard Steel Powder, but I wish you luck!
dialogsAccept.pl: Nie mam pojęcia, co zamierzasz zrobić z Stalowym Twardym Proszkiem, ale życzę ci szczęścia!
dialogsAccept.ru: Не знаю, зачем тебе вдруг понадобился металлический порошок, но удачи!
dialogsAccept.sp: Tengo poca o ninguna idea de lo que vas a hacer con el Polvo de Acero Duro, ¡pero te deseo suerte!
dialogsAccept.sw: I have little to no clue what you intend to do with the Hard Steel Powder, but I wish you luck!
dialogsAccept.th: คุณตั้งใจจะทำอย่างไรกับ Hard Steel Powder แต่ฉันขอให้คุณโชคดี!
dialogsAccept.tw: 雖然不知道你是為了什麼事情在收集材料，但希望你能夠順利拿到材料。那麼就快過去找飛兒吧。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi không biết bạn định làm gì với Hard Steel Powder, nhưng tôi chúc bạn may mắn!

dialogsDecline.en: Well! Back to work for me!
dialogsDecline.ar: Well! Back to work for me!
dialogsDecline.br: Bem! É melhor eu voltar ao trabalho!
dialogsDecline.cns: 好了! 又要为我工作了!
dialogsDecline.de: Na also! Zurück an die Arbeit für mich!
dialogsDecline.fi: Well! Back to work for me!
dialogsDecline.fil: Well! Back to work for me!
dialogsDecline.fr: J'espère que vous savez ce que vous faites…
dialogsDecline.id: Kembalilah bekerja untuk saya!
dialogsDecline.it: Well! Back to work for me!
dialogsDecline.jp: ふむ、そうか。まあ、気が向いたら訪れてみるとよいさ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 그럼, 전 이만 일하러 갈게요!
dialogsDecline.nl: Well! Back to work for me!
dialogsDecline.pl: Well! Back to work for me!
dialogsDecline.ru: Well! Back to work for me!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Bueno! ¡De vuelta al trabajo!
dialogsDecline.sw: Well! Back to work for me!
dialogsDecline.th: ดี! กลับไปทำงานให้ฉัน!
dialogsDecline.tw: 我已經回答你所問的問題了，那麼我要去忙我的事情了。
dialogsDecline.vi: Chà chà! Quay lại làm việc cho tôi à!

dialogsComplete.en: Har har har what do we have here? A new employee? You seem a little puny for a factory worker? Oh, nevermind!
dialogsComplete.ar: Har har har what do we have here? A new employee? You seem a little puny for a factory worker? Oh, nevermind!
dialogsComplete.br: Har har har o que temos aqui?? Um novo funcionário? Você não me parece um pouco insignificante para ser.. um operário de fábrica?? Ah, tanto faz!
dialogsComplete.cns: Har har har what do we have here? A new employee? You seem a little puny for a factory worker? Oh, nevermind!
dialogsComplete.de: Har har har was haben wir denn hier?? Einen neuen Mitarbeiter? Du scheinst ein wenig mickrig für einen Fabrikarbeiter zu sein. Oh, vergiss es!
dialogsComplete.fi: Har har har what do we have here? A new employee? You seem a little puny for a factory worker? Oh, nevermind!
dialogsComplete.fil: Har har har what do we have here? A new employee? You seem a little puny for a factory worker? Oh, nevermind!
dialogsComplete.fr: Vous, je sais pourquoi vous êtes là !
dialogsComplete.id: Har har har apa yang kita miliki di sini?? Karyawan baru? Kamu tampak sedikit lemah untuk seorang pekerja pabrik?? Oh, lupakan saja!
dialogsComplete.it: Har har har what do we have here? A new employee? You seem a little puny for a factory worker? Oh, nevermind!
dialogsComplete.jp: ん？　君はこんなところで何をしているんだい？　ふむふむ、アマドルカーがそんなことを言っていたのか。
dialogsComplete.kr: 하하하, 이건 또 누구지? 신입 사원인가? 공장에서 일할 사람치고는 너무 비실비실해 보이는데? 아, 신경 안 쓰셔도 돼요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Har har har what do we have here? A new employee? You seem a little puny for a factory worker? Oh, nevermind!
dialogsComplete.pl: Har har har what do we have here? A new employee? You seem a little puny for a factory worker? Oh, nevermind!
dialogsComplete.ru: Har har har what do we have here? A new employee? You seem a little puny for a factory worker? Oh, nevermind!
dialogsComplete.sp: Jua jua jua ¿¿qué tenemos aquí?? ¿Un nuevo empleado? Pareces un poco insignificante para ser un trabajador de fábrica. ¡Bueno no importa!
dialogsComplete.sw: Har har har what do we have here? A new employee? You seem a little puny for a factory worker? Oh, nevermind!
dialogsComplete.th: ฮ่า ฮ่า ฮ่า ดูซิว่าเราเจอใคร? พนักงานใหม่หรือ? คุณดูอ่อนแอกว่าคนงานในโรงงานอีกนะ ? แต่เอาเถอะ ไม่เป็นไร!
dialogsComplete.tw: 哈哈哈，這是什麼？新員工嗎？你看起來有點太瘦弱，不像工廠工人耶？啊，算了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Ha ha ha chúng ta có gì ở đây nào? Nhân viên mới à? Trông bạn có vẻ hơi nhỏ con so với một công nhân nhà máy thì phải? Mà thôi, đừng bận tâm!

dialogsFail.de: Ja, Cell ist sein Name. Ihr solltet ihn nördlich von diesem Ort finden können. Bitte ihn, die Steel Pieces für dich zu schleifen.
dialogsFail.fi: Yes, Cell is his name. You should be able to find him North of this location. Ask him to grind the Steel Pieces for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Yes, Cell is his name. You should be able to find him North of this location. Ask him to grind the Steel Pieces for you.

dialogsFail.jp: キプラのセルという人物だ。おそらく普段からボーっとしているから今日も暇だろう。

dialogsFail.th: ใช่ Cell คือชื่อเขา คุณควรจะหาเขาทางเหนือของตำแหน่งนี้ ขอให้เขาบดเหล็กให้คุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果想要製作成堅硬的鐵粉末，必須去找在艾磷斯工廠的飛兒。
dialogsFail.vi: Vâng, Cell là tên của anh ấy. Bạn sẽ có thể tìm thấy anh ta ở phía Bắc từ vị trí này. Yêu cầu anh ta mài các Steel Pieces cho bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

description.en: Please deliver this book to Gothante. This may not be enough to save the world but it should be useful. Thank you and good luck.
description.ar: Please deliver this book to Gothante. This may not be enough to save the world but it should be useful. Thank you and good luck.
description.br: Entregue este livro a Gothante. Pode não ser suficiente para salvar o mundo, mas pode ser útil. Obrigada e boa sorte.
description.cns: 把这个东西拿去给扎森特。这是我对他们调查的一些事情，虽然不是很多的资料，可是，应该会有一点帮助啦。
description.de: Hier sind die Daten die ich untersucht habe. Bitte bringe sie zu Gothante. Es ist nicht viel, aber es wird sehr hilfreich sein. Viel Glück.
description.fi: Please deliver this book to Gothante. This may not be enough to save the world but it should be useful. Thank you and good luck.

description.id: Tolong antarkan buku ini ke Gothante. Ini mungkin tidak cukup untuk menyelamatkan dunia, tapi paling tidak, akan berguna. Terima kasih dan semoga berhasil.
description.it: Please deliver this book to Gothante. This may not be enough to save the world but it should be useful. Thank you and good luck.
description.jp: ラオラから貰った本を、ゴダンテに渡しにいこう。
description.kr: 이 책을 고단테에게 전달해 주세요. 세상을 구하긴 부족할지 몰라도, 분명 도움이 될 겁니다. 고마워요, 행운을 빌어요.
description.nl: Please deliver this book to Gothante. This may not be enough to save the world but it should be useful. Thank you and good luck.

description.vi: Vui lòng giao cuốn sách này cho Gothante. Điều này có thể không đủ để cứu thế giới nhưng nó sẽ hữu ích. Cảm ơn và chúc may mắn.

dialogsBegin.en: *cough* *cough* This bead, with all of its power, was crafted by the only pupil I ever had, Lapranche. *cough*
dialogsBegin.ar: *cough* *cough* This bead, with all of its power, was crafted by the only pupil I ever had, Lapranche. *cough*
dialogsBegin.br: *cof* Esta pérola, com todo o seu poder, foi elaborada por meu único pupilo, Lapranche. *cof*
dialogsBegin.cns: 这个晶球是我的徒弟<拉佛兰栖>做的..
dialogsBegin.de: *hust* *hust* Diese Perle, mit all ihrer Macht, wurde von meinem besten Schüler Lapranche hergestellt. *hust*
dialogsBegin.fi: *cough* *cough* This bead, with all of its power, was crafted by the only pupil I ever had, Lapranche. *cough*
dialogsBegin.fil: *cough* *cough* This bead, with all of its power, was crafted by the only pupil I ever had, Lapranche. *cough*
dialogsBegin.fr: (d'un air ennuyé) Ce manuscrit est l'oeuvre du Magicien Pourpre… pour ma part, on m'appelait la Magicienne Violette
dialogsBegin.id: *uhuk* *uhuk* Manik ini, dengan seluruh kekuatannya, dibuat oleh satu-satunya murid yang pernah kumiliki, Lapranche. *uhuk*
dialogsBegin.it: *cough* *cough* This bead, with all of its power, was crafted by the only pupil I ever had, Lapranche. *cough*
dialogsBegin.jp: このオーブについてだけど…大変なことが起きたわ。この２つのオーブは、私のかつての一番弟子だった＜ラプランチェ＞が作ったものよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: *콜록* *콜록* 이 엄청난 힘을 가진 구슬은, 제 유일한 제자 라프란체가 만든 거군요. *콜록* *콜록*
dialogsBegin.nl: *cough* *cough* This bead, with all of its power, was crafted by the only pupil I ever had, Lapranche. *cough*
dialogsBegin.pl: *cough* *cough* This bead, with all of its power, was crafted by the only pupil I ever had, Lapranche. *cough*
dialogsBegin.ru: Эту бусину мог создать лишь один человек. Мой единственный ученик. Арлакин.
dialogsBegin.sp: *cof* *cof* Esta perla, con todo su poder, fue creada por el único aprendiz que he tenido, Lapranche. *cof*
dialogsBegin.sw: *cough* *cough* This bead, with all of its power, was crafted by the only pupil I ever had, Lapranche. *cough*
dialogsBegin.th: *ไอ* *ไอ* ลูกปัดนี้ด้วยพลังทั้งหมด ถูกประดิษฐ์ขึ้นโดยลูกศิษย์คนเดียวที่ฉันเคยมี Lapranche *ไอ*
dialogsBegin.tw: *咳咳* *咳咳* 這顆擁有所有力量的珠子是由我唯一的學生拉普朗什製作的。*咳嗽*
dialogsBegin.vi: * ho * * ho * Hạt này, với tất cả sức mạnh của nó, được tạo ra bởi học trò duy nhất mà tôi từng có, Lapranche. *ho*

dialogsBegin.en: She is the Black Magician. I was also the Black Magician at one point. We have often been confused for each other throughout history. *Sigh* It seems that Lapranche found out about them.
dialogsBegin.ar: She is the Black Magician. I was also the Black Magician at one point. We have often been confused for each other throughout history. *Sigh* It seems that Lapranche found out about them.
dialogsBegin.br: Ela é o Mago Negro. Eu também já fui um Mago Negro certa vez. Frequentemente nos confundiam ao longo da História. *uff* Parece que Lapranche descobriu sobre eles
dialogsBegin.cns: She is the Black Magician. I was also the Black Magician at one point. We have often been confused for each other throughout history. *Sigh* It seems that Lapranche found out about them.
dialogsBegin.de: Er ist der Black Magican. Ich bin auch der Black Magican. Vielleicht weisst du.. Er scheint nun auch zu wissen.. puh..
dialogsBegin.fi: She is the Black Magician. I was also the Black Magician at one point. We have often been confused for each other throughout history. *Sigh* It seems that Lapranche found out about them.
dialogsBegin.fil: She is the Black Magician. I was also the Black Magician at one point. We have often been confused for each other throughout history. *Sigh* It seems that Lapranche found out about them.
dialogsBegin.fr: Elle est la magicienne noire. J'ai également été le magicien noir à un moment donné. Nous avons souvent été confondus l'un avec l'autre au cours de l'histoire. *Il semble que Lapranche ait découvert leur existence.
dialogsBegin.id: Dia adalah Penyihir Hitam. Saya juga Penyihir Hitam pada satu titik. Kami sering bingung satu sama lain sepanjang sejarah. *Huh* Sepertinya Lapranche mengetahui tentang mereka.
dialogsBegin.it: She is the Black Magician. I was also the Black Magician at one point. We have often been confused for each other throughout history. *Sigh* It seems that Lapranche found out about them.
dialogsBegin.jp: 彼女はブラックマジシャンです。私はある時点で黒魔術師でもありました。私たちは歴史を通してしばしばお互いを混乱させてきました。*ため息*ラプランシュがそれらを知ったようです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그녀는 블랙 매지션이에요. 저도 한때는 블랙 매지션이었죠. 그동안 종종 서로를 혼동했던 역사가 길답니다. *한숨* 라프란체가 그들에 대해 알아낸 것 같군요.
dialogsBegin.nl: She is the Black Magician. I was also the Black Magician at one point. We have often been confused for each other throughout history. *Sigh* It seems that Lapranche found out about them.
dialogsBegin.pl: She is the Black Magician. I was also the Black Magician at one point. We have often been confused for each other throughout history. *Sigh* It seems that Lapranche found out about them.
dialogsBegin.ru: She is the Black Magician. I was also the Black Magician at one point. We have often been confused for each other throughout history. *Sigh* It seems that Lapranche found out about them.
dialogsBegin.sp: Ella es la Maga Negra. Yo también fui el Mago Negro. A menudo nos han confundido el uno con el otro a lo largo de la historia. *Parece que Lapranche los descubrió.
dialogsBegin.sw: She is the Black Magician. I was also the Black Magician at one point. We have often been confused for each other throughout history. *Sigh* It seems that Lapranche found out about them.
dialogsBegin.th: หล่อนคือจอมเวทย์มนต์ดำ ฉันยังเป็น Black Magician อยู่ ณ จุดหนึ่ง เรามักจะสับสนกันตลอดประวัติศาสตร์ *ถอนหายใจ* ดูเหมือนว่า Lapranche จะรู้เกี่ยวกับพวกเขา
dialogsBegin.tw: 那個人就是黑暗魔法師，可能已經有聽說過了…其實，我也是黑暗魔法師。拉普朗什…可能已經發現了…
dialogsBegin.vi: Cô ấy là Black Magician. Tôi cũng từng là Black Magician. Chúng tôi thường bị nhầm lẫn với nhau. *Thở dài* Có vẻ như Lapranche đã phát hiện ra chúng.

dialogsBegin.en: You believe in them now right? If you are looking to me for answers about what they were, you are wasting your time. All I know is that they created all of Madrigal and that they were once agents of Rhisis.
dialogsBegin.ar: You believe in them now right? If you are looking to me for answers about what they were, you are wasting your time. All I know is that they created all of Madrigal and that they were once agents of Rhisis.
dialogsBegin.br: Agora você acredita neles, né? Se quer que eu dê respostas sobre quem eles eram, está perdendo seu tempo. Tudo o que sei é que eles criaram toda Madrigal e que já foram agentes de Rhisis.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你是想要知道关于他们的事情吗?嗯..可是我也不是很清楚..我知道的只有他们是被黎席斯神所创作出来的。
dialogsBegin.de: (Sieht mich an) Du willst etwas über sie wissen? Das einzige was ich weiss ist, dass sie einst die Welt erschaffen haben. Und sie wiederum wurden vom Gott Rhsis erschaffen.
dialogsBegin.fi: You believe in them now right? If you are looking to me for answers about what they were, you are wasting your time. All I know is that they created all of Madrigal and that they were once agents of Rhisis.
dialogsBegin.fil: You believe in them now right? If you are looking to me for answers about what they were, you are wasting your time. All I know is that they created all of Madrigal and that they were once agents of Rhisis.
dialogsBegin.fr: Et bien…ce monde, Madrigal, a en fait été créé par des êtres très puissants, les Clowns - Bubble, Shade et Ivillis. Le Magicien Pourpre avait érigé des Autels en leur honneur…
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu percaya pada mereka sekarang kan? Jika Kamu mencariku untuk jawaban tentang apa itu, Kamu membuang-buang waktumu. Yang Aku tahu hanyalah mereka menciptakan Madrigal dan mereka pernah menjadi bagian dari agen Rhisis.
dialogsBegin.it: You believe in them now right? If you are looking to me for answers about what they were, you are wasting your time. All I know is that they created all of Madrigal and that they were once agents of Rhisis.
dialogsBegin.jp: 私が禁断の魔術を使ってこんな姿にされたのは、彼らの一員になることを拒否したからなの。彼らについて私が知っている情報は＜超越的な存在＞の指示のもとに、異端の魔術を使う恐るべき集団…。さらに＜超越的な存在＞はリシス神によって創造されたということ…。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이제 믿으시겠죠? 그들이 어떤 존재였는지 제게 물어도, 대답해 드릴 수 없어요. 제가 아는 건, 그들이 마드리갈을 창조했고, 한때는 리시스님의 사자였다는 것뿐.
dialogsBegin.nl: You believe in them now right? If you are looking to me for answers about what they were, you are wasting your time. All I know is that they created all of Madrigal and that they were once agents of Rhisis.
dialogsBegin.pl: You believe in them now right? If you are looking to me for answers about what they were, you are wasting your time. All I know is that they created all of Madrigal and that they were once agents of Rhisis.
dialogsBegin.ru: Теперь и ты веришь в *них*, да? Но даже не надейся выяснить, кто они и откуда пришли. Только время потеряешь. Довольно того, что они создали наш мир… и саму богиню Райс.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Ahora crees en ellos, verdad? Si estás buscando respuestas en mi sobre lo que eran, estás perdiendo el tiempo. Todo lo que sé es que ellos crearon todo Madrigal y que alguna vez fueron agentes de Rhisis.
dialogsBegin.sw: You believe in them now right? If you are looking to me for answers about what they were, you are wasting your time. All I know is that they created all of Madrigal and that they were once agents of Rhisis.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณเชื่อในพวกเขาตอนนี้ใช่ไหม หากคุณกำลังมองหาคำตอบเกี่ยวกับสิ่งที่พวกเขาเป็นคุณจะเสียเวลา ทั้งหมดที่ฉันรู้คือพวกเขาสร้าง Madrigal ทั้งหมด และเคยเป็นตัวแทนของ Rhisis
dialogsBegin.tw: 你是想要知道關於他們的事情嗎？嗯…可是我也不是很清楚…我知道的只有他們是被黎席斯神所創作出來的。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn tin vào họ bây giờ phải không? Nếu bạn đang tìm kiếm câu trả lời cho tôi về những gì họ đã có, bạn đang lãng phí thời gian của mình. Tất cả những gì tôi biết là họ đã tạo ra tất cả Madrigal và họ đã từng là đặc vụ của Rhisis.

dialogsBegin.en: Yes Lapranche found out about them and attempted to bring them back to this world with the Purple Magic, the same magic that drained me of so much.
dialogsBegin.ar: Yes Lapranche found out about them and attempted to bring them back to this world with the Purple Magic, the same magic that drained me of so much.
dialogsBegin.br: Sim, Lapranche descobriu sobre eles e tentou levá-los de volta para este mundo com a Magia Púrpura, a mesma que me tirou tantas coisas.
dialogsBegin.cns: 对，这家伙已经知道他是紫色的魔法，所以才对这个碰手的..我变成这个样子..也都是因为紫色的魔法而造成的..原来，所有的事情都是这样的。
dialogsBegin.de: Ja. Er kam, um etwas über sie zu erfahren und benutzte lila Magie. Die lila Magie machte mich zu dem was ich bin.
dialogsBegin.fi: Yes Lapranche found out about them and attempted to bring them back to this world with the Purple Magic, the same magic that drained me of so much.
dialogsBegin.fil: Yes Lapranche found out about them and attempted to bring them back to this world with the Purple Magic, the same magic that drained me of so much.
dialogsBegin.fr: Cependant Rhisis n'apprécia pas que les Clowns agissent et se fassent passer pour des dieux. Une guerre d'une violence inouïe éclata alors et... Madrigal... fut scindé en trois îles…
dialogsBegin.id: Ya, Lapranche mengetahui tentang mereka dan berusaha membawa mereka kembali ke dunia ini dengan Purple Magic, Magic yang sama yang membuatku kelelahan.
dialogsBegin.it: Yes Lapranche found out about them and attempted to bring them back to this world with the Purple Magic, the same magic that drained me of so much.
dialogsBegin.jp: ＜ラプランチェ＞は＜バイオレットシャドウ・マジシャンズ＞の存在を知り、禁断の魔法に手を出したのだと思うわ。…恐ろしいことに繋がらなければいいのだけど…
dialogsBegin.kr: 라프란체도 그들에 대해 알게 되었고, 그들을 이 세계로 되돌리기 위해 보라 마법을 사용했어요. 바로 그 마법이, 제 힘을 이렇게나 빼앗아 갔죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: Yes Lapranche found out about them and attempted to bring them back to this world with the Purple Magic, the same magic that drained me of so much.
dialogsBegin.pl: Yes Lapranche found out about them and attempted to bring them back to this world with the Purple Magic, the same magic that drained me of so much.
dialogsBegin.ru: Арлакин… Арлакин решил воззвать к ним с помощью лиловой магии, той самой, о которую я так обожглась. Эта магия окончательно поглотла его ослабевушую душу…
dialogsBegin.sp: Sí, Lapranche encontró algo sobre ellos e intentó traerlos de vuelta a este mundo con la Magia Violeta, la misma magia que me consumió.
dialogsBegin.sw: Yes Lapranche found out about them and attempted to bring them back to this world with the Purple Magic, the same magic that drained me of so much.
dialogsBegin.th: ใช่ Lapranche ค้นพบเกี่ยวกับพวกเขา และพยายามนำพวกเขากลับมายังโลกนี้ด้วย Purple Magic ซึ่งเป็นเวทมนตร์เดียวกับที่ทำให้ฉันหมดไปมาก
dialogsBegin.tw: 對，拉普朗什已經知道他是赤色的魔法，所以才對這個碰手的…我變成這個樣子…也都是因為赤色的魔法而造成的…原來，所有的事情都是這樣的。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tuy nhiên Rhisis không thích những chú hề hành động và giả làm thần. Một cuộc chiến bạo lực đáng kinh ngạc sau đó nổ ra và ... Madrigal ... bị chia cắt thành ba hòn đảo ...
