dialogsAccept.en: Please deliver this book to Gothante. This may not be enough to save the world but it should be useful. Thank you and good luck.
dialogsAccept.ar: Please deliver this book to Gothante. This may not be enough to save the world but it should be useful. Thank you and good luck.
dialogsAccept.br: Entregue este livro a Gothante. Pode não ser suficiente para salvar o mundo, mas pode ser útil. Obrigada e boa sorte.
dialogsAccept.cns: 把这个东西拿去给扎森特。这是我对他们调查的一些事情，虽然不是很多的资料，可是，应该会有一点帮助啦。
dialogsAccept.de: Hier sind die Daten die ich untersucht habe. Bitte bringe sie zu Gothante. Es ist nicht viel, aber es wird sehr hilfreich sein. Viel Glück.
dialogsAccept.fi: Please deliver this book to Gothante. This may not be enough to save the world but it should be useful. Thank you and good luck.
dialogsAccept.fil: Please deliver this book to Gothante. This may not be enough to save the world but it should be useful. Thank you and good luck.
dialogsAccept.fr: Apporter le Livre de Laola révélant l'histoire de Madrigal à Gothante, à Saincity.
dialogsAccept.id: Tolong antarkan buku ini ke Gothante. Ini mungkin tidak cukup untuk menyelamatkan dunia, tapi paling tidak, akan berguna. Terima kasih dan semoga berhasil.
dialogsAccept.it: Please deliver this book to Gothante. This may not be enough to save the world but it should be useful. Thank you and good luck.
dialogsAccept.jp: ラオラから貰った本を、ゴダンテに渡しにいこう。
dialogsAccept.kr: 이 책을 고단테에게 전달해 주세요. 세상을 구하긴 부족할지 몰라도, 분명 도움이 될 겁니다. 고마워요, 행운을 빌어요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Please deliver this book to Gothante. This may not be enough to save the world but it should be useful. Thank you and good luck.
dialogsAccept.pl: Please deliver this book to Gothante. This may not be enough to save the world but it should be useful. Thank you and good luck.
dialogsAccept.ru: Нужно отнести эту книгу Шлесингеру. Мир она не спасет, но пригодиться - пригодится.
dialogsAccept.sp: Por favor, llévale este libro a Gothante. Puede que esto no sea suficiente para salvar el mundo, pero debería ser útil. Gracias y buena suerte.
dialogsAccept.sw: Please deliver this book to Gothante. This may not be enough to save the world but it should be useful. Thank you and good luck.
dialogsAccept.th: โปรดส่งหนังสือเล่มนี้ให้ Gothante อาจไม่เพียงพอที่จะกอบกู้โลก แต่ควรเป็นประโยชน์ ขอบคุณและโชคดี
dialogsAccept.tw: 把這個東西拿去給高譚提拉。這是我對他們調查的一些事情，雖然不是很多的資料，可是，應該會有一點幫助啦。
dialogsAccept.vi: Vui lòng giao cuốn sách này cho Gothante. Điều này có thể không đủ để cứu thế giới nhưng nó sẽ hữu ích. Cảm ơn và chúc may mắn.

dialogsDecline.en: You are afraid. I am not surprised. The world hangs in the balance. Who would not be scared? Go on. Get out of here.
dialogsDecline.ar: You are afraid. I am not surprised. The world hangs in the balance. Who would not be scared? Go on. Get out of here.
dialogsDecline.br: Você está com medo. Não estou surpreso. O mundo está pendendo na balança. Quem não ficaria com medo? Vá em frente. Saia daqui.
dialogsDecline.cns: 嗯..连听都不听就拒绝我啊..嗯..你会害怕吗?呵呵呵。
dialogsDecline.de: Wie kannst du meine bitte ablehnen, ehe ich dich gefragt habe? Hmm.. Hast du Angst? Ho ho ho~
dialogsDecline.fi: You are afraid. I am not surprised. The world hangs in the balance. Who would not be scared? Go on. Get out of here.
dialogsDecline.fil: You are afraid. I am not surprised. The world hangs in the balance. Who would not be scared? Go on. Get out of here.
dialogsDecline.fr: Comment peux-tu refuser ma requête avant que je la formule ?
dialogsDecline.id: Aku tidak terkejut mau merasa takut. Dunia tergantung pada keseimbangan. Siapa yang tidak takut? Lanjutkan. Keluar dari sini.
dialogsDecline.it: You are afraid. I am not surprised. The world hangs in the balance. Who would not be scared? Go on. Get out of here.
dialogsDecline.jp: 聞きもしないで断るなんて。よっぽど臆病なの？
dialogsDecline.kr: 무섭겠죠. 이 세계의 운명이 걸려 있는데, 두려운 건 당연해요. 그래요. 떠나 버려요.
dialogsDecline.nl: You are afraid. I am not surprised. The world hangs in the balance. Who would not be scared? Go on. Get out of here.
dialogsDecline.pl: You are afraid. I am not surprised. The world hangs in the balance. Who would not be scared? Go on. Get out of here.
dialogsDecline.ru: Боишься? Я тебя понимаю. Мир висит на волоске. Любой бы испугался. Беги, прячься. Я тебя не держу.
dialogsDecline.sp: Tienes miedo. No me sorprende. El mundo pende de un hilo. ¿Quién no estaría asustado? Sigue adelante. Vete.
dialogsDecline.sw: You are afraid. I am not surprised. The world hangs in the balance. Who would not be scared? Go on. Get out of here.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณกลัว ฉันไม่แปลกใจเลย โลกแขวนอยู่ในสมดุล ใครจะไม่กลัว? ไปสิ ออกไปจากที่นี่
dialogsDecline.tw: 嗯…連聽都不聽就拒絕我啊…嗯…你會害怕嗎？呵呵呵。
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn sợ hãi. Tôi không ngạc nhiên. Bạn là người quá sợ mọi thứ. Ai sẽ không sợ hãi? Đi tiếp. Ra khỏi đây.

dialogsComplete.en: What a terrible... Where did they come from? Did you see them? Renegade Blades seemingly hired to kill me. It would appear that I know too much. What is that you have there?
dialogsComplete.ar: What a terrible... Where did they come from? Did you see them? Renegade Blades seemingly hired to kill me. It would appear that I know too much. What is that you have there?
dialogsComplete.br: Que terrível... de onde eles vieram? Você os viu? Blades  Renegados supostamente contratados para me matar. Parece que sei demais. O que você tem aí?
dialogsComplete.cns: What a terrible... Where did they come from? Did you see them? Renegade Blades seemingly hired to kill me. It would appear that I know too much. What is that you have there?
dialogsComplete.de: Oh danke. ich wurde beinahe getötet. Warum um alles in der Welt greifen sie mich an? Was für ein schrecklicher.. Nebenbei, was hälst du in der Hand?
dialogsComplete.fi: What a terrible... Where did they come from? Did you see them? Renegade Blades seemingly hired to kill me. It would appear that I know too much. What is that you have there?
dialogsComplete.fil: What a terrible... Where did they come from? Did you see them? Renegade Blades seemingly hired to kill me. It would appear that I know too much. What is that you have there?
dialogsComplete.fr: Les Mages Pourpres semblent être sur le pied de guerre… Oh, l'Archimage Laola t'a remis quelque chose pour moi ?
dialogsComplete.id: Mengerikan .. Dari mana mereka berasal? Apakah kamu melihat mereka? Renegade Blades tampaknya disewa untuk membunuhku. Sepertinya aku tahu terlalu banyak. Apa yang Kamu bawa itu?
dialogsComplete.it: What a terrible... Where did they come from? Did you see them? Renegade Blades seemingly hired to kill me. It would appear that I know too much. What is that you have there?
dialogsComplete.jp: おお、戻ってきたね。君が大魔導師＜ラオラ＞様のもとに出かけた後、大変なことが起きてな。得体の知れない何者かに急に襲われたんだ。必死で逃げてきたんだが、何とか命があってよかった。さて、ラオラ様からは情報をもらえたのか？
dialogsComplete.kr: 끔찍한... 어디서 온 사람들이죠? 봤어요? 변절한 블레이드들이 절 죽이라고 보냈겠죠. 제가 너무 많이 알아버린 것 같네요. 거기 들고 있는 건 뭐죠?
dialogsComplete.nl: What a terrible... Where did they come from? Did you see them? Renegade Blades seemingly hired to kill me. It would appear that I know too much. What is that you have there?
dialogsComplete.pl: What a terrible... Where did they come from? Did you see them? Renegade Blades seemingly hired to kill me. It would appear that I know too much. What is that you have there?
dialogsComplete.ru: What a terrible... Where did they come from? Did you see them? Renegade Blades seemingly hired to kill me. It would appear that I know too much. What is that you have there?
dialogsComplete.sp: Es terrible.. ¿De dónde han salido? ¿Los has visto? Parece que han contratado Blades Renegados para matarme. Parece que sé demasiado. ¿Qué es eso que tienes ahí?
dialogsComplete.sw: What a terrible... Where did they come from? Did you see them? Renegade Blades seemingly hired to kill me. It would appear that I know too much. What is that you have there?
dialogsComplete.th: ช่างน่ากลัวเสียจริง. พวกมันมาจากไหน? คุณเห็นพวกเขาไหม Renegade Blades ดูเหมือนจะถูกจ้างมาเพื่อฆ่าฉัน ดูเหมือนว่าฉันจะรู้มากเกินไป? นั่นคุณได้อะไรมา?
dialogsComplete.tw: 好可怕……他們從哪裡來？你看到他們了嗎？叛逆暗殺者似乎是受僱來殺我的。看來我知道的太多了。你那裡有什麼？
dialogsComplete.vi: Thật là khủng khiếp .. Chúng đến từ đâu? Bạn có thấy chúng không? Dường như Renegade Blades đã được thuê để giết tôi. Hình như do tôi biết quá nhiều. Mà bạn có cái gì ở đó thế?

dialogsComplete.ar: Oh, this! Is this the book that Laola wrote? Amazing
dialogsComplete.br: Ah, isto! Este é o livro que Laola escreveu? Impressionante
dialogsComplete.cns: 哇~这是拉宇写给我的吗?嗯..一看就知道是一个很贵重的东西了。

dialogsComplete.fi: Oh, this! Is this the book that Laola wrote? Amazing

dialogsComplete.it: Oh, this! Is this the book that Laola wrote? Amazing

dialogsComplete.kr: 오! 이 책… 설마 라올라가 쓴 책인가요? 놀랍군요.

dialogsComplete.pl: Oh, this! Is this the book that Laola wrote? Amazing

dialogsComplete.th: โอ้นี้! นี่คือหนังสือที่ Laola เขียนใช่ไหม อัศจรรย์มาก
dialogsComplete.tw: 哇~這是拉宇寫給我的嗎？嗯…一看就知道是一個很貴重的東西了。
dialogsComplete.vi: Ô, cái này! Đây có phải là cuốn sách mà Laola đã viết không? Kinh ngạc

dialogsComplete.en: Fine. Now we can begin the real reconstruction of the history of our world. Thank you. Oh, I may need you later on. See you then.
dialogsComplete.ar: Fine. Now we can begin the real reconstruction of the history of our world. Thank you. Oh, I may need you later on. See you then.
dialogsComplete.br: Está bem. Agora podemos começar a reconstrução real da História de nosso mundo. Obrigado. Ah, posso precisar de você mais tarde. Vejo você depois.
dialogsComplete.cns: 好了，我可以拿这些东西来专心的研究了。感谢你啦~啊，我还是会请你过来一趟的，过几天再见~
dialogsComplete.de: Gut! Darauf basierend können wir mit der echten Studie beginnen. Danke. Oh, vielleicht habe ich später nochmal eine Frage an dich. Bis bald.
dialogsComplete.fi: Fine. Now we can begin the real reconstruction of the history of our world. Thank you. Oh, I may need you later on. See you then.
dialogsComplete.fil: Fine. Now we can begin the real reconstruction of the history of our world. Thank you. Oh, I may need you later on. See you then.
dialogsComplete.fr: La vérité est enfin connue, il ne reste qu'à la répandre à travers tout Madrigal désormais !
dialogsComplete.id: Baik. Sekarang kita dapat memulai rekonstruksi sejarah dunia kita yang sebenarnya. Terima kasih. Oh, aku mungkin membutuhkanmu nanti. Sampai jumpa.
dialogsComplete.it: Fine. Now we can begin the real reconstruction of the history of our world. Thank you. Oh, I may need you later on. See you then.
dialogsComplete.jp: ようやくこれで本格的な研究ができるようになった、ありがとう。また君の助けを借りるときが来るかもしれない。そのときはよろしくな。
dialogsComplete.kr: 좋아요. 이제야 진짜로 우리 세계의 역사를 복원할 수 있겠네요. 감사합니다. 곧 또 부탁할 일이 생길지도 모르겠군요. 또 만나요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Fine. Now we can begin the real reconstruction of the history of our world. Thank you. Oh, I may need you later on. See you then.
dialogsComplete.pl: Fine. Now we can begin the real reconstruction of the history of our world. Thank you. Oh, I may need you later on. See you then.
dialogsComplete.ru: Отлично. Теперь мы знаем, как на самом деле появился наш мир. Спасибо! И заходи попозже, я найду, что тебе поручить.
dialogsComplete.sp: Vale. Ahora podemos comenzar la verdadera reconstrucción de la historia de nuestro mundo. Gracias. Emm, puede que te necesite más tarde. Hasta luego.
dialogsComplete.sw: Fine. Now we can begin the real reconstruction of the history of our world. Thank you. Oh, I may need you later on. See you then.
dialogsComplete.th: ดี ตอนนี้ เราสามารถเริ่มต้นการสร้างประวัติศาสตร์โลกของเราขึ้นมาใหม่ได้อย่างแท้จริง ขอขอบคุณ โอ้ ฉันอาจจะต้องการคุณในภายหลัง งั้นไว้เจอกันใหม่
dialogsComplete.tw: 好了，我可以拿這些東西來專心的研究了。感謝你啦~啊，我還是會請你過來一趟的，過幾天再見囉~
dialogsComplete.vi: Khỏe. Bây giờ chúng ta có thể bắt đầu tái thiết thực sự lịch sử của thế giới chúng ta. Cảm ơn bạn. Ồ, tôi có thể cần bạn sau này. Gặp bạn sau.

dialogsFail.en: You could not find Loala? It is not like he is hiding or anything. Please try again.
dialogsFail.ar: You could not find Loala? It is not like he is hiding or anything. Please try again.
dialogsFail.br: Não conseguiu encontrar Loala? Ela não está se escondendo. Tente de novo.
dialogsFail.cns: 见到拉宇了吗?哎呀~艾音娜特是满大的，但是，他应该不会躲起来啦，所以再去找一下吧!
dialogsFail.de: Hast du Laola getroffen? I weiss Ainceknight ist sehr groß, aber du solltest keine Schwierigkeiten haben sie zu finden. Bitte versuche es nochmal.
dialogsFail.fi: You could not find Loala? It is not like he is hiding or anything. Please try again.
dialogsFail.fil: You could not find Loala? It is not like he is hiding or anything. Please try again.
dialogsFail.fr: As-tu rencontré Laola ? Je sais que Aincenight est vraiment grand, mais tu devrais la trouver vers le nord est.
dialogsFail.id: Kamu tidak bisa menemukan Loala? Tidak mungkin dia bersembunyi. Coba cari lagi.
dialogsFail.it: You could not find Loala? It is not like he is hiding or anything. Please try again.
dialogsFail.jp: 大魔導師＜ラオラ＞様には会えたか？エンシェントナイトは確かに広い地域だが、ラオラ様は隠れて暮らしてるわけではないから見つけることはできるだろう。くまなく探してみてくれ。
dialogsFail.kr: 라올라를 못 찾으셨다고요? 숨어 있는 것도 아닐 텐데요. 다시 찾아보세요.
dialogsFail.nl: You could not find Loala? It is not like he is hiding or anything. Please try again.
dialogsFail.pl: You could not find Loala? It is not like he is hiding or anything. Please try again.
dialogsFail.ru: Тебе удалось разыскать Лолу? Нет? Странно. Она ни от кого не прячется.
dialogsFail.sp: ¿No has podido encontrar a Loala? No es que se esté escondiendo ni nada. Vuelve a intentarlo.
dialogsFail.sw: You could not find Loala? It is not like he is hiding or anything. Please try again.
dialogsFail.th: หา Loala ไม่เจอเหรอ? ไม่ใช่ว่าเขากำลังปิดบังหรืออะไร กรุณาลองอีกครั้ง
dialogsFail.tw: 見到拉宇了嗎？哎呀~艾音娜特是滿大的，但是，他應該不會躲起來啦，所以再去找一下吧！
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn không thể tìm thấy Loala? Nó không giống như anh ta đang trốn tránh hay gì cả. Vui lòng thử lại.

name.th: ปรับแต่ง Ribenuum

description.en: Gather 10 pieces of high quality Ribenuum
description.ar: Gather 10 pieces of high quality Ribenuum
description.br: Pegue 10 pedaços de Ribenuum de alta qualidade
description.cns: 搜集10个高纯度沛拉磷
description.de: Lass das Ribenuum veredeln und bringe es zurück
description.fi: Gather 10 pieces of high quality Ribenuum
description.fil: Kumuha ng 10 pirasong high quality Ribenuum
description.fr: Demander à Nein de purifier 10 Ribenuums, on dit qu'il habite quelque part en Désolation à Darkon 3
description.id: Kumpulkan 10 buah Ribenuum berkualitas tinggi
description.it: Gather 10 pieces of high quality Ribenuum
description.jp: ＜高純度リベニウム＞10個を持って来て！
description.nl: Gather 10 pieces of high quality Ribenuum
description.pl: Zbierz 10 sztuk wysokiej jakości Ribenuum
description.ru: Нужно принести Кайзену десять слитков качественного рибения.
description.sp: Consigue 10 Ribenuum con alto grado de pureza.
description.sw: Gather 10 pieces of high quality Ribenuum
description.th: เก็บ 10 Ribenuum คุณภาพสูง
description.tw: 蒐集 10 個高純度沛拉磷
description.vi: Tập hợp 10 miếng Ribenuum chất lượng cao

dialogsBegin.en: The Ribenuum you brought is impure. I could take it home and refine it myself but the other Dwarpets would laugh me back to Flarine.
dialogsBegin.ar: The Ribenuum you brought is impure. I could take it home and refine it myself but the other Dwarpets would laugh me back to Flarine.
dialogsBegin.br: O Ribenuum que você trouxe é impuro. Eu poderia levá-lo para casa e refiná-lo, mas os outros Dwarpets iriam rir de mim até Flarine.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你拿来的这个沛拉磷的纯度不够高啦！对我们来说精炼是很简单的事情。可是拿这种烂货去村子的话，一定会被笑死才对！
dialogsBegin.de: Dieses Ribenuum ist nicht rein. Aber ich könnte es zuhause veredeln.Allerdings würden mich die anderen Dwarpets in Flaris dafür auslachen.
dialogsBegin.fi: The Ribenuum you brought is impure. I could take it home and refine it myself but the other Dwarpets would laugh me back to Flarine.
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang Ribenuum na dinala mo ay di puro. Pwede ko ito iuwi at irefine ito ng ako lang ngunit ang ibang Dwarpets ay pagtatawanan ako pauwi ng Flarine.
dialogsBegin.fr: Hmmm... le Ribenuum que tu m'as apporté n'est pas assez pur... En fait il serait très facile pour les Dwarpets de le purifier, mais si j'en ramène d'une qualité aussi médiocre, mes compagnons vont se moquer de moi !
dialogsBegin.id: The Ribenuum yang kamu bawa itu tidak murni. Aku bisa membawanya pulang dan memperbaikinya sendiri tapi Dwarpet lain akan menertawakanku kembali ke Flarine.
dialogsBegin.it: The Ribenuum you brought is impure. I could take it home and refine it myself but the other Dwarpets would laugh me back to Flarine.
dialogsBegin.jp: オマエが採ってきた リベニウムは純度が低すぎる。この リベニウムは精錬しないと使い物にならない。これを売り物にしようなんざ、笑い者になるのがオチだよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 당신이 가져온 리베늄은 불순물이 많아요. 제가 집으로 가져가 직접 정제할 수도 있겠지만, 그러면 다른 드워펫들의 놀림거리가 되고 말 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: The Ribenuum you brought is impure. I could take it home and refine it myself but the other Dwarpets would laugh me back to Flarine.
dialogsBegin.pl: Ribenuum, które przyniosłeś, jest nieczyste. Mógłbym zabrać go do domu i sam dopracować, ale inne Krasnoludy wyśmiałyby mnie w Flarine.
dialogsBegin.ru: Да уж, видал я рибений и почище. Я бы, конечно, и сам переплавил его в домашней кузнице, да только карлики-соседи засмеют меня, вернись я в деревню с этаким богатством!
dialogsBegin.sp: El Ribenuum que trajiste es impuro. Podría llevarlo a casa y refinarlo yo mismo, pero los otros Enanos se reirían de mí en Flarine.
dialogsBegin.sw: The Ribenuum you brought is impure. I could take it home and refine it myself but the other Dwarpets would laugh me back to Flarine.
dialogsBegin.th: Ribenuum ที่คุณนำมานั้นไม่บริสุทธิ์ ฉันสามารถเอากลับบ้านและไปแก้ไขเพิ่มได้ แต่ Dwarpets จะหัวเราะฉันเมื่อกลับไป Flarine
dialogsBegin.tw: 你拿來的這個沛拉磷的純度不夠高啦！對我們來說精煉是很簡單的事情。可是拿這種爛貨去村子的話，一定會被笑死才對！
dialogsBegin.vi: Ribenuum bạn mang theo là không tinh khiết. Tôi có thể mang nó về nhà và tự tinh chế nhưng những Người lùn khác sẽ chê cười tôi khi quay lại Flarine.

dialogsBegin.en: It will have to be refined in a human village then. There is only one human I trust to do it it right. There is man named Nein, he was one of the last humans to work in these mines. Maybe the very last human.
dialogsBegin.ar: It will have to be refined in a human village then. There is only one human I trust to do it it right. There is man named Nein, he was one of the last humans to work in these mines. Maybe the very last human.
dialogsBegin.br: Então, ele terá que ser refinado em um povoado humano. Existe apenas um humano em que confio para fazer isso direito. Existe um homem chamado Nein. Ele foi um dos últimos seres humanos a trabalhar nessas minas. Talvez o último.
dialogsBegin.cns: 不管怎样你还是要去村子精炼啦！在人类里可以精炼这个东西的人只有一个，他叫做“罗殷”。
dialogsBegin.de: Es muss dann wohl in einem Menschendorf veredelt werden. Es gibt nur einen Menschen, dessen Fähigkeiten ich vertraue. Sein Name ist Shin. Er ist einer der letzten Menschen, der in dieser Mine arbeitet. Vielleicht der allerletzte.
dialogsBegin.fi: It will have to be refined in a human village then. There is only one human I trust to do it it right. There is man named Nein, he was one of the last humans to work in these mines. Maybe the very last human.
dialogsBegin.fil: Kailangan ito mairefine sa isang bayan ng mga tao. Mayroon lamang isang tao Nagtitiwala ako sayo na gagawin mo ito ng tama. Mayroong tao na nagngangalang Nein, siya ang isa sa huling tao na nagtrabaho sa minahan na ito. Baka pinakahuling tao.
dialogsBegin.fr: Au final, je dois purifier ce Ribenuum au village des humains. D'après ce que je sais, il n'y a qu'une personne capable d'une telle prouesse. Son nom est Nein et il a travaillé dans cette mine auparavant.
dialogsBegin.id: Itu harus disempurnakan di desa manusia kalau begitu. Hanya ada satu manusia yang aku percaya untuk melakukannya dengan benar. Ada seorang pria bernama Nein, dia adalah salah satu manusia terakhir yang bekerja di tambang ini. Mungkin manusia terakhir.
dialogsBegin.it: It will have to be refined in a human village then. There is only one human I trust to do it it right. There is man named Nein, he was one of the last humans to work in these mines. Maybe the very last human.
dialogsBegin.jp: 街へ出て精錬するしかないな。人間の中でもこの ＜リベニウム＞ の精錬が出来る奴は、俺が知っている限り一人しかいない。昔この鉱山で働いた ＜ナイン＞ という者だ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 인간 마을에 가서 정제해야 해요. 믿고 정제를 맡길 수 있는 사람은 딱 한 명뿐이죠. 과거 이 광산에서 끝까지 일했던 나인이라는 사람이죠. 심지어 제일 끝까지 있었어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: It will have to be refined in a human village then. There is only one human I trust to do it it right. There is man named Nein, he was one of the last humans to work in these mines. Maybe the very last human.
dialogsBegin.pl: Będzie musiał być wtedy oczyszczony w ludzkiej wiosce. Jest tylko jeden człowiek, któremu ufam, że zrobi to dobrze. Jest człowiek imieniem Nein, był jednym z ostatnich ludzi, którzy pracowali w tych kopalniach. Może ostatni człowiek.
dialogsBegin.ru: Придется просить о помощи людей. Есть среди вашего народа кузнец, которому я могу доверить самую тонкую работу. Зовут его Нейн. Когда-то он работал в Шахтах и ушел отсюда одним из последних, а может, и последним.
dialogsBegin.sp: Tendrá que ser refinado en una aldea humana entonces. Solo hay un ser humano en quien confío para hacerlo bien. Hay un hombre llamado Nein, fue uno de los últimos humanos en trabajar en estas minas. Tal vez el último humano.
dialogsBegin.sw: It will have to be refined in a human village then. There is only one human I trust to do it it right. There is man named Nein, he was one of the last humans to work in these mines. Maybe the very last human.
dialogsBegin.th: มันจะต้องได้รับการขัดเกลาในหมู่บ้านมนุษย์แล้ว มีมนุษย์เพียงคนเดียวที่ฉันไว้วางใจให้ทำถูกต้อง มีชายคนหนึ่งชื่อ Nein เขาเป็นคนสุดท้ายที่ทำงานในเหมืองเหล่านี้ อาจเป็นมนุษย์คนสุดท้าย
dialogsBegin.tw: 不管怎樣你還是要去村子精煉啦！在人類裡可以精煉這個東西的人只有一個，他叫做『羅殷』。
dialogsBegin.vi: Sau đó nó sẽ phải được tinh chế trong một ngôi làng của con người. Chỉ có một người mà tôi tin tưởng để làm điều đó 1 cách đúng đắn. Có một người đàn ông tên là Nein, anh ta là một trong những người cuối cùng làm việc trong những khu mỏ này. Có thể là con người cuối cùng

dialogsBegin.en: Bring these Ribenuum to Nein and have him refine them. Then bring them back to me, would you?
dialogsBegin.ar: Bring these Ribenuum to Nein and have him refine them. Then bring them back to me, would you?
dialogsBegin.br: Leve esse Ribenuum para o Nein e peça para que ele o refine. Em seguida, traga-me de volta. Tudo bem?
dialogsBegin.cns: 把沛拉磷拿去给“罗殷”精炼之后，在拿来给我，你做得到吧？
dialogsBegin.de: Würdest du dieses Ribuum zu ihm bringen und es veredeln lassen?Bring es danach zu mir zurück, okay?
dialogsBegin.fi: Bring these Ribenuum to Nein and have him refine them. Then bring them back to me, would you?
dialogsBegin.fil: Dalihin mo itong Ribenuum kay Nein at siya ang magrerefine nito. Tapos dalihin mo ito pabalik sakin , pakiusap?
dialogsBegin.fr: Voudrais-tu lui apporter ce Ribenuum s'il te plaît et lui demander de le purifier ? Et ensuite me le rapporter bien sûr.
dialogsBegin.id: Bawakan Ribenuum ini ke Nein dan minta dia memperbaikinya. Kemudian bawa mereka kembali kepadaku, ya?
dialogsBegin.it: Bring these Ribenuum to Nein and have him refine them. Then bring them back to me, would you?
dialogsBegin.jp: その ＜ナイン＞ に会って、この ＜リベニウム＞ を精錬して来てくれ。俺との取引はそれからだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그 리베늄을 나인에게 가져가서 정제를 부탁하세요. 그런 다음 제게 다시 가져오세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Bring these Ribenuum to Nein and have him refine them. Then bring them back to me, would you?
dialogsBegin.pl: Zanieś to Ribenuum Neinowi i każ mu je oczyścić. Następnie przynieś mi je z powrotem, dobrze?
dialogsBegin.ru: Отнеси эти самородки Нейну - пусть переплавит и очистит от примесей. Договорились?
dialogsBegin.sp: Lleva estos Ribenuum a Nein y haz que los refine. Después tráemelos de vuelta, ¿vale?
dialogsBegin.sw: Bring these Ribenuum to Nein and have him refine them. Then bring them back to me, would you?
dialogsBegin.th: นำ Ribenuum นี้ไปให้ Nein และให้เขาปรับแต่งมัน แล้วนำกลับมาให้ฉัน
dialogsBegin.tw: 把沛拉磷拿去給『羅殷』精煉之後，在拿來給我，你做得到吧？
dialogsBegin.vi: Mang những Ribenuum này cho Nein và nhờ anh ta tinh chế chúng. Sau đó mang chúng trở lại cho tôi, bạn có được không?

dialogsAccept.en: I heard that Nein lives somewhere in the Dead Walderness. He will refine the 30 pieces of impure Ribenuum into 10 pieces of high quality Ribenuum.
dialogsAccept.ar: I heard that Nein lives somewhere in the Dead Walderness. He will refine the 30 pieces of impure Ribenuum into 10 pieces of high quality Ribenuum.
dialogsAccept.br: Eu soube que Nein vive em algum lugar em Dead Walderness. Ele refinará os 30 pedaços de Ribenuum impuro em 10 pedaços de Ribenuum de alta qualidade.
dialogsAccept.cns: 听说罗殷他住在龙息荒野附近，把高纯度沛拉磷拿给他吧！精炼完之后该会减少10个啦。
dialogsAccept.de: Ich habe gehört, dass Shin irgendwo in der toten Wüste lebt. Er wird die 30 unreinen Ribenuum in 10 qualitative Ribenuum veredeln.
dialogsAccept.fi: I heard that Nein lives somewhere in the Dead Walderness. He will refine the 30 pieces of impure Ribenuum into 10 pieces of high quality Ribenuum.
dialogsAccept.fil: Nadinig ko nakatira si Nein sa Dead Walderness. Irerefine niya ang 30 pirasong impure Ribenuum at gagawin itong 10 piraso ng high quality Ribenuum.
dialogsAccept.fr: J'ai entendu dire que Nein vit dans le lieu appelé Désolation. Vas-y et rapporte-moi le métal, une fois purifié. Peut-être que Nein réussira à atteindre un degré de pureté de 10…
dialogsAccept.id: Aku mendengar bahwa Nein tinggal di suatu tempat di Dead Walderness. Dia akan memurnikan 30 buah Ribenuum yang tidak murni menjadi 10 buah Ribenuum berkualitas tinggi.
dialogsAccept.it: I heard that Nein lives somewhere in the Dead Walderness. He will refine the 30 pieces of impure Ribenuum into 10 pieces of high quality Ribenuum.
dialogsAccept.jp: ＜ナイン＞ は＜デットワルドネス砂漠＞のどこかにいると聞いたことがある。奴に会って純度の高い ＜高純度リベニウム＞ を持って来てくれ。多分精錬したら数は10個に減るだろうけど、まあ仕方ない。
dialogsAccept.kr: 나인은 데드월드니스 사막 어딘가에 있다는 얘기를 들었어. 가서 순도 높은 리베늄을 가져다 줘. 아마 정련하고 나면 숫자가 한 10개 정도로 줄겠군.
dialogsAccept.nl: I heard that Nein lives somewhere in the Dead Walderness. He will refine the 30 pieces of impure Ribenuum into 10 pieces of high quality Ribenuum.
dialogsAccept.pl: Słyszałem, że Nein mieszka gdzieś w Dead Walderness. On przerobi 30 kawałków nieczystego Ribenuum na 10 kawałków wysokiej jakości Ribenuum.
dialogsAccept.ru: Как Шахты закрылись, Нейн перебрался куда-то в Мертвую Пустошь. Попроси его переплавить рибений. По моим подсчетам, выйдет десять слитков.
dialogsAccept.sp: Escuché que Nein vive en algún lugar del Desierto Muerto. Refinará las 30 piezas de Ribenuum impuro en 10 piezas de Ribenuum de alta calidad.
dialogsAccept.sw: I heard that Nein lives somewhere in the Dead Walderness. He will refine the 30 pieces of impure Ribenuum into 10 pieces of high quality Ribenuum.
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันได้ยินมาว่า Nein อาศัยอยู่ที่ไหนสักแห่งใน Dead Walderness เขาจะปรับแต่ง Ribenuum 30 ชิ้นลงใน Ribenuum 10 ชิ้น
dialogsAccept.tw: 聽說羅殷住在死亡荒野的某處。他會將 30 塊不純的沛拉磷精煉成 10 塊高品質沛拉磷。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi nghe nói rằng Nein sống ở đâu đó trong Dead Walderness. Anh ta sẽ tinh chế 30 mảnh Ribenuum không tinh khiết thành 10 mảnh Ribenuum chất lượng cao.

dialogsDecline.en: Are you kidding me? Get lost! I do not have patience for games!
dialogsDecline.ar: Are you kidding me? Get lost! I do not have patience for games!
dialogsDecline.br: Você está brincando comigo? Suma daqui! Não tenho paciência para jogos!
dialogsDecline.cns: 你现在跟我开玩笑吗？如果你是想耍我的话，你就给我滚回家啦！
dialogsDecline.de: Ernsthaft?! Verschwinde! Ich habe keine Geduld für solche Spielchen!
dialogsDecline.fi: Are you kidding me? Get lost! I do not have patience for games!
dialogsDecline.fil: Niloloko mo ba ako? Lumayas ka! Wala akong pasensya para makipaglaro!
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu te moques de moi ? Bon rentre chez toi ! Et ne te moque plus jamais d'un Dwarpet de mon genre !
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu bercanda? Enyah! Aku tidak memiliki kesabaran untuk permainan!
dialogsDecline.it: Are you kidding me? Get lost! I do not have patience for games!
dialogsDecline.jp: ああ、そうかい？　なら取引は中止だな。
dialogsDecline.kr: 장난하시는 건가요? 꺼져요! 장난칠 기분 아니니까.
dialogsDecline.nl: Are you kidding me? Get lost! I do not have patience for games!
dialogsDecline.pl: Czy ty żartujesz? Wynoś się! Nie mam czasu na gierki!
dialogsDecline.ru: Ты что, шутишь? Ну и проваливай отсюда! Я твои игры терпеть не намерен!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Me estás tomando el pelo? ¡Piérdete! No tengo paciencia para los juegecitos!
dialogsDecline.sw: Are you kidding me? Get lost! I do not have patience for games!
dialogsDecline.th: คุณกำลังล้อเล่นใช่ไหม ออกไป ฉันเริ่มจะหมดความอดทนแล้ว!
dialogsDecline.tw: 你現在跟我開玩笑嗎？如果你是想耍我的話，你就給我滾回家啦！
dialogsDecline.vi: Đùa tôi à? Bị lạc! Tôi không có kiên nhẫn cho các trò chơi!

dialogsComplete.en: Oh… Thank you, thank you, thank you! Take this necklace and some money with you.
dialogsComplete.ar: Oh… Thank you, thank you, thank you! Take this necklace and some money with you.
dialogsComplete.br: Oh… Obrigado, obrigado, obrigado! Leve este colar e um pouco de dinheiro com você.
dialogsComplete.cns: 喔～搜集到这么高纯度沛拉磷来了啊！不错喔～拿这个给人类的话，他们应该也不会说什么了！这个项链跟钱是我给你的，你就收下吧！
dialogsComplete.de: Das ist großartig! Vielen Dank! Bitte nimm diese Halskette und etwas Geld als Belohnung.
dialogsComplete.fi: Oh… Thank you, thank you, thank you! Take this necklace and some money with you.
dialogsComplete.fil: Oh… Thank you, thank you, thank you! Take this necklace and some money with you.
dialogsComplete.fr: Génial ! Merci de me ramener du Ribenuum d'une telle pureté. Prends ce pendentif et cet argent comme récompense.
dialogsComplete.id: Oh…Terima kasih, terima kasih, terima kasih! Ambil kalung ini dan sejumlah uang bersamamu.
dialogsComplete.it: Oh… Thank you, thank you, thank you! Take this necklace and some money with you.
dialogsComplete.jp: あぁ...ありがとう、ありがとう、ありがとう!このネックレスといくらかのお金を送ろう
dialogsComplete.kr: 오... 고마워요, 정말 고마워요! 이 목걸이와 약간의 돈을 받아주세요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Oh… Thank you, thank you, thank you! Take this necklace and some money with you.
dialogsComplete.pl: Och…Dziękuję, dziękuję, dziękuję! Weź ze sobą ten naszyjnik i trochę pieniędzy.
dialogsComplete.ru: Ох… Спасибо, спасибо, спасибо! Возьми это ожерелье и немного денег.
dialogsComplete.sp: Oh... ¡Gracias, gracias, gracias! Toma este collar y algo de dinero para ti.
dialogsComplete.sw: Oh… Thank you, thank you, thank you! Take this necklace and some money with you.
dialogsComplete.th: โอ้... ขอบคุณ ขอบคุณ ขอบคุณ! รับสิ่งนี้ไว้ มันคือสร้อยคอและเงินของคุณ
dialogsComplete.tw: 喔……謝謝你、謝謝你、謝謝你！把這條項鍊和一些錢帶上吧。
dialogsComplete.vi: Oh…Cảm ơn bạn, cảm ơn bạn, cảm ơn bạn! Hãy mang theo chiếc vòng cổ này và một ít tiền.

dialogsFail.en: Hmmm... maybe I was asking too much of you. You can just go home.
dialogsFail.ar: Hmmm... maybe I was asking too much of you. You can just go home.
dialogsFail.br: Hmmm… talvez eu esteja exigindo muito de você. Você pode simplesmente ir para casa.
dialogsFail.cns: 好吧！对你来说可能是一件很困难的事情啦...你就回家睡觉吧！
dialogsFail.de: Hmmm... vielleicht habe ich zu viel von dir verlangt. Du kannst einfach nach Hause gehen.
dialogsFail.fi: Hmmm... maybe I was asking too much of you. You can just go home.
dialogsFail.fil: Hmmm... maybe I was asking too much of you. You can just go home.
dialogsFail.fr: Ouaaaaiiiis… Peut-être que c'est simplement trop difficile pour toi et que tu ferais mieux de rentrer chez ta 'ptite maman pour qu'elle te prépare un bon chocolat chaud ?!
dialogsFail.id: Hmmm…mungkin aku bertanya terlalu banyak padamu. Kamu bisa pulang.
dialogsFail.it: Hmmm... maybe I was asking too much of you. You can just go home.
dialogsFail.jp: うーん...もしかしたら、私はあなたに多くを求めすぎていたのかもしれません。家に帰ればいいのです。
dialogsFail.kr: 흠... 제가 너무 많은 걸 바란 모양이군요. 그냥 집에 가도 돼요.
dialogsFail.nl: Hmmm... maybe I was asking too much of you. You can just go home.
dialogsFail.pl: Hmmm… może prosiłem cię o zbyt wiele. Możesz po prostu iść do domu.
dialogsFail.ru: Хммм… Может, я прошу от тебя слишком многого. Можешь просто возвращаться домой.
dialogsFail.sp: Hmmm... tal vez te estaba pidiendo demasiado. Puedes irte a casa.
dialogsFail.sw: Hmmm... maybe I was asking too much of you. You can just go home.
dialogsFail.th: อืม... บางทีฉันอาจจะถามคุณมากเกินไป คุณกลับไปได้แล้ว
dialogsFail.tw: 嗯……也許是我要求你太多了。你就直接回家吧。
dialogsFail.vi: Hmmm…có lẽ tôi đã yêu cầu quá sức của bạn. Bạn có thể về nhà luôn cũng được.

description.en: Kill 15 Small Mage Pranksters & 7 Pranksters, acquire the Shade Trace and bring it to Handel.
description.ar: Kill 15 Small Mage Pranksters & 7 Pranksters, acquire the Shade Trace and bring it to Handel.
description.br: Mate 15 Magos Pranksters Pequenos e 7 Pranksters, encontre a Essência de Shade e entregue para Handel.
description.cns: 杀死15个见习小丑术士和7个小丑术士，获取谢莉德的踪迹并将其带给汉德尔。
description.de: Töte 15 Small Mage Pranksters & 7 Pranksters, nimm Shade Trace und bringe sie zu Handel.
description.fi: Kill 15 Small Mage Pranksters & 7 Pranksters, acquire the Shade Trace and bring it to Handel.
description.fil: Kill 15 Small Mage Pranksters & 7 Pranksters, acquire the Shade Trace and bring it to Handel.
description.fr: Tuez 15 Jeunes Prankster et 7 Pranksters et trouvez le sceau d'Ivillis.
description.id: Bunuh 15 Small Mage Pranksters & 7 Pranksters, dapatkan Shade Trace dan bawa ke Handel.
description.it: Kill 15 Small Mage Pranksters & 7 Pranksters, acquire the Shade Trace and bring it to Handel.
description.jp: スモールメイジいたずら者といたずら者を倒してイブリスの痕跡を入手した後、ヘンデルに報告せよ。
description.kr: 견습 프랭스터 15마리와 7마리의 프랭스터를 처치하고 쉐이드의 흔적을 찾아 헨델에게 돌아가세요.
description.nl: Kill 15 Small Mage Pranksters & 7 Pranksters, acquire the Shade Trace and bring it to Handel.
description.pl: Zabij 15 Mały Magiczny Błazen i 7 Magiczny Błazen, zdobądź Ślad Cienia i zanieś go Haendl-owi.
description.ru: Убей 15 слабых паяцев и 7 обычных, раздобудь свидетельства существования Тени и принеси их Гандель.
description.sp: Derrota a 15 Pranksters Magos Pequeños y a 7 Pranksters, consigue el Símbolo de Shade y llévaselo a Handel.
description.sw: Kill 15 Small Mage Pranksters & 7 Pranksters, acquire the Shade Trace and bring it to Handel.
description.th: ฆ่า 15 Small Mage Pranksters & 7 Pranksters เก็บ Shade Trace และนำไปให้ Handel
description.tw: 殺死 15 個小丑見習生和 7 個小丑實習生，獲得闇影線索並將其帶給賀丹爾。
description.vi: Giết 15 Small Mage Pranksters & 7 Pranksters, lấy Shade Trace và mang nó cho Handel.

dialogsBegin.en: According to my ancestors, this region was once a primary location for a massive conflict between Bubble and Shade. Lets put it this way, Madrigal was once all one continent before this war…
dialogsBegin.ar: According to my ancestors, this region was once a primary location for a massive conflict between Bubble and Shade. Lets put it this way, Madrigal was once all one continent before this war…
dialogsBegin.br: De acordo com meus ancestrais, essa região já foi um local primário para um grande conflito entre Bubble e Shade. Vamos colocar desta forma, Madrigal já foi um continente só antes desta guerra…
dialogsBegin.cns: 据我的先祖们说，这个区域曾是波布尔和谢莉德之间的巨大冲突的主要发生地。这么说吧，瑞加大陆是在这场战争之前还是完整的一块大陆...
dialogsBegin.de: Meinen Vorfahren zufolge war diese Region einst der Hauptschauplatz eines gewaltigen Konflikts zwischen Bubble und Shade. Sagen wir es mal so: Vor diesem Krieg war Madrigal ein einziger Kontinent...
dialogsBegin.fi: According to my ancestors, this region was once a primary location for a massive conflict between Bubble and Shade. Lets put it this way, Madrigal was once all one continent before this war…
dialogsBegin.fil: According to my ancestors, this region was once a primary location for a massive conflict between Bubble and Shade. Lets put it this way, Madrigal was once all one continent before this war…
dialogsBegin.fr: Tant que nous en sommes à rassembler des artefacts, autant y aller franchement.
dialogsBegin.id: Menurut nenek moyang saya, wilayah ini pernah menjadi lokasi utama konflik besar antara Bubble dan Shade. Bisa dibilang begini, Madrigal pernah menjadi satu benua sebelum perang ini terjadi...
dialogsBegin.it: According to my ancestors, this region was once a primary location for a massive conflict between Bubble and Shade. Lets put it this way, Madrigal was once all one continent before this war…
dialogsBegin.jp: ふむ……。そういえばこんな話があるよ。創世戦争、神々の闘いの発端となったのはこのリシスの庭だそうだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그래, 이것을 보니 생각나는군. 오래 전부터 이 정원을 가꿔오던 선조들로부터 전해들은 말이 있어. 버블과 쉐이드의 전쟁, 그 전에 마드리갈은 원래 하나의 대륙이었다지...
dialogsBegin.nl: According to my ancestors, this region was once a primary location for a massive conflict between Bubble and Shade. Lets put it this way, Madrigal was once all one continent before this war…
dialogsBegin.pl: According to my ancestors, this region was once a primary location for a massive conflict between Bubble and Shade. Lets put it this way, Madrigal was once all one continent before this war…
dialogsBegin.ru: According to my ancestors, this region was once a primary location for a massive conflict between Bubble and Shade. Lets put it this way, Madrigal was once all one continent before this war…
dialogsBegin.sp: Según mis antepasados, hace un tiempo esta región fue el lugar principal de un conflicto masivo entre Bubble y Shade. Digamos que, Madrigal era todo un continente antes de esta guerra...
dialogsBegin.sw: According to my ancestors, this region was once a primary location for a massive conflict between Bubble and Shade. Lets put it this way, Madrigal was once all one continent before this war…
dialogsBegin.th: ตามบรรพบุรุษของฉันภูมิภาคนี้เคยเป็นที่ตั้งหลักสำหรับความขัดแย้งระหว่าง Bubble และ Shade ให้วางไว้แบบนี้ Madrigal เคยเป็นหนึ่งทวีปก่อนสงครามครั้งนี้ ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 根據我的祖先的說法，這個地區曾經是巴布樂和闇影之間大規模衝突的主要地點。這麼說吧，在這場戰爭之前，瑪德利賈曾經是一個大陸……
dialogsBegin.vi: Theo tổ tiên của tôi, khu vực này đã từng là địa điểm chính cho một cuộc xung đột lớn giữa Bubble và Shade. Hãy nói theo cách này, Madrigal đã từng là một lục địa trước cuộc chiến này…

dialogsBegin.en: We must also acquire the Shade trace. It's rumored to be held by the Pranksters, the last remnants of the followers of Shade. As you can see, I'm a tad too short to confront them. Could you get it for me?
dialogsBegin.ar: We must also acquire the Shade trace. It's rumored to be held by the Pranksters, the last remnants of the followers of Shade. As you can see, I'm a tad too short to confront them. Could you get it for me?
dialogsBegin.br: Também devemos adquirir a Essência de Shade. Há rumores de que está nas mãos dos Pranksters, os últimos remanescentes dos seguidores de Shade. Como você pode ver, sou um pouco baixo demais para enfrentá-los. Você faria isso por mim??
dialogsBegin.cns: We must also acquire the Shade trace. It's rumored to be held by the Pranksters, the last remnants of the followers of Shade. As you can see, I'm a tad too short to confront them. Could you get it for me?
dialogsBegin.de: Wir müssen auch die Spur von Shade finden. Es wird gemunkelt, dass sie von den Prankster, den letzten Überbleibseln der Anhänger des Shade, gehalten wird. Wie du siehst, bin ich ein bisschen zu klein, um ihnen gegenüberzutreten. Könntest du sie für mich besorgen?
dialogsBegin.fi: We must also acquire the Shade trace. It's rumored to be held by the Pranksters, the last remnants of the followers of Shade. As you can see, I'm a tad too short to confront them. Could you get it for me?
dialogsBegin.fil: We must also acquire the Shade trace. It's rumored to be held by the Pranksters, the last remnants of the followers of Shade. As you can see, I'm a tad too short to confront them. Could you get it for me?
dialogsBegin.fr: Les Prankster sont des anciens adeptes du culte d'Ivillis qui ont été transformés. Ils gardent le sceau d'Ivillis.
dialogsBegin.id: Kita juga harus mendapatkan jejak Shade. Kabarnya akan dihelat oleh para Pranksters, sisa-sisa terakhir dari para pengikut Shade. Seperti yang kau lihat, saya agak terlalu pendek untuk menghadapi mereka. Bisakah kau mendapatkannya untukku??
dialogsBegin.it: We must also acquire the Shade trace. It's rumored to be held by the Pranksters, the last remnants of the followers of Shade. As you can see, I'm a tad too short to confront them. Could you get it for me?
dialogsBegin.jp: そうか、リシスの痕跡があるということはイブリスの何かも見つかるかもしれないね。イブリス信者を調査すれば何かわかるかもしれない。
dialogsBegin.kr: 쉐이드의 흔적도 얻어야 해요. 쉐이드의 마지막 추종 세력인 프랭스터들이 가지고 있다는 소문을 들었어요. 보시다시피 저는 너무 작아서 혼자 맞서 싸우긴 힘들어요. 대신 가져다주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: We must also acquire the Shade trace. It's rumored to be held by the Pranksters, the last remnants of the followers of Shade. As you can see, I'm a tad too short to confront them. Could you get it for me?
dialogsBegin.pl: Musimy zdobyć ślad Cienia. Krążą pogłoski, że mają go przetrzymywać Magiczni Błaznowie, ostatnie niedobitki wyznawców Shade. Jak widzisz, jestem ciut za niski, żeby się z nimi skonfrontować. Czy możesz to dla mnie zdobyć??
dialogsBegin.ru: We must also acquire the Shade trace. It's rumored to be held by the Pranksters, the last remnants of the followers of Shade. As you can see, I'm a tad too short to confront them. Could you get it for me?
dialogsBegin.sp: También debemos conseguir el Símbolo de Shade. Se rumorea que está en manos de los Pranksters, los últimos restos de los seguidores de Shade. Como puedes ver, soy demasiado pequeño para enfrentarlos ¿¿Me lo podrías conseguir??
dialogsBegin.sw: We must also acquire the Shade trace. It's rumored to be held by the Pranksters, the last remnants of the followers of Shade. As you can see, I'm a tad too short to confront them. Could you get it for me?
dialogsBegin.th: นอกจากนี้เรายังต้องแกะรอย Shade มีข่าวลือว่าโดยพวก Pranksters ซึ่งเป็นกลุ่มสุดท้ายที่พักดีต่อ Shade อย่างที่คุณเห็น ข้อมูลมันน้อยนิดมาก คุณจะยังช่วยฉันอยู่มั้ย?
dialogsBegin.tw: 我們還得取得闇影的痕跡。聽說那東西在惡作劇者手上，他們是闇影追隨者最後的殘黨。如你所見，我個子有點太矮，沒辦法跟他們正面衝突。你能幫我拿回來嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Chúng ta cũng phải thu thập được dấu vết của Shade. Tương truyền rằng nó được Pranksters, những tàn dư cuối cùng từ đám tín đồ của Shade canh giữ. Bạn thấy đó, tôi còn quá yếu để đối đầu với chúng. Bạn có thể giúp tôi đem nó về được không?

dialogsAccept.en: I appreciate the assistance. Please go Kill 15 Small Mage Pranksters & 7 Pranksters and acquire the Shade trace.
dialogsAccept.ar: I appreciate the assistance. Please go Kill 15 Small Mage Pranksters & 7 Pranksters and acquire the Shade trace.
dialogsAccept.br: Agradeço a ajuda. Por favor, vá matar 15 Magos Pranksters Pequenos e 7 Pranksters e adquira a Essência de Shade.
dialogsAccept.cns: 感谢你的协助。请去击杀15个见习小丑术士和7个小丑术士，并获得谢莉德的踪迹。
dialogsAccept.de: Ich weiß die Hilfe zu schätzen. Bitte töte 15 Small Mage Pranksters & 7 Pranksters und erhalte Shade trace.
dialogsAccept.fi: I appreciate the assistance. Please go Kill 15 Small Mage Pranksters & 7 Pranksters and acquire the Shade trace.
dialogsAccept.fil: I appreciate the assistance. Please go Kill 15 Small Mage Pranksters & 7 Pranksters and acquire the Shade trace.
dialogsAccept.fr: J'espère que vous ne vous ferez pas tuer avant de m'avoir apporté le sceau.
dialogsAccept.id: Saya mengapresiasi bantuanmu. Silakan bunuh 15 Small Mage Pranksters & 7 Pranksters dan dapatkan jejak Shade.
dialogsAccept.it: I appreciate the assistance. Please go Kill 15 Small Mage Pranksters & 7 Pranksters and acquire the Shade trace.
dialogsAccept.jp: スモールメイジのいたずら者といたずら者は狂信的なイブリスの崇拝者だ。彼らを倒せば何かわかるかもしれないよ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 도움이 되었다니 다행이야. 그럼 무사히 그곳에 있는 견습 프랭스터 15마리와 프랭스터 7마리를 처치하고 쉐이드의 흔적을 얻어.
dialogsAccept.nl: I appreciate the assistance. Please go Kill 15 Small Mage Pranksters & 7 Pranksters and acquire the Shade trace.
dialogsAccept.pl: Doceniam pomoc. Proszę idź Zabij 15 Mały Magiczny Błazen i 7 Magiczny Błazen i zdobądź ślad Cienia.
dialogsAccept.ru: I appreciate the assistance. Please go Kill 15 Small Mage Pranksters & 7 Pranksters and acquire the Shade trace.
dialogsAccept.sp: Agradezco tu ayuda. Derrota a 15 Pranksters Magos Pequeños y a 7 Pranksters y consigue el Símbolo de Shade.
dialogsAccept.sw: I appreciate the assistance. Please go Kill 15 Small Mage Pranksters & 7 Pranksters and acquire the Shade trace.
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันขอขอบคุณที่ให้ความช่วยเหลือ โปรดไปฆ่า 15 Small Mage Pranksters & 7 Pranksters และรับ Shade trace
dialogsAccept.tw: 我感謝你的幫助。請去殺死 15 個小丑見習生和 7 個小丑實習生並獲使得瑞線索。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi đánh giá cao sự hỗ trợ. Hãy giết 15 trò đùa của pháp sư nhỏ & 7 trò đùa và thu dấu vết của Shade.

dialogsDecline.en: What? Expect a poor little Dwarpet such as myself to take on an army of Pranksters?
dialogsDecline.ar: What? Expect a poor little Dwarpet such as myself to take on an army of Pranksters?
dialogsDecline.br: Que? Você espera que um pobre pequenino Dwarpet como eu enfrente um exército de Pranksters??
dialogsDecline.cns: What? Expect a poor little Dwarpet such as myself to take on an army of Pranksters?
dialogsDecline.de: Was? Erwartest du, dass ein armer kleiner Dwarpet wie ich es mit einer Armee von Pranksters aufnehmen kann?
dialogsDecline.fi: What? Expect a poor little Dwarpet such as myself to take on an army of Pranksters?
dialogsDecline.fil: What? Expect a poor little Dwarpet such as myself to take on an army of Pranksters?
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous ne penez pas que ça soit utile ? Mais c'est indispensable !!!
dialogsDecline.id: Apa? Kau berharap Dwarpet kecil yang malang seperti saya ikut menghadapi pasukan Pranksters??
dialogsDecline.it: What? Expect a poor little Dwarpet such as myself to take on an army of Pranksters?
dialogsDecline.jp: 君はあまりこういう話には興味がないのかな。残念だよ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 왜요? 저처럼 불쌍한 드워펫이 혼자 프랭스터 군대를 상대할 수 있으리라 생각하세요?
dialogsDecline.nl: What? Expect a poor little Dwarpet such as myself to take on an army of Pranksters?
dialogsDecline.pl: Co? Spodziewasz się, że biedny mały Krasnolud, taki jak ja, zmierzy się z armią Magicznych Błaznów??
dialogsDecline.ru: What? Expect a poor little Dwarpet such as myself to take on an army of Pranksters?
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Qué? ¿¿Esperas que un pobre y pequeño Dwarpet como yo se enfrente a un ejército de Pranksters??
dialogsDecline.sw: What? Expect a poor little Dwarpet such as myself to take on an army of Pranksters?
dialogsDecline.th: อะไรนะ? ต้องการ Dwarpet ตัวน้อยน่าสงสารอย่างข้า ไปรับมือกับกองทัพ Pranksters?
dialogsDecline.tw: 什麼？要像我這種可憐的小矮寵，去對付一整群惡作劇者軍團嗎？
dialogsDecline.vi: Cái gì? Bạn mong đợi một Dwarpet nhỏ bé tội nghiệp như tôi sẽ tham gia vào một đội quân Prankster à?

dialogsComplete.en: So according to Bowler, this was the site of the battle between Bubble and Shade? The essence of each that you contain is definitive proof of this.
dialogsComplete.ar: So according to Bowler, this was the site of the battle between Bubble and Shade? The essence of each that you contain is definitive proof of this.
dialogsComplete.br: Então, de acordo com Bowler, este foi o local da batalha entre Bubble e Shade? A essência de cada um que você contém é a prova definitiva disso.
dialogsComplete.cns: 按照保罗克所说的，这个地方就是波布尔和谢莉德发生战争的地方？你所拥有的每一份意识就是这一点的确凿证据。
dialogsComplete.de: Laut Bowler war dies also der Ort des Kampfes zwischen Bubble und Shade? Die Essenz der beiden, die Sie enthalten, ist der endgültige Beweis dafür.
dialogsComplete.fi: So according to Bowler, this was the site of the battle between Bubble and Shade? The essence of each that you contain is definitive proof of this.
dialogsComplete.fil: So according to Bowler, this was the site of the battle between Bubble and Shade? The essence of each that you contain is definitive proof of this.
dialogsComplete.fr: Vous avez le sceau ? Magnifique !
dialogsComplete.id: Jadi menurut Bowler, ini adalah tempat pertempuran antara Bubble dan Shade? Inti dari masing - masing kandungan adalah bukti definitif dari hal ini.
dialogsComplete.it: So according to Bowler, this was the site of the battle between Bubble and Shade? The essence of each that you contain is definitive proof of this.
dialogsComplete.jp: なるほど……やはりこの地は創世戦争の発端となった場所だったのですね。
dialogsComplete.kr: 역시, 이곳에서 버블과 쉐이드의 전쟁이 벌여졌던 거로군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: So according to Bowler, this was the site of the battle between Bubble and Shade? The essence of each that you contain is definitive proof of this.
dialogsComplete.pl: So according to Bowler, this was the site of the battle between Bubble and Shade? The essence of each that you contain is definitive proof of this.
dialogsComplete.ru: So according to Bowler, this was the site of the battle between Bubble and Shade? The essence of each that you contain is definitive proof of this.
dialogsComplete.sp: Entonces, según Bowler, ¿este fue el lugar de la batalla entre Bubble y Shade? Las esencias que tienes de ellos es prueba definitiva de ello.
dialogsComplete.sw: So according to Bowler, this was the site of the battle between Bubble and Shade? The essence of each that you contain is definitive proof of this.
dialogsComplete.th: ดังนั้นตาม Bowler บอก นี่เป็นที่ตั้งของการต่อสู้ระหว่าง Bubble และ Shade? ที่สำคัญที่สุดคือ สิ่งที่คุณมีคือหลักฐานที่ชัดเจนของเรื่องนี้
dialogsComplete.tw: 所以根據保羅克的說法，這是巴布樂和闇影間戰鬥的地點？你所包含的每一個的本質就是這一點的明確證明。
dialogsComplete.vi: Vậy theo Bowler, đây là địa điểm diễn ra trận chiến giữa Bubble và Shade? Bản chất của mỗi cái mà bạn chứa đựng là bằng chứng chắc chắn về điều này.

dialogsBegin.en: What? You want to know where the Violet Trillipy live? You seem so curious about this accursed mine. Unfortunately, there are not many people left who know much about it.
dialogsBegin.ar: What? You want to know where the Violet Trillipy live? You seem so curious about this accursed mine. Unfortunately, there are not many people left who know much about it.
dialogsBegin.br: O que? Você quer saber onde a Trillipy Violeta vive? Você parece estar bastante curioso a respeito dessa mina amaldiçoada. Infelizmente, não existem muitas pessoas vivas que saibam muito a respeito dela.
dialogsBegin.cns: 啊？你想知道关于毒蜥蜴的事情喔？你的好奇心未免也太大了吧！知道毒蜥蜴的人其实也不多呢～
dialogsBegin.de: Was? Du willst wissen, wo die Violet Trillipy leben? Du bist wirklich neugierig auf diese verfluchte Mine. Nur noch wenige wissen, was es damit auf sich hat.
dialogsBegin.fi: What? You want to know where the Violet Trillipy live? You seem so curious about this accursed mine. Unfortunately, there are not many people left who know much about it.
dialogsBegin.fil: Ano? Gusto mong malaman kung saan nakatira ang Violet Trillipy? Ang laki ng pagkamausisa mo tungkol sa sumpang minahang ito. Sa kasamaang-palad, kakaunti na lang ang nakakaalam nito.
dialogsBegin.fr: Comment ? Tu veux savoir où vivent les Trillipys Violets ? Tu es vraiment curieux en ce qui concerne cette mine maudite… Hmm… Il n'y a pas beaucoup de gens qui savent quelque chose à ce sujet.
dialogsBegin.id: Apa? Kamu ingin tahu di mana Violet Trillipy tinggal? Kamu tampaknya sangat ingin tahu tentang tambang yang terkutuk ini. Sayangnya, tidak banyak orang tersisa yang tahu banyak tentang ini.
dialogsBegin.it: What? You want to know where the Violet Trillipy live? You seem so curious about this accursed mine. Unfortunately, there are not many people left who know much about it.
dialogsBegin.jp: なんと… ＜バイオレットトリルピ＞ の居る場所へ行きたいと！？　あの生物については、その存在さえあまり知られていないというのに。よほど呪われた鉱山に魅入られてしまったと見えるな。
dialogsBegin.kr: 뭐라고요? 보라색 트릴리피가 어디에 사는지 알고 싶다고요? 이 저주받은 광산이 뭐가 그렇게 궁금한 거죠? 안타깝게도, 이제 이곳에 대해 잘 아는 사람은 거의 없어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: What? You want to know where the Violet Trillipy live? You seem so curious about this accursed mine. Unfortunately, there are not many people left who know much about it.
dialogsBegin.pl: Co? Chcesz wiedzieć, gdzie żyją Violet Trilipy? Wydajesz się być ciekawy tej przeklętej kopalni. Niestety niewiele osób zostało, które coś mogą powiedzieć.
dialogsBegin.ru: Что? Хочешь знать, где найти лиловых хватоглотов? И откуда такой интерес к проклятым шахтам?.. Тех, кто вышел оттуда живым, по пальцам пересчитать можно.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Qué? ¿Quieres saber dónde viven los Trillipys Violetas? Sientes mucha curiosidad sobre esta maldita mina. Desafortunadamente, no quedan muchas personas que sepan mucho al respecto.
dialogsBegin.sw: What? You want to know where the Violet Trillipy live? You seem so curious about this accursed mine. Unfortunately, there are not many people left who know much about it.
dialogsBegin.th: อะไร? คุณต้องการทราบว่าไวโอเล็ต Trillipy อาศัยอยู่ที่ไหน? ดูเหมือนคุณอยากรู้เรื่องเหมืองที่ถูกสาปแช่ง แต่น่าเสียดายเหลือเกินที่ไม่มีใครรู้เรื่องนี้มากนัก
dialogsBegin.tw: 什麼？你想知道關於劇毒蜈蚣的事情喔？你的好奇心未免也太大了吧！知道劇毒蜈蚣的人其實也不多呢～
dialogsBegin.vi: Cái gì? Bạn muốn biết Violet Trillipy sống ở đâu? Bạn có vẻ rất tò mò về điều đáng nguyền rủa này của tôi. Thật không may, không còn nhiều người biết nhiều về nó.

dialogsBegin.en: Only a few of the mine workers go that deep into the mine. I don't know much about them or the ID card they use to get down there. Oh! You should go speak with Bernard about this.
dialogsBegin.ar: Only a few of the mine workers go that deep into the mine. I don't know much about them or the ID card they use to get down there. Oh! You should go speak with Bernard about this.
dialogsBegin.br: Somente alguns poucos trabalhadores vão até as profundezas da mina. Não sei muito sobre eles ou o cartão de identificação que usam para descer lá. Ah! Você deveria falar com Bernard sobre isso.
dialogsBegin.cns: 那里只有少数的人才可以进去啦！对那个地方我是完全不懂啦。对了！你去找番若迪好了，说不定他会知道一些事情。
dialogsBegin.de: Nur wenige der Minenarbeiter gehen so tief in die Mine. Ich weiß nicht viel über sie oder den Ausweis, den sie benutzen, um da runter zu kommen. Oh! Du solltest mit Bernard darüber sprechen.inenarbeiter wagen sich so weit in die Mine hinein. Ich weiß nichts über die Minenarbeiter oder diese ID Karte. Du solltest besser Bernard aufsuchen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Only a few of the mine workers go that deep into the mine. I don't know much about them or the ID card they use to get down there. Oh! You should go speak with Bernard about this.
dialogsBegin.fil: Iilan lang sa mga minero ang pumapasok nang ganoon kalalim sa minahan. Wala akong masyadong alam tungkol sa kanila o sa ID card na ginagamit nila para makababa doon. Ah! Kausapin mo si Bernard tungkol dito.
dialogsBegin.fr: Seuls les mineurs les plus expérimentés vont travailler dans ce secteur, mais je n'ai plus cette carte d'accès en ma possession... Ah, mais Bernard lui devrait en savoir plus ! Rends-lui donc visite…
dialogsBegin.id: Hanya beberapa pekerja tambang yang masuk jauh ke dalam tambang. Saya tidak tahu banyak tentang mereka atau kartu identitas yang mereka gunakan untuk turun ke sana. Oh! Anda harus berbicara dengan Bernard tentang hal ini
dialogsBegin.it: Only a few of the mine workers go that deep into the mine. I don't know much about them or the ID card they use to get down there. Oh! You should go speak with Bernard about this.
dialogsBegin.jp: ＜バイオレットトリルピ＞ が居る地域は、限られた者だけが入れるところだったから、私などは何も知らないのだ。そうだ！　バナードだったら何か知っているかもしれないな。
dialogsBegin.kr: 광산에서 일하는 사람 중에서도 소수 인원만 광산 깊이 들어가죠. 저는 그들에 대해서는 잘 몰라요. 내려갈 때 사용하는 신분증도 모르겠고요. 오! 버나드한테 가서 대화해보는 게 좋겠군요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Only a few of the mine workers go that deep into the mine. I don't know much about them or the ID card they use to get down there. Oh! You should go speak with Bernard about this.
dialogsBegin.pl: Tylko kilku pracowników kopalni wchodzi tak głęboko w kopalnię. Wiem o nich albo o kartach identyfikacyjnych, których używają, żeby się tam dostać. Oh! Lepiej zrobisz, jeśli odwiedzisz Bernarda.
dialogsBegin.ru: Лишь немногие шахтёры спускались так глубоко. Я мало знаю о них и о карте доступа, что ведёт туда. А! Поговори-ка об этом с Бернардом.
dialogsBegin.sp: Pocos trabajadores de la mina se adentran tanto en ella. No sé mucho sobre ellos o la tarjeta de identificación que utilizan para bajar allí. ¡Oh! Deberías hablar con Bernard sobre eso.
dialogsBegin.sw: Only a few of the mine workers go that deep into the mine. I don't know much about them or the ID card they use to get down there. Oh! You should go speak with Bernard about this.
dialogsBegin.th: มีเพียงไม่กี่คนที่ทำงานเหมืองแร่ไปที่ลึกเข้าไปในเหมือง ฉันรู้เกี่ยวกับพวกเขาหรือ ID Card ที่พวกเขาใช้เพื่อลงที่นั่น จริงสิ! คุณลองไปหา Bernard น่าจะดีกว่านะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 那裡只有少數的人才可以進去啦！對欲那個地方我是完全不懂啦。對了！你去找番若迪好了，說不定他會知道一些事情。
dialogsBegin.vi: Chỉ có một số mine workers đi sâu vào mỏ. Tôi không biết nhiều về họ hay thẻ ID mà họ dùng để xuống đó. Ồ! Bạn nên nói chuyện với Bernard về điều này.

dialogsAccept.en: Would you please say Hi to Bernard for me?
dialogsAccept.ar: Would you please say Hi to Bernard for me?
dialogsAccept.br: Você poderia, por favor, dizer "Olá" ao Bernardo por mim?
dialogsAccept.cns: 好吧！你见到他的话，顺便帮我问他最近过得如何好吗？
dialogsAccept.de: Würdest du bitte Bernard von mir grüßen?
dialogsAccept.fi: Would you please say Hi to Bernard for me?
dialogsAccept.fil: Pwede mo bang sabihin hi kay Bernard para sa akin?
dialogsAccept.fr: Bien, bien. Tant que tu y es, dis-lui bonjour de ma part s'il te plaît.
dialogsAccept.id: Maukah kamu menyapa Bernard untukku?
dialogsAccept.it: Would you please say Hi to Bernard for me?
dialogsAccept.jp: バナードに会ったら、私からもよろしく言っていたと伝えてくれ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 버나드에게 안부 전해 주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Would you please say Hi to Bernard for me?
dialogsAccept.pl: Czy mógłbyś pozdrowić ode mnie Bernarda?
dialogsAccept.ru: Если найдешь, передавай привет.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¿Podrías saludar a Bernard de mi parte?
dialogsAccept.sw: Would you please say Hi to Bernard for me?
dialogsAccept.th: ฝากทักทาย Bernard ให้ฉันด้วย
dialogsAccept.tw: 好吧！你見到他的話，順便幫我問他最近過得如何好嗎？
dialogsAccept.vi: Bạn vui lòng nói Xin chào Bernard giùm tôi được không?

dialogsDecline.en: No, you are right. You should not be the next one to suffer.
dialogsDecline.ar: No, you are right. You should not be the next one to suffer.
dialogsDecline.br: Não, você está certo. Você não deveria ser o próximo a sofrer.
dialogsDecline.cns: 对啦～不要自找麻烦啦！
dialogsDecline.de: Du hast recht. Du solltest nicht das nächste Opfer auf der Liste sein.
dialogsDecline.fi: No, you are right. You should not be the next one to suffer.
dialogsDecline.fil: Tama ka, hindi dapat ikaw na ang masunod na magdusa.
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu as raison. A quoi bon s'investir autant pour cette mine...
dialogsDecline.id: Tidak, kamu benar. Kamu seharusnya tidak menjadi orang berikutnya yang menderita.
dialogsDecline.it: No, you are right. You should not be the next one to suffer.
dialogsDecline.jp: それがいい。あんな危険な場所にわざわざ行くものではないからね。
dialogsDecline.kr: 아니에요, 당신 말이 맞아요. 당신이 또 고통받아선 안 되죠.
dialogsDecline.nl: No, you are right. You should not be the next one to suffer.
dialogsDecline.pl: Nie, masz rację. Nie powinieneś być następną osobą, która będzie cierpieć.
dialogsDecline.ru: И правильно. Тебе-то помирать зачем?
dialogsDecline.sp: No, tienes razón. No deberías ser el próximo en sufrir.
dialogsDecline.sw: No, you are right. You should not be the next one to suffer.
dialogsDecline.th: ไม่ คุณพูดถูก คุณไม่ควรจะเป็นคนต่อไปที่ต้องทนทุกข์ทรมาน
dialogsDecline.tw: 對啦～不要自找麻煩啦！
dialogsDecline.vi: Không, bạn đã đúng. Bạn không nên là người tiếp theo phải chịu đựng.

dialogsComplete.en: Violet Trillipy… Do you mean you are going in there with them?
dialogsComplete.ar: Violet Trillipy… Do you mean you are going in there with them?
dialogsComplete.br: Trillipys Violetas… Você está dizendo que está indo lá com elas?
dialogsComplete.cns: 你说毒蜥蜴喔......难道你想进去那个地方吗？
dialogsComplete.de: Violet Trillipy… Du meinst du willst da rein gehen?
dialogsComplete.fi: Violet Trillipy… Do you mean you are going in there with them?
dialogsComplete.fil: Violet Trillipy… Ibig mong sabihin sasama ka sa kanila papunta roon?
dialogsComplete.fr: Les Trillipys Violets ? Tu veux dire que tu veux aller dans leur secteur ?
dialogsComplete.id: Violet Trillipy….Apakah maksudnya kamu akan pergi ke sana bersama mereka?
dialogsComplete.it: Violet Trillipy… Do you mean you are going in there with them?
dialogsComplete.jp: ＜バイオレットトリルピ＞の元へ行きたいと？
dialogsComplete.kr: 바이올렛 트릴리피라… 설마, 트릴리피와 같이 들어가겠다는 건가요?
dialogsComplete.nl: Violet Trillipy… Do you mean you are going in there with them?
dialogsComplete.pl: Violet Trillipy…. Masz na myśli, że idziesz tam z nimi?
dialogsComplete.ru: Лиловые хватоглоты… Ты что, и вправду собрался идти к ним?
dialogsComplete.sp: Trillipys Violetas… ¿Quieres decir que vas a entrar allí con ellos?
dialogsComplete.sw: Violet Trillipy… Do you mean you are going in there with them?
dialogsComplete.th: Violet Trillipy... นี่หมายความว่าคุณจะเข้าไปที่นั่นกับพวกเขาเหรอ?
dialogsComplete.tw: 劇毒蜈蚣……你的意思是你要進去牠們那裡嗎？
dialogsComplete.vi: Violet Trillipy….Ý bạn là bạn sẽ vào đó với họ à?

dialogsFail.en: Why not just relax and give it up?
dialogsFail.ar: Why not just relax and give it up?
dialogsFail.br: Por que não relaxar e desistir?
dialogsFail.cns: 不要自找麻烦了啦～放弃好不好啊？
dialogsFail.de: Warum gibst du nicht auf und legst eine Pause ein?
dialogsFail.fi: Why not just relax and give it up?
dialogsFail.fil: Bakit hindi ka na lang mag-relax at talikuran na?
dialogsFail.fr: Pourquoi n'abandonnerais-tu pas simplement et te reposerais-tu pas un peu ?
dialogsFail.id: Mengapa tidak santai saja dan menyerah?
dialogsFail.it: Why not just relax and give it up?
dialogsFail.jp: もうやめておいた方がいいのではないか？
dialogsFail.kr: 그냥 포기하고 쉬는 게 어때요?
dialogsFail.nl: Why not just relax and give it up?
dialogsFail.pl: Dlaczego po prostu się nie zrelaksować i zrezygnować?
dialogsFail.ru: Еще не поздно передумать.

dialogsFail.th: ทำไมไม่เพียงแค่ผ่อนคลายและยอมแพ้ไปล่ะ?
dialogsFail.tw: 不要自找麻煩了啦～放棄好不好啊？
dialogsFail.vi: Tại sao không chỉ cần thư giãn và từ bỏ nó?

dialogsBegin.en: Normally I'd be skeptical of such a claim, but I do recall coming across quite a peculiar sight…
dialogsBegin.ar: Normally I'd be skeptical of such a claim, but I do recall coming across quite a peculiar sight…
dialogsBegin.br: Normalmente eu seria cética em relação a tal afirmação, mas me lembro de ter visto algo bastante peculiar…
dialogsBegin.cns: 一般来说我会对这种说法持怀疑态度，但我确实记得我遇到过一个非常奇怪的景象…
dialogsBegin.de: Normalerweise wäre ich bei solchen Behauptungen skeptisch, aber ich erinnere mich an einen recht merkwürdigen Anblick...
dialogsBegin.fi: Normally I'd be skeptical of such a claim, but I do recall coming across quite a peculiar sight…
dialogsBegin.fil: Normally I'd be skeptical of such a claim, but I do recall coming across quite a peculiar sight…
dialogsBegin.fr: Si je crois à la réincarnation ? Bien entendu. Vous par exemple, vous avez dû mal vous comporter pour être réincarné en vagabond.
dialogsBegin.id: Biasanya saya akan skeptis terhadap klaim semacam itu, tetapi saya ingat saya sempat menemukan hal yang cukup aneh ...
dialogsBegin.it: Normally I'd be skeptical of such a claim, but I do recall coming across quite a peculiar sight…
dialogsBegin.jp: 過去の英雄が転生するなんて、普段ならば信じないところですがね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 평소라면 그런 이야기는 믿지 않지만, 확실히 그때 특이한 광경을 본 기억이 있어요...
dialogsBegin.nl: Normally I'd be skeptical of such a claim, but I do recall coming across quite a peculiar sight…
dialogsBegin.pl: Normally I'd be skeptical of such a claim, but I do recall coming across quite a peculiar sight…
dialogsBegin.ru: Normally I'd be skeptical of such a claim, but I do recall coming across quite a peculiar sight…
dialogsBegin.sp: Normalmente sería escéptica ante tal afirmación, pero recuerdo haber avistado a una criatura bastante peculiar...
dialogsBegin.sw: Normally I'd be skeptical of such a claim, but I do recall coming across quite a peculiar sight…
dialogsBegin.th: โดยปกติฉันจะไม่เชื่อเรื่องการเรียกร้องดังกล่าว แต่ฉันจำได้ว่าเจอสายตาที่แปลกประหลาด ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 平常若有人這麼說，我一定會半信半疑。不過，我確實想起了一件相當古怪的事……
dialogsBegin.vi: Thông thường tôi sẽ nghi ngờ về một tuyên bố như vậy, nhưng tôi nhớ lại đã bắt gặp một cảnh tượng khá kỳ lạ…

dialogsBegin.en: While out traveling, I came across a creature most bizarre not too far East of Darken City.
dialogsBegin.ar: While out traveling, I came across a creature most bizarre not too far East of Darken City.
dialogsBegin.br: Enquanto viajava, me deparei com uma criatura muito bizarra não muito distante do lado leste da cidade de Darken.
dialogsBegin.cns: 外出旅行时，我在达肯城以东不远的地方遇到了一种非常奇怪的生物。
dialogsBegin.de: Auf meiner Reise stieß ich nicht weit östlich von Darken City auf eine äußerst bizarre Kreatur.
dialogsBegin.fi: While out traveling, I came across a creature most bizarre not too far East of Darken City.
dialogsBegin.fil: While out traveling, I came across a creature most bizarre not too far East of Darken City.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je suis tombée sur une créature mystique alors que je collectais des spécimens pour mes élèves à l'Est de la ville.
dialogsBegin.id: Saat bepergian, saya menemukan makhluk yang paling aneh tidak terlalu jauh di East of Darken City.
dialogsBegin.it: While out traveling, I came across a creature most bizarre not too far East of Darken City.
dialogsBegin.jp: 先日、ダーコンの東に正体不明の生物を発見しました。弟子達の修行の付添で偶然発見したのですがね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 여행 중에, 다켄 시티 동쪽에서 정말 이상한 생명체와 마주쳤어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: While out traveling, I came across a creature most bizarre not too far East of Darken City.
dialogsBegin.pl: While out traveling, I came across a creature most bizarre not too far East of Darken City.
dialogsBegin.ru: While out traveling, I came across a creature most bizarre not too far East of Darken City.
dialogsBegin.sp: Mientras viajaba, me encontré con una criatura muy extraña no muy lejos al Este de Darken.
dialogsBegin.sw: While out traveling, I came across a creature most bizarre not too far East of Darken City.
dialogsBegin.th: ในระหว่างการเดินทางฉันได้พบสัตว์ที่แปลกประหลาดที่สุดไม่ไกลไปทางตะวันออกของ Darken City
dialogsBegin.tw: 之前旅行時，我曾在得肯市東邊不遠處遇見一個非常奇特的生物。
dialogsBegin.vi: Trong hành trình khám phá các miền đất, tôi tình cờ gặp một sinh vật kỳ lạ nhất không quá xa về phía Đông của Thành phố Darken.

dialogsBegin.en: It looked like an animal, yet it seemed to be talking. It seems quite peculiar and might warrant an investigation. I'm not sure if this will actually help you or not…
dialogsBegin.ar: It looked like an animal, yet it seemed to be talking. It seems quite peculiar and might warrant an investigation. I'm not sure if this will actually help you or not…
dialogsBegin.br: Parecia um animal, mas aparentava estar falando algo sobre os Heróis. Parece bastante peculiar e pode justificar uma investigação. Não tenho certeza se isso realmente vai te ajudar ou não…
dialogsBegin.cns: 它看起来像一只动物，但似乎又在说话。这似乎很奇怪，因此需要进行调查。我不确定这是否真的对你有帮助…
dialogsBegin.de: Es sah aus wie ein Tier, aber es schien zu sprechen. Es scheint ziemlich merkwürdig zu sein und könnte eine Untersuchung rechtfertigen. Ich bin mir nicht sicher, ob Ihnen das weiterhilft oder nicht...
dialogsBegin.fi: It looked like an animal, yet it seemed to be talking. It seems quite peculiar and might warrant an investigation. I'm not sure if this will actually help you or not…
dialogsBegin.fil: It looked like an animal, yet it seemed to be talking. It seems quite peculiar and might warrant an investigation. I'm not sure if this will actually help you or not…
dialogsBegin.fr: Il ressemble à une bête mais il peut parler. Il m'a dit être la réincarnation d'un Héros Elémentaliste. Je lui ai ris au nez et je suis partie…
dialogsBegin.id: Itu tampak seperti binatang, namun sepertinya bisa berbicara. Tampaknya cukup aneh dan sepertinya memerlukan penyelidikan. Saya tidak yakin apakah ini benar-benar akan membantumu atau tidak...
dialogsBegin.it: It looked like an animal, yet it seemed to be talking. It seems quite peculiar and might warrant an investigation. I'm not sure if this will actually help you or not…
dialogsBegin.jp: 動物のようですが人間の言葉を話すことができるようでした。さらに彼は創世戦争の時の英雄リルリップの生まれ変わりだと名乗っています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 동물처럼 보이긴 했는데... 신기하게 말을 하더군요. 특이한 존재니 조사해 볼 가치는 있어요. 당신에게 도움이 될지는 모르겠지만...
dialogsBegin.nl: It looked like an animal, yet it seemed to be talking. It seems quite peculiar and might warrant an investigation. I'm not sure if this will actually help you or not…
dialogsBegin.pl: It looked like an animal, yet it seemed to be talking. It seems quite peculiar and might warrant an investigation. I'm not sure if this will actually help you or not…
dialogsBegin.ru: It looked like an animal, yet it seemed to be talking. It seems quite peculiar and might warrant an investigation. I'm not sure if this will actually help you or not…
dialogsBegin.sp: Se asemejaba a un animal, pero parecía estar hablando. Es un tema bastante peculiar y merece una investigación. No estoy segura de si esto te va ayudar o no...
dialogsBegin.sw: It looked like an animal, yet it seemed to be talking. It seems quite peculiar and might warrant an investigation. I'm not sure if this will actually help you or not…
dialogsBegin.th: ดูเหมือนสัตว์ แต่ก็ดูเหมือนกำลังจะพูด ดูเหมือนว่าค่อนข้างแปลกและไม่รับประกันความปลอดภัย ฉันไม่แน่ใจว่านี่จะช่วยคุณได้หรือไม่ ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 牠看起來像動物，卻又會說話。那生物實在很不尋常，值得去調查看看。至於這件事到底能不能幫上你，我就不敢保證了……
dialogsBegin.vi: Nó trông giống như một con vật, và nó dường như đang nói chuyện. Nó có vẻ khá đặc biệt và có thể cần một cuộc điều tra. Tôi không chắc liệu điều này có thực sự giúp ích cho bạn hay không…
