dialogsBegin.th: โปรดไปตรวจสอบลักษณะของเรื่องนี้ บางทีสิ่งมีชีวิตตัวนี้อาจจะรู้อะไรบางอย่างด้วย?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你就去查查看吧。說不定那個生物也知道些什麼。
dialogsBegin.vi: Hãy đi tìm hiểu bản chất của vấn đề này. Có lẽ sinh vật này cũng biết điều gì đó?

dialogsAccept.en: I saw the creature near the Steel Knights, which reside in the Erons Factories. Go look for it there!
dialogsAccept.ar: I saw the creature near the Steel Knights, which reside in the Erons Factories. Go look for it there!
dialogsAccept.br: Eu vi a criatura perto dos Cavaleiros de Aço, que residem nas Fábricas Erons. Vá procurar lá!
dialogsAccept.cns: 我在绿磷石工厂的钢甲骑士附近看到了这个生物。去那里找它！
dialogsAccept.de: Ich habe die Kreatur in der Nähe der Steel Knights in Erons Factories gesehen. Sucht dort nach ihr!
dialogsAccept.fi: I saw the creature near the Steel Knights, which reside in the Erons Factories. Go look for it there!
dialogsAccept.fil: I saw the creature near the Steel Knights, which reside in the Erons Factories. Go look for it there!
dialogsAccept.fr: Il vit proche des Steelknights, dans l'usine des Erons. Va le trouver là-bas !
dialogsAccept.id: Saya melihat makhluk di dekat Carrier Bombs di sebelah timur Darken City. Cari di sana!
dialogsAccept.it: I saw the creature near the Steel Knights, which reside in the Erons Factories. Go look for it there!
dialogsAccept.jp: エランパークスにいる「スチールナイト」の手前辺りでしょうね。まあ、探してみるとよいですよ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 그 생물은  스틸 나이트 근처 에런 팩스에 가면 찾을 수 있지. 잘 찾아보라구!
dialogsAccept.nl: I saw the creature near the Steel Knights, which reside in the Erons Factories. Go look for it there!
dialogsAccept.pl: I saw the creature near the Steel Knights, which reside in the Erons Factories. Go look for it there!
dialogsAccept.ru: I saw the creature near the Steel Knights, which reside in the Erons Factories. Go look for it there!
dialogsAccept.sp: Vi a la criatura cerca de los Steel Knights, que residen en las Fábricas de Erons. ¡Ves a buscarlo por allí!
dialogsAccept.sw: I saw the creature near the Steel Knights, which reside in the Erons Factories. Go look for it there!
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันเห็นสิ่งมีชีวิตที่อยู่ใกล้ Steel Knights ทาง Erons Factories ไปหามันที่นั่น!
dialogsAccept.tw: 我是在艾磷斯工廠那一帶看到那生物的，就在騎士機械出沒的附近。去那裡找找吧！
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi đã nhìn thấy sinh vật gần các Steel Knights, cư trú trong Erons Factories. Tìm nó ở đó đi nào!

dialogsDecline.en: What? You don't believe me? Not like your story is any more believable!
dialogsDecline.ar: What? You don't believe me? Not like your story is any more believable!
dialogsDecline.br: Você não acredita em mim? Sei que um animal falante parece loucura, mas não é como se sua história fosse mais acreditável!
dialogsDecline.cns: 什么你不相信我？难道你的故事就值得相信吗！
dialogsDecline.de: Was? Du glaubst mir nicht? Deine Geschichte ist ja auch nicht glaubwürdiger!
dialogsDecline.fi: What? You don't believe me? Not like your story is any more believable!
dialogsDecline.fil: What? You don't believe me? Not like your story is any more believable!
dialogsDecline.fr: J'ai dit que je croyais à la réincarnation, pas aux balivernes du premier monstre venu.
dialogsDecline.id: Apa? Kamu tidak percaya padaku? Sepertinya ceritamu tidak bisa dipercaya lagi!
dialogsDecline.it: What? You don't believe me? Not like your story is any more believable!
dialogsDecline.jp: ふむ、まあこのような突拍子もない話は信じられないかもしれませんね。
dialogsDecline.kr: 뭐라고요? 제 말을 믿지 않는다고요? 당신 얘기도 그렇게 믿을만하진 않는데요!
dialogsDecline.nl: What? You don't believe me? Not like your story is any more believable!
dialogsDecline.pl: What? You don't believe me? Not like your story is any more believable!
dialogsDecline.ru: What? You don't believe me? Not like your story is any more believable!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Qué? ¿No me crees? ¡Cómo si tu historia fuera más creíble!
dialogsDecline.sw: What? You don't believe me? Not like your story is any more believable!
dialogsDecline.th: อะไร? คุณไม่เชื่อฉันเหรอ? ไม่เหมือนกับเรื่องราวของคุณน่าเชื่อถือมากขึ้น!
dialogsDecline.tw: 什麼？你不相信我？說得好像你的故事就比較可信一樣！
dialogsDecline.vi: Cái gì? Bạn không tin tôi ư? Chẳng giống như câu chuyện của bạn là đáng tin hơn bất kỳ thứ gì à!

dialogsComplete.en: Hi! My name is Reodos...Oh come on! It's not like you are all that normal looking either!
dialogsComplete.ar: Hi! My name is Reodos...Oh come on! It's not like you are all that normal looking either!
dialogsComplete.br: Oi! Meu nome é Reodos... Ah, qual é?! Surpreso(a)? Não é como se você parecesse normal também!
dialogsComplete.cns: 你好！我叫里奥多斯... 哦，来吧！你看起来也不是那么正常！
dialogsComplete.de: Hallo! Ich heiße Reodos...Ach komm schon! Du siehst doch auch nicht gerade normal aus!
dialogsComplete.fi: Hi! My name is Reodos...Oh come on! It's not like you are all that normal looking either!
dialogsComplete.fil: Hi! My name is Reodos...Oh come on! It's not like you are all that normal looking either!
dialogsComplete.fr: Ne me regardez pas comme ça. Je suis la réincarnation d'un grand Héros.
dialogsComplete.id: Hai! Nama saya Reodos... Oh ayolah! Kalian semua tidaklah nampak normal juga!
dialogsComplete.it: Hi! My name is Reodos...Oh come on! It's not like you are all that normal looking either!
dialogsComplete.jp: む、人間か。私はレオドスだ。この姿になってから好奇心の眼でじろじろ見られるのはあまり好かんのだ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 안녕! 전 레오도스예요… 아, 진짜! 당신도 그렇게 평범하게 생긴 건 아니면서!
dialogsComplete.nl: Hi! My name is Reodos...Oh come on! It's not like you are all that normal looking either!
dialogsComplete.pl: Hi! My name is Reodos...Oh come on! It's not like you are all that normal looking either!
dialogsComplete.ru: Привет! Меня зовут Реодос... Да ладно тебе! Ты и сам не выглядишь абсолютно нормальным!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Hola! Mi nombre es Reodos... ¡Oh, venga ya! ¡Tampoco es que tengas un aspecto muy normal!
dialogsComplete.sw: Hi! My name is Reodos...Oh come on! It's not like you are all that normal looking either!
dialogsComplete.th: ไง! ฉันชื่อ Reodos ... Oh come on! ไม่ใช่ว่าคุณเป็นคนธรรมดาที่มองหาอย่างใดอย่างหนึ่ง!
dialogsComplete.tw: 嗨！我叫列奧德斯……喂，別那種表情嘛！你看起來也沒有正常到哪裡去啊！
dialogsComplete.vi: Xin chào! Tên tôi là Reodos ... Thôi nào! Nó không giống như tất cả các bạn trông bình thường!

dialogsFail.en: A truly mysterious creature indeed… You can find it in the Erons Factories, near the Steel Knights.
dialogsFail.ar: A truly mysterious creature indeed… You can find it in the Erons Factories, near the Steel Knights.
dialogsFail.br: Uma criatura verdadeiramente misteriosa... Você pode encontrá-lo nas Fábricas de Erons, perto dos Cavaleiros de Aço.
dialogsFail.cns: 它确实是一种神秘的生物...你可以在开采场钢甲骑士附近找到它。
dialogsFail.de: Eine wahrhaft mysteriöse Kreatur... Ihr findet sie in den Eron Factories in der Nähe der Steel Knights.
dialogsFail.fi: A truly mysterious creature indeed… You can find it in the Erons Factories, near the Steel Knights.
dialogsFail.fil: A truly mysterious creature indeed… You can find it in the Erons Factories, near the Steel Knights.
dialogsFail.fr: Cette créature mystérieuse habite dans l'usine des Erons, proche des Steelknights.
dialogsFail.id: Makhluk yang memang benar-benar misterius... Anda dapat menemukannya di sebelah Timur lokasi ini di dekat Carrier Bombs
dialogsFail.it: A truly mysterious creature indeed… You can find it in the Erons Factories, near the Steel Knights.
dialogsFail.jp: 獣のくせにどこか気品がありましたね。まあ、実際に話してみればわかるでしょう。エランパークスにいる「スチールナイト」の近くでしょう。
dialogsFail.kr: 레오도스는 정말 신기한 생물이더군.. 스틸 나이트 근처 에런 팩스에 가면 찾을 수 있지.
dialogsFail.nl: A truly mysterious creature indeed… You can find it in the Erons Factories, near the Steel Knights.
dialogsFail.pl: A truly mysterious creature indeed… You can find it in the Erons Factories, near the Steel Knights.
dialogsFail.ru: A truly mysterious creature indeed… You can find it in the Erons Factories, near the Steel Knights.
dialogsFail.sp: Una criatura realmente misteriosa de hecho... Puedes encontrarla en las Fábricas de Erons, cerca de los Steel Knights.
dialogsFail.sw: A truly mysterious creature indeed… You can find it in the Erons Factories, near the Steel Knights.
dialogsFail.th: Mysterious Creature ตัวจริง ... คุณสามารถหาได้จากทางตะวันออกของสถานที่แห่งนี้ใกล้กับ Steel Knights
dialogsFail.tw: 確實是一個真正神秘的生物……你可以在騎士機械附近的艾磷斯工廠找到它。
dialogsFail.vi: Một sinh vật thực sự bí ẩn… Bạn có thể tìm thấy nó trong Erons Factories, gần Steel Knights.

name.cns: 英雄的足迹 - 守护者
name.th: ผู้สืบทอดวีรบุรุษ - Guardian
name.tw: 英雄的繼任者 - 守護者

description.en: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Mark of the Hero and the Venel heart to the Jester Guardian, Heingard, in Guardiane.
description.ar: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Mark of the Hero and the Venel heart to the Jester Guardian, Heingard, in Guardiane.
description.br: Vá encontrar o guardião Jester Heingard de Guardiane. Mas antes, você deve obter a alma do guardião, Guardião Venel, na Sala de Guardiane.
description.cns: 请你去<圣堂>找<海音卡萝德>，找到他之前你得先去<守护之室>杀死<贝纳卡度温>。
description.de: Bezwinge den Venel Guardian und erbeute das Venel Heart. Bring anschließend das Mark of Hero und das Venel Heart zum Jester Wächter Heingard in Guardiane.
description.fi: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Mark of the Hero and the Venel heart to the Jester Guardian, Heingard, in Guardiane.
description.fil: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Mark of the Hero and the Venel heart to the Jester Guardian, Heingard, in Guardiane.
description.fr: Vaincre Venel et ramener son cœur à la Gardienne des Jesters, Heingard.
description.id: Kalahkan Venel Guardian, dan berikan Mark of the Hero dan Venel heart ke Jester Guardian, Heingard, di Guardiane.
description.it: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Mark of the Hero and the Venel heart to the Jester Guardian, Heingard, in Guardiane.
description.jp: ＜ガルディア＞のジェスター守護者＜へインガルド＞の元に行こう。ただその前に、＜守護者の部屋＞にいる守護精霊＜べネルガーディアン＞と対決し、勝たなきゃいけない。
description.kr: 베넬가디언을 처치하고, 영웅의 증표와 베넬의 심장을 가르디안에 있는 제스터 수호자 헤인가르드에게 전달하세요.
description.nl: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Mark of the Hero and the Venel heart to the Jester Guardian, Heingard, in Guardiane.
description.pl: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Mark of the Hero and the Venel heart to the Jester Guardian, Heingard, in Guardiane.
description.ru: Нужно победить Виндигго и принести его сердце вместе со знаком героя в Гардиану Эйнгарде, хранительнице шутов.
description.sp: Derrota al Guardián Venel, y entrega la Marca del Héroe y el Corazón de Venel a la Guardiana Jester Heingard, en Guardiane.
description.sw: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Mark of the Hero and the Venel heart to the Jester Guardian, Heingard, in Guardiane.
description.th: กำจัด Venel Guardian และส่ง Mark of the Hero และ Venel Heart ไปให้กับ Jester Guardian ชื่อ Heingard ใน Guardiane
description.tw: 請你去守護者祭壇找海音卡蘿德，找到他之前你要先去守護者之室與貝納卡度溫對戰才行。
description.vi: Đánh bại Venel Guardian, và giao Mark of the Hero và Venel heart cho Jester Guardian, Heingard, ở Guardiane.

dialogsBegin.en: Great job, Acrobat. For the final leg of your journey, you must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.ar: Great job, Acrobat. For the final leg of your journey, you must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.br: Ótimo trabalho, Acrobata. Para a etapa final de sua jornada, você deve enfrentar o $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.cns: 做得真棒，我的弓箭手。请以猎杀$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$来结束你的旅程吧。
dialogsBegin.de: Gut gemacht, Acrobat. Für die letzte Etappe deiner Reise musst du dich dem $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ stellen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Great job, Acrobat. For the final leg of your journey, you must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fil: Great job, Acrobat. For the final leg of your journey, you must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je peux maintenant te confier le Sceau des Héros, qui confirme que tu as relevé avec succès tous les défis qui se sont présentés. Mais il te faut encore tuer $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.id: Kerja bagus, Acrobat. Untuk babak terakhir perjalananmu, kamu harus menghadapi $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.it: Great job, Acrobat. For the final leg of your journey, you must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.jp: これから守護者に会ってください。そして、これを守護者に伝えてください。ただし、守護者に会う前にひとつ、やらねばならないことがあります。
dialogsBegin.kr: 잘하셨어요, 아크로뱃. 이제 여정의 마지막 단계군요. $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$에 맞서야 합니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Great job, Acrobat. For the final leg of your journey, you must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.pl: Great job, Acrobat. For the final leg of your journey, you must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.ru: Отлично. Твоя судьба скоро решится. Но не здесь, а в Гардиане, где тебя ждёт $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.sp: Gran trabajo, Acrobat. En la prueba final, debes enfrentarte al $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.sw: Great job, Acrobat. For the final leg of your journey, you must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.th: ดีมาก Acrobat สำหรับงานชิ้นสุดท้ายของการผจญภัย คุณต้องเผชิญหน้ากับ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$
dialogsBegin.tw: 幹得好雜技師 在旅程的最後一站，你必需面對 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$。
dialogsBegin.vi: Làm tốt lắm, Acrobat. Đối với chặng cuối cùng của hành trình, bạn phải đối đầu với $ QUEST_END_KILL_NAME $.

dialogsBegin.en: The will of the heroes is preserved in the Room of the Guardian in Guardiane. This is where you will find the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.ar: The will of the heroes is preserved in the Room of the Guardian in Guardiane. This is where you will find the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.br: A vontade dos heróis é preservada na Sala do Guardião em Guardiane. É lá que você encontrará o $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.cns: 英雄的意志一直留存于圣堂的守护之室。你将会在那找到 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$。
dialogsBegin.de: Der Raum des Wächters in Guardiane birgt den letzten Willen der Helden. Dort findest du auch den $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fi: The will of the heroes is preserved in the Room of the Guardian in Guardiane. This is where you will find the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fil: The will of the heroes is preserved in the Room of the Guardian in Guardiane. This is where you will find the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fr: Au sud de Darkon 3, à Gardiane, se trouve un lieu appelé la Chambre du Gardien. Tu y trouveras $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.id: Surat wasiat para pahlawan disimpan di Room of the Guardian di Guardiane. Di sinilah kamu akan menemukan $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.it: The will of the heroes is preserved in the Room of the Guardian in Guardiane. This is where you will find the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.jp: ＜ガルディア＞には＜守護者の部屋＞というのがあります。ここに$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$があります。
dialogsBegin.kr: 가르디안에는 영웅들의 의지를 수호하고 있는 수호자의 방이란 것이 있죠. 이곳에서 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$에 맞서야 합니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: The will of the heroes is preserved in the Room of the Guardian in Guardiane. This is where you will find the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.pl: The will of the heroes is preserved in the Room of the Guardian in Guardiane. This is where you will find the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.ru: The will of the heroes is preserved in the Room of the Guardian in Guardiane. This is where you will find the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.sp: La voluntad de los héroes se conserva en la Sala del Guardián en Guardiane. Allí es donde encontrarás al $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.sw: The will of the heroes is preserved in the Room of the Guardian in Guardiane. This is where you will find the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.th: เจตจำนงของฮีโร่ยังคงอยู่ในห้องของผู้พิทักษ์ใน Guardiane นี่คือที่ที่คุณจะได้พบกับ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$
dialogsBegin.tw: 英雄的意志被保存在守護者祭壇的守護者之室裡。你可以在此處找到 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$。
dialogsBegin.vi: Ý chí của các anh hùng được lưu giữ trong Căn phòng của Guardian ở Guardiane. Đây là nơi bạn sẽ tìm thấy $ QUEST_END_KILL_NAME $.

dialogsBegin.en: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ is a soul that protects the will of the heroes. Defeat him, and obtain the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.ar: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ is a soul that protects the will of the heroes. Defeat him, and obtain the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.br: O $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ é uma alma que protege a vontade dos heróis. Derrote-o e obtenha o $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.cns: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 是一直保卫着英雄意志的灵魂。请击败他，获取$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$。
dialogsBegin.de: Der $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ist eine Seele, die den Willen der Helden schützt. Besiege ihn, und du erhältst das $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fi: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ is a soul that protects the will of the heroes. Defeat him, and obtain the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fil: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ is a soul that protects the will of the heroes. Defeat him, and obtain the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il te faut y pénétrer et vaincre $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$. Ta dernière épreuve sera de lui prendre son $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ !
dialogsBegin.id: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ adalah jiwa yang melindungi surat wasiat para pahlawan. Kalahkan dia, dan dapatkan $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.it: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ is a soul that protects the will of the heroes. Defeat him, and obtain the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.jp: ここに＜ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$＞という守護精霊がいます。英雄の意志を守っている精霊ですが、この精霊と戦って、その精霊のハート＜$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$＞を持ってきてください。
dialogsBegin.kr: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$... 영웅들의 의지를 지키는 정령인데, 이 정령을 처치하고 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$를 획득하세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ is a soul that protects the will of the heroes. Defeat him, and obtain the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.pl: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ is a soul that protects the will of the heroes. Defeat him, and obtain the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.ru: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ is a soul that protects the will of the heroes. Defeat him, and obtain the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.sp: El $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ es un alma que protege la voluntad de los héroes. Derrótalo y consigue el $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.sw: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ is a soul that protects the will of the heroes. Defeat him, and obtain the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.th: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ เป็นวิญญาณที่ปกป้องเจตจำนงของเหล่าฮีโร่ เอาชนะเขา และรับ $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$
dialogsBegin.tw: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$是守護英雄意志的靈魂。擊敗他可獲得 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$。
dialogsBegin.vi: $ QUEST_END_KILL_NAME $ là linh hồn bảo vệ ý chí của các anh hùng. Đánh bại anh ta và nhận $ QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME $.

dialogsBegin.en: Take this. It is a Mark of the Hero. Once you have confronted the Venel Guardian and retrieved the Venel Heart, bring both of these to the Jester Guardian, Heingard.
dialogsBegin.ar: Take this. It is a Mark of the Hero. Once you have confronted the Venel Guardian and retrieved the Venel Heart, bring both of these to the Jester Guardian, Heingard.
dialogsBegin.br: Somente depois de obter o coração, o guardião o reconhecerá como um Jester. Isso significa que este é o último teste para se tornar um Jester. Por favor, passe no teste.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你得到这个心脏的话，他一定会承认你做暗杀，也就是说这是给你的最后一个考验了
dialogsBegin.de: Nimm das Mark of Hero und stelle dich dem Venel Guardian. Erbeute das Venel Heart von ihm. Bring anschließend beide Gegenstände zum Jester Wächter Heingard in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.fi: Take this. It is a Mark of the Hero. Once you have confronted the Venel Guardian and retrieved the Venel Heart, bring both of these to the Jester Guardian, Heingard.
dialogsBegin.fil: Take this. It is a Mark of the Hero. Once you have confronted the Venel Guardian and retrieved the Venel Heart, bring both of these to the Jester Guardian, Heingard.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu pourras alors te présenter à la Gardienne des Jesters, Heingard.
dialogsBegin.id: Ambil ini. Itu adalah Mark of the Hero. Setelah kamu menghadapi Venel Guardian dan mengambil Venel Heart, bawa keduanya ke Jester Guardian, Heingard.
dialogsBegin.it: Take this. It is a Mark of the Hero. Once you have confronted the Venel Guardian and retrieved the Venel Heart, bring both of these to the Jester Guardian, Heingard.
dialogsBegin.jp: この＜ヴェネルハート＞が得られなければ、守護者からジェスターとして認めてもらうことが出来ません。つまり、ジェスターになるための最後の試練だと言えます。必ず成し遂げてください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 여기, 영웅의 증표를 받으세요. 베넬가디언과 싸워 베넬의 심장을 손에 넣으셨다면, 그 심장과 이 영웅의 증표를 제스터 수호자 헤인가르드에게 전달하세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Take this. It is a Mark of the Hero. Once you have confronted the Venel Guardian and retrieved the Venel Heart, bring both of these to the Jester Guardian, Heingard.
dialogsBegin.pl: Take this. It is a Mark of the Hero. Once you have confronted the Venel Guardian and retrieved the Venel Heart, bring both of these to the Jester Guardian, Heingard.
dialogsBegin.ru: Вот, возьми. Это знак героя. Когда убьешь Виндигго, отнеси его сердце и этот знак Эйнгарде, хранительнице шутов. Ну что, ты справишься?
dialogsBegin.sp: Toma esto. Es una Marca del Héroe. Una vez que te hayas enfrentado al Guardián Venel y hayas recuperado el Corazón de Venel, llévale ambos a la Guardiana Jester, Heingard.
dialogsBegin.sw: Take this. It is a Mark of the Hero. Once you have confronted the Venel Guardian and retrieved the Venel Heart, bring both of these to the Jester Guardian, Heingard.
dialogsBegin.th: เอานี้ไป เป็นเครื่องหมายของวีรบุรุษ เมื่อคุณได้เผชิญหน้า Venel Guardian และเอา Venel Heart กลับคืนมา แล้วให้นำทั้งคู่ไปให้กับ Jester Guardian ชื่อ Heingard
dialogsBegin.tw: 你得到這個心臟的話，他一定會承認你做操偶師，也就是說這是給你的最後一個考驗了
dialogsBegin.vi: Hãy làm việc này. Đó là Mark of the Hero. Một khi bạn đã đối mặt với Venel Guardian và lấy lại Venel Heart, hãy mang cả hai thứ này đến Jester Guardian, Heingard.

dialogsAccept.en: I wish you luck, Acrobat.
dialogsAccept.ar: I wish you luck, Acrobat.
dialogsAccept.br: Eu lhe desejo sorte, Acrobata.
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你好运，弓箭手
dialogsAccept.de: Ich wünsche dir Glück, Acrobat.
dialogsAccept.fi: I wish you luck, Acrobat.
dialogsAccept.fil: I wish you luck, Acrobat.
dialogsAccept.fr: Je te souhaite que la chance de Kerenen t'accompagne !
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga berhasil, Acrobat.
dialogsAccept.it: I wish you luck, Acrobat.
dialogsAccept.jp: アクロバットあなたに＜カエネン＞のご加護がありますように。
dialogsAccept.kr: 행운을 빌어요, 아크로뱃.
dialogsAccept.nl: I wish you luck, Acrobat.
dialogsAccept.pl: I wish you luck, Acrobat.
dialogsAccept.ru: I wish you luck, Acrobat.
dialogsAccept.sp: Te deseo suerte, Acrobat.
dialogsAccept.sw: I wish you luck, Acrobat.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้โชคดี Acrobat
dialogsAccept.tw: 祝你好運，雜技師。
dialogsAccept.vi: Chúc may mắn, Acrobat.

dialogsDecline.en: This is the final test to becoming a successor of the Jester Hero. You can't give up now. Speak with me again when you are ready to continue.
dialogsDecline.ar: This is the final test to becoming a successor of the Jester Hero. You can't give up now. Speak with me again when you are ready to continue.
dialogsDecline.br: Este é o teste final para se tornar um sucessor do Herói Jester. Você não pode desistir agora. Fale comigo novamente quando estiver pronto(a) para continuar.
dialogsDecline.cns: 这是成为暗杀的最后一步，现在放弃太可惜了。准备好后再来找我吧
dialogsDecline.de: Nur eine Prüfung steht noch aus. Wäre es nicht schade, wenn du jetzt aufgibst? Komm wieder wenn du bereit bist.
dialogsDecline.fi: This is the final test to becoming a successor of the Jester Hero. You can't give up now. Speak with me again when you are ready to continue.
dialogsDecline.fil: This is the final test to becoming a successor of the Jester Hero. You can't give up now. Speak with me again when you are ready to continue.
dialogsDecline.fr: Après avoir traversé tant d'épreuves, tu es sur le point d'abandonner ? Ceci est la dernière étape, réfléchis bien...
dialogsDecline.id: Ini adalah ujian terakhir untuk menjadi penerus Jester Hero. Kamu tidak boleh menyerah sekarang. Bicaralah denganku lagi ketika kamu sudah siap untuk melanjutkan.
dialogsDecline.it: This is the final test to becoming a successor of the Jester Hero. You can't give up now. Speak with me again when you are ready to continue.
dialogsDecline.jp: ここまできてあきらめるのならば、今まで歩んできた道は何だったのですか？　もう一度よくご自分の心に聞いてみて下さい。
dialogsDecline.kr: 이건 제스터 영웅의 후계자가 되기 위한 마지막 시험이라고요. 여기서 포기할 순 없죠. 계속할 준비가 되었다면 다시 말씀하세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: This is the final test to becoming a successor of the Jester Hero. You can't give up now. Speak with me again when you are ready to continue.
dialogsDecline.pl: This is the final test to becoming a successor of the Jester Hero. You can't give up now. Speak with me again when you are ready to continue.
dialogsDecline.ru: Это последнее испытание, которое покажет, быть тебе шутом или нет. Сдаваться поздно. Подготовься к сражению и скажи об этом мне.
dialogsDecline.sp: Esta es la prueba final para convertirte en Sucesor del Héroe Jester. No te puedes rendir ahora. Habla conmigo cuando estés listo para continuar.
dialogsDecline.sw: This is the final test to becoming a successor of the Jester Hero. You can't give up now. Speak with me again when you are ready to continue.
dialogsDecline.th: นี่คือการทดสอบครั้งสุดท้ายที่จะกลายเป็นทายาทของ Jester Hero คุณไม่สามารถยอมแพ้ได้ในตอนนี้ พูดกับฉันอีกครั้งเมื่อคุณพร้อมที่จะดำเนินการต่อ
dialogsDecline.tw: 這是成為操偶師英雄繼任者的最後考驗。你現在不能放棄。當你準備好繼續時，再次與我交談。
dialogsDecline.vi: Đây là bài kiểm tra cuối cùng để trở thành người kế nhiệm của Jester Hero. Bạn không thể từ bỏ bây giờ. Nói chuyện lại với tôi khi bạn sẵn sàng tiếp tục.

dialogsComplete.en: Congratulations, young Acrobat. I've heard many great things about you. You've completed the final test. You will now become a Successor of the Jester Hero!
dialogsComplete.ar: Congratulations, young Acrobat. I've heard many great things about you. You've completed the final test. You will now become a Successor of the Jester Hero!
dialogsComplete.br: Parabéns, jovem Acrobata. Eu ouvi muitas coisas boas sobre você. Você concluiu o teste final. Agora você se tornará um Sucessor do Herói Jester!
dialogsComplete.cns: 欢迎你来到这里～你已经通过最后一个考验了，你现在成为真正的暗杀了！
dialogsComplete.de: Glückwunsch, junger Acrobat. Ich hörte, du hast großes vollbracht. Du die letzte Prüfung bestanden. Nun wirst du wahrhaftig zum Nachfolger des Jester Helden!
dialogsComplete.fi: Congratulations, young Acrobat. I've heard many great things about you. You've completed the final test. You will now become a Successor of the Jester Hero!
dialogsComplete.fil: Congratulations, young Acrobat. I've heard many great things about you. You've completed the final test. You will now become a Successor of the Jester Hero!
dialogsComplete.fr: Bienvenue à Gardiane. Tu as réussi brillamment la dernière épreuve et mérites désormais d'être l'un des successeurs du Héros des Jesters.
dialogsComplete.id: Selamat, Acrobat muda. Aku telah mendengar banyak hal hebat tentangmu. Kamu telah menyelesaikan ujian akhir. Kamu sekarang akan menjadi Successor of the Jester Hero!
dialogsComplete.it: Congratulations, young Acrobat. I've heard many great things about you. You've completed the final test. You will now become a Successor of the Jester Hero!
dialogsComplete.jp: よくぞここへ辿りつきました、ジェスターの後継者よ。　最後の試練を乗り越えました。これからあなたをジェスターの後継者とし、正式に任命します。
dialogsComplete.kr: 축하합니다, 젊은 아크로뱃. 당신에 대해 좋은 소문을 많이 들었지요. 마지막 시험을 끝내셨습니다. 이제 제스터 영웅의 계승자가 되시겠군요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Congratulations, young Acrobat. I've heard many great things about you. You've completed the final test. You will now become a Successor of the Jester Hero!
dialogsComplete.pl: Congratulations, young Acrobat. I've heard many great things about you. You've completed the final test. You will now become a Successor of the Jester Hero!
dialogsComplete.ru: Поздравляю. Не зря тебя так хвалили. Последнее испытание позади. Быть тебе шутом!
dialogsComplete.sp: Felicidades, joven Acrobat. He escuchado muchas cosas buenas de ti. Has completado la prueba final. ¡Ahora te convertirás en Sucesor del Héroe Jester!
dialogsComplete.sw: Congratulations, young Acrobat. I've heard many great things about you. You've completed the final test. You will now become a Successor of the Jester Hero!
dialogsComplete.th: ขอแสดงความยินดี Acrobat หนุ่ม ฉันเคยได้ยินสิ่งดีๆมากมายเกี่ยวกับตัวคุณ คุณทำการทดสอบครั้งสุดท้ายแล้ว ตอนนี้คุณจะกลายเป็นทายาทของ Hero Jester!
dialogsComplete.tw: 歡迎你來到這裡～你已經通過最後一個考驗了，你現在成為真正的操偶師了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Xin chúc mừng, Acrobat trẻ. Tôi đã nghe nhiều điều tuyệt vời về bạn. Bạn đã hoàn thành bài kiểm tra cuối cùng. Bây giờ bạn sẽ trở thành Người kế vị Jester Hero!

dialogsComplete.en: Wise Curenen! This Acrobat wishes to follow your path! Grant them your blessing and courage, Jester Hero!
dialogsComplete.ar: Wise Curenen! This Acrobat wishes to follow your path! Grant them your blessing and courage, Jester Hero!
dialogsComplete.br: Kerenen! Eis aqui alguém que quer seguir você. Por favor, abençoe-o e o dê coragem. Jester!
dialogsComplete.cns: 暗杀的英雄<凯奈>啊～这里有一位勇士要追随你的后迹，请赐给他祝福的神力吧！
dialogsComplete.de: Oh weise Kerenen! Dieser Acrobat möchte in deine Fußstapfen treten. Gewähre ihnen deinen Segen und Mut, oh Held der Jester!
dialogsComplete.fi: Wise Curenen! This Acrobat wishes to follow your path! Grant them your blessing and courage, Jester Hero!
dialogsComplete.fil: Wise Curenen! This Acrobat wishes to follow your path! Grant them your blessing and courage, Jester Hero!
dialogsComplete.fr: Kerenen, puisses-tu bénir et soutenir en tout temps cette personne ici qui dédie sa vie à ta volonté !
dialogsComplete.id: Wise Curenen! Acrobat ini ingin mengikuti jalanmu! Beri mereka berkat dan keberanianmu, Jester Hero!
dialogsComplete.it: Wise Curenen! This Acrobat wishes to follow your path! Grant them your blessing and courage, Jester Hero!
dialogsComplete.jp: ＜カエネン＞様、ここにあなたの魂に従おうとしている者がいます。この人に祝福と勇気を与えてください。ジェスターに栄光あれ！
dialogsComplete.kr: 현명한 커에넨이시여! 이 제스터가 당신의 길을 따르고자 합니다! 레인저 영웅의 축복과 힘을 내려주소서!
dialogsComplete.nl: Wise Curenen! This Acrobat wishes to follow your path! Grant them your blessing and courage, Jester Hero!
dialogsComplete.pl: Wise Curenen! This Acrobat wishes to follow your path! Grant them your blessing and courage, Jester Hero!
dialogsComplete.ru: О, великий Ким Джерри! Взгляни на акробата, что желает пойти по твоим стопам! Благослови его и надели отвагой!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Sabio Curenen! ¡Este Acrobat desea seguir tu camino! ¡Dale tu bendición y coraje, Héroe Jester!
dialogsComplete.sw: Wise Curenen! This Acrobat wishes to follow your path! Grant them your blessing and courage, Jester Hero!
dialogsComplete.th: Curenen ผู้ชาญฉลาด! Acrobat ผู้นี้มีความประสงค์ที่จะปฏิบัติตามเส้นทางของคุณ! ให้พรและความกล้าหาญแก่พวกเขา Hero Jester!
dialogsComplete.tw: 操偶師的英雄凱奈啊～這裡有一位勇士要跟你的後跡，請賜給他祝福的神力吧！
dialogsComplete.vi: Curenen khôn ngoan! Acrobat mong muốn đi theo con đường của bạn! Xin ban cho họ lời chúc phúc và lòng can đảm của bạn, Jester Hero!

dialogsFail.en: You have not completed the tasks given to you by the Jester Priest. Return to me when you have done so.
dialogsFail.ar: You have not completed the tasks given to you by the Jester Priest. Return to me when you have done so.
dialogsFail.br: Eu acredito que você tenha vindo me ver porque a sacerdotisa lhe enviou. Mas você ainda não completou sua última tarefa. Volte para mim quando tiver feito isso.
dialogsFail.cns: 你还没有完成之前的任务，完成后再来找我吧
dialogsFail.de: Deine Aufgaben vom Jester Priester sind noch nicht erfüllt. Kehre zurück, sobald du dich als würdig erwiesen hast.
dialogsFail.fi: You have not completed the tasks given to you by the Jester Priest. Return to me when you have done so.
dialogsFail.fil: You have not completed the tasks given to you by the Jester Priest. Return to me when you have done so.
dialogsFail.fr: Seuls ceux reconnus comme successeurs de Kerenen sont admis ici. Poursuis ton apprentissage...
dialogsFail.id: Kamu belum menyelesaikan tugas yang diberikan oleh Jester Priest. Kembalilah padaku ketika kamu sudah selesai.
dialogsFail.it: You have not completed the tasks given to you by the Jester Priest. Return to me when you have done so.
dialogsFail.jp: 私を尋ねて来たということは、司祭には会ったのですね？　あなたには最後の試練が残されているはずです。
dialogsFail.kr: 제스터 사제가 준 임무를 아직 완수하지 않으셨군요. 전부 끝나면 다시 오세요.
dialogsFail.nl: You have not completed the tasks given to you by the Jester Priest. Return to me when you have done so.
dialogsFail.pl: You have not completed the tasks given to you by the Jester Priest. Return to me when you have done so.
dialogsFail.ru: You have not completed the tasks given to you by the Jester Priest. Return to me when you have done so.
dialogsFail.sp: No has completado las tareas que te asignó la Sacerdotisa Jester. Vuelve cuando las hayas terminado.
dialogsFail.sw: You have not completed the tasks given to you by the Jester Priest. Return to me when you have done so.
dialogsFail.th: คุณยังไม่เสร็จสิ้นภารกิจที่ Jester Priest มอบให้คุณ กลับมาหาฉันเมื่อคุณได้ทำภารกิจเรียบร้อยแล้ว
dialogsFail.tw: 你還沒有完成操偶師牧師交給你的任務。完成後返回給我。
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn chưa hoàn thành các nhiệm vụ mà Jester Priest giao cho bạn. Hãy quay trở lại tôi khi bạn đã hoàn thành.

name.vi: Thay đổi nhiệm vụ đầu tiên

name.th: ประตูแห่งความมืด

description.en: Investigate the temple entrace.
description.ar: Investigate the temple entrace.
description.br: Investigue a entrada do templo.
description.cns: 帮我打探一下地牢入口附近，看看有没有什么不寻常的状况。
description.de: Sieh dich am Eingang des Tempels um.
description.fi: Investigate the temple entrace.
description.fil: Imbestigahan ang pasukan ng templo.
description.fr: Vérifier que l’entrée du temple est sans danger
description.id: Selidiki pintu masuk kuil.
description.it: Investigate the temple entrace.
description.jp: イブリス神殿は夢幻の砂漠に現れたようです。探して、中に入ってみましょう。
description.nl: Investigate the temple entrace.
description.pl: Zbadaj wejście do świątyni.
description.ru: Нужно осмотреть вход в Храм Ужосса.
description.sp: Investiga la entrada del templo.
description.sw: Investigate the temple entrace.
description.th: สำรวจอุโมงค์วัด
description.tw: 幫我打探一下神殿入口附近，看看有沒有什麼不尋常的狀況。
description.vi: Điều tra lối vào ngôi đền

dialogsBegin.en: Excuse me. If you are not busy, would you please listen to my story? Have you ever heard of the Iblis Temple?
dialogsBegin.ar: Excuse me. If you are not busy, would you please listen to my story? Have you ever heard of the Iblis Temple?
dialogsBegin.br: Com licença... você gostaria de escutar a minha história se não estiver ocupado? Já ouviu falar no Templo Iblis?
dialogsBegin.cns: 请问一下，你有听说过[幻魔依普利神殿]吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Entschuldige. Wenn du gerade Zeit hast, würdest du dir bitte meine Geschichte anhören? Hast du jemals vom Ivillis Tempel gehört?
dialogsBegin.fi: Excuse me. If you are not busy, would you please listen to my story? Have you ever heard of the Iblis Temple?
dialogsBegin.fil: Patawad. Kung hindi ka abala, puwede mo bang pakinggan ang kwento ko? Narinig mo na ba ang tungkol sa Iblis Temple?
dialogsBegin.fr: Excuse-moi ! Si tu n’as pas mieux à faire, voudrais-tu s’il te plaît écouter mon histoire ? As-tu déjà entendu parler du Temple d’Ivillis ?
dialogsBegin.id: Permisi. Jika kamu tidak sibuk, maukah kamu mendengarkan ceritaku? Pernahkah kamu mendengar tentang Iblis Temple?
dialogsBegin.it: Excuse me. If you are not busy, would you please listen to my story? Have you ever heard of the Iblis Temple?
dialogsBegin.jp: あの、あなたは冒険者ですか？…そうですか。よかった！実は、ぜひ聞いてもらいたい話があります。まず＜イブリス神殿＞をご存知ですか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 저, 잠시만요. 바쁘시지 않다면 제 이야기를 좀 들어주실 수 있겠어요? 혹시 이블리스 신전이라고 아시나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Excuse me. If you are not busy, would you please listen to my story? Have you ever heard of the Iblis Temple?
dialogsBegin.pl: Przepraszam. Jeśli nie jesteś zajęty, czy mógłbyś wysłuchać mojej historii? Czy słyszałeś kiedyś o Świątyni Iblis?
dialogsBegin.ru: Кхе-кхе. Если у тебя найдется минутка, я бы рассказал тебе нелепейшую историю. Есть в Мадригале зловещее место - Храм Ужосса.
dialogsBegin.sp: Discúlpame, si no estás ocupado, ¿podrías por favor escuchar mi historia? ¿Alguna vez has oído hablar del Templo de Iblis?
dialogsBegin.sw: Excuse me. If you are not busy, would you please listen to my story? Have you ever heard of the Iblis Temple?
dialogsBegin.th: ขอโทษนะ ถ้าคุณว่างอยู่ คุณช่วยฟังเรื่องของฉันได้ไหม คุณเคยได้ยินเกี่ยวกับวัด Iblis ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 打擾一下。若你不忙，能聽聽我的故事嗎？你聽過伊普里司神殿嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Xin lỗi cho tôi hỏi. Nếu bạn không bận, bạn vui lòng nghe câu chuyện của tôi? Bạn đã bao giờ nghe nói về Đền thờ Iblis chưa?

dialogsBegin.en: The Iblis Temple was built by the followers of Iblis, a leader from before the first age of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.ar: The Iblis Temple was built by the followers of Iblis, a leader from before the first age of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.br: O Templo Iblis foi construído pelos seguidores de Iblis, um líder que viveu antes da primeira era de Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我也不是很清楚，据说幻魔依普利神殿是瑞加世界的历史开始前，就由幻魔依普利所创造出来的…
dialogsBegin.de: Der Ivillis Tempel wurde von den Anhängern des Ivillis erbaut. Er ist einer der Gottheiten, die schon vor dem ersten Zeitalter Madrigals existierten.
dialogsBegin.fi: The Iblis Temple was built by the followers of Iblis, a leader from before the first age of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.fil: Itinayo ang Iblis Temple ng mga tagasunod ni Iblis, isang lider mula bago ang unang panahon ng Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.fr: Hmm… Apparemment non. Le temple d’Ivillis a été construit par les adorateurs d’Ivillis. Celui-ci était le chef des Clowns, alors que Madrigal n’existait pas encore.
dialogsBegin.id: The Iblis Temple dibangun oleh para pengikut Iblis, seorang pemimpin dari sebelum usia pertama Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.it: The Iblis Temple was built by the followers of Iblis, a leader from before the first age of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.jp: 知らないようですね！遥かな昔、イブリスに魅入られしもの達に作られた神殿があったと伝えられています。伝説に曰く、闇の聖地＜イブリス神殿＞と。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이블리스 신전은 고대 마드리갈의 역사가 시작되기도 전, 이블리스의 추종자들이 지었던 신전이에요.
dialogsBegin.nl: The Iblis Temple was built by the followers of Iblis, a leader from before the first age of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.pl: Świątynia Iblis została zbudowana przez wyznawców Iblisa, przywódcy sprzed pierwszej epoki Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.ru: Он был построен на юге Санто Моргена, в Нереальной пустыне.
dialogsBegin.sp: El Templo de Iblis fue construido por los seguidores de Iblis, un líder anterior a la primera era de Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.sw: The Iblis Temple was built by the followers of Iblis, a leader from before the first age of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.th: วัด Iblis สร้างขึ้นโดยสาวกแห่ง Iblis ผู้นำมาตั้งแต่ก่อนยุคแรกของ Madrigal
dialogsBegin.tw: 我也不是很清楚，據說伊普里司神殿是在瑪德利賈世界歷史開始前，由伊普里司的追隨者建造出來的…
dialogsBegin.vi: Đền Iblis được xây dựng bởi những người theo Iblis, một nhà lãnh đạo từ trước thời đại đầu tiên của Madrigal.

dialogsBegin.en: The temple is located in the Fantasy Desert, in the southern part of Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.ar: The temple is located in the Fantasy Desert, in the southern part of Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.br: O templo está localizado no Deserto da Fantasia, na parte sul de Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.cns: 也有人说是人工所建造的地牢，地牢位于晨光南部梦幻沙漠！
dialogsBegin.de: Der Tempel befindet sich in der Wüste der Illusionen. Sie liegt im Süden von Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.fi: The temple is located in the Fantasy Desert, in the southern part of Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.fil: Matatagpuan ang templo sa Fantasy Desert, sa timog na bahagi ng Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.fr: Le temple est au Désert de l'imagination, qui se trouve au sud de Saint Morning. Mais maintenant, laisse-moi te raconter l’histoire…
dialogsBegin.id: Kuil ini terletak di Fantasy Desert, di bagian selatan Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.it: The temple is located in the Fantasy Desert, in the southern part of Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.jp: 寺院はセイントモーニングの南部のファンタジー砂漠にあります。
dialogsBegin.kr: 세인트 모닝 남부, 몽환의 사막에 있죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: The temple is located in the Fantasy Desert, in the southern part of Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.pl: Świątynia znajduje się na Fantasy Desert, w południowej części Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.ru: Возвели его последователи Ужосса - вождя из времен до начала эпох.
dialogsBegin.sp: El templo está ubicado en el Desierto Fantasía, en la parte sur de Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.sw: The temple is located in the Fantasy Desert, in the southern part of Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.th: วัดตั้งอยู่ใน Desert Fantasy ในตอนใต้ของ Saint Morning
dialogsBegin.tw: 也有人說是人工所建造的神殿，神殿位於聖音特南部夢幻沙漠！
dialogsBegin.vi: Ngôi đền nằm trong sa mạc Fantasy, ở phía nam của Saint Morning.

dialogsBegin.en: You see... every mayor has to explore all the Islands of Madrigal. In the course of these travels we have to visit the Iblis Temple but... I am so afraid.
dialogsBegin.ar: You see... every mayor has to explore all the Islands of Madrigal. In the course of these travels we have to visit the Iblis Temple but... I am so afraid.
dialogsBegin.br: Você sabe… todos os prefeitos querem explorar todas as ilhas de Madrigal. No decorrer dessas viagens, teremos que visitar o Templo Iblis, mas... Tenho tanto medo.
dialogsBegin.cns: 各方的旅人都会经过这地方，但这地牢让人感觉得相当危险…
dialogsBegin.de: Du siehst... jeder Bürgermeister muss alle Inseln von Madrigal erkunden. Im Laufe dieser Reisen müssen wir den Iblis-Tempel besuchen, aber... Ich habe solche Angst.
dialogsBegin.fi: You see... every mayor has to explore all the Islands of Madrigal. In the course of these travels we have to visit the Iblis Temple but... I am so afraid.
dialogsBegin.fil: Alam mo… kailangang galugarin ng bawat mayor ang lahat ng mga Isla ng Madrigal. Sa mga paglalakbay na ito kailangan naming bisitahin ang Iblis Temple pero… natatakot talaga ako.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tout Maire de Madrigal doit explorer le continent. Pour cela, on doit passer auprès du temple d’Ivillis. Mais… je… je… j’ai tellement peur… et c’est pour cela…
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu tahu… setiap walikota harus menjelajahi semua Kepulauan Madrigal. Dalam perjalanan ini kita harus mengunjungi the Iblis Temple tapi.. Aku sangat takut.
dialogsBegin.it: You see... every mayor has to explore all the Islands of Madrigal. In the course of these travels we have to visit the Iblis Temple but... I am so afraid.
dialogsBegin.jp: 夢幻で砂漠で発見された神殿は、伝説にあるイブリス神殿と酷似していたようですが、正確なことは何もわかっていません。調査団が相次いで謎の事故にあい、調査が中断されているためです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 시장님이 되면 마드리갈의 섬을 하나도 빠짐없이 순방해야 하거든요. 이 여정 중에 이블리스 신전을 방문해야 하는데... 겁이 나네요.
dialogsBegin.nl: You see... every mayor has to explore all the Islands of Madrigal. In the course of these travels we have to visit the Iblis Temple but... I am so afraid.
dialogsBegin.pl: Widzisz… każdy burmistrz musi zbadać wszystkie wyspy Madrigal. W trakcie tych podróży musimy odwiedzić świątynię Iblis, ale... tak się boję.
dialogsBegin.ru: Видишь ли… каждый мэр должен исследовать все острова Мадригала. В этих странствиях нам приходится посещать и Храм Ужосса, но… я так боюсь.
dialogsBegin.sp: Verás… cada alcalde tiene que explorar todas las Islas de Madrigal. En el curso de estos viajes tenemos que visitar el Templo de Iblis pero... estoy muy asustado.
dialogsBegin.sw: You see... every mayor has to explore all the Islands of Madrigal. In the course of these travels we have to visit the Iblis Temple but... I am so afraid.
dialogsBegin.th: คืองี้นะ... นายกเทศมนตรีทุกคนต้องสำรวจเกาะต่างๆ ของ Madrigal ในระหว่างการเดินทางเหล่านี้เราต้องไปที่วิหาร Iblis แต่... ฉันกลัวมาก
dialogsBegin.tw: 你看……每位市長都必須巡訪瑪德利賈的所有島嶼。在這段旅程中，我們也得前往伊普里司神殿，但是……我真的很害怕。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn thấy đấy… mọi thị trưởng đều phải tìm hiểu và học hỏi về tất cả Islands of Madrigal. Trong những chuyến đi này, chúng tôi phải đến thăm Iblis Temple nhưng .. tôi rất sợ.

dialogsBegin.en: Would you please help me? I beg of you.
dialogsBegin.ar: Would you please help me? I beg of you.
dialogsBegin.br: Você poderia me ajudar? Imploro a você.
dialogsBegin.cns: 所以勒，我希望你能帮帮忙！
dialogsBegin.de: Würdest du mir bitte dabei helfen? Ich flehe dich an.
dialogsBegin.fi: Would you please help me? I beg of you.
dialogsBegin.fil: Puwede mo ba akong tulungan? Ipinagdarasal ko sa'yo.
dialogsBegin.fr: que je te demande ton aide. Je t’en supplie, ne dis pas non !
dialogsBegin.id: Maukah kamu membantuku? Aku mohon.
dialogsBegin.it: Would you please help me? I beg of you.
dialogsBegin.jp: そこで、あなたにお願いがあります。頼めますか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 절 도와주실래요? 이렇게 간곡히 부탁할게요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Would you please help me? I beg of you.
dialogsBegin.pl: Czy mógłbyś mi pomóc? Błagam Cię.
dialogsBegin.ru: У меня коленки трясутся, как подумаю о нем… Ты поможешь мне?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Por favor podrías ayudarme? Te lo suplico.
dialogsBegin.sw: Would you please help me? I beg of you.
dialogsBegin.th: ได้โปรดช่วยฉันได้ไหม ฉันขอร้อง...
dialogsBegin.tw: 所以勒，我希望你能幫幫忙！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có thể làm ơn giúp tôi được không? Tôi cầu xin bạn.

dialogsAccept.en: Thank you! Please, investigate the entrance of the temple for anything dangerous. Would you?
dialogsAccept.ar: Thank you! Please, investigate the entrance of the temple for anything dangerous. Would you?
dialogsAccept.br: Obrigado! Por favor, investigue a entrada do templo em busca de algum perigo. Você faria isso?
dialogsAccept.cns: 太感谢你了！帮我打探一下地牢入口附近，看看有没有什么不寻常的状况。
dialogsAccept.de: Vielen Dank! Würdest du dir bitte zunächst den Eingang vom Tempel ansehen? Sieh dich nach möglichen Bedrohungen um.
dialogsAccept.fi: Thank you! Please, investigate the entrance of the temple for anything dangerous. Would you?
dialogsAccept.fil: Salamat! Paki-imbestiga ang pasukan ng templo kung may anumang delikado. Pwede ba?
dialogsAccept.fr: Je t'en remercie ! S’il te plaît, vérifie que l’entrée du temple est sans danger. D’accord ?
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih! Tolong, selidiki pintu masuk kuil untuk mencari sesuatu yang berbahaya. Bersediakah kamu?
dialogsAccept.it: Thank you! Please, investigate the entrance of the temple for anything dangerous. Would you?
dialogsAccept.jp: 助かります。では、神殿の入口周辺を調べてきてください。何か危険がないか？このままでは調査を再開できません。
dialogsAccept.kr: 정말 감사해요! 그럼 신전 입구에 위험한 게 없는지 조사해 주시겠어요?
dialogsAccept.nl: Thank you! Please, investigate the entrance of the temple for anything dangerous. Would you?
dialogsAccept.pl: Dziękuję Ci! Proszę, zbadaj wejście do świątyni, czy nie ma czegoś niebezpiecznego. Mógłbyś?
dialogsAccept.ru: Спасибо! Я о многом не прошу - ты только осмотри Храм вокруг да около и разведай, не таится ли там какая опасность.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Gracias! Por favor, investiga la entrada del templo en busca de algo peligroso. ¿Lo harás?
dialogsAccept.sw: Thank you! Please, investigate the entrance of the temple for anything dangerous. Would you?
dialogsAccept.th: ขอบคุณ! โปรดตรวจสอบทางเข้าของวิหารว่ามีอันตรายอะไร คุณจะช่วยใช่ไหม ?
dialogsAccept.tw: 太感謝你了！幫我打探一下神殿入口附近，看看有沒有什麼不尋常的狀況。
dialogsAccept.vi: Cảm ơn bạn! Vui lòng điều tra lối vào của ngôi đền xem có gì nguy hiểm không. Bạn có muốn không?

dialogsDecline.en: I cannot force you to help me if you are busy. But maybe, when you have the time, you could come back and help me.
dialogsDecline.ar: I cannot force you to help me if you are busy. But maybe, when you have the time, you could come back and help me.
dialogsDecline.br: Eu não posso forçá-lo a me ajudar se você estiver ocupado. Mas talvez, quando tiver tempo, você possa voltar e me ajudar.
dialogsDecline.cns: 你有急事的话那就算了，不过，我还是希望你能帮这个忙。
dialogsDecline.de: Ich kann dich nicht zwingen mir zu helfen, wenn du gerade beschäftigt bist.. Aber könntest du mir bitte helfen, wenn du Zeit hast?
dialogsDecline.fi: I cannot force you to help me if you are busy. But maybe, when you have the time, you could come back and help me.
dialogsDecline.fil: Hindi kita mapipilitang tumulong kung abala ka. Pero baka kapag may oras ka, puwede ka pang bumalik at tumulong sa'kin.
dialogsDecline.fr: Je sais que tu es très occupé, mais pourrais-tu trouver un peu de temps pour m’aider ?
dialogsDecline.id: Aku tidak bisa memaksamu untuk membantuku jika kamu sedang sibuk. Tapi mungkin, ketika kamu punya waktu, kamu bisa kembali dan membantuku.
dialogsDecline.it: I cannot force you to help me if you are busy. But maybe, when you have the time, you could come back and help me.
dialogsDecline.jp: そうですか……残念です。調査に協力していただけるようになったら、また来てくださいね。
dialogsDecline.kr: 바쁘시다면 억지로 부탁할 수는 없지만… 혹시 시간이 되실 때 다시 돌아와서 도와주시겠어요?
dialogsDecline.nl: I cannot force you to help me if you are busy. But maybe, when you have the time, you could come back and help me.
dialogsDecline.pl: Nie mogę cię zmusić do pomocy, jeśli jesteś zajęty. Ale może, kiedy będziesz miał czas, mógłbyś wrócić i mi pomóc.
dialogsDecline.ru: Ну что же, не силой ведь мне тащить тебя к Храму Ужосса… Но ты все же подумай, вдруг решишься.
dialogsDecline.sp: No puedo obligarte a que me ayudes si estás ocupado. Pero tal vez, cuando tengas tiempo, podrías volver y ayudarme.
dialogsDecline.sw: I cannot force you to help me if you are busy. But maybe, when you have the time, you could come back and help me.
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันไม่สามารถบังคับให้คุณช่วยฉันได้หากคุณไม่ว่าง แต่บางทีเมื่อคุณมีเวลาคุณสามารถกลับมาและช่วยฉันได้
dialogsDecline.tw: 你有急事的話那就算了，不過，我還是希望你能幫這個忙。
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi không thể ép bạn giúp tôi nếu bạn bận. Nhưng có thể, khi nào có thời gian, bạn có thể quay lại giúp tôi.

dialogsComplete.en: Thank you, you did a great job.
dialogsComplete.ar: Thank you, you did a great job.
dialogsComplete.br: Obrigado, você fez um grande trabalho.
dialogsComplete.cns: 辛苦你了！看起来应该是我多心了……
dialogsComplete.de: Vielen Dank. Das hast du gut gemacht.
dialogsComplete.fi: Thank you, you did a great job.
dialogsComplete.fil: Salamat, mahusay ang ginawa mo.
dialogsComplete.fr: Ah, je suis rassuré. Il n’y a donc rien de dangereux là-bas ? Je t’en remercie, tu m’as rendu un énorme service !
dialogsComplete.id: Terima kasih, kamu melakukan perkerjaan dengan bagus.
dialogsComplete.it: Thank you, you did a great job.
dialogsComplete.jp: どうやら入口付近には危険はないようですね。ひとまずは安心しました。これで調査を再開できます。ありがとうございました。
dialogsComplete.kr: 잘 해주셨어요, 정말 감사합니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Thank you, you did a great job.
dialogsComplete.pl: Dziękuję, wykonałeś świetną robotę.
dialogsComplete.ru: Вот спасибо!
dialogsComplete.sp: Gracias, has hecho un gran trabajo.
dialogsComplete.sw: Thank you, you did a great job.
dialogsComplete.th: ขอบคุณ คุณทำได้ดีทีเดียวเลยนะ
dialogsComplete.tw: 辛苦你了！看起來應該是我多心了……
dialogsComplete.vi: Xin cảm ơn, bạn đã làm tốt lắm

dialogsFail.br: É muito fácil localizar a entrada do templo no Deserto da Fantasia.
dialogsFail.cns: 地牢位于梦幻沙漠，应该很容易找到的！

dialogsFail.fi: It is very easy to find the entrance of the temple in Fantasy Desert.
dialogsFail.fil: Madali lang hanapin ang pasukan ng templo sa Fantasy Desert.
dialogsFail.fr: Il est très facile de trouver l’entrée du temple au Désert de l'imagination.
dialogsFail.id: Sangat mudah untuk menemukan pintu masuk kuil di Fantasy Desert.
dialogsFail.it: It is very easy to find the entrance of the temple in Fantasy Desert.
dialogsFail.jp: イブリス神殿はセイントモーニングの南にある夢幻の砂漠に現れました。夢幻の砂漠に行けば、すぐに見つけられるでしょう。
dialogsFail.kr: 몽환의 사막에 도착하면 신전 입구 찾기는 어렵지 않을 거예요.
dialogsFail.nl: It is very easy to find the entrance of the temple in Fantasy Desert.
dialogsFail.pl: Wejście do świątyni w Fantasy Desert jest bardzo łatwe.
dialogsFail.ru: Храм стоит посреди пустыни, его издалека видно.
dialogsFail.sp: Es muy fácil encontrar la entrada del templo en el Desierto Fantasía.
dialogsFail.sw: It is very easy to find the entrance of the temple in Fantasy Desert.
dialogsFail.th: การหาทางเข้าวิหารใน Fantasy Desert เป็นเรื่องง่ายมาก
dialogsFail.tw: 神殿位於夢幻沙漠，應該很容易找到的！
dialogsFail.vi: Rất dễ dàng tìm thấy lối vào của ngôi đền trong Sa mạc Fantasy.

dialogsBegin.en: Kalin needs you to collect Cardrin to make delicious sauce.
dialogsBegin.ar: Kalin needs you to collect Cardrin to make delicious sauce.
dialogsBegin.br: Kalin precisa que você colete Cardrin para preparar o molho delicioso.
dialogsBegin.cns: 卡琳为了制作最美味的螳螂调味料，特别请委托中心收集磨刀石。请问您要接受委托吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Kathrin benötigt Cardrin um Remantororo Sauce herzustellen. Nimmst du den Auftrag an?
dialogsBegin.fi: Kalin needs you to collect Cardrin to make delicious sauce.
dialogsBegin.fil: Kailangan ni Kalin na kolektahin mo ang Cardrin para makagawa ng masarap na sauce.
dialogsBegin.fr:
Kalin recherche des Cardrins pour la création de la source de Remantororo.
Acceptes-tu cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Kalin membutuhkanmu untuk mengumpulkan Cardrin untuk membuat Delicious Sauce.
dialogsBegin.it: Kalin needs you to collect Cardrin to make delicious sauce.
dialogsBegin.jp: フードショップのカリンからの依頼です。秘伝のソース「レッドマンティストロロ」を作るために＜みがき石＞が必要とのことです。依頼を受けますか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 카린이 맛있는 소스를 만들기 위해 카드린을 구해 달라고 부탁합니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Kalin needs you to collect Cardrin to make delicious sauce.
dialogsBegin.pl: Kalin needs you to collect Cardrin to make delicious sauce.
dialogsBegin.ru: Так-так… 'Калину нужны шипы красных богомолов для острого соуса.' Возьмешься их добыть?
dialogsBegin.sp: Kalin necesita Cardrins para hacer una deliciosa salsa.
dialogsBegin.sw: Kalin needs you to collect Cardrin to make delicious sauce.
dialogsBegin.th: Kalin ต้องการให้คุณรวบรวม Cardrin เพื่อทำซอสแสนอร่อย
dialogsBegin.tw: 卡琳為了製作最美味的螳螂調味料，特別請委託中心收集磨刃石。請問你要接受委託嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Kalin cần bạn thu thập Cardrin để làm nước sốt ngon.

description.en: Almani asked for Gorrudas to be exterminated. They are an imminent threat! Please could you kill 15 of them?
description.ar: Almani asked for Gorrudas to be exterminated. They are an imminent threat! Please could you kill 15 of them?
description.br: Almani pediu que Gorrudas fossem exterminados. Eles são uma ameaça iminente! Por favor, você poderia matar 15 deles?
description.cns: 亚尔玛尼要求消灭魔翼龙。它们是一个迫在眉睫的威胁! 请你杀掉15只魔翼龙好吗？
description.de: Almani forderte die Ausrottung der Gorrudas. Sie sind eine unmittelbare Bedrohung! Kannst du bitte 15 von ihnen töten?
description.fi: Almani asked for Gorrudas to be exterminated. They are an imminent threat! Please could you kill 15 of them?
description.fil: Hiniling ni Almani na lipulin ang mga Gorruda. Nanganganib sila! Puwede mo bang patayin ang 15 sa kanila?
description.fr: Almani a besoin d'aide pour exterminer des Gorrudas. C'est une menace imminente ! Peux-tu en tuer 15 ?
description.id: Almani meminta agar Gorrudas dimusnahkan. Mereka adalah ancaman! Bisakah kamu menghabisi 15 dari mereka?
description.it: Almani asked for Gorrudas to be exterminated. They are an imminent threat! Please could you kill 15 of them?
description.jp: アルマーニから、＜ゴルーダ＞の討伐依頼です。このモンスターは危険なモンスターだとのことです。お願いです、15体討伐してきていただけませんか？
description.kr: 알마니가 고루다를 없애 달라고 부탁했어요. 이대로 두면 큰일 날지도 몰라요! 고루다 15마리만 잡아주실 수 있나요?
description.nl: Almani asked for Gorrudas to be exterminated. They are an imminent threat! Please could you kill 15 of them?
description.pl: Almani asked for Gorrudas to be exterminated. They are an imminent threat! Please could you kill 15 of them?
description.ru: Almani asked for Gorrudas to be exterminated. They are an imminent threat! Please could you kill 15 of them?
description.sp: Almani ha pedido que se extermine a los Gorrudas. ¡Son una amenaza inminente! Por favor, ¿podrías deshacerte de 15 de ellos?
description.sw: Almani asked for Gorrudas to be exterminated. They are an imminent threat! Please could you kill 15 of them?
description.th: Almani ขอให้ Gorrudas ถูกกำจัด พวกมันเป็นภัยคุกคามที่ใกล้เข้ามา! คุณช่วยฆ่าพวกมัน 15 ตัวได้ไหม
description.tw: 阿爾瑪尼要求清剿格魯達。牠們已是迫在眉睫的威脅！你能幫忙擊殺 15 隻嗎？
description.vi: Almani yêu cầu tiêu diệt Gorrudas. Chúng là một mối đe dọa sắp xảy ra! Làm ơn, bạn có thể giết 15 trong số chúng không?

dialogsBegin.en: Well... Not a bad deal... Can you collect 20 Blood Trillipy Shells and defeat a Mutant Keakoon Worker?
dialogsBegin.ar: Well... Not a bad deal... Can you collect 20 Blood Trillipy Shells and defeat a Mutant Keakoon Worker?
dialogsBegin.br: Bem... Não é um mau negócio... Você poderia coletar 20 Conchas de Trillipy Sangrenta e derrotar um Trabalhador Keakoon Mutante?
dialogsBegin.cns: 嗯...不错的交易...你能在噬血蜥蜴上收集 20 个战利品吗？然后再击杀1个奇昆模范劳工。
dialogsBegin.de: Nun... keine schlechter Handel... Kannst du für mich bitte 20 Teile von den Hazardous Blood Trilipy sammeln und einen Mutant Keakoon Worker besiegen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Well... Not a bad deal... Can you collect 20 Blood Trillipy Shells and defeat a Mutant Keakoon Worker?
dialogsBegin.fil: Hmm... Hindi masamang kasunduan... Kaya mo bang mag-ipon ng 20 Blood Trillipy Shells at patayin ang isang Mutant Keakoon Worker?
dialogsBegin.fr: Bon... Pas mal hic... Tu peux aller récupérer 20 butins sur les Ouvriers Keakoon Mutants ?
dialogsBegin.id: Yah... Bukan kesepakatan yang buruk... Bisakah Anda mengumpulkan 20 Blood Trillipy Shells dan mengalahkan Mutant Keakoon Worker?
dialogsBegin.it: Well... Not a bad deal... Can you collect 20 Blood Trillipy Shells and defeat a Mutant Keakoon Worker?
dialogsBegin.jp: まあ... 悪くはないが...。へジャード血のトリルピ20個を手に入れることができないだろうか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 음... 나쁘지 않은 조건인데... 블러드 트릴리피 껍데기 20개를 수집하고, 변종 키쿤 일꾼을 처치해 주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Well... Not a bad deal... Can you collect 20 Blood Trillipy Shells and defeat a Mutant Keakoon Worker?
dialogsBegin.pl: Cóż... Niezły interes... Czy zdobędziesz 20 łupów z Hazardous Blood Trilipy i pokonasz Mutant Keakoon Worker?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хм… Недурная сделка… Соберёшь 20 панцирей кровавых хватоглотов и одолеешь Мутировавшего рабочего-свинa?
dialogsBegin.sp: Bueno... No es un mal trato... ¿Podrías reunir 20 Conchas de Trillipy Sangriento y derrotar a un Trabajador Keakoon Mutante?
dialogsBegin.sw: Well... Not a bad deal... Can you collect 20 Blood Trillipy Shells and defeat a Mutant Keakoon Worker?
dialogsBegin.th: ก็นะ..ข้อตกลงดูไม่แย่เกินไป...คุณช่วยไปเอา 20 Blood Trillipy Shells แล้วก็กำจัด Mutant Keakoon Worker ให้ทีสิได้ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 嗯……不錯的交易……你能在危險的凶惡噬血蜈蚣上獲得 20 個戰利品嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Chà... Một thỏa thuận không tồi... Bạn có thể thu thập 20 Blood Trillipy Shells và đánh bại Mutant Keakoon Worker không?

dialogsAccept.it: In that case...Hic, good luck.
dialogsAccept.jp: ...。その場合は..ヒック！頑張ってくれ...。

dialogsAccept.nl: In that case...Hic, good luck.

description.cns: 地牢里应该留有幻魔依普利的遗物，听说他有留下一本幻魔依普利启示录的拓本，请找回来给我！
description.de: Es gibt eine Kopie der Ivillisn Offenbarung im Tempel. Bitte bring mir die Rubbed Copy of Ivillis Revelation.
description.fi: There is a copy of the Iblis Revelation in the Iblis Temple. Bring a rubbed copy of it.
description.fil: May kopya ng Iblis Revelation sa Iblis Temple. Dalhin mo ang kiniskis na kopya nito.
description.fr: Trouver la Copie volé à l'intérieur du temple
description.id: Ada salinan Iblis Revelation di Iblis Temple. Bawa salinan itu.
description.it: There is a copy of the Iblis Revelation in the Iblis Temple. Bring a rubbed copy of it.
description.jp: 神殿内にあるという黙示録の写本を探して、持ってきましょう
description.kr: 이블리스 신전에 있는 이블리스의 계시록의 사본이 있습니다. 탁본을 가져다주세요.
description.nl: There is a copy of the Iblis Revelation in the Iblis Temple. Bring a rubbed copy of it.
description.pl: W świątyni Iblis znajduje się kopia Objawienia Iblis. Przynieś przetartą kopię.
description.ru: Нужно снять копию с таблички Откровения Ужосса и принести ее мэру города Санто.
description.sp: Hay una copia de la Revelación de Iblis en el Templo de Iblis. Trae una copia calcada.

description.th: มีสำเนาเพื่อเปิดเผยของ Iblis ในวัด Iblis นำสำเนาออกมา
description.tw: 伊普里司神殿裡應該留有伊普里司的遺物，聽說他有留下一本伊普里司啟示錄的拓本，請找回來給我！
description.vi: Có một bản sao của Khải Huyền Iblis trong Ngôi đền Iblis. Hãy mang theo một bản sao của nó.

dialogsBegin.en: Oh... Back so soon? I am glad you are back but I am still so worried.
dialogsBegin.ar: Oh... Back so soon? I am glad you are back but I am still so worried.
dialogsBegin.br: Oh... Já está de volta? Fico contente com a sua volta, porém ainda estou preocupada.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我看起来脸色很差？因为整个事情并没有真正了结……
dialogsBegin.de: Oh, schon zurück? Das freut mich, aber ich bin noch immer besorgt.
dialogsBegin.fi: Oh... Back so soon? I am glad you are back but I am still so worried.
dialogsBegin.fil: Ah... Bumalik ka na agad? Natutuwa akong bumalik ka pero nag-aalala pa rin ako.
dialogsBegin.fr: C’est sympa de te revoir ! Quoi ? J’ai toujours l’air inquiet ? Hmm, oui, j’avoue que je le suis…
dialogsBegin.id: Oh.. Kembali begitu cepat? Aku senang kamu sudah kembali tetapi aku masih sangat khawatir.
dialogsBegin.it: Oh... Back so soon? I am glad you are back but I am still so worried.
dialogsBegin.jp: え？顔色が悪い？…ええ、実はイブリス神殿の件で、まだはっきりしない事がありまして……。
dialogsBegin.kr: 오... 이렇게 빨리 돌아오셨어요? 돌아오신 건 기쁘지만, 제 걱정은 여전하답니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Oh... Back so soon? I am glad you are back but I am still so worried.
dialogsBegin.pl: Och... Wróciłeś tak szybko? Cieszę się, że wróciłeś, ale wciąż się martwię.
dialogsBegin.ru: О… Так скоро вернулся? Я рад, что ты здесь, но всё равно беспокоюсь.
dialogsBegin.sp: Oh... ¿Vuelves tan pronto? Me alegro de que hayas vuelto, pero todavía estoy muy preocupado.
dialogsBegin.sw: Oh... Back so soon? I am glad you are back but I am still so worried.
dialogsBegin.th: โอ้.. กลับมาเร็วจัง? ฉันดีใจที่คุณกลับมา แต่ฉันก็ยังคงเป็นห่วง
dialogsBegin.tw: 喔……這麼快就回來了？你平安回來我很高興，但我還是非常擔心。
dialogsBegin.vi: Oh ..Trở lại nhanh như vậy sao? Tôi rất vui vì bạn đã trở lại nhưng tôi vẫn còn rất lo lắng.

dialogsBegin.en: I guess I am still worrying about the Iblis Temple. I know you said that there is nothing to worry about but I still have a bad feeling about that place.
dialogsBegin.ar: I guess I am still worrying about the Iblis Temple. I know you said that there is nothing to worry about but I still have a bad feeling about that place.
dialogsBegin.br: Acho que ainda estou preocupada com o Templo Iblis. Sei que você disse que não há nada com que se preocupar, mas ainda estou com um pressentimento ruim a respeito daquele lugar.
dialogsBegin.cns: 没错！就是幻魔依普利，听说又出些状况！！
dialogsBegin.de: Ich schätze, ich bin noch immer wegen dem Ivillis Tempel besorgt. Ich weiß, du sagtest es sei ungefährlich. Aber ich habe immernoch ein schlechtes Gefühl, was diesen Ort angeht.
dialogsBegin.fi: I guess I am still worrying about the Iblis Temple. I know you said that there is nothing to worry about but I still have a bad feeling about that place.
dialogsBegin.fil: Siguro patuloy akong nag-aalala tungkol sa Iblis Temple. Alam kong sinabi mong walang dapat ikabahala pero may masamang kutob pa rin ako tungkol sa lugar na iyon.
dialogsBegin.fr: Oui, c’est exact. Je suis inquiet au sujet du Temple d’Ivillis. Bien que tu m’aies assuré qu’il n'y a aucun danger près de l’entrée, je ne me sens pas rassuré…
dialogsBegin.id: Kurasa aku masih mengkhawatirkan the Iblis Temple. Aku tahu kamu mengatakan bahwa tidak ada yang perlu dikhawatirkan tetapi aku masih memiliki firasat buruk tentang tempat itu.
dialogsBegin.it: I guess I am still worrying about the Iblis Temple. I know you said that there is nothing to worry about but I still have a bad feeling about that place.
dialogsBegin.jp: 今のところ、特に危険なことは起きていませんが、神殿から昇った黒い雲によって世界が覆いつくされるという悪夢に、最近市民が悩まされているのです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 아직도 이블리스 신전이 마음에 걸려요. 걱정할 필요 없다고 말씀해주셨지만, 왠지 불길한 느낌이 가시질 않네요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I guess I am still worrying about the Iblis Temple. I know you said that there is nothing to worry about but I still have a bad feeling about that place.
dialogsBegin.pl: Myślę, że nadal martwię się o Świątynię Iblis. Wiem, że powiedziałeś, że nie ma się czym martwić, ale nadal mam złe przeczucia co do tego miejsca.
dialogsBegin.ru: Я привык доверять предчувствиям, а они у меня на этот раз ох какие нехорошие.
dialogsBegin.sp: Supongo que todavía estoy preocupado por el Templo de Iblis. Sé que dijiste que no hay nada de qué preocuparse, pero todavía tengo un mal presentimiento sobre ese lugar.
dialogsBegin.sw: I guess I am still worrying about the Iblis Temple. I know you said that there is nothing to worry about but I still have a bad feeling about that place.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันเดาฉันยังคงกังวลเกี่ยวกับวัด Iblis ฉันรู้ว่าคุณบอกว่าไม่มีอะไรต้องเป็นห่วง แต่ฉันก็ยังรู้สึกไม่ดีเกี่ยวกับสถานที่แห่งนั้นอยู่ดี
dialogsBegin.tw: 我想我還是在擔心伊普里司神殿。我知道你說過沒什麼好擔心的，但我對那個地方仍有不祥的預感。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đoán tôi vẫn đang lo lắng về Ngôi đền Iblis. Tôi biết bạn đã nói rằng không có gì phải lo lắng nhưng tôi vẫn có cảm giác không tốt về nơi đó.

dialogsBegin.en: Would you please help me once more? I will not be able to rest until I know for sure…
dialogsBegin.ar: Would you please help me once more? I will not be able to rest until I know for sure…
dialogsBegin.br: Você poderia me ajudar mais uma vez? Não poderei descansar até ter certeza…
dialogsBegin.cns: 各种谣言在市民间流传着，你一定要再帮帮我才行！
dialogsBegin.de: Würdest du mir erneut helfen? Ich werde nicht in Ruhe schlafen können, bis ich nicht ganz sicher bin.
dialogsBegin.fi: Would you please help me once more? I will not be able to rest until I know for sure…
dialogsBegin.fil: Puwede mo ba akong tulungan muli? Hindi ako makakapagpahinga hangga't hindi ako sigurado…
dialogsBegin.fr: … je ne pense pas que l’endroit soit sûr. C’est tellement affreux, s’il te plaît, aide-moi encore !
dialogsBegin.id: Maukah kamu membantuku sekali lagi? Aku tidak akan bisa beristirahat sampai aku tahu pasti ...
dialogsBegin.it: Would you please help me once more? I will not be able to rest until I know for sure…
dialogsBegin.jp: 私にはそれが、何か危険な予兆であるように思えてなりません。どうか、もう一度調査に協力していただけないでしょうか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 한 번만 더 도와주실 수 있나요? 확신이 들기 전까진 마음이 놓이지 않아요...
dialogsBegin.nl: Would you please help me once more? I will not be able to rest until I know for sure…
dialogsBegin.pl: Czy mógłbyś mi jeszcze raz pomóc? Nie będę mógł odpocząć, dopóki nie będę wiedział na pewno…
dialogsBegin.ru: Придется еще раз попросить тебя о помощи, иначе я в это зловещее место ни ногой!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Podrías ayudarme una vez más? No podré descansar hasta estar seguro...
dialogsBegin.sw: Would you please help me once more? I will not be able to rest until I know for sure…
dialogsBegin.th: ช่วยฉันอีกได้ไหม? ฉันจะไม่สามารถพักผ่อนได้จนกว่าฉันจะมั่นใจ
dialogsBegin.tw: 各種謠言在市民間流傳著，你一定要再幫幫我才行！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn vui lòng giúp tôi một lần nữa được không? Tôi sẽ không thể nghỉ ngơi cho đến khi tôi biết chắc chắn…

dialogsAccept.en: I heard that there is a copy of the Iblis Revelation in the temple. Please bring me a rubbed copy of it, I need to see what it says.
dialogsAccept.ar: I heard that there is a copy of the Iblis Revelation in the temple. Please bring me a rubbed copy of it, I need to see what it says.
dialogsAccept.br: Soube que existe uma cópia da Revelação de Iblis no templo. Por favor, traga-me uma cópia. Preciso verificar o que diz na Revelação.
dialogsAccept.cns: 地牢里应该留有幻魔依普利的遗物，听说他有留下一本幻魔依普利启示录的拓本，能找找看吗？
dialogsAccept.de: Ich habe gehört, es gibt eine Kopie der Ivillis Offenbarung im Tempel.Bitte bring sie mir. Ich muss wissen, was darin geschrieben steht.
dialogsAccept.fi: I heard that there is a copy of the Iblis Revelation in the temple. Please bring me a rubbed copy of it, I need to see what it says.
dialogsAccept.fil: Narinig kong may kopya ng Iblis Revelation sa templo. Pakidala sa'kin ang isang kiniskisang kopya nito, kailangan kong makita kung ano ang sinasabi nito.
dialogsAccept.fr: J’ai entendu dire qu’il y a une Révélation d'Ivillis à l'intérieur du temple. S’il te plaît, apporte-moi une Copie volée de celle-ci. Je voudrais vraiment la lire.
dialogsAccept.id: Aku mendengar bahwa ada salinan Iblis Revelation di kuil. Tolong bawakan aku salinannya, aku perlu melihat apa yang dikatakannya.
dialogsAccept.it: I heard that there is a copy of the Iblis Revelation in the temple. Please bring me a rubbed copy of it, I need to see what it says.
dialogsAccept.jp: 神殿内にはイブリスが記した＜黙示録の写本＞が収められていると伝えられています。ぜひ、探してきてください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 신전 안에 이블리스 계시록 사본이라는 게 있다고 해요. 그 계시록의 내용을 보고 싶어요. 탁본을 한 부 가져다주실 수 있나요?
dialogsAccept.nl: I heard that there is a copy of the Iblis Revelation in the temple. Please bring me a rubbed copy of it, I need to see what it says.
dialogsAccept.pl: Słyszałem, że w świątyni znajduje się kopia Objawienia Iblis. Proszę o przyniesienie mi przetartej kopii, muszę zobaczyć, co jest napisane.
dialogsAccept.ru: Говорят, что в Храме находится табличка с Откровением Ужосса. Сними с нее копию и принеси мне. Договорились?
dialogsAccept.sp: Escuché que hay una copia de la Revelación de Iblis en el templo. Por favor, tráeme una copia calcada, necesito ver lo que dice.
dialogsAccept.sw: I heard that there is a copy of the Iblis Revelation in the temple. Please bring me a rubbed copy of it, I need to see what it says.
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันได้ยินมาว่ามีพระคัมภีร์ Iblis อยู่ในพระวิหาร กรุณานำสำเนามา ฉันต้องดูว่ามีข้อความอะไรบ้าง
dialogsAccept.tw: 神殿裡應該留有伊普里司的遺物，聽說他有留下一本伊普里司啟示錄的拓本，能找找看嗎？
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi nghe nói rằng có một bản sao của Khải Huyền Iblis trong đền thờ. Vui lòng mang cho tôi một bản sao của nó, tôi cần xem nó nói gì.

dialogsDecline.ar: ...but I... I... need your help…

dialogsDecline.cns: (快要哭出来的样子)我……我………

dialogsComplete.en: This… this is more shocking than I could have imagined. Bubble please protect us.
dialogsComplete.ar: This… this is more shocking than I could have imagined. Bubble please protect us.
dialogsComplete.br: Isto… isto é mais chocante do que eu poderia ter imaginado. Bubble, por favor nos proteja.
dialogsComplete.cns: (在得知伊普里司启示录拓本的内容后)想不到竟然会发生这样的事情… 该怎么办啊？！事情比想像的要严重许多！
dialogsComplete.de: Das... das ist schockierender, als ich es mir je hätte vorstellen können. Oh Bubble, bitte schütze uns...
dialogsComplete.fi: This… this is more shocking than I could have imagined. Bubble please protect us.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ito… ito ay mas nakakagulat kaysa inisip ko. Bubble, protektahan mo kami.
dialogsComplete.fr: (Après la lecture de la Copie volée) La situation est plus grave que ce que je pensais ! Oh mon Dieu !!!
dialogsComplete.id: Ini…ini lebih mengejutkan dari yang aku bayangkan. Bubble tolong lindungi kami.
dialogsComplete.it: This… this is more shocking than I could have imagined. Bubble please protect us.
dialogsComplete.jp: それが黙示録の写本ですね。ありがとうございます。確かに受け取りました。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이건… 이건 제가 상상했던 것보다 훨씬 충격적이네요. 버블이시여, 우리를 지켜주세요.
dialogsComplete.nl: This… this is more shocking than I could have imagined. Bubble please protect us.
dialogsComplete.pl: To… to jest bardziej szokujące, niż mogłem sobie wyobrazić. Bańko, proszę, chroń nas.
dialogsComplete.ru: Это… это ужаснее, чем я мог себе представить. Баббл, защити нас.
dialogsComplete.sp: Esto... esto es más impactante de lo que podría haber imaginado. Bubble protégenos por favor.
dialogsComplete.sw: This… this is more shocking than I could have imagined. Bubble please protect us.
dialogsComplete.th: นี่เป็นเรื่องที่น่าตกใจมาก และมันเกินกว่าที่ฉันจะนึกได้อีก โปรดปกป้องเรา
dialogsComplete.tw: 這……這比我想像的還要令人震驚。巴布樂，請保佑我們。
dialogsComplete.vi: Điều này… điều này gây sốc hơn tôi tưởng tượng. Bubble xin hãy bảo vệ chúng tôi.
