description.en: The High-Dwarpets live in the middle of the Leren Mountains in Flaris. Please go there and meet with them.
description.ar: The High-Dwarpets live in the middle of the Leren Mountains in Flaris. Please go there and meet with them.
description.br: Os Alto Dwarpets vivem no meio das Montanhas Leren, em Flaris. Por favor, vá lá e os encontre.
description.cns: 帕里的乐雅山脉中部地区，居住着高阶矮人族，去见他们吧!
description.de: Die High-Dwarpet leben in der Mitte des Leren Gebirges in Flaris. Bitte gehe dorthin und treffe dich mit ihnen.
description.fi: The High-Dwarpets live in the middle of the Leren Mountains in Flaris. Please go there and meet with them.
description.fil: The High-Dwarpets live in the middle of the Leren Mountains in Flaris. Please go there and meet with them.
description.fr: Parler du vol du portrait aux Grand Dwarpets vivant dans les montagnes centrales de Leren à Flaris
description.id: High-Dwarpets tinggal di tengah Leren Mountains di Flaris. Silakan pergi ke sana dan bertemu dengan mereka.
description.it: The High-Dwarpets live in the middle of the Leren Mountains in Flaris. Please go there and meet with them.
description.jp: フラリスのレルエン山脈中部に＜ハイドワーフの生息地＞がある。そこに行って、彼らから情報を聞こう。
description.kr: 하이-드워펫은 플라리스의 레르엔 산맥 중부에 살고 있습니다. 찾아가서 만나보세요.
description.nl: The High-Dwarpets live in the middle of the Leren Mountains in Flaris. Please go there and meet with them.
description.pl: The High-Dwarpets live in the middle of the Leren Mountains in Flaris. Please go there and meet with them.
description.ru: Нужно поговорить с высокими карликами в Леренских горках, во Фларинции.
description.sp: Los Alto-Enanos viven en el Centro de las Montañas Leren en Flaris. Por favor ves y encuéntralos.
description.sw: The High-Dwarpets live in the middle of the Leren Mountains in Flaris. Please go there and meet with them.
description.th: High-Dwarpets อาศัยอยู่กลางเทือกเขา Leren ใน Flaris โปรดไปที่นั่นและพบกับพวกเขา
description.tw: 布拉里斯的勒倫山脈中部地區，居住著海倚杜爾沛，去見他們吧！
description.vi: High-Dwarpets sống ở giữa Leren Mountains ở Flaris. Hãy đến đó và gặp họ.

dialogsBegin.en: I don't even like speaking of Rudvihil. He is disrespectful and his actions go against everything I stand for. You need to visit the High-Dwarpets in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.ar: I don't even like speaking of Rudvihil. He is disrespectful and his actions go against everything I stand for. You need to visit the High-Dwarpets in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.br: Eu não gosto de falar do Rudvihil, mas eu lhe direi como recuperar o retrato porque ele é muito valioso. Ouça, você sabe algo a respeito dos Alto Dwarpets?
dialogsBegin.cns: 如果是萝特泰斯干的，那我真的不想插手。但是那个画像是绝对不可以消失的，所以我来告诉你一个方法吧!
dialogsBegin.de: Ich möchte nicht mit Rudvihil in Verbindung gebracht werden, aber ich werde dir sagen, wie du das Portrait zurückbekommst. Denn es ist sehr wertvoll. Höre zu, kennst du High-Dwarpet?
dialogsBegin.fi: I don't even like speaking of Rudvihil. He is disrespectful and his actions go against everything I stand for. You need to visit the High-Dwarpets in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.fil: I don't even like speaking of Rudvihil. He is disrespectful and his actions go against everything I stand for. You need to visit the High-Dwarpets in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je ne veux pas être vu avec Rudvihil, mais je vais te dire comment récupérer le portrait... Ecoute, que sais-tu sur les Grand Dwarpets ?
dialogsBegin.id: Aku bahkan tidak suka berbicara tentang Rudvihil. Dia tidak sopan dan tindakannya bertentangan dengan semua yang aku perjuangkan. Kamu perlu mengunjungi High-Dwarpets di Flaris.
dialogsBegin.it: I don't even like speaking of Rudvihil. He is disrespectful and his actions go against everything I stand for. You need to visit the High-Dwarpets in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.jp: ルードウィヒが消えたと騒いでいる例の肖像画だが、あの肖像画は消えてしまうような物じゃない。そこで、探す方法を教えてあげよう。君、ハイドワーフを知ってるか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 루드비힐 이야기는 꺼내고 싶지도 않아요. 루드비힐은 무례하고, 저와는 정반대의 성격을 가진 사람이죠. 플라리스의 하이-드워펫을 찾아가 보세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I don't even like speaking of Rudvihil. He is disrespectful and his actions go against everything I stand for. You need to visit the High-Dwarpets in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.pl: I don't even like speaking of Rudvihil. He is disrespectful and his actions go against everything I stand for. You need to visit the High-Dwarpets in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.ru: Сотби… Он, конечно, человек жадный и неприятный, но раз попал в беду, надо его выручить. Думаю, тебе стоит поговорить с высокими карликами во Фларинции.
dialogsBegin.sp: Ni siquiera me gusta hablar de Rudvihil. Siempre falta el respeto y sus acciones van en contra de todo lo que defiendo. Tienes que visitar a los Alto-Enanos en Flaris.
dialogsBegin.sw: I don't even like speaking of Rudvihil. He is disrespectful and his actions go against everything I stand for. You need to visit the High-Dwarpets in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันไม่ชอบพูดถึง Rudvihil เขาไม่ให้เกียรติและการกระทำของเขาตรงข้ามกับทุกอย่างที่ฉันเชื่ออยู่ คุณต้องแวะไปที่ High-Dwarpets ในเมือง Flaris
dialogsBegin.tw: 如果是蘿特泰斯幹的，那我真的不想插手。但是那個畫像是絕對不可以消失的，所以我來告訴你一個方法吧！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi thậm chí không thích nói về Rudvihil. Anh ấy thiếu tôn trọng và hành động của anh ấy đi ngược lại tất cả những gì tôi ủng hộ. Bạn cần đến thăm High-Dwarpets ở Flaris.

dialogsBegin.en: Oh, you've heard of them, then? Well, they may be able to help us. I've heard they have strange powers that may help us find the missing portrait.
dialogsBegin.ar: Oh, you've heard of them, then? Well, they may be able to help us. I've heard they have strange powers that may help us find the missing portrait.
dialogsBegin.br: Oh, você já ouviu falar deles, então? Bem, eles podem nos ajudar. Ouvi dizer que eles têm poderes estranhos que podem nos ajudar a encontrar o retrato perdido.
dialogsBegin.cns: 对!应该有见过一次面，因为之前到处寻问画像的事情，后来我有听到一个可以找到画像的方法。
dialogsBegin.de: Oh, du hast also von ihnen gehört? Nun, sie können uns vielleicht helfen. Ich habe gehört, dass sie seltsame Kräfte haben, die uns helfen könnten, das fehlende Porträt zu finden.
dialogsBegin.fi: Oh, you've heard of them, then? Well, they may be able to help us. I've heard they have strange powers that may help us find the missing portrait.
dialogsBegin.fil: Oh, you've heard of them, then? Well, they may be able to help us. I've heard they have strange powers that may help us find the missing portrait.
dialogsBegin.fr: Oui, tu les as sans doute déjà rencontrés... J'ai demandé à droite et à gauche à propos de la disparition du portrait et j'ai entendu une histoire qui pourrait nous dire comment le retrouver.
dialogsBegin.id: Oh, kalau begitu, kamu pernah mendengar tentang mereka? Yah, mereka mungkin bisa membantu kita. Kudengar mereka punya kekuatan aneh yang bisa membantu kita menemukan potret yang hilang.
dialogsBegin.it: Oh, you've heard of them, then? Well, they may be able to help us. I've heard they have strange powers that may help us find the missing portrait.
dialogsBegin.jp: そのハイドワーフには君も1回ぐらい会ったことがあるかもしれないな。あの肖像画が消えてしまったということを聞いていろいろ調べてみたんだが、その絵を見つける方法がわかったんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 아, 하이-드워펫에 대해 들어보신 적 있군요? 그들이 도와줄지도 몰라요. 사라진 초상화를 찾는 데 도움이 되는 능력이 있다고 하더라고요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Oh, you've heard of them, then? Well, they may be able to help us. I've heard they have strange powers that may help us find the missing portrait.
dialogsBegin.pl: Oh, you've heard of them, then? Well, they may be able to help us. I've heard they have strange powers that may help us find the missing portrait.
dialogsBegin.ru: Видишь ли, они не так просты, как кажутся. Я подозреваю, что карлики владеют особым искусством, или, если хочешь, магией…
dialogsBegin.sp: Oh, ¿has oído hablar de ellos, entonces? Bueno, ellos pueden ayudarnos. Escuché que tienen unos extraños poderes que nos pueden ayudar a encontrar el retrato perdido.
dialogsBegin.sw: Oh, you've heard of them, then? Well, they may be able to help us. I've heard they have strange powers that may help us find the missing portrait.
dialogsBegin.th: โอ้ คุณเคยได้ยินเรื่องพวกเขาแล้วเหรอ? ดีล่ะ พวกเขาอาจจะช่วยเราได้ ฉันได้ยินมาว่าพวกเขามีพลังแปลกๆ ที่อาจช่วยให้เราหาภาพที่หายไปได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 哦，那你聽說過他們嗎？好吧，他們也許可以幫助我們，我聽說他們有奇怪的力量可以幫助我們找到丟失的畫像。
dialogsBegin.vi: Ồ, vậy bạn đã nghe nói về họ? Chà, họ có thể giúp chúng tôi. Tôi nghe nói họ có sức mạnh kỳ lạ có thể giúp chúng tôi tìm thấy bức chân dung bị mất tích.

dialogsBegin.en: Those High-Dwarpets collect ancient books and other rare treasures. How is it they can collect these things more easily than others?
dialogsBegin.ar: Those High-Dwarpets collect ancient books and other rare treasures. How is it they can collect these things more easily than others?
dialogsBegin.br: Os Alto Dwarpets estão coletando livros antigos e outros tesouros raros. Aqui está a chave para resolver este enigma. Como eles podem coletar estes itens com mais facilidade que outras pessoas?
dialogsBegin.cns: 这些高阶矮人族们会搜集一些古老的书籍和稀有的宝物。真不知道他们是怎么搜集的，他们找宝物可比普通人容易太多了！
dialogsBegin.de: Diese High-Dwarpets sammeln antike Bücher und wertvolle Schätze. Hier ist der Schlüssel um das Rätsel zu lösen. Wie können sie diese Dinge einfacher sammeln als andere?
dialogsBegin.fi: Those High-Dwarpets collect ancient books and other rare treasures. How is it they can collect these things more easily than others?
dialogsBegin.fil: Those High-Dwarpets collect ancient books and other rare treasures. How is it they can collect these things more easily than others?
dialogsBegin.fr: Les Grand Dwarpets collectionnent des livres anciens et autres objets rares. Comment penses-tu qu'ils arrivent à trouver tous ces trésors ?
dialogsBegin.id: Para High-Dwarpets itu mengumpulkan buku-buku kuno dan harta karun langka lainnya. Bagaimana mereka bisa mengumpulkan barang-barang ini lebih mudah daripada yang lain?
dialogsBegin.it: Those High-Dwarpets collect ancient books and other rare treasures. How is it they can collect these things more easily than others?
dialogsBegin.jp: ハイドワーフたちは古代の伝承を記した貴重な書物や、希少な宝物をたくさん集めている。しかし何故、彼らはこういった希少な物を簡単に集めることができるかわかるかい？
dialogsBegin.kr: 하이-드워펫들은 고서와 진귀한 보물을 수집하곤 해요. 어떻게 그런 것들을 쉽게 찾아내는지, 궁금하지 않으세요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Those High-Dwarpets collect ancient books and other rare treasures. How is it they can collect these things more easily than others?
dialogsBegin.pl: Those High-Dwarpets collect ancient books and other rare treasures. How is it they can collect these things more easily than others?
dialogsBegin.ru: Очень уж они охочи до золота и всяких диковин. А что самое интересное - им удается находить эти вещицы быстрее коллекционеров-людей!
dialogsBegin.sp: Esos Alto-Enanos coleccionan libros antiguos y otros tesoros raros. ¿Cómo es que ellos pueden encontrar estas cosas con más facilidad que otros?
dialogsBegin.sw: Those High-Dwarpets collect ancient books and other rare treasures. How is it they can collect these things more easily than others?
dialogsBegin.th: High-Dwarpets เหล่านั้นรวบรวมหนังสือโบราณและสมบัติล้ำค่าอื่นๆ พวกเขาสามารถรวบรวมสิ่งเหล่านี้ได้ง่ายกว่าคนอื่นๆ ได้ยังไง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 這些海倚杜爾沛都會搜集一些稀有的寶物，再哪邊應該有一個鑰匙，真不知道他們是怎麼蒐集的！
dialogsBegin.vi: Những High-Dwarpets đó thu thập sách cổ và các kho báu quý hiếm khác. Làm thế nào mà họ có thể thu thập những thứ này dễ dàng hơn những thứ khác?

dialogsBegin.en: The answer? They are clairvoyant. This allows them to see and hear things that you and I cannot comprehend. I am certain they would be able to help.
dialogsBegin.ar: The answer? They are clairvoyant. This allows them to see and hear things that you and I cannot comprehend. I am certain they would be able to help.
dialogsBegin.br: Eles tem clarividência, habilidade que os permite descobrir onde os tesouros estão. Bem, pelo menos esse é o meu palpite...
dialogsBegin.cns: 后来我才想到，他们有一个千里眼，可以看到一些稀有的物品，
dialogsBegin.de: Sie können hellsehen, das ermöglicht ihnen die Schätze zu finden. Das ist meine Theorie.
dialogsBegin.fi: The answer? They are clairvoyant. This allows them to see and hear things that you and I cannot comprehend. I am certain they would be able to help.
dialogsBegin.fil: The answer? They are clairvoyant. This allows them to see and hear things that you and I cannot comprehend. I am certain they would be able to help.
dialogsBegin.fr: Ils doivent disposer d'une capacité qui leur permet de retrouver les trésors. Ce sont du moins mes déductions.
dialogsBegin.id: Jawabannya? Mereka adalah peramal. Ini memungkinkan mereka untuk melihat dan mendengar hal-hal yang kamu dan aku tidak dapat pahami. Aku yakin mereka dapat membantu.
dialogsBegin.it: The answer? They are clairvoyant. This allows them to see and hear things that you and I cannot comprehend. I am certain they would be able to help.
dialogsBegin.jp: 彼らは千里眼です。 彼らはあなたや私が理解できないことを見たり聞いたりすることができます。 私は彼らが助けることができると確信しているんだけどな。
dialogsBegin.kr: 사실 하이-드워펫들은 선견지명을 가지고 있다고 해요. 우리가 이해하지 못하는 무언가를 보고 듣는 능력 말이에요. 분명히 도움이 될 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: The answer? They are clairvoyant. This allows them to see and hear things that you and I cannot comprehend. I am certain they would be able to help.
dialogsBegin.pl: The answer? They are clairvoyant. This allows them to see and hear things that you and I cannot comprehend. I am certain they would be able to help.
dialogsBegin.ru: Почему? Я догадываюсь: они - ясновидцы. Они видят и слышат вещи, о которых мы с тобой понятия не имеем! Вот увидишь, если попросить их как следует, они узнают, где пропавший портрет!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿La respuesta? Son clarividentes. Esto les permite ver y escuchar cosas que ni tú ni yo podemos comprender. Estoy seguro de que podrían ayudar.
dialogsBegin.sw: The answer? They are clairvoyant. This allows them to see and hear things that you and I cannot comprehend. I am certain they would be able to help.
dialogsBegin.th: คำตอบงั้นเหรอ? พวกเขามีตาทิพย์ สิ่งนี้ช่วยให้พวกเขาเห็นและได้ยินสิ่งที่คุณและฉันไม่สามารถเข้าใจได้ ฉันแน่ใจว่าพวกเขาจะสามารถช่วยได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 後來我才想到，他們有一個千里眼，可以看到一些稀有的物品，
dialogsBegin.vi: Câu trả lời à? Họ có khả năng thấu thị. Điều này cho phép họ nhìn và nghe những điều mà bạn và tôi không thể hiểu được. Tôi chắc chắn họ sẽ có thể giúp đỡ.

dialogsBegin.en: Will you meet with them?
dialogsBegin.ar: Will you meet with them?
dialogsBegin.br: Porque você não os conheceu?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你去找找他们如何?
dialogsBegin.de: Warum bist du ihnen noch nicht begegnet?
dialogsBegin.fi: Will you meet with them?
dialogsBegin.fil: Will you meet with them?
dialogsBegin.fr: Pourquoi ne pas aller leur rendre visite pour en discuter ?
dialogsBegin.id: Apakah kamu akan bertemu dengan mereka?
dialogsBegin.it: Will you meet with them?
dialogsBegin.jp: 肖像画を探すならば、一度彼らに会ってみたらどうだ？何かヒントをくれるかもしれないぞ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 가서 만나 보시겠어요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Will you meet with them?
dialogsBegin.pl: Will you meet with them?
dialogsBegin.ru: Ну что, проверишь мою догадку?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Te reunirás con ellos?
dialogsBegin.sw: Will you meet with them?
dialogsBegin.th: คุณจะไปพบกับพวกเขาไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你去找找他們如何？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn sẽ gặp họ chứ?

dialogsAccept.en: Excellent. You know where they live, right? They live in the middle of the Leren Mountains in Flaris.
dialogsAccept.ar: Excellent. You know where they live, right? They live in the middle of the Leren Mountains in Flaris.
dialogsAccept.br: Excelente! Você sabe onde eles vivem, não sabe? Eles vivem no meio das Montanhas Leren, em Flaris. Por favor, vá lá e os encontre.
dialogsAccept.cns: 你应该知道他们在哪里吧?我在告诉你一下好了~他们居住在乐雅山脉中部地区，去那边见见他们吧!
dialogsAccept.de: Ausgezeichnet. Du weißt, wo sie leben, oder? Sie leben mitten im Leren-Gebirge in Flaris.
dialogsAccept.fi: Excellent. You know where they live, right? They live in the middle of the Leren Mountains in Flaris.
dialogsAccept.fil: Excellent. You know where they live, right? They live in the middle of the Leren Mountains in Flaris.
dialogsAccept.fr: Ok. Tu sais où ils habitent, non ? Ils vivent au centre des montagnes de Leren de Flaris. Je pense qu'ils pourront t'aider.
dialogsAccept.id: Bagus sekali. Kamu tahu di mana mereka tinggal, bukan? Mereka tinggal di tengah Leren Mountain di Flaris.
dialogsAccept.it: Excellent. You know where they live, right? They live in the middle of the Leren Mountains in Flaris.
dialogsAccept.jp: 彼らのいる場所はもう知ってるだろう？忘れてしまったなら、もう一度教えてあげよう。フラリスのレルエン山脈中部に、彼らの生息地がある。そこに行けば、彼らに会えるだろう。
dialogsAccept.kr: 좋아요. 어디에 사는지 알고 계시죠? 플라리스의 레르엔 산맥 중부에 살고 있어요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Excellent. You know where they live, right? They live in the middle of the Leren Mountains in Flaris.
dialogsAccept.pl: Excellent. You know where they live, right? They live in the middle of the Leren Mountains in Flaris.
dialogsAccept.ru: Отлично. Ты ведь знаешь, где они живут? У них небольшой лагерь в Леренских горках, во Фларинции.
dialogsAccept.sp: Excelente. Sabes dónde viven, ¿verdad? Viven en el Centro de las Montañas Leren en Flaris.
dialogsAccept.sw: Excellent. You know where they live, right? They live in the middle of the Leren Mountains in Flaris.
dialogsAccept.th: ยอดเยี่ยม คุณรู้ใช่ไหมว่าพวกเขาอยู่ที่ไหน? พวกเขาอาศัยอยู่กลางเทือกเขา Leren ใน Flaris
dialogsAccept.tw: 太厲害了！你知道他們住在哪裡，對吧？他們住在布拉里斯的勒倫山脈中部。
dialogsAccept.vi: Xuất sắc. Bạn biết họ sống ở đâu, phải không? Họ sống ở giữa Leren Mountains tại Flaris.

dialogsDecline.en: If you don't wish to help recover what is arguably one of the most valuable pieces of art in Madrigal, then that is your business. It's a shame.
dialogsDecline.ar: If you don't wish to help recover what is arguably one of the most valuable pieces of art in Madrigal, then that is your business. It's a shame.
dialogsDecline.br: Você não precisa fazê-lo se não quiser. Mas é uma pena...
dialogsDecline.cns: 不想做的话也没关系啦~萝特泰斯的表情应该够看了吧!
dialogsDecline.de: Du brauchst das nicht zu tun, wenn du nicht willst. Aber es ist eine große Schande dass ich das verärgerte Gesicht von Rudvihil nicht sehen kann. Puh~
dialogsDecline.fi: If you don't wish to help recover what is arguably one of the most valuable pieces of art in Madrigal, then that is your business. It's a shame.
dialogsDecline.fil: If you don't wish to help recover what is arguably one of the most valuable pieces of art in Madrigal, then that is your business. It's a shame.
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu n'es pas obligé de le faire si tu n'en as pas envie. Mais c'est dommage, je ne pourrai pas voir la tête que Rudvihil va faire.
dialogsDecline.id: Jika kamu tidak ingin membantu memulihkan salah satu karya seni paling berharga di Madrigal, maka itu adalah urusan kamu. Memalukan.
dialogsDecline.it: If you don't wish to help recover what is arguably one of the most valuable pieces of art in Madrigal, then that is your business. It's a shame.
dialogsDecline.jp: まあ、ルードヴィヒの依頼を受けないならそれでもいいと思うぜ。あの肖像画が消えてしまったのは大変残念なことだが、あの強欲なルードヴィヒの悔しがる顔も見ものだろうしな。ハハッ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 마드리갈에서 가장 가치 있는 예술 작품을 복원하는 데 도움을 주고 싶지 않으시다면, 어쩔 수 없죠. 안타깝네요.
dialogsDecline.nl: If you don't wish to help recover what is arguably one of the most valuable pieces of art in Madrigal, then that is your business. It's a shame.
dialogsDecline.pl: If you don't wish to help recover what is arguably one of the most valuable pieces of art in Madrigal, then that is your business. It's a shame.
dialogsDecline.ru: Ну, если тебе нет дела до судьбы бесценных шедевров, я не смею настаивать.
dialogsDecline.sp: Si no quieres ayudarme a recuperar lo que podría decirse que es una de las obras de arte más valiosas de Madrigal, es asunto tuyo. Es una pena.
dialogsDecline.sw: If you don't wish to help recover what is arguably one of the most valuable pieces of art in Madrigal, then that is your business. It's a shame.
dialogsDecline.th: หากคุณไม่คิดจะช่วยตามหาศิลปะที่แสนล้ำค่าชิ้นหนึ่งใน Madrigal นั่นมันก็เป็นเรื่องของคุณ น่าอายยิ่งนัก
dialogsDecline.tw: 不想做的話也沒關係啦~蘿特泰斯的表情應該夠看了吧！
dialogsDecline.vi: Nếu bạn không muốn giúp thu hồi một trong những tác phẩm nghệ thuật có giá trị nhất ở Madrigal, thì đó là việc của bạn. Thật là hổ thẹn.

dialogsComplete.en: A missing portrait you say? Of Radion? Yes, I have heard of it. I will do what I can to help. Please allow me to focus my thoughts for a moment. Hmmmm….
dialogsComplete.ar: A missing portrait you say? Of Radion? Yes, I have heard of it. I will do what I can to help. Please allow me to focus my thoughts for a moment. Hmmmm….
dialogsComplete.br: Um retrato perdido, você diz? De Radion? Sim, já ouvi falar. Farei o que puder para ajudar. Mas por favor, permita-me focar em meus pensamentos por um momento. Hmmmm….
dialogsComplete.cns: 嗯..是吗?如果是别的画像我就不插手了，既然是贤者的画像，我就不得不插手了，等我一下喔~
dialogsComplete.de: Ein fehlendes Porträt, sagst du? Von Radion? Ja, ich habe davon gehört. Ich werde tun was ich kann um zu helfen. Bitte erlaube mir, meine Gedanken einen Moment zu sammeln. Hmmmm....
dialogsComplete.fi: A missing portrait you say? Of Radion? Yes, I have heard of it. I will do what I can to help. Please allow me to focus my thoughts for a moment. Hmmmm….
dialogsComplete.fil: A missing portrait you say? Of Radion? Yes, I have heard of it. I will do what I can to help. Please allow me to focus my thoughts for a moment. Hmmmm….
dialogsComplete.fr: Hmm... Vraiment ? Ok. Je ferai de mon mieux s'il s'agit du portrait de Radéon. Attends un instant (fermant ses yeux et commençant une incantation) Ooomm. Oooommm.
dialogsComplete.id: Potret yang hilang katamu? Dari Radion? Ya, aku pernah mendengarnya. Aku akan melakukan apa yang aku bisa. Tolong izinkan aku untuk memfokuskan pikiran sejenak. Hmm….
dialogsComplete.it: A missing portrait you say? Of Radion? Yes, I have heard of it. I will do what I can to help. Please allow me to focus my thoughts for a moment. Hmmmm….
dialogsComplete.jp: そうか。他の絵ならまだしも＜大賢者＞ラディオン様の肖像画となら、探すのに協力しよう。精神を集中するから、ちょっと待っててくれ。　ん…。おや、何か見えてきたぞ…。
dialogsComplete.kr: 사라진 초상화라고요? 라디온의? 네, 들어본 적 있어요. 저도 힘닿는 데까지 도와드릴게요. 잠시만요. 생각을 집중해야 해서. 흐으음...
dialogsComplete.nl: A missing portrait you say? Of Radion? Yes, I have heard of it. I will do what I can to help. Please allow me to focus my thoughts for a moment. Hmmmm….
dialogsComplete.pl: A missing portrait you say? Of Radion? Yes, I have heard of it. I will do what I can to help. Please allow me to focus my thoughts for a moment. Hmmmm….
dialogsComplete.ru: Пропал портрет Энвидия? Великолепная картина! Я прекрасно ее помню. Минутку, дай сосредоточиться… Где же он… Не вижу… Тогда кто же…
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿Un retrato perdido dices? ¿De Radion? Sí, he oído hablar de eso. Haré lo que pueda para ayudar. Por favor, permíteme concentrar mis pensamientos un momento. Hmmmm…
dialogsComplete.sw: A missing portrait you say? Of Radion? Yes, I have heard of it. I will do what I can to help. Please allow me to focus my thoughts for a moment. Hmmmm….
dialogsComplete.th: คุณพูดว่าภาพที่หายไปงั้นหรือ? ของ Radion? ใช่ ฉันเคยได้ยินเรื่องนี้แล้ว ฉันจะทำสิ่งที่ฉันสามารถทำได้เพื่อช่วยเหลือ โปรดให้ฉันโฟกัสความคิดของฉันสักครู่ อืมมมมมม ...
dialogsComplete.tw: 你說缺少畫像？是的，我聽說過。我會盡我所能提供幫助。請允許我集中思緒片刻。嗯……
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn nói bức chân dung bị mất tích ư? Của Radion? Vâng, tôi đã nghe nói về nó. Tôi sẽ làm những gì có thể để giúp đỡ. Xin hãy cho phép tôi tập trung suy nghĩ của mình trong giây lát. Hừm….

dialogsComplete.en: I think I've found it. Yes, this has to be the one. Here, let me draw you a picture…
dialogsComplete.ar: I think I've found it. Yes, this has to be the one. Here, let me draw you a picture…
dialogsComplete.br: ... encontrei! Um momento... Leve este papel. Isso é tudo que posso fazer por você.
dialogsComplete.cns: 啊!对了!来把这个收下。
dialogsComplete.de: (Öffnet die Augen) Ich habe es! Moment.. (schreibt etwas auf das Papier) Da bitte. Das ist alles was ich für dich tun kann.
dialogsComplete.fi: I think I've found it. Yes, this has to be the one. Here, let me draw you a picture…
dialogsComplete.fil: I think I've found it. Yes, this has to be the one. Here, let me draw you a picture…
dialogsComplete.fr: (Ouvrant les yeux) Je l'ai trouvé ! Un instant. (écrivant quelque chose sur un papier). Voilà pour toi, c'est tout ce que je peux faire pour t'aider.
dialogsComplete.id: Aku pikir aku telah menemukannya. Ya, ini harus menjadi satu. Sini saya gambarkan…
dialogsComplete.it: I think I've found it. Yes, this has to be the one. Here, let me draw you a picture…
dialogsComplete.jp: よし、わかったぞ！ちょっと待ってくれ、書き留めておくから。ほら、これだ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 찾은 것 같아요. 네, 틀림없어요. 여기, 그림을 그려 드릴게요...
dialogsComplete.nl: I think I've found it. Yes, this has to be the one. Here, let me draw you a picture…
dialogsComplete.pl: I think I've found it. Yes, this has to be the one. Here, let me draw you a picture…
dialogsComplete.ru: Есть! Да, это он. Дай-ка нарисую…
dialogsComplete.sp: Creo que lo he encontrado. Sí, tiene que ser este. Deja que te haga un dibujo...
dialogsComplete.sw: I think I've found it. Yes, this has to be the one. Here, let me draw you a picture…
dialogsComplete.th: ฉันคิดว่าฉันพบแล้ว นี่คือสิ่งนี้สินะ มา ฉันจะวาดรูปให้คุณ...
dialogsComplete.tw: 我想我找到了。沒錯，一定就是這個。來，讓我畫給你看……
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi nghĩ rằng tôi đã tìm thấy nó. Vâng, ắt hẳn là nó rồi. Đây, hãy để tôi vẽ cho bạn một bức tranh…

dialogsComplete.en: I drew the face of the thieves who stole the portrait. This is all I can do for you.
dialogsComplete.ar: I drew the face of the thieves who stole the portrait. This is all I can do for you.
dialogsComplete.br: Eu desenhei o rosto dos ladrões que roubaram o retrato. É o melhor que posso fazer.
dialogsComplete.cns: 我把偷走画像的人特色写在上面了。
dialogsComplete.de: Ich habe das Gesicht der Diebe gezeichnet, die das Portrait stahlen. Das ist alles was ich tun kann.
dialogsComplete.fi: I drew the face of the thieves who stole the portrait. This is all I can do for you.
dialogsComplete.fil: I drew the face of the thieves who stole the portrait. This is all I can do for you.
dialogsComplete.fr: J'ai dessiné le visage de ceux qui ont volé le portrait. C'est le mieux que je puisse faire.
dialogsComplete.id: Aku menggambar wajah pencuri yang mencuri potret itu. Hanya ini yang bisa aku lakukan untukmu.
dialogsComplete.it: I drew the face of the thieves who stole the portrait. This is all I can do for you.
dialogsComplete.jp: このメモに描いた絵が、肖像画を持ち出した奴らの姿だよ。もっと詳しいことを教えてあげたいけど、オレの能力ではこれが限界だ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 초상화를 훔쳐간 도둑들의 몽타주에요. 제 능력으로는 이게 최선이네요.
dialogsComplete.nl: I drew the face of the thieves who stole the portrait. This is all I can do for you.
dialogsComplete.pl: I drew the face of the thieves who stole the portrait. This is all I can do for you.
dialogsComplete.ru: Вот. Держи. Так выглядит тот, кто украл портрет. Надеюсь, это тебе поможет.
dialogsComplete.sp: He dibujado la cara de los ladrones que robaron el retrato. Esto es todo lo que puedo hacer por ti.
dialogsComplete.sw: I drew the face of the thieves who stole the portrait. This is all I can do for you.
dialogsComplete.th: ฉันวาดใบหน้าของโจรที่ขโมยภาพ นี่คือทั้งหมดที่ฉันสามารถทำได้สำหรับคุณ
dialogsComplete.tw: 我把偷走畫像的人特色寫在上面了。
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi đã vẽ khuôn mặt của những tên trộm đã đánh cắp bức chân dung. Đây là tất cả những gì tôi có thể làm cho bạn.

dialogsFail.en: Now please go away. I can only stand humans for so long…
dialogsFail.ar: Now please go away. I can only stand humans for so long…
dialogsFail.br: Agora, vá embora. Só consigo aguentar humanos por um tempo...
dialogsFail.cns: 我不喜欢人类，所以快点离我远一点!滚开啦!
dialogsFail.de: Jetzt verschwinde! Ich mag keine Menschen. Geh! Komm niemals wieder!
dialogsFail.fi: Now please go away. I can only stand humans for so long…
dialogsFail.fil: Now please go away. I can only stand humans for so long…
dialogsFail.fr: Maintenant va-t-en ! Je n'aime pas les humains ! Pars, et ne t'avises pas de revenir !
dialogsFail.id: Sekarang silakan pergi. Aku hanya bisa menahan manusia begitu lama…
dialogsFail.it: Now please go away. I can only stand humans for so long…
dialogsFail.jp: ん？何だ？オレたちは人間が大嫌いなんだよ。用が済んだならさっさと帰りな。
dialogsFail.kr: 이제 가주세요. 인간이랑 오래 있으면 피곤하거든요...
dialogsFail.nl: Now please go away. I can only stand humans for so long…
dialogsFail.pl: Now please go away. I can only stand humans for so long…
dialogsFail.ru: А теперь, пожалуйста, уходи. Не прими на свой счет, но меня трясет от людей…
dialogsFail.sp: Por favor, vete ya. Solo puedo soportar a los humanos durante un rato...
dialogsFail.sw: Now please go away. I can only stand humans for so long…
dialogsFail.th: ตอนนี้ก็ออกไปซะ ฉันทนมนุษย์ได้ไม่นานหรอกนะ...
dialogsFail.tw: 我不喜歡人類，所以快點離我遠一點！滾開啦！
dialogsFail.vi: Bây giờ làm ơn đi đi. Tôi chịu đựng quá lâu rồi…

dialogsBegin.pl: The Dwarpet needs you to collect wheeshoes for their festival. Will you help?

dialogsBegin.vi: Dwarpet cần bạn thu thập wheeshoes cho lễ hội của họ. Bạn sẽ giúp chứ?

description.en: Collect a Time Lapse Flower which only blooms near the entrance to Mars Mine.

description.cns: 收集一种只在魔域密殿入口处开花的时空之花。
description.de: Sammle eine Time Lapse Flower, die nur in der Nähe des Eingangs zur Mars Mine blüht.
description.fi: Collect a Time Lapse Flower which only blooms near the entrance to Mars Mine.
description.fil: Collect a Time Lapse Flower which only blooms near the entrance to Mars Mine.

description.it: Collect a Time Lapse Flower which only blooms near the entrance to Mars Mine.

description.nl: Collect a Time Lapse Flower which only blooms near the entrance to Mars Mine.
description.pl: Collect a Time Lapse Flower which only blooms near the entrance to Mars Mine.
description.ru: Собрать Цветы времени у входа в Марсову шахту.
description.sp: Consigue la Flor de Lapso de Tiempo, la cual sólo florece cerca de la entrada a la Mina Mars.
description.sw: Collect a Time Lapse Flower which only blooms near the entrance to Mars Mine.

description.tw: 收集一朵只在瑪斯礦坑入口附近盛開的時間倒轉的花。
description.vi: Thu thập Time Lapse Flower, chúng chỉ nở gần lối vào Mars Mine.

dialogsBegin.en: I almost have all the ingredients! The piece de resistance is a mysterious ingredient known as the Time Lapse Flower.
dialogsBegin.ar: I almost have all the ingredients! The piece de resistance is a mysterious ingredient known as the Time Lapse Flower.
dialogsBegin.br: Tenho quase todos os ingredientes! A peça de resistência é um ingrediente misterioso conhecido como a Flor do Lapso de Tempo.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我几乎拥有所有的成分！最重要的是一种被称为 "时空之花 "的神秘成分。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich habe fast alle Zutaten! Der Clou ist eine geheimnisvolle Zutat, die als Time Lapse Flower bekannt ist.
dialogsBegin.fi: I almost have all the ingredients! The piece de resistance is a mysterious ingredient known as the Time Lapse Flower.
dialogsBegin.fil: I almost have all the ingredients! The piece de resistance is a mysterious ingredient known as the Time Lapse Flower.
dialogsBegin.fr: Parfait. Maintenant j'ai besoin d'un moyen de revenir dans le temps. J'ai été maudit dans une incarnation précédente, c'est à cette époque que je dois intervenir.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya hampir memiliki semua bahan yang dibutuhkan! Piece de resistance adalah bahan misterius yang dikenal sebagai Time Lapse Flower.
dialogsBegin.it: I almost have all the ingredients! The piece de resistance is a mysterious ingredient known as the Time Lapse Flower.
dialogsBegin.jp: よし、後は一つだけだ。最後に私の肉体の時間軸を戻すために、ある媒体が必要となる。
dialogsBegin.kr: 좋아. 이제 마지막 재료만 남았어! 저주 받은 내 몸을 원래 이전의 몸으로 돌리기 위해선 시간을 되돌리는 꽃을 구해와야 해.
dialogsBegin.nl: I almost have all the ingredients! The piece de resistance is a mysterious ingredient known as the Time Lapse Flower.
dialogsBegin.pl: I almost have all the ingredients! The piece de resistance is a mysterious ingredient known as the Time Lapse Flower.
dialogsBegin.ru: Теперь у меня есть почти все ингредиенты! Осталось раздобыть самый загадочный - Цветок времени.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Ya tengo casi todos los ingredientes! Se me resiste un ingrediente misterioso conocido como la Flor de Lapso de Tiempo.
dialogsBegin.sw: I almost have all the ingredients! The piece de resistance is a mysterious ingredient known as the Time Lapse Flower.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันมีส่วนผสมเกือบทั้งหมด! ชิ้นส่วนที่ต้านทานเป็นส่วนผสมลึกลับที่รู้จักกันในชื่อดอก Time Lapse
dialogsBegin.tw: 很好。現在只剩下最後的材料。為了將受到詛咒身體返到到以前的身體，我需要時間倒轉的花。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi gần như có tất cả các thành phần! Kháng mảnh là một thành phần bí ẩn được biết đến với cái tên Time Lapse Flower.

dialogsBegin.en: Time Lapse Flowers can be found only around Mars Mine dungeon entrance. The entrance is located at the most Northern part of the Flaris continent.
dialogsBegin.ar: Time Lapse Flowers can be found only around Mars Mine dungeon entrance. The entrance is located at the most Northern part of the Flaris continent.
dialogsBegin.br: As Flores de Lapso de Tempo podem ser encontradas apenas próximos da entrada da Masmorra Mars. A entrada está localizada na parte mais ao norte do continente Flaris.
dialogsBegin.cns: 时空之花只能在魔域密殿的地牢入口处找到。该入口位于帕里的最北部。
dialogsBegin.de: Time Return Flower findet man am Eingang von Mars Mine.
dialogsBegin.fi: Time Lapse Flowers can be found only around Mars Mine dungeon entrance. The entrance is located at the most Northern part of the Flaris continent.
dialogsBegin.fil: Time Lapse Flowers can be found only around Mars Mine dungeon entrance. The entrance is located at the most Northern part of the Flaris continent.
dialogsBegin.fr: Près de l'entrée de Désiréa, au Nord de Darkon pousse une plante très spéciale. La fleur de voyage temporel…
dialogsBegin.id: Time Lapse Flowers hanya dapat ditemukan di sekitar pintu masuk penjara bawah tanah Mars Mine. Pintu masuknya terletak di bagian paling utara benua Flaris.
dialogsBegin.it: Time Lapse Flowers can be found only around Mars Mine dungeon entrance. The entrance is located at the most Northern part of the Flaris continent.
dialogsBegin.jp: フラリスダンジョンという場所はわかるかい？そこの入り口に咲いている次元花という花が必要なのだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 시간을 되돌리는 꽃은 플라리스 북쪽을 비행해서 가면 마스 마인 던전 입구에 피어 있을 거야. 그 꽃을 구해오기만 하면 돼. 어때, 할 수 있겠지?
dialogsBegin.nl: Time Lapse Flowers can be found only around Mars Mine dungeon entrance. The entrance is located at the most Northern part of the Flaris continent.
dialogsBegin.pl: Time Lapse Flowers can be found only around Mars Mine dungeon entrance. The entrance is located at the most Northern part of the Flaris continent.
dialogsBegin.ru: Цветы времени могут быть найдены только у входа в Марсову шахту.
dialogsBegin.sp: Las Flores de Lapso de Tiempo se pueden encontrar cerca de la entrada de la Mina Mars. La entrada está ubicada en la parte más al Norte del continente de Flaris.
dialogsBegin.sw: Time Lapse Flowers can be found only around Mars Mine dungeon entrance. The entrance is located at the most Northern part of the Flaris continent.
dialogsBegin.th: ดอกไม้ Time Lapse สามารถพบได้เฉพาะรอบทางเข้า Dungeon Wilds ทางเข้าตั้งอยู่บนเกาะเล็กๆ ทางตอนเหนือของทวีป Darkon
dialogsBegin.tw: 時間倒轉的花只要飛行到得肯北邊之後，在瑪斯礦坑的入口處可以看到。只要把那個花拿回來就可以。怎麼樣，做得到吧？
dialogsBegin.vi: Time Lapse Flowers chỉ có thể được tìm thấy xung quanh lối vào hầm ngục của Mars Mine. Lối vào nằm ở phía cực Bắc của lục địa Flaris.

dialogsAccept.en: Awesome! No worries! You don't have to enter the dungeon per se. The flower should simply be near it!
dialogsAccept.ar: Awesome! No worries! You don't have to enter the dungeon per se. The flower should simply be near it!
dialogsAccept.br: Legal! Não se preocupe! Você não precisa entrar na masmorra em si. A flor deve estar simplesmente perto dela!
dialogsAccept.cns: 棒极了! 不用担心! 你不需要进入地牢。花只是在入口处附近!
dialogsAccept.de: Fantastisch! Keine Angst! Ihr müsst die Mine an sich nicht betreten. Die Blume sollte einfach in der Nähe sein!
dialogsAccept.fi: Awesome! No worries! You don't have to enter the dungeon per se. The flower should simply be near it!
dialogsAccept.fil: Awesome! No worries! You don't have to enter the dungeon per se. The flower should simply be near it!
dialogsAccept.fr: … vous comprenez vite. J'attendrai ici que vous me la rapportiez.
dialogsAccept.id: Keren! Jangan khawatir! Anda tidak harus memasuki ruang bawah tanah itu sendiri. The flower itu seharusnya berada di dekatnya!
dialogsAccept.it: Awesome! No worries! You don't have to enter the dungeon per se. The flower should simply be near it!
dialogsAccept.jp: 助かるぞ！フラリスダンジョンの中に入る必要はないから心配いらないぞ。今も咲いているとすれば入口近くに見つかるはずだ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 걱정 마! 던전 안까지 들어가지 않아도 된다고. 꽃은 바로 옆에 있어.

dialogsAccept.pl: Awesome! No worries! You don't have to enter the dungeon per se. The flower should simply be near it!
dialogsAccept.ru: Отлично! Задание легче некуда! Тебе даже заходить в шахту не надо. Цветы растут где-то на поверхности.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Fantástico! ¡No te preocupes! No hace falta que entres a la mazmorra. ¡La flor debe está por ahí cerca!
dialogsAccept.sw: Awesome! No worries! You don't have to enter the dungeon per se. The flower should simply be near it!
dialogsAccept.th: ไม่ต้องห่วง! คุณไม่จำเป็นต้องเข้า Dungeon per se ดอกไม้ Time Lapse จะอยู่ใกล้บริเวณนั้น !
dialogsAccept.tw: 太棒了！不用擔心！你不需要進入副本。只要在瑪斯礦坑的入口附近就可以找到那朵花了！
dialogsAccept.vi: Đáng kinh ngạc! Đừng lo lắng! Bạn không cần phải vào hầm ngục đâu. Các bông hoa chỉ mọc xung quanh đó thôi!

dialogsBegin.en: Ahh, so I guess I should express my gratitude to you! The potion will take a little time to mix so I guess I will hang out here a little longer.
dialogsBegin.ar: Ahh, so I guess I should express my gratitude to you! The potion will take a little time to mix so I guess I will hang out here a little longer.
dialogsBegin.br: Ahh, então acho que devo expressar minha gratidão a você! A poção vai demorar um pouco para misturar, então acho que vou ficar por aqui um pouco mais.
dialogsBegin.cns: 噢，我想我应该向你表达我的感激之情！药水需要一点时间才能混合，所以我想在这里多呆一会儿。
dialogsBegin.de: Ahh, dann sollte ich dir wohl meine Dankbarkeit ausdrücken! Der Zaubertrank braucht ein wenig Zeit zum Mischen, also werde ich wohl noch ein wenig länger hier bleiben.
dialogsBegin.fi: Ahh, so I guess I should express my gratitude to you! The potion will take a little time to mix so I guess I will hang out here a little longer.
dialogsBegin.fil: Ahh, so I guess I should express my gratitude to you! The potion will take a little time to mix so I guess I will hang out here a little longer.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je vous dois vraiment beaucoup. Il est temps que je prenne ma place aux côtés de Reonan.
dialogsBegin.id: Ahh, jadi kurasa aku harus mengungkapkan rasa terima kasihku padamu! Ramuan itu akan memakan waktu sedikit untuk dicampur jadi kurasa aku akan nongkrong di sini sedikit lebih lama.
dialogsBegin.it: Ahh, so I guess I should express my gratitude to you! The potion will take a little time to mix so I guess I will hang out here a little longer.
dialogsBegin.jp: 本当にありがとう。これで私も昔の仲間と合流することができる。君には世話になったね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 아아, 고맙다는 인사를 드려야겠죠! 물약이 섞이려면 시간이 걸리니까, 여기 좀 더 머물러 있을게요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Ahh, so I guess I should express my gratitude to you! The potion will take a little time to mix so I guess I will hang out here a little longer.
dialogsBegin.pl: Ahh, so I guess I should express my gratitude to you! The potion will take a little time to mix so I guess I will hang out here a little longer.
dialogsBegin.ru: А, я думаю стоит поблагодарить тебя! Зелье будет готовиться ещё некоторое время, так что я задержусь тут.
dialogsBegin.sp: Ahh, ¡supongo que debería darte las gracias! La poción tardará un poco en mezclarse, así que supongo que me quedaré por aquí un poco más.
dialogsBegin.sw: Ahh, so I guess I should express my gratitude to you! The potion will take a little time to mix so I guess I will hang out here a little longer.
dialogsBegin.th: อ่า ข้าคิดว่าข้าควรแสดงความกตัญญูต่อคุณ! ยาจะใช้เวลาเล็กน้อยในการผสม ดังนั้น ฉันจะออกไปเที่ยวที่นี่อีกสักหน่อย
dialogsBegin.tw: 啊啊，真的是太急了，連招呼都忘記了。真的是太謝謝你了。託你的福，我才能夠解開詛咒，現在我又能夠和以前的同伴見面了。已經開始對以後要和同伴們一起進行冒險感到緊張了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Ahh, tôi nên bày tỏ lòng biết ơn với bạn! Thuốc sẽ mất một chút thời gian để trộn nên tôi đoán tôi sẽ dạo chơi quanh đây lâu hơn một chút.

dialogsBegin.en: While the potion mixes, here, take this. This is a pendant to symbolize my unwavering participation in whatever is to come. Please take it to Reonan and let him know we will meet soon enough!
dialogsBegin.ar: While the potion mixes, here, take this. This is a pendant to symbolize my unwavering participation in whatever is to come. Please take it to Reonan and let him know we will meet soon enough!
dialogsBegin.br: Enquanto a poção se mistura, aqui, pegue isso. Este é um pingente para simbolizar minha participação inabalável em tudo o que está por vir. Por favor, leve para Reonan e deixe-o saber que nos encontraremos em breve!
dialogsBegin.cns: 拿着这个。这是一个吊坠，象征着我坚定不移地参与即将到来的任何事情。请把它交给瑞尔南，让他知道我们很快就会见面！
dialogsBegin.de: Während sich der Trank mischt, nimm das hier. Dies ist ein Anhänger, der meine unerschütterliche Teilnahme an allem, was kommen wird, symbolisieren soll. Bitte bring ihn zu Reonan und lass ihn wissen, dass wir uns früh genug treffen werden!
dialogsBegin.fi: While the potion mixes, here, take this. This is a pendant to symbolize my unwavering participation in whatever is to come. Please take it to Reonan and let him know we will meet soon enough!
dialogsBegin.fil: While the potion mixes, here, take this. This is a pendant to symbolize my unwavering participation in whatever is to come. Please take it to Reonan and let him know we will meet soon enough!
dialogsBegin.fr: Je vais vous demander d'apporter ce pendentif à Reonan en signe de mon engagement.
dialogsBegin.id: Sementara ramuan bercampur, sini, ambil ini. Ini adalah liontin untuk melambangkan partisipasi saya yang tak tergoyahkan dalam situasi apa pun yang akan muncul. Tolong bawa ke Reonan dan beri tahu dia bahwa kita akan segera bertemu!
dialogsBegin.it: While the potion mixes, here, take this. This is a pendant to symbolize my unwavering participation in whatever is to come. Please take it to Reonan and let him know we will meet soon enough!
dialogsBegin.jp: そうだ。私が呪いを解くまでの間、先にレオナンに伝えてくれないか？　このペンダントは私達の絆の証だ。これを見せればわかるだろう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 물약이 섞이는 동안, 이걸 드리죠. 앞으로 어떤 일이 닥치더라도 끝까지 함께하겠다는 마음을 담은 펜던트예요. 레오난에게 가져다주시고, 곧 다시 만나게 될 거라고도 전해 주세요!
dialogsBegin.nl: While the potion mixes, here, take this. This is a pendant to symbolize my unwavering participation in whatever is to come. Please take it to Reonan and let him know we will meet soon enough!
dialogsBegin.pl: While the potion mixes, here, take this. This is a pendant to symbolize my unwavering participation in whatever is to come. Please take it to Reonan and let him know we will meet soon enough!
dialogsBegin.ru: На вот, возьми это. Это кулон, символизирующий моё участие во всём, что бы не случилось. Отнеси его Максимусу и передай, что мы скоро встретимся.
dialogsBegin.sp: Mientras se mezcla la poción, toma esto. Este es un colgante para simbolizar mi participación inquebrantable en lo que sea que esté por venir. ¡Por favor, llévaselo a Reonan y hazle saber que nos encontraremos pronto!
dialogsBegin.sw: While the potion mixes, here, take this. This is a pendant to symbolize my unwavering participation in whatever is to come. Please take it to Reonan and let him know we will meet soon enough!
dialogsBegin.th: ผมยาที่นี่ อะ นี่ จี้เพื่อเป็นสัญลักษณ์ของการมีส่วนร่วมในสิ่งที่กำลังจะมาถึง กรุณานำไปให้ Reonan และแจ้งให้เขาทราบว่าเราจะพบกันเร็ว ๆ นี้!
dialogsBegin.tw: 在我製作解除詛咒的藥時，請你拿著這個墜飾回去找雷奧南，並轉答他說不久之後我就會過去和他們會合。那個墜飾象徵我們的信義和信仰，是非常重要的東西。請你幫我轉交給他。
dialogsBegin.vi: Trong khi thuốc dđược bào chế, hãy cầm lấy cái này. Đây là mặt dây chuyền tượng trưng cho sự cam kết tham gia của tôi vào bất cứ điều gì sắp xảy đến. Hãy đưa nó đến Reonan và cho anh ấy biết chúng ta sẽ sớm gặp nhau!

dialogsAccept.en: Good! Then go to Reonan. I will soon recover my original body and meet up with the rest of the original crew!
dialogsAccept.ar: Good! Then go to Reonan. I will soon recover my original body and meet up with the rest of the original crew!
dialogsAccept.br: Boa! Então vá para Reonan. Em breve recuperarei meu corpo original e me encontrarei com o resto da cambada original!
dialogsAccept.cns: 好！去找瑞尔男吧。我很快就会恢复身体，并与其他原队友见面！
dialogsAccept.de: Sehr gut! Dann geh nach Reonan. Ich werde bald meinen ursprünglichen Körper wiedererlangen und mich mit dem Rest der ursprünglichen Mannschaft treffen!
dialogsAccept.fi: Good! Then go to Reonan. I will soon recover my original body and meet up with the rest of the original crew!
dialogsAccept.fil: Good! Then go to Reonan. I will soon recover my original body and meet up with the rest of the original crew!
dialogsAccept.fr: Parfait. Allez trouver Reonan et sauvons Madrigal une fois de plus.
dialogsAccept.id: Bagus! Pergilah ke Reonan. Saya akan segera memulihkan tubuh asli saya dan bertemu dengan kru asli lainnya!
dialogsAccept.it: Good! Then go to Reonan. I will soon recover my original body and meet up with the rest of the original crew!
dialogsAccept.jp: よしよし。頼むぞ。レオナンのことだ。きっと君の帰りを待っているだろう。
dialogsAccept.kr: 좋아요! 그러면 레오난에게 가 보세요. 저도 곧 원래의 모습으로 돌아가, 나머지 멤버들과 다시 만나게 될 거니까!
dialogsAccept.nl: Good! Then go to Reonan. I will soon recover my original body and meet up with the rest of the original crew!
dialogsAccept.pl: Good! Then go to Reonan. I will soon recover my original body and meet up with the rest of the original crew!
dialogsAccept.ru: Скоро я обрету своё прежнее тело и увижусь с остальными участниками команды!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Muy bien! Ve con Reonan. ¡Pronto recuperaré mi cuerpo y me reuniré con el resto del equipo original!
dialogsAccept.sw: Good! Then go to Reonan. I will soon recover my original body and meet up with the rest of the original crew!
dialogsAccept.th: ดี! ถ้างั้นไปที่ Reonan เร็ว ๆ ฉันจะกู้คืนร่างเดิมของฉัน
dialogsAccept.tw: 很好！那麼就快一點去找雷奧南吧。這段時間，我要製作解開詛咒的藥，我需要萬全的準備。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tốt! Sau đó đến Reonan. Tôi sẽ sớm phục hồi cơ thể ban đầu của mình và gặp gỡ các thành viên còn lại của hội nhóm thuở sơ khai!

dialogsDecline.en: Err… well in that case you must have some more urgent matters to attend to? Please take the pendant to Reonan soon.
dialogsDecline.ar: Err… well in that case you must have some more urgent matters to attend to? Please take the pendant to Reonan soon.
dialogsDecline.br: Err... bem, nesse caso você deve ter alguns assuntos mais urgentes para resolver? Por favor, leve o pingente para Reonan quando puder.
dialogsDecline.cns: 呃……你肯定有更紧急的事情要处理吧？请尽快将吊坠交给瑞尔南哦。
dialogsDecline.de: Äh... nun, in diesem Fall müsst ihr euch um dringendere Angelegenheiten kümmern? Bitte bringen Sie den Anhänger bald zu Reonan.
dialogsDecline.fi: Err… well in that case you must have some more urgent matters to attend to? Please take the pendant to Reonan soon.
dialogsDecline.fil: Err… well in that case you must have some more urgent matters to attend to? Please take the pendant to Reonan soon.
dialogsDecline.fr: Hum ? Non je ne suis pas encore allé dissiper la malédiction, je vous parlais !
dialogsDecline.id: Err... dalam hal ini bukankah Anda memiliki beberapa hal yang lebih mendesak untuk diperhatikan? Tolong bawa liontin itu ke Reonan segera.
dialogsDecline.it: Err… well in that case you must have some more urgent matters to attend to? Please take the pendant to Reonan soon.
dialogsDecline.jp: ふむ。そうか。まあ、急ぐことはないさ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 기다리고 있었네. 표정이 밝은 것을 보니 좋은 소식을 들고 온 모양이군?
dialogsDecline.nl: Err… well in that case you must have some more urgent matters to attend to? Please take the pendant to Reonan soon.
dialogsDecline.pl: Err… well in that case you must have some more urgent matters to attend to? Please take the pendant to Reonan soon.
dialogsDecline.ru: Err… well in that case you must have some more urgent matters to attend to? Please take the pendant to Reonan soon.
dialogsDecline.sp: Emm... bueno pues, debes tener asuntos más urgentes que atender. Por favor, llévale el colgante a Reonan lo antes posible.
dialogsDecline.sw: Err… well in that case you must have some more urgent matters to attend to? Please take the pendant to Reonan soon.
dialogsDecline.th: เอ่อ ... คุณมีเรื่องด่วนมากกว่านี้ไหม ? กรุณานำจี้ไป Reonan เร็ว ๆ นี้
dialogsDecline.tw: 你說你有很急的事情嗎？那麼我等詛咒解除之後，我在直接過去好了。
dialogsDecline.vi: Ơ… à trong trường hợp đó thì bạn có một số việc cấp bách hơn phải giải quyết sao? Hãy nhanh tay rinh mặt dây về Reonan nhé.

dialogsComplete.en: There you are! Unfortunately, I'm glad to see you but unable to talk at the moment. Take this time to reach level 60 then return to me.
dialogsComplete.ar: There you are! Unfortunately, I'm glad to see you but unable to talk at the moment. Take this time to reach level 60 then return to me.
dialogsComplete.br: Aí está você! Estou feliz em vê-lo, mas infelizmente não posso falar no momento. Aproveite este tempo para atingir o nível 60 e depois volte aqui.
dialogsComplete.cns: 嘿你在这儿！很高兴见到你，但不幸的是我们目前无法交谈。花点时间达到60级后再来找我。
dialogsComplete.de: Da sind Sie ja! Leider bin ich froh, dich zu sehen, aber im Moment nicht in der Lage zu sprechen. Nimm dir die Zeit, Stufe 60 zu erreichen, und komm dann zu mir zurück.
dialogsComplete.fi: There you are! Unfortunately, I'm glad to see you but unable to talk at the moment. Take this time to reach level 60 then return to me.
dialogsComplete.fil: There you are! Unfortunately, I'm glad to see you but unable to talk at the moment. Take this time to reach level 60 then return to me.
dialogsComplete.fr: À votre sourire, je dirais que vous avez une bonne nouvelle à m'annoncer.
dialogsComplete.id: Akhinya kamu datang juga! Sayangnya, saya senang melihat Anda tetapi tidak dapat ngobrol untuk saat ini. Luangkan waktu ini untuk mencapai level 60 lalu kembali kepada saya.
dialogsComplete.it: There you are! Unfortunately, I'm glad to see you but unable to talk at the moment. Take this time to reach level 60 then return to me.
dialogsComplete.jp: お、戻ってきたか。その顔をみる限り、無事に英雄を見つけだせたのかな？
dialogsComplete.kr: 거기 있었군! 다만, 아직 자네에게는 이른 것 같은데 60레벨을 달성하고 오길.
dialogsComplete.nl: There you are! Unfortunately, I'm glad to see you but unable to talk at the moment. Take this time to reach level 60 then return to me.
dialogsComplete.pl: There you are! Unfortunately, I'm glad to see you but unable to talk at the moment. Take this time to reach level 60 then return to me.
dialogsComplete.ru: There you are! Unfortunately, I'm glad to see you but unable to talk at the moment. Take this time to reach level 60 then return to me.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Ahí estás! Aunque me alegro de verte, no puedo hablar en este momento. Tómate este tiempo para alcanzar el nivel 60 y luego vuelve a verme.
dialogsComplete.sw: There you are! Unfortunately, I'm glad to see you but unable to talk at the moment. Take this time to reach level 60 then return to me.
dialogsComplete.th: นั่นแหละ! แต่ฉันดีใจที่ได้พบคุณ แต่ไม่สามารถพูดได้ในขณะนี้ รีบเวลให้ถึง 60 แล้วกลับมาหาฉัน
dialogsComplete.tw: 你在這！抱歉，我很高興見到你但目前無法交談。花點時間達到 60 級然後回到我身邊。
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn đây rồi! Rất tiếc, tôi rất vui được gặp bạn nhưng không thể nói chuyện vào lúc này. Hãy dành thời gian này để đạt được cấp độ 60 sau đó quay trở lại với tôi.

dialogsFail.en: Hurry quickly back to Reonan with the pendant!
dialogsFail.ar: Hurry quickly back to Reonan with the pendant!
dialogsFail.br: Rápido! Volte para Reonan com o pingente!
dialogsFail.cns: 赶紧带着吊坠去找瑞尔南！
dialogsFail.de: Eile mit dem Anhänger schnell zurück zu Reonan!
dialogsFail.fi: Hurry quickly back to Reonan with the pendant!
dialogsFail.fil: Hurry quickly back to Reonan with the pendant!
dialogsFail.fr: Allez vite prévenir Reonan.
dialogsFail.id: Cepat kembali ke Reonan dengan liontin itu!
dialogsFail.it: Hurry quickly back to Reonan with the pendant!
dialogsFail.jp: 頼んだぞ。このペンダントを渡せばレオナンならわかるはずだ。
dialogsFail.kr: 어서 펜던트를 가지고 레오난에게 가 보세요!
dialogsFail.nl: Hurry quickly back to Reonan with the pendant!
dialogsFail.pl: Hurry quickly back to Reonan with the pendant!
dialogsFail.ru: Hurry quickly back to Reonan with the pendant!
dialogsFail.sp: ¡Vuelve rápido con Reonan y dale el colgante!
dialogsFail.sw: Hurry quickly back to Reonan with the pendant!
dialogsFail.th: รีบหน่อย รีบกลับไปหา Reonan พร้อมจี้!
dialogsFail.tw: 不快一點把我給的墜飾拿去給雷奧南嗎？
dialogsFail.vi: Nhanh tay mang ngay mặt dây về Reonan thôi nào!

name.th: ฮีโร่เผยตัว!

description.de: Triff dich mit Reonan.

description.fil: Go meet with Reonan.

description.id: Pergi temui Reonan.

description.jp: レオナンに報告せよ。
description.nl: Go meet with Reonan.
description.pl: Go meet with Reonan.
description.ru: Пойти встретиться с Максимусом.

dialogsBegin.en: Know that I, as well as the citizens of Flaris, are forever in your debt. If you are ever in need of assistance, do not hesitate to ask!
dialogsBegin.ar: Know that I, as well as the citizens of Flaris, are forever in your debt. If you are ever in need of assistance, do not hesitate to ask!
dialogsBegin.br: Saiba que eu, assim como os cidadãos de Flaris, estaremos sempre em dívida com você. Se você precisar de ajuda, não hesite em pedir!
dialogsBegin.cns: 我和帕里的居民们都很清楚，我们永远欠你人情。如果你需要我们的帮助，请不要羞于启齿。
dialogsBegin.de: Ihr sollt wissen, dass ich und die Bürger von Flaris für immer in Eurer Schuld stehen. Sollten Sie jemals Hilfe benötigen, zögern Sie nicht zu fragen!
dialogsBegin.fi: Know that I, as well as the citizens of Flaris, are forever in your debt. If you are ever in need of assistance, do not hesitate to ask!
dialogsBegin.fil: Know that I, as well as the citizens of Flaris, are forever in your debt. If you are ever in need of assistance, do not hesitate to ask!
dialogsBegin.fr: Au nom de toute la population de Flarine, je vous remercie et vous nomme Champion de Flarine !
dialogsBegin.id: Ketahuilah kalau aku, serta seluruh warga Flaris, selamanya berhutang budi kepadamu. Jika kamu membutuhkan bantuan, jangan ragu untuk bertanya!
dialogsBegin.it: Know that I, as well as the citizens of Flaris, are forever in your debt. If you are ever in need of assistance, do not hesitate to ask!
dialogsBegin.jp: 貴方はフラリスの英雄です！　もし私がお手伝いできることがありましたらいつでも教えて下さい。
dialogsBegin.kr: 저뿐 아니라 플라리스 시민 모두 깊이 감사하고 있어요. 혹시 도움이 필요하다면, 언제든지 주저하지 말고 찾아오세요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Know that I, as well as the citizens of Flaris, are forever in your debt. If you are ever in need of assistance, do not hesitate to ask!
dialogsBegin.pl: Know that I, as well as the citizens of Flaris, are forever in your debt. If you are ever in need of assistance, do not hesitate to ask!
dialogsBegin.ru: Знай, что я и остальные жители Фларинции твои должники. Если тебе самому нужна будет помощь - обращайся!
dialogsBegin.sp: Que sepas que los ciudadanos de Flaris y yo estamos en deuda contigo para siempre. Si alguna vez necesitas ayuda, ¡no dudes en preguntar!
dialogsBegin.sw: Know that I, as well as the citizens of Flaris, are forever in your debt. If you are ever in need of assistance, do not hesitate to ask!
dialogsBegin.th: จำไว้ว่าฉันและพลเมืองของ Flaris เป็นหนี้ของคุณตลอดไป หากคุณต้องการความช่วยเหลือ อย่าลังเลที่จะถาม!
dialogsBegin.tw: 要知道，我以及布拉里斯的公民，永遠欠你的人情。如果你需要幫助，請不要猶豫跟我們說！
dialogsBegin.vi: Hãy biết rằng tôi, cũng như các công dân của Flaris, mãi mãi mang trong mình món nợ của bạn. Nếu bạn đang cần hỗ trợ, đừng ngần ngại hỏi!

dialogsBegin.en: Carry on now young adventurer! I can tell you will accomplish great things. Oh, I believe Reonan was looking for you as well. Won't you speak with him?
dialogsBegin.ar: Carry on now young adventurer! I can tell you will accomplish great things. Oh, I believe Reonan was looking for you as well. Won't you speak with him?
dialogsBegin.br: Continue no caminho certo, jovem aventureiro(a)! Posso dizer que você realizará grandes coisas. Ah, acredito que Reonan também estava procurando por você. Não vai falar com ele?
dialogsBegin.cns: 年轻的冒险者继续前进吧！你一定会成就一番事业的。噢，我相信瑞尔南正在找你，你不想和他谈谈吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Mach weiter, junger Abenteurer! Ich weiß, dass du Großes vollbringen wirst. Oh, ich glaube, Reonan hat auch nach dir gesucht. Willst du nicht mit ihm sprechen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Carry on now young adventurer! I can tell you will accomplish great things. Oh, I believe Reonan was looking for you as well. Won't you speak with him?
dialogsBegin.fil: Carry on now young adventurer! I can tell you will accomplish great things. Oh, I believe Reonan was looking for you as well. Won't you speak with him?
dialogsBegin.fr: Je viens de recevoir un mot de Reonan. Il me fait savoir qu'il a besoin de vos services.
dialogsBegin.id: Lanjutkan petualanganmu pemuda! Saya dapat melihat jika kau akan memiliki pencapaian yang besar suatu hari nanti. Oh, aku yakin Reonan juga mencarimu. Maukah kamu berbicara dengannya?
dialogsBegin.it: Carry on now young adventurer! I can tell you will accomplish great things. Oh, I believe Reonan was looking for you as well. Won't you speak with him?
dialogsBegin.jp: 冒険家を続けてください！ 私はあなたが素晴らしいことができると思います。そうそう、レオナンが貴方のことを探しているようですよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 자, 이제 가보세요, 젊은 모험가님! 위대한 일을 해낼 분이 틀림없어요. 아, 레오난이 당신을 찾고 있었던 것 같은데. 한번 들러보시겠어요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Carry on now young adventurer! I can tell you will accomplish great things. Oh, I believe Reonan was looking for you as well. Won't you speak with him?
dialogsBegin.pl: Carry on now young adventurer! I can tell you will accomplish great things. Oh, I believe Reonan was looking for you as well. Won't you speak with him?
dialogsBegin.ru: Удачи тебе, путешественник! Уверен, ты многого добьёшься. Я слышал, что Максимус искал тебя. Не хочешь ещё раз поговорить с ним?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Continúa, joven aventurero! Puedo decir que lograrás grandes cosas. Por cierto, creo que Reonan también te estaba buscando. ¿Por qué no vas a hablar con él?
dialogsBegin.sw: Carry on now young adventurer! I can tell you will accomplish great things. Oh, I believe Reonan was looking for you as well. Won't you speak with him?
dialogsBegin.th: ลุยเลย หนุ่มนักผจญภัย! ฉันบอกได้เลยว่าคุณจะประสบความสำเร็จในสิ่งที่ยิ่งใหญ่ โอ้ ฉันเชื่อว่า Reonan กำลังมองหาคุณเช่นกัน คุณจะไม่คุยกับเขาเหรอ
dialogsBegin.tw: 現在繼續年輕的冒險家！我可以告訴你會完成偉大的事情。哦，我相信雷奧南也在找你。你不跟他說話嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Thực hiện ngay nhà thám hiểm trẻ! Tôi có thể nói với bạn sẽ đạt được những điều tuyệt vời. Ồ, tôi tin rằng Reonan cũng đang tìm kiếm bạn. Bạn sẽ nói chuyện với anh ta?

dialogsAccept.en: Before you leave, please tell Reonan thanks for bringing you to my attention. He, as well, has my gratitude.
dialogsAccept.ar: Before you leave, please tell Reonan thanks for bringing you to my attention. He, as well, has my gratitude.
dialogsAccept.br: Antes de você ir, diga a Reonan que eu o agradeço por chamar minha atenção para você. Ele também tem minha gratidão.
dialogsAccept.cns: 在你离开前，请告诉瑞尔南，我很感谢他也很感谢他引领你来帮助我们。
dialogsAccept.de: Bevor Sie gehen, sagen Sie bitte Reonan danke, dass er mich auf Sie aufmerksam gemacht hat. Auch ihm gilt meine Dankbarkeit.
dialogsAccept.fi: Before you leave, please tell Reonan thanks for bringing you to my attention. He, as well, has my gratitude.
dialogsAccept.fil: Before you leave, please tell Reonan thanks for bringing you to my attention. He, as well, has my gratitude.
dialogsAccept.fr: Remerciez-le de ma part et bonne chance à vous pour la suite de vos aventures.
dialogsAccept.id: Sebelum pergi, tolong sampaikan pada Reonan akan rasa terima kasihku karena telah mengenalkanmu.
dialogsAccept.it: Before you leave, please tell Reonan thanks for bringing you to my attention. He, as well, has my gratitude.
dialogsAccept.jp: レオナンにも感謝の言葉をお伝え下さい。貴方のような立派な冒険者を紹介して頂けるなんていくら感謝してもしきれません。
dialogsAccept.kr: 떠나시기 전에... 레오난에게도, 당신을 소개해 주어 감사드린다고 꼭 전해주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Before you leave, please tell Reonan thanks for bringing you to my attention. He, as well, has my gratitude.
dialogsAccept.pl: Before you leave, please tell Reonan thanks for bringing you to my attention. He, as well, has my gratitude.
dialogsAccept.ru: Да, и передавай Максимусу мою благодарность за знакомство с тобой. Теперь я и перед ним в долгу.
dialogsAccept.sp: Antes de irte, agradécele a Reonan que me haya enviado a alguien como tú. Él también tiene mi gratitud.
dialogsAccept.sw: Before you leave, please tell Reonan thanks for bringing you to my attention. He, as well, has my gratitude.
dialogsAccept.th: ก่อนที่คุณจะจากไป โปรดบอก Reonan ขอบคุณที่ให้ความสนใจฉัน เขาเองก็มีความกตัญญูกตเวที
dialogsAccept.tw: 在你離開之前，請告訴雷奧南感謝帶你讓我們認識。他也有我的感激之情。
dialogsAccept.vi: Trước khi bạn rời đi, hãy nói với Reonan cảm ơn vì đã đưa bạn đến với sự chú ý của tôi. Anh ấy cũng có lòng biết ơn của tôi.

dialogsDecline.en: Well, I don't mind if you stay here. Who knows, perhaps you might even be the Mayor of Flarine one day! Haha!
dialogsDecline.ar: Well, I don't mind if you stay here. Who knows, perhaps you might even be the Mayor of Flarine one day! Haha!
dialogsDecline.br: Bem, eu não me importo se você ficar aqui. Quem sabe, talvez você até seja o prefeito de Flarine um dia! Haha!
dialogsDecline.cns: 没事，我也并不介意你待在这。谁知道呢，也许某天你就成为了帕里市长了！哈哈！
dialogsDecline.de: Nun, es macht mir nichts aus, wenn du hier bleibst. Wer weiß, vielleicht wirst du ja sogar eines Tages Bürgermeister von Flarine! Haha!
dialogsDecline.fi: Well, I don't mind if you stay here. Who knows, perhaps you might even be the Mayor of Flarine one day! Haha!
dialogsDecline.fil: Well, I don't mind if you stay here. Who knows, perhaps you might even be the Mayor of Flarine one day! Haha!
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous êtes le bienvenu à Flarine si vous voulez vous installer ici.
dialogsDecline.id: Aku akan senang jika kamu mau menetap disini. Siapa tahu suatu hari nanti kamu akan menjadi Mayor of Flarin! hahaha!
dialogsDecline.it: Well, I don't mind if you stay here. Who knows, perhaps you might even be the Mayor of Flarine one day! Haha!
dialogsDecline.jp: まあ、ここで我々フラリスの為に仕事してくれるのも悪くないな。私の補佐官として働いてみるか？ハッハッハ！
dialogsDecline.kr: 여기 머무셔도 좋겠네요. 어쩌면 언젠가 플라리네의 시장님이 되실지도 모르잖아요! 하하!
dialogsDecline.nl: Well, I don't mind if you stay here. Who knows, perhaps you might even be the Mayor of Flarine one day! Haha!
dialogsDecline.pl: Well, I don't mind if you stay here. Who knows, perhaps you might even be the Mayor of Flarine one day! Haha!
dialogsDecline.ru: Well, I don't mind if you stay here. Who knows, perhaps you might even be the Mayor of Flarine one day! Haha!
dialogsDecline.sp: Bueno, no me importa si te quedas aquí. Quién sabe, ¡quizás algún día seas el Alcalde de Flarine! ¡Jaja!
dialogsDecline.sw: Well, I don't mind if you stay here. Who knows, perhaps you might even be the Mayor of Flarine one day! Haha!
dialogsDecline.th: ไม่เป็นไร ฉันไม่รังเกียจถ้าคุณอยู่ที่นี่ ใครจะไปรู้ บางทีคุณอาจจะเป็นนายกเทศมนตรีแห่ง Flarine สักวันหนึ่งก็ได้! ฮ่าๆ!
dialogsDecline.tw: 好吧，我不介意你留在這裡。誰知道呢，說不定有一天你會成為布拉里斯的市長！哈哈！
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi không phiền nếu bạn ở lại đây. Ai biết được, có lẽ bạn thậm chí có thể là Thị trưởng của Flarine một ngày nào đó! Haha!

dialogsComplete.en: A safe return I see? You no doubt have completed the mayor's request. Oh and his gratitude? Can't say I've ever trusted the word of a politician, but I will take it! Hah!
dialogsComplete.ar: A safe return I see? You no doubt have completed the mayor's request. Oh and his gratitude? Can't say I've ever trusted the word of a politician, but I will take it! Hah!
dialogsComplete.br: Um retorno seguro, eu vejo. Sem dúvida você atendeu ao pedido do prefeito. Hm? Sua gratidão? Não posso dizer que já confiei na palavra de um político, mas vou aceitar! Haha!
dialogsComplete.cns: 安全地回来了？毫无疑问你完成了市长的委托。噢？还带来了他的感激？虽然我从不信任政客们说的话，但我心领了！哈哈！
dialogsComplete.de: Eine sichere Rückkehr, wie ich sehe? Ihr habt zweifellos die Bitte des Bürgermeisters erfüllt. Oh, und seine Dankbarkeit? Ich kann nicht behaupten, dass ich jemals dem Wort eines Politikers vertraut habe, aber ich werde es annehmen! Hah!
dialogsComplete.fi: A safe return I see? You no doubt have completed the mayor's request. Oh and his gratitude? Can't say I've ever trusted the word of a politician, but I will take it! Hah!
dialogsComplete.fil: A safe return I see? You no doubt have completed the mayor's request. Oh and his gratitude? Can't say I've ever trusted the word of a politician, but I will take it! Hah!
dialogsComplete.fr: Le Maire de Flarine a eu l'air impressionné par votre vigueur.
dialogsComplete.id: Kembali dengan aman? Kamu pastinya telah memenuhi permintaan walikota. Oh, dia mengucapkan terima kasih padaku? Aku memang tidak percaya perkataan politisi, tapi aku akan menerimanya! Haha!
dialogsComplete.it: A safe return I see? You no doubt have completed the mayor's request. Oh and his gratitude? Can't say I've ever trusted the word of a politician, but I will take it! Hah!
dialogsComplete.jp: お、無事に帰ってきたようだな。市長の依頼をこなせるくらいだ。ずいぶん成長したぞ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 무사히 돌아오셨군요? 시장님의 부탁도 잘 마치고 오셨겠죠. 감사의 인사까지 받으셨다고요? 정치인의 말은 믿어본 적은 없지만, 뭐, 이번엔 받아들이죠. 하핫!
dialogsComplete.nl: A safe return I see? You no doubt have completed the mayor's request. Oh and his gratitude? Can't say I've ever trusted the word of a politician, but I will take it! Hah!
dialogsComplete.pl: A safe return I see? You no doubt have completed the mayor's request. Oh and his gratitude? Can't say I've ever trusted the word of a politician, but I will take it! Hah!
dialogsComplete.ru: Вижу, всё прошло успешно. Не сомневался, что ты справишься с заданиями мэра. Он передаёт благодарность? Ха! Польщён, но никогда бы не стал верить словам политика.
dialogsComplete.sp: Regresas sano y salvo por lo que veo. Sin duda has completado la solicitud del alcalde. Ah, ¿Qué me da su gratitud? No puedo decir que haya confiado alguna vez en la palabra de un político, ¡pero lo aceptaré! ¡Ja!
dialogsComplete.sw: A safe return I see? You no doubt have completed the mayor's request. Oh and his gratitude? Can't say I've ever trusted the word of a politician, but I will take it! Hah!
dialogsComplete.th: กลับมาอย่างปลอดภัยเหรอ? คุณไม่ต้องสงสัยเลยว่าคุณได้ทำตามคำขอของนายกเทศมนตรีเสร็จแล้ว โอ้ และความกตัญญูของเขา? พูดไม่ได้ว่าเคยเชื่อคำพูดนักการเมือง แต่ก็รับไว้เถอะ! ฮะ!
dialogsComplete.tw: 我看到了一個安全的回報？你無疑已經完成了市長的要求。哦，他的感激之情？不能說我曾經相信過政治家的話，但我會接受的！哈！
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi thấy một sự trở lại an toàn? Bạn chắc chắn đã hoàn thành yêu cầu của thị trưởng. Oh và lòng biết ơn của anh ấy? Không thể nói rằng tôi đã từng tin tưởng lời nói của một chính trị gia, nhưng tôi sẽ nhận lời! Hả!
