description.en: Take the Letter of Hynan to High-Dwarpet Liekyen in Darken.
description.ar: Take the Letter of Hynan to High-Dwarpet Liekyen in Darken.
description.br: Leve esta carta e encontre o Alto Dwarpet Liekyen na vila de Darkon.
description.cns: 拿着海楠的信件去找达肯的高阶矮人族利绮安吧！
description.de: Nimm diesen Brief und geh damit zu High-Dwarpet Liekyen am nordwestlichen Eingang von Darkon City.
description.fi: Take the Letter of Hynan to High-Dwarpet Liekyen in Darken.
description.fil: Take the Letter of Hynan to High-Dwarpet Liekyen in Darken.
description.fr: Aller remettre la Lettre de Hynan au Grand Dwarpet Liekyen, qui vit au nord-ouest de Darken.
description.id: Bawa Letter of Hynan ke High-Dwarpet Liekyen di Darken.
description.it: Take the Letter of Hynan to High-Dwarpet Liekyen in Darken.
description.jp: 手紙を持って、ダーコン町のハイドワーフ＜リエキエン＞の元に行こう。
description.kr: 다켄에 있는 하이-드워펫 리에키엔에게 하이난의 편지를 전해주세요.
description.nl: Take the Letter of Hynan to High-Dwarpet Liekyen in Darken.
description.pl: Take the Letter of Hynan to High-Dwarpet Liekyen in Darken.
description.ru: Нужно отнести письмо Робина Теля в Даркенбург высокому карлику Лийкину.
description.sp: Entrega la Carta de Hynan al Alto-Enano Liekyen en Darken.
description.sw: Take the Letter of Hynan to High-Dwarpet Liekyen in Darken.
description.th: นำจดหมายของ Hynan ไปยัง High-Dwarpet แล้วมอบให้ Liekyen ที่เมือง Darken
description.tw: 拿著信件去找高階杜爾沛利綺安吧！
description.vi: Mang theo lá thư của Hynan đến cho High-Dwarpet Liekyen ở Darken.

dialogsBegin.en: Many thanks for bringing me the Letter of Hynan! I would like you to deliver it to High-Dwarpet Liekyen.
dialogsBegin.ar: Many thanks for bringing me the Letter of Hynan! I would like you to deliver it to High-Dwarpet Liekyen.
dialogsBegin.br: Muito obrigado por me trazer a carta. E há alguém que você precisa conhecer.
dialogsBegin.cns: 真的很谢谢你帮我找回海楠的信！我还希望你能把信带给高阶矮人族利绮安。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich danke dir viermals für den Brief. Bitte bring ihn zu High-Dwarpet Liekyen in Darkon.
dialogsBegin.fi: Many thanks for bringing me the Letter of Hynan! I would like you to deliver it to High-Dwarpet Liekyen.
dialogsBegin.fil: Many thanks for bringing me the Letter of Hynan! I would like you to deliver it to High-Dwarpet Liekyen.
dialogsBegin.fr: Merci beaucoup d'avoir retrouvé la Lettre de Hynan. Maintenant, je crois qu'il y a quelqu'un que tu devrais rencontrer..
dialogsBegin.id: Terima kasih banyak telah membawakan saya Letter of Hynan! Aku ingin kamu mengirimkannya ke High-Dwarpet Liekyen.
dialogsBegin.it: Many thanks for bringing me the Letter of Hynan! I would like you to deliver it to High-Dwarpet Liekyen.
dialogsBegin.jp: 手紙を見つけてくれて、ありがとう。ところで、君に会ってもらいたい人がいるのだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 하이난의 편지를 가지고 와주셔서 정말 감사합니다! 이제 그걸 하이-드워펫 리에키엔에게 가져다주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Many thanks for bringing me the Letter of Hynan! I would like you to deliver it to High-Dwarpet Liekyen.
dialogsBegin.pl: Many thanks for bringing me the Letter of Hynan! I would like you to deliver it to High-Dwarpet Liekyen.
dialogsBegin.ru: Большое тебе спасибо за возвращение письма Робина Теля. Отнеси его высокому карлику Лийкину.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Muchas gracias por traerme la Carta de Hynan! Quiero que se la entregues al Alto-Enano Liekyen.
dialogsBegin.sw: Many thanks for bringing me the Letter of Hynan! I would like you to deliver it to High-Dwarpet Liekyen.
dialogsBegin.th: ขอบคุณมากที่นำจดหมาย Hynan กลับมาให้ฉัน! ฉันต้องการให้คุณส่งมันให้กับ High-Dwarpet ชื่อ Liekyen
dialogsBegin.tw: 真的很謝謝你幫我找回卷軸…對了！你可能還要去找一個人。
dialogsBegin.vi: Rất cám ơn vì đã mang Thư của Hynan cho tôi! Tôi muốn bạn giao nó cho High-Dwarpet Liekyen.

dialogsBegin.en: High-Dwarpet Liekyen can be found near the northwestern edge of town in Darken.
dialogsBegin.ar: High-Dwarpet Liekyen can be found near the northwestern edge of town in Darken.
dialogsBegin.br: Leve esta carta e encontre o Alto Dwarpet Liekyen na entrada noroeste de Darken.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你拿着这封信去达肯村庄的西北地区的入口找一个叫利绮安的高阶矮人族吧！
dialogsBegin.de: High-Dwarpet Liekyen befindet sich in der Nähe des nordwestlichen Stadtrandes von Darkon City.
dialogsBegin.fi: High-Dwarpet Liekyen can be found near the northwestern edge of town in Darken.
dialogsBegin.fil: High-Dwarpet Liekyen can be found near the northwestern edge of town in Darken.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il s'agit du Grand Dwarpet Liekyen, qui vit à l'entrée nord-ouest de Darken. Il était majordome de la famille de Hynan, et s'occupe désormais de ses reliques.
dialogsBegin.id: High-Dwarpet Liekyen dapat ditemukan di dekat tepi barat laut kota di Darken.
dialogsBegin.it: High-Dwarpet Liekyen can be found near the northwestern edge of town in Darken.
dialogsBegin.jp: この手紙を持って、ダーコン町の北西方の入り口にいるハイドワーフ＜リエキエン＞に会ってくれ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 하이-드워펫 리에키엔은 다켄 마을 북서쪽 가장자리에 있습니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: High-Dwarpet Liekyen can be found near the northwestern edge of town in Darken.
dialogsBegin.pl: High-Dwarpet Liekyen can be found near the northwestern edge of town in Darken.
dialogsBegin.ru: High-Dwarpet Liekyen can be found near the northwestern edge of town in Darken.
dialogsBegin.sp: El Alto-Enano Liekyen se encuentra cerca del límite noroeste de Darken.
dialogsBegin.sw: High-Dwarpet Liekyen can be found near the northwestern edge of town in Darken.
dialogsBegin.th: สามารถพบ High-Dwarpet ชื่อ Liekkyen ได้ที่ใกล้ๆขอบตะวันตกเฉียงเหนือของเมือง Darken
dialogsBegin.tw: 你拿著這封信去得肯村莊的西北地區的入口找一個，高階杜爾沛利綺安吧！
dialogsBegin.vi: High-Dwarpet Liekyen có thể được tìm thấy gần rìa phía tây bắc của thị trấn ở Darken.

dialogsAccept.en: You possess great potential, young Acrobat. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsAccept.ar: You possess great potential, young Acrobat. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsAccept.br: Você pode realizar seu sonho se assim desejar profundamente. Portanto, você se tornará um Jester se realmente quiser.
dialogsAccept.cns: 做得好弓箭手，再加把劲。
dialogsAccept.de: In dir steckt viel Potenzial, junger Acrobat. Arbeite weiter hart an dir und deine Träume werden in Erfüllung gehen.
dialogsAccept.fi: You possess great potential, young Acrobat. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsAccept.fil: You possess great potential, young Acrobat. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsAccept.fr: Tu peux faire que tes rêves se réalisent si tu y mets toute ta volonté. Alors seulement deviendras-tu Ranger.
dialogsAccept.id: Kamu memiliki potensi besar, Acrobat muda. Teruslah bekerja keras dan kamu akan mewujudkan impianmu.
dialogsAccept.it: You possess great potential, young Acrobat. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsAccept.jp: 若きアクロバットよ、心からの願いは、必ず叶う。君が心から願い努力を続ければ、きっと良い結果へと導かれるだろう。
dialogsAccept.kr: 당신은 정말 대단한 가능성이 있어요, 젊은 아크로뱃님. 계속 노력한다면 분명 꿈을 이룰 수 있어요.
dialogsAccept.nl: You possess great potential, young Acrobat. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsAccept.pl: You possess great potential, young Acrobat. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsAccept.ru: You possess great potential, young Acrobat. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsAccept.sp: Posees un gran potencial, joven Acrobat. Sigue trabajando duro y cumplirás tu sueño.
dialogsAccept.sw: You possess great potential, young Acrobat. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsAccept.th: Acrobat หนุ่มคุณมีศักยภาพที่ดี ทำงานอย่างหนักต่อไป และคุณจะรู้สึกถึงสิ่งที่คุณได้ฝันไว้
dialogsAccept.tw: 你很有潛力，年輕的雜技師。繼續努力，你會實現你的夢想。
dialogsAccept.vi: Bạn có tiềm năng lớn, Acrobat trẻ à. Hãy tiếp tục làm việc chăm chỉ và bạn sẽ thực hiện được ước mơ của mình.

dialogsDecline.en: Foolish Acrobat! Don't you realize your potential? See me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ar: Foolish Acrobat! Don't you realize your potential? See me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.br: Você está brincando comigo? Não entendo. Hmm.. Fale comigo novamente se mudar de ideia.
dialogsDecline.cns: 愚蠢的弓箭手！你还没意识到你的潜力吗？如果你改变了你的想法，请再次来见我。
dialogsDecline.de: Törichter Acrobat! Erkennst du dein eigenes Potenzial nicht? Komm wieder, wenn du deine Meinung änderst.
dialogsDecline.fi: Foolish Acrobat! Don't you realize your potential? See me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fil: Foolish Acrobat! Don't you realize your potential? See me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fr: Rapporter cette boucle d'oreille à Clagabole est vraiment important... Ce n'est pas très loin d'ici, va lui remettre s'il te plaît.
dialogsDecline.id: Acrobat bodoh! Apakah kamu tidak menyadari potensimu? Temui aku lagi jika kamu berubah pikiran.
dialogsDecline.it: Foolish Acrobat! Don't you realize your potential? See me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.jp: 何？　私をからかっているのか？　それともたかがセイントモーニングまで行くのが面倒なのか？　最近の若者の考えることはわからん・・
dialogsDecline.kr: 어리석은 아크로뱃이군요! 왜 자신의 잠재력을 모르시는 거죠? 마음이 바뀌면 다시 찾아오세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Foolish Acrobat! Don't you realize your potential? See me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.pl: Foolish Acrobat! Don't you realize your potential? See me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ru: Эх, ты! Неужели ты не видишь своего предназначения?! Если передумаешь, непременно меня найди.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Tonto Acrobat! ¿No te das cuenta de tu potencial? Vuelve a verme si cambias de opinión.
dialogsDecline.sw: Foolish Acrobat! Don't you realize your potential? See me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.th: เจ้า Acrobat โง่! คุณไม่ตระหนักถึงศักยภาพของคุณเลยงั้นหรือ? โปรดมาพบฉันอีกครั้งถ้าคุณเปลี่ยนใจ
dialogsDecline.tw: 愚蠢的雜技師！你沒有意識到你的潛力嗎？如果你改變主意再來找我。
dialogsDecline.vi: Acrobat ngu ngốc! Bạn không nhận ra tiềm năng của mình? Hãy gặp lại tôi nếu bạn thay đổi quyết định.

dialogsComplete.en: Hello, I am Liekyen. A former steward of the Hynan family. I now administer the keepsakes of the Hynan family. What have you got there?
dialogsComplete.ar: Hello, I am Liekyen. A former steward of the Hynan family. I now administer the keepsakes of the Hynan family. What have you got there?
dialogsComplete.br: Olá, sou Liekyen. Na verdade, eu era um mordomo da família Hynan. Mas estou administrando os bens dos Hynan hoje em dia. O que você tem aí?
dialogsComplete.cns: 啊？这不是信件吗？哈哈～真的很感谢你啊！其实我以前是海楠的管家啦！最近我都在收藏他的遗物。
dialogsComplete.de: Hallo! Ich bin Liekyen, ehemaliger Verwalter der Hynan Familie. Heutzutage verwalte ich allerdings nur noch die Andenken der Familie. Was ist das?
dialogsComplete.fi: Hello, I am Liekyen. A former steward of the Hynan family. I now administer the keepsakes of the Hynan family. What have you got there?
dialogsComplete.fil: Hello, I am Liekyen. A former steward of the Hynan family. I now administer the keepsakes of the Hynan family. What have you got there?
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh tu m'as ramené la lettre, merci ! Je la cherchais depuis tant d'années.
dialogsComplete.id: Halo, aku Liekyen. Mantan pelayan keluarga Hynan. Aku sekarang mengelola kenang-kenangan keluarga Hynan. Apa yang kamu dapat disana?
dialogsComplete.it: Hello, I am Liekyen. A former steward of the Hynan family. I now administer the keepsakes of the Hynan family. What have you got there?
dialogsComplete.jp: 手紙！？　おおお、ありがとう！！　実は、私はこれでも＜ハイナン＞様の執事だったんだ。今では＜ハイナン＞様の遺品を管理しているんだけどね。
dialogsComplete.kr: 안녕하세요, 저는 리에키엔입니다. 전에는 하이난 가문을 모시다가, 지금은 가문 유품을 지키고 있죠. 들고 계시는 그건 뭔가요?
dialogsComplete.nl: Hello, I am Liekyen. A former steward of the Hynan family. I now administer the keepsakes of the Hynan family. What have you got there?
dialogsComplete.pl: Hello, I am Liekyen. A former steward of the Hynan family. I now administer the keepsakes of the Hynan family. What have you got there?
dialogsComplete.ru: Привет. Я - Лийкин, бывший дворецкий Телей. Теперь я управляю небольшим музеем, посвященным этой славной семье. Что ты хочешь мне показать?
dialogsComplete.sp: Hola, soy Liekyen. Un ex mayordomo de la familia Hynan. Ahora administro los recuerdos de la familia Hynan. ¿Qué tienes ahí?
dialogsComplete.sw: Hello, I am Liekyen. A former steward of the Hynan family. I now administer the keepsakes of the Hynan family. What have you got there?
dialogsComplete.th: สวัสดีฉันเป็น Liekyen อดีตผู้รับใช้ของครอบครัว Hynan ตอนนี้ฉันดูแลของที่ระลึกของครอบครัว Hynan คุณมีอะไรบ้าง?
dialogsComplete.tw: 啊？這不是信件嗎？哈哈～真的很感謝你啊！其實我以前是海楠的管家啦！最近我都在收藏他的遺物。
dialogsComplete.vi: Xin chào, tôi là Liekyen. Từng là quản gia của gia đình Hynan. Bây giờ tôi quản lý các vật kỷ niệm của gia đình Hynan. Bạn có gì ở đó?

dialogsComplete.en: The Letter of Hynan?! This was the last lost keepsake of the Hynan family. How did you… no matter. The important thing is that it has been returned. I have been looking for this for a very long time.
dialogsComplete.ar: The Letter of Hynan?! This was the last lost keepsake of the Hynan family. How did you… no matter. The important thing is that it has been returned. I have been looking for this for a very long time.
dialogsComplete.br: A Carta de Hynan?! Esta foi a última lembrança perdida da família Hynan. Como é que voc... não importa. O importante é que ela foi devolvida. Já faz muito tempo que procuro por isso.
dialogsComplete.cns: 海楠的信？！这是海楠家族最后的纪念物了。你是怎么…无所谓了，现在最重要的是东西已经回来了。我真的已经找它找了太久了。
dialogsComplete.de: Der Brief von Hynan?! Das ist das letzte verlorene Andenken der Familie Hynan. Wie hast du... Egal. Das Wichtigste ist, dass es zurückgegeben wurde. Ich habe sehr lange nach ihm gesucht.
dialogsComplete.fi: The Letter of Hynan?! This was the last lost keepsake of the Hynan family. How did you… no matter. The important thing is that it has been returned. I have been looking for this for a very long time.
dialogsComplete.fil: The Letter of Hynan?! This was the last lost keepsake of the Hynan family. How did you… no matter. The important thing is that it has been returned. I have been looking for this for a very long time.
dialogsComplete.fr: Je conservais précieusement cette relique de Hynan, mais elle m'a été volée il y a des années et personne n'avait pu la retrouver à ce jour.
dialogsComplete.id: Letter of Hynan?! Ini adalah kenang-kenangan terakhir yang hilang dari keluarga Hynan. Bagaimana kamu ... lupakan saja. Yang penting sudah dikembalikan. Aku telah lama mencari ini.
dialogsComplete.it: The Letter of Hynan?! This was the last lost keepsake of the Hynan family. How did you… no matter. The important thing is that it has been returned. I have been looking for this for a very long time.
dialogsComplete.jp: この手紙が最後の遺品だったが、何年か前に盗まれてね。でもよく見つけてくれたね。　いやあ、ありがたい！　ご答礼にこれを進呈しよう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 하이난의 편지라고요?! 이건 잃어버린 하이난 가문의 마지막 유품이에요. 어떻게 이걸… 상관없어요. 중요한 건 이 편지를 찾아주셨다는 거죠. 정말 오래도록 찾아 헤맸습니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: The Letter of Hynan?! This was the last lost keepsake of the Hynan family. How did you… no matter. The important thing is that it has been returned. I have been looking for this for a very long time.
dialogsComplete.pl: The Letter of Hynan?! This was the last lost keepsake of the Hynan family. How did you… no matter. The important thing is that it has been returned. I have been looking for this for a very long time.
dialogsComplete.ru: The Letter of Hynan?! This was the last lost keepsake of the Hynan family. How did you… no matter. The important thing is that it has been returned. I have been looking for this for a very long time.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡¿La Carta de Hynan?! Este fue el último recuerdo perdido de la familia Hynan. ¿Cómo lo...? no importa. Lo importante es que se ha devuelto. La he estado buscando durante mucho tiempo.
dialogsComplete.sw: The Letter of Hynan?! This was the last lost keepsake of the Hynan family. How did you… no matter. The important thing is that it has been returned. I have been looking for this for a very long time.
dialogsComplete.th: จดหมาย Hynan?! นี่เป็นของที่ระลึกสุดท้ายของครอบครัว Hynan คุณทำได้อย่างไร... แต่ไม่สำคัญ สิ่งที่สำคัญคือมันต้องถูกส่งกลับไป ฉันได้มองหาสิ่งนี้มาเป็นเวลานานแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 這封信見識最後一個遺物，可是在前幾年被偷走了，終於找回來了。我給你一個禮物好了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Thư của Hynan ?! Đây là kỷ vật cuối cùng bị mất của gia đình Hynan. Làm thế nào bạn ... không quan trọng. Điều quan trọng là nó đã được trả lại. Tôi đã tìm kiếm thứ này trong một thời gian rất dài.

dialogsComplete.en: Now all of the keepsakes of the Hynan family are accounted for. Here, take this. This scroll will prove that you are ready to become a successor of the Ranger Hero.
dialogsComplete.ar: Now all of the keepsakes of the Hynan family are accounted for. Here, take this. This scroll will prove that you are ready to become a successor of the Ranger Hero.
dialogsComplete.br: Agora todas as lembranças da família Hynan foram contabilizadas. Aqui, pegue isso. Este pergaminho provará que você está pronto para se tornar o sucessor do Herói Ranger.
dialogsComplete.cns: 现在海楠家族的纪念物已经全部在这了。给你，拿好这个，这个卷轴能证明你已经可以成为游侠英雄的继承者。
dialogsComplete.de: Jetzt sind alle Andenken der Familie Hynan an ihrem Platz. Hier, nimm das. Diese Schriftrolle wird beweisen, dass du der Nachfolge des Ranger Helden würdig bist.
dialogsComplete.fi: Now all of the keepsakes of the Hynan family are accounted for. Here, take this. This scroll will prove that you are ready to become a successor of the Ranger Hero.
dialogsComplete.fil: Now all of the keepsakes of the Hynan family are accounted for. Here, take this. This scroll will prove that you are ready to become a successor of the Ranger Hero.
dialogsComplete.fr: Ceci est le Parchemin que seuls les descendants de ma famille peuvent avoir. Il t'appartient désormais.
dialogsComplete.id: Sekarang semua kenang-kenangan keluarga Hynan dipertanggungjawabkan. Ambil ini. Scroll ini akan membuktikan bahwa kamu siap menjadi penerus Ranger Hero.
dialogsComplete.it: Now all of the keepsakes of the Hynan family are accounted for. Here, take this. This scroll will prove that you are ready to become a successor of the Ranger Hero.
dialogsComplete.jp: 大事にしてくれ.
dialogsComplete.kr: 이로써 하이난 가문의 유품이 모두 돌아왔군요. 자, 이 두루마리를 받으세요. 레인저 영웅의 계승자가 될 준비가 되었다는 것을 증명해주는 두루마리랍니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Now all of the keepsakes of the Hynan family are accounted for. Here, take this. This scroll will prove that you are ready to become a successor of the Ranger Hero.
dialogsComplete.pl: Now all of the keepsakes of the Hynan family are accounted for. Here, take this. This scroll will prove that you are ready to become a successor of the Ranger Hero.
dialogsComplete.ru: Now all of the keepsakes of the Hynan family are accounted for. Here, take this. This scroll will prove that you are ready to become a successor of the Ranger Hero.
dialogsComplete.sp: Ahora toda la herencia de la familia Hynan está a buen recaudo. Toma esto. Este pergamino demostrará que estás listo para convertirte en un sucesor del Héroe Ranger.
dialogsComplete.sw: Now all of the keepsakes of the Hynan family are accounted for. Here, take this. This scroll will prove that you are ready to become a successor of the Ranger Hero.
dialogsComplete.th: ตอนนี้ของที่ระลึกของครอบครัว Hynan ถูกกำจัดไหมดแล้ว เอานี่ไป scroll นี้จะพิสูจน์ว่าคุณพร้อมที่จะกลายเป็นผู้สืบทอดของ Ranger Hero
dialogsComplete.tw: 現在海南家族的所有信物都算好了。來，拿這個，此卷軸將證明你已準備好成為浪人英雄的繼任者。
dialogsComplete.vi: Giờ đây, tất cả các kỷ vật của gia đình Hynan đều bị chiếm giữ. Đây, cầm lấy cái này. Cuộn giấy này sẽ chứng minh rằng bạn đã sẵn sàng để trở thành người kế nhiệm của Ranger Hero.

dialogsFail.en: I'm waiting for someone to deliver a letter to me. Do you have it? No? Then our business is concluded.
dialogsFail.ar: I'm waiting for someone to deliver a letter to me. Do you have it? No? Then our business is concluded.
dialogsFail.br: Estou esperando uma pessoa entregar uma carta para mim. É você? Não? Então não temos nada a tratar.
dialogsFail.cns: 我在等人送信。你有吗？没有？那么终止交易吧。
dialogsFail.de: Ich warte auf jemanden, der mir einen Brief übergibt. Hast du ihn? Nein? In dem Fall haben wir nichts zu besprechen.
dialogsFail.fi: I'm waiting for someone to deliver a letter to me. Do you have it? No? Then our business is concluded.
dialogsFail.fil: I'm waiting for someone to deliver a letter to me. Do you have it? No? Then our business is concluded.
dialogsFail.fr: As-tu quelque chose pour moi de la part de Kimel ? Es-tu sûr qu'il n'a rien dit?
dialogsFail.id: Aku sedang menunggu seseorang mengirimkan surat. Apakah kamu memilikinya? Tidak? Kemudian bisnis kita selesai.
dialogsFail.it: I'm waiting for someone to deliver a letter to me. Do you have it? No? Then our business is concluded.
dialogsFail.jp: ＜キメル＞から、何か伝えてくれと言われたはずなんだが・・・本当に何にもないのか？
dialogsFail.kr: 누군가가 편지를 전해주기로 했는데요. 당신인가요? 아니라고요? 그렇다면 말 걸지 말아 주세요.
dialogsFail.nl: I'm waiting for someone to deliver a letter to me. Do you have it? No? Then our business is concluded.
dialogsFail.pl: I'm waiting for someone to deliver a letter to me. Do you have it? No? Then our business is concluded.
dialogsFail.ru: I'm waiting for someone to deliver a letter to me. Do you have it? No? Then our business is concluded.
dialogsFail.sp: Estoy esperando a alguien que me entregue una carta. ¿La tienes tú? ¿No? Entonces aquí acaba nuestra conversación.
dialogsFail.sw: I'm waiting for someone to deliver a letter to me. Do you have it? No? Then our business is concluded.
dialogsFail.th: ฉันกำลังรอให้ใครสักคนส่งจดหมายมาให้ฉัน คุณมีหรือไม่? ไม่มี? งั้นธุระของเราก็จบแล้วล่ะ
dialogsFail.tw: 是基梅爾請你過來找我的嗎？應該有東西要給我吧？
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi đang đợi ai đó chuyển thư cho tôi. Bạn có không? Không? Vậy thì giao dịch của chúng ta kết thúc.

name.br: Caçando Monstros para recuperar o Karma
name.cns: 击杀怪物以减少罪恶值
name.fil: Mangaso ng Halimaw para makarecover ng Karma
name.jp: モンスターを狩ってカルマを回復させる
name.pl: Polowanie na potwory aby odzyskać Karmę
name.sp: Derrota a los Monstruos para recuperar Karma.
name.th: ล่ามอนสเตอร์เพื่อฟื้นค่า Karma
name.tw: 狩獵怪物以讓紅人狀態消失
name.vi: Săn quái vật để phục hồi Karma

description.en: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.ar: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.br: Caçando $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ recuperará seus pontos de Karma.
description.cns: 为了减少你的罪恶值，你要去击杀 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 回来。
description.de: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ jagen wird dein Karma wiederherstellen.
description.fi: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.fil: Ang Pang-huhuli ng $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ay makakapagpanumbalik ng iyong Karma points.
description.fr: Tu devrais chasser des $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s afin de récupérer les points de Karma.
description.id: Berburu $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ akan memulihkan poin-poin Karmamu.
description.it: Stai cacciando $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ per recuperare i tuoi punti Karma.
description.jp: カルマポイントを回復するため、$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を処罰して来てください。
description.nl: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.pl: Polowanie na $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ pozwoli odzyskać punkty Karmy.
description.ru: Твоя цель - $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, только так ты очистишь карму.
description.sp: Cazar $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ recuperará tus puntos de Karma.
description.sw: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.th: การล่า $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ จะกู้คืนคะแนน Karma ของคุณ
description.tw: 狩獵 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 將會恢復你的惡名點數。
description.vi: Săn $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ sẽ phục hồi điểm Karma của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsAccept.en: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.ar: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.

dialogsDecline.en: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.ar: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.br: Você ainda tem que pagar pelos seus pecados...
dialogsDecline.cns: 你还没有为你的罪恶付出代价...
dialogsDecline.de: Du musst noch immer für deine Sünden bezahlen...
dialogsDecline.fi: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.fil: Di mo pa bayad ang iyong mga kasalanan…
dialogsDecline.fr: Quand expieras-tu tes nombreux crimes ?
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu belum membayar untuk dosa-dosamu…
dialogsDecline.it: Devi ancora pagare per i tuoi peccati...
dialogsDecline.jp: いつになったら、この底知れぬ罪悪感から抜けられるのだろう？
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신은 아직 죗값을 치르지 않았으니...
dialogsDecline.nl: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.pl: Musisz najpierw zapłacić za swoje grzechy…
dialogsDecline.ru: Велики твои грехи…
dialogsDecline.sp: Todavía tienes que pagar por tus pecados...
dialogsDecline.sw: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.th: คุณยังไม้ได้ชดใช้บาปของคุณ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 你還沒有為你的罪付出代價…
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn vẫn chưa phải trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình…

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.br: Sua missão foi concluída. Seus pecados foram perdoados.
dialogsComplete.cns: 任务完成，你的罪恶已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Buße getan. Deine Sünden wurden dir vergeben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Questmu telah tercapai. Dosa-dosamu telah diampuni.
dialogsComplete.it: La Missione è terminata. I tuoi peccati sono stati perdonati.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 끝났습니다. 당신의 죄를 용서하지요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Боги одобрили твое деяние и простили тебе грехи.
dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น บาปของคุณได้รับการอภัยแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nhiệm vụ của bạn đã được hoàn thành. Tội lỗi của bạn đã được tha thứ.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

name.th: หน้าที่ของ Mercenary

description.en: Slay Babari and speak with Mercenary Instructor Hyuit in Eastern Flarine.
description.ar: Slay Babari and speak with Mercenary Instructor Hyuit in Eastern Flarine.
description.br: Mate Babari e fale com a Instrutora Mercenário Hyuit ao Leste de Flarine.
description.cns: 啊，去找助教之前，听说帕里附近最近出现了一些巨眼小怪，好像在欺负人民呢~你去猎杀那个巨眼小怪之后拿给那个助教吧，知道吗?
description.de: Besiege Babari und sprich danach mit [Mercenary Anweiser] Hyuit in Ost-Flaris.
description.fi: Slay Babari and speak with Mercenary Instructor Hyuit in Eastern Flarine.
description.fil: Slay Babari and speak with Mercenary Instructor Hyuit in Eastern Flarine.
description.fr: Se débarrasser de Babari, le monstre rôdant au sud de Flarine, puis se présenter à l'Instructrice des Mercenaires de Flarine.
description.id: Bunuh Babari dan bicaralah dengan Mercenary Instructor Hyuit di Flarine Timur.
description.it: Slay Babari and speak with Mercenary Instructor Hyuit in Eastern Flarine.
description.jp: フラリスで悪さをするモンスター＜ババリ＞が現れた。そのモンスターを退治してからウフラリス東広場にいるマーシナリー訓練所の助手に会いに行こう。
description.kr: 바바리를 처치하고, 플라리네 동부에 있는 머서너리 훈련 조교 휴잇과 대화하세요.
description.nl: Slay Babari and speak with Mercenary Instructor Hyuit in Eastern Flarine.
description.pl: Slay Babari and speak with Mercenary Instructor Hyuit in Eastern Flarine.
description.ru: Нужно убить Бобря и поговорить с инструктором борцов Хайятой в восточной Фларинции.
description.sp: Derrota a Babari y habla con la Instructora Mercenary Hyuit en Flarine Este.
description.sw: Slay Babari and speak with Mercenary Instructor Hyuit in Eastern Flarine.
description.th: สังหาร Babari และพูดคุยกับ Mercenary Instructor ชื่อ Hyuit ในเมือง Eastern Flarine
description.tw: 啊，去找助教之前，聽說布拉里斯附近最近出現了一些魔域怪，好像在欺負人民呢~你去獵殺那個魔域怪怪之後拿給那個助教吧，知道嗎？
description.vi: Giết Babari và nói chuyện với Mercenary Instructor Hyuit ở Eastern Flarine.

dialogsBegin.en: So... are you starting to understand how a Mercenary works now? Don't lose that Label of Technique I gave you!
dialogsBegin.ar: So... are you starting to understand how a Mercenary works now? Don't lose that Label of Technique I gave you!
dialogsBegin.br: Então, agora você entende como um Mercenário é? Não perca o Pergaminho de Técnica que eu lhe dei, pois é muito importante.
dialogsBegin.cns: 所以….你现在开始打算深入了解战士了吗？别把我给你的技艺签筏给丢了。
dialogsBegin.de: Also... verstehst du jetzt, wie ein Mercenary kämpft? Verliere nicht das Buch "Label of Technique", das ich dir gegeben habe!
dialogsBegin.fi: So... are you starting to understand how a Mercenary works now? Don't lose that Label of Technique I gave you!
dialogsBegin.fil: So... are you starting to understand how a Mercenary works now? Don't lose that Label of Technique I gave you!
dialogsBegin.fr: Alors, que penses-tu des techniques de Mercenaire ? Oui, tu aimerais en apprendre d'autres je te comprends...
dialogsBegin.id: Jadi... apa kamu mulai mengerti cara kerja Mercenary sekarang? Jangan kehilangan Label of Technique yang kuberikan padamu!
dialogsBegin.it: So... are you starting to understand how a Mercenary works now? Don't lose that Label of Technique I gave you!
dialogsBegin.jp: ここまで説明したから、だいたい理解できただろう？あ、このスキル事典の破片は必ず持っていてくれよ、それはとても大事なものなんだ。もし捨てたり失くしたりしたら、オレは責任負えないぜ！
dialogsBegin.kr: 자... 이제 전사가 어떤 직업인지 조금 감이 오시나요? 제가 드린 기술 비전서는 잃어버리지 말고 꼭 잘 간직하세요!
dialogsBegin.nl: So... are you starting to understand how a Mercenary works now? Don't lose that Label of Technique I gave you!
dialogsBegin.pl: So... are you starting to understand how a Mercenary works now? Don't lose that Label of Technique I gave you!
dialogsBegin.ru: So... are you starting to understand how a Mercenary works now? Don't lose that Label of Technique I gave you!
dialogsBegin.sp: Entonces... ¿ya estás empezando a entender cómo funciona un Mercenary? ¡No pierdas ese Libro de Técnica que te di!
dialogsBegin.sw: So... are you starting to understand how a Mercenary works now? Don't lose that Label of Technique I gave you!
dialogsBegin.th: ดังนั้น... คุณเริ่มที่จะเข้าใจการทำงานของ Mercenary แล้วใช่ไหม? อย่าทำ Label of Technique ที่ฉันให้คุณหายล่ะ!
dialogsBegin.tw: 那麼……你現在開始了解勇者的技能如何使用了嗎？不要丟了我給你的技術小紙條！
dialogsBegin.vi: Vậy ... bây giờ bạn đã bắt đầu hiểu cách hoạt động của Mercenary chưa? Đừng đánh mất Label of Technique tôi đã trao cho bạn!

dialogsBegin.en: Now for your next test! There is a creature named Babari just south of Flarine terrorizing the citizens there. Slay him, and seek out Hyuit, the Mercenary Instructor in Eastern Flarine.
dialogsBegin.ar: Now for your next test! There is a creature named Babari just south of Flarine terrorizing the citizens there. Slay him, and seek out Hyuit, the Mercenary Instructor in Eastern Flarine.
dialogsBegin.br: Agora, há o teste final. Você sabe onde os Militares estão, não sabe? Você também pode encontrar o Instrutor lá. O nome dele é Hew.. Hmmm... desculpe, mas esqueci o nome dele. De qualquer maneira, por favor vá lá e o encontre.
dialogsBegin.cns: 啊，现在只要去找训练教官旁边的助教辉羽就可以了，这是最后一个考验了。不管他说什么你就听着吧!
dialogsBegin.de: Nun zur nächsten Prüfung! Es gibt ein Masquerpet namens Babari. Es lebt direkt südlich von Flaris und terrorisiert die Bewohner der Stadt. Besiege es und suche anschließend die Mercenary Anweiserin Hyuit in Ost-Flaris auf.
dialogsBegin.fi: Now for your next test! There is a creature named Babari just south of Flarine terrorizing the citizens there. Slay him, and seek out Hyuit, the Mercenary Instructor in Eastern Flarine.
dialogsBegin.fil: Now for your next test! There is a creature named Babari just south of Flarine terrorizing the citizens there. Slay him, and seek out Hyuit, the Mercenary Instructor in Eastern Flarine.
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais pour l'instant, voici ta dernière épreuve. Tu te souviens où se trouve le l'Entraîneur des Mercenaires à Flarine ? Tu y trouveras aussi une Instructrice, son nom est... Euh en fait j'ai oublié son nom.
dialogsBegin.id: Sekarang untuk ujianmu berikutnya! Ada makhluk bernama Babari di selatan Flarine meneror warga di sana. Bunuh dia, dan cari Hyuit, Mercenary Instructor di Flarine Timur.
dialogsBegin.it: Now for your next test! There is a creature named Babari just south of Flarine terrorizing the citizens there. Slay him, and seek out Hyuit, the Mercenary Instructor in Eastern Flarine.
dialogsBegin.jp: じゃ、これが最後のテストだ。フラリス南にいる＜ババリ＞というモンスターを倒すことだ。市民が怖がっているらしい。そいつを倒し、フラリス東広場にいるマーシナリー訓練所の助手に話してみるといい。詳しくはそいつに聞いてみてくれよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 다음 시험을 치를게요! 플라리네 남부에서 바바리라는 괴물이 사람들을 괴롭히고 있어요. 바바리를 처치하고, 플라리네 동부에 있는 머서너리 훈련 조교 휴잇을 찾아가세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Now for your next test! There is a creature named Babari just south of Flarine terrorizing the citizens there. Slay him, and seek out Hyuit, the Mercenary Instructor in Eastern Flarine.
dialogsBegin.pl: Now for your next test! There is a creature named Babari just south of Flarine terrorizing the citizens there. Slay him, and seek out Hyuit, the Mercenary Instructor in Eastern Flarine.
dialogsBegin.ru: А теперь к делу. В южном пригороде Фларинции завелся циклопырь по кличке Бобрь. Убей его и расскажи об этом Хайяте, инструктору борцов из восточной Фларинции. Хорошо?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡A por tu próxima prueba! Hay una criatura llamada Babari justo al sur de Flarine que aterroriza a los ciudadanos de allí. Derrótalo y busca a Hyuit, la Instructora Mercenary en Flarine Este.
dialogsBegin.sw: Now for your next test! There is a creature named Babari just south of Flarine terrorizing the citizens there. Slay him, and seek out Hyuit, the Mercenary Instructor in Eastern Flarine.
dialogsBegin.th: เอาล่ะ สำหรับการทดสอบครั้งต่อไปของคุณ! มีสิ่งมีชีวิตชื่อ Babari ทางตอนใต้ของ Flarine สร้างความวุ่นวายให้กับชาวบ้านที่นั่น ฆ่าเขาและตามหา Hyuit, Mercenary Instructor ใน Eastern Flarine
dialogsBegin.tw: 啊，現在只要去找訓練教官旁邊的助教就可以了，這是最後一個考驗了。不管他說什麼你就聽著吧！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bây giờ bài kiểm tra tiếp theo của bạn! Có một sinh vật tên là Babari ở ngay phía nam Flarine đang khủng bố những người dân ở đó. Hãy giết nó, và tìm kiếm Hyuit, Mercenary Instructor ở Eastern Flarine.

dialogsBegin.en: Be careful, I hear Babari packs quite a punch!
dialogsBegin.ar: Be careful, I hear Babari packs quite a punch!
dialogsBegin.br: Tenha cuidado, ouvi dizer que Babari dá uma garrada e tanto!
dialogsBegin.cns: 小心点，我听说巨眼小怪打人一击非常疼！
dialogsBegin.de: Sei vorsichtig! Ich habe gehört, dass Babari ziemlich stark sein kann!
dialogsBegin.fi: Be careful, I hear Babari packs quite a punch!
dialogsBegin.fil: Be careful, I hear Babari packs quite a punch!
dialogsBegin.fr: Quoi qu'il en soit, pour lui prouver ta valeur, tu dois chasser une nouvelle espèce de monstre avant d'aller la voir. Il attaque les gens au sud de Flarine. Son nom est Babari.
dialogsBegin.id: Hati-hati, kudengar Babari mengeluarkan pukulan yang cukup keras!
dialogsBegin.it: Be careful, I hear Babari packs quite a punch!
dialogsBegin.jp: あ！マーシナリー訓練所の助手に会いに行く前に、フラリス近辺で悪さをしている変なモンスターが現れたようだ。そいつにパンチをお見舞いしてきてくれ！
dialogsBegin.kr: 조심하세요. 바바리는 엄청나게 세다고 들었어요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Be careful, I hear Babari packs quite a punch!
dialogsBegin.pl: Be careful, I hear Babari packs quite a punch!
dialogsBegin.ru: Be careful, I hear Babari packs quite a punch!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Ten cuidado, he escuchado que Babari es bastante fuerte!
dialogsBegin.sw: Be careful, I hear Babari packs quite a punch!
dialogsBegin.th: ระวังตัวให้ดี ฉันได้ยินมาว่า Babari อาจทำคุณน็อคได้!
dialogsBegin.tw: 小心點，我聽說巴巴莉很厲害！
dialogsBegin.vi: Hãy cẩn thận, tôi nghe nói Babari có một cú đấm khá mạnh!

dialogsAccept.en: Good luck! You're gonna need it!
dialogsAccept.ar: Good luck! You're gonna need it!
dialogsAccept.br: Boa sorte! Você vai precisar!
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你好运！你会需要它的！
dialogsAccept.de: Viel Glück! Du wirst es brauchen!
dialogsAccept.fi: Good luck! You're gonna need it!
dialogsAccept.fil: Good luck! You're gonna need it!
dialogsAccept.fr: Je te souhaite chance et sobriété !
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga berhasil! Kamu akan membutuhkannya!
dialogsAccept.it: Good luck! You're gonna need it!
dialogsAccept.jp: なんだかまだ頼りなさそうに見えるが…。グッドラック！幸運を祈るぞ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 행운을 빌어요! 정말 많은 행운을!
dialogsAccept.nl: Good luck! You're gonna need it!
dialogsAccept.pl: Good luck! You're gonna need it!
dialogsAccept.ru: Good luck! You're gonna need it!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Buena suerte! ¡La necesitarás!
dialogsAccept.sw: Good luck! You're gonna need it!
dialogsAccept.th: โชคดี! คุณต้องการมัน!
dialogsAccept.tw: 祝你好運！你會需要它的！
dialogsAccept.vi: Chúc may mắn! Bạn sẽ cần nó!

dialogsDecline.en: You can't give up now, Vagrant! You've come so far already!
dialogsDecline.ar: You can't give up now, Vagrant! You've come so far already!
dialogsDecline.br: Verdade? Bem, depende de você. Não é problema meu. Hehehe!
dialogsDecline.cns: 是吗?看你要不要继续做下去啦~反正对我来说无所谓啊!嘻嘻嘻。
dialogsDecline.de: Du kannst jetzt nicht aufgeben! Du bist schon so weit gekommen!
dialogsDecline.fi: You can't give up now, Vagrant! You've come so far already!
dialogsDecline.fil: You can't give up now, Vagrant! You've come so far already!
dialogsDecline.fr: Bon. Après tout je ne peux pas y faire grand-chose si tu n'y arrives pas ! Ha ha ha !
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu tidak bisa menyerah sekarang, Vagrant! Kamu sudah sampai sejauh ini!
dialogsDecline.it: You can't give up now, Vagrant! You've come so far already!
dialogsDecline.jp: 好きなようにするといいさ。おまえがテストを諦めようが続けようが、オレとは何の関係もない。
dialogsDecline.kr: 이제 와서 포기하실 건가요. 지금까지 잘하셨잖아요!
dialogsDecline.nl: You can't give up now, Vagrant! You've come so far already!
dialogsDecline.pl: You can't give up now, Vagrant! You've come so far already!
dialogsDecline.ru: Сдаваться поздно, бродяга! Все зашло слишком далеко!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡No puedes rendirte ahora, Vagrant! ¡Has llegado tan lejos!
dialogsDecline.sw: You can't give up now, Vagrant! You've come so far already!
dialogsDecline.th: คุณไม่สามารถยอมแพ้ได้ตอนนี้ Vagrant! คุณมาไกลมากแล้ว!
dialogsDecline.tw: 你現在不能放棄，見習生！你已經走到這一步了！
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn không thể từ bỏ bây giờ, Vagrant! Bạn đã đi rất xa rồi!

dialogsComplete.en: The citizens of Flarine are in your debt, Vagrant! Now the children of Flarine can play outside without having to worry about being eaten by that big bully!
dialogsComplete.ar: The citizens of Flarine are in your debt, Vagrant! Now the children of Flarine can play outside without having to worry about being eaten by that big bully!
dialogsComplete.br: Muito obrigado, ele estava realmente incomodando! Este é o teste final. É a respeito do dever do Mercenário. Mercenários são especialistas em combate corpo a corpo. Um Mercenário sempre...
dialogsComplete.cns: 它是一个很恶劣的怪兽，谢谢你帮我猎杀这个怪兽，最后一个考验是关于战士的任务，战士是使用近距离攻击
dialogsComplete.de: Die Bewohner von Flaris stehen in deiner Schuld, Vagrant! Endlich können Kinder wieder draußen spielen und müssen nicht fürchten, von diesem Ungetüm aufgefressen zu werden!
dialogsComplete.fi: The citizens of Flarine are in your debt, Vagrant! Now the children of Flarine can play outside without having to worry about being eaten by that big bully!
dialogsComplete.fil: The citizens of Flarine are in your debt, Vagrant! Now the children of Flarine can play outside without having to worry about being eaten by that big bully!
dialogsComplete.fr: Merci beaucoup, il était important de s'occuper de ce monstre. Voici la dernière leçon : elle est sur le rôle du Mercenaire, écoute-moi bien.
dialogsComplete.id: Warga Flarine berhutang budi padamu, Vagrant! Sekarang anak-anak Flarine bisa bermain di luar tanpa harus khawatir dimakan oleh si pengganggu besar itu!
dialogsComplete.it: The citizens of Flarine are in your debt, Vagrant! Now the children of Flarine can play outside without having to worry about being eaten by that big bully!
dialogsComplete.jp: あら！あの迷惑なモンスターを退治してきてくれたのですか？どうもありがとう！では、これが最後のテストです。最後はマーシナリーの任務に関する学習です。マーシナリーは近接攻撃の戦闘を主とする職業として、戦闘では最前衛で敵と戦います。
dialogsComplete.kr: 플라리네 시민이 큰 빚을 졌네요, 방랑자님. 이제 플라리네 아이들이 그 무서운 녀석에게 잡아먹힐 걱정 없이 밖에서 뛰놀 수 있게 되었답니다!
dialogsComplete.nl: The citizens of Flarine are in your debt, Vagrant! Now the children of Flarine can play outside without having to worry about being eaten by that big bully!
dialogsComplete.pl: The citizens of Flarine are in your debt, Vagrant! Now the children of Flarine can play outside without having to worry about being eaten by that big bully!
dialogsComplete.ru: Граждане Фларинции перед тобой в долгу, бродяга! Теперь фларинтийские детишки могут без боязни играть в полях!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Los ciudadanos de Flarine están en deuda contigo, Vagrant! ¡Ahora los niños de Flarine pueden jugar fuera sin tener que preocuparse por qué se los coma ese enorme matón!
dialogsComplete.sw: The citizens of Flarine are in your debt, Vagrant! Now the children of Flarine can play outside without having to worry about being eaten by that big bully!
dialogsComplete.th: ชาวเมืองของ Flarine ติดหนี้คุณ Vagrant! ตอนนี้เด็กๆ ชาวเมือง Flarine สามารถออกไปวิ่งเล่นข้างนอกได้โดยไม่ต้องกลัวว่าจะถูกกินโดยสัตว์ร้ายตัวใหญ่ตัวนี้อีกแล้ว!
dialogsComplete.tw: 布拉里斯的人欠你一個人情，見習生！現在布拉里斯的孩子們可以在外面玩，不用擔心被那個大惡霸吃掉了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Các công dân của Flarine đang nợ bạn, Vagrant! Giờ đây, những đứa trẻ của Flarine có thể vui chơi bên ngoài mà không phải lo lắng bị ăn thịt bởi kẻ bắt nạt đó!

dialogsComplete.en: Mercenaries are experts at close combat. We have the ability to stop an enemy's movement in order to close distance and keep them in range. This ability is called, Sneaker.
dialogsComplete.ar: Mercenaries are experts at close combat. We have the ability to stop an enemy's movement in order to close distance and keep them in range. This ability is called, Sneaker.
dialogsComplete.br: ...luta na linha de frente e protege os outros durante a batalha, mas mesmo um Mercenário tem suas limitações. Não seja excessivamente confiante.
dialogsComplete.cns: 战斗时，都会在最前方进行攻击，通常是保护其他职业的角色，但是决不适合进行范围攻击。
dialogsComplete.de: Der Mercenary ist ein Meister des Nahkampfs. Beispielsweise haben sie Fähigkeit, ihren Gegnger festzusetzen und sie so in ihrer Nähe zu halten. Diese Fähigkeit nennt sich Sneaker.
dialogsComplete.fi: Mercenaries are experts at close combat. We have the ability to stop an enemy's movement in order to close distance and keep them in range. This ability is called, Sneaker.
dialogsComplete.fil: Mercenaries are experts at close combat. We have the ability to stop an enemy's movement in order to close distance and keep them in range. This ability is called, Sneaker.
dialogsComplete.fr: Le Mercenaire est le meilleur combattant au corps à corps, et se trouve donc toujours en première ligne sur les champs de bataille en protégeant ses compagnons.
dialogsComplete.id: Mercenaries ahli dalam pertempuran jarak dekat. Memiliki kemampuan untuk menghentikan gerakan musuh untuk menutup jarak dan menjaga mereka tetap dalam jangkauan. Kemampuan ini disebut, Sneaker.
dialogsComplete.it: Mercenaries are experts at close combat. We have the ability to stop an enemy's movement in order to close distance and keep them in range. This ability is called, Sneaker.
dialogsComplete.jp: 敵に近づいて盾になり、他の仲間を守る役割もあります。ただし一人で全てをこなせるわけでなないので、一度にたくさんの敵と戦うことは難しいかもしれませんね。
dialogsComplete.kr: 머서너리는 근접 전투 전문이랍니다. 적의 움직임을 멈추고 거리를 좁혀 계속 공격 범위 안에 둘 수 있는 기술을 쓸 수 있죠. 스니커라는 기술이에요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Mercenaries are experts at close combat. We have the ability to stop an enemy's movement in order to close distance and keep them in range. This ability is called, Sneaker.
dialogsComplete.pl: Mercenaries are experts at close combat. We have the ability to stop an enemy's movement in order to close distance and keep them in range. This ability is called, Sneaker.
dialogsComplete.ru: Борцы - мастера ближнего боя. Мы умеем останавливать врага, резко сближаться с ним и входить в клинч. Это умение зовется "Сетью".
dialogsComplete.sp: Los Mercenarys somos expertos en combate cuerpo a cuerpo. Tenemos la capacidad de detener el movimiento de un enemigo con el fin de mantener la distancia y mantenerlos alejados. Esta habilidad se llama, Red Furtiva.
dialogsComplete.sw: Mercenaries are experts at close combat. We have the ability to stop an enemy's movement in order to close distance and keep them in range. This ability is called, Sneaker.
dialogsComplete.th: ทหารรับจ้างเป็นผู้เชี่ยวชาญในการสู้รบระยะใกล้ เรามีความสามารถในการหยุดการเคลื่อนที่ของศัตรูในระยะใกล้ และรักษาระยะของพวกมัน ความสามารถนี้เรียกว่า Sneaker
dialogsComplete.tw: 戰鬥時，都會在最前方進行攻擊，通常是保護其他職業的角色，但是絕不適合進行範圍攻擊。
dialogsComplete.vi: Mercenary là những chuyên gia trong chiến đấu gần. Chúng tôi có khả năng ngăn chặn chuyển động của kẻ thù để thu hẹp khoảng cách và giữ chúng trong tầm bắn. Khả năng này được gọi là Sneaker.

dialogsComplete.en: Our main strength is in one on one combat. If we can get within range of an enemy, you can bet they are going to feel it the next day! Welcome to the fold, Mercenary!
dialogsComplete.ar: Our main strength is in one on one combat. If we can get within range of an enemy, you can bet they are going to feel it the next day! Welcome to the fold, Mercenary!
dialogsComplete.br: Você é melhor lutando com um inimigo em um contra um. Se você tiver que lutar com muitos inimigos, outras pessoas terão que ajudá-lo. Parabéns! Você passou em todos os testes e agora é um Mercenário!
dialogsComplete.cns: 如果跟一群怪物战斗时，需要其他职业们的配合。恭喜你!完成了所有的考验，战士加油!
dialogsComplete.de: Unsere größte Stärke ist der Einzelkampf. Wenn wir in Reichweite eines Gegners kommen, wird er es mit Sicherheit am nächsten Tag noch spüren! Willkommen in unserer Gemeinschaft, Mercenary!
dialogsComplete.fi: Our main strength is in one on one combat. If we can get within range of an enemy, you can bet they are going to feel it the next day! Welcome to the fold, Mercenary!
dialogsComplete.fil: Our main strength is in one on one combat. If we can get within range of an enemy, you can bet they are going to feel it the next day! Welcome to the fold, Mercenary!
dialogsComplete.fr: Toutes mes félicitations te voilà devenu Mercenaire ! Mais si tu dois affronter une horde d'ennemis, n'oublie pas de former un groupe avec des aventuriers d'autres classes.
dialogsComplete.id: Kekuatan utamanya adalah pertarungan satu lawan satu. Jika bisa mendapatkan didalam jangkauan musuh, kamu bisa bertaruh mereka akan merasakannya keesokan harinya! Selamat datang di fold, Mercenary!
dialogsComplete.it: Our main strength is in one on one combat. If we can get within range of an enemy, you can bet they are going to feel it the next day! Welcome to the fold, Mercenary!
dialogsComplete.jp: もし、たくさんの敵と戦わなければない状況になったら、必ず他の職業の助けを借りることですよ。これで全てのテストが完了しました。おめでとうございます！ここに一人、勇敢なるマーシナリーが誕生したことを心より祝福します。
dialogsComplete.kr: 우리 머서너리들은 일대일 전투에 특히 강해요. 적에게 가까이 접근할 수만 있다면, 아주 다음 날 못 일어날 정도로 끝장을 내 줄 수 있죠! 정석 머서너리의 길에 오신 걸 환영합니다!
dialogsComplete.nl: Our main strength is in one on one combat. If we can get within range of an enemy, you can bet they are going to feel it the next day! Welcome to the fold, Mercenary!
dialogsComplete.pl: Our main strength is in one on one combat. If we can get within range of an enemy, you can bet they are going to feel it the next day! Welcome to the fold, Mercenary!
dialogsComplete.ru: Сильнее всего мы в бою один на один. Если у нас получается сблизиться с врагом - сто к одному, что назавтра у него будут болеть все кости! Добро пожаловать в наши ряды!
dialogsComplete.sp: Nuestra principal fortaleza está en el combate uno contra uno. Si podemos acercarnos a un enemigo, ¡puedes estar seguro de que lo sentirá! ¡Bienvenido al redil, Mercenary!
dialogsComplete.sw: Our main strength is in one on one combat. If we can get within range of an enemy, you can bet they are going to feel it the next day! Welcome to the fold, Mercenary!
dialogsComplete.th: ความแรงหลักของเราคือการต่อสู้แบบ 1 ต่อ 1 ถ้าเราอยู่ในระยะของศัตรู คุณจะเดาได้เลยว่าวันต่อไปมันจะรู้สึกยังไง! ยินดีต้อนรับสู่ฝูง Mercenary!
dialogsComplete.tw: 如果跟一群怪物戰鬥時，需要其他職業們的配合。恭喜你！完成了所有的考驗，勇者加油！
dialogsComplete.vi: Sức mạnh chính của chúng tôi là chiến đấu một chọi một. Nếu chúng ta có thể lọt vào tầm bắn của kẻ thù, bạn có thể đặt cược rằng chúng sẽ cảm nhận được điều đó dễ dàng! Chào mừng đến với nhóm chúng tôi, Mercenary!

dialogsFail.en: May I help you? I'm waiting for a pupil to take care of a little problem for me. I'm guessing that's not you? Then we have nothing further to discuss.
dialogsFail.ar: May I help you? I'm waiting for a pupil to take care of a little problem for me. I'm guessing that's not you? Then we have nothing further to discuss.
dialogsFail.br: Em que posso ajudá-lo? Estou esperando um aluno para cuidar de um pequeno problema para mim. Eu estou supondo que não é você? Então não temos mais nada para discutir.
dialogsFail.cns: 有什么可以帮你的吗？我一直在等待一个能帮我处理一些小问题的学生。我猜那个人不是你吧？好吧那我们没什么好说的了。
dialogsFail.de: Kann ich dir helfen? Ich warte auf einen Lehrling, der sich um ein kleines Problem kümmert. Das bist nicht du, oder? Dann gibt es nichts zu besprechen.
dialogsFail.fi: May I help you? I'm waiting for a pupil to take care of a little problem for me. I'm guessing that's not you? Then we have nothing further to discuss.
dialogsFail.fil: May I help you? I'm waiting for a pupil to take care of a little problem for me. I'm guessing that's not you? Then we have nothing further to discuss.
dialogsFail.fr: Je ne crois pas que tu me sois d'une quelconque aide pour l'instant.
dialogsFail.id: Dapatkah aku membantumu? Aku sedang menunggu seorang murid untuk mengurus sedikit masalah. Aku kira itu bukan kamu? Maka tidak ada lagi yang perlu kita diskusikan.
dialogsFail.it: May I help you? I'm waiting for a pupil to take care of a little problem for me. I'm guessing that's not you? Then we have nothing further to discuss.
dialogsFail.jp: わたしに何かご用ですか？ちょうど今、しなければならない仕事がたくさんありますので、特別な用事でなければ、おひきとりください。
dialogsFail.kr: 무슨 일이신가요? 저는 지금 작은 문제를 해결해 줄 방랑자님을 기다리고 있는데, 당신은 아니겠죠? 그래요, 그럼 더 드릴 말씀이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: May I help you? I'm waiting for a pupil to take care of a little problem for me. I'm guessing that's not you? Then we have nothing further to discuss.
dialogsFail.pl: May I help you? I'm waiting for a pupil to take care of a little problem for me. I'm guessing that's not you? Then we have nothing further to discuss.
dialogsFail.ru: Чем могу помочь? Я жду бродягу, одолевшего злобного Бобря. Это не ты? Тогда говорить не о чем.
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Puedo ayudarte? Estoy esperando a que un alumno se ocupe de un pequeño problema por mí. ¿Supongo que no eres tú? Entonces no tenemos nada más que hablar.
dialogsFail.sw: May I help you? I'm waiting for a pupil to take care of a little problem for me. I'm guessing that's not you? Then we have nothing further to discuss.
dialogsFail.th: ให้ฉันช่วยไหม? ฉันกำลังรอคอยให้ลูกศิษย์ทำงานเล็กๆ ให้ฉัน ฉันเดาว่าไม่ใช่คุณ? งั้นเราก็คงไม่มีอะไรต้องหารือกันแล้วล่ะ
dialogsFail.tw: 我可以幫你嗎？我在等一個學生為我解決一個小問題。我猜那不是你？那我們就沒什麼好討論的了。
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi có thể giúp gì cho bạn? Tôi đang đợi một học trò lo cho tôi một vấn đề nhỏ. Tôi đoán đó không phải là bạn? Vậy thì chúng ta không có gì để thảo luận thêm.

name.vi: Những bước đầu tiên của Vagrant (1)

description.en: Luda at the Shield Shop will give me 2,500 Penya when I hunt 15 Small Aibatts and return to him.
description.ar: Luda at the Shield Shop will give me 2,500 Penya when I hunt 15 Small Aibatts and return to him.
description.br: Luda da Loja de Escudos lhe dará 2,500 Penyas quando você matar 15 Aibatts Pequenos e retornar até ele.
description.cns: 击杀15只小独眼蝠后，去找防具商的路达，他会给你2500金币。
description.de: Luda vom Shield Shop gibt mir 2.500 Penya, wenn ich 15 Small Aibatts jage und zu ihm zurückkehre.
description.fi: Luda at the Shield Shop will give me 2,500 Penya when I hunt 15 Small Aibatts and return to him.
description.fil: Luda at the Shield Shop will give me 2,500 Penya when I hunt 15 Small Aibatts and return to him.
description.fr: Luda du Magasin de Boucliers me donnera 2500 penyas si je vais le voir après avoir tué 15 Jeunes Aibatt.
description.id: Luda di Shield Shop akan memberiku 2.500 Penya ketika aku berburu 15 Small Aibatt dan kembali padanya
description.it: Luda at the Shield Shop will give me 2,500 Penya when I hunt 15 Small Aibatts and return to him.
description.jp: 「スモール・アイバット」15匹を倒して＜シールドショップ＞のルダに報告すると報酬がもらえます。
description.kr: 작은 아이바트 15마리를 처치하고, 방어구 상점의 루다에게 가면 2,500페냐를 받을 수 있습니다.
description.nl: Luda at the Shield Shop will give me 2,500 Penya when I hunt 15 Small Aibatts and return to him.
description.pl: Luda at the Shield Shop will give me 2,500 Penya when I hunt 15 Small Aibatts and return to him.
description.ru: Luda at the Shield Shop will give me 2,500 Penya when I hunt 15 Small Aibatts and return to him.
description.sp: Luda de la Tienda de Escudos me dará 2,500 Penya cuando cace a 15 Aibatts Pequeños y vuelva con él.
description.sw: Luda at the Shield Shop will give me 2,500 Penya when I hunt 15 Small Aibatts and return to him.
description.th: Luda ที่ Shield Shop จะมอบ 2,500 Penya ให้ฉันเมื่อฉันล่า Small Aibatts 15 ตัวและกลับไปหาเขา
description.tw: 狩獵 15 隻小型獨眼蝙蝠後回去找盾牌店的路達，他會給我 2,500 金幣。
description.vi: Luda ở Cửa hàng Khiên Chắn sẽ cho tôi 2.500 Penya khi tôi săn được 15 Aibatts Nhỏ và quay trở lại anh ta.

dialogsBegin.en: Hello! I am Losha and I run the Food Shop. I sell food that is helpful for when you lose your Health Points (HP). Each type of food has a different recovery power and level requirement.
dialogsBegin.ar: Hello! I am Losha and I run the Food Shop. I sell food that is helpful for when you lose your Health Points (HP). Each type of food has a different recovery power and level requirement.
dialogsBegin.br: Olá! Eu sou Losha da Loja de Alimentos. Eu estou vendendo alimentos que é útil quando estiver com pouco HP. Cada alimento tem poderes de recuperação diferentes.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我在贩卖的食物是可以补充HP的。各种类都有不同的HP恢复量，如果你HP剩余较多时，每次食用的恢复量就会减少哦
dialogsBegin.de: Hallo, ich bin Losha. Ich verkaufe Nahrung und diese kann sehr hilfreich sein, wenn du HP verlierst. Nahrungsmittel regenerieren deine Gesundheit unterschiedlich schnell. Der Maximalwert kann aber nie überschritten werden.
dialogsBegin.fi: Hello! I am Losha and I run the Food Shop. I sell food that is helpful for when you lose your Health Points (HP). Each type of food has a different recovery power and level requirement.
dialogsBegin.fil: Hello! I am Losha and I run the Food Shop. I sell food that is helpful for when you lose your Health Points (HP). Each type of food has a different recovery power and level requirement.
dialogsBegin.fr: Bonjour, je suis Losha. L'Epicerie est à moi. Les plats que je vends sont très sains et vous rendent les PV perdus au combat.
dialogsBegin.id: Halo! Aku Losha, pemilik dari Food Shop. Aku menjual makanan yang berguna ketika Kamu kehilangan Health Points (HP). Setiap jenis makanan memiliki kekuatan recovery dan persyaratan level yang berbeda
dialogsBegin.it: Hello! I am Losha and I run the Food Shop. I sell food that is helpful for when you lose your Health Points (HP). Each type of food has a different recovery power and level requirement.
dialogsBegin.jp: 改めてご挨拶！フードショップのロシャです。ロシャは、HPを回復できる色んなフードを売ってるよ。フードによってHP回復量が決まっていて、最大回復量以上HPが残っている場合は、フードを食べた時の回復量が減っちゃうから気をつけてね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 안녕하세요! 저는 로샤라고 해요. 식료품 상점을 운영하고 있어요. 이곳에선 HP가 줄었을 때 도움이 되는 음식을 팔고 있어요. 음식마다 회복량과 사용 가능한 레벨이 다르니 잘 살펴보세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Hello! I am Losha and I run the Food Shop. I sell food that is helpful for when you lose your Health Points (HP). Each type of food has a different recovery power and level requirement.
dialogsBegin.pl: Hello! I am Losha and I run the Food Shop. I sell food that is helpful for when you lose your Health Points (HP). Each type of food has a different recovery power and level requirement.
dialogsBegin.ru: Я продаю еду, которая помогает быстро восстановить здоровье. Пища высокого уровня восстанавливает больше здоровья, но и подходит только опытным героям.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Hola! Soy Losha y dirijo la Tienda de Comida. Vendo comida que es útil para cuando pierdes tus Puntos de Salud (HP). Cada tipo de alimento tiene un poder de recuperación y un nivel requerido diferente.
dialogsBegin.sw: Hello! I am Losha and I run the Food Shop. I sell food that is helpful for when you lose your Health Points (HP). Each type of food has a different recovery power and level requirement.
dialogsBegin.th: สวัสดี! ฉันชื่อโลชาและฉันดูแล Food Shop ฉันขายอาหารที่มีประโยชน์เมื่อคุณสูญเสียพลังชีวิต (HP) อาหารแต่ละประเภทมีพลังฟื้นฟูและระดับความต้องการที่แตกต่างกัน
dialogsBegin.tw: 我在販賣的食物是可以補充生命的。各種類都有不同的生命恢復量，如果生命剩下最大恢復量以上時，每次食用的恢復量就會減少
dialogsBegin.vi: Xin chào! Tôi là Losha và tôi điều hành Cửa hàng thực phẩm. Tôi bán thực phẩm hữu ích khi bạn mất Điểm sức khỏe (HP). Mỗi loại thực phẩm có yêu cầu về cấp độ và sức mạnh phục hồi khác nhau.

dialogsBegin.en: You can eat the food by double-clicking it in your inventory. Also, you can add them to your hot keys. Please remember that once you eat food, you cannot eat again for a certain amount of time.
dialogsBegin.ar: You can eat the food by double-clicking it in your inventory. Also, you can add them to your hot keys. Please remember that once you eat food, you cannot eat again for a certain amount of time.
dialogsBegin.br: Você pode comer alimentos clicando-os duas vezes em seu inventário. Você também pode adicioná-las nas teclas de atalho. Lembre-se que depois que comer um alimento, você deve esperar alguns momentos antes de comer outra vez.
dialogsBegin.cns: 使用食物的方法，双点击物品栏位的食物，也可以透过拖曳到热键栏后使用。要记住使用过一次后，在一定的时间之内，不能马上再使用。
dialogsBegin.de: Du kannst die Nahrung essen indem du einen Doppelklick darauf machst. Ebenso kannst du es in die Schnellstartleiste ziehen. Dein Körper braucht ein paar Sekunden um das Essen zu verdauen. In diesem Zeitraum kannst du nichts essen.
dialogsBegin.fi: You can eat the food by double-clicking it in your inventory. Also, you can add them to your hot keys. Please remember that once you eat food, you cannot eat again for a certain amount of time.
dialogsBegin.fil: You can eat the food by double-clicking it in your inventory. Also, you can add them to your hot keys. Please remember that once you eat food, you cannot eat again for a certain amount of time.
dialogsBegin.fr: Pour manger, faîtes un double clique sur les plats dans votre inventaire. Vous pouvez aussi les glisser dans la barre de raccourcis. Après avoir mangé, vous ne pourrez plus vous nourrir pendant quelques secondes.
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu dapat memakan makanan dengan mengkliknya dua kali di inventorymu. Kamu juga dapat menambahkannya ke hot key. Harap diingat bahwa sekali Kamu makan, Kamu tidak bisa makan lagi untuk jangka waktu tertentu.
dialogsBegin.it: You can eat the food by double-clicking it in your inventory. Also, you can add them to your hot keys. Please remember that once you eat food, you cannot eat again for a certain amount of time.
dialogsBegin.jp: フードでHPを回復したい時は、インベントリにあるフードをダブルクリックするか、＜F1＞～＜F9＞のショートカットスロットにフードのアイコンをドラッグ＆ドロップして登録すると、登録したスロットに対応するキーを押すだけでフードで回復できるよ。一回フードを食べた後は、少しの間続けて食べることができないから覚えておいてね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 음식은 인벤토리에서 더블 클릭하면 먹을 수 있어요. 단축키에 등록해 두면 더 편리하답니다. 한 번 음식을 먹고 나면, 일정 시간 동안은 다시 먹을 수 없으니 주의해 주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: You can eat the food by double-clicking it in your inventory. Also, you can add them to your hot keys. Please remember that once you eat food, you cannot eat again for a certain amount of time.
dialogsBegin.pl: You can eat the food by double-clicking it in your inventory. Also, you can add them to your hot keys. Please remember that once you eat food, you cannot eat again for a certain amount of time.
dialogsBegin.ru: Чтобы съесть пищу, дважды щелкни по ней в инвентаре. Если хочешь, можешь вынести любимые блюда на панель быстрого доступа. И не забывай о перерывах между едой!
dialogsBegin.sp: Puedes comer la comida haciendo doble clic en ella desde tu inventario. También puedes arrastrarla a tus teclas de acceso rápido. Recuerda que una vez que comas, no podrás volver a comer durante cierto tiempo.
dialogsBegin.sw: You can eat the food by double-clicking it in your inventory. Also, you can add them to your hot keys. Please remember that once you eat food, you cannot eat again for a certain amount of time.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณสามารถกินอาหารได้โดยดับเบิลคลิกที่อาหารในคลังของคุณ นอกจากนี้ คุณสามารถเพิ่มคีย์ลัดเหล่านี้ลงในปุ่มลัดได้ โปรดจำไว้ว่า เมื่อคุณกินอาหารแล้ว คุณจะไม่สามารถกินอาหารได้อีกในระยะเวลาหนึ่ง
dialogsBegin.tw: 使用食物的方法，雙點選物品欄位的食物，也可以透過拖曳到熱鍵欄後使用。要記住使用過一次後，在一定的時間之內，不能馬上再使用。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có thể ăn thức ăn bằng cách nhấp đúp vào nó trong kho của bạn. Ngoài ra, bạn có thể thêm chúng vào các phím nóng của mình. Hãy nhớ rằng một khi bạn đã ăn thức ăn, bạn không thể ăn lại trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định.

dialogsBegin.en: Now that the lesson is over it is time for some combat! There are a lot of Aibatts to the north. Please hunt 15 Small Aibatts and go back to Luda at the Shield Shop.
dialogsBegin.ar: Now that the lesson is over it is time for some combat! There are a lot of Aibatts to the north. Please hunt 15 Small Aibatts and go back to Luda at the Shield Shop.
dialogsBegin.br: Agora que a lição acabou, está na hora de começar a batalha! Há vários Aibatts ao norte. Por favor, cace 15 Aibatts Pequenos e retorne a Luda da Loja de Escudos.
dialogsBegin.cns: 现在课程结束了，是时候进行一些战斗了！帕里北广场边有很多独眼蝠。击杀15只独眼蝠，完成后去找防具店的路达吧。
dialogsBegin.de: Nun, die Lektion ist vorbei. Warum fängst du nicht einfach mal an zu kämpfen. Es gibt hier eine Menge Aibatts im Norden. Bitte jage 15 Small Aibatt und gehe danach zurück zu Luda.
dialogsBegin.fi: Now that the lesson is over it is time for some combat! There are a lot of Aibatts to the north. Please hunt 15 Small Aibatts and go back to Luda at the Shield Shop.
dialogsBegin.fil: Now that the lesson is over it is time for some combat! There are a lot of Aibatts to the north. Please hunt 15 Small Aibatts and go back to Luda at the Shield Shop.
dialogsBegin.fr: Bien, assez parlé, place au combat! Il y a une multitude de jeunes Aibatts au Nord, pouvez-vous en chasser 15 ? Retournez voir Luda au Magasin de Boucliers quand votre mission sera remplie.
dialogsBegin.id: Karena pelajaran telah selesai, saatnya untuk pertempuran! Ada banyak Aibatt di utara. Silakan berburu 15 Small Aibatt dan kembali ke Luda di Shield Shop.
dialogsBegin.it: Now that the lesson is over it is time for some combat! There are a lot of Aibatts to the north. Please hunt 15 Small Aibatts and go back to Luda at the Shield Shop.
dialogsBegin.jp: これで必要なことは全部みんなに教わったかな？そろそろ街の外に出て、実際にモンスターと戦ってみよっか！北の方に行くと「アイバット」ってモンスターがいるよ。何種類かいるアイバットの中の「スモール・アイバット」を15匹を倒してみてね！15匹倒したら、＜シールドショップ＞のルダおじさんに報告しに行ってね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이제 기본 수업은 끝났어요. 직접 전투를 해봐야겠죠? 북쪽으로 올라가면 아이바트가 많이 있어요. 작은 아이바트 15마리를 사냥한 뒤, 방어구 상점에 있는 루다에게 가세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Now that the lesson is over it is time for some combat! There are a lot of Aibatts to the north. Please hunt 15 Small Aibatts and go back to Luda at the Shield Shop.
dialogsBegin.pl: Now that the lesson is over it is time for some combat! There are a lot of Aibatts to the north. Please hunt 15 Small Aibatts and go back to Luda at the Shield Shop.
dialogsBegin.ru: Вот и все! А теперь попробуй одолеть десятка полтора слабых сглазов и расскажи Людору, удобно ли сражаться его оружием. Хорошо?
dialogsBegin.sp: Ahora que la lección ha terminado, ¡es hora de un poco de combate! Hay muchos Aibatts al norte. Por favor, caza 15 Aibatts Pequeños y vuelve con Luda a la Tienda de Escudos.
dialogsBegin.sw: Now that the lesson is over it is time for some combat! There are a lot of Aibatts to the north. Please hunt 15 Small Aibatts and go back to Luda at the Shield Shop.
dialogsBegin.th: บทเรียนจบแล้ว ถึงเวลาต่อสู้แล้ว! ทางเหนือมี Aibatts เป็นจำนวนมาก ไปล่า Small Aibatts 15 ตัวและกลับไปหา Luda ที่ Shield Shop
dialogsBegin.tw: 現在所有的教育都結束了。你要戰鬥看看嗎？你往北方走，可以看到獨眼蝙蝠。請你打倒 15 隻獨眼蝙蝠嘍囉後，去找盾牌店的路達吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bây giờ bài học đã kết thúc, đã đến lúc chiến đấu! Có rất nhiều Aibatts ở phía bắc. Hãy săn 15 Aibatts nhỏ và quay trở lại Luda tại Cửa hàng Khiên Chắn.

dialogsAccept.en: Don't be too nervous and please check your equipment again before you venture out. Oh, and don’t forget to buy some food!
dialogsAccept.ar: Don't be too nervous and please check your equipment again before you venture out. Oh, and don’t forget to buy some food!
dialogsAccept.br: Não se preocupe e por favor verifique seu equipamento mais uma vez. Oh, e não esqueça o seu alimento.
dialogsAccept.cns: Don't be too nervous and please check your equipment again before you venture out. Oh, and don’t forget to buy some food!
dialogsAccept.de: Sei nur nicht nervös und vergiss nicht deine Ausrüstung und deine Vorräte zu überprüfen.
dialogsAccept.fi: Don't be too nervous and please check your equipment again before you venture out. Oh, and don’t forget to buy some food!
dialogsAccept.fil: Don't be too nervous and please check your equipment again before you venture out. Oh, and don’t forget to buy some food!
dialogsAccept.fr: Ne soyez pas si nerveux, vérifiez une nouvelle fois votre équipement. Oh, n'oubliez pas d'emporter un peu de nourriture!
dialogsAccept.id: Jangan terlalu gugup dan harap periksa kembali equipmentmu sebelum keluar. Oh, dan jangan lupa beli makanan!!!
dialogsAccept.it: Don't be too nervous and please check your equipment again before you venture out. Oh, and don’t forget to buy some food!
dialogsAccept.jp: あなたなら大丈夫、緊張しないで。持っている武器や防具は、ちゃんと装備できたかな？街の外は危険だから、フードも忘れずに持って行ってね！
dialogsAccept.kr: 너무 긴장하지 마시고, 출발 전에 장비를 다시 점검해 주세요. 음식 사는 것도 잊지 마시고요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Don't be too nervous and please check your equipment again before you venture out. Oh, and don’t forget to buy some food!
dialogsAccept.pl: Don't be too nervous and please check your equipment again before you venture out. Oh, and don’t forget to buy some food!
dialogsAccept.ru: Don't be too nervous and please check your equipment again before you venture out. Oh, and don’t forget to buy some food!
dialogsAccept.sp: No te pongas demasiado nervioso y vuelve a revisar tu equipo antes de aventurarte. ¡¡¡Ah, y no te olvides de comprar algo de comida!!!
dialogsAccept.sw: Don't be too nervous and please check your equipment again before you venture out. Oh, and don’t forget to buy some food!
dialogsAccept.th: อย่าวิตกกังวลเกินไป โปรดตรวจสอบอุปกรณ์ของคุณอีกครั้งก่อนออกเดินทาง อ้อ อย่าลืมซื้อของกินไปด้วยล่ะ!!!
dialogsAccept.tw: 別太緊張，出發前請再檢查一次你的裝備。喔，還有別忘了買些食物！
dialogsAccept.vi: Đừng quá lo lắng và hãy kiểm tra lại thiết bị của bạn trước khi ra ngoài. Ồ, và đừng quên mua đồ ăn về nhé!

dialogsDecline.en: This is only your first step into a larger world. Don't hesitate, go forth and defeat those Small Aibatts!
dialogsDecline.ar: This is only your first step into a larger world. Don't hesitate, go forth and defeat those Small Aibatts!
dialogsDecline.br: Este é o seu primeiro passo como um Vagrant. Não hesite, continue em frente.
dialogsDecline.cns: 现在是你踏出初心者第一步的时候，不用再犹豫了，快点去击杀独眼蝠吧。
dialogsDecline.de: Dies ist dein erster Schritt als Vagrant. Also zögere nicht und schreite voran!
dialogsDecline.fi: This is only your first step into a larger world. Don't hesitate, go forth and defeat those Small Aibatts!
dialogsDecline.fil: This is only your first step into a larger world. Don't hesitate, go forth and defeat those Small Aibatts!
dialogsDecline.fr: C'est vos premiers pas de vagabond. N'hésitez pas et allez de l'avant ! Revenez me voir si vous changez d'avis.
dialogsDecline.id: Ini adalah langkah pertamamu menuju ke dunia yang lebih besar. Jangan ragu, maju dan kalahkan Small Aibatts itu!
dialogsDecline.it: This is only your first step into a larger world. Don't hesitate, go forth and defeat those Small Aibatts!
dialogsDecline.jp: やっと冒険者として歩む第一歩なのに･･･。マドリガルのみんなで応援してるから、がんばってよぉ～！
dialogsDecline.kr: 이제 막 첫발을 내디딘 거예요. 주저하지 마시고, 용기를 내어 아이바트를 처치해 보세요!
dialogsDecline.nl: This is only your first step into a larger world. Don't hesitate, go forth and defeat those Small Aibatts!
dialogsDecline.pl: This is only your first step into a larger world. Don't hesitate, go forth and defeat those Small Aibatts!
dialogsDecline.ru: Эх, ты! Торговцы Фларинции так старались снарядить тебя для подвигов, а ты сглазов боишься!
dialogsDecline.sp: Este es solo tu primer paso en este mundo enorme. ¡No dudes y sigue adelante derrotando a esos Aibatts Pequeños!
dialogsDecline.sw: This is only your first step into a larger world. Don't hesitate, go forth and defeat those Small Aibatts!
dialogsDecline.th: นี่เป็นแค่ก้าวแรกของคุณสู่โลกที่กว้างใหญ่ อย่าลังเลเลย ออกไปและกำจัด Small Aibatts พวกนั้นซะ!
dialogsDecline.tw: 現在是你踏出見習生的第一步的時候，不用再猶豫了，快點去挑戰吧。
dialogsDecline.vi: Đây chỉ là bước đầu tiên của bạn vào một thế giới rộng lớn hơn. Đừng chần chừ, hãy ra tay và đánh bại lũ Aibatts Nhỏ đó!

dialogsComplete.en: Great! You completed your task wonderfully! I can see that you will be very famous one day. If you talk to me again, I will give you another task which will be a little bit harder.
dialogsComplete.ar: Great! You completed your task wonderfully! I can see that you will be very famous one day. If you talk to me again, I will give you another task which will be a little bit harder.
dialogsComplete.br: Legal! Você completou a tarefa de forma maravilhosa! Eu posso ver que você será uma pessoa muito especial em Flaris. Se você vier falar comigo novamente, eu te darei uma tarefa mais difícil.
dialogsComplete.cns: 太了不起啦！虽然你是第一次，不过你漂亮的完成任务了。下次我会拜托你比较难的任务。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast deine Aufgabe abgeschlossen. Wenn du nochmals zu mir kommst, werde ich dir eine weitere Aufgabe erteilen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Great! You completed your task wonderfully! I can see that you will be very famous one day. If you talk to me again, I will give you another task which will be a little bit harder.
dialogsComplete.fil: Great! You completed your task wonderfully! I can see that you will be very famous one day. If you talk to me again, I will give you another task which will be a little bit harder.
dialogsComplete.fr: Parfait ! Vous vous êtes acquitté de votre tâche avec brio. Je pressens que vous serez quelqu'un d'important à Flaris dans le futur. J'ai une mission un peu plus ardue à vous confier.
dialogsComplete.id: Bagus! Kamu menyelesaikan tugasmu dengan luar biasa! Aku dapat melihat kalau Kau akan menjadi sangat terkenal suatu hari nanti. Jika Kau berbicara denganku lagi, Aku akan memberimu tugas lain yang akan sedikit lebih sulit.
dialogsComplete.it: Great! You completed your task wonderfully! I can see that you will be very famous one day. If you talk to me again, I will give you another task which will be a little bit harder.
dialogsComplete.jp: 素晴らしい！初めての戦いだったのに、あれだけのモンスターを倒すなんて凄いな。あんたはこれからもっと強くなれるはずだ。次は、もっと難しい依頼を用意しておくから覚悟しとくんだな、ハハハ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 멋지게 해냈군요! 정말 잘하셨어요! 언젠가 아주 유명한 모험가가 되실 것 같아요. 다시 제게 말을 걸면, 조금 더 힘든 임무를 한 번 더 부탁하도록 할게요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Great! You completed your task wonderfully! I can see that you will be very famous one day. If you talk to me again, I will give you another task which will be a little bit harder.
dialogsComplete.pl: Great! You completed your task wonderfully! I can see that you will be very famous one day. If you talk to me again, I will give you another task which will be a little bit harder.
dialogsComplete.ru: Как оружие? Не подвело? Отлично! Чувствую, однажды ты прославишь наш город! Пожалуй, нужно дать тебе другое испытание, посерьезней.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Estupendo! ¡Has completado tu tarea maravillosamente! Puedo ver que algún día serás muy famoso. Si vuelves a hablarme, te daré otra tarea que será un poco más difícil.
dialogsComplete.sw: Great! You completed your task wonderfully! I can see that you will be very famous one day. If you talk to me again, I will give you another task which will be a little bit harder.
dialogsComplete.th: ดีมาก! คุณทำภารกิจของคุณสำเร็จอย่างยอดเยี่ยม! ฉันบอกได้เลยว่าวันหนึ่งคุณจะมีชื่อเสียงมาก ถ้าคุณมาคุยกับฉันอีก ฉันจะให้งานอื่นกับคุณซึ่งจะยากขึ้นนิดหน่อย
dialogsComplete.tw: 太了不起啦！雖然你是第一次，不過你漂亮的完成任務了。下次我會拜託你比較難的任務。
dialogsComplete.vi: Tuyệt quá! Bạn đã hoàn thành tuyệt vời nhiệm vụ của mình! Tôi thấy rằng một ngày nào đó bạn sẽ rất nổi tiếng. Nếu bạn nói chuyện với tôi một lần nữa, tôi sẽ giao cho bạn một nhiệm vụ khác khó hơn một chút.

dialogsFail.en: You should hunt 15 Small Aibatts. Please check in the quest window (Q Key) and return to Luda at the Shield Shop once you're finished.
dialogsFail.ar: You should hunt 15 Small Aibatts. Please check in the quest window (Q Key) and return to Luda at the Shield Shop once you're finished.
dialogsFail.br: Você deve caçar 15 Aibatts Pequenos. Por favor verifique a janela de quests e venha até a mim quando terminar.
dialogsFail.cns: 击杀15只小独眼蝠。任务窗口（Q键）可以查看任务的进度，完成后返回防具商店路达处。
dialogsFail.de: Du sollst 15 Small Aibatt erlegen. Bitte überprüfe dein Quest Logbuch und komm erneut zu mir.
dialogsFail.fi: You should hunt 15 Small Aibatts. Please check in the quest window (Q Key) and return to Luda at the Shield Shop once you're finished.
dialogsFail.fil: You should hunt 15 Small Aibatts. Please check in the quest window (Q Key) and return to Luda at the Shield Shop once you're finished.
dialogsFail.fr: Vous devez chasser 15 jeunes Aibatts. Vérifier votre fenêtre de quête et allez voir Luda le vendeur de Boucliers dès que votre tâche est achevée.
dialogsFail.id: Kamu harus berburu 15 Small Aibatt. Silakan periksa di Quest Window (Tombol Q) dan kembali ke Luda di Shield Shop setelah Kamu selesai.
dialogsFail.it: You should hunt 15 Small Aibatts. Please check in the quest window (Q Key) and return to Luda at the Shield Shop once you're finished.
dialogsFail.jp: まだ足りないぞ？「スモール・アイバット」15匹を倒すんだ。クエストダイアリーで倒した数が確認できるから、がんばれよ！
dialogsFail.kr: 작은 아이바트를 15마리 사냥해 주세요. 퀘스트 창(Q)에서 진행 상황을 확인하고, 퀘스트가 완료되면 방어구 상점의 루다에게 돌아가세요.
dialogsFail.nl: You should hunt 15 Small Aibatts. Please check in the quest window (Q Key) and return to Luda at the Shield Shop once you're finished.
dialogsFail.pl: You should hunt 15 Small Aibatts. Please check in the quest window (Q Key) and return to Luda at the Shield Shop once you're finished.
dialogsFail.ru: Убей полтора десятка слабых сглазов и поговори с Людором. Если забудешь, что нужно сделать, посмотри в дневнике (Q)!
dialogsFail.sp: Debes cazar 15 Aibatts Pequeños. Por favor revisa tu ventana de Misiones (Tecla Q) y vuelve con Luda a la Tienda de Escudos cuando acabes.
dialogsFail.sw: You should hunt 15 Small Aibatts. Please check in the quest window (Q Key) and return to Luda at the Shield Shop once you're finished.
dialogsFail.th: คุณควรล่า Small Aibatts 15 ตัว โปรดตรวจสอบในหน้าต่างเควส (คีย์ Q) และกลับไปหา Luda ที่ Shield Shop เมื่อคุณทำภารกิจเสร็จแล้ว
dialogsFail.tw: 必須打倒獨眼蝙蝠嘍囉 15 隻喔。任務視窗可以確認任務的進行狀況，所以你請你確認好，再過來吧。
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn nên săn 15 Aibatts nhỏ. Vui lòng kiểm tra quest window (Phím Q) và quay lại Luda tại Cửa hàng Khiên Chắn khi bạn đã hoàn thành.
