dialogsBegin.en: Look, I have no problem giving you the ID card… I just do not want to see you die… But if you really insist, then fine. Hunt some Watangka and I will give you the card.
dialogsBegin.ar: Look, I have no problem giving you the ID card… I just do not want to see you die… But if you really insist, then fine. Hunt some Watangka and I will give you the card.
dialogsBegin.br: Veja bem, não há problema algum em lhe entregar o cartão de identificação. Só não quero ver você morrer. Porém, se você insiste tanto, então tudo bem. Cace um Watangka e então lhe darei o cartão.
dialogsBegin.cns: 给你通行卡是不成问题啦～可是我不希望你这个人去送死呢。好吧...不然我来看看你有没有那个能力进去好了...你想证明你的实力给我看的话，去猎杀巫民吧！
dialogsBegin.de: Ich habe kein Problem damit, dir die ID Karte zu geben aber... Ich will nicht, dass noch weitere Menschen sterben... Aber gut. Wenn du unbedingt in diese Mine willst, dann jage ein paar Watangka und ich gebe dir die ID Karte.
dialogsBegin.fi: Look, I have no problem giving you the ID card… I just do not want to see you die… But if you really insist, then fine. Hunt some Watangka and I will give you the card.
dialogsBegin.fil: Tingnan mo, wala akong problema ibigay sa'yo ang ID card… ayokong makita kang mamatay… Pero kung talagang pipilitin mo, sige. Papatayin mo muna ang ilang Watangka at ibibigay ko sa'yo ang card.
dialogsBegin.fr: Oh, te donner une carte d'accès… hic… non … hic ... pas compliqué. Mais moi … hic… pas envie. Je ne veux pas être responsable de ta mort… hic… bon… hic… Ok. Mais avant, pour me prouver que tu as l'instinct de survie, chasse-moi donc quelques Watangka... hic...
dialogsBegin.id: Dengar, aku tidak masalah memberimu kartu identitas… Aku hanya tidak ingin melihatmu mati… Tapi jika kamu benar-benar bersikeras, tidak apa-apa. Burulah beberapa Watangka dan aku akan memberikan kartu.
dialogsBegin.it: Look, I have no problem giving you the ID card… I just do not want to see you die… But if you really insist, then fine. Hunt some Watangka and I will give you the card.
dialogsBegin.jp:
この通行証を君に渡すのは、たやすいことだ。
だが俺は、人が無駄に死んで行くのを黙って見過ごすわけにはいかない。まず、君があそこへ行くだけの実力があるか見せてもらおう。
ワタングカを捕まえて、ここへ帰って来られたら、通行証を渡そうじゃないか。
dialogsBegin.kr: 저기, ID 카드를 주기 싫어서 그러는 건 아니에요… 그저 당신이 죽는 걸 보고 싶지 않다고요. 그래도 정말 가고 싶다면 어쩔 수 없죠. 와탕카를 사냥해 오세요. 그럼 ID 카드를 드릴게요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Look, I have no problem giving you the ID card… I just do not want to see you die… But if you really insist, then fine. Hunt some Watangka and I will give you the card.
dialogsBegin.pl: Słuchaj, nie mam problemu z przekazaniem ci karty identyfikacyjnej… Po prostu nie chcę widzieć, jak umierasz… Ale jeśli naprawdę nalegasz, w porządku. Upoluj trochę Watangka, a dam ci kartę.
dialogsBegin.ru: Послушай, я не против дать тебе карту… просто не хочу, чтобы ты погиб… Но если ты так настаиваешь — ладно. Охоться на Ва-танка, и я отдам тебе карту.
dialogsBegin.sp: Mira, no tengo ningún problema en darte la tarjeta ID... es solo que no quiero verte morir ... Pero si de verdad insistes, está bien. Caza unos cuántos Watangka y te daré la tarjeta.
dialogsBegin.sw: Look, I have no problem giving you the ID card… I just do not want to see you die… But if you really insist, then fine. Hunt some Watangka and I will give you the card.
dialogsBegin.th: ฟังนะ ฉันให้บัตรคุณได้ ไม่มีปัญหาหรอก แต่แค่ไม่อยากเห็นคุณต้องตาย ถ้าคุณยืนยันจะทำมันจริงๆ ล่ะก็ จงล่า Watangka จำนวนหนึ่ง และฉันจะให้การ์ดแก่คุณ
dialogsBegin.tw: 聽著，我不是不能把通行卡給你……我只是不想看到你送命……但如果你真的堅持，那好吧。去獵殺一些瓦坦卡，我就把卡給你。
dialogsBegin.vi: Nghe này, tôi không có vấn đề gì với việc đưa thẻ ID cho bạn… Tôi chỉ không muốn bạn đi đời thôi… Nhưng nếu bạn thực sự muốn vậy thì được thôi. Săn vài con Watangka đi rồi tôi sẽ đưa thẻ cho bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: If you can hunt Watangka you can probably hunt Violet Trillipy.
dialogsBegin.ar: If you can hunt Watangka you can probably hunt Violet Trillipy.
dialogsBegin.br: Se você puder caçar um Watangka, provavelmente poderá caçar uma Trillipy Violeta.
dialogsBegin.cns: 嗯！像他这种的话，应该跟毒蜥蜴有得比啦！
dialogsBegin.de: Wenn du Watangkas jagen kannst, dann sicher auch die Violet Trillipy.
dialogsBegin.fi: If you can hunt Watangka you can probably hunt Violet Trillipy.
dialogsBegin.fil: Kung kaya mong manghuli ng Watangka, malamang kakayanin mo ring hulihin ang Violet Trillipy.
dialogsBegin.fr: Si tu es capable de les chasser euh… hic… ben tu pourras chasser les Trillipys Violets !
dialogsBegin.id: Jika kamu bisa memburu Watangka kamu mungkin bisa berburu Violet Trillipy.
dialogsBegin.it: If you can hunt Watangka you can probably hunt Violet Trillipy.
dialogsBegin.jp: ワタングカくらい暴悪なやつらを捕まえる事が出来るなら＜バイオレットトリルピ＞ を捕まえられるかもしれん。
dialogsBegin.kr: 와탕카를 사냥할 수 있다면 보라색 트릴리피도 사냥할 수 있을 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: If you can hunt Watangka you can probably hunt Violet Trillipy.
dialogsBegin.pl: Jeśli dasz radę upolować Watangkę, prawdopodobnie możesz również polować na Violet Trillipy.
dialogsBegin.ru: Справишься с Ва-танка - справишься и с хватоглотами. По рукам?
dialogsBegin.sp: Si puedes derrotar a los Watangka, probablemente también puedas derrotar a los Trillipys Violetas.
dialogsBegin.sw: If you can hunt Watangka you can probably hunt Violet Trillipy.
dialogsBegin.th: ถ้าคุณสามารถล่า Watangka คุณอาจจะล่า Violet Trillipy ได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 嗯！想他這種的話，應該跟劇毒蜈蚣有得比啦！
dialogsBegin.vi: Nếu bạn có thể săn Watangka, bạn có thể săn Violet Trillipy.

dialogsDecline.de: Hmm… Violet Trillipy könnten stärker als Watangkas sein.
dialogsDecline.fi: Hmm… Violet Trillipy may be stronger than Watangka.
dialogsDecline.fil: Hmmm… Maaaring mas malakas ang Violet Trillipy kaysa Watangka.
dialogsDecline.fr: Hmm… les Trillipys Pourpres sont bien plus forts…
dialogsDecline.id: Hmm…Violet Trillipy mungkin lebih kuat dari Watangka.
dialogsDecline.it: Hmm… Violet Trillipy may be stronger than Watangka.
dialogsDecline.jp: 出直してくることだな。ワタングカを相手に出来ないようでは、わざわざ死にに行くようなものだ。

dialogsComplete.en: Alright, here is the ID card. Just make sure you come out of there alive. I do not need a guilty conscience.
dialogsComplete.ar: Alright, here is the ID card. Just make sure you come out of there alive. I do not need a guilty conscience.
dialogsComplete.br: Tudo bem, aqui está o cartão de identificação. Somente certifique-se de sair vivo de lá. Não preciso de uma dor na consciência.
dialogsComplete.cns: 好吧！通行卡给你...不要死着回来喔～祝你好运喔。
dialogsComplete.de: Okay. Hier hast du die ID Karte. Bitte komm dort lebend wieder raus. Ich möchte dich nicht auf dem Gewissen haben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Alright, here is the ID card. Just make sure you come out of there alive. I do not need a guilty conscience.
dialogsComplete.fil: Sige, heto ang ID card. Siguraduhin mo lang na makalabas ka roon nang buhay. Ayokong may mabagabag na konsensya.
dialogsComplete.fr: D'accord, voici ta carte d'accès. Mais que tu me reviennes vivant !
dialogsComplete.id: Baiklah, ini dia kartu identitasnya. Pastikan kamu keluar dari sana hidup-hidup. Aku tidak ingin merasa bersalah.
dialogsComplete.it: Alright, here is the ID card. Just make sure you come out of there alive. I do not need a guilty conscience.
dialogsComplete.jp:
見事な手並みだな。これなら通行証を渡してもよさそうだ。
いいか、必ず生きて帰ってくるんだぞ！
dialogsComplete.kr: 좋아요, 여기 ID 카드를 빌려주죠. 하지만 꼭 살아서 돌아오세요. 양심의 가책을 느끼고 싶지는 않거든요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Alright, here is the ID card. Just make sure you come out of there alive. I do not need a guilty conscience.
dialogsComplete.pl: Dobrze, oto karta identyfikacyjna. Tylko upewnij się, że wyjdziesz stamtąd żywy. Nie potrzebuję wyrzutów sumienia.
dialogsComplete.ru: Ну что же, держи карту доступа. Надеюсь, ты не сгинешь в проклятых шахтах. Не хочется брать грех на душу.
dialogsComplete.sp: Muy bien, aquí esta la tarjeta ID. Asegúrate de volver con vida. No necesito quedarme con una mala conciencia.
dialogsComplete.sw: Alright, here is the ID card. Just make sure you come out of there alive. I do not need a guilty conscience.
dialogsComplete.th: เอาล่ะ นี่คือ ID card เพียงให้แน่ใจว่าคุณจะออกมาจากที่นั่น ฉันไม่จำเป็นต้องสำนึกผิดในสิ่งที่ฉันทำ
dialogsComplete.tw: 好吧！通行卡給你…不給死著回來喔～祝你好運喔。
dialogsComplete.vi: Được rồi, đây là thẻ căn cước. Chỉ cần đảm bảo rằng bạn sống sót ra khỏi đó. Tôi không cần lương tâm cắn rứt.

dialogsFail.en: I guess we all get tired sometime?

dialogsFail.br: Acho que todos cansamos algumas vezes, não?
dialogsFail.cns: 咯～累的话休息吧！人生有什么意义呢？
dialogsFail.de: Ich schätze, wir brauchen alle manchmal eine Pause.
dialogsFail.fi: I guess we all get tired sometime?
dialogsFail.fil: Siguro napapagod din tayong lahat paminsan-minsan?
dialogsFail.fr: Hic… Pourquoi… hic… ne ferais-tu pas une pause… Je te propose même à boire… hic…
dialogsFail.id: Aku kira kita semua lelah kadang-kadang.?
dialogsFail.it: I guess we all get tired sometime?
dialogsFail.jp: なんだ？　もう音を上げるのか？
dialogsFail.kr: 때론 우리 모두 피곤할 때가 있잖아요.
dialogsFail.nl: I guess we all get tired sometime?
dialogsFail.pl: Chyba wszyscy kiedyś się zmęczymy.?
dialogsFail.ru: Видать, мы все когда-нибудь устаём?
dialogsFail.sp: Supongo que todos nos cansamos alguna vez.
dialogsFail.sw: I guess we all get tired sometime?
dialogsFail.th: ฉันเดาว่าเราคงจะเหนื่อยกันบ้างแล้วแหละ?
dialogsFail.tw: 看來每個人都有累的時候呢？
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi nghĩ rằng tất cả chúng ta đều sẽ có lúc cảm thấy mệt mỏi chứ?

dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Leí la revelación y habla del renacimiento de Iblis como el desencadenante del fin del mundo!
dialogsBegin.sw: I read the revelation and it speaks of the revival of Iblis as the trigger to the end of the world!
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันอ่านโองการนี้และพูดถึงการฟื้นคืนชีพของอิบลิสว่าเป็นต้นเหตุของจุดจบของโลก!
dialogsBegin.tw: 伊普里司啟示錄拓本的內容，竟然預言世界末日的到來，如果讓伊普里司復活，那這世界就沒希望了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đã đọc sách Khải Huyền và nó nói về sự hồi sinh của Iblis như là nguyên nhân dẫn đến ngày tận thế!

dialogsBegin.en: If this is true, we have to stop it! This could be worse than the Hero Wars of long ago.
dialogsBegin.ar: If this is true, we have to stop it! This could be worse than the Hero Wars of long ago.
dialogsBegin.br: Se isto for verdade, temos que detê-la! Isto poderia ser pior que a Guerra dos Heróis, acontecida há muito tempo.
dialogsBegin.cns: 一定要竭力所能阻止他复活才行！
dialogsBegin.de: Wenn das wahr ist, müssen wir es verhindern! Diese Sache könnte noch viel schlimmer als der Krieg der Helden damals werden.
dialogsBegin.fi: If this is true, we have to stop it! This could be worse than the Hero Wars of long ago.
dialogsBegin.fil: Kung totoo ito, kailangan natin pigilan! Maaaring mas masahol pa ito kaysa sa Hero Wars noon.
dialogsBegin.fr: S’il s’avère que c’est vrai, nous devons empêcher cela ! Car sinon des choses bien plus affreuses nous arriveront. Plus affreuses et dangereuses encore que lors de la Guerre des Héros.
dialogsBegin.id: Jika ini benar, kita harus menghentikannya! Ini bisa lebih buruk daripada Hero Wars di masa lalu.
dialogsBegin.it: If this is true, we have to stop it! This could be worse than the Hero Wars of long ago.
dialogsBegin.jp: この予言詩では、イブリスが復活すること、それによって世界が滅亡することが予言されています。もしもこれが事実なら、必ず復活を阻止しなければ……。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 예언이 사실이라면 꼭 막아야 해요! 오래전 벌어졌던 영웅 전쟁보다 더 위험한 상황을 맞게 될지도 몰라요.
dialogsBegin.nl: If this is true, we have to stop it! This could be worse than the Hero Wars of long ago.
dialogsBegin.pl: Jeśli to prawda, musimy to powstrzymać! To może być gorsze niż dawne Wojny bohaterów
dialogsBegin.ru: Если это правда, нужно… нужно этому помешать! По сравнению с Ужоссом Воскрешенным древняя Геройская война кажется пустяком…
dialogsBegin.sp: Si esto es cierto, ¡tenemos que detenerlo! Esto podría ser peor que las Guerras de los Héroes de hace mucho tiempo.
dialogsBegin.sw: If this is true, we have to stop it! This could be worse than the Hero Wars of long ago.
dialogsBegin.th: ถ้าเป็นจริง เราต้องหยุดมัน! นี่อาจเลวร้ายยิ่งกว่า Hero Wars ที่เกิดขึ้นเมื่อนานมาแล้ว
dialogsBegin.tw: 一定要竭力所能阻止他復活才行！
dialogsBegin.vi: Nếu điều này là đúng, chúng ta phải ngăn chặn nó! Điều này có thể tồi tệ hơn so với các cuộc chiến tranh anh hùng từ lâu.

dialogsBegin.en: You told me that you saw new types of masquerpets while you were getting the revelation right? I think that maybe…
dialogsBegin.ar: You told me that you saw new types of masquerpets while you were getting the revelation right? I think that maybe…
dialogsBegin.br: Você me disse que viu novos tipos de masquerpets enquanto pegava a revelação, não é? Acho que talvez…
dialogsBegin.cns: 在地穴的出现的怪物就是他复活的前兆！请帮我搜集这些怪物的情报吧！
dialogsBegin.de: Du erwähntest neue Arten von Masquerpets im Tempel, als du die Offenbarung geholt hast, richtig? Das bedeutet vielleicht, dass...
dialogsBegin.fi: You told me that you saw new types of masquerpets while you were getting the revelation right? I think that maybe…
dialogsBegin.fil: Sinabi mo sa'kin na may nakita kang bagong uri ng masquerpets habang kinukuha mo ang revelation, hindi ba? Sa tingin ko baka…
dialogsBegin.fr: D’après ton récit, sur le chemin de ta quête vers la Copie volée au temple, tu as aperçu des monstres t’étant inconnus auparavant…
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu mengatakan kepadaku bahwa kamu melihat jenis topeng baru saat kamu mendapatkan wahyu, kan? Saya pikir mungkin…
dialogsBegin.it: You told me that you saw new types of masquerpets while you were getting the revelation right? I think that maybe…
dialogsBegin.jp: え？神殿内で見たことのないモンスターを？イブリスに魅入られしもの達が、イブリス復活のために集ったのかもしれませんね……。
dialogsBegin.kr: 계시록을 찾으러 갔을 때, 새로운 종류의 마스커펫들을 보셨다고 하셨죠? 어, 어쩌면 그게...
dialogsBegin.nl: You told me that you saw new types of masquerpets while you were getting the revelation right? I think that maybe…
dialogsBegin.pl: Powiedziałeś mi, że widziałeś nowe rodzaje masquerpets, kiedy poznałeś objawienie? Myślę, że może…
dialogsBegin.ru: По твоим словам, в Храме обитают невиданные прежде марионетки… Вдруг… вдруг…
dialogsBegin.sp: Me dijiste que viste nuevos tipos de masquerpets mientras recibías la revelación, ¿verdad? Creo que tal vez…
dialogsBegin.sw: You told me that you saw new types of masquerpets while you were getting the revelation right? I think that maybe…
dialogsBegin.th: คุณบอกฉันว่าคุณได้เห็น masquerpets ประเภทใหม่ในขณะที่คุณได้รับการเปิดเผยอย่างถูกต้องหรือไม่? ฉันคิดว่าบางที ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 在地穴的出現的怪物就是他復活的前兆！請幫我搜集這些怪物的情報吧！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn đã nói với tôi rằng bạn đã nhìn thấy các chủng loại masquerpets mới trong khi bạn đang đọc sách Khải Huyền đúng không? Tôi nghĩ rằng có thể…

dialogsBegin.en: ...they are the scouts of the army of Iblis. It looks like we may have to work together for a little while longer. Are you willing to help?
dialogsBegin.ar: ...they are the scouts of the army of Iblis. It looks like we may have to work together for a little while longer. Are you willing to help?
dialogsBegin.br: Eles sejam os soldados do exército de Iblis. Parece que teremos que trabalhar juntos por mais tempo. Está disposto a ajudar?
dialogsBegin.cns: 只要你能完成，想要什么报酬都不是问题！
dialogsBegin.de: ...sie die Späher in der Armee von Ivillis sind. Es sieht so aus, als wir noch etwas länger zusammenarbeiten. Wirst du mir helfen?
dialogsBegin.fi: ...they are the scouts of the army of Iblis. It looks like we may have to work together for a little while longer. Are you willing to help?
dialogsBegin.fil: ...sila ang mga espiya ng hukbo ni Iblis. Mukhang kailangan pa nating magtulungan ng sandali. Handa ka bang tumulong?
dialogsBegin.fr: …il pourrait s’agir de l’armée qu’Ivillis avait pour intention de ressusciter. S’il te plaît, rends-moi un service… Rémunéré bien sûr ! Tu ferais cela pour moi ?
dialogsBegin.id: ..mereka adalah pengintai tentara Iblis. Sepertinya kita mungkin harus bekerja sama untuk beberapa saat lagi. Apakah kamu bersedia membantu?
dialogsBegin.it: ...they are the scouts of the army of Iblis. It looks like we may have to work together for a little while longer. Are you willing to help?
dialogsBegin.jp: まだ情報が足りませんね。調査に協力してください。報酬は惜しみませんので。
dialogsBegin.kr: ...이블리스 군대의 정찰병들이에요. 조금 더 함께 일해야 할 것만 같네요. 도와주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: ...they are the scouts of the army of Iblis. It looks like we may have to work together for a little while longer. Are you willing to help?
dialogsBegin.pl: ..są zwiadowcami armii Iblis. Wygląda na to, że będziemy musieli jeszcze trochę popracować razem. Czy chcesz pomóc?
dialogsBegin.ru: …они — разведчики войска Ужосса. Похоже, нам придётся поработать вместе ещё какое-то время. Ты готов помочь?
dialogsBegin.sp: ..son los exploradores del ejército de Iblis. Parece que tendremos que trabajar juntos por un poco más de tiempo. ¿Estás dispuesto a ayudar?
dialogsBegin.sw: ...they are the scouts of the army of Iblis. It looks like we may have to work together for a little while longer. Are you willing to help?
dialogsBegin.th: พวกเขาเป็นพลสอดแนมของกองทัพ Iblis ดูเหมือนว่าเราอาจต้องทำงานร่วมกันอีกสักระยะนึง คุณยินดีที่จะช่วยเหลือหรือไม่?
dialogsBegin.tw: ……牠們是伊普里司軍隊的偵察兵。看來我們還得再合作一段時間。你願意幫忙嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: ..bọn chúng là những quân do thám của quân đội Iblis. Có vẻ như chúng ta phải hợp tác một thời gian nữa. Bạn có sẵn sàng hỗ trợ không?

dialogsAccept.en: Excellent. Go in to the temple and gather any information you can about the strange masquerpets.
dialogsAccept.ar: Excellent. Go in to the temple and gather any information you can about the strange masquerpets.
dialogsAccept.br: Excelente. Vá até o templo e obtenha todas as informações que puder a respeito dos masquerpets estranhos.
dialogsAccept.cns: 请帮我搜集地穴怪物的情报，好好注意自身安全！
dialogsAccept.de: Wunderbar. Bitte kehre in den Tempel zurück und sammle so viele Informationen über diese seltsamen Masquerpets wie du kannst.
dialogsAccept.fi: Excellent. Go in to the temple and gather any information you can about the strange masquerpets.
dialogsAccept.fil: Mahusay. Pumasok ka sa templo at mag-ipon ng anumang impormasyon na makakakuha ka tungkol sa mga kakaibang masquerpets.
dialogsAccept.fr: Très bien. S’il te plaît, retourne de nouveau au temple d’Ivillis et enquête sur les monstres. Toute information nous sera utile.
dialogsAccept.id: Bagus sekali. Pergilah ke kuil dan kumpulkan informasi apa pun yang kamu bisa tentang topeng aneh itu.
dialogsAccept.it: Excellent. Go in to the temple and gather any information you can about the strange masquerpets.
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとうございます！神殿に入って、モンスターの情報を集めてきてください。できる限りの手を打たなくては！
dialogsAccept.kr: 훌륭해요. 신전 내로 들어가서 그 마스커펫들에 대한 정보를 최대한 많이 모아주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Excellent. Go in to the temple and gather any information you can about the strange masquerpets.
dialogsAccept.pl: Świetnie. Wejdź do świątyni i zbierz wszelkie możliwe informacje o dziwnych masquerpets.
dialogsAccept.ru: Отлично. Возвращайся в Храм и постарайся разузнать об этих марионетках все, что сможешь.
dialogsAccept.sp: Excelente. Entra en el templo y recopila toda la información que puedas sobre los extraños masquerpets.
dialogsAccept.sw: Excellent. Go in to the temple and gather any information you can about the strange masquerpets.
dialogsAccept.th: ยอดเยี่ยม ไปที่วัดและรวบรวมข้อมูลที่คุณสามารถเกี่ยวกับ masquerpets แปลกๆ
dialogsAccept.tw: 請幫我搜集地穴怪物的情報，好好注意自身安全！
dialogsAccept.vi: Xuất sắc. Đi vào ngôi đền và thu thập bất kỳ thông tin nào bạn có thể về những con masquerpets kỳ lạ.

dialogsDecline.en: What?! Are you really going to stand by and let the world end?
dialogsDecline.ar: What?! Are you really going to stand by and let the world end?
dialogsDecline.br: O que?! Você realmente vai ficar parado esperando o fim do mundo?
dialogsDecline.cns: 你一点都不觉得紧张吗？！世界末日就要到了…
dialogsDecline.de: Was?! Willst du wirklich einfach zusehen, wie die Welt untergeht?
dialogsDecline.fi: What?! Are you really going to stand by and let the world end?
dialogsDecline.fil: Ano?! Talaga bang titigil ka lang at hahayaang magwakas ang mundo?
dialogsDecline.fr: Il existe des choses bien plus importantes que cela ! Si le monde est détruit, tu n'existeras plus, comprends-tu ?!
dialogsDecline.id: Apa?! Apakah kamu benar-benar akan menunggu dan membiarkan dunia berakhir?
dialogsDecline.it: What?! Are you really going to stand by and let the world end?
dialogsDecline.jp: 世界が滅びるかもしれないという時に何をおっしゃっているんです？世界が滅んでしまったら、あなただって生きてゆけない。そんな事ぐらいわかってますよね？
dialogsDecline.kr: 뭐라고요?! 정말 세상의 종말을 그대로 두시겠다는 건가요?
dialogsDecline.nl: What?! Are you really going to stand by and let the world end?
dialogsDecline.pl: Co?! Czy naprawdę zamierzasz czekać i pozwolić, by świat się skończył?
dialogsDecline.ru: Что?! Неужели ты станешь покорно ждать конца света?!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡¿Qué?! ¿De verdad vas a quedarte quieto y dejar que el mundo se acabe?
dialogsDecline.sw: What?! Are you really going to stand by and let the world end?
dialogsDecline.th: อะไร?! คุณจะยืนหยัดเคียงข้างกัน และปล่อยให้โลกนี้จบลงงั้นเหรอ?
dialogsDecline.tw: 什麼？你一點都不覺得緊張嗎？天啊！世界末日就要到了……
dialogsDecline.vi: Cái gì?! Bạn có thực sự sẽ chờ đợi và để cho thế giới kết thúc?

dialogsComplete.en: Hmm... Iblis Crasher... So, that is one of the masquerpets? Alright, give me some time to study this information. Thank you.
dialogsComplete.ar: Hmm... Iblis Crasher... So, that is one of the masquerpets? Alright, give me some time to study this information. Thank you.
dialogsComplete.br: Hmm... Iblis Esmagador... Então, esse é um dos masquerpets? Tudo bem, me dê algum tempo para estudar essas informações. Obrigada.
dialogsComplete.cns: 就是这个……秘殿破坏者！！真是辛苦你了！
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm... Ivillis Crasher... Das ist also eines dieser Masquerpets? Okay, gib mir ein wenig Zeit, um das zu untersuchen. Ich danke dir.
dialogsComplete.fi: Hmm... Iblis Crasher... So, that is one of the masquerpets? Alright, give me some time to study this information. Thank you.
dialogsComplete.fil: Hmmm... Iblis Crasher... Iyan pala ay isa sa mga masquerpets? Sige, bigyan mo ako ng kaunting panahon para pag-aralan ang impormasyon na ito. Salamat.
dialogsComplete.fr: Hmm… Ivillis Crasher… Donc, il s’agit d’un monstre, hmm ? D’accord, je vais vérifier les informations que tu m’as apportées. Je t’en remercie infiniment !
dialogsComplete.id: Hmm.. Iblis Crasher.. Jadi, itu salah satu topengnya? Baiklah, beri aku waktu untuk mempelajari informasi ini. Terima kasih.
dialogsComplete.it: Hmm... Iblis Crasher... So, that is one of the masquerpets? Alright, give me some time to study this information. Thank you.
dialogsComplete.jp: イブル・ドロイゼンですか…それについては資料を調べてみます。ありがとうございました。
dialogsComplete.kr: 흠... 이블리스 크래셔... 저게 마스커펫 중 하나라 이거죠? 좋아요. 정보를 익힐 시간을 좀 주세요. 감사합니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Hmm... Iblis Crasher... So, that is one of the masquerpets? Alright, give me some time to study this information. Thank you.
dialogsComplete.pl: Hmm.. Iblis Crasher.. Więc to jest jeden z masquerpets? Dobrze, daj mi trochę czasu na przestudiowanie tych informacji. Dziękuję Ci.
dialogsComplete.ru: Хмм… Ужоссный крушитель… Итак, это одна из марионеток? Хорошо, дай мне время изучить эти сведения. Спасибо.
dialogsComplete.sp: Hmm... Aplastador de Iblis... Así que, ¿ese es uno de los masquerpets? Vale, dame algo de tiempo para estudiar la información. Gracias.
dialogsComplete.sw: Hmm... Iblis Crasher... So, that is one of the masquerpets? Alright, give me some time to study this information. Thank you.
dialogsComplete.th: อืม... Iblis Crasher... นี่เป็นหนึ่งใน masquerpets? เอาล่ะ ฉันขอเวลาซักหน่อยในการหาข้อมูลนี้ ขอบคุณ
dialogsComplete.tw: 嗯……伊普里司破壞者……所以那是其中一種怪物嗎？好，給我一點時間研究這些情報。謝謝你。
dialogsComplete.vi: Hmm .. Iblis Crasher .. Vậy, đó là một trong những con masquerpets à? Được rồi, hãy cho tôi chút thời gian để tìm hiểu thông tin này. Cảm ơn bạn.

dialogsFail.en: Any information about any Masquerpets is good.
dialogsFail.ar: Any information about any Masquerpets is good.
dialogsFail.br: Qualquer informação a respeito de Masquerpets é útil.
dialogsFail.cns: 请帮我搜集地穴怪物的情报，一切小心！
dialogsFail.de: Jede Art von Information über diese Masquerpets ist hilfreich.
dialogsFail.fi: Any information about any Masquerpets is good.
dialogsFail.fil: Kahit anumang impormasyon tungkol sa mga Masquerpets ay mahalaga.
dialogsFail.fr: Toute information sur les monstres nous sera d’une grande utilité.
dialogsFail.id: Informasi apa pun tentang Masquerpets apa pun bagus.
dialogsFail.it: Any information about any Masquerpets is good.
dialogsFail.jp: 事態は一刻を争います。できるだけ早くお願いします。
dialogsFail.kr: 마스커펫에 대한 어떤 정보라도 좋아요.
dialogsFail.nl: Any information about any Masquerpets is good.
dialogsFail.pl: Wszelkie informacje o Potworach są dobre.
dialogsFail.ru: Чем больше мы узнаем о марионетках, тем лучше.
dialogsFail.sp: Cualquier información sobre los Masquerpets es buena.
dialogsFail.sw: Any information about any Masquerpets is good.
dialogsFail.th: ข้อมูลเกี่ยวกับ marcquerpets ใดๆ เป็นสิ่งที่ดี
dialogsFail.tw: 請幫我搜集地穴怪物的情報，一切小心囉！
dialogsFail.vi: Mọi thông tin về Masquerpets đều tốt.

name.th: ผู้สืบทอดของฮีโร่ -Altar-
name.tw: 英雄的繼承者 - 祭壇

description.en: Take the Tear of Darkness from Scorpicon in Plateau of Silence, Saint Morning, and bring it to Priest Jeperdy in Brekin, Darkon 3.
description.ar: Take the Tear of Darkness from Scorpicon in Plateau of Silence, Saint Morning, and bring it to Priest Jeperdy in Brekin, Darkon 3.
description.br: Por favor, pegue a Lágrima da Escuridão do Scopicon, no Planalto do Silêncio em Saint Morning, e leve-a para a Sacerdotisa Jeperdy em Brekin, Darkon 3.
description.cns: 别忘了，先到晨光的沉默高原，找沙卡毕欧取得暗黑泪珠，再交给[刀锋战士祭司]杰普迪！
description.de: Nimm die Träne der Dunkelheit von Skorpion im Plateau der Stille, Saint Morning, und bringe sie zu Priester Jeperdy in Brekin, Darkon 3.
description.fi: Take the Tear of Darkness from Scorpicon in Plateau of Silence, Saint Morning, and bring it to Priest Jeperdy in Brekin, Darkon 3.
description.fil: Take the Tear of Darkness from Scorpicon in Plateau of Silence, Saint Morning, and bring it to Priest Jeperdy in Brekin, Darkon 3.
description.fr: Récupérer la Larme du Sorcier en combattant Scorpic au Plateau du Silence et la rapporter à Jeperdy, à l'Autel des Assassins de Darkon 3.
description.id: Ambil Tear of Darkness dari Scorpion di Plateau of Silence, Saint Morning, dan bawa ke Priest Jeopardy di Breckin, Darkon 3.
description.it: Take the Tear of Darkness from Scorpicon in Plateau of Silence, Saint Morning, and bring it to Priest Jeperdy in Brekin, Darkon 3.
description.jp: セイントモーニングの沈黙の高原に住んでいる毒王カレビアンから暗黒の涙を回収し、ダーコン第3地区(アリアンス)地域にあるビルポスターの祭壇ジェファディに行きましょう。
description.kr: 세인트 모닝의 침묵의 고원에 사는 스카피컨에게서 어둠의 눈물을 획득하여, 다콘 제3지구 브레킨에 있는 블레이드 사제 제퍼디에게 전달하세요.
description.nl: Take the Tear of Darkness from Scorpicon in Plateau of Silence, Saint Morning, and bring it to Priest Jeperdy in Brekin, Darkon 3.
description.pl: Take the Tear of Darkness from Scorpicon in Plateau of Silence, Saint Morning, and bring it to Priest Jeperdy in Brekin, Darkon 3.
description.ru: Take the Tear of Darkness from Scorpicon in Plateau of Silence, Saint Morning, and bring it to Priest Jeperdy in Brekin, Darkon 3.
description.sp: Consigue la Lágrima de las Tinieblas del Scorpicon en la Meseta del Silencio, en Saint Morning, y llévasela a la Sacerdotisa Jeperdy en Brekin, Darkon 3.
description.sw: Take the Tear of Darkness from Scorpicon in Plateau of Silence, Saint Morning, and bring it to Priest Jeperdy in Brekin, Darkon 3.
description.th: นำ Tear of Darkness มาจาก Scorpicon ที่ Tableland of Silence ใน Saint Morning และนำมันไปให้ Priest ที่ชื่อ Jeperdy ใน Brekin ที่ Darkon 3
description.tw: 別忘了，先到聖音特的寂靜高原，找沙卡畢歐取得暗黑淚珠，再交給得肯第三區布里肯遺廠的暗殺者祭司傑佛迪索斯！
description.vi: Lấy Tear of Darkness từ Scorpicon ở Plateau of Silence, Saint Morning, và mang nó cho Priest Jeperdy ở Brekin, Darkon 3.

dialogsBegin.en: You’ll want to take it to the Blade Priest, Jeperdy. She manages the Altar of Blades in Brekin, Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.ar: You’ll want to take it to the Blade Priest, Jeperdy. She manages the Altar of Blades in Brekin, Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.br: Agora você deve se encontrar com a sacerdotisa. A sacerdotisa Jeperdy está em Brekin, Darkon 3, onde toma conta do Altar de Blade.
dialogsBegin.cns: 请你去找[刀锋战士祭司]杰普迪，他在达肯第3地区铸炼之地管理刀锋战士的祭坛。
dialogsBegin.de: Nun musst du die Priesterin treffen. Priesterin Jeperdy ist in Brekin, Darkon3 und verwaltet den Altar des Blade.
dialogsBegin.fi: You’ll want to take it to the Blade Priest, Jeperdy. She manages the Altar of Blades in Brekin, Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.fil: You’ll want to take it to the Blade Priest, Jeperdy. She manages the Altar of Blades in Brekin, Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu approches de ton but. et la fin de ton apprentissage se passera à Darkon 3 ! Là-bas, tu trouveras l'Autel où siège Jeperdy, le Doyen des Assassins.
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu pasti ingin membawanya ke Blade Priest, Jeperdy. Dia mengelola Altar of Blades di Brekin, Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.it: You’ll want to take it to the Blade Priest, Jeperdy. She manages the Altar of Blades in Brekin, Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.jp: じゃぁ、これから司祭に会ってください。司祭ジェファディ様はダーコン第3地区(アリアンス)地域にあるビルポスターの祭壇を管理しています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 블레이드 사제, 제퍼디님을 만나세요. 제퍼디님은 다콘 제3지구 브레킨에서 블레이드의 제단을 관리하고 계신답니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: You’ll want to take it to the Blade Priest, Jeperdy. She manages the Altar of Blades in Brekin, Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.pl: You’ll want to take it to the Blade Priest, Jeperdy. She manages the Altar of Blades in Brekin, Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.ru: Отнеси свиток, который я тебе дал, жрице фехтовальщиков Гепардии. Ее можно найти у Алтаря фехтовальщиков на Бренской фактории, на Дарконе-3.
dialogsBegin.sp: Llévaselo a la Sacerdotisa Blade, Jeperdy. Administra el Altar del Blade en Brekin, Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.sw: You’ll want to take it to the Blade Priest, Jeperdy. She manages the Altar of Blades in Brekin, Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณจะต้องนำมันไปให้ Blade Priest ที่ชื่อ Jeperdy เธอคอยดูแลแท่นบูชาของ Blade ที่ Brekin ในเมือง Darkon 3
dialogsBegin.tw: 請你去找祭司 [傑佛迪索斯]，他在得肯第三區布里肯遺廠管理暗殺者的祭壇。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn sẽ muốn mang nó đến Blade Priest, Jeperdy. Cô quản lý Altar of Blades ở Brekin, Darkon 3.

dialogsBegin.en: Oh, since you're heading that way, could you retrieve a jewel for her called the Tear of Darkness? A Scorpicon in the Plateau of Silence has it, and we believe it could threaten the Souls of Heroes the Altars protect.
dialogsBegin.ar: Oh, since you're heading that way, could you retrieve a jewel for her called the Tear of Darkness? A Scorpicon in the Plateau of Silence has it, and we believe it could threaten the Souls of Heroes the Altars protect.
dialogsBegin.br: Oh, já que você está indo nessa direção, você poderia recuperar uma joia para ela chamada Lágrima da Escuridão? Um Escorpião no Planalto do Silêncio o tem, e acreditamos que ele pode ameaçar as Almas dos Heróis que os Altares protegem.
dialogsBegin.cns: 对了！在晨光沉默高原的【沙卡毕欧】，你知道这怪物的来历吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Oh, da du schon mal auf dem Weg dorthin bist, könntest du ein Juwel für sie besorgen, das die Träne der Dunkelheit genannt wird? Ein Skorpion auf dem Plateau der Stille hat es, und wir glauben, dass es die Seelen der Helden bedrohen könnte, die die Altäre schützen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Oh, since you're heading that way, could you retrieve a jewel for her called the Tear of Darkness? A Scorpicon in the Plateau of Silence has it, and we believe it could threaten the Souls of Heroes the Altars protect.
dialogsBegin.fil: Oh, since you're heading that way, could you retrieve a jewel for her called the Tear of Darkness? A Scorpicon in the Plateau of Silence has it, and we believe it could threaten the Souls of Heroes the Altars protect.
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais avant de te présenter à Jeperdy. Il y a une mission que tu dois accomplir. Il semble qu'un monstre du nom de Scorpic détienne un joyau appelé la Larme du sorcier. Cet artefact effraie les âmes des Héros.
dialogsBegin.id: Oh, karena kamu menuju ke sana, bisakah kamu mengambilkan permata untuknya yang disebut Tear of Darkness? Kalajengking di Dataran Tinggi Keheningan memilikinya, dan kami yakin itu bisa mengancam Jiwa Pahlawan yang dilindungi Altar.
dialogsBegin.it: Oh, since you're heading that way, could you retrieve a jewel for her called the Tear of Darkness? A Scorpicon in the Plateau of Silence has it, and we believe it could threaten the Souls of Heroes the Altars protect.
dialogsBegin.jp: その前にセイントモーニングの沈黙の高原に住んでいる毒王カレビアンを退治してもらえますか？カレビアンは「暗黒の涙」と呼ばれる宝玉を使い、英雄たちの魂を暗黒に引きずり込もうとしているようなんです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그리고 기왕 그쪽으로 가시는 길이니, 혹시 제퍼디님께 어둠의 눈물이라는 보석을 가져다주실 수 있을까요? 침묵의 고원에 사는 스카피컨이 어둠의 눈물을 가지고 있답니다. 이 보석이 영웅들의 영혼을 위협할 수도 있어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Oh, since you're heading that way, could you retrieve a jewel for her called the Tear of Darkness? A Scorpicon in the Plateau of Silence has it, and we believe it could threaten the Souls of Heroes the Altars protect.
dialogsBegin.pl: Oh, since you're heading that way, could you retrieve a jewel for her called the Tear of Darkness? A Scorpicon in the Plateau of Silence has it, and we believe it could threaten the Souls of Heroes the Altars protect.
dialogsBegin.ru: Oh, since you're heading that way, could you retrieve a jewel for her called the Tear of Darkness? A Scorpicon in the Plateau of Silence has it, and we believe it could threaten the Souls of Heroes the Altars protect.
dialogsBegin.sp: Oh, ya que te diriges hacia allí, ¿podrías recuperar una gema para ella llamada Lágrima de las Tinieblas? Un Scorpicon de la Meseta del Silencio la tiene, y creemos que podría amenazar a las Almas de los Héroes que protegen los Altares.
dialogsBegin.sw: Oh, since you're heading that way, could you retrieve a jewel for her called the Tear of Darkness? A Scorpicon in the Plateau of Silence has it, and we believe it could threaten the Souls of Heroes the Altars protect.
dialogsBegin.th: โอ้ ในเมื่อคุณก็กำลังไปทางนั้น คุณช่วยนำอัญมณีที่ชื่อ Tear of Darkness กลับมาด้วยได้หรือไม่? มันอยู่กับ Scorpicon ใน Tableland of Silence พวกเราเชื่อว่ามันจะสามารถทำลาย Souls of Heroes ที่แท่นบูชาปกป้องไว้ได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 哦，既然要往那邊走，能不能幫她取回一件叫做黑暗之淚的寶石？在聖音特寂靜高原的 [沙卡畢歐]，我們相信它可能會威脅到祭壇保護的英雄之魂。
dialogsBegin.vi: Ồ, vì bạn đang đi theo hướng đó, bạn có thể lấy một viên ngọc cho cô ấy có tên là Tear of Darkness không? Scorpicon ở Plateau of Silence có nó, và chúng tôi tin rằng nó có thể đe dọa Linh hồn của những Heroes mà Altars bảo vệ.

dialogsBegin.en: Please take it to Priest Jeperdy, and perhaps we can investigate it further.
dialogsBegin.ar: Please take it to Priest Jeperdy, and perhaps we can investigate it further.
dialogsBegin.br: Por favor, pegue a Lágrima da Escuridão de Scopicon antes de ir a Brekin, e leve-a para a sacerdotisa Jeperdy. Talvez nós possamos descobrir o que exatamente está ameaçando as almas ao investigar a Lágrima da Escuridão.
dialogsBegin.cns: 请把它交给祭司杰普迪，或许，从这鬼玩意可以得知威胁灵魂的真正原因！
dialogsBegin.de: Bitte entreiße dem Scorpicon den Tear of Darkness bevor du nach Brekin gehst und bring sie zur Priesterin Jeperdy. Vielleicht können wir herausfinden, was genau die Seelen der Helden bedroht, wenn wir es untersuchen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Please take it to Priest Jeperdy, and perhaps we can investigate it further.
dialogsBegin.fil: Please take it to Priest Jeperdy, and perhaps we can investigate it further.
dialogsBegin.fr: On dit que Scorpic vit au Plateau du Silence. J'aimerais que tu ailles lui prendre cette Larme du sorcier et que tu la ramènes à Jeperdy. Alors seulement les âmes des Héros reposeront en paix.
dialogsBegin.id: Tolong bawa ke Priest Jeperdy, dan mungkin kita bisa menyelidikinya lebih lanjut.
dialogsBegin.it: Please take it to Priest Jeperdy, and perhaps we can investigate it further.
dialogsBegin.jp: ブレッキンに行く前に、毒王カレビアンから暗黒の涙を回収し、司祭ジェファディ様にお渡しできますか？何とかしてこの邪悪な宝玉のメカニズムを解析しなければ･･･。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이걸 제퍼디 사제님께 전달해 주세요. 어쩌면 더 연구해볼 수 있겠죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: Please take it to Priest Jeperdy, and perhaps we can investigate it further.
dialogsBegin.pl: Please take it to Priest Jeperdy, and perhaps we can investigate it further.
dialogsBegin.ru: Жрица сделает так, чтобы слеза не причинила вреда душам героев. Надеюсь, тебе по силам одолеть скорпихвоста?
dialogsBegin.sp: Por favor, llévaselo a la Sacerdotisa Jeperdy, y tal vez podamos investigarlo más a fondo.
dialogsBegin.sw: Please take it to Priest Jeperdy, and perhaps we can investigate it further.
dialogsBegin.th: ได้โปรดนำมันไปให้ Priest ที่ชื่อ Jeperdy และบางที่พวกเราอาจจะสืบหามันต่อไปได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 去布里肯遺廠之前，先找沙卡畢歐拿到"暗黑淚珠"，再交給祭司傑佛迪索斯！！或許，從這鬼玩意可以得知威脅靈魂的真正原因！
dialogsBegin.vi: Hãy đưa nó đến Priest Jeperdy, và có lẽ chúng tôi điều tra thêm.

dialogsAccept.en: Good luck, Mercenary.
dialogsAccept.ar: Good luck, Mercenary.
dialogsAccept.br: Boa sorte, Mercenário(a).
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你好运，战士
dialogsAccept.de: Viel Glück, Mercenary.
dialogsAccept.fi: Good luck, Mercenary.
dialogsAccept.fil: Good luck, Mercenary.
dialogsAccept.fr: Bonne chance, Mercenaire !
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga berhasil, Mercenary.
dialogsAccept.it: Good luck, Mercenary.
dialogsAccept.jp: では、幸運をお祈りします。
dialogsAccept.kr: 그럼 행운을 빌어요, 머서너리님.
dialogsAccept.nl: Good luck, Mercenary.
dialogsAccept.pl: Good luck, Mercenary.
dialogsAccept.ru: Good luck, Mercenary.
dialogsAccept.sp: Buena suerte, Mercenary.
dialogsAccept.sw: Good luck, Mercenary.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้โชคดี Mercenary
dialogsAccept.tw: 祝你好運！勇者
dialogsAccept.vi: Chúc may mắn, Mercenary.

dialogsDecline.en: Something this potentially dangerous could bring harm to the Altar of Blade. Please, you must help us retrieve it.
dialogsDecline.ar: Something this potentially dangerous could bring harm to the Altar of Blade. Please, you must help us retrieve it.
dialogsDecline.br: A Lágrima da Escuridão é muito perigosa. Nós realmente temos que pegá-la e descobrir rapidamente o motivo, ou o altar ficará em perigo. Por favor, me ajude.
dialogsDecline.cns: 暗黑泪珠这不祥之物！可不能落入其他人的手中，否则祭坛会有危险，这就要拜托你了！
dialogsDecline.de: Der Tear of Darkness ist sehr gefährlich. Wir müssen ihn unbedingt bekommen um den Grund herauszufinden oder der Altar schwebt in größter Gefahr. Bitte hilf mir.
dialogsDecline.fi: Something this potentially dangerous could bring harm to the Altar of Blade. Please, you must help us retrieve it.
dialogsDecline.fil: Something this potentially dangerous could bring harm to the Altar of Blade. Please, you must help us retrieve it.
dialogsDecline.fr: Je sais que Scorpic sera peut-être redoutable, mais tu n'auras pas achevé ton apprentissage tant que tu n'auras pas ramené la Larme du sorcier.
dialogsDecline.id: Sesuatu yang berpotensi berbahaya ini dapat membahayakan Altar of Blade. Tolong, kamu harus membantu kami mengambilnya.
dialogsDecline.it: Something this potentially dangerous could bring harm to the Altar of Blade. Please, you must help us retrieve it.
dialogsDecline.jp: 伝承にいわく、暗黒の涙とは古の邪悪な存在が英雄の魂を堕落させるために創ったといわれているんだ。このままでは英雄の祭壇は危機にさらされちゃう。助けてください！
dialogsDecline.kr: 암흑의 눈물은 블레이드의 제단에 큰 해가 될 수 있어요. 제발, 도와주세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Something this potentially dangerous could bring harm to the Altar of Blade. Please, you must help us retrieve it.
dialogsDecline.pl: Something this potentially dangerous could bring harm to the Altar of Blade. Please, you must help us retrieve it.
dialogsDecline.ru: Алтарь фехтовальщиков в опасности! Прошу, помоги нам.
dialogsDecline.sp: Algo tan peligroso podría dañar el Altar del Blade. Por favor, nos tienes que ayudar a recuperarlo.
dialogsDecline.sw: Something this potentially dangerous could bring harm to the Altar of Blade. Please, you must help us retrieve it.
dialogsDecline.th: เจ้าสิ่งที่แสนอันตรายนี่จะนำอันตรายมาสู่ Altar of Blade ได้โปรด คุณต้องช่วยพวกเรานำมันกลับคืนมา
dialogsDecline.tw: 暗黑淚珠這不祥之物！可不能落入其他人的手中，否則祭壇會有危險，這就要拜託你了！
dialogsDecline.vi: Thứ gì đó nguy hiểm tiềm tàng có thể gây hại cho Altar of Blade. Làm ơn, bạn phải giúp chúng tôi lấy lại nó.

dialogsComplete.en: Hmm, just as I thought. Even Soulstones react to it. This requires much more investigation.
dialogsComplete.ar: Hmm, just as I thought. Even Soulstones react to it. This requires much more investigation.
dialogsComplete.br: Hmm... Ela traz um sentimento ruim, como eu pensei, e mesmo a Pedra de Alma reage a ela. Nós realmente temos que investigá-la rapidamente.
dialogsComplete.cns: 我有很不好的预感…你看！灵魂之石也有着反应，要快点行动才行了！
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm.. Ich habe ein schlechtes Gefühl wenn ich ihn berühre und selbst der Soulstone reagiert darauf. Wir müssen ihn schnell überprüfen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Hmm, just as I thought. Even Soulstones react to it. This requires much more investigation.
dialogsComplete.fil: Hmm, just as I thought. Even Soulstones react to it. This requires much more investigation.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tu as récupéré la Larme du sorcier ! Les Pierres des Héros y réagissent... nous devons étudier ça au plus vite !
dialogsComplete.id: Hmm, seperti yang saya pikirkan. Bahkan Soulstones bereaksi terhadapnya. Ini membutuhkan lebih banyak penyelidikan.
dialogsComplete.it: Hmm, just as I thought. Even Soulstones react to it. This requires much more investigation.
dialogsComplete.jp: ふむ･･･やはり相当危険な物のようだね。それにソウルストーンも確実に暗黒に侵食されているや･･･。はやく原因を把握しないと･･･。
dialogsComplete.kr: 역시나 예상한 대로군요. 소울스톤조차 반응을 보이다니. 더 철저한 조사가 필요하겠네요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Hmm, just as I thought. Even Soulstones react to it. This requires much more investigation.
dialogsComplete.pl: Hmm, just as I thought. Even Soulstones react to it. This requires much more investigation.
dialogsComplete.ru: Я так и думала. Даже камни, в которых заключены души героев, трепещут, почувствовав артефакт! В нем есть сила, природу которой я пока не пойму...
dialogsComplete.sp: Hmm, tal como pensaba. Hasta las Piedras de Alma reaccionan. Esto requiere mucha más investigación.
dialogsComplete.sw: Hmm, just as I thought. Even Soulstones react to it. This requires much more investigation.
dialogsComplete.th: หืมมม เหมือนที่ฉันคิดเลย แม้แต่ Soulstones ก็มีปฏิกิริยากับมัน ต้องมีการตรวจสอบมากขึ้นกว่านี้
dialogsComplete.tw: 我有很不好的預感…你看！靈魂之石也有著反應，要快點行動才行了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Hmm, đúng như tôi nghĩ. Ngay cả Soulstone cũng phản ứng với nó. Điều này đòi hỏi nhiều cuộc điều tra hơn nữa.

dialogsComplete.en: Worry not, young Mercenary. Bringing me the jewel was enough on your part. I’ll do the rest.
dialogsComplete.ar: Worry not, young Mercenary. Bringing me the jewel was enough on your part. I’ll do the rest.
dialogsComplete.br: De qualquer maneira, muito obrigado. Graças a você, a alma do herói ficará a salvo. Não se preocupe, descobrirei o motivo.
dialogsComplete.cns: 首先，先感谢你的协助，这件事做起来并不容易，我会查明一切的原因，请你放心。
dialogsComplete.de: Auf jeden Fall danke! Dank dir sind die Seelen der Helden sicher. Sei unbesorgt, ich werde den Grund herausfinden.
dialogsComplete.fi: Worry not, young Mercenary. Bringing me the jewel was enough on your part. I’ll do the rest.
dialogsComplete.fil: Worry not, young Mercenary. Bringing me the jewel was enough on your part. I’ll do the rest.
dialogsComplete.fr: Quoiqu'il en soit, merci beaucoup ! Grâce à toi les âmes des Héros seront en sécurité. Ne t'inquiète pas je résoudrai ce mystère.
dialogsComplete.id: Jangan khawatir, Mercenary muda. Membawakanku permata itu sudah cukup darimu. Saya akan melakukan sisanya.
dialogsComplete.it: Worry not, young Mercenary. Bringing me the jewel was enough on your part. I’ll do the rest.
dialogsComplete.jp: ありがとう、大変だっただろ？英雄たちの魂についてはボクに任せて！必ず原因を突き止めるよ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 걱정 마세요, 젊은 머서너리님. 보석을 가져다주신 것만으로도 충분해요. 그다음은 제가 최선을 다해 보죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: Worry not, young Mercenary. Bringing me the jewel was enough on your part. I’ll do the rest.
dialogsComplete.pl: Worry not, young Mercenary. Bringing me the jewel was enough on your part. I’ll do the rest.
dialogsComplete.ru: Но не волнуйся, борец. Слеза в надежных руках, и твой долг исполнен. Остальное оставь мне.
dialogsComplete.sp: No te preocupes, joven Mercenary. Traerme la gema ya ha sido suficiente por tu parte. Me ocuparé del resto.
dialogsComplete.sw: Worry not, young Mercenary. Bringing me the jewel was enough on your part. I’ll do the rest.
dialogsComplete.th: ไม่ต้องห่วง ทหารหนุ่ม การนำอัญมณีมาให้ฉันก็เพียงพอแล้ว ฉันจะทำส่วนที่เหลือเอง
dialogsComplete.tw: 首先，先感謝你的協助，這件事做起來並不容易，我會查明一切的原因，請你放心。
dialogsComplete.vi: Đừng lo, Mercenary trẻ tuổi. Phần việc của bạn là mang cho tôi viên ngọc quý. Tôi sẽ lo phần còn lại.

dialogsFail.en: What brings you to this holy Altar for the Souls of Heroes?
dialogsFail.ar: What brings you to this holy Altar for the Souls of Heroes?
dialogsFail.br: Aqui é o local onde as almas dos heróis são protegidas. O que o trouxe aqui?
dialogsFail.cns: 这里是守护英雄的祭坛，你来到这里有什么事呢？
dialogsFail.de: Hier ist der Ort, an dem die Seelen der Helden beschützt werden. Was führt dich hier her?
dialogsFail.fi: What brings you to this holy Altar for the Souls of Heroes?
dialogsFail.fil: What brings you to this holy Altar for the Souls of Heroes?
dialogsFail.fr: En ce lieu nous protégeons les âmes des Héros. Mais quelle est la raison de ta venue ?
dialogsFail.id: Apa yang membawamu ke Altar suci untuk Jiwa Pahlawan ini?
dialogsFail.it: What brings you to this holy Altar for the Souls of Heroes?
dialogsFail.jp: ここは英雄たちの魂を守る祭壇です。何かご用かい？
dialogsFail.kr: 영웅들의 영혼이 잠들어 있는 이 성스러운 제단에 무슨 일로 오셨지요?
dialogsFail.nl: What brings you to this holy Altar for the Souls of Heroes?
dialogsFail.pl: What brings you to this holy Altar for the Souls of Heroes?
dialogsFail.ru: Что привело тебя к священному Алтарю героя?
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Qué te trae a este Altar sagrado de las Almas de los Héroes?

description.en: Please check around for the pattern in the Hill of Shade. Oh! Please be careful because there is something very fierce over there!
description.ar: Please check around for the pattern in the Hill of Shade. Oh! Please be careful because there is something very fierce over there!
description.br: Procure o formato na Colina de Shade. Ah! Tome cuidado, porque há algo muito feroz ali!
description.cns: 请帮我去调查一下谢德莉丘岭的纹样，那边有很多很恐怖的怪物，所以要小心喔。
description.de: Bitte schau dich auf dem Hügel von Shade nach dem Muster um. Oh! Bitte sei vorsichtig. Da ist irgendwas ziemlich wildes dort drüben!
description.fi: Please check around for the pattern in the Hill of Shade. Oh! Please be careful because there is something very fierce over there!
description.fil: Please check around for the pattern in the Hill of Shade. Oh! Please be careful because there is something very fierce over there!
description.fr: Aller à la Colline de Shade et trouver u lieu similaire à celui de la Plaine de Bubble. Ramener ensuite tout indice à Rovanett à Saincity.
description.id: Tolong cari disekitar di Hill of Shade. Oh! Harap berhati-hati karena ada sesuatu yang sangat ganas di sana!
description.it: Please check around for the pattern in the Hill of Shade. Oh! Please be careful because there is something very fierce over there!
description.jp: ＜シェードの丘＞にある不思議な文様の周辺を調査し、手がかりとなるものを探そう。
description.kr: 쉐이드의 언덕에 있는 문양을 조사해 주세요. 하지만 조심하셔야 해요. 거긴 아주 위험한 존재가 도사리고 있거든요!
description.nl: Please check around for the pattern in the Hill of Shade. Oh! Please be careful because there is something very fierce over there!
description.pl: Please check around for the pattern in the Hill of Shade. Oh! Please be careful because there is something very fierce over there!
description.ru: Нужно рассмотреть узор круга на вершине Тенистого холма. Говорят, там живет зловещий проходимец…
description.sp: Busca el patrón por los alrededores de la Colina de Shade. ¡Oh! ¡Ten cuidado porque hay algo muy feroz allí!
description.sw: Please check around for the pattern in the Hill of Shade. Oh! Please be careful because there is something very fierce over there!
description.th: โปรดตรวจสอบรูปแบบใน Hill of Shade โอ้! โปรดระวัง เพราะมีบางอย่างที่ดุร้ายอยู่ตรงนั้น!
description.tw: 請幫我去調查一下闇影丘嶺的紋樣，那邊有很多很恐怖的怪物，所以要小心喔。
description.vi: Vui lòng kiểm tra xung quanh để tìm mô hình trong Hill of Shade. Ồ! Xin hãy cẩn thận vì có một cái gì đó rất khốc liệt ở đó!

dialogsBegin.en: Oh your story about the pattern reminds me of something I read in one of the ancient texts.
dialogsBegin.ar: Oh your story about the pattern reminds me of something I read in one of the ancient texts.
dialogsBegin.br: Ah, sua história sobre o formato me lembra de algo que li em um dos textos antigos.
dialogsBegin.cns: 啊，听完这个纹样的事情之后想到了一件事情。是我在以前研究古代文书的时候发现的。
dialogsBegin.de: Oh~ Deine Geschichte der Muster erinnert mich an etwas, dass ich in den Inhalten eines alten Dokuments studiert habe.
dialogsBegin.fi: Oh your story about the pattern reminds me of something I read in one of the ancient texts.
dialogsBegin.fil: Oh your story about the pattern reminds me of something I read in one of the ancient texts.
dialogsBegin.fr: Oh ! Cette image me rappelle quelque chose que j'ai lu dans d'anciens documents que j'ai étudiés.
dialogsBegin.id: Oh, ceritamu tentang pola itu mengingatkanku akan sesuatu yang pernah kubaca di salah satu teks kuno.
dialogsBegin.it: Oh your story about the pattern reminds me of something I read in one of the ancient texts.
dialogsBegin.jp: この文様については心当たりがあります。以前、わたしが古文書などを整理しているときに発見しました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 아, 문양 이야기를 들으니 예전에 고문서에서 읽은 내용이 생각나는군요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Oh your story about the pattern reminds me of something I read in one of the ancient texts.
dialogsBegin.pl: Oh your story about the pattern reminds me of something I read in one of the ancient texts.
dialogsBegin.ru: Вспомнила! Я знаю, где видела этот узор!
dialogsBegin.sp: Oh, tu historia sobre el patrón me recuerda a algo que leí en uno de los textos antiguos.
dialogsBegin.sw: Oh your story about the pattern reminds me of something I read in one of the ancient texts.
dialogsBegin.th: โอ้ เรื่องราวของคุณเกี่ยวกับรูปแบบนี้ ทำให้ฉันนึกถึงบางสิ่งที่ฉันอ่านในตำราโบราณเล่มหนึ่ง
dialogsBegin.tw: 啊，聽完這個紋樣的事情之後想到了一件事情。是我在以前研究古代文書的時候發現的。
dialogsBegin.vi: Ồ câu chuyện của bạn về mô hình gợi cho tôi nhớ đến điều gì đó mà tôi đã đọc trong một trong những văn bản cổ.

dialogsBegin.en: Do you know the Hill of Shade? I found it in one of my books but have only dared to venture there once.
dialogsBegin.ar: Do you know the Hill of Shade? I found it in one of my books but have only dared to venture there once.
dialogsBegin.br: Você conhece a Colina de Shade? Eu a descobri em um de meus livros, mas não me atrevi a ir lá.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你知道<谢德莉丘岭>吗?突然想到，我在之前研究古代文书时，发现的一个地方，后来我去过那边。
dialogsBegin.de: Kennst du den Hill of Shade? Ich habe in einem meiner Bücher über ihn gelesen, mich aber nur einmal kurz dort hingetraut.
dialogsBegin.fi: Do you know the Hill of Shade? I found it in one of my books but have only dared to venture there once.
dialogsBegin.fil: Do you know the Hill of Shade? I found it in one of my books but have only dared to venture there once.
dialogsBegin.fr: Connais-tu la Colline de Shade ? Tout comme la Plaine de Bubble, cet endroit est entouré de mystère…
dialogsBegin.id: Apa kamu tahu Hill of Shade? Aku menemukannya di salah satu bukuku tetapi hanya berani menjelajah ke sana sekali.
dialogsBegin.it: Do you know the Hill of Shade? I found it in one of my books but have only dared to venture there once.
dialogsBegin.jp: 私も古文書で読んで何度か訪れたことがあるのですが、実は＜シェードの丘＞を訪れた時に、＜バブルの平原＞で見つかった文様と非常に良く似た文様を見かけた記憶があるのです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 혹시 쉐이드의 언덕을 아시나요? 어느 책에서 본 적이 있어요. 실제로 가본 건 단 한 번뿐이었지만요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Do you know the Hill of Shade? I found it in one of my books but have only dared to venture there once.
dialogsBegin.pl: Do you know the Hill of Shade? I found it in one of my books but have only dared to venture there once.
dialogsBegin.ru: Есть такое место - Тенистый холм. Я много о нем читала, но отважилась подняться на него только раз.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Conoces la Colina de Shade? La encontré en uno de mis libros, pero solo me he atrevido a aventurarme allí una vez.
dialogsBegin.sw: Do you know the Hill of Shade? I found it in one of my books but have only dared to venture there once.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณรู้จักเนินเขาแห่งเงาหรือไม่? ฉันพบมันในหนังสือเล่มหนึ่งของฉัน แต่กล้าที่จะไปที่นั่นเพียงครั้งเดียว
dialogsBegin.tw: 你知道闇影丘嶺嗎？突然想到，我在之前研究古代文書時，發現的一個地方，後來我去過那邊。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có biết Hill of Shade? Tôi đã tìm thấy nó trong một trong những cuốn sách của mình nhưng chỉ dám mạo hiểm đến đó một lần.

dialogsBegin.en: There is a pattern similar to the one that you saw in the Field of Bubble. Or maybe it was exactly the same. If those two patterns are the same...
dialogsBegin.ar: There is a pattern similar to the one that you saw in the Field of Bubble. Or maybe it was exactly the same. If those two patterns are the same...
dialogsBegin.br: Há um formato semelhante ao que você viu na Planície de Bubble. Ou talvez seja exatamente o mesmo, se os dois formatos forem iguais..
dialogsBegin.cns: There is a pattern similar to the one that you saw in the Field of Bubble. Or maybe it was exactly the same. If those two patterns are the same...
dialogsBegin.de: Dort sind ähnliche Muster, wie diese auf der Ebene von Bubble. Wenn die beiden Muster die selben sind..
dialogsBegin.fi: There is a pattern similar to the one that you saw in the Field of Bubble. Or maybe it was exactly the same. If those two patterns are the same...
dialogsBegin.fil: There is a pattern similar to the one that you saw in the Field of Bubble. Or maybe it was exactly the same. If those two patterns are the same...
dialogsBegin.fr: Hors je me rappelle avoir lu qu'un mystérieux motif y était inscrit sur le sol… S'il est identique avec celui de la plaine de Bubble…
dialogsBegin.id: Ada pola yang mirip dengan yang kau lihat di field of Bubble. Bahkan mungkin persis sama. Jika kedua pola itu sama..
dialogsBegin.it: There is a pattern similar to the one that you saw in the Field of Bubble. Or maybe it was exactly the same. If those two patterns are the same...
dialogsBegin.jp: 私が思うに、＜シェードの丘＞にも＜バブルの平原＞と何か共通した秘密が隠されているように感じるのです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 버블의 장에서 본 것과 비슷한 무늬가 있던데요. 아니, 똑같은 걸지도 모르겠네요. 그 두 무늬가 같은 거라면...
dialogsBegin.nl: There is a pattern similar to the one that you saw in the Field of Bubble. Or maybe it was exactly the same. If those two patterns are the same...
dialogsBegin.pl: There is a pattern similar to the one that you saw in the Field of Bubble. Or maybe it was exactly the same. If those two patterns are the same...
dialogsBegin.ru: There is a pattern similar to the one that you saw in the Field of Bubble. Or maybe it was exactly the same. If those two patterns are the same...
dialogsBegin.sp: Hay un patrón similar al que viste en la Llanura de Bubble. O incluso puede que sea exactamente el mismo. Si esos dos patrones son iguales...
dialogsBegin.sw: There is a pattern similar to the one that you saw in the Field of Bubble. Or maybe it was exactly the same. If those two patterns are the same...
dialogsBegin.th: มีรูปแบบคล้ายกับที่คุณเห็นในทุ่งแห่ง Bubble หรืออาจจะเหมือนกันหมด ถ้าสองลายนี้เหมือนกัน
dialogsBegin.tw: 那裡有一個和你在巴布樂平原看到的很像的紋樣，說不定根本就是同一個。如果這兩個紋樣真的一樣……
dialogsBegin.vi: Có một hoa văn tương tự như cái mà bạn đã thấy trong Field of Bubble. Hoặc có thể nó giống hệt nhau. Nếu hai họa tiết đó giống nhau ..

dialogsBegin.en: ...maybe you can also find a cloth piece over there. Would you please go and check?
dialogsBegin.ar: ...maybe you can also find a cloth piece over there. Would you please go and check?
dialogsBegin.br: ...talvez você também encontre um pedaço de tecido ali. Você verificaria isso?
dialogsBegin.cns: ...maybe you can also find a cloth piece over there. Would you please go and check?
dialogsBegin.de: ...vielleicht findest du dort auch ein Stück Stoff. Bitte schau mal nach.
dialogsBegin.fi: ...maybe you can also find a cloth piece over there. Would you please go and check?
dialogsBegin.fil: ...maybe you can also find a cloth piece over there. Would you please go and check?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il faut absolument aller vérifier, pourrais-tu faire cela pour moi s'il te plaît ?
dialogsBegin.id: ..mungkin kamu juga dapat menemukan sepotong kain di sana. Maukah kamu pergi dan memeriksanya?
dialogsBegin.it: ...maybe you can also find a cloth piece over there. Would you please go and check?
dialogsBegin.jp: おそらくそこにも、あなたが＜バブルの平原＞で探してきたものと同じ布切れがあるはず。一度、調査をしてきていただけませんか？
dialogsBegin.kr: ...저쪽에서 천 조각도 찾으실 수 있을 거예요. 가서 확인해 보시겠어요?
dialogsBegin.nl: ...maybe you can also find a cloth piece over there. Would you please go and check?
dialogsBegin.pl: ...maybe you can also find a cloth piece over there. Would you please go and check?
dialogsBegin.ru: ...maybe you can also find a cloth piece over there. Would you please go and check?
dialogsBegin.sp: ...es posible que también puedas encontrar un trozo de tela allí. ¿Podrías ir a comprobarlo?
dialogsBegin.sw: ...maybe you can also find a cloth piece over there. Would you please go and check?
dialogsBegin.th: ..บางทีคุณอาจหาผ้าผืนนั้นก็ได้ ลองไปเช็คดูไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: ……那邊或許也能找到一塊布片。你願意過去確認看看嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: ..bạn cũng có thể tìm thấy một mảnh vải ở đó. Bạn làm ơn đi kiểm tra thử được chứ?

dialogsAccept.en: Thank you. Please check around for the pattern in the Hill of Shade. Oh! Please be careful because there is something very fierce over there!
dialogsAccept.ar: Thank you. Please check around for the pattern in the Hill of Shade. Oh! Please be careful because there is something very fierce over there!
dialogsAccept.br: Obrigada. Procure o formato na Colina de Shade. Ah! Tome cuidado, porque há algo muito feroz ali!
dialogsAccept.cns: 谢谢你，请帮我去调查一下谢德莉丘岭的纹样，那边有很多很恐怖的怪物，所以要小心喔。
dialogsAccept.de: Danke. Bitte schau dich auf dem Hügel von Shade nach dem Muster um. Oh! Bitte sei vorsichtig. Da ist irgendetwas ziemlich wildes dort drüben!
dialogsAccept.fi: Thank you. Please check around for the pattern in the Hill of Shade. Oh! Please be careful because there is something very fierce over there!
dialogsAccept.fil: Thank you. Please check around for the pattern in the Hill of Shade. Oh! Please be careful because there is something very fierce over there!
dialogsAccept.fr: Merci. Pars à la Colline de Shade, et essaie de trouver un lieu similaire à celui de la Plaine de Bubble. S'il existe, il devrait bien y avoir un indice là-bas !
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih, Tolong periksa dengan seksama pola yang ada di Hill of Shade. Oh! Harap berhati-hati karena ada sesuatu yang sangat ganas di sana!
dialogsAccept.it: Thank you. Please check around for the pattern in the Hill of Shade. Oh! Please be careful because there is something very fierce over there!
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとうございます。では＜シェードの丘＞にある文様の周辺を調査してきてください。ひとつ言い忘れていましたが、あそこはとても凶悪なモンスターがうろついていますので、十分に気をつけてくださいね。
dialogsAccept.kr: 고마워요. 쉐이드의 언덕에 있는 문양을 조사해 주세요. 하지만 조심하셔야 해요. 거긴 아주 위험한 존재가 도사리고 있거든요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Thank you. Please check around for the pattern in the Hill of Shade. Oh! Please be careful because there is something very fierce over there!
dialogsAccept.pl: Thank you. Please check around for the pattern in the Hill of Shade. Oh! Please be careful because there is something very fierce over there!
dialogsAccept.ru: Отлично. Ах, да! Чуть не забыла. Будь осторожнее - говорят, там живет какой-то проходимец. Сильный и злющий!
dialogsAccept.sp: Gracias. Por favor busca el patrón por los alrededores de la Colina de Shade. ¡Oh! ¡Ten cuidado porque hay algo muy feroz allí!
dialogsAccept.sw: Thank you. Please check around for the pattern in the Hill of Shade. Oh! Please be careful because there is something very fierce over there!
dialogsAccept.th: ขอบคุณ โปรดตรวจสอบรูปแบบใน Hill of Shade โอ้! ระวังด้วย เพราะมีบางอย่างที่ดุร้ายอยู่ตรงนั้น!
dialogsAccept.tw: 謝謝你，請幫我去調查一下闇影丘嶺的紋樣，那邊有很多很恐怖的怪物，所以要小心喔。
dialogsAccept.vi: Cảm ơn bạn. Vui lòng kiểm tra xung quanh để tìm mô hình trong Hill of Shade. Ồ! Xin hãy cẩn thận vì có một cái gì đó rất khốc liệt ở đó!

dialogsDecline.en: I understand but if you ever get the chance would you please check?
dialogsDecline.ar: I understand but if you ever get the chance would you please check?
dialogsDecline.br: Entendo, mas se tiver chance, você verificaria isso?
dialogsDecline.cns: 好，我知道了，希望以后你可以去调查看看，真的是很重要的。
dialogsDecline.de: Das ist okay, aber bitte überprüfe es, wenn du Zeit hast. Es würde sehr hilfreich sein.
dialogsDecline.fi: I understand but if you ever get the chance would you please check?
dialogsDecline.fil: I understand but if you ever get the chance would you please check?
dialogsDecline.fr: Comment ?! Tu ne peux pas renoncer à une telle aventure ?
dialogsDecline.id: Aku mengerti, tapi jika kamu sempat, maukah kamu memeriksanya?
dialogsDecline.it: I understand but if you ever get the chance would you please check?
dialogsDecline.jp: そうですか、わかりました。お急ぎの用事があるようでしたら、あとでも構いませんので。またいらっしゃってください。
dialogsDecline.kr: 이해해요. 하지만 혹시 기회가 생긴다면 꼭 확인해 주실 수 있나요?
dialogsDecline.nl: I understand but if you ever get the chance would you please check?
dialogsDecline.pl: I understand but if you ever get the chance would you please check?
dialogsDecline.ru: Да-да, я понимаю: времени в обрез. Но если будешь проходить мимо, все же загляни туда.
dialogsDecline.sp: Lo entiendo, pero si alguna vez tienes la oportunidad, ¿podrás comprobarlo?
dialogsDecline.sw: I understand but if you ever get the chance would you please check?
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันเข้าใจ แต่ถ้ามีโอกาสคุณช่วยตรวจสอบได้ไหม
dialogsDecline.tw: 好，我知道了，希望以後你可以去調查看看，真的是很重要的。
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi hiểu nhưng nếu bạn có cơ hội, bạn có vui lòng kiểm tra không?

dialogsComplete.en: Iblis above, you look terrible. I appreciate your hard work. You did exceptional work. Let me compare the two cloth pieces.
dialogsComplete.ar: Iblis above, you look terrible. I appreciate your hard work. You did exceptional work. Let me compare the two cloth pieces.
dialogsComplete.br: Por Iblis, você está horrível. Agradeço seu trabalho árduo. Você foi excepcional. Vou comparar os dois pedaços de pano.
dialogsComplete.cns: 嗯..你的样子怎么搞成这样了，辛苦你了!!我来跟之前的布条一起调查看看好了。
dialogsComplete.de: Oh mein Gott.. Du siehst schrecklich aus.. Ich sehe es dir an, dass es wirklich schwer für dich gewesen sein muss.. gute Arbeit. Ich will nun diese Cloth Pieces auch überprüfen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Iblis above, you look terrible. I appreciate your hard work. You did exceptional work. Let me compare the two cloth pieces.
dialogsComplete.fil: Iblis above, you look terrible. I appreciate your hard work. You did exceptional work. Let me compare the two cloth pieces.
dialogsComplete.fr: C'est incroyable ! Il existe donc bien un lieu similaire à la Colline de Shade. Laisse-moi étudier ce que tu m'as ramené...
dialogsComplete.id: Iblis di atas, kau terlihat mengerikan. Aku menghargai kerja kerasmu. Kamu melakukan pekerjaan yang luar biasa. Biar kucoba membandingkan dua kain itu.
dialogsComplete.it: Iblis above, you look terrible. I appreciate your hard work. You did exceptional work. Let me compare the two cloth pieces.
dialogsComplete.jp: 調べてきていただけたようですね、お疲れさまでした。やはり布切れも見つかったようですね、早速、調査いたします。ありがとうございます！
dialogsComplete.kr: 세상에나, 꼴이 말이 아니군요. 고생 많으셨어요. 정말 훌륭하게 해내셨네요. 두 천 조각을 비교해 볼게요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Iblis above, you look terrible. I appreciate your hard work. You did exceptional work. Let me compare the two cloth pieces.
dialogsComplete.pl: Iblis above, you look terrible. I appreciate your hard work. You did exceptional work. Let me compare the two cloth pieces.
dialogsComplete.ru: Святая Параллельна, ну и досталось же тебе! Я и не думала, что это будет так сложно. Давай сравним рисунки на лоскутках.
dialogsComplete.sp: Por Iblis, que mala cara tienes. Aprecio tu duro trabajo. Has hecho un trabajo excepcional. Déjame comparar los dos trozos de tela.
dialogsComplete.sw: Iblis above, you look terrible. I appreciate your hard work. You did exceptional work. Let me compare the two cloth pieces.
dialogsComplete.th: Iblis คุ้มครอง คุณดูแย่มาก ฉันขอบคุณการทำงานหนักของคุณ คุณทำงานพิเศษ ขอฉันเปรียบเทียบผ้าทั้งสองชิ้น
dialogsComplete.tw: 嗯…你的樣子怎麼搞成這樣了，辛苦你了！！我來跟之前的布條一起調查看看好了。
dialogsComplete.vi: Iblis ở trên kia, bạn trông tệ thật. Tôi đánh giá cao công việc khó khăn của bạn. Bạn đã làm việc xuất sắc. Cho tôi so sánh hai mảnh vải.

dialogsFail.en: Maybe the monster I mentioned earlier was too much for you to handle? You can try again if you wish or not up to you.
dialogsFail.ar: Maybe the monster I mentioned earlier was too much for you to handle? You can try again if you wish or not up to you.
dialogsFail.br: Talvez o monstro que mencionei antes tenha sido demais para você. Você pode tentar novamente ou não, cabe a você.
dialogsFail.cns: 那么恐怖的东西..我想你一个人应该很难对付的，我相应该要..
dialogsFail.de: Irgenwas ziemlich wildes ist dort drüben.. Vieleicht solltest du nicht alleine dort hin gehen..
dialogsFail.fi: Maybe the monster I mentioned earlier was too much for you to handle? You can try again if you wish or not up to you.
dialogsFail.fil: Maybe the monster I mentioned earlier was too much for you to handle? You can try again if you wish or not up to you.
dialogsFail.fr: S'il existe, l'endroit risque d'être très dangereux. Peut-être devrais-tu t'allier à d'autres aventuriers ?
dialogsFail.id: Mungkin monster yang aku sebutkan sebelumnya terlalu berat untuk kamu tangani? Kau dapat mencobanya lagi jika mau.
dialogsFail.it: Maybe the monster I mentioned earlier was too much for you to handle? You can try again if you wish or not up to you.
dialogsFail.jp: ＜シェードの丘＞にたむろする凶悪なモンスターは、いくら屈強な冒険者の方といえど、一人では無理かもしれません。その場合はパーティーを組んで倒すのもひとつの方法でしょう。ご無事を祈ります。
dialogsFail.kr: 혹시 제가 말한 몬스터가 감당하기엔 너무 강했던 걸까요? 다시 도전해도 되고, 아니면 그만두셔도 괜찮아요.
dialogsFail.nl: Maybe the monster I mentioned earlier was too much for you to handle? You can try again if you wish or not up to you.
dialogsFail.pl: Maybe the monster I mentioned earlier was too much for you to handle? You can try again if you wish or not up to you.
dialogsFail.ru: Говоришь, проходимец обратил тебя в бегство? Ничего не поделаешь - чтобы подняться на холм, придется его одолеть…
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Quizás el monstruo que mencioné antes era demasiado para ti? Puedes volver a intentarlo si lo deseas, depende de ti.
dialogsFail.sw: Maybe the monster I mentioned earlier was too much for you to handle? You can try again if you wish or not up to you.
dialogsFail.th: บางทีสัตว์ประหลาดที่ฉันพูดถึงก่อนหน้านี้อาจมากเกินไปสำหรับคุณที่จะรับมือมั้ง? คุณสามารถลองอีกครั้งหากต้องการขึ้นอยู่กับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 那麼恐怖的東西…我想你一個人應該很難對付的，我想應該要…
dialogsFail.vi: Có lẽ con quái vật tôi đã đề cập trước đó là quá nhiều cho bạn để xử lý? Bạn có thể thử lại nếu muốn hoặc không tùy thuộc vào bạn.

name.th: บททดสอบความแข็งแกร่ง

description.en: Show me a convincing display of your strength. This chamber is filled with Katamaws, a ferocious beast that cannot be tamed. Kill 70 of them and I may consider trusting your abilities.
description.ar: Show me a convincing display of your strength. This chamber is filled with Katamaws, a ferocious beast that cannot be tamed. Kill 70 of them and I may consider trusting your abilities.
description.br: Me mostre uma exibição convincente de sua força. Esta câmara está cheia de Katamaws, uma fera feroz que não pode ser domada. Mate 70 deles e posso considerar confiar em suas habilidades.
description.cns: 给我一个令人信服的展示你的力量。这个房间里充满了 Katamaws，一种无法驯服的凶猛野兽。杀掉70个，我可能会考虑相信你的能力。
description.de: Überzeuge mich von deiner Stärke. Diese Kammer ist gefüllt mit Katamaw, ein wildes Biest , das nicht gezähmt werden kann. Töte 70 und ich könnte deinen Fähigkeiten vertrauen.
description.fi: Show me a convincing display of your strength. This chamber is filled with Katamaws, a ferocious beast that cannot be tamed. Kill 70 of them and I may consider trusting your abilities.
description.fil: Show me a convincing display of your strength. This chamber is filled with Katamaws, a ferocious beast that cannot be tamed. Kill 70 of them and I may consider trusting your abilities.
description.fr: Tu penses pouvoir me convaincre ? Montre-moi ta force, alors. Cette salle est remplie de Katamaws, de féroces et indomptables bêtes. Tues-en 70 et je te ferai confiance.
description.id: Tunjukkan padaku tampilan yang meyakinkan dari kekuatanmu. Ruangan ini dipenuhi dengan Katamaws, Makhluk buas yang tidak bisa dijinakkan. Habisi 70 dari mereka dan aku mungkin mempertimbangkan untuk mempercayai kemampuanmu.
description.it: Show me a convincing display of your strength. This chamber is filled with Katamaws, a ferocious beast that cannot be tamed. Kill 70 of them and I may consider trusting your abilities.
description.jp: 説得力があるなら今ここで見せてみなさいよ。 この付近はカタモーでいっぱいだし、飼いならすことなんてできない獰猛な獣だわ。せいぜい70匹殺せば、お前の力を認めてやる。
description.kr: 당신의 능력으로 절 설득해 보세요. 이 방은 길들일 수 없는 사나운 몬스터로 가득 차 있어요. 바로 카타모우죠. 70마리를 처치하면 용사님의 능력을 믿어 드릴게요.
description.nl: Show me a convincing display of your strength. This chamber is filled with Katamaws, a ferocious beast that cannot be tamed. Kill 70 of them and I may consider trusting your abilities.
description.pl: Show me a convincing display of your strength. This chamber is filled with Katamaws, a ferocious beast that cannot be tamed. Kill 70 of them and I may consider trusting your abilities.
description.ru: Show me a convincing display of your strength. This chamber is filled with Katamaws, a ferocious beast that cannot be tamed. Kill 70 of them and I may consider trusting your abilities.
description.sp: Muéstrame el poder de tu fuerza. Esta cámara está llena de Katamaws, una bestia feroz que no puede ser domesticada. Mata a 70 de ellos y podría considerar confiar en tus habilidades.
description.sw: Show me a convincing display of your strength. This chamber is filled with Katamaws, a ferocious beast that cannot be tamed. Kill 70 of them and I may consider trusting your abilities.
description.th: แสดงความแข็งแกร่งของคุณให้ฉันดู ห้องนี้เต็มไปด้วย Katamaws สัตว์ดุร้ายที่ไม่สามารถทำให้เชื่องได้ สังหารพวกมัน 70 ตัว และฉันอาจจะเชื่อในความสามารถของคุณ
description.tw: 給我一個令人信服的展示你的力量。這個房間裡充滿了 卡塔毛，一種無法馴服的兇猛野獸。殺掉 70 隻，我可能會考慮相信你的能力。
description.vi: Hãy cho tôi xem một màn trình diễn sức mạnh thuyết phục. Căn phòng này chứa đầy Katamaws, một con thú hung dữ không thể thuần hóa. Giết 70 Katamaws và tôi có thể cân nhắc việc tin tưởng vào năng lực của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: The other two guardians may still be alive, but you are foolish to come here. Nobody is strong enough to face the Red Meteonyker.
dialogsBegin.ar: The other two guardians may still be alive, but you are foolish to come here. Nobody is strong enough to face the Red Meteonyker.
dialogsBegin.br: Os outros dois guardiões ainda podem estar vivos, mas você é um tolo por vir aqui. Ninguém é forte o suficiente para enfrentar o Meteonyker Vermelho.
dialogsBegin.cns: 其他两个守护者可能还活着，但你来这里，是极其愚蠢的决定。没有人强大到足以面对 红龙。
dialogsBegin.de: Die anderen zwei Beschützer sind immer noch am Leben, aber du bist dumm genug, hierher zu kommen. Niemand ist stark genug, den Red Meteonyker gegenüber zu stehen.
dialogsBegin.fi: The other two guardians may still be alive, but you are foolish to come here. Nobody is strong enough to face the Red Meteonyker.
dialogsBegin.fil: The other two guardians may still be alive, but you are foolish to come here. Nobody is strong enough to face the Red Meteonyker.
dialogsBegin.fr: Les deux autres gardiens sont peut-être en vie, mais tu es insensé pour venir ici. Personne n'est assez fort pour vaincre le Meteonyker Rouge.
dialogsBegin.id: Dua guardian lainnya mungkin masih hidup, tetapi kamu bodoh datang ke sini. Tidak ada yang cukup kuat untuk menghadapi Red Meteonyker.
dialogsBegin.it: The other two guardians may still be alive, but you are foolish to come here. Nobody is strong enough to face the Red Meteonyker.
dialogsBegin.jp: 他の2人の守護者はまだ生きているのでしょうけれど、ここに来るなんてあなたは愚かです。レッドメテオニカに立ち向かうほど強い人はもうどこにもいないわ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 다른 두 가디언이 아직 살아있다 하더라도, 여기 온 건 어리석은 짓이에요. 빨강 메테오니커에 맞설 만큼 강한 사람은 아무도 없다고요.
dialogsBegin.nl: The other two guardians may still be alive, but you are foolish to come here. Nobody is strong enough to face the Red Meteonyker.
dialogsBegin.pl: The other two guardians may still be alive, but you are foolish to come here. Nobody is strong enough to face the Red Meteonyker.
dialogsBegin.ru: The other two guardians may still be alive, but you are foolish to come here. Nobody is strong enough to face the Red Meteonyker.
dialogsBegin.sp: Puede que los otros dos guardianes sigan vivos, pero eres tonto al venir aquí. Nadie es lo suficientemente fuerte como para enfrentarse al Meteonyker Rojo.
dialogsBegin.sw: The other two guardians may still be alive, but you are foolish to come here. Nobody is strong enough to face the Red Meteonyker.
dialogsBegin.th: ผู้พิทักษ์อีกสองคนอาจยังมีชีวิตอยู่ แต่เจ้าโง่มากที่มาที่นี่ ไม่มีใครแข็งแกร่งพอที่จะเผชิญหน้ากับ Red Meteonyker
dialogsBegin.tw: 其他兩個守護者可能還活著，但你來這裡是愚蠢的，沒有人強大到足以面對炙焰飛龍。
dialogsBegin.vi: Hai guardians kia có thể vẫn còn sống, nhưng bạn thật dại dột khi đến đây. Không ai đủ mạnh để đối mặt với Red Meteonyker.

dialogsBegin.en: Kumah spoke to you? That's okay. He has too much faith in people. I'm a bit of a skeptic. Nothing has ever gone right in this terrible place for us.
dialogsBegin.ar: Kumah spoke to you? That's okay. He has too much faith in people. I'm a bit of a skeptic. Nothing has ever gone right in this terrible place for us.
dialogsBegin.br: Kumah falou com você? Tudo bem. Ele tem muita fé nas pessoas. Mas não sou como ele. Nada nunca deu certo neste lugar terrível para nós.
dialogsBegin.cns: 库马跟你说话了？真是的，他太相信别人了。对我们来说，在这个鬼地方，没有发生过任何好事。
dialogsBegin.de: Kumah hat mit dir geredet? Das ist okay. Er ist zu leichtgläubig. Ich bin eher skeptisch. Nichts hat jemals in diesem schrecklichen Ort im unseren Sinne funktioniert.
dialogsBegin.fi: Kumah spoke to you? That's okay. He has too much faith in people. I'm a bit of a skeptic. Nothing has ever gone right in this terrible place for us.
dialogsBegin.fil: Kumah spoke to you? That's okay. He has too much faith in people. I'm a bit of a skeptic. Nothing has ever gone right in this terrible place for us.
dialogsBegin.fr: Kumah t'a dit le contraire ? Eh bien, il a trop foi en l'humanité. Je suis plus sceptique. Rien ne s'est jamais bien passé dans cet endroit horrible.
dialogsBegin.id: Kumah berbicara kepadamu? Enggak apa-apa. Dia memiliki terlalu banyak kepercayaan pada orang-orang. Saya sedikit skeptis. Tidak ada yang pernah berjalan dengan benar di tempat yang mengerikan ini bagi kita.
dialogsBegin.it: Kumah spoke to you? That's okay. He has too much faith in people. I'm a bit of a skeptic. Nothing has ever gone right in this terrible place for us.
dialogsBegin.jp: クマーに話しかけられたの？ふっ、それはね、彼は人を信じすぎる癖があるからね。私は懐疑的。こんなひどい場所で、うまくいったためしがないもの。
dialogsBegin.kr: 쿠마와 대화했다고요? 괜찮아요. 쿠마는 사람을 너무 믿지만요. 전 좀 회의적이에요. 이 끔찍한 곳에 제대로 된 건 하나도 없잖아요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Kumah spoke to you? That's okay. He has too much faith in people. I'm a bit of a skeptic. Nothing has ever gone right in this terrible place for us.
dialogsBegin.pl: Kumah spoke to you? That's okay. He has too much faith in people. I'm a bit of a skeptic. Nothing has ever gone right in this terrible place for us.
dialogsBegin.ru: Kumah spoke to you? That's okay. He has too much faith in people. I'm a bit of a skeptic. Nothing has ever gone right in this terrible place for us.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Kumah habló contigo? Genial. Tiene demasiada fe en la gente. Soy un poco escéptico. Nada nos ha salido bien en este terrible lugar.
dialogsBegin.sw: Kumah spoke to you? That's okay. He has too much faith in people. I'm a bit of a skeptic. Nothing has ever gone right in this terrible place for us.
dialogsBegin.th: Kumah พูดกับคุณ? ไม่เป็นไร เขามีศรัทธาในผู้คนมากเกินไป ฉันเป็นคนขี้ระแวง ในสถานที่ที่เลวร้ายนี้ไม่เคยมีอะไรเกิดขึ้นเลยสำหรับเรา
dialogsBegin.tw: 庫瑪跟你說話了？沒關係。他太相信人了。我有點懷疑。對我們來說，在這個可怕的地方沒有任何事情發生過。
dialogsBegin.vi: Kumah đã nói chuyện với bạn? Không sao đâu. Anh ấy quá tin vào con người. Tôi có một chút hoài nghi. Đối với chúng tôi, đã không có gì xảy ra ngay tại nơi khủng khiếp này .
