dialogsComplete.en: I kept my word. You now have all three pieces of the key.
dialogsComplete.ar: I kept my word. You now have all three pieces of the key.
dialogsComplete.br: Eu mantive minha palavra. Agora você tem todas as três partes da chave.
dialogsComplete.cns: 我信守诺言。给，第三个钥匙。
dialogsComplete.de: Ich halte mein Wort. Du besitzt nun alle drei Teile des Schlüssels.
dialogsComplete.fi: I kept my word. You now have all three pieces of the key.
dialogsComplete.fil: I kept my word. You now have all three pieces of the key.
dialogsComplete.fr: J'ai tenu ma parole. Tu possèdes désormais les trois morceaux de la clé.
dialogsComplete.id: Aku menjaga kata-kataku. Kamu sekarang memiliki ketiga bagian kunci.
dialogsComplete.it: I kept my word. You now have all three pieces of the key.
dialogsComplete.jp: 約束を守ってやったわ。これでカギの欠片3つ全部、揃ったんでしょ？
dialogsComplete.kr: 전 약속을 지켰어요. 이제 열쇠 세 조각을 모두 획득하셨네요.
dialogsComplete.nl: I kept my word. You now have all three pieces of the key.
dialogsComplete.pl: I kept my word. You now have all three pieces of the key.
dialogsComplete.ru: I kept my word. You now have all three pieces of the key.
dialogsComplete.sp: Mantuve mi palabra. Ahora tienes las tres piezas de la llave.
dialogsComplete.sw: I kept my word. You now have all three pieces of the key.
dialogsComplete.th: ฉันรักษาคำพูด ตอนนี้คุณมีกุญแจทั้งสามชิ้นแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 我信守諾言，你現在擁有所有三個密鑰。
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi đã giữ lời. Bây giờ bạn có tất cả ba mảnh chìa khóa.

dialogsComplete.en: In order to merge them and unlock the entrance to the Red Meteonyker, you must find a guardian forger.
dialogsComplete.ar: In order to merge them and unlock the entrance to the Red Meteonyker, you must find a guardian forger.
dialogsComplete.br: Para fundi-los e desbloquear a entrada do Meteonyker Vermelho, você deve encontrar um guardião ferreiro.
dialogsComplete.cns: 为了合并它们并解锁红龙的入口，你必须找到一个守护锻造者。
dialogsComplete.de: Um sie zu verbinden und den Eingang zum Red Meteonyker zu öffnen musst du einen Beschützer Schmied finden.
dialogsComplete.fi: In order to merge them and unlock the entrance to the Red Meteonyker, you must find a guardian forger.
dialogsComplete.fil: In order to merge them and unlock the entrance to the Red Meteonyker, you must find a guardian forger.
dialogsComplete.fr: Pour les combiner et déverrouiller l'accès au Meteonyker Rouge, tu dois trouver un gardien forgeron.
dialogsComplete.id: Untuk menggabungkan mereka dan membuka kunci pintu masuk ke Red Meteonyker, Kamuharus menemukan Guardian forger.
dialogsComplete.it: In order to merge them and unlock the entrance to the Red Meteonyker, you must find a guardian forger.
dialogsComplete.jp: それをうまいこと繋ぎ合わせればいいんだろうけど、守護者ハーモを見つけないとできそうにないわ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 열쇠를 합쳐서 빨강 메테오니커에게 가는 입구를 열려면, 가디언 제련사를 찾아야 해요.
dialogsComplete.nl: In order to merge them and unlock the entrance to the Red Meteonyker, you must find a guardian forger.
dialogsComplete.pl: In order to merge them and unlock the entrance to the Red Meteonyker, you must find a guardian forger.
dialogsComplete.ru: In order to merge them and unlock the entrance to the Red Meteonyker, you must find a guardian forger.
dialogsComplete.sp: Para fusionarlos y desbloquear la entrada al Meteonyker Rojo, debes encontrar a un guardián forjador.
dialogsComplete.sw: In order to merge them and unlock the entrance to the Red Meteonyker, you must find a guardian forger.
dialogsComplete.th: เพื่อรวมพวกมันและปลดล็อคทางเข้า Red Meteonyker คุณต้องหาผู้พิทักษ์guardian forger
dialogsComplete.tw: 為了合併它們並解鎖炙焰飛龍的入口，你必須找到一個守護者偽造者。
dialogsComplete.vi: Để hợp nhất chúng và mở khóa lối vào Red Meteonyker, bạn phải tìm một người giả mạo là guardian.

dialogsComplete.en: Most were wiped out long ago. You must find any survivors and bring the key together once again.
dialogsComplete.ar: Most were wiped out long ago. You must find any survivors and bring the key together once again.
dialogsComplete.br: A maioria foi exterminada há muito tempo. Você deve encontrar quaisquer sobreviventes e reunir a chave novamente.
dialogsComplete.cns: 大多数在很久以前就被消灭了。你必须找到任何还存在的铸造者并再次将钥匙放在一起。
dialogsComplete.de: Die meisten wurden vor langer Zeit ausgelöscht. Du musst jeden Überlebenden finden und den Schlüssel wieder zusammenbringen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Most were wiped out long ago. You must find any survivors and bring the key together once again.
dialogsComplete.fil: Most were wiped out long ago. You must find any survivors and bring the key together once again.
dialogsComplete.fr: La plupart sont morts depuis bien longtemps. Tu dois trouver un survivant et reconstituer la clé.
dialogsComplete.id: Sebagian besar telah dimusnahkan sejak lama. Kamu harus menemukan yang selamat dan menyatukan kuncinya sekali lagi.
dialogsComplete.it: Most were wiped out long ago. You must find any survivors and bring the key together once again.
dialogsComplete.jp: 生存者を見つけて、もう一度鍵を集めなければならないわね。
dialogsComplete.kr: 대부분 오래전에 전멸했어요. 생존자를 찾아서 다시 열쇠를 모아야겠군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Most were wiped out long ago. You must find any survivors and bring the key together once again.
dialogsComplete.pl: Most were wiped out long ago. You must find any survivors and bring the key together once again.
dialogsComplete.ru: Most were wiped out long ago. You must find any survivors and bring the key together once again.
dialogsComplete.sp: La mayoría fueron aniquilados hace mucho tiempo. Debes encontrar a los sobrevivientes y unir la llave una vez más.
dialogsComplete.sw: Most were wiped out long ago. You must find any survivors and bring the key together once again.
dialogsComplete.th: ส่วนใหญ่หมดไปนานแล้ว คุณต้องค้นหาผู้รอดชีวิตและนำกุญแจมารวมกันอีกครั้ง
dialogsComplete.tw: 大多數早就被消滅了，你必須找到任何倖存者並再次將鑰匙放在一起。
dialogsComplete.vi: Hầu hết đã bị xóa sổ từ lâu. Bạn phải tìm bất kỳ người sống sót nào và đem các mảnh chìa khóa lại với nhau.

name.th: ผู้สืบทอดของ Hero -Scroll-
name.tw: 英雄的繼承者 - 卷軸

description.en: Deliver the Earring of Heren to Ata at the Observatory in Flaris.
description.ar: Deliver the Earring of Heren to Ata at the Observatory in Flaris.
description.br: Por favor, entregue este brinco para o seu dono. O seu nome é Ata e ele está aprendendo astronomia com seu professor, Noie, no Observatório em Flaris.
description.cns: 要去找阿塔米力诺，他是诺也的师弟，目前在帕里研究天文学，请你把这遗物拿给他吧！
description.de: Bitte bring den Ohrring zu seinem Besitzer. Sein Name ist Ata und er lernt Astronomie von seinem Lehrer Noier im Observatorium in Flaris.
description.fi: Deliver the Earring of Heren to Ata at the Observatory in Flaris.
description.fil: Deliver the Earring of Heren to Ata at the Observatory in Flaris.
description.fr: Aller à l'observatoire de Flaris et remettre la Boucle d'oreille de Heren à Ata, qui protège les reliques du Héros des Assassins.
description.id: Kirimkan Anting Heren ke Ata di Observatorium di Flaris.
description.it: Deliver the Earring of Heren to Ata at the Observatory in Flaris.
description.jp: イヤリングの持主に会いましょう。名前はアタ。現在フラリス天文台のノイエから天文学を学んでいるそうです。彼に聖遺物を渡しましょう。
description.kr: 헤렌의 귀걸이를 플라리스의 관측소에 있는 아타에게 전달하세요.
description.nl: Deliver the Earring of Heren to Ata at the Observatory in Flaris.
description.pl: Deliver the Earring of Heren to Ata at the Observatory in Flaris.
description.ru: Нужно отдать подвеску Д'Артамиса Ате, звездочету из обсерватории Фларинции.
description.sp: Entrega el Pendiente de Heren a Ata en el Observatorio de Flaris.
description.sw: Deliver the Earring of Heren to Ata at the Observatory in Flaris.
description.th: ส่งต่างหูของ Heren ไปให้ Ata ที่ Observatory ใน Flaris
description.tw: 要去找艾塔米力諾，他是諾也的師弟，目前在布拉里斯研究天文學，請你把這遺物拿給他吧！
description.vi: Giao Earring of Heren cho Ata tại Observatory ở Flaris.

dialogsBegin.en: Now to get the Earring back into the right hands, the Manager of the House of Heren.
dialogsBegin.ar: Now to get the Earring back into the right hands, the Manager of the House of Heren.
dialogsBegin.br: Agora eu tenho que entregar este brinco para seu dono. O dono original era Heren, mas agora é a pessoa que administra a casa de Heren.
dialogsBegin.cns: 要把这遗物还给主人才行~原主人是海琳，不过……
dialogsBegin.de: Nun muss ich den Ohrring seinem Besitzer übergeben. Der ursprüngliche Besitzer war Heren, aber nun ist es die Person, die das Haus von Heren verwaltet.
dialogsBegin.fi: Now to get the Earring back into the right hands, the Manager of the House of Heren.
dialogsBegin.fil: Now to get the Earring back into the right hands, the Manager of the House of Heren.
dialogsBegin.fr: Maintenant je dois rendre cette boucle d'oreille à son propriétaire. Son premier propriétaire était Heren bien sûr, mais désormais une personne s'occupe des reliques du Héros des Assassins.
dialogsBegin.id: Sekarang untuk mengembalikan Anting ke tangan yang tepat, Manajer House of Heren.
dialogsBegin.it: Now to get the Earring back into the right hands, the Manager of the House of Heren.
dialogsBegin.jp: この聖遺物はしかるべき者の手に戻さないとな。元の持主はヘレン様じゃが、現在はヘレン様の館を管理している一族が所有権を有しておる。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이제 헤렌 가문의 관리자에게, 이 귀걸이를 되돌려줘야겠군요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Now to get the Earring back into the right hands, the Manager of the House of Heren.
dialogsBegin.pl: Now to get the Earring back into the right hands, the Manager of the House of Heren.
dialogsBegin.ru: Нужно отдать подвеску семье Миллениев - почетным хранителям наследия Д'Артамиса.
dialogsBegin.sp: Ahora, consigue que el Pendiente vuelva a las manos adecuadas, el Gerente de la Casa de Heren.
dialogsBegin.sw: Now to get the Earring back into the right hands, the Manager of the House of Heren.
dialogsBegin.th: ในตอนนี้เราต้องการให้ Earring กลับไปยังผู้ที่สมควรจะครอบครองมันนั่นก็คือ Manager of the Houseof Heren
dialogsBegin.tw: 要把這遺物還給主人才行~原主人是海琳，不過……
dialogsBegin.vi: Bây giờ để đưa Earring trở lại đúng người, quản gia của Heren.

dialogsBegin.en: Please deliver it to Ata at the Observatory in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.ar: Please deliver it to Ata at the Observatory in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.br: Por favor, entregue o brinco para ele. O seu nome é Ata e ele está aprendendo astronomia com seu professor, Noie, no Observatório em Flaris.
dialogsBegin.cns: 请把它交给帕里天文台的阿塔。
dialogsBegin.de: Bitte bring den Ohrring zu ihm. Sein Name ist Ata und er lernt Astronomie von seinem Lehrer Noier im Observatorium in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.fi: Please deliver it to Ata at the Observatory in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.fil: Please deliver it to Ata at the Observatory in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il te faut maintenant lui rapporter cette boucle d'oreille. Son nom est Ata, il apprend l'astronomie auprès de son maître, Noier, à l'observatoire de Flaris.
dialogsBegin.id: Tolong kirimkan ke Ata di Observatory di Flaris.
dialogsBegin.it: Please deliver it to Ata at the Observatory in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.jp: その者に会うがよい。名前はアタ。現在フラリスの天文台のノイエから天文学を学んでいるそうじゃ。彼にこの聖遺物を渡してやるがいい。
dialogsBegin.kr: 플라리스의 관측소에 있는 아타에게 귀걸이를 전달하세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Please deliver it to Ata at the Observatory in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.pl: Please deliver it to Ata at the Observatory in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.ru: Отнеси ее Ате Миллению в обсерваторию Фларинции.
dialogsBegin.sp: Entrégaselo a Ata en el Observatorio de Flaris.
dialogsBegin.sw: Please deliver it to Ata at the Observatory in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.th: กรุณาส่งมันไปให้ Ata ที่ Observatory ใน Flaris
dialogsBegin.tw: 請去找 [艾塔米力諾]，他是 [諾也] 的師弟，目前在布拉里斯研究天文學，請你把這遺物拿給它吧！
dialogsBegin.vi: Vui lòng giao nó cho Ata tại Observatory ở Flaris.

dialogsBegin.en: His family has managed the House of Heren for generations, and they’ve been seeking this earring for just as long. Possessing it again will give them great relief.
dialogsBegin.ar: His family has managed the House of Heren for generations, and they’ve been seeking this earring for just as long. Possessing it again will give them great relief.
dialogsBegin.br: A família de Ata tem administrado a casa de Heren por gerações. O seu maior dever era encontrar este brinco, e agora eles podem finalmente completá-lo.
dialogsBegin.cns: 艾塔米力诺一直都管理着海琳的家，能将遗物找回，他也不必再耿耿于怀了，呵呵！！
dialogsBegin.de: Die Familie von Ata verwaltet das Haus von Heren seit Generationen. Es ist ihre wichtigste Aufgabe den Ohrring zu finden und nun können sie endlich ihre Pflicht erfüllen.
dialogsBegin.fi: His family has managed the House of Heren for generations, and they’ve been seeking this earring for just as long. Possessing it again will give them great relief.
dialogsBegin.fil: His family has managed the House of Heren for generations, and they’ve been seeking this earring for just as long. Possessing it again will give them great relief.
dialogsBegin.fr: La famille de Ata s'occupe de la maison et des reliques de Heren depuis des générations. Retrouver cette boucle d'oreille était leur principal devoir, il pourra enfin être accompli.
dialogsBegin.id: Keluarganya telah mengelola House of Heren selama beberapa generasi, dan mereka telah lama mencari anting-anting ini. Memilikinya lagi akan memberi mereka kelegaan besar.
dialogsBegin.it: His family has managed the House of Heren for generations, and they’ve been seeking this earring for just as long. Possessing it again will give them great relief.
dialogsBegin.jp: アタの一族は代々ヘレンの館を管理しおってな、失われたイヤリングを探すことは一族の使命なのじゃよ。それがやっと叶いそうじゃのう･･･。
dialogsBegin.kr: 아타의 가문은 대대로 헤렌의 저택을 관리해 오고 있는데다, 이 귀걸이를 찾는 데에도 오랜 세월을 바쳤지요. 귀걸이를 되찾으면 정말 안도할 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: His family has managed the House of Heren for generations, and they’ve been seeking this earring for just as long. Possessing it again will give them great relief.
dialogsBegin.pl: His family has managed the House of Heren for generations, and they’ve been seeking this earring for just as long. Possessing it again will give them great relief.
dialogsBegin.ru: Поискам этой подвески посвятили себя его отец и дед. Ата стал звездочетом в надежде, что звезды укажут ему путь к ней. Представляешь, как он будет рад! Ну что, в дорогу?
dialogsBegin.sp: Su familia ha administrado la Casa de Heren durante generaciones y han estado buscando este pendiente durante el mismo tiempo. Tenerlo de nuevo les será de gran alivio.
dialogsBegin.sw: His family has managed the House of Heren for generations, and they’ve been seeking this earring for just as long. Possessing it again will give them great relief.
dialogsBegin.th: ครอบครัวของเขาได้ดูแล House of Heren มาหลายชั่วอายุคนแล้ว และพวกเขาก็กำลังตามหาต่างหุอันนี้มานานแล้ว ถ้าพวกเขาได้มันคืนพวกเขาจะโล่งใจมากแน่ๆ
dialogsBegin.tw: 艾塔米力諾一直都管理著海琳的家，能將遺物找回，他也不必再耿耿於懷了，呵呵！！
dialogsBegin.vi: Gia đình anh ấy đã quản lý House of Heren trong nhiều thế hệ và họ đã tìm kiếm Earring này lâu như vậy. Sở hữu nó một lần nữa sẽ giúp họ thấy nhẹ nhõm hơn.

dialogsAccept.en: Oh, I can just imagine how happy this is going to make them. Hurry along!
dialogsAccept.ar: Oh, I can just imagine how happy this is going to make them. Hurry along!
dialogsAccept.br: Oh, posso imaginar como isso os deixará felizes. Vá, Rápido!
dialogsAccept.cns: 想到艾塔米力诺能不再为这烦恼所困，我也好开心喔~
dialogsAccept.de: Ich kann nicht aufhören mich zu freuen, wenn ich an das lachende Gesicht von Ata denken muss.
dialogsAccept.fi: Oh, I can just imagine how happy this is going to make them. Hurry along!
dialogsAccept.fil: Oh, I can just imagine how happy this is going to make them. Hurry along!
dialogsAccept.fr: Je ne peux m'empêcher de sourire en imaginant la joie d'Ata. Ha ha ha.
dialogsAccept.id: Oh, aku bisa membayangkan betapa bahagianya ini akan membuat mereka. Cepatlah!
dialogsAccept.it: Oh, I can just imagine how happy this is going to make them. Hurry along!
dialogsAccept.jp: この知らせを受け取ったら、アタのやつ大喜びするじゃろうな、フォッフォッフォ
dialogsAccept.kr: 그 가족이 얼마나 기뻐할지 상상만 해도 흐뭇하네요. 어서 가 보세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Oh, I can just imagine how happy this is going to make them. Hurry along!
dialogsAccept.pl: Oh, I can just imagine how happy this is going to make them. Hurry along!
dialogsAccept.ru: Хотел бы я сам увидеть счастливые глаза Аты! Поторопись.
dialogsAccept.sp: Oh, me imagino lo felices que les va a hacer esto. ¡Date prisa!
dialogsAccept.sw: Oh, I can just imagine how happy this is going to make them. Hurry along!
dialogsAccept.th: โอ้ แค่นึกภาพว่ามันได้กลับคืนไปหาพวกเขา ข้าก็ดีใจแล้วมากแล้ว จงรีบไป!
dialogsAccept.tw: 想到艾塔米力諾能不再為這煩惱所困，我也好開心喔~
dialogsAccept.vi: Ồ, tôi có thể tưởng tượng ra điều này sẽ khiến họ hạnh phúc như thế nào. Nhanh lên nào!

dialogsDecline.en: Delivering this earring will not only help Ata’s family, but I’m sure they’d be willing to help you in your quest. Please, reconsider.
dialogsDecline.ar: Delivering this earring will not only help Ata’s family, but I’m sure they’d be willing to help you in your quest. Please, reconsider.
dialogsDecline.br: Entregar esse anel não apenas o ajudará, mas também a família de Ata. Não fica tão longe daqui, então por favor continue o trabalho.
dialogsDecline.cns: 这遗物对阿塔米力诺来说，有着很大的意义，所以，请你也继续加油喔~
dialogsDecline.de: Das Überbringen es Ohrrings ist nicht nur für dich eine Hilfe, sondern auch für die Familie von Ata. Es ist nicht so weit weg von hier, also mach bitte weiter.
dialogsDecline.fi: Delivering this earring will not only help Ata’s family, but I’m sure they’d be willing to help you in your quest. Please, reconsider.
dialogsDecline.fil: Delivering this earring will not only help Ata’s family, but I’m sure they’d be willing to help you in your quest. Please, reconsider.
dialogsDecline.fr: Rapporter cette boucle d'oreille à Ata est vraiment important... Ce n'est pas très loin d'ici, va lui remettre s'il te plaît
dialogsDecline.id: Memberikan anting-anting ini tidak hanya akan membantu keluarga Ata, tetapi saya yakin mereka akan bersedia membantu kamu dalam pencarianmu. Tolong, pertimbangkan kembali.
dialogsDecline.it: Delivering this earring will not only help Ata’s family, but I’m sure they’d be willing to help you in your quest. Please, reconsider.
dialogsDecline.jp: この聖遺物を渡すことでおぬしに新たな道が示されるであろう。場所はここからすぐ近くだから、面倒がらずに渡してきてくれぬか？
dialogsDecline.kr: 이 귀걸이를 전달하는 일은 아타의 가족을 돕는 일이기도 하지만, 당신의 여정에도 큰 도움이 될 거예요. 부디 다시 생각해 주세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Delivering this earring will not only help Ata’s family, but I’m sure they’d be willing to help you in your quest. Please, reconsider.
dialogsDecline.pl: Delivering this earring will not only help Ata’s family, but I’m sure they’d be willing to help you in your quest. Please, reconsider.
dialogsDecline.ru: Если ты поможешь семье Аты, семья Аты тоже тебя не оставит. Подумай.
dialogsDecline.sp: Entregar este pendiente no solo ayudará a la familia de Ata, sino que estoy seguro de que te ayudarán con tu misión. Por favor reconsidera tu decisión.
dialogsDecline.sw: Delivering this earring will not only help Ata’s family, but I’m sure they’d be willing to help you in your quest. Please, reconsider.
dialogsDecline.th: การที่คุณนำต่างหูอันนี้ไปให้พวกเขาไม่เพียงแต่จะช่วยครอบครัว Ata แต่ฉันมั่นใจว่าพวกเขายินดีที่จะช่วยคุณในการทำภารกิจของคุณ ลองคิดทบทวนใหม่อีกครั้ง
dialogsDecline.tw: 這遺物對艾塔米力諾來說，有著很大的意義，所以，請你也繼續加油喔~
dialogsDecline.vi: Việc giao Earring này sẽ không chỉ giúp ích cho gia đình Ata mà tôi chắc chắn rằng họ sẵn sàng giúp bạn trong nhiệm vụ của bạn. Xin hãy cân nhắc.

dialogsComplete.en: It this…? Oh, it is! I can finally go home now! Thank you, thank you!
dialogsComplete.ar: It this…? Oh, it is! I can finally go home now! Thank you, thank you!
dialogsComplete.br: Oh, isto é... obrigado! Muito obrigado! Agora finalmente posso ir pra casa!
dialogsComplete.cns: 谢谢你！真的很谢谢你！太好了，终于可以回家了耶！
dialogsComplete.de: Ist das...? Oh, das ist es! Jetzt kann ich endlich nach Hause gehen! Danke, danke, danke!
dialogsComplete.fi: It this…? Oh, it is! I can finally go home now! Thank you, thank you!
dialogsComplete.fil: It this…? Oh, it is! I can finally go home now! Thank you, thank you!
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh... C'est la... Merci infiniment ! Je la cherchais depuis des années.
dialogsComplete.id: Ini…? Oh, itu! Akhirnya aku bisa pulang sekarang! Terima kasih terima kasih!
dialogsComplete.it: It this…? Oh, it is! I can finally go home now! Thank you, thank you!
dialogsComplete.jp: こ、これは？ひょっとして･･･、うわぁ！ありがとうございます。本当にありがとう！これで家に帰れます。先生！ボク帰れるんです！アハハ！
dialogsComplete.kr: 이게…? 정말 그 귀걸이군요! 이제 집에 돌아갈 수 있겠어요! 고맙습니다, 정말 고맙습니다!
dialogsComplete.nl: It this…? Oh, it is! I can finally go home now! Thank you, thank you!
dialogsComplete.pl: It this…? Oh, it is! I can finally go home now! Thank you, thank you!
dialogsComplete.ru: It this…? Oh, it is! I can finally go home now! Thank you, thank you!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿Esto es…? ¡Oh, si que lo es! ¡Finalmente puedo volver a casa! ¡Gracias, gracias!
dialogsComplete.sw: It this…? Oh, it is! I can finally go home now! Thank you, thank you!
dialogsComplete.th: นี่มัน... โอ้! ในที่สุดฉันก็สามารถกลับบ้านได้แล้ว! ขอบคุณ!
dialogsComplete.tw: 謝謝你！真的很謝謝你！太好了，終於可以回家了耶！
dialogsComplete.vi: Nó này…? Ồ, đúng là như vậy! Cuối cùng tôi có thể về nhà ngay bây giờ! Cảm ơn cảm ơn!

dialogsComplete.en: You don’t know how much this means to my family! We’ve been searching for the Earring for so long and now...forgive me for rambling, I’m just so excited!
dialogsComplete.ar: You don’t know how much this means to my family! We’ve been searching for the Earring for so long and now...forgive me for rambling, I’m just so excited!
dialogsComplete.br: Fico realmente agradecido por isso! Agora o nosso dever de longa data está finalmente cumprido. Oh, por favor, me desculpe, eu estou empolgado demais.
dialogsComplete.cns: 谢谢你，我真的好高兴！真是太高兴了！
dialogsComplete.de: Ich bewundere das sehr! Nun ist unsere Langzeitpflicht endlich vollfüllt. Oh, bitte verzeih mir, aber ich bin so aufgeregt.
dialogsComplete.fi: You don’t know how much this means to my family! We’ve been searching for the Earring for so long and now...forgive me for rambling, I’m just so excited!
dialogsComplete.fil: You don’t know how much this means to my family! We’ve been searching for the Earring for so long and now...forgive me for rambling, I’m just so excited!
dialogsComplete.fr: J'apprécie énormément ce que tu as fait ! Notre devoir est enfin accompli ! Voici quelque chose pour te récompenser de tes efforts.
dialogsComplete.id: Kamu tidak tahu betapa berartinya ini bagi keluarga saya! Kami telah mencari Anting begitu lama dan sekarang ... maafkan saya karena bertele-tele, saya sangat bersemangat!
dialogsComplete.it: You don’t know how much this means to my family! We’ve been searching for the Earring for so long and now...forgive me for rambling, I’m just so excited!
dialogsComplete.jp: 本当にありがとう！長いあいだの一族の使命が今こそ終わったんです！！･･･ふう、少し興奮しすぎちゃいました。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이게 우리 가족에게 얼마나 큰 의미인지 모르시죠! 이 귀걸이를 정말 오랫동안 찾았거든요. 드디어… 너무 말이 많죠, 죄송해요. 너무 흥분해서요!
dialogsComplete.nl: You don’t know how much this means to my family! We’ve been searching for the Earring for so long and now...forgive me for rambling, I’m just so excited!
dialogsComplete.pl: You don’t know how much this means to my family! We’ve been searching for the Earring for so long and now...forgive me for rambling, I’m just so excited!
dialogsComplete.ru: Жизни Миллениев, поколение за поколением, были посвящены одной цели - исполнить долг и найти подвеску... Теперь я смогу... стать простым астрономом! Спасибо!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡No sabes cuánto significa esto para mi familia! Hemos estado buscando el pendiente durante tanto tiempo y ahora... perdóname por divagar, ¡estoy tan emocionado!
dialogsComplete.sw: You don’t know how much this means to my family! We’ve been searching for the Earring for so long and now...forgive me for rambling, I’m just so excited!
dialogsComplete.th: คุณไม่รู้หรอกว่านี่มันมีค่าต่อครอบครัวของฉันมากแค่ไหน! เราได้ค้นหาตุ้มหูมานานแล้วและตอนนี้... ยกโทษให้ฉันด้วยที่ฉันมัวแต่พูดวนไปวนมา ฉันแค่รู้สึกตื่นเต้นมากเท่านั้นเอง!
dialogsComplete.tw: 你不知道這對我的家人有多重要！我們找這只耳環找了那麼久，如今終於……原諒我說個不停，我實在太激動了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn không biết điều này có ý nghĩa như thế nào đối với gia đình tôi! Chúng tôi đã tìm kiếm Earring quá lâu và bây giờ ... thứ lỗi cho tôi vì tôi nói lan man, tôi chỉ rất vui mừng!

dialogsComplete.en: This Scroll belonged to the Blades in my family line. Since you’re trying to become one, I want you to have it.
dialogsComplete.ar: This Scroll belonged to the Blades in my family line. Since you’re trying to become one, I want you to have it.
dialogsComplete.br: Este é o pergaminho que somente os sucessores na minha família podem ter. Agora eu o estou entregando a você. Será o comprovante que mostra que você é reconhecido como um sucessor.
dialogsComplete.cns: 这是给继承者的卷轴，记的要好好保管喔！这可是你已经成为了英雄的继承者的证明！
dialogsComplete.de: Dies ist die Schriftrolle, die nur Nachfolger aus meiner Familie erhalten. Nun gebe ich sie dir. Dieser Beleg beweist, das du als Nachfolger würdig bist.
dialogsComplete.fi: This Scroll belonged to the Blades in my family line. Since you’re trying to become one, I want you to have it.
dialogsComplete.fil: This Scroll belonged to the Blades in my family line. Since you’re trying to become one, I want you to have it.
dialogsComplete.fr: Ceci est le Parchemin que seuls les descendants de ma famille peuvent avoir. Il t'appartient désormais.
dialogsComplete.id: Gulungan kertas ini milik Blades di garis keluarga saya. Karena kamu mencoba menjadi satu, saya ingin kamu memilikinya.
dialogsComplete.it: This Scroll belonged to the Blades in my family line. Since you’re trying to become one, I want you to have it.
dialogsComplete.jp: これは我が一族に伝わる由緒ある巻物です、ブレード後継者を目指すものに、次の道を指し示すでしょう。どうかお受け取りください。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이 두루마리는 저희 가문의 블레이드에게 대대로 내려오던 것이랍니다. 블레이드가 되려는 분께 드리는 게 마땅하겠죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: This Scroll belonged to the Blades in my family line. Since you’re trying to become one, I want you to have it.
dialogsComplete.pl: This Scroll belonged to the Blades in my family line. Since you’re trying to become one, I want you to have it.
dialogsComplete.ru: Этот свиток передавался в моей семье от отца к сыну. Я хотел бы отдать его тебе.
dialogsComplete.sp: Este pergamino le pertenecía a los Blades de mi familia. Como estás intentando convertirte en uno, quiero que te lo quedes.
dialogsComplete.sw: This Scroll belonged to the Blades in my family line. Since you’re trying to become one, I want you to have it.
dialogsComplete.th: Scroll นี้เป็นของ Blades ภายในตระกูลของฉัน เพราะว่าคุณพยายามที่จะเป็น Blades ฉันเลยอยากมอบมันให้คุณ
dialogsComplete.tw: 這是給繼承者的卷軸，記的要好好保管喔！這可是你已經成為了英雄的繼承者的證明！
dialogsComplete.vi: Scroll này thuộc về Blades trong dòng họ của tôi. Vì bạn đang cố gắng trở thành Blade nên tôi muốn bạn có được điều đó.

dialogsFail.en: Full Moon out tonight. Strange things usually happen when that occurs…
dialogsFail.ar: Full Moon out tonight. Strange things usually happen when that occurs…
dialogsFail.br: Hoje haverá lua cheia. Coisas estranhas geralmente acontecem quando isso ocorre...
dialogsFail.cns: 气象报告！！今天的天气…怎样怎样…
dialogsFail.de: Heute nacht ist Vollmond. Das Wetter wird.. Blah blah..
dialogsFail.fi: Full Moon out tonight. Strange things usually happen when that occurs…
dialogsFail.fil: Full Moon out tonight. Strange things usually happen when that occurs…
dialogsFail.fr: La lune sera pleine ce soir. La météo devrait être plutôt.
dialogsFail.id: Bulan Purnama keluar malam ini. Hal-hal aneh biasanya terjadi ketika itu terjadi ...
dialogsFail.it: Full Moon out tonight. Strange things usually happen when that occurs…
dialogsFail.jp: 今日は満月の日で、月はあの山の端から･･･。また北緯35度の･･･ブツブツ
dialogsFail.kr: 오늘 밤은 보름달이 떴군요. 만월엔 이상한 일이 벌어지곤 하죠...
dialogsFail.nl: Full Moon out tonight. Strange things usually happen when that occurs…
dialogsFail.pl: Full Moon out tonight. Strange things usually happen when that occurs…
dialogsFail.ru: Сегодня полнолуние, а в полнолуние происходят странные вещи...
dialogsFail.sp: Hay Luna Llena esta noche. Suelen pasar cosas extrañas en noches cómo ésta...
dialogsFail.sw: Full Moon out tonight. Strange things usually happen when that occurs…
dialogsFail.th: พระจันทร์เต็มดวงในคืนนี้ มักมีเรื่องประหลาดๆ เกิดขึ้นเมื่อพระจันทร์เต็มดวง...
dialogsFail.tw: 氣象報告！！今天的天氣…怎樣怎樣…
dialogsFail.vi: Đêm nay trăng tròn. Những điều kỳ lạ thường xảy ra…

description.en: Visit High-Dwarpet Tucani in Flaris. He can be found north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) to find your way if you get lost.
description.ar: Visit High-Dwarpet Tucani in Flaris. He can be found north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) to find your way if you get lost.
description.br: Vá ver o Alto-Dwarpet Tucani em Flaris. Ele pode ser encontrado em direção norte de Flarine, no meio das Montanhas Lerem. Ele lhe dirá algo. Olhe seu mapa (Tecla M) caso se sinta perdido.
description.cns: 去雨之河找《技能序章》之后，到莱乐安山脉找“哆卡”吧！他应该会告诉一些事情的。
description.de: Geh zu [High-Dwarpet] Tucani in Flaris. Er befindet sich in der Mitte des Leren Gebirges. Schau auf deine Karte (Taste: M), falls du dich verirrst.
description.fi: Visit High-Dwarpet Tucani in Flaris. He can be found north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) to find your way if you get lost.
description.fil: Visit High-Dwarpet Tucani in Flaris. He can be found north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) to find your way if you get lost.
description.fr: Rencontrer Tucani qui habite avec les Grand Dwarpets près des Montagnes centrales de Leren.
description.id: Kunjungi High-Dwarpet Tucani di Flaris. Dia dapat ditemukan di utara Flarine. Periksa petamu (Tombol M) untuk menemukan jalan jika kamu tersesat.
description.it: Visit High-Dwarpet Tucani in Flaris. He can be found north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) to find your way if you get lost.
description.jp: ハイドワーフの生息地にいる＜トゥカニ＞のところへ行こう！
description.kr: 플라리스 북부에 있는 하이-드워펫 투카니를 만나보세요. 길을 잃으면 지도(M키)를 열고 길을 찾으실 수 있습니다.
description.nl: Visit High-Dwarpet Tucani in Flaris. He can be found north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) to find your way if you get lost.
description.pl: Visit High-Dwarpet Tucani in Flaris. He can be found north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) to find your way if you get lost.
description.ru: Нужно поговорить с высоким карликом Тукани в лагере на севре от Фларинции. Он научит меня тому, что нужно знать акробату.
description.sp: Visita al Alto-Enano Tucani en Flaris. Se le puede encontrar caminando hacia el norte desde Flarine. Consulta tu mapa (Tecla M) para encontrar el camino si te pierdes.
description.sw: Visit High-Dwarpet Tucani in Flaris. He can be found north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) to find your way if you get lost.
description.th: ไปหา High-Dwarpet Tucani ในเมือง Flaris สามารถพบเขาได้ทางตอนเหนือของ Flarine ตรวจสอบบนแผนที่ของคุณ (ปุ่ม M) เพื่อค้นหาเส้นทางของคุณหากคุณหลงทาง
description.tw: 去浪樓江找「技能序章」之後，到勒倫山脈找哆卡吧！他應該會告訴一些事情的。
description.vi: Ghé thăm Người lùn tối cao Tucani ở Flaris. Anh ta có thể được tìm thấy ở phía bắc Flarine. Kiểm tra bản đồ của bạn (Phím M) để tìm đường nếu bạn bị lạc.

dialogsBegin.en: That about does it for Acrobat weaponry.
dialogsBegin.ar: That about does it for Acrobat weaponry.
dialogsBegin.br: Agora você compreende completamente as armas?
dialogsBegin.cns: 关于武器的事情，你懂了吗？好吧！接下来是下一个训练。你知道“矮人族”这些家伙吧！他们会到“雨之河”来洗澡。
dialogsBegin.de: Das sollte alles sein, was du über die Waffen der Acrobat wissen musst.
dialogsBegin.fi: That about does it for Acrobat weaponry.
dialogsBegin.fil: That about does it for Acrobat weaponry.
dialogsBegin.fr:
Tu sembles avoir bien compris comment utiliser les armes. Voici la prochaine étape.
Tu connais les Grand Dwarpets ? Ils vivent près des montagnes centrales de Leren.
dialogsBegin.id: Itu tentang persenjataan Acrobat.
dialogsBegin.it: That about does it for Acrobat weaponry.
dialogsBegin.jp: 武器の情報は十分だったか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 이걸로 아크로뱃 무기에 대한 수업은 마칠게요.
dialogsBegin.nl: That about does it for Acrobat weaponry.
dialogsBegin.pl: That about does it for Acrobat weaponry.
dialogsBegin.ru: Вот, в сущности, и все, что можно сказать об оружии для акробатов.
dialogsBegin.sp: Parece que eso es todo con el armamento de Acrobat.
dialogsBegin.sw: That about does it for Acrobat weaponry.
dialogsBegin.th: ที่เกี่ยวกับอาวุธของ Acrobat
dialogsBegin.tw: 關於武器的事情，你懂了嗎？好吧！接下來是下一個訓練。你知道『杜爾沛』這些傢伙吧！他們會到『浪樓江』來洗澡。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đó là về việc đó làm được đối với vũ khí Acrobat.

dialogsBegin.en: Now for the next step in your journey. I want you to travel to Flaris, and visit the High-Dwarpets. They have important information for you.
dialogsBegin.ar: Now for the next step in your journey. I want you to travel to Flaris, and visit the High-Dwarpets. They have important information for you.
dialogsBegin.br: Então eu lhe direi o próximo passo. Você conhece os Alto Dwarpets, certo? Se você for até lá, eles lhe dirão algo.
dialogsBegin.cns: 可是啊～他们很会把东西弄丢，上次也是”哆卡”把《技能序章》给我弄丢了，你可以把这本书找去给他吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Nun zum nächsten Schritt. Ich möchte, dass du die High-Dwarpet in Flaris besuchst. Sie haben wichtige Informationen für dich.
dialogsBegin.fi: Now for the next step in your journey. I want you to travel to Flaris, and visit the High-Dwarpets. They have important information for you.
dialogsBegin.fil: Now for the next step in your journey. I want you to travel to Flaris, and visit the High-Dwarpets. They have important information for you.
dialogsBegin.fr: Le Grand Dwarpet Tucani était autrefois un grand acrobate. Il t'aidera à apprendre les compétences qu'il te faut.
dialogsBegin.id: Sekarang untuk langkah selanjutnya dalam perjalananmu. Aku ingin kamu melakukan perjalanan ke Flaris, dan mengunjungi High-Dwarpets. Mereka memiliki informasi penting untukmu.
dialogsBegin.it: Now for the next step in your journey. I want you to travel to Flaris, and visit the High-Dwarpets. They have important information for you.
dialogsBegin.jp: やつらは、なんとも物忘れが激しいのじゃ。最近も＜トゥカニ＞というやつが＜スキル事典＞を失くしたとかで、探してくれと頼まれて見つけるのも一苦労じゃったわい。
dialogsBegin.kr: 자, 이제 여정의 다음 단계입니다. 플라리스로 가서 하이-드워펫들을 만나보세요. 중요한 것들을 알려줄 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Now for the next step in your journey. I want you to travel to Flaris, and visit the High-Dwarpets. They have important information for you.
dialogsBegin.pl: Now for the next step in your journey. I want you to travel to Flaris, and visit the High-Dwarpets. They have important information for you.
dialogsBegin.ru: А теперь отправляйся во Фларинцию, к высоким карликам. Дальше будешь учиться у них.
dialogsBegin.sp: Ahora para el siguiente paso en tu viaje. Quiero que viajes a Flaris y visites a los Alto-Enanos. Tienen información importante para ti.
dialogsBegin.sw: Now for the next step in your journey. I want you to travel to Flaris, and visit the High-Dwarpets. They have important information for you.
dialogsBegin.th: ตอนนี้ขั้นต่อไปของการผจญภัยของคุณ ฉันต้องการให้คุณเดินทางไปที่ Flaris และไปหา High-Dwarpets พวกเขามีข้อมูลที่สำคัญสำหรับคุณ
dialogsBegin.tw: 可是啊～他們很會把東西弄丟，上次也是哆卡把「技能序章」給我弄丟了，你可以把這本書找去給他嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bây giờ cho bước tiếp theo trong cuộc hành trình của bạn. Tôi muốn bạn đi du lịch đến Flaris, và thăm Người lùn tối cao. Họ có thông tin quan trọng cho bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: The High-Dwarpets can be found north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) to find your way if you get lost.
dialogsBegin.ar: The High-Dwarpets can be found north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) to find your way if you get lost.
dialogsBegin.br: Você pode marcar o local dos Alto Dwarpets com a tecla de atalho M. É realmente útil marcar a localização de algum lugar.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你把《技能序章》找给他的话，他应该会告诉你一些事情啦。你问我在哪找喔？这还要问吗？当然是“雨之河”啊！
dialogsBegin.de: Die High-Dwarpet findest du in Flaris, bei der Mitte des Leren Gebirges. Wirf einen Blick auf deine Karte (Taste: M), falls du dich verirrst.
dialogsBegin.fi: The High-Dwarpets can be found north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) to find your way if you get lost.
dialogsBegin.fil: The High-Dwarpets can be found north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) to find your way if you get lost.
dialogsBegin.fr: Et s'il t'aime bien, peut-être même t'enseignera-t-il une technique particulière.
dialogsBegin.id: High-Dwarpets dapat ditemukan di utara Flarine. Periksa petamu (Tombol M) untuk menemukan jalanmu jika tersesat.
dialogsBegin.it: The High-Dwarpets can be found north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) to find your way if you get lost.
dialogsBegin.jp: もう無くさぬように、と釘を刺しておいたから、＜トゥカニ＞に会いに行ってみるといい。きっとおぬしの役に立つ情報を持っているはずじゃ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 하이-드워펫들은 플라리네 북쪽에서 찾을 수 있어요. 길을 잃게 되면, 지도(M 키)를 참고하세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: The High-Dwarpets can be found north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) to find your way if you get lost.
dialogsBegin.pl: The High-Dwarpets can be found north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) to find your way if you get lost.
dialogsBegin.ru: Высокие карлики обитают севернее Фларинции. Если заблудишься, сверься с картой ("M"), договорились?
dialogsBegin.sp: Los Alto-Enanos se encuentran al norte desde Flarine. Revisa tu mapa (Tecla M) para encontrar el camino si te pierdes.
dialogsBegin.sw: The High-Dwarpets can be found north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) to find your way if you get lost.
dialogsBegin.th: สามารถพบ High-Dwarpets ได้ทางตอนเหนือของ Flarine ตรวจสอบแผนที่ของคุณ (ปุ่ม M) เพื่อค้นหาเส้นทางของคุณหากคุณหลงทาง
dialogsBegin.tw: 你把「技能序章」找給他的話，他應該會告訴你一些事情啦。你問我在哪找喔？這還要問嗎？當然是『浪樓江』啊！
dialogsBegin.vi: Người Lùn Tối Cao có thể được tìm thấy ở phía bắc Flarine. Kiểm tra bản đồ của bạn (Phím M) để tìm đường nếu bạn bị lạc.

dialogsAccept.en: Good luck, apprentice.
dialogsAccept.ar: حظا موفقا، أيها المبتدئ.
dialogsAccept.br: Tenha um bom dia.
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你一路顺风啊～
dialogsAccept.de: Dann noch ein schönen Tag.
dialogsAccept.fi: Good luck, apprentice.
dialogsAccept.fil: Good luck, apprentice.
dialogsAccept.fr: Passe une bonne journée !
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga berhasil, apprentice.
dialogsAccept.it: Good luck, apprentice.
dialogsAccept.jp: では、今日も良い1日を。
dialogsAccept.kr: 행운을 빌어요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Good luck, apprentice.
dialogsAccept.pl: Good luck, apprentice.
dialogsAccept.ru: Удачи в дороге.
dialogsAccept.sp: Buena suerte, aprendiz.
dialogsAccept.sw: Good luck, apprentice.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้โชคดี เจ้าเด็กฝึกหัด
dialogsAccept.tw: 祝你一路順風啊～
dialogsAccept.vi: Chúc may mắn, người tập sự

dialogsDecline.en: What a shame to waste such potential. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ar: What a shame to waste such potential. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.br: Que pena desperdiçar esse potencial. Venha me ver de novo se mudar de ideia.
dialogsDecline.cns: 我想你应该对弓箭手不够了解啦！你如果懂弓箭手的魅力在那的话，不可能就这样放弃的。
dialogsDecline.de: Welch Verschwendung von Potenzial... Du findest mich hier, falls du deine Meinung ändern solltest.
dialogsDecline.fi: What a shame to waste such potential. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fil: What a shame to waste such potential. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fr: Apparemment tu n'as pas saisi l'appel de l'Acrobate. Il est vrai qu'il est toujours plus facile d'abandonner...
dialogsDecline.id: Sayang sekali jika potensi seperti itu disia-siakan. Temui aku lagi jika kamu berubah pikiran.
dialogsDecline.it: What a shame to waste such potential. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.jp: 君はアクロバットの魅力をまったく理解出来ていなかったのじゃなあ。残念じゃ。そんなに簡単に諦める職業ではないと思うのじゃが・・・
dialogsDecline.kr: 이렇게 뛰어난 잠재력이 있는데, 아쉽네요. 마음이 바뀌면 다시 찾아오세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: What a shame to waste such potential. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.pl: What a shame to waste such potential. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ru: Какой потенциал пропадает! Если передумаешь, непременно возвращайся.
dialogsDecline.sp: Que vergüenza desperdiciar ese potencial. Ven a verme de nuevo si cambias de opinión.
dialogsDecline.sw: What a shame to waste such potential. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.th: ช่างน่าละอายนักหากต้องสูญเสียศักยภาพเหล่านั้นไป มาพบกับฉันอีกครั้งถ้าคุณเปลี่ยนใจ
dialogsDecline.tw: 我想你應該對雜技師不夠瞭解啦！你如果懂雜技師的魅力在那的話，不可能就這樣放棄的。
dialogsDecline.vi: Thật đáng tiếc khi lãng phí tiềm năng như vậy. Hãy đến gặp tôi một lần nữa nếu bạn thay đổi ý định.

dialogsComplete.en: Hmmm, has Pyre instructed you to see me? I see. Very well, I will continue your training. Listen up!
dialogsComplete.ar: Hmmm, has Pyre instructed you to see me? I see. Very well, I will continue your training. Listen up!
dialogsComplete.br: Hmmm, o Pyre instruiu você a me ver? Certo. Muito bem, vou continuar seu treinamento. Ouça!
dialogsComplete.cns: 呃….飞蕊大师让你过来见我的吗？好吧我知道了。听好了！接下来我会继续开展对你的训练。
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm, hat Pyre dich zu mir geschickt? Ich verstehe. Nun gut, ich werde dein Training fortführen. Hör gut zu!
dialogsComplete.fi: Hmmm, has Pyre instructed you to see me? I see. Very well, I will continue your training. Listen up!
dialogsComplete.fil: Hmmm, has Pyre instructed you to see me? I see. Very well, I will continue your training. Listen up!
dialogsComplete.fr: C'est Pyre qui t'a envoyé ? Mmm. Tu as du potentiel, j'accepte de t'enseigner mon savoir.
dialogsComplete.id: Hmmm, sudahkah Pyre menyuruhmu menemuiku? Aku mengerti. Baiklah, aku akan melanjutkan pelatihan. Dengarkan!
dialogsComplete.it: Hmmm, has Pyre instructed you to see me? I see. Very well, I will continue your training. Listen up!
dialogsComplete.jp: ん？＜ピレ＞に言われてわざわざボクに会いに来たのか？物好きなやつだな。まぁ、せっかくだから何でも聞いておくれ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 흠, 파이어가 이곳으로 보냈다고요? 알겠습니다. 그럼 제가 훈련을 이어가죠. 잘 들으세요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Hmmm, has Pyre instructed you to see me? I see. Very well, I will continue your training. Listen up!
dialogsComplete.pl: Hmmm, has Pyre instructed you to see me? I see. Very well, I will continue your training. Listen up!
dialogsComplete.ru: Гм-м-м, говоришь, тебя прислал Пайр? Понятненько. Ладно, я займусь твоим обучением. Слушай и запоминай!
dialogsComplete.sp: Hmmm, ¿te ha enviado Pyre a verme? Ya veo. Muy bien, continuaré tu entrenamiento. ¡Ahora escucha!
dialogsComplete.sw: Hmmm, has Pyre instructed you to see me? I see. Very well, I will continue your training. Listen up!
dialogsComplete.th: หืมมม มี Pyre สั่งให้คุณมาพบฉันหรือ? ฉันเข้าใจล่ะ ดีมากฉันจะฝึกฝนคุณต่อ จงตั้งใจฟัง!
dialogsComplete.tw: 咦？這不是「技能序章」嗎？哈哈哈，謝謝你啊～謝謝你～一定是飛蕊幫我請你幫忙的對吧！好吧！那我給你一個禮物好了～你問我是什麼禮物喔？唉呀～你就先聽啦…
dialogsComplete.vi: Hmmm, Pyre đã hướng dẫn bạn gặp tôi chưa? Tôi thấy. Rất tốt, tôi sẽ tiếp tục việc đào tạo bạn. Nghe này!

dialogsComplete.en: Bows consume Magic Points (MP) and yo-yos consume Focus Points (FP). There are 6 special bow abilities and 7 special yo-yo abilities. I shall teach you a common Acrobat ability, Dark Illusion.
dialogsComplete.ar: Bows consume Magic Points (MP) and yo-yos consume Focus Points (FP). There are 6 special bow abilities and 7 special yo-yo abilities. I shall teach you a common Acrobat ability, Dark Illusion.
dialogsComplete.br: Lembre-se de que o Arco consome MP e o Ioiô consome FP. Há 6 habilidades de Arco e 7 habilidades de Ioiô. Há também 3 habilidades comuns. Irei lhe ensinar a Ilusão Sombria, uma habilidade comum de Acrobata.
dialogsComplete.cns: 弓箭的技能是消耗MP的，溜刃是消耗FP的，所以要记住喔。弓箭有6个技能，飞轮有7个技能，公用的有3个技能，我告诉你其中一个技能好了，就是有一个技能叫做“潜行”。
dialogsComplete.de: Bögen verbrauchen Magiepunkte (MP) und Yo-Yos verbrauchen Fokuspunkte (FP). Es gibt 6 spezielle Bogen-Fähigkeiten und 7 spezielle Yo-Yo-Fähigkeiten. Ich werde dir eine weit verbreitete Acrobat-Fähigkeit beibringen: Dark Illusion.
dialogsComplete.fi: Bows consume Magic Points (MP) and yo-yos consume Focus Points (FP). There are 6 special bow abilities and 7 special yo-yo abilities. I shall teach you a common Acrobat ability, Dark Illusion.
dialogsComplete.fil: Bows consume Magic Points (MP) and yo-yos consume Focus Points (FP). There are 6 special bow abilities and 7 special yo-yo abilities. I shall teach you a common Acrobat ability, Dark Illusion.
dialogsComplete.fr: Rappelle-toi que les arcs consomment les PM et les yo-yo les PF. Les deux armes ont des compétences communes, et d'autres qui leurs sont propres. Je vais t'en enseigner une, l'Illusion des ténèbres.
dialogsComplete.id: Bows mengkonsumsi Magic Points (MP) dan yo-yos mengkonsumsi Focus Points (FP). Ada 6 kemampuan special bows dan 7 kemampuan special yo-yo. Aku akan mengajarimu kemampuan umum Acrobat, Dark Illusion.
dialogsComplete.it: Bows consume Magic Points (MP) and yo-yos consume Focus Points (FP). There are 6 special bow abilities and 7 special yo-yo abilities. I shall teach you a common Acrobat ability, Dark Illusion.
dialogsComplete.jp: ボウのスキルはMPを、ヨーヨーのスキルはFPを消耗するんだ。これは覚えておくといいぞ。　ボウのスキルは6個、ヨーヨーのスキルは7個、共用スキルは3個あるが、その中で＜ダークイリュージョン＞というスキルを教えてやろう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 활은 MP를, 요요는 FP를 소모해요. 활에는 6개의 특수 스킬이, 요요에는 7개의 특수 스킬이 있죠. 지금은 아크로뱃 공통 스킬인 다크일루전에 대해 알려 드릴게요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Bows consume Magic Points (MP) and yo-yos consume Focus Points (FP). There are 6 special bow abilities and 7 special yo-yo abilities. I shall teach you a common Acrobat ability, Dark Illusion.
dialogsComplete.pl: Bows consume Magic Points (MP) and yo-yos consume Focus Points (FP). There are 6 special bow abilities and 7 special yo-yo abilities. I shall teach you a common Acrobat ability, Dark Illusion.
dialogsComplete.ru: Для стрельбы из лука нужна мана (ОМ), а для использования йо-йо - энергия (ОЭ). Есть шесть умений для стрельбы из лука и семь - для йо-йо. Я покажу тебе главный акробатический трюк, "Иллюзию пустоты".
dialogsComplete.sp: Los Arcos consumen Puntos de Magia (MP) y los Yo-Yos consumen Puntos de Focus (FP). Hay 6 habilidades especiales de Arco y 7 habilidades especiales de Yo-Yo. Te enseñaré una habilidad común de Acrobat, Ilusión Oscura.
dialogsComplete.sw: Bows consume Magic Points (MP) and yo-yos consume Focus Points (FP). There are 6 special bow abilities and 7 special yo-yo abilities. I shall teach you a common Acrobat ability, Dark Illusion.
dialogsComplete.th: ธนูใช้ Magic Points (MP) และ โยโย่ใช้ Focus Points (FP) ธนูมีคสกิลพิเศษ 6 ชนิด และโยโย่มีสกิลพิเศษ 7 ชนิด ฉันจะสอนความสามารถทั่วไปของ Acrobat ให้แก่คุณ นั่นคือ Dark Illusion
dialogsComplete.tw: 弓箭的技能是消耗魔力的，溜刃是消耗活力的，所以要記住喔。弓箭有 6 個技能，溜刃有 7 個技能，公用的有 3 個技能，我告訴你其中一個技能好了，就是有一個技能叫做『幻影術』。
dialogsComplete.vi: Cung tiêu hao Điểm Phép thuật (MP) và yo-yo tiêu hao Điểm Tiêu điểm (FP). Có 6 khả năng cung đặc biệt và 7 khả năng yo-yo đặc biệt. Tôi sẽ dạy cho bạn một khả năng Acrobat thông thường, Dark Illusion.

dialogsComplete.en: This ability allows you to vanish from sight. However, keep in mind that any actions performed while under the effects of this ability aside from movement will remove the effect. Take this.
dialogsComplete.ar: This ability allows you to vanish from sight. However, keep in mind that any actions performed while under the effects of this ability aside from movement will remove the effect. Take this.
dialogsComplete.br: Você pode evitar o olhar dos outros com esta habilidade, mas tome cuidado, pois o efeito é anulado caso ataque ou use outra habilidade. Pegue isto e guarde com cuidado.
dialogsComplete.cns: 这是一个隐身的技能，如何？很赞吧！可是啊，你要攻击东西或是使用其他技能的话，这个技能会自动消失，注意这一点喔～还有这个东西你收下吧！要保管好喔～
dialogsComplete.de: Diese Fähigkeit macht dich unsichtbar. Du kannst die Blicke der anderen vermeiden. Aber gib Acht! Wann immer du eine andere Fähigkeit benutzt oder angreifst, lüftet sich dein Schleier. Nimm dies und geh sorgfältig damit um.
dialogsComplete.fi: This ability allows you to vanish from sight. However, keep in mind that any actions performed while under the effects of this ability aside from movement will remove the effect. Take this.
dialogsComplete.fil: This ability allows you to vanish from sight. However, keep in mind that any actions performed while under the effects of this ability aside from movement will remove the effect. Take this.
dialogsComplete.fr: Il s'agit d'une compétence de camouflage. Intéressant, non? Mais dès que tu attaques ou utilises une autre compétence, son effet s'annule. Sers t'en avec sagesse.
dialogsComplete.id: Kemampuan ini memungkinkan kamu untuk menghilang dari pandangan. Namun, perlu diingat bahwa tindakan apa pun yang dilakukan saat berada di bawah pengaruh kemampuan ini selain dari gerakan akan menghilangkan efeknya. Ambil ini.
dialogsComplete.it: This ability allows you to vanish from sight. However, keep in mind that any actions performed while under the effects of this ability aside from movement will remove the effect. Take this.
dialogsComplete.jp: これは身を隠すスキルだ。ふふ、すごいだろう？　だが、攻撃したり、他のスキルを使ったら、自動的に解除されるのが面倒だな。さあ、このスキルをお前にやろう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이 능력을 사용하면 자신의 몸을 숨길 수 있어요. 하지만 이동 외의 행동을 하면 은신 효과가 바로 풀리니 주의하세요. 자, 받아두세요.
dialogsComplete.nl: This ability allows you to vanish from sight. However, keep in mind that any actions performed while under the effects of this ability aside from movement will remove the effect. Take this.
dialogsComplete.pl: This ability allows you to vanish from sight. However, keep in mind that any actions performed while under the effects of this ability aside from movement will remove the effect. Take this.
dialogsComplete.ru: Проделываешь этот трюк - и будто исчезаешь. Только помни, можешь ходить, бегать, прыгать, но станешь делать что-то кроме этого - эффект пропадет.
dialogsComplete.sp: Esta habilidad te permite desaparecer de la vista. Sin embargo, ten en cuenta que cualquier acción realizada bajo los efectos de esta habilidad aparte del movimiento eliminará el efecto. Toma esto.
dialogsComplete.sw: This ability allows you to vanish from sight. However, keep in mind that any actions performed while under the effects of this ability aside from movement will remove the effect. Take this.
dialogsComplete.th: ความสามารถนี้ช่วยให้คุณหายตัวได้ อย่างไรก็ตามโปรดจำไว้ว่าการทำสิ่งใดๆ ก็ตามนอกเหนือจากการเคลื่อนไหวในตอนล่องหน จะทำให้การล่องหนถูกยกเลิก เอานี่ไป
dialogsComplete.tw: 這是一個隱身的技能，如何？很讚吧！可是啊，你要攻擊東西或是使用其他技能的話，這個技能會自動消失，注意這一點喔～還有這個東西你收下吧！要保管好喔～
dialogsComplete.vi: Khả năng này cho phép bạn biến mất khỏi tầm mắt. Tuy nhiên, hãy nhớ rằng bất kỳ hành động nào được thực hiện trong khi chịu tác dụng của khả năng này ngoài chuyển động sẽ loại bỏ hiệu ứng. Hãy nhớ lấy.

dialogsFail.en: It's interesting that you've come to see me. Did Pyre send you? If he did, you would have something for me.
dialogsFail.ar: It's interesting that you've come to see me. Did Pyre send you? If he did, you would have something for me.
dialogsFail.br: É interessante que você tenha vindo me ver. Pyre te mandou? Se ele o fez, você teria que ter algo para mim.
dialogsFail.cns: 你会来找我真的很奇怪诶。飞蕊告诉过你吗？如果有的话，你肯定有一些东西要给我。
dialogsFail.de: Welch überraschender Besuch. Hat Pyre dich geschickt? Falls dem so ist, dann solltest du etwas für mich haben.
dialogsFail.fi: It's interesting that you've come to see me. Did Pyre send you? If he did, you would have something for me.
dialogsFail.fil: It's interesting that you've come to see me. Did Pyre send you? If he did, you would have something for me.
dialogsFail.fr: Que me veux-tu ? Quoi, c'est Pyre qui t'envoie ? Non ? Alors dégage de là !
dialogsFail.id: Sangat menarik bahwa kamu datang menemui saya. Apakah Pyre mengirimmu? Jika dia melakukannya, kamu pasti memiliki sesuatu untukku.
dialogsFail.it: It's interesting that you've come to see me. Did Pyre send you? If he did, you would have something for me.
dialogsFail.jp: おや？　人間がこんなところに来るなんて、珍しいこともあるもんだな。何か用か？　ん？＜ピレ＞から頼まれた？　だったらどうして手ぶらでのこのこやってきたんだ？
dialogsFail.kr: 절 찾아오다니 흥미로운데요. 파이어가 보낸 건가요? 그랬다면 제게 전해줄 게 있으실 텐데요.
dialogsFail.nl: It's interesting that you've come to see me. Did Pyre send you? If he did, you would have something for me.
dialogsFail.pl: It's interesting that you've come to see me. Did Pyre send you? If he did, you would have something for me.
dialogsFail.ru: Ты ко мне? Любопытно. Это Пайр тебя прислал? А что он просил передать, ты помнишь?
dialogsFail.sp: Es interesante que hayas venido a verme. ¿Te envió Pyre? Si lo ha hecho, tienes algo para mí.
dialogsFail.sw: It's interesting that you've come to see me. Did Pyre send you? If he did, you would have something for me.
dialogsFail.th: เป็นเรื่องที่น่าสนใจที่คุณได้มาเจอผม Pyre ส่งคุณมาหรือไม่? ถ้าเขาส่งคุณมาจะต้องมีบางอย่างมอบให้ฉัน
dialogsFail.tw: ㄟ～見鬼了！有人類會來找我ㄝ～真是太神奇了！幹嘛！幹嘛？什麼？飛蕊請你來的啊？嗯…可是怎麼沒有拿東西給我啊？
dialogsFail.vi: Thật thú vị khi bạn đến gặp tôi. Pyre có gửi cho bạn không? Nếu anh ấy làm vậy, bạn sẽ có một cái gì đó cho tôi.

name.jp: ゼンマー ハンティング

description.en: Almani asked for help with reducing the Zenma population as they're causing problems with forestation in Gouthan Mountains. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.ar: Almani asked for help with reducing the Zenma population as they're causing problems with forestation in Gouthan Mountains. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.br: Almani pediu ajuda para reduzir a população Zenma, pois eles estão causando problemas com o reflorestamento nas Montanhas Gouthan. Você poderia matar 15 deles?
description.cns: 亚尔玛尼请求减少变异巨眼怪的数量，因为它们给永恒森林的植树造林带了很多问题。你能杀掉15个变异巨眼怪吗？
description.de: Almani bat um Hilfe bei der Reduzierung der Zenma-Population, da sie Probleme mit der Aufforstung im Gouthan-Gebirge verursachen. Kannst du 15 von ihnen töten?
description.fi: Almani asked for help with reducing the Zenma population as they're causing problems with forestation in Gouthan Mountains. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.fil: Humiling si Almani ng tulong para bawasan ang populasyon ng Zenma dahil nagdudulot sila ng problema sa reforestation sa Gouthan Mountains. Puwede mo bang patayin ang 15 sa kanila?
description.fr: Almani a besoin d'aide pour réduire la population de Zenma, car ils posent des problèmes de reforestation dans les montagnes de Gouthan. Peux-tu en tuer 15 ?
description.id: Almani meminta bantuan untuk mengurangi populasi Zenma karena mereka menyebabkan masalah pada Forestation di Gouthan Mountain. Bisakah kamu habisi 15 dari mereka?
description.it: Almani asked for help with reducing the Zenma population as they're causing problems with forestation in Gouthan Mountains. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.jp: アルマーニから、ゴウダン山脈の植林に支障をきたしているので、ゼンマーの数を減らす協力をしてほしいとの依頼がありました。15匹だけでよいので、討伐してきていただけないでしょうか？
description.kr: 알마니가 고우단 산맥의 숲에서 문제를 일으키고 있는 젠마의 수를 줄여 달라고 부탁했어요. 젠마 15마리만 잡아주실 수 있나요?
description.nl: Almani asked for help with reducing the Zenma population as they're causing problems with forestation in Gouthan Mountains. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.pl: Almani asked for help with reducing the Zenma population as they're causing problems with forestation in Gouthan Mountains. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.ru: Almani asked for help with reducing the Zenma population as they're causing problems with forestation in Gouthan Mountains. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.sp: Almani ha pedido ayuda para reducir la población de Zenmas, ya que están causando problemas con la forestación en las Montañas Gouthan. ¿Podrías eliminar a 15 de ellos?
description.sw: Almani asked for help with reducing the Zenma population as they're causing problems with forestation in Gouthan Mountains. Could you kill 15 of them?
description.th: Almani ขอความช่วยเหลือในการลดจำนวน Zenma เนื่องจากพวกเขากำลังก่อให้เกิดปัญหากับป่าไม้ใน Gouthan Mountains คุณสามารถฆ่าพวกมัน 15 ตัวได้หรือไม่?
description.tw: 阿爾瑪尼請求協助減少紅蠍尖牙的數量，因為牠們正在古坦山脈造成造林上的問題。你能幫忙擊殺 15 隻嗎？
description.vi: Almani đã yêu cầu giúp đỡ để giảm dân số Zenma vì chúng đang gây ra các vấn đề với việc trồng rừng ở Gouthan Mountains. Bạn có thể giết 15 trong số chúng không?

descriptionComplete.en: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
descriptionComplete.ar: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
descriptionComplete.br: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ estava feliz em ver a quest concluída.

dialogsBegin.en: Almani asked for help with reducing the Zenma population as they're causing problems with forestation in Gouthan Mountains. Could you kill 15 of them?
dialogsBegin.ar: Almani asked for help with reducing the Zenma population as they're causing problems with forestation in Gouthan Mountains. Could you kill 15 of them?
dialogsBegin.br: Almani pediu ajuda para reduzir a população Zenma, pois eles estão causando problemas com o reflorestamento nas Montanhas Gouthan. Você poderia matar 15 deles?
dialogsBegin.cns: 亚尔玛尼请求减少变异巨眼怪的数量，因为它们给永恒森林的植树造林带了很多问题。你能杀掉15个变异巨眼怪吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Almani bat um Hilfe bei der Reduzierung der Zenma-Population, da sie Probleme mit der Aufforstung im Gouthan-Gebirge verursachen. Kannst du 15 von ihnen töten?
dialogsBegin.fi: Almani asked for help with reducing the Zenma population as they're causing problems with forestation in Gouthan Mountains. Could you kill 15 of them?
dialogsBegin.fil: Humiling si Almani ng tulong para bawasan ang populasyon ng Zenma dahil nagdudulot sila ng problema sa reforestation sa Gouthan Mountains. Puwede mo bang patayin ang 15 sa kanila?
dialogsBegin.fr: Almani a besoin d'aide pour réduire la population de Zenma, car ils posent des problèmes de reforestation dans les montagnes de Gouthan. Peux-tu en tuer 15 ?
dialogsBegin.id: Almani meminta bantuan untuk mengurangi populasi Zenma karena mereka menyebabkan masalah pada Forestation di Gouthan Mountain. Bisakah kamu habisi 15 dari mereka?
dialogsBegin.it: Almani asked for help with reducing the Zenma population as they're causing problems with forestation in Gouthan Mountains. Could you kill 15 of them?
dialogsBegin.jp: アルマーニから、ゴウダン山脈の植林に支障をきたしているので、ゼンマーの数を減らす協力をしてほしいとの依頼がありました。15匹だけでよいので、討伐してきていただけないでしょうか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 알마니가 고우단 산맥의 숲에서 문제를 일으키고 있는 젠마의 수를 줄여 달라고 부탁했어요. 젠마 15마리만 잡아주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Almani asked for help with reducing the Zenma population as they're causing problems with forestation in Gouthan Mountains. Could you kill 15 of them?
dialogsBegin.pl: Almani asked for help with reducing the Zenma population as they're causing problems with forestation in Gouthan Mountains. Could you kill 15 of them?
dialogsBegin.ru: Almani asked for help with reducing the Zenma population as they're causing problems with forestation in Gouthan Mountains. Could you kill 15 of them?
dialogsBegin.sp: Almani ha pedido ayuda para reducir la población de Zenmas, ya que están causando problemas con la forestación en las Montañas Gouthan. ¿Podrías eliminar a 15 de ellos?
dialogsBegin.sw: Almani asked for help with reducing the Zenma population as they're causing problems with forestation in Gouthan Mountains. Could you kill 15 of them?
dialogsBegin.th: Almani ขอความช่วยเหลือในการลดจำนวน Zenma เนื่องจากพวกเขากำลังก่อให้เกิดปัญหากับป่าไม้ใน Gouthan Mountains คุณสามารถฆ่าพวกมัน 15 ตัวได้หรือไม่?
dialogsBegin.tw: 阿爾瑪尼請求協助減少紅蠍尖牙的數量，因為牠們正在古坦山脈造成造林上的問題。你能幫忙擊殺 15 隻嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Almani đã yêu cầu giúp đỡ để giảm dân số Zenma vì chúng đang gây ra các vấn đề với việc trồng rừng ở Gouthan Mountains. Bạn có thể giết 15 trong số chúng không?

dialogsBegin.en: Alright, sorry about that. I just had to finish some important paperwork. Now, where were we?
dialogsBegin.ar: Alright, sorry about that. I just had to finish some important paperwork. Now, where were we?
dialogsBegin.br: Desculpe te fazer esperar. Estava terminando uma papelada importante. Agora, onde estávamos?
dialogsBegin.cns: 好吧，我为此感到抱歉。我刚刚必须得完成一些重要的书面任务。回到现在，我们进行到哪了？
dialogsBegin.de: In Ordnung, das tut mir leid. Ich musste nur wichtigen Papierkram erledigen. Also, wo waren wir?
dialogsBegin.fi: Alright, sorry about that. I just had to finish some important paperwork. Now, where were we?
dialogsBegin.fil: Alright, sorry about that. I just had to finish some important paperwork. Now, where were we?
dialogsBegin.fr: Voilà, désolé. J'avais des papiers importants à finir. Alors, où en étions-nous ?
dialogsBegin.id: Baiklah. maaf soal itu. Aku harus menyelesaikan beberapa dokumen penting terlebih dahulu. Sampai di mana kita tadi?
dialogsBegin.it: Alright, sorry about that. I just had to finish some important paperwork. Now, where were we?
dialogsBegin.jp: ごめんなさいね。大事な書類を処理しないといけないのよ。えーっと、どこまで話したかしら？
dialogsBegin.kr: 자, 미안해요. 중요한 서류 작업을 막 끝냈거든요. 어디까지 이야기했었죠?
dialogsBegin.nl: Alright, sorry about that. I just had to finish some important paperwork. Now, where were we?
dialogsBegin.pl: Alright, sorry about that. I just had to finish some important paperwork. Now, where were we?
dialogsBegin.ru: Alright, sorry about that. I just had to finish some important paperwork. Now, where were we?
dialogsBegin.sp: Vale ya está, perdón por la espera. Tenía que terminar un papeleo importante. Bien, ¿dónde estábamos?
dialogsBegin.sw: Alright, sorry about that. I just had to finish some important paperwork. Now, where were we?
dialogsBegin.th: เอาละ ขอโทษด้วย ฉันแค่ต้องทำเอกสารสำคัญให้เสร็จ เราคุยถึงไหนแล้วนะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 好吧，對此感到抱歉。我只需要完成一些重要的文書工作。現在，我們在哪裡？
dialogsBegin.vi: Được rồi, xin lỗi về điều đó. Tôi vừa phải hoàn thành một số thủ tục giấy tờ quan trọng. Bây giờ, chúng ta đã ở đâu rồi nhỉ?

dialogsBegin.en: *cough* ...Oh! The test, right. Sorry! To get you more familiar with your flying device, I want you to experience Air Combat! Yes, you can also fight in the air! It's very similar to regular Combat, actually.
dialogsBegin.ar: *cough* ...Oh! The test, right. Sorry! To get you more familiar with your flying device, I want you to experience Air Combat! Yes, you can also fight in the air! It's very similar to regular Combat, actually.
dialogsBegin.br: *Cof Cof* ...Ah claro! O teste, certo. Perdão! Para que você se familiarize com seu dispositivo voador, quero que experimente o Combate Aéreo! Sim, você também pode lutar no ar! É muito semelhante ao Combate terrestre, na verdade.
dialogsBegin.cns: *咳嗽声*..噢！对！是测试。我很抱歉！为了让你更加熟练使用你的飞行器，我希望你能去体验一下如何在空中猎杀怪物！没错，你还能在天上战斗！实际上，它和平常的战斗没什么区别。
dialogsBegin.de: *hust* ...Oh! Der Test, richtig. Entschuldigung! Um dich mit deinem Flugapparat besser vertraut zu machen, möchte ich, dass du den Luftkampf erlebst! Ja, du kannst auch in der Luft kämpfen! Es ist dem normalen Kampf sehr ähnlich.
dialogsBegin.fi: *cough* ...Oh! The test, right. Sorry! To get you more familiar with your flying device, I want you to experience Air Combat! Yes, you can also fight in the air! It's very similar to regular Combat, actually.
dialogsBegin.fil: *cough* ...Oh! The test, right. Sorry! To get you more familiar with your flying device, I want you to experience Air Combat! Yes, you can also fight in the air! It's very similar to regular Combat, actually.
dialogsBegin.fr: *tousse* ...Oh ! Le test, c'est ça. Pardon ! Pour que tu sois plus à l'aise en vol, je veux que tu découvres le combat en vol. Oui, tu peux également te battre dans les airs ! C'est très similaire au combat sur le sol, à vrai dire.
dialogsBegin.id: *huk* ...Oh iya tes, maaf! Untuk membuatmu jadi terbiasa dengan Flying Devicemu, aku ingin kamu mencoba Air Combat! Ya, Kamu juga bisa bertarung di udara! Sederhananya, ini sangat mirip dengan Combat biasa.
dialogsBegin.it: *cough* ...Oh! The test, right. Sorry! To get you more familiar with your flying device, I want you to experience Air Combat! Yes, you can also fight in the air! It's very similar to regular Combat, actually.
dialogsBegin.jp: えっへん。ああ！テストですね、ごめんなさい！では、もっと飛行に慣れてもらうために、飛行中の戦闘を体験してもらおうかしら。空でも戦えるんですよ？地上で戦ってるように、すぐ慣れるわ。
dialogsBegin.kr: *콜록* …아! 시험! 죄송해요! 비행 장치에 좀 더 익숙해지기 위해서, 비행 전투를 경험해봤으면 해요! 맞아요, 공중에서도 싸울 수 있어요! 일반 전투 방식과 거의 비슷하답니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: *cough* ...Oh! The test, right. Sorry! To get you more familiar with your flying device, I want you to experience Air Combat! Yes, you can also fight in the air! It's very similar to regular Combat, actually.
dialogsBegin.pl: *cough* ...Oh! The test, right. Sorry! To get you more familiar with your flying device, I want you to experience Air Combat! Yes, you can also fight in the air! It's very similar to regular Combat, actually.
dialogsBegin.ru: *cough* ...Oh! The test, right. Sorry! To get you more familiar with your flying device, I want you to experience Air Combat! Yes, you can also fight in the air! It's very similar to regular Combat, actually.
dialogsBegin.sp: *cof*... ¡Ay! La prueba, correcto. ¡Lo siento! Para familiarizarte más con tu dispositivo volador, ¡quiero que experimentes el Combate Aéreo! ¡Sí, también puedes luchar en el aire! Es muy parecido al Combate normal, en realidad.
dialogsBegin.sw: *cough* ...Oh! The test, right. Sorry! To get you more familiar with your flying device, I want you to experience Air Combat! Yes, you can also fight in the air! It's very similar to regular Combat, actually.
dialogsBegin.th: *ไอ* โอ้! การทดสอบใช่มั้ย โทษที! เพื่อให้คุณคุ้นเคยกับอุปกรณ์การบินมากขึ้น ฉันอยากให้คุณสัมผัสประสบการณ์ การต่อสู้กลางอากาศ! ใช่ คุณสามารถต่อสู้กลางอากาศได้! มันก็คล้ายกับการต่อสู้ทั่วไปแหละ
dialogsBegin.tw: *咳咳* …哦！測試，對吼！對不起！為了讓你更熟悉你的飛行設備，我希望你體驗空戰！是的，你也可以在空中戰鬥！實際上，它與常規戰鬥非常相似。
dialogsBegin.vi: * ho khụ * ... Ôi! Bài kiểm tra, đúng. Xin lỗi! Để giúp bạn quen thuộc hơn với thiết bị bay của mình, tôi muốn bạn trải nghiệm chiếc Air Combat! Vâng, bạn cũng có thể chiến đấu trên không! Nó rất giống với chiếc Combat thông thường, thực sự.

dialogsBegin.cns: 你甚至能在天上使用技能。快去试试吧！去杀死一些在晨光西北边缘的令人讨厌的巨型苍翼蜂蛾吧。
dialogsBegin.de: Du kannst deine Fähigkeiten sogar in der Luft einsetzen. Probier es mal aus! Geh und töte einige dieser lästigen Captain Mothbees, die in der Nähe des nordwestlichen Randes von Saint Morning fliegen.

dialogsBegin.id: Kamu bahkan bisa menggunakan skill di udara. Cobalah! Pergi dan hajar beberapa Pesky Mothbees yang terbang di sekitar barat daya Saint City.

dialogsBegin.jp: 空中でスキルを使うこともできるのよ。試してみましょ。セイントモーニング北西の端にいる＜キャプテン・モスビー＞を倒してきてほしいわ。

dialogsBegin.nl: You can even use skills in the air. Give it a try! Go and kill some of those Pesky Captain Mothbees flying near the northwestern edge of Saint City.
dialogsBegin.pl: You can even use skills in the air. Give it a try! Go and kill some of those Pesky Captain Mothbees flying near the northwestern edge of Saint City.
dialogsBegin.ru: You can even use skills in the air. Give it a try! Go and kill some of those Pesky Captain Mothbees flying near the northwestern edge of Saint City.
dialogsBegin.sp: Incluso puedes usar habilidades en el aire. ¡Dale una oportunidad! Ve y mata a algunos de esos malditos Mothbees Capitanes que vuelan cerca del extremo noroeste de Saint.
dialogsBegin.sw: You can even use skills in the air. Give it a try! Go and kill some of those Pesky Captain Mothbees flying near the northwestern edge of Saint City.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณสามารถใช้สกิลกลางอากาศได้ ลองดูสิ! บินไปกำจัด Pesky Captain Mothbees ที่บินอยู่ใกล้ๆ ชายขอบตะวันตกเฉียงเหนือของ Saint City
dialogsBegin.tw: 你甚至可以在空中使用技能。試試看！去殺死一些在聖音特西北邊緣附近飛行的討厭的蛾蜂船長。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn thậm chí có thể sử dụng các kỹ năng trên không. Hãy thử một lần! Đi và giết một số Pesky Captain Mothbees đang bay gần rìa phía tây bắc của Saint City.

dialogsAccept.en: You'll find the Mothbees flying inbetween Flaris and Saint Morning. They seem to gather near the giant gears. Killing 5 should be enough. Report back to me once you're done.
dialogsAccept.ar: You'll find the Mothbees flying inbetween Flaris and Saint Morning. They seem to gather near the giant gears. Killing 5 should be enough. Report back to me once you're done.
dialogsAccept.br: Você encontrará as Maribelhas voando entre Flaris e Saint Morning. Elas parecem se reunir perto das engrenagens gigantes. Eliminar 5 deve ser o suficiente. Relate para mim assim que terminar.
dialogsAccept.cns: 你会在帕里和晨光之间找到苍翼蜂蛾。他们似乎会在巨型齿轮周围聚集。请前去杀死5只苍翼蜂蛾，当你完成后回来向我报告。
dialogsAccept.de: Du findest die Mothbees zwischen Flaris und Saint Morning. Sie scheinen sich in der Nähe der riesigen Zahnräder zu sammeln. Es dürfte ausreichen, 5 von ihnen zu erledigen. Erstatte mir Bericht, wenn du fertig bist.
dialogsAccept.fi: You'll find the Mothbees flying inbetween Flaris and Saint Morning. They seem to gather near the giant gears. Killing 5 should be enough. Report back to me once you're done.
dialogsAccept.fil: You'll find the Mothbees flying inbetween Flaris and Saint Morning. They seem to gather near the giant gears. Killing 5 should be enough. Report back to me once you're done.
dialogsAccept.fr: Tu trouveras les Mothbees entre Flaris et Saint Morning. Ils ont tendance à se regrouper vers les engrenages géants. En tuer 5 devrait suffire, puis reviens me voir.
dialogsAccept.id: Kamu akan mendapati Mothbees terbang antara Flaris dan Saint Morning. Mereka berkumpul di sekitar Gear besar. Cukup kalahkan 5 dari mereka dan laporkan kembali padaku setelah kamu selesai.
dialogsAccept.it: You'll find the Mothbees flying inbetween Flaris and Saint Morning. They seem to gather near the giant gears. Killing 5 should be enough. Report back to me once you're done.
dialogsAccept.jp: フラリスとセイントモーニングの間にモスビーが飛んでいるはずよ。巨大な歯車の近くに群れているはずだわ。5匹倒せば十分でしょう。終わったら、報告してね。
dialogsAccept.kr: 모스비들은 플라리스와 세인트 모닝 사이를 날아다니고 있을 거예요. 거대한 기어 근처에 모이는 것 같더라고요. 5마리 정도만 사냥하면 될 것 같네요. 다 잡으면 다시 오세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: You'll find the Mothbees flying inbetween Flaris and Saint Morning. They seem to gather near the giant gears. Killing 5 should be enough. Report back to me once you're done.
dialogsAccept.pl: You'll find the Mothbees flying inbetween Flaris and Saint Morning. They seem to gather near the giant gears. Killing 5 should be enough. Report back to me once you're done.
dialogsAccept.ru: You'll find the Mothbees flying inbetween Flaris and Saint Morning. They seem to gather near the giant gears. Killing 5 should be enough. Report back to me once you're done.
dialogsAccept.sp: Encontrarás a los Mothbees volando entre Flaris y Saint Morning. Suelen reunirse cerca de los engranajes gigantes. Matar a 5 debería ser suficiente. Vuelve a informarme una vez que hayas terminado.
dialogsAccept.sw: You'll find the Mothbees flying inbetween Flaris and Saint Morning. They seem to gather near the giant gears. Killing 5 should be enough. Report back to me once you're done.
dialogsAccept.th: คุณจะพบ Mothbees บินอยู่ระหว่าง Flaris และ Saint Morning ดูเหมือนพวกมันจะมารวมตัวกันใกล้กับเกียร์ยักษ์ ฆ่า 5 ตัวก็พอ เมื่อคุณทำสำเร็จแล้วให้กลับมาหาฉัน
dialogsAccept.tw: 你會發現飛蛾在布拉里斯和聖音特之間飛行。他們似乎聚集在巨大的齒輪附近，殺 5 個就夠了，完成後向我報告。
dialogsAccept.vi: Bạn sẽ tìm thấy Mothbees bay giữa Flaris và Saint Morning. Chúng dường như tụ tập gần những bánh răng khổng lồ. Giết 5 là đủ. Báo cáo lại cho tôi sau khi bạn hoàn thành.

dialogsDecline.en: They're just bugs, they're not that scary! *sigh* Let me know when you've found enough courage.
dialogsDecline.ar: They're just bugs, they're not that scary! *sigh* Let me know when you've found enough courage.
dialogsDecline.br: São apenas insetos, não são tão assustadores! *suspira* Me avisa quando se sentir com coragem o suficiente.
dialogsDecline.cns: 它们不会尖叫的，它们只是虫子而已！*叹气*，当你拥有足够的勇气的时候再回来找我吧。
dialogsDecline.de: Es sind nur Käfer, die sind gar nicht so schrecklich! *seufz* Sag mir Bescheid, wenn du genug Mut gefunden hast.
dialogsDecline.fi: They're just bugs, they're not that scary! *sigh* Let me know when you've found enough courage.
dialogsDecline.fil: They're just bugs, they're not that scary! *sigh* Let me know when you've found enough courage.
dialogsDecline.fr: Ce ne sont que des insectes, il ne sont pas si effrayants ! *soupir* Reviens me voir une fois que tu auras trouvé suffisamment de courage.
dialogsDecline.id: Mereka hanyalah sekumpulan serangga, sama sekali tidak menakutkan! *sigh* Bilang saja padaku jika kamu telah menemukan cukup keberanian.
dialogsDecline.it: They're just bugs, they're not that scary! *sigh* Let me know when you've found enough courage.
dialogsDecline.jp: ただの虫よ！怖くないわ。勇気が出たらまた教えてね。
dialogsDecline.kr: 벌레일 뿐인걸요, 그렇게 무섭지 않다고요! *한숨* 용기가 생기면 다시 말씀해 주세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: They're just bugs, they're not that scary! *sigh* Let me know when you've found enough courage.
dialogsDecline.pl: They're just bugs, they're not that scary! *sigh* Let me know when you've found enough courage.
dialogsDecline.ru: They're just bugs, they're not that scary! *sigh* Let me know when you've found enough courage.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Son solo bichos, no dan tanto miedo! *suspiro* Avísame cuando hayas encontrado el coraje que te falta.
dialogsDecline.sw: They're just bugs, they're not that scary! *sigh* Let me know when you've found enough courage.
dialogsDecline.th: พวกมันก็แค่แมลง ไม่ได้น่ากลัวขนาดนั้น! *ถอนหายใจ* ถ้าเจอความกล้าในตัวแล้วก็บอกฉันด้วยละกัน
dialogsDecline.tw: 它們只是蟲子，沒有那麼可怕！*唉*當你找到足夠的勇氣時告訴我。
dialogsDecline.vi: Chúng chỉ là những con sâu bọ, chúng không đáng sợ như vậy! * thở dài * Hãy cho tôi biết khi bạn tìm thấy đủ can đảm.

dialogsComplete.en: Wow impressive! You've really got a knack for this. Well done. You've passed the test!
dialogsComplete.ar: Wow impressive! You've really got a knack for this. Well done. You've passed the test!
dialogsComplete.br: Uau, impressionante! Você realmente leva jeito para isso. Muito bem. Você passou no teste!

dialogsComplete.de: Beeindruckend! Du hast wirklich ein Händchen für so etwas. Gut gemacht! Du hast die Prüfung bestanden!
dialogsComplete.fi: Wow impressive! You've really got a knack for this. Well done. You've passed the test!
dialogsComplete.fil: Wow impressive! You've really got a knack for this. Well done. You've passed the test!
dialogsComplete.fr: Woah, impressionant ! Tu es fait pour ça, on dirait. Bien joué, tu as passé le test !
dialogsComplete.id: Wow mengesankan! Kamu cukup berbakat untuk ini. Bagus sekali. Kamu telah lulus tesnya!
dialogsComplete.it: Wow impressive! You've really got a knack for this. Well done. You've passed the test!
dialogsComplete.jp: わぁすっごーい！初体験はどうだったかしら？そうね、合格よ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 정말 대단해요! 역시 비행에 소질이 있으시네요. 잘하셨어요. 시험 합격이에요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Wow impressive! You've really got a knack for this. Well done. You've passed the test!
dialogsComplete.pl: Imponujące! Naprawdę masz do tego talent. Zdałeś test!
dialogsComplete.ru: Wow impressive! You've really got a knack for this. Well done. You've passed the test!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Wow impresionante! Tienes un don para esto. Bien hecho. ¡Has pasado la prueba!
dialogsComplete.sw: Wow impressive! You've really got a knack for this. Well done. You've passed the test!
dialogsComplete.th: ว้าว น่าประทับใจมาก! คุณมีความสามารถด้านนี้จริงๆ ทำได้ดีเลย คุณผ่านการทดสอบแล้ว!
dialogsComplete.tw: 哇～令人印象深刻！你真的有這方面的本領。做得好。你通過了測試！
dialogsComplete.vi: Ồ thật ấn tượng! Bạn thực sự có sở trường cho việc này. Tốt lắm. Bạn đã vượt qua bài kiểm tra!
