dialogsBegin.en: Ah! So you braved all the perils of the dungeon just to meet me eh? Oh my name? Well, I don't just give that out to anyone! Hehe.
dialogsBegin.ar: Ah! So you braved all the perils of the dungeon just to meet me eh? Oh my name? Well, I don't just give that out to anyone! Hehe.
dialogsBegin.br: Ah! Então você enfrentou todos os perigos da masmorra só para me conhecer, é? Ah meu nome? Bem, eu não sei se você pode saber! Hehe.
dialogsBegin.cns: 啊！所以你冒着危险来见我？哦，我的名字？嗯，我不会随便把它给别人的! 嘻嘻。
dialogsBegin.de: Ah! Du hast also allen Gefahren der Mine getrotzt, nur um mich zu treffen? Oh, mein Name? Nun, den verrate ich nicht einfach so! Hehe.
dialogsBegin.fi: Ah! So you braved all the perils of the dungeon just to meet me eh? Oh my name? Well, I don't just give that out to anyone! Hehe.
dialogsBegin.fil: Ah! So you braved all the perils of the dungeon just to meet me eh? Oh my name? Well, I don't just give that out to anyone! Hehe.
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous avez bravé les dangers de la mine pour me trouver ? Je sais que je suis belle mais vous n'auriez pas dû !
dialogsBegin.id: Ah! Jadi kamu berani menghadapi semua bahaya penjara bawah tanah hanya untuk bertemu denganku ya? Oh namaku? Yah, saya tidak semudah itu memberitahu kepada siapa pun! Hehe.
dialogsBegin.it: Ah! So you braved all the perils of the dungeon just to meet me eh? Oh my name? Well, I don't just give that out to anyone! Hehe.
dialogsBegin.jp: え、わたくしに会うためにわざわざこのダンジョンまで来たの！　や～、美人って罪よねぇ……わたくしストーカーには間に合ってますの。
dialogsBegin.kr: 나를 만나려고 일부러 이 던전에 들어왔다고? 어머~ 내 이름? 음, 난 연애엔 관심 없다고~
dialogsBegin.nl: Ah! So you braved all the perils of the dungeon just to meet me eh? Oh my name? Well, I don't just give that out to anyone! Hehe.
dialogsBegin.pl: Ah! So you braved all the perils of the dungeon just to meet me eh? Oh my name? Well, I don't just give that out to anyone! Hehe.
dialogsBegin.ru: Ah! So you braved all the perils of the dungeon just to meet me eh? Oh my name? Well, I don't just give that out to anyone! Hehe.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Vaya! Así que has desafiado todos los peligros de la mazmorra solo para conocerme, ¿eh? Ah ¿mi nombre? Bueno, ¡no se lo digo a nadie! Jeje.
dialogsBegin.sw: Ah! So you braved all the perils of the dungeon just to meet me eh? Oh my name? Well, I don't just give that out to anyone! Hehe.
dialogsBegin.th: อ่าา ! ดังนั้นคุณจึงต้องเผชิญกับความยากลำบากทั้งหมดของดันเจี้ยนเพียงเพื่อให้ตรงกับฉันใช่มั้ย? โอ้ฉันชื่ออะไรงั้นหรอ ? ออกไปให้หมดทุกคน! ฮิฮิ.
dialogsBegin.tw: 你是為了見我，故意進到這副本的嗎？天哪~ 竟然知道我的美麗…想不到還有拼命跟著我的人~ 我知道你的心意~ 不過我對戀愛沒有興趣~
dialogsBegin.vi: Ah! Vậy là bạn đã bất chấp mọi hiểm nguy trong ngục tối chỉ để gặp tôi sao? Ôi tên tôi ư? Chà, tôi không tiết lộ điều này cho bất cứ ai đâu! Hehe.

dialogsBegin.en: Before I bestow upon you the most graceful name ever, you have to show me you are worthy to receive it! How? Oh its quite simple! Hehe. Just kill 20 Keakoon Guards!
dialogsBegin.ar: Before I bestow upon you the most graceful name ever, you have to show me you are worthy to receive it! How? Oh its quite simple! Hehe. Just kill 20 Keakoon Guards!
dialogsBegin.br: Antes que eu conceda a você o nome mais gracioso de todos os tempos, você tem que me mostrar que é digno de recebê-lo! Como? Ah é bem simples! Hehe. Apenas mate 20 Guardas Keakoon!
dialogsBegin.cns: 在我告诉你有史以来最优雅的名字之前，让我看看你是否配得上！如何？怎么做？哦，这很简单! 嘿嘿。去杀掉20个奇昆警卫兵吧!
dialogsBegin.de: Bevor ich dir den anmutigsten Namen überhaupt gebe, musst du mir zeigen, dass du würdig bist, ihn zu erhalten! Und wie? Oh, das ist ganz einfach! Hehe. Töte einfach 20 Keakoon Guards!
dialogsBegin.fi: Before I bestow upon you the most graceful name ever, you have to show me you are worthy to receive it! How? Oh its quite simple! Hehe. Just kill 20 Keakoon Guards!
dialogsBegin.fil: Before I bestow upon you the most graceful name ever, you have to show me you are worthy to receive it! How? Oh its quite simple! Hehe. Just kill 20 Keakoon Guards!
dialogsBegin.fr: Oh, vous ne voulez pas me séduire mais devenir mon disciple ? Voyons de quoi vous êtes capable.
dialogsBegin.id: Sebelum saya menganugerahkan Anda nama paling anggun yang pernah ada, Anda harus menunjukkan kepada saya bahwa Anda layak untuk menerimanya! Bagaimana? Oh itu cukup sederhana! Hehe. Bunuh saja 20 Keakoon Guards!
dialogsBegin.it: Before I bestow upon you the most graceful name ever, you have to show me you are worthy to receive it! How? Oh its quite simple! Hehe. Just kill 20 Keakoon Guards!
dialogsBegin.jp: え、ちがうって？わたくしの弟子になりたいのかしら？だったら君の実力を見せて欲しい。そうだな！キクン警備編を20匹倒して来て欲しい。そうしたら、君を認める。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그게 아니라고? 아하~! 역시 또 내 소문을 듣고 내 제자가 되려 온 자로군? 내 제자가 되고 싶으면 우선 네 실력부터 보여달라고. 흐음.. 그래 근처에 키쿤 경비병 20마리만 처치하고 와. 그럼 널 인정해주지.
dialogsBegin.nl: Before I bestow upon you the most graceful name ever, you have to show me you are worthy to receive it! How? Oh its quite simple! Hehe. Just kill 20 Keakoon Guards!
dialogsBegin.pl: Before I bestow upon you the most graceful name ever, you have to show me you are worthy to receive it! How? Oh its quite simple! Hehe. Just kill 20 Keakoon Guards!
dialogsBegin.ru: Before I bestow upon you the most graceful name ever, you have to show me you are worthy to receive it! How? Oh its quite simple! Hehe. Just kill 20 Keakoon Guards!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Antes de decirte el nombre más elegante de la historia, tienes que demostrarme que eres digno de recibirlo! ¿Cómo? ¡Oh, es bastante simple! Jeje. ¡Sólo tienes que derrotar a 20 Guardias Keakoon!
dialogsBegin.sw: Before I bestow upon you the most graceful name ever, you have to show me you are worthy to receive it! How? Oh its quite simple! Hehe. Just kill 20 Keakoon Guards!
dialogsBegin.th: ก่อนที่ฉันจะมอบให้กับคุณในชื่ออันสง่างามที่สุดเท่าที่เคยคุณต้องแสดงให้ฉันเห็นว่าคุณสมควรที่จะได้รับมัน! อย่างไร? โอ้วว ง่ายมาก! ฮิฮิ. เพียงแค่ฆ่า 20 Keakoon Guards เท่านั้น!
dialogsBegin.tw: 你說不是那樣子啊？啊~！那麼你是聽了我的傳聞，為了要成為我的弟子而來的吧？如果想要成為我的弟子，必須先讓我看過你的實力。嗯嗯…在這附近，消滅奇昆警衛兵 20 個，然後再來找我吧。那麼我就會承認你。
dialogsBegin.vi: Trước khi tôi ban tặng cho bạn cái tên duyên dáng nhất từ ​​trước đến nay, bạn phải cho tôi thấy bạn xứng đáng được nhận nó! Bằng cách nào à? Ồ, nó khá đơn giản! Hehe. Chỉ cần giết 20 Keakoon Guards!

dialogsAccept.en: There should be more than enough Keakoon Guards in this very dungeon. Just kill 20 of them and you will have the privilege of knowing my name!
dialogsAccept.ar: There should be more than enough Keakoon Guards in this very dungeon. Just kill 20 of them and you will have the privilege of knowing my name!
dialogsAccept.br: Deve haver Guardas Keakoon suficientes nesta masmorra. Basta matar 20 deles e você terá o privilégio de saber meu nome!
dialogsAccept.cns: 在这个地牢里，应该有足够多的奇昆警卫兵。你只要杀死20个，就能有幸知道我的名字！
dialogsAccept.de: Es sollte mehr als genug Keakoon Guards in dieser Mine geben. Töte einfach 20 von ihnen und du wirst das Privileg haben, meinen Namen zu erfahren!
dialogsAccept.fi: There should be more than enough Keakoon Guards in this very dungeon. Just kill 20 of them and you will have the privilege of knowing my name!
dialogsAccept.fil: There should be more than enough Keakoon Guards in this very dungeon. Just kill 20 of them and you will have the privilege of knowing my name!
dialogsAccept.fr: Commencez par tuer 20 Keakoon.
dialogsAccept.id: Seharusnya ada lebih dari cukup Keakoon Guards di penjara bawah tanah ini. Bunuh saja 20 dari mereka dan Anda akan memiliki hak istimewa untuk mengetahui nama saya!
dialogsAccept.it: There should be more than enough Keakoon Guards in this very dungeon. Just kill 20 of them and you will have the privilege of knowing my name!
dialogsAccept.jp: そうねぇ。じゃあそこらへんにいる警備兵を倒してみてくれる？　その動きをみて決めるわ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 이 던전 안이라면 키쿤 경비병이 아주 많을 거예요. 20마리만 처치하면, 기꺼이 제 이름을 알려 드리죠!
dialogsAccept.nl: There should be more than enough Keakoon Guards in this very dungeon. Just kill 20 of them and you will have the privilege of knowing my name!
dialogsAccept.pl: There should be more than enough Keakoon Guards in this very dungeon. Just kill 20 of them and you will have the privilege of knowing my name!
dialogsAccept.ru: There should be more than enough Keakoon Guards in this very dungeon. Just kill 20 of them and you will have the privilege of knowing my name!
dialogsAccept.sp: Debería haber suficientes Guardias Keakoon en esta misma mazmorra. ¡Derrota a 20 de ellos y tendrás el privilegio de saber mi nombre!
dialogsAccept.sw: There should be more than enough Keakoon Guards in this very dungeon. Just kill 20 of them and you will have the privilege of knowing my name!
dialogsAccept.th: มี Keakoon Guards มากพอในดันเจี้ยนนี้ เพียงแค่ฆ่า 20 ตัว และคุณจะได้รับสิทธิพิเศษในการรู้จักชื่อของฉัน
dialogsAccept.tw: 哈哈哈。你好像還差很多呢。先打倒奇昆警衛兵 20 個吧。那麼我就會和你對話。

dialogsBegin.vi: *hít*. Hmm..Có lẽ tui sẽ đổi ý nếu bạn chịu làm một việc này cho Drico! Bộ tộc cần nhựa của Roach Queen để làm thuốc! *khịt mũi* Bạn có thể lấy nó về cho Drico không?

dialogsFail.de: Sammle den Saft der Pink Roach Queen und den der Blue Roach Queen! Sniff!
dialogsFail.fi: Collect Pink Roach Queen Sap and Blue Roach Queen Sap! Sniff!
dialogsFail.fil: Collect Pink Roach Queen Sap and Blue Roach Queen Sap! Sniff!
dialogsFail.fr: J'ai dit qu'il me fallait de la sève de Tyroglyphe rose et de Tyroglyphe bleu !

dialogsFail.it: Collect Pink Roach Queen Sap and Blue Roach Queen Sap! Sniff!
dialogsFail.jp: ロチクイーンは鉱山のどこかに巣があるはず。フンフン。頑張るといい。フフン！
dialogsFail.kr: 핑키 로치퀸의 수액과 블루 로치퀸의 수액을 모아와라! 크킁!
dialogsFail.nl: Collect Pink Roach Queen Sap and Blue Roach Queen Sap! Sniff!

dialogsFail.ru: Collect Pink Roach Queen Sap and Blue Roach Queen Sap! Sniff!

description.en: Visit High-Dwarpet Goripeg north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you get lost.
description.ar: Visit High-Dwarpet Goripeg north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you get lost.
description.br: O local do Alto Dwarpet Goripeg fica ao norte de Flaris, e você pode checar o local no mapa do mundo. Utilize a tecla de atalho M para ver o mundo
description.cns: 到矮人族的居住地找克利培吧!
description.de: Suche den High-Dwarpet Goripeg. Er wird dich in der Kampfkunst des Assist unterweisen. Oh, zuvor noch eins.
description.fi: Visit High-Dwarpet Goripeg north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you get lost.
description.fil: Visit High-Dwarpet Goripeg north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you get lost.
description.fr: Rencontrer le Grand Dwarpet Goripeg dans le Territoire des Grands Dwarpets.
description.id: Kunjungi High-Dwarpet Goripeg di utara Flarine. Periksa petamu (Kunci M) jika kamu tersesat.
description.it: Visit High-Dwarpet Goripeg north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you get lost.
description.jp: フラリスの北方面ハイドワーフの生息地にいる＜ゴリペック＞のところへ行こう！（Mキーでマップ確認）
description.kr: 플라리네 북부에 있는 하이-드워펫 고리펙을 찾아가세요. 길을 잃으면 지도(M키)를 참고하세요.
description.nl: Visit High-Dwarpet Goripeg north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you get lost.
description.pl: Visit High-Dwarpet Goripeg north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you get lost.
description.ru: Нужно поговорить с высоким карликом Горипегом в лагере на севере от Фларинции. Он научит меня тому, что знает сам.
description.sp: Visita al Alto-Enano Goripeg al norte desde Flarine. Revisa tu mapa (Tecla M) para encontrar el camino si te pierdes.
description.sw: Visit High-Dwarpet Goripeg north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you get lost.
description.th: ไปเยี่ยม High-Dwarpet Goripeg ทางเหนือของ Flarine ตรวจสอบแผนที่ของคุณ (คีย์ M) หากคุณหลงทาง
description.tw: 到杜爾沛的居住地找克利培吧！
description.vi: Ghé thăm High-Dwarpet Goripeg ở phía bắc Flarine. Kiểm tra bản đồ của bạn (phím M) nếu bạn bị lạc.

dialogsBegin.en: Now that you have a good understanding of Assist weaponry, I'd like you to visit Goripeg, one of the High-Dwarpets north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.ar: Now that you have a good understanding of Assist weaponry, I'd like you to visit Goripeg, one of the High-Dwarpets north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.br: Acho que fiz o que precisava fazer. Agora deixe-me contar a respeito do próximo teste. Você deve obter informações a respeito das habilidades de Assist. Primeiramente, você deve ir até o local onde vivem os Altos Dwarpets.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我要告诉你的事情，已经讲完了。下一个考验是，你要学习关于圣职者的技术。你要去找克利培，他在高阶矮人族的居住地。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich glaube getan zu haben, was ich tun konnte. Lass mich nun über die nächste Prüfung reden. Es geht dabei um die Fähigkeiten des Assist. Zunächst musst du an den Ort gehen, an dem der High-Dwarpet lebt.
dialogsBegin.fi: Now that you have a good understanding of Assist weaponry, I'd like you to visit Goripeg, one of the High-Dwarpets north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.fil: Now that you have a good understanding of Assist weaponry, I'd like you to visit Goripeg, one of the High-Dwarpets north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu sembles avoir bien compris comment utiliser les armes. Maintenant voici la prochaine étape : tu dois rassembler des informations sur les compétences de l'Acolyte.
dialogsBegin.id: Sekarang setelah kamu memiliki pemahaman yang baik tentang persenjataan Assist, aku ingin kamu mengunjungi Goripeg, salah satu High-Dwarpets di utara Flarine.
dialogsBegin.it: Now that you have a good understanding of Assist weaponry, I'd like you to visit Goripeg, one of the High-Dwarpets north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.jp: さて、これで私の知っていることは全部教えました。では、次のテスト内容を教えましょう。今度はアシストの技術に関する情報を集めるのですが、まずはハイドワーフの生息地を探し出さなければなりません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이제 어시스트 무기에 대해 잘 이해하신 것 같으니, 플라리네 북부에 있는 하이-드워펫 고리펙을 찾아가 보세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Now that you have a good understanding of Assist weaponry, I'd like you to visit Goripeg, one of the High-Dwarpets north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.pl: Now that you have a good understanding of Assist weaponry, I'd like you to visit Goripeg, one of the High-Dwarpets north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.ru: Ну вот, про оружие я тебе рассказал. Теперь ступай к Горипегу. Он живет в лагере высоких карликов на севере от Фларинции.
dialogsBegin.sp: Ahora que tienes un entendimiento mayor de las armas de Assist, quiero que visites a Goripeg, uno los de los Alto-Enanos al norte desde Flarine.
dialogsBegin.sw: Now that you have a good understanding of Assist weaponry, I'd like you to visit Goripeg, one of the High-Dwarpets north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin.th: ตอนนี้คุณมีความเข้าใจเกี่ยวกับอาวุธ Assist เป็นอย่างดีแล้ว ฉันอยากให้คุณไปที่ Goripeg หนึ่งในกลุ่ม High-Dwarpets ทางเหนือของ Flarine
dialogsBegin.tw: 我要告訴你的事情，已經講完了。下一個考驗是，你要學習關於神職者的技術。你要去海倚杜爾沛的居住地。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bây giờ bạn đã hiểu rõ về vũ khí của Assist, tôi muốn bạn đến thăm Goripeg, một trong những High-Dwarpets ở phía bắc Flarine.

dialogsBegin.en: High-Dwarpet Goripeg will give you information on Assist skills. He knows a lot about Assists and I think you are ready to speak with him.
dialogsBegin.ar: High-Dwarpet Goripeg will give you information on Assist skills. He knows a lot about Assists and I think you are ready to speak with him.
dialogsBegin.br: Visite o Alto Dwarpet Goripeg e peça para ele lhe ensinar a respeito das habilidades de Assist. Antes de ir, há algo que você precisa fazer.
dialogsBegin.cns: 高阶矮人族会告诉你一些关于圣职者技能的信息。他很了解圣职者，我相信你准备好去见他了。
dialogsBegin.de: Suche den High-Dwarpet Goripeg. Er wird dich die Kampfkunst des Assist lehren. Oh, zuvor noch eins.
dialogsBegin.fi: High-Dwarpet Goripeg will give you information on Assist skills. He knows a lot about Assists and I think you are ready to speak with him.
dialogsBegin.fil: High-Dwarpet Goripeg will give you information on Assist skills. He knows a lot about Assists and I think you are ready to speak with him.
dialogsBegin.fr: Pour cela, trouve le Grand Dwarpet du nom de Goripeg et demande-lui de t'apprendre les compétences de l'Acolyte.
dialogsBegin.id: High-Dwarpet Goripeg akan memberimu informasi tentang Assist skill. Dia tahu banyak tentang Assist dan aku pikir kamu sudah siap untuk berbicara dengannya.
dialogsBegin.it: High-Dwarpet Goripeg will give you information on Assist skills. He knows a lot about Assists and I think you are ready to speak with him.
dialogsBegin.jp: フラリスの北でハイドワーフの生息地を探し、＜ゴリペック＞というハイドワーフに会うと、彼からアシストの技術を教えてもらうことができるでしょう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 하이-드워펫 고리펙이 어시스트 스킬을 가르쳐 줄 거예요. 어시스트에 대해 아주 잘 알고 있답니다. 만나봐도 좋을 것 같네요.
dialogsBegin.nl: High-Dwarpet Goripeg will give you information on Assist skills. He knows a lot about Assists and I think you are ready to speak with him.
dialogsBegin.pl: High-Dwarpet Goripeg will give you information on Assist skills. He knows a lot about Assists and I think you are ready to speak with him.
dialogsBegin.ru: Горипег расскажет тебе об умениях униформиста. Он большой специалист в этой области. Думаю, тебе самое время с ним поговорить.
dialogsBegin.sp: El Alto-Enano Goripeg te dará información sobre las habilidades de Assist. Sabe mucho sobre los Assists y creo que estás listo para hablar con él.
dialogsBegin.sw: High-Dwarpet Goripeg will give you information on Assist skills. He knows a lot about Assists and I think you are ready to speak with him.
dialogsBegin.th: High-Dwarpet Goripeg จะให้ข้อมูลเกี่ยวกับทักษะ Assist เขารู้มากเกี่ยวกับ Assists และฉันคิดว่าคุณพร้อมที่จะพูดคุยกับเขา
dialogsBegin.tw: 到海倚杜爾沛的居住地，找一個叫做克利培的海倚杜爾沛，他會告訴你一些技術的相關知識。在那之前…
dialogsBegin.vi: High-Dwarpet Goripeg sẽ cung cấp cho bạn thông tin về các kỹ năng của Assist. Anh ấy biết nhiều về các Assist và tôi nghĩ bạn đã sẵn sàng nói chuyện với anh ấy.

dialogsBegin.en: You can find the High-Dwarpets by opening your map (M Key). Go quickly, young one!
dialogsBegin.ar: You can find the High-Dwarpets by opening your map (M Key). Go quickly, young one!
dialogsBegin.br: Espero que você realize tudo que desejar.
dialogsBegin.cns: 到矮人族的居住地找克利培吧!
dialogsBegin.de: Er hat eine wichtige Aufgabe für dich, also höre ihm gut zu.
dialogsBegin.fi: You can find the High-Dwarpets by opening your map (M Key). Go quickly, young one!
dialogsBegin.fil: You can find the High-Dwarpets by opening your map (M Key). Go quickly, young one!
dialogsBegin.fr: Il vit dans le Territoire des Grands Dwarpets près des montagnes centrales de Leren.
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu dapat menemukan High-Dwarpets dengan membuka petamu (Tombol M). Cepat pergi, anak muda!
dialogsBegin.it: You can find the High-Dwarpets by opening your map (M Key). Go quickly, young one!
dialogsBegin.jp: ハイドワーフは人間を嫌っていますが、きっと彼らはあなたに心を開いてくれるでしょう。さあ、＜ゴリペック＞の元へお行きなさい。（Mキーでマップを確認）
dialogsBegin.kr: 하이-드워펫의 위치는 지도(M키)를 열어서 찾으세요. 어서 가보세요!
dialogsBegin.nl: You can find the High-Dwarpets by opening your map (M Key). Go quickly, young one!
dialogsBegin.pl: You can find the High-Dwarpets by opening your map (M Key). Go quickly, young one!
dialogsBegin.ru: Если заблудишься, сверься с картой ("M"). Надеюсь, ты все еще хочешь стать униформистом?
dialogsBegin.sp: Puedes encontrar a los Alto-Enanos abriendo tu mapa (Tecla M). ¡Date prisa, joven!
dialogsBegin.sw: You can find the High-Dwarpets by opening your map (M Key). Go quickly, young one!
dialogsBegin.th: คุณสามารถหา High-Dwarpets ได้โดยเปิดแผนที่ของคุณ (ปุ่ม M) ไปเร็ว พ่อหนุ่ม!
dialogsBegin.tw: 到杜爾沛的居住地找克利培吧！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có thể tìm thấy High-Dwarpets bằng cách mở bản đồ của bạn (phím M). Đi nhanh lên, bạn trẻ!

dialogsAccept.en: May Bubble protect you and guide you.
dialogsAccept.ar: فل تحفظك فقاعة و ترشدك.
dialogsAccept.br: Que Bubble lhe proteja.
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你一路顺风
dialogsAccept.de: Gott segne dich!
dialogsAccept.fi: May Bubble protect you and guide you.
dialogsAccept.fil: May Bubble protect you and guide you.
dialogsAccept.fr: Que les Héros de Madrigal te protègent !
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga Bubble melindungimu dan menuntunmu.
dialogsAccept.it: May Bubble protect you and guide you.
dialogsAccept.jp: 志高きアシスト志望者に、リシスのご加護がありますように。
dialogsAccept.kr: 버블님이 당신을 지켜주고 인도해 주기를.
dialogsAccept.nl: May Bubble protect you and guide you.
dialogsAccept.pl: May Bubble protect you and guide you.
dialogsAccept.ru: Да пребудет с тобой Лучик.
dialogsAccept.sp: Que Bubble te proteja y te guíe.
dialogsAccept.sw: May Bubble protect you and guide you.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้บับเบิ้ลปกป้องและนำทางคุณ
dialogsAccept.tw: 願巴布樂保佑你並指引你。
dialogsAccept.vi: Bubble bảo vệ bạn và hướng dẫn bạn.

dialogsDecline.en: If you feel that you are not ready, young one, that is your decision. If you change your mind, come and speak with me again.
dialogsDecline.ar: ان شعرت انك لست جاهزا بعد، أيها الصغير، فذلك قرارك انت. ان غيرت رأيك عد و تحدث الي مجددا.
dialogsDecline.br: Realmente não consigo entendê-lo. Você quer desistir agora e desperdiçar seu esforço? Por favor, pense de novo cuidadosamente.
dialogsDecline.cns: 要在这里放弃吗?都快结束了还要放弃，不绝得很可惜吗?
dialogsDecline.de: Ich verstehe dich nicht. Du willst jetzt wirklich aufgeben und deine Anstrengungen sollen völlig umsonst gewesen sein? Denke noch einmal sorgfältig nach!
dialogsDecline.fi: If you feel that you are not ready, young one, that is your decision. If you change your mind, come and speak with me again.
dialogsDecline.fil: If you feel that you are not ready, young one, that is your decision. If you change your mind, come and speak with me again.
dialogsDecline.fr: Je ne te comprends pas. Veux-tu vraiment abandonner maintenant et rendre tous tes efforts aussi vains? Réfléchis-y bien.
dialogsDecline.id: Jika kamu merasa belum siap, anak muda, itu adalah keputusanmu. Jika kamu berubah pikiran, datang dan bicaralah denganku lagi.
dialogsDecline.it: If you feel that you are not ready, young one, that is your decision. If you change your mind, come and speak with me again.
dialogsDecline.jp: 諦めてしまうのですか？せっかくここまで辿りついたのに。大変残念ですね。しかし、もう一度考え直すのもよろしいでしょう。
dialogsDecline.kr: 아직 준비가 안 되셨다고 느낀다면, 그 또한 당신의 선택이겠지요. 마음이 바뀌면 다시 찾아오세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: If you feel that you are not ready, young one, that is your decision. If you change your mind, come and speak with me again.
dialogsDecline.pl: If you feel that you are not ready, young one, that is your decision. If you change your mind, come and speak with me again.
dialogsDecline.ru: Если считаешь, что рано принимать решение - дело твое. Передумаешь - возвращайся.
dialogsDecline.sp: Joven, si crees que no estás preparado, es decisión tuya. Si cambias de opinión, ven y habla conmigo de nuevo.
dialogsDecline.sw: If you feel that you are not ready, young one, that is your decision. If you change your mind, come and speak with me again.
dialogsDecline.th: ถ้าคุณรู้สึกว่าคุณไม่พร้อม นั่นแหละคือการตัดสินใจของคุณ ถ้าคุณเปลี่ยนใจ มาคุยกับฉันใหม่
dialogsDecline.tw: 要在這裡放棄嗎？都快結束了還要放棄，不絕得很可惜嗎？
dialogsDecline.vi: Nếu bạn cảm thấy chưa sẵn sàng, bạn trẻ, đó là quyết định của bạn. Nếu bạn thay đổi ý định, hãy đến và nói chuyện với tôi một lần nữa.

dialogsComplete.en: Erhm… hello there! You must be the young apprentice Maki spoke so highly of.
dialogsComplete.ar: اهم... لا بد انك المبتدئ الصغير الذي حدثني عنه ماكي.
dialogsComplete.br: Direi a você algo ótimo como recompensa. Vamos ver...
dialogsComplete.cns: 啊?这是我弄丢的书耶，怎么找到的啊?反正谢谢你啦。为了报答你，送你一个礼物好了，我看一下喔~488页..
dialogsComplete.de: Elic scheint dich zu mir geschickt zu haben. Das ist gut. Ich benötige dringend Hilfe.
dialogsComplete.fi: Erhm… hello there! You must be the young apprentice Maki spoke so highly of.
dialogsComplete.fil: Erhm… hello there! You must be the young apprentice Maki spoke so highly of.
dialogsComplete.fr: Bien, tu as du potentiel, j'accepte de t'apprendre quelques-unes de mes compétences.
dialogsComplete.id: Erhm… halo! Kamu pasti apprentice muda yang sangat dibanggakan Maki.
dialogsComplete.it: Erhm… hello there! You must be the young apprentice Maki spoke so highly of.
dialogsComplete.jp: ん？人間か？オレは人間は嫌いだが、お前と話すのは悪い気はしないな。よし、いいことを教えてあげよう。このスキル事典の･･･えっと、たしか488ページだったような・・・お、これだ！
dialogsComplete.kr: 어… 안녕하세요! 마키가 높이 평가하던 수련생이 당신이군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Erhm… hello there! You must be the young apprentice Maki spoke so highly of.
dialogsComplete.pl: Erhm… hello there! You must be the young apprentice Maki spoke so highly of.
dialogsComplete.ru: Э-э-э... привет! Значит, это ты то юное дарование, о котором предупреждал меня Макей?
dialogsComplete.sp: Emmm… ¡Hola! Debes ser el joven aprendiz del que Maki habla tan bien.
dialogsComplete.sw: Erhm… hello there! You must be the young apprentice Maki spoke so highly of.
dialogsComplete.th: เอิ่ม… สวัสดี! คุณต้องเป็นเด็กฝึกหัดที่ Maki พูดถึงไว้แน่ๆ
dialogsComplete.tw: 啊？這是我弄丟的書耶，怎麼找到的啊？反正謝謝你啦。爲了報答你，送你一個禮物好了，我看一下喔~488 頁…
dialogsComplete.vi: Erhm… xin chào! Bạn chắc hẳn là tập sự trẻ tuổi mà Maki đã ca ngợi.

dialogsComplete.en: The blessing of Rhisis be with you, apprentice! I'd like to go over one of the Assist skills with you. Haste is a skill that you can cast on yourself or an ally.
dialogsComplete.ar: The blessing of Rhisis be with you, apprentice! I'd like to go over one of the Assist skills with you. Haste is a skill that you can cast on yourself or an ally.
dialogsComplete.br: A Bênção de Rhisis tornará as coisas mais fáceis. Eu gostaria de falar sobre uma das habilidades de Assist com você. Aceleração é uma habilidade que você pode lançar em si mesmo ou em um aliado.
dialogsComplete.cns: 黎席斯的祝福使你的身体变的更轻盈，你想要什么就得到什么..嗯嗯，这是一个叫做高效术的技能，很厉害吧?
dialogsComplete.de: Bringe das Monster Chaner bitte zur Strecke. Es versetzt die Bewohner von Flaris in Angst und Schrecken.
dialogsComplete.fi: The blessing of Rhisis be with you, apprentice! I'd like to go over one of the Assist skills with you. Haste is a skill that you can cast on yourself or an ally.
dialogsComplete.fil: The blessing of Rhisis be with you, apprentice! I'd like to go over one of the Assist skills with you. Haste is a skill that you can cast on yourself or an ally.
dialogsComplete.fr: Voici une des premières compétences à maîtriser pour tout Acolyte, on l'appelle Vivacité.
dialogsComplete.id: Berkat Rhisis bersamamu, apprentice! Aku ingin membahas salah satu skill Assist denganmu. Haste adalah skill yang dapat kamu gunakan pada diri sendiri atau rekanmu.
dialogsComplete.it: The blessing of Rhisis be with you, apprentice! I'd like to go over one of the Assist skills with you. Haste is a skill that you can cast on yourself or an ally.
dialogsComplete.jp: アシストになりたいのか？フム、志さえ見失わなければ叶わない望みなどないさ。 君のなりたいように進めばいい。アシストにはヘイストという、リシスの祝福で体を軽くさせることができる高度なスキルがあるんだ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 리시스의 축복이 함께하길, 수련생이여. 어시스트의 스킬 중 하나인 헤이스트에 대해 알려 드리. 헤이스트는 자신과 아군에게 시전할 수 있는 기술입니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: The blessing of Rhisis be with you, apprentice! I'd like to go over one of the Assist skills with you. Haste is a skill that you can cast on yourself or an ally.
dialogsComplete.pl: The blessing of Rhisis be with you, apprentice! I'd like to go over one of the Assist skills with you. Haste is a skill that you can cast on yourself or an ally.
dialogsComplete.ru: Да пребудет с тобой Райс! Поговорим об умениях униформиста. Начнем со "Спешки" - ее можно применять к себе или товарищу.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Qué la bendición de Rhisis esté contigo, aprendiz! Me gustaría repasar una de las habilidades de Assist contigo. Prisa es una habilidad que puedes lanzar sobre ti mismo o sobre un aliado.
dialogsComplete.sw: The blessing of Rhisis be with you, apprentice! I'd like to go over one of the Assist skills with you. Haste is a skill that you can cast on yourself or an ally.
dialogsComplete.th: ขอให้พรของ Rhisis สถิตกับคุณ เด็กฝึกหัด! ฉันจะสอนทักษะ Assist ให้คุณ Haste เป็นสกิลที่คุณสามารถร่ายใส่ตัวเองหรือพันธมิตรได้
dialogsComplete.tw: 黎席斯的祝福使你的身體變的更輕盈，你想要什麼就得到什麼…嗯嗯，這是一個叫做海依施特的技能，很厲害吧？
dialogsComplete.vi: Ban phước cho Rhisis và bạn, người tập sự! Tôi muốn cùng bạn xem qua một trong những kỹ năng của Assist. Haste là một kỹ năng mà bạn có thể sử dụng cho bản thân hoặc đồng minh.

dialogsComplete.en: The Haste skill allows you to increase your attack speed and decrease your casting time, or that of a friend's, by a very large amount. It is an amazing skill!
dialogsComplete.ar: The Haste skill allows you to increase your attack speed and decrease your casting time, or that of a friend's, by a very large amount. It is an amazing skill!
dialogsComplete.br: É uma habilidade que aumenta a velocidade de ataque e a velocidade de conjuração, de você ou de um aliado, por uma quantidade muito grande. É realmente formidável!!
dialogsComplete.cns: 这个技能可以让你或其他人的速度加快并减少施法时间，幅度很大喔。这是一个很棒的技能。
dialogsComplete.de: Die Fertigkeit Haste ermöglicht es dir, deine Angriffsgeschwindigkeit zu erhöhen und deine Zauberzeit oder die eines Freundes um ein Vielfaches zu verkürzen. Es ist eine erstaunliche Fähigkeit!
dialogsComplete.fi: The Haste skill allows you to increase your attack speed and decrease your casting time, or that of a friend's, by a very large amount. It is an amazing skill!
dialogsComplete.fil: The Haste skill allows you to increase your attack speed and decrease your casting time, or that of a friend's, by a very large amount. It is an amazing skill!
dialogsComplete.fr: Cette technique permet d'augmenter la vitesse d'attaque de ta cible. Je suis sûr que cela te sera très utile à l'avenir !
dialogsComplete.id: Skill Haste memungkinkanmu untuk meningkatkan kecepatan serangan dan mengurangi waktu castingmu, atau waktu casting teman, dengan jumlah yang sangat besar. Ini adalah skill yang luar biasa!
dialogsComplete.it: The Haste skill allows you to increase your attack speed and decrease your casting time, or that of a friend's, by a very large amount. It is an amazing skill!
dialogsComplete.jp: ヘイストは、自分や相手の攻撃速度を上げてくれる補助スキルだ。このスキルをかけてもらうと、戦闘速度が普通より2倍ほど速くなるのさ。へへ、すごいだろう？とても役に立つぜ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 헤이스트 스킬은 공격 속도를 높이고, 자신 또는 아군의 시전 시간을 대폭 단축시켜 주죠. 정 놀라운 기술이랍니다!
dialogsComplete.nl: The Haste skill allows you to increase your attack speed and decrease your casting time, or that of a friend's, by a very large amount. It is an amazing skill!
dialogsComplete.pl: The Haste skill allows you to increase your attack speed and decrease your casting time, or that of a friend's, by a very large amount. It is an amazing skill!
dialogsComplete.ru: The Haste skill allows you to increase your attack speed and decrease your casting time, or that of a friend's, by a very large amount. It is an amazing skill!
dialogsComplete.sp: La habilidad Prisa aumentará tu velocidad de ataque y de lanzamiento, o la de un amigo, y no poco. ¡Es una habilidad asombrosa!
dialogsComplete.sw: The Haste skill allows you to increase your attack speed and decrease your casting time, or that of a friend's, by a very large amount. It is an amazing skill!
dialogsComplete.th: สกิล Haste ช่วยให้คุณเพิ่มความเร็วในการโจมตี และลดเวลาในการร่าย หรือของเพื่อนได้เป็นจำนวนมาก เป็นทักษะที่น่าทึ่งมาก!
dialogsComplete.tw: 風精的祝福這個技能可以讓你提高攻擊速度並大大減少施法時間，或者朋友的施法時間。這是一項了不起的技能！
dialogsComplete.vi: Kỹ năng Haste cho phép bạn tăng tốc độ tấn công rất lớn và giảm thời gian thi triển kỹ năng đáng kể của bạn hoặc của đồng minh. Đó là một kỹ năng tuyệt vời!

dialogsFail.en: Excuse me? I don't believe we have anything to discuss. Please leave me in peace.
dialogsFail.ar: Excuse me? I don't believe we have anything to discuss. Please leave me in peace.
dialogsFail.br: Com licença? Acho que não temos nada para discutir. Por favor, deixe-me em paz.

dialogsFail.kr: 누구시죠? 당신과는 별로 할 얘기가 없을 것 같은데. 말 걸지 말아 주세요.

dialogsFail.pl: Excuse me? I don't believe we have anything to discuss. Please leave me in peace.
dialogsFail.ru: Excuse me? I don't believe we have anything to discuss. Please leave me in peace.
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Perdona? No creo que tengamos nada de lo que hablar. Por favor déjame en paz.
dialogsFail.sw: Excuse me? I don't believe we have anything to discuss. Please leave me in peace.
dialogsFail.th: ขอโทษนะ? ฉันไม่เชื่อว่าเรามีอะไรต้องคุยกัน โปรดปล่อยให้ฉันอยู่ในความสงบ
dialogsFail.tw: 打擾一下？我不相信我們有什麼要討論的。請讓我安靜。
dialogsFail.vi: Xin phép tôi hỏi? Tôi không tin rằng chúng ta có bất cứ điều gì để thảo luận. Hãy để tôi được yên.

dialogsBegin.en: To be honest, it disappeared a long time ago. It corroded because it was made of bone.
dialogsBegin.ar: To be honest, it disappeared a long time ago. It corroded because it was made of bone.
dialogsBegin.br: Na verdade, ela desapareceu há muito tempo. Ela se desgastou pois era feita de osso.
dialogsBegin.cns: 说实话，真正的情盆已经不存在了，毕竟它是用骨头做的，所以早已经腐烂了。
dialogsBegin.de: Um ehrlich zu sein, verschand es schon vor langer Zeit. Es hat sich zersetzt und war nur noch Knochen. Trotz des Fluches.
dialogsBegin.fi: To be honest, it disappeared a long time ago. It corroded because it was made of bone.
dialogsBegin.fil: To be honest, it disappeared a long time ago. It corroded because it was made of bone.
dialogsBegin.fr: Pour être honnête, ce bol a vraiment disparu il y a très longtemps, il s'est comme. désagrégé.
dialogsBegin.id: Sejujurnya, itu sudah menghilang sangat lama. itu mulai lapuk karena terbuat dari tulang.
dialogsBegin.it: To be honest, it disappeared a long time ago. It corroded because it was made of bone.
dialogsBegin.jp: 実は本物のボーンボールはもうないんだよ。呪いがかけられているっていっても、やはり骨は骨だしね。それに大昔のことだから、骨もろとも、とっくに崩れてしまったはずさ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 사실, 본보울은 오래전에 사라졌어요. 뼈로 만들어져 있다 보니, 부식돼버렸죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: To be honest, it disappeared a long time ago. It corroded because it was made of bone.
dialogsBegin.pl: To be honest, it disappeared a long time ago. It corroded because it was made of bone.
dialogsBegin.ru: Открою тебе страшную правду. Миски-то… уж и в помине нет - сгнила. Она ведь из кости была вырезана.
dialogsBegin.sp: Para ser honesto, desapareció hace mucho tiempo. Se corroyó porque estaba hecho de hueso.
dialogsBegin.sw: To be honest, it disappeared a long time ago. It corroded because it was made of bone.
dialogsBegin.th: ความจริงก็คือ มันหายไปนานแล้ว มันสึกกร่อนเพราะมันทำจากกระดูก
dialogsBegin.tw: 說實話，真正的情盆已經不存在了，畢竟它是用骨頭做的，所以早已經腐爛了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Thành thật mà nói, nó đã biến mất từ ​​lâu lắm rồi. Nó bị ăn mòn bởi vì nó được làm bằng xương.

dialogsBegin.en: That is why I asked you to bring me these materials. These are the materials that the black magician used to place the curse on the Bone Bowl in the first place.
dialogsBegin.ar: That is why I asked you to bring me these materials. These are the materials that the black magician used to place the curse on the Bone Bowl in the first place.
dialogsBegin.br: Por isso pedi para você me trazer os materiais. Estes são os materiais que o mago usou para amaldiçoar a Tigela de Osso em primeiro lugar.
dialogsBegin.cns: 所以我才请你找这些东西给我的，当时黑暗魔导士，就是使用这些东西给骨制御碗下诅咒的。
dialogsBegin.de: Deswegen bat ich dich, mir diese Materialien zu bringen. Damit hat der schwarze Magier den Bone Bowl verflucht.
dialogsBegin.fi: That is why I asked you to bring me these materials. These are the materials that the black magician used to place the curse on the Bone Bowl in the first place.
dialogsBegin.fil: That is why I asked you to bring me these materials. These are the materials that the black magician used to place the curse on the Bone Bowl in the first place.
dialogsBegin.fr: C'est pour cela que je t'ai demandé de m'amener ces objets. Ce sont ceux dont s'est servi le magicien pour sa malédiction.
dialogsBegin.id: Maka dari itu kenapa aku memintamu untuk membawakan bahan - bahan ini. Ini adalah bahan yang digunakan black magician untuk menempatkan kutukan pada Bone Bowl di tempat pertama.
dialogsBegin.it: That is why I asked you to bring me these materials. These are the materials that the black magician used to place the curse on the Bone Bowl in the first place.
dialogsBegin.jp: だからこの3つの材料を集めてくるように指示したのさ。これらはブラックマジシャンがボーンボールに呪いをかける時に使った材料だといわれているんだ。材料さえあれば、ボーンボールは作れる。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 재료들을 가져와 달라고 부탁한 이유이기도 해요. 이건 원래 블랙 매지션이 본보울에 저주를 걸 때 썼던 재료들이거든요.
dialogsBegin.nl: That is why I asked you to bring me these materials. These are the materials that the black magician used to place the curse on the Bone Bowl in the first place.
dialogsBegin.pl: That is why I asked you to bring me these materials. These are the materials that the black magician used to place the curse on the Bone Bowl in the first place.
dialogsBegin.ru: Зато с помощью этих материалов я смогу наложить Страшное Проклятье на обычную костяную миску. Свин не заметит разницы.
dialogsBegin.sp: Por eso te pedí que me trajeras estos materiales. Estos son los materiales que usó la maga negra para colocar la maldición en el Cuenco de Hueso.
dialogsBegin.sw: That is why I asked you to bring me these materials. These are the materials that the black magician used to place the curse on the Bone Bowl in the first place.
dialogsBegin.th: นั่นคือเหตุผลที่ฉันขอให้คุณนำวัตถุดิบบางอย่างมาให้ฉัน นี่เป็นวัตถุดิบที่นักเวทย์มนตร์ดำใช้ในการทำคำสาปแช่งบน Bone Bowl ในตอนแรก
dialogsBegin.tw: 所以我才請你找這些東西給我的，當時黑暗魔法師，就是使用這些東西下詛咒的。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đó là lý do tại sao tôi yêu cầu bạn mang cho tôi những nguyên liệu này. Đây là những nguyên liệu mà hắc đạo sư dùng để đặt lời nguyền lên Bone Bowl ngay từ đầu.

dialogsBegin.en: I do not have the power to curse it as strongly as the black magician did. I can certainly curse it as much as any collector could!
dialogsBegin.ar: I do not have the power to curse it as strongly as the black magician did. I can certainly curse it as much as any collector could!
dialogsBegin.br: Eu não tenho o poder para amaldiçoar a tigela tão fortemente como o mago negro, mas posso amaldiçoá-la da mesma maneira que qualquer colecionador poderia!
dialogsBegin.cns: 虽然没有黑暗魔导士那么强大的诅咒，但是至少会使那个搜藏家感到有诅咒的感觉。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich habe nicht die Kraft ihn so zu verfluchen wie der schwarze Magier es tat, aber ich könnte ihn so sehr verfluchen wie es der seltsame Sammler könnte.
dialogsBegin.fi: I do not have the power to curse it as strongly as the black magician did. I can certainly curse it as much as any collector could!
dialogsBegin.fil: I do not have the power to curse it as strongly as the black magician did. I can certainly curse it as much as any collector could!
dialogsBegin.fr: Je n'ai pas le pouvoir de l'ensorceler comme l'avait fait le magicien noir, mais je peux sûrement le faire mieux que n'importe quel collectionneur. Ha ha
dialogsBegin.id: Saya tidak memiliki kekuatan untuk mengutuknya sekuat balck magician itu. Saya pasti bisa mengutuknya sebanyak kolektor mana pun!
dialogsBegin.it: I do not have the power to curse it as strongly as the black magician did. I can certainly curse it as much as any collector could!
dialogsBegin.jp: もちろん俺は大昔のブラックマジシャンほど魔力を持ってないから、当時のボーンボールほどの強力な呪いはかけられない。でも、あのコレクターが感じられる程度の呪いなら、俺にもかけることができるさ。ハハハ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 제가 블랙 매지션만큼 강한 저주를 걸 수는 없겠지만, 수집가 수준 정도의 저주는 충분히 걸 수 있답니다!
dialogsBegin.nl: I do not have the power to curse it as strongly as the black magician did. I can certainly curse it as much as any collector could!
dialogsBegin.pl: I do not have the power to curse it as strongly as the black magician did. I can certainly curse it as much as any collector could!
dialogsBegin.ru: Конечно, оно будет и вполовину не такое Страшное, как у ведьмы, но для продавца мисок вполне достойное!
dialogsBegin.sp: No tengo el poder de maldecirlo con tanta fuerza como lo hizo la maga negra. ¡Solo puedo maldecirlo como cualquier otro coleccionista!
dialogsBegin.sw: I do not have the power to curse it as strongly as the black magician did. I can certainly curse it as much as any collector could!
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันไม่มีอำนาจที่จะสาปมันได้อย่างที่นักเวทย์มนตร์ดำทำ ฉันสามารถสาปได้มากพอๆกับที่คนอื่นทำได้!
dialogsBegin.tw: 雖然沒有黑暗魔法師那麼強大的詛咒，但是至少會使那個蒐藏家感到有詛咒的感覺。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi không có khả năng nguyền rủa nó mạnh mẽ như hắc đạo sư đã làm. Tôi chắc chắn có thể nguyền rủa nó nhiều như bất kỳ nhà sưu tập nào có thể!

dialogsAccept.nl: The Strange Collector will be very happy. Just don't tell him I had to make another one. Hahaha!
dialogsAccept.pl: The Strange Collector will be very happy. Just don't tell him I had to make another one. Hahaha!
dialogsAccept.ru: Свин будет хрюкать от радости. Главное, не проболтайся, что это не Миска, а обычная миска! Ха-ха-ха!
dialogsAccept.sp: El Coleccionista Extraño estará muy feliz. No le digas que tuve que hacer otro. ¡Jajaja!
dialogsAccept.sw: The Strange Collector will be very happy. Just don't tell him I had to make another one. Hahaha!
dialogsAccept.th: Strange Collector จะมีความสุขมาก แต่อย่าบอกเขาล่ะว่าฉันทำขึ้นมาอีกอัน ฮ่าฮ่าฮ่า!

dialogsComplete.en: You got it?! Amazing! Look at the craftsmanship! And it's do well preserved! It's as if it was made today!
dialogsComplete.ar: You got it?! Amazing! Look at the craftsmanship! And it's do well preserved! It's as if it was made today!
dialogsComplete.br: Você conseguiu?! Incrível! Olhe para o artesanato! E está tão bem preservada! É como se tivesse sido feita hoje!
dialogsComplete.cns: 啊..终于帮我找到了，真是太美丽了..谢谢你!!
dialogsComplete.de: Oh.. (weint) Du hast es endlich gefunden. Ohm oh.. Ich kann dir nicht sagen wie wunderschön er ist.. Oh... Wunderschön..
dialogsComplete.fi: You got it?! Amazing! Look at the craftsmanship! And it's do well preserved! It's as if it was made today!
dialogsComplete.fil: You got it?! Amazing! Look at the craftsmanship! And it's do well preserved! It's as if it was made today!
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh.(Pleurant) Tu l'as finalement retrouvé... Je. Je ne trouve pas les mots pour décrire sa beauté. Quelle splendeur.
dialogsComplete.id: kamu mengerti?! Luar biasa! Lihatlah keahliannya! Dan itu terpelihara dengan baik! Seolah-olah itu dibuat hari ini!
dialogsComplete.it: You got it?! Amazing! Look at the craftsmanship! And it's do well preserved! It's as if it was made today!
dialogsComplete.jp: あっ！それはまさしく、本物のボーンボール！やっと見つけてきてくれたんだね。おお、なんとも言えないほど綺麗な器だ。美しい！
dialogsComplete.kr: 정말 구하셨군요?! 놀라워요! 이 정교한 조각 좀 보세요! 보존 상태도 완벽하네요! 마치 오늘 만든 것 같아요!
dialogsComplete.nl: You got it?! Amazing! Look at the craftsmanship! And it's do well preserved! It's as if it was made today!
dialogsComplete.pl: You got it?! Amazing! Look at the craftsmanship! And it's do well preserved! It's as if it was made today!
dialogsComplete.ru: Ух ты! Какая искусная работа! Какое Страшное Проклятье! И как хорошо она сохранилась... Словно сегодня сделали!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡¿Lo has conseguido?! ¡Increíble! ¡Mira la artesanía! ¡Y está bien conservado! ¡Es como si se hubiera hecho hoy!
dialogsComplete.sw: You got it?! Amazing! Look at the craftsmanship! And it's do well preserved! It's as if it was made today!
dialogsComplete.th: คุณหามาได้หรือไม่! น่าทึ่งจริงๆ! ดูงานฝีมือชิ้นนี้สิ! และมันก็จะได้รับการเก็บรักษาไว้เป็นอย่างดี! มันดูราวกับว่ามันเพิ่งถูกสร้างขึ้นในวันนี้เลยนะ!
dialogsComplete.tw: 啊…終於幫我找到了，真是太美麗了…謝謝你！！
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn hiểu chưa?! Thật đáng kinh ngạc! Nhìn vào tay nghề thủ công này! Nó được bảo quản tốt! Nó như thể vừa được tạo ra ngày hôm nay!

dialogsFail.tw: 你還沒有？那麼，你還等什麼呢？快去！
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn chưa có nó? À, bạn đang đợi gì vậy? Đi nào!

description.en: Speak with High-Dwarpet Langdrong. He can be found with the other High-Dwarpets north of Flarine.
description.ar: Speak with High-Dwarpet Langdrong. He can be found with the other High-Dwarpets north of Flarine.
description.br: Por favor, vá encontrar Langdrong no local dos Altos Dwarpets.
description.cns: 到高阶矮人族的居住地找到克罗
description.de: Sprich mit [High-Dwarpet] Langdrong. Du findest ihn, zusammen mit den anderen High-Dwarpets, nordöstlich von Flaris.
description.fi: Speak with High-Dwarpet Langdrong. He can be found with the other High-Dwarpets north of Flarine.
description.fil: Speak with High-Dwarpet Langdrong. He can be found with the other High-Dwarpets north of Flarine.
description.fr: Aller voir le Grand Dwarpet Langdrong au Territoire des Grands Dwarpets.
description.id: Bicaralah dengan High-Dwarpet Langdrong. Dia dapat ditemukan dengan High-Dwarpets lainnya di utara Flarine.
description.it: Speak with High-Dwarpet Langdrong. He can be found with the other High-Dwarpets north of Flarine.
description.jp: フラリス北ハイドワーフの生息地にいる＜ランドラング＞のところへ行こう！
description.kr: 하이-드워펫 랭드롱과 대화하세요. 랭드롱은 플라리네 북부의 다른 하이-드워펫들과 살고 있습니다.
description.nl: Speak with High-Dwarpet Langdrong. He can be found with the other High-Dwarpets north of Flarine.
description.pl: Speak with High-Dwarpet Langdrong. He can be found with the other High-Dwarpets north of Flarine.
description.ru: Нужно поговорить с высоким карликом Лангдронгом. Он живет где-то на севере от Фларинции.
description.sp: Habla con el Alto-Enano Langdrong. Está con los otros Alto-Enanos al norte desde Flarine.
description.sw: Speak with High-Dwarpet Langdrong. He can be found with the other High-Dwarpets north of Flarine.
description.th: พูดคุยกับ Langdrong High-Dwarpet สามารถพบเขาและ High-Dwarpets คนอื่นๆ ทางตอนเหนือของเมือง Flarine
description.tw: 到海倚杜爾沛的居住地找克羅之前，請到納洛江找一個技能序章，這樣他才會見你。
description.vi: Nói chuyện với High-Dwarpet Langdrong. Anh ta có thể được tìm thấy cùng với những High-Dwarpets khác ở phía bắc Flarine.

dialogsBegin.en: You've done very well so far, Vagrant. You are ready for the next step in your journey to become a Mercenary!
dialogsBegin.ar: You've done very well so far, Vagrant. You are ready for the next step in your journey to become a Mercenary!
dialogsBegin.br: Você fez um ótimo trabalho em seu 2° teste. Mas ainda há outros testes em que você deve passar para se tornar um Mercenário.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你已经通过了第2项测试，但是这还不算完成。要成为真正的战士，需要很多的情报。
dialogsBegin.de: Du schlägst dich soweit gut, Vagrant. Ich denke, du bist bereit für den  nächsten Schritt auf deinem Pfad zum Mercenary!
dialogsBegin.fi: You've done very well so far, Vagrant. You are ready for the next step in your journey to become a Mercenary!
dialogsBegin.fil: You've done very well so far, Vagrant. You are ready for the next step in your journey to become a Mercenary!
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu sembles avoir bien compris comment utiliser les armes, et je n'ai plus rien à t'enseigner désormais.
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu telah melakukannya dengan sangat baik sejauh ini, Vagrant. Kamu siap untuk langkah selanjutnya dalam perjalananmu untuk menjadi Mercenary!
dialogsBegin.it: You've done very well so far, Vagrant. You are ready for the next step in your journey to become a Mercenary!
dialogsBegin.jp: 2番目のテストも見事にパスしたか、おめでとう。まだテストが終わったわけではないぞ。マーシナリーを完全理解するには、まだまだたくさんの知識を必要とするぞ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 아주 잘하셨어요. 머서너리가 되기 위한 다음 단계를 밟을 준비가 된 것 같네요!
dialogsBegin.nl: You've done very well so far, Vagrant. You are ready for the next step in your journey to become a Mercenary!
dialogsBegin.pl: You've done very well so far, Vagrant. You are ready for the next step in your journey to become a Mercenary!
dialogsBegin.ru: Неплохо справляешься, бродяга. Пора переходить к следующему этапу Пути!
dialogsBegin.sp: Lo has hecho muy bien hasta ahora, Vagrant. ¡Estas listo para el siguiente paso para convertirte en Mercenary!
dialogsBegin.sw: You've done very well so far, Vagrant. You are ready for the next step in your journey to become a Mercenary!
dialogsBegin.th: คุณทำได้ดีมากแล้วล่ะ Vagrant คุณพร้อมแล้วที่จะไปสู่ขั้นต่อไปของการเป็น Mercenary!
dialogsBegin.tw: 你已經通過了第 2 項測試，但是這還不算完成。要成為真正的勇者，需要很多的情報。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn đã làm rất tốt, Vagrant. Bạn đã sẵn sàng cho bước tiếp theo trong hành trình trở thành Mercenary!

dialogsBegin.en: You must travel north, and visit the High-Dwarpets. Langdrong, one of the High-Dwarpets, will continue your training.
dialogsBegin.ar: You must travel north, and visit the High-Dwarpets. Langdrong, one of the High-Dwarpets, will continue your training.
dialogsBegin.br: Você deve viajar para o norte e visitar os Altos Dwarpets. Langdrong, um dos Alto Dwarpets, continuará seu treinamento.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我要告诉你的事情，已经讲完了。下一个考验是，你要学习关于战士的技术。你要去高阶矮人族的居住地。
dialogsBegin.de: Du musst nach Norden reisen und die High-Dwarpet besuchen. Langdrong, einer der High-Dwarpet, wird deine Ausbildung fortsetzen.
dialogsBegin.fi: You must travel north, and visit the High-Dwarpets. Langdrong, one of the High-Dwarpets, will continue your training.
dialogsBegin.fil: You must travel north, and visit the High-Dwarpets. Langdrong, one of the High-Dwarpets, will continue your training.
dialogsBegin.fr: Maintenant voici la prochaine étape : tu dois rassembler des informations sur les compétences du Mercenaire.
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu harus melakukan perjalanan ke utara, dan mengunjungi High-Dwarpets. Langdrong, salah satu High-Dwarpets, akan melanjutkan latihanmu.
dialogsBegin.it: You must travel north, and visit the High-Dwarpets. Langdrong, one of the High-Dwarpets, will continue your training.
dialogsBegin.jp: まあ、私から教えるべきことはここまでだ。次のテストは、マーシナリーの技術に関する情報を集めてきてこい。北へ行き、ハイドワーフの生息地へ足を踏み入れてみるといいだろう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 북쪽으로 가서 하이-드워펫들을 찾아가세요. 하이-드워펫 중에서 랭드롱을 찾으면 훈련을 도와줄 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: You must travel north, and visit the High-Dwarpets. Langdrong, one of the High-Dwarpets, will continue your training.
dialogsBegin.pl: You must travel north, and visit the High-Dwarpets. Langdrong, one of the High-Dwarpets, will continue your training.
dialogsBegin.ru: You must travel north, and visit the High-Dwarpets. Langdrong, one of the High-Dwarpets, will continue your training.
dialogsBegin.sp: Deberás viajar al norte, para visitar a los Alto-Enanos. Langdrong, uno de los Alto-Enanos, continuará tu entrenamiento.
dialogsBegin.sw: You must travel north, and visit the High-Dwarpets. Langdrong, one of the High-Dwarpets, will continue your training.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณต้องเดินทางไปทางเหนือและไปหา High-Dwarpets Langdrong หนึ่งใน High-Dwarpets จะฝึกคุณต่อไป
dialogsBegin.tw: 你必須向北旅行，拜訪海倚杜爾沛人。朗仲，海倚杜爾沛人之一，會繼續你的訓練。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn phải đi về phía bắc, và đến thăm High-Dwarpets. Langdrong, một trong những High-Dwarpets, sẽ tiếp tục quá trình huấn luyện của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: High-Dwarpet Langdrong will educate you on Mercenary skills.
dialogsBegin.ar: High-Dwarpet Langdrong will educate you on Mercenary skills.
dialogsBegin.br: Langdrong lhe contará coisas a respeito das habilidades dos Mercenários. Ah, antes de visitá-lo...
dialogsBegin.cns: 到高阶矮人族的居住地，找一个叫做克罗的高阶矮人族，他会告诉你一些技术的相关知识。在那之前..
dialogsBegin.de: [High-Dwarpet] Langdrong wird dir die Fähigkeiten der Mercenary lehren.
dialogsBegin.fi: High-Dwarpet Langdrong will educate you on Mercenary skills.
dialogsBegin.fil: High-Dwarpet Langdrong will educate you on Mercenary skills.
dialogsBegin.fr: Pour cela, trouve le Grand Dwarpet Langdrong et demande-lui de t'apprendre les compétences du Mercenaire.
dialogsBegin.id: High-Dwarpet Langdrong akan mengajarimu tentang skill Mercenary.
dialogsBegin.it: High-Dwarpet Langdrong will educate you on Mercenary skills.
dialogsBegin.jp: ハイドワーフの生息地を探して＜ランドラング＞というハイドワーフに会い、マーシナリーの技術について教えてもらえるだろう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 하이-드워펫 랭드롱이 머서너리 스킬을 잘 설명해 줄 겁니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: High-Dwarpet Langdrong will educate you on Mercenary skills.
dialogsBegin.pl: High-Dwarpet Langdrong will educate you on Mercenary skills.
dialogsBegin.ru: Он расскажет тебе о борцовских умениях.
dialogsBegin.sp: El Alto-Enano Langdrong te educará en la habilidades de Mercenary.
dialogsBegin.sw: High-Dwarpet Langdrong will educate you on Mercenary skills.
dialogsBegin.th: High-Dwarpet Langdrong จะให้ความรู้แก่คุณเกี่ยวกับทักษะของ Mercenary
dialogsBegin.tw: 到海倚杜爾沛的居住地，找一個叫做克羅的海倚杜爾沛，他會告訴你一些技術的相關知識。在那之前…
dialogsBegin.vi: High-Dwarpet Langdrong sẽ hướng dẫn bạn những kỹ năng của Mercenary.

dialogsBegin.en: You can find the High-Dwarpets north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you get lost.
dialogsBegin.ar: You can find the High-Dwarpets north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you get lost.
dialogsBegin.br: Você pode marcar o local dos Alto Dwarpets com a tecla de atalho M. É realmente útil marcar a localização de algum lugar.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你可以在高阶矮人族的居住地找克罗。
dialogsBegin.de: Du findest [High-Dwarpet] Langdrong nordöstlich von Flaris. Schau auf deine Karte (Taste: M), falls du dich verirrst.
dialogsBegin.fi: You can find the High-Dwarpets north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you get lost.
dialogsBegin.fil: You can find the High-Dwarpets north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you get lost.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il vit dans le Territoire des Grands Dwarpets près des montagnes centrales de Leren.
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu dapat menemukan High-Dwarpets di utara Flarine. Periksa petamu (Tombol M) jika kamu tersesat.
dialogsBegin.it: You can find the High-Dwarpets north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you get lost.
dialogsBegin.jp: おっと。ハイドワーフは人間を嫌っているが、君には心を開いてくれるといいな。フラリス道沿いに北を進んだ＜ランドラング＞だ。Mキーでマップを確認してくれよな。
dialogsBegin.kr: 하이-드워펫들은 플라리네 북부에 있어요. 길을 잃게 되면 지도(M키)를 참고하세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: You can find the High-Dwarpets north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you get lost.
dialogsBegin.pl: You can find the High-Dwarpets north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you get lost.
dialogsBegin.ru: Ищи высоких карликов севернее Фларинции. Если потеряешься, сверься с картой ("M"). Договорились?
dialogsBegin.sp: Puedes encontrar al Alto-Enano al norte desde Flarine. Revisa tu mapa (Tecla M) si te pierdes.
dialogsBegin.sw: You can find the High-Dwarpets north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you get lost.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณสามารถหา High-Dwarpets ได้ที่ทางตอนเหนือของ Flarine ตรวจสอบแผนที่ของคุณ (ปุ่ม M) หากคุณหลงทาง
dialogsBegin.tw: 到海倚杜爾沛的居住地找克羅之前，請到納洛江找一個技能序章，這樣他才會見你。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có thể tìm thấy High-Dwarpets ở phía bắc Flarine. Kiểm tra bản đồ của bạn (Phím M) nếu bạn bị lạc.

dialogsAccept.en: I sense great potential in you, Vagrant. Luck be with you.
dialogsAccept.ar: I sense great potential in you, Vagrant. Luck be with you.
dialogsAccept.br: Rhisis lhe abençoe.
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你一路顺风
dialogsAccept.de: Ich sehe großes Potenzial in dir, Vagrant. Viel Glück.
dialogsAccept.fi: I sense great potential in you, Vagrant. Luck be with you.
dialogsAccept.fil: I sense great potential in you, Vagrant. Luck be with you.
dialogsAccept.fr: Que les Héros de Madrigal te protègent !
dialogsAccept.id: Aku merasakan potensi besar dalam dirimu, Vagrant. Keberuntungan bersamamu.
dialogsAccept.it: I sense great potential in you, Vagrant. Luck be with you.
dialogsAccept.jp: どうか無事に生息地を探し出せるよう、頑張ってください。幸運を祈りますよ！
dialogsAccept.kr: 당신에게서 엄청난 잠재력이 느껴져요. 행운을 빌어요.
dialogsAccept.nl: I sense great potential in you, Vagrant. Luck be with you.
dialogsAccept.pl: I sense great potential in you, Vagrant. Luck be with you.
dialogsAccept.ru: Я чувствую в тебе неплохой потенциал, бродяга. Удачи!
dialogsAccept.sp: Siento un gran potencial en ti, Vagrant. Suerte.
dialogsAccept.sw: I sense great potential in you, Vagrant. Luck be with you.
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันรู้สึกถึงศักยภาพที่ดีในตัวคุณ Vagrant ขอให้คุณโชคดี
dialogsAccept.tw: 見習者，我可以感覺到你的潛力無窮，好運與你同在。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi cảm nhận được tiềm năng to lớn trong bạn, Vagrant. Chúc bạn may mắn.

dialogsDecline.en: What a shame. Please see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ar: What a shame. Please see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.br: Você não pode desistir agora. Não faz sentido desistir neste momento, assim tão de repente.
dialogsDecline.cns: 要在这里放弃吗?都快结束了还要放弃，不绝得很可惜吗?
dialogsDecline.de: Welch Schande. Bitte komm zurück, falls du deine Meinung änderst.
dialogsDecline.fi: What a shame. Please see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fil: What a shame. Please see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu ne peux pas abandonner maintenant. Ça n'a aucun sens d'abandonner comme ça si soudainement.
dialogsDecline.id: Sayang sekali. Cobalah temui aku lagi jika kamu berubah pikiran.
dialogsDecline.it: What a shame. Please see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.jp: ここで諦めてしまうのは、非常にもったいないですね。まあ、あなたが選んだことならいたしかたないでしょう。
dialogsDecline.kr: 어쩔 수 없죠. 마음이 바뀌면 다시 오세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: What a shame. Please see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.pl: What a shame. Please see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ru: Стыдоба. Если передумаешь, приходи.
dialogsDecline.sp: Que pena. Ven a verme si cambias de opinión.
dialogsDecline.sw: What a shame. Please see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.th: ช่างน่าอับอายนัก โปรดมาพบฉันอีกครั้งถ้าคุณเปลี่ยนใจ
dialogsDecline.tw: 要在這裡放棄嗎？都快結束了還要放棄，不絕得很可惜嗎？
dialogsDecline.vi: Thật hổ thẹn. Vui lòng gặp lại tôi nếu bạn thay đổi quyết định.

dialogsComplete.en: Where did you find that, Vagrant? Tell you what, for bringing this to me, I will go over one of the Mercenary Skills it details here. Listen up!
dialogsComplete.ar: Where did you find that, Vagrant? Tell you what, for bringing this to me, I will go over one of the Mercenary Skills it details here. Listen up!
dialogsComplete.br: Oh! Este é o livro que perdi há muito tempo! Onde você encontrou isso, Vagrant?! Eu vou lhe dizer algo ótimo como recompensa. Vou repassar uma das Habilidades de Mercenário que detalha aqui. Veja só!
dialogsComplete.cns: 初心者，你在哪找到它的？告诉你吧，有了你带来的这个东西，我要在这给你讲一下战士的详细技能。听好了！
dialogsComplete.de: Wo hast du das gefunden, Vagrant? Ich sag dir was. Ich zeige dir die Mercenary Fähigkeiten aus diesem Buch. Hör gut zu!
dialogsComplete.fi: Where did you find that, Vagrant? Tell you what, for bringing this to me, I will go over one of the Mercenary Skills it details here. Listen up!
dialogsComplete.fil: Where did you find that, Vagrant? Tell you what, for bringing this to me, I will go over one of the Mercenary Skills it details here. Listen up!
dialogsComplete.fr: Mmmm. tu as du potentiel. Il faut que tu t'entraînes vite, et bien ! Je vais commencer par t'apprendre une de mes techniques.
dialogsComplete.id: Di mana kamu menemukannya, Vagrant? Katakan apa, untuk membawa ini kepadaku, aku akan membahas salah satu Mercenary Skills yang dijelaskan disini. Dengarkan!
dialogsComplete.it: Where did you find that, Vagrant? Tell you what, for bringing this to me, I will go over one of the Mercenary Skills it details here. Listen up!
dialogsComplete.jp: ん？人間か？私は人間は嫌いだが、お前と話すのは悪い気はしないな。よし、いいことを教えてあげよう。えぇと･･このスキル事典の･･･328ページの・・・あ！これだ。よく聞くんだぞ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 어디서 그걸 찾았죠, 방랑자? 이걸 가져왔으니, 그 대가로 머서너리 스킬 하나를 자세히 설명해 드리죠. 잘 들어보세요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Where did you find that, Vagrant? Tell you what, for bringing this to me, I will go over one of the Mercenary Skills it details here. Listen up!
dialogsComplete.pl: Where did you find that, Vagrant? Tell you what, for bringing this to me, I will go over one of the Mercenary Skills it details here. Listen up!
dialogsComplete.ru: Where did you find that, Vagrant? Tell you what, for bringing this to me, I will go over one of the Mercenary Skills it details here. Listen up!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿Dónde has encontrado eso, Vagrant? Te diré algo, por traerme esto, te enseñaré una de las habilidades de Mercenary que se detallan aquí. ¡Escucha!
dialogsComplete.sw: Where did you find that, Vagrant? Tell you what, for bringing this to me, I will go over one of the Mercenary Skills it details here. Listen up!
dialogsComplete.th: คุณพบมันที่ไหน Vagrant? เพราะคุณนำสิ่งนี้มาให้ฉัน ฉันจึงจะบอกอะไรบางอย่างกับคุณเกี่ยวกับหนึ่งใน Mercenary Skills จงตั้งใจฟัง!
dialogsComplete.tw: 你在哪裡找到的，見習生？告訴你什麼，為了給我帶來這個，我將在這裡詳細介紹其中一項勇者技能。聽著！
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn tìm thấy cái đó ở đâu, Vagrant? Nói cho bạn biết điều gì, vì đã mang cái này cho tôi, tôi sẽ xem xét chi tiết về một trong những kỹ năng của Mercenary. Nghe này!

dialogsComplete.en: As a Mercenary you can wield a weapon and a shield. The skill, Keenwheel, is a high damage spinning attack that can only be used after using the Slash skill and must be used in the Action Slot.
dialogsComplete.ar: As a Mercenary you can wield a weapon and a shield. The skill, Keenwheel, is a high damage spinning attack that can only be used after using the Slash skill and must be used in the Action Slot.
dialogsComplete.br: Como um mercenário, você pode empunhar uma arma e um escudo. A habilidade Ataque Giratório é um ataque de alto dano que só pode ser usado depois de usar a habilidade Golpear e deve ser usado no Action Slot.
dialogsComplete.cns: 作为一名战士，你可以挥舞武器进行攻击。切裂之风轮是一个高额转动伤害的技能，而且只能放在连续技能栏中，在结束逆手之回旋后使用。
dialogsComplete.de: Als Mercenary kannst du eine Waffe und einen Schild führen. Die Fähigkeit Keenwheel ist ein Wirbelangriff mit hohem Schaden. Er kann nur nach dem Einsatz der Fähigkeit Slash verwendet durch den Action Slot eingesetzt werden.
dialogsComplete.fi: As a Mercenary you can wield a weapon and a shield. The skill, Keenwheel, is a high damage spinning attack that can only be used after using the Slash skill and must be used in the Action Slot.
dialogsComplete.fil: As a Mercenary you can wield a weapon and a shield. The skill, Keenwheel, is a high damage spinning attack that can only be used after using the Slash skill and must be used in the Action Slot.
dialogsComplete.fr: Prend bien appui sur le sol, et tourne sur toi-même avec ton arme dans les deux mains. Cette attaque rotative nommé Frénésie infligera beaucoup plus de dégâts qu'une attaque classique.
dialogsComplete.id: Sebagai Mercenary kamu dapat menggunakan senjata dan perisai. Skill Keenwheel merupakan serangan berputar dengan damage tinggi yang hanya bisa digunakan setelah menggunakan skill Slash dan harus digunakan di Action Slot.
dialogsComplete.it: As a Mercenary you can wield a weapon and a shield. The skill, Keenwheel, is a high damage spinning attack that can only be used after using the Slash skill and must be used in the Action Slot.
dialogsComplete.jp: まず両足を軸にして、両手に武器を握って体を回転させる。この回転力で相手に普通よりたくさんの打撃を与えることができる。これが何かわかるか？これは、キーンフィールというスキルだ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 머서너리는 무기와 방패를 사용할 수 있습니다. 킨휠은 슬래시 스킬 후에만 사용할 수 있는 강력한 회전 공격으로, 액션 슬롯에서만 사용할 수 있습니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: As a Mercenary you can wield a weapon and a shield. The skill, Keenwheel, is a high damage spinning attack that can only be used after using the Slash skill and must be used in the Action Slot.
dialogsComplete.pl: As a Mercenary you can wield a weapon and a shield. The skill, Keenwheel, is a high damage spinning attack that can only be used after using the Slash skill and must be used in the Action Slot.
dialogsComplete.ru: As a Mercenary you can wield a weapon and a shield. The skill, Keenwheel, is a high damage spinning attack that can only be used after using the Slash skill and must be used in the Action Slot.
dialogsComplete.sp: Como Mercenary, puedes empuñar un arma y un escudo. La habilidad, Giro Afilado, es un ataque giratorio de alto daño que solo se puede usar después de usar la habilidad Cuchillada y debe usarse en la Barra de Combo.
dialogsComplete.sw: As a Mercenary you can wield a weapon and a shield. The skill, Keenwheel, is a high damage spinning attack that can only be used after using the Slash skill and must be used in the Action Slot.
dialogsComplete.th: ในฐานะ Mercenary คุณสามารถใช้อาวุธได้สองชุดพร้อมกัน สกิล Keenwheel เป็นความเสียหายที่เกิดจากการปั่นมีพลังโจมตีสูง สามารถใช้งานได้หลังจากใช้สกิล Slash และต้องใช้ใน Action Slot
dialogsComplete.tw: 作為一名勇者，你可以使用武器和盾牌。技能旋風斬是一種高傷害的旋轉攻擊，只能在使用月牙斬技能後使用，並且必須在動作欄位中使用。
dialogsComplete.vi: Là một Mercenary, bạn có thể sử dụng vũ khí và khiên. Kỹ năng, Keenwheel, là một đòn tấn công xoay tròn có sát thương cao, chỉ có thể được sử dụng sau khi sử dụng kỹ năng Slash và phải được sử dụng trong Action Slot.

dialogsComplete.en: Keenwheel is another example. Notice how the skills in the Skill Tree Window (K Key) are shaped like puzzle pieces? This is a good indicator of what skills can be used in what order.
dialogsComplete.ar: Keenwheel is another example. Notice how the skills in the Skill Tree Window (K Key) are shaped like puzzle pieces? This is a good indicator of what skills can be used in what order.
dialogsComplete.br: Dilacerar é outro exemplo. Observe como as habilidades na Janela da Árvore de Habilidades (Tecla K) têm formas de peças de quebra-cabeça? Este é um bom indicador de quais habilidades podem ser usadas em que ordem.
dialogsComplete.cns: 切裂之风轮是另外一个例子。请注意技能栏窗口（K键）是怎么像拼图一样排列的，这是一个很好的指引，表明什么技能可以按什么顺序使用。
dialogsComplete.de: Keenwheel ist ein weiteres Beispiel. Hast du bemerkt, dass die Fähigkeiten im Fähigkeitenfenster (Taste: K) wie Puzzleteile geformt sind? Dieser Indikator zeigt dir, in welcher Reihenfolge die Fähigkeiten verwendet werden können.
dialogsComplete.fi: Keenwheel is another example. Notice how the skills in the Skill Tree Window (K Key) are shaped like puzzle pieces? This is a good indicator of what skills can be used in what order.
dialogsComplete.fil: Keenwheel is another example. Notice how the skills in the Skill Tree Window (K Key) are shaped like puzzle pieces? This is a good indicator of what skills can be used in what order.
dialogsComplete.fr: Mais tu ne peux utiliser cette compétence seule, il te faut l'employer après la technique nommé Fulgurance. Tu pourras ensuite enchaîner la technique que je t'ai enseignée plusieurs fois de suite !
dialogsComplete.id: Keenwheel adalah contoh lain. Perhatikan bagaimana skill di Skill Tree Window (Tombol K) berbentuk seperti potongan puzzle? Ini adalah indikator yang baik tentang skill apa yang dapat digunakan serta urutannya.
dialogsComplete.it: Keenwheel is another example. Notice how the skills in the Skill Tree Window (K Key) are shaped like puzzle pieces? This is a good indicator of what skills can be used in what order.
dialogsComplete.jp: これはスプルマッシュと連動して使うスキルで、単独では使えない。しかし一度に3連続攻撃が可能だし、最大4回まで連続で使えるスキルなんだ。上手く使いこなせばとても強力な技だぜ！わかったかい？
dialogsComplete.kr: 또 다른 예로 킨휠이 있죠. 스킬 트리 창(K)의 스킬이 퍼즐 모양으로 되어 있는 것, 알고 계셨나요? 어떤 스킬을 어떤 순서로 사용할 수 있는지 알려준답니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Keenwheel is another example. Notice how the skills in the Skill Tree Window (K Key) are shaped like puzzle pieces? This is a good indicator of what skills can be used in what order.
dialogsComplete.pl: Keenwheel is another example. Notice how the skills in the Skill Tree Window (K Key) are shaped like puzzle pieces? This is a good indicator of what skills can be used in what order.
dialogsComplete.ru: Keenwheel is another example. Notice how the skills in the Skill Tree Window (K Key) are shaped like puzzle pieces? This is a good indicator of what skills can be used in what order.
dialogsComplete.sp: Golpe Sangriento es otro ejemplo. ¿Ves cómo las habilidades del Árbol de Habilidades (Tecla K) tienen forma de piezas de un puzzle? Este es un buen indicador de qué habilidades se pueden usar en qué orden.
dialogsComplete.sw: Keenwheel is another example. Notice how the skills in the Skill Tree Window (K Key) are shaped like puzzle pieces? This is a good indicator of what skills can be used in what order.
dialogsComplete.th: Keenwheel เป็นอีกตัวอย่างหนึ่ง สังเกตว่าทักษะในหน้าต่าง Skill Tree (ปุ่ม K ) มีรูปร่างเหมือนชิ้นส่วนปริศนาหรือไม่? นี่เป็นตัวบ่งบอกที่ดีว่าทักษะใดที่สามารถใช้ในลำดับใดได้
dialogsComplete.tw: 旋風斬是另一個例子。注意技能樹視窗 (K 鍵) 中的技能是如何像拼圖一樣成形的？這是一個很好的指標，表明可以按什麼順序使用哪些技能。
dialogsComplete.vi: Keenwheel là một ví dụ khác. Hãy để ý xem các kỹ năng trong Skill Tree Window (Phím K) có hình dạng như những mảnh ghép như thế nào? Đây là một chỉ báo tốt về những kỹ năng có thể được sử dụng theo thứ tự nào.

dialogsFail.en: If Andy sent you, then he should have given you some proof. Maybe you're forgetting something, friend?
dialogsFail.ar: If Andy sent you, then he should have given you some proof. Maybe you're forgetting something, friend?
dialogsFail.br: Foi Andy que lhe enviou? Então me mostre uma prova para que eu possa confiar em você! Bem...
dialogsFail.cns: .....你说是安迪凯叫你来的啊?拿证来!不然我怎么知道你说的事真的还是假的啊!!我现在很忙啦..我的技能序章到哪里去了呢..嗯..
dialogsFail.de: Wenn Andy dich tatsächlich geschickt hast, solltest du einen Beweis dafür bei dir haben. Hast du vielleicht etwas vergessen, mein Freund?
dialogsFail.fi: If Andy sent you, then he should have given you some proof. Maybe you're forgetting something, friend?
dialogsFail.fil: If Andy sent you, then he should have given you some proof. Maybe you're forgetting something, friend?
dialogsFail.fr: C'est Andy qui t'envoie ? Alors, qu'est-ce que tu veux ? Hein ?
dialogsFail.id: Jika Andy mengirimmu, maka dia seharusnya memberimu beberapa bukti. Mungkin kamu melupakan sesuatu, teman?
dialogsFail.it: If Andy sent you, then he should have given you some proof. Maybe you're forgetting something, friend?
dialogsFail.jp: なんだおまえは？アンディの紹介で来たと？だったら、信用できる証拠を出してみな。オレは冒険者なんかに油を売るほど暇じゃないんだよ。えーっと・・・あの＜スキル事典＞はどこに置いといたっけな・・・
dialogsFail.kr: 앤디가 당신을 보냈다면, 증거가 있어야 하지 않나요? 뭔가 잊어버린 것 아닌지?
dialogsFail.nl: If Andy sent you, then he should have given you some proof. Maybe you're forgetting something, friend?
dialogsFail.pl: If Andy sent you, then he should have given you some proof. Maybe you're forgetting something, friend?
dialogsFail.ru: Мне нужно подтверждение того, что тебя в самом деле прислал ко мне Андей. Может, что-то выпало у тебя из памяти, а?
dialogsFail.sp: Si te ha enviado Andy, debería haberte dado alguna prueba. ¿Tal vez estás olvidando algo, amigo?
dialogsFail.sw: If Andy sent you, then he should have given you some proof. Maybe you're forgetting something, friend?
dialogsFail.th: ถ้า Andy ส่งคุณไป เขาก็ควรจะให้หลักฐานแก่คุณ บางทีคุณอาจจะลืมอะไรบางอย่างนะ เพื่อน?
dialogsFail.tw: …你說是安迪凱叫你來的啊？拿證來！不然我怎麼知道你說的事真的還是假的啊！！我現在很忙啦…我的技能序章到哪裡去了呢…嗯…
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu Andy đã gửi cho bạn, thì anh ấy nên đưa cho bạn một số bằng chứng. Có lẽ bạn đang quên điều gì đó, bạn nhỉ?
