description.en: Bring your pet's experience to 99.99% and the Pet Tamer will upgrade it for you!
description.ar: Bring your pet's experience to 99.99% and the Pet Tamer will upgrade it for you!
description.br: Aumente a experiência de seu Pet até 99,99% e o domador irá promovê-lo!
description.cns: 将宠物的经验提升至 99.99%，驯宠师会为你升级！
description.de: Steigere die EXP deines Pets auf 99,99% und bringe es zurück zum Pet Tamer.
description.fi: Bring your pet's experience to 99.99% and the Pet Tamer will upgrade it for you!
description.fil: Bring your pet's experience to 99.99% and the Pet Tamer will upgrade it for you!
description.fr: Monter l'expérience de votre familier à 99,99%, puis le ramener à l’Éleveur de familiers pour qu'il le fasse évoluer.
description.id: Naikkan pet EXp sampai 99,99% dan Pet Tamer akan mengupgradenya untukmu!
description.it: Bring your pet's experience to 99.99% and the Pet Tamer will upgrade it for you!
description.jp: ペットテイマーに経験値が100％になったグレードDのペットを持って行くと、グレードCのペットにレベルアップさせてくれるそうだ。
description.kr: 펫 경험치를 99.99%까지 올리면 펫 조련사가 펫을 업그레이드해 줍니다!
description.nl: Bring your pet's experience to 99.99% and the Pet Tamer will upgrade it for you!
description.pl: Bring your pet's experience to 99.99% and the Pet Tamer will upgrade it for you!
description.ru: Bring your pet's experience to 99.99% and the Pet Tamer will upgrade it for you!
description.sp: ¡Lleva la experiencia de tu mascota al 99,99 % y el Domador de Mascotas la mejorará por ti!
description.sw: Bring your pet's experience to 99.99% and the Pet Tamer will upgrade it for you!
description.th: เพิ่มประสบการณ์สัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณเป็น 99.99% แล้ว Pet Tamer จะอัปเกรดให้คุณ
description.tw: 將寵物的經驗提升至 99.99%，馴寵師會為你升級！
description.vi: Mang điểm experience của thú cưng lên đến 99,99% và Pet Tamer sẽ nâng cấp nó cho bạn!

dialogsBegin.en: Now that you're pet has been hatched, it will increase specific character statistics (Stat Points) depending on the type of pet you have summoned. Every pet type affects a specific character statistic.
dialogsBegin.ar: Now that you're pet has been hatched, it will increase specific character statistics (Stat Points) depending on the type of pet you have summoned. Every pet type affects a specific character statistic.
dialogsBegin.br: Agora que seu pet chocou, ele aumentará as estatísticas específicas do personagem (Pontos de Atributos), dependendo do tipo de animal de estimação que você convocou. Cada tipo de pet afeta uma estatística de personagem específica.
dialogsBegin.cns: 现在你的宠物已经孵化了，它会根据你召唤的宠物类型增加特定的角色属性点（Stat Points）。每种宠物类型都会影响特定的角色属性点。
dialogsBegin.de: Jetzt, wo dein Pet endlich geschlüpft ist, wird es dich im Kampf unterstützen. Je nachdem, was für ein Pet es ist, stärkt es deine Statuswerte. Jedes Pet kann unterschiedliche Statuswerte verstärken.
dialogsBegin.fi: Now that you're pet has been hatched, it will increase specific character statistics (Stat Points) depending on the type of pet you have summoned. Every pet type affects a specific character statistic.
dialogsBegin.fil: Now that you're pet has been hatched, it will increase specific character statistics (Stat Points) depending on the type of pet you have summoned. Every pet type affects a specific character statistic.
dialogsBegin.fr: Plus tu passes de temps avec ton familier, plus il augmentera tes capacités. Tôt ou tard, il débloquera son potentiel complet.
dialogsBegin.id: Sekarang setelah hewan peliharaan Anda menetas, itu akan meningkatkan statistik karakter tertentu (Stat Points) tergantung pada jenis hewan peliharaan yang Anda panggil. Setiap jenis hewan peliharaan mempengaruhi statistik karakter tertentu.
dialogsBegin.it: Now that you're pet has been hatched, it will increase specific character statistics (Stat Points) depending on the type of pet you have summoned. Every pet type affects a specific character statistic.
dialogsBegin.jp: まだペットの能力をよく分かってないのでは…。もっとペットとの時間を持った方がいいと思いますよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 펫이 부화했으니, 소환한 펫의 종류에 따라 특정 캐릭터 능력치(스탯 포인트)가 증가합니다. 모든 펫 종류는 특정 캐릭터 스탯에 영향을 줍니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Now that you're pet has been hatched, it will increase specific character statistics (Stat Points) depending on the type of pet you have summoned. Every pet type affects a specific character statistic.
dialogsBegin.pl: Now that you're pet has been hatched, it will increase specific character statistics (Stat Points) depending on the type of pet you have summoned. Every pet type affects a specific character statistic.
dialogsBegin.ru: Now that you're pet has been hatched, it will increase specific character statistics (Stat Points) depending on the type of pet you have summoned. Every pet type affects a specific character statistic.
dialogsBegin.sp: Con tu mascota eclosionad, puedes aumentar las estadísticas de tu personaje (Puntos de Estadísticas). Cada mascota afecta una estadística específica de tu personaje.
dialogsBegin.sw: Now that you're pet has been hatched, it will increase specific character statistics (Stat Points) depending on the type of pet you have summoned. Every pet type affects a specific character statistic.
dialogsBegin.th: ตอนนี้สัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณฟักออกมาแล้ว มันจะเพิ่มstatตัวละครเฉพาะ (Stat Points) ขึ้นอยู่กับประเภทของสัตว์เลี้ยงที่คุณเรียก สัตว์เลี้ยงทุกประเภทมีผลต่อstatตัวละครเฉพาะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 現在你的寵物已經孵化了，它會根據你召喚的寵物類型增加特定的角色統計數值 (數值點數)。每種寵物類型都會影響特定的角色統計數值。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bây giờ thú cưng của bạn đã nở, nó sẽ tăng chỉ số nhân vật cụ thể (Điểm Stat) tùy thuộc vào loại thú cưng bạn đã gọi đến. Mỗi loại thú ảnh hưởng đến một chỉ số nhân vật cụ thể.

dialogsBegin.en: Feed your pet the appropriate Pet Candy and it will gain experience. If you bring your pet's experience to 99.99% again, I'll upgrade it! How does that sound?
dialogsBegin.ar: Feed your pet the appropriate Pet Candy and it will gain experience. If you bring your pet's experience to 99.99% again, I'll upgrade it! How does that sound?
dialogsBegin.br: Alimente seu pet com o Doce apropriado e ele ganhará experiência. Se você elevar a experiência do seu pet para 99,99% novamente, eu irei atualizar o Grau de força dele! O que acha disso?
dialogsBegin.cns: 喂你的宠物适当的宠物糖果，它会获得经验。如果你再把你的宠物经验提升到99.99%，我就升级它！听上去怎么样？
dialogsBegin.de: Füttere dein Pet mit dem entsprechenden Pet Candy und es wird Erfahrung erhalten. Wenn es 99,99% seiner Erfahrungspunkte erreicht hat, werde ich es auf die nächste Stufe bringen. Na, wie klingt das für dich?
dialogsBegin.fi: Feed your pet the appropriate Pet Candy and it will gain experience. If you bring your pet's experience to 99.99% again, I'll upgrade it! How does that sound?
dialogsBegin.fil: Feed your pet the appropriate Pet Candy and it will gain experience. If you bring your pet's experience to 99.99% again, I'll upgrade it! How does that sound?
dialogsBegin.fr: Occupe-toi bien de ton familier ! Lorsque son expérience aura atteint 99,99%, reviens me voir et je le ferai progresser à la prochaine évolution.
dialogsBegin.id: Beri makan hewan peliharaanm Pet Candy yang sesuai dan itu akan mendapatkan pengalaman. Jika kamu membawa pengalaman hewan peliharaanmu ke 99,99% lagi, saya akan meningkatkannya! Bagaimana itu terdengar?
dialogsBegin.it: Feed your pet the appropriate Pet Candy and it will gain experience. If you bring your pet's experience to 99.99% again, I'll upgrade it! How does that sound?
dialogsBegin.jp: ペットと共にマドリガル大陸を探検して来てください。ペットの経験値が100％になったら、私がペットのレベルを上げてあげますよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 펫에게 맞는 펫 캔디를 먹이면 경험치를 얻을 수 있습니다. 펫 경험치를 다시 99.99%로 올리고 나면 업그레이드해 드릴게요! 어때요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Feed your pet the appropriate Pet Candy and it will gain experience. If you bring your pet's experience to 99.99% again, I'll upgrade it! How does that sound?
dialogsBegin.pl: Feed your pet the appropriate Pet Candy and it will gain experience. If you bring your pet's experience to 99.99% again, I'll upgrade it! How does that sound?
dialogsBegin.ru: Feed your pet the appropriate Pet Candy and it will gain experience. If you bring your pet's experience to 99.99% again, I'll upgrade it! How does that sound?
dialogsBegin.sp: Alimenta a tu mascota con los Caramelos de Mascota adecuados para aumentar tu EXP. Cuando la EXP de tu Mascota alcance 99,99 %, ¡La mejoraré!
dialogsBegin.sw: Feed your pet the appropriate Pet Candy and it will gain experience. If you bring your pet's experience to 99.99% again, I'll upgrade it! How does that sound?
dialogsBegin.th: ให้อาหารสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณด้วย Pet Candy ที่เหมาะสม และมันจะได้รับEXPหากคุณนำEXPสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณมาถึง 99.99% อีกครั้ง ฉันจะอัปเกรดมัน! ฟังดูเป็นยังไง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 餵你的寵物適當的寵物糖果，它會獲得經驗。如果你再把你的寵物經驗提升到 99.99%，我就升級它！聽上去怎麼樣？
dialogsBegin.vi: Cho thú cưng của bạn ăn Pet Candy thích hợp và nó sẽ nhận được điểm experience. Nếu bạn mang lại điểm experience thú cưng của mình lên 99,99% một lần nữa, tôi sẽ nâng cấp nó! Nghe như thế nào?

dialogsAccept.en: If your pet's energy runs out, it can't help you. When it's energy gets low, you better feed it to keep the bonuses! Now, go and spend some time with your pet! Come back when you've gained enough experience.
dialogsAccept.ar: If your pet's energy runs out, it can't help you. When it's energy gets low, you better feed it to keep the bonuses! Now, go and spend some time with your pet! Come back when you've gained enough experience.
dialogsAccept.br: Se a energia do seu pet acabar, ele não poderá ajudá-lo. Quando a energia fica baixa, é melhor alimentá-lo para manter os bônus! Agora, vá se aventurar com seu amiguinho! Volte quando tiver adquirido experiência suficiente.
dialogsAccept.cns: 如果您的宠物的能量耗尽，它将无法帮助您。当它的能量变低时，你最好喂它以保持获得属性加成！现在，去和你的宠物共度时光吧！当你获得足够的经验后回来。
dialogsAccept.de: Dein Pet wird dich nicht unterstützen können, wenn ihm die Energie ausgeht. Mit Pet Candy kannst du seine Energie wieder auffüllen. Nun zieh los und verbringe ein wenig Zeit mit deinem Pet. Komm wieder zurück, wenn es ausreichend Erfahrung erhalten hat.
dialogsAccept.fi: If your pet's energy runs out, it can't help you. When it's energy gets low, you better feed it to keep the bonuses! Now, go and spend some time with your pet! Come back when you've gained enough experience.
dialogsAccept.fil: If your pet's energy runs out, it can't help you. When it's energy gets low, you better feed it to keep the bonuses! Now, go and spend some time with your pet! Come back when you've gained enough experience.
dialogsAccept.fr: L'expérience du familier n'augmente que lorsqu'il est invoqué, avec le temps. mais n'oublie pas de le nourrir ! Sinon, ses effets ne s'appliqueront plus sur toi.
dialogsAccept.id: Jika energi hewan peliharaanmu habis, itu tidak dapat membantumu. Saat energinya berkurang, kamu sebaiknya memberinya makan untuk menyimpan bonus! Sekarang, pergi dan habiskan waktu dengan hewan peliharaanmu! Kembalilah ketika kamu sudah mendapatkan cukup pengalaman.
dialogsAccept.it: If your pet's energy runs out, it can't help you. When it's energy gets low, you better feed it to keep the bonuses! Now, go and spend some time with your pet! Come back when you've gained enough experience.
dialogsAccept.jp: ペットは召喚中に経験値が上昇します。えさも忘れないように。えさがなくなったらペットは飢え死にしちゃいますからね。
dialogsAccept.kr: 펫의 기력이 떨어지면 펫의 도움을 받을 수 없습니다. 기력이 부족해지면, 먹이를 줘야 보너스를 유지할 수 있답니다! 이제 가서 펫과 충분히 시간을 보내세요! 경험치가 충분히 쌓이면 다시 오세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: If your pet's energy runs out, it can't help you. When it's energy gets low, you better feed it to keep the bonuses! Now, go and spend some time with your pet! Come back when you've gained enough experience.
dialogsAccept.pl: If your pet's energy runs out, it can't help you. When it's energy gets low, you better feed it to keep the bonuses! Now, go and spend some time with your pet! Come back when you've gained enough experience.
dialogsAccept.ru: If your pet's energy runs out, it can't help you. When it's energy gets low, you better feed it to keep the bonuses! Now, go and spend some time with your pet! Come back when you've gained enough experience.
dialogsAccept.sp: Si la energía de tu mascota se agota, no puedrá ayudarte. Si su energía baja, ¡Mejor que la alimentes para conservar las bonificaciones! ¡Ahora ve y pasa un rato con tu mascota! Vuelve cuando hayas ganado suficiente experiencia.
dialogsAccept.sw: If your pet's energy runs out, it can't help you. When it's energy gets low, you better feed it to keep the bonuses! Now, go and spend some time with your pet! Come back when you've gained enough experience.
dialogsAccept.th: หากพลังงานของสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณหมด มันก็ไม่สามารถช่วยคุณได้ เมื่อพลังงานเหลือน้อย คุณควรป้อนมันเพื่อรักษาโบนัส! ตอนนี้ ไปและใช้เวลากับสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณ! กลับมาเมื่อคุณได้รับEXPเพียงพอ
dialogsAccept.tw: 如果你的寵物的能量耗盡，它無法幫助你。當它的能量變低時，你最好餵牠以保持加成！現在，去和你的寵物共度時光吧！當你獲得足夠的經驗後回來。
dialogsAccept.vi: Nếu năng lượng thú cưng của bạn cạn kiệt, nó không thể giúp bạn. Khi năng lượng của nó gần hết, bạn nên cho nó ăn để giữ tiền thưởng! Bây giờ, hãy dành thời gian cho thú cưng của bạn! Hãy quay lại khi bạn đã có đủ experience.

dialogsDecline.en: Really? You're not interested in advancing your pet's abilities? Fine, have it your way. What a shame…
dialogsDecline.ar: Really? You're not interested in advancing your pet's abilities? Fine, have it your way. What a shame…
dialogsDecline.br: Se você não está realmente satisfeito com a força do seu Pet, porquê não elevá-lo de nível? Ou você está satisfeito com ele?
dialogsDecline.cns: 真的吗？您对提升宠物的能力不感兴趣吗？好吧，随你吧。多可惜…
dialogsDecline.de: Wirklich? Du willst die Fähigkeiten deines Pets nicht steigern? Nun gut, wie du willst. Aber es ist eine Schande...
dialogsDecline.fi: Really? You're not interested in advancing your pet's abilities? Fine, have it your way. What a shame…
dialogsDecline.fil: Really? You're not interested in advancing your pet's abilities? Fine, have it your way. What a shame…
dialogsDecline.fr: Si tu n'es pas satisfait des capacités de ton familier, pourquoi ne pas l'améliorer ?
dialogsDecline.id: Sungguh? Kamu tidak tertarik untuk menaikkan abiliti pet kamu? Tak apa, lakukan sesukamu. Sayang sekali…
dialogsDecline.it: Really? You're not interested in advancing your pet's abilities? Fine, have it your way. What a shame…
dialogsDecline.jp: もっと頑張ってペットを成長させましょう。
dialogsDecline.kr: 정말요? 펫의 능력을 강화할 생각이 없으신 건가요? 알겠어요, 마음대로 하세요. 아깝네요...
dialogsDecline.nl: Really? You're not interested in advancing your pet's abilities? Fine, have it your way. What a shame…
dialogsDecline.pl: Really? You're not interested in advancing your pet's abilities? Fine, have it your way. What a shame…
dialogsDecline.ru: Really? You're not interested in advancing your pet's abilities? Fine, have it your way. What a shame…
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿En serio? ¿No te interesa mejorar las habilidades de tu mascota? Como desees. Es una pena…
dialogsDecline.sw: Really? You're not interested in advancing your pet's abilities? Fine, have it your way. What a shame…
dialogsDecline.th: จริงหรือ คุณไม่สนใจที่จะพัฒนาความสามารถของสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณหรือไม่? ได้สิ จัดให้เลย น่าเสียดายอะไร…
dialogsDecline.tw: 真的嗎？你對提升寵物的能力不感興趣嗎？好吧，隨你便吧。多可惜…
dialogsDecline.vi: Thật không? Bạn không quan tâm đến việc tăng năng lực của thú cưng? Tốt thôi, hãy làm theo cách của bạn. Thật xấu hổ làm sao…

dialogsComplete.en: Great job with your pet, my friend! I'll take it from here!
dialogsComplete.ar: Great job with your pet, my friend! I'll take it from here!
dialogsComplete.br: Você fez um ótimo trabalho com seu Pet, amigo(a). Deixe-me atualizar o Grau dele para você.
dialogsComplete.cns: 我的朋友，做得很好！那么就交给我了！
dialogsComplete.de: Gute Arbeit, mein Freund. Ich übernehme ab hier!
dialogsComplete.fi: Great job with your pet, my friend! I'll take it from here!
dialogsComplete.fil: Great job with your pet, my friend! I'll take it from here!
dialogsComplete.fr: Tu as fait du bon travail avec ton familier. Je vais pouvoir le faire évoluer.
dialogsComplete.id: Kerja bagus dengan hewan pet kamu kawan! Aku akan mengambil alihnya dari sini!
dialogsComplete.it: Great job with your pet, my friend! I'll take it from here!
dialogsComplete.jp: よく育てましたね。ペットのレベルをアップさせてあげましょう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 펫을 아주 잘 키우셨네요! 이제부턴 제게 맡기세요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Great job with your pet, my friend! I'll take it from here!
dialogsComplete.pl: Great job with your pet, my friend! I'll take it from here!
dialogsComplete.ru: Great job with your pet, my friend! I'll take it from here!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Buen trabajo con tu mascota, amigo mío! ¡Ahora me haré cargo yo!
dialogsComplete.sw: Great job with your pet, my friend! I'll take it from here!
dialogsComplete.th: เยี่ยมมากกับสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณเพื่อนของฉัน! ฉันจะเอามันจากที่นี่!
dialogsComplete.tw: 我的朋友，做得很好！我會從這裡開始！
dialogsComplete.vi: Thú cưng của bạn tuyệt vời, bạn của tôi! Tôi sẽ lo phần việc còn lại!

dialogsFail.en: You need to spend more time with your pet. It hasn't acquired enough experience to be upgraded yet. Stop back by when his experience reaches 99.99%!
dialogsFail.ar: You need to spend more time with your pet. It hasn't acquired enough experience to be upgraded yet. Stop back by when his experience reaches 99.99%!
dialogsFail.br: Você precisa passar mais tempo com seu Pet. A experiência dele não está alta o suficiente para que eu eleve seu Grau. Volte quando a experiência dele atingir 99,99%!
dialogsFail.cns: 你需要花更多的时间陪伴你的宠物。它还没有获得足够的经验来升级。当它的经验达到 99.99% 时停下来！
dialogsFail.de: Du musst mehr Zeit mit deinem Pet verbringen und es regelmäßig füttern. Es hat noch nicht ausreichend Erfahrung gesammelt. Komm wieder, wenn es 99,99% Erfahrung erhalten hat!
dialogsFail.fi: You need to spend more time with your pet. It hasn't acquired enough experience to be upgraded yet. Stop back by when his experience reaches 99.99%!
dialogsFail.fil: You need to spend more time with your pet. It hasn't acquired enough experience to be upgraded yet. Stop back by when his experience reaches 99.99%!
dialogsFail.fr: Passe plus de temps avec ton familier, son expérience n'est pas assez élevée pour le faire évoluer.
dialogsFail.id: Anda perlu menghabiskan lebih banyak waktu dengan hewan peliharaan Anda. Itu belum memperoleh pengalaman yang cukup untuk ditingkatkan. Mampirlah ketika pengalamannya mencapai 99,99%!
dialogsFail.it: You need to spend more time with your pet. It hasn't acquired enough experience to be upgraded yet. Stop back by when his experience reaches 99.99%!
dialogsFail.jp: ペットと共にした時間はまだまだ少ないようですね。もっといっしょに冒険してから来てください。
dialogsFail.kr: 펫과 시간을 더 많이 보내야 합니다. 아직 업그레이드에 필요한 경험치가 부족합니다. 경험치 99.99%를 달성하면 다시 찾아오세요!
dialogsFail.nl: You need to spend more time with your pet. It hasn't acquired enough experience to be upgraded yet. Stop back by when his experience reaches 99.99%!
dialogsFail.pl: You need to spend more time with your pet. It hasn't acquired enough experience to be upgraded yet. Stop back by when his experience reaches 99.99%!
dialogsFail.ru: You need to spend more time with your pet. It hasn't acquired enough experience to be upgraded yet. Stop back by when his experience reaches 99.99%!
dialogsFail.sp: Necesitas pasar más tiempo con tu mascota. Todavía no ha adquirido suficiente experiencia para una mejora. ¡Visítanos cuando su experiencia alcance el 99,99 %!
dialogsFail.sw: You need to spend more time with your pet. It hasn't acquired enough experience to be upgraded yet. Stop back by when his experience reaches 99.99%!
dialogsFail.th: คุณต้องใช้เวลากับสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณมากขึ้น มันยังไม่ได้รับEXPเพียงพอที่จะอัพเกรด กลับมาเมื่อEXPของเขาถึง 99.99%!
dialogsFail.tw: 你需要花更多的時間陪伴你的寵物。它還沒有獲得足夠的經驗來升級。當他的經驗達到 99.99% 時停下來！
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn cần dành nhiều thời gian hơn cho thú cưng của mình. Nó chưa có đủ điểm experience để được nâng cấp. Hãy dừng lại khi điểm experience đạt đến 99,99%!

name.th: อันตรายของการทำสวน
name.vi: Những nguy cơ của việc làm vườn

description.en: Hunt 20 Small Watangkas & 15 Watangkas and return to Laola.
description.ar: Hunt 20 Small Watangkas & 15 Watangkas and return to Laola.
description.br: Cace 20 Watangkas Pequenos e 15 Watangkas e reporte para Laola.
description.cns: 击杀20个巫民和15个巫民土著，并交给拉宇。
description.de: Jage 20 Watangka & 15 Watangkas und kehre zu Laola zurück.
description.fi: Hunt 20 Small Watangkas & 15 Watangkas and return to Laola.
description.fil: Hunt 20 Small Watangkas & 15 Watangkas and return to Laola.
description.fr: Tuez 20 Jeunes Watangka et 15 Watangka et retounez parler à Laola.

dialogsBegin.en: Ohh! Achaben sent you! Sorry for the less than friendly greeting! I heard you are looking for the warrior about whom I spoke of to Achaben?
dialogsBegin.ar: Ohh! Achaben sent you! Sorry for the less than friendly greeting! I heard you are looking for the warrior about whom I spoke of to Achaben?
dialogsBegin.br: Ah! Achaben enviou você! Desculpe a saudação menos que amigável! Ouvi dizer que você está procurando a guerreira de quem falei com Achaben?
dialogsBegin.cns: 哦！雅察本让你来的！不好意思，我刚才不太友好。我听说你在找我和雅察本提过的那位勇士？
dialogsBegin.de: Ohh! Achaben schickt dich! Entschuldigt die unfreundliche Begrüßung! Ich habe gehört, dass du nach dem Krieger sucht, von dem ich Achaben erzählt habe?
dialogsBegin.fi: Ohh! Achaben sent you! Sorry for the less than friendly greeting! I heard you are looking for the warrior about whom I spoke of to Achaben?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ohh! Achaben sent you! Sorry for the less than friendly greeting! I heard you are looking for the warrior about whom I spoke of to Achaben?
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous cherchez des Héros ? Dans cette région ?
dialogsBegin.id: oh! Achaben mengirimmu! Maaf untuk sapaan yang kurang ramah! Saya mendengar Anda mencari prajurit tentang siapa yang saya bicarakan dengan Achaben?
dialogsBegin.it: Ohh! Achaben sent you! Sorry for the less than friendly greeting! I heard you are looking for the warrior about whom I spoke of to Achaben?
dialogsBegin.jp: ああ！ アカベンがあなたを送ったのですね！  私がアチャベンに話した戦士を探していると聞きましたが？
dialogsBegin.kr: 오! 아카벤이 보낸 사람이군. 아카벤과 말 한 그 사람을 찾는 것인가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Ohh! Achaben sent you! Sorry for the less than friendly greeting! I heard you are looking for the warrior about whom I spoke of to Achaben?
dialogsBegin.pl: Ohh! Achaben sent you! Sorry for the less than friendly greeting! I heard you are looking for the warrior about whom I spoke of to Achaben?
dialogsBegin.ru: Ohh! Achaben sent you! Sorry for the less than friendly greeting! I heard you are looking for the warrior about whom I spoke of to Achaben?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Vaya! ¡Achaben te ha enviado! ¡Perdón por el saludo poco amistoso! ¿Estás buscando a la guerrera de la que le hablé a Achaben?
dialogsBegin.sw: Ohh! Achaben sent you! Sorry for the less than friendly greeting! I heard you are looking for the warrior about whom I spoke of to Achaben?
dialogsBegin.th: Ohh! Achaben ส่งคุณมา! ขอโทษด้วยหากคำอวยพรดูไม่ค่อยดี! คุณกำลังมองหานักรบที่ฉันพูดถึงกับ Achaben ใช่มั้ย ?
dialogsBegin.tw: 哦！原來是安迪派你來的！抱歉剛才招呼不周！聽說你正在找我向安迪提過的那位戰士？
dialogsBegin.vi: Ohh! Achaben đã gửi bạn tới đây! Xin lỗi vì lời chào kém thân thiện! Tôi nghe nói bạn đang tìm kiếm chiến binh mà tôi đã nói với Achaben?

dialogsBegin.en: I have briefly seen her before, but I’m not entirely sure of her exact whereabouts. I do have a friend who claims to have seen this warrior recently…
dialogsBegin.ar: I have briefly seen her before, but I’m not entirely sure of her exact whereabouts. I do have a friend who claims to have seen this warrior recently…
dialogsBegin.br: Eu a vi brevemente antes, mas não tenho certeza de seu paradeiro exato. Eu tenho um amigo que afirma ter visto essa guerreira recentemente…
dialogsBegin.cns: 我以前曾短暂地见过她，但现在并不确定她的具体行踪。但是我有一个朋友表明最近见过这位勇士...
dialogsBegin.de: Ich habe sie schon einmal kurz gesehen, aber ich bin mir nicht ganz sicher, wo sie sich genau aufhält. Ich habe einen Freund, der behauptet, diese Kriegerin vor kurzem gesehen zu haben...
dialogsBegin.fi: I have briefly seen her before, but I’m not entirely sure of her exact whereabouts. I do have a friend who claims to have seen this warrior recently…
dialogsBegin.fil: I have briefly seen her before, but I’m not entirely sure of her exact whereabouts. I do have a friend who claims to have seen this warrior recently…
dialogsBegin.fr: Je peux vous présenter à des amis mais tout a un prix vous savez.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya telah melihatnya sebentar sebelumnya, tetapi saya tidak sepenuhnya yakin dengan keberadaannya yang tepat. Saya punya teman yang mengaku telah melihat prajurit ini baru-baru ini ...
dialogsBegin.it: I have briefly seen her before, but I’m not entirely sure of her exact whereabouts. I do have a friend who claims to have seen this warrior recently…
dialogsBegin.jp: 私は以前に彼女に会ったことがありますが、彼女の正確な居場所はわからないけど、最近会ったと言っている友人がいます。
dialogsBegin.kr: 얼마 전 이곳에서 본 것 같기는 한데, 정확히 어디였는지는 모르겠군. 당신이 찾는 사람이 어디 있는지 알고 있는 친구를 소개해줄수도 있을 것 같은데?
dialogsBegin.nl: I have briefly seen her before, but I’m not entirely sure of her exact whereabouts. I do have a friend who claims to have seen this warrior recently…
dialogsBegin.pl: I have briefly seen her before, but I’m not entirely sure of her exact whereabouts. I do have a friend who claims to have seen this warrior recently…
dialogsBegin.ru: I have briefly seen her before, but I’m not entirely sure of her exact whereabouts. I do have a friend who claims to have seen this warrior recently…
dialogsBegin.sp: La vi hace un tiempo, pero no estoy seguro de su paradero exacto. Tengo una amiga que afirma haber visto a esa guerrera recientemente...
dialogsBegin.sw: I have briefly seen her before, but I’m not entirely sure of her exact whereabouts. I do have a friend who claims to have seen this warrior recently…
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันเพิ่งเจอเธอไม่นานมานี้ ไม่แน่ใจว่าเธออยู่ที่ไหนแล้ว ฉันมีเพื่อนที่เคยบอกว่าเจอเธอคนนี้เมื่อเร็ว ๆ นี้ ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 如果你可以幫忙我，我就會介紹一個人給你，他可能知道你所要找的人在哪吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đã từng gặp cô ấy một thời gian ngắn, nhưng tôi không hoàn toàn chắc chắn về nơi ở chính xác của cô ấy. Tôi có một người bạn tuyên bố đã nhìn thấy chiến binh này gần đây…

dialogsBegin.en: I will introduce you to them, but first I need a little help! I do extensive gardening here in Darkon 3 but the Watangka tribes have been making my work difficult. Could you please eliminate some of them?
dialogsBegin.ar: I will introduce you to them, but first I need a little help! I do extensive gardening here in Darkon 3 but the Watangka tribes have been making my work difficult. Could you please eliminate some of them?
dialogsBegin.br: Posso te apresentar para ele, mas primeiro preciso de uma ajudinha! Eu faço jardinagem extensiva aqui em Darkon 3, mas as tribos Watangka têm dificultado meu trabalho. Você poderia eliminar alguns deles?
dialogsBegin.cns: I will introduce you to them, but first I need a little help! I do extensive gardening here in Darkon 3 but the Watangka tribes have been making my work difficult. Could you please eliminate some of them?
dialogsBegin.de: Ich werde sie euch vorstellen, aber zuerst brauche ich ein wenig Hilfe! Ich betreibe hier in Darkon 3 umfangreiche Gartenarbeit, aber die Watangka-Stämme haben mir die Arbeit schwer gemacht. Könntest Du bitte einige von ihnen beseitigen?
dialogsBegin.fi: I will introduce you to them, but first I need a little help! I do extensive gardening here in Darkon 3 but the Watangka tribes have been making my work difficult. Could you please eliminate some of them?
dialogsBegin.fil: I will introduce you to them, but first I need a little help! I do extensive gardening here in Darkon 3 but the Watangka tribes have been making my work difficult. Could you please eliminate some of them?
dialogsBegin.fr: Hep là-bas, qui va là ? Vous êtes sur mon spot !
dialogsBegin.id: Aku akan memperkenalkanmu kepada mereka, tetapi pertama-tama aku butuh sedikit bantuan! Aku melakukan berkebun ekstensif di sini di Darkon 3 tetapi suku Watangka telah membuat pekerjaan saya sulit. Bisakah kamu menghilangkan beberapa di antaranya??
dialogsBegin.it: I will introduce you to them, but first I need a little help! I do extensive gardening here in Darkon 3 but the Watangka tribes have been making my work difficult. Could you please eliminate some of them?
dialogsBegin.jp: 私はこの通り齢ですのでモンスターと闘うことはできません。そのため、周囲のワタングカを倒してきてほしいのです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 제가 소개해 드릴 수 있어요. 하지만 먼저 당신 도움이 필요해요! 저는 이곳 다콘 3에서 정원을 가꾸고 있는데, 와탕카 부족이 계속 저를 힘들게 하고 있어요. 와탕카 녀석들을 좀 없애 주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: I will introduce you to them, but first I need a little help! I do extensive gardening here in Darkon 3 but the Watangka tribes have been making my work difficult. Could you please eliminate some of them?
dialogsBegin.pl: I will introduce you to them, but first I need a little help! I do extensive gardening here in Darkon 3 but the Watangka tribes have been making my work difficult. Could you please eliminate some of them?
dialogsBegin.ru: I will introduce you to them, but first I need a little help! I do extensive gardening here in Darkon 3 but the Watangka tribes have been making my work difficult. Could you please eliminate some of them?
dialogsBegin.sp: Te la presentaré, ¡pero primero necesito un poco de ayuda! Hago una gran cantidad de trabajos de jardinería aquí en Darkon 3, pero las tribus de Watangka dificultan mi trabajo. ¿¿Podrías eliminar a unos cuantos??
dialogsBegin.sw: I will introduce you to them, but first I need a little help! I do extensive gardening here in Darkon 3 but the Watangka tribes have been making my work difficult. Could you please eliminate some of them?
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันจะแนะนำคุณกับพวกเขา แต่ก่อนอื่นฉันต้องการความช่วยเหลือเล็กน้อย! ฉันทำสวนมากมายที่น Darkon 3 แต่เผ่า Watangka เป็นอุปสรรค์กับงานของฉัน คุณจะช่วยกำจัดพวกมันซักหน่อยได้ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 我會介紹你去見他們，不過在那之前我得請你幫個小忙！我在得肯第三區這裡一直都有在打理大片花圃，但瓦坦卡部族讓我的工作變得很困難。你可以幫我清掉一些牠們嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi sẽ giới thiệu bạn với họ, nhưng trước tiên tôi cần bạn giúp một việc! Tôi làm vườn trên diện tích lớn tại vùng Darkon 3 nhưng các bộ lạc Watangka đang gây khó khăn cho công việc của tôi. Bạn có thể giúp tôi tiêu diệt bớt bọn chúng không??

dialogsAccept.en: Please hunt 20 Small Watangkas & 15 Watangkas and return to me. It is terribly difficult to garden in these conditions!
dialogsAccept.ar: Please hunt 20 Small Watangkas & 15 Watangkas and return to me. It is terribly difficult to garden in these conditions!
dialogsAccept.br: Por favor, cace 20 Pequenos Watangkas e 15 Watangkas e volte para mim. É terrivelmente difícil jardinar nestas condições!
dialogsAccept.cns: 请猎杀20个巫民和15个巫民土著。在这样的条件下进行园艺是非常困难的!
dialogsAccept.de: Bitte jagen Sie 20 Small Watangkas und 15 Watangkas und schicke es mir zurück. Es ist furchtbar schwierig, unter diesen Bedingungen zu gärtnern!
dialogsAccept.fi: Please hunt 20 Small Watangkas & 15 Watangkas and return to me. It is terribly difficult to garden in these conditions!
dialogsAccept.fil: Please hunt 20 Small Watangkas & 15 Watangkas and return to me. It is terribly difficult to garden in these conditions!
dialogsAccept.fr: Je pense qu'avec quelques dizaines de Watangka en moins ça sera beaucoup plus supportable.
dialogsAccept.id: Silakan berburu 20 Small Watangkas & 15 Watangkas dan kembali kepada saya. Sangat sulit untuk berkebun dalam kondisi ini!
dialogsAccept.it: Please hunt 20 Small Watangkas & 15 Watangkas and return to me. It is terribly difficult to garden in these conditions!
dialogsAccept.jp: 20個の小さなワタンカと15個のワタンカを倒してください！これでは、庭を作るのは非常に難しいです！
dialogsAccept.kr: 와탕카 녀석들이 다시는 소란스럽게 못하도록 부하 와탕카 20마리, 와탕카 15마리만 처치해줘.
dialogsAccept.nl: Please hunt 20 Small Watangkas & 15 Watangkas and return to me. It is terribly difficult to garden in these conditions!
dialogsAccept.pl: Please hunt 20 Small Watangkas & 15 Watangkas and return to me. It is terribly difficult to garden in these conditions!
dialogsAccept.ru: Please hunt 20 Small Watangkas & 15 Watangkas and return to me. It is terribly difficult to garden in these conditions!
dialogsAccept.sp: Por favor, derrota a 20 Watangkas Pequeños y a 15 Watangkas y vuelve conmigo. ¡Es terriblemente difícil trabajar en el jardín en estas condiciones!
dialogsAccept.sw: Please hunt 20 Small Watangkas & 15 Watangkas and return to me. It is terribly difficult to garden in these conditions!
dialogsAccept.th: กรุณาล่า 20 Small Watangkas & 15 Watangkas และกลับมาหาฉัน มันเป็นเรื่องยากมากที่จะสวนในเงื่อนไขเหล่านี้!
dialogsAccept.tw: 為了讓哇噹卡傢伙無法再吵鬧，我希望你可以消滅 20 隻卡噹哇和 15 隻哇噹卡。
dialogsAccept.vi: Hãy săn 20 Small Watangkas & 15 Watangkas rồi rinh chúng về cho tôi. Rất khó để làm vườn trong những điều kiện thế này!

dialogsDecline.en: Please help eliminate the Watangka! It's hard enough to make a living already without them around!
dialogsDecline.ar: Please help eliminate the Watangka! It's hard enough to make a living already without them around!
dialogsDecline.br: Por favor, ajude a eliminar os Watangkas! Já é difícil ganhar a vida sem eles por perto!
dialogsDecline.cns: 请帮助消灭巫民土著! 他们的存在，让我们的生活已经非常艰难的了!
dialogsDecline.de: Bitte helfe, die Watangka zu beseitigen! Es ist schon schwer genug, seinen Lebensunterhalt ohne sie zu bestreiten!
dialogsDecline.fi: Please help eliminate the Watangka! It's hard enough to make a living already without them around!
dialogsDecline.fil: Please help eliminate the Watangka! It's hard enough to make a living already without them around!
dialogsDecline.fr: Bon dans ce cas je vais m'en occuper moi-même mais ne comptez pas sur mon aide.
dialogsDecline.id: Tolong bantu hilangkan Watangka! Cukup sulit untuk mencari nafkah tanpa mereka di sekitar!
dialogsDecline.it: Please help eliminate the Watangka! It's hard enough to make a living already without them around!
dialogsDecline.jp: そうですか……残念ですね。
dialogsDecline.kr: 와탕카를 빨리 처치해 줘! 시끄러워서 견딜 수가 없어!
dialogsDecline.nl: Please help eliminate the Watangka! It's hard enough to make a living already without them around!
dialogsDecline.pl: Please help eliminate the Watangka! It's hard enough to make a living already without them around!
dialogsDecline.ru: Please help eliminate the Watangka! It's hard enough to make a living already without them around!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Por favor ayúdame a eliminar a los Watangka! ¡Ya es bastante difícil ganarse la vida sin ellos cerca!
dialogsDecline.sw: Please help eliminate the Watangka! It's hard enough to make a living already without them around!
dialogsDecline.th: ช่วยกำจัด Watangka! มันยากที่เราจะมีชีวิตอยู่รอดถ้ายังมีพวกเขาอยู่
dialogsDecline.tw: 就算吵鬧，就只能夠忍耐！希望你也不要來煩我！
dialogsDecline.vi: Hãy giúp loại bỏ Watangka! Thật khó để kiếm sống nếu không có họ bên cạnh!

dialogsComplete.en: Thank you so much!! Now I can work to get my next export of flowers out!
dialogsComplete.ar: Thank you so much!! Now I can work to get my next export of flowers out!
dialogsComplete.br: Muito obrigada!! Agora posso trabalhar para conseguir minha próxima exportação de flores!
dialogsComplete.cns: 太感谢你了! 现在我可以努力种下一个花了!
dialogsComplete.de: Vielen Dank!! Jetzt kann ich arbeiten, um meinen nächste Ernte von Blumen zu bekommen!
dialogsComplete.fi: Thank you so much!! Now I can work to get my next export of flowers out!
dialogsComplete.fil: Thank you so much!! Now I can work to get my next export of flowers out!
dialogsComplete.fr: Voilà, c'est tout de suite plus calme.
dialogsComplete.id: Terima kasih banyak!! Sekarang saya dapat bekerja untuk mengeluarkan ekspor bunga saya berikutnya!
dialogsComplete.it: Thank you so much!! Now I can work to get my next export of flowers out!
dialogsComplete.jp: ありがとうございます。これでしばらく研究に集中できます。
dialogsComplete.kr: 정말 감사해요! 이제 다음 꽃 판매 준비를 할 수 있겠네요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Thank you so much!! Now I can work to get my next export of flowers out!
dialogsComplete.pl: Thank you so much!! Now I can work to get my next export of flowers out!
dialogsComplete.ru: Thank you so much!! Now I can work to get my next export of flowers out!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡¡Muchísimas gracias!! ¡Ahora puedo trabajar para sacar mi próxima exportación de flores!
dialogsComplete.sw: Thank you so much!! Now I can work to get my next export of flowers out!
dialogsComplete.th: ขอบคุณมาก!! ตอนนี้ฉันสามารถทำงานเพื่อส่งดอกไม้รอบถัดไปได้อีก
dialogsComplete.tw: 謝謝！現在我可以專心於研究上了。
dialogsComplete.vi: Cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều!! Bây giờ tôi có thể làm việc để hoàn thành việc xuất khẩu hoa của mình!

dialogsFail.en: Please go and defeat the Watangka before they destroy any more of my flowers!
dialogsFail.ar: Please go and defeat the Watangka before they destroy any more of my flowers!
dialogsFail.br: Por favor, vá e derrote os Watangkas antes que eles destruam mais das minhas flores!
dialogsFail.cns: 请去打败巫民土著，免得他们再毁掉我的花!
dialogsFail.de: Bitte geh und besiege die Watangka, bevor sie noch mehr von meinen Blumen zerstören!
dialogsFail.fi: Please go and defeat the Watangka before they destroy any more of my flowers!
dialogsFail.fil: Please go and defeat the Watangka before they destroy any more of my flowers!
dialogsFail.fr: On ne s'entend pas causer. Allez donc réduire des Watangka au silence.
dialogsFail.id: Silakan pergi dan kalahkan Watangka sebelum mereka menghancurkan bunga saya lagi!
dialogsFail.it: Please go and defeat the Watangka before they destroy any more of my flowers!
dialogsFail.jp: 彼らは私の大切なお花畑を荒らしていくのです。どうかお願いします。
dialogsFail.kr: 제 꽃들이 엉망이 되기 전에, 빨리 와탕카를 처치해 주세요!
dialogsFail.nl: Please go and defeat the Watangka before they destroy any more of my flowers!
dialogsFail.pl: Please go and defeat the Watangka before they destroy any more of my flowers!
dialogsFail.ru: Please go and defeat the Watangka before they destroy any more of my flowers!
dialogsFail.sp: ¡Por favor ve y derrota a los Watangkas antes de que destrocen más de mis flores!
dialogsFail.sw: Please go and defeat the Watangka before they destroy any more of my flowers!
dialogsFail.th: กรุณาไปกำจัด Watangka ก่อนที่พวกมันจะทำลายดอกไม้ของฉันอีก!
dialogsFail.tw: 太吵了，沒有辦法集中！快一點幫我消滅哇噹卡！
dialogsFail.vi: Hãy đi và đánh bại Watangka trước khi chúng phá hủy bất kỳ bông hoa nào của tôi!

description.sw: Find the Billposter hero high in the mountains Southeast of Nomads Village.
description.th: หา Force Master Hero ที่อยู่ในเทือกเขาสูงทางตะวันออกเฉียงใต้ของ Nomads Village
description.tw: 去找爆咒師祭壇附近的修利。
description.vi: Tìm anh hùng Billposter ở vùng núi phía Đông Nam làng Nomads.

dialogsBegin.en: The warrior you are looking for is currently training up at the Stone Mountain. I believe her to be the original hero Billposter.
dialogsBegin.ar: The warrior you are looking for is currently training up at the Stone Mountain. I believe her to be the original hero Billposter.
dialogsBegin.br: A guerreira que você está procurando está treinando na Montanha de Pedra. Eu acredito que ela seja a Heroína Original Billposter.
dialogsBegin.cns: 您正在寻找的勇士目前正在巨石山训练，我相信她是最初的英雄暴力技师。
dialogsBegin.de: Die Kriegerin, die ihr sucht, trainiert derzeit auf dem Stone Mountain. Ich glaube, sie ist der ursprüngliche Billposter Hero.
dialogsBegin.fi: The warrior you are looking for is currently training up at the Stone Mountain. I believe her to be the original hero Billposter.
dialogsBegin.fil: The warrior you are looking for is currently training up at the Stone Mountain. I believe her to be the original hero Billposter.
dialogsBegin.fr: Le héros que vous cherchez se nomme Sury et elle s'entraine à la montagne de pierre.
dialogsBegin.id: Prajurit yang Anda cari saat ini sedang berlatih di Gunung Batu. Saya percaya dia adalah pahlawan asli Billposter.
dialogsBegin.it: The warrior you are looking for is currently training up at the Stone Mountain. I believe her to be the original hero Billposter.
dialogsBegin.jp: たぶんアンタが探しているのは向こうの山で修行しているシュリさんのことだな。彼女はビルポスターの英雄と呼ばれていたそうで。
dialogsBegin.kr: 찾으시는 그 전사는, 지금 스톤 산에서 수련 중일 겁니다. 제 생각엔 그분이 분명 과거의 영웅 빌포스터가 틀림없어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: The warrior you are looking for is currently training up at the Stone Mountain. I believe her to be the original hero Billposter.
dialogsBegin.pl: The warrior you are looking for is currently training up at the Stone Mountain. I believe her to be the original hero Billposter.
dialogsBegin.ru: The warrior you are looking for is currently training up at the Stone Mountain. I believe her to be the original hero Billposter.
dialogsBegin.sp: La guerrera que buscas se está entrenando en la Montaña de Piedra. Creo que ella es la héroe original Billposter.
dialogsBegin.sw: The warrior you are looking for is currently training up at the Stone Mountain. I believe her to be the original hero Billposter.
dialogsBegin.th: นักรบที่คุณกำลังหากำลังฝึกอยู่ที่ภูเขาหิน ฉันเชื่อว่าเธอจะเป็นวีรบุรุษของ Force Master เดิม
dialogsBegin.tw: 你所尋找的最後英雄應該是在石山進行修練的修利。聽說她以前是爆咒師英雄。
dialogsBegin.vi: Chiến binh bạn đang tìm kiếm hiện đang được huấn luyện tại Stone Mountain. Tôi tin rằng cô ấy là người hùng Billposter thuở sơ khai.

dialogsBegin.en: She shouldn't be too hard to find. Seems like she's been training in the same spot for quite some time now. Plan to find her?
dialogsBegin.ar: She shouldn't be too hard to find. Seems like she's been training in the same spot for quite some time now. Plan to find her?
dialogsBegin.br: Ela não deve ser muito difícil de encontrar. Parece que ela está treinando no mesmo local há algum tempo. Planeja ir falar com ela?
dialogsBegin.cns: 她应该不会太难找到，似乎她已经在同一个地方训练了很长一段时间了，打算找她吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Es sollte nicht allzu schwer sein, sie zu finden. Anscheinend trainiert sie schon seit geraumer Zeit am selben Ort. Planen Sie, sie zu finden?
dialogsBegin.fi: She shouldn't be too hard to find. Seems like she's been training in the same spot for quite some time now. Plan to find her?
dialogsBegin.fil: She shouldn't be too hard to find. Seems like she's been training in the same spot for quite some time now. Plan to find her?
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous la trouverez facilement, elle est toujours au même endroit !
dialogsBegin.id: Dia seharusnya tidak terlalu sulit ditemukan. Sepertinya dia telah berlatih di tempat yang sama selama beberapa waktu sekarang. Berencana untuk menemukannya?
dialogsBegin.it: She shouldn't be too hard to find. Seems like she's been training in the same spot for quite some time now. Plan to find her?
dialogsBegin.jp: 彼女はいつも同じ姿勢で座禅をしているから、東の石の山に行けば、すぐ探せるよ！
dialogsBegin.kr: 항상 같은 자리에서 오랫동안 수련을 하고 있으니 아마 찾기 어렵진 않을 겁니다. 찾으러 가실 건가요?
dialogsBegin.nl: She shouldn't be too hard to find. Seems like she's been training in the same spot for quite some time now. Plan to find her?
dialogsBegin.pl: She shouldn't be too hard to find. Seems like she's been training in the same spot for quite some time now. Plan to find her?
dialogsBegin.ru: She shouldn't be too hard to find. Seems like she's been training in the same spot for quite some time now. Plan to find her?
dialogsBegin.sp: No debería ser demasiado difícil de encontrar. Ha estado entrenando en el mismo lugar durante mucho tiempo. ¿Quieres encontrarla?
dialogsBegin.sw: She shouldn't be too hard to find. Seems like she's been training in the same spot for quite some time now. Plan to find her?
dialogsBegin.th: หาเธอไม่ยากนะ ดูเหมือนว่าตอนนี้เธอกำลังฝึกอยู่ในที่เดียวกัน วางแผนที่จะหาเธอดูสิ?
dialogsBegin.tw: 她總是用同樣的姿勢坐在石上修練，所以在東邊石山就可以找到了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Không quá khó để tìm thấy cô ấy. Có vẻ như cô ấy đã tập luyện ở cùng một vị trí khá lâu rồi. Bạn có kế hoạch tìm cô ấy chưa?

dialogsAccept.en: She typically can be found meditating high up in the mountains Southeast of this location. Good luck!
dialogsAccept.ar: She typically can be found meditating high up in the mountains Southeast of this location. Good luck!
dialogsAccept.br: Ela normalmente pode ser encontrada meditando no alto das montanhas a Sudeste deste local. Boa sorte!
dialogsAccept.cns: 她通常在这个位置东南部的山脉高处冥想，祝你好运！ ！
dialogsAccept.de: Normalerweise findet man sie beim Meditieren hoch oben in den Bergen südöstlich von diesem Ort. Viel Glück!
dialogsAccept.fi: She typically can be found meditating high up in the mountains Southeast of this location. Good luck!
dialogsAccept.fil: She typically can be found meditating high up in the mountains Southeast of this location. Good luck!
dialogsAccept.fr: Elle se trouve au sud de l'autel du moine.
dialogsAccept.id: Dia biasanya dapat ditemukan bermeditasi tinggi di pegunungan Tenggara lokasi ini. Semoga sukses!
dialogsAccept.it: She typically can be found meditating high up in the mountains Southeast of this location. Good luck!
dialogsAccept.jp: シュリは東のビルポスター近辺にいると思うから、そこへ行くと探せるよ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 슈리님께선 여기서 동남쪽에 있는 높은 산 위에서 수련하고 계십니다. 꼭 만나길 빌게요!
dialogsAccept.nl: She typically can be found meditating high up in the mountains Southeast of this location. Good luck!
dialogsAccept.pl: She typically can be found meditating high up in the mountains Southeast of this location. Good luck!
dialogsAccept.ru: She typically can be found meditating high up in the mountains Southeast of this location. Good luck!
dialogsAccept.sp: Por lo general, se la puede encontrar meditando en lo alto de las montañas al sureste de aquí. ¡Buena suerte!
dialogsAccept.sw: She typically can be found meditating high up in the mountains Southeast of this location. Good luck!
dialogsAccept.th: โดยทั่วไปแล้วเธอจะนั่งสมาธิอยู่บนภูเขาทางตะวันออกเฉียงใต้ของที่นี้ ขอให้โชคดี!
dialogsAccept.tw: 修利在東邊爆咒師祭壇附近的石山修練，所以大概在那附近就可以找到了。
dialogsAccept.vi: Cô ấy thường có thể được tìm thấy khi thiền định trên cao ở vùng núi phía Đông Nam của địa điểm này. Chúc may mắn!

dialogsDecline.en: Well, you can hang around, but don't think you will be eating for free here!
dialogsDecline.ar: Well, you can hang around, but don't think you will be eating for free here!
dialogsDecline.br: Bem, você pode ficar por aqui, mas não pense que vai comer de graça!
dialogsDecline.cns: 好吧，你可以四处闲逛，但不要以为你能在这里白吃白喝！
dialogsDecline.de: Nun, du kannst hier bleiben, aber glaub nicht, dass du hier umsonst isst!
dialogsDecline.fi: Well, you can hang around, but don't think you will be eating for free here!
dialogsDecline.fil: Well, you can hang around, but don't think you will be eating for free here!
dialogsDecline.fr: Si vous avez du temps devant vous, je veux bien que vous alliez chercher plus de racines du néant.
dialogsDecline.id: Yah, Anda bisa berkeliaran, tetapi jangan berpikir Anda akan makan gratis di sini!
dialogsDecline.it: Well, you can hang around, but don't think you will be eating for free here!
dialogsDecline.jp: この辺、散歩していても良いですが、ただで食べられるとは思わないでくださいね！
dialogsDecline.kr: 여기 머물고 싶은 건 알겠지만, 공짜 밥을 바란다면 큰 오산이에요!
dialogsDecline.nl: Well, you can hang around, but don't think you will be eating for free here!
dialogsDecline.pl: Well, you can hang around, but don't think you will be eating for free here!
dialogsDecline.ru: Well, you can hang around, but don't think you will be eating for free here!
dialogsDecline.sp: Bueno, puedes pasar el rato por aquí, ¡pero no pienses que vas a comer gratis!
dialogsDecline.sw: Well, you can hang around, but don't think you will be eating for free here!
dialogsDecline.th: คุณเป็นใคร? คุณกำลังยุ่งเกี่ยวกับการฝึกซ้อมของฉัน จงออกไปจากที่นี่ซะ
dialogsDecline.tw: 如果你沒有那麼急，樹精的根好像有一點不夠，要再幫我收集嗎？
dialogsDecline.vi: Chà, bạn có thể lượn lờ, nhưng đừng nghĩ rằng bạn sẽ được ăn miễn phí ở đây!

dialogsComplete.ar: Hmm, I sense an unknown aura interfering with my meditation…
dialogsComplete.br: Hmm, sinto uma aura desconhecida interferindo na minha meditação…
dialogsComplete.cns: 嗯，我感觉到一股未知的气息干扰了我的冥想…
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm, ich spüre eine unbekannte Aura, die meine Meditation stört...
dialogsComplete.fi: Hmm, I sense an unknown aura interfering with my meditation…
dialogsComplete.fil: Hmm, I sense an unknown aura interfering with my meditation…
dialogsComplete.fr: Hum, pourquoi venez-vous interrompre mon entraînement ?
dialogsComplete.id: Hmm, saya merasakan aura yang tidak diketahui mengganggu meditasi saya ...
dialogsComplete.it: Hmm, I sense an unknown aura interfering with my meditation…
dialogsComplete.jp: どなた……？　修行の邪魔になる。話しかけないほしい。
dialogsComplete.kr: 흠, 알 수 없는 기운이 명상을 방해하는 게 느껴지는데...

dialogsComplete.pl: Hmm, I sense an unknown aura interfering with my meditation…
dialogsComplete.ru: Hmm, I sense an unknown aura interfering with my meditation…
dialogsComplete.sp: Hmm, siento un aura desconocida que interfiere en mi meditación...
dialogsComplete.sw: Hmm, I sense an unknown aura interfering with my meditation…
dialogsComplete.th: อืม ฉันรู้สึกถึงกลิ่นอายที่ไม่รู้จักซึ่งขัดขวางการทำสมาธิของฉัน ...
dialogsComplete.tw: 你是誰？如果你想要妨礙我的修練，最好還是立刻消失吧。
dialogsComplete.vi: Rất tiếc, tôi cảm thấy một luồng khí không xác định đang can thiệp vào quá trình thiền định của tôi…

dialogsFail.en: Yes yes, my food smells delicious. Time for you to go accomplish your mission!
dialogsFail.ar: Yes yes, my food smells delicious. Time for you to go accomplish your mission!

dialogsFail.fi: Yes yes, my food smells delicious. Time for you to go accomplish your mission!
dialogsFail.fil: Yes yes, my food smells delicious. Time for you to go accomplish your mission!
dialogsFail.fr: Encore ici ? Mais quel lambin ! Allez au sud de l'autel du moine !!
dialogsFail.id: Ya ya, makanan saya berbau lezat. Saatnya bagi Anda untuk pergi menyelesaikan misi Anda!
dialogsFail.it: Yes yes, my food smells delicious. Time for you to go accomplish your mission!
dialogsFail.jp: 美味しそうだろう？君はやることをまずやってからだ！行きなさい！
dialogsFail.kr: 그래그래, 제 음식 냄새가 좋긴 하죠. 하지만 이제 임무를 마치러 가 주세요!

dialogsFail.pl: Yes yes, my food smells delicious. Time for you to go accomplish your mission!
dialogsFail.ru: Yes yes, my food smells delicious. Time for you to go accomplish your mission!

dialogsFail.th: ใช่ ใช่แล้ว อาหารอร่อย ทำให้คุณทำภารกิจให้สำเร็จ!
dialogsFail.tw: 還沒有找到修利嗎？應該就在爆咒師祭壇那，快一點過去吧。
dialogsFail.vi: Vâng vâng, thức ăn của tôi có mùi rất hấp dẫn phải chứ. Đã đến lúc bạn phải hoàn thành sứ mệnh của mình!

dialogsBegin.en: Oh, also! My mommy is looking for you... Go talk to her. Don't worry, she is cooled down now.
dialogsBegin.ar: Oh, also! My mommy is looking for you... Go talk to her. Don't worry, she is cooled down now.
dialogsBegin.br: Aéé! Minha mamãe estava te procurando.. Vá falar com ela. Não se preocupe, ela está tranquila agora.
dialogsBegin.cns: Oh, also! My mommy is looking for you... Go talk to her. Don't worry, she is cooled down now.
dialogsBegin.de: Oh, außerdem! Meine Mami sucht dich... Geh und sprich mit ihr. Mach dir keine Sorgen, sie hat sich jetzt abgekühlt.
dialogsBegin.fi: Oh, also! My mommy is looking for you... Go talk to her. Don't worry, she is cooled down now.
dialogsBegin.fil: Oh, also! My mommy is looking for you... Go talk to her. Don't worry, she is cooled down now.
dialogsBegin.fr: Maman a l'air de s'être calmée, vous devriez lui parler à nouveau.
dialogsBegin.id: Oh! Ibuku Mencarimu.. Tolong temui dia. Jangan khawatir, dia sudah tenang sekarang.
dialogsBegin.it: Oh, also! My mommy is looking for you... Go talk to her. Don't worry, she is cooled down now.
dialogsBegin.jp: あ、そうだ。お兄ちゃんを探しているって言ってたよね？そろそろお母さんの怒りも収まるだろうし話してみたら？
dialogsBegin.kr: 오, 맞다! 우리 엄마가 찾던데... 가서 대화해 보세요. 걱정 마세요. 지금은 화가 가라앉았어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Oh, also! My mommy is looking for you... Go talk to her. Don't worry, she is cooled down now.
dialogsBegin.pl: Oh, also! My mommy is looking for you... Go talk to her. Don't worry, she is cooled down now.
dialogsBegin.ru: Oh, also! My mommy is looking for you... Go talk to her. Don't worry, she is cooled down now.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Ah, otra cosa! Mi mami te está buscando. Ve a hablar con ella. No te preocupes, ya se le ha pasado el enfado.
dialogsBegin.sw: Oh, also! My mommy is looking for you... Go talk to her. Don't worry, she is cooled down now.
dialogsBegin.th: อ้อ! แม่ฉันกำลังหาคุณ..ไปคุยกับเธอ ไม่ต้องกังวลน่า ตอนนี้เธอเย็นลงแล้ว
dialogsBegin.tw: 啊，還有！我媽媽正在找你……快去跟她說話吧。別擔心，她現在已經冷靜下來了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Ồ, còn nữa! Mẹ tôi đang tìm bạn đấy .. Hãy nói chuyện với bà ấy. Đừng lo lắng, bây giờ bà ấy bớt giận rồi.

dialogsAccept.en: I think she wants to thank you for helping me!
dialogsAccept.ar: I think she wants to thank you for helping me!
dialogsAccept.br: Acho que ela quer te agradecer por me ajudar!
dialogsAccept.cns: 我想她是想感谢你帮助我！
dialogsAccept.de: Ich glaube, sie möchte sich bei Ihnen für Ihre Hilfe bedanken!
dialogsAccept.fi: I think she wants to thank you for helping me!
dialogsAccept.fil: I think she wants to thank you for helping me!
dialogsAccept.fr: Je vous assure qu'elle n'utilisera pas son martinet de courroux légendaire sur vous.
dialogsAccept.id: Aku rasa dia ingin berterima kasih padamu karena telah membantuku!
dialogsAccept.it: I think she wants to thank you for helping me!
dialogsAccept.jp: 母もきっと私を助けてくれて感謝していると思います！
dialogsAccept.kr: 절 도와주셔서 고맙다고 하고 싶으신가 봐요!
dialogsAccept.nl: I think she wants to thank you for helping me!
dialogsAccept.pl: I think she wants to thank you for helping me!
dialogsAccept.ru: Думаю, она хочет тебя поблагодарить за помощь мне!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Creo que quiere agradecerte que me hayas ayudado!
dialogsAccept.sw: I think she wants to thank you for helping me!
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันคิดว่าเธออยากจะขอบคุณที่ช่วยฉัน!
dialogsAccept.tw: 我想她想感謝你幫助我！
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi nghĩ cô ấy muốn cảm ơn bạn đã giúp tôi!

dialogsComplete.en: Good to see you again. Sorry for earlier, it's just that Nerco makes me so angry sometimes. Anyway, I heard you found something for my daughter.
dialogsComplete.ar: Good to see you again. Sorry for earlier, it's just that Nerco makes me so angry sometimes. Anyway, I heard you found something for my daughter.
dialogsComplete.br: Bom te ver de novo. Desculpe por antes, só que Nerco me deixa com tanta raiva às vezes. De qualquer forma, ouvi que você encontrou algo para minha filha.
dialogsComplete.cns: 很高兴再次见到你。我对我之前的态度感到很抱歉，尼尔科时不时的会让我很生气。不管怎样，我听说你为我的女儿找到了一些东西。
dialogsComplete.de: Schön, Sie wiederzusehen. Entschuldigung für vorhin, es ist nur so, dass Nerco mich manchmal so wütend macht. Wie auch immer, ich habe gehört, Sie haben etwas für meine Tochter gefunden.
dialogsComplete.fi: Good to see you again. Sorry for earlier, it's just that Nerco makes me so angry sometimes. Anyway, I heard you found something for my daughter.
dialogsComplete.fil: Good to see you again. Sorry for earlier, it's just that Nerco makes me so angry sometimes. Anyway, I heard you found something for my daughter.
dialogsComplete.fr: J'ai vu votre manège avec ma fille… bas les pattes !
dialogsComplete.id: Senang bertemu denganmu lagi. Maaf untuk yang sebelumnya, hanya saja Nerco terkadang membuatku sangat marah. Omong-omong, aku mendengar kalau kamu membantu menemukan sesuatu untuk putriku.
dialogsComplete.it: Good to see you again. Sorry for earlier, it's just that Nerco makes me so angry sometimes. Anyway, I heard you found something for my daughter.
dialogsComplete.jp: あら、この間はごめんなさいね。取り乱してしまって… とにかく、あなたが私の娘のために何かを見つけてくれたと聞きました。
dialogsComplete.kr: 마침 잘 왔어요. 아까는 미안했어요. 네르코가 하도 짜증 나게 해서요. 그건 그렇고, 제 딸을 도와주셨다고 들었어요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Good to see you again. Sorry for earlier, it's just that Nerco makes me so angry sometimes. Anyway, I heard you found something for my daughter.
dialogsComplete.pl: Good to see you again. Sorry for earlier, it's just that Nerco makes me so angry sometimes. Anyway, I heard you found something for my daughter.
dialogsComplete.ru: Рада снова тебя видеть. Извини меня, Нерко частенько ухитряется злить меня. Так вот, я слышала, что ты помог моей дочери.
dialogsComplete.sp: Me alegro de verte de nuevo. Perdón por lo de antes, es que a veces Nerco me hace enfadar mucho. Y bueno, he escuchado que has encontrado algo para mi hija.
dialogsComplete.sw: Good to see you again. Sorry for earlier, it's just that Nerco makes me so angry sometimes. Anyway, I heard you found something for my daughter.
dialogsComplete.th: ดีใจที่ได้พบคุณอีกครั้ง ขอโทษที่ก่อนหน้านี้ บางครั้ง Nerco ทำให้ฉันโกรธมาก อย่างไรก็ตาม ฉันได้ยินมาว่าคุณพบบางอย่างสำหรับลูกสาวของฉัน
dialogsComplete.tw: 很高興再次見到你。抱歉之前，只是尼羅可有時讓我很生氣。不管怎樣，我聽說你為我女兒找到了一些東西。
dialogsComplete.vi: Rất vui khi gặp bạn. Xin lỗi vì lúc nãy, chỉ là Nerco đôi khi làm tôi giận quá. Dù sao, tôi nghe nói bạn đã tìm thấy một cái gì đó cho con gái tôi.

dialogsFail.pl: Please go talk with my mommy!

dialogsBegin.en: Alright, I guess I should uphold my end of the promise!
dialogsBegin.ar: Alright, I guess I should uphold my end of the promise!
dialogsBegin.br: Certo, acho que devo cumprir minha parte da promessa!
dialogsBegin.cns: 好吧，我想我应该坚持我的承诺！
dialogsBegin.de: Also gut, ich sollte wohl mein Versprechen einhalten!
dialogsBegin.fi: Alright, I guess I should uphold my end of the promise!
dialogsBegin.fil: Alright, I guess I should uphold my end of the promise!
dialogsBegin.fr: Bien, vous dites que vous cherchez des Héros réincarnés mais pourquoi moi ?
dialogsBegin.id: Baiklah, kurasa aku harus menjunjung tinggi akhir dari janjiku!
dialogsBegin.it: Alright, I guess I should uphold my end of the promise!
dialogsBegin.jp: いいでしょう。もう少し貴方の話を聞いてみる気になりました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 좋아요, 당신의 이야기를 좀 더 들어보도록 하죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: Alright, I guess I should uphold my end of the promise!
dialogsBegin.pl: Alright, I guess I should uphold my end of the promise!
dialogsBegin.ru: Alright, I guess I should uphold my end of the promise!
dialogsBegin.sp: Muy bien, ¡supongo que debo cumplir mi parte del trato!
dialogsBegin.sw: Alright, I guess I should uphold my end of the promise!
dialogsBegin.th: เอาล่ะ ฉันคิดว่าฉันควรจะรักษาสัญญาของฉันไว้!
dialogsBegin.tw: 好吧，我想我應該遵守我的諾言！
dialogsBegin.vi: Được rồi, tôi đoán tôi nên giữ lời hứa của mình!

dialogsBegin.en: You say Zoro is going to reunite with Reonan? Well... He did always like playing the Hero. What's this? A letter from Zoro?
dialogsBegin.ar: You say Zoro is going to reunite with Reonan? Well... He did always like playing the Hero. What's this? A letter from Zoro?
dialogsBegin.br: Você disse que Zoro vai se reunir com Reonan? Bem... Ele sempre gostou de interpretar o Herói, até se autoproclamou de Super Herói. O que é isso? Zoro deixou uma carta?
dialogsBegin.cns: You say Zoro is going to reunite with Reonan? Well... He did always like playing the Hero. What's this? A letter from Zoro?
dialogsBegin.de: Du sagst, Zoro wird sich mit Reonan wieder vereinen? Na ja... Er hat schon immer gerne den Helden gespielt. Was ist das?? Ein Brief von Zoro??
dialogsBegin.fi: You say Zoro is going to reunite with Reonan? Well... He did always like playing the Hero. What's this? A letter from Zoro?
dialogsBegin.fil: You say Zoro is going to reunite with Reonan? Well... He did always like playing the Hero. What's this? A letter from Zoro?
dialogsBegin.fr: Oh, Zoro vous a dit de me trouver ? Il va se joindre à Reonan ?
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu bilang Zoro akan bersatu kembali dengan Reonan? Dia selalu suka berperan menjadi Pahlawan. Apa ini?? Surat dari Zoro??
dialogsBegin.it: You say Zoro is going to reunite with Reonan? Well... He did always like playing the Hero. What's this? A letter from Zoro?
dialogsBegin.jp: なるほど。ゾロとも既にお会いになったのですか？彼はいま解決ゾロという名でダーコン中の問題を解決しているようですね。おや、手紙もあるのですか。
dialogsBegin.kr: 조로가 레오난과 재회할 예정이라고요? 음... 항상 영웅 놀이를 좋아하더니. 이건 뭔가요? 조로가 보낸 편지?
dialogsBegin.nl: You say Zoro is going to reunite with Reonan? Well... He did always like playing the Hero. What's this? A letter from Zoro?
dialogsBegin.pl: You say Zoro is going to reunite with Reonan? Well... He did always like playing the Hero. What's this? A letter from Zoro?
dialogsBegin.ru: You say Zoro is going to reunite with Reonan? Well... He did always like playing the Hero. What's this? A letter from Zoro?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Dices que Zoro se va a reunir con Reonan? Bueno... A él siempre le ha gustado jugar a ser Héroe. ¿¿Qué es esto?? ¿¿Una carta de Zoro??
dialogsBegin.sw: You say Zoro is going to reunite with Reonan? Well... He did always like playing the Hero. What's this? A letter from Zoro?
dialogsBegin.th: คุณบอกว่า Zoro กำลังจะรวมทีมกับ Reonan? ดีล่ะ .. เขาชอบเล่นฮีโร่อยู่เสมอ แล้วนี่คืออะไร? จดหมายจาก Zoro??
dialogsBegin.tw: 你說佐羅要去和雷奧南會合？嗯……他以前就很愛扮英雄。這是什麼？佐羅的信？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn nói Zoro sẽ đoàn tụ với Reonan? Chà .. Anh ấy luôn thích đóng vai Anh hùng. Đây là gì? Một lá thư từ Zoro?

dialogsBegin.en: Alright. I will read his letter. While I do that, would it be possible for another favor? Monsters, known as Garbagespiders, have been ravaging the land. Could you please defeat them?
dialogsBegin.ar: Alright. I will read his letter. While I do that, would it be possible for another favor? Monsters, known as Garbagespiders, have been ravaging the land. Could you please defeat them?
dialogsBegin.br: Tudo bem. Vou ler a carta dele. Enquanto eu faço isso, seria possível outro favor?? Monstros, conhecidos como Lixeiranhas, estão devastando a terra. Você poderia por favor derrotá-las?
dialogsBegin.cns: Alright. I will read his letter. While I do that, would it be possible for another favor? Monsters, known as Garbagespiders, have been ravaging the land. Could you please defeat them?
dialogsBegin.de: Also gut. Ich werde diesen Brief lesen. Wäre es möglich, dass du mir mir in der Zwischenzeit einen weiteren Gefallen tust? Monster, bekannt als Garbagespiders, haben das Land heimgesucht. Bitte beseitige sie.
dialogsBegin.fi: Alright. I will read his letter. While I do that, would it be possible for another favor? Monsters, known as Garbagespiders, have been ravaging the land. Could you please defeat them?
dialogsBegin.fil: Alright. I will read his letter. While I do that, would it be possible for another favor? Monsters, known as Garbagespiders, have been ravaging the land. Could you please defeat them?
dialogsBegin.fr: Pendant que je lis la lettre de Zoro, vous pourriez vous rendre utile et chasser des Garbagespider qui font des trous dans la montagne. C'est vraiment horrible.
dialogsBegin.id: Baiklah. Saya akan membaca suratnya. Sementara saya melakukan itu, apakah memungkinkan untuk minta bantuan lain?? Monster, yang dikenal sebagai Garbagespiders, telah menghancurkan tanah ini. Bisakah kamu mengalahkan mereka?
dialogsBegin.it: Alright. I will read his letter. While I do that, would it be possible for another favor? Monsters, known as Garbagespiders, have been ravaging the land. Could you please defeat them?
dialogsBegin.jp: ふむふむ。これは少し時間をかけて読む必要がありそうですね。すみませんが、もう一つお願いがあります。エルダーガードと共にこの森を破壊するスモール・ガーベイジパイダーを倒してきてくれませんか。
dialogsBegin.kr: 알겠습니다. 편지를 읽어보죠. 읽는 동안, 부탁 하나 더 해도 될까요? 가비지스파이더라는 괴물들이 이 땅을 엉망으로 만들고 있어요. 가서 놈들을 처치해 주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Alright. I will read his letter. While I do that, would it be possible for another favor? Monsters, known as Garbagespiders, have been ravaging the land. Could you please defeat them?
dialogsBegin.pl: W porządku. Przeczytam jego list. Kiedy to zrobię, czy mogę poprosić o kolejną przysługę? Potwory, znane jako Pająkosze, pustoszą ziemię. Czy możesz je pokonać?
dialogsBegin.ru: Alright. I will read his letter. While I do that, would it be possible for another favor? Monsters, known as Garbagespiders, have been ravaging the land. Could you please defeat them?
dialogsBegin.sp: Vale. Leeré su carta. Mientras hago eso, ¿Sería posible otro favor? Los monstruos, conocidos como Garbagespiders, han estado devastando la tierra. ¿Podrías derrotarlos?
dialogsBegin.sw: Alright. I will read his letter. While I do that, would it be possible for another favor? Monsters, known as Garbagespiders, have been ravaging the land. Could you please defeat them?
dialogsBegin.th: โอเค ฉันจะอ่านจดหมายของเขา ระหว่างนี้ ช่วยฉันหน่อย?? มอนสเตอร์ที่รู้จักกันในชื่อ Garbagespiders กำลังสร้างความวุ่นวาย คุณช่วยไปกำจัดมันที
dialogsBegin.tw: 好吧，我來看看他的信。在這段時間，你能不能再幫我一個忙？有種叫垃圾蜘蛛的怪物正在肆虐這片土地。可以請你去擊敗牠們嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Được rồi. Tôi sẽ đọc lá thư của anh ấy. Trong khi đó, bạn có thể giúp tôi một việc khác không? Quái vật Garbagespiders đang tàn phá vùng đất này. Bạn làm ơn hãy tiêu diệt chúng nhé?

dialogsAccept.en: Garbagespiders were once used to assist workers in construction. They have since become cursed and are soley bent on destruction. Please defeat 20 Small Garbagespiders & 15 Garbagespiders.
dialogsAccept.ar: Garbagespiders were once used to assist workers in construction. They have since become cursed and are soley bent on destruction. Please defeat 20 Small Garbagespiders & 15 Garbagespiders.
dialogsAccept.br: As Lixeiranhas já foram utilizadas para ajudar os trabalhadores na construção. Desde então, elas se tornaram amaldiçoados e estão determinadas à destruição. Por favor, abata 20 Lixeiranhas Pequenas e 15 Lixeiranhas.
dialogsAccept.cns: Garbagespiders were once used to assist workers in construction. They have since become cursed and are soley bent on destruction. Please defeat 20 Small Garbagespiders & 15 Garbagespiders.
dialogsAccept.de: Garbagespiders wurden einst als Hilfsmittel für Bauarbeiter eingesetzt. Inzwischen sind sie verflucht und haben es auf Zerstörung abgesehen. Bitte besiege 20 Small Garbagespiders & 15 Garbagespiders.
dialogsAccept.fi: Garbagespiders were once used to assist workers in construction. They have since become cursed and are soley bent on destruction. Please defeat 20 Small Garbagespiders & 15 Garbagespiders.
dialogsAccept.fil: Garbagespiders were once used to assist workers in construction. They have since become cursed and are soley bent on destruction. Please defeat 20 Small Garbagespiders & 15 Garbagespiders.
dialogsAccept.fr: Le temps que tu tues 20 Jeunes Garbagespider et 15 Garbagespider, j'aurai fini la lettre.
dialogsAccept.id: Garbagespiders pernah digunakan untuk membantu pekerja di bidang konstruksi. Sejak itu mereka menjadi terkutuk dan bertekad untuk menghancurkan. Tolong kalahkan 20 Small Garbagespiders & 15 Garbagespiders.
dialogsAccept.it: Garbagespiders were once used to assist workers in construction. They have since become cursed and are soley bent on destruction. Please defeat 20 Small Garbagespiders & 15 Garbagespiders.
dialogsAccept.jp: スモール・ガーベイジパイダーを20体、ガーベイジパイダーを15体討伐してください。その間に私はゾロからの手紙の内容についてじっくりと考えてみますね。
dialogsAccept.kr: 가비지스파이더는 한때 건설 현장에서 일꾼들을 보조하곤 했죠. 하지만 지금은 저주에 걸려 파괴에만 몰두하고 있어요. 작은 가비지스파이더 20마리와 가비지스파이더 15마리를 처치해 주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Garbagespiders were once used to assist workers in construction. They have since become cursed and are soley bent on destruction. Please defeat 20 Small Garbagespiders & 15 Garbagespiders.
dialogsAccept.pl: Pająkosze były kiedyś używane do pomocy robotnikom w budownictwie. Od tego czasu zostali przeklęci i dążą wyłącznie do zniszczenia. Pokonaj 20 Małych Pająkoszy i 15 Pająkoszy.
dialogsAccept.ru: Garbagespiders were once used to assist workers in construction. They have since become cursed and are soley bent on destruction. Please defeat 20 Small Garbagespiders & 15 Garbagespiders.
dialogsAccept.sp: Los Garbagespiders se usaban para ayudar a los trabajadores en la construcción. Desde entonces, se han vuelto malvados y están empeñados en la destrucción. Derrota a 20 Garbagespiders Pequeños y a 15 Garbagespiders.
dialogsAccept.sw: Garbagespiders were once used to assist workers in construction. They have since become cursed and are soley bent on destruction. Please defeat 20 Small Garbagespiders & 15 Garbagespiders.
dialogsAccept.th: ครั้งหนึ่งเคยใช้Garbagespiders ช่วยคนงานในการก่อสร้าง นับแต่นั้นมาพวกเขาถูกสาปแช่งและมุ่งแต่ความพินาศ โปรดกำจัดSmall Garbagespiders  20 ตัวและGarbagespiders15 ตัว
dialogsAccept.tw: 清道夫機械曾經被用來協助工人進行施工。從那以後，他們受到了詛咒，一心想要毀滅。請擊敗 20 隻清道夫機械嘍囉和 15 隻清道夫機械。
dialogsAccept.vi: Garbagespiders từng được sử dụng để hỗ trợ công nhân xây dựng. Kể từ đó, chúng trở nên bị nguyền rủa và bị hủy hoại. Hãy đánh bại 20 Small Garbagespiders & 15 Garbagespiders.

dialogsDecline.fi: Hmm… I would prefer to read the letter without anyone around…
dialogsDecline.fil: Hmm… I would prefer to read the letter without anyone around…
dialogsDecline.fr: Hum ? Non, je ne lis pas devant le premier venu !
dialogsDecline.id: Hmm... Saya lebih suka membaca surat itu tanpa ada orang di sekitarku...
dialogsDecline.it: Hmm… I would prefer to read the letter without anyone around…
dialogsDecline.jp: そうですか。では、私のこともそっとしておいて下さい。
dialogsDecline.kr: 흐음… 전 누가 보는 앞에서는 편지를 읽지 않습니다만…
dialogsDecline.nl: Hmm… I would prefer to read the letter without anyone around…
dialogsDecline.pl: Hmm… I would prefer to read the letter without anyone around…
dialogsDecline.ru: Hmm… I would prefer to read the letter without anyone around…
dialogsDecline.sp: Hmm… preferiría leer la carta sin nadie alrededor…
dialogsDecline.sw: Hmm… I would prefer to read the letter without anyone around…
dialogsDecline.th: อืม ... ฉันอยากจะอ่านหนังสือโดยไม่มีใครอยู่รอบ ๆ ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 嗯…要是有人站在我的前面，我就不會看信…
dialogsDecline.vi: Hmm… Tôi muốn đọc lá thư mà không có ai bên cạnh…

dialogsBegin.en: Zoro wrote this letter to convince me… but no!! I thought about it and nothing can change my mind. After the war, I promised myself I would never kill again… I intend to uphold that vow…
dialogsBegin.ar: Zoro wrote this letter to convince me… but no!! I thought about it and nothing can change my mind. After the war, I promised myself I would never kill again… I intend to uphold that vow…
dialogsBegin.br: Zoro escreveu esta carta para me convencer… mas não!! Eu pensei sobre isso e nada pode mudar minha mente. Depois da guerra, prometi a mim mesmo que nunca mais mataria… pretendo manter essa promessa…
dialogsBegin.cns: 佐罗写这封信是为了说服我......但是没有！！！我想过了，没有什么能改变我的想法。战争结束后，我向自己保证不再杀戮......我打算坚守这一誓言......
dialogsBegin.de: Zoro hat diesen Brief geschrieben, um mich zu überzeugen... aber nein!! Ich habe darüber nachgedacht und nichts kann meine Meinung ändern. Nach dem Krieg habe ich mir geschworen, nie wieder zu töten... Ich werde mich an diesen Schwur halten...
dialogsBegin.fi: Zoro wrote this letter to convince me… but no!! I thought about it and nothing can change my mind. After the war, I promised myself I would never kill again… I intend to uphold that vow…
dialogsBegin.fil: Zoro wrote this letter to convince me… but no!! I thought about it and nothing can change my mind. After the war, I promised myself I would never kill again… I intend to uphold that vow…
dialogsBegin.fr: Zoro a raison votre cause est juste mais je ne me joindrai pas à vous. Il y a vraiment trop à faire ici.
dialogsBegin.id: Zoro menulis surat ini untuk meyakinkanku... tapi tidak!! Saya sudah memikirkannya dan tidak ada yang bisa merubah pikiranku. Setelah perang, saya berjanji pada diri sendiri bahwa saya tidak akan pernah membunuh lagi ... Saya bertekad untuk menjunjung tinggi sumpah itu ...
dialogsBegin.it: Zoro wrote this letter to convince me… but no!! I thought about it and nothing can change my mind. After the war, I promised myself I would never kill again… I intend to uphold that vow…
dialogsBegin.jp: ゾロの言い分はわかりました。しかし私はたとえモンスターといえども無益な闘いには参加したくありません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 조로는 절 설득하려고 편지를 쓴 거겠죠... 하지만 안 돼요! 생각은 충분히 했고, 제 마음은 변하지 않습니다. 전쟁이 끝난 후, 다시는 사람을 죽이지 않겠다고 다짐했습니다…
dialogsBegin.nl: Zoro wrote this letter to convince me… but no!! I thought about it and nothing can change my mind. After the war, I promised myself I would never kill again… I intend to uphold that vow…
dialogsBegin.pl: Zoro wrote this letter to convince me… but no!! I thought about it and nothing can change my mind. After the war, I promised myself I would never kill again… I intend to uphold that vow…
dialogsBegin.ru: Зоро пытается этим письмом переубедить меня…но НЕТ!! Я размышляла над этим вариантом и отказываюсь менять своё мнение. После войны я пообещала, что больше не буду убивать… И собираюсь быть верной своей клятве…
dialogsBegin.sp: Zoro escribió esta carta para convencerme… ¡¡pero no!! Ya lo he decidido y nada puede hacerme cambiar de opinión. Después de la guerra, me prometí a mí mismo que nunca volvería a matar... Tengo la intención de mantener ese voto...
dialogsBegin.sw: Zoro wrote this letter to convince me… but no!! I thought about it and nothing can change my mind. After the war, I promised myself I would never kill again… I intend to uphold that vow…
dialogsBegin.th: Zoro เขียนจดหมายฉบับนี้เพื่อโน้มน้าวฉัน ... แต่ไม่ !! ฉันคิดถึงเรื่องนั้นแล้วและไม่มีอะไรที่สามารถเปลี่ยนความคิดของฉันได้ หลังจากสงครามฉันสัญญากับตัวเองว่าฉันจะไม่ฆ่าอีก ... ฉันตั้งใจที่จะรักษาคำปฏิญาณไว้ ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 索羅寫了一些想說服我的話。但是我的想法很頑固。就算是再怎麼邪惡怪物，我也不想親自殺了他們。再次重生的我，絕對不要再殺生。
dialogsBegin.vi: Zoro đã viết lá thư này để thuyết phục tôi… nhưng không !! Tôi đã nghĩ về điều đó và không gì có thể thay đổi suy nghĩ của tôi. Sau chiến tranh, tôi tự hứa với bản thân sẽ không bao giờ giết người nữa… Tôi định giữ vững lời thề đó…

dialogsAccept.vi: Cảm ơn bạn. Khi Zoro đọc bức thư này, anh ấy sẽ hiểu hết lý do của tôi…

dialogsDecline.de: Ich hoffe, Sie werden es sich noch einmal überlegen. Ich möchte, dass Zoro meine Gründe für die Ablehnung des Angebots versteht.

dialogsDecline.sw: I hope you will reconsider. I want Zoro to understand my reasons for declining the offer.
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันหวังว่าคุณจะพิจารณาใหม่ ฉันต้องการให้ Zoro เข้าใจเหตุผลของฉันในการปฏิเสธข้อเสนอนี้

dialogsBegin.en: Do not fool yourself into believing that was the only test. Next, please defeat the Shuhamma for me.
dialogsBegin.ar: Do not fool yourself into believing that was the only test. Next, please defeat the Shuhamma for me.

dialogsBegin.en: Why, this is not a code… Amazing! The language of the Ancient Tribe. This Bartholomew Hunt must have really known his stuff. Maybe there is more to this…
dialogsBegin.ar: Why, this is not a code… Amazing! The language of the Ancient Tribe. This Bartholomew Hunt must have really known his stuff. Maybe there is more to this…
dialogsBegin.br: Ora, isso não é um código... Incrível! É a língua da Tribo Antiga. Este Bartholomew Hunt deve ter realmente conhecido muitas coisas. Talvez haja mais nisso…
dialogsBegin.cns: 为什么...这并不是一种代码...令人震惊！这是一种古代部落的语言。这位巴塞洛缪·亨特一定很了解这些。继续看，也许还会有更多的内容...
dialogsBegin.de: Das ist doch kein Code... Erstaunlich! Die Sprache des antiken Stammes. Dieser Bartholomew Hunt muss sich wirklich gut ausgekannt haben. Vielleicht ist da mehr dran...
dialogsBegin.fi: Why, this is not a code… Amazing! The language of the Ancient Tribe. This Bartholomew Hunt must have really known his stuff. Maybe there is more to this…
dialogsBegin.fil: Why, this is not a code… Amazing! The language of the Ancient Tribe. This Bartholomew Hunt must have really known his stuff. Maybe there is more to this…
dialogsBegin.fr: Voilà, j'ai fini. Harmonin devait être un homme cultivé. Il connait le langage de l'Ancienne Tribu.
dialogsBegin.id: Tunggu, ini bukan kode… Luar biasa! Bahasa Ancient Tribe. Bartholomew hunt ini pasti sangat tahu banyak hal. Mungkin ada yang lebih dari ini...
dialogsBegin.it: Why, this is not a code… Amazing! The language of the Ancient Tribe. This Bartholomew Hunt must have really known his stuff. Maybe there is more to this…
dialogsBegin.jp: よし、もう目を開けてよいぞ。しかし…ハーモニンという者は想像以上に博識な人物だったようじゃな。このような古代文字を知っていたとはのう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 와, 이건 암호가 아니군요... 놀라운데요! 고대 부족의 언어입니다. 이 바솔로뮤 헌트라는 인물, 정말 대단한 사람이군요. 어쩌면 이 뒤에 뭔가 더 있을지도 모르겠네요…
dialogsBegin.nl: Why, this is not a code… Amazing! The language of the Ancient Tribe. This Bartholomew Hunt must have really known his stuff. Maybe there is more to this…
dialogsBegin.pl: Why, this is not a code… Amazing! The language of the Ancient Tribe. This Bartholomew Hunt must have really known his stuff. Maybe there is more to this…
dialogsBegin.ru: Но это же не шифр... Удивительно! Кто бы мог подумать, что Хук знал язык Древних! Он и правда был великим исследователем...
dialogsBegin.sp: Esto no es un código... ¡Increíble! El lenguaje de la Tribu Antigua. Este Bartholomew Hunt sabía muy bien lo que hacía. Puede que descubramos algo más en el diario…
dialogsBegin.sw: Why, this is not a code… Amazing! The language of the Ancient Tribe. This Bartholomew Hunt must have really known his stuff. Maybe there is more to this…
dialogsBegin.th: ทำไม นี่ไม่ใช่รหัส… น่าทึ่ง! ภาษาของชนเผ่าโบราณ นักล่าบาร์โธโลมิวคนนี้คงรู้เรื่องของเขาแล้วจริงๆ อาจจะมีมากกว่านี้…
dialogsBegin.tw: 為什麼，這不是代碼……太棒了！古代部落的語言，這個巴塞洛繆亨特一定很了解他的東西。也許還有更多……
dialogsBegin.vi: Tại sao, đây không phải là một mã… Thật tuyệt vời! Ngôn ngữ của bộ lạc cổ đại. Bartholomew Hunt này chắc hẳn đã thực sự biết những thứ của anh ta. Có lẽ còn nhiều điều hơn thế này…

dialogsDecline.id: Aku tidak percaya ini! Kemungkinan adanya tanah baru dan Kau tidak tertarik???
