dialogsDecline.jp: おぬし、歴史の一部に触れてみる気はないのかね？
dialogsDecline.kr: 말도 안 돼! 새로운 땅을 발견할지도 모르는데, 관심이 없다고요?
dialogsDecline.nl: I can't believe it! The possibility of a new land and you are not interested?
dialogsDecline.pl: I can't believe it! The possibility of a new land and you are not interested?
dialogsDecline.ru: I can't believe it! The possibility of a new land and you are not interested?
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡No puedo creerlo! La posibilidad de un nuevo continente y ¿¿¿no te interesa???
dialogsDecline.sw: I can't believe it! The possibility of a new land and you are not interested?
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันไม่อยากเชื่อเลย! ความเป็นไปได้ของดินแดนใหม่และคุณบอกว่าไม่สนใจ???
dialogsDecline.tw: 真不敢相信！有新大陸的可能性，你居然一點興趣都沒有？
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi không thể tin được! Khả năng xuất hiện một vùng đất mới đang hiện diện và bạn không thèm quan tâm sao?

dialogsComplete.en: You can't imagine how eagerly I've been waiting for you to return. Have you met the Sage Radion? Is there news?
dialogsComplete.ar: You can't imagine how eagerly I've been waiting for you to return. Have you met the Sage Radion? Is there news?
dialogsComplete.br: Você não pode imaginar como eu estava esperando ansiosamente pelo seu retorno. Você já conheceu o Sábio Radion? Há novidades?
dialogsComplete.cns: 你无法想象我有多迫切地期待你回来。你见到大贤者拉迪温了吗？有什么新消息吗？
dialogsComplete.de: Ihr könnt Euch nicht vorstellen, wie sehnsüchtig ich auf Eure Rückkehr gewartet habe. Habt Ihr den Sage Radion getroffen? Gibt es Neuigkeiten?
dialogsComplete.fi: You can't imagine how eagerly I've been waiting for you to return. Have you met the Sage Radion? Is there news?
dialogsComplete.fil: You can't imagine how eagerly I've been waiting for you to return. Have you met the Sage Radion? Is there news?
dialogsComplete.fr: Bonjour mon ami. J'étais impatient de vous revoir. Qu'a dit le très sage Radéon ?
dialogsComplete.id: Kamu tidak dapat membayangkan betapa bersemangatnya aku menunggumu kembali. Apa kamu bertemu dengan Sage Radion? Apakah ada kabar?
dialogsComplete.it: You can't imagine how eagerly I've been waiting for you to return. Have you met the Sage Radion? Is there news?
dialogsComplete.jp: おお、君が来るのを待っていたよ。それで、｢大賢者｣ラディオンには会えたのかい？
dialogsComplete.kr: 얼마나 기다렸는지 상상도 못 하실 거예요. 현자 라디온은 만나셨나요? 어땠죠?
dialogsComplete.nl: You can't imagine how eagerly I've been waiting for you to return. Have you met the Sage Radion? Is there news?
dialogsComplete.pl: You can't imagine how eagerly I've been waiting for you to return. Have you met the Sage Radion? Is there news?
dialogsComplete.ru: You can't imagine how eagerly I've been waiting for you to return. Have you met the Sage Radion? Is there news?
dialogsComplete.sp: No te imaginas las ansias que tenía de que volvieras. ¿Te has reunido con el Sabio Radion? ¿Hay novedades?
dialogsComplete.sw: You can't imagine how eagerly I've been waiting for you to return. Have you met the Sage Radion? Is there news?
dialogsComplete.th: คุณนึกภาพไม่ออกเลยว่าฉันรอคุณกลับมาอย่างกระตือรือร้นแค่ไหน คุณได้พบกับ Sage Radion หรือไม่? มีข่าวไหม?
dialogsComplete.tw: 你無法想像我是多麼急切地等待你回來。你見到大賢者拉迪溫了嗎？有消息嗎？
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn không thể tưởng tượng được rằng tôi đã háo hức chờ đợi bạn trở về như thế nào. Bạn đã gặp Sage Radion chưa? Có tin tức không?

dialogsComplete.en: He was able to translate it? Wonderful. Now we can see if this is real or just a wild goose chase… Give me a moment to read through this.
dialogsComplete.ar: He was able to translate it? Wonderful. Now we can see if this is real or just a wild goose chase… Give me a moment to read through this.
dialogsComplete.br: Ele foi capaz de traduzi-lo? Maravilhoso. Agora podemos ver se isso é real ou apenas uma perseguição... Dê-me um momento para ler isso.
dialogsComplete.cns: 他翻译了日记吗？不错，现在我们可以看看这是真的还是白费力气了。请给我一些时间阅读一下翻译文档。
dialogsComplete.de: Er konnte es übersetzen? Wunderbar. Jetzt können wir sehen, ob das echt ist oder nur eine wilde Verfolgungsjagd... Geben Sie mir einen Moment, um das durchzulesen.
dialogsComplete.fi: He was able to translate it? Wonderful. Now we can see if this is real or just a wild goose chase… Give me a moment to read through this.
dialogsComplete.fil: He was able to translate it? Wonderful. Now we can see if this is real or just a wild goose chase… Give me a moment to read through this.
dialogsComplete.fr: Il a déchiffré le document ? Merci !! Acceptez ce gage de ma gratitude. Revenez quand vous voulez mon ami.
dialogsComplete.id: Dia mampu menerjemahkannya? Luar biasa. Sekarang kita bisa melihat apakah ini nyata atau hanya hal yang sia-sia… Beri aku waktu untuk membaca ini.
dialogsComplete.it: He was able to translate it? Wonderful. Now we can see if this is real or just a wild goose chase… Give me a moment to read through this.
dialogsComplete.jp: これが、解読した文書なんだね？ありがとう。これはお礼です。少ないけれど受け取ってほしい。君には本当に感謝している。たまにはダーコンにも遊びに来るといい。君とは色々な意味で仲良くなれる気がするよ。はっはっはっ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이걸 해독하다니? 훌륭하군요. 이제 이게 진짜인지, 아니면 터무니없는 이야기인지 확인할 수 있겠어요... 문서를 읽어볼 테니 잠시만 시간을 줘요.
dialogsComplete.nl: He was able to translate it? Wonderful. Now we can see if this is real or just a wild goose chase… Give me a moment to read through this.
dialogsComplete.pl: He was able to translate it? Wonderful. Now we can see if this is real or just a wild goose chase… Give me a moment to read through this.
dialogsComplete.ru: He was able to translate it? Wonderful. Now we can see if this is real or just a wild goose chase… Give me a moment to read through this.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿Fue capaz de traducirlo? Maravilloso. Ahora podemos ver si esto es real o sólo una búsqueda inútil... Dame un momento para leerlo.
dialogsComplete.sw: He was able to translate it? Wonderful. Now we can see if this is real or just a wild goose chase… Give me a moment to read through this.
dialogsComplete.th: เขาสามารถแปลมันได้หรือไม่? มหัศจรรย์มาก ตอนนี้เราจะได้เห็นแล้วว่านี่เป็นเรื่องจริงหรือแค่การไล่ล่าห่านป่า... ขอเวลาอ่านเรื่องนี้สักครู่
dialogsComplete.tw: 他能解譯嗎？太棒了！現在我們可以看看這是真實的？！還是只是一場瘋狂的追逐…給我一點時間來閱讀這個。
dialogsComplete.vi: Anh ấy đã có thể dịch nó? Tuyệt vời. Bây giờ chúng ta có thể biết đây là thật hay chỉ là một cuộc rượt đuổi ngỗng hoang… Hãy cho tôi một chút thời gian để đọc qua phần này.

dialogsFail.en: The Mayor of Darkon is waiting for you. Hurry!
dialogsFail.ar: The Mayor of Darkon is waiting for you. Hurry!
dialogsFail.br: O Prefeito de Darken te está esperando, você já devia estar lá. Depressa!
dialogsFail.cns: 达肯市长正在等着你。赶快！
dialogsFail.de: Der Bürgermeister von Darkon wartet auf dich. Beeil dich!
dialogsFail.fi: The Mayor of Darkon is waiting for you. Hurry!
dialogsFail.fil: The Mayor of Darkon is waiting for you. Hurry!
dialogsFail.fr: Ne faites pas attendre le maire de Darkon.
dialogsFail.id: Mayor of Darkon sedang menunggumu. Cepat!
dialogsFail.it: The Mayor of Darkon is waiting for you. Hurry!
dialogsFail.jp: ダーコン市長が待ってるので急いでください。
dialogsFail.kr: 다콘 시장이 기다리고 있습니다. 서두르세요!
dialogsFail.nl: The Mayor of Darkon is waiting for you. Hurry!
dialogsFail.pl: The Mayor of Darkon is waiting for you. Hurry!
dialogsFail.ru: The Mayor of Darkon is waiting for you. Hurry!
dialogsFail.sp: El Alcalde de Darken te está esperando. ¡Rápido!
dialogsFail.sw: The Mayor of Darkon is waiting for you. Hurry!
dialogsFail.th: นายกเทศมนตรีแห่ง Darkon กำลังรอคุณอยู่ รีบไป!
dialogsFail.tw: 得肯市長在等你，快！
dialogsFail.vi: Thị trưởng của Darkon đang đợi bạn. Khẩn trương lên!

name.jp: 英雄の後継者―マスター
name.th: ผู้สืบทอดวีรบุรุษ - Master

description.en: I'll need to see what you can do before I'll allow your training. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
description.ar: I'll need to see what you can do before I'll allow your training. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
description.br: Preciso ver o que você pode fazer antes de permitir seu treinamento. Mate $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s a sudoeste das Montanhas Gouthan. Eles devem ser $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s comuns, não os pequenos ou capitães.
description.cns: 在我允许你去训练之前，我需要知道你的实力。请杀死$QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$个在永恒森林西南部的中型 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$怪物。请注意，不是小型或者大型的$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$怪物。
description.de: Ich muss erst sehen was du kannst, bevor ich dein Training erlaube. Töte $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s südwestlich der Gouthan-Berge.Es müssen normale $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s sein. Keine Small oder Captain.
description.fi: I'll need to see what you can do before I'll allow your training. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
description.fil: I'll need to see what you can do before I'll allow your training. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
description.fr: Commence par tuer $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s au sud-ouest des montagnes de Gouthan. Il s'agit de $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s adultes, pas des jeunes ni des capitaines.
description.id: Aku perlu melihat apa yang dapat kamu lakukan sebelum aku mengizinkan pelatihanmu. Bunuh $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ di barat daya Gouthan Mountain. Mereka hanyalah $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ biasa, bukan jenis kecil ataupun kapten.
description.it: I'll need to see what you can do before I'll allow your training. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
description.jp: トレーニングを許可する前に、能力を見ておく必要があります。$QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$体の$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を倒してください。ゴウダン山脈の南西、通常の$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を倒すようにしてください。スモールでもキャプテンでもありません。
description.kr: 훈련을 시작하기 전에 당신 실력을 먼저 확인해야겠군요, 고우단 산맥 남서쪽에 있는 $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$마리를 처치하고 오세요. 작은 드릴러나 두목 드릴러가 아닌, 일반 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$만 해당합니다.
description.nl: I'll need to see what you can do before I'll allow your training. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
description.pl: I'll need to see what you can do before I'll allow your training. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
description.ru: К юго-западу от Гутанских гор водится $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$. Они бывают сильные и слабые, но мне нужно убить $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ обычных.
description.sp: Tendré que ver lo que puedes hacer antes de permitirte entrenar. Derrota $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s al suroeste de las Montañas Gouthan. Deben ser $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s normales, no de la variedad Pequeño o Capitán.
description.sw: I'll need to see what you can do before I'll allow your training. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
description.th: ฉันต้องดูว่าคุณสามารถทำอะไรได้บ้างก่อนที่จะอนุญาตให้ฝึก สังหาร $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s ทางตะวันตกเฉียงใต้ของ Gouthan Mountains ต้องเป็น $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s ปกติ ไม่ใช่พันธุ์เล็กหรือพันธุ์กัปตัน
description.tw: 在准許你接受訓練前，我得先看看你的本事。前往古坦山脈西南方，擊敗 $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ 隻 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$。目標必須是普通的 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$，不要攻擊小型或隊長級的種類。
description.vi: Tôi cần xem bạn có thể làm gì trước khi cho phép đào tạo. Giết $ QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT $ $ QUEST_END_KILL_NAME $ s về phía tây nam của Dãy núi Gouthan. Chúng phải là loại $ QUEST_END_KILL_NAME $ s thông thường, không phải loại nhỏ hoặc loại lớn.

dialogsBegin.en: You think you have what it takes to be a successor of the Ranger Hero? We will see…
dialogsBegin.ar: You think you have what it takes to be a successor of the Ranger Hero? We will see…
dialogsBegin.br: Obrigada por me visitar. No entanto, eu ainda não tenho certeza se você merece ser um sucessor do Herói Ranger.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你认为你有能力成为游侠英雄的继承者吗？我们拭目以待…
dialogsBegin.de: Glaubst du, du hast das Zeug zum Nachfolger des Ranger Helden? Das werden wir ja sehen...
dialogsBegin.fi: You think you have what it takes to be a successor of the Ranger Hero? We will see…
dialogsBegin.fil: You think you have what it takes to be a successor of the Ranger Hero? We will see…
dialogsBegin.fr: Souhaites-tu être l'un des successeurs de Hynan, Héros des Rangers ? Ce n'est pas une tâche facile, mais je pense que tu en es capable...
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu pikir apa saja yang diperlukan untuk menjadi penerus Ranger Hero? Kita lihat…
dialogsBegin.it: You think you have what it takes to be a successor of the Ranger Hero? We will see…
dialogsBegin.jp: ここまで来ることが出来た功績を讃えます。お疲れ様でした。しかし、私には、あなたにレンジャー後継者としてふさわしいかどうか、まだ判断は出来ません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 본인이 레인저 영웅의 후계자가 될 자질이 있다고 생각하시나요? 어디, 두고 볼까요…
dialogsBegin.nl: You think you have what it takes to be a successor of the Ranger Hero? We will see…
dialogsBegin.pl: You think you have what it takes to be a successor of the Ranger Hero? We will see…
dialogsBegin.ru: You think you have what it takes to be a successor of the Ranger Hero? We will see…
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Crees que tienes lo necesario para ser un sucesor del Héroe Ranger? Ya lo veremos…
dialogsBegin.sw: You think you have what it takes to be a successor of the Ranger Hero? We will see…
dialogsBegin.th: คุณคิดว่าคุณมีสิ่งที่จะเป็นทายาทของ Ranger Hero งั้นเหรอ? เราจะได้รู้กัน...
dialogsBegin.tw: 辛苦你來到這裡～可是我現在無法判斷你是否有成為浪人的能力。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn nghĩ bạn có những gì để trở thành người kế nhiệm của Ranger Hero? Chúng ta sẽ thấy…

dialogsBegin.en: Fine, I'll humor you. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
dialogsBegin.ar: Fine, I'll humor you. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
dialogsBegin.br: Ok, um simples teste. Mate $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s a sudoeste das Montanhas Gouthan. Eles devem ser $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, não incomode os pequenos ou capitães.
dialogsBegin.cns: 好吧，就随你的意思。请去杀死$QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$个在永恒森林西南部的中型$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$。请注意不能是小型的或者大型的种类。
dialogsBegin.de: Na schön, ich werde dich bei Laune halten. Erledige $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s südwestlich der Gouthan-Berge. Es müssen normale $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s sein. Keine Small oder Captain.
dialogsBegin.fi: Fine, I'll humor you. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
dialogsBegin.fil: Fine, I'll humor you. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
dialogsBegin.fr: Commence par tuer $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s au sud-ouest des montagnes de Gouthan. Il s'agit de $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s adultes, pas des jeunes ni des capitaines.
dialogsBegin.id: Baiklah, aku akan menghiburmu. Bunuh $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s di barat daya Gouthan Mountains. Mereka harus biasa $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, bukan jenis kecil ataupun kapten.
dialogsBegin.it: Fine, I'll humor you. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
dialogsBegin.jp: そこで、ひとつ簡単なテストを行います。ゴウダン山の南西に生息している$QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$体の$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を狩って来てください。よいですか、$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$です。スモールやキャプテンではありません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 좋아요, 한 번 봐 드릴게요. 고우단 산맥 남서쪽에서 드릴러 $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$마리를 처치하고 오세요. 작은 드릴러나 두목 드릴러가 아닌, 일반 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$만 해당합니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Fine, I'll humor you. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
dialogsBegin.pl: Fine, I'll humor you. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
dialogsBegin.ru: Ладно, начнем с простого! Отправляйся-ка ты на юго-запад от Гутанских гор, где-то там водится $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$. Мне нужно, чтобы ты победил $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$. Не сильных, не слабых - простых, обычных. Все понятно?
dialogsBegin.sp: Bueno, te seguiré la corriente. Mata $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s al suroeste de las Montañas Gouthan. Deben ser $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s normales, no de la variedad Pequeño o Capitán.
dialogsBegin.sw: Fine, I'll humor you. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
dialogsBegin.th: ได้ งั้นลองทำให้ฉันพอใจสิ จงไปสังหาร $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s ทางตะวันตกเฉียงใต้ของ Gouthan Mountains พวกมันต้องเป็น $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s แบบปกติไม่ใช่แบบ Small หรือ Captain
dialogsBegin.tw: 好吧，就陪你玩玩。前往古坦山脈西南方，擊敗 $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ 隻 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$。目標必須是普通的 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$，不要攻擊小型或隊長級的種類。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tốt thôi, tôi sẽ hài hước với bạn. Đánh $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ s về phía tây nam của Dãy núi Gouthan. Chúng phải là loại $ QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s thông thường, không phải loại nhỏ hoặc loại lớn.

dialogsAccept.en: Show me what you can do and I might consider allowing you to continue on the path of the Ranger Hero.
dialogsAccept.ar: Show me what you can do and I might consider allowing you to continue on the path of the Ranger Hero.
dialogsAccept.br: Acredito que você consiga fazer isso.
dialogsAccept.cns: 我相信你的能力！
dialogsAccept.de: Überzeuge mich von deinen Fähigkeiten und ich überlege mir, ob du das Zeug zum nächsten Ranger Helden hast.
dialogsAccept.fi: Show me what you can do and I might consider allowing you to continue on the path of the Ranger Hero.
dialogsAccept.fil: Show me what you can do and I might consider allowing you to continue on the path of the Ranger Hero.
dialogsAccept.fr: Ma requête est assez simple : débarrasse-toi de 20 Drillers à KhipRa, Darkon 1. Pas des Jeunes ou des Capitaines Drillers, juste des Drillers.
dialogsAccept.id: Tunjukkan padaku apa yang dapat kamu lakukan dan aku mungkin akan mempertimbangkan untuk mengizinkanmu melanjutkan perjalanan Ranger Hero.
dialogsAccept.it: Show me what you can do and I might consider allowing you to continue on the path of the Ranger Hero.
dialogsAccept.jp: あなたの実力を見せてください。レンジャーヒーローの道を歩み続けることを許可できるかもしれません！
dialogsAccept.kr: 당산의 실력을 보여주세요. 그러면 레인저 영웅의 길을 계속 걷을 수 있도록 도와줄지 저도 고려해 보죠.
dialogsAccept.nl: Show me what you can do and I might consider allowing you to continue on the path of the Ranger Hero.
dialogsAccept.pl: Show me what you can do and I might consider allowing you to continue on the path of the Ranger Hero.
dialogsAccept.ru: Прояви себя, и тогда посмотрим, по плечу ли тебе Путь стрелка.
dialogsAccept.sp: Muéstrame lo que puedes hacer y consideraré si te permito seguir el camino del Héroe Ranger.
dialogsAccept.sw: Show me what you can do and I might consider allowing you to continue on the path of the Ranger Hero.
dialogsAccept.th: แสดงให้ฉันเห็นว่าคุณสามารถทำอะไรได้บ้าง และบางทีฉันอาจลองพิจารณาให้คุณเดินตามเส้นทางของฮีโร่ Ranger Hero ต่อไป
dialogsAccept.tw: 讓我看看你的能耐，我或許會考慮讓你繼續走上遊俠英雄之路。
dialogsAccept.vi: Hãy chỉ cho tôi những gì bạn có thể làm và tôi có thể cân nhắc cho phép bạn tiếp tục con đường của Ranger Hero.

dialogsDecline.en: That's too bad because I sense potential in you. You must not be ready for the challenges that lie ahead. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ar: That's too bad because I sense potential in you. You must not be ready for the challenges that lie ahead. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.br: Isso é uma pena porque eu sinto potencial em você. Você não deve estar pronto(a) para os desafios que estão por vir. Venha me ver novamente se mudar de ideia.
dialogsDecline.cns: 那太可惜了，因为我感觉到了你的潜力。如果你改变主意，请再来找我。
dialogsDecline.de: Du kannst nicht den groben und schwierigen Weg eines Nachfolgers des Jester bestreiten, wenn nicht einmal diesen einfachen Test bestehen kannst.
dialogsDecline.fi: That's too bad because I sense potential in you. You must not be ready for the challenges that lie ahead. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fil: That's too bad because I sense potential in you. You must not be ready for the challenges that lie ahead. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fr: Si tu es effectivement le successeur du Héros, ce test devrait être une formalité.
dialogsDecline.id: Itu terlalu buruk karena aku merasakan potensi dalam dirimu. Kamu tidak harus siap untuk tantangan yang ada di depan. Temui aku lagi jika kamu berubah pikiran.
dialogsDecline.it: That's too bad because I sense potential in you. You must not be ready for the challenges that lie ahead. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.jp: こんな簡単なテストさえ成し遂げられない者に、ジェスター後継者としての険しい道を歩ませるなんて、私には出来ません。
dialogsDecline.kr: 안타깝네요. 잠재력이 있다고 생각했는데... 아직 앞에 놓인 도전에 감당할 준비가 안 된 모양이에요. 마음이 바뀌면 다시 찾아오세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: That's too bad because I sense potential in you. You must not be ready for the challenges that lie ahead. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.pl: That's too bad because I sense potential in you. You must not be ready for the challenges that lie ahead. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ru: That's too bad because I sense potential in you. You must not be ready for the challenges that lie ahead. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.sp: Es una lástima porque veo potencial en ti. Supongo que no estás preparado para los desafíos que tienes por delante. Ven a verme de nuevo si cambias de opinión.
dialogsDecline.sw: That's too bad because I sense potential in you. You must not be ready for the challenges that lie ahead. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.th: นั่นมันแย่มากเพราะฉันคาดหวังศักยภาพในตัวคุณ คุณยังไม่พร้อมสำหรับความท้าทายที่อยู่ข้างหน้า มาพบฉันอีกครั้งถ้าคุณเปลี่ยนใจ
dialogsDecline.tw: 這太糟糕了，因為我感覺到你的潛力。你一定不能為即將到來的挑戰做好準備。如果你改變主意，再來找我。
dialogsDecline.vi: Điều đó quá tệ vì tôi cảm nhận được tiềm năng trong bạn. Bạn không được sẵn sàng cho những thử thách phía trước. Hãy đến gặp tôi một lần nữa nếu bạn thay đổi ý định.

dialogsComplete.en: Not bad, Acrobat. Not bad at all. You may have something to offer. I'll allow your training.
dialogsComplete.ar: Not bad, Acrobat. Not bad at all. You may have something to offer. I'll allow your training.
dialogsComplete.br: Nada mal, Acrobata. Nada mal. Você pode ter algo a oferecer. Vou permitir seu treinamento.
dialogsComplete.cns: 不错，弓箭手。 你有点东西。 我会允许你来训练。
dialogsComplete.de: Nicht schlecht, Acrobat... Ich erkenne deine Fähigkeiten an.Ich werde dein weiteres Training erlauben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Not bad, Acrobat. Not bad at all. You may have something to offer. I'll allow your training.
dialogsComplete.fil: Not bad, Acrobat. Not bad at all. You may have something to offer. I'll allow your training.
dialogsComplete.fr: Félicitations, je reconnais que tu as du talent.
dialogsComplete.id: Tidak buruk, Acrobat. Tidak terlalu buruk. Kamu mungkin memiliki sesuatu untuk ditawarkan. Aku akan mengizinkan pelatihanmu.
dialogsComplete.it: Not bad, Acrobat. Not bad at all. You may have something to offer. I'll allow your training.
dialogsComplete.jp: お疲れ様でした。では、あなたの能力を認定します。
dialogsComplete.kr: 그 정도면 꽤 괜찮은데요, 아크로뱃. 가능성이 보이는 것 같아요. 훈련을 받으셔도 괜찮겠어요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Not bad, Acrobat. Not bad at all. You may have something to offer. I'll allow your training.
dialogsComplete.pl: Not bad, Acrobat. Not bad at all. You may have something to offer. I'll allow your training.
dialogsComplete.ru: Not bad, Acrobat. Not bad at all. You may have something to offer. I'll allow your training.
dialogsComplete.sp: No está mal, Acrobat. No está nada mal. Tal vez tengas algo que ofrecer. Permitiré tu entrenamiento.
dialogsComplete.sw: Not bad, Acrobat. Not bad at all. You may have something to offer. I'll allow your training.
dialogsComplete.th: ไม่เลว Acrobat ไม่เลวเลย คุณอาจมีสิ่งที่จะนำเสนอ ฉันจะอนุญาตการฝึกของคุณ
dialogsComplete.tw: 不錯呦，雜技師！一點也不差。你可能有一些東西可以提供。我會允許你的訓練。
dialogsComplete.vi: Không tệ, Acrobat. Không tệ chút nào. Bạn có thể mời chào cái gì đó. Tôi cho phép bạn đào tạo.

dialogsFail.en: I doubt you have what it takes to be a Ranger if you can't even slay 20 Drillers.
dialogsFail.ar: I doubt you have what it takes to be a Ranger if you can't even slay 20 Drillers.
dialogsFail.br: A vontade do Ranger não o escolherá se você falhar em caçar 20 Sondadores.
dialogsFail.cns: 你没办法猎杀20只钻孔机回来的话，我也没办法帮你...
dialogsFail.de: Ich glaube kaum, dass du das Zeug zu einem Ranger hast. Du kannst ja nicht einmal 20 Driller zur Strecke bringen.
dialogsFail.fi: I doubt you have what it takes to be a Ranger if you can't even slay 20 Drillers.
dialogsFail.fil: I doubt you have what it takes to be a Ranger if you can't even slay 20 Drillers.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu ne parviens pas à tuer ces 20 Drillers, oublie la voie du Ranger.
dialogsFail.id: Aku ragu kamu memerlukan apa saja untuk menjadi Ranger jika bahkan kamu tidak bisa membunuh 20 Drillers.
dialogsFail.it: I doubt you have what it takes to be a Ranger if you can't even slay 20 Drillers.
dialogsFail.jp: 20匹の狩りに成功しなければ、レンジャー後継者への第一歩すら踏み出せませんよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 드릴러 20마리도 쓰러뜨리지 못한다면, 레인저가 될 자질이 있는 것 같진 않은데요.
dialogsFail.nl: I doubt you have what it takes to be a Ranger if you can't even slay 20 Drillers.
dialogsFail.pl: Wątpię, czy posiadasz to, czego potrzeba, by zostać Łucznikiem, jeśli nie możesz nawet zabić 20 Wiertników.
dialogsFail.ru: Если ты не можешь убить пару десятков каких-то буров, куда тебе в стрелки?
dialogsFail.sp: Dudo que tengas lo necesario para ser un Ranger si no puedes derrotar a 20 Drillers.
dialogsFail.sw: I doubt you have what it takes to be a Ranger if you can't even slay 20 Drillers.
dialogsFail.th: ฉันสงสัยว่าคุณมีสิ่งที่จะเป็น Ranger ได้หรือไม่ถ้าคุณไม่สามารถแม้แต่จะฆ่า 20 Drillers
dialogsFail.tw: 你沒辦法獵殺 20 隻回來的話，我也沒辦法幫你…
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi nghi ngờ bạn có những gì để trở thành một Ranger nếu bạn thậm chí không thể giết 20 Drillers.

dialogsBegin.en: Oh! Interested in the stories of this so called super hero I see? Can't say I know a whole lot about him.
dialogsBegin.ar: Oh! Interested in the stories of this so called super hero I see? Can't say I know a whole lot about him.
dialogsBegin.br: Oh! Interessado nas histórias deste que é chamado de super herói? Não posso dizer que sei muito sobre ele.
dialogsBegin.cns: 哦！对这个所谓的超级英雄的故事感兴趣？不过不能说我对他很了解。
dialogsBegin.de: Oh! Sie interessieren sich für die Geschichten dieses so genannten Superhelden, wie ich sehe? Ich kann nicht behaupten, dass ich viel über ihn weiß.
dialogsBegin.fi: Oh! Interested in the stories of this so called super hero I see? Can't say I know a whole lot about him.
dialogsBegin.fil: Oh! Interested in the stories of this so called super hero I see? Can't say I know a whole lot about him.
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous cherchez un Héros ? J'ai peut-être ce qui vous faut.
dialogsBegin.id: Oh! Tertarik dengan kisah-kisah yang disebut pahlawan super yang saya lihat ini? Tidak bisa saya katakan saya tahu banyak tentang dia.
dialogsBegin.it: Oh! Interested in the stories of this so called super hero I see? Can't say I know a whole lot about him.
dialogsBegin.jp: 英雄と呼ばれる人物に興味があると？はいはい、もちろん知ってますよ。最近色々なところで活躍しているようですね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 슈퍼 영웅에 대한 소문이요? 네, 물론 잘 알고 있죠. 그가 어디 있는지 알고 있냐고요? 글쎄요… 워낙 동해 번쩍, 서해 번쩍 나타나는 자라…
dialogsBegin.nl: Oh! Interested in the stories of this so called super hero I see? Can't say I know a whole lot about him.
dialogsBegin.pl: Oh! Interested in the stories of this so called super hero I see? Can't say I know a whole lot about him.
dialogsBegin.ru: Oh! Interested in the stories of this so called super hero I see? Can't say I know a whole lot about him.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Oh! ¿Estás interesado en las historias de ese supuesto superhéroe que vi? No puedo decir que sepa mucho sobre él.
dialogsBegin.sw: Oh! Interested in the stories of this so called super hero I see? Can't say I know a whole lot about him.
dialogsBegin.th: โอ้ว ! น่าสนใจเรื่องนี้เรียกว่าซูเปอร์ฮีโร่ที่ฉันเห็น? ไม่สามารถพูดได้ว่าฉันรู้เรื่องทั้งหมดเกี่ยวกับเขา
dialogsBegin.tw: 有關超級英雄的傳聞嗎？我當然知道啊。你想知道他在哪裡嗎？嗯…他一下子在東海，一下子在西海出現…
dialogsBegin.vi: Ồ! Bạn quan tâm đến những câu chuyện về siêu anh hùng này phải không? Không thể nói rằng tôi biết rất nhiều điều về anh ấy.

dialogsBegin.en: There was someone who had more insight into this mysterious man. Oh, what was his name now! Oh I've just got so much on my mind right now its hard to think about anything!
dialogsBegin.ar: There was someone who had more insight into this mysterious man. Oh, what was his name now! Oh I've just got so much on my mind right now its hard to think about anything!
dialogsBegin.br: Havia alguém que tinha mais conhecimento sobre esse homem misterioso. Oh, como era o nome dele agora?! Oh, eu tenho tanta coisa em minha mente agora que é difícil pensar em qualquer coisa!
dialogsBegin.cns: 有一个人对这个神秘的人有更多的了解。哦，他叫什么名字！？哦，我现在脑子里想的太多了，很难想起来了！
dialogsBegin.de: Es gab jemanden, der mehr Einblick in diesen mysteriösen Mann hatte. Oh, wie hieß er doch gleich! Oh, ich habe im Moment so viel um die Ohren, dass es schwer ist, an irgendetwas zu denken!
dialogsBegin.fi: There was someone who had more insight into this mysterious man. Oh, what was his name now! Oh I've just got so much on my mind right now its hard to think about anything!
dialogsBegin.fil: There was someone who had more insight into this mysterious man. Oh, what was his name now! Oh I've just got so much on my mind right now its hard to think about anything!
dialogsBegin.fr: Rahhh je l'avais sur le bout de la langue… ma mémoire me fait défaut quand j'ai trop de choses en tête…
dialogsBegin.id: Ada seseorang yang memiliki lebih banyak wawasan tentang pria misterius ini. Oh, siapa namanya sekarang! Oh, saya baru saja memikirkan banyak hal saat ini, sulit untuk memikirkan apa pun!
dialogsBegin.it: There was someone who had more insight into this mysterious man. Oh, what was his name now! Oh I've just got so much on my mind right now its hard to think about anything!
dialogsBegin.jp: うん？　もっと詳しく知りたいって……（にやり）。教えて差し上げたいのですがちょっと立てこんでおりましてね……。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그 수수께끼의 인물에 대해 잘 알고 있는 사람이 있었는데… 오, 이름이 뭐였더라! 지금은 머릿속이 너무 복잡해서 도통 기억이 나지 않네요!
dialogsBegin.nl: There was someone who had more insight into this mysterious man. Oh, what was his name now! Oh I've just got so much on my mind right now its hard to think about anything!
dialogsBegin.pl: There was someone who had more insight into this mysterious man. Oh, what was his name now! Oh I've just got so much on my mind right now its hard to think about anything!
dialogsBegin.ru: There was someone who had more insight into this mysterious man. Oh, what was his name now! Oh I've just got so much on my mind right now its hard to think about anything!
dialogsBegin.sp: Hay alguien que tiene más información sobre ese hombre misterioso. ¡Ah, cómo se llamaba! ¡Oh, tengo tantas cosas en mi cabeza ahora mismo que me es difícil pensar en algo!
dialogsBegin.sw: There was someone who had more insight into this mysterious man. Oh, what was his name now! Oh I've just got so much on my mind right now its hard to think about anything!
dialogsBegin.th: มีคนที่มีความเข้าใจลึกเข้าไปในชายลึกลับคนนี้ โอ้วว ชื่อของเขาคืออะไรตอนนี้! โอ้วว ฉันเพิ่งได้รับในใจของฉันตอนนี้มันยากที่จะคิดว่ามันเกี่ยวกับอะไร!
dialogsBegin.tw: 等一下。有一個對他很了解的人…到底是誰…啊，我現在有一個很緊急的事情，所以我完全想不起來。如果你可以幫我解決這個問題，我好像可以想起來吧…
dialogsBegin.vi: Để cho ai đó có cái nhìn sâu sắc hơn về người đàn ông bí ẩn này. Ồ, tên của anh ấy bây giờ là gì! Ồ, hiện giờ tôi đang có quá nhiều thứ trong đầu, thật khó để nghĩ về bất cứ điều gì!

dialogsBegin.en: You want to know what the problem is? I had an important package to deliver but I can't for the life of me remember what I did with it…
dialogsBegin.ar: You want to know what the problem is? I had an important package to deliver but I can't for the life of me remember what I did with it…
dialogsBegin.br: Deseja saber qual é o problema? Tudo bem, posso lhe dizer. Eu tinha um pacote importante para entregar, mas não consigo lembrar o que fiz com ele…
dialogsBegin.cns: 你想知道问题出在哪里吗？我有一个重要的包裹要送，但我这辈子都不记得我做了什么......
dialogsBegin.de: Sie wollen wissen, was das Problem ist? Ich hatte ein wichtiges Paket auszuliefern, aber ich kann mich beim besten Willen nicht erinnern, was ich damit gemacht habe...
dialogsBegin.fi: You want to know what the problem is? I had an important package to deliver but I can't for the life of me remember what I did with it…
dialogsBegin.fil: You want to know what the problem is? I had an important package to deliver but I can't for the life of me remember what I did with it…
dialogsBegin.fr: Ce qui me préoccupe ? Vous êtes gentil de demander. J'ai une commande pour Remine à livrer de toute urgence.
dialogsBegin.id: Anda ingin tahu apa masalahnya? Saya memiliki paket penting untuk dikirim tetapi saya tidak bisa mengingat apa yang saya lakukan dengannya ...
dialogsBegin.it: You want to know what the problem is? I had an important package to deliver but I can't for the life of me remember what I did with it…
dialogsBegin.jp: 何が忙しいのかって？　ふふ、明日までにリマインにドリルを渡さなければいけないのですが、在庫が不足しているのですよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 문제가 뭐냐고요? 중요한 소포를 배달해야 하는데... 도대체 어디에 뒀는지 아무리 생각해도 기억이 안 나요...
dialogsBegin.nl: You want to know what the problem is? I had an important package to deliver but I can't for the life of me remember what I did with it…
dialogsBegin.pl: You want to know what the problem is? I had an important package to deliver but I can't for the life of me remember what I did with it…
dialogsBegin.ru: You want to know what the problem is? I had an important package to deliver but I can't for the life of me remember what I did with it…
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Quieres saber cuál es el problema? Que tenía un paquete importante para entregar, pero no recuerdo lo que hice con él...
dialogsBegin.sw: You want to know what the problem is? I had an important package to deliver but I can't for the life of me remember what I did with it…
dialogsBegin.th: คุณต้องการทราบว่าปัญหาคืออะไร? ฉันมีแพ็คเกจที่สำคัญในการจัดส่ง
dialogsBegin.tw: 你問那問題是什麼嗎？哈哈！冒險家大人真的是非常的親切！事實我明天有必須交給雷米娜的東西，不過那東西掉落了…
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn muốn biết vấn đề là gì sao? Tôi có một gói hàng quan trọng cần giao nhưng suốt đời tôi không thể nhớ nổi mình đã làm gì với nó…

dialogsBegin.en: The package contained special drills acquired from the Drillers in Darkon. Some of the sturdiest around!! If you could acquire some of these drills for me it would surely help a lot!
dialogsBegin.ar: The package contained special drills acquired from the Drillers in Darkon. Some of the sturdiest around!! If you could acquire some of these drills for me it would surely help a lot!
dialogsBegin.br: O pacote continha brocas especiais adquiridas dos Sondadores em Darkon. Alguns dos mais resistentes que existem!! Se você pudesse adquirir alguns dessas brocas para mim com certeza ajudaria muito!
dialogsBegin.cns: 包裹里有从达肯的钻孔机那里获得的特殊钻头。一些最坚固的钻头! 如果你能为我搞到一些这样的钻头，那肯定会有很大的帮助!
dialogsBegin.de: Das Paket enthielt spezielle Bohrer, die von den Drillern in Darkon erworben wurden. Sie gehören zu den stärksten, die es gibt! Wenn Sie einige dieser Bohrer für mich beschaffen könnten, wäre das sicher eine große Hilfe!
dialogsBegin.fi: The package contained special drills acquired from the Drillers in Darkon. Some of the sturdiest around!! If you could acquire some of these drills for me it would surely help a lot!
dialogsBegin.fil: The package contained special drills acquired from the Drillers in Darkon. Some of the sturdiest around!! If you could acquire some of these drills for me it would surely help a lot!
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais voilà je n'ai pas les objets et mon livreur habituel est malade.
dialogsBegin.id: Paket tersebut berisi special drills yang diperoleh dari Drillers di Darkon. Beberapa yang paling kokoh di sekitar!! Jika Anda dapat memperoleh beberapa drills ini untuk saya, itu pasti akan sangat membantu!
dialogsBegin.it: The package contained special drills acquired from the Drillers in Darkon. Some of the sturdiest around!! If you could acquire some of these drills for me it would surely help a lot!
dialogsBegin.jp: ドリラーを誰かが倒してドリルを集めてくれればいいんですけど……い、いいんですけどね～。（ちらっちらっ）
dialogsBegin.kr: 그 소포 안엔 다콘의 드릴러에게서 나오는 특별한 드릴이 들어 있었어요. 이 지역에서 가장 튼튼한 드릴이죠! 이 드릴을 구해주신다면 정말 큰 도움이 될 텐데!
dialogsBegin.nl: The package contained special drills acquired from the Drillers in Darkon. Some of the sturdiest around!! If you could acquire some of these drills for me it would surely help a lot!
dialogsBegin.pl: Paczka zawierała specjalne wiertła nabyte z Wiertników w Darkon. Niektóre z najsolidniejszych w okolicy!! Gdybyś mógł nabyć dla mnie niektóre z tych wierteł, z pewnością by to bardzo pomogło!
dialogsBegin.ru: The package contained special drills acquired from the Drillers in Darkon. Some of the sturdiest around!! If you could acquire some of these drills for me it would surely help a lot!
dialogsBegin.sp: El paquete contenía unos taladros especiales conseguidos de los Drillers en Darkon. ¡Son de los más resistentes! ¡Si pudieras conseguir unos cuantos taladros para mí, sería de gran ayuda!
dialogsBegin.sw: The package contained special drills acquired from the Drillers in Darkon. Some of the sturdiest around!! If you could acquire some of these drills for me it would surely help a lot!
dialogsBegin.th: แพคเกจมีการฝึกซ้อมพิเศษที่ได้มาจาก Drillers ใน Darkon บางส่วนของ sturdiest รอบ !! หากคุณสามารถหาบางส่วนของ drills เหล่านี้ให้ฉัน ก็จะช่วยได้มาก!
dialogsBegin.tw: 你說那東西是什麼嗎？就是暴鑽機啊。那不是平凡的暴鑽機。是得肯的暴鑽機械才會有的暴鑽機吧…如果有人可以幫我把暴鑽機拿回來，那就太好了…
dialogsBegin.vi: Gói này chứa các mũi khoan đặc biệt có được từ Drillers ở Darkon. Các mũi khoan này chắc chắn nhất trong khu vực đấy!! Nếu bạn có thể lấy được vài cái cho tôi, nó chắc chắn sẽ giúp ích rất nhiều!

dialogsAccept.en: Oh! You will get the drills for me!! You are really great! Drillers can be found Southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. Acquire 10 drills and bring them to Remine the weapon smith.
dialogsAccept.ar: Oh! You will get the drills for me!! You are really great! Drillers can be found Southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. Acquire 10 drills and bring them to Remine the weapon smith.
dialogsAccept.br: Oh! Você vai conseguir mais brocas para mim?!! Você é ótimo! Sondadores podem ser encontrados a sudoeste das Montanhas Gouthan. Adquira 10 brocas e leve-as para Remine, a ferreira de armas.
dialogsAccept.cns: 哦！你会为我拿到钻头的！！你真的很伟大! 钻孔机可以在永恒森林的西南方找到。获得10个钻头并把它们带给武器工匠雷蒙。
dialogsAccept.de: Oh! Du wirst die Drills für mich besorgen!! Du bist wirklich großartig! Drillers findet man südwestlich der Gouthan Mountains. Sammle 10 Drills und bringe sie zu Remine, dem Waffenschmied.
dialogsAccept.fi: Oh! You will get the drills for me!! You are really great! Drillers can be found Southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. Acquire 10 drills and bring them to Remine the weapon smith.
dialogsAccept.fil: Oh! You will get the drills for me!! You are really great! Drillers can be found Southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. Acquire 10 drills and bring them to Remine the weapon smith.
dialogsAccept.fr: Vous vous portez volontaire ?! Il faut donc apporter 10 perceuses de Driller à Remine.
dialogsAccept.id: Oh! Anda akan mendapatkan drills untuk saya!! Anda benar-benar hebat! Pengebor dapat ditemukan di Southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. Dapatkan 10 drills dan bawa ke Remine the weapon smith.
dialogsAccept.it: Oh! You will get the drills for me!! You are really great! Drillers can be found Southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. Acquire 10 drills and bring them to Remine the weapon smith.
dialogsAccept.jp: おお！　あなたがドリルを集めてくれるのですか？　それは願ってもないことです。10個もあれば足りると思いますので、集めたらダーコン武器屋のリマインまでお願いしますね！
dialogsAccept.kr: 오! 그 드릴을 구해 주시겠다고요? 정말 친절하시군요!! 고우단 산맥 남서쪽으로 가면 드릴러들이 있답니다. 드릴 10개를 모아서 무기 제작자 레미네에게 가져다주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Oh! You will get the drills for me!! You are really great! Drillers can be found Southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. Acquire 10 drills and bring them to Remine the weapon smith.
dialogsAccept.pl: Oh! Zdobędziesz dla mnie wiertła!! Jesteś naprawdę super! Wiertła można znaleźć na południowy zachód od Gór Gouthan. Zdobądź 10 wierteł i zanieś je do Remine kowala broni.
dialogsAccept.ru: Oh! You will get the drills for me!! You are really great! Drillers can be found Southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. Acquire 10 drills and bring them to Remine the weapon smith.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Oh! ¡Conseguirás los taladros para mí! ¡Eres genial! Los Drillers se pueden encontrar al Suroeste de las Montañas Gouthan. Consigue 10 Taladros y llévaselos a Remine, la herrera de armas.
dialogsAccept.sw: Oh! You will get the drills for me!! You are really great! Drillers can be found Southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. Acquire 10 drills and bring them to Remine the weapon smith.
dialogsAccept.th: Oh! คุณจะนำ Drills  มาให้ฉัน ! เยี่ยมจริงๆ! Drills สามารถพบได้ในภาคตะวันตกเฉียงใต้ของเทือกเขา Gouthan หา Drills 10 อันและนำไปให้ Remine
dialogsAccept.tw: 哦！你會為我拿到暴鑽機械！你真的很棒！在古坦山脈的西南部可以找到暴鑽機械。拿到 10 個暴鑽機械並將它們帶給武器工匠雷米娜。
dialogsAccept.vi: Ồ! Bạn sẽ lấy các mũi khoan cho tôi sao!! Bạn thật sự quá tuyệt! Các mũi khoan có thể được tìm thấy ở phía Tây Nam của Dãy núi Gouthan. Có được 10 mũi khoan và mang chúng đến Thợ rèn vũ khí.

dialogsDecline.en: Oh no... I'm in trouble now. Who will ever want the business of such a forgetful store owner!
dialogsDecline.ar: Oh no... I'm in trouble now. Who will ever want the business of such a forgetful store owner!
dialogsDecline.br: Oh não.. Estou em apuros agora. Quem vai querer fazer negócios com um dono de loja tão esquecido!
dialogsDecline.cns: Oh no... I'm in trouble now. Who will ever want the business of such a forgetful store owner!
dialogsDecline.de: Oh nein... Jetzt stecke ich in Schwierigkeiten. Wer will schon das Geschäft eines so vergesslichen Ladenbesitzers!
dialogsDecline.fi: Oh no... I'm in trouble now. Who will ever want the business of such a forgetful store owner!
dialogsDecline.fil: Oh no... I'm in trouble now. Who will ever want the business of such a forgetful store owner!
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous avez raison, mes problèmes ne vous concernent peut-être pas.
dialogsDecline.id: Oh tidak.. Saya dalam masalah sekarang. Siapa yang akan menginginkan bisnis pemilik toko yang pelupa!
dialogsDecline.it: Oh no... I'm in trouble now. Who will ever want the business of such a forgetful store owner!
dialogsDecline.jp: あー、残念だなあ。ドリルがあれば秘話もお伝えできそうなのになぁ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 이런... 큰일 났네요. 이렇게 건망증이 심한 가게 주인에게서 누가 뭘 사려고 하겠어요!
dialogsDecline.nl: Oh no... I'm in trouble now. Who will ever want the business of such a forgetful store owner!
dialogsDecline.pl: Oh no... I'm in trouble now. Who will ever want the business of such a forgetful store owner!
dialogsDecline.ru: Oh no... I'm in trouble now. Who will ever want the business of such a forgetful store owner!
dialogsDecline.sp: Oh no... Estoy en un problema. ¡Quién va a querer negociar con un dueño tan olvidadizo!
dialogsDecline.sw: Oh no... I'm in trouble now. Who will ever want the business of such a forgetful store owner!
dialogsDecline.th: ตอนนี้ฉันกำลังเดือดร้อน ใครจะอยากจะทำธุรกิจกับเจ้าของร้านที่ขี้ลืมเช่นนี้!
dialogsDecline.tw: 糟了……我這下有麻煩了。像我這麼健忘的店主，誰還會想上門做生意啊！
dialogsDecline.vi: Ồ không...tôi gặp rắc rối rồi. Ai lại muốn tiếp quản công việc kinh doanh của một chủ cửa hàng đãng trí như vậy!

dialogsComplete.en: Achaben sent you here I see! Are these the Hard Drills I ordered?
dialogsComplete.ar: Achaben sent you here I see! Are these the Hard Drills I ordered?
dialogsComplete.br: Achaben mandou você, suponho! São estas as Brocas Resistentes que encomendei?
dialogsComplete.cns: 我看是雅察本让你来的! 这些是我订购的钻头吗？
dialogsComplete.de: Achaben hat dich geschickt? Sind das die Hard Drills, die ich bestellt habe?
dialogsComplete.fi: Achaben sent you here I see! Are these the Hard Drills I ordered?
dialogsComplete.fil: Achaben sent you here I see! Are these the Hard Drills I ordered?
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh, vous avez les perceuses que j'ai commandées à Achaben ?
dialogsComplete.id: Achaben mengirimmu ke sini, oh begitu! Apakah ini Hard Drills yang saya pesan?
dialogsComplete.it: Achaben sent you here I see! Are these the Hard Drills I ordered?
dialogsComplete.jp: アチャベンからの使いだって？　ああ、これはあたいが注文した品だね。
dialogsComplete.kr: 아카벤이 보내서 왔다고요? 아하! 그거, 제가 주문한 튼튼한 드릴인가요?
dialogsComplete.nl: Achaben sent you here I see! Are these the Hard Drills I ordered?
dialogsComplete.pl: Widzę, Achaben przysłał cię tutaj! Czy to te Twarde Wiertła, które zamówiłem?
dialogsComplete.ru: Achaben sent you here I see! Are these the Hard Drills I ordered?
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Achaben te ha enviado aquí, por lo que veo! ¿Estos son los Taladros Duros que he pedido?
dialogsComplete.sw: Achaben sent you here I see! Are these the Hard Drills I ordered?
dialogsComplete.th: ฉันเห็น Achaben ส่งคุณมาที่นี่! นี่เป็น Hard Drills ที่ฉันสั่งซื้อหรือไม่?
dialogsComplete.tw: 你說是安迪派你過來的嗎？啊哈~ 是我購買暴鑽機嗎？
dialogsComplete.vi: Achaben đã phái bạn tới đây! Đây có phải là những Hard Drills mà tôi đã đặt hàng không?

dialogsFail.en: Thank you again! Please make haste and acquire the 10 Hard Drills and take them to Remine the Darken weapon smith.
dialogsFail.ar: Thank you again! Please make haste and acquire the 10 Hard Drills and take them to Remine the Darken weapon smith.
dialogsFail.br: Obrigado novamente! Por favor, adquira as 10 Brocas Resistentes e leve-as para Remine, a ferreira de Darken.
dialogsFail.cns: 再次感谢您! 请抓紧时间获得10个钻头，并把它们拿给达肯武器商店的雷蒙。
dialogsFail.de: Nochmals vielen Dank! Bitte beeilen Sie sich und besorgen Sie die 10 Hard Drillers und bringen Sie es zu Remine, dem Waffenschmied der Finsternis.
dialogsFail.fi: Thank you again! Please make haste and acquire the 10 Hard Drills and take them to Remine the Darken weapon smith.
dialogsFail.fil: Thank you again! Please make haste and acquire the 10 Hard Drills and take them to Remine the Darken weapon smith.
dialogsFail.fr: Apportez vite 10 perceuses de Driller à Remine.
dialogsFail.id: Sekali lagi terima kasih! Harap segera dan dapatkan 10 Hard Drills dan bawa ke Remine the Darken weapon smith.
dialogsFail.it: Thank you again! Please make haste and acquire the 10 Hard Drills and take them to Remine the Darken weapon smith.
dialogsFail.jp: ドリラーから丈夫なドリルを10個集めて武器屋のリマインに渡して下さいね。
dialogsFail.kr: 다시 한번 감사드려요! 최대한 빨리 튼튼한 드릴 10개를 모아 다켄의 무기 제작자 레미네에게 가져가세요.
dialogsFail.nl: Thank you again! Please make haste and acquire the 10 Hard Drills and take them to Remine the Darken weapon smith.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeszcze raz dziękuję! Pospiesz się, zdobądź 10 Twardych Wierteł i zanieś je do kowala broni Remine the Darken.
dialogsFail.ru: Thank you again! Please make haste and acquire the 10 Hard Drills and take them to Remine the Darken weapon smith.
dialogsFail.sp: ¡Gracias de nuevo! Date prisa y consigue los 10 Taladros Duros y llévaselos a Remine, de la Tienda de Armas de Darken.
dialogsFail.sw: Thank you again! Please make haste and acquire the 10 Hard Drills and take them to Remine the Darken weapon smith.
dialogsFail.th: ขอบคุณอีกครั้ง ! กรุณารีบหา Hard Drill 10 อัน  และเอาไปให้ Remine the Darken weapon smith
dialogsFail.tw: 從暴鑽機械身上取得暴鑽機 10 個之後，幫我拿去給雷米娜吧。
dialogsFail.vi: Cám ơn bạn một lần nữa! Hãy nhanh chân và có được 10 Hard Drills và đưa chúng đến thợ rèn vũ khí Remine the Darken.

dialogsBegin.en: It's time to face off against the Mammoths. The most fearsome and terrible creature I have ever laid my eyes upon in this place.

dialogsComplete.en: You are truly a great warrior and an even greater friend. We owe our lives to you.
dialogsComplete.ar: You are truly a great warrior and an even greater friend. We owe our lives to you.
dialogsComplete.br: Você é realmente um grande guerreiro e um amigo ainda maior. Devemos nossas vidas a você.
dialogsComplete.cns: 你真是一个伟大的战士，也是一位值得托付的朋友。我们欠你一条命。
dialogsComplete.de: Du bist wahrlich ein großer Krieger und ein noch größerer Freund. Wir verdanken dir unsere Leben.
dialogsComplete.fi: You are truly a great warrior and an even greater friend. We owe our lives to you.
dialogsComplete.fil: You are truly a great warrior and an even greater friend. We owe our lives to you.
dialogsComplete.fr: Vous êtes véritablement un guerrier d'exception et un ami estimé. Nous vous devons nos vies.
dialogsComplete.id: Anda benar-benar pejuang yang hebat dan teman yang lebih hebat lagi. Kami berutang hidup kami kepada Anda.
dialogsComplete.it: You are truly a great warrior and an even greater friend. We owe our lives to you.
dialogsComplete.jp: あなたは本当に偉大な戦士であり、偉大な友人と言えます。私たちの命はあなたがいてこそ、今存在しているんですよ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 당신은 훌륭한 전사이자, 더 훌륭한 친구예요. 저희 목숨을 살려 주셨잖아요.
dialogsComplete.nl: You are truly a great warrior and an even greater friend. We owe our lives to you.
dialogsComplete.pl: You are truly a great warrior and an even greater friend. We owe our lives to you.
dialogsComplete.ru: You are truly a great warrior and an even greater friend. We owe our lives to you.
dialogsComplete.sp: Eres realmente un gran guerrero y un gran amigo. Te debemos la vida.
dialogsComplete.sw: You are truly a great warrior and an even greater friend. We owe our lives to you.
dialogsComplete.th: คุณเป็นนักรบที่ยิ่งใหญ่อย่างแท้จริงและเป็นเพื่อนที่ยิ่งใหญ่กว่า เราเป็นหนี้ชีวิตของเรากับคุณ
dialogsComplete.tw: 你真的是一個偉大的戰士，更一個更最棒的朋友。我們欠你一條命。
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn thực sự là một chiến binh vĩ đại và một người bạn vĩ đại. Cảm ơn bạn.

dialogsComplete.en: We are safe now. I know this may not be much, but take this as a sign of our appreciation. You will always be remembered here.
dialogsComplete.ar: We are safe now. I know this may not be much, but take this as a sign of our appreciation. You will always be remembered here.
dialogsComplete.br: Estamos seguros agora. Sei que pode não ser muito, mas tome isso como um sinal de nosso apreço. Você sempre será lembrado aqui.
dialogsComplete.cns: 我们现在很安全。我知道这可能不多，但请收下吧。您的英勇将被永远铭记。
dialogsComplete.de: Wir sind nun sicher. Ich weiß, das ist nicht viel, aber nimm dies als ein Zeichen unserer Dankbarkeit. Man wird sich hier immer an dich erinnern.
dialogsComplete.fi: We are safe now. I know this may not be much, but take this as a sign of our appreciation. You will always be remembered here.
dialogsComplete.fil: We are safe now. I know this may not be much, but take this as a sign of our appreciation. You will always be remembered here.
dialogsComplete.fr: Nous sommes en sécurité pour le moment. Je sais que ce n'est pas grand chose, mais prenez ceci en gage de notre gratitude. Nous ne vous oublierons jamais.
dialogsComplete.id: Kami aman sekarang. Aku tahu ini mungkin tidak banyak, tetapi anggap ini sebagai tanda terima kasih kami. Kamu akan selalu dikenang di sini.
dialogsComplete.it: We are safe now. I know this may not be much, but take this as a sign of our appreciation. You will always be remembered here.
dialogsComplete.jp: 私たちが安全で暮らせるのはあなたのおかげです。大したお礼ではありませんが、受け取ってください。生涯あなたを忘れる日はないでしょうね。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이제 안전해요. 별거 아니지만, 감사의 표시로 받아주세요. 영원히 당신을 기억할게요.
dialogsComplete.nl: We are safe now. I know this may not be much, but take this as a sign of our appreciation. You will always be remembered here.
dialogsComplete.pl: We are safe now. I know this may not be much, but take this as a sign of our appreciation. You will always be remembered here.
dialogsComplete.ru: We are safe now. I know this may not be much, but take this as a sign of our appreciation. You will always be remembered here.
dialogsComplete.sp: Ahora estamos a salvo. Sé que esto no es mucho, pero tómalo como una señal de nuestro aprecio. Siempre serás recordado aquí.
dialogsComplete.sw: We are safe now. I know this may not be much, but take this as a sign of our appreciation. You will always be remembered here.
dialogsComplete.th: ตอนนี้เราปลอดภัยแล้ว ฉันรู้ว่าสิ่งนี้อาจไม่มาก แต่ถือว่านี่เป็นสัญญาณแสดงความขอบคุณของเรา คุณจะอยู่ในความทรงจำที่นี่เสมอ
dialogsComplete.tw: 我們現在很安全，我知道這可能不多，但請將此作為我們讚賞的印記。你將永遠被銘記在這裡。
dialogsComplete.vi: Bây giờ chúng tôi an toàn. Chúng tôi đánh giá cao điều này. Ở đây bạn sẽ luôn được nhớ đến.

dialogsFail.en: We must battle on. I believe in you.
dialogsFail.ar: We must battle on. I believe in you.
dialogsFail.br: Devemos batalhar. Eu acredito em você.
dialogsFail.cns: 战斗不可避免，我相信你！
dialogsFail.de: Wir müssen weiterkämpfen. Ich glaube an dich.
dialogsFail.fi: We must battle on. I believe in you.
dialogsFail.fil: We must battle on. I believe in you.
dialogsFail.fr: Nous devons continuer de nous battre. Je crois en vous.
dialogsFail.id: Kita harus terus berjuang. Aku percaya padamu.
dialogsFail.it: We must battle on. I believe in you.
dialogsFail.jp: 戦い続けなければなりません。あなたを信頼しています。
dialogsFail.kr: 계속 싸워야만 해요. 전 당신을 믿어요.
dialogsFail.nl: We must battle on. I believe in you.
dialogsFail.pl: We must battle on. I believe in you.
dialogsFail.ru: We must battle on. I believe in you.
dialogsFail.sp: Debemos luchar. Creo en ti.
dialogsFail.sw: We must battle on. I believe in you.
dialogsFail.th: เราต้องสู้ต่อไป ฉันเชื่อในตัวคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 我們必須繼續戰鬥，我相信你。
dialogsFail.vi: Chúng ta phải tiếp tục chiến đấu. Tôi tin bạn.

description.vi: Nơi đây. Chụp ảnh này. Vui lòng giao nó cho Rovanett, người đang làm việc trong Thư viện Quốc gia ở Thành phố Saint. Bạn có thể tìm thấy cô ấy ở Saint Hall.

dialogsBegin.en: Hey! Great timing! I have just found out about something very interesting.
dialogsBegin.ar: Hey! Great timing! I have just found out about something very interesting.
dialogsBegin.br: Ei! Ótima pontualidade! Acabei de descobrir algo muito interessante.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你来了啊..来的正好，我有了新发现，是一个很有趣的事情呢~你问我是什么东西啊?你来看看..
dialogsBegin.de: Hey! Du kommst im rechten Moment! Ich habe etwas heraus gefunden, dass sehr interessant ist. Du willst wissen was es ist? Wirklich es ist..
dialogsBegin.fi: Hey! Great timing! I have just found out about something very interesting.
dialogsBegin.fil: Hey! Great timing! I have just found out about something very interesting.
dialogsBegin.fr: Pendant que tu combattais ces affreux monstres, j'ai découvert quelque chose de très intéressant. C'est…
dialogsBegin.id: Hai! Waktu yang tepat! Aku baru saja menemukan sesuatu yang sangat menarik.
dialogsBegin.it: Hey! Great timing! I have just found out about something very interesting.
dialogsBegin.jp: おや、来てくれたね。君を待っていたよ。また新しいことがひとつわかったんだ、とても興味深いことがね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 딱 맞춰서 오셨군요! 마침 아주 흥미로운 걸 알아냈거든요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Hey! Great timing! I have just found out about something very interesting.
dialogsBegin.pl: Hey! Great timing! I have just found out about something very interesting.
dialogsBegin.ru: А! Ты как раз вовремя. Мне удалось кое-что разузнать.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Oye! ¡Llegas en un gran momento! Me acabo de enterar de algo muy interesante.
dialogsBegin.sw: Hey! Great timing! I have just found out about something very interesting.
dialogsBegin.th: เฮ้! ช่วงเวลาที่ยอดเยี่ยม! ฉันเพิ่งค้นพบสิ่งที่น่าสนใจมาก
dialogsBegin.tw: 你來了啊…來的正好，我有了新發現，是一個很有趣的事情呢~你問我是什麼東西啊？你來看看…
dialogsBegin.vi: Chào! Thời điểm tuyệt vời! Tôi vừa phát hiện ra một điều rất thú vị.

dialogsBegin.en: Do you know what this is? Well, I am sure you do not but I will tell you.
dialogsBegin.ar: Do you know what this is? Well, I am sure you do not but I will tell you.
dialogsBegin.br: Sabe o que é isto? Bem, tenho certeza de que não, mas lhe direi.
dialogsBegin.cns: 就是这个..你上次拿给我的布条，还记得吧?
dialogsBegin.de: (Er spricht mit jemanden hinter ihm) Das ist es! Du willst wissen was es ist? nun... Du erinnerst dich an die Cloth Pieces, die du mir gebracht hast.. oder?
dialogsBegin.fi: Do you know what this is? Well, I am sure you do not but I will tell you.
dialogsBegin.fil: Do you know what this is? Well, I am sure you do not but I will tell you.
dialogsBegin.fr: (prenant quelque chose derrière lui) Regarde ! Tu te souviens du mystérieux morceau de tissu que tu m'as apporté, non ?
dialogsBegin.id: Apa kamu tahu apa ini? Aku yakin tidak, biarkan aku menjelaskannya padamu.
dialogsBegin.it: Do you know what this is? Well, I am sure you do not but I will tell you.
dialogsBegin.jp: これこれ。このまえ、君が私に持ってきてくれた布切れを覚えてるだろう？
dialogsBegin.kr: 이게 뭔지 아시겠어요? 아마 모르시겠죠. 설명해 드릴게요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Do you know what this is? Well, I am sure you do not but I will tell you.
dialogsBegin.pl: Do you know what this is? Well, I am sure you do not but I will tell you.
dialogsBegin.ru: Смотри! Знаешь, что это за рисунок? Сейчас объясню.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Sabes lo que es esto? Bueno, supongo que no, pero te lo explico yo.
dialogsBegin.sw: Do you know what this is? Well, I am sure you do not but I will tell you.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณรู้ไหมว่านี่คืออะไร? ฉันแน่ใจว่าคุณไม่รู้หรอก แต่ฉันจะบอกคุณ
dialogsBegin.tw: 就是這個…你上次拿給我的布條，還記得吧？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có biết cái này là cái gì không? Vâng, tôi chắc chắn bạn không nhưng tôi sẽ nói với bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: This is an entire picture of the pattern we found. I found it in one of my books but it was the only picture I could find.
dialogsBegin.ar: This is an entire picture of the pattern we found. I found it in one of my books but it was the only picture I could find.
dialogsBegin.br: É uma imagem completa do formato que encontramos. Achei em um de meus livros, mas foi a única que consegui encontrar.
dialogsBegin.cns: 那个布条上的完整图片啦..我查看古代书籍的时候发现的，可是只有图片呢..
dialogsBegin.de: Das ist es, das ganze Bild von dem Muster war auf einen der Cloth piece. Ich fand es durch die alte Daten, die ich habe, aber dieses Bild ist das einzige, was ich habe.
dialogsBegin.fi: This is an entire picture of the pattern we found. I found it in one of my books but it was the only picture I could find.
dialogsBegin.fil: This is an entire picture of the pattern we found. I found it in one of my books but it was the only picture I could find.
dialogsBegin.fr: Et bien c'est une image complète du motif qu'il y avait sur le morceau de tissu. Je l'ai trouvée dans d'anciens documents que j'avais, mais c'est la seule chose que j'ai découverte...
dialogsBegin.id: Ini adalah keseluruhan dari gambar pola yang kita temukan. Aku menemukannya di salah satu bukuku dan merupakan satu-satunya gambar yang aku dapatkan.
dialogsBegin.it: This is an entire picture of the pattern we found. I found it in one of my books but it was the only picture I could find.
dialogsBegin.jp: これが、あの布切れに書いてあった文様の全体図だ。随分古いものだからところどころ薄くはなっているがね。古い文献を片っ端から調べていたら発見したのさ。残念なことに、この絵だけしか手がかりは見つからなかったが。
dialogsBegin.kr: 우리가 발견한 문양의 전체 그림이에요. 책을 뒤적이다가 겨우 발견했죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: This is an entire picture of the pattern we found. I found it in one of my books but it was the only picture I could find.
dialogsBegin.pl: This is an entire picture of the pattern we found. I found it in one of my books but it was the only picture I could find.
dialogsBegin.ru: Помнишь наш круг? Оказывается, на нем была только часть узора! Вот как он выглядит целиком. Я нашел его в старых книгах.
dialogsBegin.sp: Esta es una imagen completa del patrón que encontramos. Lo encontré en uno de mis libros, pero fue la única imagen que pude encontrar.
dialogsBegin.sw: This is an entire picture of the pattern we found. I found it in one of my books but it was the only picture I could find.
dialogsBegin.th: นี่คือภาพทั้งหมดของรูปแบบที่เราพบ ฉันพบมันในหนังสือเล่มหนึ่งของฉัน แต่มันเป็นภาพเดียวที่ฉันสามารถหาได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 那個布條上的完整圖片啦…我查看古代書籍的時候發現的，可是只有圖片呢…
dialogsBegin.vi: Đây là toàn bộ hình ảnh của mô hình mà chúng tôi tìm thấy. Tôi đã tìm thấy nó trong một trong những cuốn sách của mình nhưng đó là bức tranh duy nhất tôi có thể tìm thấy.

dialogsBegin.en: I need your help once again. Would you do ma a favor?
dialogsBegin.ar: I need your help once again. Would you do ma a favor?
dialogsBegin.br: Preciso de sua ajuda mais uma vez. Você me faria um favor?
dialogsBegin.cns: 我可能要再仔细的调查一下，当然需要你的帮忙，可以帮我吧?
dialogsBegin.de: Wir brauchen mehr Daten, um es bis ins Detail zu prüfen.. Ich brauche deine Hilfe erneut. Würdest du mir einen Gefallen tun?
dialogsBegin.fi: I need your help once again. Would you do ma a favor?
dialogsBegin.fil: I need your help once again. Would you do ma a favor?
dialogsBegin.fr: J'ai besoin de plus d'informations... Tu as toujours envie de percer ce mystère n'est-ce pas ?
dialogsBegin.id: Aku butuh bantuanmu sekali lagi. Maukah kamu membantuku?
dialogsBegin.it: I need your help once again. Would you do ma a favor?
dialogsBegin.jp: もっと詳細な調査をするために資料がほしいんだが、それもまた君に頼みたいと思っている。どうだ？やってくれないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 다시 한번 도움이 필요해요. 제 부탁을 들어주시겠어요?
dialogsBegin.nl: I need your help once again. Would you do ma a favor?
dialogsBegin.pl: I need your help once again. Would you do ma a favor?
dialogsBegin.ru: Думаю, ты догадываешься, что мне опять нужна твоя помощь. Мне продолжать?
dialogsBegin.sp: Necesito tu ayuda una vez más. ¿Me harías un favor?
dialogsBegin.sw: I need your help once again. Would you do ma a favor?
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันต้องการให้คุณช่วยอีกครั้ง คุณช่วยฉันหน่อยได้ไหม
dialogsBegin.tw: 我可能要再仔細的調查一下，當然需要你的幫忙，可以幫我吧？
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi cần sự giúp đỡ của bạn một lần nữa. Bạn có thể giúp tôi một việc không?

dialogsAccept.ar: Take this picture. Please deliver it to Rovanett in the National Library in Saint City. You can find her at Saint Hall.

dialogsAccept.cns: 嗯，拿着这个图片，到晨光之后把这个交给在图书馆工作的鲁巴迦丽，在晨光圣教堂附近可以找到他。

dialogsAccept.fil: Take this picture. Please deliver it to Rovanett in the National Library in Saint City. You can find her at Saint Hall.
dialogsAccept.fr: Très bien ! Prend cette image et apporte-la à Rovanett qui travaille au Bureau des documents anciens de Saincity, près du Saint Hall.

dialogsAccept.jp: さあ、この絵を受け取って、セイントシティーの国立図書館で働いている＜ロバネット＞に渡してくれ。＜ロバネット＞はセイントホールにいるはずだ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 이 그림을 세인트 시티 국립 도서관에서 일하고 있는 로바네트에게 전해 주세요. 세인트 홀에 가면 만날 수 있을 거예요.

dialogsAccept.pl: Take this picture. Please deliver it to Rovanett in the National Library in Saint City. You can find her at Saint Hall.
dialogsAccept.ru: Держи рисунок. Отнеси его Ровене в Национальную библиотеку Санто. Это где-то на центральной площади.
dialogsAccept.sp: Toma esta foto. Entrégasela a Rovanett en la Biblioteca Nacional de Saint. La puedes encontrar en el Ayuntamiento de Saint.

dialogsAccept.tw: 嗯，拿著這個圖片，到聖音特之後把這個交給在圖書館工作的魯巴迦麗，你可以在聖音特教堂找到她。
dialogsAccept.vi: Chụp ảnh này. Vui lòng giao nó cho Rovanett trong Thư viện Quốc gia ở Thành phố Saint. Bạn có thể tìm thấy cô ấy ở Saint Hall.

dialogsDecline.en: Hey we are in this together. We are all in the same boat. You would do better to help me You know that.
dialogsDecline.ar: Hey we are in this together. We are all in the same boat. You would do better to help me You know that.
dialogsDecline.br: Ei, estamos juntos nessa. Estamos todos no mesmo barco. Seria melhor me ajudar, você sabe disso.
dialogsDecline.cns: 喂~帮我一下啦，反正我们都做在同一条船上了不是吗?
dialogsDecline.de: Hey~ Wir sitzen im selben Boot! Es ist besser, wenn du mir hilfst. Du weisst das.
dialogsDecline.fi: Hey we are in this together. We are all in the same boat. You would do better to help me You know that.
dialogsDecline.fil: Hey we are in this together. We are all in the same boat. You would do better to help me You know that.
dialogsDecline.fr: On est dans le même bateau désormais ! Tu ne peux plus reculer…
dialogsDecline.id: Hei kita bersama-sama dalam hal ini. Kita semua berada di kapal yang sama. Lebih baik kamu bantu aku.
dialogsDecline.it: Hey we are in this together. We are all in the same boat. You would do better to help me You know that.
dialogsDecline.jp: ちょっと助けてよ！どうせ同じ船に乗った仲間じゃないか！
dialogsDecline.kr: 같이 하는 일이잖아요. 기왕 같은 배를 탔으니, 저를 도와주시는 게 낫지 않겠어요?
dialogsDecline.nl: Hey we are in this together. We are all in the same boat. You would do better to help me You know that.
dialogsDecline.pl: Hey we are in this together. We are all in the same boat. You would do better to help me You know that.
dialogsDecline.ru: Поздно уходить со сцены! Действие в самом разгаре. Надеюсь, ты передумаешь.
dialogsDecline.sp: Oye, estamos juntos en esto. Todos estamos en el mismo barco. Harías mejor en ayudarme. Lo sabes.
dialogsDecline.sw: Hey we are in this together. We are all in the same boat. You would do better to help me You know that.
dialogsDecline.th: เฮ้ เราทำเรื่องนี้ด้วยกันนะ เราลงเรือลำเดียวกันแล้ว คุณควรทำดีกว่าเพื่อช่วยฉัน คุณก็รู้
dialogsDecline.tw: 喂~幫我一下啦，反正我們都做在同一條船上了不是嗎？
dialogsDecline.vi: Này, chúng ta đang ở trong này cùng nhau. Chúng ta cùng hội cùng thuyền. Bạn sẽ làm tốt hơn để giúp tôi. Bạn biết điều đó.

dialogsComplete.en: Hmm... Is this what Hachal said? Good job. Thank you very much. Let me check.
dialogsComplete.ar: Hmm... Is this what Hachal said? Good job. Thank you very much. Let me check.
dialogsComplete.br: Hmm... É isso o que Hachal disse? Parabéns. Muito obrigado. Vou verificar.
dialogsComplete.cns: Hmm... Is this what Hachal said? Good job. Thank you very much. Let me check.
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm.. Ist es das, was Hachal sagt? Gute Arbeit. Vielen Dank. Lass es mich prüfen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Hmm... Is this what Hachal said? Good job. Thank you very much. Let me check.
dialogsComplete.fil: Hmm... Is this what Hachal said? Good job. Thank you very much. Let me check.
dialogsComplete.fr: Hmm… Hachal t'as demandé de me remettre cela ? Très bien laisse-moi vérifier cette image s'il te plaît.
dialogsComplete.id: Hmm.. Apakah ini yang dikatakan Hachal? Kerja bagus. Terima kasih banyak. Biar kuperiksa.
dialogsComplete.it: Hmm... Is this what Hachal said? Good job. Thank you very much. Let me check.
dialogsComplete.jp: こんにちは。詳しいことはハカル氏から連絡を受けています。なるほど、これがハカル氏の言っていた絵ですね、お預かりします。これから調べてみますので、もう一度いらっしゃってください。
dialogsComplete.kr: 흠... 헤이첼이 이렇게 말하던가요? 잘했어요. 정말 감사합니다. 확인해 볼게요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Hmm... Is this what Hachal said? Good job. Thank you very much. Let me check.
dialogsComplete.pl: Hmm... Is this what Hachal said? Good job. Thank you very much. Let me check.
dialogsComplete.ru: Hmm... Is this what Hachal said? Good job. Thank you very much. Let me check.
dialogsComplete.sp: Hmm... ¿Eso ha dicho Hachal? Buen trabajo. Muchas gracias. Déjame comprobarlo.
dialogsComplete.sw: Hmm... Is this what Hachal said? Good job. Thank you very much. Let me check.
dialogsComplete.th: อืม... นี่คือสิ่งที่ Hachal พูดเหรอ?เยี่ยม! ขอบคุณมาก ขอให้ฉันได้ตรวจสอบก่อน.
dialogsComplete.tw: 嗯……這是夏格凱巴說的嗎？做得很好，謝謝你。讓我看看。
dialogsComplete.vi: Hmm .. Đây có phải là những gì Hachal nói không? Làm tốt lắm. Cảm ơn rất nhiều. Để tôi kiểm tra.

dialogsFail.en: History is always more interesting than current events but this is especially mysterious.
dialogsFail.ar: History is always more interesting than current events but this is especially mysterious.
dialogsFail.br: A História sempre é mais interessante do que eventos atuais, mas isso é especialmente misterioso.
dialogsFail.cns: 古代记录比现在的历史还要有趣，又神秘又有很多的疑惑。但是，对我来说，这个实在是太有趣了。
dialogsFail.de: Die Aufzeichnungen der Ältesten sind jedes mal mysteriöser, als die Geschichten heutzutage, aber diese ist besonders myteriös.
dialogsFail.fi: History is always more interesting than current events but this is especially mysterious.
dialogsFail.fil: History is always more interesting than current events but this is especially mysterious.
dialogsFail.fr: Les anciennes archives sont toujours très mystérieuses, mais l'histoire de Madrigal est assurément le plus grand des mystères !
dialogsFail.id: Sejarah selalu lebih menarik daripada peristiwa terkini, tetapi ini sangat misterius.
dialogsFail.it: History is always more interesting than current events but this is especially mysterious.
dialogsFail.jp: 古代マドリガルの書物に書かれている記述はとても神秘的で謎に満ちています。ですので、現在のわたしたちの知識では理解できないことが多くあるのです。興味深いでしょう？
dialogsFail.kr: 역사는 언제나 현재보다 흥미롭죠. 특히 이번 건 정말 흥미롭고 신비하네요.
dialogsFail.nl: History is always more interesting than current events but this is especially mysterious.
dialogsFail.pl: History is always more interesting than current events but this is especially mysterious.
dialogsFail.ru: Древняя история куда интереснее современной. А эта тайна особенно любопытна…
dialogsFail.sp: La historia siempre es más interesante que los acontecimientos actuales, pero esto es especialmente misterioso.
dialogsFail.sw: History is always more interesting than current events but this is especially mysterious.
dialogsFail.th: ประวัติศาสตร์มักจะน่าสนใจกว่าเหตุการณ์ปัจจุบันเสมอ แต่สิ่งนี้ลึกลับเป็นพิเศษ
dialogsFail.tw: 古代記錄比現在的歷史還要有趣，又神秘又有很多的疑惑。但是，對我來說，這個實在是太有趣了。
dialogsFail.vi: Lịch sử luôn thú vị hơn các sự kiện hiện tại nhưng điều này đặc biệt bí ẩn.

description.br: É isso. Tenho que checar primeiro, então volte daqui a um minuto.

dialogsBegin.en: I can see in your face that you do not believe me. I guess, looking at myself, I do not look like such a Great Magician.
dialogsBegin.ar: I can see in your face that you do not believe me. I guess, looking at myself, I do not look like such a Great Magician.
dialogsBegin.br: Posso ver que você não acredita em mim. Acho que olhando para mim, realmente não pareço uma Grande Maga.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你不相信啊?也对啦，我这个样子..或许配不上大魔法师的称号啦。

dialogsBegin.fi: I can see in your face that you do not believe me. I guess, looking at myself, I do not look like such a Great Magician.
dialogsBegin.fil: I can see in your face that you do not believe me. I guess, looking at myself, I do not look like such a Great Magician.
dialogsBegin.fr: Oui, je sais que je ne ressemble peut-être pas à ce que tu imaginais… Je suis très âgée, mais ma magie me permet de conserver un corps d'adolescente.
dialogsBegin.id: Sepertinya kamu tidak mempercayaiku. Aku rasa penampilanku memang tidak seperti seorang Great Magician.
dialogsBegin.it: I can see in your face that you do not believe me. I guess, looking at myself, I do not look like such a Great Magician.
dialogsBegin.jp: フフ、信用できないといった顔つきをしているわね。まあ、こんな姿ではとても＜大魔導師＞には見えないかもしれないわね。まあいい、まずはあなたにお話したいことがあるから、よく聞いて。
dialogsBegin.kr: 제 말을 믿지 않는 것 같군요. 뭐, 지금 제 꼴을 보면 대매지션이라는 말이 우습게 들리겠죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: I can see in your face that you do not believe me. I guess, looking at myself, I do not look like such a Great Magician.
dialogsBegin.pl: I can see in your face that you do not believe me. I guess, looking at myself, I do not look like such a Great Magician.
dialogsBegin.ru: Что, не веришь? Я и сама не верю, когда гляжу на свое отражение в зеркале. Но первое, чему учат в школе ведьм - менять внешность так, как заблагорассудится.
dialogsBegin.sp: Puedo ver en tu cara que no me crees. Supongo que, mirándome a mí misma, no parezco una Gran Maga.
dialogsBegin.sw: I can see in your face that you do not believe me. I guess, looking at myself, I do not look like such a Great Magician.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันเห็นหน้าคุณว่าคุณไม่เชื่อฉัน ฉันเดาว่าฉันดูไม่เหมือนนักมายากลผู้ยิ่งใหญ่
dialogsBegin.tw: 你不相信啊？也對啦，我這個樣子…或許配不上大魔法師的稱號啦。

dialogsBegin.en: Magic always has a high cost and I used some terrible magic back then.
dialogsBegin.ar: Magic always has a high cost and I used some terrible magic back then.
dialogsBegin.br: Magias sempre tem um custo alto, eu já usei umas magias terríveis no passado.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我之前练魔法的时候，学到了一个很奇怪的魔法..从那时候开始，我就要用这种样子生活到死为止，哈哈。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich habe vor langer Zeit schreckliche Magie verwendet, seit diesem Zeitpunkt, musste ich mit diesem Aussehen leben. Ho Ho~
dialogsBegin.fi: Magic always has a high cost and I used some terrible magic back then.
dialogsBegin.fil: Magic always has a high cost and I used some terrible magic back then.
dialogsBegin.fr: J'ai été la cible d'un sort terrifiant il y a longtemps… depuis je préfère vivre en ermite pour éviter de blesser les habitants de Madrigal…
dialogsBegin.id: Magic selalu meembutuhkan pengorbanan yang besar. Dulu aku pernah menggunakan Magic yang cukup mengerikan.
dialogsBegin.it: Magic always has a high cost and I used some terrible magic back then.
dialogsBegin.jp: 私はかつて高名なマジシャンでした。様々な魔法を使いこなし、私に勝る腕前の魔術師はいないと言われていた。フフ、今となっては遠い昔の話だけど。しかし…その頃私が身につけていた高位魔法の中に、禁断の魔法と呼ばれている魔法があったのです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 마법이란 언제나 대가가 따르죠. 예전에 끔찍한 마법을 사용한 적이 있어요.

dialogsBegin.pl: Magic always has a high cost and I used some terrible magic back then.
dialogsBegin.ru: Так зачем, скажи, мне выглядеть на двести лет, даже если мне и правда двести?
dialogsBegin.sp: La magia siempre tiene un alto precio y yo usé una magia terrible hace un tiempo.
dialogsBegin.sw: Magic always has a high cost and I used some terrible magic back then.
dialogsBegin.th: เวทย์มนตร์มีค่าใช้จ่ายสูงเสมอ และฉันเคยใช้เวทย์มนตร์ที่น่ากลัวในตอนนั้น
dialogsBegin.tw: 我之前練魔法的時候，學到了一個很奇怪的魔法…從那時候開始，我就要用這種樣子生活到死為止，哈哈。
dialogsBegin.vi: Phép thuật luôn có cái giá khá cao và hồi đó tôi đã sử dụng một số phép thuật khủng khiếp.
