dialogsFail.it: It is no secret why I am called the Great Magician. Though, I have learned that being a great magician, does not make you a great person. *cough*
dialogsFail.jp: どうして私が＜大魔導師＞と呼ばれるようになったのかって？それはいずれゆっくり時間のあるときに話してあげましょう。なにせ短い時間では語りつくせないからな。今は、やるべきことが先でしょう。
dialogsFail.kr: 제게 왜 대매지션의 칭호가 붙었는지는 누구나 안답니다. 하지만 대매지션이라고 해서 인격까지 훌륭하다는 소리는 아니거든요. *콜록*
dialogsFail.nl: It is no secret why I am called the Great Magician. Though, I have learned that being a great magician, does not make you a great person. *cough*
dialogsFail.pl: It is no secret why I am called the Great Magician. Though, I have learned that being a great magician, does not make you a great person. *cough*
dialogsFail.ru: Ведьмой кто попало не становится. Тут нужен талант, нужна сила. И характер - о-го-го.
dialogsFail.sp: No es ningún secreto que me llaman la Gran Maga. Sin embargo, he aprendido que ser un gran mago no te convierte en una gran persona. *cof*
dialogsFail.sw: It is no secret why I am called the Great Magician. Though, I have learned that being a great magician, does not make you a great person. *cough*
dialogsFail.th: ไม่เป็นความลับว่าทำไมฉันถึงถูกเรียกว่าจอมเวทย์ผู้ยิ่งใหญ่ แม้ว่าฉันได้เรียนรู้ว่าการเป็นจอมเวทย์ผู้ยิ่งใหญ่ ไม่ได้ทำให้คุณเป็นคนที่ยิ่งใหญ่ *ไอ*
dialogsFail.tw: 你知道我爲什麼有大魔法師的稱號嗎？哈哈…因為啊…這是秘密…呵呵…
dialogsFail.vi: Không có gì bí mật tại sao tôi được gọi là Pháp sư vĩ đại. Mặc dù vậy, tôi đã học được rằng trở thành một nhà ảo thuật vĩ đại, không khiến bạn trở thành một người vĩ đại. *ho*

name.jp: 伝説のレッドマンティス(中編)
name.th: ตำนาน Redmantis (ตอนที่ 2)

description.en: Travel to the Pumpkin patch, slay 10 Red Mantis C and acquire 15 Redyspawn. Return to Helgar when you've completed this task.
description.ar: Travel to the Pumpkin patch, slay 10 Red Mantis C and acquire 15 Redyspawn. Return to Helgar when you've completed this task.
description.br: O Louva-deus Vermelho C é a fêmea, e ela carrega o ovo especial chamado Ovo Avermelhado. Por favor, me traga os ovos.
description.cns: 前往南瓜地，杀死10只蟹足螳螂，获得15个蟹足螳螂卵。完成这个任务后找到海格乐。
description.de: Reise zum Kürbisfeld, besiege 10 Red Mantis C und erlange 15 Redyspawn. Kehre zu Helgar zurück, wenn du fertig bist.
description.fi: Travel to the Pumpkin patch, slay 10 Red Mantis C and acquire 15 Redyspawn. Return to Helgar when you've completed this task.
description.fil: Travel to the Pumpkin patch, slay 10 Red Mantis C and acquire 15 Redyspawn. Return to Helgar when you've completed this task.
description.fr: Rapporter des œufs de Jeune Mantis.
description.id: Pergi ke patch Pumpkin, bunuh 10 Red Mantis C dan dapatkan 15 Redyspawn. Kembali ke Helgar setelah kamu menyelesaikan tugas ini.
description.it: Travel to the Pumpkin patch, slay 10 Red Mantis C and acquire 15 Redyspawn. Return to Helgar when you've completed this task.
description.jp: 唯一メスのみで群生している＜レッドマンティスC＞は、＜マンティス・エッグ＞という特異な卵を産むらしい。その卵を集めて＜ヘルガース＞に鑑定してもらおう。
description.kr: 펌킨 밭으로 가서 레드맨티스 C 10마리를 처치하고, 레디스폰 15개를 수집하세요. 임무를 완료하면 헬가르에게 돌아가세요.
description.nl: Travel to the Pumpkin patch, slay 10 Red Mantis C and acquire 15 Redyspawn. Return to Helgar when you've completed this task.
description.pl: Travel to the Pumpkin patch, slay 10 Red Mantis C and acquire 15 Redyspawn. Return to Helgar when you've completed this task.
description.ru: Нужно победить десяток слабых красных богомолов на тыквенном поле и принести Ольгерду пятнадцать яиц.
description.sp: Viaja al huerto de calabazas, mata a 10 Red Mantis C y consigue 15 Huevos de Red Mantis. Vuelve con Helgar cuando hayas completado esta tarea.
description.sw: Travel to the Pumpkin patch, slay 10 Red Mantis C and acquire 15 Redyspawn. Return to Helgar when you've completed this task.
description.th: เดินทางไปที่ Patch ฟักทองฆ่า Red Mantis C 10 ตัว และรับ Redyspawn 15 ตัว แล้วกลับไปหา Helgar เมื่อเสร็จสิ้นภารกิจนี้
description.tw: 前往南瓜田，擊殺 10 隻赤螳螂 C，並取得 15 個赤螳螂卵。完成後回去找赫爾加。
description.vi: Đi đến Pumpkin patch, tiêu diệt 10 Red Mantis C và thu được 15 Redyspawn. Quay lại Helgar khi bạn đã hoàn thành nhiệm vụ này.

dialogsBegin.en: Hmmm, I think Rudvihil is referring to the Red Mantis Egg. These eggs are difficult to acquire and I think these might be the eggs Rudvihil is after.
dialogsBegin.ar: Hmmm, I think Rudvihil is referring to the Red Mantis Egg. These eggs are difficult to acquire and I think these might be the eggs Rudvihil is after.
dialogsBegin.br: Na verdade, eu não tenho a menor ideia a respeito do tesouro. A única coisa que sei é que é o ovo de um Louva-deus Vermelho.
dialogsBegin.cns: 其实我对那个东西并不太了解，只知道那个是蟹足螳螂的卵。
dialogsBegin.de: Ehrlich gesagt weiß ich nichts über dieses seltene und wertvolle Ding. Das Einzige wovon ich weiß ist dass es das Ei des Redmantis ist..
dialogsBegin.fi: Hmmm, I think Rudvihil is referring to the Red Mantis Egg. These eggs are difficult to acquire and I think these might be the eggs Rudvihil is after.
dialogsBegin.fil: Hmmm, I think Rudvihil is referring to the Red Mantis Egg. These eggs are difficult to acquire and I think these might be the eggs Rudvihil is after.
dialogsBegin.fr: Pour l'instant je ne sais rien sur cet objet rare. Tout ce que je sais c'est qu'il s'agit d'un oeuf de Mantis.
dialogsBegin.id: Hmmm, menurut saya Rudvihil mengacu pada Red Mantis Egg. Telur-telur ini sulit didapat dan saya pikir ini mungkin telur yang dicari Rudvihil.
dialogsBegin.it: Hmmm, I think Rudvihil is referring to the Red Mantis Egg. These eggs are difficult to acquire and I think these might be the eggs Rudvihil is after.
dialogsBegin.jp: 実は、その伝説中に出てくる珍しい物のことに関しては、おれも良く分からないんだ。　知っているのは、それが＜レッドマンティス＞の卵だってことだけだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 흠… 루드비힐이 말하는 건 아마 레드맨티스의 알 같군요. 아주 얻기 어려운 일인데, 아마 그래서 안달을 내고 있는 거겠죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: Hmmm, I think Rudvihil is referring to the Red Mantis Egg. These eggs are difficult to acquire and I think these might be the eggs Rudvihil is after.
dialogsBegin.pl: Hmmm, I think Rudvihil is referring to the Red Mantis Egg. These eggs are difficult to acquire and I think these might be the eggs Rudvihil is after.
dialogsBegin.ru: Яйцо Богомольже?! Вот умора! Не Богомольже, а богомольжье! Или, правильнее сказать, богомоличье. Видно, Сотби о нем рассказал тот еще грамотей! Впрочем, яйца богомола - и впрямь большая редкость.
dialogsBegin.sp: Hmmm, creo que Rudvihil se refiere al Huevo de Red Mantis. Esos huevos son difíciles de adquirir y creo que podrían ser los huevos que busca Rudvihil.
dialogsBegin.sw: Hmmm, I think Rudvihil is referring to the Red Mantis Egg. These eggs are difficult to acquire and I think these might be the eggs Rudvihil is after.
dialogsBegin.th: อืม ฉันคิดว่า Rudvihil หมายถึง Red Mantis Egg และมันยากที่จะได้ไข่เหล่านี้มา แล้วฉันก็คิดว่านี่อาจเป็นไข่ที่ Rudvihil กำลังตามหา
dialogsBegin.tw: 其實我對那個東西並不太了解，只知道那個是嫩嫩的赤螳螂的卵。
dialogsBegin.vi: Hmmm, tôi nghĩ Rudvihil đang đề cập đến Red Mantis Egg. Những quả trứng này rất khó lấy và tôi nghĩ đây có thể là những quả trứng mà Rudvihil đang theo đuổi.

dialogsBegin.en: There are reports that some Red Mantis C, the female variety, have been seen near the pumpkin patch. Feel like taking a trip?
dialogsBegin.ar: There are reports that some Red Mantis C, the female variety, have been seen near the pumpkin patch. Feel like taking a trip?
dialogsBegin.br: Então... Talvez... Anh... Desculpe-me... Mas será que você me ajudaria, por favor?
dialogsBegin.cns: 可是..又说不定..你可以帮我一件事情吗?
dialogsBegin.de: Es gibt Berichte, dass weibliche Red Mantis C in der Nähe des Kürbisfeldes gesichtet wurden. Lust auf einen Ausflug?
dialogsBegin.fi: There are reports that some Red Mantis C, the female variety, have been seen near the pumpkin patch. Feel like taking a trip?
dialogsBegin.fil: There are reports that some Red Mantis C, the female variety, have been seen near the pumpkin patch. Feel like taking a trip?
dialogsBegin.fr: Peut-être..Que.. (Hésitant) Je suis désolé.. Mais pourrais-tu m'aider?
dialogsBegin.id: Ada laporan bahwa beberapa Red Mantis C, varietas betina, telah terlihat di dekat kebun labu. Merasa seperti melakukan perjalanan?
dialogsBegin.it: There are reports that some Red Mantis C, the female variety, have been seen near the pumpkin patch. Feel like taking a trip?
dialogsBegin.jp: マドリガルでも有名な鑑定士のおれですら良く知らないことだけに、その噂にはとても興味があるんだ。ハハッ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 레드맨티스 C, 즉 암컷 개체가 펌킨 밭 근처에서 목격됐다는 보고가 있어요. 어때요, 다녀오실래요?
dialogsBegin.nl: There are reports that some Red Mantis C, the female variety, have been seen near the pumpkin patch. Feel like taking a trip?
dialogsBegin.pl: There are reports that some Red Mantis C, the female variety, have been seen near the pumpkin patch. Feel like taking a trip?
dialogsBegin.ru: Говорят, самок слабого красного богомола видели недалеко от тыквенного поля. Можно взглянуть, не появилось ли там яиц. Что скажешь?
dialogsBegin.sp: Hay informes de que se han visto algunas Red Mantis C, la variedad hembra, cerca del huerto de calabazas. ¿Te apetece hacer un viajecito?
dialogsBegin.sw: There are reports that some Red Mantis C, the female variety, have been seen near the pumpkin patch. Feel like taking a trip?
dialogsBegin.th: มีรายงานว่ามี Red Mantis C ตัวเมียถูกพบใกล้ๆ ไร่ฟักทอง มันแปลกๆ นะว่าไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 有報告指出，南瓜田附近出現了一些雌性的紅螳螂 C。想去一趟嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Có báo cáo rằng một số Red Mantis C, giống cái, đã được nhìn thấy gần pumpkin patch. Có muốn đi 1 chuyến không?

dialogsAccept.en: Great! Head to the pumpkin patch, slay 10 Red Mantis C and collect 15 Redyspawn. These are the eggs. Hopefully we'll find a pristine one!
dialogsAccept.ar: Great! Head to the pumpkin patch, slay 10 Red Mantis C and collect 15 Redyspawn. These are the eggs. Hopefully we'll find a pristine one!
dialogsAccept.br: Excelente! Vá para o canteiro de abóboras, mate 10 Louva-deus Vermelho C e colete 15 Ovos Avermelhados. Esses são os ovos. Esperançosamente nós encontraremos um imaculado!
dialogsAccept.cns: 蟹足螳螂是专门用母的组成的，所以你去帮我找她们的蟹足螳螂的卵好吗?
dialogsAccept.de: Klasse! Gehe zum Kürbisfeld, töte 10 Red Mantis C und sammle 15 Redyspawn. Das sind ihre Eier. Hoffentlich finden wir ein makelloses Ei!
dialogsAccept.fi: Great! Head to the pumpkin patch, slay 10 Red Mantis C and collect 15 Redyspawn. These are the eggs. Hopefully we'll find a pristine one!
dialogsAccept.fil: Great! Head to the pumpkin patch, slay 10 Red Mantis C and collect 15 Redyspawn. These are the eggs. Hopefully we'll find a pristine one!
dialogsAccept.fr: Le Jeune Mantis porte un oeuf spécial appelé Oeufantis. S'il te plaît rapporte-moi de ces œufs.
dialogsAccept.id: Besar! Pergilah ke petak labu, bunuh 10 Red Mantis C dan kumpulkan 15 Redyspawn. Ini adalah telur. Semoga kita akan menemukan yang murni!
dialogsAccept.it: Great! Head to the pumpkin patch, slay 10 Red Mantis C and collect 15 Redyspawn. These are the eggs. Hopefully we'll find a pristine one!
dialogsAccept.jp: レッドマンティスの中で、唯一メスのみで群生している＜レッドマンティスC＞は＜マンティス・エッグ＞という特異な卵を産むんだ。その卵を持って来てくれないか？
dialogsAccept.kr: 좋아요! 펌킨 밭으로 가서 레드맨티스 C 10마리를 처치하고, 레디스폰 15개를 모아주세요. 맨티스의 알을 레디스폰이라고 불러요. 괜찮은 녀석이 하나쯤 있겠죠!
dialogsAccept.nl: Great! Head to the pumpkin patch, slay 10 Red Mantis C and collect 15 Redyspawn. These are the eggs. Hopefully we'll find a pristine one!
dialogsAccept.pl: Great! Head to the pumpkin patch, slay 10 Red Mantis C and collect 15 Redyspawn. These are the eggs. Hopefully we'll find a pristine one!
dialogsAccept.ru: Отлично! Отправляйся на тыквенное поле, победи десяток слабых богомолов и собери пятнадцать яиц. Может, среди них найдется истинная жемчужина!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Estupendo! Dirígete al huerto de calabazas, mata a 10 Red Mantis C y recoge 15 Huevos de Red Mantis. Esos son los huevos. ¡Ojalá encontremos uno impecable!
dialogsAccept.sw: Great! Head to the pumpkin patch, slay 10 Red Mantis C and collect 15 Redyspawn. These are the eggs. Hopefully we'll find a pristine one!
dialogsAccept.th: ดีมาก! งั้นจงมุ่งหน้าไปยังไร่ฟักทองแล้วฆ่า Red Mantis C 10 ตัว และรวบรวม Redyspawn 15 ตัว พวกนี้คือไข่ หวังว่าเราจะได้พบกับอันที่เก่าแก่ที่สุด!
dialogsAccept.tw: 太好了！前往南瓜田，擊殺 10 隻赤螳螂 C，並收集 15 個赤螳螂卵。這些就是卵。希望能找到一個完好的！
dialogsAccept.vi: Tuyệt quá! Đi đến pumpkin patch, giết 10 Red Mantis C và thu thập 15 Redyspawn. Đây là những quả trứng. Hy vọng rằng chúng tôi sẽ tìm thấy một trứng nguyên sơ!

dialogsDecline.en: Are you afraid of a little action? This is a very rare find, it will be worthwhile, I promise. Let me know if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ar: Are you afraid of a little action? This is a very rare find, it will be worthwhile, I promise. Let me know if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.br: Você tem medo de um pouco de ação? Este é um achado muito raro, vai valer a pena, eu prometo. Deixe-me saber se você mudar de ideia.
dialogsDecline.cns: 这不只是因为要帮萝特泰斯而请你去找的，因为连我自己也很想看看到底是什么东西。
dialogsDecline.de: Hast du Angst vor ein bisschen Action? Dies ist ein sehr seltener Fund, es wird sich lohnen, ich verspreche es. Lass mich wissen, wenn du deine Meinung änderst.
dialogsDecline.fi: Are you afraid of a little action? This is a very rare find, it will be worthwhile, I promise. Let me know if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fil: Are you afraid of a little action? This is a very rare find, it will be worthwhile, I promise. Let me know if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fr: Ce n'est pas que pour Rudvihil, mais pour moi aussi. Je veux aussi le voir. Ce sera une bonne expérience pour toi. S'il te plaît, ramène-le moi.
dialogsDecline.id: Apakah kamu takut dengan tindakan kecil? Ini adalah penemuan yang sangat langka, itu akan bermanfaat, saya janji. Beri tahu saya jika kamu berubah pikiran.
dialogsDecline.it: Are you afraid of a little action? This is a very rare find, it will be worthwhile, I promise. Let me know if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.jp: この頼みはルードヴィヒのためだけじゃない。オレも一度その卵を見てみたいし、君にとっても良い経験になると思うが？
dialogsDecline.kr: 막상 가자니 무서우신가요? 이건 정말 희귀한 거라고요. 갈 만한 가치가 있어요, 정말로요. 마음이 바뀌면 다시 오세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Are you afraid of a little action? This is a very rare find, it will be worthwhile, I promise. Let me know if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.pl: Are you afraid of a little action? This is a very rare find, it will be worthwhile, I promise. Let me know if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ru: Are you afraid of a little action? This is a very rare find, it will be worthwhile, I promise. Let me know if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Tienes miedo de un poco de acción? Este es un hallazgo muy raro, valdrá la pena, lo prometo. Avísame si cambias de parecer.
dialogsDecline.sw: Are you afraid of a little action? This is a very rare find, it will be worthwhile, I promise. Let me know if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณกลัวเรื่องแค่นี้งั้นเหรอ? สิ่งนี้หายากมาก มันจะคุ้มค่า ฉันให้สัญญา บอกฉันด้วยหากคุณเปลี่ยนใจ
dialogsDecline.tw: 你害怕一點點的行動嗎？這是一個非常罕見的發現，這很值得的，我保證。如果你改變主意，請告訴我。
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn có e ngại hành động 1 chút không? Đây là một phát hiện rất hiếm, nó sẽ rất đáng giá, tôi hứa. Hãy cho tôi biết nếu bạn thay đổi ý định.

dialogsComplete.en: Let me see what you've got there… Hmm yes, these are very nice! Thank you for bring these to me!
dialogsComplete.ar: Let me see what you've got there… Hmm yes, these are very nice! Thank you for bring these to me!
dialogsComplete.br: Oh, é isso! Hmm... Deixe-me checar se é realmente útil ou não. Por favor, aguarde um momento.
dialogsComplete.cns: 啊，原来就是这个啊..我先去看一下..看看它是否真的有那么贵重的价值。
dialogsComplete.de: Oh, dies ist es! Hmm.. Lass mich mal sehen ob es nützlich ist oder nicht. Einen Moment bitte.
dialogsComplete.fi: Let me see what you've got there… Hmm yes, these are very nice! Thank you for bring these to me!
dialogsComplete.fil: Let me see what you've got there… Hmm yes, these are very nice! Thank you for bring these to me!
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh, c'est bien ça! Hmm.. Laisse-moi vérifier si c'est utile ou pas. Attends un instant s'il te plaît.
dialogsComplete.id: Biarkan saya melihat apa yang kamu dapatkan di sana ... Hmm ya, ini sangat bagus! Terima kasih telah membawakan ini untukku!
dialogsComplete.it: Let me see what you've got there… Hmm yes, these are very nice! Thank you for bring these to me!
dialogsComplete.jp: 君が持って来た物を見せてくれ！うーん、なかなか良い！ありがとう！
dialogsComplete.kr: 어디 봐요… 음, 좋아요. 아주 훌륭하네요! 가져다주셔서 감사해요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Let me see what you've got there… Hmm yes, these are very nice! Thank you for bring these to me!
dialogsComplete.pl: Let me see what you've got there… Hmm yes, these are very nice! Thank you for bring these to me!
dialogsComplete.ru: Давай-ка посмотрим... Да-да, это то, что нужно!
dialogsComplete.sp: Déjame ver lo que tienes ahí... Hmm sí, ¡estos son muy bonitos! ¡Gracias por traermelos!
dialogsComplete.sw: Let me see what you've got there… Hmm yes, these are very nice! Thank you for bring these to me!
dialogsComplete.th: ให้ฉันดูสิว่าคุณได้อะไรมาบ้าง... อืมใช่ นี่เป็นสิ่งที่ดีมาก! ขอบคุณที่นำสิ่งเหล่านี้มาให้ฉัน!
dialogsComplete.tw: 啊，原來就是這個啊…我先去看一下…看看它是否真的有那麼貴重的價值。
dialogsComplete.vi: Hãy để tôi xem bạn có gì ở đó… Hmm vâng, những thứ này rất hay! Cảm ơn bạn đã mang những thứ này cho tôi!

dialogsFail.en: What are you doing here? You have work to do!
dialogsFail.ar: What are you doing here? You have work to do!
dialogsFail.br: O que você está fazendo aqui? Você tem trabalho a fazer!
dialogsFail.cns: 像你这种人应该很容易猎杀蟹足螳螂才对啊..难道你是吃软饭长大的?
dialogsFail.de: Was machst du hier? Du hast noch Arbeit vor dir!
dialogsFail.fi: What are you doing here? You have work to do!
dialogsFail.fil: What are you doing here? You have work to do!
dialogsFail.fr: Ce n'est pas très difficile pour toi de vaincre un Jeune Mantis, je pense. Ai-je tort ?
dialogsFail.id: Apa yang kamu lakukan di sini? Kamu memiliki pekerjaan yang harus dilakukan!
dialogsFail.it: What are you doing here? You have work to do!
dialogsFail.jp: 君の実力なら、レッドマンティスCを相手にするのは、楽勝だろう。頑張ってくれ！
dialogsFail.kr: 여기서 뭐 하시는 거예요? 할 일이 있잖아요!

dialogsBegin.en: I now have another favor to ask of you. A mysterious curse has turned the once docile Fefern into foul beasts which are ravaging the land. Will you defeat them?
dialogsBegin.ar: I now have another favor to ask of you. A mysterious curse has turned the once docile Fefern into foul beasts which are ravaging the land. Will you defeat them?
dialogsBegin.br: Agora tenho outro favor para pedir a você. Uma misteriosa maldição transformou a outrora dócil Fefern em monstros horríveis que estão devastando a terra. Poderia derrotá-las?
dialogsBegin.cns: 我现在需要你的帮忙。一个神秘的诅咒将原来温顺的菲菲龙变成了嗜血如命的肮脏怪物。你愿意击杀它们吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Aufgrund deiner Fortschritte sollte die nächste Mission kein Problem für dich sein. Pflanzen, die im Norden von Flaris wachsen, sind mutiert und zertören das Ökosystem von Flaris. Kannst du sie beseitigen?
dialogsBegin.fi: I now have another favor to ask of you. A mysterious curse has turned the once docile Fefern into foul beasts which are ravaging the land. Will you defeat them?
dialogsBegin.fil: I now have another favor to ask of you. A mysterious curse has turned the once docile Fefern into foul beasts which are ravaging the land. Will you defeat them?
dialogsBegin.fr: On va continuer à vous entrainer. Certaines plantes au Nord de Flaris ont été corrompues par des forces maléfiques.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku sekarang memiliki permintaan lain padamu. Kutukan misterius telah mengubah Fefern yang dulu jinak menjadi binatang buas yang merusak. Apakah Kamu dapat mengalahkan mereka?
dialogsBegin.it: I now have another favor to ask of you. A mysterious curse has turned the once docile Fefern into foul beasts which are ravaging the land. Will you defeat them?
dialogsBegin.jp: さて、いまのお前さんならこの依頼も余裕だろう。フラリスの北に生息していた植物が凶暴化し人々を襲っているようだ。こいつらを退治してきてくれないか。
dialogsBegin.kr: 또 하나 부탁할 게 생겼어요. 한때는 온순했던 페페른들이 알 수 없는 저주에 걸려, 흉포한 괴물로 변해 사방을 헤집고 다니고 있어요. 혹시 페페른을 처치해 주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: I now have another favor to ask of you. A mysterious curse has turned the once docile Fefern into foul beasts which are ravaging the land. Will you defeat them?
dialogsBegin.pl: I now have another favor to ask of you. A mysterious curse has turned the once docile Fefern into foul beasts which are ravaging the land. Will you defeat them?
dialogsBegin.ru: I now have another favor to ask of you. A mysterious curse has turned the once docile Fefern into foul beasts which are ravaging the land. Will you defeat them?
dialogsBegin.sp: Ahora tengo otro favor que pedirte. Una misteriosa maldición ha convertido a los antes dóciles Fefern en bestias asquerosas que están devastando la tierra. ¿Te puedes ocupar de ellos?
dialogsBegin.sw: I now have another favor to ask of you. A mysterious curse has turned the once docile Fefern into foul beasts which are ravaging the land. Will you defeat them?
dialogsBegin.th: ตอนนี้ฉันมีเรื่องจะขอร้องคุณอีก คำสาปลึกลับได้เปลี่ยน Fefern ที่เคยเชื่อฟังให้กลายเป็นสัตว์ร้ายที่ทำลายล้างแผ่นดิน คุณจะเอาชนะพวกมันได้มั้ย?
dialogsBegin.tw: 我現在還有一個事情要請你幫忙。一個神秘的詛咒把曾經溫順的蜥蜴草變成了肆虐這片土地的邪惡野獸。你會打敗他們嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bây giờ tôi có một ân huệ khác để yêu cầu bạn. Một lời nguyền bí ẩn đã biến Fefern ngoan ngoãn một thời trở thành những con thú hôi hám đang tàn phá vùng đất. Bạn sẽ đánh bại chúng chứ?

dialogsDecline.en: So that’s it? You eliminate a giant Rogue, yet tremble at the sight of some mere weeds?

dialogsDecline.br: Então é isso? Você elimina um Rogue gigante, mas treme ao ver algumas plantinhas?

dialogsDecline.jp: 何？　ひょっとしてお前さん野菜嫌いか？

dialogsComplete.en: It's as I've come to expect. The villagers are rejoicing of your heroic deeds. You my friend, have earned yourself quite a reputation around here.
dialogsComplete.ar: It's as I've come to expect. The villagers are rejoicing of your heroic deeds. You my friend, have earned yourself quite a reputation around here.
dialogsComplete.br: É como eu esperava. Os aldeões estão se alegrando com seus atos heroicos. Você, amigo(a), ganhou uma grande reputação por aqui.
dialogsComplete.cns: 正如我所料。居民们正为你的英雄事迹欢呼呢。我的朋友，你为你自己争取到了周围人的敬重。
dialogsComplete.de: Es ist so, wie ich es erwartet habe. Die Dorfbewohner jubeln über Eure Heldentaten. Du, mein Freund, hast dir hier einen guten Ruf erworben.

dialogsComplete.fr: Traversez le pont au nord de Flaris et vous trouverez les Fefern.
dialogsComplete.id: Ini seperti yang kuharapkan. Penduduk desa bersukacita atas tindakan heroikmu. Temanku, kamu telah memiliki reputasi bagus disini.
dialogsComplete.it: It's as I've come to expect. The villagers are rejoicing of your heroic deeds. You my friend, have earned yourself quite a reputation around here.

dialogsComplete.kr: 역시 기대한 대로네요! 영웅적인 활약에 마을 사람들이 기뻐하고 있어요. 이곳에서는 명성이 자자하답니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: It's as I've come to expect. The villagers are rejoicing of your heroic deeds. You my friend, have earned yourself quite a reputation around here.
dialogsComplete.pl: It's as I've come to expect. The villagers are rejoicing of your heroic deeds. You my friend, have earned yourself quite a reputation around here.
dialogsComplete.ru: It's as I've come to expect. The villagers are rejoicing of your heroic deeds. You my friend, have earned yourself quite a reputation around here.
dialogsComplete.sp: Es lo que esperaba. Los aldeanos se regocijan de tus actos heroicos. Tú, amigo mío, te has ganado una gran reputación por aquí.

dialogsComplete.th: เป็นไปตามที่ฉันคาดไว้ ชาวบ้านชื่นชมยินดีกับการกระทำที่กล้าหาญของคุณ คุณเพื่อนของฉันได้รับชื่อเสียงค่อนข้างมากที่นี่
dialogsComplete.tw: 正如我所期待的那樣，村民們為你的英勇事蹟歡欣鼓舞。你，我的朋友，在這里為自己贏得了相當的聲譽。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nó diễn ra như tôi đã mong đợi. Dân làng vui mừng vì những việc làm anh hùng của bạn. Bạn là bạn của tôi, đã tạo được cho mình một danh tiếng khá lớn ở đây.

dialogsBegin.th: ตอนนี้เราก็แค่ต้องรอจังหวะที่เหมาะสมเพื่อเปิดประตู! ว่าแต่คุณมีอะไรอีกมั้ย?
dialogsBegin.tw: 現在我們只要等到對的時機開門就行了！不過，你到底找我有什麼事？

dialogsBegin.en: Gathering the 8 original heroes? Hmph. Been so long I can hardly recall. Only member I've kept in touch with is Elaine… err, forget I said anything. Hah.
dialogsBegin.ar: Gathering the 8 original heroes? Hmph. Been so long I can hardly recall. Only member I've kept in touch with is Elaine… err, forget I said anything. Hah.
dialogsBegin.br: Os 8 Heróis originais irão se reunir? Ih. Faz tanto tempo que mal consigo me lembrar deles. O único membro com quem mantive contato é Elaine... err, esqueça que eu te disse alguma coisa.
dialogsBegin.cns: 找到8位原始英雄？嗯哼。已经这么久了，我几乎想不起来了。我唯一保持联系的成员是伊莲......呃，忘了我说过什么。哈。
dialogsBegin.de: Die 8 Originalhelden versammeln? Hm. Es ist so lange her, dass ich mich kaum erinnern kann. Das einzige Mitglied, mit dem ich in Kontakt geblieben bin, ist Elaine... ähm, vergiss, was ich gesagt habe. Hah.
dialogsBegin.fi: Gathering the 8 original heroes? Hmph. Been so long I can hardly recall. Only member I've kept in touch with is Elaine… err, forget I said anything. Hah.
dialogsBegin.fil: Gathering the 8 original heroes? Hmph. Been so long I can hardly recall. Only member I've kept in touch with is Elaine… err, forget I said anything. Hah.
dialogsBegin.fr: Des Héros réincarnés ? Oui, je suis l'un de ceux que vous cherchez.
dialogsBegin.id: Mengumpulkan 8 pahlawan asli? Hmph. Sudah begitu lama saya hampir tidak bisa mengingatnya. Anggota yang terus saya hubungi hanyalah Elaine... err, lupakan aku mengatakan sesuatu. Hah.
dialogsBegin.it: Gathering the 8 original heroes? Hmph. Been so long I can hardly recall. Only member I've kept in touch with is Elaine… err, forget I said anything. Hah.
dialogsBegin.jp: 創世戦争の頃の英雄を探しているだと……ふむ。確かに私も古の時代、英雄と呼ばれる一人であったが……、レオナンの名を出してもまだ君を完全に信用していないぞ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 영웅 여덟 명을 다시 모은다고요? 흠. 너무 오래되어 기억도 가물가물 한데. 제가 연락을 이어온 건 일레인 정도… 아, 방금 말한 건 잊어 주세요. 하하.
dialogsBegin.nl: Gathering the 8 original heroes? Hmph. Been so long I can hardly recall. Only member I've kept in touch with is Elaine… err, forget I said anything. Hah.
dialogsBegin.pl: Gathering the 8 original heroes? Hmph. Been so long I can hardly recall. Only member I've kept in touch with is Elaine… err, forget I said anything. Hah.
dialogsBegin.ru: Gathering the 8 original heroes? Hmph. Been so long I can hardly recall. Only member I've kept in touch with is Elaine… err, forget I said anything. Hah.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Reuniendo a los 8 héroes originales? Hmmm. Ha pasado tanto tiempo que apenas puedo recordar. Con el único miembro con el que me he mantenido en contacto es Elaine... emm, olvida lo que he dicho. Ja.
dialogsBegin.sw: Gathering the 8 original heroes? Hmph. Been so long I can hardly recall. Only member I've kept in touch with is Elaine… err, forget I said anything. Hah.
dialogsBegin.th: การรวบรวมวีรบุรุษเดิม 8 ตัว? ฮึ่ม เป็นเวลานานที่ฉันแทบจะไม่สามารถจำได้ เฉพาะสมาชิกที่ฉันเก็บไว้ด้วยเท่านั้นคือเอเลน ... ฉันลืมพูดอะไร ห๊ะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 你說要集結最初的 8 位英雄？哼。時間太久了，我幾乎想不起來。唯一還有聯絡的只有伊蓮…呃，忘了我說過這些吧。哈。
dialogsBegin.vi: tập hợp đủ 8 anh hùng thuở sơ khai ư? Hừm. Đã quá lâu tôi khó có thể nhớ lại. Thành viên duy nhất tôi giữ liên lạc là Elaine… ờ, quên mất tôi đã nói gì rồi. Hah.

dialogsBegin.en: I can prove quickly if it was truly Reonan who sent you. Reonan is perceptive when it comes to people and he doesn't choose just any pushover! How about a test of your skill?
dialogsBegin.ar: I can prove quickly if it was truly Reonan who sent you. Reonan is perceptive when it comes to people and he doesn't choose just any pushover! How about a test of your skill?
dialogsBegin.br: Posso provar rapidamente se foi realmente Reonan quem te enviou. Reonan é perspicaz quando se trata de pessoas e ele não escolhe qualquer um! Que tal um teste de sua habilidade?
dialogsBegin.cns: 我可以很快证明是否真的是瑞尔南派你来的。瑞尔南对人有敏锐的洞察力，他不会随便选择容易推卸责任的人。让我来试试你的技能可以吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Ich kann schnell beweisen, ob es wirklich Reonan war, der dich geschickt hat. Reonan ist sehr scharfsinnig, wenn es um Menschen geht, und er sucht sich nicht irgendeinen Schwächling aus! Wie wäre es mit einem Test deiner Fähigkeiten?
dialogsBegin.fi: I can prove quickly if it was truly Reonan who sent you. Reonan is perceptive when it comes to people and he doesn't choose just any pushover! How about a test of your skill?
dialogsBegin.fil: I can prove quickly if it was truly Reonan who sent you. Reonan is perceptive when it comes to people and he doesn't choose just any pushover! How about a test of your skill?
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous dites que Reonan vous envoie… vous semblez pourtant si faible…
dialogsBegin.id: Aku bisa membuktikan dengan cepat jika benar-benar Reonan yang mengirimmu. Reonan tanggap dalam hal yang berkaitan dengan orang dan dia tidak memilih sembarangan! Bagaimana dengan ujian keahlian Anda?
dialogsBegin.it: I can prove quickly if it was truly Reonan who sent you. Reonan is perceptive when it comes to people and he doesn't choose just any pushover! How about a test of your skill?
dialogsBegin.jp: ところで君は本当に英雄と肩を並べられる程の実力を持っているのか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 그러면 당신이 정말 레오난이 보낸 사람이 맞는지 알 수 있겠죠. 레오난은 사람 보는 눈이 정확하거든요. 아무한테나 그런 일을 맡기진 않죠! 자, 실력을 시험해 볼까요?
dialogsBegin.nl: I can prove quickly if it was truly Reonan who sent you. Reonan is perceptive when it comes to people and he doesn't choose just any pushover! How about a test of your skill?
dialogsBegin.pl: I can prove quickly if it was truly Reonan who sent you. Reonan is perceptive when it comes to people and he doesn't choose just any pushover! How about a test of your skill?
dialogsBegin.ru: I can prove quickly if it was truly Reonan who sent you. Reonan is perceptive when it comes to people and he doesn't choose just any pushover! How about a test of your skill?
dialogsBegin.sp: Puedo comprobar rápidamente si realmente es Reonan quien te ha enviado. ¡Reonan es perspicaz con las personas y no elige a cualquiera! ¿Qué tal una prueba de tu habilidad?
dialogsBegin.sw: I can prove quickly if it was truly Reonan who sent you. Reonan is perceptive when it comes to people and he doesn't choose just any pushover! How about a test of your skill?
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันสามารถพิสูจน์ได้อย่างรวดเร็วถ้ามันเป็นอย่างแท้จริง Reonan ผู้ที่ส่งคุณ Reonan สามารถรับรู้ได้เมื่อพูดถึงคนอื่น ๆ และเขาไม่ได้เลือกอะไรเลย! วิธีการเกี่ยวกับการทดสอบทักษะของคุณ?
dialogsBegin.tw: 要證明你真是雷奧南派來的並不難。他看人很準，絕不會隨便挑個弱者！要不要接受實力測試？
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi có thể nhanh chóng chứng minh nếu đó thực sự là Reonan. Reonan rất nhạy bén khi nói đến mọi người và anh ấy không chỉ chọn bất kỳ lời thúc giục nào! Một bài kiểm tra kỹ năng của bạn có được không?

dialogsBegin.en: First, I need to test your skill. Go kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts and come back, Then I will trust you and participate to Reonan's decision.
dialogsBegin.ar: First, I need to test your skill. Go kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts and come back, Then I will trust you and participate to Reonan's decision.
dialogsBegin.br: Primeiro, preciso testar sua habilidade. Se você eliminar 15 Volts & 15 Volts Capitães e voltar, vou confiar em você e participar da decisão de Reonan.
dialogsBegin.cns: 首先，我需要测试你的技能。去杀15个电磁履带车和15个高压电磁履带车，我想我就会相信你，并参与瑞尔南的决定。
dialogsBegin.de: Zuerst muss ich deine Fähigkeiten testen. Geh und töte 15 Volts und 15 Captain Volts und komm zurück. Dann werde ich dir vertrauen und mich an Reonans Entscheidung beteiligen.
dialogsBegin.fi: First, I need to test your skill. Go kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts and come back, Then I will trust you and participate to Reonan's decision.
dialogsBegin.fil: First, I need to test your skill. Go kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts and come back, Then I will trust you and participate to Reonan's decision.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il faut que j'en aie le cœur net. Allez tuer 15 Volts et 15 Capitaines Volt pour me prouver que Reonan a pris une bonne décision en vous envoyant ici.
dialogsBegin.id: Pertama, saya perlu menguji keahlian Anda. Bunuh 15 Volt &15 Captain Volts dan kembalilah, Maka saya akan mempercayai Anda dan berpartisipasi dalam keputusan Reonan.
dialogsBegin.it: First, I need to test your skill. Go kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts and come back, Then I will trust you and participate to Reonan's decision.
dialogsBegin.jp: ふむ、じゃあ少し試してみよう。この辺りに生息しているボルト15匹、キャプテン・ボルト15匹倒してくるのだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 우선 당신 실력을 시험해 보고 싶네요. 볼트 15마리와 두목 볼트 15마리를 처치하고 돌아오세요. 그러면 당신을 믿고, 레오난의 결정에 따르겠습니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: First, I need to test your skill. Go kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts and come back, Then I will trust you and participate to Reonan's decision.
dialogsBegin.pl: First, I need to test your skill. Go kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts and come back, Then I will trust you and participate to Reonan's decision.
dialogsBegin.ru: First, I need to test your skill. Go kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts and come back, Then I will trust you and participate to Reonan's decision.
dialogsBegin.sp: Primero, necesito comprobar tu habilidad. Ve a derrotar a 15 Volts y a 15 Volts Capitanes y vuelve. Entonces confiaré en ti y participaré en la decisión de Reonan.
dialogsBegin.sw: First, I need to test your skill. Go kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts and come back, Then I will trust you and participate to Reonan's decision.
dialogsBegin.th: ขั้นแรกฉันต้องทดสอบทักษะของคุณ ไปฆ่า Captain Volt 10 ตัว และกลับมา แล้วฉันจะไว้วางใจคุณและมีส่วนร่วมในการตัดสินใจของ Reonan
dialogsBegin.tw: 首先，我需要測試你的實力。去擊殺 15 隻機械戰車和 15 隻機械戰車頭目後回來。那樣我就會信任你，並參與雷奧南的決定。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đầu tiên, tôi cần kiểm tra kỹ năng của bạn. Hãy tiêu diệt 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts và quay trở lại. Sau đó, tôi sẽ tin tưởng bạn và tham gia vào quyết định của Reonan.

dialogsAccept.en: How about you… mmm… Kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts! BAM! There we go. A true test of skill. Then I will know for sure! You can find them East of this location.
dialogsAccept.ar: How about you… mmm… Kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts! BAM! There we go. A true test of skill. Then I will know for sure! You can find them East of this location.
dialogsAccept.br: Que tal você… mmm… Matar 15 Volts & 15 Volts Capitães! BAM! Aqui vamos nós. Um verdadeiro teste de habilidade. Então eu vou saber com certeza! Você pode encontrá-los a Leste deste local.
dialogsAccept.cns: 你呢......嗯......杀了15个电磁履带车和15个高压电磁履带车! 砰! 我们走吧。一个真正的技能测试。然后我就能确定了！你可以在这个位置的东边找到他们。
dialogsAccept.de: Wie wäre es, wenn du... mmm... 15 Volt und 15 Captain Volts tötest! BAM! Das war's. Ein wahrer Test des Könnens. Dann werde ich es sicher wissen! Ihr findet sie östlich von diesem Ort.
dialogsAccept.fi: How about you… mmm… Kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts! BAM! There we go. A true test of skill. Then I will know for sure! You can find them East of this location.
dialogsAccept.fil: How about you… mmm… Kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts! BAM! There we go. A true test of skill. Then I will know for sure! You can find them East of this location.
dialogsAccept.fr: Je dois m'assurer que vous ne vous ferez pas tuer avant la fin.
dialogsAccept.id: Bagaimana denganmu... Mmm... Bunuh 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts!! BAM! Di sana kita pergi. Ujian keterampilan yang sebenarnya. Maka saya akan tahu pasti! Anda dapat menemukannya di sebelah Timur lokasi ini.
dialogsAccept.it: How about you… mmm… Kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts! BAM! There we go. A true test of skill. Then I will know for sure! You can find them East of this location.
dialogsAccept.jp: ボルト15匹、キャプテンボルト15匹だ。君が英雄ならそれくらいはたやすいだろう。
dialogsAccept.kr: 흠… 그렇다면... 볼트 15마리와 두목 볼트 15마리를 처치해 보세요! 이 정도면 실력 시험이 되겠죠? 이걸 해내면, 저도 믿어 드릴게요. 볼트는 여기서 동쪽으로 가면 있답니다.
dialogsAccept.nl: How about you… mmm… Kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts! BAM! There we go. A true test of skill. Then I will know for sure! You can find them East of this location.
dialogsAccept.pl: How about you… mmm… Kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts! BAM! There we go. A true test of skill. Then I will know for sure! You can find them East of this location.
dialogsAccept.ru: How about you… mmm… Kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts! BAM! There we go. A true test of skill. Then I will know for sure! You can find them East of this location.
dialogsAccept.sp: Qué te parece si... mmm... ¡derrota a 15 Volts y 15 Volts Capitanes! ¡BAM! Eso es. Una verdadera prueba de habilidad. ¡Entonces lo sabré con seguridad! Puedes encontrarlos al Este de aquí.
dialogsAccept.sw: How about you… mmm… Kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts! BAM! There we go. A true test of skill. Then I will know for sure! You can find them East of this location.
dialogsAccept.th: วิธีการเกี่ยวกับคุณ ... mmm ... ฆ่า 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts! เราจะไปที่นั่น. การทดสอบทักษะอย่างแท้จริง แล้วฉันจะเชื่อ! คุณสามารถหาที่ตั้งทางตะวันออกได้
dialogsAccept.tw: 你呢……嗯……殺死 15 機械戰車和 15 機械戰車頭目！砰！我們去吧。真正的技能考驗。那我就肯定知道了！你可以在此位置以東找到它們。
dialogsAccept.vi: Còn bạn thì sao… mmm… Giết 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts! RẦM! Chúng ta bắt đầu nào. Một bài kiểm tra kỹ năng thực sự. Sau đó, tôi sẽ biết chắc chắn! Bạn có thể tìm thấy chúng ở phía Đông từ vị trí này.

dialogsDecline.en: This is the only way to earn my trust.
dialogsDecline.ar: This is the only way to earn my trust.
dialogsDecline.br: Esta é a única maneira de ganhar minha confiança.
dialogsDecline.cns: 这是想要我信任你的唯一方法。
dialogsDecline.de: Nur so können Sie mein Vertrauen gewinnen.
dialogsDecline.fi: This is the only way to earn my trust.
dialogsDecline.fil: This is the only way to earn my trust.
dialogsDecline.fr: Je m'en doutais…
dialogsDecline.id: Ini adalah satu-satunya cara untuk mendapatkan kepercayaan saya.
dialogsDecline.it: This is the only way to earn my trust.
dialogsDecline.jp: ふん、この程度もできないようじゃたかが知れているぞ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 역시 보이는 데로 군.
dialogsDecline.nl: This is the only way to earn my trust.
dialogsDecline.pl: This is the only way to earn my trust.
dialogsDecline.ru: This is the only way to earn my trust.
dialogsDecline.sp: Ésta es la única forma de ganarte mi confianza.
dialogsDecline.sw: This is the only way to earn my trust.
dialogsDecline.th: นี่เป็นวิธีเดียวที่จะได้รับความไว้วางใจของฉัน
dialogsDecline.tw: 這是贏得我信任的唯一方法。
dialogsDecline.vi: Đây là cách duy nhất để có được lòng tin từ tôi.

dialogsComplete.en: Guess I will give credit where it's due. You aren't THAT much of a weakling! Alright, guess I will trust you!
dialogsComplete.ar: Guess I will give credit where it's due. You aren't THAT much of a weakling! Alright, guess I will trust you!
dialogsComplete.br: Acho que tenho que dar crédito onde é devido. Você não é tão fraco assim! Tudo bem, acho que posso confiar em você!
dialogsComplete.cns: 我想我会认为这是不错的。你并不是那么软弱的人! 好吧，我会相信你的!
dialogsComplete.de: Ich schätze, ich werde Anerkennung zollen, wo sie fällig ist. So ein Schwächling bist du nicht! Na gut, ich werde dir wohl vertrauen!
dialogsComplete.fi: Guess I will give credit where it's due. You aren't THAT much of a weakling! Alright, guess I will trust you!
dialogsComplete.fil: Guess I will give credit where it's due. You aren't THAT much of a weakling! Alright, guess I will trust you!
dialogsComplete.fr: Vous avez l'air d'une crevette mais vous avez réussi. Étonnant.
dialogsComplete.id: Kiranya saya akan menyebutkan namamu saat jatuh temponya. Anda tidak terlalu lemah! Baiklah, kurasa aku akan mempercayaimu!
dialogsComplete.it: Guess I will give credit where it's due. You aren't THAT much of a weakling! Alright, guess I will trust you!
dialogsComplete.jp: ふむ。思ったよりもやるようだな。よし、もう少し話を聞かせてやろう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 인정할 건 해야겠죠. 당신, 생각보다 그렇게 약하진 않네요. 좋아요, 믿어보죠!
dialogsComplete.nl: Guess I will give credit where it's due. You aren't THAT much of a weakling! Alright, guess I will trust you!
dialogsComplete.pl: Guess I will give credit where it's due. You aren't THAT much of a weakling! Alright, guess I will trust you!
dialogsComplete.ru: Guess I will give credit where it's due. You aren't THAT much of a weakling! Alright, guess I will trust you!
dialogsComplete.sp: Supongo que daré crédito donde sea debido. ¡No eres TAN debilucho! Muy bien, ¡supongo que confiaré en ti!
dialogsComplete.sw: Guess I will give credit where it's due. You aren't THAT much of a weakling! Alright, guess I will trust you!
dialogsComplete.th: ให้เดา ฉันจะให้เครดิตที่มันครบกำหนด คุณไม่ใช่คนที่อ่อนแอมาก! เอาล่ะเดาว่าฉันจะไว้ใจคุณ!
dialogsComplete.tw: 我想我會在應得的地方給予信任。你不是那麼弱小！好吧，我想我會相信你的！
dialogsComplete.vi: Đoán xem tôi sẽ cung cấp tín dụng khi nó đến hạn. Bạn không phải là một kẻ yếu đuối! Được rồi, tôi đoán là tôi sẽ tin bạn!

dialogsFail.en: Zoning out the entire time I was giving instructions? Head east of this location and kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts!
dialogsFail.ar: Zoning out the entire time I was giving instructions? Head east of this location and kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts!
dialogsFail.br: Estava viajando na maionese o tempo todo enquanto eu estava dando as instruções? Vá para o leste deste local e mate 15 Volts e 15 Volts Capitães!
dialogsFail.cns: Zoning out the entire time I was giving instructions? Head east of this location and kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts!
dialogsFail.de: Warst du die ganze Zeit weggetreten, als ich dir Anweisungen gegeben habe? Gehe östlich von diesem Ort und töte 15 Volts und 15 Captain Volts!
dialogsFail.fi: Zoning out the entire time I was giving instructions? Head east of this location and kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts!
dialogsFail.fil: Zoning out the entire time I was giving instructions? Head east of this location and kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts!
dialogsFail.fr: Déjà fatigué ? Vous n'en avez pas encore tué assez !
dialogsFail.id: Zonasi sepanjang waktu saya memberikan instruksi?? Pergilah ke timur lokasi ini dan bunuh 15 Volt & 15 Captain Volts!
dialogsFail.it: Zoning out the entire time I was giving instructions? Head east of this location and kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts!
dialogsFail.jp: まだ15匹ずつ倒していないようだな。この程度で音を上げるのか？
dialogsFail.kr: 제가 지시를 내리는 내내 넋 놓고 있었나요? 여기서 동쪽으로 가서, 볼트와 두목 볼트를 15마리씩 처치하세요!
dialogsFail.nl: Zoning out the entire time I was giving instructions? Head east of this location and kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts!
dialogsFail.pl: Zoning out the entire time I was giving instructions? Head east of this location and kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts!
dialogsFail.ru: Zoning out the entire time I was giving instructions? Head east of this location and kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts!
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Estabas distraído mientras estaba dando instrucciones? ¡Dirígete al Este de aquí y derrota a 15 Volts y a 15 Volts Capitanes!
dialogsFail.sw: Zoning out the entire time I was giving instructions? Head east of this location and kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts!
dialogsFail.th: แบ่งโซนตามที่ฉันให้คำแนะนำมั้ย? มุ่งหน้าไปทางทิศตะวันออกจากตรงนี้และฆ่า Volts 15 ตัว และ Captain Volts 15 ตัว!
dialogsFail.tw: 我剛剛講解的時候你整個都在發呆嗎？往這裡東邊走，去擊殺 15 隻伏特和 15 隻隊長伏特！
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn hoàn toàn không tập trung trong lúc tôi đang hướng dẫn à? Đi về phía đông của địa điểm này và giết 15 Volts và 15 Captain Volts!

description.en: Defeat 3 Worm Veduques and eliminate Serus Uriel. Use the Mars Dungeon key to enter her chamber.
description.ar: Defeat 3 Worm Veduques and eliminate Serus Uriel. Use the Mars Dungeon key to enter her chamber.
description.br: Derrote 3 Veduques Serpentinas e elimine Serus Uriel. Use a chave da Masmorra Mars para entrar em sua câmara.
description.cns: 打败3个妖女蛇，消灭赛罗斯蛇妖。使用魔域密殿的钥匙，进入她的密室。
description.de: Besiegen Sie 3 Wurm-Veduken und eliminieren Sie Serus Uriel. Benutze den Mars-Dungeon-Schlüssel, um ihre Kammer zu betreten.
description.fi: Defeat 3 Worm Veduques and eliminate Serus Uriel. Use the Mars Dungeon key to enter her chamber.
description.fil: Defeat 3 Worm Veduques and eliminate Serus Uriel. Use the Mars Dungeon key to enter her chamber.
description.fr: Tuez 3 Grand Veduque et battez Serus Uriel. Utilisez la Clé de la Mine de Mas pour entrer dans son repaire.
description.id: Kalahkan 3 Worm Veduques dan eliminasi Serus Uriel. Gunakan kunci Mars Dungeon untuk masuk ruangannya.
description.it: Defeat 3 Worm Veduques and eliminate Serus Uriel. Use the Mars Dungeon key to enter her chamber.
description.jp: ワームヴェデュークを3体倒し、セラス・ウリエルを退治せよ。古い鍵を使って、奴らの部屋に入れる。
description.kr: 웜 베듀크 3마리를 처치하고, 세루스 우리엘을 처단하세요. 마스 던전 열쇠를 사용해 은신처로 들어가세요.
description.nl: Defeat 3 Worm Veduques and eliminate Serus Uriel. Use the Mars Dungeon key to enter her chamber.
description.pl: Defeat 3 Worm Veduques and eliminate Serus Uriel. Use the Mars Dungeon key to enter her chamber.
description.ru: Defeat 3 Worm Veduques and eliminate Serus Uriel. Use the Mars Dungeon key to enter her chamber.
description.sp: Derrota a 3 Veduques Gusano y elimina a Serus Uriel. Usa la Llave de la Mazmorra Mars para entrar a su sala.
description.sw: Defeat 3 Worm Veduques and eliminate Serus Uriel. Use the Mars Dungeon key to enter her chamber.
description.th: กำจัด Worm Veduques 3 ตัวและกำจัด Serus Uriel ใช้กุญแจ Mars Dungeon เพื่อเข้าไปในรังของเธอ
description.tw: 擊敗 3 隻妖蛇妒婦並消滅賽羅斯。使用瑪斯密殿鑰匙進入她的密室。
description.vi: Đánh bại 3 Worm Veduques và loại bỏ Serus Uriel. Sử dụng phím Mars Dungeon để vào buồng của cô ấy.

dialogsBegin.en: The final task awaits. Please eliminate Serus Uriel. If we don't eliminate her now while she's weakened, Flaris will be in grave danger.
dialogsBegin.ar: The final task awaits. Please eliminate Serus Uriel. If we don't eliminate her now while she's weakened, Flaris will be in grave danger.
dialogsBegin.br: A tarefa final aguarda. Por favor, elimine Serus Uriel. Se não a eliminarmos agora, enquanto ela está enfraquecida, Flaris estará em grande perigo.
dialogsBegin.cns: 最后的任务在等待。请消灭赛罗斯蛇妖。如果我们现在不趁她虚弱的时候消灭她，帕里将面临严重的危险。
dialogsBegin.de: Die letzte Aufgabe steht an. Bitte eliminiert Serus Uriel. Wenn wir sie jetzt nicht beseitigen, während sie geschwächt ist, wird Flaris in großer Gefahr sein.
dialogsBegin.fi: The final task awaits. Please eliminate Serus Uriel. If we don't eliminate her now while she's weakened, Flaris will be in grave danger.
dialogsBegin.fil: The final task awaits. Please eliminate Serus Uriel. If we don't eliminate her now while she's weakened, Flaris will be in grave danger.
dialogsBegin.fr: Ta dernière tâche t'attend. Tu dois éliminer Serus Uriel, tant qu'elle est affaiblie. Si elle recouvre ses forces, Flaris sera en grand danger.
dialogsBegin.id: Tugas akhir sudah menunggu. Tolong lenyapkankan Serus Uriel. Jika kita tidak melenyapkannya sekarang saat dia sedang lemah, Flaris akan berada dalam bahaya besar
dialogsBegin.it: The final task awaits. Please eliminate Serus Uriel. If we don't eliminate her now while she's weakened, Flaris will be in grave danger.
dialogsBegin.jp: 最後の任務が待っています。＜セラス・ウリエル＞の抹殺をお願いします。弱っている今のうちに退治しないと、フラリスが危険な目に遭います。
dialogsBegin.kr: 마지막 임무가 기다리고 있어요. 세루스 우리엘을 처치해 주세요.지금처럼 약해졌을 때 없애지 않으면, 플라리스가 엄청난 위험에 빠질 겁니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: The final task awaits. Please eliminate Serus Uriel. If we don't eliminate her now while she's weakened, Flaris will be in grave danger.
dialogsBegin.pl: The final task awaits. Please eliminate Serus Uriel. If we don't eliminate her now while she's weakened, Flaris will be in grave danger.
dialogsBegin.ru: The final task awaits. Please eliminate Serus Uriel. If we don't eliminate her now while she's weakened, Flaris will be in grave danger.
dialogsBegin.sp: La tarea final espera. Elimina a Serus Uriel por favor. Si no la eliminamos ahora que está debilitada, Flaris correrá un grave peligro.
dialogsBegin.sw: The final task awaits. Please eliminate Serus Uriel. If we don't eliminate her now while she's weakened, Flaris will be in grave danger.
dialogsBegin.th: งานสุดท้ายรออยู่ โปรดกำจัด Serus Uriel ถ้าเราไม่กำจัดเธอตอนนี้ในขณะที่เธออ่อนแอ Flaris จะตกอยู่ในอันตรายร้ายแรง
dialogsBegin.tw: 最後的任務在等著你。請消滅賽羅斯。如果不趁她虛弱時將她消滅，布拉里斯就會陷入極大的危險。
dialogsBegin.vi: Nhiệm vụ cuối cùng đang chờ đợi. Hãy loại bỏ Serus Uriel. Nếu chúng ta không loại bỏ cô ấy ngay bây giờ trong khi cô ấy yếu đi, Flaris sẽ gặp nguy hiểm nghiêm trọng.

dialogsAccept.en: Use the key I gave you to enter her lair. Please be careful, the monsters inside are on whole other level compared to the Guardians. It would be wise to form a party before entering her chamber.
dialogsAccept.ar: Use the key I gave you to enter her lair. Please be careful, the monsters inside are on whole other level compared to the Guardians. It would be wise to form a party before entering her chamber.
dialogsAccept.br: Use a chave que lhe dei para entrar no covil dela. Por favor, tenha cuidado, os monstros lá dentro estão em um nível totalmente diferente em comparação com os Guardiões. Seria sensato formar um grupo antes de adentrar em sua câmara.
dialogsAccept.cns: 使用我给你的钥匙，进入她的巢穴。请小心，里面的怪物与守护者相比，完全是另一个层次。在进入之前，最好先组一个团队。
dialogsAccept.de: Benutze den Schlüssel, den ich dir gegeben habe, um ihr Versteck zu betreten. Seid bitte vorsichtig, die Monster darin sind auf einem ganz anderen Niveau als die Wächter. Es wäre ratsam, eine Gruppe zu bilden, bevor du ihre Kammer betrittst.
dialogsAccept.fi: Use the key I gave you to enter her lair. Please be careful, the monsters inside are on whole other level compared to the Guardians. It would be wise to form a party before entering her chamber.
dialogsAccept.fil: Use the key I gave you to enter her lair. Please be careful, the monsters inside are on whole other level compared to the Guardians. It would be wise to form a party before entering her chamber.
dialogsAccept.fr: Utilise la clé que je t'ai donnée pour entrer dans son repaire. Fais attention, les montres qui l'accompagnent sont beaucoup plus forts que les Gardiens. Il serait sage de créer un groupe pour les affronter.
dialogsAccept.id: Gunakan kunci yang kuberikan untuk masuk ke sarangnya. Berhati-hatilah, monster yang ada di dalam berada pada level yang sama sekali berbeda dengan Guardian. Sangatlah disarankan untuk membentuk Party sebelum memasuki sarangnya.
dialogsAccept.it: Use the key I gave you to enter her lair. Please be careful, the monsters inside are on whole other level compared to the Guardians. It would be wise to form a party before entering her chamber.
dialogsAccept.jp: この鍵を渡しておきますので、最奥の部屋へ入るために使ってください。そのへんのモンスターとは比べ物にならないぐらい強いので、本当に、本当に気を付けてくださいよ。最奥の部屋に入る前に、パーティを組んだ方がいいと思いますよ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 제가 드린 열쇠로 우리엘의 은신처에 잠입하세요. 그 안의 몬스터들은 가디언들과는 비교가 안 될 만큼 강하니 조심하세요. 극단을 꾸려 들어가는 게 좋을 거예요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Use the key I gave you to enter her lair. Please be careful, the monsters inside are on whole other level compared to the Guardians. It would be wise to form a party before entering her chamber.
dialogsAccept.pl: Use the key I gave you to enter her lair. Please be careful, the monsters inside are on whole other level compared to the Guardians. It would be wise to form a party before entering her chamber.
dialogsAccept.ru: Use the key I gave you to enter her lair. Please be careful, the monsters inside are on whole other level compared to the Guardians. It would be wise to form a party before entering her chamber.
dialogsAccept.sp: Usa la llave que te di para entrar a su guarida. Ten cuidado, los monstruos que hay dentro están a otro nivel en comparación con los guardianes. Sería prudente formar una party antes de entrar a su cámara.
dialogsAccept.sw: Use the key I gave you to enter her lair. Please be careful, the monsters inside are on whole other level compared to the Guardians. It would be wise to form a party before entering her chamber.
dialogsAccept.th: ใช้กุญแจที่ฉันให้ไว้เพื่อเข้าไปในรังของเธอ โปรดระวัง มอนสเตอร์ภายในนั้นอยู่อีกระดับเมื่อเทียบกับผู้พิทักษ์ ควรสร้างปาร์ตี้ก่อนเข้ารังของเธอ
dialogsAccept.tw: 用我給你的鑰匙進入她的巢穴。請小心，裡面的怪物和那些守護者完全不是同一個等級。進入她的密室前，最好先組好隊伍。
dialogsAccept.vi: Sử dụng chìa khóa tôi đã đưa cho bạn để vào hang ổ của cô ấy. Xin hãy cẩn thận, những con quái vật bên trong ở một cấp độ khác so với Guardians. Sẽ khôn ngoan nếu bạn tổ chức một bữa tiệc trước khi vào phòng của cô ấy.

dialogsDecline.en: There is no time. Please rethink this through...
dialogsDecline.ar: There is no time. Please rethink this through...
dialogsDecline.br: Não há tempo a perder. Por favor, repense...
dialogsDecline.cns: 没有时间了，请重新考虑...
dialogsDecline.de: Wir haben keine Zeit. Bitte überdenken Sie das noch einmal...
dialogsDecline.fi: There is no time. Please rethink this through...
dialogsDecline.fil: There is no time. Please rethink this through...
dialogsDecline.fr: Il n'y a pas le temps ! S'il te plaît, aide-moi...
dialogsDecline.id: Tidak ada waktu. Tolong pikirkan ini kembali...
dialogsDecline.it: There is no time. Please rethink this through...
dialogsDecline.jp: じ、時間がないんです...！今すぐ仲間を見つけて向かってください..！
dialogsDecline.kr: 망설일 시간이 없어요. 다시 잘 생각해 보세요…
dialogsDecline.nl: There is no time. Please rethink this through...
dialogsDecline.pl: There is no time. Please rethink this through...
dialogsDecline.ru: There is no time. Please rethink this through...
dialogsDecline.sp: No nos queda tiempo. Por favor, reconsidéralo...
dialogsDecline.sw: There is no time. Please rethink this through...
dialogsDecline.th: ไม่มีเวลาแล้ว โปรดคิดให้ดี…
dialogsDecline.tw: 沒有時間了。請重新考慮這個…
dialogsDecline.vi: Không có thời gian. Hãy suy nghĩ lại điều này thông qua ...

dialogsComplete.en: You've returned! Flaris can be at peace once again. Thank you, adventurer. Please take this as a reward. You have my gratitude.
dialogsComplete.ar: You've returned! Flaris can be at peace once again. Thank you, adventurer. Please take this as a reward. You have my gratitude.
dialogsComplete.br: Você retornou! Flaris pode ficar em paz mais uma vez. Obrigado, aventureiro. Por favor, tome isso como uma recompensa. Você tem minha gratidão.
dialogsComplete.cns: 你已经回来了! 帕里可以再次得到安宁了，谢谢你，冒险家。请把这个作为奖励，向你表示感谢。
dialogsComplete.de: Ihr seid zurückgekehrt! Flaris kann nun wieder in Frieden leben. Ich danke dir, Abenteurer. Bitte nehmt dies als Belohnung. Ihr habt meine Dankbarkeit.
dialogsComplete.fi: You've returned! Flaris can be at peace once again. Thank you, adventurer. Please take this as a reward. You have my gratitude.
dialogsComplete.fil: You've returned! Flaris can be at peace once again. Thank you, adventurer. Please take this as a reward. You have my gratitude.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tu es revenu ! Flaris est désormais à nouveau en sécurité. Merci, aventurier. Prends ceci en récompense. Tu as ma gratitude éternelle.
dialogsComplete.id: Kamu telah kembali! Flaris bisa damai sekali lagi. Terima kasih, petualang. Tolong ambil ini sebagai hadiah. Aku sangat berterima kasih padamu.
dialogsComplete.it: You've returned! Flaris can be at peace once again. Thank you, adventurer. Please take this as a reward. You have my gratitude.
dialogsComplete.jp: 無事に帰ってこられたんですね！フラリスに再び平穏が訪れることでしょう。本当にありがとうございました。ぜひこれを受け取ってください。
dialogsComplete.kr: 살아 돌아오셨군요! 플라리스도 다시 평화를 되찾을 수 있겠어요. 정말 감사합니다, 모험가님.
dialogsComplete.nl: You've returned! Flaris can be at peace once again. Thank you, adventurer. Please take this as a reward. You have my gratitude.
dialogsComplete.pl: You've returned! Flaris can be at peace once again. Thank you, adventurer. Please take this as a reward. You have my gratitude.
dialogsComplete.ru: You've returned! Flaris can be at peace once again. Thank you, adventurer. Please take this as a reward. You have my gratitude.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Has vuelto! Flaris puede estar en paz una vez más. Gracias, aventurero. Por favor, acepta esto como una recompensa. Tienes mi gratitud.
dialogsComplete.sw: You've returned! Flaris can be at peace once again. Thank you, adventurer. Please take this as a reward. You have my gratitude.
dialogsComplete.th: คุณกลับมาแล้ว! Flaris สามารถสงบสุขได้อีกครั้ง ขอบคุณมาก นักผจญภัย โปรดใช้สิ่งนี้เป็นรางวัล คุณได้รับการนับถือจากฉัน
dialogsComplete.tw: 你回來了！布拉里斯可以再次平靜下來。謝謝你，冒險者。請將此作為獎勵。對你我非常感激。
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn đã trở lại! Flaris có thể bình yên một lần nữa. Cảm ơn bạn, nhà thám hiểm. Hãy coi đây như một phần thưởng. Đó là lòng biết ơn của tôi dành cho bạn.

dialogsFail.en: The main thing is you are still alive. Take time to recover, and try again! You can do this!
dialogsFail.ar: The main thing is you are still alive. Take time to recover, and try again! You can do this!
dialogsFail.br: O importante é que você ainda está vivo(a). Tire um tempo para se recuperar e tente novamente! Você consegue fazer isso!
dialogsFail.cns: 最主要的是你还活着。花点时间恢复，再试一次! 你可以做到这一点!
dialogsFail.de: Das Wichtigste ist, dass Sie noch am Leben sind. Nehmen Sie sich Zeit, um sich zu erholen, und versuchen Sie es erneut! Du kannst es schaffen!
dialogsFail.fi: The main thing is you are still alive. Take time to recover, and try again! You can do this!
dialogsFail.fil: The main thing is you are still alive. Take time to recover, and try again! You can do this!
dialogsFail.fr: L'essentiel est que tu sois toujours envie. Remets-toi de tes émotions, et essaye à nouveau ! Tu peux le faire !
dialogsFail.id: Yang terpenting adalah kamu masih hidup. Istirahatlah sampai pulih dan coba lagi! Kamu pasti bisa!
dialogsFail.it: The main thing is you are still alive. Take time to recover, and try again! You can do this!
dialogsFail.jp: 生きているだけでよかったです。体力を回復させて、ぜひまた挑戦してください！あなたならきっとできるはずです。
dialogsFail.kr: 어쨌든 중요한 건, 아직 살아 있다는 거예요. 잠시 회복하시고, 다시 도전해 보세요. 분명 해내실 수 있을 거예요!
dialogsFail.nl: The main thing is you are still alive. Take time to recover, and try again! You can do this!
dialogsFail.pl: The main thing is you are still alive. Take time to recover, and try again! You can do this!
dialogsFail.ru: The main thing is you are still alive. Take time to recover, and try again! You can do this!
dialogsFail.sp: Lo importante es que todavía estás con vida. ¡Tómate un tiempo para recuperarte y vuelve a intentarlo! ¡Puedes hacerlo!
dialogsFail.sw: The main thing is you are still alive. Take time to recover, and try again! You can do this!
dialogsFail.th: สิ่งสำคัญคือคุณยังมีชีวิตอยู่ ใช้เวลาในการฟื้นตัวและกลับไปลองอีกครั้ง! คุณทำได้!
dialogsFail.tw: 關鍵是你還活著。花點時間恢復，然後再試一次！你可以這樣做！
dialogsFail.vi: Điều quan trọng là bạn vẫn còn sống. Hãy dành thời gian để phục hồi và thử lại! Bạn có thể làm được việc này!

description.en: Kill 20 Small Elderguards & 15 Elderguards located in the Northwestern region of Darkon 1.
description.ar: Kill 20 Small Elderguards & 15 Elderguards located in the Northwestern region of Darkon 1.
description.br: Mate 20 Guardiões Anciões Pequenos e 15 Guardiões Anciões, eles podem ser localizados na região Noroeste de Darkon 1.
description.cns: 杀死20个试用型电铲卫兵和15个量产型电铲卫兵，位于达肯1的西北部地区。
description.de: Töte 20 Small Elderguards und 15 Elderguards in der nordwestlichen Region von Darkon 1.
description.fi: Kill 20 Small Elderguards & 15 Elderguards located in the Northwestern region of Darkon 1.
description.fil: Kill 20 Small Elderguards & 15 Elderguards located in the Northwestern region of Darkon 1.
description.fr: Tuer 20 Jeunes Eldergard et 15 Eldergard.
description.id: Bunuh 20 Small Elderguards &15 Elderguards yang terletak di wilayah Northwestern Darkon 1.
description.it: Kill 20 Small Elderguards & 15 Elderguards located in the Northwestern region of Darkon 1.
description.jp: スモール・エルダーガードを20体、エルダーガードを15体倒した後、ダーコン1北西にいるエルラインに報告せよ。
description.kr: 북쪽 지역의 다콘 제 1지구에서 부하 엘더가드 20마리, 엘더가드 15마리를 처치하라.
description.nl: Kill 20 Small Elderguards & 15 Elderguards located in the Northwestern region of Darkon 1.
description.pl: Zabij 20 Małych Prastrażników i 15 Prastrażników znajdujących się w północno-zachodnim regionie Darkon 1.
description.ru: Kill 20 Small Elderguards & 15 Elderguards located in the Northwestern region of Darkon 1.
description.sp: Derrota a 20 Elderguards Pequeños y a 15 Elderguards, están en la parte Noroeste de Darkon 1.

description.th: ฆ่า 20 Small Elderguards & 15 Elderguards ที่อยู่ในภาคตะวันตกเฉียงเหนือของ Darkon 1
description.tw: 去殺死位於得肯第一區西北方的 20 隻戰士機械嘍囉和 15 隻戰士機械！
description.vi: Giết 20 Small Elderguards & 15 Elderguards nằm ở vùng Tây Bắc của Darkon 1.

dialogsBegin.en: Ahh, Reonan is looking to reunite the original 8 heroes you say? He was a dear friend, but I don't think I will be able to fulfill his request. You see… things have changed since that time…
dialogsBegin.ar: Ahh, Reonan is looking to reunite the original 8 heroes you say? He was a dear friend, but I don't think I will be able to fulfill his request. You see… things have changed since that time…
dialogsBegin.br: Ahh, Reonan está procurando reunir Os 8 Heróis Originais, você diz? Ele era um amigo querido, mas acho que não serei capaz de atender ao seu pedido. Você vê... as coisas mudaram desde aquela época...
dialogsBegin.cns: 啊，你说瑞尔南正在寻找原来的8位英雄？他是一位好伙计，但我不认为我能够满足他的要求。你看......自从那时以来，所有的事情就不一样了......
dialogsBegin.de: Ahh, Reonan möchte die ursprünglichen 8 Helden wieder vereinen, sagst du? Er war ein guter Freund, aber ich glaube nicht, dass ich in der Lage sein werde, seine Bitte zu erfüllen. Ihr seht, die Dinge haben sich seitdem geändert...
dialogsBegin.fi: Ahh, Reonan is looking to reunite the original 8 heroes you say? He was a dear friend, but I don't think I will be able to fulfill his request. You see… things have changed since that time…
dialogsBegin.fil: Ahh, Reonan is looking to reunite the original 8 heroes you say? He was a dear friend, but I don't think I will be able to fulfill his request. You see… things have changed since that time…
dialogsBegin.fr: Reonan vous envoie ? Ce nom me semble venu d'un autre âge. Il apporte des souvenirs de guerre… mais je ne souhaite plus me battre.
dialogsBegin.id: Ahh, Reonan ingin menyatukan kembali 8 pahlawan asli kamu bilang? Dia adalah teman baik, tetapi saya tidak yakin saya akan dapat memenuhi permintaannya. Kau tahu... banyak hal yang telah berubah sejak saat itu...
dialogsBegin.it: Ahh, Reonan is looking to reunite the original 8 heroes you say? He was a dear friend, but I don't think I will be able to fulfill his request. You see… things have changed since that time…
dialogsBegin.jp: レオナンのことですか……もちろん覚えていますよ。彼は常にナイトとして私達の盾となり闘ってくれました。再結成か...。その願いを叶えることはできそうにない。ほら...あの時とは状況が変わってしまったから...。
dialogsBegin.kr: 레오난이 보냈다고요? 네, 물론 알고 있습니다. 용기 있고 멋진 친구였죠. 하지만 그와 다시 함께하고 싶은 생각은 없습니다. 상황이 변했어요...
dialogsBegin.nl: Ahh, Reonan is looking to reunite the original 8 heroes you say? He was a dear friend, but I don't think I will be able to fulfill his request. You see… things have changed since that time…
dialogsBegin.pl: Ahh, Reonan is looking to reunite the original 8 heroes you say? He was a dear friend, but I don't think I will be able to fulfill his request. You see… things have changed since that time…
dialogsBegin.ru: Ahh, Reonan is looking to reunite the original 8 heroes you say? He was a dear friend, but I don't think I will be able to fulfill his request. You see… things have changed since that time…
dialogsBegin.sp: Ah, ¿Reonan quiere reunir a los 8 héroes originales dices? Era un querido amigo, pero no creo que pueda cumplir con lo que pide. Verás... las cosas han cambiado desde entonces...
dialogsBegin.sw: Ahh, Reonan is looking to reunite the original 8 heroes you say? He was a dear friend, but I don't think I will be able to fulfill his request. You see… things have changed since that time…
dialogsBegin.th: อ๊ะ Reonan กำลังมองหาการรวมตัวของวีรบุรุษเดิม 8 ตัวที่คุณพูด? เขาเป็นเพื่อนที่รัก แต่ฉันไม่คิดว่าฉันจะสามารถตอบสนองคำขอของเขาได้ คุณเห็นไหม ... สิ่งที่เปลี่ยนแปลงไปตั้งแต่นั้นเป็นต้นมา ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 啊，你說雷奧南想重新集結最初的 8 位英雄？他曾是我親愛的朋友，但我不認為自己能完成他的請求。你知道…從那時起，一切都變了…
dialogsBegin.vi: Ahh Reonan đang tìm cách tái hợp 8 anh hùng ban đầu mà bạn nói? Anh ấy là một người bạn thân thiết, nhưng tôi không nghĩ rằng tôi sẽ có thể đáp ứng yêu cầu của anh ấy. Bạn thấy đấy… mọi thứ đã thay đổi kể từ thời điểm đó…

dialogsBegin.en: I know it is for the sake of Madrigal! But, I've resigned from a life of heroics. All I desire now is to live in peace…
dialogsBegin.ar: I know it is for the sake of Madrigal! But, I've resigned from a life of heroics. All I desire now is to live in peace…
dialogsBegin.br: Eu sei que é pelo bem de Madrigal! Mas, eu me demiti de uma vida de heroísmo. Tudo o que desejo agora é viver em paz...
dialogsBegin.cns: 我知道这是为一切为了瑞加大陆! 但是，我已经辞去了英雄的生活。我现在所渴望的是和平的生活......
dialogsBegin.de: Ich weiß, es ist zum Wohle von Madrigal! Aber ich habe mich von meinem heldenhaften Leben zurückgezogen. Alles, was ich jetzt will, ist, in Frieden zu leben.
dialogsBegin.fi: I know it is for the sake of Madrigal! But, I've resigned from a life of heroics. All I desire now is to live in peace…
dialogsBegin.fil: I know it is for the sake of Madrigal! But, I've resigned from a life of heroics. All I desire now is to live in peace…
dialogsBegin.fr: Je mène d'autres combats plus importants à mes yeux.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya tahu itu demi Madrigal! Tapi, saya telah mengundurkan diri dari kehidupan heroik. Yang saya inginkan sekarang adalah hidup dalam damai ...
dialogsBegin.it: I know it is for the sake of Madrigal! But, I've resigned from a life of heroics. All I desire now is to live in peace…
dialogsBegin.jp: でも、私はもう闘いに参加する気はありません。私はここで農夫として森と共に過ごすことを選んだのです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 마드리갈을 위한 일인 건 압니다! 하지만 전 이제 영웅의 삶에서 물러났어요. 지금은 그저 평화롭게 살고 싶을 뿐...
dialogsBegin.nl: I know it is for the sake of Madrigal! But, I've resigned from a life of heroics. All I desire now is to live in peace…
dialogsBegin.pl: I know it is for the sake of Madrigal! But, I've resigned from a life of heroics. All I desire now is to live in peace…
dialogsBegin.ru: I know it is for the sake of Madrigal! But, I've resigned from a life of heroics. All I desire now is to live in peace…
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Sé que es por el bien de Madrigal! Pero, he renunciado a una vida heroica. Todo lo que deseo ahora es vivir en paz...
dialogsBegin.sw: I know it is for the sake of Madrigal! But, I've resigned from a life of heroics. All I desire now is to live in peace…
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันรู้ว่ามันเป็นเพื่อประโยชน์ของ Madrigal! แต่ฉันลาออกจากชีวิตที่กล้าหาญ ทั้งหมดที่ฉันต้องการคือการอยู่อย่างสงบ ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 就算是為了瑪德利賈的事情，我也不想參與戰鬥。在這不怎麼樣的地方耕田，安靜的生活是我的夢想。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi biết nó là vì lợi ích của Madrigal! Nhưng, tôi đã từ bỏ cuộc sống anh hùng. Tất cả những gì tôi mong muốn bây giờ là được sống trong hòa bình…

dialogsBegin.en: You sure are persistent eh? I'll hear you out if you do something for me. Recently, the ecosystem has been suffering due to deforestation caused by the Elderguards. Defeat them, and I will listen.
dialogsBegin.ar: You sure are persistent eh? I'll hear you out if you do something for me. Recently, the ecosystem has been suffering due to deforestation caused by the Elderguards. Defeat them, and I will listen.
dialogsBegin.br: Você é bem persistente hein? Posso escutar o que tem a dizer se fizer algo por mim. Recentemente, o ecossistema vem sofrendo devido ao desmatamento causado pelos Guardiões Anciões. Elimine eles e eu o ouvirei.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你真的很执着啊？如果你为我做点什么，我就听你的。最近，由于电铲卫兵的森林砍伐，生态系统一直在遭受破坏。打败他们，我就会听你的。
dialogsBegin.de: Du bist wirklich hartnäckig, was? Ich werde dich anhören, wenn du etwas für mich tust. In letzter Zeit hat das Ökosystem unter der Abholzung gelitten, die von den Elderguards verursacht wurde. Besiegt sie, und ich werde Euch zuhören.
dialogsBegin.fi: You sure are persistent eh? I'll hear you out if you do something for me. Recently, the ecosystem has been suffering due to deforestation caused by the Elderguards. Defeat them, and I will listen.
dialogsBegin.fil: You sure are persistent eh? I'll hear you out if you do something for me. Recently, the ecosystem has been suffering due to deforestation caused by the Elderguards. Defeat them, and I will listen.
dialogsBegin.fr: Regardez autour de vous. La forêt meurt à cause des Eldergard. Eliminez ces monstres et je me joindrai peut-être à vous.
dialogsBegin.id: Anda sangat gigih ya? Aku akan mendengarmu jika kamu melakukan sesuatu untukku. Baru-baru ini, ekosistem telah menderita karena deforestasi yang disebabkan oleh Elderguards. Kalahkan mereka, dan aku akan mendengarkan.
dialogsBegin.it: You sure are persistent eh? I'll hear you out if you do something for me. Recently, the ecosystem has been suffering due to deforestation caused by the Elderguards. Defeat them, and I will listen.
dialogsBegin.jp: どうしても……と申しますか。ふむ……そうですね。では、一つお願いがあります。最近この森を破壊するモンスターがいるのです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 정말 집요하시군요? 제 이야기를 듣고 싶다면, 부탁 하나 들어주세요. 요즘 엘더가드가 나무를 마구 베는 바람에 숲이 황폐해지고 있습니다. 그들을 처치해 준다면, 당신의 이야기를 더 들어보도록 하죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: You sure are persistent eh? I'll hear you out if you do something for me. Recently, the ecosystem has been suffering due to deforestation caused by the Elderguards. Defeat them, and I will listen.
dialogsBegin.pl: Jesteś pewien, że jesteś wytrwały? Wysłucham cię, jeśli coś dla mnie zrobisz. Ostatnio ekosystem cierpi z powodu wylesiania spowodowanego przez Prastrażników. Pokonaj ich, a Cię wysłucham.
dialogsBegin.ru: You sure are persistent eh? I'll hear you out if you do something for me. Recently, the ecosystem has been suffering due to deforestation caused by the Elderguards. Defeat them, and I will listen.
dialogsBegin.sp: Eres muy persistente ¿eh? Te escucharé si haces algo por mí. Recientemente, el ecosistema ha estado sufriendo debido a la deforestación causada por los Elderguards. Derrótalos y te escucharé.
dialogsBegin.sw: You sure are persistent eh? I'll hear you out if you do something for me. Recently, the ecosystem has been suffering due to deforestation caused by the Elderguards. Defeat them, and I will listen.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณแน่ใจหรือยัง? ฉันจะได้ยินคุณถ้าคุณทำอะไรให้ฉัน เมื่อเร็ว ๆ นี้ระบบนิเวศได้รับความทุกข์ทรมานจากการตัดไม้ทำลายป่าที่เกิดจากกองกำลังของ Elder Guards เอาชนะพวกเขาและฉันจะฟัง
dialogsBegin.tw: 真的是非常頑固呀。很好。最近戰士機械 在樹林裡濫伐，樹林逐漸變得荒廢。如果你能夠打倒他們，我就再聽你的事情吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn chắc là kiên trì hả? Tôi sẽ nghe bạn nếu bạn làm điều gì đó cho tôi. Gần đây, hệ sinh thái đang bị ảnh hưởng bởi nạn phá rừng do Elderguards gây ra. Đánh bại chúng, và tôi sẽ lắng nghe.

dialogsAccept.en: Kill 20 Small Elderguards & 15 Elderguards, responsible for the devastation to this environment, and you have my undivided attention!
dialogsAccept.ar: Kill 20 Small Elderguards & 15 Elderguards, responsible for the devastation to this environment, and you have my undivided attention!
dialogsAccept.br: Mate 20 Guardiões Anciões Pequenos e 15 Guardiões Anciões, os responsáveis pela devastação deste ambiente, e você terá toda a minha atenção!
dialogsAccept.cns: 杀死20个试用型电铲卫兵和15个量产型电铲卫兵，对这个被破坏的环境负责，你就能得到我十足的关注!
dialogsAccept.de: Töte 20 Small Elderguards und 15 Elderguards, die für die Verwüstung dieser Umgebung verantwortlich sind, und du hast meine ungeteilte Aufmerksamkeit!
dialogsAccept.fi: Kill 20 Small Elderguards & 15 Elderguards, responsible for the devastation to this environment, and you have my undivided attention!
dialogsAccept.fil: Kill 20 Small Elderguards & 15 Elderguards, responsible for the devastation to this environment, and you have my undivided attention!
dialogsAccept.fr: Tuez 20 Jeunes Eldergard et 15 Eldergard et revenez me voir.
dialogsAccept.id: Bunuh 20 Small Elderguards &15 Elderguards, yang bertanggung jawab atas kehancuran lingkungan ini, dan kamu akan memiliki semua perhatian saya!
dialogsAccept.it: Kill 20 Small Elderguards & 15 Elderguards, responsible for the devastation to this environment, and you have my undivided attention!
dialogsAccept.jp: スモール・エルダーガードを20体、エルダーガードを15体倒してきて下さい。そうすれば少しは何か御礼をしましょう。
dialogsAccept.kr: 당장 나무를 파헤치고 다니는 부하 엘더가드 20마리, 엘더가드를 15마리만 처치해 주시면 당신의 이야기를 좀 더 들어보도록 하죠.
dialogsAccept.nl: Kill 20 Small Elderguards & 15 Elderguards, responsible for the devastation to this environment, and you have my undivided attention!
dialogsAccept.pl: Zabij 20 Małych Prastrażników i 15 Prastrażników, odpowiedzialnych za dewastację tego środowiska, a otrzymasz moją niepodzielną uwagę!
dialogsAccept.ru: Kill 20 Small Elderguards & 15 Elderguards, responsible for the devastation to this environment, and you have my undivided attention!
dialogsAccept.sp: Derrota a 20 Elderguards Pequeños y a 15 Elderguards, responsables de la devastación de este entorno, y ¡tendrás toda mi atención!
dialogsAccept.sw: Kill 20 Small Elderguards & 15 Elderguards, responsible for the devastation to this environment, and you have my undivided attention!
dialogsAccept.th: ฆ่า 20 Small Elderguards & 15 Elderguards ซึ่งเป็นผู้รับผิดชอบต่อความหายนะในสภาพแวดล้อมนี้ และคุณมีความสนใจอย่างไม่มีที่สิ้นสุด!
dialogsAccept.tw: 如果你可以立刻消滅挖掘樹木的 20 隻戰士機械嘍囉和 15 隻戰士機械，我就會聽聽看你的事情。
dialogsAccept.vi: Giết 20 Elderguards nhỏ & 15 Elderguards, chịu trách nhiệm về sự tàn phá môi trường này, và bạn có sự chú ý không thể phân chia của tôi!

dialogsComplete.en: Wow, you really accomplished the task! Because of you, I no longer need to concern myself over further deforestation!
dialogsComplete.ar: Wow, you really accomplished the task! Because of you, I no longer need to concern myself over further deforestation!
dialogsComplete.br: Uau, você realmente cumpriu a tarefa! Por sua causa, não preciso mais me preocupar com mais devastação!
dialogsComplete.cns: 哇，你真的完成了任务! 因为你，我不需要再为进一步的森林砍伐而担忧了!
dialogsComplete.de: Wow, Sie haben die Aufgabe wirklich gemeistert! Dank Ihnen muss ich mir keine Sorgen mehr über die weitere Abholzung machen!
dialogsComplete.fi: Wow, you really accomplished the task! Because of you, I no longer need to concern myself over further deforestation!
dialogsComplete.fil: Wow, you really accomplished the task! Because of you, I no longer need to concern myself over further deforestation!
dialogsComplete.fr: Bien, les Eldergard ont appris leur leçon.
dialogsComplete.id: Wow, kau benar-benar menyelesaikan tugas! Karenmu, saya tidak perlu lagi mengkhawatirkan diri saya sendiri atas deforestasi lebih lanjut!
dialogsComplete.it: Wow, you really accomplished the task! Because of you, I no longer need to concern myself over further deforestation!
dialogsComplete.jp: 本当に倒してきて下さったのですね。ありがとうございます。
dialogsComplete.kr: 와, 정말 임무를 완수하셨군요! 덕분에 더는 삼림이 훼손될 걱정은 안 해도 되겠어요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Wow, you really accomplished the task! Because of you, I no longer need to concern myself over further deforestation!
dialogsComplete.pl: Wow, you really accomplished the task! Because of you, I no longer need to concern myself over further deforestation!
dialogsComplete.ru: Wow, you really accomplished the task! Because of you, I no longer need to concern myself over further deforestation!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Wow, lo has conseguido! ¡Gracias a ti, ya no me tengo que preocupar por una deforestación masiva!
dialogsComplete.sw: Wow, you really accomplished the task! Because of you, I no longer need to concern myself over further deforestation!
dialogsComplete.th: ว้าว คุณทำได้ดีจริงๆ! เพราะคุณเลย ฉันจึงไม่จำเป็นต้องกังวลเรื่องการตัดไม้ทำลายป่าอีกต่อไป!
dialogsComplete.tw: 哇，你真的完成了任務！因為你，我不再需要擔心進一步的森林砍伐！
dialogsComplete.vi: Wow, bạn thực sự đã hoàn thành nhiệm vụ! Vì các bạn, tôi không còn phải bận tâm về việc phá rừng nữa!

description.en: I see. The Garden of Rhisis is dying... Could you inform my sister Kimberley?
description.ar: I see. The Garden of Rhisis is dying... Could you inform my sister Kimberley?
description.br: Eu vejo. O Jardim de Rhisis está morrendo... Você poderia informar minha irmã Kimberley?
description.cns: 我知道了。瑞希思的花园快要枯萎了，能请你去告诉我的姐姐金伯利吗
description.de: Ich verstehe. Der Garten von Rhisis stirbt... Könntest du bitte meine Schwester Kimberley informieren?
description.fi: I see. The Garden of Rhisis is dying... Could you inform my sister Kimberley?
description.fil: I see. The Garden of Rhisis is dying... Could you inform my sister Kimberley?
description.fr: Je vois. Le Jardin de Rhisis est en train de mourir... Peux-tu en informer ma sœur Kimberley ?
description.id: Aku mengerti. Garden of Rhisis sedang sekarat... Bisakah kamu memberi tahu adikku Kimberley?
description.it: I see. The Garden of Rhisis is dying... Could you inform my sister Kimberley?
description.jp: そうだなぁ..。リシスの庭の環境が最悪な状態なんだ。妹の＜キンバリー＞に伝えてくれないだろうか？
description.kr: 세상에, 리시스의 정원이 죽어가고 있다니...저희 동생 킴벌리에게 이 사실을 전해 주시겠어요?
description.nl: I see. The Garden of Rhisis is dying... Could you inform my sister Kimberley?
description.pl: Rozumiem. Ogród Rhisis umiera... Czy możesz poinformować moją siostrę Kimberley?
description.ru: Всё ясно, Райсский сад умирает... Ты можешь сообщить эту весть моей сестре Кимберли?
description.sp: Ya veo. El Jardín de Rhisis se está muriendo... ¿Podrías informar a mi hermana Kimberley?
description.sw: I see. The Garden of Rhisis is dying... Could you inform my sister Kimberley?
description.th: เข้าใจแล้ว สวน Rhisis กำลังจะตาย... คุณช่วยแจ้ง Kimberley น้องสาวฉันหน่อยได้ไหม
description.tw: 我知道了，黎席斯庭院快要死了……你能告訴我姐姐金貝勒嗎？
description.vi: Tôi thấy rồi. Khu Vườn của Rhisis đang chết dần ... Bạn có thể thông báo cho em gái Kimberley của tôi được không?

descriptionComplete.en: Thank you from bringing me this message. I think you should talk to Marche in Eastern Flarine.
descriptionComplete.ar: Thank you from bringing me this message. I think you should talk to Marche in Eastern Flarine.
descriptionComplete.br: Obrigado por me trazer esta mensagem. Acho que você deveria falar com Marche ao Leste de Flarine.
descriptionComplete.cns: 谢谢你告诉了我这个消息。我认为你应该去帕里镇东边的玛尔琪聊聊。
descriptionComplete.de: Ich danke dir für die Überbringung dieser Nachricht. Ich denke du solltest mit Marche in Ost-Flaris sprechen.
descriptionComplete.fi: Thank you from bringing me this message. I think you should talk to Marche in Eastern Flarine.

descriptionComplete.id: Terima kasih telah membawakanku pesan ini. Aku pikir kamu harus berbicara dengan Marche di Eastern Flarine.
descriptionComplete.it: Thank you from bringing me this message. I think you should talk to Marche in Eastern Flarine.
descriptionComplete.jp: わざわざ伝言をありがとう。助かったわ。フラリス東広場にいる＜マルシェ＞に相談してみましょ。
descriptionComplete.kr: 메시지를 전해 주셔서 감사합니다. 플라리네 동부에 있는 마르셰에게 가서 말을 걸어보세요.
descriptionComplete.nl: Thank you from bringing me this message. I think you should talk to Marche in Eastern Flarine.
descriptionComplete.pl: Dziękuję, za dostarczenie mi tej wiadomości. Myślę, że powinieneś porozmawiać z Marche we Wschodnim Flarine
descriptionComplete.ru: Спасибо, что сообщил. Думаю, Марша из Восточной Фларинции тоже должна знать.
descriptionComplete.sp: Gracias por traerme este mensaje. Creo que deberías hablar con Marche en Flarine Este.
descriptionComplete.sw: Thank you from bringing me this message. I think you should talk to Marche in Eastern Flarine.
descriptionComplete.th: ขอบคุณที่นำข้อความนี้มาให้ฉัน ฉันคิดว่าคุณควรคุยกับ Marche ที่ Eastern Flarine
descriptionComplete.tw: 謝謝你給我帶來了這條訊息，我認為你應該和在東邊布拉里斯的魔力夢夢談談。
descriptionComplete.vi: Cảm ơn bạn đã mang đến cho tôi tin nhắn này. Tôi nghĩ bạn nên nói chuyện với Marche ở Eastern Flarine.

dialogsComplete.it: Thank you from bringing me this message. I think you should talk to Marche in Eastern Flarine.

dialogsComplete.nl: Thank you from bringing me this message. I think you should talk to Marche in Eastern Flarine.
dialogsComplete.pl: Dziękuję, za dostarczenie mi tej wiadomości. Myślę, że powinieneś porozmawiać z Marche we Wschodnim Flarine
dialogsComplete.ru: Спасибо, что сообщил. Думаю, Марша из Восточной Фларинции тоже должна знать.
dialogsComplete.sp: Gracias por traerme este mensaje. Creo que deberías hablar con Marche en Flarine Este.
dialogsComplete.sw: Thank you from bringing me this message. I think you should talk to Marche in Eastern Flarine.
dialogsComplete.th: ขอบคุณที่นำข้อความนี้มาให้ฉัน ฉันคิดว่าคุณควรคุยกับ Marche ที่ Eastern Flarine
dialogsComplete.tw: 謝謝你給我帶來了這條訊息，我認為你應該和在東邊布拉里斯的魔力夢夢談談。
dialogsComplete.vi: Cảm ơn bạn đã mang đến cho tôi tin nhắn này. Tôi nghĩ bạn nên nói chuyện với Marche ở Eastern Flarine.
