description.en: Find Ancimys south of the High-Dwarpet camp and ask him to find the portrait for you.
description.ar: Find Ancimys south of the High-Dwarpet camp and ask him to find the portrait for you.
description.br: Vá e encontre Ancimys. Quem tiver a habilidade normalmente a explicará de maneira diferente para os outros. Encontre-o e peça sua ajuda.
description.cns: 去找南边高阶矮人族那儿的安瑟麦斯，然后请它帮你找丢失的画像。
description.de: Geh und finde Ancimys. Derjenige der die Fähigkeit hat wird sie anderen anders erklären. Finde ihn und bitte ihn um Hilfe.
description.fi: Find Ancimys south of the High-Dwarpet camp and ask him to find the portrait for you.
description.fil: Find Ancimys south of the High-Dwarpet camp and ask him to find the portrait for you.
description.fr: Demander de l'aide à Ancimys pour qu'il localise le lieu où se trouve le portrait
description.id: Temukan Ancimys di selatan kamp High-Dwarpet dan minta dia untuk menemukan potret itu untukmu.
description.it: Find Ancimys south of the High-Dwarpet camp and ask him to find the portrait for you.
description.jp: ＜アンシミス＞という箱を探そう。特殊な能力を持っているその箱は、どうやら他の箱とはしゃべり方が違うらしい。
description.kr: 남쪽의 하이-드워프 무리 사이에서 앙키미스를 찾아 초상화가 어디에 있는지 물어보세요.
description.nl: Find Ancimys south of the High-Dwarpet camp and ask him to find the portrait for you.
description.pl: Find Ancimys south of the High-Dwarpet camp and ask him to find the portrait for you.
description.ru: Нужно разыскать Бэддини к югу от лагеря высоких карликов и попросить его о помощи.
description.sp: Encuentra a Ancimys al sur del campamento de los Alto-Enanos y pídele que te busque el retrato.
description.sw: Find Ancimys south of the High-Dwarpet camp and ask him to find the portrait for you.
description.th: หา Ancimys ทางใต้ของค่าย High-Dwarpet และขอให้เขาหาภาพวาดให้คุณ
description.tw: 去找 [魔法箱子] 安奇米斯，這個會魔法的箱子應該會說出和其他箱子不同的話。
description.vi: Tìm Ancimys ở phía nam trại High-Dwarpet và yêu cầu anh ta tìm bức chân dung cho bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: We're going to need more information if we are to find the missing portrait. Wait, maybe Ancimys can help.
dialogsBegin.ar: We're going to need more information if we are to find the missing portrait. Wait, maybe Ancimys can help.
dialogsBegin.br: Hmm... Ainda precisamos de mais dados para encontrar o retrato. Sim! Talvez ele saiba!
dialogsBegin.cns: 如果我们要找到丢失的画像的话，我们需要更多的信息。等等，也许安瑟麦斯能帮上忙。
dialogsBegin.de: Hmm.. wir brauchen mehr Daten um das Portrait finden zu können. Phew.. (denkt eine Weile nach) Ja! Vielleicht weiß er es!
dialogsBegin.fi: We're going to need more information if we are to find the missing portrait. Wait, maybe Ancimys can help.
dialogsBegin.fil: We're going to need more information if we are to find the missing portrait. Wait, maybe Ancimys can help.
dialogsBegin.fr: Hmm... Nous avons besoin de plus d'informations pour retrouver ce portrait. Hmm.... (réfléchissant quelques instants) Oui ! Bien sûr !
dialogsBegin.id: Kami akan membutuhkan lebih banyak informasi jika kami ingin menemukan potret yang hilang. Tunggu, mungkin Ancimys bisa membantu.
dialogsBegin.it: We're going to need more information if we are to find the missing portrait. Wait, maybe Ancimys can help.
dialogsBegin.jp: なるほどな。でも残念だけど、それだけじゃ俺にも何もわからない。そうだ！あいつなら知っているかも。
dialogsBegin.kr: 초상화를 찾으려면 정보가 더 필요해요. 잠깐만요, 앙키미스가 도와줄 수 있을지도 몰라요.
dialogsBegin.nl: We're going to need more information if we are to find the missing portrait. Wait, maybe Ancimys can help.
dialogsBegin.pl: We're going to need more information if we are to find the missing portrait. Wait, maybe Ancimys can help.
dialogsBegin.ru: Н-да. Вряд ли мы сумеем найти вора по этому рисунку… Постой! Попросим-ка о помощи Бэддини.
dialogsBegin.sp: Vamos a necesitar más información si queremos encontrar el retrato perdido. Espera, tal vez Ancimys pueda ayudar.
dialogsBegin.sw: We're going to need more information if we are to find the missing portrait. Wait, maybe Ancimys can help.
dialogsBegin.th: เราต้องการข้อมูลเพิ่มเติมหากเราต้องหาภาพที่หายไป เดี๋ยวก่อนนะ บางที Ancimys อาจช่วยได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 嗯？只拿著這個的話我也沒辦法啦！對了！他們的話應該可以的。
dialogsBegin.vi: Chúng tôi sẽ cần thêm thông tin nếu chúng tôi muốn tìm thấy bức chân dung bị mất tích. Chờ đã, có lẽ Ancimys có thể giúp.

dialogsBegin.en: Powerful black magicians once existed in Madrigal. They used black magic which is slightly different than what our modern day Magicians use.
dialogsBegin.ar: Powerful black magicians once existed in Madrigal. They used black magic which is slightly different than what our modern day Magicians use.
dialogsBegin.br: Poderosos magos negros já existiram em Madrigal. Eles usaram magia negra, que é um pouco diferente do que nossos magos modernos usam.
dialogsBegin.cns: 听说以前有一个叫做黑暗魔导士的人，他会使用黑暗的力量使魔法。虽然现在已经不存在了，
dialogsBegin.de: Schwarze Magier waren früher in Madrigal ansässig. Sie nutzten schwarze Magie anders als Magier aus der heutigen Zeit.
dialogsBegin.fi: Powerful black magicians once existed in Madrigal. They used black magic which is slightly different than what our modern day Magicians use.
dialogsBegin.fil: Powerful black magicians once existed in Madrigal. They used black magic which is slightly different than what our modern day Magicians use.
dialogsBegin.fr: On trouvait des magiciens noirs dans le passé à Madrigal. Ils utilisaient la magie complètement différemment de ce qu'en font aujourd'hui les magiciens.
dialogsBegin.id: Penyihir hitam yang kuat pernah ada di Madrigal. Mereka menggunakan ilmu hitam yang sedikit berbeda dari yang digunakan Magician modern kita.
dialogsBegin.it: Powerful black magicians once existed in Madrigal. They used black magic which is slightly different than what our modern day Magicians use.
dialogsBegin.jp: 今は伝説上の話だが、昔、＜ブラックマジシャン＞と呼ばれる存在がいたという。＜ブラックマジシャン＞は黒魔術といわれる異端の魔法を操る危険な魔術師だったらしい。もちろんそんな魔法は、今では存在していないけどな。
dialogsBegin.kr: 한때 마드리갈엔 강력한 블랙 매지션이 존재했었죠. 오늘날의 매지션들이 쓰는 마법과는 다른 흑마법을 사용했고요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Powerful black magicians once existed in Madrigal. They used black magic which is slightly different than what our modern day Magicians use.
dialogsBegin.pl: Powerful black magicians once existed in Madrigal. They used black magic which is slightly different than what our modern day Magicians use.
dialogsBegin.ru: Да, в прежние времена жили фокусники - не чета нынешним! Их трюки были куда опаснее и сложнее, чем современные. Бэддини, например, славился тем, что мог выбраться из любого запертого ящика.
dialogsBegin.sp: Hace tiempo existían poderosos magos negros en Madrigal. Usaban magia negra, que es ligeramente diferente a la que usan nuestros Magicians modernos.
dialogsBegin.sw: Powerful black magicians once existed in Madrigal. They used black magic which is slightly different than what our modern day Magicians use.
dialogsBegin.th: นักเวทย์จากศาสตร์มืดที่ทรงพลังเคยอาศัยอยู่ใน Madrigal พวกเขาใช้มนตร์ดำซึ่งแตกต่างจากที่นักเวทย์สมัยใหม่ใช้เล็กน้อย
dialogsBegin.tw: 聽說以前有一個叫做黑暗魔法師的人，他會使用黑暗的力量使魔法。雖然現在已經不存在了，
dialogsBegin.vi: Những Magicians đen mạnh mẽ đã từng tồn tại ở Madrigal. Họ sử dụng ma thuật đen tối hơi khác so với những gì mà các Magicians ngày nay sử dụng.

dialogsBegin.en: One of them made a box possessing great magical power… Ancimys. Some say that very same magician locked himself inside the box, hahaha!
dialogsBegin.ar: One of them made a box possessing great magical power… Ancimys. Some say that very same magician locked himself inside the box, hahaha!
dialogsBegin.br: E um deles fez uma caixa que tem um grande poder mágico... Seu nome era Ancimys. Alguns dizem que esse mesmo mago se trancou dentro da caixa, hahaha!
dialogsBegin.cns: 他们其中的一位制作了一个拥有巨大魔力的魔盒叫做… 安瑟麦斯。也有人说是某个魔法师把他自己锁盒子里了，哈哈哈！
dialogsBegin.de: Einer von ihnen fertigte eine Kiste an, die große magische Kräfte besaß... Ancimys. Manche sagen, derselbe Magier habe sich in der Kiste eingeschlossen, hahaha!
dialogsBegin.fi: One of them made a box possessing great magical power… Ancimys. Some say that very same magician locked himself inside the box, hahaha!
dialogsBegin.fil: One of them made a box possessing great magical power… Ancimys. Some say that very same magician locked himself inside the box, hahaha!
dialogsBegin.fr: Et l'un d'eux avait fabriqué une boîte possédant de grands pouvoirs mystiques. Il s'appelait Ancimys.
dialogsBegin.id: Salah satunya membuat sebuah kotak yang memiliki kekuatan magis yang besar… Ancimys. Ada yang bilang magician yang sama mengunci dirinya di dalam kotak, hahaha!
dialogsBegin.it: One of them made a box possessing great magical power… Ancimys. Some say that very same magician locked himself inside the box, hahaha!
dialogsBegin.jp: ＜ブラックマジシャン＞がある時、不思議な魔法を秘めた箱を1つ作ったんだ。その箱の名前は＜アンシミス＞という名前で、フラリス大陸のどこかにいるらしい。
dialogsBegin.kr: 블랙 매지션 중 하나가 강력한 마법의 힘을 지니고 있는 상자를 만들었어요. 앙키미스. 그 매지션은 결국 자신 만든 상자 안에 갇혔다는 이야기도 있어요, 하하!
dialogsBegin.nl: One of them made a box possessing great magical power… Ancimys. Some say that very same magician locked himself inside the box, hahaha!
dialogsBegin.pl: One of them made a box possessing great magical power… Ancimys. Some say that very same magician locked himself inside the box, hahaha!
dialogsBegin.ru: Но однажды завистники подсунули ему сундук с какими-то слишком сильными чарами. Бэддини забрался внутрь… а выбраться не сумел. Так и живет в сундуке.
dialogsBegin.sp: Uno de ellos hizo una caja que poseía un gran poder mágico... Ancimys. Algunos dicen que el mismo mago se encerró dentro de la caja, ¡jajaja!
dialogsBegin.sw: One of them made a box possessing great magical power… Ancimys. Some say that very same magician locked himself inside the box, hahaha!
dialogsBegin.th: หนึ่งในพวกเขาทำกล่องครอบครองพลังวิเศษเอาไว้... Ancimys บางคนบอกว่านักเวทย์คนเดียวกันนั้นล็อกตัวเองไว้ภายในกล่อง ฮ่าๆ!
dialogsBegin.tw: 可是不知道為什麼，那個黑暗魔法使做了一個叫做安奇米斯的箱子，有人說是同一位魔法使把自己鎖在盒子裡，哈哈哈！。
dialogsBegin.vi: Một trong số họ đã tạo ra một chiếc hộp sở hữu sức mạnh ma thuật tuyệt vời… Ancimys. Một số người nói rằng chính Magician đã tự nhốt mình trong hộp, hahaha!

dialogsBegin.en: He may be able to use Psychmetria... What? You don't know what Psychmetria is?
dialogsBegin.ar: He may be able to use Psychmetria... What? You don't know what Psychmetria is?
dialogsBegin.br: Talvez ele possa usar a magia negra Psicometria. Hum? Você está me perguntado o que é Psicometria? Deixe-me explicar.
dialogsBegin.cns: 他或许可以使用精神魔法...什么？你不知道精神魔法是什么？
dialogsBegin.de: Vielleicht kann er die schwarze Magie Psychmetria nutzen. Hm? Fragst du mich was Psychmetria ist? Lass es mich dir erklären.
dialogsBegin.fi: He may be able to use Psychmetria... What? You don't know what Psychmetria is?
dialogsBegin.fil: He may be able to use Psychmetria... What? You don't know what Psychmetria is?
dialogsBegin.fr: Peut-être qu'il peut utiliser la Psychmetria. Hein ? Tu te demandes ce que c'est ? Laisse-moi t'expliquer.
dialogsBegin.id: Dia mungkin bisa menggunakan Psychmetria... Apa? Kamu tidak tahu apa itu Psikmetria?
dialogsBegin.it: He may be able to use Psychmetria... What? You don't know what Psychmetria is?
dialogsBegin.jp: その箱なら、禁断とされる＜ブラックマジシャン＞の魔法＜サイキトメリア＞を使うことができるだろうよ。＜サイキトメリア＞が何かと？ふむ。じゃ、無知な君に説明しよう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그 녀석이라면 사이키메트리아를 쓸 수 있을지도... 네? 사이키메트리아가 뭔지 모르세요?
dialogsBegin.nl: He may be able to use Psychmetria... What? You don't know what Psychmetria is?
dialogsBegin.pl: He may be able to use Psychmetria... What? You don't know what Psychmetria is?
dialogsBegin.ru: Поговори с ним. Он наверняка расскажет, где портрет, ведь ему нет равных в психометрии.
dialogsBegin.sp: Tal vez puede usar Psicometría... ¿Qué? ¿No sabes lo que es la Psicometría?
dialogsBegin.sw: He may be able to use Psychmetria... What? You don't know what Psychmetria is?
dialogsBegin.th: เขาอาจจะใช้ Psychmetria ได้... อะไรนะ? คุณไม่รู้ว่า Psychmetria คืออะไรงั้นหรอ?
dialogsBegin.tw: 如果是那個箱子的話，應該可以使用透視魔法，你問我什麼是透視魔法啊？好我來告訴你！
dialogsBegin.vi: Anh ta có thể sử dụng Psychmetria ... Cái gì? Bạn không biết Psychmetria là gì?

dialogsBegin.en: Psychmetria is a powerful black magic spell that can pinpoint the location of an object. You must go and find Ancimys.
dialogsBegin.ar: Psychmetria is a powerful black magic spell that can pinpoint the location of an object. You must go and find Ancimys.
dialogsBegin.br: É um feitiço muito forte que pode informar o local onde algo se encontra. Agora vá e o encontre.
dialogsBegin.cns: 精神魔法是一个强大的可以精准确定物体位置黑魔法咒语。你必须去找安瑟麦斯。
dialogsBegin.de: Es ist eine sehr mächtige Magie die einen Ort formen kann wo etwas ist. Geh und finde ihn.
dialogsBegin.fi: Psychmetria is a powerful black magic spell that can pinpoint the location of an object. You must go and find Ancimys.
dialogsBegin.fil: Psychmetria is a powerful black magic spell that can pinpoint the location of an object. You must go and find Ancimys.
dialogsBegin.fr: C'est un sort très puissant qui permet de localiser l'endroit précis où se trouve un objet !
dialogsBegin.id: Psychmetria adalahblack magic spell yang kuat yang dapat menentukan lokasi suatu objek. Kamu harus pergi dan menemukan Ancimys.
dialogsBegin.it: Psychmetria is a powerful black magic spell that can pinpoint the location of an object. You must go and find Ancimys.
dialogsBegin.jp: ＜サイキトメリア＞は、見たいものや知りたいものがどこにあるかを知ることができる魔法だ。千里眼、とでも言おうか。
dialogsBegin.kr: 흑마법의 일종인데, 특정 물건의 위치를 추적할 수 있어요. 우선 가서 앙키미스를 찾아보세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Psychmetria is a powerful black magic spell that can pinpoint the location of an object. You must go and find Ancimys.
dialogsBegin.pl: Psychmetria is a powerful black magic spell that can pinpoint the location of an object. You must go and find Ancimys.
dialogsBegin.ru: Что такое психометрия? Это сложный старинный фокус, показывающий, где находится любой предмет. Словом, разыщи Бэддини! Договорились?
dialogsBegin.sp: Psicometría es un poderoso hechizo de magia negra que puede señalar la ubicación de un objeto. Debes ir a buscar a Ancimys.
dialogsBegin.sw: Psychmetria is a powerful black magic spell that can pinpoint the location of an object. You must go and find Ancimys.
dialogsBegin.th: Psychmetria คือมนตร์ดำที่ทรงพลัง ซึ่งสามารถระบุตำแหน่งของวัตถุได้ คุณต้องไปหา Ancimys
dialogsBegin.tw: 那個魔法可以，看到很多你所看不到的東西。好了！快去吧！
dialogsBegin.vi: Psychmetria là một loại ma thuật đen tối mạnh mẽ có thể xác định chính xác vị trí của một vật thể. Bạn phải đi tìm Ancimys.

dialogsAccept.en: The Ancimys you need to speak with is just south of here.
dialogsAccept.ar: The Ancimys you need to speak with is just south of here.
dialogsAccept.br: Ah, eu quase me esqueci de lhe dizer. Quem tiver a habilidade normalmente a explicará de maneira diferente para os outros.
dialogsAccept.cns: 你只需要和这南边的那个魔盒对话哦。
dialogsAccept.de: Oh, ich vergaß fast dir zu sagen. Derjenige der die Fähigkeit hat wird es anderen anders erklären.
dialogsAccept.fi: The Ancimys you need to speak with is just south of here.
dialogsAccept.fil: The Ancimys you need to speak with is just south of here.
dialogsAccept.fr: Mais Ancimys qui possède ce pouvoir saurait sûrement t'expliquer bien mieux que moi...
dialogsAccept.id: Ancimys yang perlu kamu ajak bicara ada di selatan sini.
dialogsAccept.it: The Ancimys you need to speak with is just south of here.
dialogsAccept.jp: おそらく、その特殊な能力を持っている箱は、他の箱とはしゃべり方が違うと思うぜ。よく探してみてくれ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 당신이 만나야 할 앙키미스는 여기서 남쪽으로 가면 있어요.
dialogsAccept.nl: The Ancimys you need to speak with is just south of here.
dialogsAccept.pl: The Ancimys you need to speak with is just south of here.
dialogsAccept.ru: Бэддини в своем сундуке должен быть где-то на юге отсюда.
dialogsAccept.sp: El Ancimys con el que tienes que hablar está justo al sur de aquí.
dialogsAccept.sw: The Ancimys you need to speak with is just south of here.
dialogsAccept.th: Ancimys ที่คุณต้องพูดด้วยอยู่ทางใต้ของที่นี่
dialogsAccept.tw: 啊，對了！擁有那個能力的箱子，應該跟其他箱子講不同的話喔。
dialogsAccept.vi: Ancimys mà bạn cần nói chuyện ở ngay phía nam đây.

dialogsDecline.en: What do I care if you don't do it? It's no skin off my back…
dialogsDecline.ar: What do I care if you don't do it? It's no skin off my back…
dialogsDecline.br: Bem, não é problema meu se você vai fazê-lo ou não. Depende de você.
dialogsDecline.cns: 你想不想做，对我来说没有关系啦!反正选择的人是你啊!
dialogsDecline.de: Was kümmert es mich, wenn du es nicht tust? Mir ist das egal...
dialogsDecline.fi: What do I care if you don't do it? It's no skin off my back…
dialogsDecline.fil: What do I care if you don't do it? It's no skin off my back…
dialogsDecline.fr: Bon, finalement ce n'est pas mon problème si tu acceptes ou pas.
dialogsDecline.id: Apa peduliku jika kamu tidak melakukannya? Itu bukan urusanku…
dialogsDecline.it: What do I care if you don't do it? It's no skin off my back…
dialogsDecline.jp: おそらく、その特殊な能力を持っている箱は、他の箱とはしゃべり方が違うと思うぜ。よく探してみてくれ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 안 해도 상관없어요. 제가 손해 볼 거 없거든요...
dialogsDecline.nl: What do I care if you don't do it? It's no skin off my back…
dialogsDecline.pl: What do I care if you don't do it? It's no skin off my back…
dialogsDecline.ru: What do I care if you don't do it? It's no skin off my back…
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Qué más me da si no lo haces? No tiene nada que ver conmigo...
dialogsDecline.sw: What do I care if you don't do it? It's no skin off my back…
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันจะแคร์ทำไมถ้าคุณไม่ทำ? ไม่ระคายผิวฉันเลยสักนิด...
dialogsDecline.tw: 你不做我在乎什麼？沒什麼大不了的……
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi quan tâm liệu bạn có làm điều đó không? Tôi không còn bận tậm nữa.

dialogsComplete.en: A missing portrait? Well, isn't that exciting! I was so bored I thought I was going to fall asleep! Tell me more about this portrait.
dialogsComplete.ar: A missing portrait? Well, isn't that exciting! I was so bored I thought I was going to fall asleep! Tell me more about this portrait.
dialogsComplete.br: Um retrato perdido? Bem, não é tão empolgante! Eu estava tão entediado que pensei que ' dormir! Conte-me mais sobre este retrato.
dialogsComplete.cns: 什么?既然有这种事啊?应该很好玩喔~好吧!我来帮你看看画像在哪里!等等喔!
dialogsComplete.de: Ein fehlendes Porträt? Na, das ist ja aufregend! Ich habe mich so gelangweilt, dass ich dachte, ich schlafe gleich ein! Erzähl mir mehr über dieses Porträt.
dialogsComplete.fi: A missing portrait? Well, isn't that exciting! I was so bored I thought I was going to fall asleep! Tell me more about this portrait.
dialogsComplete.fil: A missing portrait? Well, isn't that exciting! I was so bored I thought I was going to fall asleep! Tell me more about this portrait.
dialogsComplete.fr: Quoi ? C'est vrai ? Je devrais pouvoir t'aider dans ta quête, attends un moment.
dialogsComplete.id: Potret yang hilang? Nah, bukankah itu mengasyikkan! Aku sangat bosan saya pikir akan tertidur! Ceritakan lebih banyak tentang potret ini.
dialogsComplete.it: A missing portrait? Well, isn't that exciting! I was so bored I thought I was going to fall asleep! Tell me more about this portrait.
dialogsComplete.jp: なになに～？肖像画が消えたって～ぇ？クッククク～。面白い事件だね～ぇ？その肖像画を見つけるのを手伝ってくれないかって～ぇ？　ふふ～ん。ちょっと待って～ぇ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 초상화가 사라졌다고요? 와, 흥미로운데요! 너무 심심해서 졸리던 참이었거든요! 어떤 초상화인지 더 말해보세요!
dialogsComplete.nl: A missing portrait? Well, isn't that exciting! I was so bored I thought I was going to fall asleep! Tell me more about this portrait.
dialogsComplete.pl: A missing portrait? Well, isn't that exciting! I was so bored I thought I was going to fall asleep! Tell me more about this portrait.
dialogsComplete.ru: Пропавший портрет? Как интересно! Я тут совсем засыпаю от скуки. Ну-ка, ну-ка, рассказывай, да поподробнее…
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿Un retrato perdido? ¡¿No es emocionante?! ¡Estaba tan aburrido que pensaba que me iba a quedar dormido! Cuéntame más sobre ese retrato.
dialogsComplete.sw: A missing portrait? Well, isn't that exciting! I was so bored I thought I was going to fall asleep! Tell me more about this portrait.
dialogsComplete.th: ภาพที่หายไป? แหม ไม่น่าตื่นเต้นหรอกเหรอ! ฉันเบื่อจนเกือบจะหลับไปซะแล้ว! บอกข้อมูลเพิ่มเติมเกี่ยวกับภาพนี้มาสิ
dialogsComplete.tw: 一個遺失的畫像？嗯，是不是很刺激！我太無聊了，我以為我要睡著了！告訴我更多關於這幅畫像的事情。
dialogsComplete.vi: Một bức chân dung bị mất tích? Chà, điều đó không thú vị sao! Tôi đã rất chán đến nỗi chỉ muốn đi ngủ! Kể tôi nghe thêm về bức chân dung này.

dialogsComplete.en: Alright, give me a moment… Mmmmmm, yes. I've got it! I see a camp… and large creatures with hammers and blades for hands.
dialogsComplete.ar: Alright, give me a moment… Mmmmmm, yes. I've got it! I see a camp… and large creatures with hammers and blades for hands.
dialogsComplete.br: Tudo bem, me dê um momento... Mmmmmm. Sim! É isso! Vejo um acampamento... e grandes criaturas com martelos e lâminas no lugar das mãos.
dialogsComplete.cns: 好吧，给我点时间...嗯....对了 我知道了！我看到了一个营地...还有手里拿着锤子和刀片的巨大生物。
dialogsComplete.de: Gut, gib mir einen Moment... Mmmmmm, ja. Ich hab's! Ich sehe ein Lager... und große Kreaturen mit Hämmern und Klingen als Hände.
dialogsComplete.fi: Alright, give me a moment… Mmmmmm, yes. I've got it! I see a camp… and large creatures with hammers and blades for hands.
dialogsComplete.fil: Alright, give me a moment… Mmmmmm, yes. I've got it! I see a camp… and large creatures with hammers and blades for hands.
dialogsComplete.fr: (récitant une incantation) Hé hé ! Je l'ai vu ! Note bien ce que je vais te dire.
dialogsComplete.id: Baiklah, beri aku waktu sebentar… Mmmmmm, ya. Aku mengerti! Aku melihat sebuah kamp ... dan makhluk besar dengan palu dan pisau untuk tangan.
dialogsComplete.it: Alright, give me a moment… Mmmmmm, yes. I've got it! I see a camp… and large creatures with hammers and blades for hands.
dialogsComplete.jp: フムフムフム。クッククク～。わかった、わかったよ～ぉ。じゃ、何か書くものを用意して～ぇ。そしてボクの言うことをちゃ～んと書きとめたほうがいいよ～ぉ。準備はできた～ぁ？
dialogsComplete.kr: 좋아요. 잠시만요… 으으으음… 네, 찾았어요! 야영지가 보이고... 손에 망치와 칼이 달린 거대한 생물들이 보여요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Alright, give me a moment… Mmmmmm, yes. I've got it! I see a camp… and large creatures with hammers and blades for hands.
dialogsComplete.pl: Alright, give me a moment… Mmmmmm, yes. I've got it! I see a camp… and large creatures with hammers and blades for hands.
dialogsComplete.ru: Хм-м... Минутку… Есть! Я вижу его! Он в лагере… А вокруг громилы с молотками… и мечами вместо рук!
dialogsComplete.sp: Muy bien, dame un momento... Mmmmmm, sí. ¡Lo tengo! Veo un campamento... y grandes criaturas con martillos y cuchillas en lugar de manos.
dialogsComplete.sw: Alright, give me a moment… Mmmmmm, yes. I've got it! I see a camp… and large creatures with hammers and blades for hands.
dialogsComplete.th: เอาล่ะ ขอเวลาฉันสักครู่... อืมมม ฉันรู้แล้ว! ฉันเห็นค่าย... และสิ่งมีชีวิตขนาดใหญ่ที่มีค้อนและมือเป็นใบมีด
dialogsComplete.tw: 好吧，給我一點時間……嗯，是的。我懂了！我看到了一個營地……以及手持錘子和刀片的大型怪物。
dialogsComplete.vi: Được rồi, chờ tôi chút… Mmmmmm, vâng. Tôi hiểu rồi! Tôi thấy một trại ... và những sinh vật lớn với búa và lưỡi kiếm.

dialogsComplete.en: Ah ha! It's the Red Bang Troupe camp northeast of the Mars Mine. One of those big beasts has it! It's difficult to get to, but I'm sure you'll manage!
dialogsComplete.ar: Ah ha! It's the Red Bang Troupe camp northeast of the Mars Mine. One of those big beasts has it! It's difficult to get to, but I'm sure you'll manage!
dialogsComplete.br: Ah há! É o acampamento da Tropa dos Bangs Vermelhos a nordeste da Masmorra Mars. Uma dessas grandes feras tem! É difícil pegar, mas tenho certeza que você vai conseguir!
dialogsComplete.cns: 啊哈！是魔域密殿北部的红色魔导战甲强盗团。那些大怪兽中的一个拥有它! 它很难被打败，但我相信你会成功的!
dialogsComplete.de: Ah ha! Es ist das Lager der Red Bang Troupe nordöstlich des Mas Dungeon. Eines dieser großen Biester hat es! Es ist schwierig, dorthin zu gelangen, aber ich bin mir sicher, dass du das schaffen wirst!
dialogsComplete.fi: Ah ha! It's the Red Bang Troupe camp northeast of the Mars Mine. One of those big beasts has it! It's difficult to get to, but I'm sure you'll manage!
dialogsComplete.fil: Ah ha! It's the Red Bang Troupe camp northeast of the Mars Mine. One of those big beasts has it! It's difficult to get to, but I'm sure you'll manage!
dialogsComplete.fr: (Bla bla bla bla...) Tu as fini d'écrire ce que j'ai dit ? Tu trouveras le portrait là-bas, bonne continuation !
dialogsComplete.id: Ah! Itu adalah kamp Red Bang Troupe di timur laut Mars Mine. Salah satu binatang besar itu memilikinya! Sulit untuk mencapainya, tetapi aku yakin kamu akan berhasil!
dialogsComplete.it: Ah ha! It's the Red Bang Troupe camp northeast of the Mars Mine. One of those big beasts has it! It's difficult to get to, but I'm sure you'll manage!
dialogsComplete.jp: フラリスダンジョンの北東にキャンプ地があるはずだよ～ぉ。これがこう～。そうそう、そんな感じ～ぃ。全部書き取った～ぁ？そこに行けば探してるものがあると思うよ～ぉ？クッククク～。あ～楽しかったぁ。またね～ぇ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 아하! 마스 마인 북동쪽에 있는 레드 뱅 도적단 본거지예요. 큰 몬스터 중 하나가 가지고 있나 보네요! 되찾기 힘들겠지만, 당신이라면 수 있어요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Ah ha! It's the Red Bang Troupe camp northeast of the Mars Mine. One of those big beasts has it! It's difficult to get to, but I'm sure you'll manage!
dialogsComplete.pl: Ah ha! It's the Red Bang Troupe camp northeast of the Mars Mine. One of those big beasts has it! It's difficult to get to, but I'm sure you'll manage!
dialogsComplete.ru: Ну конечно! Это же проходимцы из "Труппы товарищей"! Их логово на юго-западе от Марсовой шахты. Картина у одного из них. Ох, непросто будет ее вернуть!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Ajá! Es el campamento de los Bangs Rojos al noreste de la Mina Mars. ¡Una de esas grandes bestias lo tiene! Es difícil llegar, ¡pero estoy seguro de que lo lograrás!
dialogsComplete.sw: Ah ha! It's the Red Bang Troupe camp northeast of the Mars Mine. One of those big beasts has it! It's difficult to get to, but I'm sure you'll manage!
dialogsComplete.th: อาฮ่า! เป็นค่ายที่พวก Red Bang อยู่ทางตะวันออกเฉียงเหนือของ Mars Mine หนึ่งในสัตว์ใหญ่ที่นั่นมีมัน! มันยากที่จะไปถึงที่นั่น แต่ฉันแน่ใจว่าคุณจะจัดการได้!
dialogsComplete.tw: 啊哈！這是瑪斯礦坑東北部的紅色蹦蹦劇團營地。其中一隻巨獸擁有它！很難到達，但我相信你會做到的！
dialogsComplete.vi: À ha! Đó là trại của Red Bang Troupe ở phía đông bắc của Mars Mine. Một trong những con thú lớn có nó! Rất khó để đến được, nhưng tôi chắc rằng bạn sẽ xoay sở được!

dialogsFail.en: Are you going to play with me? Really? Good! What will we do? Hide and Seek? YAY!
dialogsFail.ar: Are you going to play with me? Really? Good! What will we do? Hide and Seek? YAY!
dialogsFail.br: Você vai brincar comigo? Verdade? Bom, bom! O que faremos?! Esconde-esconde? He he he!
dialogsFail.cns: 要跟我玩吗?要玩什么呢??
dialogsFail.de: Willst du mit mir spielen? Wirklich? Gut, gut! Was spielen wir? Verstecken?
dialogsFail.fi: Are you going to play with me? Really? Good! What will we do? Hide and Seek? YAY!
dialogsFail.fil: Are you going to play with me? Really? Good! What will we do? Hide and Seek? YAY!
dialogsFail.fr: Tu veux jouer c'est ça ? Vraiment ? Bien, bien! Que va-t-on faire ? Un cache-cache ?
dialogsFail.id: Apakah kamu akan bermain denganku? Serius? Bagus! Apa yang akan kita lakukan? Petak umpet? YA!
dialogsFail.it: Are you going to play with me? Really? Good! What will we do? Hide and Seek? YAY!

dialogsBegin.tw: ……看起來像是某種紋樣。可是那裡被包圍住了，我沒辦法靠近仔細看。
dialogsBegin.vi: .. nó nhìn như một kiểu hoa văn vậy. Tôi nhìn gần được nó vì nó được bao phủ.

dialogsBegin.en: Strange fellows were hanging around there. I think they were defending something. There was no way I could have fought them off.
dialogsBegin.ar: Strange fellows were hanging around there. I think they were defending something. There was no way I could have fought them off.
dialogsBegin.br: Pessoas estranhas andavam por ali. Acho que estavam defendendo algo. Não havia como espantá-los.
dialogsBegin.cns: 因为有一些很奇怪的家伙在那边徘徊，我又不会打架..所以没有仔细的看到啦。
dialogsBegin.de: Es ist wegen den seltsamen Burschen die da rumlaufen. Ich denke, dass sie etwas bewachen. Deshalb konnte ich das nicht überprüfen. Weisst du.. Ich bin kein guter Kämpfer..
dialogsBegin.fi: Strange fellows were hanging around there. I think they were defending something. There was no way I could have fought them off.
dialogsBegin.fil: Strange fellows were hanging around there. I think they were defending something. There was no way I could have fought them off.
dialogsBegin.fr: … de nombreux monstres rôdent autour, comme s'ils protégeaient quelque chose… Tu sais je suis érudit mais mes talents de combattant sont bien faibles…
dialogsBegin.id: Orang-orang aneh berkeliaran di sana. Aku pikir mereka menjaga sesuatu. Tidak mungkin aku bisa melawan mereka.
dialogsBegin.it: Strange fellows were hanging around there. I think they were defending something. There was no way I could have fought them off.
dialogsBegin.jp: 何だか変な奴らがそこを見張っていたのさ。まるでそこを守るかのようにな。もし、そいつらに見つかったところで、私は非力だし、あいつらと戦えるはずもないさ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 수상한 놈들이 어슬렁거리고 있었어요. 무언가를 지키고 있는 것 같았는데, 제가 뭐 싸움을 할 줄 알아야죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: Strange fellows were hanging around there. I think they were defending something. There was no way I could have fought them off.
dialogsBegin.pl: Strange fellows were hanging around there. I think they were defending something. There was no way I could have fought them off.
dialogsBegin.ru: Я едва ноги унес. Должно быть, это очень важный круг, раз его охраняет грозная стража!
dialogsBegin.sp: Había unos tipos extraños rondando por allí. Creo que estaban defendiendo algo. No había forma en que yo pudiera luchar contra ellos.
dialogsBegin.sw: Strange fellows were hanging around there. I think they were defending something. There was no way I could have fought them off.
dialogsBegin.th: คนแปลกๆ อยู่รอบๆ ที่นั่น ฉันคิดว่าพวกเขากำลังปกป้องอะไรบางอย่าง ไม่มีทางที่ฉันจะต่อสู้กับพวกเขาได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 因為有一些很奇怪的傢伙在那邊徘徊，我又不會打架…所以沒有仔細的看到啦。
dialogsBegin.vi: Những người bạn kỳ lạ đang quanh quẩn ở đó. Tôi nghĩ rằng họ đang bảo vệ một cái gì đó. Không đời nào tôi có thể chống lại chúng.

dialogsBegin.en: Would you check? I am sure they are no match for you.
dialogsBegin.ar: Would you check? I am sure they are no match for you.
dialogsBegin.br: Você olharia? Sei que não são páreo para você.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你要不要去试试看啊?我想如果是你的话，应该可以对付他们。
dialogsBegin.de: Würdest du es bitte überprüfen? Ich denke du kannst sie leicht besiegen!
dialogsBegin.fi: Would you check? I am sure they are no match for you.
dialogsBegin.fil: Would you check? I am sure they are no match for you.
dialogsBegin.fr: Cependant cela ne devrait pas t'impressionner ! Es-tu prêt à m'aider encore une fois ?
dialogsBegin.id: Maukah kamu memeriksanya? Aku yakin mereka bukanlah tandinganmu.
dialogsBegin.it: Would you check? I am sure they are no match for you.
dialogsBegin.jp: 君なら、あいつらと戦っても十分相手にできそうだが…。私の代わりに調べてきてはくれないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 혹시, 당신이 가 주시겠어요? 그 정도 상대라면 충분히 이기실 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Would you check? I am sure they are no match for you.
dialogsBegin.pl: Would you check? I am sure they are no match for you.
dialogsBegin.ru: Думаю, ты-то без труда справишься с проходимцами, а?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Lo comprobarías? Estoy seguro de que no son rival para ti.
dialogsBegin.sw: Would you check? I am sure they are no match for you.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณจะตรวจสอบมั้ย? ฉันแน่ใจว่าพวกเขาไม่เหมาะกับคุณ
dialogsBegin.tw: 你要不要去試試看啊？我想如果是你的話，應該可以對付他們。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn sẽ kiểm tra? Tôi chắc chắn rằng họ không phù hợp với bạn.

dialogsAccept.en: Great! I am sure that there is something to that pattern. Check it closely and bring me what you find.
dialogsAccept.ar: Great! I am sure that there is something to that pattern. Check it closely and bring me what you find.
dialogsAccept.br: Ótimo! Tenho certeza de que há algo neste formato. Olhe atentamente e me traga o que descobrir.
dialogsAccept.cns: 好，我觉得啊，仔细的看看那个纹样的话，应该会看到什么线索，仔细的观察之后，如果有看到什么东西的话，一定要拿过来给我啊。
dialogsAccept.de: Schön! Ich bin sicher wir finden etwas, wenn wir die Muster untersuchen. Bitte überprüfe es gründlich und bringe mir was auch immer du findest.
dialogsAccept.fi: Great! I am sure that there is something to that pattern. Check it closely and bring me what you find.
dialogsAccept.fil: Great! I am sure that there is something to that pattern. Check it closely and bring me what you find.
dialogsAccept.fr: Merci beaucoup ! Alors dirige-toi vers le nord jusqu'à trouver ce motif. Etudie-le avec attention et reviens vite me faire part de ta découverte.
dialogsAccept.id: Bagus! Aku yakin ada sesuatu dengan pola itu. Periksa dengan cermat dan bawakan apa yang kamu temukan.
dialogsAccept.it: Great! I am sure that there is something to that pattern. Check it closely and bring me what you find.
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとう。本当に君は勇敢な若者だな。おそらくあの場所とその文様からは、歴史の謎を解く手がかりが見つかる気がするのだ。では、気をつけて行ってきてくれたまえ！
dialogsAccept.kr: 좋아요! 그 문양에는 분명 무언가가 있어요. 자세히 조사하고, 찾은 게 있다면 꼭 가져와 주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Great! I am sure that there is something to that pattern. Check it closely and bring me what you find.
dialogsAccept.pl: Great! I am sure that there is something to that pattern. Check it closely and bring me what you find.
dialogsAccept.ru: Отлично! Уверен, этот узор очень важен для наших исследований. Рассмотри его, пожалуйста, как следует.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Genial! Estoy seguro de que hay algo en ese patrón. Revísalo bien y tráeme lo que encuentres.
dialogsAccept.sw: Great! I am sure that there is something to that pattern. Check it closely and bring me what you find.
dialogsAccept.th: ยอดเยี่ยม! ฉันแน่ใจว่ามีบางอย่างในรูปแบบนั้น ตรวจสอบอย่างใกล้ชิดและนำสิ่งที่คุณพบมาให้ฉัน
dialogsAccept.tw: 好，我覺得啊，仔細的看看那個紋樣的話，應該會看到什麼線索，仔細的觀察之後，如果有看到什麼東西的話，一定要拿過來給我啊。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tuyệt quá! Tôi chắc chắn rằng có một cái gì đó cho mô hình đó. Kiểm tra nó chặt chẽ và mang cho tôi những gì bạn tìm thấy.

dialogsDecline.en: Are you really ready to give up? I cannot force you but think about the future.
dialogsDecline.ar: Are you really ready to give up? I cannot force you but think about the future.
dialogsDecline.br: Está mesmo pronto para desistir? Não posso lhe forçar, mas pense no futuro.
dialogsDecline.cns: 真的要在这里放弃吗?如果你想放弃的话，我也没办法了..只担心你的前途啦..哎..
dialogsDecline.de: Du willst wirklich aufgeben? Nun.. Ich kann dich nicht dazu zwingen... Auf jeden Fall danke ich dir vielmals. Aber ich mache mir sorgen um deine Zukunft... Puh..
dialogsDecline.fi: Are you really ready to give up? I cannot force you but think about the future.
dialogsDecline.fil: Are you really ready to give up? I cannot force you but think about the future.
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu veux vraiment abandonner ? Moi qui te pensais si courageux… Bien... Je ne peux pas te forcer...
dialogsDecline.id: Apa kamu yakin akan menyerah? Aku tidak bisa memaksamu, tapi cobalah pikirkan kedepannya.
dialogsDecline.it: Are you really ready to give up? I cannot force you but think about the future.
dialogsDecline.jp: 本当にやめるつもりか？せっかくここまで調べたのに、乗りかけた船を降りてしまうなんて。
dialogsDecline.kr: 정말 포기하시게요? 강요할 순 없지만, 앞으로의 미래도 생각하셔야죠.
dialogsDecline.nl: Are you really ready to give up? I cannot force you but think about the future.
dialogsDecline.pl: Are you really ready to give up? I cannot force you but think about the future.
dialogsDecline.ru: Неужели ты откажешься? Подумай о будущем Мадригала!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿De verdad te vas a rendir? No puedo obligarte pero piensa en el futuro.
dialogsDecline.sw: Are you really ready to give up? I cannot force you but think about the future.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณพร้อมที่จะยอมแพ้จริงๆ หรือไม่? ฉันไม่สามารถบังคับคุณได้ แต่คิดถึงอนาคต
dialogsDecline.tw: 真的要在這裡放棄嗎？如果你想放棄的話，我也沒辦法了…只擔心你的前途啦…哎…
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn đã thực sự sẵn sàng để từ bỏ? Tôi không thể ép buộc bạn nhưng hãy nghĩ về tương lai.

dialogsComplete.en: Oh! This! The legend is... Martinyc was right! Oh... What should we do now... Iblis watch over me!
dialogsComplete.ar: Oh! This! The legend is... Martinyc was right! Oh... What should we do now... Iblis watch over me!
dialogsComplete.br: Oh! Isto! A lenda é...!  Martinyc estava certa!... Oh... O que devemos fazer agora? Que Iblis me proteja
dialogsComplete.cns: 啊！这是！这是那传说中的...原来玛缇雅克说的都是真的！
dialogsComplete.de: Oh! Das! Die Legende ist... Martinyc hatte recht! Oh... Was sollen wir jetzt tun... Iblis wache über mich!
dialogsComplete.fi: Oh! This! The legend is... Martinyc was right! Oh... What should we do now... Iblis watch over me!
dialogsComplete.fil: Oh! This! The legend is... Martinyc was right! Oh... What should we do now... Iblis watch over me!
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh… Ceci est effectivement bien étrange… Je crois que nous ne sommes pas au bout de notre aventure !
dialogsComplete.id: Oh! Ini! Legenda itu..! Martinyc benar!.. Oh.. Apa yang harus kita lakukan sekarang.. Iblis mengawasiku!
dialogsComplete.it: Oh! This! The legend is... Martinyc was right! Oh... What should we do now... Iblis watch over me!
dialogsComplete.jp: む！むむ、これは…！！あの伝説が…マルティニークのレポートは真実だったということか、驚いたぞ。しかし、これはいったい何を意味しているのか…。ふむ、また新たな謎が出てきたな。
dialogsComplete.kr: 오! 이건! 이 전설... 마르티닉이 맞았어요! 오... 이제 어떡하죠... 이블리스님이 보고 계신다!
dialogsComplete.nl: Oh! This! The legend is... Martinyc was right! Oh... What should we do now... Iblis watch over me!
dialogsComplete.pl: Oh! This! The legend is... Martinyc was right! Oh... What should we do now... Iblis watch over me!
dialogsComplete.ru: Oh! This! The legend is... Martinyc was right! Oh... What should we do now... Iblis watch over me!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Oh! ¡Esto es! La leyenda es...¡Martinyc tenía razón! Oh... ¿Qué haremos ahora? ¡Por favor Iblis, vela por mí!
dialogsComplete.sw: Oh! This! The legend is... Martinyc was right! Oh... What should we do now... Iblis watch over me!
dialogsComplete.th: โอ้! นี้! ตำนานคือ...! Martinyc พูดถูก! โอ้ เราควรทำอย่างไรตอนนี้ Iblis กำลังจ้องฉันอยู่!
dialogsComplete.tw: 啊！這個！傳說竟然是真的……馬特尼提特是對的！啊……我們現在該怎麼辦……願伊普里司保佑我！
dialogsComplete.vi: Ồ! Đây là! Truyền thuyết là ..Martinyc đã đúng! .. Ồ .. Chúng ta phải làm gì bây giờ .. Thần Iblis phù hộ tôi!

dialogsFail.en: Were those fellows too strong for you? Bring more people with you and continue checking. I am not strong enough to help you with them.
dialogsFail.ar: Were those fellows too strong for you? Bring more people with you and continue checking. I am not strong enough to help you with them.
dialogsFail.br: Eles eram fortes demais para você? Leve mais pessoas e continue checando. Não sou suficientemente forte para lhe ajudar com eles.
dialogsFail.cns: 他们果然不是好对付的啊..连你都打不过他们，你要不要去组剧团试试啊?
dialogsFail.de: Diese Burschen.. Ja. Die sind nicht so einfach, wenn du deshalb gescheitert bist es zu prüfen. Warum tritst du nicht einer Party bei und versuchst es nochmal?
dialogsFail.fi: Were those fellows too strong for you? Bring more people with you and continue checking. I am not strong enough to help you with them.
dialogsFail.fil: Were those fellows too strong for you? Bring more people with you and continue checking. I am not strong enough to help you with them.
dialogsFail.fr: Ces monstres ? Oui, ils semblent coriaces... Peut-être ferait tu mieux de former un groupe avant de t'y rendre ?
dialogsFail.id: Apa mereka terlalu kuat untukmu? Bawa lebih banyak orang bersamamu dan lanjutkna pemeriksaan. Aku tidak cukup kuat untuk membantumu melawan mereka.
dialogsFail.it: Were those fellows too strong for you? Bring more people with you and continue checking. I am not strong enough to help you with them.
dialogsFail.jp: あの場所にいた変なやつらのことだが、それ相応の屈強な奴らに見えたぞ。気をつけてくれ。一人では手強いと思ったら、パーティーを組んでみるのも手だろう。
dialogsFail.kr: 혹시 그 녀석들이 너무 강했던 건가요? 사람을 더 데리고 가서 조사하면 어때요. 죄송하지만 전 강하지 않아서 같이 상대할 수가 없어요.
dialogsFail.nl: Were those fellows too strong for you? Bring more people with you and continue checking. I am not strong enough to help you with them.
dialogsFail.pl: Were those fellows too strong for you? Bring more people with you and continue checking. I am not strong enough to help you with them.
dialogsFail.ru: Что, одолели тебя проходимцы? Попроси о помощи друзей. Из меня-то боец никудышный.
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Eran esos tipos demasiado fuertes para ti? Trae a más personas contigo y continúa verificando. Yo no soy lo suficientemente fuerte para ayudarte con ellos.
dialogsFail.sw: Were those fellows too strong for you? Bring more people with you and continue checking. I am not strong enough to help you with them.
dialogsFail.th: พวกนั้นแข็งแกร่งเกินไปสำหรับคุณหรือ? นำผู้คนจำนวนมากขึ้นไปกับคุณและตรวจสอบต่อไป ฉันไม่แข็งแรงพอที่จะช่วยคุณกับพวกเขา
dialogsFail.tw: 他們果然不是好對付的啊…連你都打不過他們，你要不要去組劇團試試啊？
dialogsFail.vi: Những người bạn đó có quá mạnh đối với bạn không? Mang theo nhiều người hơn và tiếp tục kiểm tra. Tôi không đủ sức để giúp bạn.

dialogsDecline.fil: Ayaw mo bang tumulong? Ayos lang. Hahanapan namin ng iba.
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu ne veux pas aider ? Tant pis, nous trouverons quelqu'un d'autre.

dialogsDecline.kr: 도와주기 싫으신가요? 어쩔 수 없죠. 다른 사람을 찾아볼게요.

dialogsDecline.ru: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.

dialogsDecline.sw: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณไม่อยากช่วยเหรอ? ไม่เป็นไร เราจะหาคนอื่น

dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn không muốn giúp đỡ? Không sao đâu. Chúng tôi sẽ tìm người khác.

description.en: Bring Curenen's ring to Clackcable of the Pepoview Troupe in Saint City.
description.ar: Bring Curenen's ring to Clackcable of the Pepoview Troupe in Saint City.
description.br: Leve este anel para Clockkeble da tropa Pepoview em Saint.
description.cns: 拿着戒指去晨光找，<帕佩团>的克拉凯步吧！
description.de: Bring Kurenens Ring zu Clackcable von der Tantalus Gruppe in Saint Morning.
description.fi: Bring Curenen's ring to Clackcable of the Pepoview Troupe in Saint City.
description.fil: Bring Curenen's ring to Clackcable of the Pepoview Troupe in Saint City.
description.fr: Apporter l'Anneau de Kerenen à Clagabole de la troupe Pepole, à Saincity.
description.id: Bawa cincin Curenen ke Clackcable of the Pepoview Troupe di Saint City.
description.it: Bring Curenen's ring to Clackcable of the Pepoview Troupe in Saint City.
description.jp: リングを持って、セイントモーニングの劇団＜双月の夜＞の団員＜クロックエイブル＞の所に行こう。
description.kr: 커에넨의 반지를 세인트 시티 포페퓨 극단 근처에 있는 클락케블에게 전해 주세요.
description.nl: Bring Curenen's ring to Clackcable of the Pepoview Troupe in Saint City.
description.pl: Bring Curenen's ring to Clackcable of the Pepoview Troupe in Saint City.
description.ru: Нужно отнести кольцо Кима Джерри руководителю труппы "Погорелый театр" в Санто.
description.sp: Lleva el Anillo de Curenen a Clackcable de la Compañía Pepoview en Saint.
description.sw: Bring Curenen's ring to Clackcable of the Pepoview Troupe in Saint City.
description.th: นำแหวนของ Curenen ไปที่ Clackcable ของคณะ Pepoview ใน Saint City
description.tw: 拿著戒指去聖音特找，帕佩團的克拉凱步吧！
description.vi: Mang chiếc nhẫn của Curenen đến Clackcable of Pepoview Troupe ở Saint City.

dialogsBegin.en: My sincerest gratitude once again for finding the ring. However, now I'll need you to take it to Saint City.
dialogsBegin.ar: My sincerest gratitude once again for finding the ring. However, now I'll need you to take it to Saint City.
dialogsBegin.br: Obrigado novamente pelo anel. E há alguém que você deve conhecer.
dialogsBegin.cns: 真的很谢谢你帮我找回戒指...对了！你可能还要去找一个人。
dialogsBegin.de: Nochmals meine Hochachtung, dass du diesen Ring gefunden hast. Allerdings müsste ich dich bitten, ihn nach Saint Morning zu bringen.
dialogsBegin.fi: My sincerest gratitude once again for finding the ring. However, now I'll need you to take it to Saint City.
dialogsBegin.fil: My sincerest gratitude once again for finding the ring. However, now I'll need you to take it to Saint City.
dialogsBegin.fr: Maintenant je dois rendre cet anneau à son propriétaire. Son premier propriétaire était Kereren bien sûr, mais désormais une personne s'occupe des reliques du Héros des Jesters.
dialogsBegin.id: Terima kasihku yang tulus sekali lagi karena telah menemukan cincin itu. Namun, sekarang aku membutuhkanmu untuk membawanya ke Saint City.
dialogsBegin.it: My sincerest gratitude once again for finding the ring. However, now I'll need you to take it to Saint City.
dialogsBegin.jp: リングを見つけてくれたこと、感謝するぞ。ところで、君に会ってほしい人がいるのだよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 반지를 찾아주셔서 다시 한번 진심으로 감사드려요. 그런데, 이 반지를 세인트 시티로 가져가 주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: My sincerest gratitude once again for finding the ring. However, now I'll need you to take it to Saint City.
dialogsBegin.pl: My sincerest gratitude once again for finding the ring. However, now I'll need you to take it to Saint City.
dialogsBegin.ru: Огромное тебе спасибо за кольцо. И все же мне придется расстаться с ним.
dialogsBegin.sp: Mi más sincera gratitud una vez más por encontrar el anillo. Sin embargo, ahora necesitaré que lo lleves a Saint.
dialogsBegin.sw: My sincerest gratitude once again for finding the ring. However, now I'll need you to take it to Saint City.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันต้องขอบคุณอย่างสูงอีกครั้งสำหรับการหาแหวน แต่ตอนนี้ฉันต้องการให้คุณนำมันไปที่ Saint City
dialogsBegin.tw: 真的很謝謝你幫我找回戒指…對了！你可能還要去找一個人。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi thật lòng biết ơn một lần nữa vì đã tìm thấy chiếc nhẫn. Tuy nhiên, bây giờ tôi cần bạn đưa nó đến Saint City.

dialogsBegin.en: Visit the Pepoview Troupe near the town square and speak with Clackcable. Present him with the ring and he will guide you from there. He may even give you something in return.
dialogsBegin.ar: Visit the Pepoview Troupe near the town square and speak with Clackcable. Present him with the ring and he will guide you from there. He may even give you something in return.
dialogsBegin.br: Vá encontrar até a tropa Pepoview em Saint. Encontre um membro cujo nome é Clackcable entregue este anel. Você irá ganhar algo muito útil.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你拿着这个戒指去晨光找<帕佩团>的克拉凯步吧！他一定会跟你说很多事情！
dialogsBegin.de: Besuche die Tantalus Theatergruppe im Zentrum der Stadt Saint Morning und sprich mit Clackcable. Gib ihm den Ring und er wird dir sagen, was zu tun ist. Vielleicht hat er sogar eine Belohnung für dich.
dialogsBegin.fi: Visit the Pepoview Troupe near the town square and speak with Clackcable. Present him with the ring and he will guide you from there. He may even give you something in return.
dialogsBegin.fil: Visit the Pepoview Troupe near the town square and speak with Clackcable. Present him with the ring and he will guide you from there. He may even give you something in return.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il te faut maintenant lui rapporter cette boucle d'oreille. Son nom est Clagabole, il fait partie de la troupe Pepole de Saincity.
dialogsBegin.id: Kunjungi Pepoview Troupe di dekat alun-alun kota dan berbicara dengan Clackcable. Hadiahi dia dengan cincin dan dia akan menuntunmu dari sana. Dia bahkan mungkin memberimu sesuatu sebagai balasannya.
dialogsBegin.it: Visit the Pepoview Troupe near the town square and speak with Clackcable. Present him with the ring and he will guide you from there. He may even give you something in return.
dialogsBegin.jp: このリングを持って、セイントモーニングの＜双月の夜＞劇団に訪れ、劇団員の中、＜クロックエイブル＞という人に会うといい。そうすればこれからの君にとって役に立つ物が、彼からもらえるよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 마을 광장 근처의 페포뷰 극단을 찾아서, 극단원 클락케블과 대화하세요. 반지를 보여 드리면 그다음 뭘 해야할지 알려줄 거예요. 아마 보답도 줄 거고요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Visit the Pepoview Troupe near the town square and speak with Clackcable. Present him with the ring and he will guide you from there. He may even give you something in return.
dialogsBegin.pl: Visit the Pepoview Troupe near the town square and speak with Clackcable. Present him with the ring and he will guide you from there. He may even give you something in return.
dialogsBegin.ru: Отправляйся в Санто. Найди труппу "Погорелый театр" у городской площади и поговори с Тренбреном. Отдай ему кольцо, и он согласится тебя учить. А может, даже и наградит. Договорились?
dialogsBegin.sp: Visita a la Compañía Pepoview cerca de la plaza y habla con Clackcable. Entrégale el anillo y él te guiara desde allí. Puede que incluso te de algo como recompensa.
dialogsBegin.sw: Visit the Pepoview Troupe near the town square and speak with Clackcable. Present him with the ring and he will guide you from there. He may even give you something in return.
dialogsBegin.th: ไปยัง Pepoview Troupe ใกล้กับจัตุรัสกลางเมือง และพูดคุยกับ Clackcable โชว์แหวนแก่เขา แล้วเขาจะนำทางคุณจากที่นั่น เขาอาจจะให้สิ่งตอบแทนแก่คุณ
dialogsBegin.tw: 你拿著這個戒指去聖音特找帕佩團的克拉凱步吧！他一定會跟你說很多事情！
dialogsBegin.vi: Ghé thăm Pepoview Troupe gần quảng trường thị trấn và nói chuyện với Clackcable. Đưa cho anh ấy chiếc nhẫn và anh ấy sẽ hướng dẫn bạn từ đó. Anh ấy thậm chí có thể cho bạn một cái gì đó để đáp lại.

dialogsAccept.en: You possess great potential, young Acrobat. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsAccept.ar: You possess great potential, young Acrobat. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsAccept.br: Você pode realizar seu sonho se assim desejar profundamente. Portanto, você se tornará um Jester se realmente quiser.
dialogsAccept.cns: 做得好弓箭手，再加把劲。
dialogsAccept.de: In dir steckt viel Potenzial, junger Acrobat. Arbeite weiter hart an dir und deine Träume werden in Erfüllung gehen.
dialogsAccept.fi: You possess great potential, young Acrobat. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsAccept.fil: You possess great potential, young Acrobat. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsAccept.fr: Tu peux faire que tes rêves se réalisent si tu y mets toute ta volonté. Alors seulement deviendras-tu Ranger.
dialogsAccept.id: Kamu memiliki potensi besar, Acrobat muda. Teruslah bekerja keras dan kamu akan mewujudkan impianmu.
dialogsAccept.it: You possess great potential, young Acrobat. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsAccept.jp: 若きアクロバットよ、心からの願いは、必ず叶う。君が心から願い努力を続ければ、きっと良い結果へと導かれるだろう。
dialogsAccept.kr: 당신은 정말 대단한 가능성이 있어요, 젊은 아크로뱃님. 계속 노력한다면 분명 꿈을 이룰 수 있어요.
dialogsAccept.nl: You possess great potential, young Acrobat. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsAccept.pl: You possess great potential, young Acrobat. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsAccept.ru: You possess great potential, young Acrobat. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsAccept.sp: Posees un gran potencial, joven Acrobat. Sigue trabajando duro y cumplirás tu sueño.
dialogsAccept.sw: You possess great potential, young Acrobat. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsAccept.th: Acrobat หนุ่มคุณมีศักยภาพที่ดี ทำงานอย่างหนักต่อไป และคุณจะรู้สึกถึงสิ่งที่คุณได้ฝันไว้
dialogsAccept.tw: 你很有潛力，年輕的雜技師。繼續努力，你會實現你的夢想。
dialogsAccept.vi: Bạn có tiềm năng lớn, Acrobat trẻ à. Hãy tiếp tục làm việc chăm chỉ và bạn sẽ thực hiện được ước mơ của mình.

dialogsDecline.en: Foolish Acrobat! Don't you realize your potential? See me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ar: Foolish Acrobat! Don't you realize your potential? See me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.br: Você está brincando comigo? Não entendo. Hmm.. Fale comigo novamente se mudar de ideia.
dialogsDecline.cns: 愚蠢的弓箭手！你还没意识到你的潜力吗？如果你改变了你的想法，请再次来见我。
dialogsDecline.de: Törichter Acrobat! Erkennst du dein eigenes Potenzial nicht? Komm wieder, wenn du deine Meinung änderst.
dialogsDecline.fi: Foolish Acrobat! Don't you realize your potential? See me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fil: Foolish Acrobat! Don't you realize your potential? See me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fr: Rapporter cette boucle d'oreille à Clagabole est vraiment important... Ce n'est pas très loin d'ici, va lui remettre s'il te plaît.
dialogsDecline.id: Acrobat bodoh! Apakah kamu tidak menyadari potensimu? Temui aku lagi jika kamu berubah pikiran.
dialogsDecline.it: Foolish Acrobat! Don't you realize your potential? See me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.jp: 何？　私をからかっているのか？　それともたかがセイントモーニングまで行くのが面倒なのか？　最近の若者の考えることはわからん・・
dialogsDecline.kr: 어리석은 아크로뱃이군요! 왜 자신의 잠재력을 모르시는 거죠? 마음이 바뀌면 다시 찾아오세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Foolish Acrobat! Don't you realize your potential? See me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.pl: Foolish Acrobat! Don't you realize your potential? See me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ru: Эх, ты! Неужели ты не видишь своего предназначения?! Если передумаешь, непременно меня найди.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Tonto Acrobat! ¿No te das cuenta de tu potencial? Vuelve a verme si cambias de opinión.
dialogsDecline.sw: Foolish Acrobat! Don't you realize your potential? See me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.th: เจ้า Acrobat โง่! คุณไม่ตระหนักถึงศักยภาพของคุณเลยงั้นหรือ? โปรดมาพบฉันอีกครั้งถ้าคุณเปลี่ยนใจ
dialogsDecline.tw: 愚蠢的雜技師！你沒有意識到你的潛力嗎？如果你改變主意再來找我。
dialogsDecline.vi: Acrobat ngu ngốc! Bạn không nhận ra tiềm năng của mình? Hãy gặp lại tôi nếu bạn thay đổi quyết định.

dialogsComplete.en: Thank you so much for finding the ring! We are performing the ancestral ceremony of Curenen. This ring will complete the ritual.
dialogsComplete.ar: Thank you so much for finding the ring! We are performing the ancestral ceremony of Curenen. This ring will complete the ritual.
dialogsComplete.br: Oh... Muito obrigado por encontrar este anel! Nós estamos realizando a cerimônia ancestral de Kerenen. Mas nós perdemos este anel há alguns anos.
dialogsComplete.cns: 啊...真的很感谢你啊～这个戒指是<凯奈>的遗物，我们家里祭拜着<凯奈>的灵骨呢...
dialogsComplete.de: Vielen Dank für den Ring! Wir führen das Ahnenzeremonie von Kurenen auf. Dieser Ring war das letzte fehlende Stück.
dialogsComplete.fi: Thank you so much for finding the ring! We are performing the ancestral ceremony of Curenen. This ring will complete the ritual.
dialogsComplete.fil: Thank you so much for finding the ring! We are performing the ancestral ceremony of Curenen. This ring will complete the ritual.
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh... C'est... Merci infiniment ! Je le cherchais depuis des années.
dialogsComplete.id: Terima kasih banyak telah menemukan cincinnya! Kami sedang melakukan upacara leluhur Curenen. Cincin ini akan melengkapi ritualnya.
dialogsComplete.it: Thank you so much for finding the ring! We are performing the ancestral ceremony of Curenen. This ring will complete the ritual.
dialogsComplete.jp: ああ・・・、ありがとうございます！　このリングを見つけて下さったのですね。私の家は代々＜カエネン＞様の魂に仕える身なのですが、何年か前にこのリングが盗まれてしまい、必死で探したのですが、取り戻せずにいたのです。
dialogsComplete.kr: 반지를 찾아주셔서 정말 감사합니다! 저희는 커에넨님을 추모하는 의식을 하고 있어요. 이 반지가 의식을 완성하는 마지막 열쇠가 될 수 있겠네요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Thank you so much for finding the ring! We are performing the ancestral ceremony of Curenen. This ring will complete the ritual.
dialogsComplete.pl: Thank you so much for finding the ring! We are performing the ancestral ceremony of Curenen. This ring will complete the ritual.
dialogsComplete.ru: Большое спасибо! Мы ставим пьесу о жизни Кима. С настоящим кольцом она будет куда достовернее!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Muchas gracias por encontrar el anillo! Estamos haciendo la ceremonia ancestral de Curenen. Este anillo completará el ritual.
dialogsComplete.sw: Thank you so much for finding the ring! We are performing the ancestral ceremony of Curenen. This ring will complete the ritual.
dialogsComplete.th: ขอบคุณมากสำหรับการหาแหวน! เรากำลังดำเนินพิธีบรรพบุรุษของ Curenen แหวนนี้จะทำให้พิธีเสร็จสมบูรณ์
dialogsComplete.tw: 啊…真的很感謝你啊～這個戒指是凱奈的遺物，我們家裡祭拜著凱奈的靈骨呢…
dialogsComplete.vi: Cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều vì đã tìm thấy chiếc nhẫn! Chúng tôi đang thực hiện nghi lễ tổ tiên của Curenen. Chiếc nhẫn này sẽ hoàn tất nghi lễ.

dialogsComplete.en: Here, you certainly deserve this. It is the Successor Scroll of the Jester Hero.
dialogsComplete.ar: Here, you certainly deserve this. It is the Successor Scroll of the Jester Hero.
dialogsComplete.br: Mas você me trouxe o anel. Parece que você merece ser o sucessor! Eu lhe darei o pergaminho.
dialogsComplete.cns: 终于回来找我了啊...你一定有资格作暗杀的...我给你一个卷轴。
dialogsComplete.de: Hier, das hast du dir verdient. Es ist die Schriftrolle vom Nachfolger des Jester Helden.
dialogsComplete.fi: Here, you certainly deserve this. It is the Successor Scroll of the Jester Hero.
dialogsComplete.fil: Here, you certainly deserve this. It is the Successor Scroll of the Jester Hero.
dialogsComplete.fr: J'apprécie énormément ce que tu as fait ! Ceci est le Parchemin que seuls les descendants de ma famille peuvent avoir. Il t'appartient désormais.
dialogsComplete.id: Di sini, kamu tentu pantas mendapatkan ini. Ini adalah Successor Scroll of the Jester Hero.
dialogsComplete.it: Here, you certainly deserve this. It is the Successor Scroll of the Jester Hero.
dialogsComplete.jp: それを見つけてくださるとは、いくら感謝しても足りないくらいです。あなたは後継者の資格の持っているようですね。私から巻物を1つ差し上げましょう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 당신은 이걸 받을 자격이 있어요. 제스터 영웅의 후계자 두루마리랍니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Here, you certainly deserve this. It is the Successor Scroll of the Jester Hero.
dialogsComplete.pl: Here, you certainly deserve this. It is the Successor Scroll of the Jester Hero.
dialogsComplete.ru: Вот, возьми. Это свиток наследия героя-шута.
dialogsComplete.sp: Toma, sin duda mereces esto. Es el Pergamino de Sucesor del Héroe Jester.
dialogsComplete.sw: Here, you certainly deserve this. It is the Successor Scroll of the Jester Hero.
dialogsComplete.th: อ่ะนี่ คุณสมควรได้รับสิ่งนี้อย่างยิ่ง มันคือ Successor Scroll ของ Jester Hero
dialogsComplete.tw: 終於回來找我了啊…你一定有資格作操偶師的…我給你一個卷軸。
dialogsComplete.vi: Ở đây, bạn chắc chắn xứng đáng nhận được điều này. Là Scroll kế vị của anh hùng Jester.

dialogsFail.en: If you spoke with Radyon, didn't he ask you to bring me something? I'm sorry, I'm very busy and we don't have much more to discuss, I'm afraid.
dialogsFail.ar: If you spoke with Radyon, didn't he ask you to bring me something? I'm sorry, I'm very busy and we don't have much more to discuss, I'm afraid.
dialogsFail.br: Se você falou com Radyon, ele não pediu para você me trazer algo? Desculpe, estou muito ocupado e não temos muito mais o que discutir, receio.
dialogsFail.cns: 是[拉迪温]请你过来找我的吗？应该有东西要给我吧？抱歉，我很忙，恐怕我们没有过多的讨论时间。
dialogsFail.de: Du hast doch mit Radion gesprochen, oder? Solltst du mir nicht etwas von ihm bringen? Tut mir leid, ich bin gerade zu beschäftigt, um zu reden.
dialogsFail.fi: If you spoke with Radyon, didn't he ask you to bring me something? I'm sorry, I'm very busy and we don't have much more to discuss, I'm afraid.
dialogsFail.fil: If you spoke with Radyon, didn't he ask you to bring me something? I'm sorry, I'm very busy and we don't have much more to discuss, I'm afraid.
dialogsFail.fr: Radyan ne t'as pas confié quelque chose pour moi ?!
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu berbicara dengan Radyon, bukankah dia memintamu untuk membawakanku sesuatu? Maaf, saya sangat sibuk dan tidak banyak yang bisa kita diskusikan, sepertinya.
dialogsFail.it: If you spoke with Radyon, didn't he ask you to bring me something? I'm sorry, I'm very busy and we don't have much more to discuss, I'm afraid.
dialogsFail.jp: ＜ラディオン＞様から何か聞きませんでしたか？
dialogsFail.kr: 라디온과 이야기할 때, 혹시 저한테 무언가 전해주라고 하지 않던가요? 죄송합니다. 지금은 바빠서 이야기를 나눌 시간이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you spoke with Radyon, didn't he ask you to bring me something? I'm sorry, I'm very busy and we don't have much more to discuss, I'm afraid.
dialogsFail.pl: If you spoke with Radyon, didn't he ask you to bring me something? I'm sorry, I'm very busy and we don't have much more to discuss, I'm afraid.
dialogsFail.ru: If you spoke with Radyon, didn't he ask you to bring me something? I'm sorry, I'm very busy and we don't have much more to discuss, I'm afraid.
dialogsFail.sp: Si has hablado con Radyon, ¿no te pidió que me trajeras algo? Lo siento, estoy muy ocupado y no tenemos mucho más de lo que discutir.
dialogsFail.sw: If you spoke with Radyon, didn't he ask you to bring me something? I'm sorry, I'm very busy and we don't have much more to discuss, I'm afraid.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณได้พูดคุยกับ Radyon เขาได้ขอให้คุณนำบางสิ่งมาให้ฉันไหม? ขอโทษนะ ฉันยุ่งมาก และเราไม่มีเรื่องที่จะคุยกันมากนัก
dialogsFail.tw: 既然你和拉迪溫談過，他沒有要你帶什麼東西給我嗎？抱歉，我很忙，恐怕我們沒什麼好談的了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn nói chuyện với Radyon, anh ta không yêu cầu bạn mang cho tôi một cái gì đó sao? Tôi xin lỗi, tôi rất bận và tôi e rằng chúng ta không có nhiều thứ để thảo luận.

name.jp: 放浪者マスター（マジシャン）

description.en: Slay 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs then return to Wingyei, the Magician Drillmaster in Flarine.
description.ar: Slay 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs then return to Wingyei, the Magician Drillmaster in Flarine.
description.br: Cace 15 Aibatts Capitães e 10 Burudengs Pequenos e então reporte para Wingyei, a Maga Militar em Flarine.
description.cns: 杀死15只大独眼蝠和10只小象牙甲虫，然后回到帕里镇魔导教官那里。
description.de: Jage 15 Captain Aibatt und 10 Small Burudengs und kehre zum Ausbilder Wingyei zurück.
description.fi: Slay 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs then return to Wingyei, the Magician Drillmaster in Flarine.
description.fil: Slay 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs then return to Wingyei, the Magician Drillmaster in Flarine.
description.fr: Tuer 15 Capitaines Aibatts et 10 Jeunes Burudeng puis retourner voir Winyei à Flarine Est pour passer le premier test de la voie du Magicien.
description.id: Bunuh 15 Captain Aibatts dan 10 Small Burudengs lalu kembali ke Wingyei, Magician Drillmaster di Flarine.
description.it: Slay 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs then return to Wingyei, the Magician Drillmaster in Flarine.
description.jp: キャプテン アイバットを 15 体とスモール ブルデンを 10 体倒してから、フラリンのマジシャン ドリルマスターであるウィンゲイに戻ります。
description.kr: 두목 아이바트 15마리와 작은 부루뎅 10마리를 처치한 후, 플라리네의 매지션 드릴마스터 윙예이에게 돌아가세요.
description.nl: Slay 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs then return to Wingyei, the Magician Drillmaster in Flarine.
description.pl: Slay 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs then return to Wingyei, the Magician Drillmaster in Flarine.
description.ru: Slay 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs then return to Wingyei, the Magician Drillmaster in Flarine.
description.sp: Derrota a 15 Aibatts Capitanes y a 10 Burudengs Pequeños, después habla con Wingyei, la Instructora Maga en Flarine.
description.sw: Slay 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs then return to Wingyei, the Magician Drillmaster in Flarine.
description.th: สังหาร Captain Aibatts 15 ตัวและ Small Burudengs 10 ตัว จากนั้นกลับไปที่ Wingyei ปรมาจารย์ Magician Drillmasterใน Flarine
description.tw: 殺死 15 隻獨眼蝙蝠頭目和 10 隻小藍甲蟲，然後返回布拉里斯 的魔法使訓練教官偉依。
description.vi: Giết 15 Captain Aibatts và 10 Small Burudengs sau đó quay trở lại Wingyei, Magician Drillmaster in Flarine.

dialogsBegin.en: Are you intrigued by the art of magic? If you're speaking with me, you must be interested in becoming a Magician. I must warn you, it is not an easy road.
dialogsBegin.ar: Are you intrigued by the art of magic? If you're speaking with me, you must be interested in becoming a Magician. I must warn you, it is not an easy road.
dialogsBegin.br: Você está intrigado com a arte da magia? Se você está falando comigo, você deve estar interessado(a) em se tornar um Mago. Devo avisar, não é um caminho fácil.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你是否被魔法技能引起了深深的着迷？你现在在和我对话，想必你已经是对成为一名魔导士非常感兴趣了。但是我得提前告诉你，这绝不是一条轻松的道路。
dialogsBegin.de: Bist du von der Kunst der Magie fasziniert? Wenn du mit mir sprichst, musst du daran interessiert sein, ein Magier zu werden. Ich muss dich warnen, es ist kein leichter Weg.
dialogsBegin.fi: Are you intrigued by the art of magic? If you're speaking with me, you must be interested in becoming a Magician. I must warn you, it is not an easy road.
dialogsBegin.fil: Are you intrigued by the art of magic? If you're speaking with me, you must be interested in becoming a Magician. I must warn you, it is not an easy road.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu souhaites devenir Magicien ? Parfait, j'espère que cela s'avérera être un choix judicieux pour toi.
dialogsBegin.id: Apakah kamu tertarik dengan seni magis? Jika kamu berbicara dengan saya, kamu pasti tertarik untuk menjadi seorang Magician. Aku harus memperingatkanmu, itu bukan jalan yang mudah.
dialogsBegin.it: Are you intrigued by the art of magic? If you're speaking with me, you must be interested in becoming a Magician. I must warn you, it is not an easy road.
dialogsBegin.jp: マジシャンへの道を選んだのですね。マジシャンになるには厳しい試練が待ち受けておりますが、それでもこの職を目指すのであれば簡単なテストを行いたいと思います。心の準備は出来ていますか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 마법의 예술에 관심이 있으신가요? 제게 말을 거시는 걸 보니, 매지션이 되고 싶으신 거겠죠. 하지만 경고할게요. 이 길은 절대 쉽지 않답니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Are you intrigued by the art of magic? If you're speaking with me, you must be interested in becoming a Magician. I must warn you, it is not an easy road.
dialogsBegin.pl: Are you intrigued by the art of magic? If you're speaking with me, you must be interested in becoming a Magician. I must warn you, it is not an easy road.
dialogsBegin.ru: Все любят фокусы, но одно дело - смотреть на них, и совсем другое - исполнять. Хочешь стать настоящим фокусником? Учти, наша профессия только с виду легкая.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Te intriga el arte de la magia? Si estás hablando conmigo, debes estar interesado en convertirte en Magician. Debo advertirte que no es un camino fácil.
dialogsBegin.sw: Are you intrigued by the art of magic? If you're speaking with me, you must be interested in becoming a Magician. I must warn you, it is not an easy road.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณรู้สึกทึ่งกับศิลปะแห่งเวทมนตร์หรือไม่? ถ้าคุณกำลังพูดกับฉัน คุณต้องสนใจที่จะเป็น Magician ฉันต้องเตือนคุณว่ามันไม่ใช่เส้นทางที่ง่าย
dialogsBegin.tw: 你對魔法感興趣嗎？如果你在和我說話，你一定對成為魔法使很感興趣。我必須警告你，這不是一條容易的路。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có bị hấp dẫn bởi ma thuật không? Nếu bạn đang nói chuyện với tôi, bạn phải quan tâm đến việc trở thành một Magician. Tôi phải cảnh báo bạn, đó không phải là một con đường dễ dàng.

dialogsBegin.en: Very well then, first, I would like you to perform a small task for me. Captain Aibatts have infested the area north of Eastern Flarine.
dialogsBegin.ar: Very well then, first, I would like you to perform a small task for me. Captain Aibatts have infested the area north of Eastern Flarine.
dialogsBegin.br: Testarei sua rapidez e precisão ao realizá-lo, com base em sua experiência como Vagrant.
dialogsBegin.cns: 现在开始要进行考验了，这个训练主要是，看你在初心者的时候，有没有努力的练功，也要见识一下你的速度。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich möchte sehen, wie schnell und präzise du deine Aufgaben mit deiner Erfahrung als Vagrant erfüllst.
dialogsBegin.fi: Very well then, first, I would like you to perform a small task for me. Captain Aibatts have infested the area north of Eastern Flarine.
dialogsBegin.fil: Very well then, first, I would like you to perform a small task for me. Captain Aibatts have infested the area north of Eastern Flarine.
dialogsBegin.fr: Pour commencer, j'aimerais évaluer ta précision et ta vitesse d'exécution. J'espère que tu as acquis une expérience suffisante en tant que Vagabond.
dialogsBegin.id: Baiklah, pertama, aku ingin kamu melakukan tugas kecil. Captain Aibatts telah menduduki daerah utara Flarine Timur.
dialogsBegin.it: Very well then, first, I would like you to perform a small task for me. Captain Aibatts have infested the area north of Eastern Flarine.
dialogsBegin.jp: 最初のテストは、あなたが放浪者としてどのくらい熟練したかを評価するテストです。わたしが指示したことをどれくらい早く、正確に遂行するかを試させてもらいます。
dialogsBegin.kr: 좋아요, 그럼 먼저 간단한 임무부터 시작하죠. 플라리네 동북부에 두목 아이바트들이 들끓고 있습니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Very well then, first, I would like you to perform a small task for me. Captain Aibatts have infested the area north of Eastern Flarine.
dialogsBegin.pl: Very well then, first, I would like you to perform a small task for me. Captain Aibatts have infested the area north of Eastern Flarine.
dialogsBegin.ru: Хорошо. Посмотрим, насколько сильна твоя решимость. Немного севернее восточной Фларинции появились сильные сглазы.
dialogsBegin.sp: Muy bien entonces, primero, me gustaría que realizaras una pequeña tarea para mí. Los Aibatts Capitanes han infestado el área al norte de Flarine Este.
dialogsBegin.sw: Very well then, first, I would like you to perform a small task for me. Captain Aibatts have infested the area north of Eastern Flarine.
dialogsBegin.th: ถ้าอย่างนั้น อย่างแรก ฉันต้องการให้คุณทำงานเล็กๆ น้อยๆ ให้ฉัน Captain Aibatts ได้เข้ารุกรานพื้นที่ทางเหนือของ Eastern Flarine
dialogsBegin.tw: 現在開始要進行考驗了，這個訓練主要是，看你在見習生的時候，有沒有努力的練功，也要見識一下你的速度。
dialogsBegin.vi: Vậy thì rất tốt, trước tiên, tôi muốn bạn thực hiện một nhiệm vụ nhỏ. Captain Aibatts đã xâm nhập khu vực phía bắc Eastern Flarine.

dialogsBegin.en: If you're interested in helping, this little nuisance is just north of there. Will you slay 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs to help us?
dialogsBegin.ar: If you're interested in helping, this little nuisance is just north of there. Will you slay 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs to help us?
dialogsBegin.br: Se você estiver interessado em ajudar, esse pequeno incômodo fica ao norte. Você matará 15 Aibatts Capitães e 10 Burudengs Pequenos para nos ajudar?
dialogsBegin.cns: If you're interested in helping, this little nuisance is just north of there. Will you slay 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs to help us?
dialogsBegin.de: Falls du helfen willst, dieses kleine Ärgernis befindet sich gleich nördlich von dort. Wirst du 15 Kapitän Aibatts und 10 kleine Burudengs töten, um uns zu helfen?
dialogsBegin.fi: If you're interested in helping, this little nuisance is just north of there. Will you slay 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs to help us?
dialogsBegin.fil: If you're interested in helping, this little nuisance is just north of there. Will you slay 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs to help us?
dialogsBegin.fr: Le test est donc très simple : je veux que tu tues 15 Capitaines Aibatts et 10 Jeunes Burudengs puis que tu reviennes me voir, ça ne devrait pas te faire peur j'espère ?
dialogsBegin.id: Jika kamu tertarik untuk membantu, gangguan kecil ini ada di utara sana. Maukah kamu membunuh 15 Captain Aibatts dan 10 Small Burudengs untuk membantu kami?
dialogsBegin.it: If you're interested in helping, this little nuisance is just north of there. Will you slay 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs to help us?
dialogsBegin.jp: 助けに興味があるなら、この小さな厄介者はそこのすぐ北にあります。キャプテン・アイバット15体とスモールブルデン10体を倒して助けてくれませんか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 혹시 도와줄 수 있다면, 북쪽에 작은 골칫거리가 있답니다. 두목 아이바트 15마리와 작은 부루뎅 10마리를 좀 처치해주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: If you're interested in helping, this little nuisance is just north of there. Will you slay 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs to help us?
dialogsBegin.pl: If you're interested in helping, this little nuisance is just north of there. Will you slay 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs to help us?
dialogsBegin.ru: If you're interested in helping, this little nuisance is just north of there. Will you slay 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs to help us?
dialogsBegin.sp: Si deseas ayudar, te teletransportaré a Flarine para que te ocupes de la situación. ¿Cazarás a 15 Aibatts Capitanes y a 10 Burudengs Pequeños para ayudarnos?
dialogsBegin.sw: If you're interested in helping, this little nuisance is just north of there. Will you slay 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs to help us?
dialogsBegin.th: หากคุณสนใจที่จะช่วยเหลือ สิ่งรบกวนเล็กน้อยนี้อยู่ทางเหนือของที่นั่น คุณจะต้องสังหาร Captain Aibatts 15 ตัวและ Small Burudengs10 ตัวเพื่อช่วยเราไหม
dialogsBegin.tw: 如果你有興趣幫忙，這個小麻煩就在北邊。你會殺死 15 名獨眼蝙蝠頭目和 10 隻小藍甲蟲來幫助我們嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Nếu bạn muốn giúp đỡ, tôi sẽ dịch chuyển bạn đến phía bắc để bạn có thể giải quyết rắc rối nhỏ này. Bạn sẽ giúp chúng tôi giết 15 Captain Aibatts và 10 Small Burudengs chứ?

dialogsAccept.en: Thank you! Good luck!
dialogsAccept.ar: شكرا! حظا موفقا!
dialogsAccept.br: Boa sorte!
dialogsAccept.cns: 我会看看你有多么厉害!
dialogsAccept.de: Viel Erfolg.
dialogsAccept.fi: Thank you! Good luck!
dialogsAccept.fil: Thank you! Good luck!
dialogsAccept.fr: Je te souhaite bonne chance !
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih! Semoga berhasil!
dialogsAccept.it: Thank you! Good luck!
dialogsAccept.jp: 深い知識に長け、思いのままに魔力を操るマジシャンを目指す者たちが、どれぐらい速やかに課題を成し遂げることができるか楽しみに待っていますよ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 고맙습니다! 행운을 빌어요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Thank you! Good luck!
dialogsAccept.pl: Thank you! Good luck!
dialogsAccept.ru: Отлично! Удачи тебе!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Gracias! ¡Buena Suerte!
dialogsAccept.sw: Thank you! Good luck!
dialogsAccept.th: ขอบคุณ! ขอให้โชคดี!
dialogsAccept.tw: 我會看看你有多麼厲害！
dialogsAccept.vi: Cảm ơn! Chúc may mắn!

dialogsDecline.en: I see you're not ready to walk the path of the Magician. Very well, speak to me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ar: I see you're not ready to walk the path of the Magician. Very well, speak to me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.br: Vejo que você não está pronto para trilhar os caminhos de um Mago. Tudo bem, fale comigo novamente se mudar de ideia.
dialogsDecline.cns: 你要放弃了吗?对啦!要杀那么多的生命，不如早点放弃吧!
dialogsDecline.de: Gibst du schon auf? Ich verstehe das. Das wird dir lieber sein als viele blutige Kämpfe.
dialogsDecline.fi: I see you're not ready to walk the path of the Magician. Very well, speak to me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fil: I see you're not ready to walk the path of the Magician. Very well, speak to me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fr: Quoi tu as abandonné ? C'est vrai qu'il est toujours plus facile de fuir devant les difficultés.
dialogsDecline.id: Aku melihat kamu belum siap untuk menjalani perjalanan sebagai Magician. Baiklah, bicaralah padaku lagi jika kamu berubah pikiran.
dialogsDecline.it: I see you're not ready to walk the path of the Magician. Very well, speak to me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.jp: おやおや、諦めてしまうのですか。マジシャンを目指すには厳しい試練が待ち受けていますから、それも致し方ないことでしょう。
dialogsDecline.kr: 지금은 매지션의 길을 걸을 준비가 안 된 것 같네요. 생각이 바뀌면 다시 오세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: I see you're not ready to walk the path of the Magician. Very well, speak to me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.pl: I see you're not ready to walk the path of the Magician. Very well, speak to me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ru: Настоящий фокусник не пасует перед трудностями. Если передумаешь, возвращайся.
dialogsDecline.sp: Veo que no estás preparado para recorrer el camino del Magician. Muy bien, háblame de nuevo si cambias de opinión.
dialogsDecline.sw: I see you're not ready to walk the path of the Magician. Very well, speak to me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันเห็นเธอไม่พร้อมที่จะเดินบนเส้นทางของ Magician เอาล่ะ กลับมาคุยกับฉันอีกครั้งถ้าคุณเปลี่ยนใจ
dialogsDecline.tw: 你要放棄了嗎？對啦！要殺那麼多的生命，不如早點放棄吧！
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi thấy bạn chưa sẵn sàng để bước đi trên con đường của Magician. Tốt lắm, hãy nói chuyện với tôi một lần nữa nếu bạn thay đổi quyết định.

dialogsComplete.en: Great job, young Vagrant! I think you'll make a fine Magician.
dialogsComplete.ar: Great job, young Vagrant! I think you'll make a fine Magician.
dialogsComplete.br: Bom trabalho, jovem Vagrant! Acredito que serás um(a) ótimo(a) Mago(a).
dialogsComplete.cns: 做得好，年轻的初心者！你会成为卓越的魔导士的
dialogsComplete.de: Gut gemacht, junger Vagrant! Ich glaube, du wirst ein guter Magier werden.
dialogsComplete.fi: Great job, young Vagrant! I think you'll make a fine Magician.
dialogsComplete.fil: Great job, young Vagrant! I think you'll make a fine Magician.
dialogsComplete.fr: Merci beaucoup, il était important de s'occuper de ce monstre. Voici la dernière leçon : elle est sur le rôle du Magicien, écoute-moi bien.
dialogsComplete.id: Kerja bagus, Vagrant muda! Aku pikir kamu akan menjadi Magician yang baik.
dialogsComplete.it: Great job, young Vagrant! I think you'll make a fine Magician.
dialogsComplete.jp: 無事にテストを終わらせることができましたね。この調子で次のテストも頑張ってください。
dialogsComplete.kr: 훌륭해요, 젊은 방랑자님! 훌륭한 매지션이 될 자질이 있군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Great job, young Vagrant! I think you'll make a fine Magician.
dialogsComplete.pl: Great job, young Vagrant! I think you'll make a fine Magician.
dialogsComplete.ru: Great job, young Vagrant! I think you'll make a fine Magician.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Excelente trabajo, joven Vagrant! Creo que serás un buen Magician.
dialogsComplete.sw: Great job, young Vagrant! I think you'll make a fine Magician.
dialogsComplete.th: ทำได้ดีมาก Vagrant! ฉันคิดว่าคุณจะเป็น Magician ที่ดีได้
dialogsComplete.tw: 做得好，年輕的見習生！我想你會成為一名優秀的魔法使。
dialogsComplete.vi: Làm tốt lắm, Vagrant trẻ! Tôi nghĩ bạn sẽ trở thành một Magician giỏi.

dialogsFail.en: You must defeat 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs to prove you are worthy of Magician training. I will not help you if you cannot even complete this simple task.
dialogsFail.ar: You must defeat 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs to prove you are worthy of Magician training. I will not help you if you cannot even complete this simple task.
dialogsFail.br: Você deve derrotar 15 Aibatts Capitães e 10 Burudengs Pequenos para provar que você merece o treinamento de Mago. Não vou ajudar se você não conseguir completar uma tarefa simples como essa. Se você falhar, não se preocupe. Estou certo de que aparecerá alguém melhor.
dialogsFail.cns: 击杀15只大独眼蝠和10只小象牙甲虫，如果无法完成这个简单的任务，我将不会帮助您。
dialogsFail.de: Wenn du jetzt aufgibst, brauchst du dich nicht schuldig fühlen, viele Leute getötet zu haben. Alles hängt von deiner Entscheidung ab.
dialogsFail.fi: You must defeat 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs to prove you are worthy of Magician training. I will not help you if you cannot even complete this simple task.
dialogsFail.fil: You must defeat 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs to prove you are worthy of Magician training. I will not help you if you cannot even complete this simple task.
dialogsFail.fr: Le temps t'est compté, il faut être plus rapide !
dialogsFail.id: Kamu harus mengalahkan 15 Captain Aibatts dan 10 Small Burudengs untuk membuktikan bahwa kamu layak untuk pelatihan Magician. Aku tidak akan membantumu jika bahkan kamu tidak dapat menyelesaikan tugas sederhana ini.
dialogsFail.it: You must defeat 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs to prove you are worthy of Magician training. I will not help you if you cannot even complete this simple task.
dialogsFail.jp: 課題を出されているあなたには、あまり時間がないはずですよ。キャプテン・アイバット15体、スモール・ブルデング10体を倒してください。このままマジシャンへの道を諦めてしまうのであれば、仕方ありませんが。
dialogsFail.kr: 매지션 수련을 받고 싶다면, 두목 아이바트 15마리와 작은 부루뎅 10마리를 쓰러뜨리세요. 그 정도도 못 한다면, 도와드릴 수 없습니다.
dialogsFail.nl: You must defeat 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs to prove you are worthy of Magician training. I will not help you if you cannot even complete this simple task.
dialogsFail.pl: You must defeat 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs to prove you are worthy of Magician training. I will not help you if you cannot even complete this simple task.
dialogsFail.ru: Хочешь стать фокусником - а не можешь выполнить такое простое задание! Нет, бродяга, пока ты не убьешь 15 сильных сглазов и 10 слабых жукорогов, я не возьмусь тебя учить.
dialogsFail.sp: Debes derrotar a 15 Aibatts Capitanes y a 10 Burudengs Pequeños para demostrar que eres digno de recibir el entrenamiento de Magician. No te ayudaré si ni siquiera eres capaz de completar esta simple tarea.
dialogsFail.sw: You must defeat 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs to prove you are worthy of Magician training. I will not help you if you cannot even complete this simple task.
dialogsFail.th: คุณต้องกำจัด Captain Aibatts 15 ตัวและ Small Burudengs 10 ตัว เพื่อพิสูจน์ว่าคุณคู่ควรกับการฝึก Magician ฉันจะไม่ช่วยคุณหากคุณไม่สามารถทำงานง่ายๆ นี้ได้
dialogsFail.tw: 你必須擊敗 15 隻獨眼蝙蝠頭目和 10 隻小藍甲蟲，證明你有資格接受魔法使訓練。如果你連這麼簡單的任務都無法完成，我就不會幫你。
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn phải đánh bại 15 Captain Aibatts và 10 Small Burudengs để chứng minh rằng bạn xứng đáng được huấn luyện thành Magician. Tôi sẽ không giúp bạn nếu bạn thậm chí không thể hoàn thành nhiệm vụ đơn giản này.
