dialogsBegin.en: Thank you. I can now rest assured knowing that the pendant will be returned to its rightful owner.
dialogsBegin.ar: Thank you. I can now rest assured knowing that the pendant will be returned to its rightful owner.
dialogsBegin.br: Obrigada. Agora posso ter certeza de que o pingente será devolvido ao seu legítimo proprietário.
dialogsBegin.cns: 谢谢你。现在我可以放心了，我就知道吊坠最终会回到它真正主人的手中。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich bin danke Dir. Ich kann jetzt beruhigt sein, denn ich weiß, dass du der Anhänger seinem rechtmäßigen Besitzer zurückgegeben wird.
dialogsBegin.fi: Thank you. I can now rest assured knowing that the pendant will be returned to its rightful owner.
dialogsBegin.fil: Thank you. I can now rest assured knowing that the pendant will be returned to its rightful owner.
dialogsBegin.fr: Pfiouuu, j'avais peur que le pendentif soit perdu pour de bon.
dialogsBegin.id: Terima kasih. Saya sekarang dapat yakin mengetahui bahwa liontin itu akan dikembalikan kepada pemiliknya yang sah.
dialogsBegin.it: Thank you. I can now rest assured knowing that the pendant will be returned to its rightful owner.
dialogsBegin.jp: 二度と見つからないかと思っていました……。シュリ様に顔向けができなくなってしまうところでした。
dialogsBegin.kr: 감사합니다. 팬던트가 본래 주인에게 돌아갔으니 이제 안심할 수 있겠어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Thank you. I can now rest assured knowing that the pendant will be returned to its rightful owner.
dialogsBegin.pl: Thank you. I can now rest assured knowing that the pendant will be returned to its rightful owner.
dialogsBegin.ru: Thank you. I can now rest assured knowing that the pendant will be returned to its rightful owner.
dialogsBegin.sp: Gracias. Ahora puedo estar tranquila sabiendo que el colgante se devolverá a su legítimo propietario.
dialogsBegin.sw: Thank you. I can now rest assured knowing that the pendant will be returned to its rightful owner.
dialogsBegin.th: ขอบคุณมาก ตอนนี้ฉันมั่นใจได้แล้วว่าจี้จะถูกส่งกลับไปยังเจ้าของเดิมอย่างถูกต้อง
dialogsBegin.tw: 幸好能夠找回墜飾。我還以為會永遠找不到，一直在擔心…
dialogsBegin.vi: Cảm ơn bạn. Bây giờ tôi có thể yên tâm khi biết rằng mặt dây chuyền sẽ được trả lại cho chủ sở hữu hợp pháp của nó.

dialogsBegin.en: Will you please take the pendant to Sury, I'm sure she is anxious to receive it.
dialogsBegin.ar: Will you please take the pendant to Sury, I'm sure she is anxious to receive it.
dialogsBegin.br: Por favor, leve o pingente para Sury, tenho certeza de que ela está ansiosa para recebê-lo.
dialogsBegin.cns: 请你将吊坠交给叙里，我相信她现在非常迫切想拿到它。
dialogsBegin.de: Würdest Du den Anhänger bitte zu Sury bringen, sie freut sich sicher sehr darauf.
dialogsBegin.fi: Will you please take the pendant to Sury, I'm sure she is anxious to receive it.
dialogsBegin.fil: Will you please take the pendant to Sury, I'm sure she is anxious to receive it.
dialogsBegin.fr: Soyez brave et apportez ce pendentif à Sury maintenant.
dialogsBegin.id: Maukah Anda membawa liontin itu ke Sury, saya yakin dia sangat ingin menerimanya.
dialogsBegin.it: Will you please take the pendant to Sury, I'm sure she is anxious to receive it.
dialogsBegin.jp: さあ、このペンダントをシュリ様にお渡し下さい。
dialogsBegin.kr: 슈리님께 펜던트를 전해 주시겠어요? 지금쯤 초조하게 기다리고 계실 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Will you please take the pendant to Sury, I'm sure she is anxious to receive it.
dialogsBegin.pl: Will you please take the pendant to Sury, I'm sure she is anxious to receive it.
dialogsBegin.ru: Will you please take the pendant to Sury, I'm sure she is anxious to receive it.
dialogsBegin.sp: Por favor, llévale el colgante a Sury, estoy segura de que está ansiosa por recibirlo.
dialogsBegin.sw: Will you please take the pendant to Sury, I'm sure she is anxious to receive it.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณช่วยเอาจี้ไปให้ Sury ที ฉันมั่นใจว่าเธอต้องการมัน
dialogsBegin.tw: 可以快一點把找回的墜飾拿去給修利大人嗎？他應該等的很焦急吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn vui lòng đưa mặt dây chuyền cho Sury được không, tôi chắc rằng cô ấy rất nóng lòng muốn nhận nó.

dialogsAccept.en: Hurry over to Sury, I'm sure she is anxious to receive the pendant.
dialogsAccept.ar: Hurry over to Sury, I'm sure she is anxious to receive the pendant.
dialogsAccept.br: Vá até Sury, tenho certeza que ela está ansiosa para receber o pingente.
dialogsAccept.cns: 快点去找叙里吧，她现在肯定非常着急要拿到吊坠。
dialogsAccept.de: Geh schnell zu Sury, ich bin sicher, sie freut sich schon auf den Anhänger.
dialogsAccept.fi: Hurry over to Sury, I'm sure she is anxious to receive the pendant.
dialogsAccept.fil: Hurry over to Sury, I'm sure she is anxious to receive the pendant.
dialogsAccept.fr: Ne la faites pas attendre !
dialogsAccept.id: Cepat ke Sury, aku yakin dia sangat ingin menerima liontin itu.
dialogsAccept.it: Hurry over to Sury, I'm sure she is anxious to receive the pendant.
dialogsAccept.jp: シュリ様はお待ちになられていると思います。本当にありがとうございました。
dialogsAccept.kr: 어서 슈리님께 가보세요. 그 펜던트를 빨리 받고 싶어 하실 겁니다.
dialogsAccept.nl: Hurry over to Sury, I'm sure she is anxious to receive the pendant.
dialogsAccept.pl: Hurry over to Sury, I'm sure she is anxious to receive the pendant.
dialogsAccept.ru: Hurry over to Sury, I'm sure she is anxious to receive the pendant.
dialogsAccept.sp: Date prisa con Sury, estoy segura de que está ansiosa por recibir el colgante.
dialogsAccept.sw: Hurry over to Sury, I'm sure she is anxious to receive the pendant.
dialogsAccept.th: รีบไปหา Sury ฉันมั่นใจว่าเขาต้องการจี้มาก
dialogsAccept.tw: 修利大人正在等待你，快一點把墜飾拿去給修利大人吧。
dialogsAccept.vi: Nhanh chân chạy đến Sury, chắc chắn cô ấy đang rất nóng lòng muốn nhận được mặt dây chuyền.

dialogsDecline.en: Please rethink your decision. This pendant is quite important to Sury.
dialogsDecline.ar: Please rethink your decision. This pendant is quite important to Sury.
dialogsDecline.br: Por favor, repense sua decisão. Este pingente é muito importante para Sury.
dialogsDecline.cns: 请重新考虑您的决定。这个吊坠对叙里来说非常重要。
dialogsDecline.de: Bitte überdenke deine Entscheidung noch einmal. Dieser Anhänger ist für Sury sehr wichtig.
dialogsDecline.fi: Please rethink your decision. This pendant is quite important to Sury.
dialogsDecline.fil: Please rethink your decision. This pendant is quite important to Sury.
dialogsDecline.fr: Pourquoi je ne le fais pas moi-même ? Mais je suis obligée de rester ici !!
dialogsDecline.id: Silakan pikirkan kembali keputusan Anda. Liontin ini cukup penting bagi Sury.
dialogsDecline.it: Please rethink your decision. This pendant is quite important to Sury.
dialogsDecline.jp: え、それはどういう意味ですか？このペンダントは、シュリ様にとってかなり重要なものです。
dialogsDecline.kr: 재고해 주세요. 슈리님께 아주 중요한 팬던트랍니다.
dialogsDecline.nl: Please rethink your decision. This pendant is quite important to Sury.
dialogsDecline.pl: Please rethink your decision. This pendant is quite important to Sury.
dialogsDecline.ru: Please rethink your decision. This pendant is quite important to Sury.
dialogsDecline.sp: Por favor, reconsidera tu decisión. Ese colgante es muy importante para Sury.
dialogsDecline.sw: Please rethink your decision. This pendant is quite important to Sury.
dialogsDecline.th: โปรดตัดสินใจให้ดีๆ นะ เพราะจี้นี้สำคัญมากกับ Sury
dialogsDecline.tw: 如果沒有墜飾，修利大人就無法證明自己是英雄了…
dialogsDecline.vi: Hãy suy nghĩ lại về quyết định của bạn. Mặt dây chuyền này khá quan trọng đối với Sury.

dialogsBegin.en: What? My mother told me to come and eat? Awww but I’m just getting started!
dialogsBegin.ar: What? My mother told me to come and eat? Awww but I’m just getting started!
dialogsBegin.br: Que? Minha mãe me disse para ir comer? Awww, mas estava apenas começando!
dialogsBegin.cns: 什么?我妈妈让我回去吃饭?啊啊啊啊,可是我才刚刚开始!
dialogsBegin.de: Wie bitte? Meine Mutter hat gesagt, ich soll zum Essen kommen? Aber ich fange doch gerade erst an!
dialogsBegin.fi: What? My mother told me to come and eat? Awww but I’m just getting started!
dialogsBegin.fil: What? My mother told me to come and eat? Awww but I’m just getting started!
dialogsBegin.fr: Je dois rentrer ? Mais je ne deviendrai jamais un Héros à ce rythme… Laissez-moi tuer encore un monstre.
dialogsBegin.id: Apa? Ibu menyuruhku pulang dan makan? Awww, padahal aku baru saja mulai!
dialogsBegin.it: What? My mother told me to come and eat? Awww but I’m just getting started!
dialogsBegin.jp: う～ん、お母さんがご飯だって？　ご飯なんて食べなくても英雄はへっちゃらなんだ。これからもう一匹鬼の子を倒してから帰ると伝えてよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 엥? 어머니가 밥 먹으러 오라고 하셨다고요? 에이, 이제 막 시작했는데!
dialogsBegin.nl: What? My mother told me to come and eat? Awww but I’m just getting started!
dialogsBegin.pl: What? My mother told me to come and eat? Awww but I’m just getting started!
dialogsBegin.ru: Что? Мама зовёт есть? Аааааа.... Ну я же только начал!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Qué? ¿Mi madre dice que vaya a comer? ¡Ayyy pero acabo de empezar!
dialogsBegin.sw: What? My mother told me to come and eat? Awww but I’m just getting started!
dialogsBegin.th: อะไร แม่บอกให้มากินข้าว? แต่ฉันเพิ่งเริ่มต้น!
dialogsBegin.tw: 什麼？我媽叫我回去吃飯？哇，但我才剛剛開始！
dialogsBegin.vi: Gì? Mẹ tôi bảo tôi đến ăn cơm? Awww nhưng tôi chỉ mới bắt đầu!

dialogsBegin.en: What? She's mad at me? If you show Mia's Shackles to her, I know she will be proud! Please take this to my mother.
dialogsBegin.ar: What? She's mad at me? If you show Mia's Shackles to her, I know she will be proud! Please take this to my mother.
dialogsBegin.br: Que? Ela está brava comigo? Se você mostrar o Grilhão de Mia para ela, sei que ela ficará orgulhosa! Por favor, leve isso para minha mãe.
dialogsBegin.cns: 什么?她对我非常生气?如果我将米娅的脚镣展示给她看,我相信她会为我骄傲的!请将这个带给我妈妈。
dialogsBegin.de: Was ist? Ist sie böse auf mich? Wenn du ihr Mias Fesseln zeigst, wird sie sicher stolz sein! Bitte bring das zu meiner Mutter.
dialogsBegin.fi: What? She's mad at me? If you show Mia's Shackles to her, I know she will be proud! Please take this to my mother.
dialogsBegin.fil: What? She's mad at me? If you show Mia's Shackles to her, I know she will be proud! Please take this to my mother.
dialogsBegin.fr: J'ai une idée on va dire que les Mia m'avaient enchainé et que c'est pour ça que je suis rentré tard.
dialogsBegin.id: Apa? Dia marah padaku? Kalau kau tunjukkan Mia's Shackles ini padanya, aku yakin dia akan bangga! Tolong bawa dan berikan ini ke ibuku.
dialogsBegin.it: What? She's mad at me? If you show Mia's Shackles to her, I know she will be proud! Please take this to my mother.
dialogsBegin.jp: お母さんが怒るって？　ううむ……。そうだ！　これを持っていきなよ。ミーアを倒した証拠があればきっと心配しないはずさ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 뭐라고요? 어머니께서 화가 났다고요? 미아의 족쇄를 보여 드리면 분명 자랑스러워하실 거예요! 이걸 어머니께 전해 주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: What? She's mad at me? If you show Mia's Shackles to her, I know she will be proud! Please take this to my mother.
dialogsBegin.pl: What? She's mad at me? If you show Mia's Shackles to her, I know she will be proud! Please take this to my mother.
dialogsBegin.ru: Что? Она злится? Надеюсь, если ты покажешь ей Кандалы Миа, она будет гордиться! Держи, отнеси ей!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Qué? ¿Está enfadada conmigo? Si le enseñas estos Grilletes de Mia, ¡sé que estará orgullosa! Por favor, llévaselos a mi madre.
dialogsBegin.sw: What? She's mad at me? If you show Mia's Shackles to her, I know she will be proud! Please take this to my mother.
dialogsBegin.th: อะไร เธอโกรธฉันเหรอ? ถ้าคุณเอากุญแจมือของ Mia ให้เธอดู ฉันรู้ว่าเธอจะต้องภูมิใจ! ได้โปรดเอาไปให้แม่ของฉัน
dialogsBegin.tw: 什麼？她生我的氣？如果你把米兒的腳鍊給她看，我知道她會很自豪的！請把這個給我媽媽。
dialogsBegin.vi: Gì? Cô ấy giận tôi? Nếu bạn cho cô ấy xem Chiếc còng của Mia, tôi biết cô ấy sẽ rất tự hào! Hãy đưa cái này cho mẹ tôi.

dialogsAccept.en: Awesome! Now I can get back to killing more monsters!
dialogsAccept.ar: Awesome! Now I can get back to killing more monsters!
dialogsAccept.br: Beleza! Agora posso voltar a caçar mais monstros!
dialogsAccept.cns: 太棒了!现在我可以回去继续杀死更多的怪物了!
dialogsAccept.de: Wahnsinn! Jetzt kann ich wieder mehr Monster töten!
dialogsAccept.fi: Awesome! Now I can get back to killing more monsters!
dialogsAccept.fil: Awesome! Now I can get back to killing more monsters!
dialogsAccept.fr: S'il vous plaît ramenez des entraves de Mia à ma mère.
dialogsAccept.id: Bagus! Sekarang aku bisa kembali menghabisi lebih banyak monster!
dialogsAccept.it: Awesome! Now I can get back to killing more monsters!
dialogsAccept.jp: さぁ、まだまだ僕は鬼の子を倒すぞ～！
dialogsAccept.kr: 좋았어! 이제 전 다시 몬스터 사냥하러 가야겠어요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Awesome! Now I can get back to killing more monsters!
dialogsAccept.pl: Awesome! Now I can get back to killing more monsters!
dialogsAccept.ru: Отлично! А я буду дальше сражаться с монстрами!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Genial! ¡Me voy a matar más monstruos!
dialogsAccept.sw: Awesome! Now I can get back to killing more monsters!
dialogsAccept.th: สุดยอด! ตอนนี้ฉันสามารถกลับไปฆ่ามอนสเตอร์ได้มากขึ้นแล้ว!
dialogsAccept.tw: 太厲害了！現在我可以回去殺更多的怪物了！
dialogsAccept.vi: Đáng kinh ngạc! Bây giờ tôi có thể quay lại để giết nhiều quái vật hơn!

dialogsDecline.en: It's ok, I understand that you are just jealous! Mwahaha!
dialogsDecline.ar: It's ok, I understand that you are just jealous! Mwahaha!
dialogsDecline.br: Tudo bem, eu entendo que você só está com inveja! Mwahaha!
dialogsDecline.cns: 没关系的,我知道你只是嫉妒我而已!哇哈哈哈!
dialogsDecline.de: Schon gut, ich verstehe, dass du nur neidisch bist! Mwahaha!
dialogsDecline.fi: It's ok, I understand that you are just jealous! Mwahaha!
dialogsDecline.fil: It's ok, I understand that you are just jealous! Mwahaha!
dialogsDecline.fr: allez, soyez gentil, je veux pas me faire gronder euh… *boude*
dialogsDecline.id: Tak apa, aku mengerti kalau kamu cemburu! Mwahaha!
dialogsDecline.it: It's ok, I understand that you are just jealous! Mwahaha!
dialogsDecline.jp: むむ、どうしても連れて帰ろうとするのかい？　ふふん、僕が英雄になったらと思って焦ってるんだろう。
dialogsDecline.kr: 괜찮아요, 질투 나는 거, 다 이해해요! 무하하하!
dialogsDecline.nl: It's ok, I understand that you are just jealous! Mwahaha!
dialogsDecline.pl: It's ok, I understand that you are just jealous! Mwahaha!
dialogsDecline.ru: It's ok, I understand that you are just jealous! Mwahaha!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Está bien, entiendo que estés celoso! ¡Muajaja!
dialogsDecline.sw: It's ok, I understand that you are just jealous! Mwahaha!
dialogsDecline.th: ไม่เป็นไร ฉันเข้าใจว่าคุณแค่อิจฉา! วะฮะฮ่า!
dialogsDecline.tw: 沒關係，我明白你只是嫉妒！哇哈哈！
dialogsDecline.vi: Không sao đâu, tôi hiểu rằng bạn chỉ đang ghen tị thôi! Mwahaha!

dialogsComplete.en: What's this? Some old shackle? What? Nerco told you that he isn't coming back?
dialogsComplete.ar: What's this? Some old shackle? What? Nerco told you that he isn't coming back?
dialogsComplete.br: O que é isso? Algum grilhão velho? O que?? Nerco disse que não vai voltar???
dialogsComplete.cns: What's this? Some old shackle? What? Nerco told you that he isn't coming back?
dialogsComplete.de: Was ist das? Ein alter Schäkel? Was ist das? Nerco hat dir gesagt, dass er nicht zurückkommen wird.
dialogsComplete.fi: What's this? Some old shackle? What? Nerco told you that he isn't coming back?
dialogsComplete.fil: What's this? Some old shackle? What? Nerco told you that he isn't coming back?
dialogsComplete.fr: *rigole* Il espérait vraiment me faire croire que les Mia l'avaient enchainé avec ça…
dialogsComplete.id: Apa ini? belenggu tua? Apa? Nerco bilang kalau dia tak mau pulang???
dialogsComplete.it: What's this? Some old shackle? What? Nerco told you that he isn't coming back?
dialogsComplete.jp: あら？　なんです、その鎖は……まあ、あの子ったらそんなことを……
dialogsComplete.kr: 이건 뭔가요? 낡은 족쇄? 네? 네르코가 돌아오지 않겠다고 말했다고요?
dialogsComplete.nl: What's this? Some old shackle? What? Nerco told you that he isn't coming back?
dialogsComplete.pl: What's this? Some old shackle? What? Nerco told you that he isn't coming back?
dialogsComplete.ru: What's this? Some old shackle? What? Nerco told you that he isn't coming back?
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿Qué es esto? ¿Unos grilletes viejos? ¿¿Qué?? ¿¿¿Nerco te ha dicho que no va a volver???
dialogsComplete.sw: What's this? Some old shackle? What? Nerco told you that he isn't coming back?
dialogsComplete.th: อะไรเนี่ย? กุญแจมือเก่า? อะไรนะ?? Nerco บอกคุณว่าเขาจะไม่กลับมา???
dialogsComplete.tw: 這是什麼？一副舊手銬？什麼？尼羅可跟你說他不回來了？
dialogsComplete.vi: Đây là gì? Xích cũ hay gì đấy? Sao cơ? Nerco nói với bạn rằng anh ấy sẽ không quay lại sao?

dialogsFail.en: Hurry up and take Mia's Shackles to my mother, so she can see how great I am!
dialogsFail.ar: Hurry up and take Mia's Shackles to my mother, so she can see how great I am!
dialogsFail.br: Rápido! Leve o Grilhão de Mia para minha mãe, para que ela possa ver o quão incrível eu sou!!
dialogsFail.cns: Hurry up and take Mia's Shackles to my mother, so she can see how great I am!
dialogsFail.de: Beeil dich und bring Mias Fesseln zu meiner Mutter, damit sie sieht, wie toll ich bin!!!
dialogsFail.fi: Hurry up and take Mia's Shackles to my mother, so she can see how great I am!
dialogsFail.fil: Hurry up and take Mia's Shackles to my mother, so she can see how great I am!
dialogsFail.fr: Montrez l'entrave de Mia à ma mère.
dialogsFail.id: Cepat sana dan bawa Mia's Shackles ini ke ibuku, aku yakin dia akan sangat bangga padaku!!
dialogsFail.it: Hurry up and take Mia's Shackles to my mother, so she can see how great I am!
dialogsFail.jp: 急いでミアのシャックルを母のところに持って行ってください。そうすれば、母は私も喜ぶはず！
dialogsFail.kr: 서두르세요. 저희 어머니를 만날 땐 미아의 족쇄도 가져가세요. 그걸 보면 제가 얼마나 대단한지 아시겠죠!
dialogsFail.nl: Hurry up and take Mia's Shackles to my mother, so she can see how great I am!
dialogsFail.pl: Hurry up and take Mia's Shackles to my mother, so she can see how great I am!
dialogsFail.ru: Hurry up and take Mia's Shackles to my mother, so she can see how great I am!
dialogsFail.sp: ¡¡Date prisa y llévale los Grilletes de Mia a mi madre, para que pueda ver lo genial que soy!!
dialogsFail.sw: Hurry up and take Mia's Shackles to my mother, so she can see how great I am!
dialogsFail.th: รีบพา Mia's Shackles ไปหาแม่ให้เร็วที่สุด แล้วจะได้เห็นดีกัน!!
dialogsFail.tw: 快把米雅的手銬拿去給我媽媽看，讓她知道我有多厲害！
dialogsFail.vi: Hãy nhanh tay mang Mia's Shackles về cho mẹ tôi nhé, để bà ấy có thể thấy tôi tuyệt vời như thế nào!

name.th: ผู้สืบทอดของวีรบุรุษ - แท่นบูชา
name.tw: 英雄的繼任者 - 祭壇

description.en: Bring the Stamped Scroll and the 8 lost History of Hero books to Rupim, the Ranger Priest in Aniceknight in Darkon 3.
description.ar: Bring the Stamped Scroll and the 8 lost History of Hero books to Rupim, the Ranger Priest in Aniceknight in Darkon 3.
description.br: Leve o Pergaminho com Selo e os 8 livros perdidos da História do Herói para Rupim, a Sacerdotisa Ranger em Bomcavaleiro em Darkon 3.
description.cns: 带着被标记的卷轴和8本遗失的英雄之书去达肯3的魔夜之森找[游侠祭司]芦苹吧。
description.de: Bringt die gestempelte Schriftrolle und die 8 verlorenen Bücher mit den Überlieferungen der Helden zur Ranger Priesterin Rupim in Darkon 3.
description.fi: Bring the Stamped Scroll and the 8 lost History of Hero books to Rupim, the Ranger Priest in Aniceknight in Darkon 3.
description.fil: Bring the Stamped Scroll and the 8 lost History of Hero books to Rupim, the Ranger Priest in Aniceknight in Darkon 3.
description.fr: Récupérer l'Histoire des Héros volée par les Pranksters du Jardin de Rhisis, puis la rapporter à Rupim, à l'Autel des Rangers de Darkon 3.
description.id: Bawa Stamped Scroll dan 8 buku History of Hero yang hilang ke Rupim, Ranger Priest di Aniceknight di Darkon 3.
description.it: Bring the Stamped Scroll and the 8 lost History of Hero books to Rupim, the Ranger Priest in Aniceknight in Darkon 3.
description.jp: 刻印された巻物と失われた8冊の英雄伝記をダーコン3のアニスナイトのレンジャープリーストであるルピムに持って行ってください。
description.kr: 봉인된 두루마리와 '영웅의 역사' 8권을 가지고, 다콘 제3지구 에인셔나이트에 있는 레인저 사제 루핌을 만나세요.
description.nl: Bring the Stamped Scroll and the 8 lost History of Hero books to Rupim, the Ranger Priest in Aniceknight in Darkon 3.
description.pl: Zanieś Zapieczętowany Zwój i 8 zaginionych Książek Historii Bohaterów Rupim-owi, Kapłanowi Rangerów w Aniceknight w Darkon 3.
description.ru: Bring the Stamped Scroll and the 8 lost History of Hero books to Rupim, the Ranger Priest in Aniceknight in Darkon 3.
description.sp: Lleva el Pergamino Estampado y los 8 libros perdidos de la Historia de los Héroes a Rupim, la Sacerdotisa Ranger en Aniceknight, Darkon 3.
description.sw: Bring the Stamped Scroll and the 8 lost History of Hero books to Rupim, the Ranger Priest in Aniceknight in Darkon 3.
description.th: นำ Stamped Scroll และ History of Hero จำนวน 8 เล่มไปให้ Rupim ซึ่งเป็น Ranger Priest ในเมือง Aniceknight ที่ Darkon 3
description.tw: 拿著卷軸去得肯第三區的安尼斯巨木林找浪人的祭司，在找她之前，你應該要先去獵殺小丑實習生得到 8 本英雄史記才行！
description.vi: Mang Stamped Scroll và 8 cuốn sách Lịch sử Anh hùng đã mất đến cho Rupim, Ranger Priest ở Aniceknight trong Darkon 3.

dialogsBegin.en: This scroll is the right of passage for those seeking to pursue the path of the Ranger Hero. Please, take it and seek the Ranger Priest in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.ar: This scroll is the right of passage for those seeking to pursue the path of the Ranger Hero. Please, take it and seek the Ranger Priest in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.br: Este pergaminho prova que você merece ser um sucessor. Encontre a Sacerdotisa Ranger em Darkon 3 e leve o pergaminho até ela.
dialogsBegin.cns: 这个卷轴是证明你有资格当游侠的，拿着这个卷轴去找游侠的祭司吧！
dialogsBegin.de: Diese Schriftrolle beweist, dass du der Nachfolge des Ranger Helden würdig bist. Bring sie zur Ranger Priesterin in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.fi: This scroll is the right of passage for those seeking to pursue the path of the Ranger Hero. Please, take it and seek the Ranger Priest in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.fil: This scroll is the right of passage for those seeking to pursue the path of the Ranger Hero. Please, take it and seek the Ranger Priest in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu approches de ton but. et la fin de ton apprentissage se passera à Darkon 3 ! Là-bas, tu trouveras l'Autel où siège Rupim, la Doyenne des Rangers.
dialogsBegin.id: Scroll ini adalah bagian bagi mereka yang ingin mengejar perjalanan Ranger Hero. Tolong, ambil dan cari Ranger Priest di Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.it: This scroll is the right of passage for those seeking to pursue the path of the Ranger Hero. Please, take it and seek the Ranger Priest in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.jp: この巻物はお前がレンジャー後継者の資格を持っているという証だ。これを持って、レンジャー司祭に会うことだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 두루마리는 당신이 레인저 영웅 후계자 자격이 있다는 증명이랍니다. 이걸 가지고 다콘 제3지구의 레인저 사제를 찾아가세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: This scroll is the right of passage for those seeking to pursue the path of the Ranger Hero. Please, take it and seek the Ranger Priest in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.pl: This scroll is the right of passage for those seeking to pursue the path of the Ranger Hero. Please, take it and seek the Ranger Priest in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.ru: Этот свиток подтверждает твое право встать на Путь стрелка. Возьми его и разыщи жрицу стрелков в Дарконе-3.
dialogsBegin.sp: Este pergamino es lo que necesitan aquellos que buscan seguir el camino del Héroe Ranger. Por favor, llévatelo y busca a la Sacerdotisa Ranger en Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.sw: This scroll is the right of passage for those seeking to pursue the path of the Ranger Hero. Please, take it and seek the Ranger Priest in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.th: Scroll นี้เป็นเส้นทางที่ถูกต้องสำหรับผู้ที่ต้องการติดตามเส้นทางของ Ranger Hero โปรดนำมันไป และไปหา Ranger Priest ที่ Darkon 3
dialogsBegin.tw: 這個卷軸是證明你有資格當浪人的，拿著這個卷軸去得肯第三區找浪人的祭司吧！
dialogsBegin.vi: Cuộn giấy này là quyền đi lại cho những ai muốn theo đuổi con đường của Ranger Hero. Hãy cầm lấy nó và tìm kiếm Ranger Priest trong Darkon 3.

dialogsBegin.en: Rupin, the Ranger Priest, can be found in Aniceknight in northern Darkon 3. Present her with the scroll and she will recognize you as a successor to the Ranger Hero.
dialogsBegin.ar: Rupin, the Ranger Priest, can be found in Aniceknight in northern Darkon 3. Present her with the scroll and she will recognize you as a successor to the Ranger Hero.
dialogsBegin.br: A sacerdotisa Ranger está no Altar Ranger em Bomcavaleiro. Ela o reconhecerá como um sucessor do herói se você mostrar isso para ela.
dialogsBegin.cns: 游侠的祭司在“阴森林”地区。把这个拿去给她吧！
dialogsBegin.de: Die Ranger Priesterin Rupim befindet sich am Altar des Ranger in Aniceknight, Darkon 3. Wenn du die Schriftrolle vorzeigst, wird sie dich als Nachfolger des Ranger Helden anerkennen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Rupin, the Ranger Priest, can be found in Aniceknight in northern Darkon 3. Present her with the scroll and she will recognize you as a successor to the Ranger Hero.
dialogsBegin.fil: Rupin, the Ranger Priest, can be found in Aniceknight in northern Darkon 3. Present her with the scroll and she will recognize you as a successor to the Ranger Hero.
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais avant cela. Il y a une mission que tu dois accomplir. Heedan recherche une relique disparue : l'Histoire des Héros, qui décrit l'épopée des Héros de Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.id: Rupin, Ranger Priest, dapat ditemukan di Aniceknight di Darkon 3 utara. Hadiahi dia scroll itu dan dia akan mengenalimu sebagai penerus Ranger Hero.
dialogsBegin.it: Rupin, the Ranger Priest, can be found in Aniceknight in northern Darkon 3. Present her with the scroll and she will recognize you as a successor to the Ranger Hero.
dialogsBegin.jp: レンジャー司祭はダーコン＜マグミアント＞地域のレンジャー祭壇にいるはずだ。彼女にこれを見せれば、あなたを英雄の後継者として認めてくれるはずだよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 레인저 사제 루핌님은 다콘 제3지구 북부의 에인셔나이트에 있어요. 이 두루마리를 전하면, 당신을 레인저 영웅의 계승자로 인정해 주실 겁니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Rupin, the Ranger Priest, can be found in Aniceknight in northern Darkon 3. Present her with the scroll and she will recognize you as a successor to the Ranger Hero.
dialogsBegin.pl: Rupin, the Ranger Priest, can be found in Aniceknight in northern Darkon 3. Present her with the scroll and she will recognize you as a successor to the Ranger Hero.
dialogsBegin.ru: Жрица стрелков Рупия живет в Дождевом лесу - это в южном Дарконе-3. Отдай ей свиток. Она поймет, что у героя, чьей памяти она служит, появился достойный наследник.
dialogsBegin.sp: Rupin, la Sacerdotisa Ranger, se encuentra en Aniceknight al norte de Darkon 3. Entrégale el pergamino y te reconocerá como un Sucesor del Héroe Ranger.
dialogsBegin.sw: Rupin, the Ranger Priest, can be found in Aniceknight in northern Darkon 3. Present her with the scroll and she will recognize you as a successor to the Ranger Hero.
dialogsBegin.th: สามารถพบ Priest Ranger ชื่อ Rupin ได้ใน Aniceknight ที่ภาคเหนือ Darkon 3 นำ Scroll นี้ให้เธอ และเธอจะรู้ว่าคุณคือทายาทของ Ranger Hero
dialogsBegin.tw: 浪人的祭司在得肯第三區的「安尼斯巨木林」地區。把這個拿去給她吧！
dialogsBegin.vi: Rupin, Ranger Priest, có thể được tìm thấy ở Aniceknight ở phía bắc Darkon 3. Đưa cho cô ấy cuộn giấy và cô ấy sẽ công nhận bạn là người kế vị Ranger Hero.

dialogsBegin.en: There is one thing you must do before you can speak with the Ranger Priest. Pranksters in the Garden of Rhisis have stolen the 8 books of the History of Heroes.
dialogsBegin.ar: There is one thing you must do before you can speak with the Ranger Priest. Pranksters in the Garden of Rhisis have stolen the 8 books of the History of Heroes.
dialogsBegin.br: Ah. Tem algo que você precisa fazer antes de ver a Sacerdotisa. Os Pranksters no Jardim Rhisis levaram todos os Livros da História dos Heróis embora.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你去找祭司之前有一件事情要请你先去做，听说莱斯庭院的“小丑实习生”把“英雄史记”全部偷走了。
dialogsBegin.de: Es gibt jedoch noch eine Sache, die es zu erledigen gilt, bevor du mit der Ranger Priesterin sprechen kannst. Prankster im Garten von Rhisis haben die acht Bücher mit den Überlieferungen der Helden gestohlen.
dialogsBegin.fi: There is one thing you must do before you can speak with the Ranger Priest. Pranksters in the Garden of Rhisis have stolen the 8 books of the History of Heroes.
dialogsBegin.fil: There is one thing you must do before you can speak with the Ranger Priest. Pranksters in the Garden of Rhisis have stolen the 8 books of the History of Heroes.
dialogsBegin.fr: Ces 8 livres ont été volé par les Pranksters, mais nous ne sommes jamais parvenus à les récupérer.
dialogsBegin.id: Ada satu hal yang harus kamu lakukan sebelum kamu bisa berbicara dengan Ranger Priest. Pranksters di Garden of Rhisis telah mencuri 8 buku History of Heroes.
dialogsBegin.it: There is one thing you must do before you can speak with the Ranger Priest. Pranksters in the Garden of Rhisis have stolen the 8 books of the History of Heroes.
dialogsBegin.jp: あ、司祭の所に行く前に、やってもらいたいことがあるんだ。＜リシスの庭園＞の＜プランクスター＞というやつが、＜英雄伝記＞を全部奪ったそうだ。まったく・・・
dialogsBegin.kr: 레인저 사제를 만나기 전에 해야 할 일이 하나 있어요. 리시스의 정원에 있는 프랭스터 놈들이 ‘영웅의 역사’ 여덟 권을 훔쳐 갔어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: There is one thing you must do before you can speak with the Ranger Priest. Pranksters in the Garden of Rhisis have stolen the 8 books of the History of Heroes.
dialogsBegin.pl: Jest jedna rzecz, którą musisz zrobić, zanim będziesz mógł porozmawiać z Kapłanem Rangerów. Magiczni Dowcipnisie z Ogrodu Rhisis ukradli 8 Ksiąg Historii Bohaterów.
dialogsBegin.ru: Но сначала тебе придется выполнить опасное задание. Паяцы Райсского сада украли восемь книг из серии "Жизнь замечательных героев".
dialogsBegin.sp: Hay algo que debes hacer antes de poder hablar con la Sacerdotisa Ranger. Unos Pranksters del Jardín de Rhisis han robado los 8 libros de la Historia de los Héroes.
dialogsBegin.sw: There is one thing you must do before you can speak with the Ranger Priest. Pranksters in the Garden of Rhisis have stolen the 8 books of the History of Heroes.
dialogsBegin.th: มีสิ่งหนึ่งที่คุณต้องทำก่อนที่คุณจะสามารถพูดคุยกับ Ranger Priest ได้ Pranksters ใน Garden of Rhisis ได้ขโมยหนังสือประวัติศาสตร์ของ Heroes จำนวน 8 เล่ม
dialogsBegin.tw: 在你與浪人祭司交談之前，必須先完成一件事。黎席斯庭院的小丑實習生偷走了 8 本英雄史記。
dialogsBegin.vi: Có một điều bạn phải làm trước khi có thể nói chuyện với Ranger Priest. Pranksters trong Garden of Rhisis đã lấy cắp 8 cuốn sách Lịch sử các anh hùng.

dialogsBegin.en: These books detail the History of the Heroes and are very sacred us. Go now, to Rhisis, and do what you must to get these books back!
dialogsBegin.ar: These books detail the History of the Heroes and are very sacred us. Go now, to Rhisis, and do what you must to get these books back!
dialogsBegin.br: Esses livros detalham a História dos Heróis e são muito sagrados para nós. Vá agora, e faça o que for preciso para recuperar esses livros!
dialogsBegin.cns: 这些书籍详述了英雄们的历史。现在就出发吧，去莱斯庭院，无论做什么你都一定要拿回这些书籍！
dialogsBegin.de: Diese Bücher beschreiben die Geschichte der Helden und sind uns sehr heilig. Gehe jetzt in den Garten von Rhisis und hole diese Bücher zurück!
dialogsBegin.fi: These books detail the History of the Heroes and are very sacred us. Go now, to Rhisis, and do what you must to get these books back!
dialogsBegin.fil: These books detail the History of the Heroes and are very sacred us. Go now, to Rhisis, and do what you must to get these books back!
dialogsBegin.fr: Selon mes sources, les Pranksters seraient désormais au Jardin de Rhisis. Ces 8 livres sont vraiment d'une valeur inestimable, Rupim te sera éternellement reconnaissante si tu les lui ramènes.
dialogsBegin.id: Buku-buku ini merangkum History of the Heroes dan sangat sakral bagi kita. Pergilah sekarang, ke Rhisis, dan lakukan apa yang harus kamu lakukan untuk mendapatkan kembali buku-buku ini!
dialogsBegin.it: These books detail the History of the Heroes and are very sacred us. Go now, to Rhisis, and do what you must to get these books back!
dialogsBegin.jp: 全部で8冊だが、これがなかなかどうしてたいした宝物だからね。これを全部持っていけば、司祭はきっと喜ぶと思うなあ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 영웅의 역사가 자세히 담겨있는 책이라, 저희에겐 아주 신성한 보물이에요. 어서 리시스로 가서, 이 책들을 되찾아 주세요!
dialogsBegin.nl: These books detail the History of the Heroes and are very sacred us. Go now, to Rhisis, and do what you must to get these books back!
dialogsBegin.pl: Te księgi szczegółowo opisują Historię Bohaterów i są dla nas bardzo święte. Idź teraz do Rhisis i zrób wszystko, aby odzyskać te książki!
dialogsBegin.ru: These books detail the History of the Heroes and are very sacred us. Go now, to Rhisis, and do what you must to get these books back!
dialogsBegin.sp: Estos libros detallan la Historia de los Héroes y son muy sagrados para nosotros. ¡Ve a Rhisis y haz lo que tengas que hacer para recuperar esos libros!
dialogsBegin.sw: These books detail the History of the Heroes and are very sacred us. Go now, to Rhisis, and do what you must to get these books back!
dialogsBegin.th: หนังสือเหล่านี้มีรายละเอียดประวัติศาสตร์ของวีรบุรุษและมีความศักดิ์สิทธิ์มาก ไป Rhisis และทำในสิ่งที่คุณต้องทำเพื่อให้ได้หนังสือเหล่านี้กลับมา!
dialogsBegin.tw: 這些書詳細介紹了英雄的歷史，對我們來說非常神聖。現在就去黎席斯，盡你所能把這些書拿回來！
dialogsBegin.vi: Những cuốn sách này trình bày chi tiết về Lịch sử của các Anh hùng và rất thiêng liêng đối với chúng ta. Đi ngay, đến Rhisis, và làm những gì bạn phải làm để lấy lại những cuốn sách này!

dialogsAccept.en: Good luck to you, Acrobat. May the Ranger Hero guide you. Speak with Rupin, the Ranger Priest in Aniceknight, once you've recovered the sacred texts.
dialogsAccept.ar: Good luck to you, Acrobat. May the Ranger Hero guide you. Speak with Rupin, the Ranger Priest in Aniceknight, once you've recovered the sacred texts.
dialogsAccept.br: Boa sorte para você, Acrobata. Que o Herói Ranger o guie. Fale com Rupin, a Sacerdotisa Ranger em Bomcavaleiro, depois de recuperar os textos sagrados.
dialogsAccept.cns: 加油！不要死到喔～黑黑～
dialogsAccept.de: Ich wünsche dir viel Glück, Acrobat. Möge dich der Ranger Held leiten. Sprich mit der Ranger Priesterin Rupim in Aniceknight, sobald du die Bücher hast.
dialogsAccept.fi: Good luck to you, Acrobat. May the Ranger Hero guide you. Speak with Rupin, the Ranger Priest in Aniceknight, once you've recovered the sacred texts.
dialogsAccept.fil: Good luck to you, Acrobat. May the Ranger Hero guide you. Speak with Rupin, the Ranger Priest in Aniceknight, once you've recovered the sacred texts.
dialogsAccept.fr: Bonne chance, futur Ranger !
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga berhasil, Acrobat. Semoga Ranger Hero menuntunmu. Bicaralah dengan Rupin, Ranger Priest di Aniceknight, setelah kamu menemukan sacred text.
dialogsAccept.it: Good luck to you, Acrobat. May the Ranger Hero guide you. Speak with Rupin, the Ranger Priest in Aniceknight, once you've recovered the sacred texts.
dialogsAccept.jp: 頑張れよ!
dialogsAccept.kr: 행운을 빕니다. 레인저 영웅의 인도가 함께하기를... 그 신성한 책들을 되찾으면 에인셔나이트에 있는 레인저 사제 루핌님을 찾아가세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Good luck to you, Acrobat. May the Ranger Hero guide you. Speak with Rupin, the Ranger Priest in Aniceknight, once you've recovered the sacred texts.
dialogsAccept.pl: Good luck to you, Acrobat. May the Ranger Hero guide you. Speak with Rupin, the Ranger Priest in Aniceknight, once you've recovered the sacred texts.
dialogsAccept.ru: Удачи тебе, акробат. Да пребудет с тобой сила Теля. Когда вернешь книги, поговори с Рупией, жрицей стрелков, в Дождевом лесу.
dialogsAccept.sp: Buena suerte, Acrobat. Que el Héroe Ranger te guíe. Habla con Rupin, la Sacerdotisa Ranger en Aniceknight, una vez que hayas recuperado los textos sagrados.
dialogsAccept.sw: Good luck to you, Acrobat. May the Ranger Hero guide you. Speak with Rupin, the Ranger Priest in Aniceknight, once you've recovered the sacred texts.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้โชคดีกับคุณ Acrobat ขอให้ Ranger Hero นำทางคุณ พูดคุยกับ Ranger Priest ชื่อ Rupin ในเมือง Aniceknight เมื่อคุณได้รับข้อความศักดิ์สิทธิ์คืนแล้ว
dialogsAccept.tw: 加油！不要死到喔～黑黑～拿回神聖文獻後，記得去安尼斯巨木林找浪人的祭司蘆蘋。
dialogsAccept.vi: Chúc bạn may mắn, Acrobat. Mong Ranger Hero hướng dẫn bạn. Hãy nói chuyện với Rupin, Ranger Priest ở Aniceknight, khi bạn đã khôi phục được các văn bản thiêng liêng.

dialogsDecline.en: The books must be returned. We need your help, Acrobat. Speak with me again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.ar: The books must be returned. We need your help, Acrobat. Speak with me again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.br: Os livros devem ser devolvidos. Precisamos de sua ajuda, Acrobata. Fale comigo novamente quando estiver pronto.
dialogsDecline.cns: 咦？你是笨蛋喔？在一点点就完成了，要在这里放弃吗？
dialogsDecline.de: Wir müssen diese Bücher unbedingt zurückbekommen. Wir brauchen deine Hilfe! Komm zu mir zurück, wenn du bereit bist.
dialogsDecline.fi: The books must be returned. We need your help, Acrobat. Speak with me again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.fil: The books must be returned. We need your help, Acrobat. Speak with me again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.fr: Il faut absolument retrouver cette relique, ceci devrait être ta toute première priorité !
dialogsDecline.id: Buku-buku itu harus dikembalikan. Kami membutuhkan bantuanmu, Acrobat. Bicaralah denganku lagi ketika kamu sudah siap.
dialogsDecline.it: The books must be returned. We need your help, Acrobat. Speak with me again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.jp: 資質を持ちながら無駄にする奴の気持ちはまったくわからないな。
dialogsDecline.kr: 반드시 책을 되찾아야 합니다. 당신의 도움이 필요하다고요, 아크로뱃. 준비가 되면 다시 말씀해 주세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: The books must be returned. We need your help, Acrobat. Speak with me again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.pl: The books must be returned. We need your help, Acrobat. Speak with me again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.ru: Книги непременно нужно вернуть. Акробат, нам нужна твоя помощь. Готовься к выступлению и приходи ко мне.
dialogsDecline.sp: Se deben recuperar los libros. Necesitamos tu ayuda, Acrobat. Habla conmigo cuando estés listo.
dialogsDecline.sw: The books must be returned. We need your help, Acrobat. Speak with me again when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.th: หนังสือต้องถูกส่งคืน เราต้องการความช่วยเหลือจากคุณ Acrobat พูดคุยกับฉันอีกครั้งเมื่อคุณพร้อม
dialogsDecline.tw: 咦？你是笨蛋喔？在一點點就完成了，要在這裡放棄嗎？
dialogsDecline.vi: Sách phải được trả lại. Chúng tôi cần sự giúp đỡ của bạn, Acrobat. Nói chuyện với tôi một lần nữa khi bạn đã sẵn sàng.

dialogsComplete.en: What've you got there, Acrobat? A Stamped Scroll, and are those… they are! I can't believe it! The 8 lost books of the History of Heroes!
dialogsComplete.ar: What've you got there, Acrobat? A Stamped Scroll, and are those… they are! I can't believe it! The 8 lost books of the History of Heroes!
dialogsComplete.br: O que você tem aí, Acrobata? Um Pergaminho com o Selo, e são esses os... sim! Eu não posso acreditar! Os 8 livros perdidos da História dos Heróis!
dialogsComplete.cns: 弓箭手，你拿到了什么？一个被标记的卷轴，还有...就是它们！难以置信！8本遗失的英雄之书！
dialogsComplete.de: Was hast du da, Acrobat? Eine gestempelte Schriftrolle? Und sind das... sie sind es! Ich kann es nicht glauben! Die 8 verlorenen Bücher mit den Überlieferungen der Helden!
dialogsComplete.fi: What've you got there, Acrobat? A Stamped Scroll, and are those… they are! I can't believe it! The 8 lost books of the History of Heroes!
dialogsComplete.fil: What've you got there, Acrobat? A Stamped Scroll, and are those… they are! I can't believe it! The 8 lost books of the History of Heroes!
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh, tu as finalement retrouvé l'Histoire des Héros ! Je ne sais pas par quel miracle tu l'as retrouvée, mais maintenant le trésor est enfin à sa place..
dialogsComplete.id: Apa yang kamu dapatkan di sana, Acrobat? Stamped Scroll, dan apakah itu… mereka! Aku tidak percaya! 8 buku History of Heroes yang hilang!
dialogsComplete.it: What've you got there, Acrobat? A Stamped Scroll, and are those… they are! I can't believe it! The 8 lost books of the History of Heroes!
dialogsComplete.jp: これは確かに＜ハイナン＞様の印章ですね。あと＜英雄伝記＞8冊まで、全部見つけていただいて、本当にありがとうございます。
dialogsComplete.kr: 그게 뭔가요? 봉인된 두루마리와, 이것들은... 혹시…! 믿을 수 없군요! 잃어버렸던 ‘영웅의 역사’ 여덟 권이라니!
dialogsComplete.nl: What've you got there, Acrobat? A Stamped Scroll, and are those… they are! I can't believe it! The 8 lost books of the History of Heroes!
dialogsComplete.pl: Co tam masz, Akrobato? Zapieczętowany Zwój i czy to… one są! Nie mogę w to uwierzyć! 8 zaginionych Ksiąg Historii Bohaterów!
dialogsComplete.ru: What've you got there, Acrobat? A Stamped Scroll, and are those… they are! I can't believe it! The 8 lost books of the History of Heroes!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿Qué tienes ahí, Acrobat? Un Pergamino Estampado, y esos son… ¡sí son! ¡No puedo creerlo! ¡Los 8 libros perdidos de la Historia de los Héroes!
dialogsComplete.sw: What've you got there, Acrobat? A Stamped Scroll, and are those… they are! I can't believe it! The 8 lost books of the History of Heroes!
dialogsComplete.th: คุณเคยไปที่นั่นบ้างไหม Acrobat? Stamped Scroll และพวกเขาเป็น! ฉันไม่สามารถเชื่อได้! หนังสือหายไป 8 เล่มในประวัติศาสตร์ของวีรบุรุษ!
dialogsComplete.tw: 這是海楠印章。而且還有 8 本英雄史記。不知道要如何報答你才好～真的很感謝你。
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn có gì ở đó, Acrobat? Stamped Scroll, và đó là… chúng là như vậy! Tôi không thể tin được! 8 cuốn sách Lịch sử Anh hùng đã mất!

dialogsComplete.en: How did you ever… never mind! The important thing is that we have them back! We owe you our sincerest gratitude, young Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.ar: How did you ever… never mind! The important thing is that we have them back! We owe you our sincerest gratitude, young Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.br: Como você... deixa pra lá! O importante é que os tenhamos de volta! Devemos a você nossa mais sincera gratidão, jovem Acrobata!
dialogsComplete.cns: 再一次的感谢你～
dialogsComplete.de: Wie hast du... ach, nicht so wichtig! Wichtig ist nur, dass wir sie zurück haben! Wir stehen tief in deiner Schuld, junger Acrobat.
dialogsComplete.fi: How did you ever… never mind! The important thing is that we have them back! We owe you our sincerest gratitude, young Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.fil: How did you ever… never mind! The important thing is that we have them back! We owe you our sincerest gratitude, young Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.fr: Quoiqu'il en soit, merci infiniment ! Je craignais vraiment de ne jamais revoir ces ouvrages...
dialogsComplete.id: Pernahkah kamu ... tidak apa-apa! Yang penting adalah kita mendapatkannya kembali! Kami berutang banyak terima kasih, Acrobat muda!
dialogsComplete.it: How did you ever… never mind! The important thing is that we have them back! We owe you our sincerest gratitude, young Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.jp: この大切な宝物を・・・。もう一度感謝を申し上げます。
dialogsComplete.kr: 어떻게 이걸… 아니, 그게 중요한 게 아니죠! 중요한 건 우리가 다시 이 책을 되찾았다는 사실이죠! 진심으로 감사드립니다, 아크로뱃!
dialogsComplete.nl: How did you ever… never mind! The important thing is that we have them back! We owe you our sincerest gratitude, young Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.pl: How did you ever… never mind! The important thing is that we have them back! We owe you our sincerest gratitude, young Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.ru: Как тебе это... Да какая разница?! Главное, что они снова у нас! Знай, что мы тебе бесконечно благодарны.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿Cómo has...? ¡da igual! ¡Lo importante es que los tenemos de vuelta! ¡Te debemos nuestra más sincera gratitud, joven Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.sw: How did you ever… never mind! The important thing is that we have them back! We owe you our sincerest gratitude, young Acrobat!
dialogsComplete.th: คุณทำได้ไง... ไม่เป็นไร! สิ่งสำคัญคือเราได้มันกลับมา! เราเป็นหนี้คุณ พ่อหนุ่ม Acrobat !
dialogsComplete.tw: 你究竟是怎麼……算了！重要的是東西都拿回來了！年輕的雜技師，我們由衷感謝你！
dialogsComplete.vi: Làm thế nào mà bạn đã từng ... đừng bận tâm! Điều quan trọng là chúng tôi đã có chúng trở lại! Chúng tôi nợ bạn lòng biết ơn chân thành nhất của chúng tôi, Acrobat trẻ!

dialogsFail.en: I'm waiting for someone who has allegedly found the 8 lost books of the History of Heroes. Is that you? No? Then we have nothing more to discuss.
dialogsFail.ar: I'm waiting for someone who has allegedly found the 8 lost books of the History of Heroes. Is that you? No? Then we have nothing more to discuss.
dialogsFail.br: Estou esperando por alguém que supostamente encontrou os 8 livros perdidos da História dos Heróis. É você? “Não?” Então não temos mais nada para discutir.
dialogsFail.cns: 我一直在等待可以宣称找到了八本遗失英雄典籍的人。是你吗？不是？那我们没什么好说的了。
dialogsFail.de: Ich warte auf jemanden, der angeblich die 8 verlorenen Bücher mit den  Überlieferungen der Helden gefunden hat. Bist du das? Nein? Dann geh jetzt.
dialogsFail.fi: I'm waiting for someone who has allegedly found the 8 lost books of the History of Heroes. Is that you? No? Then we have nothing more to discuss.
dialogsFail.fil: I'm waiting for someone who has allegedly found the 8 lost books of the History of Heroes. Is that you? No? Then we have nothing more to discuss.
dialogsFail.fr: En ce lieu nous protégeons les âmes des Héros. Mais quelle est la raison de ta venue ?
dialogsFail.id: Aku sedang menunggu seseorang yang diduga telah menemukan 8 buku History of Heroes yang hilang. Apa itu kamu? Tidak? Maka tidak ada lagi yang perlu kita diskusikan.
dialogsFail.it: I'm waiting for someone who has allegedly found the 8 lost books of the History of Heroes. Is that you? No? Then we have nothing more to discuss.
dialogsFail.jp: 失われた英雄の歴史の8冊の本を見つけた人を待っています。 あなたなの？ 違うの？ だったら、これ以上話す事はありません。
dialogsFail.kr: ‘영웅의 역사’ 여덟 권을 되찾아온다는 사람을 기다리고 있는데요. 그게 당신인가요? 아니라고요? 그럼 더 드릴 말씀이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: I'm waiting for someone who has allegedly found the 8 lost books of the History of Heroes. Is that you? No? Then we have nothing more to discuss.
dialogsFail.pl: Czekam na kogoś, kto rzekomo odnalazł 8 zaginionych Ksiąg Historii Bohaterów. Czy to ty? Nie? W takim razie nie mamy nic do omówienia.
dialogsFail.ru: I'm waiting for someone who has allegedly found the 8 lost books of the History of Heroes. Is that you? No? Then we have nothing more to discuss.
dialogsFail.sp: Estoy esperando a alguien que supuestamente ha encontrado los 8 libros perdidos de la Historia de los Héroes. ¿Eres tú? ¿No? Entonces no tenemos nada más que hablar.
dialogsFail.sw: I'm waiting for someone who has allegedly found the 8 lost books of the History of Heroes. Is that you? No? Then we have nothing more to discuss.
dialogsFail.th: ฉันกำลังรอคนที่บอกว่าพบหนังสือประวัติความเป็นมาของวีรบุรุษ 8 เล่มที่หายไป ใช่คุณรึเปล่า? ไม่งั้นเหรอ? งั้นเราก็ไม่มีอะไรต้องคุยกันแล้วล่ะ
dialogsFail.tw: 我在等一個據稱找到了英雄史中丟失的 8 本書的人。那是你嗎？不？那我們就沒什麼好討論的了。
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi đang chờ một người được cho là đã tìm thấy 8 cuốn sách bị mất của Lịch sử các anh hùng. Có phải bạn không? Không? Vậy thì chúng ta không còn gì để thảo luận nữa.

name.th: พล็อตของ Colack

description.en: Find 5 Pieces of Meteoritill and bring them to Colack in Saint City.
description.ar: Find 5 Pieces of Meteoritill and bring them to Colack in Saint City.
description.br: Por favor, me traga 5 pedaços de Meteoritil. O meteorito caiu em algum lugar ao sul do continente.
description.cns: 帮我找5个岩石回来好吗?它好像掉在晨光南部呢~
description.de: Bitte bringe mir 5 Meteoritils. Der Meteorit befindet sich irgendwo südlich von Saint Morning
description.fi: Find 5 Pieces of Meteoritill and bring them to Colack in Saint City.
description.fil: Find 5 Pieces of Meteoritill and bring them to Colack in Saint City.
description.fr: Ramener 5 morceaux de Meteoritil de la météorite tombée quelque part au sud de Saint Morning
description.id: Temukan 5 Potongan Meteoritill dan bawa ke Coack di Saint City.
description.it: Find 5 Pieces of Meteoritill and bring them to Colack in Saint City.
description.jp: 噂の隕石はセイントモーニング南部のどこかに落ちたそうだ。隕石の近くにあるという＜メテオライティル＞を5個探して持ってこよう。
description.kr: 메테오리틸 조각 5개를 찾아 세인트 시티의 콜락에게 가져가세요.
description.nl: Find 5 Pieces of Meteoritill and bring them to Colack in Saint City.
description.pl: Find 5 Pieces of Meteoritill and bring them to Colack in Saint City.
description.ru: Нужно принести Колаку в Санто пять кусков метеорития.
description.sp: Encuentra 5 trozos de Meteoritill y llévaselos a Colack en Saint.
description.sw: Find 5 Pieces of Meteoritill and bring them to Colack in Saint City.
description.th: หาชิ้นส่วนของ Meteoritill 5 ชิ้น และนำไปให้ Colack ใน Saint City
description.tw: 幫我找 5 個岩石回來好嗎？帶它給在聖音特的克勒。
description.vi: Tìm 5 mảnh Meteoritill và mang chúng đến Colack ở Saint City.

dialogsBegin.en: Did you know that a huge meteorite fell nearby a few days ago?
dialogsBegin.ar: Did you know that a huge meteorite fell nearby a few days ago?
dialogsBegin.br: Você sabia que um enorme meteorito caiu em Saint Morning alguns dias atrás?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你知道前几天有一颗巨大的陨石落在附近吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Weißt du eigentlich, dass neulich ein großer Meteorit in der Nähe von Saint Morning vom Himmel fiel?
dialogsBegin.fi: Did you know that a huge meteorite fell nearby a few days ago?
dialogsBegin.fil: Did you know that a huge meteorite fell nearby a few days ago?
dialogsBegin.fr: Sais-tu qu'une grosse météorite est tombée près de Saint Morning il y a quelques jours ? Mais... (regardant autour)
dialogsBegin.id: Tahukah kamu bahwa meteorit besar jatuh di dekat situ beberapa hari yang lalu?
dialogsBegin.it: Did you know that a huge meteorite fell nearby a few days ago?
dialogsBegin.jp: 冒険者の君、もう知っているかい？最近セイントモーニングの近くに大きな隕石が落ちたらしいんだよ！
dialogsBegin.kr: 며칠 전에 근처에 커다란 운석이 떨어진 거 아세요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Did you know that a huge meteorite fell nearby a few days ago?
dialogsBegin.pl: Did you know that a huge meteorite fell nearby a few days ago?
dialogsBegin.ru: Did you know that a huge meteorite fell nearby a few days ago?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Sabías que un enorme meteorito cayó cerca hace unos días?
dialogsBegin.sw: Did you know that a huge meteorite fell nearby a few days ago?
dialogsBegin.th: คุณรู้หรือไม่ว่าอุกกาบาตขนาดใหญ่ตกลงมาใกล้ๆ เมื่อไม่กี่วันก่อน
dialogsBegin.tw: 你知道幾天前附近有一顆巨大的隕石墜落嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có biết rằng một thiên thạch khổng lồ đã rơi gần đó vài ngày trước không?

dialogsBegin.en: We usually refine chunks of meteorite into a very rare metal. We call it Meteoritill.
dialogsBegin.ar: We usually refine chunks of meteorite into a very rare metal. We call it Meteoritill.
dialogsBegin.br: Alguns pedaços de meteorito quebrado normalmente se transformam em um metal muito raro. Nós o chamamos de Meteoritil.
dialogsBegin.cns: 听说掉下来的岩石中有一小块，可以制作成很棒的宝石，叫做陨石。
dialogsBegin.de: (Flüstern) Man sagt, wenn Stücke von einem Meteoriten abbrechen, verändern sie sich zu seltenem Metall. Wir nennen dieses Metall Meteoritil.
dialogsBegin.fi: We usually refine chunks of meteorite into a very rare metal. We call it Meteoritill.
dialogsBegin.fil: We usually refine chunks of meteorite into a very rare metal. We call it Meteoritill.
dialogsBegin.fr: (Chuchotant) Certains morceaux de la météorite se transforment habituellement en un métal très rare qu'on appelle Météoritil.
dialogsBegin.id: Kami biasanya memperbaiki potongan meteorit menjadi logam yang sangat langka. Kami menyebutnya Meteoritill.
dialogsBegin.it: We usually refine chunks of meteorite into a very rare metal. We call it Meteoritill.
dialogsBegin.jp: 隕石が落ちるとその欠片の一部が急激に冷えて、とても珍しい金属に変化するんだよ。その金属は＜メテオライティル＞と呼ばれているんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 우리는 운석 덩어리를 정제해서 희귀한 금속을 만들어요. 그걸 메테오리틸이라고 부르죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: We usually refine chunks of meteorite into a very rare metal. We call it Meteoritill.
dialogsBegin.pl: We usually refine chunks of meteorite into a very rare metal. We call it Meteoritill.
dialogsBegin.ru: Из осколков метеорита можно выплавить очень прочный металл - метеоритий.
dialogsBegin.sp: Por lo general, refinamos trozos de meteorito en un metal muy raro. Lo llamamos Meteoritill.
dialogsBegin.sw: We usually refine chunks of meteorite into a very rare metal. We call it Meteoritill.
dialogsBegin.th: เรามักจะปรับแต่งอุกกาบาตให้เป็นโลหะที่หายากมาก เราเรียกมันว่า Meteoritill
dialogsBegin.tw: 聽說掉下來的岩石中有一小塊，可以製作成很棒的寶石，叫做賣泰雅蘿提
dialogsBegin.vi: Chúng tôi thường tinh luyện các khối thiên thạch thành một kim loại rất hiếm. Chúng tôi gọi nó là Meteoritill.

dialogsBegin.en: It is the best material for making expensive arms or armor in Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.ar: It is the best material for making expensive arms or armor in Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.br: É o melhor material que há em Madrigal para se fazer armas ou armaduras caras. E...
dialogsBegin.cns: 那是一个很有名的材料呢~那个价钱也相当高喔~好像是拿来制作防具的吧!
dialogsBegin.de: Das ist das beste Material in Madrigal, um daraus teure Waffen und Rüstung zu fertigen. Und dieses Material ist sehr selten.
dialogsBegin.fi: It is the best material for making expensive arms or armor in Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.fil: It is the best material for making expensive arms or armor in Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.fr: C'est le meilleur métal pour fabriquer des armes et des armures qui se vendent très cher dans tout Madrigal. Et.
dialogsBegin.id: Ini adalah bahan terbaik untuk membuat senjata atau armor yang mahal di Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.it: It is the best material for making expensive arms or armor in Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.jp: これはマドリガルでもめったに採れることがないとても貴重な素材でね。だから＜メテオライティル＞で作られた武器や防具はとても高価なのさ。材料自体の希少性が高いからね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 마드리갈에서 최고급 무기나 방어구를 만드는 데 재료로 쓰여요.
dialogsBegin.nl: It is the best material for making expensive arms or armor in Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.pl: It is the best material for making expensive arms or armor in Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.ru: Лучшего материала для оружия и доспехов не найти!
dialogsBegin.sp: Es el mejor material para hacer armas y armaduras de las caras en Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.sw: It is the best material for making expensive arms or armor in Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.th: เป็นวัสดุที่ดีที่สุดสำหรับการผลิตอาวุธหรือชุดเกราะราคาแพงในเมือง Madrigal
dialogsBegin.tw: 那是一個很有名的材料呢~那個價錢也相當高喔~好像是拿來製作防具的吧！
dialogsBegin.vi: Đây là nguyên liệu tốt nhất để chế tạo vũ khí hoặc áo giáp đắt tiền ở Madrigal.

dialogsBegin.en: It usually takes about 500 years to get it because meteorites don't fall every day. However, one just fell, so now's our chance!
dialogsBegin.ar: It usually takes about 500 years to get it because meteorites don't fall every day. However, one just fell, so now's our chance!
dialogsBegin.br: ... Geralmente leva-se cerca de 500 anos para obtê-lo. Mas, desta vez, podemos conseguir um pedaço realmente grande de Meteoritil.
dialogsBegin.cns: 听说用那个宝石作武器或防具需要花500年的时间呢~可是这次好像不一样耶..听说这次掉的是很大很大的宝石。
dialogsBegin.de: Die Herstellung der Waffen und Rüstung bedarf etwa 500 Jahre. Aber dieses Mal liegt der Fall anders: Wir können sehr große Stücke Meteoritils bekommen.
dialogsBegin.fi: It usually takes about 500 years to get it because meteorites don't fall every day. However, one just fell, so now's our chance!
dialogsBegin.fil: It usually takes about 500 years to get it because meteorites don't fall every day. However, one just fell, so now's our chance!
dialogsBegin.fr: .. De telles météorites ne tombent que tous les 500 ans ! Mais ce coup-ci tu peux en avoir un énorme morceau.
dialogsBegin.id: Biasanya dibutuhkan sekitar 500 tahun untuk mendapatkannya karena meteorit tidak jatuh setiap hari. Namun, satu baru saja jatuh, jadi sekaranglah kesempatan kita!
dialogsBegin.it: It usually takes about 500 years to get it because meteorites don't fall every day. However, one just fell, so now's our chance!
dialogsBegin.jp: ＜メテオライティル＞で武器や防具を作ったら、材料を集めるだけで約500年はかかると言われているんだ。ハハッ、気が遠くなるだろう？ところが先日落ちた隕石からは、とても大きな＜メテオライティル＞が採れるらしいんだ！
dialogsBegin.kr: 운석이 매일 떨어지는 건 아니니까, 보통은 500년에 하나쯤 얻을 수 있을까 말까죠. 그런데 얼마 전에 하나가 떨어졌어요. 지금이 기회요!
dialogsBegin.nl: It usually takes about 500 years to get it because meteorites don't fall every day. However, one just fell, so now's our chance!
dialogsBegin.pl: It usually takes about 500 years to get it because meteorites don't fall every day. However, one just fell, so now's our chance!
dialogsBegin.ru: А поскольку метеориты падают раз в пятьсот лет, не чаще, металл этот очень и очень редкий. И вот мы дождались!
dialogsBegin.sp: Por lo general se tarda unos 500 años en obtenerlo porque los meteoritos no caen todos los días. Sin embargo, acaba de caer uno, ¡así que ahora es nuestra oportunidad!
dialogsBegin.sw: It usually takes about 500 years to get it because meteorites don't fall every day. However, one just fell, so now's our chance!
dialogsBegin.th: ปกติจะใช้เวลาประมาณ 500 ปีกว่าจะได้มา เพราะอุกกาบาตไม่ได้ตกทุกวัน อย่างไรก็ตาม เพิ่งมีตกมาอันหนึ่ง ดังนั้นตอนนี้เป็นโอกาสของเรา!
dialogsBegin.tw: 聽說用那個寶石作武器或防具需要花 500 年的時間呢~可是這次好像不一樣耶…聽說這次掉的是很大很大的寶石。
dialogsBegin.vi: Thường mất khoảng 500 năm để có được nó vì thiên thạch không rơi mỗi ngày. Tuy nhiên, một thiên thạch vừa rơi, vì vậy bây giờ là cơ hội của chúng ta!

dialogsBegin.en: Think you can find me some Meteoritill? I would be very pleased to acquire some.
dialogsBegin.ar: Think you can find me some Meteoritill? I would be very pleased to acquire some.
dialogsBegin.br: Acha que pode me encontrar algum Meteoritill? Gostaria muito de adquirir alguns.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你能帮我找到陨石吗？我很乐意购买一些。
dialogsBegin.de: Kannst du mir etwas Meteoritill besorgen? Ich würde mich sehr freuen, welche zu erwerben.
dialogsBegin.fi: Think you can find me some Meteoritill? I would be very pleased to acquire some.
dialogsBegin.fil: Think you can find me some Meteoritill? I would be very pleased to acquire some.
dialogsBegin.fr: Alors. Tu pourrais m'en ramener. à l'écart des regards indiscrets ?
dialogsBegin.id: Bisakah kamu menemukan untukku beberapa Meteoritill? Aku akan sangat senang jika mendapatkannya.
dialogsBegin.it: Think you can find me some Meteoritill? I would be very pleased to acquire some.
dialogsBegin.jp: 今はセイント中がこの噂でもちきりさ。メテオライティルを採りに、みんなやっきになって隕石の落ちた場所を探し回ってるところだ。ところで頼みがあるんだが、俺の代わりにこの＜メテオライティル＞を採ってきてくれないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 혹시 메테오리틸을 좀 찾아주실 수 있나요? 손에 넣을 수 있다면 정말 기쁠 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Think you can find me some Meteoritill? I would be very pleased to acquire some.
dialogsBegin.pl: Think you can find me some Meteoritill? I would be very pleased to acquire some.
dialogsBegin.ru: Think you can find me some Meteoritill? I would be very pleased to acquire some.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Crees que me puedes conseguir un poco de Meteoritill? Estaría muy contento si me consigues unos cuantos.
dialogsBegin.sw: Think you can find me some Meteoritill? I would be very pleased to acquire some.
dialogsBegin.th: คิดว่าคุณสามารถหา Meteoritill ให้ฉันได้ไหม? ฉันจะยินดีมากที่จะได้รับบางส่วน
dialogsBegin.tw: 覺得你能幫我找到一些賣泰雅蘿提嗎？我會很高興拿到一些。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có thể tìm cho tôi một ít Meteoritill? Tôi sẽ rất vui khi có được một số Meteoritill.

dialogsAccept.en: Keep it secret, though. I don't want the other armorsmiths to find out! Try searching south of Saint City.
dialogsAccept.ar: Keep it secret, though. I don't want the other armorsmiths to find out! Try searching south of Saint City.
dialogsAccept.br: Mas mantenha isso em segredo. Não quero que os outros armeiros descubram! Tente procurar ao sul de Saint.
dialogsAccept.cns: 哈哈哈..帮我找5个岩石回来好吗?它好像掉在晨光南部呢~
dialogsAccept.de: Hole mir bitte 5 Stücke Meteoritils. Dieser Meteorit ging irgendwo im südlichen Saint Morning nieder.
dialogsAccept.fi: Keep it secret, though. I don't want the other armorsmiths to find out! Try searching south of Saint City.
dialogsAccept.fil: Keep it secret, though. I don't want the other armorsmiths to find out! Try searching south of Saint City.
dialogsAccept.fr: Hahaha.. Parfait ! (surveillant autour, puis chuchotant). Alors apporte-moi 5 morceaux de Météoritil. La météorite s'est écrasée quelque part au sud de Saint Morning selon mes sources..
dialogsAccept.id: Tetap rahasiakan. Aku tidak ingin pembuat senjata lain mengetahuinya! Coba cari di selatan Saint City.
dialogsAccept.it: Keep it secret, though. I don't want the other armorsmiths to find out! Try searching south of Saint City.
dialogsAccept.jp: 頼まれてくれるのかい？感謝するぜ！じゃ、＜メテオライティル＞を5個集めて来てくれよ。隕石はセイントモーニング南部のどこかに落ちたそうなんだ。誰かに全部採られてしまわないうちに、頼むぜ！
dialogsAccept.kr: 하지만 비밀로 하자고요. 다른 방어구 제작자들한텐 들키면 안 돼요! 세인트 시티 남쪽 부근을 찾아보세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Keep it secret, though. I don't want the other armorsmiths to find out! Try searching south of Saint City.
dialogsAccept.pl: Keep it secret, though. I don't want the other armorsmiths to find out! Try searching south of Saint City.
dialogsAccept.ru: Только никому не говори, иначе нас опередят! Ищи упавший метеорит на юге от Санто.
dialogsAccept.sp: Eso sí, mantenlo en secreto. ¡No quiero que los otros herreros se enteren! Intenta buscar al sur de Saint.
dialogsAccept.sw: Keep it secret, though. I don't want the other armorsmiths to find out! Try searching south of Saint City.
dialogsAccept.th: เก็บไว้เป็นความลับ ฉันไม่ต้องการให้ช่างทำอาวุธคนอื่นรู้! ลองค้นหาทางตอนใต้ของ Saint City
dialogsAccept.tw: 哈哈哈…幫我找 5 個岩石回來好嗎？它好像掉在聖音特南部呢~
dialogsAccept.vi: Tuy nhiên, hãy giữ bí mật. Tôi không muốn những người thợ rèn khác phát hiện ra! Hãy thử tìm kiếm về phía nam của Saint City.

dialogsDecline.en: Pfft! Fine! I'll find someone else to help me, but you better keep your mouth shut!
dialogsDecline.ar: Pfft! Fine! I'll find someone else to help me, but you better keep your mouth shut!
dialogsDecline.br: Hum! Certo, eu não preciso de você! Vou encontrar outra pessoa para me ajudar, mas é melhor você ficar de boca fechada!
dialogsDecline.cns: 哼..虽然不知道你是多么的利害啦!不想帮我就算了，也没必要那么骄傲吧!
dialogsDecline.de: Huh! Ich weiß nicht wie ehrlich du bist, aber wenn du das nicht machen willst.. Auch gut! Ich brauche dich nicht.
dialogsDecline.fi: Pfft! Fine! I'll find someone else to help me, but you better keep your mouth shut!
dialogsDecline.fil: Pfft! Fine! I'll find someone else to help me, but you better keep your mouth shut!
dialogsDecline.fr: Hein ! Bon, j'ai pas besoin de toi ! T'es vraiment pas sympa...
dialogsDecline.id: Pfft! Baik! Aku akan menemukan orang lain untuk membantuku, tetapi kamu lebih baik tutup mulut!
dialogsDecline.it: Pfft! Fine! I'll find someone else to help me, but you better keep your mouth shut!
dialogsDecline.jp: なんだ、やりたくないならしかたないな。じゃ、別の人にでも頼むさ。またな。
dialogsDecline.kr: 쳇! 딴 사람 찾아볼 테니까, 대신 입은 다무세요!
dialogsDecline.nl: Pfft! Fine! I'll find someone else to help me, but you better keep your mouth shut!
dialogsDecline.pl: Pfft! Fine! I'll find someone else to help me, but you better keep your mouth shut!
dialogsDecline.ru: П-ф. Ну и ладно! Попрошу кого-нибудь другого. А ты держи рот на замке!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Pfff! ¡Vale! Encontraré a otro que me ayude, ¡pero será mejor que mantengas la boca cerrada!
dialogsDecline.sw: Pfft! Fine! I'll find someone else to help me, but you better keep your mouth shut!
dialogsDecline.th: เฮ้อ! ก็ได้! ฉันจะหาคนอื่นมาช่วย แต่เธอหุบปากไว้ดีกว่า!

dialogsComplete.en: Oh my… you found it! Real Meteoritill! I'll be rich beyond my wildest dreams! Muahahah!

dialogsComplete.fil: Oh my… you found it! Real Meteoritill! I'll be rich beyond my wildest dreams! Muahahah!

dialogsComplete.it: Oh my… you found it! Real Meteoritill! I'll be rich beyond my wildest dreams! Muahahah!

dialogsComplete.nl: Oh my… you found it! Real Meteoritill! I'll be rich beyond my wildest dreams! Muahahah!

dialogsComplete.en: Oh, I mean uh… I will be sure to make good use of this material. Here's a little something for your trouble.
dialogsComplete.ar: Oh, I mean uh… I will be sure to make good use of this material. Here's a little something for your trouble.

dialogsComplete.it: Oh, I mean uh… I will be sure to make good use of this material. Here's a little something for your trouble.
dialogsComplete.jp: しかし、本当に上質のメテオライティルだなあ。おや、ついこの美しい輝きに夢中になってしまったようだ、すまない。

dialogsComplete.nl: Oh, I mean uh… I will be sure to make good use of this material. Here's a little something for your trouble.

dialogsComplete.ru: Гм… Я хотел сказать… Из этого прекрасного материала выйдут отличные доспехи! Вот, возьми пару монеток за труды.

dialogsComplete.th: โอ้ ฉันหมายถึง เอ่อ… ฉันจะแน่ใจว่าจะใช้วัสดุนี้ให้เกิดประโยชน์ นี่เป็นรางวัลเล็กน้อยสำหรับปัญหาของคุณ
dialogsComplete.tw: 哦，我的意思是呃……我一定會好好利用這種材料的，這裡有一些東西可以解決你的麻煩。
dialogsComplete.vi: Ồ, ý tôi là ... tôi chắc chắn sẽ sử dụng tốt nguyên liệu này. Tôi đã phiền bạn một chút rồi.

dialogsComplete.it: Thanks again, friend!
dialogsComplete.jp: 上質のメテオライティルがこんなにあれば、最高の武器防具が作れるだろう！考えただけでわくわくするぜ。ありがとう！
dialogsComplete.kr: 정말 고마워요!

dialogsComplete.tw: 反正找這個應該很累吧！真的很感謝你啊…
dialogsComplete.vi: Một lần nữa xin cảm ơn bạn!

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?

dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?

dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?

dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?

dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?

dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsBegin.en: So, you think you're ready to become a Successor of the Elementor Hero? You've come a long way, Magician. I think you're ready.
dialogsBegin.ar: So, you think you're ready to become a Successor of the Elementor Hero? You've come a long way, Magician. I think you're ready.
dialogsBegin.br: Você deseja ser um sucessor do herói Elementor? Não é nada fácil. Mas acho que você está preparado, já que veio até tão longe.
dialogsBegin.cns: 要成为元素使者英雄的继承者可不简单，你要有心理准备喔！！
dialogsBegin.de: Du willst ein Nachfolger des Elementor Hero werden? Es wird nicht einfach sein, aber ich glaube du kannst es schaffen, denn immerhin bist du hierher gekommen.
dialogsBegin.fi: So, you think you're ready to become a Successor of the Elementor Hero? You've come a long way, Magician. I think you're ready.
dialogsBegin.fil: So, you think you're ready to become a Successor of the Elementor Hero? You've come a long way, Magician. I think you're ready.
dialogsBegin.fr: Souhaites-tu devenir un successeur de Lillip, le Héros des Elémentalistes ? Ce n'est pas une tâche facile, mais je pense que tu en es capable...
dialogsBegin.id: Jadi, apakah kamu sudah siap untuk menjadi Penerus Pahlawan Elementor? Kamu telah datang jauh, Penyihir. Saya pikir kamu sudah siap.
dialogsBegin.it: So, you think you're ready to become a Successor of the Elementor Hero? You've come a long way, Magician. I think you're ready.
dialogsBegin.jp: エレメンター後継者の道を歩む覚悟はできていますか？では、ご案内します。
dialogsBegin.kr: 엘리멘터 영웅의 후계자가 될 준비가 되셨다고요? 그동안 먼 길을 오셨군요, 매지션님. 확실히, 준비되었을 것 같네요.
dialogsBegin.nl: So, you think you're ready to become a Successor of the Elementor Hero? You've come a long way, Magician. I think you're ready.
dialogsBegin.pl: So, you think you're ready to become a Successor of the Elementor Hero? You've come a long way, Magician. I think you're ready.
dialogsBegin.ru: Значит, ты хочешь стать факиром? Думаю, у тебя для этого достаточно способностей. Но достаточно ли отваги?
dialogsBegin.sp: Entonces, ¿crees que estás listo para convertirte en Sucesor de la Héroe Elementor? Has recorrido un largo camino, Magician. Creo que estás listo.
dialogsBegin.sw: So, you think you're ready to become a Successor of the Elementor Hero? You've come a long way, Magician. I think you're ready.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณคิดว่าคุณพร้อมที่จะกลายเป็นผู้สืบทอดของฮีโร่ Elementor? คุณเป็นนักเวทย์มานาน ฉันคิดว่าคุณพร้อมแล้ว
dialogsBegin.tw: 要成為研術者英雄的繼承者可不簡單，你要有心理準備喔！！
dialogsBegin.vi: Vì vậy, bạn nghĩ rằng bạn đã sẵn sàng để trở thành Người kế vị của Anh hùng Elementor? Bạn đã đi một chặng đường dài, Magician. Tôi nghĩ bạn đã sẵn sàng.

description.en: Please, once more, check the Field of Bubble and the Hill of Shade. I am sure that there is more to be found!

dialogsBegin.en: I have finished translating the book. The Purple Magician and the Black Magician are the same person! Just as Hachal said!
dialogsBegin.ar: I have finished translating the book. The Purple Magician and the Black Magician are the same person! Just as Hachal said!
dialogsBegin.br: Acabei de traduzir o livro. O Mago Púrpuro e o Mago Negro são a mesma pessoa! Como Hachal disse!
dialogsBegin.cns: 我已经翻译完这本书了，紫色魔法师和黑色魔法师是同一个人！正如哈查尔所说！
dialogsBegin.de: Ich habe das Buch endlich fertig übersetzt. Der lila Magier und der schwarze Magier sind ein und dieselbe Person! Genau wie Hachal gesagt hat!
dialogsBegin.fi: I have finished translating the book. The Purple Magician and the Black Magician are the same person! Just as Hachal said!
dialogsBegin.fil: I have finished translating the book. The Purple Magician and the Black Magician are the same person! Just as Hachal said!

dialogsBegin.id: Aku telah selesai menerjemahkan bukunya. The Purple Magician dan The Black Magician ternyata orang yang sama! Tepat seperti perkataan Hachal!
dialogsBegin.it: I have finished translating the book. The Purple Magician and the Black Magician are the same person! Just as Hachal said!
dialogsBegin.jp: やっと本の翻訳が終わったぞ。ハカルの調査書の記述通り＜ブラックマジシャン＞と＜紫闇の魔導師＞は同一人物だった。
dialogsBegin.kr: 드디어 책의 내용을 모두 번역했어요. 헤이첼의 말대로 블랙 매지션과 퍼플 매지션은 같은 인물이었어요!
dialogsBegin.nl: I have finished translating the book. The Purple Magician and the Black Magician are the same person! Just as Hachal said!

dialogsBegin.sp: He terminado de traducir el libro. ¡El Mago Violeta y el Mago Negro son la misma persona! ¡Justo como dijo Hachal!
dialogsBegin.sw: I have finished translating the book. The Purple Magician and the Black Magician are the same person! Just as Hachal said!
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันแปลหนังสือเสร็จแล้ว นักมายากลสีม่วงกับนักมายากลสีดำคือคนเดียวกัน! เหมือนที่ Hachal พูดเป๊ะ!
dialogsBegin.tw: 我已經翻譯完這本書了。紫色魔法師和黑暗魔法師竟然是同一個人！就如夏格凱巴所說！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đã dịch xong cuốn sách. Pháp sư Tím và Pháp sư Đen là cùng một người! Đúng như Hachal đã nói!
