dialogsBegin.sp: Parece que el altar violeta fue hecho por el Mago Violeta para algún tipo de servicio religioso.
dialogsBegin.sw: It looks like the purple altar was made by the Magician in Purple for some kind of religious service.
dialogsBegin.th: ดูเหมือนว่าแท่นบูชาสีม่วงสร้างขึ้นโดยนักมายากลม่วงเพื่อประกอบพิธีทางศาสนา
dialogsBegin.tw: 看來這座紫色祭壇是紫色魔法師為某種宗教儀式建造的。
dialogsBegin.vi: Có vẻ như bàn thờ màu tím được tạo ra bởi Magician màu Tím cho một loại nghi lễ tôn giáo nào đó.

dialogsBegin.en: It seems that they were attempting to transcend to a better existence but how?
dialogsBegin.ar: It seems that they were attempting to transcend to a better existence but how?
dialogsBegin.br: Parece que estavam tentando transcender para uma existência melhor, mas como?
dialogsBegin.cns: 用途是这样的啦。我觉得马特尼提特拿给我的这个布条上面形容着，它是一个超越能力的东西。
dialogsBegin.de: Der Cloth Pieces zufolge, die Martinyc uns gab, stand da etwas über eine übersinnliche Existenz.
dialogsBegin.fi: It seems that they were attempting to transcend to a better existence but how?
dialogsBegin.fil: It seems that they were attempting to transcend to a better existence but how?
dialogsBegin.fr: … mais je manque d'éléments pour réellement comprendre leur signification
dialogsBegin.id: Sepertinya mereka berusaha berubah menjadi lebih kuat, namun bagaimana caranya?
dialogsBegin.it: It seems that they were attempting to transcend to a better existence but how?
dialogsBegin.jp: 以前にマルティニークからもらった資料とあわせると、＜誰か＞の部分は明らかにされず、＜超越的な存在＞という表現で記述されているのだ。普通、誰かを祀るために作られたものなら、その名前が記されてもいいものだがな…。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그들은 더 나은 존재로 초월하려 했던 것 같아요. 하지만 어떻게?
dialogsBegin.nl: It seems that they were attempting to transcend to a better existence but how?
dialogsBegin.pl: It seems that they were attempting to transcend to a better existence but how?
dialogsBegin.ru: С его помощью труппа надеялась призвать сюда созданий чистой энергии… Но как? Зачем… Здесь смысл записей ускользает от меня…
dialogsBegin.sp: Parece que estaban intentando trascender a una existencia mejor, pero ¿cómo?
dialogsBegin.sw: It seems that they were attempting to transcend to a better existence but how?
dialogsBegin.th: ดูเหมือนว่าพวกเขากำลังพยายามที่จะก้าวข้ามไปสู่การดำรงอยู่ที่ดีขึ้น แต่ยังไงล่ะ?
dialogsBegin.tw: 用途是這樣的啦。我覺得馬特尼提特拿給我的這個布條上面形容著，它是一個超越能力的東西。
dialogsBegin.vi: Có vẻ như họ đang cố gắng vượt qua một sự tồn tại tốt hơn nhưng làm thế nào?

dialogsBegin.en: As always, I have a few good theories but I need more data. Always more data! I want answers now!
dialogsBegin.ar: As always, I have a few good theories but I need more data. Always more data! I want answers now!
dialogsBegin.br: Como sempre, tenho algumas teorias boas, mas preciso de mais dados. Sempre mais dados! Quero respostas agora!
dialogsBegin.cns: 或许，那个超越能力的东西，就是祭拜对象。虽然还没有根据事实，所以啊..
dialogsBegin.de: Ich vermute die Ausführung der religiösen Dienste galten der übersinnlichen Existenz, aber es gibt dafür keinen Beweis. So...
dialogsBegin.fi: As always, I have a few good theories but I need more data. Always more data! I want answers now!
dialogsBegin.fil: As always, I have a few good theories but I need more data. Always more data! I want answers now!
dialogsBegin.fr: Il faudrait trouver de nouveaux indices, je sens que la vérité est juste devant nos yeux…
dialogsBegin.id: Seperti biasa, aku punya beberapa teori, tapi aku butuh lebih banyak data. Selalu kekuraangan data! Aku ingin jawabannya sekarang!
dialogsBegin.it: As always, I have a few good theories but I need more data. Always more data! I want answers now!
dialogsBegin.jp: その謎めいた＜超越的な存在＞が、この祭祀の対象であることはわかったが…現時点では、その存在については何も分からない。
dialogsBegin.kr: 늘 그렇듯, 떠오르는 가설은 몇 가지 있지만 더 많은 자료가 필요해요. 항상 정보가 더 있어야 하죠! 그 해답이 필요해요!
dialogsBegin.nl: As always, I have a few good theories but I need more data. Always more data! I want answers now!
dialogsBegin.pl: As always, I have a few good theories but I need more data. Always more data! I want answers now!
dialogsBegin.ru: Конечно, я могу сочинить сколько угодно теорий, но нам нужна истина! Нужно больше сведений!
dialogsBegin.sp: Como siempre, tengo algunas buenas teorías, pero necesito más datos. ¡Siempre más datos! ¡Quiero respuestas ahora!
dialogsBegin.sw: As always, I have a few good theories but I need more data. Always more data! I want answers now!
dialogsBegin.th: และเช่นเคย ฉันมีทฤษฎีที่ดีอยู่สองสามข้อ แต่ฉันต้องการข้อมูลเพิ่มเติม ข้อมูลมากขึ้นเสมอ! ฉันต้องการคำตอบตอนนี้!
dialogsBegin.tw: 或許，那個超越能力的東西，就是祭拜對象。雖然還沒有根據事實，所以啊…
dialogsBegin.vi: Như mọi khi, tôi có một vài lý thuyết hay nhưng tôi cần thêm dữ liệu. Luôn luôn nhiều dữ liệu hơn! Tôi muốn câu trả lời ngay bây giờ!

dialogsBegin.en: Would you help me again? I can see the curiosity in your eyes, same as mine. Am I right?
dialogsBegin.ar: Would you help me again? I can see the curiosity in your eyes, same as mine. Am I right?
dialogsBegin.br: Você me ajudaria novamente? Vejo que está tão curioso quanto eu. Estou certo?
dialogsBegin.cns: 可以在帮我一下吗?我看你应该也很想知道真实吧。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich würde dich gerne bitten mir erneut zu helfen. Ich denke du willst auch wissen wie das Resultat aussieht. Liege ich da richtig?
dialogsBegin.fi: Would you help me again? I can see the curiosity in your eyes, same as mine. Am I right?
dialogsBegin.fil: Would you help me again? I can see the curiosity in your eyes, same as mine. Am I right?
dialogsBegin.fr: Comme tu t'en doutes, je compte encore sur toi. Je peux te faire confiance ?
dialogsBegin.id: Maukah Kamu membantuku lagi? Aku bisa melihat rasa ingin tahu di matamu, sama sepertiku. Benarkan?
dialogsBegin.it: Would you help me again? I can see the curiosity in your eyes, same as mine. Am I right?
dialogsBegin.jp: そこで、もう一度調査を頼みたいのだが。君もきっと、結果が知りたいだろう？
dialogsBegin.kr: 도와주시겠어요? 당신 눈에도 호기심이 가득해 보여요. 저처럼요. 제 말이 맞죠?
dialogsBegin.nl: Would you help me again? I can see the curiosity in your eyes, same as mine. Am I right?
dialogsBegin.pl: Would you help me again? I can see the curiosity in your eyes, same as mine. Am I right?
dialogsBegin.ru: Надеюсь, ты мне поможешь. А, загорелись глаза, да? Тебе ведь тоже любопытно узнать правду?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Me ayudarás otra vez? Puedo ver la curiosidad en tus ojos, igual que en los míos. ¿Tengo razón?
dialogsBegin.sw: Would you help me again? I can see the curiosity in your eyes, same as mine. Am I right?
dialogsBegin.th: คุณช่วยฉันอีกครั้งได้ไหม ฉันสามารถเห็นความอยากรู้อยากเห็นในดวงตาของคุณ เหมือนกับของฉัน ฉันถูกไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 可以在幫我一下嗎？我看你應該也很想知道真實吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có thể giúp tôi một lần nữa? Tôi có thể thấy sự tò mò trong mắt bạn, cũng như của tôi. Tôi nói đúng chứ?

dialogsAccept.en: Very well! Then please check the Field of Bubble and the Hill of Shade more carefully. I am really sure there is something over there!
dialogsAccept.ar: Very well! Then please check the Field of Bubble and the Hill of Shade more carefully. I am really sure there is something over there!
dialogsAccept.br: Muito bem! Busque na Planície de Bubble e na Colina de Shade mais cuidadosamente. Tenho certeza de que há algo por lá!
dialogsAccept.cns: 好吧，你仔细的帮我去调查一下波布尔的平原跟谢德莉丘岭。那边!!一定!!会有线索。
dialogsAccept.de: Gut! Dann untersuche bitte die Ebene von Bubble und den Hügel von Shade sorgfältig. Ich bin mir ziemlich sicher, dass du dort etwas finden wirst!!
dialogsAccept.fi: Very well! Then please check the Field of Bubble and the Hill of Shade more carefully. I am really sure there is something over there!
dialogsAccept.fil: Very well! Then please check the Field of Bubble and the Hill of Shade more carefully. I am really sure there is something over there!
dialogsAccept.fr: Merci d'avance ! Bon je pense qu'il faudrait
dialogsAccept.id: Baiklah! Kalau begitu tolong cek Field of Bubble dan Hill of Shade lebih teliti. Aku sangat yakin ada sesuatu tertinggal disana!
dialogsAccept.it: Very well! Then please check the Field of Bubble and the Hill of Shade more carefully. I am really sure there is something over there!
dialogsAccept.jp: では、君が布切れを拾ってきた＜バブルの平原＞と＜シェードの丘＞を、もう一度調べてきてくれないか？恐らくあの場所にはまだ、鍵となるものが隠されていると思うんだ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 좋아요! 그렇다면 버블의 장과 쉐이드 언덕을 좀 더 자세히 조사해 주세요. 그 근처에 무언가 있을 게 분명해요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Very well! Then please check the Field of Bubble and the Hill of Shade more carefully. I am really sure there is something over there!
dialogsAccept.pl: Very well! Then please check the Field of Bubble and the Hill of Shade more carefully. I am really sure there is something over there!
dialogsAccept.ru: Отлично! Тогда отправляйся на Лучистое поле и Тенистый холм. Кажется, мы кое-что упустили!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Muy bien! Explora la Llanura de Bubble y la Colina de Shade con más detalle. ¡Estoy segura de que hay algo allí!
dialogsAccept.sw: Very well! Then please check the Field of Bubble and the Hill of Shade more carefully. I am really sure there is something over there!
dialogsAccept.th: ดีมาก! จากนั้นโปรดตรวจสอบ Field of Bubble และ Hill of Shade ให้ละเอียดยิ่งขึ้น ฉันแน่ใจว่ามีบางอย่างอยู่ที่นั่นจริงๆ!
dialogsAccept.tw: 好吧，你仔細的幫我去調查一下巴布樂平原跟闇影丘嶺。那邊！！一定！！會有線索。
dialogsAccept.vi: Rất tốt! Sau đó, hãy kiểm tra Cánh đồng bong bóng và Đồi bóng râm cẩn thận hơn. Tôi thực sự chắc chắn rằng có một cái gì đó ở đó!

dialogsDecline.en: Fine, return to me when you get the time.
dialogsDecline.ar: Fine, return to me when you get the time.
dialogsDecline.br: Está bem, dê um retorno quando tiver tempo.
dialogsDecline.cns: 如果没有什么急事的话，先帮我处里这件事情好吗?
dialogsDecline.de: Wenn du nichts spezielles zu tun hast, hoffe ich das du dieses zuerst erledigst.
dialogsDecline.fi: Fine, return to me when you get the time.
dialogsDecline.fil: Fine, return to me when you get the time.
dialogsDecline.fr: La vérité mérite parfois des sacrifices tu sais !
dialogsDecline.id: Baik, Temui aku saat kau sedang senggang.
dialogsDecline.it: Fine, return to me when you get the time.
dialogsDecline.jp: 何か急ぎの用ではないのなら、私の頼みを先に聞いてほしいのだが。どうかお願いするよ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 그래요, 시간 되실 때 다시 와 주세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Fine, return to me when you get the time.
dialogsDecline.pl: Fine, return to me when you get the time.
dialogsDecline.ru: Хорошо. Но если выкроишь время - скажи.
dialogsDecline.sp: Vale, vuelve cuando tengas tiempo.
dialogsDecline.sw: Fine, return to me when you get the time.
dialogsDecline.th: ได้ กลับมาหาฉันเมื่อคุณมีเวลา
dialogsDecline.tw: 如果沒有什麼急事的話，先幫我處裡這件事情好嗎？
dialogsDecline.vi: Tốt thôi, hãy trả lại cho tôi khi bạn có thời gian.

dialogsComplete.en: Oh... What a strong magical power this bead has... Oh... What a surprise!
dialogsComplete.ar: Oh... What a strong magical power this bead has... Oh... What a surprise!
dialogsComplete.br: Oh... Que poder forte e mágico esta pérola tem... Oh... Que surpresa!
dialogsComplete.cns: Oh... What a strong magical power this bead has... Oh... What a surprise!
dialogsComplete.de: Huh? Oh.. Oh was für eine starke magische Energie diese Perle hat.. Oh.. Welch Überraschung..!!
dialogsComplete.fi: Oh... What a strong magical power this bead has... Oh... What a surprise!
dialogsComplete.fil: Oh... What a strong magical power this bead has... Oh... What a surprise!
dialogsComplete.fr: (surpris) Oh ! Ces parchemins que tu as trouvés renferment un pouvoir magique si grand ! Vraiment impressionnant !
dialogsComplete.id: Hmm.. Semuanya tertulis dalam bahasa Kuno. Untungnya kita dapat menerjemahkannya. Terima kasih.
dialogsComplete.it: Oh... What a strong magical power this bead has... Oh... What a surprise!
dialogsComplete.jp: こ、このオーブは…！こんなに強い魔力を発するオーブがあるとは。これはこれは…驚くことばかりだ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 오... 이 구슬의 마력이 얼마나 강한지... 오... 놀랍지 않나요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Oh... What a strong magical power this bead has... Oh... What a surprise!
dialogsComplete.pl: Oh... What a strong magical power this bead has... Oh... What a surprise!
dialogsComplete.ru: Oh... What a strong magical power this bead has... Oh... What a surprise!
dialogsComplete.sp: Oh... ¡Qué poder mágico tan fuerte tiene esta perla... Oh... ¡Qué sorpresa!
dialogsComplete.sw: Oh... What a strong magical power this bead has... Oh... What a surprise!
dialogsComplete.th: โอ้.. ลูกปัดนี้มีพลังเวทย์มนตร์ที่แข็งแกร่งจริงๆ.. ช่างน่าประหลาดใจจริงๆ!
dialogsComplete.tw: 喔……這顆珠子裡蘊含的魔力好強……真讓人吃驚！
dialogsComplete.vi: Ôi .. Hạt này có ma lực mạnh làm sao.. Ôi .. Thật là bất ngờ!

dialogsComplete.en: Good job...But something like this is completely out of my range. Let me think for a moment. Yes, I have it!
dialogsComplete.ar: Good job...But something like this is completely out of my range. Let me think for a moment. Yes, I have it!
dialogsComplete.br: Bom trabalho...Mas algo como isso está totalmente fora do meu alcance. Vou pensar por um momento. Sim. Tenho isso.
dialogsComplete.cns: Good job...But something like this is completely out of my range. Let me think for a moment. Yes, I have it!
dialogsComplete.de: Gute Arbeit... Aber so etwas liegt völlig außerhalb meiner Möglichkeiten. Ich muss einen Moment nachdenken. Ja, ich habe es!
dialogsComplete.fi: Good job...But something like this is completely out of my range. Let me think for a moment. Yes, I have it!
dialogsComplete.fil: Good job...But something like this is completely out of my range. Let me think for a moment. Yes, I have it!
dialogsComplete.fr: Merci encore ! Cependant je ne suis pas en mesure de manipuler de telles forces… (réfléchissant) Peut-être que…
dialogsComplete.id: Kerja bagus. Tapi sesuatu seperti ini benar-benar diluar bidangku. Biarkan aku berpikir sejenak. Ya, aku memilikinya!
dialogsComplete.it: Good job...But something like this is completely out of my range. Let me think for a moment. Yes, I have it!
dialogsComplete.jp: 手がかりを見つけてきてくれてありがとう、ごくろう。しかし…これはもう、わたしが手におえる問題ではなくなってしまったかもしれない…。
dialogsComplete.kr: 잘하셨어요.. 하지만 이런 건 제 능력 밖의 일이거든요. 잠깐 생각 좀 해볼게요. 오, 찾았어요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Good job...But something like this is completely out of my range. Let me think for a moment. Yes, I have it!
dialogsComplete.pl: Good job...But something like this is completely out of my range. Let me think for a moment. Yes, I have it!
dialogsComplete.ru: Good job...But something like this is completely out of my range. Let me think for a moment. Yes, I have it!
dialogsComplete.sp: Buen trabajo... Pero esto está completamente fuera de mi alcance. Déjame pensar por un momento. ¡Si, lo tengo!
dialogsComplete.sw: Good job...But something like this is completely out of my range. Let me think for a moment. Yes, I have it!
dialogsComplete.th: ทำได้ดีมาก แต่บางอย่างเช่นนี้อยู่นอกขอบเขตของฉัน ขอคิดสักครู่ อา...ใช่ ฉันนึกออกแล้ว!
dialogsComplete.tw: 做得好……不過這種東西已經完全超出我的能力範圍了。讓我想一想……有了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Làm tốt lắm..Nhưng những thứ như thế này hoàn toàn vượt quá khả năng của tôi. Để tôi suy nghĩ chút. Ừ, tôi có nó đấy!

dialogsComplete.en: Please deliver this to the Great Magician Laola in Darkon 3.
dialogsComplete.ar: Please deliver this to the Great Magician Laola in Darkon 3.
dialogsComplete.br: Entregue isto à Grande Maga Laola em Darkon 3.
dialogsComplete.cns: 拿着这个到达肯3的艾音娜特去找大魔导士<拉宇>吧。
dialogsComplete.de: Bitte bringe dies zu Laola. Sie ist die große Magierin in Darkon3 Ainceknight.
dialogsComplete.fi: Please deliver this to the Great Magician Laola in Darkon 3.
dialogsComplete.fil: Please deliver this to the Great Magician Laola in Darkon 3.
dialogsComplete.fr: Oui ! Je ne vois que l'Archimage Laola pour accomplir cela ! Il faut que tu ailles la trouver à Anicenight, à Darkon 3.
dialogsComplete.id: Mohon serahkan ini ke Great Magician Laola di Darkon 3.
dialogsComplete.it: Please deliver this to the Great Magician Laola in Darkon 3.
dialogsComplete.jp: これを至急、エンシェントナイトにいる大魔導師＜ラオラ＞というマジシャンに渡してくれ。ラオラ様なら何かを知っているだろう。頼んだよ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이것을 다콘 제3지구에 있는 대매지션 라올라에게 전해주세요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Please deliver this to the Great Magician Laola in Darkon 3.
dialogsComplete.pl: Please deliver this to the Great Magician Laola in Darkon 3.
dialogsComplete.ru: Разыщи в Дарконе-3 ведьму Лолу.
dialogsComplete.sp: Por favor entrégale esto a la Gran Maga Laola en Darkon 3.
dialogsComplete.sw: Please deliver this to the Great Magician Laola in Darkon 3.
dialogsComplete.th: โปรดส่งสิ่งนี้ไปยัง Great Magician Laola ใน Darkon 3
dialogsComplete.tw: 請把這個交給得肯第三區的大魔法使拉宇。
dialogsComplete.vi: Hãy giao cái này cho Great Magician Laola trong Darkon 3.

dialogsFail.en: I have a bad feeling about this. I have never been wrong about anything. I hope I am this time.
dialogsFail.ar: I have a bad feeling about this. I have never been wrong about anything. I hope I am this time.
dialogsFail.br: Tenho uma sensação ruim sobre isso. Nunca estive errado sobre nada. Espero estar desta vez.
dialogsFail.cns: 很难找吗?可是我真的觉得有啊，我的预感从来没错过~
dialogsFail.de: Ist es schwer herauszufinden? Aber es ist möglich! Ja!! Meine Vorahnungen lagen nie falsch. (sorgend)
dialogsFail.fi: I have a bad feeling about this. I have never been wrong about anything. I hope I am this time.
dialogsFail.fil: I have a bad feeling about this. I have never been wrong about anything. I hope I am this time.
dialogsFail.fr: Tu n'arrives vraiment pas à trouver de nouveaux indices ? (prend un air inquiet))
dialogsFail.id: Aku punya firasat buruk tentang hal ini. Firasatku tidak pernah salah sebelumnya. Aku harap kali ini salah.
dialogsFail.it: I have a bad feeling about this. I have never been wrong about anything. I hope I am this time.
dialogsFail.jp: ふむ、いくら探しても見つからないと？諦めず、根気よく探してみてくれ。必ず、手がかりになる証拠があるはずだ。頼んだよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 왠지 불길한 예감이 드네요. 지금껏 직감이 틀린 적이 없는데. 이번만은 부디 틀렸기를 바라지만...
dialogsFail.nl: I have a bad feeling about this. I have never been wrong about anything. I hope I am this time.
dialogsFail.pl: I have a bad feeling about this. I have never been wrong about anything. I hope I am this time.
dialogsFail.ru: Ох, нехорошее у меня предчувствие… А ведь предчувствие меня никогда не обманывало. Хоть бы на этот раз ошибиться!..
dialogsFail.sp: Tengo un mal presentimiento. Nunca me equivoco en nada. Espero que esta vez sí.
dialogsFail.sw: I have a bad feeling about this. I have never been wrong about anything. I hope I am this time.
dialogsFail.th: ฉันมีความรู้สึกไม่ดีเกี่ยวกับเรื่องนี้ ฉันไม่เคยผิดอะไร ฉันหวังว่าฉันจะเป็นครั้งนี้
dialogsFail.tw: 很難找嗎？可是我真的覺得有啊，我的預感從來沒錯過~
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi có một cảm giác xấu về việc này. Tôi chưa bao giờ sai về bất cứ điều gì. Tôi hy vọng tôi là thời gian này.

description.en: Locate the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, and present it to Pereb, the Psykeeper Priest at the Altar of Psykeeper in Darkon 3.
description.ar: Locate the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, and present it to Pereb, the Psykeeper Priest at the Altar of Psykeeper in Darkon 3.
description.br: Localize o $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ e mostre para Pereb, a Sacerdotisa Psykeeper no Altar do Psykeeper em Darkon 3.
description.cns: 请到达肯第2区爱安芙凯博找到欧布华矿石，再去达肯第三区域海乐伊地区找精神使者祭司安得利尔。
description.de: Finde den $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ und überreiche ihn Pereb, dem Psykeeper Priester, am Altar des Psykeepers in Darkon 3.

description.fr: Retrouver la $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ dans la Caverne de l'Envie de Darkon 2, et la remettre à Pererb, à l'Autel des Sorciers de Darkon 3.
description.id: Temukan $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, dan berikan kepada Pereb, Psykeeper Priest di Altar of Psykeeper di Darkon 3.
description.it: Locate the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, and present it to Pereb, the Psykeeper Priest at the Altar of Psykeeper in Darkon 3.

description.kr: 다콘 제2지구 엔비 동굴 어딘가에 있는 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ 탐색을 수행하고, 다콘 제3지구의 사이키퍼 제단에 있는 사제 퍼에브를 만나세요.

description.sw: Locate the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, and present it to Pereb, the Psykeeper Priest at the Altar of Psykeeper in Darkon 3.
description.th: ค้นหา $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ และมอบให้ Pereb Psykeeper Priest ที่ Altar of Psykeeper ใน Darkon 3
description.tw: 找到 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$，並交給得肯 3 念力師祭壇的念力師祭司佩雷布。
description.vi: Tìm $ QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME $ và đưa nó cho Pereb, Psykeeper Priest tại Altar of Psykeeper trong Darkon 3.

dialogsBegin.en: No, on to your next challenge, Magician! I need you to speak with someone.
dialogsBegin.ar: No, on to your next challenge, Magician! I need you to speak with someone.
dialogsBegin.br: Agora, para o seu próximo desafio, jovem Mago(a)! Eu preciso que você fale com alguém.
dialogsBegin.cns: 请你去找达肯第3区的精神使者的祭坛找祭司【安得利尔】。
dialogsBegin.de: Nein, auf zu deiner nächsten Herausforderung, Magier! Ich möchte, dass du mit jemandem sprichst.
dialogsBegin.fi: No, on to your next challenge, Magician! I need you to speak with someone.
dialogsBegin.fil: No, on to your next challenge, Magician! I need you to speak with someone.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu approches de ton but. et la fin de ton apprentissage se passera à Darkon 3 ! Là-bas, tu trouveras l'Autel où siège Pereb, la Doyenne des Sorciers.
dialogsBegin.id: Tidak, tantangan berikutnya, Penyihir! Aku ingin kau berbicara dengan seseorang.
dialogsBegin.it: No, on to your next challenge, Magician! I need you to speak with someone.
dialogsBegin.jp: いいえ、次の挑戦に挑もう！マジシャン！ 私は君と話さないといけません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 좋아요, 다음 과제를 드릴게요, 매지션님. 누군가를 찾아가 주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: No, on to your next challenge, Magician! I need you to speak with someone.
dialogsBegin.pl: No, on to your next challenge, Magician! I need you to speak with someone.
dialogsBegin.ru: No, on to your next challenge, Magician! I need you to speak with someone.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡A por tu próximo desafío, Magician! Necesito que hables con alguien.
dialogsBegin.sw: No, on to your next challenge, Magician! I need you to speak with someone.
dialogsBegin.th: ไม่มีความท้าทายต่อไปของคุณ Magician! ฉันต้องการให้คุณพูดคุยกับใครสักคน
dialogsBegin.tw: 請你去找得肯第三區的念力師的祭壇找祭司 [安得利爾]。
dialogsBegin.vi: Không, hãy sẵn sàng với thử thách tiếp theo của bạn, Magician! Tôi cần bạn nói chuyện với ai đó.

dialogsBegin.en: Pereb, the Psykeeper Priest, is trying to locate an ancient Relic from the war somewhere in the Cave of Envy in Darkon 2. It's called the Trace of Offerep.
dialogsBegin.ar: Pereb, the Psykeeper Priest, is trying to locate an ancient Relic from the war somewhere in the Cave of Envy in Darkon 2. It's called the Trace of Offerep.
dialogsBegin.br: Pereb, a Sacerdotisa Psykeeper, está tentando localizar uma antiga relíquia da guerra em algum lugar da Caverna da Inveja em Darkon 2. É chamada de Vestígio de Offerep.
dialogsBegin.cns: 安得利尔在寻找欧布华矿石，因为那遗物非常有价值！
dialogsBegin.de: Pereb, der Psykeeper Priester versucht, ein uraltes Relikt aus dem Krieg irgendwo in der Höhle des Neids in Darkon 2 zu finden. Sie heißt "Trace of Offerep".
dialogsBegin.fi: Pereb, the Psykeeper Priest, is trying to locate an ancient Relic from the war somewhere in the Cave of Envy in Darkon 2. It's called the Trace of Offerep.
dialogsBegin.fil: Pereb, the Psykeeper Priest, is trying to locate an ancient Relic from the war somewhere in the Cave of Envy in Darkon 2. It's called the Trace of Offerep.
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais avant cela. Il y a une mission que tu dois accomplir. Pereb est à la recherche de la Trace d'Offerep, perdue après la Grande Guerre.
dialogsBegin.id: Pereb, Psykeeper Priest, sedang mencoba untuk menemukan Relik kuno dari perang di suatu tempat di Cave of Envy in Darkon 2. Ini disebut Trace of Offerep.
dialogsBegin.it: Pereb, the Psykeeper Priest, is trying to locate an ancient Relic from the war somewhere in the Cave of Envy in Darkon 2. It's called the Trace of Offerep.
dialogsBegin.jp: ハーマイオ様はダーコン第2地区（エイエンブルケーブ）のどこかにあるオルファー様の聖遺物を探していたなぁ。相当価値のあるものらしいね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 사이키퍼 사제 퍼에브님은 고대 전쟁의 성물인, 오퍼엡의 흔적을 찾고 있어요. 다콘 제2지구의 엔비 동굴 어딘가에 있다고 들었습니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Pereb, the Psykeeper Priest, is trying to locate an ancient Relic from the war somewhere in the Cave of Envy in Darkon 2. It's called the Trace of Offerep.
dialogsBegin.pl: Pereb, the Psykeeper Priest, is trying to locate an ancient Relic from the war somewhere in the Cave of Envy in Darkon 2. It's called the Trace of Offerep.
dialogsBegin.ru: Pereb, the Psykeeper Priest, is trying to locate an ancient Relic from the war somewhere in the Cave of Envy in Darkon 2. It's called the Trace of Offerep.
dialogsBegin.sp: Pereb, la Sacerdotisa Psykeeper, está intentando localizar una reliquia antigua de la guerra cerca de la Cueva de la Envidia en Darkon 2. Se llama la Huella de Offerep.
dialogsBegin.sw: Pereb, the Psykeeper Priest, is trying to locate an ancient Relic from the war somewhere in the Cave of Envy in Darkon 2. It's called the Trace of Offerep.
dialogsBegin.th: Pereb นักบวช Psykeeper กำลังพยายามหา Relic โบราณจากสงครามที่ไหนสักแห่งใน Eienble Cave ใน Darkon 2 เรียกว่า Trace of Offerep
dialogsBegin.tw: 念力師祭司佩雷布正在得肯第二區的嫉妒洞窟中尋找一件古老的戰爭遺物，叫做歐布華的痕跡。
dialogsBegin.vi: Pereb, Psykeeper Priest, đang cố gắng tìm một di vật cổ xưa từ cuộc chiến tranh ở đâu đó trong Cave of Envy trong Darkon 2. Nó được gọi là Trace of Offerep.

dialogsAccept.en: Well, what are you waiting for? Get moving!
dialogsAccept.ar: Well, what are you waiting for? Get moving!
dialogsAccept.br: Bem, o que você está esperando? Mexa-se!
dialogsAccept.cns: 那么就拜托你了！
dialogsAccept.de: Worauf wartest du dann noch? Beweg dich!
dialogsAccept.fi: Well, what are you waiting for? Get moving!
dialogsAccept.fil: Well, what are you waiting for? Get moving!
dialogsAccept.fr: Bonne chance, futur Sorcier !
dialogsAccept.id: Nah, tunggu apa lagi? Bergerak!
dialogsAccept.it: Well, what are you waiting for? Get moving!
dialogsAccept.jp: では、よろしくお願いします。
dialogsAccept.kr: 뭘 망설이고 계신가요? 어서 출발하세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Well, what are you waiting for? Get moving!
dialogsAccept.pl: Well, what are you waiting for? Get moving!
dialogsAccept.ru: Well, what are you waiting for? Get moving!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¿Bueno, a qué esperas? ¡Muévete!
dialogsAccept.sw: Well, what are you waiting for? Get moving!
dialogsAccept.th: เอาละ คุณกำลังรออะไรอยู่ ไปสิ!
dialogsAccept.tw: 那麼，你還等什麼呢？動起來！
dialogsAccept.vi: À, bạn đang đợi gì vậy? Đi thôi!

dialogsDecline.en: Don't give up now, Magician. You're so close!
dialogsDecline.ar: Don't give up now, Magician. You're so close!
dialogsDecline.br: Como eu disse, é muito importante e valiosa. Nós realmente precisamos dele, então por favor encontre-o.
dialogsDecline.cns: 我非常需要那东西，所以请一定要找回来喔！
dialogsDecline.de: Wie ich bereits sagte, es ist wertvoll und wichtig. Wir brauchen es wirklich, also finde es bitte.
dialogsDecline.fi: Don't give up now, Magician. You're so close!
dialogsDecline.fil: Don't give up now, Magician. You're so close!
dialogsDecline.fr: Il est vraiment important de retrouver cette relique. Nous comptons tous sur toi.
dialogsDecline.id: Jangan menyerah sekarang, Penyihir. Kamu sangat dekat!
dialogsDecline.it: Don't give up now, Magician. You're so close!
dialogsDecline.jp: あのなあ、俺らも暇や酔狂で探してるんじゃないんだぜ！真面目にやってくれ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 지금 포기하시면 안 돼요. 이제 거의 다 왔잖아요!
dialogsDecline.nl: Don't give up now, Magician. You're so close!
dialogsDecline.pl: Don't give up now, Magician. You're so close!
dialogsDecline.ru: Не сдавайся, фокусник! Ты почти у цели!
dialogsDecline.sp: No te rindas ahora, Magician. ¡Estás muy cerca!
dialogsDecline.sw: Don't give up now, Magician. You're so close!
dialogsDecline.th: อย่ายอมแพ้ตอนนี้ Magician คุณใกล้ทำสำเร็จแล้ว!
dialogsDecline.tw: 我非常需要那東西，所以請一定要找回來喔！
dialogsDecline.vi: Đừng bỏ cuộc bây giờ, Magician. Bạn sắp hoàn thành rồi!

dialogsComplete.en: I am grateful that you've brought the Trace of Offerep, Magician. I have been searching for this for a very long time.
dialogsComplete.ar: I am grateful that you've brought the Trace of Offerep, Magician. I have been searching for this for a very long time.
dialogsComplete.br: Oh, finalmente... Você finalmente o encontrou.. Não consigo parar de chorar, pois estou tão grata...
dialogsComplete.cns: 终于找到了，这是我最尊敬的人的遗物！好高兴喔！真是的，我高兴的眼泪都流出来了…
dialogsComplete.de: Oh, endlich.. Endlich hast du es gefunden.. *schluchzen* Ich kann nicht aufhören zu weinen, weil ich so glücklich bin.
dialogsComplete.fi: I am grateful that you've brought the Trace of Offerep, Magician. I have been searching for this for a very long time.
dialogsComplete.fil: I am grateful that you've brought the Trace of Offerep, Magician. I have been searching for this for a very long time.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tu as retrouvé la Trace d'Offerep ! Elle était introuvable depuis la Grande Guerre.
dialogsComplete.id: Saya bersyukur bahwa kamu telah membawa Trace of Offerep, Penyihir. Saya telah mencari ini untuk waktu yang sangat lama.
dialogsComplete.it: I am grateful that you've brought the Trace of Offerep, Magician. I have been searching for this for a very long time.
dialogsComplete.jp: ああ、これはオルファー様の･･･。なんて嬉しい！この日をどんなに待っていたか。･･･ああ、ごめんよ、涙が止まらないや･･･。
dialogsComplete.kr: 오퍼엡의 흔적을 찾아주셔서 감사합니다, 매지션님. 정말 오래도록 찾아 헤맸던 성물이었어요.
dialogsComplete.nl: I am grateful that you've brought the Trace of Offerep, Magician. I have been searching for this for a very long time.
dialogsComplete.pl: I am grateful that you've brought the Trace of Offerep, Magician. I have been searching for this for a very long time.
dialogsComplete.ru: Благодарю тебя, фокусник. Я давно ищу Звезду Коверфильда.
dialogsComplete.sp: Te agradezco que hayas traído la Huella de Offerep, Magician. La he estado buscando durante mucho tiempo.
dialogsComplete.sw: I am grateful that you've brought the Trace of Offerep, Magician. I have been searching for this for a very long time.
dialogsComplete.th: ฉันรู้สึกขอบคุณที่ได้นำมาซึ่งการติดตามผลของ Offerep Magician ฉันกำลังค้นหาสิ่งนี้มาเป็นเวลานาน
dialogsComplete.tw: 終於找到了，這是我最尊敬的人的遺物！好高興喔！真是的，我高興的眼淚都流出來了…
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi rất biết ơn vì bạn đã mang theo Trace of Offerep, Magician à. Tôi đã tìm kiếm cái này trong một thời gian rất dài.

dialogsComplete.en: You possess great potential, young Magician. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsComplete.ar: You possess great potential, young Magician. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsComplete.br: Muito obrigada. Agora a relíquia está onde deve estar. Obrigada.
dialogsComplete.cns: 真的谢谢你喔！真的好幸福喔！可以找回这遗物(哭泣声)
dialogsComplete.de: Vielen Dank. Nun ist das Relikt wo es hingehört. Danke.
dialogsComplete.fi: You possess great potential, young Magician. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsComplete.fil: You possess great potential, young Magician. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsComplete.fr: Quoiqu'il en soit, merci beaucoup ! Désormais cette relique se trouve là où elle aurait toujours dû être.
dialogsComplete.id: Kamu memiliki potensi besar, Penyihir muda. Teruslah bekerja keras dan kamu akan mewujudkan impian kamu.
dialogsComplete.it: You possess great potential, young Magician. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsComplete.jp: どうもありがとう！やっとあるべきところにろに戻さってきたね。オルファー様、お帰りなさい･･･。
dialogsComplete.kr: 당신은 큰 잠재력을 지니고 있어요, 매지션님. 계속 노력하신다면 분명 꿈을 이루실 수 있을 거예요.
dialogsComplete.nl: You possess great potential, young Magician. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsComplete.pl: You possess great potential, young Magician. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsComplete.ru: Тебя ждут великие дела. Продолжай идти к своей мечте.
dialogsComplete.sp: Posees un gran potencial, joven Magician. Sigue trabajando duro y lograrás tu sueño.
dialogsComplete.sw: You possess great potential, young Magician. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsComplete.th: คุณมีศักยภาพที่ดี Magician หนุ่ม ทำงานหนักและคุณจะตระหนักถึงความฝันของคุณ
dialogsComplete.tw: 真的謝謝你喔！真的好幸福喔！可以找回這遺物 (哭泣聲)
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn có tiềm năng tuyệt vời, Magician trẻ tuổi. Hãy tiếp tục làm việc chăm chỉ và bạn sẽ thực hiện được ước mơ của mình.

dialogsFail.en: This is the alter where the Souls of Heroes are protected. What can I do for you, young one?
dialogsFail.ar: This is the alter where the Souls of Heroes are protected. What can I do for you, young one?
dialogsFail.br: Este é o altar onde as Almas dos Heróis são protegidas. O que posso fazer por você, jovem?
dialogsFail.cns: 这里是守护欧布华灵魂的祭坛，你怎么会到这里来呢？
dialogsFail.de: Dies ist der Altar, in dem die Souls of Heroes geschützt werden. Was kann ich für dich tun, junger Mann?
dialogsFail.fi: This is the alter where the Souls of Heroes are protected. What can I do for you, young one?
dialogsFail.fil: This is the alter where the Souls of Heroes are protected. What can I do for you, young one?
dialogsFail.fr: En ce lieu nous protégeons les âmes des Héros. Mais quelle est la raison de ta venue ?
dialogsFail.id: Ini adalah alter dimana Jiwa Pahlawan dilindungi. Apa yang bisa saya lakukan untukmu, anak muda?
dialogsFail.it: This is the alter where the Souls of Heroes are protected. What can I do for you, young one?
dialogsFail.jp: ここは英雄たちの魂を守る祭壇です。何か用かい？
dialogsFail.kr: 이곳은 영웅들의 영혼이 잠들어 있는 제단입니다. 무슨 일로 찾아오셨지요?
dialogsFail.nl: This is the alter where the Souls of Heroes are protected. What can I do for you, young one?
dialogsFail.pl: This is the alter where the Souls of Heroes are protected. What can I do for you, young one?

dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nhiệm vụ của bạn đã được hoàn thành. Tội lỗi của bạn đã được tha thứ.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Hmm... What should I do? Hey, can you help me?
dialogsBegin.ar: Hmm... What should I do? Hey, can you help me?
dialogsBegin.br: Hmm... O que devo fazer? Ei, pode me ajudar?
dialogsBegin.cns: Hmm... What should I do? Hey, can you help me?
dialogsBegin.de: Hmm ... Was soll ich tun? Hey, kannst du mir helfen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Hmm... What should I do? Hey, can you help me?
dialogsBegin.fil: Hmm... What should I do? Hey, can you help me?
dialogsBegin.fr: (pensive) Hmm... Que dois-je faire ?! (vous regardant) Je suis vraiment heureuse de te rencontrer en tout cas, crois-tu que tu pourrais m'aider ?
dialogsBegin.id: Hmm.. Apa yang harus kulakukan? Hei, bisakah bantu aku?
dialogsBegin.it: Hmm... What should I do? Hey, can you help me?
dialogsBegin.jp: うーん、これは一体どういうことなのかしら…。あら！あなたはいつからそこにいたの？考え事をしていて全然気が付かなかったわ、ごめんなさい。
dialogsBegin.kr: 흠... 어떡하죠? 저, 좀 도와주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Hmm... What should I do? Hey, can you help me?
dialogsBegin.pl: Hmm... What should I do? Hey, can you help me?
dialogsBegin.ru: Hmm... What should I do? Hey, can you help me?
dialogsBegin.sp: Hmm... ¿Qué debo hacer? Oye, ¿Puedes ayudarme?
dialogsBegin.sw: Hmm... What should I do? Hey, can you help me?
dialogsBegin.th: อืม... ฉันจะทำยังไงดี? เฮ้ คุณช่วยฉันได้ไหม
dialogsBegin.tw: 嗯……我該怎麼辦呢？欸，你可以幫我嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Hmm .. Tôi phải làm gì đây? Này, bạn có thể giúp tôi được không?

dialogsBegin.en: I have been worried for so long, I know I must look a mess. It is good to have a friendly ear to turn to.
dialogsBegin.ar: I have been worried for so long, I know I must look a mess. It is good to have a friendly ear to turn to.
dialogsBegin.br: Estou preocupada há tanto tempo, sei que pareço estar mal. É bom ter alguém com quem conversar.
dialogsBegin.cns: 真的很感谢你啊~其实，最近有一件事情让我很烦恼，皮肤也变的很差..
dialogsBegin.de: Vielen Dank, dass du zu mir gekommen bist. Ich bin über ein paar Dinge in Sorge. Deshalb sehe ich so deprimiert aus.
dialogsBegin.fi: I have been worried for so long, I know I must look a mess. It is good to have a friendly ear to turn to.
dialogsBegin.fil: I have been worried for so long, I know I must look a mess. It is good to have a friendly ear to turn to.
dialogsBegin.fr: Pour être tout à fait honnête, quelque chose m'angoisse depuis quelques temps…
dialogsBegin.id: Sejak lama aku khawatir, aku tahu kalau aku mungkin terlihat berantakan. Rasanya nyaman sekali ada teman yang mau mendengarkanku.
dialogsBegin.it: I have been worried for so long, I know I must look a mess. It is good to have a friendly ear to turn to.
dialogsBegin.jp: 最近、悩み事だらけで・・・悩みすぎて肌が荒れてきちゃったくらいです。ふふふ。ちょうどよかった、ちょっと手伝ってもらいたいことがあるのですが、よろしいでしょうか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 계속 걱정만 하다 보니, 얼굴이 엉망이 됐네요. 이렇게 이야기를 들어주는 사람이 있으니 좋군요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I have been worried for so long, I know I must look a mess. It is good to have a friendly ear to turn to.
dialogsBegin.pl: I have been worried for so long, I know I must look a mess. It is good to have a friendly ear to turn to.
dialogsBegin.ru: Кручусь, как белка в колесе, ни на что времени нет! До ратуши два шага, а я все до нее дойти не могу.
dialogsBegin.sp: He estado preocupada durante tanto tiempo que debo parecer una lunática. Es bueno tener un oído amigo al que recurrir.
dialogsBegin.sw: I have been worried for so long, I know I must look a mess. It is good to have a friendly ear to turn to.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันกังวลมานานแล้ว ฉันรู้ว่าฉันต้องดูเลอะเทอะ เป็นการดีที่จะมีหูที่เป็นมิตรที่จะหันไปหา
dialogsBegin.tw: 真的很感謝你啊~其實，最近有一件事情讓我很煩惱，皮膚也變的很差…
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đã lo lắng quá lâu, tôi biết mình trông rất rối. Thật tốt khi có một đôi tai biết lắng nghe.

dialogsBegin.en: I am studying recent history, but it is really hard. So would you please help me? Please?
dialogsBegin.ar: I am studying recent history, but it is really hard. So would you please help me? Please?
dialogsBegin.br: Estou estudando História recente, mas é muito difícil. Mas será que você me ajudaria, por favor? Por favor?
dialogsBegin.cns: 我最近啊~在研究一个历史..可是好难喔..可以帮我一下吗?
dialogsBegin.de: Ich studiere die Geschichte Madrigals, aber es ist wirklich schwer. Würdest du mir bitte einen Gefallen tun? Bitte.
dialogsBegin.fi: I am studying recent history, but it is really hard. So would you please help me? Please?
dialogsBegin.fil: I am studying recent history, but it is really hard. So would you please help me? Please?
dialogsBegin.fr: J'étudie l'histoire de Madrigal, mais il reste de nombreuses zones d'ombres… Ta force me serait précieuse, veux-tu bien m'aider, s'il te plaît ?
dialogsBegin.id: Aku kesulitan saat mempelajari sejarah. Maukah kamu membantuku? Kumohon?
dialogsBegin.it: I am studying recent history, but it is really hard. So would you please help me? Please?
dialogsBegin.jp: 私は新しい歴史の研究をしている歴史学者なのですが、これが本当に大変な作業なんです。そこであなたにお願いしたいことがあるんです。力を貸してくださいませんか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 제가 요즘 새로운 역사를 연구하고 있거든요. 근데 연구가 만만치가 않네요. 혹시 저를 도와주실 수 있나요? 제발...
dialogsBegin.nl: I am studying recent history, but it is really hard. So would you please help me? Please?
dialogsBegin.pl: I am studying recent history, but it is really hard. So would you please help me? Please?
dialogsBegin.ru: Понимаешь, я напала на очень важную тему и хочу получить у мэра грант на исследования. Поможешь?
dialogsBegin.sp: Estoy estudiando historia reciente, pero es muy difícil. Por eso es que, ¿podrías ayudarme? ¿Por favor?
dialogsBegin.sw: I am studying recent history, but it is really hard. So would you please help me? Please?
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันกำลังศึกษาประวัติศาสตร์เมื่อเร็วๆ นี้ แต่มันยากจริงๆ งั้นคุณช่วยฉันหน่อยได้ไหม ได้โปรด?
dialogsBegin.tw: 我最近啊~在研究一個歷史…可是好難喔…可以幫我一下嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đang học lịch sử gần đây, nhưng nó thực sự khó khăn. Vậy bạn vui lòng giúp tôi được không? Xin vui lòng?

dialogsAccept.en: Really? Wow! Thanks a lot! Please go to the office and deliver my application for a scholarship. Thank you.
dialogsAccept.ar: Really? Wow! Thanks a lot! Please go to the office and deliver my application for a scholarship. Thank you.
dialogsAccept.br: Verdade? Nossa! Muito obrigada! Vá ao escritório e entregue minha inscrição para uma bolsa de estudos. Obrigada.
dialogsAccept.cns: 哈哈哈，那请到管理所去申请研究费用，然后亲自把请款单拿去给市长吧。
dialogsAccept.de: Wow, Vielen Dank! Bitte geh zur Stadtverwaltung und überbring dem Bürgermeister das benötigte Research Cost Request Formular. Du findest es in der Nähe der Stadtverwaltung.
dialogsAccept.fi: Really? Wow! Thanks a lot! Please go to the office and deliver my application for a scholarship. Thank you.
dialogsAccept.fil: Really? Wow! Thanks a lot! Please go to the office and deliver my application for a scholarship. Thank you.
dialogsAccept.fr: J'étudie l'histoire de Madrigal, mais il reste de nombreuses zones d'ombres… Ta force me serait précieuse, veux-tu bien m'aider, s'il te plaît ?
dialogsAccept.id: Sungguh? Wow, terima kasih banyak! Tolong pergi ke kantor dan serahkan aplikasi beasiswaku. Terima kasih.
dialogsAccept.it: Really? Wow! Thanks a lot! Please go to the office and deliver my application for a scholarship. Thank you.
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとうございます。では今からシティホールに行って＜研究費用の申請書＞を作成したら、それを市長に渡してください。お願いしますね。
dialogsAccept.kr: 정말요? 와! 정말 고마워요! 그러면 제 관공서에 가서 장학금 신청서를 대신 전달해 주세요. 감사해요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Really? Wow! Thanks a lot! Please go to the office and deliver my application for a scholarship. Thank you.
dialogsAccept.pl: Really? Wow! Thanks a lot! Please go to the office and deliver my application for a scholarship. Thank you.
dialogsAccept.ru: Спасибо! Всего-то и нужно, что забрать прошение от ратуши и отнести его мэру.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¿En serio? ¡Guau! ¡Muchas gracias! Por favor ves a la oficina y entregale mi solicitud para conseguir una beca. Gracias.
dialogsAccept.sw: Really? Wow! Thanks a lot! Please go to the office and deliver my application for a scholarship. Thank you.
dialogsAccept.th: จริงหรือ ว้าว! ขอบคุณมาก! กรุณาไปที่สำนักงานและส่งใบสมัครเพื่อรับทุนของฉัน ขอบคุณ
dialogsAccept.tw: 哈哈哈，那請到管理所去申請研究費用，然後親自把請款單拿去給市長吧。
dialogsAccept.vi: Có thật không? Ồ! Cảm ơn rất nhiều! Vui lòng đến văn phòng và gửi đơn xin học bổng của tôi. Cảm ơn bạn.

dialogsDecline.en: What? Awww I knew it was too good to be true.
dialogsDecline.ar: What? Awww I knew it was too good to be true.
dialogsDecline.br: O que? Aaaaah, eu sabia que era bom demais para ser verdade.
dialogsDecline.cns: 哎唷~~好过份啊..看在我这么可爱的份上..帮我一次好吗?
dialogsDecline.de: Was? Du bist wirklich gemein und unfreundlich!!
dialogsDecline.fi: What? Awww I knew it was too good to be true.
dialogsDecline.fil: What? Awww I knew it was too good to be true.
dialogsDecline.fr: J'étudie l'histoire de Madrigal, mais il reste de nombreuses zones d'ombres… Ta force me serait précieuse, veux-tu bien m'aider, s'il te plaît ?
dialogsDecline.id: Apa? Awww, sudah kuduga itu hanya mimpi.
dialogsDecline.it: What? Awww I knew it was too good to be true.
dialogsDecline.jp: あら…お忙しいようですね、残念です。簡単な頼みごとですので、お手伝いしてくださる時間ができたら、また来てくださいな。
dialogsDecline.kr: 뭐라고요? 에이, 역시 그렇게 잘 풀릴 리 없겠죠.
dialogsDecline.nl: What? Awww I knew it was too good to be true.
dialogsDecline.pl: What? Awww I knew it was too good to be true.
dialogsDecline.ru: Честно говоря, я сразу поняла, что от тебя помощи не видать.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Qué? Oh, sabía que era demasiado bueno para ser verdad.
dialogsDecline.sw: What? Awww I knew it was too good to be true.
dialogsDecline.th: อะไรนะ ฉันรู้ว่ามันดีเกินจริง
dialogsDecline.tw: 哎唷~~好過份啊…看在我這麼可愛的份上…幫我一次好嗎？
dialogsDecline.vi: Gì? Awww, tôi biết điều đó là quá tốt để trở thành sự thật.

dialogsComplete.en: Oh, it seems like Martinyc is too busy to deliver her own applications.
dialogsComplete.ar: Oh, it seems like Martinyc is too busy to deliver her own applications.
dialogsComplete.br: Oh, parece que Martinyc está muito ocupada para entregar suas inscrições.
dialogsComplete.cns: 喔，玛缇雅克这么忙啊?既然叫你把请款单拿过来..好!我知道了，帮我告诉他，研究费用我会付支给他。
dialogsComplete.de: Oh, es sieht so aus als sei Martinyc zu beschäftigt, um es selber zu überbringen. Danke, dass du mir das Dokument gebracht hast. Ihre Studiengebühren werde ich natürlich erstatten.
dialogsComplete.fi: Oh, it seems like Martinyc is too busy to deliver her own applications.
dialogsComplete.fil: Oh, it seems like Martinyc is too busy to deliver her own applications.
dialogsComplete.fr: Il semble que Martinyc soit trop occupée pour me rendre visite d'elle-même… (lisant la lettre) Hmm…d'accord j'accepte qu'elle poursuivre ces études sur l'histoire de Madrigal.
dialogsComplete.id: Oh, sepertinya Martinyc terlalu sibuk untuk menyerahkan aplikasinya sendiri.
dialogsComplete.it: Oh, it seems like Martinyc is too busy to deliver her own applications.
dialogsComplete.jp: 申請書ですか？マルティニークもずいぶん忙しいようですね、冒険者の方にお願いするなんて。はい、わかりました。研究費用はすぐ支給されるはずです、とお伝えください。宜しくお願いします。
dialogsComplete.kr: 흠, 마르티닉은 신청서 하나도 직접 전달할 시간이 없나 보네요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Oh, it seems like Martinyc is too busy to deliver her own applications.
dialogsComplete.pl: Oh, it seems like Martinyc is too busy to deliver her own applications.
dialogsComplete.ru: Похоже, Мартиника слишком занята, чтобы отнести собственное прошение!
dialogsComplete.sp: Oh, parece que Martinyc está demasiado ocupada para entregar sus propias solicitudes.
dialogsComplete.sw: Oh, it seems like Martinyc is too busy to deliver her own applications.
dialogsComplete.th: โอ้ ดูเหมือนว่า Martinyc จะยุ่งเกินกว่าจะส่งใบสมัครของเธอเอง
dialogsComplete.tw: 喔，馬特尼提特這麼忙啊？既然叫你把請款單拿過來…好！我知道了，幫我告訴他，研究費用我會支付給他。
dialogsComplete.vi: Ồ, có vẻ như Martinyc quá bận để gửi đơn đăng ký của riêng cô ấy.

dialogsFail.en: May I help you? You want to fill out an application? The form is on the right side of the office.
dialogsFail.ar: May I help you? You want to fill out an application? The form is on the right side of the office.
dialogsFail.br: Em que posso ajudá-lo? Você gostaria de preencher uma inscrição? O formulário está à direita no escritório.
dialogsFail.cns: 有什么事吗?喔~你说你要填写请款单啊..请款单在管理所的后面..
dialogsFail.de: Kann ich dir helfen? Oh, du möchtest eine Rückvergütung der Studiengebühren für Martinyc beantragen? Die Formulare sind auf der rechten Seite vom Rathaus.
dialogsFail.fi: Voinko auttaa? Haluatko täyttää hakemuksen? Lomake on toimiston oikealla puolella.
dialogsFail.fil: May I help you? You want to fill out an application? The form is on the right side of the office.
dialogsFail.fr: Est-ce que je peux te renseigner ? Ah, vous voulez me remettre une lettre de Martinyc ? Reviens me voir avec ce Devoir de mémoire…
dialogsFail.id: Ada yang bisa kubantu? Oh, Anda ingin mengisi aplikasi? Formulirnya bisa anda dapatkan di sisi kanan kantor.
dialogsFail.it: May I help you? You want to fill out an application? The form is on the right side of the office.
dialogsFail.jp: 何かご用でしょうか？はい、申請書ですね。それならシティホールの右側に置いてありますよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 무엇을 도와드릴까요? 신청서를 작성하시겠다고요? 오른쪽에 비치되어 있답니다.
dialogsFail.nl: May I help you? You want to fill out an application? The form is on the right side of the office.
dialogsFail.pl: May I help you? You want to fill out an application? The form is on the right side of the office.
dialogsFail.ru: Привет! Прошение Мартиники? Не получал. Если она отдавала его секретарю, поищи справа от здания ратуши.
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Puedo ayudarte? ¿Quieres rellenar una solicitud? El formulario está en el lado derecho de la oficina.
dialogsFail.sw: May I help you? You want to fill out an application? The form is on the right side of the office.
dialogsFail.th: ฉันช่วยคุณได้ไหม ต้องการกรอกใบสมัครเหรอ? แบบฟอร์มอยู่ด้านขวาของสำนักงาน
dialogsFail.tw: 有什麼事嗎？喔~你說你要填寫請款單啊…請款單在管理所的後面…
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi có thể giúp gì cho bạn? Bạn muốn điền vào một ứng dụng? Biểu mẫu nằm ở phía bên phải của văn phòng.

dialogsBegin.en: Hah, you have become quite the celebrity around here! Yes, there is still evil afoot in Saint Morning, but nothing that we can't now contain thanks to your aid!
dialogsBegin.ar: Hah, you have become quite the celebrity around here! Yes, there is still evil afoot in Saint Morning, but nothing that we can't now contain thanks to your aid!
dialogsBegin.br: Hah, você se tornou uma celebridade e tanto por aqui! Claro, ainda há mal em ação em Saint Morning, mas não há nada que não possamos conter agora. Graças à sua ajuda!
dialogsBegin.cns: 哈，你在晨光已经非常受人敬重了！是的，晨光虽仍有邪恶在酝酿，但有了你的帮助，我们是所向披靡的！
dialogsBegin.de: Hah, du bist hier eine ziemliche Berühmtheit geworden! Ja, das Böse treibt immer noch sein Unwesen in Saint Morning, aber nichts, was wir dank deiner Hilfe nicht eindämmen könnten!
dialogsBegin.fi: Hah, you have become quite the celebrity around here! Yes, there is still evil afoot in Saint Morning, but nothing that we can't now contain thanks to your aid!
dialogsBegin.fil: Hah, you have become quite the celebrity around here! Yes, there is still evil afoot in Saint Morning, but nothing that we can't now contain thanks to your aid!
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous avez rendu de nombreux services à Saincity. Reonan choisit bien ses associés.
dialogsBegin.id: Hah, kamu telah menjadi selebriti di sekitar sini! Ya, memang masih ada kejahatan yang terjadi di Saint Morning, tetapi tak ada yang tidak dapat kami lakukan sekarang berkat bantuanmu!
dialogsBegin.it: Hah, you have become quite the celebrity around here! Yes, there is still evil afoot in Saint Morning, but nothing that we can't now contain thanks to your aid!
dialogsBegin.jp: 既に貴方の名声はセイントモーニング中に知れ渡っています。さすがレオナンの紹介ですね。まだまだモンスターは生息していますが当面は大丈夫でしょう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 하하, 이제 이곳에선 당신 소문이 자자해요! 세인트 모닝에는 아직 악의 무리가 남아있지만, 덕분에 나머지는 저희가 감당할 수 있을 것 같네요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Hah, you have become quite the celebrity around here! Yes, there is still evil afoot in Saint Morning, but nothing that we can't now contain thanks to your aid!
dialogsBegin.pl: Hah, you have become quite the celebrity around here! Yes, there is still evil afoot in Saint Morning, but nothing that we can't now contain thanks to your aid!
dialogsBegin.ru: Смотрю, ты уже местная знаменитость! Да, марионетки ещё бродят в окрестностях Санто, но нет ничего, с чем бы мы не справились!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Ja, te has convertido en toda una celebridad por aquí! Sí, todavía queda mal por Saint Morning, ¡pero nada que ahora no podamos contener gracias a tu ayuda!
dialogsBegin.sw: Hah, you have become quite the celebrity around here! Yes, there is still evil afoot in Saint Morning, but nothing that we can't now contain thanks to your aid!
dialogsBegin.th: ฮ่าฮ่า คุณกลายเป็นคนดังที่นี่แล้ว ! เมืองของเราได้สงบสุขลงแล้ว ขอบคุณ
dialogsBegin.tw: 哈，你已經成為這裡的名人了！是的，在聖音特仍有邪惡在醞釀，但感謝你的幫助，我們現在無法遏制一切！
dialogsBegin.vi: Hah, bạn đã trở thành một người nổi tiếng ở đây! Vâng, vẫn còn ác quỷ đang xuất hiện trong Saint Morning, nhưng không có gì mà chúng tôi không thể ngăn chặn ngay bây giờ nhờ sự trợ giúp của bạn!

dialogsBegin.en: I do wish to ask you one last favor. Will you hear me out in my final request?
dialogsBegin.ar: I do wish to ask you one last favor. Will you hear me out in my final request?
dialogsBegin.br: Eu gostaria de lhe pedir um último favor. Poderia ouvir meu pedido final?
dialogsBegin.cns: 我想最后请你帮个忙。你愿意听听我最后的请求吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Ich möchte Sie um einen letzten Gefallen bitten. Werden Sie mich bei meiner letzten Bitte anhören?
dialogsBegin.fi: I do wish to ask you one last favor. Will you hear me out in my final request?
dialogsBegin.fil: I do wish to ask you one last favor. Will you hear me out in my final request?
dialogsBegin.fr: Si vous pouviez nous aider une dernière fois nous serions tranquilles pour un moment avec les monstres.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya ingin meminta satu bantuan terakhir kepadamu. Maukah kamu mendengar permintaan terakhir saya?
dialogsBegin.it: I do wish to ask you one last favor. Will you hear me out in my final request?
dialogsBegin.jp: 最後に、これは失礼な話かもしれませんが、一つだけ貴方を試してみたいのです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 부탁 하나만 더 드려도 될까요? 제 마지막 부탁, 들어주시겠어요?
dialogsBegin.nl: I do wish to ask you one last favor. Will you hear me out in my final request?
dialogsBegin.pl: I do wish to ask you one last favor. Will you hear me out in my final request?
dialogsBegin.ru: У меня есть одно, последнее задание для тебя. Поможешь?
dialogsBegin.sp: Quiero pedirte un último favor. ¿Me escucharás en mi última solicitud?
dialogsBegin.sw: I do wish to ask you one last favor. Will you hear me out in my final request?
dialogsBegin.th: คุณจะรับคำร้องขอสุดท้ายของฉันหรือไม่?
dialogsBegin.tw: 我想請你幫最後一個忙。你會聽到我最後的請求嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi muốn nhờ bạn một ân huệ cuối cùng. Bạn sẽ nghe tôi nói trong yêu cầu cuối cùng của tôi chứ?

dialogsAccept.en: You have my thanks. Word has it, a group of dangerous escaped convicts from Saint City Prison are planning their revenge. Please defeat the Hobo and take his sword as proof!
dialogsAccept.ar: You have my thanks. Word has it, a group of dangerous escaped convicts from Saint City Prison are planning their revenge. Please defeat the Hobo and take his sword as proof!
dialogsAccept.br: Você tem minha gratidão! Dizem que um grupo de perigosos fugitivos da prisão da Cidade de Saint estão planejando vingança. Por favor, derrote o Hobo e pegue sua espada como prova!
dialogsAccept.cns: 非常感谢。我听说，一群危险的罪犯从晨光监狱逃了出去，并且正在筹划着他们的复仇计划。请击杀独臂浪人并将他们的剑作为证物带回！
dialogsAccept.de: Sie haben meinen Dank. Man munkelt, dass eine Gruppe gefährlicher entflohener Sträflinge aus dem Gefängnis von Saint City ihre Rache plant. Bitte besiege den Hobo und nimm sein Schwert als Beweis!
dialogsAccept.fi: You have my thanks. Word has it, a group of dangerous escaped convicts from Saint City Prison are planning their revenge. Please defeat the Hobo and take his sword as proof!
dialogsAccept.fil: You have my thanks. Word has it, a group of dangerous escaped convicts from Saint City Prison are planning their revenge. Please defeat the Hobo and take his sword as proof!
dialogsAccept.fr: Loiiiiin au sud de Saint Morning vivent les Hobo. Ce sont des brutes et j'ai peur qu'ils ne profite du calme pour nous attaquer. Je vous demande donc d'aller tuer un d'eux.
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih. Kabarnya, sekelompok narapidana berbahaya yang melarikan diri dari Penjara Saint City sedang merencanakan balas dendam mereka. Tolong kalahkan Hobo dan ambil pedangnya sebagai bukti!
dialogsAccept.it: You have my thanks. Word has it, a group of dangerous escaped convicts from Saint City Prison are planning their revenge. Please defeat the Hobo and take his sword as proof!
dialogsAccept.jp: さすがですね。貴方でしたら挑戦されると信じていました。この大陸の最南端にホボーという監獄から脱獄をした集団が生息しています。彼らのキャプテンを倒し、その証を持ってきて下さい。
dialogsAccept.kr: 정말 감사드립니다. 소문에 따르면, 세인트 시티 감옥에서 탈출한 죄수들이 복수를 계획 중이라고 해요. 호보를 처치하고, 그 증거로 호보의 검을 가져와 주세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: You have my thanks. Word has it, a group of dangerous escaped convicts from Saint City Prison are planning their revenge. Please defeat the Hobo and take his sword as proof!
dialogsAccept.pl: You have my thanks. Word has it, a group of dangerous escaped convicts from Saint City Prison are planning their revenge. Please defeat the Hobo and take his sword as proof!
dialogsAccept.ru: Прими мою благодарность. Ходят слухи, что группа опасных заключенных сбежала из тюрьмы Санто и замыслила отомстить. Пожалуйста, победи одноруких бандитов и принеси мне их мечи в доказательство!
dialogsAccept.sp: Tienes mi agradecimiento. Se dice que un grupo de peligrosos convictos fugitivos de la prisión de Saint están planeando su venganza. ¡Derrota a los Hobo y llévate su espada como prueba!
dialogsAccept.sw: You have my thanks. Word has it, a group of dangerous escaped convicts from Saint City Prison are planning their revenge. Please defeat the Hobo and take his sword as proof!
dialogsAccept.th: โปรดกำจัด Hobo
dialogsAccept.tw: 我非常的感謝你。傳聞，一群從聖音特監獄逃出來的危險逃犯，正在籌劃著報仇雪恨。請打敗獨刀並以他的刀為證！
dialogsAccept.vi: Bạn có lời cảm ơn của tôi. Có tin đồn rằng, một nhóm tội phạm nguy hiểm đã trốn thoát từ Nhà tù Thành phố Saint và đang lên kế hoạch trả thù. Hãy đánh bại Hobo và lấy thanh kiếm của hắn làm bằng chứng!

dialogsDecline.en: Hmm…just unfortunate considering how far you have come!
dialogsDecline.ar: Hmm…just unfortunate considering how far you have come!
dialogsDecline.br: Hmm... lamentável, considerando o quão longe você chegou!
dialogsDecline.cns: 好吧...但你已经帮我们做了那么多事，放弃这最后一个请求的话真让人感到很遗憾啊！
dialogsDecline.de: Hmm... einfach schade, wenn man bedenkt, wie weit Sie gekommen sind!
dialogsDecline.fi: Hmm…just unfortunate considering how far you have come!
dialogsDecline.fil: Hmm…just unfortunate considering how far you have come!
dialogsDecline.fr: Oh, vous n'avez plus assez de temps à consacrer à une petite ville comme Saincity ?
dialogsDecline.id: Hmm... sangat disayangkan mengingat seberapa jauh kamu telah berusaha!
dialogsDecline.it: Hmm…just unfortunate considering how far you have come!
dialogsDecline.jp: そうですか。さすがに内容を聞かずに受けるほど無謀ではないというわけですね。
dialogsDecline.kr: 흐음… 지금까지 걸어온 길을 생각하면 아깝네요!
dialogsDecline.nl: Hmm…just unfortunate considering how far you have come!
dialogsDecline.pl: Hmm…just unfortunate considering how far you have come!
dialogsDecline.ru: Hmm…just unfortunate considering how far you have come!
dialogsDecline.sp: Hmm... ¡Una pena teniendo en cuenta lo lejos que has llegado!
dialogsDecline.sw: Hmm…just unfortunate considering how far you have come!
dialogsDecline.th: อืม ... น่าเสียดาย คิดว่าคุณจะทำมันซะอีก
dialogsDecline.tw: 嗯…只是很不幸想到你已經歷了這麼多！
dialogsDecline.vi: Hmm… thật không may khi bạn đã đi được bao xa!

dialogsComplete.en: I knew it all along. Reonan was right. There is truly greatness within you. I, and the people of Saint City, wish to bestow you with this gift of elemental cards. Use them wisely!
dialogsComplete.ar: I knew it all along. Reonan was right. There is truly greatness within you. I, and the people of Saint City, wish to bestow you with this gift of elemental cards. Use them wisely!
dialogsComplete.br: Eu sempre soube. Reonan estava certo. Existe realmente grandeza dentro de você. Eu, e o povo de Saint, queremos conceder a você este presente de cartas elementais. Utilize com sabedoria!
dialogsComplete.cns: 我就知道瑞尔南是对的。你真的是个伟大的人。我和晨光的人民们希望将这些元素卡作为你的谢礼。合理的使用它们吧！
dialogsComplete.de: Ich wusste es die ganze Zeit. Reonan hatte Recht. Es steckt wahrlich Größe in dir. Ich und das Volk von Saint City möchten dir dieses Geschenk der Elementarkarten überreichen. Nutze sie weise!
dialogsComplete.fi: I knew it all along. Reonan was right. There is truly greatness within you. I, and the people of Saint City, wish to bestow you with this gift of elemental cards. Use them wisely!
dialogsComplete.fil: I knew it all along. Reonan was right. There is truly greatness within you. I, and the people of Saint City, wish to bestow you with this gift of elemental cards. Use them wisely!
dialogsComplete.fr: C'est bien l'épée d'un Hobo. Vous êtes vraiment le Champion de Saincity !!!
dialogsComplete.id: Saya tahu itu selama ini. Reonan benar. Benar-benar ada kebaikan dalam dirimu. Saya, dan orang-orang di Saint City, ingin memberimu hadiah kartu elemen ini. Gunakan dengan bijak!
dialogsComplete.it: I knew it all along. Reonan was right. There is truly greatness within you. I, and the people of Saint City, wish to bestow you with this gift of elemental cards. Use them wisely!
dialogsComplete.jp: まさしくこれはホボーの大剣！　もはや貴方はこの辺りのモンスターなど赤子の手をひねるようなものなのでしょうね。色々と依頼を聞いて頂きありがとうございました。これを差し上げましょう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 그럴 줄 알았어요. 레오난의 말이 맞았네요. 당신에겐 진정한 위대함이 보여요. 저와 세인트 시티 사람들이 보답으로 속성 카드를 준비했어요. 잘 사용해 주세요!
dialogsComplete.nl: I knew it all along. Reonan was right. There is truly greatness within you. I, and the people of Saint City, wish to bestow you with this gift of elemental cards. Use them wisely!
dialogsComplete.pl: I knew it all along. Reonan was right. There is truly greatness within you. I, and the people of Saint City, wish to bestow you with this gift of elemental cards. Use them wisely!
dialogsComplete.ru: Я так и знал. Максимус был прав во всём. В тебе явно есть доблесть. От лица всех жителей Санто, приношу тебе свою благодарность и небольшой подарок.
dialogsComplete.sp: Lo sabía desde el principio. Reonan tenía razón. De verdad que hay grandeza dentro de ti. Tanto yo como la gente de Saint, queremos otorgarte este regalo de cartas elementales. ¡Úsalas sabiamente!
dialogsComplete.sw: I knew it all along. Reonan was right. There is truly greatness within you. I, and the people of Saint City, wish to bestow you with this gift of elemental cards. Use them wisely!
dialogsComplete.th: ข้าและคนในเมืองอยากจะมอบของขวัญชิ้นนี้ให้แก่คุณ !
dialogsComplete.tw: 我一直都知道，雷奧南是對的。你真的很偉大，我和聖音特的人，都想把這元素卡片的禮物送給你。請明智地使用它們！
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi đã biết tất cả. Reonan đã đúng. Có một sự vĩ đại thực sự bên trong bạn. Tôi và người dân thành phố Saint mong muốn ban tặng cho bạn món quà là những lá bài nguyên tố. Hãy sử dụng chúng một cách khôn ngoan!

dialogsFail.en: The Hobo should be in the Western Fantasy Desert. Please eliminate this threat!
dialogsFail.ar: The Hobo should be in the Western Fantasy Desert. Please eliminate this threat!
dialogsFail.br: O Hobo deve estar a Oeste do Deserto da Fantasia. Elimine esta ameaça!
dialogsFail.cns: 独臂浪人在梦幻沙漠的西部。请消除他们的威胁！
dialogsFail.de: Der Hobo sollte in der westlichen Fantasy Desert sein. Bitte beseitigen Sie diese Bedrohung!
dialogsFail.fi: The Hobo should be in the Western Fantasy Desert. Please eliminate this threat!
dialogsFail.fil: The Hobo should be in the Western Fantasy Desert. Please eliminate this threat!
dialogsFail.fr: Allez tuer un Hobo et rapportez-moi son arme.
dialogsFail.id: Hobo seharusnya berada di Western Fantasy Desert. Tolong hilangkan ancaman ini!
dialogsFail.it: The Hobo should be in the Western Fantasy Desert. Please eliminate this threat!
dialogsFail.jp: ホボーの中でもキャプテンと名のつくホボーですよ。彼らは集団で生息しているのでどうぞお気をつけて。
dialogsFail.kr: 호보는 몽환의 사막 서쪽에 있을 거예요. 부디, 녀석들을 전부 없애 주세요!
dialogsFail.nl: The Hobo should be in the Western Fantasy Desert. Please eliminate this threat!
dialogsFail.pl: The Hobo should be in the Western Fantasy Desert. Please eliminate this threat!
dialogsFail.ru: The Hobo should be in the Western Fantasy Desert. Please eliminate this threat!
dialogsFail.sp: Los Hobo deben estar en la parte Oeste del Desierto Fantasía. ¡Acaba con ésta amenaza!
dialogsFail.sw: The Hobo should be in the Western Fantasy Desert. Please eliminate this threat!
dialogsFail.th: Hobo อยู่ในทะเลทราย Fantasy Fantasy โปรดกำจัดมัน!
dialogsFail.tw: 獨刀應該在西部奇幻沙漠，請消除這種威脅！
dialogsFail.vi: Hobo nên ở Western Fantasy Desert. Hãy loại bỏ mối đe dọa này!
