description.en: I'll need to see what you can do before I'll allow your training. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
description.ar: I'll need to see what you can do before I'll allow your training. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
description.br: Preciso ver o que você pode fazer antes de permitir seu treinamento. Mate $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s a sudoeste das Montanhas Gouthan. Eles devem ser $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s comuns, não os pequenos ou capitães.
description.cns: 在我允许你去训练之前，我需要知道你的实力。请杀死$QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$个在永恒森林西南部的中型 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$怪物。请注意，不是小型或者大型的$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$怪物。
description.de: Ich muss erst sehen was du kannst, bevor ich dein Training erlaube. Töte $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s südwestlich der Gouthan-Berge.Es müssen normale $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s sein. Keine Small oder Captain.
description.fi: I'll need to see what you can do before I'll allow your training. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
description.fil: I'll need to see what you can do before I'll allow your training. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
description.fr: Commence par tuer $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s au sud-ouest des montagnes de Gouthan. Il s'agit de $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s adultes, pas des jeunes ni des capitaines.
description.id: Aku perlu melihat apa yang dapat kamu lakukan sebelum aku mengizinkan pelatihanmu. Bunuh $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ di barat daya Gouthan Mountain. Mereka hanyalah $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ biasa, bukan jenis kecil ataupun kapten.
description.it: I'll need to see what you can do before I'll allow your training. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
description.jp: トレーニングを許可する前に、能力を見ておく必要があります。$QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$体の$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を倒してください。ゴウダン山脈の南西、通常の$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を倒すようにしてください。スモールでもキャプテンでもありません。
description.kr: 훈련을 시작하기 전에 당신 실력을 먼저 확인해야겠군요, 고우단 산맥 남서쪽에 있는 $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$마리를 처치하고 오세요. 작은 드릴러나 두목 드릴러가 아닌, 일반 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$만 해당합니다.
description.nl: I'll need to see what you can do before I'll allow your training. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
description.pl: I'll need to see what you can do before I'll allow your training. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
description.ru: К юго-западу от Гутанских гор водится $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$. Они бывают сильные и слабые, но мне нужно убить $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ обычных.
description.sp: Tendré que ver lo que puedes hacer antes de permitirte entrenar. Derrota $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s al suroeste de las Montañas Gouthan. Deben ser $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s normales, no de la variedad Pequeño o Capitán.
description.sw: I'll need to see what you can do before I'll allow your training. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
description.th: ฉันต้องดูว่าคุณสามารถทำอะไรได้บ้างก่อนที่จะอนุญาตให้ฝึก สังหาร $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s ทางตะวันตกเฉียงใต้ของ Gouthan Mountains ต้องเป็น $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s ปกติ ไม่ใช่พันธุ์เล็กหรือพันธุ์กัปตัน
description.tw: 在准許你接受訓練前，我得先看看你的本事。前往古坦山脈西南方，擊敗 $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ 隻 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$。目標必須是普通的 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$，不要攻擊小型或隊長級的種類。
description.vi: Tôi cần xem bạn có thể làm gì trước khi cho phép đào tạo. Giết $ QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT $ $ QUEST_END_KILL_NAME $ s về phía tây nam của Dãy núi Gouthan. Chúng phải là loại $ QUEST_END_KILL_NAME $ s thông thường, không phải loại nhỏ hoặc loại lớn.

dialogsBegin.en: You think you have what it takes to be a successor of the Jester Hero? We will see…
dialogsBegin.ar: You think you have what it takes to be a successor of the Jester Hero? We will see…
dialogsBegin.br: Você acha que tem o que é preciso para ser um sucessor do Herói Jester? Veremos…
dialogsBegin.cns: 你认为你有能力成为暗杀者英雄的继承者吗？我们拭目以待…
dialogsBegin.de: Du glaubst, du hast das Zeug zum Nachfolger des Jester Helden? Wir werden sehen...
dialogsBegin.fi: You think you have what it takes to be a successor of the Jester Hero? We will see…
dialogsBegin.fil: You think you have what it takes to be a successor of the Jester Hero? We will see…
dialogsBegin.fr: Souhaites-tu devenir un successeur de Kerenen, Héros des Jesters ? Ce n'est pas une tâche facile, mais je pense que tu en es capable...
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu pikir apa saja yang diperlukan untuk menjadi penerus Pahlawan Jester? Kita lihat…
dialogsBegin.it: You think you have what it takes to be a successor of the Jester Hero? We will see…
dialogsBegin.jp: ここまで来ることが出来た功績を讃えます。お疲れ様でした。しかし、私には、あなたにジェスター後継者としてふさわしいかどうか、まだ判断は出来ません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 본인이 제스터 영웅의 후계자가 될 자질이 있다고 생각하시나요? 어디, 두고 볼까요…
dialogsBegin.nl: You think you have what it takes to be a successor of the Jester Hero? We will see…
dialogsBegin.pl: You think you have what it takes to be a successor of the Jester Hero? We will see…
dialogsBegin.ru: Думаешь поднять знамя павшего героя-шута? Посмотрим...
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Crees que tienes lo necesario para ser un sucesor del Héroe Jester? Ya lo veremos…
dialogsBegin.sw: You think you have what it takes to be a successor of the Jester Hero? We will see…
dialogsBegin.th: คุณคิดว่าคุณมีสิ่งที่จะเป็นผู้สืบทอดของ Jester Hero? เราจะได้รู้กัน...
dialogsBegin.tw: 辛苦你來到這裡～可是我現在無法判斷你是否有成為操偶師的能力。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn nghĩ bạn có những gì cần thiết để trở thành người kế nhiệm của Anh hùng Jester? Chúng ta sẽ thấy…

dialogsBegin.en: Fine, I'll humor you. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
dialogsBegin.ar: Fine, I'll humor you. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
dialogsBegin.br: Ok, um simples teste. Mate $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s a sudoeste das Montanhas Gouthan. Eles devem ser $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, não incomode os pequenos ou capitães.
dialogsBegin.cns: 好吧，就随你的意思。请去杀死$QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$个在永恒森林西南部的中型$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$。请注意不能是小型的或者大型的种类。
dialogsBegin.de: Na schön, ich werde dich bei Laune halten. Erledige $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s südwestlich der Gouthan-Berge. Es müssen normale $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s sein. Keine Small oder Captain.
dialogsBegin.fi: Fine, I'll humor you. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
dialogsBegin.fil: Fine, I'll humor you. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
dialogsBegin.fr: Commence par tuer $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s au sud-ouest des montagnes de Gouthan. Il s'agit de $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s adultes, pas des jeunes ni des capitaines.
dialogsBegin.id: Baiklah, aku akan menghiburmu. Bunuh $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s di barat daya Gouthan Mountains. Mereka harus biasa $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, bukan jenis kecil ataupun kapten.
dialogsBegin.it: Fine, I'll humor you. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
dialogsBegin.jp: そこで、ひとつ簡単なテストを行います。ゴウダン山の南西に生息している$QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$体の$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を狩って来てください。よいですか、$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$です。スモールやキャプテンではありません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 좋아요, 한 번 봐 드릴게요. 고우단 산맥 남서쪽에서 드릴러 $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$마리를 처치하고 오세요. 작은 드릴러나 두목 드릴러가 아닌, 일반 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$만 해당합니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Fine, I'll humor you. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
dialogsBegin.pl: Fine, I'll humor you. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
dialogsBegin.ru: Ладно, начнем с простого! Отправляйся-ка ты на юго-запад от Гутанских гор, где-то там водится $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$. Мне нужно, чтобы ты победил $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$. Не сильных, не слабых - простых, обычных. Все понятно?
dialogsBegin.sp: Bueno, te seguiré la corriente. Mata $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s al suroeste de las Montañas Gouthan. Deben ser $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s normales, no de la variedad Pequeño o Capitán.
dialogsBegin.sw: Fine, I'll humor you. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
dialogsBegin.th: ได้ งั้นลองทำให้ฉันพอใจสิ จงไปสังหาร $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s ทางตะวันตกเฉียงใต้ของ Gouthan Mountains พวกมันต้องเป็น $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s แบบปกติไม่ใช่แบบ Small หรือ Captain
dialogsBegin.tw: 好吧，就陪你玩玩。前往古坦山脈西南方，擊敗 $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ 隻 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$。目標必須是普通的 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$，不要攻擊小型或隊長級的種類。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tốt thôi, tôi sẽ hài hước với bạn. Đánh $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ s về phía tây nam của Dãy núi Gouthan. Chúng phải là loại $ QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s thông thường, không phải loại nhỏ hoặc loại lớn.

dialogsAccept.en: Show me what you can do and I might consider allowing you to continue on the path of the Jester Hero.
dialogsAccept.ar: Show me what you can do and I might consider allowing you to continue on the path of the Jester Hero.
dialogsAccept.br: Mostre-me sua habilidade.
dialogsAccept.cns: 请给我看你的能力吧！
dialogsAccept.de: Zeig mir deine Fertigkeiten. Dann überlege ich mir vielleicht, ob du wirklich das Zeug zu einem heldenhaften Jester hast.
dialogsAccept.fi: Show me what you can do and I might consider allowing you to continue on the path of the Jester Hero.
dialogsAccept.fil: Show me what you can do and I might consider allowing you to continue on the path of the Jester Hero.
dialogsAccept.fr: Ma requête est assez simple : débarrasse-toi de 20 Drillers à KhipRa, Darkon 1. Pas des Jeunes ou des Capitaines Drillers, juste des Drillers.
dialogsAccept.id: Tunjukkan padaku apa yang dapat kamu lakukan dan aku mungkin mempertimbangkan untuk mengizinkanmu melanjutkan jalan Jester Hero.
dialogsAccept.it: Show me what you can do and I might consider allowing you to continue on the path of the Jester Hero.
dialogsAccept.jp: あなたの実力を見せてください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 당산의 실력을 보여주세요. 그러면 제스터 영웅의 길을 계속 걷을 수 있도록 도와줄지 저도 고려해 보죠.
dialogsAccept.nl: Show me what you can do and I might consider allowing you to continue on the path of the Jester Hero.
dialogsAccept.pl: Show me what you can do and I might consider allowing you to continue on the path of the Jester Hero.
dialogsAccept.ru: Прояви себя, и тогда посмотрим, по плечу ли тебе Путь шута.
dialogsAccept.sp: Muéstrame lo que puedes hacer y consideraré si te permito ir por el camino del Héroe Jester.
dialogsAccept.sw: Show me what you can do and I might consider allowing you to continue on the path of the Jester Hero.
dialogsAccept.th: แสดงให้ฉันเห็นว่าคุณสามารถทำอะไรได้บ้าง และบางทีฉันอาจลองพิจารณาให้คุณเดินตามเส้นทางของ Jester Hero ต่อไป
dialogsAccept.tw: 讓我看看你的能耐，我或許會考慮讓你繼續走上幻影師英雄之路。
dialogsAccept.vi: Chỉ cho tôi những gì bạn có thể làm và tôi có thể cân nhắc cho phép bạn tiếp tục con đường của Người hùng Jester.

dialogsDecline.en: That's too bad because I sense potential in you. You must not be ready for the challenges that lie ahead. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ar: That's too bad because I sense potential in you. You must not be ready for the challenges that lie ahead. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.br: Isso é uma pena porque eu sinto potencial em você. Você não deve estar pronto(a) para os desafios que estão por vir. Venha me ver novamente se mudar de ideia.
dialogsDecline.cns: 那太可惜了，因为我感觉到了你的潜力。如果你改变主意，请再来找我。
dialogsDecline.de: Du kannst nicht den groben und schwierigen Weg eines Nachfolgers des Jester bestreiten, wenn nicht einmal diesen einfachen Test bestehen kannst.
dialogsDecline.fi: That's too bad because I sense potential in you. You must not be ready for the challenges that lie ahead. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fil: That's too bad because I sense potential in you. You must not be ready for the challenges that lie ahead. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fr: Si tu es effectivement le successeur du Héros, ce test devrait être une formalité.
dialogsDecline.id: Itu terlalu buruk karena aku merasakan potensi dalam dirimu. Kamu tidak harus siap untuk tantangan yang ada di depan. Temui aku lagi jika kamu berubah pikiran.
dialogsDecline.it: That's too bad because I sense potential in you. You must not be ready for the challenges that lie ahead. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.jp: こんな簡単なテストさえ成し遂げられない者に、ジェスター後継者としての険しい道を歩ませるなんて、私には出来ません。
dialogsDecline.kr: 안타깝네요. 잠재력이 있다고 생각했는데... 아직 앞에 놓인 도전에 감당할 준비가 안 된 모양이에요. 마음이 바뀌면 다시 찾아오세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: That's too bad because I sense potential in you. You must not be ready for the challenges that lie ahead. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.pl: That's too bad because I sense potential in you. You must not be ready for the challenges that lie ahead. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ru: That's too bad because I sense potential in you. You must not be ready for the challenges that lie ahead. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.sp: Es una lástima porque veo potencial en ti. Supongo que no estás preparado para los desafíos que tienes por delante. Ven a verme de nuevo si cambias de opinión.
dialogsDecline.sw: That's too bad because I sense potential in you. You must not be ready for the challenges that lie ahead. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.th: นั่นมันแย่มากเพราะฉันคาดหวังศักยภาพในตัวคุณ คุณยังไม่พร้อมสำหรับความท้าทายที่อยู่ข้างหน้า มาพบฉันอีกครั้งถ้าคุณเปลี่ยนใจ
dialogsDecline.tw: 這太糟糕了，因為我感覺到你的潛力。你一定不能為即將到來的挑戰做好準備。如果你改變主意，再來找我。
dialogsDecline.vi: Điều đó quá tệ vì tôi cảm nhận được tiềm năng trong bạn. Bạn không được sẵn sàng cho những thử thách phía trước. Hãy đến gặp tôi một lần nữa nếu bạn thay đổi ý định.

dialogsComplete.en: Not bad, Acrobat. Not bad at all. You may have something to offer. I'll allow your training.
dialogsComplete.ar: Not bad, Acrobat. Not bad at all. You may have something to offer. I'll allow your training.
dialogsComplete.br: Nada mal, Acrobata. Nada mal. Você pode ter algo a oferecer. Vou permitir seu treinamento.
dialogsComplete.cns: 不错，弓箭手。 你有点东西。 我会允许你来训练。
dialogsComplete.de: Nicht schlecht, Acrobat... Ich erkenne deine Fähigkeiten an.Ich werde dein weiteres Training erlauben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Not bad, Acrobat. Not bad at all. You may have something to offer. I'll allow your training.
dialogsComplete.fil: Not bad, Acrobat. Not bad at all. You may have something to offer. I'll allow your training.
dialogsComplete.fr: Félicitations, je reconnais que tu as du talent.
dialogsComplete.id: Tidak buruk, Acrobat. Tidak terlalu buruk. Kamu mungkin memiliki sesuatu untuk ditawarkan. Aku akan mengizinkan pelatihanmu.
dialogsComplete.it: Not bad, Acrobat. Not bad at all. You may have something to offer. I'll allow your training.
dialogsComplete.jp: お疲れ様でした。では、あなたの能力を認定します。
dialogsComplete.kr: 그 정도면 꽤 괜찮은데요, 아크로뱃. 가능성이 보이는 것 같아요. 훈련을 받으셔도 괜찮겠어요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Not bad, Acrobat. Not bad at all. You may have something to offer. I'll allow your training.
dialogsComplete.pl: Not bad, Acrobat. Not bad at all. You may have something to offer. I'll allow your training.
dialogsComplete.ru: Not bad, Acrobat. Not bad at all. You may have something to offer. I'll allow your training.
dialogsComplete.sp: No está mal, Acrobat. No está nada mal. Tal vez tengas algo que ofrecer. Permitiré tu entrenamiento.
dialogsComplete.sw: Not bad, Acrobat. Not bad at all. You may have something to offer. I'll allow your training.
dialogsComplete.th: ไม่เลว Acrobat ไม่เลวเลย คุณอาจมีสิ่งที่จะนำเสนอ ฉันจะอนุญาตการฝึกของคุณ
dialogsComplete.tw: 不錯呦，雜技師！一點也不差。你可能有一些東西可以提供。我會允許你的訓練。
dialogsComplete.vi: Không tệ, Acrobat. Không tệ chút nào. Bạn có thể mời chào cái gì đó. Tôi cho phép bạn đào tạo.

dialogsFail.en: I doubt you have what it takes to be a Jester if you can't even slay 20 Drillers.
dialogsFail.ar: I doubt you have what it takes to be a Jester if you can't even slay 20 Drillers.
dialogsFail.br: Outro Jester jamais seguraria sua mão se você não conseguisse caçar os 20.
dialogsFail.cns: 你没办法猎杀20只钻孔机回来的话，我也没办法帮你...
dialogsFail.de: Ich bezweifle, dass du das Zeug zum Jester hast. Du bist ja nicht einmal in der Lage, 20 Driller zu erlegen...
dialogsFail.fi: I doubt you have what it takes to be a Jester if you can't even slay 20 Drillers.
dialogsFail.fil: I doubt you have what it takes to be a Jester if you can't even slay 20 Drillers.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu ne parviens pas à tuer ces 20 Drillers, il vaut mieux que tu oublies la voie du Jester.
dialogsFail.id: Aku ragu kamu memiliki apa saja yang diperlukan untuk menjadi Jester jika bahkan kamu tidak bisa membunuh 20 Drillers.
dialogsFail.it: I doubt you have what it takes to be a Jester if you can't even slay 20 Drillers.
dialogsFail.jp: 20匹の狩りに成功しなければ、ジェスター後継者への第一歩すら踏み出せませんよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 드릴러 20마리도 쓰러뜨리지 못한다면, 제스터가 될 자질이 있는 것 같진 않은데요.
dialogsFail.nl: I doubt you have what it takes to be a Jester if you can't even slay 20 Drillers.
dialogsFail.pl: Wątpię, czy posiadasz to, czego potrzeba, by zostać Figlarzem, jeśli nie możesz zabić 20 Wiertników.
dialogsFail.ru: Если ты не можешь убить пару десятков буров, куда тебе в шуты?
dialogsFail.sp: Dudo que tengas lo necesario para ser un Jester si no puedes derrotar a 20 Drillers.
dialogsFail.sw: I doubt you have what it takes to be a Jester if you can't even slay 20 Drillers.
dialogsFail.th: ฉันสงสัยว่าคุณมีสิ่งที่จะเป็น Jester ได้หรือไม่ ถ้าคุณไม่สามารถแม้แต่จะฆ่า 20 Drillers ได้
dialogsFail.tw: 你沒辦法獵殺 20 隻回來的話，我也沒辦法幫你…
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi nghi ngờ bạn có trở thành được Jester nếu bạn thậm chí không thể giết 20 Drillers.

description.en: Deliver the Seal of Aenn to Teshar in Eastern Flarine.

dialogsComplete.pl: Greetings, I am Teshar, and I lead Kyon’s company of soldiers for hire. How may I help...oh my. How did you find this? I’ve looked all over Flaris for it.
dialogsComplete.ru: Greetings, I am Teshar, and I lead Kyon’s company of soldiers for hire. How may I help...oh my. How did you find this? I’ve looked all over Flaris for it.
dialogsComplete.sp: Saludos, soy Teshar y dirijo la compañía de soldados a sueldo de Kyon. ¿Cómo te puedo ayudar...? oh. ¿Cómo has encontrado esto? Lo he buscado por todo Flaris.
dialogsComplete.sw: Greetings, I am Teshar, and I lead Kyon’s company of soldiers for hire. How may I help...oh my. How did you find this? I’ve looked all over Flaris for it.
dialogsComplete.th: หวัดดี ฉันคือ Teshar และฉันเป็นผู้นำของกลุ่ม Kyon ฉันทำหน้าที่ในหน่วยว่าจ้างทหาร ฉันสามารถช่วยอะไรคุณได้บ้าง โอ้โห คุณพบสิ่งนี้ได้อย่างไรกัน? ฉันตามหามันทั่ว Flaris เลยนะ
dialogsComplete.tw: 你好！我是傭兵團團長蝶斯塔洛得，是你找回這個的嗎？你是怎麼找到的？
dialogsComplete.vi: Xin chào, tôi là Teshar, và tôi lãnh đạo đội lính cho thuê của Kyon. Làm thế nào tôi có thể giúp ... Ôi trời. Làm thế nào bạn tìm thấy cái này vậy? Tôi đã kiểm tra khắp Flaris để tìm nó.

dialogsComplete.en: In Saint Morning, really? That explains why I never ran across it. Anyway, thank you very much. Please, take this as a token of my appreciation.
dialogsComplete.ar: In Saint Morning, really? That explains why I never ran across it. Anyway, thank you very much. Please, take this as a token of my appreciation.
dialogsComplete.br: Ah, você a encontrou em Saint Morning? Sério? Foi por isso que não consegui encontrá-la... De qualquer maneira, muito obrigada. Por favor, aceite isto como símbolo de meu agradecimento.
dialogsComplete.cns: 原来如此，是在晨光找到的啊！总之，谢谢你的帮忙，这谢礼请收下吧！
dialogsComplete.de: In Saint Morning, wirklich? Das erklärt, warum ich nie darauf gestoßen bin. Wie auch immer, ich danke dir vielmals. Bitte nimm dies als ein Zeichen meiner Wertschätzung.
dialogsComplete.fi: In Saint Morning, really? That explains why I never ran across it. Anyway, thank you very much. Please, take this as a token of my appreciation.
dialogsComplete.fil: In Saint Morning, really? That explains why I never ran across it. Anyway, thank you very much. Please, take this as a token of my appreciation.
dialogsComplete.fr: J'apprécie énormément ce que tu as fait ! Je commençais à désespérer de retrouver un jour cette relique sacrée.
dialogsComplete.id: Di Saint Morning, benarkah? Itu menjelaskan mengapa saya tidak pernah berlari melintasinya. Bagaimanapun, terima kasih banyak. Tolong, anggap ini sebagai tanda penghargaan saya.
dialogsComplete.it: In Saint Morning, really? That explains why I never ran across it. Anyway, thank you very much. Please, take this as a token of my appreciation.
dialogsComplete.jp: なるほど、セイントモーニングにあったのだな。感謝する！やっと一族の使命を果たすことができた。そうだ、君にこれを託そう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 세인트 모닝에 있었다고요? 제가 지금껏 못 찾은 이유가 있었군요. 아무튼 정말 고맙습니다. 이건 감사의 표시예요.
dialogsComplete.nl: In Saint Morning, really? That explains why I never ran across it. Anyway, thank you very much. Please, take this as a token of my appreciation.
dialogsComplete.pl: In Saint Morning, really? That explains why I never ran across it. Anyway, thank you very much. Please, take this as a token of my appreciation.
dialogsComplete.ru: In Saint Morning, really? That explains why I never ran across it. Anyway, thank you very much. Please, take this as a token of my appreciation.
dialogsComplete.sp: En Saint Morning, ¿de verdad? Eso explica por qué nunca me lo he encontrado. De todos modos, muchas gracias. Por favor, toma esto como una muestra de mi agradecimiento.
dialogsComplete.sw: In Saint Morning, really? That explains why I never ran across it. Anyway, thank you very much. Please, take this as a token of my appreciation.
dialogsComplete.th: ในเมือง Saint Morning งั้นเหรอ? สิ่งนี้อธิบายได้เลยล่ะว่าทำไมฉันมักมองข้ามมันไป แต่ยังไงก็ขอบคุณมากนะ รับนี่ไป นี่คือเหรียญแห่งการยอมรับของฉัน
dialogsComplete.tw: 原來如此，是在聖音特找到的啊！總之，謝謝你的幫忙，這謝禮請收下吧！
dialogsComplete.vi: Ở Saint Morning, thực sự sao? Điều đó giải thích tại sao tôi không bao giờ tình cờ gặp nó. Dù sao, cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều. Làm ơn, hãy coi điều này như một biểu hiện trân trọng của tôi.

dialogsComplete.en: This Scroll was passed down to each Ringmasters in my family. I’d like you to have it.
dialogsComplete.ar: This Scroll was passed down to each Ringmasters in my family. I’d like you to have it.
dialogsComplete.br: Este é o pergaminho que somente os sucessores na minha família podem ter. Agora eu o estou entregando a você. Será o comprovante que mostra que você é reconhecido como um sucessor.
dialogsComplete.cns: 这是给继承者的卷轴，记的要好好保管喔！这是你已经成为了守护使者继承者的证明！
dialogsComplete.de: Diese Schriftrolle können nur die Nachfolger meiner Familie erhalten. Nun werde ich sie dir geben. Ist ist der Beweis, das du als Nachfolger anerkannt wurdest.
dialogsComplete.fi: This Scroll was passed down to each Ringmasters in my family. I’d like you to have it.
dialogsComplete.fil: This Scroll was passed down to each Ringmasters in my family. I’d like you to have it.
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh, voici quelque chose pour te récompenser de tes efforts. Ceci est le Parchemin que seuls les descendants de ma famille peuvent avoir. Il t'appartient désormais.
dialogsComplete.id: Gulungan ini diturunkan ke setiap Ringmaster di keluarga saya. Saya ingin kamu memilikinya.
dialogsComplete.it: This Scroll was passed down to each Ringmasters in my family. I’d like you to have it.
dialogsComplete.jp: これは後継者に差し上げる巻物だ。リングマスター後継者を目指すものに、次の道を指し示すでだろう。どうか受け取ってくれ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이 두루마리는 저희 가문의 링마스터에게 대대로 전해지는 거랍니다. 이걸 당신에게 드리고 싶군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: This Scroll was passed down to each Ringmasters in my family. I’d like you to have it.
dialogsComplete.pl: This Scroll was passed down to each Ringmasters in my family. I’d like you to have it.
dialogsComplete.ru: Он передавался в моей семье из поколения в поколение. Теперь я отдаю его тебе.
dialogsComplete.sp: Este Pergamino se ha transmitido a cada Ringmaster de mi familia. Me gustaría que te lo quedaras.
dialogsComplete.sw: This Scroll was passed down to each Ringmasters in my family. I’d like you to have it.
dialogsComplete.th: Scroll นี้ตกทอดจาก Ringmasters ในครอบครัวของฉัน ฉันอยากให้คุณรับไว้
dialogsComplete.tw: 這是給繼承者的卷軸，記的要好好保管喔！這是你已經成為了守護者繼承者的證明！
dialogsComplete.vi: Scroll này đã được truyền lại cho từng Ringmasters trong gia đình tôi. Tôi muốn bạn có nó.

dialogsFail.en: Even though the Kyon are hired soldiers, we do not follow just anyone because of the money. We respect faith and royalty.
dialogsFail.ar: Even though the Kyon are hired soldiers, we do not follow just anyone because of the money. We respect faith and royalty.
dialogsFail.br: Mesmo sendo soldados contratados, os Kyon não seguem ninguém por causa do dinheiro. Nós respeitamos a fé e a realeza.
dialogsFail.cns: 本佣兵团可不是随随便便的佣兵团~我们很重视信义和礼仪的！
dialogsFail.de: Obwohl die Soldaten von Kyon Söldner sind, folgen nicht alle des Geldes wegen. Wir respektieren Hoffnung und Könige.
dialogsFail.fi: Even though the Kyon are hired soldiers, we do not follow just anyone because of the money. We respect faith and royalty.
dialogsFail.fil: Even though the Kyon are hired soldiers, we do not follow just anyone because of the money. We respect faith and royalty.
dialogsFail.fr: Même si les soldats de Kyon sont des conscrits, nous ne suivons personne pour l'argent !
dialogsFail.id: Meskipun Kyon adalah tentara bayaran, kami tidak mengikuti sembarang orang karena uang. Kami menghormati iman dan royalti.
dialogsFail.it: Even though the Kyon are hired soldiers, we do not follow just anyone because of the money. We respect faith and royalty.
dialogsFail.jp: キオン傭兵団は金のために善悪を考えず動く集団ではない。常に正義の道を尊重しているのだ。
dialogsFail.kr: 키온 용병단은 돈 때문에 아무에게나 충성하지 않습니다. 신의와 의리를 중요하게 생각하죠.
dialogsFail.nl: Even though the Kyon are hired soldiers, we do not follow just anyone because of the money. We respect faith and royalty.
dialogsFail.pl: Even though the Kyon are hired soldiers, we do not follow just anyone because of the money. We respect faith and royalty.
dialogsFail.ru: Мои солдаты - наемники, но им не все равно, за кого воевать. Мы следуем заветам Киу и уважаем верность и честь.
dialogsFail.sp: Aunque los de Kyon somos soldados contratados, no seguimos a cualquiera por el dinero. Respetamos la fe y la realeza.
dialogsFail.sw: Even though the Kyon are hired soldiers, we do not follow just anyone because of the money. We respect faith and royalty.
dialogsFail.th: แม้ว่า Kyon จะเป็นทหารว่าจ้าง แต่เราก็ไม่ได้ทำเพราะเงิน เรานับถือความศรัทธาและความภักดี
dialogsFail.tw: 本傭兵團可不是隨隨便便的傭兵團~我們很重視信義和禮儀的！
dialogsFail.vi: Mặc dù Kyon là những người lính đánh thuê, chúng tôi không theo bất cứ ai chỉ vì tiền. Chúng tôi tôn trọng đức tin và hoàng gia.

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsDecline.en: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.ar: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.br: Você ainda tem que pagar pelos seus pecados...
dialogsDecline.cns: 你还没有为你的罪恶付出代价...
dialogsDecline.de: Du musst noch immer für deine Sünden bezahlen...
dialogsDecline.fi: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.fil: Di mo pa bayad ang iyong mga kasalanan…
dialogsDecline.fr: Quand expieras-tu tes nombreux crimes ?
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu belum membayar untuk dosa-dosamu…
dialogsDecline.it: Devi ancora pagare per i tuoi peccati...
dialogsDecline.jp: いつになったら、この底知れぬ罪悪感から抜けられるのだろう？
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신은 아직 죗값을 치르지 않았으니...
dialogsDecline.nl: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.pl: Musisz najpierw zapłacić za swoje grzechy…
dialogsDecline.ru: Велики твои грехи…
dialogsDecline.sp: Todavía tienes que pagar por tus pecados...
dialogsDecline.sw: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.th: คุณยังไม้ได้ชดใช้บาปของคุณ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 你還沒有為你的罪付出代價…
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn vẫn chưa phải trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình…

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.br: Sua missão foi concluída. Seus pecados foram perdoados.
dialogsComplete.cns: 任务完成，你的罪恶已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Buße getan. Deine Sünden wurden dir vergeben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Questmu telah tercapai. Dosa-dosamu telah diampuni.
dialogsComplete.it: La Missione è terminata. I tuoi peccati sono stati perdonati.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 끝났습니다. 당신의 죄를 용서하지요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Боги одобрили твое деяние и простили тебе грехи.
dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น บาปของคุณได้รับการอภัยแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nhiệm vụ của bạn đã được hoàn thành. Tội lỗi của bạn đã được tha thứ.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Sury's mind is currently clouded with doubt, as the Guardian had mentioned. In her current state, she will never reach enlightenment regardless of how hard she trains…
dialogsBegin.ar: Sury's mind is currently clouded with doubt, as the Guardian had mentioned. In her current state, she will never reach enlightenment regardless of how hard she trains…
dialogsBegin.br: A mente de Sury está atualmente nublada pela dúvida, como a Guardiã havia mencionado. Em seu estado atual, ela nunca alcançará o estado de iluminação, independentemente de quão duro ela treine…
dialogsBegin.cns: 正如守护使者所说，现在叙里的脑海中充满了自我怀疑。以她现在的状态，再怎么努力修炼，也永远不会突破...
dialogsBegin.de: Surys Geist ist derzeit von Zweifeln getrübt, wie der Wächter erwähnt hatte. In ihrem derzeitigen Zustand wird sie die Erleuchtung nie erreichen, egal wie hart sie trainiert...
dialogsBegin.fi: Sury's mind is currently clouded with doubt, as the Guardian had mentioned. In her current state, she will never reach enlightenment regardless of how hard she trains…
dialogsBegin.fil: Sury's mind is currently clouded with doubt, as the Guardian had mentioned. In her current state, she will never reach enlightenment regardless of how hard she trains…
dialogsBegin.fr: En effet le fragment de savoir nous aidera à découvrir la cause de l'inquiétude de Sury.
dialogsBegin.id: Pikiran Sury saat ini diselimuti keraguan, seperti yang disebutkan Guardian. Dalam kondisinya saat ini, dia tidak akan pernah mencapai pencerahan terlepas dari seberapa keras dia berlatih ...
dialogsBegin.it: Sury's mind is currently clouded with doubt, as the Guardian had mentioned. In her current state, she will never reach enlightenment regardless of how hard she trains…
dialogsBegin.jp: シュリの心は現在疑いで曇っています。 彼女の現在の状態では、どんなに激しく訓練しても、彼女は決して悟りに達することはできません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 수호자님의 말씀처럼, 슈리님께선 깊은 의심에 사로잡혀 있습니다. 이런 상태로는 아무리 수행을 해도 깨달음에 이르긴 어렵겠죠...
dialogsBegin.nl: Sury's mind is currently clouded with doubt, as the Guardian had mentioned. In her current state, she will never reach enlightenment regardless of how hard she trains…
dialogsBegin.pl: Sury's mind is currently clouded with doubt, as the Guardian had mentioned. In her current state, she will never reach enlightenment regardless of how hard she trains…
dialogsBegin.ru: Sury's mind is currently clouded with doubt, as the Guardian had mentioned. In her current state, she will never reach enlightenment regardless of how hard she trains…
dialogsBegin.sp: La mente de Sury está nublada por la duda, como había mencionado la Guardiana. En su estado actual, nunca alcanzará la iluminación, independientemente de lo duro que entrene...
dialogsBegin.sw: Sury's mind is currently clouded with doubt, as the Guardian had mentioned. In her current state, she will never reach enlightenment regardless of how hard she trains…
dialogsBegin.th: หากต้องการได้รับการเรียน รู้คุณต้องเสี่ยงมาก ดังนั้นให้ฉันทดสอบความสามารถของนักผจญภัย คุณพร้อมที่จะสอบแล้วหรือยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 正如守護者所說，修利的思緒目前被疑惑籠罩。以她現在的狀態，無論多麼努力訓練都無法獲得啟蒙……
dialogsBegin.vi: Tâm trí của Sury hiện đang xuất hiện trạng thái hoang mang nghi ngại, như Guardian đã đề cập. Ở trạng thái hiện tại, cô ấy sẽ không bao giờ đạt được sự giác ngộ bất kể cô ấy luyện tập chăm chỉ như thế nào…

dialogsBegin.en: To help grant her thoughts a renewed sense of clarity, we must bring her a Shard of Enlightenment. First I must test your own personal strength. Do you accept?
dialogsBegin.ar: To help grant her thoughts a renewed sense of clarity, we must bring her a Shard of Enlightenment. First I must test your own personal strength. Do you accept?
dialogsBegin.br: Para ajudar a conceder a seus pensamentos uma sensação renovada de clareza, devemos levar para ela um Fragmento de Iluminação. Mas primeiro devo testar sua própria força pessoal. Você aceita?
dialogsBegin.cns: 为了让她的思绪重新变得清晰，我们必须给她带来一点启迪。但首先，我必须考验你的个人实力。你接受吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Um ihren Gedanken zu neuer Klarheit zu verhelfen, müssen wir ihr einen Shard of Enlightenment bringen. Zuerst muss ich deine persönliche Stärke testen. Bist du einverstanden?
dialogsBegin.fi: To help grant her thoughts a renewed sense of clarity, we must bring her a Shard of Enlightenment. First I must test your own personal strength. Do you accept?
dialogsBegin.fil: To help grant her thoughts a renewed sense of clarity, we must bring her a Shard of Enlightenment. First I must test your own personal strength. Do you accept?
dialogsBegin.fr: Le fragment de savoir se fabrique à l'aide d'un rituel magique.
dialogsBegin.id: Untuk membantu memberikan pikirannya rasa kejelasan yang diperbarui, kita harus membawakannya pecahan Shard of Enlightenment saya harus menguji kekuatan pribadi Anda sendiri. Apakah Anda menerima?
dialogsBegin.it: To help grant her thoughts a renewed sense of clarity, we must bring her a Shard of Enlightenment. First I must test your own personal strength. Do you accept?
dialogsBegin.jp: 彼女の考えに新たな明晰さを与えるために、私たちは彼女に悟りの欠片を持って来なければなりません。 最初に私はあなたの強さをテストしなければなりません。 受けますか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 슈리님께서 마음의 안개를 걷고 다시 맑은 정신을 되찾을 수 있도록, 깨달음의 파편을 가져와야 합니다. 하지만 그 전에 먼저 당신의 실력부터 확인하고 싶군요. 어떻습니까?
dialogsBegin.nl: To help grant her thoughts a renewed sense of clarity, we must bring her a Shard of Enlightenment. First I must test your own personal strength. Do you accept?
dialogsBegin.pl: To help grant her thoughts a renewed sense of clarity, we must bring her a Shard of Enlightenment. First I must test your own personal strength. Do you accept?
dialogsBegin.ru: To help grant her thoughts a renewed sense of clarity, we must bring her a Shard of Enlightenment. First I must test your own personal strength. Do you accept?
dialogsBegin.sp: Para ayudarle a otorgar a sus pensamientos una renovada sensación de claridad, debemos llevarle un Fragmento de la Iluminación. Primero debo poner a prueba tu propia fuerza personal. ¿Aceptas?
dialogsBegin.sw: To help grant her thoughts a renewed sense of clarity, we must bring her a Shard of Enlightenment. First I must test your own personal strength. Do you accept?
dialogsBegin.th: เพื่อช่วยให้เธอตาสว่าง เราต้องนำ Shard of Enlightenment มาให้เธอ ก่อนอื่น ฉันต้องทดสอบความแข็งแกร่งของคุณ คุณรับคำท้าหรือไม่
dialogsBegin.tw: 若要讓她重新理清思緒，我們必須帶一枚啟蒙碎片給她。不過，我得先測試你本人的實力。你願意接受嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Để giúp cho suy nghĩ của cô ấy trở nên sáng suốt hơn, chúng ta phải mang lại về cho cô ấy Shard of Enlightenment. Đầu tiên, tôi phải kiểm tra sức mạnh cá nhân của riêng bạn. Bạn có chấp nhận không?

dialogsAccept.en: I knew you wouldn't back away from this challenge. Please hunt 60 Small Kern and 40 Kern located in Southern Darkon 3.
dialogsAccept.ar: I knew you wouldn't back away from this challenge. Please hunt 60 Small Kern and 40 Kern located in Southern Darkon 3.
dialogsAccept.br: Eu sabia que você não iria recusar esse desafio. Por favor, cace 60 Kerns Pequenos e 40 Kerns localizados ao Sul de Darkon 3.

dialogsAccept.de: Ich wusste, dass du vor dieser Herausforderung nicht zurückschrecken würdest. Bitte jagt 60 Small Kern und 40 Kern in Süd-Darkon 3.

dialogsAccept.jp: わかりました。では、部下ケルン60匹、ケルン40匹を倒してきて下さい。
dialogsAccept.kr: 수락하실 줄 알았습니다. 그럼 서쪽 다콘 제3지구에 있는 부하 케른 60마리, 케른 40마리를 처치하고 오십시오.
dialogsAccept.nl: I knew you wouldn't back away from this challenge. Please hunt 60 Small Kern and 40 Kern located in Southern Darkon 3.
dialogsAccept.pl: I knew you wouldn't back away from this challenge. Please hunt 60 Small Kern and 40 Kern located in Southern Darkon 3.
dialogsAccept.ru: I knew you wouldn't back away from this challenge. Please hunt 60 Small Kern and 40 Kern located in Southern Darkon 3.
dialogsAccept.sp: Sabía que no retrocederías ante este desafío. Derrota a 60 Kerns Pequeños y a 40 Kerns ubicados al Sur de Darkon 3.
dialogsAccept.sw: I knew you wouldn't back away from this challenge. Please hunt 60 Small Kern and 40 Kern located in Southern Darkon 3.
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันรู้ว่าคุณจะไม่หนีจากการท้าทายครั้งนี้ ช่วยล่า 60 Small Kern and 40 Kern ที่ Southern Darkon 3
dialogsAccept.tw: 我就知道你會答應。那麼請消滅位於得肯第三區南部的 60 隻小炎王和 40 隻炎王，然後再回來吧。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi biết bạn sẽ không lùi bước trước thử thách này. Hãy săn 60 Small Kern và 40 Kern nằm trong Southern Darkon 3.

dialogsComplete.fi: I never doubted your skill for a second!
dialogsComplete.fil: I never doubted your skill for a second!
dialogsComplete.fr: Vous avez réussi, les esprits s'agitent…
dialogsComplete.id: Saya tidak pernah meragukan keahlian Anda sedetik pun!
dialogsComplete.it: I never doubted your skill for a second!
dialogsComplete.jp: ケルンを倒してきたのですね。確かに、貴方に悟りの一部が宿ってきたようです。

dialogsComplete.tw: 我從來沒有懷疑過你的實力！
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi không bao giờ nghi ngờ kỹ năng của bạn dù trong một tích tắc!

dialogsFail.de: Bitte gehe auf die Jagd nach Kern, und deine eigene Stärke zu testen.

dialogsFail.tw: 請去追捕炎王，以測試你自己的力量。
dialogsFail.vi: Hãy đi săn Kern để kiểm tra sức mạnh của bản thân.

name.jp: ルダの金庫を取り戻せ！
name.sp: Encuentra la Caja Fuerte de Luda
name.th: ค้นหากล่องเงินสดของ Luda

description.en: Recover Luda's cash box from the Red bang Thieves at the camp west of the Fountain of Dead Person.
description.ar: Recover Luda's cash box from the Red bang Thieves at the camp west of the Fountain of Dead Person.
description.br: Recupere o Cofre de Luda dos Ladrões dos Bangs Vermelhos no acampamento a oeste da Fonte dos Mortos.
description.cns: 听说它们的其中一个人员保管着我的金库，你一定可以找得到的!
description.de: Hol dir Ludas Geldkassette von den Red Bang Dieben im Lager westlich des Fountain of Dead Person.
description.fi: Recover Luda's cash box from the Red bang Thieves at the camp west of the Fountain of Dead Person.
description.fil: Recover Luda's cash box from the Red bang Thieves at the camp west of the Fountain of Dead Person.
description.fr: Ramener la tirelire des Luda volée par l'un des Big Bangs qui se cache aux Montagnes nord de Leren
description.id: Pulihkan kotak uang Luda dari Red bang Thieves di kamp barat Fountain of Dead Person.
description.it: Recover Luda's cash box from the Red bang Thieves at the camp west of the Fountain of Dead Person.
description.jp: 奪われた金庫はその盗賊団の中の一人が保管しているらしい。盗賊団を倒して金庫を取り戻そう。
description.kr: 망자의 샘 서쪽에 있는 레드 뱅 도적단 본거지에서 루다의 금고를 되찾아 주세요.
description.nl: Recover Luda's cash box from the Red bang Thieves at the camp west of the Fountain of Dead Person.
description.pl: Recover Luda's cash box from the Red bang Thieves at the camp west of the Fountain of Dead Person.
description.ru: Нужно отобрать кубышку Людора у проходимцев из "Труппы товарищей". Они бродят на западе от фонтана Мертвеца.
description.sp: Recupera la Caja Fuerte de Luda de los Bangs Rojos ladrones del campamento que hay al oeste del Manantial de Almas.
description.sw: Recover Luda's cash box from the Red bang Thieves at the camp west of the Fountain of Dead Person.
description.th: กู้คืนกล่องเงินสดของ Luda จาก Red Bang Thieves ที่ค่ายทางตะวันตกของ Fountain of Dead Person
description.tw: 在亡者噴泉以西的營地，從紅崩崩竊盜手中奪回路達的錢箱。
description.vi: Thu hồi thùng tiền của Luda từ Red bang Thieves ở trại phía tây Fountain of Dead Person.

dialogsBegin.en: I asked the witnesses with the evidence you have brought to me, and now it is clear they had stolen my cash box. Now the only thing I have to do is get the cash box back from them.
dialogsBegin.ar: I asked the witnesses with the evidence you have brought to me, and now it is clear they had stolen my cash box. Now the only thing I have to do is get the cash box back from them.
dialogsBegin.br: Falei com as testemunhas e apresentei a prova que você me trouxe, e agora ficou claro que eles roubaram o meu cofre. Agora a única coisa que eu tenho que fazer é pegar o cofre de volta.
dialogsBegin.cns: 嗯..我拿了你给我的证据去问村民，他们说就是它们没有错!只要把我的金库拿来就好了..
dialogsBegin.de: Mit den Beweisen befragte ich die Zeugen und nun ist klar, dass diese Diebe den Safe gestohlen haben. Das einzige, was jetzt noch zu tun bleibt, ist den Safe zu finden.
dialogsBegin.fi: Kysyin todistajilta todisteita, jotka olet tuonut minulle, ja nyt on selvää, että he olivat varastaneet kassalaatikoni. Nyt minun täytyy vain saada kassalaatikko heiltä takaisin.
dialogsBegin.fil: I asked the witnesses with the evidence you have brought to me, and now it is clear they had stolen my cash box. Now the only thing I have to do is get the cash box back from them.
dialogsBegin.fr: J'ai demandé à plusieurs témoins avec la preuve que tu m'as rapportée, et maintenant je suis sûr que c'est les Big Bangs qui ont ma tirelire !
dialogsBegin.id: Aku bertanya kepada para saksi dengan bukti yang kamu bawa kepadaku, dan sekarang jelas mereka telah mencuri kotak uangnya. Sekarang satu-satunya hal yang harus aku lakukan adalah mengambil kotak uang itu kembali dari mereka.
dialogsBegin.it: I asked the witnesses with the evidence you have brought to me, and now it is clear they had stolen my cash box. Now the only thing I have to do is get the cash box back from them.
dialogsBegin.jp: 持ってきてくれた証拠を見せて情報を集めたら、やはりそいつらの仕業に間違いはなかったよ。そいつらから金庫を取り戻すことができれば！
dialogsBegin.kr: 당신이 준 증거를 가지고 목격자들을 수소문했어요. 역시, 도적단이 제 금고 상자를 훔친 거였어요. 이제 되찾아오기만 하면 돼요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I asked the witnesses with the evidence you have brought to me, and now it is clear they had stolen my cash box. Now the only thing I have to do is get the cash box back from them.
dialogsBegin.pl: I asked the witnesses with the evidence you have brought to me, and now it is clear they had stolen my cash box. Now the only thing I have to do is get the cash box back from them.
dialogsBegin.ru: Ну, теперь уж я уверен, что эти самые разбойники и украли мою кубышку! Осталось вернуть добро.
dialogsBegin.sp: Le pregunté a los testigos con las pruebas que me has traído, y ahora está claro que me habían robado la caja registradora. Ahora lo único que tengo que hacer es recuperarla.
dialogsBegin.sw: I asked the witnesses with the evidence you have brought to me, and now it is clear they had stolen my cash box. Now the only thing I have to do is get the cash box back from them.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันถามพยานพร้อมหลักฐานที่คุณนำมาให้ฉัน และตอนนี้เห็นได้ชัดว่าพวกเขาขโมยกล่องเงินสดของฉันไป ตอนนี้สิ่งเดียวที่ฉันต้องทำคือเอากล่องเงินสดคืนจากพวกเขา
dialogsBegin.tw: 嗯…我拿了你給我的證據去問村民，他們說就是牠們沒有錯！只要把我的金庫拿來就好了…
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đã hỏi các nhân chứng với bằng chứng mà bạn mang đến cho tôi, và rõ ràng chúng đã lấy trộm thùng tiền của tôi. Bây giờ điều duy nhất tôi phải làm là lấy lại thùng tiền từ chúng.

dialogsBegin.en: I am really sorry but please do me a favor once again? I really need to get that cash box back. I really need to get my girlfriend a present. You see…
dialogsBegin.ar: I am really sorry but please do me a favor once again? I really need to get that cash box back. I really need to get my girlfriend a present. You see…
dialogsBegin.br: Perdão, mas você pode me fazer mais um favor? Realmente preciso do meu cofre. Preciso comprar um presente para minha namorada. Sabe...
dialogsBegin.cns: 那个..我知道这样很不好意思..可以再帮我一次吗?我要有金库里面的钱，才能购买礼物送给女朋友…
dialogsBegin.de: Entschuldige bitte, aber kannst du mir ein weiteres Mal helfen? Erst wenn ich das Geld aus dem Safe habe, kann ich meiner Freundin das Geschenk kaufen. Weißt du...
dialogsBegin.fi: Olen todella pahoillani, mutta tehkää minulle palvelus vielä kerran? Minun täytyy todella saada se kassalaatikko takaisin. Minun täytyy todella saada tyttöystävälleni lahja. Näet…
dialogsBegin.fil: I am really sorry but please do me a favor once again? I really need to get that cash box back. I really need to get my girlfriend a present. You see…
dialogsBegin.fr: Je suis vraiment désolé, mais s'il te plaît accorde-moi encore une faveur. Je ne pourrais acheter de cadeau à ma petite amie qu'une fois que j'aurais cet argent. En plus.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku benar-benar minta maaf tapi tolong bantu aku sekali lagi? Aku benar-benar perlu mendapatkan kotak uang itu kembali. Aku benar-benar perlu memberi kekasihku hadiah. Kamu tahu…
dialogsBegin.it: I am really sorry but please do me a favor once again? I really need to get that cash box back. I really need to get my girlfriend a present. You see…
dialogsBegin.jp: すまないが、もう一度君に頼みたい。あいつらに奪われた金庫を取り戻さないと、婚約者にバースデープレゼントがあげられないんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 정말 죄송하지만, 다시 한 번만 부탁할게요. 금고 상자를 꼭 되찾아야 해요. 여자친구에게 선물을 주고 싶거든요…
dialogsBegin.nl: I am really sorry but please do me a favor once again? I really need to get that cash box back. I really need to get my girlfriend a present. You see…
dialogsBegin.pl: I am really sorry but please do me a favor once again? I really need to get that cash box back. I really need to get my girlfriend a present. You see…
dialogsBegin.ru: Ты поможешь, правда? Деньги мне сейчас очень нужны. Иначе я не смогу купить подарок моей красавице… А у нас юбилей!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Perdona pero, podrías hacerme un favor más por favor? Necesito recuperar esa caja registradora. Necesito comprarle un regalo a mi novia. Además…
dialogsBegin.sw: I am really sorry but please do me a favor once again? I really need to get that cash box back. I really need to get my girlfriend a present. You see…
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันขอโทษจริงๆ แต่โปรดช่วยฉันอีกครั้งได้ไหม? ฉันต้องเอากล่องเงินสดคืนมาจริงๆ ฉันต้องการของขวัญให้แฟนจริงๆ…
dialogsBegin.tw: 我真的很抱歉，但請再幫我一個忙好嗎？我真的需要拿回那個錢箱，我真的需要給我的女朋友送禮物。你知道的…
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi thực sự xin lỗi nhưng làm ơn hãy giúp tôi một lần nữa được không? Tôi thực sự cần lấy lại thùng tiền đó. Tôi thực sự cần tặng quà cho bạn gái của mình. Bạn thấy…

dialogsBegin.en: it is our 100th day anniversary… She will be so upset if I don't. Would you please get my cash box back from them? I will reward you.
dialogsBegin.ar: it is our 100th day anniversary… She will be so upset if I don't. Would you please get my cash box back from them? I will reward you.
dialogsBegin.br: é nosso aniversário de 100 dias...Ela vai ficar triste se eu não der um presente. Então, você poderia trazer meu cofre de volta, por favor? Eu o recompensarei.
dialogsBegin.cns: 过不几天是我跟女朋友的100天纪念日，可以帮我拿回我的钱吗?我一定会报答你的!
dialogsBegin.de: Bald wird unser 100. Jubiläumstag sein.. Würdest du also bitte den Safe von den Dieben zurückbringen? Ich werde dich reich belohnen.
dialogsBegin.fi: on 100-vuotispäivämme… Hän on niin järkyttynyt, jos en tee. Saisitko kassalaatikkoni heiltä takaisin? Minä palkitsen sinut.
dialogsBegin.fil: it is our 100th day anniversary… She will be so upset if I don't. Would you please get my cash box back from them? I will reward you.
dialogsBegin.fr: Ce sera bientôt l'anniversaire de notre rencontre...100 jours déjà ! Peux-tu me ramener ma tirelire s'il te plaît, et je te récompenserai comme il se doit ?
dialogsBegin.id: ini adalah hari jadi kami yang ke-100… Dia akan sangat marah jika aku tidak melakukannya. Maukah kamu mendapatkan kembali kotak uangku dari mereka? Aku akan memberimu hadiah.
dialogsBegin.it: it is our 100th day anniversary… She will be so upset if I don't. Would you please get my cash box back from them? I will reward you.
dialogsBegin.jp: その日は恋人と付き合い始めてからちょうど100日目になる大事な記念日なんだよ。どうかオレのために、力を貸してくれないか？もちろんお礼は約束するよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 저희의 100일 기념이라… 선물이 없으면 여자친구가 실망할 거예요. 부탁해요, 제발 금고 상자를 찾아주세요. 보상도 드릴게요.
dialogsBegin.nl: it is our 100th day anniversary… She will be so upset if I don't. Would you please get my cash box back from them? I will reward you.
dialogsBegin.pl: it is our 100th day anniversary… She will be so upset if I don't. Would you please get my cash box back from them? I will reward you.
dialogsBegin.ru: Сто дней знакомства - это тебе не шутка! Она обидится, если я ее не поздравлю. Пожалуйста, помоги мне вернуть кубышку!
dialogsBegin.sp: es nuestro aniversario de 100 días... Se enfadará mucho si no le regalo nada. ¿Podrías recuperar mi caja registradora por favor? Te recompensaré.
dialogsBegin.sw: it is our 100th day anniversary… She will be so upset if I don't. Would you please get my cash box back from them? I will reward you.
dialogsBegin.th: มันเป็นวันครบรอบ 100 วันของเรา… เธอจะอารมณ์เสียมากถ้าฉันไม่ทำ คุณช่วยเอากล่องเงินสดของฉันคืนจากพวกเขาได้ไหม ฉันจะตอบแทนคุณอย่างงาม
dialogsBegin.tw: 過不幾天是我跟女朋友的 100 天紀念日，可以幫我拿回我的錢嗎？我一定會報答你的！
dialogsBegin.vi: đó là kỷ niệm 100 ngày của chúng tôi… Cô ấy sẽ rất buồn nếu tôi không tặng quà. Bạn có vui lòng lấy lại thùng tiền của tôi từ chúng không? Tôi sẽ thưởng cho bạn.

dialogsAccept.en: Thank you. Thank you very much. As I heard, one of them is keeping the cash box.
dialogsAccept.ar: Thank you. Thank you very much. As I heard, one of them is keeping the cash box.
dialogsAccept.br: Obrigado. Muito obrigado. Eu ouvi dizer que um deles está com o cofre.
dialogsAccept.cns: 真的很感谢你~听说我的金库，被它们的其中一个人员保管着。
dialogsAccept.de: Ich danke dir. Ich danke dir vielmals. Ich hörte, einer der Diebe verwahre den Safe.
dialogsAccept.fi: Kiitos. Paljon kiitoksia. Kuten kuulin, yksi heistä pitää kassalaatikkoa.
dialogsAccept.fil: Thank you. Thank you very much. As I heard, one of them is keeping the cash box.
dialogsAccept.fr: Merci. Merci beaucoup. J'ai entendu que l'un des Big Bangs l'avait en sa possession.
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih. Terima kasih banyak. Seperti yang aku dengar, salah satu dari mereka menyimpan kotak uangnya.
dialogsAccept.it: Thank you. Thank you very much. As I heard, one of them is keeping the cash box.
dialogsAccept.jp: 力を貸してくれるのかい？ありがとう。聞いたところでは、奪われた金庫はその盗賊団の中の一人が保管しているようだ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 감사합니다. 정말 감사합니다. 듣자하니, 녀석 중 하나가 금고 상자를 가지고 있다네요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Thank you. Thank you very much. As I heard, one of them is keeping the cash box.
dialogsAccept.pl: Thank you. Thank you very much. As I heard, one of them is keeping the cash box.
dialogsAccept.ru: Спасибо! Большое спасибо! Кубышка наверняка у одного из воров.
dialogsAccept.sp: Gracias. Muchísimas gracias. Según escuché, uno de ellos guarda la caja registradora.
dialogsAccept.sw: Thank you. Thank you very much. As I heard, one of them is keeping the cash box.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอบคุณ ขอบคุณมาก อย่างที่ฉันได้ยินมา หนึ่งในนั้นเก็บกล่องเงินสดไว้
dialogsAccept.tw: 真的很感謝你~聽說我的金庫，被牠們的其中一個人員保管著。
dialogsAccept.vi: Cảm ơn bạn. Cảm ơn rất nhiều. Tôi nghe nói,một trong số bọn chúng đang giữ thùng tiền.

dialogsDecline.en: You make me really disappointed. Whatever…
dialogsDecline.ar: You make me really disappointed. Whatever…
dialogsDecline.br: Você realmente me desapontou. Que seja. Tudo bem.
dialogsDecline.cns: 呜呜..你让我太失望了..那也没办法了..我也不能强迫你..
dialogsDecline.de: Du machst mich wirklich traurig.. Okay, ich verstehe das.. Meinetwegen soll kein anderer belastet werden.
dialogsDecline.fi: Saat minut todella pettymään. Mitä tahansa…
dialogsDecline.fil: You make me really disappointed. Whatever…
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu me déçois... Bon laisse tomber et ne t'avise pas de me demander un service à l'avenir !
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu membuatku benar-benar kecewa. Terserah…
dialogsDecline.it: You make me really disappointed. Whatever…
dialogsDecline.jp: そうか。力になってはくれないのか。わかったよ。他人に無理をさせるのも悪いしな。
dialogsDecline.kr: 실망이에요. 뭐… 어쩔 수 없죠.
dialogsDecline.nl: You make me really disappointed. Whatever…
dialogsDecline.pl: You make me really disappointed. Whatever…
dialogsDecline.ru: Эх, ну что же ты…
dialogsDecline.sp: Me decepcionas mucho. En fin…
dialogsDecline.sw: You make me really disappointed. Whatever…
dialogsDecline.th: คุณทำให้ฉันผิดหวังจริงๆ…
dialogsDecline.tw: 嗚嗚…你讓我太失望了…那也沒辦法了…我也不能強迫你…
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn làm tôi thực sự thất vọng. Sao cũng được…

dialogsComplete.en: You found it! Thank you so much! I'll never forget this! Take this, it's the least I can do.
dialogsComplete.ar: You found it! Thank you so much! I'll never forget this! Take this, it's the least I can do.
dialogsComplete.br: Eu fico realmente agradecido por isso. Obrigado... Obrigado... Por favor, aceite meu presente.
dialogsComplete.cns: 呜呜..真的很感谢你，这是一点心意，请你收下吧!
dialogsComplete.de: Danke. Vielen Dank. Hier ist meine kleine Belohnungen. Bitte nimm sie an!
dialogsComplete.fi: You found it! Thank you so much! I'll never forget this! Take this, it's the least I can do.
dialogsComplete.fil: You found it! Thank you so much! I'll never forget this! Take this, it's the least I can do.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tu as retrouvé ma tirelire ! Merci et encore merci ! Voilà un cadeau pour te récompenser de tes efforts.
dialogsComplete.id: Kamu menemukannya! Terima kasih banyak! Aku tidak akan pernah melupakan ini! Ambil ini, itulah bisa saya lakukan.
dialogsComplete.it: You found it! Thank you so much! I'll never forget this! Take this, it's the least I can do.
dialogsComplete.jp: おお、これはオレの金庫だ！ありがとう、本当にありがとう。これでフィアンセに心をこめたプレゼントができるよ、君のおかげさ。さあ、これはお礼だ、受け取ってくれ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 금고를 찾아오셨군요! 정말 감사해요! 절대 잊지 않을게요! 이건 작은 보답이에요.
dialogsComplete.nl: You found it! Thank you so much! I'll never forget this! Take this, it's the least I can do.
dialogsComplete.pl: You found it! Thank you so much! I'll never forget this! Take this, it's the least I can do.
dialogsComplete.ru: Вот спасибо! Вовек не забуду! Чем бы тебя наградить? Вот, возьми.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡La has encontrado! ¡Muchas gracias! ¡Nunca lo olvidaré! Toma esto, es lo menos que puedo hacer.
dialogsComplete.sw: You found it! Thank you so much! I'll never forget this! Take this, it's the least I can do.
dialogsComplete.th: คุณหาเจอแล้ว! ขอบคุณมาก! ฉันจะไม่มีวันลืมสิ่งนี้! เอานี่ อย่างน้อยที่สุดที่ฉันทำได้
dialogsComplete.tw: 嗚嗚…真的很感謝你，這是一點心意，請你收下吧！
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn đã tìm thấy nó! Cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều! Tôi sẽ không bao giờ quên điều này! Hãy cầm lấy cái này, đó là điều tối thiểu tôi có thể làm.

dialogsFail.en: Where is my cash box? You have not found it yet. Please bring it to me. I will be waiting.
dialogsFail.ar: Where is my cash box? You have not found it yet. Please bring it to me. I will be waiting.
dialogsFail.br: Onde está meu cofre? Você ainda não o encontrou. Por favor, traga-o para mim. Estarei esperando.
dialogsFail.cns: 金库呢?原来还没找到啊..我想你一定可以找得到的~加油!
dialogsFail.de: Wo ist mein Safe? Du hast ihn noch nicht gefunden. Aber ich glaube dir, dass du ihn mir zurückbringen wirst.
dialogsFail.fi: Where is my cash box? You have not found it yet. Please bring it to me. I will be waiting.
dialogsFail.fil: Where is my cash box? You have not found it yet. Please bring it to me. I will be waiting.
dialogsFail.fr: Où est ma tirelire ? Tu ne l'as pas encore trouvée ?! Erf le temps passe...
dialogsFail.id: Di mana kotak uangku? Kamu belum menemukannya. Tolong bawakan padaku. Aku akan menunggu.
dialogsFail.it: Where is my cash box? You have not found it yet. Please bring it to me. I will be waiting.
dialogsFail.jp: 奪われた金庫は見つかったかい？そうか、まだか。取り戻してきてくれるのを待ってるよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 제 금고… 아직 못 찾으신 거예요? 부탁해요, 꼭 필요하다고. 여기서 계속 기다릴게요.
dialogsFail.nl: Where is my cash box? You have not found it yet. Please bring it to me. I will be waiting.
dialogsFail.pl: Where is my cash box? You have not found it yet. Please bring it to me. I will be waiting.
dialogsFail.ru: А где моя кубышка? Тебе не удалось ее найти? Пожалуйста, постарайся! Я буду ждать.
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Dónde está mi caja registradora? Aún no la has encontrado. Por favor, tráemela. Estaré esperando.
dialogsFail.sw: Where is my cash box? You have not found it yet. Please bring it to me. I will be waiting.
dialogsFail.th: กล่องเงินสดของฉันอยู่ที่ไหน คุณยังไม่พบมัน กรุณานำมาให้ฉัน ฉันจะรอนะ
dialogsFail.tw: 金庫呢？原來還沒找到啊…我想你一定可以找得到的~加油！
dialogsFail.vi: Thùng tiền của tôi ở đâu? Bạn vẫn chưa tìm thấy nó. Hãy mang nó đến cho tôi. Tôi sẽ đợi.

description.pl: Return to Darken and meet with Achaben.
