dialogsBegin.en: You know? You've grown a lot during the course of this all. We've almost reached the end of the initial phase though! We just need to find the last hero!
dialogsBegin.ar: You know? You've grown a lot during the course of this all. We've almost reached the end of the initial phase though! We just need to find the last hero!
dialogsBegin.br: Sabia? Você cresceu muito no decorrer de tudo isso. No entanto, quase chegamos ao final da fase inicial! Só precisamos encontrar o último herói!
dialogsBegin.cns: 你知道吗？在这过程中，你已经成长了很多。虽然我们几乎已经达到了初始阶段的终点! 但是我们仍需要找到最后一个英雄!
dialogsBegin.de: Weißt du das? Du bist im Laufe der Zeit sehr gewachsen. Aber wir sind fast am Ende der Anfangsphase angelangt! Wir müssen nur noch den letzten Helden finden!
dialogsBegin.fi: You know? You've grown a lot during the course of this all. We've almost reached the end of the initial phase though! We just need to find the last hero!
dialogsBegin.fil: You know? You've grown a lot during the course of this all. We've almost reached the end of the initial phase though! We just need to find the last hero!
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous avez bien travaillé mais… la menace qui nous guette requiert l'assistance héros de plus.
dialogsBegin.id: Kau tahu? Kau telah tumbuh banyak setelah ini semua. Kami hampir mencapai akhir dari fase awal! Kita hanya perlu menemukan pahlawan terakhir!
dialogsBegin.it: You know? You've grown a lot during the course of this all. We've almost reached the end of the initial phase though! We just need to find the last hero!
dialogsBegin.jp: お前さんもずいぶんと立派になったもんだ。我々は最後のヒーロを探しています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이번 여정을 거치며 정말 많이 성장하셨군요! 기초 훈련은 거의 끝났어요. 이제 마지막 영웅만 찾으면 되겠죠!
dialogsBegin.nl: You know? You've grown a lot during the course of this all. We've almost reached the end of the initial phase though! We just need to find the last hero!
dialogsBegin.pl: You know? You've grown a lot during the course of this all. We've almost reached the end of the initial phase though! We just need to find the last hero!
dialogsBegin.ru: You know? You've grown a lot during the course of this all. We've almost reached the end of the initial phase though! We just need to find the last hero!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Sabes qué? Has crecido mucho durante el transcurso de todo esto. ¡Casi hemos llegado al final de la fase inicial! ¡Solo tenemos que encontrar a la última héroe!
dialogsBegin.sw: You know? You've grown a lot during the course of this all. We've almost reached the end of the initial phase though! We just need to find the last hero!
dialogsBegin.th: คุณรู้? คุณดูโตขึ้นมาก เกือบเสร็จแล้ว ! เราต้องหาฮีโร่คนสุดท้าย!
dialogsBegin.tw: 看到你成長的模樣，真的很讓人信任！現在只要找出最後一個英雄就好了。請你再辛苦一下吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn biết chăng? Bạn đã tiến bộ rất nhiều trong suốt quá trình rèn luyện. Mặc dù vậy, chúng ta gần như đã đi đến cuối giai đoạn sơ khởi rồi! Chúng ta chỉ cần tìm ra người hùng cuối cùng!

dialogsBegin.en: Shade's power grows progressively stronger… I can feel it…. We must hurry and find the last hero as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.ar: Shade's power grows progressively stronger… I can feel it…. We must hurry and find the last hero as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.br: O poder de Shade fica progressivamente mais forte... eu posso sentir isso... Devemos nos apressar e encontrar o último herói o mais rápido possível.
dialogsBegin.cns: 谢莉德的力量逐渐变强...我能感觉到... 我们必须抓紧时间，找到最后的英雄。
dialogsBegin.de: Shades Kräfte werden immer stärker... Ich kann es spüren.... Wir müssen uns beeilen und den letzten Helden so schnell wie möglich finden.
dialogsBegin.fi: Shade's power grows progressively stronger… I can feel it…. We must hurry and find the last hero as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.fil: Shade's power grows progressively stronger… I can feel it…. We must hurry and find the last hero as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous l'avez ressenti, le sombre pouvoir qui grandit... nous devons trouver un cinquième héros très très vite !
dialogsBegin.id: Kekuatan Shade tumbuh semakin kuat ... Aku bisa merasakannya .... Kita harus bergegas dan menemukan pahlawan terakhir sesegera mungkin.
dialogsBegin.it: Shade's power grows progressively stronger… I can feel it…. We must hurry and find the last hero as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.jp: シェードの力はだんだん強くなっているのを感じます。 私たちは急いで最後のヒーローを見つけなければなりません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 쉐이드의 힘이 점점 강해지고 있어요... 느껴집니다... 마지막 영웅을 최대한 빨리 찾아야 할 것 같군요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Shade's power grows progressively stronger… I can feel it…. We must hurry and find the last hero as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.pl: Shade's power grows progressively stronger… I can feel it…. We must hurry and find the last hero as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.ru: Shade's power grows progressively stronger… I can feel it…. We must hurry and find the last hero as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.sp: El poder de Shade aumenta progresivamente... Puedo sentirlo... Debemos darnos prisa y encontrar a la última héroe lo antes posible.
dialogsBegin.sw: Shade's power grows progressively stronger… I can feel it…. We must hurry and find the last hero as soon as possible.
dialogsBegin.th: พลังของ Shade เติบโตขึ้นเรื่อย ๆ ... ฉันรู้สึกได้ ... เราต้องรีบและค้นหาฮีโร่คนสุดท้ายให้เร็วที่สุด
dialogsBegin.tw: 黑暗的勢力好像好像越來越強大…必須快一點找到最後的英雄…
dialogsBegin.vi: Sức mạnh của Shade ngày càng tăng dần lên… Tôi có thể cảm nhận được điều đó…. Chúng ta phải nhanh chóng tìm ra anh hùng cuối cùng càng sớm càng tốt.

dialogsBegin.en: I believe Achaben has more details on where we might find the last hero. Please go to him right away!
dialogsBegin.ar: I believe Achaben has more details on where we might find the last hero. Please go to him right away!
dialogsBegin.br: Achaben entrou em contato, me disse que talvez tenha mais detalhes sobre onde podemos encontrar o último herói. Por favor, vá até ele imediatamente!
dialogsBegin.cns: 我相信雅察本有更多可以找到最后一位英雄的细节。请马上去找他!
dialogsBegin.de: Ich glaube, Achaben hat mehr Informationen darüber, wo wir den letzten Helden finden können. Bitte geht sofort zu ihm!
dialogsBegin.fi: I believe Achaben has more details on where we might find the last hero. Please go to him right away!
dialogsBegin.fil: I believe Achaben has more details on where we might find the last hero. Please go to him right away!
dialogsBegin.fr: Achaben saura nous donner les informations nécessaires. Allez le voir tout de suite.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya yakin Achaben memiliki detail lebih lanjut tentang di mana kita mungkin menemukan pahlawan terakhir. Pergilah kepadanya segera!
dialogsBegin.it: I believe Achaben has more details on where we might find the last hero. Please go to him right away!
dialogsBegin.jp: アチャベンは最後のヒーロの手がかりを持ってます。彼に、直接聞きに行ってみないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 마침 아카벤이 마지막 영웅에 관한 이야기를 알고 있는 것 같으니 어서 빨리 그를 찾아가보게.
dialogsBegin.nl: I believe Achaben has more details on where we might find the last hero. Please go to him right away!
dialogsBegin.pl: I believe Achaben has more details on where we might find the last hero. Please go to him right away!
dialogsBegin.ru: I believe Achaben has more details on where we might find the last hero. Please go to him right away!
dialogsBegin.sp: Creo que Achaben tiene más detalles sobre dónde podríamos encontrar a la última héroe. ¡Por favor, ve a preguntarle ahora mismo!
dialogsBegin.sw: I believe Achaben has more details on where we might find the last hero. Please go to him right away!
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันเชื่อว่า Achaben มีรายละเอียดเพิ่มเติมเกี่ยวกับสถานที่ที่เราอาจพบฮีโร่คนสุดท้าย กรุณาไปหาเขาทันที!
dialogsBegin.tw: 安迪好像聽說了什麼事情，快一點過去找他吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi tin rằng Achaben có thêm thông tin chi tiết về nơi chúng ta có thể tìm thấy người hùng cuối cùng. Hãy đến với anh ấy ngay lập tức!

dialogsAccept.en: You can hear more details on where to find the last hero from Achaben! Please go and speak with him!
dialogsAccept.ar: You can hear more details on where to find the last hero from Achaben! Please go and speak with him!
dialogsAccept.br: Você pode ouvir mais detalhes sobre onde encontrar o último herói de Achaben! Por favor, vá falar com ele!
dialogsAccept.cns: 你可以从雅察本那里得到更多关于寻找最后一位英雄的细节! 请去和他谈谈吧!
dialogsAccept.de: Du kannst von Achaben erfahren, wo du den letzten Helden finden kannst! Bitte geht und sprecht mit ihm!
dialogsAccept.fi: You can hear more details on where to find the last hero from Achaben! Please go and speak with him!
dialogsAccept.fil: You can hear more details on where to find the last hero from Achaben! Please go and speak with him!
dialogsAccept.fr: Dépêchez-vous d'aller trouver Achaben. Le temps nous est compté.
dialogsAccept.id: Anda dapat mendengar detail lebih lanjut tentang di mana menemukan pahlawan terakhir dari Achaben! Silahkan pergi dan berbicara dengannya!
dialogsAccept.it: You can hear more details on where to find the last hero from Achaben! Please go and speak with him!
dialogsAccept.jp: アチャベンは最後のヒーロの手がかりを持ってます。彼に、直接聞きに行ってみないか？
dialogsAccept.kr: 아카벤에게 가면 자세한 얘기를 들을 수 있다네. 그를 찾아서 얘기해 보게나!
dialogsAccept.nl: You can hear more details on where to find the last hero from Achaben! Please go and speak with him!
dialogsAccept.pl: You can hear more details on where to find the last hero from Achaben! Please go and speak with him!
dialogsAccept.ru: You can hear more details on where to find the last hero from Achaben! Please go and speak with him!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Achaben te puede dar más detalles sobre dónde encontrar a la última héroe! ¡Por favor, ve y habla con él!
dialogsAccept.sw: You can hear more details on where to find the last hero from Achaben! Please go and speak with him!
dialogsAccept.th: คุณได้ยินรายละเอียดเพิ่มเติมเกี่ยวกับสถานที่ที่จะหาฮีโร่สุดท้ายจาก Achaben! กรุณาไปและพูดคุยกับเขา!
dialogsAccept.tw: 只要去找安迪，他就會詳細告訴你。就算是只有一天，也希望能夠盡快找出英雄。
dialogsAccept.vi: Bạn có thể biết thêm thông tin chi tiết về nơi tìm anh hùng cuối cùng từ Achaben! Hãy đi và nói chuyện với anh ấy!

dialogsDecline.en: You cannot give up yet after everything we've worked for!
dialogsDecline.ar: You cannot give up yet after everything we've worked for!
dialogsDecline.br: Sua falta de vontade me decepciona, ainda mais depois de tudo pelo que trabalhamos!
dialogsDecline.cns: 在我们做了这么多努力之后，你已经不能放弃了！
dialogsDecline.de: Du darfst nicht aufgeben, nach allem, wofür wir gearbeitet haben!
dialogsDecline.fi: You cannot give up yet after everything we've worked for!
dialogsDecline.fil: You cannot give up yet after everything we've worked for!
dialogsDecline.fr: N'abandonnez pas la bataille alors qu'elle n'a pas commencé !!
dialogsDecline.id: Anda tidak boleh menyerah dulu setelah semua yang telah kita lakukan!
dialogsDecline.it: You cannot give up yet after everything we've worked for!
dialogsDecline.jp: 君はまだ、諦めてはいけない！
dialogsDecline.kr: 우리가 함께해 온 것이 있는데 이제 와서 포기할 수는 없어!
dialogsDecline.nl: You cannot give up yet after everything we've worked for!
dialogsDecline.pl: You cannot give up yet after everything we've worked for!
dialogsDecline.ru: You cannot give up yet after everything we've worked for!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡No te puedes rendir después de todo lo que hemos trabajado!
dialogsDecline.sw: You cannot give up yet after everything we've worked for!
dialogsDecline.th: คุณจะยอมแพ้ไม่ได้ หลังจากงานได้เริ่มไปแล้ว
dialogsDecline.tw: 事到如今你才覺得麻煩嗎？不久瑪德利賈就會遭遇到很大的危險…
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn không thể từ bỏ sau tất cả những gì chúng ta đã nỗ lực đạt được!

dialogsComplete.en: Yes~ Oh! You're here again, my lord.
dialogsComplete.ar: Yes~ Oh! You're here again, my lord.
dialogsComplete.br: Sim~ Ei! Você está aqui de novo, aventureiro(a).
dialogsComplete.cns: 是的~ 哦！你又来了，我的主人。
dialogsComplete.de: Ja~ Oh! Du bist wieder hier, mein Herr.
dialogsComplete.fi: Yes~ Oh! You're here again, my lord.
dialogsComplete.fil: Yes~ Oh! You're here again, my lord.
dialogsComplete.fr: J'ai l'impression de vous connaître…
dialogsComplete.id: Iya~ Oh! Anda di sini lagi, Tuanku.
dialogsComplete.it: Yes~ Oh! You're here again, my lord.
dialogsComplete.jp: あら、いらっしゃい！　どうしたのですか？
dialogsComplete.kr: 네에... 앗! 또 들르셨네요?
dialogsComplete.nl: Yes~ Oh! You're here again, my lord.
dialogsComplete.pl: Yes~ Oh! You're here again, my lord.
dialogsComplete.ru: Yes~ Oh! You're here again, my lord.
dialogsComplete.sp: Sí~ ¡Ay! Estás aquí de nuevo.
dialogsComplete.sw: Yes~ Oh! You're here again, my lord.
dialogsComplete.th: ใช่ ~ โอ้! คุณกลับมาที่นี่อีกครั้งแล้ว ลอร์ด
dialogsComplete.tw: 是~ 啊！客人又來了嗎？
dialogsComplete.vi: Vâng ~ Ồ! Ngài lại ở đây, thưa ngài.

dialogsFail.en: Why haven't you left yet? Achaben is running the general store of Darken. Please go meet with him!
dialogsFail.ar: Why haven't you left yet? Achaben is running the general store of Darken. Please go meet with him!
dialogsFail.br: Por que você ainda não foi? Achaben está administrando a loja geral de Darken. Por favor, vá se encontrar com ele!
dialogsFail.cns: 你为什么还不走？雅察本在经营达肯杂货店。请你去见他!
dialogsFail.de: Warum bist du noch nicht weg? Achaben betreibt den Gemischtwarenladen von Darken. Bitte geh zu ihm!
dialogsFail.fi: Why haven't you left yet? Achaben is running the general store of Darken. Please go meet with him!
dialogsFail.fil: Why haven't you left yet? Achaben is running the general store of Darken. Please go meet with him!
dialogsFail.fr: Mais qu'est-ce que vous faites encore là ? Achaben tient un commerce à Darkon…
dialogsFail.id: Mengapa Anda belum pergi? Achaben menjalankan general store di Darken. Silahkan bertemu dengannya!
dialogsFail.it: Why haven't you left yet? Achaben is running the general store of Darken. Please go meet with him!
dialogsFail.jp: まだ、行ってないの？アカベンはダーケンの雑貨店を経営しています。 彼に会いに行ってください！
dialogsFail.kr: 아직도 여기 있어요? 아카벤은 다켄에서 잡화점을 하고 있어요. 서둘러 아카벤을 만나세요!
dialogsFail.nl: Why haven't you left yet? Achaben is running the general store of Darken. Please go meet with him!
dialogsFail.pl: Why haven't you left yet? Achaben is running the general store of Darken. Please go meet with him!
dialogsFail.ru: Why haven't you left yet? Achaben is running the general store of Darken. Please go meet with him!
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Por qué no te has ido todavía? Achaben dirige la Tienda General de Darken. ¡Por favor, ve a reunirte con él!
dialogsFail.sw: Why haven't you left yet? Achaben is running the general store of Darken. Please go meet with him!
dialogsFail.th: ทำไมคุณถึงยังไม่ไปอีก? Achaben กำลังทำงานอยู่ที่ร้านค้าทั่วไปของ Darken กรุณาไปพบเขา!
dialogsFail.tw: 還沒有出發嗎？安迪就在得肯經營雜貨店，快一點過去吧。
dialogsFail.vi: Tại sao bạn vẫn chưa cất bước đi thế? Achaben đang điều hành cửa hàng tổng hợp của Darken. Hãy đi gặp anh ấy!

description.en: Please come back again when you have met all of the conditions for creating your guild.
description.ar: Please come back again when you have met all of the conditions for creating your guild.
description.br: Por favor, volte novamente quando você atender todas as condições para criar uma guilda.
description.cns: 剧团长是你，加上你总共3名成员！别搞错啦！
description.de: Bitte komm wieder, wenn du alle Voraussetzungen zur Erstellung der Gilde erfüllt hast.
description.fi: Please come back again when you have met all of the conditions for creating your guild.
description.fil: Please come back again when you have met all of the conditions for creating your guild.
description.fr: Retourner voir Helena en étant le leader d'un groupe composé d'uniquement 3 membres.
description.id: Silakan kembali lagi ketika kamu telah memenuhi semua persyaratan untuk membuat serikat kamu.
description.it: Please come back again when you have met all of the conditions for creating your guild.
description.jp: あなたがパーティーリーダーとなり、あなたを含めて3人のメンバーで構成されたパーティーを結成しましょう。
description.kr: 길드 창설에 필요한 조건을 모두 충족하셨을 때 다시 찾아와 주세요.
description.nl: Please come back again when you have met all of the conditions for creating your guild.
description.pl: Please come back again when you have met all of the conditions for creating your guild.
description.ru: Собери труппу из трех человек, стань их лидером и приходи ко мне.
description.sp: Vuelve de nuevo cuando hayas cumplido con todas las condiciones para crear tu guild.
description.sw: Please come back again when you have met all of the conditions for creating your guild.
description.th: โปรดกลับมาอีกครั้งเมื่อคุณปฏิบัติตามเงื่อนไขทั้งหมดในการสร้างกิลด์ของคุณแล้ว
description.tw: 劇團長是你，加上你總共 3 名成員！！別搞錯囉！
description.vi: Vui lòng quay lại khi bạn đã đáp ứng tất cả các điều kiện để tạo bang hội của mình.

dialogsBegin.en: Do you want to create a new guild? Excellent! First, I have to check if you are qualified to create a new guild.
dialogsBegin.ar: Do you want to create a new guild? Excellent! First, I have to check if you are qualified to create a new guild.
dialogsBegin.br: Você deseja criar uma nova guilda? Bem-vindo(a), bem-vindo(a)! Mas antes eu tenho que checar se você está qualificado para criar uma nova guilda.
dialogsBegin.cns: 要申请创立公会吗？欢迎欢迎！！先让我看看你有没有资格！！
dialogsBegin.de: Du willst eine neue Gilde erstellen? Willkommen! Zuerst muss ich überprüfen ob du geeignet bist, eine Gilde zu eröffnen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Do you want to create a new guild? Excellent! First, I have to check if you are qualified to create a new guild.
dialogsBegin.fil: Do you want to create a new guild? Excellent! First, I have to check if you are qualified to create a new guild.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu souhaites fonder une nouvelle guilde ? Bien sûr ! Mais je dois d'abord vérifier si tu es apte à le faire.
dialogsBegin.id: Apakah kamu ingin membuat serikat baru? Bagus sekali! Pertama, saya harus memeriksa apakah kamu memenuhi syarat untuk membuat guild baru.
dialogsBegin.it: Do you want to create a new guild? Excellent! First, I have to check if you are qualified to create a new guild.
dialogsBegin.jp: ギルド作成の申請ですか？あなたにギルドを作成する資格があるのか、テストをしますね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 길드를 새로 만들고 싶으신가요? 좋습니다! 먼저, 길드를 만들 자격이 되는지 확인해 볼까요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Do you want to create a new guild? Excellent! First, I have to check if you are qualified to create a new guild.
dialogsBegin.pl: Do you want to create a new guild? Excellent! First, I have to check if you are qualified to create a new guild.
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь создать собственную гильдию? Отлично! Я с удовольствием расскажу тебе, как это сделать.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Quieres crear una nueva guild? ¡Excelente! Primero, tengo que verificar si estás calificado para crearla.
dialogsBegin.sw: Do you want to create a new guild? Excellent! First, I have to check if you are qualified to create a new guild.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณต้องการสร้าง guild ใหม่หรือไม่? เยี่ยม! ก่อนอื่น ฉันต้องตรวจสอบว่าคุณมีคุณสมบัติในการสร้าง guild ใหม่หรือยัง
dialogsBegin.tw: 要申請創立公會嗎？歡迎歡迎！！先讓我看看你有沒有資格！！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có muốn tạo một bang hội mới không? Xuất sắc! Đầu tiên, tôi phải kiểm tra xem bạn có đủ điều kiện để tạo một bang hội hay không.

dialogsBegin.en: Okay, first you have to organize your own party. You should be the party leader and the total number of members should be 3, including you. Got it?
dialogsBegin.ar: Okay, first you have to organize your own party. You should be the party leader and the total number of members should be 3, including you. Got it?
dialogsBegin.br: Certo, primeiro você deve organizar o seu próprio grupo. Você deve ser o líder do grupo, e deve haver 3 membros no total, incluindo você. Entendeu?
dialogsBegin.cns: 请先成立剧团，剧团长是你，总共是3名人员！！知道了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Okay, zuerst musst du eine Party erstellen. Es müssen 3 Mitglieder mit dir in der Party sein während du der Leader bist. Verstanden?
dialogsBegin.fi: Okay, first you have to organize your own party. You should be the party leader and the total number of members should be 3, including you. Got it?
dialogsBegin.fil: Okay, first you have to organize your own party. You should be the party leader and the total number of members should be 3, including you. Got it?
dialogsBegin.fr: D'abord il te faut créer un groupe. Tu dois en être le leader, et le groupe doit comprendre 3 membres ; ni plus, ni moins !
dialogsBegin.id: Oke, pertama-tama kamu harus mengatur pesta kamu sendiri. Kamu harus menjadi pemimpin partai dan jumlah total anggota harus 3, termasuk kamu. Mengerti?
dialogsBegin.it: Okay, first you have to organize your own party. You should be the party leader and the total number of members should be 3, including you. Got it?
dialogsBegin.jp: まずはパーティーを結成してください。あなたがパーティーリーダーになって、2人のメンバーを集めてください。あなたを含めると、3人のメンバーが必要になるのですよ。いいですね？
dialogsBegin.kr: 좋아요, 우선 극단을 구성하셔야 하는데요. 본인이 극단장이어야 하고, 총인원수는 자신을 포함해 3명이 되어야 합니다. 이해되셨죠?
dialogsBegin.nl: Okay, first you have to organize your own party. You should be the party leader and the total number of members should be 3, including you. Got it?
dialogsBegin.pl: Okay, first you have to organize your own party. You should be the party leader and the total number of members should be 3, including you. Got it?
dialogsBegin.ru: Во-первых, нужны артисты. Собери труппу из трех тру... человек, включая себя. Тебе, как главе гильдии, нужно быть лидером труппы. Ясно?
dialogsBegin.sp: Vale, primero tienes que organizar tu propia party. Debes ser el líder de la party y el número total de miembros debe ser 3, incluyéndote a ti. ¿Entendido?
dialogsBegin.sw: Okay, first you have to organize your own party. You should be the party leader and the total number of members should be 3, including you. Got it?
dialogsBegin.th: เอาล่ะ ก่อนอื่นคุณต้องจัดปาร์ตี้ของคุณเอง คุณควรเป็นหัวหน้าปาร์ตี้และจำนวนสมาชิกทั้งหมดควรมี 3 คน รวมคุณด้วย พร้อมหรือไม่?
dialogsBegin.tw: 請先成立劇團，劇團長是你，總共是 3 名人員！！知道了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Được rồi, trước tiên bạn phải tổ chức bữa tiệc của riêng mình. Bạn nên là người lãnh đạo nhóm và tổng số thành viên phải là 3, bao gồm cả bạn. Hiểu rồi?

dialogsAccept.en: Once again, make your own party. Remember that you should be the party leader and the total number of members should be 3, including you. Please visit me again once you have done this.
dialogsAccept.ar: Once again, make your own party. Remember that you should be the party leader and the total number of members should be 3, including you. Please visit me again once you have done this.
dialogsAccept.br: Mais uma vez, crie seu próprio grupo. Lembre-se de que você deve ser o líder do grupo, e deve haver 3 membros no total, incluindo você. Por favor, me visite novamente quando tiver feito isso.
dialogsAccept.cns: 再说一次喔！剧团长是你，连你算进去共3个人！！知道了吗？
dialogsAccept.de: Also nochmal, erstell eine Party. Denk daran, dass du der Leader sein musst und insgesamt (inklusive dir selbst) nur 3 Leute in deiner Party sein dürfen. Besuch mich wieder, wenn du das getan hast.
dialogsAccept.fi: Once again, make your own party. Remember that you should be the party leader and the total number of members should be 3, including you. Please visit me again once you have done this.
dialogsAccept.fil: Once again, make your own party. Remember that you should be the party leader and the total number of members should be 3, including you. Please visit me again once you have done this.
dialogsAccept.fr: Je te rappelle qu'il faut que tu formes un groupe composé d'uniquement 3 membres, et que tu en sois le leader.
dialogsAccept.id: Sekali lagi, buat pesta kamu sendiri. Ingatlah bahwa kamu harus menjadi pemimpin partai dan jumlah total anggota harus 3, termasuk kamu. Silakan kunjungi saya lagi setelah kamu melakukan ini.
dialogsAccept.it: Once again, make your own party. Remember that you should be the party leader and the total number of members should be 3, including you. Please visit me again once you have done this.
dialogsAccept.jp: わかりました。条件を満たしてから、また私のところに来てくださいね。あっ、そうそう。ギルドを結成するためには3,000,000ペニャが必要になります。それも用意しておいてくださいね。では、いってらっしゃ～い！
dialogsAccept.kr: 다시 한번 말씀드리지만, 먼저 극단을 꾸리셔야 합니다. 본인이 극단장이어야 하고, 인원은 본인을 포함해 3명이어야 해요. 조건을 모두 갖추신 뒤에 다시 찾아와 주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Once again, make your own party. Remember that you should be the party leader and the total number of members should be 3, including you. Please visit me again once you have done this.
dialogsAccept.pl: Once again, make your own party. Remember that you should be the party leader and the total number of members should be 3, including you. Please visit me again once you have done this.
dialogsAccept.ru: Запоминай: труппа из трех артистов, включая тебя - лидера. Когда соберетесь, приходите ко мне.
dialogsAccept.sp: Otra vez, crea tu propia party. Recuerda que debes ser el líder de la party, y el número total de miembros debe ser 3, incluyéndote. Visítame cuando estés listo.
dialogsAccept.sw: Once again, make your own party. Remember that you should be the party leader and the total number of members should be 3, including you. Please visit me again once you have done this.
dialogsAccept.th: จัดปาร์ตี้ของคุณเองอีกครั้ง จำไว้ว่าคุณควรเป็นหัวหน้าปาร์ตี้และจำนวนสมาชิกทั้งหมดควรมี 3 คน รวมทั้งคุณด้วย โปรดกลับมาหาฉันอีกครั้งเมื่อคุณได้ทำสิ่งนี้แล้ว
dialogsAccept.tw: 再說一次，請自行建立劇團。記得你必須擔任團長，而且包含你在內，成員總數必須是 3 人。完成後再來找我。
dialogsAccept.vi: Một lần nữa, hãy làm bữa tiệc của riêng bạn. Nhớ rằng bạn phải là người lãnh đạo nhóm và tổng số thành viên phải là 3, bao gồm cả bạn. Hãy ghé thăm tôi một lần nữa khi bạn đã làm xong.

dialogsDecline.en: Okay, in that case, if you decide to create a guild later, we'll be here!
dialogsDecline.ar: Okay, in that case, if you decide to create a guild later, we'll be here!
dialogsDecline.br: Certo, você pode voltar depois. Estaremos esperando por você o tempo todo.
dialogsDecline.cns: 准备好的话，就再来找我吧！
dialogsDecline.de: Okay, komm später wieder. Wir werden hier immer auf dich warten.
dialogsDecline.fi: Okay, in that case, if you decide to create a guild later, we'll be here!
dialogsDecline.fil: Okay, in that case, if you decide to create a guild later, we'll be here!
dialogsDecline.fr: Ok, tu peux revenir quand tu veux. Nous t'attendrons quoi qu'il arrive.
dialogsDecline.id: Oke, kalau begitu, jika kamu memutuskan untuk membuat guild nanti, kami akan berada di sini!
dialogsDecline.it: Okay, in that case, if you decide to create a guild later, we'll be here!
dialogsDecline.jp: あらあら？ギルドの結成はあきらめるんですね。…残念です。
dialogsDecline.kr: 그래요. 그럼, 길드를 만들고 싶으면 언제든 다시 오세요!
dialogsDecline.nl: Okay, in that case, if you decide to create a guild later, we'll be here!
dialogsDecline.pl: Okay, in that case, if you decide to create a guild later, we'll be here!
dialogsDecline.ru: Ничего, если все-таки решишь создать гильдию, приходи.
dialogsDecline.sp: De acuerdo, en ese caso, si decides crear una guild más adelante, ¡aquí estaremos!
dialogsDecline.sw: Okay, in that case, if you decide to create a guild later, we'll be here!
dialogsDecline.th: โอเค ในกรณีนั้น ถ้าคุณตัดสินใจสร้างกิลด์ในภายหลัง เราจะรออยู่ที่นี่!
dialogsDecline.tw: 準備好的話，就再來找我吧！
dialogsDecline.vi: Được rồi, trong trường hợp đó, nếu bạn quyết định thành lập một hội sau này, chúng tôi sẽ ở đây!

dialogsComplete.en: Hmm… Okay, lets see. You are the party leader, and there are 3 members... Good!
dialogsComplete.ar: Hmm… Okay, lets see. You are the party leader, and there are 3 members... Good!
dialogsComplete.br: Hmm... Vamos ver.. Certo, você é o líder do grupo, e há 3 membros... Boa!
dialogsComplete.cns: 恩！剧团长加2个人员，总共3个人没错！！
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm.. Lass mal sehen. Okay, du bist der Leader und es sind 3 Mitglieder in der Party.. Gut.
dialogsComplete.fi: Hmm… Okay, lets see. You are the party leader, and there are 3 members... Good!
dialogsComplete.fil: Hmm… Okay, lets see. You are the party leader, and there are 3 members... Good!
dialogsComplete.fr: Hmm... Ok, ton groupe satisfait à mes exigences. Passons à la suite !
dialogsComplete.id: Hmm…Oke, kalau begitu, jika kamu memutuskan untuk membuat guild nanti, kami akan berada di sini!
dialogsComplete.it: Hmm… Okay, lets see. You are the party leader, and there are 3 members... Good!
dialogsComplete.jp: おかえりなさい！それではチェックしますね。まずメンバーは3人、そしてパーティーリーダーはあなた…うん！合格ですよ～！
dialogsComplete.kr: 그럼… 확인해 볼게요. 본인이 극단장이시고, 인원이 3명… 좋습니다!
dialogsComplete.nl: Hmm… Okay, lets see. You are the party leader, and there are 3 members... Good!
dialogsComplete.pl: Hmm… Okay, lets see. You are the party leader, and there are 3 members... Good!
dialogsComplete.ru: Давай проверим. Ты лидер труппы, и артистов в ней... раз... два... три... достаточно! Отлично.
dialogsComplete.sp: Hmm... Está bien, veamos. Eres el líder de la party y hay 3 miembros... ¡Bien!
dialogsComplete.sw: Hmm… Okay, lets see. You are the party leader, and there are 3 members... Good!
dialogsComplete.th: อืม… โอเค มาดูกัน คุณเป็นหัวหน้าปาร์ตี้ และมีสมาชิก 3 คน... ดี!
dialogsComplete.tw: 恩！劇團長加 2 個人員，總共 3 個人沒錯！！
dialogsComplete.vi: Hmm… Được rồi, hãy xem. Bạn là đội trưởng, và có 3 thành viên ... Tốt!

dialogsComplete.en: Now I will let you create your own guild. By the way, according to Madrigal policy, you must pay 3,000,000 Penya to create the guild.
dialogsComplete.ar: Now I will let you create your own guild. By the way, according to Madrigal policy, you must pay 3,000,000 Penya to create the guild.
dialogsComplete.br: Agora deixarei você criar sua própria guilda. A propósito, de acordo com a política de Madrigal, você deve pagar 3.000.000 Penyas para criar uma guilda.
dialogsComplete.cns: "你已经有资格创立公会了！不过，还需要创团费用金币 3,000,000！"
dialogsComplete.de: Nun werde ich dich eine Gilde erstellen lassen. Ach so, auf Grund der Madrigal Gesetzgebung musst du für die Erstellung der Gilde 3,000,000 Penya zahlen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Now I will let you create your own guild. By the way, according to Madrigal policy, you must pay 3,000,000 Penya to create the guild.
dialogsComplete.fil: Now I will let you create your own guild. By the way, according to Madrigal policy, you must pay 3,000,000 Penya to create the guild.
dialogsComplete.fr: Maintenant je vais te laisser fonder ta guilde. Cependant en accord avec la politique de Madrigal, il te faut payer 3 Millions de Penyas.
dialogsComplete.id: Sekarang saya akan membiarkan kamu membuat serikat kamu sendiri. Omong-omong, menurut kebijakan Madrigal, kamu harus membayar 3.000.000 Penya untuk membuat guild.
dialogsComplete.it: Now I will let you create your own guild. By the way, according to Madrigal policy, you must pay 3,000,000 Penya to create the guild.
dialogsComplete.jp: あなたにギルド結成の資格を与えます。ギルドマスターになるにあたり、ギルド連盟に加入する必要があります。入会費として3,000,000ペニャをいただきたいのですが、
dialogsComplete.kr: 이제 길드를 만드실 수 있겠네요. 참고로 마드리갈 규정에 따라 길드를 창설하려면 3,000,000 페냐가 필요하답니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Now I will let you create your own guild. By the way, according to Madrigal policy, you must pay 3,000,000 Penya to create the guild.
dialogsComplete.pl: Now I will let you create your own guild. By the way, according to Madrigal policy, you must pay 3,000,000 Penya to create the guild.
dialogsComplete.ru: Если хочешь, я зарегистрирую вашу гильдию. Кстати, по мадригальским законам, вам нужно уплатить пошлину - три миллиона пенни.
dialogsComplete.sp: Ahora te dejaré crear tu propia guild. Por cierto, según la política de Madrigal, debes pagar 3,000,000 Penya para crear la guild.
dialogsComplete.sw: Now I will let you create your own guild. By the way, according to Madrigal policy, you must pay 3,000,000 Penya to create the guild.
dialogsComplete.th: ฉันจะให้คุณสร้างกิลด์ของคุณเอง อย่างไรก็ตาม ตามนโยบายของ Madrigal คุณต้องจ่าย 3,000,000 Penya เพื่อสร้างกิลด์
dialogsComplete.tw: 你已經有資格創立公會了！不過，還需要創團費用金幣 3,000,000！
dialogsComplete.vi: Bây giờ tôi sẽ để bạn thành lập một bang hội của riêng bạn. Nhân tiện, theo chính sách của Madrigal, bạn phải trả 3.000.000 Penya để tạo nhóm.

dialogsFail.en: There seems to be a problem. Maybe you aren't the party leader or you do not have enough members. Remember, you have to be the party leader and you should have 3 party members, including yourself.
dialogsFail.ar: There seems to be a problem. Maybe you aren't the party leader or you do not have enough members. Remember, you have to be the party leader and you should have 3 party members, including yourself.
dialogsFail.br: Há um problema. Talvez você não seja o líder do grupo ou não tenha membros o suficiente. Lembre-se, você deve ser o líder do grupo, e deve haver 3 membros, incluindo você.
dialogsFail.cns: 你不是剧团长或剧团人数不足！请准备好再跟我说吧！
dialogsFail.de: Das ist ein Problem. Vielleicht bist du nicht der Partyleader oder du hast keine 3 Leute in der Party.
dialogsFail.fi: There seems to be a problem. Maybe you aren't the party leader or you do not have enough members. Remember, you have to be the party leader and you should have 3 party members, including yourself.
dialogsFail.fil: There seems to be a problem. Maybe you aren't the party leader or you do not have enough members. Remember, you have to be the party leader and you should have 3 party members, including yourself.
dialogsFail.fr: Hmm... Il semble que tu ne remplisses pas les conditions... Je te rappelle que tu dois être le leader d'un groupe composé de 3 membres ; ni plus, ni moins !
dialogsFail.id: Sepertinya ada masalah. Mungkin kamu bukan pemimpin partai atau kamu tidak memiliki cukup anggota. Ingat, kamu harus menjadi pemimpin partai dan kamu harus memiliki 3 anggota partai, termasuk kamu sendiri.
dialogsFail.it: There seems to be a problem. Maybe you aren't the party leader or you do not have enough members. Remember, you have to be the party leader and you should have 3 party members, including yourself.
dialogsFail.jp: パーティーリーダーではないか、メンバーが3人になっていない、あるいはギルドを脱退するか解散してから48時間が経過していない。このような場合、ギルドマスターにはなれませんから、気をつけてくださいね。
dialogsFail.kr: 문제가 있는 것 같아요. 극단장이 아니시거나 극단 인원이 부족한 것 같네요. 다시 한번 말씀드리지만, 본인이 극단장이어야 하고, 인원은 본인을 포함해 3명이 필요합니다.
dialogsFail.nl: There seems to be a problem. Maybe you aren't the party leader or you do not have enough members. Remember, you have to be the party leader and you should have 3 party members, including yourself.
dialogsFail.pl: There seems to be a problem. Maybe you aren't the party leader or you do not have enough members. Remember, you have to be the party leader and you should have 3 party members, including yourself.
dialogsFail.ru: Что-то тут не так. То ли артистов не хватает, то ли лидер труппы не ты. Проверь.
dialogsFail.sp: Parece que hay un problema. Tal vez no seas el líder de la party o no tengas suficientes miembros. Recuerda, debes ser el líder de la party y debe tener 3 miembros, incluido tú mismo.
dialogsFail.sw: There seems to be a problem. Maybe you aren't the party leader or you do not have enough members. Remember, you have to be the party leader and you should have 3 party members, including yourself.
dialogsFail.th: ดูเหมือนว่าจะมีปัญหา บางทีคุณอาจไม่ใช่หัวหน้าปาร์ตี้หรือคุณมีสมาชิกไม่เพียงพอ จำไว้ว่า คุณต้องเป็นหัวหน้าปาร์ตี้ และคุณควรมีสมาชิกปาร์ตี้ 3 คน รวมทั้งตัวคุณเองด้วย
dialogsFail.tw: 似乎有點問題。也許你不是劇團長，或成員不足。請記住，你必須是劇團長，而且包含你自己在內應有 3 名劇團成員。
dialogsFail.vi: Dường như có một vấn đề. Có thể bạn không phải là đội trưởng hoặc bạn không có đủ thành viên. Hãy nhớ rằng bạn phải là đội trưởng và bạn nên có 3 thành viên, bao gồm cả chính bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

name.tw: 英雄的繼承者 - 耳環

description.en: Find the Earring of Heren, hidden somewhere in Heret. Then take it and your letter to Guabrill, the Blade Sage at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
description.ar: Find the Earring of Heren, hidden somewhere in Heret. Then take it and your letter to Guabrill, the Blade Sage at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
description.br: Você deve encontrar o Brinco de Heren, que está escondido em algum lugar em Heret. Depois visite Guabrill, o Sábio Blade. Ele fica na Fonte dos Mortos, ao norte, perto das Montanhas Leren em Flaris.
description.cns: 请先去达肯第3地区的海勒辛，找回海琳的耳环，再去亡者之泉找[刀锋战士贤者]加布里！
description.de: Finde den Earring of Heren, der irgendwo in Heret versteckt ist. Bringe ihn und den Brief zu Guabrill, dem Klingen-Weisen am Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
description.fi: Find the Earring of Heren, hidden somewhere in Heret. Then take it and your letter to Guabrill, the Blade Sage at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
description.fil: Find the Earring of Heren, hidden somewhere in Heret. Then take it and your letter to Guabrill, the Blade Sage at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
description.fr: Retrouver la Boucle d'oreille de Heren qui se trouve quelque part à Heret, Darkon 3 puis la rapporter au Sage des Assassins Guabrill, à la Fontaine des Défunts de Flaris.
description.id: Temukan Anting Heren, tersembunyi di suatu tempat di Heret. Kemudian bawa dan surat kamu ke Guabrill, Blade Sage di Fountain of Dead Person di Flaris.
description.it: Find the Earring of Heren, hidden somewhere in Heret. Then take it and your letter to Guabrill, the Blade Sage at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
description.jp: ダーコン第3地区（ヘルエット）からヘレンのイヤーリングを取り戻し、フラリスの魂の泉にいるブレード賢者ガブリに持っていってください。
description.kr: 다콘 제3지구 헤르엣 지역 어딘가에 숨겨진 헤렌의 귀걸이를 찾으세요. 그다음, 귀걸이와 추천서를 플라리스의 망자의 샘에 있는 블레이드 현자 가브릴에게 전달하세요.
description.nl: Find the Earring of Heren, hidden somewhere in Heret. Then take it and your letter to Guabrill, the Blade Sage at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
description.pl: Find the Earring of Heren, hidden somewhere in Heret. Then take it and your letter to Guabrill, the Blade Sage at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
description.ru: Нужно отыскать спрятанную в Арквуде подвеску Д'Артамиса и отнести ее вместе с рекомендательным письмом старейшине фехтовальщиков Габриэлю. Габриэля можно найти у фонтана Мертвеца во Фларинции.
description.sp: Encuentra el Pendiente de Heren, escondido en algún lugar de Heret. Luego llévaselo junto con la carta a Guabrill, el Sabio Blade en el Manantial de Almas de Flaris.
description.sw: Find the Earring of Heren, hidden somewhere in Heret. Then take it and your letter to Guabrill, the Blade Sage at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
description.th: ค้นหา Earring of Heren ที่ซ่อนอยู่ที่ไหนสักแห่งใน Heret จากนั้นนำมันและจดหมายของคุณไปให้ Knight Sage ชื่อ Guabrill ที่ Fountain of Dead Person ใน Flaris
description.tw: 請先去得肯第三區的赫瑞特幽林，找回海琳的耳環，再去亡者之泉找暗殺者賢者 [加布里]！
description.vi: Tìm Earring of Heren được giấu ở đâu đó trong Heret. Sau đó mang nó và lá thư của bạn cho Guabrill, Blade Sage tại Fountain of Dead Person ở Flaris.

dialogsBegin.en: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Blade-in-Training. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.ar: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Blade-in-Training. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.br: Esta é a carta de recomendação que mostra que o mestre o reconhece como um sucessor. Por favor, guarde-a com sua vida. Se você perdê-la, não poderá provar que é reconhecido.
dialogsBegin.cns: 这推荐书表示首领认定你具有继承者的能力，如果没有推荐书认定形同无效，所以要好好保管喔！
dialogsBegin.de: Dieses Empfehlungsschreiben beweist, dass dich der Meister als Nachfolger akzeptiert hat. Bitte beschütze es mit deinem Leben. Wenn du ihn verlierst, kannst du nicht beweisen, dass du anerkannt wurdest.
dialogsBegin.fi: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Blade-in-Training. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.fil: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Blade-in-Training. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.fr: Félicitations, voici une lettre de recommandation confirmant que tu es sur la voie de devenir Assassin.
dialogsBegin.id: Surat rekomendasi ini adalah bukti pencapaianmu sebagai Blade-in-Training. Jaga itu seperti kamu menjaga hidupmu sendiri.
dialogsBegin.it: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Blade-in-Training. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.jp: これはマスターが後継者としての資質を認めたという推薦書です。あなたの資質が認められるものですから大事にしてください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 추천서는 블레이드 수련자로서 당신이 거둔 성과를 증명하는 증명서랍니다. 목숨처럼 소중히 간직하세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Blade-in-Training. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.pl: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Blade-in-Training. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.ru: Это рекомендательное письмо - доказательство того, что тебе удалось пройти мое испытание. Береги его как зеницу ока.
dialogsBegin.sp: Esta carta de recomendación es prueba de tus progresos como Blade en pruebas. Guárdala como si fuera tu propia vida.
dialogsBegin.sw: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Blade-in-Training. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.th: จดหมายแนะนำฉบับนี้เป็นข้อพิสูจน์ถึงความสำเร็จของคุณในการเป็น Blade-in-Training จงรักษามันไว้ยิ่งชีพล่ะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 這推薦書表示首領認定你具有繼承者的能力，如果沒有推薦書認定形同無效，所以要好好保管喔！
dialogsBegin.vi: Thư giới thiệu này là bằng chứng về thành tích của bạn với tư cách là một Blade-đang-trong-quá-trình-huấn luyện. Hãy bảo vệ nó như chính cuộc sống của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Take it to Guabill, the Blade Sage. He resides at the Fountain of Dead Person in the North Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.ar: Take it to Guabill, the Blade Sage. He resides at the Fountain of Dead Person in the North Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.br: Leve para Guabill, o Sábio Blade. Ele está na Fonte dos Mortos nas Montanhas Leren, ao norte.
dialogsBegin.cns: 把那推荐书拿给位于乐雅山脉北部亡者之泉的[刀锋战士贤者]加布里。
dialogsBegin.de: Bringt es zu Guabill, dem Blade Weisen. Er ist an der Quelle der verstorbenen Seelen im Norden des Leren Gebirges.
dialogsBegin.fi: Take it to Guabill, the Blade Sage. He resides at the Fountain of Dead Person in the North Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.fil: Take it to Guabill, the Blade Sage. He resides at the Fountain of Dead Person in the North Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il faut que tu l'apportes à Guabrill, le Sage des Assassins qui se trouve à la Fontaine des Défunts de Flaris.
dialogsBegin.id: Bawa ke Guabill, Blade Sage. Dia tinggal di the Fountain of Dead Person di North Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.it: Take it to Guabill, the Blade Sage. He resides at the Fountain of Dead Person in the North Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.jp: それではフラリスのレルエン山脈北部にある魂の泉に行って、ブレード賢者ガブリにその推薦書を渡してください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 추천서를 레르엔 산맥 북부 망자의 샘에 있는 블레이드 현자, 구아빌님께 가져가세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Take it to Guabill, the Blade Sage. He resides at the Fountain of Dead Person in the North Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.pl: Take it to Guabill, the Blade Sage. He resides at the Fountain of Dead Person in the North Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.ru: Take it to Guabill, the Blade Sage. He resides at the Fountain of Dead Person in the North Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.sp: Llévaselo a Guabill, el Sabio Blade. Está en el Manantial de Almas al Norte de las Montañas Leren.
dialogsBegin.sw: Take it to Guabill, the Blade Sage. He resides at the Fountain of Dead Person in the North Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.th: เอามันไปให้ Blade Sage ที่ชื่อ Guabill เขาอาศัยอยู่ที่ Fountain of Dead Person ในเทือกเขา North Leren Mountains
dialogsBegin.tw: 把那推薦書拿給位於勒倫山脈北部亡者之泉的暗殺者賢者 [加布里]。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đưa nó đến Guabill, Blade Sage. Anh ta cư trú tại Fountain of Dead Person ở North Leren Mountains.

dialogsBegin.en: Before you do that, however, locate the Earring of Heren. It’s hidden somewhere in Heret, in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.ar: Before you do that, however, locate the Earring of Heren. It’s hidden somewhere in Heret, in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.br: Ah, antes de ir ver Guabrill, você deve encontrar o Brinco de Heren, que está escondido em algum lugar de Heret, Darkon3.
dialogsBegin.cns: 对了~把推荐书拿给[刀锋战士贤者]加布里之前，请先去达肯第3地区的海勒辛找回海琳的耳环！
dialogsBegin.de: Oh, bevor du zu Guabrill gehst, musst du den Earring of Heren finden, der irgendwo in Heret, Darkon3 verschollen ist.
dialogsBegin.fi: Before you do that, however, locate the Earring of Heren. It’s hidden somewhere in Heret, in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.fil: Before you do that, however, locate the Earring of Heren. It’s hidden somewhere in Heret, in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.fr: Oh, avant d'aller t'adresser à Guabrill, tu dois retrouver la Boucle d'oreille de Heren qui se trouve quelque part à Heret, Darkon3.
dialogsBegin.id: Namun, sebelum kamu melakukannya, temukan Earring of Heren. Itu tersembunyi di suatu tempat di Heret, di Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.it: Before you do that, however, locate the Earring of Heren. It’s hidden somewhere in Heret, in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.jp: あ、その前にダーコン第3地区（ヘルエット）のどこかに隠されているヘレンのイヤリングを取り戻してください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그 전에, 다콘 제3지구 헤르엣 어딘가에 숨겨진 헤렌의 귀걸이를 찾으세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Before you do that, however, locate the Earring of Heren. It’s hidden somewhere in Heret, in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.pl: Before you do that, however, locate the Earring of Heren. It’s hidden somewhere in Heret, in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.ru: Но сначала найди подвеску Д'Артамиса, героя-фехтовальщика. Она спрятана где-то в Арквуде, на Дарконе-3. Ты примешь это испытание?
dialogsBegin.sp: Antes de hacer eso, busca el Pendiente de Heren. Está escondido en algún lugar de Heret, en Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.sw: Before you do that, however, locate the Earring of Heren. It’s hidden somewhere in Heret, in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin.th: ก่อนที่คุณจะสิ่งนั้น คุณจำเป็นต้องไปหา Earring of Heren เสียก่อนมันซ่อนอยู่ที่ไหนสักแห่งที่ Heret ใน Darkon 3
dialogsBegin.tw: 對了~把推薦書拿給暗殺者賢者 [加布里] 之前，請先去得肯第三區的赫瑞特幽林找回海琳的耳環！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tuy nhiên, trước khi bạn làm điều đó, hãy xác định vị trí Earring of Heren. Nó được giấu ở đâu đó trong Heret, ở Darkon 3.

dialogsAccept.en: May the mercy of Heren be with you always.
dialogsAccept.ar: May the mercy of Heren be with you always.
dialogsAccept.br: Desejo que a piedade de Heren esteja sempre com você.
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝福你一切顺利！！海琳与你同在！
dialogsAccept.de: Ich wünsche, das die Gnade von Heren immer mit dir ist.
dialogsAccept.fi: May the mercy of Heren be with you always.
dialogsAccept.fil: May the mercy of Heren be with you always.
dialogsAccept.fr: Que la grâce de Heren soit toujours avec toi !
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga rahmat Heren selalu bersamamu.
dialogsAccept.it: May the mercy of Heren be with you always.
dialogsAccept.jp: ヘレンの慈悲が共にありますように！
dialogsAccept.kr: 헤렌님의 자비가 언제나 당신과 함께하기를.
dialogsAccept.nl: May the mercy of Heren be with you always.
dialogsAccept.pl: May the mercy of Heren be with you always.
dialogsAccept.ru: Да пребудет с тобой милость Д'Артамиса.
dialogsAccept.sp: Que la misericordia de Heren esté siempre contigo.
dialogsAccept.sw: May the mercy of Heren be with you always.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอท่าน Heren ได้โปรดเมตตาคุณด้วยเถิด
dialogsAccept.tw: 祝福你一切順利！！海琳與你同在！
dialogsAccept.vi: Cầu mong lòng thương xót của Heren luôn ở bên bạn.

dialogsDecline.en: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.ar: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.br: Não se subestime. Você deve ser forte, ou não poderá se tornar um sucessor. Por que desistir agora?
dialogsDecline.cns: 你已经做到这了，为什么还要放弃呢？
dialogsDecline.de: Du bist schon so weit gekommen, warum solltest du jetzt aufgeben?
dialogsDecline.fi: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.fil: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.fr: Ne sous-estime jamais tes capacités ! Tu dois être fort, ou tu ne deviendras jamais un Héros.
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu sudah sampai sejauh ini, mengapa menyerah sekarang?
dialogsDecline.it: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.jp: 自分に勇気がないなどと思わないでください。あなたには力がある･･･。そんな簡単に諦めてはいけません。
dialogsDecline.kr: 여기까지 왔는데, 왜 그만두시려 하시죠?
dialogsDecline.nl: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.pl: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.ru: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.sp: Ya has llegado muy lejos, ¿te vas a rendir ahora?
dialogsDecline.sw: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.th: คุณมาได้ไกลแล้ว ทำไมถึงคิดจะยอมแพ้ในตอนนี้?
dialogsDecline.tw: 已經走到這一步了，為什麼要放棄呢？
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn đã đi quá xa, tại sao bây giờ lại từ bỏ?

dialogsComplete.en: Dear me! This… this is Earring of Heren! We thought it had been lost forever!
dialogsComplete.ar: Dear me! This… this is Earring of Heren! We thought it had been lost forever!
dialogsComplete.br: Hmm? Esse, esse é o Brinco de Heren! Ah, como você o recuperou?! Obrigado! Este brinco é o que Heren, a heroína Blade, usou durante a Guerra do Herói.
dialogsComplete.cns: 除了你，还没有人能完成这挑战，辛苦你了！！
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm? Das, das ist der Earring of Heren! Oh, wie konntest du ihn finden? Danke! Dieser Ohrring wurde von Heren, dem Blade Hero im Hero War getragen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Dear me! This… this is Earring of Heren! We thought it had been lost forever!
dialogsComplete.fil: Dear me! This… this is Earring of Heren! We thought it had been lost forever!
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh ! C'est... c'est la boucle d'oreille magique que portait Heren pendant la Grande Guerre ! Où l'as-tu retrouvé ?!
dialogsComplete.id: Untuk aku! Ini ... ini adalah Anting Heren! Kami pikir itu telah hilang selamanya!
dialogsComplete.it: Dear me! This… this is Earring of Heren! We thought it had been lost forever!
dialogsComplete.jp: おお、これは長きにわたり見出されることがなかった、ヘレンの聖遺物ではないか！大変だったろじゃろう、ありがとうな！
dialogsComplete.kr: 세상에! 이건… 이게 바로 헤렌의 귀걸이군요! 영원히 잃어버린 줄로만 알았는데!
dialogsComplete.nl: Dear me! This… this is Earring of Heren! We thought it had been lost forever!
dialogsComplete.pl: Dear me! This… this is Earring of Heren! We thought it had been lost forever!
dialogsComplete.ru: Не может быть! Это и в самом деле подвеска Д'Артамиса. А ведь мы думали, что она утрачена навсегда!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡No puede ser! ¡Éste... éste es el Pendiente de Heren! ¡Pensábamos que se había perdido para siempre!
dialogsComplete.sw: Dear me! This… this is Earring of Heren! We thought it had been lost forever!
dialogsComplete.th: มอบให้ฉันงั้นหรือ! เอานี่... นี่คือต่างหูของ Heren! เราคิดว่ามันหายไปตลอดกาลเสียแล้ว!
dialogsComplete.tw: 除了你，還沒有人能完成這挑戰，辛苦你了！！
dialogsComplete.vi: Trời ơi! Đây… đây là Earring of Heren! Chúng tôi nghĩ rằng nó đã bị mất vĩnh viễn!

dialogsComplete.en: It had gone missing in Heret somewhere, and no one could find it. Thank you, you're truly remarkable!
dialogsComplete.ar: It had gone missing in Heret somewhere, and no one could find it. Thank you, you're truly remarkable!
dialogsComplete.br: Mas ele estava perdido em algum lugar em Heret. Ninguém havia conseguido encontrá-lo... Obrigado, muito obrigado! Ha ha ha!
dialogsComplete.cns: 这是刀锋战士英雄海琳的耳环，听说在英雄战争时期于海勒辛遗失，之后，就再也找不到了！
dialogsComplete.de: Aber er war so lange verschollen in Heret. Niemand konnte ihn finden. Danke, vielen Dank!
dialogsComplete.fi: It had gone missing in Heret somewhere, and no one could find it. Thank you, you're truly remarkable!
dialogsComplete.fil: It had gone missing in Heret somewhere, and no one could find it. Thank you, you're truly remarkable!
dialogsComplete.fr: Elle avait été perdue depuis des années et personne n'avait réussi à la retrouver à ce jour.
dialogsComplete.id: Itu hilang di Heret di suatu tempat, dan tidak ada yang bisa menemukannya. Terima kasih,kamu benar-benar luar biasa!
dialogsComplete.it: It had gone missing in Heret somewhere, and no one could find it. Thank you, you're truly remarkable!
dialogsComplete.jp: このイヤリングはブレード英雄ヘレン様のものじゃった。伝説のヘルエットの会戦で龍と戦った際に失われ、その後の行方は誰にも分からなかったのだ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 헤르엣 어딘가에서 사라져 아무도 찾지 못했던 귀걸이잖아요. 감사해요. 정말 대단한 분이군요!
dialogsComplete.nl: It had gone missing in Heret somewhere, and no one could find it. Thank you, you're truly remarkable!
dialogsComplete.pl: It had gone missing in Heret somewhere, and no one could find it. Thank you, you're truly remarkable!
dialogsComplete.ru: Она исчезла, будто растворилась, и с тех пор никто о ней не слышал. Спасибо тебе, ты - исключительная личность!
dialogsComplete.sp: Había desaparecido por Heret y nadie lo encontraba. ¡Gracias, eres increíble!
dialogsComplete.sw: It had gone missing in Heret somewhere, and no one could find it. Thank you, you're truly remarkable!
dialogsComplete.th: มันหายไปที่ไหนสักแห่งใน Heret และไม่มีใครสามารถหามันได้ ขอบคุณคุณมาก คุณช่างสุดยอดไปเลย!
dialogsComplete.tw: 這是暗殺者英雄海琳的耳環，聽說在英雄戰爭時期於赫瑞特幽林遺失，之後，就再也找不到了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Nó đã bị mất tích nơi nào đó ở Heret, và không ai tìm thấy nó. Cảm ơn bạn, bạn thực sự xuất sắc!

dialogsComplete.en: Your efforts this day will be forever appreciated.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your efforts this day will be forever appreciated.
dialogsComplete.br: Agradeço profundamente o seu esforço em encontrá-lo. Obrigado.
dialogsComplete.cns: 再次感谢你~帮我找回这对耳环！！
dialogsComplete.de: Ich bewundere deine Mühen ihn zu finden. Danke.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your efforts this day will be forever appreciated.
dialogsComplete.fil: Your efforts this day will be forever appreciated.
dialogsComplete.fr: J'apprécie vraiment les efforts que tu as fournis pour la retrouver. Merci, merci infiniment !
dialogsComplete.id: Usahamu hari ini akan selamanya dihargai.
dialogsComplete.it: Your efforts this day will be forever appreciated.
dialogsComplete.jp: 貴重な聖遺物を取り戻してくれてありがとうな！
dialogsComplete.kr: 이 귀중한 성물을 찾아주신 일, 영원히 기억할게요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your efforts this day will be forever appreciated.
dialogsComplete.pl: Your efforts this day will be forever appreciated.
dialogsComplete.ru: Уверен, однажды мы будем тобой гордиться.
dialogsComplete.sp: Tus esfuerzos de este día siempre serán recordados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your efforts this day will be forever appreciated.
dialogsComplete.th: ความช่วยเหลือของคุณในวันนี้จะถูกจดจำตลอดไป
dialogsComplete.tw: 再次感謝你~幫我找回這對耳環！！
dialogsComplete.vi: Những nỗ lực của bạn hôm nay sẽ mãi mãi được tôn vinh.

dialogsFail.en: The souls of many people travel to the Fountain of Dead Person. It is the crossroads between life and death.
dialogsFail.ar: The souls of many people travel to the Fountain of Dead Person. It is the crossroads between life and death.
dialogsFail.br: As almas de muitas pessoas vem e vão aqui na Fonte das Pessoas Mortas. É o limite entre a vida e a morte.
dialogsFail.cns: 欢迎来到亡者之潭，这里是生与死共存的地方！
dialogsFail.de: Die Seelen vieler Menschen kommen und gehen an der Quelle der verstorbenen Seelen. Es ist die Verbindung zwischen Leben und Tod.
dialogsFail.fi: The souls of many people travel to the Fountain of Dead Person. It is the crossroads between life and death.
dialogsFail.fil: The souls of many people travel to the Fountain of Dead Person. It is the crossroads between life and death.
dialogsFail.fr: Les âmes de nombreuses personnes vont et viennent ici à la Fontaine des Défunts. C'est ici la limite entre la vie et la mort.
dialogsFail.id: Jiwa banyak orang melakukan perjalanan ke Fountain of Dead Person. Ini adalah persimpangan antara hidup dan mati.
dialogsFail.it: The souls of many people travel to the Fountain of Dead Person. It is the crossroads between life and death.
dialogsFail.jp: この魂の泉は、生の世界と死の世界の出入り口と言われておる。死者の魂がそこから冥界に行き、また冥界から生まれ変わるためにもどってくるといわれている。
dialogsFail.kr: 수많은 영혼이 망자의 샘을 거쳐 간답니다. 생과 사를 넘나드는 틈이지요.
dialogsFail.nl: The souls of many people travel to the Fountain of Dead Person. It is the crossroads between life and death.
dialogsFail.pl: The souls of many people travel to the Fountain of Dead Person. It is the crossroads between life and death.
dialogsFail.ru: Души людей приходят к фонтану Мертвеца. Здесь кончаются дороги живых и начинаются дороги мертвых.
dialogsFail.sp: Las almas de muchas personas viajan al Manantial de Almas. Es el cruze de caminos entre la vida y muerte.
dialogsFail.sw: The souls of many people travel to the Fountain of Dead Person. It is the crossroads between life and death.
dialogsFail.th: วิญญาณของคนจำนวนมากเดินทางไปยัง Fountain of Dead Person เป็นทางแยกระหว่างชีวิตกับความตาย
dialogsFail.tw: 歡迎來到亡者之泉，這裡是生與死共存的地方！
dialogsFail.vi: Linh hồn của nhiều người du hành đến Fountain of Dead Person. Đó là ngã rẽ giữa sự sống và cái chết.

dialogsBegin.en: ...the Purple Magician in this book. History of Hardship. Only it says that the Black Magician and the Magician in Purple are the same person. The same person that fought alongside the heroes in the Hero Wars. That does not make sense.
dialogsBegin.ar: ...the Purple Magician in this book. History of Hardship. Only it says that the Black Magician and the Magician in Purple are the same person. The same person that fought alongside the heroes in the Hero Wars. That does not make sense.
dialogsBegin.br: ..o Mago Púrpuro neste livro. História de Dificuldades. Só que...ele diz que o Mago Negro e o Mago Púrpuro são a mesma pessoa. A mesma pessoa que lutou junto aos heróis nas Guerras dos Heróis. Isso não faz sentido.
dialogsBegin.cns: ...the Purple Magician in this book. History of Hardship. Only it says that the Black Magician and the Magician in Purple are the same person. The same person that fought alongside the heroes in the Hero Wars. That does not make sense.
dialogsBegin.de: .. der lila Magier in diesem Buch. Geschichte der Bitternis. Da steht nur dass der schwarze Magier und der lila Magier die gleiche Person sind. Die gleiche Person, die an der Seite der Helden in den Heldenkriegen gekämpft hat. Das ergibt keinen Sinn.
dialogsBegin.fi: ...the Purple Magician in this book. History of Hardship. Only it says that the Black Magician and the Magician in Purple are the same person. The same person that fought alongside the heroes in the Hero Wars. That does not make sense.
dialogsBegin.fil: ...the Purple Magician in this book. History of Hardship. Only it says that the Black Magician and the Magician in Purple are the same person. The same person that fought alongside the heroes in the Hero Wars. That does not make sense.
dialogsBegin.fr: Cependant.. (hésitant pendant une minute) il indique que le Magicien Pourpre, leader des Mages Pourpres, a affronté les Héros de Madrigal pendant la Grande Guerre !?
dialogsBegin.id: ..The Purple Magician dalam buku ini. History of Hardship. Disana dikatakan jika The Black Magician dan The purple Magician adalah orang yang sama. Orang yang sama yang bertarung bersama para Hero dalam Hero Wars. Tidak masuk akal.
dialogsBegin.it: ...the Purple Magician in this book. History of Hardship. Only it says that the Black Magician and the Magician in Purple are the same person. The same person that fought alongside the heroes in the Hero Wars. That does not make sense.
dialogsBegin.jp: ＜苦難の歴史＞によると、＜紫闇の魔導師＞とは、英雄戦争の時代に、偉大な魔力をもって英雄たちを支え、この世を救ったといわれる＜ブラックマジシャン＞と同一人物だそうだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: ...이 책에 나오는 퍼플 매지션이요. 고난의 역사. 블랙 매지션과 퍼플 매지션이 같은 사람이라고만 적혀있어요. 영웅 전쟁에서 영웅들과 함께 싸웠던 바로 그 사람이라고요. 말도 안 돼요.
dialogsBegin.nl: ...the Purple Magician in this book. History of Hardship. Only it says that the Black Magician and the Magician in Purple are the same person. The same person that fought alongside the heroes in the Hero Wars. That does not make sense.
dialogsBegin.pl: ...the Purple Magician in this book. History of Hardship. Only it says that the Black Magician and the Magician in Purple are the same person. The same person that fought alongside the heroes in the Hero Wars. That does not make sense.
dialogsBegin.ru: ...the Purple Magician in this book. History of Hardship. Only it says that the Black Magician and the Magician in Purple are the same person. The same person that fought alongside the heroes in the Hero Wars. That does not make sense.
dialogsBegin.sp: ...el Mago Violeta que sale en este libro. Historia de Dificultades. Solo dice que el Mago Negro y el Mago Violeta son la misma persona. La misma persona que luchó junto a los héroes en la Guerra de los Héroes. Esto no tiene sentido.
dialogsBegin.sw: ...the Purple Magician in this book. History of Hardship. Only it says that the Black Magician and the Magician in Purple are the same person. The same person that fought alongside the heroes in the Hero Wars. That does not make sense.
dialogsBegin.th: จอมเวทสีม่วงในหนังสือนี้เล่าว่า จอมเวทดำ และ จอมเวทสีม่วง เป็นคนเดียวกัน คนเดียวกับที่ต่อสู้เคียงข้างเหล่าผู้กล้าในช่วงสงคราม ฟังดูมันไม่สมเหตุสมผลเลย
dialogsBegin.tw: ……這本《苦難的歷史》裡提到的紫色魔法師有關。可書上卻說，黑暗魔法師和紫色魔法師是同一個人，甚至還是那位曾在英雄戰爭中與英雄們並肩作戰的人。這根本說不通啊。
dialogsBegin.vi: ...the Purple Magician trong cuốn sách này. History of Hardship. Chỉ có điều sách cho rằng the Black Magician và the Magician in Purple là cùng một người. Cũng chính là người đã chiến đấu cùng phe với các anh hùng trong các Hero Wars. Điều đó thật vô lý.

dialogsBegin.en: It is something really unbelievable, but it is also something we should believe.
dialogsBegin.ar: It is something really unbelievable, but it is also something we should believe.
dialogsBegin.br: É realmente incrível, mas algo que em devemos acreditar.
dialogsBegin.cns: 解救了这世界的黑暗魔法师是同一个人啊。真是很难相信的内容啊..可是又不能不信。
dialogsBegin.de: Eigentlich ist es wirklich unglaublich, aber es ist auch etwas, was wir glauben sollten.
dialogsBegin.fi: It is something really unbelievable, but it is also something we should believe.
dialogsBegin.fil: It is something really unbelievable, but it is also something we should believe.
dialogsBegin.fr: C'est vraiment surprenant, mais cela ne semble faire aucun doute désormais…
dialogsBegin.id: Itu adalah sesuatu yang benar-benar tidak dapat dipercaya, tetapi juga sesuatu yang harus kita percayai.
dialogsBegin.it: It is something really unbelievable, but it is also something we should believe.
dialogsBegin.jp: これだけの証拠で、謎の魔導師と伝説上のブラックマジシャンが繋がるとは確定できないが、十分に信憑性がある。そしてこの大陸のどこかに＜紫闇の祭壇＞と呼ばれる場所があるらしい。
dialogsBegin.kr: 믿기지 않는 이야기지만, 동시에 믿어야만 하는 이야기이기도 해요.
dialogsBegin.nl: It is something really unbelievable, but it is also something we should believe.
dialogsBegin.pl: It is something really unbelievable, but it is also something we should believe.
dialogsBegin.ru: В это невозможно поверить… Но вот же они - доказательства…

dialogsBegin.sw: It is something really unbelievable, but it is also something we should believe.
dialogsBegin.th: ไม่น่าเชื่อจริงๆ แต่ก็เป็นสิ่งที่เราควรเชื่อด้วย

dialogsBegin.vi: Đó là một điều gì đó thực sự khó tin, nhưng cũng là điều chúng ta nên tin.

dialogsBegin.en: I think this is the best I can do for now but I will never stop looking for the truth.
dialogsBegin.ar: I think this is the best I can do for now but I will never stop looking for the truth.
dialogsBegin.br: Acho que é o melhor que consigo fazer agora, mas nunca deixarei de procurar a verdade.

dialogsBegin.fil: I think this is the best I can do for now but I will never stop looking for the truth.

dialogsBegin.pl: I think this is the best I can do for now but I will never stop looking for the truth.
dialogsBegin.ru: Придется верить. Но я не отступлюсь и однажды узнаю правду.
dialogsBegin.sp: Creo que esto es lo mejor que puedo descubrir por ahora, pero nunca dejaré de buscar la verdad.
dialogsBegin.sw: I think this is the best I can do for now but I will never stop looking for the truth.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันคิดว่านี่เป็นสิ่งที่ดีที่สุดที่ฉันสามารถทำได้ตอนนี้ แต่ฉันจะไม่หยุดค้นหาความจริง

dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi nghĩ đây là điều tốt nhất tôi có thể làm lúc này nhưng tôi sẽ không bao giờ ngừng tìm kiếm sự thật.

dialogsComplete.ar: Oh... Bubble protect us! Is this true? Oh... Oh... This is too big to deal with alone.
dialogsComplete.br: Oh... Que Bubble nos proteja! É verdade? Oh... Oh... Isso é demais para uma pessoa só.
dialogsComplete.cns: Oh... Bubble protect us! Is this true? Oh... Oh... This is too big to deal with alone.
dialogsComplete.de: Oh.. Oh je! ist das wahr? Oh.. Oh.. Das ist auch ein Weg zum großen Erfolg..
dialogsComplete.fi: Oh... Bubble protect us! Is this true? Oh... Oh... This is too big to deal with alone.
dialogsComplete.fil: Oh... Bubble protect us! Is this true? Oh... Oh... This is too big to deal with alone.
dialogsComplete.fr: (lisant la thèse de Hachal) Oh... Par Rhisis ! C'est… C'est… C'est tout bonnement incroyable !!
dialogsComplete.id: Oh.. Bubble, lindungi kami! Apa ini benar? Oh.. Oh.. Ini terlalu besar untuk dihadapi sendirian.
dialogsComplete.it: Oh... Bubble protect us! Is this true? Oh... Oh... This is too big to deal with alone.
dialogsComplete.jp: ほう、ハカルの調査書か。興味深いな、読ませてもらおう。…おや…おやおや、なんとこの内容は！ただごとではない領域まで調べてしまったな。これはマドリガルの歴史を覆すかもしれんくらいの重大なことだぞ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 오... 버블님이 지켜주셨어요! 이게 사실인가요? 오... 오... 혼자 감당하기엔 너무 큰 일이에요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Oh... Bubble protect us! Is this true? Oh... Oh... This is too big to deal with alone.
dialogsComplete.pl: Oh... Bubble protect us! Is this true? Oh... Oh... This is too big to deal with alone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Oh... Bubble protect us! Is this true? Oh... Oh... This is too big to deal with alone.
dialogsComplete.sp: Oh... ¡Bubble protégenos! ¿Esto es cierto? Oh... Oh... Esto es demasiado grande para uno solo...
dialogsComplete.sw: Oh... Bubble protect us! Is this true? Oh... Oh... This is too big to deal with alone.
dialogsComplete.th: โอ้.. Bubble กป้องเรา! เรื่องจริงหรือนี่? โอ้.. โอ้.. เรื่องมันใหญ่เกินไปที่จะรับมือคนเดียว
dialogsComplete.tw: 啊……願巴布樂保佑我們！這是真的嗎？啊……啊……這件事已經不是我一個人能處理的了。
dialogsComplete.vi: Ồ .. Bubble bảo vệ chúng ta! Điều này có thật không? Ôi...Ôi...Chuyện này quá lớn để giải quyết một mình.

dialogsFail.en: I am really glad to see you again, but did Hachal tell you to meet me? For what?
dialogsFail.ar: I am really glad to see you again, but did Hachal tell you to meet me? For what?
dialogsFail.br: Estou mesmo feliz em lhe ver novamente, mas Hachal lhe disse para me encontrar? Para quê?
dialogsFail.cns: 见到你很高兴，但是哈查尔说让你来见我了吗？是因为什么？
dialogsFail.de: Ich bin wirklich erfreut dich wieder zusehen, aber sagte dir Haka, dass du mich treffen sollst? Für was?
dialogsFail.fi: I am really glad to see you again, but did Hachal tell you to meet me? For what?
dialogsFail.fil: I am really glad to see you again, but did Hachal tell you to meet me? For what?
dialogsFail.fr: Je suis vraiment content de te revoir, mais as-tu bien terminé les missions que Hachal a dû te confier ?
dialogsFail.id: Aku sangat senang bertemu denganmu lagi, tapi apakah Hachal menyuruhmu bertemu denganku? Untuk apa?
dialogsFail.it: I am really glad to see you again, but did Hachal tell you to meet me? For what?
dialogsFail.jp: おや、君かね。久しぶりだな。ハカルとは無事に会えたかね？私に何か用か？
dialogsFail.kr: 다시 뵙게 되어 정말 반갑지만… 헤이첼이 저를 만나라고 하던가요? 무슨 일로요?
dialogsFail.nl: I am really glad to see you again, but did Hachal tell you to meet me? For what?
dialogsFail.pl: I am really glad to see you again, but did Hachal tell you to meet me? For what?
dialogsFail.ru: С тобой всегда приятно поговорить просто так, но неужели Гачалео ничего не просил передать мне? Совсем-совсем?
dialogsFail.sp: Me alegra verte de nuevo, pero ¿te ha dicho Hachal que vengas a verme? ¿Para qué?
dialogsFail.sw: I am really glad to see you again, but did Hachal tell you to meet me? For what?
dialogsFail.th: ฉันดีใจมากที่ได้พบคุณอีกครั้ง แต่ Hachal บอกให้คุณพบฉันเหรอ เพื่ออะไร?
dialogsFail.tw: 喔，又見到你了~可是，有什麼事情要找我嗎？夏格凱巴要你來找我啊？夏格凱巴發生什麼事情了嗎？
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi thực sự vui mừng khi gặp lại bạn, nhưng Hachal có bảo bạn gặp tôi không? Để làm gì?

dialogsBegin.en: This will be my final task. Complete this and you will have proven yourself worthy enough to speak with me regarding Reonan's request.
dialogsBegin.ar: This will be my final task. Complete this and you will have proven yourself worthy enough to speak with me regarding Reonan's request.
dialogsBegin.br: Esta será minha tarefa final. Complete isso e você terá se provado digno(a) o suficiente para falar comigo sobre o pedido de Reonan.
dialogsBegin.cns: 这将是我的最终考验。完成这个，你就证明了你有足够的资格可以和我谈论瑞尔南的请求。

dialogsBegin.kr: 이게 마지막 시험입니다. 이걸 끝낸다면, 저와 마주앉아 레오난의 부탁에 관해 이야기할 기회를 드리죠.

dialogsBegin.th: นี่เป็นงานสุดท้ายของฉัน สุดท้ายแล้ว คุณจะได้พิสูจน์ตัวเองและมันคุ้มค่าพอที่จะพูดกับฉันเกี่ยวกับคำร้องขอของ Reonan

dialogsBegin.vi: Đây sẽ là nhiệm vụ cuối cùng của tôi dành cho bạn. Hoàn thành điều này và bạn sẽ chứng minh được mình đủ xứng đáng để nói chuyện với tôi về yêu cầu của Reonan.

dialogsComplete.th: นั่นมันไม่ง่ายเลยนะ ฉันคือ Sury แต่ก่อนฉันเคยเป็น Hero Force Master
dialogsComplete.tw: 了不起！我還猜想你可能無法消滅爆鑽機械象。現在我可以相信你了。我的名字叫修利，最初的爆咒師英雄
dialogsComplete.vi: Đó chắc chắn không phải là một kỳ tích dễ dàng. Bạn đã giành được sự tôn trọng của tôi! Tên tôi là Sury, Anh hùng Billposter thuở sơ khai.
