name.th: ผู้สืบทอดของฮีโร่ -Guardian-
name.tw: 英雄的繼承者 - 守護者

description.en: Defeat the Venel Guardian, take his heart, and present it to Sencyrit the Blade Guardian in Guardiane.
description.ar: Defeat the Venel Guardian, take his heart, and present it to Sencyrit the Blade Guardian in Guardiane.
description.br: Derrote o espírito, Guardião Venel, e obtenha seu coração. Visite então Sencyrit, a Guardiã Blade.
description.cns: 去打倒守护兽贝纳卡度温，得取得它的心脏，再去找刀锋战士守护使者桑希里特。
description.de: Besiege den Wächtergeist Venel Guardian und beschaffe sein Herz. Dann besuche Sencyrit, den Blade Wächter.
description.fi: Defeat the Venel Guardian, take his heart, and present it to Sencyrit the Blade Guardian in Guardiane.
description.fil: Defeat the Venel Guardian, take his heart, and present it to Sencyrit the Blade Guardian in Guardiane.
description.fr: Vaincre Venel et ramener son cœur à la Gardienne des Assassins, Sencyrit.
description.id: Kalahkan Venel Guardian, ambil hatinya, dan berikan kepada Sencyrit the Blade Guardian di Guardiane.
description.it: Defeat the Venel Guardian, take his heart, and present it to Sencyrit the Blade Guardian in Guardiane.
description.jp: ガルディアの守護者の部屋にいる守護精霊＜ヴェネル・ガーディアン＞のハートを手に入れ、ブレード守護者センシリトに会おう。
description.kr: 베넬가디언을 처치하고 심장을 손에 넣으세요. 그다음, 가르디안에 있는 블레이드 수호자 센시리트에게 전달하세요.
description.nl: Defeat the Venel Guardian, take his heart, and present it to Sencyrit the Blade Guardian in Guardiane.
description.pl: Defeat the Venel Guardian, take his heart, and present it to Sencyrit the Blade Guardian in Guardiane.
description.ru: Нужно победить Виндигго и принести его сердце Сенсирити, хранительнице фехтовальщиков.
description.sp: Derrota al Guardián Venel, consigue su corazón y llévaselo a Sencyrit, la Guardiana Blade, en Guardiane.
description.sw: Defeat the Venel Guardian, take his heart, and present it to Sencyrit the Blade Guardian in Guardiane.
description.th: เอาชนะ Venel Guardian และนำเอาหัวใจของเขาไปให้ the Blade Guardian ที่ชื่อ Sencyrit ในเมือง Guardiane
description.tw: 去打倒守護獸貝納卡度溫，取得牠的心臟，再去守護者祭壇找暗殺者守護者桑希里特。
description.vi: Đánh bại Venel Guardian, lấy trái tim của anh ta và đưa nó cho Sencyrit, Blade Guardian ở Guardiane.

dialogsBegin.en: Here, take this Mark of the Heroes. It along with one last item will denote your status as a true Blade.
dialogsBegin.ar: Here, take this Mark of the Heroes. It along with one last item will denote your status as a true Blade.
dialogsBegin.br: Aqui está o símbolo do herói. Você precisa de mais um comprovante para ser reconhecido como um sucessor do herói.
dialogsBegin.cns: 这能证明你是英雄守护使者的继承者，但还需要另一个证明，了解你真正的实力！
dialogsBegin.de: Hier ist das Symbol der Helden. Du benötigst einen weiteren Beleg um als Nachfolger des Helden anerkannt zu werden.
dialogsBegin.fi: Here, take this Mark of the Heroes. It along with one last item will denote your status as a true Blade.
dialogsBegin.fil: Here, take this Mark of the Heroes. It along with one last item will denote your status as a true Blade.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je peux maintenant te confier le Sceau des Héros, qui confirme que tu as relevé avec succès tous les défis qui se sont présentés. Mais il te faut réussir l'épreuve finale.
dialogsBegin.id: Ini, ambil Tanda Pahlawan ini. Itu bersama dengan satu item terakhir akan menunjukkan statusmu sebagai Blade sejati.
dialogsBegin.it: Here, take this Mark of the Heroes. It along with one last item will denote your status as a true Blade.
dialogsBegin.jp: じゃあ、これが英雄の証だよ。実は、このほかにもうひとつ証が必要なんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 여기, 영웅의 증표를 받으세요. 진정한 블레이드로 인정을 받으시려면 한 가지의 증표가 더 필요합니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Here, take this Mark of the Heroes. It along with one last item will denote your status as a true Blade.
dialogsBegin.pl: Here, take this Mark of the Heroes. It along with one last item will denote your status as a true Blade.
dialogsBegin.ru: Это Знак героя. Он означает, что его владелец является истинным наследником героя-фехтовальщика.
dialogsBegin.sp: Toma esta Marca de los Héroes. Junto con un último objeto, marcará tu estado como un verdadero Blade.
dialogsBegin.sw: Here, take this Mark of the Heroes. It along with one last item will denote your status as a true Blade.
dialogsBegin.th: รับไป นำ Mark of the Heroes นี่ไปพร้อมกับไอเท็มอย่างสุดท้ายของคุณที่แสดงว่าคุณเป็น Blade ที่แท้จริง
dialogsBegin.tw: 這能證明你是英雄守護者的繼承者，但還需要另一個證明，了解你真正的實力！
dialogsBegin.vi: Đây, lấy Mark of the Heroes này. Nó cùng với một vật phẩm cuối cùng sẽ cho thấy bạn là một Blade thực sự.

dialogsBegin.en: In the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.ar: In the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.br: Na Sala do Guardião, você encontrará um espírito chamado $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你将会在守护之室找到一个名为$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$的意志。
dialogsBegin.de: Im Raum des Wächters findest du einen Geist namens $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fi: In the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fil: In the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fr: Au sud de Darkon 3, à Gardiane, se trouve un esprit appelé $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.id: Di Ruang Penjaga, Kamu akan menemukan roh yang disebut $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.it: In the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.jp: ガルディアンの守護者の部屋というところがありますが、この場所は英雄の紋章があるところで、英雄たちの意志が保存されています。 ここでは、$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$という精霊を見つけることができます。
dialogsBegin.kr: 수호자의 방에, $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$라는 정령이 있을 겁니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: In the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.pl: In the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.ru: In the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.sp: En la Habitación del Guardián, encontrarás un espíritu llamado $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.sw: In the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.th: ใน Guardian's Room คุณจะพบกับวิญญาณที่ถูกเรียกว่า $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$
dialogsBegin.tw: 在守護者之室裡，你會找到一個名為 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 的靈魂。
dialogsBegin.vi: Trong Guardian's Room, bạn sẽ tìm thấy một linh hồn được gọi là $ QUEST_END_KILL_NAME $.

dialogsBegin.en: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.ar: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.br: Derrote o espírito e obtenha seu coração. O coração será o comprovante do seu último teste.
dialogsBegin.cns: 击败它，拿走它的心脏。这是最后的考验了
dialogsBegin.de: Besiegt diesen Geist und nehmt sein Herz. Dies wird deine letzte Prüfung sein.
dialogsBegin.fi: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.fil: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il te faut y pénétrer et vaincre l'esprit qui s'y trouve. Il s'agit de ta dernière épreuve !
dialogsBegin.id: Kalahkan roh ini, dan ambil hatinya. Ini akan menjadi ujian terakhirmu.
dialogsBegin.it: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.jp: この守護者の部屋にいるヴェネル・ガーディアンを倒して、ヴェネル・ハートを取らなきゃいけないんだ。そしてそのハートが最後の証なのさ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그 정령을 쓰러뜨리고 심장을 손에 넣으세요. 이게 마지막 시험이에요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.pl: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.ru: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.sp: Derrota a ese espíritu y consigue su corazón. Esta es tu prueba final.
dialogsBegin.sw: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.th: เอาชนะวิญญาณตนนี้ และเอาหัวใจของมันมา นี่เป็นการทดสอบครั้งสุดท้ายของคุณ
dialogsBegin.tw: 打敗這個靈魂，奪取他的心。這將是你最後的考驗。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đánh bại tinh linh này, và lấy trái tim của nó. Đây sẽ là bài kiểm tra cuối cùng của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Sencyrit, the Blade Guardian.
dialogsBegin.ar: Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Sencyrit, the Blade Guardian.
dialogsBegin.br: Por favor, entregue o coração para Sencyrit, o guardião Blade.
dialogsBegin.cns: 请你把心脏拿给圣堂的[刀锋战士守护使者]桑希里特！
dialogsBegin.de: Bitte bringe das Herz zu Sencyrit, dem Blade Wächter.
dialogsBegin.fi: Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Sencyrit, the Blade Guardian.
dialogsBegin.fil: Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Sencyrit, the Blade Guardian.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu pourras alors te présenter à la Gardienne des Assassins, Sencyrit.
dialogsBegin.id: Setelah kamu menyelesaikan tugas ini, berikan hati kepada Sencyrit, Blade Guardian.
dialogsBegin.it: Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Sencyrit, the Blade Guardian.
dialogsBegin.jp: それを手に入れたらブレード守護者センシリトのもとに行ってください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 임무를 완수하면, 블레이드 수호자 센시리트님께 심장을 전달하세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Sencyrit, the Blade Guardian.
dialogsBegin.pl: Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Sencyrit, the Blade Guardian.
dialogsBegin.ru: Отнеси сердце Сенсирити, хранительнице фехтовальщиков. Что скажешь, борец? По плечу ли тебе такая схватка?
dialogsBegin.sp: Una vez que hayas completado esta tarea, llévale el corazón a Sencyrit, la Guardiana Blade.
dialogsBegin.sw: Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Sencyrit, the Blade Guardian.
dialogsBegin.th: เมื่อคุณเสร็จสิ้นภารกิจนี้แล้วให้แสดงหัวใจขอต่อ Blade Guardian ที่ชื่อ Sencyrit
dialogsBegin.tw: 請你把心臟拿給守護者祭壇的暗殺者守護者 [桑希里特]！
dialogsBegin.vi: Khi bạn đã hoàn thành nhiệm vụ này, hãy đưa trái tim cho Sencyrit, Blade Guardian.

dialogsAccept.en: I wish you luck.
dialogsAccept.ar: I wish you luck.
dialogsAccept.br: Eu lhe desejo sorte.
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你好运
dialogsAccept.de: Ich wünsche Dir viel Glück.
dialogsAccept.fi: Toivotan sinulle onnea.
dialogsAccept.fil: I wish you luck.
dialogsAccept.fr: Je te souhaite que la grâce de Heren t'accompagne.
dialogsAccept.id: Saya berharap Anda beruntung.
dialogsAccept.it: I wish you luck.
dialogsAccept.jp: じゃあ、がんばってね。無事に試練を乗り越えられますように！
dialogsAccept.kr: 승리를 기원하죠.
dialogsAccept.nl: I wish you luck.
dialogsAccept.pl: I wish you luck.
dialogsAccept.ru: I wish you luck.
dialogsAccept.sp: Te deseo suerte.
dialogsAccept.sw: I wish you luck.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้คุณโชคดี
dialogsAccept.tw: 祝你好運！
dialogsAccept.vi: Chúc bạn may mắn.

dialogsDecline.en: You’re almost finished, Mercenary. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.ar: You’re almost finished, Mercenary. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.br: Você veio até aqui, e agora está desistindo? Este é o último passo, por favor pense cuidadosamente.
dialogsDecline.cns: 你已经快完成了，战士，不要在此处放弃
dialogsDecline.de: Du bist fast fertig, Mercenary. Geben Sie jetzt nicht auf.
dialogsDecline.fi: You’re almost finished, Mercenary. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.fil: You’re almost finished, Mercenary. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.fr: Après avoir traversé tant d'épreuves, tu es sur le point d'abandonner ? Ceci est la dernière étape, réfléchis bien...
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu hampir selesai, Mercenary. Jangan menyerah sekarang.
dialogsDecline.it: You’re almost finished, Mercenary. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.jp: ここまできて、全部諦めちゃうの？そりゃないよ～。これで最後なんだから、もう一度よく考えなよ！
dialogsDecline.kr: 거의 다 왔어요. 지금 포기하면 아깝잖아요.
dialogsDecline.nl: You’re almost finished, Mercenary. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.pl: You’re almost finished, Mercenary. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.ru: You’re almost finished, Mercenary. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.sp: Ya casi has terminado, Mercenary. No te rindas ahora.
dialogsDecline.sw: You’re almost finished, Mercenary. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณใกล้จะทำสำเร็จแล้วนะ Mercenary อย่าพึ่งยอมแพ้สิ
dialogsDecline.tw: 你快完成了，勇者，現在別放棄。
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn sắp hoàn thành, Mercenary. Đừng bỏ cuộc ngay lúc này.

dialogsComplete.en: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Blade upon you.
dialogsComplete.ar: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Blade upon you.
dialogsComplete.br: Muito bem, sucessor. Você passou no último teste! Eu agora oficialmente concedo o título de Blade a você.
dialogsComplete.cns: 恭喜你！你已经通过最终的测验，你已经成为了刀锋战士的继承者！
dialogsComplete.de: Willkommen Nachfolger. Du hast den letzten Test bestanden! Du bist nun offiziell ein Nachfolger des Blade.
dialogsComplete.fi: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Blade upon you.
dialogsComplete.fil: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Blade upon you.
dialogsComplete.fr: Bienvenue à Gardiane. Tu as réussi brillamment la dernière épreuve et mérites désormais d'être l'un des successeurs du Héros des Assassins.
dialogsComplete.id: Bagus sekali! Saya sekarang secara resmi memberikan gelar Blade kepadamu.
dialogsComplete.it: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Blade upon you.
dialogsComplete.jp: 後継者よ。汝は最後の試練を乗り越えた。これからはブレード後継者として新たな道を歩むがよい！聖王の慈悲が雨のごとく汝に降り注ぐであろう！
dialogsComplete.kr: 훌륭하네요! 이제 당신에게 블레이드의 칭호를 정식으로 수여하겠습니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Blade upon you.
dialogsComplete.pl: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Blade upon you.
dialogsComplete.ru: Прекрасно! Объявляю тебя фехтовальщиком!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Bien hecho! Te otorgo oficialmente el título de Blade.
dialogsComplete.sw: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Blade upon you.
dialogsComplete.th: ทำได้ดีมาก! ตอนนี้ฉันมอบอาชีพ Blade ให้กับคุณอย่างเป็นทางการ
dialogsComplete.tw: 恭喜你！你已經通過最終的測驗，你已經成為了暗殺者的繼承者！
dialogsComplete.vi: Làm tốt! Bây giờ tôi chính thức ban tặng danh hiệu Blade cho bạn.

dialogsComplete.en: Heren, please bless and encourage this Blade as they follow your will!
dialogsComplete.ar: Heren, please bless and encourage this Blade as they follow your will!
dialogsComplete.br: Heren, por favor abençoe e encoraje esta pessoa que está seguindo a sua vontade!! Blade!
dialogsComplete.cns: 海琳啊！这里有要继承你的人，请你引领他吧！
dialogsComplete.de: Heren, bitte segne und ermutige diese Person, die dem Weg deines Willen folgen möchte. Blade.
dialogsComplete.fi: Heren, please bless and encourage this Blade as they follow your will!
dialogsComplete.fil: Heren, please bless and encourage this Blade as they follow your will!
dialogsComplete.fr: Heren, puisses-tu bénir et soutenir en tout temps cette personne ici qui dédie sa vie à ta volonté !
dialogsComplete.id: Di sini, tolong berkati dan dorong Blade ini karena mereka mengikuti kehendakmu!
dialogsComplete.it: Heren, please bless and encourage this Blade as they follow your will!
dialogsComplete.jp: ＜疾風の刃＞ヘレンよ、今ここに新たな後継者が誕生しました！この者に祝福と勇気を授けたまえ！
dialogsComplete.kr: 헤렌이시여, 이 블레이드가 당신의 뜻을 따를 수 있도록 축복과 격려를 내려주소서!
dialogsComplete.nl: Heren, please bless and encourage this Blade as they follow your will!
dialogsComplete.pl: Heren, please bless and encourage this Blade as they follow your will!
dialogsComplete.ru: О, великий Д'Артамис! Дай этому фехтовальщику сил идти твоей дорогой!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Heren, por favor bendice y dale valor a este Blade que seguirá tu voluntad!
dialogsComplete.sw: Heren, please bless and encourage this Blade as they follow your will!
dialogsComplete.th: Heren โปรดอวยพรและให้ความช่วยเหลือ Blade คนนี้ตามที่คุณต้องการด้วยเถิด!
dialogsComplete.tw: 海琳啊！這裡有要繼承你的人，請你引領他吧！
dialogsComplete.vi: Heren, xin hãy chúc phúc và khích lệ Blade khi họ làm theo ý muốn của bạn!

dialogsFail.en: Only one recognized as a Blade may pass. Please turn back.
dialogsFail.ar: Only one recognized as a Blade may pass. Please turn back.
dialogsFail.br: Somente aquele que for reconhecido como um sucessor poderá entrar aqui. Volte.
dialogsFail.cns: 这里只有英雄的继承者才可以进入！请离开吧！
dialogsFail.de: Nur derjenige, der als Nachfolger anerkannt wurde, darf passieren. Geh zurück.
dialogsFail.fi: Only one recognized as a Blade may pass. Please turn back.
dialogsFail.fil: Only one recognized as a Blade may pass. Please turn back.
dialogsFail.fr: Seuls ceux reconnus comme successeurs de Heren sont admis ici. Poursuis ton apprentissage...
dialogsFail.id: Hanya satu yang dikenali sebagai Blade yang boleh lewat. Silakan kembali.
dialogsFail.it: Only one recognized as a Blade may pass. Please turn back.
dialogsFail.jp: ここは英雄の後継者として認められた者のみが立ち入ることを許される、資格のないものは即刻立ち去るがよい･･･。
dialogsFail.kr: 블레이드로 인정받은 자만이 이곳을 지나갈 수 있습니다. 돌아가세요.
dialogsFail.nl: Only one recognized as a Blade may pass. Please turn back.
dialogsFail.pl: Only one recognized as a Blade may pass. Please turn back.
dialogsFail.ru: Пройти может только фехтовальщик. Тебя я попрошу отойти.
dialogsFail.sp: Sólo los reconocidos como Blade pueden pasar. Por favor vete.
dialogsFail.sw: Only one recognized as a Blade may pass. Please turn back.
dialogsFail.th: ผู้ที่ได้ชื่อว่าเป็น Blade แล้วเท่านั้นถึงจะผ่านไปได้ กรุณากลับไป
dialogsFail.tw: 這裡只有英雄的繼承者才可以進入！請離開吧！
dialogsFail.vi: Chỉ một người được công nhận là Blade mới có thể vượt qua. Xin hãy quay lại.

description.br: Mate os Cavaleiros de Aço para coletar Peças de Aço e leve-as para Amadolka processar.
description.cns: Kill Steel Knights to collect Steel Pieces and bring them to Amadolka.
description.de: Töte Steel Knights, um Steel Pieces zu sammeln und sie zu Amadolka zu bringen.
description.fi: Kill Steel Knights to collect Steel Pieces and bring them to Amadolka.
description.fil: Kill Steel Knights to collect Steel Pieces and bring them to Amadolka.
description.fr: Tuez des Steelknight et apportez les morceaux d'acier à Amadolca.
description.id: Bunuh Steelknights untuk mengumpulkan Steel Pieces dan membawanya ke Amadolka.
description.it: Kill Steel Knights to collect Steel Pieces and bring them to Amadolka.
description.jp: スチールナイトを倒して鉄板を入手した後、アマドルカーを訪ねよ。
description.kr: 스틸 나이트들을 처치하고, 강철 조각을 모아 아마돌카에게 가져가세요.
description.nl: Kill Steel Knights to collect Steel Pieces and bring them to Amadolka.

description.ru: Kill Steel Knights to collect Steel Pieces and bring them to Amadolka.
description.sp: Derrota a Caballero de Acero, consigue las Piezas de Acero y llévaselas a Amadolka.
description.sw: Kill Steel Knights to collect Steel Pieces and bring them to Amadolka.
description.th: ฆ่า Steel Knights เพื่อรวบรวม Steel Pieces และนำไปให้ Amadolka
description.tw: 擊倒騎士機械收集鋼鐵碎片，並帶去給阿瑪多卡。

dialogsBegin.en: Yes you heard me correctly, FIRST component. What!? Did you think breaking this curse would be THAT easy? Hah!
dialogsBegin.ar: Yes you heard me correctly, FIRST component. What!? Did you think breaking this curse would be THAT easy? Hah!
dialogsBegin.br: Sim, você me ouviu corretamente, PRIMEIRO componente. Hã!? Você achou que quebrar essa maldição seria TÃO fácil assim? Quem me dera!
dialogsBegin.cns: 是的，你没听错，第一部分。什么！？你认为打破这个诅咒会那么容易吗？哈!
dialogsBegin.de: Ja, Sie haben richtig gehört, ERSTER Bestandteil. Was!? Dachtest du, es wäre so einfach, diesen Fluch zu brechen? Hah!
dialogsBegin.fi: Yes you heard me correctly, FIRST component. What!? Did you think breaking this curse would be THAT easy? Hah!
dialogsBegin.fil: Yes you heard me correctly, FIRST component. What!? Did you think breaking this curse would be THAT easy? Hah!
dialogsBegin.fr: Merci beaucoup mais la liste est encore longue. L'ingrédient suivant est de la poudre d'acier trempé.
dialogsBegin.id: Ya, Anda mendengar saya dengan benar, komponen PERTAMA. Apa!? Apakah menurut Anda mematahkan kutukan ini akan semudah ITU? Hah!
dialogsBegin.it: Yes you heard me correctly, FIRST component. What!? Did you think breaking this curse would be THAT easy? Hah!
dialogsBegin.jp: む？　まさかこの程度で呪いが解けると思ったか？　まだまだ集めなければならぬ材料がある。次は鋼鉄粉だ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 뭐야, 설마 이게 끝이라 생각하는 건 아니겠지? 아직 모아야 하는 재료는  많다고. 쉽게 얻을 수 있는 것들이 아니니 좀 어려울꺼야.
dialogsBegin.nl: Yes you heard me correctly, FIRST component. What!? Did you think breaking this curse would be THAT easy? Hah!
dialogsBegin.pl: Yes you heard me correctly, FIRST component. What!? Did you think breaking this curse would be THAT easy? Hah!
dialogsBegin.ru: Да, ты всё правильно расслышал. ПЕРВЫЙ компонент. Что? Ты думаешь так просто избавиться от такого сильного заклятия? Ха!
dialogsBegin.sp: Sí, me has oído bien, era el PRIMER componente. ¿¡Qué!? ¿Te pensabas que romper esta maldición sería TAN fácil? ¡Ja!
dialogsBegin.sw: Yes you heard me correctly, FIRST component. What!? Did you think breaking this curse would be THAT easy? Hah!
dialogsBegin.th: ใช่ คุณได้ยินฉันถูกต้องส่วนประกอบ ก่อนอื่น อะไร!? คุณคิดว่าการทำลายคำสาปนี้จะเป็นเรื่องง่ายไหม? ฮะ!
dialogsBegin.tw: 什麼，你以為這樣就結束了嗎？要收集的材料還很多。這次的材料是堅硬的鐵粉末。鐵粉末不是那麼容易就可以獲得，這有一點困難。
dialogsBegin.vi: Vâng, bạn đã nghe tôi một cách chính xác, thành phần ĐẦU TIÊN. Gì!? Bạn có nghĩ rằng việc phá bỏ lời nguyền này sẽ dễ dàng đến vậy? Hả!

dialogsBegin.en: Next I will be needing Hard Steel Powder. Unfortunately, as with most things in life, this is easier said than done!
dialogsBegin.ar: Next I will be needing Hard Steel Powder. Unfortunately, as with most things in life, this is easier said than done!
dialogsBegin.br: Em seguida vou precisar de Pó de Aço Reforçado. Infelizmente, como a maioria das coisas na vida, é mais fácil falar do que fazer!
dialogsBegin.cns: 接下来，我需要硬钢粉末。不幸的是，与生活中的大多数事情一样，说起来容易做起来难。
dialogsBegin.de: Als Nächstes werde ich Hard Steel Powder benötigen. Leider ist das, wie bei den meisten Dingen im Leben, leichter gesagt als getan!
dialogsBegin.fi: Next I will be needing Hard Steel Powder. Unfortunately, as with most things in life, this is easier said than done!
dialogsBegin.fil: Next I will be needing Hard Steel Powder. Unfortunately, as with most things in life, this is easier said than done!
dialogsBegin.fr: Commencez par tuer des Steelknight et récupérez des morceaux d'acier.
dialogsBegin.id: Selanjutnya saya akan membutuhkan Hard Steel Powder. Sayangnya, seperti kebanyakan hal dalam hidup, ini lebih mudah diucapkan daripada dilakukan!
dialogsBegin.it: Next I will be needing Hard Steel Powder. Unfortunately, as with most things in life, this is easier said than done!
dialogsBegin.jp: これには段階があってな。まずはスチールナイトを倒して、鉄板をはぎ取ってくるのだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 우선 스틸나이트를 처치하고 그들에게서 단단한 철조각을 얻어야 해.
dialogsBegin.nl: Next I will be needing Hard Steel Powder. Unfortunately, as with most things in life, this is easier said than done!
dialogsBegin.pl: Następnie będę potrzebował Stalowego Twardego Proszku. Niestety, jak w przypadku większości rzeczy w życiu, łatwiej to powiedzieć niż zrobić!
dialogsBegin.ru: Next I will be needing Hard Steel Powder. Unfortunately, as with most things in life, this is easier said than done!
dialogsBegin.sp: A continuación, necesitaré Polvo de Acero Duro. Desafortunadamente, como con la mayoría de las cosas en la vida, ¡es más fácil decirlo que hacerlo!
dialogsBegin.sw: Next I will be needing Hard Steel Powder. Unfortunately, as with most things in life, this is easier said than done!
dialogsBegin.th: มันยากที่ฉันจะต้องการผงเหล็ก ว่าแต่ มัวแต่พูดแล้วเมื่อไหร่จะเสร็จล่ะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 首先消滅騎士機械，然後從他們的身上獲得鐵碎片。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tiếp theo tôi sẽ cần đến Hard Steel Powder. Thật không may, như với hầu hết mọi thứ trong cuộc sống, điều này nói dễ hơn làm!

dialogsBegin.en: First you will need to get Steel pieces, then take them to Amadolka. He is knowledgeable in metallurgy and can convert the pieces to powder. Up to the challenge?
dialogsBegin.ar: First you will need to get Steel pieces, then take them to Amadolka. He is knowledgeable in metallurgy and can convert the pieces to powder. Up to the challenge?
dialogsBegin.br: Primeiro você precisará obter Peças de Aço e depois levar para Amadolka. Ele é conhecedor de metalurgia e pode converter as peças em pó. Está pronto para o desafio?
dialogsBegin.cns: 首先你需要得到钢片，然后把它们带到艾玛都卡那里。他对冶金学很有研究，可以将这些碎片转化为粉末。准备好迎接挑战了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Als Erstes müsst ihr Steel pieces besorgen und sie dann zu Amadolka bringen. Er kennt sich mit Metallurgie aus und kann die Stücke in Pulver umwandeln. Bist du der Herausforderung gewachsen?
dialogsBegin.fi: First you will need to get Steel pieces, then take them to Amadolka. He is knowledgeable in metallurgy and can convert the pieces to powder. Up to the challenge?
dialogsBegin.fil: First you will need to get Steel pieces, then take them to Amadolka. He is knowledgeable in metallurgy and can convert the pieces to powder. Up to the challenge?
dialogsBegin.fr: Quand vous aurez les morceaux, apportez-les à Amadolka et demandez-lui comment en faire de la poudre.
dialogsBegin.id: Pertama, Anda perlu mendapatkan Steel Pieces, lalu membawanya ke Amadolka. Dia berpengetahuan luas dalam metalurgi dan dapat mengubah potongan-potongan menjadi bubuk. Siap untuk ikut tantangan ini?
dialogsBegin.it: First you will need to get Steel pieces, then take them to Amadolka. He is knowledgeable in metallurgy and can convert the pieces to powder. Up to the challenge?
dialogsBegin.jp: 鉄板があればよいかと？　いや、私が必要としているのは鋼鉄粉だ。まあ、まずはスチールナイトを倒して鉄板をはぎ取ってくればよい。
dialogsBegin.kr: 우선 스틸나이트에게서 철조각을 구해 아마돌카에게 가서 단단한 철가루를 만들고 싶다고 말해봐. 그럼 그가 가르쳐 줄거야.
dialogsBegin.nl: First you will need to get Steel pieces, then take them to Amadolka. He is knowledgeable in metallurgy and can convert the pieces to powder. Up to the challenge?
dialogsBegin.pl: Najpierw musisz zdobyć Kawałki Stali, następnie zanieś je do Amadolki. Zna się na metalurgii i potrafi zamienić kawałki na proszek. Podołasz wyzwaniu?
dialogsBegin.ru: Теперь надо будет раздобыть кусочки металла и отнести их Амадолару. Только он достаточно разбирается в металлургии, чтобы сделать из них очень тонкий порошок. Ты готов?
dialogsBegin.sp: Primero necesitarás conseguir las Piezas de Acero y luego llevárselas a Amadolka. Tiene conocimientos de metalurgia y puede convertir las piezas en polvo. ¿A por todas?
dialogsBegin.sw: First you will need to get Steel pieces, then take them to Amadolka. He is knowledgeable in metallurgy and can convert the pieces to powder. Up to the challenge?
dialogsBegin.th: ก่อนอื่น คุณจะต้องได้รับชิ้นส่วนเหล็กแล้วนำไปให้ Amadolka เขามีความรู้ด้านโลหะวิทยาและสามารถแปรรูปเป็นผงได้ รับคำท้าทาย?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你說把那個拿回來就可以嗎？不！我需要的是堅硬的鐵粉末！首先從騎士機械那裡收集鐵碎片，然後去找亞瑪多，然後告訴他你想要製作堅硬的鐵粉末。那麼他就會告訴你。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đầu tiên, bạn sẽ cần lấy các mảnh Thép, sau đó đưa chúng đến Amadolka. Anh ta am hiểu về luyện kim và có thể chuyển các mảnh thành bột. Chấp nhận thách thức chứ?

dialogsAccept.en: Good!! Kill Steel Knights near the Erons Factory to get the Steel Pieces, then bring them to Amadolka!
dialogsAccept.ar: Good!! Kill Steel Knights near the Erons Factory to get the Steel Pieces, then bring them to Amadolka!
dialogsAccept.br: Boa!! Mate os Cavaleiros de Aço perto da Fábrica Erons para obter as Peças de Aço, depois leve-as para Amadolka!
dialogsAccept.cns: Good!! Kill Steel Knights near the Erons Factory to get the Steel Pieces, then bring them to Amadolka!
dialogsAccept.de: Gut!!! Töte Steel Knights in der Nähe der Erons Factory, um die Steel Pieces zu bekommen, und bringe sie dann zu Amadolka!
dialogsAccept.fi: Good!! Kill Steel Knights near the Erons Factory to get the Steel Pieces, then bring them to Amadolka!
dialogsAccept.fil: Good!! Kill Steel Knights near the Erons Factory to get the Steel Pieces, then bring them to Amadolka!
dialogsAccept.fr: Bien ! Tuez les Steelknights près de l'Usine des Erons pour obtenir les Morceau d'acier, puis apportez-les à Amadolka !
dialogsAccept.id: Bagus!! Bunuh Steelknights di dekat Erons Factory untuk mendapatkan Steel Pieces, lalu bawa ke Amadolka!
dialogsAccept.it: Good!! Kill Steel Knights near the Erons Factory to get the Steel Pieces, then bring them to Amadolka!
dialogsAccept.jp: 鉄板を手に入れた後はダーコンにいるアマドルカーに渡すのだ。彼ならすぐに鉄板を加工してくれるだろう。
dialogsAccept.kr: 좋아요!!! 에런스 공장 근처에서 스틸 나이트를 처치하고, 강철 조각을 모아 아마돌카에게 가져가세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Good!! Kill Steel Knights near the Erons Factory to get the Steel Pieces, then bring them to Amadolka!
dialogsAccept.pl: Dobrze!! Zabij Żelaznych Rycerzy w pobliżu Fabryki Eronsa, aby zdobyć Stalowe Kawałki, a następnie zanieś je do Amadolki!
dialogsAccept.ru: Good!! Kill Steel Knights near the Erons Factory to get the Steel Pieces, then bring them to Amadolka!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡¡Bien!! ¡Derrota a Caballero de Acero cerca de la Fábrica de Erons para conseguir las Piezas de Acero y luego llévaselas a Amadolka!
dialogsAccept.sw: Good!! Kill Steel Knights near the Erons Factory to get the Steel Pieces, then bring them to Amadolka!
dialogsAccept.th: ดี!! ฆ่า Steel Knights ใกล้โรงงาน Erons เพื่อเก็บ Steel Pieces ไปให้ Amadolka!
dialogsAccept.tw: 很好！！去艾隆工廠附近擊倒騎士機械取得鋼鐵碎片，然後把它們帶去給阿瑪多卡！
dialogsAccept.vi: Tốt!! Giết Steelknights gần Erons Factory để lấy các Steel Pieces, sau đó mang chúng đến Amadolka!

dialogsDecline.en: What? Complicated? What's complicated is being a man, trapped in a fuzzy little body! Try that on for size!
dialogsDecline.ar: What? Complicated? What's complicated is being a man, trapped in a fuzzy little body! Try that on for size!
dialogsDecline.br: Que? Complicado? O complicado é ser um homem, preso em um corpinho felpudo! Considere isso como complicado!
dialogsDecline.cns: 什么？复杂？复杂的是作为一个男人，被困在一个毛茸茸的小身体里! 试试这个尺寸吧！
dialogsDecline.de: Was? Kompliziert? Kompliziert ist es, ein Mann zu sein, der in einem wuscheligen kleinen Körper gefangen ist! Probier das mal aus!
dialogsDecline.fi: What? Complicated? What's complicated is being a man, trapped in a fuzzy little body! Try that on for size!
dialogsDecline.fil: What? Complicated? What's complicated is being a man, trapped in a fuzzy little body! Try that on for size!
dialogsDecline.fr: Compliqué ? Imaginez-vous à ma place…
dialogsDecline.id: Apa? Rumit? Yang rumit adalah menjadi seorang manusia, terjebak dalam tubuh kecil yang tidak jelas! Coba saja dengan ukuran segini!
dialogsDecline.it: What? Complicated? What's complicated is being a man, trapped in a fuzzy little body! Try that on for size!
dialogsDecline.jp: ふん、この程度で音を上げるようじゃまだまだだな。
dialogsDecline.kr: 네? 복잡하다고요? 진짜 복잡한 건, 어른인데도 이 복슬복슬한 조그만 몸에 갇혀 있는 거라고요! 한번 직접 겪어보세요!
dialogsDecline.nl: What? Complicated? What's complicated is being a man, trapped in a fuzzy little body! Try that on for size!
dialogsDecline.pl: What? Complicated? What's complicated is being a man, trapped in a fuzzy little body! Try that on for size!
dialogsDecline.ru: What? Complicated? What's complicated is being a man, trapped in a fuzzy little body! Try that on for size!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Qué? ¿Complicado? ¡Lo complicado es ser un hombre, atrapado en un cuerpecito peludo! ¡Pruébalo tú para ver el dilema!
dialogsDecline.sw: What? Complicated? What's complicated is being a man, trapped in a fuzzy little body! Try that on for size!
dialogsDecline.th: อะไร? ซับซ้อน? สิ่งที่ซับซ้อนคือการเป็นมนุษย์ติดอยู่ในร่างเล็ก ๆ
dialogsDecline.tw: 很複雜嗎？頭腦這麼笨，怎麼能夠記住怪物的名字呢？
dialogsDecline.vi: Gì cơ? Phức tạp sao? Điều phức tạp nhất ở đây là trở thành một người đàn ông bị mắc kẹt trong một cơ thể nhỏ bé mờ nhạt! Cứ hãy thử kích thước này sẽ rõ!

dialogsComplete.en: Woah! Don't get many visitors out this way. What are you looking for here anyway?
dialogsComplete.ar: Woah! Don't get many visitors out this way. What are you looking for here anyway?
dialogsComplete.br: Uau! Faz tempo que recebo visitantes desta forma. O que você está procurando aqui, afinal?
dialogsComplete.cns: 呜! 这条路的访客不多。你在这里找什么呢？
dialogsComplete.de: Wahnsinn! Hierher kommen nicht viele Besucher. Wonach suchen Sie hier überhaupt?
dialogsComplete.fi: Woah! Don't get many visitors out this way. What are you looking for here anyway?
dialogsComplete.fil: Woah! Don't get many visitors out this way. What are you looking for here anyway?
dialogsComplete.fr: Vous avez l'air bien chargé pour un petit gringalet…
dialogsComplete.id: Woah! Jangan sampai banyak pengunjung yang keluar dengan cara ini. Apa yang kamu cari di sini?
dialogsComplete.it: Woah! Don't get many visitors out this way. What are you looking for here anyway?
dialogsComplete.jp: お、これはスチールナイトの鉄板じゃないか？　ふんふん、研磨してほしいのだね。ちょっと待ちなさい。
dialogsComplete.kr: 무슨 일인가 젊은이! 이 주변에는 방문객이 잘 없는데.
dialogsComplete.nl: Woah! Don't get many visitors out this way. What are you looking for here anyway?
dialogsComplete.pl: Woah! Don't get many visitors out this way. What are you looking for here anyway?
dialogsComplete.ru: Вау! Теперь мало кто заходит с этой стороны. Вы что-то здесь ищите?
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Guau! No traigas a gente para que me vean así. ¿Qué estás buscando aquí de todos modos?
dialogsComplete.sw: Woah! Don't get many visitors out this way. What are you looking for here anyway?
dialogsComplete.th: ว้าว! ไม่ได้รับผู้เข้าชมจำนวนมากด้วยวิธีนี้ คุณกำลังมองหาอะไร?
dialogsComplete.tw: 有什麼事情嗎？年輕人！哈哈~你要我將那個鐵碎片製作成堅硬的鐵碎片啊！這是我的專長！你等我一下吧。
dialogsComplete.vi: Chà! Đừng thu hút nhiều khách theo cách này. Bạn đang tìm kiếm điều gì ở đây?

dialogsFail.en: You heard me correctly! Kill Steel Knights to get Steel Pieces and go to Amadolka. You got this champ!
dialogsFail.ar: You heard me correctly! Kill Steel Knights to get Steel Pieces and go to Amadolka. You got this champ!
dialogsFail.br: Você me ouviu corretamente! Mate os Cavaleiros de Aço para obter Peças de Aço e leve para Amadolka. Você consegue campeão!
dialogsFail.cns: You heard me correctly! Kill Steel Knights to get Steel Pieces and go to Amadolka. You got this champ!
dialogsFail.de: Du hast mich richtig verstanden! Töte Steel Knights, um Steel Pieces zu bekommen und gehe zu Amadolka. Du schaffst das!
dialogsFail.fi: You heard me correctly! Kill Steel Knights to get Steel Pieces and go to Amadolka. You got this champ!
dialogsFail.fil: You heard me correctly! Kill Steel Knights to get Steel Pieces and go to Amadolka. You got this champ!
dialogsFail.fr: Vous avez bien entendu ! Tuez des Steelknights pour obtenir des Morceaux d'acier et apportez les à Amadolka. Vous pouvez le faire !
dialogsFail.id: Kamu mendengar saya dengan benar! Bunuh Steelknights untuk mendapatkan Steel Pieces dan pergi ke Amadolka. Kamu pasti bisa melakukannya!
dialogsFail.it: You heard me correctly! Kill Steel Knights to get Steel Pieces and go to Amadolka. You got this champ!
dialogsFail.jp: スチールナイトからはぎ取るのだ。他のモンスターではあまり綺麗にはぎ取れぬからな。
dialogsFail.kr: 제 말 똑바로 들으셨죠! 스틸 나이트를 처치하고 강철 조각을 모아 아마돌카에게 가세요. 잘할 수 있어요!
dialogsFail.nl: You heard me correctly! Kill Steel Knights to get Steel Pieces and go to Amadolka. You got this champ!
dialogsFail.pl: Słyszałeś mnie! Zabij Żelaznych Rycerzy, aby zdobyć Stalowe Kawałki, następnie udaj się do Amadolki. Powodzenia!
dialogsFail.ru: You heard me correctly! Kill Steel Knights to get Steel Pieces and go to Amadolka. You got this champ!
dialogsFail.sp: ¡Me has oído bien! Derrota a Caballero de Acero para obtener Piezas de Acero y ves con Amadolka. ¡Tu puedes!
dialogsFail.sw: You heard me correctly! Kill Steel Knights to get Steel Pieces and go to Amadolka. You got this champ!
dialogsFail.th: คุณได้ยินถูกแล้ว! ฆ่า Steel Knights เพื่อเก็บ Steel Pieces และไปหา Amadolka !
dialogsFail.tw: 你沒聽錯！去擊倒騎士機械取得鋼鐵碎片，然後送去阿瑪多卡。你一定辦得到，冠軍！
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn nghe đúng những gì tôi nói rồi đấy! Giết Steel Knights để lấy Steel Pieces và đến Amadolka. Bạn sẽ làm được thôi!

description.en: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.ar: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.br: Caçando $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ recuperará seus pontos de Karma.
description.cns: 为了减少你的罪恶值，你要去击杀 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 回来。
description.de: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ jagen wird dein Karma wiederherstellen.
description.fi: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.fil: Ang Pang-huhuli ng $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ay makakapagpanumbalik ng iyong Karma points.
description.fr: Tu devrais chasser des $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s afin de récupérer les points de Karma.
description.id: Berburu $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ akan memulihkan poin-poin Karmamu.
description.it: Stai cacciando $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ per recuperare i tuoi punti Karma.
description.jp: カルマポイントを回復するため、$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を処罰して来てください。
description.nl: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.pl: Polowanie na $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ pozwoli odzyskać punkty Karmy.
description.ru: Твоя цель - $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, только так ты очистишь карму.
description.sp: Cazar $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ recuperará tus puntos de Karma.
description.sw: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.th: การล่า $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ จะกู้คืนคะแนน Karma ของคุณ
description.tw: 狩獵 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 將會恢復你的惡名點數。
description.vi: Săn $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ sẽ phục hồi điểm Karma của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsAccept.pl: Upoluj $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.

dialogsDecline.en: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.ar: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.br: Você ainda tem que pagar pelos seus pecados...
dialogsDecline.cns: 你还没有为你的罪恶付出代价...
dialogsDecline.de: Du musst noch immer für deine Sünden bezahlen...
dialogsDecline.fi: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.fil: Di mo pa bayad ang iyong mga kasalanan…
dialogsDecline.fr: Quand expieras-tu tes nombreux crimes ?
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu belum membayar untuk dosa-dosamu…
dialogsDecline.it: Devi ancora pagare per i tuoi peccati...
dialogsDecline.jp: いつになったら、この底知れぬ罪悪感から抜けられるのだろう？
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신은 아직 죗값을 치르지 않았으니...
dialogsDecline.nl: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.pl: Musisz najpierw zapłacić za swoje grzechy…
dialogsDecline.ru: Велики твои грехи…
dialogsDecline.sp: Todavía tienes que pagar por tus pecados...
dialogsDecline.sw: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.th: คุณยังไม้ได้ชดใช้บาปของคุณ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 你還沒有為你的罪付出代價…
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn vẫn chưa phải trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình…

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.br: Sua missão foi concluída. Seus pecados foram perdoados.
dialogsComplete.cns: 任务完成，你的罪恶已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Buße getan. Deine Sünden wurden dir vergeben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Questmu telah tercapai. Dosa-dosamu telah diampuni.
dialogsComplete.it: La Missione è terminata. I tuoi peccati sono stati perdonati.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 끝났습니다. 당신의 죄를 용서하지요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Боги одобрили твое деяние и простили тебе грехи.
dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น บาปของคุณได้รับการอภัยแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nhiệm vụ của bạn đã được hoàn thành. Tội lỗi của bạn đã được tha thứ.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

name.vi: Kịch bản vở kịch mất tích

description.en: Colar is hiding somewhere in Darkon 1. Find him and retrieve the play script.
description.ar: Colar is hiding somewhere in Darkon 1. Find him and retrieve the play script.
description.br: Colar está escondido em algum lugar de Darkon 1. Por favor, encontre-o e recupere o roteiro da peça para mim.
description.cns: 凯乐拉现在好像在达肯1附近，找到他之后，要回剧本。
description.de: Colar versteckt sich irgendwo bei Darkon 1, bitte finde ihn und bringe das Skript zurück.
description.fi: Colar is hiding somewhere in Darkon 1. Find him and retrieve the play script.
description.fil: Colar is hiding somewhere in Darkon 1. Find him and retrieve the play script.
description.fr: Trouver Colar, le voleur de la pièce de théâtre, qui se cache dans Darkon 1.
description.id: Colar bersembunyi di suatu tempat di Darkon 1. Temukan dia dan ambil naskah dramanya.
description.it: Colar is hiding somewhere in Darkon 1. Find him and retrieve the play script.
description.jp: 台本を盗んだ＜コラール＞は、キプラ（ダーコン第1地区）のどこかに隠れているらしい。ダーコンへ行って、コラールを探しにいこう。
description.kr: 콜라르가 다콘 제1지구 어딘가에 숨어있습니다. 콜라르를 잡아 사라진 대본을 되찾으세요.
description.nl: Colar is hiding somewhere in Darkon 1. Find him and retrieve the play script.
description.pl: Colar is hiding somewhere in Darkon 1. Find him and retrieve the play script.
description.ru: Нужно отыскать Колара в Дарконе-1 и вернуть похищенный сценарий.
description.sp: Colar se esconde en algún lugar de Darkon 1. Encuéntralo y recupera el guión de la obra.
description.sw: Colar is hiding somewhere in Darkon 1. Find him and retrieve the play script.
description.th: Colar ซ่อนตัวอยู่ที่ไหนสักแห่งใน Darkon 1 ค้นหาเขาและนำสคริปต์บทละครกลับคืนมา
description.tw: 凱樂拉現在好像在得肯 1 附近，找到他之後，要回劇本。
description.vi: Colar đang trốn ở đâu đó trong Darkon 1. Tìm anh ta và lấy kịch bản vở kịch.

dialogsBegin.en: Oh boy... I am in big trouble. How long have you been standing there? Did you hear everything I was saying?
dialogsBegin.ar: Oh boy... I am in big trouble. How long have you been standing there? Did you hear everything I was saying?
dialogsBegin.br: Oh... Estou muito encrencado. Ai! ai! Você estava aí? Você ouviu tudo o que eu estava dizendo?
dialogsBegin.cns: 啊..糟糕了..你什么时候来的啊?应该没有听到我说的话吧?
dialogsBegin.de: Oh... jetzt bin ich in Schwierigkeiten (überrascht) Ups! Hast du hier gestanden? hast du gehört, was ich gesagt habe?
dialogsBegin.fi: Oh boy... I am in big trouble. How long have you been standing there? Did you hear everything I was saying?
dialogsBegin.fil: Oh boy... I am in big trouble. How long have you been standing there? Did you hear everything I was saying?
dialogsBegin.fr: Oh..Je suis vraiment mal..(Etonné) Ca alors! Tu étais là? T'as entendu tout ce que je disais?
dialogsBegin.id: Astaga... Aku dalam masalah besar. Berapa lama kamu berdiri di sana? Apakah kamu mendengar semua yang aku katakan?
dialogsBegin.it: Oh boy... I am in big trouble. How long have you been standing there? Did you hear everything I was saying?
dialogsBegin.jp: ああ、どうしよう…困ったなぁ。わっ！ いつからそこにいたんだ？ひょっとして、ボクの喋ってたこと聞こえてたのかい？
dialogsBegin.kr: 아이고… 큰일 났네... 언제부터 거기 계셨던 거예요? 혹시 제가 한 말을 전부 들으신 건 아니죠?
dialogsBegin.nl: Oh boy... I am in big trouble. How long have you been standing there? Did you hear everything I was saying?
dialogsBegin.pl: Oh boy... I am in big trouble. How long have you been standing there? Did you hear everything I was saying?
dialogsBegin.ru: Ох, беда, беда… Что делать, ума не приложу... Эй! И давно ты подслушиваешь?
dialogsBegin.sp: Oh chico... estoy en un gran problema. ¿Cuánto tiempo has estado ahí parado? ¿Has escuchado todo lo que estaba diciendo?
dialogsBegin.sw: Oh boy... I am in big trouble. How long have you been standing there? Did you hear everything I was saying?
dialogsBegin.th: โอ้ เด็กน้อย... ฉันเจอปัญหาใหญ่แล้ว คุณยืนอยู่ที่นั่นนานแค่ไหน? คุณได้ยินทุกอย่างที่ฉันพูดไหม
dialogsBegin.tw: 啊…糟糕了…你什麼時候來的啊？應該沒有聽到我說的話吧？
dialogsBegin.vi: Ôi trời ... tôi đang gặp rắc rối lớn. Bạn đã đứng đó bao lâu rồi? Bạn đã nghe thấy tất cả những gì tôi đang nói chứ?

dialogsBegin.en: You heard? Hmm... Okay, I will tell you what happened. I am in charge of play scripts for the Pepoview Troupe.
dialogsBegin.ar: You heard? Hmm... Okay, I will tell you what happened. I am in charge of play scripts for the Pepoview Troupe.
dialogsBegin.br: Você ouviu? Hmm... Certo, eu vou lhe dizer o que aconteceu. Eu sou encarregado pelos roteiros das peças. Só que...
dialogsBegin.cns: You heard? Hmm... Okay, I will tell you what happened. I am in charge of play scripts for the Pepoview Troupe.
dialogsBegin.de: Du hast es gehört? Hmm... Okay, ich werde dir erzählen, was passiert ist. Ich bin für die Drehbücher der Tantalus-Truppe zuständig.
dialogsBegin.fi: You heard? Hmm... Okay, I will tell you what happened. I am in charge of play scripts for the Pepoview Troupe.
dialogsBegin.fil: You heard? Hmm... Okay, I will tell you what happened. I am in charge of play scripts for the Pepoview Troupe.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu as entendu? Hmm..Ok, je vais te dire ce qui est arrivé. Je suis responsable des manuscrits des pièces de théâtre. Mais..
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu dengar? Hmm.. Oke, aku akan memberitahumu apa yang terjadi. Aku bertanggung jawab atas skrip permainan untuk Pepoview Troupe.
dialogsBegin.it: You heard? Hmm... Okay, I will tell you what happened. I am in charge of play scripts for the Pepoview Troupe.
dialogsBegin.jp: そうか、聞こえちゃったのか…。実はボクは劇団の台本を管理しているんだ。ところが、今回準備している飛行劇＜蒼きマドリガルの空に＞という作品の台本が無くなってしまったんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 들으셨어요? 흠... 무슨 일이 있었는지 말씀드릴게요. 저는 페포뷰 극단의 연극 대본을 담당하고 있어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: You heard? Hmm... Okay, I will tell you what happened. I am in charge of play scripts for the Pepoview Troupe.
dialogsBegin.pl: You heard? Hmm... Okay, I will tell you what happened. I am in charge of play scripts for the Pepoview Troupe.
dialogsBegin.ru: You heard? Hmm... Okay, I will tell you what happened. I am in charge of play scripts for the Pepoview Troupe.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Has escuchado? Hmm... Está bien, te diré lo que ha pasado. Estoy a cargo de los guiones de la Compañía Pepoview.
dialogsBegin.sw: You heard? Hmm... Okay, I will tell you what happened. I am in charge of play scripts for the Pepoview Troupe.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณก็ได้ข่าวเหรอ อืม... ตกลง ฉันจะบอกคุณว่าเกิดอะไรขึ้น ฉันเป็นผู้รับผิดชอบบทละครของคณะละคร Pepoview
dialogsBegin.tw: 你聽說了？嗯……好吧，我來告訴你發生了什麼事。我負責帕佩劇團的劇本。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn đã nghe thấy rồi à? Hmm .. Được rồi, tôi sẽ kể cho bạn nghe chuyện gì đã xảy ra. Tôi phụ trách viết kịch bản cho vở Pepoview Troupe.

dialogsBegin.en: The new play script called The Sky of Madrigal has disappeared. If I don't get it back, I'll be fired.
dialogsBegin.ar: The new play script called The Sky of Madrigal has disappeared. If I don't get it back, I'll be fired.
dialogsBegin.br: O roteiro da nova peça, O Céu de Madrigal, desapareceu. Não sei o que fazer.. Serei despedido...
dialogsBegin.cns: 瑞加大陆的天空既然不见了。如果被团长知道了，我一定会被开除的。
dialogsBegin.de: Das neue Skript der Himmel Madrigals ist verschwunden. Ich weiß nicht, was ich tun soll.. Ich werde bestimmt entlassen..
dialogsBegin.fi: The new play script called The Sky of Madrigal has disappeared. If I don't get it back, I'll be fired.
dialogsBegin.fil: The new play script called The Sky of Madrigal has disappeared. If I don't get it back, I'll be fired.
dialogsBegin.fr: La dernière pièce, Les Cieux de Madrigal, a disparu. Je ne sais pas ce que je dois faire. On va me virer..
dialogsBegin.id: Naskah drama baru berjudul The Sky of Madrigal telah menghilang. Jika aku tidak mendapatkannya kembali, aku akan dipecat.
dialogsBegin.it: The new play script called The Sky of Madrigal has disappeared. If I don't get it back, I'll be fired.
dialogsBegin.jp: 台本がないと、練習すらできなくなってしまう。僕はもうどうしたら良いのかわからなくて、途方に暮れていたところなんだ。大事な台本をなくしてしまったなんてことを団長に知られたら！ああ、どうしよう。
dialogsBegin.kr: '마드리갈의 하늘'이라는 새 연극 대본이 사라졌어요. 대본을 못 찾으면, 전 해고당할지도 몰라요.
dialogsBegin.nl: The new play script called The Sky of Madrigal has disappeared. If I don't get it back, I'll be fired.
dialogsBegin.pl: The new play script called The Sky of Madrigal has disappeared. If I don't get it back, I'll be fired.
dialogsBegin.ru: Недавно нам принесли отличный сценарий - "Храп в мадригальскую ночь". Вот это вещь, скажу я тебе! И, видно, не один я так считаю, потому что его у нас украли…
dialogsBegin.sp: El nuevo guión llamado El Cielo de Madrigal ha desaparecido. Si no lo encuentro, me despedirán...
dialogsBegin.sw: The new play script called The Sky of Madrigal has disappeared. If I don't get it back, I'll be fired.
dialogsBegin.th: บทละครใหม่ชื่อ The Sky of Madrigal ได้หายไปแล้ว ถ้าฉันไม่หาคืนมา ฉันจะถูกไล่ออก
dialogsBegin.tw: 瑪德利賈的天空既然不見了，真的不知道要怎麼辦，如果被團長知道了，一定會被開除的…
dialogsBegin.vi: Kịch bản vở kịch mới mang tên Sky of Madrigal đã biến mất. Nếu tôi không lấy lại được, tôi sẽ bị đuổi việc.

dialogsBegin.en: I know who stole it. His name is Colar, and I think he did it as payback for being fired himself.
dialogsBegin.ar: I know who stole it. His name is Colar, and I think he did it as payback for being fired himself.
dialogsBegin.br: Na verdade, eu sei quem roubou. O nome dele é Colar, e eu acho que ele fez isso como vingança por ter sido despedido. Mas se eu for despedido...
dialogsBegin.cns: 我知道是谁偷的了，那个人叫凯乐拉，而且我认为他是为了报复自己被解雇才这么做的。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich weiß, wer es gestohlen hat. Sein Name ist Colar, und ich glaube, er hat es aus Rache getan, weil er selbst gefeuert wurde.
dialogsBegin.fi: I know who stole it. His name is Colar, and I think he did it as payback for being fired himself.
dialogsBegin.fil: I know who stole it. His name is Colar, and I think he did it as payback for being fired himself.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je sais exactement qui l'a volé. Il s'appelle Colar, et je pense que c'est une vengeance pour s'être fait renvoyer. Mais si je suis mis à la porte..
dialogsBegin.id: Aku tahu siapa yang mencurinya. Namanya Colar, dan aku pikir dia melakukannya sebagai balasan karena dipecat akibat ulahnya sendiri.
dialogsBegin.it: I know who stole it. His name is Colar, and I think he did it as payback for being fired himself.
dialogsBegin.jp: 実はね、犯人は誰か分かっているんだ。以前、団長に劇団を追放された＜コラール＞というやつなんだが、多分、追い出されたことに対する腹いせなんだろうと思うんだ。だけど、このままだと・・・・
dialogsBegin.kr: 사실 범인이 누구인지 알고 있어요 콜라르라는 녀석인데, 극단에서 쫓겨난 데 대한 앙갚음 같아요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I know who stole it. His name is Colar, and I think he did it as payback for being fired himself.
dialogsBegin.pl: I know who stole it. His name is Colar, and I think he did it as payback for being fired himself.
dialogsBegin.ru: I know who stole it. His name is Colar, and I think he did it as payback for being fired himself.
dialogsBegin.sp: En realidad se quien lo ha robado. Su nombre es Colar, le despidieron y creo que lo ha hecho por venganza.
dialogsBegin.sw: I know who stole it. His name is Colar, and I think he did it as payback for being fired himself.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันรู้ว่าใครขโมยมันไป ชื่อของเขาคือ Colar และฉันคิดว่าเขาทำเพื่อตอบแทนการถูกไล่ออก
dialogsBegin.tw: 其實，我知道誰是偷的，之前被團長開除的凱樂拉，可能是因為想對團長報復，所以才會做出這種事吧！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi biết ai đã lấy trộm nó. Tên anh ta là Colar, và tôi nghĩ anh ta đã làm điều đó như để trả thù vì bị sa thải.

dialogsBegin.en: Would you please do me a favor? Would you please bring me the play script from Colar?
dialogsBegin.ar: Would you please do me a favor? Would you please bring me the play script from Colar?
dialogsBegin.br: Então... Você poderia me fazer um favor? Você poderia recuperar o roteiro da peça que está com Colar?
dialogsBegin.cns: 其他人都会发现剧本不见的事情，可以帮我去找凯乐拉之后，帮我把剧本拿回来吗?
dialogsBegin.de: Jeder wird wissen, dass das Skript verschwunden ist.Tu mir bitte einen Gefallen und hole das Skript von Colar zurück.
dialogsBegin.fi: Would you please do me a favor? Would you please bring me the play script from Colar?
dialogsBegin.fil: Would you please do me a favor? Would you please bring me the play script from Colar?
dialogsBegin.fr: Tout le monde saura que le manuscrit a disparu. Hmm..Alors..Tu veux bien m'aider? Pourrais-tu reprendre ce manuscrit à Colar?
dialogsBegin.id: Maukah kamu membantuku? Maukah kamu membawakanku naskah drama dari Colar?
dialogsBegin.it: Would you please do me a favor? Would you please bring me the play script from Colar?
dialogsBegin.jp: 大事な台本を管理しているボクが、台本をなくしてしまったことがみんなに気づかれてしまうんだ。そこで、お願いがあるんだけど、ボクの代わりに＜コラール＞から台本を取り戻してもらえない？お願い、ボクを助けてくれよ～！
dialogsBegin.kr: 혹시 괜찮다면, 콜라르를 찾아가 대본을 돌려받아 주실래요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Would you please do me a favor? Would you please bring me the play script from Colar?
dialogsBegin.pl: Would you please do me a favor? Would you please bring me the play script from Colar?
dialogsBegin.ru: Я последним брал почитать пьесу, и Броди уволит меня, если я ее не верну… Пожалуйста, найди Колара и отбери у него сценарий, хорошо?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Me harías un favor? ¿Podrías traerme el guión de la obra de Colar?
dialogsBegin.sw: Would you please do me a favor? Would you please bring me the play script from Colar?
dialogsBegin.th: คุณช่วยฉันหน่อยได้ไหม คุณช่วยนำสคริปต์การเล่นจาก Colar มาให้ฉันได้ไหม
dialogsBegin.tw: 其他人都會發現劇本不見的事情，可以幫我去找凱樂拉之後，幫我把劇本拿回來嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn vui lòng giúp tôi một việc được không? Bạn mang giúp cho tôi kịch bản vở kịch từ Colar được không?

dialogsAccept.en: You will?! Thank you very much! Colar is hiding somewhere in the far east of Darkon 1. Please find him!
dialogsAccept.ar: You will?! Thank you very much! Colar is hiding somewhere in the far east of Darkon 1. Please find him!
dialogsAccept.br: Oh, muito obrigado! Colar está escondido em algum lugar em Darkon 1. Por favor, encontre-o.
dialogsAccept.cns: 啊，真的谢谢你!凯乐拉现在好像在达肯1附近。拜托你~一定要帮我找回来喔~
dialogsAccept.de: Oh vielen Dank. Colar versteckt sich irgendwo in Darkon 1.
dialogsAccept.fi: You will?! Thank you very much! Colar is hiding somewhere in the far east of Darkon 1. Please find him!
dialogsAccept.fil: You will?! Thank you very much! Colar is hiding somewhere in the far east of Darkon 1. Please find him!
dialogsAccept.fr: Oh, merci beaucoup! Colar se cache quelque part dans Darkon 1. S'il te plaît retrouve-le.
dialogsAccept.id: Kamu mau?! Terima kasih banyak! Colar bersembunyi di suatu tempat di timur jauh Darkon 1. Tolong temukan dia!
dialogsAccept.it: You will?! Thank you very much! Colar is hiding somewhere in the far east of Darkon 1. Please find him!
dialogsAccept.jp: 取り戻してきてくれるの？！ありがとう！台本を盗んだ＜コラール＞は、キプラ（ダーコン第1地区）のどこにに隠れて暮らしているらしい。どうか無事に台本を取り返してきて。頼んだよ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 도와주신다고요?! 정말 감사합니다! 콜라르는 다콘 제1지구 동쪽 끝 어딘가에 숨어 지내는 모양이에요. 꼭 찾아주세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: You will?! Thank you very much! Colar is hiding somewhere in the far east of Darkon 1. Please find him!
dialogsAccept.pl: You will?! Thank you very much! Colar is hiding somewhere in the far east of Darkon 1. Please find him!
dialogsAccept.ru: Большое спасибо! Колар прячется где-то на востоке от Даркона-1. Пожалуйста, найди его!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡¿Lo harás?! ¡Muchas gracias! Colar se esconde en algún lugar al este de Darkon 1. ¡Encuéntralo por favor!
dialogsAccept.sw: You will?! Thank you very much! Colar is hiding somewhere in the far east of Darkon 1. Please find him!
dialogsAccept.th: คุณจะทำเหรอ?! ขอบคุณมากๆ! Colar กำลังซ่อนตัวอยู่ที่ไหนสักแห่งในตะวันออกไกลของ Darkon 1 โปรดหาเขาให้พบ!
dialogsAccept.tw: 啊，真的謝謝你！凱樂拉現在好像在得肯 1 附近。拜託你~一定要幫我找回來喔~
dialogsAccept.vi: Bạn sẽ giúp chứ?! Cám ơn rất nhiều! Colar đang ẩn náu ở đâu đó vùng viễn đông của Darkon 1. Hãy tìm anh ta!

dialogsDecline.en: I knew you weren't going to help me. Why did I even tell you all of that?
dialogsDecline.ar: I knew you weren't going to help me. Why did I even tell you all of that?
dialogsDecline.br: E agora, o que farei...? Serei despedido...Oh... Ira de Shade! O que fiz para merecer isso?
dialogsDecline.cns: 我现在该怎么办呢?我一定会被开除的..
dialogsDecline.de: Was kann ich also tun ? ich werde gefeuert, oh Gott...
dialogsDecline.fi: I knew you weren't going to help me. Why did I even tell you all of that?
dialogsDecline.fil: I knew you weren't going to help me. Why did I even tell you all of that?
dialogsDecline.fr: Maintenant qu'est-ce que je peux faire..? Je vais me faire renvoyer...
dialogsDecline.id: Aku tahu kamu tidak akan membantuku. Kenapa aku memberitahumu semua itu?
dialogsDecline.it: I knew you weren't going to help me. Why did I even tell you all of that?
dialogsDecline.jp: どうしよう、こんなことがみんなに知られたら、ボクは劇団を追い出されてしまうかもしれない。ああ、本当に困ったなぁ。どうすれば…
dialogsDecline.kr: 그럴 줄 알았어요. 도와주지도 않을 건, 괜히 다 말했네요.
dialogsDecline.nl: I knew you weren't going to help me. Why did I even tell you all of that?
dialogsDecline.pl: I knew you weren't going to help me. Why did I even tell you all of that?
dialogsDecline.ru: И зачем я только с тобой поделился?.. Так и знал ведь, что не поможешь.
dialogsDecline.sp: Sabía que no me ibas a ayudar. ¿Por qué te he explicado todo esto?
dialogsDecline.sw: I knew you weren't going to help me. Why did I even tell you all of that?
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันรู้ว่าคุณจะไม่ช่วยฉัน ทำไมฉันถึงบอกคุณทั้งหมดนะ?
dialogsDecline.tw: 我現在該怎麼辦呢？我一定會被開除的…
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi biết bạn sẽ không giúp tôi. Tại sao tôi còn kể với bạn tất cả những điều đó?

dialogsComplete.en: What?! What play script? I don't have it, I swear!
dialogsComplete.ar: What?! What play script? I don't have it, I swear!
dialogsComplete.br: O que?! Que roteiro da peça? Eu não tenho, eu juro!
dialogsComplete.cns: 什么？什么剧本？我没有，我发誓！
dialogsComplete.de: Was?! Welches Drehbuch? Ich habe es nicht, ich schwöre!
dialogsComplete.fi: What?! What play script? I don't have it, I swear!
dialogsComplete.fil: What?! What play script? I don't have it, I swear!
dialogsComplete.fr: Hé! Je n'ai pas la pièce! Comment crois-tu que je vais faire?
dialogsComplete.id: Apa?! naskah drama apa? Aku tidak memilikinya, aku bersumpah!
dialogsComplete.it: What?! What play script? I don't have it, I swear!
dialogsComplete.jp: はい、たしかに私が＜コラール＞ですが。おや、あの台本を返してもらいにきたのですか？しかし、見てください。こんなところで、こんなボロボロの格好をした私が、大事な台本を持っているように見えますか？
dialogsComplete.kr: 뭐라고요?! 연극 대본이라니? 전 몰라요, 정말이에요!
dialogsComplete.nl: What?! What play script? I don't have it, I swear!
dialogsComplete.pl: What?! What play script? I don't have it, I swear!
dialogsComplete.ru: What?! What play script? I don't have it, I swear!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡¿Qué?! ¿Qué guión de obra? ¡Yo no lo tengo, te lo juro!
dialogsComplete.sw: What?! What play script? I don't have it, I swear!
dialogsComplete.th: อะไร?! สคริปต์การเล่นอะไร? ฉันไม่มีมัน ฉันสาบานได้!
dialogsComplete.tw: 喂…我才沒拿什麼劇本呢！我發誓！
dialogsComplete.vi: Gì?! Kịch bản vở kịch gì à? Tôi không có nó, tôi thề!

dialogsComplete.en: Well, yes. I stole it. A grave robber who was riding some kind of strange machine took it from me.
dialogsComplete.ar: Well, yes. I stole it. A grave robber who was riding some kind of strange machine took it from me.
dialogsComplete.br: Bem, sim. Eu o roubei. Mas o ladrão de túmulos que estava guiando uma máquina estranha o roubou de mim.
dialogsComplete.cns: 对对对！是我！我偷走了！但是我在逃亡到这里的时候，被一个强盗抢走了!
dialogsComplete.de: Nun...ja.... ich habe es gestohlen, doch ein Grabräuber, der auf einer komischen Maschine ritt, hat es mir weggenommen
dialogsComplete.fi: Well, yes. I stole it. A grave robber who was riding some kind of strange machine took it from me.
dialogsComplete.fil: Well, yes. I stole it. A grave robber who was riding some kind of strange machine took it from me.
dialogsComplete.fr: Bon, c'est vrai, je l'ai volé. Mais le pilleur de tombe qui était monté sur une machine étrange me l'a pris.
dialogsComplete.id: Baiklah. Aku mencurinya. Seorang perampok kuburan yang mengendarai semacam mesin aneh mengambilnya dariku.
dialogsComplete.it: Well, yes. I stole it. A grave robber who was riding some kind of strange machine took it from me.
dialogsComplete.jp: 私が台本を盗んだのは事実です。しかし、台本を持って逃げる途中、変なロボットに乗った盗賊にかばんごと奪われてしまったのです！
dialogsComplete.kr: 그래요, 사실 훔쳤어요. 그런데 다른 도굴꾼이 이상한 기계를 타고 나타나선, 대본을 빼앗아 갔어요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Well, yes. I stole it. A grave robber who was riding some kind of strange machine took it from me.
dialogsComplete.pl: Well, yes. I stole it. A grave robber who was riding some kind of strange machine took it from me.
dialogsComplete.ru: Ладно, ладно. Сознаюсь. Да, я стащил сценарий у этих горе-актеров и спрятался в лесу, а потом… Ох, вспоминать страшно… Раздался грохот… Затрещали деревья… Задрожала земля… Я бросился наутек…
dialogsComplete.sp: Bueno, sí. Lo robé. Pero me lo quitó un ladrón de tumbas que estaba montado en una especie de máquina extraña.
dialogsComplete.sw: Well, yes. I stole it. A grave robber who was riding some kind of strange machine took it from me.
dialogsComplete.th: ใช่ ฉันขโมยมัน โจรหลุมฝังศพที่ขี่เครื่องจักรแปลกๆ บางอย่างได้เอามันไปจากฉัน
dialogsComplete.tw: 當然我我偷走了！但是在逃亡到這裡的時候，被一個怪物搶走了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Vâng, vâng. Tôi đã lấy trộm nó. Một tên cướp mộ đang cưỡi một loại máy kì lạ đã lấy nó đi từ tôi.

dialogsComplete.en: The machine was spouting steam and the grave robber was riding and controlling it. That is why I am in this terrible situation now.
dialogsComplete.ar: The machine was spouting steam and the grave robber was riding and controlling it. That is why I am in this terrible situation now.
dialogsComplete.br: A máquina estava esguichando vapor... E o ladrão de túmulos estava dirigindo e controlando a máquina. É por isso que agora estou nesta situação terrível.
dialogsComplete.cns: 是一个能发出蒸气的机器，强盗就骑在它身上驾驶着它！这就是为什么我现在处于这种可怕的境地！
dialogsComplete.de: Die Maschine spuckte Dampf und er kontrollierte sie, darum bin ich jetzt in dieser Lage.
dialogsComplete.fi: The machine was spouting steam and the grave robber was riding and controlling it. That is why I am in this terrible situation now.
dialogsComplete.fil: The machine was spouting steam and the grave robber was riding and controlling it. That is why I am in this terrible situation now.
dialogsComplete.fr: La machine crachait de la fumée.. Et le pilleur de tombe la conduisait. C'est pour ça que je suis dans une telle situation en ce moment.
dialogsComplete.id: Mesin itu menyemburkan uap dan perampok kuburan itu mengendarai dan mengendalikannya. Itulah mengapa aku berada dalam situasi yang mengerikan ini sekarang.
dialogsComplete.it: The machine was spouting steam and the grave robber was riding and controlling it. That is why I am in this terrible situation now.
dialogsComplete.jp: 蒸気を噴き出す変なロボットだったのですが、盗賊はその上に乗ってロボットを操っていました。しつこく追い回されて、こんなところに迷い込んでしまったあげく、見ての通り閉じ込められてボロボロの格好です…とほほ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 스팀을 뿜는 이상한 기계였는데, 도굴꾼이 그 위에 올라타 조종하고 있었어요. 그 일 때문에 제가 이런 신세가 된 거고요.
dialogsComplete.nl: The machine was spouting steam and the grave robber was riding and controlling it. That is why I am in this terrible situation now.
dialogsComplete.pl: The machine was spouting steam and the grave robber was riding and controlling it. That is why I am in this terrible situation now.
dialogsComplete.ru: Но адская машина меня настигла. От нее во все стороны валил пар. Наверху восседал ужасный маленький человечек. Он хохотал как безумный…
dialogsComplete.sp: La máquina echaba vapor y el ladrón de tumbas la controlaba desde arriba. Es por eso que estoy en esta terrible situación.
dialogsComplete.sw: The machine was spouting steam and the grave robber was riding and controlling it. That is why I am in this terrible situation now.
dialogsComplete.th: เครื่องจักรกำลังพ่นไอน้ำและโจรหลุมฝังศพกำลังขี่และควบคุมมัน นั่นคือเหตุผลที่ฉันอยู่ในสถานการณ์ที่เลวร้ายในขณะนี้
dialogsComplete.tw: 那台機器不停噴出蒸氣，盜墓賊就騎在上面操控它。我現在才會落到這種悲慘的處境。
dialogsComplete.vi: Cỗ máy đang phun ra hơi nước và kẻ cướp mộ đang cưỡi và điều khiển nó. Đó là lý do tại sao bây giờ tôi đang ở trong tình trạng khủng khiếp.

dialogsFail.en: All I know is that he is somewhere in the far east of Darkon 1. Please find him.
dialogsFail.ar: All I know is that he is somewhere in the far east of Darkon 1. Please find him.
dialogsFail.br: Tudo o que sei é que ele está em algum lugar de Darkon 1. Por favor, encontre-o.
dialogsFail.cns: 我知道他在达肯1，其他的我就不知道了，麻烦你去找一下吧!
dialogsFail.de: Ich weiß nur, dass er irgendwo in der Nähe von Darkon 1 ist, bitte finde ihn.
dialogsFail.fi: All I know is that he is somewhere in the far east of Darkon 1. Please find him.
dialogsFail.fil: All I know is that he is somewhere in the far east of Darkon 1. Please find him.
dialogsFail.fr: Tout ce que je sais c'est qu'il est quelque part à Darkon1. Trouve-le s'il te plaît.
dialogsFail.id: Yang aku tahu adalah dia ada di suatu tempat di timur jauh Darkon 1. Tolong temukan dia.
dialogsFail.it: All I know is that he is somewhere in the far east of Darkon 1. Please find him.
dialogsFail.jp: 残念ながら、台本が奪われた場所はキプラ（ダーコン第1地区）ということしか覚えていないのです。とにかく、あの恐ろしいロボットから逃げきることで必死でしたから。手ががりが少なくて大変でしょうけど、無事に台本を取り戻してきてください。お願いします。
dialogsFail.kr: 그가 다콘 제1지구 동쪽 어딘가 있다는 것만 알고 있어요. 부디 찾아주세요.
dialogsFail.nl: All I know is that he is somewhere in the far east of Darkon 1. Please find him.
dialogsFail.pl: All I know is that he is somewhere in the far east of Darkon 1. Please find him.
dialogsFail.ru: Я так испугался, что отдал ему все - и деньги, и котомку с вещами, где лежал твой сценарий! Он уехал на восток от Даркона-1. Больше я ничего не знаю!
dialogsFail.sp: Todo lo que sé es que está en algún lugar al este de Darkon 1. Por favor, encuéntralo.
dialogsFail.sw: All I know is that he is somewhere in the far east of Darkon 1. Please find him.
dialogsFail.th: ทั้งหมดที่ฉันรู้คือเขาอยู่ที่ไหนสักแห่งในตะวันออกไกลของ Darkon 1 โปรดหาเขาให้พบ
dialogsFail.tw: 我知道他在得肯 1，其他的我就不知道了，麻煩你去找一下吧！
dialogsFail.vi: Tất cả những gì tôi biết là anh ta đang ở đâu đó ở vùng viễn đông của Darkon 1. Hãy tìm anh ta.

description.en: You can collect them from Meteonyker. I heard it's in Dekane Dungeon. Be careful, the Meteonyker is very strong! It's  best if you go with a party!
description.ar: You can collect them from Meteonyker. I heard it's in Dekane Dungeon. Be careful, the Meteonyker is very strong! It's  best if you go with a party!
description.br: Você pode coletá-los de Meteonyker. Ouvi dizer que ele está na Mina Dekane. Tome cuidado! O Meteonyker é muito forte! É melhor você formar um grupo para ir!
description.cns: 你可以从达肯矿洞里的飞龙处获取这些物品。但是请小心，飞龙非常强大！
description.de: Du kannst sie von Meteonyker sammeln. Ich habe gehört, dass er sich im Dekane Dungeon befindet. Sei vorsichtig, der Meteonyker ist sehr stark! Es ist am besten, wenn du mit einer Gruppe gehst!
description.fi: You can collect them from Meteonyker. I heard it's in Dekane Dungeon. Be careful, the Meteonyker is very strong! It's  best if you go with a party!
description.fil: Makukuha mo ang mga ito mula sa Meteonyker. Narinig kong nasa Dekane Dungeon ito. Mag-ingat, napakalakas ng Meteonyker! Mas mabuti kung sasama ka sa party!
description.fr: Vous les trouverez sur corps des Meteonyker dans la mine de Dekanes. Attention, ils sont très forts ! Tu devrais créer un groupe pour t'aider.
description.id: Kamu dapat mengumpulkannya dari Meteonyker. Aku dengar, mereka berada di Dekane Dungeon. Berhati-hatilah, Meteonyker sangatlah kuat! Aku sangat menyarankan agar kamu membentuk Party sebelum kesana!
description.it: You can collect them from Meteonyker. I heard it's in Dekane Dungeon. Be careful, the Meteonyker is very strong! It's  best if you go with a party!
description.jp: メテオニカが持っています。よろしくおねがいしますです。
description.kr: 메테오니커는 데카네 던전에 있다고 들었어요. 정말 강력하니까, 극단을 꾸려서 함께 가는 게 좋아요! 조심하세요!
description.nl: You can collect them from Meteonyker. I heard it's in Dekane Dungeon. Be careful, the Meteonyker is very strong! It's  best if you go with a party!
description.pl: You can collect them from Meteonyker. I heard it's in Dekane Dungeon. Be careful, the Meteonyker is very strong! It's  best if you go with a party!
description.ru: You can collect them from Meteonyker. I heard it's in Dekane Dungeon. Be careful, the Meteonyker is very strong! It's  best if you go with a party!
description.sp: Los puedes conseguir derrotando al Meteonyker. Escuché que está en la Mina Dekane. ¡Ten cuidado! ¡El Meteonyker es muy fuerte! ¡Mejor que vayas con más gente!
description.sw: You can collect them from Meteonyker. I heard it's in Dekane Dungeon. Be careful, the Meteonyker is very strong! It's  best if you go with a party!
description.th: คุณสามารถรวบรวมได้จาก Meteonyker ฉันได้ยินมาว่ามันอยู่ใน Dekane Dungeon ระวังนะ Meteonyker แข็งแกร่งมาก! ถ้าคุณไปกับปาร์ตี้จะดีกว่า!
description.tw: 你可以從地炎飛龍收集它們。我聽說它在迪坎礦坑副本。小心，地炎飛龍非常強大！參加劇團是最好的辦法！
description.vi: Bạn có thể thu thập chúng từ Meteonyker. Tôi nghe nói nó ở Dekane Dungeon. Hãy cẩn thận, Meteonyker rất mạnh! Thật tuyệt nếu bạn đi cùng một bữa tiệc!
