dialogsBegin.en: Sorry, I'm busy looking for someone so hurry… What did you say? YOU are the hero Reonan spoke of!? I imagined you to look, oh… a tad more heroic?
dialogsBegin.ar: Sorry, I'm busy looking for someone so hurry… What did you say? YOU are the hero Reonan spoke of!? I imagined you to look, oh… a tad more heroic?
dialogsBegin.br: Desculpe, estou ocupada… Tenho que encontrar uma pessoa depressa... O que você disse? VOCÊ é o herói que Reonan falou!? Eu imaginei você fosse, hm... talvez um pouco mais heroico?
dialogsBegin.cns: 抱歉，我现在非常着急寻找某个人... 你说什么？你就是瑞尔南说的那位英雄吗！？我想象中的你会看起来...比较英勇？
dialogsBegin.de: Tut mir leid, ich bin damit beschäftigt, jemanden zu suchen, also beeil dich... Was hast du gesagt? Du bist der Held, von dem Reonan sprach!? Ich hatte dich mir... ein bisschen heldenhafter vorgestellt?
dialogsBegin.fi: Sorry, I'm busy looking for someone so hurry… What did you say? YOU are the hero Reonan spoke of!? I imagined you to look, oh… a tad more heroic?
dialogsBegin.fil: Sorry, I'm busy looking for someone so hurry… What did you say? YOU are the hero Reonan spoke of!? I imagined you to look, oh… a tad more heroic?
dialogsBegin.fr: C'est bizarre je vous imaginais faisant 2m de haut et avec des biscottos mais vous avez l'air plutôt faible en fait.
dialogsBegin.id: Maaf, aku sibuk mencari seseorang jadi cepatlah... Apa yang kamu katakan? KAMU adalah pahlawan yang dibicarakan Reonan!? Aku kira penampilanmu akan terlihat... sedikit lebih heroik?
dialogsBegin.it: Sorry, I'm busy looking for someone so hurry… What did you say? YOU are the hero Reonan spoke of!? I imagined you to look, oh… a tad more heroic?
dialogsBegin.jp: あら？　貴方が噂の冒険者様ですか。むむ……思ったよりも華奢な方なんですね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 죄송해요, 누굴 찾느라 바빠서요, 얼른... 뭐라고 하셨죠? 레오난이 언급한 영웅이 당신이라고요!? 오... 생각한 것보다 영웅 같지 않은데요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Sorry, I'm busy looking for someone so hurry… What did you say? YOU are the hero Reonan spoke of!? I imagined you to look, oh… a tad more heroic?
dialogsBegin.pl: Sorry, I'm busy looking for someone so hurry… What did you say? YOU are the hero Reonan spoke of!? I imagined you to look, oh… a tad more heroic?
dialogsBegin.ru: Я очень-очень занята... Что ты сказал? ТЫ тот самый герой? Я думала он должен выглядеть более... эмм... по-геройски..
dialogsBegin.sp: Lo siento, estoy ocupado buscando a alguien así que date prisa… ¿Cómo dices? ¿¡TÚ eres el héroe del que habla Reonan!? Te imaginaba un poco más, hmm... ¿heroico?
dialogsBegin.sw: Sorry, I'm busy looking for someone so hurry… What did you say? YOU are the hero Reonan spoke of!? I imagined you to look, oh… a tad more heroic?
dialogsBegin.th: ขอโทษ ฉันกำลังยุ่งอยู่กับการมองหาใครสักคน รีบเลย... คุณพูดว่าอะไรนะ? คุณคือฮีโร่ที่ Reonan พูดถึง!? ฉันจินตนาการว่าคุณจะดูโอ้… กล้าหาญกว่านี้หน่อยไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 對不起，我正忙著找人，所以著急……你說什麼？你就是雷奧南所說的英雄！？我想像你看起來，哦……更英勇一點？
dialogsBegin.vi: Xin lỗi, tôi đang bận tìm người nên vội ... Bạn nói gì? BẠN là người hùng mà Reonan đã nói đến !? Tôi đã tưởng tượng bạn trông, ồ… anh hùng hơn một chút?

dialogsBegin.en: Well, where are my manners? Heh. Welcome to Saint City, the biggest town of Madrigal, supplier of airships and… oh sorry, you probably don't care about any of this!
dialogsBegin.ar: Well, where are my manners? Heh. Welcome to Saint City, the biggest town of Madrigal, supplier of airships and… oh sorry, you probably don't care about any of this!
dialogsBegin.br: Bem, onde estão minhas maneiras? Heh. Bem-vindo(a) a Cidade de Saint, a maior de Madrigal, fornecedora de barcos e... heh desculpa, você provavelmente não se importa com nada disso!
dialogsBegin.cns: 好吧，是我失礼了。哈。欢迎来到瑞加大陆上最大的城镇晨光镇，这里是飞船的产地并且还是... 噢，抱歉，我想你对这些应该不太感兴趣！
dialogsBegin.de: Nun, wo sind meine Manieren? Hehe. Willkommen in Saint City, der größten Stadt von Madrigal, Lieferant von Luftschiffen und... ach, tut mir leid, das interessiert Sie wahrscheinlich alles nicht!
dialogsBegin.fi: Well, where are my manners? Heh. Welcome to Saint City, the biggest town of Madrigal, supplier of airships and… oh sorry, you probably don't care about any of this!
dialogsBegin.fil: Well, where are my manners? Heh. Welcome to Saint City, the biggest town of Madrigal, supplier of airships and… oh sorry, you probably don't care about any of this!
dialogsBegin.fr: Quoi qu'il en soit, bienvenue à Saincity. Les monstres de la région sont plus forts que ceux que vous avez rencontré jusqu'ici.
dialogsBegin.id: Maafkan atas ketidaksopananku. Omong-omong, selamat datang di Saint City, kota terbesar di Madrigal, pemasok dari Airship dan... oh maaf, kamu mungkin tidak terlalu peduli soal ini!
dialogsBegin.it: Well, where are my manners? Heh. Welcome to Saint City, the biggest town of Madrigal, supplier of airships and… oh sorry, you probably don't care about any of this!
dialogsBegin.jp: 改めまして、ようこそ！　セイントモーニングへ！　この街はフラリスと比べて広大でしょう？　それだけ問題も多いんですよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 아, 실례되는 말을 했네요. 마드리갈에서 가장 큰 도시, 세인트 시티에 오신 걸 환영합니다! 비행선을 공급하는 도시이기도 하고... 아, 이런 말은 관심 없으시겠죠!
dialogsBegin.nl: Well, where are my manners? Heh. Welcome to Saint City, the biggest town of Madrigal, supplier of airships and… oh sorry, you probably don't care about any of this!
dialogsBegin.pl: Cóż, gdzie są moje maniery? Heh. Witamy w Saint City, największym mieście Madrigal, dostawcy sterowców i… przepraszam, prawdopodobnie nie obchodzi cię to wszystko!
dialogsBegin.ru: Извини, где мои манеры... Добро пожаловать в Санто, крупнейший город Мадригала, а так же верфь по постройке летающих кораблей... Ой, прости... Думаю, тебе сейчас совсем не до экскурсии!
dialogsBegin.sp: Bueno, ¿dónde están mis modales? Jeje. Bienvenido a Saint, la ciudad más grande de Madrigal, proveedora de aeronaves y... ¡oh, lo siento, puede que no te interese nada de esto!
dialogsBegin.sw: Well, where are my manners? Heh. Welcome to Saint City, the biggest town of Madrigal, supplier of airships and… oh sorry, you probably don't care about any of this!
dialogsBegin.th: มารยาทของฉันอยู่ที่ไหน เฮ้ ยินดีต้อนรับสู่ Saint City เมืองที่ใหญ่ที่สุดของ Madrigal ผู้จัดหาเรือบินและ… ขออภัย คุณอาจไม่สนใจเรื่องนี้!
dialogsBegin.tw: 好吧，我的禮貌在哪裡？呵呵。歡迎來到聖音特，瑪德利賈大的城鎮，飛艇供應商…哦，對不起，你可能不關心這些！
dialogsBegin.vi: Chà, cách cư xử của tôi ở đâu? Hì hì. Chào mừng bạn đến với Thành phố Saint, thị trấn lớn nhất của Madrigal, nhà cung cấp khí cầu và… ôi xin lỗi, bạn có thể không quan tâm đến bất kỳ điều gì trong số này!

dialogsBegin.en: Reonan DID send you here for more than listening to me ramble about our town, but hey! I'm a tour guide, it's what I do! Anyway! The mayor requests your presence. Please speak with him.
dialogsBegin.ar: Reonan DID send you here for more than listening to me ramble about our town, but hey! I'm a tour guide, it's what I do! Anyway! The mayor requests your presence. Please speak with him.
dialogsBegin.br: Reonan enviou você aqui para MAIS do que apenas me ouvir falar sobre a nossa cidade, mas hey! Sou uma guia turística, é o que faço! De qualquer forma. O prefeito pede sua presença. Por favor, fale com ele.
dialogsBegin.cns: 瑞尔南派你来到这里不是为了听我碎碎念关于晨光镇的事情的，不过，嘿！我是一个旅游向导，这就是我的工作！不管怎样！市长想要见你。请你前去与他谈一谈。
dialogsBegin.de: Reonan hat euch nicht nur deshalb hergeschickt, damit ihr mir beim Erzählen über unsere Stadt zuhört, aber hey! Ich bin ein Reiseleiter, das ist mein Job! Wie auch immer! Der Bürgermeister bittet um Ihre Anwesenheit. Bitte sprecht mit ihm.
dialogsBegin.fi: Reonan DID send you here for more than listening to me ramble about our town, but hey! I'm a tour guide, it's what I do! Anyway! The mayor requests your presence. Please speak with him.
dialogsBegin.fil: Reonan DID send you here for more than listening to me ramble about our town, but hey! I'm a tour guide, it's what I do! Anyway! The mayor requests your presence. Please speak with him.
dialogsBegin.fr: Voilà tout est dit. Vous n'avez plus qu'à aller parler à notre maire adoré.
dialogsBegin.id: Reonan MUNGKIN mengirimmu kesini bukan untuk mendengarkan ocehanku, tapi mau bagaimana lagi! aku adalah pemandu wisata, mengoceh adalah keseharianku! oh iya, Mayor mengundangmu, mohon temui dia.
dialogsBegin.it: Reonan DID send you here for more than listening to me ramble about our town, but hey! I'm a tour guide, it's what I do! Anyway! The mayor requests your presence. Please speak with him.
dialogsBegin.jp: そうだ、ここで与太話している暇なんてなかったんです。すぐそちらに市長がおります。何やら貴方に依頼したいことがあるようですよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 레오난이 단순히 마을 이야기나 듣고 오라고 당신을 이리로 보낸 건 아니겠죠. 하지만 뭐, 저는 가이드라 떠드는 게 일이랍니다! 어쨌든, 시장님이 당신을 찾고 계세요. 꼭 가서 말씀 나눠보세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Reonan DID send you here for more than listening to me ramble about our town, but hey! I'm a tour guide, it's what I do! Anyway! The mayor requests your presence. Please speak with him.
dialogsBegin.pl: Reonan DID send you here for more than listening to me ramble about our town, but hey! I'm a tour guide, it's what I do! Anyway! The mayor requests your presence. Please speak with him.
dialogsBegin.ru: Максимус явно не прохлаждаться тебя прислал. Но я всё-таки местный гид... Так вот! Мэр хочет встретиться с тобой. Пожалуйста, найди его.
dialogsBegin.sp: Reonan te ha enviado aquí para algo más que escucharme divagar sobre nuestra ciudad, pero ¡oye! Soy una guía turística, ¡es lo que hago! ¡En fin! El alcalde solicita tu presencia. Por favor, habla con él.
dialogsBegin.sw: Reonan DID send you here for more than listening to me ramble about our town, but hey! I'm a tour guide, it's what I do! Anyway! The mayor requests your presence. Please speak with him.
dialogsBegin.th: Reonan ไม่ได้ส่งคุณมาที่นี่มากกว่าฟังฉันบ่นเกี่ยวกับเมืองของเรา แต่เดี๋ยวก่อน! ฉันเป็นมัคคุเทศก์ มันคือสิ่งที่ฉันทำ! อย่างไรก็ตาม! นายกเทศมนตรีขอแสดงตนของคุณ กรุณาพูดคุยกับเขา
dialogsBegin.tw: 雷奧南派你來這裡不僅僅是為了聽我閒聊我們的小鎮，但是，嘿！我是導遊，這就是我的工作！反正！市長請求你出席。請和他談談。
dialogsBegin.vi: Reonan DID gửi cho bạn ở đây nhiều hơn là nghe tôi nói lan man về thị trấn của chúng ta, nhưng này! Tôi là một hướng dẫn viên du lịch, đó là những gì tôi làm! Dẫu sao thì! Thị trưởng yêu cầu sự hiện diện của bạn. Hãy nói chuyện với anh ấy.

dialogsAccept.en: The Mayor of Saint City is standing behind me. He'll inform you more of the situation at hand!
dialogsAccept.ar: The Mayor of Saint City is standing behind me. He'll inform you more of the situation at hand!
dialogsAccept.br: O Prefeito da Cidade está logo atrás de mim. Ele irá informar mais sobre a situação em questão para você!
dialogsAccept.cns: 晨光市长就在我后面。他会告诉你更多我们目前所拥有的信息！
dialogsAccept.de: Der Bürgermeister von Saint City steht hinter mir. Er wird Sie über die aktuelle Situation informieren!
dialogsAccept.fi: The Mayor of Saint City is standing behind me. He'll inform you more of the situation at hand!
dialogsAccept.fil: The Mayor of Saint City is standing behind me. He'll inform you more of the situation at hand!
dialogsAccept.fr: Le maire de Saincity est un homme très occupé. Ne lui faites pas perdre son temps.
dialogsAccept.id: Orang dibelakangku ini adalah Mayor of Saint City. Dialah yang akan menjelaskan padamu lebih detail tentang situasi saat ini!
dialogsAccept.it: The Mayor of Saint City is standing behind me. He'll inform you more of the situation at hand!
dialogsAccept.jp: ああ……最近、市長はあまりにお悩みのせいか白髪も増えてしまいまして……どうか力になってあげて下さい。
dialogsAccept.kr: 세인트 시티 시장님은 제 뒤쪽에 계세요. 지금 세인트 시티의 상황에 대해 더 자세히 설명해 주실 거예요!
dialogsAccept.nl: The Mayor of Saint City is standing behind me. He'll inform you more of the situation at hand!
dialogsAccept.pl: The Mayor of Saint City is standing behind me. He'll inform you more of the situation at hand!
dialogsAccept.ru: Мэр Санто стоит где-то неподалёку. Он объяснит тебе положение дел в городе.
dialogsAccept.sp: El Alcalde de Saint está detrás de mí. ¡Él te dará más detalles de la situación actual!
dialogsAccept.sw: The Mayor of Saint City is standing behind me. He'll inform you more of the situation at hand!
dialogsAccept.th: นายกเทศมนตรีเมืองเซนต์กำลังยืนอยู่ข้างหลังฉัน เขาจะแจ้งให้คุณทราบเพิ่มเติมเกี่ยวกับสถานการณ์ในมือ!
dialogsAccept.tw: 聖音特市長站在我身後。他會告訴你更多目前的情況！
dialogsAccept.vi: Thị trưởng thành phố Saint đang đứng sau lưng tôi. Anh ấy sẽ thông báo cho bạn biết thêm về tình hình hiện tại!

dialogsDecline.en: Don't feel like it? Just don't expect me to babysit you all day long! I'm a busy gal ya know!
dialogsDecline.ar: Don't feel like it? Just don't expect me to babysit you all day long! I'm a busy gal ya know!
dialogsDecline.br: Não tá afim? Só não espere que eu cuide de você o dia todo! Eu sou uma garota ocupada, saca?!
dialogsDecline.cns: 你不喜欢它吗？那也不要指望我能照顾你一整天！我可是个忙碌的女孩呢！
dialogsDecline.de: Sie haben keine Lust? Erwarte nur nicht, dass ich den ganzen Tag auf dich aufpasse! Ich bin ein vielbeschäftigtes Mädchen, weißt du!
dialogsDecline.fi: Don't feel like it? Just don't expect me to babysit you all day long! I'm a busy gal ya know!
dialogsDecline.fil: Don't feel like it? Just don't expect me to babysit you all day long! I'm a busy gal ya know!
dialogsDecline.fr: Et vous vous prétendez un héros…
dialogsDecline.id: Tidak suka? Jangan harap aku akan menjagamu sepanjang hari! Aku gadis yang sibuk kau tahu!
dialogsDecline.it: Don't feel like it? Just don't expect me to babysit you all day long! I'm a busy gal ya know!
dialogsDecline.jp: そうですか……やはり私の待っている方は貴方ではなかったようですね。冷やかしはお断りですよ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 싫다고요? 그렇다면 저도 따라다니며 챙겨 드릴 순 없겠네요! 저도 바쁜 사람이거든요!
dialogsDecline.nl: Don't feel like it? Just don't expect me to babysit you all day long! I'm a busy gal ya know!
dialogsDecline.pl: Don't feel like it? Just don't expect me to babysit you all day long! I'm a busy gal ya know!
dialogsDecline.ru: Don't feel like it? Just don't expect me to babysit you all day long! I'm a busy gal ya know!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿No te apetece? ¡No esperes que te vaya detrás todo el día! ¡Soy una chica ocupada, ya sabes!
dialogsDecline.sw: Don't feel like it? Just don't expect me to babysit you all day long! I'm a busy gal ya know!
dialogsDecline.th: ไม่รู้สึกอย่างนั้นหรือ? อย่าคาดหวังให้ฉันดูแลคุณทั้งวันเลย! ฉันเป็นคนยุ่งนะรู้ยัง!
dialogsDecline.tw: 不喜歡嗎？只是別指望我整天照顧你！我是一個忙碌的女孩你知道！
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn không cảm thấy thích nó? Chỉ cần không mong đợi tôi sẽ trông con suốt ngày! Bạn biết không tôi là một cô gái bận rộn!

dialogsComplete.en: Ah! So you must be the famed hero of Flaris I've heard so much about? I guess I owe you my thanks already for making the trip to Saint City.
dialogsComplete.ar: Ah! So you must be the famed hero of Flaris I've heard so much about? I guess I owe you my thanks already for making the trip to Saint City.
dialogsComplete.br: Ah! Então você deve ser o famoso herói de Flaris de quem tanto ouvi falar? Acho que já devo a você meus agradecimentos por ter vindo para a nossa cidade.
dialogsComplete.cns: 哈！你一定就是帕里那位声名远扬的英雄吧？我很感谢你能来一趟晨光。
dialogsComplete.de: Ah! Sie müssen also der berühmte Held von Flaris sein, von dem ich schon so viel gehört habe? Ich schätze, ich schulde Euch bereits meinen Dank dafür, dass Ihr die Reise nach Saint City gemacht habt.
dialogsComplete.fi: Ah! So you must be the famed hero of Flaris I've heard so much about? I guess I owe you my thanks already for making the trip to Saint City.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ah! So you must be the famed hero of Flaris I've heard so much about? I guess I owe you my thanks already for making the trip to Saint City.
dialogsComplete.fr: Vous êtes le Champion de Flarine ?
dialogsComplete.id: Ah! Jadi kamu Hero of Flaris yang selama ini kudengar? Aku rasa aku harus berterimakasih padamu karena telah menyempatkan waktumu untuk mampir ke Saint City.
dialogsComplete.it: Ah! So you must be the famed hero of Flaris I've heard so much about? I guess I owe you my thanks already for making the trip to Saint City.
dialogsComplete.jp: おお！　貴方はフラリスで噂の冒険者様ですね。
dialogsComplete.kr: 아! 혹시 소문으로만 듣던 그 유명한 플라리스의 영웅님이신가? 세인트 시티까지 와주시다니, 정말 감사드립니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Ah! So you must be the famed hero of Flaris I've heard so much about? I guess I owe you my thanks already for making the trip to Saint City.
dialogsComplete.pl: Ah! So you must be the famed hero of Flaris I've heard so much about? I guess I owe you my thanks already for making the trip to Saint City.
dialogsComplete.ru: О! Ты наверное тот самый герой Фларинции, слухи о котором дошли до меня? Думаю, я уже должен поблагодарить тебя за поездку в наш город.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Ay! ¿Tú eres el famoso héroe de Flaris del que tanto he oído hablar? Supongo que ya te debo las gracias por hacer el viaje hasta aquí.
dialogsComplete.sw: Ah! So you must be the famed hero of Flaris I've heard so much about? I guess I owe you my thanks already for making the trip to Saint City.
dialogsComplete.th: อา! คุณต้องเป็นฮีโร่ที่มีชื่อเสียงของ Flaris ที่ฉันเคยได้ยินมามากใช่หรือไม่? ฉันคิดว่าฉันเป็นหนี้บุญคุณคุณที่เดินทางไป Saint City
dialogsComplete.tw: 啊！所以你一定是我耳熟能詳的布拉里斯的著名英雄吧？我想我已經感謝你來聖音特旅行了。
dialogsComplete.vi: Ah! Vậy chắc hẳn bạn là người hùng nổi tiếng của Flaris mà tôi đã nghe rất nhiều về? Tôi đoán tôi nợ bạn lời cảm ơn của tôi vì đã thực hiện chuyến đi đến Thành phố Saint.

dialogsFail.en: What? Lost? The Mayor is right behind me. Apparently your vision is as bad as Reonan's choice in heroes.
dialogsFail.ar: What? Lost? The Mayor is right behind me. Apparently your vision is as bad as Reonan's choice in heroes.
dialogsFail.br: Quee?! Perdido(a)? O prefeito está bem atrás de mim. Aparentemente, sua visão é tão ruim quanto a escolha de Reonan para heróis.
dialogsFail.cns: 什么？这你都找不到吗？市长就在我身后。显然你的眼睛和瑞尔南选择英雄的眼光一样差劲。
dialogsFail.de: Was? Verloren? Der Bürgermeister ist direkt hinter mir. Offenbar ist deine Sehkraft so schlecht wie Reonans Wahl der Helden.
dialogsFail.fi: What? Lost? The Mayor is right behind me. Apparently your vision is as bad as Reonan's choice in heroes.
dialogsFail.fil: What? Lost? The Mayor is right behind me. Apparently your vision is as bad as Reonan's choice in heroes.
dialogsFail.fr: Il est juste là sur la place de la ville, ne le faites pas attendre.
dialogsFail.id: Apa? Hilang? Pak Mayor tepat di belakangku. Ternyata penglihatanmu sama buruknya dengan kepribadian si Reonan.
dialogsFail.it: What? Lost? The Mayor is right behind me. Apparently your vision is as bad as Reonan's choice in heroes.
dialogsFail.jp: 市長は真っ黒な肌と白髪が特徴です。広場のすぐそばにおりますよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 네에? 모르겠다고요? 시장님은 바로 제 뒤에 계시다니까요. 별로 눈이 안 좋으신가 봐요.
dialogsFail.nl: What? Lost? The Mayor is right behind me. Apparently your vision is as bad as Reonan's choice in heroes.
dialogsFail.pl: What? Lost? The Mayor is right behind me. Apparently your vision is as bad as Reonan's choice in heroes.
dialogsFail.ru: What? Lost? The Mayor is right behind me. Apparently your vision is as bad as Reonan's choice in heroes.
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Qué? ¿Te has perdido? El Alcalde está justo detrás de mí. Aparentemente, tu visión es tan mala como la elección de héroes de Reonan.
dialogsFail.sw: What? Lost? The Mayor is right behind me. Apparently your vision is as bad as Reonan's choice in heroes.
dialogsFail.th: อะไร สูญหาย? นายกเทศมนตรีอยู่ข้างหลังฉัน เห็นได้ชัดว่าวิสัยทัศน์ของคุณแย่พอๆ กับการเลือกฮีโร่ของ Reonan
dialogsFail.tw: 什麼？丟失的？市長就在我身後。顯然你的眼光和雷奧南在選英雄時一樣糟糕。
dialogsFail.vi: Gì? Mất đi? Thị trưởng ở ngay sau tôi. Rõ ràng tầm nhìn của bạn cũng tệ như lựa chọn của Reonan trong các anh hùng.

description.pl: Polowanie na $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ pozwoli odzyskać punkty Karmy.
description.ru: Твоя цель - $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, только так ты очистишь карму.
description.sp: Cazar $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ recuperará tus puntos de Karma.
description.sw: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.th: การล่า $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ จะกู้คืนคะแนน Karma ของคุณ
description.tw: 狩獵 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 將會恢復你的惡名點數。
description.vi: Săn $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ sẽ phục hồi điểm Karma của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsAccept.en: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.ar: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.br: Cace $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.cns: 击杀 $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.de: Jage $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.fi: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.fil: Manghuli ng $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.fr: Si tu souhaites te faire pardonner tes péchés, tue $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s.
dialogsAccept.id: Berburu $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.it: Caccia $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.jp: では、カルマポイントを回復して差し上げますので、$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を$QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$匹討伐しなさい。
dialogsAccept.kr: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$마리를 사냥하세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.pl: Upoluj $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.ru: Твоя цель - $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$. Требуется покарать не менее $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$.
dialogsAccept.sp: Caza $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.sw: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.th: ล่า $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$
dialogsAccept.tw: 獵殺$QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.vi: Săn $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.

dialogsDecline.en: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.ar: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.br: Você ainda tem que pagar pelos seus pecados...
dialogsDecline.cns: 你还没有为你的罪恶付出代价...
dialogsDecline.de: Du musst noch immer für deine Sünden bezahlen...
dialogsDecline.fi: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.fil: Di mo pa bayad ang iyong mga kasalanan…
dialogsDecline.fr: Quand expieras-tu tes nombreux crimes ?
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu belum membayar untuk dosa-dosamu…
dialogsDecline.it: Devi ancora pagare per i tuoi peccati...
dialogsDecline.jp: いつになったら、この底知れぬ罪悪感から抜けられるのだろう？
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신은 아직 죗값을 치르지 않았으니...
dialogsDecline.nl: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.pl: Musisz najpierw zapłacić za swoje grzechy…
dialogsDecline.ru: Велики твои грехи…
dialogsDecline.sp: Todavía tienes que pagar por tus pecados...
dialogsDecline.sw: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.th: คุณยังไม้ได้ชดใช้บาปของคุณ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 你還沒有為你的罪付出代價…
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn vẫn chưa phải trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình…

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.br: Sua missão foi concluída. Seus pecados foram perdoados.
dialogsComplete.cns: 任务完成，你的罪恶已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Buße getan. Deine Sünden wurden dir vergeben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Questmu telah tercapai. Dosa-dosamu telah diampuni.
dialogsComplete.it: La Missione è terminata. I tuoi peccati sono stati perdonati.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 끝났습니다. 당신의 죄를 용서하지요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Боги одобрили твое деяние и простили тебе грехи.
dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น บาปของคุณได้รับการอภัยแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nhiệm vụ của bạn đã được hoàn thành. Tội lỗi của bạn đã được tha thứ.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

name.cns: 死亡的矿山与巨械毒花(2)
name.sp: Mina de la Muerte y Roaches (2)
name.tw: 死亡的礦坑與巨械毒花 (2)
name.vi: Hầm mỏ chết và những con rắn (2)

description.en: Gather the blood of Pinky and Blue Roach Queen.
description.ar: Gather the blood of Pinky and Blue Roach Queen.
description.br: Pegue o sangue das Baratas Rainhas Rosa e Azul.
description.cns: 搜集蓝毒花女王的血液。
description.de: Besorge die Flüssigkeit der Pinky und Blue Roach Queens.
description.fi: Gather the blood of Pinky and Blue Roach Queen.
description.fil: Kunin ang dugo ng Pinky at Blue Roach Queen.
description.fr: Collecter le sang des Reines Tyroglyphes Bleues et Roses
description.id: Kumpulkan darah Pinky dan Blue Roach Queen.
description.it: Gather the blood of Pinky and Blue Roach Queen.
description.jp: ピンクとブルーの、ローチクイーン水を持って来て。
description.kr: 핑크 로치 퀸과 블루 로치 퀸의 혈액을 모으세요.
description.nl: Gather the blood of Pinky and Blue Roach Queen.
description.pl: Zbierz krew Pinky i Blue królowej Roach.
description.ru: Нужно добыть кровь цариц розовых и синих кукарачей.
description.sp: Consigue la sangre de las Reinas Roach Rosas y Azules.
description.sw: Gather the blood of Pinky and Blue Roach Queen.
description.th: รวบรวมเลือดของ Pinky และ Blue Roach Queen
description.tw: 蒐集粉紅、藍色巨械毒花女王的樹液
description.vi: Thu thập máu của Nữ hoàng rắn Pinky và Blue

descriptionComplete.en: Something about the way Bernard talks suggessts that the Roaches were placed in the mines intentionally. Maybe you can find out.
descriptionComplete.ar: Something about the way Bernard talks suggessts that the Roaches were placed in the mines intentionally. Maybe you can find out.
descriptionComplete.br: Algo na forma que Bernard fala sugere que as Baratas foram colocados na mina de forma intencional. Talvez você possa descobrir.
descriptionComplete.cns: 依照番若迪所说的，这些巨械毒花应该是因为一些原因而产生的，我再进去一点看看好了，说不定可以找到我想要的答案。
descriptionComplete.de: Manche von Bernards Aussagen lassen darauf schließen, dass die Roaches absichtlich in die Mine gebracht wurden. Vielleicht findest du mehr heraus.
descriptionComplete.fi: Something about the way Bernard talks suggessts that the Roaches were placed in the mines intentionally. Maybe you can find out.
descriptionComplete.fil: Mayroong rason sa pangungusap ni Bernard na nagsasabing ang mga Roaches ay inilagay sa minahan ng pasadya. Baka mahanap mo ito.
descriptionComplete.fr: Selon Bernard, les Tyroglyphes pourraient avoir été créés par une autre créature… Peut-être qu'en pénétrant plus profondément dans la mine…
descriptionComplete.id: Sesuatu tentang apa yang Bernard bicarakan menunjukkan bahwa Roaches ditempatkan di tambang dengan sengaja. Mungkin kamu bisa mencari tahu.
descriptionComplete.it: Something about the way Bernard talks suggessts that the Roaches were placed in the mines intentionally. Maybe you can find out.
descriptionComplete.jp: バナードは、＜ローチフル＞ が何者かによって意図的に作られたのではないかと睨んでいるみたいだ。もっと奥まで行ってみれば、何かがわかるだろう。
descriptionComplete.kr: 버나드의 말투를 보면, 누군가가 일부러 로치를 광산에 푼 것 아닐까 싶어요. 어쩌면 당신이 진실을 밝힐 수도 있겠죠.
descriptionComplete.nl: Something about the way Bernard talks suggessts that the Roaches were placed in the mines intentionally. Maybe you can find out.
descriptionComplete.pl: Coś w sposobie, w jaki Bernard mówi, sugeruje, że Roach zostały celowo umieszczone w kopalniach. Może się dowiesz.
descriptionComplete.ru: Бернард намекнул на то, что кукарачи завелись в Шахтах не сами собой. Надо бы проверить эту догадку.
descriptionComplete.sp: Algo en la forma en que habla Bernard sugiere que las Roaches fueron colocadas en las minas intencionalmente. Tal vez puedas averiguarlo.
descriptionComplete.sw: Something about the way Bernard talks suggessts that the Roaches were placed in the mines intentionally. Maybe you can find out.
descriptionComplete.th: เรื่องที่เบอร์นาร์ดพูดทำให้เห็นว่าแมลงสาบถูกวางไว้ในเหมืองโดยเจตนา บางทีคุณอาจเจอคำตอบ
descriptionComplete.tw: 依照番若迪所說的，這些巨械毒花應該是因為一些原因而產生的，我再進去一點看看好了，說不定可以找到我想要的答案。
descriptionComplete.vi: Có điều gì đó về cách nói chuyện của Bernard cho thấy rằng những con Rắn đã được đặt vào hầm mỏ một cách có chủ ý. Có lẽ bạn có thể tìm ra.

dialogsBegin.en: The toxicity of Roaches has poisoned many humans in the mine.
dialogsBegin.ar: The toxicity of Roaches has poisoned many humans in the mine.
dialogsBegin.br: A toxicidade das Baratas envenenaram muitos humanos na mina.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我使用你帮我搜集的“乳虫树液”来研究后，找到以前那些人在矿山里无原无辜死掉的原因了，都是因为巨械毒花的毒而引起的。
dialogsBegin.de: Die Roaches haben die Menschen in der Mine vergiftet.
dialogsBegin.fi: The toxicity of Roaches has poisoned many humans in the mine.
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang lason sa mga ipis ang naglason ng maraming tao sa minahan na ito.
dialogsBegin.fr: Après avoir étudié le fluide que tu m'as ramené, j'ai découvert que la toxicité des Tyroglyphes est la cause de la mort des personnes dans la mine.
dialogsBegin.id: Toksisitas Roaches telah meracuni banyak manusia di tambang.
dialogsBegin.it: The toxicity of Roaches has poisoned many humans in the mine.
dialogsBegin.jp: 君に採ってきてもらったローチ水を分析した結果、この鉱山で人間達が倒れていった原因がとうとう分かったぞ！ローチフルという生物には毒性があるんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 로치의 독성이 광산에서 일하던 사람들을 병들게 한 거였어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: The toxicity of Roaches has poisoned many humans in the mine.
dialogsBegin.pl: Toksyczność Roachów zatruła wielu ludzi w kopalni.
dialogsBegin.ru: В крови личинок яд. Тот самый, от которого умерли шахтеры!
dialogsBegin.sp: La toxicidad de las Roaches ha envenenado a muchos humanos en la mina.
dialogsBegin.sw: The toxicity of Roaches has poisoned many humans in the mine.
dialogsBegin.th: พิษของมันมีผลกับคนในเหมืองเป็นจำนวนมาก
dialogsBegin.tw: 我使用你幫我蒐集的『乳蟲樹液』來研究後，找到以前那些人在礦坑裡無原無辜死掉的原因了，都是因為巨械毒花的毒而引起的。
dialogsBegin.vi: Độc tính của Rắn đã đầu độc nhiều người trong hầm mỏ

dialogsBegin.en: It seems that the Roach Queens are the source of the poison.
dialogsBegin.ar: It seems that the Roach Queens are the source of the poison.
dialogsBegin.br: Parece que as Baratas Rainhas são a fonte do veneno.
dialogsBegin.cns: 似乎这个毒是来自于毒花女王的。
dialogsBegin.de: Es scheint, als wären die Roach Queens der Ursprung der Vergiftungen.
dialogsBegin.fi: It seems that the Roach Queens are the source of the poison.
dialogsBegin.fil: Mukhang ang Reyna ng mga ipis ang pinagmumulan ng lason.
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais j'ai découvert aussi que la toxine fatale aux être humains émanait de la Reine Tyroglyphe.
dialogsBegin.id: Terlihat bahwa Roach Queens adalah sumber racunnya.
dialogsBegin.it: It seems that the Roach Queens are the source of the poison.
dialogsBegin.jp: 特に、人間にとって致命的な猛毒が、この ローチフルの女王であるローチクイーンの体から発生することも判明した。
dialogsBegin.kr: 로치 퀸들이 그 독성의 근원인 것 같아요.
dialogsBegin.nl: It seems that the Roach Queens are the source of the poison.
dialogsBegin.pl: Wygląda na to, że źródłem trucizny są Królowe Roach.
dialogsBegin.ru: Сдается мне, сильнее всего должен быть яд цариц розовых и синих кукарачей.
dialogsBegin.sp: Parece que las Reinas Roach son la fuente del veneno.
dialogsBegin.sw: It seems that the Roach Queens are the source of the poison.
dialogsBegin.th: ดูเหมือนว่า Roach Queens เป็นแหล่งกำเนิดพิษ
dialogsBegin.tw: 而且我發現『毒花女王』的毒會使人類受到致命傷。
dialogsBegin.vi: Có vẻ như Nữ hoàng Rắn là nguồn gốc của chất độc.

dialogsBegin.en: Bring me the blood of Pink and Blue Roach Queens so that I can make a vaccine.
dialogsBegin.ar: Bring me the blood of Pink and Blue Roach Queens so that I can make a vaccine.
dialogsBegin.br: Traga o sangue das Baratas Rainhas Rosa e Azul, para que eu possa preparar uma vacina.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我要制造预防这些病菌的疫苗，你可以帮我从蓝毒花女王身上采取她的血液给我吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Ich brauche das Blut der Pink und Blue Roach Queens. Damit sollte ich einen Impfstoff herstellen können.
dialogsBegin.fi: Bring me the blood of Pink and Blue Roach Queens so that I can make a vaccine.
dialogsBegin.fil: Bring me the blood of Pink and Blue Roach Queens so that I can make a vaccine.
dialogsBegin.fr: Pourrais-tu me ramener le fluide des Reines Tyroglyphes Bleues et Roses afin que je concocte un vaccin ?
dialogsBegin.id: Bawakan aku darah dari Pinky dan Blue Roach Queens agar aku bisa membuat vaksin.
dialogsBegin.it: Bring me the blood of Pink and Blue Roach Queens so that I can make a vaccine.
dialogsBegin.jp: ワクチンを作る為には、ピンクとブルーの ＜ローチクイーン＞ の体から採れる ＜ローチクィーン水＞必要なのだがどうだ、君にそれを採ってくる勇気はあるか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 백신을 만들 수 있도록, 분홍 로치 퀸과 파랑 로치 퀸의 피를 가져다주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Bring me the blood of Pink and Blue Roach Queens so that I can make a vaccine.
dialogsBegin.pl: Przynieś mi krew Pinky i Blue Roach Queens, żebym mogła zrobić szczepionkę.
dialogsBegin.ru: Принеси мне кровь цариц розовых и синих кукарачей, чтобы я мог изготовить вакцину.
dialogsBegin.sp: Tráeme la sangre de las Reinas Cucarachas Rosas y Azules para que pueda hacer una vacuna.
dialogsBegin.sw: Bring me the blood of Pink and Blue Roach Queens so that I can make a vaccine.
dialogsBegin.th: นำเลือดของ Pink และ Blue Roach Queens มา เพื่อให้ฉันสามารถทำวัคซีนได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 我要製造預防這些病菌的藥水，你可以幫我在巨械毒花女王身上採取他的樹液給我。
dialogsBegin.vi: Mang cho tôi máu của Pink và Blue Roach Queen để tôi có thể tạo ra vắc-xin.

dialogsAccept.en: Sprinkle this liquid on the Roach Queen egg to wake her up. Be careful.
dialogsAccept.ar: Sprinkle this liquid on the Roach Queen egg to wake her up. Be careful.
dialogsAccept.br: Jogue este líquido sobre o ovo da Barata Rainha para acordá-la. Tome cuidado.
dialogsAccept.cns: 将这种液体洒在毒花女王的蛋上以唤醒她。但请当心。
dialogsAccept.de: Träufle diese Flüssigkeit auf die Eier der Roach Queen. Sei vorsichtig.
dialogsAccept.fi: Sprinkle this liquid on the Roach Queen egg to wake her up. Be careful.
dialogsAccept.fil: Ikalat ang liquid na ito sa itlog ng Reyna ng mga ipis para gisingin siya. Mag iingat ka.
dialogsAccept.fr: Pour réveiller une Reine Tyroglyphe, tu dois projeter ce fluide sur ses oeufs. Fais très attention… La reine doit être redoutable !
dialogsAccept.id: Taburkan cairan ini pada telur Roach Queen untuk membangunkannya. Hati-hati.
dialogsAccept.it: Sprinkle this liquid on the Roach Queen egg to wake her up. Be careful.
dialogsAccept.jp: ローチクイーンを起こすには、この液体を ＜ローチクイーンエッグ＞ に振りかけることだ。だがローチクイーンは凶暴だから、気をつけてくれ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 이 액체를 로치 퀸의 알에 뿌리면 퀸이 깨어날 거예요. 부디 조심하세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Sprinkle this liquid on the Roach Queen egg to wake her up. Be careful.
dialogsAccept.pl: Posyp tym płynem jajko Królowej Roach, aby ją obudzić. Bądź ostrożny.
dialogsAccept.ru: Чтобы царица кукарачей пробудилась, окропи яйцо этой жидкостью. Будь осторожнее.
dialogsAccept.sp: Espolvorea este líquido sobre el huevo de la Reina Roach para despertarla. Ten cuidado.
dialogsAccept.sw: Sprinkle this liquid on the Roach Queen egg to wake her up. Be careful.
dialogsAccept.th: โรยของเหลวนี้ลงบนไข่ Roach Queen เพื่อปลุกเธอขึ้นมา ระวังด้วยนะ!!
dialogsAccept.tw: 為了讓巨械毒花女王醒過來的話，要把這個液體噴在巨械毒花女王的卵上，你要小心一點喔！他可是很兇狠的傢伙啊！
dialogsAccept.vi: Rắc chất lỏng này lên quả trứng của Nữ Hoàng Rắn để đánh thức cô ấy. Hãy cẩn thận.

dialogsDecline.en: You really will not see this through to the end?
dialogsDecline.ar: You really will not see this through to the end?
dialogsDecline.br: Você realmente não deseja ver isto até o fim?
dialogsDecline.cns: 反正你已经接手了，那麻烦你帮我做到底好吗？不然，你不觉得有一种，你去厕所之后，没擦屁股的感觉吗？
dialogsDecline.de: Warum hilfst du mir nicht, es zu Ende zu bringen?
dialogsDecline.fi: You really will not see this through to the end?
dialogsDecline.fil: Ayaw mo makita ito hanggang sa pagtatapos?
dialogsDecline.fr: Pourquoi ne me veux-tu pas m'aider dans cette tâche ? Pense à toutes les vies qu'on pourrait sauver…
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu benar-benar tidak akan melihat ini sampai akhir?
dialogsDecline.it: You really will not see this through to the end?
dialogsDecline.jp: ここまで来て、諦めるのか！もう少しで、謎が解けるというのに…！
dialogsDecline.kr: 이왕 손댄 일인데, 끝까지 도와주시지 않을 건가요?
dialogsDecline.nl: You really will not see this through to the end?
dialogsDecline.pl: Naprawdę nie doczekasz tego do końca?
dialogsDecline.ru: Неужели ты откажешься спасти людей?
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿No verás esto hasta el final?
dialogsDecline.sw: You really will not see this through to the end?
dialogsDecline.th: คุณจะไม่อยู่ดูเรื่องนี้จนจบจริงๆ เหรอ?
dialogsDecline.tw: 反正你已經碰手了，那麻煩你幫我做到底好嗎？不然，你不覺得有一種，你去廁所之後，沒擦屁股的感覺嗎？
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn thực sự sẽ không nhìn thấy điều này đến cuối cùng?

dialogsComplete.en: This vaccine will save many lives. Thank you.
dialogsComplete.ar: This vaccine will save many lives. Thank you.
dialogsComplete.br: Esta vacina salvará muitas vidas. Obrigado.
dialogsComplete.cns: 因为你的帮忙，我可以给死去的那些人一个交代了。只要有这个药水它们应该不会再乱来了！
dialogsComplete.de: Dieser Impfstoff wird viele Leben retten. Vielen Dank!
dialogsComplete.fi: This vaccine will save many lives. Thank you.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang bakuna na ito ay magliligtas ng maraming buhay. Salamat.
dialogsComplete.fr: Excellent travail ! Grâce à ton aide, nous avons soulagé les nombreux esprits qui errent dans la mine. Le vaccin rendra désormais cette toxine impuissante.
dialogsComplete.id: Vaksin ini akan menyelamatkan banyak nyawa. Terima kasih.
dialogsComplete.it: This vaccine will save many lives. Thank you.
dialogsComplete.jp:
君のおかげで、この鉱山で倒れて行った数多くの魂たちを慰めることが出来た。ありがとう、感謝するよ。
このワクチンさえあれば、あのローチクイーンの毒も恐れることはなくなったぞ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이 백신으로 많은 생명을 구할 수 있을 거예요. 감사합니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: This vaccine will save many lives. Thank you.
dialogsComplete.pl: Ta szczepionka uratuje wiele istnień. Dziękuję Ci.
dialogsComplete.ru: Эта вакцина спасет многих.
dialogsComplete.sp: Esta vacuna salvará muchas vidas. Gracias.
dialogsComplete.sw: This vaccine will save many lives. Thank you.
dialogsComplete.th: วัคซีนนี้จะช่วยชีวิตคนได้เป็นจำนวนมาก ขอบคุณ
dialogsComplete.tw: 因為你的幫忙，我可以給死去的那些人一個交代了。只要有這個藥水牠們應該不會再亂來了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Loại vắc xin này sẽ cứu sống nhiều người. Cảm ơn bạn.

dialogsComplete.en: Take this weapon as a token of gratitude and this card to venture deeper into the mine.
dialogsComplete.ar: Take this weapon as a token of gratitude and this card to venture deeper into the mine.
dialogsComplete.br: Como um símbolo de gratidão, pegue esta arma e este cartão para se aventurar mais fundo dentro da mina.
dialogsComplete.cns: 这个武器是我送给你的，还有这张通行卡，可以进入矿山的里面。
dialogsComplete.de: Nimm diese Waffe als Zeichen meiner Dankbarkeit und diese Karte, mit der du tiefer in die Mine eindringen kannst.
dialogsComplete.fi: Take this weapon as a token of gratitude and this card to venture deeper into the mine.
dialogsComplete.fil: Take this weapon as a token of gratitude and this card to venture deeper into the mine.
dialogsComplete.fr: Voici une arme, que je t'offre en signe de reconnaissance. Et grâce à cette carte d'accès, tu pourras pénétrer au plus profond de la mine.
dialogsComplete.id: Ambil senjata ini sebagai tanda terima kasih dan kartu ini untuk menjelajahi lebih dalam ke tambang.
dialogsComplete.it: Take this weapon as a token of gratitude and this card to venture deeper into the mine.
dialogsComplete.jp: この武器は感謝の気持ちだ。それからこのカードは、鉱山のさらに奥深くへ行けるIDカードだ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 감사의 표시로 드리는 이 무기와 카드를 가지고, 광산 더 깊은 곳으로 모험을 떠나보세요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Take this weapon as a token of gratitude and this card to venture deeper into the mine.
dialogsComplete.pl: Weź tę broń jako dowód wdzięczności i tę kartę, aby zapuścić się głębiej w kopalnię.
dialogsComplete.ru: Прими это оружие в знак благодарности, а также эту карту — она откроет тебе путь вглубь шахты.
dialogsComplete.sp: Toma este arma como muestra de gratitud y esta Carta para adentrarte en la mina.
dialogsComplete.sw: Take this weapon as a token of gratitude and this card to venture deeper into the mine.
dialogsComplete.th: รับอาวุธนี้เป็นสัญลักษณ์ของความขอบคุณ และการ์ดใบนี้ใช้สำหรับเข้าไปในเหมืองที่ลึกขึ้น
dialogsComplete.tw: 這個武器是我送給妳的，還有這張通行卡，可以進入礦坑的裡面。
dialogsComplete.vi: Hãy lấy vũ khí này như một biểu tượng của lòng biết ơn và thẻ này để tiến sâu hơn vào mỏ.

dialogsComplete.en: The Roaches appeared very suddenly in the mine. Maybe you can find out the reason by going deeper into the mine.
dialogsComplete.ar: The Roaches appeared very suddenly in the mine. Maybe you can find out the reason by going deeper into the mine.
dialogsComplete.br: As Baratas apareceram de repente na mina. Talvez você possa descobrir o motivo, investigando mais fundo na mina.
dialogsComplete.cns: 矿山里面突然冒出一堆巨械毒花，我觉得很诡异。我猜进到里面应该会找到原因吧！
dialogsComplete.de: Die Roaches tauchten sehr plötzlich in der Mine auf. Vielleicht kannst du den Grund herausfinden, indem du tiefer in die Mine vordringst.
dialogsComplete.fi: The Roaches appeared very suddenly in the mine. Maybe you can find out the reason by going deeper into the mine.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang Roaches ay biglaang nagpakita sa minahan. Baka makita mo ang rason bakit sa kailaliman nito.
dialogsComplete.fr: Les Tyroglyphes sont apparus soudainement dans la mine. Peut-être que tu pourras découvrir la raison de cette apparition en pénétrant plus profondément dans la mine.
dialogsComplete.id: The Roaches muncul tiba-tiba di tambang. Mungkin kamu bisa menemukan alasannya dengan masuk lebih dalam ke tambang.
dialogsComplete.it: The Roaches appeared very suddenly in the mine. Maybe you can find out the reason by going deeper into the mine.
dialogsComplete.jp:
ローチフルが鉱山に現れたのは、突然のことだったそうだ。
怪しいと思わないか？
もっと鉱山の奥に行ってみれば、その原因が分かるかも知れないな。
dialogsComplete.kr: 로치들은 갑작스럽게 광산에 나타났어요. 광산 더 깊은 곳으로 들어가면 그 이유를 찾을 수 있을지도 몰라요.
dialogsComplete.nl: The Roaches appeared very suddenly in the mine. Maybe you can find out the reason by going deeper into the mine.
dialogsComplete.pl: Roach pojawiły się nagle w kopalni. Może odkryjesz przyczynę, wchodząc głębiej w kopalnię.
dialogsComplete.ru: Вот тебе новая загадка: кукарачи появились в Шахтах внезапно, словно из ниоткуда. Ищи ответ на нее в глубине Шахт.
dialogsComplete.sp: Las Roaches aparecieron de repente en la mina. Tal vez puedas averiguar el motivo adentrándote en la mina.
dialogsComplete.sw: The Roaches appeared very suddenly in the mine. Maybe you can find out the reason by going deeper into the mine.
dialogsComplete.th: แมลงสาบปรากฏตัวขึ้นอย่างฉับพลันในเหมือง บางทีคุณอาจจะหาเหตุผลได้โดยเข้าไปในเหมืองให้ลึกขึ้น
dialogsComplete.tw: 礦坑裡面突然冒出一堆巨械毒花，我覺得很詭異。我猜進到裡面應該會找到原因吧！
dialogsComplete.vi: Những con Rắn xuất hiện rất đột ngột trong hầm mỏ. Có lẽ bạn có thể tìm ra lý do bằng cách đi sâu hơn vào hầm mỏ.

dialogsFail.en: I am sure that you can handle the upcoming danger.
dialogsFail.ar: I am sure that you can handle the upcoming danger.
dialogsFail.br: Estou certo de que você pode enfrentar o perigo.
dialogsFail.cns: 我相信你一定可以解决得。如果、你觉得很累的话，可以多找一些伙伴一起进去也不错啦！
dialogsFail.de: Ich bin mir sicher, dass du mit der Gefahr fertig werden wirst.
dialogsFail.fi: I am sure that you can handle the upcoming danger.
dialogsFail.fil: Sigurado ako na kaya mo ang nagbabadyang panganib.
dialogsFail.fr: Je crois que tu en es capable.
dialogsFail.id: Aku yakin bahwa kamu bisa mengatasi bahaya yang akan datang.
dialogsFail.it: I am sure that you can handle the upcoming danger.
dialogsFail.jp:
君なら、きっとこの謎を解明出来ると信じているぞ！
だが、鉱山の奥地は今までよりずっと危険だからな。仲間を集めて行くのもいいんじゃないか？
dialogsFail.kr: 당신이라면 충분히 해낼 수 있을 거라 믿어요.
dialogsFail.nl: I am sure that you can handle the upcoming danger.
dialogsFail.pl: Jestem pewien, że poradzisz sobie z nadchodzącym niebezpieczeństwem.
dialogsFail.ru: Уверен, опасности Шахты тебе вполне по плечу.
dialogsFail.sp: Estoy seguro de que podrás superar el próximo peligro.
dialogsFail.sw: I am sure that you can handle the upcoming danger.
dialogsFail.th: ฉันแน่ใจว่าคุณจะจัดการอันตรายที่กำลังจะมาถึงได้
dialogsFail.tw: 我相信你一定可以解決得。如果、你覺得很累的話，可以多找一些伙伴一起進去也不錯啦！
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi chắc chắn rằng bạn có thể đối phó với nguy hiểm sắp tới.

name.th: เต็มไปด้วยความทรงจำ
name.vi: Một chiếc rương đầy những kỷ niệm

description.en: Bring the purified Memory Shard to Hael.
description.ar: Bring the purified Memory Shard to Hael.
description.br: Leve o Resquício de Memória purificado para Hael.
description.cns: 将净化后的记忆碎片带给海尔。
description.de: Bringe ein gereinigtes Memory Shard zu Hael.
description.fi: Bring the purified Memory Shard to Hael.
description.fil: Bring the purified Memory Shard to Hael.
description.fr: Apportez la vision purifiée à Hael.
description.id: Bawa Memory Shard yang telah dimurnikan ke Hael.
description.it: Bring the purified Memory Shard to Hael.
description.jp: 浄化された記憶の欠片をハエルに渡せ。
description.nl: Bring the purified Memory Shard to Hael.
description.pl: Bring the purified Memory Shard to Hael.
description.ru: Bring the purified Memory Shard to Hael.
description.sp: Llévale el Fragmento de Memoria purificado a Hael.
description.sw: Bring the purified Memory Shard to Hael.
description.th: นำ Memory Shard ที่ได้รับการชำระล้างไปให้ Hael
description.tw: 將淨化後的記憶碎片帶給哈爾。
description.vi: Mang Mảnh ký ức tinh khiết đến Hael.

dialogsBegin.en: I will purify the Memory Shards sure, but first a joke!
dialogsBegin.ar: I will purify the Memory Shards sure, but first a joke!
dialogsBegin.br: Eu vou purificar os Resquícios de Memória com certeza, mas primeiro uma piada!
dialogsBegin.cns: 当然，我会净化记忆碎片。但你首先得听我说一个笑话！
dialogsBegin.de: Ich werde die Memory Shards sicher reinigen, aber zuerst ein Scherz!
dialogsBegin.fi: I will purify the Memory Shards sure, but first a joke!
dialogsBegin.fil: I will purify the Memory Shards sure, but first a joke!
dialogsBegin.fr: *Crache, frotte* Et voilà ça brille ! Mais pourquoi vous faites cette tête-là ?
dialogsBegin.id: Aku akan memurnikan Memory Shard, tapi bohong!
dialogsBegin.it: I will purify the Memory Shards sure, but first a joke!
dialogsBegin.jp: ケラケラ。むしゃむしゃ。ペッペ！　ほら、できたよ。これで浄化されたはず。何？　汚いだって？　ふん、そんなに言うならもう協力してあげないぞ！
dialogsBegin.kr: 기억의 파편을 정화해 달라고요? 좋아요. 하지만 먼저 농담 하나 들려 드리죠!
dialogsBegin.nl: I will purify the Memory Shards sure, but first a joke!
dialogsBegin.pl: I will purify the Memory Shards sure, but first a joke!
dialogsBegin.ru: I will purify the Memory Shards sure, but first a joke!
dialogsBegin.sp: Claro que purificaré los Fragmentos de Memoria, ¡pero primero una broma!
dialogsBegin.sw: I will purify the Memory Shards sure, but first a joke!
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันจะชำระล้างหน่วยความจำให้แน่ใจ แต่มันเป็นครั้งแรกที่ตลก
dialogsBegin.tw: 我當然可以幫你淨化記憶碎片，不過先聽我講個笑話！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi chắc chắn sẽ thanh lọc các mảnh vỡ ký ức, nhưng trước tiên là một trò đùa!

dialogsAccept.en: Haha, well since you were so kind to listen here is your crystal. Now go ahead and take it!
dialogsAccept.ar: Haha, well since you were so kind to listen here is your crystal. Now go ahead and take it!
dialogsAccept.br: Haha, bem, já que você foi tão gentil em ouvir, aqui está o seu cristal. Agora vá em frente e pegue!
dialogsAccept.cns: 哈哈，既然你这么善良的愿意听我讲笑话，那就给你记忆碎片吧！上前来拿着它吧。
dialogsAccept.de: Haha, nun, da du so nett warst, mir zuzuhören, hier ist dein Kristall. Jetzt geh und nimm ihn!
dialogsAccept.fi: Haha, well since you were so kind to listen here is your crystal. Now go ahead and take it!
dialogsAccept.fil: Haha, well since you were so kind to listen here is your crystal. Now go ahead and take it!
dialogsAccept.fr: Mais parfaitement, ma salive a purifié la vision ! Vous pouvez l'apporter à la personne qui la voulait !
dialogsAccept.id: Haha, karena kamu bersedia mendengarkan dengan sabar, ini kristalmu. Ambilah!
dialogsAccept.it: Haha, well since you were so kind to listen here is your crystal. Now go ahead and take it!
dialogsAccept.jp: そうそう、素直なことは大事だよね。ケラケラ。私のつばにはロイヤルゼリーがたっぷり含まれてるんだよ。ケラケラ
dialogsAccept.kr: 하하, 이렇게 친절하게 얘길 들어준 대가로 수정을 드릴게요. 자아, 받아가세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Haha, well since you were so kind to listen here is your crystal. Now go ahead and take it!
dialogsAccept.pl: Haha, well since you were so kind to listen here is your crystal. Now go ahead and take it!
dialogsAccept.ru: Haha, well since you were so kind to listen here is your crystal. Now go ahead and take it!
dialogsAccept.sp: Jaja, bueno, ya que has sido tan amable de escuchar, aquí está tu cristal. ¡Adelante, llévatelo!
dialogsAccept.sw: Haha, well since you were so kind to listen here is your crystal. Now go ahead and take it!
dialogsAccept.th: ฮ่าฮ่า เนี่ยตั้งแต่คุณรู้สึกดีที่ฟังนี่เป็นผลึกของคุณ ตอนนี้ไปต่อ และใช้มัน!
dialogsAccept.tw: 哈哈，既然你好心聽完了，這就是你的水晶。來，拿去吧！
dialogsAccept.vi: Haha, vì bạn đã rất tử tế khi lắng nghe ở đây chính là viên pha lê của bạn. Bây giờ hãy tiếp tục và lấy nó!

dialogsDecline.en: Thanks again for listening. The Pukepukes around here don't have a very good sense of humor! Haha!
dialogsDecline.ar: Thanks again for listening. The Pukepukes around here don't have a very good sense of humor! Haha!
dialogsDecline.br: Obrigado novamente por ouvir. Os Pukepukes por aqui não têm muito senso de humor! Haha!
dialogsDecline.cns: 再次感谢你的倾听。这附近的邪精灵随从一点幽默感都没有，真是无聊！哈哈！
dialogsDecline.de: Nochmals vielen Dank fürs Zuhören. Die Pukepukes hier haben keinen sehr guten Sinn für Humor! Haha!
dialogsDecline.fi: Thanks again for listening. The Pukepukes around here don't have a very good sense of humor! Haha!
dialogsDecline.fil: Thanks again for listening. The Pukepukes around here don't have a very good sense of humor! Haha!
dialogsDecline.fr: C'était la seule façon de la purifier.
dialogsDecline.id: Sekali lagi terima kasih karena telah mendengarkan. Para Pukepuke disini tidak memilki selera humor sama sekali, haha!
dialogsDecline.it: Thanks again for listening. The Pukepukes around here don't have a very good sense of humor! Haha!
dialogsDecline.jp: ふん、そんなことを言うならもう協力してあげないよ～だ！
dialogsDecline.kr: 들어줘서 정말 고마워요. 이곳 근처의 푸케푸케들은 유머 감각이 별로 없거든요! 하하!
dialogsDecline.nl: Thanks again for listening. The Pukepukes around here don't have a very good sense of humor! Haha!
dialogsDecline.pl: Thanks again for listening. The Pukepukes around here don't have a very good sense of humor! Haha!
dialogsDecline.ru: Thanks again for listening. The Pukepukes around here don't have a very good sense of humor! Haha!
dialogsDecline.sp: Gracias de nuevo por escuchar. ¡Los Pukepukes de por aquí no tienen muy buen sentido del humor! ¡Jaja!
dialogsDecline.sw: Thanks again for listening. The Pukepukes around here don't have a very good sense of humor! Haha!
dialogsDecline.th: ขอขอบคุณอีกครั้งสำหรับการฟัง Pukepukes รอบที่นี่ไม่ได้มีอารมณ์ขันมากนัก! ฮ่าฮ่า!
dialogsDecline.tw: 再次謝謝你肯聽我說笑。這附近的噗卡噗卡可沒什麼幽默感！哈哈！
dialogsDecline.vi: Cảm ơn một lần nữa vì đã lắng nghe. Pukepukes quanh đây không có khiếu hài hước cho lắm! Haha!

dialogsComplete.en: What's the deal with this weird looking stone? Oh, for helping me to recall my lost thoughts you say? Oh well, worth a shot!
dialogsComplete.ar: What's the deal with this weird looking stone? Oh, for helping me to recall my lost thoughts you say? Oh well, worth a shot!
dialogsComplete.br: Qual é desta pedra de aparência estranha? Oh, É para me ajudar a relembrar minhas memórias perdidos, você diz? Ah, vale a pena tentar!
dialogsComplete.cns: 这个看起来奇奇怪怪的石头有什么用吗？你说这是用来帮助我恢复记忆的？噢，好吧，值得一试！
dialogsComplete.de: Was hat es mit diesem seltsam aussehenden Stein auf sich? Oh, um mir zu helfen, meine verlorenen Gedanken wiederzufinden, sagst du? Na ja, einen Versuch ist es wert!
dialogsComplete.fi: What's the deal with this weird looking stone? Oh, for helping me to recall my lost thoughts you say? Oh well, worth a shot!
dialogsComplete.fil: What's the deal with this weird looking stone? Oh, for helping me to recall my lost thoughts you say? Oh well, worth a shot!
dialogsComplete.fr: Merci beaucoup. Elle sent un peu bizarre cette vision…
dialogsComplete.id: Apa sih istimewanya batu aneh ini? Oh, untuk membantu untuk memanggil kembali ingatanku yang lalu? Oke, layak dicoba!
dialogsComplete.it: What's the deal with this weird looking stone? Oh, for helping me to recall my lost thoughts you say? Oh well, worth a shot!
dialogsComplete.jp: む、なんだ……このべたついた石は……
dialogsComplete.kr: 이 이상하게 생긴 돌은 대체 뭐죠? 어, 잃어버린 기억을 되찾게 도와주는 거라고요? 뭐, 시도해 볼 가치는 있겠네요!
dialogsComplete.nl: What's the deal with this weird looking stone? Oh, for helping me to recall my lost thoughts you say? Oh well, worth a shot!
dialogsComplete.pl: What's the deal with this weird looking stone? Oh, for helping me to recall my lost thoughts you say? Oh well, worth a shot!
dialogsComplete.ru: What's the deal with this weird looking stone? Oh, for helping me to recall my lost thoughts you say? Oh well, worth a shot!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿Qué pasa con esta piedra de aspecto extraño? Oh, ¿Es para ayudarme a recordar mis recuerdos perdidos dices? ¡Oh, vale la pena intentarlo!
dialogsComplete.sw: What's the deal with this weird looking stone? Oh, for helping me to recall my lost thoughts you say? Oh well, worth a shot!
dialogsComplete.th: ข้อตกลงกับหินแปลก ๆ นี้มีอะไรบ้าง? โอ้ช่วยในการเรียกคืนความคิดที่หายไปของคุณที่คุณพูด? โอ้คุ้มค่าอย่างยิ่ง!
dialogsComplete.tw: 這顆看起來怪怪的石頭是怎麼回事？喔，你說它能幫我找回失去的記憶？好吧，那就試試看！
dialogsComplete.vi: Có chuyện gì với viên đá trông kỳ lạ này? Ồ, vì đã giúp tôi nhớ lại những suy nghĩ đã mất, bạn nói sao? Oh tốt, đáng để bắn!

dialogsFail.ar: Oh back so soon? Don't worry I have plenty more jokes! So what do you get when you cross an Aibatt with... Er wait, I forgot how it goes...
dialogsFail.br: Oh! já voltou? Não se preocupe, eu tenho muito mais piadas! Então o que acontece quando você cruza um Aibatt com... Er calma, eu esqueci como é...
dialogsFail.cns: Oh back so soon? Don't worry I have plenty more jokes! So what do you get when you cross an Aibatt with... Er wait, I forgot how it goes...
dialogsFail.de: Oh, schon zurück? Keine Sorge, ich habe noch viele Witze auf Lager! Also was bekommt man, wenn man einen Aibatt mit... Äh warte, ich habe vergessen wie es geht...
dialogsFail.fi: Oh back so soon? Don't worry I have plenty more jokes! So what do you get when you cross an Aibatt with... Er wait, I forgot how it goes...
dialogsFail.fil: Oh back so soon? Don't worry I have plenty more jokes! So what do you get when you cross an Aibatt with... Er wait, I forgot how it goes...
dialogsFail.fr: Je vous assure que ça suffit. Je peux recracher dessus si vous voulez.
dialogsFail.id: Oh sudah kembali? Jangan khawatir saya punya lebih banyak lelucon! Jadi apa yang kau dapatkan ketika melintasi Aibatt dengan.. Eh tunggu, aku lupa bagaimana kelanjutannya...
dialogsFail.it: Oh back so soon? Don't worry I have plenty more jokes! So what do you get when you cross an Aibatt with... Er wait, I forgot how it goes...
dialogsFail.jp: すぐ戻りましたね！それで、あなたがアイバットを横切るとき、あなたは何を得られますか？、、ちょっと忘れてしまいました。
dialogsFail.kr: 이렇게 빨리 돌아왔어요? 걱정 말아요, 아직도 다른 개그가 많으니까! 아이바트를 만나면 뭘 얻게 되게... 잠깐, 그다음이 뭐더라...
dialogsFail.nl: Oh back so soon? Don't worry I have plenty more jokes! So what do you get when you cross an Aibatt with... Er wait, I forgot how it goes...
dialogsFail.pl: Oh back so soon? Don't worry I have plenty more jokes! So what do you get when you cross an Aibatt with... Er wait, I forgot how it goes...
dialogsFail.ru: Oh back so soon? Don't worry I have plenty more jokes! So what do you get when you cross an Aibatt with... Er wait, I forgot how it goes...
dialogsFail.sp: Oh, ¿ya de vuelta? ¡No te preocupes, tengo muchos más chistes! Entonces, ¿qué consigues cuando atraviesas a un Aibatt con...? Er espera, he olvidado cómo sigue...
dialogsFail.sw: Oh back so soon? Don't worry I have plenty more jokes! So what do you get when you cross an Aibatt with... Er wait, I forgot how it goes...
dialogsFail.th: ดีใจที่คุณกลับมาอีกแล้ว! อย่าต้องกังวล ฉันยังมีมุขฮาๆ อีกเพียบ! ว่าแล้วก็,, คุณจะได้อะไรเมื่อคุณผ่าน Aibatt กับ... เออ รอหน่อยนะ... ฉันลืมไปแล้วว่ามันต้องเล่นต่อยังไง...
dialogsFail.tw: 喔，這麼快就回來啦？別擔心，我還有很多笑話可以講！所以說，把獨眼蝙蝠跟……呃等等，我忘記後面怎麼接了……
dialogsFail.vi: Ồ, trở lại sớm vậy? Đừng lo, tôi còn rất nhiều câu chuyện cười nữa! Vậy bạn sẽ nhận được gì khi băng qua một Aibatt với .. Ơ khoan, tôi quên mất đoạn sau rồi...

description.cns: 在达肯西部杀死矿工幽魂，获得被抛弃的灵魂。

description.fi: Kill the Zombiger West of Darken City and acquire the Forsaken Soul.
description.fil: Kill the Zombiger West of Darken City and acquire the Forsaken Soul.

description.tw: 消滅礦工腐屍，然後拿回委屈的怨魂。
description.vi: Giết Zombiger West of Darken City và lấy được Forsaken Soul.

dialogsBegin.en: As I was going to say! I would love to reunite with my fellow heroes, but I can't do much in my, uh… current form hehe. Never fear! I think I have a possible solution!
dialogsBegin.ar: As I was going to say! I would love to reunite with my fellow heroes, but I can't do much in my, uh… current form hehe. Never fear! I think I have a possible solution!
dialogsBegin.br: Como eu ia dizer! Eu adoraria me reunir com meus companheiros Heróis, mas não posso fazer muito na minha, uh... forma atual hehe. Mas não tema! Acho que tenho uma possível solução!
dialogsBegin.cns: 正如我想说的! 我很想和我的英雄伙伴们团聚，但我现在的样子，呃...做不了什么，嘿嘿。不要害怕! 我想我有一个可能的解决方案!
dialogsBegin.de: Wie ich schon sagen wollte! Ich würde mich gerne wieder mit meinen Mithelden zusammentun, aber in meiner, äh... jetzigen Form kann ich nicht viel tun, hehe. Aber keine Angst! Ich glaube, ich habe eine mögliche Lösung!
dialogsBegin.fi: As I was going to say! I would love to reunite with my fellow heroes, but I can't do much in my, uh… current form hehe. Never fear! I think I have a possible solution!
dialogsBegin.fil: As I was going to say! I would love to reunite with my fellow heroes, but I can't do much in my, uh… current form hehe. Never fear! I think I have a possible solution!
dialogsBegin.fr: Dans mon état actuel, je ne peux pas aider Reonan, les gens fuient quand j'approche, les enfants pleurent, on me jette des pierres...
dialogsBegin.id: Seperti yang akan saya katakan! Saya ingin sekali bersatu kembali dengan sesama pahlawan, tetapi saya tidak bisa berbuat banyak dalam, uh ... bentuk saya saat ini hehe. Jangan pernah takut! Saya pikir saya punya solusi yang bisa dilakukan!
dialogsBegin.it: As I was going to say! I would love to reunite with my fellow heroes, but I can't do much in my, uh… current form hehe. Never fear! I think I have a possible solution!
dialogsBegin.jp: さて、手伝ってもらった手前、私も何か恩を返したいが、如何せんこの身体ではどうすることもできん。
dialogsBegin.kr: 제가 하려던 말이 그거예요! 다른 영웅들과 다시 만나고 싶긴 한데, 지금 이 모습으로는 할 수 있는 게 많지 않아서요. 헤헤... 하지만 걱정 마시죠! 방법이 하나 떠올랐으니까!
dialogsBegin.nl: As I was going to say! I would love to reunite with my fellow heroes, but I can't do much in my, uh… current form hehe. Never fear! I think I have a possible solution!
dialogsBegin.pl: As I was going to say! I would love to reunite with my fellow heroes, but I can't do much in my, uh… current form hehe. Never fear! I think I have a possible solution!
dialogsBegin.ru: На чём я остановился.. Я бы с радостью присоединился к моим старым друзьям, но не в моей нынешней форме... Но не беспокойся! У меня похоже есть решение!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Cómo iba a decir! Me encantaría reunirme con mis compañeros héroes, pero no puedo hacer mucho en mi, eh... forma actual, jeje. ¡Pero no temas! ¡Creo que tengo una posible solución!
dialogsBegin.sw: As I was going to say! I would love to reunite with my fellow heroes, but I can't do much in my, uh… current form hehe. Never fear! I think I have a possible solution!
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันจะพูดว่า ! ฉันรักที่จะรวมตัวกับวีรบุรุษเพื่อนของฉัน แต่ฉันไม่สามารถทำอะไรได้มากกว่านี้ ... ฉันคิดว่าฉันมีทางออกที่เป็นไปได้!
dialogsBegin.tw: 正如我要說的！我很想和我的英雄們團聚，但我不能以我的，呃……現在的形式做太多，呵呵。從不畏懼！我想我有一個可能的解決方案！
dialogsBegin.vi: Như tôi sẽ nói! Tôi rất muốn được đoàn tụ với những người hùng của mình, nhưng tôi không thể làm được gì nhiều trong hình dạng hiện tại, hehe. Đừng bao giờ sợ hãi! Tôi nghĩ rằng tôi có một giải pháp khả thi!

dialogsBegin.en: I have a list of items I need to create a powerful concoction that might possibly alleviate this curse… OR destroy us all. Want in on it? Don't worry, I'm sure everything will be fine! Bwahaha.
dialogsBegin.ar: I have a list of items I need to create a powerful concoction that might possibly alleviate this curse… OR destroy us all. Want in on it? Don't worry, I'm sure everything will be fine! Bwahaha.
dialogsBegin.br: Eu tenho uma lista de itens que preciso para criar uma mistura poderosa que pode aliviar essa maldição... OU destruir a todos nós. Quer tentar?? Não se preocupe, tenho certeza que vai dar tudo certo! Bwahaha.
dialogsBegin.cns: I have a list of items I need to create a powerful concoction that might possibly alleviate this curse… OR destroy us all. Want in on it? Don't worry, I'm sure everything will be fine! Bwahaha.
dialogsBegin.de: Ich habe eine Liste von Gegenständen, die ich benötige, um ein mächtiges Gebräu herzustellen, das diesen Fluch möglicherweise lindert... ODER uns alle vernichtet. Willst du dabei sein? Keine Sorge, ich bin sicher, alles wird gut! Bwahaha.
dialogsBegin.fi: I have a list of items I need to create a powerful concoction that might possibly alleviate this curse… OR destroy us all. Want in on it? Don't worry, I'm sure everything will be fine! Bwahaha.
dialogsBegin.fil: I have a list of items I need to create a powerful concoction that might possibly alleviate this curse… OR destroy us all. Want in on it? Don't worry, I'm sure everything will be fine! Bwahaha.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je vais avoir besoin de votre aide pour dissiper ma malédiction. J'ai une recette prometteuse. Pourriez-vous me rapporter les ingrédients ?
dialogsBegin.id: Saya memiliki daftar item yang saya butuhkan untuk membuat ramuan yang kuat yang mungkin dapat meringankan kutukan ini ... ATAU menghancurkan kita semua. Mau coba?? Jangan khawatir, saya yakin semuanya akan baik-baik saja! Bwahaha.
dialogsBegin.it: I have a list of items I need to create a powerful concoction that might possibly alleviate this curse… OR destroy us all. Want in on it? Don't worry, I'm sure everything will be fine! Bwahaha.
dialogsBegin.jp: すまんが、私の呪いを解く手伝いをしてくれないか？　方法は既にわかってきているのだ。いくつか材料がいるがね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 저주를 완화할 수 있는 강력한 제조약을 만들려면 재료가 많이 필요해요...우릴 파괴할 수도 있는 위력이죠. 해 보실래요? 걱정하지 마세요, 분명 잘될 거예요! 으하하하.
dialogsBegin.nl: I have a list of items I need to create a powerful concoction that might possibly alleviate this curse… OR destroy us all. Want in on it? Don't worry, I'm sure everything will be fine! Bwahaha.
dialogsBegin.pl: I have a list of items I need to create a powerful concoction that might possibly alleviate this curse… OR destroy us all. Want in on it? Don't worry, I'm sure everything will be fine! Bwahaha.
dialogsBegin.ru: I have a list of items I need to create a powerful concoction that might possibly alleviate this curse… OR destroy us all. Want in on it? Don't worry, I'm sure everything will be fine! Bwahaha.
dialogsBegin.sp: Tengo una lista de objetos que necesito para crear un brebaje poderoso que posiblemente pueda romper esta maldición... O destruirnos a todos. ¿Quieres ayudarme? ¡No te preocupes, estoy seguro de que todo saldrá bien! Buajaja.
dialogsBegin.sw: I have a list of items I need to create a powerful concoction that might possibly alleviate this curse… OR destroy us all. Want in on it? Don't worry, I'm sure everything will be fine! Bwahaha.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันมีรายการของไอเท็มที่ฉันต้องการเพื่อสร้างของที่จะอาจช่วยบรรเทาผลของคำสาปได้ ..หรือมันจะทำลายพวกเราทุกคนแทน ต้องการมันไหม? ไม่ต้องกังวล ฉันมั่นใจว่าทุกอย่างจะเรียบร้อยดี! ฮ่าฮ่า
dialogsBegin.tw: 我這裡有一份材料清單，可以調製出一種強力藥劑，也許能減輕這個詛咒……當然，也可能把我們全炸了。要一起來嗎？別擔心，我很確定一切都會沒事的！哇哈哈哈。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi có một danh sách các nguyên liệu tôi cần để tạo ra một hỗn hợp mạnh mẽ có thể giảm nhẹ lời nguyền này… HOẶC nó sẽ tiêu diệt tất cả chúng ta. Muốn tham gia không anh bạn? Đừng lo lắng, tôi chắc rằng sẽ không sao đâu! Bwahaha.

dialogsAccept.en: Excellent! The first material I will need is a Forsaken Soul. You can collect one from the Zombiger directly West of Darken City.
dialogsAccept.ar: Excellent! The first material I will need is a Forsaken Soul. You can collect one from the Zombiger directly West of Darken City.
dialogsAccept.br: Excelente! O primeiro material que vou precisar é uma Alma Abandonada. Você pode coletar uma dos Zombigers diretamente a oeste da cidade de Darken.
dialogsAccept.cns: 很棒! 我需要的第一个材料是“被遗忘的灵魂”。你可以从达肯西部的矿工幽魂那里收集一个。
dialogsAccept.de: Ausgezeichnet! Das erste Material, das ich brauche, ist eine Forsaken Soul. Du kannst eine von dem Zombiger direkt westlich von Darken City sammeln.
dialogsAccept.fi: Excellent! The first material I will need is a Forsaken Soul. You can collect one from the Zombiger directly West of Darken City.
dialogsAccept.fil: Excellent! The first material I will need is a Forsaken Soul. You can collect one from the Zombiger directly West of Darken City.
dialogsAccept.fr: En premier lieu, il me faut une âme torturée de Zombiger.
dialogsAccept.id: Kerja yang bagus! Bahan pertama yang akan saya butuhkan adalah Forsaken Soul. Anda bisa mendapatkannya dari Zombiger di West of Darken City.
dialogsAccept.it: Excellent! The first material I will need is a Forsaken Soul. You can collect one from the Zombiger directly West of Darken City.
dialogsAccept.jp: 一つ目は生霊の欠片だ。これはゾンビガーというモンスターから入手できると思う。頼めるかな？
dialogsAccept.kr: 좋아, 첫 번째 재료는 잠비거에게서 나온다는 억울한 원혼이야. 잠비거는 다켄 도시 서쪽에 있으니 그들을 처치하고 억울한 원혼을 가져오도록 해.
dialogsAccept.nl: Excellent! The first material I will need is a Forsaken Soul. You can collect one from the Zombiger directly West of Darken City.
dialogsAccept.pl: Excellent! The first material I will need is a Forsaken Soul. You can collect one from the Zombiger directly West of Darken City.
dialogsAccept.ru: Отлично! Первым делом мне нужна Покинутая душа. Отберешь её у Зомбойщика к западу от Даркенбурга.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Excelente! El primer material que necesito es un Alma Abandonada. Puedes conseguirla de los Zombiger que están justo al Oeste de Darken.
dialogsAccept.sw: Excellent! The first material I will need is a Forsaken Soul. You can collect one from the Zombiger directly West of Darken City.
dialogsAccept.th: ยอดเยี่ยม! วัสดุชิ้นแรกที่ฉันต้องการคือ Forsaken Soul คุณสามารถเก็บรวบรวมได้จาก Zombiger โดยตรงทางตะวันตกของ Darken City
dialogsAccept.tw: 很好。第一材料就是在礦工腐屍身上才可以拿到的委屈的怨魂。礦工腐屍就在多墾都市的西邊，消滅他們之後，把委屈的怨魂拿回來吧。
dialogsAccept.vi: Xuất sắc! Vật liệu đầu tiên tôi sẽ cần là một Forsaken Soul. Bạn có thể thu thập một cái từ Zombiger ở phía Tây của Thành phố Darken.

dialogsBegin.en: So, you think you're ready to become a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero? You've come a long way, Magician. I think you're ready.
dialogsBegin.ar: So, you think you're ready to become a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero? You've come a long way, Magician. I think you're ready.
dialogsBegin.br: Você deseja se tornar um Psykeeper? Não é nada fácil. Você percorreu um longo caminho, jovem Mago(a). Acho que você está pronto(a).
dialogsBegin.cns: 精神使者需要坚强的意志和精神力！你能做得到吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Du glaubst also, du bist bereit, ein Nachfolger des Psykeeper Helden zu werden? Du hast einen langen Weg hinter dir, Magier. Ich denke, du bist bereit.

dialogsBegin.fr: Souhaites-tu succéder à Offerep, le Héros des Sorciers ? Tu devrais en être capable, puisque tu es déjà arrivé jusqu'ici...
dialogsBegin.id: Jadi, apakah kamu sudah siap menjadi Penerus Psykeeper Hero? Kamu telah datang jauh, Penyihir. Saya pikir kamu sudah siap.
dialogsBegin.it: So, you think you're ready to become a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero? You've come a long way, Magician. I think you're ready.
dialogsBegin.jp: サイキーパー後継者の道を歩む覚悟はできていますか？では、ご案内します。
dialogsBegin.kr: 사이키퍼 영웅의 후계자가 될 준비가 되셨다고요? 그동안 먼 길을 오셨군요, 매지션님. 확실히, 준비되었을 것 같네요.
dialogsBegin.nl: So, you think you're ready to become a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero? You've come a long way, Magician. I think you're ready.

dialogsBegin.sp: Entonces, ¿crees que estás listo para convertirte en Sucesor de la Héroe Psykeeper? Has recorrido un largo camino, Magician. Creo que estás listo.
dialogsBegin.sw: So, you think you're ready to become a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero? You've come a long way, Magician. I think you're ready.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณคิดว่าคุณพร้อมที่จะเป็นผู้สืบทอดพระเอก Psykeeper แล้วเหรอ? คุณเป็นนักเวทย์มานาน ฉันคิดว่าคุณพร้อมแล้ว
dialogsBegin.tw: 念力師需要堅強的意志和精神力！你能做得到嗎？你已經走到這邊了，魔法使。我想你已經準備好了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Vì vậy, bạn nghĩ rằng bạn đã sẵn sàng để trở thành Người kế vị của Anh hùng Psykeeper? Bạn đã đi một chặng đường dài, Magician. Tôi nghĩ bạn đã sẵn sàng.
