dialogsAccept.ru: I will be watching you, Magician. Good luck!
dialogsAccept.sp: Te estaré observando, Magician. ¡Buena suerte!
dialogsAccept.sw: I will be watching you, Magician. Good luck!
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันจะเฝ้าดูคุณ Magician โชคดี!
dialogsAccept.tw: 我會看著你的，魔法使。祝你好運！
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi sẽ dõi theo bạn, Magician. Chúc may mắn!

dialogsDecline.en: You're giving up now before you've even started?
dialogsDecline.ar: You're giving up now before you've even started?
dialogsDecline.br: Você está desistindo agora antes mesmo de começar?
dialogsDecline.cns: 你还没开始就要放弃了吗？
dialogsDecline.de: Du gibst jetzt auf, bevor du überhaupt angefangen hast?
dialogsDecline.fi: You're giving up now before you've even started?
dialogsDecline.fil: You're giving up now before you've even started?
dialogsDecline.fr: Ce n'est pas si difficile pourtant. comptes-tu déjà abandonner ?
dialogsDecline.id: kamu menyerah sekarang bahkan sebelum kamu memulai?
dialogsDecline.it: You're giving up now before you've even started?
dialogsDecline.jp: 確かに容易な道ではないと話していたと思いますが･･･。やはり辞めるのですか？
dialogsDecline.kr: 시작도 하기 전에 포기하겠다고요?
dialogsDecline.nl: You're giving up now before you've even started?
dialogsDecline.pl: You're giving up now before you've even started?
dialogsDecline.ru: You're giving up now before you've even started?
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Te rindes incluso antes de haber comenzado?
dialogsDecline.sw: You're giving up now before you've even started?
dialogsDecline.th: ยอมแพ้ตั้งแต่ยังไม่เริ่มเลยเหรอ?
dialogsDecline.tw: 你還沒開始就放棄了？
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn đang từ bỏ ngay trước khi bắt đầu sao?

dialogsComplete.en: Yes, very well done, Magician. You've certainly come a long way. You're ready to become a Successor to the Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsComplete.ar: Yes, very well done, Magician. You've certainly come a long way. You're ready to become a Successor to the Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsComplete.br: Sim, muito bem, jovem mago(a). Você certamente percorreu um longo caminho. Você está pronto(a) para se tornar um sucessor do herói Psykeeper.
dialogsComplete.cns: 辛苦你了！果然我没看错人了，你可以成为继承者了！
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm.. Gute Arbeit, ich wusste das du das kannst! Nun bist du als Nachfolger qualifiziert.
dialogsComplete.fi: Yes, very well done, Magician. You've certainly come a long way. You're ready to become a Successor to the Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsComplete.fil: Yes, very well done, Magician. You've certainly come a long way. You're ready to become a Successor to the Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsComplete.fr: Félicitations ! Tu as réussi la première épreuve.
dialogsComplete.id: Ya, bagus sekali, Penyihir. Kamu pasti telah menempuh perjalanan jauh. Kamu siap menjadi Penerus Pahlawan Psikiater.
dialogsComplete.it: Yes, very well done, Magician. You've certainly come a long way. You're ready to become a Successor to the Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsComplete.jp: 最初の試練を無事乗り越えましたね。おめでとうございます。
dialogsComplete.kr: 잘하셨어요, 여기까지 오시다니 정말 대단해요. 이제 사이키퍼 영웅의 후계자가 될 준비가 되었군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Yes, very well done, Magician. You've certainly come a long way. You're ready to become a Successor to the Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsComplete.pl: Yes, very well done, Magician. You've certainly come a long way. You're ready to become a Successor to the Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsComplete.ru: Отлично! Думаю, из тебя получится прекрасный манипулятор.
dialogsComplete.sp: Sí, muy bien hecho, Magician. Has recorrido un largo camino. Estás listo para convertirte en Sucesor de la Héroe Psykeeper.
dialogsComplete.sw: Yes, very well done, Magician. You've certainly come a long way. You're ready to become a Successor to the Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsComplete.th: ใช่ ทำได้ดีมาก Magician คุณมาไกลมากแล้ว คุณพร้อมที่จะเป็นผู้สืบทอดฮีโร่ Psykeeper แล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 辛苦你了！果然我沒看錯人了，你可以成為繼承者了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Vâng, làm rất tốt, Magician. Bạn chắc chắn đã đi một chặng đường dài. Bạn đã sẵn sàng để trở thành Người kế vị Anh hùng Psykeeper.

dialogsFail.en: I've already given you your task, my friend. You must hurry.
dialogsFail.ar: I've already given you your task, my friend. You must hurry.
dialogsFail.br: Já lhe dei sua tarefa, amigo(a). Você deve se apressar.
dialogsFail.cns: 我已经给你分配任务了，我的朋友。你得尽快
dialogsFail.de: Ich habe dir deine Aufgabe bereits erteilt, mein Freund. Du musst dich beeilen.
dialogsFail.fi: I've already given you your task, my friend. You must hurry.
dialogsFail.fil: I've already given you your task, my friend. You must hurry.
dialogsFail.fr: Je t'ai déjà donné une tâche, mon ami. Tu dois faire vite.
dialogsFail.id: Saya sudah memberi kamu tugasmu, temanku. Kamu harus bergegas.
dialogsFail.it: I've already given you your task, my friend. You must hurry.
dialogsFail.jp: 既に任務を渡しました。急いでください。
dialogsFail.kr: 제가 이미 임무를 드렸잖아요. 서두르세요.
dialogsFail.nl: I've already given you your task, my friend. You must hurry.
dialogsFail.pl: I've already given you your task, my friend. You must hurry.
dialogsFail.ru: I've already given you your task, my friend. You must hurry.
dialogsFail.sp: Ya te he dado tu tarea, amigo mío. Date prisa.
dialogsFail.sw: I've already given you your task, my friend. You must hurry.
dialogsFail.th: ฉันได้ให้คุณไปแล้ว เพื่อน รีบหน่อย
dialogsFail.tw: 我已經把你的任務交給你了，我的朋友。你必須快點。
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi đã giao cho bạn nhiệm vụ, bạn tôi. Bạn phải nhanh lên.

name.th: ผู้สืบทอดของวีรบุรุษ - แหวน
name.vi: Người kế nhiệm của Anh hùng - Chiếc nhẫn

description.en: Meet with Radyon, the Jester Wise Man at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris. First though, slay Ren and get the ring from him. He can be found in the Fantasy Desert south of Saint City.
description.ar: Meet with Radyon, the Jester Wise Man at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris. First though, slay Ren and get the ring from him. He can be found in the Fantasy Desert south of Saint City.
description.br: Vá encontrar o sábio Jester Radion, que vive na Fonte dos Mortos em Flaris. Porém, antes disso, encontre Ren e pegue o anel dele. Ele está no Deserto da Fantasia ao Sul da Cidade de Saint.
description.cns: 你去<亡者之泉>找<拉迪温>吧！可是找他之前，你应该要先去猎杀，晨光南部<梦幻沙漠>的<莲>
description.de: Mach dich auf den Weg und suche den Jester Weisen Radion an der Quelle der verstorbenen Seelen in Flaris. Zuvor musst du Ren besiegen, der in der Wüste der Illusionen im Süden von Saint Morning lebt, um den Ring zurückzubekommen.
description.fi: Meet with Radyon, the Jester Wise Man at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris. First though, slay Ren and get the ring from him. He can be found in the Fantasy Desert south of Saint City.
description.fil: Meet with Radyon, the Jester Wise Man at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris. First though, slay Ren and get the ring from him. He can be found in the Fantasy Desert south of Saint City.
description.fr: Récupérer l'Anneau de Kerenen volé par Ren, dans le Désert de l'Imagination de Saint Morning, puis le rapporter au Sage des Jesters Radyan à la Fontaine des Défunts de Flaris.
description.id: Temui Radyon, Jester Wise Man di Fountain of Dead Person di Flaris. Pertama, bunuh Ren dan dapatkan cincin itu darinya. Dia dapat ditemukan di Fantasy Desert di selatan Saint City.
description.it: Meet with Radyon, the Jester Wise Man at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris. First though, slay Ren and get the ring from him. He can be found in the Fantasy Desert south of Saint City.
description.jp: フラリス＜魂の泉＞にいるジェスター賢者＜ラディオン＞の所に行こう。その前に、＜セイントモーニング＞南部の＜夢幻の砂漠＞に住んでいる＜レン＞からリングを取り戻さないといけないな。
description.kr: 플라리스 망자의 샘에 있는 제스터 현자 라디온을 만나세요. 그 전에 렌을 처치하고 반지를 되찾으세요. 렌은 세인트 모닝의 남쪽, 몽환의 사막에 살고 있습니다.
description.nl: Meet with Radyon, the Jester Wise Man at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris. First though, slay Ren and get the ring from him. He can be found in the Fantasy Desert south of Saint City.
description.pl: Meet with Radyon, the Jester Wise Man at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris. First though, slay Ren and get the ring from him. He can be found in the Fantasy Desert south of Saint City.
description.ru: Нужно поговорить с Радеоном, шутовским мудрецом, у фонтана Мертвеца во Фларинции. Но сначала придется убить Потрошонка и забрать у него кольцо. Этот негодяй прячется в Нереальной пустыне, южнее Санто.
description.sp: Reúnete con Radyon, el Sabio Jester en el Manantial de Almas en Flaris. Primero, vence a Ren y quítale el anillo. Se le puede encontrar en el Desierto Fantasía al sur de Saint.
description.sw: Meet with Radyon, the Jester Wise Man at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris. First though, slay Ren and get the ring from him. He can be found in the Fantasy Desert south of Saint City.
description.th: ไปพบกับ Jester Wise Man ชื่อ Radyon ที่เมือง Fountain of Dead Person ใน Flaris ก่อนอื่นให้กำจัด Ren และเอาแหวนมาจากเขา สามารถพบเขาได้ที่ Fantasy Desert ทางตอนใต้ของ Saint City
description.tw: 你去亡者之泉找拉迪溫吧！可是找他之前，你應該要先去獵殺，聖音特南部夢幻沙漠的蓮
description.vi: Gặp gỡ Radyon, Người đàn ông khôn ngoan của Jester tại Fountain of Dead Person ở Flaris. Trước tiên, hãy giết Ren và lấy chiếc nhẫn từ anh ta. Anh ta có thể được tìm thấy ở Fantasy Desert ở phía nam Saint City.

dialogsBegin.en: Here is a Letter of Recommendation. You will need to give this to Radyon, the Jester Wise Man in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.ar: Here is a Letter of Recommendation. You will need to give this to Radyon, the Jester Wise Man in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.br: Parabéns! Você passou no teste. Aqui está a carta de recomendação. Por favor, vá em busca de Radion, o sábio Jester, na Fonte dos Mortos em Flaris, e leve a carta a ele.
dialogsBegin.cns: 恭喜你通过测试。拿这个“推荐书”去[亡者之泉]找[暗杀贤者]拉迪温吧！
dialogsBegin.de: Nimm dieses Empfehlungsschreiben. Ohne dieses Schreiben wird dir Radion, der Jester Weise, nicht viel Beachtung schenken. Bring es ihm.
dialogsBegin.fi: Here is a Letter of Recommendation. You will need to give this to Radyon, the Jester Wise Man in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.fil: Here is a Letter of Recommendation. You will need to give this to Radyon, the Jester Wise Man in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.fr: Félicitations, voici une lettre de recommandation confirmant que tu es sur la voie de devenir Jester.
dialogsBegin.id: Ini Letter of Recommendation. Kamu harus memberikan ini ke Radyon, Jester Wise Man di Flaris.
dialogsBegin.it: Here is a Letter of Recommendation. You will need to give this to Radyon, the Jester Wise Man in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.jp: テストは終了しました。あなたの資質を認めます。どうぞこの推薦書を受け取ってください。これを持って、フラリス＜魂の泉＞にいるジェスター賢者＜ラディオン＞の元へ行ってください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 자아, 추천서입니다. 플라리스에 있는 제스터 현자 라디온님께 드리세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Here is a Letter of Recommendation. You will need to give this to Radyon, the Jester Wise Man in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.pl: Here is a Letter of Recommendation. You will need to give this to Radyon, the Jester Wise Man in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.ru: Вот тебе рекомендательное письмо. Отправляйся с ним во Фларинцию, к мудрецу Радеону.
dialogsBegin.sp: Toma esta Carta de Recomendación. Tendrás que entregársela a Raydon, el Sabio Jester en Flaris.
dialogsBegin.sw: Here is a Letter of Recommendation. You will need to give this to Radyon, the Jester Wise Man in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.th: นี่คือจดหมายแนะนำตัว คุณจะต้องให้สิ่งนี้แก่ Jester Wise Man ชื่อ Radyon ใน Flaris
dialogsBegin.tw: 恭喜你通過測試。拿這個『推薦書』去亡者之泉找操偶師賢者拉迪溫吧！
dialogsBegin.vi: Đây là một lá thư giới thiệu. Bạn sẽ cần đưa cái này cho Radyon, người đàn ông khôn ngoan của Jester trong Flaris.

dialogsBegin.en: Radyon can be found at the Fountain of Dead Person north of the River of Weeping. Before meeting with him, you need to find the ring he lost and return it to him.
dialogsBegin.ar: Radyon can be found at the Fountain of Dead Person north of the River of Weeping. Before meeting with him, you need to find the ring he lost and return it to him.
dialogsBegin.br: Ele não é a mesma pessoa que o grande sábio Radion. Você deve encontrar o sábio Jester Radion. Por favor, não se esqueça disso. Mas antes...
dialogsBegin.cns: 不要与[大贤者]雷迪温搞混了喔。你要去找的是[亡者之泉]的[暗杀贤者]拉迪温喔！
dialogsBegin.de: Du kannst Radion im nördlichen Teil von Flaris, an der Quelle der verstorbenen Seelen, finden. Doch bevor du ihn triffst, solltest du den Ring finden, den er verloren hat.
dialogsBegin.fi: Radyon can be found at the Fountain of Dead Person north of the River of Weeping. Before meeting with him, you need to find the ring he lost and return it to him.
dialogsBegin.fil: Si Radyon ay matatagpuan sa Fountain of Dead Person sa hilaga ng Ilog ng Pag-iyak. Bago makipagkita sa kanya, kailangan mong hanapin ang singsing na nawala niya at ibalik ito sa kaniya.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il faut que tu l'apportes à Radyan, le Sage des Jesters qui se trouve à la Fontaine des Défunts de Flaris. Mais tout d'abord.
dialogsBegin.id: Radyon dapat ditemukan di Fountain of Dead Person di utara River of Weeping. Sebelum bertemu dengannya, kamu perlu menemukan cincin yang hilang dan mengembalikannya kepadanya.
dialogsBegin.it: Radyon can be found at the Fountain of Dead Person north of the River of Weeping. Before meeting with him, you need to find the ring he lost and return it to him.
dialogsBegin.jp: 大賢者＜ラディオン＞様と名前が同じで間違いやすいので、ご注意を。ジェスター賢者＜ラディオン＞です。決してお忘れなきように。あ、その前に・・・
dialogsBegin.kr: 라디온은 플라리스의 망자의 샘, 낙루의 강 북쪽에 있답니다. 라디온을 만나기 전, 그가 잃어버린 반지를 되찾아 같이 전해주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Radyon can be found at the Fountain of Dead Person north of the River of Weeping. Before meeting with him, you need to find the ring he lost and return it to him.
dialogsBegin.pl: Radyon can be found at the Fountain of Dead Person north of the River of Weeping. Before meeting with him, you need to find the ring he lost and return it to him.
dialogsBegin.ru: Ты найдешь его у фонтана Мертвеца, к северу от Плакучей реки. Но не торопись на встречу с ним! Прежде раздобудь кольцо, которое он ищет уже много лет.
dialogsBegin.sp: Puedes encontrar a Radyon en el Manantial de Almas al norte del Río del Llanto. Antes de verlo, deberás encontrar el anillo que perdió y entrégaselo.
dialogsBegin.sw: Radyon can be found at the Fountain of Dead Person north of the River of Weeping. Before meeting with him, you need to find the ring he lost and return it to him.
dialogsBegin.th: สามารถพบ Radyon ได้ที่ Fountain of Dead Person ทางตอนเหนือของแม่น้ำ Weeping ก่อนที่จะพบกับเขาคุณต้องหาแหวนที่เขาเสียไปและส่งคืนให้เขา
dialogsBegin.tw: 不要與大賢者拉迪溫搞混了喔。你要去找的是亡者之泉的操偶師賢者拉迪溫喔！
dialogsBegin.vi: Có thể tìm thấy Radyon ở Fountain of Dead Person ở phía bắc River of Weeping. Trước khi gặp anh ta, bạn cần tìm lại chiếc nhẫn mà anh ta đánh mất và trả lại cho anh ta.

dialogsBegin.en: Far to the south of Saint City, lies the Fantasy Desert. It is believed that a gentleman named Ren is in possession of the ring. Slay Ren and bring the ring to Radyon.
dialogsBegin.ar: Far to the south of Saint City, lies the Fantasy Desert. It is believed that a gentleman named Ren is in possession of the ring. Slay Ren and bring the ring to Radyon.
dialogsBegin.br: Bem ao sul da Cidade de Saint fica o Deserto da Fantasia. Acredita-se que um cavalheiro chamado Ren está de posse do anel. Livre-se de Ren e traga o anel para Radion.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你应该要去猎杀，晨光南部[梦幻沙漠]的“莲”，然后把“拉迪温”的戒指找回去给他吧！
dialogsBegin.de: Im südlichen Teil von Saint Morning befindet sich die Wüste der Illusionen. Dort gibt es ein Masquerpet namens Ren. Man sagt, Ren sei im Besitz des und wird ihn nicht freiwillig hergeben. Überzeuge ihn mit deiner Waffe!
dialogsBegin.fi: Far to the south of Saint City, lies the Fantasy Desert. It is believed that a gentleman named Ren is in possession of the ring. Slay Ren and bring the ring to Radyon.
dialogsBegin.fil: Far to the south of Saint City, lies the Fantasy Desert. It is believed that a gentleman named Ren is in possession of the ring. Slay Ren and bring the ring to Radyon.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu dois retrouver Ren dans le Désert de l'Imagination de Saint Morning. Il a volé un anneau de grande valeur appartenant à Kerenen.
dialogsBegin.id: Jauh di selatan Saint City, terletak Fantasy Desert. Diyakini bahwa seorang pria bernama Ren memiliki cincin tersebut. Bunuh Ren dan bawa cincin itu ke Radyon.
dialogsBegin.it: Far to the south of Saint City, lies the Fantasy Desert. It is believed that a gentleman named Ren is in possession of the ring. Slay Ren and bring the ring to Radyon.
dialogsBegin.jp: セイントモーニングの南部＜夢幻の砂漠＞に住んでいる＜レン＞という者を捕まえて＜ラディオン＞が失くしたリングを取り戻し、それを持って行くとよいでしょう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 세인트 모닝 남쪽으로 가면 몽환의 사막이 있어요. 전해지는 말로는, 렌이라는 녀석이 반지를 가지고 있다고 해요. 렌을 처치하고 반지를 회수해 라디온에게 가져가세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Far to the south of Saint City, lies the Fantasy Desert. It is believed that a gentleman named Ren is in possession of the ring. Slay Ren and bring the ring to Radyon.
dialogsBegin.pl: Far to the south of Saint City, lies the Fantasy Desert. It is believed that a gentleman named Ren is in possession of the ring. Slay Ren and bring the ring to Radyon.
dialogsBegin.ru: На юге от Санто раскинулась Нереальная пустыня. Говорят, что кольцом владеет некий господин по имени Потрошонок. Убей его и верни кольцо Радеону, хорошо?
dialogsBegin.sp: Muy al sur de Saint, se encuentra el Desierto Fantasía. Se cree que un caballero llamado Ren está en posesión del anillo. Derrota a Ren y entrega al anillo a Radyon.
dialogsBegin.sw: Far to the south of Saint City, lies the Fantasy Desert. It is believed that a gentleman named Ren is in possession of the ring. Slay Ren and bring the ring to Radyon.
dialogsBegin.th: ไกลไปทางทิศใต้ของ Saint City อยู่ที่ Fantasy Desert เป็นที่เชื่อกันว่าสุภาพบุรุษชื่อ Ren เป็นผู้ครอบครองแหวน ฆ่า Ren และนำแหวนไปให้ Radyon
dialogsBegin.tw: 你應該要去獵殺，聖音特南部夢幻沙漠的蓮，然後把拉迪溫的戒指找回去給他吧！
dialogsBegin.vi: Xa về phía nam của Saint City là Fantasy Desert. Người ta tin rằng một quý ông tên Ren đang sở hữu chiếc nhẫn. Hãy giết Ren và mang chiếc nhẫn cho Radyon.

dialogsAccept.en: I hope I'm right about you. Don't let me down!
dialogsAccept.ar: I hope I'm right about you. Don't let me down!
dialogsAccept.br: Espero que seu sonho se torne realidade.
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你一路顺风！
dialogsAccept.de: Ich hoffe, ich täusche mich nicht in dir. Lass mich nicht hängen!
dialogsAccept.fi: I hope I'm right about you. Don't let me down!
dialogsAccept.fil: I hope I'm right about you. Don't let me down!
dialogsAccept.fr: Ne sous-estime jamais tes capacités ! Tu dois être fort, ou tu ne deviendras jamais un Héros.
dialogsAccept.id: Aku harap aku menilaimu dengan benar. Jangan mengecewakanku!
dialogsAccept.it: I hope I'm right about you. Don't let me down!
dialogsAccept.jp: あなたの進む道に栄光があることを願っています。
dialogsAccept.kr: 한번 믿어 볼게요. 실망하게 하지 마세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: I hope I'm right about you. Don't let me down!
dialogsAccept.pl: I hope I'm right about you. Don't let me down!
dialogsAccept.ru: Я в тебя верю. Не подведи меня!
dialogsAccept.sp: Espero estar en lo cierto contigo. ¡No me decepciones!
dialogsAccept.sw: I hope I'm right about you. Don't let me down!
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันหวังว่าฉันจะมองคุณถูก อย่าทำให้ฉันผิดหวัง!
dialogsAccept.tw: 祝你一路順風！
dialogsAccept.vi: Hy vọng tôi nghĩ đúng về bạn. Đừng làm tôi thất vọng!

dialogsDecline.en: I guess I was wrong about you. You're not ready to walk the path of the successor of the Jester hero. See me again when you think you're ready.
dialogsDecline.ar: I guess I was wrong about you. You're not ready to walk the path of the successor of the Jester hero. See me again when you think you're ready.
dialogsDecline.br: Você não tem confiança? Não há nada impossível se você tiver confiança. Espero que você faça a escolha sábia.
dialogsDecline.cns: 没信心吗？只要有信心没有不可能的任务啦！我相信你一定可以的！
dialogsDecline.de: Ich schätze, ich habe mich in dir getäuscht. Du bist noch nicht bereit für diese Herausforderung. Komm zu mir zurück, sobald du es bist.
dialogsDecline.fi: I guess I was wrong about you. You're not ready to walk the path of the successor of the Jester hero. See me again when you think you're ready.
dialogsDecline.fil: I guess I was wrong about you. You're not ready to walk the path of the successor of the Jester hero. See me again when you think you're ready.
dialogsDecline.fr: N'as-tu pas confiance ? Si tu as confiance rien ne te sera impossible. J'espère que tu prendras une sage décision.
dialogsDecline.id: Kurasa aku salah tentangmu. Kamu belum siap untuk berjalan di jalan sebagai penerus Jester Hero. Temui aku lagi ketika kamu sudah siap.
dialogsDecline.it: I guess I was wrong about you. You're not ready to walk the path of the successor of the Jester hero. See me again when you think you're ready.
dialogsDecline.jp: 自信がないのですか？　時には困難に立ち向かう事も必要ですよ。勇気ある判断をしていただきたいですね。
dialogsDecline.kr: 제가 잘못 봤네요. 당신은 제스터 영웅의 계승자가 될 준비가 안 된 것 같군요. 준비되었을 때 다시 찾아오세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: I guess I was wrong about you. You're not ready to walk the path of the successor of the Jester hero. See me again when you think you're ready.
dialogsDecline.pl: I guess I was wrong about you. You're not ready to walk the path of the successor of the Jester hero. See me again when you think you're ready.
dialogsDecline.ru: Видно, рано тебе на Путь шута. Возвращайся, когда наберешься сил и смелости.
dialogsDecline.sp: Supongo que estaba equivocado contigo. No estas listo para tomar el camino de sucesor del Héroe Jester. Ven a verme cuando creas que estás listo.
dialogsDecline.sw: I guess I was wrong about you. You're not ready to walk the path of the successor of the Jester hero. See me again when you think you're ready.
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันเดาว่าฉันมองคุณผิด คุณยังไม่พร้อมที่จะเดินไปตามเส้นทางผู้สืบทอดของ Jester Hero มาพบฉันอีกครั้งเมื่อคุณคิดว่าคุณพร้อม
dialogsDecline.tw: 沒信心嗎？只要有信心沒有不可能的任務啦！我相信你一定可以的！
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi đoán tôi đã sai về bạn. Bạn chưa sẵn sàng bước đi trên con đường của người kế vị anh hùng Jester. Hẹn gặp lại tôi khi bạn nghĩ rằng bạn đã sẵn sàng.

dialogsComplete.en: Is that… the ring? My goodness, thank you so much! This ring belongs to the Jester Hero Curenen. Ren has always wanted to acquire this ring, or so the story goes.
dialogsComplete.ar: Is that… the ring? My goodness, thank you so much! This ring belongs to the Jester Hero Curenen. Ren has always wanted to acquire this ring, or so the story goes.
dialogsComplete.br: Este é... o Anel?! Meu Deus, muito obrigado! Na verdade, este anel pertence ao Herói Jester Curenen. Ren sempre quis adquirir este anel, ou assim diz a história.
dialogsComplete.cns: 这就是…那个戒指吗？我的天，感激不尽！这个其实是暗杀英雄[凯奈]的戒指。[莲]为了得到它不择手段。
dialogsComplete.de: Ist das... der Ring? Meine Güte, ich danke Dir vielmals! Dieser Ring gehört dem Jester Helden Kerenen. Ren wollte diesen Ring schon immer haben. So erzählt man sich zumindest.
dialogsComplete.fi: Is that… the ring? My goodness, thank you so much! This ring belongs to the Jester Hero Curenen. Ren has always wanted to acquire this ring, or so the story goes.
dialogsComplete.fil: Is that… the ring? My goodness, thank you so much! This ring belongs to the Jester Hero Curenen. Ren has always wanted to acquire this ring, or so the story goes.
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh ! C'est... c'est l'anneau que portait Kerenen pendant la Grande Guerre ! Ren a toujours voulu posséder cet anneau, cela n'a pas dû être facile de l'obtenir...
dialogsComplete.id: Apakah itu… cincin? Ya ampun, terima kasih banyak! Cincin ini milik Jester Hero Curenen. Ren selalu ingin mendapatkan cincin ini, atau begitulah ceritanya.
dialogsComplete.it: Is that… the ring? My goodness, thank you so much! This ring belongs to the Jester Hero Curenen. Ren has always wanted to acquire this ring, or so the story goes.
dialogsComplete.jp: おお、リングを見つけてくれたのか。実はこのリングは、ジェスター英雄の＜カエネン＞様のリングなのだよ。＜レン＞のやつは以前からこれを欲しがっていたのだ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 그거... 제 반지인가요? 세상에, 정말 감사합니다! 이 반지는 제스터 영웅 커에넨님의 것이죠. 렌이 항상 이 반지를 탐냈다고들 하더군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Is that… the ring? My goodness, thank you so much! This ring belongs to the Jester Hero Curenen. Ren has always wanted to acquire this ring, or so the story goes.
dialogsComplete.pl: Is that… the ring? My goodness, thank you so much! This ring belongs to the Jester Hero Curenen. Ren has always wanted to acquire this ring, or so the story goes.
dialogsComplete.ru: То самое кольцо!.. Спасибо тебе огромное! Оно принадлежало Киму Джерри, герою-шуту. Потрошонок еще тогда положил на него глаз…
dialogsComplete.sp: Eso es… ¿el anillo? Dios mío, ¡muchísimas gracias! Este anillo le pertenecía al Héroe Jester Curenen. Ren siempre ha querido este anillo, o eso dice la historia.
dialogsComplete.sw: Is that… the ring? My goodness, thank you so much! This ring belongs to the Jester Hero Curenen. Ren has always wanted to acquire this ring, or so the story goes.
dialogsComplete.th: นั่นคือ... แหวนใช่ไหม? โอ้พระเจ้า ขอบคุณมาก! แหวนวงนี้เป็นของ Jester Hero ชื่อ Curenen เพราะว่า Ren อยากจะครอบครองแหวนวงนี้ เรื่องต่างๆ เลยเกิดขึ้น
dialogsComplete.tw: 啊！你幫我把戒指找回來了啊…呵呵～其實啊，這個戒指是英雄操偶師凱奈的戒指啦。平時蓮為了想要這個東西不擇手段…
dialogsComplete.vi: Đó là… chiếc nhẫn? Chúa ơi, cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều! Chiếc nhẫn này thuộc về Jester Hero Curenen. Ren luôn muốn có được chiếc nhẫn này, hoặc câu chuyện cứ thế diễn ra.

dialogsComplete.en: After the war ended, and Curenen passed on, Ren searched for this ring for hundreds of years. He finally discovered it a couple of years ago.
dialogsComplete.ar: After the war ended, and Curenen passed on, Ren searched for this ring for hundreds of years. He finally discovered it a couple of years ago.
dialogsComplete.br: Depois que a guerra terminou e Kerenen morreu, Ren procurou este anel por centenas de anos e finalmente o encontrou a alguns anos atrás. Obrigado.
dialogsComplete.cns: <凯奈>过世之后，他好像为了找这个戒指找了好几百年，总之～谢谢你啦！
dialogsComplete.de: Nach dem Krieg, und nachdem Kerenen weiterzog, suchte Ren Hunderte Jahre  nach diesem Ring. Vor einigen Jahren hat er ihn endlich gefunden.
dialogsComplete.fi: After the war ended, and Curenen passed on, Ren searched for this ring for hundreds of years. He finally discovered it a couple of years ago.
dialogsComplete.fil: After the war ended, and Curenen passed on, Ren searched for this ring for hundreds of years. He finally discovered it a couple of years ago.
dialogsComplete.fr: En tout cas, merci infiniment. Cet anneau a énormément de valeur.
dialogsComplete.id: Setelah perang berakhir, dan Curenen meninggal, Ren mencari cincin ini selama ratusan tahun. Dia akhirnya menemukannya beberapa tahun yang lalu.
dialogsComplete.it: After the war ended, and Curenen passed on, Ren searched for this ring for hundreds of years. He finally discovered it a couple of years ago.
dialogsComplete.jp: 戦争が終わり、＜カエネン＞様がなくなってから何百年もの間、安置されていたこのリングを、あろうことか盗み出し、隠し持っていたのだ。本当にありがとう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 전쟁이 끝나고 커에넨님이 세상을 뜨자, 그때부터 렌은 이 반지를 찾아 수 백 년을 헤매고 다녔던 모양입니다. 그러다 몇 년 전에 마침내 반지를 발견한 거죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: After the war ended, and Curenen passed on, Ren searched for this ring for hundreds of years. He finally discovered it a couple of years ago.
dialogsComplete.pl: After the war ended, and Curenen passed on, Ren searched for this ring for hundreds of years. He finally discovered it a couple of years ago.
dialogsComplete.ru: А потом война закончилась. Вскоре Ким умер. Потрошонок всерьез взялся за поиски кольца - и вот, несколько лет назад, нашел.
dialogsComplete.sp: Después de que la guerra terminara y de que Curenen muriera, Ren busco este anillo por cientos de años. Y hace un par de años finalmente lo encontró.
dialogsComplete.sw: After the war ended, and Curenen passed on, Ren searched for this ring for hundreds of years. He finally discovered it a couple of years ago.
dialogsComplete.th: หลังจากสงครามสิ้นสุดลงและ Curenen ได้เสียชีวิตลง Ren ก็ค้นหาแหวนนี้มานับร้อยๆ ปี ในที่สุดเขาก็ค้นพบมันเมื่อสองสามปีที่ผ่านมา
dialogsComplete.tw: 凱奈過世之後，他好像為了找這個戒指找了好幾百年，反正～謝謝你啦！
dialogsComplete.vi: Sau khi chiến tranh kết thúc, và Curenen qua đời, Ren đã tìm kiếm chiếc nhẫn này trong hàng trăm năm. Cuối cùng anh ấy đã phát hiện ra nó cách đây vài năm.

dialogsFail.en: Have you met Lorein? If you did, you should have something for me. Think carefully.
dialogsFail.ar: Have you met Lorein? If you did, you should have something for me. Think carefully.
dialogsFail.br: Você conheceu Lorein? E você não me trouxe nada mesmo tendo encontrado com ela? Hmm... Tem algo que você deve me trazer. Pense com cuidado.
dialogsFail.cns: 你有见到<萝丽安>吗？那怎么什么都没带来呢？嗯...她应该会叫你拿东西给我的啊～仔细的想一下啦！
dialogsFail.de: Hast du Lorein getroffen? Falls ja, solltest du etwas für mich haben. Denk genau nach.
dialogsFail.fi: Have you met Lorein? If you did, you should have something for me. Think carefully.
dialogsFail.fil: Have you met Lorein? If you did, you should have something for me. Think carefully.
dialogsFail.fr: Les âmes de nombreuses personnes vont et viennent ici à la Fontaine des Défunts. C'est ici la limite entre la vie et la mort.
dialogsFail.id: Apakah kamu bertemu dengan Lorein? Jika iya, kamu pasti memiliki sesuatu untukku. Pikirkan baik-baik.
dialogsFail.it: Have you met Lorein? If you did, you should have something for me. Think carefully.
dialogsFail.jp: ＜ロレイン＞には会ったのか？　ならば、何か持って来るはずの物がないか、よく考えてほしいのだが？
dialogsFail.kr: 로레인을 만났어요? 그렇다면 제게 줄 무언가가 있을 텐데요. 잘 생각해 보세요.
dialogsFail.nl: Have you met Lorein? If you did, you should have something for me. Think carefully.
dialogsFail.pl: Have you met Lorein? If you did, you should have something for me. Think carefully.
dialogsFail.ru: Тебя прислала Лорена? Правда? Тогда у тебя должно кое-что быть для меня.
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Te reuniste con Lorein? Si lo hiciste, deberías tener algo para mí. Piénsalo bien.
dialogsFail.sw: Have you met Lorein? If you did, you should have something for me. Think carefully.
dialogsFail.th: คุณได้พบกับ Lorein แล้วงั้นรึ? ถ้าคุณได้เจอเธอแล้วต้องมีบางอย่างมอบให้ฉันสิ ลองคิดดูดีๆ
dialogsFail.tw: 你有見到蘿麗安嗎？那怎麼什麼都沒帶來呢？嗯…他應該會叫你拿東西給我的啊～仔細的想一下啦！
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn đã gặp Lorein chưa? Nếu bạn đã gặp, bạn nên có một cái gì đó cho tôi. Nghĩ kỹ đi.

dialogsBegin.en: I was trapped by the monsters while researching and hid behind these rocks here. Ahh, so you are searching for the super hero?
dialogsBegin.ar: I was trapped by the monsters while researching and hid behind these rocks here. Ahh, so you are searching for the super hero?
dialogsBegin.br: Eu estava preso pelos monstros enquanto pesquisava e me escondi atrás dessas rochas aqui. Achaben disse que eu sei sobre os Heróis? Ahh, então você está procurando o Super Herói??
dialogsBegin.cns: I was trapped by the monsters while researching and hid behind these rocks here. Ahh, so you are searching for the super hero?
dialogsBegin.de: Ich wurde bei meinen Nachforschungen von den Monstern gefangen und habe mich hinter diesen Felsen hier versteckt. Ahh, du suchst also den Superhelden?
dialogsBegin.fi: I was trapped by the monsters while researching and hid behind these rocks here. Ahh, so you are searching for the super hero?
dialogsBegin.fil: I was trapped by the monsters while researching and hid behind these rocks here. Ahh, so you are searching for the super hero?
dialogsBegin.fr: Ça me rappelle la dernière fois où j'étais encerclé par les Driller. Zoro était arrivé !
dialogsBegin.id: Saya terjebak oleh monster saat meneliti dan bersembunyi di balik bebatuan ini di sini. Ahh, jadi kamu sedang mencari pahlawan super??
dialogsBegin.it: I was trapped by the monsters while researching and hid behind these rocks here. Ahh, so you are searching for the super hero?
dialogsBegin.jp: あ、貴方がドリルを倒してくれたのですね。ありがとうございます。最近ドリルが増えすぎてまともに研究ができなかったのでとても助かりました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 조사하다가 괴물들에게 포위당해서, 여기 이 바위 뒤에 숨어있었어요. 아, 슈퍼 히어로를 찾고 계신다고요?
dialogsBegin.nl: I was trapped by the monsters while researching and hid behind these rocks here. Ahh, so you are searching for the super hero?
dialogsBegin.pl: I was trapped by the monsters while researching and hid behind these rocks here. Ahh, so you are searching for the super hero?
dialogsBegin.ru: I was trapped by the monsters while researching and hid behind these rocks here. Ahh, so you are searching for the super hero?
dialogsBegin.sp: Los monstruos me rodearon mientras investigaba y me escondí detrás de estas rocas. Ahh, ¿¿así que estás buscando al superhéroe??
dialogsBegin.sw: I was trapped by the monsters while researching and hid behind these rocks here. Ahh, so you are searching for the super hero?
dialogsBegin.th: พวกมันสเตอร์มันล้อมไปหมด ตอนที่ทำการวิจัย ฉันจึงซ่อนตัวอยู่หลังหินเหล่านี้ อ้อ งั้นคุณกำลังตามหาผู้กล้าใช่ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 我在研究時被怪物困住了，只好躲在這些岩石後面。啊，所以你是在找那位超級英雄？
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đã sập bẫy của lũ quái vật khi đang tìm mẫu vật nghiên cứu và trốn sau những tảng đá. Ahh, vậy là bạn đang đi tìm các siêu anh hùng à?

dialogsBegin.en: I briefly came across him earlier while high up in the Gouthan Mountains. He was in a hurry to save a young boy trapped in Eastern Darkon. Maybe you could head there?
dialogsBegin.ar: I briefly came across him earlier while high up in the Gouthan Mountains. He was in a hurry to save a young boy trapped in Eastern Darkon. Maybe you could head there?
dialogsBegin.br: Eu o encontrei brevemente mais cedo enquanto estava no alto das Montanhas Gouthan. Ele estava com pressa para salvar um menino preso no Leste de Darkon. Talvez você possa encontrá-lo lá!
dialogsBegin.cns: 早些时候，我在高处的永恒森林短暂地遇到了他。他正急着去救一个被困在达肯东部的小男孩。或许你可以去那里找找他？
dialogsBegin.de: Ich bin ihm vorhin kurz begegnet, als ich hoch oben in den Gouthan Mountains war. Er hatte es eilig, einen kleinen Jungen zu retten, der im östlichen Darkon gefangen war. Vielleicht könntest du dorthin gehen?
dialogsBegin.fi: I briefly came across him earlier while high up in the Gouthan Mountains. He was in a hurry to save a young boy trapped in Eastern Darkon. Maybe you could head there?
dialogsBegin.fil: I briefly came across him earlier while high up in the Gouthan Mountains. He was in a hurry to save a young boy trapped in Eastern Darkon. Maybe you could head there?
dialogsBegin.fr: Si j'ai bien compris il est parti aider un garçon emprisonné à l'Est de Darkon…
dialogsBegin.id: Saya sempat menemukannya lebih awal saat berada di Gouthan Mountains. Dia sedang terburu-buru untuk menyelamatkan seorang anak laki-laki yang terperangkap di Eastern Darkon. Mungkin Anda bisa menuju ke sana?
dialogsBegin.it: I briefly came across him earlier while high up in the Gouthan Mountains. He was in a hurry to save a young boy trapped in Eastern Darkon. Maybe you could head there?
dialogsBegin.jp: ところで僕に何か御用ですか？　ふむふむ……英雄を探しているということですね。私も何度かお会いしたことがあります。
dialogsBegin.kr: 저도 예전에 고우단 산맥 높은 곳에서 그를 잠시 만난 적이 있어요. 그는 다콘 동부에 갇힌 어느 소년을 구하러 가는 중이었죠. 혹시 그곳으로 가보면 어때요?
dialogsBegin.nl: I briefly came across him earlier while high up in the Gouthan Mountains. He was in a hurry to save a young boy trapped in Eastern Darkon. Maybe you could head there?
dialogsBegin.pl: I briefly came across him earlier while high up in the Gouthan Mountains. He was in a hurry to save a young boy trapped in Eastern Darkon. Maybe you could head there?
dialogsBegin.ru: I briefly came across him earlier while high up in the Gouthan Mountains. He was in a hurry to save a young boy trapped in Eastern Darkon. Maybe you could head there?
dialogsBegin.sp: Me lo encontré cuando estaba en lo alto de las Montañas Gouthan. Tenía prisa por salvar a un niño atrapado al Este de Darkon. ¿Tal vez podrías dirigirte allí?
dialogsBegin.sw: I briefly came across him earlier while high up in the Gouthan Mountains. He was in a hurry to save a young boy trapped in Eastern Darkon. Maybe you could head there?
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันแวบเข้ามาหาเขาก่อนหน้านี้ ในขณะที่อยู่ในภูเขา Gouthan ที่ค่อนข้างสูง เขาดูกระตือรืนร้นเพื่อที่จะช่วยเด็กหนุ่มคนหนึ่งที่ติดอยู่ใน Eastern Darkon บางทีคุณอาจจะไปที่นั่นได้ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 早些時候，我在古坦山脈高處時曾短暫地遇到過他，他急於拯救一個被困在東得肯的小男孩，也許你可以去那裡？
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đã tình cờ gặp anh ấy trước đó khi ở trên cao trên dãy núi Gouthan. Anh ta đã vội vàng để cứu một cậu bé bị mắc kẹt ở Đông Darkon. Có lẽ bạn có thể đến đó?

dialogsAccept.en: So you are going there? You are quite brave! This mysterious hero has to be somewhere near where the boy is in Eastern Darkon
dialogsAccept.ar: So you are going there? You are quite brave! This mysterious hero has to be somewhere near where the boy is in Eastern Darkon
dialogsAccept.br: Então você vai lá? Você é bem corajoso! Este Herói misterioso deve estar em algum lugar perto de onde o menino está no leste de Darkon.
dialogsAccept.cns: 所以你要去那里？真是个勇敢的人！这个神秘的英雄一定是在达肯东部小男孩所在的地方附近。
dialogsAccept.de: Sie gehen also dorthin? Du bist ziemlich mutig! Dieser mysteriöse Held muss irgendwo in der Nähe des Jungen in Ost-Darkon sein.
dialogsAccept.fi: So you are going there? You are quite brave! This mysterious hero has to be somewhere near where the boy is in Eastern Darkon
dialogsAccept.fil: So you are going there? You are quite brave! This mysterious hero has to be somewhere near where the boy is in Eastern Darkon
dialogsAccept.fr: Il doit encore y être, si vous partez maintenant vous le rattraperez peut-être.
dialogsAccept.id: Jadi, Anda akan pergi ke sana? Anda cukup berani! Pahlawan misterius ini harus berada di suatu tempat di dekat tempat bocah itu berada di Eastern Darkon
dialogsAccept.it: So you are going there? You are quite brave! This mysterious hero has to be somewhere near where the boy is in Eastern Darkon
dialogsAccept.jp: 確か監獄に閉じ込められてしまった少年を救うためにその周辺を探ると言っていました。探してみてはいかがですか？
dialogsAccept.kr: 그곳에 가보시려고요? 꽤 용감하시네요! 그 수수께끼의 영웅은 다콘 동부 어딘가에 있을 겁니다.
dialogsAccept.nl: So you are going there? You are quite brave! This mysterious hero has to be somewhere near where the boy is in Eastern Darkon
dialogsAccept.pl: So you are going there? You are quite brave! This mysterious hero has to be somewhere near where the boy is in Eastern Darkon
dialogsAccept.ru: So you are going there? You are quite brave! This mysterious hero has to be somewhere near where the boy is in Eastern Darkon
dialogsAccept.sp: ¿Vas a ir allí? ¡Eres bastante valiente! Ese héroe misterioso tiene que estar cerca del niño al Este de Darkon.
dialogsAccept.sw: So you are going there? You are quite brave! This mysterious hero has to be somewhere near where the boy is in Eastern Darkon
dialogsAccept.th: คุณจะไปที่นั่นใช่มั้ย ? เยี่ยม คุณกล้าหาญมาก! ฮีโร่ลึกลับคนนี้ต้องอยู่ที่ไหนสักแห่งใกล้กับสถานที่ที่เด็กชายอยู่ที่ Eastern Darkon
dialogsAccept.tw: 你要去那個地方看看嗎？他為了要救出被關在監獄裡的少年，好像躲在那附近。那麼，祝你可以順利找到他。
dialogsAccept.vi: Vì vậy, bạn sẽ đến đó? Bạn khá dũng cảm! Anh hùng bí ẩn này phải ở đâu đó gần nơi cậu bé đang ở trong Eastern Darkon

dialogsDecline.en: Don't blame you. I prefer to stay out of trouble like that myself anyway!
dialogsDecline.ar: Don't blame you. I prefer to stay out of trouble like that myself anyway!
dialogsDecline.br: Não te culpo. De qualquer maneira, eu também prefiro ficar longe de problemas como esses!
dialogsDecline.cns: 不要自责。反正我更喜欢远离这样的麻烦!
dialogsDecline.de: Ich mache Ihnen keine Vorwürfe. Ich halte mich sowieso lieber aus solchen Schwierigkeiten heraus!
dialogsDecline.fi: Don't blame you. I prefer to stay out of trouble like that myself anyway!
dialogsDecline.fil: Don't blame you. I prefer to stay out of trouble like that myself anyway!
dialogsDecline.fr: Si vous ne faites pas vite, vous allez le rater.
dialogsDecline.id: Jangan salahkan Anda. Saya sendiri lebih suka menghindari masalah seperti itu!
dialogsDecline.it: Don't blame you. I prefer to stay out of trouble like that myself anyway!
dialogsDecline.jp: まあ、確かに雲をつかむような話ではありますけどね。
dialogsDecline.kr: 그럴 만도 하죠. 저도 그런 문제엔 엮이고 싶지 않거든요!
dialogsDecline.nl: Don't blame you. I prefer to stay out of trouble like that myself anyway!
dialogsDecline.pl: Don't blame you. I prefer to stay out of trouble like that myself anyway!
dialogsDecline.ru: Don't blame you. I prefer to stay out of trouble like that myself anyway!
dialogsDecline.sp: No te culpes. ¡Yo también prefiero no meterme en problemas como ese!
dialogsDecline.sw: Don't blame you. I prefer to stay out of trouble like that myself anyway!
dialogsDecline.th: อย่าตำหนิเลยน่ะ ฉันชอบที่จะหลีกเลี่ยงปัญหาเอง!
dialogsDecline.tw: 沒怪你，我只是聽到那樣的事情而已！哈哈。
dialogsDecline.vi: Đừng trách bạn. Dù sao thì tôi vẫn thích tự mình tránh khỏi những rắc rối như thế!

dialogsComplete.en: Hush! Be very quiet! I, Zoro the Magnificent!.....am in the middle of a very important mission!
dialogsComplete.ar: Hush! Be very quiet! I, Zoro the Magnificent!.....am in the middle of a very important mission!
dialogsComplete.br: Silêncio! Fique quieto! Eu, Zoro, o Magnífico!.....estou no meio de uma missão muito importante!
dialogsComplete.cns: 安静! 要非常安静! 我，伟大的佐罗！.....，正在进行一项非常重要的任务！
dialogsComplete.de: Sei still! Seid ganz still! Ich, Zoro der Prächtige!..... bin gerade mitten in einer sehr wichtigen Mission!
dialogsComplete.fi: Hush! Be very quiet! I, Zoro the Magnificent!.....am in the middle of a very important mission!
dialogsComplete.fil: Hush! Be very quiet! I, Zoro the Magnificent!.....am in the middle of a very important mission!
dialogsComplete.fr: Chuuut ! Vous allez nous faire prendre !
dialogsComplete.id: Hush! Diam! Aku, Zoro yang Luar Biasa!..... Saya berada di tengah-tengah misi yang sangat penting!
dialogsComplete.it: Hush! Be very quiet! I, Zoro the Magnificent!.....am in the middle of a very important mission!
dialogsComplete.jp: む、君は何者だ？　なぜ私がここにいるとわかった？
dialogsComplete.kr: 쉿! 조용히 해요! 나, 위대한 조로는... 아주 중요한 임무를 수행하는 중이니까!
dialogsComplete.nl: Hush! Be very quiet! I, Zoro the Magnificent!.....am in the middle of a very important mission!
dialogsComplete.pl: Hush! Be very quiet! I, Zoro the Magnificent!.....am in the middle of a very important mission!
dialogsComplete.ru: Шшшш! Веди себя тише! Я Зоро Великолепный!... и я выполняю очень важное поручение!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Cállate! ¡Estate muy callado! ¡Yo, Zoro el Magnífico!... ¡Estoy en medio de una misión muy importante!
dialogsComplete.sw: Hush! Be very quiet! I, Zoro the Magnificent!.....am in the middle of a very important mission!
dialogsComplete.th: ห๊ะ! มันเงียบมาก! ฉัน และ Zoro มาครึ่งทางของมิชชั่นที่สำคัญมาก !
dialogsComplete.tw: 噓！小聲一點吧！因為我正在進行一個很重要的任務。
dialogsComplete.vi: Im đi! Hãy yên lặng! Tôi, Zoro the Magnificent! ..... đang thực hiện một nhiệm vụ rất quan trọng!

dialogsFail.en: Look around the prison in which the boy is locked in East Darkon. I'm sure the hero will be there.
dialogsFail.ar: Look around the prison in which the boy is locked in East Darkon. I'm sure the hero will be there.
dialogsFail.br: Olhe ao redor da prisão em que o menino está trancado no Leste de Darkon. Tenho certeza que o Herói estará lá.
dialogsFail.cns: 在达肯东部小男孩被关的监狱里看看。我相信英雄会在那里。
dialogsFail.de: Sieh dich in dem Gefängnis um, in dem der Junge in Ost-Darkon eingesperrt ist. Ich bin sicher, der Held wird dort sein.
dialogsFail.fi: Look around the prison in which the boy is locked in East Darkon. I'm sure the hero will be there.
dialogsFail.fil: Look around the prison in which the boy is locked in East Darkon. I'm sure the hero will be there.
dialogsFail.fr: Cherchez Zoro près d'une prison.
dialogsFail.id: Lihatlah sekeliling penjara tempat bocah itu dikurung di East Darkon. Saya yakin pahlawan itu akan ada di sana.
dialogsFail.it: Look around the prison in which the boy is locked in East Darkon. I'm sure the hero will be there.
dialogsFail.jp: 少年が閉じ込められているという監獄の周辺が一番怪しいと思います。まずはそこを探してみては？
dialogsFail.kr: 다콘 동쪽에 소년이 갇혀있는 감옥 주변을 잘 살펴보세요. 그가 있을 겁니다.
dialogsFail.nl: Look around the prison in which the boy is locked in East Darkon. I'm sure the hero will be there.
dialogsFail.pl: Look around the prison in which the boy is locked in East Darkon. I'm sure the hero will be there.
dialogsFail.ru: Look around the prison in which the boy is locked in East Darkon. I'm sure the hero will be there.
dialogsFail.sp: Mira alrededor de la prisión en la que está encerrado el niño al Este de Darkon. Estoy seguro de que el héroe estará allí.
dialogsFail.sw: Look around the prison in which the boy is locked in East Darkon. I'm sure the hero will be there.
dialogsFail.th: มองไปรอบ ๆ คุกที่เด็กถูกขังอยู่ใน East Darkon ฉันแน่ใจว่าฮีโร่จะอยู่ที่นั่น
dialogsFail.tw: 仔細確認少年被關的監獄四周吧。他一定就在那裡。
dialogsFail.vi: Nhìn quanh nhà tù nơi cậu bé bị nhốt ở Đông Darkon. Tôi chắc chắn rằng anh hùng sẽ ở đó.

name.th: ผู้สืบทอดของ Hero -Scroll-
name.tw: 英雄的繼承者 - 卷軸

description.en: Deliver the Hall Document to Segho in the Leren Mountains.
description.ar: Deliver the Hall Document to Segho in the Leren Mountains.
description.br: Segho é um alpinista, então talvez ele esteja em algum lugar das Montanhas Leren. Por favor, encontre-o e entregue este Documento do Templo.
description.cns: 去乐雅山脉找找看吧~把这印章与文件拿给佩辛就可以了！
description.de: Segho ist ein Bergsteiger, daher kann es sein, dass er im Leren Gebirge ist. Bitte such ihn und bring ihm das Hall Document.
description.fi: Deliver the Hall Document to Segho in the Leren Mountains.
description.fil: Deliver the Hall Document to Segho in the Leren Mountains.
description.fr: Explorer les Montagnes nord de Leren et trouver Regho pour lui remettre le Document du Hall de Roentel.
description.id: Kirimkan Dokumen Hall ke Segho di Pegunungan Leren.
description.it: Deliver the Hall Document to Segho in the Leren Mountains.
description.jp: レルエン山脈を探してみよう。そこにいるセグホにこの印章文章を渡しましょう。
description.kr: 레르엔 산맥에 있는 세그호에게 전당 문서를 전달하세요.
description.nl: Deliver the Hall Document to Segho in the Leren Mountains.
description.pl: Deliver the Hall Document to Segho in the Leren Mountains.
description.ru: Нужно отнести документы Сего. Он бродит в Леренских горках.
description.sp: Entrega el Documento de la Sala a Segho en las Montañas Leren.
description.sw: Deliver the Hall Document to Segho in the Leren Mountains.
description.th: ส่ง Hall Document ไปยัง Segho ในเทือกเขา Leren Mountains
description.tw: 去勒倫山脈找找看吧~把這印章與文件拿給佩辛就可以了！
description.vi: Giao Hall Document cho Segho ở Leren Mountains.

dialogsBegin.en: The rightful caretaker of the Hall Document is Segho of the Pesin family. They have been managing Roentel’s Hall of the Martial Arts for generations.
dialogsBegin.ar: The rightful caretaker of the Hall Document is Segho of the Pesin family. They have been managing Roentel’s Hall of the Martial Arts for generations.
dialogsBegin.br: Agora deixe-me dizer o que você deve fazer por enquanto. Por favor, entregue esta relíquia para Segho. Ele é da família Pesin, que tem cuidado do Templo das artes militares de Roentel por gerações.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你要帮忙的事情是…把这遗物拿给【佩辛】！
dialogsBegin.de: Nun lass mich dir erklären was du nun tun musst. Bitte bring dieses Relikt zu Segho. Er ist von der Pesin Familie, welche die Kampfsporthalle von Roentel seit Generationen verwaltet.
dialogsBegin.fi: The rightful caretaker of the Hall Document is Segho of the Pesin family. They have been managing Roentel’s Hall of the Martial Arts for generations.
dialogsBegin.fil: The rightful caretaker of the Hall Document is Segho of the Pesin family. They have been managing Roentel’s Hall of the Martial Arts for generations.
dialogsBegin.fr: Maintenant il faut remettre cette relique à son propriétaire. Son premier propriétaire était le Roentel, mais désormais une personne s'occupe des reliques du Héros des Moines.
dialogsBegin.id: Pengurus yang sah dari Dokumen Hall adalah Segho dari keluarga Pesin. Mereka telah mengelola Aula Seni Bela Diri Roentel selama beberapa generasi.
dialogsBegin.it: The rightful caretaker of the Hall Document is Segho of the Pesin family. They have been managing Roentel’s Hall of the Martial Arts for generations.
dialogsBegin.jp: おぬしにやってほしいことを伝えよう。この聖遺物をロエンテール様の聖遺物を管理しているペシン家のセグホに渡してほしいのだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 전당 문서의 정당한 소유자는 페신 가문의 세그호입니다. 페신 가문은 오랫동안 로엔텔의 무술 전당을 관리했죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: The rightful caretaker of the Hall Document is Segho of the Pesin family. They have been managing Roentel’s Hall of the Martial Arts for generations.
dialogsBegin.pl: The rightful caretaker of the Hall Document is Segho of the Pesin family. They have been managing Roentel’s Hall of the Martial Arts for generations.
dialogsBegin.ru: Нужно отдать документы их полноправному владельцу - Сего Песину. Он возглавляет Школу боевых искусств имени Арнолли Терминатти.
dialogsBegin.sp: El legítimo cuidador del Documento de la Sala es Segho de la familia Pesin. Han estado administrando la Sala de Artes Marciales de Roentel durante generaciones.
dialogsBegin.sw: The rightful caretaker of the Hall Document is Segho of the Pesin family. They have been managing Roentel’s Hall of the Martial Arts for generations.
dialogsBegin.th: ผู้ดูแลที่ถูกต้องของ Hall Document คือ Segho จากครอบครัว Pesin พวกเขาได้ดูแล Hall of the Martial Arts ของ Roentel มาหลายชั่วอายุคน
dialogsBegin.tw: 武術館文書理應由佩辛家族的賽格保管。他們家世世代代都在管理羅瓦特武術館。
dialogsBegin.vi: Người trông nom hợp pháp của Hall Document là Segho của gia đình Pesin. Họ đã quản lý Roentel’s Hall of the Martial Arts qua nhiều thế hệ.

dialogsBegin.en: He is out of the Hall right now, doing some adventuring of his own in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.ar: He is out of the Hall right now, doing some adventuring of his own in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.br: Mas eu acho que ele não está na prefeitura agora. Ele gosta muito de montanhas, e eu ouvi dizer que ele está aqui em Flaris no momento.
dialogsBegin.cns: 佩辛他可能在山上，因为他热爱登山，你可能要走多点路了！
dialogsBegin.de: Allerdings glaube ich, das er zur Zeit nicht dort ist. Er liebt die Berge und ich habe gehört, das er zur Zeit in Flaris ist.
dialogsBegin.fi: He is out of the Hall right now, doing some adventuring of his own in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.fil: He is out of the Hall right now, doing some adventuring of his own in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.fr: Son nom est Regho, il est de la famille Pesin qui dirige le hall des arts militaires de Roentel. Mais Regho est aussi un passionné d'alpinisme, et je crois qu'il ne se trouve pas au Hall en ce moment.
dialogsBegin.id: Dia keluar dari Aula sekarang, melakukan petualangannya sendiri di Flaris.
dialogsBegin.it: He is out of the Hall right now, doing some adventuring of his own in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.jp: ところが、セグホは山が大好きでな。フラリスでこの秘伝書が発見されたとのデマで、この辺に来ているようなのじゃが・・・。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그렇지만 세그호는 지금 전당을 떠나 플라리스에서 모험 중이랍니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: He is out of the Hall right now, doing some adventuring of his own in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.pl: He is out of the Hall right now, doing some adventuring of his own in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.ru: Эта школа расположена в том самом здании, где когда-то был первый спортивный зал героя.
dialogsBegin.sp: Está fuera de la Sala ahora, está de aventuras por Flaris.
dialogsBegin.sw: He is out of the Hall right now, doing some adventuring of his own in Flaris.
dialogsBegin.th: เขาออกจากฮอลล์ไปแล้วตอนนี้ กำลังผจญภัยในแบบของเขาที่ Flaris อยู่น่ะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 佩辛他可能在山上，因為他熱愛登山，你可能要走多點路了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Anh ấy đang ở ngoài Hall ngay bây giờ, đang thực hiện một số cuộc phiêu lưu của riêng mình ở Flaris

dialogsBegin.en: He’s an accomplished mountaineer, so you may be able to find him in the Leren Mountains. Present him with the Hall Document when you find him.
dialogsBegin.ar: He’s an accomplished mountaineer, so you may be able to find him in the Leren Mountains. Present him with the Hall Document when you find him.
dialogsBegin.br: Ele é um alpinista, então talvez esteja em algum lugar das Montanhas Leren. Por favor, encontre-o e entregue este Documento do Templo.
dialogsBegin.cns: 麻烦你去乐雅山脉找找看~把这印章文件拿给佩辛就可以了！
dialogsBegin.de: Er ist ein Bergsteiger und das könnte bedeuten, das er irgendwo im Leren Gebirge ist. Bitte such ihn und bring ihm das Hall Document.
dialogsBegin.fi: He’s an accomplished mountaineer, so you may be able to find him in the Leren Mountains. Present him with the Hall Document when you find him.
dialogsBegin.fil: He’s an accomplished mountaineer, so you may be able to find him in the Leren Mountains. Present him with the Hall Document when you find him.
dialogsBegin.fr: J'ai entendu dû dire qu'il était parti gravir les Montagnes nord de Leren, à Flaris. Il te faudra sûrement escalader la montagne également si tu souhaites le rejoindre.
dialogsBegin.id: Dia pendaki gunung yang ulung, jadi kamu mungkin bisa menemukannya di Pegunungan Leren. Hadir dia dengan Dokumen Hall ketika kamu menemukannya.
dialogsBegin.it: He’s an accomplished mountaineer, so you may be able to find him in the Leren Mountains. Present him with the Hall Document when you find him.
dialogsBegin.jp: 山が好きだから、山に登っているじゃろうな。レルエン山脈を探してみるがいい。とにかくセグホにこの秘伝書を渡してくれ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 워낙 산을 좋아하는 산악인이니, 아마 레르엔 산맥에 가면 찾을 수 있을 겁니다. 세그호를 만나 전당 문서를 전해 주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: He’s an accomplished mountaineer, so you may be able to find him in the Leren Mountains. Present him with the Hall Document when you find him.
dialogsBegin.pl: He’s an accomplished mountaineer, so you may be able to find him in the Leren Mountains. Present him with the Hall Document when you find him.
dialogsBegin.ru: В школе прекрасные тренеры, и Сего может часто отлучаться из нее, чтобы заняться любимым делом - скалолазанием. Поищи его в Леренских горках, хорошо?
dialogsBegin.sp: Es un montañero experimentado, así que es posible que puedas encontrarlo en las Montañas Leren. Enséñale el Documento de la Sala cuando le encuentres.
dialogsBegin.sw: He’s an accomplished mountaineer, so you may be able to find him in the Leren Mountains. Present him with the Hall Document when you find him.
dialogsBegin.th: เขาเป็นนักปีนเขาที่ประสบความสำเร็จ ดังนั้นคุณอาจจะพบเขาใน Leren Mountains โชว์ Hall Document ให้เขาดูเมื่อคุณพบเขา
dialogsBegin.tw: 麻煩你去勒倫山脈找找看~把這印章文件拿給佩辛就可以了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Anh ấy là một nhà leo núi cừ khôi, vì vậy bạn có thể tìm thấy anh ấy ở Leren Mountains. Đưa cho anh ta Hall Document khi bạn tìm thấy anh ta.

dialogsAccept.en: Good luck!
dialogsAccept.ar: Good luck!
dialogsAccept.br: Boa sorte!
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你好运！
dialogsAccept.de: Viel Glück!
dialogsAccept.fi: Good luck!
dialogsAccept.fil: Sana suwertehin ka!
dialogsAccept.fr: Bonne chance !
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga berhasil!
dialogsAccept.it: Good luck!
dialogsAccept.jp: では、頼んだぞ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 행운을 빌어요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Good luck!
dialogsAccept.pl: Powodzenia!
dialogsAccept.ru: Удачи!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Buena suerte!
dialogsAccept.sw: Good luck!
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้โชคดี!
dialogsAccept.tw: 好運！
dialogsAccept.vi: Chúc bạn may mắn!

dialogsDecline.en: Very well, then. Perhaps someone truly worthy of becoming a Billposter will come along to deliver this for me...
dialogsDecline.ar: Very well, then. Perhaps someone truly worthy of becoming a Billposter will come along to deliver this for me...
dialogsDecline.br: Você não faz idéia de como esta relíquia é valiosa. Claro, eu não quero pedir para um humano entregá-la. Você que nem mesmo tem idéia do valor dessa relíquia. Você não merece cumprir esta tarefa.
dialogsDecline.cns: 英雄的遗物可是很珍贵的~不过，你不想帮我拿给他就算了…
dialogsDecline.de: Du hast keine Ahnung wie wertvoll das Relikt ist. In Ordnung, ich kann keinen Menschen fragen, der die Wichtigkeit dieser Lieferung nicht versteht. Du verdienst es nicht, das zu erledigen.
dialogsDecline.fi: Very well, then. Perhaps someone truly worthy of becoming a Billposter will come along to deliver this for me...
dialogsDecline.fil: Very well, then. Perhaps someone truly worthy of becoming a Billposter will come along to deliver this for me...
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu n'as pas idée de la valeur de cette relique. Il est vraiment important de la rapporter à Regho.
dialogsDecline.id: Baiklah kalau begitu. Mungkin seseorang yang benar-benar layak menjadi Billposter akan datang untuk menyampaikan ini untukku...
dialogsDecline.it: Very well, then. Perhaps someone truly worthy of becoming a Billposter will come along to deliver this for me...
dialogsDecline.jp: 英雄の聖遺物はしっかりとした管理者の手にゆだねる必要がある。面倒がらずにきちんと後継者の義務を果たすのじゃ！
dialogsDecline.kr: 싫으면 어쩔 수 없지요. 언젠가 진정한 빌포스터 영웅이 나타나 전달해주겠죠...
dialogsDecline.nl: Very well, then. Perhaps someone truly worthy of becoming a Billposter will come along to deliver this for me...
dialogsDecline.pl: Very well, then. Perhaps someone truly worthy of becoming a Billposter will come along to deliver this for me...
dialogsDecline.ru: Понятно... Что ж, придется подождать кого-нибудь более достойного звания атлета...
dialogsDecline.sp: Está bien. Tal vez alguien realmente digno de convertirse en Billposter me lo venga a entregar...
dialogsDecline.sw: Very well, then. Perhaps someone truly worthy of becoming a Billposter will come along to deliver this for me...
dialogsDecline.th: ดีมาก บางทีคนที่สมควรจะเป็น Billposter จริงๆ จะเดินทางมาเพื่อมอบมันให้กับฉัน...
dialogsDecline.tw: 英雄的遺物可是很珍貴的~不過，你不想幫我拿給他就算了…
dialogsDecline.vi: Thôi được rồi. Có lẽ ai đó thực sự xứng đáng trở thành Billposter sẽ đến để giao cái này cho tôi ...

dialogsComplete.en: Surprised to run into somebody else this high up. I’m looking for Roentel’s Hall Document, you wouldn’t happen to have heard about it… well, what d’ya know...
dialogsComplete.ar: Surprised to run into somebody else this high up. I’m looking for Roentel’s Hall Document, you wouldn’t happen to have heard about it… well, what d’ya know...
dialogsComplete.br: Ah? Como você me encontrou? Eu vim para Flaris porque ouvi um rumor que esse documento estava aqui em algum lugar, e o rumor estava certo! Ha ha ha!
dialogsComplete.cns: 你是怎么找到我的呢？可真有你的！
dialogsComplete.de: Oh? Wie hast du mich gefunden? Ich bin nach Flaris gekommen, weil mir ein Gerücht zu Ohren gekommen ist, dass das Dokument hier irgendwo sein soll und es scheint zu stimmen!
dialogsComplete.fi: Surprised to run into somebody else this high up. I’m looking for Roentel’s Hall Document, you wouldn’t happen to have heard about it… well, what d’ya know...
dialogsComplete.fil: Surprised to run into somebody else this high up. I’m looking for Roentel’s Hall Document, you wouldn’t happen to have heard about it… well, what d’ya know...
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh... C'est le... Merci infiniment ! Je le cherchais depuis des années.
dialogsComplete.id: Terkejut bertemu orang lain setinggi ini. Saya mencari Dokumen Aula Roentel, kamu tidak akan pernah mendengarnya ... yah, apa yang kamu tahu ...
dialogsComplete.it: Surprised to run into somebody else this high up. I’m looking for Roentel’s Hall Document, you wouldn’t happen to have heard about it… well, what d’ya know...
dialogsComplete.jp: あら？おれっちに何か用け？おお、この文書は！文書がフラリスにあるという噂を聞いたけどただの噂ではなかったみてぇだな。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이렇게 높은 곳에서 사람을 만나다니 놀랍군요. 저는 로엔텔의 전당 문서를 찾고 있었는데… 혹시 들어보신 적 있나요… 혹시나 해서...
dialogsComplete.nl: Surprised to run into somebody else this high up. I’m looking for Roentel’s Hall Document, you wouldn’t happen to have heard about it… well, what d’ya know...
dialogsComplete.pl: Surprised to run into somebody else this high up. I’m looking for Roentel’s Hall Document, you wouldn’t happen to have heard about it… well, what d’ya know...
dialogsComplete.ru: Надо же! Не ожидал встретить людей на такой высоте! Не знаешь, пока я бродил в горах, никому не удалось одолеть Лойфа Дунгрена? Да что ты говоришь! Не может быть!
dialogsComplete.sp: Estoy sorprendido de encontrarme con alguien a esta altura. Estoy buscando el Documento de la Sala de Roentel, no habrás oído hablar de él... bueno, qué vas a saber...
dialogsComplete.sw: Surprised to run into somebody else this high up. I’m looking for Roentel’s Hall Document, you wouldn’t happen to have heard about it… well, what d’ya know...
dialogsComplete.th: ประหลาดใจจริงๆ ที่พบคนที่สามารถปีนขึ้นมาได้สูงขนาดนี้น่ะ ฉันกำลังมองหา Hall Document ของ Roentel อยู่คุณคงจะไม่เคยได้ยินเรื่องนี้มาก่อน อืมม แล้วคุณรู้อะไรบ้างล่ะ...
dialogsComplete.tw: 真沒想到會在這麼高的地方遇到別人。我正在找羅瓦特武術館文書，你該不會聽說過吧……哎呀，真巧……
dialogsComplete.vi: Ngạc nhiên khi tình cờ gặp ai đó quan trọng. Tôi đang tìm Hall Document của Roentel, bạn chưa tình cờ nghe về nó bao giờ… à, bạn biết đấy…

dialogsComplete.en: Thanks for bringing this back to us, now I can finally get back to the Hall. Say, I knew I had a good reason to bring this along. Let’s see... *rummaging*
dialogsComplete.ar: Thanks for bringing this back to us, now I can finally get back to the Hall. Say, I knew I had a good reason to bring this along. Let’s see... *rummaging*
dialogsComplete.br: Muito obrigado! Finalmente posso voltar para o hall! Acho que sou bastante precavido, porque eu trouxe isso caso precisasse... Onde está... *remexendo*
dialogsComplete.cns: 真的很感谢你，终于能回到爆咒练习场了！！为了今天我已经准备好久了，稍等一下……练习场在到底在哪里呢！？
dialogsComplete.de: Vielen Dank! Endlich kann ich zur Halle zurück! Ich habe in weiser Voraussicht das hier mitgebracht.. wo ist es denn.. *rumwühl*
dialogsComplete.fi: Thanks for bringing this back to us, now I can finally get back to the Hall. Say, I knew I had a good reason to bring this along. Let’s see... *rummaging*
dialogsComplete.fil: Thanks for bringing this back to us, now I can finally get back to the Hall. Say, I knew I had a good reason to bring this along. Let’s see... *rummaging*
dialogsComplete.fr: J'apprécie énormément ce que tu as fait ! Je commençais à désespérer de retrouver un jour ce document.
dialogsComplete.id: Terima kasih telah membawa ini kembali kepada kami, sekarang saya akhirnya bisa kembali ke Aula. Katakanlah, saya tahu saya punya alasan bagus untuk membawa ini. Mari kita lihat... *rummaging*
dialogsComplete.it: Thanks for bringing this back to us, now I can finally get back to the Hall. Say, I knew I had a good reason to bring this along. Let’s see... *rummaging*
dialogsComplete.jp: あんがと。んだばもう帰らんとなぁ。そだ、ひょっとしてこんなこともあろうかと持ってきといたもんがあるだよ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 정말 감사합니다. 이제 전당으로 돌아갈 수 있겠군요. 아, 이걸 챙겨오길 잘했죠. 어디 보자… *뒤적뒤적*
dialogsComplete.nl: Thanks for bringing this back to us, now I can finally get back to the Hall. Say, I knew I had a good reason to bring this along. Let’s see... *rummaging*
dialogsComplete.pl: Thanks for bringing this back to us, now I can finally get back to the Hall. Say, I knew I had a good reason to bring this along. Let’s see... *rummaging*
dialogsComplete.ru: Наконец-то я полноправный владелец Школы! Кстати... А я все гадал, зачем захватил с собой этот свиток... У меня словно предчувствие было.
dialogsComplete.sp: Gracias por devolvernos esto, ahora ya puedo volver a la Sala. Sabía que había una buena razón para traer esto. Veamos… *hurgando*
dialogsComplete.sw: Thanks for bringing this back to us, now I can finally get back to the Hall. Say, I knew I had a good reason to bring this along. Let’s see... *rummaging*
dialogsComplete.th: ขอบคุณที่นำสิ่งนี้กลับมาให้เรา ตอนนี้ฉันก็สามารถกลับไปที่ฮอลล์ได้แล้ว พูดได้ว่าฉันมีเหตุผลที่สมควรจะนำสิ่งนี้ไปด้วย ไหนดูหน่อยซิ... *ค้นกระจุยกระจาย*
dialogsComplete.tw: 真的很感謝你，終於能回到爆咒練習場囉！！為了今天我已經準備好久了，稍等一下……練習場在到底在哪裡呢！？
dialogsComplete.vi: Cảm ơn vì đã mang điều này trở lại với chúng tôi, bây giờ cuối cùng tôi cũng có thể quay lại Hall. Giả sử, tôi biết tôi có lý do chính đáng để mang theo điều này. Để xem nào ... * lục lọi *

dialogsComplete.en: There you go. Every Billposter in my family line possessed this Scroll. Now it’s yours.
dialogsComplete.ar: There you go. Every Billposter in my family line possessed this Scroll. Now it’s yours.
dialogsComplete.br: Oh, aqui está. Este é o pergaminho que somente os sucessores na minha família podem ter. Agora eu o estou entregando a você. Será o comprovante que mostra que você é reconhecido como um sucessor.
dialogsComplete.cns: 我给你的卷轴，请记得要好好保管喔！ 这是你已经成为了英雄的继承者的证明！
dialogsComplete.de: Oh, da bist du ja. Diese Schriftrolle erhalten nur die Nachfolger meiner Familie. Nun gebe ich sie dir. Es ist der Beleg, das du als Nachfolger würdig bist.
dialogsComplete.fi: There you go. Every Billposter in my family line possessed this Scroll. Now it’s yours.
dialogsComplete.fil: There you go. Every Billposter in my family line possessed this Scroll. Now it’s yours.
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh, voici quelque chose pour te récompenser de tes efforts. Ceci est le Parchemin que seuls les descendants de ma famille peuvent avoir. Il t'appartient désormais.
dialogsComplete.id: Ini dia. Setiap Billposter di garis keluarga saya memiliki Scroll ini. Sekarang milikmu.
dialogsComplete.it: There you go. Every Billposter in my family line possessed this Scroll. Now it’s yours.
dialogsComplete.jp: えっとぉ･･･、あったあった。これは俺の家に伝わる巻物でな、ビルポスター後継者を目指すものに、次の道を指し示すもんだ。どうか受け取ってくんろ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 아. 여기 있군요. 우리 가문의 빌포스터에게 대대로 내려오는 이 두루마리를 당신께 드리죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: There you go. Every Billposter in my family line possessed this Scroll. Now it’s yours.
dialogsComplete.pl: There you go. Every Billposter in my family line possessed this Scroll. Now it’s yours.
dialogsComplete.ru: Вот, пожалуйста. Такой свиток был у всех атлетов в нашей семье. Теперь и у тебя будет.
dialogsComplete.sp: Ahí tienes. Todos los Billposters de mi línea familiar poseían este Pergamino. Ahora es tuyo.
dialogsComplete.sw: There you go. Every Billposter in my family line possessed this Scroll. Now it’s yours.
dialogsComplete.th: เจอละ ทุกคนในตระกูล Billposter ของฉันครอบครอง Scroll นี้ แต่ในตอนนี้มันเป็นของคุณแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 我給你的卷軸，請記得要好好保管喔！這是你已經成為了英雄的繼承者的證明！
dialogsComplete.vi: Của bạn đây. Mọi Billposter trong dòng họ của tôi đều sở hữu Scroll này. Bây giờ nó là của bạn.

dialogsFail.en: Ahh, Leren Mountains. The root of Flaris itself, perfect for surveying every spot on the map.
dialogsFail.ar: Ahh, Leren Mountains. The root of Flaris itself, perfect for surveying every spot on the map.
dialogsFail.br: As Montanhas Lerem são a raiz e o tronco de Flaris. Elas ficam a 3.000 metros acima do nível do mar, e... Blá blá blá...
dialogsFail.cns: 乐雅山脉。帕里的根源，非常适合观测地图上的每个地点。
dialogsFail.de: Ahh, das Leren Gebirge. Die Wurzel von Flaris selbst, perfekt, um jeden Punkt auf der Karte zu vermessen.
dialogsFail.fi: Ahh, Leren Mountains. The root of Flaris itself, perfect for surveying every spot on the map.
dialogsFail.fil: Ahh, Leren Mountains. The root of Flaris itself, perfect for surveying every spot on the map.
dialogsFail.fr: Les montagnes de Leren sont les racines et le tronc de Flaris. Elles culminent à une altitude de 3000 mètre au-dessus du niveau de la mer !
dialogsFail.id: Ahh, Pegunungan Leren. Akar Flaris itu sendiri, sempurna untuk mensurvei setiap tempat di peta.
dialogsFail.it: Ahh, Leren Mountains. The root of Flaris itself, perfect for surveying every spot on the map.
dialogsFail.jp: レルエン山はぁ～♪、フラリスのぉ～名山～♪、あ～ヨイヨイ。
dialogsFail.kr: 아아, 레르엔 산맥이란. 플라리스의 뿌리이자, 이곳 전체를 한눈에 내려다보기에 완벽한 곳이죠.
dialogsFail.nl: Ahh, Leren Mountains. The root of Flaris itself, perfect for surveying every spot on the map.
dialogsFail.pl: Ahh, Leren Mountains. The root of Flaris itself, perfect for surveying every spot on the map.
dialogsFail.ru: Леренские горки... Чудесное место! Отсюда вся Фларинция как на ладони.
dialogsFail.sp: Ahh, las Montañas Leren. La mismísima raíz de Flaris, perfectas para ver cada rincón del mapa.
dialogsFail.sw: Ahh, Leren Mountains. The root of Flaris itself, perfect for surveying every spot on the map.
dialogsFail.th: Leren Mountains รากของ Flaris ช่างเหมาะสำหรับการสำรวจทุกจุดบนแผนที่เลยจริง
dialogsFail.tw: 啊，勒倫山脈。這裡是布拉里斯的根源，也最適合眺望地圖上的每個角落。
dialogsFail.vi: Ahh, Leren Mountains. Gốc rễ của chính Flaris, hoàn hảo để khảo sát mọi điểm trên bản đồ.
