dialogsBegin.en: In a way this is good for them. The citizens of Darken needed to become more self-efficient. I know they will be fine without me. There is another issue that has come up.
dialogsBegin.ar: In a way this is good for them. The citizens of Darken needed to become more self-efficient. I know they will be fine without me. There is another issue that has come up.
dialogsBegin.br: De certa forma, isso é bom para eles. Os cidadãos de Darken precisavam se tornar mais autoeficientes. Eu sei que eles vão ficar bem sem mim. Há outra questão que surgiu.
dialogsBegin.cns: 在某种程度上，这对他们来说是好事，达肯的公民需要变得更加自立。我知道他们没有我也会很好，但是另一个问题也出现了。
dialogsBegin.de: In gewisser Weise ist das gut für sie. Die Bürger von Darken müssen selbständiger werden. Ich weiß, dass sie auch ohne mich zurechtkommen werden. Es gibt noch ein weiteres Problem, das aufgetaucht ist.
dialogsBegin.fi: In a way this is good for them. The citizens of Darken needed to become more self-efficient. I know they will be fine without me. There is another issue that has come up.
dialogsBegin.fil: In a way this is good for them. The citizens of Darken needed to become more self-efficient. I know they will be fine without me. There is another issue that has come up.
dialogsBegin.fr: Le maire de Darkon a de la suite dans les idées. Hum, par où commencer… ?
dialogsBegin.id: Di satu sisi ini baik untuk mereka. Warga Darken perlu menjadi lebih mandiri. Saya tahu mereka akan baik-baik saja tanpa saya. Namun ada masalah lain yang muncul.
dialogsBegin.it: In a way this is good for them. The citizens of Darken needed to become more self-efficient. I know they will be fine without me. There is another issue that has come up.
dialogsBegin.jp: そうですか。市長の許可を頂けたということでしたら私も心おきなく貴方に協力することができます。そういえば……
dialogsBegin.kr: 어쩌면 다콘 시민에게도 잘된 일이에요. 다콘 시민도 이제 자립할 때가 되었고, 제 도움 없이도 충분히 잘해낼 거라 믿거든요. 하지만... 새로운 문제가 생겨서 말이죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: In a way this is good for them. The citizens of Darken needed to become more self-efficient. I know they will be fine without me. There is another issue that has come up.
dialogsBegin.pl: In a way this is good for them. The citizens of Darken needed to become more self-efficient. I know they will be fine without me. There is another issue that has come up.
dialogsBegin.ru: In a way this is good for them. The citizens of Darken needed to become more self-efficient. I know they will be fine without me. There is another issue that has come up.
dialogsBegin.sp: En cierto modo, esto es bueno para ellos. Los ciudadanos de Darken necesitan volverse más autosuficientes. Sé que estarán bien sin mí. Ha surgido otro problema.
dialogsBegin.sw: In a way this is good for them. The citizens of Darken needed to become more self-efficient. I know they will be fine without me. There is another issue that has come up.
dialogsBegin.th: ในทางนี้เป็นสิ่งที่ดีสำหรับพวกเขา พลเมืองของ Darken จำเป็นต้องมีความสามารถในตนเองได้มากขึ้น ฉันรู้ว่าพวกเขาจะสบายดีถ้าไม่มีฉัน มีปัญหาอื่นที่เกิดขึ้น
dialogsBegin.tw: 在某種程度上，這對他們有好處。得肯的市民需要變得更加自律。我知道沒有我他們會沒事的。還有一個問題出現了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Theo một cách nào đó, điều này tốt cho họ. Các công dân của Darken cần phải trở nên năng động hơn. Tôi biết họ sẽ ổn nếu không có tôi. Có một vấn đề khác đã được đưa ra.

dialogsBegin.en: When we finished the war, aside from my sister's ring, I also threw my pendant somewhere in Darkon 3. I was so convinced I would never need it again…
dialogsBegin.ar: When we finished the war, aside from my sister's ring, I also threw my pendant somewhere in Darkon 3. I was so convinced I would never need it again…
dialogsBegin.br: Quando terminamos a guerra, além do anel da minha irmã, também joguei meu Pingente em algum lugar de Darkon 3. Eu estava tão convencido de que nunca mais precisaria dele…
dialogsBegin.cns: 当我们结束战争时，除了我妹妹的戒指外，我还把我的吊坠扔在了达肯3的某个地方。我很确信我再也不需要它了...
dialogsBegin.de: Als wir den Krieg beendeten, warf ich neben dem Ring meiner Schwester auch meinen Anhänger irgendwo in Darkon 3 weg. Ich war so überzeugt, dass ich ihn nie wieder brauchen würde...
dialogsBegin.fi: When we finished the war, aside from my sister's ring, I also threw my pendant somewhere in Darkon 3. I was so convinced I would never need it again…
dialogsBegin.fil: When we finished the war, aside from my sister's ring, I also threw my pendant somewhere in Darkon 3. I was so convinced I would never need it again…
dialogsBegin.fr: Avant de quitter ma précédente enveloppe charnelle, j'ai enfermé mes pouvoirs dans une amulette. Je l'ai jetée au fin fond de Darkon 3 quand j'ai renoncé à me battre.
dialogsBegin.id: Ketika kami menyelesaikan perang, selain cincin saudara perempuan saya, saya juga melemparkan pendant saya ke suatu tempat di Darkon 3. Saya sangat yakin saya tidak akan pernah membutuhkannya lagi ...
dialogsBegin.it: When we finished the war, aside from my sister's ring, I also threw my pendant somewhere in Darkon 3. I was so convinced I would never need it again…
dialogsBegin.jp: 私達は創世戦争の終わりにそれぞれペンダントをわかり合いました。ただ……ノートレーに奪われてしまったのです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 전쟁이 끝났을 무렵, 여동생의 반지와 제 펜던트를 다콘 제3지구 어딘가에 던져 버렸어요. 두 번 다시 필요 없을 거라 믿었거든요…
dialogsBegin.nl: When we finished the war, aside from my sister's ring, I also threw my pendant somewhere in Darkon 3. I was so convinced I would never need it again…
dialogsBegin.pl: When we finished the war, aside from my sister's ring, I also threw my pendant somewhere in Darkon 3. I was so convinced I would never need it again…
dialogsBegin.ru: When we finished the war, aside from my sister's ring, I also threw my pendant somewhere in Darkon 3. I was so convinced I would never need it again…
dialogsBegin.sp: Cuando se acabó la guerra, aparte del anillo de mi hermana, también tiré mi colgante en algún lugar de Darkon 3. Estaba convencido de que nunca más lo necesitaría...
dialogsBegin.sw: When we finished the war, aside from my sister's ring, I also threw my pendant somewhere in Darkon 3. I was so convinced I would never need it again…
dialogsBegin.th: เมื่อเราเสร็จสิ้นสงครามนอกเหนือจากแหวนของน้องสาวของฉัน ฉันยังโยนจี้ของฉันอยู่ที่ไหนสักแห่งใน Darkon 3 ฉันมั่นใจว่าฉันจะไม่ต้องการอีก ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 當我們結束戰爭時，除了我姐姐的戒指，我還把我的墜飾扔到了得肯第三區的某個地方。我確信我再也不需要它了……
dialogsBegin.vi: Khi chúng tôi kết thúc cuộc chiến, ngoài chiếc nhẫn của em gái tôi, tôi cũng đã ném mặt dây chuyền của mình ở đâu đó trong Darkon 3. Tôi tin rằng mình sẽ không bao giờ cần nó nữa…

dialogsBegin.en: Could you please find it for me? I know it is asking much of you. It is important that I regain possession of it though and present it to Reonan.
dialogsBegin.ar: Could you please find it for me? I know it is asking much of you. It is important that I regain possession of it though and present it to Reonan.
dialogsBegin.br: Por favor, você poderia encontrá-lo para mim? Eu sei que é pedir muito de você, mas é importante que eu recupere a posse dele e o apresente a Reonan.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你能为我找到它吗？我知道这对你的要求很高。但重要的是，我必须重新获得它的所有权，并把它交给瑞尔南。
dialogsBegin.de: Könnten Sie sie bitte für mich finden? Ich weiß, dass das zu viel von dir verlangt ist. Es ist aber wichtig, dass ich sie wieder in meinen Besitz bekomme und sie Reonan überreichen kann.
dialogsBegin.fi: Could you please find it for me? I know it is asking much of you. It is important that I regain possession of it though and present it to Reonan.
dialogsBegin.fil: Could you please find it for me? I know it is asking much of you. It is important that I regain possession of it though and present it to Reonan.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je l'avais lancée à la tête d'un Nautrepy. Ces créatures l'ont peut-être encore.
dialogsBegin.id: Bisakah Anda menemukannya untuk saya? Saya tahu bahwa saya meminta banyak dari Anda. Namun sangatlah penting bagi saya untuk mendapatkan kembali kepemilikannya dan menyerahkannya kepada Reonan.
dialogsBegin.it: Could you please find it for me? I know it is asking much of you. It is important that I regain possession of it though and present it to Reonan.
dialogsBegin.jp: 申し訳ないのですが、今の私はノートレーと闘う力がありません。そのペンダントを見つけてきて頂けませんか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 부탁해도 될까요? 무리한 부탁이라는 건 알지만… 저는 그 펜던트를 꼭 되찾아서 레오난에게 전해야만 해요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Could you please find it for me? I know it is asking much of you. It is important that I regain possession of it though and present it to Reonan.
dialogsBegin.pl: Could you please find it for me? I know it is asking much of you. It is important that I regain possession of it though and present it to Reonan.
dialogsBegin.ru: Could you please find it for me? I know it is asking much of you. It is important that I regain possession of it though and present it to Reonan.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Podrías encontrarlo por mí? Sé que te pido mucho. Pero, es importante que lo recupere y se lo lleve a Reonan.
dialogsBegin.sw: Could you please find it for me? I know it is asking much of you. It is important that I regain possession of it though and present it to Reonan.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณช่วยหามันได้ไหม? ฉันรู้ว่าฉันถามคุณมากไป แต่นี่เป็นสิ่งสำคัญที่ฉันได้ครอบครองมันและนำไปให้ Reonan
dialogsBegin.tw: 你能幫我找到嗎？我知道這對你要求很高。重要的是我重新擁有它並將它呈現給雷奧南。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có thể vui lòng tìm nó cho tôi được không? Tôi biết tôi đang hỏi nhiều ở bạn. Điều quan trọng là tôi phải giành lại quyền sở hữu nó và đưa nó cho Reonan.

dialogsAccept.en: Thank you. I feel that if anything, a Nautrepy has the pendant. They tend to seek out shiny objects. Please locate them in the Eastern forests of Darkon 3. Please retrieve it.
dialogsAccept.ar: Thank you. I feel that if anything, a Nautrepy has the pendant. They tend to seek out shiny objects. Please locate them in the Eastern forests of Darkon 3. Please retrieve it.
dialogsAccept.br: Obrigado. Eu sinto que, provavelmente, um Nautrepy está com o pingente. Eles tendem a procurar por objetos brilhantes. Por favor, localize-os nas florestas no leste de Darkon 3. Por favor, tente achá-lo.
dialogsAccept.cns: 谢谢你。我觉得，如果有的话，蛙跳蝠有吊坠。他们倾向于寻找闪亮的物体，请在达肯3的东部森林中找到他们，并把它找回来。
dialogsAccept.de: Ich danke Ihnen. Ich glaube, wenn überhaupt, dann hat ein Nautrepy den Anhänger. Sie neigen dazu, glänzende Objekte zu suchen. Bitte lokalisiert sie in den östlichen Wäldern von Darkon 3. Bitte holt ihn zurück.
dialogsAccept.fi: Thank you. I feel that if anything, a Nautrepy has the pendant. They tend to seek out shiny objects. Please locate them in the Eastern forests of Darkon 3. Please retrieve it.
dialogsAccept.fil: Thank you. I feel that if anything, a Nautrepy has the pendant. They tend to seek out shiny objects. Please locate them in the Eastern forests of Darkon 3. Please retrieve it.
dialogsAccept.fr: Les Nautrepy aiment les choses qui brillent. L'un d'eux aura certainement l'amulette.
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih. Saya merasa, seorang Nautrepy memiliki pendant itu. Mereka cenderung mencari benda-benda mengkilap. Silakan temukan mereka di Eastern forests di Darkon 3. Tolong ambil kembali.
dialogsAccept.it: Thank you. I feel that if anything, a Nautrepy has the pendant. They tend to seek out shiny objects. Please locate them in the Eastern forests of Darkon 3. Please retrieve it.
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとうございます。ノートレーは貴金属など光りものを好むモンスターです。
dialogsAccept.kr: 고맙습니다. 아마 너트레피가 펜던트를 가지고 있을 것 같은 느낌이 들어요. 반짝이는 걸 좋아하거든요. 다콘 제3지구 동쪽 숲에서 너트러피를 찾아서, 펜던트를 회수해 주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Thank you. I feel that if anything, a Nautrepy has the pendant. They tend to seek out shiny objects. Please locate them in the Eastern forests of Darkon 3. Please retrieve it.
dialogsAccept.pl: Thank you. I feel that if anything, a Nautrepy has the pendant. They tend to seek out shiny objects. Please locate them in the Eastern forests of Darkon 3. Please retrieve it.
dialogsAccept.ru: Thank you. I feel that if anything, a Nautrepy has the pendant. They tend to seek out shiny objects. Please locate them in the Eastern forests of Darkon 3. Please retrieve it.
dialogsAccept.sp: Gracias. Creo que el colgante lo tiene un Nautrepy. Tienden a buscar objetos brillantes. Localízalos en los bosques que hay al Este de Darkon 3. Por favor, recupéralo.
dialogsAccept.sw: Thank you. I feel that if anything, a Nautrepy has the pendant. They tend to seek out shiny objects. Please locate them in the Eastern forests of Darkon 3. Please retrieve it.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอขอบคุณ. ฉันรู้สึกว่า Nautrepy มีจี้ พวกเขามักจะหาวัตถุเงา กรุณาหาพวกเขาในป่าตะวันออกของ Darkon 3 กรุณานำกลับมา
dialogsAccept.tw: 謝謝。帥帥鼠們很喜歡閃亮的東西，所以一定會撿走那個墜飾。請你去得肯第三區東部森林消滅帥帥鼠，然後把我的墜飾找回來吧。
dialogsAccept.vi: Cảm ơn bạn. Tôi cảm thấy rằng nếu có bất cứ điều gì xảy đến, một Nautrepy sẽ có mặt dây chuyền. Họ có xu hướng tìm kiếm những đồ vật sáng bóng. Hãy xác định vị trí của chúng trong khu rừng phía Đông của Darkon 3. Hãy lấy nó.

dialogsDecline.en: It is imperative that you retrieve this pendant and get it to Reonan!
dialogsDecline.ar: It is imperative that you retrieve this pendant and get it to Reonan!
dialogsDecline.br: É de suma importância que você recupere este pingente e o entregue a Reonan!
dialogsDecline.cns: 当务之急是找回这个吊坠，并把它交给瑞尔南!
dialogsDecline.de: Sie müssen diesen Anhänger unbedingt wiederfinden und ihn zu Reonan bringen!
dialogsDecline.fi: It is imperative that you retrieve this pendant and get it to Reonan!
dialogsDecline.fil: It is imperative that you retrieve this pendant and get it to Reonan!
dialogsDecline.fr: J'ai besoin de récupérer ces pouvoirs pour vous aider…
dialogsDecline.id: Sangat penting bagi Anda untuk mengambil pendant ini dan membawanya ke Reonan!
dialogsDecline.it: It is imperative that you retrieve this pendant and get it to Reonan!
dialogsDecline.jp: あのペンダントがなければ仲間達に顔向けが……。
dialogsDecline.kr: 꼭 펜던트를 되찾아서 레오난에게 전달해야 해요!
dialogsDecline.nl: It is imperative that you retrieve this pendant and get it to Reonan!
dialogsDecline.pl: It is imperative that you retrieve this pendant and get it to Reonan!
dialogsDecline.ru: It is imperative that you retrieve this pendant and get it to Reonan!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Es imperativo que recuperes este colgante y se lo lleves a Reonan!
dialogsDecline.sw: It is imperative that you retrieve this pendant and get it to Reonan!
dialogsDecline.th: จำเป็นมากที่คุณจะได้รับจี้นี้และส่งไปให้ Reonan!
dialogsDecline.tw: 務必取回這枚墜飾，並把它交給雷奧南！
dialogsDecline.vi: Điều bắt buộc là bạn phải lấy lại mặt dây chuyền này và đưa nó cho Reonan!

dialogsBegin.ar: Fighter needs you to collect Golden Fists to make a golden glove. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.br: O Lutador precisa que você colete Punhos Dourados para fazer uma luva dourada. Você poderia ajudar?
dialogsBegin.cns: 格斗家为了强化他们的全套,委托了搜集黄金之拳,你要接受委托吗?
dialogsBegin.de: Kämpfer wollen Golden Fist um sich goldene Handschuhe zu machen. Nimmst du den Auftrag an?

dialogsBegin.fil: Kailangan ng Fighter na kolektahin mo ang Golden Fists para gumawa ng golden glove. Tutulungan mo ba?

dialogsBegin.en: It appears that word of your selfless exploits has reached the Mayor of Flarine. I believe he has something important about which to speak with you. Please speak with him
dialogsBegin.ar: It appears that word of your selfless exploits has reached the Mayor of Flarine. I believe he has something important about which to speak with you. Please speak with him
dialogsBegin.br: Parece que a notícia de suas façanhas chegou ao prefeito de Flarine. Eu acredito que ele tem algo importante para falar com você. Por favor vá falar com ele.
dialogsBegin.cns: 看来你无私奉献的消息传到帕里市长那里了。我相信他有一些重要的事情要和你说。请去找他吧。
dialogsBegin.de: Wie es scheint, hat die Nachricht von Euren selbstlosen Taten den Bürgermeister von Flarine erreicht. Ich glaube, er hat etwas Wichtiges mit Euch zu besprechen. Bitte sprecht mit ihm
dialogsBegin.fi: It appears that word of your selfless exploits has reached the Mayor of Flarine. I believe he has something important about which to speak with you. Please speak with him
dialogsBegin.fil: It appears that word of your selfless exploits has reached the Mayor of Flarine. I believe he has something important about which to speak with you. Please speak with him
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous devenez célèbre, le maire de Flarine veut vous rencontrer en personne.
dialogsBegin.id: Sepertinya berita tentang pencapaianmu telah sampai di telinga Mayor of Flarine. Aku percaya dia memiliki sesuatu yang penting untuk dibicarakan denganmu. Tolong bicaralah dengannya.
dialogsBegin.it: It appears that word of your selfless exploits has reached the Mayor of Flarine. I believe he has something important about which to speak with you. Please speak with him
dialogsBegin.jp: お前さんの噂を市長が聞きつけたようだ。どうだ？　市長に話に行ってみないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 용사님의 헌신적인 활약이 플라리네 시장님 귀에까지 들어간 것 같아요. 시장님께서 하실 말씀이 있다고 하니, 꼭 찾아가 보세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: It appears that word of your selfless exploits has reached the Mayor of Flarine. I believe he has something important about which to speak with you. Please speak with him
dialogsBegin.pl: It appears that word of your selfless exploits has reached the Mayor of Flarine. I believe he has something important about which to speak with you. Please speak with him
dialogsBegin.ru: It appears that word of your selfless exploits has reached the Mayor of Flarine. I believe he has something important about which to speak with you. Please speak with him
dialogsBegin.sp: Parece que las noticias de tus hazañas desinteresadas han llegado a oídos del Alcalde de Flarine. Creo que tiene algo importante de lo que hablar contigo. Por favor ves a hablar con él.
dialogsBegin.sw: It appears that word of your selfless exploits has reached the Mayor of Flarine. I believe he has something important about which to speak with you. Please speak with him
dialogsBegin.th: ดูเหมือนว่าคำพูดของการหาประโยชน์อย่างไม่เห็นแก่ตัวของคุณมาถึงนายกเทศมนตรีแห่ง Flarine แล้ว ฉันเชื่อว่าเขามีบางสิ่งที่สำคัญที่จะพูดกับคุณ กรุณาพูดคุยกับเขา
dialogsBegin.tw: 看來你的無私功績已經傳到布拉里斯市長那裡了，我相信他有重要的事情要和你談談。請和他談談！
dialogsBegin.vi: Có vẻ như lời nói về chiến công quên mình của bạn đã đến tai Thị trưởng Flarine. Tôi tin rằng ông ấy có điều gì đó quan trọng muốn nói chuyện với bạn. Hãy nói chuyện với ông ấy

dialogsAccept.en: The Mayor of Flarine can be found in Central Flarine. Please see what it is he requires of you.
dialogsAccept.ar: The Mayor of Flarine can be found in Central Flarine. Please see what it is he requires of you.
dialogsAccept.br: O prefeito de Flarine pode ser encontrado no Centro de Flarine. Por favor, veja o que ele quer de você.
dialogsAccept.cns: 你可以在帕里镇中心找到帕里市长。请去看看他找你有什么事。
dialogsAccept.de: Der Bürgermeister von Flarine ist im Zentrum von Flarine zu finden. Bitte sehen Sie nach, was er von Ihnen verlangt.
dialogsAccept.fi: The Mayor of Flarine can be found in Central Flarine. Please see what it is he requires of you.
dialogsAccept.fil: The Mayor of Flarine can be found in Central Flarine. Please see what it is he requires of you.
dialogsAccept.fr: Je vous conseille d'être poli avec lui. C'est un homme important.

dialogsAccept.it: The Mayor of Flarine can be found in Central Flarine. Please see what it is he requires of you.
dialogsAccept.jp: フラリスの中心に市長はいるぞ。急ぎの用らしいから早めにな。
dialogsAccept.kr: 플라리네 시장님은 플라리네 중부에 계세요. 시장님을 찾아가 무슨 일인지 확인해 보세요.

dialogsAccept.th: นายกเทศมนตรีแห่ง Flarine สามารถพบได้ใน Central Flarine โปรดดูว่าเขาต้องการอะไรจากคุณ
dialogsAccept.tw: 布拉里斯市長可以在布拉里斯中央找到。請看看他對你有什麼要求。

dialogsDecline.en: Well, not that I can blame you. I have no time to meddle with politicians.

dialogsDecline.br: Bem, não que eu possa culpar você. Não tenho tempo para me intrometer com políticos.
dialogsDecline.cns: 行吧，这与我无关，我也没什么好指责你的。我没有时间去多管这些政客的闲事。
dialogsDecline.de: Nun, ich kann es Ihnen nicht verdenken. Ich habe keine Zeit, mich mit Politikern einzulassen.
dialogsDecline.fi: Well, not that I can blame you. I have no time to meddle with politicians.

dialogsDecline.fr: Ne soyez pas timide, c'est le début de la gloire !

dialogsDecline.jp: 何と断ると申すか。こういう機会はなかなかないのだぞ？
dialogsDecline.kr: 뭐, 이해는 해요. 저도 정치인과 엮이는 건 별로라서요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Well, not that I can blame you. I have no time to meddle with politicians.
dialogsDecline.pl: Well, not that I can blame you. I have no time to meddle with politicians.
dialogsDecline.ru: Well, not that I can blame you. I have no time to meddle with politicians.

dialogsDecline.th: ไม่ใช่ว่าฉันจะตำหนิคุณได้ ไม่มีเวลาไปยุ่งกับนักการเมือง

dialogsComplete.en: It is with a warm heart that I welcome you to our humble town young adventurer! The citizens of this town speak highly of all you.
dialogsComplete.ar: It is with a warm heart that I welcome you to our humble town young adventurer! The citizens of this town speak highly of all you.
dialogsComplete.br: É com o coração que vos dou as boas-vindas a nossa humilde cidade jovem aventureiro(a)! Os cidadãos desta cidade falaram muito bem de você.
dialogsComplete.cns: 年轻的冒险者，我怀着激动的心欢迎你来到我们这个小镇！这里的居民对你的评价很高。
dialogsComplete.de: Mit warmem Herzen heiße ich dich in unserer bescheidenen Stadt willkommen, junger Abenteurer! Die Bürger dieser Stadt sprechen in den höchsten Tönen von dir.
dialogsComplete.fi: It is with a warm heart that I welcome you to our humble town young adventurer! The citizens of this town speak highly of all you.
dialogsComplete.fil: It is with a warm heart that I welcome you to our humble town young adventurer! The citizens of this town speak highly of all you.
dialogsComplete.fr: Bonjour, c'est un honneur de rencontrer un aventurier prometteur comme vous.
dialogsComplete.id: Wahai Adventurer muda, dengan hati yang hangat aku menyambutmu di kota kami yang sederhana! Warga kota ini sangat memuji kalian semua.
dialogsComplete.it: It is with a warm heart that I welcome you to our humble town young adventurer! The citizens of this town speak highly of all you.
dialogsComplete.jp: おお、貴方は最近フラリスのモンスターを退治して下さっている方ですね。
dialogsComplete.kr: 젊은 모험가님, 이 조용한 마을에 오신 걸 진심으로 환영합니다! 마을 사람들 사이에 당신 칭찬이 자자하더군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: It is with a warm heart that I welcome you to our humble town young adventurer! The citizens of this town speak highly of all you.
dialogsComplete.pl: It is with a warm heart that I welcome you to our humble town young adventurer! The citizens of this town speak highly of all you.
dialogsComplete.ru: Рад приветствовать тебя в нашем скромном городке, юный искатель приключений! Жители хорошо отзываются о тебе.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Es con un corazón cálido que te doy la bienvenida a nuestro humilde pueblo, joven aventurero! Los ciudadanos de esta ciudad hablan muy bien de ti.
dialogsComplete.sw: It is with a warm heart that I welcome you to our humble town young adventurer! The citizens of this town speak highly of all you.
dialogsComplete.th: ฉันยินดีต้อนรับคุณสู่นักผจญภัยหนุ่มเมืองต่ำต้อยของเราด้วยใจที่อบอุ่น! พลเมืองของเมืองนี้ยกย่องคุณทั้งหมด
dialogsComplete.tw: 我懷著一顆溫暖的心，歡迎你來到我們卑微的小鎮，年輕冒險家！鎮上的市民都對你們贊不絕口。
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi chào đón bạn đến với nhà thám hiểm trẻ ở thị trấn khiêm tốn của chúng tôi với một trái tim ấm áp! Các công dân của thị trấn này đánh giá cao tất cả các bạn.
