dialogsBegin.en: So you think you're ready to become a Knight? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.ar: So you think you're ready to become a Knight? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.br: Você deseja ser um sucessor do Herói Knight? Não é uma tarefa fácil. Mas acho que você está preparado, já que veio até aqui.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你是要当骑士英雄的继承者吗？不简单喔~不过，我想应该你已经心理准备好了！
dialogsBegin.de: Du glaubst also, du bist bereit, ein Knight zu werden? Es ist nicht leicht, aber da du es bis hierher geschafft hast, denke ich, dass du der Herausforderung gewachsen bist.
dialogsBegin.fi: So you think you're ready to become a Knight? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.fil: So you think you're ready to become a Knight? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu souhaites suivre la voie de Billein, Héros des Chevaliers ? Si tu es parvenu jusqu'ici, tu dois en être capable.
dialogsBegin.id: Jadi kamu pikir kamu siap untuk menjadi seorang Ksatria? Ini tidak mudah, tetapi karena kamu telah berhasil sejauh ini, saya pikir kamu siap menghadapi tantangan.
dialogsBegin.it: So you think you're ready to become a Knight? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.jp: ナイト英雄の後継者の道を歩む覚悟はできていますか？では、ご案内します。
dialogsBegin.kr: 나이트가 될 준비가 된 것 같나요? 쉬운 일은 아니지만, 여기까지 온 걸 보면 도전할 자격이 있어 보이는군요.
dialogsBegin.nl: So you think you're ready to become a Knight? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.pl: So you think you're ready to become a Knight? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.ru: So you think you're ready to become a Knight? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Crees que estás listo para convertirte en Knight? No es algo fácil, pero como has llegado hasta aquí, creo que estás preparado para el desafío.
dialogsBegin.sw: So you think you're ready to become a Knight? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณคิดว่าคุณพร้อมที่จะเป็น Knight แล้วงั้นเรอะ? ไม่ใช่เรื่องง่ายหรอก แต่เพราะว่าคุณมาได้ไกลขนาดนี้ ฉันก็คิดว่าคุณพร้อมสำหรับการท้าทายนี้แล้วล่ะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 你是要當騎士英雄的繼承者嗎？不簡單喔~不過，我想應該你已經心理準備好了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn nghĩ rằng bạn đã sẵn sàng để trở thành một Knight? Nó không phải là dễ dàng, nhưng vì cho tới nay bạn đã nỗ lực rất nhiều,nên tôi nghĩ rằng bạn đạt được thử thách.

dialogsBegin.en: First, a simple test of your skills in combat to see if you are qualified.
dialogsBegin.ar: First, a simple test of your skills in combat to see if you are qualified.
dialogsBegin.br: Primeiro, vamos fazer um teste simples para checar se você está qualificado para ser um sucessor. É um teste de habilidade de combate.
dialogsBegin.cns: 首先，测试下你的战斗技巧及能力，看你是否合格
dialogsBegin.de: Zunächst ein einfacher Test deiner Fähigkeiten im Kampf, um festzustellen, ob du qualifiziert bist.
dialogsBegin.fi: First, a simple test of your skills in combat to see if you are qualified.
dialogsBegin.fil: First, a simple test of your skills in combat to see if you are qualified.
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais je vais te faire passer une première épreuve pour m'assurer que tu es bien digne de notre classe. Il s'agit de tester ton aptitude au combat.
dialogsBegin.id: Pertama, tes sederhana keterampilanmu dalam pertempuran untuk melihat apakah kamu memenuhi syarat.
dialogsBegin.it: First, a simple test of your skills in combat to see if you are qualified.
dialogsBegin.jp: まずあなたが後継者としての資質を持っているか、簡単にテストを行います。この試験によりあなたの戦闘能力を見させてもらいます。
dialogsBegin.kr: 먼저, 전투 실력을 간단히 시험해 볼게요. 자격이 있는지 확인해 보고 싶어서요.
dialogsBegin.nl: First, a simple test of your skills in combat to see if you are qualified.
dialogsBegin.pl: First, a simple test of your skills in combat to see if you are qualified.
dialogsBegin.ru: Для начала испытаем тебя в бою.
dialogsBegin.sp: Primero, una simple prueba de tus habilidades en combate para ver si estás calificado.
dialogsBegin.sw: First, a simple test of your skills in combat to see if you are qualified.
dialogsBegin.th: ขั้นแรกให้ทดสอบทักษะของคุณในการต่อสู้เพื่อดูว่าคุณมีคุณสมบัติเหมาะสมหรือไม่
dialogsBegin.tw: 首先，簡單測試一下你的戰鬥技巧，看看你是否合格。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đầu tiên, một bài kiểm tra đơn giản về kỹ năng của bạn trong chiến đấu để xem bạn có đủ tiêu chuẩn hay không.

dialogsBegin.en: Go to KhipRa and hunt down $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. Not the Small ones, or the Giants, just regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. That should be easy enough.
dialogsBegin.ar: Go to KhipRa and hunt down $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. Not the Small ones, or the Giants, just regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. That should be easy enough.
dialogsBegin.br: Como eu disse, é bem simples. Cace $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s em KhipRa, Darkon1. Não os Pequenos Sondadores ou o Gigante, somente os comuns.
dialogsBegin.cns: 请去到开发区猎杀$QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$个中型$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$。请注意不是小型的也不是大型的。这个测试足够简单了。
dialogsBegin.de: Geh zu KhipRa und mach Jagd auf $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. Nicht die Smalls oder die Giants, sondern die normalen $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. Das sollte einfach genug sein.
dialogsBegin.fi: Go to KhipRa and hunt down $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. Not the Small ones, or the Giants, just regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. That should be easy enough.
dialogsBegin.fil: Go to KhipRa and hunt down $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. Not the Small ones, or the Giants, just regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. That should be easy enough.
dialogsBegin.fr: Commence par tuer $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s au sud-ouest des montagnes de Gouthan. Il s'agit de $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s adultes, pas des jeunes ni des capitaines.
dialogsBegin.id: Pergi ke KhipRa dan buru $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. Bukan yang Kecil, atau Raksasa, hanya $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yang biasa. Itu seharusnya cukup mudah.
dialogsBegin.it: Go to KhipRa and hunt down $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. Not the Small ones, or the Giants, just regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. That should be easy enough.
dialogsBegin.jp: 内容は簡単です。ダーコンの第1地区、キプラと呼ばれるその地域に生息する、$QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$体の$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を倒してきなさい。 スモールやボスではなく$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ですよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 킵라로 가서 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$마리를 처치하세요. 두목이나 작은 몬스터 말고, 일반 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 말이에요. 별로 어렵진 않을 겁니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Go to KhipRa and hunt down $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. Not the Small ones, or the Giants, just regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. That should be easy enough.
dialogsBegin.pl: Go to KhipRa and hunt down $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. Not the Small ones, or the Giants, just regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. That should be easy enough.
dialogsBegin.ru: Go to KhipRa and hunt down $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. Not the Small ones, or the Giants, just regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. That should be easy enough.
dialogsBegin.sp: Ve a KhipRa y derrota $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. Ni los Pequeños ni los Capitanes, solo los $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ normales. Debería ser bastante fácil para ti.
dialogsBegin.sw: Go to KhipRa and hunt down $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. Not the Small ones, or the Giants, just regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. That should be easy enough.
dialogsBegin.th: ไปที่ KhipRa และล่า $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s ที่ไม่ใช่ Small หรือ Giants แค่ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s ธรรมดา คงไม่ใช่เรื่องยากอะไร
dialogsBegin.tw: 前往機械荒原，獵殺 $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ 隻 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$。不要攻擊小型或巨型的種類，只需對付普通的 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$，這應該不難。
dialogsBegin.vi: Truy cập KhipRa và săn tìm $ QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT $ $ QUEST_END_KILL_NAME $ s. Không phải những người Lùn hay Những người khổng lồ, chỉ là những $ QUEST_END_KILL_NAME $ s thông thường. Điều đó rất dễ dàng.

dialogsAccept.en: Good luck, my friend. I'll be watching.
dialogsAccept.ar: حظا موفقا، يا صديقي. سوف اراقبك.
dialogsAccept.br: Eu estarei observando. Boa sorte!
dialogsAccept.cns: 那么加油吧！！
dialogsAccept.de: Ich werde dich beobachten. Viel Glück.
dialogsAccept.fi: Good luck, my friend. I'll be watching.
dialogsAccept.fil: Good luck, my friend. I'll be watching.
dialogsAccept.fr: Si tu ne peux pas à accomplir cela, il vaut mieux que tu oublies l'idée de devenir un Chevalier.
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga berhasil, temanku. Aku akan melihat.
dialogsAccept.it: Good luck, my friend. I'll be watching.
dialogsAccept.jp: ではご武運を祈ります。
dialogsAccept.kr: 행운을 빌어요, 친구.
dialogsAccept.nl: Good luck, my friend. I'll be watching.
dialogsAccept.pl: Good luck, my friend. I'll be watching.
dialogsAccept.ru: Удачи! Я буду наблюдать за тобой.
dialogsAccept.sp: Buena suerte, amigo mío. Estaré observando.
dialogsAccept.sw: Good luck, my friend. I'll be watching.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้โชคดี เพื่อน ฉันจะคอยดู
dialogsAccept.tw: 那麼加油吧！！
dialogsAccept.vi: Chúc may mắn, bạn tôi. Tôi sẽ luôn dõi theo.

dialogsDecline.en: Giving up already? But this is the easy part.
dialogsDecline.ar: Giving up already? But this is the easy part.
dialogsDecline.br: Já está desistindo? Mas essa é a parte mais fácil.
dialogsDecline.cns: 这就放弃了？这可是最简单的部分。
dialogsDecline.de: Gibst du schon auf? Aber das ist der einfache Teil.
dialogsDecline.fi: Giving up already? But this is the easy part.
dialogsDecline.fil: Giving up already? But this is the easy part.
dialogsDecline.fr: Si tu ne parviens pas à tuer ces 20 Drillers, oublie la voie du Chevalier.
dialogsDecline.id: Sudah menyerah? Tapi ini adalah bagian yang mudah.
dialogsDecline.it: Giving up already? But this is the easy part.
dialogsDecline.jp: 確かに容易な道ではないと話していたと思いますが･･･。やはり辞めるのですか？
dialogsDecline.kr: 벌써 포기하려고요? 이제 시작인데요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Giving up already? But this is the easy part.
dialogsDecline.pl: Giving up already? But this is the easy part.
dialogsDecline.ru: Giving up already? But this is the easy part.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Ya te has dado por vencido? Pero si esta es la parte fácil.
dialogsDecline.sw: Giving up already? But this is the easy part.
dialogsDecline.th: ยอมแพ้แล้วงั้นเรอะ? แต่นี่เป็นส่วนง่ายๆ เองนะ
dialogsDecline.tw: 已經放棄了？但這是容易的部分。
dialogsDecline.vi: Bỏ cuộc rồi à? Nhưng đây là phần dễ dàng cơ mà.

dialogsComplete.en: Excellent work, Mercenary! Now you're on your way to becoming a Knight.
dialogsComplete.ar: Excellent work, Mercenary! Now you're on your way to becoming a Knight.
dialogsComplete.br: Hmm... Parabéns, eu sabia que você conseguiria! Agora você está qualificado para ser um sucessor.
dialogsComplete.cns: 辛苦你了！我果然没看错人，你已经具备成为骑士英雄继承者的资格了！
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm.. Gute Arbeit, ich wusste das du das kannst! Nun bist du als Nachfolger qualifiziert.
dialogsComplete.fi: Excellent work, Mercenary! Now you're on your way to becoming a Knight.
dialogsComplete.fil: Excellent work, Mercenary! Now you're on your way to becoming a Knight.
dialogsComplete.fr: Ce n'est pas si difficile pourtant. comptes-tu déjà abandonner ?
dialogsComplete.id: Kerja bagus, Mercenary! Sekarang kamu sedang dalam perjalanan untuk menjadi seorang Ksatria.
dialogsComplete.it: Excellent work, Mercenary! Now you're on your way to becoming a Knight.
dialogsComplete.jp: おめでとうございます。私の目に狂いはありませんでした。あなたは後継者の初めの試練を突破しました。
dialogsComplete.kr: 훌륭합니다, 머서너리님! 이제 나이트가 되는 길로 접어드셨군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Excellent work, Mercenary! Now you're on your way to becoming a Knight.
dialogsComplete.pl: Excellent work, Mercenary! Now you're on your way to becoming a Knight.
dialogsComplete.ru: Отлично, борец! Думаю, в тебе есть задатки гладиатора.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Excelente trabajo, Mercenary! Ya estás en el camino para convertirte en un Knight.
dialogsComplete.sw: Excellent work, Mercenary! Now you're on your way to becoming a Knight.
dialogsComplete.th: ยอดเยี่ยมมาก Mercenary! ตอนนี้คุณกำลังจะกลายเป็น Knight แล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 辛苦你了！我果然沒看錯人，你已經具備成為騎士英雄繼承者的資格了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Làm tốt lắm, Mercenary! Bây giờ bạn đang trên con đường trở thành một Knight.

dialogsComplete.en: To commemorate this day, I have something for you.
dialogsComplete.ar: To commemorate this day, I have something for you.
dialogsComplete.br: Parabéns! Você passou no primeiro teste.
dialogsComplete.cns: 恭喜你通过第一关测验！！
dialogsComplete.de: Gratulation! Du hast den ersten Test bestanden.
dialogsComplete.fi: To commemorate this day, I have something for you.
dialogsComplete.fil: To commemorate this day, I have something for you.
dialogsComplete.fr: Félicitations ! Tu as réussi la première épreuve.
dialogsComplete.id: Untuk memperingati hari ini, aku punya sesuatu untukmu.
dialogsComplete.it: To commemorate this day, I have something for you.
dialogsComplete.jp: 最初の試練を無事乗り越えましたね。おめでとうございます。
dialogsComplete.kr: 오늘을 기념해서, 드릴 것이 있어요.
dialogsComplete.nl: To commemorate this day, I have something for you.
dialogsComplete.pl: To commemorate this day, I have something for you.
dialogsComplete.ru: У меня есть для тебя памятный подарок. Запомни этот день.
dialogsComplete.sp: Para conmemorar este día, tengo algo para ti.
dialogsComplete.sw: To commemorate this day, I have something for you.
dialogsComplete.th: เพื่อเป็นที่ระลึกถึงวันนี้ ฉันมีของบางอย่างให้คุณ
dialogsComplete.tw: 恭喜你通過第一關測驗！！
dialogsComplete.vi: Để kỷ niệm ngày này, tôi có một cái gì đó dành cho bạn.

dialogsFail.en: Exactly 20 Drillers, Squire. That's what you'll need to take your first steps to Knighthood.
dialogsFail.ar: Exactly 20 Drillers, Squire. That's what you'll need to take your first steps to Knighthood.
dialogsFail.br: Exatamente 20 Sondadores. Caso contrário, não posso julgar se você está qualificado. Você tem que cumprir a tarefa se realmente quiser ser um sucessor.
dialogsFail.cns: 一定要打20只钻孔机喔！这样才可以判断你的能力如何！ 为了当真正的继承者，加油吧！
dialogsFail.de: Genau 20 Driller, sonst kann ich nicht entscheiden ob du qualifiziert bist. Du musst das tun, wenn wirklich ein Nachfolger sein möchtest.
dialogsFail.fi: Exactly 20 Drillers, Squire. That's what you'll need to take your first steps to Knighthood.
dialogsFail.fil: Exactly 20 Drillers, Squire. That's what you'll need to take your first steps to Knighthood.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu ne parviens pas à tuer ces 20 Drillers, oublie la voie du Chevalier.
dialogsFail.id: Tepatnya 20 Pengebor, Squire. Itulah yang kamu perlukan untuk mengambil langkah pertama menuju Knighthood.
dialogsFail.it: Exactly 20 Drillers, Squire. That's what you'll need to take your first steps to Knighthood.
dialogsFail.jp: 正確に20匹です。そうではないとあなたの資質が判断できません。本当に後継者になりたいのなら、必ず成し遂げてください。
dialogsFail.kr: 정확히 드릴러 20마리여야 합니다. 그 정도는 되어야 나이트후드가 되기 위한 첫걸음이라고 할 수 있겠죠.
dialogsFail.nl: Exactly 20 Drillers, Squire. That's what you'll need to take your first steps to Knighthood.
dialogsFail.pl: Dokładnie 20 Wiertników. Właśnie tego będziesz potrzebować, aby postawić pierwsze kroki w Rycerstwie.
dialogsFail.ru: Ровно двадцать буров, борец. Это будет твоим первым шагом к званию гладиатора.
dialogsFail.sp: Exactamente 20 Drillers. Es lo que hace falta para dar los primeros pasos para convertirte en Knight.
dialogsFail.sw: Exactly 20 Drillers, Squire. That's what you'll need to take your first steps to Knighthood.
dialogsFail.th: Drillers 20 อัน นั่นคือสิ่งที่คุณจะต้องทำตามขั้นตอนแรกของการเป็น Knight
dialogsFail.tw: 一定要打 20 隻暴鑽機械喔！這樣才可以判斷你的能力如何！為了當真正的繼承者，加油吧！
dialogsFail.vi: Chính xác là 20 Drillers, Squire. Đó là những gì bạn cần để thực hiện các bước đầu tiên đến với phong tước Hiệp sĩ.

name.cns: 英雄的继承者-印章文件-
name.sp: Sucesor del Héroe -Documento de la Sala-
name.th: ผู้สืบทอดฮีโร่ -Hall Document-
name.tw: 英雄的繼承者 - 印章文件
name.vi: Người kế vị của Hero -Hall Document-

description.en: Retrieve the Hall Document from Hoiren, who is hiding somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis. Then deliver it and your letter to Domek the Billposter Sage. You can find him at the Fountain of Dead Person.
description.ar: Retrieve the Hall Document from Hoiren, who is hiding somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis. Then deliver it and your letter to Domek the Billposter Sage. You can find him at the Fountain of Dead Person.
description.br: Você precisa pegar o Documento do Templo de Hoiren. Ele está escondido em algum lugar no Jardim de Rhisis. Entregue então, a carta de recomendação para Domek, o Sábio Billposter. Ele fica na Fonte dos Mortos, na parte norte das Montanhas Leren.
description.cns: 从隐藏在莱斯庭院某处的霍伦那里取回印章文件。然后把它和你的信交给[暴力技师贤者]道麦。你可以在帕里亡者之泉找到他。
description.de: Hol dir das Hall Document von Hoiren, der sich irgendwo im Garden of Rhisis versteckt hält. Bringe es dann zusammen mit deinem Brief zu Domek, dem Schnabelputzer-Weisen. Du findest ihn am Brunnen der toten Person.
description.fi: Retrieve the Hall Document from Hoiren, who is hiding somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis. Then deliver it and your letter to Domek the Billposter Sage. You can find him at the Fountain of Dead Person.
description.fil: Retrieve the Hall Document from Hoiren, who is hiding somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis. Then deliver it and your letter to Domek the Billposter Sage. You can find him at the Fountain of Dead Person.
description.fr: Retrouver le Document du Hall de Roentel qui se trouve quelque part au Jardin de Rhisis, dans la région des Tombstones, puis le rapporter au Sage des Moines Domek à la Fontaine des Défunts de Flaris.
description.id: Ambil Dokumen Aula dari Hoiren, yang bersembunyi di suatu tempat di Taman Rhisis. Kemudian kirimkan dan suratmu ke Domek the Billposter Sage. Kamu dapat menemukannya di Fountain of Dead Person.
description.it: Retrieve the Hall Document from Hoiren, who is hiding somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis. Then deliver it and your letter to Domek the Billposter Sage. You can find him at the Fountain of Dead Person.
description.jp: リシスの庭園に潜んでいるヴェスパーから秘伝書を取り戻し、フラリスの魂の泉にいるビルポスター賢者ンドゥークに持っていってください。
description.kr: 리시스의 정원 어딘가에 숨어 있는 호이렌에게서 전당 문서를 되찾으세요. 그다음, 망자의 샘에 있는 빌포스터 현자 도멕을 찾아가 추천서와 문서를 전달하세요.
description.nl: Retrieve the Hall Document from Hoiren, who is hiding somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis. Then deliver it and your letter to Domek the Billposter Sage. You can find him at the Fountain of Dead Person.
description.pl: Retrieve the Hall Document from Hoiren, who is hiding somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis. Then deliver it and your letter to Domek the Billposter Sage. You can find him at the Fountain of Dead Person.
description.ru: Нужно отобрать документы спортивного зала у Лойфа Дунгрена. Он прячется в Райсском саду. Затем нужно отнести документы и рекомендательное письмо старейшине атлетов Доминику к фонтану Мертвеца во Фларинции.
description.sp: Consigue el Documento de la Sala que tiene Hoiren, se esconde en algún lugar del Jardín de Rhisis. Después entrégaselo junto con tu carta a Domek, el Sabio Billposter. Puedes encontrarlo en el Manantial de Almas.
description.sw: Retrieve the Hall Document from Hoiren, who is hiding somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis. Then deliver it and your letter to Domek the Billposter Sage. You can find him at the Fountain of Dead Person.
description.th: นำ Hall Document จาก Hoiren ที่ซ่อนอยู่ที่ไหนสักแห่งใน Garden of Rhisis จากนั้นส่งมันและจดหมายของคุณให้ Billposter Sage ที่ชื่อว่า Domek คุณสามารถหาเขาได้ที่ Fountain of Dead Person
description.tw: 從藏在黎席斯庭院某處的惠蓮那裡取回大廳文件。然後將它和你的信交給廣告海報聖人多梅克。你可以在死人噴泉找到他。
description.vi: Lấy Hall Document từ Hoiren, người đang trốn ở đâu đó trong Garden of Rhisis. Sau đó, chuyển nó và lá thư của bạn cho Domek, Billposter Sage. Bạn có thể tìm thấy anh ta ở Fountain of Dead Person.

dialogsBegin.en: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Billposter. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.ar: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Billposter. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.br: Esta é a carta de recomendação que mostra que o mestre o reconhece como um sucessor. Por favor, proteja-a com sua vida. Se você perdê-la, não poderá provar que é reconhecido.
dialogsBegin.cns: 这推荐书表示首领认定继承者的能力，若没有推荐书认定形同无效，所以要好好保管！！
dialogsBegin.de: Dieses Empfehlungsschreiben beweist, dass dich der Meister als Nachfolger akzeptiert hat. Bitte beschütze es mit deinem Leben. Wenn du ihn verlierst, kannst du nicht beweisen, dass du anerkannt wurdest.
dialogsBegin.fi: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Billposter. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.fil: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Billposter. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.fr: Félicitations, voici une lettre de recommandation confirmant que tu es sur la voie de devenir Moine.
dialogsBegin.id: Surat rekomendasi ini merupakan bukti pencapaianmu sebagai seorang Billposter. Jaga itu seperti kamu menjaga hidupmu sendiri.
dialogsBegin.it: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Billposter. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.jp: これはマスターが後継者としての資質を認めたという推薦書です。あなたの資質が認められるものですから大事にしてください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 추천서는 빌포스터로서 당신이 거둔 성과를 증명하는 증명서랍니다. 목숨처럼 소중히 간직하세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Billposter. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.pl: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Billposter. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.ru: Это рекомендательное письмо - доказательство того, что тебе удалось пройти мое испытание. Береги его как зеницу ока.
dialogsBegin.sp: Esta carta de recomendación es prueba de tus progresos como Billposter. Guárdalo como si fuera tu propia vida.
dialogsBegin.sw: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Billposter. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.th: จดหมายแนะนำฉบับนี้เป็นข้อพิสูจน์ถึงความสำเร็จของคุณในการเป็น Billposter จงรักษามันไว้ยิ่งชีพล่ะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 這推薦書表示首領認定繼承者的能力，若沒有推薦書認定形同無效，所以要好好保管！！
dialogsBegin.vi: Thư giới thiệu này là bằng chứng về thành tích của bạn với tư cách là Billposter. Hãy bảo vệ nó như chính cuộc sống của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Take it to Domek, the Billposter Sage. He resides at Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.ar: Take it to Domek, the Billposter Sage. He resides at Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.br: Por favor, entregue a carta de recomendação para Domek , o sábio Billposter. Ele fica na Fonte das Pessoas Mortas, ao norte, nas Montanhas Leren.
dialogsBegin.cns: 把推荐书拿给位于乐雅山脉北部亡者之泉的[暴力技师贤者]道麦。
dialogsBegin.de: Bitte bringe das Empfehlungsschreiben zu Domek, dem Billposter Weisen. Er ist an der Quelle der verstorbenen Seelen im Norden des Leren Gebirges.
dialogsBegin.fi: Take it to Domek, the Billposter Sage. He resides at Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.fil: Take it to Domek, the Billposter Sage. He resides at Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il faut que tu l'apportes à Domek, le Sage des Moines qui se trouve à la Fontaine des Défunts de Flaris. Mais avant cela, j'aimerais que tu retrouves le Document du Hall de Roentel.
dialogsBegin.id: Bawa ke Domek, Sage Billposter. Dia tinggal di Fountain of Dead Person di Pegunungan Leren Utara.
dialogsBegin.it: Take it to Domek, the Billposter Sage. He resides at Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.jp: それではフラリスのレルエン山脈北部にある魂の泉に行って、ビルポスター賢者ンドゥークにその推薦書を渡してください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 추천서를 빌포스터 현자 도멕님께 전달하세요. 도멕님은 북부 레르엔 산맥 망자의 샘에 있답니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Take it to Domek, the Billposter Sage. He resides at Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.pl: Take it to Domek, the Billposter Sage. He resides at Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.ru: Отнеси его старейшине атлетов Доминику. Его можно найти у фонтана Мертвеца на севере Леренских горок.
dialogsBegin.sp: Llévaselo a Domek, el Sabio Billposter. Está en el Manantial de Almas al Norte de las Montañas Leren.
dialogsBegin.sw: Take it to Domek, the Billposter Sage. He resides at Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.th: นำมันไปให้ Billposter Sage ที่ชื่อ Domek เขาอาศัยอยู่ที่ Fountain of Dead Person ใน Northern Leren Mountains
dialogsBegin.tw: 把那推廌書拿給位於勒倫山脈北部亡者之泉的爆咒師賢者 [德邁洛‧詹]！
dialogsBegin.vi: Đưa nó đến Domek, Billposter Sage. Anh ta cư ngụ tại Fountain of Dead Person ở Northern Leren Mountains.

dialogsBegin.en: Before you do that, however, retrieve the Hall Document from Hoiren. He's hiding somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis.
dialogsBegin.ar: Before you do that, however, retrieve the Hall Document from Hoiren. He's hiding somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis.
dialogsBegin.br: Ah, antes de visitar Domek, você deve obter o Documento do Templo de Hoiren. Ele está escondido em algum lugar do Jardim de Rhisis.
dialogsBegin.cns: 对了！请先到莱斯庭院，找【胡欧仁】取回印章文件！
dialogsBegin.de: Oh, bevor du zu Domek gehst, musst du das Hall Document von Hoiren besorgen. Es ist irgendwo im Garten der Rhisis versteckt.
dialogsBegin.fi: Before you do that, however, retrieve the Hall Document from Hoiren. He's hiding somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis.
dialogsBegin.fil: Before you do that, however, retrieve the Hall Document from Hoiren. He's hiding somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis.
dialogsBegin.fr: C'est une relique du Héros qui a été dérobée par Hoiren à la mort de Roentel. J'ai entendu dire que Hoiren errait dans le Jardin de Rhisis, dans la région des Tombstones.
dialogsBegin.id: Namun, sebelum kamu melakukannya, ambil Dokumen Hall dari Hoiren. Dia bersembunyi di suatu tempat di Taman Rhisis.
dialogsBegin.it: Before you do that, however, retrieve the Hall Document from Hoiren. He's hiding somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis.
dialogsBegin.jp: あ、その前にリシスの庭園のどこかに潜んでいる背信者ヴェスパーから秘伝書を獲得してください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 하지만 그 전에, 리시스의 정원 어딘가에 숨어 있는 호이렌을 찾아내 전당 문서를 되찾으세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Before you do that, however, retrieve the Hall Document from Hoiren. He's hiding somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis.
dialogsBegin.pl: Before you do that, however, retrieve the Hall Document from Hoiren. He's hiding somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis.
dialogsBegin.ru: Но сначала тебе нужно будет забрать у Лойфа Дунгрена документы спортивного зала. Этот проходимец прячется где-то в Райсском саду. Разыщи его, хорошо?
dialogsBegin.sp: Antes de hacer eso, recupera el Documento de la Sala que tiene Hoiren. Está escondido por el Jardín de Rhisis.
dialogsBegin.sw: Before you do that, however, retrieve the Hall Document from Hoiren. He's hiding somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis.
dialogsBegin.th: แต่ก่อนที่คุณจะทำเรื่องที่ว่า ให้คุณไปค้นหา Hall Document จาก Hoiren เสียก่อนเขาซ่อนตัวอยู่ที่ไหนสักแห่งใน Garden of Rhisis
dialogsBegin.tw: 對了！請先到黎席斯庭院，找 [胡歐仁] 取回印章文件！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tuy nhiên, trước khi bạn làm điều đó, hãy lấy Hall Document từ Hoiren. Anh ta đang trốn ở đâu đó trong Garden of Rhisis.

dialogsAccept.en: Luck be with you.
dialogsAccept.ar: Luck be with you.
dialogsAccept.br: Eu lhe desejo sorte.
dialogsAccept.cns: 预祝你成功。
dialogsAccept.de: Viel Glück.
dialogsAccept.fi: Luck be with you.
dialogsAccept.fil: Luck be with you.
dialogsAccept.fr: Que la maîtrise de Roentel t'accompagne dans ta quête !
dialogsAccept.id: Keberuntungan bersamamu.
dialogsAccept.it: Luck be with you.
dialogsAccept.jp: うまく行くといいですね。がんばってね！
dialogsAccept.kr: 행운을 빌죠.
dialogsAccept.nl: Luck be with you.
dialogsAccept.pl: Luck be with you.
dialogsAccept.ru: Удачи. Ты скоро поймешь, что это не простые документы!
dialogsAccept.sp: Te deseo suerte.
dialogsAccept.sw: Luck be with you.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้โชคเข้าข้างคุณ
dialogsAccept.tw: 預祝你成功！！
dialogsAccept.vi: May mắn luôn bên bạn.

dialogsDecline.en: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.ar: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.br: Não se subestime. Você deve ser forte, ou não poderá se tornar um sucessor. Por que desistir agora?
dialogsDecline.cns: 你已经做到这了，为什么还要放弃呢？
dialogsDecline.de: Du bist schon so weit gekommen, warum solltest du jetzt aufgeben?
dialogsDecline.fi: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.fil: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.fr: Ne sous-estime jamais tes capacités ! Tu dois être fort, ou tu ne deviendras jamais un Héros.
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu sudah sampai sejauh ini, mengapa menyerah sekarang?
dialogsDecline.it: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.jp: 自分に勇気がないなどと思わないでください。あなたには力がある･･･。そんな簡単に諦めてはいけません。
dialogsDecline.kr: 여기까지 왔는데, 왜 그만두시려 하시죠?
dialogsDecline.nl: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.pl: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.ru: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.sp: Ya has llegado muy lejos, ¿te vas a rendir ahora?
dialogsDecline.sw: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.th: คุณมาได้ไกลแล้ว ทำไมถึงคิดจะยอมแพ้ในตอนนี้?
dialogsDecline.tw: 已經走到這一步了，為什麼要放棄呢？
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn đã đi quá xa, tại sao bây giờ lại từ bỏ?

dialogsComplete.en: Your skill must be extraordinary if you were able to take this document from Hoiren, good work!
dialogsComplete.ar: Your skill must be extraordinary if you were able to take this document from Hoiren, good work!
dialogsComplete.br: Se você conseguiu pegar este documento de Hoiren é porque sua habilidade deve ser extraordinária, bom trabalho!
dialogsComplete.cns: 你真的很厉害！谢谢你帮我找回这印章文件！
dialogsComplete.de: Oh, du bist großartig, dass du das Hall Document von Hoiren besorgt hast. Gut gemacht!
dialogsComplete.fi: Your skill must be extraordinary if you were able to take this document from Hoiren, good work!
dialogsComplete.fil: Your skill must be extraordinary if you were able to take this document from Hoiren, good work!
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh ! C'est... c'est le Document du Hall de Roentel ! Où l'as-tu retrouvé ?!
dialogsComplete.id: Keahlianmu pasti luar biasa jika bisa mengambil dokumen ini dari Hoiren, kerja bagus!
dialogsComplete.it: Your skill must be extraordinary if you were able to take this document from Hoiren, good work!
dialogsComplete.jp: ほほう、この秘伝書を持ってくるとは･･･。ヴェスパーは手ごわかったじゃろう？いやいや、大儀じゃった。
dialogsComplete.kr: 호이렌에게서 이 문서를 되찾다니, 정말 대단한 실력을 갖춘 분이겠군요. 잘하셨습니다!
dialogsComplete.nl: Your skill must be extraordinary if you were able to take this document from Hoiren, good work!
dialogsComplete.pl: Your skill must be extraordinary if you were able to take this document from Hoiren, good work!
dialogsComplete.ru: Тебе удалось отобрать эти документы у Дунгрена? Должно быть, в бою тебе найдется мало равных!
dialogsComplete.sp: Tu habilidad debe ser extraordinaria si has podido conseguir este documento de Hoiren, ¡buen trabajo!
dialogsComplete.sw: Your skill must be extraordinary if you were able to take this document from Hoiren, good work!
dialogsComplete.th: ทักษะของคุณจะต้องเยี่ยมมากแน่ๆ ถึงสามารถเอาเอกสารมาจาก Hoiren ได้ ทำได้ดีมาก!
dialogsComplete.tw: 你真的很厲害！謝謝你幫我找回這印章文件！
dialogsComplete.vi: Kỹ năng của bạn phải rất phi thường nếu bạn có thể lấy tài liệu này từ Hoiren, bạn làm tốt lắm!

dialogsComplete.en: The Billposter Hero Roentel originally owned this document, but his pupil Hoiren stole it when he died.
dialogsComplete.ar: The Billposter Hero Roentel originally owned this document, but his pupil Hoiren stole it when he died.
dialogsComplete.br: Este é o Documento do Templo de Roentel, que é o herói Billposter. Hoiren era aluno de Roentel, mas ele roubou o documento...
dialogsComplete.cns: 这文件是暴力技师英雄罗瓦特的爆咒练习场的印章文件，胡欧仁原来是罗瓦特的弟子，不过，在罗瓦特死后，这家伙就把……
dialogsComplete.de: Dies ist das Hall Document von Roentel, dem Billposter Hero. Hoiren war der Schüler von Roentel, aber er stahl das Dokument....
dialogsComplete.fi: The Billposter Hero Roentel originally owned this document, but his pupil Hoiren stole it when he died.
dialogsComplete.fil: The Billposter Hero Roentel originally owned this document, but his pupil Hoiren stole it when he died.
dialogsComplete.fr: Il avait été volé il y a des années et personne n'avait réussi à le retrouver à ce jour. Il s'agit du plan du lieu où Roentel, Héros des Moines, a appris l'art de la guerre.
dialogsComplete.id: Pahlawan Billposter Roentel awalnya memiliki dokumen ini, tetapi muridnya Hoiren mencurinya ketika dia meninggal.
dialogsComplete.it: The Billposter Hero Roentel originally owned this document, but his pupil Hoiren stole it when he died.
dialogsComplete.jp: この秘伝書はな、ビルポスター英雄ロエンテール様の奥義の秘伝が記されておるのじゃ。ヴェスパーのやつは元々はロエンテール様の弟子だったんじゃが、英雄が亡くなった際に秘伝書を奪って逃亡した。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이 전당 문서는 원래 빌포스터 영웅 로엔텔님의 것이었는데, 로엔텔님이 돌아가시자 제자였던 호이렌이 훔쳐 갔지 뭡니까.
dialogsComplete.nl: The Billposter Hero Roentel originally owned this document, but his pupil Hoiren stole it when he died.
dialogsComplete.pl: The Billposter Hero Roentel originally owned this document, but his pupil Hoiren stole it when he died.
dialogsComplete.ru: Это документы спортивного зала, где начинал тренироваться герой-атлет Арнолли Терминатти. Став богатым и знаменитым, он выкупил этот зал.
dialogsComplete.sp: El Héroe Billposter Roentel fue originalmente el dueño del documento, pero su alumno Hoiren lo robó cuando se murió.
dialogsComplete.sw: The Billposter Hero Roentel originally owned this document, but his pupil Hoiren stole it when he died.
dialogsComplete.th: Billposter Hero Roentel เป็นเจ้าของเอกสารฉบับนี้ แต่ Hoiren ขโมยไปตอนเขาตาย
dialogsComplete.tw: 這文件是爆咒師英雄羅瓦特的爆咒練習場的印章文件，胡歐仁原來是羅瓦特的弟子，不過，在羅瓦特死後，這傢伙就把……
dialogsComplete.vi: illposter Hero Roentel ban đầu sở hữu tài liệu này, nhưng học trò của ông là Hoiren đã đánh cắp nó khi ông chết.

dialogsComplete.en: Hoiren hid it away, and no one could find it until now. We deeply appreciate your efforts to return it.
dialogsComplete.ar: Hoiren hid it away, and no one could find it until now. We deeply appreciate your efforts to return it.
dialogsComplete.br: ... depois que Roentel morreu, e então o escondeu em algum lugar. Mas, infelizmente, a sua aparência mudou horrivelmente, como você viu. De qualquer maneira, eu lhe agradeço profundamente por trazer esta preciosa relíquia.
dialogsComplete.cns: 那家伙竟把那印章文件据为己有，之后还销声匿迹，算了！你能把东西找回来，这些也不是那么重要了！
dialogsComplete.de: ..nachdem Roentel gestorben war und versteckte es irgendwo. Aber leider hat sich sein Anblick schrecklich verändert, wie du selbst gesehen hast. Jedefalls möchte ich dir herzlich danken, dass du das wertvolle Relikt zurück gebracht hast.
dialogsComplete.fi: Hoiren hid it away, and no one could find it until now. We deeply appreciate your efforts to return it.
dialogsComplete.fil: Hoiren hid it away, and no one could find it until now. We deeply appreciate your efforts to return it.
dialogsComplete.fr: J'apprécie vraiment les efforts que tu as fournis pour le retrouver. Merci, merci infiniment !
dialogsComplete.id: Hoiren menyembunyikannya, dan tidak ada yang bisa menemukannya sampai sekarang. Kami sangat menghargai upaya kamu untuk mengembalikannya.
dialogsComplete.it: Hoiren hid it away, and no one could find it until now. We deeply appreciate your efforts to return it.
dialogsComplete.jp: しかし、邪悪な心で秘伝書を使ったためにその姿も徐々に邪悪なものに変わってしまったのだ･･･。ああ、話はここまでにしようか。とにかくこんな貴重な聖遺物を取り戻してくれたことにはもう一度感謝するよ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 호이렌이 꼭꼭 숨긴 탓에 지금까지 아무도 찾지 못했었죠. 되찾아 주셔서 정말 감사드립니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Hoiren hid it away, and no one could find it until now. We deeply appreciate your efforts to return it.
dialogsComplete.pl: Hoiren hid it away, and no one could find it until now. We deeply appreciate your efforts to return it.
dialogsComplete.ru: После смерти Арнолли его ученик Лойф Дунгрен выкрал документы и сбежал. Самые отважные атлеты боялись бросить ему вызов... Так что мы очень благодарны тебе!
dialogsComplete.sp: Hoiren lo escondió y nadie lo ha podido encontrar hasta ahora. Agradecemos profundamente tus esfuerzos por devolverlo.
dialogsComplete.sw: Hoiren hid it away, and no one could find it until now. We deeply appreciate your efforts to return it.
dialogsComplete.th: Hoiren ซ่อนมันไว้และไม่มีใครสามารถค้นพบได้จนถึงขณะนี้ เราขอบคุณเป็นอย่างยิ่งกับความพยายามของคุณที่นำมันมาคืน
dialogsComplete.tw: 那傢伙竟把那印章文件據為己有，之後還銷聲匿跡，算了！你能把東西找回來，這些也不是那麼重要了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Hoiren đã giấu nó đi, và không ai có thể tìm thấy nó cho đến bây giờ. Chúng tôi đánh giá cao nỗ lực của bạn để giúp nó trở lại.

dialogsFail.en: Such a peaceful place...if only these other Sages would stop with their chattering I could get some writing done...
dialogsFail.ar: Such a peaceful place...if only these other Sages would stop with their chattering I could get some writing done...
dialogsFail.br: Este é um lugar sossegado, pelo menos quando seus barulhentos amigos calam a boca. Ha ha ha! De qualquer maneira, é um ótimo lugar para escrever algo.
dialogsFail.cns: 这里是个安静的地方，可以专心写作创作！
dialogsFail.de: Dies ist ein sehr stiller Ort, wenn diese lauten Typen ihre Klappe halten würden. Nebenbei ist es ein großartiger Ort etwas zu schreiben.
dialogsFail.fi: Such a peaceful place...if only these other Sages would stop with their chattering I could get some writing done...
dialogsFail.fil: Such a peaceful place...if only these other Sages would stop with their chattering I could get some writing done...
dialogsFail.fr: Les âmes de nombreuses personnes vont et viennent ici à la Fontaine des Défunts. C'est ici la limite entre la vie et la mort.
dialogsFail.id: Tempat yang begitu damai ... jika saja orang bijak lain ini berhenti dengan obrolan mereka, saya bisa menyelesaikan beberapa tulisan ..
dialogsFail.it: Such a peaceful place...if only these other Sages would stop with their chattering I could get some writing done...
dialogsFail.jp: ここは静かなところじゃ。まわりはわしと一緒のじじいばっかりじゃがな。フォッフォッフォ。考え事をしたり文章を書いたりするにはうってつけの場所じゃわい。
dialogsFail.kr: 참 평화로운 곳이죠… 다른 현자들이 수다를 멈춰준다면 저도 글을 좀 쓸 수 있을 텐데요…
dialogsFail.nl: Such a peaceful place...if only these other Sages would stop with their chattering I could get some writing done...
dialogsFail.pl: Such a peaceful place...if only these other Sages would stop with their chattering I could get some writing done...
dialogsFail.ru: Здесь так... покойно... Если бы еще другие старейшины не болтали без умолку, я бы закончил мемуары...
dialogsFail.sp: Que lugar tan tranquilo... si los otros Sabios dejaran de charlar, podría escribir un poco...
dialogsFail.sw: Such a peaceful place...if only these other Sages would stop with their chattering I could get some writing done...
dialogsFail.th: ช่างเป็นสถานที่ที่เงียบสงบอะไรเช่นนี้ เพียงแต่ถ้านักปราชญ์ท่านอื่นๆ หยุดคุยกันละก็ ข้าคงสามารถเขียนงานชิ้นนี้ได้สำเร็จ...
dialogsFail.tw: 這地方真寧靜……要是其他賢者能停止喋喋不休，我就能好好寫點東西了……
dialogsFail.vi: Một nơi yên bình như vậy ... giá như những Sages khác ngừng nói chuyện phiếm, tôi có thể hoàn thành một số bài viết ...

description.en: Get the ID card that will allow you into the room with the Violet Trillipy. Hunt them down and bring 20 pieces of Triduum to Nein.
description.ar: Get the ID card that will allow you into the room with the Violet Trillipy. Hunt them down and bring 20 pieces of Triduum to Nein.
description.br: Pegue o cartão de identificação que permitirá sua entrada no sala com Trillipy Violeta. Cace-as e traga 20 pedaços de Triduum para Nein.
description.cns: 得到通行卡之后，猎杀毒蜥蜴搜集20个特立磷回来吧！
description.de: Besorge die ID Karte, um in den Bereich der Mine zu gelangen, wo die Violet Trillity leben. Bring Shin 20 Triduum indem du Violet Trillipy jagst.
description.fi: Get the ID card that will allow you into the room with the Violet Trillipy. Hunt them down and bring 20 pieces of Triduum to Nein.
description.fil: Kunin mo ang ID card na papapasok sa'yo sa kuwartong may Violet Trillipy. Hulihin ang mga iyon at magbalik ng 20 piraso ng Triduum kay Nein.
description.fr: Utiliser la carte d'accès pour entrer dans le repaire des Trillipys Violets puis collecter 20 Triduums sur les Trillipys Violets Perfides
description.id: Dapatkan kartu identitas yang memungkinkan kamu masuk ke ruangan dengan Violet Trillipy. Buru mereka dan bawa 20 buah Triduum ke Nein.
description.it: Get the ID card that will allow you into the room with the Violet Trillipy. Hunt them down and bring 20 pieces of Triduum to Nein.
description.jp: ＜バイオレットトリルピ＞ のいる場所へ入れる通行証を手に入れ＜トリディウム＞ 20個を持って行く。
description.kr: 바이올렛 트릴리피가 있는 곳에 들어가는 데 필요한 ID 카드를 구한 후, 트릴리피를 사냥해서 트리듐 20개를 구해오세요.
description.nl: Get the ID card that will allow you into the room with the Violet Trillipy. Hunt them down and bring 20 pieces of Triduum to Nein.
description.pl: Zdobądź kartę identyfikacyjną, która pozwoli ci wejść do pokoju z Violet Trillipy. Upoluj ich i przynieś Neinowi 20 kawałków Triduum.
description.ru: Нужно получить карту доступа в шахты, где поселились лиловые хватоглоты, и раздобыть двадцать самородков тридия.
description.sp: Consigue la tarjeta ID para poder ir donde están los Trillipys Violetas. Cázalos y llévale 20 piezas de Triduums a Nein.
description.sw: Get the ID card that will allow you into the room with the Violet Trillipy. Hunt them down and bring 20 pieces of Triduum to Nein.
description.th: รับบัตรที่จะช่วยให้คุณเข้าห้องได้ด้วย Violet Trillipy ค้นหาพวกเขาและลงไปหา Triduum จำนวน 20 ชิ้นไปให้ Nein
description.tw: 得到通行卡之後，獵殺劇毒蜈蚣蒐集 20 個特立磷回來吧！
description.vi: Lấy thẻ căn cước sẽ cho phép bạn vào phòng với Violet Trillipy. Hãy săn lùng chúng và mang 20 mảnh Triduum cho Nein.

dialogsBegin.en: Ribenuum is useless to most humans. Maybe you have a Dwarpet friend you can give it to? Here, let me see it. These samples are too impure and even I cannot refine them without the right materials.
dialogsBegin.ar: Ribenuum is useless to most humans. Maybe you have a Dwarpet friend you can give it to? Here, let me see it. These samples are too impure and even I cannot refine them without the right materials.
dialogsBegin.br: Ribenuum não tem serventia para a maioria dos humanos. Talvez você tenha um amigo Dwarpet para fornecer a ele. Aqui, deixe-me ver. Essas amostras estão muito impuras e nem mesmo eu posso refiná-las sem os materiais apropriados.
dialogsBegin.cns: 精炼沛拉磷吧...这个东西对我们人类来说没什么用啦！纯度真的是太低了呢～应该没办法这样拿来精炼啦～
dialogsBegin.de: Ribenuum ist für Menschen ein nutzloses Material. Hast du einen Dwarpet Freund? Lass mal sehen. Dieses Ribenuum hat einen niedrigen Reinheitsgrad.Nicht einmal ich kann es ohne die richtigen Materialien veredeln.
dialogsBegin.fi: Ribenuum is useless to most humans. Maybe you have a Dwarpet friend you can give it to? Here, let me see it. These samples are too impure and even I cannot refine them without the right materials.
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang Ribenuum ay walang kwenta sa karamihan ng tao. Baka mayroon kang kaibigang dwarpet na pagbibigyan neto? Dito, tingnan ko nga yan. Ang mga ito ay masyadong marumi na kahit ako Ay di kayang linisin ito ng walang tamang kagamitan.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tiens du Ribenuum…Tu sais ce métal est inutile aux êtres humains. Ah tu as un ami Dwarpet ? Ha ha, allez fais moi voir ça…. Hmmm, celui-ci est vraiment imparfait, il va être très dur de le purifier comme ça…
dialogsBegin.id: Ribenuum tidak berguna bagi kebanyakan manusia. Mungkin kamu punya teman Dwarpet yang bisa kamu berikan? Sini, biarkan aku melihatnya. Sampel ini terlalu tidak murni dan bahkan aku tidak dapat memperbaikinya tanpa bahan yang tepat.
dialogsBegin.it: Ribenuum is useless to most humans. Maybe you have a Dwarpet friend you can give it to? Here, let me see it. These samples are too impure and even I cannot refine them without the right materials.
dialogsBegin.jp: ＜リベニウム＞ の精錬だって？こいつは人間には価値がない金属だが君、ドワーフの友達でもいるのかい？それにしても、これは純度が低すぎるな。このままでは精錬出来そうにもないぞ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 리베늄은 대부분 인간에게는 쓸모없는 금속인데, 혹시 드워펫 친구에게 줄 건가요? 자, 좀 보여주세요. 이 샘플들은 불순물이 너무 많아서, 적절한 재료 없이는 저도 정제할 수 없어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Ribenuum is useless to most humans. Maybe you have a Dwarpet friend you can give it to? Here, let me see it. These samples are too impure and even I cannot refine them without the right materials.
dialogsBegin.pl: Ribenuum jest bezużyteczne dla większości ludzi. Może masz przyjaciela Krasnoluda, któremu możesz go dać? Proszę, pozwól mi to zobaczyć. Te próbki są zbyt nieczyste i nawet ja nie mogę ich dopracować bez odpowiednich materiałów.
dialogsBegin.ru: Хм. Странно. Рибений в наших краях не часто встретишь, особенно у человека. Впрочем, дело это не мое, да и вообще, должен тебя огорчить: просто так его не переплавить.
dialogsBegin.sp: El Ribenuum es inútil para la mayoría de los humanos. ¿Tal vez tienes algún amigo Enano al que puedas dárselo? Trae, déjame verlo. Estas muestras son tan impuras que ni yo no puedo refinarlas sin los materiales adecuados.
dialogsBegin.sw: Ribenuum is useless to most humans. Maybe you have a Dwarpet friend you can give it to? Here, let me see it. These samples are too impure and even I cannot refine them without the right materials.
dialogsBegin.th: ส่วนใหญ่ Ribenuum ไม่มีประโยชน์สำหรับมนุษย์ บางทีคุณอาจมีเพื่อน Dwarpet ที่คุณสามารถให้มันได้หรือไม่? มาดูกันเถอะ ตัวอย่างของพวกนี้สกปรกมากเกินไปและฉันไม่สามารถแก้ไขวัสดุเหล่านี้ได้โดยที่ไม่มีวัสดุที่เหมาะสม
dialogsBegin.tw: 精煉沛拉磷吧…這個東西對我們人類來說沒什麼用啦！純度真的是太低了呢～應該沒辦法這樣拿來精煉啦～
dialogsBegin.vi: Ribenuum là vô dụng đối với hầu hết con người. Có thể bạn có một người bạn Người lùn mà bạn có thể tặng nó cho người bạn đó? Đây, để tôi xem. Những mẫu này quá không tinh khiết và thậm chí tôi không thể tinh chế chúng nếu không có vật liệu phù hợp.

dialogsBegin.en: I need a special metal called Triduum in order to refine this. You can get it by hunting Violet Trillipy but they live deep in the Dekane Mine.
dialogsBegin.ar: I need a special metal called Triduum in order to refine this. You can get it by hunting Violet Trillipy but they live deep in the Dekane Mine.
dialogsBegin.br: Para fazer o refino, preciso de um metal especial chamado Triduum. Você pode obtê-lo caçando Trillipys Violetas. Só que elas vivem nas profundezas da Mina Dekane.
dialogsBegin.cns: 如果你要精炼这个东西的话，需要特立磷。这个东西在蜥蜴身上可以得到啦！它居住在达肯矿洞里...
dialogsBegin.de: Ich brauche ein spezielles Material namens Triduum. Du kannst es als Beute von Violet Trillipy erhalten, aber sie leben tief in der Dekane Mine.
dialogsBegin.fi: I need a special metal called Triduum in order to refine this. You can get it by hunting Violet Trillipy but they live deep in the Dekane Mine.
dialogsBegin.fil: Kailangan ko ng kakaibang bakal na ang tawag ay Triduum para malinis ito. Makukuha mo ito sa mga Violet Trillipy, ngunit nakatira sila sa kailaliman ng Dekane Mine.
dialogsBegin.fr: J'ai besoin d'un autre métal nommé Triduum afin de pouvoir purifier ce Ribenuum. Tu peux trouver ce métal seulement dans les… déchets des Trillipys Violets.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku membutuhkan logam khusus yang disebut Triduum untuk memperbaiki ini. Kamu bisa mendapatkannya dengan berburu Violet Trillipy tetapi mereka tinggal jauh di dalam Dekane Mine.
dialogsBegin.it: I need a special metal called Triduum in order to refine this. You can get it by hunting Violet Trillipy but they live deep in the Dekane Mine.
dialogsBegin.jp: こいつを精錬しようとするなら、＜トリディウム＞ という特殊な金属が必要だ。その金属は ＜バイオレットトリルピ＞ という生物の甲殻から採れるんだが…その生物は呪われた ＜デェカネス鉱山＞ の奥の奥の、さらに奥地にしかいないんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 정말로 리베늄을 정제하고 싶다면, 트리듐이라는 특별한 금속 20개가 필요해요. 그걸 얻으려면 데카네 광산 깊은 곳에 사는 보라색 트릴리피를 사냥해야 하죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: I need a special metal called Triduum in order to refine this. You can get it by hunting Violet Trillipy but they live deep in the Dekane Mine.
dialogsBegin.pl: Potrzebuję specjalnego metalu o nazwie Triduum, aby to oczyścić. Możesz go zdobyć, polując na Violet Trillipy, ale żyją one głęboko w Kopalni Dekane.
dialogsBegin.ru: Чтобы вытянуть примеси, нужен тридий… Камень, побывавший в желудке у хватоглота, только не зеленого, а лилового!
dialogsBegin.sp: Necesito un metal especial llamado Triduum para refinar esto. Puedes conseguirlo cazando algunos Trillipys Violetas, pero viven en las profundidades de la Mina Dekane.
dialogsBegin.sw: I need a special metal called Triduum in order to refine this. You can get it by hunting Violet Trillipy but they live deep in the Dekane Mine.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันต้องการโลหะพิเศษที่เรียกว่า Triduum เพื่อที่จะแก้ไขสิ่งนี้ คุณจะได้รับมันโดยการล่า Violet Trillipy แต่พวกเขาอาศัยอยู่ลึกลงไปในเหมืองแร่ Dekane
dialogsBegin.tw: 如果你要精煉這個東西的話，需要特立磷。這個東西在劇毒蜈蚣身上可以得到啦！牠居住在迪坎礦坑裡…
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi cần một loại kim loại đặc biệt gọi là Triduum để tinh luyện thứ này. Bạn có thể lấy nó bằng cách săn Violet Trillipy nhưng chúng sống sâu trong hầm mỏ Dekane.

dialogsBegin.en: Well… If you really need the Ribenuum refined bring me 20 Triduums. You are going to need a special ID card to go in there.
dialogsBegin.ar: Well… If you really need the Ribenuum refined bring me 20 Triduums. You are going to need a special ID card to go in there.
dialogsBegin.br: Bem… se você realmente precisa do Ribenuum refinado, traga-me 20 Triduums. Para entrar lá, você precisará de um cartão de identificação especial.
dialogsBegin.cns: 而且、你要进去那里需要另外去找通行卡，可是你要精炼沛拉磷，所以也没办法咯～你就去搜集20个特立磷来好了！
dialogsBegin.de: Wenn du das Ribenuum wirklich brauchst, dann bring mir 20 Triduum. Du brauchst eine spezielle ID Karte, um in diesen Bereich der Mine zu gelangen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Well… If you really need the Ribenuum refined bring me 20 Triduums. You are going to need a special ID card to go in there.
dialogsBegin.fil: Well… If you really need the Ribenuum refined bring me 20 Triduums. You are going to need a special ID card to go in there.
dialogsBegin.fr: En plus il faut une carte d'accès particulière pour y aller... Mais bon, s'il te faut vraiment du Ribenuum pur, amène-moi 20 Triduums pour que je procède à l'opération de purification.
dialogsBegin.id: Baik…Jika kamu benar-benar membutuhkan Ribenuum yang disempurnakan bawakan aku 20 Triduum. Kamu akan memerlukan kartu identitas khusus untuk masuk ke sana.
dialogsBegin.it: Well… If you really need the Ribenuum refined bring me 20 Triduums. You are going to need a special ID card to go in there.
dialogsBegin.jp: しかもそこに入るにはIDカードを入手しなければならない。まあ君にリベニウムが本当に必要なら、仕方ないだろう。 それならトリジウムを20個入手してほしい。 この分量を精錬するにはそれくらいの量は必要だ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 음… 정제된 리베누움이 꼭 필요하다면, 일단 트리두움 20개를 가져오세요. 그 안에 들어가려면 특별한 ID 카드가 필요할 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Well… If you really need the Ribenuum refined bring me 20 Triduums. You are going to need a special ID card to go in there.
dialogsBegin.pl: Cóż… Jeśli naprawdę potrzebujesz oczyszczonego Ribenuum, przynieś mi 20 Triduum. Aby tam wejść, będziesz potrzebować specjalnej karty identyfikacyjnej.
dialogsBegin.ru: Что ж… Если тебе и вправду нужен очищенный рибений, принеси мне 20 самородков тридия. Но чтобы туда попасть, понадобится особая карта доступа.
dialogsBegin.sp: Bueno... Si realmente necesitas el Ribenuum refinado tráeme 20 Triduums. Necesitarás una tarjeta ID especial para ir allí.
dialogsBegin.sw: Well… If you really need the Ribenuum refined bring me 20 Triduums. You are going to need a special ID card to go in there.
dialogsBegin.th: ดี... ถ้าคุณต้องการ Ribenuum นำ Triduums มาให้ฉัน 20 อัน และคุณจะต้องมีบัตรพิเศษเพื่อไปที่นั่น
dialogsBegin.tw: 好吧……如果你真的需要把沛拉磷精煉，就帶 20 個特立磷給我。要進去那裡你還需要一張特殊的通行卡。
dialogsBegin.vi: Chà…Nếu bạn thực sự cần Ribenuum tinh chế, hãy mang cho tôi 20 Triduums. Bạn sẽ cần một thẻ ID đặc biệt để vào đó.

dialogsAccept.en: Go and get an ID card from the guys I used to work with.
dialogsAccept.ar: Go and get an ID card from the guys I used to work with.
dialogsAccept.br: Vá e pegue um cartão de identificação com o pessoal com quem eu costumava trabalhar.
dialogsAccept.cns: 可是你还是要先去找进入那里的通行证才可以啦！你应该要去找以前在矿山做过事情的人，他们应该会给你一些情报的！
dialogsAccept.de: Besorg dir die ID Karte von meinen ehemaligen Kollegen.
dialogsAccept.fi: Go and get an ID card from the guys I used to work with.
dialogsAccept.fil: Kuhanin ang ID card sa mga kasamahan ko sa trabaho dati.
dialogsAccept.fr: Pour entrer dans la zone des Trillipys Violets, peut-être que Cell à Darkon 1 pourrait t'aider, il était l'un des mineurs les plus expérimentés à l'époque...
dialogsAccept.id: Pergi dan dapatkan kartu identitas dari orang-orang yang pernah bekerja denganku.
dialogsAccept.it: Go and get an ID card from the guys I used to work with.
dialogsAccept.jp: そうか、だったらまずは＜バイオレットトリルピ＞ が棲息している地域へ入るための通行証が必要になるが…それは、昔、あの鉱山で働いていた人に聞いた方が良いと思う。
dialogsAccept.kr: 저랑 같이 일하던 사람들한테 가면 광산에 들어가는 ID 카드를 받을 수 있을 거예요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Go and get an ID card from the guys I used to work with.
dialogsAccept.pl: Idź i zdobądź kartę identyfikacyjną od ludzi, z którymi kiedyś pracowałem.
dialogsAccept.ru: Но это не беда. Карты доступа есть у моих бывших напарников-шахтеров.
dialogsAccept.sp: Ve y consigue la tarjeta ID de la gente con la que solía trabajar.
dialogsAccept.sw: Go and get an ID card from the guys I used to work with.
dialogsAccept.th: ไปรับบัตรประจำตัวจากคนที่ฉันเคยทำงานด้วย
dialogsAccept.tw: 可是你還是要先去找進入那裡的通行證才可以啦！你應該要去找以前在礦坑做過事情的人，他們應該會給你一些情報的！
dialogsAccept.vi: Hãy đi lấy thẻ căn cước từ những người tôi từng làm việc cùng.

dialogsDecline.en: Ha ha ha.You can do that if you need to. I hope you are not doing this for some Dwarpet.
dialogsDecline.ar: Ha ha ha.You can do that if you need to. I hope you are not doing this for some Dwarpet.
dialogsDecline.br: Ha ha ha. Você pode fazer isso, se necessário. Eu espero que não esteja fazendo isso para algum Dwarpet.
dialogsDecline.cns: 哈哈哈...如果这是你要需要的东西的话，我是没话说啦～可是如果你是为了矮人族做这些事情的话...我就更无言了～
dialogsDecline.de: Hahaha. Tu, was du tun musst. Ich hoffe nur, du tust das nicht für irgendeinen Dwarpet.
dialogsDecline.fi: Ha ha ha.You can do that if you need to. I hope you are not doing this for some Dwarpet.
dialogsDecline.fil: Ha ha ha.Gawin mo yan kung kailangan mo. Sana ay hindi mo ginagawa ito para lang sa isang Dwarpet.
dialogsDecline.fr: Ha ha ha. Ok, si tu en as vraiment besoin… J'espère que tu ne fais pas ça seulement pour les Dwarpets.
dialogsDecline.id: Ha ha ha. Kamu bisa melakukannya jika perlu. Aku harap kamu tidak melakukan ini untuk beberapa Dwarpet.
dialogsDecline.it: Ha ha ha.You can do that if you need to. I hope you are not doing this for some Dwarpet.
dialogsDecline.jp: まあ、君が自分のためというならまだしも、ドワーフのためというなら、やめておいたほうが賢明だね。
dialogsDecline.kr: 하하하. 뭐, 꼭 필요하다면 그렇게 하세요. 설마 드워펫에게 주려고 이러는 건 아니겠죠?
dialogsDecline.nl: Ha ha ha.You can do that if you need to. I hope you are not doing this for some Dwarpet.
dialogsDecline.pl: Ha ha ha. Możesz to zrobić, jeśli potrzebujesz. Mam nadzieję, że nie robisz tego dla jakiegoś Krasnoluda.
dialogsDecline.ru: Ха! Вот видишь, немного старания - и самое трудное дело становится легким! Постой… Надеюсь, тебя не карлики подрядили переплавить металл?
dialogsDecline.sp: Ja, ja, ja. Puedes hacerlo si lo necesitas. Espero que no estés haciendo esto por algún Enano.
dialogsDecline.sw: Ha ha ha.You can do that if you need to. I hope you are not doing this for some Dwarpet.
dialogsDecline.th: ฮ่าๆ คุณสามารถทำเช่นนั้นได้หากต้องการ ฉันหวังว่าคุณจะไม่ทำเช่นนี้กับ Dwarpet
dialogsDecline.tw: 哈哈哈…如果這是你要需要的東西的話，我是沒話說啦～可是如果你是為了杜爾沛做這些事情的話…我就更無言囉～
dialogsDecline.vi: Ha ha ha. Bạn có thể làm điều đó nếu bạn cần. Tôi hy vọng bạn không làm điều này vì một số Người lùn

dialogsComplete.en: Here is your refined Ribenuum. But, a word of warning, if the Dwarpet Kazen asked you for this… he is thinking more than he is saying.
dialogsComplete.ar: Here is your refined Ribenuum. But, a word of warning, if the Dwarpet Kazen asked you for this… he is thinking more than he is saying.
dialogsComplete.br: Aqui está seu Ribenuum refinado. Porém, uma palavra de advertência: se Dwarpet Kazen pediu isso a você… ele está pensando algo a mais do que falou.
dialogsComplete.cns: 哈～来！这是帮你精炼好的沛拉磷，拿去吧。这是卡斩请你帮忙的吗？我猜他应该有其他阴谋喔。
dialogsComplete.de: Hier hast du das veredelte Ribenuum. Aber wenn Dwarpet Kazen danach fragt, wird er womöglich etwas im Schilde führen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Here is your refined Ribenuum. But, a word of warning, if the Dwarpet Kazen asked you for this… he is thinking more than he is saying.
dialogsComplete.fil: Narito ang pinong Ribenuum mo. Ngunit mag-ingat ka — kung hiniling ito sa'yo ng Dwarpet na si Kazen… mas marami siyang iniisip kaysa sa sinasabi niya.
dialogsComplete.fr: Voici du Ribenuum avec un haut degré de pureté que j'ai obtenu avec les matériaux que tu m'as amenés. Mais si le Dwarpet Kasen t'a demandé ceci, il doit avoir une arrière-pensée...
dialogsComplete.id: Ini dia Ribenuummu yang sudah diperbaiki. Tetapi, sebuah peringatan, jika Dwarpet Kazen memintamu untuk ini...dia berpikir lebih dari yang dia katakan.
dialogsComplete.it: Here is your refined Ribenuum. But, a word of warning, if the Dwarpet Kazen asked you for this… he is thinking more than he is saying.
dialogsComplete.jp: さあ、これが精錬した＜高純度リベニウム＞ だ。だが、もしこれがカゼンというドワーフから頼まれたことだったら用心しろ。奴は何かたくらんでいるような気がするんだ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 자아, 여기 정제된 리베누움이에요. 하지만 조심하세요. 만약 드워펫 카젠이 이걸 부탁한 거라면… 카젠은 속으로 다른 꿍꿍이가 있을 수도 있어요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Here is your refined Ribenuum. But, a word of warning, if the Dwarpet Kazen asked you for this… he is thinking more than he is saying.
dialogsComplete.pl: Oto twoje oczyszczone Ribenuum. Ale słowo ostrzeżenia, jeśli krasnoludzki Kazen cię o to poprosił… on więcej wie niż mówi.
dialogsComplete.ru: Вот твой очищенный рибений. Но имей в виду: если карлик Кайзен просил тебя об этом… значит, он задумал больше, чем говорит.
dialogsComplete.sp: Aquí está tu Ribenuum refinado. Pero, una pequeña advertencia, si el Enano Kazen te pidió esto... está tramando algo.
dialogsComplete.sw: Here is your refined Ribenuum. But, a word of warning, if the Dwarpet Kazen asked you for this… he is thinking more than he is saying.
dialogsComplete.th: นี่คือ Refined Ribenuum ของคุณ โปรดจำไว้ว่า.. ถ้า Dwarpet Kazen ถามคุณสำหรับเรื่องนี้... เขาคิดไปเยอะกว่าสิ่งที่เขาพูด
dialogsComplete.tw: 這是你精煉好的沛拉磷。不過我得提醒你一句，如果杜爾沛卡斬叫你做這件事……那他盤算的可不只表面上這些。
dialogsComplete.vi: Đây là Ribenuum tinh chế của bạn. Nhưng, cảnh báo trước, nếu Dwarpet Kazen hỏi bạn điều này… thì lời anh ta nói ra chưa chắc đã là những gì anh ta nghĩ đâu.

dialogsComplete.en: Kazen has hated humans for as long as I have known him and him working with you means he is on to something big. You know… there is a rumor that he had a hand in all the deaths in that mine.
dialogsComplete.ar: Kazen has hated humans for as long as I have known him and him working with you means he is on to something big. You know… there is a rumor that he had a hand in all the deaths in that mine.
dialogsComplete.br: Kazen odeia os humanos desde que o conheço e o fato de ele estar trabalhando com você significa que está envolvido em algo grande. Você sabe… existe um rumor de que ele teve estava envolvida com todas as mortes naquela mina.
dialogsComplete.cns: 因为啊～他很讨厌我们人类啦！可是他还请你帮他做事情，我猜他应该有其他阴谋才对啦...而且也听说过他跟矿山的诡异事件有相关呢...
dialogsComplete.de: Kazen hat Menschen schon immer gehasst. Wenn er sich also sogar mit dir zusammentut, hat er wahrscheinlich etwas großes vor. Es gibt das Gerücht,dass er etwas mit all den Todesfällen in der Mine zu tun hat.
dialogsComplete.fi: Kazen has hated humans for as long as I have known him and him working with you means he is on to something big. You know… there is a rumor that he had a hand in all the deaths in that mine.
dialogsComplete.fil: Matagal nang galit si Kazen sa mga tao simula nang makilala ko siya, at kapag nakikipag-trabaho siya sa'yo ibig sabihin may malaki siyang napag-alaman. Alam mo… may sabi-sabi na may kinalaman siya sa lahat ng pagkamatay sa minahan na iyon.
dialogsComplete.fr: Parce qu’il déteste vraiment les humains tu sais. Il doit donc y avoir une raison pour qu'il soit aussi gentil avec toi. En plus des rumeurs circulent, disant qu'il serait impliqué dans l'histoire des mystérieux décès dans la mine.
dialogsComplete.id: Kazen telah membenci manusia selama aku mengenalnya dan dia bekerja denganmu berarti dia sedang melakukan sesuatu yang besar. Kamu tahu ... ada rumor bahwa dia memiliki andil dalam semua kematian di tambang itu.
dialogsComplete.it: Kazen has hated humans for as long as I have known him and him working with you means he is on to something big. You know… there is a rumor that he had a hand in all the deaths in that mine.
dialogsComplete.jp: あいつはドワーフの中でも特に、人間が大嫌いなドワーフなんだ。だから、もし君に親しい態度をとっても、何かをたくらんでいるに違いない。それにあいつは＜デェカネス鉱山＞ の怪しい部分に関わっている、という噂もあるからね。
dialogsComplete.kr: 카젠은 제가 아는 한, 인간을 늘 싫어했거든요. 그런 녀석이 협력하고 있다면, 분명 무언가 큰일을 꾸미고 있는 거예요. 광산에서 있었던 죽음에도 카젠이 연루되어 있다는 소문이 있다고요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Kazen has hated humans for as long as I have known him and him working with you means he is on to something big. You know… there is a rumor that he had a hand in all the deaths in that mine.
dialogsComplete.pl: Kazen nienawidził ludzi odkąd go znam, a jego praca z tobą oznacza, że ​​zmierza do czegoś wielkiego. Wiesz… krążą plotki, że miał swój udział we wszystkich zgonach w tej kopalni.
dialogsComplete.ru: Кайзен ненавидит людей с тех пор, как я его знаю. Если он вдруг стал с тобой работать, значит, затевает нечто грандиозное. Знаешь… поговаривают, что все смерти в той шахте — дело его рук.
dialogsComplete.sp: Kazen ha odiado a los humanos desde que lo conozco y el hecho de que trabaje contigo significa que está en algo grande. Ya sabes... hay un rumor de que tuvo algo que ver con todas las muertes de esa mina.
dialogsComplete.sw: Kazen has hated humans for as long as I have known him and him working with you means he is on to something big. You know… there is a rumor that he had a hand in all the deaths in that mine.
dialogsComplete.th: ท่าที่ฉันรู้จักเขา Kazen เกลียดมนุษมาก และเขาทำงานร่วมกับคุณหมายความว่าเขาต้องการอะไรที่ยิ่งใหญ่ คุณรู้ไหม... มีข่าวลือว่าเขามีส่วนช่วยในการเสียชีวิตในเหมืองนั่น
dialogsComplete.tw: 就我認識卡斬以來，他一直都痛恨人類，而現在他居然和你合作，代表他一定在謀劃什麼大事。你知道嗎……有傳聞說礦坑裡那些死亡事件都和他有關。
dialogsComplete.vi: Kazen đã căm ghét con người từ khi tôi biết anh ấy rồi, việc anh ta chịu hợp tác với bạn nghĩa là anh ta đang âm mưu gì đó lớn đấy. Bạn biết đấy… có tin đồn rằng anh ta đã nhúng tay vào tất cả những cái chết trong khu mỏ đó.

dialogsComplete.en: You let me know if he is acting suspiciously. Maybe I can do something to help you.
dialogsComplete.ar: You let me know if he is acting suspiciously. Maybe I can do something to help you.
dialogsComplete.br: Não deixe de me avisar caso ele aja de forma suspeita. Talvez eu possa fazer algo para ajudá-lo.
dialogsComplete.cns: 反正啦～如果你觉得它怪怪的话，马上来跟我说吧！或许我可以帮得上你的忙。
dialogsComplete.de: Sage mir Bescheid, wenn du etwas Auffälliges an ihm bemerkst. Vielleicht kann ich dir helfen.
dialogsComplete.fi: You let me know if he is acting suspiciously. Maybe I can do something to help you.
dialogsComplete.fil: Sabihin mo sa'kin kung may kahina-hinala siyang ginagawa. Baka may magagawa ako para tumulong.
dialogsComplete.fr: Donc, dis-moi franchement s’il y a quelque chose de suspect avec lui. Peut-être pourrais-je t'aider !?
dialogsComplete.id: Kamu beritahu aku jika dia bertingkah mencurigakan. Mungkin aku bisa melakukan sesuatu untuk membantumu.
dialogsComplete.it: You let me know if he is acting suspiciously. Maybe I can do something to help you.
dialogsComplete.jp: とにかく少しでも奴のあやしい動きに気づいたら、俺に相談しろ。何か力になってやれることがあるかもしれないからな。
dialogsComplete.kr: 그 친구가 수상한 행동을 한다면 꼭 알려주세요. 제가 도와줄 수 있을지도 몰라요.
dialogsComplete.nl: You let me know if he is acting suspiciously. Maybe I can do something to help you.
dialogsComplete.pl: Daj mi znać, jeśli zachowuje się podejrzanie. Może mogę coś zrobić, aby ci pomóc.
dialogsComplete.ru: Будь настороже, и как почуешь что подозрительное - беги ко мне, вместе быстрее разберемся, что к чему.
dialogsComplete.sp: Hazme saber si está actuando de manera sospechosa. Tal vez pueda hacer algo para ayudarte.
dialogsComplete.sw: You let me know if he is acting suspiciously. Maybe I can do something to help you.
dialogsComplete.th: คุณบอกเราได้ ถ้าเขาทำตัวน่าสงสัย บางทีฉันสามารถทำอะไรเพื่อช่วยคุณได้
dialogsComplete.tw: 反正啦～如果你覺得牠怪怪的話，馬上來跟我說吧！或許我可以幫得上你的忙。
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn cho tôi biết nếu anh ta đang hành động đáng ngờ. Có lẽ tôi có thể làm gì đó để giúp bạn

dialogsFail.en: Why not just let it go? Go home and get some rest.
dialogsFail.ar: Why not just let it go? Go home and get some rest.
dialogsFail.br: Por que não deixá-lo ir? Vá para casa e descanse um pouco.
dialogsFail.cns: 我觉得你还是不要自找麻烦啦！在这里放弃好不好？
dialogsFail.de: Warum gibst du nicht auf und legst eine Pause ein?
dialogsFail.fi: Why not just let it go? Go home and get some rest.
dialogsFail.fil: Bakit hindi mo na lang palampasin? Umuwi ka na at magpahinga.
dialogsFail.fr: Pourquoi n'abandonnerais-tu pas simplement et te reposerais-tu pas un peu ?
dialogsFail.id: Kenapa tidak dibiarkan begitu saja? Pulang dan istirahatlah.
dialogsFail.it: Why not just let it go? Go home and get some rest.
dialogsFail.jp: もうやめておいたほうがいいんじゃないか？　どうせ無駄骨だよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 그냥 잊고 넘어가세요. 집에 가서 좀 쉬는 게 어때요?
dialogsFail.nl: Why not just let it go? Go home and get some rest.
dialogsFail.pl: Dlaczego po prostu nie odpuścić? Idź do domu i odpocznij.
dialogsFail.ru: А и правда. Зачем оно тебе нужно? Ступай домой, отдыхай, живи нормальной жизнью.
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Por qué no lo dejas y ya? Vete a casa y descansa un poco.
dialogsFail.sw: Why not just let it go? Go home and get some rest.
dialogsFail.th: ทำไมไม่ปล่อยวางซะ? กลับบ้านไปพักผ่อนเถอะ
dialogsFail.tw: 我覺得你還是不要自找麻煩啦！在這裡放棄好不好？
dialogsFail.vi: Tại sao không chỉ để nó đi? Về nhà nghỉ ngơi đi.

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?
