dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.br: Sua missão foi concluída. Seus pecados foram perdoados.
dialogsComplete.cns: 任务完成，你的罪恶已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Buße getan. Deine Sünden wurden dir vergeben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Questmu telah tercapai. Dosa-dosamu telah diampuni.
dialogsComplete.it: La Missione è terminata. I tuoi peccati sono stati perdonati.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 끝났습니다. 당신의 죄를 용서하지요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Боги одобрили твое деяние и простили тебе грехи.
dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น บาปของคุณได้รับการอภัยแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nhiệm vụ của bạn đã được hoàn thành. Tội lỗi của bạn đã được tha thứ.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

name.th: ผู้สืบทอดของฮีโร่ -Guardian-
name.tw: 英雄的繼承者 - 守護者

description.en: Defeat the guardian spirit, Venel Guardian, and get it's heart. Then please visit Capafe who is the Billposter Guardian.
description.ar: Defeat the guardian spirit, Venel Guardian, and get it's heart. Then please visit Capafe who is the Billposter Guardian.
description.br: Derrote o espírito, Guardião Venel, e obtenha seu coração. Visite então Capafe, a Guardiã Billposter.
description.cns: 去打倒守护兽贝纳卡度温，并取得他的心脏，再去找暴力技师守护使者卡帕菲！
description.de: Besiege den Wächtergeist Venel Guardian und beschaffe sein Herz. Dann besuchst du Capafe, den Billposter Wächter.
description.fi: Defeat the guardian spirit, Venel Guardian, and get it's heart. Then please visit Capafe who is the Billposter Guardian.
description.fil: Defeat the guardian spirit, Venel Guardian, and get it's heart. Then please visit Capafe who is the Billposter Guardian.
description.fr: Vaincre Venel et ramener son cœur à la Gardienne des Moines, Capafe.
description.id: Kalahkan roh penjaga, Venel Guardian, dan dapatkan jantungnya. Kemudian silahkan kunjungi Capafe yang merupakan Billposter Guardian.
description.it: Defeat the guardian spirit, Venel Guardian, and get it's heart. Then please visit Capafe who is the Billposter Guardian.
description.jp: ガルディアの守護者の部屋にいる守護精霊＜ヴェネル・ガーディアン＞のハートを手に入れ、ビルポスター守護者カペーペに会おう。
description.kr: 수호 정령 베넬가디언을 처치하고 심장을 손에 넣으세요. 그다음, 빌포스터 수호자 카파페를 찾아가세요.
description.nl: Defeat the guardian spirit, Venel Guardian, and get it's heart. Then please visit Capafe who is the Billposter Guardian.
description.pl: Defeat the guardian spirit, Venel Guardian, and get it's heart. Then please visit Capafe who is the Billposter Guardian.
description.ru: Нужно победить Виндигго и принести его сердце Капифе, хранительнице атлетов.
description.sp: Derrota al Guardián Venel, y consigue su corazón. Entrégaselo a Capafe, la Guardiana Billposter.
description.sw: Defeat the guardian spirit, Venel Guardian, and get it's heart. Then please visit Capafe who is the Billposter Guardian.
description.th: เอาชนะ Venel Guardian และนำเอาหัวใจของเขาไปให้ the Billposter Guardian ที่ชื่อ Capafe
description.tw: 去打倒守護獸貝納卡度溫，並取得他的心臟，再去找爆咒師守護者卡班沛！
description.vi: Đánh bại thần hộ mệnh, Venel Guardian, và lấy trái tim của nó. Sau đó, hãy đến thăm Capafe, là Billposter Guardian.

dialogsBegin.en: Here, take this Mark of the Heroes. It along with one last item will denote your status as a true Billposter.
dialogsBegin.ar: Here, take this Mark of the Heroes. It along with one last item will denote your status as a true Billposter.
dialogsBegin.br: Aqui está o símbolo do herói. Você precisa de mais um comprovante para ser reconhecido como um sucessor do herói.
dialogsBegin.cns: 这能证明你是英雄守护使者的继承者，但还需要另一个证明，了解你真正的实力！
dialogsBegin.de: Dies ist das Symbol der Helden. Du brauchst noch einen Beleg um als Nachfolger der Helden anerkannt zu werden.
dialogsBegin.fi: Here, take this Mark of the Heroes. It along with one last item will denote your status as a true Billposter.
dialogsBegin.fil: Here, take this Mark of the Heroes. It along with one last item will denote your status as a true Billposter.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je peux maintenant te confier le Sceau des Héros, qui confirme que tu as relevé avec succès tous les défis qui se sont présentés. Mais il te faut encore réussir l'épreuve finale.
dialogsBegin.id: Di sini, ambil Tanda Pahlawan ini. Ini bersama dengan satu item terakhir akan menunjukkan statusmu sebagai Billposter sejati.
dialogsBegin.it: Here, take this Mark of the Heroes. It along with one last item will denote your status as a true Billposter.
dialogsBegin.jp: じゃあ、これが英雄の証だよ。実は、このほかにもうひとつ証が必要なんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 여기, 영웅의 증표를 받으세요. 진정한 빌포스터로 인정을 받으시려면 한 가지의 증표가 더 필요합니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Here, take this Mark of the Heroes. It along with one last item will denote your status as a true Billposter.
dialogsBegin.pl: Here, take this Mark of the Heroes. It along with one last item will denote your status as a true Billposter.
dialogsBegin.ru: Это Знак героя. Он означает, что его владелец является истинным наследником героя-атлета.
dialogsBegin.sp: Toma esta Marca de los Héroes. Junto con un último objeto, marcará tu estado como un verdadero Billposter.
dialogsBegin.sw: Here, take this Mark of the Heroes. It along with one last item will denote your status as a true Billposter.
dialogsBegin.th: อ่ะนี่ นำ Mark of the Heroes ไปพร้อมกับไอเท็มอย่างสุดท้ายของคุณที่แสดงว่าคุณเป็น Billposter ที่แท้จริง
dialogsBegin.tw: 這能證明你是英雄守護者的繼承者，但還需要另一個證明，了解你真正的實力！
dialogsBegin.vi: Đây, cầm lấy Mark of the Heroes này. Nó cùng với một vật phẩm cuối cùng sẽ cho thấy bạn là một Billposter thực sự.

dialogsBegin.en: In the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.ar: In the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.br: Na Sala do Guardião, você encontrará um espírito chamado $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你将会在守护之室找到一个名为$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$的意志。
dialogsBegin.de: Im Raum des Wächters findest du einen Geist namens $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fi: In the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fil: In the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fr: Au sud de Darkon 3, à Gardiane, se trouve un esprit appelé $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.id: Di Ruang Penjaga, Kamu akan menemukan roh yang disebut $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.it: In the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.jp: ガルディアンの守護者の部屋というところがありますが、この場所は英雄の紋章があるところで、英雄たちの意志が保存されています。 ここでは、$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$という精霊を見つけることができます。
dialogsBegin.kr: 수호자의 방에, $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$라는 정령이 있을 겁니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: In the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.pl: In the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.ru: In the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.sp: En la Habitación del Guardián, encontrarás un espíritu llamado $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.sw: In the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.th: ใน Guardian's Room คุณจะพบกับวิญญาณที่ถูกเรียกว่า $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$
dialogsBegin.tw: 在守護者之室裡，你會找到一個名為 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 的靈魂。
dialogsBegin.vi: Trong Guardian's Room, bạn sẽ tìm thấy một linh hồn được gọi là $ QUEST_END_KILL_NAME $.

dialogsBegin.en: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.ar: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.br: Derrote o espírito e obtenha seu coração. O coração será o comprovante do seu último teste.
dialogsBegin.cns: 击败它，拿走它的心脏。这是最后的考验了
dialogsBegin.de: Besiegt diesen Geist und nehmt sein Herz. Dies wird deine letzte Prüfung sein.
dialogsBegin.fi: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.fil: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il te faut y pénétrer et vaincre l'esprit qui s'y trouve. Il s'agit de ta dernière épreuve !
dialogsBegin.id: Kalahkan roh ini, dan ambil hatinya. Ini akan menjadi ujian terakhirmu.
dialogsBegin.it: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.jp: この守護者の部屋にいるヴェネル・ガーディアンを倒して、ヴェネル・ハートを取らなきゃいけないんだ。そしてそのハートが最後の証なのさ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그 정령을 쓰러뜨리고 심장을 손에 넣으세요. 이게 마지막 시험이에요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.pl: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.ru: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.sp: Derrota a ese espíritu y consigue su corazón. Esta es tu prueba final.
dialogsBegin.sw: Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
dialogsBegin.th: เอาชนะวิญญาณตนนี้ และเอาหัวใจของมันมา นี่เป็นการทดสอบครั้งสุดท้ายของคุณ
dialogsBegin.tw: 打敗這個靈魂，奪取他的心。這將是你最後的考驗。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đánh bại tinh linh này, và lấy trái tim của nó. Đây sẽ là bài kiểm tra cuối cùng của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Capafe, the Billposter Guardian.
dialogsBegin.ar: Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Capafe, the Billposter Guardian.
dialogsBegin.br: Por favor, entregue o coração para Capafe, a Guardiã Billposter.
dialogsBegin.cns: 然后，请你把这心脏拿给加勒迪安暴力技师守护使者卡帕菲！
dialogsBegin.de: Bitte bring das Herz zu Capafe, dem Billposter Wächter.
dialogsBegin.fi: Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Capafe, the Billposter Guardian.
dialogsBegin.fil: Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Capafe, the Billposter Guardian.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu pourras alors te présenter à la Gardienne des Moines, Capafe.
dialogsBegin.id: Setelah kamu menyelesaikan tugas ini, tunjukkan hati kepada Capafe, Penjaga Billposter.
dialogsBegin.it: Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Capafe, the Billposter Guardian.
dialogsBegin.jp: それを手に入れたらビルポスター守護者カペーペのもとに行ってください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 임무를 완수하면, 심장을 빌포스터 수호자 카파페에게 전달하세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Capafe, the Billposter Guardian.
dialogsBegin.pl: Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Capafe, the Billposter Guardian.
dialogsBegin.ru: Отнеси сердце Капифе, хранительнице атлетов. Справишься?
dialogsBegin.sp: Una vez que hayas terminado, entrega el Corazón a Capafe, la Guardiana Billposter.
dialogsBegin.sw: Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Capafe, the Billposter Guardian.
dialogsBegin.th: เมื่อคุณเสร็จสิ้นภารกิจนี้แล้ว ให้แสดงหัวใจต่อ Billposter Guardian ที่ชื่อ Capafe
dialogsBegin.tw: 然後，請你把這心臟拿給守護者祭壇爆咒師守護者 [卡班沛]！
dialogsBegin.vi: Khi bạn đã hoàn thành nhiệm vụ này, hãy giao trái tim cho Capafe, Billposter Guardian.

dialogsAccept.en: I wish you luck.
dialogsAccept.ar: I wish you luck.
dialogsAccept.br: Eu lhe desejo sorte.
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你好运
dialogsAccept.de: Ich wünsche Dir viel Glück.
dialogsAccept.fi: Toivotan sinulle onnea.
dialogsAccept.fil: I wish you luck.
dialogsAccept.fr: Je te souhaite que la grâce de Heren t'accompagne.
dialogsAccept.id: Saya berharap Anda beruntung.
dialogsAccept.it: I wish you luck.
dialogsAccept.jp: じゃあ、がんばってね。無事に試練を乗り越えられますように！
dialogsAccept.kr: 승리를 기원하죠.
dialogsAccept.nl: I wish you luck.
dialogsAccept.pl: I wish you luck.
dialogsAccept.ru: I wish you luck.
dialogsAccept.sp: Te deseo suerte.
dialogsAccept.sw: I wish you luck.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้คุณโชคดี
dialogsAccept.tw: 祝你好運！
dialogsAccept.vi: Chúc bạn may mắn.

dialogsDecline.en: You’re almost finished, Assist. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.ar: You’re almost finished, Assist. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.br: Você veio até aqui, e agora está desistindo? Este é o último passo, por favor pense cuidadosamente.
dialogsDecline.cns: 都已经来到这里了才要放弃，太可惜了，要不要再加油一下呢？
dialogsDecline.de: Du bist den Ganzen Weg hierher gekommen und willst jetzt aufgeben? Das ist die letzte Prüfung, also überleg es dir gut.
dialogsDecline.fi: You’re almost finished, Assist. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.fil: You’re almost finished, Assist. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.fr: Après avoir traversé tant d'épreuves, tu es sur le point d'abandonner ? Ceci est la dernière étape, réfléchis bien...
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu hampir selesai,Asisten. Jangan menyerah sekarang.
dialogsDecline.it: You’re almost finished, Assist. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.jp: 何かを成し遂げるには大変なことです。ここまでやっておきながらその結果を見ずにやめてしまうんですか？
dialogsDecline.kr: 이제 거의 끝났습니다, 어시스트님. 포기하지 마세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: You’re almost finished, Assist. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.pl: You’re almost finished, Assist. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.ru: Не сдавайся, униформист, ты почти у цели.
dialogsDecline.sp: Ya casi has terminado, Assist. No te rindas ahora.
dialogsDecline.sw: You’re almost finished, Assist. Don’t give up now.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณใกล้จะทำสำเร็จแล้ว Assist อย่าพึ่งยอมแพ้ตอนนี้สิ
dialogsDecline.tw: 都已經來到這裡了才要放棄，太可惜了，要不要再加油一下呢？
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn sắp hoàn thành, Assist. Đừng bỏ cuộc bây giờ.

dialogsComplete.en: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Billposter upon you.
dialogsComplete.ar: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Billposter upon you.
dialogsComplete.br: Muito bem, sucessor. Você passou no último teste! Eu agora oficialmente concedo o título de Billposter para você.
dialogsComplete.cns: 恭喜你喔！你已经通过最后的测验，成为了暴力技师的继承者了！
dialogsComplete.de: Willkommen Nachfolger. Du hast den letzten Test bestanden! Nun werde ich dich zum Nachfolger des Billposter Hero ernennen!
dialogsComplete.fi: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Billposter upon you.
dialogsComplete.fil: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Billposter upon you.
dialogsComplete.fr: Bienvenue à Gardiane. Tu as réussi brillamment la dernière épreuve et mérites désormais d'être l'un des successeurs du Héros des Moines.
dialogsComplete.id: Bagus sekali! Saya sekarang secara resmi menganugerahkan gelar Billposter kepadamu.
dialogsComplete.it: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Billposter upon you.
dialogsComplete.jp: 後継者よ。汝は最後の試練を乗り越えた。これからはビルポスター後継者として新たな道を歩むがよい！舞踏する神の息吹が汝の心臓にも宿るであろう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 훌륭하네요! 이제 당신에게 빌포스터의 칭호를 정식으로 수여하겠습니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Billposter upon you.
dialogsComplete.pl: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Billposter upon you.
dialogsComplete.ru: Прекрасно! Объявляю тебя атлетом!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Bien hecho! Oficialmente te otorgo el título de Billposter.
dialogsComplete.sw: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Billposter upon you.
dialogsComplete.th: ทำได้ดีมาก! ตอนนี้ฉันขอมอบอาชีพ Billposter ให้กับคุณอย่างเป็นทางการ
dialogsComplete.tw: 恭喜你喔！你已經通過最後的測驗，成為了爆咒師的繼承者了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Làm tốt lắm! Bây giờ tôi chính thức ban tặng danh hiệu Billposter cho bạn.

dialogsComplete.en: Roentel, please bless and encourage this Billposter as they follow your will!
dialogsComplete.ar: Roentel, please bless and encourage this Billposter as they follow your will!
dialogsComplete.br: Roentel, por favor abençoe e encoraje esta pessoa que está seguindo a sua vontade! Billposter!
dialogsComplete.cns: 罗瓦特啊！这里有要继承你的人，祝福它吧！
dialogsComplete.de: Roentel, bitte segne und ermutige die Person, die deinem Geist folgen möchte! Billposter!
dialogsComplete.fi: Roentel, please bless and encourage this Billposter as they follow your will!
dialogsComplete.fil: Roentel, please bless and encourage this Billposter as they follow your will!
dialogsComplete.fr: Roentel, puisses-tu bénir et soutenir en tout temps cette personne ici qui dédie sa vie à ta volonté !
dialogsComplete.id: Roentel, mohon berkati dan dorong Poster Poster ini karena mereka mengikuti kehendakmu!
dialogsComplete.it: Roentel, please bless and encourage this Billposter as they follow your will!
dialogsComplete.jp: ＜鋼の拳＞ロエンテールよ、今ここに新たな後継者が誕生しました！この者に祝福と勇気を授けたまえ！
dialogsComplete.kr: 로엔텔이시여, 이 빌포스터가 당신의 뜻을 따를 수 있도록 축복과 격려를 내려주소서!
dialogsComplete.nl: Roentel, please bless and encourage this Billposter as they follow your will!
dialogsComplete.pl: Roentel, please bless and encourage this Billposter as they follow your will!
dialogsComplete.ru: О, великий Арнолли Терминатти! Благослови этого атлета на подвиги и направь его по верному пути.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Roentel, por favor bendice y dale valor a este Billposter qué seguirá tu voluntad!
dialogsComplete.sw: Roentel, please bless and encourage this Billposter as they follow your will!
dialogsComplete.th: Roentel โปรดอวยพรและคอยช่วยเหลือ Billposter คนนี้ตามที่คุณต้องการด้วยเถิด!
dialogsComplete.tw: 羅瓦特啊！這裡有要繼承你的人，祝福它吧！

dialogsBegin.en: Hello traveler! It looks like you've reached level 20! You know what this means right? You can now fly on your very own flying device!
dialogsBegin.ar: Hello traveler! It looks like you've reached level 20! You know what this means right? You can now fly on your very own flying device!
dialogsBegin.br: Olá viajante! Parece que você atingiu o nível 20! Você sabe o que isso significa, certo? Agora você pode voar em seu próprio dispositivo voador!
dialogsBegin.cns: 你好啊，旅行者！看起来你已经达到了20级！你知道这意味着什么吗？你现在可以用你自己的飞行器进行飞行了！
dialogsBegin.de: Hallo Abenteurer! Es sieht so aus, als hättest du Level 20 erreicht! Du weißt, was das bedeutet, oder? Du kannst jetzt mit deinem eigenen Flugapparat fliegen!
dialogsBegin.fi: Hello traveler! It looks like you've reached level 20! You know what this means right? You can now fly on your very own flying device!
dialogsBegin.fil: Hello traveler! It looks like you've reached level 20! You know what this means right? You can now fly on your very own flying device!
dialogsBegin.fr: Bonjour, voyageur ! Je vois que tu as atteint le niveau 20 ! Sais-tu ce que cela signifie ? Tu peux désormais voler à bord de ton propre engin volant !
dialogsBegin.id: Halo Traveler! Sepertinya Kamu telah mencapai level 20! Kamu tahu apa artinya ini kan? Kamu sekarang dapat terbang dengan perangkat terbangmu sendiri!
dialogsBegin.it: Hello traveler! It looks like you've reached level 20! You know what this means right? You can now fly on your very own flying device!
dialogsBegin.jp: こんにちは、旅人さん。ついにレベル20に到達したようですね。だからどうした、ですって？お気づきではなさそうね。おめでとうございます。空を飛べるようになったんですよ！
dialogsBegin.kr: 안녕하세요 모험가님! 드디어 레벨 20에 도달하셨군요! 이게 무슨 뜻인지 아시나요? 이제 직접 비행 장치를 타고날 수 있다는 뜻이에요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Hello traveler! It looks like you've reached level 20! You know what this means right? You can now fly on your very own flying device!
dialogsBegin.pl: Hello traveler! It looks like you've reached level 20! You know what this means right? You can now fly on your very own flying device!
dialogsBegin.ru: Hello traveler! It looks like you've reached level 20! You know what this means right? You can now fly on your very own flying device!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Hola viajero! ¡Parece que has alcanzado el nivel 20! ¿Sabes lo que eso significa, verdad? ¡Ahora puedes volar en tu propio dispositivo volador!
dialogsBegin.sw: Hello traveler! It looks like you've reached level 20! You know what this means right? You can now fly on your very own flying device!
dialogsBegin.th: สวัสดี นักเดินทาง! ดูเหมือนว่าคุณจะถึงเลเวล 20 แล้ว! คุณรู้ว่านี่หมายถึงอะไรใช่มั้ย? ตอนนี้คุณสามารถบินด้วยอุปกรณ์บินของคุณเองได้แล้ว!
dialogsBegin.tw: 旅行者你好！看來你已經達到 20 級了！你知道這意味著什麼嗎？你現在可以使用自己的飛行設備飛行！
dialogsBegin.vi: Xin chào du khách! Có vẻ như bạn đã đạt đến cấp độ 20! Bạn biết điều này nghĩa là gì, đúng không? Bây giờ bạn có thể bay trên thiết bị bay của riêng mình!

dialogsBegin.en: Scared? Don't worry, go see the Station Manager Dior. She'll show you the ropes and get you flying in no time!
dialogsBegin.ar: Scared? Don't worry, go see the Station Manager Dior. She'll show you the ropes and get you flying in no time!

dialogsBegin.jp: 心配いりません。怖いことは何もありませんよ。ステーションの＜ディオール＞に会いに行ってみてください。すぐに操縦のコツを教えてもらえますよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 무섭다고요? 걱정 마세요. 플라리네 정류장의 디올을 찾아가 보세요. 기초부터 배우면 금방 날 수 있을 거예요!

dialogsBegin.th: กลัวเหรอ? ไม่ต้องห่วง ไปหาผู้จัดการสถานี Dior เธอจะสาธิตให้คุณดูและพาคุณขึ้นบินได้ในเวลาไม่นาน!

dialogsAccept.fi: Dior is on Flarine Station. Take the elevator right in front of me. You can't miss it!
dialogsAccept.fil: Dior is on Flarine Station. Take the elevator right in front of me. You can't miss it!
dialogsAccept.fr: Dior est à la Station de Vol de Flarine. Prends l'ascenseur à côté de moi. Tu ne peux pas le rater !
dialogsAccept.id: Dior ada di Stasiun Flarine. Gunakan elevator yang ada tepat depanku. Jangan melewatkannya!
dialogsAccept.it: Dior is on Flarine Station. Take the elevator right in front of me. You can't miss it!
dialogsAccept.jp: ＜ディオール＞はフラリスのステーションにいますよ。ぜひエレベーターに乗ってみてください！そこにいるはずです。
dialogsAccept.kr: 디올은 플라리네 정류장에 있어요. 바로 앞에 있는 엘리베이터를 타면 금방 찾을 수 있을 거예요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Dior is on Flarine Station. Take the elevator right in front of me. You can't miss it!
dialogsAccept.pl: Dior is on Flarine Station. Take the elevator right in front of me. You can't miss it!
dialogsAccept.ru: Dior is on Flarine Station. Take the elevator right in front of me. You can't miss it!
dialogsAccept.sp: Dior está en la Estación de Flarine. Toma el ascensor que hay justo en frente de mí. ¡Es imposible que te pierdas!
dialogsAccept.sw: Dior is on Flarine Station. Take the elevator right in front of me. You can't miss it!
dialogsAccept.th: Dior อยู่ที่สถานี Flarine ขึ้นลิฟต์ตรงหน้าฉัน คุณไม่ควรพลาดนะ!
dialogsAccept.tw: 寶雅在聖音特站。坐電梯就在我面前。你不能錯過它！
dialogsAccept.vi: Dior đang ở trên Flarine Station. Đi thang máy ngay trước mặt tôi. Bạn không thể bỏ lỡ nó!

dialogsDecline.en: You don't have to be scared. Well... if you change your mind, do let me know! I'll be right here.
dialogsDecline.ar: You don't have to be scared. Well... if you change your mind, do let me know! I'll be right here.
dialogsDecline.br: Você não precisa ter medo. Bem... se mudar de ideia, me avise! Eu estarei bem aqui.
dialogsDecline.cns: 你没必要感到害怕的。好吧..如果你改变了你的想法，请务必让我知道！我会一直在这的。
dialogsDecline.de: Du brauchst keine Angst zu haben. Nun... wenn du deine Meinung änderst, lass es mich wissen! Ich werde hier sein.
dialogsDecline.fi: You don't have to be scared. Well... if you change your mind, do let me know! I'll be right here.
dialogsDecline.fil: You don't have to be scared. Well... if you change your mind, do let me know! I'll be right here.
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu n'as pas à avoir peur. Bien... Si tu changes d'avis, reviens me voir ! Je serai juste ici.
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu tidak perlu takut. Ya... jika Kamu berubah pikiran, beri tahu Aku! Aku akan berada di sini
dialogsDecline.it: You don't have to be scared. Well... if you change your mind, do let me know! I'll be right here.
dialogsDecline.jp: 怖がる必要はありませんよ。気が変わったらまたいらしてください。
dialogsDecline.kr: 무서워하실 필요 없어요. 음… 마음이 바뀌면 꼭 말씀해 주세요! 여기서 기다리고 있을게요.
dialogsDecline.nl: You don't have to be scared. Well... if you change your mind, do let me know! I'll be right here.
dialogsDecline.pl: You don't have to be scared. Well... if you change your mind, do let me know! I'll be right here.
dialogsDecline.ru: You don't have to be scared. Well... if you change your mind, do let me know! I'll be right here.
dialogsDecline.sp: No tienes que tener miedo. Bueno... si cambias de opinión, ¡avísame! Estaré aquí.
dialogsDecline.sw: You don't have to be scared. Well... if you change your mind, do let me know! I'll be right here.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณไม่ต้องกลัวนะ เอ่อ... ถ้าเปลี่ยนใจก็บอกได้! ฉันอยู่ตรงนี้แหละ
dialogsDecline.tw: 你不必害怕。嗯……如果你改變主意，一定要告訴我！我馬上就到。
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn không cần phải sợ hãi. Chà ... nếu bạn đổi ý, hãy cho tôi biết! Tôi sẽ tới ngay lập tức.

dialogsComplete.en: What's this? Is sent you? Oh! you want to know about flying on your own flying device? Why didn't you say so?
dialogsComplete.ar: What's this? Is sent you? Oh! you want to know about flying on your own flying device? Why didn't you say so?
dialogsComplete.br: Do que se trata? Is mandou você? Ah! você quer saber sobre como voar em seu próprio dispositivo de voo? Por que não disse antes?
dialogsComplete.cns: 这是什么？是它送你来的吗？噢！你想学习如何使用自己的飞行器进行飞行吗？你为什么不直接说呢？
dialogsComplete.de: Was ist das? Is hat dich geschickt? Oh! Du willst wissen, wie man mit seinem eigenen Flugapparat fliegt? Warum hast du das nicht gleich gesagt?
dialogsComplete.fi: What's this? Is sent you? Oh! you want to know about flying on your own flying device? Why didn't you say so?
dialogsComplete.fil: What's this? Is sent you? Oh! you want to know about flying on your own flying device? Why didn't you say so?
dialogsComplete.fr: Qu'est-ce qu'il y a ? Qui t'a envoyé ? Oh ! Tu veux apprendre à voler ? Pourquoi ne l'as-tu pas dit ?
dialogsComplete.id: Kau ingin mengetahui cara mengemudikan pesawatmu? Kenapa tidak bilang dari awal?
dialogsComplete.it: What's this? Is sent you? Oh! you want to know about flying on your own flying device? Why didn't you say so?
dialogsComplete.jp: あれ？イスが送ったって？あああ、飛行装置に乗って飛びたいってわけね？そう言えば良いのに！
dialogsComplete.kr: 이게 뭐죠? 이스가 보냈다고요? 아! 비행 장치에 대해 알고 싶으신 거군요? 그렇게 말씀하시지!
dialogsComplete.nl: What's this? Is sent you? Oh! you want to know about flying on your own flying device? Why didn't you say so?
dialogsComplete.pl: What's this? Is sent you? Oh! you want to know about flying on your own flying device? Why didn't you say so?
dialogsComplete.ru: What's this? Is sent you? Oh! you want to know about flying on your own flying device? Why didn't you say so?
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿Qué es esto? ¿Te envía Is? ¡Oh! ¿Quieres aprender a volar en tu propio dispositivo volador? ¿Por qué no lo has dicho antes?
dialogsComplete.sw: What's this? Is sent you? Oh! you want to know about flying on your own flying device? Why didn't you say so?
dialogsComplete.th: อะไรนะ? Is ส่งคุณมาเหรอ? โอ้! คุณอยากรู้เกี่ยวกับการบินด้วยอุปกรณ์บินของคุณเองงั้นเรอะ? แล้วทำไมคุณไม่บอกล่ะ?
dialogsComplete.tw: 這是什麼？是寄給你的嗎？哦！你想了解使用自己的飛行設備飛行嗎？你怎麼不說呢？
dialogsComplete.vi: Đây là gì? Gửi cho bạn sao? Ồ! bạn muốn biết về việc bay trên thiết bị bay của riêng bạn? Tại sao bạn không nói vậy đi?

description.en: Go to the Plain of Bubble to meet Kurmin and give her the Golden Helmet.
description.ar: Go to the Plain of Bubble to meet Kurmin and give her the Golden Helmet.
description.br: Por favor, vá até a Planície Bubble com esse elmo. E então você poderá encontrar Kurmin, o líder do local.
description.cns: 对了，拿这黄金帽去波布尔的平原，找管理波布尔的平原的库鲁米．韩森！
description.de: Bitte geh zur Ebene von Bubble mit diesem Helm. Dort kannst du Kurmin treffen, die den Ort überwacht.
description.fi: Go to the Plain of Bubble to meet Kurmin and give her the Golden Helmet.
description.fil: Go to the Plain of Bubble to meet Kurmin and give her the Golden Helmet.
description.fr: Aller à la Plaine de Buble et remettre le Heaume de Billein à Kurmin, le protecteur des reliques du Héros des Chevaliers.
description.id: Pergi ke Plain of Bubble untuk bertemu Kurmin dan berikan dia Helm Emas.
description.it: Go to the Plain of Bubble to meet Kurmin and give her the Golden Helmet.
description.jp: このヘルメットを持って、バブルの平原に行こう。そこにいるクルミンという人に会うのだ。
description.kr: 버블 평원에 있는 쿠르민을 찾아가 황금 헬멧을 전달하세요.
description.nl: Go to the Plain of Bubble to meet Kurmin and give her the Golden Helmet.
description.pl: Go to the Plain of Bubble to meet Kurmin and give her the Golden Helmet.
description.ru: Нужно отнести Золотой шлем Кармине на Лучистое поле.
description.sp: Ve a la Llanura de Bubble para encontrarte con Kurmin y darle el Casco Dorado.
description.sw: Go to the Plain of Bubble to meet Kurmin and give her the Golden Helmet.
description.th: ไปที่ Plain of Bubble เพื่อไปพบกับ Kurmin และมอบ Golden Helmet ให้เธอ
description.tw: 對了，拿這黃金帽去巴布樂平原，找管理巴布樂平原的庫魯米‧韓森！
description.vi: Đi đến Plain of Bubble để gặp Kurmin và trao cho cô ấy chiếc Golden Helmet.

dialogsBegin.en: I deeply appreciate what you've already done, but alas, the Helmet's journey does not end here.
dialogsBegin.ar: I deeply appreciate what you've already done, but alas, the Helmet's journey does not end here.
dialogsBegin.br: Agradeço profundamente o seu esforço para recuperar o Elmo Dourado. Aliás, há uma pessoa que você deve conhecer. O nome dele é... Hmm...
dialogsBegin.cns: 感谢你找回这宝贵的东西，我要介绍一个人给你认识……
dialogsBegin.de: Ich bedanke mich für deinen Einsatz, dass du den Golden Helmet zurück gebracht hast. Ach so, das ist ein Typ, den du treffen solltest. Sein Name ist.. Hmm..
dialogsBegin.fi: I deeply appreciate what you've already done, but alas, the Helmet's journey does not end here.
dialogsBegin.fil: I deeply appreciate what you've already done, but alas, the Helmet's journey does not end here.
dialogsBegin.fr: J'apprécie vraiment les efforts que tu as fournis pour retrouver le Heaume de Billein. Mais ta quête n'est pas encore terminée...
dialogsBegin.id: Saya sangat menghargai apa yang telah kamu lakukan, tetapi sayangnya, perjalanan Helm tidak berakhir di sini.
dialogsBegin.it: I deeply appreciate what you've already done, but alas, the Helmet's journey does not end here.
dialogsBegin.jp: ビレリアンの聖遺物をよくぞ取り戻した！心より感謝しておるぞ。･･･さてさっそくではあるが、おぬしに会ってほしい者がおるのだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 벌써 많은 일을 해주신 것에 감사드리지만, 안타깝게도 헬멧의 여정은 여기서 끝이 아니랍니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: I deeply appreciate what you've already done, but alas, the Helmet's journey does not end here.
dialogsBegin.pl: I deeply appreciate what you've already done, but alas, the Helmet's journey does not end here.
dialogsBegin.ru: Я ценю твою заслуги, но приключения Золотого шлема еще не окончены.
dialogsBegin.sp: Aprecio mucho lo que has hecho, pero, por desgracia, el tema del Casco no termina aquí.
dialogsBegin.sw: I deeply appreciate what you've already done, but alas, the Helmet's journey does not end here.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันขอบคุณอย่างยิ่งสำหรับสิ่งที่คุณได้ทำให้ แต่ว่าอนิจจาการผจญภัยของ Helmet นี้ยังไม่จบ
dialogsBegin.tw: 感謝你找回這寶貴的東西，我要介紹一個人給你認識……
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đánh giá cao những gì bạn đã làm, nhưng than ôi, hành trình của Helmet không kết thúc ở đây.

dialogsBegin.en: It belongs with the Hersan Kurmin, in the Plain of Bubble.
dialogsBegin.ar: It belongs with the Hersan Kurmin, in the Plain of Bubble.
dialogsBegin.br: Ah, você deve ir até a Planície Bubble com esse Elmo. E então você poderá encontrar Kurmin, o líder do local.
dialogsBegin.cns: 对了，拿这黄金帽去波布尔平原，找管理波布尔的平原的库鲁米·韩森。
dialogsBegin.de: Oh, du musst zur Ebene von Bubble mit dem Helm. Dann kannst du Kurmin treffen, die ihn überwacht.
dialogsBegin.fi: It belongs with the Hersan Kurmin, in the Plain of Bubble.
dialogsBegin.fil: It belongs with the Hersan Kurmin, in the Plain of Bubble.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il te faut maintenant te rendre à la Plaine de Bubble avec ce casque. Là-bas tu y rencontreras Kurmin.
dialogsBegin.id: Itu milik Hersan Kurmin, di Plain of Bubble.
dialogsBegin.it: It belongs with the Hersan Kurmin, in the Plain of Bubble.
dialogsBegin.jp: このヘルメットを持って、バブルの平原に行き、そこおるクルミンという者に会うのじゃ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그 헬멧은 버블 평원에 있는 헤르산 쿠르민의 것이랍니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: It belongs with the Hersan Kurmin, in the Plain of Bubble.
dialogsBegin.pl: It belongs with the Hersan Kurmin, in the Plain of Bubble.
dialogsBegin.ru: Ему предстоит отправиться на Лучистое поле, к Кармине.
dialogsBegin.sp: Pertenece a Hersan Kurmin, está en la Llanura de Bubble.
dialogsBegin.sw: It belongs with the Hersan Kurmin, in the Plain of Bubble.
dialogsBegin.th: มันอยู่กับ Hersan Kurmin ในเมือง Plain of Bubble
dialogsBegin.tw: 對了，拿這黃金帽去巴布樂平原，找管理巴布樂平原的 [庫魯米‧韓森]。
dialogsBegin.vi: Nó liên quan đến Hersan Kurmin, ở Plain of Bubble.

dialogsBegin.en: The Kurmin Family has managed the house and relics of Billaon for generations. I'm sure they would reward you handsomely for its return.
dialogsBegin.ar: The Kurmin Family has managed the house and relics of Billaon for generations. I'm sure they would reward you handsomely for its return.
dialogsBegin.br: A família Kurmin tem administrado a casa e a relíquia de Billaon por gerações. O Elmo fará com que você consiga algo realmente útil.
dialogsBegin.cns: 把这黄金帽拿给管理波布尔的平原的库鲁米．韩森，可以从他那得到有用的东西喔！
dialogsBegin.de: Die Kurmin Familie überwacht das Haus und das Relic of Billaon seit Generationen. Dieser Helm kann dir sehr von Nutzen sein.
dialogsBegin.fi: The Kurmin Family has managed the house and relics of Billaon for generations. I'm sure they would reward you handsomely for its return.
dialogsBegin.fil: The Kurmin Family has managed the house and relics of Billaon for generations. I'm sure they would reward you handsomely for its return.
dialogsBegin.fr: La famille de Kurmin s'occupe de la maison et des reliques de Billein depuis des générations. Ce heaume te permettra d'obtenir quelque chose de très utile.
dialogsBegin.id: Keluarga Kurmin telah mengelola rumah dan peninggalan Billaon secara turun-temurun. Saya yakin mereka akan memberimu imbalan yang mahal untuk pengembaliannya.
dialogsBegin.it: The Kurmin Family has managed the house and relics of Billaon for generations. I'm sure they would reward you handsomely for its return.
dialogsBegin.jp: クルミンの一族は代々ビレリアンの館と聖遺物を管理しておるのじゃ。このヘルメットを渡せば、次の道をおぬしに指し示すであろう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 쿠르민 가문은 집안 대대로 빌레이언 저택과 유물을 관리해 왔어요. 그 헬멧을 돌려주면 분명 큰 보상을 받으실 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: The Kurmin Family has managed the house and relics of Billaon for generations. I'm sure they would reward you handsomely for its return.
dialogsBegin.pl: The Kurmin Family has managed the house and relics of Billaon for generations. I'm sure they would reward you handsomely for its return.
dialogsBegin.ru: Кармина происходит из рода почетных хранителей реликвий Максимилиануса. Думаю, она достойно наградит тебя. Ты отнесешь ей шлем?
dialogsBegin.sp: La familia Kurmin ha administrado la casa y las reliquias de Billaon durante generaciones. Estoy seguro de que te recompensarán generosamente por la devolución.
dialogsBegin.sw: The Kurmin Family has managed the house and relics of Billaon for generations. I'm sure they would reward you handsomely for its return.
dialogsBegin.th: ครอบครัว Kurmin ได้ดูแลบ้านและของโบราณของ Billaon มาหลายชั่วอายุคน ฉันแน่ใจว่าพวกเขาจะตอบแทนคุณอย่างดีสำหรับการนำสิ่งเหล่านั้นกลับมา
dialogsBegin.tw: 把這黃金帽拿給管理巴布樂平原的庫魯米‧韓森，可以從他那得到有用的東西喔！
dialogsBegin.vi: Gia đình Kurmin đã quản lý ngôi nhà và di tích của Billaon trong nhiều thế hệ. Tôi chắc rằng họ sẽ thưởng cho bạn hậu hĩnh nếu nó được trả lại.

dialogsAccept.en: Time is a-wasting, Mercenary! Hurry along, now!
dialogsAccept.ar: Time is a-wasting, Mercenary! Hurry along, now!
dialogsAccept.br: Agora vá! Em que você está pensando? Simplesmente vá!
dialogsAccept.cns: 出发吧！快点出发吧！
dialogsAccept.de: Nun Geh! Was denkst du noch nach? Geh einfach!
dialogsAccept.fi: Time is a-wasting, Mercenary! Hurry along, now!
dialogsAccept.fil: Time is a-wasting, Mercenary! Hurry along, now!
dialogsAccept.fr: Que Billein t'accompagne dans ta quête !
dialogsAccept.id: Waktu adalah buang-buang waktu, Mercenary! Cepatlah, sekarang!
dialogsAccept.it: Time is a-wasting, Mercenary! Hurry along, now!
dialogsAccept.jp: ではゆけ！足に翼をもつ者のように駆けてゆけ！
dialogsAccept.kr: 자아, 하루가 바빠요, 머서너리님! 서둘러 주세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Time is a-wasting, Mercenary! Hurry along, now!
dialogsAccept.pl: Time is a-wasting, Mercenary! Hurry along, now!

dialogsAccept.sw: Time is a-wasting, Mercenary! Hurry along, now!
dialogsAccept.th: เวลาไม่คอยท่า Mercenary! รีบไปเดี๋ยวนี้เลย!
dialogsAccept.tw: 出發吧！快點出發吧！
dialogsAccept.vi: Thời gian thật lãng phí, Mercenary! Nhanh lên, ngay bây giờ!

dialogsDecline.en: No time to be showered with the appreciation and riches of a wealthy family? Very well, then...
dialogsDecline.ar: No time to be showered with the appreciation and riches of a wealthy family? Very well, then...
dialogsDecline.br: Sem tempo para ser regado(a) com a apreciação e as riquezas de uma família abastada? Muito bem, então...
dialogsDecline.cns: 又不是很远的路，可别偷懒，不能中途放弃喔！
dialogsDecline.de: Keine Zeit, sich mit der Wertschätzung und dem Reichtum einer wohlhabenden Familie überhäufen zu lassen? Nun gut, dann...
dialogsDecline.fi: No time to be showered with the appreciation and riches of a wealthy family? Very well, then...
dialogsDecline.fil: No time to be showered with the appreciation and riches of a wealthy family? Very well, then...
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu es trop impatient. Ce n'est pas si loin d'ici... et tu abandonnes déjà ?
dialogsDecline.id: Tidak ada waktu untuk dihujani penghargaan dan kekayaan keluarga kaya? Baiklah kalau begitu...
dialogsDecline.it: No time to be showered with the appreciation and riches of a wealthy family? Very well, then...
dialogsDecline.jp: 最近の若者はずいぶんと根性がないのう。やれやれ、嘆かわしいことじゃ。こんなことで諦めてはならんぞ！

dialogsDecline.nl: No time to be showered with the appreciation and riches of a wealthy family? Very well, then...
dialogsDecline.pl: No time to be showered with the appreciation and riches of a wealthy family? Very well, then...
dialogsDecline.ru: No time to be showered with the appreciation and riches of a wealthy family? Very well, then...
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿No tienes tiempo para ser colmado con el aprecio y las riquezas de una familia adinerada? Muy bien, entonces...
dialogsDecline.sw: No time to be showered with the appreciation and riches of a wealthy family? Very well, then...
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันไม่มีเวลาว่างมากหรอกนะ? ก็ได้ งั้น...
dialogsDecline.tw: 沒有時間享受富裕家庭的讚賞和財富？那好吧…
dialogsDecline.vi: Thời gian không dành cho lòng cảm kích và của cảui của một gia đình giàu có? Thôi được rồi...

dialogsComplete.en: Oh my… I can't believe it.... I've been looking for this for years. Thank you, thank you very much!
dialogsComplete.ar: Oh my… I can't believe it.... I've been looking for this for years. Thank you, thank you very much!
dialogsComplete.br: Oh meu Deus... É o... Muito obrigado. Eu estava procurando isso há anos. Obrigado, obrigado.
dialogsComplete.cns: (啜泣声)真的谢谢你，为了找这个东西，我不知道花了多少时间，真的很谢谢你~
dialogsComplete.de: Oh mein.. Da ist.. Vielen Dank. Ich suche seit Jahren danach. Danke, Danke.
dialogsComplete.fi: Oh my… I can't believe it.... I've been looking for this for years. Thank you, thank you very much!
dialogsComplete.fil: Oh my… I can't believe it.... I've been looking for this for years. Thank you, thank you very much!
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh... C'est le... Merci infiniment ! Je le cherchais depuis des années.
dialogsComplete.id: Astaga... Aku tidak percaya.... Aku sudah mencari ini selama bertahun-tahun. Terima kasih terima kasih banyak!
dialogsComplete.it: Oh my… I can't believe it.... I've been looking for this for years. Thank you, thank you very much!
dialogsComplete.jp: これは盗まれた聖遺物･･･。あなたがみつけてくれたの？ありがとう！ずっと探していたの。英雄ビレリアンにかわってお礼を申し上げま～す。
dialogsComplete.kr: 세상에… 믿을 수가 없네요… 몇 년 동안 찾고 있었던 건데. 정말 감사해요. 진심이에요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Oh my… I can't believe it.... I've been looking for this for years. Thank you, thank you very much!
dialogsComplete.pl: Oh my… I can't believe it.... I've been looking for this for years. Thank you, thank you very much!
dialogsComplete.ru: Святая Лучик! Не могу поверить... Мы так давно ищем этот шлем! Огромное спасибо!
dialogsComplete.sp: Oh... No puedo creerlo... Lo he estado buscando durante años. ¡Gracias, muchas gracias!
dialogsComplete.sw: Oh my… I can't believe it.... I've been looking for this for years. Thank you, thank you very much!
dialogsComplete.th: โอ้... ฉันไม่อยากจะเชื่อเลย... ฉันตามหาสิ่งนี้มานานหลายปี ขอบคุณมาก!
dialogsComplete.tw: (啜泣聲) 真的謝謝你，為了找這個東西，我不知道花了多少時間，真的很謝謝你~
dialogsComplete.vi: Ôi trời… Tôi không thể tin được… Tôi đã tìm kiếm điều này trong nhiều năm. Cảm ơn bạn, cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều!

dialogsComplete.en: I'd like to give you something for bringing this back to the Kurmin family.
dialogsComplete.ar: I'd like to give you something for bringing this back to the Kurmin family.
dialogsComplete.br: Eu sou... Hum? Você já ouviu falar de mim? Ah, então eu não preciso me apresentar. De qualquer maneira, quero lhe dar algo em troca pelo elmo.
dialogsComplete.cns: 我是……什么？你已经知道我是谁了啊？那就不用再介绍了！谢谢你帮我找回黄金帽！这是我的一点心意。
dialogsComplete.de: Ich bin.. hm? Du hast bereits von mir gehört? Oh, dann muss ich mich ja nicht vorstellen. Dennoch möchte ich dir etwas als Gegenleistung für den Helm geben.
dialogsComplete.fi: I'd like to give you something for bringing this back to the Kurmin family.
dialogsComplete.fil: I'd like to give you something for bringing this back to the Kurmin family.
dialogsComplete.fr: Je suis... Quoi ? Tu as déjà entendu parler de moi ? Bon, et bien je n'ai plus besoin de me présenter alors. Mais j'ai quelque chose pour te récompenser de tes efforts.
dialogsComplete.id: Saya ingin memberimu sesuatu untuk membawa ini kembali ke keluarga Kurmin.
dialogsComplete.it: I'd like to give you something for bringing this back to the Kurmin family.
dialogsComplete.jp: 賢者から私のことは聞いてるでしょう？では自己紹介はいりませんね。あなたはナイト後継者の道を目指している方ですね、それでは･･･
dialogsComplete.kr: 쿠르민 가문에 헬멧을 돌려주셨으니, 저도 감사의 의미로 답례를 드리죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: I'd like to give you something for bringing this back to the Kurmin family.
dialogsComplete.pl: I'd like to give you something for bringing this back to the Kurmin family.
dialogsComplete.ru: Мне хотелось бы вознаградить тебя за помощь.
dialogsComplete.sp: Me gustaría darte algo por devolverle esto a la familia Kurmin.
dialogsComplete.sw: I'd like to give you something for bringing this back to the Kurmin family.
dialogsComplete.th: ฉันต้องการตอบแทนคุณด้วยของบางอย่างที่นำมันกลับไปคืนให้ครอบครัว Kurmin
dialogsComplete.tw: 我是……什麼？你已經知道我是誰了啊？那就不用再介紹了！謝謝你幫我找回黃金帽！這是我的一點心意。
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi muốn tặng bạn một cái gì đó để mang nó trở lại gia đình Kurmin.

dialogsComplete.en: This Scroll has only been passed down to the Knights in my family line, until now. I'd like you to have it.
dialogsComplete.ar: This Scroll has only been passed down to the Knights in my family line, until now. I'd like you to have it.
dialogsComplete.br: Este é o pergaminho que somente os sucessores na minha família podem ter. Agora eu o estou entregando a você.
dialogsComplete.cns: 这是只有继承者才可以拿到的卷轴，现在我把这个给你！
dialogsComplete.de: Dies ist die Schriftrolle, die nur Nachfolger aus meiner Familie erhalten. Nun gebe ich sie dir.
dialogsComplete.fi: This Scroll has only been passed down to the Knights in my family line, until now. I'd like you to have it.
dialogsComplete.fil: This Scroll has only been passed down to the Knights in my family line, until now. I'd like you to have it.
dialogsComplete.fr: Ceci est le Parchemin que seuls les descendants de ma famille peuvent avoir. Il t'appartient désormais.
dialogsComplete.id: Gulir ini hanya diturunkan ke Ksatria di garis keluarga saya, sampai sekarang. Saya ingin kamu memilikinya.
dialogsComplete.it: This Scroll has only been passed down to the Knights in my family line, until now. I'd like you to have it.
dialogsComplete.jp: これは我が一族に伝わる由緒ある巻物です、ナイト後継者を目指すものに、次の道を指し示すでしょう。どうかお受け取りください。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이 두루마리는 저희 가문의 나이트에게만 대대로 전해지는 거랍니다. 이걸 당신에게 드리고 싶군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: This Scroll has only been passed down to the Knights in my family line, until now. I'd like you to have it.
dialogsComplete.pl: This Scroll has only been passed down to the Knights in my family line, until now. I'd like you to have it.
dialogsComplete.ru: Этот свиток передавался в моей семье из поколения в поколение. Я хотела бы отдать его тебе.
dialogsComplete.sp: Este Pergamino solo se ha transmitido a los Knights de mi línea familiar, hasta ahora. Me gustaría que te lo quedaras.
dialogsComplete.sw: This Scroll has only been passed down to the Knights in my family line, until now. I'd like you to have it.
dialogsComplete.th: Scroll นี้ถูกส่งผ่านไปยัง Knights ในตระกูลของฉันจนถึงตอนนี้ ฉันต้องการให้คุณเก็บรักษามัน
dialogsComplete.tw: 這是只有繼承者才可以拿到的卷軸，現在我把這個給你！
dialogsComplete.vi: Scroll này chỉ được truyền lại cho các Knights trong dòng họ của tôi, cho đến bây giờ. Tôi muốn bạn có nó.

dialogsFail.en: What nice weather! Oh, I'm sorry, did you need to speak with me?
dialogsFail.ar: What nice weather! Oh, I'm sorry, did you need to speak with me?
dialogsFail.br: Que clima agradável! A propósito, você tem alguma coisa para me perguntar?
dialogsFail.cns: 天气真不错，对了！你找我有什么事吗？
dialogsFail.de: Was schönes Wetter! Nun, willst du mich etwas fragen?
dialogsFail.fi: What nice weather! Oh, I'm sorry, did you need to speak with me?
dialogsFail.fil: What nice weather! Oh, I'm sorry, did you need to speak with me?
dialogsFail.fr: Quel temps magnifique ! Tant qu'on y est, as-tu quelque chose à me demander ?
dialogsFail.id: Cuaca yang bagus! Oh, maaf, apakah kamu perlu berbicara dengan saya?
dialogsFail.it: What nice weather! Oh, I'm sorry, did you need to speak with me?
dialogsFail.jp: いい天気ですね。私に何かご用ですか？
dialogsFail.kr: 날씨가 정말 좋네요! 아, 죄송해요. 혹시 저에게 하실 말씀이 있나요?
dialogsFail.nl: What nice weather! Oh, I'm sorry, did you need to speak with me?
dialogsFail.pl: What nice weather! Oh, I'm sorry, did you need to speak with me?
dialogsFail.ru: Какая чудесная погода! Прости, у тебя ко мне какое-то дело?
dialogsFail.sp: ¡Qué buen tiempo! Oh, lo siento, ¿necesitas hablar conmigo?
dialogsFail.sw: What nice weather! Oh, I'm sorry, did you need to speak with me?
dialogsFail.th: อากาศดีอะไรเช่นนี้! อ้ะ โทษที คุณจะคุยกับฉันหรอ?
dialogsFail.tw: 天氣真不錯，對了！你找我有什麼事嗎？
dialogsFail.vi: Thời tiết đẹp làm sao! Ồ, tôi xin lỗi, bạn cần nói chuyện với tôi phải không?

description.en: Deliver the Feather of Magic Power to Parine, Tina's helper at Saint City Station.

description.cns: 把这羽毛拿给晨光航空站的解说员佩琳！
description.de: Bitte bring die Feder zu Parine, der Helferin an der Station in Saint Morning.
description.fi: Deliver the Feather of Magic Power to Parine, Tina's helper at Saint City Station.
description.fil: Deliver the Feather of Magic Power to Parine, Tina's helper at Saint City Station.
description.fr: Remettre la Plume de Lillip à Parine, qui se trouve à la Station de Vol de Saincity.
description.id: Kirimkan Feather of Magic Power ke Parine, pembantu Tina di Stasiun Saint City
description.it: Deliver the Feather of Magic Power to Parine, Tina's helper at Saint City Station.

description.pl: Deliver the Feather of Magic Power to Parine, Tina's helper at Saint City Station.
description.ru: Нужно отдать Волшебное перо Пери, помощнице Тины. Она живет в Санто.

dialogsBegin.en: Now, I need you to deliver this relic to Parine, Tina's helper at Saint City Station.
dialogsBegin.ar: Now, I need you to deliver this relic to Parine, Tina's helper at Saint City Station.
dialogsBegin.br: Agora deixe-me dizer o que você tem que fazer. Por favor, entregue esta pena a Parine, a ajudante de Assist que está na Estação da Cidade de Saint.
dialogsBegin.cns: 请帮我一件事~ 请把羽毛拿给晨光航空站的解说员【佩琳】。
dialogsBegin.de: Nun lass mich dir erzählen was du tun musst. Bitte bring die Feder zu Parine, der Helferin bei der Saint Morning Station.
dialogsBegin.fi: Now, I need you to deliver this relic to Parine, Tina's helper at Saint City Station.
dialogsBegin.fil: Now, I need you to deliver this relic to Parine, Tina's helper at Saint City Station.
dialogsBegin.fr: Maintenant je dois rendre cette plume à son propriétaire. Son premier propriétaire était Lillip bien sûr, mais désormais une personne s'occupe des reliques du Héros des Elémentalistes.
dialogsBegin.id: Sekarang, saya ingin kamu mengirimkan relik ini ke Parine, pembantu Tina di Stasiun Saint City.
dialogsBegin.it: Now, I need you to deliver this relic to Parine, Tina's helper at Saint City Station.
dialogsBegin.jp: じゃあ、１つお願いがある。魔力増加の羽飾りをセイントモーニングのステーションで補助をしているパリンノに渡してくれ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그럼, 이제 이 성물을 세인트 시티 정류장에 있는 티나의 조수, 파린에게 전달해 주시면 좋겠군요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Now, I need you to deliver this relic to Parine, Tina's helper at Saint City Station.
dialogsBegin.pl: Now, I need you to deliver this relic to Parine, Tina's helper at Saint City Station.
dialogsBegin.ru: Отнеси это перо Пери, помощнице Тины, хорошо? Ты, конечно же, помнишь Тину? Она управляет воздушным портом Санто.
dialogsBegin.sp: Ahora, necesito que le entregues esta reliquia a Parine, la ayudante de Tina en la Estación de Saint.
dialogsBegin.sw: Now, I need you to deliver this relic to Parine, Tina's helper at Saint City Station.
dialogsBegin.th: ตอนนี้ฉันต้องการให้คุณมอบของที่ระลึกให้แก่ Parine ผู้ช่วยของ Tina ที่ Saint City Station
dialogsBegin.tw: 請幫我一件事~請把羽毛拿給聖音特航空站的解說員 [霍華‧芬特]。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bây giờ, tôi cần bạn giao di vật này cho Parine, người giúp việc của Tina ở Saint City Station.

dialogsAccept.en: Take good care of that relic, and good luck!
dialogsAccept.ar: Take good care of that relic, and good luck!
dialogsAccept.br: Cuide bem da relíquia e boa sorte!
dialogsAccept.cns: 就先这样，我要回去继续写英雄记事了。
dialogsAccept.de: Dann viel Glück.
dialogsAccept.fi: Take good care of that relic, and good luck!
dialogsAccept.fil: Take good care of that relic, and good luck!
dialogsAccept.fr: Il te faut maintenant lui rapporter cette plume. Son nom est Parine, elle devrait se trouver à la station de vol de Saincity.
dialogsAccept.id: Jaga baik-baik relik itu, dan semoga berhasil!
dialogsAccept.it: Take good care of that relic, and good luck!
dialogsAccept.jp: では、わしの英雄史記の執筆のためにもがんばってくれい！
dialogsAccept.kr: 성물 잃어버리지 마시고요, 행운을 빌어요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Take good care of that relic, and good luck!
dialogsAccept.pl: Take good care of that relic, and good luck!
dialogsAccept.ru: Береги перо! Удачи!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Cuida bien esa reliquia y buena suerte!
dialogsAccept.sw: Take good care of that relic, and good luck!
dialogsAccept.th: ดูแลรักษาของที่ระลึกให้ดีและขอให้โชคดี!
dialogsAccept.tw: 就先這樣，我要回去繼續寫英雄記事了。
dialogsAccept.vi: Hãy trông nom di vật đó, và chúc may mắn!

dialogsDecline.en: What? You did all this just to get your filthy hands on that relic? That's just… awful. I'm speechless.
dialogsDecline.ar: What? You did all this just to get your filthy hands on that relic? That's just… awful. I'm speechless.
dialogsDecline.br: Que? Você fez tudo isso só para colocar suas mãos imundas naquela relíquia? Isso é simplesmente... horrível. Estou sem palavras.
dialogsDecline.cns: 别这么凶啊！！这遗物非常有价值喔，你可以偷偷拿回去，但可别拿给我喔~
dialogsDecline.de: Was? Du hast das alles gemacht, nur um diese Reliquie in deine dreckigen Hände zu bekommen? Das ist einfach... furchtbar. Ich bin sprachlos.
dialogsDecline.fi: What? You did all this just to get your filthy hands on that relic? That's just… awful. I'm speechless.
dialogsDecline.fil: What? You did all this just to get your filthy hands on that relic? That's just… awful. I'm speechless.
dialogsDecline.fr: Rapporter cette relique à Parine est vraiment important... Ce n'est pas très loin d'ici, va lui remettre s'il te plaît
dialogsDecline.id: Apa? Kamu melakukan semua ini hanya untuk mendapatkan relik itu? Itu hanya... mengerikan. Saya tidak dapat berkata-kata.
dialogsDecline.it: What? You did all this just to get your filthy hands on that relic? That's just… awful. I'm speechless.
dialogsDecline.jp: おいっ！あんまりにもそっけないのう･･･。これはとても価値のある遺物じゃぞ？最近の若いものはノリが悪いわい。
dialogsDecline.kr: 뭐라고요? 고작 그 성물을 손에 넣으려고 이 모든 짓을 벌인 거예요? 정말… 충격이네요. 할 말이 없어요.
dialogsDecline.nl: What? You did all this just to get your filthy hands on that relic? That's just… awful. I'm speechless.
dialogsDecline.pl: What? You did all this just to get your filthy hands on that relic? That's just… awful. I'm speechless.
dialogsDecline.ru: What? You did all this just to get your filthy hands on that relic? That's just… awful. I'm speechless.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Qué? ¿Has hecho todo esto sólo para poner tus sucias manos en esa reliquia? Eso es... horrible. Estoy sin palabras.
dialogsDecline.sw: What? You did all this just to get your filthy hands on that relic? That's just… awful. I'm speechless.
dialogsDecline.th: อะไร? คุณทำทั้งหมดนี้เพียงเพื่อให้ได้มือสกปรกของคุณในที่ระลึก? มันแย่มาก ฉันพูดไม่ออก
dialogsDecline.tw: 別這麼兇啊！！這遺物非常有價值喔，你可以偷偷拿回去，但可別拿給我喔~
dialogsDecline.vi: Gì? Bạn đã làm tất cả những điều này vì có mưu mô đen tối với di vật đó sao? Thật là ... tồi tệ. Tôi không nói nên lời.

dialogsComplete.en: You've found it! Oh thank you, thank you, thank you! Finally, I have it! The Feather of Magic Power!
dialogsComplete.ar: You've found it! Oh thank you, thank you, thank you! Finally, I have it! The Feather of Magic Power!
dialogsComplete.br: Você encontrou! Oh, obrigada, obrigada, obrigada! Finalmente, eu consegui! A Pena do Poder Mágico!
dialogsComplete.cns: 咦！这不是我正在找的遗物吗？真的很谢谢你！居然藏在那种鬼地方呀！
dialogsComplete.de: Oh mein.. Das, das ist.. Das ist das Relikt, nach dem ich schon so lange gesucht habe. Vielen Dank!
dialogsComplete.fi: You've found it! Oh thank you, thank you, thank you! Finally, I have it! The Feather of Magic Power!
dialogsComplete.fil: You've found it! Oh thank you, thank you, thank you! Finally, I have it! The Feather of Magic Power!
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh... C'est la... Merci infiniment ! Je la cherchais depuis des années.
dialogsComplete.id: Kamu telah menemukannya! Oh terima kasih, terima kasih, terima kasih! Akhirnya, saya memilikinya! The Feather of Magic Power!
dialogsComplete.it: You've found it! Oh thank you, thank you, thank you! Finally, I have it! The Feather of Magic Power!
dialogsComplete.jp: まあ、これは私が探していた聖遺物じゃない！どこにあったの？
dialogsComplete.kr: 찾으셨군요! 정말 고맙습니다! 마력 증가 깃털을! 드디어 손에 넣다니!
dialogsComplete.nl: You've found it! Oh thank you, thank you, thank you! Finally, I have it! The Feather of Magic Power!
dialogsComplete.pl: You've found it! Oh thank you, thank you, thank you! Finally, I have it! The Feather of Magic Power!
dialogsComplete.ru: Волшебное перо Гэндальфи! Как давно я его искала!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡La has encontrado! ¡Oh gracias, gracias, gracias! ¡Por fin la tengo! ¡La Pluma del Poder Mágico!
dialogsComplete.sw: You've found it! Oh thank you, thank you, thank you! Finally, I have it! The Feather of Magic Power!
dialogsComplete.th: คุณหาเจอแล้ว! โอ้ ขอบคุณๆ! สุดท้ายฉันมีมัน! The Feather of Magic Power!
dialogsComplete.tw: 咦！這不是我正在找的遺物嗎？真的很謝謝你！居然藏在那種鬼地方呀！
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn đã tìm thấy nó! Oh cảm ơn bạn, cảm ơn, cảm ơn! Cuối cùng, tôi đã có nó! Feather of Magic Power!

dialogsComplete.en: You must have been through a lot to acquire this for me. Here, I have something for you…
dialogsComplete.ar: You must have been through a lot to acquire this for me. Here, I have something for you…
dialogsComplete.br: Ah, eu não sabia que estava tão cuidadosamente escondida. De qualquer maneira, eu quero lhe dar algo em troca.
dialogsComplete.cns: 如果换成是我，是绝对找不到的！谢谢你帮我找到，这是我的一点小意思！！
dialogsComplete.de: Oh, ich wusste nicht das es so gut versteckt war. Auf jeden Fall möchte ich dir etwas als Dank geben.
dialogsComplete.fi: You must have been through a lot to acquire this for me. Here, I have something for you…
dialogsComplete.fil: You must have been through a lot to acquire this for me. Here, I have something for you…
dialogsComplete.fr: J'apprécie énormément ce que tu as fait pour ma famille ! Voici quelque chose pour te récompenser de tes efforts.
dialogsComplete.id: Kamu pasti telah melalui banyak hal untuk mendapatkan ini untuk saya. Ini, aku punya sesuatu untukmu…
dialogsComplete.it: You must have been through a lot to acquire this for me. Here, I have something for you…
dialogsComplete.jp: なるほど、それじゃあ私がいくら探しても見つからないはずだわ～。あ・り・が・と。お礼にこれをあげるわぁ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이걸 얻기까지 고생을 많이 하셨겠어요. 저도 감사의 표시로 드릴 게 있어요…
dialogsComplete.nl: You must have been through a lot to acquire this for me. Here, I have something for you…
dialogsComplete.pl: You must have been through a lot to acquire this for me. Here, I have something for you…
dialogsComplete.ru: Тебе, наверное, пришлось многое пережить, чтобы найти его. Я хочу тебя отблагодарить...
dialogsComplete.sp: Debes haber pasado por mucho para conseguir esto para mí. Toma, tengo algo para ti...
dialogsComplete.sw: You must have been through a lot to acquire this for me. Here, I have something for you…
dialogsComplete.th: คุณต้องได้รับผ่านจำนวนมากที่จะได้รับนี้สำหรับฉัน เอานี่ ฉันมีบางอย่างสำหรับคุณ...

dialogsComplete.en: Take this, my friend. This Stamp Scroll will prove you are worthy to become a Successor of the Elementor Hero.
dialogsComplete.ar: Take this, my friend. This Stamp Scroll will prove you are worthy to become a Successor of the Elementor Hero.
dialogsComplete.br: Aqui está. Este é o pergaminho que somente os sucessores na minha família podem ter. Agora eu o estou entregando a você. Será o comprovante que mostra que você é reconhecido como um sucessor.
dialogsComplete.cns: 这是给继承者的卷轴，你已经成为元素使者的继承者了！
dialogsComplete.de: Bitte schön. Diese Schriftrolle können nur die Nachfolger meiner Familie erhalten. Nun werde ich sie dir geben. Ist ist der Beweis, das du als Nachfolger anerkannt wurdest.
dialogsComplete.fi: Take this, my friend. This Stamp Scroll will prove you are worthy to become a Successor of the Elementor Hero.
dialogsComplete.fil: Take this, my friend. This Stamp Scroll will prove you are worthy to become a Successor of the Elementor Hero.
dialogsComplete.fr: Ceci est le Parchemin que seuls les descendants de ma famille peuvent obtenir. Il t'appartient désormais.
dialogsComplete.id: Ambil ini, teman saya. Gulungan Stempel ini akan membuktikan bahwa kamu layak menjadi Penerus Elementor Hero.
dialogsComplete.it: Take this, my friend. This Stamp Scroll will prove you are worthy to become a Successor of the Elementor Hero.
dialogsComplete.jp: これは我が一族に伝わる由緒ある巻物です、エレメンター後継者を目指すものに、次の道を指し示すでしょう。どうぞ受け取って！うふ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이걸 받으세요. 당신이 엘리멘터 영웅의 후계자라는 걸 증명하는 봉인된 두루마리랍니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Take this, my friend. This Stamp Scroll will prove you are worthy to become a Successor of the Elementor Hero.
dialogsComplete.pl: Take this, my friend. This Stamp Scroll will prove you are worthy to become a Successor of the Elementor Hero.
dialogsComplete.ru: Возьми этот свиток. Он доказывает, что его носитель достоин стать наследником героя-факира.
dialogsComplete.sp: Toma esto, amigo mío. Este Pergamino Sellado demostrará que eres digno de convertirte en Sucesor de la Héroe Elementor.
dialogsComplete.sw: Take this, my friend. This Stamp Scroll will prove you are worthy to become a Successor of the Elementor Hero.
dialogsComplete.th: รับไป เพื่อน Stamp Scroll นี้จะพิสูจน์ว่าคุณสมควรจะเป็นทายาทของ Elementor Hero
dialogsComplete.tw: 這是給繼承者的卷軸，你已經成為研術者的繼承者了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Cầm lấy cái này, bạn tôi. Stamp Scroll này sẽ chứng minh bạn xứng đáng trở thành Người kế vị Anh hùng Elementor.

dialogsFail.en: I am the scion of Lillip. At the moment, I am learning from Tina about managing the Saint City Station. Why are you here? Are you forgetting something?

dialogsFail.nl: I am the scion of Lillip. At the moment, I am learning from Tina about managing the Saint City Station. Why are you here? Are you forgetting something?
dialogsFail.pl: I am the scion of Lillip. At the moment, I am learning from Tina about managing the Saint City Station. Why are you here? Are you forgetting something?
dialogsFail.ru: I am the scion of Lillip. At the moment, I am learning from Tina about managing the Saint City Station. Why are you here? Are you forgetting something?
dialogsFail.sp: Soy la descendiente de Lillip. Por ahora, estoy aprendiendo de Tina sobre la gestión de la Estación de Saint. ¿Por qué estás aquí? ¿Te has perdido?
dialogsFail.sw: I am the scion of Lillip. At the moment, I am learning from Tina about managing the Saint City Station. Why are you here? Are you forgetting something?
dialogsFail.th: ฉันคือ Scion ของ Lillip ในตอนนี้ฉันเรียนรู้จาก Tina เกี่ยวกับการบริหารสถานี Saint City ทำไมเธอถึงอยู่ที่นี่? คุณลืมอะไรไหม
dialogsFail.tw: 我是黎利的親人，目前正跟蒂娜姐學習管理航空站的方法！找我有什麼事呢？！
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi là con cháu của Lillip. Hiện tại, tôi đang học hỏi Tina quản lý Saint City Station. Tại sao bạn ở đây? Bạn đang quên điều gì đó à?
