dialogsBegin.id: Saya telah menghubungi ahli sejarah dan sihir Flaris untuk meninjau temuan seputar sifat menarik dari jiwa Nightmist.
dialogsBegin.it: I have contacted the experts of Flaris history and magic to review the findings surrounding the interesting properties of the souls of the Nightmist.
dialogsBegin.jp: 私はフラリスの歴史と魔法の専門家に連絡を取り、ナイトミストの魂の興味深い特性を取り巻く調査結果をレビューしました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 플라리스의 역사와 마법 전문가들에게 연락해 나이트미스트의 흥미로운 특성을 연구해달라고 부탁했어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I have contacted the experts of Flaris history and magic to review the findings surrounding the interesting properties of the souls of the Nightmist.
dialogsBegin.pl: I have contacted the experts of Flaris history and magic to review the findings surrounding the interesting properties of the souls of the Nightmist.
dialogsBegin.ru: I have contacted the experts of Flaris history and magic to review the findings surrounding the interesting properties of the souls of the Nightmist.
dialogsBegin.sp: He contactado con los expertos en historia y magia de Flaris para que revisen los hallazgos en torno a las interesantes propiedades de las almas de la Niebla Nocturna.
dialogsBegin.sw: I have contacted the experts of Flaris history and magic to review the findings surrounding the interesting properties of the souls of the Nightmist.
dialogsBegin.th: ข้าได้ติดต่อกับผู้เชียวชาญเกี่ยวกับประวัติศาสตร์ของ Flaris และเวทย์มนต์เพื่อที่จะหาว่ารอบ ๆ นั้นมีคุณสมบัติอะไรที่น่าสนใจเกี่ยวกับวิญญาณของ Nightmist อยู่อีกรึเปล่า
dialogsBegin.tw: 我已經聯絡了研究布拉里斯歷史與魔法的專家，請他們協助檢視夜霧靈魂的特殊性質。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đã liên hệ với experts về lịch sử và phép thuật của Flaris để xem xét những phát hiện xung quanh những đặc tính thú vị của souls of the Nightmist.

dialogsBegin.en: Shockingly... they have come to the conclusion that these Nightmist creatures were likely once trolls themselves. The Elixir of Vitality may have given them unending life in a new form.
dialogsBegin.ar: Shockingly... they have come to the conclusion that these Nightmist creatures were likely once trolls themselves. The Elixir of Vitality may have given them unending life in a new form.
dialogsBegin.br: Pasme! Eles descobriram que essas criaturas da Bruma Noturna eram, na verdade, trolls em sua forma original! Parece que o Elixir da Vitalidade deu a eles uma vida eterna em uma nova forma...
dialogsBegin.cns: Shockingly... they have come to the conclusion that these Nightmist creatures were likely once trolls themselves. The Elixir of Vitality may have given them unending life in a new form.
dialogsBegin.de: Schockierenderweise... sind sie zu dem Schluss gekommen, dass diese Nightmist-Kreaturen wahrscheinlich selbst einmal Trolle waren. Das Elixier der Vitalität könnte ihnen unendliches Leben in einer neuen Form gegeben haben.
dialogsBegin.fi: Shockingly... they have come to the conclusion that these Nightmist creatures were likely once trolls themselves. The Elixir of Vitality may have given them unending life in a new form.
dialogsBegin.fil: Shockingly... they have come to the conclusion that these Nightmist creatures were likely once trolls themselves. The Elixir of Vitality may have given them unending life in a new form.
dialogsBegin.fr: Chose choquante, ils en sont arrivés à la conclusion que ces Créatures de la Nuit étaient probablement elles-mêmes des trolls à l'origine. L'Élixir de Vitalité leur a peut-être donné une vie sans fin sous une nouvelle forme.
dialogsBegin.id: Mengejutkan .. mereka sampai pada kesimpulan bahwa makhluk Nightmist ini kemungkinan besar pernah menjadi troll. Elixir of Vitality mungkin telah memberi mereka kehidupan tanpa akhir dalam bentuk baru.
dialogsBegin.it: Shockingly... they have come to the conclusion that these Nightmist creatures were likely once trolls themselves. The Elixir of Vitality may have given them unending life in a new form.
dialogsBegin.jp: 驚く ほど。。彼らは、これらのナイトミストの生き物はかつてトロールであった可能性が高いという結論に達しました。活力のエリクサーは、彼らに新しい形で終わりのない人生を与えたかもしれません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 놀랍게도... 이 나이트미스트 생명체가 한때 트롤이었을 가능성이 높다는 결론이 났어요. 활력 비약 덕분에 새로운 형태의 영생을 얻은 것일지도 모르겠네요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Shockingly... they have come to the conclusion that these Nightmist creatures were likely once trolls themselves. The Elixir of Vitality may have given them unending life in a new form.
dialogsBegin.pl: Shockingly... they have come to the conclusion that these Nightmist creatures were likely once trolls themselves. The Elixir of Vitality may have given them unending life in a new form.
dialogsBegin.ru: Shockingly... they have come to the conclusion that these Nightmist creatures were likely once trolls themselves. The Elixir of Vitality may have given them unending life in a new form.
dialogsBegin.sp: Sorprendentemente .. han llegado a la conclusión de que estas criaturas Nightmist probablemente fueron una vez los propios trolls. El Elixir de Vitalidad puede haberles dado vida sin fin en una nueva forma.
dialogsBegin.sw: Shockingly... they have come to the conclusion that these Nightmist creatures were likely once trolls themselves. The Elixir of Vitality may have given them unending life in a new form.
dialogsBegin.th: ยิ่งกว่าช็อค..พวกเขาสรุปร่วมกันได้ว่า Nightmist พวกนี้ครั้งนึงก็คือพวก Troll และเป็น Elixir of Vitality ที่ให้พลังชีวิตไม่จำกัดกับพวกมัน พร้อมร่างใหม่ของพวกมันด้วย
dialogsBegin.tw: 令人震驚的是……他們得出的結論是，這些夜霧生物很可能原本就是巨魔。活力靈藥或許讓牠們以另一種型態獲得了近乎無盡的生命。
dialogsBegin.vi: Thật đáng kinh ngạc .. họ đã đi đến kết luận rằng những sinh vật Nightmist này có thể cũng từng là trolls. Elixir of Vitality có thể đã mang lại cho chúng sự sống bất tận trong một hình hài mới.

dialogsBegin.en: That explains why no evidence of trolls were found within the Leren Chasm today. The trolls of the past evolved into something new... the Nightmist.
dialogsBegin.ar: That explains why no evidence of trolls were found within the Leren Chasm today. The trolls of the past evolved into something new... the Nightmist.
dialogsBegin.br: Mistério resolvido! Por isso que não achamos nenhuma evidência de trolls no Abismo de Leren. Eles evoluíram para algo novo... a Bruma Noturna!
dialogsBegin.cns: That explains why no evidence of trolls were found within the Leren Chasm today. The trolls of the past evolved into something new... the Nightmist.
dialogsBegin.de: Das erklärt, warum heute keine Spuren von Trollen in der Lerenkluft gefunden werden konnten. Die Trolle der Vergangenheit entwickelt sich in etwas Neues...den Nightmist.
dialogsBegin.fi: That explains why no evidence of trolls were found within the Leren Chasm today. The trolls of the past evolved into something new... the Nightmist.
dialogsBegin.fil: That explains why no evidence of trolls were found within the Leren Chasm today. The trolls of the past evolved into something new... the Nightmist.
dialogsBegin.fr: Cela explique pourquoi aucune trace de trolls n'a été trouvée dans le Gouffre de Leren aujourd'hui. Les trolls du passé ont évolué vers quelque chose de nouveau... les Créatures de la Nuit.
dialogsBegin.id: Itu menjelaskan mengapa tidak ada bukti troll yang ditemukan di Leren Chasm hari ini. Troll masa lalu berevolusi menjadi sesuatu yang baru.. Nightmist.
dialogsBegin.it: That explains why no evidence of trolls were found within the Leren Chasm today. The trolls of the past evolved into something new... the Nightmist.
dialogsBegin.jp: これが、今日、レレンの淵内でトロルの証拠が見つからなかった理由を説明しています。過去のトロールは何か新しいものに進化しました..ナイトミスト。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그래서 요즘 레르엔 협곡에서 트롤의 흔적이 발견되지 않은 거군요. 과거의 트롤이 새로운 존재로... 나이트미스트로 진화한 거였어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: That explains why no evidence of trolls were found within the Leren Chasm today. The trolls of the past evolved into something new... the Nightmist.
dialogsBegin.pl: That explains why no evidence of trolls were found within the Leren Chasm today. The trolls of the past evolved into something new... the Nightmist.
dialogsBegin.ru: That explains why no evidence of trolls were found within the Leren Chasm today. The trolls of the past evolved into something new... the Nightmist.
dialogsBegin.sp: Eso explica por qué no se han encontrado evidencias de trolls en la Sima de Leren hoy en día. Los trolls del pasado evolucionaron en algo nuevo .. el Niebla Nocturna.
dialogsBegin.sw: That explains why no evidence of trolls were found within the Leren Chasm today. The trolls of the past evolved into something new... the Nightmist.
dialogsBegin.th: นี่ก็อธิบายได้ว่า ทำไมถึงไม่มีหลักฐานของพวก Troll อยู่เลยใน Leren Chasm ทุกวันนี้ เพราะพวก Troll ได้วิวัฒนาการตัวเองกลายเป็น...Nightmist
dialogsBegin.tw: 這也就能解釋，為什麼如今的勒倫峽谷裡完全找不到巨魔的痕跡。過去的巨魔，已經演變成了新的存在……也就是夜霧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Điều đó giải thích tại sao ngày nay không có bằng chứng nào về trolls được tìm thấy trong Leren Chasm. Những con troll trong quá khứ đã phát triển thành một thứ mới .. Nightmist.

dialogsBegin.en: I am curious, however, if there is something we missed along the way. Go inside the Leren Chasm once more and make sure there's nothing we left behind.
dialogsBegin.ar: I am curious, however, if there is something we missed along the way. Go inside the Leren Chasm once more and make sure there's nothing we left behind.
dialogsBegin.br: Estou curioso, no entanto, se deixamos algo para trás pelo caminho. Entre no Abismo de Leren mais uma vez e certifique-se de que não deixamos nada para trás.
dialogsBegin.cns: I am curious, however, if there is something we missed along the way. Go inside the Leren Chasm once more and make sure there's nothing we left behind.
dialogsBegin.de: Ich bin jedoch neugierig, ob wir auf dem Weg etwas übersehen haben. Geht noch einmal in die Lerenkluft und stelle sicher, dass wir nichts zurückgelassen haben.
dialogsBegin.fi: I am curious, however, if there is something we missed along the way. Go inside the Leren Chasm once more and make sure there's nothing we left behind.
dialogsBegin.fil: I am curious, however, if there is something we missed along the way. Go inside the Leren Chasm once more and make sure there's nothing we left behind.
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais je suis curieux de savoir si nous avons manqué quelque chose en chemin. Retournez dans le Gouffre de Leren et assurez-vous qu'il n'y a rien que nous ayons laissé derrière nous.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya ingin tahu, bagaimanapun, jika ada sesuatu yang kami lewatkan di sepanjang jalan. Masuk ke dalam Leren Chasm sekali lagi dan pastikan tidak ada yang tertinggal.
dialogsBegin.it: I am curious, however, if there is something we missed along the way. Go inside the Leren Chasm once more and make sure there's nothing we left behind.
dialogsBegin.jp: しかし、途中で見逃したものがあるかどうか興味があります。もう一度レレンの淵の中に入って、私たちが残したものがないことを確認してください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 혹시 우리가 놓친 것이 있는지 궁금하네요. 레르엔 협곡에 다시 한번 들어가서 우리가 놓친 것이 없는지 확인해 보는 게 좋겠어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I am curious, however, if there is something we missed along the way. Go inside the Leren Chasm once more and make sure there's nothing we left behind.
dialogsBegin.pl: I am curious, however, if there is something we missed along the way. Go inside the Leren Chasm once more and make sure there's nothing we left behind.
dialogsBegin.ru: I am curious, however, if there is something we missed along the way. Go inside the Leren Chasm once more and make sure there's nothing we left behind.
dialogsBegin.sp: Tengo curiosidad, sin embargo, por si hay algo que nos hayamos dejado por el camino. Entra en la Sima de Leren una vez más y asegúrate de que no hay nada que nos hayamos dejado.
dialogsBegin.sw: I am curious, however, if there is something we missed along the way. Go inside the Leren Chasm once more and make sure there's nothing we left behind.
dialogsBegin.th: ข้าสงสัย ว่ามีอะไรไหมที่เราพลาดระหว่างทาง เข้าไปใน Leren Chasm อีกครั้งและไปตรวจสอบให้แน่ใจว่าเราไม่ได้พลาดอะไรไป
dialogsBegin.tw: 不過我還是很好奇，我們是不是漏掉了什麼。再進去勒倫峽谷一次吧，確認沒有遺漏任何東西。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tuy nhiên, tôi tò mò liệu có điều gì chúng ta đã bỏ lỡ trên đường đi không. Đi vào bên trong Leren Chasm một lần nữa và đảm bảo rằng chúng ta không bỏ sót thứ gì.

dialogsAccept.en: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. This trip will be your last. Make sure to leave no stone unturned, so we can close the case on the mystery of the Leren Chasm.
dialogsAccept.ar: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. This trip will be your last. Make sure to leave no stone unturned, so we can close the case on the mystery of the Leren Chasm.
dialogsAccept.br: Fale comigo quando estiver pronto para entrar no Abismo de Leren mais uma vez. Esta será sua última viagem. Certifique-se de não deixar pedra sobre pedra, para que possamos encerrar o mistério do Abismo de Leren.
dialogsAccept.cns: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. This trip will be your last. Make sure to leave no stone unturned, so we can close the case on the mystery of the Leren Chasm.
dialogsAccept.de: Spreche mit mir, wenn du bereit bist, die Lerenkluft erneut zu betreten. Dies wird dein letzter Ausflug sein. Lass nichts unversucht, damit wir das Geheimnis der Lerenkluft lüften können.
dialogsAccept.fi: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. This trip will be your last. Make sure to leave no stone unturned, so we can close the case on the mystery of the Leren Chasm.
dialogsAccept.fil: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. This trip will be your last. Make sure to leave no stone unturned, so we can close the case on the mystery of the Leren Chasm.
dialogsAccept.fr: Parlez-moi quand vous serez prêts à pénétrer à nouveau dans le Gouffre de Leren. Ce voyage sera le dernier. Veillez à ne négliger aucune piste, afin que nous puissions élucider le mystère du Gouffre de Leren.
dialogsAccept.id: Silakan berbicara dengan saya ketika Anda siap untuk memasuki Leren Chasm sekali lagi. Perjalanan ini akan menjadi yang terakhir. Pastikan untuk tidak melewatkan kebutuhan bisnis yang terlewat, sehingga kita dapat menutup kasus misteri Leren Chasm.
dialogsAccept.it: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. This trip will be your last. Make sure to leave no stone unturned, so we can close the case on the mystery of the Leren Chasm.
dialogsAccept.jp: もう一度レレンの淵に入る準備ができたら、私に話しかけてください。この旅行はあなたの最後の旅行になります。レレンの淵の謎の事件を終わらせることができるように、石を回さないように注意してください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 다시 레르엔 협곡에 들어갈 준비가 되면, 제게 말씀해 주세요. 이번 여행이 마지막이 되겠군요. 레르엔 협곡의 미스터리 사건을 해결할 수 있도록, 끝까지 노력해주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. This trip will be your last. Make sure to leave no stone unturned, so we can close the case on the mystery of the Leren Chasm.
dialogsAccept.pl: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. This trip will be your last. Make sure to leave no stone unturned, so we can close the case on the mystery of the Leren Chasm.
dialogsAccept.ru: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. This trip will be your last. Make sure to leave no stone unturned, so we can close the case on the mystery of the Leren Chasm.
dialogsAccept.sp: Por favor, háblame cuando estés listo para entrar en la Sima de Leren una vez más. Este viaje será el último. Asegúrate de no dejar piedra sin remover, para que podamos cerrar el caso del misterio de la Sima de Leren.
dialogsAccept.sw: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. This trip will be your last. Make sure to leave no stone unturned, so we can close the case on the mystery of the Leren Chasm.
dialogsAccept.th: โปรดกลับมาคุยกับข้าใหม่เมื่อเจ้าพร้อมจะเข้าไปใน Leren Chasm อีกครั้ง นี่จะเป็นรอบสุดท้ายของเจ้าล่ะ จงแน่ใจว่าหาทุกอย่างละเอียดดีแล้ว เราจะได้แน่ใจว่าเราสามารถปิดเคสเกี่ยวกับปริศนาแห่ง Leren Chasm ได้
dialogsAccept.tw: 等你準備好再次進入勒倫峽谷時再來找我。這會是你最後一次進去，務必要把每個角落都查清楚，這樣我們才能真正替勒倫峽谷之謎畫下句點。
dialogsAccept.vi: Vui lòng nói chuyện với tôi khi bạn sẵn sàng bước vào Leren Chasm một lần nữa. Chuyến đi này sẽ là chuyến đi cuối cùng của bạn. Đảm bảo không bỏ sót bất kỳ điều gì, để chúng ta có thể khép lại vụ án về bí ẩn của Leren Chasm.

dialogsDecline.en: You have made great progress figuring out the mysteries within the Leren Chasm. Maybe there is nothing left to explore anymore.
dialogsDecline.ar: You have made great progress figuring out the mysteries within the Leren Chasm. Maybe there is nothing left to explore anymore.
dialogsDecline.br: Você fez um ótimo progresso descobrindo os mistérios do Abismo de Leren. Talvez não haja mais nada para explorar.
dialogsDecline.cns: You have made great progress figuring out the mysteries within the Leren Chasm. Maybe there is nothing left to explore anymore.
dialogsDecline.de: Du hast große Fortschritte bei der Erforschung der Geheimnisse in der Lerenkluft gemacht. Vielleicht gibt es jetzt nichts mehr zu erforschen.
dialogsDecline.fi: You have made great progress figuring out the mysteries within the Leren Chasm. Maybe there is nothing left to explore anymore.
dialogsDecline.fil: You have made great progress figuring out the mysteries within the Leren Chasm. Maybe there is nothing left to explore anymore.
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous avez beaucoup progressé dans la découverte des mystères du Gouffre de Leren. Peut-être n'y a-t-il plus rien à explorer.
dialogsDecline.id: Anda telah membuat kemajuan besar dalam mencari tahu misteri di dalam Leren Chasm. Mungkin tidak ada yang tersisa untuk dijelajahi lagi.
dialogsDecline.it: You have made great progress figuring out the mysteries within the Leren Chasm. Maybe there is nothing left to explore anymore.
dialogsDecline.jp: あなたはレレンの淵内の謎を理解するために大きな進歩を遂げました。たぶん、もう探索するものは何も残っていません。
dialogsDecline.kr: 레르엔 협곡의 미스터리 해결에 꽤 진전이 있었네요! 이제 더는 탐사할 게 없을 것 같은데요.
dialogsDecline.nl: You have made great progress figuring out the mysteries within the Leren Chasm. Maybe there is nothing left to explore anymore.
dialogsDecline.pl: You have made great progress figuring out the mysteries within the Leren Chasm. Maybe there is nothing left to explore anymore.
dialogsDecline.ru: You have made great progress figuring out the mysteries within the Leren Chasm. Maybe there is nothing left to explore anymore.
dialogsDecline.sp: Has hecho grandes progresos descubriendo los misterios de la Sima de Leren. Quizá ya no quede nada por explorar.
dialogsDecline.sw: You have made great progress figuring out the mysteries within the Leren Chasm. Maybe there is nothing left to explore anymore.
dialogsDecline.th: เจ้าทำทุกอย่างได้ดีเกี่ยวกับปริศนาแห่ง Leren Chasm อาจจะไม่มีอะไรเหลือให้สำรวจอีกแล้วก็ได้
dialogsDecline.tw: 你在解開勒倫峽谷的祕密上已經取得很大的進展了。也許裡面已經沒有更多東西可探索了。
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn đã đạt được tiến bộ lớn trong việc tìm ra những bí ẩn bên trong Leren Chasm. Có lẽ không còn gì để khám phá nữa.

dialogsComplete.en: Welcome back, adventurer! I have heard from everyone the great work you have done investigating the strange sounds within the Leren Chasm.
dialogsComplete.ar: Welcome back, adventurer! I have heard from everyone the great work you have done investigating the strange sounds within the Leren Chasm.
dialogsComplete.br: Bem-vindo de volta! Todo mundo tá falando sobre o seu trabalho incrível investigando os sons estranhos no Abismo de Leren!
dialogsComplete.cns: Welcome back, adventurer! I have heard from everyone the great work you have done investigating the strange sounds within the Leren Chasm.
dialogsComplete.de: Willkommen zurück, Abenteurer! Ich habe von allen gehört, welch großartige Arbeit du bei der Untersuchung der seltsamen Geräusche in der Lerenkluft geleistet hast.
dialogsComplete.fi: Welcome back, adventurer! I have heard from everyone the great work you have done investigating the strange sounds within the Leren Chasm.
dialogsComplete.fil: Welcome back, adventurer! I have heard from everyone the great work you have done investigating the strange sounds within the Leren Chasm.
dialogsComplete.fr: Bienvenue, aventurier ! Tout le monde m'a parlé de l'excellent travail que vous avez accompli en enquêtant sur les bruits étranges du Gouffre de Leren.
dialogsComplete.id: Selamat datang kembali, petualang! Aku telah mendengar dari semua orang pekerjaan hebat yang telah kamu lakukan untuk menyelidiki suara-suara aneh di dalam Leren Chasm.
dialogsComplete.it: Welcome back, adventurer! I have heard from everyone the great work you have done investigating the strange sounds within the Leren Chasm.
dialogsComplete.jp: おかえりなさい、冒険者さん!私は皆から、あなたがレレンの淵内の奇妙な音を調査するために行った素晴らしい仕事を聞いています。
dialogsComplete.kr: 돌아온 걸 환영해요, 모험가님! 레르엔 협곡에서 들리는 이상한 소리를 조사하느라 고생이 많으셨다고 들었습니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Welcome back, adventurer! I have heard from everyone the great work you have done investigating the strange sounds within the Leren Chasm.
dialogsComplete.pl: Welcome back, adventurer! I have heard from everyone the great work you have done investigating the strange sounds within the Leren Chasm.
dialogsComplete.ru: Welcome back, adventurer! I have heard from everyone the great work you have done investigating the strange sounds within the Leren Chasm.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Bienvenido de nuevo, aventurero! He oído de todos el gran trabajo que has hecho investigando los extraños sonidos dentro de la Sima de Leren.
dialogsComplete.sw: Welcome back, adventurer! I have heard from everyone the great work you have done investigating the strange sounds within the Leren Chasm.
dialogsComplete.th: ยินดีต้อนรับกลับมาท่านนักผจญภัย! ข้าได้ยินเรื่องราวจากทุกคนแล้วเกี่ยวกับงานที่ยิ่งใหญ่ที่ท่านทำได้สำเร็จ เรื่องที่มาของเสียงประหลาดใน Leren Chasm
dialogsComplete.tw: 歡迎回來，冒險家！我已經聽大家說了，你在調查勒倫峽谷裡那些奇怪聲響時表現得非常出色。
dialogsComplete.vi: Chào mừng trở lại, adventurer! Tôi đã nghe từ mọi người về công việc tuyệt vời mà bạn đã thực hiện khi điều tra những âm thanh kỳ lạ trong Leren Chasm.

dialogsComplete.en: It seems to me the Caveman Chief you encountered was the last of its kind in Flaris. Perhaps it simply held on to life as a way to protect its kin, even those that transformed into the horrid Nightmist.
dialogsComplete.ar: It seems to me the Caveman Chief you encountered was the last of its kind in Flaris. Perhaps it simply held on to life as a way to protect its kin, even those that transformed into the horrid Nightmist.
dialogsComplete.br: Parece que o Chefe das Cavernas que você encontrou foi o último de sua espécie em Flaris. Talvez ele tenha se mantido vivo como uma forma de proteger seus parentes, mesmo aqueles que se transformaram na terrível Bruma Noturna.
dialogsComplete.cns: It seems to me the Caveman Chief you encountered was the last of its kind in Flaris. Perhaps it simply held on to life as a way to protect its kin, even those that transformed into the horrid Nightmist.
dialogsComplete.de: Mir scheint, dass der Höhlenmenschen-Häuptling, dem du begegnet bist, der letzte seiner Art in Flaris war. Vielleicht hat er einfach am Leben festgehalten, um seine Verwandten zu beschützen, selbst diejenigen, die sich in den schrecklichen Nightmist verwandelt haben.
dialogsComplete.fi: It seems to me the Caveman Chief you encountered was the last of its kind in Flaris. Perhaps it simply held on to life as a way to protect its kin, even those that transformed into the horrid Nightmist.
dialogsComplete.fil: It seems to me the Caveman Chief you encountered was the last of its kind in Flaris. Perhaps it simply held on to life as a way to protect its kin, even those that transformed into the horrid Nightmist.
dialogsComplete.fr: Il me semble que le Chef des Hommes des Cavernes que vous avez rencontré était le dernier de son espèce à Flaris. Il s'est peut-être simplement accroché à la vie pour protéger ses proches, même ceux qui se sont transformés en horribles Créatures de la Nuit.
dialogsComplete.id: Menurutku Caveman Chief yang kamu temui adalah yang terakhir dari jenisnya di Flaris. Mungkin dia hanya bertahan hidup sebagai cara untuk melindungi kerabatnya, bahkan mereka yang telah berubah menjadi Nightmist yang mengerikan.
dialogsComplete.it: It seems to me the Caveman Chief you encountered was the last of its kind in Flaris. Perhaps it simply held on to life as a way to protect its kin, even those that transformed into the horrid Nightmist.
dialogsComplete.jp: あなたが遭遇した穴居人の首長は、フラリスでその種の最後のものだったようです。おそらくそれは、恐ろしいナイトミストに変身したものでさえ、その親族を保護する方法として単に生命を保持していました。
dialogsComplete.kr: 당신이 싸운 원시인 족장은 플라리스에 남아 있던 마지막 원시인인 것 같네요. 끔찍한 나이트미스트로 변해버린 동족들까지도 지키기 위해, 지금까지 목숨을 부지하고 있었을지도 모르죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: It seems to me the Caveman Chief you encountered was the last of its kind in Flaris. Perhaps it simply held on to life as a way to protect its kin, even those that transformed into the horrid Nightmist.
dialogsComplete.pl: It seems to me the Caveman Chief you encountered was the last of its kind in Flaris. Perhaps it simply held on to life as a way to protect its kin, even those that transformed into the horrid Nightmist.
dialogsComplete.ru: It seems to me the Caveman Chief you encountered was the last of its kind in Flaris. Perhaps it simply held on to life as a way to protect its kin, even those that transformed into the horrid Nightmist.
dialogsComplete.sp: Me parece que el Jefe Cavernícola que encontraste era el último de su especie en Flaris. Quizá se aferró a la vida para proteger a los suyos, incluso a los que se transformaron en el horrible Niebla Nocturna.
dialogsComplete.sw: It seems to me the Caveman Chief you encountered was the last of its kind in Flaris. Perhaps it simply held on to life as a way to protect its kin, even those that transformed into the horrid Nightmist.
dialogsComplete.th: ข้าเห็นว่า Caveman Chief ที่เจ้าปะทะด้วยเป็นตัวสุดท้ายของพวกมันใน Flaris แล้ว บางทีมันอาจจะมีชีวิตอยู่เพียงแค่คอยปกป้องลูกหลานมันเท่านั้น แต่ถึงยังไงพวกนั้นมันก็กลายเป็น Nightmist ที่น่าสะพรึงกลัวไปหมดแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 在我看來，你遇到的穴居人酋長應該就是布拉里斯最後一個同類了。也許牠一直苟活著，只是為了守護自己的族人，哪怕那些族人早已變成可怕的夜霧。
dialogsComplete.vi: Đối với tôi, có vẻ như Caveman Chief mà bạn gặp phải là người cuối cùng thuộc loại này ở Flaris. Có lẽ nó chỉ đơn giản là duy trì sự sống như một cách để bảo vệ đồng loại của mình, ngay cả chúng đã biến thành Nightmist khủng khiếp.

dialogsComplete.en: For now, I think the mystery of the Leren Chasm has been solved. Well done!
dialogsComplete.ar: For now, I think the mystery of the Leren Chasm has been solved. Well done!
dialogsComplete.br: Por enquanto, acho que desvendamos o mistério do Abismo de Leren, hein? Arrasou!
dialogsComplete.cns: For now, I think the mystery of the Leren Chasm has been solved. Well done!
dialogsComplete.de: Ich glaube, das Rätsel der Lerenkluft ist vorerst gelöst. Gut gemacht!
dialogsComplete.fi: For now, I think the mystery of the Leren Chasm has been solved. Well done!
dialogsComplete.fil: For now, I think the mystery of the Leren Chasm has been solved. Well done!
dialogsComplete.fr: Pour l'instant, je pense que le mystère du Gouffre de Leren a été résolu. C'est très bien !
dialogsComplete.id: Untuk saat ini, kurasa misteri Jurang Leren telah terpecahkan. Bagus sekali!
dialogsComplete.it: For now, I think the mystery of the Leren Chasm has been solved. Well done!
dialogsComplete.jp: 今のところ、レレンの淵の謎は解決されたと思います。よくやりましたね！
dialogsComplete.kr: 드디어 레르엔 협곡의 미스터리가 풀린 것 같네요. 잘했어요!
dialogsComplete.nl: For now, I think the mystery of the Leren Chasm has been solved. Well done!
dialogsComplete.pl: For now, I think the mystery of the Leren Chasm has been solved. Well done!
dialogsComplete.ru: For now, I think the mystery of the Leren Chasm has been solved. Well done!
dialogsComplete.sp: Por ahora, creo que el misterio de la Sima de Leren ha sido resuelto. ¡Bien hecho!
dialogsComplete.sw: For now, I think the mystery of the Leren Chasm has been solved. Well done!
dialogsComplete.th: สำหรับตอนนี้ ข้าว่าปริศนาทั้งหมดของ Leren Chasm ได้ถูกไขหมดแล้ว ทำได้ดีมาก!
dialogsComplete.tw: 至少現在，我想勒倫峽谷的謎團已經解開了。做得漂亮！
dialogsComplete.vi: Hiện tại, tôi nghĩ rằng bí ẩn của Leren Chasm đã được giải quyết. Làm tốt!

description.de: Ich bin mir sicher dass die Gruppe im Norden des Leren Gebirges lebt. Es ist ein seltsamer Ort. Bitte siehe nach.

description.fil: Search the Northern Leren Mountains for evidence of another Red bang Troupe camp.
description.fr: Investiguer dans les Montagnes nord de Leren pour trouver la cachette du nouveau Lord Bang.
description.id: Cari di Northern Leren Mountains untuk mencari bukti kamp Red bang Troupe lainnya.
description.it: Search the Northern Leren Mountains for evidence of another Red bang Troupe camp.
description.jp: レルエン山脈の北部にあるという盗賊団の拠点を探し、やつらを倒そう。
description.kr: 레르엔 산맥 북부에서 레드 뱅 도적단의 본거지 흔적을 찾아보세요.
description.nl: Search the Northern Leren Mountains for evidence of another Red bang Troupe camp.
description.pl: Search the Northern Leren Mountains for evidence of another Red bang Troupe camp.
description.ru: Нужно разыскать на севере Леренских горок новое укрытие "Труппы товарищей".
description.sp: Ve al Norte de las Montañas Leren y busca pruebas de la existencia de otro campamento de los Bangs Rojos.
description.sw: Search the Northern Leren Mountains for evidence of another Red bang Troupe camp.
description.th: ค้นหาภูเขา Northern Leren Mountains เพื่อหาหลักฐานการมีอยู่ของค่าย Red Bang Troupe อีกแห่ง
description.tw: 在勒倫山脈北部，跟之前是不同的地方，請你仔細的看一下。
description.vi: Tìm kiếm Northern Leren Mountains để tìm bằng chứng về một trại Red bang Troupe khác.

dialogsBegin.en: They still exist, huh? I knew it. This can only mean there is a new leader.
dialogsBegin.ar: They still exist, huh? I knew it. This can only mean there is a new leader.
dialogsBegin.br: Eles ainda existem, hum? Sabia! Isso significa que agora eles tem um novo líder.
dialogsBegin.cns: 他们还生存着，而且重新占领了一个地区，这代表他们有了新的领导者。
dialogsBegin.de: Es gibt sie noch, was? Ich wusste es. Das kann nur bedeuten, dass es einen neuen Anführer gibt.
dialogsBegin.fi: They still exist, huh? I knew it. This can only mean there is a new leader.
dialogsBegin.fil: They still exist, huh? I knew it. This can only mean there is a new leader.
dialogsBegin.fr: Ils existent toujours ! Cela veut dire qu'ils ont un nouveau chef.
dialogsBegin.id: Mereka masih ada, ya? Aku tahu itu. Ini hanya bisa berarti ada pemimpin baru.
dialogsBegin.it: They still exist, huh? I knew it. This can only mean there is a new leader.
dialogsBegin.jp: 彼らがまだ生き残って集結しているって？それは、あいつらの中から新しいリーダーが現れたってことだな。
dialogsBegin.kr: 도적단이 아직 건재하군요? 그럴 줄 알았어요. 분명 새로운 두목이 있다는 뜻이에요.
dialogsBegin.nl: They still exist, huh? I knew it. This can only mean there is a new leader.
dialogsBegin.pl: They still exist, huh? I knew it. This can only mean there is a new leader.
dialogsBegin.ru: They still exist, huh? I knew it. This can only mean there is a new leader.
dialogsBegin.sp: Todavía existen, ¿eh? Lo sabía. Esto solo puede significar que hay un nuevo líder.
dialogsBegin.sw: They still exist, huh? I knew it. This can only mean there is a new leader.
dialogsBegin.th: พวกมันยังอยู่ใช่ไหม? ว่าแล้วเชียว นี่หมายความได้อย่างเดียวก็คือมีหัวหน้าคนใหม่
dialogsBegin.tw: 他們還生存著，而且重新佔領了一個地區，這代表他們有了新的領導者。
dialogsBegin.vi: Chúng vẫn tồn tại, hả? Tôi biết mà. Điều này có nghĩa là có một thủ lĩnh mới.

dialogsBegin.en: Darn it! We've got to do something before it's too late!
dialogsBegin.ar: Darn it! We've got to do something before it's too late!
dialogsBegin.br: Eu achei que se livrar do líder resolveria o problema, mas... e agora, o que faremos? Se houver um novo Lorde Bang... Então...
dialogsBegin.cns: 啊，我以为把他们杀光就解决了，没有到有新的锣得崩崩会出现，如果我所想的锣得崩崩是我认识的家伙的话..
dialogsBegin.de: Ich dachte wenn wir den Anführer beseitigen, wäre auch das Problem beseitigt, aber.. Was sollen wir jetzt tun? Wenn der neue Lord Bang.. Dann..
dialogsBegin.fi: Darn it! We've got to do something before it's too late!
dialogsBegin.fil: Darn it! We've got to do something before it's too late!
dialogsBegin.fr: Moi qui pensait qu'éliminer leur chef serait la solution, mais. que faire maintenant ? S'il y a un nouveau Lord Bang... Alors...(trainant des pieds)
dialogsBegin.id: Sialan! Kita harus melakukan sesuatu sebelum terlambat!
dialogsBegin.it: Darn it! We've got to do something before it's too late!
dialogsBegin.jp: ボスをやっつけて、全てが終わったと思っていたのに。やはりそんな簡単なことでは収まらなかったか。ひとつ心当たりがあるんだが、あいつらの新しいリーダーになった＜ロードヴァン＞が、俺の知っているあいつだったら！
dialogsBegin.kr: 젠장… 너무 늦기 전에 우리가 먼저 움직여야 해요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Darn it! We've got to do something before it's too late!
dialogsBegin.pl: Darn it! We've got to do something before it's too late!
dialogsBegin.ru: Надо что-то делать, пока не поздно!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Maldita sea! ¡Debemos hacer algo antes de que sea demasiado tarde!
dialogsBegin.sw: Darn it! We've got to do something before it's too late!
dialogsBegin.th: บ้าจริง! เราต้องทำอะไรสักอย่างก่อนจะสายเกินไป!
dialogsBegin.tw: 啊，我以為把他們殺光就解決了，沒有到有新的鑼得崩崩會出現，如果我所想的鑼得崩崩是我認識的傢伙的話…
dialogsBegin.vi: Khỉ thật! Chúng ta phải làm điều gì đó trước khi quá muộn!

dialogsBegin.en: Since there is evidence of a new leader, there must be a new group of Red Bang Troupe members hiding out somewhere.
dialogsBegin.ar: Since there is evidence of a new leader, there must be a new group of Red Bang Troupe members hiding out somewhere.
dialogsBegin.br: Agora estamos com um grande problema, porque eles estão se tornando mais perigosos do que qualquer outra coisa. Como há evidências de um novo líder, deve haver novos membros escondidos em algum lugar.
dialogsBegin.cns: 如果真的是那个家伙的话，那就糟糕了!那个红色战甲强盗团比之前的还要凶猛，更加恶劣，这不是重点..
dialogsBegin.de: Dann sind wir jetzt in wirklich großen Schwierigkeiten, es wird gefährlicher als alles andere. Auf jeden Fall..
dialogsBegin.fi: Since there is evidence of a new leader, there must be a new group of Red Bang Troupe members hiding out somewhere.
dialogsBegin.fil: Since there is evidence of a new leader, there must be a new group of Red Bang Troupe members hiding out somewhere.
dialogsBegin.fr: Maintenant nous ne sommes plus en sécurité, ils deviennent encore plus dangereux qu'avant. Quoi qu'il en soit...
dialogsBegin.id: Karena ada bukti pemimpin baru, pasti ada kelompok baru anggota Red Bang Troupe yang bersembunyi di suatu tempat.
dialogsBegin.it: Since there is evidence of a new leader, there must be a new group of Red Bang Troupe members hiding out somewhere.
dialogsBegin.jp: そいつだったら本当に大変なことになる。なにせそいつは、こないだのロードヴァンよりももっと危険で野望に満ち溢れた、恐ろしく凶暴なやつなんだよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 새로운 두목의 흔적이 있다는 건, 어딘가에서 레드 뱅 도적단이 다시 움직이고 있다는 뜻이에요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Since there is evidence of a new leader, there must be a new group of Red Bang Troupe members hiding out somewhere.
dialogsBegin.pl: Since there is evidence of a new leader, there must be a new group of Red Bang Troupe members hiding out somewhere.
dialogsBegin.ru: Раз у них новый главарь, значит, есть и новое укрытие.
dialogsBegin.sp: Dado que hay evidencias de que hay un nuevo líder, debe haber un nuevo grupo de Miembros de los Bangs Rojos escondidos en algún lugar.
dialogsBegin.sw: Since there is evidence of a new leader, there must be a new group of Red Bang Troupe members hiding out somewhere.
dialogsBegin.th: เพราะว่าพวกโจรมีผู้นำคนใหม่ จะต้องมีสมาชิกกลุ่มใหม่ของพวกโจร Red Bang ซ่อนตัวอยู่ที่ไหนสักแห่งแน่ๆ
dialogsBegin.tw: 如果真的是那個傢伙的話，那就糟糕了！那個鑼得崩崩比之前的鑼得崩崩還要兇猛，更加惡劣，這不是重點…
dialogsBegin.vi: Vì có bằng chứng về một thủ lĩnh mới, nên chắc chắn phải có một nhóm thành viên Red Bang Troupe mới đang ẩn náu ở đâu đó.

dialogsBegin.en: A good friend of mine mentioned having seen some Red bang Troupe members in the Northern Leren Mountains
dialogsBegin.ar: A good friend of mine mentioned having seen some Red bang Troupe members in the Northern Leren Mountains
dialogsBegin.br: Se houver um novo grupo, nós devemos ser capazes de encontrar alguns sinais deles em Flaris. Você me ajudaria, por favor...?
dialogsBegin.cns: 我的一个好朋友说，他在乐雅山脉北部发现了红色魔导战甲团成员的身影
dialogsBegin.de: Wenn es eine neue Gruppe geben sollte, können wir in Flaris Anzeichen von ihnen finden. Würdest du bitte helfen...?
dialogsBegin.fi: A good friend of mine mentioned having seen some Red bang Troupe members in the Northern Leren Mountains
dialogsBegin.fil: A good friend of mine mentioned having seen some Red bang Troupe members in the Northern Leren Mountains
dialogsBegin.fr: S'il y a une nouvelle bande, nous devrions en trouver des preuves à Flaris. Tu veux bien m'aider ?
dialogsBegin.id: Seorang teman baikku menyebutkan telah melihat beberapa anggota Red bang Troupe di Pegunungan Leren Utara
dialogsBegin.it: A good friend of mine mentioned having seen some Red bang Troupe members in the Northern Leren Mountains
dialogsBegin.jp: もし赤いヴァン盗賊団が復活して勢力を広げてきたとすれば、フラリス地域でもすでに怪しい動きが見えてくるはず。そこで勇敢な君に、また頼みを聞いてほしいんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 제 친구 중 한 명이 레르엔 산맥 북부에서 레드 뱅 도적단을 봤다고 했어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: A good friend of mine mentioned having seen some Red bang Troupe members in the Northern Leren Mountains
dialogsBegin.pl: A good friend of mine mentioned having seen some Red bang Troupe members in the Northern Leren Mountains
dialogsBegin.ru: Один мой друг говорил, что видел разбойников, похожих на проходимцев из "Труппы", на севере Леренских горок. Думаю, там у них лагерь. Попробуешь отыскать его?
dialogsBegin.sp: Un buen amigo mío mencionó haber visto a algunos Miembros de los Bangs Rojos al Norte de las Montañas Leren.
dialogsBegin.sw: A good friend of mine mentioned having seen some Red bang Troupe members in the Northern Leren Mountains
dialogsBegin.th: เพื่อนของฉันพูดว่าเขาเห็นกลุ่มโจร Red Bang แถวๆ Northern Leren Mountains
dialogsBegin.tw: 如果組織了新的團隊的話，一定會在布拉里斯生活著，可以幫我嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Một người bạn tốt của tôi đã đề cập đến việc nhìn thấy một số thành viên của Red bang Troupe ở Northern Leren Mountains

dialogsAccept.en: I am sure that the group of them live in the Northern Leren Mountains. Go now, friend, and see if you can identify a new group of troupe members.
dialogsAccept.ar: I am sure that the group of them live in the Northern Leren Mountains. Go now, friend, and see if you can identify a new group of troupe members.
dialogsAccept.br: Tenho certeza de que um grupo deles vive nas Montanhas Leren, ao norte. É um lugar diferente. Por favor, cheque o local.
dialogsAccept.cns: 我很确定他们一定住在乐雅山脉北部。去吧，我的朋友，看看是否可以在那找到一个新的强盗团成员。
dialogsAccept.de: Ich bin mir sicher dass die Gruppe im Norden des Leren Gebirges lebt. Es ist ein seltsamer Ort. Bitte siehe nach.
dialogsAccept.fi: I am sure that the group of them live in the Northern Leren Mountains. Go now, friend, and see if you can identify a new group of troupe members.
dialogsAccept.fil: I am sure that the group of them live in the Northern Leren Mountains. Go now, friend, and see if you can identify a new group of troupe members.
dialogsAccept.fr: Je pense que ce groupe se réfugie dans le nord des Montagnes de Leren. Mais il faudrait vérifier...
dialogsAccept.id: Saya yakin kelompok mereka tinggal di Pegunungan Leren Utara. Pergi sekarang, teman, dan lihat apakah kamu dapat mengidentifikasi grup baru dari anggota rombongan.
dialogsAccept.it: I am sure that the group of them live in the Northern Leren Mountains. Go now, friend, and see if you can identify a new group of troupe members.
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとう！本当に君には感謝するよ。レルエン山脈の北部に、たしか彼らの拠点があったはず。そこを探してみてくれないか？
dialogsAccept.kr: 분명! 레르엔 산맥 북부에 도적단의 본거지가 있을 거예요. 어서 가서 새로운 도적단원들이 있는지 탐색해 주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: I am sure that the group of them live in the Northern Leren Mountains. Go now, friend, and see if you can identify a new group of troupe members.
dialogsAccept.pl: I am sure that the group of them live in the Northern Leren Mountains. Go now, friend, and see if you can identify a new group of troupe members.
dialogsAccept.ru: Отлично. Отправляйся на север Леренских горок и отыщи разбойничье укрытие.
dialogsAccept.sp: Estoy seguro de que el grupo vive al Norte de las Montañas Leren. Adelante, amigo, a ver si puedes identificar un nuevo grupo de Miembros de los Bangs Rojos.
dialogsAccept.sw: I am sure that the group of them live in the Northern Leren Mountains. Go now, friend, and see if you can identify a new group of troupe members.
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันแน่ใจว่ากลุ่มของพวกเขาอาศัยอยู่ใน Northern Leren Mountains นายควรไปเดี๋ยวนี้เลย สหาย และลองดูว่าพวกโจรคนใหม่คือใครบ้าง
dialogsAccept.tw: 一定在勒倫山脈北部，跟之前是不同的地方，請你仔細的看一下好嗎？
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi chắc chắn rằng nhóm họ sống ở Northern Leren Mountains. Đi ngay nào, và xem liệu bạn có thể xác định được một nhóm thành viên mới hay không.

dialogsDecline.en: I know I've asked for many favors, but we are so close to putting an end to this threat. Please, help me!
dialogsDecline.ar: I know I've asked for many favors, but we are so close to putting an end to this threat. Please, help me!
dialogsDecline.br: Sei que pedi muitos favores, mas estamos tão perto de acabar com essa ameaça. Por favor me ajude!
dialogsDecline.cns: 那个家伙…!你既然放了那个家伙..啊!!!
dialogsDecline.de: (Wird ganz plötzlich wütend) Wenn wir! Wenn wir in Leben lassen.. Ahh! (Schreit)
dialogsDecline.fi: I know I've asked for many favors, but we are so close to putting an end to this threat. Please, help me!
dialogsDecline.fil: I know I've asked for many favors, but we are so close to putting an end to this threat. Please, help me!
dialogsDecline.fr: (S'énervant d'un seul coup) Si on. si on le laissait en vie? Ahhh !! (criant)
dialogsDecline.id: Saya tahu saya telah meminta banyak bantuan, tetapi kami sangat dekat untuk mengakhiri ancaman ini. Tolong bantu aku!
dialogsDecline.it: I know I've asked for many favors, but we are so close to putting an end to this threat. Please, help me!
dialogsDecline.jp: あいつをほっといたら、本当に恐ろしいことになるんだ。俺だけじゃなく、多くの人が恐怖に怯えることになる･･･。どうか力を貸してくれないか？
dialogsDecline.kr: 부탁을 너무 많이 드리고 있다는 건 알아요. 하지만 지금이야말로 이 위협을 끝낼 기회예요. 도와주세요!
dialogsDecline.nl: I know I've asked for many favors, but we are so close to putting an end to this threat. Please, help me!
dialogsDecline.pl: I know I've asked for many favors, but we are so close to putting an end to this threat. Please, help me!
dialogsDecline.ru: Я знаю, что дело нешуточное, но разбойников нужно остановить! Умоляю, помоги!
dialogsDecline.sp: Sé que te he pedido muchos favores, pero estamos muy cerca de acabar con esta amenaza. ¡Por favor, ayúdame!
dialogsDecline.sw: I know I've asked for many favors, but we are so close to putting an end to this threat. Please, help me!
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันรู้ว่าฉันขอร้องให้คุณช่วยเหลือหลายครั้ง แต่เราก็ใกล้จะยุติปัญหานี้ได้แล้ว กรุณาช่วยฉันด้วย!
dialogsDecline.tw: 我知道已經拜託你很多次了，但我們就快能徹底消除這個威脅。請幫幫我！
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi biết tôi đã yêu cầu nhiều ân huệ, nhưng chúng tôi đã gần chấm dứt mối đe dọa này. Làm ơn giúp tôi!

dialogsComplete.en: I see. There must be a new leader. Thank you for delivering this information.
dialogsComplete.ar: I see. There must be a new leader. Thank you for delivering this information.
dialogsComplete.br: Eu vejo. Deve haver um novo líder. Obrigado por entregar esta informação.
dialogsComplete.cns: 嗯..现在很确定了，真的出现了新的锣得崩崩..
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm.. Dann ist alles klar. Es gibt einen neuen Lord Bang. Es ist vollkommen klar.
dialogsComplete.fi: I see. There must be a new leader. Thank you for delivering this information.
dialogsComplete.fil: I see. There must be a new leader. Thank you for delivering this information.
dialogsComplete.fr: Hmm... Maintenant c'est très clair. Il y a un bien nouveau Lord Bang !
dialogsComplete.id: Saya mengerti. Harus ada pemimpin baru. Terima kasih telah menyampaikan informasi ini.
dialogsComplete.it: I see. There must be a new leader. Thank you for delivering this information.
dialogsComplete.jp: なるほど。新しいロードヴァンが現れたという情報は、やはり間違いがなかったようだね。ありがとう。しかし、とんでもないことになってしまったな。
dialogsComplete.kr: 그렇군요. 새로운 두목이 생긴 게 틀림없어요. 정보 감사합니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: I see. There must be a new leader. Thank you for delivering this information.
dialogsComplete.pl: I see. There must be a new leader. Thank you for delivering this information.
dialogsComplete.ru: Ага. Значит, труппа снова в сборе и куда сильнее прежнего. Интересно, где же прячется их главарь?..
dialogsComplete.sp: Ya veo. Debe haber un nuevo líder. Gracias por informarme.
dialogsComplete.sw: I see. There must be a new leader. Thank you for delivering this information.
dialogsComplete.th: เข้าใจล่ะ ต้องมีผู้นำคนใหม่อยู่ที่นั่นแน่ ขอบคุณที่บอกข้อมูลนี้แก่ฉัน
dialogsComplete.tw: 嗯…現在很確定了，真的出現了新的鑼得崩崩…
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi thấy rồi. Chắc phải có một thủ lĩnh mới. Cảm ơn bạn đã cung cấp thông tin này.

dialogsFail.en: Please, hurry! We don't have much time!
dialogsFail.ar: Please, hurry! We don't have much time!
dialogsFail.br: É óbvio! É óbvio que existe! Por favor, descubra. Você precisa descobrir!!!
dialogsFail.cns: 一定会有的!一定有!请你在仔细的调查一下。
dialogsFail.de: Offenbar! Offenbar ja! Bitte finde es heraus. Du musst!!!
dialogsFail.fi: Please, hurry! We don't have much time!
dialogsFail.fil: Please, hurry! We don't have much time!
dialogsFail.fr: Evidemment ! Bien sûr que c'est ça ! Trouve-les. Tu dois le faire, c'est ton destin !
dialogsFail.id: Tolong, cepat! Kami tidak punya banyak waktu!
dialogsFail.it: Please, hurry! We don't have much time!
dialogsFail.jp: 怪しいやつらは見つからなかったって？そんなことはないはずだ、もう一度よく調べてみてくれ。
dialogsFail.kr: 제발, 서둘러 주세요! 시간이 많지 않아요!
dialogsFail.nl: Please, hurry! We don't have much time!
dialogsFail.pl: Please, hurry! We don't have much time!
dialogsFail.ru: Прошу, поспеши! У нас не так уж много времени!
dialogsFail.sp: ¡Por favor, date prisa! ¡No tenemos mucho tiempo!
dialogsFail.sw: Please, hurry! We don't have much time!
dialogsFail.th: กรุณารีบไป! เรามีเวลามากไม่มาก!
dialogsFail.tw: 一定會有的！一定有！請你在仔細的調查一下。
dialogsFail.vi: Xin hãy nhanh lên! Chúng ta không có nhiều thời gian!

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsAccept.de: Jage $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.fi: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.fil: Manghuli ng $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.fr: Si tu souhaites te faire pardonner tes péchés, tue $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s.
dialogsAccept.id: Berburu $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.it: Caccia $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.jp: では、カルマポイントを回復して差し上げますので、$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を$QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$匹討伐しなさい。
dialogsAccept.kr: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$마리를 사냥하세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.pl: Upoluj $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.ru: Твоя цель - $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$. Требуется покарать не менее $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$.
dialogsAccept.sp: Caza $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.sw: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept.th: ล่า $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$

dialogsAccept.vi: Săn $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.

dialogsDecline.en: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.ar: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.br: Você ainda tem que pagar pelos seus pecados...
dialogsDecline.cns: 你还没有为你的罪恶付出代价...
dialogsDecline.de: Du musst noch immer für deine Sünden bezahlen...
dialogsDecline.fi: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.fil: Di mo pa bayad ang iyong mga kasalanan…
dialogsDecline.fr: Quand expieras-tu tes nombreux crimes ?
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu belum membayar untuk dosa-dosamu…
dialogsDecline.it: Devi ancora pagare per i tuoi peccati...
dialogsDecline.jp: いつになったら、この底知れぬ罪悪感から抜けられるのだろう？
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신은 아직 죗값을 치르지 않았으니...
dialogsDecline.nl: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.pl: Musisz najpierw zapłacić za swoje grzechy…
dialogsDecline.ru: Велики твои грехи…
dialogsDecline.sp: Todavía tienes que pagar por tus pecados...
dialogsDecline.sw: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.th: คุณยังไม้ได้ชดใช้บาปของคุณ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 你還沒有為你的罪付出代價…
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn vẫn chưa phải trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình…

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.br: Sua missão foi concluída. Seus pecados foram perdoados.
dialogsComplete.cns: 任务完成，你的罪恶已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Buße getan. Deine Sünden wurden dir vergeben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Questmu telah tercapai. Dosa-dosamu telah diampuni.
dialogsComplete.it: La Missione è terminata. I tuoi peccati sono stati perdonati.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 끝났습니다. 당신의 죄를 용서하지요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Боги одобрили твое деяние и простили тебе грехи.
dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น บาปของคุณได้รับการอภัยแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nhiệm vụ của bạn đã được hoàn thành. Tội lỗi của bạn đã được tha thứ.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

description.br: Leve o pingente de Hael para Reonan.
description.cns: 将从海尔处获得的项链带给瑞尔南。

description.fi: Bring the pendant from Hael to Reonan.
description.fil: Bring the pendant from Hael to Reonan.
description.fr: Parlez à Reonan.
description.id: Bawa liontinnya dari Hael ke Reonan.
description.it: Bring the pendant from Hael to Reonan.
description.jp: レオナンにハエルのペンダントを渡せ。
description.nl: Bring the pendant from Hael to Reonan.
description.pl: Bring the pendant from Hael to Reonan.
description.ru: Bring the pendant from Hael to Reonan.

dialogsBegin.en: Woahhhh now, everything is finally clear. Hah...Hah... I finally remember... I can't believe this... I recall Reonan now...
dialogsBegin.ar: Woahhhh now, everything is finally clear. Hah...Hah... I finally remember... I can't believe this... I recall Reonan now...
dialogsBegin.br: Woahhhh agora, tudo está finalmente claro. Hah.. Hah.. Eu finalmente me lembro.. Mal posso acreditar.. Eu me lembro de Reonan agora..
dialogsBegin.cns: Woahhhh now, everything is finally clear. Hah...Hah... I finally remember... I can't believe this... I recall Reonan now...
dialogsBegin.de: Woahhhh, jetzt ist endlich alles klar. Hah..Hah.. ich erinnere mich endlich.. Ich kann es nicht glauben... Ich erinnere mich jetzt an Reonan..
dialogsBegin.fi: Woahhhh now, everything is finally clear. Hah...Hah... I finally remember... I can't believe this... I recall Reonan now...
dialogsBegin.fil: Woahhhh now, everything is finally clear. Hah...Hah... I finally remember... I can't believe this... I recall Reonan now...
dialogsBegin.fr: *Regarde dans la vision du futur* Je vois, ce n'est pas vraiment une surprise.
dialogsBegin.id: Woahhhh, semuanya menjadi jelas sekarang. Hah...Hah... Akhirnya aku ingat semua... Tak dapat kupercaya.. Aku mengingat Reonan sekarang..
dialogsBegin.it: Woahhhh now, everything is finally clear. Hah...Hah... I finally remember... I can't believe this... I recall Reonan now...
dialogsBegin.jp: ううっ！　頭が…！　うううう……。
dialogsBegin.kr: 우와아아, 이제야 모든 게 밝혀졌군요. 하...하... 이제야 기억이 나요... 믿을 수가 없어요... 이제야 레오난이 기억나다니...
dialogsBegin.nl: Woahhhh now, everything is finally clear. Hah...Hah... I finally remember... I can't believe this... I recall Reonan now...
dialogsBegin.pl: Woahhhh now, everything is finally clear. Hah...Hah... I finally remember... I can't believe this... I recall Reonan now...
dialogsBegin.ru: Woahhhh now, everything is finally clear. Hah...Hah... I finally remember... I can't believe this... I recall Reonan now...
dialogsBegin.sp: Wuahhhh ahora, ya está todo claro. Ja... Ja... Al fin recuerdo.. No me lo puedo creer... Ya me acuerdo de Reonan...
dialogsBegin.sw: Woahhhh now, everything is finally clear. Hah...Hah... I finally remember... I can't believe this... I recall Reonan now...
dialogsBegin.th: โอ้ววว ตอนนี้ทุกอย่างชัดเจนมาก .. ในที่สุดฉันก็จำได้ .. ฉันไม่สามารถเชื่อได้ .. ฉันจำ Reonan ได้แล้ว ..
dialogsBegin.tw: 哇啊啊……現在一切終於都清楚了。哈……哈……我終於想起來了……真不敢相信……我想起雷奧南了……
dialogsBegin.vi: Woahhhh bây giờ, mọi thứ cuối cùng đã rõ ràng. Hah..Hah .. Cuối cùng thì tôi cũng nhớ ra .. Tôi không thể tin được .. Bây giờ tôi đã nhớ ra Reonan rồi ..

dialogsBegin.en: We were once good friends who stood together against a great threat… only at that time… we went by different names… I'm sure you will understand in time.
dialogsBegin.ar: We were once good friends who stood together against a great threat… only at that time… we went by different names… I'm sure you will understand in time.
dialogsBegin.br: Nós já fomos bons amigos, lutamos juntos contra uma grande ameaça tempos atrás... só que naquela época... nós tínhamos nomes diferentes... eu tenho certeza que você vai entender com o tempo.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我们曾是一起对抗邪恶威胁的非常要好的朋友..只是那段时间...我们使用了不同的名字...我相信你会马上理解的。
dialogsBegin.de: Wir waren einst gute Freunde, die gemeinsam gegen eine große Bedrohung kämpften... nur damals... trugen wir verschiedene Namen... Ich bin sicher, ihr werdet es mit der Zeit verstehen.
dialogsBegin.fi: We were once good friends who stood together against a great threat… only at that time… we went by different names… I'm sure you will understand in time.
dialogsBegin.fil: We were once good friends who stood together against a great threat… only at that time… we went by different names… I'm sure you will understand in time.
dialogsBegin.fr: Selon cette vision, je sortirai vivant de cette mission.
dialogsBegin.id: Kita pernah menjadi teman baik yang berdiri bersama melawan ancaman besar... hanya pada saat itu... kita berdiri dengan nama yang berbeda... aku yakin kau akan paham nanti.
dialogsBegin.it: We were once good friends who stood together against a great threat… only at that time… we went by different names… I'm sure you will understand in time.
dialogsBegin.jp: ああ……何ということだ。ようやく思い出したぞ。そうだ……レオナン。私はかつての友人のことを忘れてしまっていたなんて……。
dialogsBegin.kr: 우린 한때 좋은 친구들이었고, 크나큰 위협에 맞서 함께 싸웠어요... 그 시절엔... 지금과는 다른 이름으로 불렸죠... 시간이 지나면 당신도 이게 무슨 소린지 알게 될 겁니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: We were once good friends who stood together against a great threat… only at that time… we went by different names… I'm sure you will understand in time.
dialogsBegin.pl: We were once good friends who stood together against a great threat… only at that time… we went by different names… I'm sure you will understand in time.
dialogsBegin.ru: We were once good friends who stood together against a great threat… only at that time… we went by different names… I'm sure you will understand in time.
dialogsBegin.sp: Hace tiempo éramos buenos amigos y resistimos juntos una gran amenaza... sólo que en ese momento... teníamos diferentes nombres... Estoy seguro de que lo entenderás con el tiempo.
dialogsBegin.sw: We were once good friends who stood together against a great threat… only at that time… we went by different names… I'm sure you will understand in time.
dialogsBegin.th: เราเคยเป็นเพื่อนที่ดีที่ยืนเคียงข้างกับภัยคุกคามที่ยิ่งใหญ่ ... เฉพาะในเวลานั้น ... เราไปตามชื่อที่แตกต่างกัน ... ฉันแน่ใจว่าคุณจะเข้าใจในเวลา
dialogsBegin.tw: 我們曾經是一起對抗巨大威脅的好朋友……只是在那個時候……我們用了不同的名字……我相信你會明白的。
dialogsBegin.vi: Chúng tôi đã từng là những người bạn tốt cùng nhau chống lại một mối đe dọa lớn… chỉ tại thời điểm đó… chúng tôi đi bằng những cái tên khác nhau… Tôi chắc rằng bạn sẽ hiểu thôi.

dialogsBegin.en: Here, take this to Reonan. It's a pendant once shared amongst several old comrades… He'll understand when he sees it…
dialogsBegin.ar: Here, take this to Reonan. It's a pendant once shared amongst several old comrades… He'll understand when he sees it…
dialogsBegin.br: Aqui, leve isso para Reonan. É um pingente que já foi compartilhado entre vários antigos camaradas… Ele vai entender quando o vir…
dialogsBegin.cns: 给你，把这个交给瑞尔南。这是曾经的战友都佩戴过的一条项链...当他看见这个的时候他会明白的...
dialogsBegin.de: Hier, bring das zu Reonan. Es ist ein Anhänger, der einst von mehreren alten Kameraden geteilt wurde... Er wird es verstehen, wenn er es sieht...
dialogsBegin.fi: Here, take this to Reonan. It's a pendant once shared amongst several old comrades… He'll understand when he sees it…
dialogsBegin.fil: Here, take this to Reonan. It's a pendant once shared amongst several old comrades… He'll understand when he sees it…
dialogsBegin.fr: Retournez voir Reonan et dites-lui que je viendrai me battre pour lui dès que j'aurai terminé mon travail.
dialogsBegin.id: Berikan ini kepada Reonan. Ini adalah pendant yang pernah dibagikan di antara beberapa kawan lama... Dia akan mengerti ketika dia melihatnya...
dialogsBegin.it: Here, take this to Reonan. It's a pendant once shared amongst several old comrades… He'll understand when he sees it…
dialogsBegin.jp: さあ、このペンダントをレオナンに渡してくれ。私はまだやらねばならないことがある。しかし、レオナンならこの意味がわかるはずだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이걸 레오난에게 전해 주세요. 오랜 전우들끼리 나눴던 펜던트인데... 분명 바로 알아볼 거예요...
dialogsBegin.nl: Here, take this to Reonan. It's a pendant once shared amongst several old comrades… He'll understand when he sees it…
dialogsBegin.pl: Here, take this to Reonan. It's a pendant once shared amongst several old comrades… He'll understand when he sees it…
dialogsBegin.ru: Here, take this to Reonan. It's a pendant once shared amongst several old comrades… He'll understand when he sees it…
dialogsBegin.sp: Toma, llévale esto a Reonan. Es un colgante que una vez compartimos varios viejos camaradas... Lo entenderá cuando lo vea...
dialogsBegin.sw: Here, take this to Reonan. It's a pendant once shared amongst several old comrades… He'll understand when he sees it…
dialogsBegin.th: ไปที่ Reonan เป็นจี้ที่เคยมีในหมู่เพื่อนเก่าหลายคน ... เขาจะเข้าใจเมื่อเขาเห็นมัน ...ไปที่ Reonan เป็นจี้ที่เคยมีในหมู่เพื่อนเก่าหลายคน ... เขาจะเข้าใจเมื่อเขาเห็นมัน ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 來，把這個交給雷奧南。是幾位老戰友曾經分享過的吊墜……他看到了就明白了……
dialogsBegin.vi: Đây, đưa cái này cho Reonan. Đó là một mặt dây chuyền từng được chia sẻ giữa một số đồng đội cũ… Anh ấy sẽ hiểu khi anh ấy nhìn thấy nó…

dialogsAccept.en: As for now, I have business to attend to. I will catch up with you guys later. Try not to miss me too much and stuff *sneer*
dialogsAccept.ar: As for now, I have business to attend to. I will catch up with you guys later. Try not to miss me too much and stuff *sneer*
dialogsAccept.br: Agora, tenho negócios a tratar. Me encontrarei com vocês mais tarde. Tentem não sentir muito a minha falta e outras coisas *zomba*
dialogsAccept.cns: 至于现在，我还有事情需要处理。我之后会赶上你们的。尽量不要太想我了 *嘲笑声*
dialogsAccept.de: Jetzt muss ich mich erst einmal um meine Geschäfte kümmern. Ich werde mich später bei euch melden. Versucht, mich nicht zu sehr zu vermissen und so *sneer*
dialogsAccept.fi: As for now, I have business to attend to. I will catch up with you guys later. Try not to miss me too much and stuff *sneer*
dialogsAccept.fil: As for now, I have business to attend to. I will catch up with you guys later. Try not to miss me too much and stuff *sneer*
dialogsAccept.fr: J'espère que vous vous joindrez à la bataille.
dialogsAccept.id: Untuk saat ini, saya memiliki urusan yang harus saya urus. Saya akan menyusul kalian nanti. Cobalah untuk tidak terlalu merindukanku secara berlebihan *mencibir*
dialogsAccept.it: As for now, I have business to attend to. I will catch up with you guys later. Try not to miss me too much and stuff *sneer*
dialogsAccept.jp: いつか私達は共に闘うだろう。その時は君も一緒に闘えるとよいな。
dialogsAccept.kr: 지금은 처리할 일이 있어서요. 나중에 다시 얘기하죠. 제가 너무 보고 싶더라도 좀 참으세요. *씨익*
dialogsAccept.nl: As for now, I have business to attend to. I will catch up with you guys later. Try not to miss me too much and stuff *sneer*
dialogsAccept.pl: As for now, I have business to attend to. I will catch up with you guys later. Try not to miss me too much and stuff *sneer*
dialogsAccept.ru: As for now, I have business to attend to. I will catch up with you guys later. Try not to miss me too much and stuff *sneer*
dialogsAccept.sp: Por ahora, tengo asuntos que atender. Me pondré al día con vosotros más tarde. Intenta no echarme demasiado de menos y esas cosas. *burla*
dialogsAccept.sw: As for now, I have business to attend to. I will catch up with you guys later. Try not to miss me too much and stuff *sneer*
dialogsAccept.th: สำหรับตอนนี้ฉันมีธุระในการเข้าร่วม ฉันจะติดต่อกับพวกคุณในภายหลัง พยายามอย่าคิดถึงฉันมากเกินไปและสิ่งที่เย้ยหยัน *
dialogsAccept.tw: 至於現在，我有事要處理。稍後我會趕上你們的。不要太想我喔   *冷笑*
dialogsAccept.vi: Còn bây giờ, tôi có việc phải làm. Tôi sẽ bắt kịp với các bạn sau. Cố gắng đừng nhớ tôi quá nhiều và những thứ * như vậy *

dialogsDecline.en: Well, I'm in no real hurry. Just take the pendant to Reonan whenever you have the chance.
dialogsDecline.ar: Well, I'm in no real hurry. Just take the pendant to Reonan whenever you have the chance.
dialogsDecline.br: Bem, não estou com muita pressa. Leve o pingente para Reonan quando tiver tempo.
dialogsDecline.cns: 我现在也不着急。当你有时间的时候就把项链带给瑞尔南就行了。
dialogsDecline.de: Nun, ich habe es nicht wirklich eilig. Bringen Sie den Anhänger einfach zu Reonan, wenn Sie die Gelegenheit dazu haben.
dialogsDecline.fi: Well, I'm in no real hurry. Just take the pendant to Reonan whenever you have the chance.
dialogsDecline.fil: Well, I'm in no real hurry. Just take the pendant to Reonan whenever you have the chance.
dialogsDecline.fr: Oh, vous avez plus important à faire ?
dialogsDecline.id: Aku tidak terburu-buru. Bawa saja liontin itu ke Reonan kapan pun kau memiliki kesempatan.
dialogsDecline.it: Well, I'm in no real hurry. Just take the pendant to Reonan whenever you have the chance.
dialogsDecline.jp: そうか……せっかく君の力になれると思ったのだが……。
dialogsDecline.kr: 뭐, 서두를 필요는 없죠. 시간이 될 때 레오난에게 펜던트를 전해 주세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Well, I'm in no real hurry. Just take the pendant to Reonan whenever you have the chance.
dialogsDecline.pl: Well, I'm in no real hurry. Just take the pendant to Reonan whenever you have the chance.
dialogsDecline.ru: Well, I'm in no real hurry. Just take the pendant to Reonan whenever you have the chance.
dialogsDecline.sp: Bueno, no tengo mucha prisa. Llévale el colgante a Reonan cuando tengas la oportunidad.
dialogsDecline.sw: Well, I'm in no real hurry. Just take the pendant to Reonan whenever you have the chance.
dialogsDecline.th: ดีฉันไม่รีบร้อนจริงๆ เพียงแค่เอาจี้ไป Reonan เมื่อใดก็ตามที่คุณมีโอกาส
dialogsDecline.tw: 好吧，我並不著急。只要有機會，就將吊墜帶到雷奧南。
dialogsDecline.vi: Chà, tôi không vội đâu. Chỉ cần mang mặt dây chuyền đến Reonan bất cứ khi nào bạn có cơ hội.

dialogsComplete.en: This pendant… It was a symbol of the trust that I once shared with Hael. I've been hoping to find him for awhile now to no avail…
dialogsComplete.ar: This pendant… It was a symbol of the trust that I once shared with Hael. I've been hoping to find him for awhile now to no avail…
dialogsComplete.br: Este pingente... Era um símbolo de confiança que uma vez compartilhei com Hael. Estava tentando encontrá-lo há algum tempo sem sucesso…
dialogsComplete.cns: 这条项链...这是我曾和海尔分享的信任的象征。我一直希望能找到他，但却找不到…
dialogsComplete.de: Dieser Anhänger... Er war ein Symbol für das Vertrauen, das ich einst mit Hael teilte. Ich habe schon eine Weile gehofft, ihn zu finden, ohne Erfolg...
dialogsComplete.fi: This pendant… It was a symbol of the trust that I once shared with Hael. I've been hoping to find him for awhile now to no avail…
dialogsComplete.fil: This pendant… It was a symbol of the trust that I once shared with Hael. I've been hoping to find him for awhile now to no avail…
dialogsComplete.fr: Vous avez recruté un combattant redoutable. Parfait !
dialogsComplete.id: Liontin ini... Itu adalah simbol kepercayaan yang pernah saya bagikan dengan Hael. Saya telah berharap untuk menemukannya untuk sementara waktu meski tidak berhasil...
dialogsComplete.it: This pendant… It was a symbol of the trust that I once shared with Hael. I've been hoping to find him for awhile now to no avail…
dialogsComplete.jp: おお……これは、私達が共に闘う時に身に着けていたペンダントだ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이 펜던트는… 한때 제가 하엘과 나눴던 신뢰의 상징이군요. 오랫동안 그를 찾았는데도 여전히 소식이 없네요...
dialogsComplete.nl: This pendant… It was a symbol of the trust that I once shared with Hael. I've been hoping to find him for awhile now to no avail…
dialogsComplete.pl: This pendant… It was a symbol of the trust that I once shared with Hael. I've been hoping to find him for awhile now to no avail…
dialogsComplete.ru: This pendant… It was a symbol of the trust that I once shared with Hael. I've been hoping to find him for awhile now to no avail…
dialogsComplete.sp: Este colgante... Era un símbolo de la confianza que una vez compartí con Hael. Esperaba reunirme con él un rato pero...
dialogsComplete.sw: This pendant… It was a symbol of the trust that I once shared with Hael. I've been hoping to find him for awhile now to no avail…
dialogsComplete.th: จี้นี้ ... เป็นสัญลักษณ์ของความไว้วางใจที่เคยร่วมกับ Hael ฉันหวังว่าจะได้พบเขาวันหนึ่ง
dialogsComplete.tw: 這個吊墜……這是我曾經與哈爾分享的信任的象徵。我一直希望找到他有一段時間了，但無濟於事……
dialogsComplete.vi: Mặt dây chuyền này… Nó là biểu tượng của sự tin tưởng mà tôi đã từng chia sẻ với Hael. Tôi đã hy vọng tìm thấy anh ấy từ nãy giờ nhưng vô ích…

dialogsFail.en: Take the pendant to Reonan soon. I didn't give it to you as a keepsake.
dialogsFail.ar: Take the pendant to Reonan soon. I didn't give it to you as a keepsake.
dialogsFail.br: Leve o pingente para Reonan em breve. Não te dei como lembrança.
dialogsFail.cns: 尽快将这条项链带给瑞尔南。我并不是把这个给你当作纪念品的。
dialogsFail.de: Bring den Anhänger bald zu Reonan. Ich habe ihn dir nicht als Andenken geschenkt.
dialogsFail.fi: Take the pendant to Reonan soon. I didn't give it to you as a keepsake.
dialogsFail.fil: Take the pendant to Reonan soon. I didn't give it to you as a keepsake.
dialogsFail.fr: Parlez à Reonan.
dialogsFail.id: Segera bawa liontin itu ke Reonan. Saya tidak memberikannya kepadamu sebagai kenang-kenangan.
dialogsFail.it: Take the pendant to Reonan soon. I didn't give it to you as a keepsake.
dialogsFail.jp: レオナンはフラリスにいるのか。久しぶりに会いたいものだ。
dialogsFail.kr: 레오난에게 얼른 펜던트를 전해 주세요. 기념품으로 드린 게 아니라고요.
dialogsFail.nl: Take the pendant to Reonan soon. I didn't give it to you as a keepsake.
dialogsFail.pl: Take the pendant to Reonan soon. I didn't give it to you as a keepsake.
dialogsFail.ru: Take the pendant to Reonan soon. I didn't give it to you as a keepsake.
dialogsFail.sp: Llévale el colgante a Reonan pronto. No te lo he dado como recuerdo.
dialogsFail.sw: Take the pendant to Reonan soon. I didn't give it to you as a keepsake.
dialogsFail.th: นำจี้ไปให้ Reonan เร็ว ๆ นี้ ฉันไม่ได้ให้มันเป็นของที่ระลึก
dialogsFail.tw: 盡快把吊墜帶給雷奧南，我並不是把它給你作為紀念品喔。
dialogsFail.vi: Mang mặt dây chuyền đến Reonan nhé. Tôi đã không đưa nó cho bạn như một vật kỷ niệm.

dialogsBegin.en: I apologize but I have no time to talk. I have to figure a way to rescue that boy and I'm afraid the at time is limited.
dialogsBegin.ar: I apologize but I have no time to talk. I have to figure a way to rescue that boy and I'm afraid the at time is limited.
dialogsBegin.br: Peço desculpas, mas não tenho tempo para falar. Eu tenho que descobrir uma maneira de resgatar aquele garoto e temo que o tempo esteja escasso.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我很抱歉，顾不上和你说话了。我必须想办法救出那个男孩，时间有限。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich bitte um Entschuldigung, aber ich habe keine Zeit zum Reden. Ich muss einen Weg finden, den Jungen zu retten, und ich fürchte, die Zeit ist begrenzt.
dialogsBegin.fi: I apologize but I have no time to talk. I have to figure a way to rescue that boy and I'm afraid the at time is limited.
dialogsBegin.fil: I apologize but I have no time to talk. I have to figure a way to rescue that boy and I'm afraid the at time is limited.
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous ne voyez pas que je suis occupé, là ? Je cherche à libérer le garçon de la prison.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya minta maaf tetapi saya tidak punya waktu untuk berbicara. Saya harus mencari cara untuk menyelamatkan anak laki-laki itu dan saya khawatir waktunya terbatas.
dialogsBegin.it: I apologize but I have no time to talk. I have to figure a way to rescue that boy and I'm afraid the at time is limited.
dialogsBegin.jp: 残念ながら私はいま忙しいのだ。あの監獄に閉じ込められている少年を救い出さねばならないからな。
dialogsBegin.kr: 미안하지만 지금은 대화할 시간이 없어요. 저 아이를 구할 방법을 찾아야 하는데 시간이 많지 않거든요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I apologize but I have no time to talk. I have to figure a way to rescue that boy and I'm afraid the at time is limited.
dialogsBegin.pl: I apologize but I have no time to talk. I have to figure a way to rescue that boy and I'm afraid the at time is limited.
dialogsBegin.ru: I apologize but I have no time to talk. I have to figure a way to rescue that boy and I'm afraid the at time is limited.
dialogsBegin.sp: Lo siento pero no tengo tiempo para hablar. Tengo que encontrar una manera de rescatar a ese chico y me temo que el tiempo se acaba.
dialogsBegin.sw: I apologize but I have no time to talk. I have to figure a way to rescue that boy and I'm afraid the at time is limited.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันขอโทษ แต่ฉันไม่มีเวลามาก ฉันต้องคิดหาหนทางที่จะช่วยเหลือเด็กคนนั้น และฉันกลัวว่ามันมีเวลาจำกัด
dialogsBegin.tw: 現在我有一點忙，所以你不要在這裡。嗯，我現在真的很忙，你有看到需要我幫助的少年就被關在那裡嗎？我必須救出那個少年，所以你去找你的事情做吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi xin lỗi nhưng tôi không có thời gian để nói chuyện. Tôi phải tìm cách giải cứu cậu bé đó và tôi sợ thời gian có hạn.

dialogsBegin.en: At any moment the Steam Walker that put the boy there might return, so I must keep an ever vigilant watch! Maybe you COULD help me?
dialogsBegin.ar: At any moment the Steam Walker that put the boy there might return, so I must keep an ever vigilant watch! Maybe you COULD help me?
dialogsBegin.br: A qualquer momento o Andarilho a Vapor que colocou o menino lá pode retornar, então devo ficar de olho e me manter sempre vigilante! Talvez você pudesse me ajudar?
dialogsBegin.cns: At any moment the Steam Walker that put the boy there might return, so I must keep an ever vigilant watch! Maybe you COULD help me?
dialogsBegin.de: Der Steamwalker, der den Jungen dorthin gebracht hat, könnte jeden Moment zurückkehren, also muss ich ständig wachsam sein! Vielleicht KANNST du mir helfen?
dialogsBegin.fi: At any moment the Steam Walker that put the boy there might return, so I must keep an ever vigilant watch! Maybe you COULD help me?
dialogsBegin.fil: At any moment the Steam Walker that put the boy there might return, so I must keep an ever vigilant watch! Maybe you COULD help me?
dialogsBegin.fr: À tout moment, le marcheur à vapeur qui a mis le garçon là peut revenir, alors je dois rester vigilant ! Peut-être pourriez-vous m'aider ?
dialogsBegin.id: Setiap saat Steamwalker yang menempatkan bocah itu di sana mungkin akan kembali, jadi saya harus terus waspada! Mungkin kamu BISA membantu saya?
dialogsBegin.it: At any moment the Steam Walker that put the boy there might return, so I must keep an ever vigilant watch! Maybe you COULD help me?
dialogsBegin.jp: むむ……君もしつこいな。そんなに私に用があるならまず少年を助けることから手伝ってはくれないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 저 소년을 가둔 스팀 워커가 언제 다시 돌아올지 모르니, 계속 경계하고 있어야겠어요! 저를 도와주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: At any moment the Steam Walker that put the boy there might return, so I must keep an ever vigilant watch! Maybe you COULD help me?
dialogsBegin.pl: W każdej chwili Parochodziarz, który umieścił tam chłopca, może wrócić, więc muszę mieć zawsze czujny! Może mógłbyś mi pomóc?
dialogsBegin.ru: At any moment the Steam Walker that put the boy there might return, so I must keep an ever vigilant watch! Maybe you COULD help me?
dialogsBegin.sp: En cualquier momento, el Caminante Vapor que puso al niño allí podría regresar, ¡así que debo estar siempre atento! ¿Quizás PODRÍAS ayudarme?
dialogsBegin.sw: At any moment the Steam Walker that put the boy there might return, so I must keep an ever vigilant watch! Maybe you COULD help me?
dialogsBegin.th: ในขณะที่ Steam Walker จะกลับมาอีก ดังนั้นฉันต้องเฝ้าระวังอย่างไม่ลดละ! บางทีคุณอาจช่วยฉันได้?
dialogsBegin.tw: 把那個孩子關在裡面的蒸氣機械隨時都可能回來，所以我必須一直保持警戒！也許你真的可以幫上忙？
dialogsBegin.vi: Con Steamwalker đã mang cậu bé đến đó có thể quay trở lại đây bất cứ lúc nào, vì vậy tôi phải luôn đề phòng! Bạn CÓ THỂ giúp tôi không?

dialogsBegin.en: How about this? While I secure the perimeter, you acquire a key to open the prison door. Deal?
dialogsBegin.ar: How about this? While I secure the perimeter, you acquire a key to open the prison door. Deal?
dialogsBegin.br: Que tal fazermos da seguinte maneira: enquanto eu seguro o perímetro, você adquire uma chave para abrir as grades da prisão. O que acha?
dialogsBegin.cns: 这样好吗？在我保护周边环境的同时，你获得一把钥匙来打开监狱的门。成交吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Wie wäre es damit? Während ich die Umgebung sichere, besorgst du dir einen Schlüssel, um die Gefängnistür zu öffnen. Abgemacht?
dialogsBegin.fi: How about this? While I secure the perimeter, you acquire a key to open the prison door. Deal?
dialogsBegin.fil: How about this? While I secure the perimeter, you acquire a key to open the prison door. Deal?
dialogsBegin.fr: Je vais faire le guet ici et vous vous chargez des Steamwalker.
dialogsBegin.id: Bagaimana dengan ini? Sementara saya mengamankan perimeter, Anda mendapatkan kunci untuk membuka pintu penjara. Setuju?
dialogsBegin.it: How about this? While I secure the perimeter, you acquire a key to open the prison door. Deal?
dialogsBegin.jp: 私はここで監視を続ける。君はその隙に少年が閉じ込められている監獄の鍵を入手するのだ。できるか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 이건 어때요? 제가 주변 지역을 감시하는 동안, 당신이 감옥 문을 열 열쇠를 구해오는 거죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: How about this? While I secure the perimeter, you acquire a key to open the prison door. Deal?
dialogsBegin.pl: How about this? While I secure the perimeter, you acquire a key to open the prison door. Deal?
dialogsBegin.ru: How about this? While I secure the perimeter, you acquire a key to open the prison door. Deal?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Qué te parece este plan? Mientras aseguro el perímetro, tú consigues la llave para abrir la puerta de la prisión. ¿Vale?
dialogsBegin.sw: How about this? While I secure the perimeter, you acquire a key to open the prison door. Deal?
dialogsBegin.th: ทำยังไงดีเกี่ยวกับเรื่องนี้? คุณจะได้รับกุญแจสำคัญในการเปิดประตู จัดการได้ไหม ?
dialogsBegin.tw: 我在這裡監視的期間，你有辦法將可以打開監獄的門的鑰匙拿過來嗎？怎麼樣呢？
dialogsBegin.vi: Còn cái này thì sao? Trong khi tôi bảo vệ chu vi, bạn có được chìa khóa để mở cửa nhà tù. Thỏa thuận?

dialogsAccept.fil: Great! While I secure the area, quickly retrieve a key from one of the Steam Walkers!
dialogsAccept.fr: Génial ! Pendant que je sécurise la zone, récupérez rapidement une clé sur l'un des Steamwalkers !
