dialogsAccept.it: Great! While I secure the area, quickly retrieve a key from one of the Steam Walkers!
dialogsAccept.jp: すごい！私がエリアを確保している間に、スチームウォーカーの1人から鍵をすぐに取り出してください!
dialogsAccept.kr: 좋아요! 제가 이곳을 지킬 테니, 빨리 스팀 워커들을 처치하고 열쇠를 가져오세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Great! While I secure the area, quickly retrieve a key from one of the Steam Walkers!
dialogsAccept.pl: Świetnie! Podczas gdy ja zabezpieczę teren, Ty odzyskaj szybko klucz od jednego z Parochodziarzy!
dialogsAccept.ru: Great! While I secure the area, quickly retrieve a key from one of the Steam Walkers!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Genial! Mientras aseguro el área, ¡recupera rápidamente una llave de un Caminate Vapor!
dialogsAccept.sw: Great! While I secure the area, quickly retrieve a key from one of the Steam Walkers!
dialogsAccept.th: เยี่ยม!! ในขณะที่ฉันรักษาความปลอดภัยในพื้นที่นี้ รีบไปเอากุญแจคืนจาก Steam Walkers เร็วๆ!
dialogsAccept.tw: 太好了！我來守住這一帶，你快去從蒸氣機械身上拿到鑰匙！
dialogsAccept.vi: Tuyệt vời! Trong khi tôi bảo vệ khu vực này, bạn hãy nhanh chóng lấy chìa khóa từ một trong các Steam Walkers!

dialogsDecline.en: If you won't help me then I have no time to deal with you!
dialogsDecline.ar: If you won't help me then I have no time to deal with you!
dialogsDecline.br: Se você não vai me ajudar, então eu não tenho tempo para lidar com você!
dialogsDecline.cns: 如果你不帮我，那么我就没有时间来对付你了！
dialogsDecline.de: Wenn Sie mir nicht helfen wollen, habe ich keine Zeit, mich mit Ihnen zu befassen!
dialogsDecline.fi: If you won't help me then I have no time to deal with you!
dialogsDecline.fil: If you won't help me then I have no time to deal with you!
dialogsDecline.fr: Si vous ne voulez pas m'aider vous pouvez repartir d'où vous venez !
dialogsDecline.id: Jika Anda tidak mau membantu saya maka saya tidak punya waktu untuk berurusan dengan Anda!
dialogsDecline.it: If you won't help me then I have no time to deal with you!
dialogsDecline.jp: ふん、それならどいてくれ。私は忙しいのだ！
dialogsDecline.kr: 도와줄 생각 없다면, 저도 상대할 시간 없어요!
dialogsDecline.nl: If you won't help me then I have no time to deal with you!
dialogsDecline.pl: If you won't help me then I have no time to deal with you!
dialogsDecline.ru: If you won't help me then I have no time to deal with you!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Si no me vas a ayudar, no tengo tiempo para perder contigo!
dialogsDecline.sw: If you won't help me then I have no time to deal with you!
dialogsDecline.th: ถ้าคุณไม่ช่วยฉัน ฉันก็ไม่มีเวลาให้คุณหรอก!
dialogsDecline.tw: 如果你不幫忙，就不要在這裡妨礙我。
dialogsDecline.vi: Nếu bạn không giúp tôi thì tôi không có thời gian để đàm phán với bạn!

dialogsComplete.en: Huzzah! Mission accomplished. Good thing I was here. Who knows what might have happened. Anyway! Time for phase 2!
dialogsComplete.ar: Huzzah! Mission accomplished. Good thing I was here. Who knows what might have happened. Anyway! Time for phase 2!
dialogsComplete.br: Ihaaah! Missão cumprida. Ainda bem que eu estava aqui. Quem sabe o que poderia ter acontecido. De qualquer forma! Hora da fase 2!
dialogsComplete.cns: 欢呼吧! 任务完成了。幸亏我在这里。要不然谁知道可能会发生什么。不管怎么说! 是时候进行第二阶段了!
dialogsComplete.de: Hurra! Mission erfüllt. Gut, dass ich hier war. Wer weiß, was sonst passiert wäre. Wie auch immer! Zeit für Phase 2!
dialogsComplete.fi: Huzzah! Mission accomplished. Good thing I was here. Who knows what might have happened. Anyway! Time for phase 2!
dialogsComplete.fil: Huzzah! Mission accomplished. Good thing I was here. Who knows what might have happened. Anyway! Time for phase 2!
dialogsComplete.fr: Vous l'avez ? Parfait, libérons ce gosse et partons d'ici !
dialogsComplete.id: Huzzah! Misi tercapai. Untung saya ada di sini. Siapa yang tahu apa yang mungkin terjadi. Anyway! Saatnya fase 2!
dialogsComplete.it: Huzzah! Mission accomplished. Good thing I was here. Who knows what might have happened. Anyway! Time for phase 2!
dialogsComplete.jp: お、本当に見つけてきてくれたのか。ふむ、少しは君もやるようだな。
dialogsComplete.kr: 오오, 임무 완수군요. 제가 여기 있어서 다행이네요. 무슨 일이 벌어졌을지도 모르잖아요. 자, 이제 2단계로 넘어갈까요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Huzzah! Mission accomplished. Good thing I was here. Who knows what might have happened. Anyway! Time for phase 2!
dialogsComplete.pl: Huzzah! Mission accomplished. Good thing I was here. Who knows what might have happened. Anyway! Time for phase 2!
dialogsComplete.ru: Huzzah! Mission accomplished. Good thing I was here. Who knows what might have happened. Anyway! Time for phase 2!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Hurra! Misión cumplida. Menos mal que estaba aquí. Quién sabe lo que podría haber pasado. ¡Y ahora! ¡Pasamos a la fase 2!
dialogsComplete.sw: Huzzah! Mission accomplished. Good thing I was here. Who knows what might have happened. Anyway! Time for phase 2!
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสมบูรณ์. สิ่งที่ดีก็คือ ฉันยังอยู่ที่นี่ ใครจะรู้ว่าอาจจะเกิดอะไรขึ้น อย่างไรก็ตาม! เวลาสำหรับเฟส 2!
dialogsComplete.tw: 好啊！任務完成了。幸好有我在，誰知道會發生什麼事。總之！該進入第 2 階段了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Huzzah! Hoàn thành nhiệm vụ. Điều tốt là tôi đã ở đây. Ai biết điều gì có thể đã xảy ra. Dẫu sao thì! Thời gian cho giai đoạn 2!

dialogsFail.en: Quickly! Quickly! Retrieve the prison key from one of the Steam Walkers! We may not have much time!
dialogsFail.ar: Quickly! Quickly! Retrieve the prison key from one of the Steam Walkers! We may not have much time!
dialogsFail.br: Rápido! Rápido! Recupere a chave da prisão de um dos Andarilhos a Vapor! Não temos muito tempo!
dialogsFail.cns: Quickly! Quickly! Retrieve the prison key from one of the Steam Walkers! We may not have much time!
dialogsFail.de: Schnell! Schnell, schnell! Hol den Gefängnisschlüssel von einem der Steamwalker! Wir haben wahrscheinlich nicht mehr viel Zeit!
dialogsFail.fi: Quickly! Quickly! Retrieve the prison key from one of the Steam Walkers! We may not have much time!
dialogsFail.fil: Quickly! Quickly! Retrieve the prison key from one of the Steam Walkers! We may not have much time!
dialogsFail.fr: Vite ! Vite ! Récupérez la clé de la prison sur l'un des Steamwalkers ! Nous n'avons peut-être pas beaucoup de temps !
dialogsFail.id: Cepat! Cepat! Ambil kunci penjara dari salah satu Steamwalker! Kita tidak punya banyak waktu!
dialogsFail.it: Quickly! Quickly! Retrieve the prison key from one of the Steam Walkers! We may not have much time!
dialogsFail.jp: 監獄の鍵は見つかったか？　何？　事は急を要するのだ。頼むぞ！
dialogsFail.kr: 빨리요! 빨리요! 스팀 워커들을 처치하고 감옥 열쇠를 찾으세요! 시간이 별로 없어요!
dialogsFail.nl: Quickly! Quickly! Retrieve the prison key from one of the Steam Walkers! We may not have much time!
dialogsFail.pl: Szybko! Szybko! Odbierz klucz więzienny od jednego z Parochodziarzy! Możemy nie mieć dużo czasu!
dialogsFail.ru: Quickly! Quickly! Retrieve the prison key from one of the Steam Walkers! We may not have much time!
dialogsFail.sp: ¡Rápido!¡Rápido!¡Recupera la llave de la prisión de un Caminante Vapor! ¡Puede que no tengamos mucho tiempo!
dialogsFail.sw: Quickly! Quickly! Retrieve the prison key from one of the Steam Walkers! We may not have much time!
dialogsFail.th: เร็กว่านี้! เร็วกว่านี้อีก! เอากุญแจคืนจาก Steam Walkers ! พวกเรามีเวลาไม่มาก!
dialogsFail.tw: 快！快一點！去從蒸氣機械身上拿到牢房鑰匙！我們可能沒有多少時間了！
dialogsFail.vi: Nhanh lên! Nhanh lên! Nhanh lấy chìa khóa nhà tù từ một trong những Steamwalker! Chúng ta có thể không còn nhiều thời gian đâu!

name.th: ยินดีต้อนรับสู้ Azria! (2)

description.en: Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
description.ar: Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
description.br: Vá e visite Mawrang. Ele é o mais velho e o mais sábio de todos nós. Ele o ajudará a sobreviver no frio.
description.cns: 去拜访玫然。他是我们当中最年长和最睿智的。他会帮助你在寒冷中生存。
description.de: Besuche Mawrang. Er ist der älteste und weiseste von uns allen. Er wird dir helfen, in der Kälte zu überleben.
description.fi: Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
description.fil: Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
description.fr: Allez voir Mawran. C'est le plus vieux et le plus sage de nous tous. Il vous aidera à survivre dans le froid.
description.id: Pergi dan kunjungi Mawrang. Dia adalah yang tertua dan paling bijaksana dari kita semua. Dia akan membantumu bertahan hidup dalam cuaca dingin.
description.it: Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
description.jp: マウランに行ってみましょう。彼は私たちの中で年長で最も賢いです。彼は、あなたが寒さの中で生き残るのを手助けしてくれるでしょう。
description.kr: 마우랑을 찾아가세요. 우리 중 가장 나이가 많고 현명하거든요. 추위 속에서 살아남는 방법을 알려줄 거예요.
description.nl: Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
description.pl: Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
description.ru: Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
description.sp: Visita a Mawrang. Es el más viejo y sabio de todos nosotros. Él te ayudará a sobrevivir en el frío.
description.sw: Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
description.th: ไปหาMawrang เขาเป็นคนที่เก่าแก่และฉลาดที่สุดของเราทุกคน เขาจะช่วยให้คุณรอดพ้นจากความหนาวเย็น
description.tw: 去拜訪馬巫郎，他是我們當中最年長和最聰明的，他會幫助你在寒冷中生存。
description.vi: Đi thăm Mawrang. Ông ấy là người già nhất và khôn ngoan nhất trong chúng ta. Ông ấy sẽ giúp bạn sống sót trong giá lạnh.

dialogsBegin.en: I help protect this small town. Dangerous Masquerpets are everywhere.
dialogsBegin.ar: I help protect this small town. Dangerous Masquerpets are everywhere.
dialogsBegin.br: Eu ajudo a proteger este pequeno vilarejo. Muitos aventureiros como você vêm a este lugar para ficar mais fortes, o vilarejo auxilia e se beneficia dessa interação.
dialogsBegin.cns: 可怕的怪物在虎视眈眈，无惧，这个小镇由我来保护。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich helfe dieses Gebiet zu beschützen. Gefährliche Monster sind überall.
dialogsBegin.fi: I help protect this small town. Dangerous Masquerpets are everywhere.
dialogsBegin.fil: I help protect this small town. Dangerous Masquerpets are everywhere.
dialogsBegin.fr: J'aide à protéger ce petit village. De dangereux monstres rôdent tout autour.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku membantu melindungi kota kecil ini. Masquerpet berbahaya ada di mana-mana.
dialogsBegin.it: I help protect this small town. Dangerous Masquerpets are everywhere.
dialogsBegin.jp: 私はこの小さな町を守る手伝いをしています。危険なモンスターはどこにでもいるんです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 저는 이 작은 마을을 지키고 있어요. 위험한 마스커펫들이 도처에 도사리고 있죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: I help protect this small town. Dangerous Masquerpets are everywhere.
dialogsBegin.pl: I help protect this small town. Dangerous Masquerpets are everywhere.
dialogsBegin.ru: I help protect this small town. Dangerous Masquerpets are everywhere.
dialogsBegin.sp: Ayudo a proteger este pequeño Pueblo. Los Masquerpets están por todas las partes.
dialogsBegin.sw: I help protect this small town. Dangerous Masquerpets are everywhere.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันช่วยปกป้องเมืองเล็กๆ แห่งนี้ Masquerpets อันตรายมีอยู่ทั่วไป
dialogsBegin.tw: 我幫助保護這個小鎮，危險的怪物無處不在。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi giúp bảo vệ thị trấn nhỏ này. Dangerous Masquerpets ở khắp mọi nơi.

dialogsBegin.en: I could use some help fighting them off. If you are interested, feel free to drop by and lend me your assistance.
dialogsBegin.ar: I could use some help fighting them off. If you are interested, feel free to drop by and lend me your assistance.
dialogsBegin.br: Masquerpets perigosos estão por toda parte e toda ajuda é necessária para lutar contra eles. Se você estiver interessado, sinta-se à vontade para passar por aqui e me emprestar sua força.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我需要一些帮手来击退他们。如果你有兴趣，请随时光临并给予帮助。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich kann ein bisschen Hilfe gebrauchen die Monster zu bekämpfen. Wenn du interessiert bist, komm vorbei.
dialogsBegin.fi: I could use some help fighting them off. If you are interested, feel free to drop by and lend me your assistance.
dialogsBegin.fil: I could use some help fighting them off. If you are interested, feel free to drop by and lend me your assistance.
dialogsBegin.fr: J'aurais bien besoin d'un coup de main pour les combattre. Si cela vous dit, n'hésitez pas à venir me voir.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku bisa menggunakan bantuan untuk melawan mereka. Jika kamu tertarik, jangan ragu untuk mampir dan meminjamkanku bantuanmu.
dialogsBegin.it: I could use some help fighting them off. If you are interested, feel free to drop by and lend me your assistance.
dialogsBegin.jp: やつら撃退する手助けをするおつもりがあれば、また立ち寄って力を貸してほしい。
dialogsBegin.kr: 마스커펫의 전투에 도움이 필요한데요. 혹시 흥미가 있으시다면, 언제든 들러 도와주시면 좋겠어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I could use some help fighting them off. If you are interested, feel free to drop by and lend me your assistance.
dialogsBegin.pl: I could use some help fighting them off. If you are interested, feel free to drop by and lend me your assistance.
dialogsBegin.ru: I could use some help fighting them off. If you are interested, feel free to drop by and lend me your assistance.
dialogsBegin.sp: Me vendría bien una ayuda para luchar contra ellos. Si estás interesado, no dudes en unirte y prestar tu ayuda.
dialogsBegin.sw: I could use some help fighting them off. If you are interested, feel free to drop by and lend me your assistance.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันสามารถใช้ความช่วยเหลือบางอย่างในการต่อสู้กับพวกเขา หากคุณสนใจโปรดอย่าลังเลที่จะแวะมาและให้ยืมความช่วยเหลือของคุณ
dialogsBegin.tw: 我可以使用一些協助來擊退他們。如果你有興趣，請隨時光臨並借給我你的協助。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi có thể sử dụng một số trợ giúp để chống lại chúng. Bạn nào quan tâm thì cứ ghé qua cho mình mượn trợ giúp nhé.

dialogsBegin.en: Stay within this town and you will be safe from harm. Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
dialogsBegin.ar: Stay within this town and you will be safe from harm. Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
dialogsBegin.br: Este vilarejo será seu ponto de segurança! Neste continente as temperaturas podem chegar em até -20°C em alguns lugares. Visite Mawrang, ele é o mais velho e o mais sábio de todos nós. Ele pode te ajudar a sobreviver neste frio.
dialogsBegin.cns: 留在这个城镇，你将免受伤害。去拜访玫然。他是我们当中最年长和最睿智的。他会帮助你在寒冷中生存。
dialogsBegin.de: Bleibe in dieser Stadt, hier bist du sicher. Besuche Mawrang. Er ist der älteste und weiseste von uns allen. Er wird dir helfen, in der Kälte zu überleben.
dialogsBegin.fi: Stay within this town and you will be safe from harm. Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
dialogsBegin.fil: Stay within this town and you will be safe from harm. Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
dialogsBegin.fr: Si vous restez dans cette ville, vous serez en sécurité. Allez voir Mawran. C'est le plus vieux et le plus sage de nous tous. Il vous aidera à survivre dans le froid.
dialogsBegin.id: Tetap di dalam kota ini dan Kamu akan aman dari bahaya. Pergi dan kunjungi Mawrang. Dia adalah yang tertua dan paling bijaksana dari kita semua. Dia akan membantumu bertahan hidup dalam cuaca dingin.
dialogsBegin.it: Stay within this town and you will be safe from harm. Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
dialogsBegin.jp: この町にいる限りは安全です。まずはマウランに会ってください。彼は私たちの中で年長で最も賢い方です。彼は寒さの中で生きるすべを教えてくれるはずです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 마을에 머무르는 동안은 안전해요. 마우랑을 찾아가세요. 우리 중 가장 나이가 많고 현명하거든요. 추위 속에서 살아남는 방법을 알려줄 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Stay within this town and you will be safe from harm. Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
dialogsBegin.pl: Stay within this town and you will be safe from harm. Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
dialogsBegin.ru: Stay within this town and you will be safe from harm. Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
dialogsBegin.sp: Quédate dentro de esta ciudad y estarás a salvo. Visita a Mawrang. Es el más viejo y sabio de todos nosotros. Él te ayudará a sobrevivir en el frío.
dialogsBegin.sw: Stay within this town and you will be safe from harm. Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
dialogsBegin.th: อยู่ในเมืองนี้และคุณจะปลอดภัยจากอันตราย ไปทีMawrang เขาเป็นคนที่เก่าแก่และฉลาดที่สุดของเราทุกคน เขาจะช่วยให้คุณรอดพ้นจากความหนาวเย็น
dialogsBegin.tw: 留在這個城鎮，你將免受傷害。去拜訪馬巫郎，他是我們當中最年長和最聰明的，他會幫助你在寒冷中生存。
dialogsBegin.vi: Ở trong thị trấn này và bạn sẽ an toàn không bị tổn hại. Đi thăm Mawrang. Ông ấy là người già nhất và khôn ngoan nhất trong chúng ta. Ông ấy sẽ giúp bạn sống sót trong giá lạnh.

dialogsComplete.en: Welcome, brave warrior. I hope this town serves as your safe haven during your perilous journey here.
dialogsComplete.ar: Welcome, brave warrior. I hope this town serves as your safe haven during your perilous journey here.
dialogsComplete.br: Bem-vindo, bravo guerreiro. Espero que este vilarejo sirva como seu porto seguro durante sua perigosa jornada aqui.
dialogsComplete.cns: 欢迎你，勇士。我希望这个小镇能成为你在这里危险旅程中的避风港。
dialogsComplete.de: Willkommen, mutiger Krieger. Ich hoffe, diese Stadt dient dir als sicherer Hafen während deiner gefährlichen Reise hierher.
dialogsComplete.fi: Welcome, brave warrior. I hope this town serves as your safe haven during your perilous journey here.
dialogsComplete.fil: Welcome, brave warrior. I hope this town serves as your safe haven during your perilous journey here.
dialogsComplete.fr: Bienvenue, brave guerrier. Que ce village soit un havre de paix durant votre séjour dans cette contrée dangereuse.
dialogsComplete.id: Selamat datang, pejuang pemberani. Aku harap kota ini berfungsi sebagai tempat aman bagi selama perjalanan berbahaya kamu di sini.
dialogsComplete.it: Welcome, brave warrior. I hope this town serves as your safe haven during your perilous journey here.
dialogsComplete.jp: ようこそ、勇敢な戦士。危険な旅の間、この町が安全な避難所となることを願っています。
dialogsComplete.kr: 환영합니다, 용감한 전사님. 위험한 여정에서, 이 마을이 잠시나마 안전한 피난처가 되어 주기를.
dialogsComplete.nl: Welcome, brave warrior. I hope this town serves as your safe haven during your perilous journey here.
dialogsComplete.pl: Welcome, brave warrior. I hope this town serves as your safe haven during your perilous journey here.
dialogsComplete.ru: Welcome, brave warrior. I hope this town serves as your safe haven during your perilous journey here.
dialogsComplete.sp: Bienvenido, valiente guerrero. Espero que esta ciudad te sirva de refugio en tu peligroso viaje hasta aquí.
dialogsComplete.sw: Welcome, brave warrior. I hope this town serves as your safe haven during your perilous journey here.
dialogsComplete.th: ยินดีต้อนรับ นักรบผู้กล้า ฉันหวังว่าเมืองนี้จะเป็นที่หลบภัยของคุณในระหว่างการเดินทางที่เต็มไปด้วยอันตรายที่นี่
dialogsComplete.tw: 歡迎，勇敢的戰士。我希望這個小鎮能成為你在這裡危險旅程中的避風港。
dialogsComplete.vi: Chào mừng, chiến binh dũng cảm. Tôi hy vọng thị trấn này là nơi trú ẩn an toàn của bạn trong chuyến hành trình đầy hiểm nguy của bạn ở đây.

dialogsComplete.en: This town could really use your help. We are surrounded in every corner of this continent.
dialogsComplete.ar: This town could really use your help. We are surrounded in every corner of this continent.
dialogsComplete.br: Este vilarejo precisa muito da sua ajuda. Estamos cercados em todos os cantos deste continente.
dialogsComplete.cns: 这个小镇真的需要你的帮助。我们被怪物包围住了。
dialogsComplete.de: Diese Stadt braucht deine Hilfe. Wir sind in jeder Ecke dieses Kontinents umzingelt.
dialogsComplete.fi: This town could really use your help. We are surrounded in every corner of this continent.
dialogsComplete.fil: This town could really use your help. We are surrounded in every corner of this continent.
dialogsComplete.fr: Ce village aurait bien besoin de votre aide. Nous sommes encerclés sur tout le continent.
dialogsComplete.id: Kota ini benar-benar membutuhkan bantuanmu. Kami terkepung di setiap sudut benua ini.
dialogsComplete.it: This town could really use your help. We are surrounded in every corner of this continent.
dialogsComplete.jp: この町にはあなたの助けが必要なのです。この大陸はもう、隅々にまでモンスターが蔓延っているのです。
dialogsComplete.kr: 당신의 도움이 절실히 필요해요. 대륙 끄트머리에 고립된 곳이니까요.
dialogsComplete.nl: This town could really use your help. We are surrounded in every corner of this continent.
dialogsComplete.pl: This town could really use your help. We are surrounded in every corner of this continent.
dialogsComplete.ru: This town could really use your help. We are surrounded in every corner of this continent.
dialogsComplete.sp: Esta ciudad podría necesitar tu ayuda. Estamos rodeados en todos los rincones del continente.
dialogsComplete.sw: This town could really use your help. We are surrounded in every corner of this continent.
dialogsComplete.th: เมืองนี้สามารถช่วยคุณได้จริงๆ เราถูกห้อมล้อมอยู่ทุกมุมของทวีปนี้
dialogsComplete.tw: 這個小鎮真的可以使用你的幫助。在這個大陸的每一個角落裡，我們被包圍。
dialogsComplete.vi: Thị trấn này thực sự có thể sử dụng trợ giúp. Chúng tôi bị bao vây ở mọi ngóc ngách của lục địa này.

dialogsComplete.en: Our people have a lot of hope, but I fear the threat grows stronger and stronger every day.
dialogsComplete.ar: Our people have a lot of hope, but I fear the threat grows stronger and stronger every day.
dialogsComplete.br: Nosso povo tem muita esperança, mas temo que a ameaça fique cada vez mais forte a cada dia.
dialogsComplete.cns: 我们的人民充满希望，但我却惴惴不安，因为威胁每天都在变得越来越强大。
dialogsComplete.de: Unsere Leute haben viel Hoffnung, aber ich fürchte, die Bedrohung wird jeden Tag größer.
dialogsComplete.fi: Our people have a lot of hope, but I fear the threat grows stronger and stronger every day.
dialogsComplete.fil: Our people have a lot of hope, but I fear the threat grows stronger and stronger every day.
dialogsComplete.fr: Notre peuple a beaucoup d'espoir, mais je crains que la menace ne soit de plus en plus forte chaque jour.
dialogsComplete.id: Orang-orang kami memiliki banyak harapan, tetapi aku khawatir ancaman itu tumbuh semakin kuat setiap hari.
dialogsComplete.it: Our people have a lot of hope, but I fear the threat grows stronger and stronger every day.
dialogsComplete.jp: 私たちの人々は多くの希望を持っていますが、脅威が日に日に強くなっているのではないかと心配しています。
dialogsComplete.kr: 마을 주민은 아직 희망을 잃지 않았지만, 외부의 위협이 날로 강해지고 있어 걱정이 커요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Our people have a lot of hope, but I fear the threat grows stronger and stronger every day.
dialogsComplete.pl: Our people have a lot of hope, but I fear the threat grows stronger and stronger every day.
dialogsComplete.ru: Our people have a lot of hope, but I fear the threat grows stronger and stronger every day.
dialogsComplete.sp: Nuestro pueblo tiene mucha esperanza, pero me temo que la amenaza se aumenta cada día.
dialogsComplete.sw: Our people have a lot of hope, but I fear the threat grows stronger and stronger every day.
dialogsComplete.th: คนของเรามีความหวังมากมาย แต่ฉันกลัวว่าภัยคุกคามจะรุนแรงขึ้นเรื่อย ๆ ทุกวัน
dialogsComplete.tw: 我們的人民充滿希望，但我擔心威脅每天都在變得越來越強大。
dialogsComplete.vi: Người dân chúng tôi có rất nhiều hy vọng, nhưng tôi lo sợ mối đe dọa mỗi ngày một mạnh hơn.

dialogsFail.en: Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
dialogsFail.ar: Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
dialogsFail.br: Vá e visite Mawrang. Ele é o mais velho e o mais sábio de todos nós. Ele o ajudará a sobreviver no frio.
dialogsFail.cns: 去拜访玫然。他是我们当中最年长和最睿智的。他会帮助你在寒冷中生存。
dialogsFail.de: Besuche Mawrang. Er ist der älteste und weiseste von uns allen. Er wird dir helfen, in der Kälte zu überleben.
dialogsFail.fi: Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
dialogsFail.fil: Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
dialogsFail.fr: Allez voir Mawran. C'est le plus vieux et le plus sage de nous tous. Il vous aidera à survivre dans le froid.
dialogsFail.id: Pergi dan kunjungi Mawrang. Dia adalah yang tertua dan paling bijaksana dari kita semua. Dia akan membantumu bertahan hidup dalam cuaca dingin.
dialogsFail.it: Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
dialogsFail.jp: マウランに行ってみましょう。彼は私たちの中で年長で最も賢いです。彼は、あなたが寒さの中で生き残るのを手助けしてくれるでしょう。
dialogsFail.kr: 마우랑을 찾아가세요. 우리 중 가장 나이가 많고 현명하거든요. 추위 속에서 살아남는 방법을 알려줄 거예요.
dialogsFail.nl: Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
dialogsFail.pl: Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
dialogsFail.ru: Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
dialogsFail.sp: Visita a Mawrang. Es el más viejo y sabio de todos nosotros. Él te ayudará a sobrevivir en el frío.
dialogsFail.sw: Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
dialogsFail.th: ไปหาMawrang เขาเป็นคนที่เก่าแก่และฉลาดที่สุดของเราทุกคน เขาจะช่วยให้คุณรอดพ้นจากความหนาวเย็น
dialogsFail.tw: 去拜訪馬巫郎，他是我們當中最年長和最聰明的，他會幫助你在寒冷中生存。
dialogsFail.vi: Đi thăm Mawrang. Ông ấy là người già nhất và khôn ngoan nhất trong chúng ta. Ông ấy sẽ giúp bạn sống sót trong giá lạnh.

name.pl: Polowanie na potwory aby odzyskać Karmę
name.sp: Derrota a los Monstruos para recuperar Karma.

description.cns: 为了减少你的罪恶值，你要去击杀 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 回来。
description.de: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ jagen wird dein Karma wiederherstellen.
description.fi: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.fil: Ang Pang-huhuli ng $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ay makakapagpanumbalik ng iyong Karma points.
description.fr: Tu devrais chasser des $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s afin de récupérer les points de Karma.

description.sp: Cazar $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ recuperará tus puntos de Karma.
description.sw: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.th: การล่า $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ จะกู้คืนคะแนน Karma ของคุณ

description.vi: Săn $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ sẽ phục hồi điểm Karma của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsDecline.en: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.ar: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.br: Você ainda tem que pagar pelos seus pecados...
dialogsDecline.cns: 你还没有为你的罪恶付出代价...
dialogsDecline.de: Du musst noch immer für deine Sünden bezahlen...
dialogsDecline.fi: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.fil: Di mo pa bayad ang iyong mga kasalanan…
dialogsDecline.fr: Quand expieras-tu tes nombreux crimes ?
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu belum membayar untuk dosa-dosamu…
dialogsDecline.it: Devi ancora pagare per i tuoi peccati...
dialogsDecline.jp: いつになったら、この底知れぬ罪悪感から抜けられるのだろう？
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신은 아직 죗값을 치르지 않았으니...
dialogsDecline.nl: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.pl: Musisz najpierw zapłacić za swoje grzechy…
dialogsDecline.ru: Велики твои грехи…
dialogsDecline.sp: Todavía tienes que pagar por tus pecados...
dialogsDecline.sw: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.th: คุณยังไม้ได้ชดใช้บาปของคุณ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 你還沒有為你的罪付出代價…
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn vẫn chưa phải trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình…

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.br: Sua missão foi concluída. Seus pecados foram perdoados.
dialogsComplete.cns: 任务完成，你的罪恶已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Buße getan. Deine Sünden wurden dir vergeben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Questmu telah tercapai. Dosa-dosamu telah diampuni.
dialogsComplete.it: La Missione è terminata. I tuoi peccati sono stati perdonati.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 끝났습니다. 당신의 죄를 용서하지요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Боги одобрили твое деяние и простили тебе грехи.
dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น บาปของคุณได้รับการอภัยแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nhiệm vụ của bạn đã được hoàn thành. Tội lỗi của bạn đã được tha thứ.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。

description.en: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.

description.de: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ jagen wird dein Karma wiederherstellen.
description.fi: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.fil: Ang Pang-huhuli ng $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ay makakapagpanumbalik ng iyong Karma points.
description.fr: Tu devrais chasser des $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s afin de récupérer les points de Karma.
description.id: Berburu $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ akan memulihkan poin-poin Karmamu.

description.jp: カルマポイントを回復するため、$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を処罰して来てください。
description.nl: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.pl: Polowanie na $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ pozwoli odzyskać punkty Karmy.
description.ru: Твоя цель - $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, только так ты очистишь карму.
description.sp: Cazar $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ recuperará tus puntos de Karma.
description.sw: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
description.th: การล่า $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ จะกู้คืนคะแนน Karma ของคุณ
description.tw: 狩獵 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 將會恢復你的惡名點數。
description.vi: Săn $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ sẽ phục hồi điểm Karma của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsDecline.en: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.ar: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.br: Você ainda tem que pagar pelos seus pecados...
dialogsDecline.cns: 你还没有为你的罪恶付出代价...
dialogsDecline.de: Du musst noch immer für deine Sünden bezahlen...
dialogsDecline.fi: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.fil: Di mo pa bayad ang iyong mga kasalanan…
dialogsDecline.fr: Quand expieras-tu tes nombreux crimes ?
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu belum membayar untuk dosa-dosamu…
dialogsDecline.it: Devi ancora pagare per i tuoi peccati...
dialogsDecline.jp: いつになったら、この底知れぬ罪悪感から抜けられるのだろう？
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신은 아직 죗값을 치르지 않았으니...
dialogsDecline.nl: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.pl: Musisz najpierw zapłacić za swoje grzechy…
dialogsDecline.ru: Велики твои грехи…
dialogsDecline.sp: Todavía tienes que pagar por tus pecados...
dialogsDecline.sw: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsDecline.th: คุณยังไม้ได้ชดใช้บาปของคุณ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 你還沒有為你的罪付出代價…
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn vẫn chưa phải trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình…

dialogsComplete.en: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.br: Sua missão foi concluída. Seus pecados foram perdoados.
dialogsComplete.cns: 任务完成，你的罪恶已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast Buße getan. Deine Sünden wurden dir vergeben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ang iyong quest ay natapos na. Ang iyong mga kasalanan ay napatawad na.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tes crimes sont à présent pardonnés. Fais le bien autour de toi à partir de maintenant !
dialogsComplete.id: Questmu telah tercapai. Dosa-dosamu telah diampuni.
dialogsComplete.it: La Missione è terminata. I tuoi peccati sono stati perdonati.
dialogsComplete.jp: きちんと任務を完遂したようですね。これであなたの罪は償われました。これからは同じ罪に堕ちぬよう、祈っております。
dialogsComplete.kr: 퀘스트가 끝났습니다. 당신의 죄를 용서하지요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.pl: Zadanie zostało wykonane. Twoje grzechy zostały wybaczone.
dialogsComplete.ru: Боги одобрили твое деяние и простили тебе грехи.
dialogsComplete.sp: Has cumplido con tu misión. Tus pecados han sido perdonados.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsComplete.th: ภารกิจเสร็จสิ้น บาปของคุณได้รับการอภัยแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的任務已經完成，你的罪已被赦免。
dialogsComplete.vi: Nhiệm vụ của bạn đã được hoàn thành. Tội lỗi của bạn đã được tha thứ.

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

name.th: ยินดีต้อนรับ Azria!

description.en: Feel free to stay as long as you need to. Go and visit Gigaka, our protector. He will help you stay safe.
description.ar: Feel free to stay as long as you need to. Go and visit Gigaka, our protector. He will help you stay safe.
description.br: Fique à vontade para ficar o tempo que precisar. Vá visitar Gigaka, nosso protetor. Ele pode te auxiliar com sua segurança.
description.cns: 如要留下，请随意。去找季加卡吧，我们的守护者。他会保证你的安全。
description.de: Bleib ruhig so lange wie du willst. Besuche auch Gigaka, unseren Beschützer. Er wird dir dabei helfen sicher unter zu kommen.
description.fi: Feel free to stay as long as you need to. Go and visit Gigaka, our protector. He will help you stay safe.
description.fil: Feel free to stay as long as you need to. Go and visit Gigaka, our protector. He will help you stay safe.
description.fr: Soyez notre hôte ici aussi longtemps que vous le désirez. Allez rendre visite à Jizaka, notre protecteur. Il vous aidera à rester en vie.
description.id: Tinggalah selama yang kamu inginkan. Pergi dan kunjungi Gigaka, Pelindung kamu. Dia akan membantu menjagamu.
description.it: Feel free to stay as long as you need to. Go and visit Gigaka, our protector. He will help you stay safe.
description.jp: 必要なだけ滞在していってください。私たちの保護者であるギガカに会いに行ってください。彼はあなたが安全に過ごせるように手助けしてくれるでしょう。
description.kr: 원하시는 만큼 마음 편하게 머무르세요. 우리의 보호자, 기가카를 찾아가세요. 안전하게 지낼 수 있도록 도와줄 겁니다.
description.nl: Feel free to stay as long as you need to. Go and visit Gigaka, our protector. He will help you stay safe.
description.pl: Feel free to stay as long as you need to. Go and visit Gigaka, our protector. He will help you stay safe.
description.ru: Feel free to stay as long as you need to. Go and visit Gigaka, our protector. He will help you stay safe.
description.sp: Puedes permanecer el tiempo que necesites. Visita a Gigaka, nuestro protector. Él te ayudará a mantenerte a salvo.
description.sw: Feel free to stay as long as you need to. Go and visit Gigaka, our protector. He will help you stay safe.
description.th: รู้สึกเป็นอิสระที่จะอยู่ได้นานเท่าที่คุณต้องการ ไปหา Gigaka ผู้พิทักษ์ของเรา เขาจะช่วยให้คุณปลอดภัย
description.tw: 只要你需要，請隨時入住。去拜訪我們的保護者機嘎卡，他會幫助你保持安全。
description.vi: Hãy ở lại nếu cần. Hãy đến thăm Gigaka, người bảo vệ của chúng ta. Anh ấy sẽ giúp bạn giữ an toàn.

dialogsBegin.en: Welcome to Azria, one of the coldest places in Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.ar: Welcome to Azria, one of the coldest places in Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.br: Seja bem-vindo(a) a Azria, um dos lugares mais congelantes de Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.cns: 欢迎来到阿兹利亚，瑞加大陆最寒冷的地方之一！
dialogsBegin.de: Willkommen in Azria, einen der kältesten Orte in Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.fi: Welcome to Azria, one of the coldest places in Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.fil: Welcome to Azria, one of the coldest places in Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.fr: Bienvenue à Azria, un des endroits les plus froids de Madrigal !
dialogsBegin.id: Selamat datang di Azria, satu dari tempat terdingin di Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.it: Welcome to Azria, one of the coldest places in Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.jp: マドリガルで最も寒い場所の1つ、アズリアへようこそ!
dialogsBegin.kr: 아즈리아에 오신 걸 환영합니다, 마드리갈에서 가장 추운 곳이죠!
dialogsBegin.nl: Welcome to Azria, one of the coldest places in Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.pl: Welcome to Azria, one of the coldest places in Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.ru: Welcome to Azria, one of the coldest places in Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Bienvenido a Azria, uno de los lugares más fríos de Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.sw: Welcome to Azria, one of the coldest places in Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.th: ยินดีต้อนรับสู่ Azria หนึ่งในสถานที่ที่หนาวที่สุดใน Madrigal!
dialogsBegin.tw: 歡迎來到阿茲里亞！瑪德利賈最冷的地方之一！
dialogsBegin.vi: Chào mừng bạn đến với Azria, một trong những nơi lạnh nhất ở Madrigal!

dialogsBegin.en: This town is a haven in this dangerous place. Masquerpets have overrun the entire continent and made much of this land uninhabitable.
dialogsBegin.ar: This town is a haven in this dangerous place. Masquerpets have overrun the entire continent and made much of this land uninhabitable.
dialogsBegin.br: Este virajero é um refúgio neste lugar perigoso. Os Masquerpets invadiram todo o continente e tornaram grande parte desta terra inabitável.
dialogsBegin.cns: 这个小镇是这危险地带的避风港。怪物们已经席卷了整个大陆，使这片土地的大部分地区都无法居住。
dialogsBegin.de: Diese Stadt ist ein Zufluchtsort an diesem gefährlichen Ort. Masquerpets haben den gesamten Kontinent überrannt und haben einen Großteil des Landes unbewohnbar gemacht.
dialogsBegin.fi: This town is a haven in this dangerous place. Masquerpets have overrun the entire continent and made much of this land uninhabitable.
dialogsBegin.fil: This town is a haven in this dangerous place. Masquerpets have overrun the entire continent and made much of this land uninhabitable.
dialogsBegin.fr: Ce village est un havre de paix dans cette dangereuse contrée. Le continent regorge de monstres, qui ont rendu la plupart de ces terres inhabitables.
dialogsBegin.id: Kota ini adalah surga di tempat berbahaya ini. Masquerpets telah menguasai seluruh benua dan membuat sebagian besar tanah ini tidak dapat dihuni.
dialogsBegin.it: This town is a haven in this dangerous place. Masquerpets have overrun the entire continent and made much of this land uninhabitable.
dialogsBegin.jp: この町は危険な場所の安息の地です。モンスターは大陸全体を侵略し、この土地の多くを住めないものにしました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이곳 마을은 이 위험한 곳의 안식처예요. 마스커펫이 대륙 전체를 뒤덮어, 이 땅 대부분을 사람이 살 수 없는 곳으로 만들어버리고 말았죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: This town is a haven in this dangerous place. Masquerpets have overrun the entire continent and made much of this land uninhabitable.
dialogsBegin.pl: This town is a haven in this dangerous place. Masquerpets have overrun the entire continent and made much of this land uninhabitable.
dialogsBegin.ru: This town is a haven in this dangerous place. Masquerpets have overrun the entire continent and made much of this land uninhabitable.
dialogsBegin.sp: Este pueblo es un refugio en este peligroso lugar. Los Masquerpets han invadido todo el continente y han hecho inhabitable gran parte de esta tierra.
dialogsBegin.sw: This town is a haven in this dangerous place. Masquerpets have overrun the entire continent and made much of this land uninhabitable.
dialogsBegin.th: เมืองนี้เป็นสวรรค์ในสถานที่อันตรายแห่งนี้ Masquerpets ได้บุกรุกทั่วทั้งทวีปและทำให้พื้นที่ส่วนใหญ่นี้ไม่เอื้ออำนวย
dialogsBegin.tw: 這個小鎮是這個危險地方的避風港。怪物已經席捲了整個大陸，使這片土地的大部分無法居住。
dialogsBegin.vi: Thị trấn này là một nơi ẩn náu ở nơi nguy hiểm đây. Masquerpets đã tràn qua toàn bộ lục địa và khiến phần lớn vùng đất này không thể ở được.

dialogsBegin.en: We see you have come a long way to get here. I bet it was a very dangerous journey! You must be very brave.
dialogsBegin.ar: We see you have come a long way to get here. I bet it was a very dangerous journey! You must be very brave.
dialogsBegin.br: Vemos que você percorreu um longo caminho para chegar até aqui. Aposto que foi uma viagem muito perigosa! Você deve ser muito corajoso(a).
dialogsBegin.cns: 你肯定走了很长一段路才到这里。我敢打赌，这是一段非常危险的旅程！你一定很勇敢。
dialogsBegin.de: Wir sehen, dass du einen langen Weg hinter dir hast. Ich wette, es war eine sehr gefährliche Reise! Du bist bestimmt sehr mutig!
dialogsBegin.fi: We see you have come a long way to get here. I bet it was a very dangerous journey! You must be very brave.
dialogsBegin.fil: We see you have come a long way to get here. I bet it was a very dangerous journey! You must be very brave.
dialogsBegin.fr: Nous voyons que vous avez parcouru un long chemin pour arriver ici. Je parie que ce voyage a été périlleux ! Vous devez être très courageux.
dialogsBegin.id: Kami melihat kamu telah menempuh perjalanan jauh untuk sampai ke sini. Aku yakin itu adalah perjalanan yang sangat berbahaya! Kamu harus sangat berani.
dialogsBegin.it: We see you have come a long way to get here. I bet it was a very dangerous journey! You must be very brave.
dialogsBegin.jp: ここまで来るのに長い道のりを歩んできたのですね。とても危険な旅だったに違いない！あなたはとても勇敢です。
dialogsBegin.kr: 여기까지 참으로 먼 길을 오셨군요. 정말 위험한 여정이었겠죠! 용감하신 분이네요.
dialogsBegin.nl: We see you have come a long way to get here. I bet it was a very dangerous journey! You must be very brave.
dialogsBegin.pl: We see you have come a long way to get here. I bet it was a very dangerous journey! You must be very brave.
dialogsBegin.ru: We see you have come a long way to get here. I bet it was a very dangerous journey! You must be very brave.
dialogsBegin.sp: Vemos que has recorrido un largo camino hasta llegar aquí. ¡Apuesto a que fue un viaje muy peligroso! Debes ser muy valiente.
dialogsBegin.sw: We see you have come a long way to get here. I bet it was a very dangerous journey! You must be very brave.
dialogsBegin.th: เราเห็นว่าคุณเดินทางมาไกลเพื่อมาที่นี่ ฉันพนันได้เลยว่ามันเป็นการเดินทางที่อันตรายมาก! คุณต้องกล้าหาญมาก
dialogsBegin.tw: 我們看到你已經走了很長一段路才到這裡。我敢打賭，這是一段非常危險的旅程！你一定很勇敢。
dialogsBegin.vi: Chúng tôi thấy bạn đã đi một chặng đường dài để đến được đây. Tôi cá rằng đó là một cuộc hành trình rất nguy hiểm! Bạn phải rất dũng cảm.

dialogsAccept.en: Feel free to stay as long as you need to. Go and visit Gigaka, our protector. He will help you stay safe.
dialogsAccept.ar: Feel free to stay as long as you need to. Go and visit Gigaka, our protector. He will help you stay safe.
dialogsAccept.br: Fique à vontade para ficar o tempo que precisar. Vá visitar Gigaka, nosso protetor. Ele pode te auxiliar com sua segurança.
dialogsAccept.cns: 如要留下，请随意。去找季加卡吧，我们的守护者。他会保证你的安全。
dialogsAccept.de: Bleib ruhig so lange wie du willst. Besuche auch Gigaka, unseren Beschützer. Er wird dir dabei helfen sicher unter zu kommen.
dialogsAccept.fi: Feel free to stay as long as you need to. Go and visit Gigaka, our protector. He will help you stay safe.
dialogsAccept.fil: Feel free to stay as long as you need to. Go and visit Gigaka, our protector. He will help you stay safe.
dialogsAccept.fr: Soyez notre hôte ici aussi longtemps que vous le désirez. Allez rendre visite à Jizaka, notre protecteur. Il vous aidera à rester en vie.
dialogsAccept.id: Tinggalah selama yang kamu inginkan. Pergi dan kunjungi Gigaka, Pelindung kamu. Dia akan membantu menjagamu.
dialogsAccept.it: Feel free to stay as long as you need to. Go and visit Gigaka, our protector. He will help you stay safe.
dialogsAccept.jp: 必要なだけ滞在していってください。私たちの保護者であるギガカに会いに行ってください。彼はあなたが安全に過ごせるように手助けしてくれるでしょう。
dialogsAccept.kr: 원하시는 만큼 마음 편하게 머무르세요. 우리의 보호자, 기가카를 찾아가세요. 안전하게 지낼 수 있도록 도와줄 겁니다.
dialogsAccept.nl: Feel free to stay as long as you need to. Go and visit Gigaka, our protector. He will help you stay safe.
dialogsAccept.pl: Feel free to stay as long as you need to. Go and visit Gigaka, our protector. He will help you stay safe.
dialogsAccept.ru: Feel free to stay as long as you need to. Go and visit Gigaka, our protector. He will help you stay safe.
dialogsAccept.sp: Puedes permanecer el tiempo que necesites. Visita a Gigaka, nuestro protector. Él te ayudará a mantenerte a salvo.
dialogsAccept.sw: Feel free to stay as long as you need to. Go and visit Gigaka, our protector. He will help you stay safe.
dialogsAccept.th: รู้สึกเป็นอิสระที่จะอยู่ได้นานเท่าที่คุณต้องการ ไปหา Gigaka ผู้พิทักษ์ของเรา เขาจะช่วยให้คุณปลอดภัย
dialogsAccept.tw: 只要你需要，請隨時入住。去拜訪我們的保護者機嘎卡，他會幫助你保持安全。
dialogsAccept.vi: Hãy ở lại nếu cần. Hãy đến thăm Gigaka, người bảo vệ của chúng ta. Anh ấy sẽ giúp bạn giữ an toàn.

dialogsComplete.en: Azria is a dangerous place. You are lucky you made it here and lived.
dialogsComplete.ar: Azria is a dangerous place. You are lucky you made it here and lived.
dialogsComplete.br: Azria é um lugar perigoso. Você tem sorte de ter chegado com vida.
dialogsComplete.cns: 阿兹利亚是一个危险的地方。能活下来，算你走运。
dialogsComplete.de: Azria ist ein sehr gefährlicher Ort. Du hattest viel Glück hier lebendig angekommen zu sein.
dialogsComplete.fi: Azria is a dangerous place. You are lucky you made it here and lived.
dialogsComplete.fil: Azria is a dangerous place. You are lucky you made it here and lived.
dialogsComplete.fr: Azria est un lieu dangereux. Vous avez de la chance d'avoir survécu jusqu'ici.
dialogsComplete.id: Azria adalah tempat yang berbahaya. Kamu beruntung kamu berhasil sampai di sini dan hidup.
dialogsComplete.it: Azria is a dangerous place. You are lucky you made it here and lived.
dialogsComplete.jp: アズリアは危険な場所です。ここに生きてたどり着いたあなたは、きっと幸運を運んできてくれたに違いありませんね。
dialogsComplete.kr: 아즈리아는 위험한 곳이에요. 지금까지 살아있다니 운이 좋으시군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Azria is a dangerous place. You are lucky you made it here and lived.
dialogsComplete.pl: Azria is a dangerous place. You are lucky you made it here and lived.
dialogsComplete.ru: Azria is a dangerous place. You are lucky you made it here and lived.
dialogsComplete.sp: Azria es un lugar peligroso. Tienes suerte de haber llegado hasta aquí vivo.
dialogsComplete.sw: Azria is a dangerous place. You are lucky you made it here and lived.
dialogsComplete.th: Azria เป็นสถานที่อันตราย คุณโชคดีที่คุณมาที่นี่และอาศัยอยู่
dialogsComplete.tw: 阿茲里亞是一個危險的地方，你很幸運，你做到了並活了下來。
dialogsComplete.vi: Azria là một nơi nguy hiểm. Bạn thật may mắn khi bạn đã đến sống ở đây.
