name.cns: 魔导战甲强盗团的报复
name.de: Die Rache der Red Bang Truppe
name.jp: 奪われた家宝を取り戻せ！
name.th: การแก้แค้นของ Red Bang Troupe
name.tw: 紅色崩崩竊盜團的報復
name.vi: Sự trả thù của Red Bang Troupe

description.en: Defeat the Red Bang Troupe Leader west of the Fountain of Dead Person and return Luda's family treasure.
description.ar: Defeat the Red Bang Troupe Leader west of the Fountain of Dead Person and return Luda's family treasure.
description.br: Acho que o líder da Tropa dos Bangs Vermelhos está com o tesouro. Derrote-o a oeste da Fonte dos Mortos e retorne o tesouro da família de Luda.
description.cns: 红色魔导战甲强盗团头目拿走了我们家的传家宝，请你帮我找回来。
description.de: Ich denke der Anführer der Red Bang Troupe hat den Schatz. Bitte bringe ihn mir zurück.
description.fi: Defeat the Red Bang Troupe Leader west of the Fountain of Dead Person and return Luda's family treasure.
description.fil: Defeat the Red Bang Troupe Leader west of the Fountain of Dead Person and return Luda's family treasure.
description.fr: Je pense que c'est le chef des voleurs qui garde le trésor. S'il te plaît retrouve-le et ramène-le moi.
description.id: Kalahkan Pemimpin Red Bang Troupe di sebelah barat Fountain of Dead Person dan kembalikan harta keluarga Luda.
description.it: Defeat the Red Bang Troupe Leader west of the Fountain of Dead Person and return Luda's family treasure.
description.jp: ルダの家に伝わる家宝の剣を、＜赤いヴァン盗賊団＞を倒して取り戻してこよう。
description.kr: 망자의 샘 서쪽의 레드 뱅 도적 대장을 처치하고 루다의 가보를 되찾아 주세요.
description.nl: Defeat the Red Bang Troupe Leader west of the Fountain of Dead Person and return Luda's family treasure.
description.pl: Defeat the Red Bang Troupe Leader west of the Fountain of Dead Person and return Luda's family treasure.
description.ru: Нужно отобрать меч Людора у главаря "Труппы товарищей" в лагере на западе от фонтана Мертвеца.
description.sp: Derrota al Líder de los Bangs Rojos al oeste del Manantial de Almas y devuelve el tesoro familiar de Luda.
description.sw: Defeat the Red Bang Troupe Leader west of the Fountain of Dead Person and return Luda's family treasure.
description.th: เอาชนะหัวหน้าโจร Red Bang ทางฝั่งตะวันตกของ Fountain of Dead Person และนำสมบัติของครอบครัว Luda ไปคืน
description.tw: 紅色崩崩竊盜團的頭目拿走了我們家的傳家寶，請你幫我找回來。
description.vi: Đánh bại Thủ lĩnh của Red Bang Troupe ở phía tây Fountain of Dead Person và trả lại kho báu của gia đình Luda.

dialogsBegin.en: That Red Bang Troupe is making me absolutely nuts!
dialogsBegin.ar: ان عصابة صلب الأحمر تدفعني للجنون!
dialogsBegin.br: O que posso fazer? Ugh, aqueles Bangs Vermelhos me deixam louco!
dialogsBegin.cns: 怎么办呢..那些家伙真的来了..
dialogsBegin.de: Was kann ich nur tun? Oh, sie machen mich verrückt.
dialogsBegin.fi: That Red Bang Troupe is making me absolutely nuts!
dialogsBegin.fil: That Red Bang Troupe is making me absolutely nuts!
dialogsBegin.fr: Qu'est-ce que je peux faire? Ils me rendent fou!
dialogsBegin.id: That Red Bang Troupe itu membuatku benar-benar gila!
dialogsBegin.it: That Red Bang Troupe is making me absolutely nuts!
dialogsBegin.jp: ああ、本当にあいつらときたら全く頭にくる！聞いてくれ、本当にひどい話なんだよ。そうさ、あの赤いヴァン盗賊団のやつらさ！
dialogsBegin.kr: 레드 뱅 도적단 때문에 정말이지 미치겠어요!
dialogsBegin.nl: That Red Bang Troupe is making me absolutely nuts!
dialogsBegin.pl: That Red Bang Troupe is making me absolutely nuts!
dialogsBegin.ru: Эта "Труппа товарищей" вгонит меня в гроб!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Esos Bangs Rojos me está volviendo completamente loco!
dialogsBegin.sw: That Red Bang Troupe is making me absolutely nuts!
dialogsBegin.th: แก๊ง Red Bang กำลังทำให้ฉันเป็นบ้าแล้ว!
dialogsBegin.tw: 怎麼辦呢…那些傢伙真的來了…
dialogsBegin.vi: Nhóm Red Bang Troupe đó đang khiến tôi hoàn toàn phát điên!

dialogsBegin.en: They invaded our home and stole our family treasure, leaving only a note yesterday. I was absolutely horrified...
dialogsBegin.ar: لقد غزوا بيوتنا و سرقوا ثرواتنا، و لم يتركوا سوى رسالة بالأمس. لقد كنت خائفا...
dialogsBegin.br: Ontem, eles invadiram a nossa casa e roubaram nosso tesouro da família, deixando um bilhete. Eu fiquei aterrorizado...
dialogsBegin.cns: 其实，他们昨天到我家，把我们家的传家宝拿走了，还留了一张纸条，真是太恐怖了。
dialogsBegin.de: In Wirklichkeit fielen sie ein und nahmen unseren Familienschatz, sie hinterließen eine Nachricht. Ich hatte echt Angst.
dialogsBegin.fi: They invaded our home and stole our family treasure, leaving only a note yesterday. I was absolutely horrified...
dialogsBegin.fil: They invaded our home and stole our family treasure, leaving only a note yesterday. I was absolutely horrified...
dialogsBegin.fr: En fait, ils sont venus chez nous et ont volés le trésor de notre famille. Ils ont laissé un mot hier. J'étais vraiment terrifé..
dialogsBegin.id: Mereka menyerbu rumah kami dan mencuri harta keluarga kami, hanya meninggalkan catatan kemarin. Saya benar-benar ketakutan...
dialogsBegin.it: They invaded our home and stole our family treasure, leaving only a note yesterday. I was absolutely horrified...
dialogsBegin.jp: 実は昨晩、突然やつらが押しかけてきて、うちに伝わるの先祖代々の家宝を奪っていったんだ！このまえの腹いせだと言って、家宝を奪ったうえに、うちの家具や物まで壊していったんだ。その時は、怖くて怖くて・・・
dialogsBegin.kr: 어제 녀석들이 우리 집을 털었어요. 남긴 건 쪽지 한 장뿐이었어요. 정말 끔찍한…
dialogsBegin.nl: They invaded our home and stole our family treasure, leaving only a note yesterday. I was absolutely horrified...
dialogsBegin.pl: They invaded our home and stole our family treasure, leaving only a note yesterday. I was absolutely horrified...
dialogsBegin.ru: Проходимцы ворвались в мой дом, украли мое фамильное сокровище, да еще и записку издевательскую оставили.
dialogsBegin.sp: Ayer invadieron nuestra casa y robaron nuestro tesoro familiar, dejando solo una nota. Estaba totalmente horrorizado...
dialogsBegin.sw: They invaded our home and stole our family treasure, leaving only a note yesterday. I was absolutely horrified...
dialogsBegin.th: พวกเขาบุกเข้าไปในบ้านของเราและขโมยสมบัติของครอบครัว ทิ้งไว้เพียงแค่โน๊ตแผ่นเดียวเท่านั้น ฉันรู้สึกหวาดกลัวมากๆ...
dialogsBegin.tw: 其實，他們昨天到我家，把我們家的傳家寶拿走了，還留了一張紙條，真是太恐怖了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Họ đã xâm nhập nhà của chúng tôi và đánh cắp kho báu của gia đình chúng tôi, chỉ để lại một lời nhắn ngày hôm qua. Tôi hoàn toàn kinh hãi...

dialogsBegin.en: I was so scared I couldn't do anything about it. They stole my family treasure, and I am powerless to do anything.
dialogsBegin.ar: كنت خائفا لدرجة انني لم استطع فعل أي شيء. لقد سرقوا كنز عائلتي الثمين، و انا عاجز عن مواجهتهم.
dialogsBegin.br: Tão aterrorizado que não pude fazer nada, mesmo o tesouro da família sendo tão valioso e precioso para mim.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我醒过来的时候发现事情不好了，因为那个传家宝不是一般的东西。
dialogsBegin.de: ..ich konnte rein garnichts tun, auch wenn der Familienschatz sehr wertvoll ist.
dialogsBegin.fi: I was so scared I couldn't do anything about it. They stole my family treasure, and I am powerless to do anything.
dialogsBegin.fil: I was so scared I couldn't do anything about it. They stole my family treasure, and I am powerless to do anything.
dialogsBegin.fr: ..mais malheureusment je ne peux absolument rien faire même si ce trésor est très précieux.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya sangat takut sehingga saya tidak bisa berbuat apa-apa. Mereka mencuri harta keluarga saya, dan saya tidak berdaya untuk melakukan apa pun.
dialogsBegin.it: I was so scared I couldn't do anything about it. They stole my family treasure, and I am powerless to do anything.
dialogsBegin.jp: 何にも抵抗できず、まんまとやつらに家宝を持っていかれてしまった。その家宝は古くからつたわる剣で、値段がつけられないほど貴重な物なんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 너무 무서워서 아무것도 할 수가 없었어요. 도적들이 집에 들어와서 가보를 훔쳐 갔지만, 제가 뭘 어떻게 하겠어요?
dialogsBegin.nl: I was so scared I couldn't do anything about it. They stole my family treasure, and I am powerless to do anything.
dialogsBegin.pl: I was so scared I couldn't do anything about it. They stole my family treasure, and I am powerless to do anything.
dialogsBegin.ru: Фамильное сокровище, представляешь? А я так перетрусил, что даже не попытался дать им отпор.
dialogsBegin.sp: Estaba tan asustado que no podía hacer nada. Me robaron el tesoro de mi familia y no tengo el poder para hacer nada.
dialogsBegin.sw: I was so scared I couldn't do anything about it. They stole my family treasure, and I am powerless to do anything.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันกลัวจนฉันไม่สามารถทำอะไรเกี่ยวกับเรื่องนี้ได้เลย พวกมันขโมยสมบัติของครอบครัวของฉัน แล้วฉันกลับไม่มีอำนาจที่จะทำอะไรได้เลย
dialogsBegin.tw: 我醒過來的時候發現事情不好了，因為那個傳家寶不是一般的東西。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đã rất sợ hãi và không thể làm gì. Họ đã đánh cắp kho báu của gia đình tôi, và tôi bất lực không làm được gì.

dialogsBegin.en: If I knew this was going to happen, I would have donated it to the Public Office.
dialogsBegin.ar: ان علمت بأن هذا كان سيحدث، لتبرعت به الى المكتب العام.
dialogsBegin.br: Se eu soubesse que isso aconteceria, eu teria doado tudo para o Escritório Público.
dialogsBegin.cns: 管理所之前对我说他们要帮我保管，那时候我应该要听他们的话才对..
dialogsBegin.de: Wenn ich vorher gewusst hätte dass das passiert, hätte ich es dem Rathaus gestiftet.
dialogsBegin.fi: If I knew this was going to happen, I would have donated it to the Public Office.
dialogsBegin.fil: If I knew this was going to happen, I would have donated it to the Public Office.
dialogsBegin.fr: Si j'avais pu prévoir ça, je l'aurais confié à l'office..
dialogsBegin.id: Jika saya tahu ini akan terjadi, saya akan menyumbangkannya ke Public Office.
dialogsBegin.it: If I knew this was going to happen, I would have donated it to the Public Office.
dialogsBegin.jp: 以前シティホールに、寄贈すれば市の美術品として大切に保管しましょう、という提案も断って大事にうちで保管していたのに、こんなことになるとは。寄贈品として寄贈した方が良かったのかもしれない。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이럴 줄 알았으면 차라리 어디 기증이라도 할 걸 그랬어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: If I knew this was going to happen, I would have donated it to the Public Office.
dialogsBegin.pl: If I knew this was going to happen, I would have donated it to the Public Office.
dialogsBegin.ru: Эх, знал бы - лучше бы в музей прапрадедушкин меч отдал. Мэр у меня его давно выпрашивал, а я - ни в какую.
dialogsBegin.sp: Si hubiera sabido que esto iba a pasar, lo hubiera donado a la Oficina Pública.
dialogsBegin.sw: If I knew this was going to happen, I would have donated it to the Public Office.
dialogsBegin.th: ถ้าฉันรู้ว่ามันจะเกิดขึ้นฉันคงจะได้บริจาคสิ่งเหล่านั้นให้กับ Public Office ไปแล้วล่ะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 管理所之前對我說他們要幫我保管，那時候我應該要聽他們的話才對…
dialogsBegin.vi: Nếu tôi biết điều này sẽ xảy ra, tôi đã quyên góp nó cho Public Office.

dialogsBegin.en: What can I do now? Is there anything you can do to help? Please?!
dialogsBegin.ar: What can I do now? Is there anything you can do to help? Please?!
dialogsBegin.br: Mas... O que posso fazer agora? Você poderia me ajudar? Por favor...
dialogsBegin.cns: 既然你都要帮我了，那就帮到底好吗?
dialogsBegin.de: Was kann ich jetzt tun? Kannst du irgendetwas tun, um zu helfen? Bitte, ja!
dialogsBegin.fi: What can I do now? Is there anything you can do to help? Please?!
dialogsBegin.fil: What can I do now? Is there anything you can do to help? Please?!
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais.. Que puis-je faire? Hein.. Tu pourrais m'aider? s'il te plaît.. s'il te plaît..
dialogsBegin.id: Apa yang bisa saya lakukan sekarang? Apakah ada yang bisa kamu lakukan untuk membantu? Silahkan?!
dialogsBegin.it: What can I do now? Is there anything you can do to help? Please?!
dialogsBegin.jp: すまないが、また君にお願いしていいだろうか？頼む！
dialogsBegin.kr: 이젠 어쩌죠? 혹시 도와주실 수 있나요? 제발!
dialogsBegin.nl: What can I do now? Is there anything you can do to help? Please?!
dialogsBegin.pl: What can I do now? Is there anything you can do to help? Please?!
dialogsBegin.ru: Что же делать? Может, ты сумеешь мне помочь? Пожалуйста!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Qué puedo hacer ahora? ¿Hay algo que puedas hacer para ayudar? ¡¿Por favor?!
dialogsBegin.sw: What can I do now? Is there anything you can do to help? Please?!
dialogsBegin.th: ตอนนี้ฉันสามารถทำอะไรได้บ้าง? มีอะไรที่คุณสามารถช่วยได้หรือไม่? ได้โปรดเถอะ?!
dialogsBegin.tw: 我現在能做什麼？你有什麼可以幫忙的嗎？拜託？！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi có thể làm gì bây giờ? Bạn có thể làm gì để giúp đỡ? Làm ơn?!

dialogsAccept.en: Are you serious!? Thank you! The leader of the thieves has my treasure. Their camp is just west of the Fountain of Dead person. Please, find it and bring it back to me!
dialogsAccept.ar: Are you serious!? Thank you! The leader of the thieves has my treasure. Their camp is just west of the Fountain of Dead person. Please, find it and bring it back to me!
dialogsAccept.br: Você está falando sério!? Obrigado! O líder dos ladrões tem meu tesouro. O acampamento deles fica a oeste da Fonte dos Mortos. Por favor, encontre-o e traga de volta para mim!
dialogsAccept.cns: 我想那个东西，应该在他们头目的手中..拜托你了。
dialogsAccept.de: Ist das dein Ernst? Ich danke Dir! Der Anführer der Diebe hat meinen Schatz. Ihr Lager befindet sich westlich des Brunnens der toten Person. Bitte, findet ihn und bringt ihn mir zurück!
dialogsAccept.fi: Are you serious!? Thank you! The leader of the thieves has my treasure. Their camp is just west of the Fountain of Dead person. Please, find it and bring it back to me!
dialogsAccept.fil: Are you serious!? Thank you! The leader of the thieves has my treasure. Their camp is just west of the Fountain of Dead person. Please, find it and bring it back to me!
dialogsAccept.fr: Merci, merci. Je pense que c'est le chef des voleurs qui garde le trésor. S'il te plaît retrouve-le et ramène-le moi.
dialogsAccept.id: Apakah kamu serius!? Terima kasih! Pemimpin pencuri memiliki harta saya. Perkemahan mereka berada di sebelah barat Fountain of Dead person. Tolong, temukan dan bawa kembali padaku!
dialogsAccept.it: Are you serious!? Thank you! The leader of the thieves has my treasure. Their camp is just west of the Fountain of Dead person. Please, find it and bring it back to me!
dialogsAccept.jp: 取り戻してきてくれるのか？ありがとう！家宝の剣は、おそらくあいつらのボスが持っているはず。必ず取り戻してきてくれ、頼んだよ！
dialogsAccept.kr: 정말이세요!? 감사합니다! 도적단의 대장이 가보를 가지고 있어요. 도적단의 본거지는 망자의 샘 서쪽에 있답니다. 제발 가보를 찾아주세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Are you serious!? Thank you! The leader of the thieves has my treasure. Their camp is just west of the Fountain of Dead person. Please, find it and bring it back to me!
dialogsAccept.pl: Are you serious!? Thank you! The leader of the thieves has my treasure. Their camp is just west of the Fountain of Dead person. Please, find it and bring it back to me!
dialogsAccept.ru: Серьезно? Спасибо! Думаю, меч забрал себе главарь "Труппы". Их лагерь, если помнишь, на западе от фонтана Мертвеца. Прошу, верни мое фамильное сокровище!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¿¡Hablas en serio!? ¡Gracias! El líder de los ladrones tiene mi tesoro. Su campamento está justo al oeste del Manantial de Almas. ¡Por favor, encuéntralo y tráemelo!
dialogsAccept.sw: Are you serious!? Thank you! The leader of the thieves has my treasure. Their camp is just west of the Fountain of Dead person. Please, find it and bring it back to me!
dialogsAccept.th: คุณพูดจริงนะ!? ขอบคุณ! ผู้นำโจรมีสมบัติของฉัน ค่ายของพวกเขาอยู่ทางตะวันตกของ Fountain of Dead person โปรดหามัน แล้วนำมันกลับมาหาฉัน!
dialogsAccept.tw: 真假！？謝謝！盜賊首領有我的寶物，他們的營地就在死者之泉的西邊，請找到它並把它還給我！
dialogsAccept.vi: Bạn nghiêm túc chứ!? Cảm ơn bạn! Kẻ cầm đầu bọn trộm có kho báu của tôi. Trại của họ ở ngay phía tây của Fountain of Dead Person. Làm ơn, hãy tìm nó và mang nó về cho tôi!

dialogsDecline.en: Oh… okay. Never mind then. I guess my problems are none of your concern.
dialogsDecline.ar: حسنا... اذا. اعتقد ان مشاكلي لا تهمك.
dialogsDecline.br: Oh... tudo bem. Deixa pra lá então. Acho que meus problemas não são da sua conta.
dialogsDecline.cns: 是这样喔..也对啦~你已经帮我不少了，那就没办法了..
dialogsDecline.de: ..Puh.. Okay.. Ich habe mich zu sehr auf dich verlassen. Tut mir leid.
dialogsDecline.fi: Oh… okay. Never mind then. I guess my problems are none of your concern.
dialogsDecline.fil: Oh… okay. Never mind then. I guess my problems are none of your concern.
dialogsDecline.fr: ..Hein..Ok.. Je comptais trop sur toi. Je suis désolé.
dialogsDecline.id: Oh… baiklah. Lupakan saja. Saya kira masalah saya bukan urusanmu….
dialogsDecline.it: Oh… okay. Never mind then. I guess my problems are none of your concern.
dialogsDecline.jp: そうか・・・今までも君には世話になりっぱなしだったもんなあ。これ以上は頼めないか、仕方ない。
dialogsDecline.kr: 아… 네. 괜찮아요. 제 일은 별로 중요하지 않으시겠죠…
dialogsDecline.nl: Oh… okay. Never mind then. I guess my problems are none of your concern.
dialogsDecline.pl: Oh… okay. Never mind then. I guess my problems are none of your concern.
dialogsDecline.ru: Понятно... Мои проблемы, значит, тебя не касаются…
dialogsDecline.sp: Ah... vale. Olvidalo entonces. Supongo que mis problemas no son de tu incumbencia.
dialogsDecline.sw: Oh… okay. Never mind then. I guess my problems are none of your concern.
dialogsDecline.th: โอ้... ก็ได้ ไม่เป็นไร ฉันเดาว่าปัญหาของฉันคงไม่ใช่ปัญหาของคุณสินะ
dialogsDecline.tw: 是這樣喔…也對啦~你已經幫我不少了，那就沒辦法了…
dialogsDecline.vi: Ờ được rồi. Đừng bận tâm. Tôi đoán vấn đề của tôi không phải là mối quan tâm của bạn.

dialogsComplete.en: My Entanale Sword! Thank you so much! My family treasure has been returned!
dialogsComplete.ar: My Entanale Sword! Thank you so much! My family treasure has been returned!
dialogsComplete.br: Oh, este é definitivamente o tesouro da família, é a Espada Entanale. Obrigado. Muito obrigado!
dialogsComplete.cns: 啊，这是我的家的家宝安托娜剑。
dialogsComplete.de: Oh, das ist definitiv mein Familienschatz, Entale Sword. Danke. Ich danke dir vielmals.
dialogsComplete.fi: My Entanale Sword! Thank you so much! My family treasure has been returned!
dialogsComplete.fil: My Entanale Sword! Thank you so much! My family treasure has been returned!
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh, c'est bien le trésor de ma famille, c'est l'Epée Entanalle. Merci. Merci beaucoup!
dialogsComplete.id: My Entanale Sword! Terima kasih banyak! Harta keluarga saya telah dikembalikan!
dialogsComplete.it: My Entanale Sword! Thank you so much! My family treasure has been returned!
dialogsComplete.jp: おお！これこそうちの家宝である＜エンタナル・ソード＞に間違いない！取り戻してくれて本当にありがとう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 엔타날레 소드! 정말 감사합니다! 가문의 보물이 돌아오다니!
dialogsComplete.nl: My Entanale Sword! Thank you so much! My family treasure has been returned!
dialogsComplete.pl: My Entanale Sword! Thank you so much! My family treasure has been returned!
dialogsComplete.ru: Меч Анатоля! Мое фамильное сокровище! Не верится, что тебе удалось его вернуть!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Mi Espada Entanale! ¡Muchas gracias! ¡El tesoro de mi familia se ha recuperado!
dialogsComplete.sw: My Entanale Sword! Thank you so much! My family treasure has been returned!
dialogsComplete.th: ดาบ Entanale ของฉัน! ขอบคุณมาก! ฉันได้สมบัติของครอบครัวของฉันคืนมาแล้ว!
dialogsComplete.tw: 啊，這是我的家的家寶安托娜利劍。
dialogsComplete.vi: Thanh kiến Entanale của tôi! Cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều! Kho báu của gia đình tôi đã được trả lại!

dialogsComplete.en: This sword was made by Entanale Boineo, my great great grandfather. It was made out of the bones of an ancient animal...
dialogsComplete.ar: This sword was made by Entanale Boineo, my great great grandfather. It was made out of the bones of an ancient animal...
dialogsComplete.br: Estas armas foram feita por Entanale Boineo, meu tataravô. Foi feita com o osso de uma animal antigo...
dialogsComplete.cns: 这把剑是我的曾曾祖父安托娜·博伊内奥使用一种古老动物的骨头制成的。
dialogsComplete.de: Dieses Schwert wurde von Entalle Boineo, dem Gründer meiner Familie, hergestellt. Es wurde aus den Knochen eines antiken Tieres gefertigt.
dialogsComplete.fi: This sword was made by Entanale Boineo, my great great grandfather. It was made out of the bones of an ancient animal...
dialogsComplete.fil: This sword was made by Entanale Boineo, my great great grandfather. It was made out of the bones of an ancient animal...
dialogsComplete.fr: Cette épée a été forgée par Entanalle Boineo mon ancêtre. Elle a été faite à partir d'un os d'animal préhistorique..
dialogsComplete.id: Pedang ini dibuat oleh Entanale Boineo, kakek buyutku. Itu terbuat dari tulang binatang purba...
dialogsComplete.it: This sword was made by Entanale Boineo, my great great grandfather. It was made out of the bones of an ancient animal...
dialogsComplete.jp: この剣は、うちのご先祖様にあたるエンタナレ・ボルネーが作った剣なんだ。マドリガルの秘境に住む、神聖な動物の骨で作られたそうなんだ。]
dialogsComplete.kr: 이 검은 고대 생물의 뼈로 만들어진 데다, 저희 고조할아버지, 엔타날레 보이네오가 직접 만드셨대요...
dialogsComplete.nl: This sword was made by Entanale Boineo, my great great grandfather. It was made out of the bones of an ancient animal...
dialogsComplete.pl: This sword was made by Entanale Boineo, my great great grandfather. It was made out of the bones of an ancient animal...
dialogsComplete.ru: Этот меч сделал Анатоль Борнео, мой прапрадедушка. Вырезал из кости какого-то древнего животного, если верить семейному преданию.
dialogsComplete.sp: Esta espada fue hecha por Entanale Boineo, mi tatarabuelo. La hizo con los huesos de un animal antiguo...
dialogsComplete.sw: This sword was made by Entanale Boineo, my great great grandfather. It was made out of the bones of an ancient animal...
dialogsComplete.th: ดาบเล่มนี้ทำโดย Entanale Boineo คุณปู่ที่ยิ่งใหญ่ของฉัน มันถูกสร้างขึ้นมาจากกระดูกของสัตว์โบราณ...
dialogsComplete.tw: 這是我們祖先使用一種稀有動物骨頭製作出來的，
dialogsComplete.vi: Thanh kiếm này do Entanale Boineo, ông nội vĩ đại của tôi, làm ra. Nó được làm từ xương của một loài động vật cổ đại...

dialogsComplete.en: I would like to give this to you in return. Perhaps you can keep it safe from thieves better than I can. Thank you once again, my friend.
dialogsComplete.ar: I would like to give this to you in return. Perhaps you can keep it safe from thieves better than I can. Thank you once again, my friend.
dialogsComplete.br: Eu gostaria de lhe entregar elas como recompensa. Talvez só você consiga mantê-las a salvo dos ladrões. Por favor, fique com elas. Obrigado mais uma vez, amigo(a)!
dialogsComplete.cns: 为了表达我的心意，这个剑送给你，如果在我家的话，早晚又会被偷走的。
dialogsComplete.de: Ich würde es dir gerne geben. Nur du kannst es von den Dieben fernhalten. Bitte nimm es.
dialogsComplete.fi: I would like to give this to you in return. Perhaps you can keep it safe from thieves better than I can. Thank you once again, my friend.
dialogsComplete.fil: I would like to give this to you in return. Perhaps you can keep it safe from thieves better than I can. Thank you once again, my friend.
dialogsComplete.fr: J'aimerais te donner ça en retour. Toi seul a pu vaincre ces voleurs. C'est pour toi.
dialogsComplete.id: Saya ingin memberikan ini kepadamu sebagai balasannya. Mungkin kau bisa menjaganya dari pencuri lebih baik daripada aku. Terima kasih sekali lagi, temanku.
dialogsComplete.it: I would like to give this to you in return. Perhaps you can keep it safe from thieves better than I can. Thank you once again, my friend.
dialogsComplete.jp: お礼に、この剣をあげるよ。どうせオレが私が持っていてもまた盗まれるかも知れないしな、アハハ！是非、受け取ってくれ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이걸 받아 주세요. 정말 소중한 물건이지만… 어쩌면 도둑들보다는 당신한테 맡기는 게 나을 것 같네요. 다시 한번, 정말 감사드려요.
dialogsComplete.nl: I would like to give this to you in return. Perhaps you can keep it safe from thieves better than I can. Thank you once again, my friend.
dialogsComplete.pl: I would like to give this to you in return. Perhaps you can keep it safe from thieves better than I can. Thank you once again, my friend.
dialogsComplete.ru: Я хочу тебя отблагодарить. Возьми этот меч себе. Если кто и сможет уберечь его от разбойников, так это ты. И еще раз спасибо.
dialogsComplete.sp: Me gustaría darte esto como recompensa. Tal vez lo puedas mantener a salvo de los ladrones mejor que yo. Gracias una vez más, amigo mío.
dialogsComplete.sw: I would like to give this to you in return. Perhaps you can keep it safe from thieves better than I can. Thank you once again, my friend.
dialogsComplete.th: ฉันต้องการจะให้สิ่งนี้แก่คุณเป็นการตอบแทน บางทีคุณสามารถรักษามันจากพวกโจรได้ดีกว่าฉัน ขอบคุณอีกครั้งนะ เพื่อน
dialogsComplete.tw: 為了表達我的心意，這個劍送給你，如果在我家的話，早晚又會被偷走的。
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi muốn trả lại cái này cho bạn. Có lẽ bạn có thể giữ nó an toàn khỏi những tên trộm tốt hơn tôi. Cảm ơn bạn một lần nữa, bạn của tôi.

dialogsFail.en: You have to find the leader of the troupe. Only he could have done this.
dialogsFail.ar: You have to find the leader of the troupe. Only he could have done this.
dialogsFail.br: Não será fácil derrotar o líder dos ladrões, eu acho.
dialogsFail.cns: 那个头目看起来很恐怖，应该不容易对付的..所以要小心喔~
dialogsFail.de: Der Anführer der Diebe ist nicht einfach zu besiegen, denke ich.
dialogsFail.fi: You have to find the leader of the troupe. Only he could have done this.
dialogsFail.fil: You have to find the leader of the troupe. Only he could have done this.
dialogsFail.fr: Le chef des voleurs doit être difficile à battre, je présume.
dialogsFail.id: Kamu harus menemukan pemimpin rombongan. Hanya dia yang bisa melakukan ini.
dialogsFail.it: You have to find the leader of the troupe. Only he could have done this.
dialogsFail.jp: 赤いヴァン盗賊団のボスは、なかなか手強いときくよ。十分、気をつけてくれ。
dialogsFail.kr: 도적단의 두목을 찾으세요. 이런 일을 벌일 사람은 그자뿐입니다.
dialogsFail.nl: You have to find the leader of the troupe. Only he could have done this.
dialogsFail.pl: You have to find the leader of the troupe. Only he could have done this.
dialogsFail.ru: Разыщи главаря "Труппы товарищей". Вряд ли он доверил меч своим проходимцам.
dialogsFail.sp: Tienes que encontrar al líder de la compañía. Solo él puede haber hecho esto.
dialogsFail.sw: You have to find the leader of the troupe. Only he could have done this.
dialogsFail.th: คุณต้องหาผู้นำโจร มีแค่เขาเท่านั้นแหละที่สามารถทำเช่นนี้ได้
dialogsFail.tw: 那個頭目看起來很恐怖，應該不容易對付的…所以要小心喔~
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn phải tìm người đứng đầu nhóm Chỉ có anh ấy mới có thể làm được điều này.

name.jp: 英雄の後継者-マスター-
name.th: ผู้สืบทอดฮีโร่ -Master-
name.tw: 英雄的繼任者 - 大師
name.vi: Người kế vị anh hùng - Chủ nhân- (Successor of Hero -Master-)

description.en: Hunt Down 20 Drillers and return to Ride in Darken City.
description.ar: Hunt Down 20 Drillers and return to Ride in Darken City.
description.br: É muito simples. Cace 20 Sondadores em KhipRa, Darkon 1. Não incomode os Pequenos Sondadores ou o Sondador Gigante, ataque apenas os Sondadores.
description.cns: 测验的内容很简单，只要在达肯1区，打败20只钻孔机就可以了！
description.de: Wie ich sagte, er ist leicht. Jage 20 Driller in KhipRa, Darkon 1. Keine Small Driller oder Giant Driller, einfach nur Driller.
description.fi: Hunt Down 20 Drillers and return to Ride in Darken City.
description.fil: Hunt Down 20 Drillers and return to Ride in Darken City.
description.fr: Tuer 20 Drillers à KhipRa, Darkon 1 et retourner voir le Maître des Moines, Ride à Darken.
description.id: Buru 20 Pengebor dan kembali ke Ride in Darken City.
description.it: Hunt Down 20 Drillers and return to Ride in Darken City.
description.jp: ダーコン1地区、キプラと言われている地域に棲息しているドリラーを20匹狩りましょう。
description.kr: 드릴러 20마리를 처치한 뒤, 다켄 시티의 라이드에게 돌아가세요.
description.nl: Hunt Down 20 Drillers and return to Ride in Darken City.
description.pl: Zapoluj na 20 Wiertników i wróć do Ride in Darken City.
description.ru: Нужно одолеть двадцать обычных буров и вернуться к Рите в Даркенбург.
description.sp: Derrota a 20 Drillers y vuelve con Corel a Darken.
description.sw: Hunt Down 20 Drillers and return to Ride in Darken City.
description.th: ไล่ล่า 20 Drillers และกลับไปหา Ride ใน Darken City
description.tw: 測驗的內容很簡單，只要在得肯第 1 地區，打敗 20 隻暴鑽機械就可以了！
description.vi: Săn lùng 20 Drillers và quay trở lại Ride tại Darken City.

dialogsBegin.en: So you think you're ready to become a Billposter? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.ar: So you think you're ready to become a Billposter? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.br: Você deseja se sente preparado(a) para se tornar um Billposter? Não é nada fácil. Mas eu acho que você está pronto(a), já que veio até aqui.
dialogsBegin.cns: 要成为暴力技师英雄的继承者可不简单，你要有心理准备喔！好吧，让我来为你解说！
dialogsBegin.de: Du glaubst also, du bist bereit, ein Billposter zu werden? Es ist nicht einfach, aber da du es bis hierher geschafft hast, denke ich, dass du der Herausforderung gewachsen bist.
dialogsBegin.fi: So you think you're ready to become a Billposter? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.fil: So you think you're ready to become a Billposter? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tu aimerais succéder à Roentel, le Héros des Moines ? Ce n'est pas une tâche facile, mais je pense que tu en es capable...
dialogsBegin.id: Jadi kamu pikir kamu siap untuk menjadi seorang Billposter? Ini tidak mudah, tetapi karena kamu telah berhasil sejauh ini, saya pikir kamu siap menghadapi tantangan.
dialogsBegin.it: So you think you're ready to become a Billposter? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
dialogsBegin.jp: ビルポスター後継者の道を歩む覚悟はできていますか？では、ご案内します。
dialogsBegin.kr: 블레이드가 될 준비가 된 것 같나요? 쉬운 일은 아니지만, 여기까지 온 걸 보면 도전할 자격이 있어 보이는군요.

dialogsBegin.en: What am I going to do? Oh my... What? You're curious as to why I'm so nervous? Actually, we Helpers have a test once every year and I'm no good under pressure.
dialogsBegin.ar: What am I going to do? Oh my... What? You're curious as to why I'm so nervous? Actually, we Helpers have a test once every year and I'm no good under pressure.
dialogsBegin.br: Oh, minha Rhisis! O que eu vou fazer? Hum? Ahh, você quer saber por que estou tão nervosa? Na verdade, nós Ajudantes temos um teste uma vez por ano e eu não sei lidar com a pressão.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我该怎么办？我天….什么？你好奇我为什么这么紧张？实际上我们帮手每年都要有一次测试，在这种压力下我真的高兴不起来。
dialogsBegin.de: Was soll ich nur tun? Oh mein... Was? Du bist neugierig, warum ich so nervös bin? Wir Helfer haben einmal im Jahr eine Prüfung, und ich bin nicht gut unter Druck.
dialogsBegin.fi: What am I going to do? Oh my... What? You're curious as to why I'm so nervous? Actually, we Helpers have a test once every year and I'm no good under pressure.
dialogsBegin.fil: What am I going to do? Oh my... What? You're curious as to why I'm so nervous? Actually, we Helpers have a test once every year and I'm no good under pressure.
dialogsBegin.fr: Par Rhisis ! (vous regardant) Hein ? Aah, tu te demandes pourquoi je suis si nerveux ? Et bien tu sais les intendants doivent passer un test chaque année...
dialogsBegin.id: Apa yang akan aku lakukan? Ya ampun... Apa? Kamu ingin tahu mengapa aku sangat gugup? Sebenarnya, Helper memiliki ujian setahun sekali dan kurang cocok dibawah tekanan.
dialogsBegin.it: What am I going to do? Oh my... What? You're curious as to why I'm so nervous? Actually, we Helpers have a test once every year and I'm no good under pressure.
dialogsBegin.jp: どうしよう、緊張しちゃうなぁ。ドキドキ…。えっ？なぜそんなにソワソワ落ち着かないのかって？実は私たちヘルパーは1年に1度、適性試験を受けなければならないのです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이를 어쩌나, 이를 어쩌지... 네? 왜 이렇게 떨고 있느냐고요? 사실, 저희 도우미들은 해마다 시험을 보거든요. 전 긴장을 많이 하는 타입이라서요.
dialogsBegin.nl: What am I going to do? Oh my... What? You're curious as to why I'm so nervous? Actually, we Helpers have a test once every year and I'm no good under pressure.
dialogsBegin.pl: What am I going to do? Oh my... What? You're curious as to why I'm so nervous? Actually, we Helpers have a test once every year and I'm no good under pressure.
dialogsBegin.ru: What am I going to do? Oh my... What? You're curious as to why I'm so nervous? Actually, we Helpers have a test once every year and I'm no good under pressure.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Que voy a hacer? Dios mío... ¿Qué? ¿Tienes curiosidad de por qué estoy tan nerviosa? En realidad, los Ayudantes tenemos una prueba una vez al año y no soy buena bajo presión.
dialogsBegin.sw: What am I going to do? Oh my... What? You're curious as to why I'm so nervous? Actually, we Helpers have a test once every year and I'm no good under pressure.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันจะทำอะไรดี? โอ้ ไม่... อะไรล่ะ? คุณสงสัยว่าทำไมฉันรู้สึกกังวลมาก? ที่จริงแล้วผู้ช่วยของเรามีการทดสอบปีละครั้ง และฉันอยู่ภายใต้ความกดดันไม่ค่อยได้น่ะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 怎麼辦啊…你說我在緊張什麼喔？我們解說員每一年都要進行考試。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi sẽ làm gì đây? Ôi chao ... Cái gì? Bạn đang tò mò tại sao tôi lại lo lắng như vậy? Trên thực tế, những Helpers của chúng tôi có bài kiểm tra mỗi năm một lần và tôi không chịu được áp lực.

dialogsBegin.en: The test is very soon, and the date was just moved up all of the sudden! I am so worried! I'm a good helper, so I should pass and all, but I want to be the best!
dialogsBegin.ar: The test is very soon, and the date was just moved up all of the sudden! I am so worried! I'm a good helper, so I should pass and all, but I want to be the best!
dialogsBegin.br: O teste acontecerá em breve. Mas a data foi antecipada de repente e é por isso que estou preocupada. Mas eu vou passar no teste, com certeza! Sou uma boa Ajudante!
dialogsBegin.cns: The test is very soon, and the date was just moved up all of the sudden! I am so worried! I'm a good helper, so I should pass and all, but I want to be the best!
dialogsBegin.de: Der Test ist sehr bald, und das Datum wurde einfach plötzlich vorverlegt! Ich bin so besorgt! Ich bin ein guter Helfer, also sollte ich bestehen und so, aber ich will der Beste sein!
dialogsBegin.fi: The test is very soon, and the date was just moved up all of the sudden! I am so worried! I'm a good helper, so I should pass and all, but I want to be the best!
dialogsBegin.fil: The test is very soon, and the date was just moved up all of the sudden! I am so worried! I'm a good helper, so I should pass and all, but I want to be the best!
dialogsBegin.fr: Le test aura bientôt lieu. Mais la date a été rapprochée récemment, ça m'inquiète. Mais je vais réussir ce test ! Je suis un bon intendant !
dialogsBegin.id: Tesnya sangat cepat, dan tanggalnya baru saja dimajukan tiba-tiba! Aku sangat khawatir! Aku penolong yang baik, aku harus lulus semuanya, tapi aku ingin jadi yang terbaik!
dialogsBegin.it: The test is very soon, and the date was just moved up all of the sudden! I am so worried! I'm a good helper, so I should pass and all, but I want to be the best!
dialogsBegin.jp: その試験がもうそろそろ近づいてきたので落ち着かなくって…。まあ、こつこつ勉強をしてきたので、落ちる心配はないのですけどね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 시험이 얼마 안 남았는데, 갑자기 날짜가 앞당겨졌어요! 너무 걱정돼요! 전 일을 잘하니까 합격은 하겠지만, 그래도 최고가 되고 싶거든요!
dialogsBegin.nl: The test is very soon, and the date was just moved up all of the sudden! I am so worried! I'm a good helper, so I should pass and all, but I want to be the best!
dialogsBegin.pl: The test is very soon, and the date was just moved up all of the sudden! I am so worried! I'm a good helper, so I should pass and all, but I want to be the best!
dialogsBegin.ru: The test is very soon, and the date was just moved up all of the sudden! I am so worried! I'm a good helper, so I should pass and all, but I want to be the best!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡La prueba es muy pronto y la fecha se adelantó de repente! ¡Estoy de los nervios! Soy una buena ayudante, así que debería pasar, ¡¡pero quiero ser la mejor!!
dialogsBegin.sw: The test is very soon, and the date was just moved up all of the sudden! I am so worried! I'm a good helper, so I should pass and all, but I want to be the best!
dialogsBegin.th: การทดสอบใกล้เข้ามาแล้ว แต่แล้วจู่ๆ ก็ถูกเลื่อนวัน! ฉันกังวลมาก! ฉันเป็นผู้ช่วยที่ดี ดังนั้นฉันควรผ่านไปได้ ฉันจะต้องทำให้ดีที่สุด!
dialogsBegin.tw: 考試很快就要到了，而且日期突然提前了！我好擔心！我本來就是個優秀的助手，照理說應該能通過，但我想成為最好的那個！
dialogsBegin.vi: Ngày kiểm tra vốn đã sớm rồi, vậy mà giờ nó còn bị dời lên đột ngột! Tôi lo lắng quá! Tôi là một helper giỏi, vì vậy tôi sẽ qua môn thôi, nhưng tôi muốn trở thành người giỏi nhất!!

dialogsBegin.en: I have never taken first place because of that know-it-all Herth, and I absolutely must beat her this year! I will do anything to come in first place and I need your help!
dialogsBegin.ar: I have never taken first place because of that know-it-all Herth, and I absolutely must beat her this year! I will do anything to come in first place and I need your help!
dialogsBegin.br: Mas eu nunca fiquei em primeiro lugar por causa de Herth! Este ano, farei qualquer coisa para ser a primeira! Mas preciso da ajuda de outras pessoas.
dialogsBegin.cns: 可是每年都会把第一的位子让给了赫丝，可是今年我很想拿到第一名。拿到第一名的办法只有一个，可是需要其他人的帮忙。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich war aber nie die Beste, sondern Herth. Sie war immer besser als ich. Dieses mal will ich sie schlagen, aber ich brauche Hilfe.
dialogsBegin.fi: I have never taken first place because of that know-it-all Herth, and I absolutely must beat her this year! I will do anything to come in first place and I need your help!
dialogsBegin.fil: I have never taken first place because of that know-it-all Herth, and I absolutely must beat her this year! I will do anything to come in first place and I need your help!
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais je n'ai jamais pu être première à cause de Herth ! Cette année je ferai tout pour être en tête. Mais c'est pour ça que j'ai besoin d'un coup de pouce...
dialogsBegin.id: Aku tidak pernah menjadi yang pertama karena Herth yang tahu segalanya itu, dan aku benar-benar harus mengalahkannya tahun ini! Aku akan melakukan apa saja untuk menjadi yang pertama dan aku butuh bantuanmu!
dialogsBegin.it: I have never taken first place because of that know-it-all Herth, and I absolutely must beat her this year! I will do anything to come in first place and I need your help!
dialogsBegin.jp: でも、毎年1等をハースに取られています。今年はどうしてもわたしが1等になりたいのです！そこで、お願いがあるのです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 전 매번 그 잘난 체하는 허스 녀석에게 밀려, 한 번도 1등을 해본 적이 없어요. 올해는 꼭 이겨서 1등이 되고 싶어요! 뭐든지 할 테니 도와주세요!
dialogsBegin.nl: I have never taken first place because of that know-it-all Herth, and I absolutely must beat her this year! I will do anything to come in first place and I need your help!
dialogsBegin.pl: I have never taken first place because of that know-it-all Herth, and I absolutely must beat her this year! I will do anything to come in first place and I need your help!
dialogsBegin.ru: Лучшей всегда становится эта всезнайка Герда… Но я знаю, как ее обойти!
dialogsBegin.sp: Nunca he conseguido el primer lugar por culpa de esa sabelotodo de Herth, ¡pero este año venceré! ¡Haré lo que sea para quedar en primer lugar y para eso necesito tu ayuda!
dialogsBegin.sw: I have never taken first place because of that know-it-all Herth, and I absolutely must beat her this year! I will do anything to come in first place and I need your help!
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันไม่เคยได้ที่หนึ่งเพราะเจ้าคนที่รู้ไปหมดที่ชื่อ Herth น่ะ และฉันต้องเอาชนะเธอให้ได้ในปีนี้! ฉันจะทำทุกอย่างเพื่อให้ได้ที่ 1 และฉันต้องการความช่วยเหลือจากคุณ!
dialogsBegin.tw: 可是每年都會把第一的位子讓給了海斯，可是今年我很想拿到第一名。拿到第一名的辦法只有一個，可是需要其他人的幫忙。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi chưa bao giờ đứng đầu vì Herth biết tất cả, và tôi nhất định phải đánh bại cô ấy trong năm nay! Tôi sẽ làm bất cứ điều gì để đạt được vị trí đầu tiên và tôi cần sự giúp đỡ của bạn!

dialogsBegin.en: So will you help me, stranger?
dialogsBegin.ar: So will you help me, stranger?
dialogsBegin.br: Então... Você me ajudaria?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你可以帮我吗?
dialogsBegin.de: Würdest du mir helfen?
dialogsBegin.fi: So will you help me, stranger?
dialogsBegin.fil: So will you help me, stranger?
dialogsBegin.fr: Alors. Ca te dirait de m'aider?
dialogsBegin.id: Jadi maukah kamu membantuku, orang asing?
dialogsBegin.it: So will you help me, stranger?
dialogsBegin.jp: わたしのお願いをきいてもらえますか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 도와주실 거죠?
dialogsBegin.nl: So will you help me, stranger?
dialogsBegin.pl: So will you help me, stranger?
dialogsBegin.ru: Нужно выучить второй урок из "Книги хорошего гида". Я брала ее в библиотеке, но страницы урока оказались вырваны! Ты поможешь мне их найти?
dialogsBegin.sp: Entonces, ¿me ayudarás?
dialogsBegin.sw: So will you help me, stranger?
dialogsBegin.th: คุณจะช่วยฉันไหม คนแปลกหน้า?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你可以幫我嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Vậy bạn có giúp tôi không, người lạ?

dialogsAccept.en: I need lessons 1 and 2 of the Helper Text Books. I understand that both lessons can be found in the flower bed behind the Public Office. Will you bring it to me?
dialogsAccept.ar: I need lessons 1 and 2 of the Helper Text Books. I understand that both lessons can be found in the flower bed behind the Public Office. Will you bring it to me?
dialogsAccept.br: Preciso das lições 1 e 2 dos Livros do Ajudante. Eu entendo que ambas as lições podem ser encontradas no canteiro de flores atrás do Escritório Público. Você vai trazer para mim?
dialogsAccept.cns: 我需要解说员教本的第一章和第二章。它们可以在城镇服务处后面的花坛里找到。你可以帮我带过来吗？
dialogsAccept.de: Hole das Helper Book bitte aus der Stadtverwaltung in Flaris. Das ist doch keine zu schwere Aufgabe, oder?
dialogsAccept.fi: I need lessons 1 and 2 of the Helper Text Books. I understand that both lessons can be found in the flower bed behind the Public Office. Will you bring it to me?
dialogsAccept.fil: I need lessons 1 and 2 of the Helper Text Books. I understand that both lessons can be found in the flower bed behind the Public Office. Will you bring it to me?
dialogsAccept.fr: Merci. Tu peux trouver le Manuel de l'Intendant à l'Office Public. Pourrais-tu me le ramener? C'est plutôt simple, non?
dialogsAccept.id: Aku membutuhkan pelajaran 1 dan 2 dari Helper Text Books. Aku mengerti bahwa kedua pelajaran itu dapat ditemukan di petak bunga di belakang Public Office. Maukah kamu membawanya kepadaku?
dialogsAccept.it: I need lessons 1 and 2 of the Helper Text Books. I understand that both lessons can be found in the flower bed behind the Public Office. Will you bring it to me?
dialogsAccept.jp: 聞いてくれるんですか？ありがとうございます！シティーホールに行くとヘルパー教本があるので、それを取ってきてもらえませんか？簡単でしょう？
dialogsAccept.kr: 도우미 교재 1, 2권이 필요해요. 둘 다 플라리네 관공서 뒤 화단에서 찾을 수 있다고 들었어요. 책을 찾아주실 수 있나요?
dialogsAccept.nl: I need lessons 1 and 2 of the Helper Text Books. I understand that both lessons can be found in the flower bed behind the Public Office. Will you bring it to me?
dialogsAccept.pl: I need lessons 1 and 2 of the Helper Text Books. I understand that both lessons can be found in the flower bed behind the Public Office. Will you bring it to me?
dialogsAccept.ru: Пожалуйста, поищи их… На месте того, кто их вырвал, я бы сожгла их или закопала в какой-нибудь цветочной клумбе.
dialogsAccept.sp: Necesito las lecciones 1 y 2 de los Libros de Ayudante. Ambas lecciones se pueden encontrar en el jardín de flores detrás de la Oficina Pública. ¿Me las traerás?
dialogsAccept.sw: I need lessons 1 and 2 of the Helper Text Books. I understand that both lessons can be found in the flower bed behind the Public Office. Will you bring it to me?
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันต้องการบทเรียนที่ 1 และ 2 ของตาราช่วยเหลือ ฉันเข้าใจว่าทั้งสองบทเรียนสามารถพบได้ในเตียงดอกไม้ด้านหลัง Public Office คุณจะนำมันมาให้ฉันใช่ไหม?
dialogsAccept.tw: 我需要解說員教本的第 1 課和第 2 課。我知道這兩課都可以在城鎮事務所後方的花壇找到。你能幫我帶來嗎？
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi cần các bài học 1 và 2 của Helper Text Books. Tôi hiểu rằng cả hai bài học đều có thể được tìm thấy trong bồn hoa phía sau Public Office. Bạn sẽ mang nó cho tôi?

dialogsDecline.en: You know, people nowadays are only worried about themselves. Typical…
dialogsDecline.ar: You know, people nowadays are only worried about themselves. Typical…
dialogsDecline.br: Certo... Pedirei para outra pessoa... Bem, obrigada de qualquer jeito.
dialogsDecline.cns: 是喔?那就没办法了，我只好找其他人来帮我，谢谢你陪我聊了这么多。
dialogsDecline.de: (schaut bedrückt) Okay.. Ich frage jemand anderes...
dialogsDecline.fi: You know, people nowadays are only worried about themselves. Typical…
dialogsDecline.fil: You know, people nowadays are only worried about themselves. Typical…
dialogsDecline.fr: (Avec un regard triste) Ok.. Je vais demander à quelqu'un d'autre. Mais bon, merci quand même.
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu tahu, orang-orang saat ini hanya mengkhawatirkan diri mereka sendiri. Sangat khas…
dialogsDecline.it: You know, people nowadays are only worried about themselves. Typical…
dialogsDecline.jp: そうですか、わかりました。他の人に頼むので大丈夫です。
dialogsDecline.kr: 요즘 사람들은 다 자기 생각만 한다니까요...
dialogsDecline.nl: You know, people nowadays are only worried about themselves. Typical…
dialogsDecline.pl: You know, people nowadays are only worried about themselves. Typical…
dialogsDecline.ru: Да, в наше время каждый думает только о себе...
dialogsDecline.sp: Ya sabes, hoy en día la gente solo se preocupa por sí misma. Típico…
dialogsDecline.sw: You know, people nowadays are only worried about themselves. Typical…
dialogsDecline.th: คุณรู้หรือไม่ว่าทุกวันนี้คนเราทุกคนก็กังวลเกี่ยวกับเรื่องของตัวเองเท่านั้นแหละ เป็นธรรมดา ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 是喔？那就沒辦法了，我只好找其他人來幫我，謝謝你陪我聊了這麼多。
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn biết đấy, mọi người ngày nay chỉ lo lắng cho bản thân họ. Thông thường thì…

dialogsComplete.en: Hmmm yes! These are the ones! So this must be the range of possible questions, huh?
dialogsComplete.ar: Hmmm yes! These are the ones! So this must be the range of possible questions, huh?
dialogsComplete.br: Sim, são definitivamente 2 pedaços do Livro do Ajudante. Estas são as possíveis perguntas. Hum?
dialogsComplete.cns: 啊，对!就是这个教本第2章，这次的考题会从这边出来。你说什么?考试也有范围喔?
dialogsComplete.de: Ja, es gibt 2 Arten von Helper Text Book. Aufgrund der vielen Fragen, was?
dialogsComplete.fi: Hmmm yes! These are the ones! So this must be the range of possible questions, huh?
dialogsComplete.fil: Hmmm yes! These are the ones! So this must be the range of possible questions, huh?
dialogsComplete.fr: Oui, ce sont bien les deux Manuels de l'Intendant. Ils contiennent les questions qui risquent de tomber. Hein?
dialogsComplete.id: Hmm ya! Ini dia! Jadi ini pasti kisaran pertanyaan yang mungkin, ya?
dialogsComplete.it: Hmmm yes! These are the ones! So this must be the range of possible questions, huh?
dialogsComplete.jp: 確かにこの教本2枚です！今年はここから試験問題が出題されるそうなんです。え？ヘルパー試験にも試験範囲があるのかって？
dialogsComplete.kr: 오오! 이게 맞아요! 그렇다면 문제 범위가 이 정도쯤 되겠네요?
dialogsComplete.nl: Hmmm yes! These are the ones! So this must be the range of possible questions, huh?
dialogsComplete.pl: Hmmm yes! These are the ones! So this must be the range of possible questions, huh?
dialogsComplete.ru: Да-да! Это первые уроки книги! Думаю, их-то мне и не хватает, чтобы победить.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Oh, sí! ¡Estas son! Así que este debe ser el rango de posibles preguntas, ¿eh?
dialogsComplete.sw: Hmmm yes! These are the ones! So this must be the range of possible questions, huh?
dialogsComplete.th: อืมใช่! สิ่งเหล่านี้แหละ! ดังนั้นนี่คงเป็นคำถามที่น่าจะออกสินะ หืม?
dialogsComplete.tw: 啊，對！就是這個教本第 2 章，這次的考題會從這邊出來。你說什麼？考試也有範圍喔？
dialogsComplete.vi: Hmmm vâng! Họ như thế đấy. Vì vậy, đây chắc hẳn là một loạt các câu hỏi có thể xảy ra, phải không?

dialogsComplete.en: Yes, it all makes sense now! This is the information I needed. This will really help me put Herth in her place!
dialogsComplete.ar: Yes, it all makes sense now! This is the information I needed. This will really help me put Herth in her place!
dialogsComplete.br: Claro! Estas são as possíveis perguntas. Tenho certeza!
dialogsComplete.cns: 当然~考试当然有考试范围啦~哪有考试没有范围的啊?
dialogsComplete.de: Ja sicher!
dialogsComplete.fi: Yes, it all makes sense now! This is the information I needed. This will really help me put Herth in her place!
dialogsComplete.fil: Yes, it all makes sense now! This is the information I needed. This will really help me put Herth in her place!
dialogsComplete.fr: Oui c'est sûr ! Ces manuels couvrent toutes les questions du test ~
dialogsComplete.id: Ya, semuanya masuk akal sekarang! Ini adalah informasi yang aku butuhkan. Ini akan sangat membantuku menempatkan Herth di tempatnya!
dialogsComplete.it: Yes, it all makes sense now! This is the information I needed. This will really help me put Herth in her place!
dialogsComplete.jp: 試験なので、ちゃんと試験範囲はきまっていますよ～。この教本を集中して勉強すれば、今年こそハースに勝てるかもしれないわ！ありがとう！
dialogsComplete.kr: 그래요, 이제 알겠어요! 저에게 딱 필요한 정보였어요. 이걸로 허스에게 한 방 먹일 수 있겠네요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Yes, it all makes sense now! This is the information I needed. This will really help me put Herth in her place!
dialogsComplete.pl: Yes, it all makes sense now! This is the information I needed. This will really help me put Herth in her place!
dialogsComplete.ru: Побегу зубрить и репетировать. Ну, Герда, держись!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Sí, todo tiene sentido ahora! Esta es la información que necesitaba. ¡Esto me ayudará a poner a Herth en su lugar!
dialogsComplete.sw: Yes, it all makes sense now! This is the information I needed. This will really help me put Herth in her place!
dialogsComplete.th: ใช่ ทุกอย่างมันลงตัวแล้ว! นี่คือข้อมูลที่ฉันต้องการ สิ่งนี้จะช่วยให้ Herth กลับไปอยู่ในที่ของเธอ!
dialogsComplete.tw: 當然囉~考試當然有考試範圍啦~哪有考試沒有範圍的啊？
dialogsComplete.vi: Vâng, rõ ràng rồi! Đây là thông tin tôi cần. Điều này thực sự sẽ giúp tôi đặt Herth vào vị trí của cô ấy!

dialogsComplete.en: Thank you very much, my friend! Please see me anytime if you need my help.
dialogsComplete.ar: Thank you very much, my friend! Please see me anytime if you need my help.
dialogsComplete.br: Muito obrigada. Venha até mim se precisar da minha ajuda.
dialogsComplete.cns: 反正谢谢你啦~有需要我帮忙的话，随时都可以来找我喔~
dialogsComplete.de: Danke, komm zu mir, wenn du Hilfe brauchst.
dialogsComplete.fi: Thank you very much, my friend! Please see me anytime if you need my help.
dialogsComplete.fil: Thank you very much, my friend! Please see me anytime if you need my help.
dialogsComplete.fr: Merci beaucoup. Viens me voir si jamais tu as besoin de mon aide.
dialogsComplete.id: Terima kasih banyak temanku! Temui aku kapan saja jika kamu membutuhkan bantuanku.
dialogsComplete.it: Thank you very much, my friend! Please see me anytime if you need my help.
dialogsComplete.jp: 何かわたしが手伝えることがあったら、いつでも来てくださいね。うふふ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 정말 고마워요, 도움이 필요하면 언제든 절 찾아오세요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Thank you very much, my friend! Please see me anytime if you need my help.
dialogsComplete.pl: Thank you very much, my friend! Please see me anytime if you need my help.
dialogsComplete.ru: Большое спасибо! Если тебе понадобится гид - обращайся!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Muchas gracias amigo! Por favor, ven siempre que necesites mi ayuda.
dialogsComplete.sw: Thank you very much, my friend! Please see me anytime if you need my help.
dialogsComplete.th: ขอบคุณมากๆ นะ เพื่อน! โปรดมาหาฉันได้ทุกเมื่อหากคุณต้องการความช่วยเหลือจากฉัน
dialogsComplete.tw: 反正謝謝你啦~有需要我幫忙的話，隨時都可以來找我喔~
dialogsComplete.vi: Cảm ơn rất nhiều, bạn tôi! Vui lòng gặp tôi bất cứ lúc nào nếu bạn cần sự giúp đỡ của tôi.

dialogsFail.en: Do you have the Helper Text Books I need? Please hurry, the test is very soon. I'm so nervous!
dialogsFail.ar: Do you have the Helper Text Books I need? Please hurry, the test is very soon. I'm so nervous!
dialogsFail.br: Oh, obrigada, mas este não é o Livro que eu preciso. Por favor, traga-me outro Livro do Ajudante. Desculpe-me.
dialogsFail.cns: 啊，谢谢你帮我找教本，但是我需要的教本不是这个，可以重新帮我找吗?谢谢喔~
dialogsFail.de: Danke, aber dieses Buch ist nicht das, welches ich brauche. Bringe mir bitte das andere Helper Text Book.
dialogsFail.fi: Do you have the Helper Text Books I need? Please hurry, the test is very soon. I'm so nervous!
