name.th: ผู้สืบทอดฮีโร่ -Seal-
name.tw: 英雄的繼承者 - 紋章

description.en: Retrieve the Seal of Aenn from Roy near the Plateau of Silence in Saint Morning, then take it to Clamb, the Ringmaster Sage. You can find him at the Fountain of Dead Person.
description.ar: Retrieve the Seal of Aenn from Roy near the Plateau of Silence in Saint Morning, then take it to Clamb, the Ringmaster Sage. You can find him at the Fountain of Dead Person.
description.br: Recupere o Selo de Aenn de Roy perto do Planalto do Silêncio em Saint Morning, depois leve para o Sábio Ringmaster, Clamb. Você pode encontrá-lo na Fontes dos Mortos.
description.cns: 去晨光梦幻沙漠的邪恶的紫草食人花那找回艾诺纹章之后，再去找位于亡者之潭的守护使者贤者可伯内特！
description.de: Hol dir das Seal of Aenn von Roy in der Nähe des Plateaus der Stille in Saint Morning und bringe es dann zu Clamb, dem Ringmeister-Weisen. Du findest ihn am Brunnen der toten Person.
description.fi: Retrieve the Seal of Aenn from Roy near the Plateau of Silence in Saint Morning, then take it to Clamb, the Ringmaster Sage. You can find him at the Fountain of Dead Person.
description.fil: Retrieve the Seal of Aenn from Roy near the Plateau of Silence in Saint Morning, then take it to Clamb, the Ringmaster Sage. You can find him at the Fountain of Dead Person.
description.fr: Récupérer le Sceau d'Aenn auprès du voleur Roy qu'on dit être au Plateau du Silence, puis le rapporter au Sage des Prêtres Clamb à la Fontaine des Défunts de Flaris.
description.id: Ambil Seal of Aenn dari Roy di dekat Plateau of Silence di Saint Morning, lalu bawa ke Clamb, the Ringmaster Sage. Kamu dapat menemukannya di Fountain of Dead Person.
description.it: Retrieve the Seal of Aenn from Roy near the Plateau of Silence in Saint Morning, then take it to Clamb, the Ringmaster Sage. You can find him at the Fountain of Dead Person.
description.jp: セイントモーニングの沈黙の高原でエーエンヌの印章を取り戻してから、フラリスの魂の泉にいるリングマスター賢者クラムボに会いましょう。
description.kr: 세인트 모닝 침묵의 고원 근처에 있는 로이에게서 에이엔느의 인장을 되찾은 뒤, 망자의 샘에 있는 링마스터 현자 클램브를 찾아가세요.
description.nl: Retrieve the Seal of Aenn from Roy near the Plateau of Silence in Saint Morning, then take it to Clamb, the Ringmaster Sage. You can find him at the Fountain of Dead Person.
description.pl: Retrieve the Seal of Aenn from Roy near the Plateau of Silence in Saint Morning, then take it to Clamb, the Ringmaster Sage. You can find him at the Fountain of Dead Person.
description.ru: Нужно отобрать печать Киу у Потрошонка в Нереальной пустыне и отнести ее старейшине иллюзионистов Кламу. Его можно найти у фонтана Мертвеца.
description.sp: Recupera el Sello de Aenn de Roy cerca de la Meseta del Silencio en Saint Morning, y llévaselo a Clamb, el Sabio Ringmaster. Puedes encontrarlo en el Manantial de Almas.
description.sw: Retrieve the Seal of Aenn from Roy near the Plateau of Silence in Saint Morning, then take it to Clamb, the Ringmaster Sage. You can find him at the Fountain of Dead Person.
description.th: นำ Seal of Aenn มาจาก Ren ที่อยู่ใกล้ Desert Desert Fantasy ใน Saint Morning จากนั้นนำไปให้ Ringmaster Sage ที่ชื่อ Clamb คุณสามารถพบเขาได้ที่ Fountain of Dead Person
description.tw: 去聖音特寂靜高原找回阿利安諾紋章之後，再去找位於亡者之泉的守護者賢者可伯內特！
description.vi: Lấy Seal of Aenn từ Roy gần Plateau of Silence ở Saint Morning, sau đó đưa nó đến Clamb, Ringmaster Sage. Bạn có thể tìm thấy anh ta ở Fountain of Dead Person.

dialogsBegin.en: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Ringmaster. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.ar: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Ringmaster. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.br: Esta é a carta de recomendação que mostra que o mestre o reconhece como um sucessor. Por favor, proteja-a com sua vida. Se você perdê-la, não poderá provar que é reconhecido.
dialogsBegin.cns: 这推荐书表示首领认定继承者的能力，若没有推荐书认定形同无效，所以，请好好保管！！
dialogsBegin.de: Dieses Empfehlungsschreiben beweist, dass dich der Meister als Nachfolger akzeptiert hat. Bitte beschütze es mit deinem Leben. Wenn du es verlierst, kannst du nicht beweisen, dass du anerkannt wurdest.
dialogsBegin.fi: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Ringmaster. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.fil: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Ringmaster. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.fr: Félicitations, voici une lettre de recommandation confirmant que tu es sur la voie de devenir Prêtre.
dialogsBegin.id: Surat rekomendasi ini adalah bukti pencapaianmu sebagai Ringmaster. Jaga itu seperti kamu menjaga hidupmu sendiri.
dialogsBegin.it: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Ringmaster. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.jp: これはマスターが後継者としての資質を認めたという推薦書です。あなたの資質が認められるものですから大事にしてください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 추천서는 링마스터로서 당신이 거둔 성과를 증명하는 증명서랍니다. 목숨처럼 소중히 간직하세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Ringmaster. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.pl: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Ringmaster. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.ru: Это рекомендательное письмо - доказательство того, что тебе удалось пройти мое испытание. Береги его как зеницу ока.
dialogsBegin.sp: Esta carta de recomendación es prueba de sus progresos como Ringmaster. Guárdalo como si fuera tu propia vida.
dialogsBegin.sw: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Ringmaster. Guard it as you would your own life.
dialogsBegin.th: จดหมายแนะนำฉบับนี้เป็นข้อพิสูจน์ถึงความสำเร็จของคุณในการเป็น Ringmaster จงรักษามันไว้ยิ่งชีพล่ะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 這推薦書表示首領認定繼承者的能力，若沒有推薦書認定形同無效，所以，請好好保管！！
dialogsBegin.vi: Thư giới thiệu này là bằng chứng về thành tích của bạn với tư cách là Ringmaster. Hãy bảo vệ nó như chính cuộc sống của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Take it to Clamb, the Ringmaster Sage. He resides at the The Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.ar: Take it to Clamb, the Ringmaster Sage. He resides at the The Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.br: Por favor, entregue a carta de recomendação para Clamb, o sábio Ringmaster. Ele fica na Fonte das Pessoas Mortas, ao norte, nas Montanhas Lerem.
dialogsBegin.cns: 把那推荐书拿给位于乐雅山脉北部亡者之潭的守护使者的贤者【可伯内特】。
dialogsBegin.de: Bitte bring das Empfehlungsschreiben zu Clamb, dem Ringmaster Weisen. Er ist an der Quelle der verstorbenen Seelen im Norden des Leren Gebirges.
dialogsBegin.fi: Take it to Clamb, the Ringmaster Sage. He resides at the The Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.fil: Take it to Clamb, the Ringmaster Sage. He resides at the The Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il faut que tu l'apportes à Clamb, le Sage des Prêtres qui se trouve à la Fontaine des Défunts de Flaris. Mais avant cela, j'aimerais que tu retrouves le Sceau d'Aenn, Héros des Prêtres.
dialogsBegin.id: Bawa ke Clam, Sage Ringmaster. Dia tinggal di The Fountain of Dead Person di Pegunungan Leren Utara.
dialogsBegin.it: Take it to Clamb, the Ringmaster Sage. He resides at the The Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.jp: それではフラリスのレルエン山脈北部にある魂の泉に行って、リングマスター賢者クラムボにその推薦書を渡してください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이걸 레르엔 산맥 북부 망자의 샘에 있는 링마스터 현자, 클램브님께 전달하세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Take it to Clamb, the Ringmaster Sage. He resides at the The Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.pl: Take it to Clamb, the Ringmaster Sage. He resides at the The Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.ru: Отнеси его старейшине иллюзионистов Кламу. Его можно найти у фонтана Мертвеца на севере Леренских горок.
dialogsBegin.sp: Entrégaselo a Clamb, el Sabio Ringmaster. Le puedes encontrar en el Manantial de Almas al Norte de las Montañas Leren.
dialogsBegin.sw: Take it to Clamb, the Ringmaster Sage. He resides at the The Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.th: นำมันไปหา Ringmaster Sage ที่ชื่อ Clamb เขาอาศัยอยู่ที่ The Fountain of Dead Person ใน Leren Mountains
dialogsBegin.tw: 把那推廌書拿給位於勒倫山脈北部亡者之泉的守護者的賢者 [可伯內特]。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đưa nó cho Clamb, Ringmaster Sage. Anh ta cư trú tại The Fountain of Dead Person ở Northern Leren Mountains.

dialogsBegin.en: Before you do that, however, retrieve the Seal of Aenn from Roy near the Plateau of Silence in Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.ar: Before you do that, however, retrieve the Seal of Aenn from Roy near the Plateau of Silence in Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.br: Ah, antes de você fazer isso, você deve recuperar o Selo de Aenn que está com Roy perto do Planalto do Silêncio em Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.cns: 首先，请先到晨光梦幻沙漠跟找回艾诺纹章！
dialogsBegin.de: Bevor du das tust, musst du dir jedoch das Seal of Aenn von Roy in der Nähe des Plateaus der Stille in Saint Morning holen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Before you do that, however, retrieve the Seal of Aenn from Roy near the Plateau of Silence in Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.fil: Before you do that, however, retrieve the Seal of Aenn from Roy near the Plateau of Silence in Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.fr: Ce sceau sacré est en possession Roy, qu'on dit être sur le Plateau du Silence à Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.id: Namun, sebelum Anda melakukannya, ambil Seal of Aenn dari Roy di dekat Plateau of Silence di Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.it: Before you do that, however, retrieve the Seal of Aenn from Roy near the Plateau of Silence in Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.jp: その前に、セイントモーニング沈黙の高原近くに住んでいるロイからエイエンの封印を手に入れてください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 하지만 그 전에 먼저, 세인트 모닝 침묵의 고원 근처에 있는 로이에게서 에이엔느의 인장을 되찾아야 합니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Before you do that, however, retrieve the Seal of Aenn from Roy near the Plateau of Silence in Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.pl: Before you do that, however, retrieve the Seal of Aenn from Roy near the Plateau of Silence in Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.ru: Before you do that, however, retrieve the Seal of Aenn from Roy near the Plateau of Silence in Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.sp: Antes de hacer eso, recupera el Sello de Aenn que tiene Roy cerca de la Meseta del Silencio en Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.sw: Before you do that, however, retrieve the Seal of Aenn from Roy near the Plateau of Silence in Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.th: แต่ก่อนที่คุณจะทำเรื่องที่ว่า ให้คุณนำ Seal of Aenn จาก Ren ที่อยู่ใกล้ๆ กับ Fantasy Desert ขอเมือง Saint Morning
dialogsBegin.tw: 首先，請先到聖音特寂靜高原找回阿利安諾紋章！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tuy nhiên, trước khi làm điều đó, hãy lấy Seal of Aenn từ Roy gần Plateau of Silence ở Saint Morning.

dialogsAccept.en: May Aenn’s mercy be with you always.
dialogsAccept.ar: May Aenn’s mercy be with you always.
dialogsAccept.br: Desejo que a piedade de Aenn esteja sempre com você.
dialogsAccept.cns: 愿艾诺的宽仁与你常在。
dialogsAccept.de: Ich wünsche, dass die Gnade von Aenn ewig mit dir ist.
dialogsAccept.fi: May Aenn’s mercy be with you always.
dialogsAccept.fil: May Aenn’s mercy be with you always.
dialogsAccept.fr: Que la sagesse d'Aenn t'accompagne dans ta quête !
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga rahmat Aenn selalu bersamamu.
dialogsAccept.it: May Aenn’s mercy be with you always.
dialogsAccept.jp: 幸運の女神があなたに振り向きますように。
dialogsAccept.kr: 에이엔느의 자비가 당신과 늘 함께하길...
dialogsAccept.nl: May Aenn’s mercy be with you always.
dialogsAccept.pl: May Aenn’s mercy be with you always.
dialogsAccept.ru: Да пребудет с тобой сила Киу.
dialogsAccept.sp: Que la misericordia de Aenn esté siempre contigo.
dialogsAccept.sw: May Aenn’s mercy be with you always.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้ความเมตตาของ Aenn อยู่กับคุณตลอดไป
dialogsAccept.tw: 祝你好運！！
dialogsAccept.vi: Cầu mong sự nhân từ của Aenn luôn ở bên bạn.

dialogsDecline.en: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.ar: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.br: Não se subestime. Você deve ser forte, ou não poderá se tornar um sucessor. Por que desistir agora?
dialogsDecline.cns: 你已经做到这了，为什么还要放弃呢？
dialogsDecline.de: Du bist schon so weit gekommen, warum solltest du jetzt aufgeben?
dialogsDecline.fi: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.fil: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.fr: Ne sous-estime jamais tes capacités ! Tu dois être fort, ou tu ne deviendras jamais un Héros.
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu sudah sampai sejauh ini, mengapa menyerah sekarang?
dialogsDecline.it: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.jp: 自分に勇気がないなどと思わないでください。あなたには力がある･･･。そんな簡単に諦めてはいけません。
dialogsDecline.kr: 여기까지 왔는데, 왜 그만두시려 하시죠?
dialogsDecline.nl: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.pl: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.ru: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.sp: Ya has llegado muy lejos, ¿te vas a rendir ahora?
dialogsDecline.sw: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsDecline.th: คุณมาได้ไกลแล้ว ทำไมถึงคิดจะยอมแพ้ในตอนนี้?
dialogsDecline.tw: 已經走到這一步了，為什麼要放棄呢？
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn đã đi quá xa, tại sao bây giờ lại từ bỏ?

dialogsComplete.en: The Seal of Aenn! Someone’s finally found the Aenn family symbol!
dialogsComplete.ar: The Seal of Aenn! Someone’s finally found the Aenn family symbol!
dialogsComplete.br: Hmm? Esse, esse é o Selo de Aenn! Você finalmente o encontrou! Este é o símbolo da família de Aenn, portanto é uma relíquia muito valiosa.
dialogsComplete.cns: 终于找回艾诺纹章了！这纹章可是价值连城的宝物！
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm? Das ist das Seal of Aenn! Du hast es gefunden! Es ist das Symbol der Familie von Aenn und ein wertvolles Relikt.
dialogsComplete.fi: The Seal of Aenn! Someone’s finally found the Aenn family symbol!
dialogsComplete.fil: The Seal of Aenn! Someone’s finally found the Aenn family symbol!
dialogsComplete.fr: Elle a été volée il y a longtemps par Hunter X, mais nous n'avons jamais pu le localiser précisément ce voleur.
dialogsComplete.id: Segel Aenn! Seseorang akhirnya menemukan simbol keluarga Aenn!
dialogsComplete.it: The Seal of Aenn! Someone’s finally found the Aenn family symbol!
dialogsComplete.jp: おお、これはエーエンヌ様の印章。おぬしが見つけたのか！この印章はエーエンヌ様の家門を象徴する印章で、とても価値のある聖遺物じゃ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이게 바로 에이엔느 가문의 상징, 에이엔느의 인장이군요! 드디어 찾다니!
dialogsComplete.nl: The Seal of Aenn! Someone’s finally found the Aenn family symbol!
dialogsComplete.pl: The Seal of Aenn! Someone’s finally found the Aenn family symbol!
dialogsComplete.ru: Печать Киу! Она наконец-то найдена!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡El Sello de Aenn! ¡Por fin alguien ha encontrado el símbolo de la familia Aenn!
dialogsComplete.sw: The Seal of Aenn! Someone’s finally found the Aenn family symbol!
dialogsComplete.th: ตราประทับของ Aenn! ในที่สุดก็มีคนพบตราสัญลักษณ์ของครอบครัว Aenn!
dialogsComplete.tw: 終於找回阿利安諾紋章了！這紋章可是價值連城的寶物！
dialogsComplete.vi: Seal of Aenn! Ai đó cuối cùng đã tìm thấy biểu tượng của gia đình Aenn!

dialogsComplete.en: I’d always heard that Roy would steal anything of value, but I never thought he’d have a mind to take the Seal!
dialogsComplete.ar: I’d always heard that Roy would steal anything of value, but I never thought he’d have a mind to take the Seal!
dialogsComplete.br: Eu ouvi um rumor que Ren gosta de qualquer coisa valiosa, que foi coletada há muito tempo. Agora vejo que o rumor era verdade. Maldito!
dialogsComplete.cns: 听说是被魔域怪偷走的，真是讨厌的家伙！！
dialogsComplete.de: Ich habe ein Gerücht gehört, dass Ren alles mag, was wertvoll ist. Ich weiß nun, dass das Gerücht wahr ist. Verdammt!
dialogsComplete.fi: I’d always heard that Roy would steal anything of value, but I never thought he’d have a mind to take the Seal!
dialogsComplete.fil: I’d always heard that Roy would steal anything of value, but I never thought he’d have a mind to take the Seal!
dialogsComplete.fr: Il avait été volé il y a quelques années par Roy, qui est un amateur d'objet précieux. Mais cette relique était trop précieuse pour lui laisser.
dialogsComplete.id: Saya selalu mendengar bahwa Roy akan mencuri sesuatu yang berharga, tetapi saya tidak pernah berpikir dia akan memiliki pikiran untuk mengambil segel!
dialogsComplete.it: I’d always heard that Roy would steal anything of value, but I never thought he’d have a mind to take the Seal!
dialogsComplete.jp: 高価なものには目がないレンというやつがこれを盗んだという噂があったが、それは本当だったということじゃな。
dialogsComplete.kr: 로이가 가치 있는 물건은 뭐든 훔친다는 얘긴 들었지만, 설마 인장까지 노릴 줄은 몰랐군요!
dialogsComplete.nl: I’d always heard that Roy would steal anything of value, but I never thought he’d have a mind to take the Seal!
dialogsComplete.pl: I’d always heard that Roy would steal anything of value, but I never thought he’d have a mind to take the Seal!
dialogsComplete.ru: Я, конечно, знал, что Потрошонок тащит все, что не приколочено, но покуситься на саму печать… на Печать!..
dialogsComplete.sp: Escuché que Roy robaría cualquier cosa de valor, ¡pero nunca pensé que tendría en mente robar el Sello!
dialogsComplete.sw: I’d always heard that Roy would steal anything of value, but I never thought he’d have a mind to take the Seal!
dialogsComplete.th: ฉันเคยได้ยินมาว่า Ren จะขโมยทุกอย่างที่มีค่า แต่ฉันไม่เคยคิดว่าเขาจะมีความคิดที่จะเอา Seal!
dialogsComplete.tw: 聽說是被魔域怪偷走的，真是討厭的傢伙！！
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi luôn nghe nói rằng Roy sẽ ăn cắp bất cứ thứ gì có giá trị, nhưng tôi chưa bao giờ nghĩ rằng anh ấy có ý định lấy Seal!

dialogsComplete.en: Your efforts are most appreciated!
dialogsComplete.ar: Your efforts are most appreciated!
dialogsComplete.br: Agradeço profundamente o seu esforço em encontrá-lo. Obrigado.
dialogsComplete.cns: 辛苦你了~
dialogsComplete.de: Ich bedanke mich herzlich für deine Mühe. Danke.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your efforts are most appreciated!
dialogsComplete.fil: Your efforts are most appreciated!
dialogsComplete.fr: J'apprécie vraiment les efforts que tu as fournis pour le retrouver. Merci, merci infiniment !
dialogsComplete.id: Usahamu sangat dihargai!
dialogsComplete.it: Your efforts are most appreciated!
dialogsComplete.jp: ようやってくれた。ありがとうな。
dialogsComplete.kr: 정말 감사드립니다!
dialogsComplete.nl: Your efforts are most appreciated!
dialogsComplete.pl: Your efforts are most appreciated!
dialogsComplete.ru: Спасибо за помощь!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Tus esfuerzos de este día siempre serán recordados!
dialogsComplete.sw: Your efforts are most appreciated!
dialogsComplete.th: ความพยายามของคุณจะได้รับการยอมรับ!
dialogsComplete.tw: 辛苦你了~
dialogsComplete.vi: Những nỗ lực của bạn được đánh giá cao nhất!

dialogsFail.en: You're a long way from a doctor’s office… but I am still a healer of the sick and injured.
dialogsFail.ar: You're a long way from a doctor’s office… but I am still a healer of the sick and injured.
dialogsFail.br: Há muito tempo, eu era um médico. Eu podia curar qualquer doença ou ferimento! Ha ha ha! De qualquer jeito, agora vou curar meus co-operadores.
dialogsFail.cns: 我之前是医疗神官，虽然目前没有这职业，不过，之前满有名的~呵呵，我现在仍会帮其他人治疗看病喔！
dialogsFail.de: Ich war vor langer Zeit Arzt. Ich konnte jede Krankheit oder Wunde heilen! Naja mittlerweile heile ich meine Mitarbeiter.
dialogsFail.fi: You're a long way from a doctor’s office… but I am still a healer of the sick and injured.
dialogsFail.fil: You're a long way from a doctor’s office… but I am still a healer of the sick and injured.
dialogsFail.fr: Les âmes de nombreuses personnes vont et viennent ici à la Fontaine des Défunts. C'est ici la limite entre la vie et la mort.
dialogsFail.id: Kamu jauh dari kantor dokter ... tapi saya masih penyembuh yang sakit dan terluka
dialogsFail.it: You're a long way from a doctor’s office… but I am still a healer of the sick and injured.
dialogsFail.jp: わしは以前医療神官じゃった。今はなくなった職業じゃがの。当時は＜神の癒し手＞とよばれて、若いギャルに大人気じゃったわい！カッカッカッ。
dialogsFail.kr: 여긴 병원이 아니지만, 저는 여전히 병들고 다친 이들을 치유하죠.
dialogsFail.nl: You're a long way from a doctor’s office… but I am still a healer of the sick and injured.
dialogsFail.pl: You're a long way from a doctor’s office… but I am still a healer of the sick and injured.
dialogsFail.ru: Врачей поблизости нет... но ведь и я тоже лекарь.
dialogsFail.sp: Estás muy lejos de tener un consultorio médico... pero siges siendo un sanador de enfermos y heridos.
dialogsFail.sw: You're a long way from a doctor’s office… but I am still a healer of the sick and injured.
dialogsFail.th: คุณอยุ่ห่างจากออฟฟิศของหมอ... แต่ฉันก็เป็นหมอสำหรับคนที่ป่วยและบาดเจ็บอยุ่
dialogsFail.tw: 我之前是醫療神官，雖然目前沒有這職業，不過，之前滿有名的~呵呵，我現在仍會幫其他人治療看病喔！
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn còn một quãng đường dài đến văn phòng bác sĩ… nhưng tôi vẫn là người chữa lành cho người bị bệnh và bị thương.

description.en: Kill 8 Small Bucrow & 4 Bucrow while in a party and return to the Mayor of Saint City.
description.ar: Kill 8 Small Bucrow & 4 Bucrow while in a party and return to the Mayor of Saint City.
description.br: Elimine 8 Bucrows Pequenos e 4 Bucrows enquanto estiver em um grupo e volte para informar o Prefeito.
description.cns: 请在组队的情况下杀死8个小巴科洛和4个巴科洛，然后回去找晨光市长。
description.de: Töte 8 Small Bucrow & 4 Bucrow in einer Party und kehre anschliessend zum Bürgermeister von Saint City zurück.
description.fi: Kill 8 Small Bucrow & 4 Bucrow while in a party and return to the Mayor of Saint City.
description.fil: Kill 8 Small Bucrow & 4 Bucrow while in a party and return to the Mayor of Saint City.
description.fr: Tuez 8 Jeunes Bucrow et 4 Bucrow et parlez au maire de Saincity.
description.id: Bunuh 8 Small Bucrow dan 4 Bucrow saat bergabung di party dan kembali ke Walikota Saint City.
description.it: Kill 8 Small Bucrow & 4 Bucrow while in a party and return to the Mayor of Saint City.
description.jp: パーティーを組んでスモールバクロウを8体、バクロウを4体倒して、セイントモーニング市長に報告せよ。
description.kr: 극단을 맺은 상태에서 작은 버크로 8마리와 버크로 4마리를 처치한 뒤, 세인트 시티의 시장에게 돌아가세요.
description.nl: Kill 8 Small Bucrow & 4 Bucrow while in a party and return to the Mayor of Saint City.
description.pl: Kill 8 Small Bucrow & 4 Bucrow while in a party and return to the Mayor of Saint City.
description.ru: Kill 8 Small Bucrow & 4 Bucrow while in a party and return to the Mayor of Saint City.
description.sp: Derrota a 8 Bucrows Pequeños y a 4 Bucrows mientras estás en Party y vuelve con el Alcalde de Saint.
description.sw: Kill 8 Small Bucrow & 4 Bucrow while in a party and return to the Mayor of Saint City.
description.th: ฆ่า 8 Small Bucrow & 4 Bucrow ในขณะที่อยู่ในปาร์ตี้และกลับไปหานายกเทศมนตรีเมือง Saint Morning
description.tw: 在劇團中殺死 8 隻赤火巴斯克和 4 隻赤焰巴斯克，然後返回聖音特市長處。
description.vi: Giết 8 Small Bucrow & 4 Bucrow khi đang ở trong một bữa tiệc và quay trở lại Thị trưởng thành phố Saint.

dialogsBegin.en: Do you know about the Bucrow? They are protectors of the natural order that have existed long before man. They have since grown malicious, and attack our citizens.
dialogsBegin.ar: Do you know about the Bucrow? They are protectors of the natural order that have existed long before man. They have since grown malicious, and attack our citizens.
dialogsBegin.br: Você tem conhecimento sobre os Bucrows? Eles são os protetores da ordem natural que existia muito antes do homem. Desde então, eles se tornaram maliciosos e atacam nossos cidadãos.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你知道巴科洛吗？他们是人类出现之前就存在的自然秩序守护者。但是现在他们变得敌视人类，还会攻击我们的居民。
dialogsBegin.de: Weißt du etwas über die Bucrow? Sie sind Beschützer der natürlichen Ordnung, die schon lange vor dem Menschen existiert haben. Inzwischen sind sie bösartig geworden und greifen unsere Bürger an.
dialogsBegin.fi: Do you know about the Bucrow? They are protectors of the natural order that have existed long before man. They have since grown malicious, and attack our citizens.
dialogsBegin.fil: Do you know about the Bucrow? They are protectors of the natural order that have existed long before man. They have since grown malicious, and attack our citizens.
dialogsBegin.fr: Les Bucrow étaient jadis des créatures paisibles mais depuis quelques temps ils attaquent les humains.
dialogsBegin.id: Apakah kamu tahu tentang Bucrow? Mereka adalah pelindung tatanan alam yang telah ada jauh sebelum manusia. Sejak saat itu mereka menjadi jahat, dan menyerang warga kita.
dialogsBegin.it: Do you know about the Bucrow? They are protectors of the natural order that have existed long before man. They have since grown malicious, and attack our citizens.
dialogsBegin.jp: バクロウはわかりますか？　セイントモーニングができる遥か昔、この地の精霊として讃えられていた存在です。最近になってこの精霊が凶暴化してしまったようです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 버크로에 대해 아시나요? 인류가 생기기 훨씬 전부터 존재해 온, 자연의 질서를 지키는 수호자 같은 존재죠. 그런데 어느 순간 난폭해지더니 사람들을 공격하고 있어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Do you know about the Bucrow? They are protectors of the natural order that have existed long before man. They have since grown malicious, and attack our citizens.
dialogsBegin.pl: Do you know about the Bucrow? They are protectors of the natural order that have existed long before man. They have since grown malicious, and attack our citizens.
dialogsBegin.ru: Ты слышал о тавродемонах? Это очень древние защитники природы, намного старше людей. Когда-то всё было хорошо, но теперь они взбесились и атакуют горожан.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Sabes quiénes son los Bucrow? Son protectores del orden natural que han existido desde mucho antes que el hombre. Se han vuelto malvados y atacan a nuestros ciudadanos.
dialogsBegin.sw: Do you know about the Bucrow? They are protectors of the natural order that have existed long before man. They have since grown malicious, and attack our citizens.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณรู้จัก Bucrow ไหม ? พวกเขาเป็นผู้ปกป้องธรรมชาติที่มีอยู่ก่อนหน้ามนุษย์ แต่เขาโดนเวทมนต์บางอย่างทำให้ทำร้ายชาวบ้าน
dialogsBegin.tw: 你知道巴斯克嗎？他們是早在人類之前就存在的自然的保護者。不知從那時候開始，他們漸漸變得邪惡了，並攻擊我們的人。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có biết về Bucrow? Họ là những người bảo vệ trật tự tự nhiên đã có từ rất lâu trước con người. Kể từ đó, chúng trở nên độc hại và tấn công công dân của chúng ta.

dialogsBegin.en: I believe the sudden increase in the amount of monsters is to blame. Bucrow are very in tune with the balance of nature, and have become enraged with its disintegration
dialogsBegin.ar: I believe the sudden increase in the amount of monsters is to blame. Bucrow are very in tune with the balance of nature, and have become enraged with its disintegration
dialogsBegin.br: Eu acredito que o aumento repentino na quantidade de monstros é o culpado. Bucrows sempre estão muito em sintonia com o equilíbrio da natureza e deve ter ficado furioso com sua desintegração.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我相信这是因为怪物的数量激增导致的问题。巴科洛对大自然的平衡非常敏感，如果大自然的平衡被打破就会让他们异常愤怒。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich glaube, dass die plötzliche Zunahme von Monstern daran schuld ist. Die Bucrow sind sehr gut mit dem Gleichgewicht der Natur vertraut und sind wütend über dessen Zerfall geworden
dialogsBegin.fi: I believe the sudden increase in the amount of monsters is to blame. Bucrow are very in tune with the balance of nature, and have become enraged with its disintegration
dialogsBegin.fil: I believe the sudden increase in the amount of monsters is to blame. Bucrow are very in tune with the balance of nature, and have become enraged with its disintegration
dialogsBegin.fr: Je ne saurais pas expliquer pourquoi ils se comportent comme ça mais il va falloir leur rappeler qui commande ici.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya percaya peningkatan jumlah monster yang tiba-tiba adalah penyebabnya. Bucrow sangat selaras dengan keseimbangan alam, dan menjadi marah jika ada disintegrasi.
dialogsBegin.it: I believe the sudden increase in the amount of monsters is to blame. Bucrow are very in tune with the balance of nature, and have become enraged with its disintegration
dialogsBegin.jp: 各地でモンスターの凶暴化が進んでいます。これは何かの予兆なのかもしれません。私も不穏なオーラを常に感じています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 갑작스럽게 몬스터 수가 급증한 것이 원인이 아닐까 싶습니다. 버크로는 자연의 균형에 민감한 존재라, 그걸 느끼고 분노한 것 같아요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I believe the sudden increase in the amount of monsters is to blame. Bucrow are very in tune with the balance of nature, and have become enraged with its disintegration
dialogsBegin.pl: I believe the sudden increase in the amount of monsters is to blame. Bucrow are very in tune with the balance of nature, and have become enraged with its disintegration
dialogsBegin.ru: Наверное, винить стоит резкое увеличение числа марионеток. Тавродемоны очень чувствительны к изменениям в природе.
dialogsBegin.sp: Creo que el aumento repentino de la cantidad de monstruos es el culpable. Los Bucrow están muy en sintonía con el equilibrio de la naturaleza y se han enfurecido con su desintegración.
dialogsBegin.sw: I believe the sudden increase in the amount of monsters is to blame. Bucrow are very in tune with the balance of nature, and have become enraged with its disintegration
dialogsBegin.th: ตอนนี้ Bucrow กำลังขยายพันธุ์เพิ่มขึ้นเรื่อยๆ
dialogsBegin.tw: 我相信怪物數量的突然增加是主要原因，巴斯克非常渴望自然的平衡，對自然的環境漸漸被破壞自然會感到憤怒。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi tin rằng số lượng quái vật tăng đột biến là điều đáng trách. Bucrow rất hòa hợp với sự cân bằng của tự nhiên, và đã trở nên tức giận với sự tan rã của nó

dialogsBegin.en: I must warn you though. Bucrow are very strong, which is why I've asked you to unite with other champions in this task. Please, will you help us to defeat them?
dialogsBegin.ar: I must warn you though. Bucrow are very strong, which is why I've asked you to unite with other champions in this task. Please, will you help us to defeat them?
dialogsBegin.br: Devo avisá-lo. Bucrows são muito fortes, por isso peço que você una-se a outros campeões nessa tarefa. Por favor, poderia nos ajudar a derrotá-los?
dialogsBegin.cns: 但我必须要警告你。巴科洛非常强大。这就是为什么我要求你和其他的英雄合作执行该任务。请问你是否愿意帮我们击败他们？
dialogsBegin.de: Ich muss euch allerdings warnen. Die Bucrow sind sehr stark, und deshalb habe ich Euch gebeten, Euch mit anderen Champions zusammenzutun, um diese Aufgabe zu bewältigen. Bitte, werdet ihr uns helfen, sie zu besiegen?
dialogsBegin.fi: I must warn you though. Bucrow are very strong, which is why I've asked you to unite with other champions in this task. Please, will you help us to defeat them?
dialogsBegin.fil: I must warn you though. Bucrow are very strong, which is why I've asked you to unite with other champions in this task. Please, will you help us to defeat them?
dialogsBegin.fr: Comme nos gardes n'arrivent pas à les chasser, je vais devoir faire appel à vous. Je vous recommande quand même d'y aller avec des amis.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya harus memperingatkanmu. Bucrow sangatlah kuat, itulah sebabnya saya memintamu untuk bersatu dengan yang lain dalam tugas ini. Maukah kamu membantu kami untuk mengalahkan mereka?
dialogsBegin.it: I must warn you though. Bucrow are very strong, which is why I've asked you to unite with other champions in this task. Please, will you help us to defeat them?
dialogsBegin.jp: モンスターの生態系が崩れたことにより精霊も何か影響があったのかもしれません。このバクロウはとても強力で警備兵が束になっても敵いません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 미리 경고해 두지만, 버크로는 아주 강력한 존재예요. 그래서 여러 영웅이 힘을 합쳐야 한다고 부탁한 거랍니다. 부디, 버크로를 처치해 주시겠어요?
dialogsBegin.nl: I must warn you though. Bucrow are very strong, which is why I've asked you to unite with other champions in this task. Please, will you help us to defeat them?
dialogsBegin.pl: I must warn you though. Bucrow are very strong, which is why I've asked you to unite with other champions in this task. Please, will you help us to defeat them?
dialogsBegin.ru: Но предупреждаю - они очень сильны. Лучше найди кого-нибудь себе на подмогу.
dialogsBegin.sp: Aunque debo advertirte. Los Bucrow son muy fuertes, por eso te aconsejo que te unas a otros campeones en esta tarea. Por favor, ¿nos ayudarás a derrotarlos?
dialogsBegin.sw: I must warn you though. Bucrow are very strong, which is why I've asked you to unite with other champions in this task. Please, will you help us to defeat them?
dialogsBegin.th: Bucrow มีความแข็งแรงมาก ขอให้คุณหาปาร์ตี้กับคนอื่นแล้วจัดการมัน ช่วยเอาชนะพวกมันได้ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 不過我必須警告你，巴斯克非常強大，這就是為什麼我要求你在這個任務中與其他英雄聯合起來對抗。拜託，你會幫助我們打敗他們嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi phải cảnh báo bạn mặc dù. Bucrow rất mạnh, đó là lý do tại sao tôi đã yêu cầu bạn hợp nhất với các nhà vô địch khác trong nhiệm vụ này. Làm ơn, bạn sẽ giúp chúng tôi đánh bại họ?

dialogsAccept.en: You and your band of allies must travel to Saint Morning's southernmost region known as the Fantasy Desert. This is where the Bucrow primarily reside.
dialogsAccept.ar: You and your band of allies must travel to Saint Morning's southernmost region known as the Fantasy Desert. This is where the Bucrow primarily reside.
dialogsAccept.br: Você e seu grupo de aliados devem viajar para a região mais ao sul de Saint Morning, conhecida como o Deserto da Fantasia. É lá que os Bucrow estão.
dialogsAccept.cns: 你和你的队友必须前往晨光最南部被称为梦幻沙漠的地区。那里是巴科洛主要的栖息地。
dialogsAccept.de: Du und deine Verbündeten müssen in die südlichste Region von Saint Morning reisen, die als Fantasy Desert bekannt ist. Dort leben hauptsächlich die Bucrow.
dialogsAccept.fi: You and your band of allies must travel to Saint Morning's southernmost region known as the Fantasy Desert. This is where the Bucrow primarily reside.
dialogsAccept.fil: You and your band of allies must travel to Saint Morning's southernmost region known as the Fantasy Desert. This is where the Bucrow primarily reside.
dialogsAccept.fr: Allez, vous savez tout. Revenez me voir quand vous en aurez tué quelques-uns.
dialogsAccept.id: Kamu dan sekutumu harus melakukan perjalanan ke wilayah paling selatan di Saint Morning yang dikenal sebagai Fantasy Desert. Di sinilah Bucrow sering tinggal.
dialogsAccept.it: You and your band of allies must travel to Saint Morning's southernmost region known as the Fantasy Desert. This is where the Bucrow primarily reside.
dialogsAccept.jp: 一人ではとても危険です。パーティーを組み、このバクロウを倒して貰えませんか？
dialogsAccept.kr: 버크로는 세인트 모닝 남쪽 끝, 몽환의 사막 일대에 많이 나타나고 있습니다. 극단과 함께 그리로 가 주시겠어요?
dialogsAccept.nl: You and your band of allies must travel to Saint Morning's southernmost region known as the Fantasy Desert. This is where the Bucrow primarily reside.
dialogsAccept.pl: You and your band of allies must travel to Saint Morning's southernmost region known as the Fantasy Desert. This is where the Bucrow primarily reside.
dialogsAccept.ru: Последний раз тавродемонов видели на самом юге Санто, в Нереальной Пустыне.
dialogsAccept.sp: Tú y tu banda de aliados debéis viajar a la región más al sur de Saint Morning conocida como Desierto Fantasía. Allí es donde residen los Bucrow.
dialogsAccept.sw: You and your band of allies must travel to Saint Morning's southernmost region known as the Fantasy Desert. This is where the Bucrow primarily reside.
dialogsAccept.th: คุณต้องเดินทางไปที่บริเวณใต้สุดของ Saint Morning ที่รู้จักกันในนาม Desert นี่คือที่ที่ Bucrow อาศัยอยู่เป็นหลัก
dialogsAccept.tw: 你和你的盟友必須前往聖音特最南端地區的夢幻沙漠，這是巴斯克主要居住的地方。
dialogsAccept.vi: Bạn và nhóm đồng minh của bạn phải đi đến vùng cực nam của Saint Morning, được gọi là Fantasy Desert. Đây là nơi cư trú chính của Bucrow.

dialogsDecline.en: I might not know with any certainty how the Bucrow first began to become so vicious, but what I do know is that we must do something about them soon!
dialogsDecline.ar: I might not know with any certainty how the Bucrow first began to become so vicious, but what I do know is that we must do something about them soon!
dialogsDecline.br: Posso não saber com toda certeza como o Bucrow começou a ficar tão cruel, mas o que sei é que devemos fazer algo a respeito em breve!
dialogsDecline.cns: 我并不知道巴科洛是如何变得如此狂暴的，但我唯一清楚的就是我们必须马上对他们采取一些必要措施！
dialogsDecline.de: Ich weiß zwar nicht mit Sicherheit, wie die Bucrow so bösartig geworden sind, aber ich weiß, dass wir bald etwas gegen sie unternehmen müssen!
dialogsDecline.fi: I might not know with any certainty how the Bucrow first began to become so vicious, but what I do know is that we must do something about them soon!
dialogsDecline.fil: I might not know with any certainty how the Bucrow first began to become so vicious, but what I do know is that we must do something about them soon!
dialogsDecline.fr: Et moi qui pensais que vous étiez un vrai héros…
dialogsDecline.id: Saya mungkin tidak tahu dengan pasti bagaimana Bucrow pertama kali menjadi begitu kejam, tetapi yang saya tahu adalah bahwa kita harus segera melakukan sesuatu terhadap mereka!
dialogsDecline.it: I might not know with any certainty how the Bucrow first began to become so vicious, but what I do know is that we must do something about them soon!
dialogsDecline.jp: どうしてこのようなことに……このままではセイントモーニングは壊滅してしまうでしょう。
dialogsDecline.kr: 버크로가 왜 이렇게 흉포해졌는지 잘 모르겠지만, 이대로 두면 더 위험해질 게 분명합니다! 우리가 나서야 해요!
dialogsDecline.nl: I might not know with any certainty how the Bucrow first began to become so vicious, but what I do know is that we must do something about them soon!
dialogsDecline.pl: I might not know with any certainty how the Bucrow first began to become so vicious, but what I do know is that we must do something about them soon!
dialogsDecline.ru: Я не знаю, что послужило причиной, но атаки надо прекратить!
dialogsDecline.sp: No sé con certeza cómo los Bucrow se han comenzado a volver tan perversos, pero lo que sí sé es que debemos hacer algo al respecto pronto.
dialogsDecline.sw: I might not know with any certainty how the Bucrow first began to become so vicious, but what I do know is that we must do something about them soon!
dialogsDecline.th: สิ่งที่ฉันรู้ก็คือเราต้องทำอะไรบางอย่างให้เร็วที่สุด
dialogsDecline.tw: 我可不確定巴斯克最初是如何開始變得如此兇殘，但我所知道的是我們必須盡快對它們採取行動！
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi có thể không biết chắc chắn bằng cách nào mà lần đầu tiên Bucrow trở nên hung ác như vậy, nhưng điều tôi biết là chúng ta phải sớm làm gì đó với chúng!

dialogsComplete.en: Done already!? My thanks go out to you and your allies. Sometimes companionship is the key to victory! As soon as you reach level 30, please return to me as I have another request.
dialogsComplete.ar: Done already!? My thanks go out to you and your allies. Sometimes companionship is the key to victory! As soon as you reach level 30, please return to me as I have another request.
dialogsComplete.br: Já resolveu!? Meus agradecimentos a você e seus aliados. Às vezes, o companheirismo é a chave para a vitória! Assim que você atingir o nível 30, por favor, me informe, pois tenho outra solicitação para fazer.
dialogsComplete.cns: 已经完成了吗！？非常感谢你和你的队友。有时候友谊才是胜利的关键！一旦你到了30级时，请回来找我，我有新的任务要交给你。
dialogsComplete.de: Schon erledigt!? Mein Dank geht an Sie und Ihre Verbündeten. Manchmal ist Kameradschaft der Schlüssel zum Sieg! Sobald Ihr Stufe 30 erreicht habt, kommt bitte zu mir zurück, denn ich habe eine weitere Bitte.
dialogsComplete.fi: Done already!? My thanks go out to you and your allies. Sometimes companionship is the key to victory! As soon as you reach level 30, please return to me as I have another request.
dialogsComplete.fil: Done already!? My thanks go out to you and your allies. Sometimes companionship is the key to victory! As soon as you reach level 30, please return to me as I have another request.
dialogsComplete.fr: Chasser des monstres avec vos partenaires est plus agréable hein ? Merci de votre aide en tout cas.
dialogsComplete.id: Sudah selesai!? Terima kasih untukmu dan sekutumu. Terkadang persahabatan adalah kunci kemenangan! Segera setelah kamu mencapai level 30, silakan kembali kepada saya karena saya memiliki permintaan lain.
dialogsComplete.it: Done already!? My thanks go out to you and your allies. Sometimes companionship is the key to victory! As soon as you reach level 30, please return to me as I have another request.
dialogsComplete.jp: おお、やはり貴方は私の見込んだ通りの英雄ですね。よい仲間にも恵まれているようです。これからも多くの仲間と共に冒険をされるとよいでしょう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 벌써 끝냈다고요? 정말 고맙군요. 함께 싸운 동료에게도 고맙다고 전해주세요. 때론 좋은 동료가 있다는 게 정말 큰 힘이죠! 레벨 30이 되면 다시 찾아와 주세요. 또 부탁이 있답니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Done already!? My thanks go out to you and your allies. Sometimes companionship is the key to victory! As soon as you reach level 30, please return to me as I have another request.
dialogsComplete.pl: Done already!? My thanks go out to you and your allies. Sometimes companionship is the key to victory! As soon as you reach level 30, please return to me as I have another request.
dialogsComplete.ru: Уже справился!? Уважаю, молодец! Как только достигнешь 30 уровня - заходи, у меня для тебя есть ещё задание.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿Ya has terminado? Mi agradecimiento va para ti y tus aliados. ¡A veces el compañerismo es la clave de la victoria! Tan pronto como alcances el nivel 30, vuelve a mí porque tengo otra solicitud.
dialogsComplete.sw: Done already!? My thanks go out to you and your allies. Sometimes companionship is the key to victory! As soon as you reach level 30, please return to me as I have another request.
dialogsComplete.th: เสร็จเรียบร้อยแล้วหรอ !? เมื่อคุณถึงเลเวล 30 แล้วโปรดกลับมาหาฉัน เนื่องจากฉันมีคำร้องขออีกครั้ง
dialogsComplete.tw: 完成了！？我要感謝你和你的盟友。有時候，陪伴是勝利的關鍵！等你達到 30 級後，請回到我這裡，因為我還有一個要求。
dialogsComplete.vi: Xong rồi !? Tôi xin gửi lời cảm ơn đến bạn và các đồng minh của bạn. Đôi khi sự đồng hành là chìa khóa của chiến thắng! Ngay sau khi bạn đạt đến cấp độ 30, hãy trả lại cho tôi khi tôi có yêu cầu khác.

dialogsFail.en: Please you must all hurry! We cannot sit idly by in such a dire situation.
dialogsFail.ar: Please you must all hurry! We cannot sit idly by in such a dire situation.
dialogsFail.br: Por favor, depressa! Não podemos ficar parados em uma situação tão terrível.
dialogsFail.cns: 你必须要赶快完成！这种可怕的情况下，我们绝不能袖手旁观。
dialogsFail.de: Bitte beeilen Sie sich alle! Wir können in einer solchen Situation nicht tatenlos zusehen.
dialogsFail.fi: Please you must all hurry! We cannot sit idly by in such a dire situation.
dialogsFail.fil: Please you must all hurry! We cannot sit idly by in such a dire situation.
dialogsFail.fr: Je ne pense pas que vous ayez eu le temps de tuer des Bucrow.
dialogsFail.id: Tolong kalian semua harus cepat! Kita tidak bisa duduk diam dalam situasi yang begitu mengerikan.
dialogsFail.it: Please you must all hurry! We cannot sit idly by in such a dire situation.
dialogsFail.jp: このままではセイントモーニングが壊滅してしまうかもしれません。よろしくお願いします。
dialogsFail.kr: 제발 서둘러 주세요! 이렇게 위급한 상황에 가만히 있을 수는 없습니다!
dialogsFail.nl: Please you must all hurry! We cannot sit idly by in such a dire situation.
dialogsFail.pl: Please you must all hurry! We cannot sit idly by in such a dire situation.
dialogsFail.ru: Please you must all hurry! We cannot sit idly by in such a dire situation.
dialogsFail.sp: ¡Por favor, daos prisa! No podemos quedarnos de brazos cruzados en una situación tan grave.
dialogsFail.sw: Please you must all hurry! We cannot sit idly by in such a dire situation.
dialogsFail.th: รีบหน่อย ! เราไม่สามารถนั่งอยู่เฉยๆในสถานการณ์เลวร้ายดังกล่าวได้
dialogsFail.tw: 請大家一定要快點！在如此嚴峻的形勢下，我們不能坐視不管。
dialogsFail.vi: Làm ơn, tất cả các bạn phải nhanh lên! Chúng ta không thể ngồi yên trong một tình huống thảm khốc như vậy.

dialogsBegin.en: Remina needs Luchest to make the strongest shield in the world. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.ar: Remina needs Luchest to make the strongest shield in the world. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.br: Remina precisa de Luchest para fazer o escudo mais forte do mundo. Você poderia ajudar?
dialogsBegin.cns: 雷米娜为了制造强化盾牌，委托了搜集“凤凰胸甲”，您要接受委托吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Remine bittet uns, Luchest zu sammeln. Sie kann damit den stärksten Schild der Welt machen. Willst du den Auftrag annehmen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Remina needs Luchest to make the strongest shield in the world. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.fil: Kailangan ni Remina ang Luchest para gawin ang pinakamalakas na shield sa mundo. Tutulungan mo ba?
dialogsBegin.fr:
Remina nous demande de rassembler des Blasons Luias afin de forger le bouclier le plus puissant au monde.
Acceptes-tu de l'aider ?
dialogsBegin.id: Remina membutuhkan Luchest untuk membuat perisai terkuat di dunia. Bisakah kamu membantu?
dialogsBegin.it: Remina needs Luchest to make the strongest shield in the world. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.jp: ロッキーが、世界で一番強力な盾の製作に兆戦するそうです。そこで、材料となるラチェスト60個の依頼が来ました。依頼を受けますか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 레미나가 세상에서 가장 강력한 방패를 만들기 위해 루체스트를 구해 달라고 부탁합니다. 도와주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Remina needs Luchest to make the strongest shield in the world. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.pl: Remina needs Luchest to make the strongest shield in the world. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.ru: Ну-ка, ну-ка… 'Рамине нужны нагрудные щитки лавлинов для прочнейшего в мире щита.' Поможешь?
dialogsBegin.sp: Remina nos ha pedido recolectar algunos Luchest para hacer el escudo más fuerte del mundo. ¿Aceptas esta misión?
dialogsBegin.sw: Remina needs Luchest to make the strongest shield in the world. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.th: Remina ต้องการ Luchest เพื่อสร้างโล่ที่แข็งแกร่งที่สุดในโลก คุณจะช่วยไหม
dialogsBegin.tw: 雷米娜為了製造強化盾牌，委託了蒐集『鳳凰胸甲』，你要接受委託嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Remina cần Luchest để làm khiên chắn mạnh nhất trên thế giới. Bạn sẽ giúp chứ?

description.en: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from the Aibatts, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Poporam from Doridoma then bring them to Andy, the Mercenary Master in northern Flarine.
description.ar: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from the Aibatts, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Poporam from Doridoma then bring them to Andy, the Mercenary Master in northern Flarine.
description.br: Reúna 10 Pedras Cintilantes dos Aibatts, 5 Chupims de Pukepukes e 1 Poporam de Doridoma e leve-os para Andy, o Mestre Mercenário ao norte de Flarine.
description.cns: 材料是10个独眼蝠的发光石，5个邪精灵的坚果和1个蓝纹海马的紫晶球。收集完材料后，去帕里北广场找战士大师安迪凯。
description.de: Erbeute 10 Twinkle Stone von Aibatts, 5 Chupim von Pukepukes und 1  Poporam von den Doridoma. Bringe die Gegenstände anschließend zu [Mercenary Meister] Andy in Nord-Flaris.
description.fi: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from the Aibatts, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Poporam from Doridoma then bring them to Andy, the Mercenary Master in northern Flarine.
description.fil: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from the Aibatts, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Poporam from Doridoma then bring them to Andy, the Mercenary Master in northern Flarine.
description.fr: Collecter 10 Pierre brillantes sur des Aibatts, 5 Chupims sur des Pukepukes et 1 Poporam sur un Doridoma puis les rapporter au Maître des Mercenaires Andy à Flarine Nord.
description.id: Kumpulkan 10 Twinkle Stones dari Aibatts, 5 Chupim dari Pukepukes dan 1 Poporam dari Doridoma lalu bawa ke Andy, Mercenary Master di Flarine utara.
description.it: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from the Aibatts, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Poporam from Doridoma then bring them to Andy, the Mercenary Master in northern Flarine.
description.jp: 武器の材料はアイバットを倒して輝く石を10個、プケプケを倒してチュピム5個、ドリドマを倒してポポラムを1個集め、フラリス北広場にいるマーシナリーマスターの元へ行こう。
description.kr: 아이바트의 반짝이는 돌 10개, 푸케푸케의 츄핌 5개, 도리도마의 포포람 1개를 수집해 플라리네 북부에 있는 머서너리 마스터 앤디를 찾아가세요.
description.nl: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from the Aibatts, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Poporam from Doridoma then bring them to Andy, the Mercenary Master in northern Flarine.
description.pl: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from the Aibatts, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Poporam from Doridoma then bring them to Andy, the Mercenary Master in northern Flarine.
description.ru: Нужно добыть 10 мерцающих камней, 5 кислых яблок и 1 розовую жемчужину и отнести их Андею, магистру борцов из северной Фларинции.
description.sp: Consigue 10 Piedras Centelleantes de los Aibatts, 5 Chupims de los Pukepukes y 1 Poporam de los Doridomas. Entrégaselos a Andy, el Maestro Mercenary en Flarine Norte.
description.sw: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from the Aibatts, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Poporam from Doridoma then bring them to Andy, the Mercenary Master in northern Flarine.
description.th: รวบรวม Twinkle Stones 10 ชิ้นจาก Aibatts, Chupims 5 ชิ้นจาก Pukepukes และ 1 Poporam จาก Doridoma จากนั้นนำไปให้ Andy, Mercenary Master ทางเหนือของ Flarine
description.tw: 從獨眼蝙蝠收集 10 個閃耀石、從噗卡噗卡收集 5 個生果實，並從多利多瑪收集 1 個紫寶石，然後交給布拉里斯北部的勇者大師安迪。
description.vi: Thu thập 10 Twinkle Stones từ Aibatts, 5 Chupim từ Pukepukes và 1 Poporam từ Doridoma sau đó mang chúng đến Andy, Mercenary Master ở phía bắc Flarine.

dialogsBegin.en: I suppose you've proven you're not completely useless. On to the next task!
dialogsBegin.ar: I suppose you've proven you're not completely useless. On to the next task!
dialogsBegin.br: Parabéns por passar no 1° teste! Mas tudo está apenas começando.
dialogsBegin.cns: 虽然你很帅气的完成了第一个测试，但是不这样就结束了!听清楚我这个伟大的摸斯腾所说的话喔!
dialogsBegin.de: Du scheinst zumindest nicht komplett nutzlos zu sein. Auf zum nächsten Schritt!
dialogsBegin.fi: I suppose you've proven you're not completely useless. On to the next task!
dialogsBegin.fil: I suppose you've proven you're not completely useless. On to the next task!
dialogsBegin.fr: Pas si mal pour un bleu ! Mais ça ne fait que commencer.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku kira kamu telah membuktikan bahwa kamu tidak sepenuhnya tidak berguna. Ayo ke tugas berikutnya!
dialogsBegin.it: I suppose you've proven you're not completely useless. On to the next task!
dialogsBegin.jp: 初めてのテストはパスだ！しかし、これで終わりではないぞ、諸君。このマスタングの言うことを、ちゃんと傾聴したまえ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 음, 그래도 아주 못 쓸 실력은 아니네요. 자, 다음 과제로 넘어가 볼까요!
dialogsBegin.nl: I suppose you've proven you're not completely useless. On to the next task!
dialogsBegin.pl: I suppose you've proven you're not completely useless. On to the next task!
dialogsBegin.ru: Ладно, может, из тебя еще и выйдет толк. Поживем - увидим.
dialogsBegin.sp: Supongo que has demostrado que no eres completamente inútil. ¡A por la siguiente tarea!
dialogsBegin.sw: I suppose you've proven you're not completely useless. On to the next task!
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันคิดว่าคุณได้พิสูจน์แล้วว่าคุณไม่ได้ไร้ประโยชน์เสียทีเดียว ไปดูงานต่อไปกัน!
dialogsBegin.tw: 雖然你很帥氣的完成了第一個測試，但是不這樣就結束了！聽清楚我這個偉大的摸斯騰所說的話喔！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi cho rằng bạn đã chứng minh bạn không hoàn toàn vô dụng. Vào nhiệm vụ tiếp theo!

dialogsBegin.en: I want you to gather the materials needed for making the weapons of the Mercenary. Try not to mess this one up, alright?
dialogsBegin.ar: I want you to gather the materials needed for making the weapons of the Mercenary. Try not to mess this one up, alright?
dialogsBegin.br: Quero que você reúna os materiais necessários para fazer as armas do Mercenário. Tente não bagunçar isso, beleza?
dialogsBegin.cns: 第2个训练就是，要去找制作战士武器的材料。
dialogsBegin.de: Sammle die notwendigen Materialien, um die Waffen der Mercenary herzustellen.  Bitte versuche zumindest, es nicht zu vermasseln, okay?
dialogsBegin.fi: I want you to gather the materials needed for making the weapons of the Mercenary. Try not to mess this one up, alright?
dialogsBegin.fil: I want you to gather the materials needed for making the weapons of the Mercenary. Try not to mess this one up, alright?
dialogsBegin.fr: Bon, le deuxième test consiste à trouver les matériaux nécessaires pour fabriquer les armes du Mercenaire et par la même occasion en apprendre plus sur celles-ci..
dialogsBegin.id: Aku ingin kamu mengumpulkan bahan-bahan yang dibutuhkan untuk membuat senjata Mercenary. Cobalah untuk tidak mengacaukan yang satu ini, oke?
dialogsBegin.it: I want you to gather the materials needed for making the weapons of the Mercenary. Try not to mess this one up, alright?
dialogsBegin.jp: フム、「傾聴する」の意味がわからないとな？ワッハハハ！よーく耳を傾けて聞きたまえ。という意味だ、わかったか？2番目のテストはマーシナリーの武器を作るために必要な材料を集めるのだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 머서너리의 무기를 만들기 위한 재료를 모아오세요. 이번엔 실수 없이 하실 수 있죠?
dialogsBegin.nl: I want you to gather the materials needed for making the weapons of the Mercenary. Try not to mess this one up, alright?
dialogsBegin.pl: I want you to gather the materials needed for making the weapons of the Mercenary. Try not to mess this one up, alright?
dialogsBegin.ru: Собери-ка ты материалы для борцовского оружия. Да постарайся не напортачить!
dialogsBegin.sp: Quiero que consigas los materiales necesarios para hacer las armas de Mercenary. Intenta no cagarla con esto, ¿vale?
dialogsBegin.sw: I want you to gather the materials needed for making the weapons of the Mercenary. Try not to mess this one up, alright?
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันต้องการให้คุณรวบรวมวัสดุที่จำเป็นสำหรับการสร้างอาวุธของ Mercenary พยายามอย่าไปทำให้มันวุ่นวายได้ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 第 2 個訓練就是，要去找製作勇者武器的材料。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi muốn bạn thu thập các nguyên liệu cần thiết để chế tạo vũ khí của Mercenary. Cố gắng đừng làm rối tung lên, được chứ?

dialogsBegin.nl: Collect 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts in the area, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Poporam from Doridoma. They should be relatively easy to find.
dialogsBegin.pl: Collect 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts in the area, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Poporam from Doridoma. They should be relatively easy to find.
dialogsBegin.ru: Добудь 10 мерцающих камней у сглазов, 5 кислых яблок у вуки-туки и 1 розовую жемчужину у конька. Их несложно отыскать.
dialogsBegin.sp: Consigue 10 Piedras Centelleantes de los Aibatts de la zona, 5 Chupims de los Pukepukes y 1 Poporam de los Doridomas. Deberían ser relativamente fáciles de encontrar.
dialogsBegin.sw: Collect 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts in the area, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Poporam from Doridoma. They should be relatively easy to find.
dialogsBegin.th: รวบรวม Twinkle Stone 10 อันจาก Aibatts ในพื้นที่ 5 Chupims จาก Pukepukes และ 1 Poporam จาก Doridoma พวกเขาควรจะค่อนข้างง่ายที่จะหา
dialogsBegin.tw: 從附近的獨眼蝙蝠收集 10 個閃耀石、從噗卡噗卡收集 5 個生果實，並從多利多瑪收集 1 個紫寶石。這些應該相當容易找到。
dialogsBegin.vi: Thu thập 10 Twinkle Stone từ Aibatts trong khu vực, 5 Chupim từ Pukepukes và 1 Poporam từ Doridoma. Chúng tương đối dễ tìm.

dialogsBegin.en: Once you've gathered enough Twinkle Stones, Chupims and Poporam, bring them to Andy the Mercenary Master in northern Flarine.
dialogsBegin.ar: Once you've gathered enough Twinkle Stones, Chupims and Poporam, bring them to Andy the Mercenary Master in northern Flarine.
dialogsBegin.br: Uma vez que você tenha reunido Pedras Cintilates, Chupims e Poporams suficientes, leve-os para Andy, o Mestre Mercenário, no norte de Flarine.
dialogsBegin.cns: 一旦你收集到足够的发光石、坚果和紫晶球，就把它们带给帕里北部的战士大师安迪凯。
dialogsBegin.de: Sobald du ausreichend Twinkle Stone, Chupim und Poporam erbeutet hast, bringst du die Sachen zu [Mercenary Meister] Andy in Nord-Flaris.
dialogsBegin.fi: Once you've gathered enough Twinkle Stones, Chupims and Poporam, bring them to Andy the Mercenary Master in northern Flarine.
dialogsBegin.fil: Once you've gathered enough Twinkle Stones, Chupims and Poporam, bring them to Andy the Mercenary Master in northern Flarine.
dialogsBegin.fr: Une fois que tu auras tout ça en ta possession, apporte le tout à Andy, le Maître des Mercenaires que tu trouveras au nord de Flarine.
dialogsBegin.id: Setelah kamu mengumpulkan cukup Twinkle Stones, Chupims dan Poporam, bawa mereka ke Andy Mercenary Master di Flarine utara.
dialogsBegin.it: Once you've gathered enough Twinkle Stones, Chupims and Poporam, bring them to Andy the Mercenary Master in northern Flarine.
dialogsBegin.jp: 輝く石、チュピム、ポポラムを集めたらマーシナリーマスターに聞いてみろ。北広場にあるマドリガル職業マスターズにいるはずだ。もじもじしている時間はないぞ、諸君！早く出発するといい！
dialogsBegin.kr: 반짝이는 돌, 츄핌, 포포람을 다 모으면 플라리네 북부에 있는 머서너리 마스터 앤디에게 가지고 가세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Once you've gathered enough Twinkle Stones, Chupims and Poporam, bring them to Andy the Mercenary Master in northern Flarine.
dialogsBegin.pl: Once you've gathered enough Twinkle Stones, Chupims and Poporam, bring them to Andy the Mercenary Master in northern Flarine.
dialogsBegin.ru: Once you've gathered enough Twinkle Stones, Chupims and Poporam, bring them to Andy the Mercenary Master in northern Flarine.
dialogsBegin.sp: Una vez que hayas reunido suficientes Piedras Centelleantes, Chupims y el Poporam, llévaselos a Andy, el Maestro Mercenary en Flarine Norte.
dialogsBegin.sw: Once you've gathered enough Twinkle Stones, Chupims and Poporam, bring them to Andy the Mercenary Master in northern Flarine.
dialogsBegin.th: เมื่อคุณได้รวบรวม Twinkle Stones ได้แล้วให้นำสิ่งเหล่านั้นไปหา Andy Mercenary Master ทางตอนเหนือของเมือง Flarine
dialogsBegin.tw: 一旦你收集到足夠多的閃耀石、生果實和紫寶石，將它們帶給布拉里斯北部的勇者大師安迪。
dialogsBegin.vi: Khi bạn đã thu thập đủ Twinkle Stones, Chupims và Poporam, hãy mang chúng đến Andy the Mercenary Master ở phía bắc Flarine.

dialogsAccept.fi: Good luck! You're gonna need it!
dialogsAccept.fil: Good luck! You're gonna need it!
dialogsAccept.fr: Je te souhaite chance et sobriété !

dialogsAccept.jp: なんだかまだ頼りなさそうに見えるが…。グッドラック！幸運を祈るぞ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 행운을 빌어요! 정말 많은 행운을!
dialogsAccept.nl: Good luck! You're gonna need it!
dialogsAccept.pl: Good luck! You're gonna need it!
dialogsAccept.ru: Good luck! You're gonna need it!

dialogsDecline.en: Are you afraid of a couple Aibatts? I know they stink and all... but really?
dialogsDecline.ar: Are you afraid of a couple Aibatts? I know they stink and all... but really?
dialogsDecline.br: Você tem medo de uns míseros Aibatts? Eu sei que eles fedem e tudo... mas sério?
dialogsDecline.cns: 你害怕成群的独眼蝠吗？我知道他们非常的恶心而且都……但是你确定吗？
dialogsDecline.de: Hast du Angst vor ein paar Aibatts? Ich weiß, sie müffeln... Aber wirklich?
dialogsDecline.fi: Are you afraid of a couple Aibatts? I know they stink and all... but really?
dialogsDecline.fil: Are you afraid of a couple Aibatts? I know they stink and all... but really?
dialogsDecline.fr: Mouais, je savais bien que tu abandonnerais. C'est juste de la paresse ou ??
dialogsDecline.id: Apakah kamu takut pada sepasang Aibatt? Aku tahu mereka bau dan sebagainya... tapi benarkah?
dialogsDecline.it: Are you afraid of a couple Aibatts? I know they stink and all... but really?
dialogsDecline.jp: やっぱりダメだったか。まぁ、ここまで来られたのも褒められることかもしれないな。
dialogsDecline.kr: 아이바트 몇 마리가 무섭다고요? 냄새는 좀 나지만… 진짜로요?
dialogsDecline.nl: Are you afraid of a couple Aibatts? I know they stink and all... but really?
dialogsDecline.pl: Are you afraid of a couple Aibatts? I know they stink and all... but really?
dialogsDecline.ru: Are you afraid of a couple Aibatts? I know they stink and all... but really?
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Le tienes miedo a un par de Aibatts? Se que apestan y todo pero... ¿en serio?
dialogsDecline.sw: Are you afraid of a couple Aibatts? I know they stink and all... but really?
dialogsDecline.th: คุณกลัวเจ้าพวก Aibatts? ฉันรู้ว่าพวกมันเหม็นและมันทั้งหมด... แต่เอาจริงดิ?
dialogsDecline.tw: 你害怕這些獨眼蝙蝠嗎？我知道它們很臭……但真的嗎？
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn có sợ một vài Aibatts? Tôi biết chúng bốc mùi và tất cả ... nhưng thực sự?

dialogsComplete.en: Great job acquiring the Twinkle Stones, Chupims and Poporam, Vagrant. Oh, and don't worry about old Mustang. He's all bark and no bite!
dialogsComplete.ar: Great job acquiring the Twinkle Stones, Chupims and Poporam, Vagrant. Oh, and don't worry about old Mustang. He's all bark and no bite!
dialogsComplete.br: Excelente trabalho adquirindo Pedras Cintilantes, Chupims e Poporams Vagrant. Ah, e não se preocupe com a Mustang. Ela até late mas não morde! Agora ouça atentamente...
dialogsComplete.cns: 收集发光石、坚果和紫晶球的差事很棒。初心者，不要担心玛斯滕，他只会叫，不咬人。
dialogsComplete.de: Gute Arbeit beim Erbeuten der Twinkle Stone, Chupim und Poporam, Vagrant. Oh, und keine Sorge wegen dem alten Mustang. Er bellt nur, beißt aber nicht.
dialogsComplete.fi: Great job acquiring the Twinkle Stones, Chupims and Poporam, Vagrant. Oh, and don't worry about old Mustang. He's all bark and no bite!
dialogsComplete.fil: Great job acquiring the Twinkle Stones, Chupims and Poporam, Vagrant. Oh, and don't worry about old Mustang. He's all bark and no bite!
dialogsComplete.fr: Merci beaucoup d'être venu jusqu'ici. Maintenant, écoute-moi bien. Un Mercenaire utilise deux types d'armes : l'épée et la hache.
dialogsComplete.id: Kerja bagus untuk mendapatkan Twinkle Stones, Chupims dan Poporam, Vagrant. Oh, dan jangan khawatir tentang Mustang tua. Dia menggonggong dan tidak menggigit!
dialogsComplete.it: Great job acquiring the Twinkle Stones, Chupims and Poporam, Vagrant. Oh, and don't worry about old Mustang. He's all bark and no bite!
dialogsComplete.jp: 力強く勇敢なマーシナリーを志望する諸君、よくやった。では、武器についてお話しするとしよう。マーシナリーは2つの武器を使うことができる。それはソード（剣）とアックス（斧）だ。ソードは迅速で正確な攻撃を要する戦闘に適しているが、打撃力は低い。
dialogsComplete.kr: 반짝이는 돌, 츄핌, 포포람을 전부 잘 구해오셨네요! 오, 머스탱을 무서워하지 마세요. 겉으론 무서워 보여도 사실 순한 양이에요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Great job acquiring the Twinkle Stones, Chupims and Poporam, Vagrant. Oh, and don't worry about old Mustang. He's all bark and no bite!
dialogsComplete.pl: Great job acquiring the Twinkle Stones, Chupims and Poporam, Vagrant. Oh, and don't worry about old Mustang. He's all bark and no bite!
dialogsComplete.ru: Great job acquiring the Twinkle Stones, Chupims and Poporam, Vagrant. Oh, and don't worry about old Mustang. He's all bark and no bite!
dialogsComplete.sp: Buen trabajo consiguiendo las Piedras Centelleantes, los Chupims y el Poporam, Vagrant. Ah, y no te preocupes por el viejo Mustang. ¡Es de los que ladran pero no muerden!
dialogsComplete.sw: Great job acquiring the Twinkle Stones, Chupims and Poporam, Vagrant. Oh, and don't worry about old Mustang. He's all bark and no bite!
dialogsComplete.th: เยี่ยมมากที่ได้ Twinkle Stones, Chupims และ Poporam, Vagrant โอ้ ไม่ต้องกังวลกับเจ้าเฒ่ามัสแตง มันแค่เห่าแต่ไม่กัด!
dialogsComplete.tw: 做得好！見習生取得了閃耀石、生果實和紫寶石。哦，別擔心老摸斯騰，他只是嘴上嚇人而已！
dialogsComplete.vi: Làm tốt lắm khi giành được Twinkle Stones, Chupims và Poporam, Vagrant. Ồ, và đừng lo lắng về Mustang già. Nó chỉ sủa và không cắn!

dialogsComplete.en: A Mercenary can use both swords and axes. They each have strengths and weaknesses. Swords strike fast, but deal only moderate damage, whereas axes deal heavy damage but at a moderate speed.
dialogsComplete.ar: A Mercenary can use both swords and axes. They each have strengths and weaknesses. Swords strike fast, but deal only moderate damage, whereas axes deal heavy damage but at a moderate speed.
dialogsComplete.br: Um Mercenário pode usar Espadas ou Machados. Cada um deles tem pontos fortes e fracos. Espadas atacam rápido, mas causam apenas dano moderado, enquanto machados causam dano pesado, mas a uma velocidade moderada.
dialogsComplete.cns: 战士可以同时使用剑和斧子，它们各有优劣。剑攻速更快，但是伤害适中，斧子伤害更高，但攻速略次，
dialogsComplete.de: Ein Mercenary kann sowohl Schwerter, als auch Äxte benutzen. Beides hat seine Stärken und Schwächen. Schwerter sind schnell, verursachen aber nur moderaten Schaden. Äxte hingegen sind stärker, jedoch auch langsamer.
dialogsComplete.fi: A Mercenary can use both swords and axes. They each have strengths and weaknesses. Swords strike fast, but deal only moderate damage, whereas axes deal heavy damage but at a moderate speed.
dialogsComplete.fil: A Mercenary can use both swords and axes. They each have strengths and weaknesses. Swords strike fast, but deal only moderate damage, whereas axes deal heavy damage but at a moderate speed.
dialogsComplete.fr: L'épée est rapide et précise mais ne fait pas de lourds dégâts, alors que la hache n'est ni rapide, ni très précise, mais fait beaucoup plus mal qu'une épée. Utiliser ces armes de façon appropriée est très important.
dialogsComplete.id: Seorang Mercenary dapat menggunakan pedang dan kapak. Masing-masing memiliki kekuatan dan kelemahan. Pedang dapat menyerang dengan cepat, tetapi hanya memberikan damage sedang, sedangkan kapak memberikan damage yang keras tetapi pada kecepatan sedang.
dialogsComplete.it: A Mercenary can use both swords and axes. They each have strengths and weaknesses. Swords strike fast, but deal only moderate damage, whereas axes deal heavy damage but at a moderate speed.
dialogsComplete.jp: マーシナリ―は剣と斧の両方を使えるわけだが、それぞれに長所と短所があるんだ。 剣は速く攻撃できるが、適度にしかダメージは与えられん。斧は大きなダメージを与えられるが、スピード感のある攻撃とは言えないな。
dialogsComplete.kr: 머서너리는 검과 도끼, 두 가지 무기를 사용할 수 있어요. 검은 공격 속도가 빠르지만 공격력은 평범하고, 도끼는 공격력이 높지만 속도가 평범하죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: A Mercenary can use both swords and axes. They each have strengths and weaknesses. Swords strike fast, but deal only moderate damage, whereas axes deal heavy damage but at a moderate speed.
dialogsComplete.pl: A Mercenary can use both swords and axes. They each have strengths and weaknesses. Swords strike fast, but deal only moderate damage, whereas axes deal heavy damage but at a moderate speed.
dialogsComplete.ru: A Mercenary can use both swords and axes. They each have strengths and weaknesses. Swords strike fast, but deal only moderate damage, whereas axes deal heavy damage but at a moderate speed.
dialogsComplete.sp: Los Mecenary pueden usar tanto Espadas como Hachas. Cada una tiene sus fortalezas y debilidades. Las Espadas son rápidas, pero solo hacen daño moderado, mientras que las Hachas hacen mucho daño, pero tienen una velocidad moderada.
dialogsComplete.sw: A Mercenary can use both swords and axes. They each have strengths and weaknesses. Swords strike fast, but deal only moderate damage, whereas axes deal heavy damage but at a moderate speed.
dialogsComplete.th: Mercenary สามารถใช้ทั้งดาบและขงาาน แต่ละคนมีจุดแข็งและจุดอ่อน ดาบโจมตีได้อย่างรวดเร็ว แต่สร้างความเสียหายได้เพียงปานกลางในขณะที่ขวานสร้างความเสียหายได้หนัก แต่มีความเร็วปานกลาง
dialogsComplete.tw: 勇者可以使用劍和斧頭，每樣都有長處和短處。劍的攻擊速度很快，但只能造成中等傷害，而斧子會造成大量傷害，但速度適中。打擊力比較弱。
dialogsComplete.vi: Một Mercenary có thể sử dụng cả kiếm và rìu. Mỗi cái đều có điểm mạnh và điểm yếu. Kiếm tấn công nhanh, nhưng chỉ gây sát thương vừa phải, trong khi rìu gây sát thương nặng nhưng với tốc độ vừa phải.

dialogsComplete.en: Which weapon suits you best? That's a decision only you can make, young Vagrant.
dialogsComplete.ar: Which weapon suits you best? That's a decision only you can make, young Vagrant.
dialogsComplete.br: Qual arma combina mais com você? Essa é uma decisão que só você pode tomar, jovem Vagrant.
dialogsComplete.cns: 你最擅长哪个武器？年轻的初心者，这是你只有你才能做出的决定。
dialogsComplete.de: Welche Waffe passt am besten zu dir? Das ist eine Entscheidung, die nur du treffen kannst, junger Vagrant.
dialogsComplete.fi: Which weapon suits you best? That's a decision only you can make, young Vagrant.
dialogsComplete.fil: Which weapon suits you best? That's a decision only you can make, young Vagrant.
dialogsComplete.fr: Voilà en ce qui concerne les armes de Mercenaire, j'espère que tu as retenu mon enseignement ?
dialogsComplete.id: Senjata mana yang paling cocok untukmu? Keputusan itu hanya kamu yang bisa menentukannya, Vagrant muda.
dialogsComplete.it: Which weapon suits you best? That's a decision only you can make, young Vagrant.
dialogsComplete.jp: どうだ？マーシナリーが使う武器について、理解できたか？どの武器、装備が自分に合うか、確かめてみるいいだろう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 어떤 무기가 잘 맞을 것 같나요? 뭐, 물론 방랑자님 본인이 결정하실 문제죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: Which weapon suits you best? That's a decision only you can make, young Vagrant.
dialogsComplete.pl: Which weapon suits you best? That's a decision only you can make, young Vagrant.
dialogsComplete.ru: Which weapon suits you best? That's a decision only you can make, young Vagrant.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿Que arma te encaja mejor? Esa decisión solamente la puedes tomar tú, joven Vagrant.
dialogsComplete.sw: Which weapon suits you best? That's a decision only you can make, young Vagrant.
dialogsComplete.th: อาวุธใดเหมาะสมกับคุณมากที่สุดเหรอ? มีเพียงคุณคนเดียวที่ตัดสินใจได้พ่อหนุ่ม Vagrant
dialogsComplete.tw: 年輕的見習生，哪種武器最適合你？這是一個只有你才能做出的決定。
dialogsComplete.vi: Vũ khí nào phù hợp với bạn nhất? Chỉ có bạn mới có thể quyết định được, Vagrant trẻ tuổi.

dialogsFail.ar: You need to acquire 10 Twinkle Stones, 5 Chupims and 1 Poporam before I can continue your training, Vagrant.
dialogsFail.br: Você precisa adquirir 10 Pedras Cintilantes, 5 Chupims e 1 Poporam antes que eu possa continuar seu treinamento, Vagrant.
dialogsFail.cns: 你还没进行摸斯腾交代的事情吗?我总是告诉很多人，如果要得到东西，一定要付出代价。
dialogsFail.de: Du benötigst 10 Twinkle Stone, 5 Chupim und 1 Poporam, bevor wir mit deinem  Training fortfahren können, Vagrant.
dialogsFail.fi: You need to acquire 10 Twinkle Stones, 5 Chupims and 1 Poporam before I can continue your training, Vagrant.
dialogsFail.fil: You need to acquire 10 Twinkle Stones, 5 Chupims and 1 Poporam before I can continue your training, Vagrant.
dialogsFail.fr: Je pensais que Mustang m'enverrai des personnes plus aguerries..
dialogsFail.id: Kamu harus mendapatkan 10 Twinkle Stone, 5 Chupim dan 1 Poporam sebelum aku bisa melanjutkan latihanmu, Vagrant.
dialogsFail.it: You need to acquire 10 Twinkle Stones, 5 Chupims and 1 Poporam before I can continue your training, Vagrant.
dialogsFail.jp: おや？マスタング様から言われた指示をまだ終わらせていないのですか？輝く石10個、チュピム5個、ポポラム1個ですよ。指示どおりに材料を集めてきてから、もういちどおいで下さい。
dialogsFail.kr: 훈련을 계속하려면 반짝이는 돌 10개, 츄핌 5개, 포포람 1개를 먼저 모아오세요.
dialogsFail.nl: You need to acquire 10 Twinkle Stones, 5 Chupims and 1 Poporam before I can continue your training, Vagrant.
dialogsFail.pl: You need to acquire 10 Twinkle Stones, 5 Chupims and 1 Poporam before I can continue your training, Vagrant.
dialogsFail.ru: Мы продолжим твое обучение, но сперва принеси мне пять мерцающих камней.
dialogsFail.sp: Necesitarás conseguir 10 Piedras Centelleantes, 5 Chupims y 1 Poporam para continuar con tu entrenamiento, Vagrant.
dialogsFail.sw: You need to acquire 10 Twinkle Stones, 5 Chupims and 1 Poporam before I can continue your training, Vagrant.
dialogsFail.th: คุณต้องได้รับ Twinkle Stone 10 อัน, 5 Chupims และ 1 Poporam ก่อนที่ฉันจะสามารถฝึกฝนต่อไปได้ Vagrant
dialogsFail.tw: 見習生，在我繼續你的訓練之前，你需要獲得 10 個閃耀石、5 個生果實和 1 個紫寶石。
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn cần phải có được 10 Twinkle Stones, 5 Chupims và 1 Poporam trước khi tôi có thể tiếp tục quá trình huấn luyện của bạn, Vagrant.
