description.en: Locate Bowler, the Bowl Merchant in the Garden of Rhisis.
description.ar: Locate Bowler, the Bowl Merchant in the Garden of Rhisis.
description.br: Você pode encontrar Bowler, o Vendedor de Tigelas, no jardim de Rhisis. Vá e pergunte a ele!
description.cns: 莱斯庭院去的话，可以找到一个叫做保罗克的商人，你去问他就可以了!
description.de: Du findest Bowler den bowl merchant im Garten von Rhisis. Bitte gehe und frage ihn. He he he~
description.fi: Locate Bowler, the Bowl Merchant in the Garden of Rhisis.
description.fil: Locate Bowler, the Bowl Merchant in the Garden of Rhisis.
description.fr: Se renseigner sur le bol maudit auprès de Bowler, au jardin de Rhisis.
description.id: Temukan Bowler, Pedagang Mangkuk di Garden of Rhisis.
description.it: Locate Bowler, the Bowl Merchant in the Garden of Rhisis.
description.jp: リシスの庭に向かうと、ボーンボール商人の＜ボウラー＞がいるらしい。まずは彼を探してみよう。
description.kr: 리시스의 정원에서 보울 상인 보울러를 찾아가세요.
description.nl: Locate Bowler, the Bowl Merchant in the Garden of Rhisis.
description.pl: Locate Bowler, the Bowl Merchant in the Garden of Rhisis.
description.ru: Нужно поговорить с продавцом мисок Миском в Райсском саду.
description.sp: Localiza a Bowler, el Mercader de Cuencos en el Jardín de Rhisis.
description.sw: Locate Bowler, the Bowl Merchant in the Garden of Rhisis.
description.th: ค้นหา Bowl Merchant ชื่อ Bowler ในสวนแห่ง Rhisis
description.tw: 黎席斯庭院去的話，可以找到一個叫做保羅克的商人，你去問他就可以了！
description.vi: Xác định vị trí của Bowler, Người buôn Bowl trong Garden of Rhisis.

dialogsBegin.en: *Gnarllll!* Hey! You there! You don't know me, right? My reputation usually precedes me. I am the strange collector!
dialogsBegin.ar: *Gnarllll!* Hey! You there! You don't know me, right? My reputation usually precedes me. I am the strange collector!
dialogsBegin.br: *Giarrlll!* Ei! Você aí! Você não me conhece, certo? Minha reputação geralmente me precede. Me chamam de Colecionador Estranho!
dialogsBegin.cns: 喂!呵呵呵，你应该第一次见到我吧?你有听过诡异的搜藏家吗?
dialogsBegin.de: *Gnarllll!* Hey! Du da! Du kennst mich nicht, oder? Mein Ruf eilt mir normalerweise voraus. Ich bin der seltsame Sammler!
dialogsBegin.fi: *Gnarllll!* Hey! You there! You don't know me, right? My reputation usually precedes me. I am the strange collector!
dialogsBegin.fil: *Gnarllll!* Hey! You there! You don't know me, right? My reputation usually precedes me. I am the strange collector!
dialogsBegin.fr: Hé ! Tu ne me reconnais pas ? Je suis sûr que tu as entendu parler de moi au bureau des quêtes pourtant. Je suis le Collectionneur mystérieux !
dialogsBegin.id: *Gnarllll!* Hei! Kau disana! Kamu tidak tahu aku, kan? Reputasiku biasanya mendahuluiku. Aku kolektor aneh!
dialogsBegin.it: *Gnarllll!* Hey! You there! You don't know me, right? My reputation usually precedes me. I am the strange collector!
dialogsBegin.jp: ほう。君は初めて会う顔だな。わたしは誰かって？ハハッ。君は依頼所で私の名前を耳にしたことがあるだろう。ん？心あたりがないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: *으르릉!* 거기! 제가 누군지는 몰라도, 제 명성은 익히 들었을 테죠? 그 유명한 수상한 수집가가 바로 저랍니다!
dialogsBegin.nl: *Gnarllll!* Hey! You there! You don't know me, right? My reputation usually precedes me. I am the strange collector!
dialogsBegin.pl: *Gnarllll!* Hey! You there! You don't know me, right? My reputation usually precedes me. I am the strange collector!
dialogsBegin.ru: Хрюк! Эй, постой! Мы не знакомы, верно? Зато тебе наверняка обо мне рассказывали. Я - Свин-мусорщик! Про меня и пословица ходит: "Свин везде мусор найдет"! Думаю, это повод для гордости, а?
dialogsBegin.sp: *¡Gnarllll!* ¡Oye! ¡Tú! No me conoces, ¿verdad? Mi reputación suele precederme. ¡Soy el coleccionista extraño!
dialogsBegin.sw: *Gnarllll!* Hey! You there! You don't know me, right? My reputation usually precedes me. I am the strange collector!
dialogsBegin.th: เฮ้! คุณน่ะ! คุณไม่รู้จักฉันใช่ไหม? เกียรติศัพท์ฉันกว้างไกลมากนะ ฉันเป็นนักสะสมของแปลกไงล่ะ!
dialogsBegin.tw: 喂！呵呵呵，你應該第一次見到我吧？你有聽過詭異的蒐藏家嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: * Gnarllll! * Này! Bạn ở đó! Bạn không biết tôi, phải không? Người ta thường đã nghe đến danh tiếng của tôi rồi. Tôi là nhà sưu tập kỳ lạ!

dialogsBegin.en: I wanted to ask you something. Have you ever heard of the Bone Bowl? No, not just some random Bone Bowl. THE Bone Bowl!
dialogsBegin.ar: I wanted to ask you something. Have you ever heard of the Bone Bowl? No, not just some random Bone Bowl. THE Bone Bowl!
dialogsBegin.br: Sim, eu que sou esse colecionador. Na verdade, eu gostaria de lhe perguntar uma coisa. Você já ouviu falar da Tigela de Osso? Mas não qualquer uma Tigela de Osso, a Verdadeira Tigela de Osso!
dialogsBegin.cns: 其实，那个诡异的搜藏家就是我啦~我有一件事情想拜托你，所以才找你过来的，你应该有听过骨制御碗吧?
dialogsBegin.de: Ich wollte dich etwas fragen. Hast du jemals von der Bone Bowl gehört? Nein, nicht nur von irgendeiner Bone Bowl. DER Bone Bowl!
dialogsBegin.fi: I wanted to ask you something. Have you ever heard of the Bone Bowl? No, not just some random Bone Bowl. THE Bone Bowl!
dialogsBegin.fil: I wanted to ask you something. Have you ever heard of the Bone Bowl? No, not just some random Bone Bowl. THE Bone Bowl!
dialogsBegin.fr: Je voudrais juste te demander quelque chose. As-tu déjà entendu parler d'un bol d'os ?
dialogsBegin.id: Aku ingin menanyakan sesuatu padamu. Pernahkah kamu mendengar tentang Bone Bowl? Tidak, bukan hanya Bone Bowl acak. Bone Bowl!
dialogsBegin.it: I wanted to ask you something. Have you ever heard of the Bone Bowl? No, not just some random Bone Bowl. THE Bone Bowl!
dialogsBegin.jp: 依頼所には何回か依頼を頼んでいるからな。そう、＜謎のコレクター＞というのは私のことだ、ハッハハハ。実は君に1つ頼みたいことがある。君、＜ボーンボール＞の話は聞いたことがあるだろう？
dialogsBegin.kr: 물어보고 싶은 게 있어서요. 혹시 본보울에 대해 들어보셨나요? 아뇨, 그냥 흔한 본보울 말고요. 특별한 본보울 말이에요!
dialogsBegin.nl: I wanted to ask you something. Have you ever heard of the Bone Bowl? No, not just some random Bone Bowl. THE Bone Bowl!
dialogsBegin.pl: I wanted to ask you something. Have you ever heard of the Bone Bowl? No, not just some random Bone Bowl. THE Bone Bowl!
dialogsBegin.ru: Ты что-нибудь знаешь о Костяной Миске? Нет, не об обычной костяной миске, каких пруд пруди, а о ТОЙ САМОЙ Костяной Миске!
dialogsBegin.sp: Quería preguntarte algo. ¿Alguna vez has oído hablar del Cuenco de Hueso? No, no es un Cuenco de Hueso al azar. ¡EL Cuenco de Hueso!
dialogsBegin.sw: I wanted to ask you something. Have you ever heard of the Bone Bowl? No, not just some random Bone Bowl. THE Bone Bowl!
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันอยากจะถามอะไรคุณหน่อย คุณเคยได้ยินเกี่ยวกับ Bone Bowl บ้างไหม? ไม่ใช่ๆ Bone Bowl ทั่วๆ ไปน่ะ Bone Bowl ไง!
dialogsBegin.tw: 我想問你一件事。你聽說過情盆嗎？不，不僅僅是一些隨機出現的情盆。情盆！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi muốn hỏi bạn một vài điều. Bạn đã bao giờ nghe nói về Bone Bowl? Không, không chỉ là Bone Bowl ngẫu nhiên nào đó đâu. Bone Bowl!

dialogsBegin.en: I'm talking about the original cursed Bone Bowl.
dialogsBegin.ar: I'm talking about the original cursed Bone Bowl.
dialogsBegin.br: Estou falando sobre a Original Tigela de Osso amaldiçoada.
dialogsBegin.cns: 嗯?你说我找那个做什么啊?我想找的是第一个做出来的骨制御碗，也就是有下诅咒的那个。
dialogsBegin.de: Hm? Fragst du warum ich nach einer solch gewöhnlichen Sache suche? Ich suche etwas Aussergewöhnliches. Eine echte Bone Bowl natürlich..
dialogsBegin.fi: I'm talking about the original cursed Bone Bowl.
dialogsBegin.fil: I'm talking about the original cursed Bone Bowl.
dialogsBegin.fr: Hein? Tu te demandes pourquoi je cherche quelque chose de si commun ? Mais je recherche quelque chose de très spécial : le bol maudit.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku sedang berbicara tentang Bone Bowl terkutuk yang asli.
dialogsBegin.it: I'm talking about the original cursed Bone Bowl.
dialogsBegin.jp: 私が欲しいのは恐ろしい呪いがかかっていると言われる本物の＜ボーンボール＞さ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 저주받은 기원의 본보울 이야기를 하는 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I'm talking about the original cursed Bone Bowl.
dialogsBegin.pl: I'm talking about the original cursed Bone Bowl.
dialogsBegin.ru: О Миске, на которой лежит ПРОКЛЯТЬЕ!
dialogsBegin.sp: Estoy hablando del Cuenco de Hueso maldito.
dialogsBegin.sw: I'm talking about the original cursed Bone Bowl.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันกำลังพูดถึง Bone Bowl ที่ถูกสาปน่ะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 嗯？你說我找那個做什麼啊？我想找的是第一個做出來的情盆，也就是有下詛咒的那個。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đang nói về Bone Bowl bị lời nguyền ban đầu.

dialogsBegin.en: I am looking to acquire it. Will you help me?
dialogsBegin.ar: I am looking to acquire it. Will you help me?
dialogsBegin.br: Estou tentando obtê-la. Então? Você quer me ajudar?
dialogsBegin.cns: 如何?有兴趣吗?要不要帮我呢?
dialogsBegin.de: Also? Willst du mir helfen?
dialogsBegin.fi: I am looking to acquire it. Will you help me?
dialogsBegin.fil: I am looking to acquire it. Will you help me?
dialogsBegin.fr: As-tu envie de m'aider?
dialogsBegin.id: Aku mencari untuk mendapatkannya. Akankan kamu menolongku?
dialogsBegin.it: I am looking to acquire it. Will you help me?
dialogsBegin.jp: 興味をもってくれたようで嬉しいよ。私は好奇心旺盛な冒険者が大好きだ。さて、ここからリシスの庭に向かうと、ボーンボール商人の＜ボウラー＞がいる。まず、彼をたずねてみてくれないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 그걸 손에 넣고 싶어서요. 도와주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: I am looking to acquire it. Will you help me?
dialogsBegin.pl: I am looking to acquire it. Will you help me?
dialogsBegin.ru: Я давно ее ищу. Поможешь?
dialogsBegin.sp: Estoy intentando adquirirlo. ¿Me ayudarás?
dialogsBegin.sw: I am looking to acquire it. Will you help me?
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันตามหามันเพราะอยากจะได้มันมา คุณจะช่วยฉันได้ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 如何？有興趣嗎？要不要幫我呢？
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đang tìm cách để có được nó. Bạn sẽ giúp tôi chứ?

dialogsAccept.en: *Grawrrrll* Great! Head to the Garden of Rhisis and find (Bowl Merchant) Bowler! *SNARF!*
dialogsAccept.ar: *Grawrrrll* Great! Head to the Garden of Rhisis and find (Bowl Merchant) Bowler! *SNARF!*
dialogsAccept.br: *Grawrrrll*. Beleza. Vá para o Jardim de Rhisis e encontre o Bowler, ele é um vendedor de tigelas e deve saber de algo!
dialogsAccept.cns: 好，你到莱斯庭院去的话，可以找到一个叫做保罗克的商人，你去问他就可以了!
dialogsAccept.de: Ja. Das sagte ich. He he he~ Du findest Bowler den Bowl Merchant im Garten von Rhisis. Bitte gehe und frage ihn.
dialogsAccept.fi: *Grawrrrll* Great! Head to the Garden of Rhisis and find (Bowl Merchant) Bowler! *SNARF!*
dialogsAccept.fil: *Grawrrrll* Great! Head to the Garden of Rhisis and find (Bowl Merchant) Bowler! *SNARF!*
dialogsAccept.fr: Parfait ! Va trouver Bowler au jardin de Rhisis, il devrait pouvoir te donner plus d'informations.
dialogsAccept.id: *Grawrrll* Hebat! Pergilah ke Garden of Rhisis dan temukan (Bowl Merchan) Bowler! *SNARF!*
dialogsAccept.it: *Grawrrrll* Great! Head to the Garden of Rhisis and find (Bowl Merchant) Bowler! *SNARF!*
dialogsAccept.jp: 興味をもってくれたようで嬉しいよ。私は好奇心旺盛な冒険者が大好きだ。さて、ここからリシスの庭に向かうと、ボーンボール商人の＜ボウラー＞がいる。まず、彼をたずねてみてくれないか？
dialogsAccept.kr: *으르렁* 좋아요! 그럼 리시스의 가든으로 가서 (보울 상인) 보울러를 찾아가세요! *킁킁!*
dialogsAccept.nl: *Grawrrrll* Great! Head to the Garden of Rhisis and find (Bowl Merchant) Bowler! *SNARF!*
dialogsAccept.pl: *Grawrrrll* Great! Head to the Garden of Rhisis and find (Bowl Merchant) Bowler! *SNARF!*
dialogsAccept.ru: Хрюк! Отлично! В Райсском саду есть продавец мисок по имени Мисок. Поговори с ним. Хрю!
dialogsAccept.sp: *Grrrr* ¡Genial! ¡Dirígete al Jardín de Rhisis y encuentra al [Mercader de Cuencos] Bowler! *¡ÑAM!*
dialogsAccept.sw: *Grawrrrll* Great! Head to the Garden of Rhisis and find (Bowl Merchant) Bowler! *SNARF!*
dialogsAccept.th: ดีมาก! จงมุ่งหน้าไปที่ Garden of Rhisis และค้นหา (Bowl Merchant) Bowler!
dialogsAccept.tw: 好，你到黎席斯庭院去的話，可以找到一個叫做保羅克的商人，你去問他就可以了！
dialogsAccept.vi: * Grawrrrll * Tuyệt vời! Đi đến Garden of Rhisis và tìm (Bowl Merchant) Bowler! *SNARF!*

dialogsDecline.en: Oh come on! I can pay you as much as you want! *GNARL*
dialogsDecline.ar: Oh come on! I can pay you as much as you want! *GNARL*
dialogsDecline.br: Ah qual é?! Posso pagar o quanto você quiser! *GIARL*
dialogsDecline.cns: 我一定会给你酬劳的，你一定要帮我啦~除了你没有人可以帮我了!再考虑一下啦~
dialogsDecline.de: Ich kann dir zahlen so viel zu willst, ich bin reich! Aber ich kenne niemanden den ich fragen könnte. Hilft du mir bitte, hm?
dialogsDecline.fi: Oh come on! I can pay you as much as you want! *GNARL*
dialogsDecline.fil: Oh come on! I can pay you as much as you want! *GNARL*
dialogsDecline.fr: Je peux te payer autant que tu veux, je suis riche ! Mais je n'ai personne d'autre à qui demander... Peux-tu m'aider ?
dialogsDecline.id: Oh ayolah! Aku bisa membayarmu sebanyak yang kamu mau! *GNARL*
dialogsDecline.it: Oh come on! I can pay you as much as you want! *GNARL*
dialogsDecline.jp: もちろん依頼を受けてくれるのなら、報酬ははずませてもらうよ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 에이, 왜 그래요! 보수는 원하시는 만큼 드릴게요! *그르르르*
dialogsDecline.nl: Oh come on! I can pay you as much as you want! *GNARL*
dialogsDecline.pl: Oh come on! I can pay you as much as you want! *GNARL*
dialogsDecline.ru: Да будет тебе! Я заплачу столько, сколько скажешь! Хрю!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Oh venga ya! ¡Puedo pagarte tanto como quieras! *GNARL*
dialogsDecline.sw: Oh come on! I can pay you as much as you want! *GNARL*
dialogsDecline.th: โธ่ ไม่เอาน่า! ฉันสามารถจ่ายเท่าที่คุณต้องการ!
dialogsDecline.tw: 我一定會給你酬勞的，你一定要幫我啦~除了你沒有人可以幫我了！再考慮一下啦~
dialogsDecline.vi: Ôi thôi! Tôi có thể trả cho bạn bao nhiêu tùy thích! * GNARL *

dialogsComplete.de: Hmm.. Endlich ist der seltsame Sammler erschienen.. Er wollte wirklich die Bone Bowl haben.. (denkt eine Weile nach)
dialogsComplete.fi: Hmmm… so the strange collector wants the Bone Bowl, huh?
dialogsComplete.fil: Hmmm… so the strange collector wants the Bone Bowl, huh?

dialogsComplete.pl: Hmmm… so the strange collector wants the Bone Bowl, huh?
dialogsComplete.ru: Ага! Значит, Свин хочет заполучить Костяную Миску?

dialogsComplete.sw: Hmmm… so the strange collector wants the Bone Bowl, huh?
dialogsComplete.th: อืม... นักสะสมของแปลกต้องการ Bone Bowl งั้นเหรอ?

dialogsComplete.vi: Hmmm… vậy là nhà sưu tập kỳ lạ muốn Bone Bowl, hả?

dialogsBegin.en: Hmm, I sense an aura of greatness from you young warrior, yet a mind clouded with uncertainty and doubt.
dialogsBegin.ar: Hmm, I sense an aura of greatness from you young warrior, yet a mind clouded with uncertainty and doubt.
dialogsBegin.br: Hmm, eu sinto uma aura de grandeza de você jovem guerreiro(a), mas uma mente nublada de incertezas e dúvidas.
dialogsBegin.cns: 嗯...年轻的战士，我能从你身上感觉到一股强大的气场，但你的内心还充满了不确定和怀疑。
dialogsBegin.de: Hmm, ich spüre eine Aura der Größe von dir, junger Krieger, aber auch einen von Unsicherheit und Zweifel getrübten Geist.
dialogsBegin.fi: Hmm, I sense an aura of greatness from you young warrior, yet a mind clouded with uncertainty and doubt.
dialogsBegin.fil: Hmm, I sense an aura of greatness from you young warrior, yet a mind clouded with uncertainty and doubt.
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous m’avez l’air d’un Dragoméro à peine sorti de sa coquille… Vous ferez l’affaire cette fois-ci ! Après tout, on ne fait pas d’omelette sans casser des œufs !
dialogsBegin.id: Hmm, saya merasakan aura yang kuat darimu pejuang muda, namun pikiranmu diselimuti ketidakpastian dan keraguan.
dialogsBegin.it: Hmm, I sense an aura of greatness from you young warrior, yet a mind clouded with uncertainty and doubt.
dialogsBegin.jp: ふむ、お前さんからは英雄の兆しを感じるな。どうだい、お前さんも私のような英雄になりたくないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 흐음, 젊은 전사에게서 위대한 기운이 느껴지는군요. 마음속에 아직 불안과 의심이 도사리고 있긴 하지만.
dialogsBegin.nl: Hmm, I sense an aura of greatness from you young warrior, yet a mind clouded with uncertainty and doubt.
dialogsBegin.pl: Hmm, I sense an aura of greatness from you young warrior, yet a mind clouded with uncertainty and doubt.
dialogsBegin.ru: Hmm, I sense an aura of greatness from you young warrior, yet a mind clouded with uncertainty and doubt.
dialogsBegin.sp: Hmm, siento un aura de grandeza en ti, joven guerrero, pero una mente nublada por la incertidumbre y la duda.
dialogsBegin.sw: Hmm, I sense an aura of greatness from you young warrior, yet a mind clouded with uncertainty and doubt.
dialogsBegin.th: อืม ข้าสัมผัสได้ถึงรัศมีแห่งความยิ่งใหญ่จากเจ้านักรบหนุ่ม แต่จิตใจกลับเต็มไปด้วยความไม่แน่นอนและความสงสัย
dialogsBegin.tw: 嗯，從你這個年輕的武者身上，我感受到了一種偉大的氣息，但心中卻充滿了不確定和懷疑。
dialogsBegin.vi: Hmm, tôi cảm nhận được một luồng khí vĩ đại toát từ người chiến binh trẻ tuổi này, nhưng tâm trí lại đầy rẫy sự không chắc chắn và sự nghi ngờ.

dialogsBegin.en: I intend to help you realize your true inner potential. Though I am but a stranger to you, I need you to trust in me. My true identity will be revealed soon enough.
dialogsBegin.ar: I intend to help you realize your true inner potential. Though I am but a stranger to you, I need you to trust in me. My true identity will be revealed soon enough.
dialogsBegin.br: Pretendo ajudá-lo a realizar seu verdadeiro potencial interior. Embora eu seja apenas um estranho para você, preciso que confie em mim. Minha verdadeira identidade será revelada em breve.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我愿意帮助你激发你的潜能。虽然我对你来说仍然是陌生的，但我需要你相信我。我的真实身份很快就会揭晓。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich möchte dir helfen, dein wahres inneres Potenzial zu erkennen. Obwohl ich für dich ein Fremder bin, musst du mir vertrauen. Meine wahre Identität wird früh genug enthüllt werden.
dialogsBegin.fi: I intend to help you realize your true inner potential. Though I am but a stranger to you, I need you to trust in me. My true identity will be revealed soon enough.
dialogsBegin.fil: I intend to help you realize your true inner potential. Though I am but a stranger to you, I need you to trust in me. My true identity will be revealed soon enough.
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous n’avez peut-être pas assez d'expérience pour sauver le monde… Pourtant, il faut bien débuter un jour non ? Si vous suivez mes conseils, vous serez un héros, Madrigalien !
dialogsBegin.id: Aku bermaksud membantu mengeluarkan potensimu yang terpendam. Meskipun aku hanyalah orang asing bagimu, aku ingin kamu mempercayaiku. Identitasku yang sebenarnya akan segera terungkap.
dialogsBegin.it: I intend to help you realize your true inner potential. Though I am but a stranger to you, I need you to trust in me. My true identity will be revealed soon enough.
dialogsBegin.jp: いい返事だ。まだまだお前さんじゃ力不足かもしれないが、私の言うとおりに進めればきっと英雄に近づけるぞ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 당신이 진정한 잠재력을 깨닫도록 돕고 싶어요. 저를 잘 모르시겠지만, 그래도 믿어주면 좋겠군요. 제 진짜 정체를 곧 알게 되실 겁니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: I intend to help you realize your true inner potential. Though I am but a stranger to you, I need you to trust in me. My true identity will be revealed soon enough.
dialogsBegin.pl: I intend to help you realize your true inner potential. Though I am but a stranger to you, I need you to trust in me. My true identity will be revealed soon enough.
dialogsBegin.ru: I intend to help you realize your true inner potential. Though I am but a stranger to you, I need you to trust in me. My true identity will be revealed soon enough.
dialogsBegin.sp: Tengo la intención de ayudarte a que te des cuenta de tu verdadero potencial interior. Aunque no soy más que un extraño para ti, necesito que confíes en mí. Te revelaré mi verdadera identidad muy pronto.
dialogsBegin.sw: I intend to help you realize your true inner potential. Though I am but a stranger to you, I need you to trust in me. My true identity will be revealed soon enough.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันตั้งใจจะช่วยให้คุณตระหนักถึงศักยภาพภายในที่แท้จริงของคุณ แม้ว่าฉันจะเป็นเพียงคนแปลกหน้าสำหรับคุณ ฉันต้องการให้คุณเชื่อใจในตัวฉัน ตัวตนที่แท้จริงของฉันจะถูกเปิดเผยในไม่ช้า
dialogsBegin.tw: 從你這個年輕的武者身上，我感受到了一種偉大的氣息，但心中卻充滿了不確定和懷疑。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi có ý định giúp bạn nhận ra tiềm năng thực sự bên trong của bạn. Dù tôi là một người xa lạ với bạn, tôi cần bạn tin tưởng vào tôi. Danh tính thực sự của tôi sẽ sớm được tiết lộ.

dialogsAccept.en: Apparently I was correct in choosing you. Well then! Please eliminate 10 Lawolfs & 5 Grownup Lawolfs residing in Northern Flaris.
dialogsAccept.ar: Apparently I was correct in choosing you. Well then! Please eliminate 10 Lawolfs & 5 Grownup Lawolfs residing in Northern Flaris.
dialogsAccept.br: Aparentemente, eu estava certo em escolher você. Muito bem! Elimine 10 Lawolfs e 5 Lawolfs Adultos que residem ao Norte de Flaris.
dialogsAccept.cns: 很显然，选择你是正确的。那么好的，接下来请击败栖息在帕里北部的 10只山地野狼和 5只山地老狼吧。
dialogsAccept.de: Offensichtlich war es richtig, dass ich Sie ausgewählt habe. Nun denn! Bitte eliminieren Sie 10 Lawolfs & 5 Grownup Lawolfs mit Wohnsitz in Nordflaris.
dialogsAccept.fi: Apparently I was correct in choosing you. Well then! Please eliminate 10 Lawolfs & 5 Grownup Lawolfs residing in Northern Flaris.
dialogsAccept.fil: Apparently I was correct in choosing you. Well then! Please eliminate 10 Lawolfs & 5 Grownup Lawolfs residing in Northern Flaris.
dialogsAccept.fr: J’aime votre attitude. Suivez mes ordres et vous deviendrez un élément indispensable en peu de temps. Commencez par tuer 10 Lawolf et 5 capitaines Lawolf au Nord de Flarine.
dialogsAccept.id: Ternyata aku benar dalam memilihmu. Baiklah! Tolong habisi 10 Lawolf & 5 Grownup Lawolf yang berkeliaran di Northern Flaris.
dialogsAccept.it: Apparently I was correct in choosing you. Well then! Please eliminate 10 Lawolfs & 5 Grownup Lawolfs residing in Northern Flaris.
dialogsAccept.jp: どうやら私はあなたを選んで正解だったようですね。 では、 北フラリスに生息している10体のラーウルフと5体のグロウアップ・ラーウルフを倒してください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 당신을 선택한 건 정확한 판단이었어요. 그렇다면! 플라리스 북부로 가서 로울프 10마리와 성체 로울프 5마리를 처치해 주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Apparently I was correct in choosing you. Well then! Please eliminate 10 Lawolfs & 5 Grownup Lawolfs residing in Northern Flaris.
dialogsAccept.pl: Apparently I was correct in choosing you. Well then! Please eliminate 10 Lawolfs & 5 Grownup Lawolfs residing in Northern Flaris.
dialogsAccept.ru: Apparently I was correct in choosing you. Well then! Please eliminate 10 Lawolfs & 5 Grownup Lawolfs residing in Northern Flaris.
dialogsAccept.sp: Parece que hice bien en elegirte. ¡Bien entonces! Elimina a 10 Lawolfs y a 5 Lawolfs Adultos, los puedes encontrar al Norte de Flaris.
dialogsAccept.sw: Apparently I was correct in choosing you. Well then! Please eliminate 10 Lawolfs & 5 Grownup Lawolfs residing in Northern Flaris.
dialogsAccept.th: เห็นได้ชัดว่าฉันถูกต้องในการเลือกคุณ ดีละถ้าอย่างนั้น! โปรดกำจัด Lawolfs 10 ตัวและ Grownup Lawolfs 5 ตัวที่อาศัยอยู่ใน Northern Flaris
dialogsAccept.tw: 看來我選擇你是對的。好吧！請消滅居住在布拉里斯北方的 10 隻布魯狼和 5 隻布魯狼頭目。
dialogsAccept.vi: Rõ ràng tôi đã đúng khi chọn bạn. Vậy thì! Hãy loại bỏ 10 Lawolf & 5 Grownup Lawolf sống ở Northern Flaris.

dialogsDecline.en: Hmm, apparently I made a mistake. I believed you to be the champion I was searching for.
dialogsDecline.ar: Hmm, apparently I made a mistake. I believed you to be the champion I was searching for.
dialogsDecline.br: Hmm, aparentemente cometi um erro. Eu acreditei que você fosse o campeão que eu procurava.
dialogsDecline.cns: 嗯...相信你是我一直寻找的英雄的这个想法显然是错的。
dialogsDecline.de: Hmm, offenbar habe ich mich geirrt. Ich habe geglaubt, dass Sie der Champion sind, den ich gesucht habe.
dialogsDecline.fi: Hmm, apparently I made a mistake. I believed you to be the champion I was searching for.
dialogsDecline.fil: Hmm, apparently I made a mistake. I believed you to be the champion I was searching for.
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous rentrez dans votre coquille, je vais demander à quelqu’un de plus sensé alors.
dialogsDecline.id: Hmm, rupanya aku melakukan kesalahan. Aku percaya Kaulah Champion yang aku cari.
dialogsDecline.it: Hmm, apparently I made a mistake. I believed you to be the champion I was searching for.
dialogsDecline.jp: うーん…私は人を間違って見たのですが。 だから私は一人が惜しいので、他の救い主を探しに行くべきです。
dialogsDecline.kr: 흐음, 제가 사람을 잘못 봤나 보네요. 제가 찾던 용사인 줄 알았는데.
dialogsDecline.nl: Hmm, apparently I made a mistake. I believed you to be the champion I was searching for.
dialogsDecline.pl: Hmm, apparently I made a mistake. I believed you to be the champion I was searching for.
dialogsDecline.ru: Hmm, apparently I made a mistake. I believed you to be the champion I was searching for.
dialogsDecline.sp: Hmm, parece que me equivocaba. Pensaba que eras el campeón que estaba buscando.
dialogsDecline.sw: Hmm, apparently I made a mistake. I believed you to be the champion I was searching for.
dialogsDecline.th: อืม เห็นได้ชัดว่าฉันทำผิดพลาด ฉันเชื่อว่าคุณเป็นแชมป์ที่ฉันตามหา
dialogsDecline.tw: 嗯，顯然我犯了一個錯誤。我相信你就是我正在尋找的冠軍。
dialogsDecline.vi: Hmm, rõ ràng là tôi đã mắc sai lầm. Tôi đã tin rằng bạn là nhà vô địch mà tôi đang tìm kiếm.

dialogsComplete.en: Ah! I admire your courage. It appears you could very well be the champion I have sought.
dialogsComplete.ar: Ah! I admire your courage. It appears you could very well be the champion I have sought.
dialogsComplete.br: Ah! Admiro sua coragem. Parece que você poderia muito bem ser o campeão que procuro.
dialogsComplete.cns: 哈！我欣赏你的勇气。看来你很有可能成为我所追寻的英雄。
dialogsComplete.de: Ah! Ich bewundere Ihren Mut. Es scheint, als könnten Sie sehr wohl der Champion sein, den ich gesucht habe.
dialogsComplete.fi: Ah! I admire your courage. It appears you could very well be the champion I have sought.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ah! I admire your courage. It appears you could very well be the champion I have sought.
dialogsComplete.fr: Ah, j'admire ton courage ! Il se peut que tu sois le champion que je recherche.
dialogsComplete.id: Aku kagum dengan keberanianmu. Sepertinya kamulah Champion yang selama ini aku cari.
dialogsComplete.it: Ah! I admire your courage. It appears you could very well be the champion I have sought.
dialogsComplete.jp: お、すべて倒してきたか。まずはお前さんの功績を讃えよう！
dialogsComplete.kr: 아! 정말 대단한 용기군요. 당신이야말로 제가 찾아 헤매던 챔피언일지도 모르겠네요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Ah! I admire your courage. It appears you could very well be the champion I have sought.
dialogsComplete.pl: Ah! I admire your courage. It appears you could very well be the champion I have sought.
dialogsComplete.ru: Ah! I admire your courage. It appears you could very well be the champion I have sought.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Oh! Admiro tu valentía. Parece que podrías ser el campeón que he estado buscando.
dialogsComplete.sw: Ah! I admire your courage. It appears you could very well be the champion I have sought.
dialogsComplete.th: อา! ฉันชื่นชมความกล้าหาญของคุณ ดูเหมือนว่าคุณจะเป็นแชมป์ที่ฉันตามหาได้เป็นอย่างดี
dialogsComplete.tw: 啊！我佩服你的勇氣。看來你很可能是我尋找的冠軍。
dialogsComplete.vi: Ah! Tôi khâm phục lòng dũng cảm của bạn. Có vẻ như bạn là nhà vô địch mà tôi đã tìm kiếm bấy lâu.

dialogsFail.ar: The citizens grow ever more fearful of this situation! Please get rid of 10 Lawolfs & 5 Grownup Lawolfs.
dialogsFail.br: Os cidadãos têm cada vez mais medo desta situação! Por favor, elimine 10 Lawolfs e 5 Lawolfs Adultos.
dialogsFail.cns: 居民们对这种情况愈发的害怕了！请你前去击杀10只山地野狼和5只山地老狼。
dialogsFail.de: Die Bürger haben immer mehr Angst vor dieser Situation! Bitte werden Sie 10 Lawolfs & 5 Grownup Lawolfs.
dialogsFail.fi: The citizens grow ever more fearful of this situation! Please get rid of 10 Lawolfs & 5 Grownup Lawolfs.
dialogsFail.fil: The citizens grow ever more fearful of this situation! Please get rid of 10 Lawolfs & 5 Grownup Lawolfs.
dialogsFail.fr: Bon débarras, vous avez du potentiel !
dialogsFail.id: Warga semakin takut dengan situasi ini! Tolong singkirkan 10 Lawolf & 5 Grownup Lawolf.
dialogsFail.it: The citizens grow ever more fearful of this situation! Please get rid of 10 Lawolfs & 5 Grownup Lawolfs.
dialogsFail.jp: 人々はこの状況をとても怖がっています！ 10体のラーウルフと5体のグロウアップ・ラーウルフを倒してください。
dialogsFail.kr: 시민이 점점 겁을 먹고 있어요! 로울프 10마리와 성체 로울프 5마리를 없애주세요.

dialogsFail.pl: The citizens grow ever more fearful of this situation! Please get rid of 10 Lawolfs & 5 Grownup Lawolfs.
dialogsFail.ru: The citizens grow ever more fearful of this situation! Please get rid of 10 Lawolfs & 5 Grownup Lawolfs.
dialogsFail.sp: ¡Los ciudadanos tienen cada vez más miedo de esta situación! Deshazte de 10 Lawolfs y de 5 Lawolfs Adultos.
dialogsFail.sw: The citizens grow ever more fearful of this situation! Please get rid of 10 Lawolfs & 5 Grownup Lawolfs.
dialogsFail.th: ประชาชนเริ่มหวาดกลัวต่อสถานการณ์นี้มากขึ้นเรื่อยๆ! ได้โปรดกำจัด Lawolfs 10 ตัว & Grownup Lawolfs 5 ตัว
dialogsFail.tw: 市民越來越害怕這種情況！請除掉 10 隻布魯狼和 5 隻布魯狼頭目。
dialogsFail.vi: Người dân ngày càng lo sợ về tình trạng này hơn bao giờ hết! Hãy loại bỏ 10 Lawolf & 5 Grownup Lawolf.

dialogsBegin.en: Search out the Great Teacher Inisis. She has a wealth of knowledge on many subjects and has produced many outstanding students. If anyone knows it would be her.
dialogsBegin.ar: Search out the Great Teacher Inisis. She has a wealth of knowledge on many subjects and has produced many outstanding students. If anyone knows it would be her.
dialogsBegin.br: Procure a Grande Mentora Inisis. Ela tem uma riqueza de conhecimento em muitos assuntos e produziu muitos alunos excelentes. Se há alguém para saber de algo nessa cidade, ela é essa pessoa.
dialogsBegin.cns: 寻找伟大的导师伊内瑟丝。她拥有丰富的学科知识，培养了许多优秀的学生。如果所有人都认识某个人，那这个人就是她了。
dialogsBegin.de: Suchen Sie die Große Lehrerin Inisis auf. Sie verfügt über eine Fülle von Wissen zu vielen Themen und hat viele hervorragende Schüler hervorgebracht. Wenn jemand etwas weiß, dann sie.
dialogsBegin.fi: Search out the Great Teacher Inisis. She has a wealth of knowledge on many subjects and has produced many outstanding students. If anyone knows it would be her.
dialogsBegin.fil: Search out the Great Teacher Inisis. She has a wealth of knowledge on many subjects and has produced many outstanding students. If anyone knows it would be her.
dialogsBegin.fr: Inisis est la pire commère de toute la ville. Aucune rumeur ne lui échappe.
dialogsBegin.id: Carilah Great Teacher Inisis. Dia memiliki pengetahuan yang luas tentang banyak mata pelajaran dan telah menghasilkan banyak siswa berprestasi. Jika mencari orang yang tahu tentang sesuatu pastilah dia orangnya.
dialogsBegin.it: Search out the Great Teacher Inisis. She has a wealth of knowledge on many subjects and has produced many outstanding students. If anyone knows it would be her.
dialogsBegin.jp: 約束通り、貴方に有益な情報を与えられる人を紹介してあげる。ロッテンマイヤーはご存知かしら？
dialogsBegin.kr: 대스승 이니시스를 찾아가 보세요. 다양한 분야에 해박한 지식이 있고, 뛰어난 제자들을 수없이 길러 낸 분이죠. 그분이라면 무언가 알고 있을 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Search out the Great Teacher Inisis. She has a wealth of knowledge on many subjects and has produced many outstanding students. If anyone knows it would be her.
dialogsBegin.pl: Search out the Great Teacher Inisis. She has a wealth of knowledge on many subjects and has produced many outstanding students. If anyone knows it would be her.
dialogsBegin.ru: Search out the Great Teacher Inisis. She has a wealth of knowledge on many subjects and has produced many outstanding students. If anyone knows it would be her.
dialogsBegin.sp: Busca a la Mentora Inisis. Tiene un gran conocimiento en muchos ámbitos y ha enseñado a muchos estudiantes sobresalientes. Si alguien sabe algo, tiene que ser ella.
dialogsBegin.sw: Search out the Great Teacher Inisis. She has a wealth of knowledge on many subjects and has produced many outstanding students. If anyone knows it would be her.
dialogsBegin.th: ตามที่ได้สัญญาไว้ผมจะแนะนำคุณกับคนที่จะรู้จักวีรบุรุษที่คุณพูด Inisis เป็นครูที่ยิ่งใหญ่ บางทีเธออาจรู้จักกับคุณหลายคนที่พูด
dialogsBegin.tw: 和約定的一樣，我就介紹知道你所說的英雄們的人。那就是大師傅伊希尼斯。如果是培養出許多人材的她，我想她說不定會知道你所說的英雄們。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tìm kiếm người thầy vĩ đại Inisis. Cô có kiến thức phong phú về nhiều môn học và đã đào tạo ra nhiều học sinh xuất sắc. Nếu ai biết đó sẽ là cô ấy.

dialogsBegin.en: Inisis can be found at the center of Darken. Please go see her! I'm sure she will be of assistance!
dialogsBegin.ar: Inisis can be found at the center of Darken. Please go see her! I'm sure she will be of assistance!
dialogsBegin.br: Inisis pode ser encontrada no centro de Darken. Por favor, vá falar com ela! Tenho certeza que ela vai ajudar!
dialogsBegin.cns: 伊内瑟丝可以在达肯市中心找到。请去见她！我相信她可以提供帮助！
dialogsBegin.de: Inisis ist in der Mitte von Darken zu finden. Bitte geht zu ihr! Ich bin sicher, sie wird euch helfen!
dialogsBegin.fi: Inisis can be found at the center of Darken. Please go see her! I'm sure she will be of assistance!
dialogsBegin.fil: Inisis can be found at the center of Darken. Please go see her! I'm sure she will be of assistance!
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous la trouverez au centre de Darkon.
dialogsBegin.id: Inisis dapat ditemukan di center of Darken. Silakan pergi menemuinya! Saya yakin dia akan membantu!
dialogsBegin.it: Inisis can be found at the center of Darken. Please go see her! I'm sure she will be of assistance!
dialogsBegin.jp: ロッテンマイヤーはダーコンの中心にいます。ツンツンしているからすぐにわかると思うわ。でも……
dialogsBegin.kr: 이시니스는 다켄 중앙에 있으니 쉽게 찾을 수 있을 거네. 그럼 어서 그녀에게 가보게나!
dialogsBegin.nl: Inisis can be found at the center of Darken. Please go see her! I'm sure she will be of assistance!
dialogsBegin.pl: Inisis can be found at the center of Darken. Please go see her! I'm sure she will be of assistance!
dialogsBegin.ru: Inisis can be found at the center of Darken. Please go see her! I'm sure she will be of assistance!
dialogsBegin.sp: Puedes encontrar a Inisis en el centro de Darken. ¡Por favor ve a verla! ¡Estoy seguro de que ella será de ayuda!
dialogsBegin.sw: Inisis can be found at the center of Darken. Please go see her! I'm sure she will be of assistance!
dialogsBegin.th: Inisis สามารถพบได้ในใจกลาง Darken กรุณาไปดูเธอ! ฉันแน่ใจว่าเธอจะให้ความช่วยเหลือ!
dialogsBegin.tw: 伊希尼斯就在得肯的中央，很容易就可以找到。快一點過去找她吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Inisis có thể được tìm thấy ở trung tâm của Darken. Hãy đi gặp cô ấy! Tôi chắc chắn cô ấy sẽ được hỗ trợ!

dialogsAccept.en: But be patient! Inisis will hardly give you the answers you seek so quickly!
dialogsAccept.ar: But be patient! Inisis will hardly give you the answers you seek so quickly!
dialogsAccept.br: Mas tenha paciência! Dificilmente a Inisis lhe dará as respostas que procura tão rapidamente!
dialogsAccept.cns: 但是要有耐心！伊内瑟丝很难如此迅速地给你答案！
dialogsAccept.de: Aber haben Sie Geduld! Inisis wird dir kaum so schnell die Antworten geben, die du suchst!
dialogsAccept.fi: But be patient! Inisis will hardly give you the answers you seek so quickly!
dialogsAccept.fil: But be patient! Inisis will hardly give you the answers you seek so quickly!
dialogsAccept.fr: Inisis aime beaucoup marchander. Elle ne vous donnera sans doute aucune information sans contrepartie.
dialogsAccept.id: Tapi bersabarlah! Inisis tidak akan memberimu jawaban yang kamu cari dengan segera!
dialogsAccept.it: But be patient! Inisis will hardly give you the answers you seek so quickly!
dialogsAccept.jp: ロッテンマイヤーは頑固者で有名だからね。少しは信頼されないと何も教えてくれないかもしれないわ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 조급해하지 마세요! 이니시스는 그렇게 쉽게 입을 여는 분이 아니니까요!
dialogsAccept.nl: But be patient! Inisis will hardly give you the answers you seek so quickly!
dialogsAccept.pl: But be patient! Inisis will hardly give you the answers you seek so quickly!
dialogsAccept.ru: But be patient! Inisis will hardly give you the answers you seek so quickly!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Pero ten paciencia! ¡Inisis no te dará las respuestas que buscas tan rápido!
dialogsAccept.sw: But be patient! Inisis will hardly give you the answers you seek so quickly!
dialogsAccept.th: Inisis มีชื่อเสียงในด้านความดื้อรั้นของเขาและแม้ว่าเขาจะรู้เรื่องนี้เขาก็จะไม
dialogsAccept.tw: 伊希尼斯是以挑剔著名的。可能就算是知道也不會輕易告訴你吧。
dialogsAccept.vi: Nhưng hãy kiên nhẫn! Inisis sẽ khó cho bạn câu trả lời mà bạn tìm kiếm quá nhanh!

dialogsDecline.en: Changed your mind already? Guess the task wasn't that important then.
dialogsDecline.ar: Changed your mind already? Guess the task wasn't that important then.
dialogsDecline.br: Já mudou de ideia? Acho que seu pedido não era tão importante então.
dialogsDecline.cns: 你已经改变主意了吗？我猜任务当时没那么重要。
dialogsDecline.de: Hast du deine Meinung schon geändert? Dann war die Aufgabe wohl nicht so wichtig.
dialogsDecline.fi: Changed your mind already? Guess the task wasn't that important then.
dialogsDecline.fil: Changed your mind already? Guess the task wasn't that important then.
dialogsDecline.fr: Si vous avez plus important à faire, ne me laissez pas vous retenir.
dialogsDecline.id: Sudah berubah pikiran? Sepertinya tugas itu tidak begitu penting.
dialogsDecline.it: Changed your mind already? Guess the task wasn't that important then.
dialogsDecline.jp: そう？　まあ、そんなに大事なことじゃなければいいのよ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 벌써 마음이 바뀐 건가요? 별로 중요한 일은 아닌가 보군요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Changed your mind already? Guess the task wasn't that important then.
dialogsDecline.pl: Changed your mind already? Guess the task wasn't that important then.
dialogsDecline.ru: Changed your mind already? Guess the task wasn't that important then.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Ya has cambiado de opinión? Supongo que tu misión no era tan importante entonces.
dialogsDecline.sw: Changed your mind already? Guess the task wasn't that important then.
dialogsDecline.th: เปลี่ยนความคิดของคุณแล้วหรือยัง? คาดเดางานนี้คงไม่สำคัญสินะ
dialogsDecline.tw: 改變心意了嗎？這好像不是很重要的事情吧？
dialogsDecline.vi: Đã thay đổi suy nghĩ của bạn rồi? Đoán rằng nhiệm vụ lúc đó không quan trọng lắm.

dialogsComplete.en: Hmm... You are new here aren't you? Have you journeyed all this way to become one of my students?
dialogsComplete.ar: Hmm... You are new here aren't you? Have you journeyed all this way to become one of my students?
dialogsComplete.br: Hmm.. Você é novo aqui não é? Você percorreu todo esse caminho para se tornar um dos meus alunos?
dialogsComplete.cns: Hmm... You are new here aren't you? Have you journeyed all this way to become one of my students?
dialogsComplete.de: Du bist neu hier, nicht wahr? Bist du den ganzen Weg hierher gereist, um einer meiner Schüler zu werden?
dialogsComplete.fi: Hmm... You are new here aren't you? Have you journeyed all this way to become one of my students?
dialogsComplete.fil: Hmm... You are new here aren't you? Have you journeyed all this way to become one of my students?
dialogsComplete.fr: Hum… que puis-je pour toi mon petit vagabond ?
dialogsComplete.id: Hmm.. Kamu murid baru di sini bukan? Apakah kamu melakukan perjalanan sejauh ini untuk menjadi salah satu murid saya?
dialogsComplete.it: Hmm... You are new here aren't you? Have you journeyed all this way to become one of my students?
dialogsComplete.jp: ん？　君は何者だね？私の生徒になりたいと言うか？
dialogsComplete.kr: 흠... 여긴 처음 와보는 거죠? 제 제자가 되려고 여기까지 온 겁니까?
dialogsComplete.nl: Hmm... You are new here aren't you? Have you journeyed all this way to become one of my students?
dialogsComplete.pl: Hmm... You are new here aren't you? Have you journeyed all this way to become one of my students?
dialogsComplete.ru: Hmm... You are new here aren't you? Have you journeyed all this way to become one of my students?
dialogsComplete.sp: Hmm... Eres nuevo por aquí, ¿no? ¿Has recorrido todo este camino para convertirte en uno de mis estudiantes?
dialogsComplete.sw: Hmm... You are new here aren't you? Have you journeyed all this way to become one of my students?
dialogsComplete.th: อืม .. คุณเพิ่งมาที่นี่ไม่ใช่เหรอ? ที่มานี่เพราะต้องการจะเป็นหนึ่งในลูกศิษย์ของฉันงั้นรึ?
dialogsComplete.tw: 嗯……你是新來的，對吧？你一路來到這裡，是想成為我的學生之一嗎？
dialogsComplete.vi: Hmm .. Bạn là người mới ở đây phải không? Bạn đã vượt qua chừng ấy khoảng cách để đến tầm sư học đạo nơi tôi sao?

dialogsBegin.en: You know where these monsters come from right? According to the records, they were the creation of Shade. Angered by her inability to destroy all of Roika, she plagued the lands with these foul beasts.
dialogsBegin.ar: You know where these monsters come from right? According to the records, they were the creation of Shade. Angered by her inability to destroy all of Roika, she plagued the lands with these foul beasts.
dialogsBegin.br: Você sabe de onde esses monstros vêm, certo? De acordo com os registros, eles foram a criação de Shade. Irritada por sua incapacidade de destruir toda Roika, ela atormentou as terras com essas feras.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你知道这些怪物是从哪里来的对吗？根据记录，他们是谢莉德的产物。谢莉德因无法摧毁罗伊卡而愤怒，她用这些肮脏的野兽折磨着这片大陆。
dialogsBegin.de: Du weißt, woher diese Monster kommen, oder? Den Aufzeichnungen zufolge sind sie eine Schöpfung von Shade. Verärgert darüber, dass sie nicht in der Lage war, ganz Roika zu vernichten, plagte sie das Land mit diesen üblen Bestien.
dialogsBegin.fi: You know where these monsters come from right? According to the records, they were the creation of Shade. Angered by her inability to destroy all of Roika, she plagued the lands with these foul beasts.
dialogsBegin.fil: You know where these monsters come from right? According to the records, they were the creation of Shade. Angered by her inability to destroy all of Roika, she plagued the lands with these foul beasts.
dialogsBegin.fr: Qu'est-ce que je cherche ? Les secrets d'Ivillis bien entendu. Les monstres qui vivent ici sont ses esclaves.
dialogsBegin.id: Kau tahu dari mana monster-monster ini berasal, bukan? Menurut catatan, mereka adalah ciptaan Shade. Marah dengan ketidakmampuannya untuk menghancurkan semua Roika, dia berusaha menghancurkan kota dengan binatang buas ini.
dialogsBegin.it: You know where these monsters come from right? According to the records, they were the creation of Shade. Angered by her inability to destroy all of Roika, she plagued the lands with these foul beasts.
dialogsBegin.jp: 私はここでモンスターの研究をしています。貴方は私達が闘っているモンスターがどのように創造されたかご存知ですか？昔、リシスと争ったイブリスが創ったおもちゃだそうです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 몬스터들이 어디서 왔는지 알고 계세요? 기록에 따르면, 모두 쉐이드가 만들어낸 존재라고 해요. 로이카 전체를 파괴하지 못한 데 대한 분노로, 이 끔찍한 놈들을 세상에 풀어놓았다고 하죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: You know where these monsters come from right? According to the records, they were the creation of Shade. Angered by her inability to destroy all of Roika, she plagued the lands with these foul beasts.
dialogsBegin.pl: You know where these monsters come from right? According to the records, they were the creation of Shade. Angered by her inability to destroy all of Roika, she plagued the lands with these foul beasts.
dialogsBegin.ru: You know where these monsters come from right? According to the records, they were the creation of Shade. Angered by her inability to destroy all of Roika, she plagued the lands with these foul beasts.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Sabes de dónde vienen estos monstruos, verdad? Según los registros, fueron creación de Shade. Enfadada por no haber sido capaz de destruir todo Roika, llenó las tierras con estas bestias repugnantes.
dialogsBegin.sw: You know where these monsters come from right? According to the records, they were the creation of Shade. Angered by her inability to destroy all of Roika, she plagued the lands with these foul beasts.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณรู้หรือไม่ว่ามอนสเตอร์เหล่านี้มาจากด้านขวา? ตามประวัติพวกเขาสร้าง Shade โกรธเธอไม่สามารถที่จะทำลาย Roika ทั้งหมดเธอ plagued ที่ดินกับสัตว์ร้ายเหล่านี้
dialogsBegin.tw: 你知道這些怪物是從哪裡來的嗎？根據記錄，它們是闇影創造的。她因無法摧毀所有洛伊卡而感到憤怒，她用這些骯髒的野獸困擾著這片土地。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn biết những con quái vật này đến từ đâu phải không? Theo hồ sơ, họ là người tạo ra Shade. Tức giận vì không thể tiêu diệt được toàn bộ Roika, cô đã gây khó khăn cho vùng đất với những con thú hôi hám này.

dialogsBegin.en: Shade and her monsters succeeded in taking over all of Madrigal. She was subsequently defeated by 8 brave heroes who all rose to the challenge, restoring peace to the land.
dialogsBegin.ar: Shade and her monsters succeeded in taking over all of Madrigal. She was subsequently defeated by 8 brave heroes who all rose to the challenge, restoring peace to the land.
dialogsBegin.br: Shade e seus monstros conseguiram dominar Madrigal. Ela foi posteriormente derrotada por 8 bravos heróis que aceitaram o desafio, restaurando a paz na terra.
dialogsBegin.cns: 谢莉德和她的怪物们成功的掌控了瑞加大陆。但随后她被八位勇敢的英雄奋起反抗打败了，这些英雄将和平再次带给了大陆。
dialogsBegin.de: Shade und ihren Monstern gelang es, ganz Madrigal zu erobern. Sie wurde dann von 8 tapferen Helden besiegt, die sich der Herausforderung stellten und den Frieden im Land wiederherstellten.
dialogsBegin.fi: Shade and her monsters succeeded in taking over all of Madrigal. She was subsequently defeated by 8 brave heroes who all rose to the challenge, restoring peace to the land.
dialogsBegin.fil: Shade and her monsters succeeded in taking over all of Madrigal. She was subsequently defeated by 8 brave heroes who all rose to the challenge, restoring peace to the land.
dialogsBegin.fr: C'est assez simple, que cherchent les esclaves d'Ivillis au Jardin de Rhisis ?
dialogsBegin.id: Shade dan monsternya berhasil mengambil alih semua Madrigal. Dia kemudian dikalahkan oleh 8 pahlawan pemberani yang semuanya bangkit menghadapi tantangan, memulihkan perdamaian ke tanah itu.
dialogsBegin.it: Shade and her monsters succeeded in taking over all of Madrigal. She was subsequently defeated by 8 brave heroes who all rose to the challenge, restoring peace to the land.
dialogsBegin.jp: シェードと彼女のモンスターはマドリガルのすべてを引き継ぐことに成功しました。 彼女はその後、8人の勇敢な英雄に敗れ、再び平和な場所になりました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 쉐이드와 몬스터들은 한때 마드리갈 전역을 장악했어요. 하지만 그 후, 여덟 명의 용감한 영웅들이 쉐이드를 물리치고 평화를 찾아 주었죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: Shade and her monsters succeeded in taking over all of Madrigal. She was subsequently defeated by 8 brave heroes who all rose to the challenge, restoring peace to the land.
dialogsBegin.pl: Shade and her monsters succeeded in taking over all of Madrigal. She was subsequently defeated by 8 brave heroes who all rose to the challenge, restoring peace to the land.
dialogsBegin.ru: Shade and her monsters succeeded in taking over all of Madrigal. She was subsequently defeated by 8 brave heroes who all rose to the challenge, restoring peace to the land.
dialogsBegin.sp: Shade y sus monstruos lograron apoderarse de todo Madrigal. Más tarde, fue derrotada por 8 valientes héroes que la desafiaron y restauraron la paz en Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.sw: Shade and her monsters succeeded in taking over all of Madrigal. She was subsequently defeated by 8 brave heroes who all rose to the challenge, restoring peace to the land.
dialogsBegin.th: Shade และมอนสเตอร์ของเธอประสบความสำเร็จในการครอบครอง Madrigal ทั้งหมด หลังจากนั้นเธอก็แพ้ 8 วีรบุรุษผู้กล้าหาญทุกคนลุกขึ้นท้าทายความสงบสุขกับแผ่นดิน
dialogsBegin.tw: 闇影和她的怪物成功地接管了整個瑪德利賈。她隨後被 8 位勇敢的英雄打敗，他們都挺身而出，恢復了大地的和平。
dialogsBegin.vi: Shade và những con quái vật của cô đã thành công trong việc chiếm toàn bộ Madrigal. Sau đó, cô đã bị đánh bại bởi 8 anh hùng dũng cảm, những người đã vượt lên thử thách, khôi phục hòa bình cho vùng đất.

dialogsBegin.en: Shade is now dead, but monsters that she created still exist. In fact, they seem to be growing stronger and greater in number. I'm here in the hopes of uncovering some sort of answer.
dialogsBegin.ar: Shade is now dead, but monsters that she created still exist. In fact, they seem to be growing stronger and greater in number. I'm here in the hopes of uncovering some sort of answer.
dialogsBegin.br: Shade agora está morta, mas os monstros que ela criou ainda existem. Na verdade, eles parecem estar ficando cada vez mais fortes e em maior número. Estou aqui na esperança de descobrir algum tipo de resposta.
dialogsBegin.cns: 谢莉德已经死亡了，但是她创造的怪兽仍然存在。实际上，他们数量正在增加并且力量正在变强。我来到这就是问了寻求这个情况的答案。
dialogsBegin.de: Shade ist jetzt tot, aber die Monster, die sie erschaffen hat, existieren immer noch. Sie scheinen sogar noch stärker und zahlreicher zu werden. Ich bin hier in der Hoffnung, eine Art Antwort zu finden.
dialogsBegin.fi: Shade is now dead, but monsters that she created still exist. In fact, they seem to be growing stronger and greater in number. I'm here in the hopes of uncovering some sort of answer.
dialogsBegin.fil: Shade is now dead, but monsters that she created still exist. In fact, they seem to be growing stronger and greater in number. I'm here in the hopes of uncovering some sort of answer.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je suis persuadée que je pourrais trouver la réponse...
dialogsBegin.id: Shade sekarang sudah mati, tetapi monster yang dia ciptakan masih ada. Bahkan, mereka tampaknya semakin kuat dan lebih besar jumlahnya. Saya di sini dengan harapan untuk mengungkap suatu jawaban.
dialogsBegin.it: Shade is now dead, but monsters that she created still exist. In fact, they seem to be growing stronger and greater in number. I'm here in the hopes of uncovering some sort of answer.
dialogsBegin.jp: シェードは死にましたが、彼女が作ったモンスターはまだ存在しています。 実際、それらはますます強くなり、数が増えているようです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 쉐이드는 소멸했지만, 그녀가 창조한 몬스터들은 여전히 남아 있어요. 오히려 더 강력해지고, 그 수도 증가하고 있죠. 그래서 단서를 찾아보려고 이곳에 왔어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Shade is now dead, but monsters that she created still exist. In fact, they seem to be growing stronger and greater in number. I'm here in the hopes of uncovering some sort of answer.
dialogsBegin.pl: Shade is now dead, but monsters that she created still exist. In fact, they seem to be growing stronger and greater in number. I'm here in the hopes of uncovering some sort of answer.
dialogsBegin.ru: Shade is now dead, but monsters that she created still exist. In fact, they seem to be growing stronger and greater in number. I'm here in the hopes of uncovering some sort of answer.
dialogsBegin.sp: Shade está muerta, pero los monstruos que ella creó todavía existen. De hecho, parece que cada vez son más fuertes y están aumentando en número. Estoy aquí con la esperanza de descubrir algún tipo de respuesta.
dialogsBegin.sw: Shade is now dead, but monsters that she created still exist. In fact, they seem to be growing stronger and greater in number. I'm here in the hopes of uncovering some sort of answer.
dialogsBegin.th: ตอนนี้ Shade ตายแล้ว แต่มอนสเตอร์ที่เธอสร้างยังคงมีอยู่ ในความเป็นจริงพวกเขาดูเหมือนจะเติบโตแข็งแกร่งและมากขึ้นในจำนวนนั้น ฉันอยู่ที่นี่ด้วยความหวังในการค้นพบคำตอบบางอย่าง
dialogsBegin.tw: 闇影現在已經死了，但她創造的怪物仍然存在。事實上，它們的數量似乎越來越大。我在這里希望能找到某種答案。
dialogsBegin.vi: Shade hiện đã chết, nhưng những con quái vật mà cô ấy tạo ra vẫn tồn tại. Trên thực tế, chúng dường như đang phát triển mạnh mẽ hơn và số lượng lớn hơn. Tôi ở đây với hy vọng tìm ra câu trả lời nào đó.

dialogsBegin.en: Research is difficult with the constant threat of Tombstone Bearers around. Will you please help buy me some time by defeating them?
dialogsBegin.ar: Research is difficult with the constant threat of Tombstone Bearers around. Will you please help buy me some time by defeating them?
dialogsBegin.br: A pesquisa é difícil com a constante ameaça dos Portadores de Lápides ao redor. Poderia me ajudar a ganhar algum tempo acabando com eles?
dialogsBegin.cns: 由于碑石工匠在周围不断地威胁安全，研究很难正常开展。你愿意花点时间帮我打败他们吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Die ständige Bedrohung durch die Tombstone Bearers macht die Forschung schwierig. Würden Sie mir bitte helfen, etwas Zeit zu gewinnen, indem Sie sie besiegen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Research is difficult with the constant threat of Tombstone Bearers around. Will you please help buy me some time by defeating them?
dialogsBegin.fil: Research is difficult with the constant threat of Tombstone Bearers around. Will you please help buy me some time by defeating them?
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais ces Tombstone ma barrent la route. Pourriez-vous faire un peu de ménage pour moi ?
dialogsBegin.id: Penelitian sulit dilakukan dengan ancaman konstan dari Tombstone Bearers di sekitarku. Maukah kau membantu dengan memberi saya waktu dengan mengalahkan mereka?
dialogsBegin.it: Research is difficult with the constant threat of Tombstone Bearers around. Will you please help buy me some time by defeating them?
dialogsBegin.jp: ただ…ここにきて調査は行き詰っています。周囲のモンスターがあまりにも増えすぎてしまい身動きが取れなくなってしまいました。どうか手伝って頂けませんか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 툼스톤 베어러들이 계속 위협을 가하는 바람에 연구에 집중하기가 어려워요. 시간을 벌 수 있도록, 녀석들을 처치해 주시겠어요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Research is difficult with the constant threat of Tombstone Bearers around. Will you please help buy me some time by defeating them?
dialogsBegin.pl: Badania są trudne ze względu na ciągłe zagrożenie ze strony Targaczy Nagrobków. Czy pomożesz mi kupić trochę czasu, pokonując ich?
dialogsBegin.ru: Research is difficult with the constant threat of Tombstone Bearers around. Will you please help buy me some time by defeating them?
dialogsBegin.sp: La investigación es complicada con la constante amenaza de Tombstone Bearers por alrededor. ¿Podrías ayudarme a ganar algo de tiempo derrotándolos?
dialogsBegin.sw: Research is difficult with the constant threat of Tombstone Bearers around. Will you please help buy me some time by defeating them?
dialogsBegin.th: การวิจัยเป็นสิ่งที่ยากลำบากและมีภัยคุกคามต่อผู้ถือ Tombstone Bearers อยู่ตลอด คุณช่วยกรุณาช่วยยื้อเวลาด้วยการเอาชนะพวกเขาได้ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 由於苦命超人的不斷威脅，研究很困難。你能幫我打敗他們，幫我爭取一些時間嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Việc nghiên cứu rất khó khăn với sự đe dọa thường xuyên của những Người mang bia mộ xung quanh. Bạn vui lòng giúp tôi một chút thời gian bằng cách đánh bại chúng được không?

dialogsAccept.en: Thank you for your assistance. Killing 15 Tombstone Bearers should allow me ample time to complete my research.
dialogsAccept.ar: Thank you for your assistance. Killing 15 Tombstone Bearers should allow me ample time to complete my research.
dialogsAccept.br: Obrigada pela sua ajuda. Matar 15 Portadores de Lápides deve me dar tempo suficiente para completar minha pesquisa.
dialogsAccept.cns: 谢谢你的协助。杀死15个碑石工匠应该就可以让我有足够时间完成我的研究了。
dialogsAccept.de: Ich danke Euch für Eure Hilfe. Die Tötung von 15 Tombstone Bearers sollte mir ausreichend Zeit geben, meine Nachforschungen abzuschließen.
dialogsAccept.fi: Thank you for your assistance. Killing 15 Tombstone Bearers should allow me ample time to complete my research.
dialogsAccept.fil: Thank you for your assistance. Killing 15 Tombstone Bearers should allow me ample time to complete my research.
dialogsAccept.fr: Si vous en tuez quelques-uns et laissez les cadavres pourrir au soleil, les autres devraient comprendre le message.
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih atas bantuanmu. Membunuh 15 Tombstone Bearers seharusnya memberi saya cukup waktu untuk menyelesaikan penelitian saya.
dialogsAccept.it: Thank you for your assistance. Killing 15 Tombstone Bearers should allow me ample time to complete my research.
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとうございます。私は調査を続けておりますので、この周囲にいるトムストンベアーを15匹倒して下さい。
dialogsAccept.kr: 도와주셔서 감사합니다. 툼스톤 베어러 15마리만 처치해 주시면, 연구를 마무리할 시간도 충분할 거예요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Thank you for your assistance. Killing 15 Tombstone Bearers should allow me ample time to complete my research.
dialogsAccept.pl: Dziękuję za pomoc. Zabicie 15 Targaczy Nagrobków powinno dać mi wystarczająco dużo czasu na ukończenie badań.
dialogsAccept.ru: Thank you for your assistance. Killing 15 Tombstone Bearers should allow me ample time to complete my research.
dialogsAccept.sp: Gracias por tu ayuda. Derrotar a 15 Tombstone Bearers debería darme suficiente tiempo para completar mi investigación.
dialogsAccept.sw: Thank you for your assistance. Killing 15 Tombstone Bearers should allow me ample time to complete my research.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอบคุณสำหรับความช่วยเหลือ. การฆ่า 15 Tombstone Bearers ควรช่วยให้ฉันมีเวลาเหลือเฟือในการทำวิจัยของฉัน
dialogsAccept.tw: 謝謝你的幫助。殺死 15 個苦命超人應該讓我有足夠的時間來完成我的研究。
dialogsAccept.vi: Cám ơn sự giúp đỡ của bạn. Giết 15 Tombstone Bearers sẽ cho phép tôi có nhiều thời gian để hoàn thành nghiên cứu của mình.

dialogsDecline.pl: For the sake of truth, please do not pass up my request!

dialogsDecline.sw: For the sake of truth, please do not pass up my request!

dialogsDecline.vi: Vì sự thật, xin đừng từ bỏ yêu cầu của tôi!

dialogsFail.en: I'm still in the process of research. Please go and defeat 15 Small Tombstone Bearers & 7 Tombstone Bearers while I complete my work!
dialogsFail.ar: I'm still in the process of research. Please go and defeat 15 Small Tombstone Bearers & 7 Tombstone Bearers while I complete my work!
dialogsFail.br: Ainda estou em processo de pesquisa. Por favor, vá e derrote 15 Portadores de Lápides Pequenos e 7 Portadores de Lápides enquanto eu termino meu trabalho!
dialogsFail.cns: 我仍在继续做研究。请在我完成我工作的同时，前去杀死15个碑石工匠学徒和7个碑石工匠。
dialogsFail.de: Ich bin immer noch in der Forschung. Bitte geh und besiege 5 Small Tombstone Bearers & 7 Tombstone Bearers, während ich meine Arbeit beende!
dialogsFail.fi: I'm still in the process of research. Please go and defeat 15 Small Tombstone Bearers & 7 Tombstone Bearers while I complete my work!
dialogsFail.fil: I'm still in the process of research. Please go and defeat 15 Small Tombstone Bearers & 7 Tombstone Bearers while I complete my work!
dialogsFail.fr: Je vous ai dit de tuer 15 Jeunes Tombstones et 7 Tombstones, c'est important.
dialogsFail.id: Saya masih dalam proses penelitian. Silakan pergi dan kalahkan 15 Small Tombstone Bearers &7 Tombstone Bearers sementara saya menyelesaikan pekerjaan saya!
dialogsFail.it: I'm still in the process of research. Please go and defeat 15 Small Tombstone Bearers & 7 Tombstone Bearers while I complete my work!
dialogsFail.jp: スモール・トムストンベアラーが特に邪魔をするんです。15匹倒してください！どうかお願いします。
dialogsFail.kr: 아직 연구가 끝나지 않았어요. 제가 연구를 마칠 수 있도록 작은 툼스톤 베어러 15마리와 툼스톤 베어러 7마리를 처치해 주세요!
dialogsFail.nl: I'm still in the process of research. Please go and defeat 15 Small Tombstone Bearers & 7 Tombstone Bearers while I complete my work!
dialogsFail.pl: Nadal jestem w trakcie badań. Proszę, idź i pokonaj 15 Małych Targaczy Nagrobków i 7 Targaczy Nagrobków, podczas gdy ja dokończę swoją pracę.
dialogsFail.ru: I'm still in the process of research. Please go and defeat 15 Small Tombstone Bearers & 7 Tombstone Bearers while I complete my work!
dialogsFail.sp: La investigación todavía está en proceso. ¡Ve y derrota a 15 Tombstone Bearers Pequeños y a 7 Tombstone Bearers mientras la completo!
dialogsFail.sw: I'm still in the process of research. Please go and defeat 15 Small Tombstone Bearers & 7 Tombstone Bearers while I complete my work!
dialogsFail.th: ฉันยังอยู่ระหว่างการวิจัย กรุณาไปและเอาชนะ Small Tombstone Bearer 15 ตัว
dialogsFail.tw: 我還在研究過程中。在我完成我的工作時，請去打敗 15 個苦命小超人和 7 個苦命超人！
dialogsFail.vi: Tôi vẫn đang trong quá trình nghiên cứu. Hãy đi và đánh bại 15 Người mang bia mộ nhỏ & 7 Người mang bia mộ trong khi tôi hoàn thành công việc của mình!

description.en: Speak with High-Dwarpet Hastan north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you lose your way.
description.ar: Speak with High-Dwarpet Hastan north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you lose your way.
description.br: Por favor, vá encontrar Hastan no local dos Alto Dwarpets.
description.cns: 到高阶矮人族的居住地找海珊之前，请到亡者之泉找一个技能序章，这样他才会见你。
description.de: Suche den High-Dwarpet Hastan. Er wird dich in der Kampfkunst des Magicians unterweisen. Oh, zuvor noch eins..
description.fi: Speak with High-Dwarpet Hastan north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you lose your way.
description.fil: Speak with High-Dwarpet Hastan north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you lose your way.
description.fr: Rencontrer Hastan qui habite avec les Grand Dwarpets près des Montagnes centrales de Leren.
description.id: Bicara dengan High-Dwarpet Hastan di utara Flarine. Periksa petamu (Tombol M) jika tersesat.
description.it: Speak with High-Dwarpet Hastan north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you lose your way.
description.jp: ハイドワーフの生息地にいる＜ハスタン＞のところへ行こう！
description.kr: 플라리네 북부에 있는 하이-드워펫 해스탄과 대화하세요. 길을 잃으면 지도(M키)를 확인하세요.
description.nl: Speak with High-Dwarpet Hastan north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you lose your way.
description.pl: Speak with High-Dwarpet Hastan north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you lose your way.
description.ru: Нужно поговорить с высоким карликом Гастаном в лагере к северу от Фларинции. Направление всегда можно посмотреть по карте ("M").
description.sp: Habla con el Alto-Enano Hastan al norte desde Flarine. Revisa tu mapa (Tecla M) si te pierdes.
description.sw: Speak with High-Dwarpet Hastan north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you lose your way.
description.th: คุยกับ High-Dwarpet Hastan ทางเหนือของ Flarine ตรวจสอบแผนที่ของคุณ (คีย์ M) หากคุณหลงทาง
description.tw: 到海倚_杜爾沛的居住地找海珊之前，請到亡者之泉找一個技能序章，這樣他才會見你。
description.vi: Nói chuyện với High-Dwarpet Hastan ở phía bắc Flarine. Kiểm tra bản đồ của bạn (phím M) nếu bạn bị lạc đường.

dialogsBegin.en: That concludes your lesson on Magician weaponry. Now, I'll need you to visit one of the High-Dwarpets to continue your training.
dialogsBegin.ar: That concludes your lesson on Magician weaponry. Now, I'll need you to visit one of the High-Dwarpets to continue your training.
dialogsBegin.br: Agora fiz o que precisava fazer. Certo, o próximo teste! Você deve obter informações a respeito das habilidades de Magos. Primeiro, vá até o local onde vivem os Altos Dwarpets.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我要告诉你的事情，已经讲完了。下一个考验是，你要学习关于魔导士的技术。你要去海倚矮人族的居住地。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich glaube getan zu haben, was ich tun konnte. Lass mich nun über die nächste Prüfung reden. Es geht dabei um die Fähigkeiten des Magicians. Gehe zu den High-Dwarpet.
dialogsBegin.fi: That concludes your lesson on Magician weaponry. Now, I'll need you to visit one of the High-Dwarpets to continue your training.
dialogsBegin.fil: That concludes your lesson on Magician weaponry. Now, I'll need you to visit one of the High-Dwarpets to continue your training.
dialogsBegin.fr:
Tu sembles avoir bien compris comment utiliser les armes. Voici la prochaine étape.
Tu connais les Grands Dwarpets ? Ils vivent près des montagnes centrales de Leren.
dialogsBegin.id: Itu kesimpulan pelajaranmu tentang persenjataan Magician. Sekarang, aku ingin kamu mengunjungi salah satu High-Dwarpets untuk melanjutkan pelatihanmu.
dialogsBegin.it: That concludes your lesson on Magician weaponry. Now, I'll need you to visit one of the High-Dwarpets to continue your training.
dialogsBegin.jp: これで、私に教えられることは全てです。では、次のテストを受けてくださいね。次は、マジシャンの技術に関する情報を集めることなのですが、その前にまず、ハイドワーフの生息地を探し出さなければなりません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이제 매지션 무기에 대한 수업은 끝났어요. 남은 훈련은 하이-드워펫을 찾아가 받도록 하세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: That concludes your lesson on Magician weaponry. Now, I'll need you to visit one of the High-Dwarpets to continue your training.
dialogsBegin.pl: That concludes your lesson on Magician weaponry. Now, I'll need you to visit one of the High-Dwarpets to continue your training.
dialogsBegin.ru: Ну вот я и рассказала тебе все, что нужно знать об оружии. А о наших умениях тебе поведает один из высоких карликов.
dialogsBegin.sp: Con esto concluye la lección de Armas de Magician. Ahora, visita a uno de los Alto-Enanos para continuar tu entrenamiento.
dialogsBegin.sw: That concludes your lesson on Magician weaponry. Now, I'll need you to visit one of the High-Dwarpets to continue your training.
dialogsBegin.th: นั่นเป็นการสรุปบทเรียนของคุณเกี่ยวกับอาวุธของ Magician ฉันต้องการให้คุณไปเยี่ยมหนึ่งใน High-Dwarpets เพื่อฝึกต่อ
dialogsBegin.tw: 我要告訴你的事情，已經講完了。下一個考驗是，你要學習關於魔法師的技術。你要去海倚杜爾沛的居住地。
dialogsBegin.vi: Điều đó kết thúc bài học của bạn về vũ khí của Magician. Bây giờ, tôi cần bạn đến thăm một trong những High-Dwarpets để tiếp tục quá trình huấn luyện của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Travel to Flarine and head north. You'll find a High-Dwarpet camp just south of the middle of Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.ar: Travel to Flarine and head north. You'll find a High-Dwarpet camp just south of the middle of Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.br: Vá e visite o Alto Dwarpet Hastan, que lhe contará coisas a respeito das habilidades de um Mago. Ah, há algo que você precisa fazer antes de visitá-lo...
dialogsBegin.cns: 在帕里镇一直往北的地方，有一个乐雅山脉。在乐雅山脉中部以南的地方，你可以找到高阶矮人族们的营地
dialogsBegin.de: Suche den High-Dwarpet Hastan. Er wird dich in der Kampfkunst des Magicians unterweisen. Oh, zuvor noch eins..
dialogsBegin.fi: Travel to Flarine and head north. You'll find a High-Dwarpet camp just south of the middle of Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.fil: Travel to Flarine and head north. You'll find a High-Dwarpet camp just south of the middle of Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.fr: Présente-toi au Grand Dwarpet Hastan, c'était un grand magicien dans le temps.
dialogsBegin.id: Perjalanan ke Flarine dan menuju utara. Kamu akan menemukan kamp High-Dwarpet di selatan tengah Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.it: Travel to Flarine and head north. You'll find a High-Dwarpet camp just south of the middle of Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.jp: ハイドワーフの生息地を探し出し、＜ハスタン＞というハイドワーフに会うと、彼からマジシャンの技術について教わることができるでしょう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 플라리네 북쪽으로 가면, 레르엔 산맥 중부 아래쪽에 하이-드워펫 야영지가 있을 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Travel to Flarine and head north. You'll find a High-Dwarpet camp just south of the middle of Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.pl: Travel to Flarine and head north. You'll find a High-Dwarpet camp just south of the middle of Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.ru: Отправляйся во Фларинцию, а от нее иди на север. Лагерь высоких карликов разбит к югу от Леренских горок.
dialogsBegin.sp: Viaja a Flarine y dirígete hacia el norte. Encontrarás al campamento de los Alto-Enanos al sur del Centro de las Montañas Leren.
dialogsBegin.sw: Travel to Flarine and head north. You'll find a High-Dwarpet camp just south of the middle of Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.th: เดินทางไปยัง Flarine และมุ่งหน้าไปทางเหนือ คุณจะพบค่าย High-Dwarpet ทางตอนใต้ของใจกลาง Leren Mountains
dialogsBegin.tw: 到海倚杜爾沛的居住地，找一個叫做海珊的海倚杜爾沛，他會告訴你一些技術的相關知識。在那之前…
dialogsBegin.vi: Đi đến Flarine và đi về phía bắc. Bạn sẽ tìm thấy một trại High-Dwarpet ngay phía nam của chính giữa Leren Mountains.

dialogsBegin.en: Speak with High-Dwarpet Hastan once you arrive. If you get lost, you can check your map (M Key) to find your way.
dialogsBegin.ar: Speak with High-Dwarpet Hastan once you arrive. If you get lost, you can check your map (M Key) to find your way.
dialogsBegin.br: Você pode marcar o local dos Alto Dwarpets com a tecla de atalho M. É realmente útil marcar a localização de algum lugar.
dialogsBegin.cns: 到高阶矮人族的居住地找海珊之前，请到亡者之泉找一个技能序章，这样他才会见你。
dialogsBegin.de: Er wird dir ein Label of Technique geben und eine Aufgabe. Erfülle diese bitte.
dialogsBegin.fi: Speak with High-Dwarpet Hastan once you arrive. If you get lost, you can check your map (M Key) to find your way.
dialogsBegin.fil: Speak with High-Dwarpet Hastan once you arrive. If you get lost, you can check your map (M Key) to find your way.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il t'apprendra bien des choses, et s'il t'aime bien, il te confiera même une de ses techniques.
dialogsBegin.id: Bicara dengan High-Dwarpet Hastan setelah kamu tiba. Jika tersesat, kamu dapat memeriksa petamu (Tombol M) untuk menemukan jalan.
dialogsBegin.it: Speak with High-Dwarpet Hastan once you arrive. If you get lost, you can check your map (M Key) to find your way.
dialogsBegin.jp: ハイドワーフは人間を嫌っていますが、きっと彼らはあなたに心を開いてくれるでしょう。さあ、＜ハスタン＞の元へお行きなさい。
dialogsBegin.kr: 도착하면 하이-드워펫 해스탄을 만나세요. 가다가 길을 잃으면, M키를 눌러 지도를 확인하세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Speak with High-Dwarpet Hastan once you arrive. If you get lost, you can check your map (M Key) to find your way.
dialogsBegin.pl: Speak with High-Dwarpet Hastan once you arrive. If you get lost, you can check your map (M Key) to find your way.
dialogsBegin.ru: Отыщи там Гастана. Если потеряешься, сверься с картой ("M"). Ну что, в путь?
dialogsBegin.sp: Habla con el Alto-Enano Hastan una vez que llegues. Si te pierdes, puedes revisar tu mapa (Tecla M) para encontrar el camino.
dialogsBegin.sw: Speak with High-Dwarpet Hastan once you arrive. If you get lost, you can check your map (M Key) to find your way.
dialogsBegin.th: คุยกับ High-Dwarpet Hastan เมื่อคุณมาถึง หากคุณหลงทาง คุณสามารถตรวจสอบแผนที่ (M Key) เพื่อค้นหาเส้นทางของคุณ
dialogsBegin.tw: 到海倚杜爾沛的居住地找海珊之前，請到亡者之泉找一個技能序章，這樣他才會見你。
dialogsBegin.vi: Nói chuyện với High-Dwarpet Hastan khi bạn đến nơi. Nếu bị lạc, bạn có thể kiểm tra bản đồ (phím M) để tìm đường.
