dialogsDecline.en: Do not be frightened by what lies ahead. This is your destiny. Speak with me again if you'd like to continue your path.
dialogsDecline.ar: Do not be frightened by what lies ahead. This is your destiny. Speak with me again if you'd like to continue your path.
dialogsDecline.br: Você está preocupado com o que Wingyei disse? Não preste atenção nisso. Apenas acredite em você mesmo. Certo?
dialogsDecline.cns: 很在意伟依对你说的话吗?他本来就这样啦~所以不要太在意，用你自己的信念去做就好啦~
dialogsDecline.de: Ärgerst du dich über das, was Wingyei sagte? Sie ist immer so, deshalb brauchst dir darüber keine Gedanken machen. Habe Selbstvertrauen! Okay?
dialogsDecline.fi: Do not be frightened by what lies ahead. This is your destiny. Speak with me again if you'd like to continue your path.
dialogsDecline.fil: Do not be frightened by what lies ahead. This is your destiny. Speak with me again if you'd like to continue your path.
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu t'inquiètes pour la suite des évènements ? N'y prête pas attention, aies juste confiance en toi.
dialogsDecline.id: Jangan takut dengan apa yang ada di depan. Ini adalah takdirmu. Bicaralah denganku lagi jika ingin melanjutkan perjalananmu.
dialogsDecline.it: Do not be frightened by what lies ahead. This is your destiny. Speak with me again if you'd like to continue your path.
dialogsDecline.jp: 諦めてしまうのもしかたないことです。ご自分が決断したことであれば、好きなように進めばいいのですよ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 앞으로의 길이 두렵더라도 겁먹지 마세요. 당신의 운명이니까요. 계속 훈련을 받고 싶다면, 다시 말 걸어주세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Do not be frightened by what lies ahead. This is your destiny. Speak with me again if you'd like to continue your path.
dialogsDecline.pl: Do not be frightened by what lies ahead. This is your destiny. Speak with me again if you'd like to continue your path.
dialogsDecline.ru: Не страшись грядущего. Фокусы - твоя судьба, твое призвание. Когда поймешь это, приходи.
dialogsDecline.sp: No te asustes por lo que se avecina. Este es tu destino. Habla conmigo de nuevo si quieres continuar tu camino.
dialogsDecline.sw: Do not be frightened by what lies ahead. This is your destiny. Speak with me again if you'd like to continue your path.
dialogsDecline.th: อย่าตกใจกับสิ่งที่อยู่ข้างหน้า นี่คือชะตากรรมของคุณ พูดกับฉันอีกครั้งหากคุณต้องการดำเนินการต่อเส้นทางของคุณ
dialogsDecline.tw: 很在意偉依對你說的話嗎？他本來就這樣啦~所以不要太在意，用你自己的信念去做就好啦~
dialogsDecline.vi: Đừng sợ hãi những gì phía trước. Đây là số phận của bạn. Nói chuyện với tôi một lần nữa nếu bạn muốn tiếp tục con đường của mình.

dialogsComplete.en: Greetings, young one! The will of Rhisis be with you! I am Hastan. Magician Master Hee mentioned that you might be stopping by.
dialogsComplete.ar: Greetings, young one! The will of Rhisis be with you! I am Hastan. Magician Master Hee mentioned that you might be stopping by.
dialogsComplete.br: Saudações, jovem! Que a vontade de Rhisis esteja com você! Eu sou Hastan. A Mestre Maga Hee mencionou que você estaria passando por aqui.
dialogsComplete.cns: 你好，年轻人！莱斯神的意志伴随着你！我叫海珊。魔法大师海恩提到你可能会过来。
dialogsComplete.de: Sei gegrüßt, Jüngling! Der Wille von Rhisis sei mit dir! Ich bin Hastan. Magiermeister Hee erwähnte, dass du vielleicht vorbeikommen würdest.
dialogsComplete.fi: Greetings, young one! The will of Rhisis be with you! I am Hastan. Magician Master Hee mentioned that you might be stopping by.
dialogsComplete.fil: Greetings, young one! The will of Rhisis be with you! I am Hastan. Magician Master Hee mentioned that you might be stopping by.
dialogsComplete.fr: Tu as du potentiel. Je veux bien t'apprendre une de mes techniques, c'est une très importante.
dialogsComplete.id: Salam, anak muda! Kehendak Rhisis bersamamu! Aku Hastan. Magician Master Hee menyebutkan bahwa kamu mungkin akan mampir.
dialogsComplete.it: Greetings, young one! The will of Rhisis be with you! I am Hastan. Magician Master Hee mentioned that you might be stopping by.
dialogsComplete.jp: ん？人間か？人間は嫌いだが、お前と話すのは悪い気はしないな。よし、いいことを教えてあげよう。このスキル事典の･･･あったあった。
dialogsComplete.kr: 안녕하세요, 젊은이. 리시스의 뜻이 당신과 함께하길. 저는 해스탄입니다. 매지션 마스터 희님께서 당신이 올지도 모른다고 하시더군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Greetings, young one! The will of Rhisis be with you! I am Hastan. Magician Master Hee mentioned that you might be stopping by.
dialogsComplete.pl: Greetings, young one! The will of Rhisis be with you! I am Hastan. Magician Master Hee mentioned that you might be stopping by.
dialogsComplete.ru: Ну, здравствуй. Да хранит тебя Райс! Я - Гастан. Магистр Хея говорила, что ты придешь.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Saludos, joven! ¡Qué la voluntad de Rhisis esté contigo! Soy Hastan. La Maestra Magician Hee mencionó que tal vez te pasarías por aquí.
dialogsComplete.sw: Greetings, young one! The will of Rhisis be with you! I am Hastan. Magician Master Hee mentioned that you might be stopping by.
dialogsComplete.th: สวัสดีหนุ่มๆ! ความประสงค์ของ Rhisis จะอยู่กับคุณ! ฉันชื่อ Hastan ปรมาจารย์ Magician Hee กล่าวว่าคุณอาจจะแวะมา
dialogsComplete.tw: 問候，年輕人！黎席斯的意志與你同在！我是哈斯坦，魔法使大師熙提到你可能會過來。
dialogsComplete.vi: Chúc mừng, bạn trẻ! Ý chí của Rhisis sẽ ở bên bạn! Tôi là Hastan. Magician Master Hee đã nhắc rằng bạn có thể sẽ ghé qua.

dialogsComplete.en: Magicians are powerful fighters that utilize magic to defeat their enemies. Let me go over one of the basic attacks with you.
dialogsComplete.ar: Magicians are powerful fighters that utilize magic to defeat their enemies. Let me go over one of the basic attacks with you.
dialogsComplete.br: A vontade de Rhisis permite que você derrote seus inimigos com este poder. É um feitiço básico de Mago conhecido como Ataque Mental.
dialogsComplete.cns: 黎席斯的意志力，助你使其他人的精神混乱，请助赐给我力量吧!这是魔导士的一个技能，叫做念力球。
dialogsComplete.de: Saint Morning wird seit längerem von einem Monster namens Seido angegriffen. Vernichte Seido und kehre zurück zum Magician Anweiser.
dialogsComplete.fi: Magicians are powerful fighters that utilize magic to defeat their enemies. Let me go over one of the basic attacks with you.
dialogsComplete.fil: Magicians are powerful fighters that utilize magic to defeat their enemies. Let me go over one of the basic attacks with you.
dialogsComplete.fr: Voici une des premières compétences à maîtriser pour tout Magicien, on l'appelle Fouet Mental.
dialogsComplete.id: Magician adalah petarung kuat yang memanfaatkan sihir untuk mengalahkan musuh mereka. Biarkan aku membahas salah satu serangan dasar denganmu.
dialogsComplete.it: Magicians are powerful fighters that utilize magic to defeat their enemies. Let me go over one of the basic attacks with you.
dialogsComplete.jp: 〈大いなるリシスよ。あなたから授かった偉大な力で、邪悪なる魂を持つ者の精神にリシスの裁きを下します〉これが、マジシャンの一番ベーシックなスキル＜メンタルストライク＞と呼ばれる呪文だ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 매지션은 마법을 통해 적을 쓰러뜨리는 강력한 전투를 할 수 있습니다. 기본 공격 중 하나를 설명해 드리죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: Magicians are powerful fighters that utilize magic to defeat their enemies. Let me go over one of the basic attacks with you.
dialogsComplete.pl: Magicians are powerful fighters that utilize magic to defeat their enemies. Let me go over one of the basic attacks with you.
dialogsComplete.ru: Мы, фокусники, не только кролика достать из шляпы можем, но и отпор любому громиле дадим. Люди зовут наши трюки магией. Давай, я расскажу тебе о простом, но очень полезном приеме.
dialogsComplete.sp: Los Magicians son guerreros poderosos que utilizan la magia para derrotar a sus enemigos. Deja que te enseñe uno de los ataques básicos.
dialogsComplete.sw: Magicians are powerful fighters that utilize magic to defeat their enemies. Let me go over one of the basic attacks with you.
dialogsComplete.th: Magicians เป็นนักสู้ที่ทรงพลังที่ใช้เวทมนตร์เพื่อเอาชนะศัตรู ให้ฉันแนะนำการโจมตีพื้นฐานกับคุณ
dialogsComplete.tw: 黎席斯的意志力，助你使其他人的精神混亂，請助賜給我力量吧！這是魔法師的一個技能，叫做念力球。
dialogsComplete.vi: Magicians là những chiến binh mạnh mẽ sử dụng phép thuật để đánh bại kẻ thù. Hãy để tôi cùng bạn xem qua một trong những cách tấn công cơ bản.

dialogsComplete.en: Mental Strike is a very strong magic attack that consumes Magic Points (MP) in order to be cast. This skill allows you to attack the target from a distance for a high amount of damage.
dialogsComplete.ar: Mental Strike is a very strong magic attack that consumes Magic Points (MP) in order to be cast. This skill allows you to attack the target from a distance for a high amount of damage.
dialogsComplete.br: É um ataque psíquico poderoso que somente os Magos mais poderosos podem aprender...e parece que você será realmente poderoso.
dialogsComplete.cns: 这个不管对方的属性，会让对方绝得自己受了重伤，是一个很炫的技术呢~
dialogsComplete.de: Nimm bitte dieses Label of Technique. Es ist der Beweis, das ich dir die Aufgabe erteilt habe.
dialogsComplete.fi: Mental Strike is a very strong magic attack that consumes Magic Points (MP) in order to be cast. This skill allows you to attack the target from a distance for a high amount of damage.
dialogsComplete.fil: Mental Strike is a very strong magic attack that consumes Magic Points (MP) in order to be cast. This skill allows you to attack the target from a distance for a high amount of damage.
dialogsComplete.fr: Grâce à cette compétence, tu peux utiliser ta force psychique pour infliger des dégâts à un ennemi, uniquement en le persuadant qu'il a été blessé. Cette attaque se révèlera souvent très efficace, tu verras.
dialogsComplete.id: Mental Strike adalah serangan sihir yang sangat kuat yang menghabiskan Magic Points (MP) untuk dilemparkan. Skill ini memungkinkanmu untuk menyerang target dari jarak jauh dengan damage yang besar.
dialogsComplete.it: Mental Strike is a very strong magic attack that consumes Magic Points (MP) in order to be cast. This skill allows you to attack the target from a distance for a high amount of damage.
dialogsComplete.jp: これは相手の属性にかかわらず、精神的なショックを与えて相手の心や思考を粉々に打ち砕くというスキルなのだ。簡単なように見えるが、使い方によっては非常に強力なスキルになる。
dialogsComplete.kr: 멘탈 스트라이크은 MP를 사용하는 아주 강력한 마법 공격입니다. 멀리 있는 적을 강하게 공격할 수 있는 기술이죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: Mental Strike is a very strong magic attack that consumes Magic Points (MP) in order to be cast. This skill allows you to attack the target from a distance for a high amount of damage.
dialogsComplete.pl: Mental Strike is a very strong magic attack that consumes Magic Points (MP) in order to be cast. This skill allows you to attack the target from a distance for a high amount of damage.
dialogsComplete.ru: Он называется "Пси-удар". Этот фокус требует маны. С его помощью можно атаковать врага на расстоянии - и поверь, противник надолго запомнит урок!
dialogsComplete.sp: Golpe Mental es un ataque mágico muy fuerte que consume Puntos Mágicos (MP) al lanzarla. Esta habilidad te permite atacar al objetivo manteniendo la distancia y con una gran cantidad de daño.
dialogsComplete.sw: Mental Strike is a very strong magic attack that consumes Magic Points (MP) in order to be cast. This skill allows you to attack the target from a distance for a high amount of damage.
dialogsComplete.th: Mental Strike เป็นการโจมตีด้วยเวทย์มนตร์ที่แข็งแกร่งมากซึ่งใช้ Magic Points (MP) เพื่อที่จะร่าย ทักษะนี้ทำให้คุณสามารถโจมตีเป้าหมายจากระยะไกลเพื่อสร้างความเสียหายได้สูง
dialogsComplete.tw: 這個不管對方的屬性，會讓對方絕得自己受了重傷，是一個很炫的技術呢~
dialogsComplete.vi: Mental Strike là một đòn tấn công ma thuật rất mạnh, tiêu tốn Magic Points (MP) để được thi triển. Kỹ năng này cho phép bạn tấn công mục tiêu từ xa với lượng sát thương cao.

dialogsFail.en: Excuse me? Who are you exactly? I'm waiting for someone else right now. Take a hike!
dialogsFail.ar: Excuse me? Who are you exactly? I'm waiting for someone else right now. Take a hike!
dialogsFail.br: Com licença? Quem é você exatamente? Estou esperando outra pessoa agora. Continue andando!
dialogsFail.cns: 打扰了你到底是谁啊？我现在在等别人。哪儿凉快哪儿呆着去！
dialogsFail.de: Wie bitte? Wer bist du eigentlich? Ich warte gerade auf jemand anderen. Verschwinde!
dialogsFail.fi: Excuse me? Who are you exactly? I'm waiting for someone else right now. Take a hike!
dialogsFail.fil: Excuse me? Who are you exactly? I'm waiting for someone else right now. Take a hike!
dialogsFail.fr: Que me veux-tu ? J'ai un bain à prendre, laisse-moi tranquille...
dialogsFail.id: Permisi? Siapa kamu sebenarnya? Aku sedang menunggu orang lain sekarang. Berjalanlah!
dialogsFail.it: Excuse me? Who are you exactly? I'm waiting for someone else right now. Take a hike!
dialogsFail.jp: 誰だおまえは？そんなところに突っ立って、オレの邪魔をしないでくれ。オレは今、スキル事典を探すのに必死なんだよ。どこに置いたのかな、さっぱり思い出せないじゃないか。困ったな。
dialogsFail.kr: 실례지만… 누구시죠? 지금은 다른 사람을 기다리고 있으니, 돌아가 주세요.
dialogsFail.nl: Excuse me? Who are you exactly? I'm waiting for someone else right now. Take a hike!
dialogsFail.pl: Excuse me? Who are you exactly? I'm waiting for someone else right now. Take a hike!
dialogsFail.ru: Excuse me? Who are you exactly? I'm waiting for someone else right now. Take a hike!
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Perdona? ¿Quién eres exactamente? Estoy esperando a alguien. ¡Fuera de aquí!
dialogsFail.sw: Excuse me? Who are you exactly? I'm waiting for someone else right now. Take a hike!
dialogsFail.th: ขอโทษนะ? คุณเป็นใครกันแน่? ฉันกำลังรอคนอื่นอยู่ ไปเดินป่าไป!
dialogsFail.tw: 打擾一下？你到底是誰？我現在在等別人，別來煩我！
dialogsFail.vi: Xin lỗi cho tôi hỏi? Chính xác bạn là ai? Tôi đang đợi một người khác ngay bây giờ. Hãy đi chỗ khác!

name.jp: 放浪者マスター(マーシナリー)

description.en: Slay 20 Small Aibatts and 20 Small Mushpangs just north of Eastern Flarine and return to Mercenary Drillmaster Mustang.
description.ar: Slay 20 Small Aibatts and 20 Small Mushpangs just north of Eastern Flarine and return to Mercenary Drillmaster Mustang.
description.br: Cace 20 Aibatts Pequenos e 20 Mushpangs Pequenos ao norte da Zona Leste de Flarine e volte para a Mercenária Militar Mustang.
description.cns: 击杀20只小独眼蝠和20只小嘭嘭菇！完成后返回战士教官玛斯滕处。
description.de: Jage 20 Small Aibatt und 20 Small Mushpang nördlich von Ost-Flaris und kehre zu [Mercenary Ausbilder] Mustang zurück.
description.fi: Slay 20 Small Aibatts and 20 Small Mushpangs just north of Eastern Flarine and return to Mercenary Drillmaster Mustang.
description.fil: Slay 20 Small Aibatts and 20 Small Mushpangs just north of Eastern Flarine and return to Mercenary Drillmaster Mustang.
description.fr: Tuer 20 Jeunes Aibatts et 20 Jeunes Mushpangs puis retourner voir Mustang à Flarine Est pour passer le premier test de la voie du Mercenaire.
description.id: Bunuh 20 Small Aibatts dan 20 Small Mushpangs di utara Flarine Timur dan kembali ke Mercenary Drillmaster Mustang.
description.it: Slay 20 Small Aibatts and 20 Small Mushpangs just north of Eastern Flarine and return to Mercenary Drillmaster Mustang.
description.jp: スモール・アイバットを10匹狩ってくること。
description.kr: 플라리네 동부의 북쪽에서 작은 아이바트 20마리와 작은 머쉬팡 20마리를 처치한 뒤, 머서너리 훈련 조교 머스탱에게 돌아가세요.
description.nl: Slay 20 Small Aibatts and 20 Small Mushpangs just north of Eastern Flarine and return to Mercenary Drillmaster Mustang.
description.pl: Slay 20 Small Aibatts and 20 Small Mushpangs just north of Eastern Flarine and return to Mercenary Drillmaster Mustang.
description.ru: Нужно убить 20 слабых сглазов и 20 слабых сыробежек к северу от восточной Фларинции и вернуться к вербовщику борцов Мустангу.
description.sp: Derrota a 20 Aibatts Pequeños y a 20 Mushpangs Pequeños al norte desde Flarine Este y vuelve con el Instructor Mercenary Mustang.
description.sw: Slay 20 Small Aibatts and 20 Small Mushpangs just north of Eastern Flarine and return to Mercenary Drillmaster Mustang.
description.th: สังหาร Small Aibatts 20 ตัวและ Small Mushpangs 20 ตัวทางเหนือของ Eastern Flarine และกลับไปที่ Mercenary Drillmaster Mustang
description.tw: 在布拉里斯東部以北殺死 20 隻眼蝙蝠嘍囉和 20 隻小型蘑菇龐，然後返回 [勇者訓練教官] 摸斯騰。
description.vi: Tiêu diệt 20 Small Aibatts nhỏ và 20 Small Mushpangs ngay phía bắc của Eastern Flarine và quay trở lại Mercenary Drillmaster Mustang.

dialogsBegin.en: What?! Hahaha! You think you have what it takes to be a Mercenary? Oh, that's good …hic! I think you'd be better off as a comedian!
dialogsBegin.ar: What?! Hahaha! You think you have what it takes to be a Mercenary? Oh, that's good …hic! I think you'd be better off as a comedian!
dialogsBegin.br: O que?! Hahaha! Você acha que tem o que é preciso para ser um Mercenário? Essa é boa... hic! Acho que você se sairia melhor como comediante!
dialogsBegin.cns: 什么？哈哈哈哈哈哈！你认为你有成为战士的能力？喔..那很好…咳咳！我觉得你更适合做一个喜剧演员！
dialogsBegin.de: Was?! Hahaha! Du denkst, du hast das Zeug zu einem Mercenary? Oh, das ist gut ...hic! Ich glaube, du wärst als Komiker besser dran!
dialogsBegin.fi: What?! Hahaha! You think you have what it takes to be a Mercenary? Oh, that's good …hic! I think you'd be better off as a comedian!
dialogsBegin.fil: What?! Hahaha! You think you have what it takes to be a Mercenary? Oh, that's good …hic! I think you'd be better off as a comedian!
dialogsBegin.fr: Haha, tu cherches donc à devenir Mercenaire ! Cependant tu dois mériter cette classe, et je vais donc te faire passer quelques tests.
dialogsBegin.id: Apa?! Ha ha ha! Kamu pikir apa saja yang diperlukan untuk menjadi Mercenary? Oh, itu bagus ... hic! Aku pikir kamu lebih baik menjadi komedian!
dialogsBegin.it: What?! Hahaha! You think you have what it takes to be a Mercenary? Oh, that's good …hic! I think you'd be better off as a comedian!
dialogsBegin.jp: ふむ、なんだか覇気のない若者がやってきたな。まぁ、この＜マスタング・ローバー＞のところへテストを受けるためにわざわざ来たのだから、そのまま帰らせるわけにもいくまい。では、よ～く聞け！諸君は最初に、放浪者としての熟練度を試される。
dialogsBegin.kr: 뭐라고요?! 하하하! 당신이 머서너리가 될 수 있으리라 생각해요? 아, 정말 웃기네요… 히끅! 차라리 코미디언이 되세요!
dialogsBegin.nl: What?! Hahaha! You think you have what it takes to be a Mercenary? Oh, that's good …hic! I think you'd be better off as a comedian!
dialogsBegin.pl: What?! Hahaha! You think you have what it takes to be a Mercenary? Oh, that's good …hic! I think you'd be better off as a comedian!
dialogsBegin.ru: What?! Hahaha! You think you have what it takes to be a Mercenary? Oh, that's good …hic! I think you'd be better off as a comedian!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡¿Qué?! ¡Jajaja! ¿Crees que tienes lo que se necesita para ser un Mercenary? Oh, eso es bueno... ¡hic! ¡Creo que lo harías mejor como comediante!
dialogsBegin.sw: What?! Hahaha! You think you have what it takes to be a Mercenary? Oh, that's good …hic! I think you'd be better off as a comedian!
dialogsBegin.th: อะไรนะ?! ฮ่าๆ! คุณคิดว่าคุณมีสิ่งที่เหมาะสมจะเป็น Mercenary? โอ้ดีๆๆ... เอิ้ก! ฉันคิดว่าคุณน่าจะเหมาะกับการเป็นตลกมากกว่านะ!
dialogsBegin.tw: 什麼？！哈哈哈！你認為你具備成為勇者的條件嗎？哦，那很好……呃！我覺得你最好當喜劇演員！
dialogsBegin.vi: Gì?! Hahaha! Bạn nghĩ bạn có những gì để trở thành một Mercenary? Ồ, tốt quá… hic! Tôi nghĩ bạn sẽ tốt hơn với tư cách là một diễn viên hài!

dialogsBegin.en: You're still here? Ugh… fine. I'll humor you just this once. If you think you are strong enough to be a Mercenary, then I'll need you to do a little something for me.
dialogsBegin.ar: You're still here? Ugh… fine. I'll humor you just this once. If you think you are strong enough to be a Mercenary, then I'll need you to do a little something for me.
dialogsBegin.br: Você ainda está aqui? Vou agradar você só desta vez. Se você acha que é forte o suficiente para ser um Mercenário, então eu preciso que você faça algo por mim.
dialogsBegin.cns: 你还在这？咳咳…好吧。我就开这一次玩笑。如果你认为你有能力成为一名战士，那么我需要你为我做点事情。
dialogsBegin.de: Du bist immer noch hier? Ugh... na gut. Ich werde dich nur dieses eine Mal bei Laune halten. Wenn du glaubst, das Zeug zum Mercenary zu haben, musst du eine kleine Aufgabe für mich erledigen.
dialogsBegin.fi: You're still here? Ugh… fine. I'll humor you just this once. If you think you are strong enough to be a Mercenary, then I'll need you to do a little something for me.
dialogsBegin.fil: You're still here? Ugh… fine. I'll humor you just this once. If you think you are strong enough to be a Mercenary, then I'll need you to do a little something for me.
dialogsBegin.fr: Pour commencer, j'aimerais évaluer ta puissance d'attaque, qui est un élément primordial pour tout Mercenaire.
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu masih di sini? Ugh… baiklah. Aku akan menghiburmu sekali ini saja. Jika kamu pikir kamu cukup kuat untuk menjadi Mercenary, aku ingin kamu melakukan sesuatu untukku.
dialogsBegin.it: You're still here? Ugh… fine. I'll humor you just this once. If you think you are strong enough to be a Mercenary, then I'll need you to do a little something for me.
dialogsBegin.jp: このテストは諸君が放浪者としてどのくらい熟練したかを評価するものだ。まずはこれから指示することをどれくらい早く正確に遂行できるかをテストする。わかったか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 아직도 여기 있어요? 휴… 좋아요, 딱 한 번만 봐 드리죠. 정말 머서너리가 될 수 있을 만큼 강하다고 생각한다면, 이 정도는 하실 수 있어야겠죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: You're still here? Ugh… fine. I'll humor you just this once. If you think you are strong enough to be a Mercenary, then I'll need you to do a little something for me.
dialogsBegin.pl: You're still here? Ugh… fine. I'll humor you just this once. If you think you are strong enough to be a Mercenary, then I'll need you to do a little something for me.
dialogsBegin.ru: You're still here? Ugh… fine. I'll humor you just this once. If you think you are strong enough to be a Mercenary, then I'll need you to do a little something for me.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Todavía estás aquí? Uf... bueno. Te seguiré la corriente solo por esta vez. Si crees que eres lo suficientemente fuerte para ser un Mercenary, necesitaré que hagas algo por mí.
dialogsBegin.sw: You're still here? Ugh… fine. I'll humor you just this once. If you think you are strong enough to be a Mercenary, then I'll need you to do a little something for me.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณยังอยู่ที่นี่อีกเรอะ? เอ่อ... ก็ได้ ฉันจะทดสอบคุณเพียงครั้งนี้ครั้งเดียว ถ้าคุณคิดว่าคุณเข้มแข็งพอที่จะเป็น Mercenary ฉันจะให้คุณทำอะไรให้ฉันหน่อย
dialogsBegin.tw: 你還在這裡？呃……好吧。我只會逗你一次。如果你認為你足夠強大，可以成為一名勇者，那麼我需要你為我做點什麼。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn vẫn ở đây? Ugh… ổn. Tôi sẽ hài hước với bạn chỉ một lần này. Nếu bạn nghĩ bạn đủ mạnh để trở thành Mercenary, thì tôi sẽ cần bạn làm một chút gì đó giúp tôi.

dialogsBegin.en: Small Aibatts have been infesting our crops just north of here. We need someone to go exterminate some of those filthy things.
dialogsBegin.ar: Small Aibatts have been infesting our crops just north of here. We need someone to go exterminate some of those filthy things.
dialogsBegin.br: Pequenos Aibatts têm infestado nossas plantações ao norte daqui. Precisamos de alguém para exterminar algumas dessas coisas imundas.
dialogsBegin.cns: 呵呵，我说的语言是上流人士才听得懂得语言啦。反正!从现在开始，你要去猎杀10只小独眼蝠回来!
dialogsBegin.de: Small Aibatts plagen unsere Ernte nördlich von hier. Wir brauchen jemanden, der diese ekelhaften Viecher vernichtet.
dialogsBegin.fi: Small Aibatts have been infesting our crops just north of here. We need someone to go exterminate some of those filthy things.
dialogsBegin.fil: Small Aibatts have been infesting our crops just north of here. We need someone to go exterminate some of those filthy things.
dialogsBegin.fr: Pour réussir ce test, tu dois tuer des Jeunes Aibatts, ça ne devrait pas te prendre très longtemps.
dialogsBegin.id: Small Aibatts telah menyerang tanaman kami di utara ini. Kami membutuhkan seseorang untuk pergi memusnahkan hal-hal menyebalkan itu.
dialogsBegin.it: Small Aibatts have been infesting our crops just north of here. We need someone to go exterminate some of those filthy things.
dialogsBegin.jp: 何だって？俺の喋り声がちょっと大きすぎるって？ワッハハハ、小さいよりはいいだろう！では、やることを指示するぞ。まずは、スモール・アイバットを狩ってこい！
dialogsBegin.kr: 이곳 북쪽에서 작은 아이바트 녀석들이 우리 농작물을 해치고 있어요. 저 더러운 녀석들을 퇴치할 사람이 필요한데...
dialogsBegin.nl: Small Aibatts have been infesting our crops just north of here. We need someone to go exterminate some of those filthy things.
dialogsBegin.pl: Small Aibatts have been infesting our crops just north of here. We need someone to go exterminate some of those filthy things.
dialogsBegin.ru: Чуть севернее города есть поле. На нем завелись слабые сглазы. Нужно их прогнать.
dialogsBegin.sp: Los Aibatts Pequeños han estado infestando nuestra cosechas al norte de aquí. Necesitamos a alguien que extermine algunos de esos bichos asquerosos.
dialogsBegin.sw: Small Aibatts have been infesting our crops just north of here. We need someone to go exterminate some of those filthy things.
dialogsBegin.th: Small Aibatts มาก่อกวนพืชของเราที่ทางตอนเหนือของที่นี่ เราต้องการคนที่จะกำจัดมอนเตอร์พวกนี้ออกไป
dialogsBegin.tw: 呵呵，我說的語言是上流人士才聽得懂的語言啦。反正！從現在開始，你要去獵殺 10 隻獨眼蝙蝠嘍囉回來！
dialogsBegin.vi: Aibatts nhỏ đã phá hoại mùa màng của chúng ta ngay phía bắc đây. Chúng ta cần ai đó tiêu diệt những thứ bẩn thỉu đó.

dialogsBegin.en: Slay 20 Small Aibatts and 20 Small Mushpangs then return me when you are finished. Understand? Now get out of here, vermin!
dialogsBegin.ar: Slay 20 Small Aibatts and 20 Small Mushpangs then return me when you are finished. Understand? Now get out of here, vermin!
dialogsBegin.br: Mate 20 Aibatts Pequenos e 20 Mushpangs Pequenos e retorne quando terminar. Entendeu? Agora cai fora daqui!
dialogsBegin.cns: 杀死20只小独眼蝠和20只小嘭嘭菇，然后当你完成后归还我，明白了吗？现在快离开这，小害虫!
dialogsBegin.de: Besiege 20 Small Aibatt und 20 Small Mushpang und komme dann zurück. Verstanden? Und jetzt verschwinde!
dialogsBegin.fi: Slay 20 Small Aibatts and 20 Small Mushpangs then return me when you are finished. Understand? Now get out of here, vermin!
dialogsBegin.fil: Slay 20 Small Aibatts and 20 Small Mushpangs then return me when you are finished. Understand? Now get out of here, vermin!
dialogsBegin.fr: Va tuer 20 Jeunes Aibatts et 20 Jeunes Mushpangs puis reviens me voir. Allez, montre moi ce que tu sais faire !
dialogsBegin.id: Bunuh 20 Small Aibatts dan 20 Small Mushpangs lalu kembalikan padaku saat kamu selesai. Mengerti? Sekarang pergi dari sini, kutu!
dialogsBegin.it: Slay 20 Small Aibatts and 20 Small Mushpangs then return me when you are finished. Understand? Now get out of here, vermin!
dialogsBegin.jp: いいか、＜スモール・アイバット＞20体、＜スモール・マッシュファング＞を20体狩ってこい！俺の言ったことがわかったか？頑張って狩ってくるんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 작은 아이바트 20마리와 작은 머쉬팡 20마리를 처치하고, 이쪽으로 다시 오시죠. 이해했겠지? 그럼 이제 썩 꺼져, 벌레!
dialogsBegin.nl: Slay 20 Small Aibatts and 20 Small Mushpangs then return me when you are finished. Understand? Now get out of here, vermin!
dialogsBegin.pl: Slay 20 Small Aibatts and 20 Small Mushpangs then return me when you are finished. Understand? Now get out of here, vermin!
dialogsBegin.ru: Убей 20 слабых сглазов, 20 слабых сыробежек и возвращайся. Задача ясна? Ну так выполняй!
dialogsBegin.sp: Derrota a 20 Aibatts Pequeños y a 20 Mushpangs Pequeños, vuelve cuando hayas terminado. ¿Comprendes? ¡Pues sal de aquí, alimaña!
dialogsBegin.sw: Slay 20 Small Aibatts and 20 Small Mushpangs then return me when you are finished. Understand? Now get out of here, vermin!
dialogsBegin.th: ฆ่า Small Aibatts 20 ตัว กับ Small Mushpangs 20 ตัว แล้วกลับมาหาฉันเมื่อคุณทำสำเร็จแล้ว เข้าใจนะ? ตอนนี้ก็ออกไปได้แล้ว!
dialogsBegin.tw: 獵殺 20 個獨眼蝙蝠嘍囉和 20 個新鮮的咚咚菇，然後在你完成後拿回給我。理解？現在就去吧！
dialogsBegin.vi: Giết 20 Aibatts nhỏ và 20 Mushpangs nhỏ sau đó quay trở lại tôi khi bạn kết thúc. Hiểu chứ? Bây giờ hãy ra khỏi đây, đồ sâu bọ!

dialogsAccept.en: Good luck, Vagrant. You'll need it! Hahaha!
dialogsAccept.ar: Good luck, Vagrant. You'll need it! Hahaha!
dialogsAccept.br: Boa sorte, Vagrant. Você vai precisar! Hahaha!
dialogsAccept.cns: 祝你一路顺风啦!哈哈哈!
dialogsAccept.de: Viel Glück, Vagrant. Du wirst es brauchen!
dialogsAccept.fi: Good luck, Vagrant. You'll need it! Hahaha!
dialogsAccept.fil: Good luck, Vagrant. You'll need it! Hahaha!
dialogsAccept.fr: Bonne chance...Tu en auras peut-être besoin.
dialogsAccept.id: Semoga berhasil, Vagrant. Kamu akan membutuhkan itu! Hahaha!
dialogsAccept.it: Good luck, Vagrant. You'll need it! Hahaha!
dialogsAccept.jp: では諸君、グッドラック！ワッハハハ！！
dialogsAccept.kr: 행운을 빌어요, 방랑자. 운이 필요할 거예요! 하하하!
dialogsAccept.nl: Good luck, Vagrant. You'll need it! Hahaha!
dialogsAccept.pl: Good luck, Vagrant. You'll need it! Hahaha!
dialogsAccept.ru: Удачи, бродяга. Она тебе понадобится. Ха-ха-ха!
dialogsAccept.sp: Buena suerte, Vagrant. ¡La necesitarás! ¡Jajaja!
dialogsAccept.sw: Good luck, Vagrant. You'll need it! Hahaha!
dialogsAccept.th: ขอให้โชคดี Vagrant คุณต้องใช้มัน! ฮ่าๆ!
dialogsAccept.tw: 祝你好運，見習生。你會需要它！哈哈哈！
dialogsAccept.vi: Chúc may mắn, Vagrant. Bạn sẽ cần đến nó! Hahaha!

dialogsDecline.en: I knew you were all talk, Vagrant. That's 30 seconds of my life I won't be getting back…
dialogsDecline.ar: I knew you were all talk, Vagrant. That's 30 seconds of my life I won't be getting back…
dialogsDecline.br: Sim, eu sabia que seria muito difícil para você. Você não é de nada!
dialogsDecline.cns: 也对啦，对你这种人来说应该是满难的啦!你以为我这个伟大的摸斯腾那么好欺负吗?
dialogsDecline.de: Da hast du den Mund wohl zu voll genommen, Vagrant. Das waren dreißig Sekunden meines Lebens, die ich nicht wieder zurückbekomme...
dialogsDecline.fi: I knew you were all talk, Vagrant. That's 30 seconds of my life I won't be getting back…
dialogsDecline.fil: I knew you were all talk, Vagrant. That's 30 seconds of my life I won't be getting back…
dialogsDecline.fr: Olala, je sentais que tu n'aurais pas le niveau, je me demande pourquoi je t'ai même autorisé à faire cela..
dialogsDecline.id: Aku tahu kamu bicara, Vagrant. Itu 30 detik dalam hidupku, aku tidak akan kembali…
dialogsDecline.it: I knew you were all talk, Vagrant. That's 30 seconds of my life I won't be getting back…
dialogsDecline.jp: そうそう、そうだろうと思ったぜ。このテストは根性のない奴が受けるほどへっぽこなテストではないぞ！このマスタングがそんなに甘いと思ったのか？
dialogsDecline.kr: 거봐요, 역시 말뿐이었네요. 제 인생의 30초를 낭비하셨군요…
dialogsDecline.nl: I knew you were all talk, Vagrant. That's 30 seconds of my life I won't be getting back…
dialogsDecline.pl: I knew you were all talk, Vagrant. That's 30 seconds of my life I won't be getting back…
dialogsDecline.ru: Я так и знал, бродяга, что твои слова - просто пшик. Только время зря на тебя потратил.
dialogsDecline.sp: Sabía que eras pura palabrería, Vagrant. Son 30 segundos de mi vida que no recuperaré...
dialogsDecline.sw: I knew you were all talk, Vagrant. That's 30 seconds of my life I won't be getting back…
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันรู้ว่าคุณได้คุยไปหมดแล้ว Vagrant นั่นคือ 30 วินาทีในชีวิตของฉัน ที่ฉันไม่เสียดาย ...
dialogsDecline.tw: 我就知道你只會說大話，見習生。我的人生有 30 秒再也拿不回來了…
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi biết bạn chỉ nói mà không làm, Vagrant. Đó là 30 giây của cuộc đời tôi mà tôi sẽ không lấy lại được…

dialogsComplete.en: Hmmm, that's acceptable. Not bad, Vagrant! Although, I could have done it in half the time. But that's neither here nor there.
dialogsComplete.ar: Hmmm, that's acceptable. Not bad, Vagrant! Although, I could have done it in half the time. But that's neither here nor there.
dialogsComplete.br: Bem... Em comparação comigo, você ainda é muito devagar. Eu demoraria 2 minutos para concluir o teste. Mas, de qualquer maneira, você passou.
dialogsComplete.cns: 哈哈哈，这种小事情如果叫我这个伟大的摸斯腾来做的话，不到2分钟就完成了。好啦!反正你已经通过测试了。
dialogsComplete.de: Hmm, das war ganz passabel, Vagrant! Allerdings hätte ich es locker in der Hälfte der Zeit geschafft. Aber egal, du hast dennoch bestanden.
dialogsComplete.fi: Hmmm, that's acceptable. Not bad, Vagrant! Although, I could have done it in half the time. But that's neither here nor there.
dialogsComplete.fil: Hmmm, that's acceptable. Not bad, Vagrant! Although, I could have done it in half the time. But that's neither here nor there.
dialogsComplete.fr: Bon. Comparé à moi tu es vraiment lent. Ça m'aurait pris 2 minutes, mais bon tu as réussi l'épreuve.
dialogsComplete.id: Hmm, bisa diterima. Tidak buruk, Vagrant! Meskipun, aku bisa melakukannya di separuh waktu. Tapi itu tidak di sini ataupun di sana.
dialogsComplete.it: Hmmm, that's acceptable. Not bad, Vagrant! Although, I could have done it in half the time. But that's neither here nor there.
dialogsComplete.jp: よし、戻ってきたな。まあ、 オレ様がやったら2分で終わる程度のテストさ。ちょいと遅すぎだな、諸君！最初のテストは無事にパスだ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 흠, 뭐… 그 정도면 괜찮군요. 나쁘지 않아요, 방랑자. 물론, 제가 했다면 그 절반 만에 끝냈겠지만요. 뭐, 그건 그렇다 치고요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Hmmm, that's acceptable. Not bad, Vagrant! Although, I could have done it in half the time. But that's neither here nor there.
dialogsComplete.pl: Hmmm, that's acceptable. Not bad, Vagrant! Although, I could have done it in half the time. But that's neither here nor there.
dialogsComplete.ru: Гм-м-м, а знаешь, неплохо. Неплохо, бродяга! Я бы, конечно, справился вдвое быстрее. Но кто будет считать?
dialogsComplete.sp: Hmmm, es aceptable. ¡No está mal, Vagrant! Aunque, yo podría haberlo hecho en la mitad de tiempo. Pero bueno eso no viene a cuento.
dialogsComplete.sw: Hmmm, that's acceptable. Not bad, Vagrant! Although, I could have done it in half the time. But that's neither here nor there.
dialogsComplete.th: หืมมมม ก็พอใช้ได้ ไม่เลว Vagrant! แม้ว่าฉันจะทำได้เร็วกว่าคุณครึ่งนึง แต่มันไม่ใช่ที่นี่หรือที่นั่น
dialogsComplete.tw: 哈哈哈，這種小事情如果叫我這個偉大的摸斯騰來做的話，不到 2 分鐘就完成了。好啦！反正你已經通過測試了。
dialogsComplete.vi: Hmmm, có thể chấp nhận được. Không tệ, Vagrant! Mặc dù, tôi đã có thể làm trong một nửa thời gian. Nhưng điều đó không quan trọng.

dialogsComplete.en: Hahaha! As if you could ever hope to compare yourself to me… Mustang the Great!
dialogsComplete.ar: Hahaha! As if you could ever hope to compare yourself to me… Mustang the Great!
dialogsComplete.br: Mesmo assim, você não é nada em comparação a mim, Mustang, a Grande! Ha ha ha!
dialogsComplete.cns: 但是，不要这么快就高兴了。不要以为伟大的玛斯滕会这样轻松的放过你啊!
dialogsComplete.de: Hahaha! Dachtest du wirklich du könntest dich mit mir, dem großen Mustang, messen?
dialogsComplete.fi: Hahaha! As if you could ever hope to compare yourself to me… Mustang the Great!
dialogsComplete.fil: Hahaha! As if you could ever hope to compare yourself to me… Mustang the Great!
dialogsComplete.fr: Bon il est clair que toi et moi, on ne joue pas dans la même catégorie.
dialogsComplete.id: Ha ha ha! Seolah-olah kamu bisa berharap untuk membandingkan dirimu denganku… Mustang the Great!
dialogsComplete.it: Hahaha! As if you could ever hope to compare yourself to me… Mustang the Great!
dialogsComplete.jp: でも、喜ぶにはまだまだ早い！
dialogsComplete.kr: 하하하! 설마 당신이 위대한 머스탱의 상대가 되리라 생각하진 않겠죠!
dialogsComplete.nl: Hahaha! As if you could ever hope to compare yourself to me… Mustang the Great!
dialogsComplete.pl: Hahaha! As if you could ever hope to compare yourself to me… Mustang the Great!
dialogsComplete.ru: Ха! Будто у тебя был хоть мизерный шанс сравниться со мной... Мустангом Могучим!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Jajaja! ¡ Como si te pudieras comparar a mí… el Gran Mustang!
dialogsComplete.sw: Hahaha! As if you could ever hope to compare yourself to me… Mustang the Great!
dialogsComplete.th: ฮ่าๆ! ราวกับว่าคุณเคยหวังที่จะเปรียบเทียบตัวเองกับฉัน... Mustang ดี!
dialogsComplete.tw: 但是，不要這麼快就高興了。不要以為偉大的摸斯騰會這樣輕鬆的放過你啊！
dialogsComplete.vi: Hahaha! Như thể bạn hy vọng được so sánh mình với tôi… Mustang the Great!

dialogsFail.en: What's the matter? You're not afraid of some Small Aibatts, are you?
dialogsFail.ar: What's the matter? You're not afraid of some Small Aibatts, are you?
dialogsFail.br: Qual é o problema? Você não está com medo de alguns Pequenos Aibatts, está?
dialogsFail.cns: 咋了？你不害怕小独眼蝠的对吧？
dialogsFail.de: Was ist? Du fürchtest dich doch nicht vor ein paar Small Aibatt, oder?
dialogsFail.fi: What's the matter? You're not afraid of some Small Aibatts, are you?
dialogsFail.fil: What's the matter? You're not afraid of some Small Aibatts, are you?
dialogsFail.fr: Pas si facile, hein ?
dialogsFail.id: Apa masalahnya? Kamu tidak takut pada beberapa Small Aibatts, bukan?
dialogsFail.it: What's the matter? You're not afraid of some Small Aibatts, are you?
dialogsFail.jp: オレの目は厳しいぞ、ごまかしはきかん！マーシナリーのテストはそんなに甘くないぞと、最初に忠告しただろう？ワッハハハハ！
dialogsFail.kr: 왜 그러죠? 설마 저 작은 아이바트가 무서운 건 아니겠죠?
dialogsFail.nl: What's the matter? You're not afraid of some Small Aibatts, are you?
dialogsFail.pl: What's the matter? You're not afraid of some Small Aibatts, are you?
dialogsFail.ru: What's the matter? You're not afraid of some Small Aibatts, are you?
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Qué pasa? No tienes miedo de unos Aibatts Pequeños, ¿verdad?
dialogsFail.sw: What's the matter? You're not afraid of some Small Aibatts, are you?
dialogsFail.th: เกิดอะไรขึ้น? คุณไม่ได้กลัว Small Aibatts ใช่มั้ย?
dialogsFail.tw: 怎麼了？你不怕這些獨眼蝙蝠嘍囉，是嗎？
dialogsFail.vi: Có chuyện gì vậy? Bạn không sợ Small Aibatts, phải không?

dialogsFail.en: Alright, listen carefully. Just north of here, there are several Small Aibatts. Slay 20 of them with 20 Small Mushpangs and return to me. Got it?
dialogsFail.ar: Alright, listen carefully. Just north of here, there are several Small Aibatts. Slay 20 of them with 20 Small Mushpangs and return to me. Got it?
dialogsFail.br: Certo, ouça com atenção. Ao norte daqui, existem vários Aibatts Pequenos. Mate 20 deles e 20 Mushpangs Pequenos e volte aqui quando terminar. Entendeu?
dialogsFail.cns: 好吧，仔细听，就在这北边，击杀20只小独眼蝠和20只小嘭嘭菇。快去！
dialogsFail.de: Okay, hör gut zu. Nördlich von hier gibt es eine ganze Herde von Small Aibatts. Jage 20 von ihnen und dazu noch 20 Small Mushpang. Verstanden?
dialogsFail.fi: Alright, listen carefully. Just north of here, there are several Small Aibatts. Slay 20 of them with 20 Small Mushpangs and return to me. Got it?
dialogsFail.fil: Alright, listen carefully. Just north of here, there are several Small Aibatts. Slay 20 of them with 20 Small Mushpangs and return to me. Got it?
dialogsFail.fr: Écoute-moi attentivement, ok ? Dégomme moi 20 Jeunes Aibatts et 20 Jeunes Mushpangs, ça devrait te prendre 2 minutes !
dialogsFail.id: Baiklah, dengarkan baik-baik. Di utara sini, ada beberapa Small Aibatts. Bunuh 20 dari mereka dengan 20 Small Mushpangs dan kembalikan padaku. Mengerti?
dialogsFail.it: Alright, listen carefully. Just north of here, there are several Small Aibatts. Slay 20 of them with 20 Small Mushpangs and return to me. Got it?
dialogsFail.jp: もう一度教えるから、よ～く聞くんだ！スモール・アイバットが20匹と、スモール・マッシュファング20体だ。わかったか？もたもたしている時間はないはずだ。さぁ、行ってこい！
dialogsFail.kr: 좋아요, 잘 들으세요. 이곳 북쪽에 작은 아이바트들이 좀 있어요. 작은 머쉬팡과 작은 머쉬팡을 20마리씩 처치한 뒤 돌아오세요. 알겠죠?
dialogsFail.nl: Alright, listen carefully. Just north of here, there are several Small Aibatts. Slay 20 of them with 20 Small Mushpangs and return to me. Got it?
dialogsFail.pl: Alright, listen carefully. Just north of here, there are several Small Aibatts. Slay 20 of them with 20 Small Mushpangs and return to me. Got it?
dialogsFail.ru: Ладно, слушай. Пройдешь немного на север - увидишь поле, а на нем слабых сглазов и слабых сыробежек. Убей пару десятков тех и других и возвращайся. Все понятно?
dialogsFail.sp: Muy bien, escucha atentamente. Justo al norte de aquí, hay varios Aibatts Pequeños. Derrota a 20 de ellos y a 20 Mushpangs Pequeños, cuando acabes vuelve a verme. ¿Entendido?
dialogsFail.sw: Alright, listen carefully. Just north of here, there are several Small Aibatts. Slay 20 of them with 20 Small Mushpangs and return to me. Got it?
dialogsFail.th: เอาล่ะ ฟังให้ดี ทางเหนือของที่นี่มี Small Aibatts อยู่เยอะ ฆ่าพวกมัน 20 ตัว กับ Small Mushpangs 20 ตัว แล้วกลับมาหาฉัน เข้าใจไหม?
dialogsFail.tw: 好，仔細聽。這裡北邊有幾隻小型獨眼蝙蝠。去擊殺 20 隻小型獨眼蝙蝠和 20 隻小型咚咚菇後回來找我，聽懂了嗎？
dialogsFail.vi: Được rồi, hãy nghe cẩn thận. Ngay phía bắc đây, có một số Small Aibatts. Giết 20 Small Aibatts cùng với 20 Small Mushpangs và quay trở lại tôi. Hiểu rồi chứ?

dialogsFail.en: <Mustang mumbles something under his breath about you being… not so bright.>
dialogsFail.ar: <Mustang mumbles something under his breath about you being… not so bright.>
dialogsFail.br: Você é um bobo...
dialogsFail.cns: 怎么这么没有头脑啊…哎.
dialogsFail.de: *Mustang murmelt irgendwas... Es klingt nicht sehr freundlich*
dialogsFail.fi: <Mustang mumbles something under his breath about you being… not so bright.>
dialogsFail.fil: <Mustang mumbles something under his breath about you being… not so bright.>
dialogsFail.fr: (te montrant du doigt) Toi. t'as encore tapé dans la bouteille...
dialogsFail.id: <Mustang menggumamkan sesuatu dengan pelan tentang dirimu... tidak begitu jelas.>
dialogsFail.it: <Mustang mumbles something under his breath about you being… not so bright.>
dialogsFail.jp: こんなに根性がないとは情けないな。まあ、人には向き・不向きがあるからな！仕方あるまい。
dialogsFail.kr: <*머스탱이 작게 중얼거립니다... 별로 똑똑하진 않네.*>
dialogsFail.nl: <Mustang mumbles something under his breath about you being… not so bright.>
dialogsFail.pl: <Mustang mumbles something under his breath about you being… not so bright.>
dialogsFail.ru: <Мустанг бормочет что-то себе под нос. Что-то о вашем... недалеком уме.>
dialogsFail.sp: <Mustang murmura algo en voz baja sobre ti… no eres muy inteligente>
dialogsFail.sw: <Mustang mumbles something under his breath about you being… not so bright.>
dialogsFail.th: <มัสแตงพึมพำอะไรบางอย่างที่อยู่ภายใต้ลมหายใจของเขาเกี่ยวกับตัวคุณ... ที่ไม่สู้ดีนัก
dialogsFail.tw: <穆斯唐低聲嘟囔著說你…不太聰明。>
dialogsFail.vi: <Mustang lầm bầm điều gì đó trong hơi thở về việc bạn ... không được tươi sáng cho lắm.>

description.en: Almani asked for Fafnirs to be exterminated, before they grow into Dragons! Please could you kill 15 of them?
description.ar: Almani asked for Fafnirs to be exterminated, before they grow into Dragons! Please could you kill 15 of them?
description.br: Almani pediu que os Fafnirs fossem exterminados, antes que se tornem poderosos Dragões! Por favor, você poderia matar 15 deles?
description.cns: 亚尔玛尼要求在龙宝宝成长为恶龙之前将其消灭!请你杀15只龙宝宝好吗？
description.de: Almani hat darum gebeten, die Fafnirs auszurotten, bevor sie zu Drachen werden! Kannst du bitte 15 von ihnen töten?
description.fi: Almani asked for Fafnirs to be exterminated, before they grow into Dragons! Please could you kill 15 of them?
description.fil: Hiniling ni Almani na lipulin ang mga Fafnir bago pa sila maging dragon! Puwede mo bang patayin ang 15 sa kanila?
description.fr: Almani a besoin d'aide pour exterminer des Fafnirs avant qu'ils ne deviennent des dragons ! Peux-tu en tuer 15 ?
description.id: Almani meminta agar Fafnir dimusnahkan sebelum mereka tumbuh besar menjadi Dragon. Bisakah kamu habisi 15 dari mereka?
description.it: Almani asked for Fafnirs to be exterminated, before they grow into Dragons! Please could you kill 15 of them?
description.jp: アルマニからの依頼で、ドラゴンになる前に＜ファフニール＞を退治してくれ...とのことでした。私からもお願いです。15匹討伐していただけないでしょうか？
description.kr: 알마니가 파프니르를 없애 달라고 부탁했어요. 그대로 두면 전부 드래곤이 될 것 같다고요! 파프니르 15마리만 잡아주실 수 있나요?
description.nl: Almani asked for Fafnirs to be exterminated, before they grow into Dragons! Please could you kill 15 of them?
description.pl: Almani asked for Fafnirs to be exterminated, before they grow into Dragons! Please could you kill 15 of them?
description.ru: Almani asked for Fafnirs to be exterminated, before they grow into Dragons! Please could you kill 15 of them?
description.sp: ¡Almani ha pedido que se extermine a los Fafnirs, antes de que se conviertan en Dragones! Por favor, ¿podrías deshacerte de 15 de ellos?
description.sw: Almani asked for Fafnirs to be exterminated, before they grow into Dragons! Please could you kill 15 of them?
description.th: Almani ขอให้ Fafnirs ถูกกำจัด ก่อนที่พวกมันจะเติบโตเป็น Dragons! คุณช่วยฆ่าพวกมัน 15 ตัวได้ไหม
description.tw: 阿爾瑪尼要求在法夫尼爾成長為龍之前先將牠們消滅！你能幫忙擊殺 15 隻嗎？
description.vi: Almani yêu cầu tiêu diệt Fafnirs, trước khi chúng phát triển thành Rồng! Làm ơn, bạn có thể giết 15 trong số chúng không?

dialogsDecline.en: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.

dialogsDecline.jp: 手伝わないんですね。大丈夫ですよ、他の人を探します。
dialogsDecline.kr: 도와주기 싫으신가요? 어쩔 수 없죠. 다른 사람을 찾아볼게요.

dialogsDecline.ru: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿No quieres ayudar? De acuerdo. Encontraremos a otra persona.
dialogsDecline.sw: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsDecline.th: คุณไม่อยากช่วยเหรอ? ไม่เป็นไร เราจะหาคนอื่น
dialogsDecline.tw: 你不想幫忙？沒關係。我們會找到其他人的。
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn không muốn giúp đỡ? Không sao đâu. Chúng tôi sẽ tìm người khác.

dialogsBegin.en: Darkon natives need you to collect Tangkask. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.ar: Darkon natives need you to collect Tangkask. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.br: Os nativos de Darkon precisam que você colete Tangkask. Você poderia ajudar?
dialogsBegin.cns: 原住民为了逃离哇当卡，委托了搜集“哇当卡面具”，您要接受委托吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Darkons Eingeborene bitten uns Tangkask zu sammeln. damit sie vor den gefährlichen Watangka fliehen können. Willst du den Auftrag annehmen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Darkon natives need you to collect Tangkask. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.fil: Kailangan ng mga native ng Darkon na kolektahin mo ang Tangkask. Tutulungan mo ba?
dialogsBegin.fr:
Les résidents de Darkon nous ont invité à trouver des Masques tangk pour échapper aux dangereux Watangkas.
Acceptes-tu cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Darkon Natives membutuhkanmu untuk mengumpulkan Tangkask. Bisakah kamu bantu?
dialogsBegin.it: Darkon natives need you to collect Tangkask. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.jp: ダーコンに住む人々が、モンスターの危険から身を守るため、タンマスクをかぶって外出するのが流行っているそうです。そこでタンマスク55個の収集を依頼されました。依頼を受けますか？
