dialogsBegin.cns: 只要把矿石给我，我向你保证，我将与瑞尔南和其他人团聚。但是我需要一点时间先来检查矿石。
dialogsBegin.de: Gib mir einfach das Erz und du hast mein Wort, dass ich mich wieder mit Reonan und dem Rest der Bande treffen werde. Zuerst brauche ich ein wenig Zeit, um das Erz zu untersuchen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Just give me the ore and you have my word that I will reunite with Reonan and the rest of the gang. First I need a little time to examine the ore.
dialogsBegin.fil: Just give me the ore and you have my word that I will reunite with Reonan and the rest of the gang. First I need a little time to examine the ore.
dialogsBegin.fr: Bon, donnez-moi le minerai d'agonie. Je vais me joindre à la cause de Reonan.
dialogsBegin.id: Beri aku ore nya dan kamu bisa pegang janjiku bahwa aku akan bersatu kembali dengan Reonan dan anggota geng lainnya. Pertama saya perlu sedikit waktu untuk memeriksa ore.
dialogsBegin.it: Just give me the ore and you have my word that I will reunite with Reonan and the rest of the gang. First I need a little time to examine the ore.
dialogsBegin.jp: こんな貴重なものを貰ったからには相応の御礼をしないとね……。そうそう。既にお気づきかもしれないけど私はサイキーパーだったの。
dialogsBegin.kr: 광석만 넘겨 준다면, 레오난과 다른 멤버들과 꼭 다시 만나겠다고 약속드릴게요. 지금은 이 광석을 분석할 시간이 필요해요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Just give me the ore and you have my word that I will reunite with Reonan and the rest of the gang. First I need a little time to examine the ore.
dialogsBegin.pl: Just give me the ore and you have my word that I will reunite with Reonan and the rest of the gang. First I need a little time to examine the ore.
dialogsBegin.ru: Just give me the ore and you have my word that I will reunite with Reonan and the rest of the gang. First I need a little time to examine the ore.
dialogsBegin.sp: Dame el mineral y tienes mi palabra de que me reuniré con Reonan y el resto de la pandilla. Primero necesito un poco de tiempo para examinar el mineral.
dialogsBegin.sw: Just give me the ore and you have my word that I will reunite with Reonan and the rest of the gang. First I need a little time to examine the ore.
dialogsBegin.th: เพียงแค่ให้แร่ฉันและคุณมีคำพูดของฉันที่ฉันจะรวมตัวกับ Reonan และคนที่เหลือของแก๊ง ฉันต้องใช้เวลาเล็กน้อยในการตรวจสอบแร่ก่อน
dialogsBegin.tw: 很好！這麼珍貴的礦石你都能夠拿回來，按照約定我也跟隨雷奧南的意思吧。這是看在為了我的研究而努力的你的面子。
dialogsBegin.vi: Chỉ cần đưa cho tôi quặng và bạn nhận lời hứa từ tôi rằng tôi sẽ đoàn tụ với Reonan và những người còn lại trong băng. Đầu tiên tôi cần một ít thời gian để kiểm tra quặng.

dialogsBegin.en: I can't leave this very moment, but here, take my pendant to Reonan. It will seal the deal! I will meet up with you again soon enough! Hehe.
dialogsBegin.ar: I can't leave this very moment, but here, take my pendant to Reonan. It will seal the deal! I will meet up with you again soon enough! Hehe.
dialogsBegin.br: Não posso sair neste exato momento, mas aqui, leve meu Pingente para Reonan. Vai resolver o negócio! Eu vou me encontrar com você novamente em breve! Hehe.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我现在不能离开，但在这里，把我的吊坠拿给瑞尔南。我们就算完成了交易，我会很快和你再见面的! 嘻嘻。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich kann im Moment nicht weg, aber hier, bring meinen Anhänger zu Reonan. Er wird das Geschäft besiegeln! Wir werden uns schon bald wiedersehen! Hehe.
dialogsBegin.fi: I can't leave this very moment, but here, take my pendant to Reonan. It will seal the deal! I will meet up with you again soon enough! Hehe.
dialogsBegin.fil: I can't leave this very moment, but here, take my pendant to Reonan. It will seal the deal! I will meet up with you again soon enough! Hehe.
dialogsBegin.fr: Dites voir, est-il aussi mignon dans cette incarnation qu'il l'était dans la précédente ?
dialogsBegin.id: Saya tidak bisa meninggalkan momen ini, tetapi ambil ini, bawa pendant saya ke Reonan. Ini akan menyegel kesepakatan! Aku akan segera bertemu denganmu lagi! Hehe.
dialogsBegin.it: I can't leave this very moment, but here, take my pendant to Reonan. It will seal the deal! I will meet up with you again soon enough! Hehe.
dialogsBegin.jp: この苦悩の鉱石を研究すれば、この世界を漂う何かがわかるかもしれない。もう少し研究を続けたいところだけど……ペンダントをレオナンに持って行ってくれ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 당장은 자리를 뜰 수 없지만, 이 펜던트를 레오난에게 전해 주세요. 이걸로 약속이 성립되는 거예요! 곧 저도 합류한다고 약속할게요! 헤헤.
dialogsBegin.nl: I can't leave this very moment, but here, take my pendant to Reonan. It will seal the deal! I will meet up with you again soon enough! Hehe.
dialogsBegin.pl: I can't leave this very moment, but here, take my pendant to Reonan. It will seal the deal! I will meet up with you again soon enough! Hehe.
dialogsBegin.ru: I can't leave this very moment, but here, take my pendant to Reonan. It will seal the deal! I will meet up with you again soon enough! Hehe.
dialogsBegin.sp: No puedo ir en este momento, pero toma, llévale mi colgante a Reonan. ¡Sellará el trato! ¡Me reuniré contigo pronto! Jeje.
dialogsBegin.sw: I can't leave this very moment, but here, take my pendant to Reonan. It will seal the deal! I will meet up with you again soon enough! Hehe.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันไม่สามารถออกจากช่วงเวลานี้ แต่ที่นี่นำจี้ของฉันไป Reonan ไปประทับตรา! ฉันจะพบกับคุณอีกครั้งในเร็วๆนี้ ! ฮิฮิ.
dialogsBegin.tw: 但是，現在還不是時候。因為我還在進行非常重要的研究。所以，你可以把這個墜飾轉交給雷奧南嗎？只要研究一完成，我就會過去。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi không thể rời khỏi khoảnh khắc này, nhưng tại nơi đây, hãy đưa mặt dây chuyền của tôi đến Reonan. Nó sẽ là cam kết giao dịch! Tôi sẽ gặp lại bạn trong thời gian sớm nhất! Hehe.

dialogsAccept.en: Please tell Reonan I am busy with important research but will come directly to him afterwards!
dialogsAccept.ar: Please tell Reonan I am busy with important research but will come directly to him afterwards!
dialogsAccept.br: Por favor, diga a Reonan que estou ocupada com uma pesquisa importante, mas irei diretamente a ele depois!
dialogsAccept.cns: 请告诉瑞尔南，我正忙于重要的研究，但之后会直接来找他。
dialogsAccept.de: Bitte sagen Sie Reonan, dass ich mit wichtigen Recherchen beschäftigt bin, aber danach direkt zu ihm kommen werde!
dialogsAccept.fi: Please tell Reonan I am busy with important research but will come directly to him afterwards!
dialogsAccept.fil: Please tell Reonan I am busy with important research but will come directly to him afterwards!
dialogsAccept.fr: Tenez, apportez ce pendentif à Reonan en signe de ma confiance.
dialogsAccept.id: Tolong beri tahu Reonan bahwa saya sibuk dengan penelitian penting tetapi akan datang langsung kepadanya setelah itu!
dialogsAccept.it: Please tell Reonan I am busy with important research but will come directly to him afterwards!
dialogsAccept.jp: そう、このペンダントをレオナンに渡して。わたくしはもう少しここで研究してから戻るから心配しないでね！
dialogsAccept.kr: 지금은 중요한 연구 때문에 바쁘지만, 끝나는 대로 찾아가겠다고 레오난에게 전해 주세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Please tell Reonan I am busy with important research but will come directly to him afterwards!
dialogsAccept.pl: Please tell Reonan I am busy with important research but will come directly to him afterwards!
dialogsAccept.ru: Please tell Reonan I am busy with important research but will come directly to him afterwards!
dialogsAccept.sp: Por favor, dile a Reonan que estoy ocupada con una investigación importante, ¡pero que acudiré a él más tarde!
dialogsAccept.sw: Please tell Reonan I am busy with important research but will come directly to him afterwards!
dialogsAccept.th: กรุณาบอก Reonan ฉันยุ่งมากเกี่ยวกับการวิจัยที่สำคัญ แต่ฉันจะไปหาเขาโดยตรงหลังจากนั้น!
dialogsAccept.tw: 現在因為重要的研究，非常的忙碌。所以請你不要忘記告訴雷奧南，不久我就會過去。
dialogsAccept.vi: Hãy nói với Reonan rằng tôi đang bận với nghiên cứu quan trọng nhưng sẽ đến gặp trực tiếp anh ấy sau!

dialogsDecline.en: Eh? You don't want to leave here because of my radiant beauty? Guess I don't blame you!
dialogsDecline.ar: Eh? You don't want to leave here because of my radiant beauty? Guess I don't blame you!
dialogsDecline.br: Eh? Você não quer sair daqui por causa da minha beleza radiante? Acho que não te culpo! <3
dialogsDecline.cns: 嗯？你不想离开这里，因为我光芒四射的美貌？那我当然不会怪你了!
dialogsDecline.de: Eh? Ihr wollt wegen meiner strahlenden Schönheit nicht von hier weg? Ich schätze, ich kann es Euch nicht verdenken!
dialogsDecline.fi: Eh? You don't want to leave here because of my radiant beauty? Guess I don't blame you!
dialogsDecline.fil: Eh? You don't want to leave here because of my radiant beauty? Guess I don't blame you!
dialogsDecline.fr: Je parie que vous voulez rester ici à m'admirer pour le reste de vos jours !
dialogsDecline.id: Eh? Anda tidak ingin pergi dari sini karena kecantikan saya yang bercahaya? Kurasa aku tidak akan menyalahkanmu!
dialogsDecline.it: Eh? You don't want to leave here because of my radiant beauty? Guess I don't blame you!
dialogsDecline.jp: あら……ひょっとしてわたくしの美しさを前に離れがたくなったのかしら？
dialogsDecline.kr: 어머? 제 눈부신 미모 때문에 여기서 떠나기 싫다는 건가요? 으음, 이해는 가지만!
dialogsDecline.nl: Eh? You don't want to leave here because of my radiant beauty? Guess I don't blame you!
dialogsDecline.pl: Eh? You don't want to leave here because of my radiant beauty? Guess I don't blame you!
dialogsDecline.ru: Eh? You don't want to leave here because of my radiant beauty? Guess I don't blame you!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Eh? ¿No quieres irte de aquí por mi radiante belleza? ¡Supongo que no te puedo culpar!
dialogsDecline.sw: Eh? You don't want to leave here because of my radiant beauty? Guess I don't blame you!
dialogsDecline.th: โอ้ ~! คุณกลับมาหรือเปล่า
dialogsDecline.tw: 天哪，你是迷上我的美貌，不想離開了嗎？哼，男人們都是一樣的。
dialogsDecline.vi: Hở? Bạn không muốn rời khỏi đây vì vẻ đẹp rạng rỡ của tôi chăng? Đoán trúng rồi chứ nhỉ, tôi không trách bạn đâu!

dialogsComplete.en: You're back! How is Ainher doing? What? This is another of the pendants!
dialogsComplete.ar: You're back! How is Ainher doing? What? This is another of the pendants!
dialogsComplete.br: Você voltou! Como está Ainher? O que?? Este é mais um dos pingentes!
dialogsComplete.cns: You're back! How is Ainher doing? What? This is another of the pendants!
dialogsComplete.de: Du bist wieder da! Wie geht's Ainher? Was ist das? Das ist noch einer der Anhänger!
dialogsComplete.fi: You're back! How is Ainher doing? What? This is another of the pendants!
dialogsComplete.fil: You're back! How is Ainher doing? What? This is another of the pendants!
dialogsComplete.fr: Vous avez trouvé un nouveau Héros ? Mais vous êtes incroyable !
dialogsComplete.id: Kamu kembali! Bagaimana kabar Ainher? Apa?? Ini adalah pendants lainnya!
dialogsComplete.it: You're back! How is Ainher doing? What? This is another of the pendants!
dialogsComplete.jp: おお、お前さん。戻ってきたか。その顔をみるときっとよい報告だな。
dialogsComplete.kr: 돌아오셨군요! 아인헤르는 어떻게 지내던가요? 네? 이건 또 다른 펜던트예요!
dialogsComplete.nl: You're back! How is Ainher doing? What? This is another of the pendants!
dialogsComplete.pl: You're back! How is Ainher doing? What? This is another of the pendants!
dialogsComplete.ru: You're back! How is Ainher doing? What? This is another of the pendants!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Estás de vuelta! ¿Cómo está Ainher? ¿¿Qué?? ¡Este es otro de los colgantes!
dialogsComplete.sw: You're back! How is Ainher doing? What? This is another of the pendants!
dialogsComplete.th: คุณกลับมาแล้ว! Ainher เป็นยังไงบ้าง? อะไรนะ?? นี้เป็นจี้อีกชิ้นหนึ่ง!
dialogsComplete.tw: 你回來了！艾因赫那邊怎麼樣？什麼？這又是一枚墜飾！
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn quay trở lại rồi! Ainher vẫn ổn chứ? Gì đây?? Lại là một mặt dây chuyền khác sao!

dialogsFail.en: Well what are you waiting for! Take the pendant to Reonan!
dialogsFail.ar: Well what are you waiting for! Take the pendant to Reonan!
dialogsFail.br: Bem, é melhor não perder tempo! Leve o pingente para Reonan!
dialogsFail.cns: 那你还等什么！？带着吊坠去找瑞尔南!
dialogsFail.de: Worauf wartest du noch? Bring den Anhänger zu Reonan!
dialogsFail.fi: Well what are you waiting for! Take the pendant to Reonan!
dialogsFail.fil: Well what are you waiting for! Take the pendant to Reonan!
dialogsFail.fr: Apportez mon pendentif à Reonan.
dialogsFail.id: Nah tunggu apalagi! Bawa pendant itu ke Reonan!
dialogsFail.it: Well what are you waiting for! Take the pendant to Reonan!
dialogsFail.jp: あら……ひょっとしてわたくしの美しさを前に離れがたくなったのかしら？
dialogsFail.kr: 뭘 망설이고 있어요! 이 펜던트를 레오난에게 전해 주세요!
dialogsFail.nl: Well what are you waiting for! Take the pendant to Reonan!
dialogsFail.pl: Well what are you waiting for! Take the pendant to Reonan!
dialogsFail.ru: Well what are you waiting for! Take the pendant to Reonan!
dialogsFail.sp: ¡Bueno, a qué estás esperando! ¡Llévale el colgante a Reonan!
dialogsFail.sw: Well what are you waiting for! Take the pendant to Reonan!
dialogsFail.th: รออะไรอยู่! นำจี้ไป Reonan!
dialogsFail.tw: 你還在這裡做什麼？快點把我的墜飾拿去給雷奧南吧！
dialogsFail.vi: À, bạn đang chờ đợi gì vậy! Mau chóng mang mặt dây chuyền đến Reonan!

name.jp: 伝説のレッドマンティス（前編）
name.th: ตำนาน Redmantis (ตอนที่ 1)

description.en: Travel to Saint City and speak with Helgar, the connoisseur of rare and precious items. He should be located near Saint hall.
description.ar: Travel to Saint City and speak with Helgar, the connoisseur of rare and precious items. He should be located near Saint hall.
description.br: Na verdade, eu realmente gostaria de achar esse tesouro. Mas não sei nada a respeito dele. Por favor, fale com o apreciador Helgar em Saint.
description.cns: 其实啊~我很想得到我刚刚说的那个东西啦..可是我对那个东西并不了解..所以你可以去帮我找鉴定家海格乐帮我问一下吧。
description.de: Um ehrlich zu sein würde ich sehr gerne dieses seltene und wertvolle Ding besitzen. Aber es gibt nichts was ich darüber weiß. Bitte begib dich nach Saint Morning zu Helgar, der darüber Bescheid weiß.
description.fi: Travel to Saint City and speak with Helgar, the connoisseur of rare and precious items. He should be located near Saint hall.
description.fil: Travel to Saint City and speak with Helgar, the connoisseur of rare and precious items. He should be located near Saint hall.
description.fr: Trouver des informations sur l'objet rare recherché par Rudvihil auprès de Helgar, à Saincity.
description.id: Perjalanan ke Saint City dan berbicara dengan Helgar, penikmat barang langka dan berharga. Dia seharusnya berada di dekat aula Saint.
description.it: Travel to Saint City and speak with Helgar, the connoisseur of rare and precious items. He should be located near Saint hall.
description.jp: ルードヴィヒの欲しがる貴重な＜ある物＞を探そう。まずはセイントモーニングの鑑定士＜ヘルガール＞のところに行って、情報を聞こう。
description.kr: 세인트 시티로 가서 희귀한 보물과 유물을 수집하는 감정사 헬가르와 대화하세요. 세인트 홀 근처에 있습니다.
description.nl: Travel to Saint City and speak with Helgar, the connoisseur of rare and precious items. He should be located near Saint hall.
description.pl: Travel to Saint City and speak with Helgar, the connoisseur of rare and precious items. He should be located near Saint hall.
description.ru: Нужно поговорить с Ольгердом, знатоком диковин, в Санто.
description.sp: Viaja a Saint y habla con Helgar, el experto en objetos raros y preciosos. Debería estar cerca del Ayuntamiento de Saint.
description.sw: Travel to Saint City and speak with Helgar, the connoisseur of rare and precious items. He should be located near Saint hall.
description.th: เดินทางไปยัง Saint City และพูดคุยกับ Helgar นักสะสมของหายากและมีค่า เขาควรจะอยู่ใกล้ Saint hall
description.tw: 其實啊~我很想得到我剛剛說的那個東西啦…可是我對那個東西並不了解…所以你可以去幫我找鑑定家海佳樂幫我問一下吧。
description.vi: Du lịch đến Saint City và nói chuyện với Helgar, một người sành sỏi về các mặt hàng quý hiếm. Anh ấy nên ở gần Saint hall.

dialogsBegin.en: Hey you! Yeah, you! Come here for a minute… I would like to speak with about something.
dialogsBegin.ar: Hey you! Yeah, you! Come here for a minute… I would like to speak with about something.
dialogsBegin.br: Ei você! Sim, você! Venha aqui por um minuto... Eu gostaria de falar sobre uma coisa.
dialogsBegin.cns: 喔~你好啊~..这是谁啊?又好像有见过，又好像没见过。
dialogsBegin.de: Hey du! Ja, du! Komm mal kurz her... Ich würde gerne mit dir über etwas sprechen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Hey you! Yeah, you! Come here for a minute… I would like to speak with about something.
dialogsBegin.fil: Hey you! Yeah, you! Come here for a minute… I would like to speak with about something.
dialogsBegin.fr: Eh, salut ? Je te connais ? Hmm.. Parfois je ne reconnais plus très bien les gens.. Je deviens trop vieux. Ha ha ha ha !
dialogsBegin.id: Hei kamu! Ya kamu! Kemarilah sebentar… Saya ingin berbicara tentang sesuatu.
dialogsBegin.it: Hey you! Yeah, you! Come here for a minute… I would like to speak with about something.
dialogsBegin.jp: おや、こんにちは・・・君は誰だっけ？歳を取ってから、物忘れがひどくてな。悪気はないが、覚えておらんのだよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이봐요, 거기! 네, 당신요! 잠깐만요... 드리고 싶은 말씀이 있어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Hey you! Yeah, you! Come here for a minute… I would like to speak with about something.
dialogsBegin.pl: Hey you! Yeah, you! Come here for a minute… I would like to speak with about something.
dialogsBegin.ru: Hey you! Yeah, you! Come here for a minute… I would like to speak with about something.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Eh, tú! ¡Si, tú! Ven aquí un momento... Me gustaría hablar contigo sobre una cosa.
dialogsBegin.sw: Hey you! Yeah, you! Come here for a minute… I would like to speak with about something.
dialogsBegin.th: เฮ้ คุณ! ช่ายย คุณนั่นแหละ! มานี่สักครู่หน่อยสิ... ฉันอยากบอกอะไรคุณหน่อย
dialogsBegin.tw: 嘿，你！就是你！來這裡一下……我想談談一些事情。
dialogsBegin.vi: Này bạn! Vâng, bạn! Hãy đến đây một phút… Tôi muốn nói một vài điều.

dialogsBegin.en: My name is Rudvihil, and I am a collector or rare and expensive artifacts. I'm always on the lookout for something new and precious.
dialogsBegin.ar: My name is Rudvihil, and I am a collector or rare and expensive artifacts. I'm always on the lookout for something new and precious.
dialogsBegin.br: Ei, quer saber algo? Tem algo muito, muito raro e caro. Você já ouviu falar a respeito?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你有听过吗?就是对于又贵又高级的东西啊..
dialogsBegin.de: (Sich umsehend und geheim flüsternd) Hey, weißt du was? Etwas sehr sehr seltenes und wertvolles. Hast du davon gehört?
dialogsBegin.fi: My name is Rudvihil, and I am a collector or rare and expensive artifacts. I'm always on the lookout for something new and precious.
dialogsBegin.fil: My name is Rudvihil, and I am a collector or rare and expensive artifacts. I'm always on the lookout for something new and precious.
dialogsBegin.fr: (Regardant autour et chuchotant) Hé, tu sais quoi? Il y a quelque chose très très rare et cher. T'en as entendu parler?
dialogsBegin.id: Nama saya Rudvihil, dan saya seorang kolektor atau artefak langka dan mahal. Saya selalu mencari sesuatu yang baru dan berharga.
dialogsBegin.it: My name is Rudvihil, and I am a collector or rare and expensive artifacts. I'm always on the lookout for something new and precious.
dialogsBegin.jp: 君も知っているのかね？今、セイントモーニング中で話題になっている、とても珍しくて希少な美術品の噂だよ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 제 이름은 루드비힐인데, 희귀하고 값비싼 유물들을 수집하고 있어요. 언제나 새로운 보물을 찾아다니죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: My name is Rudvihil, and I am a collector or rare and expensive artifacts. I'm always on the lookout for something new and precious.
dialogsBegin.pl: My name is Rudvihil, and I am a collector or rare and expensive artifacts. I'm always on the lookout for something new and precious.
dialogsBegin.ru: Думаю, мне не надо представляться. Только глухой не слышал о Сотби и моей коллекции редких и дорогих безделушек!
dialogsBegin.sp: Mi nombre es Rudvihil, y soy un coleccionista de objetos raros y caros. Siempre estoy buscando algo nuevo y valioso.
dialogsBegin.sw: My name is Rudvihil, and I am a collector or rare and expensive artifacts. I'm always on the lookout for something new and precious.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันชื่อ Rudvihil และฉันเป็นนักสะสมสิ่งประดิษฐ์ที่หายากและมีราคาแพง ฉันมักจะมองหาสิ่งใหม่ๆ และมีค่า
dialogsBegin.tw: 我叫魯德比希爾，是專門收藏稀有昂貴文物的收藏家。我總是在尋找新奇而珍貴的東西。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tên tôi là Rudvihil, và tôi là một nhà sưu tập hoặc những cổ vật quý hiếm và đắt tiền. Tôi luôn tìm kiếm những thứ mới mẻ và quý giá.

dialogsBegin.en: Anyway, to the point, I heard some rumors that there is a very rare artifact in Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.ar: Anyway, to the point, I heard some rumors that there is a very rare artifact in Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.br: Ei, você já ouviu essa história incrível...? Ei, ouça.. deixe-me contá-la a você. Existem um item muito, muito raro e valioso em algum lugar de Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.cns: 好吧..我讲给你听吧..晨光里啊..传说中有一个很珍贵的东西..
dialogsBegin.de: Woher hast du von dieser unglaublichen Geschichte gehört..? Hey, hör zu. Lass mich dir etwas erzählen. Es gibt etwas sehr sehr seltenes und wertvolles irgendwo in Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.fi: Anyway, to the point, I heard some rumors that there is a very rare artifact in Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.fil: Anyway, to the point, I heard some rumors that there is a very rare artifact in Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.fr: Hé, t'as entendu parler de cette histoire incroyable..? Hé, écoute..laisse-moi te la raconter. Il y a un objet très très rare et très très intéressant quelque part à Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.id: Ngomong-ngomong, inti pembicaraan, aku mendengar beberapa rumor bahwa ada artefak yang sangat langka di Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.it: Anyway, to the point, I heard some rumors that there is a very rare artifact in Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.jp: この噂を聞いたことがないって？うとい奴だなあ。その噂は、セイントモーニング大陸のどこかに、伝説に出てくるとても珍しくて貴重な＜ある物＞があるそうだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 본론부터 말할게요. 세인트 모닝에 아주 희귀한 유물이 있다는 소문을 들었어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Anyway, to the point, I heard some rumors that there is a very rare artifact in Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.pl: Anyway, to the point, I heard some rumors that there is a very rare artifact in Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.ru: Но к делу. Я слышал, что на Санто Моргене появился очень необычный и редкий артефакт.
dialogsBegin.sp: Da igual, a lo importante, he escuchado algunos rumores de que hay un objeto muy raro en Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.sw: Anyway, to the point, I heard some rumors that there is a very rare artifact in Saint Morning.
dialogsBegin.th: อย่างไรก็ตาม ฉันได้ยินข่าวลือว่ามีสิ่งประดิษฐ์ที่หายากมากใน Saint Morning
dialogsBegin.tw: 好吧…我講給你聽吧…聖音特裡啊…傳說中有一個很珍貴的東西…
dialogsBegin.vi: Dù sao, tôi đã nghe một số tin đồn rằng có một cổ vật rất hiếm ở Saint Morning.

dialogsBegin.en: I intend to acquire this artifact for my collection. I have a vast collection of artifacts and it would make a nice addition.
dialogsBegin.ar: I intend to acquire this artifact for my collection. I have a vast collection of artifacts and it would make a nice addition.
dialogsBegin.br: Ótima história, não? He he he
dialogsBegin.cns: 听说那个东西真的很珍贵啊..有没有绝得很期待啊?哈哈..
dialogsBegin.de: Wie? Tolle Geschichte, nicht wahr?
dialogsBegin.fi: I intend to acquire this artifact for my collection. I have a vast collection of artifacts and it would make a nice addition.
dialogsBegin.fil: I intend to acquire this artifact for my collection. I have a vast collection of artifacts and it would make a nice addition.
dialogsBegin.fr: Géniale mon histoire, non? (maugréant en imaginant quelque chose)
dialogsBegin.id: Saya berniat untuk mendapatkan artefak ini untuk koleksi saya. Saya memiliki banyak koleksi artefak dan itu akan menjadi tambahan yang bagus.
dialogsBegin.it: I intend to acquire this artifact for my collection. I have a vast collection of artifacts and it would make a nice addition.
dialogsBegin.jp: なんだか謎めいていてわくわくするだろう？フフフ・・・
dialogsBegin.kr: 그 유물을 제가 수집하고 싶어요. 이미 꽤 방대한 유물 컬렉션을 모으고 있어서, 같이 두면 좋을 것 같거든요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I intend to acquire this artifact for my collection. I have a vast collection of artifacts and it would make a nice addition.
dialogsBegin.pl: I intend to acquire this artifact for my collection. I have a vast collection of artifacts and it would make a nice addition.
dialogsBegin.ru: Хотелось бы заполучить его в коллекцию. Он станет ее жемчужиной!
dialogsBegin.sp: Tengo la intención de adquirir ese objeto para mi colección. Tengo una gran colección de objetos y esa sería una buena adquisición.
dialogsBegin.sw: I intend to acquire this artifact for my collection. I have a vast collection of artifacts and it would make a nice addition.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันอยากได้สิ่งประดิษฐ์นี้เข้ามาในคอลเลกชันของฉัน ฉันมีคอลเลคชั่นของสิ่งประดิษฐ์เหล่านี้มากมาย และมันคงจะดีถ้าได้สิ่งนั้นมาเติมเต็มคอลเลคชั่นของฉัน
dialogsBegin.tw: 聽說那個東西真的很珍貴啊…有沒有絕得很期待啊？哈哈…
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi dự định mua lại cổ vật này cho bộ sưu tập của mình. Tôi có một bộ sưu tập đồ đồ cổ khổng lồ và nó sẽ tạo ra một bổ sung tuyệt vời.

dialogsBegin.en: So, what do you say? Will you help me find this artifact?
dialogsBegin.ar: So, what do you say? Will you help me find this artifact?
dialogsBegin.br: Então o que você diz? Você vai me ajudar a encontrar este artefato?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你可以帮我一件事情吗?是很简单的啦..
dialogsBegin.de: Also, was sagst du dazu? Wirst du mir helfen, dieses Artefakt zu finden?
dialogsBegin.fi: So, what do you say? Will you help me find this artifact?
dialogsBegin.fil: So, what do you say? Will you help me find this artifact?
dialogsBegin.fr: (Me regardant à nouveau) Hé, fais moi une fleur veux-tu. C'est très simple. Ca te dit ?
dialogsBegin.id: Jadi, apa yang kamu katakan? Maukah kamu membantu saya menemukan artefak ini?
dialogsBegin.it: So, what do you say? Will you help me find this artifact?
dialogsBegin.jp: それでだ。ここで会ったのも何かの縁。わしの頼みを聞いてくれないか？とても簡単なことなんだが、どうだ？
dialogsBegin.kr: 어때요? 유물 찾는 걸 도와주실래요?
dialogsBegin.nl: So, what do you say? Will you help me find this artifact?
dialogsBegin.pl: So, what do you say? Will you help me find this artifact?
dialogsBegin.ru: So, what do you say? Will you help me find this artifact?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Entonces que dices? ¿Me ayudarás a encontrar ese objeto?
dialogsBegin.sw: So, what do you say? Will you help me find this artifact?
dialogsBegin.th: แล้วคุณคิดว่ายังไงล่ะ? คุณช่วยฉันหาสิ่งประดิษฐ์นี้ได้หรือไม่?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你認為呢？你能幫我找到這個神器嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Vậy bạn sẽ nói gì? Bạn sẽ giúp tôi tìm thấy cổ vật này?

dialogsAccept.en: Great! Travel to Saint City, and speak with Helgar, the connoisseur of rare and precious items. He should be located near Saint Hall.
dialogsAccept.ar: Great! Travel to Saint City, and speak with Helgar, the connoisseur of rare and precious items. He should be located near Saint Hall.
dialogsAccept.br: Hi hi hi! Na verdade, eu adoraria obter esta coisa rara e valiosa. Mas eu não sei nada a respeito dela. Por favor, fale com o apreciador Helgar em Saint.
dialogsAccept.cns: 其实啊~我很想得到我刚刚说的那个东西啦..可是我对那个东西并不了解..所以你可以去帮我找鉴定家海格乐吗?
dialogsAccept.de: Um ehrlich zu sein würde ich sehr gerne dieses seltene und wertvolle Ding besitzen. Aber es gibt nichts was ich darüber weiß. Bitte begib dich nach Saint Morning zu Helgar, der darüber Bescheid weiß.
dialogsAccept.fi: Great! Travel to Saint City, and speak with Helgar, the connoisseur of rare and precious items. He should be located near Saint Hall.
dialogsAccept.fil: Great! Travel to Saint City, and speak with Helgar, the connoisseur of rare and precious items. He should be located near Saint Hall.
dialogsAccept.fr: Hi hi hi! Je voudrais vraiment avoir cet objet très rare et précieux. Mais je n'y connais rien. Va voir Helgar, c'est un expert sur l'art à Saint Morning.
dialogsAccept.id: Benar! Perjalanan ke Saint City, dan berbicara dengan Helgar, penikmat barang langka dan berharga. Dia harus berada di dekat Saint Hall.
dialogsAccept.it: Great! Travel to Saint City, and speak with Helgar, the connoisseur of rare and precious items. He should be located near Saint Hall.
dialogsAccept.jp: わしはその貴重な＜ある物＞をどうしても手に入れたい。だが、＜ある物＞について何も情報を知らない。そこで、セイントモーニングの鑑定士ヘルガースのところに行って、情報を聞き出してきてくれないか？
dialogsAccept.kr: 좋아요! 그럼 세인트 시티로 가서, 감정사 헬가르를 만나보세요. 아마 세인트 홀 근처에 있을 거예요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Great! Travel to Saint City, and speak with Helgar, the connoisseur of rare and precious items. He should be located near Saint Hall.
dialogsAccept.pl: Great! Travel to Saint City, and speak with Helgar, the connoisseur of rare and precious items. He should be located near Saint Hall.
dialogsAccept.ru: Отлично! Отправляйся в Санто и найди там Ольгерда. Он известный знаток диковин. Спроси его о яйце Богомольже.
dialogsAccept.sp: Genial! Viaja a Saint, habla con Helgar, el experto en objetos raros y preciosos. Debería estar cerca del Ayuntamiento de Saint.
dialogsAccept.sw: Great! Travel to Saint City, and speak with Helgar, the connoisseur of rare and precious items. He should be located near Saint Hall.
dialogsAccept.th: ดีมาก! เดินทางไปยัง Saint City และพูดคุยกับ Helgar นักสะสมของหายากและมีค่า เขาควรจะอยู่ใกล้ Saint Hall
dialogsAccept.tw: 太好了！前往聖音特，去找珍奇古物鑑定家海佳樂。他就在聖音特教堂附近。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tuyệt quá! Du lịch đến Saint City, và nói chuyện với Helgar, một người sành sỏi về các mặt hàng quý hiếm. Anh ta nên ở gần Saint Hall.

dialogsDecline.en: What? You won't help me? Fine, get off my property, then!
dialogsDecline.ar: What? You won't help me? Fine, get off my property, then!
dialogsDecline.br: O que? Você não quer me ajudar? Tudo bem, saia da minha propriedade, então!
dialogsDecline.cns: 啥?什么?既然都听我说了还不帮我!!这些年轻人真没礼貌啊..
dialogsDecline.de: WAS? Du willst mir nicht helfen? Gut, dann verschwinde von meinem Grundstück!
dialogsDecline.fi: What? You won't help me? Fine, get off my property, then!
dialogsDecline.fil: What? You won't help me? Fine, get off my property, then!
dialogsDecline.fr: QUOI ? Tu ne veux pas le faire ? Tu es très malpoli ! Alors ça..!!
dialogsDecline.id: Apa? Kamu tidak akan membantu saya? Baiklah, turun dari propertiku, kalau begitu!
dialogsDecline.it: What? You won't help me? Fine, get off my property, then!
dialogsDecline.jp: なんだって？断る？ それなら仕方ない。用がないならとっととどっかにいってくれ。
dialogsDecline.kr: 뭐라고요? 싫다고요? 참나, 당장 여기서 나가세요!
dialogsDecline.nl: What? You won't help me? Fine, get off my property, then!
dialogsDecline.pl: What? You won't help me? Fine, get off my property, then!
dialogsDecline.ru: What? You won't help me? Fine, get off my property, then!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Qué? ¿No me vas a ayudar? ¡Vale, entonces sal de mi propiedad!
dialogsDecline.sw: What? You won't help me? Fine, get off my property, then!
dialogsDecline.th: อะไรนะ? คุณจะไม่ช่วยฉันงั้นเหรอ? ก็ได้ งั้นก็ออกไปจากพื้นที่ของฉันซะ!
dialogsDecline.tw: 什麼？你不幫我？好吧，那就滾出我的地盤！
dialogsDecline.vi: Gì? Bạn sẽ không giúp tôi? Được rồi, vậy thì cút khỏi căn hộ của tôi!

dialogsComplete.en: Hello there, are you interested in any rare artifacts? I have an stunning ancient Aibatt carving here that is very unique…
dialogsComplete.ar: Hello there, are you interested in any rare artifacts? I have an stunning ancient Aibatt carving here that is very unique…
dialogsComplete.br: Olá, você está interessado em algum artefato raro? Eu tenho uma impressionante escultura antiga de Aibatt aqui que é muito única…
dialogsComplete.cns: 您好，您对稀有文物感兴趣吗？我有一个令人惊叹的古代独眼蝠雕刻，非常独特……
dialogsComplete.de: Hallo, bist du an irgendwelchen seltenen Artefakten interessiert? Ich habe hier eine atemberaubende alte Aibatt-Schnitzerei, die sehr einzigartig ist...
dialogsComplete.fi: Hello there, are you interested in any rare artifacts? I have an stunning ancient Aibatt carving here that is very unique…
dialogsComplete.fil: Hello there, are you interested in any rare artifacts? I have an stunning ancient Aibatt carving here that is very unique…
dialogsComplete.fr: Hmm ? Qu'est-ce qui t'amène ? (Lui parle de Rudvihil) Ha ha ha ! Cette histoire tient vraiment à cœur à Rudvihil.
dialogsComplete.id: Halo, apakah Anda tertarik dengan artefak langka? Saya memiliki ukiran Aibatt kuno yang menakjubkan di sini yang sangat unik…
dialogsComplete.it: Hello there, are you interested in any rare artifacts? I have an stunning ancient Aibatt carving here that is very unique…
dialogsComplete.jp: 何か用か？あの噂のことでルードヴィヒに頼まれてやってきたのか。ハハッ！たしかにルードヴィヒが食いつきそうな話だな。
dialogsComplete.kr: 안녕하세요, 희귀 유물에 관심 있으신가요? 아주 독특한 아이바트 조각상이 하나 있습니다만…
dialogsComplete.nl: Hello there, are you interested in any rare artifacts? I have an stunning ancient Aibatt carving here that is very unique…
dialogsComplete.pl: Hello there, are you interested in any rare artifacts? I have an stunning ancient Aibatt carving here that is very unique…
dialogsComplete.ru: Привет-привет! Не желаешь взглянуть на диковины? Вот очень редкая статуэтка Сглаза, вырезанная неизвестным мастером древней цивилизации...
dialogsComplete.sp: Hola, ¿estás interesado en algún objeto raro? Tengo una impresionante estatua antigua de Aibatt única tallada a mano...
dialogsComplete.sw: Hello there, are you interested in any rare artifacts? I have an stunning ancient Aibatt carving here that is very unique…
dialogsComplete.th: สวัสดี คุณคนนั้นน่ะ คุณสนใจสิ่งประดิษฐ์ที่หาได้ยากหรือไม่? ฉันมีงานแกะสลักโบราณ Aibatt ที่แสนงดงามและมีเอกลักษณ์มาก...
dialogsComplete.tw: 你好啊，你對稀有文物感興趣嗎？我在這裡有一個令人驚豔的古代蘿特泰斯雕刻，非常獨特……
dialogsComplete.vi: Xin chào, bạn có quan tâm đến cổ vật quý hiếm nào không? Tôi có một bức chạm khắc Aibatt cổ tuyệt đẹp ở đây rất độc đáo…

dialogsComplete.en: Rudvihil? Hahaha! That guy will never stop hoarding rare and precious treasure.
dialogsComplete.ar: Rudvihil? Hahaha! That guy will never stop hoarding rare and precious treasure.
dialogsComplete.br: Rudvihil? Hahaha! Esse cara nunca vai parar de acumular tesouros raros e preciosos. É muito importante para ele.
dialogsComplete.cns: 因为萝特泰斯很喜欢收藏又贵又稀有的东西啊。哈哈
dialogsComplete.de: Rudvihil? Hahaha! Dieser Kerl wird nie aufhören, seltene und wertvolle Schätze zu horten.
dialogsComplete.fi: Rudvihil? Hahaha! That guy will never stop hoarding rare and precious treasure.
dialogsComplete.fil: Rudvihil? Hahaha! That guy will never stop hoarding rare and precious treasure.
dialogsComplete.fr: Rudvihil veut toujours avoir quelque chose de rare et précieux. C'est très important pour lui.
dialogsComplete.id: Rudvihil? Hahaha! Orang itu tidak akan pernah berhenti menimbun harta langka dan berharga.
dialogsComplete.it: Rudvihil? Hahaha! That guy will never stop hoarding rare and precious treasure.
dialogsComplete.jp: ルードヴィヒ？彼は珍しい物や貴重な物に対しては、異常な執念があるからな。
dialogsComplete.kr: 루드비힐이요? 하하하! 그 친구는 희귀한 보물에 목숨 거는 사람이죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: Rudvihil? Hahaha! That guy will never stop hoarding rare and precious treasure.
dialogsComplete.pl: Rudvihil? Hahaha! That guy will never stop hoarding rare and precious treasure.
dialogsComplete.ru: Сотби? Ха-ха! Ну, этот думает только о своей коллекции.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿Rudvihil? ¡Jajaja! Ese personaje nunca dejará de acumular tesoros raros y preciosos.
dialogsComplete.sw: Rudvihil? Hahaha! That guy will never stop hoarding rare and precious treasure.
dialogsComplete.th: Rudvihil? ฮ่าๆ! นายคนนั้นไม่เคยจะหยุดสะสมขุมทรัพย์ที่หายากและของมีค่าเลยจริงๆ แฮะ
dialogsComplete.tw: 蘿特泰斯？哈哈哈！那傢伙永遠不會停止囤積稀有珍貴的寶物。
dialogsComplete.vi: Rudvihil? Hahaha! Chàng trai ấy sẽ không ngừng tích trữ kho báu quý hiếm.

dialogsFail.en: Have you found anything, yet? No? Well hurry up! I don't have all day!
dialogsFail.ar: Have you found anything, yet? No? Well hurry up! I don't have all day!
dialogsFail.br: Já encontrou alguma coisa? Não? Bem apresse-se! Eu não tenho o dia todo!
dialogsFail.cns: 你有什么特别的物品吗?我来看看值多少钱好了!
dialogsFail.de: Haben Sie schon etwas gefunden? Nein? Dann beeil dich! Ich habe nicht den ganzen Tag Zeit!
dialogsFail.fi: Have you found anything, yet? No? Well hurry up! I don't have all day!
dialogsFail.fil: Have you found anything, yet? No? Well hurry up! I don't have all day!
dialogsFail.fr: As-tu trouvé quelque chose de rare et précieux ? Laisse-moi en juger.
dialogsFail.id: Apakah kamu menemukan sesuatu, belum? Tidak? Yah cepatlah! Saya tidak punya waktu seharian!
dialogsFail.it: Have you found anything, yet? No? Well hurry up! I don't have all day!
dialogsFail.jp: 何か見つけましたか？ 無いなら 急いで！ 一日中持てません！
dialogsFail.kr: 무언가 찾으셨어요? 아직 인가요? 서두르세요! 온종일 기다려 드릴 순 없어요!
dialogsFail.nl: Have you found anything, yet? No? Well hurry up! I don't have all day!
dialogsFail.pl: Have you found anything, yet? No? Well hurry up! I don't have all day!
dialogsFail.ru: Have you found anything, yet? No? Well hurry up! I don't have all day!
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Ya has encontrado algo? ¿No? ¡Pues espabila! ¡No tengo todo el día!
dialogsFail.sw: Have you found anything, yet? No? Well hurry up! I don't have all day!
dialogsFail.th: คุณพบอะไรบ้างหรือยัง? ยังอีกเหรอ? งั้นก็รีบเข้าสิ! ฉันไม่มีเวลาทั้งวันหรอก!
dialogsFail.tw: 你有什麼發現嗎？不？快點！我沒有那麼多的時間！
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn đã tìm thấy gì chưa? Chưa sao?Nhanh lên! Tôi không có nhiều thời gian đâu!

description.en: Kill 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas.
description.ar: Kill 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas.
description.br: Elimine 20 Leyenas Pequenas e 10 Leyenas.
description.cns: 请杀死20个高地幼犬和10个高地猎犬！
description.de: Töte 20 Small Leyenas und 10 Leyenas.
description.fi: Kill 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas.
description.fil: Kill 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas.
description.fr: Allez chasser 20 Jeunes Leyenas et 10 Leyenas à l'Est de Darkon.
description.id: Bunuh 20 Small Leyenas dan 10 Leyenas.
description.it: Kill 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas.
description.jp: リトルレイーナを20体、レイーナ10体を倒し、ダーコン市長に報告せよ。
description.nl: Kill 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas.
description.pl: Kill 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas.
description.ru: Kill 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas.
description.sp: Derrota a 20 Leyenas Pequeñas y a 10 Leyenas.
description.sw: Kill 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas.
description.th: กำจัด 20 Small Leyenas และ 10 Leyenas!
description.tw: 殺 20 個小血狼和 10 個血狼！
description.vi: Giết 20 con Leyenas nhỏ và 10 con Leyenas.

dialogsBegin.en: What's this you speak of? Heroes? Can't say I've heard anything about that… But, I believe I know a person who may have…
dialogsBegin.ar: What's this you speak of? Heroes? Can't say I've heard anything about that… But, I believe I know a person who may have…
dialogsBegin.br: Do que está falando?? Aqueles Heróis?? Não posso falar sobre algo tão sigiloso por aqui... Mas acredito que conheço uma pessoa que pode...
dialogsBegin.cns: What's this you speak of? Heroes? Can't say I've heard anything about that… But, I believe I know a person who may have…
dialogsBegin.de: Was ist das, wovon du sprichst? Helden? Ich kann nicht behaupten, davon gehört zu haben... Aber ich glaube, ich kenne eine Person, die vielleicht...
dialogsBegin.fi: What's this you speak of? Heroes? Can't say I've heard anything about that… But, I believe I know a person who may have…
dialogsBegin.fil: What's this you speak of? Heroes? Can't say I've heard anything about that… But, I believe I know a person who may have…
dialogsBegin.fr: Des Héros réincarnés ? Première fois que j'entends parler de ça...
dialogsBegin.id: Apa yang kau bicarakan?? Pahlawan?? Saya tidak bisa bilang bahwa saya pernah mendengar apa-apa tentang itu... Tapi, saya yakin saya mengenal seseorang yang mungkin tahu tentang hal ini...
dialogsBegin.it: What's this you speak of? Heroes? Can't say I've heard anything about that… But, I believe I know a person who may have…
dialogsBegin.jp: 英雄の転生……ほほう、そういった話は聞いたことがないが、詳しいであろう人物なら心当たりがあるぞ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 뭐라고 하셨어요? 영웅들이요? 글쎄요… 전 잘 모르겠네요... 그런 이야기를 알 법한 사람을 알고 있긴 해요…
dialogsBegin.nl: What's this you speak of? Heroes? Can't say I've heard anything about that… But, I believe I know a person who may have…
dialogsBegin.pl: What's this you speak of? Heroes? Can't say I've heard anything about that… But, I believe I know a person who may have…
dialogsBegin.ru: What's this you speak of? Heroes? Can't say I've heard anything about that… But, I believe I know a person who may have…
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿¿De qué estás hablando?? ¿Héroes? No he escuchado nada sobre eso... Pero, creo que conozco a una persona que puede saber algo...
dialogsBegin.sw: What's this you speak of? Heroes? Can't say I've heard anything about that… But, I believe I know a person who may have…
dialogsBegin.th: คุณพูดถึงเรื่องอะไร? ผู้กล้า? ฉันก็เพิ่งได้ยินเรื่องนี้เหมือนกัน... แต่ฉันคิดว่าฉันรู้จักคนที่อาจจะรู้เรื่องนี้...
dialogsBegin.tw: 你在說什麼？英雄？這件事我倒是沒怎麼聽說過……不過，我想我認識一個也許知道的人……
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn nói về cái gì vậy?  Những Anh hùng ư? Tôi không chắc đã nghe ngóng được hết mọi thông tin… Nhưng, tôi tin rằng tôi biết một người có khả năng đó…

dialogsBegin.en: Oh you want to know? Of course I will tell you… But first perhaps you could do me a favor?
dialogsBegin.ar: Oh you want to know? Of course I will tell you… But first perhaps you could do me a favor?
dialogsBegin.br: Hm Você precisa saber? Claro que vou te dizer... Mas primeiro, que tal você me fazer um favor?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你想知道吗？我当然会告诉你…但首先也许你能帮我个忙吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Ach, das willst du wissen? Natürlich werde ich es dir sagen... Aber vielleicht könntest du mir zuerst einen Gefallen tun?
dialogsBegin.fi: Oh you want to know? Of course I will tell you… But first perhaps you could do me a favor?
dialogsBegin.fil: Oh you want to know? Of course I will tell you… But first perhaps you could do me a favor?
dialogsBegin.fr: En revanche, je connais tous les porteurs de ragots de Darkon. Quelqu'un aura sans doute des informations pour vous.
dialogsBegin.id: Oh, kau ingin tahu? Tentu saja aku akan memberitahumu... Tapi pertama-tama bisakah kamu membantu saya?
dialogsBegin.it: Oh you want to know? Of course I will tell you… But first perhaps you could do me a favor?
dialogsBegin.jp: そう急くな。教える、教えるが……その前に一つやってほしいことがある。
dialogsBegin.kr: 알려달라고요? 물론, 알려 드려야죠... 하지만 그전에 제 부탁 하나만 들어주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Oh you want to know? Of course I will tell you… But first perhaps you could do me a favor?
dialogsBegin.pl: Oh you want to know? Of course I will tell you… But first perhaps you could do me a favor?
dialogsBegin.ru: Oh you want to know? Of course I will tell you… But first perhaps you could do me a favor?
dialogsBegin.sp: Ah, ¿quieres información? Por supuesto que te la daré… Pero primero, ¿quizás podrías hacerme un favor?
dialogsBegin.sw: Oh you want to know? Of course I will tell you… But first perhaps you could do me a favor?
dialogsBegin.th: โอ้ คุณอยากรู้งั้นหรอ ? แน่นอนฉันจะบอกคุณ ... แต่ก่อนอื่นคุณพอจะช่วยฉันได้ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: 要我告訴你嗎？好啊，我當然可以告訴你…但是，在那之前，你可以幫我一個忙嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Oh bạn muốn biết? Tất nhiên tôi sẽ nói với bạn… Nhưng trước tiên, có lẽ bạn có thể giúp tôi một việc?

dialogsBegin.en: I am frequently in touch with the mayors of both Saint City and Flarine. I have heard of your heroic actions and request your aid. There has been a dramatic increase in Leyena populations.
dialogsBegin.ar: I am frequently in touch with the mayors of both Saint City and Flarine. I have heard of your heroic actions and request your aid. There has been a dramatic increase in Leyena populations.
dialogsBegin.br: Estou frequentemente em contato com os prefeitos das cidades Saint e Flarine. Ouvi falar de suas ações heroicas e solicito sua ajuda. Houve um aumento dramático nas populações de Leyenas.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我经常与晨光和帕里的市长保持联系。我听说了你的英勇行为。我现在需要你的帮助。现在高地猎犬的数量急剧增加。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich stehe häufig in Kontakt mit den Bürgermeistern von Saint City und Flarine. Ich habe von Ihren heldenhaften Taten gehört und bitte Sie um Ihre Hilfe. Die Leyena-Bevölkerung hat dramatisch zugenommen.
dialogsBegin.fi: I am frequently in touch with the mayors of both Saint City and Flarine. I have heard of your heroic actions and request your aid. There has been a dramatic increase in Leyena populations.
dialogsBegin.fil: I am frequently in touch with the mayors of both Saint City and Flarine. I have heard of your heroic actions and request your aid. There has been a dramatic increase in Leyena populations.
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais avant que Darkon vous rendre service, vous allez rendre service à Darkon. Les Leyena sont très agités en ce moment. Cela perturbe les collecteurs de la ville.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya sering berhubungan dengan walikota Saint City dan Flarine. Saya telah mendengar tentang tindakan heroikmu dan meminta bantuanmu. Ada peningkatan dramatis dalam populasi Leyena.
dialogsBegin.it: I am frequently in touch with the mayors of both Saint City and Flarine. I have heard of your heroic actions and request your aid. There has been a dramatic increase in Leyena populations.
dialogsBegin.jp: 君は各地の問題を解決してきた英雄だと言うじゃないかね。我が都市も少しばかり困った問題を抱えておるのだ。……東地区にはびこるレイーナを見たかね？ どんどん増えてきておる。まったく…
dialogsBegin.kr: 세인트 시티와 플라리네의 시장님들과 자주 연락하고 있는데, 당신의 활약에 대해서도 들었거든요. 최근 레이에나의 개체 수가 급격히 늘어나고 있어서 도움이 필요해요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I am frequently in touch with the mayors of both Saint City and Flarine. I have heard of your heroic actions and request your aid. There has been a dramatic increase in Leyena populations.
dialogsBegin.pl: I am frequently in touch with the mayors of both Saint City and Flarine. I have heard of your heroic actions and request your aid. There has been a dramatic increase in Leyena populations.
dialogsBegin.ru: I am frequently in touch with the mayors of both Saint City and Flarine. I have heard of your heroic actions and request your aid. There has been a dramatic increase in Leyena populations.
dialogsBegin.sp: Contacto con frecuencia con los alcaldes de Saint y de Flarine. He oído hablar de tus heroicos actos y por eso solicito tu ayuda. Ha habido un aumento dramático en la población de Leyenas.
dialogsBegin.sw: I am frequently in touch with the mayors of both Saint City and Flarine. I have heard of your heroic actions and request your aid. There has been a dramatic increase in Leyena populations.
dialogsBegin.th: บ่อยครั้งที่ฉันติดต่อกับนายกเทศมนตรีของ Saint City และ Flarine ฉันได้ยินเกี่ยวกับการกระทำที่กล้าหาญของคุณและขอความช่วยเหลือจากคุณ
dialogsBegin.tw: 你很會解決城市的問題，非常的有名…也幫忙一下得肯的問題吧。最近血狼的數量突然增加很多，所以我們不能放著城鎮，跑去採礦。但是我們城市又是必須採礦，才能夠生存的城市。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi thường xuyên liên lạc với các thị trưởng của Saint City và Flarine. Tôi đã nghe nói về những hành động anh hùng của bạn và yêu cầu sự giúp đỡ của bạn. Dân số Leyena đã gia tăng đáng kể.

dialogsBegin.en: They have made it awfully hard for our workers to collect a rare ore which is a staple export here in Darken. Please defeat the Leyena and I will give you the information.
dialogsBegin.ar: They have made it awfully hard for our workers to collect a rare ore which is a staple export here in Darken. Please defeat the Leyena and I will give you the information.
dialogsBegin.br: Elas atrapalham nossos trabalhadores na coleta de um minério raro, que é um produto básico de exportação aqui em Darken. Por favor, derrote as Leyenas e eu lhe darei a informação.
dialogsBegin.cns: 它们让我们的工人很难收集一种稀有矿石，这种矿石是达肯的主要出口产品。请打败高地猎犬，我会告诉你你想知道的一些信息。
dialogsBegin.de: Sie haben es unseren Arbeitern furchtbar schwer gemacht, ein seltenes Erz zu sammeln, das hier in Darken ein wichtiges Exportgut ist. Bitte besiegt die Leyena und ich werde euch die Informationen geben.
dialogsBegin.fi: They have made it awfully hard for our workers to collect a rare ore which is a staple export here in Darken. Please defeat the Leyena and I will give you the information.
dialogsBegin.fil: They have made it awfully hard for our workers to collect a rare ore which is a staple export here in Darken. Please defeat the Leyena and I will give you the information.
dialogsBegin.fr: Allez donc tuer une vingtaine de Leyena pour que les collecteurs travaillent en paix.
dialogsBegin.id: Mereka telah membuat pekerja kami sangat kesulitan untuk mengumpulkan rare ore yang merupakan ekspor pokok di Darken. Tolong kalahkan Leyena dan saya akan memberimu informasinya.
dialogsBegin.it: They have made it awfully hard for our workers to collect a rare ore which is a staple export here in Darken. Please defeat the Leyena and I will give you the information.
dialogsBegin.jp: 私たちの労働者がダーコンで主要な輸出品である珍しい鉱石を集めるのに苦労しています。 レイーナを倒してください！重要な情報を伝えます！
dialogsBegin.kr: 레이에나 녀석들 때문에 이 지역의 핵심 자원인 희귀 광석을 캐는 데 큰 지장이 생기고 있어요. 레이에나를 처치해 주신다면, 약속한 정보를 드리죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: They have made it awfully hard for our workers to collect a rare ore which is a staple export here in Darken. Please defeat the Leyena and I will give you the information.
dialogsBegin.pl: They have made it awfully hard for our workers to collect a rare ore which is a staple export here in Darken. Please defeat the Leyena and I will give you the information.
dialogsBegin.ru: They have made it awfully hard for our workers to collect a rare ore which is a staple export here in Darken. Please defeat the Leyena and I will give you the information.
dialogsBegin.sp: Han hecho que sea terriblemente difícil para nuestros trabajadores recolectar un mineral raro que es básico para la exportación de Darken. Por favor derrota a las Leyenas y te daré la información.
dialogsBegin.sw: They have made it awfully hard for our workers to collect a rare ore which is a staple export here in Darken. Please defeat the Leyena and I will give you the information.
dialogsBegin.th: กรุณากำจัด Leyena และฉันจะให้ข้อมูลแก่คุณ
dialogsBegin.tw: 它們讓我們的工人很難收集稀有礦石，這是得肯這裡的主要出口產品。請打敗血狼，我會給你相關資訊。
dialogsBegin.vi: Họ đã làm cho công nhân cho chúng tôi và rất khó khăn để thu thập một loại quặng quý hiếm, một loại quặng xuất khẩu chủ yếu ở đây cho Darken. Hãy đánh bại Leyena và tôi sẽ cung cấp cho bạn thông tin.

dialogsAccept.en: Thank you adventurer! The Leyena can be found in Eastern Darkon. Please decrease their population by killing 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas.
dialogsAccept.ar: Thank you adventurer! The Leyena can be found in Eastern Darkon. Please decrease their population by killing 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas.
dialogsAccept.br: Obrigado aventureiro! As Leyenas podem ser encontradas no leste de Darkon. Por favor, diminua sua população eliminando 20 Leyenas Pequenas e 10 Leyenas.
dialogsAccept.cns: 谢谢你，我的冒险家！高地猎犬可以在达肯东部找到。请通过杀死20只高地幼犬和10只高地猎犬来减少它们的数量。
dialogsAccept.de: Danke, Abenteurer! Die Leyena sind im östlichen Darkon zu finden. Bitte verringert ihre Population, indem ihr 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas tötet.
dialogsAccept.fi: Thank you adventurer! The Leyena can be found in Eastern Darkon. Please decrease their population by killing 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas.
dialogsAccept.fil: Thank you adventurer! The Leyena can be found in Eastern Darkon. Please decrease their population by killing 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas.
dialogsAccept.fr: Vous trouverez des Leyena à l'Est de Darkon.
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih petualang! Leyena dapat ditemukan di Eastern Darkon. Harap kurangi populasi mereka dengan membunuh 20 Small Leyenas dan 10 Leyenas.
dialogsAccept.it: Thank you adventurer! The Leyena can be found in Eastern Darkon. Please decrease their population by killing 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas.
dialogsAccept.jp: おぉ、ありがたい！レイーナの居所は判るかね？ レイーナはイースタンダーコンにいます。スモール・レイーナを20体、レイーナを10体倒してくれたまえ。
dialogsAccept.kr: 고맙네! 레이에나는 다콘 동쪽 끝에서 서식하며 점점 영역을 늘리고 있네. 레이에나 20마리만 처치해주게나.
dialogsAccept.nl: Thank you adventurer! The Leyena can be found in Eastern Darkon. Please decrease their population by killing 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas.
dialogsAccept.pl: Thank you adventurer! The Leyena can be found in Eastern Darkon. Please decrease their population by killing 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas.
dialogsAccept.ru: Thank you adventurer! The Leyena can be found in Eastern Darkon. Please decrease their population by killing 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Gracias aventurero! Las Leyenas se pueden encontrar al Este de Darkon. Disminuye su población matando a 20 Leyenas Pequeñas y a 10 Leyenas.
dialogsAccept.sw: Thank you adventurer! The Leyena can be found in Eastern Darkon. Please decrease their population by killing 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอบคุณเหล่านักผจญภัย! Leyena สามารถพบได้ใน Eastern Darkon โปรดฆ่า 20 Small Leyenas และ 10 Leyenas
dialogsAccept.tw: 謝謝你，冒險者！血狼出沒在得肯東部。請擊敗 20 隻小型血狼與 10 隻血狼，減少牠們的數量。
dialogsAccept.vi: Cảm ơn nhà thám hiểm! Leyena có thể được tìm thấy ở Eastern Darkon. Hãy giảm dân số của chúng bằng cách giết 20 Small Leyenas và 10 Leyenas.

dialogsDecline.en: Hmm, what was it you needed again? My mind seems to be getting fuzzy... Since you are here, why not do some sightseeing?
dialogsDecline.ar: Hmm, what was it you needed again? My mind seems to be getting fuzzy... Since you are here, why not do some sightseeing?
dialogsDecline.br: Hmm, o que você queria? Minha mente parece estar ficando confusa... Já que você está aqui, por que não faz um pouco de turismo?
dialogsDecline.cns: 嗯，你还需要什么？我的头脑似乎变得糊涂了... 既然你都来这了，为什么不观光一下呢？
dialogsDecline.de: Hmm, was haben Sie noch mal gebraucht? Mein Gedächtnis scheint zu verwirren... Wenn du schon mal hier bist, warum machst du nicht ein bisschen Sightseeing?
dialogsDecline.fi: Hmm, what was it you needed again? My mind seems to be getting fuzzy... Since you are here, why not do some sightseeing?
dialogsDecline.fil: Hmm, what was it you needed again? My mind seems to be getting fuzzy... Since you are here, why not do some sightseeing?
dialogsDecline.fr: Je ne vous aiderai pas si vous ne nous aidez pas.
dialogsDecline.id: Hmm, apa yang kamu butuhkan lagi? Pikiranku sepertinya semakin kabur... Karena kamu di sini, mengapa tidak melihat-lihat pemandangan sekitar?
dialogsDecline.it: Hmm, what was it you needed again? My mind seems to be getting fuzzy... Since you are here, why not do some sightseeing?
dialogsDecline.jp: うーん、また何か必要？ 頭が回らないなら、観光してみませんか？
dialogsDecline.kr: 음, 뭐가 필요하다고 하셨죠...? 요즘 자꾸 정신이 흐릿하네요... 여기까지 온 김에 구경이나 하고 가시죠?
dialogsDecline.nl: Hmm, what was it you needed again? My mind seems to be getting fuzzy... Since you are here, why not do some sightseeing?
dialogsDecline.pl: Hmm, what was it you needed again? My mind seems to be getting fuzzy... Since you are here, why not do some sightseeing?
dialogsDecline.ru: Hmm, what was it you needed again? My mind seems to be getting fuzzy... Since you are here, why not do some sightseeing?
dialogsDecline.sp: Hmm, ¿qué era lo que necesitabas? Estoy un poco confundido... Ya que estás aquí, ¿por qué no haces un poco de turismo?
dialogsDecline.sw: Hmm, what was it you needed again? My mind seems to be getting fuzzy... Since you are here, why not do some sightseeing?
dialogsDecline.th: ถ้าอย่างนั้นฉันก็ช่วยอะไรคุณไม่ได้เหมือนกัน เอาล่ะ! ฉันจะไป Darkon สักครู่แล้วฉันจะกลับไป
dialogsDecline.tw: 嗯，你又需要什麼？我的思緒似乎變得模糊了……既然來了，不如去觀光一下吧？
dialogsDecline.vi: Hmm, bạn cần những thứ ấy lần nữa à? Đầu óc tôi dường như trở nên mờ mịt ... Vì bạn đã ở đây, tại sao không đi tham quan một số nơi?

dialogsComplete.en: Hah! It is just as I have heard. You are truly a problem saver! Now to uphold my end of the bargain!
dialogsComplete.ar: Hah! It is just as I have heard. You are truly a problem saver! Now to uphold my end of the bargain!
dialogsComplete.br: Hah! É exatamente como tenho escutado. Você é realmente um resolvedor de problemas! Agora, para cumprir a minha parte do trato!
dialogsComplete.cns: 哈！正如我所听说的那样。你真是个问题拖延者！但现在我坚持我的协议！
dialogsComplete.de: Hah! Es ist genau so, wie ich es gehört habe. Sie sind wirklich ein Problemlöser! Jetzt muss ich meinen Teil der Abmachung einhalten!
dialogsComplete.fi: Hah! It is just as I have heard. You are truly a problem saver! Now to uphold my end of the bargain!
dialogsComplete.fil: Hah! It is just as I have heard. You are truly a problem saver! Now to uphold my end of the bargain!
dialogsComplete.fr: La rumeur disait vrai, vous avez l'air gringalet comme ça mais vous vous défendez bien.
dialogsComplete.id: Hah! Itu seperti yang saya dengar. Kau benar-benar penyelamat! Sekarang saatnya untuk akhir dari tawar-menawar saya!
dialogsComplete.it: Hah! It is just as I have heard. You are truly a problem saver! Now to uphold my end of the bargain!
dialogsComplete.jp: 噂通りの実力じゃないかね！
dialogsComplete.kr: 하하! 역시 소문대로군요! 진짜 문제 해결사세요! 이제 저도 약속을 지킬 차례군요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Hah! It is just as I have heard. You are truly a problem saver! Now to uphold my end of the bargain!
dialogsComplete.pl: Hah! It is just as I have heard. You are truly a problem saver! Now to uphold my end of the bargain!
dialogsComplete.ru: Hah! It is just as I have heard. You are truly a problem saver! Now to uphold my end of the bargain!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Ja! Eres justo lo que me habían dicho. ¡Eres un solucionador de problemas! ¡Ahora a cumplir mi parte del trato!
dialogsComplete.sw: Hah! It is just as I have heard. You are truly a problem saver! Now to uphold my end of the bargain!
dialogsComplete.th: ฮะ! มันเป็นแค่ข่าวลือ
dialogsComplete.tw: 哈！正如我所聽到的那樣。你真的是一個問題拯救者！現在堅持我的討價還價！
dialogsComplete.vi: Hả! Nó giống như tôi đã nghe. Bạn thực sự là một người được việc. Bây giờ để duy trì sự kết thúc của món hời của tôi!

dialogsFail.en: Well? I'm not getting any younger! The Leyena are found in Eastern Darkon. Please get rid of at least 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas!
dialogsFail.ar: Well? I'm not getting any younger! The Leyena are found in Eastern Darkon. Please get rid of at least 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas!
dialogsFail.br: Bem.. Eu não estou ficando mais jovem! As Leyenas são encontradas no leste de Darkon. Por favor, livre-se de pelo menos 20 Leyenas Pequenas e 10 Leyenas!
dialogsFail.cns: 我不再年轻了！高地猎犬可以在达肯东部找到。请除掉至少20个高地幼犬和10个高地猎犬！
dialogsFail.de: Und jetzt? Ich werde auch nicht jünger! Die Leyena sind im östlichen Darkon zu finden. Bitte werden Sie mindestens 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas!
dialogsFail.fi: Well? I'm not getting any younger! The Leyena are found in Eastern Darkon. Please get rid of at least 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas!
dialogsFail.fil: Well? I'm not getting any younger! The Leyena are found in Eastern Darkon. Please get rid of at least 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas!
dialogsFail.fr: Allez chasser 20 Jeunes Leyenas et 10 Leyenas à l'Est de Darkon.
dialogsFail.id: Saya tidak menjadi lebih muda! Leyena ditemukan di Darkon Timur. Harap singkirkan setidaknya 20 Small Leyenas dan 10 Leyenas!
dialogsFail.it: Well? I'm not getting any younger! The Leyena are found in Eastern Darkon. Please get rid of at least 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas!
dialogsFail.jp: レイーナはダーコンの東側に生息している。20個の小さなレエナと10個のレエナを倒してください。
dialogsFail.kr: 으음, 저도 언제까지나 젊지는 않거든요! 다콘 동부에 있는 작은 레이에나 20마리와 레이에나 10마리를 처치해 주세요!
dialogsFail.nl: Well? I'm not getting any younger! The Leyena are found in Eastern Darkon. Please get rid of at least 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas!
dialogsFail.pl: Well? I'm not getting any younger! The Leyena are found in Eastern Darkon. Please get rid of at least 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas!
dialogsFail.ru: Well? I'm not getting any younger! The Leyena are found in Eastern Darkon. Please get rid of at least 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas!
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Y bien? ¡No van a desaparecer solos! Las Leyenas se encuentran al Este de Darkon. ¡Deshazte de al menos 20 Leyenas Pequeñas y 10 Leyenas!
dialogsFail.sw: Well? I'm not getting any younger! The Leyena are found in Eastern Darkon. Please get rid of at least 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas!
dialogsFail.th: เยี่ยม ? ฉันยังไม่ได้รับเลย ! Leyena พบได้ใน Eastern Darkon โปรดกำจัด 20 Small Leyenas และ 10 Leyenas!
dialogsFail.tw: 好吧！我不再年輕了！血狼位於東得肯。請除掉至少 20 個小血狼和 10 個血狼！
dialogsFail.vi: Tốt chứ? Tôi không còn trẻ nữa! Loài Leyena được tìm thấy ở Eastern Darkon. Hãy loại bỏ ít nhất 20 Small Leyenas và 10 Leyenas!

name.jp: 至高の料理「ドリドリ寿司」

description.en: Collect 12 Doridoma Keratins and 5 Mushpang Secretion from Small Doridomas and Captain Mushpangs. Return to Sotta when you have the ingredients.
description.ar: Collect 12 Doridoma Keratins and 5 Mushpang Secretion from Small Doridomas and Captain Mushpangs. Return to Sotta when you have the ingredients.
description.br: Colete 12 Queratinas de Doridomas e 5 Secreções de Mushpangs. Você pode obtê-los das Doridomas Pequenas e dos Mushpangs Capitães. Retorne para Sotta quando conseguir os ingredientes.
description.cns: 那么请帮我找一些材料~ 材料是紫晶球12个和蘑菇孢子5个，据说小蓝纹海马和大嘭嘭菇身上可以找到！
description.de: Sammle 12 Doridoma-Keratine und 5 Mushpang-Sekret von Small Doridomas und Captain Mushpangs. Kehre zu Sotta zurück, wenn du die Zutaten hast.
description.fi: Collect 12 Doridoma Keratins and 5 Mushpang Secretion from Small Doridomas and Captain Mushpangs. Return to Sotta when you have the ingredients.
description.fil: Collect 12 Doridoma Keratins and 5 Mushpang Secretion from Small Doridomas and Captain Mushpangs. Return to Sotta when you have the ingredients.
description.fr: Collecter 12 Kératines et 5 Mushurines sur les Jeune Doridoma et les Capitaine Mushpang.
description.id: Kumpulkan 12 Doridoma Keratins dan 5 Mushpang Secretion dari Small Doridomas dan Captain Mushpangs. Kembali ke Sotta ketika kamu memiliki bahan-bahannya.
description.it: Collect 12 Doridoma Keratins and 5 Mushpang Secretion from Small Doridomas and Captain Mushpangs. Return to Sotta when you have the ingredients.
description.jp: 材料を集めてきましょう。ドリドマの殻12個とマシュリン液5個。スモール・ドリドマとキャプテン・マッシュファングから入手できます。
description.kr: 작은 도리도마와 두목 머쉬팡을 사냥해서, 도리도마 껍질 12개와 머쉬팡 육수 5개를 모으세요. 재료를 모두 모으면 소타에게 돌아가세요.
description.nl: Collect 12 Doridoma Keratins and 5 Mushpang Secretion from Small Doridomas and Captain Mushpangs. Return to Sotta when you have the ingredients.
description.pl: Collect 12 Doridoma Keratins and 5 Mushpang Secretion from Small Doridomas and Captain Mushpangs. Return to Sotta when you have the ingredients.
description.ru: Нужно принести Ррежу двенадцать копытец слабых коньков и пять мешочков грибного порошка сильных сыробежек.
description.sp: Reúne 12 Queratinas de Doridoma y 5 Secreciones de Mushpang de los Doridomas Pequeños y de los Mushpangs Capitanes. Regresa con Sotta cuando tengas los ingredientes.
description.sw: Collect 12 Doridoma Keratins and 5 Mushpang Secretion from Small Doridomas and Captain Mushpangs. Return to Sotta when you have the ingredients.
description.th: เก็บ Dorothoma Keratins 12 อัน และ Mushpang Secretion จำนวน 5 อันจาก Small Doridomas และ Captain Mushpangs แล้วกลับไปหา Sotta เมื่อคุณเก็บส่วนผสมครบแล้ว
description.tw: 那麼請幫我找一些材料~ 材料是多魯殼 12 個和慕雪林液 5 個，據說多魯嘍囉和全熟的咚咚菇身上可以找到！
description.vi: Thu thập 12 Doridoma Keratins và 5 Mushpang Secretion từ Small Doridomas và Captain Mushpangs. Quay lại Sotta khi bạn có đủ các nguyên liệu.

dialogsBegin.en: Finally! The time has come to learn how to make Doridori Sushi. I just need some ingredients!
dialogsBegin.ar: Finally! The time has come to learn how to make Doridori Sushi. I just need some ingredients!
dialogsBegin.br: Ha ha ha.. Finalmente chegou a hora de aprender como fazer Doridori Sushi depois de 15 anos de experiência em fazer sushi.
dialogsBegin.cns: "我15年的料理人生，终于有机会可以学习""综合多鲁寿司"" 的作法了！"
dialogsBegin.de: Endlich ist die Zeit gekommen, zu lernen wie man Doridoma Sushi zubereitet und das nach 15 Jahren Erfahrung im Sushi herstellen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Finally! The time has come to learn how to make Doridori Sushi. I just need some ingredients!
dialogsBegin.fil: Finally! The time has come to learn how to make Doridori Sushi. I just need some ingredients!
dialogsBegin.fr: Ha ha ha... Le moment est enfin venu de préparer des Doridori Sushis, après 15 années de dur apprentissage.
dialogsBegin.id: Akhirnya! Waktunya telah tiba untuk mempelajari cara membuat Doridori Sushi. Aku hanya butuh beberapa bahan!
dialogsBegin.it: Finally! The time has come to learn how to make Doridori Sushi. I just need some ingredients!
dialogsBegin.jp: 寿司職人の修行を始めて、苦節15年。至高の料理と呼ばれる＜ドリドリ寿司＞のにぎり方をついに！ついに伝授されることになった！
dialogsBegin.kr: 드디어! 도리도리 초밥 만드는 법을 배우는 날이 왔네. 이제 재료만 있으면 돼요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Finally! The time has come to learn how to make Doridori Sushi. I just need some ingredients!
dialogsBegin.pl: Finally! The time has come to learn how to make Doridori Sushi. I just need some ingredients!
dialogsBegin.ru: Настал знаменательный день! День, когда я решил взяться за суши "цок-цок". Осталось раздобыть всего пару ингредиентов.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Por fin! Ha llegado el momento de aprender a hacer Sushi Doridori. ¡Solo necesito algunos ingredientes!
dialogsBegin.sw: Finally! The time has come to learn how to make Doridori Sushi. I just need some ingredients!
dialogsBegin.th: ในที่สุด! ถึงเวลาแล้วที่จะเรียนรู้วิธีทำ Doridori Sushi สักที ฉันต้องการส่วนผสมบางอย่าง!
dialogsBegin.tw: 我 15 年的料理人生，終於有機會可以學習"綜合多魯壽司" 的作法了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Cuối cùng cũng tới! Đã đến lúc học cách làm Doridori Sushi. Tôi cần một số nguyên liệu!

dialogsBegin.en: I'll need to practice the recipe so that I can master it. Oh boy, Doridori Sushi is the best sushi in Madrigal! I can't wait!
dialogsBegin.ar: I'll need to practice the recipe so that I can master it. Oh boy, Doridori Sushi is the best sushi in Madrigal! I can't wait!
dialogsBegin.br: Mas preciso praticar sozinho antes de preparar. Então...
dialogsBegin.cns: 不过呢！这需要不间断的练习试做才行，所以，可不可以帮我…
dialogsBegin.de: Aber ich muss es selbst erst üben, daher..
dialogsBegin.fi: I'll need to practice the recipe so that I can master it. Oh boy, Doridori Sushi is the best sushi in Madrigal! I can't wait!
dialogsBegin.fil: I'll need to practice the recipe so that I can master it. Oh boy, Doridori Sushi is the best sushi in Madrigal! I can't wait!
dialogsBegin.fr: Mais je dois m'entraîner d'abord pour en préparer... Donc.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya perlu mempraktekkan resepnya agar saya bisa menguasainya. Astaga, Doridori Sushi adalah sushi terbaik di Madrigal! Saya tidak sabar!
dialogsBegin.it: I'll need to practice the recipe so that I can master it. Oh boy, Doridori Sushi is the best sushi in Madrigal! I can't wait!
dialogsBegin.jp: 失敗は絶対に許されねえ。しっかり練習しねえとな。そこであんたを見込んで、一つ頼みがある。
dialogsBegin.kr: 저는 계속 연습해서 레시피를 완벽하게 익혀야 해요. 도리도리 초밥은 마드리갈 최고의 초밥이거든요! 너무 기대되네요!
dialogsBegin.nl: I'll need to practice the recipe so that I can master it. Oh boy, Doridori Sushi is the best sushi in Madrigal! I can't wait!
dialogsBegin.pl: I'll need to practice the recipe so that I can master it. Oh boy, Doridori Sushi is the best sushi in Madrigal! I can't wait!
dialogsBegin.ru: Мне надо хорошенько потренироваться, чтобы не ударить в грязь лицом перед клиентами. Ведь "цок-цок" - самые лучшие суши во всем Мадригале!
dialogsBegin.sp: Tendré que practicar la receta para llegar a dominarla. ¡Bua, el Sushi Doridori es el mejor sushi de Madrigal! ¡No puedo esperar!
dialogsBegin.sw: I'll need to practice the recipe so that I can master it. Oh boy, Doridori Sushi is the best sushi in Madrigal! I can't wait!
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันต้องฝึกทำตามสูตรนี้เพื่อที่สักวันฉันจะได้ชำนาญในการทำมัน โอ้ เด็กน้อย Doridori เป็นซูชิที่ดีที่สุดใน Madrigal แล้ว! ฉันรอไม่ไหวแล้วล่ะ!
dialogsBegin.tw: 不過呢！這需要不間斷的練習試做才行，所以，可不可以幫我…
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi cần phải thực hành công thức mới có thể thành thạo. Ôi cậu bé, Doridori Sushi là món sushi ngon nhất ở Madrigal! Tôi không thể chờ đợi lâu hơn nữa!

dialogsBegin.en: Tell you what, if you help me, I will give you some of this fantastic sushi. How's that sound?
dialogsBegin.ar: Tell you what, if you help me, I will give you some of this fantastic sushi. How's that sound?
dialogsBegin.br: Então... Você poderia me ajudar, por favor? Se você me ajudar, eu lhe darei um delicioso sushi. O que você me diz?
dialogsBegin.cns: 我要再试做一次！如果你帮我的忙，我一定会做好吃的寿司给你，好不好？
dialogsBegin.de: Daher.. Könntest du mir bitte helfen? Wenn du mir hilfst, werde ich dir etwas von dem Sushi geben. Was sagst du dazu?
dialogsBegin.fi: Tell you what, if you help me, I will give you some of this fantastic sushi. How's that sound?
dialogsBegin.fil: Tell you what, if you help me, I will give you some of this fantastic sushi. How's that sound?
dialogsBegin.fr: Pourrais-tu me donner un coup de main ? Si tu m'aides, je te donnerai de ces succulents sushis. Alors qu'en dis tu ?
dialogsBegin.id: Katakan apa, jika kamu membantu saya, saya akan memberimu beberapa sushi yang fantastis ini. Bagaimana suara itu?
dialogsBegin.it: Tell you what, if you help me, I will give you some of this fantastic sushi. How's that sound?
dialogsBegin.jp: 練習の手伝いをして欲しいわけだが、どうだい？いっちょ俺に手を貸してくれねえか？うまい寿司をたらふく食わせてやるからよう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이렇게 하죠. 저를 도와주시면, 이 환상적인 초밥을 조금 나눠 드릴게요. 어때요, 괜찮죠?
dialogsBegin.nl: Tell you what, if you help me, I will give you some of this fantastic sushi. How's that sound?
dialogsBegin.pl: Tell you what, if you help me, I will give you some of this fantastic sushi. How's that sound?
dialogsBegin.ru: Послушай, если ты мне поможешь, я угощу тебя этим райским лакомством, этим объедением, этим неземным наслаждением! Соблазнительно, а?
dialogsBegin.sp: Si me ayudas, te daré un poco de este fantástico sushi. ¿Qué te parece?
dialogsBegin.sw: Tell you what, if you help me, I will give you some of this fantastic sushi. How's that sound?
dialogsBegin.th: จะบอกอะไรให้นะ ถ้าคุณช่วยฉัน ฉันจะให้ซูชิแสนอร่อยนี้ ฟังดูเป็นไงล่ะ?
dialogsBegin.tw: 我要再試做一次！如果你幫我的忙，我一定會做好吃的壽司給你，好不好？
dialogsBegin.vi: Để tôi cho bạn biết điều gì, nếu bạn giúp tôi, tôi sẽ cho bạn một số món sushi tuyệt vời này. Lời đề nghị đó thế nào?

dialogsAccept.en: I knew you wouldn't be able to resist! Now, bring me the following materials: 12 Doridoma Keratins and 5 Mushpang Secretion. You can get them from Small Doridomas and Captain Mushpangs.
dialogsAccept.ar: I knew you wouldn't be able to resist! Now, bring me the following materials: 12 Doridoma Keratins and 5 Mushpang Secretion. You can get them from Small Doridomas and Captain Mushpangs.
dialogsAccept.br: Eu sabia que você não resistiria! Agora, por favor me traga estes materiais: 12 Queratinas de Doridomas e 5 Secreções de Mushpangs. Você pode obtê-los de Doridomas Pequenas e Mushpang Capitães.
dialogsAccept.cns: 那么请帮我找一些实材，材料是紫晶球12个和蘑菇孢子5个，据说可以在小蓝纹海马和大嘭嘭菇身上找到…
dialogsAccept.de: Ich wusste, du würdest nicht widerstehen können! Bring mir jetzt die folgenden Materialien: 12 Doridoma-Keratine und 5 Mushpang-Sekret. Ihr könnt sie von Small-Doridomas und Capitän Mushpangs bekommen.
dialogsAccept.fi: I knew you wouldn't be able to resist! Now, bring me the following materials: 12 Doridoma Keratins and 5 Mushpang Secretion. You can get them from Small Doridomas and Captain Mushpangs.
dialogsAccept.fil: I knew you wouldn't be able to resist! Now, bring me the following materials: 12 Doridoma Keratins and 5 Mushpang Secretion. You can get them from Small Doridomas and Captain Mushpangs.
dialogsAccept.fr: Bien, il me faut les ingrédients suivants : 12 Kératines et 5 Mushurines. Tu devrais en trouver sur les Jeunes Doridoma et les Capitaines Mushpang.
dialogsAccept.id: Aku tahu kamu tidak akan bisa menolak! Sekarang, bawakan saya bahan-bahan berikut: 12 Doridoma Keratins dan 5 Mushpang Secretion. Kamu bisa mendapatkannya dari Small Doridomas dan Captain Mushpang.
dialogsAccept.it: I knew you wouldn't be able to resist! Now, bring me the following materials: 12 Doridoma Keratins and 5 Mushpang Secretion. You can get them from Small Doridomas and Captain Mushpangs.
dialogsAccept.jp: よっしゃあ！欲しいのは寿司のネタだ！ドリドマの殻を12個、マシュリン液を5個持ってきてくれ。スモール・ドリドマとキャプテン・マッシュファングからドロップするからよう。
dialogsAccept.kr: 역시 못 참으시겠죠? 좋아요, 재료가 필요한데요. 도리도마 껍질 12개, 머쉬팡 육수 5개예요. 작은 도리도마와 두목 머쉬팡을 사냥하면 얻을 수 있답니다.
dialogsAccept.nl: I knew you wouldn't be able to resist! Now, bring me the following materials: 12 Doridoma Keratins and 5 Mushpang Secretion. You can get them from Small Doridomas and Captain Mushpangs.
dialogsAccept.pl: I knew you wouldn't be able to resist! Now, bring me the following materials: 12 Doridoma Keratins and 5 Mushpang Secretion. You can get them from Small Doridomas and Captain Mushpangs.
dialogsAccept.ru: Так и знал, что ты не сможешь устоять! Тогда принеси мне вот что: двенадцать копытец слабых коньков и пять мешочков грибного порошка сильных сыробежек.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Sabía que no serías capaz de resistirte! Ahora, tráeme los siguientes materiales: 12 Queratinas de Doridoma y 5 Secreciones de Mushpang. Los puedes obtener de los Doridomas Pequeños y de los Mushpangs Capitanes.
dialogsAccept.sw: I knew you wouldn't be able to resist! Now, bring me the following materials: 12 Doridoma Keratins and 5 Mushpang Secretion. You can get them from Small Doridomas and Captain Mushpangs.
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันรู้ว่าคุณจะทนไม่ไหวหรอก! ตอนนี้นำวัตถุดิบต่อไปนี้มาให้ฉัน Dorothoma Keratins 12 อัน และ Mushpang Secretion 5 อัน คุณสามารถหาได้จาก Small Doridomas และ Captain Mushpangs
dialogsAccept.tw: 我就知道你無法抗拒！那麼現在請幫我找一些食材，材料是多魯殼 12 個和咚菇體液 5 個，據說可以在多魯嘍囉和全熟的咚咚菇身上找到…
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi biết bạn sẽ không thể cưỡng lại được đâu! Bây giờ, hãy mang cho tôi những nguyên liệu sau: 12 Doridoma Keratins và 5 Mushpang Secretion. Bạn có thể lấy chúng từ Small Doridomas và Captain Mushpangs.

dialogsDecline.en: You have no idea how delicious my sushi is. Oh well. Your loss!
dialogsDecline.ar: You have no idea how delicious my sushi is. Oh well. Your loss!
dialogsDecline.br: Você não faz ideia de como o meu sushi é delicioso. Se você não puder trazer tudo o que eu pedi, você vai se arrepender.
dialogsDecline.cns: 你没尝试过我亲自做的料理，真都不愿意试看看吗？真的太可惜了！
dialogsDecline.de: Du hast keine Ahnung wie lecker mein Sushi ist. Wenn du mir nicht alle benötigten Zutaten bringen kannst, wirst du es bereuen.
dialogsDecline.fi: You have no idea how delicious my sushi is. Oh well. Your loss!
dialogsDecline.fil: You have no idea how delicious my sushi is. Oh well. Your loss!
dialogsDecline.fr: Tu n'as pas idée à quel point mes sushis sont délicieux. Si tu ne peux pas ramener tout ce dont j'ai besoin, tu vas rater un met exceptionnel !
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu tidak tahu betapa lezatnya sushi saya. Baiklah. Kerugianmu!
dialogsDecline.it: You have no idea how delicious my sushi is. Oh well. Your loss!
dialogsDecline.jp: おいおい。俺の寿司を食いたくないのかよ？
dialogsDecline.kr: 제 초밥이 얼마나 맛있는지 모르시죠? 뭐, 어쩔 수 없네요. 손해 보시는 거라고요!
dialogsDecline.nl: You have no idea how delicious my sushi is. Oh well. Your loss!
dialogsDecline.pl: You have no idea how delicious my sushi is. Oh well. Your loss!
dialogsDecline.ru: Ты отказываешься от лучших суши в мире? Смотри, всю жизнь жалеть будешь!
dialogsDecline.sp: Oh, bueno. No tienes idea de lo rico que está mi sushi. ¡Tú te lo pierdes!
dialogsDecline.sw: You have no idea how delicious my sushi is. Oh well. Your loss!
dialogsDecline.th: คุณไม่มีทางรู้หรอกว่าซูชิที่แสนอร่อยนั้นเป็นยังไง ฮะฮ่า คุณพลาดแล้วล่ะ!
dialogsDecline.tw: 你沒嘗試過我親自做的料理，真都不願意試看看嗎？真的太可惜了！
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn không biết món sushi của tôi ngon như thế nào ư. Ồ, ồ tốt thôi. Thật là sự thiếu sót của bạn!

dialogsComplete.en: Ah ha! There we go! Your order is ready! I even autographed it in wasabi! Careful, it's SPICY!
dialogsComplete.ar: Ah ha! There we go! Your order is ready! I even autographed it in wasabi! Careful, it's SPICY!
dialogsComplete.br: Ah ha! Aqui está! Seu pedido está pronto! Eu até autografei com wasabi! Cuidado, é PICANTE!

dialogsBegin.en: What, you thought that was it? Oh no, I have plenty more for you to do, champ!

dialogsDecline.ar: Don't want to do it, eh? You kill hundreds of small animals and you're going to preach to me about ethics?

dialogsDecline.th: ไม่อยากทำเหรอ? คุณฆ่าสัตว์เล็กๆ หลายร้อยตัวและคุณจะสั่งสอนฉันเกี่ยวกับจริยธรรมงั้นหรือ?

dialogsBegin.en: Mule wants you to collect Tarin roots so he can make a new magic quill. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.ar: Mule wants you to collect Tarin roots so he can make a new magic quill. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.br: Mule quer que você colete Raízes de Tarin para que ele possa fazer uma nova pena mágica. Você poderia ajudar?
dialogsBegin.cns: 穆勒为了写一本小说，所以需要一支魔法笔，他委托本中心去收集“塔林根茎”，您要接受吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Mule möchte, dass du Tarin Roots sammelst, damit er einen neuen magischen Federkiel herstellen kann. Wirst du ihm helfen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Mule wants you to collect Tarin roots so he can make a new magic quill. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.fil: Kailangan ni Mule na kolektahin mo ang Tarin roots para makagawa siya ng bagong magic quill. Tutulungan mo ba?
dialogsBegin.fr: Mule recherche des Racines de Tarin pour fabriquer de nouveaux crayons magiques. Acceptes-tu cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Mule ingin kamu mengumpulkan Tarin Roots agar dia dapat membuat Magic Quill yang baru. Bisakah kamu membantunya?
dialogsBegin.it: Mule wants you to collect Tarin roots so he can make a new magic quill. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.jp: ミュールが新しい小説を書くための魔法のペン「タブラン」の材料であるタリンの根を探しています。依頼を受けますか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 뮬이 새로운 마법 깃펜을 만들기 위해 타린 뿌리를 구해 달라고 부탁합니다. 도와주실 수 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Mule wants you to collect Tarin roots so he can make a new magic quill. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.pl: Mule wants you to collect Tarin roots so he can make a new magic quill. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.ru: Так-так… 'Мулю нужен корень крыжорника, чтобы приготовить чернила.'  Подходит?
dialogsBegin.sp: Mule quiere que consigas Raíces Tarin para poder hacer una nueva pluma mágica. ¿Le ayudarás?
dialogsBegin.sw: Mule wants you to collect Tarin roots so he can make a new magic quill. Will you help?
dialogsBegin.th: Mule ต้องการให้คุณรวบรวมราก Tarin เพื่อให้เขาสามารถสร้างปากกาวิเศษใหม่ได้ คุณจะช่วยไหม
dialogsBegin.tw: 謬為了寫一本小說，所以需要一支魔法筆，他委託本中心去收集『蜥蜴草根』，你要接受嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Mule muốn bạn thu thập rễ cây Tarin để anh ta có thể làm một cây bút ma thuật mới. Bạn sẽ giúp chứ?
