dialogsBegin.en: It appears as if I must again call upon you for a favor. We have reports of a missing child, but unfortunately our guards are too occupied to help.
dialogsBegin.ar: It appears as if I must again call upon you for a favor. We have reports of a missing child, but unfortunately our guards are too occupied to help.
dialogsBegin.br: Parece que devo pedir um favor novamente a você. Temos relatos de uma criança desaparecida, mas infelizmente nossos guardas estão muito ocupados com as invasões de Masquerpets e não sobra tempo para ajudar.
dialogsBegin.cns: 看来我还需要再请你帮我个忙。我们得到通报说一个孩子走丢了，但是很不幸的是我们的守卫没办法分出人手去帮忙。
dialogsBegin.de: Es scheint, als müsste ich Sie erneut um einen Gefallen bitten. Wir haben Berichte über ein vermisstes Kind, aber leider sind unsere Wachen zu beschäftigt, um zu helfen.
dialogsBegin.fi: It appears as if I must again call upon you for a favor. We have reports of a missing child, but unfortunately our guards are too occupied to help.
dialogsBegin.fil: It appears as if I must again call upon you for a favor. We have reports of a missing child, but unfortunately our guards are too occupied to help.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il nous faut maintenant résoudre un autre problème. Un de mes jeunes citoyens était parti cueillir des champignons mais il n'est pas revenu…
dialogsBegin.id: Sepertinya aku harus meminta bantuanmu lagi. Kami memiliki laporan tentang seorang anak yang hilang, tetapi sayangnya penjaga kami terlalu sibuk untuk membantu.
dialogsBegin.it: It appears as if I must again call upon you for a favor. We have reports of a missing child, but unfortunately our guards are too occupied to help.
dialogsBegin.jp: 実はもう一つお願いがあります。最近自警団はモンスターの討伐ばかりでなかなか住民の依頼を聞くことができないのです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 또 부탁할 일이 있습니다. 실종 아동에 대한 제보가 들어왔는데, 지금 경비대가 다른 일로 모두 바빠서요.
dialogsBegin.nl: It appears as if I must again call upon you for a favor. We have reports of a missing child, but unfortunately our guards are too occupied to help.
dialogsBegin.pl: It appears as if I must again call upon you for a favor. We have reports of a missing child, but unfortunately our guards are too occupied to help.
dialogsBegin.ru: Похоже, мне снова придётся просить тебя о помощи. Мне сообщили о пропавшем ребёнке, но охрана ещё слишком ослаблена борьбой с марионетками.
dialogsBegin.sp: Parece que tengo que llamarte de nuevo para pedirte un favor. Tenemos informes de un niño desaparecido, pero desafortunadamente nuestros guardias están demasiado ocupados para ayudar.
dialogsBegin.sw: It appears as if I must again call upon you for a favor. We have reports of a missing child, but unfortunately our guards are too occupied to help.
dialogsBegin.th: ดูเหมือนว่าข้าจะต้องร้องขอความช่วยเหลือจากท่านอีกครั้ง เรามีรายงานเด็กหาย แต่น่าเสียดายที่ยามของเราไม่ว่างที่จะช่วยเหลือ
dialogsBegin.tw: 看來我必須再次請你幫忙。我們有一個孩子失蹤的報告，但不幸的是我們的守衛太忙了，無法提供幫助。
dialogsBegin.vi: Có vẻ như tôi phải kêu gọi bạn một lần nữa cho một ân huệ. Chúng tôi có báo cáo về một đứa trẻ mất tích, nhưng không may là lính canh của chúng tôi quá bận rộn để giúp đỡ.

dialogsBegin.en: The boy, named Nerco, apparently left a note to his mother saying he wanted to defeat monsters just like the Hero of Flaris! For his sake, please find and protect him!
dialogsBegin.ar: The boy, named Nerco, apparently left a note to his mother saying he wanted to defeat monsters just like the Hero of Flaris! For his sake, please find and protect him!
dialogsBegin.br: É um garoto, chamado Nerco, aparentemente deixou um bilhete para sua mãe dizendo que queria derrotar monstros como o Herói de Flaris! Para o bem dele, por favor, encontre e proteja-o!
dialogsBegin.cns: 这个孩子叫尼尔科，他给他的母亲留下了一张纸条，纸条上说他要像帕里的英雄一样去打败怪物！所以，请找到并保护他！
dialogsBegin.de: Der Junge namens Nerco hat seiner Mutter offenbar eine Nachricht hinterlassen, in der er sagt, dass er Monster besiegen will, genau wie der Held von Flaris! Um seinetwillen, bitte findet und beschützt ihn!
dialogsBegin.fi: The boy, named Nerco, apparently left a note to his mother saying he wanted to defeat monsters just like the Hero of Flaris! For his sake, please find and protect him!
dialogsBegin.fil: The boy, named Nerco, apparently left a note to his mother saying he wanted to defeat monsters just like the Hero of Flaris! For his sake, please find and protect him!
dialogsBegin.fr: Il se nomme Nerco et ses parents font un scandale pour que j'envoie une patrouille le chercher. Vous vous en sentez capable ?
dialogsBegin.id: Anak laki-laki bernama Nerco itu rupanya meninggalkan pesan kepada ibunya yang mengatakan bahwa dia ingin mengalahkan monster seperti Hero of Flaris! Tolong temukan dan lindungi dia!
dialogsBegin.it: The boy, named Nerco, apparently left a note to his mother saying he wanted to defeat monsters just like the Hero of Flaris! For his sake, please find and protect him!
dialogsBegin.jp: 村の悪ガキ……おほん。ネルコという子が森で迷子になってしまったようです。母親から捜索依頼が届いているのですがなかなか人手が割けない状態でして
dialogsBegin.kr: 네르코라는 꼬마가, 플라리스의 영웅처럼 괴물을 물리치고 싶다는 쪽지를 남기고 사라졌다고 하더군요. 그 아이를 꼭 찾아주세요!
dialogsBegin.nl: The boy, named Nerco, apparently left a note to his mother saying he wanted to defeat monsters just like the Hero of Flaris! For his sake, please find and protect him!
dialogsBegin.pl: The boy, named Nerco, apparently left a note to his mother saying he wanted to defeat monsters just like the Hero of Flaris! For his sake, please find and protect him!
dialogsBegin.ru: Мальчик Нерко оставил дома записку, в которой значилось, что он хочет сражаться с марионетками и стать героем! Похоже, его нужно срочно разыскать и защитить!
dialogsBegin.sp: El niño, llamado Nerco, aparentemente le dejó una nota a su madre diciendo que quería ¡derrotar a monstruos como el Héroe de Flaris! ¡Por su bien, encuéntralo y protégelo!
dialogsBegin.sw: The boy, named Nerco, apparently left a note to his mother saying he wanted to defeat monsters just like the Hero of Flaris! For his sake, please find and protect him!
dialogsBegin.th: เห็นได้ชัดว่าเด็กชายชื่อ Nerco ได้ทิ้งข้อความถึงแม่ของเขา โดยบอกว่าเขาต้องการเอาชนะมอนสเตอร์ เช่นเดียวกับ Hero of Flaris! เพื่อประโยชน์ของเขา โปรดค้นหาและปกป้องเขา!
dialogsBegin.tw: 這個男孩名叫尼羅可，顯然是給他媽媽留下了一張紙條，說他想像布拉里斯英雄一樣去打怪物！為了他，請幫忙找到他並保護他！
dialogsBegin.vi: Cậu bé Nerco dường như đã để lại lời nhắn cho mẹ rằng cậu muốn đánh bại những con quái vật giống như Anh hùng Flaris! Vì lợi ích của anh ấy, hãy tìm và bảo vệ anh ấy!

dialogsAccept.en: His mother believes him to be in Southern Saint Morning, attempting to take on the Mia by himself. Please protect him by defeating 10 Small Mia & 5 Mia.
dialogsAccept.ar: His mother believes him to be in Southern Saint Morning, attempting to take on the Mia by himself. Please protect him by defeating 10 Small Mia & 5 Mia.
dialogsAccept.br: A mãe de Nerco, acredita que ele está para o lado Sul de Saint Morning, tentando enfrentar as Mias sozinho. Por favor, proteja-o derrotando 10 Pequenas Mias e 5 Mias.
dialogsAccept.cns: 他母亲相信他正在晨光南部尝试独自对付米娅娃娃。请通过击杀10只粗布米娅娃娃和5只花布米娅娃娃来保护他。
dialogsAccept.de: Seine Mutter glaubt, dass er im südlichen Heiligen Morgen ist und versucht, die Mia alleine zu bekämpfen. Bitte beschütze ihn, indem du 10 Small Mia & 5 Mia besiegst.
dialogsAccept.fi: His mother believes him to be in Southern Saint Morning, attempting to take on the Mia by himself. Please protect him by defeating 10 Small Mia & 5 Mia.
dialogsAccept.fil: His mother believes him to be in Southern Saint Morning, attempting to take on the Mia by himself. Please protect him by defeating 10 Small Mia & 5 Mia.
dialogsAccept.fr: Selon des témoins il se dirigeait vers le territoire des Mia. Faisons d'une pierre deux coups et éliminez 10 Mia au passage.
dialogsAccept.id: Ibunya percaya dia berada di Southern Saint Morning, mencoba untuk melawan Mia sendiri. Tolong lindungi dia dengan mengalahkan 10 Small Mia & 5 Mia.
dialogsAccept.it: His mother believes him to be in Southern Saint Morning, attempting to take on the Mia by himself. Please protect him by defeating 10 Small Mia & 5 Mia.
dialogsAccept.jp: 母親の証言では、鬼の子を捕まえると言ってナイフを片手に森に行ったそうです。スモールミーア10個とミーア5個を倒して彼を守ってください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 애 엄마 말로는, 네르코가 혼자 미아를 상대해 보려고 세인트 모닝 남부로 간 것 같다고 하던데. 아이의 안전을 위해 작은 미아 10마리와 미아 5마리를 처치해 주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: His mother believes him to be in Southern Saint Morning, attempting to take on the Mia by himself. Please protect him by defeating 10 Small Mia & 5 Mia.
dialogsAccept.pl: His mother believes him to be in Southern Saint Morning, attempting to take on the Mia by himself. Please protect him by defeating 10 Small Mia & 5 Mia.
dialogsAccept.ru: His mother believes him to be in Southern Saint Morning, attempting to take on the Mia by himself. Please protect him by defeating 10 Small Mia & 5 Mia.
dialogsAccept.sp: Su madre cree que él está al Sur de Saint, intentando enfrentarse a las Mias él solo. Protégelo derrotando a 10 Mias Pequeñas y a 5 Mias.
dialogsAccept.sw: His mother believes him to be in Southern Saint Morning, attempting to take on the Mia by himself. Please protect him by defeating 10 Small Mia & 5 Mia.
dialogsAccept.th: แม่ของเขาเชื่อว่าเขาอยู่ทางตอนใต้ของ Saint Morning โดยพยายามจะจัดการกับ Mia ด้วยตัวเอง โปรดปกป้องเขาด้วยการเอาชนะ Small Mia 10 ตัว & 5 Mia
dialogsAccept.tw: 他的母親認為他人在南聖音特，正試圖獨自對付米兒。請擊敗 10 隻米兒妹妹與 5 隻米兒，保護他的安全。
dialogsAccept.vi: Mẹ anh tin rằng anh đang ở phía Nam Saint Morning, cố gắng tự mình đảm nhận Mia. Hãy bảo vệ anh ta bằng cách đánh bại 10 Mia nhỏ & 5 Mia.

dialogsDecline.en: What? Why am I asking you to find just a KID? Kids are the future of Madrigal. You have a bad mental attitude.
dialogsDecline.ar: What? Why am I asking you to find just a KID? Kids are the future of Madrigal. You have a bad mental attitude.
dialogsDecline.br: Que? Por que estou pedindo para você encontrar apenas uma CRIANÇA? As crianças são o futuro de Madrigal. Você tem uma atitude mental ruim.
dialogsDecline.cns: 什么？为什么我仅仅让你去找一个孩子？孩子们可是瑞加大陆的未来啊，你现在的心理想法很不健康
dialogsDecline.de: Wie bitte? Warum bitte ich Sie, nur ein KID zu finden? Kinder sind die Zukunft von Madrigal. Du hast eine schlechte mentale Einstellung.
dialogsDecline.fi: What? Why am I asking you to find just a KID? Kids are the future of Madrigal. You have a bad mental attitude.
dialogsDecline.fil: What? Why am I asking you to find just a KID? Kids are the future of Madrigal. You have a bad mental attitude.
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous pensez que l'enfant perdu mérite son destin ? Vous êtes un monstre !
dialogsDecline.id: Apa? Mengapa aku memintamu untuk mencari ANAK KECIL? Itu karena mereka adalah masa depan Madrigal. Kamu memiliki sikap mental yang buruk.
dialogsDecline.it: What? Why am I asking you to find just a KID? Kids are the future of Madrigal. You have a bad mental attitude.
dialogsDecline.jp: そうですか……こんな依頼は英雄の貴方には失礼でしたね。
dialogsDecline.kr: 뭐라고요? 겨우 아이 하나 찾으라는 거냐고요? 아이들은 마드리갈의 미래랍니다. 그런 사고방식은 좋지 않아요.
dialogsDecline.nl: What? Why am I asking you to find just a KID? Kids are the future of Madrigal. You have a bad mental attitude.
dialogsDecline.pl: What? Why am I asking you to find just a KID? Kids are the future of Madrigal. You have a bad mental attitude.
dialogsDecline.ru: What? Why am I asking you to find just a KID? Kids are the future of Madrigal. You have a bad mental attitude.
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Qué? ¿Por qué te pido que busques a un NIÑO? Los niños son el futuro de Madrigal. Tienes una mala actitud mental.
dialogsDecline.sw: What? Why am I asking you to find just a KID? Kids are the future of Madrigal. You have a bad mental attitude.
dialogsDecline.th: อะไร ทำไมฉันขอให้คุณหา? เด็กคืออนาคตของมาดริกัล คุณมีทัศนคติที่ไม่ดี
dialogsDecline.tw: 什麼？為什麼我要你只找一個孩子？孩子是瑪德利賈的未來。你這樣的心態不好喔！
dialogsDecline.vi: Gì? Tại sao tôi yêu cầu bạn chỉ tìm một KID? Trẻ em là tương lai của Madrigal. Bạn có một thái độ tinh thần không tốt.

dialogsComplete.en: Tremble ghosts, for I am the mightiest warrior in the… wait, who are you? You are interrupting my ghost slaying!
dialogsComplete.ar: Tremble ghosts, for I am the mightiest warrior in the… wait, who are you? You are interrupting my ghost slaying!
dialogsComplete.br: Estremeçam fantasmas, pois sou o guerreiro mais poderoso do m... ei, quem é você?? Você está interrompendo minha caça aos fantasmas!

dialogsComplete.fil: Tremble ghosts, for I am the mightiest warrior in the… wait, who are you? You are interrupting my ghost slaying!
dialogsComplete.fr: Vous m'avez fait peur !!
dialogsComplete.id: Gemetarlah kalian para hantu, karena aku prajurit terkuat di... tunggu, siapa kamu?? Hei, kamu mengganggu kegiatan pembasmian hantuku!

dialogsComplete.jp: この！　鬼の子め、かかってこい！ちょっと、私の邪魔をしている、あなたは誰ですか？
dialogsComplete.kr: 두려워해라, 유령들아! 나는 바로 강력한 전사… 어? 누구세요? 유령 처치 중이니 방해하지 마세요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Tremble ghosts, for I am the mightiest warrior in the… wait, who are you? You are interrupting my ghost slaying!

dialogsComplete.sp: Temblad fantasmas, porque soy el guerrero más poderoso del... espera, ¿quién eres? ¡Estás interrumpiendo mi matanza de fantasmas!
dialogsComplete.sw: Tremble ghosts, for I am the mightiest warrior in the… wait, who are you? You are interrupting my ghost slaying!
dialogsComplete.th: จงสั่นสะท้านเถิดเหล่าวิญญาณ เพราะข้าคือยอดนักรบผู้ยิ่งใหญ่ที่สุดใน... เดี๋ยวก่อน คุณเป็นใคร? คุณกำลังขัดจังหวะการปราบผีของข้า!
dialogsComplete.tw: 顫抖吧，幽靈們！因為我是最強大的戰……等等，你是誰？你打擾我獵鬼了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Hãy run sợ đi, những bóng ma kia, vì ta là chiến binh dũng mãnh nhất… khoan đã, bạn là ai ?? Bạn đang làm gián đoạn việc diệt trừ tà ma của tôi!

dialogsBegin.en: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.ar: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.br: O seu Karma pode ser resgatado. Você está preparado(a) para pagar pelos seus pecados?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你的罪恶可以被赎回。 你准备好为你的罪付出代价了吗？
dialogsBegin.de: Dein schlechtes Karma kann dir erlassen werden. Bist du bereit, um für deine Sünden zu bezahlen?
dialogsBegin.fi: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang iyong karma ay pwedeng maligtas. Handa kanaba bayaran ang iyong mga kasalanan?
dialogsBegin.fr: Il existe une quête afin d'expier tes crimes. Souhaites-tu effectuer cette quête ?
dialogsBegin.id: Karmamu bisa ditukarkan. Apakah kamu siap membayar untuk dosa-dosamu?
dialogsBegin.it: Il vostro Karma può essere riscattato. Siete pronti a pagare per i vostri peccati?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは罪を償うために、試練を受けなければなりません。この試練を乗り越え、罪を購うお気持ちがありますか？？
dialogsBegin.kr: 너의 카르마를 줄이기 위한 과제가 준비되어 있다. 과제를 하겠는가?
dialogsBegin.nl: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.pl: Twoja Karma może być odzyskana. Czy jesteś gotowy zapłacić za swoje grzechy?
dialogsBegin.ru: Хочешь искупить грехи и очистить карму?
dialogsBegin.sp: Tu Karma puede ser redimido. ¿Estás listo para pagar por tus pecados?
dialogsBegin.sw: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsBegin.th: ค่า Karma ของคุณสามารถนำมาแลกได้ พร้อมที่ชดใช้บาปของคุณรึยัง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的紅人狀態可以被贖回，你準備好為你的罪付出代價了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Karma của bạn có thể được mua lại. Bạn đã sẵn sàng trả giá cho tội lỗi của mình chưa?

dialogsFail.en: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.ar: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.br: Se você não está realmente interessado(a) em lutar por perdão, então não resta nenhuma esperança para você.
dialogsFail.cns: 不想赎罪？那你真的无可救药了
dialogsFail.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung wenn du nicht willens bist, für Vergebung zu kämpfen.
dialogsFail.fi: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.fil: Kung ikaw ay ayaw mo lumaban para sa kapatawaran, wala nang pag asa para sa iyo.
dialogsFail.fr: Si tu n'es pas dans la bonne condition d'esprit pour expier tes péchés, cette quête sera vaine.
dialogsFail.id: Jika kamu benar-benar tidak mau berjuang untuk pengampunan, maka tidak ada harapan bagi kamu.
dialogsFail.it: Se sei riluttante a lottare per il perdono, allora non c'è speranza per te.
dialogsFail.jp: 罪を償う意志がないのなら、この試練も意味をなさないのですよ。
dialogsFail.kr: 죄를 씻고자 싸울 의지가 없다면, 당신에겐 희망이 없네요.
dialogsFail.nl: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.pl: Jeśli jesteś naprawdę niechętny żeby walczyć o wybaczenie, nie ma dla ciebie nadziei.
dialogsFail.ru: Прощение само не придет. Его нужно заслужить.
dialogsFail.sp: Si no estás dispuesto a luchar por el perdón, no hay esperanza para ti.
dialogsFail.sw: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.
dialogsFail.th: ถ้าคุณไม่เต็มใจจะสู้ เพื่อให้ได้รับการให้อภัย เช่นนั้นก็ไม่มีความหวังสำหรับคุณ
dialogsFail.tw: 如果你真的不願意為寬恕而戰，那麼你就沒有希望了。
dialogsFail.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự không muốn đấu tranh để được tha thứ, thì không có hy vọng cho bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: From the information we have available, the remnant of Ishirut hides in the very heart of the catacombs.
dialogsBegin.ar: From the information we have available, the remnant of Ishirut hides in the very heart of the catacombs.
dialogsBegin.br: De acordo com as informações disponíveis, o resquício de Ishirut se esconde no próprio coração das catacumbas.
dialogsBegin.cns: From the information we have available, the remnant of Ishirut hides in the very heart of the catacombs.
dialogsBegin.de: Nach den uns vorliegenden Informationen verbirgt sich die Überreste von Ishirut im Herzen der Katakomben.
dialogsBegin.fi: From the information we have available, the remnant of Ishirut hides in the very heart of the catacombs.
dialogsBegin.fil: From the information we have available, the remnant of Ishirut hides in the very heart of the catacombs.
dialogsBegin.fr: D'après les informations dont nous disposons, les vestiges d'Ishirut se cachent au cœur même des catacombes.
dialogsBegin.id: Dari informasi yang kami miliki, sisa-sisa Ishirut bersembunyi di jantung catacomb.
dialogsBegin.it: From the information we have available, the remnant of Ishirut hides in the very heart of the catacombs.
dialogsBegin.jp: 私たちが入手した情報から、イシルトの残骸はカタコンベのまさに中心に隠れています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 입수한 정보로는, 지하 묘지 한가운데 이실루트의 추종 세력이 숨어 있다고 하는군요.
dialogsBegin.nl: From the information we have available, the remnant of Ishirut hides in the very heart of the catacombs.
dialogsBegin.pl: From the information we have available, the remnant of Ishirut hides in the very heart of the catacombs.
dialogsBegin.ru: From the information we have available, the remnant of Ishirut hides in the very heart of the catacombs.
dialogsBegin.sp: Por la información de que disponemos, el vestigio de Ishirut se esconde en el corazón mismo de las catacumbas.
dialogsBegin.sw: From the information we have available, the remnant of Ishirut hides in the very heart of the catacombs.
dialogsBegin.th: จากข้อมูลเท่าที่เรามี เศษเสี้ยวของ Ishirut นั้นอยู่ตรงใจกลางของสุสาน
dialogsBegin.tw: 根據目前掌握的資訊，伊希魯特的殘響就藏在地下墓穴最深處。
dialogsBegin.vi: Từ những thông tin chúng tôi có được, remnant of Ishirut ẩn náu trong chính trung tâm của catacombs.

dialogsAccept.en: You have already made it further than the last group, keep pushing and find out what lies in store.
dialogsAccept.ar: You have already made it further than the last group, keep pushing and find out what lies in store.
dialogsAccept.br: Você já avançou mais do que o último grupo, continue avançando e descubra o que aguarda adiante.
dialogsAccept.cns: You have already made it further than the last group, keep pushing and find out what lies in store.
dialogsAccept.de: Du hast es schon weiter geschafft als die letzte Gruppe, mach weiter und finde heraus, was dich erwartet.
dialogsAccept.fi: You have already made it further than the last group, keep pushing and find out what lies in store.
dialogsAccept.fil: You have already made it further than the last group, keep pushing and find out what lies in store.
dialogsAccept.fr: Vous êtes déjà allé plus loin que le dernier groupe, continuez à pousser et découvrez ce qui vous attend.
dialogsAccept.id: Anda telah berhasil lebih jauh dari grup terakhir, teruslah mendorong dan cari tahu apa yang ada di toko.
dialogsAccept.it: You have already made it further than the last group, keep pushing and find out what lies in store.
dialogsAccept.jp: あなたはすでに最後のグループよりも進んでいます、プッシュし続けて、何が待ち受けているかを見つけてください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 이미 마지막 그룹보다도 더 멀리 와버렸으니, 계속 나가서 뭐가 있는지 알아보자고요.
dialogsAccept.nl: You have already made it further than the last group, keep pushing and find out what lies in store.
dialogsAccept.pl: You have already made it further than the last group, keep pushing and find out what lies in store.
dialogsAccept.ru: You have already made it further than the last group, keep pushing and find out what lies in store.
dialogsAccept.sp: Ya has llegado más lejos que el último grupo, sigue empujando y descubre lo que te espera.
dialogsAccept.sw: You have already made it further than the last group, keep pushing and find out what lies in store.
dialogsAccept.th: คุณได้เข้ามาไกลกว่ากลุ่มล่าสุดแล้ว พยายามเข้าไปให้ลึกยิ่งขึ้นและดูว่ามีอะไรรอคุณอยุ่ข้างใน
dialogsAccept.tw: 你已經比上一批人走得更遠了，繼續前進，看看前方究竟還有什麼。
dialogsAccept.vi: Bạn đã tiến xa hơn nhóm cuối cùng, hãy tiếp tục thúc đẩy và tìm hiểu xem điều gì đang chờ đợi bạn.

dialogsDecline.en: You've made it so far... why give up now?
dialogsDecline.ar: You've made it so far... why give up now?
dialogsDecline.br: Você chegou tão longe... por que desistir agora?
dialogsDecline.cns: You've made it so far... why give up now?
dialogsDecline.de: Du hast es so weit geschafft, warum jetzt aufgeben?
dialogsDecline.fi: You've made it so far... why give up now?
dialogsDecline.fil: You've made it so far... why give up now?
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous êtes arrivé jusqu'ici, pourquoi abandonner maintenant ?
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu telah berhasil sejauh ini.. mengapa menyerah sekarang?
dialogsDecline.it: You've made it so far... why give up now?
dialogsDecline.jp: あなたはここまでそれを成し遂げました..なぜ今あきらめるのですか?
dialogsDecline.kr: 여기까지 왔는데... 왜 지금 포기해요?
dialogsDecline.nl: You've made it so far... why give up now?
dialogsDecline.pl: You've made it so far... why give up now?
dialogsDecline.ru: You've made it so far... why give up now?
dialogsDecline.sp: Has llegado hasta aquí... ¿Por qué rendirte ahora?
dialogsDecline.sw: You've made it so far... why give up now?
dialogsDecline.th: คุณมาไกลขนาดนี้แล้ว ทำถึงยอมแพ้ซะตอนนี้ล่ะ?
dialogsDecline.tw: 你都已經走到這一步了……現在為什麼要放棄？
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn đã đi xa đến mức này...sao bây giờ lại từ bỏ?

dialogsComplete.en: Fascinating! The bark from the large tree creature seems to have the symbol of Shelid etched on the surface... Does this mean that the catacombs were originally an altar to Shelid themself?
dialogsComplete.ar: Fascinating! The bark from the large tree creature seems to have the symbol of Shelid etched on the surface... Does this mean that the catacombs were originally an altar to Shelid themself?
dialogsComplete.br: Fascinante! A casca da criatura arbórea tem o símbolo de Shelid gravado em sua superfície... Será que isso significa que as catacumbas eram originalmente um altar dedicado a Shelid?
dialogsComplete.cns: Fascinating! The bark from the large tree creature seems to have the symbol of Shelid etched on the surface... Does this mean that the catacombs were originally an altar to Shelid themself?
dialogsComplete.de: Faszinierend! In der Rinde der großen Baumkreatur scheint das Symbol Shelids auf der Oberfläche eingeritzt zu sein...Bedeutet das, dass die Katabomben ursprünglich ein Altar von Shelid selbst waren?
dialogsComplete.fi: Fascinating! The bark from the large tree creature seems to have the symbol of Shelid etched on the surface... Does this mean that the catacombs were originally an altar to Shelid themself?
dialogsComplete.fil: Fascinating! The bark from the large tree creature seems to have the symbol of Shelid etched on the surface... Does this mean that the catacombs were originally an altar to Shelid themself?
dialogsComplete.fr: Fascinant ! L'écorce de la grande créature arboricole semble porter le symbole de Shelid gravé à la surface... Cela signifie-t-il que les catacombes étaient à l'origine un autel à Shelid lui-même ?
dialogsComplete.id: Memukau! Kulit kayu dari makhluk pohon besar tampaknya memiliki simbol Shelid terukir di permukaannya.. Apakah ini berarti bahwa catacombs pada awalnya adalah altar untuk Shelid itu sendiri?
dialogsComplete.it: Fascinating! The bark from the large tree creature seems to have the symbol of Shelid etched on the surface... Does this mean that the catacombs were originally an altar to Shelid themself?
dialogsComplete.jp: 大きな木の生き物の樹皮は、表面にシェリッドのシンボルが刻まれているようです。これは、カタコンベがもともとシェリッド自身の祭壇であったことを意味しますか?
dialogsComplete.kr: 흥미로운데요! 커다란 나무 생명체 껍질에 셸리드의 상징이 새겨져 있는 것 같아요... 지하 묘지가 원래 셸리드의 제단이었다는 뜻일까요?
dialogsComplete.nl: Fascinating! The bark from the large tree creature seems to have the symbol of Shelid etched on the surface... Does this mean that the catacombs were originally an altar to Shelid themself?
dialogsComplete.pl: Fascinating! The bark from the large tree creature seems to have the symbol of Shelid etched on the surface... Does this mean that the catacombs were originally an altar to Shelid themself?
dialogsComplete.ru: Fascinating! The bark from the large tree creature seems to have the symbol of Shelid etched on the surface... Does this mean that the catacombs were originally an altar to Shelid themself?
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Fascinante! La corteza de la gran criatura arbórea parece tener el símbolo de Shelid grabado en la superficie.. ¿Significa esto que las catacumbas eran originalmente un altar al propio Shelid?
dialogsComplete.sw: Fascinating! The bark from the large tree creature seems to have the symbol of Shelid etched on the surface... Does this mean that the catacombs were originally an altar to Shelid themself?
dialogsComplete.th: งดงามนัก! เปลือกไม้จากมอนสเตอร์ต้นไม้ดูเหมือนจะมีสัญลักษณ์ของ Shelid สลักอยู่บนผิวด้วย นี่หมายความว่าตัวสุสานเองในตอนแรกเคยเป็นแท่นบูชาของ Shelid รึเปล่า?
dialogsComplete.tw: 真令人著迷！那頭巨大樹木怪身上的樹皮表面，竟然刻著謝莉德的象徵……這是否代表地下墓穴原本其實是獻給謝莉德的祭壇？
dialogsComplete.vi: Thật thú vị! Vỏ của sinh vật cây lớn dường như có khắc biểu tượng của Shelid trên bề mặt.. Điều này có nghĩa là hầm mộ ban đầu thật ra là một bàn thờ cho chính Shelid?

dialogsFail.tw: 繼續深入調查地下墓穴，裡面還有更多東西值得一看。

dialogsBegin.en: Those who call Coral Island their home have been unable to explore the world due to a curse placed on the island many years ago.
dialogsBegin.ar: Those who call Coral Island their home have been unable to explore the world due to a curse placed on the island many years ago.
dialogsBegin.br: Aqueles que chamam a Ilha de Coral de lar não puderam explorar o mundo devido a uma maldição colocada na ilha muitos anos atrás.
dialogsBegin.cns: 多年前，这座岛屿被施加了诅咒，因此定居在珊瑚岛的人们始终无法前往外界探险。
dialogsBegin.de: Diejenigen, die die Koralleninsel ihr Zuhause nennen, waren aufgrund eines Fluchs, der vor vielen Jahren auf der Insel lastete, nicht in der Lage, die Welt zu erkunden.
dialogsBegin.fi: Those who call Coral Island their home have been unable to explore the world due to a curse placed on the island many years ago.
dialogsBegin.fil: Those who call Coral Island their home have been unable to explore the world due to a curse placed on the island many years ago.
dialogsBegin.fr: Ceux qui désormais font de l'Île Corail leur maison n'ont pas pu explorer le monde en raison d'une malédiction jetée sur l'île il y a de nombreuses années.
dialogsBegin.id: Mereka yang menyebut Coral Island sebagai rumah mereka tidak dapat menjelajahi dunia karena kutukan yang menimpa pulau tersebut beberapa tahun yang lalu.
dialogsBegin.it: Those who call Coral Island their home have been unable to explore the world due to a curse placed on the island many years ago.
dialogsBegin.jp: 珊瑚島を故郷と呼ぶ人々は、何年も前に島にかけられた呪いのために世界を探検することができませんでした。
dialogsBegin.kr: 코랄 아일랜드를 고향으로 두고 있는 사람들은, 오래전 섬에 걸린 저주 때문에 세상을 돌아다닐 수 없게 되었어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Those who call Coral Island their home have been unable to explore the world due to a curse placed on the island many years ago.
dialogsBegin.pl: Those who call Coral Island their home have been unable to explore the world due to a curse placed on the island many years ago.
dialogsBegin.ru: Those who call Coral Island their home have been unable to explore the world due to a curse placed on the island many years ago.
dialogsBegin.sp: Aquellos que llaman a Isla Coral su hogar no han podido debido a una maldición colocada en la isla hace muchos años.
dialogsBegin.sw: Those who call Coral Island their home have been unable to explore the world due to a curse placed on the island many years ago.
dialogsBegin.th: ผู้ที่เรียก Coral Island เป็นบ้านของตนเองนั้นไม่สามารถออกไปสำรวจโลกได้ เนื่องจากคำสาปที่ถูกวางไว้บนเกาะแห่งนี้เมื่อหลายปีก่อน
dialogsBegin.tw: 把珊瑚島視為家園的人們，因為多年前施加在島上的詛咒，一直無法探索外面的世界。
dialogsBegin.vi: Những người gọi Coral Island là nhà của họ đã không thể khám phá thế giới do lời nguyền bị đặt lên hòn đảo này nhiều năm trước.

dialogsBegin.en: The cause of the cursed mist that has kept the Coral Island inhabitants trapped is unknown.
dialogsBegin.ar: The cause of the cursed mist that has kept the Coral Island inhabitants trapped is unknown.
dialogsBegin.br: A causa da névoa amaldiçoada que manteve os habitantes da Ilha de Coral presos é desconhecida.
dialogsBegin.cns: 那片诅咒之雾将珊瑚岛居民困在此地，其根源至今无人知晓。
dialogsBegin.de: Die Ursache für den verfluchten Nebel, der die Bewohner der Koralleninsel gefangen hält, ist unbekannt.
dialogsBegin.fi: The cause of the cursed mist that has kept the Coral Island inhabitants trapped is unknown.
dialogsBegin.fil: The cause of the cursed mist that has kept the Coral Island inhabitants trapped is unknown.
dialogsBegin.fr: La cause de la malédiction qui a piégé les habitant de l'île est inconnue.
dialogsBegin.id: Belum diketahui penyebab kabut terkutuk yang membuat penduduk Coral Island terjebak.
dialogsBegin.it: The cause of the cursed mist that has kept the Coral Island inhabitants trapped is unknown.
dialogsBegin.jp: 珊瑚島の住民を閉じ込めた呪われた霧の原因は不明です。
dialogsBegin.kr: 코랄 아일랜드 주민을 가둔 저주받은 안개의 원인은 아직도 밝혀지지 않았죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: The cause of the cursed mist that has kept the Coral Island inhabitants trapped is unknown.
dialogsBegin.pl: The cause of the cursed mist that has kept the Coral Island inhabitants trapped is unknown.
dialogsBegin.ru: The cause of the cursed mist that has kept the Coral Island inhabitants trapped is unknown.
dialogsBegin.sp: Se desconoce la causa de la niebla maldita que ha mantenido atrapados a los habitantes de Isla Coral.
dialogsBegin.sw: The cause of the cursed mist that has kept the Coral Island inhabitants trapped is unknown.
dialogsBegin.th: สาเหตุของหมอกร้ายที่กักขังชาว Coral Island ไว้ยังคงไม่ทราบแน่ชัด
dialogsBegin.tw: 造成困住珊瑚島居民的詛咒迷霧，其真正原因至今不明。
dialogsBegin.vi: Người ta vẫn chưa biết nguyên nhân của màn sương mù đáng nguyền rủa đã khiến cư dân Coral Island bị mắc kẹt lại này.

dialogsBegin.en: However with the mist cleared from around the island, we can finally welcome fresh new faces to help us defend our small village!
dialogsBegin.ar: However with the mist cleared from around the island, we can finally welcome fresh new faces to help us defend our small village!
dialogsBegin.br: No entanto, com a névoa dissipada ao redor da ilha, finalmente podemos receber novos rostos para nos ajudar a defender nossa pequena vila!
dialogsBegin.cns: 不过随着岛屿周围的迷雾散去，我们终于能迎来新的伙伴，一同守护这座小村庄了！
dialogsBegin.de: Aber jetzt, wo sich der Nebel um die Insel gelichtet hat, können wir endlich neue Gesichter begrüßen, die uns helfen, unser kleines Dorf zu verteidigen!
dialogsBegin.fi: However with the mist cleared from around the island, we can finally welcome fresh new faces to help us defend our small village!
dialogsBegin.fil: However with the mist cleared from around the island, we can finally welcome fresh new faces to help us defend our small village!
dialogsBegin.fr: Cependant, la brume s'étant dissipée autour de l'île, nous pouvons enfin accueillir de nouveaux visages pour nous aider à défendre notre petit village !
dialogsBegin.id: Namun dengan hilangnya kabut di sekitar pulau, kami akhirnya dapat menyambut wajah-wajah baru yang segar untuk membantu kami mempertahankan desa kecil kami!
dialogsBegin.it: However with the mist cleared from around the island, we can finally welcome fresh new faces to help us defend our small village!
dialogsBegin.jp: しかし、島中の霧が晴れたことで、小さな村を守るために、ようやく新鮮な顔ぶれを迎えることができます!
dialogsBegin.kr: 그런데 섬 주변의 안개가 걷히더니, 마침내 우리 마을을 지켜주실 새로운 분들을 뵙게 되는군요!
dialogsBegin.nl: However with the mist cleared from around the island, we can finally welcome fresh new faces to help us defend our small village!
dialogsBegin.pl: However with the mist cleared from around the island, we can finally welcome fresh new faces to help us defend our small village!
dialogsBegin.ru: However with the mist cleared from around the island, we can finally welcome fresh new faces to help us defend our small village!
dialogsBegin.sp: Sin embargo, una vez que la niebla se haya disipado, ¡Finalmente podremos ver caras nuevas que nos ayudarán a defender nuestro pequeño pueblo!
dialogsBegin.sw: However with the mist cleared from around the island, we can finally welcome fresh new faces to help us defend our small village!
dialogsBegin.th: อย่างไรก็ตาม เมื่อหมอกรอบๆ เกาะจางลง เราก็สามารถต้อนรับผู้คน ที่เข้ามาช่วยปกป้องหมู่บ้านเล็กๆ ของเราได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 不過現在島嶼周圍的迷霧已散，我們終於能歡迎新面孔來幫忙守護這座小村莊了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tuy nhiên, khi sương mù bao quanh hòn đảo đã tan đi, chúng ta cuối cùng cũng có thể chào đón những gương mặt mới, họ có thể giúp chúng ta bảo vệ ngôi làng nhỏ này!

dialogsAccept.en: Coral Island is a dangerous place. To prove you are an adventurer capable of surviving the dangers here, I want you to go explore the island and take down 200 of any kind of Atrox.
dialogsAccept.ar: Coral Island is a dangerous place. To prove you are an adventurer capable of surviving the dangers here, I want you to go explore the island and take down 200 of any kind of Atrox.
dialogsAccept.br: A Ilha de Coral é um lugar perigoso. Para provar que você é um aventureiro capaz de sobreviver aos perigos daqui, quero que você explore a ilha e derrube 200 Atrox de qualquer tipo.
dialogsAccept.cns: 珊瑚岛危机四伏。为了证明你是有能力在此险境中生存的冒险者，我要你去探索这座岛屿，击败任意种类的巨齿蛉共计 200 只。
dialogsAccept.de: Die Koralleninsel ist ein gefährlicher Ort. Um zu demonstrieren, ob du ein Abenteurer bist, der in der Lage ist, die Gefahren hier zu überleben, möchte ich, dass du die Insel erkundest und 200 Artrox aller Art erlegst.
dialogsAccept.fi: Coral Island is a dangerous place. To prove you are an adventurer capable of surviving the dangers here, I want you to go explore the island and take down 200 of any kind of Atrox.
dialogsAccept.fil: Coral Island is a dangerous place. To prove you are an adventurer capable of surviving the dangers here, I want you to go explore the island and take down 200 of any kind of Atrox.
dialogsAccept.fr: L'Île Corail est dangereuse. Pour prouver que vous êtes un aventurier capable de survivre aux dangers, je veux que vous exploriez l'île et que vous éliminiez 200 Artrox de toutes sortes.
dialogsAccept.id: Coral Island adalah tempat yang berbahaya. Untuk membuktikan bahwa kamu adalah seorang petualang yang mampu bertahan dari bahaya di sini, aku ingin kamu menjelajahi pulau dan mengalahkan 200 jenis Atrox apa pun.
dialogsAccept.it: Coral Island is a dangerous place. To prove you are an adventurer capable of surviving the dangers here, I want you to go explore the island and take down 200 of any kind of Atrox.
dialogsAccept.jp: 珊瑚島は危険な場所です。ここでの危険を生き延びることができる冒険者であることを証明するために、島を探索してあらゆる種類のアトロックスを200体倒してほしい。
dialogsAccept.kr: 코랄 아일랜드는 위험한 곳이에요. 섬을 탐험하고, 종류에 상관없이 아트록스 200마리를 처치해 이곳의 위험도 이겨낼 수 있는 모험가임을 증명해 주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Coral Island is a dangerous place. To prove you are an adventurer capable of surviving the dangers here, I want you to go explore the island and take down 200 of any kind of Atrox.
dialogsAccept.pl: Coral Island is a dangerous place. To prove you are an adventurer capable of surviving the dangers here, I want you to go explore the island and take down 200 of any kind of Atrox.
dialogsAccept.ru: Coral Island is a dangerous place. To prove you are an adventurer capable of surviving the dangers here, I want you to go explore the island and take down 200 of any kind of Atrox.
dialogsAccept.sp: Isla Coral es un lugar peligroso. Para demostrar que eres un aventurero capaz de sobrevivir a los peligros aquí, quiero que vayas a explorar la isla y elimines 200 Atrox de cualquier tipo.
dialogsAccept.sw: Coral Island is a dangerous place. To prove you are an adventurer capable of surviving the dangers here, I want you to go explore the island and take down 200 of any kind of Atrox.
dialogsAccept.th: Coral Island เป็นสถานที่อันตราย เพื่อพิสูจน์ว่าคุณเป็นนักผจญภัยที่สามารถเอาชีวิตรอดจากอันตรายที่นี่ได้ ฉันอยากให้คุณออกสำรวจเกาะและกำจัด Atrox ชนิดใดก็ได้ 200 ตัว
dialogsAccept.tw: 珊瑚島是個危險的地方。為了證明你是有能力在此生存的冒險者，我要你去探索島嶼，並擊倒任意 200 隻 巨齒蛉。
dialogsAccept.vi: Coral Island là một nơi nguy hiểm. Để chứng minh bạn là một nhà thám hiểm có khả năng sống sót qua những nguy hiểm ở đây, tôi muốn bạn đi khám phá hòn đảo và hạ gục 200 loại Atrox bất kỳ.

dialogsDecline.en: We didn't expect everyone that arrived to be strong enough for this place. Perhaps you can return to Darken City.
dialogsDecline.ar: We didn't expect everyone that arrived to be strong enough for this place. Perhaps you can return to Darken City.
dialogsDecline.br: Não esperávamos que todos que chegassem fossem fortes o suficiente para este lugar. Talvez você possa retornar à Cidade Darken.
dialogsDecline.cns: 我们本就没指望来到这里的每个人都有足够的实力。或许你还是回到达肯去吧。
dialogsDecline.de: Wir haben nicht erwartet, dass alle, die hierher kamen, stark genug für diesen Ort sind. Vielleicht kannst du nach Darken City zurückkehren.
dialogsDecline.fi: We didn't expect everyone that arrived to be strong enough for this place. Perhaps you can return to Darken City.
dialogsDecline.fil: We didn't expect everyone that arrived to be strong enough for this place. Perhaps you can return to Darken City.
dialogsDecline.fr: Nous ne nous attendions pas à ce que tout le monde soit assez fort pour braver les dangers de l'île. Peut-être devriez-vous retourner à Darken.
dialogsDecline.id: Kami tidak berharap semua orang yang datang cukup kuat untuk tempat ini. Mungkin kamu bisa kembali ke Darken City.
dialogsDecline.it: We didn't expect everyone that arrived to be strong enough for this place. Perhaps you can return to Darken City.
dialogsDecline.jp: 到着した皆さんがこんなにも強いとは思いませんでした。もしかすると、ダーコンシティに戻れる日が来るかもしれない・・・。
dialogsDecline.kr: 마을에 도착하신 분들이 전부 이렇게 강할 거라곤 생각지도 못했어요. 당신이라면, 다켄 시티로 돌아갈 수도 있겠네요.
dialogsDecline.nl: We didn't expect everyone that arrived to be strong enough for this place. Perhaps you can return to Darken City.
dialogsDecline.pl: We didn't expect everyone that arrived to be strong enough for this place. Perhaps you can return to Darken City.
dialogsDecline.ru: We didn't expect everyone that arrived to be strong enough for this place. Perhaps you can return to Darken City.
dialogsDecline.sp: No esperábamos que todos los visitantes fueran lo suficientemente fuertes para este lugar. Quizás puedas regresar a Ciudad Darken.
dialogsDecline.sw: We didn't expect everyone that arrived to be strong enough for this place. Perhaps you can return to Darken City.
dialogsDecline.th: พวกเราไม่คิดว่าทุกคนที่มาจะแข็งแกร่งพอสำหรับที่นี่ บางทีคุณควรจะกลับไปที่เมือง Darken
dialogsDecline.tw: 我們本來也不指望每個來到這裡的人都足夠強大。也許你還是回得肯城比較好。
dialogsDecline.vi: Chúng tôi cũng không hy vọng tất cả những người đến đây đều đủ mạnh mẽ để sống sót tại nơi này. Có lẽ bạn nên quay lại Darken City.

dialogsComplete.en: I am impressed! Atrox are dangerous beasts known to cut down most creatures that approach them. You have proven yourself.
dialogsComplete.ar: I am impressed! Atrox are dangerous beasts known to cut down most creatures that approach them. You have proven yourself.
dialogsComplete.br: Estou impressionado! Os Atrox são feras perigosas conhecidas por derrubar a maioria das criaturas que se aproximam. Você provou seu valor.
dialogsComplete.cns: 真是令人刮目相看！巨齿蛉是极为凶险的猛兽，绝大多数靠近它们的生物都会被轻易斩杀。你已经证明了自己的实力。
dialogsComplete.de: Ich bin beeindruckt! Artrox sind gefährliche Biester, die dafür bekannt sind, die meisten Kreaturen, die sich ihnen nähern, zu töten. Du hast dich bewährt.
dialogsComplete.fi: I am impressed! Atrox are dangerous beasts known to cut down most creatures that approach them. You have proven yourself.
dialogsComplete.fil: I am impressed! Atrox are dangerous beasts known to cut down most creatures that approach them. You have proven yourself.
dialogsComplete.fr: Je suis impressionné ! Les Artroxs sont des bêtes dangereuses connues pour abattre la plupart des créatures qui les approchent. Vous avez fait vos preuves.
dialogsComplete.id: Aku terkesan! Atrox adalah binatang berbahaya yang dikenal suka membunuh sebagian besar makhluk yang mendekatinya. Kamu telah membuktikan dirimu sendiri.
dialogsComplete.it: I am impressed! Atrox are dangerous beasts known to cut down most creatures that approach them. You have proven yourself.
dialogsComplete.jp: 感動しました!アトロックスは、近づいてくるほとんどの生物を切り倒すことで知られる危険な獣です。あなたは自分自身を証明しました。
dialogsComplete.kr: 대단한데요! 아트록스는 접근하는 존재는 뭐든 베어버리는 위험한 몬스터거든요. 실력은 충분하네요.
dialogsComplete.nl: I am impressed! Atrox are dangerous beasts known to cut down most creatures that approach them. You have proven yourself.
dialogsComplete.pl: I am impressed! Atrox are dangerous beasts known to cut down most creatures that approach them. You have proven yourself.
dialogsComplete.ru: I am impressed! Atrox are dangerous beasts known to cut down most creatures that approach them. You have proven yourself.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Estoy impresionado! Los Atrox son bestias peligrosas conocidas por matar a la mayoría de las criaturas que se les acercan. Has demostrado tu valor.
dialogsComplete.sw: I am impressed! Atrox are dangerous beasts known to cut down most creatures that approach them. You have proven yourself.
dialogsComplete.th: ฉันประทับใจมาก! Atrox เป็นสัตว์ร้ายอันตรายที่รู้กันว่าสามารถสังหารสิ่งมีชีวิตทุกชนิดที่เข้าใกล้ได้ คุณได้พิสูจน์ตัวเองแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 我很佩服你！巨齒蛉 是危險的野獸，大多數接近牠們的生物都會被撕碎。你已經證明了自己。
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi rất ấn tượng! Atrox là những con thú nguy hiểm có khả năng tiêu diệt hầu hết những sinh vật tiếp cận chúng. Bạn đã chứng minh được khả năng của mình.

dialogsFail.en: Atrox are dangerous foes, you'll need to successfully defeat more of them to prove yourself to me.
dialogsFail.ar: Atrox are dangerous foes, you'll need to successfully defeat more of them to prove yourself to me.
dialogsFail.br: Os Atrox são inimigos perigosos, você precisará derrotar mais deles para provar seu valor para mim.
dialogsFail.cns: 巨齿蛉十分凶险，你得再击败更多这样的怪物，才能向我证明你的实力。
dialogsFail.de: Artrox sind gefährliche Feinde, du musst mehr von ihnen erfolgreich besiegen, um dich mir gegenüber zu beweisen.
dialogsFail.fi: Atrox are dangerous foes, you'll need to successfully defeat more of them to prove yourself to me.
dialogsFail.fil: Atrox are dangerous foes, you'll need to successfully defeat more of them to prove yourself to me.
dialogsFail.fr: Les Artroxs sont de dangereux ennemis, vous devrez en vaincre plusieurs afin de prouver votre valeur.
dialogsFail.id: Atrox adalah musuh yang berbahaya, kamu harus berhasil mengalahkan lebih banyak dari mereka untuk membuktikan diri kepadaku.
dialogsFail.it: Atrox are dangerous foes, you'll need to successfully defeat more of them to prove yourself to me.
dialogsFail.jp: アトロックスは危険な敵だ、俺に実力を証明するには、もっと多くの敵を倒す必要がある。
dialogsFail.kr: 아트록스는 위험한 적이죠. 당신 능력을 증명하려면 아트록스를 더 많이 처치해야 할 겁니다.
dialogsFail.nl: Atrox are dangerous foes, you'll need to successfully defeat more of them to prove yourself to me.
dialogsFail.pl: Atrox are dangerous foes, you'll need to successfully defeat more of them to prove yourself to me.
dialogsFail.ru: Atrox are dangerous foes, you'll need to successfully defeat more of them to prove yourself to me.
dialogsFail.sp: Los Atrox son peligrosos, tendrás que derrotar con a más de ellos para demostrar tu valía ante mí.
dialogsFail.sw: Atrox are dangerous foes, you'll need to successfully defeat more of them to prove yourself to me.
dialogsFail.th: Atrox เป็นศัตรูที่อันตราย คุณจะต้องเอาชนะพวกมันให้ได้มากพอเพื่อพิสูจน์ตัวเองให้ฉันเห็น
dialogsFail.tw: 巨齒蛉 是很危險的對手。你得再擊敗更多牠們，才能向我證明自己。
dialogsFail.vi: Atrox là những kẻ nguy hiểm, bạn sẽ cần phải tiêu diệt nhiều con Atrox hơn để cho tối thấy năng lực của bạn.

dialogsBegin.en: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.ar: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.br: Bem-vindo aventureiro! Chegou mais um pedido de $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ da Torre Abandonada.Você poderia conseguir 60 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ e trazê-los para mim?
dialogsBegin.cns: 欢迎你，英雄！又有一项委托来了 —— 肃清深渊之塔内的 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$，请你斩杀50只 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$，完成之后再回来找我。
dialogsBegin.de: Willkommen Held! Es ist eine weitere Bitte eingegangen, $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ aus dem Verlassenen Turm zu entfernen. Kannst du bitte 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ erschlagen und zu mir zurückkehren, sobald du fertig bist?
dialogsBegin.fi: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.fil: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.fr: Bienvenue, héros ! Nous avons reçu une autre demande pour éliminer des $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ de la Tour Oubliée. Pourriez-vous tuer 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ et revenir me voir une fois que vous aurez terminé ?
dialogsBegin.id: Selamat datang pahlawan! Request lain telah masuk untuk $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ dari Forsaken Tower. Bisakah kamu mengambil 50 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, dan mengembalikannya kepadaku?
dialogsBegin.it: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.jp: ようこそヒーロー！忘却の塔から$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を一掃せよと依頼が届きました。50体の$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を倒し戻ってきてくれないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 어서 오세요, 용사님! 버려진 탑에서 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$을(를) 처치해 달라는 요청이 또 들어왔어요. $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 50마리를 처치하고, 완료되면 제게 돌아와 주시겠어요?

dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Bienvenido héroe! Ha llegado otra solicitud para retirar $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ de la Torre Abandonada. ¿Podrías matar 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ y regresar conmigo una vez hecho?
dialogsBegin.sw: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.th: ยินดีต้อนรับฮีโร่! มีคำขอสำหรับ $$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ จาก Forsaken Tower มาอีกแล้ว คุณช่วยไปเก็บ 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ และนำกลับมาให้ฉันทีได้ไหม
dialogsBegin.tw: 歡迎，英雄！又有新的委託要你清除深淵之塔中的 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$。可以請你擊殺 50 隻 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$，完成後再回來找我嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Chào mừng người hùng! Một nhiệm vụ khác từ Forsaken Tower yêu cầu bạn đánh bại $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$s. Bạn có thể vui lòng diệt 60 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ và quay lại tìm tôi sau khi hoàn thành nhiệm vụ không?

dialogsDecline.en: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.

dialogsDecline.th: Tower เต็มไปด้วย masquerpets ที่อันตราย ข้าเข้าใจดีถ้าเจ้าไม่อยากเสี่ยงอันตราย
dialogsDecline.tw: 塔內充滿了危險的怪物。如果你不想冒險，我可以理解。
dialogsDecline.vi: Tower chứa đầy masquerpets nguy hiểm. Tôi hiểu bạn không muốn mạo hiểm.

description.fil: Defeat any kind of Kingster or Creper until you've made 200 Island Bait.
description.fr: Tuez n'importe quel type de Kingster ou Creper jusqu'à ce que vous ayez fabriqué 200 Appâts de l'île.

description.kr: 종류에 상관없이 킹스터와 크리퍼를 처치해 섬 미끼를 200개 만드세요.

description.vi: Tiêu diệt bất kỳ loại Kingster hoặc Creper nào cho đến khi bạn thu thập được 200 Island Bait.

dialogsBegin.en: Ha! You have really made a name for yourself here on Coral Island, hero. Everyone has told me of the amazing feats you've accomplished.
dialogsBegin.ar: Ha! You have really made a name for yourself here on Coral Island, hero. Everyone has told me of the amazing feats you've accomplished.
dialogsBegin.br: Ha! Você realmente fez um nome para si mesmo aqui na Ilha de Coral, herói. Todos me contaram sobre os feitos incríveis que você realizou.
dialogsBegin.cns: 哈！你在珊瑚岛已经名声大噪了，英雄。所有人都在跟我诉说你立下的赫赫功绩。
dialogsBegin.de: Ha! Du hast dir hier auf der Koralleninsel wirklich einen Namen gemacht, du Held. Jeder hat mir von den erstaunlichen Leistungen erzählt, die du vollbracht hast.
dialogsBegin.fi: Ha! You have really made a name for yourself here on Coral Island, hero. Everyone has told me of the amazing feats you've accomplished.
dialogsBegin.fil: Ha! You have really made a name for yourself here on Coral Island, hero. Everyone has told me of the amazing feats you've accomplished.
dialogsBegin.fr: Ha ! Vous vous êtes vraiment fait un nom ici sur l'île Corail, héros. Tout le monde m'a parlé de vos incroyables exploits.
dialogsBegin.id: Ha! Kamu benar-benar telah membuat nama untuk dirimu sendiri di Coral Island, Pahlawan. Semua orang memberi tahuku tentang prestasi luar biasa yang telah kamu capai.
dialogsBegin.it: Ha! You have really made a name for yourself here on Coral Island, hero. Everyone has told me of the amazing feats you've accomplished.
dialogsBegin.jp: ハッ!ここコーラル島で名を馳せたな、英雄よ。誰もが、あなたが成し遂げた素晴らしい偉業について私に話してくれました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 하! 멋지게 이름을 날리고 코랄 아일랜드의 영웅이 되셨군요, 용사님. 마을 사람들 모두 용사님의 놀라운 실력을 이야기해 주던걸요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Ha! You have really made a name for yourself here on Coral Island, hero. Everyone has told me of the amazing feats you've accomplished.
dialogsBegin.pl: Ha! You have really made a name for yourself here on Coral Island, hero. Everyone has told me of the amazing feats you've accomplished.
dialogsBegin.ru: Ha! You have really made a name for yourself here on Coral Island, hero. Everyone has told me of the amazing feats you've accomplished.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Ja! Te has hecho un nombre aquí en Isla Coral, héroe. Todo el mundo me habla de las increíbles hazañas que has logrado.
dialogsBegin.sw: Ha! You have really made a name for yourself here on Coral Island, hero. Everyone has told me of the amazing feats you've accomplished.
dialogsBegin.th: ฮ่าๆ คุณสร้างชื่อเสียงให้กับตัวเองบน Coral Island ได้มากจริงๆ ทุกคนบอกฉันถึงความสำเร็จอันน่าทึ่งที่คุณ
dialogsBegin.tw: 哈！英雄，你在珊瑚島上真的闖出名號了。大家都在說你完成了多麼驚人的壯舉。
dialogsBegin.vi: Ha! Bạn thật sự đã xây dựng được danh tiếng trên Coral Island này đấy, người hùng. Mọi người đã kể tôi nghe về những việc phi thường bạn đã hoàn thành.

dialogsBegin.en: If you want to prove yourself further, help us defeat the legion of Naga that have taken over the island.
dialogsBegin.ar: If you want to prove yourself further, help us defeat the legion of Naga that have taken over the island.
dialogsBegin.br: Se quiser se provar ainda mais, ajude-nos a derrotar a legião de Naga que tomou conta da ilha.
dialogsBegin.cns: 若想进一步证明你的实力，就帮我们击败盘踞在这座岛上的那伽军团吧。
dialogsBegin.de: Wenn du dich weiter beweisen willst, hilf uns, die Legion der Naga zu besiegen, die die Insel übernommen hat.
dialogsBegin.fi: If you want to prove yourself further, help us defeat the legion of Naga that have taken over the island.
dialogsBegin.fil: If you want to prove yourself further, help us defeat the legion of Naga that have taken over the island.
dialogsBegin.fr: Si vous voulez faire encore vos preuves, aidez-nous à vaincre la légion de Naga qui a envahi l'île.
dialogsBegin.id: Jika kamu ingin membuktikan diri lebih jauh, bantu kami mengalahkan legiun Naga yang telah menguasai pulau itu.
dialogsBegin.it: If you want to prove yourself further, help us defeat the legion of Naga that have taken over the island.
dialogsBegin.jp: さらに実力を証明したいなら、島を乗っ取ったナーガの軍団を倒すのを手伝ってください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 용사님의 능력을 더 증명하고 싶다면, 저희를 도와 섬을 점령한 나가 군단을 처치해 주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: If you want to prove yourself further, help us defeat the legion of Naga that have taken over the island.
dialogsBegin.pl: If you want to prove yourself further, help us defeat the legion of Naga that have taken over the island.
dialogsBegin.ru: If you want to prove yourself further, help us defeat the legion of Naga that have taken over the island.
dialogsBegin.sp: Si quieres demostrar tu valía, ayúdanos a derrotar a la legión de Naga que se ha apoderado de la Isla.
dialogsBegin.sw: If you want to prove yourself further, help us defeat the legion of Naga that have taken over the island.
dialogsBegin.th: หากคุณต้องการพิสูจน์ตัวเอง โปรดช่วยเราเอาชนะกองทัพ Naga ที่ยึดครองเกาะนี้
dialogsBegin.tw: 如果你還想更進一步證明自己，就幫我們擊敗那些佔據整座島的納迦軍團吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Nếu bạn muốn chứng minh mình có khả năng nhiều hơn thế, hãy giúp chúng tôi đánh bại quân đoàn của Naga, những tên đã xâm chiếm hòn đảo.

dialogsAccept.en: To safely take on the Naga, first you'll need to gather bait made of their favorite foods. You can make bait from any type of Kingster or Creper! Meet up with Pau Pau and he'll prepare everything.
dialogsAccept.ar: To safely take on the Naga, first you'll need to gather bait made of their favorite foods. You can make bait from any type of Kingster or Creper! Meet up with Pau Pau and he'll prepare everything.
dialogsAccept.br: Para enfrentar os Naga com segurança, primeiro você precisará reunir isca feita de seus alimentos favoritos. Você pode fazer isca de qualquer tipo de Kingster ou Creper! Encontre Pau Pau e ele preparará tudo.
dialogsAccept.cns: 想要安全地对付那伽，首先你得用它们最爱的食物制作鱼饵。任何一种霸王虾或巨钳蟹都能用来制作鱼饵！去找泡泡，他会帮你准备好一切。
dialogsAccept.de: Um es sicher mit den Naga aufnehmen zu können, musst du zunächst Köder aus ihren Lieblingsspeisen sammeln. Du kannst Köder aus jeder Art von Kingster oder Creper herstellen! Triff dich mit Pau Pau und er wird alles vorbereiten.
dialogsAccept.fi: To safely take on the Naga, first you'll need to gather bait made of their favorite foods. You can make bait from any type of Kingster or Creper! Meet up with Pau Pau and he'll prepare everything.
dialogsAccept.fil: To safely take on the Naga, first you'll need to gather bait made of their favorite foods. You can make bait from any type of Kingster or Creper! Meet up with Pau Pau and he'll prepare everything.
dialogsAccept.fr: Pour affronter les Naga en toute sécurité, vous devrez d'abord rassembler des appâts composés de leurs aliments préférés. Vous pouvez fabriquer des appâts à partir de n'importe quel type de Kingster ou Creper ! Rendez-vous ensuite chez Pau Pau et il préparera tout.
dialogsAccept.id: Untuk menghadapi Naga dengan aman, pertama-tama kamu harus mengumpulkan umpan yang terbuat dari makanan favoritnya. Kamu bisa membuat umpan dari jenis Kingster atau Creper apa pun! Temui Pau Pau dan dia akan mempersiapkan segalanya.
dialogsAccept.it: To safely take on the Naga, first you'll need to gather bait made of their favorite foods. You can make bait from any type of Kingster or Creper! Meet up with Pau Pau and he'll prepare everything.
dialogsAccept.jp: ナーガを安全に捕らえるには、まずナーガの好きな食べ物で作られた餌を集める必要があります。どんな種類のキングスターやクレーパーからも餌を作ることができます!パウ・パウと会えば、彼がすべてを準備してくれる。
dialogsAccept.kr: 안전하게 나가를 잡으려면, 먼저 나가들이 좋아하는 먹이로 만든 미끼를 모아야 해요. 킹스터나 크리퍼로 미끼를 만들 수 있답니다! 파우파우를 찾으면 잘 알려줄 거예요.
dialogsAccept.nl: To safely take on the Naga, first you'll need to gather bait made of their favorite foods. You can make bait from any type of Kingster or Creper! Meet up with Pau Pau and he'll prepare everything.
dialogsAccept.pl: To safely take on the Naga, first you'll need to gather bait made of their favorite foods. You can make bait from any type of Kingster or Creper! Meet up with Pau Pau and he'll prepare everything.
dialogsAccept.ru: To safely take on the Naga, first you'll need to gather bait made of their favorite foods. You can make bait from any type of Kingster or Creper! Meet up with Pau Pau and he'll prepare everything.
dialogsAccept.sp: Para enfrentarte a los Naga, primero tendrás que recolectar cebo hecho con sus comidas favoritas. ¡Puedes hacer cebo con cualquier tipo de Kingster o Creper! Ve con Pau Pau y él lo preparará todo.
dialogsAccept.sw: To safely take on the Naga, first you'll need to gather bait made of their favorite foods. You can make bait from any type of Kingster or Creper! Meet up with Pau Pau and he'll prepare everything.
dialogsAccept.th: หากต้องการรับมือกับ Naga อย่างปลอดภัย ขั้นแรกคุณต้องรวบรวมเหยื่อที่ทำจากอาหารที่พวกมันชอบ คุณสามารถทำเหยื่อจาก Kingster หรือ Creper ชนิดใดก็ได้! และนำไปให้ Pau Pau จากนั้นเขาจะเตรียมทุกอย่างให้
dialogsAccept.tw: 為了安全地對付那迦，首先你需要收集他們最喜歡的食物製成的誘餌。你可以用任何類型的金斯特或克雷普製作魚餌！與包包會面，他會準備好一切。
dialogsAccept.vi: Để hạ gục Naga một cách an toàn, trước tiên bạn cần thu thập mồi nhử làm từ những loại thực phẩm yêu thích của chúng. Bạn có thể làm mồi từ bất kỳ loại Kingster hoặc Creper nào! Gặp Pau Pau và anh ấy sẽ chuẩn bị mọi thứ giúp bạn.

dialogsDecline.en: Everyone's adventure comes to a close one day. That's alright, hero.
dialogsDecline.ar: Everyone's adventure comes to a close one day. That's alright, hero.
dialogsDecline.br: Toda aventura chega ao fim um dia. Tudo bem, herói.
dialogsDecline.cns: 每个人的冒险终有落幕之日。没关系，英雄。
dialogsDecline.de: Das Abenteuer eines jeden geht eines Tages zu Ende. Das ist in Ordnung, Held.
dialogsDecline.fi: Everyone's adventure comes to a close one day. That's alright, hero.
dialogsDecline.fil: Everyone's adventure comes to a close one day. That's alright, hero.
dialogsDecline.fr: L'aventure de chacun prend fin un jour. Ce n'est pas grave, héros.
dialogsDecline.id: Petualangan semua orang akan berakhir suatu hari nanti. Tidak apa-apa, Pahlawan.
dialogsDecline.it: Everyone's adventure comes to a close one day. That's alright, hero.
dialogsDecline.jp: みんなの冒険はいつか終わります。大丈夫だよ、ヒーロー。
dialogsDecline.kr: 어떤 모험이든 끝이 있는 법이죠. 괜찮아요, 용사님.
dialogsDecline.nl: Everyone's adventure comes to a close one day. That's alright, hero.
dialogsDecline.pl: Everyone's adventure comes to a close one day. That's alright, hero.
dialogsDecline.ru: Everyone's adventure comes to a close one day. That's alright, hero.
dialogsDecline.sp: La aventura de todos llega a su fin un día. Está bien, héroe.
dialogsDecline.sw: Everyone's adventure comes to a close one day. That's alright, hero.
dialogsDecline.th: ซักวันหนึ่งการผจญภัยของทุกคนก็ต้องจบลง ไม่เป็นไรนะ
dialogsDecline.tw: 每個人的冒險總有一天會畫下句點。沒關係的，英雄。
dialogsDecline.vi: Cuộc phiêu lưu nào rồi cũng sẽ đến hồi kết. Không sao đâu, anh hùng ạ.

dialogsComplete.en: Woaw, nice job hero! We can make plenty of bait with all this to lower the guard of the Naga! For now, take a rest. We'll make a plan of attack later.
dialogsComplete.ar: Woaw, nice job hero! We can make plenty of bait with all this to lower the guard of the Naga! For now, take a rest. We'll make a plan of attack later.
dialogsComplete.br: Woaw, bom trabalho, herói! Podemos fazer muita isca com tudo isso para diminuir a guarda dos Naga! Por enquanto, descanse. Faremos um plano de ataque mais tarde.
dialogsComplete.cns: 哇，干得漂亮，英雄！这些材料足够我们制作大量鱼饵，用来麻痹那伽的警惕！你先好好休息，我们稍后再制定进攻计划。
dialogsComplete.de: Wow, gute Arbeit, Held! Damit können wir eine Menge Köder herstellen, um die Wachen der Naga zu schwächen! Ruh dich erst einmal aus. Wir werden später einen Angriffsplan ausarbeiten.
dialogsComplete.fi: Woaw, nice job hero! We can make plenty of bait with all this to lower the guard of the Naga! For now, take a rest. We'll make a plan of attack later.
dialogsComplete.fil: Woaw, nice job hero! We can make plenty of bait with all this to lower the guard of the Naga! For now, take a rest. We'll make a plan of attack later.
dialogsComplete.fr: Woaw, beau travail héros ! Nous pouvons fabriquer plein d'appâts avec tout ça pour abaisser la garde des Naga ! Pour l'instant, reposez-vous. Nous établirons un plan d'attaque plus tard.
dialogsComplete.id: Wow, pekerjaan yang bagus, pahlawan! Kita bisa membuat banyak umpan dengan semua ini untuk menurunkan pertahanan Naga! Untuk saat ini, istirahatlah. Kami akan membuat rencana penyerangan nanti.
dialogsComplete.it: Woaw, nice job hero! We can make plenty of bait with all this to lower the guard of the Naga! For now, take a rest. We'll make a plan of attack later.
dialogsComplete.jp: うわー、ナイジョブヒーロー!これだけで餌をたくさん作って、ナーガのガードを下げましょう!とりあえず、お休みください。攻撃の計画は後で立てます。
dialogsComplete.kr: 와, 잘하셨어요 용사님! 이걸로 미끼를 충분히 만들면 나가의 경계심을 낮출 수 있을 거예요! 일단은 조금 쉬세요. 나중에 공격 계획을 다시 세우자고요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Woaw, nice job hero! We can make plenty of bait with all this to lower the guard of the Naga! For now, take a rest. We'll make a plan of attack later.
dialogsComplete.pl: Woaw, nice job hero! We can make plenty of bait with all this to lower the guard of the Naga! For now, take a rest. We'll make a plan of attack later.
dialogsComplete.ru: Woaw, nice job hero! We can make plenty of bait with all this to lower the guard of the Naga! For now, take a rest. We'll make a plan of attack later.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Guau, buen trabajo héroe! ¡Podemos hacer mucho cebo con todo esto para bajar la guardia de los Naga! Por ahora, descansa. Haremos un plan de ataque más tarde.
dialogsComplete.sw: Woaw, nice job hero! We can make plenty of bait with all this to lower the guard of the Naga! For now, take a rest. We'll make a plan of attack later.
dialogsComplete.th: ว้าว เยี่ยมมาก ท่านผู้กล้า! เราสามารถทำเหยื่อล่อได้มากมายจากสิ่งนี้ เพื่อลดการป้องกันของ Naga! ตอนนี้พักผ่อนก่อน เราจะวางแผนโจมตีในภายหลัง
dialogsComplete.tw: 哇喔，幹得漂亮，英雄！有了這些，我們就能製作大量誘餌，來降低納迦的警戒！先休息一下吧，之後我們再擬定進攻計畫。
dialogsComplete.vi: Wow, làm tốt lắm người anh hùng! Chúng ta có thể tạo ra rất nhiều mồi nhử với tất cả những thứ này để thu hút sự cảnh giác của Naga! Bây giờ hãy nghỉ ngơi đi. Chúng ta sẽ lên kế hoạch tấn công sau.

dialogsFail.cns: 继续猎杀霸王虾或巨钳蟹，直到收集到足够的鱼饵材料。

dialogsFail.it: Keep fighting Kingster or Creper until you've found enough bait.
dialogsFail.jp: 十分な餌が見つかるまで、キングスターまたはクレパーと戦い続けます。
dialogsFail.kr: 미끼를 충분히 찾을 때까지 킹스터, 크리퍼와 계속 싸우세요.
dialogsFail.nl: Keep fighting Kingster or Creper until you've found enough bait.

dialogsFail.ru: Keep fighting Kingster or Creper until you've found enough bait.
dialogsFail.sp: Sigue luchando contra Kingster o Creper hasta que encuentres suficiente cebo.
dialogsFail.sw: Keep fighting Kingster or Creper until you've found enough bait.
dialogsFail.th: ต่อสู้กับ Kingster หรือ Creper ต่อไป จนกว่าจะได้เหยื่อเพียงพอ
dialogsFail.tw: 繼續與金斯特或克雷普戰鬥，直到找到足夠的誘餌。
dialogsFail.vi: Hãy tiếp tục tiêu diệt Kingster hoặc Creper cho đến khi bạn thu thập đủ mồi nhử.

dialogsBegin.en: Tigars are known to have some of the strongest teeth in all of Madrigal. If you come across $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ could you bring me a few? I'm crafting a giant dagger... it'll be HUGE!
dialogsBegin.ar: Tigars are known to have some of the strongest teeth in all of Madrigal. If you come across $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ could you bring me a few? I'm crafting a giant dagger... it'll be HUGE!
dialogsBegin.br: Os Tigars são conhecidos por terem alguns dos dentes mais fortes de toda Madrigal. Se você encontrar $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, poderia me trazer alguns? Estou criando um punhal gigante... será ENORME!
dialogsBegin.cns: Tigars are known to have some of the strongest teeth in all of Madrigal. If you come across $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ could you bring me a few? I'm crafting a giant dagger... it'll be HUGE!
dialogsBegin.de: Tigaren sind dafür bekannt, dass sie die stärksten Zähne in ganz Madrigal haben. Wenn du auf $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ stößt, könntest du mir ein paar davon mitbringen? Ich stelle einen riesigen Dolch her... er wird RIESIG sein!
dialogsBegin.fi: Tigars are known to have some of the strongest teeth in all of Madrigal. If you come across $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ could you bring me a few? I'm crafting a giant dagger... it'll be HUGE!
dialogsBegin.fil: Kilala ang mga Tigar na may ilan sa pinakamalakas na ngipin sa buong Madrigal. Kung makakita ka ng $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, puwede mo ba akong dalhan ng ilang piraso? Ginagawa ko ang isang higanteng punyal... malaki talaga!
dialogsBegin.fr: Les Taigas sont connus pour avoir les dents les plus solides de tout le Madrigal. Si vous trouvez des $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, pourriez-vous m'en apporter quelques-unes ? Je suis en train de fabriquer une dague géante... elle sera ENORME !
dialogsBegin.id: Tigars diketahui memiliki gigi terkuat di seluruh Madrigal. Jika kamu menemukan $QUEST_END ITEM_NAME$ bisakah kamu membawakan beberapa? Aku sedang membuat belati raksasa... itu akan menjadi BESAR!
dialogsBegin.it: Tigars are known to have some of the strongest teeth in all of Madrigal. If you come across $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ could you bring me a few? I'm crafting a giant dagger... it'll be HUGE!
dialogsBegin.jp: タイガーは、マドリガル全土で最も強い歯を持っていることで知られています。$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$に出くわしたら、いくつか持ってきてもらえますか?巨大な短剣を作っています。それは巨大になるでしょう!
dialogsBegin.kr: 타이가는 마드리갈 전체에서 이빨이 가장 강하다고 해요. $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$을(를) 발견하면 몇 개 가져다주실 수 있나요? 대형 단검을 만들고 있는데.. 엄청나게 클 거예요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Tigars are known to have some of the strongest teeth in all of Madrigal. If you come across $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ could you bring me a few? I'm crafting a giant dagger... it'll be HUGE!
dialogsBegin.pl: Tigars are known to have some of the strongest teeth in all of Madrigal. If you come across $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ could you bring me a few? I'm crafting a giant dagger... it'll be HUGE!
dialogsBegin.ru: Tigars are known to have some of the strongest teeth in all of Madrigal. If you come across $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ could you bring me a few? I'm crafting a giant dagger... it'll be HUGE!
dialogsBegin.sp: Se sabe que los Tigars tienen los dientes más fuertes de todo Madrigal. Si encuentras $QUEST_END ITEM_NAME$, ¿podrías traerme algunos? Estoy creando una daga gigante... ¡¡será ENORME!!
dialogsBegin.sw: Tigars are known to have some of the strongest teeth in all of Madrigal. If you come across $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ could you bring me a few? I'm crafting a giant dagger... it'll be HUGE!
dialogsBegin.th: Tigars มีฟันที่แข็งแรงที่สุดใน Madrigal หากคุณเจอ $QUEST_END ITEM_NAME$ ช่วยเอามาให้ฉันสักสองสามอันได้ไหม ฉันกำลังประดิษฐ์มีดสั้นขนาดยักษ์... มันจะใหญญญญญญญญ่มาก!
dialogsBegin.tw: 提加以擁有整個瑪德利賈最堅硬的牙齒之一而聞名。如果你遇到 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$，能幫我帶幾個回來嗎？我正在打造一把巨大的匕首……會非常巨大！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tigars được biết đến là loài có hàm răng khỏe nhất ở Madrigal. Nếu bạn gặp $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, bạn có thể mang cho tôi một ít được không? Tôi đang chế tạo một con dao găm khổng lồ... nó sẽ SIÊU LỚN!

dialogsDecline.th: ขอร้องอย่าให้ฉันต้องไปเก็บ $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ คนเดียวเลย... ฉันยุ่งเกินไปกับการฝันถึงสิ่งประดิษฐ์ใหม่ๆ!

dialogsComplete.en: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! Soon I'll have the biggest dagger in Madrigal. Hehehe, catch me showing off to the Demians!

dialogsComplete.br: Obrigado por coletar todos aqueles $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, aventureiro! Em breve terei o maior punhal de Madrigal. Hehehe, me veja exibindo para os Demians!
dialogsComplete.cns: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! Soon I'll have the biggest dagger in Madrigal. Hehehe, catch me showing off to the Demians!

dialogsComplete.fi: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! Soon I'll have the biggest dagger in Madrigal. Hehehe, catch me showing off to the Demians!

dialogsComplete.id: Terima kasih telah mengumpulkan semua $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ itu, petualang! Sebentar lagi aku akan mendapatkan belati terbesar di Madrigal. Hehehe, tangkap aku pamer ke Demian!
dialogsComplete.it: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! Soon I'll have the biggest dagger in Madrigal. Hehehe, catch me showing off to the Demians!
dialogsComplete.jp: 冒険者の皆さん、$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$を全て集めてくれてありがとう!もうすぐマドリガルで一番大きな短剣が手に入る。ふ、デミアンに見せびらかすのを捕まえろ!
