dialogsBegin.nl: Lapranche has certainly slowed down our efforts to build a force that can oppose her. It's likely that the previous Keeper of the Sanctuary was transformed like all the others...
dialogsBegin.pl: Lapranche has certainly slowed down our efforts to build a force that can oppose her. It's likely that the previous Keeper of the Sanctuary was transformed like all the others...
dialogsBegin.ru: Lapranche has certainly slowed down our efforts to build a force that can oppose her. It's likely that the previous Keeper of the Sanctuary was transformed like all the others...
dialogsBegin.sp: Lapranche ha frenado nuestros esfuerzos de ser fuertes para enfrentarla. Es probable que el anterior Guardián del Santuario fuera transformado como todos los demás..
dialogsBegin.sw: Lapranche has certainly slowed down our efforts to build a force that can oppose her. It's likely that the previous Keeper of the Sanctuary was transformed like all the others...
dialogsBegin.th: Lapranche พยายามขัดขวางกองทัพที่จะต่อต้านเธอ แล้วก็ดูเหมือนว่า Keeper of the Sanctuary เริ่มแปรสภาพไปเหมือนสิ่งอื่น ๆ แล้วเช่นกัน...
dialogsBegin.tw: 拉普蘭雪確實拖慢了我們建立對抗她軍勢的速度。看來聖域過去的守護者也和其他人一樣，遭到了轉化……
dialogsBegin.vi: Lapranche chắc chắn đã ngáng đường những nỗ lực của chúng ta trong việc xây dựng một lực lượng có thể chống lại cô ta. Có khả năng là Keeper of the Sanctuary trước đó đã bị biến đổi giống như tất cả những người khác..

dialogsBegin.en: The Keeper was a force to be reckoned with, the second in command of the protective force that guarded the Guardiane Sanctuary. If the Keeper still remains... it will be a formidable challenge.
dialogsBegin.ar: The Keeper was a force to be reckoned with, the second in command of the protective force that guarded the Guardiane Sanctuary. If the Keeper still remains... it will be a formidable challenge.
dialogsBegin.br: O Guardião era daqueles que metia respeito, o segundo no comando da força protetora que guardava o Santuário do Guardião. Se o Guardião ainda estiver na área... vai ser um desafio e tanto!
dialogsBegin.cns: The Keeper was a force to be reckoned with, the second in command of the protective force that guarded the Guardiane Sanctuary. If the Keeper still remains... it will be a formidable challenge.
dialogsBegin.de: Der Hüter war eine Kraft, mit der man rechnen musste. Er war der zweite Befehlshaber der Schutztruppe, die das Guardiane-Heiligtum bewachte. Wenn der Hüter noch da ist, wird es eine gewaltige Herausforderung sein.
dialogsBegin.fi: The Keeper was a force to be reckoned with, the second in command of the protective force that guarded the Guardiane Sanctuary. If the Keeper still remains... it will be a formidable challenge.
dialogsBegin.fil: The Keeper was a force to be reckoned with, the second in command of the protective force that guarded the Guardiane Sanctuary. If the Keeper still remains... it will be a formidable challenge.
dialogsBegin.fr: Le Protecteur était une force qu'on ne pouvait ignorer, le commandant en second de la force de protection qui gardait le Sanctuaire de Gardiane. Si le Protecteur est toujours là... nous avons un formidable défi devant nous !
dialogsBegin.id: Penjaga adalah kekuatan yang harus diperhitungkan, yang kedua dalam komando pasukan pelindung yang menjaga Guardiane Sanctuary. Jika Keeper masih tersisa.. itu akan menjadi tantangan yang berat.
dialogsBegin.it: The Keeper was a force to be reckoned with, the second in command of the protective force that guarded the Guardiane Sanctuary. If the Keeper still remains... it will be a formidable challenge.
dialogsBegin.jp: キーパーは考慮すべき力であり、ガーディアンサンクチュアリを守っていた保護部隊の2番目の指揮官でした。キーパーがまだ残っている場合..それは手ごわい挑戦になるでしょう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 관리자는 가르디안 성소를 지키는 수호 군대의 두 번째 지휘관이었어요. 정말 무시무시한 존재였죠. 그 관리자가 아직도 그곳을 지키고 있다면... 만만찮은 도전이 될 겁니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: The Keeper was a force to be reckoned with, the second in command of the protective force that guarded the Guardiane Sanctuary. If the Keeper still remains... it will be a formidable challenge.
dialogsBegin.pl: The Keeper was a force to be reckoned with, the second in command of the protective force that guarded the Guardiane Sanctuary. If the Keeper still remains... it will be a formidable challenge.
dialogsBegin.ru: The Keeper was a force to be reckoned with, the second in command of the protective force that guarded the Guardiane Sanctuary. If the Keeper still remains... it will be a formidable challenge.
dialogsBegin.sp: El Guadián era una fuerza a tener en cuenta, el segundo al mando de la fuerza protectora que custodiaba el Santuario Guardiane. Si el Custodio aún permanece.. será un desafío formidable.
dialogsBegin.sw: The Keeper was a force to be reckoned with, the second in command of the protective force that guarded the Guardiane Sanctuary. If the Keeper still remains... it will be a formidable challenge.
dialogsBegin.th: Keeper ทำให้เราต้องคิดกันใหม่ เป็นถึงผู้มีพลังอันดับสองที่ปกป้อง Guardiane Sanctuary ถ้า Keeper ยังคงอยู่ มันจะเป็นการท้าทายที่น่าเกรงขามทีเดียว
dialogsBegin.tw: 守護者曾是不可小覷的戰力，是保衛守護者聖域部隊中的副指揮官。如果守護者至今仍在……那會是一場極其艱難的戰鬥。
dialogsBegin.vi: The Keeper là một thế lực phải dè chừng đấy, hắn là kẻ có quyền lực đứng thứ hai trong lực lượng bảo vệ của Guardiane Sanctuary. Nếu Keeper vẫn còn .. đó sẽ là một thử thách ghê gớm.

dialogsAccept.en: You have already done so much to help uncover the truth of the Purple Magician's terrible crimes. Defeat the Keeper if you are able... and please, be careful.
dialogsAccept.ar: You have already done so much to help uncover the truth of the Purple Magician's terrible crimes. Defeat the Keeper if you are able... and please, be careful.
dialogsAccept.br: Você já fez tanto para ajudar a descobrir a verdade dos terríveis crimes da Maga Púrpura. Derrote o Guardião, se você for capaz... e por favor, tenha cuidado.
dialogsAccept.cns: You have already done so much to help uncover the truth of the Purple Magician's terrible crimes. Defeat the Keeper if you are able... and please, be careful.
dialogsAccept.de: Du hast schon so viel dazu beigetragen, die Wahrheit über die schrecklichen Verbrechen des Purpurmagiers aufzudecken. Besiege den Hüter, wenn du in der Lage bist... und sei bitte vorsichtig.
dialogsAccept.fi: You have already done so much to help uncover the truth of the Purple Magician's terrible crimes. Defeat the Keeper if you are able... and please, be careful.
dialogsAccept.fil: You have already done so much to help uncover the truth of the Purple Magician's terrible crimes. Defeat the Keeper if you are able... and please, be careful.
dialogsAccept.fr: Vous avez déjà tellement fait pour aider à découvrir la vérité sur les crimes de la Magicienne Pourpre. Terrassez le Protecteur si vous le pouvez... mais surtout, soyez prudent !
dialogsAccept.id: Kamu telah melakukan banyak hal untuk membantu mengungkap kebenaran kejahatan mengerikan Purple Magician. Kalahkan Penjaga jika mampu .. dan harap berhati-hati.
dialogsAccept.it: You have already done so much to help uncover the truth of the Purple Magician's terrible crimes. Defeat the Keeper if you are able... and please, be careful.
dialogsAccept.jp: あなたはすでに紫の魔術師の恐ろしい犯罪の真実を明らかにするのを助けるためにたくさんのことをしました。可能であればキーパーを倒してください..そして、注意してください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 당신은 이미 퍼플 매지션이 벌인 끔찍한 범죄의 진실을 밝히기 위해 엄청나게 노력하셨죠. 가능하다면 관리자를 처치해 주세요... 부디, 몸조심하시고요.
dialogsAccept.nl: You have already done so much to help uncover the truth of the Purple Magician's terrible crimes. Defeat the Keeper if you are able... and please, be careful.
dialogsAccept.pl: You have already done so much to help uncover the truth of the Purple Magician's terrible crimes. Defeat the Keeper if you are able... and please, be careful.
dialogsAccept.ru: You have already done so much to help uncover the truth of the Purple Magician's terrible crimes. Defeat the Keeper if you are able... and please, be careful.
dialogsAccept.sp: Ya has hecho mucho para ayudar a descubrir la verdad de los terribles crímenes del Mago Púrpura. Derrota al Custodio si eres capaz... y por favor, ten cuidado.
dialogsAccept.sw: You have already done so much to help uncover the truth of the Purple Magician's terrible crimes. Defeat the Keeper if you are able... and please, be careful.
dialogsAccept.th: เจ้าได้ทำอะไรสำเร็จไปเยอะมากแล้วเกี่ยวกับการเปิดเผยเรื่องของ Purple Magician ตอนนี้ช่วยกำจัด Keeper เถอะถ้าเจ้าทำได้ และได้โปรดระวังตัวด้วย
dialogsAccept.tw: 你已經為揭開紫色魔法師那可怕罪行的真相做了太多事。如果你有能力，就去擊敗守護者吧……只是，拜託你一定要小心。
dialogsAccept.vi: Bạn đã giúp chúng tôi rất nhiều trong việc làm sáng tỏ sự thật về những tội ác khủng khiếp của Purple Magician. Đánh bại Keeper nếu bạn có thể.. và làm ơn, hãy cẩn thận.

dialogsDecline.en: The Keeper stood guard over the grounds of the Guardiane Sanctuary, and dealt with intruders abruptly. Defeating the Keeper is a challenge even you may not be ready to handle.
dialogsDecline.ar: The Keeper stood guard over the grounds of the Guardiane Sanctuary, and dealt with intruders abruptly. Defeating the Keeper is a challenge even you may not be ready to handle.
dialogsDecline.br: O Guardião mantinha a guarda nos terrenos do Santuário do Guardião e não pegava leve com invasores. Encarar o Guardião é um desafio que talvez nem você esteja totalmente preparado para encarar.
dialogsDecline.cns: The Keeper stood guard over the grounds of the Guardiane Sanctuary, and dealt with intruders abruptly. Defeating the Keeper is a challenge even you may not be ready to handle.
dialogsDecline.de: Der Hüter wacht über das Gelände des Guardiane-Heiligtums und schaltet Eindringlinge schnell aus. Den Hüter zu besiegen, ist eine Herausforderung, der selbst du vielleicht nicht gewachsen bist.
dialogsDecline.fi: The Keeper stood guard over the grounds of the Guardiane Sanctuary, and dealt with intruders abruptly. Defeating the Keeper is a challenge even you may not be ready to handle.
dialogsDecline.fil: The Keeper stood guard over the grounds of the Guardiane Sanctuary, and dealt with intruders abruptly. Defeating the Keeper is a challenge even you may not be ready to handle.
dialogsDecline.fr: Le Protecteur montait la garde sur les terres du Sanctuaire de Gardiane. Il s'occupait de toute intrusion avec efficacité. Battre le Protecteur est un défi que vous-même n'êtes peut-être pas prêt à surmonter.
dialogsDecline.id: Keeper berjaga di halaman Guardians Sanctuary, dan menangani penyusup secara tiba-tiba. Mengalahkan Penjaga adalah sebuah tantangan bahkan Anda mungkin belum siap untuk menanganinya.
dialogsDecline.it: The Keeper stood guard over the grounds of the Guardiane Sanctuary, and dealt with intruders abruptly. Defeating the Keeper is a challenge even you may not be ready to handle.
dialogsDecline.jp: キーパーはガーディアンサンクチュアリの敷地を警備し、侵入者を突然処理しました。キーパーを倒すことは、あなたが対処する準備ができていなくても挑戦です。
dialogsDecline.kr: 관리자는 가르디안 성소 내부를 지키며 침입자들을 철저히 처단하고 있어요. 관리자를 처치하는 일은 당신에게도 어려운 도전이 될 겁니다.
dialogsDecline.nl: The Keeper stood guard over the grounds of the Guardiane Sanctuary, and dealt with intruders abruptly. Defeating the Keeper is a challenge even you may not be ready to handle.
dialogsDecline.pl: The Keeper stood guard over the grounds of the Guardiane Sanctuary, and dealt with intruders abruptly. Defeating the Keeper is a challenge even you may not be ready to handle.
dialogsDecline.ru: The Keeper stood guard over the grounds of the Guardiane Sanctuary, and dealt with intruders abruptly. Defeating the Keeper is a challenge even you may not be ready to handle.
dialogsDecline.sp: El Guardián vigilaba los terrenos del Santuario de los Guardianes y se enfrentaba a los intrusos con brusquedad. Derrotar al Guardián es un desafío que ni siquiera tú estás preparado para afrontar.
dialogsDecline.sw: The Keeper stood guard over the grounds of the Guardiane Sanctuary, and dealt with intruders abruptly. Defeating the Keeper is a challenge even you may not be ready to handle.
dialogsDecline.th: Keeper ยืนปกป้องผืนที่ของ Guardiane Sanctuary และคอยจัดการกับผู้บุกรุกทันทีที่เข้ามา การกำจัด Keeper อาจจะเป็นการท้าทายที่เจ้ายังไม่พร้อมก็ได้
dialogsDecline.tw: 守護者守衛著守護者聖域的地面，並突然對付入侵者。擊敗守衛者是一項挑戰，即使你可能還沒有準備好應對。
dialogsDecline.vi: The Keeper đứng canh gác trong khuôn viên của Guardiane Sanctuary, và đột ngột xử lý những kẻ xâm nhập. Đánh bại Keeper là một thách thức thậm chí bạn có thể chưa sẵn sàng để xử lý.

dialogsComplete.en: Your strength is nearly beyond belief... You are a true hero, down to the very core of who you are. The Pyramid Keeper was also a hero... and now a hero who can rest.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your strength is nearly beyond belief... You are a true hero, down to the very core of who you are. The Pyramid Keeper was also a hero... and now a hero who can rest.
dialogsComplete.br: Sua força é de tirar o fôlego... Você é um herói de verdade, até a última partícula do seu ser. O Guardião da Pirâmide também era um herói... e agora ele pode descansar em paz.
dialogsComplete.cns: Your strength is nearly beyond belief... You are a true hero, down to the very core of who you are. The Pyramid Keeper was also a hero... and now a hero who can rest.
dialogsComplete.de: Deine Stärke ist fast unvorstellbar... Du bist ein wahrer Held, bis zum tiefsten Kern dessen, was du bist. Der Pyramidenwächter war auch ein Held. Und jetzt ein Held, der sich ausruhen kann.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your strength is nearly beyond belief... You are a true hero, down to the very core of who you are. The Pyramid Keeper was also a hero... and now a hero who can rest.
dialogsComplete.fil: Your strength is nearly beyond belief... You are a true hero, down to the very core of who you are. The Pyramid Keeper was also a hero... and now a hero who can rest.
dialogsComplete.fr: Votre force est presque inimaginable... Vous êtes un véritable héros, jusqu'au plus profond de vous-même. Le Protecteur était aussi un héros... puisse-t-il reposer en paix désormais.
dialogsComplete.id: Kekuatanmu  hampir tidak dapat dipercaya .. Kamu adalah pahlawan sejati, sampai ke inti dirimu. Penjaga Piramida juga seorang pahlawan.. dan sekarang menjadi pahlawan yang bisa beristirahat.
dialogsComplete.it: Your strength is nearly beyond belief... You are a true hero, down to the very core of who you are. The Pyramid Keeper was also a hero... and now a hero who can rest.
dialogsComplete.jp: あなたの強さはほとんど信じられないほどです..あなたは、あなたが誰であるかの核心に至るまで、真のヒーローです。ピラミッドキーパーもヒーローでした..そして今、休むことができるヒーロー。
dialogsComplete.kr: 정말 믿기지 않는 힘이군요... 당신은 진정한 영웅이에요. 그 선한 마음까지도요. 피라미드 관리자도 한때는 영웅이었어요... 다행히 이제는 잠들 수 있겠죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your strength is nearly beyond belief... You are a true hero, down to the very core of who you are. The Pyramid Keeper was also a hero... and now a hero who can rest.
dialogsComplete.pl: Your strength is nearly beyond belief... You are a true hero, down to the very core of who you are. The Pyramid Keeper was also a hero... and now a hero who can rest.
dialogsComplete.ru: Your strength is nearly beyond belief... You are a true hero, down to the very core of who you are. The Pyramid Keeper was also a hero... and now a hero who can rest.
dialogsComplete.sp: Tu fuerza es casi increíble... Eres un verdadero héroe, hasta la médula de lo que eres. El Guardián de la Pirámide también era un héroe .. y ahora un héroe que puede descansar.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your strength is nearly beyond belief... You are a true hero, down to the very core of who you are. The Pyramid Keeper was also a hero... and now a hero who can rest.
dialogsComplete.th: ความแข็งแกรงของเจ้าแทบจะเหลือเชื่อ เจ้าเป็นผู้อย่างแท้จริงจนไปถึงแก่นของตัวเจ้าเลย Pyramid Keeper เองก็เป็น ผู้กล้าด้วย และตอนนี้ก็ถึงเวลาที่จะได้พักผ่อนแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的力量幾乎令人難以置信……你是真正的英雄，打從靈魂深處就是。金字塔守護者也曾是一位英雄……而現在，那名英雄終於能安息了。
dialogsComplete.vi: Sức mạnh của bạn gần như không thể tin nổi.. Bạn quả là một người hùng thực sự, mọi phẩm chất của bạn đều toát lên điều đó. Pyramid Keeper cũng từng là một người hùng.. và giờ người hùng ấy có thể yên nghỉ rồi.

dialogsFail.en: Carefully scout the grounds of the twisted Guardiane Sanctuary, and defeat whatever remains of the Pyramid Keeper.
dialogsFail.ar: Carefully scout the grounds of the twisted Guardiane Sanctuary, and defeat whatever remains of the Pyramid Keeper.
dialogsFail.br: Navegue com cautela pelos confins do Santuário Distorcido do Guardião e acabe com qualquer resquício que sobrou do Guardião da Pirâmide.
dialogsFail.cns: Carefully scout the grounds of the twisted Guardiane Sanctuary, and defeat whatever remains of the Pyramid Keeper.
dialogsFail.de: Erkundet sorgfältig das Gelände des verdrehten Guardiane-Heiligtums und besiegt die Überreste des Pyramidenwächters.
dialogsFail.fi: Carefully scout the grounds of the twisted Guardiane Sanctuary, and defeat whatever remains of the Pyramid Keeper.
dialogsFail.fil: Carefully scout the grounds of the twisted Guardiane Sanctuary, and defeat whatever remains of the Pyramid Keeper.
dialogsFail.fr: Inspectez soigneusement les environs du Sanctuaire de Gardiane et battez ce qui reste du Protecteur de la Pyramide.
dialogsFail.id: Hati-hati mengintai dasar dari Guardiane Sanctuary yang terpelintir, dan kalahkan apapun yang tersisa dari Pyramid Keeper.
dialogsFail.it: Carefully scout the grounds of the twisted Guardiane Sanctuary, and defeat whatever remains of the Pyramid Keeper.
dialogsFail.jp: ねじれたガーディアンサンクチュアリの敷地を注意深く偵察し、ピラミッドキーパーの残骸をすべて倒します。
dialogsFail.kr: 뒤틀린 가르디안 성소 내부를 조심스럽게 정찰하고, 피라미드 관리자의 남은 세력을 처치하세요.
dialogsFail.nl: Carefully scout the grounds of the twisted Guardiane Sanctuary, and defeat whatever remains of the Pyramid Keeper.
dialogsFail.pl: Carefully scout the grounds of the twisted Guardiane Sanctuary, and defeat whatever remains of the Pyramid Keeper.
dialogsFail.ru: Carefully scout the grounds of the twisted Guardiane Sanctuary, and defeat whatever remains of the Pyramid Keeper.
dialogsFail.sp: Explora con cuidado los terrenos del retorcido santuario de Guardiane y derrota a lo que quede del guardián de la pirámide.
dialogsFail.sw: Carefully scout the grounds of the twisted Guardiane Sanctuary, and defeat whatever remains of the Pyramid Keeper.
dialogsFail.th: สำรวจพื้นที่ twisted Guardiane Sanctuary อย่างระวังด้วยนะแล้วก็กำจัดอะไรก็ตามที่ยังเหลืออยู่ของ Pyramid Keeper ซะ
dialogsFail.tw: 仔細偵察扭曲的守護者聖域的地面，並擊敗金字塔守衛者的任何殘餘。
dialogsFail.vi: Cẩn thận dò tìm khu đất của twisted Guardiane Sanctuary, và đánh bại bất cứ thứ gì còn sót lại của Pyramid Keeper.

dialogsBegin.en: A small group recently went inside the catacombs, but have not returned in several hours. I fear they have fallen to whatever creatures may be inside.
dialogsBegin.ar: A small group recently went inside the catacombs, but have not returned in several hours. I fear they have fallen to whatever creatures may be inside.
dialogsBegin.br: Um pequeno grupo entrou recentemente nas catacumbas, mas não retornou há várias horas. Receio que tenham sucumbido às criaturas que podem estar lá dentro.
dialogsBegin.cns: A small group recently went inside the catacombs, but have not returned in several hours. I fear they have fallen to whatever creatures may be inside.
dialogsBegin.de: Eine kleine Gruppe ist vor kurzem in die Katakomben gegangen, aber seit mehreren Stunden nicht mehr zurückgekehrt. Ich fürchte, sie sind den Kreaturen zum Opfer gefallen, die sich dort aufhalten könnten.
dialogsBegin.fi: A small group recently went inside the catacombs, but have not returned in several hours. I fear they have fallen to whatever creatures may be inside.
dialogsBegin.fil: A small group recently went inside the catacombs, but have not returned in several hours. I fear they have fallen to whatever creatures may be inside.
dialogsBegin.fr: Un petit groupe est récemment entré dans les catacombes, mais n'est pas revenu depuis plusieurs heures. Je crains qu'ils ne soient tombés sous la coupe des créatures qui s'y trouvent.
dialogsBegin.id: Sekelompok kecil baru-baru ini masuk ke dalam catacombs, tetapi belum kembali dalam beberapa jam. Saya khawatir mereka telah jatuh ke makhluk apa pun yang mungkin ada di dalamnya.
dialogsBegin.it: A small group recently went inside the catacombs, but have not returned in several hours. I fear they have fallen to whatever creatures may be inside.
dialogsBegin.jp: 最近、小さなグループがカタコンベの中に入ったが、数時間戻ってこなかった。私は彼らが中にいるかもしれないどんな生き物にも落ちたのではないかと心配しています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 모험가 한 무리가 최근 지하 묘지 안으로 들어갔는데, 아무리 기다려도 돌아오지 않았어요. 안에 있는 괴물에게 당한 건 아닌지 걱정이 되어서요.
dialogsBegin.nl: A small group recently went inside the catacombs, but have not returned in several hours. I fear they have fallen to whatever creatures may be inside.
dialogsBegin.pl: A small group recently went inside the catacombs, but have not returned in several hours. I fear they have fallen to whatever creatures may be inside.
dialogsBegin.ru: A small group recently went inside the catacombs, but have not returned in several hours. I fear they have fallen to whatever creatures may be inside.
dialogsBegin.sp: Un pequeño grupo entró recientemente en las catacumbas, pero no han regresado en varias horas. Temo que hayan caído ante cualquier criatura que pueda haber dentro.
dialogsBegin.sw: A small group recently went inside the catacombs, but have not returned in several hours. I fear they have fallen to whatever creatures may be inside.
dialogsBegin.th: เพิ่งมีกลุ่มเล็ก ๆ เข้าไปในสุสาน แต่พวกเขายังไม่กลับมาหลายชั่วโมงแล้ว ข้าเกรงว่าพวกเขาจะพลาดท่าให้กับพวกสัตว์ร้ายที่อยู๋ข้างในเสียแล้ว
dialogsBegin.tw: 最近有一小隊人進了這座地下墓穴，但幾個小時過去了還沒回來。我擔心他們已經死在裡頭那些怪物手上了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Một nhóm nhỏ gần đây đã vào bên trong catacombs, nhưng đã không quay trở lại trong vài giờ. Tôi e rằng họ đã rơi vào tay bất cứ sinh vật nào có thể ở bên trong.

dialogsBegin.en: A thick webbing has appeared around the entrance, and I hear loud footsteps not far within the depths of the ruins.
dialogsBegin.ar: A thick webbing has appeared around the entrance, and I hear loud footsteps not far within the depths of the ruins.
dialogsBegin.br: Uma teia espessa surgiu ao redor da entrada, e ouço passos pesados ressoando nas profundezas das ruínas.
dialogsBegin.cns: A thick webbing has appeared around the entrance, and I hear loud footsteps not far within the depths of the ruins.
dialogsBegin.de: Ein dickes Netz hat sich um den Eingang gelegt, und ich höre laute Schritte nicht weit in den Tiefen der Ruinen.
dialogsBegin.fi: A thick webbing has appeared around the entrance, and I hear loud footsteps not far within the depths of the ruins.
dialogsBegin.fil: A thick webbing has appeared around the entrance, and I hear loud footsteps not far within the depths of the ruins.
dialogsBegin.fr: Une toile épaisse est apparue autour de l'entrée, et j'entends des pas bruyants non loin dans les profondeurs des ruines.
dialogsBegin.id: Jaring tebal telah muncul di sekitar pintu masuk, dan aku mendengar langkah kaki yang keras tidak jauh dari kedalaman reruntuhan.
dialogsBegin.it: A thick webbing has appeared around the entrance, and I hear loud footsteps not far within the depths of the ruins.
dialogsBegin.jp: 入り口の周りに厚い水かきが現れ、遺跡の奥深くでそれほど遠くないところで大きな足音が聞こえます。
dialogsBegin.kr: 입구 주변에 굵은 거미줄이 나타났어요. 폐허 깊숙한 곳에서 큰 발소리도 들리고요.
dialogsBegin.nl: A thick webbing has appeared around the entrance, and I hear loud footsteps not far within the depths of the ruins.
dialogsBegin.pl: A thick webbing has appeared around the entrance, and I hear loud footsteps not far within the depths of the ruins.
dialogsBegin.ru: A thick webbing has appeared around the entrance, and I hear loud footsteps not far within the depths of the ruins.
dialogsBegin.sp: Una gruesa telaraña ha aparecido alrededor de la entrada, y oigo fuertes pasos no muy lejos en las profundidades de las ruinas.
dialogsBegin.sw: A thick webbing has appeared around the entrance, and I hear loud footsteps not far within the depths of the ruins.
dialogsBegin.th: ใยแมงมุมหนา ๆ ปรากฏขึ้นรอบ ๆ ทางเข้าและข้าก็ได้ยินเสียงฝีเท้าที่ดังมากออกมาจากด้านในของทรากซากปรักหักพังนั่น
dialogsBegin.tw: 入口周圍出現了厚厚的蛛網，而且我能聽見遺跡深處傳來沉重的腳步聲。
dialogsBegin.vi: Một mạng lưới dày đã xuất hiện xung quanh lối vào, và tôi nghe thấy tiếng bước chân lớn cách đó không xa sâu trong đống đổ nát.

dialogsAccept.en: Go inside and find out what happened to the group before you.
dialogsAccept.ar: Go inside and find out what happened to the group before you.
dialogsAccept.br: Entre e descubra o que aconteceu com o grupo que foi antes de você.
dialogsAccept.cns: Go inside and find out what happened to the group before you.
dialogsAccept.de: Geh hinein und finde heraus, was mit der Gruppe vor dir passiert ist.
dialogsAccept.fi: Go inside and find out what happened to the group before you.
dialogsAccept.fil: Go inside and find out what happened to the group before you.
dialogsAccept.fr: Allez à l'intérieur et découvrez ce qui est arrivé au groupe qui vous a précédé.
dialogsAccept.id: Masuk ke dalam dan cari tahu apa yang terjadi pada grup sebelum Anda.
dialogsAccept.it: Go inside and find out what happened to the group before you.
dialogsAccept.jp: 中に入って、あなたの前にグループに何が起こったのかを調べてください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 안으로 들어가서 앞의 일행에게 무슨 일이 일어났는지 알아보세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Go inside and find out what happened to the group before you.
dialogsAccept.pl: Go inside and find out what happened to the group before you.
dialogsAccept.ru: Go inside and find out what happened to the group before you.
dialogsAccept.sp: Entra y averigua qué le ocurrió al grupo que te precedió.
dialogsAccept.sw: Go inside and find out what happened to the group before you.
dialogsAccept.th: เข้าไปด้านในเพื่อคนหาว่าเกิดอะไรขึ้นกับกลุ่มที่เข้าไปก่อนหน้าเจ้า
dialogsAccept.tw: 進去看看，在你之前進去的那群人到底發生了什麼事。
dialogsAccept.vi: Đi vào bên trong và tìm hiểu những gì đã xảy ra với nhóm trước bạn.

dialogsDecline.en: Scared of a few spiders? Those poor adventurers...
dialogsDecline.ar: Scared of a few spiders? Those poor adventurers...
dialogsDecline.br: Com medo de algumas aranhas? Coitados dos aventureiros...
dialogsDecline.cns: Scared of a few spiders? Those poor adventurers...
dialogsDecline.de: Angst vor ein paar Spinnen? Diese armen Abenteurer...
dialogsDecline.fi: Scared of a few spiders? Those poor adventurers...
dialogsDecline.fil: Scared of a few spiders? Those poor adventurers...
dialogsDecline.fr: Quelques araignées vous font peur ? Ces pauvres aventuriers..
dialogsDecline.id: Takut dengan beberapa laba-laba? Para petualang yang malang itu..
dialogsDecline.it: Scared of a few spiders? Those poor adventurers...
dialogsDecline.jp: いくつかのクモが怖いですか?あの哀れな冒険者たち..
dialogsDecline.kr: 거미 몇 마리가 무서운가요? 불쌍한 모험가들 같으니...
dialogsDecline.nl: Scared of a few spiders? Those poor adventurers...
dialogsDecline.pl: Scared of a few spiders? Those poor adventurers...
dialogsDecline.ru: Scared of a few spiders? Those poor adventurers...
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Asustado de unas arañas? Esos pobres aventureros..
dialogsDecline.sw: Scared of a few spiders? Those poor adventurers...
dialogsDecline.th: กลัวแมงมุมแค่ไม่กี่ตัวเนี่ยนะ...นักผจญภัยที่น่าสงสารพวกนี้.......
dialogsDecline.tw: 只是幾隻蜘蛛你就怕了？那些可憐的冒險家啊……
dialogsDecline.vi: Một vài con nhện mà cũng sợ à? Những kẻ thám hiểm đáng thương...

dialogsComplete.en: I see... so you found only the remains of their armor. It is a shame what has happened, but you seem to be strong enough to continue pushing deeper into the ruins.
dialogsComplete.ar: I see... so you found only the remains of their armor. It is a shame what has happened, but you seem to be strong enough to continue pushing deeper into the ruins.
dialogsComplete.br: Entendi... então você só encontrou os pedaços das armaduras deles. É uma pena o que aconteceu, mas você parece ser bem forte para seguir em frente e explorar as profundezas das ruínas.
dialogsComplete.cns: I see... so you found only the remains of their armor. It is a shame what has happened, but you seem to be strong enough to continue pushing deeper into the ruins.
dialogsComplete.de: Ich verstehe... du hast also nur die Überreste ihrer Rüstung gefunden. Es ist eine Schande, was geschehen ist, aber du scheinst stark genug zu sein, um weiter in die Ruinen vorzudringen.
dialogsComplete.fi: I see... so you found only the remains of their armor. It is a shame what has happened, but you seem to be strong enough to continue pushing deeper into the ruins.
dialogsComplete.fil: I see... so you found only the remains of their armor. It is a shame what has happened, but you seem to be strong enough to continue pushing deeper into the ruins.
dialogsComplete.fr: Je vois... Vous n'avez donc trouvé que les restes de leur armure. C'est dommage ce qui s'est passé, mais vous semblez assez forts pour continuer à vous enfoncer dans les ruines.
dialogsComplete.id: Begitu ya.. jadi kamu hanya menemukan sisa-sisa armor mereka. Sungguh memalukan apa yang telah terjadi, tetapi kamu tampaknya cukup kuat untuk terus mendorong lebih dalam ke reruntuhan.
dialogsComplete.it: I see... so you found only the remains of their armor. It is a shame what has happened, but you seem to be strong enough to continue pushing deeper into the ruins.
dialogsComplete.jp: なるほど。。それで、あなたは彼らの鎧の残骸だけを見つけました。何が起こったのか残念ですが、あなたは廃墟の奥深くに押し込み続けるのに十分強いようです。
dialogsComplete.kr: 그렇군요... 방어구의 잔해만 찾았단 거군요. 그런 일이 일어나다니 정말 안타깝네요. 하지만 당신은 폐허 깊숙한 곳까지 들어갈 수 있을 정도로 강해 보이네요.
dialogsComplete.nl: I see... so you found only the remains of their armor. It is a shame what has happened, but you seem to be strong enough to continue pushing deeper into the ruins.
dialogsComplete.pl: I see... so you found only the remains of their armor. It is a shame what has happened, but you seem to be strong enough to continue pushing deeper into the ruins.
dialogsComplete.ru: I see... so you found only the remains of their armor. It is a shame what has happened, but you seem to be strong enough to continue pushing deeper into the ruins.
dialogsComplete.sp: Ya veo .. así que sólo encontraste los restos de su armadura. Es una lástima lo que ha pasado, pero parece que eres lo suficientemente fuerte como para seguir empujando más profundamente en las ruinas.
dialogsComplete.sw: I see... so you found only the remains of their armor. It is a shame what has happened, but you seem to be strong enough to continue pushing deeper into the ruins.
dialogsComplete.th: ข้าเข้าใจล่ะ เจ้าเจอแต่ชิ้นสวนเกราะของพวกเขา มันแย่จริง ๆ กับสิ่งที่เกิดขึ้น แต่เจ้าดูเหมือนจะแข็งแกร่งพอ ที่ไปต่อได้เรื่อย ๆ สินะ
dialogsComplete.tw: 原來如此……所以你只找到了他們鎧甲的殘骸。真是遺憾，不過看來你夠強，還能繼續往遺跡更深處推進。
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi hiểu rồi.. vậy là bạn chỉ tìm thấy phần áo giáp còn sót lại của họ. Những gì đã xảy ra thật đáng tiếc, nhưng bạn có vẻ đủ kiên cường để tiếp tục bước sâu hơn vào khu tàn tích.

dialogsBegin.en: With the smelting complete, it's time to craft an army's worth of armor!
dialogsBegin.ar: With the smelting complete, it's time to craft an army's worth of armor!
dialogsBegin.br: Com o processo de fundição finalizado, é hora de forjar armaduras em quantidade suficiente para um exército inteiro!
dialogsBegin.cns: With the smelting complete, it's time to craft an army's worth of armor!
dialogsBegin.de: Nach dem Schmelzen ist es an der Zeit, Rüstungen für eine ganze Armee herzustellen!
dialogsBegin.fi: With the smelting complete, it's time to craft an army's worth of armor!
dialogsBegin.fil: With the smelting complete, it's time to craft an army's worth of armor!
dialogsBegin.fr: Maintenant que la fonte est terminée, il est temps de monter une armée digne de ces armures !
dialogsBegin.id: Dengan peleburan selesai, saatnya untuk membuat baju besi senilai pasukan!
dialogsBegin.it: With the smelting complete, it's time to craft an army's worth of armor!
dialogsBegin.jp: 製錬が完了したら、軍隊に相当する鎧を作りましょう!
dialogsBegin.kr: 제련이 완료되었으니, 이제 군대를 위한 방어구를 제작할 차례네요!

dialogsBegin.th: เมื่อการหลอมเสร็จสิ้นแล้ว ถึงเวลาสร้างกองทัพที่เหมาะสมสำหรับเกราะเหล่านี้ล่ะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 金屬既然已經熔好，接下來就是打造足夠一支軍隊使用的鎧甲了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Khi quá trình nấu chảy hoàn tất, đã đến lúc chế tạo áo giáp đáng giá cho quân đội!

dialogsAccept.en: Alright, head back to Chenbing. Work with him to start crafting the armor we'll need to win the battle against Lapranche!
dialogsAccept.ar: Alright, head back to Chenbing. Work with him to start crafting the armor we'll need to win the battle against Lapranche!
dialogsAccept.br: Certo, volte para Chenbing. Trabalhe com ele para começar a criar as armaduras de que precisaremos para vencer a batalha contra Lapranche!
dialogsAccept.cns: Alright, head back to Chenbing. Work with him to start crafting the armor we'll need to win the battle against Lapranche!
dialogsAccept.de: Also gut, geht zurück zu Chenbing. Beginne mit ihm, die Rüstung herzustellen, die wir brauchen, um den Kampf gegen Lapranche zu gewinnen!
dialogsAccept.fi: Alright, head back to Chenbing. Work with him to start crafting the armor we'll need to win the battle against Lapranche!
dialogsAccept.fil: Alright, head back to Chenbing. Work with him to start crafting the armor we'll need to win the battle against Lapranche!
dialogsAccept.fr: Ok, retournez vers Chenbing. Travaillez avec lui pour début la fabrication des armures dont nous avons besoin pour gagner la bataille contre Lapranche !
dialogsAccept.id: Baiklah, kembali ke Chenbing. Bekerja dengannya untuk mulai membuat baju zirah yang kita perlukan untuk memenangkan pertempuran melawan Lapranche!
dialogsAccept.it: Alright, head back to Chenbing. Work with him to start crafting the armor we'll need to win the battle against Lapranche!
dialogsAccept.jp: よし、チェンビンに戻る。彼と協力して、ラプランシュとの戦いに勝つために必要な鎧を作り始めましょう!
dialogsAccept.kr: 좋아요, 이제 첸빙에게 돌아가세요. 첸빙과 같이, 라프란체와의 전투를 위한 방어구 제작을 시작해 보세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Alright, head back to Chenbing. Work with him to start crafting the armor we'll need to win the battle against Lapranche!
dialogsAccept.pl: Alright, head back to Chenbing. Work with him to start crafting the armor we'll need to win the battle against Lapranche!
dialogsAccept.ru: Alright, head back to Chenbing. Work with him to start crafting the armor we'll need to win the battle against Lapranche!
dialogsAccept.sp: Muy bien, regresa con Chenbing. Trabaja con él para empezar a fabricar la armadura que necesitaremos para ganar la batalla contra Lapranche.
dialogsAccept.sw: Alright, head back to Chenbing. Work with him to start crafting the armor we'll need to win the battle against Lapranche!
dialogsAccept.th: เอาล่ะ มุ่งหน้ากลับไปยัง Chenbing ทำงานร่วมกับเขาเพื่อเริ่มสร้างเกราะที่เราต้องการเพื่อที่จะเอาชนะ Lapranche!
dialogsAccept.tw: 好了，回到趁風身邊。與他一起開始製作我們贏得與拉普朗什戰鬥所需的盔甲！
dialogsAccept.vi: Được rồi, quay trở lại Chenbing. Hợp tác với anh ấy để bắt đầu chế tạo áo giáp mà chúng ta cần để giành chiến thắng trong trận chiến với Lapranche!

dialogsDecline.en: Crafting is tough work. It's not for everybody.
dialogsDecline.ar: Crafting is tough work. It's not for everybody.

dialogsDecline.cns: Crafting is tough work. It's not for everybody.
dialogsDecline.de: Kunsthandwerk ist harte Arbeit. Es ist nicht für jeden etwas.
dialogsDecline.fi: Crafting is tough work. It's not for everybody.
dialogsDecline.fil: Crafting is tough work. It's not for everybody.
dialogsDecline.fr: L'artisanat c'est compliqué ! Ce n'est pas pour tout le monde.
dialogsDecline.id: Kerajinan adalah pekerjaan yang sulit. Ini bukan untuk semua orang.
dialogsDecline.it: Crafting is tough work. It's not for everybody.
dialogsDecline.jp: クラフトは大変な作業です。それは皆のためではありません。
dialogsDecline.kr: 제작은 쉬운 일이 아니죠. 아무나 하는 게 아니에요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Crafting is tough work. It's not for everybody.
dialogsDecline.pl: Crafting is tough work. It's not for everybody.
dialogsDecline.ru: Crafting is tough work. It's not for everybody.
dialogsDecline.sp: La artesanía es un trabajo duro. No es para todos.
dialogsDecline.sw: Crafting is tough work. It's not for everybody.
dialogsDecline.th: การสร้างงานแบบนี้เป็นงานยาก มันไม่ใช่สิ่งที่ทุกคนทำได้
dialogsDecline.tw: 打造裝備可是重勞力活，不是每個人都做得來。
dialogsDecline.vi: Chế tạo là công việc khó khăn. Nó không dành cho tất cả mọi người.

dialogsComplete.en: Well done, we have everything needed to bolster an army of adventurers against the Black Magician!
dialogsComplete.ar: Well done, we have everything needed to bolster an army of adventurers against the Black Magician!
dialogsComplete.br: Muito bem, temos tudo o que é necessário para fortalecer um exército de aventureiros contra a Maga Negra!
dialogsComplete.cns: Well done, we have everything needed to bolster an army of adventurers against the Black Magician!
dialogsComplete.de: Gut gemacht, wir haben alles, was wir brauchen, um eine Armee von Abenteurern gegen den Schwarzen Magier zu verstärken!
dialogsComplete.fi: Well done, we have everything needed to bolster an army of adventurers against the Black Magician!
dialogsComplete.fil: Well done, we have everything needed to bolster an army of adventurers against the Black Magician!
dialogsComplete.fr: Bien joué, nous avons tout ce qu'il faut pour renforcer une armée d'aventuriers contre le Magicien Noir !
dialogsComplete.id: Kerja bagus, kami memiliki semua yang dibutuhkan untuk memperkuat pasukan petualang melawan Black Magician!

dialogsBegin.en: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.ar: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.

dialogsBegin.cns: 欢迎回来，英雄！据报告，深渊之塔中出现了新的威胁。请前去找到并消灭 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$
dialogsBegin.de: Willkommen zurück, Held! Berichte zufolge wartet im Verlassenen Turm eine neue Bedrohung. Suche und töte die $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.

dialogsBegin.kr: 돌아온 걸 환영해요, 용사님! 버려진 탑에 위협이 발생했다는 보고를 받았어요. 버려진 탑에서 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$을(를) 찾아 없애주세요.

dialogsBegin.th: ยินดีต้อนรับกลับมาฮีโร่! มีรายงานมาว่าพบกันอันตรายใหม่เกิดขึ้นที่ Forsaken Tower โปรดไปค้นหาและทำลาย $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ให้สิ้นซาก

dialogsBegin.vi: Chào mừng trở lại hero! Có báo cáo về một mối đe dọa mới trong Forsaken Tower. Vui lòng tìm kiếm và loại bỏ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.

dialogsDecline.en: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.ar: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.br: A Torre está infestada de masquerpets perigosos. Entendo se não quiser correr o risco.
dialogsDecline.cns: 这座塔里到处都是危险的假面怪。如果你不想冒这个险，我完全理解。

dialogsDecline.jp: タワーは危険なモンスターでいっぱいです。あなたがリスクを冒したくないのなら、私は理解しています。
dialogsDecline.kr: 탑에는 위험한 마스커펫이 가득해요. 위험을 감수하고 싶지 않다고 하셔도 이해합니다.

dialogsDecline.th: Tower เต็มไปด้วย masquerpets ที่อันตราย ข้าเข้าใจดีถ้าเจ้าไม่อยากเสี่ยงอันตราย

dialogsBegin.en: The murky darkness clouding our vision of the future clears up with the use of these special herbs, when combined with a powerful cursed item. It takes a toll on me every time...
dialogsBegin.ar: The murky darkness clouding our vision of the future clears up with the use of these special herbs, when combined with a powerful cursed item. It takes a toll on me every time...
dialogsBegin.br: A névoa escura que encobre nossa visão do futuro se dissipa com o uso dessas ervas especiais, quando combinadas com um item amaldiçoado poderoso. É uma carga pesada para mim toda vez que faço isso...
dialogsBegin.cns: The murky darkness clouding our vision of the future clears up with the use of these special herbs, when combined with a powerful cursed item. It takes a toll on me every time...
dialogsBegin.de: Die trübe Dunkelheit, die unsere Sicht auf die Zukunft trübt, wird durch die Verwendung dieser besonderen Kräuter in Verbindung mit einem mächtigen verfluchten Gegenstand gelichtet. Es fordert jedes Mal seinen Tribut von mir...

dialogsBegin.id: Kegelapan suram yang mengaburkan pandangan kita tentang masa depan akan hilang dengan penggunaan ramuan khusus ini, jika digabungkan dengan benda terkutuk yang kuat. Dibutuhkan tol padaku setiap kali ..
dialogsBegin.it: The murky darkness clouding our vision of the future clears up with the use of these special herbs, when combined with a powerful cursed item. It takes a toll on me every time...
dialogsBegin.jp: 未来のビジョンを曇らせている暗い闇は、強力な呪われたアイテムと組み合わせると、これらの特別なハーブを使用することでクリアされます。それは毎回私に負担をかけます..
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 특별한 약초와 강력한 저주 아이템을 합치면... 미래를 향한 우리의 시야를 가리는 흐릿한 어둠이 걷히게 되지요. 매번 저를 힘들게 하긴 하지만...
dialogsBegin.nl: The murky darkness clouding our vision of the future clears up with the use of these special herbs, when combined with a powerful cursed item. It takes a toll on me every time...
dialogsBegin.pl: The murky darkness clouding our vision of the future clears up with the use of these special herbs, when combined with a powerful cursed item. It takes a toll on me every time...
dialogsBegin.ru: The murky darkness clouding our vision of the future clears up with the use of these special herbs, when combined with a powerful cursed item. It takes a toll on me every time...
dialogsBegin.sp: La turbia oscuridad que nubla nuestra visión del futuro se aclara con el uso de estas hierbas especiales, cuando se combinan con un poderoso objeto maldito. Me pasa factura cada vez..
dialogsBegin.sw: The murky darkness clouding our vision of the future clears up with the use of these special herbs, when combined with a powerful cursed item. It takes a toll on me every time...
dialogsBegin.th: ความมืดมนได้บดบังอนาคตของพวกเรา จะถูกทำให้กระจ่างด้วยสมุนไพรพวกนี้ และเมื่อมันผสมกับเข้ากับไอเทมต้องสาป มันทำให้ข้าต้องเจ็บปวดทุกครั้งไป
dialogsBegin.tw: 這些特殊草藥加上強力的詛咒物品，能驅散遮蔽我們對未來視線的陰霾黑暗。不過每用一次，對我都是巨大的負擔……
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có thể xua đi bóng tối u ám che phủ tầm nhìn của chúng ta về tương lai bằng cách sử dụng các loại thảo mộc đặc biệt này cùng với một vật phẩm bị nguyền rủa đầy sức mạnh. Và tôi phải trả cái giá khá đắt mỗi khi dùng cách này...

dialogsBegin.en: The darkness is lifting! And the truth is just as I feared... remnants of the lightning god, Ishirut, have stirred, creating a powerful beast that hides in the stormy mountains of the Garden of Rhisis...
dialogsBegin.ar: The darkness is lifting! And the truth is just as I feared... remnants of the lightning god, Ishirut, have stirred, creating a powerful beast that hides in the stormy mountains of the Garden of Rhisis...
dialogsBegin.br: A escuridão está se dissipando! E a verdade é tão assustadora quanto eu imaginava... fragmentos do deus do trovão, Ishirut, se agitaram, dando origem a uma criatura poderosa que se esconde nas montanhas tempestuosas do Jardim de Rhisis...
dialogsBegin.cns: The darkness is lifting! And the truth is just as I feared... remnants of the lightning god, Ishirut, have stirred, creating a powerful beast that hides in the stormy mountains of the Garden of Rhisis...
dialogsBegin.de: Die Dunkelheit lichtet sich! Und die Wahrheit ist genau so, wie ich befürchtet habe... Überreste des Blitzgottes Ishirut haben sich gerührt und eine mächtige Bestie erschaffen, die sich in den stürmischen Bergen des Gartens von Rhisis versteckt...
dialogsBegin.fi: The darkness is lifting! And the truth is just as I feared... remnants of the lightning god, Ishirut, have stirred, creating a powerful beast that hides in the stormy mountains of the Garden of Rhisis...
dialogsBegin.fil: The darkness is lifting! And the truth is just as I feared... remnants of the lightning god, Ishirut, have stirred, creating a powerful beast that hides in the stormy mountains of the Garden of Rhisis...
dialogsBegin.fr: Les ténèbres se dissipent ! Et la vérité est exactement ce que je craignais... des vestiges du dieu de la foudre, Ishirut, se sont réveillés, créant une bête puissante qui se cache dans les montagnes orageuses du Jardin de Rhisis...
dialogsBegin.id: Kegelapan terangkat! Dan kebenarannya seperti yang kutakutkan.. sisa-sisa dewa petir, Ishirut, telah bergerak, menciptakan binatang buas yang kuat yang bersembunyi di pegunungan badai di Garden of Rhisis..
dialogsBegin.it: The darkness is lifting! And the truth is just as I feared... remnants of the lightning god, Ishirut, have stirred, creating a powerful beast that hides in the stormy mountains of the Garden of Rhisis...
dialogsBegin.jp: 暗闇が解き放たれています!そして真実は私が恐れていた通りです..稲妻の神イシルートの残党がかき混ぜられ、リシスの庭の嵐の山々に隠れる強力な獣を生み出しました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 어둠이 걷히고 있어요! 그리고 진실은 제가 두려워했던 그대로군요... 번개의 신 이실루트의 추종 세력들이 리시스의 정원에 있는 폭풍우 치는 산속에 강력한 괴물을 만들어 숨겨 두었어요...
dialogsBegin.nl: The darkness is lifting! And the truth is just as I feared... remnants of the lightning god, Ishirut, have stirred, creating a powerful beast that hides in the stormy mountains of the Garden of Rhisis...
dialogsBegin.pl: The darkness is lifting! And the truth is just as I feared... remnants of the lightning god, Ishirut, have stirred, creating a powerful beast that hides in the stormy mountains of the Garden of Rhisis...
dialogsBegin.ru: The darkness is lifting! And the truth is just as I feared... remnants of the lightning god, Ishirut, have stirred, creating a powerful beast that hides in the stormy mountains of the Garden of Rhisis...
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡La oscuridad se está disipando! Y la verdad es tal y como me temía.. restos del dios del rayo, Ishirut, se han agitado, creando una poderosa bestia que se esconde en las montañas tormentosas del Jardín de Rhisis..
dialogsBegin.sw: The darkness is lifting! And the truth is just as I feared... remnants of the lightning god, Ishirut, have stirred, creating a powerful beast that hides in the stormy mountains of the Garden of Rhisis...
dialogsBegin.th: ความมืดได้หายออกไปแล้ว และความจริงก็เป็นอย่างที่ข้ากลัว เศษเสี้ยวของเทพสายฟ้า Ishirut ยังคงอยู่และได้สร้างสัตว์ร้ายทรงพลังที่ซ่อนตัวอยู่ในหุบเขาแห่งพายุ ณ Garden of Rhisis..
dialogsBegin.tw: 黑暗正在消散！而真相正如我所擔心的一樣……雷神伊希魯特的殘響已被驚動，並孕育出一頭強大的怪物，躲藏在黎席斯庭院暴風肆虐的群山之中……
dialogsBegin.vi: Bóng tối đang dần được hé lộ! Và sự thật đúng như những gì tôi lo sợ... tàn dư của thần sét Ishirut đã khuấy động và tạo ra một con quái vật mạnh mẽ ẩn náu trong vùng núi giông bão của Garden of Rhisis..

dialogsAccept.en: I am too weak from the ritual to do anything about the remnant of Ishirut, but here is a map that will lead you to where the creature is hiding.
dialogsAccept.ar: I am too weak from the ritual to do anything about the remnant of Ishirut, but here is a map that will lead you to where the creature is hiding.
dialogsAccept.br: Estou tão exausto após o ritual para fazer algo em relação ao remanescente de Ishirut, mas aqui está um mapa que o guiará até onde a criatura está se escondendo.
dialogsAccept.cns: I am too weak from the ritual to do anything about the remnant of Ishirut, but here is a map that will lead you to where the creature is hiding.
dialogsAccept.de: Ich bin von dem Ritutal zu geschwächt um etwas gegen die Überreste von Ishirut zu unternehmen, aber hier ist eine Karte, die dich zu dem Versteck der Kreatur führen wird.
dialogsAccept.fi: I am too weak from the ritual to do anything about the remnant of Ishirut, but here is a map that will lead you to where the creature is hiding.
dialogsAccept.fil: I am too weak from the ritual to do anything about the remnant of Ishirut, but here is a map that will lead you to where the creature is hiding.
dialogsAccept.fr: Je suis trop affaibli par le rituel pour faire quoi que ce soit au sujet des restes d'Ishirut, mais voici une carte qui vous mènera à l'endroit où se cache la créature.
dialogsAccept.id: Saya terlalu lemah dari ritual untuk melakukan apa pun tentang sisa-sisa Ishirut, tetapi ini adalah peta yang akan membawa Anda ke tempat persembunyian makhluk itu.
dialogsAccept.it: I am too weak from the ritual to do anything about the remnant of Ishirut, but here is a map that will lead you to where the creature is hiding.
dialogsAccept.jp: 私は儀式から弱すぎてイシルートの残党について何もできませんが、ここに生き物が隠れている場所にあなたを導く地図があります。
dialogsAccept.kr: 저는 의식을 치른 후 너무 약해져서, 이실루트의 남은 힘을 막을 수 없었죠. 여기 그 괴물이 있는 곳을 알려주는 지도가 있어요.
dialogsAccept.nl: I am too weak from the ritual to do anything about the remnant of Ishirut, but here is a map that will lead you to where the creature is hiding.
dialogsAccept.pl: I am too weak from the ritual to do anything about the remnant of Ishirut, but here is a map that will lead you to where the creature is hiding.
dialogsAccept.ru: I am too weak from the ritual to do anything about the remnant of Ishirut, but here is a map that will lead you to where the creature is hiding.
dialogsAccept.sp: Estoy demasiado débil por el ritual para hacer algo con los restos de Ishirut, pero aquí tienes un mapa que te llevará a donde se esconde la criatura.
dialogsAccept.sw: I am too weak from the ritual to do anything about the remnant of Ishirut, but here is a map that will lead you to where the creature is hiding.
dialogsAccept.th: ข้าอ่อนแอเกินไปจากการทำพิธีกรรม เกินกว่าที่ข้าจะทำอะไรเกี่ยวกับเศษที่หลงเหลือของ Ishirut ได้ แต่แผนที่นี่จะนำเจ้าไปสู่ที่ซ่อนตัวของเจ้าสัตว์ร้ายนั่น
dialogsAccept.tw: 這場儀式讓我虛弱到無法親自處理伊希魯特的殘響，但這裡有一張地圖，它會帶你前往那頭怪物的藏身處。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi quá yếu sau nghi lễ không thể làm bất cứ điều gì với remnant of Ishirut, nhưng đây là bản đồ sẽ dẫn bạn đến nơi sinh vật đang ẩn náu.

dialogsDecline.en: Ishirut was known to be one of the most powerful beings in existence... fear of them is nothing to be ashamed of.
dialogsDecline.ar: Ishirut was known to be one of the most powerful beings in existence... fear of them is nothing to be ashamed of.
dialogsDecline.br: Ishirut era famoso por ser um dos seres mais poderosos que já existiram... ter medo deles não é nada para se envergonhar.
dialogsDecline.cns: Ishirut was known to be one of the most powerful beings in existence... fear of them is nothing to be ashamed of.
dialogsDecline.de: Ishirut war als eines der mächtigsten Wesen bekannt, man muss sich nicht schämen, sich zu fürchten.
dialogsDecline.fi: Ishirut was known to be one of the most powerful beings in existence... fear of them is nothing to be ashamed of.
dialogsDecline.fil: Ishirut was known to be one of the most powerful beings in existence... fear of them is nothing to be ashamed of.
dialogsDecline.fr: Ishirut était connu pour être l'un des êtres les plus puissants de l'existence... il n'y a pas de quoi avoir honte de les craindre.
dialogsDecline.id: Ishirut dikenal sebagai salah satu makhluk paling kuat yang ada.. takut pada mereka bukanlah hal yang memalukan.
dialogsDecline.it: Ishirut was known to be one of the most powerful beings in existence... fear of them is nothing to be ashamed of.
dialogsDecline.jp: イシルートは、現存する中で最も強力な存在の一人として知られていました。彼らへの恐れは恥ずべきことではありません
dialogsDecline.kr: 이실루트는 최강을 논할 때 빠지지 않는 존재입니다... 두렵더라도 부끄러워할 일이 아니에요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Ishirut was known to be one of the most powerful beings in existence... fear of them is nothing to be ashamed of.
dialogsDecline.pl: Ishirut was known to be one of the most powerful beings in existence... fear of them is nothing to be ashamed of.
dialogsDecline.ru: Ishirut was known to be one of the most powerful beings in existence... fear of them is nothing to be ashamed of.
dialogsDecline.sp: Ishirut era conocido por ser uno de los seres más poderosos que existen... temerles no es nada de lo que avergonzarse.
dialogsDecline.sw: Ishirut was known to be one of the most powerful beings in existence... fear of them is nothing to be ashamed of.
dialogsDecline.th: Ishirut นั้นเป็นที่รู้จักกันว่าเป็นสิ่งที่ทรงพลังที่สุดที่เคยมีมา...การที่จะเกรงกลัวก็ไม่ใช่เรื่องผิดอะไร
dialogsDecline.tw: 伊希魯特曾被視為最強大的存在之一……對那種存在心懷敬畏，並不是什麼可恥的事。
dialogsDecline.vi: Ishirut được biết đến là một trong những sinh vật mạnh nhất còn tồn tại nơi đây...Không có gì phải xấu hổ khi bạn thấy sợ hãi chúng cả.

dialogsComplete.en: Ah, the MewMew clan sent word of your arrival. I have been stationed outside this ruined temple to prevent travelers from facing death before their time has come. Inside are beasts of great power.
dialogsComplete.ar: Ah, the MewMew clan sent word of your arrival. I have been stationed outside this ruined temple to prevent travelers from facing death before their time has come. Inside are beasts of great power.
dialogsComplete.br: Ah, o clã MewMew me mandou um recado sobre a sua chegada. Fui colocado aqui do lado de fora deste templo em ruínas para evitar que aventureiros enfrentem a morte prematuramente. Lá dentro, há bestas de poder imenso.
dialogsComplete.cns: Ah, the MewMew clan sent word of your arrival. I have been stationed outside this ruined temple to prevent travelers from facing death before their time has come. Inside are beasts of great power.
dialogsComplete.de: Ah, der MewMew-Klan hat mich über deine Ankunft informiert. Ich wurde vor dieser Tempelruine stationiert, um zu verhindern, dass Reisende den Tod finden, bevor ihre Zeit gekommen ist. Im Inneren befinden sich Bestien von großer Macht.
dialogsComplete.fi: Ah, the MewMew clan sent word of your arrival. I have been stationed outside this ruined temple to prevent travelers from facing death before their time has come. Inside are beasts of great power.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ah, the MewMew clan sent word of your arrival. I have been stationed outside this ruined temple to prevent travelers from facing death before their time has come. Inside are beasts of great power.
dialogsComplete.fr: Ah, le clan MewMew a annoncé votre arrivée. J'ai été posté à l'extérieur de ce temple en ruines pour empêcher les voyageurs de mourir avant l'heure. À l'intérieur se trouvent des bêtes d'une grande puissance.
dialogsComplete.id: Ah, klan MewMew mengirim kabar kedatanganmu. Saya telah ditempatkan di luar kuil yang hancur ini untuk mencegah para pelancong menghadapi kematian sebelum waktunya tiba. Di dalamnya ada binatang buas dengan kekuatan besar.
dialogsComplete.it: Ah, the MewMew clan sent word of your arrival. I have been stationed outside this ruined temple to prevent travelers from facing death before their time has come. Inside are beasts of great power.
dialogsComplete.jp: ああ、ミュウミュウ一族はあなたの到着の知らせを送りました。私はこの廃墟となった寺院の外に駐屯し、旅行者が時が来る前に死に直面するのを防ぎます。中には大きな力の獣がいます。
dialogsComplete.kr: 아, 뮤뮤 일족이 당신이 온다고 전해주었답니다. 저는 이 폐허가 된 신전 밖을 지키며 여행자들이 괜히 들어갔다가 죽지 않도록 막고 있지요. 내부에는 강력한 괴물들이 많거든요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Ah, the MewMew clan sent word of your arrival. I have been stationed outside this ruined temple to prevent travelers from facing death before their time has come. Inside are beasts of great power.
dialogsComplete.pl: Ah, the MewMew clan sent word of your arrival. I have been stationed outside this ruined temple to prevent travelers from facing death before their time has come. Inside are beasts of great power.
dialogsComplete.ru: Ah, the MewMew clan sent word of your arrival. I have been stationed outside this ruined temple to prevent travelers from facing death before their time has come. Inside are beasts of great power.
dialogsComplete.sp: Ah, el clan MewMew envió noticias de tu llegada. Me han apostado fuera de este templo en ruinas para evitar que los viajeros se enfrenten a la muerte antes de tiempo. Dentro hay bestias de gran poder.
dialogsComplete.sw: Ah, the MewMew clan sent word of your arrival. I have been stationed outside this ruined temple to prevent travelers from facing death before their time has come. Inside are beasts of great power.
dialogsComplete.th: โอ้ เผ่า MewMew ได้แจ้งแล้วถึงการที่เจ้าจะมา ข้าคอยเฝ้าด้านนอกของอารามที่ผุพังนี้เพื่อป้องกันไม่ให้นักเดินทางเข้าไปหาความตายของตัวเองก่อนเวลาอันควร ข้างในมันมีสัตว์ร้ายทรงพลังมากมาย
dialogsComplete.tw: 啊，喵喵族已經通知我你會來。我奉命守在這座廢棄神殿外，避免旅人還沒到壽命終點就白白送死。裡面棲息著極其強大的怪物。
dialogsComplete.vi: Ah, gia tộc MewMew đã gửi thông báo về sự xuất hiện của bạn. Tôi đã đóng quân bên ngoài ngôi đền đổ nát này để ngăn travelers đối mặt với cái chết trước khi thời điểm đến. Bên trong là những quái thú có sức mạnh to lớn.

dialogsComplete.en: Only enter if you feel truly prepared for a difficult challenge. I have heard rumors that the beast in the deepest part of the ruins holds a remnant of an ancient god's power.
dialogsComplete.ar: Only enter if you feel truly prepared for a difficult challenge. I have heard rumors that the beast in the deepest part of the ruins holds a remnant of an ancient god's power.
dialogsComplete.br: Só se atreva a entrar se estiver verdadeiramente preparado para um desafio difícil. Ouvi dizer que a criatura nas profundezas das ruínas guarda um resquício do poder de um deus antigo.
dialogsComplete.cns: Only enter if you feel truly prepared for a difficult challenge. I have heard rumors that the beast in the deepest part of the ruins holds a remnant of an ancient god's power.
dialogsComplete.de: Gehe nur hinein, wenn du dich wirklich auf eine schwierige Herausforderung vorbereitet fühlst. Ich habe Gerüchte gehört, dass die Bestie im tiefsten Teil der Ruinen ein Überbleibsel der Macht eines alten Gottes birgt.
dialogsComplete.fi: Only enter if you feel truly prepared for a difficult challenge. I have heard rumors that the beast in the deepest part of the ruins holds a remnant of an ancient god's power.
dialogsComplete.fil: Only enter if you feel truly prepared for a difficult challenge. I have heard rumors that the beast in the deepest part of the ruins holds a remnant of an ancient god's power.
dialogsComplete.fr: N'entrez que si vous vous sentez vraiment prêt à relever un défi difficile. J'ai entendu des rumeurs selon lesquelles la bête qui se trouve au plus profond des ruines renferme un vestige du pouvoir d'un ancien dieu.
dialogsComplete.id: Hanya masuk jika Anda merasa benar-benar siap menghadapi tantangan yang sulit. Saya telah mendengar desas-desus bahwa binatang buas di bagian terdalam reruntuhan menyimpan sisa-sisa kekuatan dewa kuno.
dialogsComplete.it: Only enter if you feel truly prepared for a difficult challenge. I have heard rumors that the beast in the deepest part of the ruins holds a remnant of an ancient god's power.
dialogsComplete.jp: 困難な挑戦に本当に準備ができていると感じた場合にのみ参加してください。遺跡の最深部にいる獣には、古代の神の力の名残が残っているという噂を聞いたことがあります。
dialogsComplete.kr: 어려운 도전을 맞이할 준비가 되었을 때만 들어가세요. 폐허 깊은 곳의 괴물이 고대 신의 힘을 아직까지 간직하고 있다는 소문을 들었어요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Only enter if you feel truly prepared for a difficult challenge. I have heard rumors that the beast in the deepest part of the ruins holds a remnant of an ancient god's power.
dialogsComplete.pl: Only enter if you feel truly prepared for a difficult challenge. I have heard rumors that the beast in the deepest part of the ruins holds a remnant of an ancient god's power.
dialogsComplete.ru: Only enter if you feel truly prepared for a difficult challenge. I have heard rumors that the beast in the deepest part of the ruins holds a remnant of an ancient god's power.
dialogsComplete.sp: Sólo entra si te sientes realmente preparado para un reto difícil. He oído rumores de que la bestia de lo más profundo de las ruinas guarda un resto del poder de un antiguo dios.
dialogsComplete.sw: Only enter if you feel truly prepared for a difficult challenge. I have heard rumors that the beast in the deepest part of the ruins holds a remnant of an ancient god's power.
dialogsComplete.th: จงเข้าไปเมื่อเจ้ารู้สึกว่าพร้อมแล้วสำหรับการท้าทายที่ยิ่งใหญ่ ข้าได้ยินมาว่าพวกสัตว์ร้ายในชั้นลึก ๆ นั้นมีเศษเสี้ยวพลังของเทพเจ้าโบราณสถิตอยู่ด้วย
dialogsComplete.tw: 只有在你真的做好迎接艱難挑戰的準備時，才進去吧。我聽說在遺跡最深處的野獸，握有古神之力的一部分殘響。
dialogsComplete.vi: Chỉ tham gia nếu bạn cảm thấy thực sự sẵn sàng cho một thử thách khó khăn. Tôi đã nghe tin đồn rằng con thú ở nơi sâu nhất của đống đổ nát nắm giữ remnant of an ancient god's power.

dialogsFail.kr: 지도를 따라 괴물의 은신처를 찾으세요.

dialogsFail.pl: Follow the map to find the creature's lair.

dialogsFail.tw: 依照地圖去找出那頭怪物的巢穴。
dialogsFail.vi: Đi theo bản đồ để tìm creature's lair.

dialogsBegin.en: After being assigned to my post here in the Cave of Envy, I've witnessed dozens of Syliaca enter the waters of the cavern behind me. If what the mayor said is true... those Syliaca may have grown into something much stronger by now. An investigation is in order.
dialogsBegin.ar: After being assigned to my post here in the Cave of Envy, I've witnessed dozens of Syliaca enter the waters of the cavern behind me. If what the mayor said is true... those Syliaca may have grown into something much stronger by now. An investigation is in order.
dialogsBegin.br: Desde que fui designado para o meu posto aqui na Caverna da Avareza, tenho visto dezenas de Syliaca mergulhando nas águas da caverna atrás de mim. Se o que o prefeito disse for verdade... esses Syliaca podem ter se transformado em criaturas superfortes! Uma investigação é necessária.
dialogsBegin.cns: After being assigned to my post here in the Cave of Envy, I've witnessed dozens of Syliaca enter the waters of the cavern behind me. If what the mayor said is true... those Syliaca may have grown into something much stronger by now. An investigation is in order.
dialogsBegin.de: Nachdem ich meinen Posten hier in der Eienble Höhle angetreten habe, habe ich gesehen, wie Dutzende von Syliaca in die Gewässer der Höhle hinter mir eingetreten sind. Wenn das, was der Bürgermeister sagte, wahr ist, könnten diese Syliaca inzwischen zu etwas viel Stärkerem herangewachsen sein. Eine Untersuchung steht an.
dialogsBegin.fi: After being assigned to my post here in the Cave of Envy, I've witnessed dozens of Syliaca enter the waters of the cavern behind me. If what the mayor said is true... those Syliaca may have grown into something much stronger by now. An investigation is in order.
dialogsBegin.fil: After being assigned to my post here in the Cave of Envy, I've witnessed dozens of Syliaca enter the waters of the cavern behind me. If what the mayor said is true... those Syliaca may have grown into something much stronger by now. An investigation is in order.
dialogsBegin.fr: Depuis que j'ai pris mon poste dans la Caverne de l'Envie, j'ai vu des dizaines de Syliacas entrer dans les eaux de la caverne derrière moi. Si ce qu'a dit le maire est vrai, ces Syliacas sont peut-être devenus beaucoup plus puissants. Une enquête s'impose.
dialogsBegin.id: Setelah ditugaskan ke pos saya di sini di Cave of Envy, aku telah menyaksikan puluhan Syliaca memasuki perairan gua di belakangku. Jika apa yang dikatakan walikota itu benar.. Syliaca itu mungkin telah tumbuh menjadi sesuatu yang jauh lebih kuat sekarang. Investigasi sedang dilakukan.
dialogsBegin.it: After being assigned to my post here in the Cave of Envy, I've witnessed dozens of Syliaca enter the waters of the cavern behind me. If what the mayor said is true... those Syliaca may have grown into something much stronger by now. An investigation is in order.
dialogsBegin.jp: ここ羨望の洞窟の私のポストに割り当てられた後、私は何十ものシリアカが私の後ろの洞窟の海に入るのを目撃しました。市長の言ったことが本当なら..それらのシリアカは今でははるかに強いものに成長しているかもしれません。調査が必要です。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이곳 엔비 동굴에 배치된 후로, 실리아카 수십 마리가 저기 뒤쪽 동굴 물속으로 들어가는 걸 봤어요. 시장님 말씀이 사실이라면... 그 실리아카들은 지금쯤 훨씬 강력한 존재가 되어 있을지도 몰라요. 조사해 보는 게 좋겠어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: After being assigned to my post here in the Cave of Envy, I've witnessed dozens of Syliaca enter the waters of the cavern behind me. If what the mayor said is true... those Syliaca may have grown into something much stronger by now. An investigation is in order.
dialogsBegin.pl: After being assigned to my post here in the Cave of Envy, I've witnessed dozens of Syliaca enter the waters of the cavern behind me. If what the mayor said is true... those Syliaca may have grown into something much stronger by now. An investigation is in order.
dialogsBegin.ru: After being assigned to my post here in the Cave of Envy, I've witnessed dozens of Syliaca enter the waters of the cavern behind me. If what the mayor said is true... those Syliaca may have grown into something much stronger by now. An investigation is in order.
dialogsBegin.sp: Después de ser asignado a mi puesto aquí en la Cueva de la Envidia, he sido testigo de cómo docenas de Syliaca entraban en las aguas de la caverna detrás de mí. Si lo que dijo el alcalde es cierto... esos Syliaca pueden haberse convertido en algo mucho más fuerte a estas alturas. Una investigación está en orden.
dialogsBegin.sw: After being assigned to my post here in the Cave of Envy, I've witnessed dozens of Syliaca enter the waters of the cavern behind me. If what the mayor said is true... those Syliaca may have grown into something much stronger by now. An investigation is in order.
dialogsBegin.th: หลังจากที่ข้าได้รับมอบหมายให้มาประจำที่ Cave of Envy ข้าได้เห็น Syliaca ฝูงนึงเข้าไปยังน้ำที่อยู่ในถ้ำข้างหลังข้านี่ ถ้าเรื่องที่นายกเทศมนตรีพูดมาเป็นเรื่องจริงล่ะก็ Syliaca น่าจะกลายเป็นอะไรที่แข็งแกร่งยิ่งกว่าเดิมมากแล้ว ตอนนี้อยู่ระหว่างการตรวจสอบกันอยู่
dialogsBegin.tw: 自從我被派來駐守嫉妒洞窟後，就親眼看到好幾十隻希莉卡游進我身後那座洞窟的水域裡。要是市長說的都是真的……那些希莉卡現在恐怕已經變得強得多了。必須調查清楚。
dialogsBegin.vi: Sau khi được phân công vào vị trí của tôi tại Cave of Envy, tôi đã chứng kiến ​​hàng tá Syliaca xâm nhập vào vùng nước của hang động phía sau tôi. Nếu những gì ngài thị trưởng nói là sự thật.. những Syliaca đó có thể đã phát triển thành một thứ gì đó mạnh mẽ hơn nhiều. Một cuộc điều tra đang diễn ra.

dialogsAccept.en: Head inside the cavern behind me and find out what have happened to the Syliaca.
dialogsAccept.ar: Head inside the cavern behind me and find out what have happened to the Syliaca.
dialogsAccept.br: Avance na caverna atrás de mim e descubra o que aconteceu com os Syliaca!
dialogsAccept.cns: Head inside the cavern behind me and find out what have happened to the Syliaca.
dialogsAccept.de: Betrete die Höhle hinter mir und finde heraus, was mit den Syliaca geschehen ist.
dialogsAccept.fi: Head inside the cavern behind me and find out what have happened to the Syliaca.
dialogsAccept.fil: Head inside the cavern behind me and find out what have happened to the Syliaca.
dialogsAccept.fr: Entrez dans la caverne derrière moi et découvrez ce qui est arrivé aux Syliaca.
dialogsAccept.id: Pergilah ke dalam gua di belakangku dan cari tahu apa yang terjadi pada Syliaca.
dialogsAccept.it: Head inside the cavern behind me and find out what have happened to the Syliaca.
dialogsAccept.jp: 私の後ろの洞窟の中に向かい、シリアカに何が起こったのかを調べてください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 뒤에 있는 동굴로 들어가서, 실리아카에게 무슨 일이 일어났는지 알아보죠.
dialogsAccept.nl: Head inside the cavern behind me and find out what have happened to the Syliaca.
dialogsAccept.pl: Head inside the cavern behind me and find out what have happened to the Syliaca.
dialogsAccept.ru: Head inside the cavern behind me and find out what have happened to the Syliaca.
dialogsAccept.sp: Entra en la caverna detrás de mí y averigua qué ha pasado con los Syliaca.
dialogsAccept.sw: Head inside the cavern behind me and find out what have happened to the Syliaca.
dialogsAccept.th: เข้าไปในถ้ำด้านหลังข้า และหาว่าเกิดอะไรขึ้นกันแน่กับ Syliaca
dialogsAccept.tw: 進入我身後的洞窟，查查看那些希莉卡到底變成了什麼樣子。
dialogsAccept.vi: Đi vào trong hang động phía sau tôi và tìm hiểu chuyện gì đã xảy ra với Syliaca.

dialogsDecline.en: You seem strong enough to handle a few empowered Syliaca... but maybe not.
dialogsDecline.ar: You seem strong enough to handle a few empowered Syliaca... but maybe not.
dialogsDecline.br: Você parece forte o suficiente para lidar com alguns Syliaca fortalecidos.. mas talvez não.
dialogsDecline.cns: You seem strong enough to handle a few empowered Syliaca... but maybe not.
dialogsDecline.de: Du scheinst stark genug zu sein, um mit ein paar ermächtigten Syliaca fertig zu werden... aber vielleicht auch nicht.
dialogsDecline.fi: You seem strong enough to handle a few empowered Syliaca... but maybe not.
dialogsDecline.fil: You seem strong enough to handle a few empowered Syliaca... but maybe not.
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous semblez assez fort pour affronter quelques Syliaca dotés de pouvoirs... mais peut-être pas.
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu tampaknya cukup kuat untuk menangani beberapa Syliaca yang diberdayakan.. tapi mungkin tidak.
dialogsDecline.it: You seem strong enough to handle a few empowered Syliaca... but maybe not.
dialogsDecline.jp: あなたはいくつかの権限を与えられたシリアカを処理するのに十分強いようです..しかし、そうではないかもしれません。
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신은 강해 보이니, 힘이 센 실리아카 몇 마리는 상대할 수 있을 거예요... 아닐지도 모르지만.
dialogsDecline.nl: You seem strong enough to handle a few empowered Syliaca... but maybe not.
dialogsDecline.pl: You seem strong enough to handle a few empowered Syliaca... but maybe not.
dialogsDecline.ru: You seem strong enough to handle a few empowered Syliaca... but maybe not.
dialogsDecline.sp: Pareces lo suficientemente fuerte como para manejar algunos Syliaca empoderados .. pero tal vez no.
dialogsDecline.sw: You seem strong enough to handle a few empowered Syliaca... but maybe not.
dialogsDecline.th: เจ้าดูจะแข็งแกร่งพอที่จะต่อกรกับ Syliaca ที่ถูกเสริมพลังขึ้นมา....แต่ก็อาจจะไม่
dialogsDecline.tw: 你看起來應該有實力對付幾隻被強化過的希莉卡……不過也可能沒有。
dialogsDecline.vi: Trông bạn có vẻ đủ mạnh để xử lý vài Syliaca đấy...hoặc không.

dialogsComplete.en: Very interesting... so the Syliaca have turned into Overgrown Sharks after ingesting the cavern's magic waters. I am curious what else may be living within the cavern...
dialogsComplete.ar: Very interesting... so the Syliaca have turned into Overgrown Sharks after ingesting the cavern's magic waters. I am curious what else may be living within the cavern...
dialogsComplete.br: Ah, que interessante! Os Syliaca se transformaram em Tubarões Gigantescos depois de beberem as águas mágicas da caverna. Fico curioso para descobrir quais outras criaturas podem estar habitando esse lugar sombrio...
dialogsComplete.cns: Very interesting... so the Syliaca have turned into Overgrown Sharks after ingesting the cavern's magic waters. I am curious what else may be living within the cavern...
dialogsComplete.de: Sehr interessant... die Syliaca haben sich also in übergroße Haie verwandelt, nachdem sie das magische Wasser der Höhle zu sich genommen haben. Ich bin neugierig, was sonst noch in der Höhle leben mag...
dialogsComplete.fi: Very interesting... so the Syliaca have turned into Overgrown Sharks after ingesting the cavern's magic waters. I am curious what else may be living within the cavern...
dialogsComplete.fil: Very interesting... so the Syliaca have turned into Overgrown Sharks after ingesting the cavern's magic waters. I am curious what else may be living within the cavern...
dialogsComplete.fr: Très intéressant... Les Syliaca se sont donc transformés en Requins Géants après avoir ingéré les eaux magiques de la caverne. Je suis curieux de savoir ce qui peut vivre dans la caverne...
dialogsComplete.id: Sangat menarik.. jadi Syliaca telah berubah menjadi Overgrown Sharks setelah menelan air ajaib gua. Aku ingin tahu apa lagi yang mungkin hidup di dalam gua ..
dialogsComplete.it: Very interesting... so the Syliaca have turned into Overgrown Sharks after ingesting the cavern's magic waters. I am curious what else may be living within the cavern...
dialogsComplete.jp: 非常に興味深い..そのため、シリアカは洞窟の魔法の水を摂取した後、生い茂ったサメに変わりました。洞窟の中に他に何が住んでいるのか興味があります。
dialogsComplete.kr: 흥미로운데요... 실리아카가 동굴에서 마법의 물을 마신 뒤, 거대 상어로 변한 거였군요. 동굴 안에 또 어떤 생명체들이 살고 있을지 궁금한데요...
dialogsComplete.nl: Very interesting... so the Syliaca have turned into Overgrown Sharks after ingesting the cavern's magic waters. I am curious what else may be living within the cavern...
dialogsComplete.pl: Very interesting... so the Syliaca have turned into Overgrown Sharks after ingesting the cavern's magic waters. I am curious what else may be living within the cavern...
dialogsComplete.ru: Very interesting... so the Syliaca have turned into Overgrown Sharks after ingesting the cavern's magic waters. I am curious what else may be living within the cavern...
dialogsComplete.sp: Muy interesante... así que los Syliaca se han convertido en Tiburones Crecidos después de ingerir las aguas mágicas de la caverna. Tengo curiosidad por saber qué más puede estar viviendo dentro de la caverna ..
dialogsComplete.sw: Very interesting... so the Syliaca have turned into Overgrown Sharks after ingesting the cavern's magic waters. I am curious what else may be living within the cavern...
dialogsComplete.th: น่าสนใจนัก Syliaca ได้กลายเป็น Overgrown Sharks หลังจากได้กินน้ำเวทมนต์ในถ้ำนั่นเข้าไป ข้าสงสัยจริง ๆ ว่ายังมีอะไรอยู่ในถ้ำนั้นอีก
dialogsComplete.tw: 真有意思……所以那些希莉卡在吞下洞窟中的魔法水後，竟然變成了過度生長的鯊魚。我很好奇，洞窟裡還藏著什麼生物……
dialogsComplete.vi: Rất thú vị.. vậy Syliaca đã biến thành Overgrown Sharks sau khi nuốt phải nước ma thuật của hang động. Tôi tò mò không biết còn thứ gì khác có thể sống trong hang...

dialogsDecline.en: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.ar: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.br: A Torre está infestada de masquerpets perigosos. Entendo se não quiser correr o risco.
dialogsDecline.cns: 这座塔里到处都是危险的假面怪。如果你不想冒这个险，我完全理解。
dialogsDecline.de: Der Turm ist voller gefährlicher Masquerpets. Ich verstehe es, wenn du das Risiko nicht eingehen willst.
dialogsDecline.fi: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.fil: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.fr: La Tour est remplies de monstres dangereux. Je comprends que tu ne veuilles pas prendre ce risque.
dialogsDecline.id: Menara dipenuhi dengan masquerpets berbahaya. Saya mengerti jika Anda tidak ingin mengambil risiko.
dialogsDecline.it: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.jp: タワーは危険なモンスターでいっぱいです。あなたがリスクを冒したくないのなら、私は理解しています。
dialogsDecline.kr: 탑에는 위험한 마스커펫이 가득해요. 위험을 감수하고 싶지 않다고 하셔도 이해합니다.
dialogsDecline.nl: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.pl: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.ru: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.sp: La Torre está llena de masquerpets peligrosos. Comprendo si no deseas correr el riesgo.
dialogsDecline.sw: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.th: Tower เต็มไปด้วย masquerpets ที่อันตราย ข้าเข้าใจดีถ้าเจ้าไม่อยากเสี่ยงอันตราย
dialogsDecline.tw: 塔內充滿了危險的怪物。如果你不想冒險，我可以理解。
dialogsDecline.vi: Tower chứa đầy masquerpets nguy hiểm. Tôi hiểu bạn không muốn mạo hiểm.

dialogsComplete.en: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.ar: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.br: Obrigado aventureiro, a ameaça $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ foi eliminada.
dialogsComplete.cns: 感谢你英雄, $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 的威胁被终结了。
dialogsComplete.de: Vielen Dank, dank dir wurde die $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ Bedrohung beseitigt.
dialogsComplete.fi: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.fil: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.fr: Merci, héros, la menace $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ a été éliminée.
dialogsComplete.id: Terima kasih pahlawan, ancaman $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ telah dihilangkan.
dialogsComplete.it: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.jp: ありがとうヒーロー、$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$の脅威が排除されました。
dialogsComplete.kr: 감사해요 용사님. $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$을(를) 처치해 위협을 없애 주셨군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.pl: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.ru: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.sp: Gracias héroe, la amenaza $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ha sido eliminada.
dialogsComplete.sw: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.th: ขอบคุณมากฮีโร่ อันตรายจาก $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ได้ถูกกำจัดไปหมดแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 謝謝英雄，$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 威脅已被消除。
dialogsComplete.vi: Cảm ơn hero, mối đe dọa $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ đã bị loại bỏ.

dialogsFail.en: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.ar: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.br: Você ainda não conseguiu matar o $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$? Tudo bem, por favor, volte depois de vencer o gigante!
dialogsFail.cns: 你还没能击杀 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$吗？没关系，等你战胜那个巨人之后再回来吧！
dialogsFail.de: Du hast es nicht geschafft, $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ zu töten? Das stimmt, komm wieder, sobald du gegen den Giant gewonnen hast!
dialogsFail.fi: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.fil: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.fr: Tu n'as pas encore réussi à tuer le $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ? Pas de problème, reviens me voir après avoir vaincu le géant !
dialogsFail.id: Anda belum bisa membunuh $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$? Tidak apa-apa, mohon segera kembali setelah Anda menang melawan para giant!
dialogsFail.it: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.jp: あなたはまだ$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を倒すことができませんでしたか?大丈夫、巨人に勝ったら戻ってください!
dialogsFail.kr: 아직 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$을(를) 처치하지 못하셨나요? 괜찮아요. 거대 몬스터를 처치하고 나면 돌아오세요!
dialogsFail.nl: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.pl: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.ru: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Aún no has podido matar al $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$? No pasa nada, ¡Vuelve cuando hayas ganado al gigante!
dialogsFail.sw: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.th: คุณไม่ยังสามาถจัดการ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ได้อีกรึ? ไม่เป็นไรกลับมาเมื่อคุณจัดการพวกไจแอนท์พวกนั้นสำเร็จนะ!
dialogsFail.tw: 你還沒能殺死 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$？沒關係，打敗巨人後請回來！
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn vẫn chưa giết được $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$? Không sao đâu, hãy trở về sau khi đánh bại giant!
