description.en: Meet with the guard outside the Leren Chasm.
description.ar: Meet with the guard outside the Leren Chasm.
description.br: Encontre com o guarda do lado de fora do Desfiladeiro de Leren.
description.cns: Meet with the guard outside the Leren Chasm.
description.de: Treffe die Wache vor der Lerenkluft.
description.fi: Meet with the guard outside the Leren Chasm.
description.fil: Meet with the guard outside the Leren Chasm.
description.fr: Rencontrez le garde à l'extérieur du Gouffre de Leren.
description.id: Temui penjaga di luar Leren Chasm.
description.it: Meet with the guard outside the Leren Chasm.
description.jp: レレンの淵の外で警備員と会いましょう。
description.kr: 레르엔 협곡 밖에 있는 경비병과 만나세요.
description.nl: Meet with the guard outside the Leren Chasm.
description.pl: Meet with the guard outside the Leren Chasm.
description.ru: Meet with the guard outside the Leren Chasm.
description.sp: Reúnete con el guardia fuera de la Sima de Leren.
description.sw: Meet with the guard outside the Leren Chasm.
description.th: ไปพบกับยามที่ด้านหน้าของ Leren Chasm
description.tw: 在勒倫峽谷外與守衛會面。
description.vi: Gặp guard bên ngoài Leren Chasm.

dialogsBegin.en: Now that we know where the Leren Chasm is, I have stationed a guard outside the cave to prevent anyone from accidently going inside.
dialogsBegin.ar: Now that we know where the Leren Chasm is, I have stationed a guard outside the cave to prevent anyone from accidently going inside.
dialogsBegin.br: Agora que descobrimos onde fica o Desfiladeiro de Leren, coloquei um guarda na entrada da caverna para evitar que alguém entre sem querer.
dialogsBegin.cns: Now that we know where the Leren Chasm is, I have stationed a guard outside the cave to prevent anyone from accidently going inside.
dialogsBegin.de: Da wir nun wissen, wo sich die Lerenkluft befindet, habe ich eine Wache vor der Höhle postiert, um zu verhindern, dass jemand versehentlich hinein geht.
dialogsBegin.fi: Now that we know where the Leren Chasm is, I have stationed a guard outside the cave to prevent anyone from accidently going inside.
dialogsBegin.fil: Now that we know where the Leren Chasm is, I have stationed a guard outside the cave to prevent anyone from accidently going inside.
dialogsBegin.fr: Maintenant que nous savons où se trouve le Gouffre de Leren, j'ai posté un garde à l'extérieur de la grotte pour empêcher quiconque d'y pénétrer accidentellement.
dialogsBegin.id: Sekarang kita tahu di mana Leren Chasm berada, saya telah menempatkan penjaga di luar gua untuk mencegah siapa pun masuk ke dalam.
dialogsBegin.it: Now that we know where the Leren Chasm is, I have stationed a guard outside the cave to prevent anyone from accidently going inside.
dialogsBegin.jp: レレンの淵がどこにあるかがわかったので、洞窟の外に警備員を配置して、誰かが誤って中に入るのを防ぎました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이제 레르엔 협곡의 위치를 알았으니, 아무도 실수로 들어가는 일이 없도록 밖에 경비병을 배치해 두었답니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Now that we know where the Leren Chasm is, I have stationed a guard outside the cave to prevent anyone from accidently going inside.
dialogsBegin.pl: Now that we know where the Leren Chasm is, I have stationed a guard outside the cave to prevent anyone from accidently going inside.
dialogsBegin.ru: Now that we know where the Leren Chasm is, I have stationed a guard outside the cave to prevent anyone from accidently going inside.
dialogsBegin.sp: Ahora que sabemos dónde está la sima de Leren, he apostado a un guardia fuera de la cueva para evitar que alguien entre accidentalmente.
dialogsBegin.sw: Now that we know where the Leren Chasm is, I have stationed a guard outside the cave to prevent anyone from accidently going inside.
dialogsBegin.th: ตอนนี้พอเรารู้ว่า Leren Chasm อยู่ที่ไหนแล้ว ข้าจะคอยเฝ้าระวังด้านนอกถ้ำ เพื่อป้องกันไม่ให้ใครเข้าไปข้างในโดยไม่รุ้ตัว
dialogsBegin.tw: 既然知道了勒倫峽谷的位置，我就在洞外派了守衛，以防有人誤入其中。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bây giờ chúng tôi đã biết Leren Chasm ở đâu, tôi đã bố trí một guard bên ngoài hang động để ngăn chặn bất kỳ ai vô tình đi vào bên trong.

dialogsBegin.en: From here on adventurer, you must delve into the Leren Chasm if we are ever to know the truth. Please speak to the Leren Chasm guard when you are ready to explore the caves.
dialogsBegin.ar: From here on adventurer, you must delve into the Leren Chasm if we are ever to know the truth. Please speak to the Leren Chasm guard when you are ready to explore the caves.
dialogsBegin.br: A partir de agora, aventureiro, a única maneira de descobrirmos a verdade é se aventurar no Desfiladeiro de Leren. Quando estiver pronto para explorar as cavernas, fale com o guarda que está de plantão na entrada
dialogsBegin.cns: From here on adventurer, you must delve into the Leren Chasm if we are ever to know the truth. Please speak to the Leren Chasm guard when you are ready to explore the caves.
dialogsBegin.de: Von nun an musst du dich in die Lerenkluft begeben, wenn wir die Wahrheit erfahren wollen. Bitte sprich mit der Wache der Lerenkluft, wenn du bereit bist, die Höhlen zu erforschen.
dialogsBegin.fi: From here on adventurer, you must delve into the Leren Chasm if we are ever to know the truth. Please speak to the Leren Chasm guard when you are ready to explore the caves.
dialogsBegin.fil: From here on adventurer, you must delve into the Leren Chasm if we are ever to know the truth. Please speak to the Leren Chasm guard when you are ready to explore the caves.
dialogsBegin.fr: A partir de maintenant, aventurier, vous devez vous aventurer dans le Gouffre de Leren si nous voulons connaître la vérité. Veuillez vous adresser au garde du gouffre de Leren lorsque vous serez prêt à explorer les grottes.
dialogsBegin.id: Dari sini petualang, Anda harus menyelidiki Leren Chasm jika kita ingin mengetahui kebenarannya. Silakan berbicara dengan penjaga Leren Chasm ketika Anda siap untuk menjelajahi gua.
dialogsBegin.it: From here on adventurer, you must delve into the Leren Chasm if we are ever to know the truth. Please speak to the Leren Chasm guard when you are ready to explore the caves.
dialogsBegin.jp: ここから冒険者、私たちが真実を知るためには、レレンの裂け目を掘り下げる必要があります。洞窟を探索する準備ができたら、レレンの淵の警備員に話しかけてください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 자, 모험가님. 진실을 알기 위해서는 레르엔 협곡으로 뛰어들어야 해요. 동굴을 탐험할 준비가 되면 레르엔 협곡 경비병에게 말을 걸어주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: From here on adventurer, you must delve into the Leren Chasm if we are ever to know the truth. Please speak to the Leren Chasm guard when you are ready to explore the caves.
dialogsBegin.pl: From here on adventurer, you must delve into the Leren Chasm if we are ever to know the truth. Please speak to the Leren Chasm guard when you are ready to explore the caves.
dialogsBegin.ru: From here on adventurer, you must delve into the Leren Chasm if we are ever to know the truth. Please speak to the Leren Chasm guard when you are ready to explore the caves.
dialogsBegin.sp: A partir de ahora, aventurero, debes adentrarte en la sima de Leren si queremos conocer la verdad. Por favor, habla con el guardia de la sima de Leren cuando estés listo para explorar las cuevas.
dialogsBegin.sw: From here on adventurer, you must delve into the Leren Chasm if we are ever to know the truth. Please speak to the Leren Chasm guard when you are ready to explore the caves.
dialogsBegin.th: ถ้าเจ้าอยากจะรู้ความจริงล่ะก็ จากนี้ไปการผจญภัยจะต้องลงเจาะลึกไปใน Leren Chasm โปรดไปคุยกับ ยามของ Leren Chasm เมื่อคุณพร้อมที่จะสำรวจถ้ำ
dialogsBegin.tw: 冒險家從這裡開始，如果我們想知道真相，你必須深入勒倫峽谷，當你準備好探索洞穴時，請與勒倫峽谷守衛交談。
dialogsBegin.vi: Từ đây trở đi, adventurer, bạn phải đi sâu vào Leren Chasm nếu chúng ta muốn biết sự thật. Vui lòng nói chuyện với Leren Chasm guard khi bạn sẵn sàng khám phá các hang động.

dialogsAccept.en: What you find in the caves of Leren Chasm may be terrifying, but I sense a special kind of bravery within you adventurer... When you are ready go speak to the guard outside the Leren Chasm.
dialogsAccept.ar: What you find in the caves of Leren Chasm may be terrifying, but I sense a special kind of bravery within you adventurer... When you are ready go speak to the guard outside the Leren Chasm.
dialogsAccept.br: O que você encontrará nas cavernas do Desfiladeiro de Leren pode ser assustador, mas sei que você tem uma coragem especial, aventureiro. Quando estiver pronto para encarar essa aventura vá falar com o guarda que está do lado de fora da entrada.
dialogsAccept.cns: What you find in the caves of Leren Chasm may be terrifying, but I sense a special kind of bravery within you adventurer... When you are ready go speak to the guard outside the Leren Chasm.
dialogsAccept.de: Was du in den Höhlen der Lerenkluft findest, mag furchterregend sein, aber ich spüre eine besondere Art von Tapferkeit in dir, Abenteurer. Wenn du bereit bist, sprich mit der Wache vor der Lerenkluft.
dialogsAccept.fi: What you find in the caves of Leren Chasm may be terrifying, but I sense a special kind of bravery within you adventurer... When you are ready go speak to the guard outside the Leren Chasm.
dialogsAccept.fil: What you find in the caves of Leren Chasm may be terrifying, but I sense a special kind of bravery within you adventurer... When you are ready go speak to the guard outside the Leren Chasm.
dialogsAccept.fr: Ce que vous trouverez dans les grottes du Gouffre de Leren peut être terrifiant, mais je sens en vous une forme particulière de bravoure, aventurier. Lorsque vous serez prêt, allez parler au garde à l'extérieur du Gouffre de Leren.
dialogsAccept.id: Apa yang kamu temukan di gua Leren Chasm mungkin menakutkan, tapi aku merasakan keberanian khusus dalam diri kamu petualang.. Saat kamu siap, bicaralah dengan penjaga di luar Jurang Leren.
dialogsAccept.it: What you find in the caves of Leren Chasm may be terrifying, but I sense a special kind of bravery within you adventurer... When you are ready go speak to the guard outside the Leren Chasm.
dialogsAccept.jp: レレンの淵の洞窟で見つけたものは恐ろしいかもしれませんが、冒険者の中に特別な勇気を感じます。準備ができたら、レレンの淵の外にいる警備員に話しかけてください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 레르엔 협곡의 동굴에서 발견한 것은 끔찍했지만, 당신에게서 모험가의 특별한 용기가 느껴지네요... 들어갈 준비가 끝나면 레르엔 협곡 앞의 경비병과 대화하세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: What you find in the caves of Leren Chasm may be terrifying, but I sense a special kind of bravery within you adventurer... When you are ready go speak to the guard outside the Leren Chasm.
dialogsAccept.pl: What you find in the caves of Leren Chasm may be terrifying, but I sense a special kind of bravery within you adventurer... When you are ready go speak to the guard outside the Leren Chasm.
dialogsAccept.ru: What you find in the caves of Leren Chasm may be terrifying, but I sense a special kind of bravery within you adventurer... When you are ready go speak to the guard outside the Leren Chasm.
dialogsAccept.sp: Lo que encontraras en las cuevas del Abismo de Leren puede ser aterrador, pero siento un tipo especial de valentía dentro de ti aventurero.. Cuando estés listo ve a hablar con el guardia fuera del Abismo de Leren.
dialogsAccept.sw: What you find in the caves of Leren Chasm may be terrifying, but I sense a special kind of bravery within you adventurer... When you are ready go speak to the guard outside the Leren Chasm.
dialogsAccept.th: สิ่งที่เจ้าพบที่ Leren Chasm อาจจะน่ากลัว แต่ข้าก็รู้สึกได้ถึงความกล้าหาญยิ่งในการผจญภัยของเจ้า ถ้าเจ้าพร้อมเมื่อไหร่ก็ไปคุยกับยามที่ด้านนอกของ Leren Chasm ได้เลย
dialogsAccept.tw: 你在勒倫峽谷洞窟裡會遇到的東西，可能相當可怕。不過，冒險家，我能感覺到你身上有種特別的勇氣……等你準備好了，就去和勒倫峽谷外的守衛談談吧。
dialogsAccept.vi: Những gì bạn tìm thấy trong các hang động của Leren Chasm có thể rất đáng sợ, nhưng tôi cảm nhận được lòng dũng cảm đặc biệt ẩn bên trong bạn, kẻ du hành kia... Khi bạn đã sẵn sàng, hãy nói chuyện với lính canh bên ngoài Leren Chasm.

dialogsDecline.en: Without you, the mystery of the Leren Chasm trolls may never be resolved. No matter though...
dialogsDecline.ar: Without you, the mystery of the Leren Chasm trolls may never be resolved. No matter though...
dialogsDecline.br: Sem você, o mistério dos trolls do Desfiladeiro de Leren pode nunca ser resolvido. Mas não importa...
dialogsDecline.cns: Without you, the mystery of the Leren Chasm trolls may never be resolved. No matter though...
dialogsDecline.de: Ohne dich wird das Geheimnis der Trolle in der Lerenkluft vielleicht nie gelüftet werden. Aber egal...
dialogsDecline.fi: Without you, the mystery of the Leren Chasm trolls may never be resolved. No matter though...
dialogsDecline.fil: Without you, the mystery of the Leren Chasm trolls may never be resolved. No matter though...
dialogsDecline.fr: Sans vous, le mystère des trolls du Gouffre de Leren ne sera peut-être jamais résolu. Peu importe..
dialogsDecline.id: Tanpamu, misteri troll Leren Chasm mungkin tidak akan pernah terpecahkan. Tidak peduli meskipun..
dialogsDecline.it: Without you, the mystery of the Leren Chasm trolls may never be resolved. No matter though...
dialogsDecline.jp: あなたがいなければ、レレンの淵トロールの謎は決して解決されないかもしれません。関係ありませんが..
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신이 없으면, 레르엔 협곡의 트롤 미스터리는 해결되지 않을지도 모르죠. 그렇다 하더라도...
dialogsDecline.nl: Without you, the mystery of the Leren Chasm trolls may never be resolved. No matter though...
dialogsDecline.pl: Without you, the mystery of the Leren Chasm trolls may never be resolved. No matter though...
dialogsDecline.ru: Without you, the mystery of the Leren Chasm trolls may never be resolved. No matter though...
dialogsDecline.sp: Sin ti, el misterio de los trolls del Abismo de Leren puede que nunca se resuelva. No importa sin embargo ..

dialogsComplete.en: Welcome to the Leren Chasm. I am here to prevent those who are ill-prepared from entering and befalling an early death... I see Radion sent you though, you seem prepared.
dialogsComplete.ar: Welcome to the Leren Chasm. I am here to prevent those who are ill-prepared from entering and befalling an early death... I see Radion sent you though, you seem prepared.
dialogsComplete.br: Bem-vindo ao Desfiladeiro de Leren. Estou aqui para impedir que os despreparados entrem e sofram uma morte prematura... Mas, como Radion o enviou, imagino que você esteja bem preparado para o que vem pela frente.
dialogsComplete.cns: Welcome to the Leren Chasm. I am here to prevent those who are ill-prepared from entering and befalling an early death... I see Radion sent you though, you seem prepared.
dialogsComplete.de: Willkommen in der Lerenkluft. Ich bin hier, um zu verhindern, dass diejenigen, die unvorbereitet sind, eintreten und einen frühen Tod erleiden. Wie ich sehe, hat Radion dich geschickt, du scheinst vorbereitet zu sein.1
dialogsComplete.fi: Welcome to the Leren Chasm. I am here to prevent those who are ill-prepared from entering and befalling an early death... I see Radion sent you though, you seem prepared.
dialogsComplete.fil: Welcome to the Leren Chasm. I am here to prevent those who are ill-prepared from entering and befalling an early death... I see Radion sent you though, you seem prepared.
dialogsComplete.fr: Bienvenue dans le Gouffre de Leren. Je suis ici pour empêcher ceux qui sont mal préparés d'y entrer et d'y mourir prématurément... Je vois que Radion t'a envoyé, tu as l'air préparé.
dialogsComplete.id: Selamat datang di Leren Chasm. Aku di sini untuk mencegah mereka yang tidak siap memasuki dan menimpa kematian dini .. Aku melihat Radion mengirimmu, kamu tampaknya siap.
dialogsComplete.it: Welcome to the Leren Chasm. I am here to prevent those who are ill-prepared from entering and befalling an early death... I see Radion sent you though, you seem prepared.
dialogsComplete.jp: レレンの淵へようこそ。私は、準備ができていない人々が入って早期に死ぬのを防ぐためにここにいます..ラディオンがあなたを送ったようですが、あなたは準備ができているようです。
dialogsComplete.kr: 레르엔 협곡에 어서 오시죠. 저는 준비 없이 들어간 사람들이 때 이른 죽음을 맞이하지 않도록 막기 위해 이곳을 지키고 있죠... 라디온이 보냈다고요? 그럼 준비된 분이겠군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Welcome to the Leren Chasm. I am here to prevent those who are ill-prepared from entering and befalling an early death... I see Radion sent you though, you seem prepared.
dialogsComplete.pl: Welcome to the Leren Chasm. I am here to prevent those who are ill-prepared from entering and befalling an early death... I see Radion sent you though, you seem prepared.
dialogsComplete.ru: Welcome to the Leren Chasm. I am here to prevent those who are ill-prepared from entering and befalling an early death... I see Radion sent you though, you seem prepared.
dialogsComplete.sp: Bienvenidos al Abismo de Leren. Estoy aquí para evitar que aquellos que no están preparados entren y sufran una muerte prematura.. Veo que Radion te envió, pareces preparado.
dialogsComplete.sw: Welcome to the Leren Chasm. I am here to prevent those who are ill-prepared from entering and befalling an early death... I see Radion sent you though, you seem prepared.
dialogsComplete.th: ยินดีต้อนรับสู่ Leren Chasm ฉันมาที่นี่เพื่อป้องกันไม่ให้ผู้ที่ไม่เตรียมตัวมาได้พบกับความตายก่อนกำหนด... ฉันเห็น Radion ส่งคุณมา ดูเหมือนว่าคุณพร้อมแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 歡迎來到勒倫峽谷。我奉命守在這裡，避免那些準備不足的人進去白白送命……不過既然是拉迪溫派你來的，看來你應該準備好了。
dialogsComplete.vi: Chào mừng đến với Leren Chasm. Tôi ở đây để ngăn những người không mảy may đề phòng bước vào và chết yểu. Mặc dù vậy, có vẻ Radion đã cử bạn đến, bạn dường như đã sẵn sàng rồi.

dialogsBegin.en: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.ar: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.br: Bem-vindo de volta aventureiro! Há relatos de uma nova ameaça na Torre Abandonada. Procure e livre-se de $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.cns: 欢迎回来，英雄！据报告，深渊之塔中出现了新的威胁。请前去找到并消灭 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$
dialogsBegin.de: Willkommen zurück, Held! Berichte zufolge wartet im Verlassenen Turm eine neue Bedrohung. Suche und töte die $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.

dialogsBegin.fr: Content de te revoir, héros ! Des rapports indiquent la présence d'une nouvelle menace dans la Tour Oubliée. S'il te plaît, cherche et élimine le $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.id: Selamat datang kembali pahlawan! Ada laporan ancaman baru di Forsaken Tower. Silakan cari dan singkirkan $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.

dialogsBegin.jp: おかえりヒーロー！忘却の塔に新たな脅威の報告がありました。$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を探して一掃してきてください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 돌아온 걸 환영해요, 용사님! 버려진 탑에 위협이 발생했다는 보고를 받았어요. 버려진 탑에서 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$을(를) 찾아 없애주세요.

dialogsBegin.th: ยินดีต้อนรับกลับมาฮีโร่! มีรายงานมาว่าพบกันอันตรายใหม่เกิดขึ้นที่ Forsaken Tower โปรดไปค้นหาและทำลาย $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ให้สิ้นซาก
dialogsBegin.tw: 歡迎回來的英雄！有報告稱深淵之塔出現了新的威脅。請找出並擺脫 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$。
dialogsBegin.vi: Chào mừng trở lại hero! Có báo cáo về một mối đe dọa mới trong Forsaken Tower. Vui lòng tìm kiếm và loại bỏ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.

dialogsDecline.en: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.

dialogsDecline.br: A Torre está infestada de masquerpets perigosos. Entendo se não quiser correr o risco.

dialogsBegin.en: If the water from the flood continues to affect the masquerpets in the Cave of Envy, soon they may become too strong for our forces to overcome. We must find the broken wall and see if a repair is possible.
dialogsBegin.ar: If the water from the flood continues to affect the masquerpets in the Cave of Envy, soon they may become too strong for our forces to overcome. We must find the broken wall and see if a repair is possible.
dialogsBegin.br: Se a água da inundação continuar mexendo com os masquerpets na Caverna da Inveja, logo eles vão ficar tão fortes que nem as nossas tropas vão dar conta. Precisamos encontrar a parede quebrada e ver se dá pra consertar.
dialogsBegin.cns: If the water from the flood continues to affect the masquerpets in the Cave of Envy, soon they may become too strong for our forces to overcome. We must find the broken wall and see if a repair is possible.
dialogsBegin.de: Wenn das Wasser der Überschwemmung weiterhin auf die Maskenpuppen in der Eienble Höhle einwirkt, könnten sie bald zu stark werden, um von unseren Kräften überwunden zu werden. Wir müssen die kaputte Wand finden und sehen, ob eine Reparatur möglich ist.
dialogsBegin.fi: If the water from the flood continues to affect the masquerpets in the Cave of Envy, soon they may become too strong for our forces to overcome. We must find the broken wall and see if a repair is possible.
dialogsBegin.fil: If the water from the flood continues to affect the masquerpets in the Cave of Envy, soon they may become too strong for our forces to overcome. We must find the broken wall and see if a repair is possible.
dialogsBegin.fr: Si l'eau de l'inondation continue d'affecter les masquerpets de la Caverne de l'Envie, ils pourraient bientôt devenir trop forts pour que nos forces en viennent à bout. Nous devons trouver le mur brisé et voir s'il est possible de le réparer.
dialogsBegin.id: Jika air dari banjir terus mempengaruhi topeng di Cave of Envy, mereka mungkin akan segera menjadi terlalu kuat untuk diatasi oleh kekuatan kita. Kita harus menemukan tembok yang rusak dan melihat apakah mungkin diperbaiki.
dialogsBegin.it: If the water from the flood continues to affect the masquerpets in the Cave of Envy, soon they may become too strong for our forces to overcome. We must find the broken wall and see if a repair is possible.
dialogsBegin.jp: 洪水からの水が羨望の洞窟の仮面舞踏会に影響を与え続けるならば、すぐに彼らは私たちの力が克服するには強すぎるかもしれません。壊れた壁を見つけて、修理が可能かどうかを確認する必要があります。
dialogsBegin.kr: 홍수로 넘친 물이 엔비 동굴의 마스커펫에게 계속 영향을 미친다면, 곧 우리 힘으로 상대하기엔 너무 강력한 존재가 되어버리고 말 거예요. 부서진 곳을 찾아서 막을 수 있을지 보자고요.
dialogsBegin.nl: If the water from the flood continues to affect the masquerpets in the Cave of Envy, soon they may become too strong for our forces to overcome. We must find the broken wall and see if a repair is possible.
dialogsBegin.pl: If the water from the flood continues to affect the masquerpets in the Cave of Envy, soon they may become too strong for our forces to overcome. We must find the broken wall and see if a repair is possible.
dialogsBegin.ru: If the water from the flood continues to affect the masquerpets in the Cave of Envy, soon they may become too strong for our forces to overcome. We must find the broken wall and see if a repair is possible.
dialogsBegin.sp: Si el agua de la inundación sigue afectando a los masquerpets de la Cueva de la Envidia, pronto podrían volverse demasiado fuertes para que nuestras fuerzas puedan vencerlos. Debemos encontrar el muro roto y ver si es posible repararlo.
dialogsBegin.sw: If the water from the flood continues to affect the masquerpets in the Cave of Envy, soon they may become too strong for our forces to overcome. We must find the broken wall and see if a repair is possible.
dialogsBegin.th: ถ้าน้ำที่ท่วมมีผลกับพวก masquerpets ใน Cave of Envy ไปเรื่อย ๆ ล่ะก็ มันอาจจะแข็งแกร่งเกินกว่าที่พวกเราจะทำอะไรได้ เราต้องรีบหากำแพงที่แตกและรีบซ่อมมันโดยเร็ว
dialogsBegin.tw: 如果洪水持續影響嫉妒洞窟裡的怪物，用不了多久，牠們就會變得強到我們的部隊也無法應付。我們必須找出那道破牆，看看能不能修復。
dialogsBegin.vi: Nếu nước từ trận lũ tiếp tục ảnh hưởng đến masquerpets trong Cave of Envy, chẳng bao lâu nữa họ có thể trở nên quá mạnh để lực lượng của chúng ta không thể vượt qua. Chúng ta phải tìm bức tường bị hỏng và xem liệu có thể sửa chữa được không.

dialogsAccept.en: The hole must be near the Syliaca... find it and determine if the damage is reparable.
dialogsAccept.ar: The hole must be near the Syliaca... find it and determine if the damage is reparable.
dialogsAccept.br: O buraco deve estar perto dos Syliaca... encontre-o e determine se é possível reparar o dano.
dialogsAccept.cns: The hole must be near the Syliaca... find it and determine if the damage is reparable.
dialogsAccept.de: Das Loch muss sich bei den Syliaca befinden...finde es und sehe nach, ob man den Schaden reparieren kann.
dialogsAccept.fi: The hole must be near the Syliaca... find it and determine if the damage is reparable.
dialogsAccept.fil: The hole must be near the Syliaca... find it and determine if the damage is reparable.
dialogsAccept.fr: Le trou doit se trouver près du Syliaca... trouvez-le et déterminez si les dommages sont réparables.
dialogsAccept.id: Lubang tersebut harus berada di dekat Syliaca.. temukan dan tentukan apakah kerusakannya dapat diperbaiki.
dialogsAccept.it: The hole must be near the Syliaca... find it and determine if the damage is reparable.
dialogsAccept.jp: 穴はシリアカの近くにある必要があります。それを見つけて、損傷が修復可能かどうかを判断します。
dialogsAccept.kr: 실리아카 근처에 구멍이 있을 거예요... 균열을 찾아서, 복구할 수 있는지 확인해야겠어요.
dialogsAccept.nl: The hole must be near the Syliaca... find it and determine if the damage is reparable.
dialogsAccept.pl: The hole must be near the Syliaca... find it and determine if the damage is reparable.
dialogsAccept.ru: The hole must be near the Syliaca... find it and determine if the damage is reparable.
dialogsAccept.sp: El agujero debe estar cerca del Syliaca.. encuéntralo y determina si el daño es reparable.
dialogsAccept.sw: The hole must be near the Syliaca... find it and determine if the damage is reparable.
dialogsAccept.th: รูนั่นต้องอยุ่ใกล้ ๆ Syliaca ลองไปหาดูและตรวจสอบว่ามันจะซ่อมได้หรือเปล่า
dialogsAccept.tw: 破洞應該就在希莉卡附近……去找到它，並確認牆體是否還有修復的可能。
dialogsAccept.vi: Cái lỗ phải ở gần Syliaca.. hãy tìm nó và xác định xem có thể khắc phục thiệt hại được không.

dialogsDecline.en: If we leave the break in the walls of the Cave of Envy for too long, this situation will become an even bigger disaster.
dialogsDecline.ar: If we leave the break in the walls of the Cave of Envy for too long, this situation will become an even bigger disaster.
dialogsDecline.br: Se deixarmos essa rachadura nas paredes da Caverna da Inveja por muito tempo, essa situação se tornará um desastre ainda maior.
dialogsDecline.cns: If we leave the break in the walls of the Cave of Envy for too long, this situation will become an even bigger disaster.
dialogsDecline.de: Wenn wir den Riss in den Wänden der Eienble Höhle zu lange aufrechterhalten, wird sich die Situation zu einer noch größeren Katastrophe entwickeln.
dialogsDecline.fi: If we leave the break in the walls of the Cave of Envy for too long, this situation will become an even bigger disaster.
dialogsDecline.fil: If we leave the break in the walls of the Cave of Envy for too long, this situation will become an even bigger disaster.
dialogsDecline.fr: Si nous laissons trop longtemps la brèche dans les murs de la Caverne de l'Envie, cette situation se transformera en un désastre encore plus grand.
dialogsDecline.id: Jika kita membiarkan celah di dinding Cave of Envy terlalu lama, situasi ini akan menjadi bencana yang lebih besar.
dialogsDecline.it: If we leave the break in the walls of the Cave of Envy for too long, this situation will become an even bigger disaster.
dialogsDecline.jp: 羨望の洞窟の壁の切れ目を長時間放置すると、この状況はさらに大きな災害になります。
dialogsDecline.kr: 엔비 동굴 벽의 균열을 너무 오래 방치하면, 상황이 더욱 나빠질 겁니다.
dialogsDecline.nl: If we leave the break in the walls of the Cave of Envy for too long, this situation will become an even bigger disaster.
dialogsDecline.pl: If we leave the break in the walls of the Cave of Envy for too long, this situation will become an even bigger disaster.
dialogsDecline.ru: If we leave the break in the walls of the Cave of Envy for too long, this situation will become an even bigger disaster.
dialogsDecline.sp: Si dejamos demasiado tiempo la ruptura de los muros de la Cueva de la Envidia, esta situación se convertirá en un desastre aún mayor.
dialogsDecline.sw: If we leave the break in the walls of the Cave of Envy for too long, this situation will become an even bigger disaster.
dialogsDecline.th: ถ้าเราปล่อยให้รอยแตกของผนัง Cave of Envy อยู่นานเกินไปล่ะก็ สถานะการ์ณมันจะยิ่งกลายเป็นหายนะที่ยิ่งใหญ่เกินไป
dialogsDecline.tw: 如果嫉妒洞窟牆上的缺口放太久不處理，這場災難只會變得更加嚴重。
dialogsDecline.vi: Nếu chúng ta để vết nứt trong các bức tường của Cave of Envy quá lâu, tình trạng này sẽ trở thành một thảm họa thậm chí còn lớn hơn.

dialogsComplete.en: So behind the wall seems to be a large, ornate cavern... What has Lapranche opened up to the world!?
dialogsComplete.ar: So behind the wall seems to be a large, ornate cavern... What has Lapranche opened up to the world!?
dialogsComplete.br: Do outro lado da parede tem uma caverna enorme e toda enfeitada.. O que Lapranche abriu para o mundo!?
dialogsComplete.cns: So behind the wall seems to be a large, ornate cavern... What has Lapranche opened up to the world!?
dialogsComplete.de: Hinter der Mauer scheint sich also eine große, verzierte Höhle zu befinden. Was hat Lapranche für die Welt geöffnet!?
dialogsComplete.fi: So behind the wall seems to be a large, ornate cavern... What has Lapranche opened up to the world!?
dialogsComplete.fil: So behind the wall seems to be a large, ornate cavern... What has Lapranche opened up to the world!?
dialogsComplete.fr: Derrière le mur, il semble y avoir une grande caverne ornée... Qu'est-ce que Lapranche a ouvert au monde ?
dialogsComplete.id: Jadi di balik dinding tampak sebuah gua besar berornamen.. Apa yang Lapranche telah buka untuk dunia!?
dialogsComplete.it: So behind the wall seems to be a large, ornate cavern... What has Lapranche opened up to the world!?
dialogsComplete.jp: 壁の後ろには大きくて華やかな洞窟があるようです。ラプランシェは世界に何を切り開いたのか!?
dialogsComplete.kr: 벽 뒤쪽에 크고 화려한 동굴이 있는 듯해요... 라프란체는 도대체 뭘 열어 놓은 걸까요!?
dialogsComplete.nl: So behind the wall seems to be a large, ornate cavern... What has Lapranche opened up to the world!?
dialogsComplete.pl: So behind the wall seems to be a large, ornate cavern... What has Lapranche opened up to the world!?
dialogsComplete.ru: So behind the wall seems to be a large, ornate cavern... What has Lapranche opened up to the world!?
dialogsComplete.sp: Así que detrás del muro parece haber una gran caverna adornada.. ¿Qué ha abierto Lapranche al mundo?
dialogsComplete.sw: So behind the wall seems to be a large, ornate cavern... What has Lapranche opened up to the world!?
dialogsComplete.th: หลังกำแพงนั้นดูเหมือนจะเป็นถ้ำวิหารขนาดใหญ่สินะ อะไรที่ Lapranche พามาสู่โลกเรากันแน่
dialogsComplete.tw: 所以牆後面竟然是一座華麗的大洞窟……拉普蘭雪到底又把什麼東西放到這個世界上了！？
dialogsComplete.vi: Vậy đằng sau bức tường dường như là một hang động lớn, được trang trí công phu.. Lapranche đã giải phóng cái gì ra bên ngoài vậy!?

dialogsFail.pl: Find the damaged wall in the Cave of Envy.

dialogsFail.tw: 在嫉妒洞窟中尋找受損的牆面。
dialogsFail.vi: Tìm bức tường bị hư hại trong Cave of Envy.

dialogsBegin.en: A horde of the dead have arisen inside the sanctuary...
dialogsBegin.ar: A horde of the dead have arisen inside the sanctuary...
dialogsBegin.br: Uma horda de mortos-vivos ressurgiu dentro do santuário...
dialogsBegin.cns: A horde of the dead have arisen inside the sanctuary...
dialogsBegin.de: Eine Horde von Toten ist im Heiligtum aufgetaucht...
dialogsBegin.fi: A horde of the dead have arisen inside the sanctuary...
dialogsBegin.fil: A horde of the dead have arisen inside the sanctuary...
dialogsBegin.fr: Une horde de mort a surgi à l'intérieur du Sanctuaire.
dialogsBegin.id: Gerombolan orang mati telah muncul di dalam tempat kudus..
dialogsBegin.it: A horde of the dead have arisen inside the sanctuary...
dialogsBegin.jp: 聖域内には死者の大群が出現した。
dialogsBegin.kr: 성소 안에서 죽은 자들의 무리가 깨어났어요...
dialogsBegin.nl: A horde of the dead have arisen inside the sanctuary...
dialogsBegin.pl: A horde of the dead have arisen inside the sanctuary...
dialogsBegin.ru: A horde of the dead have arisen inside the sanctuary...
dialogsBegin.sp: Una horda de muertos se ha levantado dentro del santuario..

dialogsBegin.th: กองทัพคนตายได้เกิดขึ้นภายใน sanctuary...
dialogsBegin.tw: 一大群死者已經在聖域內甦醒……
dialogsBegin.vi: Một đoàn người chết đã trỗi dậy bên trong thánh địa...

dialogsAccept.en: Your first order of duty is to eliminate the dead and find any clues that may lead to Lapranche.
dialogsAccept.ar: Your first order of duty is to eliminate the dead and find any clues that may lead to Lapranche.
dialogsAccept.br: Sua primeira missão é acabar com os mortos e encontrar qualquer pista que possa levar à Lapranche.
dialogsAccept.cns: Your first order of duty is to eliminate the dead and find any clues that may lead to Lapranche.
dialogsAccept.de: Deine erste Aufgabe besteht darin, die Toten zu beseitigen und alle Hinweise zu finden, die zu Lapranche führen könnten.
dialogsAccept.fi: Your first order of duty is to eliminate the dead and find any clues that may lead to Lapranche.
dialogsAccept.fil: Your first order of duty is to eliminate the dead and find any clues that may lead to Lapranche.
dialogsAccept.fr: Votre premier devoir est d'éliminer les morts et de trouver tout indice pouvant mener à Lapranche.
dialogsAccept.id: Urutan tugas pertama Anda adalah melenyapkan yang mati dan menemukan petunjuk yang mungkin mengarah ke Lapranche.
dialogsAccept.it: Your first order of duty is to eliminate the dead and find any clues that may lead to Lapranche.
dialogsAccept.jp: あなたの最初の義務は、死者を排除し、ラプランシュにつながる可能性のある手がかりを見つけることです。
dialogsAccept.kr: 당신의 첫 번째 임무는, 죽은 자들을 없애고 라프란체가 있는 곳을 알아낼 단서를 찾는 거예요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Your first order of duty is to eliminate the dead and find any clues that may lead to Lapranche.
dialogsAccept.pl: Your first order of duty is to eliminate the dead and find any clues that may lead to Lapranche.
dialogsAccept.ru: Your first order of duty is to eliminate the dead and find any clues that may lead to Lapranche.
dialogsAccept.sp: Tu primera orden del día es eliminar a los muertos y encontrar cualquier pista que pueda conducir a Lapranche.
dialogsAccept.sw: Your first order of duty is to eliminate the dead and find any clues that may lead to Lapranche.
dialogsAccept.th: สิ่งแรกที่เจ้าต้องทำก็คือ กำจัดพวกคนตายพวกนี้ให้หมดและหาเงื่อนงำที่จะนำไปสู่ Lapranche
dialogsAccept.tw: 你的首要任務是消滅死者並找到任何可能導致拉普朗什的線索。
dialogsAccept.vi: Nhiệm vụ đầu tiên của bạn là loại bỏ xác chết và tìm ra bất kỳ manh mối nào có thể dẫn đến Lapranche.

dialogsDecline.en: Do not feel guilty for slaying the creatures inside. They are long dead now.
dialogsDecline.ar: Do not feel guilty for slaying the creatures inside. They are long dead now.
dialogsDecline.br: Não se sinta culpado por matar as criaturas lá dentro. Elas já estão mortas faz tempo.
dialogsDecline.cns: Do not feel guilty for slaying the creatures inside. They are long dead now.
dialogsDecline.de: Fühle dich nicht schuldig, weil du die Kreaturen darin getötet hast. Sie sind jetzt schon lange tot.
dialogsDecline.fi: Do not feel guilty for slaying the creatures inside. They are long dead now.
dialogsDecline.fil: Do not feel guilty for slaying the creatures inside. They are long dead now.
dialogsDecline.fr: Ne vous sentez pas coupable d'avoir tué les créatures à l'intérieur. Cela fait longtemps qu'elles sont mortes désormais.
dialogsDecline.id: Jangan merasa bersalah karena membunuh makhluk di dalamnya. Mereka sudah lama mati sekarang.
dialogsDecline.it: Do not feel guilty for slaying the creatures inside. They are long dead now.
dialogsDecline.jp: 中の生き物を殺すことに罪悪感を感じないでください。彼らは今長い間死んでいます。
dialogsDecline.kr: 안에 있는 생명체들을 죽였다고 죄책감을 갖지는 마세요. 이미 오래전에 죽었으니까요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Do not feel guilty for slaying the creatures inside. They are long dead now.
dialogsDecline.pl: Do not feel guilty for slaying the creatures inside. They are long dead now.
dialogsDecline.ru: Do not feel guilty for slaying the creatures inside. They are long dead now.
dialogsDecline.sp: No te sientas culpable por matar a las criaturas de dentro. Hace tiempo que murieron.
dialogsDecline.sw: Do not feel guilty for slaying the creatures inside. They are long dead now.
dialogsDecline.th: อย่ารู้สึกผิดที่จะไล่กำจัดพวกทีอยู่ข้างใน พวกมันตายไปนานก่อนหน้านี้แล้ว
dialogsDecline.tw: 別因為斬殺裡頭那些生物而感到愧疚。牠們其實早就死了。
dialogsDecline.vi: Đừng cảm thấy tội lỗi vì đã giết những sinh vật bên trong. Bây giờ chúng đã chết từ lâu.

dialogsComplete.en: Well done on clearing out the dead. Oh, and what's this? Interesting... a vial of purple mist. Could the mist be connected to the Purple Magic that Lapranche is said to practice?
dialogsComplete.ar: Well done on clearing out the dead. Oh, and what's this? Interesting... a vial of purple mist. Could the mist be connected to the Purple Magic that Lapranche is said to practice?
dialogsComplete.br: Mandou bem em acabar com os mortos. Ah, e olha só isso! Interessante... um frasco de névoa roxa. Será que essa névoa tem alguma ligação com a Magia Roxa que dizem que Lapranche pratica?
dialogsComplete.cns: Well done on clearing out the dead. Oh, and what's this? Interesting... a vial of purple mist. Could the mist be connected to the Purple Magic that Lapranche is said to practice?
dialogsComplete.de: Gut gemacht, die Toten zu beseitigen. Oh, und was ist das? Interessant. Eine Ampulle mit lila Nebel. Könnte der Nebel mit der lila Magie zu tun haben, die Lapranche angeblich praktiziert?
dialogsComplete.fi: Well done on clearing out the dead. Oh, and what's this? Interesting... a vial of purple mist. Could the mist be connected to the Purple Magic that Lapranche is said to practice?
dialogsComplete.fil: Well done on clearing out the dead. Oh, and what's this? Interesting... a vial of purple mist. Could the mist be connected to the Purple Magic that Lapranche is said to practice?
dialogsComplete.fr: Bravo pour le nettoyage ! Oh, qu'est-ce que c'est ? Intéressant... Une Fiole de Brume Violette. Est-ce que la brume est liée à la Magie Pourpre dont on dit que Lapranche est adepte ?
dialogsComplete.id: Dilakukan dengan baik untuk membersihkan orang mati. Oh, dan apa ini? Menarik.. sebotol kabut ungu. Mungkinkah kabut itu terhubung dengan Purple Magic yang konon dipraktikkan oleh Lapranche?
dialogsComplete.it: Well done on clearing out the dead. Oh, and what's this? Interesting... a vial of purple mist. Could the mist be connected to the Purple Magic that Lapranche is said to practice?
dialogsComplete.jp: 死者を一掃するのによくやった。ああ、これは何ですか?面白いね。。紫色の霧の小瓶。霧は、ラプランシュが実践していると言われている紫の魔法に関連しているのでしょうか?
dialogsComplete.kr: 죽은 자들을 잘 처리해 주셨어요. 오, 이건 뭔가요? 흥미롭네요... 자주색 안개 병이라. 이 안개가, 라프란체가 사용한다는 자주색 마법과도 관련이 있을까요?
dialogsComplete.nl: Well done on clearing out the dead. Oh, and what's this? Interesting... a vial of purple mist. Could the mist be connected to the Purple Magic that Lapranche is said to practice?
dialogsComplete.pl: Well done on clearing out the dead. Oh, and what's this? Interesting... a vial of purple mist. Could the mist be connected to the Purple Magic that Lapranche is said to practice?
dialogsComplete.ru: Well done on clearing out the dead. Oh, and what's this? Interesting... a vial of purple mist. Could the mist be connected to the Purple Magic that Lapranche is said to practice?
dialogsComplete.sp: Bien hecho en la limpieza de los muertos. Oh, ¿Y qué es esto? Interesante... un frasco de niebla púrpura. ¿Podría la niebla estar conectada a la Magia Púrpura que se dice que practica Lapranche?
dialogsComplete.sw: Well done on clearing out the dead. Oh, and what's this? Interesting... a vial of purple mist. Could the mist be connected to the Purple Magic that Lapranche is said to practice?
dialogsComplete.th: ดีมากในการกำจัดพวกคนตาย โอ้! นี่มันขวด vial of purple mist เป็นไปได้ว่าหมอกสีม่วงนี่อาจจะเกี่ยวข้องกับ Purple Magic ที่ Lapranche ฝึกใช้อยู่
dialogsComplete.tw: 做得好，死者都已經清掉了。喔，這是什麼？有意思……一瓶紫色霧氣。這霧氣會不會和據說拉普蘭雪使用的紫色魔法有關？
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn làm tốt việc dọn dẹp xác chết đấy. Ồ, và cái gì đây? Thật thú vị.. một lọ bụi màu tím. Có thể nào lọ bụi có kết nối với Purple Magic mà Lapranche thực hành không?

dialogsFail.pl: Clear out the undead minions inside the sanctuary, and search for any clue that could help us find Lapranche.

dialogsFail.th: จัดการพวกสมุนอันเดทข้างใน sanctuary, และค้นหาเงื่อนงำที่ช่วยเราหา Lapranche.
dialogsFail.tw: 清除聖域內的亡靈爪牙，尋找任何能幫助我們找到拉普朗什的線索。
dialogsFail.vi: Dọn dẹp lũ tay sai bất tử bên trong sanctuary và tìm kiếm bất kỳ manh mối nào có thể giúp chúng ta tìm thấy Lapranche.

dialogsBegin.en: For many years the mine that sits atop the Azria mountains was run by a group of Dwarpets. The export of crystals from the mine allowed us to build this village in the first place, long long ago.
dialogsBegin.ar: For many years the mine that sits atop the Azria mountains was run by a group of Dwarpets. The export of crystals from the mine allowed us to build this village in the first place, long long ago.
dialogsBegin.br: Por muitos anos, a mina que fica no topo das montanhas de Azria foi administrada por um grupo de Dwarpets. Graças à exportação dos cristais da mina, conseguimos construir esta vila, há muito tempo.
dialogsBegin.cns: For many years the mine that sits atop the Azria mountains was run by a group of Dwarpets. The export of crystals from the mine allowed us to build this village in the first place, long long ago.
dialogsBegin.de: Viele Jahre lang wurde die Mine, die auf dem Azria-Gebirge liegt, von einer Gruppe von Dwarpets betrieben. Der Export von Kristallen aus der Mine ermöglichte es uns vor langer Zeit, dieses Dorf zu errichten.
dialogsBegin.fi: For many years the mine that sits atop the Azria mountains was run by a group of Dwarpets. The export of crystals from the mine allowed us to build this village in the first place, long long ago.
dialogsBegin.fil: For many years the mine that sits atop the Azria mountains was run by a group of Dwarpets. The export of crystals from the mine allowed us to build this village in the first place, long long ago.
dialogsBegin.fr: Pendant de nombreuses années, les mines que l'on trouve aux sommets des montagnes d'Azria étaient gérées par un groupe de Dwarpets. L'exportation de cristaux nous a permis de construite ce village, il y a bien longtemps.
dialogsBegin.id: Selama bertahun-tahun tambang yang berada di atas pegunungan Azria dijalankan oleh sekelompok Dwarpet. Ekspor kristal dari tambang memungkinkan kami untuk membangun desa ini sejak lama sekali.
dialogsBegin.it: For many years the mine that sits atop the Azria mountains was run by a group of Dwarpets. The export of crystals from the mine allowed us to build this village in the first place, long long ago.
dialogsBegin.jp: 何年もの間、アズリア山脈の頂上にある鉱山はドワーペットのグループによって運営されていました。鉱山からの結晶の輸出により、そもそもこの村を建設することができました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 아즈리아 산꼭대기에 있는 광산은 오랫동안 드워펫들의 소유였죠. 오래전, 광산에서 캐온 크리스탈 덕에 이 마을을 처음 건설할 수 있었답니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: For many years the mine that sits atop the Azria mountains was run by a group of Dwarpets. The export of crystals from the mine allowed us to build this village in the first place, long long ago.
dialogsBegin.pl: For many years the mine that sits atop the Azria mountains was run by a group of Dwarpets. The export of crystals from the mine allowed us to build this village in the first place, long long ago.
dialogsBegin.ru: For many years the mine that sits atop the Azria mountains was run by a group of Dwarpets. The export of crystals from the mine allowed us to build this village in the first place, long long ago.
dialogsBegin.sp: Durante muchos años, la mina que se encuentra en la cima de las montañas Azria fue gestionada por un grupo de Dwarpets. La exportación de cristales de la mina nos permitió construir esta aldea en primer lugar, hace mucho tiempo.
dialogsBegin.sw: For many years the mine that sits atop the Azria mountains was run by a group of Dwarpets. The export of crystals from the mine allowed us to build this village in the first place, long long ago.
dialogsBegin.th: เหมืองที่อยู่บนยอดเขา Azria นั้นถูกดำเนิการโดยกลุ่ม Dwarpets มาหลายปีแล้ว การส่งออกคริสตัลจากเหมืองช่วยให้เราสร้างหมู่บ้านแห่งนี้ขึ้นมาได้ตั้งแต่แรก เป็นเรื่องที่นานมากแล้ว
dialogsBegin.tw: 很多年前，位在阿茲里亞山頂的那座礦坑是由一群矮寵經營的。正是靠那座礦坑出口的水晶，我們才得以在很久很久以前建立起這座村莊。
dialogsBegin.vi: Trong nhiều năm, mỏ nằm trên đỉnh dãy núi Azria được điều hành bởi một nhóm Dwarpets. Việc xuất khẩu tinh thể từ mỏ đã cho phép chúng tôi xây dựng ngôi làng này ngay từ đầu, từ lâu lắm rồi.

dialogsBegin.en: Not only did the crystals help defend Azria Village from the monsters outside these walls, but they were once used to give life to a mechanical beast that the Dwarpets used to fight against Shade's army.
dialogsBegin.ar: Not only did the crystals help defend Azria Village from the monsters outside these walls, but they were once used to give life to a mechanical beast that the Dwarpets used to fight against Shade's army.
dialogsBegin.br: Não apenas os cristais ajudaram a defender a Vila de Azria dos monstros que estão além dessas muralhas, mas também foram usados antigamente para dar vida a uma besta mecânica que os Dwarpets usavam para lutar contra o exército de Shade.
dialogsBegin.cns: Not only did the crystals help defend Azria Village from the monsters outside these walls, but they were once used to give life to a mechanical beast that the Dwarpets used to fight against Shade's army.
dialogsBegin.de: Die Kristalle halfen nicht nur, das Dorf Azria vor den Monstern außerhalb der Mauern zu verteidigen, sondern sie wurden auch dazu verwendet, einem mechanischen Tier Leben einzuhauchen, das die Dwarpets im Kampf gegen Shades Armee einsetzten.
dialogsBegin.fi: Not only did the crystals help defend Azria Village from the monsters outside these walls, but they were once used to give life to a mechanical beast that the Dwarpets used to fight against Shade's army.
dialogsBegin.fil: Not only did the crystals help defend Azria Village from the monsters outside these walls, but they were once used to give life to a mechanical beast that the Dwarpets used to fight against Shade's army.
dialogsBegin.fr: Non seulement les cristaux ont permis de défendre le Village d'Azria des monstres en dehors de ses murs, mais ils ont aussi été utilisés pour donner vie à une bête mécanique que les Dwarpets ont utilisé pour se battre contre l'armée de Shade.
dialogsBegin.id: Kristal tidak hanya membantu mempertahankan Azria Village dari monster di luar tembok ini, tetapi juga pernah digunakan untuk memberikan kehidupan kepada binatang mekanik yang digunakan Dwarpet untuk berperang melawan pasukan Shade.
dialogsBegin.it: Not only did the crystals help defend Azria Village from the monsters outside these walls, but they were once used to give life to a mechanical beast that the Dwarpets used to fight against Shade's army.
dialogsBegin.jp: クリスタルは、これらの壁の外のモンスターからアズリア村を守るのに役立つだけでなく、かつてドワーペットがシェイドの軍隊と戦うために使用した機械的な獣に命を与えるために使用されていました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 크리스탈은 성벽 밖의 몬스터에게서 아즈리아 마을을 지키는 데 사용했었고, 한때 드워펫이 쉐이드의 군대에 맞서 싸우느라 사용했던 기계 야수에 생명을 불어넣을 때도 사용했어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Not only did the crystals help defend Azria Village from the monsters outside these walls, but they were once used to give life to a mechanical beast that the Dwarpets used to fight against Shade's army.
dialogsBegin.pl: Not only did the crystals help defend Azria Village from the monsters outside these walls, but they were once used to give life to a mechanical beast that the Dwarpets used to fight against Shade's army.
dialogsBegin.ru: Not only did the crystals help defend Azria Village from the monsters outside these walls, but they were once used to give life to a mechanical beast that the Dwarpets used to fight against Shade's army.
dialogsBegin.sp: Los cristales no sólo ayudaron a defender la Aldea Azria de los monstruos que se encontraban fuera de estos muros, sino que una vez se utilizaron para dar vida a una bestia mecánica que los Dwarpets usaron para luchar contra el ejército de Shade.
dialogsBegin.sw: Not only did the crystals help defend Azria Village from the monsters outside these walls, but they were once used to give life to a mechanical beast that the Dwarpets used to fight against Shade's army.
dialogsBegin.th: คริสตัลไม่เพียงแต่ช่วยป้องกัน Azria Village จากพวกมอนสเตอร์นอกกำแพงเท่านั้น แต่ยังให้ชีวิตกับสัตว์จักรกลที่พวก Dwarpets สร้างขึ้นมาพอต่อสู้กับกองทัพของ Shade ด้วย
dialogsBegin.tw: 那些水晶不僅幫助我們守護阿茲里亞村，抵禦牆外的怪物，還曾被用來賦予一頭機械巨獸生命，讓矮寵一族能與闇影的軍勢對抗。
dialogsBegin.vi: Những viên pha lê không chỉ giúp bảo vệ Làng Azria khỏi những con quái vật bên ngoài những bức tường này, mà chúng còn từng được sử dụng để mang lại sự sống cho một con quái vật máy móc mà Dwarpets sử dụng để chiến đấu chống lại quân đội của Shade.

dialogsBegin.en: Rankashu probably wonders what is left of the mine's powerful crystals, and what may have been left behind by his people...
dialogsBegin.ar: Rankashu probably wonders what is left of the mine's powerful crystals, and what may have been left behind by his people...
dialogsBegin.br: Rankashu provavelmente está curioso sobre o que restou dos cristais poderosos da mina e quais tesouros foram deixados para trás pelos seus antecessores.
dialogsBegin.cns: Rankashu probably wonders what is left of the mine's powerful crystals, and what may have been left behind by his people...
dialogsBegin.de: Rankashu fragt sich wahrscheinlich, was von den mächtigen Kristallen in der Mine übrig geblieben ist und was seine Leute zurückgelassen haben könnten.
dialogsBegin.fi: Rankashu probably wonders what is left of the mine's powerful crystals, and what may have been left behind by his people...
dialogsBegin.fil: Rankashu probably wonders what is left of the mine's powerful crystals, and what may have been left behind by his people...
dialogsBegin.fr: Rankashu se demande probablement ce qu'il reste des puissants cristaux de la mine et ce qui a pu être laissé par son peuple...
dialogsBegin.id: Rankashu mungkin bertanya-tanya apa yang tersisa dari kristal kuat tambang, dan apa yang mungkin ditinggalkan oleh rakyatnya..
dialogsBegin.it: Rankashu probably wonders what is left of the mine's powerful crystals, and what may have been left behind by his people...
dialogsBegin.jp: 蘭川はおそらく、鉱山の強力な結晶が何を残しているのか、そして彼の人々が残したものは何なのか疑問に思っているでしょう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 랑카슈는 아직도 광산 안에 강력한 크리스탈이 남아있는지, 사람들이 뭘 남겨두었는지 궁금할 테죠...
dialogsBegin.nl: Rankashu probably wonders what is left of the mine's powerful crystals, and what may have been left behind by his people...
dialogsBegin.pl: Rankashu probably wonders what is left of the mine's powerful crystals, and what may have been left behind by his people...
dialogsBegin.ru: Rankashu probably wonders what is left of the mine's powerful crystals, and what may have been left behind by his people...
dialogsBegin.sp: Rankashu probablemente se pregunta qué queda de los poderosos cristales de la mina, y qué puede haber dejado atrás su pueblo..
dialogsBegin.sw: Rankashu probably wonders what is left of the mine's powerful crystals, and what may have been left behind by his people...
dialogsBegin.th: Rankashu อาจจะสงสัยอยู่ก็ได้ว่าอะไรที่เหลืออยู่กับคริสตัลที่ทรงพลังนั้น และอะไรที่ถูกทิ้งไว้จากผู้คนของพวกเขา
dialogsBegin.tw: 蘭卡修大概很想知道，礦坑裡那些強大的水晶還剩下多少，又或者他的族人是否留下了什麼東西……
dialogsBegin.vi: Rankashu có lẽ đang tự hỏi những tinh thể mạnh mẽ tại mỏ khai thác còn lại gì, và những gì có thể đã bị bỏ lại bởi đồng loại của anh ta...

dialogsAccept.en: There is a guard outside the entrance to the Storm Peak where the Azria Mine is located, let him know that Mawrang has sent you and he may allow you to step inside the mine to search for clues.
dialogsAccept.ar: There is a guard outside the entrance to the Storm Peak where the Azria Mine is located, let him know that Mawrang has sent you and he may allow you to step inside the mine to search for clues.
dialogsAccept.br: Há um guarda do lado de fora da entrada do Pico da Tempestade, onde está localizada a Mina de Azria. Informe-o de que Mawrang o enviou e ele poderá permitir que você entre na mina em busca de pistas.
dialogsAccept.cns: There is a guard outside the entrance to the Storm Peak where the Azria Mine is located, let him know that Mawrang has sent you and he may allow you to step inside the mine to search for clues.
dialogsAccept.de: Vor dem Eingang zum Sturmgipfel, wo sich die Azria-Mine befindet, steht eine Wache. Erzählt, dass Mawrang euch geschickt hat, und euch wird erlaubt, die Mine zu betreten und nach Hinweisen zu suchen.
dialogsAccept.fi: There is a guard outside the entrance to the Storm Peak where the Azria Mine is located, let him know that Mawrang has sent you and he may allow you to step inside the mine to search for clues.
dialogsAccept.fil: There is a guard outside the entrance to the Storm Peak where the Azria Mine is located, let him know that Mawrang has sent you and he may allow you to step inside the mine to search for clues.
dialogsAccept.fr: Il y a un gardien posté à l'entrée du Pic de Tempête où la mine Azria se trouve. Dites lui que Mawran vous a envoyé et il vous laissera peut être entrer dans la mine en quête d'indices.
dialogsAccept.id: Ada penjaga di luar pintu masuk ke Storm Peak di mana Azria Mine berada, beri tahu dia bahwa Mawrang telah mengirimmu dan dia mengizinkanmu masuk ke dalam tambang untuk mencari petunjuk.
dialogsAccept.it: There is a guard outside the entrance to the Storm Peak where the Azria Mine is located, let him know that Mawrang has sent you and he may allow you to step inside the mine to search for clues.
dialogsAccept.jp: アズリア鉱山があるストームピークの入り口の外に警備員がいて、マウランがあなたを送ったことを彼に知らせてください、そして彼はあなたが手がかりを探すために鉱山の中に足を踏み入れることを許可するかもしれません。
dialogsAccept.kr: 아즈리아 광산이 있는 스톰 봉우리 입구 쪽에 경비병이 있습니다. 그에게 마우랑의 부탁을 받고 왔다고 말하면, 광산 안에 들어가 단서를 찾게 해 줄지도 몰라요.
dialogsAccept.nl: There is a guard outside the entrance to the Storm Peak where the Azria Mine is located, let him know that Mawrang has sent you and he may allow you to step inside the mine to search for clues.
dialogsAccept.pl: There is a guard outside the entrance to the Storm Peak where the Azria Mine is located, let him know that Mawrang has sent you and he may allow you to step inside the mine to search for clues.
dialogsAccept.ru: There is a guard outside the entrance to the Storm Peak where the Azria Mine is located, let him know that Mawrang has sent you and he may allow you to step inside the mine to search for clues.
dialogsAccept.sp: Hay un guardia fuera de la entrada del Pico de la Tormenta donde se encuentra la Mina Azria, hazle saber que Mawrang te ha enviado y puede que te permita entrar en la mina para buscar pistas.
dialogsAccept.sw: There is a guard outside the entrance to the Storm Peak where the Azria Mine is located, let him know that Mawrang has sent you and he may allow you to step inside the mine to search for clues.
dialogsAccept.th: มีการ์ดยืนอยูที่ด้านนอกทางเข้าของ Storm Peak ที่ซึ่ง Azria Mine ตั้งอยู่ บอกเขาว่า Mawrang ส่งเจ้ามาและเขาอาจจะให้เจ้าได้เข้าไปข้างในเพื่อหาเงื่อนงำก็ก็ได้
dialogsAccept.tw: 通往阿茲里亞礦坑的風暴峰入口外有一名守衛。你只要告訴他是馬巫郎派你來的，也許他就會讓你進礦坑搜尋線索。
dialogsAccept.vi: Có một người bảo vệ bên ngoài lối vào Storm Peak, nơi có Azria Mine, hãy cho anh ta biết rằng Mawrang đã cử bạn đến và anh ta có thể cho phép bạn bước vào bên trong mỏ để tìm kiếm manh mối.

dialogsDecline.en: Those are do not seek knowledge may never know true wisdom...
dialogsDecline.ar: Those are do not seek knowledge may never know true wisdom...
dialogsDecline.br: Aqueles que não ousam buscar conhecimento jamais conhecerão a verdadeira essência da sabedoria.
dialogsDecline.cns: Those are do not seek knowledge may never know true wisdom...
dialogsDecline.de: Diejenigen, die nicht nach Wissen streben, werden niemals wahre Weisheit erfahren.
dialogsDecline.fi: Those are do not seek knowledge may never know true wisdom...
dialogsDecline.fil: Those are do not seek knowledge may never know true wisdom...
dialogsDecline.fr: Ceux qui ne cherchent pas la connaissance ne connaitront peut être jamais la véritable sagesse...
dialogsDecline.id: Mereka yang tidak mencari ilmu mungkin tidak pernah tahu kebijaksanaan sejati..
dialogsDecline.it: Those are do not seek knowledge may never know true wisdom...
dialogsDecline.jp: 知識を求めない人は、真の知恵を知ることは決してないかもしれません。
dialogsDecline.kr: 지식을 좇는 자만이 진정한 지혜를 알게 되리니...
dialogsDecline.nl: Those are do not seek knowledge may never know true wisdom...
dialogsDecline.pl: Those are do not seek knowledge may never know true wisdom...
dialogsDecline.ru: Those are do not seek knowledge may never know true wisdom...
dialogsDecline.sp: Aquellos que no buscan el conocimiento nunca conocerán la verdadera sabiduría...
dialogsDecline.sw: Those are do not seek knowledge may never know true wisdom...
dialogsDecline.th: ผู้ซึ่งไม่ยอมแสวงหาความรู้ ยอมไม่ได้พบกับภูมิปัญญาที่แท้จริง...
dialogsDecline.tw: 不願追求知識的人，永遠不會明白真正的智慧……
dialogsDecline.vi: Những kẻ không mong cầu tri ​​​​thức có thể không bao giờ chạm đến được trí tuệ thực sự...

dialogsComplete.en: Oh hello, it's rare to see visitors way up here. I see, so Mawrang sent you to investigate the mine.
dialogsComplete.ar: Oh hello, it's rare to see visitors way up here. I see, so Mawrang sent you to investigate the mine.
dialogsComplete.br: Oh, olá! É raro ver visitantes tão longe aqui. Entendo, então Mawrang enviou você para investigar a mina.
dialogsComplete.cns: Oh hello, it's rare to see visitors way up here. I see, so Mawrang sent you to investigate the mine.
dialogsComplete.de: Oh hallo, es ist selten, dass man hier oben Besucher sieht. Verstehe, Mawrang hat dich also geschickt, um die Mine zu untersuchen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Oh hello, it's rare to see visitors way up here. I see, so Mawrang sent you to investigate the mine.
dialogsComplete.fil: Oh hello, it's rare to see visitors way up here. I see, so Mawrang sent you to investigate the mine.
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh bonjour ! Il est rare de tomber sur des visiteurs ici. Je vois, donc Mawran vous envoie pour enquêter sur la mine.
dialogsComplete.id: Oh halo, sangat jarang melihat pengunjung jauh di sini. Begitu ya, jadi Mawrang mengirimmu untuk menyelidiki tambang itu.
dialogsComplete.it: Oh hello, it's rare to see visitors way up here. I see, so Mawrang sent you to investigate the mine.
dialogsComplete.jp: こんにちは、ここに訪問者がいるのを見るのはめったにありません。なるほど、それでマウランは鉱山の調査にあなたを送りました。
dialogsComplete.kr: 오, 안녕하세요. 이곳엔 방문자들이 잘 오지 않는데. 그렇군요. 마우랑이 광산을 조사하고 오라고 보냈단 말이죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: Oh hello, it's rare to see visitors way up here. I see, so Mawrang sent you to investigate the mine.
dialogsComplete.pl: Oh hello, it's rare to see visitors way up here. I see, so Mawrang sent you to investigate the mine.
dialogsComplete.ru: Oh hello, it's rare to see visitors way up here. I see, so Mawrang sent you to investigate the mine.
dialogsComplete.sp: Oh hola, es raro ver visitantes por aquí arriba. Ya veo, así que Mawrang te envió a investigar la mina.
dialogsComplete.sw: Oh hello, it's rare to see visitors way up here. I see, so Mawrang sent you to investigate the mine.
dialogsComplete.th: โอ้ สวัสดี ไม่ค่อยจะได้เจอใครขึ้นมาบนนี้เลย เข้าใจล่ะ Mawrang ส่งเจ้ามาตรวจสอบเหมืองสินะ
dialogsComplete.tw: 喔，你好。這麼高的地方很少有訪客來呢。原來如此，所以是馬巫郎派你來調查礦坑的。
dialogsComplete.vi: Ồ, hiếm khi thấy du khách lên đây. Tôi hiểu rồi, vì vậy Mawrang cử bạn đi điều tra mỏ.

dialogsBegin.en: The weather lately has been terrible! Recently lightning has been striking airships on route to Saint City, causing delays in our shipments.
dialogsBegin.ar: The weather lately has been terrible! Recently lightning has been striking airships on route to Saint City, causing delays in our shipments.
dialogsBegin.br: O clima tá terrível ultimamente! Parece que os raios estão atingindo os navios aéreos que vão pra Cidade de Saint, causando um monte de atrasos nas nossas entregas.
dialogsBegin.cns: The weather lately has been terrible! Recently lightning has been striking airships on route to Saint City, causing delays in our shipments.
dialogsBegin.de: Das Wetter war in letzter Zeit schrecklich! Kürzlich schlugen Blitze in Luftschiffe auf dem Weg nach Saint Morning ein, was zu Verzögerungen bei unseren Sendungen führte.
dialogsBegin.fi: The weather lately has been terrible! Recently lightning has been striking airships on route to Saint City, causing delays in our shipments.
dialogsBegin.fil: The weather lately has been terrible! Recently lightning has been striking airships on route to Saint City, causing delays in our shipments.
dialogsBegin.fr: Le temps a été terrible ces derniers temps ! Récemment, la foudre s'est abattue sur les dirigeables en route vers Saincity, entraînant des retards dans nos expéditions.
dialogsBegin.id: Cuaca akhir-akhir ini sangat buruk! Baru-baru ini petir menyambar kapal udara dalam perjalanan ke Saint City, menyebabkan keterlambatan pengiriman kami.
dialogsBegin.it: The weather lately has been terrible! Recently lightning has been striking airships on route to Saint City, causing delays in our shipments.
dialogsBegin.jp: 最近の天気はひどいです!最近、セントシティに向かう飛行船に雷が落ち、出荷が遅れています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 요즘 왜 이렇게 날씨가 엉망이죠? 최근 세인트 시티로 가는 비행선에 계속 번개가 쳐서, 수송이 지연되고 있어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: The weather lately has been terrible! Recently lightning has been striking airships on route to Saint City, causing delays in our shipments.
dialogsBegin.pl: The weather lately has been terrible! Recently lightning has been striking airships on route to Saint City, causing delays in our shipments.
dialogsBegin.ru: The weather lately has been terrible! Recently lightning has been striking airships on route to Saint City, causing delays in our shipments.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡El tiempo últimamente ha sido terrible! Cayeron rayos en las aeronaves en ruta a Ciudad Santa, provocando retrasos en nuestros envíos.
dialogsBegin.sw: The weather lately has been terrible! Recently lightning has been striking airships on route to Saint City, causing delays in our shipments.
dialogsBegin.th: อากาศช่วงหลังนี่ไม่ดีเอาซะเลย! ไม่นานนี้เองสายฟ้าได้ฟาดไปยังเรือเหาะที่มีเส้นทางมุ่งหน้าไปยัง Saint City ทำให้สินค้าเราส่งล่าช้า
dialogsBegin.tw: 最近天氣糟透了！近來前往聖音特航線上的飛艇頻頻遭到雷擊，導致我們的貨運一再延誤。
dialogsBegin.vi: Thời tiết gần đây thật tồi tệ! Gần đây sét đã đánh trúng airships trên đường đến Saint City, gây ra sự chậm trễ trong các chuyến hàng của chúng tôi.

dialogsBegin.en: I wonder what has caused all the bad weather lately? I am still on duty here for a while longer.
dialogsBegin.ar: I wonder what has caused all the bad weather lately? I am still on duty here for a while longer.
dialogsBegin.br: Será que alguém tem uma explicação pro mau tempo que tá rolando ultimamente? Tô aqui de plantão por mais um tempinho.
dialogsBegin.cns: I wonder what has caused all the bad weather lately? I am still on duty here for a while longer.
dialogsBegin.de: Was wohl die Ursache für das schlechte Wetter in letzter Zeit war? Ich bin hier noch eine Weile im Dienst.
dialogsBegin.fi: I wonder what has caused all the bad weather lately? I am still on duty here for a while longer.
dialogsBegin.fil: I wonder what has caused all the bad weather lately? I am still on duty here for a while longer.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je me demande ce qui a provoqué toutes ces intempéries ces derniers temps. Je suis encore en service ici pour un certain temps.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya bertanya-tanya apa yang menyebabkan semua cuaca buruk akhir-akhir ini? Saya masih bertugas di sini untuk beberapa waktu lagi.
dialogsBegin.it: I wonder what has caused all the bad weather lately? I am still on duty here for a while longer.
dialogsBegin.jp: 最近、何が悪天候を引き起こしたのだろうか?私はまだしばらくここで勤務しています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 요즘 날씨가 왜 이렇게 안 좋은지 궁금하네요. 아직 한동안은 이곳에 더 있을 거랍니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: I wonder what has caused all the bad weather lately? I am still on duty here for a while longer.
dialogsBegin.pl: I wonder what has caused all the bad weather lately? I am still on duty here for a while longer.
dialogsBegin.ru: I wonder what has caused all the bad weather lately? I am still on duty here for a while longer.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Me pregunto qué habrá causado el mal tiempo últimamente? Todavía estoy de servicio aquí por más rato.
dialogsBegin.sw: I wonder what has caused all the bad weather lately? I am still on duty here for a while longer.
dialogsBegin.th: ข้าสงสัยเหลือเกินว่าอะไรเป็นเหตุให้อากาศมันแย่ขนาดนี้ช่วงหลัง ๆ ข้ายังคงต้องทำหน้าที่ ณ ที่นี่ต่อไปอีกช่วงนึงเลย
dialogsBegin.tw: 我真想知道最近這些惡劣天氣到底是怎麼回事？不過我暫時還得留在這裡值勤。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi tự hỏi điều gì đã gây ra tất cả thời tiết xấu gần đây? Tôi còn làm nhiệm vụ ở đây thêm một thời gian nữa.

dialogsBegin.en: Parine helps manage the Station with me. She acts as a scion of the great Elementor hero, Lillip.
dialogsBegin.ar: Parine helps manage the Station with me. She acts as a scion of the great Elementor hero, Lillip.
dialogsBegin.br: Parine ajuda a gerenciar a Estação comigo. Ela age como uma descendente da grande heroína Elementor, Lillip.
dialogsBegin.cns: Parine helps manage the Station with me. She acts as a scion of the great Elementor hero, Lillip.
dialogsBegin.de: Parine hilft mir bei der Verwaltung der Station. Sie ist ein Nachkomme des großen Elementor-Helden Lillip.
dialogsBegin.fi: Parine helps manage the Station with me. She acts as a scion of the great Elementor hero, Lillip.
dialogsBegin.fil: Parine helps manage the Station with me. She acts as a scion of the great Elementor hero, Lillip.
dialogsBegin.fr: Parine m'aide à gérer la station. Elle agit comme une descendante du grand héros d'Élémentaliste, Lillip.
dialogsBegin.id: Parine membantu mengelola Stasiun dengan saya. Dia bertindak sebagai keturunan dari pahlawan Elementor yang hebat, Lillip.
dialogsBegin.it: Parine helps manage the Station with me. She acts as a scion of the great Elementor hero, Lillip.
dialogsBegin.jp: パリンは私と一緒に駅を管理するのを手伝ってくれます。彼女は偉大なエレメンターヒーロー、リリップの末裔として行動します。
dialogsBegin.kr: 파린은 저와 함께 정류장 관리를 하고 있어요. 위대한 엘리멘터 영웅, 릴립의 후손이기도 하죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: Parine helps manage the Station with me. She acts as a scion of the great Elementor hero, Lillip.
dialogsBegin.pl: Parine helps manage the Station with me. She acts as a scion of the great Elementor hero, Lillip.
dialogsBegin.ru: Parine helps manage the Station with me. She acts as a scion of the great Elementor hero, Lillip.
dialogsBegin.sp: Parine ayuda a dirigir la Estación conmigo. Actúa como descendiente del gran héroe de Elementor, Lillip.
dialogsBegin.sw: Parine helps manage the Station with me. She acts as a scion of the great Elementor hero, Lillip.
dialogsBegin.th: Parine ช่วยกันจัดการสถานนีกับข้า หล่อนทำตัวเหมือนเป็นเชื้อสายของ Elementor hero, Lillip
dialogsBegin.tw: 帕琳和我一起負責管理這座站點。她繼承了偉大元素使英雄莉莉普的血脈。
dialogsBegin.vi: Parine giúp quản lý Station với tôi. Cô đóng vai trò là hậu duệ của Elementor hero, Lillip.

dialogsAccept.en: Parine may know why the skies have been so angry lately. Go speak with her please!
dialogsAccept.ar: Parine may know why the skies have been so angry lately. Go speak with her please!
dialogsAccept.br: A Parine deve ter uma ideia do porquê dos céus estarem tão bravos ultimamente. Vai lá conversar com ela.
dialogsAccept.cns: Parine may know why the skies have been so angry lately. Go speak with her please!
dialogsAccept.de: Parine weiß vielleicht, warum der Himmel in letzter Zeit so wütend war. Sprich bitte mit ihr!
dialogsAccept.fi: Parine may know why the skies have been so angry lately. Go speak with her please!
dialogsAccept.fil: Parine may know why the skies have been so angry lately. Go speak with her please!
dialogsAccept.fr: Parine sait peut-être pourquoi les cieux sont si fâchés ces derniers temps. Allez lui parler, s'il vous plaît !
dialogsAccept.id: Parine mungkin tahu mengapa langit sangat marah akhir-akhir ini. Silakan bicara dengannya!
dialogsAccept.it: Parine may know why the skies have been so angry lately. Go speak with her please!
dialogsAccept.jp: パリーンは、なぜ空が最近そんなに怒っているのか知っているかもしれません。彼女と話してください!
dialogsAccept.kr: 파린이라면 요즘 왜 날씨가 엉망인지 알지도 몰라요. 가서 파린에게 물어봐 주세요, 부탁이에요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Parine may know why the skies have been so angry lately. Go speak with her please!
dialogsAccept.pl: Parine may know why the skies have been so angry lately. Go speak with her please!
dialogsAccept.ru: Parine may know why the skies have been so angry lately. Go speak with her please!
dialogsAccept.sp: Puede que Parine sepa por qué los cielos están enojados últimamente. ¡Hablar con ella, por favor!
dialogsAccept.sw: Parine may know why the skies have been so angry lately. Go speak with her please!
dialogsAccept.th: Parine อาจจะรู้ก็ได้ว่าทำไมท้องฟ้าถึงได้พิโรธนักช่วงหลังนี่ ไปลองพูดกับเธอดูหน่อยเถอะได้โปรด
dialogsAccept.tw: 也許帕琳知道最近天空為什麼這麼暴躁。拜託你去找她談談吧！
dialogsAccept.vi: Parine có thể biết lý do tại sao bầu trời gần đây sấm chớp. Đi nói chuyện với cô ấy làm ơn!

dialogsDecline.en: The lightning is out of control... perhaps you can help us another time.
dialogsDecline.ar: The lightning is out of control... perhaps you can help us another time.
dialogsDecline.br: Olha, os raios tão fora de controle mesmo.. não dá pra lidar com isso agora, mas quem sabe você pode ajudar a gente depois, né?
dialogsDecline.cns: The lightning is out of control... perhaps you can help us another time.
dialogsDecline.de: Die Blitze sind außer Kontrolle. Vielleicht kannst du uns ein anderes Mal helfen.
dialogsDecline.fi: The lightning is out of control... perhaps you can help us another time.
dialogsDecline.fil: The lightning is out of control... perhaps you can help us another time.
dialogsDecline.fr: La foudre est hors de contrôle... peut-être pourrez-vous nous aider une autre fois.
dialogsDecline.id: Petirnya di luar kendali.. mungkin kamu bisa membantu kami lain kali.
dialogsDecline.it: The lightning is out of control... perhaps you can help us another time.
dialogsDecline.jp: 雷は制御不能です..おそらくあなたは別の機会に私たちを助けることができます。
dialogsDecline.kr: 지금은 번개가 완전히 통제 불능이군요... 다음에 도와주시면 좋겠어요.
dialogsDecline.nl: The lightning is out of control... perhaps you can help us another time.
dialogsDecline.pl: The lightning is out of control... perhaps you can help us another time.
dialogsDecline.ru: The lightning is out of control... perhaps you can help us another time.
dialogsDecline.sp: El relámpago está fuera de control .. tal vez nos ayudes en otra ocasión.
dialogsDecline.sw: The lightning is out of control... perhaps you can help us another time.
dialogsDecline.th: สายฟ้ามันเกิดการควบคุมแล้ว บางที คุณอาจจะมาช่วยเราทีหลังได้นะ
dialogsDecline.tw: 這雷電已經失控了……也許改天你再來幫我們吧。
dialogsDecline.vi: Tia sét đang nằm ngoài tầm kiểm soát.. có lẽ bạn có thể giúp chúng tôi vào lúc khác.

dialogsComplete.en: It is true, the airship deliveries have stopped due to lightning... We must get to the bottom of this, for Saint City.
dialogsComplete.ar: It is true, the airship deliveries have stopped due to lightning... We must get to the bottom of this, for Saint City.
dialogsComplete.br: É verdade mesmo, os navios aéreos não estão mais entregando nada por causa dos raios! Precisamos resolver isso logo, pelo bem da Cidade de Saint!
dialogsComplete.cns: It is true, the airship deliveries have stopped due to lightning... We must get to the bottom of this, for Saint City.
dialogsComplete.de: Es stimmt, die Luftschifflieferungen wurden wegen eines Blitzes gestoppt... Wir müssen der Sache auf den Grund gehen, für Saint Morning.
dialogsComplete.fi: It is true, the airship deliveries have stopped due to lightning... We must get to the bottom of this, for Saint City.
dialogsComplete.fil: It is true, the airship deliveries have stopped due to lightning... We must get to the bottom of this, for Saint City.
dialogsComplete.fr: C'est vrai, les livraisons de dirigeables ont été interrompues à cause de la foudre... Nous devons faire toute la lumière sur cette affaire, pour Saincity.
dialogsComplete.id: Memang benar, pengiriman pesawat terhenti karena petir.. Kita harus menyelesaikan ini, untuk Saint City.
dialogsComplete.it: It is true, the airship deliveries have stopped due to lightning... We must get to the bottom of this, for Saint City.
dialogsComplete.jp: 確かに、雷のために飛行船の配達が停止しました。セントシティのために、私たちはこれの根底に到達しなければなりません。
dialogsComplete.kr: 그래요, 비행선 수송이 중단된 건 번개 때문이랍니다... 세인트 시티를 위해서, 반드시 이 사건의 진상을 파악해야겠어요.
dialogsComplete.nl: It is true, the airship deliveries have stopped due to lightning... We must get to the bottom of this, for Saint City.
dialogsComplete.pl: It is true, the airship deliveries have stopped due to lightning... We must get to the bottom of this, for Saint City.
dialogsComplete.ru: It is true, the airship deliveries have stopped due to lightning... We must get to the bottom of this, for Saint City.
dialogsComplete.sp: Es cierto, las entregas de la aeronave se han detenido debido a un rayo .. Debemos llegar al fondo de esto, por Ciudad Santa.
dialogsComplete.sw: It is true, the airship deliveries have stopped due to lightning... We must get to the bottom of this, for Saint City.
dialogsComplete.th: มันเป็นเรื่องจริง เรือเหาะต้องหยุดขนส่งเพราะว่าสายฟ้า เราคงต้องหาเหตุผลเรื่องนี้ให้ได้ เพื่อ Saint City
dialogsComplete.tw: 沒錯，因為雷擊的關係，飛艇運輸已經停止了……為了聖音特，我們一定得查出原因。
dialogsComplete.vi: Đúng là đường vận chuyển hàng không đã bị dừng lại do sét đánh.. Chúng ta phải tìm hiểu cặn kẽ vấn đề này, vì Saint City.

dialogsFail.tw: 找到帕琳，把飛艇的情況告訴她。
