dialogsBegin.en: No wonder Lapranche released the powers hidden within the Envy Depths... She has certainly bought time to work towards her own goals while you deal with this.
dialogsBegin.ar: No wonder Lapranche released the powers hidden within the Envy Depths... She has certainly bought time to work towards her own goals while you deal with this.
dialogsBegin.br: Não é surpresa que Lapranche tenha soltado os poderes escondidos nas Profundezas da Inveja... Com certeza ela tá se aproveitando desse momento pra correr atrás dos próprios objetivos enquanto você lida com essa parada.
dialogsBegin.cns: No wonder Lapranche released the powers hidden within the Envy Depths... She has certainly bought time to work towards her own goals while you deal with this.
dialogsBegin.de: Kein Wunder, dass Lapranche die in den Neidischen Tiefen verborgenen Kräfte freigesetzt hat. Sie hat sich sicherlich Zeit verschafft, um auf ihre eigenen Ziele hinzuarbeiten, während du dich mit dieser Sache beschäftigt.
dialogsBegin.fi: No wonder Lapranche released the powers hidden within the Envy Depths... She has certainly bought time to work towards her own goals while you deal with this.
dialogsBegin.fil: No wonder Lapranche released the powers hidden within the Envy Depths... She has certainly bought time to work towards her own goals while you deal with this.
dialogsBegin.fr: Pas étonnant que Lapranche ait libéré les pouvoirs cachés dans l'Abîme de l'Envie... Elle a certainement gagné du temps pour travailler à ses propres objectifs pendant que vous vous occupez de cela.
dialogsBegin.id: Tidak heran Lapranche melepaskan kekuatan yang tersembunyi di dalam Envy Depths.. Dia pasti mengulur waktu untuk bekerja menuju tujuannya sendiri saat kamu menangani ini.
dialogsBegin.it: No wonder Lapranche released the powers hidden within the Envy Depths... She has certainly bought time to work towards her own goals while you deal with this.
dialogsBegin.jp: ラプランシュが羨望の深さに隠された力を解放したのも不思議ではありません。あなたがこれに対処している間、彼女は確かに彼女自身の目標に向かって働くための時間を稼いでいます。
dialogsBegin.kr: 라프란체가 엔비 심연에 숨겨져 있는 힘을 방출한 게 분명합니다... 당신이 이 일을 해결하는 동안, 라프란체는 자기 목표를 달성할 시간을 번 것이 되니까요.
dialogsBegin.nl: No wonder Lapranche released the powers hidden within the Envy Depths... She has certainly bought time to work towards her own goals while you deal with this.
dialogsBegin.pl: No wonder Lapranche released the powers hidden within the Envy Depths... She has certainly bought time to work towards her own goals while you deal with this.
dialogsBegin.ru: No wonder Lapranche released the powers hidden within the Envy Depths... She has certainly bought time to work towards her own goals while you deal with this.
dialogsBegin.sp: No es de extrañar que Lapranche liberara los poderes ocultos en las Profundidades de la Envidia.. Ciertamente ha ganado tiempo para trabajar en sus propios objetivos mientras tú te ocupas de esto.
dialogsBegin.sw: No wonder Lapranche released the powers hidden within the Envy Depths... She has certainly bought time to work towards her own goals while you deal with this.
dialogsBegin.th: ไม่น่าแปลกใจที่ Lapranche ปลดปล่อยพลังที่ซ่อนอยู่ใส่ Envy Depths เพราะหล่อนจะได้มีเวลาทำสิ่งที่ต้องการในขณะที่เจ้าต้องมาจัดการสิ่งนี้
dialogsBegin.tw: 難怪拉普蘭雪會釋放嫉妒深淵裡潛藏的力量……你在處理這件事的同時，她肯定已經替自己的計畫爭取到了不少時間。
dialogsBegin.vi: Chẳng trách Lapranche lại giải phóng sức mạnh ẩn giấu trong Envy Depths.. Cô ta chắc chắn đã câu giờ để hoàn thành mục tiêu của mình trong khi bạn bận tay giải quyết chuyện này.

dialogsBegin.en: I believed the masquerpets that you gathered samples from were the last remaining creatures within the cavern... but certainly you hear the roar coming from within the cavern now?
dialogsBegin.ar: I believed the masquerpets that you gathered samples from were the last remaining creatures within the cavern... but certainly you hear the roar coming from within the cavern now?
dialogsBegin.br: Eu achava que os masquerpets dos quais você pegou amostras eram os últimos bichos na caverna... mas agora você escuta o rugido vindo lá de dentro?
dialogsBegin.cns: I believed the masquerpets that you gathered samples from were the last remaining creatures within the cavern... but certainly you hear the roar coming from within the cavern now?
dialogsBegin.de: Ich habe geglaubt, dass die Masquerpets, von denen du Proben genommen hast, die letzten verbliebenen Kreaturen in der Höhle waren... aber du hörst doch sicher das Gebrüll, das jetzt aus der Höhle kommt?
dialogsBegin.fi: I believed the masquerpets that you gathered samples from were the last remaining creatures within the cavern... but certainly you hear the roar coming from within the cavern now?
dialogsBegin.fil: I believed the masquerpets that you gathered samples from were the last remaining creatures within the cavern... but certainly you hear the roar coming from within the cavern now?
dialogsBegin.fr: Je croyais que les mascarons dont vous avez recueilli des échantillons étaient les dernières créatures qui restaient dans la caverne... mais vous entendez certainement le rugissement qui vient de l'intérieur de la caverne maintenant ?
dialogsBegin.id: Aku percaya topeng yang kamu kumpulkan sampelnya adalah makhluk terakhir yang tersisa di dalam gua .. tetapi tentu saja kamu mendengar suara gemuruh yang berasal dari dalam gua sekarang?
dialogsBegin.it: I believed the masquerpets that you gathered samples from were the last remaining creatures within the cavern... but certainly you hear the roar coming from within the cavern now?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたがサンプルを集めたマスカレットは、洞窟内に最後に残った生き物だと信じていました。しかし、確かにあなたは今洞窟の中から轟音が聞こえますか?
dialogsBegin.kr: 당신이 표본을 채취한 마스커펫이 동굴에 남은 마지막 생명체라고 생각했는데... 동굴에서 포효 소리가 들린다는 게 정말인가요?
dialogsBegin.nl: I believed the masquerpets that you gathered samples from were the last remaining creatures within the cavern... but certainly you hear the roar coming from within the cavern now?
dialogsBegin.pl: I believed the masquerpets that you gathered samples from were the last remaining creatures within the cavern... but certainly you hear the roar coming from within the cavern now?
dialogsBegin.ru: I believed the masquerpets that you gathered samples from were the last remaining creatures within the cavern... but certainly you hear the roar coming from within the cavern now?
dialogsBegin.sp: Creía que los masquerpets de los que recogiste muestras eran las últimas criaturas que quedaban dentro de la caverna... pero, ¿Seguro que ahora oyes el rugido proveniente de la caverna?
dialogsBegin.sw: I believed the masquerpets that you gathered samples from were the last remaining creatures within the cavern... but certainly you hear the roar coming from within the cavern now?
dialogsBegin.th: ข้าเชื่อว่า masquerpets ที่เจ้าเก็บตัวอย่างมานั้นเป็นพวกสุดท้ายที่หลงเหลืออยุ่ในถ้ำแล้ว แต่เจ้าแน่ใจนะว่า เจ้ายังคงได้ยินเสียงคำรามออกมาจากถ้ำอยู่?
dialogsBegin.tw: 我原本以為你收集樣本的那些怪物，就是洞窟裡最後殘存的生物了……不過，你現在應該也聽得見洞窟深處傳來的咆哮吧？
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi tin rằng những con masquerpet mà bạn thu thập mẫu là những sinh vật cuối cùng còn sót lại trong hang động.. nhưng chắc chắn bạn có nghe thấy tiếng gầm phát ra từ bên trong hang động ngay bây giờ phải không?

dialogsAccept.en: Only the roar of a mighty creature emanates the cavern now... Slay whatever beast is within. If you survive, deliver a report of your victory to the Mayor of Darken City.
dialogsAccept.ar: Only the roar of a mighty creature emanates the cavern now... Slay whatever beast is within. If you survive, deliver a report of your victory to the Mayor of Darken City.
dialogsAccept.br: Apenas o rugido de uma criatura poderosa ecoa na caverna agora... Mate qualquer besta que estiver lá dentro. Se sobreviver, entregue um relatório de sua vitória ao Prefeito da Cidade Sombria.
dialogsAccept.cns: Only the roar of a mighty creature emanates the cavern now... Slay whatever beast is within. If you survive, deliver a report of your victory to the Mayor of Darken City.
dialogsAccept.de: Nur noch das Gebrüll einer mächtigen Kreatur erfüllt die Höhle. Töte die Bestie, die sich darin befindet. Wenn du überlebst, berichte dem Bürgermeister von Darken City von deinem Sieg.
dialogsAccept.fi: Only the roar of a mighty creature emanates the cavern now... Slay whatever beast is within. If you survive, deliver a report of your victory to the Mayor of Darken City.
dialogsAccept.fil: Only the roar of a mighty creature emanates the cavern now... Slay whatever beast is within. If you survive, deliver a report of your victory to the Mayor of Darken City.
dialogsAccept.fr: Seul le rugissement d'une puissante créature émane maintenant de la caverne... Tuez la bête qui se trouve à l'intérieur. Si vous survivez, rapportez votre victoire au maire de Darken.
dialogsAccept.id: Hanya raungan makhluk perkasa yang keluar dari gua sekarang .. Bunuh binatang apa pun yang ada di dalamnya. Jika kamu selamat, sampaikan laporan kemenangan kepada Mayor of Darken City.
dialogsAccept.it: Only the roar of a mighty creature emanates the cavern now... Slay whatever beast is within. If you survive, deliver a report of your victory to the Mayor of Darken City.
dialogsAccept.jp: 強大な生き物の咆哮だけが今洞窟を発しています..。中にいる獣を殺します。生き残ったら、勝利の報告をダーコン市長に届けてください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 이제 동굴에서는 거대한 괴물의 포효만이 울려 퍼지네요... 동굴 속의 괴물을 처치해 주세요. 살아 나오신다면, 다켄 시티의 시장에게 승리 보고서를 전달해 주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Only the roar of a mighty creature emanates the cavern now... Slay whatever beast is within. If you survive, deliver a report of your victory to the Mayor of Darken City.
dialogsAccept.pl: Only the roar of a mighty creature emanates the cavern now... Slay whatever beast is within. If you survive, deliver a report of your victory to the Mayor of Darken City.
dialogsAccept.ru: Only the roar of a mighty creature emanates the cavern now... Slay whatever beast is within. If you survive, deliver a report of your victory to the Mayor of Darken City.
dialogsAccept.sp: Sólo el rugido de una criatura poderosa emana la caverna ahora .. Mata a la bestia que haya dentro. Si sobrevives, entrega un informe de tu victoria al Alcalde de Ciudad Oscura.
dialogsAccept.sw: Only the roar of a mighty creature emanates the cavern now... Slay whatever beast is within. If you survive, deliver a report of your victory to the Mayor of Darken City.
dialogsAccept.th: มีแต่เสียงคำรามของสัตว์ที่ทรงพลังเท่านั้นที่อยู่ในถ้ำตอนนี้ จัดการอะไรก็ตามที่อยุ่ข้างใน ถ้าเจ้ารอดมาได้ กลับไปรายงานชัยชนะของเจ้าให้นายกเทศมนตรีของ Darken City ทราบ
dialogsAccept.tw: 現在從洞窟中傳出的，只剩下一頭強大生物的怒吼……去斬殺那頭野獸吧。如果你能活著回來，就把勝利的消息帶回去向得肯市長回報。
dialogsAccept.vi: Chỉ có tiếng gầm của một sinh vật hùng mạnh phát ra trong hang động.. Hãy giết bất cứ con thú nào ở bên trong. Nếu bạn sống sót, hãy báo tin chiến thắng của bạn về cho Thị trưởng của Darken City.

dialogsDecline.en: That roar is terrifying... steel your emotions and return to me when you are ready to find out what it is.
dialogsDecline.ar: That roar is terrifying... steel your emotions and return to me when you are ready to find out what it is.
dialogsDecline.br: Aquele rugido é de arrepiar até os cabelos da nuca... Mantenha suas emoções sob controle e volte aqui quando estiver pronto pra descobrir o que é essa parada.
dialogsDecline.cns: That roar is terrifying... steel your emotions and return to me when you are ready to find out what it is.
dialogsDecline.de: Dieses Gebrüll ist furchterregend. Stähle deine Gefühle und komm zu mir, wenn du bereit bist, herauszufinden, was es ist.
dialogsDecline.fi: That roar is terrifying... steel your emotions and return to me when you are ready to find out what it is.
dialogsDecline.fil: That roar is terrifying... steel your emotions and return to me when you are ready to find out what it is.
dialogsDecline.fr: Ce grondement est terrifiant... laisse tes émotions de côté et reviens me voir quand tu seras prêt à découvrir ce que c'est.
dialogsDecline.id: Raungan itu menakutkan .. kuatkan emosimu dan kembalilah padaku ketika kamu siap untuk mencari tahu apa itu.
dialogsDecline.it: That roar is terrifying... steel your emotions and return to me when you are ready to find out what it is.
dialogsDecline.jp: その轟音は恐ろしいです..あなたの感情を鋼鉄にして、それが何であるかを知る準備ができたら私に戻ってください。
dialogsDecline.kr: 저 포효, 정말 끔찍하네요... 마음의 준비를 단단히 하고, 저 포효의 정체를 알아낼 준비가 되면 다시 저를 찾아오세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: That roar is terrifying... steel your emotions and return to me when you are ready to find out what it is.
dialogsDecline.pl: That roar is terrifying... steel your emotions and return to me when you are ready to find out what it is.
dialogsDecline.ru: That roar is terrifying... steel your emotions and return to me when you are ready to find out what it is.
dialogsDecline.sp: Ese rugido es aterrador... templa tus emociones y vuelve a mí cuando estés listo para averiguar qué es.
dialogsDecline.sw: That roar is terrifying... steel your emotions and return to me when you are ready to find out what it is.
dialogsDecline.th: เสียงคำรามนี่น่าสะพรึงจริง ๆ ทำจิตใจของเจ้าให้แข็งเข้าไว้และกลับมาหาข้าเมื่อเจ้าพร้อมจะค้นหาว่ามันคืออะไร
dialogsDecline.tw: 那聲咆哮太駭人了……先穩住心神，等你準備好再來找我，去查出那到底是什麼。
dialogsDecline.vi: Tiếng gầm đó thật đáng sợ.. hãy rèn luyện lòng dũng cảm của bạn và quay lại tìm tôi khi bạn sẵn sàng tìm hiểu tiếng gầm là gì.

dialogsComplete.en: So all along the sealed chamber was an altar to an ancient being... I suppose the myths of the water god Herness may be more than a myth after all.
dialogsComplete.ar: So all along the sealed chamber was an altar to an ancient being... I suppose the myths of the water god Herness may be more than a myth after all.
dialogsComplete.br: Aquele lugar selado era um altar pra uma criatura antiga... Tô começando a pensar que os mitos do deus das águas, Herness, podem ser reais!
dialogsComplete.cns: So all along the sealed chamber was an altar to an ancient being... I suppose the myths of the water god Herness may be more than a myth after all.
dialogsComplete.de: Die ganze Zeit über war die versiegelte Kammer also ein Altar für ein uraltes Wesen. Ich nehme an, die Mythen des Wassergottes Herness sind vielleicht doch mehr als nur ein Mythos.
dialogsComplete.fi: So all along the sealed chamber was an altar to an ancient being... I suppose the myths of the water god Herness may be more than a myth after all.
dialogsComplete.fil: So all along the sealed chamber was an altar to an ancient being... I suppose the myths of the water god Herness may be more than a myth after all.
dialogsComplete.fr: Donc, tout au long de la chambre scellée, il y avait un autel à un être ancien... Je suppose que les mythes du dieu de l'eau Herness sont peut-être plus qu'un mythe après tout.
dialogsComplete.id: Jadi di sepanjang ruangan yang disegel itu terdapat altar bagi makhluk kuno.. Kurasa mitos dewa air Herness mungkin lebih dari sekadar mitos.
dialogsComplete.it: So all along the sealed chamber was an altar to an ancient being... I suppose the myths of the water god Herness may be more than a myth after all.
dialogsComplete.jp: ですから、密閉された部屋に沿って、古代の存在の祭壇がありました..。結局のところ、水の神ハーネスの神話は神話以上のものかもしれないと思います。
dialogsComplete.kr: 봉인된 방 안에는, 고대 존재의 제단이 있었던 거군요... 물의 신 헤르네스 신화가 단순히 신화가 아닐지도 모르겠네요.
dialogsComplete.nl: So all along the sealed chamber was an altar to an ancient being... I suppose the myths of the water god Herness may be more than a myth after all.
dialogsComplete.pl: So all along the sealed chamber was an altar to an ancient being... I suppose the myths of the water god Herness may be more than a myth after all.
dialogsComplete.ru: So all along the sealed chamber was an altar to an ancient being... I suppose the myths of the water god Herness may be more than a myth after all.
dialogsComplete.sp: Así que la cámara sellada era un altar a un ser antiguo .. Supongo que el mito del dios del agua Herness puede ser más que un mito después de todo.
dialogsComplete.sw: So all along the sealed chamber was an altar to an ancient being... I suppose the myths of the water god Herness may be more than a myth after all.
dialogsComplete.th: สรุปแล้วห้องที่ถูกผนึกไว้ มันคือแทนบูชาของสิ่งมีชีวิตโบราณ ข้าว่าเรื่องเล่าเกี่ยวกับ Herness เทพแห่งน้ำคงไม่ใช่แค่เรื่องเล่าแล้วสินะ
dialogsComplete.tw: 所以一直以來，那座被封印的密室其實是獻給古老存在的祭壇……看來關於水神赫尼斯的神話，說不定真的不只是神話而已。
dialogsComplete.vi: Và dọc theo căn phòng kín là một bàn thờ của một sinh vật cổ xưa.. Tôi cho rằng giai thoại về thủy thần Herness có thể không chỉ là những câu chuyện vô căn cứ đâu.

dialogsComplete.en: Well, with the Great Kraken defeated at least the danger that Lapranche brought to our feet has ended... for now.
dialogsComplete.ar: Well, with the Great Kraken defeated at least the danger that Lapranche brought to our feet has ended... for now.
dialogsComplete.br: Beleza, com o Grande Kraken na lona, pelo menos o perigo que Lapranche trouxe foi por água abaixo... por enquanto, né?
dialogsComplete.cns: Well, with the Great Kraken defeated at least the danger that Lapranche brought to our feet has ended... for now.
dialogsComplete.de: Nun, da der Große Krake besiegt ist, ist zumindest die Gefahr, die Lapranche uns vor die Füße gelegt hat, vorbei... vorerst.
dialogsComplete.fi: Well, with the Great Kraken defeated at least the danger that Lapranche brought to our feet has ended... for now.
dialogsComplete.fil: Well, with the Great Kraken defeated at least the danger that Lapranche brought to our feet has ended... for now.
dialogsComplete.fr: Le Grand Kraken ayant été vaincu, le danger que Lapranche avait fait peser sur nous a pris fin... pour l'instant.
dialogsComplete.id: Nah, dengan Great Kraken dikalahkan setidaknya bahaya yang dibawa Lapranche ke kaki kita telah berakhir .. untuk saat ini.
dialogsComplete.it: Well, with the Great Kraken defeated at least the danger that Lapranche brought to our feet has ended... for now.
dialogsComplete.jp: さて、グレートクラーケンが敗北したことで、少なくともラプランシュが私たちの足元にもたらした危険は終わりました..。今のところ。
dialogsComplete.kr: 대형 크라켄을 처치했으니, 적어도 라프란체가 불러온 위험이 일단락되긴 했군요... 지금은요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Well, with the Great Kraken defeated at least the danger that Lapranche brought to our feet has ended... for now.
dialogsComplete.pl: Well, with the Great Kraken defeated at least the danger that Lapranche brought to our feet has ended... for now.
dialogsComplete.ru: Well, with the Great Kraken defeated at least the danger that Lapranche brought to our feet has ended... for now.
dialogsComplete.sp: Bueno, con el Gran Kraken derrotado, el peligro que Lapranche trajo a nuestros pies ha terminado.. por ahora.
dialogsComplete.sw: Well, with the Great Kraken defeated at least the danger that Lapranche brought to our feet has ended... for now.
dialogsComplete.th: เอาล่ะในเมื่อ Great Kraken ถูกกำจัดลงแล้วอย่างน้อยอันตรายที่ Lapranche นำมาสู่พวกเราก็จบลงแล้ว...สำหรับตอนนี้
dialogsComplete.tw: 總之，至少大海怪已經被擊倒，拉普蘭雪帶到我們腳邊的危機算是暫時結束了……至少現在如此。
dialogsComplete.vi: Chà, bằng việc Great Kraken đã bị đánh bại, ít nhất mối nguy hiểm mà Lapranche mang đến cho chúng ta đã kết thúc.. tại thời điểm này.

dialogsComplete.en: I congratulate you on making it out of there alive. Expect the repercussions of releasing Lapranche to be upon us one day though...
dialogsComplete.ar: I congratulate you on making it out of there alive. Expect the repercussions of releasing Lapranche to be upon us one day though...
dialogsComplete.br: Meus parabéns por ter saído vivo de lá. Mas não se iluda, as consequências de ter soltado a Lapranche vão cair sobre nós um dia...
dialogsComplete.cns: I congratulate you on making it out of there alive. Expect the repercussions of releasing Lapranche to be upon us one day though...
dialogsComplete.de: Ich gratuliere dir, dass du es lebend da raus geschafft hast. Aber eines Tages werden wir die Folgen der Freilassung von Lapranche zu spüren bekommen...
dialogsComplete.fi: I congratulate you on making it out of there alive. Expect the repercussions of releasing Lapranche to be upon us one day though...
dialogsComplete.fil: I congratulate you on making it out of there alive. Expect the repercussions of releasing Lapranche to be upon us one day though...
dialogsComplete.fr: Je vous félicite de vous en être sorti vivant. Mais attendez-vous à ce que les répercussions de la libération de Lapranche se fassent sentir un jour...
dialogsComplete.id: Aku mengucapkan selamat kepadamu karena berhasil keluar dari sana hidup-hidup. Harapkan dampak dari melepaskan Lapranche akan menimpa kita suatu hari nanti..
dialogsComplete.it: I congratulate you on making it out of there alive. Expect the repercussions of releasing Lapranche to be upon us one day though...
dialogsComplete.jp: 生きてそこから抜け出したことを祝福します。しかし、ラプランシュをリリースすることの影響がいつか私たちに及ぶことを期待してください..。
dialogsComplete.kr: 거길 무사히 빠져나오다니, 축하해요. 언젠가는 라프란체를 풀어준 후폭풍이 여기까지 닥칠 거라 예상했죠...
dialogsComplete.nl: I congratulate you on making it out of there alive. Expect the repercussions of releasing Lapranche to be upon us one day though...
dialogsComplete.pl: I congratulate you on making it out of there alive. Expect the repercussions of releasing Lapranche to be upon us one day though...
dialogsComplete.ru: I congratulate you on making it out of there alive. Expect the repercussions of releasing Lapranche to be upon us one day though...
dialogsComplete.sp: Te felicito por haber sobrevivido. Espero que las repercusiones para liberar a Lapranche lleguen algún día...
dialogsComplete.sw: I congratulate you on making it out of there alive. Expect the repercussions of releasing Lapranche to be upon us one day though...
dialogsComplete.th: ข้ายินดีกับเจ้าด้วยที่กลับมาทั้ง ๆ ที่ยังมีชีวิตอยู่ แต่ผลกระทบของการปล่อย Lapranche ออกมานั้นจะต้องส่งผลถึงพวกเราซักวันแน่นอน
dialogsComplete.tw: 恭喜你活著從裡面出來。不過，放出拉普蘭雪的後果，總有一天還是會落到我們頭上……
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi chúc mừng bạn đã sống sót mà ra khỏi nơi đó. Mặc dù vậy, hãy chuẩn bị sẵn tinh thần là hậu quả của việc giải phóng Lapranche sẽ đến với chúng ta vào một ngày nào đó..

dialogsBegin.en: Based on Laola's instructions, you'll need to help me gather enough metal scraps for a small army... That might take a while.

dialogsBegin.kr: 라올라의 말대로라면, 작은 군대를 만들 수 있을 정도로 금속을 모아주셔야 할 겁니다... 시간이 좀 걸릴 거예요.

dialogsBegin.th: จากคำแนะนำของ Laola เจ้าต้องช่วยข้าเก็บเศษโลหะให้พอสำหรับกองทัพเล็ก ๆ มันคงต้องใช้เวลาซักพักเลย
dialogsBegin.tw: 照拉宇的指示來看，你得先幫我蒐集足夠一支小型軍隊使用的金屬廢料……這可得花上一段時間。

dialogsComplete.en: Thank you for your efforts. I know gathering this much metal must have taken a toll on you.
dialogsComplete.ar: Thank you for your efforts. I know gathering this much metal must have taken a toll on you.
dialogsComplete.br: Valeu pelo seu empenho. Imagino que juntar tanto metal deve ter dado um trabalho danado pra você.
dialogsComplete.cns: Thank you for your efforts. I know gathering this much metal must have taken a toll on you.
dialogsComplete.de: Ich danke dir für deine Bemühungen. Ich weiß, dass das Sammeln von so viel Metall für dich sehr anstrengend gewesen sein muss.

dialogsComplete.fil: Thank you for your efforts. I know gathering this much metal must have taken a toll on you.

dialogsComplete.jp: あなたの努力に感謝します。これだけの金属を集めることは、あなたに負担をかけたに違いありません。
dialogsComplete.kr: 도와주셔서 정말 감사합니다. 금속을 이렇게나 많이 모으기도 쉽지 않았을 테지요.

dialogsComplete.pl: Thank you for your efforts. I know gathering this much metal must have taken a toll on you.
dialogsComplete.ru: Thank you for your efforts. I know gathering this much metal must have taken a toll on you.
dialogsComplete.sp: Gracias por tus esfuerzos. Sé que reunir tanto metal debe haberte pasado factura.
dialogsComplete.sw: Thank you for your efforts. I know gathering this much metal must have taken a toll on you.
dialogsComplete.th: ขอบคุณสำหรับความพยายามของเจ้า ข้ารุ้ดีว่าการไปเก็บโลหะมามากขนาดนี้ทำให้เจ้าลำบากไม่ใช่น้อย
dialogsComplete.tw: 謝謝你的努力。蒐集這麼多金屬，肯定讓你吃了不少苦。
dialogsComplete.vi: Cảm ơn sự nỗ lực của bạn. Tôi biết việc thu thập nhiều kim loại này hẳn đã gây thiệt hại cho bạn.

dialogsBegin.de: Die Königin der Langbeine hatte Beweise dafür, dass es das Elixier der Vitalität einst gab. Aber dennoch wurden auf deinen Reisen durch die Lerenkluft keine Trolle gesichtet.
dialogsBegin.fi: The Queen Long Legs held evidence that the Elixir of Vitality was once real. But still, there have been no sightings of trolls within your journeys through the Leren Chasm.
dialogsBegin.fil: The Queen Long Legs held evidence that the Elixir of Vitality was once real. But still, there have been no sightings of trolls within your journeys through the Leren Chasm.
dialogsBegin.fr: La Reine des Pattes Longues détenait la preuve que l'Elixir de Vitalité existait bel et bien. Pourtant, aucun troll n'a été aperçu au cours de vos voyages dans le Gouffre de Leren.
dialogsBegin.id: Queen Long Legs memegang bukti bahwa Elixir of Vitality dulunya nyata. Tapi tetap saja, tidak ada penampakan troll dalam perjalanan Anda melewati Leren Chasm.
dialogsBegin.it: The Queen Long Legs held evidence that the Elixir of Vitality was once real. But still, there have been no sightings of trolls within your journeys through the Leren Chasm.
dialogsBegin.jp: クイーンロングレッグスは、活力のエリクサーがかつて本物であったという証拠を持っていました。しかし、それでも、レレンの淵を通る旅の中でトロルの目撃はありませんでした。
dialogsBegin.kr: 긴다리 거미 여왕은 한때 활력 비약이 실재했다는 증거를 가지고 있었어요. 하지만 레르엔 협곡을 통과하면서 트롤을 목격했다는 말은 못 들었는데...
dialogsBegin.nl: The Queen Long Legs held evidence that the Elixir of Vitality was once real. But still, there have been no sightings of trolls within your journeys through the Leren Chasm.
dialogsBegin.pl: The Queen Long Legs held evidence that the Elixir of Vitality was once real. But still, there have been no sightings of trolls within your journeys through the Leren Chasm.
dialogsBegin.ru: The Queen Long Legs held evidence that the Elixir of Vitality was once real. But still, there have been no sightings of trolls within your journeys through the Leren Chasm.
dialogsBegin.sp: La Reina Piernas Largas tenía pruebas de que el Elixir de Vitalidad fue una vez real. Pero aún así, no ha habido avistamientos de trolls en sus viajes por la Sima de Leren.
dialogsBegin.sw: The Queen Long Legs held evidence that the Elixir of Vitality was once real. But still, there have been no sightings of trolls within your journeys through the Leren Chasm.
dialogsBegin.th: มีหลักฐานจาก Queen Long Legs ว่า Elixir of Vitality นั้นเคยมีอยู่จริง แต่ก็นั่นล่ะแต่เราก็ยังไม่เห็น Troll เลยซักตัวระหว่างการเดินทางใน Leren Chasm
dialogsBegin.tw: 長腳女王身上的證據顯示，活力靈藥過去確實存在過。但即使如此，你在勒倫峽谷裡仍然沒有見到任何巨魔。
dialogsBegin.vi: Queen Long Legs nắm giữ bằng chứng cho thấy Elixir of Vitality là có thật. Tuy nhiên, vẫn chưa có lần nào nhìn thấy trolls qua Leren Chasm.

dialogsBegin.en: There must be more to the Leren Chasm that has yet to be uncovered. If you are feeling brave, descend deeper within the caves, and see what may be waiting for us.
dialogsBegin.ar: There must be more to the Leren Chasm that has yet to be uncovered. If you are feeling brave, descend deeper within the caves, and see what may be waiting for us.
dialogsBegin.br: Tem certeza de que explorou tudo no Abismo de Leren? Acho que ainda tem coisas a descobrir! Se você se sente corajoso o suficiente, desça ainda mais fundo nas cavernas!
dialogsBegin.cns: There must be more to the Leren Chasm that has yet to be uncovered. If you are feeling brave, descend deeper within the caves, and see what may be waiting for us.
dialogsBegin.de: Die Lerenkluft hat sicher noch mehr zu bieten, das noch nicht erforscht ist. Wenn du dich mutig fühlst, kannst du tiefer in die Höhlen hinabsteigen und sehen, was dich dort erwartet.
dialogsBegin.fi: There must be more to the Leren Chasm that has yet to be uncovered. If you are feeling brave, descend deeper within the caves, and see what may be waiting for us.
dialogsBegin.fil: There must be more to the Leren Chasm that has yet to be uncovered. If you are feeling brave, descend deeper within the caves, and see what may be waiting for us.
dialogsBegin.fr: Le Gouffre de Leren n'a sans doute pas fini de faire parler de lui. Si vous vous sentez courageux, descendez plus profondément dans les grottes et voyez ce qui nous attend.
dialogsBegin.id: Pasti ada lebih banyak lagi di Leren Chasm yang belum terungkap. Jika Anda merasa berani, turunlah lebih dalam ke dalam gua, dan lihat apa yang mungkin menunggu kita.
dialogsBegin.it: There must be more to the Leren Chasm that has yet to be uncovered. If you are feeling brave, descend deeper within the caves, and see what may be waiting for us.
dialogsBegin.jp: レレンの淵には、まだ明らかにされていないものがあるに違いありません。勇気があれば、洞窟の奥深くに降りて、何が私たちを待っているのかを見てください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 레르엔 협곡에는 아직 숨은 비밀이 많을 겁니다. 용기를 내어 동굴 깊숙한 곳으로 내려가 보세요. 무엇이 우리를 기다리고 있을지 확인해 보세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: There must be more to the Leren Chasm that has yet to be uncovered. If you are feeling brave, descend deeper within the caves, and see what may be waiting for us.
dialogsBegin.pl: There must be more to the Leren Chasm that has yet to be uncovered. If you are feeling brave, descend deeper within the caves, and see what may be waiting for us.
dialogsBegin.ru: There must be more to the Leren Chasm that has yet to be uncovered. If you are feeling brave, descend deeper within the caves, and see what may be waiting for us.
dialogsBegin.sp: Debe de haber algo más en la Sima de Leren que aún no se ha descubierto. Si se siente valiente, descienda a las profundidades de las cuevas y vea lo que puede estar esperándonos.
dialogsBegin.sw: There must be more to the Leren Chasm that has yet to be uncovered. If you are feeling brave, descend deeper within the caves, and see what may be waiting for us.
dialogsBegin.th: ต้องมีอะไรมากกว่านี้ที่ซ่อนอยู่ใน Leren Chasm ที่ยังไม่ถูกพบแน่ ๆ ถ้าคุณยังรุ้สึกกล้าพอ ไปให้ลึกขึ้นในถ้ำและไปดูว่ามีอะไรคอยเราอยุ่ในนั้น
dialogsBegin.tw: 勒倫峽谷裡一定還有尚未被揭開的秘密。若你夠勇敢，就再深入洞窟，看看還有什麼在等著我們。
dialogsBegin.vi: Phải có nhiều hơn nữa cho Leren Chasm chưa được khám phá. Nếu bạn cảm thấy dũng cảm, hãy xuống sâu hơn trong các hang động và xem điều gì có thể đang chờ đợi chúng ta.

dialogsAccept.en: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. You will need to go past where you faced the Queen Long Legs this time to find new information.
dialogsAccept.ar: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. You will need to go past where you faced the Queen Long Legs this time to find new information.
dialogsAccept.br: Fale comigo quando estiver pronto para entrar no Abismo de Leren novamente. Desta vez, você precisará ir além do lugar onde enfrentou a Rainha Pernas Longas para encontrar novas informações.
dialogsAccept.cns: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. You will need to go past where you faced the Queen Long Legs this time to find new information.
dialogsAccept.de: Spreche mit mir, wenn du die Lerenkluft noch einmal betreten möchtest. Du musst diesmal an der Stelle weitergehen, an der du der Königin der Langbeine begegnet bist um neue Informationen zu beschaffen.
dialogsAccept.fi: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. You will need to go past where you faced the Queen Long Legs this time to find new information.
dialogsAccept.fil: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. You will need to go past where you faced the Queen Long Legs this time to find new information.
dialogsAccept.fr: Parlez-moi quand vous serez prêts à pénétrer à nouveau dans le Gouffre de Leren. Cette fois, vous devrez aller au-delà de l'endroit où vous avez affronté la Reine des Pattes Longues pour trouver de nouvelles informations.
dialogsAccept.id: Silakan berbicara dengan saya ketika Anda siap untuk memasuki Leren Chasm sekali lagi. Anda harus melewati tempat Anda menghadapi Queen Long Legs kali ini untuk menemukan informasi baru.
dialogsAccept.it: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. You will need to go past where you faced the Queen Long Legs this time to find new information.
dialogsAccept.jp: もう一度レレンの淵に入る準備ができたら、私に話しかけてください。新しい情報を見つけるには、今回はクイーンロングレッグに直面した場所を通り過ぎる必要があります。
dialogsAccept.kr: 다시 레르엔 협곡에 들어갈 준비가 되면, 제게 말씀해 주세요. 새로운 정보를 얻으려면, 긴다리 거미 여왕과 싸웠던 곳을 지나가야 해요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. You will need to go past where you faced the Queen Long Legs this time to find new information.
dialogsAccept.pl: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. You will need to go past where you faced the Queen Long Legs this time to find new information.
dialogsAccept.ru: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. You will need to go past where you faced the Queen Long Legs this time to find new information.
dialogsAccept.sp: Por favor, habla conmigo cuando estés listo para entrar en la Sima de Leren una vez más. Esta vez tendrás que pasar por donde te enfrentaste a la Reina Piernas Largas para encontrar nueva información.
dialogsAccept.sw: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. You will need to go past where you faced the Queen Long Legs this time to find new information.
dialogsAccept.th: โปรดกลับมาคุยกับข้าใหม่เมื่อเจ้าพร้อมจะเข้าไปใน Leren Chasm อีกครั้ง  เจ้าต้องไปให้ไกลกว่าคราวที่เจ้าพบกับ Queen Long Legs นะถึงจะได้ข้อมูลอะไรเพิ่มเติม
dialogsAccept.tw: 等你準備好再次進入勒倫峽谷時再來找我。這次你得走過之前遇到長腳女王的地方，才能找到新的線索。
dialogsAccept.vi: Vui lòng nói chuyện với tôi khi bạn sẵn sàng bước vào Leren Chasm một lần nữa. Bạn sẽ cần phải đi qua nơi bạn đã đối mặt với Queen Long Legs lần này để tìm thông tin mới.

dialogsDecline.en: The Queen Long Legs was a powerful foe. I am sure the remaining Masuqerpets within the Leren Chasm will only get stronger. Rest here for now if you are not ready.
dialogsDecline.ar: The Queen Long Legs was a powerful foe. I am sure the remaining Masuqerpets within the Leren Chasm will only get stronger. Rest here for now if you are not ready.
dialogsDecline.br: Uau, a Rainha Pernas Longas era realmente forte! E com certeza os outros Masuqerpets do Abismo de Leren só vão ficar mais fortes a partir daqui! Mas se você precisar de um descanso antes de continuar, fique à vontade!
dialogsDecline.cns: The Queen Long Legs was a powerful foe. I am sure the remaining Masuqerpets within the Leren Chasm will only get stronger. Rest here for now if you are not ready.
dialogsDecline.de: Die Königin der Langbeine war ein mächtiger Gegner. Ich bin sicher, dass die übrig verbleibenden Masquerpets in der Lerenkluft nur stärker werden. Ruhe dich hier aus, wenn du noch nicht bereit bist.
dialogsDecline.fi: The Queen Long Legs was a powerful foe. I am sure the remaining Masuqerpets within the Leren Chasm will only get stronger. Rest here for now if you are not ready.
dialogsDecline.fil: The Queen Long Legs was a powerful foe. I am sure the remaining Masuqerpets within the Leren Chasm will only get stronger. Rest here for now if you are not ready.
dialogsDecline.fr: La Reine aux Pattes Longues était un ennemi puissant. Je suis sûr que les Masquerpets qui restent dans le Gouffre de Leren seront de plus en plus forts. Reposez-vous ici pour l'instant si vous n'êtes pas prêts.
dialogsDecline.id: Queen Long Legs adalah musuh yang kuat. Saya yakin Masuqerpets yang tersisa di Leren Chasm hanya akan menjadi lebih kuat. Beristirahatlah di sini untuk saat ini jika Anda belum siap.
dialogsDecline.it: The Queen Long Legs was a powerful foe. I am sure the remaining Masuqerpets within the Leren Chasm will only get stronger. Rest here for now if you are not ready.
dialogsDecline.jp: クイーンロングレッグスは強力な敵でした。レレンの淵内に残っているモンスターは、ますます強くなると確信しています。準備ができていない場合は、今のところここで休んでください。
dialogsDecline.kr: 긴다리 거미 여왕은 강력한 적이었어요. 레르엔 협곡에 남은 마스커펫들은 계속 강해질 겁니다. 일단 쉬면서 다시 마음의 준비를 하세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: The Queen Long Legs was a powerful foe. I am sure the remaining Masuqerpets within the Leren Chasm will only get stronger. Rest here for now if you are not ready.
dialogsDecline.pl: The Queen Long Legs was a powerful foe. I am sure the remaining Masuqerpets within the Leren Chasm will only get stronger. Rest here for now if you are not ready.
dialogsDecline.ru: The Queen Long Legs was a powerful foe. I am sure the remaining Masuqerpets within the Leren Chasm will only get stronger. Rest here for now if you are not ready.
dialogsDecline.sp: La Reina Piernas Largas era un enemigo poderoso. Estoy seguro de que los Masuqerpets que quedan en la Sima de Leren serán cada vez más fuertes. Descansen aquí por ahora si no están listos.
dialogsDecline.sw: The Queen Long Legs was a powerful foe. I am sure the remaining Masuqerpets within the Leren Chasm will only get stronger. Rest here for now if you are not ready.
dialogsDecline.th: Queen Long Legs เป็นศัตรูที่ทรงพลัง ข้าแน่ใจว่า Masuqerpets ที่เหลืออยู่ใน Leren Chasm จะยิ่งแข็งแกร่งขึ้นไปอีก พักผ่อนซะที่นี่ก่อนถ้าเจ้ายังไม่พร้อม
dialogsDecline.tw: 長腳女王已經是相當強大的敵人了。我敢肯定，勒倫峽谷剩下的怪物只會越來越強。若你還沒準備好，先在這裡休息一下吧。
dialogsDecline.vi: Queen Long Legs là một kẻ thù mạnh mẽ. Tôi chắc chắn rằng những Masuqerpets còn lại trong Leren Chasm sẽ ngày càng mạnh hơn. Hãy nghỉ ngơi ở đây ngay bây giờ nếu bạn chưa sẵn sàng.

dialogsComplete.en: The souls of the Nightmist creatures have an interesting property... when looking through the glassy orb that contains the soul itself, it faintly looks like the face of a troll.
dialogsComplete.ar: The souls of the Nightmist creatures have an interesting property... when looking through the glassy orb that contains the soul itself, it faintly looks like the face of a troll.
dialogsComplete.br: As almas das criaturas da Bruma Noturna têm uma propriedade bem peculiar... quando se olha através do orbe de vidro que contém a alma, ela parece um pouco com um rosto de troll! Dá até arrepios!
dialogsComplete.cns: The souls of the Nightmist creatures have an interesting property... when looking through the glassy orb that contains the soul itself, it faintly looks like the face of a troll.
dialogsComplete.de: Die Seelen der Nightmist Kreaturen verfügen über eine interessante Eigenschaft... Wenn man durch die gläserne Kugel blickt, die die Seele selbst enthält, erinnert sie schwach an das Gesicht eines Trolls.
dialogsComplete.fi: The souls of the Nightmist creatures have an interesting property... when looking through the glassy orb that contains the soul itself, it faintly looks like the face of a troll.
dialogsComplete.fil: The souls of the Nightmist creatures have an interesting property... when looking through the glassy orb that contains the soul itself, it faintly looks like the face of a troll.
dialogsComplete.fr: Les âmes des Créatures de la Nuit ont une propriété intéressante : lorsque l'on regarde à travers l'orbe vitreux qui contient l'âme elle-même, celle-ci ressemble légèrement au visage d'un troll.
dialogsComplete.id: Jiwa makhluk Nightmist memiliki sifat yang menarik.. saat melihat melalui bola kaca yang berisi jiwa itu sendiri, samar-samar terlihat seperti wajah troll.
dialogsComplete.it: The souls of the Nightmist creatures have an interesting property... when looking through the glassy orb that contains the soul itself, it faintly looks like the face of a troll.
dialogsComplete.jp: ナイトミストの生き物の魂は興味深い性質を持っています..魂そのものを含むガラスのオーブを通して見ると、それはかすかにトロールの顔のように見えます。
dialogsComplete.kr: 나이트미스트 생명체의 영혼에는 흥미로운 특성이 있어요... 영혼을 담은 유리구슬을 들여다보면, 희미하게 트롤의 얼굴이 보이죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: The souls of the Nightmist creatures have an interesting property... when looking through the glassy orb that contains the soul itself, it faintly looks like the face of a troll.
dialogsComplete.pl: The souls of the Nightmist creatures have an interesting property... when looking through the glassy orb that contains the soul itself, it faintly looks like the face of a troll.
dialogsComplete.ru: The souls of the Nightmist creatures have an interesting property... when looking through the glassy orb that contains the soul itself, it faintly looks like the face of a troll.
dialogsComplete.sp: Las almas de las criaturas de la Niebla Nocturna tienen una propiedad interesante... cuando se mira a través del orbe vidrioso que contiene el alma en sí, se parece tenuemente a la cara de un trol.
dialogsComplete.sw: The souls of the Nightmist creatures have an interesting property... when looking through the glassy orb that contains the soul itself, it faintly looks like the face of a troll.
dialogsComplete.th: วิญญาณของ Nightmist มีคุณสมบัติที่น่าสนใจ เวลาเรามองผ่านลูกแก้วกระจกที่บรรจุวิญญาณอยู่นั้น มันจะมองดูคล้ายหน้า Troll อยู่จาง ๆ
dialogsComplete.tw: 夜霧生物的靈魂有個很特別的性質……透過包覆靈魂的那顆玻璃球看進去，隱約會看見一張像巨魔的臉。
dialogsComplete.vi: Linh hồn của các sinh vật Nightmist có một đặc tính thú vị.. khi nhìn qua quả cầu thủy tinh chứa chính linh hồn đó, nó trông tựa như khuôn mặt của một con troll.

dialogsBegin.en: Throughout history the Black Magician has changed from person to person... the two best known are Great Magician Loala and the one you've just released... Lapranche.
dialogsBegin.ar: Throughout history the Black Magician has changed from person to person... the two best known are Great Magician Loala and the one you've just released... Lapranche.
dialogsBegin.br: Ao longo da história, o Mago Negro mudou de pessoa para pessoa.. os dois mais conhecidos são o Grande Mago Loala e aquele que você acabou de libertar.. Lapranche.
dialogsBegin.cns: Throughout history the Black Magician has changed from person to person... the two best known are Great Magician Loala and the one you've just released... Lapranche.
dialogsBegin.de: Im Laufe der Geschichte hat sich der Schwarze Magier von Person zu Person verändert. Die beiden bekanntesten sind der Große Magier Loala und der, den du gerade veröffentlicht hast... Lapranche.
dialogsBegin.fi: Throughout history the Black Magician has changed from person to person... the two best known are Great Magician Loala and the one you've just released... Lapranche.
dialogsBegin.fil: Throughout history the Black Magician has changed from person to person... the two best known are Great Magician Loala and the one you've just released... Lapranche.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tout au long de l'histoire, le Magicien Noir a changé d'une personne à l'autre... les deux plus connus sont le Grand Magicien Loala et celui que vous venez de publier.... Lapranche.
dialogsBegin.id: Sepanjang sejarah Black Magician telah berubah dari orang ke orang.. dua yang paling terkenal adalah Great Magician Loala dan yang baru saja kamu rilis.. Lapranche.
dialogsBegin.it: Throughout history the Black Magician has changed from person to person... the two best known are Great Magician Loala and the one you've just released... Lapranche.
dialogsBegin.jp: 歴史を通して、黒魔術師は人から人へと変化しました。最もよく知られているのは、グレートマジシャンロアラとあなたがリリースしたばかりの2つです。ラプランシェ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 역사 속에서 블랙 매지션의 계보를 이은 자는 많았지만... 가장 유명한 두 사람을 꼽으라면 위대한 매지션 라올라와 당신이 풀어준 바로 그자입니다... 라프란체.
dialogsBegin.nl: Throughout history the Black Magician has changed from person to person... the two best known are Great Magician Loala and the one you've just released... Lapranche.
dialogsBegin.pl: Throughout history the Black Magician has changed from person to person... the two best known are Great Magician Loala and the one you've just released... Lapranche.
dialogsBegin.ru: Throughout history the Black Magician has changed from person to person... the two best known are Great Magician Loala and the one you've just released... Lapranche.
dialogsBegin.sp: A lo largo de la historia el Mago Negro ha cambiado de persona a persona.. los dos más conocidos son el Gran Mago Loala y el que acabas de estrenar.. Lapranche.
dialogsBegin.sw: Throughout history the Black Magician has changed from person to person... the two best known are Great Magician Loala and the one you've just released... Lapranche.
dialogsBegin.th: ประวัติของนักเวทย์มนต์ดำนั้นจะแตกต่างกันไปในแต่ละคน แต่สองคนที่เป็นที่รู้จักที่สุดคือ Great Magician Loala และ Lapranche ที่เจ้าเพิ่งปลดปล่อยไป
dialogsBegin.tw: 歷史上的黑暗魔法師，其身分曾幾度更替……其中最廣為人知的兩位，就是大魔法使拉宇，以及你剛剛釋放出來的那位……拉普蘭雪。
dialogsBegin.vi: Trong suốt lịch sử, Black Magician đã thay đổi từ người này sang người khác.. hai người được biết đến nhiều nhất là Great Magician Loala và người mà bạn vừa thả ra.. Lapranche.

dialogsBegin.en: While Loala has stood down from her post as the Black Magician, Lapranche's mind was enslaved by Shade, and granted an incredible dark power...
dialogsBegin.ar: While Loala has stood down from her post as the Black Magician, Lapranche's mind was enslaved by Shade, and granted an incredible dark power...
dialogsBegin.br: Embora Loala tenha abandonado seu posto como a Mago Negro, a mente de Lapranche foi escravizada por Shade e concedida um incrível poder das trevas.
dialogsBegin.cns: While Loala has stood down from her post as the Black Magician, Lapranche's mind was enslaved by Shade, and granted an incredible dark power...
dialogsBegin.de: Während Loala von ihrem Amt als Schwarze Magierin zurückgetreten ist, wurde Lapranches Geist von Shade versklavt und mit einer unglaublichen dunklen Macht ausgestattet.
dialogsBegin.fi: While Loala has stood down from her post as the Black Magician, Lapranche's mind was enslaved by Shade, and granted an incredible dark power...
dialogsBegin.fil: While Loala has stood down from her post as the Black Magician, Lapranche's mind was enslaved by Shade, and granted an incredible dark power...
dialogsBegin.fr: Alors que Loala s'est retirée de son poste de Magicienne Noire, l'esprit de Lapranche a été asservi par Shade et doté d'un incroyable pouvoir obscur...
dialogsBegin.id: Sementara Loala mundur dari jabatannya sebagai Black Magician, pikiran Lapranche diperbudak oleh Shade, dan diberikan kekuatan kegelapan yang luar biasa..
dialogsBegin.it: While Loala has stood down from her post as the Black Magician, Lapranche's mind was enslaved by Shade, and granted an incredible dark power...
dialogsBegin.jp: ロアラが黒魔術師としての彼女のポストから立ち上がっている間、ラプランシュの心はシェイドによって奴隷にされ、信じられないほどの闇の力を与えられました..。
dialogsBegin.kr: 라올라는 블랙 매지션의 자리에서 물러났지만, 라프란체는 완전히 쉐이드의 노예가 되어 놀라운 어둠의 힘을 부여받게 되었죠...
dialogsBegin.nl: While Loala has stood down from her post as the Black Magician, Lapranche's mind was enslaved by Shade, and granted an incredible dark power...
dialogsBegin.pl: While Loala has stood down from her post as the Black Magician, Lapranche's mind was enslaved by Shade, and granted an incredible dark power...
dialogsBegin.ru: While Loala has stood down from her post as the Black Magician, Lapranche's mind was enslaved by Shade, and granted an incredible dark power...
dialogsBegin.sp: Mientras Loala ha renunciado a su puesto de Mago Negro, la mente de Lapranche ha sido esclavizada por Shade y se le ha concedido un increíble poder oscuro...
dialogsBegin.sw: While Loala has stood down from her post as the Black Magician, Lapranche's mind was enslaved by Shade, and granted an incredible dark power...
dialogsBegin.th: ในขณะที่ Loala ลงจากตำแหน่ง จิตใจของ Lapranche นั้นถูกครอบงำโดย Shade และให้พลังแห่งความมืดอย่างไร้ขีดจำกัด
dialogsBegin.tw: 拉宇雖已卸下黑暗魔法師之位，但拉普蘭雪的心智曾被闇影奴役，並因此獲得了驚人的黑暗力量……
dialogsBegin.vi: Trong khi Loala đã từ bỏ vị trí của mình với tư cách là Black Magician, tâm trí của Lapranche đã bị giam giữ bởi Shade và được ả ban cho một sức mạnh đen tối đáng kinh ngạc.

dialogsBegin.en: For a while we were safe with Lapranche sealed away by Bubble's magic, but Lapranche will surely send disasters our way to distract us while she builds her power back up.
dialogsBegin.ar: For a while we were safe with Lapranche sealed away by Bubble's magic, but Lapranche will surely send disasters our way to distract us while she builds her power back up.
dialogsBegin.br: Por um tempo, estivemos seguros com Lapranche selada pela magia de Bubble, mas ela certamente enviará desastres em nosso caminho para nos distrair enquanto ela reconstrói seu poder
dialogsBegin.cns: For a while we were safe with Lapranche sealed away by Bubble's magic, but Lapranche will surely send disasters our way to distract us while she builds her power back up.
dialogsBegin.de: Eine Zeit lang waren wir sicher, da Lapranche durch Bubbles Magie abgeschottet war, aber Lapranche wird uns sicher Unheil schicken, um uns abzulenken, während sie ihre Macht wieder aufbaut.
dialogsBegin.fi: For a while we were safe with Lapranche sealed away by Bubble's magic, but Lapranche will surely send disasters our way to distract us while she builds her power back up.
dialogsBegin.fil: For a while we were safe with Lapranche sealed away by Bubble's magic, but Lapranche will surely send disasters our way to distract us while she builds her power back up.
dialogsBegin.fr: Pendant un moment, nous avons été en sécurité avec Lapranche enfermé par la magie de Bubble, mais Lapranche va sûrement envoyer des désastres sur notre chemin pour nous distraire pendant qu'elle reconstitue son pouvoir.
dialogsBegin.id: Untuk sementara kami aman dengan Lapranche disegel oleh sihir Bubble, tetapi Lapranche pasti akan mengirim bencana ke arah kami untuk mengalihkan perhatian kami sementara dia membangun kembali kekuatannya.
dialogsBegin.it: For a while we were safe with Lapranche sealed away by Bubble's magic, but Lapranche will surely send disasters our way to distract us while she builds her power back up.
dialogsBegin.jp: しばらくの間、バブルの魔法によって封印されたラプランチェで安全でしたが、ラプランシェが力を回復している間、ラプランシェは確かに私たちの気をそらすために災害を送ります。
dialogsBegin.kr: 버블의 마법이 라프란체를 봉인해둔 동안은 안전했지만, 다시 풀려난 이상 분명 끔찍한 재앙으로 우리 주의를 분산시킨 뒤 그 사이 힘을 회복하려고 할 겁니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: For a while we were safe with Lapranche sealed away by Bubble's magic, but Lapranche will surely send disasters our way to distract us while she builds her power back up.
dialogsBegin.pl: For a while we were safe with Lapranche sealed away by Bubble's magic, but Lapranche will surely send disasters our way to distract us while she builds her power back up.
dialogsBegin.ru: For a while we were safe with Lapranche sealed away by Bubble's magic, but Lapranche will surely send disasters our way to distract us while she builds her power back up.
dialogsBegin.sp: Durante un tiempo estuvimos a salvo con Lapranche sellado por la magia de Bubble, pero Lapranche seguramente enviará desastres a nuestro camino para distraernos mientras ella construye su poder de nuevo.
dialogsBegin.sw: For a while we were safe with Lapranche sealed away by Bubble's magic, but Lapranche will surely send disasters our way to distract us while she builds her power back up.
dialogsBegin.th: ในขณะที่พวกเรายังคงปลอดภัยจาก Lapranche ที่ถูกผนึกไว้ด้วย เวทย์มนต์ของ  Bubble แต่ Lapranche ต้องส่งหายนะมาทางเราเพื่อดึงความสนใจพวกเราในขณะที่เธอกำลังสะสมพลังกลับคืนมาแน่ ๆ
dialogsBegin.tw: 有一段時間我們很安全，因為拉普朗什被巴布樂的魔法封鎖了，但拉普朗什肯定會在她恢復力量的同時給我們帶來災難來分散我們的注意力。
dialogsBegin.vi: Trong một thời gian, chúng tôi đã an toàn với Lapranche bị phong ấn bởi phép thuật của Bubble, nhưng Lapranche chắc chắn sẽ gửi thảm họa đến cho chúng tôi để đánh lạc hướng chúng tôi trong khi cô ấy xây dựng lại sức mạnh của mình.

dialogsBegin.ar: You should go speak to the Mayor of Darken City as quickly as possible to see if anything has been reported...

dialogsBegin.de: Du solltest so schnell wie möglich mit dem Bürgermeister von Darken City sprechen um herauszufinden, ob es Neuigkeiten gibt.
dialogsBegin.fi: You should go speak to the Mayor of Darken City as quickly as possible to see if anything has been reported...
dialogsBegin.fil: You should go speak to the Mayor of Darken City as quickly as possible to see if anything has been reported...

dialogsBegin.it: You should go speak to the Mayor of Darken City as quickly as possible to see if anything has been reported...
dialogsBegin.jp: できるだけ早くダーコン市長に相談して、何かが報告されていないかどうかを確認する必要があります。
dialogsBegin.kr: 최대한 빨리 다켄 시티의 시장님께 가서, 보고를 받으신 게 있는지 확인해야 해요...
dialogsBegin.nl: You should go speak to the Mayor of Darken City as quickly as possible to see if anything has been reported...
dialogsBegin.pl: You should go speak to the Mayor of Darken City as quickly as possible to see if anything has been reported...
dialogsBegin.ru: You should go speak to the Mayor of Darken City as quickly as possible to see if anything has been reported...
dialogsBegin.sp: Deberías ir a hablar con el alcalde de Darken City lo antes posible para ver si se ha informado de algo..
dialogsBegin.sw: You should go speak to the Mayor of Darken City as quickly as possible to see if anything has been reported...
dialogsBegin.th: เจ้าควรไปคุยกับนายกเทศมนตรีของ Darken City ให้เร็วที่สุดเท่าที่จะทำได้ เพื่อดูว่ามีรายงานอะไรเข้ามาหรือเปล่า
dialogsBegin.tw: 你最好立刻去找得肯市長，看看是否已經有什麼災難被通報了……
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn nên nói chuyện với Thị trưởng của Darken City càng nhanh càng tốt để xem có gì mới được báo cáo không...

dialogsAccept.th: ไปตรวจสอบกับนายกเทศมนตรีของ Darken City และดูว่ามีข่าวเกี่ยวกับภัยพิบัติอะไรถูกรานงานเข้ามาบ้าง!
dialogsAccept.tw: 去向得肯市長確認，看看有沒有災難發生的消息！
dialogsAccept.vi: Kiểm tra với Mayor of Darken City và xem tin tức về thảm họa đã được báo cáo chưa!

dialogsDecline.en: Whyyyy, why won't you help us? Are you secretly working with Shade!?
dialogsDecline.ar: Whyyyy, why won't you help us? Are you secretly working with Shade!?
dialogsDecline.br: Por quêêê, por quêêê você não nos ajuda? Você está secretamente se aliando a Shade!?
dialogsDecline.cns: Whyyyy, why won't you help us? Are you secretly working with Shade!?
dialogsDecline.de: Warum willst du uns nicht helfen? Arbeitest du heimlich mit Shade zusammen!?
dialogsDecline.fi: Whyyyy, why won't you help us? Are you secretly working with Shade!?
dialogsDecline.fil: Whyyyy, why won't you help us? Are you secretly working with Shade!?
dialogsDecline.fr: Pourquoi vous ne nous aidez pas ? Est-ce que tu travailles secrètement avec Shade !?
dialogsDecline.id: Kenapaaaa, kenapa kamu tidak mau membantu kami? Apakah Anda diam-diam bekerja dengan Shade !?
dialogsDecline.it: Whyyyy, why won't you help us? Are you secretly working with Shade!?
dialogsDecline.jp: なぜ、なぜあなたは私たちを助けないのですか?シェイドと密かに仕事をしているのか!?
dialogsDecline.kr: 왜, 우릴 도와주지 않는 겁니까? 혹시 몰래 쉐이드와 손잡고 있는 겁니까!?
dialogsDecline.nl: Whyyyy, why won't you help us? Are you secretly working with Shade!?
dialogsDecline.pl: Whyyyy, why won't you help us? Are you secretly working with Shade!?
dialogsDecline.ru: Whyyyy, why won't you help us? Are you secretly working with Shade!?
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿Por qué no nos ayudas? ¿Estás trabajando en secreto con Shade?
dialogsDecline.sw: Whyyyy, why won't you help us? Are you secretly working with Shade!?
dialogsDecline.th: ทำไม? ทำไมเจ้าไม่ช่วยพวกเรา? เจ้าทำงานให้ Shade! อย่างลับ ๆ รึเปล่า?
dialogsDecline.tw: 為什麼……為什麼你不肯幫我們？難道你暗中在替闇影做事！？
dialogsDecline.vi: Tại sao, tại sao bạn không giúp chúng tôi? Bạn đang bí mật làm việc với Shade!?

dialogsComplete.fr: Lapranche a donc été libéré de sa prison après toutes ces années...

dialogsComplete.it: So Lapranche was released from her prison after all these years...
dialogsComplete.jp: それで、ラプランシュはこれらすべての年の後に彼女の刑務所から釈放されました..
dialogsComplete.kr: 결국 라프란체가 기어이 감옥에서 풀려났다는 거군요...

dialogsComplete.ru: So Lapranche was released from her prison after all these years...

dialogsComplete.th: Lapranche ถูกปล่อยออกจากที่คุมขังหลังจากหลายปีที่ผ่านมาแล้วสินะ

dialogsComplete.vi: Vì vậy, Lapranche đã được thả tự do sau ngần ấy năm bị cầm tù...

description.th: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ถูกพบอยู่บนชั้นแรกของ Forsaken Tower.

dialogsBegin.en: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.ar: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.br: Bem-vindo de volta aventureiro! Há relatos de uma nova ameaça na Torre Abandonada. Procure e livre-se de $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.cns: 欢迎回来，英雄！据报告，深渊之塔中出现了新的威胁。请前去找到并消灭 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$
dialogsBegin.de: Willkommen zurück, Held! Berichte zufolge wartet im Verlassenen Turm eine neue Bedrohung. Suche und töte die $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fi: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fil: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fr: Content de te revoir, héros ! Des rapports indiquent la présence d'une nouvelle menace dans la Tour Oubliée. S'il te plaît, cherche et élimine le $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.id: Selamat datang kembali pahlawan! Ada laporan ancaman baru di Forsaken Tower. Silakan cari dan singkirkan $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.it: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.jp: おかえりヒーロー！忘却の塔に新たな脅威の報告がありました。$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を探して一掃してきてください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 돌아온 걸 환영해요, 용사님! 버려진 탑에 위협이 발생했다는 보고를 받았어요. 버려진 탑에서 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$을(를) 찾아 없애주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.pl: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.ru: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Bienvenido, héroe! Hay informes de una nueva amenaza en la Torre de los Desamparados. Por favor, busca y deshazte del $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.sw: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.th: ยินดีต้อนรับกลับมาฮีโร่! มีรายงานมาว่าพบกันอันตรายใหม่เกิดขึ้นที่ Forsaken Tower โปรดไปค้นหาและทำลาย $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ให้สิ้นซาก
dialogsBegin.tw: 歡迎回來的英雄！有報告稱深淵之塔出現了新的威脅。請找出並擺脫 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$。
dialogsBegin.vi: Chào mừng trở lại hero! Có báo cáo về một mối đe dọa mới trong Forsaken Tower. Vui lòng tìm kiếm và loại bỏ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.

dialogsAccept.en: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the first floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsAccept.ar: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the first floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsAccept.br: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ teve sua localização revelada no primeiro andar da Torre Abandonada.
dialogsAccept.cns: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 已在深渊之塔一层被发现。
dialogsAccept.de: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ wurde im ersten Stock des Verlassenen Turms gesehen.
dialogsAccept.fi: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the first floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsAccept.fil: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the first floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsAccept.fr: Le $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ a été vu au premier étage de la Tour Oubliée.
dialogsAccept.id: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ terlihat di lantai pertama Forsaken Tower.
dialogsAccept.it: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the first floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsAccept.jp: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$は、忘却の塔の1階で発見されました。
dialogsAccept.kr: 버려진 탑 1층에서 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$이(가) 발견되었습니다.
