dialogsDecline.en: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.ar: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.br: A Torre está infestada de masquerpets perigosos. Entendo se não quiser correr o risco.
dialogsDecline.cns: 这座塔里到处都是危险的假面怪。如果你不想冒这个险，我完全理解。
dialogsDecline.de: Der Turm ist voller gefährlicher Masquerpets. Ich verstehe es, wenn du das Risiko nicht eingehen willst.
dialogsDecline.fi: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.fil: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.fr: La Tour est remplies de monstres dangereux. Je comprends que tu ne veuilles pas prendre ce risque.
dialogsDecline.id: Menara dipenuhi dengan masquerpets berbahaya. Saya mengerti jika Anda tidak ingin mengambil risiko.
dialogsDecline.it: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.jp: タワーは危険なモンスターでいっぱいです。あなたがリスクを冒したくないのなら、私は理解しています。
dialogsDecline.kr: 탑에는 위험한 마스커펫이 가득해요. 위험을 감수하고 싶지 않다고 하셔도 이해합니다.
dialogsDecline.nl: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.pl: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.ru: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.sp: La Torre está llena de masquerpets peligrosos. Comprendo si no deseas correr el riesgo.
dialogsDecline.sw: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.th: Tower เต็มไปด้วย masquerpets ที่อันตราย ข้าเข้าใจดีถ้าเจ้าไม่อยากเสี่ยงอันตราย
dialogsDecline.tw: 塔內充滿了危險的怪物。如果你不想冒險，我可以理解。
dialogsDecline.vi: Tower chứa đầy masquerpets nguy hiểm. Tôi hiểu bạn không muốn mạo hiểm.

dialogsComplete.en: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.ar: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.br: Obrigado aventureiro, a ameaça $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ foi eliminada.
dialogsComplete.cns: 感谢你英雄, $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 的威胁被终结了。
dialogsComplete.de: Vielen Dank, dank dir wurde die $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ Bedrohung beseitigt.
dialogsComplete.fi: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.fil: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.fr: Merci, héros, la menace $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ a été éliminée.
dialogsComplete.id: Terima kasih pahlawan, ancaman $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ telah dihilangkan.
dialogsComplete.it: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.jp: ありがとうヒーロー、$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$の脅威が排除されました。
dialogsComplete.kr: 감사해요 용사님. $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$을(를) 처치해 위협을 없애 주셨군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.pl: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.ru: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.sp: Gracias héroe, la amenaza $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ha sido eliminada.
dialogsComplete.sw: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.th: ขอบคุณมากฮีโร่ อันตรายจาก $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ได้ถูกกำจัดไปหมดแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 謝謝英雄，$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 威脅已被消除。
dialogsComplete.vi: Cảm ơn hero, mối đe dọa $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ đã bị loại bỏ.

dialogsFail.en: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.ar: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.br: Você ainda não conseguiu matar o $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$? Tudo bem, por favor, volte depois de vencer o gigante!
dialogsFail.cns: 你还没能击杀 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$吗？没关系，等你战胜那个巨人之后再回来吧！
dialogsFail.de: Du hast es nicht geschafft, $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ zu töten? Das stimmt, komm wieder, sobald du gegen den Giant gewonnen hast!
dialogsFail.fi: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.fil: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.fr: Tu n'as pas encore réussi à tuer le $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ? Pas de problème, reviens me voir après avoir vaincu le géant !
dialogsFail.id: Anda belum bisa membunuh $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$? Tidak apa-apa, mohon segera kembali setelah Anda menang melawan para giant!
dialogsFail.it: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.jp: あなたはまだ$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を倒すことができませんでしたか?大丈夫、巨人に勝ったら戻ってください!
dialogsFail.kr: 아직 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$을(를) 처치하지 못하셨나요? 괜찮아요. 거대 몬스터를 처치하고 나면 돌아오세요!
dialogsFail.nl: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.pl: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.ru: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Aún no has podido matar al $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$? No pasa nada, ¡Vuelve cuando hayas ganado al gigante!
dialogsFail.sw: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.th: คุณไม่ยังสามาถจัดการ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ได้อีกรึ? ไม่เป็นไรกลับมาเมื่อคุณจัดการพวกไจแอนท์พวกนั้นสำเร็จนะ!
dialogsFail.tw: 你還沒能殺死 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$？沒關係，打敗巨人後請回來！
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn vẫn chưa giết được $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$? Không sao đâu, hãy trở về sau khi đánh bại giant!

description.en: Defeat the Crystal Demon Lord to obtain the Clockworks Core, then return to Rankashu in Darkon.
description.ar: Defeat the Crystal Demon Lord to obtain the Clockworks Core, then return to Rankashu in Darkon.
description.br: Derrote o Lorde Demônio de Cristal para obter o Núcleo do Clockworks e depois retorne a Rankashu em Darkon.
description.cns: Defeat the Crystal Demon Lord to obtain the Clockworks Core, then return to Rankashu in Darkon.
description.de: Besiege den Kristalldämonenfürst, um den Clockworks-Kern zu erhalten, und kehre dann nach Rankashu in Darkon zurück.
description.fi: Defeat the Crystal Demon Lord to obtain the Clockworks Core, then return to Rankashu in Darkon.
description.fil: Defeat the Crystal Demon Lord to obtain the Clockworks Core, then return to Rankashu in Darkon.
description.fr: Battez le Seigneur Démon de Cristal pour obtenir un Coeur de Clockworks puis retournez voir Rankashu à Darkon.
description.id: Kalahkan Crystal Demon Lord untuk mendapatkan Clockworks Core, lalu kembali ke Rankashu di Darkon.
description.it: Defeat the Crystal Demon Lord to obtain the Clockworks Core, then return to Rankashu in Darkon.
description.jp: クリスタル魔王を倒してクロックワークスコアを手に入れ、ダーコンのランカシュに戻ります。
description.kr: 크리스탈 데몬 로드를 처치하고 클락워크 코어를 획득하여 다콘의 랑카슈에게 돌아가세요.
description.nl: Defeat the Crystal Demon Lord to obtain the Clockworks Core, then return to Rankashu in Darkon.
description.pl: Defeat the Crystal Demon Lord to obtain the Clockworks Core, then return to Rankashu in Darkon.
description.ru: Defeat the Crystal Demon Lord to obtain the Clockworks Core, then return to Rankashu in Darkon.
description.sp: Derrota al Señor de los Demonios de Cristal para obtener el Núcleo de Mecanismos y regresa a Rankashu en Darkon.
description.sw: Defeat the Crystal Demon Lord to obtain the Clockworks Core, then return to Rankashu in Darkon.
description.th: กำจัด Crystal Demon Lord เพื่อนำ Clockworks Core มา และกลับไปหา Rankashu ที่ Darkon
description.tw: 擊敗水晶惡魔領主獲得時空毀滅者核心，然後返回得肯的小草兒。
description.vi: Đánh bại Crystal Demon Lord để lấy Clockworks Core, sau đó quay trở lại Rankashu ở Darkon.

dialogsBegin.en: The dream of building a new weapon to defend Madgrial is starting to feel real. The only thing standing in our way is the Crystal Demon Lord.
dialogsBegin.ar: The dream of building a new weapon to defend Madgrial is starting to feel real. The only thing standing in our way is the Crystal Demon Lord.
dialogsBegin.br: O sonho de construir uma nova arma para defender Madrigal está começando a se tornar realidade. A única coisa que está nos impedindo é o Lorde Demônio de Cristal.
dialogsBegin.cns: The dream of building a new weapon to defend Madgrial is starting to feel real. The only thing standing in our way is the Crystal Demon Lord.
dialogsBegin.de: Der Traum, eine neue Waffe zur Verteidigung von Madgrial zu bauen, fühlt sich langsam real an. Das einzige, was uns im Weg steht, ist der Kristalldämonenfürst.
dialogsBegin.fi: The dream of building a new weapon to defend Madgrial is starting to feel real. The only thing standing in our way is the Crystal Demon Lord.
dialogsBegin.fil: The dream of building a new weapon to defend Madgrial is starting to feel real. The only thing standing in our way is the Crystal Demon Lord.
dialogsBegin.fr: Le rêve de créer une nouvelle arme permettant de défendre Madrigal est en train de prendre forme. La seule chose pouvant nous en empêcher est le Seigneur Démon de Cristal.
dialogsBegin.id: Impian membangun senjata baru untuk membela Madgrial mulai terasa nyata. Satu-satunya hal yang menghalangi kita adalah Crystal Demon Lord.
dialogsBegin.it: The dream of building a new weapon to defend Madgrial is starting to feel real. The only thing standing in our way is the Crystal Demon Lord.
dialogsBegin.jp: マドリガルを守るために新しい武器を作るという夢が現実に感じ始めています。私たちの邪魔をしているのはクリスタル魔王だけです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 마드리갈을 지킬 신무기 제작의 꿈이, 어쩌면 꿈으로만 끝나진 않을 것 같네요. 이제 우리 앞을 가로막는 건 크리스탈 데몬 로드뿐이에요.
dialogsBegin.nl: The dream of building a new weapon to defend Madgrial is starting to feel real. The only thing standing in our way is the Crystal Demon Lord.
dialogsBegin.pl: The dream of building a new weapon to defend Madgrial is starting to feel real. The only thing standing in our way is the Crystal Demon Lord.
dialogsBegin.ru: The dream of building a new weapon to defend Madgrial is starting to feel real. The only thing standing in our way is the Crystal Demon Lord.
dialogsBegin.sp: El sueño de construir una nueva arma para defender Madgrial empieza a hacerse realidad. Lo único que se interpone en nuestro camino es el Señor de los Demonios de Cristal.
dialogsBegin.sw: The dream of building a new weapon to defend Madgrial is starting to feel real. The only thing standing in our way is the Crystal Demon Lord.
dialogsBegin.th: การสร้างอาวุธใหม่ ไว้เพื่อป้องกัน Madgrial ดูเริ่มจะเป็นจริงขึ้นมาแล้ว สิ่งเดียวที่ขวางทางพวกเราอยู่คือ Crystal Demon Lord
dialogsBegin.tw: 打造出能守護瑪德利賈的新武器，這個夢想開始變得真實了。現在擋在我們前面的，就只剩下水晶惡魔領主。
dialogsBegin.vi: Giấc mơ chế tạo vũ khí mới để bảo vệ Madgrial bắt đầu thành hiện thực. Thứ duy nhất cản đường chúng ta là Crystal Demon Lord.

dialogsAccept.en: Go collect the Clockworks Core that the Crystal Demon Lord has been guarding all these years. Once you've collected the Clockworks Core, I'm sure that Rankashu would appreciate an update on your progress...
dialogsAccept.ar: Go collect the Clockworks Core that the Crystal Demon Lord has been guarding all these years. Once you've collected the Clockworks Core, I'm sure that Rankashu would appreciate an update on your progress...
dialogsAccept.br: Vá coletar o Núcleo do Clockworks que o Senhor Demônio de Cristal tem guardado todos esses anos. Assim que você pegar o Núcleo do Clockworks, tenho certeza de que Rankashu ficaria grato por uma atualização sobre o seu progresso.
dialogsAccept.cns: Go collect the Clockworks Core that the Crystal Demon Lord has been guarding all these years. Once you've collected the Clockworks Core, I'm sure that Rankashu would appreciate an update on your progress...
dialogsAccept.de: Sammel den Kern von Clockwork, den der Kristalldämonenfürst all diese Jahre behütet hat. Sobald du diesen beschafft hast, solltest du Rankashu über deinen Fortschritt informieren.
dialogsAccept.fi: Go collect the Clockworks Core that the Crystal Demon Lord has been guarding all these years. Once you've collected the Clockworks Core, I'm sure that Rankashu would appreciate an update on your progress...
dialogsAccept.fil: Go collect the Clockworks Core that the Crystal Demon Lord has been guarding all these years. Once you've collected the Clockworks Core, I'm sure that Rankashu would appreciate an update on your progress...
dialogsAccept.fr: Allez récupérer les Cœurs de Clockworks que le Seigneur Démon de Cristal a gardé pendant toutes ces années. Une fois cela fait, je suis sûr que Rankashu apprécierait grandement que vous le teniez au courant sur votre progrès.
dialogsAccept.id: Kumpulkan Clockworks Core yang telah dijaga oleh Crystal Demon Lord selama ini. Setelah kamu mengumpulkan Clockworks Core, aku yakin bahwa Rankashu akan menghargai pembaruan kemajuanmu..
dialogsAccept.it: Go collect the Clockworks Core that the Crystal Demon Lord has been guarding all these years. Once you've collected the Clockworks Core, I'm sure that Rankashu would appreciate an update on your progress...
dialogsAccept.jp: クリスタル魔王がここ数年守ってきた時計のコアを集めに行きましょう。時計のコアを集めたら、蘭川があなたの進捗状況の最新情報をいただければ幸いです。
dialogsAccept.kr: 그동안 크리스탈 데몬 로드가 지키고 있던 클락워크 코어를 수집하세요. 클락워크 코어를 모으고 나면, 랑카슈가 진행 상황을 알려줄 거예요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Go collect the Clockworks Core that the Crystal Demon Lord has been guarding all these years. Once you've collected the Clockworks Core, I'm sure that Rankashu would appreciate an update on your progress...
dialogsAccept.pl: Go collect the Clockworks Core that the Crystal Demon Lord has been guarding all these years. Once you've collected the Clockworks Core, I'm sure that Rankashu would appreciate an update on your progress...
dialogsAccept.ru: Go collect the Clockworks Core that the Crystal Demon Lord has been guarding all these years. Once you've collected the Clockworks Core, I'm sure that Rankashu would appreciate an update on your progress...
dialogsAccept.sp: Ve a recoger el Núcleo del Reloj que el Señor de los Demonios de Cristal ha estado guardando todos estos años. Una vez que hayas recogido el Núcleo del Reloj, estoy seguro de que Rankashu agradecerá que le pongas al día de tus progresos...
dialogsAccept.sw: Go collect the Clockworks Core that the Crystal Demon Lord has been guarding all these years. Once you've collected the Clockworks Core, I'm sure that Rankashu would appreciate an update on your progress...
dialogsAccept.th: ลงไปเก็บ Clockworks Core ที่ Crystal Demon Lord คอยปกป้องมานาน และเมื่อคุณได้ Clockworks Core แล้ว ข้าแน่ใจว่า Rankashu ต้องยินดีแน่ กับความคืบหน้าที่เจ้าจะไปรายงานให้เขาฟัง
dialogsAccept.tw: 去把水晶惡魔領主多年來守護的機甲鐘樓核心拿回來吧。一旦你取得那顆核心，我想蘭卡修也會很想知道你的進展……
dialogsAccept.vi: Hãy đi thu thập Clockworks Core mà Crystal Demon Lord đã canh giữ suốt những năm qua. Khi bạn đã thu thập được Clockworks Core, tôi chắc chắn rằng Rankashu sẽ muốn nghe bạn cập nhật tiến độ công việc đấy...

dialogsDecline.en: Without the Clockworks Core there is no hope to build a new weapon.
dialogsDecline.ar: Without the Clockworks Core there is no hope to build a new weapon.
dialogsDecline.br: Sem o Núcleo do Clockworks, não há esperança de construir uma nova arma.
dialogsDecline.cns: Without the Clockworks Core there is no hope to build a new weapon.
dialogsDecline.de: Ohne den Kern von Clockwork können wir niemals eine neue Waffe erschaffen.
dialogsDecline.fi: Without the Clockworks Core there is no hope to build a new weapon.
dialogsDecline.fil: Without the Clockworks Core there is no hope to build a new weapon.
dialogsDecline.fr: Sans les Coeurs de Clockworks, il n'y a aucun espoir de pouvoir créer une nouvelle arme.
dialogsDecline.id: Tanpa Clockworks Core tidak ada harapan untuk membuat senjata baru.
dialogsDecline.it: Without the Clockworks Core there is no hope to build a new weapon.
dialogsDecline.jp: クロックワークスコアがなければ、新しい武器を作ることはできません。
dialogsDecline.kr: 클락워크 코어가 없으면 새로운 무기를 만들 수가 없거든요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Without the Clockworks Core there is no hope to build a new weapon.
dialogsDecline.pl: Without the Clockworks Core there is no hope to build a new weapon.
dialogsDecline.ru: Without the Clockworks Core there is no hope to build a new weapon.
dialogsDecline.sp: Sin el Núcleo de Mecanismos no hay esperanza de construir una nueva arma.
dialogsDecline.sw: Without the Clockworks Core there is no hope to build a new weapon.
dialogsDecline.th: ปราศจาก Clockworks Core แล้ว มันไม่มีหวังที่จะสร้างอาวูธใหม่ได้เลย
dialogsDecline.tw: 沒有機甲鐘樓核心，我們就不可能打造出新的武器。
dialogsDecline.vi: Không có Clockworks Core thì không có hy vọng chế tạo vũ khí mới.

dialogsComplete.en: This is incredible!!! My kin was in Storm Peak all along... and a Clockworks Core was being guarded there, too!? Perhaps the future of Madrigal is brighter than I thought...
dialogsComplete.ar: This is incredible!!! My kin was in Storm Peak all along... and a Clockworks Core was being guarded there, too!? Perhaps the future of Madrigal is brighter than I thought...
dialogsComplete.br: Isso é incrível!!! Meus semelhantes estavam no Pico Tempestuoso o tempo todo.. e um Núcleo do Clockworks estava sendo guardado lá também!? Talvez o futuro de Madrigal seja mais promissor do que eu pensava..
dialogsComplete.cns: This is incredible!!! My kin was in Storm Peak all along... and a Clockworks Core was being guarded there, too!? Perhaps the future of Madrigal is brighter than I thought...
dialogsComplete.de: Das ist unglaublich!!! Meine Verwandtschaft war die ganze Zeit über im Sturmgipfel....und der Kern von Clockwork wurde dort bewacht? Vielleicht ist die Zukunft Madrigals rosiger als ich dachte...
dialogsComplete.fi: This is incredible!!! My kin was in Storm Peak all along... and a Clockworks Core was being guarded there, too!? Perhaps the future of Madrigal is brighter than I thought...
dialogsComplete.fil: This is incredible!!! My kin was in Storm Peak all along... and a Clockworks Core was being guarded there, too!? Perhaps the future of Madrigal is brighter than I thought...
dialogsComplete.fr: C'est incroyable !!! Ma famille était au Pic de Tempête tout ce temps là... Et un Cœur de Clockworks s'y trouvait également ? Finalement, peut être que le futur de Madrigal est plus prometteur que je ne le pensais.
dialogsComplete.id: Ini luar biasa!!! Kerabatku ada di Storm Peak selama ini.. dan Clockworks Core juga dijaga di sana!? Mungkin masa depan Madrigal lebih cerah dari yang aku kira..
dialogsComplete.it: This is incredible!!! My kin was in Storm Peak all along... and a Clockworks Core was being guarded there, too!? Perhaps the future of Madrigal is brighter than I thought...
dialogsComplete.jp: これは信じられません！！！私の親族はずっとストームピークにいました..。時計のコアも守られていた!?もしかしたら、マドリガルの未来は思ったより明るいのかもしれない。
dialogsComplete.kr: 믿기지가 않네요!!! 스톰 봉우리에 친척이 있었다니... 게다가 그곳에서 클락워크 코어도 지키고 있었다니!? 마드리갈의 미래가 생각보다 밝을지도 모르겠네요...
dialogsComplete.nl: This is incredible!!! My kin was in Storm Peak all along... and a Clockworks Core was being guarded there, too!? Perhaps the future of Madrigal is brighter than I thought...
dialogsComplete.pl: This is incredible!!! My kin was in Storm Peak all along... and a Clockworks Core was being guarded there, too!? Perhaps the future of Madrigal is brighter than I thought...
dialogsComplete.ru: This is incredible!!! My kin was in Storm Peak all along... and a Clockworks Core was being guarded there, too!? Perhaps the future of Madrigal is brighter than I thought...
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Esto es increíble! ¿¡Mi familia estaba en el Pico Tormentoso todo el tiempo... y un Núcleo Mecánico estaba siendo custodiado allí, también!? Tal vez el futuro de Madrigal es más brillante de lo que pensaba ..
dialogsComplete.sw: This is incredible!!! My kin was in Storm Peak all along... and a Clockworks Core was being guarded there, too!? Perhaps the future of Madrigal is brighter than I thought...
dialogsComplete.th: สุดยอดมาก! พวกคนของข้าอยู่ใน Storm Peak มาตลอด และ Clockworks Core ก็ถูกป้องกันอยู่ที่นั่นด้วย? บางทีอนาคตของ Madrigal อาจจะสดใสกว่าที่ข้าคิดไว้
dialogsComplete.tw: 這太驚人了！！！原來我的族人一直都在風暴峰裡……而且那裡竟然還守著一顆機甲鐘樓核心！？也許瑪德利賈的未來，比我想像中還要光明……
dialogsComplete.vi: Điều này thật kỳ diệu!!! Họ hàng của tôi đã ở Storm Peak suốt thời gian qua.. và một cái Clockworks Core cũng được canh giữ ở đó!? Có lẽ tương lai của Madrigal tươi sáng hơn tôi nghĩ..

dialogsComplete.en: I will spend my days trying to understand this Clockworks Core, perhaps one day Rankashin and I will successfully create the strongest Clockworks of all time!
dialogsComplete.ar: I will spend my days trying to understand this Clockworks Core, perhaps one day Rankashin and I will successfully create the strongest Clockworks of all time!
dialogsComplete.br: Passarei meus dias tentando entender este Núcleo do Clockworks, talvez um dia Rankashin e eu consigamos criar o Clockworks mais poderoso de todos os tempos!
dialogsComplete.cns: I will spend my days trying to understand this Clockworks Core, perhaps one day Rankashin and I will successfully create the strongest Clockworks of all time!
dialogsComplete.de: Ich werde bis zum Ende meiner Tage versuchen, diesen Kern von Clockwork zu verstehen; vielleicht können Rankashin und ich eines Tages den stärksten Clockwork aller Zeiten erschaffen!
dialogsComplete.fi: I will spend my days trying to understand this Clockworks Core, perhaps one day Rankashin and I will successfully create the strongest Clockworks of all time!
dialogsComplete.fil: I will spend my days trying to understand this Clockworks Core, perhaps one day Rankashin and I will successfully create the strongest Clockworks of all time!
dialogsComplete.fr: Je vais passer mes journées à tenter de percer les secrets de ce Coeur de Clockworks. Peut être un jour Rankashin et moi allons créer le Clockworks le plus puissant de tous les temps !
dialogsComplete.id: Saya akan menghabiskan hari-hari saya untuk mencoba memahami Clockworks Core ini, mungkin suatu hari nanti saya dan Rankashin akan berhasil membuat Clockworks terkuat sepanjang masa!
dialogsComplete.it: I will spend my days trying to understand this Clockworks Core, perhaps one day Rankashin and I will successfully create the strongest Clockworks of all time!
dialogsComplete.jp: 私はこのクロックワークスコア、おそらくいつかランカシンを理解しようと日々を過ごし、史上最強のクロックワークスを成功裏に作成します!
dialogsComplete.kr: 그동안은 이 클락워크 코어를 연구해 보도록 하겠어요. 언젠가는 랑카신과 제가 사상 최강의 클락워크를 만들어낼 수도 있겠죠!
dialogsComplete.nl: I will spend my days trying to understand this Clockworks Core, perhaps one day Rankashin and I will successfully create the strongest Clockworks of all time!
dialogsComplete.pl: I will spend my days trying to understand this Clockworks Core, perhaps one day Rankashin and I will successfully create the strongest Clockworks of all time!
dialogsComplete.ru: I will spend my days trying to understand this Clockworks Core, perhaps one day Rankashin and I will successfully create the strongest Clockworks of all time!
dialogsComplete.sp: Me pasaré el día intentando comprender el núcleo de este mecanismo de relojería. ¡Quizá algún día Rankashin y yo logremos crear el mecanismo de relojería más potente de todos los tiempos!
dialogsComplete.sw: I will spend my days trying to understand this Clockworks Core, perhaps one day Rankashin and I will successfully create the strongest Clockworks of all time!
dialogsComplete.th: ข้าจะใช้เวลาของข้าเพื่อทำความเข้าใจเกี่ยวกับ Clockworks Core บางทีวันนึง Rankashin กับข้าจะสามารถสร้าง Clockworks ที่แข็งแกร่งที่สุดตลอดกาลขึ้นมาได้!
dialogsComplete.tw: 我會花很多時間去理解這個時空毀滅者核心，也許有一天我和森林守衛者會成功地創造出有史以來最強大的時空毀滅者！
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi sẽ dành nhiều ngày của mình để cố gắng hiểu được Clockworks Core này, có lẽ một ngày nào đó Rankashin và tôi sẽ tạo thành công Clockworks mạnh nhất mọi thời đại!

dialogsFail.en: Destroy the Crystal Demon Lord so I may finally bring a new Clockworks into the world!
dialogsFail.ar: Destroy the Crystal Demon Lord so I may finally bring a new Clockworks into the world!
dialogsFail.br: Destrua o Lorde Demônio de Cristal para que eu possa finalmente dar vida a um novo Clockworks!
dialogsFail.cns: Destroy the Crystal Demon Lord so I may finally bring a new Clockworks into the world!
dialogsFail.de: Vernichte den Kristalldämonenfürsten, damit ich endlich ein neues Clockworks auf die Welt bringen kann!
dialogsFail.fi: Destroy the Crystal Demon Lord so I may finally bring a new Clockworks into the world!
dialogsFail.fil: Destroy the Crystal Demon Lord so I may finally bring a new Clockworks into the world!
dialogsFail.fr: Détruisez le Seigneur Démon de Cristal que je puisse enfin mettre au monde un nouveau Clockworks !
dialogsFail.id: Hancurkan Crystal Demon Lord jadi aku akhirnya bisa membawa Clockworks baru ke dunia!
dialogsFail.it: Destroy the Crystal Demon Lord so I may finally bring a new Clockworks into the world!
dialogsFail.jp: クリスタル魔王を倒して、ついに新しい時計仕掛けを世界に持ち込むことができます!
dialogsFail.kr: 크리스탈 데몬 로드를 처치해 주신다면, 저도 마침내 새로운 클락워크를 세상에 선보일 수 있을 거예요!
dialogsFail.nl: Destroy the Crystal Demon Lord so I may finally bring a new Clockworks into the world!
dialogsFail.pl: Destroy the Crystal Demon Lord so I may finally bring a new Clockworks into the world!
dialogsFail.ru: Destroy the Crystal Demon Lord so I may finally bring a new Clockworks into the world!
dialogsFail.sp: Destruye al Señor Demonio de Cristal para que pueda traer al mundo un nuevo Mecanismo de Relojería.
dialogsFail.sw: Destroy the Crystal Demon Lord so I may finally bring a new Clockworks into the world!
dialogsFail.th: ทำลาย Crystal Demon Lord แล้วข้าจะได้สามารถนำ Clockworks ใหม่มาสู่โลกนี้ได้ซะที
dialogsFail.tw: 消滅水晶惡魔領主，這樣我才能終於把新的機甲鐘樓帶到這個世界上！
dialogsFail.vi: Tiêu diệt Crystal Demon Lord để cuối cùng tôi có thể mang một Clockworks mới vào thế giới!

dialogsBegin.en: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?

dialogsBegin.cns: 欢迎你，英雄！又有一项委托来了 —— 肃清深渊之塔内的 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$，请你斩杀50只 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$，完成之后再回来找我。
dialogsBegin.de: Willkommen Held! Es ist eine weitere Bitte eingegangen, $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ aus dem Verlassenen Turm zu entfernen. Kannst du bitte 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ erschlagen und zu mir zurückkehren, sobald du fertig bist?

dialogsBegin.fr: Bienvenue, héros ! Nous avons reçu une autre demande pour éliminer des $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ de la Tour Oubliée. Pourriez-vous tuer 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ et revenir me voir une fois que vous aurez terminé ?
dialogsBegin.id: Selamat datang pahlawan! Request lain telah masuk untuk $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ dari Forsaken Tower. Bisakah kamu mengambil 50 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, dan mengembalikannya kepadaku?

dialogsBegin.jp: ようこそヒーロー！忘却の塔から$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を一掃せよと依頼が届きました。50体の$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を倒し戻ってきてくれないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 어서 오세요, 용사님! 버려진 탑에서 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$을(를) 처치해 달라는 요청이 또 들어왔어요. $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 50마리를 처치하고, 완료되면 제게 돌아와 주시겠어요?

dialogsBegin.sw: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.th: ยินดีต้อนรับฮีโร่! มีคำขอสำหรับ $$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ จาก Forsaken Tower มาอีกแล้ว คุณช่วยไปเก็บ 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ และนำกลับมาให้ฉันทีได้ไหม
dialogsBegin.tw: 歡迎，英雄！又有新的委託要你清除深淵之塔中的 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$。可以請你擊殺 50 隻 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$，完成後再回來找我嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Chào mừng người hùng! Một nhiệm vụ khác từ Forsaken Tower yêu cầu bạn đánh bại $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$s. Bạn có thể vui lòng diệt 60 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ và quay lại tìm tôi sau khi hoàn thành nhiệm vụ không?

dialogsDecline.en: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.ar: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.br: A Torre está infestada de masquerpets perigosos. Entendo se não quiser correr o risco.
dialogsDecline.cns: 这座塔里到处都是危险的假面怪。如果你不想冒这个险，我完全理解。
dialogsDecline.de: Der Turm ist voller gefährlicher Masquerpets. Ich verstehe es, wenn du das Risiko nicht eingehen willst.

dialogsDecline.fil: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.fr: La Tour est remplies de monstres dangereux. Je comprends que tu ne veuilles pas prendre ce risque.
dialogsDecline.id: Menara dipenuhi dengan masquerpets berbahaya. Saya mengerti jika Anda tidak ingin mengambil risiko.
dialogsDecline.it: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.jp: タワーは危険なモンスターでいっぱいです。あなたがリスクを冒したくないのなら、私は理解しています。
dialogsDecline.kr: 탑에는 위험한 마스커펫이 가득해요. 위험을 감수하고 싶지 않다고 하셔도 이해합니다.
dialogsDecline.nl: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.

dialogsDecline.sp: La Torre está llena de masquerpets peligrosos. Comprendo si no deseas correr el riesgo.

dialogsBegin.en: A hole in the heart of the Guardiane Sanctuary has been torn asunder! Purple magic has ripped open a portal to a sad, twisted version of the once peaceful haven.

dialogsBegin.br: Um buraco sinistro surgiu no coração do Santuário do Guardião! A magia roxa abriu um portal para uma versão macabra e distorcida do que já foi um refúgio de paz.
dialogsBegin.cns: A hole in the heart of the Guardiane Sanctuary has been torn asunder! Purple magic has ripped open a portal to a sad, twisted version of the once peaceful haven.

dialogsBegin.kr: 그때 가르디안 성소 중심이 갈라지며 틈이 생겨났죠! 자주색 마법이 차원문을 열어, 한때는 평화롭던 안식처를 슬프고 뒤틀린 곳으로 만들어 버린 겁니다.

dialogsBegin.vi: Một lỗ hổng ở trung tâm của Guardiane Sanctuary đã bị xé toạc! Purple magic đã xé toạc cánh cổng dẫn đến một phiên bản buồn bã, méo mó của nơi trú ẩn yên bình một thời.

dialogsBegin.fi: Reports show that all the inhabitants were killed and raised as bloodthirsty masquerpets... this is no doubt the doing of Lapranche. She is causing chaos to bide time, just as we expected!
dialogsBegin.fil: Reports show that all the inhabitants were killed and raised as bloodthirsty masquerpets... this is no doubt the doing of Lapranche. She is causing chaos to bide time, just as we expected!
dialogsBegin.fr: Les rapports indiquent que tous les habitants ont été tués et transformés en pantins assoiffés de sang... c'est sans aucun doute l'œuvre de Lapranche. Elle sème le chaos pour gagner du temps, comme nous l'avions prévu !
dialogsBegin.id: Laporan menunjukkan bahwa semua penduduk dibunuh dan dibesarkan sebagai penyamar haus darah.. ini tidak diragukan lagi adalah perbuatan Lapranche. Dia menyebabkan kekacauan menunggu waktu, seperti yang kita harapkan!
dialogsBegin.it: Reports show that all the inhabitants were killed and raised as bloodthirsty masquerpets... this is no doubt the doing of Lapranche. She is causing chaos to bide time, just as we expected!
dialogsBegin.jp: 報告によると、すべての住民が殺され、血に飢えた仮面劇として育てられました。これは間違いなくラプランシュの行動です。彼女は私たちが予想したように、時間を入札するために混乱を引き起こしています!
dialogsBegin.kr: 이곳에 살던 사람들이 모조리 몰살당한 뒤, 피에 굶주린 마스커펫으로 되살아났다고 하더군요... 라프란체의 소행이 틀림없어요. 우리 예상대로, 시간을 끌려고 혼란을 일으키고 있는 거예요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Reports show that all the inhabitants were killed and raised as bloodthirsty masquerpets... this is no doubt the doing of Lapranche. She is causing chaos to bide time, just as we expected!
dialogsBegin.pl: Reports show that all the inhabitants were killed and raised as bloodthirsty masquerpets... this is no doubt the doing of Lapranche. She is causing chaos to bide time, just as we expected!
dialogsBegin.ru: Reports show that all the inhabitants were killed and raised as bloodthirsty masquerpets... this is no doubt the doing of Lapranche. She is causing chaos to bide time, just as we expected!
dialogsBegin.sp: Los informes muestran que los habitantes fueron asesinados y convertidos en masquerpets sedientos de sangre.. Esto es obra de Lapranche. Está causando el caos para ganar tiempo, ¡Tal como esperábamos!
dialogsBegin.sw: Reports show that all the inhabitants were killed and raised as bloodthirsty masquerpets... this is no doubt the doing of Lapranche. She is causing chaos to bide time, just as we expected!
dialogsBegin.th: รายงานแสดงให้เห็นว่าผู้อยู่อาศัยทั้งหมดถูกฆ่าและปลุกขึ้นมาเป็น masquerpets ที่กระหายเลือด ไม่ต้องสงสัยเลยว่านี่เป็นสิ่งที่ Lapranche ทำ หล่อนทำเรื่องนี้เพื่อคอยถ่วงเวลาอย่างที่เราคิดกันไว้
dialogsBegin.tw: 根據回報，裡面的居民全都被殺害，然後又被喚起成嗜血的怪物……這毫無疑問是拉普蘭雪所為。正如我們預料的那樣，她正靠製造混亂來拖延時間！
dialogsBegin.vi: Các báo cáo cho thấy rằng tất cả cư dân đã bị giết và bị biến thành như những con rối khát máu.. chắc chắn đây là việc làm của Lapranche. Ả ta đang gây hỗn loạn để câu giờ, đúng như chúng ta dự đoán!

dialogsBegin.en: For now we must pause our preparations to deal with the twisted Guardiane Sanctuary.
dialogsBegin.ar: For now we must pause our preparations to deal with the twisted Guardiane Sanctuary.
dialogsBegin.br: Por enquanto, precisamos dar uma pausa nas preparações e lidar com o Santuário do Guardião distorcido.
dialogsBegin.cns: For now we must pause our preparations to deal with the twisted Guardiane Sanctuary.
dialogsBegin.de: Im Moment müssen wir unsere Vorbereitungen für den Umgang mit dem verdrehten Guardiane-Heiligtum unterbrechen.
dialogsBegin.fi: For now we must pause our preparations to deal with the twisted Guardiane Sanctuary.
dialogsBegin.fil: For now we must pause our preparations to deal with the twisted Guardiane Sanctuary.
dialogsBegin.fr: Nos devons mettre en pause nos préparatifs pour nous occuper du Sanctuaire de Gardiane corrompu.
dialogsBegin.id: Untuk saat ini kita harus menghentikan persiapan kita untuk berurusan dengan Guardiane Sanctuary yang bengkok.
dialogsBegin.it: For now we must pause our preparations to deal with the twisted Guardiane Sanctuary.
dialogsBegin.jp: 今のところ、私たちはねじれたガーディアンサンクチュアリに対処するための準備を一時停止しなければなりません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 지금은 뒤틀린 가르디안 성소 처리 준비를 잠시 멈추는 게 좋겠어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: For now we must pause our preparations to deal with the twisted Guardiane Sanctuary.
dialogsBegin.pl: For now we must pause our preparations to deal with the twisted Guardiane Sanctuary.
dialogsBegin.ru: For now we must pause our preparations to deal with the twisted Guardiane Sanctuary.
dialogsBegin.sp: Debemos hacer una pausa en nuestros preparativos para enfrentarnos al retorcido Santuario de Guardiane.
dialogsBegin.sw: For now we must pause our preparations to deal with the twisted Guardiane Sanctuary.
dialogsBegin.th: เราต้องหยุดการเตรียมตัวของเราไว้ก่อนเพื่อจัดการกับ Guardiane Sanctuary ที่บิดเบี้ยว
dialogsBegin.tw: 現在我們必須暫停我們的準備工作來處理扭曲的守護者聖域。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bây giờ chúng ta phải tạm dừng việc chuẩn bị của mình để đối phó với Guardiane Sanctuary xoắn.

dialogsAccept.en: A guard has been posted out front of the portal... go speak with them. Prepare to clear out the Guardiane Sanctuary.
dialogsAccept.ar: A guard has been posted out front of the portal... go speak with them. Prepare to clear out the Guardiane Sanctuary.
dialogsAccept.br: Um guarda foi posicionado na frente do portal... vá falar com ele. Prepare-se para limpar o Santuário do Guardião.
dialogsAccept.cns: A guard has been posted out front of the portal... go speak with them. Prepare to clear out the Guardiane Sanctuary.
dialogsAccept.de: Ein Wächter wurde vor dem Portal abgestellt, spreche mit ihm. Bereite dich darauf vor, das Guardiane Heiligtum aufzuräumen.
dialogsAccept.fi: A guard has been posted out front of the portal... go speak with them. Prepare to clear out the Guardiane Sanctuary.
dialogsAccept.fil: A guard has been posted out front of the portal... go speak with them. Prepare to clear out the Guardiane Sanctuary.
dialogsAccept.fr: Un gardien a été posté devant le portail... Allez parler avec lui. Préparez-vous à devoir nettoyer le Sanctuaire de Gardiane.
dialogsAccept.id: Seorang penjaga telah ditempatkan di depan portal.. bicaralah dengan mereka. Bersiaplah untuk membersihkan Guardiane Sanctuary.
dialogsAccept.it: A guard has been posted out front of the portal... go speak with them. Prepare to clear out the Guardiane Sanctuary.
dialogsAccept.jp: ポータルの前に警備員が配置されています。彼らと話してください。ガーディアンサンクチュアリを一掃する準備をしてください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 포털 앞에 경비병이 있을 테니... 가서 말을 걸어보세요. 가르디안 성소를 소탕할 준비를 하세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: A guard has been posted out front of the portal... go speak with them. Prepare to clear out the Guardiane Sanctuary.
dialogsAccept.pl: A guard has been posted out front of the portal... go speak with them. Prepare to clear out the Guardiane Sanctuary.
dialogsAccept.ru: A guard has been posted out front of the portal... go speak with them. Prepare to clear out the Guardiane Sanctuary.
dialogsAccept.sp: Se ha apostado un guardia frente al portal... Ve a hablar con ellos. Prepárate para desalojar el Santuario Guardiane.
dialogsAccept.sw: A guard has been posted out front of the portal... go speak with them. Prepare to clear out the Guardiane Sanctuary.
dialogsAccept.th: การ์ดยืนเฝ้าอยู่หน้า พอร์ทัล ไปคุยกับพวกเขา เตรียมตัวให้พร้อมเพื่อที่จะเข้าไป Guardiane Sanctuary
dialogsAccept.tw: 入口外已經派了守衛駐守……去和他說話吧。準備好清剿守護者聖域。
dialogsAccept.vi: Một lính canh đã được bố trí trước cổng.. hãy nói chuyện với người đó. Chuẩn bị dọn sạch khu vực Guardiane Sanctuary.

dialogsDecline.en: Are you really so weak as to run away from danger, after all you've done!?
dialogsDecline.ar: Are you really so weak as to run away from danger, after all you've done!?
dialogsDecline.br: Você vai mesmo ser tão frouxo a ponto de sair correndo do perigo, depois de tudo que fez!?
dialogsDecline.cns: Are you really so weak as to run away from danger, after all you've done!?
dialogsDecline.de: Bist du wirklich so ein Schwächling, dass du vor der Gefahr wegläufst, nach allem, was du getan hast?
dialogsDecline.fi: Are you really so weak as to run away from danger, after all you've done!?
dialogsDecline.fil: Are you really so weak as to run away from danger, after all you've done!?
dialogsDecline.fr: Êtes-vous vraiment si faible que vous esquivez le danger ? Après tout ce que vous avez fait ?
dialogsDecline.id: Apakah kamu benar-benar sangat lemah untuk melarikan diri dari bahaya, setelah semua yang telah kamu lakukan!?
dialogsDecline.it: Are you really so weak as to run away from danger, after all you've done!?
dialogsDecline.jp: やっぱり危険から逃げるほど弱いの!?
dialogsDecline.kr: 위험하다고 도망칠 정도로 나약한 겁니까? 그 모든 노력이 무색할 정도로!?
dialogsDecline.nl: Are you really so weak as to run away from danger, after all you've done!?
dialogsDecline.pl: Are you really so weak as to run away from danger, after all you've done!?
dialogsDecline.ru: Are you really so weak as to run away from danger, after all you've done!?
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿De verdad eres tan débil que huyes del peligro, después de todo lo que has hecho?
dialogsDecline.sw: Are you really so weak as to run away from danger, after all you've done!?
dialogsDecline.th: นี่เจ้าอ่อนแอขนาดที่วิ่งหนีจากอันตรายทั้ง ๆ ที่ผ่านเรื่องทั้งหมดนี่มาแล้วน่ะนะ?
dialogsDecline.tw: 做了這麼多事之後，你現在竟然還弱到要逃避危險嗎！？
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn có thực sự yếu đến mức chạy trốn khỏi nguy hiểm, sau tất cả những gì bạn đã làm không!

dialogsComplete.en: Laola sent word of your arrival. The events that Lapranche have put into place are tragic... all the inhabitants of the Guardiane Sanctuary are dead. And yet... they live.
dialogsComplete.ar: Laola sent word of your arrival. The events that Lapranche have put into place are tragic... all the inhabitants of the Guardiane Sanctuary are dead. And yet... they live.
dialogsComplete.br: Laola mandou dizer que você chegou. Os eventos causados pela Lapranche são trágicos... todos os moradores do Santuário do Guardião estão mortos. E ainda assim... eles vivem.
dialogsComplete.cns: Laola sent word of your arrival. The events that Lapranche have put into place are tragic... all the inhabitants of the Guardiane Sanctuary are dead. And yet... they live.
dialogsComplete.de: Laola hat uns von deiner Ankunft benachrichtigt. Die Ereignisse, die Lapranche inszeniert hat, sind tragisch. Alle Bewohner des Guardiane-Heiligtums sind tot. Und doch leben sie noch.
dialogsComplete.fi: Laola sent word of your arrival. The events that Lapranche have put into place are tragic... all the inhabitants of the Guardiane Sanctuary are dead. And yet... they live.
dialogsComplete.fil: Laola sent word of your arrival. The events that Lapranche have put into place are tragic... all the inhabitants of the Guardiane Sanctuary are dead. And yet... they live.
dialogsComplete.fr: Laola a prévenu de votre arrivée. Ce que Lapranche a mis en place est tragique... Tous les habitants du Sanctuaire de Gardiane sont morts... Et pourtant... Ils vivent.
dialogsComplete.id: Laola mengirimkan kabar kedatanganmu. Peristiwa yang terjadi Lapranche tragis.. semua penghuni Guardiane Sanctuary sudah mati. Namun .. mereka hidup.
dialogsComplete.it: Laola sent word of your arrival. The events that Lapranche have put into place are tragic... all the inhabitants of the Guardiane Sanctuary are dead. And yet... they live.
dialogsComplete.jp: ラオラはあなたの到着の知らせを送りました。ラプランシュが実施した出来事は悲劇的です。ガーディアンサンクチュアリのすべての住民は死んでいます。それなのに。。彼らは生きています。
dialogsComplete.kr: 라올라가 당신이 올 거라고 전갈을 보냈더군요. 이곳에서 라프란체가 일으킨 비극으로... 가르디안 성소의 사람들이 모두 죽고 말았습니다. 그와 동시에 아직... 살아 있죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: Laola sent word of your arrival. The events that Lapranche have put into place are tragic... all the inhabitants of the Guardiane Sanctuary are dead. And yet... they live.
dialogsComplete.pl: Laola sent word of your arrival. The events that Lapranche have put into place are tragic... all the inhabitants of the Guardiane Sanctuary are dead. And yet... they live.
dialogsComplete.ru: Laola sent word of your arrival. The events that Lapranche have put into place are tragic... all the inhabitants of the Guardiane Sanctuary are dead. And yet... they live.
dialogsComplete.sp: Laola envió noticias de tu llegada. Los acontecimientos que Lapranche ha puesto en marcha son trágicos .. todos los habitantes del Santuario Guardiane están muertos. Y sin embargo .. viven.
dialogsComplete.sw: Laola sent word of your arrival. The events that Lapranche have put into place are tragic... all the inhabitants of the Guardiane Sanctuary are dead. And yet... they live.
dialogsComplete.th: Laola ได้แจ้งมาแล้วว่าเจ้าจะมา เหตุการณ์ที่ Lapranche สร้างขึ้นที่นีมันเป็นโศกนาฏกรรม ชาวเมืองของ Guardiane Sanctuary ตายทั้งหมด แต่....ถูกทำให้ยังมีชีวิตอยู่..
dialogsComplete.tw: 拉宇已經通知我你會來。拉普蘭雪造成的這場悲劇……守護者聖域裡的居民全都死了。可是……他們又還活著。
dialogsComplete.vi: Laola đã báo cho tôi về sự xuất hiện của bạn. Các sự kiện mà Lapranche đã gây ra thật bi thảm.. tất cả cư dân của Guardiane Sanctuary đều đã chết. Và sau tất cả .. họ vẫn tồn tại.

dialogsFail.en: Go find the guard posted outside the Guardiane Sanctuary portal, in the heart of Guardiane.
dialogsFail.ar: Go find the guard posted outside the Guardiane Sanctuary portal, in the heart of Guardiane.
dialogsFail.br: Vá encontrar o guarda posicionado fora do portal do Santuário do Guardião, no coração de Guardiane.
dialogsFail.cns: Go find the guard posted outside the Guardiane Sanctuary portal, in the heart of Guardiane.
dialogsFail.de: Suche die Wache, die vor dem Portal des Guardiane-Heiligtum im Herzen von Guardiane postiert ist.
dialogsFail.fi: Go find the guard posted outside the Guardiane Sanctuary portal, in the heart of Guardiane.
dialogsFail.fil: Go find the guard posted outside the Guardiane Sanctuary portal, in the heart of Guardiane.
dialogsFail.fr: Allez retrouver le gardien posté en dehors du portail du Sanctuaire de Gardiane, dans le cœur de Gardiane.
dialogsFail.id: Pergi temukan penjaga yang ditempatkan di luar portal Guardiane Sanctuary, di jantung Guardiane.
dialogsFail.it: Go find the guard posted outside the Guardiane Sanctuary portal, in the heart of Guardiane.
dialogsFail.jp: ガーディアンの中心部にあるガーディアンサンクチュアリポータルの外に配置された警備員を探しに行きましょう。
dialogsFail.kr: 가르디안 중심부의 가르디안 성소 포털에 배치된 경비병을 찾아가세요.
dialogsFail.nl: Go find the guard posted outside the Guardiane Sanctuary portal, in the heart of Guardiane.
dialogsFail.pl: Go find the guard posted outside the Guardiane Sanctuary portal, in the heart of Guardiane.
dialogsFail.ru: Go find the guard posted outside the Guardiane Sanctuary portal, in the heart of Guardiane.
dialogsFail.sp: Ve a buscar al guardia apostado frente al portal del Santuario de Guardiane, en el corazón de Guardiane.
dialogsFail.sw: Go find the guard posted outside the Guardiane Sanctuary portal, in the heart of Guardiane.
dialogsFail.th: ออกไปหาการ์ดด้านนอกของ Guardiane Sanctuary พอร์ทัล ในใจกลางของ Guardiane
dialogsFail.tw: 去守護者中心的守護者聖域門戶外找到守衛。
dialogsFail.vi: Đi tìm guard được đăng bên ngoài cổng Guardiane Sanctuary, ở trung tâm của Guardiane.

dialogsBegin.en: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.ar: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.br: Bem-vindo de volta aventureiro! Há relatos de uma nova ameaça na Torre Abandonada. Procure e livre-se de $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.cns: 欢迎回来，英雄！据报告，深渊之塔中出现了新的威胁。请前去找到并消灭 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$
dialogsBegin.de: Willkommen zurück, Held! Berichte zufolge wartet im Verlassenen Turm eine neue Bedrohung. Suche und töte die $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fi: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fil: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fr: Content de te revoir, héros ! Des rapports indiquent la présence d'une nouvelle menace dans la Tour Oubliée. S'il te plaît, cherche et élimine le $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.id: Selamat datang kembali pahlawan! Ada laporan ancaman baru di Forsaken Tower. Silakan cari dan singkirkan $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.it: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.jp: おかえりヒーロー！忘却の塔に新たな脅威の報告がありました。$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を探して一掃してきてください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 돌아온 걸 환영해요, 용사님! 버려진 탑에 위협이 발생했다는 보고를 받았어요. 버려진 탑에서 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$을(를) 찾아 없애주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.pl: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.ru: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Bienvenido, héroe! Hay informes de una nueva amenaza en la Torre de los Desamparados. Por favor, busca y deshazte del $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.sw: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.th: ยินดีต้อนรับกลับมาฮีโร่! มีรายงานมาว่าพบกันอันตรายใหม่เกิดขึ้นที่ Forsaken Tower โปรดไปค้นหาและทำลาย $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ให้สิ้นซาก
dialogsBegin.tw: 歡迎回來的英雄！有報告稱深淵之塔出現了新的威脅。請找出並擺脫 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$。
dialogsBegin.vi: Chào mừng trở lại hero! Có báo cáo về một mối đe dọa mới trong Forsaken Tower. Vui lòng tìm kiếm và loại bỏ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.

dialogsAccept.it: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the second floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsAccept.jp: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$は、忘却の塔の2階で発見されました。
dialogsAccept.kr: 버려진 탑 2층에서 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$이(가) 발견되었습니다.
dialogsAccept.nl: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the second floor of the Forsaken Tower.

dialogsAccept.ru: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the second floor of the Forsaken Tower.

dialogsAccept.sw: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the second floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsAccept.th: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ถูกพบอยู่บนชั้นสองของ Forsaken Tower.
dialogsAccept.tw: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 被發現在深淵之塔的二樓。
dialogsAccept.vi: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ đã được phát hiện trên tầng hai của Forsaken Tower.

dialogsDecline.en: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.ar: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.br: A Torre está infestada de masquerpets perigosos. Entendo se não quiser correr o risco.
dialogsDecline.cns: 这座塔里到处都是危险的假面怪。如果你不想冒这个险，我完全理解。
dialogsDecline.de: Der Turm ist voller gefährlicher Masquerpets. Ich verstehe es, wenn du das Risiko nicht eingehen willst.
dialogsDecline.fi: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.fil: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.fr: La Tour est remplies de monstres dangereux. Je comprends que tu ne veuilles pas prendre ce risque.
dialogsDecline.id: Menara dipenuhi dengan masquerpets berbahaya. Saya mengerti jika Anda tidak ingin mengambil risiko.
dialogsDecline.it: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.jp: タワーは危険なモンスターでいっぱいです。あなたがリスクを冒したくないのなら、私は理解しています。
dialogsDecline.kr: 탑에는 위험한 마스커펫이 가득해요. 위험을 감수하고 싶지 않다고 하셔도 이해합니다.
dialogsDecline.nl: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.pl: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.ru: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.sp: La Torre está llena de masquerpets peligrosos. Comprendo si no deseas correr el riesgo.
dialogsDecline.sw: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.th: Tower เต็มไปด้วย masquerpets ที่อันตราย ข้าเข้าใจดีถ้าเจ้าไม่อยากเสี่ยงอันตราย
dialogsDecline.tw: 塔內充滿了危險的怪物。如果你不想冒險，我可以理解。
dialogsDecline.vi: Tower chứa đầy masquerpets nguy hiểm. Tôi hiểu bạn không muốn mạo hiểm.

dialogsComplete.en: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.ar: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.br: Obrigado aventureiro, a ameaça $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ foi eliminada.
dialogsComplete.cns: 感谢你英雄, $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 的威胁被终结了。
dialogsComplete.de: Vielen Dank, dank dir wurde die $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ Bedrohung beseitigt.
dialogsComplete.fi: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.fil: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.fr: Merci, héros, la menace $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ a été éliminée.
dialogsComplete.id: Terima kasih pahlawan, ancaman $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ telah dihilangkan.
dialogsComplete.it: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.jp: ありがとうヒーロー、$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$の脅威が排除されました。
dialogsComplete.kr: 감사해요 용사님. $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$을(를) 처치해 위협을 없애 주셨군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.pl: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.ru: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.sp: Gracias héroe, la amenaza $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ha sido eliminada.
dialogsComplete.sw: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsComplete.th: ขอบคุณมากฮีโร่ อันตรายจาก $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ได้ถูกกำจัดไปหมดแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 謝謝英雄，$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 威脅已被消除。
dialogsComplete.vi: Cảm ơn hero, mối đe dọa $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ đã bị loại bỏ.

dialogsFail.en: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.ar: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.br: Você ainda não conseguiu matar o $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$? Tudo bem, por favor, volte depois de vencer o gigante!
dialogsFail.cns: 你还没能击杀 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$吗？没关系，等你战胜那个巨人之后再回来吧！
dialogsFail.de: Du hast es nicht geschafft, $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ zu töten? Das stimmt, komm wieder, sobald du gegen den Giant gewonnen hast!
dialogsFail.fi: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.fil: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.fr: Tu n'as pas encore réussi à tuer le $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ? Pas de problème, reviens me voir après avoir vaincu le géant !
dialogsFail.id: Anda belum bisa membunuh $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$? Tidak apa-apa, mohon segera kembali setelah Anda menang melawan para giant!
dialogsFail.it: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.jp: あなたはまだ$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を倒すことができませんでしたか?大丈夫、巨人に勝ったら戻ってください!
dialogsFail.kr: 아직 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$을(를) 처치하지 못하셨나요? 괜찮아요. 거대 몬스터를 처치하고 나면 돌아오세요!
dialogsFail.nl: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.pl: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.ru: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Aún no has podido matar al $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$? No pasa nada, ¡Vuelve cuando hayas ganado al gigante!
dialogsFail.sw: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!
dialogsFail.th: คุณไม่ยังสามาถจัดการ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ได้อีกรึ? ไม่เป็นไรกลับมาเมื่อคุณจัดการพวกไจแอนท์พวกนั้นสำเร็จนะ!
dialogsFail.tw: 你還沒能殺死 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$？沒關係，打敗巨人後請回來！
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn vẫn chưa giết được $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$? Không sao đâu, hãy trở về sau khi đánh bại giant!

dialogsBegin.en: I wish you the best on your journey, however just know that the Storm Peak is terrifying. Only step foot within if you are truly prepared.
dialogsBegin.ar: I wish you the best on your journey, however just know that the Storm Peak is terrifying. Only step foot within if you are truly prepared.
dialogsBegin.br: Te desejo o máximo de sorte em sua jornada, mas já te adianto que o Pico da Tempestade é de arrepiar os cabelos. Só entre se estiver realmente preparado.
dialogsBegin.cns: I wish you the best on your journey, however just know that the Storm Peak is terrifying. Only step foot within if you are truly prepared.
dialogsBegin.de: Ich wünsche dir alles Gute für deine Reise, aber du solltest wissen, dass der Sturmgipfel furchterregend ist. Betrete ihn nur, wenn du wirklich vorbereitet bist.
dialogsBegin.fi: I wish you the best on your journey, however just know that the Storm Peak is terrifying. Only step foot within if you are truly prepared.
dialogsBegin.fil: I wish you the best on your journey, however just know that the Storm Peak is terrifying. Only step foot within if you are truly prepared.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je vous souhaite le meilleur dans votre aventure. Cependant sachez que le Pic de Tempête est terrifiant. N'y mettez le pied que si vous êtes bien préparé.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya berharap yang terbaik dalam perjalanan Anda, namun ketahuilah bahwa Storm Peak menakutkan. Hanya melangkah masuk jika Anda benar-benar siap.
dialogsBegin.it: I wish you the best on your journey, however just know that the Storm Peak is terrifying. Only step foot within if you are truly prepared.
dialogsBegin.jp: 私はあなたがあなたの旅で最高であることを願っています、しかしただストームピークが恐ろしいことを知ってください。あなたが本当に準備ができている場合にのみ、中に足を踏み入れてください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 당신의 여정에 행운을 빌지만, 스톰 봉우리가 정말 무서운 곳이라는 사실만은 명심하세요. 진정 준비가 되었을 때만 발을 디디라고요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I wish you the best on your journey, however just know that the Storm Peak is terrifying. Only step foot within if you are truly prepared.
dialogsBegin.pl: I wish you the best on your journey, however just know that the Storm Peak is terrifying. Only step foot within if you are truly prepared.
dialogsBegin.ru: I wish you the best on your journey, however just know that the Storm Peak is terrifying. Only step foot within if you are truly prepared.
dialogsBegin.sp: Le deseo lo mejor en su viaje, pero sepa que el Pico de la Tormenta es aterrador. Solo pisadlo si estáis realmente preparados.
dialogsBegin.sw: I wish you the best on your journey, however just know that the Storm Peak is terrifying. Only step foot within if you are truly prepared.
dialogsBegin.th: ข้ออวยพรให้เจ้าโชคดีในการเดินทาง แม้จะรุ้ว่า Storm Peak อันตรายขนาดไหน แค่ก้าวเท้าเข้าไปได้เจ้าก็พร้อมแล้วล่ะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 祝你旅途順利，不過我得先提醒你，風暴峰真的非常可怕。只有在你做好萬全準備時，才踏進去吧。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi chúc bạn những điều tốt đẹp nhất trên hành trình của mình, tuy nhiên chỉ cần biết rằng Storm Peak thật đáng sợ. Chỉ bước chân vào bên trong nếu bạn thực sự chuẩn bị.

dialogsAccept.en: Many dangers lie ahead... but I trust you to take them head on and emerge victorious, warrior. Enter the Storm Peak and find out what lies ahead.
dialogsAccept.ar: Many dangers lie ahead... but I trust you to take them head on and emerge victorious, warrior. Enter the Storm Peak and find out what lies ahead.
dialogsAccept.br: Muitos perigos estão à sua frente... mas confio em você para enfrentá-los de frente e sair vitorioso, guerreiro. Entre no Pico Tempestuoso e descubra o que o aguarda.
dialogsAccept.cns: Many dangers lie ahead... but I trust you to take them head on and emerge victorious, warrior. Enter the Storm Peak and find out what lies ahead.
dialogsAccept.de: Viele Gefahren liegen vor dir, aber ich vertraue darauf, dass du dich ihnen stellst und siegreich daraus hervorgehst, Krieger. Betritt den Sturmgipfel und finde heraus, was vor dir liegt.
dialogsAccept.fi: Many dangers lie ahead... but I trust you to take them head on and emerge victorious, warrior. Enter the Storm Peak and find out what lies ahead.
dialogsAccept.fil: Many dangers lie ahead... but I trust you to take them head on and emerge victorious, warrior. Enter the Storm Peak and find out what lies ahead.
dialogsAccept.fr: De nombreux dangers vous attendent... mais je vous fais confiance pour les affronter et en sortir victorieux, guerrier. Pénètrez dans le Pic de Tempête et découvrez ce qui vous attend.
dialogsAccept.id: Banyak bahaya terbentang di depan.. tetapi aku percaya kamu untuk menghadapinya dan muncul sebagai pemenang, pejuang. Masuki Storm Peak dan cari tahu apa yang ada di depan.
dialogsAccept.it: Many dangers lie ahead... but I trust you to take them head on and emerge victorious, warrior. Enter the Storm Peak and find out what lies ahead.
dialogsAccept.jp: 多くの危険が待ち受けています。しかし、私はあなたが彼らを正面から受け止め、勝利を収めると信じています、戦士。ストームピークに入り、その先にあるものを見つけてください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 많은 위험이 도사리고 있지만... 당신 같은 전사는 맞서 싸워 승리할 거라고 믿어요. 스톰 봉우리에 들어가서 뭐가 있는지 알아보세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Many dangers lie ahead... but I trust you to take them head on and emerge victorious, warrior. Enter the Storm Peak and find out what lies ahead.
dialogsAccept.pl: Many dangers lie ahead... but I trust you to take them head on and emerge victorious, warrior. Enter the Storm Peak and find out what lies ahead.
dialogsAccept.ru: Many dangers lie ahead... but I trust you to take them head on and emerge victorious, warrior. Enter the Storm Peak and find out what lies ahead.
dialogsAccept.sp: Te aguardan muchos peligros... pero confío en que los afrontarás y saldrás victorioso, guerrero. Entra en el Pico Tormentoso y descubre lo que te espera.
dialogsAccept.sw: Many dangers lie ahead... but I trust you to take them head on and emerge victorious, warrior. Enter the Storm Peak and find out what lies ahead.
dialogsAccept.th: อันตรายมากมายรออยู่ข้างหน้า แต่ข้าเชื่อว่าท่านจะเผชิญหน้ามันและเอาชนะได้อย่างแน่นอนท่านนักรบ โปรดเข้าไปสู่ Storm Peak และค้นหาว่าอะไรรออยู่ข้างหน้า
dialogsAccept.tw: 前方危機四伏……但我相信你能正面迎戰，並凱旋而歸，戰士。進入風暴峰，去看看前方究竟藏著什麼吧。
dialogsAccept.vi: Nhiều hiểm nguy còn phía trước.. nhưng tôi tin tưởng bạn sẽ đương đầu với chúng và thắng trận trở về, hỡi chiến binh kia. Hãy bước vào Storm Peak và tìm ra những gì đang chờ đợi ở phía trước.

dialogsDecline.en: It is not too late to turn back, entering the Storm Peak is almost certain death.
dialogsDecline.ar: It is not too late to turn back, entering the Storm Peak is almost certain death.
dialogsDecline.br: Ainda dá pra dar meia-volta, entrar no Pico da Tempestade é como assinar seu próprio atestado de óbito.
dialogsDecline.cns: It is not too late to turn back, entering the Storm Peak is almost certain death.
dialogsDecline.de: Es ist noch nicht zu spät, umzukehren, denn das Betreten des Sturmgipfels bedeutet fast den sicheren Tod.
dialogsDecline.fi: It is not too late to turn back, entering the Storm Peak is almost certain death.
dialogsDecline.fil: It is not too late to turn back, entering the Storm Peak is almost certain death.
dialogsDecline.fr: Il n'est pas trop tard pour faire demi tour. Pénétrer dans le Pic de Tempête est presque synonyme d'une mort certaine.
dialogsDecline.id: Belum terlambat untuk kembali, memasuki Storm Peak hampir pasti kematian.
dialogsDecline.it: It is not too late to turn back, entering the Storm Peak is almost certain death.
dialogsDecline.jp: 引き返すのに遅すぎることはありません、ストームピークに入ることはほぼ確実な死です。
dialogsDecline.kr: 아직 늦지 않았으니 돌아가세요. 스톰 봉우리에 들어가면 죽게 될 게 뻔하니까요.
dialogsDecline.nl: It is not too late to turn back, entering the Storm Peak is almost certain death.
dialogsDecline.pl: It is not too late to turn back, entering the Storm Peak is almost certain death.
dialogsDecline.ru: It is not too late to turn back, entering the Storm Peak is almost certain death.
dialogsDecline.sp: No es demasiado tarde para dar marcha atrás, entrar en el Pico Tormentoso es una muerte casi segura.
dialogsDecline.sw: It is not too late to turn back, entering the Storm Peak is almost certain death.
dialogsDecline.th: ยังไม่สายเกินไปที่จะหันหลังกลับนะ การเข้าไปใน Storm Peak แทบจะหมายถึงเข้าไปรนหาที่ตายเอง
dialogsDecline.tw: 現在回頭還來得及，踏進風暴峰幾乎等同於送死。
dialogsDecline.vi: Quay đầu lại cũng không muộn, tiến vào Storm Peak gần như là cái chết.

dialogsComplete.en: Heh!? What is one of your kind doing here? I haven't seen any living creatures other than these puppets of Shade for years now...
dialogsComplete.ar: Heh!? What is one of your kind doing here? I haven't seen any living creatures other than these puppets of Shade for years now...
dialogsComplete.br: Heh!? O que um ser como você tá fazendo por aqui? Já faz anos que só vejo esses fantoches da Shade..
dialogsComplete.cns: Heh!? What is one of your kind doing here? I haven't seen any living creatures other than these puppets of Shade for years now...
dialogsComplete.de: Heh!? Was macht einer von deiner Sorte hier? Ich habe schon seit Jahren keine lebenden Kreaturen mehr gesehen, außer diesen Marionetten von Shade...
dialogsComplete.fi: Heh!? What is one of your kind doing here? I haven't seen any living creatures other than these puppets of Shade for years now...
dialogsComplete.fil: Heh!? What is one of your kind doing here? I haven't seen any living creatures other than these puppets of Shade for years now...
dialogsComplete.fr: Heh ?! Qu'est ce qu'un humain comme toi fait ici ? Ca fait un bail que je n'ai pas vu quelqu'un de vivant ici autre que les marionnettes de Shade.
dialogsComplete.id: Heh!? Apa yang salah satu dari jenis kamu lakukan di sini? Aku belum pernah melihat makhluk hidup selain boneka Shade ini selama bertahun-tahun sekarang..
dialogsComplete.it: Heh!? What is one of your kind doing here? I haven't seen any living creatures other than these puppets of Shade for years now...
dialogsComplete.jp: あわや！。あなたの種類の1つはここで何をしていますか?私は何年もの間、これらのシェイドの人形以外の生き物を見ていません..
dialogsComplete.kr: 뭐야!? 당신 종족을 여기서 보게 되다니. 쉐이드의 꼭두각시들 말고는 살아있는 생명체를 본 게 얼마 만인지...
dialogsComplete.nl: Heh!? What is one of your kind doing here? I haven't seen any living creatures other than these puppets of Shade for years now...
dialogsComplete.pl: Heh!? What is one of your kind doing here? I haven't seen any living creatures other than these puppets of Shade for years now...
dialogsComplete.ru: Heh!? What is one of your kind doing here? I haven't seen any living creatures other than these puppets of Shade for years now...
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿¡Eh!? ¿Qué hace uno de tu especie aquí? No he visto ninguna criatura viviente aparte de estas marionetas de Shade desde hace años ..
dialogsComplete.sw: Heh!? What is one of your kind doing here? I haven't seen any living creatures other than these puppets of Shade for years now...
dialogsComplete.th: เห? อะไรทำให้พวกเจ้าเข้ามาในนี้กันนี่ ข้าไม่ได้เห็นสิ่งมีชีวิตอะไรนอกจากพวกหุ่นเชิดของ Shade มาหลายปีแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 嘿！？你這種傢伙怎麼會跑到這裡來？這麼多年來，我除了這些闇影的傀儡外，就再也沒見過活著的生物……
dialogsComplete.vi: Hả!? Một trong những đồng loại của bạn đang làm gì ở đây? Tôi đã không nhìn thấy bất kỳ sinh vật sống nào khác ngoài những con rối của Shade trong nhiều năm nay...

dialogsFail.en: Head inside the Storm Peak when you are ready.
dialogsFail.ar: Head inside the Storm Peak when you are ready.
dialogsFail.br: Entre no Pico Tempestuoso quando estiver pronto.
dialogsFail.cns: Head inside the Storm Peak when you are ready.
dialogsFail.de: Begib dich ins Innere des Sturmgipfels, wenn du bereit bist.
dialogsFail.fi: Head inside the Storm Peak when you are ready.
dialogsFail.fil: Head inside the Storm Peak when you are ready.
dialogsFail.fr: Rendez vous à l'intérieur du Pic de Tempête lorsque vous êtes prêt.
dialogsFail.id: Pergilah ke dalam Storm Peak saat Anda siap.

dialogsBegin.en: Strange sounds have been coming from the Leren Mountains. I recall Martinyc once speaking of a myth about creatures that roam deep within the mountain caves.
dialogsBegin.ar: Strange sounds have been coming from the Leren Mountains. I recall Martinyc once speaking of a myth about creatures that roam deep within the mountain caves.
dialogsBegin.br: Sons estranhos têm vindo das montanhas Leren. Lembro-me de Martinyc ter falado uma vez sobre um mito acerca de criaturas que vagam profundamente nas cavernas da montanha.
dialogsBegin.cns: Strange sounds have been coming from the Leren Mountains. I recall Martinyc once speaking of a myth about creatures that roam deep within the mountain caves.
dialogsBegin.de: Aus dem Leren Gebirge sind seltsame Geräusche zu hören. Ich erinnere mich, dass Martinyc einst von einem Mythos über Kreaturen sprach, die tief in den Berghöhlen umherstreifen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Strange sounds have been coming from the Leren Mountains. I recall Martinyc once speaking of a myth about creatures that roam deep within the mountain caves.
dialogsBegin.fil: Strange sounds have been coming from the Leren Mountains. I recall Martinyc once speaking of a myth about creatures that roam deep within the mountain caves.
dialogsBegin.fr: D'étranges bruits proviennent des montagnes de Leren. Je me souviens que Martinyc a parlé un jour d'un mythe concernant des créatures qui rôdent dans les grottes des montagnes.
dialogsBegin.id: Suara-suara aneh datang dari Leren Mountain. Aku ingat Martinyc pernah berbicara seputar mitos tentang makhluk yang berkeliaran jauh di dalam gua gunung.
dialogsBegin.it: Strange sounds have been coming from the Leren Mountains. I recall Martinyc once speaking of a myth about creatures that roam deep within the mountain caves.
dialogsBegin.jp: レレン山脈から奇妙な音が聞こえてきました。マルティニークがかつて山の洞窟の奥深くを歩き回る生き物についての神話について話したことを思い出します。
dialogsBegin.kr: 레르엔 산맥에서 계속 이상한 소리가 들렸어요. 마르티닉이 산속 동굴 깊은 곳에 사는 괴물 신화 이야기를 했던 게 기억나네요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Strange sounds have been coming from the Leren Mountains. I recall Martinyc once speaking of a myth about creatures that roam deep within the mountain caves.
dialogsBegin.pl: Strange sounds have been coming from the Leren Mountains. I recall Martinyc once speaking of a myth about creatures that roam deep within the mountain caves.
dialogsBegin.ru: Strange sounds have been coming from the Leren Mountains. I recall Martinyc once speaking of a myth about creatures that roam deep within the mountain caves.
dialogsBegin.sp: Extraños ruidos provienen de las Montañas de Leren. Recuerdo que Martinyc contó un mito sobre criaturas que vagan en las profundidades de las cuevas en las montañas.
dialogsBegin.sw: Strange sounds have been coming from the Leren Mountains. I recall Martinyc once speaking of a myth about creatures that roam deep within the mountain caves.
dialogsBegin.th: มีเสียงแปลก ๆ มาจาก Leren Mountains ข้าจำได้ว่าครั้งนึง Martinyc พูดถึงเรื่องเล่าเกี่ยวกับครีเจอร์ที่อาศัยอยู่ในส่วนที่ลึกที่สุดของถ้ำในภูเขา
dialogsBegin.tw: 勒倫山脈一直傳來奇怪的聲音，我記得馬特尼提特曾經說過一個關於在山洞深處漫遊的生物的神話。
dialogsBegin.vi: Những âm thanh kỳ lạ đã phát ra từ Leren Mountains. Tôi nhớ Martinyc từng nói một câu chuyện thần thoại về những sinh vật lang thang sâu trong mountain caves.

dialogsBegin.en: Could you go check with her to see if she has any information about what could be causing this disturbance?
dialogsBegin.ar: Could you go check with her to see if she has any information about what could be causing this disturbance?
dialogsBegin.br: Você poderia ir encontrá-la para ver se ela tem alguma informação sobre o que pode estar causando essa perturbação?
dialogsBegin.cns: Could you go check with her to see if she has any information about what could be causing this disturbance?
dialogsBegin.de: Kannst du mit ihr sprechen, um herauszufinden, ob sie Informationen über die Ursache dieser Störung hat?
dialogsBegin.fi: Could you go check with her to see if she has any information about what could be causing this disturbance?
dialogsBegin.fil: Could you go check with her to see if she has any information about what could be causing this disturbance?
dialogsBegin.fr: Pourriez-vous aller la voir pour voir si elle a des informations sur ce qui pourrait être à l'origine de cette perturbation ?
dialogsBegin.id: Bisakah kamu memeriksanya untuk mengetahui apakah dia memiliki informasi tentang apa yang dapat menyebabkan gangguan ini?
dialogsBegin.it: Could you go check with her to see if she has any information about what could be causing this disturbance?
dialogsBegin.jp: この騒動の原因について何か情報があるかどうか、彼女に確認してもらえますか?
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 소란의 원인이 뭔지, 마르티닉은 알고 있을지도 모르죠. 직접 가서 물어보시겠어요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Could you go check with her to see if she has any information about what could be causing this disturbance?
dialogsBegin.pl: Could you go check with her to see if she has any information about what could be causing this disturbance?
dialogsBegin.ru: Could you go check with her to see if she has any information about what could be causing this disturbance?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Podrías ir a hablar con ella para ver si tiene alguna información sobre lo que podría estar causando esta perturbación?
dialogsBegin.sw: Could you go check with her to see if she has any information about what could be causing this disturbance?
dialogsBegin.th: คุณช่วยไปตรวจสอบกับหล่อนทีได้ไหมว่าเธอรุ้ข้อมูลอะไรบ้าง เกี่ยวกับเหตุผลของสิ่งที่กำลังเกิดขึ้นตอนนี้
dialogsBegin.tw: 你能去跟她確認一下，看看她是否有任何有關導致這場騷亂的資訊嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có thể đi kiểm tra để xem liệu cô ấy có bất kỳ thông tin nào về những gì có thể gây ra sự xáo trộn này không?

dialogsAccept.en: Martinyc is likely reading her books as always. Go speak with her to find out more information.
dialogsAccept.ar: Martinyc is likely reading her books as always. Go speak with her to find out more information.

dialogsDecline.en: Leren Mountains is a dangerous place. I do not blame you for wanting to stay within the safety of Flarine.
dialogsDecline.ar: Leren Mountains is a dangerous place. I do not blame you for wanting to stay within the safety of Flarine.
dialogsDecline.br: As Montanhas Leren são um lugar perigoso. Não o culpo por querer ficar na segurança de Flarine.
dialogsDecline.cns: Leren Mountains is a dangerous place. I do not blame you for wanting to stay within the safety of Flarine.
dialogsDecline.de: Das Leren Gebirge ist ein gefährlicher Ort. Ich kann es dir nicht verüblen, in der Sicherheit von Flaris bleiben zu wollen.
dialogsDecline.fi: Leren Mountains is a dangerous place. I do not blame you for wanting to stay within the safety of Flarine.
dialogsDecline.fil: Leren Mountains is a dangerous place. I do not blame you for wanting to stay within the safety of Flarine.
dialogsDecline.fr: Les monts Leren sont un endroit dangereux. Je ne vous reproche pas de vouloir rester à l'abri à Flarine.
dialogsDecline.id: Leren Mountain adalah tempat yang berbahaya. Saya tidak menyalahkan Anda karena ingin tetap berada dalam keamanan Flarine.
dialogsDecline.it: Leren Mountains is a dangerous place. I do not blame you for wanting to stay within the safety of Flarine.
dialogsDecline.jp: レレン山脈は危険な場所です。私はあなたがフラリスの安全の中にとどまりたいと思っていることを責めません。
dialogsDecline.kr: 레르엔 산맥은 위험한 곳이죠. 안전한 플라리네에 머물고 싶다고 하시면 어쩔 수 없죠.

dialogsDecline.sp: Las Montañas Leren son un lugar peligroso. No te culpo por querer permanecer dentro de la seguridad de Flarine.
dialogsDecline.sw: Leren Mountains is a dangerous place. I do not blame you for wanting to stay within the safety of Flarine.
dialogsDecline.th: Leren Mountains เป็นสถานที่อันตราย ข้าไม่โทษเจ้าหรอกที่เจ้าอยากจะอยู่ในสถานที่ปลอดภัยแบบ Flarine น่ะ
dialogsDecline.tw: 勒倫山脈是很危險的地方。你想待在布拉里斯的安全範圍裡，我也能理解。
dialogsDecline.vi: Leren Mountains là một nơi nguy hiểm. Tôi không đổ lỗi cho bạn vì muốn ở trong sự an toàn của Flarine.

dialogsComplete.jp: おや。。市長があなたを送りました!そして彼は、レレン山脈で混乱があったと言います..

dialogsComplete.sw: Oh... the Mayor sent you! And he says that there has been a disturbance in the Leren Mountains...
dialogsComplete.th: โอ้ นายกเทศมนตรีส่งเจ้ามา! และเขาบอกว่ามีเหตุวุ่นวายเกิดขึ้นที่ Leren Mountains...
dialogsComplete.tw: 喔……是市長派你來的！而且他說勒倫山脈那邊出了點騷動……
dialogsComplete.vi: Ồ .. Thị trưởng đã phái bạn đến! Ông ấy cũng nói rằng hiện đang có rắc rối xảy ra ở Leren Mountains..

dialogsBegin.en: So many mysteries still to unfold... but I believe you are now close to the heart of the catacombs.
dialogsBegin.ar: So many mysteries still to unfold... but I believe you are now close to the heart of the catacombs.
dialogsBegin.br: Ainda há tantos mistérios a serem revelados... Mas acredito que você esteja próximo(a) do coração das catacumbas.
dialogsBegin.cns: So many mysteries still to unfold... but I believe you are now close to the heart of the catacombs.
dialogsBegin.de: Es gibt noch so viele Geheimnisse zu lüften... aber ich glaube, du bist dem Herzen der Katakomben schon sehr nahe.
dialogsBegin.fi: So many mysteries still to unfold... but I believe you are now close to the heart of the catacombs.
dialogsBegin.fil: So many mysteries still to unfold... but I believe you are now close to the heart of the catacombs.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il reste tant de mystères à dévoiler... mais je crois que vous êtes maintenant près du cœur des catacombes.
dialogsBegin.id: Masih banyak misteri yang belum terkuak.. tapi aku yakin kamu sekarang dekat dengan jantung catacombs.
dialogsBegin.it: So many mysteries still to unfold... but I believe you are now close to the heart of the catacombs.
dialogsBegin.jp: まだ多くの謎が展開しています..しかし、あなたは今、カタコンベの中心に近いと思います。
dialogsBegin.kr: 아직 풀어야 할 미스터리는 많지만... 이제 지하 묘지의 중심부 가까이 온 것 같군요.
