dialogsBegin.ru: So many mysteries still to unfold... but I believe you are now close to the heart of the catacombs.
dialogsBegin.sp: Tantos misterios aún por desvelar... pero creo que ahora estás cerca del corazón de las catacumbas.
dialogsBegin.sw: So many mysteries still to unfold... but I believe you are now close to the heart of the catacombs.
dialogsBegin.th: เรื่องลึกลับมากมายยังคงไม่ถูกเปิดเผย แต่ข้าเชื่อว่าตอนนี้เจ้าได้เข้าใกล้ใจกลางแห่งสุสานแล้ว
dialogsBegin.tw: 還有好多謎團尚未揭曉……不過我相信你現在已經很接近地下墓穴的核心了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Rất nhiều điều bí ẩn vẫn chưa được khám phá.. nhưng tôi tin rằng bạn đang ở gần những hầm mộ lắm rồi.

dialogsAccept.en: Enter once more and clear out the remnant of Ishirut if you are capable of doing so. Prepare yourself before entering again, for I fear the beast within the depths of the ruins is far stronger than you could imagine.
dialogsAccept.ar: Enter once more and clear out the remnant of Ishirut if you are capable of doing so. Prepare yourself before entering again, for I fear the beast within the depths of the ruins is far stronger than you could imagine.
dialogsAccept.br: Entre mais uma vez e elimine o resquício de Ishirut, se você for capaz. Prepare-se antes de entrar novamente, pois temo que a fera que espreita nas profundezas das ruínas seja incrivelmente poderosa.
dialogsAccept.cns: Enter once more and clear out the remnant of Ishirut if you are capable of doing so. Prepare yourself before entering again, for I fear the beast within the depths of the ruins is far stronger than you could imagine.
dialogsAccept.de: Geh noch einmal hinein und räume die Überreste von Ishirut aus, wenn du dazu in der Lage bist. Bereite dich vor, bevor du wieder eintrittst, denn ich fürchte, die Bestie in den Tiefen der Ruinen ist viel stärker, als du dir vorstellen kannst.
dialogsAccept.fi: Enter once more and clear out the remnant of Ishirut if you are capable of doing so. Prepare yourself before entering again, for I fear the beast within the depths of the ruins is far stronger than you could imagine.
dialogsAccept.fil: Enter once more and clear out the remnant of Ishirut if you are capable of doing so. Prepare yourself before entering again, for I fear the beast within the depths of the ruins is far stronger than you could imagine.
dialogsAccept.fr: Entrez une fois de plus et éliminez les vestiges d'Ishirut si vous en êtes capables. Préparez-vous avant d'entrer à nouveau, car je crains que la bête qui se trouve dans les profondeurs des ruines ne soit bien plus forte que vous ne l'imaginez.
dialogsAccept.id: Masuk sekali lagi dan bersihkan sisa-sisa Ishirut jika Anda mampu melakukannya. Persiapkan diri Anda sebelum masuk lagi, karena saya khawatir binatang buas di kedalaman reruntuhan jauh lebih kuat dari yang Anda bayangkan.
dialogsAccept.it: Enter once more and clear out the remnant of Ishirut if you are capable of doing so. Prepare yourself before entering again, for I fear the beast within the depths of the ruins is far stronger than you could imagine.
dialogsAccept.jp: もう一度入り、イシルトの残党を片付ければ、そうすることができます。再び入る前に準備をしてください、廃墟の奥にいる獣はあなたが想像できるよりもはるかに強いのではないかと私は恐れているからです。
dialogsAccept.kr: 할 수 있다면 다시 한번 들어가서 이실루트의 추종 세력을 제거하세요. 폐허 깊숙한 곳에 도사린 괴물은 상상 이상으로 강하니, 다시 들어가기 전에 마음의 준비를 단단히 하세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Enter once more and clear out the remnant of Ishirut if you are capable of doing so. Prepare yourself before entering again, for I fear the beast within the depths of the ruins is far stronger than you could imagine.
dialogsAccept.pl: Enter once more and clear out the remnant of Ishirut if you are capable of doing so. Prepare yourself before entering again, for I fear the beast within the depths of the ruins is far stronger than you could imagine.
dialogsAccept.ru: Enter once more and clear out the remnant of Ishirut if you are capable of doing so. Prepare yourself before entering again, for I fear the beast within the depths of the ruins is far stronger than you could imagine.
dialogsAccept.sp: Entra una vez más y limpia los restos de Ishirut si eres capaz de hacerlo. Prepárate antes de volver a entrar, pues me temo que la bestia que habita en las profundidades de las ruinas es mucho más fuerte de lo que puedas imaginar.
dialogsAccept.sw: Enter once more and clear out the remnant of Ishirut if you are capable of doing so. Prepare yourself before entering again, for I fear the beast within the depths of the ruins is far stronger than you could imagine.
dialogsAccept.th: เข้าไปอีกครั้งและจัดการเศษซากของ Ishirut ให้หมดถ้าเจ้าทำได้ เตรียมตัวให้พร้อมก่อนที่จะเข้าไปอีกครั้ง ข้าเกรงว่ายิ่งลึกเข้าไปสัตว์ร้ายด้านในจะยิ่งแข็งแกร่งเกินกว่าที่เจ้าจะจินตนาการได้
dialogsAccept.tw: 如果你有能力的話，就再進去一次，清除伊希魯特的殘響吧。不過在再次進入前，務必要做好萬全準備，因為我擔心遺跡深處那頭野獸比你想像中還要強大得多。
dialogsAccept.vi: Đi vào một lần nữa và dọn sạch remnant of Ishirut nếu bạn có khả năng. Hãy chuẩn bị tinh thần trước khi bước vào lần nữa, vì tôi e rằng con quái vật ở sâu trong đống đổ nát còn mạnh hơn nhiều so với tưởng tượng.

dialogsDecline.en: After all this effort... now is when you back away from danger?
dialogsDecline.ar: After all this effort... now is when you back away from danger?
dialogsDecline.br: Depois de todo esse esforço... agora é quando você vai recuar diante do perigo?
dialogsDecline.cns: After all this effort... now is when you back away from danger?
dialogsDecline.de: Nach all diesen Anstrengungen... ist das der Zeitpunkt, an dem du vor der Gefahr zurückschreckst?
dialogsDecline.fi: After all this effort... now is when you back away from danger?
dialogsDecline.fil: After all this effort... now is when you back away from danger?
dialogsDecline.fr: Après tous ces efforts, c'est maintenant que vous reculez devant le danger ?
dialogsDecline.id: Setelah semua upaya ini.. sekarang saatnya kamu mundur dari bahaya?
dialogsDecline.it: After all this effort... now is when you back away from danger?
dialogsDecline.jp: このすべての努力の後..今はあなたが危険から離れるときですか?
dialogsDecline.kr: 그동안 그렇게 노력하고도... 지금 와서 위험하니 물러나시겠단 말인가요?
dialogsDecline.nl: After all this effort... now is when you back away from danger?
dialogsDecline.pl: After all this effort... now is when you back away from danger?
dialogsDecline.ru: After all this effort... now is when you back away from danger?
dialogsDecline.sp: Después de todo este esfuerzo... ¿Ahora es cuando te alejas del peligro?
dialogsDecline.sw: After all this effort... now is when you back away from danger?
dialogsDecline.th: ทั้งๆ ที่พยายามมาขนาดนี้ แต่ตอนนี้เจ้าอยากจะหันหลังหนีจากอันตรายซะอย่างนั้น?
dialogsDecline.tw: 努力到這一步了……你現在才想退縮？
dialogsDecline.vi: Sau tất cả những nỗ lực này.. bây giờ là lúc bạn lùi lại trước hiểm nguy à?

dialogsComplete.en: What you have uncovered has tremendous impact on our knowledge of the past! Congratulations on making it through the deadly Rhisis Catacombs, and uncovering the secrets of the past.
dialogsComplete.ar: What you have uncovered has tremendous impact on our knowledge of the past! Congratulations on making it through the deadly Rhisis Catacombs, and uncovering the secrets of the past.
dialogsComplete.br: O que você descobriu tem um impacto tremendo em nosso conhecimento do passado! Parabéns por sobreviver às temíveis Catacumbas de Rhisis e revelar os segredos há muito guardados.
dialogsComplete.cns: What you have uncovered has tremendous impact on our knowledge of the past! Congratulations on making it through the deadly Rhisis Catacombs, and uncovering the secrets of the past.
dialogsComplete.de: Was du aufgedeckt hast, hat enorme Auswirkungen auf unser Wissen über die Vergangenheit! Herzlichen Glückwunsch, dass du es durch die tödlichen Katakomben von Rhisis geschafft und die Geheimnisse der Vergangenheit gelüftet hast.
dialogsComplete.fi: What you have uncovered has tremendous impact on our knowledge of the past! Congratulations on making it through the deadly Rhisis Catacombs, and uncovering the secrets of the past.
dialogsComplete.fil: What you have uncovered has tremendous impact on our knowledge of the past! Congratulations on making it through the deadly Rhisis Catacombs, and uncovering the secrets of the past.
dialogsComplete.fr: Ce que vous avez découvert a un impact considérable sur notre connaissance du passé ! Félicitations pour avoir réussi à traverser les Catacombes Mortelles de Rhisis et à découvrir les secrets du passé.
dialogsComplete.id: Apa yang telah Anda temukan berdampak luar biasa pada pengetahuan kita tentang masa lalu! Selamat telah berhasil melewati Rhisis Catacombs yang mematikan, dan mengungkap rahasia masa lalu.
dialogsComplete.it: What you have uncovered has tremendous impact on our knowledge of the past! Congratulations on making it through the deadly Rhisis Catacombs, and uncovering the secrets of the past.
dialogsComplete.jp: あなたが発見したことは、過去の私たちの知識に多大な影響を及ぼします!致命的なリシスカタコンベを通り抜け、過去の秘密を明らかにしたことおめでとうございます。
dialogsComplete.kr: 당신의 발견이 우리의 과거 지식에 엄청난 영향을 미쳤어요! 위험천만한 리시스 지하 묘지를 통과하고, 과거의 비밀까지 밝혀내신 것을 축하합니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: What you have uncovered has tremendous impact on our knowledge of the past! Congratulations on making it through the deadly Rhisis Catacombs, and uncovering the secrets of the past.
dialogsComplete.pl: What you have uncovered has tremendous impact on our knowledge of the past! Congratulations on making it through the deadly Rhisis Catacombs, and uncovering the secrets of the past.
dialogsComplete.ru: What you have uncovered has tremendous impact on our knowledge of the past! Congratulations on making it through the deadly Rhisis Catacombs, and uncovering the secrets of the past.
dialogsComplete.sp: Lo que has descubierto tiene un impacto tremendo en nuestro conocimiento del pasado. Enhorabuena por atravesar las mortíferas catacumbas de Rhisis y descubrir los secretos del pasado.
dialogsComplete.sw: What you have uncovered has tremendous impact on our knowledge of the past! Congratulations on making it through the deadly Rhisis Catacombs, and uncovering the secrets of the past.
dialogsComplete.th: สิ่งที่เจ้าค้นพบมันได้เปลี่ยนแปลงความรุ้จากอดิตไปอย่างมาก ยินดีด้วยที่เจ้าได้ฝ่าฟัน Rhisis Catacombs ได้สำเร็จ และสามารถไขความลับแห่งอดีตได้
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的發現對我們對過去的認識產生了巨大的影響！恭喜你成功穿越致命的黎席斯墓窟，並揭開了過去的秘密。
dialogsComplete.vi: Những gì bạn đã phát hiện ra có tác động to lớn đến kiến ​​​​thức của chúng ta về quá khứ! Chúc mừng bạn đã vượt qua Rhisis Catacombs chết chóc và khám phá những bí mật của quá khứ.

dialogsComplete.en: Based on the evidence you have gathered, we believe that the Rhisis Catacombs were once a holy ground for the god of earth, Shelid.
dialogsComplete.ar: Based on the evidence you have gathered, we believe that the Rhisis Catacombs were once a holy ground for the god of earth, Shelid.
dialogsComplete.br: Com base nas provas que você coletou, acreditamos que as Catacumbas de Rhisis eram um lugar sagrado dedicado ao deus da terra, Shelid!
dialogsComplete.cns: Based on the evidence you have gathered, we believe that the Rhisis Catacombs were once a holy ground for the god of earth, Shelid.
dialogsComplete.de: Aufgrund der Beweise, die du gesammelt hast, glauben wir, dass die Katakomben von Rhisis einst ein heiliger Ort für den Gott der Erde, Shelid, waren.
dialogsComplete.fi: Based on the evidence you have gathered, we believe that the Rhisis Catacombs were once a holy ground for the god of earth, Shelid.
dialogsComplete.fil: Based on the evidence you have gathered, we believe that the Rhisis Catacombs were once a holy ground for the god of earth, Shelid.
dialogsComplete.fr: D'après les preuves que vous avez recueillies, nous pensons que les Catacombes de Rhisis étaient autrefois une terre sacrée pour le dieu de la terre, Shelid.
dialogsComplete.id: Berdasarkan bukti yang telah Anda kumpulkan, kami percaya bahwa Rhisis Catacombs pernah menjadi tempat suci bagi dewa bumi, Shelid.
dialogsComplete.it: Based on the evidence you have gathered, we believe that the Rhisis Catacombs were once a holy ground for the god of earth, Shelid.
dialogsComplete.jp: あなたが集めた証拠に基づいて、私たちはリシスカタコンベがかつて地球の神シェリドの聖地であったと信じています。
dialogsComplete.kr: 당신이 모아 온 증거에 따르면, 리시스 지하 묘지는 한때 대지의 신 셸리드의 성지였던 것으로 보입니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Based on the evidence you have gathered, we believe that the Rhisis Catacombs were once a holy ground for the god of earth, Shelid.
dialogsComplete.pl: Based on the evidence you have gathered, we believe that the Rhisis Catacombs were once a holy ground for the god of earth, Shelid.
dialogsComplete.ru: Based on the evidence you have gathered, we believe that the Rhisis Catacombs were once a holy ground for the god of earth, Shelid.
dialogsComplete.sp: Basándonos en las pruebas que has reunido, creemos que las Catacumbas de Rhisis fueron una vez tierra sagrada para el dios de la tierra, Shelid.
dialogsComplete.sw: Based on the evidence you have gathered, we believe that the Rhisis Catacombs were once a holy ground for the god of earth, Shelid.
dialogsComplete.th: จากหลักฐานที่เจ้าได้รวบรวมมา เราเชื่อว่า Rhisis Catacombs เคยเป็นสถานที่ศักดิ์สิทธิ์ของเทพแห่งดิน Shelid
dialogsComplete.tw: 根據你收集到的證據，我們相信黎席斯墓窟曾經是大地之神謝莉德的聖地。
dialogsComplete.vi: Dựa trên những bằng chứng mà bạn đã thu thập được, chúng tôi tin rằng Rhisis Catacombs đã từng là thánh địa của thần đất, Shelid.

dialogsComplete.en: Along the way, a feud between Shelid and Ishirut must have occurred, leaving behind remnants of both gods that empowered the masquerpets that would eventually call the catacombs their home.
dialogsComplete.ar: Along the way, a feud between Shelid and Ishirut must have occurred, leaving behind remnants of both gods that empowered the masquerpets that would eventually call the catacombs their home.
dialogsComplete.br: Ao longo do caminho, uma disputa entre Shelid e Ishirut deve ter ocorrido, deixando para trás vestígios de ambos os deuses que concederam poder aos masquerpets que acabaram fazendo das catacumbas o seu lar.
dialogsComplete.cns: Along the way, a feud between Shelid and Ishirut must have occurred, leaving behind remnants of both gods that empowered the masquerpets that would eventually call the catacombs their home.
dialogsComplete.de: Auf dem Weg dorthin muss es zu einer Fehde zwischen Shelid und Ishirut gekommen sein, bei der Überreste beider Götter zurückblieben, die den Masquerpets, die die Katakomben schließlich ihr Zuhause nannten, Kraft verliehen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Along the way, a feud between Shelid and Ishirut must have occurred, leaving behind remnants of both gods that empowered the masquerpets that would eventually call the catacombs their home.
dialogsComplete.fil: Along the way, a feud between Shelid and Ishirut must have occurred, leaving behind remnants of both gods that empowered the masquerpets that would eventually call the catacombs their home.
dialogsComplete.fr: En cours de route, une querelle entre Shelid et Ishirut a dû avoir lieu, laissant derrière elle des vestiges des deux dieux qui ont donné du pouvoir aux masquerpets qui ont fini par élire domicile dans les catacombes.
dialogsComplete.id: Sepanjang jalan, perseteruan antara Shelid dan Ishirut pasti terjadi, meninggalkan sisa-sisa kedua dewa yang memberdayakan para penyamar yang pada akhirnya akan menyebut catacombs sebagai rumah mereka.
dialogsComplete.it: Along the way, a feud between Shelid and Ishirut must have occurred, leaving behind remnants of both gods that empowered the masquerpets that would eventually call the catacombs their home.
dialogsComplete.jp: 途中で、シェリドとイシルトの間で確執が起こり、最終的にカタコンベを彼らの家と呼ぶことになる仮面舞踏会に力を与えた両方の神の残骸を残したに違いありません。
dialogsComplete.kr: 그 과정에서, 셸리드와 이실루트 사이에 불화가 생겼던 모양입니다. 각 신의 추종 세력들이 마스커펫에게 힘을 주었고, 결국 지하 묘지를 집으로 부르며 살아가게 된 것이죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: Along the way, a feud between Shelid and Ishirut must have occurred, leaving behind remnants of both gods that empowered the masquerpets that would eventually call the catacombs their home.
dialogsComplete.pl: Along the way, a feud between Shelid and Ishirut must have occurred, leaving behind remnants of both gods that empowered the masquerpets that would eventually call the catacombs their home.
dialogsComplete.ru: Along the way, a feud between Shelid and Ishirut must have occurred, leaving behind remnants of both gods that empowered the masquerpets that would eventually call the catacombs their home.
dialogsComplete.sp: Por el camino, debió de producirse una disputa entre Shelid e Ishirut, dejando tras de sí restos de ambos dioses que dieron poder a los masquerpets que acabarían llamando a las catacumbas su hogar.
dialogsComplete.sw: Along the way, a feud between Shelid and Ishirut must have occurred, leaving behind remnants of both gods that empowered the masquerpets that would eventually call the catacombs their home.
dialogsComplete.th: ที่ผ่านมานั้น ความบาดหมางระหว่าง Shelid และ Ishirut ต้องเกิดขึ้นมาแน่นอน ทิ้งไว้ก็แต่เพียงเศษเสี้ยวของเทพทั้งสอง ที่ทำให้พวก masquerpets นั้นได้เรียนสุสานแห่งนี้ว่าเป็นบ้านของพวกมัน
dialogsComplete.tw: 看來在這一路上，謝莉德與伊希魯特之間一定發生過衝突，才會留下兩位神的殘響，強化了後來以地下墓穴為巢的那些怪物。
dialogsComplete.vi: Trên đường đi, một mối thù giữa Shelid và Ishirut hẳn đã xảy ra, để lại tàn tích của cả hai vị thần đã cho phép masquerpets gọi hầm mộ là nhà của họ.

dialogsFail.en: Eliminate the remnant of Ishirut and anything in your way to get there.
dialogsFail.ar: Eliminate the remnant of Ishirut and anything in your way to get there.
dialogsFail.br: Elimine o resquício de Ishirut e qualquer coisa que esteja em seu caminho para chegar lá.
dialogsFail.cns: Eliminate the remnant of Ishirut and anything in your way to get there.
dialogsFail.de: Vernichte die Überreste von Ishirut und alles, was sich dir in den Weg stellt, um dorthin zu gelangen.
dialogsFail.fi: Eliminate the remnant of Ishirut and anything in your way to get there.
dialogsFail.fil: Eliminate the remnant of Ishirut and anything in your way to get there.
dialogsFail.fr: Éliminez les vestiges d'Ishirut et tout ce qui se trouve sur votre chemin pour y parvenir.
dialogsFail.id: Singkirkan sisa-sisa Ishirut dan apa pun yang menghalangi Anda untuk sampai ke sana.
dialogsFail.it: Eliminate the remnant of Ishirut and anything in your way to get there.
dialogsFail.jp: イシルトの残党とそこにたどり着くためにあなたの邪魔なものを排除してください。
dialogsFail.kr: 이실루트의 추종 세력과, 거기로 가는 길을 막는 것을 모두 제거하세요.
dialogsFail.nl: Eliminate the remnant of Ishirut and anything in your way to get there.
dialogsFail.pl: Eliminate the remnant of Ishirut and anything in your way to get there.
dialogsFail.ru: Eliminate the remnant of Ishirut and anything in your way to get there.
dialogsFail.sp: Elimina los restos de Ishirut y todo lo que se interponga en tu camino para llegar allí.
dialogsFail.sw: Eliminate the remnant of Ishirut and anything in your way to get there.
dialogsFail.th: กำจัดเศษเสี้ยวของ Ishirut และอะไรก็ตามที่ขวางทางคุณที่จะไปสู่ที่นั่น
dialogsFail.tw: 擊敗伊希魯特的殘響，以及所有阻擋你去路的敵人。
dialogsFail.vi: Loại bỏ remnant of Ishirut và bất cứ thứ gì cản đường bạn đến đó.

dialogsBegin.en: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.ar: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.br: Bem-vindo de volta aventureiro! Há relatos de uma nova ameaça na Torre Abandonada. Procure e livre-se de $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.cns: 欢迎回来，英雄！据报告，深渊之塔中出现了新的威胁。请前去找到并消灭 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$
dialogsBegin.de: Willkommen zurück, Held! Berichte zufolge wartet im Verlassenen Turm eine neue Bedrohung. Suche und töte die $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fi: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fil: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.fr: Content de te revoir, héros ! Des rapports indiquent la présence d'une nouvelle menace dans la Tour Oubliée. S'il te plaît, cherche et élimine le $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.id: Selamat datang kembali pahlawan! Ada laporan ancaman baru di Forsaken Tower. Silakan cari dan singkirkan $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.it: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.jp: おかえりヒーロー！忘却の塔に新たな脅威の報告がありました。$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を探して一掃してきてください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 돌아온 걸 환영해요, 용사님! 버려진 탑에 위협이 발생했다는 보고를 받았어요. 버려진 탑에서 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$을(를) 찾아 없애주세요.

dialogsBegin.sw: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.th: ยินดีต้อนรับกลับมาฮีโร่! มีรายงานมาว่าพบกันอันตรายใหม่เกิดขึ้นที่ Forsaken Tower โปรดไปค้นหาและทำลาย $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ ให้สิ้นซาก

dialogsDecline.en: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.

dialogsDecline.th: Tower เต็มไปด้วย masquerpets ที่อันตราย ข้าเข้าใจดีถ้าเจ้าไม่อยากเสี่ยงอันตราย

dialogsBegin.en: After all that seafood I couldn't eat another bite! For this next invention, I need $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the large crabs called Creper. From their hard carapace I will craft the strongest of armors. I forsee a fate in which doning this armor will save Coral Island!
dialogsBegin.ar: After all that seafood I couldn't eat another bite! For this next invention, I need $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the large crabs called Creper. From their hard carapace I will craft the strongest of armors. I forsee a fate in which doning this armor will save Coral Island!
dialogsBegin.br: Depois de todo esse fruto do mar, não consigo comer mais uma mordida! Para esta próxima invenção, preciso de $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ dos grandes caranguejos chamados Creper. De suas duras carapaças, eu farei a armadura mais forte. Prevejo um destino em que usar essa armadura salvará a Ilha de Coral!
dialogsBegin.cns: After all that seafood I couldn't eat another bite! For this next invention, I need $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the large crabs called Creper. From their hard carapace I will craft the strongest of armors. I forsee a fate in which doning this armor will save Coral Island!
dialogsBegin.de: Nach all den Meeresfrüchten konnte ich keinen Bissen mehr essen! Für die nächste Erfindung brauche ich $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ von den großen Krabben namens Creper. Aus ihrem harten Panzer werde ich die stärkste aller Rüstungen herstellen. Ich sehe ein Schicksal voraus, in dem das Anlegen dieser Rüstung die Koralleninsel retten wird!
dialogsBegin.fi: After all that seafood I couldn't eat another bite! For this next invention, I need $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the large crabs called Creper. From their hard carapace I will craft the strongest of armors. I forsee a fate in which doning this armor will save Coral Island!
dialogsBegin.fil: Pagkatapos ng lahat ng pagkaing-dagat hindi ko na kinaya kumain pa ng isa pang kagat! Para sa susunod kong imbensyon, kailangan ko ng $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ mula sa malalaking alimangong tinatawag na Creper. Mula sa matigas nilang baluti gagawa ako ng pinakamatatag na baluti—baka sakaling mailigtas nito ang Coral Island!
dialogsBegin.fr: Je vais exploser après tous ces fruits de mer ! Pour ma prochaine invention, j'ai besoin de $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ provenant des gros crabes appelés Pincedure. De leur carapace dure, je fabriquerai la plus solide des armures. J'imagine que cette armure sauvera l'Île Corail !
dialogsBegin.id: Setelah semua makanan laut itu, aku tidak bisa makan lagi! Untuk penemuan berikutnya, aku memerlukan $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ dari kepiting besar bernama Creper. Dari karapasnya yang keras aku akan membuat baju zirah yang paling kuat. Aku meramalkan nasib di mana mengenakan baju besi ini akan menyelamatkan Coral Island!
dialogsBegin.it: After all that seafood I couldn't eat another bite! For this next invention, I need $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the large crabs called Creper. From their hard carapace I will craft the strongest of armors. I forsee a fate in which doning this armor will save Coral Island!
dialogsBegin.jp: あれだけの魚介類を食べた後、もう一口食べられませんでした!この次の発明のために、クリーパーという大きなカニの$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$が必要です。奴らの硬い甲殻から最強の鎧を作ろう。この鎧を身に着けることで珊瑚島が救われる運命を予見する!
dialogsBegin.kr: 해산물을 그렇게 먹었더니 더는 아무것도 못 먹겠어요! 다음 발명품을 만들려면 크리퍼라는 큰 게의 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$이(가) 필요해요. 딱딱한 딱지로 강력한 방어구를 만들려고요. 그 방어구를 입으면 코랄 아일랜드를 구할 수 있는 운명이 되겠죠!
dialogsBegin.nl: After all that seafood I couldn't eat another bite! For this next invention, I need $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the large crabs called Creper. From their hard carapace I will craft the strongest of armors. I forsee a fate in which doning this armor will save Coral Island!
dialogsBegin.pl: After all that seafood I couldn't eat another bite! For this next invention, I need $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the large crabs called Creper. From their hard carapace I will craft the strongest of armors. I forsee a fate in which doning this armor will save Coral Island!
dialogsBegin.ru: After all that seafood I couldn't eat another bite! For this next invention, I need $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the large crabs called Creper. From their hard carapace I will craft the strongest of armors. I forsee a fate in which doning this armor will save Coral Island!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Después de todo ese marisco no pude comer más! Para este próximo invento, necesito $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ de los cangrejos grandes llamados Creper. Con su duro caparazón crearé las armaduras más fuertes. ¡Preveo que usar esta armadura salvará Isla Coral!
dialogsBegin.sw: After all that seafood I couldn't eat another bite! For this next invention, I need $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the large crabs called Creper. From their hard carapace I will craft the strongest of armors. I forsee a fate in which doning this armor will save Coral Island!
dialogsBegin.th: หลังจากกินอาหารทะเลหมดแล้ว ฉันก็กินอะไรไม่ได้อีกเลย! สำหรับการประดิษฐ์ครั้งต่อไป ฉันต้องการ $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ จากปูตัวใหญ่ที่ชื่อว่า Creper ฉันจะประดิษฐ์ชุดเกราะที่แข็งแกร่งที่สุดจากกระดองที่แข็งของมัน ฉันคิดว่าเกราะนี้จะช่วยเกาะ Coral Island ได้!
dialogsBegin.tw: 吃了那麼多海鮮後，我一口都吃不下了！不過為了下一個發明，我需要來自大螃蟹克雷普的 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$。我要用牠們堅硬的甲殼打造最堅固的盔甲。我已經預見，穿上這套盔甲的命運將會拯救珊瑚島！
dialogsBegin.vi: Sau khi ăn một đống hải sản đó tôi đã ngán tận cổ rồi! Với phát minh tiếp theo, tôi cần $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ từ những con cua bự gọi là Creper. Từ cái mai cứng của chúng tôi có thể chế tác ra những bộ giáp mạnh nhất. Tôi nhìn thấy được một tương lai nơi việc chế tạo bộ giáp này sẽ cứu rỗi Coral Island rồi đó!

dialogsComplete.en: Hopefully soon our village can sleep without keeping one eye open.
dialogsComplete.ar: Hopefully soon our village can sleep without keeping one eye open.
dialogsComplete.br: Espero que em breve nossa vila possa dormir sem manter um olho aberto.
dialogsComplete.cns: 但愿很快，我们村里的人就能安心睡觉，不用再时刻提心吊胆了。

dialogsComplete.fil: Hopefully soon our village can sleep without keeping one eye open.
dialogsComplete.fr: Espérons que notre village pourra bientôt dormir les yeux fermés.
dialogsComplete.id: Semoga segera desa kami bisa tidur tanpa membuka satu mata pun.
dialogsComplete.it: Hopefully soon our village can sleep without keeping one eye open.
dialogsComplete.jp: 願わくば、早く私たちの村が片目を開けずに眠れるようになることを願っています。

dialogsComplete.pl: Hopefully soon our village can sleep without keeping one eye open.
dialogsComplete.ru: Hopefully soon our village can sleep without keeping one eye open.

dialogsComplete.sw: Hopefully soon our village can sleep without keeping one eye open.

dialogsComplete.en: With these items I can perform the ritual to read from the fabric of time. We will finally know the true meaning of these storms!

dialogsBegin.cns: 这场战斗需要我们倾尽所有力量。如果你能活着离开，就回到达肯，把这里发生的一切告知城主。
dialogsBegin.de: Dieser Kampf wird uns alle Kraft abverlangen, die wir aufbringen können. Wenn du es lebendig überstehst, geh zurück nach Darken City und informiere den Bürgermeister über alles, was hier passiert ist.
dialogsBegin.fi: This battle will take all the strength we can muster. If you make it out alive, go back to Darken City, and let the mayor know about all that happened here.
dialogsBegin.fil: This battle will take all the strength we can muster. If you make it out alive, go back to Darken City, and let the mayor know about all that happened here.
dialogsBegin.fr: Cette bataille nécessitera toutes les forces que nous pourrons rassembler. Si vous survivez, retournez à Darken et informez le maire de tout ce qui s'est passé ici.
dialogsBegin.id: Pertarungan ini akan membutuhkan seluruh kekuatan yang bisa kita kumpulkan. Jika kamu berhasil keluar hidup-hidup, kembalilah ke Darken City, dan beri tahu walikota tentang semua yang terjadi di sini.
dialogsBegin.it: This battle will take all the strength we can muster. If you make it out alive, go back to Darken City, and let the mayor know about all that happened here.
dialogsBegin.jp: この戦いには全力を尽くす必要があります。生きて帰れたら、ダーコンシティへ戻って、ここで起こったことを市長に知らせてください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 전투를 위해선 우리 모두 최대한 힘을 모아야 해요. 살아남는다면 다켄 시티로 돌아가, 시장님께 여기서 일어난 모든 일을 알려주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: This battle will take all the strength we can muster. If you make it out alive, go back to Darken City, and let the mayor know about all that happened here.
dialogsBegin.pl: This battle will take all the strength we can muster. If you make it out alive, go back to Darken City, and let the mayor know about all that happened here.
dialogsBegin.ru: This battle will take all the strength we can muster. If you make it out alive, go back to Darken City, and let the mayor know about all that happened here.
dialogsBegin.sp: Esta batalla requerirá toda la fuerza que podamos reunir. Si sales con vida, regresa a Ciudad Darken e informa al alcalde de todo lo que sucedió aquí.
dialogsBegin.sw: This battle will take all the strength we can muster. If you make it out alive, go back to Darken City, and let the mayor know about all that happened here.
dialogsBegin.th: การต่อสู้ครั้งนี้ต้องใช้ความแข็งแกร่งทั้งหมดที่มี หากคุณสามารถเอาชีวิตรอดได้ ให้กลับไปที่เมือง Darken และแจ้งให้ผู้ว่าการเมืองทราบเกี่ยวกับเหตุการณ์ทั้งหมดที่เกิดขึ้นที่นี่
dialogsBegin.tw: 這場戰鬥需要我們傾盡所有力量。如果你能活著回來，就回得肯城，把這裡發生的一切告訴市長。
dialogsBegin.vi: Trận chiến này sẽ lấy hết sức mạnh mà chúng ta có thể tập hợp được. Nếu bạn còn sống sót, hãy quay lại Darken City và cho thị trưởng biết về tất cả những gì đã xảy ra ở đây.

dialogsAccept.en: The only path forward to end the curse of the Sea King is to slay the beast in its lair. Go forth and do the deed, for Coral Island!
dialogsAccept.ar: The only path forward to end the curse of the Sea King is to slay the beast in its lair. Go forth and do the deed, for Coral Island!
dialogsAccept.br: O único caminho para acabar com a maldição do Rei do Mar é matar a besta em seu covil. Vá e faça a tarefa, pela Ilha de Coral!
dialogsAccept.cns: 想要终结海王的诅咒，唯一的前路就是前往它的巢穴斩杀这头巨兽。为了珊瑚岛，挺身而出，完成这使命吧！
dialogsAccept.de: Der einzige Weg, den Fluch des Meereskönigs zu beenden, besteht darin, die Bestie in ihrer Höhle zu erschlagen. Geh und tu es, für die Koralleninsel!
dialogsAccept.fi: The only path forward to end the curse of the Sea King is to slay the beast in its lair. Go forth and do the deed, for Coral Island!
dialogsAccept.fil: The only path forward to end the curse of the Sea King is to slay the beast in its lair. Go forth and do the deed, for Coral Island!
dialogsAccept.fr: Le seul moyen de mettre fin à la malédiction du Roi des mers est de tuer la bête dans son repaire. Allez-y et accomplissez votre mission, pour l'Île Corail !
dialogsAccept.id: Satu-satunya jalan untuk mengakhiri kutukan Sea King adalah dengan membunuh binatang itu di sarangnya. Majulah dan lakukan perbuatanmu, demi Coral Island!
dialogsAccept.it: The only path forward to end the curse of the Sea King is to slay the beast in its lair. Go forth and do the deed, for Coral Island!
dialogsAccept.jp: 海王の呪いを終わらせる唯一の道は、その隠れ家で獣を殺すことです。さあ、珊瑚の島のために行え!
dialogsAccept.kr: 바다 왕의 저주를 끝낼 수 있는 유일한 방법은, 은신처로 찾아가 그 괴물을 죽이는 것뿐이죠. 코랄 아일랜드를 위해, 꼭 이기고 돌아오세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: The only path forward to end the curse of the Sea King is to slay the beast in its lair. Go forth and do the deed, for Coral Island!
dialogsAccept.pl: The only path forward to end the curse of the Sea King is to slay the beast in its lair. Go forth and do the deed, for Coral Island!
dialogsAccept.ru: The only path forward to end the curse of the Sea King is to slay the beast in its lair. Go forth and do the deed, for Coral Island!
dialogsAccept.sp: El única forma de poner fin a la maldición del Rey del Mar es matar a la bestia en su guarida. ¡Adelante, hazlo por Isla Coral!
dialogsAccept.sw: The only path forward to end the curse of the Sea King is to slay the beast in its lair. Go forth and do the deed, for Coral Island!
dialogsAccept.th: ทางเดียวที่จะยุติคำสาปของ Sea King ได้คือต้องสังหารสัตว์ร้ายในถ้ำของมัน โปรดสู้เพื่อ Coral Island!!
dialogsAccept.tw: 要終結海王詛咒的唯一方法，就是在牠的巢穴中將其斬殺。為了珊瑚島，前去完成這件事吧！
dialogsAccept.vi: Con đường duy nhất để chấm dứt lời nguyền của Vua Biển là giết chết con quái vật trong hang ổ của nó. Hãy tiến lên và thực hiện hành động đó vì Coral Island!

dialogsDecline.en: Those who lose their mind to the Sea King are said to become faceless.
dialogsDecline.ar: Those who lose their mind to the Sea King are said to become faceless.
dialogsDecline.br: Dizem que aqueles que perdem a mente para o Rei do Mar se tornam sem rosto.
dialogsDecline.cns: 那些被海王夺走心智的人，据说都会变成无面者。
dialogsDecline.de: Es heißt, dass diejenigen, die ihren Verstand an den Meereskönig verlieren, gesichtslos werden.
dialogsDecline.fi: Those who lose their mind to the Sea King are said to become faceless.
dialogsDecline.fil: Those who lose their mind to the Sea King are said to become faceless.
dialogsDecline.fr: On dit que ceux qui perdent la raison à cause du Roi des mers deviennent sans visage.
dialogsDecline.id: Mereka yang kehilangan akal sehatnya karena Sea King dikatakan tidak berwajah.
dialogsDecline.it: Those who lose their mind to the Sea King are said to become faceless.
dialogsDecline.jp: 海王に正気を失った者は、顔が見えなくなるといわれています。
dialogsDecline.kr: 바다의 왕에게 홀려 넋을 잃은 사람은 얼굴이 없어진다고 해요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Those who lose their mind to the Sea King are said to become faceless.
dialogsDecline.pl: Those who lose their mind to the Sea King are said to become faceless.
dialogsDecline.ru: Those who lose their mind to the Sea King are said to become faceless.
dialogsDecline.sp: Se dice que aquellos que pierden la cabeza ante el Rey del Mar se quedan sin rostro.
dialogsDecline.sw: Those who lose their mind to the Sea King are said to become faceless.
dialogsDecline.th: กล่าวกันว่าผู้ที่สูญเสียสติให้กับ Sea King จะกลายเป็นคนที่ไม่สามารถระบุตัวตนได้
dialogsDecline.tw: 據說凡是因海王而失去理智的人，最後都會變成無面者。
dialogsDecline.vi: Những người mất trí trước Vua Biển được cho là sẽ trở nên vô danh.

dialogsComplete.en: Welcome back from Coral Island, hero! And what a story to tell, it's true that Coral Island is a fascinating place.
dialogsComplete.ar: Welcome back from Coral Island, hero! And what a story to tell, it's true that Coral Island is a fascinating place.
dialogsComplete.br: Bem-vindo de volta da Ilha de Coral, herói! E que história para contar, é verdade que a Ilha de Coral é um lugar fascinante.
dialogsComplete.cns: 英雄，欢迎从珊瑚岛归来！你的经历真是传奇，珊瑚岛果然是个神奇之地。
dialogsComplete.de: Willkommen zurück von der Koralleninsel! Und was für ein Abenteuer! Die Koralleninsel ist in der Tat ein faszinierender Ort.
dialogsComplete.fi: Welcome back from Coral Island, hero! And what a story to tell, it's true that Coral Island is a fascinating place.
dialogsComplete.fil: Welcome back from Coral Island, hero! And what a story to tell, it's true that Coral Island is a fascinating place.
dialogsComplete.fr: Bon retour de l'Île Corail, héros ! Et quelle histoire à raconter, c'est vrai que l'Île Corail est un endroit fascinant.
dialogsComplete.id: Selamat datang kembali dari Coral Island, Pahlawan! Dan sungguh menarik untuk diceritakan, memang benar bahwa Coral Island adalah tempat yang menakjubkan.
dialogsComplete.it: Welcome back from Coral Island, hero! And what a story to tell, it's true that Coral Island is a fascinating place.
dialogsComplete.jp: 珊瑚島からおかえりなさい、ヒーロー!そして、コーラル島が魅力的な場所であることは事実です。
dialogsComplete.kr: 코랄 아일랜드에서 돌아오셨군요, 용사님! 대단한 모험을 하셨네요, 코랄 아일랜드가 정말 매력적인 곳이긴 하죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: Welcome back from Coral Island, hero! And what a story to tell, it's true that Coral Island is a fascinating place.
dialogsComplete.pl: Welcome back from Coral Island, hero! And what a story to tell, it's true that Coral Island is a fascinating place.
dialogsComplete.ru: Welcome back from Coral Island, hero! And what a story to tell, it's true that Coral Island is a fascinating place.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Bienvenido de nuevo a Isla Coral, héroe! Vaya historia que contar, realmente Isla Coral es un lugar fascinante.
dialogsComplete.sw: Welcome back from Coral Island, hero! And what a story to tell, it's true that Coral Island is a fascinating place.
dialogsComplete.th: ยินดีต้อนรับกลับจาก Coral Island,! จากที่ได้ฟังเรื่องราวมา Coral Island เป็นสถานที่ที่น่าสนใจจริงๆ
dialogsComplete.tw: 歡迎從珊瑚島歸來，英雄！而且這故事可真精彩，珊瑚島果然是個令人著迷的地方。
dialogsComplete.vi: Chào mừng trở về từ Đảo San hô, người hùng! Thật là một câu chuyện hay để kể, sự thật là Đảo San Hô là một nơi hấp dẫn

dialogsComplete.en: BoBu and the Coral Island villagers sent something by mail for you as a way to say thanks. Perhaps they were too shy to give it to you themselves!
dialogsComplete.ar: BoBu and the Coral Island villagers sent something by mail for you as a way to say thanks. Perhaps they were too shy to give it to you themselves!
dialogsComplete.br: BoBu e os moradores da Ilha de Coral enviaram algo por correio para você como forma de agradecimento. Talvez eles fossem muito tímidos para entregar pessoalmente!
dialogsComplete.cns: 波布和珊瑚岛的村民们给你寄了份邮件聊表谢意。大概是他们不好意思亲手交给你吧！
dialogsComplete.de: BoBu und die Dorfbewohner der Koralleninsel haben dir etwas per Post geschickt, um sich zu bedanken. Vielleicht waren sie zu schüchtern, es dir selbst zu geben!
dialogsComplete.fi: BoBu and the Coral Island villagers sent something by mail for you as a way to say thanks. Perhaps they were too shy to give it to you themselves!
dialogsComplete.fil: BoBu and the Coral Island villagers sent something by mail for you as a way to say thanks. Perhaps they were too shy to give it to you themselves!
dialogsComplete.fr: BoBu et les habitants de l'Île Corail vous ont envoyé quelque chose par courrier pour vous remercier. Peut-être étaient-ils trop timides pour vous le donner eux-mêmes !
dialogsComplete.id: BoBu dan penduduk desa Coral Island mengirimkan sesuatu melalui pos untukmu sebagai cara untuk mengucapkan terima kasih. Mungkin mereka terlalu malu untuk memberikannya sendiri!
dialogsComplete.it: BoBu and the Coral Island villagers sent something by mail for you as a way to say thanks. Perhaps they were too shy to give it to you themselves!
dialogsComplete.jp: ボブと珊瑚島の村人たちは、感謝の気持ちを込めてメールで送ってくれました。もしかしたら、恥ずかしがり屋で、あなた自身に渡せなかったのかもしれません。
dialogsComplete.kr: 보부와 코랄 아일랜드 마을 사람들이 감사를 담아 뭔가를 보내왔어요. 쑥스러워서 직접 전하지 못했나 봐요!
dialogsComplete.nl: BoBu and the Coral Island villagers sent something by mail for you as a way to say thanks. Perhaps they were too shy to give it to you themselves!
dialogsComplete.pl: BoBu and the Coral Island villagers sent something by mail for you as a way to say thanks. Perhaps they were too shy to give it to you themselves!
dialogsComplete.ru: BoBu and the Coral Island villagers sent something by mail for you as a way to say thanks. Perhaps they were too shy to give it to you themselves!
dialogsComplete.sp: BoBu y los aldeanos de Isla Coral te enviaron algo por correo como forma de agradecimiento. ¡Quizás fueron demasiado tímidos para dártelo ellos mismos!
dialogsComplete.sw: BoBu and the Coral Island villagers sent something by mail for you as a way to say thanks. Perhaps they were too shy to give it to you themselves!
dialogsComplete.th: BoBu และผู้คนจาก Coral Island ส่งของบางอย่างมาให้คุณทางไปรษณีย์เพื่อเป็นการขอบคุณ บางทีพวกเขาอาจเขินอายเกินกว่าจะให้มันกับคุณเอง!
dialogsComplete.tw: 波布 和珊瑚島的村民寄了些東西給你，作為感謝。也許他們只是太害羞，不敢當面交給你！
dialogsComplete.vi: BoBu và dân làng Đảo San hô đã gửi một thứ gì đó qua đường bưu điện cho bạn như một cách để nói lời cảm ơn. Có lẽ họ quá ngại ngùng khi tự mình đưa nó cho bạn!

dialogsFail.en: The Sea King consumes all who look into the void.
dialogsFail.ar: The Sea King consumes all who look into the void.
dialogsFail.br: O Rei do Mar consome todos que olham para o vazio.
dialogsFail.cns: 凝望深渊者，终将被海王吞噬。
dialogsFail.de: Der Meereskönig verzehrt alle, die in die Leere schauen.
dialogsFail.fi: The Sea King consumes all who look into the void.
dialogsFail.fil: The Sea King consumes all who look into the void.
dialogsFail.fr: Le Roi des mers consume tous ceux qui regardent dans le vide.
dialogsFail.id: Sea King menghabisi semua orang yang melihat ke dalam kehampaan.
dialogsFail.it: The Sea King consumes all who look into the void.
dialogsFail.jp: 海の王は虚空を覗き込む者を全て飲み込む。
dialogsFail.kr: 바다의 왕은 허공을 들여다보는 모든 이를 삼켜버립니다.
dialogsFail.nl: The Sea King consumes all who look into the void.
dialogsFail.pl: The Sea King consumes all who look into the void.
dialogsFail.ru: The Sea King consumes all who look into the void.
dialogsFail.sp: El Rey del Mar consume a todos los que miran al vacío.
dialogsFail.sw: The Sea King consumes all who look into the void.
dialogsFail.th: Sea King จะกลืนกินทุกคนที่มองเข้าไปสู่ความว่างเปล่า
dialogsFail.tw: 海王會吞噬所有凝視虛無之人。
dialogsFail.vi: Sea King tiêu diệt tất cả những ai nhìn vào khoảng không.
