dialogsBegin.en: I hope you are ready for our final challenge hero... According to legend, once every few hundred years the Sea King will release spawn onto Coral Island.
dialogsBegin.ar: I hope you are ready for our final challenge hero... According to legend, once every few hundred years the Sea King will release spawn onto Coral Island.
dialogsBegin.br: Espero que você esteja pronto para nosso desafio final, herói... Segundo a lenda, a cada poucos centenas de anos, o Rei do Mar libera sua prole na Ilha de Coral.
dialogsBegin.cns: 英雄，希望你已准备好迎接我们最终的挑战…… 传说中，每隔数百年，海王便会将子嗣投放至珊瑚岛。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich hoffe, du bist bereit für unsere letzte Herausforderung, den Helden. Die Legende besagt, dass der Meereskönig alle paar hundert Jahre seine Brut auf der Koralleninsel freisetzt.
dialogsBegin.fi: I hope you are ready for our final challenge hero... According to legend, once every few hundred years the Sea King will release spawn onto Coral Island.
dialogsBegin.fil: I hope you are ready for our final challenge hero... According to legend, once every few hundred years the Sea King will release spawn onto Coral Island.
dialogsBegin.fr: J'espère que vous êtes prêts pour notre ultime défi, héros... Selon la légende, tous les quelques centaines d'années, le Roi des mers libère sa progéniture sur l'île Corail.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku harap kamu siap untuk tantangan terakhir kami pahlawan... Menurut legenda, setiap beberapa ratus tahun sekali Sea King akan bertelur ke Coral Island.
dialogsBegin.it: I hope you are ready for our final challenge hero... According to legend, once every few hundred years the Sea King will release spawn onto Coral Island.
dialogsBegin.jp: 最後の挑戦ヒーローの準備ができていることを願っています..。伝説によると、数百年に一度、海王は珊瑚島に産卵を放つと言われています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 마지막 도전 영웅을 맞이할 준비가 되셨나요... 전설에 따르면, 수백 년에 한 번씩 바다의 왕이 코랄 아일랜드에 알을 낳아둔다고 하더군요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I hope you are ready for our final challenge hero... According to legend, once every few hundred years the Sea King will release spawn onto Coral Island.
dialogsBegin.pl: I hope you are ready for our final challenge hero... According to legend, once every few hundred years the Sea King will release spawn onto Coral Island.
dialogsBegin.ru: I hope you are ready for our final challenge hero... According to legend, once every few hundred years the Sea King will release spawn onto Coral Island.
dialogsBegin.sp: Espero que estés listo para el desafío final, héroe... Según la leyenda, una vez cada pocos cientos de años, el Rey del Mar libera engendros en Isla Coral.
dialogsBegin.sw: I hope you are ready for our final challenge hero... According to legend, once every few hundred years the Sea King will release spawn onto Coral Island.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันหวังว่าคุณจะพร้อมสำหรับการท้าทายครั้งสุดท้ายของเราแล้ว... ตามตำนาน ทุกๆ ร้อยปี ราชาแห่งท้องทะเลจะปรากฎตัวที่ Coral Island
dialogsBegin.tw: 希望你已經準備好迎接我們最後的挑戰了，英雄……根據傳說，每隔幾百年，海王就會在珊瑚島釋出牠的子嗣。
dialogsBegin.vi: Người hùng, tôi hy vọng bạn đã sẵn sàng cho thứ thách cuối cùng của chúng ta... Theo truyền thuyết, vài trăm năm một lần, Sea King sẽ để lại trứng trên Coral Island.

dialogsBegin.en: A strange darkness has began to fill the waters of Coral Island, so it seems as if the legend is true.
dialogsBegin.ar: A strange darkness has began to fill the waters of Coral Island, so it seems as if the legend is true.
dialogsBegin.br: Uma estranha escuridão começou a preencher as águas da Ilha de Coral, então parece que a lenda é verdadeira.
dialogsBegin.cns: 一股诡异的黑暗开始笼罩珊瑚岛的水域，看来传说所言非虚。
dialogsBegin.de: Eine seltsame Dunkelheit hat begonnen, die Gewässer der Koralleninsel zu erfüllen, so dass es scheint, dass die Legende wahr ist.
dialogsBegin.fi: A strange darkness has began to fill the waters of Coral Island, so it seems as if the legend is true.
dialogsBegin.fil: A strange darkness has began to fill the waters of Coral Island, so it seems as if the legend is true.
dialogsBegin.fr: Une étrange obscurité a commencé à envahir les eaux de l'île Corail, il semble donc que la légende soit vraie.
dialogsBegin.id: Kegelapan yang aneh mulai memenuhi perairan Coral Island, jadi sepertinya legenda itu benar adanya.
dialogsBegin.it: A strange darkness has began to fill the waters of Coral Island, so it seems as if the legend is true.
dialogsBegin.jp: 珊瑚島の海に奇妙な闇が満ち始めており、伝説が真実であるかのようです。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이상한 어둠이 코랄 아일랜드 바다를 뒤덮기 시작했습니다. 전설이 사실인 것 같군요.
dialogsBegin.nl: A strange darkness has began to fill the waters of Coral Island, so it seems as if the legend is true.
dialogsBegin.pl: A strange darkness has began to fill the waters of Coral Island, so it seems as if the legend is true.
dialogsBegin.ru: A strange darkness has began to fill the waters of Coral Island, so it seems as if the legend is true.
dialogsBegin.sp: Una extraña oscuridad ha comenzado a llenar las aguas de Isla Coral. La leyenda parece cierta.
dialogsBegin.sw: A strange darkness has began to fill the waters of Coral Island, so it seems as if the legend is true.
dialogsBegin.th: ความมืดมิดอันแปลกประหลาดเริ่มปกคลุมน่านน้ำของ Coral Island ดูเหมือนว่าตำนานจะเป็นเรื่องจริง
dialogsBegin.tw: 一股詭異的黑暗已開始籠罩珊瑚島的海域，看來那則傳說是真的。
dialogsBegin.vi: Một màn đêm kỳ lạ đã bắt đầu bao trùm những vùng nước của Coral Island, vì vậy có lẽ giai thoại theo truyền thuyết là thật.

dialogsBegin.en: Please help us stave off the spawn of the Sea King!
dialogsBegin.ar: Please help us stave off the spawn of the Sea King!
dialogsBegin.br: Por favor, ajude-nos a conter a prole do Rei do Mar!
dialogsBegin.cns: 请帮帮我们，阻挡海王的子嗣！
dialogsBegin.de: Bitte hilf uns, die Brut des Meereskönigs abzuwehren!
dialogsBegin.fi: Please help us stave off the spawn of the Sea King!
dialogsBegin.fil: Please help us stave off the spawn of the Sea King!
dialogsBegin.fr: Aidez-nous à repousser la progéniture du Roi des mers !
dialogsBegin.id: Tolong bantu kami mencegah telur Sea King!
dialogsBegin.it: Please help us stave off the spawn of the Sea King!
dialogsBegin.jp: 海王の出現を食い止めるのを手伝ってください!
dialogsBegin.kr: 바다의 왕이 숨겨둔 알을 막을 수 있게 도와주세요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Please help us stave off the spawn of the Sea King!
dialogsBegin.pl: Please help us stave off the spawn of the Sea King!
dialogsBegin.ru: Please help us stave off the spawn of the Sea King!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Ayúdanos a evitar la aparición del Rey del Mar!
dialogsBegin.sw: Please help us stave off the spawn of the Sea King!
dialogsBegin.th: โปรดช่วยเราป้องกันการมาของ Sea King
dialogsBegin.tw: 請幫助我們阻止海王的子嗣！
dialogsBegin.vi: Xin hãy giúp chúng tôi ngăn chặn sự sinh sôi của trứng của Sea King!

dialogsAccept.en: Thank you! Find where the Sea King has released their spawn, and defeat as many as you can. Let BoBu know once you've finished!
dialogsAccept.ar: Thank you! Find where the Sea King has released their spawn, and defeat as many as you can. Let BoBu know once you've finished!
dialogsAccept.br: Obrigado! Encontre onde o Rei do Mar liberou sua prole e derrote o máximo que puder. Informe BoBu quando terminar!
dialogsAccept.cns: 多谢你！去找到海王投放子嗣的地方，尽可能多地消灭它们。完成后就来告知波布！
dialogsAccept.de: Ich danke dir! Finde heraus, wo der Seekönig seine Brut freigelassen hat, und besiege so viele wie möglich. Sag BoBu Bescheid, wenn du es geschafft hast!
dialogsAccept.fi: Thank you! Find where the Sea King has released their spawn, and defeat as many as you can. Let BoBu know once you've finished!
dialogsAccept.fil: Thank you! Find where the Sea King has released their spawn, and defeat as many as you can. Let BoBu know once you've finished!
dialogsAccept.fr: Merci ! Trouvez l'endroit où le Roi des mers a libéré sa progéniture et battez-en autant que possible. Prévenez BoBu dès que vous avez terminé !
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih! Temukan di mana Sea King melepaskan telurnya, dan kalahkan sebanyak mungkin. Beritahu BoBu setelah kamu selesai!
dialogsAccept.it: Thank you! Find where the Sea King has released their spawn, and defeat as many as you can. Let BoBu know once you've finished!
dialogsAccept.jp: ありがとうございます！海の王が落とし子を放った場所を見つけて、できるだけ多くを倒してください。終わったらボブに知らせてください!
dialogsAccept.kr: 고마워요! 바다의 왕이 알을 숨겨둔 곳을 찾아, 최대한 많이 처치하세요. 끝나면 보부에게 알려주세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Thank you! Find where the Sea King has released their spawn, and defeat as many as you can. Let BoBu know once you've finished!
dialogsAccept.pl: Thank you! Find where the Sea King has released their spawn, and defeat as many as you can. Let BoBu know once you've finished!
dialogsAccept.ru: Thank you! Find where the Sea King has released their spawn, and defeat as many as you can. Let BoBu know once you've finished!
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Gracias! Averigua dónde ha liberado a sus engendros el Rey de los Mares y derrota a tantos como puedas. ¡Avisa a BoBu cuando hayas terminado!
dialogsAccept.sw: Thank you! Find where the Sea King has released their spawn, and defeat as many as you can. Let BoBu know once you've finished!
dialogsAccept.th: ขอบคุณ! ค้นหาจุดที่ราชาแห่งท้องทะเลจะปรากฎตัวออกมา และเอาชนะพวกมันให้ได้มากที่สุดเท่าที่จะทำได้ แจ้งให้ BoBu ทราบเมื่อคุณทำเสร็จแล้ว!
dialogsAccept.tw: 謝謝你！去找出海王釋出子嗣的地方，盡可能擊敗牠們。完成後再告訴 波布。
dialogsAccept.vi: Xin cảm ơn! Hãy tìm nơi Sea King để lại trứng và tiêu diệt nhiều trứng nhất có thể. Hãy cho BoBu biết tin ngay khi bạn đã hoàn thành nhiệm vụ!

dialogsDecline.en: Soon the inky darkness will overflow Coral Island, and we will be engulfed...
dialogsDecline.ar: Soon the inky darkness will overflow Coral Island, and we will be engulfed...
dialogsDecline.br: Em breve, a escuridão envolverá a Ilha de Coral, e seremos engolidos...
dialogsDecline.cns: 很快，这墨色深渊般的黑暗就会席卷珊瑚岛，将我们彻底吞噬……
dialogsDecline.de: Bald wird die tiefschwarze Dunkelheit die Koralleninsel überfluten, und wir werden verschlungen.
dialogsDecline.fi: Soon the inky darkness will overflow Coral Island, and we will be engulfed...
dialogsDecline.fil: Soon the inky darkness will overflow Coral Island, and we will be engulfed...
dialogsDecline.fr: Bientôt, les ténèbres d'encre envahiront l'île Corail et nous serons engloutis...
dialogsDecline.id: Sebentar lagi kegelapan pekat akan membanjiri Coral Island, dan kita akan ditelan...
dialogsDecline.it: Soon the inky darkness will overflow Coral Island, and we will be engulfed...
dialogsDecline.jp: やがて漆黒の闇が珊瑚島にあふれ、私たちは飲み込まれるだろう。
dialogsDecline.kr: 곧 짙은 어둠이 코랄 아일랜드를 뒤덮고, 우리까지 삼켜버릴 거예요...
dialogsDecline.nl: Soon the inky darkness will overflow Coral Island, and we will be engulfed...
dialogsDecline.pl: Soon the inky darkness will overflow Coral Island, and we will be engulfed...
dialogsDecline.ru: Soon the inky darkness will overflow Coral Island, and we will be engulfed...
dialogsDecline.sp: Pronto la Oscuridad Tinta inundará Isla Coral y seremos engullidos...
dialogsDecline.sw: Soon the inky darkness will overflow Coral Island, and we will be engulfed...
dialogsDecline.th: ไม่ช้าความมืดมิดจะย้อม Coral Island และเราจะถูกกลืนกิน...
dialogsDecline.tw: 不久之後，墨一般的黑暗就會淹沒整座珊瑚島，而我們也將被吞噬……
dialogsDecline.vi: Sớm thôi, màn đêm đen tối sẽ nhấn chìm Đảo San Hô và chúng ta sẽ bị nuốt chửng...

dialogsComplete.en: Hohoho! You really do have a mysterious power within you, don't you hero?
dialogsComplete.ar: Hohoho! You really do have a mysterious power within you, don't you hero?
dialogsComplete.br: Hohoho! Você realmente tem um poder misterioso dentro de você, não é, herói?
dialogsComplete.cns: 嚯嚯嚯！英雄，你体内当真蕴藏着一股神秘的力量，不是吗？
dialogsComplete.de: Hohoho! Du hast wirklich eine geheimnisvolle Kraft in dir, nicht wahr?
dialogsComplete.fi: Hohoho! You really do have a mysterious power within you, don't you hero?
dialogsComplete.fil: Hohoho! You really do have a mysterious power within you, don't you hero?
dialogsComplete.fr: Hohoho ! Vous possédez vraiment un pouvoir mystérieux en vous, n'est-ce pas héros ?
dialogsComplete.id: Hohoho! Kamu benar-benar memiliki kekuatan misterius di dalam dirimu kan, pahlawan?
dialogsComplete.it: Hohoho! You really do have a mysterious power within you, don't you hero?
dialogsComplete.jp: ほ!あなたは本当にあなたの中に不思議な力を持っていますね、あなたはヒーローですよね?
dialogsComplete.kr: 호호호! 정말 신비한 힘을 가지고 계시잖아요, 용사님!
dialogsComplete.nl: Hohoho! You really do have a mysterious power within you, don't you hero?
dialogsComplete.pl: Hohoho! You really do have a mysterious power within you, don't you hero?
dialogsComplete.ru: Hohoho! You really do have a mysterious power within you, don't you hero?
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Ho Ho Ho! Realmente tienes un poder misterioso dentro de ti, ¿No es así, héroe?
dialogsComplete.sw: Hohoho! You really do have a mysterious power within you, don't you hero?
dialogsComplete.th: ฮ่าๆ คุณมีพลังลึกลับอยู่ในตัวจริงๆ ใช่มั้ยล่ะผู้กล้า?
dialogsComplete.tw: 呵呵呵！你體內果然蘊藏著一股神秘的力量，不是嗎，英雄？
dialogsComplete.vi: Hohoho! Bên trong bạn thật sự có một sức mạnh bí ẩn, đúng không người hùng?

dialogsFail.en: Will we become faceless like those that failed before us?
dialogsFail.ar: Will we become faceless like those that failed before us?
dialogsFail.br: Nos tornaremos sem rosto como aqueles que falharam antes de nós?
dialogsFail.cns: 我们会像那些先前失败的人一样，变成没有面容的行尸走肉吗？
dialogsFail.de: Werden wir gesichtslos werden wie die, die vor uns gescheitert sind?
dialogsFail.fi: Will we become faceless like those that failed before us?
dialogsFail.fil: Will we become faceless like those that failed before us?
dialogsFail.fr: Deviendrons-nous anonymes comme ceux qui ont échoué avant nous ?
dialogsFail.id: Akankah kita menjadi tidak berwajah seperti orang-orang yang gagal sebelum kita?
dialogsFail.it: Will we become faceless like those that failed before us?
dialogsFail.jp: 私たちは、先人たちのように顔が見えなくなってしまうのでしょうか?
dialogsFail.kr: 우리도 앞서 실패한 이들처럼 얼굴 없는 존재가 되어버리면 어떡하죠?
dialogsFail.nl: Will we become faceless like those that failed before us?
dialogsFail.pl: Will we become faceless like those that failed before us?
dialogsFail.ru: Will we become faceless like those that failed before us?
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Nos volveremos anónimos como los que fracasaron antes que nosotros?
dialogsFail.sw: Will we become faceless like those that failed before us?
dialogsFail.th: เราจะกลายเป็นพวกที่ไม่สามารถระบุตัวตนได้ แบบคนที่ล้มเหลวมาก่อนเราไหม?
dialogsFail.tw: 我們會變得像那些失敗者一樣失去面容嗎？
dialogsFail.vi: Liệu chúng ta sẽ trở nên vô danh như những người đã bại trận trước đây sao?

name.jp: デミアン・デビアンツ

description.en: Kill 15 Demian and find the Legend of Leren Mountains, then return to Martinyc.
description.ar: Kill 15 Demian and find the Legend of Leren Mountains, then return to Martinyc.
description.br: Mate 15 Demian e encontre o livro da Lenda das Montanhas Leren, depois volte para Martinyc.
description.cns: Kill 15 Demian and find the Legend of Leren Mountains, then return to Martinyc.
description.de: Töte 15 Demians und finde die Legende des Leren Gebirges und kehre zu Martinyc zurück.
description.fi: Kill 15 Demian and find the Legend of Leren Mountains, then return to Martinyc.
description.fil: Kill 15 Demian and find the Legend of Leren Mountains, then return to Martinyc.
description.fr: Tuez 15 Demian et trouvez la légende des montagnes de Leren, puis retournez à Martinyc.
description.id: Bunuh 15 Demian dan temukan Legend of Leren Mountains, lalu kembali ke Martinyc.
description.it: Kill 15 Demian and find the Legend of Leren Mountains, then return to Martinyc.
description.jp: 15人のデミアンを殺し、レレン山脈の伝説を見つけて、マルティニークに戻ります。
description.kr: 데미안 15마리를 처치하고, 레르엔 산맥의 전설을 찾아 마르티닉에게 돌아가세요.
description.nl: Kill 15 Demian and find the Legend of Leren Mountains, then return to Martinyc.
description.pl: Kill 15 Demian and find the Legend of Leren Mountains, then return to Martinyc.
description.ru: Kill 15 Demian and find the Legend of Leren Mountains, then return to Martinyc.
description.sp: Mata a 15 Demian y encuentra la Leyenda de las Montañas Leren, luego regresa a Martinyc.
description.sw: Kill 15 Demian and find the Legend of Leren Mountains, then return to Martinyc.
description.th: กำจัด 15 Demian และหาหนังสือ Legend of Leren Mountains มา จากนั้นก็กลับไปหา Martinyc
description.tw: 獵殺 15 個德米安並找到勒倫山的傳說，然後返回馬特尼提特。
description.vi: Tiêu diệt 15 Demian và tìm Legend of Leren Mountains, sau đó quay trở lại Martinyc.

dialogsBegin.en: I once had a book that contains legends of the beasts that live within the caves of the Leren Mountains... but it was stolen by a pack of Demians during my research.
dialogsBegin.ar: I once had a book that contains legends of the beasts that live within the caves of the Leren Mountains... but it was stolen by a pack of Demians during my research.
dialogsBegin.br: Eu tinha um livro que continha lendas das criaturas que vivem dentro das cavernas das Montanhas Leren... Enquanto pesquisava para comprovar as informações do livro, um bando de Demians o roubou.
dialogsBegin.cns: I once had a book that contains legends of the beasts that live within the caves of the Leren Mountains... but it was stolen by a pack of Demians during my research.
dialogsBegin.de: Ich besaß einst ein Buch, das Legenden über die Bestien enthielt, die in den Höhlen des Lerengebirges leben... aber es wurde während meiner Nachforschungen von einem Rudel Demiants gestohlen.
dialogsBegin.fi: I once had a book that contains legends of the beasts that live within the caves of the Leren Mountains... but it was stolen by a pack of Demians during my research.
dialogsBegin.fil: I once had a book that contains legends of the beasts that live within the caves of the Leren Mountains... but it was stolen by a pack of Demians during my research.
dialogsBegin.fr: J'avais un livre qui contenait des légendes sur les bêtes qui vivent dans les grottes des montagnes de Leren... Mais il a été volé par une meute de Démiens pendant mes recherches.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku pernah punya buku yang berisi legenda binatang buas yang hidup di gua-gua Leren Mountain.. tapi buku itu dicuri oleh sekelompok kaum Demian selama penelitianku.
dialogsBegin.it: I once had a book that contains legends of the beasts that live within the caves of the Leren Mountains... but it was stolen by a pack of Demians during my research.
dialogsBegin.jp: 私はかつて、レレン山脈の洞窟に住む獣の伝説を含む本を持っていました..。しかし、それは私の研究中にデミアンの群れによって盗まれました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 레르엔 산맥 동굴에 사는 괴물들의 전설이 담긴 책을 가지고 있었는데... 연구 중 데미안 무리에게 도둑맞고 말았답니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: I once had a book that contains legends of the beasts that live within the caves of the Leren Mountains... but it was stolen by a pack of Demians during my research.
dialogsBegin.pl: I once had a book that contains legends of the beasts that live within the caves of the Leren Mountains... but it was stolen by a pack of Demians during my research.
dialogsBegin.ru: I once had a book that contains legends of the beasts that live within the caves of the Leren Mountains... but it was stolen by a pack of Demians during my research.
dialogsBegin.sp: Tuve un libro con leyendas de las bestias que viven en las cuevas de las Montañas Leren... pero fue robado por una manada de Demians durante mi investigación.
dialogsBegin.sw: I once had a book that contains legends of the beasts that live within the caves of the Leren Mountains... but it was stolen by a pack of Demians during my research.
dialogsBegin.th: ข้าเคยมีหนังสือที่บันทึกตำนานเกี่ยวกับสัตว์ที่อาศัยอยู่ในถ้ำที่ Leren Mountains.. แต่มันถูกขโมยไปโดยกลุ่มของ Demians ในระหว่างข้ากำลังค้นคว้า
dialogsBegin.tw: 我以前有一本到處記錄勒倫山脈洞窟內怪物傳說的書……但在我調查時被一群德米安搶走了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đã từng có một cuốn sách chứa truyền thuyết về những con thú sống trong các hang động của Leren Mountains.. nhưng nó đã bị đánh cắp bởi một toán quân Demian trong khi tôi vẫn đang nghiên cứu.

dialogsBegin.en: If you return my book to me I may be able to help.
dialogsBegin.ar: If you return my book to me I may be able to help.
dialogsBegin.br: Se você conseguir recuperá-lo para mim, certamente será de grande ajuda.
dialogsBegin.cns: If you return my book to me I may be able to help.
dialogsBegin.de: Wenn du mir mein Buch zurückbringst kann ich vielleicht helfen.
dialogsBegin.fi: If you return my book to me I may be able to help.
dialogsBegin.fil: If you return my book to me I may be able to help.
dialogsBegin.fr: Si vous me renvoyez mon livre, je pourrai peut-être vous aider.
dialogsBegin.id: Jika Anda mengembalikan bukuku kepadaku, aku mungkin dapat membantu.
dialogsBegin.it: If you return my book to me I may be able to help.
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたが私の本を私に返すならば、私は助けることができるかもしれません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 제 책을 돌려주면, 저도 당신을 도와드릴 수 있을 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: If you return my book to me I may be able to help.
dialogsBegin.pl: If you return my book to me I may be able to help.
dialogsBegin.ru: If you return my book to me I may be able to help.
dialogsBegin.sp: Si me devuelves el libro, quizá pueda ayudarte.
dialogsBegin.sw: If you return my book to me I may be able to help.
dialogsBegin.th: ถ้าเจ้าไปหาหนังสือมาคืนให้ฉันได้ ฉันอาจจะช่วยเจ้าได้นะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 如果你能幫我把書拿回來，我也許就能幫上忙。
dialogsBegin.vi: Nếu bạn trả lại cuốn sách cho tôi, tôi có thể giúp đỡ.

dialogsAccept.en: I have a feeling that the Demians still have my book of legends. Search for my book in Madren Town. You may have to get your hands a bit dirty...
dialogsAccept.ar: I have a feeling that the Demians still have my book of legends. Search for my book in Madren Town. You may have to get your hands a bit dirty...
dialogsAccept.br: Provavelmente os Demians ainda estão com meu livro de lendas. Tente recuperar meu livro na Vila Madren. Você pode ter que sujar um pouco suas mãos para isso...
dialogsAccept.cns: I have a feeling that the Demians still have my book of legends. Search for my book in Madren Town. You may have to get your hands a bit dirty...
dialogsAccept.de: Ich habe das Gefühl, dass die Demians immer noch mein Buch der Legenden haben. Suche in der Stadt Madren nach meinem Buch. Vielleicht müsst du dir die Hände ein wenig schmutzig machen.
dialogsAccept.fi: I have a feeling that the Demians still have my book of legends. Search for my book in Madren Town. You may have to get your hands a bit dirty...
dialogsAccept.fil: I have a feeling that the Demians still have my book of legends. Search for my book in Madren Town. You may have to get your hands a bit dirty...
dialogsAccept.fr: J'ai l'impression que les Démiens ont toujours mon livre de légendes. Cherchez mon livre à Madren. Vous devrez peut-être vous salir un peu les mains...
dialogsAccept.id: Aku merasa para Demian masih menyimpan buku legendaku. Cari bukuku di Kota Madren. Kamu mungkin harus mengotori tanganmu..
dialogsAccept.it: I have a feeling that the Demians still have my book of legends. Search for my book in Madren Town. You may have to get your hands a bit dirty...
dialogsAccept.jp: デミアンはまだ私の伝説の本を持っているような気がします。マドレンタウンで私の本を検索してください。手を少し汚す必要があるかもしれません。
dialogsAccept.kr: 데미안들이 아직 제 전설 책을 갖고 있을 것 같아요. 매드런 타운에서 제 책을 찾아주세요. 손을 좀 더럽혀야 할지도 모르지만...
dialogsAccept.nl: I have a feeling that the Demians still have my book of legends. Search for my book in Madren Town. You may have to get your hands a bit dirty...
dialogsAccept.pl: I have a feeling that the Demians still have my book of legends. Search for my book in Madren Town. You may have to get your hands a bit dirty...
dialogsAccept.ru: I have a feeling that the Demians still have my book of legends. Search for my book in Madren Town. You may have to get your hands a bit dirty...
dialogsAccept.sp: Creo que los Demians todavía tienen mi libro de leyendas. Busca mi libro en Poblado Madren. Puede que tengas que ensuciarte un poco las manos..
dialogsAccept.sw: I have a feeling that the Demians still have my book of legends. Search for my book in Madren Town. You may have to get your hands a bit dirty...
dialogsAccept.th: ฉันคิดว่า Demians ยังคงมีหนังสือของข้าอยู่ ลองหาหนังสือดูใน Madren Town เจ้าอาจจะต้องยอมมือสกปรกหน่อยนะ
dialogsAccept.tw: 我有種感覺，我的傳說之書還在那些德米安手裡。去瑪德倫鎮找找看吧。你可能得親手解決一些麻煩……
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi có cảm giác rằng người Demian vẫn giữ cuốn sách về các truyền thuyết của tôi. Hãy tìm kiếm cuốn sách của tôi ở Madren Town. Bạn có thể phải nhúng tay vào mấy việc hơi bẩn thỉu một chút đấy...

dialogsDecline.en: Madren Town is no place for commoners to travel. I could never expect you to risk your life for my book. Thank you for listening to me anyway.
dialogsDecline.ar: Madren Town is no place for commoners to travel. I could never expect you to risk your life for my book. Thank you for listening to me anyway.
dialogsDecline.br: A Vila Madren não é um lugar para pessoas comuns visitarem. Eu nunca poderia esperar que você arriscasse sua vida pelo meu livro. Obrigado por me ouvir de qualquer maneira.
dialogsDecline.cns: Madren Town is no place for commoners to travel. I could never expect you to risk your life for my book. Thank you for listening to me anyway.
dialogsDecline.de: Die Stadt Madren ist kein Ort, zu dem gewöhnliche Menschen reisen. Ich könnte niemals erwarten, dass du dein Leben für mein Buch riskierst. Trotzdem vielen Dank fürs Zuhören.
dialogsDecline.fi: Madren Town is no place for commoners to travel. I could never expect you to risk your life for my book. Thank you for listening to me anyway.
dialogsDecline.fil: Madren Town is no place for commoners to travel. I could never expect you to risk your life for my book. Thank you for listening to me anyway.
dialogsDecline.fr: Madren n'est pas un lieu de passage pour les roturiers. Je ne m'attendais pas à ce que vous risquiez votre vie pour mon livre. Mais je vous remercie de m'avoir écouté.
dialogsDecline.id: Kota Madren bukanlah tempat bagi orang biasa untuk bepergian. Aku tidak pernah bisa mengharapkanmu mempertaruhkan hidupmu untuk bukuku. Terima kasih sudah mendengarkanku.
dialogsDecline.it: Madren Town is no place for commoners to travel. I could never expect you to risk your life for my book. Thank you for listening to me anyway.
dialogsDecline.jp: マドレンタウンは庶民が旅行する場所ではありません。あなたが私の本のためにあなたの命を危険にさらすとは思ってもみませんでした。とにかく私の話を聞いてくれてありがとう。
dialogsDecline.kr: 매드런 타운은 일반인이 갈 곳이 아니에요. 제 책을 찾으려고 목숨까지 거실 줄은 몰랐다고요. 그래도 제 부탁을 들어주셔서 정말 감사해요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Madren Town is no place for commoners to travel. I could never expect you to risk your life for my book. Thank you for listening to me anyway.
dialogsDecline.pl: Madren Town is no place for commoners to travel. I could never expect you to risk your life for my book. Thank you for listening to me anyway.
dialogsDecline.ru: Madren Town is no place for commoners to travel. I could never expect you to risk your life for my book. Thank you for listening to me anyway.
dialogsDecline.sp: Poblado Madren no es lugar para plebeyos. Nunca desearía que arriesgaras tu vida por mi libro. Gracias por escucharme de todos modos.
dialogsDecline.sw: Madren Town is no place for commoners to travel. I could never expect you to risk your life for my book. Thank you for listening to me anyway.
dialogsDecline.th: Madren Town ไม่ใช่สถานที่ที่คนทั่วไปจะเดินทางไป ข้าไม่เคยนึกว่าเจ้าจะเสี่ยงชีวิตเพื่อหนังสือของข้า ขอบคุณมากที่ฟังเรื่องราวของข้านะ
dialogsDecline.tw: 瑪德倫鎮可不是普通人該去的地方。我也不該期待你願意為了一本書賭上性命。不過還是謝謝你願意聽我說。
dialogsDecline.vi: Madren Town không phải là nơi dành cho dân thường đi lại. Tôi không bao giờ mong đợi bạn mạo hiểm cuộc sống của bạn cho cuốn sách. Dù sao cũng cảm ơn vì đã lắng nghe tôi.

dialogsComplete.en: You found my book, thank you so much! Now to find the legend of the Leren Chasm...
dialogsComplete.ar: You found my book, thank you so much! Now to find the legend of the Leren Chasm...
dialogsComplete.br: Ótimo! Você conseguiu encontrar meu livro, muito obrigada! Agora, para encontrar a verdade sobre a lenda do Abismo de Leren...
dialogsComplete.cns: You found my book, thank you so much! Now to find the legend of the Leren Chasm...
dialogsComplete.de: Du hast mein Buch gefunden, vielen Dank! Jetzt finde die Legende der Lerenkluft.
dialogsComplete.fi: You found my book, thank you so much! Now to find the legend of the Leren Chasm...
dialogsComplete.fil: You found my book, thank you so much! Now to find the legend of the Leren Chasm...
dialogsComplete.fr: Vous avez trouvé mon livre, merci beaucoup ! Il ne me reste plus qu'à trouver la légende du Gouffre de Leren...
dialogsComplete.id: Kamu menemukan bukuku, terima kasih banyak! Sekarang untuk menemukan legenda Leren Chasm..
dialogsComplete.it: You found my book, thank you so much! Now to find the legend of the Leren Chasm...
dialogsComplete.jp: あなたは私の本を見つけました、どうもありがとう!今、レレンの淵の伝説を見つけるために。
dialogsComplete.kr: 제 책을 찾아 주셨군요, 정말 감사해요! 이제 레르엔 협곡의 전설만 찾으면 되겠어요...
dialogsComplete.nl: You found my book, thank you so much! Now to find the legend of the Leren Chasm...
dialogsComplete.pl: You found my book, thank you so much! Now to find the legend of the Leren Chasm...
dialogsComplete.ru: You found my book, thank you so much! Now to find the legend of the Leren Chasm...
dialogsComplete.sp: Recuperaste mi libro, ¡Muchas gracias! Ahora a encontrar la leyenda del Abismo de Leren..
dialogsComplete.sw: You found my book, thank you so much! Now to find the legend of the Leren Chasm...
dialogsComplete.th: เจ้าเจอหนังสือของข้า ขอบคุณเจ้ามาก! เอาล่ะได้เวลามาค้นหาตำนานแห่ง Leren Chasm กันแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你找到我的書了，真的太感謝你了！現在只要再找到勒倫峽谷的傳說……
dialogsComplete.vi: Bạn đã tìm thấy cuốn sách, cảm ơn bạn! Bây giờ để tìm truyền thuyết về Leren Chasm thì...

dialogsFail.en: Please find my book! I'm positive it is still in Madren Town.
dialogsFail.ar: Please find my book! I'm positive it is still in Madren Town.
dialogsFail.br: Por favor, encontre meu livro! Tenho certeza de que o levaram para a Vila Madren.
dialogsFail.cns: Please find my book! I'm positive it is still in Madren Town.
dialogsFail.de: Bitte finde mein Buch. Ich bin sicher, dass es noch in der Stadt Madren ist.
dialogsFail.fi: Please find my book! I'm positive it is still in Madren Town.
dialogsFail.fil: Please find my book! I'm positive it is still in Madren Town.
dialogsFail.fr: S'il vous plaît, trouvez mon livre ! Je suis certain qu'il est toujours à Madren.
dialogsFail.id: Tolong temukan bukuku! Aku yakin buku itu masih ada di Kota Madren.
dialogsFail.it: Please find my book! I'm positive it is still in Madren Town.
dialogsFail.jp: 私の本を見つけてください!私はそれがまだマドレンタウンにあると確信しています。
dialogsFail.kr: 제 책을 찾아주세요! 아직 매드런 타운에 있을 거예요.
dialogsFail.nl: Please find my book! I'm positive it is still in Madren Town.
dialogsFail.pl: Please find my book! I'm positive it is still in Madren Town.
dialogsFail.ru: Please find my book! I'm positive it is still in Madren Town.
dialogsFail.sp: ¡Por favor, encuentra mi libro! Estoy seguro de que todavía está en el Poblado Madren.
dialogsFail.sw: Please find my book! I'm positive it is still in Madren Town.
dialogsFail.th: โปรดหาหนังสือมาให้ข้า! ข้าแน่ใจว่ามันยังอยู่ใน Madren Town
dialogsFail.tw: 拜託你幫我找到那本書！我敢肯定它還在瑪德倫鎮裡。
dialogsFail.vi: Hãy tìm cuốn sách của tôi! Tôi khẳng định nó vẫn còn ở Madren Town.

name.th: เปิดเส้นทาง

description.en: Defeat 300 of any kind of Tigar, then return to Talus.
description.ar: Defeat 300 of any kind of Tigar, then return to Talus.
description.br: Derrote 300 Tigars de qualquer tipo, depois retorne a Talus.
description.cns: 击败任意种类热带虎共计 300 只，之后返回塔卢斯处。
description.de: Besiege 300 Tigar jeglicher Art und kehre dann nach Talus zurück.
description.fi: Defeat 300 of any kind of Tigar, then return to Talus.
description.fil: Defeat 300 of any kind of Tigar, then return to Talus.
description.fr: Tuez 300 Tigars de toutes sortes, puis retournez voir Talus.
description.id: Kalahkan 300 Tigar jenis apa pun, lalu kembali ke Talus.
description.it: Defeat 300 of any kind of Tigar, then return to Talus.
description.jp: タイガーを300体倒し、タルスに戻る。
description.kr: 종류에 상관없이 타이가 300마리를 처치하고, 탈루스에게 돌아가세요.
description.nl: Defeat 300 of any kind of Tigar, then return to Talus.
description.pl: Defeat 300 of any kind of Tigar, then return to Talus.
description.ru: Defeat 300 of any kind of Tigar, then return to Talus.
description.sp: Derrota a 300 Tigar de cualquier tipo y regresa con Talus.
description.sw: Defeat 300 of any kind of Tigar, then return to Talus.
description.th: เอาชนะ Tigar ชนิดใดก็ได้ 300 ตัว จากนั้นกลับไปยัง Talus
description.tw: 擊敗任意種類的提卡 300 隻，然後回去找塔盧斯。
description.vi: Hãy tiêu diệu 300 Tigar bất kỳ và quay lại gặp Talus khi bạn đã hoàn thành.

dialogsBegin.en: Word has been going around the village about a strong new visitor that can hold their own against the ferocities of Coral Island.
dialogsBegin.ar: Word has been going around the village about a strong new visitor that can hold their own against the ferocities of Coral Island.
dialogsBegin.br: Corre pela vila que um novo visitante forte consegue se defender contra as ferocidades da Ilha de Coral.
dialogsBegin.cns: 村里已经传开了，说是来了一位身手不凡的外来者，能在珊瑚岛的凶险环境中站稳脚跟。
dialogsBegin.de: Es hat sich im Dorf herumgesprochen, dass es einen starken neuen Besucher gibt, der sich gegen die Grausamkeiten der Koralleninsel behaupten kann.
dialogsBegin.fi: Word has been going around the village about a strong new visitor that can hold their own against the ferocities of Coral Island.
dialogsBegin.fil: Word has been going around the village about a strong new visitor that can hold their own against the ferocities of Coral Island.
dialogsBegin.fr: La rumeur court dans le village qu'un nouveau visiteur puissant pourrait tenir tête aux nombreux dangers de l'île.
dialogsBegin.id: Kabar telah beredar di desa tentang pengunjung baru yang kuat yang mampu bertahan melawan keganasan Coral Island.
dialogsBegin.it: Word has been going around the village about a strong new visitor that can hold their own against the ferocities of Coral Island.
dialogsBegin.jp: 噂は、珊瑚島の獰猛さに対抗することができる強力な新しい訪問者について村を駆け巡っています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 사나운 몬스터에 맞설 수 있는 강력한 새 방문자의 소문이 코랄 아일랜드 마을에 퍼졌어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Word has been going around the village about a strong new visitor that can hold their own against the ferocities of Coral Island.
dialogsBegin.pl: Word has been going around the village about a strong new visitor that can hold their own against the ferocities of Coral Island.
dialogsBegin.ru: Word has been going around the village about a strong new visitor that can hold their own against the ferocities of Coral Island.
dialogsBegin.sp: Se ha corrido la voz por el pueblo sobre un nuevo visitante fuerte que puede defenderse de las ferocidades de Isla Coral.
dialogsBegin.sw: Word has been going around the village about a strong new visitor that can hold their own against the ferocities of Coral Island.
dialogsBegin.th: มีข่าวลือไปทั่วหมู่บ้านเกี่ยวกับผู้มาเยือนหน้าใหม่ที่แข็งแกร่ง ที่สามารถรับมือความโหดร้ายของ Coral Island ได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 村裡都在傳，來了一位強大的新訪客，足以獨自面對珊瑚島上的兇猛威脅。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tin đồn đã lan truyền khắp làng về một vị khách mạnh mẽ có thể tự mình chống lại sự hiểm ác của Coral Island.

dialogsBegin.en: The number of Tigars on the island have exploded recently, and we're not sure why. It's hardly safe to walk along the paths of Coral Island anymore.
dialogsBegin.ar: The number of Tigars on the island have exploded recently, and we're not sure why. It's hardly safe to walk along the paths of Coral Island anymore.
dialogsBegin.br: O número de Tigars na ilha explodiu recentemente, e não sabemos por quê. Não é mais seguro caminhar pelos caminhos da Ilha de Coral.
dialogsBegin.cns: 最近岛上的热带虎数量暴增，原因不明。如今在珊瑚岛的小径上行走已经很不安全了。
dialogsBegin.de: Die Zahl der Tigars auf der Insel ist in letzter Zeit explodiert, und wir sind uns nicht sicher, warum. Es ist kaum noch sicher, auf den Pfaden der Koralleninsel zu gehen.
dialogsBegin.fi: The number of Tigars on the island have exploded recently, and we're not sure why. It's hardly safe to walk along the paths of Coral Island anymore.
dialogsBegin.fil: The number of Tigars on the island have exploded recently, and we're not sure why. It's hardly safe to walk along the paths of Coral Island anymore.
dialogsBegin.fr: Le nombre de Taigas sur l'île a explosé récemment, et nous ne savons pas exactement pourquoi. Il n'est plus guère possible de se promener en toute sécurité sur les sentiers de l'île.
dialogsBegin.id: Jumlah Tigar di pulau itu membludak baru-baru ini, dan kami tidak yakin alasannya. Hampir tidak aman lagi untuk berjalan di sepanjang jalan Coral Island.
dialogsBegin.it: The number of Tigars on the island have exploded recently, and we're not sure why. It's hardly safe to walk along the paths of Coral Island anymore.
dialogsBegin.jp: 最近、島のタイガールの数が爆発的に増えていますが、その理由はよくわかっていません。珊瑚島の小道を歩くのはもう安全とは言い難い。
dialogsBegin.kr: 최근 섬에 타이가의 수가 폭발적으로 늘었는데, 그 이유를 알 수가 없어요. 코랄 아일랜드 길도 더는 안전하게 걸을 수 없죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: The number of Tigars on the island have exploded recently, and we're not sure why. It's hardly safe to walk along the paths of Coral Island anymore.
dialogsBegin.pl: The number of Tigars on the island have exploded recently, and we're not sure why. It's hardly safe to walk along the paths of Coral Island anymore.
dialogsBegin.ru: The number of Tigars on the island have exploded recently, and we're not sure why. It's hardly safe to walk along the paths of Coral Island anymore.
dialogsBegin.sp: La cantidad de Tigars en la isla se ha disparado recientemente y no estamos seguros de por qué. Ya no es seguro caminar por los senderos de Isla Coral.
dialogsBegin.sw: The number of Tigars on the island have exploded recently, and we're not sure why. It's hardly safe to walk along the paths of Coral Island anymore.
dialogsBegin.th: จำนวนของ Tigars บนเกาะเพิ่มขึ้นอย่างรวดเร็วในช่วงนี้ และเราไม่แน่ใจว่าทำไม การเดินไปตามเส้นทางบนเกาะจึงแทบไม่ปลอดภัยอีกแล้ว
dialogsBegin.tw: 最近島上的提卡數量暴增，我們也不知道原因。現在連走在珊瑚島的小路上都幾乎不安全了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Số lượng Tigars trên đảo dạo gần đây đã bùng nổ, và chúng tôi không rõ tại sao. Việc đi bộ dọc theo các con đường ở Coral Island hầu như không còn an toàn nữa.

dialogsAccept.en: If you are willing to help us, go hunt enough Tigars to keep our paths safe for a while. Around 300 should do.
dialogsAccept.ar: If you are willing to help us, go hunt enough Tigars to keep our paths safe for a while. Around 300 should do.
dialogsAccept.br: Se você estiver disposto a nos ajudar, vá caçar Tigars suficientes para manter nossos caminhos seguros por um tempo. Cerca de 300 devem bastar.
dialogsAccept.cns: 如果你愿意帮我们，就去猎杀足够多的热带虎，让道路暂时恢复安全。大概三百只就够了。
dialogsAccept.de: Wenn du bereit bist, uns zu helfen, dann jage so viele Tigars, dass unsere Wege eine Zeit lang sicher sind. Etwa 300 sollten genügen.
dialogsAccept.fi: If you are willing to help us, go hunt enough Tigars to keep our paths safe for a while. Around 300 should do.
dialogsAccept.fil: If you are willing to help us, go hunt enough Tigars to keep our paths safe for a while. Around 300 should do.
dialogsAccept.fr: Si vous êtes prêts à nous aider, allez chasser suffisamment de Taigas pour assurer la sécurité de nos chemins pendant un certain temps. 300 devraient faire l'affaire.
dialogsAccept.id: Jika kamu bersedia membantu kami, pergilah berburu Tigars secukupnya agar jalan kami tetap aman untuk sementara waktu. Sekitar 300 sudah cukup.
dialogsAccept.it: If you are willing to help us, go hunt enough Tigars to keep our paths safe for a while. Around 300 should do.
dialogsAccept.jp: 手伝ってくれるなら、しばらくの間、私たちの道を安全に保つために、十分な数のタイガールを狩りに行ってください。300人くらいでいいと思います。
dialogsAccept.kr: 혹시 저희를 도와주실 수 있다면, 당분간 길이 안전해지도록 타이가를 사냥해 주세요. 300마리 정도면 충분할 거예요.
dialogsAccept.nl: If you are willing to help us, go hunt enough Tigars to keep our paths safe for a while. Around 300 should do.
dialogsAccept.pl: If you are willing to help us, go hunt enough Tigars to keep our paths safe for a while. Around 300 should do.
dialogsAccept.ru: If you are willing to help us, go hunt enough Tigars to keep our paths safe for a while. Around 300 should do.
dialogsAccept.sp: Si quieres ayudarnos, cazar Tigars para mantener nuestros caminos seguros. Con 300 deberían ser suficientes.
dialogsAccept.sw: If you are willing to help us, go hunt enough Tigars to keep our paths safe for a while. Around 300 should do.
dialogsAccept.th: หากคุณเต็มใจหรือไม่ ที่จะช่วยเราล่าพวก Tigars ให้มากพอที่จะรักษาเส้นทางของเราให้ปลอดภัยได้สักพัก ประมาณ 300 ตัวก็น่าจะพอ
dialogsAccept.tw: 如果你願意幫助我們，就去獵殺足夠的提卡，讓道路暫時恢復安全吧。大約 300 隻應該就夠了。
dialogsAccept.vi: Nếu bạn sẵn lòng giúp đỡ chúng tôi, hãy giúp chúng tôi săn những con Tigars. Có lẽ tiêu diệt 300 con có thể sẽ giữ đường đi của chúng tôi an toàn trong một khoảng thời gian.

dialogsDecline.en: Perhaps no one is powerful enough to defeat the Tigars.
dialogsDecline.ar: Perhaps no one is powerful enough to defeat the Tigars.
dialogsDecline.br: Talvez ninguém seja poderoso o suficiente para derrotar os Tigars.
dialogsDecline.cns: 或许根本没人有足够的力量击败这些热带虎。
dialogsDecline.de: Vielleicht ist niemand mächtig genug, um die Tigars zu besiegen.
dialogsDecline.fi: Perhaps no one is powerful enough to defeat the Tigars.
dialogsDecline.fil: Perhaps no one is powerful enough to defeat the Tigars.
dialogsDecline.fr: Peut-être que personne n'est assez fort pour pour vaincre les Taigas.
dialogsDecline.id: Mungkin tidak ada seorang pun yang cukup kuat untuk mengalahkan Tigars.
dialogsDecline.it: Perhaps no one is powerful enough to defeat the Tigars.
dialogsDecline.jp: おそらく、タイガーを倒すのに十分な力を持つ人はいないでしょう。
dialogsDecline.kr: 아마 타이가를 처치할 만큼 강력한 사람이 없나 봐요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Perhaps no one is powerful enough to defeat the Tigars.
dialogsDecline.pl: Perhaps no one is powerful enough to defeat the Tigars.
dialogsDecline.ru: Perhaps no one is powerful enough to defeat the Tigars.
dialogsDecline.sp: Quizás nadie sea lo suficientemente poderoso como para derrotar a los Tigres.
dialogsDecline.sw: Perhaps no one is powerful enough to defeat the Tigars.
dialogsDecline.th: บางทีอาจไม่มีใครมีกำลังพอที่จะเอาชนะ Tigars ได้
dialogsDecline.tw: 也許根本沒有人強大到能擊敗那些提卡。
dialogsDecline.vi: Có lẽ không có ai đủ mạnh để tiêu diệt những con Tigar.

dialogsComplete.en: Incredible, thank you for your efforts! We can safely travel around the land paths of the island again.
dialogsComplete.ar: Incredible, thank you for your efforts! We can safely travel around the land paths of the island again.
dialogsComplete.br: Incrível, obrigado pelos seus esforços! Podemos viajar com segurança pelos caminhos da ilha novamente.
dialogsComplete.cns: 太棒了，感谢你的付出！我们又能在岛上的陆路安全通行了。
dialogsComplete.de: Unglaublich, danke für deine Bemühungen! Wir können wieder sicher auf den Landwegen der Insel reisen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Incredible, thank you for your efforts! We can safely travel around the land paths of the island again.
dialogsComplete.fil: Incredible, thank you for your efforts! We can safely travel around the land paths of the island again.
dialogsComplete.fr: Incroyable, merci pour vos efforts ! Nous pouvons à nouveau circuler en toute sécurité sur les chemins de l'île.

dialogsComplete.th: สุดยอดมาก ขอบคุณสำหรับความพยายามของคุณ! เราสามารถเดินทางรอบเกาะได้อย่างปลอดภัยอีกครั้ง

dialogsBegin.en: Here you are again!? The last time was too easy... What if we put it back but a notch up?
dialogsBegin.ar: Here you are again!? The last time was too easy... What if we put it back but a notch up?
dialogsBegin.br: Você aqui de novo!? A última vez foi muito fácil. E se realocássemos de volta, mas um pouquinho acima?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你又来了！？上次也太轻松了吧……要不我把等级再重置回去，这次难度再上调一档？
dialogsBegin.de: Du schon wieder? Letztes Mal war zu einfach... Sollen wir es ein bisschen schwieriger machen?

dialogsBegin.fr: Te revoilà !? La dernière fois, c'était trop facile... Qu'est-ce que tu dis de recommencer, en plus difficile ?
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu kembali lagi!? Terakhir kali masih terlalu mudah .. Bagaimana jika kita memasangnya kembali tetapi dengan sedikit tambahan?
dialogsBegin.it: Here you are again!? The last time was too easy... What if we put it back but a notch up?
dialogsBegin.jp: また来た!?前回は簡単すぎました..元に戻したが、ノッチを上げた場合はどうなりますか?
dialogsBegin.kr: 또 오셨네요!? 저번엔 너무 쉬웠다고요... 다시 돌아가서 한 단계 올리면 어떨까요?

dialogsBegin.sw: Here you are again!? The last time was too easy... What if we put it back but a notch up?
dialogsBegin.th: เจ้ามาอีกแล้วรึ? ครั้งสุดท้ายง่ายเกินไปสินะ.. จะว่ายังไงถ้าเราจะลองอีกทีแล้วก็ทำให้มันยากขึ้นซักนิด?

dialogsBegin.en: Like last time, I take your levels and you go back up! As simple as that!
dialogsBegin.ar: Like last time, I take your levels and you go back up! As simple as that!

dialogsBegin.vi: Giống như lần trước, tôi lấy cấp độ của bạn và bạn quay trở lại! Đơn giản vậy thôi!

dialogsBegin.en: And like last time, if you want to resume your previous progression, you can cancel the quest, you will resume the progression of the latter by resuming the quest!
dialogsBegin.ar: And like last time, if you want to resume your previous progression, you can cancel the quest, you will resume the progression of the latter by resuming the quest!

dialogsDecline.en: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.ar: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.br: A Torre está infestada de masquerpets perigosos. Entendo se não quiser correr o risco.
dialogsDecline.cns: 这座塔里到处都是危险的假面怪。如果你不想冒这个险，我完全理解。
dialogsDecline.de: Der Turm ist voller gefährlicher Masquerpets. Ich verstehe es, wenn du das Risiko nicht eingehen willst.
dialogsDecline.fi: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.

dialogsDecline.it: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.jp: タワーは危険なモンスターでいっぱいです。あなたがリスクを冒したくないのなら、私は理解しています。

dialogsDecline.th: Tower เต็มไปด้วย masquerpets ที่อันตราย ข้าเข้าใจดีถ้าเจ้าไม่อยากเสี่ยงอันตราย
dialogsDecline.tw: 塔內充滿了危險的怪物。如果你不想冒險，我可以理解。
dialogsDecline.vi: Tower chứa đầy masquerpets nguy hiểm. Tôi hiểu bạn không muốn mạo hiểm.

dialogsBegin.en: Long ago I sailed into the mist that surrounded this island, hoping to discover something new and untouched in the land of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.ar: Long ago I sailed into the mist that surrounded this island, hoping to discover something new and untouched in the land of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.br: Há muito tempo, naveguei pela névoa que cercava esta ilha, na esperança de descobrir algo novo e intocado na terra de Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.cns: 很久以前，我驾船驶入了环绕这座岛屿的迷雾之中，希望能在瑞加大陆上，发现一片全新且未曾被踏足的土地。
dialogsBegin.de: Vor langer Zeit segelte ich in den Nebel, der diese Insel umgab, in der Hoffnung, etwas Neues und Unberührtes im Land von Madrigal zu entdecken.
dialogsBegin.fi: Long ago I sailed into the mist that surrounded this island, hoping to discover something new and untouched in the land of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.fil: Long ago I sailed into the mist that surrounded this island, hoping to discover something new and untouched in the land of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il y a longtemps, j'ai navigué dans la brume qui entourait cette île, espérant découvrir quelque chose de nouveau et d'intact dans le pays de Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.id: Dahulu kala aku berlayar menuju kabut yang mengelilingi pulau ini, berharap menemukan sesuatu yang baru dan belum tersentuh di negeri Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.it: Long ago I sailed into the mist that surrounded this island, hoping to discover something new and untouched in the land of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.jp: 遠い昔、私はこの島を取り囲む霧の中を航海し、マドリガルの地で何か新しいもの、手つかずのものを発見しようと願っていました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 오래전, 저는 마드리갈에서 사람의 손길이 닿지 않은 장소를 발견하기를 바라면서 이 섬을 둘러싼 안갯속을 항해했죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: Long ago I sailed into the mist that surrounded this island, hoping to discover something new and untouched in the land of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.pl: Long ago I sailed into the mist that surrounded this island, hoping to discover something new and untouched in the land of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.ru: Long ago I sailed into the mist that surrounded this island, hoping to discover something new and untouched in the land of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.sp: Hace mucho tiempo navegué hacia la niebla que rodeaba esta isla, con la esperanza de descubrir algo nuevo e intacto en la tierra de Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.sw: Long ago I sailed into the mist that surrounded this island, hoping to discover something new and untouched in the land of Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.th: เมื่อนานมาแล้ว ฉันได้ล่องเรือไปในหมอกที่ล้อมรอบเกาะแห่งนี้ โดยหวังว่าจะค้นพบสิ่งใหม่ๆ ที่ยังไม่ถูกค้นพบในดินแดนแห่ง Madrigal
dialogsBegin.tw: 很久以前，我駕船闖進包圍這座島嶼的迷霧之中，希望能在瑪德利賈大陸上發現一片嶄新且未被觸及的土地。
dialogsBegin.vi: Cách đây rất lâu, tôi đã đi thuyền vào màn sương mù bao quanh hòn đảo này, với hy vọng khám phá được điều gì đó mới mẻ và hoang sơ ở vùng đất Madrigal.

dialogsBegin.en: I found Coral Island nestled deep into the clouds, but something kept me from ever leaving.
dialogsBegin.ar: I found Coral Island nestled deep into the clouds, but something kept me from ever leaving.
dialogsBegin.br: Encontrei a Ilha de Coral aninhada nas profundezas das nuvens, mas algo me impediu de sair.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我发现珊瑚岛深藏在云雾之间，可某种力量却让我再也无法离开。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich fand die Koralleninsel tief in den Wolken, aber etwas hielt mich davon ab, sie jemals zu verlassen.
dialogsBegin.fi: I found Coral Island nestled deep into the clouds, but something kept me from ever leaving.
dialogsBegin.fil: I found Coral Island nestled deep into the clouds, but something kept me from ever leaving.
dialogsBegin.fr: J'ai trouvé l'ïle Corail nichée au creux des nuages, mais quelque chose m'a empêché de la quitter.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku menemukan Coral Island terletak jauh di balik awan, namun ada sesuatu yang menghalangiku untuk pergi.
dialogsBegin.it: I found Coral Island nestled deep into the clouds, but something kept me from ever leaving.
dialogsBegin.jp: 珊瑚島は雲の奥深くに隠れていたが、何かが私を妨げていた。
dialogsBegin.kr: 구름 깊숙이 자리 잡은 코랄 아일랜드를 발견했지만, 그때부터 무언가에 막혀 떠나지 못했어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I found Coral Island nestled deep into the clouds, but something kept me from ever leaving.
dialogsBegin.pl: I found Coral Island nestled deep into the clouds, but something kept me from ever leaving.
dialogsBegin.ru: I found Coral Island nestled deep into the clouds, but something kept me from ever leaving.
dialogsBegin.sp: Encontré Isla Coral enclavada profundamente entre las nubes, pero algo me impidió irme.
dialogsBegin.sw: I found Coral Island nestled deep into the clouds, but something kept me from ever leaving.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันพบ Coral Island ซ่อนตัวอยู่ลึกเข้าไปในเมฆ แต่มีบางสิ่งบางอย่างที่ทำให้ฉันออกไปไม่ได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 我在重重雲霧深處找到了珊瑚島，但某種力量阻止了我離開。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi thấy Coral Island ẩn sâu trong mây, nhưng có điều gì đó khiến tôi không thể rời đi.

dialogsBegin.en: The mist that covered the island held some magic that prevented those who arrived from escaping.
dialogsBegin.ar: The mist that covered the island held some magic that prevented those who arrived from escaping.
dialogsBegin.br: A névoa que cobria a ilha tinha alguma magia que impedia aqueles que chegavam de escapar.
dialogsBegin.cns: 笼罩岛屿的迷雾蕴含着某种魔力，让登岛之人再也无法离去。
dialogsBegin.de: Der Nebel, der die Insel bedeckte, enthielt einen Zauber, der die Ankommenden an der Flucht hinderte.
dialogsBegin.fi: The mist that covered the island held some magic that prevented those who arrived from escaping.
dialogsBegin.fil: The mist that covered the island held some magic that prevented those who arrived from escaping.
dialogsBegin.fr: La brume qui recouvrait l'île était imprégnée d'une magie qui empêchait les gens de la quitter.
dialogsBegin.id: Kabut yang menutupi pulau itu menyimpan sihir yang mencegah mereka yang datang untuk melarikan diri.
dialogsBegin.it: The mist that covered the island held some magic that prevented those who arrived from escaping.
dialogsBegin.jp: 島を覆う霧には、到着した者が逃げるのを防ぐ魔法が宿っていた。
dialogsBegin.kr: 섬을 뒤덮고 있는 안개에는 섬에 온 사람들이 탈출하지 못하게 하는 마법이 걸려 있었어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: The mist that covered the island held some magic that prevented those who arrived from escaping.
dialogsBegin.pl: The mist that covered the island held some magic that prevented those who arrived from escaping.
dialogsBegin.ru: The mist that covered the island held some magic that prevented those who arrived from escaping.
dialogsBegin.sp: La niebla que cubría la Isla contenía cierta magia que impedía escapar a los que llegaban.
dialogsBegin.sw: The mist that covered the island held some magic that prevented those who arrived from escaping.
dialogsBegin.th: หมอกที่ปกคลุมเกาะมีเวทมนตร์บางอย่าง ที่ป้องกันไม่ให้ผู้ที่เดินทางมาถึงหลบหนีได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 覆蓋島嶼的迷霧帶有魔力，使所有抵達此地的人都無法逃離。
dialogsBegin.vi: Màn sương mù bao phủ hòn đảo mang một loại phép thuật ngăn cản những người đến trốn thoát khỏi hòn đảo.

dialogsAccept.en: With Coral Island open to all, we may begin seeing more travelers arrive over time. For now, go introduce yourself to Sunny Pang. Sunny Pang will help you in your adventures around the island.
dialogsAccept.ar: With Coral Island open to all, we may begin seeing more travelers arrive over time. For now, go introduce yourself to Sunny Pang. Sunny Pang will help you in your adventures around the island.
dialogsAccept.br: Com a Ilha de Coral aberta a todos, podemos começar a ver mais viajantes chegando ao longo do tempo. Por enquanto, vá se apresentar a Sunny Pang. Sunny Pang o ajudará em suas aventuras pela ilha.
dialogsAccept.cns: 如今珊瑚岛已向所有人开放，用不了多久，想必会有更多旅人前来。你先去和阳光胖胖打个招呼吧，他会在你探索这座岛屿时为你提供帮助。
dialogsAccept.de: Da die Koralleninsel für alle offen ist, werden mit der Zeit vielleicht mehr Reisende kommen. Fürs Erste stelle dich bei Sunny Pang vor. Sunny Pang wird dir bei deinen Abenteuern auf der Insel helfen.
dialogsAccept.fi: With Coral Island open to all, we may begin seeing more travelers arrive over time. For now, go introduce yourself to Sunny Pang. Sunny Pang will help you in your adventures around the island.
dialogsAccept.fil: With Coral Island open to all, we may begin seeing more travelers arrive over time. For now, go introduce yourself to Sunny Pang. Sunny Pang will help you in your adventures around the island.
dialogsAccept.fr: L'Île Corail étant à nouveau navigable, il est possible que nous voyions arriver de plus en plus de voyageurs au fil du temps. Pour l'instant, présentez-vous à Sunny Pang. Sunny Pang vous aidera dans vos aventures autour de l'île.
dialogsAccept.id: Dengan terbukanya Coral Island untuk semua orang, kita mungkin mulai melihat lebih banyak wisatawan datang seiring berjalannya waktu. Untuk saat ini, perkenalkan dirimu pada Sunny Pang. Sunny Pang akan membantumu dalam petualangan mengelilingi pulau.
dialogsAccept.it: With Coral Island open to all, we may begin seeing more travelers arrive over time. For now, go introduce yourself to Sunny Pang. Sunny Pang will help you in your adventures around the island.
dialogsAccept.jp: コーラルアイランドはすべての人に開放されており、時間の経過とともにより多くの旅行者が到着し始める可能性があります。とりあえず、サニーパンに自己紹介しに行きましょう。サニーパンは、島を巡る冒険をお手伝いします。
dialogsAccept.kr: 코랄 아일랜드가 다시 열렸으니, 시간이 흐르면 더 많은 여행자가 방문하겠죠. 우선 써니 팡에게 가서 인사하세요. 써니 팡이 섬에서의 모험을 도와줄 거예요.
dialogsAccept.nl: With Coral Island open to all, we may begin seeing more travelers arrive over time. For now, go introduce yourself to Sunny Pang. Sunny Pang will help you in your adventures around the island.
dialogsAccept.pl: With Coral Island open to all, we may begin seeing more travelers arrive over time. For now, go introduce yourself to Sunny Pang. Sunny Pang will help you in your adventures around the island.
dialogsAccept.ru: With Coral Island open to all, we may begin seeing more travelers arrive over time. For now, go introduce yourself to Sunny Pang. Sunny Pang will help you in your adventures around the island.
dialogsAccept.sp: Con Isla Coral abierta a todos, es posible que comencemos a ver llegar más viajeros. Por ahora, preséntate a Pang Soleado. Él te ayudará en tus aventuras por la Isla.
dialogsAccept.sw: With Coral Island open to all, we may begin seeing more travelers arrive over time. For now, go introduce yourself to Sunny Pang. Sunny Pang will help you in your adventures around the island.
dialogsAccept.th: เมื่อ Coral Island เปิดให้นักท่องเที่ยวทุกคนเข้าชม เราอาจเริ่มเห็นนักท่องเที่ยวเดินทางมาเพิ่มมากขึ้นในอนาคต สำหรับตอนนี้ ไปทำความรู้จักกับ Sunny Pang กันเถอะ Sunny Pang จะช่วยคุณในการผจญภัยได้
dialogsAccept.tw: 現在珊瑚島已向所有人開放，隨著時間推移，應該會有越來越多旅人到來。現在先去跟 陽光胖胖 打個招呼吧，他會協助你在島上的冒險。
dialogsAccept.vi: Với việc Coral Island mở cửa cho tất cả mọi người, chúng ta có thể dân thấy nhiều du khách đến tham quan hòn đảo hơn. Còn bây giờ, hãy giới thiệu bản thân bạn với Sunny Pang. Sunny Pang sẽ giúp bạn trong cuộc phiêu lưu trên hòn đảo thú vị này.

dialogsDecline.en: Take your time, the island has a lot to offer. Come back to me when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.ar: Take your time, the island has a lot to offer. Come back to me when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.br: Leve o tempo que precisar, a ilha tem muito a oferecer. Volte para mim quando estiver pronto.
dialogsDecline.cns: 别急，这座岛上有不少值得探索的事物。等你准备好了，再来找我。
dialogsDecline.de: Lass dir Zeit, die Insel hat eine Menge zu bieten. Komm zurück zu mir, wenn du bereit bist.
dialogsDecline.fi: Take your time, the island has a lot to offer. Come back to me when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.fil: Take your time, the island has a lot to offer. Come back to me when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.fr: Prenez votre temps, l'île a beaucoup à offrir. Revenez me voir quand vous serez prêts.
dialogsDecline.id: Luangkan waktumu, pulau ini memiliki banyak hal yang ditawarkan. Kembalilah padaku ketika kamu sudah siap.
dialogsDecline.it: Take your time, the island has a lot to offer. Come back to me when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.jp: 時間をかけて、島にはたくさんの魅力があります。準備ができたら、私のところに戻ってきてください。
dialogsDecline.kr: 이 섬에는 볼거리가 많으니 천천히 둘러보셔도 돼요. 준비되면 다시 제게 오세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Take your time, the island has a lot to offer. Come back to me when you are ready.
dialogsDecline.pl: Take your time, the island has a lot to offer. Come back to me when you are ready.

dialogsDecline.th: ค่อยๆ เป็น ค่อยๆไป เกาะแห่งนี้มีอะไรให้ทำมากมาย กลับมาหาฉันเมื่อคุณพร้อม
dialogsDecline.tw: 慢慢來，這座島上有很多值得探索的東西。等你準備好了再回來找我。
dialogsDecline.vi: Từ từ khám phá nhé, hòn đảo có rất nhiều thứ đang chờ bạn tìm ra. Hãy quay lại với tôi khi bạn đã sẵn sàng cho điều khác.

dialogsComplete.en: Wow, it's a real adventure! It's been so long since we've had anyone come visit Coral Island. I wasn't sure this day would ever come!
dialogsComplete.ar: Wow, it's a real adventure! It's been so long since we've had anyone come visit Coral Island. I wasn't sure this day would ever come!
dialogsComplete.br: Uau, é uma verdadeira aventura! Faz tanto tempo desde que tivemos alguém visitando a Ilha de Coral. Eu não tinha certeza de que este dia chegaria!
dialogsComplete.cns: 哇，这可真是一场真正的冒险！我们已经太久没有迎来访客了，我都不确定这一天是否还会到来！
dialogsComplete.de: Wow, das ist ein echtes Abenteuer! Es ist schon so lange her, dass uns jemand auf der Koralleninsel besucht hat. Ich war mir nicht sicher, ob dieser Tag jemals kommen würde!
dialogsComplete.fi: Wow, it's a real adventure! It's been so long since we've had anyone come visit Coral Island. I wasn't sure this day would ever come!
dialogsComplete.fil: Wow, it's a real adventure! It's been so long since we've had anyone come visit Coral Island. I wasn't sure this day would ever come!
dialogsComplete.fr: C'est une véritable aventure ! Cela fait tellement longtemps que personne n'est venu visiter l'Île Corail. Je n'étais pas sûr que je puisse voir ce jour de mes propres yeux !
dialogsComplete.id: Wow, ini benar-benar petualangan! Sudah lama sekali tidak ada orang yang datang mengunjungi Coral Island. Aku tidak yakin hari ini akan datang!
dialogsComplete.it: Wow, it's a real adventure! It's been so long since we've had anyone come visit Coral Island. I wasn't sure this day would ever come!
dialogsComplete.jp: うわー、それは本当の冒険です!珊瑚島に遊びに来る人がいるのは久しぶりです。まさかこんな日が来るとは思っていませんでした!
dialogsComplete.kr: 진정한 모험을 하고 계시군요! 정말 오랜만에 코랄 아일랜드를 방문해주신 분이 계실 줄이야. 이런 날이 올 줄은...!
dialogsComplete.nl: Wow, it's a real adventure! It's been so long since we've had anyone come visit Coral Island. I wasn't sure this day would ever come!
dialogsComplete.pl: Wow, it's a real adventure! It's been so long since we've had anyone come visit Coral Island. I wasn't sure this day would ever come!
dialogsComplete.ru: Wow, it's a real adventure! It's been so long since we've had anyone come visit Coral Island. I wasn't sure this day would ever come!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Guau, es una verdadera aventura! Ha pasado tanto tiempo desde que alguien vino a Isla Coral. ¡No estaba seguro de que este día llegaría otra vez!
dialogsComplete.sw: Wow, it's a real adventure! It's been so long since we've had anyone come visit Coral Island. I wasn't sure this day would ever come!
dialogsComplete.th: ว้าว มันเป็นการผจญภัยที่แท้จริง! นานมากแล้วที่เราไม่ได้เจอใครมาเยี่ยม Coral Island ฉันคิดว่าวันนี้จะไม่มาถึงซะแล้ว!
dialogsComplete.tw: 哇，真是一場大冒險！珊瑚島已經很久沒有人來訪了，我都不確定這一天是否真的會到來！
dialogsComplete.vi: Wow, đó thực sự là một cuộc phiêu lưu đấy! Vì lâu lắm rồi mới có người đến thăm Coral Island, tôi còn không chắc ngày này sẽ đến nữa cơ!

dialogsBegin.it: Have you heard of the legendary King of the Beasts? Brace yourself, adventurer, for he is not one to be easily defeated.
dialogsBegin.jp: 伝説の百獣王について聞いたことがありますか?冒険者よ、気を引き締めろ、彼は簡単に倒せるような人間ではない。
dialogsBegin.kr: 전설적인 야수의 왕에 대해 들어보셨나요? 쉽지 않은 싸움이 될 겁니다. 마음 단단히 먹어야 해요, 모험가님.
dialogsBegin.nl: Have you heard of the legendary King of the Beasts? Brace yourself, adventurer, for he is not one to be easily defeated.
dialogsBegin.pl: Have you heard of the legendary King of the Beasts? Brace yourself, adventurer, for he is not one to be easily defeated.
dialogsBegin.ru: Have you heard of the legendary King of the Beasts? Brace yourself, adventurer, for he is not one to be easily defeated.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿Has oído hablar del legendario Rey de las Bestias? Prepárate, aventurero, no es alguien que pueda ser derrotado fácilmente.
dialogsBegin.sw: Have you heard of the legendary King of the Beasts? Brace yourself, adventurer, for he is not one to be easily defeated.
dialogsBegin.th: คุณเคยได้ยินเกี่ยวกับราชาแห่งสัตว์ร้ายในตำนานหรือไม่? เตรียมตัวให้พร้อม เพราะเขาไม่ใช่คนที่สามารถเอาชนะได้ง่ายๆ
dialogsBegin.tw: 你聽過傳說中的獸王之王嗎？做好心理準備吧，冒險家，牠可不是那麼容易就能擊敗的對手。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn đã từng nghe danh huyền thoại King of the Beasts chưa? Hãy chuẩn bị tinh thần đi, kẻ du hành, vì hắn ta không phải là một đối thủ dễ xơi đâu.

dialogsBegin.en: Before you can even set foot in the presence of the King, you must navigate through a winding path teeming with a vicious monsters.
dialogsBegin.ar: Before you can even set foot in the presence of the King, you must navigate through a winding path teeming with a vicious monsters.
dialogsBegin.br: Antes de você poder sequer se aproximar da presença do Rei, deve navegar por um caminho sinuoso repleto de monstros ferozes.
dialogsBegin.cns: Before you can even set foot in the presence of the King, you must navigate through a winding path teeming with a vicious monsters.
dialogsBegin.de: Bevor du überhaupt einen Fuß in die Gegenwart des Königs setzen kannst, musst du durch einen gewundenen Pfad navigieren, auf dem es von bösartigen Monstern wimmelt.
dialogsBegin.fi: Before you can even set foot in the presence of the King, you must navigate through a winding path teeming with a vicious monsters.
dialogsBegin.fil: Before you can even set foot in the presence of the King, you must navigate through a winding path teeming with a vicious monsters.
dialogsBegin.fr: Avant de pouvoir poser le pied en présence du Roi, vous devez emprunter un chemin sinueux où grouillent des monstres vicieux.
dialogsBegin.id: Sebelum kamu dapat menginjakkan kaki di hadapan sang Raja, kamu harus melewati jalan berliku yang dipenuhi monster ganas.
dialogsBegin.it: Before you can even set foot in the presence of the King, you must navigate through a winding path teeming with a vicious monsters.
dialogsBegin.jp: 王様の前に足を踏み入れる前に、凶暴なモンスターが跋扈する曲がりくねった道を進む必要があります。
dialogsBegin.kr: 왕 앞까지 나아가려면, 우선은 사악한 몬스터가 우글거리는 기나긴 길을 통과해야 해요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Before you can even set foot in the presence of the King, you must navigate through a winding path teeming with a vicious monsters.
dialogsBegin.pl: Before you can even set foot in the presence of the King, you must navigate through a winding path teeming with a vicious monsters.
dialogsBegin.ru: Before you can even set foot in the presence of the King, you must navigate through a winding path teeming with a vicious monsters.
dialogsBegin.sp: Antes de que puedas siquiera poner un pie en presencia del Rey, debes navegar a través de un camino sinuoso lleno de monstruos feroces.
dialogsBegin.sw: Before you can even set foot in the presence of the King, you must navigate through a winding path teeming with a vicious monsters.
dialogsBegin.th: ก่อนที่คุณจะพบเขาได้ คุณต้องเดินทางผ่านเส้นทางคดเคี้ยวที่เต็มไปด้วยมอนสเตอร์ดุร้าย
dialogsBegin.tw: 在你有資格踏入獸王面前之前，還得先穿越一條蜿蜒小徑，那裡充滿了兇猛的怪物。
dialogsBegin.vi: Trước khi bạn có thể đặt chân đến trước mặt nhà vua, bạn phải băng qua một con đường ngoằn ngoèo đầy rẫy những con quái vật hiểm ác.

dialogsAccept.en: Venture forth and cleanse The Wilds of the fearsome cobras and their master, the Twinstrike Den Mother. Clearing an opening will grant you the breathing space needed to strategize and prepare for what's to come.
dialogsAccept.ar: Venture forth and cleanse The Wilds of the fearsome cobras and their master, the Twinstrike Den Mother. Clearing an opening will grant you the breathing space needed to strategize and prepare for what's to come.
dialogsAccept.br: Aventure-se e limpe The Wilds das temíveis cobras e de sua mestra, a Mãe da Toca de Duplo Ataque. Abrir uma passagem lhe dará o espaço necessário para respirar e se preparar para o que está por vir.
dialogsAccept.cns: Venture forth and cleanse The Wilds of the fearsome cobras and their master, the Twinstrike Den Mother. Clearing an opening will grant you the breathing space needed to strategize and prepare for what's to come.
dialogsAccept.de: Wage es, die Wildnis von den furchterregenden Kobras und ihrer Meisterin, der Höhlenmutter der Twinstrikes, zu säubern. Eine Öffnung verschafft dir den nötigen Freiraum, um Strategien zu entwickeln und dich auf das vorzubereiten, was kommen wird.
dialogsAccept.fi: Venture forth and cleanse The Wilds of the fearsome cobras and their master, the Twinstrike Den Mother. Clearing an opening will grant you the breathing space needed to strategize and prepare for what's to come.
dialogsAccept.fil: Venture forth and cleanse The Wilds of the fearsome cobras and their master, the Twinstrike Den Mother. Clearing an opening will grant you the breathing space needed to strategize and prepare for what's to come.
dialogsAccept.fr: Aventurez-vous et nettoyez Désiréa des redoutables cobras et la Mère du Repaire Mutante. En dégageant une ouverture, vous disposerez de l'espace nécessaire pour élaborer une stratégie et vous préparer à ce qui vous attend.
dialogsAccept.id: Berpetualanglah dan bersihkan The Wilds dari ular kobra yang menakutkan dan tuannya, Twinstrike Den Mother. Membersihkan celah akan memberimu ruang bernapas yang dibutuhkan untuk menyusun strategi dan mempersiapkan diri menghadapi apa yang akan datang.
dialogsAccept.it: Venture forth and cleanse The Wilds of the fearsome cobras and their master, the Twinstrike Den Mother. Clearing an opening will grant you the breathing space needed to strategize and prepare for what's to come.
dialogsAccept.jp: 荒野から恐ろしいコブラとその主人であるツインストライク・デン・マザーを浄化せよ。隙を空けることで、戦略を立て、これから起こることに備えるために必要な息抜きのスペースが与えられます。
dialogsAccept.kr: 계속 나아가 무시무시한 코브라와 그들의 주인인 트윈스트라이크 어미를 처치하고 러스티아를 정화하세요. 진입부의 몬스터들을 소탕하고 나면 잠시 숨을 돌리면서 전략을 세우고 앞으로 다가올 일에 대비할 수 있을 겁니다.
dialogsAccept.nl: Venture forth and cleanse The Wilds of the fearsome cobras and their master, the Twinstrike Den Mother. Clearing an opening will grant you the breathing space needed to strategize and prepare for what's to come.
dialogsAccept.pl: Venture forth and cleanse The Wilds of the fearsome cobras and their master, the Twinstrike Den Mother. Clearing an opening will grant you the breathing space needed to strategize and prepare for what's to come.
dialogsAccept.ru: Venture forth and cleanse The Wilds of the fearsome cobras and their master, the Twinstrike Den Mother. Clearing an opening will grant you the breathing space needed to strategize and prepare for what's to come.
dialogsAccept.sp: Aventúrate y limpia Los Salvajes de las temibles cobras y su maestra, Madre Guarida Golpe Gemelo. Despejar una vacante le otorgará el respiro necesario para elaborar estrategias y prepararse para lo que está por venir.
dialogsAccept.sw: Venture forth and cleanse The Wilds of the fearsome cobras and their master, the Twinstrike Den Mother. Clearing an opening will grant you the breathing space needed to strategize and prepare for what's to come.
dialogsAccept.th: ออกผจญภัยและชำระล้าง The Wilds จากเหล่า cobras ที่น่ากลัวและ Twinstrike Den Mother การเคลียร์พื้นที่เปิดจะทำให้คุณมีเวลาหายใจเพื่อวางแผนและเตรียมพร้อมสำหรับสิ่งที่จะเกิดขึ้น
dialogsAccept.tw: 前往荒野叢境，清剿那些可怕的眼鏡蛇以及牠們的首領──雙擊蛇巢母。清出一條路後，你才有喘息與擬定下一步戰略的空間。
dialogsAccept.vi: Hãy tiến lên phía trước và diệt trừ lũ rắn độc cùng chủ nhân của chúng - Twinstrike Den Mother khỏi The Wilds . Mở một đường máu ở đây sẽ giúp bạn có thêm nơi để nghỉ ngơi và lên chiến thuật chuẩn bị cho thử thách sắp tới.

dialogsDecline.en: Should a mere handful of these snakes cast doubt upon your resolve, the prospect of facing Beast King Khan becomes a distant dream!
dialogsDecline.ar: Should a mere handful of these snakes cast doubt upon your resolve, the prospect of facing Beast King Khan becomes a distant dream!
dialogsDecline.br: Se um simples punhado dessas cobras lançar dúvidas sobre sua determinação, a perspectiva de enfrentar o Rei das Feras Khan se torna um sonho distante!
dialogsDecline.cns: Should a mere handful of these snakes cast doubt upon your resolve, the prospect of facing Beast King Khan becomes a distant dream!
dialogsDecline.de: Sollte auch nur eine Handvoll dieser Schlangen deine Entschlossenheit in Frage stellen, wird die Aussicht, dem Bestienkönig Khan gegenüberzutreten, zu einem fernen Traum!
dialogsDecline.fi: Should a mere handful of these snakes cast doubt upon your resolve, the prospect of facing Beast King Khan becomes a distant dream!
dialogsDecline.fil: Should a mere handful of these snakes cast doubt upon your resolve, the prospect of facing Beast King Khan becomes a distant dream!
dialogsDecline.fr: Si une poignée de ces serpents vient à vous faire douter de votre détermination, la perspective d'affronter Remardda, le Roi des Bêtes, n'est plus qu'un rêve lointain !
dialogsDecline.id: Jika segelintir ular ini saja meragukan tekadmu, prospek menghadapi Beast King Khan menjadi mimpi yang jauh!
dialogsDecline.it: Should a mere handful of these snakes cast doubt upon your resolve, the prospect of facing Beast King Khan becomes a distant dream!
dialogsDecline.jp: ほんの一握りの蛇があなたの決意に疑問を投げかければ、獣王カーンと対峙する可能性は遠い夢になります!
dialogsDecline.kr: 뱀 몇 마리 때문에 의지가 흔들릴 정도라면, 야수의 왕 칸에게 맞서는 건 굉장히 먼 미래가 되고 말 거예요!
dialogsDecline.nl: Should a mere handful of these snakes cast doubt upon your resolve, the prospect of facing Beast King Khan becomes a distant dream!
dialogsDecline.pl: Should a mere handful of these snakes cast doubt upon your resolve, the prospect of facing Beast King Khan becomes a distant dream!
dialogsDecline.ru: Should a mere handful of these snakes cast doubt upon your resolve, the prospect of facing Beast King Khan becomes a distant dream!
dialogsDecline.sp: Si un simple puñado de estas serpientes pone en duda tu determinación, ¡la perspectiva de enfrentarte al Rey Bestia Khan se convierte en un sueño lejano!
dialogsDecline.sw: Should a mere handful of these snakes cast doubt upon your resolve, the prospect of facing Beast King Khan becomes a distant dream!
dialogsDecline.th: หากงูไม่กี่ตัว ทำให้คุณเกิดความสงสัยในความสามารถของคุณ โอกาสที่จะเผชิญหน้ากับ Beast King Khan ก็คงเป็นเพียงความฝันอันห่างไกล!
dialogsDecline.tw: 如果只是這麼幾條蛇就讓你動搖，那麼面對百獸之王可汗的夢想，恐怕也只是空談！
dialogsDecline.vi: Nếu chỉ vài con rắn này đã khiến cho quyết tâm của bạn bị nghi ngờ, mục tiêu đối đầu với Beast King Khan sẽ chỉ còn là một giấc mơ xa vời!

dialogsComplete.en: With the serpents vanquished, your valor shines brightly, hero. Savor a brief rest, but keep your mind sharp, for another battle awaits when you re-enter the untamed Wilds!
dialogsComplete.ar: With the serpents vanquished, your valor shines brightly, hero. Savor a brief rest, but keep your mind sharp, for another battle awaits when you re-enter the untamed Wilds!
dialogsComplete.br: Com as serpentes derrotadas, sua bravura brilha intensamente, herói. Saboreie um breve descanso, mas mantenha sua mente afiada, pois outra batalha aguarda quando você retornar às selvagens Wilds!
dialogsComplete.cns: With the serpents vanquished, your valor shines brightly, hero. Savor a brief rest, but keep your mind sharp, for another battle awaits when you re-enter the untamed Wilds!
dialogsComplete.de: Nachdem die Schlangen besiegt sind, erstrahlt deine Tapferkeit in neuem Glanz, Held. Genieße eine kurze Pause, aber halte deinen Geist wach, denn ein neuer Kampf wartet auf dich, wenn du die ungezähmte Wildnis wieder betrittst!
dialogsComplete.fi: With the serpents vanquished, your valor shines brightly, hero. Savor a brief rest, but keep your mind sharp, for another battle awaits when you re-enter the untamed Wilds!
dialogsComplete.fil: With the serpents vanquished, your valor shines brightly, hero. Savor a brief rest, but keep your mind sharp, for another battle awaits when you re-enter the untamed Wilds!
dialogsComplete.fr: Une fois les serpents vaincus, votre courage brille de tous ses feux, héros. Savourez un bref repos, mais gardez l'esprit vif, car une nouvelle bataille vous attend lorsque vous pénétrerez à nouveau dans les étendues indomptées de Désiréa !
dialogsComplete.id: Setelah ular-ular itu dikalahkan, keberanianmu bersinar terang, pahlawan. Nikmatilah istirahat sejenak, tetapi tetaplah waspada, karena pertempuran lain menanti saat kau memasuki kembali Wilds yang tak terkendali!
dialogsComplete.it: With the serpents vanquished, your valor shines brightly, hero. Savor a brief rest, but keep your mind sharp, for another battle awaits when you re-enter the untamed Wilds!
dialogsComplete.jp: 蛇を打ち負かした今、あなたの勇気は明るく輝きます、英雄。束の間の休息を味わってください、しかし、あなたが手つかずの荒野に再び入ったときに別の戦いが待っているので、あなたの心を鋭くしてください!
dialogsComplete.kr: 뱀까지 퇴치하다니, 정말 용맹하시군요, 용사님. 야생의 러스티아로 돌아가면 또 다른 전투가 시작될 테니, 잠시 쉬시는 게 좋겠어요. 하지만 정신 바짝 차리고 계세요!
dialogsComplete.nl: With the serpents vanquished, your valor shines brightly, hero. Savor a brief rest, but keep your mind sharp, for another battle awaits when you re-enter the untamed Wilds!
dialogsComplete.pl: With the serpents vanquished, your valor shines brightly, hero. Savor a brief rest, but keep your mind sharp, for another battle awaits when you re-enter the untamed Wilds!
dialogsComplete.ru: With the serpents vanquished, your valor shines brightly, hero. Savor a brief rest, but keep your mind sharp, for another battle awaits when you re-enter the untamed Wilds!
dialogsComplete.sp: Con las serpientes vencidas, tu valor brilla intensamente, héroe. ¡Disfruta de un breve descanso, pero mantente alerta, porque habrá otra batalla cuando vuelvas a los indómitos Salvajes!
dialogsComplete.sw: With the serpents vanquished, your valor shines brightly, hero. Savor a brief rest, but keep your mind sharp, for another battle awaits when you re-enter the untamed Wilds!
dialogsComplete.th: เมื่อเอาชนะ serpents ได้แล้ว ความกล้าหาญของคุณก็จะเปล่งประกาย พักผ่อนสักครู่ แต่อย่าลืมตั้งสติให้เฉียบคม เพราะการต่อสู้ครั้งใหม่กำลังรอคุณอยู่เมื่อคุณกลับเข้าสู่ Wilds!
dialogsComplete.tw: 毒蛇已被你掃蕩，英雄，你的勇氣閃耀奪目。先稍作休息，但可別鬆懈，等你再次踏入荒野叢境時，還有新的戰鬥在等著你！
dialogsComplete.vi: Người anh hùng, bằng việc đánh bại lũ rắn độc, lòng dũng cảm của bạn đã tỏa sáng rực rỡ. Hãy tận hưởng giây phút nghỉ ngơi ngắn ngủi này nhưng nhớ giữ cho tâm trí tỉnh táo, vì còn một trận chiến nữa đang chờ đón khi bạn quay lại vùng đất Wilds hoang dã!

dialogsFail.en: Stay focused, adventurer. Venture back to the Wilds, and press on until the Prismatic Cobras and Twinstrike Den Mother are no more.
dialogsFail.ar: Stay focused, adventurer. Venture back to the Wilds, and press on until the Prismatic Cobras and Twinstrike Den Mother are no more.
dialogsFail.br: Mantenha o foco, aventureiro. Volte para as Wilds e continue até que as Cobras Prismáticas e a Mãe da Toca de Duplo Ataque sejam derrotadas.
dialogsFail.cns: Stay focused, adventurer. Venture back to the Wilds, and press on until the Prismatic Cobras and Twinstrike Den Mother are no more.
dialogsFail.de: Bleib konzentriert, Abenteurer. Wage dich zurück in die Wildnis und kämpfe weiter, bis die Prismakobras und die Höhlenmutter der Twinstrikes erledigt sind.
dialogsFail.fi: Stay focused, adventurer. Venture back to the Wilds, and press on until the Prismatic Cobras and Twinstrike Den Mother are no more.
dialogsFail.fil: Stay focused, adventurer. Venture back to the Wilds, and press on until the Prismatic Cobras and Twinstrike Den Mother are no more.
dialogsFail.fr: Restez concentré, aventurier. Retournez dans Désiréa et poursuivez votre route jusqu'à ce que les Cobras Prismatiques et Mère du Repaire Mutante aient disparu.
dialogsFail.id: Tetaplah fokus, petualang. Berpetualanglah kembali ke Wilds, dan teruslah maju hingga Prismatic Cobras dan Twinstrike Den Mother tidak ada lagi.
dialogsFail.it: Stay focused, adventurer. Venture back to the Wilds, and press on until the Prismatic Cobras and Twinstrike Den Mother are no more.
dialogsFail.jp: 冒険者よ、集中しろ。荒野に戻り、プリズム・コブラとツインストライク・デン・マザーがいなくなるまで進みましょう。
dialogsFail.kr: 정신 단단히 차리세요, 모험가님. 러스티아로 돌아가서, 프리즘 코브라와 트윈스트라이크 어미를 전부 처치할 때까지 용맹하게 싸워주세요.
dialogsFail.nl: Stay focused, adventurer. Venture back to the Wilds, and press on until the Prismatic Cobras and Twinstrike Den Mother are no more.
dialogsFail.pl: Stay focused, adventurer. Venture back to the Wilds, and press on until the Prismatic Cobras and Twinstrike Den Mother are no more.
dialogsFail.ru: Stay focused, adventurer. Venture back to the Wilds, and press on until the Prismatic Cobras and Twinstrike Den Mother are no more.
dialogsFail.sp: Mantente concentrado, aventurero. Aventúrate de regreso a Salvajes y continúa hasta que Cobra Prismática y Madre Guarida Golpe Gemelo ya no existan.
dialogsFail.sw: Stay focused, adventurer. Venture back to the Wilds, and press on until the Prismatic Cobras and Twinstrike Den Mother are no more.
dialogsFail.th: ตั้งสติไว้นักผจญภัย และเดินหน้าต่อไป จนกว่า Prismatic Cobras และ Twinstrike Den Mother จะไม่เหลืออยู่อีกแล้ว
dialogsFail.tw: 集中精神，冒險家。回到荒野叢境，繼續前進，直到稜彩眼鏡蛇與雙擊蛇巢母都不復存在。
dialogsFail.vi: Hãy tập trung vào mục tiêu của mình, kẻ du hành kia. Quay lại vùng đất Wilds và tiếp tục chiến đấu đến khi lũ Prismatic Cobras và Twinstrike Den Mother bị tiêu diệt.

dialogsBegin.en: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.ar: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin.br: Bem-vindo de volta aventureiro! Há relatos de uma nova ameaça na Torre Abandonada. Procure e livre-se de $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
