dialogsBegin.en: Hahaha! I cannot thank you enough for all that you have done for our village, hero! Only the most powerful of masquerpets remain a threat to our village now.
dialogsBegin.ar: Hahaha! I cannot thank you enough for all that you have done for our village, hero! Only the most powerful of masquerpets remain a threat to our village now.
dialogsBegin.br: Hahaha! Não posso agradecer o suficiente por tudo o que você fez por nossa vila, herói! Agora, apenas os masquerpets mais poderosos permanecem uma ameaça para nossa vila.
dialogsBegin.cns: 哈哈哈！英雄，真不知该如何感谢你为我们村子所做的一切！如今，只剩下那些最强大的怪兽还在威胁着我们的村庄。
dialogsBegin.de: Hahaha! Ich kann dir nicht genug für alles danken, was du für unser Dorf getan hast, du Held! Nur die mächtigsten Masquerpets sind jetzt noch eine Bedrohung für unser Dorf.
dialogsBegin.fi: Hahaha! I cannot thank you enough for all that you have done for our village, hero! Only the most powerful of masquerpets remain a threat to our village now.
dialogsBegin.fil: Hahaha! I cannot thank you enough for all that you have done for our village, hero! Only the most powerful of masquerpets remain a threat to our village now.
dialogsBegin.fr: Hahaha ! Je ne saurais trop vous remercier pour tout ce que vous avez fait pour notre village, héros ! Seuls les plus puissants des masquerpets restent une menace pour notre village à présent.
dialogsBegin.id: Ha ha ha! Aku sangat berterima kasih atas semua yang telah kamu lakukan untuk desa kami, Pahlawan! Hanya masquerpet terkuat yang masih menjadi ancaman bagi desa kami saat ini.
dialogsBegin.it: Hahaha! I cannot thank you enough for all that you have done for our village, hero! Only the most powerful of masquerpets remain a threat to our village now.
dialogsBegin.jp: ハハハ!英雄よ、あなたが私たちの村のためにしてくれたことすべてに感謝してもしきれません!最強の仮面舞踏会だけが、今や私たちの村にとって脅威であり続けています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 하하하! 우리 마을을 위해 애써주셔서 정말 감사드려요, 용사님! 이제 우리 마을에 위협이 되는 존재는 강력한 마스커펫뿐입니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Hahaha! I cannot thank you enough for all that you have done for our village, hero! Only the most powerful of masquerpets remain a threat to our village now.
dialogsBegin.pl: Hahaha! I cannot thank you enough for all that you have done for our village, hero! Only the most powerful of masquerpets remain a threat to our village now.
dialogsBegin.ru: Hahaha! I cannot thank you enough for all that you have done for our village, hero! Only the most powerful of masquerpets remain a threat to our village now.
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Jajaja! ¡No puedo agradecerte lo que has hecho por nuestro pueblo, héroe! Ahora sólo los masquerpets más poderosos siguen siendo una amenaza para nuestra aldea.
dialogsBegin.sw: Hahaha! I cannot thank you enough for all that you have done for our village, hero! Only the most powerful of masquerpets remain a threat to our village now.
dialogsBegin.th: ฮ่าๆ ขอบคุณมากสำหรับทุกสิ่งทุกอย่างที่คุณทำเพื่อหมู่บ้านของเรา ตอนนี้ เหลือแค่ masquerpets เท่านั้นที่ยังคงเป็นภัยคุกคามต่อหมู่บ้านของเรา
dialogsBegin.tw: 哈哈哈！英雄，真不知道該怎麼感謝你為我們村莊所做的一切！如今只剩下最強大的變身怪物還能威脅我們村莊了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Hahaha! Tôi không biết phải nói bao nhiêu lời cảm ơn mới đủ cho tất cả những gì bạn đã làm vì làng chúng tôi, anh hùng ạ! Bây giờ chỉ còn bọn masquerpets mạnh nhất vẫn là mối đe dọa cho ngôi làng.

dialogsBegin.en: We rarely see the Dorian and Okean creatures approach the village. However with so many other Island evils defeated, I fear they may leave their lair to take advantage of the situation!
dialogsBegin.ar: We rarely see the Dorian and Okean creatures approach the village. However with so many other Island evils defeated, I fear they may leave their lair to take advantage of the situation!
dialogsBegin.br: Raramente vemos as criaturas Dorian e Okean se aproximarem da vila. No entanto, com tantos outros males da ilha derrotados, temo que possam sair de seus covis para aproveitar a situação!
dialogsBegin.cns: 我们很少见到变异枪鱼和皇冠海妖这类怪物靠近村庄。可如今岛上的诸多邪恶势力都已被你击溃，我担心它们会离开巢穴，趁机作乱！
dialogsBegin.de: Wir sehen nur selten, dass sich die Kreaturen aus Dorian und Okean dem Dorf nähern. Aber da so viele andere Bösewichte der Insel besiegt wurden, befürchte ich, dass sie ihr Versteck verlassen könnten, um die Situation auszunutzen!
dialogsBegin.fi: We rarely see the Dorian and Okean creatures approach the village. However with so many other Island evils defeated, I fear they may leave their lair to take advantage of the situation!
dialogsBegin.fil: We rarely see the Dorian and Okean creatures approach the village. However with so many other Island evils defeated, I fear they may leave their lair to take advantage of the situation!
dialogsBegin.fr: Nous voyons rarement les créatures Dorian et Okean s'approcher du village. Cependant, avec la défaite de tant d'autres maux de l'île, je crains qu'elles ne quittent leur repaire pour profiter de la situation !
dialogsBegin.id: Jarang kita melihat makhluk Dorian dan Okean mendekati desa. Namun dengan begitu banyak kejahatan Pulau lainnya yang dikalahkan, aku khawatir mereka akan meninggalkan sarangnya untuk mengambil keuntungan dari situasi ini!
dialogsBegin.it: We rarely see the Dorian and Okean creatures approach the village. However with so many other Island evils defeated, I fear they may leave their lair to take advantage of the situation!
dialogsBegin.jp: ドリアンとオケアンの生き物が村に近づくのを見ることはめったにありません。しかし、他の多くの島の悪が倒されたので、彼らがこの状況を利用するために隠れ家を離れるのではないかと心配しています!
dialogsBegin.kr: 도리언과 오케안이 마을에 접근하는 일은 거의 없어요. 하지만 다른 섬의 괴물들을 많이 처치했으니, 기회를 노리고 서식지를 벗어날까 봐 걱정되네요!
dialogsBegin.nl: We rarely see the Dorian and Okean creatures approach the village. However with so many other Island evils defeated, I fear they may leave their lair to take advantage of the situation!
dialogsBegin.pl: We rarely see the Dorian and Okean creatures approach the village. However with so many other Island evils defeated, I fear they may leave their lair to take advantage of the situation!
dialogsBegin.ru: We rarely see the Dorian and Okean creatures approach the village. However with so many other Island evils defeated, I fear they may leave their lair to take advantage of the situation!
dialogsBegin.sp: Rara vez vemos a los Dorian y Okean acercarse al pueblo. Sin embargo, con tantos otros monstruos derrotados, ¡Temo que abandonen su guarida para aprovechar la situación!
dialogsBegin.sw: We rarely see the Dorian and Okean creatures approach the village. However with so many other Island evils defeated, I fear they may leave their lair to take advantage of the situation!
dialogsBegin.th: เราแทบไม่เคยเห็นพวก Dorian และ Okean เข้ามาใกล้หมู่บ้าน ยังไงก็ตาม เมื่อกำจัดสิ่งมีชีวิตชั่วร้ายอื่นๆ บนเกาะได้มากมาย ฉันกลัวว่าพวกมันอาจออกจากรังเพื่อใช้ประโยชน์จากสถานการณ์!
dialogsBegin.tw: 我們很少看到多利安和奧肯怪物接近村莊。然而，隨著如此多的島嶼邪惡勢力被擊敗，我擔心他們可能會離開巢穴來乘虛而入！
dialogsBegin.vi: Chúng tôi hiếm khi thấy Dorian và Okean tiếp cận ngôi làng. Tuy nhiên, vì rất nhiều quái vật độc ác trên đảo đang dần bị tiêu diệt , tôi sợ chúng có thể rời khỏi hang ổ của mình để lợi dụng tình hình này!

dialogsAccept.en: Go seek out where the Dorian and Okean live. We'll need as much information as we can get if we expect to defeat them!
dialogsAccept.ar: Go seek out where the Dorian and Okean live. We'll need as much information as we can get if we expect to defeat them!
dialogsAccept.br: Vá descobrir onde vivem os Dorian e Okean. Precisaremos de todas as informações que pudermos obter se quisermos derrotá-los!
dialogsAccept.cns: 去查明变异枪鱼和皇冠海妖的栖息地。想要打败它们，我们就得掌握尽可能多的情报！
dialogsAccept.de: Finde heraus, wo die Dorian und Okean leben. Wir brauchen so viele Informationen, wie wir bekommen können, wenn wir sie besiegen wollen!
dialogsAccept.fi: Go seek out where the Dorian and Okean live. We'll need as much information as we can get if we expect to defeat them!
dialogsAccept.fil: Go seek out where the Dorian and Okean live. We'll need as much information as we can get if we expect to defeat them!
dialogsAccept.fr: Allez chercher où vivent les Dorian et les Okean. Nous aurons besoin du maximum d'informations si nous voulons les vaincre !
dialogsAccept.id: Carilah tempat tinggal Dorian dan Okean. Kita memerlukan informasi sebanyak-banyaknya jika ingin mengalahkan mereka!
dialogsAccept.it: Go seek out where the Dorian and Okean live. We'll need as much information as we can get if we expect to defeat them!
dialogsAccept.jp: ドリアンとオキアンが住んでいる場所を探しに行きます。彼らを倒すには、できるだけ多くの情報が必要です!
dialogsAccept.kr: 가서 도리언과 오케안이 사는 곳을 찾으세요. 녀석들을 처치하려면 최대한 많은 정보가 필요해요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Go seek out where the Dorian and Okean live. We'll need as much information as we can get if we expect to defeat them!
dialogsAccept.pl: Go seek out where the Dorian and Okean live. We'll need as much information as we can get if we expect to defeat them!
dialogsAccept.ru: Go seek out where the Dorian and Okean live. We'll need as much information as we can get if we expect to defeat them!
dialogsAccept.sp: Ve a buscar dónde viven los Dorian y los Okean. ¡Necesitaremos toda la información que podamos obtener si queremos derrotarlos!
dialogsAccept.sw: Go seek out where the Dorian and Okean live. We'll need as much information as we can get if we expect to defeat them!
dialogsAccept.th: ออกไปค้นหาที่ซ่อน Dorian และ Okean เราต้องการข้อมูลมากที่สุด เพื่อหาทางเอาชนะพวกมัน!
dialogsAccept.tw: 去尋找多利安人和奧肯人居住的地方。如果我們想要擊敗他們，我們需要更多的資訊！
dialogsAccept.vi: Hãy đi tìm nơi Dorian và Okean đang trú ngụ. Chúng ta sẽ cần nhiều thông tin nhất có thể nếu muốn đánh bại chúng!

dialogsDecline.en: What!? You can't possibly be scared of a few more masquerpets after all we've been through together!
dialogsDecline.ar: What!? You can't possibly be scared of a few more masquerpets after all we've been through together!
dialogsDecline.br: O quê!? Você não pode estar com medo de mais alguns masquerpets depois de tudo o que passamos juntos!
dialogsDecline.cns: 什么！？我们一起历经了这么多风雨，你总不会还怕这几只怪物吧！
dialogsDecline.de: Was?! Du kannst doch unmöglich Angst vor ein paar weiteren Masquerpets haben, nach allem, was wir zusammen durchgemacht haben!
dialogsDecline.fi: What!? You can't possibly be scared of a few more masquerpets after all we've been through together!
dialogsDecline.fil: What!? You can't possibly be scared of a few more masquerpets after all we've been through together!
dialogsDecline.fr: Quoi ? Après tout ce que nous avons traversé ensemble, je ne pensais pas que tu aurais peur de quelques masquerpets supplémentaires !
dialogsDecline.id: Apa!? Kamu tidak mungkin takut dengan beberapa masquerpet lagi setelah semua yang kita lalui bersama!
dialogsDecline.it: What!? You can't possibly be scared of a few more masquerpets after all we've been through together!
dialogsDecline.jp: 何！。私たちが一緒に経験してきたすべての後、あなたはおそらくいくつかのより多くの仮面舞踏会を恐れることはできません!
dialogsDecline.kr: 네?! 이제까지 함께 온갖 일을 겪어놓고, 이제 와서 마스커펫 몇 마리 때문에 무서워서 못 한다니 그게 무슨 말이에요!
dialogsDecline.nl: What!? You can't possibly be scared of a few more masquerpets after all we've been through together!
dialogsDecline.pl: What!? You can't possibly be scared of a few more masquerpets after all we've been through together!
dialogsDecline.ru: What!? You can't possibly be scared of a few more masquerpets after all we've been through together!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¿¡Qué!? ¡No es posible que tengas miedo de unas cuantas masquerpets, después de todo lo pasado juntos!
dialogsDecline.sw: What!? You can't possibly be scared of a few more masquerpets after all we've been through together!
dialogsDecline.th: อะไรนะ!? คุณจะมากลัว masquerpets ไม่ได้นะ เราผ่านอะไรมาด้วยกันมากมายขนาดนี้!
dialogsDecline.tw: 什麼！？經過我們一起經歷了這麼多之後，你該不會還會怕那幾隻變身怪物吧！
dialogsDecline.vi: Gì cơ!? Không thể nào có chuyện bạn sợ phải đối mặt với thêm vài con masquerpet sau mọi chuyện chúng ta đã cùng trải qua chứ!

dialogsComplete.en: Well done, hero! With this information we have a chance to defeat the Dorian and Okean before they can attack!
dialogsComplete.ar: Well done, hero! With this information we have a chance to defeat the Dorian and Okean before they can attack!
dialogsComplete.br: Muito bem, herói! Com estas informações, temos uma chance de derrotar os Dorian e Okean antes que eles possam atacar!
dialogsComplete.cns: 干得漂亮，英雄！有了这些情报，我们就有机会在变异枪鱼和皇冠海妖发动袭击前将它们击败！
dialogsComplete.de: Gut gemacht, Held! Mit diesen Informationen haben wir eine Chance, die Dorian und Okean zu besiegen, bevor sie angreifen können!
dialogsComplete.fi: Well done, hero! With this information we have a chance to defeat the Dorian and Okean before they can attack!
dialogsComplete.fil: Well done, hero! With this information we have a chance to defeat the Dorian and Okean before they can attack!
dialogsComplete.fr: Bien joué, héros ! Avec ces informations, nous avons une chance de vaincre les Dorian et les Okean avant qu'ils n'attaquent !
dialogsComplete.id: Bagus sekali, pahlawan! Dengan informasi ini kita mempunyai kesempatan untuk mengalahkan Dorian dan Okean sebelum mereka menyerang!
dialogsComplete.it: Well done, hero! With this information we have a chance to defeat the Dorian and Okean before they can attack!
dialogsComplete.jp: よくやった、ヒーロー!この情報をもとに、ドリアンとオケアンが攻撃してくる前に倒すチャンスがあります!
dialogsComplete.kr: 훌륭해요, 용사님! 이 정보로 도리언과 오케안이 공격하기 전에 우리가 먼저 처치할 기회가 생겼어요!
dialogsComplete.nl: Well done, hero! With this information we have a chance to defeat the Dorian and Okean before they can attack!
dialogsComplete.pl: Well done, hero! With this information we have a chance to defeat the Dorian and Okean before they can attack!
dialogsComplete.ru: Well done, hero! With this information we have a chance to defeat the Dorian and Okean before they can attack!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Bien hecho, héroe! ¡Con esta información oodremos derrotar a Dorian y Okean antes de que puedan atacar!
dialogsComplete.sw: Well done, hero! With this information we have a chance to defeat the Dorian and Okean before they can attack!
dialogsComplete.th: ทำได้ดีมากผู้กล้า! ด้วยข้อมูลนี้ เรามีโอกาสที่จะเอาชนะ Dorian และ Okean ก่อนที่พวกมันจะโจมตี!
dialogsComplete.tw: 作得好，英雄！有了這些訊息，我們就有機會在多利安人和奧肯人進攻之前擊敗他們！
dialogsComplete.vi: Tốt lắm, người hùng! Với thông tin này chúng ta có cơ hội đánh bại loài Dorian và Okean trước khi chúng tấn công!

dialogsFail.en: Keep searching, the Dorian and Okean make their homes in the waters of Coral Island.
dialogsFail.ar: Keep searching, the Dorian and Okean make their homes in the waters of Coral Island.
dialogsFail.br: Continue procurando, os Dorian e Okean fazem suas casas nas águas da Ilha de Coral.
dialogsFail.cns: 继续搜寻，变异枪鱼和皇冠海妖就栖息在珊瑚岛的水域之中。
dialogsFail.de: Suche weiter, die Dorian und Okean sind in den Gewässern der Koralleninsel zu Hause.
dialogsFail.fi: Keep searching, the Dorian and Okean make their homes in the waters of Coral Island.
dialogsFail.fil: Keep searching, the Dorian and Okean make their homes in the waters of Coral Island.
dialogsFail.fr: Continuez à chercher, les Dorian et Okean vivent dans les eaux de l'île Corail.
dialogsFail.id: Terus mencari, suku Dorian dan Okean menetap di perairan Coral Island.
dialogsFail.it: Keep searching, the Dorian and Okean make their homes in the waters of Coral Island.
dialogsFail.jp: ドリアンとオキアンはコーラル島の海域に住み着きます。
dialogsFail.kr: 계속 찾아보세요. 도리언과 오케안은 코랄 아일랜드 바다 어딘가 살고 있어요.
dialogsFail.nl: Keep searching, the Dorian and Okean make their homes in the waters of Coral Island.
dialogsFail.pl: Keep searching, the Dorian and Okean make their homes in the waters of Coral Island.
dialogsFail.ru: Keep searching, the Dorian and Okean make their homes in the waters of Coral Island.
dialogsFail.sp: Sigue buscando, los Dorian y los Okean tienen sus hogares en las aguas de Isla Coral.
dialogsFail.sw: Keep searching, the Dorian and Okean make their homes in the waters of Coral Island.
dialogsFail.th: ค้นหาต่อไป Dorian และ Okean สร้างที่อยู่ของพวกมันอยู่ในน่านน้ำของ Coral Island
dialogsFail.tw: 繼續尋找，多利安人和奧肯人在珊瑚島的水域安了家。
dialogsFail.vi: Tiếp tục tìm kiếm đi, loài Dorian và Okean xây nhà của bọn chúng ở vùng nước của Đảo San hô.

dialogsBegin.en: We won't be able to craft any armor until Nein has completed smelting the Muffrin's buckets into something suitable. But once Nein is complete, we will need several materials only found from rare creatures known as Catchers.
dialogsBegin.ar: We won't be able to craft any armor until Nein has completed smelting the Muffrin's buckets into something suitable. But once Nein is complete, we will need several materials only found from rare creatures known as Catchers.
dialogsBegin.br: Não vai rolar de forjar nenhuma armadura até o Nein terminar de fundir os baldes dos Muffrin e transformar em algo útil. Mas depois que ele terminar, vamos precisar de vários materiais que só podem ser obtidos de criaturas raras conhecidas como Acumuladores.
dialogsBegin.cns: We won't be able to craft any armor until Nein has completed smelting the Muffrin's buckets into something suitable. But once Nein is complete, we will need several materials only found from rare creatures known as Catchers.
dialogsBegin.de: Wir können erst dann eine Rüstung herstellen, wenn Shin die Eimer der Muffrin zu etwas Geeignetem geschmolzen hat. Aber sobald Shin fertig ist, brauchen wir einige Materialien, die wir nur bei seltenen Kreaturen, den Catchers, finden.
dialogsBegin.fi: We won't be able to craft any armor until Nein has completed smelting the Muffrin's buckets into something suitable. But once Nein is complete, we will need several materials only found from rare creatures known as Catchers.
dialogsBegin.fil: We won't be able to craft any armor until Nein has completed smelting the Muffrin's buckets into something suitable. But once Nein is complete, we will need several materials only found from rare creatures known as Catchers.
dialogsBegin.fr: Nous ne pourrons pas commencer la fabrication des amures tant que Nein n'aura pas terminé de fondre les Seaux de Muffrin en quelque chose de convenable. Mais une fois qu'il aura terminé, il nous faudra trouver des matériaux que seuls des créatures connues sous le nom de Catcher pourront nous procurer.
dialogsBegin.id: Kami tidak akan dapat membuat baju besi apa pun sampai Nein selesai melebur ember Muffrin menjadi sesuatu yang cocok. Tapi begitu Nein selesai, kita membutuhkan beberapa bahan yang hanya ditemukan dari makhluk langka yang dikenal sebagai Catchers.
dialogsBegin.it: We won't be able to craft any armor until Nein has completed smelting the Muffrin's buckets into something suitable. But once Nein is complete, we will need several materials only found from rare creatures known as Catchers.
dialogsBegin.jp: ネインがマフリンのバケツを適切なものに製錬し終えるまで、鎧を作ることはできません。しかし、ネインが完成したら、キャッチャーと呼ばれる珍しい生き物からしか見つけられないいくつかの材料が必要になります。
dialogsBegin.kr: 네인이 머프린 양동이들을 쓸만한 수준으로 제련할 때까지는 우리도 방어구를 제작할 수 없을 거예요. 하지만 네인이 제련을 끝내면, 캐처라는 희귀 생물에게서만 얻을 수 있는 재료가 몇 가지 필요해요.
dialogsBegin.nl: We won't be able to craft any armor until Nein has completed smelting the Muffrin's buckets into something suitable. But once Nein is complete, we will need several materials only found from rare creatures known as Catchers.
dialogsBegin.pl: We won't be able to craft any armor until Nein has completed smelting the Muffrin's buckets into something suitable. But once Nein is complete, we will need several materials only found from rare creatures known as Catchers.
dialogsBegin.ru: We won't be able to craft any armor until Nein has completed smelting the Muffrin's buckets into something suitable. But once Nein is complete, we will need several materials only found from rare creatures known as Catchers.
dialogsBegin.sp: No podremos fabricar ninguna armadura hasta que Nein haya terminado de fundir los cubos de Muffrin en algo adecuado. Pero una vez que Nein haya terminado, necesitaremos varios materiales que sólo se encuentran en criaturas raras conocidas como Catchers.
dialogsBegin.sw: We won't be able to craft any armor until Nein has completed smelting the Muffrin's buckets into something suitable. But once Nein is complete, we will need several materials only found from rare creatures known as Catchers.
dialogsBegin.th: เราจะยังไม่สามารถสร้างเกราะอะไรได้จนกว่า Nein จะหลอม Muffrin's buckets เป็นสิ่งที่เหมาะสมเสร็จเสียก่อน แต่เมื่อ Nein ทำสำเร็จแล้ว เราจะต้องการวัตถุดิบบางอย่างที่พบได้จาก สัตว์หายากที่รู้จักชื่อกันว่า Catchers
dialogsBegin.tw: 在奈因把慕弗林水桶熔煉成適合的材料之前，我們還無法開始打造鎧甲。不過一旦奈因完成了，我們還需要數種只有稀有生物「捕捉者」身上才找得到的材料。
dialogsBegin.vi: Chúng tôi sẽ không thể chế tạo bất kỳ áo giáp nào cho đến khi Nein hoàn thành việc nấu chảy Muffrin's buckets thành thứ gì đó phù hợp. Nhưng một khi Nein hoàn thành, chúng ta sẽ cần một số nguyên liệu chỉ được tìm thấy từ những sinh vật quý hiếm được gọi là Catchers.

dialogsAccept.en: Catchers can be found all over Madrigal, but luckily for you all the most common catchers appear in Darkon 3. Collect 500 of each Catcher's material, then head back to Nein to collect the smelted metal.
dialogsAccept.ar: Catchers can be found all over Madrigal, but luckily for you all the most common catchers appear in Darkon 3. Collect 500 of each Catcher's material, then head back to Nein to collect the smelted metal.
dialogsAccept.br: Os Acumuladores estão espalhados por toda Madrigal, mas por sorte, os Acumuladores mais comuns aparecem em Darkon 3. Junte 500 unidades de cada material dos Acumuladores e depois volte para Nein para pegar o metal derretido.
dialogsAccept.cns: Catchers can be found all over Madrigal, but luckily for you all the most common catchers appear in Darkon 3. Collect 500 of each Catcher's material, then head back to Nein to collect the smelted metal.
dialogsAccept.de: Catcher gibt es überall in Madrigal, aber zu deinem Glück tauchen die häufigsten Catcher in Darkon 3 auf. Sammle 500 der Materialien jedes Catchers und gehe dann zurück nach Shin , um das geschmolzene Metall einzusammeln.
dialogsAccept.fi: Catchers can be found all over Madrigal, but luckily for you all the most common catchers appear in Darkon 3. Collect 500 of each Catcher's material, then head back to Nein to collect the smelted metal.
dialogsAccept.fil: Catchers can be found all over Madrigal, but luckily for you all the most common catchers appear in Darkon 3. Collect 500 of each Catcher's material, then head back to Nein to collect the smelted metal.
dialogsAccept.fr: On peut trouver des Catchers partout sur Madrigal. Mais heureusement pour toi, les Catchers les plus communs ont été aperçus à Darkon 3. Récupérez 500 matériaux de chaque Catcher et retournez voir Nein pour prendre le métal fondu.
dialogsAccept.id: Penangkap dapat ditemukan di seluruh Madrigal, tetapi untungnya bagi Anda semua penangkap yang paling umum muncul di Darkon 3. Kumpulkan 500 dari setiap bahan Catcher, lalu kembali ke Nein untuk mengumpulkan logam yang dilebur.
dialogsAccept.it: Catchers can be found all over Madrigal, but luckily for you all the most common catchers appear in Darkon 3. Collect 500 of each Catcher's material, then head back to Nein to collect the smelted metal.
dialogsAccept.jp: キャッチャーはマドリガルのいたるところにありますが、幸いなことに、最も一般的なキャッチャーはすべてダーコン3に登場します。各キャッチャーの材料を500個集めてから、ネインに戻って製錬された金属を集めます。
dialogsAccept.kr: 캐처는 마드리갈 곳곳에 퍼져 있지만, 쉽게 볼 수 있는 캐처들은 다행히 다콘 3에 다 모여 있답니다. 각 캐처 재료를 500개씩 모은 다음, 네인에게 돌아가 제련된 금속을 수집하세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Catchers can be found all over Madrigal, but luckily for you all the most common catchers appear in Darkon 3. Collect 500 of each Catcher's material, then head back to Nein to collect the smelted metal.
dialogsAccept.pl: Catchers can be found all over Madrigal, but luckily for you all the most common catchers appear in Darkon 3. Collect 500 of each Catcher's material, then head back to Nein to collect the smelted metal.
dialogsAccept.ru: Catchers can be found all over Madrigal, but luckily for you all the most common catchers appear in Darkon 3. Collect 500 of each Catcher's material, then head back to Nein to collect the smelted metal.
dialogsAccept.sp: Los Catchers se pueden encontrar por todo Madrigal, pero por suerte para ti todos los Catchers más comunes aparecen en Darkon 3. Recoge 500 de cada material de Catcher, luego vuelve a Nein para recoger el metal fundido.
dialogsAccept.sw: Catchers can be found all over Madrigal, but luckily for you all the most common catchers appear in Darkon 3. Collect 500 of each Catcher's material, then head back to Nein to collect the smelted metal.
dialogsAccept.th: สามารถพบ Catchers ได้ทั่วไปรอบ ๆ Madrigal แต่เจ้าโชคดีแล้วเพราะว่า Catchers ส่วนใหญ่จะพบที่ Darkon 3. เก็บวัตถุดิบแต่ละอย่างของ Catcher มา 500 อัน แล้วกลับไปหา Nein เพื่อรับโลหะที่หลอมแล้ว
dialogsAccept.tw: 捕捉者遍布整個瑪德利賈，不過對你來說幸運的是，最常見的那些全都出現在得肯第三區。去把每種捕捉者的材料各收集 500 個，然後回奈因那裡領取熔好的金屬。
dialogsAccept.vi: Catcher có thể được tìm thấy trên khắp Madrigal, nhưng may mắn cho bạn là tất cả những Catcher phổ biến nhất đều xuất hiện trong Darkon 3. Thu thập 500 Catcher's material, sau đó quay trở lại Nein để thu thập kim loại đã nấu chảy.

dialogsDecline.en: Collecting materials from Catchers is quite simple... I have a book on how to gather them in my tent if you need a reference.
dialogsDecline.ar: Collecting materials from Catchers is quite simple... I have a book on how to gather them in my tent if you need a reference.
dialogsDecline.br: Coletar materiais dos Acumuladores é bem simples... Eu tenho um livro sobre como coletá-los na minha barraca, se você precisar de uma referência.
dialogsDecline.cns: Collecting materials from Catchers is quite simple... I have a book on how to gather them in my tent if you need a reference.
dialogsDecline.de: Das Sammeln von Materialien von Catchers ist recht einfach. Ich habe ein Buch darüber, wie man sie sammelt, in meinem Zelt, wenn du eine Referenz brauchst.
dialogsDecline.fi: Collecting materials from Catchers is quite simple... I have a book on how to gather them in my tent if you need a reference.
dialogsDecline.fil: Collecting materials from Catchers is quite simple... I have a book on how to gather them in my tent if you need a reference.
dialogsDecline.fr: Récupérer des matériaux des Catchers est relativement simple. J'ai un livre dans ma tente expliquant comment procéder si vous le souhaitez.
dialogsDecline.id: Mengumpulkan bahan dari Catchers cukup sederhana.. Aku punya buku tentang cara mengumpulkannya di tenda jika kamu membutuhkan referensi.
dialogsDecline.it: Collecting materials from Catchers is quite simple... I have a book on how to gather them in my tent if you need a reference.
dialogsDecline.jp: キャッチャーから材料を集めるのはとても簡単です。参考資料が必要な場合、テントに集める方法についての本があります。
dialogsDecline.kr: 캐처에게서 재료를 모으는 건 꽤 간단해요... 제 천막 안에 채집 방법이 적힌 책이 있으니, 필요하다면 얼마든 참고하세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Collecting materials from Catchers is quite simple... I have a book on how to gather them in my tent if you need a reference.
dialogsDecline.pl: Collecting materials from Catchers is quite simple... I have a book on how to gather them in my tent if you need a reference.
dialogsDecline.ru: Collecting materials from Catchers is quite simple... I have a book on how to gather them in my tent if you need a reference.
dialogsDecline.sp: Recoger materiales de los Catchers es bastante sencillo.. Tengo un libro en mi tienda sobre cómo recogerlos.
dialogsDecline.sw: Collecting materials from Catchers is quite simple... I have a book on how to gather them in my tent if you need a reference.
dialogsDecline.th: เก็บวัตถุดิบจาก Catchers นั้นเป็นเรื่องค่อนข้างง่าย ข้ามีหนังสือเกี่ยวกับการเก็บพวกมันอยู่ในเต้นท์ ถ้าเจ้าต้องการข้อมูลอ้างอิงล่ะก็
dialogsDecline.tw: 收集捕捉者材料其實不算難……如果你需要參考，我帳篷裡有一本教你怎麼採集的書。
dialogsDecline.vi: Thu thập nguyên liệu từ Catchers khá đơn giản.. Tôi có một cuốn sách hướng dẫn cách thu thập chúng trong lều của mình nếu bạn cần tham khảo.

dialogsComplete.en: Perfect timing! I just finished smelting down all the metal into something of use.
dialogsComplete.ar: Perfect timing! I just finished smelting down all the metal into something of use.
dialogsComplete.br: Hora perfeita! Acabei de fundir todo o metal em algo útil.
dialogsComplete.cns: Perfect timing! I just finished smelting down all the metal into something of use.
dialogsComplete.de: Perfektes Timing! Ich bin gerade damit fertig geworden, das ganze Metall in etwas Brauchbares umzuschmelzen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Perfect timing! I just finished smelting down all the metal into something of use.
dialogsComplete.fil: Perfect timing! I just finished smelting down all the metal into something of use.
dialogsComplete.fr: Timing parfait ! Je viens juste de terminer à fondre tout le métal.
dialogsComplete.id: Waktu yang tepat! Saya baru saja selesai melebur semua logam menjadi sesuatu yang berguna.
dialogsComplete.it: Perfect timing! I just finished smelting down all the metal into something of use.
dialogsComplete.jp: 完璧なタイミング!私はちょうどすべての金属を何か使えるものに製錬し終えました。
dialogsComplete.kr: 타이밍이 완벽하네요! 마침 금속을 쓸만하게 제련하는 작업을 끝낸 참이거든요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Perfect timing! I just finished smelting down all the metal into something of use.
dialogsComplete.pl: Perfect timing! I just finished smelting down all the metal into something of use.
dialogsComplete.ru: Perfect timing! I just finished smelting down all the metal into something of use.
dialogsComplete.sp: Justo a tiempo. Acabo de terminar de fundir todo el metal en algo de uso.
dialogsComplete.sw: Perfect timing! I just finished smelting down all the metal into something of use.
dialogsComplete.th: มาได้เวลาเหมาะพอดี! ข้อเพิ่งหลอมเสร็จการหลอมโลหะทั้งหมดเป็นอะไรที่พร้อมใช้งานแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 你來得正好！我才剛把所有金屬熔成可用材料。
dialogsComplete.vi: Thời gian hoàn hảo! Tôi vừa hoàn thành việc nấu chảy tất cả kim loại thành thứ gì đó hữu ích.

dialogsFail.en: Catchers are rare, but Darkon 3 has them all. Keep looking, and make sure to equip your Collector weapon to harvest a Catcher after you defeat it.
dialogsFail.ar: Catchers are rare, but Darkon 3 has them all. Keep looking, and make sure to equip your Collector weapon to harvest a Catcher after you defeat it.
dialogsFail.br: Os Acumuladores são raros, mas Darkon 3 tem todos eles. Continue procurando e não se esqueça de equipar sua arma de Coletor para coletar um Acumulador depois de derrotá-lo.
dialogsFail.cns: Catchers are rare, but Darkon 3 has them all. Keep looking, and make sure to equip your Collector weapon to harvest a Catcher after you defeat it.
dialogsFail.de: Catcher sind selten, aber in Darkon 3 gibt es sie alle. Halte weiter Ausschau und stelle sicher, dass du deine Sammlerwaffe ausrüstest, um einen Catcher zu ernten, nachdem du ihn besiegt hast.
dialogsFail.fi: Catchers are rare, but Darkon 3 has them all. Keep looking, and make sure to equip your Collector weapon to harvest a Catcher after you defeat it.
dialogsFail.fil: Catchers are rare, but Darkon 3 has them all. Keep looking, and make sure to equip your Collector weapon to harvest a Catcher after you defeat it.
dialogsFail.fr: Les Catchers sont rares, mais ils peuvent tous être trouvés à Darkon 3. Continuez de chercher et n'oubliez pas d'équiper votre arme de collecte pour vous assurer de récolter les matériaux après avoir vaincu un Catcher.
dialogsFail.id: Catcher sangat jarang, tetapi Darkon 3 memiliki semuanya. Terus mencari, dan pastikan untuk melengkapi senjata Kolektor Anda untuk memanen Catcher setelah Anda mengalahkannya.
dialogsFail.it: Catchers are rare, but Darkon 3 has them all. Keep looking, and make sure to equip your Collector weapon to harvest a Catcher after you defeat it.
dialogsFail.jp: キャッチャーはまれですが、ダーコン3にはそれらすべてがあります。探し続け、コレクターの武器を装備して、キャッチャーを倒した後にキャッチャーを収穫してください。
dialogsFail.kr: 캐처가 희귀하긴 하지만, 다콘 3에 전부 있습니다. 계속 찾아보세요. 컬렉터 무기로 캐처를 처치하고 재료를 수확하는 것도 잊지 마시고요.
dialogsFail.nl: Catchers are rare, but Darkon 3 has them all. Keep looking, and make sure to equip your Collector weapon to harvest a Catcher after you defeat it.
dialogsFail.pl: Catchers are rare, but Darkon 3 has them all. Keep looking, and make sure to equip your Collector weapon to harvest a Catcher after you defeat it.
dialogsFail.ru: Catchers are rare, but Darkon 3 has them all. Keep looking, and make sure to equip your Collector weapon to harvest a Catcher after you defeat it.
dialogsFail.sp: Los Catchers son raros, pero Darkon 3 los tiene todos. Sigue buscando, y asegúrate de equipar tu arma Coleccionista para cosechar un Atrapador después de derrotarlo.
dialogsFail.sw: Catchers are rare, but Darkon 3 has them all. Keep looking, and make sure to equip your Collector weapon to harvest a Catcher after you defeat it.
dialogsFail.th: Catchers นั้นค่อนข้างหายาก แต่ว่า Darkon 3 มีพวกมันทั้งหมด ลองมองหาต่อไปนะ แล้วก็ต้องแน่ใจว่าเจ้าสวมอาวุธของ Collector เพื่อที่จะได้เก็บของจาก Catcherได้หลังจากกำจัดมันแล้ว
dialogsFail.tw: 捕捉者雖然稀少，但得肯第三區全都找得到。繼續找吧，別忘了擊敗捕捉者後要裝備收集器武器，才能進行採收。
dialogsFail.vi: Catchers rất hiếm, nhưng Darkon 3 có tất cả. Tiếp tục tìm kiếm và đảm bảo trang bị vũ khí Collector của bạn để thu hoạch Catcher sau khi bạn đánh bại nó.

description.en: Collect the Oversized Heart from Beast King Khan.

description.br: Colete o Coração Gigante do Rei das Feras Khan.
description.cns: 从兽王可汗身上获得巨人心脏。

description.fil: Collect the Oversized Heart from Beast King Khan.

description.kr: 야수의 왕 칸에게서 거대 심장을 획득하세요.

description.vi: Thu thập Oversized Heart từ Beast King Khan.

dialogsBegin.en: Beast King Khan, the sovereign of the Wilds, holds dominion over all the untamed creatures dwelling within its depths. His fury befalls any who dare venture too close to his inner sanctum.
dialogsBegin.ar: Beast King Khan, the sovereign of the Wilds, holds dominion over all the untamed creatures dwelling within its depths. His fury befalls any who dare venture too close to his inner sanctum.
dialogsBegin.br: O Rei das Feras Khan, o soberano das Wilds, detém domínio sobre todas as criaturas indomadas que habitam suas profundezas. Sua fúria recai sobre qualquer um que se atreva a se aventurar muito perto de seu santuário interno.
dialogsBegin.cns: Beast King Khan, the sovereign of the Wilds, holds dominion over all the untamed creatures dwelling within its depths. His fury befalls any who dare venture too close to his inner sanctum.
dialogsBegin.de: Der Bestienkönig Khan, der Herrscher der Wildnis, herrscht über alle ungezähmten Kreaturen, die in den Tiefen der Wildnis leben. Sein Zorn trifft jeden, der es wagt, sich seinem inneren Heiligtum zu nähern.
dialogsBegin.fi: Beast King Khan, the sovereign of the Wilds, holds dominion over all the untamed creatures dwelling within its depths. His fury befalls any who dare venture too close to his inner sanctum.
dialogsBegin.fil: Beast King Khan, the sovereign of the Wilds, holds dominion over all the untamed creatures dwelling within its depths. His fury befalls any who dare venture too close to his inner sanctum.
dialogsBegin.fr: Le Roi Remardda, souverain de Désiréa, domine toutes les créatures indomptées qui vivent dans ses profondeurs. Sa fureur s'abat sur tous ceux qui osent s'aventurer trop près de son sanctuaire.
dialogsBegin.id: Beast King Khan, penguasa Wilds, menguasai semua makhluk liar yang tinggal di dalamnya. Amarahnya menimpa siapa pun yang berani mendekati tempat sucinya.
dialogsBegin.it: Beast King Khan, the sovereign of the Wilds, holds dominion over all the untamed creatures dwelling within its depths. His fury befalls any who dare venture too close to his inner sanctum.
dialogsBegin.jp: 荒野の君主である獣王カーンは、その深淵に棲むすべての手つかずの生き物を支配しています。彼の怒りは、彼の内なる聖域に近づきすぎる勇気のある者に降りかかる。
dialogsBegin.kr: 러스티아의 심장부에 서식하는 러스티아의 군주, 야수의 왕 칸은 모든 야수의 위에 군림하고 있습니다. 그의 안식처에 함부로 다가가는 자는 왕의 분노를 맛보게 됩니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Beast King Khan, the sovereign of the Wilds, holds dominion over all the untamed creatures dwelling within its depths. His fury befalls any who dare venture too close to his inner sanctum.
dialogsBegin.pl: Beast King Khan, the sovereign of the Wilds, holds dominion over all the untamed creatures dwelling within its depths. His fury befalls any who dare venture too close to his inner sanctum.
dialogsBegin.ru: Beast King Khan, the sovereign of the Wilds, holds dominion over all the untamed creatures dwelling within its depths. His fury befalls any who dare venture too close to his inner sanctum.
dialogsBegin.sp: El Rey Bestia Khan, el soberano de Lo Salvaje, domina a todas las criaturas indómitas que habitan en sus profundidades. Su furia cae sobre cualquiera que se atreva a acercase a su santuario.
dialogsBegin.sw: Beast King Khan, the sovereign of the Wilds, holds dominion over all the untamed creatures dwelling within its depths. His fury befalls any who dare venture too close to his inner sanctum.
dialogsBegin.th: Beast King Khan ผู้ปกครองแห่ง Wilds ครอบครองอำนาจเหนือสิ่งมีชีวิตดุร้ายทั้งหมดที่อาศัยอยู่ในส่วนลึกขอ Wilds ความโกรธเกรี้ยวของเขาจะเกิดกับทุกคนที่กล้าเสี่ยงเข้ามาในพื้นที่ของเขา
dialogsBegin.tw: 百獸之王可汗，是荒野叢境之主，統御著深處所有未馴化的生物。凡是膽敢靠近他內殿者，都將承受他的怒火。
dialogsBegin.vi: Beast King Khan, kẻ thống trị Wilds, nắm giữ quyền kiểm soát đối với toàn bộ sinh vật hoang dã đang ấn náu tại vùng đất này. Cơn thịnh nộ của nhà vua sẽ giáng lên những kẻ dám tiến đến quá gần thánh địa của hắn.

dialogsBegin.en: Legend speaks of the King's chambers as housing extraordinary treasures, granting those who uncover them unparalleled power. Are you prepared to test the truth of these legends?
dialogsBegin.ar: Legend speaks of the King's chambers as housing extraordinary treasures, granting those who uncover them unparalleled power. Are you prepared to test the truth of these legends?
dialogsBegin.br: A lenda fala das câmaras do Rei como abrigando tesouros extraordinários, concedendo àqueles que os descobrem um poder incomparável. Você está preparado para testar a veracidade dessas lendas?
dialogsBegin.cns: Legend speaks of the King's chambers as housing extraordinary treasures, granting those who uncover them unparalleled power. Are you prepared to test the truth of these legends?
dialogsBegin.de: Die Legende besagt, dass die Kammern des Königs außergewöhnliche Schätze beherbergen, die demjenigen, der sie entdeckt, unvergleichliche Macht verleihen. Bist du bereit, die Wahrheit dieser Legenden herauszufinden?
dialogsBegin.fi: Legend speaks of the King's chambers as housing extraordinary treasures, granting those who uncover them unparalleled power. Are you prepared to test the truth of these legends?
dialogsBegin.fil: Legend speaks of the King's chambers as housing extraordinary treasures, granting those who uncover them unparalleled power. Are you prepared to test the truth of these legends?
dialogsBegin.fr: Selon la légende, les chambres du Roi abritent des trésors extraordinaires qui confèrent à ceux qui les découvrent des pouvoirs inégalés. Êtes-vous prêt à vérifier la véracité de ces légendes ?
dialogsBegin.id: Legenda mengatakan bahwa kamar-kamar Raja menyimpan harta karun yang luar biasa, yang memberikan kekuatan tak tertandingi bagi siapa pun yang menemukannya. Apakah kamu siap untuk menguji kebenaran legenda ini?
dialogsBegin.it: Legend speaks of the King's chambers as housing extraordinary treasures, granting those who uncover them unparalleled power. Are you prepared to test the truth of these legends?
dialogsBegin.jp: 伝説によると、王の部屋には並外れた宝物が収められており、それを発見した者には比類のない力が与えられます。これらの伝説の真実をテストする準備はできていますか?
dialogsBegin.kr: 전설에 따르면 왕의 알현실에는 특별한 보물이 숨겨져 있는데, 이 보물을 발견하는 자는 범접할 수 없는 힘을 손에 넣는다고 합니다. 과연 진짜일지 확인할 준비가 되셨나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Legend speaks of the King's chambers as housing extraordinary treasures, granting those who uncover them unparalleled power. Are you prepared to test the truth of these legends?
dialogsBegin.pl: Legend speaks of the King's chambers as housing extraordinary treasures, granting those who uncover them unparalleled power. Are you prepared to test the truth of these legends?
dialogsBegin.ru: Legend speaks of the King's chambers as housing extraordinary treasures, granting those who uncover them unparalleled power. Are you prepared to test the truth of these legends?
dialogsBegin.sp: La leyenda habla de que las cámaras del Rey albergan tesoros extraordinarios que otorgan un poder incomparable. ¿Estás preparado para corroborar estas leyendas?
dialogsBegin.sw: Legend speaks of the King's chambers as housing extraordinary treasures, granting those who uncover them unparalleled power. Are you prepared to test the truth of these legends?
dialogsBegin.th: ตำนานเล่าขานว่าห้องของราชามีสมบัติล้ำค่ามากมาย ผู้ที่ค้นพบจะได้รับพลังที่ไม่มีใครเทียบได้ คุณพร้อมที่จะทดสอบความจริงของตำนานเหล่านี้หรือยัง
dialogsBegin.tw: 傳說中，王之密室藏有驚人的寶藏，能賜予發現者無與倫比的力量。你準備好去驗證這傳說的真偽了嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Truyền thuyết kể rằng các căn phòng của Nhà vua là nơi chứa những kho báu đặc biệt, ban cho những ai khám phá ra chúng sức mạnh vô song. Bạn đã sẵn sàng để kiểm tra sự thật của những truyền thuyết này chưa?

dialogsAccept.en: Your time has come to confront the King, hero. Stand against the mighty King Beast Khan, and collect the spoils of your brave endeavors!
dialogsAccept.ar: Your time has come to confront the King, hero. Stand against the mighty King Beast Khan, and collect the spoils of your brave endeavors!
dialogsAccept.br: Chegou a sua hora de confrontar o Rei, herói. Enfrente o poderoso Rei das Feras Khan e colete os despojos de seus bravos esforços!
dialogsAccept.cns: Your time has come to confront the King, hero. Stand against the mighty King Beast Khan, and collect the spoils of your brave endeavors!
dialogsAccept.de: Deine Zeit ist gekommen, dich dem König zu stellen, Held. Stelle dich dem mächtigen Bestienkönig Khan entgegen und sammle die Beute deiner mutigen Unternehmungen!
dialogsAccept.fi: Your time has come to confront the King, hero. Stand against the mighty King Beast Khan, and collect the spoils of your brave endeavors!
dialogsAccept.fil: Your time has come to confront the King, hero. Stand against the mighty King Beast Khan, and collect the spoils of your brave endeavors!
dialogsAccept.fr: L'heure est venue d'affronter le Roi. Affrontez le puissant Remardda et recueillez les fruits de vos courageux efforts !
dialogsAccept.id: Waktumu telah tiba untuk menghadapi sang Raja, sang pahlawan. Lawanlah sang King Beast Khan yang perkasa, dan kumpulkan hasil rampasan dari usahamu yang berani!
dialogsAccept.it: Your time has come to confront the King, hero. Stand against the mighty King Beast Khan, and collect the spoils of your brave endeavors!
dialogsAccept.jp: 英雄である王に立ち向かう時が来ました。強大なビーストカーン王に立ち向かい、勇敢な戦いの戦利品を集めましょう!
dialogsAccept.kr: 이제 야수의 왕과 맞설 때가 왔군요, 용사님. 야수의 왕 칸에게 용감하게 맞서고, 그 용기에 걸맞은 전리품을 손에 넣으세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Your time has come to confront the King, hero. Stand against the mighty King Beast Khan, and collect the spoils of your brave endeavors!
dialogsAccept.pl: Your time has come to confront the King, hero. Stand against the mighty King Beast Khan, and collect the spoils of your brave endeavors!
dialogsAccept.ru: Your time has come to confront the King, hero. Stand against the mighty King Beast Khan, and collect the spoils of your brave endeavors!
dialogsAccept.sp: Ha llegado el momento de enfrentarse al Rey, héroe. ¡Enfréntate al poderoso Rey Bestia Khan y recoge el botín por tus esfuerzos!
dialogsAccept.sw: Your time has come to confront the King, hero. Stand against the mighty King Beast Khan, and collect the spoils of your brave endeavors!
dialogsAccept.th: ถึงเวลาแล้วที่คุณต้องเผชิญหน้ากับราชา ยืนหยัดต่อสู้ King Beast Khan และรับรางวัลจากความพยายามอันกล้าหาญของคุณ!
dialogsAccept.tw: 面對王者的時刻已經到了，英雄。挺身對抗百獸之王可汗，帶回屬於你英勇冒險的戰利品吧！
dialogsAccept.vi: Đã đến lúc bạn phải đối đầu với Nhà vua, anh hùng. Hãy chống lại King Beast Khan hùng mạnh và thu thập chiến lợi phẩm từ những nỗ lực dũng cảm của bạn!

dialogsDecline.en: Take all the time you require to make your preparations. The Beast King will surely remain within.
dialogsDecline.ar: Take all the time you require to make your preparations. The Beast King will surely remain within.
dialogsDecline.br: Tome todo o tempo necessário para fazer seus preparativos. O Rei das Feras certamente permanecerá dentro.
dialogsDecline.cns: Take all the time you require to make your preparations. The Beast King will surely remain within.
dialogsDecline.de: Nimm dir alle Zeit, die du brauchst, um deine Vorbereitungen zu treffen. Der Bestienkönig wird sicher im Inneren bleiben.
dialogsDecline.fi: Take all the time you require to make your preparations. The Beast King will surely remain within.
dialogsDecline.fil: Take all the time you require to make your preparations. The Beast King will surely remain within.
dialogsDecline.fr: Prenez tout votre temps pour vous préparer. Remardda ne bougera pas.
dialogsDecline.id: Luangkan waktu sebanyak yang kau perlukan untuk mempersiapkan diri. Beast King pasti akan tetap di dalam.
dialogsDecline.it: Take all the time you require to make your preparations. The Beast King will surely remain within.
dialogsDecline.jp: 準備に必要なすべての時間をかけてください。獣王はきっとその中に残るだろう。
dialogsDecline.kr: 시간을 충분하니 꼼꼼히 준비하세요. 야수의 왕은 분명히 그 안에 있을 겁니다.
dialogsDecline.nl: Take all the time you require to make your preparations. The Beast King will surely remain within.
dialogsDecline.pl: Take all the time you require to make your preparations. The Beast King will surely remain within.
dialogsDecline.ru: Take all the time you require to make your preparations. The Beast King will surely remain within.
dialogsDecline.sp: Tómate el tiempo que necesites para prepararte. El Rey Bestia seguramente permanecerá dentro.
dialogsDecline.sw: Take all the time you require to make your preparations. The Beast King will surely remain within.
dialogsDecline.th: ใช้เวลาให้เต็มที่กับการเตรียมตัว ราชาสัตว์ร้ายอยู่ภายในอย่างแน่นอน
dialogsDecline.tw: 你儘管慢慢做準備，獸王肯定還會待在裡頭等著。
dialogsDecline.vi: Hãy dành tất cả thời gian bạn cần để chuẩn bị. Beast King chắc chắn sẽ ở lại bên trong.

dialogsComplete.ar: Astounding, hero! You've vanquished the very King of Beasts himself!

dialogsComplete.fi: Astounding, hero! You've vanquished the very King of Beasts himself!
dialogsComplete.fil: Astounding, hero! You've vanquished the very King of Beasts himself!
dialogsComplete.fr: Stupéfiant ! Vous avez vaincu le roi des bêtes en personne !
dialogsComplete.id: Hebat sekali, pahlawan! Kau telah mengalahkan King of Beasts itu sendiri!

dialogsComplete.th: น่าทึ่งมาก ฮีโร่! คุณได้ปราบราชาแห่งสัตว์ร้ายได้แล้ว!

dialogsBegin.en: Smelting all this metal down for use will take a while. You may want to find an armorsmith to determine what else will be needed until I finish my work.
dialogsBegin.ar: Smelting all this metal down for use will take a while. You may want to find an armorsmith to determine what else will be needed until I finish my work.
dialogsBegin.br: Derreter todo esse metal vai demorar. Talvez seja bom procurar um ferreiro para ver o que mais a gente vai precisar enquanto eu termino minha parte.
dialogsBegin.cns: Smelting all this metal down for use will take a while. You may want to find an armorsmith to determine what else will be needed until I finish my work.
dialogsBegin.de: Es wird eine Weile dauern, all dieses Metall einzuschmelzen, um es zu verwenden. Du solltest vielleicht einen Rüstungsschmied aufsuchen, um festzustellen, was noch benötigt wird, bis ich meine Arbeit beendet habe.
dialogsBegin.fi: Smelting all this metal down for use will take a while. You may want to find an armorsmith to determine what else will be needed until I finish my work.
dialogsBegin.fil: Smelting all this metal down for use will take a while. You may want to find an armorsmith to determine what else will be needed until I finish my work.
dialogsBegin.fr: Fondre tout ce métal va prendre un moment. En attendant que je termine, vous devriez vous rapprocher d'un armurier pour voir si vous avez besoin d'autre chose.
dialogsBegin.id: Peleburan semua logam ini untuk digunakan akan memakan waktu cukup lama. Anda mungkin ingin mencari tukang senjata untuk menentukan apa lagi yang dibutuhkan sampai saya menyelesaikan pekerjaan saya.
dialogsBegin.it: Smelting all this metal down for use will take a while. You may want to find an armorsmith to determine what else will be needed until I finish my work.
dialogsBegin.jp: 使用のためにこのすべての金属を製錬するにはしばらく時間がかかります。私が仕事を終えるまで、他に何が必要かを判断するために、鎧細工師を見つけることをお勧めします。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 금속을 사용할 수 있게 전부 제련하려면 좀 걸릴 거예요. 제가 작업하는 동안 다른 준비도 먼저 해두시려면, 방어구 장인을 찾아가는 게 좋겠군요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Smelting all this metal down for use will take a while. You may want to find an armorsmith to determine what else will be needed until I finish my work.
dialogsBegin.pl: Smelting all this metal down for use will take a while. You may want to find an armorsmith to determine what else will be needed until I finish my work.
dialogsBegin.ru: Smelting all this metal down for use will take a while. You may want to find an armorsmith to determine what else will be needed until I finish my work.
dialogsBegin.sp: Fundir todo este metal para usarlo llevará un tiempo. Puede que quieras encontrar un herrero para determinar qué más se necesitará hasta que termine mi trabajo.
dialogsBegin.sw: Smelting all this metal down for use will take a while. You may want to find an armorsmith to determine what else will be needed until I finish my work.
dialogsBegin.th: หลอมโลหะทั้งหมดนี่มันจะใช้เวลาซักพัก เจ้าน่าจะต้องไปหาช่างทำเกราะเพื่อจะได้ตัดสินใจว่าอะไรอีกที่จำเป็นจนกว่าข้าจะเสร็จงานทั้งหมด
dialogsBegin.tw: 要把這些金屬全都熔煉成可用材料，還需要一點時間。趁我工作的這段期間，你最好先去找位鎧甲匠，看看之後還需要準備哪些東西。
dialogsBegin.vi: Nấu chảy tất cả kim loại này để sử dụng sẽ mất một thời gian. Bạn có thể muốn tìm một thợ rèn áo giáp để xác định những gì khác sẽ cần thiết cho đến khi tôi hoàn thành công việc của mình.

dialogsAccept.sw: Out in the Village of Kan there is a talented craftsman named Chenbing Khan who can guide you further.
dialogsAccept.th: ที่ หมู่บ้าน Kan มีช่างฝีมือมีพรสวรรค์ชื่อ Chenbing Khan ที่จะสามารถแนะนำเจ้าได้
dialogsAccept.tw: 在坎恩村有一位天才工匠，名叫趁風可汗，他可以指導你進一步。
dialogsAccept.vi: Ở làng Kan có craftsman tài năng tên là Chenbing Khan, người có thể hướng dẫn bạn thêm.

dialogsDecline.en: Well you could just wait here... but time is ticking, better to get other tasks out of the way.
dialogsDecline.ar: Well you could just wait here... but time is ticking, better to get other tasks out of the way.
dialogsDecline.br: Ah, você até poderia ficar aqui esperando... mas o relógio tá correndo, é melhor dar um jeito em outras tarefas primeiro.
dialogsDecline.cns: Well you could just wait here... but time is ticking, better to get other tasks out of the way.
dialogsDecline.de: Nun, du könntest einfach hier warten... aber die Zeit läuft, es ist besser, andere Aufgaben aus dem Weg zu räumen.
dialogsDecline.fi: Well you could just wait here... but time is ticking, better to get other tasks out of the way.
dialogsDecline.fil: Well you could just wait here... but time is ticking, better to get other tasks out of the way.
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous pourriez attendre ici... mais le temps passe vite, il vaut mieux s'atteler à d'autres tâches.
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu bisa saja menunggu di sini.. tetapi waktu terus berjalan, lebih baik selesaikan tugas lain.
dialogsDecline.it: Well you could just wait here... but time is ticking, better to get other tasks out of the way.
dialogsDecline.jp: さて、あなたはここで待つことができます..しかし、時間は刻々と過ぎており、他のタスクを邪魔にならないようにする方が良いです。
dialogsDecline.kr: 여기서 기다리셔도 되지만... 시간이 촉박하니, 다른 일을 처리하고 오시는 게 좋겠어요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Well you could just wait here... but time is ticking, better to get other tasks out of the way.
dialogsDecline.pl: Well you could just wait here... but time is ticking, better to get other tasks out of the way.
dialogsDecline.ru: Well you could just wait here... but time is ticking, better to get other tasks out of the way.
dialogsDecline.sp: Bueno, podrías esperar aquí... pero el tiempo corre, mejor quitarse otras tareas de encima.
dialogsDecline.sw: Well you could just wait here... but time is ticking, better to get other tasks out of the way.
dialogsDecline.th: เจ้าจะรออยู่ก่อนก็ได้ แต่ว่าเวลาไม่เคยคอยใคร ทางที่ดีเจ้ารีบไปทำงานอื่นในระหว่างรอดีกว่า
dialogsDecline.tw: 你當然也可以就站在這裡等……不過時間緊迫，還是趁現在先把其他事辦一辦比較好。
dialogsDecline.vi: Chà, bạn có thể đợi ở đây .. nhưng thời gian đang trôi qua, tốt hơn hết là bạn nên thu xếp hoàn thành trước các nhiệm vụ khác.

dialogsComplete.en: It's nice Nein thinks enough of me to send you my way. I run a humble armor shop here in my village, and know all the secrets of how to improve simple weapons into deadly munitions.
dialogsComplete.ar: It's nice Nein thinks enough of me to send you my way. I run a humble armor shop here in my village, and know all the secrets of how to improve simple weapons into deadly munitions.
dialogsComplete.br: É bom que o Nein tenha pensado em mim e te enviado até aqui. Eu administro uma humilde loja de armaduras aqui na minha vila e conheço todos os segredos de como transformar armas simples em armas letais.
dialogsComplete.cns: It's nice Nein thinks enough of me to send you my way. I run a humble armor shop here in my village, and know all the secrets of how to improve simple weapons into deadly munitions.
dialogsComplete.de: Es ist schön, dass Shin genug von mir hält, um dich zu mir zu schicken. Ich betreibe einen bescheidenen Rüstungsladen hier in meinem Dorf und kenne alle Geheimnisse, wie man einfache Waffen in tödliche Munition verwandelt.
dialogsComplete.fi: It's nice Nein thinks enough of me to send you my way. I run a humble armor shop here in my village, and know all the secrets of how to improve simple weapons into deadly munitions.
dialogsComplete.fil: It's nice Nein thinks enough of me to send you my way. I run a humble armor shop here in my village, and know all the secrets of how to improve simple weapons into deadly munitions.
dialogsComplete.fr: C'est bien que Nein ait assez d'estime pour moi pour vous envoyer ici. Je tiens une modeste boutique d'armures dans mon village et je connais tous les secrets pour transformer de simples armes en munitions mortelles.
dialogsComplete.id: Sangat menyenangkan Nein cukup memikirkan saya untuk mengirim Anda ke jalan saya. Saya menjalankan toko senjata sederhana di sini di desa saya, dan mengetahui semua rahasia bagaimana meningkatkan senjata sederhana menjadi amunisi yang mematikan.
dialogsComplete.it: It's nice Nein thinks enough of me to send you my way. I run a humble armor shop here in my village, and know all the secrets of how to improve simple weapons into deadly munitions.
dialogsComplete.jp: ネインが私のことを十分に考えてくれて、あなたを私の道に送ってくれるのはいいことです。私はここ村で謙虚な鎧屋を経営しており、単純な武器を致命的な弾薬に改良する方法のすべての秘密を知っています。
dialogsComplete.kr: 당신을 여기 보내다니, 네인이 저를 잊지는 않았네요. 저는 이곳 마을에서 작은 방어구 가게를 하고 있답니다. 간단한 무기를 치명적인 병기로 만드는 온갖 비법을 알고 있죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: It's nice Nein thinks enough of me to send you my way. I run a humble armor shop here in my village, and know all the secrets of how to improve simple weapons into deadly munitions.
dialogsComplete.pl: It's nice Nein thinks enough of me to send you my way. I run a humble armor shop here in my village, and know all the secrets of how to improve simple weapons into deadly munitions.
dialogsComplete.ru: It's nice Nein thinks enough of me to send you my way. I run a humble armor shop here in my village, and know all the secrets of how to improve simple weapons into deadly munitions.
dialogsComplete.sp: Es agradable que Nein piense lo suficiente en mí como para enviarte a mi casa. Dirijo una humilde tienda de armaduras aquí en mi pueblo, y conozco todos los secretos de cómo mejorar armas sencillas para convertirlas en municiones mortales.
dialogsComplete.sw: It's nice Nein thinks enough of me to send you my way. I run a humble armor shop here in my village, and know all the secrets of how to improve simple weapons into deadly munitions.
dialogsComplete.th: มันดีมากที่ Nein ยังคงนึกถึงข้าพอที่จะส่งเจ้ามาหา ข้าแค่เปิดร้านเกราะเล็ก ๆ ที่หมู่บ้านแห่งนี้ และข้าก็รู้ความลับของการเปลี่ยนอาวุธธรรมดาให้กลายเป็นอาวุธอันตรายได้
dialogsComplete.tw: 奈因看得起我，才會把你派來找我。我在這個村子裡經營一家小小的鎧甲店，也很清楚該怎麼把普通材料強化成致命兵裝。
dialogsComplete.vi: Thật tốt là Nein nghĩ đủ về tôi để gửi bạn cách của tôi. Tôi điều hành một cửa hàng áo giáp khiêm tốn ở đây trong làng của mình và biết tất cả những bí mật về cách cải tiến vũ khí đơn giản thành vũ khí chết người.

dialogsBegin.en: Thank you for finding the break in the wall... I have sent a guard to prevent unsuspecting travelers from entering the cavern.
dialogsBegin.ar: Thank you for finding the break in the wall... I have sent a guard to prevent unsuspecting travelers from entering the cavern.
dialogsBegin.br: Valeu por achar a rachadura na parede... Mandei um guarda pra não deixar aventureiros desprevenidos entrarem na caverna.
dialogsBegin.cns: Thank you for finding the break in the wall... I have sent a guard to prevent unsuspecting travelers from entering the cavern.
dialogsBegin.de: Danke, dass du das Loch in der Wand gefunden hast...Ich habe einen Wächter gesendet, um unschuldige Reisende davon abzuhalten, die Höhle zu betreten.
dialogsBegin.fi: Thank you for finding the break in the wall... I have sent a guard to prevent unsuspecting travelers from entering the cavern.
dialogsBegin.fil: Thank you for finding the break in the wall... I have sent a guard to prevent unsuspecting travelers from entering the cavern.
dialogsBegin.fr: Merci d'avoir trouvé la brèche dans le mur... J'ai envoyé un garde pour empêcher les voyageurs sans méfiance de rentrer dans la caverne.
dialogsBegin.id: Terima kasih telah menemukan celah di dinding.. Aku telah mengirimkan penjaga untuk mencegah traveler yang tidak menaruh curiga memasuki gua.
dialogsBegin.it: Thank you for finding the break in the wall... I have sent a guard to prevent unsuspecting travelers from entering the cavern.
dialogsBegin.jp: 壁の切れ目を見つけていただきありがとうございます。無防備な旅行者が洞窟に入るのを防ぐために警備員を派遣しました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 벽의 균열을 찾아주셔서 감사합니다. 순진한 여행자들이 동굴에 우연히 들어가는 일이 없도록, 경비병을 보냈습니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Thank you for finding the break in the wall... I have sent a guard to prevent unsuspecting travelers from entering the cavern.
dialogsBegin.pl: Thank you for finding the break in the wall... I have sent a guard to prevent unsuspecting travelers from entering the cavern.
dialogsBegin.ru: Thank you for finding the break in the wall... I have sent a guard to prevent unsuspecting travelers from entering the cavern.
dialogsBegin.sp: Gracias por encontrar la ruptura en la pared .. He enviado un guardia para evitar que viajeros desprevenidos entren en la caverna.
dialogsBegin.sw: Thank you for finding the break in the wall... I have sent a guard to prevent unsuspecting travelers from entering the cavern.
dialogsBegin.th: ขอบคุณเจ้ามากที่หารอยแตกในกำแพงเจอ ข้าส่งการ์ดไปป้องกันที่คนไม่รู้เรื่องเข้าไปสู่ถ้ำแล้ว
dialogsBegin.tw: 謝謝你找到那面破損的牆……我已經派了一名守衛去阻止不知情的旅人闖進那座洞窟。
dialogsBegin.vi: Cảm ơn bạn đã tìm ra lỗ hổng trên bức tường.. Tôi đã cử một lính gác để ngăn chặn những kẻ du hành nhẹ dạ vào hang rồi.

dialogsBegin.en: I believe our next step will be to explore the cavern and see what Lapranche has unleashed upon us...
dialogsBegin.ar: I believe our next step will be to explore the cavern and see what Lapranche has unleashed upon us...
dialogsBegin.br: Acredito que nosso próximo passo será explorar a caverna e ver o que Lapranche libertou sobre nós.
dialogsBegin.cns: I believe our next step will be to explore the cavern and see what Lapranche has unleashed upon us...
dialogsBegin.de: Ich glaube, unser nächster Schritt sollte sein, die Höhle zu erforschen und zu sehen, was Lapranche auf uns losgelassen hat.
dialogsBegin.fi: I believe our next step will be to explore the cavern and see what Lapranche has unleashed upon us...
dialogsBegin.fil: I believe our next step will be to explore the cavern and see what Lapranche has unleashed upon us...
dialogsBegin.fr: Je pense que notre prochaine étape sera d'explorer la caverne et de voir ce que Lapranche a déchaîné sur nous.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku percaya langkah kita selanjutnya adalah menjelajahi gua dan melihat apa yang telah dilepaskan Lapranche kepada kita..
dialogsBegin.it: I believe our next step will be to explore the cavern and see what Lapranche has unleashed upon us...
dialogsBegin.jp: 次のステップは、洞窟を探索し、ラプランシュが私たちに何を解き放ったかを確認することだと思います。
dialogsBegin.kr: 아마 다음 임무는 동굴을 탐험해서 라프란체가 풀어놓은 게 무엇인지 확인하는 일일 겁니다...
dialogsBegin.nl: I believe our next step will be to explore the cavern and see what Lapranche has unleashed upon us...
dialogsBegin.pl: I believe our next step will be to explore the cavern and see what Lapranche has unleashed upon us...
dialogsBegin.ru: I believe our next step will be to explore the cavern and see what Lapranche has unleashed upon us...
dialogsBegin.sp: Creo que nuestro próximo paso será explorar la caverna y ver lo que Lapranche ha desatado sobre nosotros..
dialogsBegin.sw: I believe our next step will be to explore the cavern and see what Lapranche has unleashed upon us...
dialogsBegin.th: ข้าเชื่อว่าขั้นต่อไปของพวกเราคือการสำรวจถ้ำและดูว่า Lapranche ได้ปลดปล่อยอะไรมาบ้าง
dialogsBegin.tw: 我想我們下一步，就是進入那座洞窟，看看拉普蘭雪到底放出了什麼東西……
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi tin rằng bước tiếp theo của chúng ta sẽ là khám phá hang động và xem những gì Lapranche đã thả ra ngoài....

dialogsBegin.en: There is no hope in standing against Lapranche on our own. We must build an army of warriors, ensuring each is equipped with the weapons and armor needed to succeed.
dialogsBegin.ar: There is no hope in standing against Lapranche on our own. We must build an army of warriors, ensuring each is equipped with the weapons and armor needed to succeed.
dialogsBegin.br: Não adianta tentar encarar a Lapranche sozinho, não tem como! Precisamos reunir uma legião de guerreiros, cada um com as armas e armaduras certas, prontos pra detonar!
dialogsBegin.cns: There is no hope in standing against Lapranche on our own. We must build an army of warriors, ensuring each is equipped with the weapons and armor needed to succeed.
dialogsBegin.de: Es gibt keine Hoffnung, Lapranche allein zu besiegen. Wir müssen eine Armee von Kriegern aufbauen und dafür sorgen, dass jeder mit den Waffen und der Rüstung ausgestattet ist, die er braucht, um erfolgreich zu sein.
dialogsBegin.fi: There is no hope in standing against Lapranche on our own. We must build an army of warriors, ensuring each is equipped with the weapons and armor needed to succeed.
dialogsBegin.fil: There is no hope in standing against Lapranche on our own. We must build an army of warriors, ensuring each is equipped with the weapons and armor needed to succeed.
dialogsBegin.fr: S'opposer seul à Lapranche est peine perdue. Nous devons constituer une armée de guerriers, en veillant à ce que chacun soit équipé des armes et de l'armure appropriées pour garantir la victoire !
dialogsBegin.id: Tidak ada harapan untuk berdiri sendiri melawan Lapranche. Kita harus membangun pasukan prajurit, memastikan masing-masing dilengkapi dengan senjata dan baju besi yang dibutuhkan untuk berhasil.
dialogsBegin.it: There is no hope in standing against Lapranche on our own. We must build an army of warriors, ensuring each is equipped with the weapons and armor needed to succeed.
dialogsBegin.jp: 私たちだけでラプランシュに立ち向かうことに希望はありません。私たちは戦士の軍隊を構築し、それぞれが成功するために必要な武器と鎧を装備していることを確認する必要があります。
dialogsBegin.kr: 우리 힘만으로 라프란체에 맞서기엔 역부족입니다. 무기와 방어구로 충분히 무장한 전사 부대가 있어야 이길 수 있을 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: There is no hope in standing against Lapranche on our own. We must build an army of warriors, ensuring each is equipped with the weapons and armor needed to succeed.
dialogsBegin.pl: There is no hope in standing against Lapranche on our own. We must build an army of warriors, ensuring each is equipped with the weapons and armor needed to succeed.
dialogsBegin.ru: There is no hope in standing against Lapranche on our own. We must build an army of warriors, ensuring each is equipped with the weapons and armor needed to succeed.
dialogsBegin.sp: No hay esperanza en enfrentarnos a Lapranche nosotros solos. Debemos formar un ejército de guerreros, asegurándonos de que cada uno esté equipado con las armas y armaduras necesarias para triunfar.
dialogsBegin.sw: There is no hope in standing against Lapranche on our own. We must build an army of warriors, ensuring each is equipped with the weapons and armor needed to succeed.
dialogsBegin.th: มัน แทบจะไม่มีหวังที่จะต่อต้าน Lapranche ได้ด้วยตัวพวกเราเองเลย เราต้องรวบรวมเหล่านักรบ และมั่นใจว่าทุกคนมีอาวุธและชุดเกราะที่พร้อมสำหรับความสำเร็จแล้ว
dialogsBegin.tw: 靠我們自己對抗拉普朗什是沒有希望的。我們必須建立一支戰士軍隊，確保每個人都配備成功所需的武器和盔甲。
dialogsBegin.vi: Không có hy vọng tự mình chống lại Lapranche. Chúng ta phải xây dựng một đội quân warriors, đảm bảo mỗi người đều được trang bị vũ khí và áo giáp cần thiết để thành công.

dialogsAccept.en: In the Deadwallderness lives a smelter who has experience with unique requests. Tell Nein of our plan, and see what help he can offer.
dialogsAccept.ar: In the Deadwallderness lives a smelter who has experience with unique requests. Tell Nein of our plan, and see what help he can offer.
dialogsAccept.br: No Deserto da Morte vive um ferreiro que tem experiência com pedidos especiais. Fale com Nein sobre nosso plano e veja que ajuda ele pode oferecer.
dialogsAccept.cns: In the Deadwallderness lives a smelter who has experience with unique requests. Tell Nein of our plan, and see what help he can offer.
dialogsAccept.de: In der toten Wüste lebt ein Schmied, der Erfahrung mit einzigartigen Anfragen hat. Berichte Nein von unserem Plan und frage ihn, ob er dir helfen kann.
dialogsAccept.fi: In the Deadwallderness lives a smelter who has experience with unique requests. Tell Nein of our plan, and see what help he can offer.
dialogsAccept.fil: In the Deadwallderness lives a smelter who has experience with unique requests. Tell Nein of our plan, and see what help he can offer.
dialogsAccept.fr: Dans la Désolation, il y a un fondeur qui sait y faire avec les demandes sortant de l'ordinaire. Informez Nein de notre projet et voyez s'il peut vous aider.
dialogsAccept.id: Di Deadwallderness tinggal seorang pelebur yang memiliki pengalaman dengan permintaan unik. Beri tahu Nein tentang rencana kita, dan lihat bantuan apa yang bisa dia tawarkan.
dialogsAccept.it: In the Deadwallderness lives a smelter who has experience with unique requests. Tell Nein of our plan, and see what help he can offer.
dialogsAccept.jp: デッドウォールダーネスには、ユニークなリクエストの経験を持つ製錬所が住んでいます。ネインに私たちの計画を伝え、彼が提供できる助けを見てください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 데드월드니스에는 독특한 의뢰를 다룬 적이 있는 제련사가 있어요. 네인에게 우리 계획을 말하고, 어떤 도움을 받을 수 있는지 알아보세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: In the Deadwallderness lives a smelter who has experience with unique requests. Tell Nein of our plan, and see what help he can offer.
dialogsAccept.pl: In the Deadwallderness lives a smelter who has experience with unique requests. Tell Nein of our plan, and see what help he can offer.
dialogsAccept.ru: In the Deadwallderness lives a smelter who has experience with unique requests. Tell Nein of our plan, and see what help he can offer.
dialogsAccept.sp: En el Bosque de los Muertos vive un fundidor que tiene experiencia con pedidos únicos. Cuéntale a Nein nuestro plan, a ver qué ayuda puede ofrecerte.
dialogsAccept.sw: In the Deadwallderness lives a smelter who has experience with unique requests. Tell Nein of our plan, and see what help he can offer.
dialogsAccept.th: ใน Deadwallderness มีนักถลุงแร่ที่เคยได้รับคำขอพิเศษ ๆ มากมาย บอก Nein ถึงแผนของพวกเรา และดูว่าเขาจะช่วยอะไรพวกเราได้บ้าง
dialogsAccept.tw: 在死寂荒原裡，有位熔匠很擅長處理這類特殊委託。把我們的計畫告訴奈因，看看他能提供什麼協助。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tại Deadwallderness có một thợ rèn có kinh nghiệm xử lý các yêu cầu độc nhất vô nhị. Kể cho Nein nghe về kế hoạch của chúng ta, và xem anh ấy có thể giúp được gì.

dialogsDecline.en: *Scoff* What, will you smelt the materials for equipment all on your own?
dialogsDecline.ar: *Scoff* What, will you smelt the materials for equipment all on your own?
dialogsDecline.br: *Indignado* O quê? Você vai mesmo fundir os materiais para as armas e armaduras sozinho?
dialogsDecline.cns: *Scoff* What, will you smelt the materials for equipment all on your own?
dialogsDecline.de: *hüstel* Was, du willst die Materialien für die Ausrüstung ganz alleine schmelzen?
dialogsDecline.fi: *Scoff* What, will you smelt the materials for equipment all on your own?
dialogsDecline.fil: *Scoff* What, will you smelt the materials for equipment all on your own?
dialogsDecline.fr: *se moquant* Quoi, vous allez fondre les matériaux d'équipement tout seul ?
dialogsDecline.id: *Mencemooh* Apa, akankah kau melebur material untuk peralatan sendiri?
dialogsDecline.it: *Scoff* What, will you smelt the materials for equipment all on your own?
dialogsDecline.jp: *嘲笑*何、あなたはすべて自分で機器の材料を製錬しますか?
dialogsDecline.kr: *콧방귀* 뭡니까, 장비 재료를 혼자서 전부 제련하기라도 할 겁니까?
dialogsDecline.nl: *Scoff* What, will you smelt the materials for equipment all on your own?
dialogsDecline.pl: *Scoff* What, will you smelt the materials for equipment all on your own?
dialogsDecline.ru: *Scoff* What, will you smelt the materials for equipment all on your own?
dialogsDecline.sp: *Scoff* ¿Qué, vas a fundir los materiales para el equipamiento tú solo?
dialogsDecline.sw: *Scoff* What, will you smelt the materials for equipment all on your own?
dialogsDecline.th: *แค่ก* อะไร? เจ้าจะหลอมวัตถุดิบทั้งหมดเพื่อทำเครื่องสวมใส่เองทั้งหมดเลย?
dialogsDecline.tw: *嗤笑* 怎麼，你該不會打算自己把整支軍隊的裝備材料都熔煉完吧？
dialogsDecline.vi: *Chế giễu* Cái gì, bạn sẽ tự nấu chảy nguyên liệu cho thiết bị à?

dialogsComplete.en: So there's trouble... Well if Laola has sent you, I am much obliged to help if I can.
dialogsComplete.ar: So there's trouble... Well if Laola has sent you, I am much obliged to help if I can.
dialogsComplete.br: Então, temos problemas... Bem, se Laola te enviou, ficarei muito grato em ajudar, se puder.
dialogsComplete.cns: So there's trouble... Well if Laola has sent you, I am much obliged to help if I can.
dialogsComplete.de: Es gibt also Ärger...Wenn dich Laola geschickt hat, wede ich dir sehr gerne helfen, wenn ich kann.
dialogsComplete.fi: So there's trouble... Well if Laola has sent you, I am much obliged to help if I can.
dialogsComplete.fil: So there's trouble... Well if Laola has sent you, I am much obliged to help if I can.
dialogsComplete.fr: Il y a donc de quoi s'inquiéter... Si Laola vous a envoyé, je me dois de vous aider dans la mesure du possible.
dialogsComplete.id: Jadi ada masalah.. Nah kalau Laola sudah kirim, aku sangat wajib membantu kalau bisa.
dialogsComplete.it: So there's trouble... Well if Laola has sent you, I am much obliged to help if I can.
dialogsComplete.jp: だから問題があります..ラオラがあなたを送ったのなら、私はできれば助ける義務があります。
dialogsComplete.kr: 문제가 있단 얘기군요... 라올라가 당신을 보냈다면, 저도 최대한 도와야겠죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: So there's trouble... Well if Laola has sent you, I am much obliged to help if I can.
dialogsComplete.pl: So there's trouble... Well if Laola has sent you, I am much obliged to help if I can.
dialogsComplete.ru: So there's trouble... Well if Laola has sent you, I am much obliged to help if I can.
dialogsComplete.sp: Así que hay problemas .. Bueno, si Laola te ha enviado, estoy obligado a ayudar si puedo.
dialogsComplete.sw: So there's trouble... Well if Laola has sent you, I am much obliged to help if I can.
dialogsComplete.th: มันค่อนขางเอาเรื่องอยู่เหมือนกัน แต่ถ้า Laola ได้ส่งเจ้ามา ข้าก็จำเป็นที่จะต้องช่วยถ้าข้าทำได้
dialogsComplete.tw: 所以真的出事了……好吧，既然是拉宇派你來的，只要我幫得上忙，就一定會幫。
dialogsComplete.vi: Vậy là có rắc rối.. Chà, nếu Laola đã cử bạn đến, tôi có nghĩa vụ phải giúp đỡ hết mức có thể.

dialogsBegin.en: The legend states that long ago packs of trolls ruled the creatures that made the Leren Mountains their home.
dialogsBegin.ar: The legend states that long ago packs of trolls ruled the creatures that made the Leren Mountains their home.
dialogsBegin.br: A lenda afirma que há muito tempo, um bandos de trolls governavam as criaturas que fizeram das Montanhas Leren seu lar.
dialogsBegin.cns: The legend states that long ago packs of trolls ruled the creatures that made the Leren Mountains their home.
dialogsBegin.de: Die Legende besasgt ,dass vor langer Zeit Trollrudel die Kreaturen beherrschten, die das Leren Gebirge zu ihrer Heimat machten.
dialogsBegin.fi: The legend states that long ago packs of trolls ruled the creatures that made the Leren Mountains their home.
dialogsBegin.fil: The legend states that long ago packs of trolls ruled the creatures that made the Leren Mountains their home.
dialogsBegin.fr: La légende raconte qu'il y a bien longtemps, des meutes de trolls régnaient sur les créatures qui avaient élu domicile dans les montagnes de Leren.
dialogsBegin.id: Legenda menyatakan bahwa dahulu kala sekelompok troll menguasai makhluk yang menjadikan Leren Mountain sebagai rumah mereka.
dialogsBegin.it: The legend states that long ago packs of trolls ruled the creatures that made the Leren Mountains their home.

dialogsBegin.kr: 전설에 따르면 트롤 무리는 오래전 레르엔 산맥을 터전으로 살아가는 생명체들을 지배했다고 해요.

dialogsBegin.en: Through disease, famine, and bickering betweeen Masquerpets, the trolls retreated from the Leren Mountains into the caves.

dialogsBegin.br: Por meio de doenças, fome e brigas entre Masquerpets, os trolls recuaram das Montanhas Leren para dentro das cavernas.

dialogsBegin.de: Aufgrund von Krankheiten, Hungersnot und Auseinandersetzungen zwischen den Masquerpets zogen sich die Trolle aus dem Leren Gebirge in die Höhlen zurück.

dialogsBegin.fil: Through disease, famine, and bickering betweeen Masquerpets, the trolls retreated from the Leren Mountains into the caves.
dialogsBegin.fr: À cause de la maladie, de la famine et des querelles entre les Masquerpets, les trolls ont quitté les montagnes de Leren pour se réfugier dans les grottes.
dialogsBegin.id: Melalui penyakit, kelaparan, dan pertengkaran antara Masquerpets, para troll mundur dari Leren Mountain ke dalam gua.
dialogsBegin.it: Through disease, famine, and bickering betweeen Masquerpets, the trolls retreated from the Leren Mountains into the caves.
dialogsBegin.jp: 病気、飢饉、そしてマスケルペッツ間の口論を通して、トロルはレレン山脈から洞窟に後退しました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 질병과 기근, 그리고 마스커펫 간의 갈등 때문에 트롤들은 레르엔 산맥을 포기하고 동굴 안으로 들어갔어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Through disease, famine, and bickering betweeen Masquerpets, the trolls retreated from the Leren Mountains into the caves.
dialogsBegin.pl: Through disease, famine, and bickering betweeen Masquerpets, the trolls retreated from the Leren Mountains into the caves.
dialogsBegin.ru: Through disease, famine, and bickering betweeen Masquerpets, the trolls retreated from the Leren Mountains into the caves.
dialogsBegin.sp: A causa de las enfermedades, el hambre y las disputas entre Masquerpets, los trolls dejaron las Montañas Leren por las cuevas.
dialogsBegin.sw: Through disease, famine, and bickering betweeen Masquerpets, the trolls retreated from the Leren Mountains into the caves.
dialogsBegin.th: เนื่องจากโรคระบาด ความอดยาก และความขัดแย้งของพวก Masquerpets พวก Troll เลยล่าถอยจาก Leren Mountains ลงไปยังถ้ำแทน
dialogsBegin.tw: 由於疾病、飢荒，以及怪物彼此之間的爭鬥，巨魔最後從勒倫山脈退入了洞窟之中。
dialogsBegin.vi: Thông qua bệnh tật, nạn đói và cãi nhau giữa Masquerpet, trolls rút lui khỏi Leren Mountains vào hang động.

dialogsBegin.en: The caves were said to contain magical mushrooms that could prolong the life of those who ate them, and it is said that the trolls who once lived in the cave may still live there, in the darkness.
dialogsBegin.ar: The caves were said to contain magical mushrooms that could prolong the life of those who ate them, and it is said that the trolls who once lived in the cave may still live there, in the darkness.
dialogsBegin.br: Diziam que as cavernas continham cogumelos mágicos que poderiam prolongar a vida de quem os comesse, e diz que os trolls que uma vez viveram nas cavernas ainda podem estar lá, na escuridão.
dialogsBegin.cns: The caves were said to contain magical mushrooms that could prolong the life of those who ate them, and it is said that the trolls who once lived in the cave may still live there, in the darkness.
dialogsBegin.de: Die Höhlen sollen magische Pilze enthalten, die das Leben derjenigen, die sie verzehrten, verlängern würden, und man sagt, dass die Trolle, die einst in den Höhlen lebten, immer noch in der Finsternis hausen.
dialogsBegin.fi: The caves were said to contain magical mushrooms that could prolong the life of those who ate them, and it is said that the trolls who once lived in the cave may still live there, in the darkness.
dialogsBegin.fil: The caves were said to contain magical mushrooms that could prolong the life of those who ate them, and it is said that the trolls who once lived in the cave may still live there, in the darkness.
dialogsBegin.fr: On dit que les grottes contiennent des champignons magiques qui peuvent prolonger la vie de ceux qui les mangent, et on dit que les trolls qui vivaient autrefois dans la grotte y vivent encore, dans l'obscurité.
dialogsBegin.id: Gua-gua tersebut dikatakan mengandung jamur ajaib yang dapat memperpanjang umur orang yang memakannya, dan konon troll yang pernah tinggal di gua tersebut mungkin masih tinggal di sana, dalam kegelapan.
dialogsBegin.it: The caves were said to contain magical mushrooms that could prolong the life of those who ate them, and it is said that the trolls who once lived in the cave may still live there, in the darkness.
dialogsBegin.jp: 洞窟には、それらを食べた人々の寿命を延ばすことができる魔法のキノコが含まれていると言われており、かつて洞窟に住んでいたトロルは、暗闇の中でまだそこに住んでいる可能性があると言われています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 동굴 속에는 먹으면 수명이 늘어나는 마법 버섯이 있다는 전설이 있어요. 한때 동굴에 살았던 트롤들이 아직도 그 어둠 속에 살고 있다고 하죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: The caves were said to contain magical mushrooms that could prolong the life of those who ate them, and it is said that the trolls who once lived in the cave may still live there, in the darkness.
dialogsBegin.pl: The caves were said to contain magical mushrooms that could prolong the life of those who ate them, and it is said that the trolls who once lived in the cave may still live there, in the darkness.
dialogsBegin.ru: The caves were said to contain magical mushrooms that could prolong the life of those who ate them, and it is said that the trolls who once lived in the cave may still live there, in the darkness.
dialogsBegin.sp: Se decía que las cuevas contenían setas mágicas que podían prolongar la vida de quienes las comían, y se dice que los trolls aún pueden vivir allí, en la oscuridad.
dialogsBegin.sw: The caves were said to contain magical mushrooms that could prolong the life of those who ate them, and it is said that the trolls who once lived in the cave may still live there, in the darkness.
dialogsBegin.th: ว่ากันว่าในถ้ำมี magical mushroom ที่จะทำให้คนที่กินมาอายุยืนยาว และนอกจากนั้นยังพูดกันอีกว่าพวก Troll นั้นยังคงอาศัยกันอยู่ในถ้ำ ท่ามกลางความมืดเหล่านั้น
dialogsBegin.tw: 據說洞窟裡有能延長壽命的魔法蘑菇，而那些曾住在洞裡的巨魔，或許至今仍活在那片黑暗之中。
dialogsBegin.vi: Các hang động được cho là có chứa magical mushrooms có thể kéo dài tuổi thọ của những người ăn chúng, và người ta nói rằng những con troll từng sống trong hang có thể vẫn sống ở đó, trong bóng tối.

dialogsBegin.en: Perhaps a sample of the local fungi could hold some clues...
dialogsBegin.ar: Perhaps a sample of the local fungi could hold some clues...

dialogsBegin.cns: Perhaps a sample of the local fungi could hold some clues...

dialogsBegin.it: Perhaps a sample of the local fungi could hold some clues...

dialogsBegin.kr: 이 지역의 버섯 표본이 단서가 될 수도 있겠죠...

dialogsBegin.sw: Perhaps a sample of the local fungi could hold some clues...
dialogsBegin.th: บางทีพวกเห็ดแถวนั้นอาจจะมีเบาะแสอะไรให้บ้าง...
dialogsBegin.tw: 也許採集一份當地真菌的樣本，就能找到一些線索……
dialogsBegin.vi: Có lẽ một mẫu nấm địa phương có thể chứa một số manh mối..

dialogsComplete.tw: 啊，布拉里斯的真菌！一直以來，這裡的蘑菇就被認為帶有魔法性質……
dialogsComplete.vi: À, nấm Flaris! Nấm vùng Flaris luôn được cho là có đặc tính ma thuật...
