dialogsBegin.en: These armaments are a good foundation to work off of for now... but to bring a new Clockworks to life, we need a powerful core of energy.
dialogsBegin.ar: These armaments are a good foundation to work off of for now... but to bring a new Clockworks to life, we need a powerful core of energy.
dialogsBegin.br: Esses armamentos são uma boa base para trabalhar... mas para dar vida a um novo Clockworks, precisamos de um núcleo poderoso de energia.
dialogsBegin.cns: These armaments are a good foundation to work off of for now... but to bring a new Clockworks to life, we need a powerful core of energy.
dialogsBegin.de: Diese Rüstungen sind eine gute Grundlage, auf der wir vorerst aufbauen können... aber um ein neues Uhrwerk zum Leben zu erwecken, brauchen wir einen mächtigen Energiekern.
dialogsBegin.fi: These armaments are a good foundation to work off of for now... but to bring a new Clockworks to life, we need a powerful core of energy.
dialogsBegin.fil: These armaments are a good foundation to work off of for now... but to bring a new Clockworks to life, we need a powerful core of energy.
dialogsBegin.fr: Ces éléments constituent une bonne base de travail pour l'instant... Mais pour donner vie à un nouveau Clockworks, nous avons besoin d'un puissant noyau d'énergie.
dialogsBegin.id: Persenjataan ini adalah fondasi yang baik untuk dikerjakan saat ini.. tetapi untuk menghidupkan Clockworks baru, kita membutuhkan inti energi yang kuat.
dialogsBegin.it: These armaments are a good foundation to work off of for now... but to bring a new Clockworks to life, we need a powerful core of energy.
dialogsBegin.jp: これらの兵器は、今のところ作業するための良い基盤です..しかし、新しい時計仕掛けに命を吹き込むには、強力なエネルギーのコアが必要です。
dialogsBegin.kr: 지금은 이런 무기들로 어떻게든 버티고 있지만... 새로운 클락워크에 생명을 불어넣으려면 강력한 에너지 코어가 필요해요.
dialogsBegin.nl: These armaments are a good foundation to work off of for now... but to bring a new Clockworks to life, we need a powerful core of energy.
dialogsBegin.pl: These armaments are a good foundation to work off of for now... but to bring a new Clockworks to life, we need a powerful core of energy.
dialogsBegin.ru: These armaments are a good foundation to work off of for now... but to bring a new Clockworks to life, we need a powerful core of energy.
dialogsBegin.sp: Estos armamentos son una buena base sobre la que trabajar por ahora... pero para dar vida a un nuevo Mecanismo, necesitamos un poderoso núcleo de energía.
dialogsBegin.sw: These armaments are a good foundation to work off of for now... but to bring a new Clockworks to life, we need a powerful core of energy.
dialogsBegin.th: อาวุธยุทโธปกรณ์ เป็นพื้นฐานที่ดีที่จะไว้ใช้งานสำหรับตอนนี้ แต่การที่จะทำให้ Clockworks มีชีวิตอีกครั้งนั้น จะต้องการแก่นพลังงานที่ทรงพลัง
dialogsBegin.tw: 這些裝備材料現在已經是很好的基底了……但若想讓新的機甲鐘樓真正動起來，我們還需要一顆強大的能源核心。
dialogsBegin.vi: Hiện tại, những vũ khí này có nền tảng tốt để phát triển đấy.. nhưng để mang lại sự sống cho một Clockworks mới, chúng ta cần một lõi năng lượng mạnh mẽ.

dialogsBegin.en: When the masquerpets invaded Storm Peak, the Crystal Demon Lord led an army of undead deep within the mountains and sealed away the last known energy core produced by my people...
dialogsBegin.ar: When the masquerpets invaded Storm Peak, the Crystal Demon Lord led an army of undead deep within the mountains and sealed away the last known energy core produced by my people...
dialogsBegin.br: Quando os masquerpets invadiram o Pico da Tempestade, o Lorde Demônio de Cristal comandou um exército de mortos-vivos adentrando as profundezas da montanha e lacrou o último núcleo de energia fabricado pelo meu povo.
dialogsBegin.cns: When the masquerpets invaded Storm Peak, the Crystal Demon Lord led an army of undead deep within the mountains and sealed away the last known energy core produced by my people...
dialogsBegin.de: Als die Masquerpets in die Sturmspitze eindrangen, führte der Herr der Kristalldämonen eine Armee von Untoten tief in die Berge und versiegelte den letzten bekannten Energiekern, der von meinem Volk produziert wurde.
dialogsBegin.fi: When the masquerpets invaded Storm Peak, the Crystal Demon Lord led an army of undead deep within the mountains and sealed away the last known energy core produced by my people...
dialogsBegin.fil: When the masquerpets invaded Storm Peak, the Crystal Demon Lord led an army of undead deep within the mountains and sealed away the last known energy core produced by my people...
dialogsBegin.fr: Quand les monstres ont envahi le Pic de Tempête, le Seigneur Démon de Cristal a mené une armée des morts très profond dans la montage et y a scellé le dernier noyau d'énergie fabriqué par mon peuple.
dialogsBegin.id: Ketika para penyamar menginvasi Storm Peak, Crystal Demon Lord memimpin pasukan undead jauh di dalam pegunungan dan menyegel inti energi terakhir yang diketahui diproduksi oleh orang-orangku..
dialogsBegin.it: When the masquerpets invaded Storm Peak, the Crystal Demon Lord led an army of undead deep within the mountains and sealed away the last known energy core produced by my people...
dialogsBegin.jp: モンスターがストームピークに侵入したとき、クリスタル魔王は山の奥深くにアンデッドの軍隊を率いて、私の人々によって生成された最後の既知のエネルギーコアを封印しました..。
dialogsBegin.kr: 마스커펫들이 스톰 봉우리에 쳐들어왔을 때, 크리스탈 데몬 로드는 언데드 군대를 이끌고 산속 깊은 곳으로 들어가 우리 선조가 만든 마지막 에너지 코어를 봉인해 버렸죠...
dialogsBegin.nl: When the masquerpets invaded Storm Peak, the Crystal Demon Lord led an army of undead deep within the mountains and sealed away the last known energy core produced by my people...
dialogsBegin.pl: When the masquerpets invaded Storm Peak, the Crystal Demon Lord led an army of undead deep within the mountains and sealed away the last known energy core produced by my people...
dialogsBegin.ru: When the masquerpets invaded Storm Peak, the Crystal Demon Lord led an army of undead deep within the mountains and sealed away the last known energy core produced by my people...
dialogsBegin.sp: Cuando los masquerpets invadieron Pico Tormentoso, el Señor de los Demonios de Cristal dirigió un ejército de muertos vivientes a las profundidades de las montañas y selló el último núcleo de energía producido por mi pueblo...
dialogsBegin.sw: When the masquerpets invaded Storm Peak, the Crystal Demon Lord led an army of undead deep within the mountains and sealed away the last known energy core produced by my people...
dialogsBegin.th: เมื่อตอนที่ masquerpets เข้ารุกราน Storm Peak นั้น Crystal Demon Lord เองได้นำทัพของอันเดดที่อยู่ลึกลงไปในภูเขา และผนึกแก่นกลางพลังงานอันสุดท้ายที่ถูกสร้างโดยผู้คนของข้าไว้
dialogsBegin.tw: 當怪物大軍入侵風暴峰時，水晶惡魔領主率領一支不死軍團深入山脈，並把我族最後已知的一枚能源核心封印了起來……
dialogsBegin.vi: Khi đám masquerpets xâm chiếm Storm Peak, Crystal Demon Lord đã lãnh đạo một đội quân xác sống ẩn sâu trong núi và phong ấn lõi năng lượng cuối cùng do các đồng bào của tôi tạo ra..

dialogsBegin.en: The Demon Lord hides behind its skeletal minions, so to even have a chance at retriving the energy core we will need to eliminate the Skeletal Militants along with the Skeleton General.
dialogsBegin.ar: The Demon Lord hides behind its skeletal minions, so to even have a chance at retriving the energy core we will need to eliminate the Skeletal Militants along with the Skeleton General.
dialogsBegin.br: O Lorde Demônio se esconde atrás dos seus capangas esqueléticos, então, pra ter a mínima chance de pegar de volta o núcleo de energia, vamos ter que eliminar os Militantes Esqueléticos junto com o General Esqueleto.
dialogsBegin.cns: The Demon Lord hides behind its skeletal minions, so to even have a chance at retriving the energy core we will need to eliminate the Skeletal Militants along with the Skeleton General.
dialogsBegin.de: Der Dämonenlord versteckt sich hinter seinen skelettartigen Schergen. Um überhaupt eine Chance zu haben, den Energiekern zurückzubekommen, müssen wir die Skelettkämpfer zusammen mit dem Skelettgeneral ausschalten.
dialogsBegin.fi: The Demon Lord hides behind its skeletal minions, so to even have a chance at retriving the energy core we will need to eliminate the Skeletal Militants along with the Skeleton General.
dialogsBegin.fil: The Demon Lord hides behind its skeletal minions, so to even have a chance at retriving the energy core we will need to eliminate the Skeletal Militants along with the Skeleton General.
dialogsBegin.fr: Le Seigneur Démon se cache derrière ses sbires squelettes. Donc pour vous avoir une chance de vous emparer du noyau d'énergie il vous faudra éliminer les Militants Squelettes et le Général Squelette.
dialogsBegin.id: Raja Iblis bersembunyi di balik antek-antek kerangkanya, jadi bahkan untuk memiliki kesempatan untuk mendapatkan kembali inti energi kita perlu melenyapkan Skeletal Militants bersama dengan Skeleton General.
dialogsBegin.it: The Demon Lord hides behind its skeletal minions, so to even have a chance at retriving the energy core we will need to eliminate the Skeletal Militants along with the Skeleton General.
dialogsBegin.jp: 魔王はその骨格の手先の後ろに隠れているので、エネルギーコアを取り戻すチャンスを得るには、スケルトン将軍と一緒に骨格過激派を排除する必要があります。
dialogsBegin.kr: 데몬 로드는 부하 스켈레톤들 뒤에 숨어 있어요. 에너지 코어를 되찾을 기회라도 노려보려면, 일단은 스켈레톤 병사들과 스켈레톤 장군을 처치해야 해요.
dialogsBegin.nl: The Demon Lord hides behind its skeletal minions, so to even have a chance at retriving the energy core we will need to eliminate the Skeletal Militants along with the Skeleton General.
dialogsBegin.pl: The Demon Lord hides behind its skeletal minions, so to even have a chance at retriving the energy core we will need to eliminate the Skeletal Militants along with the Skeleton General.
dialogsBegin.ru: The Demon Lord hides behind its skeletal minions, so to even have a chance at retriving the energy core we will need to eliminate the Skeletal Militants along with the Skeleton General.
dialogsBegin.sp: El Señor de los Demonios se esconde tras sus esqueléticos secuaces, así que para tener siquiera una oportunidad de recuperar el núcleo de energía necesitaremos eliminar a los Militantes Esqueletos junto con el General Esqueleto.
dialogsBegin.sw: The Demon Lord hides behind its skeletal minions, so to even have a chance at retriving the energy core we will need to eliminate the Skeletal Militants along with the Skeleton General.
dialogsBegin.th: Demon Lord ซ่อนตัวอยู่หลังสมุนโครงกระดูกนั่น ฉะนั้นถ้าถ้าอยากจะมีโอกาสนำแก่นพลังงานคือมาล่ะก็ เราต้องกำจัด Skeletal Militants ไปพร้อมกับ Skeleton General
dialogsBegin.tw: 惡魔領主總是躲在牠那些骷髏手下後面。所以若想拿回能源核心，我們就必須先清掉冥骸戰兵與冥骸將軍，才有一點機會。
dialogsBegin.vi: Demon Lord ẩn đằng sau những tay sai xương xẩu của nó, vì vậy để có cơ hội lấy lại lõi năng lượng, chúng ta sẽ cần phải loại bỏ Skeletal Militants cùng với Skeleton General.

dialogsAccept.en: The Skeletal Militants are formidable foes. The Skeleton General is said to use sharp blades affixed to its back to rip through anything that gets in its way.
dialogsAccept.ar: The Skeletal Militants are formidable foes. The Skeleton General is said to use sharp blades affixed to its back to rip through anything that gets in its way.
dialogsAccept.br: Os Militantes Esqueléticos são inimigos formidáveis. Dizem que o General Esqueleto usa lâminas afiadas presas em suas costas para rasgar qualquer coisa que apareça em seu caminho.
dialogsAccept.cns: The Skeletal Militants are formidable foes. The Skeleton General is said to use sharp blades affixed to its back to rip through anything that gets in its way.
dialogsAccept.de: Die Skelettkämpfer sind furchterregende Feinde. Man sagt, dass der Skelettgeneral scharfe Klingen auf seinem Rücken trägt, mit denen er alles zerreißt, was ihm in die Quere kommt.
dialogsAccept.fi: The Skeletal Militants are formidable foes. The Skeleton General is said to use sharp blades affixed to its back to rip through anything that gets in its way.
dialogsAccept.fil: The Skeletal Militants are formidable foes. The Skeleton General is said to use sharp blades affixed to its back to rip through anything that gets in its way.
dialogsAccept.fr: Les Militants Squelettes sont connus pour être de puissants ennemis. Quant au Général, on dit de lui qu'il utilise des lames aiguisées comme jamais et fixées sur son dos pour déchirer tout ce qui se trouve sur son chemin.
dialogsAccept.id: Skeletal Militants adalah musuh yang tangguh. Jenderal Kerangka dikatakan menggunakan bilah tajam yang ditempelkan di punggungnya untuk merobek apa pun yang menghalangi jalannya.
dialogsAccept.it: The Skeletal Militants are formidable foes. The Skeleton General is said to use sharp blades affixed to its back to rip through anything that gets in its way.
dialogsAccept.jp: スケルタルミリタントは手ごわい敵です。スケルトン将軍は、背中に取り付けられた鋭い刃を使用して、邪魔になるものをすべて引き裂くと言われています。
dialogsAccept.kr: 스켈레톤 병사들은 정말 강력해요. 그리고 스켈레톤 장군은 등에 있는 날카로운 칼날로 잡히는 건 모두 찢어버리죠.
dialogsAccept.nl: The Skeletal Militants are formidable foes. The Skeleton General is said to use sharp blades affixed to its back to rip through anything that gets in its way.
dialogsAccept.pl: The Skeletal Militants are formidable foes. The Skeleton General is said to use sharp blades affixed to its back to rip through anything that gets in its way.
dialogsAccept.ru: The Skeletal Militants are formidable foes. The Skeleton General is said to use sharp blades affixed to its back to rip through anything that gets in its way.
dialogsAccept.sp: Los Militantes Esqueléticos son enemigos formidables. Se dice que el General Esqueleto utiliza afiladas cuchillas fijadas a su espalda para desgarrar todo lo que se interponga en su camino.
dialogsAccept.sw: The Skeletal Militants are formidable foes. The Skeleton General is said to use sharp blades affixed to its back to rip through anything that gets in its way.
dialogsAccept.th: Skeletal Militants เป็นศัตรูที่น่าเกรงขาม และ กล่าวกันว่า Skeleton General ใช้ดาบที่อยุ่ด้านหลัง คอยจัดการใครก็ตามที่ขวางทางมัน
dialogsAccept.tw: 冥骸戰兵是可怕的敵人。據說冥骸將軍會使用固定在背部的鋒利刀片來撕裂任何擋道的東西。
dialogsAccept.vi: Skeletal Militants là những kẻ thù ghê gớm. Skeleton General được cho là sử dụng những lưỡi kiếm sắc bén gắn sau lưng để xé toạc bất cứ thứ gì cản đường nó.

dialogsDecline.en: There's no way we can get to the Demon Lord without first killing its minions...
dialogsDecline.ar: There's no way we can get to the Demon Lord without first killing its minions...
dialogsDecline.br: Não tem como chegar no Lorde Demônio sem dar um fim nos seus capangas.
dialogsDecline.cns: There's no way we can get to the Demon Lord without first killing its minions...
dialogsDecline.de: Wir können nicht zum Dämonenlord gelangen, ohne vorher seine Lakaien zu töten.
dialogsDecline.fi: There's no way we can get to the Demon Lord without first killing its minions...
dialogsDecline.fil: There's no way we can get to the Demon Lord without first killing its minions...
dialogsDecline.fr: Aucune chance de parvenir au Seigneur Démon sans se débarrasser de ses sbires.
dialogsDecline.id: Tidak mungkin kita bisa sampai ke Demon Lord tanpa terlebih dahulu membunuh antek-anteknya..
dialogsDecline.it: There's no way we can get to the Demon Lord without first killing its minions...
dialogsDecline.jp: 最初にその手下を殺さずに魔王に到達する方法はありません..。
dialogsDecline.kr: 하지만 먼저 부하들을 죽여야 데몬 로드가 있는 곳까지 갈 수 있어요...
dialogsDecline.nl: There's no way we can get to the Demon Lord without first killing its minions...
dialogsDecline.pl: There's no way we can get to the Demon Lord without first killing its minions...
dialogsDecline.ru: There's no way we can get to the Demon Lord without first killing its minions...
dialogsDecline.sp: No hay manera de que podamos llegar al Señor de los Demonios sin antes matar a sus secuaces..
dialogsDecline.sw: There's no way we can get to the Demon Lord without first killing its minions...
dialogsDecline.th: เราไม่มีทางไปถึงตัว Demon Lord ได้ ถ้าเราไม่กำจัดพวกลูกสมุนมันเสียก่อน...
dialogsDecline.tw: 不先清掉惡魔領主的手下，我們根本不可能接近它……
dialogsDecline.vi: Không có cách nào chúng ta có thể tiếp cận Demon Lord mà không giết tay sai của hắn trước..

dialogsComplete.en: Your power is tremendous! With your help I have made more progress in creating a new Clockworks than I have in my years out here on my own.
dialogsComplete.ar: Your power is tremendous! With your help I have made more progress in creating a new Clockworks than I have in my years out here on my own.
dialogsComplete.br: Seu poder é tremendo! Com sua ajuda, fiz mais progresso na criação de um novo Clockworks do que em todos os meus anos aqui sozinho.
dialogsComplete.cns: Your power is tremendous! With your help I have made more progress in creating a new Clockworks than I have in my years out here on my own.
dialogsComplete.de: Deine Macht ist überwältigend! Mit deiner Hilfe habe ich bei der Schaffung eines neuen Clockworks mehr Fortschritte gemacht als in den Jahren, in denen ich hier draußen allein war.
dialogsComplete.fi: Your power is tremendous! With your help I have made more progress in creating a new Clockworks than I have in my years out here on my own.
dialogsComplete.fil: Your power is tremendous! With your help I have made more progress in creating a new Clockworks than I have in my years out here on my own.
dialogsComplete.fr: Vous avez une telle puissance ! Avec votre aide j'ai bien plus progressé sur la création du nouveau Clockworks que je n'ai pu sur toutes ces années passées seul ici.
dialogsComplete.id: Kekuatanmu luar biasa! Dengan bantuan Anda, saya telah membuat lebih banyak kemajuan dalam menciptakan Clockworks baru daripada yang saya miliki selama bertahun-tahun di sini sendirian.
dialogsComplete.it: Your power is tremendous! With your help I have made more progress in creating a new Clockworks than I have in my years out here on my own.
dialogsComplete.jp: あなたの力は途方もないです!あなたの助けを借りて、私はここで一人で過ごした年よりも新しい時計仕掛けの作成においてより多くの進歩を遂げました。
dialogsComplete.kr: 엄청난 힘이네요! 용사님 덕분에, 새로운 클락워크를 만드는 속도가 더 빨라지고 있어요. 혼자 할 때보다 훨씬 진전이 빠르네요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Your power is tremendous! With your help I have made more progress in creating a new Clockworks than I have in my years out here on my own.
dialogsComplete.pl: Your power is tremendous! With your help I have made more progress in creating a new Clockworks than I have in my years out here on my own.
dialogsComplete.ru: Your power is tremendous! With your help I have made more progress in creating a new Clockworks than I have in my years out here on my own.
dialogsComplete.sp: Tu poder es tremendo. Con tu ayuda he avanzado más en la creación de un nuevo Mecanismo que en los años que llevo aquí solo.
dialogsComplete.sw: Your power is tremendous! With your help I have made more progress in creating a new Clockworks than I have in my years out here on my own.
dialogsComplete.th: พลังของเจ้ามันมหาศาล ด้วยการช่วยเหลือของเจ้า ข้าได้ก้าวหน้าไปมากในการสร้าง Clockworks มากกว่าที่ข้าทำด้วยตัวเองมาหลายปี
dialogsComplete.tw: 你的力量真是驚人！有了你的幫助，我打造新機甲鐘樓的進展，已經比我這些年來單打獨鬥時還多得多。
dialogsComplete.vi: Sức mạnh của bạn rất lớn! Với sự giúp đỡ của bạn, tôi đã đạt được nhiều tiến bộ hơn trong việc tạo ra một Clockworks mới so với những năm tôi tự mình làm ở đây.

dialogsFail.en: You couldn't find the Skeletal Militants and their general? Head to the valley far below.
dialogsFail.ar: You couldn't find the Skeletal Militants and their general? Head to the valley far below.
dialogsFail.br: Você não conseguiu achar os Militantes Esqueléticos e o general deles? Vá até o vale lá embaixo.
dialogsFail.cns: You couldn't find the Skeletal Militants and their general? Head to the valley far below.
dialogsFail.de: Du konntest die Skelettkrieger und ihren General nicht finden? Begebt euch in das Tal weit unten.
dialogsFail.fi: You couldn't find the Skeletal Militants and their general? Head to the valley far below.
dialogsFail.fil: You couldn't find the Skeletal Militants and their general? Head to the valley far below.
dialogsFail.fr: Vous n'avez pas trouver les Militants Squelettes et leur Général ? Dirigez vous plus bas dans la vallée.
dialogsFail.id: Anda tidak dapat menemukan Skeletal Militants dan jendral mereka? Pergilah ke lembah jauh di bawah.
dialogsFail.it: You couldn't find the Skeletal Militants and their general? Head to the valley far below.
dialogsFail.jp: 骸骨の過激派とその将軍を見つけることができませんでしたか?はるか下の谷に向かいます。
dialogsFail.kr: 스켈레톤 병사와 장군을 찾지 못하셨다고요? 저 아래 계곡으로 내려가야 해요.
dialogsFail.nl: You couldn't find the Skeletal Militants and their general? Head to the valley far below.
dialogsFail.pl: You couldn't find the Skeletal Militants and their general? Head to the valley far below.
dialogsFail.ru: You couldn't find the Skeletal Militants and their general? Head to the valley far below.
dialogsFail.sp: ¿No pudiste encontrar a los Militantes Esqueléticos y a su general? Dirígete al valle que hay más abajo.
dialogsFail.sw: You couldn't find the Skeletal Militants and their general? Head to the valley far below.
dialogsFail.th: เจ้าหา Skeletal Militants กับ General ไม่เจอรึ? มุ่งหน้าไปที่หุบเขาด้านล่างสิ
dialogsFail.tw: 你找不到冥骸戰兵與冥骸將軍嗎？往山谷更下方走吧。
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn không thể tìm thấy Skeletal Militants và tướng của họ? Đi đến thung lũng xa bên dưới.

name.th: ราชาแห่งสัตว์ร้าย

description.en: Enter the Leren Chasm, then kill 20 Radioactive Long Legs and obtain the Broken Vial from the Queen Long Legs.
description.ar: Enter the Leren Chasm, then kill 20 Radioactive Long Legs and obtain the Broken Vial from the Queen Long Legs.
description.br: Entre no Abismo de Leren, derrote 20 Pernas Longas Radioativas e obtenha o Frasco Quebrado da Rainha Pernas Longas.
description.cns: Enter the Leren Chasm, then kill 20 Radioactive Long Legs and obtain the Broken Vial from the Queen Long Legs.
description.de: Betrete die Lerenkluft und töte 20 Radioaktive Langbeine und beschaffe die Zerbrochene Phiole von der Königin der Langbeine.
description.fi: Enter the Leren Chasm, then kill 20 Radioactive Long Legs and obtain the Broken Vial from the Queen Long Legs.
description.fil: Enter the Leren Chasm, then kill 20 Radioactive Long Legs and obtain the Broken Vial from the Queen Long Legs.
description.fr: Entrez dans le Gouffre de Leren, puis tuez 20 Pattes Longues Radioactives et obtenez la Fiole Brisée auprès de la Reine des Pattes Longues.
description.id: Masuki Leren Chasm, lalu bunuh 20 Radioactive Long Legs dan dapatkan Broken Vial dari Queen Long Legs.
description.it: Enter the Leren Chasm, then kill 20 Radioactive Long Legs and obtain the Broken Vial from the Queen Long Legs.
description.jp: ラディオアクティブロングレッグボウを20体排除し、クイーンロングレッグスボウから壊れたバイアルを収集してください。
description.kr: 레르엔 협곡으로 들어가, 방사성 긴다리 거미 20마리를 처치하고 긴다리 거미 여왕에게서 깨진 병을 얻으세요.
description.nl: Enter the Leren Chasm, then kill 20 Radioactive Long Legs and obtain the Broken Vial from the Queen Long Legs.
description.pl: Enter the Leren Chasm, then kill 20 Radioactive Long Legs and obtain the Broken Vial from the Queen Long Legs.
description.ru: Enter the Leren Chasm, then kill 20 Radioactive Long Legs and obtain the Broken Vial from the Queen Long Legs.
description.sp: Entra en la Sima de Leren, mata a 20 Piernas Largas Radiactivas y obtén el Frasco Roto de la Reina Piernas Largas.
description.sw: Enter the Leren Chasm, then kill 20 Radioactive Long Legs and obtain the Broken Vial from the Queen Long Legs.
description.th: เข้าสู่ Leren Chasm แล้วกำจัด 20 Radioactive Long Legs และ เก็บ Broken Vial มาจาก Queen Long Legs
description.tw: 進入勒倫峽谷，擊殺 20 隻輻射長腳蛛，並從長腳女王身上取得破碎小瓶。
description.vi: Đi vào Leren Chasm, sau đó giết 20 Radioactive Long Legs và lấy Broken Vial từ Queen Long Legs.

dialogsBegin.en: While inside the Leren Chasm there were no sign of the trolls? Go back inside and push deeper within the caves to look for more evidence.
dialogsBegin.ar: While inside the Leren Chasm there were no sign of the trolls? Go back inside and push deeper within the caves to look for more evidence.
dialogsBegin.br: Hmm, parece que ainda não encontramos nenhuma pista sobre os trolls do Desfiladeiro de Leren. Volte para dentro das cavernas e explore mais fundo, quem sabe o que é possível descobrir?
dialogsBegin.cns: While inside the Leren Chasm there were no sign of the trolls? Go back inside and push deeper within the caves to look for more evidence.
dialogsBegin.de: In der Lerenkluft gab es keine Anzeichen für die Trolle? Geh wieder hinein und dringe tiefer in die Höhlen ein, um nach weiteren Beweisen zu suchen.
dialogsBegin.fi: While inside the Leren Chasm there were no sign of the trolls? Go back inside and push deeper within the caves to look for more evidence.
dialogsBegin.fil: While inside the Leren Chasm there were no sign of the trolls? Go back inside and push deeper within the caves to look for more evidence.
dialogsBegin.fr: À l'intérieur du Gouffre de Leren, il n'y a aucun signe des trolls ? Retournez à l'intérieur et poussez plus loin dans les grottes pour trouver d'autres preuves.
dialogsBegin.id: Sementara di dalam Leren Chasm tidak ada tanda-tanda troll? Kembali ke dalam dan dorong lebih dalam ke dalam gua untuk mencari lebih banyak bukti.
dialogsBegin.it: While inside the Leren Chasm there were no sign of the trolls? Go back inside and push deeper within the caves to look for more evidence.
dialogsBegin.jp: レレンの淵の中にいる間、トロルの兆候はありませんでしたか?中に戻り、洞窟の奥深くまで押し込んで、より多くの証拠を探します。
dialogsBegin.kr: 레르엔 협곡 안에서 트롤의 흔적을 보지 못했다고요? 다시 협곡 깊이 들어가 증거가 더 있는지 찾아보세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: While inside the Leren Chasm there were no sign of the trolls? Go back inside and push deeper within the caves to look for more evidence.
dialogsBegin.pl: While inside the Leren Chasm there were no sign of the trolls? Go back inside and push deeper within the caves to look for more evidence.
dialogsBegin.ru: While inside the Leren Chasm there were no sign of the trolls? Go back inside and push deeper within the caves to look for more evidence.
dialogsBegin.sp: Mientras estabas dentro de la Sima de Leren no había señales de los trolls... Vuelve a entrar y adéntrate en las cuevas en busca de más pruebas.
dialogsBegin.sw: While inside the Leren Chasm there were no sign of the trolls? Go back inside and push deeper within the caves to look for more evidence.
dialogsBegin.th: ตอนที่อยู่ใน Leren Chasm เจ้าไม่เห็นวี่แววของพวก Troll เลยรึ? กลับไปแล้วลงไปให้ลึกขึ้นอีกแล้วดูว่าเจออะไรเพิ่มเติมรึเปล่านะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 你說在勒倫峽谷裡面沒有看到巨魔的蹤跡？那就再進去一次，往洞窟更深處探索，看看還能不能找到更多證據。
dialogsBegin.vi: Trong khi bên trong Leren Chasm không có dấu hiệu của lũ troll? Quay trở lại bên trong và đẩy sâu hơn vào các hang động để tìm kiếm thêm bằng chứng.

dialogsAccept.en: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. You will need to go past where you faced the Cavern Larva this time to find more information.
dialogsAccept.ar: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. You will need to go past where you faced the Cavern Larva this time to find more information.
dialogsAccept.br: Pronto para continuar explorando o Desfiladeiro de Leren? Fale comigo quando estiver pronto. Desta vez, você precisará passar pela área onde enfrentou a Larva da Caverna para encontrar mais informações sobre o mistério.
dialogsAccept.cns: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. You will need to go past where you faced the Cavern Larva this time to find more information.
dialogsAccept.de: Spreche mit mir, wenn du bereit bist, die Lerenkluft abermals zu betreten. Diesmal musst du an der Stelle vorbeigehen, an der du den Höhlen-Larven begegnet bist, um weitere Informationen zu finden.
dialogsAccept.fi: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. You will need to go past where you faced the Cavern Larva this time to find more information.
dialogsAccept.fil: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. You will need to go past where you faced the Cavern Larva this time to find more information.
dialogsAccept.fr: Parlez-moi quand vous serez prêts à pénétrer à nouveau dans le Gouffre de Leren. Vous devrez aller au-delà de l'endroit où vous avez affronté les Larves de la Caverne cette fois-ci pour trouver plus d'informations.
dialogsAccept.id: Silakan berbicara dengan saya ketika Anda siap untuk memasuki Leren Chasm sekali lagi. Anda harus melewati tempat Anda menghadapi Cavern Larva kali ini untuk menemukan informasi lebih lanjut.
dialogsAccept.it: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. You will need to go past where you faced the Cavern Larva this time to find more information.
dialogsAccept.jp: もう一度レレンの淵に入る準備ができたら、私に話しかけてください。詳細については、今回は洞窟の幼虫と対峙した場所を通り過ぎる必要があります。
dialogsAccept.kr: 다시 레르엔 협곡에 들어갈 준비가 되면, 제게 말씀해 주세요. 새로운 정보를 얻으려면, 동굴 애벌레와 싸웠던 곳을 지나가야 해요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. You will need to go past where you faced the Cavern Larva this time to find more information.
dialogsAccept.pl: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. You will need to go past where you faced the Cavern Larva this time to find more information.
dialogsAccept.ru: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. You will need to go past where you faced the Cavern Larva this time to find more information.
dialogsAccept.sp: Háblame cuando estés listo para entrar de nuevo en la Sima de Leren. Esta vez tendrás que pasar por donde te enfrentaste a la Larva de la Caverna para encontrar más información.
dialogsAccept.sw: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. You will need to go past where you faced the Cavern Larva this time to find more information.
dialogsAccept.th: โปรดกลับมาคุยกับข้าใหม่เมื่อเจ้าพร้อมจะเข้าไปใน Leren Chasm อีกครั้ง เจ้าต้องไปให้ไกลกว่าคราวที่เจ้าพบกับ Cavern Larva นะถึงจะได้ข้อมูลอะไรเพิ่มเติม
dialogsAccept.tw: 等你準備好再次進入勒倫峽谷時再來找我。這次你得走過之前遇到洞窟幼蟲的地方，才能找到更多情報。
dialogsAccept.vi: Vui lòng nói chuyện với tôi khi bạn sẵn sàng bước vào Leren Chasm một lần nữa. Bạn sẽ cần phải đi qua nơi bạn đối mặt với Cavern Larva lần này để tìm thêm thông tin.

dialogsDecline.en: The situation will only become more dangerous the deeper within the Leren Chasm you go. Stop now if you are scared.
dialogsDecline.ar: The situation will only become more dangerous the deeper within the Leren Chasm you go. Stop now if you are scared.
dialogsDecline.br: Cuidado, aventureiro! Quanto mais fundo você for no Desfiladeiro de Leren, mais perigoso ficará. Se você estiver com medo ou não se sentir preparado, é melhor parar agora.
dialogsDecline.cns: The situation will only become more dangerous the deeper within the Leren Chasm you go. Stop now if you are scared.
dialogsDecline.de: Die Situation wird nur umso gefährlicher, je weiter du in die Lerenkluft vordringst. Geht nicht weiter, wenn du Angst hast.
dialogsDecline.fi: The situation will only become more dangerous the deeper within the Leren Chasm you go. Stop now if you are scared.
dialogsDecline.fil: The situation will only become more dangerous the deeper within the Leren Chasm you go. Stop now if you are scared.
dialogsDecline.fr: La situation deviendra de plus en plus dangereuse au fur et à mesure que vous vous enfoncerez dans le Gouffre de Leren. Arrêtez-vous maintenant si vous avez peur.
dialogsDecline.id: Situasi hanya akan menjadi lebih berbahaya semakin dalam Leren Chasm yang Anda tuju. Berhenti sekarang jika Anda takut.
dialogsDecline.it: The situation will only become more dangerous the deeper within the Leren Chasm you go. Stop now if you are scared.
dialogsDecline.jp: 状況は、あなたが行くレレンの淵の奥深くに行くほど、より危険になります。怖いなら今すぐやめてください。
dialogsDecline.kr: 레르엔 협곡 깊숙이 들어갈수록, 상황은 더 위험해질 겁니다. 두려우면 여기서 그만두세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: The situation will only become more dangerous the deeper within the Leren Chasm you go. Stop now if you are scared.
dialogsDecline.pl: The situation will only become more dangerous the deeper within the Leren Chasm you go. Stop now if you are scared.
dialogsDecline.ru: The situation will only become more dangerous the deeper within the Leren Chasm you go. Stop now if you are scared.
dialogsDecline.sp: La situación se volverá más peligrosa cuanto más te adentres en la Sima de Leren. Detente ahora si tienes miedo.
dialogsDecline.sw: The situation will only become more dangerous the deeper within the Leren Chasm you go. Stop now if you are scared.
dialogsDecline.th: สถานการณ์จะยิ่งอันตรายมากขึ้นถ้าเข้าไปลึกใน Leren Chasm หยุดซะตอนนี้ถ้าเจ้ากลัว
dialogsDecline.tw: 你在勒倫峽谷裡越往深處走，情況就會越危險。要是害怕，現在停下來也還來得及。
dialogsDecline.vi: Tình hình sẽ chỉ trở nên nguy hiểm hơn khi bạn đi sâu hơn vào Leren Chasm. Dừng lại ngay nếu bạn đang sợ hãi.

dialogsComplete.en: Perhaps this Broken Vial was once an Elixir of Vitality. It seems the magic within was used long ago, however...
dialogsComplete.ar: Perhaps this Broken Vial was once an Elixir of Vitality. It seems the magic within was used long ago, however...
dialogsComplete.br: Este Frasco Quebrado pode ter sido um Elixir da Vitalidade no passado. Infelizmente, parece que a magia dentro dele foi usada há muito tempo e agora está vazia.
dialogsComplete.cns: Perhaps this Broken Vial was once an Elixir of Vitality. It seems the magic within was used long ago, however...
dialogsComplete.de: Vielleicht war diese Zerbrochene Phiole einst ein Elixier der Vitalität. Die Magie jedoch wurde scheinbar vor langer Zeit bereits benutzt...
dialogsComplete.fi: Perhaps this Broken Vial was once an Elixir of Vitality. It seems the magic within was used long ago, however...
dialogsComplete.fil: Perhaps this Broken Vial was once an Elixir of Vitality. It seems the magic within was used long ago, however...
dialogsComplete.fr: Cette Fiole Brisée était peut-être autrefois un Élixir de Vitalité. Il semble que la magie qu'elle contient ait été utilisée il y a longtemps, cependant...
dialogsComplete.id: Mungkin Broken Vial ini dulunya adalah Elixir of Vitality. Tampaknya sihir di dalamnya sudah lama digunakan, namun..
dialogsComplete.it: Perhaps this Broken Vial was once an Elixir of Vitality. It seems the magic within was used long ago, however...
dialogsComplete.jp: おそらく、この壊れたバイアルはかつて活力のエリクサーでした。しかし、内部の魔法はずっと前に使われていたようです..。
dialogsComplete.kr: 이 깨진 병에, 한때는 활력 비약이 담겨 있었을지도 모르죠. 하지만 담겨 있던 마법은 오래전에 사라진 것 같네요...
dialogsComplete.nl: Perhaps this Broken Vial was once an Elixir of Vitality. It seems the magic within was used long ago, however...
dialogsComplete.pl: Perhaps this Broken Vial was once an Elixir of Vitality. It seems the magic within was used long ago, however...
dialogsComplete.ru: Perhaps this Broken Vial was once an Elixir of Vitality. It seems the magic within was used long ago, however...
dialogsComplete.sp: Quizás este Frasco Roto fue una vez un Elixir de Vitalidad. Parece que la magia que contiene fue usada hace mucho tiempo, sin embargo..
dialogsComplete.sw: Perhaps this Broken Vial was once an Elixir of Vitality. It seems the magic within was used long ago, however...
dialogsComplete.th: บางทีขวดที่แตกนั่นอาจะเคยบรรจุ Elixir of Vitality มาก่อน ยังไงก็ตามดูเหมือนว่าเวทมนตร์ภายในถูกใช้ไปนานแล้ว แต่...
dialogsComplete.tw: 這瓶破掉的小瓶子，也許以前就是一瓶活力靈藥。不過看起來其中的魔力早在很久以前就被用掉了……
dialogsComplete.vi: Có lẽ Broken Vial này đã từng là Elixir of Vitality. Tuy nhiên, có vẻ như phép thuật bên trong đã được sử dụng từ lâu, tuy nhiên...

dialogsBegin.en: I will share with you an explanation of our disdain for the Otems... We believe that eons ago, Otems stole the remaining power from an ancient god named Shelid that was a bastion of protection for this land long ago.
dialogsBegin.ar: I will share with you an explanation of our disdain for the Otems... We believe that eons ago, Otems stole the remaining power from an ancient god named Shelid that was a bastion of protection for this land long ago.
dialogsBegin.br: Eu vou compartilhar com você o porquê não suportamos os Otems. Acredita-se que há éons atrás, essas criaturas roubaram o poder de Shelid, um deus que protegia essa terra.
dialogsBegin.cns: I will share with you an explanation of our disdain for the Otems... We believe that eons ago, Otems stole the remaining power from an ancient god named Shelid that was a bastion of protection for this land long ago.
dialogsBegin.de: Ich werde dir erklären, warum wir die Totems so sehr verachten. Wir glauben, dass die Totems vor Äonen die restliche Macht eines alten Gottes namens Shelid gestohlen haben, der vor langer Zeit eine Bastion des Schutzes für dieses Land war.
dialogsBegin.fi: I will share with you an explanation of our disdain for the Otems... We believe that eons ago, Otems stole the remaining power from an ancient god named Shelid that was a bastion of protection for this land long ago.
dialogsBegin.fil: I will share with you an explanation of our disdain for the Otems... We believe that eons ago, Otems stole the remaining power from an ancient god named Shelid that was a bastion of protection for this land long ago.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je vais vous expliquer pourquoi nous méprisons les Otems... Nous pensons qu'il y a des éons, les Otems ont volé le reste du pouvoir d'un ancien dieu nommé Shelid qui était un bastion de protection pour cette terre il y a longtemps.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku akan jelaskan padamu tentang pandangan hina kami terhadap Otems.. Kami percaya bahwa ribuan tahun yang lalu, Otems mencuri kekuatan yang tersisa dari dewa kuno bernama Shelid yang merupakan benteng perlindungan di tanah ini sejak lama.
dialogsBegin.it: I will share with you an explanation of our disdain for the Otems... We believe that eons ago, Otems stole the remaining power from an ancient god named Shelid that was a bastion of protection for this land long ago.
dialogsBegin.jp: オテムに対する私たちの軽蔑の説明をあなたと共有します。はるか昔、オテムスははるか昔、この土地の保護の要塞であったシェリッドという古代の神から残りの力を盗んだと信じています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 우리가 왜 오템을 경멸하게 되었는지 설명해 드리죠... 우리는 아주 오래전, 오템이 이 땅을 보호하던 고대 신 셸리드의 남은 힘을 훔쳤다고 믿고 있습니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: I will share with you an explanation of our disdain for the Otems... We believe that eons ago, Otems stole the remaining power from an ancient god named Shelid that was a bastion of protection for this land long ago.
dialogsBegin.pl: I will share with you an explanation of our disdain for the Otems... We believe that eons ago, Otems stole the remaining power from an ancient god named Shelid that was a bastion of protection for this land long ago.
dialogsBegin.ru: I will share with you an explanation of our disdain for the Otems... We believe that eons ago, Otems stole the remaining power from an ancient god named Shelid that was a bastion of protection for this land long ago.
dialogsBegin.sp: Compartiré contigo una explicación de nuestro desdén por los Otems.. Creemos que hace eones, los Otems robaron el poder restante de un antiguo dios llamado Shelid que fue un bastión de protección para esta tierra hace mucho tiempo.
dialogsBegin.sw: I will share with you an explanation of our disdain for the Otems... We believe that eons ago, Otems stole the remaining power from an ancient god named Shelid that was a bastion of protection for this land long ago.
dialogsBegin.th: ข้าจะอธิบายเรื่องเกี่ยวกับการดูถูกของ Otem ให้เจ้าฟัง เราเชื่อกันว่ามาโบราณกาล Otem ได้ขโมยพลังที่เหลืออยุ่ของเทพเจ้าโบราณชื่อว่า Shelid ซึ่งเป็นป้อมปราการที่คอยปกป้องดินแดนแห่งนี้อยู่เมื่อนานมาแล้ว
dialogsBegin.tw: 我可以告訴你，為什麼我們如此憎恨歐特姆……我們相信在遠古時代，歐特姆竊取了一位名為謝莉德的古神殘餘力量。很久以前，那位神曾是守護這片土地的堡壘。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi sẽ cho bạn biết vì sao chúng tô lại có thái độ khinh thường đối với bọn Otems đến vậy... Chúng tôi tin rằng từ hàng ngàn năm trước, Otems đã đánh cắp sức mạnh còn lại từ một vị thần cổ đại tên là Shelid, vốn là pháo đài bảo vệ cho vùng đất này từ lâu.

dialogsBegin.en: While you may have proven yourself enough to YaoRin to speak to me, you must further show that you are worthy to receive the MewMew clan's assistance.
dialogsBegin.ar: While you may have proven yourself enough to YaoRin to speak to me, you must further show that you are worthy to receive the MewMew clan's assistance.
dialogsBegin.br: Embora você tenha provado para YaoRin que é digno de falar comigo, você ainda precisa mostrar que é digno de receber a ajuda do clã MewMew.
dialogsBegin.cns: While you may have proven yourself enough to YaoRin to speak to me, you must further show that you are worthy to receive the MewMew clan's assistance.
dialogsBegin.de: Du hast dich zwar gegenüber YaoRin ausreichend bewährt, um mit mir zu sprechen, aber du musst noch zeigen, dass du würdig bist, die Unterstützung des MewMew-Clans zu erhalten.
dialogsBegin.fi: While you may have proven yourself enough to YaoRin to speak to me, you must further show that you are worthy to receive the MewMew clan's assistance.
dialogsBegin.fil: While you may have proven yourself enough to YaoRin to speak to me, you must further show that you are worthy to receive the MewMew clan's assistance.
dialogsBegin.fr: Si vous avez suffisamment prouvé à YaoRin que vous pouviez me parler, vous devez encore montrer que vous êtes digne de recevoir l'aide du clan MewMew.
dialogsBegin.id: Meskipun Anda mungkin telah cukup membuktikan diri kepada YaoRin untuk berbicara kepada saya, Anda harus unjuk diri lebih lanjut bahwa Anda layak menerima bantuan klan MewMew.
dialogsBegin.it: While you may have proven yourself enough to YaoRin to speak to me, you must further show that you are worthy to receive the MewMew clan's assistance.
dialogsBegin.jp: ヤオリンが私に話しかけるのに十分なことを証明したかもしれませんが、ミュウミュウ一族の支援を受けるに値することをさらに示さなければなりません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 야오린에게는 충분히 당신 능력을 증명했을지 모르겠지만, 뮤뮤 일족의 도움을 받을 자격이 있는 사람이란 걸 내게도 보여주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: While you may have proven yourself enough to YaoRin to speak to me, you must further show that you are worthy to receive the MewMew clan's assistance.
dialogsBegin.pl: While you may have proven yourself enough to YaoRin to speak to me, you must further show that you are worthy to receive the MewMew clan's assistance.
dialogsBegin.ru: While you may have proven yourself enough to YaoRin to speak to me, you must further show that you are worthy to receive the MewMew clan's assistance.
dialogsBegin.sp: Aunque YaoRin te haya demostrado lo suficiente como para hablar conmigo, debes demostrar aún más que eres digno de recibir la ayuda del clan MewMew.
dialogsBegin.sw: While you may have proven yourself enough to YaoRin to speak to me, you must further show that you are worthy to receive the MewMew clan's assistance.
dialogsBegin.th: แม้เจ้าจะได้พิสูจน์ตัวเองมามากพอกับ YaoRin จึงได้มาคุยกับข้า แต่เจ้ายังต้องแสดงให้เห็นว่าเจ้ามีค่าพอที่จะได้รับความช่วยเหลือจากเผ่า MewMew
dialogsBegin.tw: 雖然你已經向姚琳證明到足以見我，但你還得進一步證明，自己值得獲得喵喵族的幫助。
dialogsBegin.vi: Mặc dù bạn có thể đã chứng tỏ bản thân đủ để YaoRin nói chuyện với tôi, nhưng bạn phải thể hiện thêm rằng bạn xứng đáng nhận được sự trợ giúp của gia tộc MewMew.

dialogsAccept.en: Thin the herd of Totemia that taint the Southern Hillid Mountains and destroy their leader. If you can take down the leader of the Totemia, then you have earned our trust enough for YaoRin's help... once.
dialogsAccept.ar: Thin the herd of Totemia that taint the Southern Hillid Mountains and destroy their leader. If you can take down the leader of the Totemia, then you have earned our trust enough for YaoRin's help... once.
dialogsAccept.br: Elimine os Totemia que poluem as Montanhas do Sul e destrua seu líder. Se você conseguir derrotar o líder dos Totemia, terá conquistado nossa confiança o suficiente para obter a ajuda de YaoRin... uma vez.
dialogsAccept.cns: Thin the herd of Totemia that taint the Southern Hillid Mountains and destroy their leader. If you can take down the leader of the Totemia, then you have earned our trust enough for YaoRin's help... once.
dialogsAccept.de: Reduziere die Herde der Totemia, die das südliche Hillid-Gebirge befällt, und vernichte ihren Anführer. Wenn du den Anführer der Totemia ausschalten kannst, hast du dir unser Vertrauen verdient und kannst YaoRins Hilfe in Anspruch nehmen... einmal.
dialogsAccept.fi: Thin the herd of Totemia that taint the Southern Hillid Mountains and destroy their leader. If you can take down the leader of the Totemia, then you have earned our trust enough for YaoRin's help... once.
dialogsAccept.fil: Thin the herd of Totemia that taint the Southern Hillid Mountains and destroy their leader. If you can take down the leader of the Totemia, then you have earned our trust enough for YaoRin's help... once.
dialogsAccept.fr: Réduisez le troupeau de Totemia qui souille les monts Hillid du Sud et détruisez leur chef. Si vous parvenez à abattre le chef des Totemia, vous aurez suffisamment gagné notre confiance pour obtenir l'aide de YaoRin... une fois.
dialogsAccept.id: Menipiskan kawanan Totemia yang mencemari Southern Hillid Mountains dan menghancurkan pemimpin mereka. Jika kamu bisa menjatuhkan pemimpin Totemia, maka kamu telah mendapatkan kepercayaan kami yang cukup atas bantuan YaoRin.. sekali.
dialogsAccept.it: Thin the herd of Totemia that taint the Southern Hillid Mountains and destroy their leader. If you can take down the leader of the Totemia, then you have earned our trust enough for YaoRin's help... once.
dialogsAccept.jp: 南ヒリッド山脈を汚すトテミアの群れを薄くし、彼らのリーダーを破壊します。トテミアのリーダーを倒すことができれば、ヤオリンの助けのために私たちの信頼を得ています..。ある時。
dialogsAccept.kr: 남쪽 힐리드 산맥을 오염시키는 토테미아 무리를 줄이고 놈들의 대장을 없애주세요. 토테미아의 대장을 쓰러뜨릴 수 있다면, 우리 신뢰를 얻고 야오린의 도움을 받을 수 있을 겁니다... 한 번뿐이지만.
dialogsAccept.nl: Thin the herd of Totemia that taint the Southern Hillid Mountains and destroy their leader. If you can take down the leader of the Totemia, then you have earned our trust enough for YaoRin's help... once.
dialogsAccept.pl: Thin the herd of Totemia that taint the Southern Hillid Mountains and destroy their leader. If you can take down the leader of the Totemia, then you have earned our trust enough for YaoRin's help... once.
dialogsAccept.ru: Thin the herd of Totemia that taint the Southern Hillid Mountains and destroy their leader. If you can take down the leader of the Totemia, then you have earned our trust enough for YaoRin's help... once.
dialogsAccept.sp: Disminuye la manada de Totemia que contamina las Montañas Hillid del Sur y destruye a su líder. Si puedes acabar con el líder de los Totemia, te habrás ganado nuestra confianza lo suficiente como para recibir la ayuda de YaoRin... una vez.
dialogsAccept.sw: Thin the herd of Totemia that taint the Southern Hillid Mountains and destroy their leader. If you can take down the leader of the Totemia, then you have earned our trust enough for YaoRin's help... once.
dialogsAccept.th: ไปทำให้ฝูง Totemia ที่คอยทำให้ Southern Hillid Mountains แปดเปื้อนลดจำนวนลงบ้าง และกำจัดผู้นำของพวกมันซะ ถ้าเจ้ากำจัดผู้นำของ Totemia เจ้าจะได้รับความเชื่อใจมากพอให้ YaoRin ช่วยเหลือเจ้า..ซักครั้ง
dialogsAccept.tw: 去清理汙染南方希利德山區的圖特米亞群，並擊潰牠們的首領。只要你能打倒圖特米亞的首領，就算真正贏得了我們的信任，姚琳也會願意幫你一次……僅此一次。
dialogsAccept.vi: Hãy làm thưa thớt dần bè lũ Totemia đang làm dơ bẩn Southern Hillid Mountains và tiêu diệt thủ lĩnh của chúng. Nếu bạn có thể hạ gục thủ lĩnh Totemia, thì bạn sẽ nhận được sự tin tưởng của chúng tôi để YaoRin có thể giúp đỡ bạn...một lần nữa.

dialogsBegin.en: I am curious if additional life lives within the cavern. Sadly whatever remains in the tainted waters has likely gone feral by now. More samples from the masquerpets within may reveal the true nature of what this place represents.
dialogsBegin.ar: I am curious if additional life lives within the cavern. Sadly whatever remains in the tainted waters has likely gone feral by now. More samples from the masquerpets within may reveal the true nature of what this place represents.
dialogsBegin.br: Minha curiosidade é imensa para descobrir se existem mais seres vivos ocultos nesta caverna. Infelizmente, tudo o que permanece nas águas contaminadas provavelmente se tornou selvagem com o tempo. Coletar mais amostras dos masquerpets que residem aqui pode revelar a verdadeira essência deste lugar misterioso.
dialogsBegin.cns: I am curious if additional life lives within the cavern. Sadly whatever remains in the tainted waters has likely gone feral by now. More samples from the masquerpets within may reveal the true nature of what this place represents.
dialogsBegin.de: Ich bin neugierig, ob noch mehr Leben in der Höhle lebt. Leider ist das, was in den verdorbenen Gewässern verbleibt, inzwischen wahrscheinlich verwildert. Weitere Proben von den Masquerpets in der Höhle könnten Aufschluss über die wahre Natur dieses Ortes geben.
dialogsBegin.fi: I am curious if additional life lives within the cavern. Sadly whatever remains in the tainted waters has likely gone feral by now. More samples from the masquerpets within may reveal the true nature of what this place represents.
dialogsBegin.fil: I am curious if additional life lives within the cavern. Sadly whatever remains in the tainted waters has likely gone feral by now. More samples from the masquerpets within may reveal the true nature of what this place represents.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je suis curieux de savoir si la caverne abrite d'autres formes de vie. Malheureusement, tout ce qui reste dans les eaux contaminées est probablement devenu sauvage à l'heure qu'il est. D'autres échantillons prélevés sur les animaux masqués qui s'y trouvent pourraient révéler la véritable nature de ce que représente cet endroit.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya ingin tahu apakah kehidupan tambahan hidup di dalam gua. Sayangnya apa pun yang tersisa di perairan yang tercemar kemungkinan besar sudah menjadi liar sekarang. Lebih banyak sampel dari topeng di dalamnya dapat mengungkapkan sifat sebenarnya dari apa yang diwakili oleh tempat ini.
dialogsBegin.it: I am curious if additional life lives within the cavern. Sadly whatever remains in the tainted waters has likely gone feral by now. More samples from the masquerpets within may reveal the true nature of what this place represents.
dialogsBegin.jp: 洞窟の中に追加の生命が住んでいるかどうか興味があります。悲しいことに、汚染された海に残っているものは何でも今では野生になっている可能性があります。内部の仮面舞踏会からのより多くのサンプルは、この場所が表すものの本質を明らかにするかもしれません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 동굴 안에 또 다른 생명체가 살고 있는지 궁금하네요. 안타깝지만, 오염된 물속에 생명체가 남아 있다면 지금은 아주 사나워졌을 겁니다. 마스커펫의 표본을 좀 더 채취할 수 있다면, 이곳의 실체를 알 수 있을지도 모르죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: I am curious if additional life lives within the cavern. Sadly whatever remains in the tainted waters has likely gone feral by now. More samples from the masquerpets within may reveal the true nature of what this place represents.
dialogsBegin.pl: I am curious if additional life lives within the cavern. Sadly whatever remains in the tainted waters has likely gone feral by now. More samples from the masquerpets within may reveal the true nature of what this place represents.
dialogsBegin.ru: I am curious if additional life lives within the cavern. Sadly whatever remains in the tainted waters has likely gone feral by now. More samples from the masquerpets within may reveal the true nature of what this place represents.
dialogsBegin.sp: Tengo curiosidad por saber si hay más vida en la caverna. Lamentablemente, lo que quede en las aguas contaminadas probablemente ya se haya vuelto salvaje. Más muestras de los masquerpets pueden revelar la verdadera naturaleza de lo que este lugar representa.
dialogsBegin.sw: I am curious if additional life lives within the cavern. Sadly whatever remains in the tainted waters has likely gone feral by now. More samples from the masquerpets within may reveal the true nature of what this place represents.
dialogsBegin.th: ข้าล่ะสงสัยจริง ๆ ว่ายังมีสิ่งมีชีวิตอะไรเหลืออยู่ในถ้ำบ้าง แต่น่าเศร้าอะไรก็ตามที่อยู่ในนั้นคงถูกทำให้น้ำที่แปดเปื้อนนั้นทำให้ดุร้ายไปหมดแล้ว ตัวอย่างจำนวนมากจาก masquerpets ที่อยู่ในนั้นอาจจะแสดงให้เห็นว่าธรรมชาติจริง ๆ ของที่นั่นมันเป็นยังไง
dialogsBegin.tw: 我很好奇這座洞窟裡是否還有其他生命存在。只可惜，待在受汙染水域裡的生物，到現在多半都已經狂暴化了。也許從洞窟內剩下的怪物身上取得更多樣本，就能揭開這個地方真正的本質。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi tò mò liệu cuộc sống có tồn tại trong hang không. Đáng buồn thay, bất cứ thứ gì còn sót lại trong vùng nước bị nhiễm độc có thể đã trở nên hoang dã. Nhiều mẫu hơn từ masquerpet bên trong có thể tiết lộ bản chất thực sự của những gì nơi này đại diện.

dialogsAccept.tw: 再回到洞窟裡，從任何還存活的怪物身上收集樣本。
dialogsAccept.vi: Quay trở lại bên trong hang động và thu thập các mẫu từ bất kỳ masquerpet nào còn sót lại.

dialogsComplete.cns: Wow, these artifacts are pulsing with power! No normal being could handle something like this without becoming corrupted. It appears as if these artifacts have been present here for hundreds or thousands of years...
dialogsComplete.de: Wow, diese Artefakte pulsieren vor Kraft! Kein normales Wesen könnte mit so etwas umgehen, ohne verdorben zu werden. Es scheint, als ob diese Artefakte hier schon seit Hunderten oder Tausenden von Jahren vorhanden sind...

dialogsComplete.fr: Wow, ces artefacts sont pleins de puissance ! Aucun être normal ne pourrait manipuler quelque chose comme ça sans être corrompu. On dirait que ces artefacts sont présents ici depuis des centaines ou des milliers d'années...
dialogsComplete.id: Wow, artefak ini berdenyut dengan kekuatan! Tidak ada makhluk normal yang dapat menangani hal seperti ini tanpa menjadi rusak. Tampaknya artefak ini telah ada di sini selama ratusan atau ribuan tahun..

dialogsComplete.jp: うわー、これらのアーティファクトは力で脈動しています!普通の存在は、腐敗することなくこのようなことを処理することはできません。これらのアーティファクトは何百年も何千年もの間ここに存在していたようです。
dialogsComplete.kr: 와, 이 유물들, 엄청난 힘을 뿜어내고 있잖아요! 정상적인 존재라면 타락하지 않고서는 이런 물건들을 다룰 수 없어요. 마치 이곳에 수백, 수천 년 동안 있었던 유물들처럼 보입니다만...
dialogsComplete.nl: Wow, these artifacts are pulsing with power! No normal being could handle something like this without becoming corrupted. It appears as if these artifacts have been present here for hundreds or thousands of years...

dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Vaya, estos artefactos están llenos de poder! Ningún ser normal podría manejar algo así sin corromperse. Parece como si estos artefactos han estado presentes aquí durante cientos o miles de años ..
dialogsComplete.sw: Wow, these artifacts are pulsing with power! No normal being could handle something like this without becoming corrupted. It appears as if these artifacts have been present here for hundreds or thousands of years...
dialogsComplete.th: ว้าว อาร์ติแฟกต์ ชิ้นนี้เต็มไปด้วยพลัง ไม่มีสิ่งมีชีวิตธรรมดาที่ไหนที่จะจัดการสิ่งนี้ได้โดยไม่ถูกแปดเปื้อนหรอก มันเหมือนกับว่าอาร์ติแฟกต์ชิ้นนี้ได้อยู่ที่นี่มาเป็นร้อยเป็นพันปีแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 哇，這些遺物正不斷脈動著力量！一般存在若接觸這種東西，根本不可能不被腐化。看來這些遺物已經存在這裡幾百，甚至幾千年了……
dialogsComplete.vi: Ồ, những hiện vật này đang phát ra sức mạnh! Không có sinh vật bình thường nào có thể tiếp cận một thứ như thế này mà không bị thao túng. Có vẻ như những cổ vật này đã có mặt ở đây hàng trăm hoặc hàng nghìn năm...

dialogsBegin.en: Just one binding is left... we must break it so I can grant you new strength!
dialogsBegin.ar: Just one binding is left... we must break it so I can grant you new strength!

dialogsBegin.de: Nur noch eine Bindung übrig....wir müssen sie brechen, damit ich dir neue Kraft geben kann!

dialogsBegin.fil: Just one binding is left... we must break it so I can grant you new strength!
dialogsBegin.fr: Il ne reste plus qu'un seul lien... nous devons le briser pour que je puisse t'accorder une nouvelle force !
dialogsBegin.id: Hanya satu ikatan yang tersisa.. kita harus mematahkannya agar aku bisa memberimu kekuatan baru!
dialogsBegin.it: Just one binding is left... we must break it so I can grant you new strength!
dialogsBegin.jp: バインドが1つだけ残っています。私はあなたに新しい力を与えることができるようにそれを壊さなければなりません!
dialogsBegin.kr: 이제 속박 하나만 더 풀면 된다... 이걸 풀어주면, 새로운 힘을 주마!

dialogsBegin.ru: Just one binding is left... we must break it so I can grant you new strength!
dialogsBegin.sp: Sólo queda una atadura... ¡Debemos romperla para que pueda concederte nueva fuerza!
dialogsBegin.sw: Just one binding is left... we must break it so I can grant you new strength!
dialogsBegin.th: ผนึกเหลือแค่อีกอันเดียวเท่านั้น เราต้องทำลายมันและข้าจะสามารถให้พลังใหม่แก่เจ้าได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 只剩最後一道束縛了……我們一定得打破它，這樣我才能賜予你新的力量！
dialogsBegin.vi: Chỉ còn lại một sợi dây trói buộc.. chúng ta phải phá vỡ nó thì tôi mới có thể ban cho bạn sức mạnh mới!

dialogsAccept.en: That foolish clown thought they hid his cache of power out of reach of my minions... HA! How wrong he was... Collect the cache and my bindings to this place will finally be broken! No one will be able to stop me either... unless that rat Reodos is still around.
dialogsAccept.ar: That foolish clown thought they hid his cache of power out of reach of my minions... HA! How wrong he was... Collect the cache and my bindings to this place will finally be broken! No one will be able to stop me either... unless that rat Reodos is still around.
dialogsAccept.br: Esse palhaço tolo achou que escondeu seu poder fora do alcance dos meus lacaios.. HA! Como ele estava enganado.. Colete o pacote e minhas amarras a este lugar finalmente serão quebradas!
dialogsAccept.cns: That foolish clown thought they hid his cache of power out of reach of my minions... HA! How wrong he was... Collect the cache and my bindings to this place will finally be broken! No one will be able to stop me either... unless that rat Reodos is still around.
dialogsAccept.de: Dieser törichte Clown dachte, sie hätten seine Macht außerhalb der Reichweite meiner Lakaien versteckt... HA! Wie falsch er doch lag... Sammel das Versteck ein und meine Fesseln an diesen Ort werden endlich gebrochen sein! Niemand wird mich mehr aufhalten können, es sei denn, diese Ratte Reodos ist noch da.
dialogsAccept.fi: That foolish clown thought they hid his cache of power out of reach of my minions... HA! How wrong he was... Collect the cache and my bindings to this place will finally be broken! No one will be able to stop me either... unless that rat Reodos is still around.
dialogsAccept.fil: That foolish clown thought they hid his cache of power out of reach of my minions... HA! How wrong he was... Collect the cache and my bindings to this place will finally be broken! No one will be able to stop me either... unless that rat Reodos is still around.
dialogsAccept.fr: Ce clown idiot pensait qu'ils avaient caché sa cachette de pouvoir hors de portée de mes sous-fifres... HA ! Comme il se trompait... Récupérez la cache et mes liens avec cet endroit seront enfin brisés ! Personne ne pourra m'arrêter non plus... à moins que ce rat de Reodos ne soit toujours dans les parages.
dialogsAccept.id: Badut bodoh itu mengira mereka menyembunyikan cache kekuatannya dari jangkauan antek-antekku.. HA! Betapa salahnya dia .. Kumpulkan cache dan bindingku ke tempat ini akhirnya akan rusak! Tidak ada yang bisa menghentikanku juga.. kecuali tikus Reodos itu masih ada.
dialogsAccept.it: That foolish clown thought they hid his cache of power out of reach of my minions... HA! How wrong he was... Collect the cache and my bindings to this place will finally be broken! No one will be able to stop me either... unless that rat Reodos is still around.
dialogsAccept.jp: あの愚かな道化師は、彼らが私の手下の手の届かないところに彼の力のキャッシュを隠したと思った..。ハ!彼がどれほど間違っていたか..キャッシュを集めると、この場所への私のバインディングがついに壊れます!誰も私を止めることはできません..そのネズミレオドスがまだ周りにいない限り。
dialogsAccept.kr: 그 멍청한 바보가, 내 부하들이 접근할 수 없는 곳에 힘을 숨겨놨다고 생각했나 보군... 하! 멍청하기도 하지... 은닉처를 찾아내어 모으면 내 속박도 풀릴 거다! 아무도 날 막을 수 없을 테지... 그 쥐새끼 레오도스만 없다면.
dialogsAccept.nl: That foolish clown thought they hid his cache of power out of reach of my minions... HA! How wrong he was... Collect the cache and my bindings to this place will finally be broken! No one will be able to stop me either... unless that rat Reodos is still around.
dialogsAccept.pl: That foolish clown thought they hid his cache of power out of reach of my minions... HA! How wrong he was... Collect the cache and my bindings to this place will finally be broken! No one will be able to stop me either... unless that rat Reodos is still around.
dialogsAccept.ru: That foolish clown thought they hid his cache of power out of reach of my minions... HA! How wrong he was... Collect the cache and my bindings to this place will finally be broken! No one will be able to stop me either... unless that rat Reodos is still around.
dialogsAccept.sp: Ese payaso tonto pensó que escondieron su alijo de poder fuera del alcance de mis secuaces .. ¡HA! Que equivocado estaba.. Recoge el alijo y mis ataduras a este lugar finalmente se romperán. Nadie podrá detenerme... a menos que esa rata de Reodos siga por aquí.
dialogsAccept.sw: That foolish clown thought they hid his cache of power out of reach of my minions... HA! How wrong he was... Collect the cache and my bindings to this place will finally be broken! No one will be able to stop me either... unless that rat Reodos is still around.
dialogsAccept.th: ตัวตลกงี่เง่าที่คิดว่ามันซ่อนพลังของข้าห่างจากสมุนของข้าได้ ฮ่า ๆ มันได้คิดผิดไปแล้ว ไปเก็บพลังพวกนั้นมา และผนึกอันสุดท้ายจะได้หมดไปซักที ไม่มีใครหยุดข้าได้แล้ว ยกเว้นว่า Reodos จะอยู่แถวนี้
dialogsAccept.tw: 那個愚蠢的小丑以為他把力量藏匿處放到我手下搆不到的地方……哈！他大錯特錯了……把那個力量儲藏找回來，我對這個地方的束縛就會徹底解除！到時候也再也沒人能阻止我……除非那隻臭老鼠雷奧多斯還活著。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tên hề ngu ngốc đó nghĩ rằng hắn đã giấu được kho tàng sức mạnh của hắn ngoài tầm với của đám tay sai của tôi.. HA! Hắn đã quá sai lầm.. Thu thập kho tàng đó rồi những gì trói buộc tôi với nơi này cuối cùng sẽ bị phá vỡ! Không ai có thể ngăn tôi lại được.. trừ khi con chuột Reodos đó vẫn còn ở đây.

dialogsBegin.en: So a Dwarpet named Rankashu sent you to look for scraps that could be used to build another weapon... interesting. I have lived my life reflecting on the effects of the last time the Dwarpets made a weapon... the Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.ar: So a Dwarpet named Rankashu sent you to look for scraps that could be used to build another weapon... interesting. I have lived my life reflecting on the effects of the last time the Dwarpets made a weapon... the Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.br: Então um Dwarpet chamado Rankashu te mandou em uma missão de procurar sucatas para construir outra arma... interessante. Eu passadei minha vida toda refletindo sobre as consequências da última vez que os Dwarpetes inventaram uma arma... o Clockworks.
