dialogsBegin.de: Ein Dwarpet namens Rankashu hat dich also geschickt, um nach Resten zu suchen, die zum Bau einer weiteren Waffe verwendet werden können... interessant. Ich habe mein ganzes Leben lang über die Auswirkungen des letzten Mal nachgedacht, als die Dwarpets eine Waffe gebaut haben: Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.fi: So a Dwarpet named Rankashu sent you to look for scraps that could be used to build another weapon... interesting. I have lived my life reflecting on the effects of the last time the Dwarpets made a weapon... the Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.fil: So a Dwarpet named Rankashu sent you to look for scraps that could be used to build another weapon... interesting. I have lived my life reflecting on the effects of the last time the Dwarpets made a weapon... the Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.fr: Donc si je récapitule, un Dwarpet nommé Rankashu vous a envoyé ici pour trouver des morceaux permettant de créer une nouvelle arme... Intéressant. J'ai passé ma vie à réfléchir aux effets de la dernière fois que les Dwarpets ont fabriqué une arme... les Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.id: Jadi Dwarpet bernama Rankashu menyuruhmu untuk mencari sisa-sisa yang bisa digunakan untuk membuat senjata lain.. menarik. Aku telah menjalani hidup dengan merenungkan efek terakhir kali para Dwarpet membuat senjata .. Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.it: So a Dwarpet named Rankashu sent you to look for scraps that could be used to build another weapon... interesting. I have lived my life reflecting on the effects of the last time the Dwarpets made a weapon... the Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.jp: そこで、ランカシュという名前のドワーペットが、別の武器を作るために使用できるスクラップを探すためにあなたを送りました..。面白いね。私はドワーペットが最後に武器を作ったときの影響を反映して人生を生きてきました..。時計仕掛け。
dialogsBegin.kr: 그래서 랑카슈라는 드워펫이 다른 무기 제작에 쓸 재료를 찾으려고 당신을 보낸 거군요... 흥미로운데요. 저는 드워펫이 마지막으로 무기를... 클락워크를 만들었을 때를 생각하며 평생을 살아왔어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: So a Dwarpet named Rankashu sent you to look for scraps that could be used to build another weapon... interesting. I have lived my life reflecting on the effects of the last time the Dwarpets made a weapon... the Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.pl: So a Dwarpet named Rankashu sent you to look for scraps that could be used to build another weapon... interesting. I have lived my life reflecting on the effects of the last time the Dwarpets made a weapon... the Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.ru: So a Dwarpet named Rankashu sent you to look for scraps that could be used to build another weapon... interesting. I have lived my life reflecting on the effects of the last time the Dwarpets made a weapon... the Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.sp: Así que un Dwarpet llamado Rankashu te envió a buscar restos que pudieran ser usados para construir otra arma.. interesante. He vivido mi vida reflexionando sobre los efectos de la última vez que los Dwarpets fabricaron un arma.. el Mecanismo del Reloj.
dialogsBegin.sw: So a Dwarpet named Rankashu sent you to look for scraps that could be used to build another weapon... interesting. I have lived my life reflecting on the effects of the last time the Dwarpets made a weapon... the Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.th: เอาล่ะ Dwarpet ที่ชื่อ Rankashu ส่งเจ้ามาหาข้าเพื่อมองหาเศษอะไรซักอย่างที่สามารถใช้สร้างอาวุธได้....น่าสนใจ ข้าจะใช้ชีวิตที่เหลือของข้าเพื่ออาวุธสุดท้ายที่ Dwarpets สร้างขึ้นมา...Clockworks
dialogsBegin.tw: 所以一個叫蘭卡修的矮寵派你來找能打造新武器的殘料……有意思。我這一生都在反思矮寵上次打造兵器──機甲鐘樓──所帶來的後果。
dialogsBegin.vi: Vì vậy, một Dwarpet tên là Rankashu đã cử bạn đi tìm những mảnh vụn có thể được sử dụng để chế tạo một loại vũ khí khác.. thật thú vị. Tôi đã dành cả đời mình để suy nghĩ về kết quả của lần cuối cùng Dwarpets chế tạo vũ khí.. là những chiếc Clockworks.

dialogsBegin.en: Creating the Clockworks weapon brought Madrigal salvation... until Shade turned our weapon against us. The Clockworks rampaged throughout the lands, destroying villages and the people who lived in them. Clockworks was eventually contained... but is no longer a threat to Shade.
dialogsBegin.ar: Creating the Clockworks weapon brought Madrigal salvation... until Shade turned our weapon against us. The Clockworks rampaged throughout the lands, destroying villages and the people who lived in them. Clockworks was eventually contained... but is no longer a threat to Shade.
dialogsBegin.br: A criação da arma Clockworks trouxe salvação para Madrigal... até que Shade virou o jogo e usou nossa própria arma contra nós. O Clockworks saiu devastando tudo por onde passava, arrasando vilarejos e quem cruzasse seu caminho. No final das contas, conseguimos conter o Clockworks... mas agora ele não é mais uma ameaça pra Shade.
dialogsBegin.cns: Creating the Clockworks weapon brought Madrigal salvation... until Shade turned our weapon against us. The Clockworks rampaged throughout the lands, destroying villages and the people who lived in them. Clockworks was eventually contained... but is no longer a threat to Shade.
dialogsBegin.de: Die Erschaffung von Clockworks brachte Madrigal Erlösung... bis Shade unsere Waffe gegen uns wandte. Clockworks wütete im ganzen Land und zerstörte Dörfer und die Menschen, die in ihnen lebten. Das Clockworks wurde schließlich eingedämmt, stellt aber keine Bedrohung mehr für Shade dar.
dialogsBegin.fi: Creating the Clockworks weapon brought Madrigal salvation... until Shade turned our weapon against us. The Clockworks rampaged throughout the lands, destroying villages and the people who lived in them. Clockworks was eventually contained... but is no longer a threat to Shade.
dialogsBegin.fil: Creating the Clockworks weapon brought Madrigal salvation... until Shade turned our weapon against us. The Clockworks rampaged throughout the lands, destroying villages and the people who lived in them. Clockworks was eventually contained... but is no longer a threat to Shade.
dialogsBegin.fr: La création des Clockworks a apporté le salut à Madrigal... Jusqu'à ce que Shade les retourne contre nous. Les Clockworks se sont déchaînés sur les terres, détruisant des villages entiers et ainsi que leurs habitants... Mais ils ne représentent plus une menace pour Shade.
dialogsBegin.id: Membuat senjata Clockworks membawa keselamatan Madrigal.. sampai Shade mengarahkan senjata kami ke arah kami. Clockworks mengamuk di seluruh negeri, menghancurkan desa dan orang-orang yang tinggal di dalamnya. Clockworks akhirnya tertahan.. tetapi tidak lagi menjadi ancaman bagi Shade.
dialogsBegin.it: Creating the Clockworks weapon brought Madrigal salvation... until Shade turned our weapon against us. The Clockworks rampaged throughout the lands, destroying villages and the people who lived in them. Clockworks was eventually contained... but is no longer a threat to Shade.
dialogsBegin.jp: 時計の武器を作ることはマドリガルに救いをもたらしました..シェイドが私たちの武器を私たちに向けるまで。時計仕掛けは土地全体に暴れ回り、村とそこに住んでいた人々を破壊しました。時計仕掛けは最終的に封じ込められました。しかし、もはやシェイドにとって脅威ではありません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 클락워크 무기는 마드리갈을 구원했지만... 쉐이드는 이를 역이용해 우릴 공격했죠. 클락워크는 곳곳에서 날뛰며 마을과 사람들을 마구 공격했어요. 마침내 클락워크를 봉인했지만... 이제 쉐이드를 위협할 무기도 사라진 셈이죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: Creating the Clockworks weapon brought Madrigal salvation... until Shade turned our weapon against us. The Clockworks rampaged throughout the lands, destroying villages and the people who lived in them. Clockworks was eventually contained... but is no longer a threat to Shade.
dialogsBegin.pl: Creating the Clockworks weapon brought Madrigal salvation... until Shade turned our weapon against us. The Clockworks rampaged throughout the lands, destroying villages and the people who lived in them. Clockworks was eventually contained... but is no longer a threat to Shade.
dialogsBegin.ru: Creating the Clockworks weapon brought Madrigal salvation... until Shade turned our weapon against us. The Clockworks rampaged throughout the lands, destroying villages and the people who lived in them. Clockworks was eventually contained... but is no longer a threat to Shade.
dialogsBegin.sp: La creación del arma de los Mecanismos trajo la salvación a Madrigal... hasta que Shade volvió nuestra arma contra nosotros. El Mecanismo de Relojería arrasó las tierras, destruyendo aldeas y a sus habitantes. Los Mecanismos fueron eventualmente contenidos... pero ya no son una amenaza para Shade.
dialogsBegin.sw: Creating the Clockworks weapon brought Madrigal salvation... until Shade turned our weapon against us. The Clockworks rampaged throughout the lands, destroying villages and the people who lived in them. Clockworks was eventually contained... but is no longer a threat to Shade.
dialogsBegin.th: การสร้าง Clockworks ขึ้นมานั้นก็เพื่อความอยู่รอดของ Madrigal จนกระทั่ง Shade ได้เปลี่ยนพวกมันเป็นอาวุธมาต่อต้านพวกเราซะเอง Clockworks ได้อาละวาดไปทั่วดินแดน ทำลายหมู่บ้านและชีวิตผู้คนที่อาศัยที่นั่น แต่แล้ว Clockworks ก็ถูกหยุดเอาไว้ได้ในที่สุด แต่นั่นก็ไม่ได้มีผลอะไรกับ Shade อีกต่อไป
dialogsBegin.tw: 打造機甲鐘樓曾為瑪德利賈帶來救贖……直到闇影把我們的武器反過來對準我們。機甲鐘樓在大地上瘋狂肆虐，摧毀村莊與居民。雖然最後被封印了……但它早已無法再對闇影構成威脅。
dialogsBegin.vi: Việc tạo ra vũ khí Clockworks đã cứu rỗi Madrigal.. cho đến khi Shade biến những vũ khí đó thành kẻ thù chống lại chính chúng tôi. Clockworks hoành hành khắp các vùng đất, phá hủy các ngôi làng và những người dân sống tại đó. Clockworks cuối cùng đã được kiểm soát.. nhưng chúng không còn là mối đe dọa đối với Shade nữa.

dialogsBegin.en: All the other Dwarpets have long died or left the Storm Peak... but perhaps with your help, we can gather materials to build a new weapon to stop Shade once and for all.
dialogsBegin.ar: All the other Dwarpets have long died or left the Storm Peak... but perhaps with your help, we can gather materials to build a new weapon to stop Shade once and for all.
dialogsBegin.br: Todos os outros Dwarpetes já morreram ou deixaram o Pico Tempestuoso há muito tempo... mas talvez, com a sua ajuda, possamos reunir materiais para construir uma nova arma e deter a Shade de uma vez por todas.
dialogsBegin.cns: All the other Dwarpets have long died or left the Storm Peak... but perhaps with your help, we can gather materials to build a new weapon to stop Shade once and for all.
dialogsBegin.de: Alle anderen Dwarpets sind schon lange tot oder haben die Sturmspitze verlassen. Aber vielleicht können wir mit deiner Hilfe Materialien sammeln, um eine neue Waffe zu bauen, mit der wir Shade ein für alle Mal aufhalten können.
dialogsBegin.fi: All the other Dwarpets have long died or left the Storm Peak... but perhaps with your help, we can gather materials to build a new weapon to stop Shade once and for all.
dialogsBegin.fil: All the other Dwarpets have long died or left the Storm Peak... but perhaps with your help, we can gather materials to build a new weapon to stop Shade once and for all.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tous les autres Dwarpets sont morts depuis longtemps ou ont quitté le Pic de Tempête... Mais peut être qu'avec votre aide on pourra rassembler assez de matériaux et créer une nouvelle arme pour vaincre Shade une bonne fois pour toute.
dialogsBegin.id: Semua Dwarpet lainnya telah lama mati atau meninggalkan Storm Peak.. tapi mungkin dengan bantuanmu, kami dapat mengumpulkan bahan untuk membuat senjata baru guna menghentikan Shade untuk selamanya.
dialogsBegin.it: All the other Dwarpets have long died or left the Storm Peak... but perhaps with your help, we can gather materials to build a new weapon to stop Shade once and for all.
dialogsBegin.jp: 他のすべてのドワーペットは長い間死んだか、ストームピークを去りました..しかし、おそらくあなたの助けを借りて、私たちはシェイドを完全に止めるための新しい武器を構築するための材料を集めることができます。
dialogsBegin.kr: 다른 드워펫들은 모두 죽거나 스톰 봉우리를 떠났지만... 용사님의 도움으로 재료를 모아 새 무기를 만들기만 한다면 쉐이드를 완전히 저지할 수 있을 거예요.
dialogsBegin.nl: All the other Dwarpets have long died or left the Storm Peak... but perhaps with your help, we can gather materials to build a new weapon to stop Shade once and for all.
dialogsBegin.pl: All the other Dwarpets have long died or left the Storm Peak... but perhaps with your help, we can gather materials to build a new weapon to stop Shade once and for all.
dialogsBegin.ru: All the other Dwarpets have long died or left the Storm Peak... but perhaps with your help, we can gather materials to build a new weapon to stop Shade once and for all.
dialogsBegin.sp: Todos los demás Dwarpets hace tiempo que murieron o abandonaron el Pico de la Tormenta... pero quizá con tu ayuda podamos reunir materiales para construir una nueva arma que detenga a Shade de una vez por todas.
dialogsBegin.sw: All the other Dwarpets have long died or left the Storm Peak... but perhaps with your help, we can gather materials to build a new weapon to stop Shade once and for all.
dialogsBegin.th: พวก Dwarpets นั้นได้ตาย หรือไม่ก็ย้ายออกจาก Storm Peak กันไปหมดแล้ว แต่ถ้าได้เจ้าช่วยล่ะก็ เราอาจจะรวบรวมวัตถุดิบเพื่อที่จะสร้างอาวุธใหม่เพื่อหยุด Shade ได้อีกซักครั้ง
dialogsBegin.tw: 其他矮寵不是早已死去，就是離開風暴峰了……不過若有你的幫助，也許我們還能蒐集材料，打造一把新的武器，徹底終結闇影。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tất cả những Dwarpets khác đã chết hoặc rời khỏi Storm Peak từ lâu.. nhưng có lẽ với sự giúp đỡ của bạn, chúng tôi có thể thu thập nguyên liệu để chế tạo vũ khí mới và ngăn chặn Shade một lần và mãi mãi.

dialogsAccept.en: Frozen Hare Guards have completely blocked off the path leading deeper within the mountains. If you can take down their leader we can make a foothold further ahead.
dialogsAccept.ar: Frozen Hare Guards have completely blocked off the path leading deeper within the mountains. If you can take down their leader we can make a foothold further ahead.
dialogsAccept.br: Os Guardas Lebres Congelados montaram uma barreira congelante bloqueando o caminho que leva ainda mais fundo nas montanhas. Se você acabar com o chefe deles, poderemos avançar mais adiante.
dialogsAccept.cns: Frozen Hare Guards have completely blocked off the path leading deeper within the mountains. If you can take down their leader we can make a foothold further ahead.
dialogsAccept.de: Gefrorener Hasen-Wächter haben den Weg, der tiefer in die Berge führt, vollständig versperrt. Wenn ihr ihren Anführer ausschalten könnt, können wir weiter vorne Fuß fassen.
dialogsAccept.fi: Frozen Hare Guards have completely blocked off the path leading deeper within the mountains. If you can take down their leader we can make a foothold further ahead.
dialogsAccept.fil: Frozen Hare Guards have completely blocked off the path leading deeper within the mountains. If you can take down their leader we can make a foothold further ahead.
dialogsAccept.fr: Des Gardes Lièvre-Gelé ont complètement bloqué le passage menant aux profondeurs de la montage. Si vous pouvez vous occuper de leur chef nous pourrons prendre pied plus loin.
dialogsAccept.id: Frozen Hare Guards telah sepenuhnya memblokir jalan yang mengarah lebih dalam ke pegunungan. Jika Anda bisa menjatuhkan pemimpin mereka, kita bisa membuat pijakan lebih jauh ke depan.
dialogsAccept.it: Frozen Hare Guards have completely blocked off the path leading deeper within the mountains. If you can take down their leader we can make a foothold further ahead.
dialogsAccept.jp: フローズン・ヘア・ガードが、山奥に続く道を完全に封鎖している。彼らのリーダーを倒せば、さらに先に進む足がかりが手に入るだろう。
dialogsAccept.kr: 빙결 토끼 파수꾼이 산속 깊이 들어가는 길을 완전히 막고 있어요. 토끼들의 대장을 쓰러뜨리고 길을 만들면 더 깊이 들어갈 수 있을 거예요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Frozen Hare Guards have completely blocked off the path leading deeper within the mountains. If you can take down their leader we can make a foothold further ahead.
dialogsAccept.pl: Frozen Hare Guards have completely blocked off the path leading deeper within the mountains. If you can take down their leader we can make a foothold further ahead.
dialogsAccept.ru: Frozen Hare Guards have completely blocked off the path leading deeper within the mountains. If you can take down their leader we can make a foothold further ahead.
dialogsAccept.sp: Los Guardias de la Liebre Helada han bloqueado completamente el camino que lleva a lo profundo de las montañas. Si puedes acabar con su líder, podremos abrirnos paso más adelante.
dialogsAccept.sw: Frozen Hare Guards have completely blocked off the path leading deeper within the mountains. If you can take down their leader we can make a foothold further ahead.
dialogsAccept.th: Frozen Hare Guards ได้ปิดทางเข้าไปสู้ด้านในภูเขาหมดแล้ว ถ้าคุณสามารถจัดการกับผู้นำของมันได้ล่ะก็ เราจะได้มุ่งหน้าเข้าไปต่อกันได้
dialogsAccept.tw: 冰凍野兔守衛已經完全封住通往山脈深處的道路。只要你能幹掉牠們的首領，我們就能在前方建立立足點。
dialogsAccept.vi: Frozen Hare Guards đã chặn hoàn toàn con đường dẫn vào sâu trong núi. Nếu bạn có thể hạ gục thủ lĩnh của chúng, chúng ta có thể tiến xa hơn về phía trước.

dialogsDecline.en: You were my one hope of continuing work on a new weapon... please reconsider.
dialogsDecline.ar: You were my one hope of continuing work on a new weapon... please reconsider.
dialogsDecline.br: Você era a minha última esperança de seguir em frente com a criação de uma nova arma... por favor, repense essa decisão.
dialogsDecline.cns: You were my one hope of continuing work on a new weapon... please reconsider.
dialogsDecline.de: Du warst meine einzige Hoffnung, die Arbeit an einer neuen Waffe fortzusetzen. bitte überlege es dir noch einmal.
dialogsDecline.fi: You were my one hope of continuing work on a new weapon... please reconsider.
dialogsDecline.fil: You were my one hope of continuing work on a new weapon... please reconsider.
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous étiez mon seul espoir de poursuivre le travail sur une nouvelle arme... s'il vous plaît, reconsidérez.
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu adalah satu-satunya harapan untuk terus mengerjakan senjata baru .. tolong pertimbangkan kembali.
dialogsDecline.it: You were my one hope of continuing work on a new weapon... please reconsider.
dialogsDecline.jp: あなたは新しい武器の仕事を続けるという私の唯一の希望でした..再考してください。
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신은 새로운 무기 연구의 유일한 희망이라고요... 제발 다시 생각해 주세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: You were my one hope of continuing work on a new weapon... please reconsider.
dialogsDecline.pl: You were my one hope of continuing work on a new weapon... please reconsider.
dialogsDecline.ru: You were my one hope of continuing work on a new weapon... please reconsider.
dialogsDecline.sp: Eras mi única esperanza de seguir trabajando en una nueva arma... por favor, reconsidéralo.
dialogsDecline.sw: You were my one hope of continuing work on a new weapon... please reconsider.
dialogsDecline.th: เจ้าเป็นความหวังเดียวของข้าที่จะได้เริ่มทำอาวุธใหม่ต่อ โปรดลองไปทบทวนให้ดี
dialogsDecline.tw: 你是我繼續打造新武器的唯一希望……再考慮一下吧。
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn là niềm hy vọng duy nhất của tôi để tiếp tục nghiên cứu vũ khí mới.. làm ơn hãy nghĩ kỹ lại đi....

dialogsComplete.en: Well done! With the Frozen Hare Assassin out of the way we can continue to explore.
dialogsComplete.ar: Well done! With the Frozen Hare Assassin out of the way we can continue to explore.
dialogsComplete.br: Muito bem! Com o Assassino Lebre Congelado fora do caminho, podemos continuar a explorar.
dialogsComplete.cns: Well done! With the Frozen Hare Assassin out of the way we can continue to explore.
dialogsComplete.de: Gut gemacht! Jetzt, da der Gefrorener Hasen-Assassine aus dem Weg ist, können wir weiter untersuchen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Well done! With the Frozen Hare Assassin out of the way we can continue to explore.
dialogsComplete.fil: Well done! With the Frozen Hare Assassin out of the way we can continue to explore.
dialogsComplete.fr: Bien joué ! Avec les Lièvres-Gelés hors d'état de nuire nous pouvons poursuivre les explorations.
dialogsComplete.id: Bagus sekali! Dengan tersingkirnya Frozen Hare Assassin, kita dapat terus menjelajah.
dialogsComplete.it: Well done! With the Frozen Hare Assassin out of the way we can continue to explore.
dialogsComplete.jp: よし！フローズン・ヘア・アサシンのがいなくなった。これで探索を続けることができる。
dialogsComplete.kr: 잘했어요! 빙결 토끼 암살자를 처치했으니, 이제 탐험을 계속할 수 있겠어요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Well done! With the Frozen Hare Assassin out of the way we can continue to explore.
dialogsComplete.pl: Well done! With the Frozen Hare Assassin out of the way we can continue to explore.
dialogsComplete.ru: Well done! With the Frozen Hare Assassin out of the way we can continue to explore.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Bien hecho! Con el Asesino de la Liebre Helada fuera del camino podemos seguir explorando.
dialogsComplete.sw: Well done! With the Frozen Hare Assassin out of the way we can continue to explore.
dialogsComplete.th: ทำได้ดีมาก! เมื่อ Frozen Hare Assassin ได้ไปพ้นทางเราแล้ว เราจะได้สำรวจกันต่อซักที
dialogsComplete.tw: 做得好！既然冰凍野兔刺客已經解決，我們就能繼續深入探索了。
dialogsComplete.vi: Làm tốt! Với Frozen Hare Assassin, chúng ta có thể tiếp tục khám phá.

dialogsFail.en: Eliminate 30 Frozen Hare Guards and their leader, the Frozen Hare Assassin.

dialogsBegin.en: With the guards out of our hair we can start collecting supplies to start building a brand new weapon!
dialogsBegin.ar: With the guards out of our hair we can start collecting supplies to start building a brand new weapon!
dialogsBegin.br: Agora que os guardas tão de fora do nosso pé, podemos sair por aí juntando materiais pra criar uma arma novinha em folha!
dialogsBegin.cns: With the guards out of our hair we can start collecting supplies to start building a brand new weapon!
dialogsBegin.de: Wenn wir die Wachen los sind, können wir anfangen, Vorräte zu sammeln, um eine brandneue Waffe zu bauen!
dialogsBegin.fi: With the guards out of our hair we can start collecting supplies to start building a brand new weapon!
dialogsBegin.fil: With the guards out of our hair we can start collecting supplies to start building a brand new weapon!
dialogsBegin.fr: Avec les gardes en dehors de notre chemin, nous pouvons commencer à rassembler les fournitures pour une arme toute neuve !

dialogsBegin.it: With the guards out of our hair we can start collecting supplies to start building a brand new weapon!

dialogsBegin.kr: 일단 경비병들을 쓸어버린 다음, 새로운 무기를 만들 재료들을 수집하면 되겠어요!
dialogsBegin.nl: With the guards out of our hair we can start collecting supplies to start building a brand new weapon!

dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Con los guardias fuera de nuestro pelo podemos empezar a recoger suministros para empezar a construir una nueva arma!
dialogsBegin.sw: With the guards out of our hair we can start collecting supplies to start building a brand new weapon!
dialogsBegin.th: หลังจากเราจัดการพวกการ์ดให้พ้นหูพ้นตาไปแล้ว เราก็สามารถเริ่มเก็บสิ่งที่จำเป็นสำหรับการสร้างอาวุธใหม่ได้แล้ว!
dialogsBegin.tw: 守衛的問題解決後，我們終於可以開始蒐集材料，著手打造一把全新的武器了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Với những guards ra khỏi tóc của chúng tôi, chúng tôi có thể bắt đầu thu thập nguồn cung cấp để bắt đầu chế tạo một loại vũ khí hoàn toàn mới!

dialogsBegin.en: The Enraged Yetti and Saphyryan Hounds that live in the valley below have weapons and armor we can use to forge the basis of a mechanical beast like Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.ar: The Enraged Yetti and Saphyryan Hounds that live in the valley below have weapons and armor we can use to forge the basis of a mechanical beast like Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.br: Os Yettis Enfurecidos e Saphyryan Perseguidores que habitam o vale abaixo têm equipamentos e armaduras que podemos usar como base para forjar uma besta mecânica poderosa, tipo o Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.cns: The Enraged Yetti and Saphyryan Hounds that live in the valley below have weapons and armor we can use to forge the basis of a mechanical beast like Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.de: Die wütenden Yeti und die Saphyryan-Hunde, die unten im Tal leben, haben Waffen und Rüstungen, die wir verwenden können, um die Grundlage für eine mechanische Bestie wie Clockworks zu schmieden.
dialogsBegin.fi: The Enraged Yetti and Saphyryan Hounds that live in the valley below have weapons and armor we can use to forge the basis of a mechanical beast like Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.fil: The Enraged Yetti and Saphyryan Hounds that live in the valley below have weapons and armor we can use to forge the basis of a mechanical beast like Clockworks.

dialogsBegin.id: AEnraged Yetti dan Saphyryan Hounds yang hidup di lembah di bawah memiliki senjata dan baju zirah yang bisa kita gunakan untuk menempa basis monster mekanis seperti Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.it: The Enraged Yetti and Saphyryan Hounds that live in the valley below have weapons and armor we can use to forge the basis of a mechanical beast like Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.jp: 下の谷に住む激怒したイエッティとサフィリアンハウンドは、クロックワークスのような機械的な獣の基礎を築くために使用できる武器と鎧を持っています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 계곡에 사는 격분한 예티와 사피리안 하운드의 무기와 방어구는 클락워크 같은 기계 몬스터의 기반을 작업할 때 유용하게 쓸 수 있거든요.
dialogsBegin.nl: The Enraged Yetti and Saphyryan Hounds that live in the valley below have weapons and armor we can use to forge the basis of a mechanical beast like Clockworks.

dialogsBegin.ru: The Enraged Yetti and Saphyryan Hounds that live in the valley below have weapons and armor we can use to forge the basis of a mechanical beast like Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.sp: Los Yetti Enfurecidos y los Sabuesos Saphyryan que viven en el valle de abajo tienen armas y armaduras que podemos usar para forjar la base de una bestia mecánica como Relojería.
dialogsBegin.sw: The Enraged Yetti and Saphyryan Hounds that live in the valley below have weapons and armor we can use to forge the basis of a mechanical beast like Clockworks.
dialogsBegin.th: Enraged Yetti และ Saphyryan Hounds ที่อาศัยอยู่ที่หุบเขาด้านล่างนี่ มีอาวุธและเกราะที่เราสามารถใช้เพื่อสร้างสัตว์จักรกลพื้นฐานอย่าง Clockworks ได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 住在下方山谷裡的暴怒雪怪和薩菲利安獵犬，身上都有武器與護具可供我們熔鑄，作為打造類似機甲鐘樓的機械巨獸基礎材料。

dialogsComplete.en: Yes, this will do nicely! I can start forging a new Clockworks with these materials. But there's one thing we're missing...
dialogsComplete.ar: Yes, this will do nicely! I can start forging a new Clockworks with these materials. But there's one thing we're missing...
dialogsComplete.br: Sim, isso vai ficar perfeito! Posso começar a forjar um novo Clockworks com esses materiais. Mas tem uma coisa que está faltando...
dialogsComplete.cns: Yes, this will do nicely! I can start forging a new Clockworks with these materials. But there's one thing we're missing...
dialogsComplete.de: Ja, das wird gut funktionieren! Ich kann mit diesen Materialien ein neues Clockworks schmieden. Aber eine Sache fehlt uns noch...
dialogsComplete.fi: Yes, this will do nicely! I can start forging a new Clockworks with these materials. But there's one thing we're missing...
dialogsComplete.fil: Yes, this will do nicely! I can start forging a new Clockworks with these materials. But there's one thing we're missing...
dialogsComplete.fr: Oui ! Cela fera l'affaire ! Nous pouvons commencer à forger un nouveau Clockworks avec tout ça. Mais il nous manque une chose....
dialogsComplete.id: Ya, ini akan berhasil dengan baik! Aku bisa mulai menempa Clockworks baru dengan bahan-bahan ini. Tapi ada satu hal yang kita lewatkan..
dialogsComplete.it: Yes, this will do nicely! I can start forging a new Clockworks with these materials. But there's one thing we're missing...
dialogsComplete.jp: はい、これはうまくいきます!私はこれらの材料で新しい時計仕掛けを作り始めることができます。しかし、私たちが見逃していることが1つあります..
dialogsComplete.kr: 네, 이 정도면 충분해요! 이 재료들만 있으면 새 클락워크를 만들 수 있어요. 그런데 하나 빠진 게 있네요...
dialogsComplete.nl: Yes, this will do nicely! I can start forging a new Clockworks with these materials. But there's one thing we're missing...
dialogsComplete.pl: Yes, this will do nicely! I can start forging a new Clockworks with these materials. But there's one thing we're missing...
dialogsComplete.ru: Yes, this will do nicely! I can start forging a new Clockworks with these materials. But there's one thing we're missing...
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Sí, esto servirá muy bien! Puedo empezar a forjar un nuevo Mecanismo con estos materiales. Pero hay una cosa que nos falta...
dialogsComplete.sw: Yes, this will do nicely! I can start forging a new Clockworks with these materials. But there's one thing we're missing...
dialogsComplete.th: ใช่แล้ว นี่มันเยี่ยมไปเลย! ข้าจะเริ่มขึ้นรูป Clockworks ใหม่ได้ด้วยวัตถุดิบพวกนี้ แต่ยังมีอีกอย่างนึงที่เรายังขาดไป
dialogsComplete.tw: 很好，這些材料很夠用了！我可以開始用它們打造新的機甲鐘樓。不過我們還缺一樣關鍵東西……
dialogsComplete.vi: Được, những thứ này có vẻ ổn đấy! Tôi có thể bắt đầu rèn một Clockworks mới bằng những vật liệu này. Nhưng vẫn còn một thứ chúng ta đang thiếu..

dialogsBegin.sp: Bueno, al menos has demostrado tener algo de fuerza. Aunque aún quedan tres ataduras por romper.
dialogsBegin.sw: Well you've proven yourself to have some strength at least. There are still three more bindings to shatter though.
dialogsBegin.th: อย่างน้อยเจ้าได้พิสูจน์ตัวเองแล้วว่ามีความแข็งแกร่งอยู่บ้าง ยังมีผนึกอีก 3 อันที่ยังคงต้องให้เจ้าทำลาย
dialogsBegin.tw: 看來你至少還算有點實力。不過，還有另外三道束縛等著你去打破。
dialogsBegin.vi: Chà, ít nhất bạn cũng đã chứng tỏ mình có một số sức mạnh. Vẫn còn 3 binding nữa để phá vỡ mặc dù.

dialogsAccept.en: You won't find anymore Symbols of Shade with that same level of power. I don't care where you get them from, but bring me 5 normal Symbols of Shade to break the next binding. Symbols of Shade drop from Violet masquerpets.
dialogsAccept.ar: You won't find anymore Symbols of Shade with that same level of power. I don't care where you get them from, but bring me 5 normal Symbols of Shade to break the next binding. Symbols of Shade drop from Violet masquerpets.
dialogsAccept.br: Você não encontrará mais Símbolos de Shade com o mesmo poder. Mas não importa de onde você os consiga, traga-me 5 Símbolos de Shade normais para quebrar a próxima amarra. Os Símbolos de Shade são conquistados derrotando masquerpets Violetas.
dialogsAccept.cns: You won't find anymore Symbols of Shade with that same level of power. I don't care where you get them from, but bring me 5 normal Symbols of Shade to break the next binding. Symbols of Shade drop from Violet masquerpets.
dialogsAccept.de: Du wirst keine anderen Symbols of Shade mit der gleichen Kraft finden. Ist mir egal, wo du die herbekommstt, aber bringe mir 5 normale Symbols of Shade um die nächste Bindung zu zerschlagen. Symbols of Shade fallen beim Besiegen von Violet Masquerpets.
dialogsAccept.fi: You won't find anymore Symbols of Shade with that same level of power. I don't care where you get them from, but bring me 5 normal Symbols of Shade to break the next binding. Symbols of Shade drop from Violet masquerpets.
dialogsAccept.fil: You won't find anymore Symbols of Shade with that same level of power. I don't care where you get them from, but bring me 5 normal Symbols of Shade to break the next binding. Symbols of Shade drop from Violet masquerpets.
dialogsAccept.fr: Vous ne trouverez pas d'autres Symboles d'Ombre ayant le même niveau de puissance. Je me fiche de savoir d'où vous les obtenez, mais apportez-moi 5 Symboles d'Ombre normaux pour briser le prochain lien. Symboles d'Ombre drop de Violet masquerpets.
dialogsAccept.id: Anda tidak akan menemukan lagi Symbols of Shade dengan tingkat kekuatan yang sama. Saya tidak peduli dari mana Anda mendapatkannya, tetapi bawakan saya 5 Symbols of Shade normal untuk memutuskan ikatan berikutnya. Symbols of Shade jatuh dari Violet masquerpet.
dialogsAccept.it: You won't find anymore Symbols of Shade with that same level of power. I don't care where you get them from, but bring me 5 normal Symbols of Shade to break the next binding. Symbols of Shade drop from Violet masquerpets.
dialogsAccept.jp: 同じレベルの力を持つシェードのシンボルはもう見つかりません。どこから入手してもかまいませんが、次のバインディングを壊すために5つの通常のシンボローフシェード持ってきてください。シェードのシンボルはバイオレットモンスターからドロップします。
dialogsAccept.kr: 그 정도로 강력한 쉐이드의 상징은 절대 못 찾을 거다. 어디서 구했는지는 모르겠지만, 다음 속박을 풀려면 일반 쉐이드의 상징 5개를 가져와. 쉐이드의 상징은 보라 마스커펫에게서 얻을 수 있다.
dialogsAccept.nl: You won't find anymore Symbols of Shade with that same level of power. I don't care where you get them from, but bring me 5 normal Symbols of Shade to break the next binding. Symbols of Shade drop from Violet masquerpets.
dialogsAccept.pl: You won't find anymore Symbols of Shade with that same level of power. I don't care where you get them from, but bring me 5 normal Symbols of Shade to break the next binding. Symbols of Shade drop from Violet masquerpets.
dialogsAccept.ru: You won't find anymore Symbols of Shade with that same level of power. I don't care where you get them from, but bring me 5 normal Symbols of Shade to break the next binding. Symbols of Shade drop from Violet masquerpets.
dialogsAccept.sp: No encontrarás más Símbolos de la Sombra con ese mismo nivel de poder. No me importa de dónde los saques, pero tráeme 5 Símbolos de la Sombra normales para romper la siguiente atadura. Los Símbolos de la sombra se obtienen de Masquerpets Violeta.
dialogsAccept.sw: You won't find anymore Symbols of Shade with that same level of power. I don't care where you get them from, but bring me 5 normal Symbols of Shade to break the next binding. Symbols of Shade drop from Violet masquerpets.
dialogsAccept.th: เจ้าไม่สามารถหา Symbols of Shade ที่มีพลังระดับเดียวกันได้อีกแล้ว ข้าไม่สนว่าเจ้าจะไปหามันมาจากไหน แต่ไปเอา 5 normal Symbols of Shade เพื่อมาทำลายผนึกขั้นต่อไป Symbols of Shade ดรอปจาก Violet masquerpets.
dialogsAccept.tw: 你不可能再從那種等級的力量裡找到更多闇影象徵了。我不管你去哪裡拿，總之再替我帶來 5 個普通的闇影象徵，才能打破下一道束縛。紫色怪物會掉落闇影象徵。
dialogsAccept.vi: Bạn sẽ không tìm thấy Symbols of Shade nào nữa với cùng mức sức mạnh đó. Tôi không quan tâm bạn lấy chúng từ đâu, nhưng hãy mang cho tôi 5 Symbols of Shade bình thường để phá vỡ binding tiếp theo. Symbols of Shade rơi ra từ Violet masquerpets.

dialogsDecline.ru: WHAT!? You don't trust me or something?

dialogsComplete.en: Wahahahaha! You really are something, aren't you! I'm surprised you were powerful enough to take down so many Violet masquerpets. And with that, the second binding has been released!
dialogsComplete.ar: Wahahahaha! You really are something, aren't you! I'm surprised you were powerful enough to take down so many Violet masquerpets. And with that, the second binding has been released!
dialogsComplete.br: Wahahahaha! Você realmente é incrível, não é mesmo! Estou impressionado que você tenha sido tão poderoso para derrotar tantos masquerpets Violetas. E com isso, a segunda amarra foi solta!
dialogsComplete.cns: Wahahahaha! You really are something, aren't you! I'm surprised you were powerful enough to take down so many Violet masquerpets. And with that, the second binding has been released!
dialogsComplete.de: Wahahahaha! Du bist wirklich etwas Besonderes, nicht wahr! Ich bin überrascht, dass du stark genug warst, um so viele Violet Masquerpets zu besiegen. Und damit ist die zweite Bindung gelöst!
dialogsComplete.fi: Wahahahaha! You really are something, aren't you! I'm surprised you were powerful enough to take down so many Violet masquerpets. And with that, the second binding has been released!
dialogsComplete.fil: Wahahahaha! You really are something, aren't you! I'm surprised you were powerful enough to take down so many Violet masquerpets. And with that, the second binding has been released!
dialogsComplete.fr: Wahahahaha ! Vous êtes vraiment quelqu'un, n'est-ce pas ? Je suis surpris que tu sois assez puissant pour vaincre autant de mascarades de Violette. Et voilà, la deuxième reliure est sortie !
dialogsComplete.id: Wahahahaha! Anda benar-benar sesuatu, bukan! Aku terkejut kau cukup kuat untuk menjatuhkan begitu banyak Violet masquerpet. Dan dengan itu, pengikatan kedua telah dilepaskan!
dialogsComplete.it: Wahahahaha! You really are something, aren't you! I'm surprised you were powerful enough to take down so many Violet masquerpets. And with that, the second binding has been released!
dialogsComplete.jp: ワハハハハ!あなたは本当に何かですよね!あなたがたくさんのバイオレットモンスターを倒すのに十分強力だったことに驚いています。そしてそれに伴い、第2弾バインディングがリリースされました!
dialogsComplete.kr: 와하하하! 아주 대단한 사람이구나, 안 그래? 보라 마스커펫을 그렇게 많이 쓰러뜨릴 정도로 강하다니, 놀랍구나. 이제 두 번째 속박이 풀렸구나!
dialogsComplete.nl: Wahahahaha! You really are something, aren't you! I'm surprised you were powerful enough to take down so many Violet masquerpets. And with that, the second binding has been released!
dialogsComplete.pl: Wahahahaha! You really are something, aren't you! I'm surprised you were powerful enough to take down so many Violet masquerpets. And with that, the second binding has been released!
dialogsComplete.ru: Wahahahaha! You really are something, aren't you! I'm surprised you were powerful enough to take down so many Violet masquerpets. And with that, the second binding has been released!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Wahahahaha! Eres increíble, ¿Verdad? Me sorprende que fueras tan poderosa como para acabar con tantos Masquerpets Violeta. Y con esto, ¡La segunda encuadernación ha sido liberada!
dialogsComplete.sw: Wahahahaha! You really are something, aren't you! I'm surprised you were powerful enough to take down so many Violet masquerpets. And with that, the second binding has been released!
dialogsComplete.th: วะฮ่ะ ๆๆ ฮ่า! เจ้านี่มันไม่ธรรมดา ใช่ไหมล่ะ? ข้าล่ะแปลกใจจริง ๆ ที่เจ้าแข็งแกร่งมากพอที่จะจัดการกับ Violet masquerpets ได้มากขนาดนั้น และเพราะแบบนั้นผนึกที่สองได้ถูกทำลายลงแล้ว!
dialogsComplete.tw: 哇哈哈哈哈！你還真有一套，不是嗎！我真沒想到你居然強到能擊倒那麼多紫色怪物。就這樣，第二道束縛也解開了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Wahahahaha! Bạn thực sự kì lạ, phải không! Tôi ngạc nhiên là bạn đủ mạnh để hạ gục nhiều Violet masquerpets như vậy. Và với điều đó, binding thứ hai đã được ban hành!

dialogsFail.en: Can't you figure this out on your own? Go kill Violet masquerpets for their Symbols of Shade!
dialogsFail.ar: Can't you figure this out on your own? Go kill Violet masquerpets for their Symbols of Shade!
dialogsFail.br: Você não consegue descobrir isso sozinho? Vá derrotar masquerpets Violetas e pegue os Símbolos de Shade!
dialogsFail.cns: Can't you figure this out on your own? Go kill Violet masquerpets for their Symbols of Shade!

dialogsFail.id: Tidak bisakah kamu mencari tahu ini sendiri? Bunuh penyamar Violet untuk Symbols of Shade mereka!
dialogsFail.it: Can't you figure this out on your own? Go kill Violet masquerpets for their Symbols of Shade!
dialogsFail.jp: これを自分で理解できませんか?日陰のシンボルのためにバイオレットモンスターを殺しに行きましょう!
dialogsFail.kr: 혼자서는 못 알아내나? 보라 마스커펫을 처치하고, 쉐이드의 상징을 가져와!
dialogsFail.nl: Can't you figure this out on your own? Go kill Violet masquerpets for their Symbols of Shade!
dialogsFail.pl: Can't you figure this out on your own? Go kill Violet masquerpets for their Symbols of Shade!
dialogsFail.ru: Can't you figure this out on your own? Go kill Violet masquerpets for their Symbols of Shade!
dialogsFail.sp: ¿No puedes averiguarlo por ti mismo? ¡Ve a matar Masquerpets Violeta por sus Símbolos de Sombra!
dialogsFail.sw: Can't you figure this out on your own? Go kill Violet masquerpets for their Symbols of Shade!
dialogsFail.th: เจ้าคิดด้วยตัวเองไม่ออกรึไง? ไปจัดการ Violet masquerpets เพื่อSymbols of Shade ซะ!
dialogsFail.tw: 這點事你還看不出來嗎？去擊倒紫色怪物，拿牠們掉落的闇影象徵！
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn không thể tìm ra điều này một mình? Đi giết Violet masquerpets để lấy Symbols of Shade!

dialogsBegin.en: I feel we are getting close to solving the mystery behind the magic mushrooms in Flaris...
dialogsBegin.ar: I feel we are getting close to solving the mystery behind the magic mushrooms in Flaris...
dialogsBegin.br: Sinto que estamos chegando perto de resolver o mistério por trás dos cogumelos mágicos em Flaris...
dialogsBegin.cns: I feel we are getting close to solving the mystery behind the magic mushrooms in Flaris...
dialogsBegin.de: Ich habe das Gefühl, dass wir kurz davor sind, das Geheimnis der Zauberpilze in Flaris zu lüften.
dialogsBegin.fi: I feel we are getting close to solving the mystery behind the magic mushrooms in Flaris...
dialogsBegin.fil: I feel we are getting close to solving the mystery behind the magic mushrooms in Flaris...
dialogsBegin.fr: Je pense que nous sommes sur le point de résoudre le mystère des champignons magiques de Flaris.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku merasa kita semakin dekat untuk memecahkan misteri di balik jamur ajaib di Flaris..
dialogsBegin.it: I feel we are getting close to solving the mystery behind the magic mushrooms in Flaris...
dialogsBegin.jp: フラリスの魔法のキノコの背後にある謎の解決に近づいていると感じています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 플라리스 마법 버섯의 미스터리 해결에 한 걸음 더 가까워진 것 같아요...
dialogsBegin.nl: I feel we are getting close to solving the mystery behind the magic mushrooms in Flaris...
dialogsBegin.pl: I feel we are getting close to solving the mystery behind the magic mushrooms in Flaris...
dialogsBegin.ru: I feel we are getting close to solving the mystery behind the magic mushrooms in Flaris...
dialogsBegin.sp: Siento que estamos cerca de resolver el misterio detrás de los hongos mágicos en Flaris..
dialogsBegin.sw: I feel we are getting close to solving the mystery behind the magic mushrooms in Flaris...
dialogsBegin.th: ข้ารู้สึกได้เลยว่าเราใกล้จะไขปริศนาลึกลับของ magic mushrooms ใน Flaris ได้แล้ว
dialogsBegin.tw: 我感覺我們離解開布拉里斯魔法蘑菇之謎越來越近了……
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi cảm thấy chúng ta đang tiến gần đến việc giải quyết bí ẩn đằng sau những chiếc nấm ma thuật ở Flaris..

dialogsBegin.en: The wise sage Radion in the North of Leren Mountains has lived in Flaris longer than most residents have been alive.
dialogsBegin.ar: The wise sage Radion in the North of Leren Mountains has lived in Flaris longer than most residents have been alive.
dialogsBegin.br: O sábio Radion, ao norte das Montanhas de Leren, viveu em Flaris por mais tempo do que a maioria dos residentes viveu.
dialogsBegin.cns: The wise sage Radion in the North of Leren Mountains has lived in Flaris longer than most residents have been alive.
dialogsBegin.de: Der weise Mann Radion im Norden des Leren Gebirges lebt schon länger in Flaris als die meisten Einwohner am Leben sind.
dialogsBegin.fi: The wise sage Radion in the North of Leren Mountains has lived in Flaris longer than most residents have been alive.
dialogsBegin.fil: The wise sage Radion in the North of Leren Mountains has lived in Flaris longer than most residents have been alive.
dialogsBegin.fr: Le sage Radion, au nord des monts Leren, vit à Flaris depuis plus longtemps que la plupart des habitants.
dialogsBegin.id: Wise Sage Radion di Utara Pegunungan Leren telah tinggal di Flaris lebih lama dari kebanyakan penduduk yang hidup.
dialogsBegin.it: The wise sage Radion in the North of Leren Mountains has lived in Flaris longer than most residents have been alive.
dialogsBegin.jp: レレン山脈の北に住む賢者ラディオンは、ほとんどの住民が生きているよりも長くフラリスに住んでいます。
dialogsBegin.kr: 레르엔 산맥 북쪽에 사는 라디온은 플라리스에서 누구보다 오래 살아온 현자랍니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: The wise sage Radion in the North of Leren Mountains has lived in Flaris longer than most residents have been alive.
dialogsBegin.pl: The wise sage Radion in the North of Leren Mountains has lived in Flaris longer than most residents have been alive.
dialogsBegin.ru: The wise sage Radion in the North of Leren Mountains has lived in Flaris longer than most residents have been alive.
dialogsBegin.sp: El sabio Radion, en el norte de las montañas Leren, lleva viviendo en Flaris más tiempo que la mayoría de sus habitantes.
dialogsBegin.sw: The wise sage Radion in the North of Leren Mountains has lived in Flaris longer than most residents have been alive.
dialogsBegin.th: ปราชญ์ Radion ทางตอนเหนือของ Leren Mountains อาศัยอยู่ใน Flaris มานานกว่าใครก็ตามที่ยังมีชีวิตอยู่ ณ ตอนนี้
dialogsBegin.tw: 住在勒倫山脈北方的賢者拉迪溫，在布拉里斯生活的時間比大多數居民的壽命還久。
dialogsBegin.vi: Sage Radion thông thái ở phía Bắc Leren Mountains đã sống ở Flaris lâu hơn hầu hết cư dân còn sống.

dialogsAccept.en: Go speak with the sage Radion and see if he knows anything about the power within the Elixir of Vitality!
dialogsAccept.ar: Go speak with the sage Radion and see if he knows anything about the power within the Elixir of Vitality!
dialogsAccept.br: Vá falar com o sábio Radion e veja se ele sabe alguma coisa sobre o poder dentro do Elixir da Vitalidade!
dialogsAccept.cns: Go speak with the sage Radion and see if he knows anything about the power within the Elixir of Vitality!
dialogsAccept.de: Spreche mit dem Weisen Radion und finded heraus, ob er irgendetwas über die Macht des Elixier der Vitalität weiß.
dialogsAccept.fi: Go speak with the sage Radion and see if he knows anything about the power within the Elixir of Vitality!
dialogsAccept.fil: Go speak with the sage Radion and see if he knows anything about the power within the Elixir of Vitality!
dialogsAccept.fr: Va parler au sage Radion et vois s'il sait quelque chose sur le pouvoir de l'élixir de vitalité !
dialogsAccept.id: Bicaralah dengan Sage Radion dan lihat apakah dia tahu sesuatu tentang kekuatan dalam Elixir of Vitality!
dialogsAccept.it: Go speak with the sage Radion and see if he knows anything about the power within the Elixir of Vitality!
dialogsAccept.jp: 賢者ラディオンと話をして、彼が生命のエリクサーの中の力について何か知っているかどうかを確認してください!
dialogsAccept.kr: 현자 라디온을 찾아가서, 활력 비약의 힘에 관해 아는 게 있는지 물어보세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: Go speak with the sage Radion and see if he knows anything about the power within the Elixir of Vitality!
dialogsAccept.pl: Go speak with the sage Radion and see if he knows anything about the power within the Elixir of Vitality!
dialogsAccept.ru: Go speak with the sage Radion and see if he knows anything about the power within the Elixir of Vitality!
dialogsAccept.sp: Ve a hablar con el sabio Radion y averigua si sabe algo sobre el poder del Elixir de Vitalidad.
dialogsAccept.sw: Go speak with the sage Radion and see if he knows anything about the power within the Elixir of Vitality!
dialogsAccept.th: ลองไปพูดคุยกับ ปราชญ์ Radion และดูว่าเขารุ้เรื่องอะไรเกี่ยวกับพลังของ Elixir of Vitality บ้างไหม!
dialogsAccept.tw: 去找賢者拉迪溫談談，看看他是否知道活力靈藥內部力量的來歷！
dialogsAccept.vi: Hãy nói chuyện với sage Radion và xem liệu ông ta có biết gì về sức mạnh trong Elixir of Vitality không!

dialogsDecline.en: Radion is a bit of a hermit, but he means no harm. I cannot force you to speak to him if you do not want to, though.
dialogsDecline.ar: Radion is a bit of a hermit, but he means no harm. I cannot force you to speak to him if you do not want to, though.
dialogsDecline.br: Radion é meio recluso, mas ele é de boas. Não vou te obrigar a falar com ele, mas pode ser legal dar uma passadinha lá!
dialogsDecline.cns: Radion is a bit of a hermit, but he means no harm. I cannot force you to speak to him if you do not want to, though.
dialogsDecline.de: Radion ist eine Art Einsiedler, aber er meint es nicht böse. Ich kann dich allerdings nicht zwingen, mit ihm zu sprechen, wenn du das nicht willst.
dialogsDecline.fi: Radion is a bit of a hermit, but he means no harm. I cannot force you to speak to him if you do not want to, though.
dialogsDecline.fil: Radion is a bit of a hermit, but he means no harm. I cannot force you to speak to him if you do not want to, though.
dialogsDecline.fr: Radion est un peu un ermite, mais il ne veut pas faire de mal. Je ne peux pas vous obliger à lui parler si vous ne le souhaitez pas.
dialogsDecline.id: Radion agak pertapa, tapi dia tidak bermaksud jahat. Saya tidak bisa memaksa Anda untuk berbicara dengannya jika Anda tidak mau.
dialogsDecline.it: Radion is a bit of a hermit, but he means no harm. I cannot force you to speak to him if you do not want to, though.
dialogsDecline.jp: ラディオンは少し隠者ですが、害はありません。しかし、あなたが望まないのなら、私はあなたに彼と話すことを強制することはできません。
dialogsDecline.kr: 라디온이 은둔자 기질이 있긴 해도, 나쁜 사람은 아니에요. 하지만 당신이 원치 않는다면, 제가 대화를 강요할 순 없겠죠.
dialogsDecline.nl: Radion is a bit of a hermit, but he means no harm. I cannot force you to speak to him if you do not want to, though.
dialogsDecline.pl: Radion is a bit of a hermit, but he means no harm. I cannot force you to speak to him if you do not want to, though.
dialogsDecline.ru: Radion is a bit of a hermit, but he means no harm. I cannot force you to speak to him if you do not want to, though.
dialogsDecline.sp: Radion es un poco ermitaño, pero no tiene mala intención. Sin embargo, no puedo obligarte a hablar con él si no quieres.
dialogsDecline.sw: Radion is a bit of a hermit, but he means no harm. I cannot force you to speak to him if you do not want to, though.
dialogsDecline.th: Radion จะดูแปลก ๆ อยู่บ้าง แต่เขาไม่มีอันตรายอะไรหรอก ข้าไม่อาจจะบังคับให้เจ้าไปลองคุยกับเขาได้ถ้าเจ้าไม่อยากไป
dialogsDecline.tw: 拉迪溫這人有點隱居，不過他沒有惡意。若你不想去找他，我也不會勉強你。
dialogsDecline.vi: Radion là một hermit, nhưng ông ấy không có ý hãm hại. Tuy nhiên, tôi không thể buộc bạn nói chuyện với ông ấy nếu bạn không muốn.

dialogsComplete.fil: Hello adventurer... I see Marche has sent you to me with something interesting in hand.

dialogsComplete.th: สวัสดีนักผจญภัย... Marche ส่งเจ้ามาหาข้าด้วยเรื่องที่น่าสนใจสินะ
dialogsComplete.tw: 你好啊，冒險家……看來瑪爾奇派你帶著有趣的東西來找我了。
dialogsComplete.vi: Xin chào nhà thám hiểm.. Tôi thấy Marche đã cử bạn đến gặp tôi cùng với một thứ thú vị trong tay.

description.en: Collect ten Ultima from the giants of Coral Island and treasure chests in The Wilds.

description.sw: Collect ten Ultima from the giants of Coral Island and treasure chests in The Wilds.

description.tw: 從珊瑚島的巨人和荒野叢境的寶箱中蒐集十個終極精粹。
description.vi: Thu thập mười Ultima từ những người khổng lồ của Đảo San hô và các rương kho báu trong The Wilds.

dialogsBegin.en: Your arrival has come at a critical time, hero. Bring me Ultima, and in return I shall grant you the key to ultimate power.
dialogsBegin.ar: Your arrival has come at a critical time, hero. Bring me Ultima, and in return I shall grant you the key to ultimate power.
dialogsBegin.br: Sua chegada ocorreu em um momento crítico, herói. Traga-me Ultima e, em troca, eu lhe concederei a chave para o poder supremo.
dialogsBegin.cns: 英雄，你来得正是时候。为我取来终极精粹，作为回报，我将授予你掌控终极力量的钥匙。
dialogsBegin.de: Deine Ankunft kommt zu einem kritischen Zeitpunkt. Bring mir Ultima, und im Gegenzug werde ich dir den Schlüssel zur ultimativen Macht geben.
dialogsBegin.fi: Your arrival has come at a critical time, hero. Bring me Ultima, and in return I shall grant you the key to ultimate power.
dialogsBegin.fil: Your arrival has come at a critical time, hero. Bring me Ultima, and in return I shall grant you the key to ultimate power.
dialogsBegin.fr: Votre arrivée tombe à un moment critique, héros. Apportez-moi des Ultima, et en échange je vous accorderai la clé du pouvoir ultime.
dialogsBegin.id: Kedatanganmu datang pada saat yang kritis, Pahlawan. Bawakan aku Ultima, dan sebagai imbalannya aku akan memberimu kunci kekuatan tertinggi.
dialogsBegin.it: Your arrival has come at a critical time, hero. Bring me Ultima, and in return I shall grant you the key to ultimate power.
dialogsBegin.jp: 英雄よ、君の到着は危機的な時期にやってきた。ウルティマを持ってきてくれ、その見返りに究極の力への鍵を授けよう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 때마침 도착하셨네요, 용사님. 울티마를 가져다주시면, 얼티밋 파워를 얻을 비법을 알려 드릴게요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Your arrival has come at a critical time, hero. Bring me Ultima, and in return I shall grant you the key to ultimate power.
dialogsBegin.pl: Your arrival has come at a critical time, hero. Bring me Ultima, and in return I shall grant you the key to ultimate power.
dialogsBegin.ru: Your arrival has come at a critical time, hero. Bring me Ultima, and in return I shall grant you the key to ultimate power.
dialogsBegin.sp: Has llegado en un momento crítico, héroe. Tráeme a Ultima y, a cambio, te daré la llave del poder supremo.
dialogsBegin.sw: Your arrival has come at a critical time, hero. Bring me Ultima, and in return I shall grant you the key to ultimate power.
dialogsBegin.th: การมาถึงของคุณมาในช่วงเวลาที่สำคัญมาก นำUltima มาให้ฉัน และฉันจะมอบกุญแจสู่พลังให้กับคุณ
dialogsBegin.tw: 你的到來正是關鍵時刻，英雄。把終極精粹帶給我，作為交換，我將賜予你通往究極力量的鑰匙。
dialogsBegin.vi: Sự xuất hiện của bạn đã đến vào thời điểm quan trọng, anh hùng. Hãy mang Ultima cho tôi, đổi lại tôi sẽ trao cho bạn chìa khóa của sức mạnh tối thượng.

dialogsAccept.en: Collect Ultima from the giant creatures that live on Coral Island, or from chests of plunder deep in The Wilds.
dialogsAccept.ar: Collect Ultima from the giant creatures that live on Coral Island, or from chests of plunder deep in The Wilds.
dialogsAccept.br: Colete Ultima das criaturas gigantes que vivem na Ilha de Coral ou dos baús de tesouro nas profundezas de The Wilds.
dialogsAccept.cns: 从栖息在珊瑚岛的巨型生物身上收集终极精粹，或是深入荒野，从掠夺宝箱中获取。
dialogsAccept.de: Sammle Ultima von den riesigen Kreaturen, die auf der Koralleninsel leben, oder von Truhen mit Beute tief in der Wildnis.
dialogsAccept.fi: Collect Ultima from the giant creatures that live on Coral Island, or from chests of plunder deep in The Wilds.
dialogsAccept.fil: Collect Ultima from the giant creatures that live on Coral Island, or from chests of plunder deep in The Wilds.
dialogsAccept.fr: Récupérez des Ultima sur les créatures géantes de l'Île Corail ou dans les coffres remplis de trésors de la Jungle Sauvage.

dialogsAccept.kr: 코랄 아일랜드에 사는 거대 몬스터를 사냥하거나 러스티아 깊은 곳에 있는 상자를 열어 울티마를 수집하세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Collect Ultima from the giant creatures that live on Coral Island, or from chests of plunder deep in The Wilds.

dialogsAccept.th: รวบรวม Ultima จากสิ่งมีชีวิตขนาดยักษ์ที่อาศัยอยู่บน Coral Island หรือจากหีบสมบัติอันล้ำค่าใน The Wilds
dialogsAccept.tw: 從珊瑚島上的巨型生物，或荒野叢境深處的掠奪寶箱中蒐集終極精粹。

dialogsDecline.en: Without Ultima I cannot grant the ultimate power you seek.
dialogsDecline.ar: Without Ultima I cannot grant the ultimate power you seek.
dialogsDecline.br: Sem Ultima, não posso conceder o poder supremo que você procura.
dialogsDecline.cns: 没有终极精粹，我便无法赐予你所追寻的终极力量。
dialogsDecline.de: Ohne Ultima kann ich die ultimative Macht, die du suchst, nicht gewähren.
dialogsDecline.fi: Without Ultima I cannot grant the ultimate power you seek.
dialogsDecline.fil: Without Ultima I cannot grant the ultimate power you seek.
dialogsDecline.fr: Sans Ultima, je ne peux pas vous accorder le pouvoir ultime que vous recherchez.
dialogsDecline.id: Tanpa Ultima saya tidak bisa memberikan kekuatan tertinggi yang kamu cari.
dialogsDecline.it: Without Ultima I cannot grant the ultimate power you seek.
dialogsDecline.jp: ウルティマがいなければ、お前が求める究極の力を与えることはできない。
dialogsDecline.kr: 울티마가 없으면 용사님이 찾으시는 얼티밋 파워도 드릴 수 없어요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Without Ultima I cannot grant the ultimate power you seek.
dialogsDecline.pl: Without Ultima I cannot grant the ultimate power you seek.
dialogsDecline.ru: Without Ultima I cannot grant the ultimate power you seek.
dialogsDecline.sp: Sin Ultima no puedo otorgarte el poder supremo que buscas.
dialogsDecline.sw: Without Ultima I cannot grant the ultimate power you seek.
dialogsDecline.th: หากไม่มี Ultima ฉันคงไม่สามารถมอบพลังขั้นสูงสุดที่คุณต้องการได้
dialogsDecline.tw: 沒有終極精粹，我就無法賜予你所追求的究極力量。
dialogsDecline.vi: Không có Ultima tôi không thể ban cho bạn sức mạnh tối thượng mà bạn tìm kiếm.

dialogsComplete.en: Well done, hero... I bestow upon you the power of the Ultimate Orb. Combine this with Shining Oricalkum and obtain ultimate power!
dialogsComplete.ar: Well done, hero... I bestow upon you the power of the Ultimate Orb. Combine this with Shining Oricalkum and obtain ultimate power!
dialogsComplete.br: Muito bem, herói... Eu lhe concedo o poder do Orbe Supremo. Combine isso com Oricalco Brilhante e obtenha o poder supremo!
dialogsComplete.cns: 做得好，英雄……我将终极宝珠的力量赐予你。将它与闪耀晶石结合，即可获得终极力量！
dialogsComplete.de: Gut gemacht... Ich verleihe dir die Macht des Ultimate Orb. Kombiniere ihn mit dem Shining Oricalkum und erhalte ultimative Macht!
dialogsComplete.fi: Well done, hero... I bestow upon you the power of the Ultimate Orb. Combine this with Shining Oricalkum and obtain ultimate power!
dialogsComplete.fil: Well done, hero... I bestow upon you the power of the Ultimate Orb. Combine this with Shining Oricalkum and obtain ultimate power!
dialogsComplete.fr: Bien joué, héros... Je vous confère le pouvoir de l'Orbe ultime. Combinez-le avec l'Orichalque Scintillant et obtenez le pouvoir ultime !
dialogsComplete.id: Bagus sekali, Pahlawan... Aku menganugerahkan kepadamu kekuatan Ultimate Orb. Gabungkan ini dengan Shining Oricalkum dan dapatkan kekuatan tertinggi!
dialogsComplete.it: Well done, hero... I bestow upon you the power of the Ultimate Orb. Combine this with Shining Oricalkum and obtain ultimate power!
dialogsComplete.jp: よくやった、ヒーロー..究極のオーブの力をあなたに授けます。シャイニング・オリカルクムと合体して究極のパワーを手に入れよう!
dialogsComplete.kr: 훌륭해요, 용사님... 용사님께 얼티밋 오브의 힘을 드릴게요. 이 구슬을 빛나는 오리칼쿰과 결합하면 얼티밋 파워를 손에 넣을 수 있죠!
dialogsComplete.nl: Well done, hero... I bestow upon you the power of the Ultimate Orb. Combine this with Shining Oricalkum and obtain ultimate power!
dialogsComplete.pl: Well done, hero... I bestow upon you the power of the Ultimate Orb. Combine this with Shining Oricalkum and obtain ultimate power!
dialogsComplete.ru: Well done, hero... I bestow upon you the power of the Ultimate Orb. Combine this with Shining Oricalkum and obtain ultimate power!
dialogsComplete.sp: Bien hecho, héroe. Te otorgo el poder del Orbe Definitivo. ¡Combina esto con Oricalco Brillante y obtén el máximo poder!
dialogsComplete.sw: Well done, hero... I bestow upon you the power of the Ultimate Orb. Combine this with Shining Oricalkum and obtain ultimate power!
dialogsComplete.th: ทำได้ดีมากผู้กล้า... ข้าขอมอบพลังของ Ultimate Orb ให้กับเจ้า ใช้ร่วมกับ Shining Oricalkum เพื่อนำไปสูงพลังสูงสุด
dialogsComplete.tw: 做得好，英雄……我現在將終極寶珠的力量賜予你。把它與閃耀奧里哈鋼結合，獲得究極之力吧！
dialogsComplete.vi: Làm tốt lắm, anh hùng... Tôi ban cho bạn sức mạnh của Ultimate Orb. Kết hợp điều này với Shining Oricalkum và có được sức mạnh tối thượng!

dialogsBegin.en: One thing still troubles me though... The thick webbing around the entrance can be explained by the spiders, but what creature could have such loud, stomping footsteps?
dialogsBegin.ar: One thing still troubles me though... The thick webbing around the entrance can be explained by the spiders, but what creature could have such loud, stomping footsteps?
dialogsBegin.br: Uma coisa ainda me preocupa... A teia espessa ao redor da entrada pode ser explicada pelas aranhas, mas que criatura poderia ter passos tão fortes e pesados?
dialogsBegin.cns: One thing still troubles me though... The thick webbing around the entrance can be explained by the spiders, but what creature could have such loud, stomping footsteps?
dialogsBegin.de: Eine Sache beunruhigt mich allerdings noch. Die dicken Spinnweben um den Eingang lassen sich durch die Spinnen erklären, aber welches Wesen könnte so laute, stampfende Schritte machen?
dialogsBegin.fi: One thing still troubles me though... The thick webbing around the entrance can be explained by the spiders, but what creature could have such loud, stomping footsteps?
dialogsBegin.fil: One thing still troubles me though... The thick webbing around the entrance can be explained by the spiders, but what creature could have such loud, stomping footsteps?
dialogsBegin.fr: Une chose me perturbe encore... Les toiles épaisses autour de l'entrée peuvent être expliquées par les araignées, mais quelle créature pourrait avoir des bruits de pas aussi forts ?
dialogsBegin.id: Satu hal yang masih menggangguku.. Jaring tebal di sekitar pintu masuk dapat dijelaskan oleh laba-laba, tetapi makhluk apa yang memiliki langkah kaki yang begitu keras dan menghentak?
dialogsBegin.it: One thing still troubles me though... The thick webbing around the entrance can be explained by the spiders, but what creature could have such loud, stomping footsteps?
dialogsBegin.jp: しかし、まだ1つのことが私を悩ませています..入り口の周りの厚い水かきはクモによって説明することができますが、どの生き物がそのような大声で踏み鳴らす足音を持つことができますか?
dialogsBegin.kr: 하지만 아직도 한 가지 문제가 있어요... 입구 주변의 두꺼운 거미줄은 거미가 했다고 쳐요. 그런데 발소리가 저렇게 크고 요란한 생물도 있나요?
dialogsBegin.nl: One thing still troubles me though... The thick webbing around the entrance can be explained by the spiders, but what creature could have such loud, stomping footsteps?
dialogsBegin.pl: One thing still troubles me though... The thick webbing around the entrance can be explained by the spiders, but what creature could have such loud, stomping footsteps?
dialogsBegin.ru: One thing still troubles me though... The thick webbing around the entrance can be explained by the spiders, but what creature could have such loud, stomping footsteps?
dialogsBegin.sp: Sin embargo, hay algo que todavía me preocupa... Las gruesas telarañas alrededor de la entrada pueden ser explicadas por las arañas, pero ¿qué criatura podría tener pisadas tan fuertes?
dialogsBegin.sw: One thing still troubles me though... The thick webbing around the entrance can be explained by the spiders, but what creature could have such loud, stomping footsteps?
dialogsBegin.th: มีสิ่งนึงรบกวนจิตใจข้า คือไอ้ใยแมงมุมหนา ๆ รอบ ๆ ทางเข้านั้นน่าจะเกิดจากพวกแมงมุมน่ะหล่ะ แต่ตัวอะไรกัน ที่มันมีเสียงฝีเท้าและกระทืบเท้าดังขนาดนั้น
dialogsBegin.tw: 不過有件事還是讓我很在意……入口那層厚蛛網還能說是蜘蛛造成的，但那麼沉重的踏步聲，究竟是什麼生物發出的？
dialogsBegin.vi: Mặc dù vậy, có một điều vẫn khiến tôi băn khoăn.. Mạng nhện dày bao quanh lối vào có thể được giải thích là do lũ nhện, nhưng sinh vật nào có thể có những bước dậm chân to và ồn ào như vậy?

dialogsAccept.de: Geh tiefer in die Ruinen und finde heraus, was dieses laute, pochende Geräusch verursacht.

dialogsAccept.fil: Go deeper into the ruins and find out what is making that loud thumping noise.
dialogsAccept.fr: Poursuivez votre chemin dans les ruines et découvrez ce qui fait ce bruit sourd.

dialogsAccept.it: Go deeper into the ruins and find out what is making that loud thumping noise.
dialogsAccept.jp: 廃墟の奥深くに行き、その大きなゴツゴツという音を立てているものを見つけてください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 폐허 깊숙이 들어가서 시끄러운 발소리의 원인을 찾아보세요.

dialogsAccept.pl: Go deeper into the ruins and find out what is making that loud thumping noise.
dialogsAccept.ru: Go deeper into the ruins and find out what is making that loud thumping noise.
dialogsAccept.sp: Adéntrate en las ruinas y averigua qué está provocando ese fuerte ruido sordo.
dialogsAccept.sw: Go deeper into the ruins and find out what is making that loud thumping noise.
dialogsAccept.th: ไปให้ลึกในซากปรักหักพังนี้และค้นหาว่าอะไรคือที่มาของเสียงดังพวกนี้
dialogsAccept.tw: 再往遺跡深處去，查清楚那個巨大聲響到底是什麼。
dialogsAccept.vi: Đi sâu hơn vào đống đổ nát và tìm hiểu điều gì đang tạo ra tiếng ồn lớn đó.

dialogsDecline.en: I won't blame you for avoing whatever beast awaits the next group of adventurers. It sounds big...
dialogsDecline.ar: I won't blame you for avoing whatever beast awaits the next group of adventurers. It sounds big...
dialogsDecline.br: Não vou te culpar por evitar a criatura que espera pelos próximos aventureiros. Parece ser enorme...
dialogsDecline.cns: I won't blame you for avoing whatever beast awaits the next group of adventurers. It sounds big...
dialogsDecline.de: Ich kann es dir nicht verübeln, wenn du dem Ungeheuer aus dem Weg gehst, das die nächste Gruppe von Abenteurern erwartet. Es klingt groß...
dialogsDecline.fi: I won't blame you for avoing whatever beast awaits the next group of adventurers. It sounds big...
dialogsDecline.fil: I won't blame you for avoing whatever beast awaits the next group of adventurers. It sounds big...
dialogsDecline.fr: Je ne vous en voudrai pas d'éviter la bête qui attend le prochain groupe d'aventuriers. Ça a l'air gros..
dialogsDecline.id: Aku tidak akan menyalahkanmu karena menghindari monster apa pun yang menunggu kelompok petualang berikutnya. Kedengarannya besar..
dialogsDecline.it: I won't blame you for avoing whatever beast awaits the next group of adventurers. It sounds big...
dialogsDecline.jp: 次の冒険者グループを待っている獣を犯したことであなたを責めるつもりはありません。それは大きく聞こえます..
dialogsDecline.kr: 다음 모험가들을 기다리고 있는 괴물을 피하신다 해도 원망하진 않을게요. 소리가 꽤 큰데요...
dialogsDecline.nl: I won't blame you for avoing whatever beast awaits the next group of adventurers. It sounds big...
dialogsDecline.pl: I won't blame you for avoing whatever beast awaits the next group of adventurers. It sounds big...
dialogsDecline.ru: I won't blame you for avoing whatever beast awaits the next group of adventurers. It sounds big...
dialogsDecline.sp: No te culparé por evitar cualquier bestia que espere al próximo grupo de aventureros. Suena grande..
dialogsDecline.sw: I won't blame you for avoing whatever beast awaits the next group of adventurers. It sounds big...
dialogsDecline.th: ข้าไม่โทษเจ้าหรอกที่เจ้าเลี่ยงที่จะไม่เจอพวกสัตว์ร้าย..เสียงพวกนั้นมันดังทีเดียว
dialogsDecline.tw: 如果你想避開等待下一批冒險家的那頭怪物，我也不會怪你。聽起來真的很巨大……
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi sẽ không trách bạn vì đã né tránh bất cứ con quái vật nào đang chờ đợi nhóm thám hiểm tiếp theo. Nghe chừng nó có vẻ to lớn...

dialogsComplete.en: Sadly it seems the adventurers all fell to the power of the the massive gorilla inside the ruins... I believe the group would have wanted you to finish what they set out to do. Here, take their belongings. Perhaps it will help.
dialogsComplete.ar: Sadly it seems the adventurers all fell to the power of the the massive gorilla inside the ruins... I believe the group would have wanted you to finish what they set out to do. Here, take their belongings. Perhaps it will help.
dialogsComplete.br: Que tristeza... Parece que todos os aventureiros foram vencidos pelo poderoso gorila gigante dentro das ruínas... Mas acredito que o grupo gostaria que você completasse a missão que eles começaram. Aqui, leve os pertences deles. Quem sabe esses itens possam ser úteis.
dialogsComplete.cns: Sadly it seems the adventurers all fell to the power of the the massive gorilla inside the ruins... I believe the group would have wanted you to finish what they set out to do. Here, take their belongings. Perhaps it will help.
dialogsComplete.de: Leider scheinen die Abenteurer alle der Macht des riesigen Gorillas in den Ruinen zum Opfer gefallen zu sein. Ich glaube, die Gruppe hätte gewollt, dass du beendest, was sie vorhatte. Hier, nimm ihre Habseligkeiten. Vielleicht hilft es dir.
dialogsComplete.fi: Sadly it seems the adventurers all fell to the power of the the massive gorilla inside the ruins... I believe the group would have wanted you to finish what they set out to do. Here, take their belongings. Perhaps it will help.
dialogsComplete.fil: Sadly it seems the adventurers all fell to the power of the the massive gorilla inside the ruins... I believe the group would have wanted you to finish what they set out to do. Here, take their belongings. Perhaps it will help.
dialogsComplete.fr: Malheureusement, il semble que les aventuriers aient tous succombé au pouvoir de l'énorme gorille à l'intérieur des ruines... Je crois que le groupe aurait voulu que vous terminiez ce qu'il avait entrepris. Tenez, prenez leurs affaires. Cela vous aidera peut-être.
dialogsComplete.id: Sedihnya tampaknya semua petualang jatuh ke dalam kekuatan gorila besar di dalam reruntuhan.. Aku yakin kelompok itu ingin kamu menyelesaikan apa yang ingin mereka lakukan. Ini, ambil barang-barang mereka. Mungkin itu akan membantu.
dialogsComplete.it: Sadly it seems the adventurers all fell to the power of the the massive gorilla inside the ruins... I believe the group would have wanted you to finish what they set out to do. Here, take their belongings. Perhaps it will help.
dialogsComplete.jp: 悲しいことに、冒険者たちは皆、廃墟の中の巨大なゴリラの力に落ちたようです。グループはあなたに彼らがやろうとしていることを終えてほしかっただろうと私は信じています。ここで、彼らの持ち物を取ります。おそらくそれは役立つでしょう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 안타깝게도 모험가들은 모두 폐허 속 거대한 고릴라에게 쓰러진 것 같군요... 아마 자신들이 하려던 일을 당신이 마저 끝내주길 바랄 거예요. 자, 모험가들의 소지품을 좀 받아 가요. 도움이 될지도 모르죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: Sadly it seems the adventurers all fell to the power of the the massive gorilla inside the ruins... I believe the group would have wanted you to finish what they set out to do. Here, take their belongings. Perhaps it will help.
dialogsComplete.pl: Sadly it seems the adventurers all fell to the power of the the massive gorilla inside the ruins... I believe the group would have wanted you to finish what they set out to do. Here, take their belongings. Perhaps it will help.
dialogsComplete.ru: Sadly it seems the adventurers all fell to the power of the the massive gorilla inside the ruins... I believe the group would have wanted you to finish what they set out to do. Here, take their belongings. Perhaps it will help.
dialogsComplete.sp: Lamentablemente parece que todos los aventureros cayeron ante el poder del enorme gorila dentro de las ruinas.. Creo que el grupo hubiera querido que terminaras lo que se propusieron hacer. Toma sus pertenencias. Tal vez ayude.
dialogsComplete.sw: Sadly it seems the adventurers all fell to the power of the the massive gorilla inside the ruins... I believe the group would have wanted you to finish what they set out to do. Here, take their belongings. Perhaps it will help.
dialogsComplete.th: น่าเศร้าที่นักผจญภัยทั้งหมดได้พลาดท่าให้กับกอริล่าตัวใหญ่ทรงพลังที่อยู่ด้านใน ข้าเชื่อว่าทุกคนอยากให้เจ้าทำสิ่งที่ค้างคาให่เสร็จ นี่เป็นสิ่งของที่เหลือจากพวกเขา มันอาจจะช่วยเจ้าได้บ้างนะ
dialogsComplete.tw: 可惜，看來那些冒險家全都倒在遺跡裡那頭巨型猩猩手下了……我想，他們一定會希望你替他們完成未竟之事。拿著吧，這是他們留下的東西，也許能派上用場。
dialogsComplete.vi: Buồn thay, có vẻ như tất cả nhà thám hiểm đều gục ngã trước sức mạnh của gorilla khổng lồ bên trong khu tàn tích... Tôi tin rằng những người đó sẽ muốn bạn hoàn thành những gì họ đã bắt đầu. Đây, hãy lấy dụng cụ của họ. Có lẽ nó sẽ giúp ích.

dialogsComplete.de: Unglaublich, dass sich hier die ganze Zeit Leben versteckt hat! Es ist eine Schande, dass die Meerjungfrauen-Schönheiten so bösartig waren. Wahrscheinlich wurden sie von den magischen Gewässern beeinflusst, genau wie die Syliaca.
dialogsComplete.fi: It's incredible that life has been hidden here this whole time! It's a shame the Mermaid Beauties were so vicious. Likely influenced by the magical waters just as the Syliaca were.
dialogsComplete.fil: It's incredible that life has been hidden here this whole time! It's a shame the Mermaid Beauties were so vicious. Likely influenced by the magical waters just as the Syliaca were.
dialogsComplete.fr: C'est incroyable que la vie soit restée cachée ici pendant tout ce temps ! C'est dommage que les Belles Sirènes aient été si vicieuses. Probablement influencées par les eaux magiques, tout comme les Syliaca.
dialogsComplete.id: Sungguh luar biasa bahwa hidup telah tersembunyi di sini selama ini! Sayang sekali Mermaid Beauties begitu kejam. Kemungkinan dipengaruhi oleh air ajaib seperti halnya Syliaca.
dialogsComplete.it: It's incredible that life has been hidden here this whole time! It's a shame the Mermaid Beauties were so vicious. Likely influenced by the magical waters just as the Syliaca were.
dialogsComplete.jp: 人生がずっとここに隠されてきたのは信じられないほどです!マーメイドビューティーズがとても悪質だったのは残念です。おそらく、シリアカと同じように魔法の水の影響を受けています。
dialogsComplete.kr: 그동안 이곳에 생명체가 숨어 살고 있었다니, 정말 놀라워요! 아름다운 인어들이 너무 포악해서 안타깝지만요. 실리아카처럼 마법 물의 영향을 받았나 봐요.
dialogsComplete.nl: It's incredible that life has been hidden here this whole time! It's a shame the Mermaid Beauties were so vicious. Likely influenced by the magical waters just as the Syliaca were.
dialogsComplete.pl: It's incredible that life has been hidden here this whole time! It's a shame the Mermaid Beauties were so vicious. Likely influenced by the magical waters just as the Syliaca were.
dialogsComplete.ru: It's incredible that life has been hidden here this whole time! It's a shame the Mermaid Beauties were so vicious. Likely influenced by the magical waters just as the Syliaca were.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Es increíble que la vida haya estado escondida aquí tanto tiempo! Es una pena que las Bellas Sirenas fueran tan viciosas. Probablemente influenciadas por las aguas mágicas como lo fueron las Syliaca.
dialogsComplete.sw: It's incredible that life has been hidden here this whole time! It's a shame the Mermaid Beauties were so vicious. Likely influenced by the magical waters just as the Syliaca were.
dialogsComplete.th: มันสุดยอดมากที่มีชีวิตที่ซ่อนอยู่ตรงนี้มาตลอดเวลา มันแย่ไปหน่อยที่ Mermaid Beauties ดุร้ายมาก เหมือนมันจะได้รับผลมาจากน้ำเวทย์มนต์แบบเดียวกับที่ Syliaca ได้รับ
dialogsComplete.tw: 真不可思議，原來生命一直都被藏在這裡！可惜那些人魚美人竟然如此兇暴。大概就和希莉卡一樣，是受到了魔法水流的影響。
dialogsComplete.vi: Thật không thể tin được rằng sự sống đã bị ẩn giấu ở đây suốt thời gian qua! Thật xấu hổ khi Mermaid Beauties quá ác độc. Có khả năng bị ảnh hưởng bởi dòng nước ma thuật giống như Syliaca.

dialogsBegin.en: Long ago, a huge Meral was once blessed by Shade. The Meral grew twisted and grotesque, but filled with dark power.

dialogsComplete.vi: Dường như một mảnh của viên đá này tràn đầy lam thuật...đây chắc chắn là tác phẩm của Shade.

dialogsComplete.en: Fufufu, the only thing that bothers me is that there is legend of a second piece of magic stone hidden on this island. Maybe one day the two of us will discover where it's hiding!
dialogsComplete.ar: Fufufu, the only thing that bothers me is that there is legend of a second piece of magic stone hidden on this island. Maybe one day the two of us will discover where it's hiding!
dialogsComplete.br: Fufufu, a única coisa que me incomoda é que há uma lenda sobre um segundo pedaço de pedra mágica escondido nesta ilha. Talvez um dia nós dois descubramos onde está escondido!
dialogsComplete.cns: 呼呼呼，唯一让我耿耿于怀的是，传说岛上还藏着第二块魔法石。说不定哪天，咱们俩就能找到它藏在哪里！
dialogsComplete.de: Fufufu, das Einzige, was mich beunruhigt, ist die Legende von einem zweiten magischen Stein, der auf dieser Insel versteckt sein soll. Vielleicht werden wir beide eines Tages herausfinden, wo er versteckt ist!
dialogsComplete.fi: Fufufu, the only thing that bothers me is that there is legend of a second piece of magic stone hidden on this island. Maybe one day the two of us will discover where it's hiding!
dialogsComplete.fil: Fufufu, the only thing that bothers me is that there is legend of a second piece of magic stone hidden on this island. Maybe one day the two of us will discover where it's hiding!
dialogsComplete.fr: Fufufu, la seule chose qui me dérange est qu'il existe une légende d'un deuxième morceau de pierre magique caché sur cette île. Peut-être qu'un jour nous découvrirons tous les deux où il se cache !
dialogsComplete.id: Fufufu, satu-satunya hal yang menggangguku adalah ada legenda batu ajaib kedua yang tersembunyi di pulau ini. Mungkin suatu hari nanti kita berdua akan mengetahui di mana persembunyiannya!
dialogsComplete.it: Fufufu, the only thing that bothers me is that there is legend of a second piece of magic stone hidden on this island. Maybe one day the two of us will discover where it's hiding!
dialogsComplete.jp: ふふふ、唯一気になるのは、この島に2つ目の魔石が隠されているという伝説があることです。いつの日か、2人で隠れている場所がわかるかもしれませんね!
dialogsComplete.kr: 후후후, 사실 신경 쓰이는 게 있어요. 이 섬에 숨겨진 두 번째 마법의 돌에 얽힌 전설을 들었거든요. 어쩌면 우리 둘이 함께 그 돌이 어디에 숨겨져 있는지 알아낼 수 있을지도 모르죠!
dialogsComplete.nl: Fufufu, the only thing that bothers me is that there is legend of a second piece of magic stone hidden on this island. Maybe one day the two of us will discover where it's hiding!
dialogsComplete.pl: Fufufu, the only thing that bothers me is that there is legend of a second piece of magic stone hidden on this island. Maybe one day the two of us will discover where it's hiding!
dialogsComplete.ru: Fufufu, the only thing that bothers me is that there is legend of a second piece of magic stone hidden on this island. Maybe one day the two of us will discover where it's hiding!
dialogsComplete.sp: Fufufu, lo que me molesta es que según la leyenda hay una segunda pieza de piedra mágica escondida en la isla. ¡Quizás algún día nosotros dos descubramos dónde se esconde!
dialogsComplete.sw: Fufufu, the only thing that bothers me is that there is legend of a second piece of magic stone hidden on this island. Maybe one day the two of us will discover where it's hiding!
dialogsComplete.th: ฟุฟุฟุ สิ่งเดียวที่กวนใจฉันคือมีตำนานเกี่ยวกับหินวิเศษชิ้นที่สองที่ซ่อนอยู่บนเกาะแห่งนี้ บางทีวันหนึ่งเราสองคนอาจจะค้นพบว่ามันซ่อนอยู่ที่ไหนก็ได้!
dialogsComplete.tw: 呵呵呵，唯一讓我在意的是，傳說中這座島上還藏著第二塊魔法石。也許總有一天，我們兩個會一起找出它藏在哪裡！
dialogsComplete.vi: Fufufu, điều duy nhất làm tôi băn khoăn là truyền thuyết về một mảnh thứ hai của viên đá phép thuật được giấu trên hòn đảo này. Có lẽ một ngày nào đó hai chúng ta sẽ khám phá ra được nơi nó được cất giấu!

dialogsBegin.en: There has been an influx of Meteoritill lately ever since a meteorite fell in the Fantasy Desert.

dialogsBegin.en: If I combine the Metallurgic Bull Ring, some Meteoritill, and Cardpuppet gears, I believe I can create a lightning rod strong enough to draw lightning away from the airships heading to Saint City!
dialogsBegin.ar: If I combine the Metallurgic Bull Ring, some Meteoritill, and Cardpuppet gears, I believe I can create a lightning rod strong enough to draw lightning away from the airships heading to Saint City!
dialogsBegin.br: Se eu combinar o Anel de Touro Metálico, um pouco de Meteoritil e engrenagens de Cardpuppet, acredito que posso criar um para-raios forte o suficiente para desviar o raio dos dirigíveis que seguem para a Cidade de Saint!
dialogsBegin.cns: If I combine the Metallurgic Bull Ring, some Meteoritill, and Cardpuppet gears, I believe I can create a lightning rod strong enough to draw lightning away from the airships heading to Saint City!
dialogsBegin.de: Wenn ich den Metallurgischen Stierring, einige Meteoritill und Cardpuppet -Zahnräder kombiniere, glaube ich, dass ich einen Blitzableiter bauen kann, der stark genug ist, um die Blitze von den Luftschiffen auf dem Weg nach Saint Morning abzuleiten!
dialogsBegin.fi: If I combine the Metallurgic Bull Ring, some Meteoritill, and Cardpuppet gears, I believe I can create a lightning rod strong enough to draw lightning away from the airships heading to Saint City!
dialogsBegin.fil: If I combine the Metallurgic Bull Ring, some Meteoritill, and Cardpuppet gears, I believe I can create a lightning rod strong enough to draw lightning away from the airships heading to Saint City!
dialogsBegin.fr: Si je combine l'anneau de taureau métallurgique, un peu de Météoritil et des engrenages de Cardpuppet, je pense pouvoir créer un paratonnerre suffisamment puissant pour éloigner la foudre des dirigeables qui se dirigent vers Saint City !
dialogsBegin.id: Jika saya menggabungkan Metallurgic Bull Ring, beberapa Meteoritill, dan perlengkapan Cardpuppet, saya yakin saya dapat membuat penangkal petir yang cukup kuat untuk menarik petir menjauh dari kapal udara yang menuju ke Saint City!
dialogsBegin.it: If I combine the Metallurgic Bull Ring, some Meteoritill, and Cardpuppet gears, I believe I can create a lightning rod strong enough to draw lightning away from the airships heading to Saint City!
dialogsBegin.jp: 冶金ブルリング、隕石、カードパペットのギアを組み合わせると、セントシティに向かう飛行船から稲妻を引き離すのに十分な強度の避雷針を作成できると思います!
dialogsBegin.kr: 야금술 황소 반지와 메테오리틸, 카드퍼펫 부품을 조합해 튼튼한 피뢰침을 만들면, 세인트 시티로 향하는 비행선이 번개를 피할 수 있을 거예요!
dialogsBegin.nl: If I combine the Metallurgic Bull Ring, some Meteoritill, and Cardpuppet gears, I believe I can create a lightning rod strong enough to draw lightning away from the airships heading to Saint City!
dialogsBegin.pl: If I combine the Metallurgic Bull Ring, some Meteoritill, and Cardpuppet gears, I believe I can create a lightning rod strong enough to draw lightning away from the airships heading to Saint City!
dialogsBegin.ru: If I combine the Metallurgic Bull Ring, some Meteoritill, and Cardpuppet gears, I believe I can create a lightning rod strong enough to draw lightning away from the airships heading to Saint City!
dialogsBegin.sp: Si combino el Anillo de Toro Metalúrgico, algo de Meteoritill y engranajes de Cardpuppet, ¡creo que podré crear un pararrayos lo bastante fuerte como para alejar los rayos de las aeronaves que se dirigen a Ciudad Santa!
dialogsBegin.sw: If I combine the Metallurgic Bull Ring, some Meteoritill, and Cardpuppet gears, I believe I can create a lightning rod strong enough to draw lightning away from the airships heading to Saint City!
dialogsBegin.th: ถ้าข้าผสม Metallurgic Bull Ring แล้วก็ Meteoritill กับ Cardpuppet gears แล้วล
dialogsBegin.tw: 如果把冶金牛環、一些隕鐵礦，再加上卡牌傀儡的齒輪組合起來，我相信就能打造出足以把雷電引離聖音特航線飛艇的避雷針！
dialogsBegin.vi: Nếu tôi kết hợp Metallurgic Bull Ring, một số Meteoritill, và Cardpuppet gears, tôi tin rằng mình có thể tạo ra một lightning rod đủ mạnh để thu hút tia sét khỏi các airships đang hướng đến Saint City!
