dialogsBegin.en: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 20 dungeon bosses on Hard or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.ar: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 20 dungeon bosses on Hard or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.br: Bem-vindo herói! Recebemos outro pedido para limpar os chefes masquerpets das masmorras de Madrigal. Você poderia eliminar 20 chefes de masmorra na dificuldade Difícil ou superior e retornar a mim quando terminar?
dialogsBegin.cns: 欢迎你，英雄！又有新委托了，需要清除瑞加大陆副本中的Boss 级别怪物。请你击杀 20 个副本 Boss，完成后再来找我。
dialogsBegin.de: Willkommen Held! Es ist eine weitere Bitte eingegangen, die Boss-Masquerpets in Madrigals Dungeons zu beseitigen. Kannst du bitte 20 Dungeon-Bosse auf dem Schwierigkeitsgrad "Schwer" oder höher töten und zu mir zurückkehren, sobald du fertig bist?
dialogsBegin.fi: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 20 dungeon bosses on Hard or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.fil: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 20 dungeon bosses on Hard or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.fr: Bienvenue héros ! Nous avons reçu une autre demande pour éliminer les boss dans les donjons de Madrigal. Pourriez-vous, s'il vous plaît, tuer 20 boss de donjon (Difficile ou plus), et revenir me voir une fois que vous aurez terminé ?
dialogsBegin.id: Selamat datang pahlawan! Permintaan lain telah datang untuk membersihkan boss masquerpets di Madrigal's dungeons. Bisakah kamu membunuh 20 bos dungeon pada tingkat kesulitan Hard atau lebih tinggi, dan kembali kepadaku setelah kamu selesai?
dialogsBegin.it: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 20 dungeon bosses on Hard or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.jp: ようこそヒーロー!マドリガルのダンジョン内のボスの仮面舞踏会を一掃する依頼がまた一つ入ってきた。ハード以上の難易度でダンジョンのボスを20体倒して、終わったら戻ってきてくれませんか?
dialogsBegin.kr: 어서 오세요, 용사님! 마드리갈 던전에 있는 보스 마스커펫을 처치해 달라는 부탁을 또 받았어요. 어려움 이상 난이도의 던전 보스 20마리를 처치하고, 완료되면 제게 돌아와 주시겠어요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 20 dungeon bosses on Hard or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.pl: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 20 dungeon bosses on Hard or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.ru: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 20 dungeon bosses on Hard or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Bienvenido héroe! Ha llegado otra solicitud; Eliminar los jefes enmascarados en las mazmorras de Madrigal. ¿Podrías matar a 20 jefes de mazmorra en dificultad Difícil o superior y regresar cuando hayas terminado?
dialogsBegin.sw: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 20 dungeon bosses on Hard or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.th: ยินดีต้อนรับผู้กล้า! มีคำขอเข้ามาอีกครั้งเพื่อกำจัด masquerpets ในดันเจี้ยนของ Madrigal คุณจะช่วยกำจัดบอสดันเจี้ยนซัก 20 ตัว ที่ระดับ Hard หรือสูงกว่าได้ไหม จากนั้นกลับมาหาฉันเมื่อคุณจัดการเสร็จ
dialogsBegin.tw: 歡迎，英雄！又有新的委託，要清除瑪德利賈各地副本中的頭目魔物。請在困難以上難度擊殺 20 隻副本頭目，完成後再回來找我。
dialogsBegin.vi: Xin chào người hùng! Có một nhiệm vụ khác yêu cầu dọn sạch trùm masquerpets ẩn náu trong ngục tối của Madrigal. Bạn có thể giết 20 trùm ngục tối ở mức độ Hard hoặc cao hơn và quay lại chỗ tôi khi xong việc không?

dialogsAccept.en: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon on Hard or higher difficulty 20 times, and return to me for a reward.

dialogsAccept.de: Sammle am Ende eines beliebigen Dungeons auf dem Schwierigkeitsgrad "Schwer" oder höher 20x die Seelen von Boss-Masquerpets und bringe sie zu mir zurück, um eine Belohnung zu erhalten.

dialogsAccept.it: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon on Hard or higher difficulty 20 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsAccept.jp: ハード以上の難易度のダンジョンの最後にあるボスの仮面舞踏会から魂を20回集めて、報酬を求めて私のところに戻ってきます。

dialogsAccept.sw: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon on Hard or higher difficulty 20 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsAccept.th: รวบรวมวิญญาณจาก masquerpets ตอนท้ายของดันเจี้ยนใดๆ 20 ครั้ง ที่ระดับความยาก Hard หรือสูงกว่าแล้วกลับมาหาฉันเพื่อรับรางวัล
dialogsAccept.tw: 從任意副本困難以上難度的最終頭目魔物身上蒐集 20 次靈魂，再回來找我領取獎勵。
dialogsAccept.vi: Thu thập linh hồn của trùm masquerpet mức độ Hard hoặc cao hơn ở cuối hầm ngục tối 20 lần và quay lại chỗ tôi để nhận thưởng.

dialogsDecline.en: The dungeons are filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.ar: The dungeons are filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.br: As masmorras estão cheias de masquerpets perigosos. Eu entendo se você não quiser correr o risco.
dialogsDecline.cns: 这些副本遍布着危险的怪物。如果你不想冒这个险，我完全理解。

dialogsDecline.th: ในดันเจี้ยนไปด้วย masquerpets ที่อันตรายมาก ฉันเข้าใจถ้าคุณไม่อยากเสี่ยง

dialogsComplete.en: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsComplete.ar: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsComplete.br: A ameaça dentro das masmorras foi reduzida graças a você, herói. Por favor, aceite um cartão de perfuração de arma como agradecimento por seus esforços!
dialogsComplete.cns: 英雄，多亏了你，副本内部的威胁已经减轻了。为感谢你的付出，请收下这张武器穿洞卡作为谢礼！
dialogsComplete.de: Die Bedrohung aus den Dungeons ist dank dir, Held, geringer geworden. Bitte nimm eine Weapon Piercing Card als Dank für deine Bemühungen an!

dialogsComplete.fr: La menace des donjons a été réduite grâce à vous, héros. Veuillez accepter une carte de piercing d'arme en guise de remerciement pour vos efforts !
dialogsComplete.id: Ancaman dari dalam dungeon telah mengurangi berkatmu, Pahlawan. Mohon terima weapon piercing card sebagai ucapan terima kasih atas usahamu!
dialogsComplete.it: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsComplete.jp: ダンジョン内からの脅威は、ヒーローであるあなたのおかげで減少しました。お礼に武器貫通カードを受け取ってください!
dialogsComplete.kr: 용사님 덕분에 던전 안이 훨씬 안전해졌어요. 자, 무기 피어싱 카드를 받아주세요, 노고에 대한 감사의 표시랍니다!
dialogsComplete.nl: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!

dialogsComplete.sp: La amenaza en las mazmorras se ha reducido gracias a ti, héroe. ¡Acepte una tarjeta de perforación de armas como agradecimiento por tus esfuerzos!
dialogsComplete.sw: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsComplete.th: ภัยคุกคามจากดันเจี้ยนลดลงเล้ว ท่านผู้กล้าโปรดรับการ์ดเจาะอาวุธเพื่อเป็นการขอบคุณสำหรับความพยายามของคุณ!
dialogsComplete.tw: 多虧了你，副本內的威脅已經減輕了，英雄。請收下這張武器打洞卡，作為對你努力的感謝！
dialogsComplete.vi: Mối đe dọa từ bên trong hầm ngục đã giảm đi nhiều nhờ có bạn đấy, người hùng. Xin hãy nhận một thẻ xuyên vũ khí như một lời cảm ơn vì những nỗ lực của bạn!

dialogsAccept.en: Deep within the camp of the Wildwoods dwells a potent species of beast known as the Wildwood Stalkers. They are lead by the mysterious Wildwood Shaman, a being believed to imbue them with corrupted magics.
dialogsAccept.ar: Deep within the camp of the Wildwoods dwells a potent species of beast known as the Wildwood Stalkers. They are lead by the mysterious Wildwood Shaman, a being believed to imbue them with corrupted magics.
dialogsAccept.br: No fundo do acampamento dos Wildwoods habita uma espécie potente de besta conhecida como Perseguidores Wildwood. Eles são liderados pelo misterioso Xamã Wildwood, uma entidade que se acredita imbuir-los com magias corrompidas.
dialogsAccept.cns: Deep within the camp of the Wildwoods dwells a potent species of beast known as the Wildwood Stalkers. They are lead by the mysterious Wildwood Shaman, a being believed to imbue them with corrupted magics.
dialogsAccept.de: Tief im Lager der Wildhölzer haust eine mächtige Bestienart, die als Wildholz-Pirscher bekannt ist. Sie werden von dem mysteriösen Wildholz-Schamanen angeführt, einem Wesen, von dem man glaubt, dass es sie mit verderbter Magie durchdringt.

dialogsAccept.fil: Deep within the camp of the Wildwoods dwells a potent species of beast known as the Wildwood Stalkers. They are lead by the mysterious Wildwood Shaman, a being believed to imbue them with corrupted magics.
dialogsAccept.fr: Dans les profondeurs de Désiréa vit une puissante espèce de bête connue sous le nom de Guerrier Tang. Ils sont dirigés par le mystérieux Chamane Tang, un être censé les imprégner de magies corrompues.
dialogsAccept.id: Jauh di dalam perkemahan Wildwoods, hiduplah spesies binatang buas yang dikenal sebagai Wildwood Stalkers. Mereka dipimpin oleh Wildwood Shaman yang misterius, makhluk yang diyakini memberi mereka sihir jahat.
dialogsAccept.it: Deep within the camp of the Wildwoods dwells a potent species of beast known as the Wildwood Stalkers. They are lead by the mysterious Wildwood Shaman, a being believed to imbue them with corrupted magics.
dialogsAccept.jp: ワイルドウッズのキャンプの奥深くには、ワイルドウッドストーカーとして知られる強力な獣の種が住んでいます。彼らは、堕落した魔法を吹き込むと信じられている謎のワイルドウッドシャーマンに率いられています。
dialogsAccept.kr: 와일드우드 영지 깊숙한 곳에는 와일드우드 사냥꾼이라는 무시무시한 야수들이 살고 있어요. 수수께끼의 와일드우드 주술사들이 무리를 이끄는데, 아마 사냥꾼들에게 타락한 주술을 불어넣는 것 같아요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Deep within the camp of the Wildwoods dwells a potent species of beast known as the Wildwood Stalkers. They are lead by the mysterious Wildwood Shaman, a being believed to imbue them with corrupted magics.
dialogsAccept.pl: Deep within the camp of the Wildwoods dwells a potent species of beast known as the Wildwood Stalkers. They are lead by the mysterious Wildwood Shaman, a being believed to imbue them with corrupted magics.
dialogsAccept.ru: Deep within the camp of the Wildwoods dwells a potent species of beast known as the Wildwood Stalkers. They are lead by the mysterious Wildwood Shaman, a being believed to imbue them with corrupted magics.
dialogsAccept.sp: En lo profundo del campamento de Bosque Salvaje habita una potente bestia conocida como Acosador Bosque Salvaje. Están dirigidos por el misterioso Chamán Bosque Salvaje, un ser que les imbuye magia corrupta.
dialogsAccept.sw: Deep within the camp of the Wildwoods dwells a potent species of beast known as the Wildwood Stalkers. They are lead by the mysterious Wildwood Shaman, a being believed to imbue them with corrupted magics.
dialogsAccept.th: ลึกเข้าไปในค่าย Wildwoods มีสายพันธุ์อันทรงพลัง ที่รู้จักกันในชื่อ Wildwood Stalkers อาศัยอยู่ พวกมันถูกนำโดย Wildwood Shaman ผู้ลึกลับ ซึ่งเชื่อกันว่าเป็นผู้ที่มอบเวทมนตร์ชั่วร้ายให้กับพวกมัน
dialogsAccept.tw: 在荒林營地深處，棲息著一種強大的野獸──荒林潛獵者。牠們由神秘的荒林薩滿率領，據說那個存在會賦予牠們腐化魔法。
dialogsAccept.vi: Sâu bên trong doanh trại của Wildwoods là nơi trú ngụ của một dòng quái vật hùng mạnh với cái tên Wildwood Stalkers. Chúng được điều khiển bởi Wildwood Shaman bí ẩn, một thực thể được cho là đã yểm bùa những con quái vật này bằng tà thuật.

dialogsDecline.en: To challenge the Wildwood without being thoroughly prepared would be a grave mistake.
dialogsDecline.ar: To challenge the Wildwood without being thoroughly prepared would be a grave mistake.
dialogsDecline.br: Desafiar os Wildwood sem estar totalmente preparado seria um grave erro.
dialogsDecline.cns: To challenge the Wildwood without being thoroughly prepared would be a grave mistake.
dialogsDecline.de: Es wäre ein großer Fehler, die Wildhölzer herauszufordern, ohne gründlich vorbereitet zu sein.
dialogsDecline.fi: To challenge the Wildwood without being thoroughly prepared would be a grave mistake.
dialogsDecline.fil: To challenge the Wildwood without being thoroughly prepared would be a grave mistake.
dialogsDecline.fr: Affronter Désiréa sans être bien préparé serait une grave erreur
dialogsDecline.id: Menantang Wildwood tanpa persiapan yang matang akan menjadi kesalahan besar.
dialogsDecline.it: To challenge the Wildwood without being thoroughly prepared would be a grave mistake.
dialogsDecline.jp: 万全の準備をせずにワイルドウッドに挑むのは、重大な過ちです。
dialogsDecline.kr: 철저한 준비 없이 섣불리 와일드우드에 도전하다가는 큰코 다치실 겁니다.
dialogsDecline.nl: To challenge the Wildwood without being thoroughly prepared would be a grave mistake.
dialogsDecline.pl: To challenge the Wildwood without being thoroughly prepared would be a grave mistake.
dialogsDecline.ru: To challenge the Wildwood without being thoroughly prepared would be a grave mistake.
dialogsDecline.sp: Desafiar a Bosque Salvaje sin estar completamente preparado sería un grave error.
dialogsDecline.sw: To challenge the Wildwood without being thoroughly prepared would be a grave mistake.
dialogsDecline.th: การท้าทาย Wildwood โดยไม่ได้เตรียมตัวมาอย่างดี ถือเป็นเรื่องที่ผิดพลาดมาก
dialogsDecline.tw: 若未做好萬全準備就去挑戰荒林族群，會是極其嚴重的錯誤。
dialogsDecline.vi: Thách thức quái vật vùng Wildwood mà không chuẩn bị kỹ càng sẽ là một sai lầm lớn.

dialogsComplete.en: The Wildwood have truly fallen!? Well done, hero! Only the King now stands in your path!
dialogsComplete.ar: The Wildwood have truly fallen!? Well done, hero! Only the King now stands in your path!
dialogsComplete.br: Os Wildwood realmente caíram!? Bem feito, herói! Agora apenas o Rei está no seu caminho!
dialogsComplete.cns: The Wildwood have truly fallen!? Well done, hero! Only the King now stands in your path!
dialogsComplete.de: Sind die Wildhölzer wirklich gefallen? Gut gemacht, Held! Nur der König steht dir noch im Weg!

dialogsComplete.fil: The Wildwood have truly fallen!? Well done, hero! Only the King now stands in your path!
dialogsComplete.fr: Désiréa est vraiment tombé ! Bien joué, héros ! Seul le Roi, Remardda, se dresse maintenant sur votre chemin !
dialogsComplete.id: Wildwood benar-benar telah jatuh!? Bagus sekali, pahlawan! Hanya Raja yang sekarang berdiri di jalanmu!
dialogsComplete.it: The Wildwood have truly fallen!? Well done, hero! Only the King now stands in your path!
dialogsComplete.jp: ワイルドウッドは本当に堕ちた!?よくやった、ヒーロー!今、あなたの行く手を阻むのは王様だけです!
dialogsComplete.kr: 정말 와일드우드를 쓰러뜨리다니!? 훌륭해요, 용사님! 이제는 왕만 남았군요!
dialogsComplete.nl: The Wildwood have truly fallen!? Well done, hero! Only the King now stands in your path!
dialogsComplete.pl: The Wildwood have truly fallen!? Well done, hero! Only the King now stands in your path!
dialogsComplete.ru: The Wildwood have truly fallen!? Well done, hero! Only the King now stands in your path!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¿¡Bosque Salvaje realmente han caído!? ¡Bien hecho, héroe! ¡Ahora sólo el Rey se interpone en tu camino!
dialogsComplete.sw: The Wildwood have truly fallen!? Well done, hero! Only the King now stands in your path!
dialogsComplete.th: Wildwood ล่มสลายจริงหรือ!? ทำได้ดีมาก! ตอนนี้มีเพียงราชาเท่านั้น!
dialogsComplete.tw: 荒林族竟然真的被你擊潰了！？做得好，英雄！現在就只剩下獸王擋在你面前了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Bọn quái vật Wildwood thực sự đã bị đánh bại sao!? Làm tốt lắm, người hùng! Giờ đây chỉ còn The King đang ngáng đường bạn!

dialogsBegin.en: The Naga are powerful warriors of the sea... their $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ are said to hold magical powers that can be used to harness purple energy. I have a healthy fear of Purple Magic, but what doesn't kill you only makes you stronger.
dialogsBegin.ar: The Naga are powerful warriors of the sea... their $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ are said to hold magical powers that can be used to harness purple energy. I have a healthy fear of Purple Magic, but what doesn't kill you only makes you stronger.
dialogsBegin.br: Os Naga são guerreiros poderosos do mar... seus $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ dizem ter poderes mágicos que podem ser usados para controlar energia roxa. Tenho um medo saudável de Magia Roxa, mas o que não nos mata nos torna mais fortes.
dialogsBegin.cns: The Naga are powerful warriors of the sea... their $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ are said to hold magical powers that can be used to harness purple energy. I have a healthy fear of Purple Magic, but what doesn't kill you only makes you stronger.
dialogsBegin.de: Die Naga sind mächtige Krieger des Meeres. Ihre $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ sollen magische Kräfte besitzen, mit denen man sich violette Energie zunutze machen kann. Ich habe eine gesunde Angst vor violetter Magie, aber was dich nicht umbringt, macht dich nur stärker.
dialogsBegin.fi: The Naga are powerful warriors of the sea... their $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ are said to hold magical powers that can be used to harness purple energy. I have a healthy fear of Purple Magic, but what doesn't kill you only makes you stronger.
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang mga Naga ay makapangyarihang mandirigma ng dagat... sinasabing ang kanilang mga $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ ay may mahikal na kapangyarihang magamit para kontrolin ang purple energy. Natatakot ako sa Purple Magic, pero ang hindi pumapatay sa'yo ay nagpapalakas sa'yo.
dialogsBegin.fr: Les Nagaros sont de puissantes guerrières des mers... leurs $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ sont réputés détenir des pouvoirs magiques qui peuvent être utilisés pour exploiter l'énergie violette. J'ai une peur bleue de la magie pourpre, mais ce qui ne vous tue pas vous rend plus fort.
dialogsBegin.id: Naga adalah pejuang laut yang kuat... mereka $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ dikatakan memiliki kekuatan magis yang dapat digunakan untuk memanfaatkan energi ungu. Aku punya ketakutan yang sehat terhadap Purple Magic, tapi apa yang tidak membunuhmu hanya akan membuatmu lebih kuat.
dialogsBegin.it: The Naga are powerful warriors of the sea... their $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ are said to hold magical powers that can be used to harness purple energy. I have a healthy fear of Purple Magic, but what doesn't kill you only makes you stronger.
dialogsBegin.jp: ナーガは海の強力な戦士です。彼らの$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$は、紫色のエネルギーを利用するために使用できる魔法の力を持っていると言われています。私はパープルマジックを健全に恐れているが、あなたを殺さないものはあなたを強くするだけだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 나가족은 강력한 바다의 전사로... $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$은(는) 자주색 에너지를 사용하는 마법의 힘을 가지고 있다고 하죠. 사람들은 자주색 마법을 두려워하지만, 날 죽이지 못하는 건 날 더 강하게 할 뿐 아니겠어요?
dialogsBegin.nl: The Naga are powerful warriors of the sea... their $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ are said to hold magical powers that can be used to harness purple energy. I have a healthy fear of Purple Magic, but what doesn't kill you only makes you stronger.
dialogsBegin.pl: The Naga are powerful warriors of the sea... their $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ are said to hold magical powers that can be used to harness purple energy. I have a healthy fear of Purple Magic, but what doesn't kill you only makes you stronger.

dialogsBegin.sp: Los Naga son poderosos guerreros del mar. Se dice que sus $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ tienen poderes mágicos que aprovechan la energía púrpura. Tengo miedo a la Magia Púrpura, pero lo que no te mata te hace más fuerte.
dialogsBegin.sw: The Naga are powerful warriors of the sea... their $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ are said to hold magical powers that can be used to harness purple energy. I have a healthy fear of Purple Magic, but what doesn't kill you only makes you stronger.
dialogsBegin.th: Naga เป็นนักรบแห่งท้องทะเลผู้ทรงพลัง... มีการกล่าวกันว่า $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ ของพวกมันมีพลังวิเศษที่สามารถใช้ควบคุมพลังงานสีม่วงได้ ฉันกลัวเวทมนตร์สีม่วงนั่นพอสมควร แต่สิ่งที่ฆ่าคุณไม่ได้จะทำให้คุณแข็งแกร่งขึ้น
dialogsBegin.tw: 那伽是海中的強大戰士……據說牠們的 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ 內蘊含著可用來駕馭紫色能量的魔力。我對紫色魔法懷有適度的敬畏，但凡是殺不死你的，只會讓你更強。
dialogsBegin.vi: Người Naga là những chiến binh hùng mạnh của biển...Người ta kể rằng $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ của họ nắm giữ sức mạnh phép thuật có khả năng khai thác năng lượng tím. Tôi có một sự lo lắng nhất định với Purple Magic, nhưng cái gì không giết được ta sẽ khiến ta mạnh hơn.

dialogsComplete.en: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! Soon I'll know more about this Purple Magic... Perhaps one day enough to stop its evil from taking over Coral Island.
dialogsComplete.ar: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! Soon I'll know more about this Purple Magic... Perhaps one day enough to stop its evil from taking over Coral Island.
dialogsComplete.br: Obrigado por coletar todos aqueles $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, aventureiro! Em breve saberei mais sobre essa Magia Roxa... Talvez um dia o suficiente para impedir que seu mal tome conta da Ilha de Coral.
dialogsComplete.cns: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! Soon I'll know more about this Purple Magic... Perhaps one day enough to stop its evil from taking over Coral Island.
dialogsComplete.de: Danke, dass du all diese $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ gesammelt hast, Abenteurer! Bald werde ich mehr über diese Purpurmagie wissen. Vielleicht kann ich eines Tages verhindern, dass das Böse die Koralleninsel übernimmt.

dialogsComplete.fr: Merci d'avoir collecté tous ces $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, aventurier ! Bientôt, j'en saurai plus sur cette Magie Pourpre. Peut-être qu'un jour, j'en saurai assez pour empêcher le mal de s'emparer de l'Île Corail.
dialogsComplete.id: Terima kasih telah mengumpulkan semua $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ itu, petualang! Saya akan segera mengetahui lebih banyak tentang Purple Magic ini... Mungkin suatu hari cukup untuk menghentikan kejahatannya mengambil alih Coral Island.
dialogsComplete.it: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! Soon I'll know more about this Purple Magic... Perhaps one day enough to stop its evil from taking over Coral Island.
dialogsComplete.jp: 冒険者の皆さん、$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$を全て集めてくれてありがとう!すぐに私はこの紫の魔法についてもっと知るでしょう..いつの日か、その悪がコーラル島を乗っ取るのを止めるのに十分でしょう。
dialogsComplete.kr: $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$을(를) 모두 수집해 주셔서 감사합니다, 모험가님! 곧 이 자주색 마법에 대해서도 더 자세히 알게 되겠죠... 언젠가는 코랄 아일랜드를 지배하는 악의 세력을 막아낼 수 있을지도 모르죠.

dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Gracias por reunir todos esos $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, aventurero! Pronto sabré más sobre esta Magia Púrpura. Quizás algún día sea suficiente para evitar que su maldad se apodere de Isla Coral.
dialogsComplete.sw: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! Soon I'll know more about this Purple Magic... Perhaps one day enough to stop its evil from taking over Coral Island.
dialogsComplete.th: ขอบคุณที่รวบรวม $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ ทั้งหมดมาได้นะ นักผจญภัย! เร็วๆ นี้ ฉันจะได้รู้เพิ่มเติมเกี่ยวกับเวทมนตร์สีม่วงนี้... บางทีสักวันหนึ่งอาจจะเพียงพอที่จะหยุดยั้งความชั่วร้ายไม่ให้เข้ายึด Coral Island ได้
dialogsComplete.tw: 感謝你收集了這麼多 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$，冒險家！很快我就能更了解這種紫色魔法……也許有一天，知道的夠多時，就能阻止它的邪惡侵蝕珊瑚島。
dialogsComplete.vi: Cảm ơn vì đã thu thập tất cả $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, nhà thám hiểm! Sớm thôi tôi sẽ biết được nhiều hơn về Purple Magic...Có lẽ một ngày nào đó tôi sẽ đủ kiến thức để ngăn chặn thứ tà thuật này xâm chiếm Coral Island.

dialogsBegin.en: The glass inside a Meral's $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ can enhance a person's vision thrice their normal spotting distance. Collect me enough and I could build a telescope to peer halfway across the globe!
dialogsBegin.ar: The glass inside a Meral's $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ can enhance a person's vision thrice their normal spotting distance. Collect me enough and I could build a telescope to peer halfway across the globe!
dialogsBegin.br: O vidro dentro de um $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ de Meral pode aumentar a visão de uma pessoa em até três vezes a sua distância normal. Colete o suficiente para mim e eu poderia construir um telescópio para ver metade do globo!
dialogsBegin.cns: The glass inside a Meral's $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ can enhance a person's vision thrice their normal spotting distance. Collect me enough and I could build a telescope to peer halfway across the globe!
dialogsBegin.de: Das Glas im Inneren eines Meral $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ kann die Sicht einer Person um das Dreifache ihrer normalen Sehentfernung verbessern. Wenn ich genug Geld hätte, könnte ich ein Teleskop bauen, mit dem ich die halbe Welt sehen kann!

dialogsBegin.fil: Ang salamin sa loob ng $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ ng Meral ay kayang palakihin ang paningin ng isang tao nang tatlong beses kaysa normal. Kolektahin mo ang sapat at makakagawa ako ng teleskopyo na makakakita ng kalahati ng mundo!
dialogsBegin.fr: Le verre à l'intérieur d'un $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ Merel peut améliorer la vision d'une personne en triplant sa distance d'observation normale. Rassemblez assez d'argent et je pourrai construire un télescope pour observer la moitié du globe !
dialogsBegin.id: Kaca di dalam Meral $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ dapat meningkatkan penglihatan seseorang tiga kali lipat jarak penglihatan normalnya. Kumpulkan secukupnya dan aku bisa membuat teleskop untuk mengintip belahan dunia!

dialogsAccept.jp: マルケは常にこの地域の植物の魔法の特性の専門家でした。マルケと話して、フラリス菌の魔法についてもっと学びましょう。
dialogsAccept.kr: 마르셰는 예전부터 이 지역 식물의 마법 속성에 관해서는 최고의 전문가였죠... 마르셰를 찾아가서, 플라리스 버섯 마법에 대해 더 자세히 알아보세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Marche has always been an expert on the magical properties of the plant life in the region... Go speak with Marche to learn more about the magic within the Flaris fungi.
dialogsAccept.pl: Marche has always been an expert on the magical properties of the plant life in the region... Go speak with Marche to learn more about the magic within the Flaris fungi.
dialogsAccept.ru: Marche has always been an expert on the magical properties of the plant life in the region... Go speak with Marche to learn more about the magic within the Flaris fungi.
dialogsAccept.sp: Marche es un experto de las propiedades mágicas de los vegetales de la región.. Habla con Marche para saber más sobre la magia de los hongos Flaris.
dialogsAccept.sw: Marche has always been an expert on the magical properties of the plant life in the region... Go speak with Marche to learn more about the magic within the Flaris fungi.
dialogsAccept.th: Marche เป็นผู้เชี่ยวชาญเกี่ยวกับคุณสมบัติทางเวทย์ของพืชในเขตนี้ ลองไปคุยกับกับ Marche เพื่อหาข้อมูลเพิ่มเติมเกี่ยวกับเวทย์มนต์ใน Flaris fungi
dialogsAccept.tw: 瑪爾奇一直都是這一帶植物魔法特性的專家……去找瑪爾奇聊聊，看看布拉里斯真菌裡究竟藏著什麼魔力。
dialogsAccept.vi: Marche luôn là một chuyên gia về các đặc tính ma thuật của hệ thực vật trong vùng.. Hãy nói chuyện với Marche để tìm hiểu thêm về ma thuật trong loại nấm Flaris.

dialogsDecline.en: Magic is powerful, and sometimes scary. I understand if you do not want to speak to Marche.
dialogsDecline.ar: Magic is powerful, and sometimes scary. I understand if you do not want to speak to Marche.
dialogsDecline.br: Magia é poderosa e, às vezes, assustadora. Eu entendo se você não quiser falar com o Marche.
dialogsDecline.cns: Magic is powerful, and sometimes scary. I understand if you do not want to speak to Marche.
dialogsDecline.de: Magie ist mächtig, und manchmal auch beängstigend. Ich verstehe, wenn du nicht mit Marche sprechen willst.
dialogsDecline.fi: Magic is powerful, and sometimes scary. I understand if you do not want to speak to Marche.
dialogsDecline.fil: Magic is powerful, and sometimes scary. I understand if you do not want to speak to Marche.
dialogsDecline.fr: La magie est puissante, et parfois effrayante. Je comprends que tu ne veuilles pas parler à Marche.
dialogsDecline.id: Sihir itu kuat, dan terkadang menakutkan. Aku mengerti jika kamu tidak ingin berbicara dengan Marche.
dialogsDecline.it: Magic is powerful, and sometimes scary. I understand if you do not want to speak to Marche.
dialogsDecline.jp: 魔法は強力で、時には怖いです。マルケと話したくない場合は理解できます。
dialogsDecline.kr: 마법은 강력하고 때로는 무섭기도 하죠. 마르셰와 대화하고 싶지 않다는 것도 이해해요.
dialogsDecline.nl: Magic is powerful, and sometimes scary. I understand if you do not want to speak to Marche.
dialogsDecline.pl: Magic is powerful, and sometimes scary. I understand if you do not want to speak to Marche.
dialogsDecline.ru: Magic is powerful, and sometimes scary. I understand if you do not want to speak to Marche.
dialogsDecline.sp: La magia es poderosa, y a veces da miedo. Entiendo que no quieras hablar con Marche.
dialogsDecline.sw: Magic is powerful, and sometimes scary. I understand if you do not want to speak to Marche.
dialogsDecline.th: เวทย์มนต์นั้นทรงพลัง บางครั้งก็น่ากลัว ข้าเข้าใจถ้าเจ้าไม่อยากจะไปคุยกับ Marche
dialogsDecline.tw: 魔法的力量很強，有時也很可怕。如果你不想去找瑪爾奇，我也能理解。
dialogsDecline.vi: Magic rất mạnh mẽ và đôi khi đáng sợ. Tôi hiểu nếu bạn không muốn nói chuyện với Marche.

dialogsComplete.en: Oh, hello! So Sotta sent you to me. I wonder if you are prepared to seek out the magic behind these mushrooms...
dialogsComplete.ar: Oh, hello! So Sotta sent you to me. I wonder if you are prepared to seek out the magic behind these mushrooms...
dialogsComplete.br: Ah, olá! Então a Sotta te mandou até mim. Eu me pergunto se você está preparado para descobrir a magia por trás desses cogumelos...
dialogsComplete.cns: Oh, hello! So Sotta sent you to me. I wonder if you are prepared to seek out the magic behind these mushrooms...
dialogsComplete.de: Oh, hallo! Sotta hat dich also zu mir geschickt. Ich frage mich, ob du bereit bist, die Magie hinter diesen Pilzen zu erforschen...
dialogsComplete.fi: Oh, hello! So Sotta sent you to me. I wonder if you are prepared to seek out the magic behind these mushrooms...
dialogsComplete.fil: Oh, hello! So Sotta sent you to me. I wonder if you are prepared to seek out the magic behind these mushrooms...
dialogsComplete.fr: Oh, bonjour ! C'est Sotta qui vous a envoyé à moi. Je me demande si vous êtes prêt à chercher la magie qui se cache derrière ces champignons...
dialogsComplete.id: Halo! Jadi Sotta mengirimmu kepadaku. Aku ingin tahu apakah kamu siap untuk mencari keajaiban di balik jamur ini..
dialogsComplete.it: Oh, hello! So Sotta sent you to me. I wonder if you are prepared to seek out the magic behind these mushrooms...
dialogsComplete.jp: ねえ！だからソッタはあなたを私に送った。あなたはこれらのキノコの背後にある魔法を探す準備ができているのだろうか..
dialogsComplete.kr: 오, 안녕하세요! 그래서, 소타가 보냈다고요. 이 버섯 속에 숨겨진 마법을 찾을 준비는 되셨겠죠?
dialogsComplete.nl: Oh, hello! So Sotta sent you to me. I wonder if you are prepared to seek out the magic behind these mushrooms...
dialogsComplete.pl: Oh, hello! So Sotta sent you to me. I wonder if you are prepared to seek out the magic behind these mushrooms...
dialogsComplete.ru: Oh, hello! So Sotta sent you to me. I wonder if you are prepared to seek out the magic behind these mushrooms...
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Oh, hola! Así que Sotta te envió a mí. Me pregunto si estás preparado para conocer la magia de estos hongos..
dialogsComplete.sw: Oh, hello! So Sotta sent you to me. I wonder if you are prepared to seek out the magic behind these mushrooms...
dialogsComplete.th: โอ้ สวัสดี Sotta ส่งเจ้ามาหาข้าสินะ ข้าสงสัยจริงว่าเจ้าพร้อมรึยังสำหรับการหาเวทมนต์ที่ซ่อนอยู่ของเจ้าเห็ดพวกนี้
dialogsComplete.tw: 喔，你好！所以是索塔派你來找我的啊。看來你已經準備好探究這些蘑菇背後的魔法了……
dialogsComplete.vi: Ồ, xin chào! Vậy là Sotta cử bạn đến gặp tôi. Tôi tự hỏi liệu bạn đã sẵn sàng để tìm hiểu về phép thuật đằng sau những chiếc nấm không...

dialogsBegin.en: Often potent magic leaves behind a trail in its wake of destruction. If Purple Magic was used to destroy the Guardiane Sanctuary... the people inside that turned into those creatures may have a small essence of purple energy still hanging on.
dialogsBegin.ar: Often potent magic leaves behind a trail in its wake of destruction. If Purple Magic was used to destroy the Guardiane Sanctuary... the people inside that turned into those creatures may have a small essence of purple energy still hanging on.
dialogsBegin.br: O poder mágico, quando intenso, deixa para trás um rastro de destruição. Se a Magia Púrpura foi usada para aniquilar o Santuário dos Guardiões... aqueles que se transformaram nessas criaturas podem reter uma pequena essência da energia púrpura que ainda paira no ar
dialogsBegin.cns: Often potent magic leaves behind a trail in its wake of destruction. If Purple Magic was used to destroy the Guardiane Sanctuary... the people inside that turned into those creatures may have a small essence of purple energy still hanging on.
dialogsBegin.de: Starke Magie hinterlässt oft eine Spur der Zerstörung. Wenn lila Magie verwendet wurde, um das Guardiane-Heiligtum zu zerstören, kann es sein, dass die Menschen, die sich in diese Kreaturen verwandelt haben, noch eine kleine Essenz lila Energie in sich tragen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Often potent magic leaves behind a trail in its wake of destruction. If Purple Magic was used to destroy the Guardiane Sanctuary... the people inside that turned into those creatures may have a small essence of purple energy still hanging on.
dialogsBegin.fil: Often potent magic leaves behind a trail in its wake of destruction. If Purple Magic was used to destroy the Guardiane Sanctuary... the people inside that turned into those creatures may have a small essence of purple energy still hanging on.
dialogsBegin.fr: Souvent, les puissantes magies laissent des traces dans leurs sillages de destruction. Si la magie pourpre a été utilisée pour détruire le Sanctuaire de Gardiane, les personnes à l'intérieur qui se sont transformées en ces créatures pourraient avoir de l'essence d'énergie pourpre qui s'accroche encore en eux.
dialogsBegin.id: Seringkali sihir yang ampuh meninggalkan jejak setelah kehancurannya. Jika Purple Magic digunakan untuk menghancurkan Guardiane Sanctuary.. orang-orang di dalamnya yang berubah menjadi makhluk-makhluk itu mungkin masih memiliki esensi kecil energi ungu yang masih bertahan.
dialogsBegin.it: Often potent magic leaves behind a trail in its wake of destruction. If Purple Magic was used to destroy the Guardiane Sanctuary... the people inside that turned into those creatures may have a small essence of purple energy still hanging on.
dialogsBegin.jp: 多くの場合、強力な魔法は破壊の結果として痕跡を残します。パープルマジックがガーディアンサンクチュアリを破壊するために使用された場合..それらの生き物に変わった内部の人々は、紫色のエネルギーの小さなエッセンスがまだぶら下がっているかもしれません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 강력한 마법이 무언가를 파괴하면 가끔 흔적이 남곤 하죠. 가르디안 성소를 파괴할 때 자주색 마법을 사용했다면... 그 안에 있다가 악의 생명체로 변한 사람들의 몸에 자주색 에너지 정수가 남아있을지도 몰라요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Often potent magic leaves behind a trail in its wake of destruction. If Purple Magic was used to destroy the Guardiane Sanctuary... the people inside that turned into those creatures may have a small essence of purple energy still hanging on.
dialogsBegin.pl: Often potent magic leaves behind a trail in its wake of destruction. If Purple Magic was used to destroy the Guardiane Sanctuary... the people inside that turned into those creatures may have a small essence of purple energy still hanging on.
dialogsBegin.ru: Often potent magic leaves behind a trail in its wake of destruction. If Purple Magic was used to destroy the Guardiane Sanctuary... the people inside that turned into those creatures may have a small essence of purple energy still hanging on.
dialogsBegin.sp: A menudo la magia potente deja tras de sí un rastro de destrucción. Si se utilizó Magia Púrpura para destruir el Santuario de los Guardianes... las personas de dentro que se convirtieron en esas criaturas pueden tener una pequeña esencia de energía púrpura colgando.
dialogsBegin.sw: Often potent magic leaves behind a trail in its wake of destruction. If Purple Magic was used to destroy the Guardiane Sanctuary... the people inside that turned into those creatures may have a small essence of purple energy still hanging on.
dialogsBegin.th: บ่อยครั้งที่เวทมนต์จะทิ้งร่องรอยของการทำลายไว้ ถ้า Purple Magic ถูกใช้เพื่อทำลาย Guardiane Sanctuary แล้วล่ะก็ ผู้คนที่ถูกทำให้เป็นสัตว์ร้ายน่าจะยังมีร่องรอยของพลังงานสีม่วงหลงเหลืออยู่
dialogsBegin.tw: 強大的魔法往往會在毀滅之後留下痕跡。如果摧毀守護者聖域的真是紫色魔法……那麼那些變成怪物的人，體內應該還殘留著些許紫色能量。
dialogsBegin.vi: Ma thuật mạnh mẽ thường để lại dấu vết khi nó được thức tỉnh. Nếu Purple Magic được sử dụng để phá hủy Guardiane Sanctuary.. những người đã bị biến thành những sinh vật sống trong đó có thể vẫn còn một lượng ma thuật tím nhỏ trong cơ thể.

dialogsAccept.th: กลับไปยังซากของ Guardiane Sanctuary และเก็บ purple essence ที่ถูกทิ้งไว้เป็นร่องรอยกับพวกมอนสเตอร์พวกนั้น
dialogsAccept.tw: 返回守護者聖域遺跡，收集留在裡面生物身上的紫色精華。
dialogsAccept.vi: Quay trở lại tàn tích của Guardiane Sanctuary và thu thập tinh chất màu tím còn sót lại trên cơ thể của các sinh vật bên trong.

dialogsDecline.en: Little is known about the effects of Purple Magic on the body... a healthy fear of it may be for the best.
dialogsDecline.ar: Little is known about the effects of Purple Magic on the body... a healthy fear of it may be for the best.
dialogsDecline.br: Pouco se sabe sobre os efeitos da Magia Púrpura no corpo... talvez seja melhor ter um medo saudável dela.
dialogsDecline.cns: Little is known about the effects of Purple Magic on the body... a healthy fear of it may be for the best.
dialogsDecline.de: Über die Auswirkungen von lila Magie auf den Körper ist wenig bekannt. Eine gesunde Angst davor ist vielleicht das Beste.
dialogsDecline.fi: Little is known about the effects of Purple Magic on the body... a healthy fear of it may be for the best.
dialogsDecline.fil: Little is known about the effects of Purple Magic on the body... a healthy fear of it may be for the best.
dialogsDecline.fr: On sait peu de choses sur les effets de la Magie Pourpre sur le corps... Il est préférable d'avoir une crainte saine de cette dernière.
dialogsDecline.id: Sedikit yang diketahui tentang efek Purple Magic pada tubuh.. ketakutan yang sehat akan hal itu mungkin yang terbaik.
dialogsDecline.it: Little is known about the effects of Purple Magic on the body... a healthy fear of it may be for the best.
dialogsDecline.jp: パープルマジックの体への影響についてはほとんど知られていません。それに対する健康的な恐れは最善かもしれません。
dialogsDecline.kr: 자주색 마법이 사람의 몸에 미치는 영향은 거의 알려진 바가 없어요... 지금으로서는 경계하는 게 최선이죠.
dialogsDecline.nl: Little is known about the effects of Purple Magic on the body... a healthy fear of it may be for the best.
dialogsDecline.pl: Little is known about the effects of Purple Magic on the body... a healthy fear of it may be for the best.
dialogsDecline.ru: Little is known about the effects of Purple Magic on the body... a healthy fear of it may be for the best.
dialogsDecline.sp: Se sabe poco sobre los efectos de la Magia Púrpura en el organismo... un sano temor a ella puede ser lo mejor.
dialogsDecline.sw: Little is known about the effects of Purple Magic on the body... a healthy fear of it may be for the best.
dialogsDecline.th: เรื่องที่เรารู้เกี่ยวผลที่มีต่อร่างกายของ Purple Magic นั้นน้อยมาก ดังนั้นการที่จะกลัวก็ไม่ใช่เรื่องผิดอะไร
dialogsDecline.tw: 我們對紫色魔法對肉體造成的影響所知甚少……對它保有敬畏，說不定反而是好事。
dialogsDecline.vi: Người ta biết rất ít về tác dụng của Purple Magic đối với cơ thể.. nên dè chừng nó là tốt nhất.

dialogsComplete.en: The evidence is clear... the only magician powerful enough to cast Purple Magic of this potency is the Purple Magician herself, Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.ar: The evidence is clear... the only magician powerful enough to cast Purple Magic of this potency is the Purple Magician herself, Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.br: As provas são incontestáveis... só uma maga realmente poderosa tem o dom de conjurar a Magia Roxa com uma potência tão avassaladora. Lapranche!
dialogsComplete.cns: The evidence is clear... the only magician powerful enough to cast Purple Magic of this potency is the Purple Magician herself, Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.de: Die Beweise sind eindeutig: Die einzige Magierin, die mächtig genug ist, lila Magie in dieser Stärke zu wirken, ist die lila Magierin selbst, Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.fi: The evidence is clear... the only magician powerful enough to cast Purple Magic of this potency is the Purple Magician herself, Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.fil: The evidence is clear... the only magician powerful enough to cast Purple Magic of this potency is the Purple Magician herself, Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.fr: La preuve est faite... le seul magicien assez puissant pour lancer des sorts de Magie Pourpre de cette puissance est la Magicienne Pourpre en personne, Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.id: Buktinya jelas.. satu-satunya penyihir yang cukup kuat untuk mengeluarkan Purple Magic dari potensi ini adalah Purple Magician itu sendiri, Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.it: The evidence is clear... the only magician powerful enough to cast Purple Magic of this potency is the Purple Magician herself, Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.jp: 証拠は明らかです。この効力のパープルマジックを唱えるのに十分強力な唯一の魔術師は、パープルマジシャン自身、ラプランシュです。
dialogsComplete.kr: 증거가 확실하네요... 이 정도의 강력한 자주색 마법을 시전할 수 있는 유일한 매지션은 퍼플 매지션인 라프란체뿐이에요.
dialogsComplete.nl: The evidence is clear... the only magician powerful enough to cast Purple Magic of this potency is the Purple Magician herself, Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.pl: The evidence is clear... the only magician powerful enough to cast Purple Magic of this potency is the Purple Magician herself, Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.ru: The evidence is clear... the only magician powerful enough to cast Purple Magic of this potency is the Purple Magician herself, Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.sp: La evidencia es clara... la única maga lo suficientemente poderosa como para lanzar Magia Púrpura de esta potencia es la propia Maga Púrpura, Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.sw: The evidence is clear... the only magician powerful enough to cast Purple Magic of this potency is the Purple Magician herself, Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.th: หลักฐานชัดเจนแล้ว นักเวทย์ที่มีพลังมากพอที่จะร่าย Purple Magic ได้ระดับนี้มีเพียงแต่ Lapranche เองเท่านั้น
dialogsComplete.tw: 證據已經很明確了……能施展出這種強度紫色魔法的，只有紫色魔法師本人──拉普蘭雪。
dialogsComplete.vi: Bằng chứng đã rõ ràng.. thuật sư duy nhất đủ mạnh để thi triển Purple Magic có quyền năng to lớn dường này là chính Purple Magician, Lapranche.

dialogsBegin.en: Hmm... well, I believe the magical properties of these mushrooms originally came from spores that fall from the wings of Mothbees.
dialogsBegin.ar: Hmm... well, I believe the magical properties of these mushrooms originally came from spores that fall from the wings of Mothbees.
dialogsBegin.br: Bem, acredito que as propriedades mágicas desses cogumelos vêm originalmente de esporos que caem das asas das Maribelhas.
dialogsBegin.cns: Hmm... well, I believe the magical properties of these mushrooms originally came from spores that fall from the wings of Mothbees.
dialogsBegin.de: Nun, ich glaube, die magischen Eigenschaften dieser Pilze stammen ursprünglich von Sporen, die von den Flügeln der Mothbees fallen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Hmm... well, I believe the magical properties of these mushrooms originally came from spores that fall from the wings of Mothbees.
dialogsBegin.fil: Hmm... well, I believe the magical properties of these mushrooms originally came from spores that fall from the wings of Mothbees.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je crois que les propriétés magiques de ces champignons proviennent à l'origine des spores qui tombent des ailes des papillons de nuit.
dialogsBegin.id: Hmm.. yah, aku yakin khasiat jamur ini awalnya berasal dari spora yang jatuh dari sayap Mothbees.
dialogsBegin.it: Hmm... well, I believe the magical properties of these mushrooms originally came from spores that fall from the wings of Mothbees.
dialogsBegin.jp: んん。。まあ、私はこれらのキノコの魔法の特性はもともとモスビーの翼から落ちる胞子から来たと信じています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 음... 이 버섯의 마법 속성은 모스비의 날개에서 떨어지는 포자에서 나온 것 같아요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Hmm... well, I believe the magical properties of these mushrooms originally came from spores that fall from the wings of Mothbees.
dialogsBegin.pl: Hmm... well, I believe the magical properties of these mushrooms originally came from spores that fall from the wings of Mothbees.
dialogsBegin.ru: Hmm... well, I believe the magical properties of these mushrooms originally came from spores that fall from the wings of Mothbees.
dialogsBegin.sp: Hmm... Bueno, creo que las propiedades mágicas de estas setas proceden de las esporas que sueltan las alas de las Abejas Polilla.
dialogsBegin.sw: Hmm... well, I believe the magical properties of these mushrooms originally came from spores that fall from the wings of Mothbees.
dialogsBegin.th: อืมมม เอาล่ะข้าเชื่อว่าคุณสมบัติเวทมนต์ของพวกเห็ดพวกนี้มาจากสปอร์ที่หล่นมาจากปีกของ Mothbees
dialogsBegin.tw: 嗯……我想，這些蘑菇的魔法特性，原本應該是來自蛾蜂翅膀上掉落的孢子。
dialogsBegin.vi: Hmm.. tôi tin rằng đặc tính ma thuật của nấm ban đầu đến từ hạt giống rơi ra từ cánh của Mothbees.

dialogsBegin.en: With a sample of Mothbee Spores I may be able to recreate the potent vitality mushrooms that may have allowed a troll to live much longer than normal...
dialogsBegin.ar: With a sample of Mothbee Spores I may be able to recreate the potent vitality mushrooms that may have allowed a troll to live much longer than normal...
dialogsBegin.br: Com uma amostra de Esporos de Maribelha, talvez eu possa recriar os cogumelos de vitalidade potente que permitiram trolls viverem muito mais tempo que o normal...
dialogsBegin.cns: With a sample of Mothbee Spores I may be able to recreate the potent vitality mushrooms that may have allowed a troll to live much longer than normal...
dialogsBegin.de: Mit einer Probe von Mothbee-Sporen kann ich vielleicht die starken Vitalpilze nachbilden, die es einem Troll ermöglicht haben, viel länger als normal zu leben.
dialogsBegin.fi: With a sample of Mothbee Spores I may be able to recreate the potent vitality mushrooms that may have allowed a troll to live much longer than normal...
dialogsBegin.fil: With a sample of Mothbee Spores I may be able to recreate the potent vitality mushrooms that may have allowed a troll to live much longer than normal...
dialogsBegin.fr: Avec un échantillon de spores de naphtaline, je pourrais peut-être recréer les puissants champignons de vitalité qui ont permis à un troll de vivre beaucoup plus longtemps que la normale.
dialogsBegin.id: Dengan sampel Spora Mothbee, aku mungkin dapat membuat ulang jamur vitalitas kuat yang memungkinkan troll hidup lebih lama dari biasanya..
dialogsBegin.it: With a sample of Mothbee Spores I may be able to recreate the potent vitality mushrooms that may have allowed a troll to live much longer than normal...
dialogsBegin.jp: モスビー胞子のサンプルで、トロールが通常よりもはるかに長生きすることを可能にしたかもしれない強力な活力キノコを再現できるかもしれません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 모스비의 포자 표본만 있다면, 트롤의 수명을 연장해준 강력한 활력 버섯을 재현할 수 있을지도 몰라요...
dialogsBegin.nl: With a sample of Mothbee Spores I may be able to recreate the potent vitality mushrooms that may have allowed a troll to live much longer than normal...
dialogsBegin.pl: With a sample of Mothbee Spores I may be able to recreate the potent vitality mushrooms that may have allowed a troll to live much longer than normal...
dialogsBegin.ru: With a sample of Mothbee Spores I may be able to recreate the potent vitality mushrooms that may have allowed a troll to live much longer than normal...
dialogsBegin.sp: Con una muestra de esporas de Abeja Polilla seré capaz de recrear los hongos de vitalidad que pueden haber permitido a un troll vivir mucho más tiempo de lo normal..
dialogsBegin.sw: With a sample of Mothbee Spores I may be able to recreate the potent vitality mushrooms that may have allowed a troll to live much longer than normal...
dialogsBegin.th: แค่ตัวอย่างของ Mothbee Spores ข้าอาจจะสามารถจำลองและสร้างเห็ดแห่งพลังชีวิตที่ทำให้พวก Troll สามารถมีชีวิตยืนยาวมากกว่าปรกติได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 只要有蛾蜂孢子的樣本，我也許就能重現那種強效的活力蘑菇，說不定正是它讓巨魔活得比正常還久……
dialogsBegin.vi: Với một mẫu Mothbee Spores, tôi có thể tạo ra một loại nấm tăng sức sống mạnh mẽ cho phép một con quỷ troll sống lâu hơn nhiều so với bình thường..

dialogsAccept.en: The wings of Mothbees shed spores constantly. Please, go defeat the Mothbees flying above Flaris, and bring me a sample of the spores!
dialogsAccept.ar: The wings of Mothbees shed spores constantly. Please, go defeat the Mothbees flying above Flaris, and bring me a sample of the spores!
dialogsAccept.br: As asas das Maribelhas soltam esporos constantemente. Por favor, vá derrotar as Maribelhas voando acima de Flaris e traga uma amostra dos esporos para mim!
dialogsAccept.cns: The wings of Mothbees shed spores constantly. Please, go defeat the Mothbees flying above Flaris, and bring me a sample of the spores!
dialogsAccept.de: Die Flügel der Mothbees werfen ständig Sporen ab. Bitte, besiege die Mothbees, die über Flaris fliegen, und bring mir eine Probe der Sporen!
dialogsAccept.fi: The wings of Mothbees shed spores constantly. Please, go defeat the Mothbees flying above Flaris, and bring me a sample of the spores!
dialogsAccept.fil: The wings of Mothbees shed spores constantly. Please, go defeat the Mothbees flying above Flaris, and bring me a sample of the spores!
dialogsAccept.fr: Les ailes des Mothbees répandent constamment des spores. S'il vous plaît, allez vaincre les papillons de nuit qui volent au-dessus de Flaris et rapportez-moi un échantillon des spores !
dialogsAccept.id: Sayap Mothbees melepaskan spora terus-menerus. Tolong, kalahkan Mothbees yang terbang di atas Flaris, dan bawakan aku sampel spora!
dialogsAccept.it: The wings of Mothbees shed spores constantly. Please, go defeat the Mothbees flying above Flaris, and bring me a sample of the spores!
dialogsAccept.jp: モスビーの羽は絶えず胞子を流します。どうか、フラリスの上空を飛んでいるモスビーを倒して、胞子のサンプルを持ってきてください!
dialogsAccept.kr: 모스비의 날개는 끊임없이 포자를 흩뿌리죠. 플라리스를 날아다니는 모스비들을 처치하고, 제게 포자 표본을 가져다주세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: The wings of Mothbees shed spores constantly. Please, go defeat the Mothbees flying above Flaris, and bring me a sample of the spores!

dialogsAccept.sp: Las alas de las Abejas Polilla desprenden esporas. Por favor, derrota a las Abejas Polilla que vuelan sobre Flaris y tráeme una muestra de las esporas.
dialogsAccept.sw: The wings of Mothbees shed spores constantly. Please, go defeat the Mothbees flying above Flaris, and bring me a sample of the spores!
dialogsAccept.th: ปีกของ Mothbee มีสปอร์หลุดออกมาเรื่อย ๆ ได้โปรดไปกำจัดMothbees ที่บินอยู่เหนื่อ Flaris และนำตัวอย่างสปอร์มาให้ข้า
dialogsAccept.tw: 蛾蜂的翅膀會不斷灑落孢子。拜託你，去擊敗飛在布拉里斯上空的蛾蜂，替我帶回一些孢子樣本！
dialogsAccept.vi: Đôi cánh của Mothbees liên tục rụng spores. Làm ơn, hãy đánh bại những con Mothbees đang bay phía trên Flaris, và mang cho tôi một mẫu spores!

dialogsDecline.en: Mothbees can be vicious creatures. If you don't want to get knocked off your broom, it is best if you leave them alone.
dialogsDecline.ar: Mothbees can be vicious creatures. If you don't want to get knocked off your broom, it is best if you leave them alone.
dialogsDecline.br: As Maribelhas podem ser criaturas muito agressivas. Se você não quiser ser derrubado de sua vassoura, é melhor deixá-las em paz.
dialogsDecline.cns: Mothbees can be vicious creatures. If you don't want to get knocked off your broom, it is best if you leave them alone.
dialogsDecline.de: Mothbees können bösartige Kreaturen sein. Wenn du nicht von deinem Besen gestoßen werden möchtest, lasse sie besser in Ruhe.

dialogsDecline.fr: Les mites peuvent être des créatures vicieuses. Si vous ne voulez pas être renversé de votre balai, il est préférable de les laisser tranquilles.
dialogsDecline.id: Mothbees bisa menjadi makhluk ganas. Jika Anda tidak ingin terlempar dari sapu Anda, sebaiknya Anda membiarkannya saja.

dialogsDecline.nl: Mothbees can be vicious creatures. If you don't want to get knocked off your broom, it is best if you leave them alone.

dialogsDecline.sp: Las Abejas Polilla pueden ser criaturas viciosas. Si no quieres que te tiren de la escoba, es mejor que las dejes tranquilas.
dialogsDecline.sw: Mothbees can be vicious creatures. If you don't want to get knocked off your broom, it is best if you leave them alone.
dialogsDecline.th: Mothbees อาจจะเป็นสัตว์ร้ายที่น่ากลัว ถ้าเจ้าไม่อยากจะถูกตีให้ตกลงมาจากไม้กวาดแล้วละก็ อย่าไปยุ่งกับมันจะดีกว่านะ
dialogsDecline.tw: 蛾蜂可是很兇的生物。如果你不想從飛天掃帚上被打下來，最好還是別去招惹牠們。
dialogsDecline.vi: Mothbees có thể là những sinh vật xấu xa. Nếu không muốn bị rơi khỏi chổi, tốt nhất bạn nên để chúng yên.

description.tw: 從 夢靨 難度的 50 隻副本頭目身上蒐集靈魂。
description.vi: Thu thập linh hồn từ 50 Dungeon Bosses ở độ khó Nightmare.

dialogsBegin.en: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 50 dungeon bosses on Nightmare or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.ar: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 50 dungeon bosses on Nightmare or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.br: Bem-vindo herói! Recebemos outro pedido para limpar os chefes masquerpets das masmorras de Madrigal. Você poderia eliminar 50 chefes de masmorra na dificuldade Pesadelo ou superior e retornar a mim quando terminar?
dialogsBegin.cns: 欢迎你，英雄！又有新委托了，需要清除瑞加大陆副本中的Boss 级别怪物。请你击杀 50 个副本 Boss，完成后再来找我。
dialogsBegin.de: Willkommen Held! Es ist eine weitere Bitte eingegangen, die Boss-Masquerpets in Madrigals Dungeons zu beseitigen. Kannst du bitte 50 Dungeon-Bosse auf dem Schwierigkeitsgrad "Alptraum" oder höher töten und zu mir zurückkehren, sobald du fertig bist?
dialogsBegin.fi: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 50 dungeon bosses on Nightmare or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.fil: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 50 dungeon bosses on Nightmare or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.fr: Bienvenue au héros ! Nous avons reçu une autre demande pour éliminer les boss masqués dans les donjons de Madrigal. Pourriez-vous, s'il vous plaît, tuer 50 boss de donjon (Cauchemar ou plus), et revenir me voir une fois que vous aurez terminé ?
dialogsBegin.id: Selamat datang pahlawan! Permintaan lain telah datang untuk membersihkan boss masquerpets di Madrigal's dungeons. Bisakah kamu membunuh 50 bos dungeon pada tingkat kesulitan Nightmare atau lebih tinggi, dan kembali kepadaku setelah kamu selesai?
dialogsBegin.it: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 50 dungeon bosses on Nightmare or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.jp: ようこそヒーロー!マドリガルのダンジョン内のボスの仮面舞踏会を一掃する依頼がまた一つ入ってきた。ナイトメア以上の難易度でダンジョンのボスを50体倒して、終わったら私のところに戻ってきてくれませんか?
dialogsBegin.kr: 어서 오세요, 용사님! 마드리갈 던전에 있는 보스 마스커펫을 처치해 달라는 부탁을 또 받았어요. 악몽 이상 난이도의 던전 보스 50마리를 처치하고, 완료되면 제게 돌아와 주시겠어요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 50 dungeon bosses on Nightmare or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.pl: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 50 dungeon bosses on Nightmare or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.ru: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 50 dungeon bosses on Nightmare or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Bienvenido héroe! Ha llegado otra solicitud; Eliminar los jefes enmascarados en las mazmorras de Madrigal. ¿Podrías matar a 50 jefes de mazmorra en dificultad Pesadilla o superior y regresar cuando hayas terminado?
dialogsBegin.sw: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 50 dungeon bosses on Nightmare or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.th: ยินดีต้อนรับผู้กล้า! มีคำขอเข้ามาอีกครั้งเพื่อกำจัด masquerpets ในดันเจี้ยนของ Madrigal คุณจะช่วยกำจัดบอสดันเจี้ยนซัก 50 ตัว ที่ระดับ Nightmare หรือสูงกว่าได้ไหม จากนั้นกลับมาหาฉันเมื่อคุณจัดการเสร็จ
dialogsBegin.tw: 歡迎，英雄！又有新的委託要清除瑪德利賈各地副本中的頭目 Masquerpets。可以請你在 夢靨 以上難度擊殺 50 隻副本頭目，完成後再回來找我嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Xin chào người hùng! Có một nhiệm vụ khác yêu cầu dọn sạch trùm masquerpets ẩn náu trong ngục tối của Madrigal. Bạn có thể giết 50 trùm ngục tối ở mức độ Nightmare hoặc cao hơn và quay lại chỗ tôi khi xong việc không?

dialogsAccept.en: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon on Nightmare or higher difficulty 50 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsAccept.ar: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon on Nightmare or higher difficulty 50 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsAccept.br: Colete almas de chefes masquerpets no final de qualquer masmorra na dificuldade Pesadelo ou superior 50 vezes e retorne a mim para uma recompensa.
dialogsAccept.cns: 在任意副本的尽头，从Boss 级别怪物身上收集灵魂，完成50 次后回来找我领取奖励。
dialogsAccept.de: Sammle am Ende eines beliebigen Dungeons auf dem Schwierigkeitsgrad "Alptraum" oder höher 50x die Seelen von Boss-Masquerpets und bringe sie zu mir zurück, um eine Belohnung zu erhalten.
dialogsAccept.fi: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon on Nightmare or higher difficulty 50 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsAccept.fil: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon on Nightmare or higher difficulty 50 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsAccept.fr: Récupérez les âmes des mascarons de boss à la fin de n'importe quel donjon (Cauchemar ou plus) 50 fois, et revenez me voir pour une récompense.
dialogsAccept.id: Kumpulkan jiwa dari bos masquerpet di akhir dungeon mana pun pada tingkat Nightmare atau lebih tinggi sebanyak 50 kali, dan kembalikan kepadaku untuk mendapatkan hadiah.
dialogsAccept.it: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon on Nightmare or higher difficulty 50 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsAccept.jp: ナイトメア以上の難易度でダンジョンの最後にいるボスの仮面舞踏会から魂を50回集めて、報酬を求めて私のところに戻ってきます。
dialogsAccept.kr: 악몽 이상 난이도의 던전이 끝날 때마다 보스 마스커펫을 처치해 영혼을 50회 수집하고, 제게 돌아와 보상을 받으세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon on Nightmare or higher difficulty 50 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsAccept.pl: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon on Nightmare or higher difficulty 50 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsAccept.ru: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon on Nightmare or higher difficulty 50 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsAccept.sp: Recoge almas de jefes masquerpets al salir de mazmorra en dificultad Pesadilla o superior 50 veces y vuelve para recibir una recompensa.
dialogsAccept.sw: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon on Nightmare or higher difficulty 50 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsAccept.th: รวบรวมวิญญาณจาก masquerpets ตอนท้ายของดันเจี้ยนใดๆ 50 ครั้ง ที่ระดับความยาก Nightmare หรือสูงกว่า แล้วกลับมาหาฉันเพื่อรับรางวัล
dialogsAccept.tw: 從任意副本惡夢以上難度的最終頭目魔物身上蒐集 50 次靈魂，再回來找我領取獎勵。
dialogsAccept.vi: Thu thập linh hồn của trùm masquerpet mức độ Nightmare hoặc cao hơn ở cuối hầm ngục tối 35 lần và quay lại chỗ tôi để nhận thưởng.

dialogsDecline.en: The dungeons are filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.ar: The dungeons are filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.br: As masmorras estão cheias de masquerpets perigosos. Eu entendo se você não quiser correr o risco.
dialogsDecline.cns: 这些副本遍布着危险的怪物。如果你不想冒这个险，我完全理解。
dialogsDecline.de: Die Dungeons sind voll von gefährlichen Masquerpets. Ich verstehe, wenn du das Risiko nicht eingehen willst.
dialogsDecline.fi: The dungeons are filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.fil: The dungeons are filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.fr: Les donjons sont remplis de monstres dangereux. Je comprends que vous ne souhaitiez pas prendre le risque.
dialogsDecline.id: Dungeons dipenuhi dengan dangerous masquerpets. Aku mengerti jika kamu tidak ingin mengambil risiko.
dialogsDecline.it: The dungeons are filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.jp: ダンジョンは危険な仮面舞踏会でいっぱいです。リスクを冒したくないのであれば、私は理解しています。
dialogsDecline.kr: 던전에는 위험한 마스커펫이 가득해요. 위험을 감수하고 싶지 않다고 하셔도 이해합니다.
dialogsDecline.nl: The dungeons are filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.pl: The dungeons are filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.ru: The dungeons are filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.sp: Las mazmorras están llenas de peligrosas masquerpets. Entiendo que no quieras correr el riesgo.
dialogsDecline.sw: The dungeons are filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.th: ในดันเจี้ยนไปด้วย masquerpets ที่อันตรายมาก ฉันเข้าใจถ้าคุณไม่อยากเสี่ยง
dialogsDecline.tw: 副本裡充滿危險的 Masquerpets。如果你不想冒這個險，我也能理解。
dialogsDecline.vi: Những hầm ngục đầy rẫy đám masquerpet nguy hiểm. Tôi hiểu nếu bạn không muốn chấp nhận rủi ro này.

dialogsComplete.en: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsComplete.ar: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsComplete.br: A ameaça dentro das masmorras foi reduzida graças a você, herói. Por favor, aceite um cartão de perfuração de arma como agradecimento por seus esforços!
dialogsComplete.cns: 英雄，多亏了你，副本内部的威胁已经减轻了。为感谢你的付出，请收下这张武器穿洞卡作为谢礼！
dialogsComplete.de: Die Bedrohung aus den Dungeons ist dank dir, Held, geringer geworden. Bitte nimm eine Weapon Piercing Card als Dank für deine Bemühungen an!
dialogsComplete.fi: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsComplete.fil: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsComplete.fr: La menace des donjons a été réduite grâce à vous, héros. Veuillez accepter une carte de piercing d'arme en guise de remerciement pour vos efforts !
dialogsComplete.id: Ancaman dari dalam dungeon telah mengurangi berkatmu, Pahlawan. Mohon terima weapon piercing card sebagai ucapan terima kasih atas usahamu!
dialogsComplete.it: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsComplete.jp: ダンジョン内からの脅威は、ヒーローであるあなたのおかげで減少しました。お礼に武器貫通カードを受け取ってください!
dialogsComplete.kr: 용사님 덕분에 던전 안이 훨씬 안전해졌어요. 자, 무기 피어싱 카드를 받아주세요, 노고에 대한 감사의 표시랍니다!
dialogsComplete.nl: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsComplete.pl: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsComplete.ru: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsComplete.sp: La amenaza en las mazmorras se ha reducido gracias a ti, héroe. ¡Acepte una tarjeta de perforación de armas como agradecimiento por tus esfuerzos!
dialogsComplete.sw: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsComplete.th: ภัยคุกคามจากดันเจี้ยนลดลงเล้ว ท่านผู้กล้าโปรดรับการ์ดเจาะอาวุธเพื่อเป็นการขอบคุณสำหรับความพยายามของคุณ!
dialogsComplete.tw: 多虧了你，副本內的威脅已經減輕了，英雄。請收下這張武器打洞卡，作為對你努力的感謝！
dialogsComplete.vi: Mối đe dọa từ bên trong hầm ngục đã giảm đi nhiều nhờ có bạn đấy, người hùng. Xin hãy nhận một thẻ xuyên vũ khí như một lời cảm ơn vì những nỗ lực của bạn!

dialogsFail.en: You haven't defeated the bosses yet? That's okay, just return once you have.
dialogsFail.ar: You haven't defeated the bosses yet? That's okay, just return once you have.
dialogsFail.br: Você ainda não derrotou os chefes? Tudo bem, apenas retorne quando tiver terminado.
dialogsFail.cns: 你还没有击败那些 Boss 吗？没关系，等你完成之后再回来就好。
dialogsFail.de: Du hast die Bosse noch nicht besiegt? Das ist okay, komm einfach zurück, wenn du es geschafft hast.
dialogsFail.fi: You haven't defeated the bosses yet? That's okay, just return once you have.
dialogsFail.fil: You haven't defeated the bosses yet? That's okay, just return once you have.
dialogsFail.fr: Vous n'avez pas encore vaincu les boss ? Ce n'est pas grave, revenez une fois que vous les aurez vaincus.
dialogsFail.id: Kamu belum mengalahkan bosnya? Tidak apa-apa, kembalikan saja setelah kamu punya.
dialogsFail.it: You haven't defeated the bosses yet? That's okay, just return once you have.
dialogsFail.jp: まだボスを倒していませんか?大丈夫です、一度戻ればいいのです。
dialogsFail.kr: 아직 보스를 처치하지 못하셨다고요? 괜찮아요. 처치하고 나서 다시 오세요.

dialogsFail.pl: You haven't defeated the bosses yet? That's okay, just return once you have.
dialogsFail.ru: You haven't defeated the bosses yet? That's okay, just return once you have.

dialogsBegin.en: It was reported a few hours ago that a wall near where the Syliaca roam recently burst open, flooding the caves. Something this destructive has not happened in many years... I am certain this was caused by Lapranche's meddling.
dialogsBegin.ar: It was reported a few hours ago that a wall near where the Syliaca roam recently burst open, flooding the caves. Something this destructive has not happened in many years... I am certain this was caused by Lapranche's meddling.
dialogsBegin.br: Foi informado há algumas horas que uma parede perto do território dos Syliaca se rompeu, inundando as cavernas. Uma bagunça dessas não acontecia há séculos.. Tenho certeza de que Lapranche está metida nisso.
dialogsBegin.cns: It was reported a few hours ago that a wall near where the Syliaca roam recently burst open, flooding the caves. Something this destructive has not happened in many years... I am certain this was caused by Lapranche's meddling.
dialogsBegin.de: Vor ein paar Stunden wurde berichtet, dass eine Mauer in der Nähe der Syliaca vor kurzem aufgebrochen ist und die Höhlen überflutet hat. Etwas so Zerstörerisches ist seit vielen Jahren nicht mehr passiert... Ich bin sicher, dass Lapranche sich eingemischt hat.
dialogsBegin.fi: It was reported a few hours ago that a wall near where the Syliaca roam recently burst open, flooding the caves. Something this destructive has not happened in many years... I am certain this was caused by Lapranche's meddling.
dialogsBegin.fil: It was reported a few hours ago that a wall near where the Syliaca roam recently burst open, flooding the caves. Something this destructive has not happened in many years... I am certain this was caused by Lapranche's meddling.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il y a quelques heures, on a appris qu'un mur près de l'endroit où vivent les Syliacas s'était récemment ouvert, inondant les grottes. Une chose aussi destructrice ne s'était pas produite depuis de nombreuses années... Je suis certain que cela a été causé par l'intervention de Lapranche.
dialogsBegin.id: Dilaporkan beberapa jam yang lalu bahwa tembok di dekat tempat penjelajahan Sylica baru-baru ini pecah, membanjiri gua. Sesuatu yang merusak ini belum pernah terjadi selama bertahun-tahun.. Aku yakin ini disebabkan oleh campur tangan Lapranche.
dialogsBegin.it: It was reported a few hours ago that a wall near where the Syliaca roam recently burst open, flooding the caves. Something this destructive has not happened in many years... I am certain this was caused by Lapranche's meddling.
dialogsBegin.jp: 数時間前に、シリアカが歩き回る場所の近くの壁が最近破裂し、洞窟が浸水したと報告されました。この破壊的なことは何年も起こっていません..これはラプランシュの干渉によって引き起こされたと確信しています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 몇 시간 전, 실리아카 서식지 근처의 벽이 부서져, 동굴의 물이 넘쳤다는 보고를 받았습니다. 그동안 이런 이상한 일은 일어난 적이 없어요. 라프란체가 방해한 게 분명합니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: It was reported a few hours ago that a wall near where the Syliaca roam recently burst open, flooding the caves. Something this destructive has not happened in many years... I am certain this was caused by Lapranche's meddling.
dialogsBegin.pl: It was reported a few hours ago that a wall near where the Syliaca roam recently burst open, flooding the caves. Something this destructive has not happened in many years... I am certain this was caused by Lapranche's meddling.
dialogsBegin.ru: It was reported a few hours ago that a wall near where the Syliaca roam recently burst open, flooding the caves. Something this destructive has not happened in many years... I am certain this was caused by Lapranche's meddling.
dialogsBegin.sp: Hace unas horas se ha informado de que un muro cercano al lugar por el que deambulan los Syliaca se ha reventado recientemente, inundando las cuevas. Algo tan destructivo no había sucedido en muchos años.. Estoy seguro de que esto fue causado por la intromisión de Lapranche.
dialogsBegin.sw: It was reported a few hours ago that a wall near where the Syliaca roam recently burst open, flooding the caves. Something this destructive has not happened in many years... I am certain this was caused by Lapranche's meddling.
dialogsBegin.th: มีรายงานมาเมื่อไม่กี่ชั่วโมงก่อนว่ากำแพงใกล้ ๆ กับที่เขตของพวก Syliaca อยู่ถูกพังให้เปิดออกมา น้ำท่วมเข้าไปในถ้ำ ความเสียหายระดับนี้ไม่เกิดขึ้นมาหลายปีแล้ว ข้าแน่ใจว่าสิ่งนี้มันเกิดขึ้นจากฝีมือของ Lapranche แน่ ๆ
dialogsBegin.tw: 幾個小時前傳來消息，希莉卡出沒地附近的一面牆突然崩裂，導致洞窟被洪水淹沒。這種破壞程度已經很多年沒發生過了……我很確定，這一定是拉普蘭雪搞的鬼。
dialogsBegin.vi: Vài giờ trước, có tin báo một bức tường gần nơi Syliaca hoành hành đã bị vỡ tung, làm ngập các hang động. Điều gì đó mang tính hủy diệt như thế này đã không xảy ra trong nhiều năm rồi.. Tôi chắc chắn rằng chuyện này là việc làm của Lapranche.

dialogsBegin.en: I wish to investigate the matter, but I have to attend to my duties here in the city.

dialogsBegin.fil: I wish to investigate the matter, but I have to attend to my duties here in the city.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je souhaite enquêter sur cette affaire, mais je dois m'acquitter de mes obligations en ville.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya ingin menyelidiki masalah ini, tetapi saya harus menjalankan tugas saya di kota ini.
dialogsBegin.it: I wish to investigate the matter, but I have to attend to my duties here in the city.
dialogsBegin.jp: 私はその件を調査したいのですが、私はこの街での職務に出席しなければなりません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 저도 이 문제를 조사하고 싶지만, 지금은 이곳 도시에서의 임무에 집중해야 한답니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: I wish to investigate the matter, but I have to attend to my duties here in the city.

dialogsBegin.th: ข้าหวังว่าจะได้ตรวจสอบเรื่องที่เกิดขึ้น แต่ว่าข้ามีหน้าที่ ที่ต้องทำในเมืองนี้
dialogsBegin.tw: 我本來想親自調查這件事，但我還得留在城裡執行職務。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi muốn điều tra vụ việc, nhưng tôi phải thực hiện nghĩa vụ của mình ở đây trong thành phố.

dialogsAccept.en: Collect enough samples of Syliaca to see if the flood has caused any mutations in their DNA.
dialogsAccept.ar: Collect enough samples of Syliaca to see if the flood has caused any mutations in their DNA.
dialogsAccept.br: Colete amostras suficientes de Syliaca para verificar se a inundação causou alguma mutação em seu DNA.
dialogsAccept.cns: Collect enough samples of Syliaca to see if the flood has caused any mutations in their DNA.
dialogsAccept.de: Sammle genug Problem von Syliaca um zu sehen, ob die Flut irgendwelche DNA Mutationen ausgelöst hat.
dialogsAccept.fi: Collect enough samples of Syliaca to see if the flood has caused any mutations in their DNA.
dialogsAccept.fil: Collect enough samples of Syliaca to see if the flood has caused any mutations in their DNA.
dialogsAccept.fr: Prélever suffisamment d'échantillons de Syliaca pour voir si l'inondation a provoqué des mutations dans leur ADN.
dialogsAccept.id: Kumpulkan sampel Syliaca yang cukup untuk melihat apakah banjir menyebabkan mutasi pada DNA mereka.
dialogsAccept.it: Collect enough samples of Syliaca to see if the flood has caused any mutations in their DNA.
dialogsAccept.jp: 洪水がDNAに突然変異を引き起こしたかどうかを確認するために、シリアカの十分なサンプルを収集します。
dialogsAccept.kr: 홍수로 실리아카의 DNA에 돌연변이가 생겼는지 확인해 볼 수 있도록, 표본을 충분히 모아주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Collect enough samples of Syliaca to see if the flood has caused any mutations in their DNA.
dialogsAccept.pl: Collect enough samples of Syliaca to see if the flood has caused any mutations in their DNA.
dialogsAccept.ru: Collect enough samples of Syliaca to see if the flood has caused any mutations in their DNA.
dialogsAccept.sp: Recoger suficientes muestras de Syliaca para ver si la inundación ha causado alguna mutación en su ADN.
dialogsAccept.sw: Collect enough samples of Syliaca to see if the flood has caused any mutations in their DNA.
dialogsAccept.th: เก็บตัวอย่างของ Syliaca มาให้พอเพื่อจะได้รุ้กันว่าที่น้ำท่วมนั้นเกิดจากการกลายพันธุ์ใน DNA ของพวกมันรึเปล่า
dialogsAccept.tw: 收集足夠的希莉卡樣本，確認這場洪水是否導致牠們的 DNA 發生突變。
dialogsAccept.vi: Thu thập đủ mẫu Syliaca để xem liệu lũ lụt có gây ra bất kỳ đột biến nào trong DNA của chúng hay không.
