dialogsDecline.ar: Without your help, who knows when I'll have time to investigate this matter...
dialogsDecline.br: Sem a sua ajuda, quem sabe quando eu terei tempo para investigar esse assunto.
dialogsDecline.cns: Without your help, who knows when I'll have time to investigate this matter...
dialogsDecline.de: Wer weiß, wann ich ohne deine Hilfe die Zeit hätte, um diese Sache zu untersuchen...
dialogsDecline.fi: Without your help, who knows when I'll have time to investigate this matter...
dialogsDecline.fil: Without your help, who knows when I'll have time to investigate this matter...
dialogsDecline.fr: Sans votre aide, qui sait quand j'aurai le temps d'enquêter sur cette affaire.
dialogsDecline.id: Tanpa bantuanmu, siapa tahu kapan punya waktu untuk menyelidiki masalah ini..
dialogsDecline.it: Without your help, who knows when I'll have time to investigate this matter...
dialogsDecline.jp: あなたの助けがなければ、私がこの問題を調査する時間がいつあるか誰が知っていますか..
dialogsDecline.kr: 당신이 도와주시지 않았다면, 이 문제를 조사할 시간이 있기나 했을지...
dialogsDecline.nl: Without your help, who knows when I'll have time to investigate this matter...
dialogsDecline.pl: Without your help, who knows when I'll have time to investigate this matter...
dialogsDecline.ru: Without your help, who knows when I'll have time to investigate this matter...
dialogsDecline.sp: Sin tu ayuda, quién sabe cuándo tendré tiempo para investigar este asunto..
dialogsDecline.sw: Without your help, who knows when I'll have time to investigate this matter...
dialogsDecline.th: ถ้าไม่ได้เจ้าช่วย ใครจะรู้ว่าเมื่อไหร่ที่ข้าถึงจะมีเวลาตรวจสอบเรื่องนี้กัน
dialogsDecline.tw: 要是沒有你的幫忙，天知道我什麼時候才有空去查這件事……
dialogsDecline.vi: Nếu không có sự giúp đỡ của bạn, ai mà biết được khi nào tôi sẽ có thời gian để điều tra vấn đề này...

dialogsComplete.en: Fascinating! After analyzing the Syliaca samples it seems the water in the flood contains a magic component that affects the Syliaca's brain.
dialogsComplete.ar: Fascinating! After analyzing the Syliaca samples it seems the water in the flood contains a magic component that affects the Syliaca's brain.
dialogsComplete.br: Fascinante! Após analisar as amostras de Syliaca, parece que a água da inundação contém um componente mágico que afeta o cérebro dos Syliaca.
dialogsComplete.cns: Fascinating! After analyzing the Syliaca samples it seems the water in the flood contains a magic component that affects the Syliaca's brain.
dialogsComplete.de: Faszinierend! Nach der Analyse der Syliaca Problem scheint es, dass das Wasser in der Flut eine magische Komponente beinhaltet, die das Gehirn von Syliaca beeinflusst.
dialogsComplete.fi: Fascinating! After analyzing the Syliaca samples it seems the water in the flood contains a magic component that affects the Syliaca's brain.
dialogsComplete.fil: Fascinating! After analyzing the Syliaca samples it seems the water in the flood contains a magic component that affects the Syliaca's brain.
dialogsComplete.fr: Fascinant ! Après avoir analysé les échantillons de Syliaca, il semble que l'eau de l'inondation contienne un composant magique qui affecte le cerveau du Syliaca.
dialogsComplete.id: Memukau! Setelah menganalisis sampel Syliaca tampaknya air di banjir mengandung komponen ajaib yang memengaruhi otak Syliaca.
dialogsComplete.it: Fascinating! After analyzing the Syliaca samples it seems the water in the flood contains a magic component that affects the Syliaca's brain.
dialogsComplete.jp: 嬈！シリアカのサンプルを分析した後、洪水の水にはシリアカの脳に影響を与える魔法の成分が含まれているようです。
dialogsComplete.kr: 흥미로운데요! 실리아카 표본을 분석해보니, 넘친 물속에 실리아카의 뇌에 영향을 주는 마법 성분이 들어 있는 듯해요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Fascinating! After analyzing the Syliaca samples it seems the water in the flood contains a magic component that affects the Syliaca's brain.
dialogsComplete.pl: Fascinating! After analyzing the Syliaca samples it seems the water in the flood contains a magic component that affects the Syliaca's brain.
dialogsComplete.ru: Fascinating! After analyzing the Syliaca samples it seems the water in the flood contains a magic component that affects the Syliaca's brain.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Fascinante! Tras analizar las muestras de Syliaca parece que el agua de la inundación contiene un componente mágico que afecta al cerebro de los Syliaca.
dialogsComplete.sw: Fascinating! After analyzing the Syliaca samples it seems the water in the flood contains a magic component that affects the Syliaca's brain.
dialogsComplete.th: งดงาม! หลังจากวิเคราะห์ตัวอย่างของ Syliaca ข้าก็พบว่าน้ำที่ท่วมนั้นมีส่วนประกอบของเวทย์มนต์ที่มีผลต่อสมองของ Syliaca อยู่
dialogsComplete.tw: 真有意思！分析完希莉卡樣本後，似乎可以確定洪水裡含有某種魔法成分，會影響希莉卡的大腦。
dialogsComplete.vi: Lôi cuốn! Sau khi phân tích các mẫu của Syliaca, có vẻ như nước trong trận lụt có chứa một thành phần ma thuật ảnh hưởng đến não của Syliaca.

dialogsFail.en: The hormones of these Syliaca seem to affect how aggressive they will become. And their teeth are somehow much sharper than before...
dialogsFail.ar: The hormones of these Syliaca seem to affect how aggressive they will become. And their teeth are somehow much sharper than before...
dialogsFail.br: Os hormônios desses Syliaca parecem afetar o quão agressivos eles se tornam. E seus dentes estão de alguma forma muito mais afiados do que antes.
dialogsFail.cns: The hormones of these Syliaca seem to affect how aggressive they will become. And their teeth are somehow much sharper than before...
dialogsFail.de: Die Hormone von diesen Syliaca scheinen zu beeinflussen, wie aggressiv sie werden. Und ihre Zähne scheinen schärfer als zuvor.
dialogsFail.fi: The hormones of these Syliaca seem to affect how aggressive they will become. And their teeth are somehow much sharper than before...
dialogsFail.fil: The hormones of these Syliaca seem to affect how aggressive they will become. And their teeth are somehow much sharper than before...
dialogsFail.fr: Les hormones de ces Syliaca semblent influer sur leur agressivité. Et leurs dents sont d'une manière ou d'une autre beaucoup plus tranchantes qu'auparavant...
dialogsFail.id: Hormon-hormon Syliaca ini tampaknya memengaruhi seberapa agresif mereka nantinya. Dan gigi mereka entah bagaimana jauh lebih tajam dari sebelumnya..
dialogsFail.it: The hormones of these Syliaca seem to affect how aggressive they will become. And their teeth are somehow much sharper than before...
dialogsFail.jp: これらのシリアカのホルモンは、彼らがどれほど攻撃的になるかに影響を与えるようです。そして、彼らの歯はどういうわけか以前よりもはるかに鋭いです..
dialogsFail.kr: 실리아카의 공격적인 성향은 녀석들의 호르몬 때문인 것 같군요. 이전보다 이빨도 훨씬 날카로워졌고요...
dialogsFail.nl: The hormones of these Syliaca seem to affect how aggressive they will become. And their teeth are somehow much sharper than before...
dialogsFail.pl: The hormones of these Syliaca seem to affect how aggressive they will become. And their teeth are somehow much sharper than before...
dialogsFail.ru: The hormones of these Syliaca seem to affect how aggressive they will become. And their teeth are somehow much sharper than before...
dialogsFail.sp: Las hormonas de estos Syliaca parecen afectar a su agresividad. Y sus dientes son mucho más afilados que antes...
dialogsFail.sw: The hormones of these Syliaca seem to affect how aggressive they will become. And their teeth are somehow much sharper than before...
dialogsFail.th: ดูเหมือฮอร์โมนของพวก Syliaca จะส่งผลให้พวกมันก้าวร้าวขึ้น และฟันของพวกมันก็ดูจะคมกว่าเมื่อก่อน
dialogsFail.tw: 這些希莉卡的荷爾蒙似乎會左右牠們變得多麼具有攻擊性。而且牠們的牙齒也比以前鋒利得多……
dialogsFail.vi: Những hormone của những Syliaca này dường như ảnh hưởng đến việc chúng sẽ trở nên hung dữ như thế nào. Và răng của chúng bằng cách nào đó sắc hơn nhiều so với trước đây..

dialogsBegin.en: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 35 dungeon bosses on Extra Hard or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.ar: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 35 dungeon bosses on Extra Hard or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.br: Bem-vindo herói! Recebemos outro pedido para limpar os chefes masquerpets das masmorras de Madrigal. Você poderia eliminar 35 chefes de masmorra na dificuldade Extra Difícil ou superior e retornar a mim quando terminar?
dialogsBegin.cns: 欢迎你，英雄！又有新委托了，需要清除瑞加大陆副本中的Boss 级别怪物。请你击杀 35 个副本 Boss，完成后再来找我。
dialogsBegin.de: Willkommen Held! Eine weitere Aufforderung ist eingegangen, die Boss-Masquerpets in Madrigals Dungeons zu beseitigen. Kannst du bitte 35 Dungeon-Bosse auf dem Schwierigkeitsgrad "Extra schwer" oder höher töten und zu mir zurückkehren, sobald du fertig bist?
dialogsBegin.fi: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 35 dungeon bosses on Extra Hard or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.fil: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 35 dungeon bosses on Extra Hard or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.fr: Bienvenue au héros ! Nous avons reçu une autre demande pour éliminer les boss masqués dans les donjons de Madrigal. Pourriez-vous, s'il vous plaît, tuer 35 boss de donjon (Trés Difficile ou plus), et revenir me voir une fois que vous aurez terminé ?
dialogsBegin.id: Selamat datang pahlawan! Permintaan lain telah datang untuk membersihkan boss masquerpets di Madrigal's dungeons. Bisakah kamu membunuh 30 bos dungeon pada tingkat kesulitan Extra Hard atau lebih tinggi, dan kembali kepadaku setelah kamu selesai?
dialogsBegin.it: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 35 dungeon bosses on Extra Hard or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.jp: ようこそヒーロー!マドリガルのダンジョン内のボスの仮面舞踏会を一掃する依頼がまた一つ入ってきた。超高難易度以上のダンジョンボスを35体倒して、終わったら私のところに戻ってきてくれませんか?
dialogsBegin.kr: 어서 오세요, 용사님! 마드리갈 던전에 있는 보스 마스커펫을 처치해 달라는 부탁을 또 받았어요. 아주 어려움 이상 난이도의 던전 보스 35마리를 처치하고, 완료되면 제게 돌아와 주시겠어요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 35 dungeon bosses on Extra Hard or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.pl: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 35 dungeon bosses on Extra Hard or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?

dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Bienvenido héroe! Ha llegado otra solicitud; Eliminar los jefes enmascarados en las mazmorras de Madrigal. ¿Podrías matar a 35 jefes de mazmorra en dificultad Extra Difícil o superior y regresar cuando hayas terminado?
dialogsBegin.sw: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 35 dungeon bosses on Extra Hard or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.th: ยินดีต้อนรับผู้กล้า! มีคำขอเข้ามาอีกครั้งเพื่อกำจัด masquerpets ในดันเจี้ยนของ Madrigal คุณจะช่วยกำจัดบอสดันเจี้ยนซัก 35 ตัว ที่ระดับ Extra Hard หรือสูงกว่าได้ไหม จากนั้นกลับมาหาฉันเมื่อคุณจัดการเสร็จ
dialogsBegin.tw: 歡迎，英雄！又有新的委託，要清除瑪德利賈各地副本中的頭目魔物。請在超難以上難度擊殺 35 隻副本頭目，完成後再回來找我。
dialogsBegin.vi: Xin chào người hùng! Có một nhiệm vụ khác yêu cầu dọn sạch trùm masquerpets ẩn náu trong ngục tối của Madrigal. Bạn có thể giết 35 trùm ngục tối ở mức độ Extra Hard hoặc cao hơn và quay lại chỗ tôi khi xong việc không?

dialogsAccept.en: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon on Extra Hard or higher difficulty 35 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsAccept.ar: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon on Extra Hard or higher difficulty 35 times, and return to me for a reward.

dialogsAccept.cns: 在任意副本的尽头，从Boss 级别怪物身上收集灵魂，完成35 次后回来找我领取奖励。
dialogsAccept.de: Sammle am Ende eines beliebigen Dungeons auf dem Schwierigkeitsgrad "Extra schwer" oder höher 35x die Seelen von Boss-Masquerpets ein und kehre für eine Belohnung zu mir zurück.

dialogsAccept.fr: Récupérez les âmes des mascarons de boss à la fin de n'importe quel donjon (Très Difficile ou plus) 35 fois, et revenez me voir pour une récompense.
dialogsAccept.id: Kumpulkan jiwa dari bos masquerpet di akhir dungeon mana pun pada tingkat kesulitan Extra Hard atau lebih tinggi sebanyak 35 kali, dan kembalikan kepadaku untuk mendapatkan hadiah.
dialogsAccept.it: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon on Extra Hard or higher difficulty 35 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsAccept.jp: 超難易度以上のダンジョンの最後にあるボスの仮面から魂を35回集めて、報酬を求めて私のところに戻ってきます。
dialogsAccept.kr: 아주 어려움 이상 난이도의 던전이 끝날 때마다 보스 마스커펫을 처치해 영혼을 35회 수집하고, 제게 돌아와 보상을 받으세요.

dialogsAccept.sp: Recoge almas de jefes masquerpets al salir de mazmorra en dificultad Super Difícil o superior 35 veces y vuelve para recibir una recompensa.
dialogsAccept.sw: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon on Extra Hard or higher difficulty 35 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsAccept.th: รวบรวมวิญญาณจาก masquerpets ตอนท้ายของดันเจี้ยนใดๆ 35 ครั้ง ที่ระดับความยาก Extra Hard หรือสูงกว่า แล้วกลับมาหาฉันเพื่อรับรางวัล
dialogsAccept.tw: 從任意副本超難以上難度的最終頭目魔物身上蒐集 35 次靈魂，再回來找我領取獎勵。
dialogsAccept.vi: Thu thập linh hồn của trùm masquerpet mức độ Extra Hard hoặc cao hơn ở cuối hầm ngục tối 35 lần và quay lại chỗ tôi để nhận thưởng.

dialogsDecline.en: The dungeons are filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.ar: The dungeons are filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.br: As masmorras estão cheias de masquerpets perigosos. Eu entendo se você não quiser correr o risco.
dialogsDecline.cns: 这些副本遍布着危险的怪物。如果你不想冒这个险，我完全理解。
dialogsDecline.de: Die Dungeons sind voll von gefährlichen Masquerpets. Ich verstehe, wenn du das Risiko nicht eingehen willst.

dialogsDecline.kr: 던전에는 위험한 마스커펫이 가득해요. 위험을 감수하고 싶지 않다고 하셔도 이해합니다.

dialogsDecline.th: ในดันเจี้ยนไปด้วย masquerpets ที่อันตรายมาก ฉันเข้าใจถ้าคุณไม่อยากเสี่ยง

dialogsComplete.en: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsComplete.ar: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!

dialogsComplete.cns: 英雄，多亏了你，副本内部的威胁已经减轻了。为感谢你的付出，请收下这张武器穿洞卡作为谢礼！
dialogsComplete.de: Die Bedrohung aus den Dungeons ist dank dir, Held, geringer geworden. Bitte nimm eine Weapon Piercing Card als Dank für deine Bemühungen an!

dialogsComplete.fr: La menace des donjons a été réduite grâce à vous, héros. Veuillez accepter une carte de piercing d'arme en guise de remerciement pour vos efforts !
dialogsComplete.id: Ancaman dari dalam dungeon telah mengurangi berkatmu, Pahlawan. Mohon terima weapon piercing card sebagai ucapan terima kasih atas usahamu!
dialogsComplete.it: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsComplete.jp: ダンジョン内からの脅威は、ヒーローであるあなたのおかげで減少しました。お礼に武器貫通カードを受け取ってください!
dialogsComplete.kr: 용사님 덕분에 던전 안이 훨씬 안전해졌어요. 자, 무기 피어싱 카드를 받아주세요, 노고에 대한 감사의 표시랍니다!
dialogsComplete.nl: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!

dialogsComplete.sp: La amenaza en las mazmorras se ha reducido gracias a ti, héroe. ¡Acepte una tarjeta de perforación de armas como agradecimiento por tus esfuerzos!
dialogsComplete.sw: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsComplete.th: ภัยคุกคามจากดันเจี้ยนลดลงเล้ว ท่านผู้กล้าโปรดรับการ์ดเจาะอาวุธเพื่อเป็นการขอบคุณสำหรับความพยายามของคุณ!
dialogsComplete.tw: 多虧了你，副本內的威脅已經減輕了，英雄。請收下這張武器打洞卡，作為對你努力的感謝！
dialogsComplete.vi: Mối đe dọa từ bên trong hầm ngục đã giảm đi nhiều nhờ có bạn đấy, người hùng. Xin hãy nhận một thẻ xuyên vũ khí như một lời cảm ơn vì những nỗ lực của bạn!

dialogsBegin.en: The Dorian have risen from the seas around our island! Please defeat them and collect their $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ as proof. My inventions can only hold them back for so long...
dialogsBegin.ar: The Dorian have risen from the seas around our island! Please defeat them and collect their $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ as proof. My inventions can only hold them back for so long...
dialogsBegin.br: Os Dorian emergiram dos mares ao redor de nossa ilha! Por favor, derrote-os e colete seus $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ como prova. Minhas invenções só podem segurá-los por um tempo...
dialogsBegin.cns: The Dorian have risen from the seas around our island! Please defeat them and collect their $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ as proof. My inventions can only hold them back for so long...
dialogsBegin.de: Die Dorian sind aus den Meeren um unsere Insel aufgestiegen! Bitte besiege sie und sammle ihre $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ als Beweis. Meine Erfindungen können sie nur eine bestimmte Zeit lang aufhalten...
dialogsBegin.fi: The Dorian have risen from the seas around our island! Please defeat them and collect their $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ as proof. My inventions can only hold them back for so long...
dialogsBegin.fil: Ang mga Dorian ay bumangon mula sa dagat sa paligid ng ating isla! Pakiusap, talunin mo sila at kolektahin ang kanilang $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ bilang patunay. Hindi sapat ang aking mga imbensyon para pigilan sila mag-isa...
dialogsBegin.fr: Les Dorians ont surgi des mers autour de notre île ! Battez-les et récupérez leurs $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ comme preuve. Mes inventions ne peuvent pas les retenir plus longtemps.
dialogsBegin.id: Dorian telah muncul dari lautan di sekitar pulau kami! Silakan kalahkan mereka dan kumpulkan $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ mereka sebagai bukti. Penemuanku hanya bisa menahannya begitu lama...
dialogsBegin.it: The Dorian have risen from the seas around our island! Please defeat them and collect their $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ as proof. My inventions can only hold them back for so long...
dialogsBegin.jp: ドリアンが私たちの島の周りの海から上昇しました!彼らを倒し、証拠として$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$を回収してください。私の発明は、彼らを長く引き留めることしかできません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 섬 주변 바다에 도리언이 출몰했어요! 도리안들을 처치하고, 그 증거로 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$을(를) 수집해 주세요. 제 발명품으로 계속 막을 수는 없거든요...
dialogsBegin.nl: The Dorian have risen from the seas around our island! Please defeat them and collect their $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ as proof. My inventions can only hold them back for so long...
dialogsBegin.pl: The Dorian have risen from the seas around our island! Please defeat them and collect their $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ as proof. My inventions can only hold them back for so long...
dialogsBegin.ru: The Dorian have risen from the seas around our island! Please defeat them and collect their $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ as proof. My inventions can only hold them back for so long...
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Los Dorian han surgido de los mares que rodean nuestra isla! Por favor, derrótalos y recoge su $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$. Mis inventos sólo pueden detenerlos por un tiempo.
dialogsBegin.sw: The Dorian have risen from the seas around our island! Please defeat them and collect their $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ as proof. My inventions can only hold them back for so long...
dialogsBegin.th: พวก Dorian ได้โผล่ขึ้นมาจากทะเลรอบๆ เกาะของเราแล้ว! โปรดปราบพวกมันและเก็บ $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ ของพวกมันไว้เป็นหลักฐาน สิ่งประดิษฐ์ของฉันสามารถยับยั้งพวกมันไว้ได้เพียงชั่วระยะเวลาหนึ่งเท่านั้น...
dialogsBegin.tw: 多利安已從島嶼周遭的海域現身！請擊敗牠們並收集牠們的 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ 作為證明。我的發明只能暫時阻止牠們一段時間……
dialogsBegin.vi: Người Dorian đã trỗi dậy từ vùng biển xung quanh hòn đảo của chúng tôi! Làm ơn đánh bại họ và thu thập $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ làm bằng chứng. Những phát minh của tôi chỉ có thể giữ chân chúng một thời gian thôi...

dialogsComplete.en: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! Those fishy creatures have a strange power that makes them age slower than others. Perhaps studying their teeth can give us insight to the Dorian's special powers.
dialogsComplete.ar: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! Those fishy creatures have a strange power that makes them age slower than others. Perhaps studying their teeth can give us insight to the Dorian's special powers.
dialogsComplete.br: Obrigado por coletar todos aqueles $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, aventureiro! Essas criaturas aquáticas têm um estranho poder que as faz envelhecer mais lentamente que as outras. Talvez estudar seus dentes nos dê uma visão sobre os poderes especiais dos Dorian.
dialogsComplete.cns: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! Those fishy creatures have a strange power that makes them age slower than others. Perhaps studying their teeth can give us insight to the Dorian's special powers.
dialogsComplete.de: Danke, dass du all diese $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ gesammelt hast, Abenteurer! Diese fischigen Kreaturen haben eine seltsame Kraft, die sie langsamer altern lässt als andere. Vielleicht kann uns das Studium ihrer Zähne Aufschluss über die besonderen Kräfte der Dorian geben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! Those fishy creatures have a strange power that makes them age slower than others. Perhaps studying their teeth can give us insight to the Dorian's special powers.
dialogsComplete.fil: Salamat sa pagkolekta ng lahat ng $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, manlalakbay! Mukhang may kakaibang kapangyarihan ang mga nilalang-dagat na 'to na nagpapabagal ng kanilang pagtanda. Siguro may magandang matutunan tayo mula sa kanilang mga ngipin tungkol sa lakas ng mga Dorian.
dialogsComplete.fr: Merci d'avoir collecté tous ces $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, aventurier ! Ces créatures poissonneuses ont un pouvoir étrange qui les fait vieillir moins vite que les autres. L'étude de leurs dents nous permettra peut-être de mieux comprendre les pouvoirs spéciaux des Dorians.
dialogsComplete.id: Terima kasih telah mengumpulkan semua $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ itu, petualang! Makhluk mencurigakan tersebut memiliki kekuatan aneh yang membuat mereka menua lebih lambat dibandingkan makhluk lain. Mungkin mempelajari gigi mereka dapat memberi kita wawasan tentang kekuatan khusus Dorian.
dialogsComplete.it: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! Those fishy creatures have a strange power that makes them age slower than others. Perhaps studying their teeth can give us insight to the Dorian's special powers.
dialogsComplete.jp: 冒険者の皆さん、$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$を全て集めてくれてありがとう!これらの魚のような生き物は、他の生き物よりも老化を遅らせる奇妙な力を持っています。もしかしたら、彼らの歯を研究することで、ドリアンの特別な力を知ることができるかもしれません。
dialogsComplete.kr: $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$을(를) 모두 수집해 주셔서 감사합니다, 모험가님! 이 물고기 같은 것들은 다른 생명체들보다 나이를 천천히 먹는 이상한 힘을 가지고 있어요. 이빨을 연구하면 도리언의 특별한 힘을 알아낼 수 있을지도 모르겠네요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! Those fishy creatures have a strange power that makes them age slower than others. Perhaps studying their teeth can give us insight to the Dorian's special powers.
dialogsComplete.pl: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! Those fishy creatures have a strange power that makes them age slower than others. Perhaps studying their teeth can give us insight to the Dorian's special powers.
dialogsComplete.ru: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! Those fishy creatures have a strange power that makes them age slower than others. Perhaps studying their teeth can give us insight to the Dorian's special powers.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Gracias por reunir todos esos $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, aventurero! Esas criaturas parecidas a peces tienen un extraño poder que les hace envejecer más lentamente. Quizás estudiar sus dientes pueda darnos una idea de los poderes especiales de Dorian.
dialogsComplete.sw: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! Those fishy creatures have a strange power that makes them age slower than others. Perhaps studying their teeth can give us insight to the Dorian's special powers.
dialogsComplete.th: ขอบคุณที่รวบรวม $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ ทั้งหมดได้นะ นักผจญภัย! สิ่งมีชีวิตคล้ายปลาเหล่านี้มีพลังประหลาดที่ทำให้พวกมันแก่ช้ากว่าสิ่งมีชีวิตอื่น บางทีการศึกษาฟันของพวกมันอาจช่วยให้เราเข้าใจถึงพลังพิเศษของ Dorian ได้
dialogsComplete.tw: 感謝你收集所有這些 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$，冒險家！那些魚類生物擁有一種奇怪的力量，讓牠們比其他生物老得更慢。也許研究牠們的牙齒可以讓我們了解多利安的特殊能力。
dialogsComplete.vi: Cảm ơn vì đã thu thập tất cả $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, nhà thám hiểm! Những sinh vật giống cá đó có một sức mạnh kỳ lạ khiến chúng lão hóa chậm hơn bình thường. Có lẽ nghiên cứu mẫu răng của chúng sẽ giúp chúng ta biết thêm về năng lực đặc biệt của Dorian.

dialogsFail.en: That isn't nearly enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ for me to build one of my grand inventions... come back with more!

dialogsFail.fr: C'est loin d'être assez de $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ pour que je construise l'une de mes grandes inventions... revenez avec plus !
dialogsFail.id: $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ itu tidak cukup bagiku untuk membuat salah satu penemuan hebat... kembalilah dengan lebih banyak lagi!

dialogsFail.jp: これは、私の壮大な発明の1つを構築するには、$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$が十分ではありません。もっと戻ってきてください!
dialogsFail.kr: 진정 위대한 발명품을 만들기엔, $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$이(가) 턱없이 부족하네요... 더 모아서 다시 오세요!

dialogsFail.sp: No es suficiente $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ para construir mi gran invento... ¡Tráeme más!
dialogsFail.sw: That isn't nearly enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ for me to build one of my grand inventions... come back with more!
dialogsFail.th: นั่นยังไม่ใกล้เคียงเลยเลยสำหรับ $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ ที่ฉันจะใช้สร้างสิ่งประดิษฐ์อันยิ่งใหญ่ของฉัน... โปรดนำกลับมาเพิ่มอีก!
dialogsFail.tw: 這些 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ 還遠遠不夠讓我完成其中一項偉大發明……帶更多回來吧！
dialogsFail.vi: Số tiền đó gần như không đủ $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ để tôi xây dựng một trong những phát minh vĩ đại của mình...Đừng quay lại đây cho đến khi bạn mang theo nhiều hơn!

dialogsBegin.en: Interesting... even with my vast knowledge of Flaris I know very little about the troll migration to the Leren Chasm.
dialogsBegin.ar: Interesting... even with my vast knowledge of Flaris I know very little about the troll migration to the Leren Chasm.
dialogsBegin.br: Que curioso... mesmo com meu vasto conhecimento de Flaris, eu ainda sei pouco sobre a migração de trolls para o Desfiladeiro de Leren.
dialogsBegin.cns: Interesting... even with my vast knowledge of Flaris I know very little about the troll migration to the Leren Chasm.
dialogsBegin.de: Interessant. Selbst mit meinem umfangreichen Wissen über Flaris weiß ich nur sehr wenig über die Wanderung der Trolle in die Lerenkluft.

dialogsBegin.kr: 흥미로운데요... 저도 플라리스에 관한 건 죄다 꿰고 있는데, 트롤이 레르엔 협곡으로 이주했다는 건 거의 처음 듣는 일이라.

dialogsBegin.tw: 有意思……就算我對布拉里斯瞭若指掌，對巨魔遷往勒倫峽谷的事也幾乎一無所知。
dialogsBegin.vi: Thật thú vị.. ngay cả với kiến ​​thức rộng lớn của tôi về Flaris, tôi biết rất ít về cuộc di cư của quỷ lùn đến Leren Chasm.

dialogsBegin.en: Perhaps it is time to go explore the Leren Chasm to find out more about the powers behind the Elixir of Vitality.
dialogsBegin.ar: Perhaps it is time to go explore the Leren Chasm to find out more about the powers behind the Elixir of Vitality.
dialogsBegin.br: Acho que é hora de partir em uma aventura pelo Desfiladeiro de Leren para descobrir mais sobre os poderes do Elixir da Vitalidade.
dialogsBegin.cns: Perhaps it is time to go explore the Leren Chasm to find out more about the powers behind the Elixir of Vitality.
dialogsBegin.de: Vielleicht ist es an der Zeit, die Lerenkluft zu erforschen, um mehr über die Kräfte hinter dem Elixier der Vitalität herauszufinden.
dialogsBegin.fi: Perhaps it is time to go explore the Leren Chasm to find out more about the powers behind the Elixir of Vitality.
dialogsBegin.fil: Perhaps it is time to go explore the Leren Chasm to find out more about the powers behind the Elixir of Vitality.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il est peut-être temps d'aller explorer le Gouffre de Leren pour en savoir plus sur les pouvoirs de l'Élixir de vitalité.
dialogsBegin.id: Mungkin sudah waktunya untuk menjelajahi Leren Chasm untuk mengetahui lebih banyak tentang kekuatan di balik Elixir of Vitality.
dialogsBegin.it: Perhaps it is time to go explore the Leren Chasm to find out more about the powers behind the Elixir of Vitality.
dialogsBegin.jp: おそらく、活力のエリクサーの背後にある力についてもっと知るために、レレンの淵を探索する時が来たのでしょう。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이제 레르엔 협곡을 탐험하며, 활력 비약에 숨은 힘의 비밀을 알아볼 때가 된 것 같네요.

dialogsBegin.sw: Perhaps it is time to go explore the Leren Chasm to find out more about the powers behind the Elixir of Vitality.
dialogsBegin.th: น่าจะได้เวลาไปสำรวจ Leren Chasm เพื่อหาข้อมูลเกี่ยวกับพลังแห่ง Elixir of Vitality กันแล้วสินะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 也許是時候去探索勒倫峽谷，以了解更多關於活力藥劑背後的力量。
dialogsBegin.vi: Có lẽ đã đến lúc khám phá Leren Chasm để tìm hiểu thêm về sức mạnh đằng sau Elixir of Vitality.

dialogsAccept.en: The secret behind the longevity of the Leren Chasm trolls begins with finding the entrance to their cave. Search for the entrance to the Leren Chasm and return to me at once!
dialogsAccept.ar: The secret behind the longevity of the Leren Chasm trolls begins with finding the entrance to their cave. Search for the entrance to the Leren Chasm and return to me at once!
dialogsAccept.br: O segredo por trás da longevidade dos trolls do Desfiladeiro de Leren começa com a busca pela entrada de sua caverna. Procure a entrada para o Desfiladeiro de Leren e volte imediatamente para mim!
dialogsAccept.cns: The secret behind the longevity of the Leren Chasm trolls begins with finding the entrance to their cave. Search for the entrance to the Leren Chasm and return to me at once!
dialogsAccept.de: Das Geheimnis der Langlebigkeit der Trolle der Lerenkluft beginnt mit der Suche nach dem Eingang zu ihrer Höhle. Suche nach dem Eingang zur Lerenkluft und kehre sofort zu mir zurück!
dialogsAccept.fi: The secret behind the longevity of the Leren Chasm trolls begins with finding the entrance to their cave. Search for the entrance to the Leren Chasm and return to me at once!
dialogsAccept.fil: The secret behind the longevity of the Leren Chasm trolls begins with finding the entrance to their cave. Search for the entrance to the Leren Chasm and return to me at once!
dialogsAccept.fr: Le secret de la longévité des trolls du Gouffre de Leren commence par la découverte de l'entrée de leur grotte. Cherchez l'entrée du Gouffre de Leren et revenez-moi immédiatement !
dialogsAccept.id: Rahasia di balik umur panjang troll Leren Chasm dimulai dengan menemukan pintu masuk ke gua mereka. Cari pintu masuk ke Leren Chasm dan segera kembali padaku!
dialogsAccept.it: The secret behind the longevity of the Leren Chasm trolls begins with finding the entrance to their cave. Search for the entrance to the Leren Chasm and return to me at once!
dialogsAccept.jp: レレンの淵トロールの寿命の背後にある秘密は、彼らの洞窟への入り口を見つけることから始まります。レレンの淵への入り口を探して、すぐに私に戻ってください!
dialogsAccept.kr: 레르엔 협곡 트롤들의 장수 비밀을 밝혀내려면 동굴 입구부터 찾아야겠군요. 레르엔 협곡의 입구를 찾고 나면 바로 다시 저에게 와주세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: The secret behind the longevity of the Leren Chasm trolls begins with finding the entrance to their cave. Search for the entrance to the Leren Chasm and return to me at once!
dialogsAccept.pl: The secret behind the longevity of the Leren Chasm trolls begins with finding the entrance to their cave. Search for the entrance to the Leren Chasm and return to me at once!
dialogsAccept.ru: The secret behind the longevity of the Leren Chasm trolls begins with finding the entrance to their cave. Search for the entrance to the Leren Chasm and return to me at once!
dialogsAccept.sp: El secreto de la longevidad de los trolls de la Sima de Leren empieza por encontrar la entrada a su cueva. Busca la entrada a la sima de Leren y vuelve conmigo de inmediato.
dialogsAccept.sw: The secret behind the longevity of the Leren Chasm trolls begins with finding the entrance to their cave. Search for the entrance to the Leren Chasm and return to me at once!
dialogsAccept.th: การค้นหาความลับของการมีอายุยืนยาวของ Leren Chasm Troll เริ่มต้นจากการหาทางเข้าถ้ำพวกมันให้เจอ กลับมาอีกครั้งตอนที่เจ้าเจอทางเข้าไปยัง Leren Chasm นะ
dialogsAccept.tw: 勒倫峽谷巨魔長壽的秘密始於找到他們洞穴的入口。尋找勒倫峽谷的入口並立刻回到我身邊！
dialogsAccept.vi: Bí mật đằng sau tuổi thọ của những con troll Leren Chasm bắt đầu bằng việc tìm ra lối vào hang động của chúng. Tìm kiếm lối vào Leren Chasm và quay lại với tôi

dialogsDecline.en: The trolls of the Leren Mountains were believed to be part of a fierce army. If you are not comfortable seeking out the trolls, I will understand.
dialogsDecline.ar: The trolls of the Leren Mountains were believed to be part of a fierce army. If you are not comfortable seeking out the trolls, I will understand.
dialogsDecline.br: Dizem que os trolls das Montanhas de Leren faziam parte de um exército temível. Mas, se você não se sentir confortável em procurá-los, tudo bem.
dialogsDecline.cns: The trolls of the Leren Mountains were believed to be part of a fierce army. If you are not comfortable seeking out the trolls, I will understand.
dialogsDecline.de: Man glaubte, die Trolle des Leren Gebirges seien Teil einer gewaltigen Armee. Wenn du dich nicht wohl dabei fühlst, die Trolle aufzusuchen, werde ich das verstehen.
dialogsDecline.fi: The trolls of the Leren Mountains were believed to be part of a fierce army. If you are not comfortable seeking out the trolls, I will understand.

dialogsDecline.id: Para troll dari Pegunungan Leren diyakini sebagai bagian dari pasukan yang ganas. Jika Anda merasa tidak nyaman mencari para troll, saya akan mengerti.
dialogsDecline.it: The trolls of the Leren Mountains were believed to be part of a fierce army. If you are not comfortable seeking out the trolls, I will understand.
dialogsDecline.jp: レレン山脈のトロルは激しい軍隊の一部であると信じられていました。あなたがトロルを探すのが苦手なら、私は理解します。
dialogsDecline.kr: 레르엔 산맥의 트롤들은 원래 사나운 군대를 이루고 있었다고들 해요. 트롤을 찾는 것이 불안하다면, 저도 이해는 합니다.
dialogsDecline.nl: The trolls of the Leren Mountains were believed to be part of a fierce army. If you are not comfortable seeking out the trolls, I will understand.
dialogsDecline.pl: The trolls of the Leren Mountains were believed to be part of a fierce army. If you are not comfortable seeking out the trolls, I will understand.
dialogsDecline.ru: The trolls of the Leren Mountains were believed to be part of a fierce army. If you are not comfortable seeking out the trolls, I will understand.
dialogsDecline.sp: Se creía que los trolls de las Montañas Leren formaban parte de un ejército feroz. Si no te sientes cómodo buscando a los trolls, lo entenderé.
dialogsDecline.sw: The trolls of the Leren Mountains were believed to be part of a fierce army. If you are not comfortable seeking out the trolls, I will understand.
dialogsDecline.th: เชื่อกันว่า Troll แห่ง Leren Mountains เป็นส่วนหนึ่งของกองทัพอันน่ากลัว ถ้าเจ้ารู้สึกไม่สบายใจที่จะออกค้นหามันละก็ ข้าเข้าใจดี
dialogsDecline.tw: 據說勒倫山脈的巨魔曾經屬於一支兇猛的軍隊。如果你不想去追查那些巨魔，我也能理解。
dialogsDecline.vi: Những con troll của dãy núi Leren được cho là một phần của đội quân hung dữ. Nếu bạn không thoải mái khi tìm kiếm những kẻ troll, tôi hiểu.

dialogsBegin.it: The $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ of the Okean must be mine! I know having their crown won't make me a king, but it will put me on the path of my dream. To be King of Coral Island!

dialogsBegin.nl: The $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ of the Okean must be mine! I know having their crown won't make me a king, but it will put me on the path of my dream. To be King of Coral Island!

dialogsBegin.sw: The $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ of the Okean must be mine! I know having their crown won't make me a king, but it will put me on the path of my dream. To be King of Coral Island!
dialogsBegin.th: $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ ของ Okean ต้องเป็นของฉัน! ฉันรู้ว่าการได้มงกุฎของพวกเขาจะไม่ทำให้ฉันกลายเป็นราชา แต่มันจะพาฉันไปสู่เส้นทางแห่งความฝันในการเป็นราชาแห่ง Coral Island!
dialogsBegin.tw: 皇冠海妖的 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ 一定得是我的！我知道擁有牠們的王冠並不會讓我直接成為國王，但這會讓我更接近夢想——成為珊瑚島之王！

dialogsBegin.en: Over many years our society has collected rare texts that reveal the history of the world of Madrigal. Eons ago a god of lightning helped create this world. That god was named Ishirut.
dialogsBegin.ar: Over many years our society has collected rare texts that reveal the history of the world of Madrigal. Eons ago a god of lightning helped create this world. That god was named Ishirut.
dialogsBegin.br: Ao longo dos anos, nossa sociedade coletou textos raros que revelam a história do mundo de Madrigal. Há éons, um deus do raio ajudou a criar este mundo. Esse deus se chamava Ishirut.
dialogsBegin.cns: Over many years our society has collected rare texts that reveal the history of the world of Madrigal. Eons ago a god of lightning helped create this world. That god was named Ishirut.
dialogsBegin.de: Über viele Jahre hinweg hat unsere Gesellschaft seltene Texte gesammelt, die die Geschichte der Welt von Madrigal offenbaren. Vor Äonen half ein Gott des Blitzes, diese Welt zu erschaffen. Dieser Gott wurde Ishirut genannt.
dialogsBegin.fi: Over many years our society has collected rare texts that reveal the history of the world of Madrigal. Eons ago a god of lightning helped create this world. That god was named Ishirut.
dialogsBegin.fil: Over many years our society has collected rare texts that reveal the history of the world of Madrigal. Eons ago a god of lightning helped create this world. That god was named Ishirut.
dialogsBegin.fr: Depuis de nombreuses années, notre société a rassemblé des textes rares qui révèlent l'histoire du monde de Madrigal. À une époque lointaine, un dieu de la foudre a contribué à la création de ce monde. Ce dieu s'appelait Ishirut.
dialogsBegin.id: Selama bertahun-tahun masyarakat kita telah mengumpulkan teks langka yang mengungkap sejarah dunia Madrigal. Ribuan tahun yang lalu dewa petir membantu menciptakan dunia ini. Dewa itu bernama Ishirut.
dialogsBegin.it: Over many years our society has collected rare texts that reveal the history of the world of Madrigal. Eons ago a god of lightning helped create this world. That god was named Ishirut.
dialogsBegin.jp: 長年にわたり、私たちの社会はマドリガルの世界の歴史を明らかにする珍しいテキストを収集してきました。はるか昔、稲妻の神がこの世界を創造するのを助けました。その神はイシルトと名付けられました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 오랜 세월에 걸쳐, 우리 사회는 마드리갈 세계의 역사를 보여주는 고서를 모아 왔어요. 수천 년 전, 번개의 신이 이 세계를 창조하는 걸 도와주었죠. 그 신이 바로 이실루트였어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Over many years our society has collected rare texts that reveal the history of the world of Madrigal. Eons ago a god of lightning helped create this world. That god was named Ishirut.
dialogsBegin.pl: Over many years our society has collected rare texts that reveal the history of the world of Madrigal. Eons ago a god of lightning helped create this world. That god was named Ishirut.
dialogsBegin.ru: Over many years our society has collected rare texts that reveal the history of the world of Madrigal. Eons ago a god of lightning helped create this world. That god was named Ishirut.
dialogsBegin.sp: A lo largo de muchos años, nuestra sociedad ha recopilado textos raros que revelan la historia del mundo de Madrigal. Hace eones un dios del rayo ayudó a crear este mundo. Ese dios se llamaba Ishirut.
dialogsBegin.sw: Over many years our society has collected rare texts that reveal the history of the world of Madrigal. Eons ago a god of lightning helped create this world. That god was named Ishirut.
dialogsBegin.th: หลายปีที่ผ่านมา กลุ่มของพวกเราได้คอยรวบรวมข้อความหายากที่เปิดเผยเกี่ยวกับประวัตศาร์ตของโลกของ Madrigal เมื่อเวลาชั่วกัปก่อน เทพเจ้าแห่งสายฟ้าได้สร้างโลกนี้คือมา เทพที่ชื่อว่า Ishirut
dialogsBegin.tw: 多年來，我們的學會蒐集了許多珍稀文獻，記錄瑪德利賈世界的歷史。在遠古的時代，有一位雷電之神協助創造了這個世界。那位神名為伊希魯特。
dialogsBegin.vi: Trong nhiều năm, xã hội của chúng ta đã thu thập được những dòng chữ hiếm hoi tiết lộ lịch sử của thế giới Madrigal. Eons trước, god of lightning đã giúp tạo ra thế giới này. Vị thần đó tên là Ishirut.

dialogsBegin.en: Perhaps ripples of Ishirut's spirit have returned to give us a sign, but I have no connection to the gods. Perhaps this is work for a mystic of sorts.
dialogsBegin.ar: Perhaps ripples of Ishirut's spirit have returned to give us a sign, but I have no connection to the gods. Perhaps this is work for a mystic of sorts.
dialogsBegin.br: Pode ser que as vibes do espírito do Ishirut voltaram para mandar um recado, mas não sou muito conectado com os deuses. Talvez precise de um bruxo ou algo do tipo para resolver isso.
dialogsBegin.cns: Perhaps ripples of Ishirut's spirit have returned to give us a sign, but I have no connection to the gods. Perhaps this is work for a mystic of sorts.
dialogsBegin.de: Vielleicht sind Spuren des Geistes von Ishirut zurückgekehrt, um uns ein Zeichen zu geben, aber ich habe keine Verbindung zu den Göttern. Vielleicht ist das eine Arbeit für einen Mystiker oder so.
dialogsBegin.fi: Perhaps ripples of Ishirut's spirit have returned to give us a sign, but I have no connection to the gods. Perhaps this is work for a mystic of sorts.
dialogsBegin.fil: Perhaps ripples of Ishirut's spirit have returned to give us a sign, but I have no connection to the gods. Perhaps this is work for a mystic of sorts.
dialogsBegin.fr: Peut-être que des ondes de l'esprit d'Ishirut sont revenues pour nous donner un signe, mais je n'ai aucun lien avec les dieux. C'est peut-être le travail d'un mystique.
dialogsBegin.id: Mungkin riak roh Ishirut telah kembali untuk memberi kita tanda, tapi aku tidak memiliki hubungan dengan para dewa. Mungkin ini adalah pekerjaan mistis dan sejenisnya.
dialogsBegin.it: Perhaps ripples of Ishirut's spirit have returned to give us a sign, but I have no connection to the gods. Perhaps this is work for a mystic of sorts.
dialogsBegin.jp: おそらくイシルートの精神の波紋が戻ってきてしるしを与えてくれたのかもしれませんが、私は神々とは何の関係もありません。おそらくこれはある種の神秘家のための仕事です。
dialogsBegin.kr: 어쩌면 이실루트의 정신이 돌아와 우리에게 신호를 보냈을지도 모르겠지만, 저는 신들과 소통할 수 없거든요. 뭐랄까, 주술적인 일이니까요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Perhaps ripples of Ishirut's spirit have returned to give us a sign, but I have no connection to the gods. Perhaps this is work for a mystic of sorts.
dialogsBegin.pl: Perhaps ripples of Ishirut's spirit have returned to give us a sign, but I have no connection to the gods. Perhaps this is work for a mystic of sorts.
dialogsBegin.ru: Perhaps ripples of Ishirut's spirit have returned to give us a sign, but I have no connection to the gods. Perhaps this is work for a mystic of sorts.
dialogsBegin.sp: Quizás ondas del espíritu de Ishirut han regresado para darnos una señal, pero no tengo conexión con los dioses. Tal vez esto es trabajo para una especie de místico.
dialogsBegin.sw: Perhaps ripples of Ishirut's spirit have returned to give us a sign, but I have no connection to the gods. Perhaps this is work for a mystic of sorts.
dialogsBegin.th: บางทีระลอกวิญญาณแห่ง Ishirut ที่กลับมาอาจจะคอยบอกอะไรบางอย่างกับเรา แต่ข้าไม่มีอะไรเกี่ยวกับพวกเทพหรอกนะ บางทีนี่อาจจะเป็นแค่เรื่องลึกลับแค่นั้นเอง
dialogsBegin.tw: 也許伊希魯特靈魂的殘波已經回歸，向我們傳達某種訊號。但我和諸神毫無連結。這件事也許得交給真正的靈能者來處理。
dialogsBegin.vi: Có lẽ những gợn sóng linh hồn của Ishirut đã trở lại để cho chúng ta một dấu hiệu, nhưng tôi không có mối liên hệ nào với các vị thần. Có lẽ đây là công việc dành cho một loại thần bí.

dialogsAccept.en: I believe that YaoRin of the MewMew people has the power to reveal the truth, but the MewMew clan are distrusting of most humans. Anyway, I recommend you go speak with YaoRin and see if they are willing to cooperate. They are our best chance at learning what the gods are up to.
dialogsAccept.ar: I believe that YaoRin of the MewMew people has the power to reveal the truth, but the MewMew clan are distrusting of most humans. Anyway, I recommend you go speak with YaoRin and see if they are willing to cooperate. They are our best chance at learning what the gods are up to.
dialogsAccept.br: Eu acredito que YaoRin do povo MewMew tem o poder de revelar a verdade, mas o clã MewMew não confia muito nos humanos. De qualquer forma, eu recomendo que você vá falar com YaoRin e veja se eles estão dispostos a cooperar. Eles são a nossa melhor chance de descobrir o que os deuses estão tramando.
dialogsAccept.cns: I believe that YaoRin of the MewMew people has the power to reveal the truth, but the MewMew clan are distrusting of most humans. Anyway, I recommend you go speak with YaoRin and see if they are willing to cooperate. They are our best chance at learning what the gods are up to.
dialogsAccept.de: Ich glaube, dass YaoRin vom MewMew-Volk die Macht hat, die Wahrheit zu enthüllen, aber der MewMew-Klan misstraut den meisten Menschen. Wie auch immer, ich empfehle dir, mit YaoRin zu sprechen und herauszufinden, ob sie zur Zusammenarbeit bereit sind. Sie sind unsere beste Chance zu erfahren, was die Götter vorhaben.
dialogsAccept.fi: I believe that YaoRin of the MewMew people has the power to reveal the truth, but the MewMew clan are distrusting of most humans. Anyway, I recommend you go speak with YaoRin and see if they are willing to cooperate. They are our best chance at learning what the gods are up to.
dialogsAccept.fil: I believe that YaoRin of the MewMew people has the power to reveal the truth, but the MewMew clan are distrusting of most humans. Anyway, I recommend you go speak with YaoRin and see if they are willing to cooperate. They are our best chance at learning what the gods are up to.
dialogsAccept.fr: Je crois que YaoRin, du peuple MewMew, a le pouvoir de révéler la vérité, mais le clan MewMew se méfie de la plupart des humains. Quoi qu'il en soit, je vous recommande d'aller parler à YaoRin et de voir s'ils sont prêts à coopérer. Ils sont notre meilleure chance d'apprendre ce que les dieux manigancent.
dialogsAccept.id: Saya percaya bahwa YaoRin dari orang MewMew memiliki kekuatan untuk mengungkapkan kebenaran, tetapi klan MewMew tidak mempercayai kebanyakan manusia. Ngomong-ngomong, saya sarankan Anda berbicara dengan YaoRin dan lihat apakah mereka mau bekerja sama. Mereka adalah kesempatan terbaik kita untuk mempelajari apa yang sedang dilakukan para dewa.
dialogsAccept.it: I believe that YaoRin of the MewMew people has the power to reveal the truth, but the MewMew clan are distrusting of most humans. Anyway, I recommend you go speak with YaoRin and see if they are willing to cooperate. They are our best chance at learning what the gods are up to.
dialogsAccept.jp: ミュウミュウ族のヤオリンには真実を明らかにする力があると思いますが、ミュウミュウ一族はほとんどの人間に不信感を抱いています。とにかく、YaoRinと話をして、彼らが協力してくれるかどうかを確認することをお勧めします。彼らは神々が何をしているのかを学ぶための私たちの最高のチャンスです。
dialogsAccept.kr: 뮤뮤족의 야오린이란 자가 진실을 밝혀줄 수 있을 것 같지만, 뮤뮤족은 대개 인간을 믿지 않아요. 어쨌든, 야오린과 대화하면서 협조해 줄 의향이 있는지 보세요. 신들이 무슨 일을 꾸미고 있는지 알아내려면 뮤뮤족의 도움이 필요해요.

dialogsAccept.pl: I believe that YaoRin of the MewMew people has the power to reveal the truth, but the MewMew clan are distrusting of most humans. Anyway, I recommend you go speak with YaoRin and see if they are willing to cooperate. They are our best chance at learning what the gods are up to.
dialogsAccept.ru: I believe that YaoRin of the MewMew people has the power to reveal the truth, but the MewMew clan are distrusting of most humans. Anyway, I recommend you go speak with YaoRin and see if they are willing to cooperate. They are our best chance at learning what the gods are up to.
dialogsAccept.sp: Creo que YaoRin, del pueblo MewMew, tiene el poder de revelar la verdad, pero el clan MewMew desconfía de la mayoría de los humanos. De todos modos, te recomiendo que vayas a hablar con YaoRin y veas si están dispuestos a cooperar. Son nuestra mejor oportunidad para saber qué traman los dioses.
dialogsAccept.sw: I believe that YaoRin of the MewMew people has the power to reveal the truth, but the MewMew clan are distrusting of most humans. Anyway, I recommend you go speak with YaoRin and see if they are willing to cooperate. They are our best chance at learning what the gods are up to.
dialogsAccept.th: ข้าเชื่อว่า YaoRin แห่ง ชาว MewMew มีพลังที่จะเปิดเผยความจริงออกมาได้ แต่เผ่า MewMew นั้นไม่ไว้วางใจพวกมนุษย์ แต่ถึงยังไงข้าก็ยังแนะนำให้เจ้าลองไปคุยกับ YaoRin ดูก่อนและดูว่าพวกเขาอยากจะร่วมมือไหม พวกเขาเป็นโอกาสที่ดีที่สุดของพวกเราที่จะรู้ว่าพวกเทพกำลังจะทำอะไรกันแน่
dialogsAccept.tw: 我相信喵喵族的姚琳有能力揭開真相，不過喵喵一族向來不太信任大多數人類。總之，我建議你去找姚琳，看看他們願不願意合作。現在想知道諸神到底在做什麼，最有希望的就是他們了。
dialogsAccept.vi: Tôi tin rằng YaoRin của người MewMew có khả năng tiết lộ sự thật, nhưng tộc MewMew không tin tưởng vào hầu hết con người. Dù sao, tôi khuyên bạn nên nói chuyện với YaoRin và xem họ có sẵn sàng hợp tác hay không. Họ là cơ hội tốt nhất để chúng ta biết được các vị thần đang làm gì.

dialogsDecline.en: While a bit standoffish, the MewMew clan is not that scary...
dialogsDecline.ar: While a bit standoffish, the MewMew clan is not that scary...
dialogsDecline.br: Embora possam parecer um pouco fechados, o clã MewMew não é tão amedrontador assim.
dialogsDecline.cns: While a bit standoffish, the MewMew clan is not that scary...
dialogsDecline.de: Der MewMew-Clan ist zwar etwas zurückhaltend, aber nicht wirklich furchterregend.
dialogsDecline.fi: While a bit standoffish, the MewMew clan is not that scary...
dialogsDecline.fil: While a bit standoffish, the MewMew clan is not that scary...
dialogsDecline.fr: Bien qu'un peu distant, le clan MewMew n'est pas si effrayant que cela.
dialogsDecline.id: Meski agak angkuh, klan MewMew tidak seseram itu..
dialogsDecline.it: While a bit standoffish, the MewMew clan is not that scary...
dialogsDecline.jp: 少しスタンドオフですが、ミュウミュー一族はそれほど怖くありません..
dialogsDecline.kr: 뮤뮤족은 약간 거만하긴 하지만, 무서운 종족은 아니에요...
dialogsDecline.nl: While a bit standoffish, the MewMew clan is not that scary...
dialogsDecline.pl: While a bit standoffish, the MewMew clan is not that scary...
dialogsDecline.ru: While a bit standoffish, the MewMew clan is not that scary...
dialogsDecline.sp: Aunque un poco distante, el clan MewMew no da miedo...
dialogsDecline.sw: While a bit standoffish, the MewMew clan is not that scary...
dialogsDecline.th: ถึงจะมีเรื่องขัดแย้งกันอยู่บ้าง แต่เผ่า MewMew ก็ไม่ได้น่ากลัวขนาดนั้น
dialogsDecline.tw: 喵喵族雖然有點排外，但其實也沒那麼可怕……
dialogsDecline.vi: Mặc dù họ có cảnh giác một chút, gia tộc MewMew sẽ không đáng sợ đến thế đâu...

dialogsComplete.en: *Hmmph* So you were sent by that man Gothante. Even so, I do not trust you one bit.
dialogsComplete.ar: *Hmmph* So you were sent by that man Gothante. Even so, I do not trust you one bit.
dialogsComplete.br: Hmmph, então o Gothante mandou você aqui. Mas não se ache muito, ainda não confio em você!
dialogsComplete.cns: *Hmmph* So you were sent by that man Gothante. Even so, I do not trust you one bit.
dialogsComplete.de: *Hmmph* Dieser Gothante hat dich also geschickt. Trotzdem traue ich dir nicht über den Weg.
dialogsComplete.fi: *Hmmph* So you were sent by that man Gothante. Even so, I do not trust you one bit.
dialogsComplete.fil: *Hmmph* So you were sent by that man Gothante. Even so, I do not trust you one bit.
dialogsComplete.fr: *Mmmph* C'est donc cet homme, Gothante, qui vous a envoyé. Malgré cela, je ne vous fais pas confiance.
dialogsComplete.id: *Hmmph* Jadi kamu dikirim oleh pria Gothante itu. Meski begitu, saya tidak mempercayai Anda sedikit pun.
dialogsComplete.it: *Hmmph* So you were sent by that man Gothante. Even so, I do not trust you one bit.
dialogsComplete.jp: *うーん*それで、あなたはその男ゴタンテによって送られました。それでも、私はあなたを少しも信用していません。
dialogsComplete.kr: *흐으음* 그럼 고단테가 당신을 보낸 거군요. 그렇더라도 아직은 전혀 믿음이 안 가네요.
dialogsComplete.nl: *Hmmph* So you were sent by that man Gothante. Even so, I do not trust you one bit.
dialogsComplete.pl: *Hmmph* So you were sent by that man Gothante. Even so, I do not trust you one bit.
dialogsComplete.ru: *Hmmph* So you were sent by that man Gothante. Even so, I do not trust you one bit.
dialogsComplete.sp: *Hmmph* Así que fuiste enviado por ese hombre Gothante. Aun así, no confío en ti ni un poco.
dialogsComplete.sw: *Hmmph* So you were sent by that man Gothante. Even so, I do not trust you one bit.
dialogsComplete.th: *อืมมมม* เจ้าถูกส่งมาโดย Gothante รึ แต่ยังไงข้าก็ไม่ไว้ใจเจ้าแม้แต่นิดเดียวอยุ่ดี
dialogsComplete.tw: *哼*原來你是那個高譚提拉派來的。即便如此，我一點也不信任你。
dialogsComplete.vi: *Hmmph* Vậy là bạn được gửi bởi người đàn ông Gothante đó. Mặc dù vậy, tôi không tin tưởng bạn một chút.

dialogsFail.jp: 聖都市西部の城壁のすぐ外にあるミュウミューキャンプでヤオリンを見つけましょう。
dialogsFail.kr: 세인트 시티 서쪽 성벽 바깥쪽 근처에 사는 뮤뮤족 야영지에서 야오린을 찾으세요.
dialogsFail.nl: Find YaoRin in the MewMew camp just outside the walls of western Saint City.

dialogsFail.ru: Find YaoRin in the MewMew camp just outside the walls of western Saint City.

dialogsFail.sw: Find YaoRin in the MewMew camp just outside the walls of western Saint City.
dialogsFail.th: ค้นหา YaoRin ในค่ายของพวก MewMew ที่อยู่ด้านอกกำแพงทางตะวันตกของ Saint City
dialogsFail.tw: 到聖音特西側城牆外的喵喵營地尋找姚琳。
dialogsFail.vi: Tìm YaoRin trong trại MewMew ngay bên ngoài bức tường western Saint City.

description.en: Collect souls from 5 dungeon bosses on any difficulty.
description.ar: Collect souls from 5 dungeon bosses on any difficulty.
description.br: Colete almas de 5 chefes de masmorra em qualquer dificuldade.
description.cns: 在任意难度下，收集5 个副本 Boss的灵魂。
description.de: Sammle die Seelen von 5 Dungeon-Bossen auf einem beliebigen Schwierigkeitsgrad.
description.fi: Collect souls from 5 dungeon bosses on any difficulty.
description.fil: Collect souls from 5 dungeon bosses on any difficulty.
description.fr: Récupérez les âmes de 5 boss de donjon (n'importe quelle difficulté).

description.vi: Thu thập linh hồn từ 5 Dungeon Bosses ở bất kỳ độ khó nào.

dialogsBegin.en: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 5 dungeon bosses, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.ar: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 5 dungeon bosses, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.br: Bem-vindo herói! Recebemos outro pedido para limpar os chefes masquerpets das masmorras de Madrigal. Você poderia eliminar 5 chefes de masmorra e retornar a mim quando terminar?
dialogsBegin.cns: 欢迎你，英雄！又有新委托了，需要清除瑞加大陆副本中的Boss 级别怪物。请你击杀 5 个副本 Boss，完成后再来找我。
dialogsBegin.de: Willkommen Held! Es ist eine weitere Anfrage eingegangen, um die Boss-Masquerpets in Madrigals Dungeons zu beseitigen. Kannst du bitte 5 Dungeonbosse töten und zu mir zurückkehren, sobald du fertig bist?
dialogsBegin.fi: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 5 dungeon bosses, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.fil: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 5 dungeon bosses, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.fr: Bienvenue héros ! Nous avons reçu une autre demande pour éliminer les boss dans les donjons de Madrigal. Pourriez-vous tuer 5 boss de donjon et revenir me voir une fois que vous aurez terminé ?
dialogsBegin.id: Selamat datang pahlawan! Permintaan lain telah datang untuk membersihkan boss masquerpets di Madrigal's dungeons. Bisakah kamu membunuh 5 bos dungeon, dan kembali padaku setelah kamu selesai?
dialogsBegin.it: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 5 dungeon bosses, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.jp: ようこそヒーロー!マドリガルのダンジョン内のボスの仮面舞踏会を一掃する依頼がまた一つ入ってきた。ダンジョンのボスを5体倒して、終わったら私のところに戻ってきてくれませんか?
dialogsBegin.kr: 어서 오세요, 용사님! 마드리갈 던전에 있는 보스 마스커펫을 처치해 달라는 부탁을 또 받았어요. 던전 보스 5마리를 처치하고, 완료되면 제게 돌아와 주시겠어요?
dialogsBegin.nl: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 5 dungeon bosses, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.pl: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 5 dungeon bosses, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.ru: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 5 dungeon bosses, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Bienvenido héroe! Ha llegado una solicitud; Eliminar los jefes enmascarados en las mazmorras de Madrigal. ¿Podrías matar a 5 jefes de mazmorra y regresar cuando hayas terminado?
dialogsBegin.sw: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 5 dungeon bosses, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.th: ยินดีต้อนรับผู้กล้า! มีคำขอเข้ามาอีกครั้งเพื่อกำจัด masquerpets ในดันเจี้ยนของ Madrigal คุณจะช่วยกำจัดบอสดันเจี้ยนซัก 5 ตัวได้ไหม จากนั้นกลับมาหาฉันเมื่อคุณจัดการเสร็จ
dialogsBegin.tw: 歡迎，英雄！又有新的委託，要清除瑪德利賈各地副本中的頭目魔物。請擊殺 5 隻副本頭目，完成後再回來找我。
dialogsBegin.vi: Xin chào người hùng! Có một nhiệm vụ khác yêu cầu dọn sạch trùm masquerpets ẩn náu trong ngục tối của Madrigal. Bạn có thể giết 5 Dungeon Boss và quay lại chỗ tôi khi xong việc không?

dialogsAccept.en: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon 5 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsAccept.ar: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon 5 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsAccept.br: Colete almas de chefes masquerpets no final de qualquer masmorra 5 vezes e retorne a mim para uma recompensa.
dialogsAccept.cns: 在任意副本的尽头，从Boss 级别怪物身上收集灵魂，完成5 次后回来找我领取奖励。
dialogsAccept.de: Sammle am Ende eines beliebigen Dungeons 5x die Seelen von Boss-Masquerpets und kehre für eine Belohnung zu mir zurück.
dialogsAccept.fi: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon 5 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsAccept.fil: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon 5 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsAccept.fr: Récupérez les âmes de boss à la fin de n'importe quel donjon 5 fois, et revenez me voir pour une récompense.
dialogsAccept.id: Kumpulkan jiwa dari bos masquerpet di akhir dungeon mana pun sebanyak 5 kali, dan kembalikan kepadaku untuk mendapatkan hadiah.
dialogsAccept.it: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon 5 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsAccept.jp: ダンジョンの最後にあるボスの仮面舞踏会から魂を5回集めて、報酬を求めて私のところに戻ってください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 원하는 난이도의 던전이 끝날 때마다 보스 마스커펫을 처치해 영혼을 5회 수집하고, 제게 돌아와 보상을 받으세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon 5 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsAccept.pl: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon 5 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsAccept.ru: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon 5 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsAccept.sp: Recoge almas de jefes masquerpet al salir de mazmorra 5 veces y vuelve para recibir una recompensa.
dialogsAccept.sw: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon 5 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsAccept.th: รวบรวมวิญญาณจาก masquerpets ตอนท้ายของดันเจี้ยนใดๆ 5 ครั้ง แล้วกลับมาหาฉันเพื่อรับรางวัล
dialogsAccept.tw: 從任意副本的最終頭目魔物身上蒐集 5 次靈魂，再回來找我領取獎勵。
dialogsAccept.vi: Thu thập linh hồn của trùm masquerpet ở cuối hầm ngục tối 5 lần và quay lại chỗ tôi để nhận thưởng.

dialogsDecline.en: The dungeons are filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.ar: The dungeons are filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.br: As masmorras estão cheias de masquerpets perigosos. Eu entendo se você não quiser correr o risco.
dialogsDecline.cns: 这些副本遍布着危险的怪物。如果你不想冒这个险，我完全理解。
dialogsDecline.de: Die Dungeons sind voll von gefährlichen Masquerpets. Ich verstehe, wenn du das Risiko nicht eingehen willst.
dialogsDecline.fi: The dungeons are filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.fil: The dungeons are filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.fr: Les donjons sont remplis de monstres dangereux. Je comprends que vous ne souhaitiez pas prendre le risque.
dialogsDecline.id: Dungeons dipenuhi dengan dangerous masquerpets. Aku mengerti jika kamu tidak ingin mengambil risiko.
dialogsDecline.it: The dungeons are filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.jp: ダンジョンは危険な仮面舞踏会でいっぱいです。リスクを冒したくないのであれば、私は理解しています。
dialogsDecline.kr: 던전에는 위험한 마스커펫이 가득해요. 위험을 감수하고 싶지 않다고 하셔도 이해합니다.
dialogsDecline.nl: The dungeons are filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.pl: The dungeons are filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.ru: The dungeons are filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.sp: Las mazmorras están llenas de peligrosas masquerpets. Entiendo que no quieras correr el riesgo.
dialogsDecline.sw: The dungeons are filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.th: ในดันเจี้ยนไปด้วย masquerpets ที่อันตรายมาก ฉันเข้าใจถ้าคุณไม่อยากเสี่ยง
dialogsDecline.tw: 副本裡充滿危險的 Masquerpets。如果你不想冒這個險，我也能理解。
dialogsDecline.vi: Những hầm ngục đầy rẫy đám masquerpet nguy hiểm. Tôi hiểu nếu bạn không muốn chấp nhận rủi ro này.

dialogsComplete.en: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsComplete.ar: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsComplete.br: A ameaça dentro das masmorras foi reduzida graças a você, herói. Por favor, aceite um cartão de perfuração de arma como agradecimento por seus esforços!
dialogsComplete.cns: 英雄，多亏了你，副本内部的威胁已经减轻了。为感谢你的付出，请收下这张武器穿洞卡作为谢礼！
dialogsComplete.de: Die Bedrohung aus den Dungeons ist dank dir, Held, geringer geworden. Bitte nimm eine Weapon Piercing Card als Dank für deine Bemühungen an!
dialogsComplete.fi: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsComplete.fil: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsComplete.fr: La menace des donjons a été réduite grâce à vous, héros. Veuillez accepter une carte de piercing d'arme en guise de remerciement pour vos efforts !
dialogsComplete.id: Ancaman dari dalam dungeon telah mengurangi berkatmu, Pahlawan. Mohon terima weapon piercing card sebagai ucapan terima kasih atas usahamu!
dialogsComplete.it: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsComplete.jp: ダンジョン内からの脅威は、ヒーローであるあなたのおかげで減少しました。お礼に武器貫通カードを受け取ってください!
dialogsComplete.kr: 용사님 덕분에 던전 안이 훨씬 안전해졌어요. 자, 무기 피어싱 카드를 받아주세요, 노고에 대한 감사의 표시랍니다!
dialogsComplete.nl: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsComplete.pl: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsComplete.ru: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsComplete.sp: La amenaza en las mazmorras se ha reducido gracias a ti, héroe. ¡Acepte una tarjeta de perforación de armas como agradecimiento por tus esfuerzos!
dialogsComplete.sw: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsComplete.th: ภัยคุกคามจากดันเจี้ยนลดลงเล้ว ท่านผู้กล้าโปรดรับการ์ดเจาะอาวุธเพื่อเป็นการขอบคุณสำหรับความพยายามของคุณ!
dialogsComplete.tw: 多虧了你，副本內的威脅已經減輕了，英雄。請收下這張武器打洞卡，作為對你努力的感謝！
dialogsComplete.vi: Mối đe dọa từ bên trong hầm ngục đã giảm đi nhiều nhờ có bạn đấy, người hùng. Xin hãy nhận một thẻ xuyên vũ khí như một lời cảm ơn vì những nỗ lực của bạn!

dialogsFail.en: You haven't defeated the bosses yet? That's okay, just return once you have.
dialogsFail.ar: You haven't defeated the bosses yet? That's okay, just return once you have.
dialogsFail.br: Você ainda não derrotou os chefes? Tudo bem, apenas retorne quando tiver terminado.
dialogsFail.cns: 你还没有击败那些 Boss 吗？没关系，等你完成之后再回来就好。
dialogsFail.de: Du hast die Bosse noch nicht besiegt? Das ist okay, komm einfach zurück, wenn du es geschafft hast.
dialogsFail.fi: You haven't defeated the bosses yet? That's okay, just return once you have.
dialogsFail.fil: You haven't defeated the bosses yet? That's okay, just return once you have.
dialogsFail.fr: Vous n'avez pas encore vaincu les boss ? Ce n'est pas grave, revenez une fois que vous les aurez vaincus.
dialogsFail.id: Kamu belum mengalahkan bosnya? Tidak apa-apa, kembalikan saja setelah kamu punya.
dialogsFail.it: You haven't defeated the bosses yet? That's okay, just return once you have.
dialogsFail.jp: まだボスを倒していませんか?大丈夫です、一度戻ればいいのです。
dialogsFail.kr: 아직 보스를 처치하지 못하셨다고요? 괜찮아요. 처치하고 나서 다시 오세요.
dialogsFail.nl: You haven't defeated the bosses yet? That's okay, just return once you have.
dialogsFail.pl: You haven't defeated the bosses yet? That's okay, just return once you have.
dialogsFail.ru: You haven't defeated the bosses yet? That's okay, just return once you have.
dialogsFail.sp: ¿Aún no has derrotado a los jefes? Está bien, regresa cuando lo hayas hecho.
dialogsFail.sw: You haven't defeated the bosses yet? That's okay, just return once you have.
dialogsFail.th: ยังไม่เอาชนะบอสไม่ได้ใช่ไหม? ไม่เป็นไร กลับมาใหม่เมื่อทำสำเร็จแล้ว
dialogsFail.tw: 你還沒打倒那些頭目嗎？沒關係，完成後再回來吧。
dialogsFail.vi: Bạn chưa hạ gục đám trùm quái vật đó à? Không sao cả, quay lại đây khi bạn đã làm xong nhé.

dialogsBegin.en: Look at all this steel. We'll have an army up and running in no time!
dialogsBegin.ar: Look at all this steel. We'll have an army up and running in no time!
dialogsBegin.br: Vê só esse monte de aço. Logo logo teremos um exército de pé e pronto pra ação!
dialogsBegin.cns: Look at all this steel. We'll have an army up and running in no time!
dialogsBegin.de: Sieh dir all diesen Stahl an. Wir werden im Handumdrehen eine ganze Armee auf die Beine stellen können!
dialogsBegin.fi: Look at all this steel. We'll have an army up and running in no time!
dialogsBegin.fil: Look at all this steel. We'll have an army up and running in no time!
dialogsBegin.fr: Regardez moi tout cet acier ! Nous aurons une armée prête à l'action en un rien de temps !
dialogsBegin.id: Lihatlah semua baja ini. Kami akan memiliki pasukan dan berlari dalam waktu singkat!
dialogsBegin.it: Look at all this steel. We'll have an army up and running in no time!
dialogsBegin.jp: このすべての鋼を見てください。すぐに軍隊を立ち上げて稼働させます!
dialogsBegin.kr: 이 강철 좀 보세요. 금방 군대를 꾸릴 수 있겠는데요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Look at all this steel. We'll have an army up and running in no time!
dialogsBegin.pl: Look at all this steel. We'll have an army up and running in no time!
dialogsBegin.ru: Look at all this steel. We'll have an army up and running in no time!
dialogsBegin.sp: Mira todo este acero. ¡Tendremos un ejército en marcha muy pronto!
dialogsBegin.sw: Look at all this steel. We'll have an army up and running in no time!
dialogsBegin.th: ดูเหล็กกล้าพวกนี้สิ พวกเราจะมีกองทัพที่พร้อมในไม่ช้านี่หล่ะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 看看這些鋼材。我們很快就能拉起一支軍隊了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Nhìn vào tất cả thép này. Chúng tôi sẽ có một đội quân và chạy nhanh!

dialogsAccept.en: *BANG* Wha... What was that!? Perhaps the battle has already begun? Quickly, go speak with Loala to figure out what is going on!
dialogsAccept.ar: *BANG* Wha... What was that!? Perhaps the battle has already begun? Quickly, go speak with Loala to figure out what is going on!
dialogsAccept.br: *BOOM* O que foi isso!? Será que a batalha já começou? Vai correndo falar com Loala e descobrir o que tá rolando!
dialogsAccept.cns: *BANG* Wha... What was that!? Perhaps the battle has already begun? Quickly, go speak with Loala to figure out what is going on!
dialogsAccept.de: *BANG* Was... Was war das? Vielleicht hat der Kampf schon begonnen? Schnell, geh und sprich mit Loala, um herauszufinden, was hier los ist!
dialogsAccept.fi: *BANG* Wha... What was that!? Perhaps the battle has already begun? Quickly, go speak with Loala to figure out what is going on!
dialogsAccept.fil: *BANG* Wha... What was that!? Perhaps the battle has already begun? Quickly, go speak with Loala to figure out what is going on!
dialogsAccept.fr: *BOOM* Qu... Qu'est-ce que c'était que ça ? La bataille a déjà commencé ? Vite, allez voir Loala pour voir ce qu'il se passe ?
dialogsAccept.id: *BANG* Apa.. Apa itu!? Mungkin pertempuran sudah dimulai? Cepat, bicaralah dengan Loala untuk mencari tahu apa yang sedang terjadi!
dialogsAccept.it: *BANG* Wha... What was that!? Perhaps the battle has already begun? Quickly, go speak with Loala to figure out what is going on!
dialogsAccept.jp: *バン*うわー..何でしたか！。おそらく戦いはすでに始まっていますか?すぐに、ロアラと話して、何が起こっているのかを理解してください!
dialogsAccept.kr: *쾅!* 어... 방금 뭐였죠!? 이미 전투가 시작된 걸까요? 어서 라올라에게 가서 무슨 일인지 알아보세요!
dialogsAccept.nl: *BANG* Wha... What was that!? Perhaps the battle has already begun? Quickly, go speak with Loala to figure out what is going on!
dialogsAccept.pl: *BANG* Wha... What was that!? Perhaps the battle has already begun? Quickly, go speak with Loala to figure out what is going on!
dialogsAccept.ru: *BANG* Wha... What was that!? Perhaps the battle has already begun? Quickly, go speak with Loala to figure out what is going on!
dialogsAccept.sp: *BANG* Wha.. ¿¡Qué fue eso!? ¿Quizás la batalla ya ha comenzado? ¡Rápido, ve a hablar con Loala para averiguar qué pasa!
dialogsAccept.sw: *BANG* Wha... What was that!? Perhaps the battle has already begun? Quickly, go speak with Loala to figure out what is going on!
dialogsAccept.th: อ...อะไรล่ะนั่น? การต่อสู้เริ่มขึ้นแล้วรึ? เร็วเข้า รีบไปคุยกับ Laola เพื่อดูว่าเกิดอะไรขึ้น!
dialogsAccept.tw: *轟隆* 什……那是什麼聲音！？難道戰鬥已經開始了？快，立刻去找拉宇，搞清楚發生了什麼事！
dialogsAccept.vi: *BANG* Cá.. Cái gì thế!? Có lẽ trận chiến đã bắt đầu? Hãy nhanh chóng nói chuyện với Loala để biết chuyện gì đang xảy ra!

dialogsDecline.en: Just a while longer and we'll have enough armor to equip a proper militia!
dialogsDecline.ar: Just a while longer and we'll have enough armor to equip a proper militia!
dialogsDecline.br: Mais um pouco e vamos ter armaduras o suficiente pra equipar uma milícia de respeito!
dialogsDecline.cns: Just a while longer and we'll have enough armor to equip a proper militia!
dialogsDecline.de: Nur noch eine Weile und wir haben genug Rüstung, um eine richtige Miliz auszurüsten!
dialogsDecline.fi: Just a while longer and we'll have enough armor to equip a proper militia!
dialogsDecline.fil: Just a while longer and we'll have enough armor to equip a proper militia!
dialogsDecline.fr: Encore un peu de temps et nous aurons assez d'armures pour équiper une armée entière !
dialogsDecline.id: Sebentar lagi dan kita akan memiliki cukup baju besi untuk melengkapi milisi yang tepat!
dialogsDecline.it: Just a while longer and we'll have enough armor to equip a proper militia!
dialogsDecline.jp: もう少しすれば、適切な民兵を装備するのに十分な装甲を手に入れることができます!
dialogsDecline.kr: 조금만 더 있으면, 방어구를 더 구해서 제대로 된 민병대를 꾸릴 수 있어요!
dialogsDecline.nl: Just a while longer and we'll have enough armor to equip a proper militia!
dialogsDecline.pl: Just a while longer and we'll have enough armor to equip a proper militia!
dialogsDecline.ru: Just a while longer and we'll have enough armor to equip a proper militia!
dialogsDecline.sp: ¡Un poco más y tendremos armadura suficiente para equipar una milicia!
dialogsDecline.sw: Just a while longer and we'll have enough armor to equip a proper militia!
dialogsDecline.th: อีกไม่นานพวกเราก็จะมีชุดเกราะมากพอสำหรับให้พวกทหารรับจ้างทุกคนแล้ว!
dialogsDecline.tw: 再一下下，我們就有足夠的鎧甲裝備一支正規民兵隊了！
dialogsDecline.vi: Chỉ một thời gian nữa thôi là chúng ta sẽ có đủ áo giáp để trang bị cho một lực lượng dân quân đàng hoàng!

dialogsComplete.en: Chenbing was smart to send you to me... surely you felt the tremors after that loud bang.
dialogsComplete.ar: Chenbing was smart to send you to me... surely you felt the tremors after that loud bang.
dialogsComplete.br: O Chenbing foi esperto em te mandar pra cá... tenho certeza que você sentiu o tremor depois daquele barulhão.
dialogsComplete.cns: Chenbing was smart to send you to me... surely you felt the tremors after that loud bang.
dialogsComplete.de: Chenbing war klug, dich zu mir zu senden...sicherlich hast du die Beben des großen Knalls gespürt.
dialogsComplete.fi: Chenbing was smart to send you to me... surely you felt the tremors after that loud bang.
dialogsComplete.fil: Chenbing was smart to send you to me... surely you felt the tremors after that loud bang.
dialogsComplete.fr: Chenbing vous a envoyé judicieusement envoyé me trouver... Vous avez sûrement ressenti la déflagration suite à cette grande explosion !
dialogsComplete.id: Chenbing pintar mengirimmu padaku.. pasti kau merasakan getaran setelah ledakan keras itu.
dialogsComplete.it: Chenbing was smart to send you to me... surely you felt the tremors after that loud bang.
dialogsComplete.jp: チェンビンはあなたを私に送るのが賢かった..確かにあなたはその大きな強打の後に震えを感じました。
dialogsComplete.kr: 첸빙이 당신을 보낸 건 정말 현명한 선택이었어요... 큰 소리가 난 후에 분명 진동을 느끼셨겠죠.
dialogsComplete.nl: Chenbing was smart to send you to me... surely you felt the tremors after that loud bang.
dialogsComplete.pl: Chenbing was smart to send you to me... surely you felt the tremors after that loud bang.
dialogsComplete.ru: Chenbing was smart to send you to me... surely you felt the tremors after that loud bang.
dialogsComplete.sp: Chenbing fue listo al enviarte a mí... seguro sentiste los temblores después de ese fuerte golpe.
dialogsComplete.sw: Chenbing was smart to send you to me... surely you felt the tremors after that loud bang.
dialogsComplete.th: Chenbing ฉลาดมากที่ส่งเจ้ามาหาข้า แน่นอนว่าเจ้าคงรู้สึกถึงแรงสั่นสะเทือนที่มาจากเสียงดังนั่น
dialogsComplete.tw: 陳兵把你派來找我，算他聰明……剛剛那聲巨響之後的震動，你一定也感覺到了吧。
dialogsComplete.vi: Chenbing đã rất sáng suốt khi cử bạn đến chỗ tôi.. chắc chắn bạn đã cảm thấy những rung chấn sau tiếng nổ lớn đó.

dialogsFail.kr: 라올라와 대화하여 소음의 원인을 알아보세요.

dialogsFail.tw: 去找拉宇，查清楚那聲巨響的來源。

dialogsBegin.en: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.ar: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.br: Bem-vindo aventureiro! Chegou mais um pedido de $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ da Torre Abandonada.Você poderia conseguir 60 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ e trazê-los para mim?
dialogsBegin.cns: 欢迎你，英雄！又有一项委托来了 —— 肃清深渊之塔内的 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$，请你斩杀50只 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$，完成之后再回来找我。
dialogsBegin.de: Willkommen Held! Es ist eine weitere Bitte eingegangen, $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ aus dem Verlassenen Turm zu entfernen. Kannst du bitte 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ erschlagen und zu mir zurückkehren, sobald du fertig bist?
dialogsBegin.fi: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.fil: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.fr: Bienvenue, héros ! Nous avons reçu une autre demande pour éliminer des $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ de la Tour Oubliée. Pourriez-vous tuer 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ et revenir me voir une fois que vous aurez terminé ?
dialogsBegin.id: Selamat datang pahlawan! Request lain telah masuk untuk $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ dari Forsaken Tower. Bisakah kamu mengambil 50 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, dan mengembalikannya kepadaku?
dialogsBegin.it: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.jp: ようこそヒーロー！忘却の塔から$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を一掃せよと依頼が届きました。50体の$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$を倒し戻ってきてくれないか？
dialogsBegin.kr: 어서 오세요, 용사님! 버려진 탑에서 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$을(를) 처치해 달라는 요청이 또 들어왔어요. $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ 50마리를 처치하고, 완료되면 제게 돌아와 주시겠어요?

dialogsBegin.sw: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsBegin.th: ยินดีต้อนรับฮีโร่! มีคำขอสำหรับ $$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ จาก Forsaken Tower มาอีกแล้ว คุณช่วยไปเก็บ 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ และนำกลับมาให้ฉันทีได้ไหม
dialogsBegin.tw: 歡迎，英雄！又有新的委託要你清除深淵之塔中的 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$。可以請你擊殺 50 隻 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$，完成後再回來找我嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Chào mừng người hùng! Một nhiệm vụ khác từ Forsaken Tower yêu cầu bạn đánh bại $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$s. Bạn có thể vui lòng diệt 60 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ và quay lại tìm tôi sau khi hoàn thành nhiệm vụ không?
