dialogsBegin.en: Storm Peak mountain has been closed off for many years... I am stationed here to prevent anyone from going inside. Terrifying masquerpets have overrun the place, and as far as I know no one has been able to safely step inside for a long time.
dialogsBegin.ar: Storm Peak mountain has been closed off for many years... I am stationed here to prevent anyone from going inside. Terrifying masquerpets have overrun the place, and as far as I know no one has been able to safely step inside for a long time.
dialogsBegin.br: A montanha do Pico da Tempestade está fechada há anos. Fui designado para evitar que qualquer um entre. Masquerpets aterrorizantes tomaram conta do local, e até onde sei, ninguém conseguiu se aventurar por lá com segurança por muito tempo.
dialogsBegin.cns: Storm Peak mountain has been closed off for many years... I am stationed here to prevent anyone from going inside. Terrifying masquerpets have overrun the place, and as far as I know no one has been able to safely step inside for a long time.
dialogsBegin.de: Der Berg Sturmgipfel ist seit Jahren verschlossen. Ich bin hier stationiert, um zu verhindern, dass jemand den Berg betritt. Schreckliche Masquerpets haben den Ort überrannt, und soweit ich weiß, konnte schon lange niemand mehr gefahrlos hineingehen.
dialogsBegin.fi: Storm Peak mountain has been closed off for many years... I am stationed here to prevent anyone from going inside. Terrifying masquerpets have overrun the place, and as far as I know no one has been able to safely step inside for a long time.
dialogsBegin.fil: Storm Peak mountain has been closed off for many years... I am stationed here to prevent anyone from going inside. Terrifying masquerpets have overrun the place, and as far as I know no one has been able to safely step inside for a long time.
dialogsBegin.fr: Le Pic de Tempête a été fermé pendant de nombreuses années. Je suis stationné ici pour éviter que quiconque se rende à l'intérieur. Des monstres terrifiants se sont emparés des lieux et du peu que je sache, personne n'a pu y pénétrer en toute sécurité depuis très longtemps.
dialogsBegin.id: Gunung Storm Peak telah ditutup selama bertahun-tahun.. Aku ditempatkan di sini untuk mencegah siapa pun masuk ke dalam. Masquerpet yang menakutkan telah menyerbu tempat itu, dan sejauh yang aku tahu tidak ada yang bisa masuk dengan aman untuk waktu yang lama.
dialogsBegin.it: Storm Peak mountain has been closed off for many years... I am stationed here to prevent anyone from going inside. Terrifying masquerpets have overrun the place, and as far as I know no one has been able to safely step inside for a long time.
dialogsBegin.jp: ストームピーク山は何年もの間閉鎖されています..私は誰も中に入るのを防ぐためにここに駐在しています。恐ろしい仮面舞踏会がその場所をオーバーランさせており、私の知る限り、誰も長い間安全に中に足を踏み入れることができませんでした。
dialogsBegin.kr: 스톰 봉우리 산은 오랫동안 봉쇄되어 있었죠... 저는 여기서 아무도 못 들어가게 막고 있고요. 무시무시한 마스커펫들이 이곳을 점령하고 있어요. 제가 아는 한, 일단 여기 들어가면 아무도 무사히 나오지 못해요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Storm Peak mountain has been closed off for many years... I am stationed here to prevent anyone from going inside. Terrifying masquerpets have overrun the place, and as far as I know no one has been able to safely step inside for a long time.
dialogsBegin.pl: Storm Peak mountain has been closed off for many years... I am stationed here to prevent anyone from going inside. Terrifying masquerpets have overrun the place, and as far as I know no one has been able to safely step inside for a long time.
dialogsBegin.ru: Storm Peak mountain has been closed off for many years... I am stationed here to prevent anyone from going inside. Terrifying masquerpets have overrun the place, and as far as I know no one has been able to safely step inside for a long time.
dialogsBegin.sp: La montaña Pico Tormentoso ha estado cerrada durante muchos años.. Estoy destinado aquí para evitar que nadie entre. Masquerpets aterradores han invadido el lugar, y por lo que yo sé nadie ha sido capaz de adentrarse con seguridad durante mucho tiempo.
dialogsBegin.sw: Storm Peak mountain has been closed off for many years... I am stationed here to prevent anyone from going inside. Terrifying masquerpets have overrun the place, and as far as I know no one has been able to safely step inside for a long time.
dialogsBegin.th: ภูเขา Storm Peak ถูกปิดตายมาหลายปีแล้ว ข้ามาประจำการอยู่ที่นี่เพื่อป้องกันไม่ให้ใครเข้าไป ข้างในมี masquerpets ที่น่าสะพรึงอยู่ในนั้นเต็มไปหมด และเท่าที่ข้ารู้ ไม่มีใครก้าวเข้าไปในนั้นได้อย่างปลอดภัยมานานแล้ว
dialogsBegin.tw: 風暴峰已經封閉很多年了……我被派來駐守這裡，就是為了阻止任何人闖進去。那裡早就被可怕的假面怪占據，而據我所知，已經很久沒有人能安全進入了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Núi Storm Peak đã bị đóng cửa trong nhiều năm.. Tôi canh gác ở đây để ngăn chặn bất cứ ai vào bên trong. Masquerpets đáng sợ đã tràn ngập nơi này, và theo như tôi biết thì không ai có thể bước vào bên trong một cách an toàn trong một thời gian dài.

dialogsBegin.en: If you really want to go inside, you'll need to prove that you can handle the strongest masquerpets in Azria. Those found within the Storm Peak are even more dangerous...
dialogsBegin.ar: If you really want to go inside, you'll need to prove that you can handle the strongest masquerpets in Azria. Those found within the Storm Peak are even more dangerous...
dialogsBegin.br: Se você realmente quer entrar, você precisará provar que é capaz de lidar com os masquerpets mais fortes em Azria. Aqueles encontrados dentro do Pico Tempestuoso são ainda mais perigosos...
dialogsBegin.cns: If you really want to go inside, you'll need to prove that you can handle the strongest masquerpets in Azria. Those found within the Storm Peak are even more dangerous...
dialogsBegin.de: Wenn du wirklich hineingehen willst, musst du beweisen, dass du mit den stärksten Masquerpets in Azria umgehen kannst. Diejenigen, die sich im Sturmgipfel befinden, sind sogar noch gefährlicher...
dialogsBegin.fi: If you really want to go inside, you'll need to prove that you can handle the strongest masquerpets in Azria. Those found within the Storm Peak are even more dangerous...
dialogsBegin.fil: If you really want to go inside, you'll need to prove that you can handle the strongest masquerpets in Azria. Those found within the Storm Peak are even more dangerous...
dialogsBegin.fr: Si vous souhaitez vraiment y entrer, vous allez devoir prouver que vous êtes capable de gérer les monstres les plus puissants d'Azria. Ceux que l'on peut trouver au Pic de Tempête sont encore plus dangereux.
dialogsBegin.id: Jika kamu benar-benar ingin masuk ke dalam, kamu harus membuktikan bahwa dapat menangani penyamaran terkuat di Azria. Yang ditemukan di dalam Storm Peak bahkan lebih berbahaya..
dialogsBegin.it: If you really want to go inside, you'll need to prove that you can handle the strongest masquerpets in Azria. Those found within the Storm Peak are even more dangerous...
dialogsBegin.jp: 本当に中に入れたい場合は、アズリアで最強のマスカペットを扱えることを証明する必要があります。ストームピーク内で見つかったものはさらに危険です..
dialogsBegin.kr: 정말 봉우리 안으로 들어가고 싶다면, 아즈리아에서 가장 강력한 마스커펫도 문제없다는 걸 증명해 보세요. 스톰 봉우리 안에 사는 녀석들은 그보다 훨씬 위험하니까요...
dialogsBegin.nl: If you really want to go inside, you'll need to prove that you can handle the strongest masquerpets in Azria. Those found within the Storm Peak are even more dangerous...
dialogsBegin.pl: If you really want to go inside, you'll need to prove that you can handle the strongest masquerpets in Azria. Those found within the Storm Peak are even more dangerous...
dialogsBegin.ru: If you really want to go inside, you'll need to prove that you can handle the strongest masquerpets in Azria. Those found within the Storm Peak are even more dangerous...
dialogsBegin.sp: Si realmente quieres entrar, tendrás que demostrar que puedes con los masquerpets más fuertes de Azria. Los que se encuentran en el Pico Tormentoso son aún más peligrosos...
dialogsBegin.sw: If you really want to go inside, you'll need to prove that you can handle the strongest masquerpets in Azria. Those found within the Storm Peak are even more dangerous...
dialogsBegin.th: ถ้าเจ้าต้องการจะเข้าไปข้างในจริง ๆ เจ้าต้องพิสูจน์ตัวเองก่อนว่าเจ้าสามารถจัดการ masquerpets ที่แข็งแกร่งทีสุดใน Azria ได้ เพราะพวกที่จะเจอใน Storm Peak นั้นอันตรายยิ่งกว่านั้นอีก...
dialogsBegin.tw: 如果你真的想進去，就得先證明自己有能力對付阿茲里亞最強的怪物。風暴峰裡的傢伙，甚至比那些還更危險……
dialogsBegin.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự muốn vào trong, bạn sẽ cần chứng minh rằng bạn có thể xử lý những con masquerpet mạnh nhất ở Azria. Những con sống trong Storm Peak thậm chí còn nguy hiểm hơn..

dialogsBegin.en: With the information you've brought back, our village has a real chance to take down the Dorian and Okean before they get to us!
dialogsBegin.ar: With the information you've brought back, our village has a real chance to take down the Dorian and Okean before they get to us!
dialogsBegin.br: Com as informações que você trouxe, nossa vila tem uma chance real de derrotar os Dorian e Okean antes que eles cheguem até nós!
dialogsBegin.cns: 有了你带回的情报，我们村子完全有机会在变异枪鱼和皇冠海妖找上门之前就彻底解决它们！
dialogsBegin.de: Mit den Informationen, die du mitgebracht hast, hat unser Dorf eine echte Chance, die Dorianer und Okeaner auszuschalten, bevor sie uns erwischen!
dialogsBegin.fi: With the information you've brought back, our village has a real chance to take down the Dorian and Okean before they get to us!
dialogsBegin.fil: With the information you've brought back, our village has a real chance to take down the Dorian and Okean before they get to us!
dialogsBegin.fr: Avec les informations que vous avez ramenées, notre village a une réelle chance d'abattre les Dorian et les Okean avant qu'ils n'arrivent jusqu'à nous !
dialogsBegin.id: Dengan informasi yang kamu bawa, desa kami punya peluang nyata untuk mengalahkan Dorian dan Okean sebelum mereka sampai ke tangan kami!
dialogsBegin.it: With the information you've brought back, our village has a real chance to take down the Dorian and Okean before they get to us!
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたが持ち帰った情報があれば、私たちの村はドリアンとオキアンが私たちに来る前に倒すチャンスがあります!
dialogsBegin.kr: 용사님이 가져오신 정보 덕분에, 도리언과 오케안이 마을에 오기 전에 처치하러 나설 수 있게 되었어요!
dialogsBegin.nl: With the information you've brought back, our village has a real chance to take down the Dorian and Okean before they get to us!
dialogsBegin.pl: With the information you've brought back, our village has a real chance to take down the Dorian and Okean before they get to us!
dialogsBegin.ru: With the information you've brought back, our village has a real chance to take down the Dorian and Okean before they get to us!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Con la información que has traído, nuestra aldea tiene la oportunidad de acabar con Dorian y Okean antes de que lleguen a nosotros!
dialogsBegin.sw: With the information you've brought back, our village has a real chance to take down the Dorian and Okean before they get to us!
dialogsBegin.th: ด้วยข้อมูลที่คุณนำกลับมา หมู่บ้านของเรามีโอกาสกำจัดพวก Dorian และ Okean ก่อนที่พวกมันจะมาถึงเรา!
dialogsBegin.tw: 有了你帶回來的訊息，我們村莊就有機會在多利安人和奧肯人到達我們面前之前幹掉他們！
dialogsBegin.vi: Với thông tin bạn mang về, làng của chúng tôi có cơ hội thực sự để hạ gục Dorian và Okean trước khi chúng đến chỗ chúng tôi!

dialogsAccept.en: Go ahead and defeat as many Dorian and Okean as you can find, including their leaders! We trust you to take down the leaders, we'll be helping with the smaller ones in the back.
dialogsAccept.ar: Go ahead and defeat as many Dorian and Okean as you can find, including their leaders! We trust you to take down the leaders, we'll be helping with the smaller ones in the back.
dialogsAccept.br: Vá em frente e derrote o máximo de Dorian e Okean que puder encontrar, incluindo seus líderes! Confiamos em você para derrotar os líderes, estaremos ajudando com os menores na retaguarda.
dialogsAccept.cns: 尽管去打败你能找到的所有变异枪鱼和皇冠海妖，包括它们的首领！我们相信你能解决掉那些头领，我们会在后方帮忙清理小怪。
dialogsAccept.de: Mach weiter und besiege so viele Dorian und Okean, wie du finden kannst, einschließlich ihrer Anführer! Wir vertrauen darauf, dass du die Anführer ausschaltest, wir helfen dir bei den kleineren im Hintergrund.
dialogsAccept.fi: Go ahead and defeat as many Dorian and Okean as you can find, including their leaders! We trust you to take down the leaders, we'll be helping with the smaller ones in the back.
dialogsAccept.fil: Go ahead and defeat as many Dorian and Okean as you can find, including their leaders! We trust you to take down the leaders, we'll be helping with the smaller ones in the back.
dialogsAccept.fr: Allez-y et battez autant de Dorian et Okean que vous pouvez trouver, y compris leurs chefs ! Nous vous faisons confiance pour éliminer les chefs, nous aiderons avec les plus petits à l'arrière.
dialogsAccept.id: Silakan dan kalahkan sebanyak mungkin Dorian dan Okean, termasuk pemimpin mereka! Kami percaya akan menjatuhkan para pemimpin, kami akan membantu yang lebih kecil di belakang.
dialogsAccept.it: Go ahead and defeat as many Dorian and Okean as you can find, including their leaders! We trust you to take down the leaders, we'll be helping with the smaller ones in the back.
dialogsAccept.jp: さあ、リーダーを含め、できるだけ多くのドリアンとオキアンを倒してください!リーダーを倒すのは君に任せておけば、後ろの小さなリーダーたちを助けます。
dialogsAccept.kr: 가서 도리언과 오케안을 최대한 많이 처치하세요, 녀석들의 우두머리도 포함해서요! 우두머리는 용사님이 쓰러뜨릴 거라 믿고, 저희는 뒤에서 작은 녀석들을 처치할게요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Go ahead and defeat as many Dorian and Okean as you can find, including their leaders! We trust you to take down the leaders, we'll be helping with the smaller ones in the back.
dialogsAccept.pl: Go ahead and defeat as many Dorian and Okean as you can find, including their leaders! We trust you to take down the leaders, we'll be helping with the smaller ones in the back.
dialogsAccept.ru: Go ahead and defeat as many Dorian and Okean as you can find, including their leaders! We trust you to take down the leaders, we'll be helping with the smaller ones in the back.
dialogsAccept.sp: ¡Adelante, derrota a todos los Dorian y Okean que puedas, incluidos sus líderes! Confiamos en ti para derrotar a los líderes, ayudaremos con los más pequeños en la retaguardia.
dialogsAccept.sw: Go ahead and defeat as many Dorian and Okean as you can find, including their leaders! We trust you to take down the leaders, we'll be helping with the smaller ones in the back.
dialogsAccept.th: ลุยเลยและเอาชนะพวก Dorian และ Okean ให้ได้มากที่สุดเท่าที่จะทำได้ รวมถึงผู้นำของพวกมันด้วย! เราเชื่อว่าคุณจะเอาชนะผู้นำพวกมันได้ และเราจะสนับสนุนอยู่อยู่ด้านหลัง
dialogsAccept.tw: 繼續吧，擊敗更多的多利安和奧肯，包括他們的頭目！我們相信你能打倒頭目，我們會幫助後面的較小的怪物。
dialogsAccept.vi: Hãy tiếp tục và đánh bại càng nhiều Dorian và Okean mà bạn có thể tìm thấy, bao gồm cả thủ lĩnh của họ! Chúng tôi tin tưởng bạn sẽ hạ gục những kẻ dẫn đầu, chúng tôi sẽ giúp đỡ những kẻ nhỏ hơn ở phía sau.

dialogsDecline.th: ถ้าเรารอนานเกินไป พวก Dorian และ Okean จะโจมตีหมู่บ้าน!
dialogsDecline.tw: 如果再拖下去，多利安和歐肯就要攻擊村莊了！
dialogsDecline.vi: Nếu chúng ta đợi quá lâu thì Dorian và Okean sẽ tấn công ngôi làng!

dialogsComplete.en: It's been done, hero. We've defeated the Dorian and Okean, and can now rest easy.
dialogsComplete.ar: It's been done, hero. We've defeated the Dorian and Okean, and can now rest easy.
dialogsComplete.br: Está feito, herói. Derrotamos os Dorian e Okean e agora podemos descansar tranquilos.
dialogsComplete.cns: 搞定了，英雄。我们已经击败了变异枪鱼和皇冠海妖，现在终于可以安心歇息了。
dialogsComplete.de: Es ist vollbracht, Held. Wir haben die Dorian und Okean besiegt und können jetzt beruhigt sein.
dialogsComplete.fi: It's been done, hero. We've defeated the Dorian and Okean, and can now rest easy.
dialogsComplete.fil: It's been done, hero. We've defeated the Dorian and Okean, and can now rest easy.
dialogsComplete.fr: C'est fait, héros. Nous avons vaincu les Dorian et les Okean, et nous pouvons maintenant nous reposer tranquillement.
dialogsComplete.id: Sudah selesai, Pahlawan. Kami telah mengalahkan Dorian dan Okean, dan sekarang bisa tenang.
dialogsComplete.it: It's been done, hero. We've defeated the Dorian and Okean, and can now rest easy.
dialogsComplete.jp: やったぜ、英雄。ドリアンとオキアンを倒したので、安心できます。
dialogsComplete.kr: 해냈어요, 용사님! 도리언과 오케안을 처치했으니, 이제 안심하셔도 돼요.
dialogsComplete.nl: It's been done, hero. We've defeated the Dorian and Okean, and can now rest easy.
dialogsComplete.pl: It's been done, hero. We've defeated the Dorian and Okean, and can now rest easy.
dialogsComplete.ru: It's been done, hero. We've defeated the Dorian and Okean, and can now rest easy.
dialogsComplete.sp: Ya está hecho, héroe. Hemos derrotado a Dorian y Okean y ahora podemos estar tranquilos.
dialogsComplete.sw: It's been done, hero. We've defeated the Dorian and Okean, and can now rest easy.
dialogsComplete.th: สำเร็จแล้วผู้กล้า เราเอาชนะ Dorian และ Okean ได้แล้ว ตอนนี้ก็สามารถพักผ่อนได้อย่างสบายใจแล้ว
dialogsComplete.tw: 已經完成了，英雄。我們已經擊敗了多利安人和奧肯人，現在可以高枕無憂了。
dialogsComplete.vi: Đã xong rồi, anh hùng. Chúng ta đã đánh bại Dorian và Okean và giờ có thể yên tâm rồi.

dialogsFail.en: We're doomed... without your help we will never defeat the Dorian and Okean in time!
dialogsFail.ar: We're doomed... without your help we will never defeat the Dorian and Okean in time!
dialogsFail.br: Estamos condenados... sem a sua ajuda, nunca derrotaremos os Dorian e Okean a tempo!
dialogsFail.cns: 如果没有你的帮助我们就完蛋了…… 我们根本没法及时击败变异枪鱼和皇冠海妖！
dialogsFail.de: Wir sind dem Untergang geweiht. Ohne eure Hilfe werden wir die Dorian und Okean nicht rechtzeitig besiegen!
dialogsFail.fi: We're doomed... without your help we will never defeat the Dorian and Okean in time!
dialogsFail.fil: We're doomed... without your help we will never defeat the Dorian and Okean in time!
dialogsFail.fr: Nous sommes condamnés... sans votre aide, nous ne pourrons jamais vaincre les Dorian et les Okean à temps !
dialogsFail.id: Kami ditakdirkan... tanpa bantuanmu kami tidak akan pernah mengalahkan Dorian dan Okean tepat pada waktunya!
dialogsFail.it: We're doomed... without your help we will never defeat the Dorian and Okean in time!
dialogsFail.jp: 私たちは運命づけられています..あなたの助けがなければ、ドリアンとオケアンを倒すことはできません!
dialogsFail.kr: 망했어요... 용사님의 도움이 없으면 도리언과 오케안을 저지할 수 없을 거예요!
dialogsFail.nl: We're doomed... without your help we will never defeat the Dorian and Okean in time!
dialogsFail.pl: We're doomed... without your help we will never defeat the Dorian and Okean in time!
dialogsFail.ru: We're doomed... without your help we will never defeat the Dorian and Okean in time!
dialogsFail.sp: Estamos condenados... ¡Sin tu ayuda nunca derrotaremos a Dorian y Okean a tiempo!
dialogsFail.sw: We're doomed... without your help we will never defeat the Dorian and Okean in time!
dialogsFail.th: พวกเราถึงคราวล่มสลายแล้ว... ถ้าไม่มีความช่วยเหลือจากคุณ เราจะไม่มีวันเอาชนะ Dorian และ Okeanได้ทันเวลา!
dialogsFail.tw: 我們完了……沒有你的幫助，我們根本來不及擊敗多利安和歐肯！
dialogsFail.vi: Chúng tôi sẽ phải chịu số phận... nếu không có sự giúp đỡ của bạn, chúng tôi sẽ không bao giờ đánh bại được Dorian và Okean kịp thời!

dialogsBegin.en: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.

dialogsBegin.cns: 欢迎回来，英雄！据报告，深渊之塔中出现了新的威胁。请前去找到并消灭 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$

dialogsDecline.en: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.ar: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.br: A Torre está infestada de masquerpets perigosos. Entendo se não quiser correr o risco.
dialogsDecline.cns: 这座塔里到处都是危险的假面怪。如果你不想冒这个险，我完全理解。
dialogsDecline.de: Der Turm ist voller gefährlicher Masquerpets. Ich verstehe es, wenn du das Risiko nicht eingehen willst.
dialogsDecline.fi: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.fil: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.fr: La Tour est remplies de monstres dangereux. Je comprends que tu ne veuilles pas prendre ce risque.

dialogsDecline.it: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.jp: タワーは危険なモンスターでいっぱいです。あなたがリスクを冒したくないのなら、私は理解しています。
dialogsDecline.kr: 탑에는 위험한 마스커펫이 가득해요. 위험을 감수하고 싶지 않다고 하셔도 이해합니다.

dialogsDecline.sw: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsDecline.th: Tower เต็มไปด้วย masquerpets ที่อันตราย ข้าเข้าใจดีถ้าเจ้าไม่อยากเสี่ยงอันตราย
dialogsDecline.tw: 塔內充滿了危險的怪物。如果你不想冒險，我可以理解。
dialogsDecline.vi: Tower chứa đầy masquerpets nguy hiểm. Tôi hiểu bạn không muốn mạo hiểm.

dialogsBegin.en: Lapranche has twisted this once peaceful haven into the distorted Guardiane Sanctuary that you see before you. Your strength has carried you to do deeds that many others would be unable to stomach.
dialogsBegin.ar: Lapranche has twisted this once peaceful haven into the distorted Guardiane Sanctuary that you see before you. Your strength has carried you to do deeds that many others would be unable to stomach.
dialogsBegin.br: Lapranche botou tudo de pernas pro ar nesse paraíso que era o Santuário do Guardião, deixando ele completamente distorcido como você tá vendo agora. Sua força o levou a realizar feitos que muitos outros não seriam capazes de suportar.
dialogsBegin.cns: Lapranche has twisted this once peaceful haven into the distorted Guardiane Sanctuary that you see before you. Your strength has carried you to do deeds that many others would be unable to stomach.
dialogsBegin.de: Lapranche hat diesen einst friedlichen Zufluchtsort in das entstellte Guardiane-Heiligtum verwandelt, das du vor dir siehst. Deine Stärke hat dich zu Taten getrieben, die viele andere nicht verkraften würden.
dialogsBegin.fi: Lapranche has twisted this once peaceful haven into the distorted Guardiane Sanctuary that you see before you. Your strength has carried you to do deeds that many others would be unable to stomach.
dialogsBegin.fil: Lapranche has twisted this once peaceful haven into the distorted Guardiane Sanctuary that you see before you. Your strength has carried you to do deeds that many others would be unable to stomach.
dialogsBegin.fr: Lapranche a corrompu ce havre de paix qu'était le Sanctuaire de Gardiane, maintenant déformé. Votre force vous a permis d'accomplir des actes que beaucoup d'autres n'auraient pas pu supporter.
dialogsBegin.id: Lapranche telah mengubah surga yang dulunya damai ini menjadi Guardiane Sanctuary yang terdistorsi yang Anda lihat di hadapan Anda. Kekuatan Anda telah membawa Anda untuk melakukan perbuatan yang tidak dapat dilakukan oleh banyak orang lain.
dialogsBegin.it: Lapranche has twisted this once peaceful haven into the distorted Guardiane Sanctuary that you see before you. Your strength has carried you to do deeds that many others would be unable to stomach.
dialogsBegin.jp: ラプランシュは、かつて平和だったこの天国を、目の前に見える歪んだガーディアンサンクチュアリにねじ込みました。あなたの力は、他の多くの人々が腹を立てることができないであろう行為をするようにあなたを運びました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 라프란체는 한때 평화로운 안식처였던 이곳을 뒤흔들고 뒤틀린 가르디안의 성소로 바꾸었습니다. 지금 보이시는 것처럼요. 다른 이들은 도저히 할 수 없었던 일을, 당신은 결국 해냈습니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: Lapranche has twisted this once peaceful haven into the distorted Guardiane Sanctuary that you see before you. Your strength has carried you to do deeds that many others would be unable to stomach.
dialogsBegin.pl: Lapranche has twisted this once peaceful haven into the distorted Guardiane Sanctuary that you see before you. Your strength has carried you to do deeds that many others would be unable to stomach.
dialogsBegin.ru: Lapranche has twisted this once peaceful haven into the distorted Guardiane Sanctuary that you see before you. Your strength has carried you to do deeds that many others would be unable to stomach.
dialogsBegin.sp: Lapranche ha transformado este refugio antaño pacífico en el distorsionado Santuario de los Guardianes que ves ante ti. Tu fuerza te ha llevado a cometer actos que muchos otros serían incapaces de soportar.
dialogsBegin.sw: Lapranche has twisted this once peaceful haven into the distorted Guardiane Sanctuary that you see before you. Your strength has carried you to do deeds that many others would be unable to stomach.
dialogsBegin.th: Lapranche ได้ทำให้สวรรค์ที่สงบสุขนี้บิดเบี้ยวและกลายเป็น Guardiane Sanctuary  อย่างที่เจ้าเห็นอยู่ตอนนี้ ความแข็งแกร่งของเจ้าจะพาไปไปทำภาระกิจที่ไม่มีคนมากนักที่จะสามารถจัดการได้
dialogsBegin.tw: 拉普朗什將這個曾經寧靜的避風港扭曲成你眼前這片扭曲的守護者聖域。你的力量使你做出了許多其他人無法忍受的事情。
dialogsBegin.vi: Lapranche đã biến nơi trú ẩn yên bình một thời này thành distorted Guardiane Sanctuary mà bạn thấy trước mắt. Sức mạnh của bạn đã đưa bạn làm những việc mà nhiều người khác không thể chịu nổi.

dialogsBegin.en: With great honor, you have put to rest those cursed by the power of the Purple Magician. In eternal rest, Shade's curse can no longer harm them.
dialogsBegin.ar: With great honor, you have put to rest those cursed by the power of the Purple Magician. In eternal rest, Shade's curse can no longer harm them.
dialogsBegin.br: Com grande honra, você pôs para descansar aqueles amaldiçoados pelo poder da Maga Púrpura. Em descanso eterno, a maldição de Shade não pode mais prejudicá-los.
dialogsBegin.cns: With great honor, you have put to rest those cursed by the power of the Purple Magician. In eternal rest, Shade's curse can no longer harm them.
dialogsBegin.de: Mit großer Ehre hast du die von der Macht des lila Magiers Verfluchten zur Ruhe gebracht. In ewiger Ruhe kann ihnen der Fluch des Schattens nichts mehr anhaben.
dialogsBegin.fi: With great honor, you have put to rest those cursed by the power of the Purple Magician. In eternal rest, Shade's curse can no longer harm them.
dialogsBegin.fil: With great honor, you have put to rest those cursed by the power of the Purple Magician. In eternal rest, Shade's curse can no longer harm them.
dialogsBegin.fr: Avec beaucoup d'honneur, vous avez mis au repos ceux qui ont été maudits par le pouvoir de la Magicienne Pourpre. Dans un repos éternel, la malédiction de Shade ne pourra plus leur nuire.
dialogsBegin.id: Dengan kehormatan besar, Anda telah mengistirahatkan mereka yang dikutuk oleh kekuatan Purple Magician. Dalam peristirahatan abadi, kutukan Shade tidak bisa lagi menyakiti mereka.
dialogsBegin.it: With great honor, you have put to rest those cursed by the power of the Purple Magician. In eternal rest, Shade's curse can no longer harm them.
dialogsBegin.jp: 大きな名誉をもって、あなたは紫の魔術師の力によって呪われた人々を休ませました。永遠の休息では、シェイドの呪いはもはや彼らを傷つけることはできません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 정말 감사하게도, 당신이 퍼플 매지션의 강력한 저주를 받았던 이들이 쉴 수 있도록 도와주셨습니다. 영원한 안식처에서는, 쉐이드의 저주도 더는 해를 끼칠 수 없겠지요.
dialogsBegin.nl: With great honor, you have put to rest those cursed by the power of the Purple Magician. In eternal rest, Shade's curse can no longer harm them.
dialogsBegin.pl: With great honor, you have put to rest those cursed by the power of the Purple Magician. In eternal rest, Shade's curse can no longer harm them.
dialogsBegin.ru: With great honor, you have put to rest those cursed by the power of the Purple Magician. In eternal rest, Shade's curse can no longer harm them.
dialogsBegin.sp: Con gran honor, has puesto a descansar a los maldecidos por el poder del Mago Púrpura. En descanso eterno, la maldición de Shade ya no puede dañarlos.
dialogsBegin.sw: With great honor, you have put to rest those cursed by the power of the Purple Magician. In eternal rest, Shade's curse can no longer harm them.
dialogsBegin.th: เป็นเกียรติอย่างสูง เจ้าได้ทำให้คำสาบของ Purple Magician หายไป และในการพักผ่อาชัวนิรันด์นี้ คำสาปของ Shade ก็ไม่สามารถทำอะไรพวกเขาได้แล้ว
dialogsBegin.tw: 你以無上的榮耀，讓那些因紫色魔法師之力而被詛咒的人們得到解脫。如今在永恆的長眠之中，闇影的詛咒再也無法傷害他們。
dialogsBegin.vi: Với niềm vinh dự to lớn, bạn đã khiến những kẻ bị nguyền rủa bởi sức mạnh của Purple Magician yên nghỉ. Trong phần còn lại vĩnh cửu, lời nguyền của Shade không còn có thể làm hại họ.

dialogsBegin.en: Within the walls of the Guardiane Sanctuary, there was one guardian that acted as the last defense against evil that dared to approach. In hundreds of years of service, the Pyramid Guardian never faced defeat... until now.
dialogsBegin.ar: Within the walls of the Guardiane Sanctuary, there was one guardian that acted as the last defense against evil that dared to approach. In hundreds of years of service, the Pyramid Guardian never faced defeat... until now.
dialogsBegin.br: Dentro das muralhas do Santuário do Guardião, havia um guardião que era a última linha de defesa contra as forças malignas que tentassem se aproximar. Em centenas de anos de serviço, o Guardião da Pirâmide nunca foi derrotado... até agora.
dialogsBegin.cns: Within the walls of the Guardiane Sanctuary, there was one guardian that acted as the last defense against evil that dared to approach. In hundreds of years of service, the Pyramid Guardian never faced defeat... until now.
dialogsBegin.de: Innerhalb der Mauern des Guardiane-Heiligtums gab es einen Wächter, der als letzte Verteidigung gegen das Böse fungierte, das sich zu nähern wagte. In Hunderten von Dienstjahren musste der Pyramidenwächter nie eine Niederlage hinnehmen... bis jetzt.
dialogsBegin.fi: Within the walls of the Guardiane Sanctuary, there was one guardian that acted as the last defense against evil that dared to approach. In hundreds of years of service, the Pyramid Guardian never faced defeat... until now.
dialogsBegin.fil: Within the walls of the Guardiane Sanctuary, there was one guardian that acted as the last defense against evil that dared to approach. In hundreds of years of service, the Pyramid Guardian never faced defeat... until now.
dialogsBegin.fr: A l'intérieur des murs du Sanctuaire de Guardiane, il y avait un gardien qui agissait en tant que dernier rideau de défense contre le mal qui oserait s'en approcher. En cent ans de loyaux services, le Protecteur de la Pyramide n'a jamais été vaincu... Jusqu'à aujourd'hui.
dialogsBegin.id: Di dalam dinding Guardiane Sanctuary, ada satu penjaga yang bertindak sebagai pertahanan terakhir melawan kejahatan yang berani mendekat. Selama ratusan tahun mengabdi, Pyramid Guardian tidak pernah menghadapi kekalahan.. sampai sekarang.
dialogsBegin.it: Within the walls of the Guardiane Sanctuary, there was one guardian that acted as the last defense against evil that dared to approach. In hundreds of years of service, the Pyramid Guardian never faced defeat... until now.
dialogsBegin.jp: ガーディアンサンクチュアリの壁の中には、あえて近づこうとする悪に対する最後の防御として機能する1人のガーディアンがいました。何百年もの奉仕の中で、ピラミッドガーディアンは決して敗北に直面しませんでした。これまでは。
dialogsBegin.kr: 가르디안 성소 안에는, 다가오는 악에 맞서 끝까지 가르디안을 지킨 한 명의 수호자가 있었습니다. 수백 년의 세월 동안, 피라미드 수호자는 단 한 번도 패배한 적이 없었죠... 지금까지는요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Within the walls of the Guardiane Sanctuary, there was one guardian that acted as the last defense against evil that dared to approach. In hundreds of years of service, the Pyramid Guardian never faced defeat... until now.
dialogsBegin.pl: Within the walls of the Guardiane Sanctuary, there was one guardian that acted as the last defense against evil that dared to approach. In hundreds of years of service, the Pyramid Guardian never faced defeat... until now.
dialogsBegin.ru: Within the walls of the Guardiane Sanctuary, there was one guardian that acted as the last defense against evil that dared to approach. In hundreds of years of service, the Pyramid Guardian never faced defeat... until now.
dialogsBegin.sp: Dentro de los muros del Santuario Guardiano, había un guardián que actuaba como última defensa contra el mal que osaba acercarse. En cientos de años de servicio, el Guardián de la Pirámide nunca fué derrotado... hasta ahora.
dialogsBegin.sw: Within the walls of the Guardiane Sanctuary, there was one guardian that acted as the last defense against evil that dared to approach. In hundreds of years of service, the Pyramid Guardian never faced defeat... until now.
dialogsBegin.th: ภายในกำแพงของ Guardiane Sanctuary มี guardian อยู่ตัวนึงซึ่งเป็นปราการด่านสุดท้ายต่อปีศาจที่กล้าเข้าใกล้ ในเวลาร้อยปีของหน้าที่ Pyramid Guardian ไม่เคยแพ้เลยซักครั้ง กระทั่งจนถึงตอนนี้
dialogsBegin.tw: 在守護者聖域的城牆之中，曾有一位守護者作為對抗邪惡最後防線。數百年來，金字塔守護者從未敗北……直到如今。
dialogsBegin.vi: Ẩn sâu trong các bức tường của Guardiane Sanctuary, có một người lính canh gác đóng vai trò là hàng rào bảo vệ cuối cùng chống lại các thế lực xấu xa dám tiếp cận. Trong hàng trăm năm phục vụ, Pyramid Guardian chưa bao giờ nếm mùi thất bại.. cho đến tận bây giờ.

dialogsBegin.en: The last bastion of Guardiane stands within the deformed heart before you. Its tattered muscles move to protect the twisted realm, though no life remains behind its eyes.
dialogsBegin.ar: The last bastion of Guardiane stands within the deformed heart before you. Its tattered muscles move to protect the twisted realm, though no life remains behind its eyes.
dialogsBegin.br: O último bastião de Guardiane permanece no coração deformado diante de você. Seus músculos desgastados se movem para proteger o reino distorcido, mesmo sem vida brilhando em seus olhos.
dialogsBegin.cns: The last bastion of Guardiane stands within the deformed heart before you. Its tattered muscles move to protect the twisted realm, though no life remains behind its eyes.
dialogsBegin.de: Die letzte Bastion der Guardiane steht in dem deformierten Herzen vor dir. Seine zerfledderten Muskeln bewegen sich, um das verdrehte Reich zu schützen, obwohl hinter seinen Augen kein Leben mehr ist.
dialogsBegin.fi: The last bastion of Guardiane stands within the deformed heart before you. Its tattered muscles move to protect the twisted realm, though no life remains behind its eyes.
dialogsBegin.fil: The last bastion of Guardiane stands within the deformed heart before you. Its tattered muscles move to protect the twisted realm, though no life remains behind its eyes.
dialogsBegin.fr: Le dernier bastion de Gardiane se trouve à l'intérieur du cœur déformé devant vous. Ses muscles en lambeaux s'agitent pour protéger le royaume tordu, bien qu'aucune vie ne subsiste derrière ses yeux.
dialogsBegin.id: Benteng terakhir Guardiane berdiri di dalam hati yang cacat di hadapan Anda. Otot-ototnya yang compang-camping bergerak untuk melindungi dunia yang terpelintir, meskipun tidak ada kehidupan yang tertinggal di belakang matanya.
dialogsBegin.it: The last bastion of Guardiane stands within the deformed heart before you. Its tattered muscles move to protect the twisted realm, though no life remains behind its eyes.
dialogsBegin.jp: ガーディアンの最後の砦は、あなたの目の前の変形した心の中に立っています。そのボロボロの筋肉は、ねじれた領域を保護するために動きますが、目の後ろに生命は残っていません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 가르디안의 마지막 수호자가 그 뒤틀린 심장 안에 남아 있습니다. 너덜너덜한 근육은 아직도 뒤틀린 왕국을 지키려고 움직이지만, 그 눈은 이미 생기를 모두 잃었죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: The last bastion of Guardiane stands within the deformed heart before you. Its tattered muscles move to protect the twisted realm, though no life remains behind its eyes.
dialogsBegin.pl: The last bastion of Guardiane stands within the deformed heart before you. Its tattered muscles move to protect the twisted realm, though no life remains behind its eyes.
dialogsBegin.ru: The last bastion of Guardiane stands within the deformed heart before you. Its tattered muscles move to protect the twisted realm, though no life remains behind its eyes.
dialogsBegin.sp: El último bastión de Guardiane se alza en el corazón deformado que tienes ante ti. Sus músculos destrozados se mueven para proteger el reino retorcido, aunque no queda vida tras sus ojos.
dialogsBegin.sw: The last bastion of Guardiane stands within the deformed heart before you. Its tattered muscles move to protect the twisted realm, though no life remains behind its eyes.
dialogsBegin.th: ปราการสุดท้ายของ Guardiane ได้มายืนต่อหน้าคุณด้วยหัวใจที่ไม่สมประกอบ กล้ามเนื้อที่ขาดวิ่นของมันเคลื่อนไหวเพื่อปกป้องดินแดนที่บิดเบี้ยวแห่งนี้ และดวงตานั้นก็ไม่มีชีวิตหลงเหลืออยุ่เลย
dialogsBegin.tw: 守護者聖域最後的堡壘，就矗立在你眼前那顆扭曲之心中。它殘破的肌肉依舊在活動，守護著這個畸形的領域，雖然那雙眼裡早已沒有生命。
dialogsBegin.vi: Pháo đài cuối cùng của Guardiane nằm trong trái tim biến dạng trước mặt bạn. Những cơ bắp rách nát của nó di chuyển để bảo vệ vương quốc vặn vẹo, mặc dù không còn sự sống nào sau đôi mắt của nó.

dialogsAccept.en: This barbaric curse sickens me... Put the Pyramid Guardian to rest, then report back to Laola.
dialogsAccept.ar: This barbaric curse sickens me... Put the Pyramid Guardian to rest, then report back to Laola.
dialogsAccept.br: Essa maldição bárbara me dá nos nervos... Coloque o Guardião da Pirâmide para descansar em paz e depois informe a Laola.
dialogsAccept.cns: This barbaric curse sickens me... Put the Pyramid Guardian to rest, then report back to Laola.
dialogsAccept.de: Dieser barbarische Fluch macht mich krank... Bring den Pyramidenwächter zur Ruhe und melde dich dann bei Laola.
dialogsAccept.fi: This barbaric curse sickens me... Put the Pyramid Guardian to rest, then report back to Laola.
dialogsAccept.fil: This barbaric curse sickens me... Put the Pyramid Guardian to rest, then report back to Laola.
dialogsAccept.fr: Cette malédiction barbare me rend malade... Faites reposer le Gardien de la Pyramide en paix et allez faire votre rapport à Laola.
dialogsAccept.id: Kutukan biadab ini membuatku muak.. Istirahatkan Pyramid Guardian, lalu laporkan kembali ke Laola.
dialogsAccept.it: This barbaric curse sickens me... Put the Pyramid Guardian to rest, then report back to Laola.
dialogsAccept.jp: この野蛮な呪いは私をうんざりさせます..ピラミッドガーディアンを休ませてから、ラオラに報告してください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 얼마나 야만적인 저주인지... 피라미드 수호자를 영면에 잠들게 도와준 다음, 라올라에게 알려주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: This barbaric curse sickens me... Put the Pyramid Guardian to rest, then report back to Laola.
dialogsAccept.pl: This barbaric curse sickens me... Put the Pyramid Guardian to rest, then report back to Laola.
dialogsAccept.ru: This barbaric curse sickens me... Put the Pyramid Guardian to rest, then report back to Laola.
dialogsAccept.sp: Esta bárbara maldición me enferma.. Pon a descansar al Guardián de la Pirámide, luego informa a Laola.
dialogsAccept.sw: This barbaric curse sickens me... Put the Pyramid Guardian to rest, then report back to Laola.
dialogsAccept.th: คำสาปที่ป่าเถื่อนนี้มันทำให้รู้สึกแย่ ให้ Pyramid Guardian ได้พักผ่อนซะทีเถอะ เสร็จแล้วกลับไปรายงานกับ Laola ด้วย
dialogsAccept.tw: 這野蠻的詛咒讓我作嘔……讓金字塔守護者安息吧，之後再向拉宇回報。
dialogsAccept.vi: Lời nguyền man rợ này khiến tôi ghê tởm.. Hãy để Pyramid Guardian yên nghỉ, sau đó báo cáo lại cho Laola.

dialogsDecline.en: For all but the Purple Magician... little hope may remain for those who enter into a battle with such a powerful warrior.
dialogsDecline.ar: For all but the Purple Magician... little hope may remain for those who enter into a battle with such a powerful warrior.
dialogsDecline.br: Para todos, exceto a Maga Púrpura... a esperança é mínima para aqueles que enfrentam um guerreiro tão poderoso.
dialogsDecline.cns: For all but the Purple Magician... little hope may remain for those who enter into a battle with such a powerful warrior.
dialogsDecline.de: Für alle außer dem lila Magier... bleibt wenig Hoffnung für diejenigen, die sich in einen Kampf mit einem so mächtigen Krieger begeben.
dialogsDecline.fi: For all but the Purple Magician... little hope may remain for those who enter into a battle with such a powerful warrior.
dialogsDecline.fil: For all but the Purple Magician... little hope may remain for those who enter into a battle with such a powerful warrior.
dialogsDecline.fr: Courage ! Du courage il en faut, malgré le mince espoir pour ceux qui entre en combat contre un guerrier si puissant.
dialogsDecline.id: Untuk semua kecuali Purple Magician.. sedikit harapan yang tersisa bagi mereka yang memasuki pertempuran dengan pejuang yang begitu kuat.
dialogsDecline.it: For all but the Purple Magician... little hope may remain for those who enter into a battle with such a powerful warrior.
dialogsDecline.jp: 紫の魔術師を除くすべてのために..そのような強力な戦士との戦いに入る人々にはほとんど希望が残っていないかもしれません。
dialogsDecline.kr: 퍼플 매지션을 제외한 다른 이들은... 그토록 강력한 전사와 싸워야 하는 이들에겐 별로 희망이 없어요.
dialogsDecline.nl: For all but the Purple Magician... little hope may remain for those who enter into a battle with such a powerful warrior.
dialogsDecline.pl: For all but the Purple Magician... little hope may remain for those who enter into a battle with such a powerful warrior.
dialogsDecline.ru: For all but the Purple Magician... little hope may remain for those who enter into a battle with such a powerful warrior.
dialogsDecline.sp: Para todos menos para el Mago Púrpura... poca esperanza puede quedar para aquellos que entren en batalla con un guerrero tan poderoso.
dialogsDecline.sw: For all but the Purple Magician... little hope may remain for those who enter into a battle with such a powerful warrior.
dialogsDecline.th: สำหรับทุกคนนอกจาก Purple Magician อาจจะมีความหวังอยู่บ้างถ้าเข้าต่อสู้พร้อมกับนักรบที่แข็งแกร่ง
dialogsDecline.tw: 除了紫色魔法師本人之外……幾乎沒有人能在與這般強大的戰士交戰後還保有太多希望。
dialogsDecline.vi: Ai cũng được nhưng Purple Magician thì.. có thể chẳng còn bao nhiêu hy vọng cho những người đối đầu với một chiến binh hùng mạnh như vậy.

dialogsComplete.en: So it is done... thank you for laying to rest those cursed by the Purple Magician. It's selfish, but I truly do not wish harm upon Lapranche, only for her to be free from Shade's curse...
dialogsComplete.ar: So it is done... thank you for laying to rest those cursed by the Purple Magician. It's selfish, but I truly do not wish harm upon Lapranche, only for her to be free from Shade's curse...
dialogsComplete.br: Missão cumprida.. valeu por mandar esses amaldiçoados da Maga Púrpura pro descanso eterno. Olha, pode ser egoísta, mas eu realmente não quero mal pra Lapranche, só desejo que ela consiga se libertar da maldição de Shade e seguir seu caminho em paz..
dialogsComplete.cns: So it is done... thank you for laying to rest those cursed by the Purple Magician. It's selfish, but I truly do not wish harm upon Lapranche, only for her to be free from Shade's curse...
dialogsComplete.de: Es ist also vollbracht. Danke, dass du die vom lila Magier Verfluchten zur Ruhe gebracht hast. Es ist egoistisch, aber ich wünsche Lapranche nichts Böses, sondern nur, dass sie von dem Fluch des Schattens befreit wird.
dialogsComplete.fi: So it is done... thank you for laying to rest those cursed by the Purple Magician. It's selfish, but I truly do not wish harm upon Lapranche, only for her to be free from Shade's curse...
dialogsComplete.fil: So it is done... thank you for laying to rest those cursed by the Purple Magician. It's selfish, but I truly do not wish harm upon Lapranche, only for her to be free from Shade's curse...
dialogsComplete.fr: C'est donc fait... merci d'avoir aidé à faire en sorte que ceux qui ont été maudits par la Magicienne Pourpre puissent maintenant reposer en paix. C'est égoïste, mais je ne souhaite vraiment pas de mal à Lapranche, seulement qu'elle soit libérée de la malédiction de Shade.
dialogsComplete.id: Selesai sudah.. terima kasih telah mengistirahatkan mereka yang dikutuk oleh Purple Magician. Itu egois, tapi aku benar-benar tidak ingin menyakiti Lapranche, hanya agar dia bebas dari kutukan Shade..
dialogsComplete.it: So it is done... thank you for laying to rest those cursed by the Purple Magician. It's selfish, but I truly do not wish harm upon Lapranche, only for her to be free from Shade's curse...
dialogsComplete.jp: だからそれは行われます..紫の魔術師に呪われた人々を休ませてくれてありがとう。わがままですが、私は本当にラプランシュに危害を加えることを望んでいません、彼女がシェイドの呪いから解放されることだけを望んでいます..。
dialogsComplete.kr: 마침내 끝났군요...퍼플 매지션의 저주에 걸린 이들이 쉴 수 있게 도와줘서 고마워요. 이기적인 생각이지만, 라프란체에게 해를 입히고 싶지 않아요. 라프란체가 쉐이드의 저주에서 벗어나길 바랄 뿐...
dialogsComplete.nl: So it is done... thank you for laying to rest those cursed by the Purple Magician. It's selfish, but I truly do not wish harm upon Lapranche, only for her to be free from Shade's curse...
dialogsComplete.pl: So it is done... thank you for laying to rest those cursed by the Purple Magician. It's selfish, but I truly do not wish harm upon Lapranche, only for her to be free from Shade's curse...
dialogsComplete.ru: So it is done... thank you for laying to rest those cursed by the Purple Magician. It's selfish, but I truly do not wish harm upon Lapranche, only for her to be free from Shade's curse...
dialogsComplete.sp: Así está hecho... Gracias por hacer descansar a los maldecidos por el Mago Púrpura. Es egoísta, pero realmente no deseo daño a Lapranche, sólo que esté libre de la maldición de Shade...
dialogsComplete.sw: So it is done... thank you for laying to rest those cursed by the Purple Magician. It's selfish, but I truly do not wish harm upon Lapranche, only for her to be free from Shade's curse...
dialogsComplete.th: มันจบแล้วสินะ ขอบคุณเจ้ามากที่ช่วยให้ผู้ที่โดนคำสาปจาก Purple Magician พวกนี้ได้พักซักที อาจจะดูเห็นแก่ตัวไปหน่อย แต่ข้าไม่อยากจะทำร้าย Lapranche เลย ข้าแค่อยากจะให้หล่อนได้หลุดพ้นจากคำสาปของ Shade
dialogsComplete.tw: 事情終於結束了……謝謝你讓那些遭紫色魔法師詛咒的人獲得安息。雖然很自私，但我其實並不希望拉普蘭雪受到傷害，我只希望她能從闇影的詛咒中解脫……
dialogsComplete.vi: Vậy là xong.. cảm ơn bạn đã giúp những người bị nguyền rủa bởi Lam Thuật sư được yên nghỉ. Thật ích kỷ, nhưng tôi thực sự không muốn làm hại Lapranche, tôi chỉ muốn cô ấy thoát khỏi lời nguyền của Shade...

dialogsComplete.en: I intend to find a way to stop Lapranche without destroying her entirely... but in the end, we have no choice but to stop her now.
dialogsComplete.ar: I intend to find a way to stop Lapranche without destroying her entirely... but in the end, we have no choice but to stop her now.
dialogsComplete.br: Eu estou determinado a encontrar um jeito de parar Lapranche sem destruí-la por completo.. mas, no fim das contas, não temos outra opção além de detê-la agora mesmo.
dialogsComplete.cns: I intend to find a way to stop Lapranche without destroying her entirely... but in the end, we have no choice but to stop her now.
dialogsComplete.de: Ich beabsichtige, einen Weg zu finden, Lapranche aufzuhalten, ohne sie völlig zu zerstören... aber letztendlich haben wir keine andere Wahl, als sie jetzt aufzuhalten.
dialogsComplete.fi: I intend to find a way to stop Lapranche without destroying her entirely... but in the end, we have no choice but to stop her now.
dialogsComplete.fil: I intend to find a way to stop Lapranche without destroying her entirely... but in the end, we have no choice but to stop her now.
dialogsComplete.fr: J'ai l'intention de trouver un moyen d'arrêter Lapranche sans la détruire complètement... Mais au final, nous n'avons aucun autre choix que de l'arrêter maintenant.
dialogsComplete.id: Aku bermaksud untuk menemukan cara untuk menghentikan Lapranche tanpa menghancurkannya sepenuhnya.. tetapi pada akhirnya, kami tidak punya pilihan selain menghentikannya sekarang.
dialogsComplete.it: I intend to find a way to stop Lapranche without destroying her entirely... but in the end, we have no choice but to stop her now.
dialogsComplete.jp: 私は彼女を完全に破壊することなくラプランシェを止める方法を見つけるつもりです..しかし、結局、私たちは今彼女を止めるしかありません。
dialogsComplete.kr: 라프란체를 완전히 부수지 않고도 막을 방법을 찾고 싶지만... 지금으로서는 우선 막는 것에만 집중해야겠네요.
dialogsComplete.nl: I intend to find a way to stop Lapranche without destroying her entirely... but in the end, we have no choice but to stop her now.
dialogsComplete.pl: I intend to find a way to stop Lapranche without destroying her entirely... but in the end, we have no choice but to stop her now.
dialogsComplete.ru: I intend to find a way to stop Lapranche without destroying her entirely... but in the end, we have no choice but to stop her now.
dialogsComplete.sp: Tengo la intención de encontrar una manera de detener a Lapranche sin destruirla.. pero al final, no tenemos más remedio que detenerla ahora.
dialogsComplete.sw: I intend to find a way to stop Lapranche without destroying her entirely... but in the end, we have no choice but to stop her now.
dialogsComplete.th: ข้าตั้งใจจะหาวิธีที่จะหยุด Lapranche โดยที่ไม่ต้องทำลายเธอ แต่สุดท้ายมันก็ไม่มีทางเลือก เราต้องหยุดเธอเดียวนี้
dialogsComplete.tw: 我打算尋找一個不必徹底毀滅拉普蘭雪，也能阻止她的方法……但無論如何，我們現在都必須先阻止她。
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi định tìm cách ngăn Lapranche lại mà không tiêu diệt cô ấy hoàn toàn.. nhưng cuối cùng, chúng tôi không còn lựa chọn nào khác ngoài việc ngăn chặn cô ấy ngay bây giờ.

dialogsComplete.en: Guardiane needs time to heal, but soon we will speak again about the plan at hand. The army of Madrigal will rise again to defeat Shade and her puppet Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.ar: Guardiane needs time to heal, but soon we will speak again about the plan at hand. The army of Madrigal will rise again to defeat Shade and her puppet Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.br: Guardiane precisa de um tempo pra se recuperar, mas logo voltaremos a discutir o plano. O exército de Madrigal vai ressurgir das cinzas pra detonar Shade e seu fantoche Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.cns: Guardiane needs time to heal, but soon we will speak again about the plan at hand. The army of Madrigal will rise again to defeat Shade and her puppet Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.de: Guardiane braucht Zeit, um sich zu erholen, aber wir werden bald wieder über den Plan sprechen, den wir verfolgen. Die Armee von Madrigal wird sich wieder erheben, um Shade und ihre Marionette Lapranche zu besiegen.
dialogsComplete.fi: Guardiane needs time to heal, but soon we will speak again about the plan at hand. The army of Madrigal will rise again to defeat Shade and her puppet Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.fil: Guardiane needs time to heal, but soon we will speak again about the plan at hand. The army of Madrigal will rise again to defeat Shade and her puppet Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.fr: Gardiane aura besoin de temps pour panser ses blessures, mais bientôt nous reparlerons du projet en cours. L'Armée de Madrigal renaîtra à nouveau pour vaincre Shade et sa marionnette Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.id: Guardiane butuh waktu untuk sembuh, tapi sebentar lagi kita akan bicara lagi tentang rencana yang ada. Pasukan Madrigal akan bangkit kembali untuk mengalahkan Shade dan bonekanya Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.it: Guardiane needs time to heal, but soon we will speak again about the plan at hand. The army of Madrigal will rise again to defeat Shade and her puppet Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.jp: ガーディアンが癒すのに時間が必要ですが、すぐに目前の計画についてもう一度話します。マドリガルの軍隊は、シェイドと彼女の傀儡ラプランシュを倒すために再び立ち上がるでしょう。
dialogsComplete.kr: 가르디안은 회복할 시간이 필요하지만, 곧 앞으로의 계획에 관해 다시 이야기하게 될 겁니다. 마드리갈의 군대가 다시 일어나, 쉐이드와 그 수하인 라프란체를 처치할 겁니다.
dialogsComplete.nl: Guardiane needs time to heal, but soon we will speak again about the plan at hand. The army of Madrigal will rise again to defeat Shade and her puppet Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.pl: Guardiane needs time to heal, but soon we will speak again about the plan at hand. The army of Madrigal will rise again to defeat Shade and her puppet Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.ru: Guardiane needs time to heal, but soon we will speak again about the plan at hand. The army of Madrigal will rise again to defeat Shade and her puppet Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.sp: Guardiane necesita tiempo para curarse, pero pronto volveremos a hablar del plan que tenemos entre manos. El ejército de Madrigal se alzará de nuevo para derrotar a Shade y a su marioneta Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.sw: Guardiane needs time to heal, but soon we will speak again about the plan at hand. The army of Madrigal will rise again to defeat Shade and her puppet Lapranche.
dialogsComplete.th: Guardiane ต้องการเวลาที่จะรักษา แต่เราจะพูดเรื่องแผนนั้นกันอีกครั้ง กองกำลังแห่ง Madrigal จะกลับมาอีกครั้งและจัดการ shade และก็พวกหุ่นเชิดของ Lapranche
dialogsComplete.tw: 守護者祭壇需要時間來療傷，但很快我們將再次討論手頭的計劃。瑪德利賈的軍隊將再次崛起，以擊敗闇影和她的傀儡拉普朗什。
dialogsComplete.vi: Guardiane cần thời gian để hồi phục, nhưng chúng ta sẽ sớm nói lại về kế hoạch sắp tới. Đội quân của Madrigal sẽ trỗi dậy một lần nữa để đánh bại Shade và con rối Lapranche của cô ta.

dialogsFail.ru: Seek out what remains of the Pyramid Guardian, and put it to rest.
dialogsFail.sp: Busca lo que queda del Guardián de la Pirámide y ponlo a descansar.

dialogsFail.th: คนหาว่ามีอะไรที่หลงเหลือจาก Pyramid Guardian แล้วก็จัดการให้พวกมันได้พักผ่อนซะ
dialogsFail.tw: 去找出金字塔守護者殘存的身軀，讓它安息。
dialogsFail.vi: Tìm kiếm những gì còn sót lại của Pyramid Guardian và đặt nó yên nghỉ.

dialogsBegin.en: Do you really think you’re the strongest? You’re wrong. You can be stronger! Listen... What if I told you that you could... relive certain moments of your life? It would be crazy, wouldn’t it?
dialogsBegin.ar: Do you really think you’re the strongest? You’re wrong. You can be stronger! Listen... What if I told you that you could... relive certain moments of your life? It would be crazy, wouldn’t it?
dialogsBegin.br: Você realmente acha que é o mais forte? Você está errado. Você pode ser mais forte! Escute... E se eu dissesse que você poderia reviver certos momentos de sua vida? Seria loucura, não seria?
dialogsBegin.cns: 你真觉得自己已经是最强的了？大错特错。你还能变得更强！你听我说…… 假如我告诉你，你可以…… 重温生命中的某些时刻呢？这听起来很疯狂，对吧？
dialogsBegin.de: Glaubst du wirklich, dass du der Stärkste bist? Du irrst dich. Du kannst stärker sein! Hör zu... Was wäre, wenn ich dir sagen würde, dass du bestimmte Momente deines Lebens noch einmal erleben könntest? Das wäre doch verrückt, oder?
dialogsBegin.fi: Do you really think you’re the strongest? You’re wrong. You can be stronger! Listen... What if I told you that you could... relive certain moments of your life? It would be crazy, wouldn’t it?
dialogsBegin.fil: Do you really think you’re the strongest? You’re wrong. You can be stronger! Listen... What if I told you that you could... relive certain moments of your life? It would be crazy, wouldn’t it?
dialogsBegin.fr: Penses-tu vraiment être le plus fort ? C'est faux. Tu peux devenir plus fort ! Écoute... Que dirais-tu si je te disais que tu pouvais... revivre certains moments de ta vie ? Ça serait fou, n'est-ce pas ?
dialogsBegin.id: Apakah Anda benar-benar berpikir Anda yang terkuat? Anda salah. Anda bisa menjadi lebih kuat! Dengar... Bagaimana jika aku memberitahumu bahwa kamu bisa... menghidupkan kembali momen-momen tertentu dalam hidupmu? Itu akan gila, bukan?
dialogsBegin.it: Do you really think you’re the strongest? You’re wrong. You can be stronger! Listen... What if I told you that you could... relive certain moments of your life? It would be crazy, wouldn’t it?
dialogsBegin.jp: あなたは本当にあなたが最強だと思いますか?あなたは間違っている。あなたは強くなることができます!聞く。。。私があなたにできると言ったらどうしますか...あなたの人生の特定の瞬間を追体験しますか?それはクレイジーでしょうね。
dialogsBegin.kr: 정말 자신이 가장 강하다고 생각하시나요? 틀렸어요. 지금보다 더 강해질 수 있어요! 생각해 보세요... 만약 삶의 어떤 순간을 다시 살아볼 수 있다면 어떨까요? 정말 믿기지 않는 일이겠죠?
dialogsBegin.nl: Do you really think you’re the strongest? You’re wrong. You can be stronger! Listen... What if I told you that you could... relive certain moments of your life? It would be crazy, wouldn’t it?
dialogsBegin.pl: Do you really think you’re the strongest? You’re wrong. You can be stronger! Listen... What if I told you that you could... relive certain moments of your life? It would be crazy, wouldn’t it?
dialogsBegin.ru: Do you really think you’re the strongest? You’re wrong. You can be stronger! Listen... What if I told you that you could... relive certain moments of your life? It would be crazy, wouldn’t it?
dialogsBegin.sp: ¿De verdad crees que eres el más fuerte? Te equivocas. ¡Puedes ser más fuerte! Escucha... ¿Y si te dijera que puedes... revivir ciertos momentos de tu vida? Sería una locura, ¿no?
dialogsBegin.sw: Do you really think you’re the strongest? You’re wrong. You can be stronger! Listen... What if I told you that you could... relive certain moments of your life? It would be crazy, wouldn’t it?
dialogsBegin.th: เจ้าคิดว่าเจ้าแข็งแกร่งที่สุดแล้วงั้นหรือ? เจ้าผิดแล้วล่ะ เจ้ายังแข็งแกร่งกว่านี้ได้อีก! ฟังนะ... เจ้าจะว่ายังไงถ้าฉันจะบอกว่าเจ้าสามารถ ระลึกถึงบางช่วงของชีวิตได้น่ะ? มันคงบ้าน่าดูเลยนะ ใช่ไหมล่ะ?
dialogsBegin.tw: 你真的認為你是最強的嗎？你錯了。你可以變得更強！聽著……如果我告訴你你可以……重溫你生命中的某些時刻呢？這會很瘋狂，不是嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn có thực sự nghĩ rằng bạn là người mạnh nhất? Bạn sai rồi. Bạn có thể mạnh mẽ hơn! Nghe này... Điều gì sẽ xảy ra nếu tôi nói với bạn rằng bạn có thể... hồi tưởng lại những khoảnh khắc nhất định trong cuộc đời mình? Nó sẽ là điên, phải không?

dialogsBegin.en: I have a proposal for you. I take a few levels from you, of course temporarily, and you will accomplish a task for me. What do you have to gain? Everything!
dialogsBegin.ar: I have a proposal for you. I take a few levels from you, of course temporarily, and you will accomplish a task for me. What do you have to gain? Everything!
dialogsBegin.br: Eu tenho uma proposta para você. Eu pego alguns níveis de você, é claro que temporariamente, e você realizará uma tarefa para mim. O que você tem a ganhar? Tudo!
dialogsBegin.cns: 我有个建议。我从你那里扣掉一些等级，当然只是暂时的，然后你为我完成一项任务。你能获得什么好处？应有尽有!
dialogsBegin.de: Ich habe einen Vorschlag für dich. Ich nehme dir ein paar Level ab, natürlich nur vorübergehend, und du erledigst eine Aufgabe für mich. Was hast du zu gewinnen? Alles!
dialogsBegin.fi: I have a proposal for you. I take a few levels from you, of course temporarily, and you will accomplish a task for me. What do you have to gain? Everything!
dialogsBegin.fil: I have a proposal for you. I take a few levels from you, of course temporarily, and you will accomplish a task for me. What do you have to gain? Everything!
dialogsBegin.fr: J'ai une proposition pour toi. Je te retire quelques niveaux, temporairement bien sûr, et tu m'aide à accomplir une tâche. Qu'est-ce que tu as à y gagner ? Tout !
dialogsBegin.id: Saya punya proposal untuk Anda. Saya mengambil beberapa level dari Anda, tentu saja untuk sementara, dan Anda akan menyelesaikan tugas untuk saya. Apa yang harus Anda dapatkan? Semuanya!
dialogsBegin.it: I have a proposal for you. I take a few levels from you, of course temporarily, and you will accomplish a task for me. What do you have to gain? Everything!
dialogsBegin.jp: 私はあなたに提案があります。もちろん、一時的に、私はあなたからいくつかのレベルを取ります、そしてあなたは私のために仕事を成し遂げるでしょう。あなたは何を得る必要がありますか?すべてが！
dialogsBegin.kr: 제안할 게 있어요. 제가 잠시 레벨을 조금 낮출 테니, 그 상태에서 미션을 진행하는 거예요. 뭘 얻을 수 있느냐고요? 뭐든지요!
dialogsBegin.nl: I have a proposal for you. I take a few levels from you, of course temporarily, and you will accomplish a task for me. What do you have to gain? Everything!
dialogsBegin.pl: I have a proposal for you. I take a few levels from you, of course temporarily, and you will accomplish a task for me. What do you have to gain? Everything!
dialogsBegin.ru: I have a proposal for you. I take a few levels from you, of course temporarily, and you will accomplish a task for me. What do you have to gain? Everything!
dialogsBegin.sp: Tengo una propuesta para ti. Te quito unos niveles, por supuesto temporalmente, y tú cumplirás una tarea para mí. ¿Qué tienes que ganar? Todo.
dialogsBegin.sw: I have a proposal for you. I take a few levels from you, of course temporarily, and you will accomplish a task for me. What do you have to gain? Everything!
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันมีข้อเสนอให้เจ้า ฉันจะเอา Level ลดเลเวลของคุณนิดหน่อย, แน่นอนว่าชั่วคราว, และคุณก็ไปทำงานของฉันให้สำเร็จ. แล้วคุณจะได้อะไร? ทุกสิ่ง!
dialogsBegin.tw: 我有一個建議給你。我拿你幾級，當然是暫時的，你幫我完成一個任務。你有什麼收穫？一切！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi có một đề nghị cho bạn. Tất nhiên, tôi kém bạn một vài cấp độ, tất nhiên là tạm thời, và bạn sẽ hoàn thành một nhiệm vụ cho tôi. Bạn phải đạt được điều gì? Mọi thứ!

dialogsBegin.en: I’m bringing you down to level 60, and when you get to level 70, come back to me! I’ll give you back your previous levels with a little gift.
dialogsBegin.ar: I’m bringing you down to level 60, and when you get to level 70, come back to me! I’ll give you back your previous levels with a little gift.
dialogsBegin.br: Eu vou te levar para o nível 60, e quando você chegar ao nível 70, volte para mim! Eu devolverei seus níveis anteriores com um pequeno presente.
dialogsBegin.cns: 我会先把你的等级重置到 60 级，等你升到 70 级后再来找我！我会帮你恢复之前的等级，还会附赠一份小礼物。
dialogsBegin.de: Ich bringe dich auf Level 60, und wenn du Level 70 erreicht hast, kommst du zu mir zurück! Ich gebe dir deine vorherigen Level zurück und mache dir ein kleines Geschenk.
dialogsBegin.fi: I’m bringing you down to level 60, and when you get to level 70, come back to me! I’ll give you back your previous levels with a little gift.
dialogsBegin.fil: I’m bringing you down to level 60, and when you get to level 70, come back to me! I’ll give you back your previous levels with a little gift.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je te fais redescendre au niveau 60, et quand tu atteindras le niveau 70, reviens me voir ! Je te rendrai tous tes niveaux ainsi qu'un cadeau.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya menurunkan Anda ke level 60, dan saat Anda mencapai level 70, kembalilah ke saya! Saya akan mengembalikan level Anda sebelumnya dengan hadiah kecil.
dialogsBegin.it: I’m bringing you down to level 60, and when you get to level 70, come back to me! I’ll give you back your previous levels with a little gift.
dialogsBegin.jp: びっくりだベア！君のおかげでクリスマスは楽しく過ごせそうだベア！モンスターが雪だるまを壊したり、ニンジンを食べちゃわない限り！ベアベア！
dialogsBegin.kr: 당신을 60레벨로 되돌려 줄게요. 70레벨에 도달하면 제게 돌아오세요! 예전 레벨도 돌려주고, 작은 선물도 드리죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: I’m bringing you down to level 60, and when you get to level 70, come back to me! I’ll give you back your previous levels with a little gift.
dialogsBegin.pl: I’m bringing you down to level 60, and when you get to level 70, come back to me! I’ll give you back your previous levels with a little gift.
dialogsBegin.ru: I’m bringing you down to level 60, and when you get to level 70, come back to me! I’ll give you back your previous levels with a little gift.
dialogsBegin.sp: Te bajaré al Nivel 60, y cuando llegues al 70, ¡Vuelve a mí! Te devolveré tu Nivel anterior y un regalito.
dialogsBegin.sw: I’m bringing you down to level 60, and when you get to level 70, come back to me! I’ll give you back your previous levels with a little gift.
dialogsBegin.th: ฉันจะลด Level เจ้าลงมาเหลือ Level 60 และพอเจ้า Level 70 เมื่อไหร่ก็กลับมาหาฉัน ฉันจะให้ Level เดิมเจ้าคืนพร้อมกับของขวัญเล็ก ๆ น้อย ๆ
dialogsBegin.tw: 我把你降到 60 級，等你升到 70 級再回來找我！我會用小禮物把你以前的等級還給你。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi sẽ đưa bạn xuống cấp 60, và khi bạn đạt đến cấp 70, hãy quay lại với tôi! Tôi sẽ trả lại cho bạn các cấp độ trước đó của bạn với một món quà nhỏ.

dialogsBegin.en: Be careful though, your experience will be halved for the duration of this short mission!
dialogsBegin.ar: Be careful though, your experience will be halved for the duration of this short mission!
dialogsBegin.br: Mas tenha cuidado, sua experiência será reduzida pela metade durante a duração desta pequena missão!
dialogsBegin.cns: 但是要小心，在短暂的任务期间你的经验会减半！
dialogsBegin.de: Aber Vorsicht: Deine Erfahrung wird für die Dauer dieses kurzen Einsatzes halbiert!
dialogsBegin.fi: Be careful though, your experience will be halved for the duration of this short mission!
dialogsBegin.fil: Be careful though, your experience will be halved for the duration of this short mission!
dialogsBegin.fr: Attention, en revanche, l'expérience reçue sera divisée par deux durant cette courte mission !
dialogsBegin.id: Berhati-hatilah, pengalaman Anda akan berkurang setengahnya selama durasi misi singkat ini!
dialogsBegin.it: Be careful though, your experience will be halved for the duration of this short mission!
dialogsBegin.jp: ただし、この短いミッションの期間中、経験値は半分になりますのでご注意ください!
dialogsBegin.kr: 하지만 이 잠시 미션을 진행하는 동안은 경험치가 절반으로 줄어드니 주의하세요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Be careful though, your experience will be halved for the duration of this short mission!
dialogsBegin.pl: Be careful though, your experience will be halved for the duration of this short mission!
dialogsBegin.ru: Be careful though, your experience will be halved for the duration of this short mission!
dialogsBegin.sp: Pero ten cuidado, ¡Tu experiencia se reducirá a la mitad durante esta breve misión!
dialogsBegin.sw: Be careful though, your experience will be halved for the duration of this short mission!
dialogsBegin.th: ระวังไว้เรืองนึง EXP ที่เจ้าได้จะเหลือเพียงครึ่งเดียวระหว่างที่เจ้าอยู่ในภารกิจนี้
dialogsBegin.tw: 不過要小心，在這個短任務期間你的經驗值會減半！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tuy nhiên, hãy cẩn thận, experience của bạn sẽ bị giảm một nửa trong thời gian thực hiện nhiệm vụ ngắn này!

dialogsBegin.en: Obviously, if you change your mind, you can abandon the quest at any time through your quest window and I will give you back your levels, of course!
dialogsBegin.ar: Obviously, if you change your mind, you can abandon the quest at any time through your quest window and I will give you back your levels, of course!
dialogsBegin.br: Obviamente, se você mudar de ideia, pode abandonar a missão a qualquer momento por meio da janela de missão e eu devolverei seus níveis, é claro!
dialogsBegin.cns: 当然，如果改变了主意你可以在任何时候通过任务窗口放弃任务，然后当然我会把你的等级还给你！
dialogsBegin.de: Wenn du deine Meinung änderst, kannst du die Quest natürlich jederzeit über dein Quest-Fenster abbrechen, und ich gebe dir dann natürlich deine Level zurück!
dialogsBegin.fi: Obviously, if you change your mind, you can abandon the quest at any time through your quest window and I will give you back your levels, of course!
dialogsBegin.fil: Obviously, if you change your mind, you can abandon the quest at any time through your quest window and I will give you back your levels, of course!
dialogsBegin.fr: Évidemment, si tu changes d'avis, tu peux abandonner cette quête à tout moment en utilisant la fenêtre de quête, et je te rendrai tes niveaux, bien sûr.
dialogsBegin.id: Jelas, jika Anda berubah pikiran, Anda dapat meninggalkan pencarian kapan saja melalui jendela pencarian Anda dan saya akan mengembalikan level Anda, tentunya!
dialogsBegin.it: Obviously, if you change your mind, you can abandon the quest at any time through your quest window and I will give you back your levels, of course!
dialogsBegin.jp: 気が変わった場合は、クエストウィンドウからいつでもクエストを放棄することができ、もちろんレベルを返します!
dialogsBegin.kr: 물론 마음이 바뀌면 언제든지 퀘스트 창에서 퀘스트를 포기할 수 있어요. 레벨도 전부 돌려 드리고요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Obviously, if you change your mind, you can abandon the quest at any time through your quest window and I will give you back your levels, of course!
dialogsBegin.pl: Obviously, if you change your mind, you can abandon the quest at any time through your quest window and I will give you back your levels, of course!
dialogsBegin.ru: Obviously, if you change your mind, you can abandon the quest at any time through your quest window and I will give you back your levels, of course!
dialogsBegin.sp: Obviamente, si cambias de opinión, puedes abandonar la búsqueda en cualquier momento a través de tu ventana de búsqueda y te devolveré tu nivel, ¡Por supuesto!
dialogsBegin.sw: Obviously, if you change your mind, you can abandon the quest at any time through your quest window and I will give you back your levels, of course!
dialogsBegin.th: แน่นอน ถ้าคุณเปลี่ยนใจคุณจะกดยกเลิกเควสเมื่อไหร่ก็ได้ผ่านทางหน้าต่างเควสของคุณ และข้าก็จะมอบ Level คืนให้กับท่าน ไว้ใจได้!
dialogsBegin.tw: 當然，如果你改變心意，隨時都能從任務視窗放棄任務；我也會把等級還給你！
dialogsBegin.vi: Rõ ràng, nếu bạn đổi ý, bạn có thể từ bỏ nhiệm vụ bất cứ lúc nào thông qua quest window và tất nhiên, tôi sẽ trả lại cấp độ cho bạn!
