description.kr: 코랄 아일랜드로 가서 보부가 살아 있는지 알아보세요.
description.nl: Go seek out Coral Island and see if BoBu managed to survive.
description.pl: Go seek out Coral Island and see if BoBu managed to survive.
description.ru: Go seek out Coral Island and see if BoBu managed to survive.
description.sp: Ve a buscar Isla Coral y mira si BoBu logró sobrevivir.
description.sw: Go seek out Coral Island and see if BoBu managed to survive.
description.th: ออกตามหา Coral Island แล้วตรวจสอบว่า BoBu เอาชีวิตรอดได้หรือไม่
description.tw: 前往珊瑚島，看看 波布 是否還活著。
description.vi: Hãy đi tìm Coral Island và xem liệu BoBu có sống sót được không.

dialogsBegin.en: Hero, the clouds over the island to the southeast have finally cleared!
dialogsBegin.ar: Hero, the clouds over the island to the southeast have finally cleared!
dialogsBegin.br: Herói, as nuvens sobre a ilha ao sudeste finalmente se dissiparam!
dialogsBegin.cns: 英雄，东南方那座岛屿上空的乌云终于散去了！
dialogsBegin.de: Held, die Wolken über der Insel im Südosten haben sich endlich verzogen!
dialogsBegin.fi: Hero, the clouds over the island to the southeast have finally cleared!
dialogsBegin.fil: Hero, the clouds over the island to the southeast have finally cleared!
dialogsBegin.fr: Héro, les nuages au-dessus de l'île au sud-est se sont enfin dissipés !
dialogsBegin.id: Pahlawan, awan di atas pulau di sebelah tenggara akhirnya cerah!
dialogsBegin.it: Hero, the clouds over the island to the southeast have finally cleared!
dialogsBegin.jp: 英雄よ、南東の島の雲がようやく晴れました!
dialogsBegin.kr: 용사님, 섬의 남동쪽에 있던 구름이 드디어 걷혔어요!
dialogsBegin.nl: Hero, the clouds over the island to the southeast have finally cleared!
dialogsBegin.pl: Hero, the clouds over the island to the southeast have finally cleared!
dialogsBegin.ru: Hero, the clouds over the island to the southeast have finally cleared!
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡Héroe, las nubes sobre la isla del sureste finalmente se han despejado!
dialogsBegin.sw: Hero, the clouds over the island to the southeast have finally cleared!
dialogsBegin.th: ท่านผู้กล้า เมฆเหนือเกาะทางทิศตะวันออกเฉียงใต้สลายไปแล้ว!
dialogsBegin.tw: 英雄啊，東南方那座島嶼上空的雲層終於散開了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Hero, những đám mây trên hòn đảo phía đông nam cuối cùng đã tan!

dialogsBegin.en: For the longest time we have been unable to travel to the famed Coral Island. I wonder who or what caused the clouds to dissipate?
dialogsBegin.ar: For the longest time we have been unable to travel to the famed Coral Island. I wonder who or what caused the clouds to dissipate?
dialogsBegin.br: Durante muito tempo, não conseguimos viajar para a famosa Ilha de Coral. Eu me pergunto quem ou o que causou o desaparecimento das nuvens?
dialogsBegin.cns: 长久以来，我们都无法前往那座闻名遐迩的珊瑚岛。不知究竟是谁，又或是何物，驱散了那些云雾？
dialogsBegin.de: Seit langem konnten wir nicht mehr zur berühmten Koralleninsel reisen. Ich frage mich, wer oder was die Wolken zum Verschwinden gebracht hat?
dialogsBegin.fi: For the longest time we have been unable to travel to the famed Coral Island. I wonder who or what caused the clouds to dissipate?
dialogsBegin.fil: For the longest time we have been unable to travel to the famed Coral Island. I wonder who or what caused the clouds to dissipate?
dialogsBegin.fr: Ca fait très longtemps que nous n'avons pas pu nous rendre sur l'Île Corail. Je me demande ce qui fait que les nuages se sont dissipés ?
dialogsBegin.id: Untuk waktu yang lama kami tidak dapat melakukan perjalanan ke Coral Island yang terkenal. Aku bertanya-tanya siapa atau apa yang menyebabkan awan menghilang?
dialogsBegin.it: For the longest time we have been unable to travel to the famed Coral Island. I wonder who or what caused the clouds to dissipate?
dialogsBegin.jp: 長い間、私たちは有名なコーラルアイランドに旅行することができませんでした。誰が、あるいは何によって雲が消えたのだろうか?
dialogsBegin.kr: 오랫동안 우리는 그 유명한 코랄 아일랜드를 여행할 수 없었죠. 도대체 무엇이 구름을 없애버린 걸까요?
dialogsBegin.nl: For the longest time we have been unable to travel to the famed Coral Island. I wonder who or what caused the clouds to dissipate?
dialogsBegin.pl: For the longest time we have been unable to travel to the famed Coral Island. I wonder who or what caused the clouds to dissipate?
dialogsBegin.ru: For the longest time we have been unable to travel to the famed Coral Island. I wonder who or what caused the clouds to dissipate?
dialogsBegin.sp: Durante mucho tiempo no hemos podido viajar a la famosa Isla Coral. Me pregunto quién o qué causó que las nubes se disiparan.
dialogsBegin.sw: For the longest time we have been unable to travel to the famed Coral Island. I wonder who or what caused the clouds to dissipate?
dialogsBegin.th: เป็นเวลานานมากแล้ว ที่เราไม่สามารถเดินทางไปยัง Coral Island อันเลื่องชื่อได้ ฉันสงสัยว่าเมฆสลายไปได้ยังไง?
dialogsBegin.tw: 長久以來，我們一直無法前往那座聞名的珊瑚島。我真想知道究竟是誰、或是什麼，讓那些雲霧消散了？
dialogsBegin.vi: Đã lâu rồi chúng tôi không thể đến Đảo San Hô nổi tiếng. Tôi tự hỏi ai hoặc cái gì đã khiến mây tan?

dialogsBegin.en: Regardless of the reason, perhaps you should go pay a visit to the island and see what's new.
dialogsBegin.ar: Regardless of the reason, perhaps you should go pay a visit to the island and see what's new.
dialogsBegin.br: Independentemente da razão, talvez você deva visitar a ilha e ver o que há de novo.
dialogsBegin.cns: 不管缘由如何，你或许都该去那座岛上看看，瞧瞧有什么新变化。
dialogsBegin.de: Was auch immer der Grund sein mag, vielleicht solltest du der Insel einen Besuch abstatten und sehen, was es Neues gibt.
dialogsBegin.fi: Regardless of the reason, perhaps you should go pay a visit to the island and see what's new.
dialogsBegin.fil: Regardless of the reason, perhaps you should go pay a visit to the island and see what's new.
dialogsBegin.fr: Quelle que soit la raison, vous devriez peut-être visiter l'île et voir ce qu'il se passe.
dialogsBegin.id: Apa pun alasannya, mungkin kamu harus berkunjung ke pulau itu dan melihat apa yang baru.
dialogsBegin.it: Regardless of the reason, perhaps you should go pay a visit to the island and see what's new.
dialogsBegin.jp: 理由はどうあれ、島に行って新しいものを見に行った方がいいかもしれません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이유야 어찌 됐든, 그 섬을 방문해 새로운 소식이 있는지 알아보는 게 좋겠어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Regardless of the reason, perhaps you should go pay a visit to the island and see what's new.
dialogsBegin.pl: Regardless of the reason, perhaps you should go pay a visit to the island and see what's new.
dialogsBegin.ru: Regardless of the reason, perhaps you should go pay a visit to the island and see what's new.
dialogsBegin.sp: Independientemente del motivo, quizás deberías ir a visitar la Isla y ver qué hay de nuevo.
dialogsBegin.sw: Regardless of the reason, perhaps you should go pay a visit to the island and see what's new.
dialogsBegin.th: ไม่ว่าด้วยเหตุผลใดก็ตาม บางทีคุณควรไปเยี่ยมชมเกาะแห่งนี้และดูสิ่งใหม่ๆ บ้าง
dialogsBegin.tw: 不管原因是什麼，也許你該去那座島上看看，瞧瞧有了哪些新變化。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bất kể lý do là gì, có lẽ bạn nên đến thăm hòn đảo và xem có gì mới.

dialogsAccept.en: Many years ago a skilled blacksmith from Darken City named BoBu traveled through the fog in search for rare materials. Go seek out Coral Island and see if BoBu managed to survive.
dialogsAccept.ar: Many years ago a skilled blacksmith from Darken City named BoBu traveled through the fog in search for rare materials. Go seek out Coral Island and see if BoBu managed to survive.
dialogsAccept.br: Há muitos anos, um habilidoso ferreiro da Cidade Darken chamado BoBu viajou pela névoa em busca de materiais raros. Vá até a Ilha de Coral e veja se BoBu conseguiu sobreviver.
dialogsAccept.cns: 多年前，达肯有一位技艺精湛的铁匠，名叫波布。他穿过迷雾，前去寻找珍稀材料。前往珊瑚岛，看看布布是否还活着。
dialogsAccept.de: Vor vielen Jahren reiste ein begabter Schmied aus Darken City namens BoBu auf der Suche nach seltenen Materialien durch den Nebel. Suche die Koralleninsel auf und sieh nach, ob BoBu es geschafft hat, zu überleben.
dialogsAccept.fi: Many years ago a skilled blacksmith from Darken City named BoBu traveled through the fog in search for rare materials. Go seek out Coral Island and see if BoBu managed to survive.
dialogsAccept.fil: Many years ago a skilled blacksmith from Darken City named BoBu traveled through the fog in search for rare materials. Go seek out Coral Island and see if BoBu managed to survive.
dialogsAccept.fr: Il y a de nombreuses années, un forgeron expérimenté de Darken nommé BoBu a traversé le brouillard à la recherche de matériaux rares. Partez à sa recherche sur l'Île Corail et voyez s'il a survécu.
dialogsAccept.id: Bertahun-tahun yang lalu seorang pandai besi terampil dari Darken City bernama BoBu melakukan perjalanan melalui kabut untuk mencari bahan langka. Pergilah mencari Coral Island dan lihat apakah BoBu berhasil bertahan.
dialogsAccept.it: Many years ago a skilled blacksmith from Darken City named BoBu traveled through the fog in search for rare materials. Go seek out Coral Island and see if BoBu managed to survive.
dialogsAccept.jp: 何年も前、ボブという名のダーコンシティの熟練した鍛冶屋が、珍しい材料を求めて霧の中を旅したそうです。コーラルアイランドを目指しましたが、果たしてボブが生き残ったかどうか・・・。
dialogsAccept.kr: 오래전, 다켄 시티에서 온 보부라는 실력 좋은 대장장이가 희귀한 재료를 찾아 안갯속을 여행했죠. 코랄 아일랜드로 가서 보부가 살아 있는지 알아보세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Many years ago a skilled blacksmith from Darken City named BoBu traveled through the fog in search for rare materials. Go seek out Coral Island and see if BoBu managed to survive.
dialogsAccept.pl: Many years ago a skilled blacksmith from Darken City named BoBu traveled through the fog in search for rare materials. Go seek out Coral Island and see if BoBu managed to survive.
dialogsAccept.ru: Many years ago a skilled blacksmith from Darken City named BoBu traveled through the fog in search for rare materials. Go seek out Coral Island and see if BoBu managed to survive.
dialogsAccept.sp: Hace muchos años, un hábil herrero de Ciuda Darken llamado BoBu viajó a través de la niebla en busca de materiales raros. Ve a buscar Isla Coral y mira si BoBu logró sobrevivir.
dialogsAccept.sw: Many years ago a skilled blacksmith from Darken City named BoBu traveled through the fog in search for rare materials. Go seek out Coral Island and see if BoBu managed to survive.
dialogsAccept.th: หลายปีก่อน ช่างตีเหล็กฝีมือดีจากเมือง Darken ชื่อ BoBu ได้เดินทางผ่านหมอกหนาเพื่อค้นหาวัตถุดิบหายาก ออกตามหา Coral Island และ ตรวจสอบว่า BoBu จะรอดชีวิตได้หรือไม่
dialogsAccept.tw: 很多年前，一位來自得肯城、名叫 波布 的高明鐵匠為了尋找稀有材料，穿越迷霧前往那裡。去找找珊瑚島，看看 波布 是否成功活了下來。
dialogsAccept.vi: Nhiều năm trước, một thợ rèn lành nghề đến từ Thành phố Darken tên là BoBu đã du hành xuyên qua sương mù để tìm kiếm những vật liệu quý hiếm. Hãy đi tìm Đảo San Hô và xem liệu BoBu có sống sót được không.

dialogsDecline.en: I understand hero, Coral Island has been uncharted territory for many years... Come back to me if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ar: I understand hero, Coral Island has been uncharted territory for many years... Come back to me if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.br: Eu entendo, herói, a Ilha de Coral tem sido um território desconhecido por muitos anos... Volte para mim se mudar de ideia.
dialogsDecline.cns: 我明白，英雄。珊瑚岛多年来一直是片未知之地……如果你改变主意了，就回来找我。
dialogsDecline.de: Ich verstehe Held, die Koralleninsel war viele Jahre lang unbekanntes Terrain. Komm zurück zu mir, wenn du deine Meinung änderst.
dialogsDecline.fi: I understand hero, Coral Island has been uncharted territory for many years... Come back to me if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fil: I understand hero, Coral Island has been uncharted territory for many years... Come back to me if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.fr: Je vous comprends Héros, l'Île Corail est un territoire inexploré depuis de nombreuses années. Revenez me voir si vous changez d'avis.
dialogsDecline.id: Aku mengerti pahlawan, Coral Island telah menjadi wilayah yang belum dipetakan selama bertahun-tahun... Kembalilah kepadaku jika berubah pikiran.
dialogsDecline.it: I understand hero, Coral Island has been uncharted territory for many years... Come back to me if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.jp: 私は英雄を理解しています、珊瑚島は何年もの間未知の領域でした..。気が変わったら、私のところに戻ってきてください。
dialogsDecline.kr: 이해해요, 용사님. 코랄 아일랜드는 오랫동안 미지의 땅이었으니까요... 혹시라도 마음이 바뀌면 돌아오세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: I understand hero, Coral Island has been uncharted territory for many years... Come back to me if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.pl: I understand hero, Coral Island has been uncharted territory for many years... Come back to me if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.ru: I understand hero, Coral Island has been uncharted territory for many years... Come back to me if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.sp: Entiendo, héroe, Isla Coral ha sido territorio inexplorado por muchos años. Vuelve si cambias de opinión.
dialogsDecline.sw: I understand hero, Coral Island has been uncharted territory for many years... Come back to me if you change your mind.
dialogsDecline.th: ฉันเข้าใจท่านผู้กล้า เพราะ Coral Island เป็นดินแดนที่ยังไม่มีการสำรวจมานานหลายปีแล้ว... กลับมาหาฉันถ้าคุณเปลี่ยนใจ
dialogsDecline.tw: 我明白，英雄，珊瑚島多年來一直是未被探索的區域……如果你改變主意，再回來找我。
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi hiểu hero, Coral Island đã là lãnh thổ chưa được khám phá trong nhiều năm... Hãy quay lại với tôi nếu bạn thay đổi ý định.

dialogsComplete.en: Hello there traveler, I didn't expect to see one of you so soon after the clouds around Coral Island were lifted...
dialogsComplete.ar: Hello there traveler, I didn't expect to see one of you so soon after the clouds around Coral Island were lifted...
dialogsComplete.br: Olá, viajante, não esperava ver um de vocês tão cedo após a dissipação das nuvens ao redor da Ilha de Coral...
dialogsComplete.cns: 你好啊，旅人。珊瑚岛周围的云雾刚散去没多久，我没想到这么快就能见到你们这样的冒险者……
dialogsComplete.de: Hallo, ich hatte nicht erwartet, einen von euch so schnell zu sehen, nachdem sich die Wolken um die Koralleninsel gelichtet haben.
dialogsComplete.fi: Hello there traveler, I didn't expect to see one of you so soon after the clouds around Coral Island were lifted...
dialogsComplete.fil: Hello there traveler, I didn't expect to see one of you so soon after the clouds around Coral Island were lifted...
dialogsComplete.fr: Bonjour voyageur, je ne m'attendais pas à voir quelqu'un si peu de temps après la dissipation des nuages autour de l'Île.
dialogsComplete.id: Hello traveler, aku tidak menyangka akan bertemu salah satu dari kalian secepat ini setelah awan di sekitar Coral Island terangkat...
dialogsComplete.it: Hello there traveler, I didn't expect to see one of you so soon after the clouds around Coral Island were lifted...
dialogsComplete.jp: こんにちはそこの旅行者、私はコーラル島の周りの雲が持ち上げられた後、すぐにあなたの一人に会うとは思っていませんでした..
dialogsComplete.kr: 안녕하세요, 여행자님. 코랄 아일랜드의 구름이 걷히긴 했지만 이렇게 빨리 사람을 만나게 될 줄은 몰랐지 뭐예요...
dialogsComplete.nl: Hello there traveler, I didn't expect to see one of you so soon after the clouds around Coral Island were lifted...
dialogsComplete.pl: Hello there traveler, I didn't expect to see one of you so soon after the clouds around Coral Island were lifted...
dialogsComplete.ru: Hello there traveler, I didn't expect to see one of you so soon after the clouds around Coral Island were lifted...
dialogsComplete.sp: Hola viajero, no esperaba ver a ninguno después de que se levantaran las nubes envolviendo Isla Coral...
dialogsComplete.sw: Hello there traveler, I didn't expect to see one of you so soon after the clouds around Coral Island were lifted...
dialogsComplete.th: สวัสดีนักเดินทาง ฉันไม่คิดว่าจะได้พบกับคุณเร็วขนาดนี้ หลังจากเมฆรอบ Coral Island หายไป...
dialogsComplete.tw: 你好啊，旅人。珊瑚島周圍的雲霧才剛散去不久，沒想到這麼快就會見到你們其中一位……
dialogsComplete.vi: Xin chào du khách, tôi không ngờ sẽ gặp lại một trong số các bạn ngay sau khi mây mù quanh Coral Island tan đi...

name.th: ดำดิ่งไปสู่ถ้ำ

description.ar: Enter the Leren Chasm, then kill 20 Deep Cave Gorilla and 20 Cavern Larva.
description.br: Entre no Desfiladeiro de Leren e mate 20 Gorilas das Cavernas Profundas e 20 Larvas das Cavernas.
description.cns: Enter the Leren Chasm, then kill 20 Deep Cave Gorilla and 20 Cavern Larva.
description.de: Betrete die Lerenkluft und töte 20 Tiefenhöhlen-Gorilla und 20 Höhlen-Larven.
description.fi: Enter the Leren Chasm, then kill 20 Deep Cave Gorilla and 20 Cavern Larva.
description.fil: Enter the Leren Chasm, then kill 20 Deep Cave Gorilla and 20 Cavern Larva.
description.fr: Entrez dans le gouffre de Leren, puis tuez 20 Gorilles des Profondeurs et 20 Larves des Cavernes.
description.id: Masuki Leren Chasm, lalu habisi 20 Deep Cave Gorilla dan 20 Cavern Larva.
description.it: Enter the Leren Chasm, then kill 20 Deep Cave Gorilla and 20 Cavern Larva.
description.jp: レレンの淵へ入り、ディープケイブゴリラとケイヴンラーバを20体討伐
description.kr: 레르엔 협곡으로 들어가서, 깊은 동굴 고릴라 20마리와 동굴 애벌레 20마리를 처치하세요.

description.pl: Enter the Leren Chasm, then kill 20 Deep Cave Gorilla and 20 Cavern Larva.
description.ru: Enter the Leren Chasm, then kill 20 Deep Cave Gorilla and 20 Cavern Larva.

description.th: เข้าสู่ Leren Chasm แล้วกำจัด 20 Deep Cave Gorilla และ 20 Cavern Larva
description.tw: 進入勒倫峽谷，然後殺死 20 隻深洞大猩猩和 20 隻洞穴幼蟲。
description.vi: Đi vào Leren Chasm, sau đó giết 20 Deep Cave Gorilla và 20 Cavern Larva.

dialogsBegin.en: After unblocking the entrance to Leren Chasm, strange creatures have started coming out, causing havoc in the Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.ar: After unblocking the entrance to Leren Chasm, strange creatures have started coming out, causing havoc in the Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.br: Depois de desbloquear a entrada do Desfiladeiro de Leren, coisas estranhas começaram a acontecer nas Montanhas de Leren. Criaturas perigosas começaram a surgir e a causar caos na região
dialogsBegin.cns: After unblocking the entrance to Leren Chasm, strange creatures have started coming out, causing havoc in the Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.de: Nachdem der Eingang zur Lerenkluft freigelegt wurde, sind seltsame Kreaturen herausgekommen und haben im Leren Gebirge für Verwüstung gesorgt.
dialogsBegin.fi: After unblocking the entrance to Leren Chasm, strange creatures have started coming out, causing havoc in the Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.fil: After unblocking the entrance to Leren Chasm, strange creatures have started coming out, causing havoc in the Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.fr: Après avoir débloqué l'entrée du Gouffre de Leren, d'étranges créatures ont commencé à en sortir, semant le trouble dans les Montagnes de Leren.
dialogsBegin.id: Setelah membuka blokir pintu masuk ke Leren Chasm, makhluk aneh mulai keluar, menyebabkan kekacauan di Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.it: After unblocking the entrance to Leren Chasm, strange creatures have started coming out, causing havoc in the Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.jp: レレンの淵への入り口の封鎖を解除した後、奇妙な生き物が出始め、レレン山脈に大混乱を引き起こしました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 레르엔 협곡의 입구를 다시 연 후, 이상한 괴물들이 나오기 시작했어요. 레르엔 산맥에 큰 혼란이 일고 있죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: After unblocking the entrance to Leren Chasm, strange creatures have started coming out, causing havoc in the Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.pl: After unblocking the entrance to Leren Chasm, strange creatures have started coming out, causing havoc in the Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.ru: After unblocking the entrance to Leren Chasm, strange creatures have started coming out, causing havoc in the Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.sp: Tras desbloquear la entrada a la sima de Leren, han empezado a salir extrañas criaturas que causan estragos en las montañas de Leren.
dialogsBegin.sw: After unblocking the entrance to Leren Chasm, strange creatures have started coming out, causing havoc in the Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin.th: Leren Chasm หลังจากที่เปิดทางเข้าไปสู่ Leren Chasm แล้วพวกครีเจอร์ประหลาดก็เริ่มออกมากันเต็มไปหมด ทำให้เกิดเรื่องวุ่นวายขึ้นใน Leren Mountains
dialogsBegin.tw: 勒倫峽谷的入口被打開後，奇怪的生物開始出現，在勒倫山脈造成了巨大的破壞。
dialogsBegin.vi: Sau khi mở khóa lối vào Leren Chasm, những sinh vật lạ bắt đầu xuất hiện, gây ra sự tàn phá ở Leren Mountains.

dialogsBegin.en: Go inside the Leren Chasm and clear out the creatures that have been causing us problems.
dialogsBegin.ar: Go inside the Leren Chasm and clear out the creatures that have been causing us problems.
dialogsBegin.br: Entre no Desfiladeiro de Leren e elimine as criaturas que têm causado problemas.
dialogsBegin.cns: Go inside the Leren Chasm and clear out the creatures that have been causing us problems.
dialogsBegin.de: Betrete die Lerenkluft und beseitige die Kreaturen, die uns Probleme bereitet haben.
dialogsBegin.fi: Go inside the Leren Chasm and clear out the creatures that have been causing us problems.
dialogsBegin.fil: Go inside the Leren Chasm and clear out the creatures that have been causing us problems.
dialogsBegin.fr: Entrez dans le Gouffre de Leren et éliminez les créatures qui nous ont causé des problèmes.
dialogsBegin.id: Masuklah ke dalam Leren Chasm dan singkirkan makhluk-makhluk yang telah menyebabkan masalah bagi kita.
dialogsBegin.it: Go inside the Leren Chasm and clear out the creatures that have been causing us problems.
dialogsBegin.jp: レレンの淵の中に入って、私たちに問題を引き起こしている生き物を一掃してください。
dialogsBegin.kr: 레르엔 협곡으로 들어가서, 저희를 괴롭히는 괴물들을 소탕해 주세요.
dialogsBegin.nl: Go inside the Leren Chasm and clear out the creatures that have been causing us problems.
dialogsBegin.pl: Go inside the Leren Chasm and clear out the creatures that have been causing us problems.
dialogsBegin.ru: Go inside the Leren Chasm and clear out the creatures that have been causing us problems.
dialogsBegin.sp: Entra en la sima de Leren y elimina a las criaturas que nos han estado causando problemas.
dialogsBegin.sw: Go inside the Leren Chasm and clear out the creatures that have been causing us problems.
dialogsBegin.th: เข้าไปใน Leren Chasm แล้วจัดการพวกสัตว์ร้ายที่ก่อปัญหาพวกนั้นให้หมด
dialogsBegin.tw: 進入勒倫峽谷並清除一直給我們帶來麻煩的生物。
dialogsBegin.vi: Đi vào bên trong Leren Chasm và dọn sạch những sinh vật đã gây ra vấn đề cho chúng ta.

dialogsAccept.en: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm. Inside you will find the Masquerpets I speak of.
dialogsAccept.ar: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm. Inside you will find the Masquerpets I speak of.
dialogsAccept.br: Quando estiver pronto para entrar no Desfiladeiro de Leren, fale comigo. Dentro das cavernas, você encontrará os Masquerpets que têm causado problemas.
dialogsAccept.cns: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm. Inside you will find the Masquerpets I speak of.
dialogsAccept.de: Spreche mit mir, wenn du bereit bist, die Lerenkluft zu betreten. Innen wirst du die Masquerpets finden, von denen ich erzählte.
dialogsAccept.fi: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm. Inside you will find the Masquerpets I speak of.
dialogsAccept.fil: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm. Inside you will find the Masquerpets I speak of.
dialogsAccept.fr: Parlez-moi quand vous serez prêts à entrer dans le Gouffre de Leren. À l'intérieur, vous trouverez les Masquerpets dont je parle.
dialogsAccept.id: Silakan berbicara dengan saya ketika Anda siap untuk memasuki Leren Chasm. Di dalam Anda akan menemukan Masquerpets yang saya bicarakan.
dialogsAccept.it: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm. Inside you will find the Masquerpets I speak of.
dialogsAccept.jp: レレンの淵に入る準備ができたら、私に話してください。中には、私が話すモンスターがいます。
dialogsAccept.kr: 레르엔 협곡에 들어갈 준비가 되면, 제게 말씀해 주세요. 협곡 안에는 제가 말했던 마스커펫들이 있을 겁니다.
dialogsAccept.nl: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm. Inside you will find the Masquerpets I speak of.
dialogsAccept.pl: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm. Inside you will find the Masquerpets I speak of.
dialogsAccept.ru: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm. Inside you will find the Masquerpets I speak of.
dialogsAccept.sp: Por favor, habla conmigo cuando estés listo para entrar en la sima de Leren. Dentro encontrarás los Masquerpets de los que hablo.
dialogsAccept.sw: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm. Inside you will find the Masquerpets I speak of.
dialogsAccept.th: โปรดกลับมาคุยกับข้าใหม่เมื่อเจ้าพร้อมจะเข้าไปใน Leren Chasm แล้ว ภายในเจ้าจะพบกับ Masquerpets ที่ข้าพูดถึง
dialogsAccept.tw: 當你準備好進入勒倫峽谷時，請與我交談。在裡面你會發現我所說的怪物。
dialogsAccept.vi: Vui lòng nói chuyện với tôi khi bạn sẵn sàng bước vào Leren Chasm. Bên trong, bạn sẽ tìm thấy Masquerpet mà

dialogsDecline.en: These unknown creatures are terribly dangerous. Do not approach them if you feel unprepared.
dialogsDecline.ar: These unknown creatures are terribly dangerous. Do not approach them if you feel unprepared.
dialogsDecline.br: Essas criaturas desconhecidas são terrivelmente perigosas. Não se aproxime delas se você se sentir despreparado.
dialogsDecline.cns: These unknown creatures are terribly dangerous. Do not approach them if you feel unprepared.
dialogsDecline.de: Diese unbekannten Kreaturen sind furchtbar gefährlich. Komme ihnen nicht zu nahe, wenn du dich dafür nicht bereit fühlst.
dialogsDecline.fi: These unknown creatures are terribly dangerous. Do not approach them if you feel unprepared.
dialogsDecline.fil: These unknown creatures are terribly dangerous. Do not approach them if you feel unprepared.
dialogsDecline.fr: Ces créatures inconnues sont terriblement dangereuses. Ne les approchez pas si vous ne vous sentez pas préparé.
dialogsDecline.id: Makhluk-makhluk tak dikenal ini sangat berbahaya. Jangan mendekati mereka jika Anda merasa belum siap.
dialogsDecline.it: These unknown creatures are terribly dangerous. Do not approach them if you feel unprepared.
dialogsDecline.jp: これらの未知の生き物はひどく危険です。準備ができていないと感じた場合は、近づかないでください。
dialogsDecline.kr: 이 녀석들, 아주 위험한 괴물이에요. 싸울 준비 없이는 가까이 가지 마세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: These unknown creatures are terribly dangerous. Do not approach them if you feel unprepared.
dialogsDecline.pl: These unknown creatures are terribly dangerous. Do not approach them if you feel unprepared.
dialogsDecline.ru: These unknown creatures are terribly dangerous. Do not approach them if you feel unprepared.
dialogsDecline.sp: Estas criaturas desconocidas son terriblemente peligrosas. No te acerques a ellas si no te sientes preparado.
dialogsDecline.sw: These unknown creatures are terribly dangerous. Do not approach them if you feel unprepared.
dialogsDecline.th: เจ้าสัตว์ตัวนี้มันอันตรายอย่าลเหลือเชื่อ อย่าไปยุ่งกับมันถ้าเจ้ายังไม่พร้อม
dialogsDecline.tw: 這些未知生物非常危險。如果你覺得自己還沒準備好，就不要靠近。
dialogsDecline.vi: Những sinh vật chưa biết cực kỳ nguy hiểm. Đừng tiếp cận chúng nếu bạn cảm thấy chưa chuẩn bị.

dialogsComplete.en: Hopefully we will have less disturbences in the Leren Mountains now, thanks to you.
dialogsComplete.ar: Hopefully we will have less disturbences in the Leren Mountains now, thanks to you.
dialogsComplete.br: Esperamos ter menos problemas nas Montanhas de Leren agora, graças a você.
dialogsComplete.cns: Hopefully we will have less disturbences in the Leren Mountains now, thanks to you.
dialogsComplete.de: Hoffentlich haben wir dank dir von nun an weniger Unruhen im Leren Gebirge.
dialogsComplete.fi: Hopefully we will have less disturbences in the Leren Mountains now, thanks to you.
dialogsComplete.fil: Hopefully we will have less disturbences in the Leren Mountains now, thanks to you.
dialogsComplete.fr: J'espère que, grâce à vous, il y aura moins de perturbations dans les Montagnes de Leren.
dialogsComplete.id: Semoga gangguan di Leren Mountains sekarang berkurang, terima kasih.
dialogsComplete.it: Hopefully we will have less disturbences in the Leren Mountains now, thanks to you.
dialogsComplete.jp: あなたのおかげで、レレン山脈での混乱が少なくなることを願っています。
dialogsComplete.kr: 아, 덕분에 이제 레르엔 산맥에 방해꾼이 줄어들겠네요.
dialogsComplete.nl: Hopefully we will have less disturbences in the Leren Mountains now, thanks to you.
dialogsComplete.pl: Hopefully we will have less disturbences in the Leren Mountains now, thanks to you.
dialogsComplete.ru: Hopefully we will have less disturbences in the Leren Mountains now, thanks to you.
dialogsComplete.sp: Esperemos que ahora tengamos menos disturbios en las Montañas Leren, gracias a ti.
dialogsComplete.sw: Hopefully we will have less disturbences in the Leren Mountains now, thanks to you.
dialogsComplete.th: หวังว่าคงมีเรื่องรบกวนน้อยลงใน Leren Mountains หลังจากนี้นะ ขอบคุณเจ้ามากนะ
dialogsComplete.tw: 多虧有你，希望勒倫山脈之後能少一點騷動。
dialogsComplete.vi: Hy vọng rằng bây giờ chúng ta sẽ ít bị xáo trộn hơn ở Dãy núi Leren, nhờ có bạn.

description.en: You may find delicious $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from Kingsters in shallow waters around the island.

description.fil: Maaaring makuha mo ang masarap na $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ mula sa mga Kingster sa mababaw na tubig sa paligid ng isla.
description.fr: Vous pouvez trouver de délicieux $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ de Langoustroy dans les eaux peu profondes autour de l'île.

description.it: You may find delicious $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from Kingsters in shallow waters around the island.
description.jp: 島の周りの浅瀬でKingstersのおいしい$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$を見つけることができます。
description.kr: 섬 주변의 얕은 바다에서 킹스터가 남긴 맛있는 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$을(를) 찾을 수 있습니다.
description.nl: You may find delicious $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from Kingsters in shallow waters around the island.
description.pl: You may find delicious $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from Kingsters in shallow waters around the island.

description.th: คุณอาจพบ $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ แสนอร่อยจาก Kingsters ในบริเวณน้ำตื้นรอบเกาะ
description.tw: 你可以從島嶼周圍淺水區的金斯特身上找到美味的 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$。
description.vi: Bạn có thể tìm thấy $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ ngon lành từ Kingsters ở vùng nước nông xung quanh đảo.

descriptionComplete.en: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ cackles with glee! Soon their inventions will become a reality.
descriptionComplete.ar: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ cackles with glee! Soon their inventions will become a reality.
descriptionComplete.br: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ ri de alegria! Em breve suas invenções se tornarão realidade.
descriptionComplete.cns: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ cackles with glee! Soon their inventions will become a reality.
descriptionComplete.de: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ gackert vor Vergnügen! Bald werden ihre Erfindungen Wirklichkeit werden.
descriptionComplete.fi: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ cackles with glee! Soon their inventions will become a reality.
descriptionComplete.fil: Tumatawa si $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ ng may tuwa! Malapit nang maging realidad ang kanilang mga imbensyon.
descriptionComplete.fr: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ se réjouit ! Bientôt, leurs inventions deviendront réalité.
descriptionComplete.id: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ tertawa gembira! Penemuan mereka akan segera menjadi kenyataan.
descriptionComplete.it: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ cackles with glee! Soon their inventions will become a reality.
descriptionComplete.jp: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$は歓喜の声を上げます!まもなく彼らの発明は現実のものとなるでしょう。
descriptionComplete.kr: QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$이(가) 환호성을 지릅니다! 곧 그 발명품이 현실이 될 거예요.

descriptionComplete.sw: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ cackles with glee! Soon their inventions will become a reality.
descriptionComplete.th: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ หัวเราะด้วยความยินดี! ในไม่ช้าสิ่งประดิษฐ์ของพวกเขาจะกลายเป็นความจริง
descriptionComplete.tw: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ 興奮地咯咯大笑！很快，他們的發明就會成為現實。
descriptionComplete.vi: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ cười khúc khích vui sướng! Sớm thôi, những phát minh của họ sẽ trở thành hiện thực.

dialogsBegin.en: All this inventing has me famished! Could you go get me some of the Kingster's $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$? We'll eat like kings! Don't worry, I'll share...
dialogsBegin.ar: All this inventing has me famished! Could you go get me some of the Kingster's $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$? We'll eat like kings! Don't worry, I'll share...
dialogsBegin.br: Toda essa invenção me deixou faminto! Você poderia pegar $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ dos Kingsters? Vamos comer como reis! Não se preocupe, eu vou compartilhar...
dialogsBegin.cns: All this inventing has me famished! Could you go get me some of the Kingster's $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$? We'll eat like kings! Don't worry, I'll share...
dialogsBegin.de: Diese ganze Erfindung hat mich hungrig gemacht! Könntest du mir etwas von den $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ des Kingsters besorgen? Wir werden essen wie die Könige! Keine Sorge, ich teile mit dir...
dialogsBegin.fi: All this inventing has me famished! Could you go get me some of the Kingster's $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$? We'll eat like kings! Don't worry, I'll share...
dialogsBegin.fil: Gutom na gutom na ako sa dami ng imbensyon! Puwede mo bang kunin para sa akin ang $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ ng Kingster? Kakain tayo na parang mga hari! Huwag mag-alala, hahatiin ko rin naman.
dialogsBegin.fr: Tout ce travail d'invention me donne faim ! Pourriez-vous aller me chercher un peu de $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ des Langoustroys ? Nous mangerons comme des rois ! Ne vous inquiétez pas, je partagerai...
dialogsBegin.id: Semua penemuan ini membuatku kelaparan! Bisakah kamu membelikanku beberapa Kingster $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$? Kami akan makan seperti raja! Jangan khawatir, aku akan berbagi...
dialogsBegin.it: All this inventing has me famished! Could you go get me some of the Kingster's $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$? We'll eat like kings! Don't worry, I'll share...
dialogsBegin.jp: このすべての発明は私を飢えさせました!キングスターの$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$をもらってきてくれませんか?王様のように食べます!心配しないで、私は共有します..
dialogsBegin.kr: 발명을 하고 나니 배가 고프네요! 가서 킹스터의 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$을(를) 좀 가져오실 수 있나요? 왕처럼 먹어 보자고요! 걱정 마세요, 같이 나눠 먹으면 되니까...
dialogsBegin.nl: All this inventing has me famished! Could you go get me some of the Kingster's $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$? We'll eat like kings! Don't worry, I'll share...
dialogsBegin.pl: All this inventing has me famished! Could you go get me some of the Kingster's $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$? We'll eat like kings! Don't worry, I'll share...
dialogsBegin.ru: All this inventing has me famished! Could you go get me some of the Kingster's $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$? We'll eat like kings! Don't worry, I'll share...
dialogsBegin.sp: ¡¡Todo este inventar me tiene hambrienta!! ¿Podrías traerme un poco de $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ de Kingster? ¡Comeremos como reyes! No te preocupes, lo compartiré.
dialogsBegin.sw: All this inventing has me famished! Could you go get me some of the Kingster's $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$? We'll eat like kings! Don't worry, I'll share...
dialogsBegin.th: คิดค้นสิ่งประดิษฐ์เนี่ย มันทำให้ฉันหิวมาก! คุณช่วยไปซื้อ $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ ของ Kingster ให้ฉันหน่อยได้ไหม เราจะกินกันอย่างราชา! ไม่ต้องกังวล ฉันจะแบ่งให้...
dialogsBegin.tw: 搞這些發明把我餓壞了！你能幫我去弄一些金斯特的 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ 嗎？我們要像國王一樣大吃一頓！別擔心，我會分你一份……
dialogsBegin.vi: Công việc sáng chế khiến tôi đói meo rồi! Bạn có thể mang cho tôi vài $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ của Kingster không? Chúng ta sẽ ăn uống như những vị vua! Đừng lo, tôi sẽ chia sẻ mà...

dialogsDecline.sw: Please, don't make me go collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ all on my own... I'm too busy dreaming up new inventions!
dialogsDecline.th: ขอร้องอย่าให้ฉันต้องไปเก็บ $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ คนเดียวเลย... ฉันยุ่งเกินไปกับการฝันถึงสิ่งประดิษฐ์ใหม่ๆ!

dialogsDecline.vi: Làm ơn, đừng bắt tôi phải đi thu thập $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ một mình...Tôi đang quá bận tay với việc sáng tạo ra những sáng chế mới rồi!

dialogsComplete.it: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! We're going to be so full! Eat up, it's time to feast!
dialogsComplete.jp: 冒険者の皆さん、$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$を全て集めてくれてありがとう!お腹いっぱいになりそうです!食べて、ごちそうの時間です!
dialogsComplete.kr: $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$을(를) 모두 수집해 주셔서 감사합니다, 모험가님! 정말 배부른데요! 더 드세요, 축제를 즐겨야죠!
dialogsComplete.nl: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! We're going to be so full! Eat up, it's time to feast!
dialogsComplete.pl: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! We're going to be so full! Eat up, it's time to feast!
dialogsComplete.ru: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! We're going to be so full! Eat up, it's time to feast!
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡Gracias por reunir todos esos $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, aventurero! ¡Vamos a estar muy llenos! ¡Come, es hora de un festín!
dialogsComplete.sw: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! We're going to be so full! Eat up, it's time to feast!
dialogsComplete.th: ขอบคุณที่รวบรวม $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ ทั้งหมดมาได้นะนักผจญภัย! เราคงจะอิ่มมากแน่ๆ! รีบกินซะ ได้เวลาปาร์ตี้แล้ว!
dialogsComplete.tw: 感謝你收集了這麼多 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$，冒險家！我們肯定能吃得超飽！開動吧，是時候大快朵頤了！
dialogsComplete.vi: Cảm ơn vì đã thu thập tất cả $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, nhà thám hiểm! Dạ dày chúng ta sẽ căng tròn sớm thôi! Đến lúc đánh chén rồi!

dialogsFail.en: That isn't nearly enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ for me to build one of my grand inventions... come back with more!
dialogsFail.ar: That isn't nearly enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ for me to build one of my grand inventions... come back with more!
dialogsFail.br: Isso não é nem de perto suficiente $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ para eu construir uma das minhas grandes invenções... volte com mais!
dialogsFail.cns: That isn't nearly enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ for me to build one of my grand inventions... come back with more!
dialogsFail.de: Das ist nicht annähernd genug $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, um eine meiner großartigen Erfindungen zu bauen... komm mit mehr zurück!
dialogsFail.fi: That isn't nearly enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ for me to build one of my grand inventions... come back with more!
dialogsFail.fil: Hindi pa sapat ang dami ng $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ para makagawa ako ng isa sa malalaking imbensyon ko... bumalik ka kapag may dala ka pang marami!
dialogsFail.fr: C'est loin d'être assez de $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ pour que je construise l'une de mes grandes inventions... revenez avec plus !
dialogsFail.id: $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ itu tidak cukup bagiku untuk membuat salah satu penemuan hebat... kembalilah dengan lebih banyak lagi!

dialogsFail.jp: これは、私の壮大な発明の1つを構築するには、$QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$が十分ではありません。もっと戻ってきてください!
dialogsFail.kr: 진정 위대한 발명품을 만들기엔, $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$이(가) 턱없이 부족하네요... 더 모아서 다시 오세요!

dialogsFail.pl: That isn't nearly enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ for me to build one of my grand inventions... come back with more!

dialogsFail.sp: No es suficiente $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ para construir mi gran invento... ¡Tráeme más!
dialogsFail.sw: That isn't nearly enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ for me to build one of my grand inventions... come back with more!
dialogsFail.th: นั่นยังไม่ใกล้เคียงเลยเลยสำหรับ $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ ที่ฉันจะใช้สร้างสิ่งประดิษฐ์อันยิ่งใหญ่ของฉัน... โปรดนำกลับมาเพิ่มอีก!
dialogsFail.tw: 這些 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ 還遠遠不夠讓我完成其中一項偉大發明……帶更多回來吧！
dialogsFail.vi: Số tiền đó gần như không đủ $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ để tôi xây dựng một trong những phát minh vĩ đại của mình...Đừng quay lại đây cho đến khi bạn mang theo nhiều hơn!

dialogsBegin.en: I see... you wish to see my powers of the mind. Well, the MewMew people are not very trusting of outsiders.
dialogsBegin.ar: I see... you wish to see my powers of the mind. Well, the MewMew people are not very trusting of outsiders.
dialogsBegin.br: Ué, ué, ué... você quer ver meu poder mental? Bem, o povo MewMew não confia muito em estranhos.
dialogsBegin.cns: I see... you wish to see my powers of the mind. Well, the MewMew people are not very trusting of outsiders.
dialogsBegin.de: Verstehe... Du willst meine Geistesgaben sehen. Nun, die MewMew-Leute sind nicht sehr vertrauensvoll gegenüber Außenstehenden.
dialogsBegin.fi: I see... you wish to see my powers of the mind. Well, the MewMew people are not very trusting of outsiders.
dialogsBegin.fil: I see... you wish to see my powers of the mind. Well, the MewMew people are not very trusting of outsiders.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je vois... vous voulez voir mes pouvoirs de l'esprit. Les MewMew ne sont pas très confiants envers les étrangers.
dialogsBegin.id: Begitu ya.. Kamu ingin melihat kekuatan pikiranku. Yah, orang MewMew tidak terlalu mempercayai orang luar.
dialogsBegin.it: I see... you wish to see my powers of the mind. Well, the MewMew people are not very trusting of outsiders.
dialogsBegin.jp: なるほど。。あなたは私の心の力を見たいのです。さて、ミュウミューの人々は部外者をあまり信頼していません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 흐음... 제 정신적 능력을 보고 싶어 하시는군요. 글쎄, 뮤뮤족 사람들은 외부인을 그다지 신뢰하지 않거든요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I see... you wish to see my powers of the mind. Well, the MewMew people are not very trusting of outsiders.
dialogsBegin.pl: I see... you wish to see my powers of the mind. Well, the MewMew people are not very trusting of outsiders.
dialogsBegin.ru: I see... you wish to see my powers of the mind. Well, the MewMew people are not very trusting of outsiders.
dialogsBegin.sp: Ya veo .. usted desea ver mis poderes de la mente. Bueno, los MewMew no son muy confiados con los forasteros.
dialogsBegin.sw: I see... you wish to see my powers of the mind. Well, the MewMew people are not very trusting of outsiders.
dialogsBegin.th: เข้าใจล่ะ เจ้าอยากที่จะเห็นพลังแห่งจิตใจของข้าสินะ แต่ผู้ชาว MewMew น่ะ ไม่ค่อยจะเชื่อใจคนนอกเท่าไหร่หรอกนะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 我明白了……你想見識我的心靈之力。不過，喵喵族可不怎麼信任外人。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi hiểu rồi...vậy là bạn muốn thấy sức mạnh tâm trí của tôi. Chà, người MewMew không tin người ngoài cho lắm.

dialogsBegin.en: If you really want to have a fortune read you will need permission from the leader of the MewMew clan, Locku. Before I will allow you to speak to Locku, you must prove yourself to me.
dialogsBegin.ar: If you really want to have a fortune read you will need permission from the leader of the MewMew clan, Locku. Before I will allow you to speak to Locku, you must prove yourself to me.
dialogsBegin.br: Se você quiser ter a sorte lida, vai precisar pedir permissão pro líder dos MewMews, Locku. Mas antes disso, você precisa provar que é digno das minhas habilidades telepáticas.
dialogsBegin.cns: If you really want to have a fortune read you will need permission from the leader of the MewMew clan, Locku. Before I will allow you to speak to Locku, you must prove yourself to me.
dialogsBegin.de: Wenn du wirklich etwas über die Zukunft erfahren willst, brauchst du die Erlaubnis des Anführers des MewMew-Clans, Locku. Bevor ich dir erlaube, mit Locku zu sprechen, musst du dich mir gegenüber beweisen.
dialogsBegin.fi: If you really want to have a fortune read you will need permission from the leader of the MewMew clan, Locku. Before I will allow you to speak to Locku, you must prove yourself to me.
dialogsBegin.fil: If you really want to have a fortune read you will need permission from the leader of the MewMew clan, Locku. Before I will allow you to speak to Locku, you must prove yourself to me.
dialogsBegin.fr: Si tu veux vraiment faire lire l'avenir, tu dois obtenir la permission du chef du clan MewMew, Locku. Avant que je ne t'autorise à parler à Locku, tu dois faire tes preuves.
dialogsBegin.id: Jika Anda benar-benar ingin membaca keberuntungan, Anda memerlukan izin dari pemimpin klan MewMew, Locku. Sebelum saya mengizinkan Anda berbicara dengan Locku, Anda harus membuktikan diri kepada saya.
dialogsBegin.it: If you really want to have a fortune read you will need permission from the leader of the MewMew clan, Locku. Before I will allow you to speak to Locku, you must prove yourself to me.
dialogsBegin.jp: 本当に占いを読ませたい場合は、ミュウミュウ一族のリーダーであるロックーの許可が必要です。私があなたにロックーと話すことを許す前に、あなたは私に自分自身を証明しなければなりません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 운세를 보려면, 우선 뮤뮤족 대장 록쿠의 허락을 받아야 합니다. 그리고 록쿠와 대화하려면, 먼저 제게 능력을 증명해 보이셔야 하죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: If you really want to have a fortune read you will need permission from the leader of the MewMew clan, Locku. Before I will allow you to speak to Locku, you must prove yourself to me.
dialogsBegin.pl: If you really want to have a fortune read you will need permission from the leader of the MewMew clan, Locku. Before I will allow you to speak to Locku, you must prove yourself to me.
dialogsBegin.ru: If you really want to have a fortune read you will need permission from the leader of the MewMew clan, Locku. Before I will allow you to speak to Locku, you must prove yourself to me.
dialogsBegin.sp: Si realmente quieres que te lea la fortuna, necesitarás el permiso del líder del clan MewMew, Locku. Antes de que te permita hablar con Locku, debes demostrarme tu valía.
dialogsBegin.sw: If you really want to have a fortune read you will need permission from the leader of the MewMew clan, Locku. Before I will allow you to speak to Locku, you must prove yourself to me.
dialogsBegin.th: ถ้าเจ้าอยากจะอ่านดวงชะตาจริง ๆ แล้วละก็เจ้าต้องไปขออนุญาตผู้นำของเผ่า MewMew ก่อน และก่อนที่เจ้าจะไปคุยกับ Locku ได้ ข้าจะต้องพิสูจน์ตัวเองให้ข้าได้เห็นก่อน
dialogsBegin.tw: 如果你真的想讓我為你占卜，就必須先得到喵喵族首領洛庫的許可。在我允許你去見洛庫之前，你得先向我證明自己。
dialogsBegin.vi: Nếu bạn thực sự muốn xem vận may, bạn sẽ cần sự cho phép của người đứng đầu bộ tộc MewMew, Locku. Trước khi tôi cho phép bạn nói chuyện với Locku, bạn phải chứng minh bản thân.

dialogsAccept.en: Prove your worth by bringing me the Hearts of Red Otem who reside in the Iblis Dungeon. If you can do that, then I will let you speak with our leader.
dialogsAccept.ar: Prove your worth by bringing me the Hearts of Red Otem who reside in the Iblis Dungeon. If you can do that, then I will let you speak with our leader.
dialogsAccept.br: Prove o seu valor trazendo para mim os Corações dos Otem Vermelhos que residem no Templo Iblis. Se você conseguir fazer isso, eu permitirei que você fale com nosso líder.
dialogsAccept.cns: Prove your worth by bringing me the Hearts of Red Otem who reside in the Iblis Dungeon. If you can do that, then I will let you speak with our leader.
dialogsAccept.de: Beweise dich, indem du mir die Hearts of the Red Totem bringst, die sich im Ivillis Dungeon aufhalten. Wenn du das schaffst, dann werde ich dich mit unserem Anführer sprechen lassen.
dialogsAccept.fi: Prove your worth by bringing me the Hearts of Red Otem who reside in the Iblis Dungeon. If you can do that, then I will let you speak with our leader.
dialogsAccept.fil: Prove your worth by bringing me the Hearts of Red Otem who reside in the Iblis Dungeon. If you can do that, then I will let you speak with our leader.
dialogsAccept.fr: Prouvez votre valeur en m'apportant les Coeurs de Rotem qui résident dans le Donjon d'Ivillis. Si vous y parvenez, je vous laisserai parler à notre chef.
dialogsAccept.id: Buktikan kemampuanmu dengan membawakanku Hearts of Red Otem yang tinggal di Penjara Iblis. Jika Anda dapat melakukan itu, maka saya akan membiarkan Anda berbicara dengan pemimpin kami.
dialogsAccept.it: Prove your worth by bringing me the Hearts of Red Otem who reside in the Iblis Dungeon. If you can do that, then I will let you speak with our leader.
dialogsAccept.jp: イブリスダンジョンに住むレッドオテムのハートを持ってきて、あなたの価値を証明してください。あなたがそれをすることができるなら、私はあなたに私たちのリーダーと話させます。
dialogsAccept.kr: 이블리스 던전에 있는 빨강 오템의 심장을 가져와서 당신의 가치를 증명해 보이세요. 해낸다면, 우리 대장과 이야기할 수 있게 해 드리죠.
dialogsAccept.nl: Prove your worth by bringing me the Hearts of Red Otem who reside in the Iblis Dungeon. If you can do that, then I will let you speak with our leader.
dialogsAccept.pl: Prove your worth by bringing me the Hearts of Red Otem who reside in the Iblis Dungeon. If you can do that, then I will let you speak with our leader.
dialogsAccept.ru: Prove your worth by bringing me the Hearts of Red Otem who reside in the Iblis Dungeon. If you can do that, then I will let you speak with our leader.
dialogsAccept.sp: Demuestra tu valía trayéndome los Corazones de Otem Rojo que residen en la Mazmorra de Iblis. Si puedes hacerlo, te dejaré hablar con nuestro líder.
dialogsAccept.sw: Prove your worth by bringing me the Hearts of Red Otem who reside in the Iblis Dungeon. If you can do that, then I will let you speak with our leader.
dialogsAccept.th: พิสูจน์ตัวเองด้วยการนำ Hearts of Red Otem ที่อยู่ใน Iblis Dungeon มาให้ข้า ถ้าเจ้าทำได้สำเร็จ ข้าจะให้เจ้าได้ไปคุยกับผู้นำของเรา
dialogsAccept.tw: 去取得住在伊普里司副本裡的紅色歐特姆之心，證明你的價值。只要你辦得到，我就讓你去見我們的首領。
dialogsAccept.vi: Chứng minh giá trị của bạn bằng cách mang về cho tôi Hearts of Red Otem cư trú trong Iblis Dungeon. Nếu bạn có thể làm điều đó, thì tôi sẽ để bạn nói chuyện với thủ lĩnh của chúng tôi.

dialogsDecline.en: If you cannot do a simple task then you are not worthy of to speak to the MewMew clan leader...
dialogsDecline.ar: If you cannot do a simple task then you are not worthy of to speak to the MewMew clan leader...
dialogsDecline.br: Se não consegue nem cumprir uma simples missão, não merece nem olhar na cara do líder do clã MewMew!

dialogsDecline.de: Wenn du nicht einmal eine einfache Aufgabe erledigen kannst, bist du es nicht wert, mit dem MewMew-Clanführer zu sprechen.
dialogsDecline.fi: If you cannot do a simple task then you are not worthy of to speak to the MewMew clan leader...
dialogsDecline.fil: If you cannot do a simple task then you are not worthy of to speak to the MewMew clan leader...
dialogsDecline.fr: Si vous ne pouvez pas accomplir une tâche simple, vous n'êtes pas digne de parler au chef du clan MewMew.
dialogsDecline.id: Jika kamu tidak dapat melakukan tugas sederhana maka kamu tidak layak untuk berbicara dengan pemimpin klan MewMew..

dialogsDecline.kr: 간단한 임무도 해낼 수 없다면, 뮤뮤족 대장과 대화할 가치도 없다고 봐도 되겠죠...

dialogsDecline.th: หากเจ้าทำเรื่องง่าย ๆ แค่นี้ไม่ได้ เจ้าก็ไม่มีค่าพอที่จะไปคุยกับหัวหน้าเผ่า MewMew
dialogsDecline.tw: 連這點小事都做不到的話，你就沒有資格去見喵喵族首領……
dialogsDecline.vi: Nếu bạn không thể làm một nhiệm vụ đơn giản như thế này thì bạn không xứng đáng để nói chuyện với tộc trưởng tộc MewMew...

dialogsComplete.en: We distrust you humans, but I see you have helped YaoRin in eliminating our mortal enemies, the Otems.
dialogsComplete.ar: We distrust you humans, but I see you have helped YaoRin in eliminating our mortal enemies, the Otems.
dialogsComplete.br: Desconfiamos de vocês humanos, mas vejo que ajudou YaoRin a eliminar nossos inimigos mortais, os Otems.
dialogsComplete.cns: We distrust you humans, but I see you have helped YaoRin in eliminating our mortal enemies, the Otems.
dialogsComplete.de: Wir misstrauen euch Menschen, aber wie ich sehe, hast du YaoRin geholfen, unsere Todfeinde, die Totems, zu vernichten.
dialogsComplete.fi: We distrust you humans, but I see you have helped YaoRin in eliminating our mortal enemies, the Otems.
dialogsComplete.fil: We distrust you humans, but I see you have helped YaoRin in eliminating our mortal enemies, the Otems.
dialogsComplete.fr: Nous nous méfions des humains, mais je vois que vous avez aidé YaoRin à éliminer nos ennemis mortels, les Otems.
dialogsComplete.id: Kami tidak mempercayai Anda manusia, tapi saya melihat Anda telah membantu YaoRin dalam melenyapkan musuh bebuyutan kami, para Otem.
dialogsComplete.it: We distrust you humans, but I see you have helped YaoRin in eliminating our mortal enemies, the Otems.
dialogsComplete.jp: 私たちはあなた方人間を信用していませんが、あなたはヤオリンが私たちの致命的な敵であるオテムを排除するのを助けたようです。
dialogsComplete.kr: 우리는 인간을 믿지 않지만, 당신은 야오린이 우리 천적 오템을 없앨 때 도움을 줬으니까요.
dialogsComplete.nl: We distrust you humans, but I see you have helped YaoRin in eliminating our mortal enemies, the Otems.
dialogsComplete.pl: We distrust you humans, but I see you have helped YaoRin in eliminating our mortal enemies, the Otems.
dialogsComplete.ru: We distrust you humans, but I see you have helped YaoRin in eliminating our mortal enemies, the Otems.
dialogsComplete.sp: Desconfiamos de vosotros, los humanos, pero veo que habéis ayudado a YaoRin a eliminar a nuestros enemigos mortales, los Otems.
dialogsComplete.sw: We distrust you humans, but I see you have helped YaoRin in eliminating our mortal enemies, the Otems.
dialogsComplete.th: เราไม่เชื่อใจพวกมนุษย์ แต่ข้าเห็นเจ้าช่วย YaoRin กำจัดศัตรูตลอดกาลของพวกเรา พวก Otems
dialogsComplete.tw: 我們喵喵族並不信任你們人類，但我看得出來，你已經幫姚琳清除了我們的死敵──歐特姆。
dialogsComplete.vi: Chúng tôi không tin tưởng con người các bạn, nhưng tôi thấy các bạn đã giúp YaoRin tiêu diệt kẻ thù không đội trời chung của chúng tôi, các Otem.

dialogsBegin.en: *Psst* Hey, you! Can you come help an old box like me?
dialogsBegin.ar: *Psst* Hey, you! Can you come help an old box like me?
dialogsBegin.br: Psst Ei, você aí! Pode vir ajudar uma velha caixa como eu?
dialogsBegin.cns: *Psst* Hey, you! Can you come help an old box like me?
dialogsBegin.de: *Pst* Hey, du! Kannst du einer alten Schachtel wie mir helfen?
dialogsBegin.fi: *Psst* Hey, you! Can you come help an old box like me?
dialogsBegin.fil: *Psst* Hey, you! Can you come help an old box like me?
dialogsBegin.fr: *Psst* Hé, toi ! Tu peux venir aider une vieille boîte comme moi ?
dialogsBegin.id: *Psst* Hei, kamu! Bisakah Anda datang membantu kotak tua seperti saya?
dialogsBegin.it: *Psst* Hey, you! Can you come help an old box like me?
dialogsBegin.jp: *追伸*ねえ、あなた!私のような古い箱を手伝ってくれませんか?
dialogsBegin.kr: *핏* 거기, 너! 이 낡은 상자를 좀 도와주지 않겠나?
dialogsBegin.nl: *Psst* Hey, you! Can you come help an old box like me?
dialogsBegin.pl: *Psst* Hey, you! Can you come help an old box like me?
dialogsBegin.ru: *Psst* Hey, you! Can you come help an old box like me?
dialogsBegin.sp: *Psst* ¡Eh, tú! ¿Puedes venir a ayudar a una vieja caja como yo?
dialogsBegin.sw: *Psst* Hey, you! Can you come help an old box like me?
dialogsBegin.th: *ชี่....* เฮ้ เจ้าน่ะ! เจ้ามาช่วยอะไรกล่องเก่า ๆ อย่างข้าหน่อยได้ไหม?
dialogsBegin.tw: *噓* 喂，你！可以過來幫幫像我這種可憐的老箱子嗎？
dialogsBegin.vi: *Psst* Này, bạn! Bạn có thể đến giúp một chiếc hộp cũ như tôi không?

dialogsBegin.en: I haven't seen an adventurer here in years, you must be tough. I was turned into this box a long time ago by an annoying clown... Could you help return me to my original form? I can help you become so much stronger if you do...
dialogsBegin.ar: I haven't seen an adventurer here in years, you must be tough. I was turned into this box a long time ago by an annoying clown... Could you help return me to my original form? I can help you become so much stronger if you do...
dialogsBegin.br: Não vejo um aventureiro por aqui há anos, você deve ser forte. Fui transformada nesta caixa há muito tempo por um palhaço irritante... Você poderia me ajudar a voltar à minha forma original? Posso ajudá-lo a se tornar muito mais forte se o fizer.
dialogsBegin.cns: I haven't seen an adventurer here in years, you must be tough. I was turned into this box a long time ago by an annoying clown... Could you help return me to my original form? I can help you become so much stronger if you do...
dialogsBegin.de: Ich habe hier seit Jahren keinen Abenteurer mehr gesehen, du musst hart im Nehmen sein. Ich wurde vor langer Zeit von einem lästigen Clown in diese Kiste verwandelt... Könntest du mir helfen, meine ursprüngliche Gestalt wieder anzunehmen? Ich kann dir helfen, viel stärker zu werden, wenn du das tust.
dialogsBegin.fi: I haven't seen an adventurer here in years, you must be tough. I was turned into this box a long time ago by an annoying clown... Could you help return me to my original form? I can help you become so much stronger if you do...
dialogsBegin.fil: I haven't seen an adventurer here in years, you must be tough. I was turned into this box a long time ago by an annoying clown... Could you help return me to my original form? I can help you become so much stronger if you do...
dialogsBegin.fr: Je n'ai pas vu d'aventurier ici depuis des années, vous devez être coriace. J'ai été transformé en cette boîte il y a longtemps par un clown ennuyeux... Pourriez-vous m'aider à retrouver ma forme originelle ? Je peux vous aider à devenir beaucoup plus fort si vous le faites...
dialogsBegin.id: Aku belum pernah melihat seorang petualang di sini selama bertahun-tahun, aku pasti tangguh. Aku sudah lama berubah menjadi kotak ini oleh badut yang menyebalkan.. Bisakah kamu membantu mengembalikanku ke bentuk asliku? Aku dapat membantumu menjadi jauh lebih kuat jika kamu melakukannya ..
dialogsBegin.it: I haven't seen an adventurer here in years, you must be tough. I was turned into this box a long time ago by an annoying clown... Could you help return me to my original form? I can help you become so much stronger if you do...
dialogsBegin.jp: 私はここで何年も冒険者を見ていません、あなたはタフでなければなりません。私はずっと前に迷惑なピエロによってこの箱に変えられました..元の形に戻すのを手伝ってくれませんか?あなたがそうするなら、私はあなたがとても強くなるのを助けることができます..
dialogsBegin.kr: 이곳에서 모험가를 본 지가 오래됐는데, 꽤 하는 녀석인가 보군. 오래전, 어떤 고약한 멍청이가 날 이런 상자로 만들어 버렸다... 내가 원래 모습으로 돌아가게 도와주지 않겠나? 그렇게만 해 준다면, 훨씬 더 강해지게 도와주지...
dialogsBegin.nl: I haven't seen an adventurer here in years, you must be tough. I was turned into this box a long time ago by an annoying clown... Could you help return me to my original form? I can help you become so much stronger if you do...
dialogsBegin.pl: I haven't seen an adventurer here in years, you must be tough. I was turned into this box a long time ago by an annoying clown... Could you help return me to my original form? I can help you become so much stronger if you do...
dialogsBegin.ru: I haven't seen an adventurer here in years, you must be tough. I was turned into this box a long time ago by an annoying clown... Could you help return me to my original form? I can help you become so much stronger if you do...
dialogsBegin.sp: No he visto un aventurero aquí en años, debes ser duro. Fui convertido en esta caja hace mucho tiempo por un payaso molesto.. ¿Podrías ayudarme a volver a mi forma original? Puedo ayudarte a ser mucho mas fuerte si lo haces..
dialogsBegin.sw: I haven't seen an adventurer here in years, you must be tough. I was turned into this box a long time ago by an annoying clown... Could you help return me to my original form? I can help you become so much stronger if you do...
dialogsBegin.th: ข้าไม่เห็นนักผจญภัยที่นี่มาหลายปีแล้ว เจ้าคงแข็งแกร่งมากทีเดียว ข้าถูกเปลี่ยนเป็นกล่องมาตั้งนานแล้วเพราะตัวตลกน่ารำคาญตัวนึง.. เจ้าช่วยข้ากลับไปเป็นรูปร่างเดิมทีได้ไหม ข้าจะช่วยให้เจ้าแข็งแกร่งขึ้นอีกมากถ้าเจ้าช่วยข้านะ
dialogsBegin.tw: 我好幾年沒在這裡見過冒險家了，看來你很有兩把刷子。我很久以前被一個惱人的小丑變成了這個箱子……你能幫我恢復原本的樣子嗎？只要你肯幫忙，我就能讓你變得更強……
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi đã không nhìn thấy một nhà thám hiểm đến đây trong nhiều năm rồi, bạn hẳn phải đáng gờm đấy. Tôi đã bị biến thành chiếc hộp này từ lâu bởi một tên hề phiền phức.. Bạn có thể giúp tôi trở lại hình dạng ban đầu không? Tôi có thể giúp bạn trở nên mạnh hơn rất nhiều nếu bạn làm thế..

dialogsAccept.sw: *Cackle* Wonderful hahahaha! You can start by releasing the magic chains that bind me to this location. Collect a Corrupted Symbol of Shade from a Violet monster in Darkon 1.
dialogsAccept.th: *แคร็ก* เยี่ยมยอดไปเลย ฮ่า ๆๆๆๆ! เจ้าจะเริ่มต้นได้โดยการปล่อยข้าจากโซ่เวทย์มนต์ที่ยึดข้าไว้ที่นี่ เก็บ Corrupted Symbol of Shade จาก Violet ใน Darkon 1
dialogsAccept.tw: *怪笑* 太好了，哈哈哈哈！先從解除把我困在這裡的魔法鎖鏈開始吧。去得肯 1 擊敗紫色怪物，取得 1 個腐化的闇影象徵。
dialogsAccept.vi: *Cạch cạch* Tuyệt vời hahahaha! Bạn có thể bắt đầu bằng cách giải phóng sợi xích ma thuật ràng buộc tôi với vị trí này. Thu thập Corrupted Symbol of Shade từ Violet monster trong Darkon 1.

dialogsComplete.en: Ahhh... I feel the first binding being released. One down, three to go.
dialogsComplete.ar: Ahhh... I feel the first binding being released. One down, three to go.
dialogsComplete.br: Ahhh... Sinto a primeira amarra sendo desfeita. Uma a menos, três para ir.
dialogsComplete.cns: Ahhh... I feel the first binding being released. One down, three to go.
dialogsComplete.de: Ahhh... Ich spüre, wie die erste Bindung gelöst wird. Eine erledigt, drei noch vor mir.
dialogsComplete.fi: Ahhh... I feel the first binding being released. One down, three to go.
dialogsComplete.fil: Ahhh... I feel the first binding being released. One down, three to go.
dialogsComplete.fr: Ahhh... je sens que la première reliure est libérée. Un de moins, trois de plus.
dialogsComplete.id: Ahhh .. Aku merasa ikatan pertama dilepaskan. Satu jatuh, tiga lagi.
