dialogsBegin.en: I don't know why I am telling you this... but sometimes I think back to the mighty beast Clockworks that us Dwarpets built to protect Madrigal long ago.
dialogsBegin.ar: I don't know why I am telling you this... but sometimes I think back to the mighty beast Clockworks that us Dwarpets built to protect Madrigal long ago.
dialogsBegin.br: Não faço ideia por que estou te contando isso... mas às vezes me pego relembrando da poderosa criatura Clockworks que nós (Dwarpets) construímos para proteger Madrigal tempos atrás.
dialogsBegin.cns: I don't know why I am telling you this... but sometimes I think back to the mighty beast Clockworks that us Dwarpets built to protect Madrigal long ago.
dialogsBegin.de: Ich weiß nicht, warum ich euch das erzähle, aber manchmal denke ich an das gewaltige Clockworks, die wir Dwarpets vor langer Zeit gebaut haben, um Madrigal zu schützen.
dialogsBegin.fi: I don't know why I am telling you this... but sometimes I think back to the mighty beast Clockworks that us Dwarpets built to protect Madrigal long ago.
dialogsBegin.fil: I don't know why I am telling you this... but sometimes I think back to the mighty beast Clockworks that us Dwarpets built to protect Madrigal long ago.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je ne sais pas pourquoi je vous dis ça... Mais je repense souvent aux puissantes bêtes Clockworks que nous, les Dwarpets, avons construites pour protéger Madrigal il y a bien longtemps.
dialogsBegin.id: Aku tidak tahu mengapa aku mengatakan ini kepadamu .. tetapi kadang-kadang saya berpikir kembali ke Clockworks binatang buas yang kami bangun untuk melindungi Madrigal sejak lama.
dialogsBegin.it: I don't know why I am telling you this... but sometimes I think back to the mighty beast Clockworks that us Dwarpets built to protect Madrigal long ago.
dialogsBegin.jp: なぜ私があなたにこれを言っているのかわかりません..しかし、時々、私たちドワーペットがマドリガルを守るために建てた強大な獣クロックワークスを思い出すことがあります。
dialogsBegin.kr: 왜 이런 이야기를 하고 있는지 모르겠네요... 하지만 가끔은 저도 우리 드워펫이 오래전 마드리갈을 지키려고 만든 거대한 야수, 클락워크가 생각나곤 해요.
dialogsBegin.nl: I don't know why I am telling you this... but sometimes I think back to the mighty beast Clockworks that us Dwarpets built to protect Madrigal long ago.
dialogsBegin.pl: I don't know why I am telling you this... but sometimes I think back to the mighty beast Clockworks that us Dwarpets built to protect Madrigal long ago.
dialogsBegin.ru: I don't know why I am telling you this... but sometimes I think back to the mighty beast Clockworks that us Dwarpets built to protect Madrigal long ago.
dialogsBegin.sp: No sé por qué te digo esto... pero a veces pienso en la poderosa bestia de los Mecanismos de Relojería que los Dwarpets construimos para proteger Madrigal hace mucho tiempo.
dialogsBegin.sw: I don't know why I am telling you this... but sometimes I think back to the mighty beast Clockworks that us Dwarpets built to protect Madrigal long ago.
dialogsBegin.th: ข้าไม่รู้ว่าทำไมข้าถึงเล่าเรื่องนี้ให้เจ้าฟัง แต่บางครั้งข้าก็คิดย้อนไปถึง Clockworks ที่พวกเราเหล่า Dwarpets สร้างขึ้นมาเพื่อปกป้อง Madrigal เมื่อนานมาแล้ว
dialogsBegin.tw: 我也不知道自己為什麼會對你說這些……但有時候，我還是會想起很久以前，我們矮寵一族打造的那頭巨大機械獸──機甲鐘樓。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi không biết tại sao tôi lại nói với bạn điều này.. nhưng đôi khi tôi lại hồi tưởng về quái vật hùng mạnh Clockworks mà Dwarpets chúng tôi đã chế tạo để bảo vệ Madrigal cách đây từ lâu.

dialogsBegin.en: You are a powerful warrior... you may have even fought Clockworks at its prison in Darken City. But did you know Clockworks was once used to defend all life from the evils of the Goddess Shade? Shade corrupted our creation, turning the Clockworks against the world for her own desires.
dialogsBegin.ar: You are a powerful warrior... you may have even fought Clockworks at its prison in Darken City. But did you know Clockworks was once used to defend all life from the evils of the Goddess Shade? Shade corrupted our creation, turning the Clockworks against the world for her own desires.
dialogsBegin.br: Você é um guerreiro poderoso... pode ser até que você já tenha lutado contra Clockworks em sua prisão na Cidade Sombria. Mas sabia que Clockworks foi usado uma vez para defender toda a vida dos terríveis planos da Deusa Shade? Shade corrompeu nossa criação, transformando Clockworks em uma ameaça para o mundo, tudo por seus desejos egoístas.
dialogsBegin.cns: You are a powerful warrior... you may have even fought Clockworks at its prison in Darken City. But did you know Clockworks was once used to defend all life from the evils of the Goddess Shade? Shade corrupted our creation, turning the Clockworks against the world for her own desires.
dialogsBegin.de: Du bist ein mächtiger Krieger und hast vielleicht sogar gegen Clockworks in seinem Gefängnis in Darken City gekämpft. Aber wusstest du, dass Clockworks einst eingesetzt wurde, um alles Leben vor den Übeln der Göttin Shade zu schützen? Shade korrumpierte unsere Schöpfung und wandte Clockworks gegen die Welt, um ihre eigenen Wünsche zu erfüllen.
dialogsBegin.fi: You are a powerful warrior... you may have even fought Clockworks at its prison in Darken City. But did you know Clockworks was once used to defend all life from the evils of the Goddess Shade? Shade corrupted our creation, turning the Clockworks against the world for her own desires.
dialogsBegin.fil: You are a powerful warrior... you may have even fought Clockworks at its prison in Darken City. But did you know Clockworks was once used to defend all life from the evils of the Goddess Shade? Shade corrupted our creation, turning the Clockworks against the world for her own desires.
dialogsBegin.fr: Vous êtes un puissant guerrier... Vous vous êtes peut-être même battu contre les Clockworks à la Prison de Darken. Mais saviez-vous que fut un temps les Clockworks défendait toute forme de vie contre le mal de la Déesse Shade? Shade a corrompu notre création retournant les Clockworks contre le monde pour son propre désir.
dialogsBegin.id: Kamu adalah pejuang yang kuat.. kamu bahkan mungkin pernah melawan Clockworks di penjaranya di Darken City. Tapi tahukah kamu Clockworks pernah digunakan untuk mempertahankan semua kehidupan dari kejahatan Goddess Shade? Shade merusak kreasi kami, membuat Clockworks melawan dunia demi keinginannya sendiri.
dialogsBegin.it: You are a powerful warrior... you may have even fought Clockworks at its prison in Darken City. But did you know Clockworks was once used to defend all life from the evils of the Goddess Shade? Shade corrupted our creation, turning the Clockworks against the world for her own desires.
dialogsBegin.jp: 強力な戦士よ...。あなたはダークンシティのクロックワークス永久牢獄で奴と戦ったことがあるかもしれないが。「クロックワークス 」は女神シェイドの悪から全ての生命を守る為に使われていたらしい。シェードは我々の創造物を崩壊させた。自分の欲望のために世界を敵に回したんだ。
dialogsBegin.kr: 당신은 강력한 전사예요... 다켄 시티의 감옥에서 클락워크와 싸운 경험이 있을지도 모르죠. 한때는 클락워크가 여신 쉐이드의 악행에서 모든 생명을 지켜주는 역할을 했다는 사실을 아세요? 쉐이드는 자신의 욕망을 위해 우리 창조물을 타락시켰고, 클락워크가 우리를 공격하게 했어요.
dialogsBegin.nl: You are a powerful warrior... you may have even fought Clockworks at its prison in Darken City. But did you know Clockworks was once used to defend all life from the evils of the Goddess Shade? Shade corrupted our creation, turning the Clockworks against the world for her own desires.
dialogsBegin.pl: You are a powerful warrior... you may have even fought Clockworks at its prison in Darken City. But did you know Clockworks was once used to defend all life from the evils of the Goddess Shade? Shade corrupted our creation, turning the Clockworks against the world for her own desires.
dialogsBegin.ru: You are a powerful warrior... you may have even fought Clockworks at its prison in Darken City. But did you know Clockworks was once used to defend all life from the evils of the Goddess Shade? Shade corrupted our creation, turning the Clockworks against the world for her own desires.
dialogsBegin.sp: Eres un guerrero poderoso... puede que incluso hayas luchado contra Mecanismos en su prisión de Darken City. Pero, ¿Sabías que los Mecanismos se usaron una vez para defender la vida de los males de la diosa Shade? Shade corrompió nuestra creación, volviendo al Mecanismo contra el mundo.
dialogsBegin.sw: You are a powerful warrior... you may have even fought Clockworks at its prison in Darken City. But did you know Clockworks was once used to defend all life from the evils of the Goddess Shade? Shade corrupted our creation, turning the Clockworks against the world for her own desires.
dialogsBegin.th: เจ้าเป็นนักรบที่ทรงพลัง เจ้าเคยแม้กระทั่งเคยสู้กับ Clockworks ที่คุกในเมือง Darken City แต่เจ้ารุ้ไหม จริง ๆ แล้ว Clockworks ถูกสร้างขึ้นมาเพื่อปกป้องทุกชีวิตจาก Goddess Shade? แต่ Shade ก็ได้ทำให้งานของเราแปดเปื้อนและ เปลี่่ยน Clockworks มาต่อต้านพวกเราตามที่เธอต้องการ
dialogsBegin.tw: 你是個強大的戰士……你甚至可能曾在得肯市的監牢中和機甲鐘樓交過手。但你知道嗎？機甲鐘樓原本是為了守護所有生命，抵禦女神闇影的邪惡而打造的。只是後來闇影腐化了我們的造物，讓機甲鐘樓反過來攻擊這個世界，滿足她自己的野心。
dialogsBegin.vi: Bạn là một chiến binh mạnh mẽ.. thậm chí bạn có thể đã chiến đấu với Clockworks tại nhà tù ở Darken City. Nhưng bạn có biết Clockworks từng được sử dụng để bảo vệ tất cả sinh vật sống khỏi sự xấu xa của Nữ thần Shade không? Shade đã làm hỏng tạo vật của chúng tôi, biến Clockworks thành kẻ thù của thế giới vì những tham vọng ích kỷ của ả ta..

dialogsBegin.en: My family is long gone now... but they always told tales about how Clockworks was built from mechanical parts formed in the mines around Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.ar: My family is long gone now... but they always told tales about how Clockworks was built from mechanical parts formed in the mines around Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.br: Minha família se foi há tempos... mas eles sempre me contavam contos sobre como Clockworks foi criado usando partes mecânicas encontradas nas profundezas das minas ao redor de Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.cns: My family is long gone now... but they always told tales about how Clockworks was built from mechanical parts formed in the mines around Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.de: Meine Familie ist schon lange tot, aber sie erzählte immer, dass Clockworks aus mechanischen Teilen gebaut wurden, die in den Minen um Madrigal entstanden.
dialogsBegin.fi: My family is long gone now... but they always told tales about how Clockworks was built from mechanical parts formed in the mines around Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.fil: My family is long gone now... but they always told tales about how Clockworks was built from mechanical parts formed in the mines around Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il y a longtemps que je n'ai plus de famille désormais... Mais ils me racontaient toujours des histoires sur comment les Clockworks ont été construits de pièces mécaniques dans les mines tout autour de Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.id: Keluargaku sudah lama pergi sekarang.. tetapi mereka selalu bercerita tentang bagaimana Clockworks dibangun dari bagian mekanis yang terbentuk di tambang di sekitar Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.it: My family is long gone now... but they always told tales about how Clockworks was built from mechanical parts formed in the mines around Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.jp: 私の家族はもうずっといなくなっています..しかし、彼らは常に、マドリガル周辺の鉱山で形成された機械部品から時計製作所がどのように構築されたかについての話をしました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 이제 가족들은 아무도 남지 않았지만... 늘 마드리갈 주변의 광산에서 얻은 기계 부품으로 클락워크를 만들었다고 했었거든요.
dialogsBegin.nl: My family is long gone now... but they always told tales about how Clockworks was built from mechanical parts formed in the mines around Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.pl: My family is long gone now... but they always told tales about how Clockworks was built from mechanical parts formed in the mines around Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.ru: My family is long gone now... but they always told tales about how Clockworks was built from mechanical parts formed in the mines around Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.sp: Mi familia ya no está... pero siempre contaban historias sobre cómo se construyó el Mecanismo a partir de piezas mecánicas formadas en las minas de los alrededores de Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.sw: My family is long gone now... but they always told tales about how Clockworks was built from mechanical parts formed in the mines around Madrigal.
dialogsBegin.th: ครอบครัวของข้าจากไปนานแล้ว แต่พวกเขามักคอยเล่าเรื่องนี้มาเสมอๆ เกี่ยวกับ Clockworks นั้นถูกสร้างมาจากชิ้นส่วนจักรกลจากเหมืองรอบ ๆ Madrigal
dialogsBegin.tw: 我的家人如今都不在了……但他們總是提起，機甲鐘樓是用瑪德利賈各處礦坑中開採出的機械零件所打造而成的。
dialogsBegin.vi: Gia đình tôi giờ đã mất lâu rồi.. nhưng hồi ấy họ vẫn luôn kể những câu chuyện về cách Clockworks được chế tạo từ các bộ phận máy móc được hình thành trong các mỏ xung quanh Madrigal.

dialogsBegin.en: It's a long shot, but I want to try and seek out any lost parts from back then that may have been left behind in the mines. I haven't been successful in finding anything during my stay here at the Dekane Mine, but I've heard there is a mine deep in the mountains of Azria...
dialogsBegin.ar: It's a long shot, but I want to try and seek out any lost parts from back then that may have been left behind in the mines. I haven't been successful in finding anything during my stay here at the Dekane Mine, but I've heard there is a mine deep in the mountains of Azria...
dialogsBegin.br: É uma jogada ousada, mas estou determinado a buscar por quaisquer peças perdidas daquela época que possam ter sido deixadas para trás nas minas. Infelizmente, minha estadia aqui na Mina Dekane não rendeu frutos, mas dizem que há uma mina escondida nas profundezas das montanhas de Azria...
dialogsBegin.cns: It's a long shot, but I want to try and seek out any lost parts from back then that may have been left behind in the mines. I haven't been successful in finding anything during my stay here at the Dekane Mine, but I've heard there is a mine deep in the mountains of Azria...
dialogsBegin.de: Es ist weit hergeholt, aber ich möchte versuchen, alle verlorenen Teile von damals zu finden, die vielleicht in den Minen zurückgelassen worden sind. Während meines Aufenthalts hier in der Dekane-Mine habe ich nichts gefunden, aber ich habe gehört, dass es tief in den Bergen von Azria eine Mine gibt...
dialogsBegin.fi: It's a long shot, but I want to try and seek out any lost parts from back then that may have been left behind in the mines. I haven't been successful in finding anything during my stay here at the Dekane Mine, but I've heard there is a mine deep in the mountains of Azria...
dialogsBegin.fil: It's a long shot, but I want to try and seek out any lost parts from back then that may have been left behind in the mines. I haven't been successful in finding anything during my stay here at the Dekane Mine, but I've heard there is a mine deep in the mountains of Azria...
dialogsBegin.fr: Ce n'est pas gagné, mais je veux essayer de retrouver des pièces perdues à l'époque, qui auraient été abandonnées dans les mines. Je n'ai rien trouvé pendant mon séjour à la mine Dekane, mais j'ai entendu dire qu'il y avait une mine au fin fond des montagnes d'Azria...
dialogsBegin.id: Ini tembakan yang panjang, tetapi aku ingin mencoba dan mencari bagian yang hilang dari masa lalu yang mungkin tertinggal di tambang. Aku belum berhasil menemukan apa pun selama tinggal di sini di Tambang Dekane, tetapi aku pernah mendengar ada tambang jauh di pegunungan Azria..
dialogsBegin.it: It's a long shot, but I want to try and seek out any lost parts from back then that may have been left behind in the mines. I haven't been successful in finding anything during my stay here at the Dekane Mine, but I've heard there is a mine deep in the mountains of Azria...
dialogsBegin.jp: ロングショットですが、鉱山に残された可能性のある当時の失われた部品を探してみたいと思います。デカネ鉱山に滞在している間は何も見つかりませんでしたが、アズリアの山奥に鉱山があると聞いています。
dialogsBegin.kr: 가능성은 희박하지만, 당시의 부품이 광산에 남아 있을지도 모르니 찾아보고 싶어요. 이곳 데카네 광산에 머무르는 동안은 아무것도 찾지 못했지만, 아즈리아 산 깊은 곳에도 광산이 있다고 들었어요...
dialogsBegin.nl: It's a long shot, but I want to try and seek out any lost parts from back then that may have been left behind in the mines. I haven't been successful in finding anything during my stay here at the Dekane Mine, but I've heard there is a mine deep in the mountains of Azria...
dialogsBegin.pl: It's a long shot, but I want to try and seek out any lost parts from back then that may have been left behind in the mines. I haven't been successful in finding anything during my stay here at the Dekane Mine, but I've heard there is a mine deep in the mountains of Azria...
dialogsBegin.ru: It's a long shot, but I want to try and seek out any lost parts from back then that may have been left behind in the mines. I haven't been successful in finding anything during my stay here at the Dekane Mine, but I've heard there is a mine deep in the mountains of Azria...
dialogsBegin.sp: Es una posibilidad remota, pero quiero intentar buscar cualquier pieza perdida de entonces que pueda haber quedado en las minas. No he tenido éxito en encontrar nada durante mi estancia aquí en la mina Dekane, pero he oído que hay una mina en lo profundo de las montañas de Azria...
dialogsBegin.sw: It's a long shot, but I want to try and seek out any lost parts from back then that may have been left behind in the mines. I haven't been successful in finding anything during my stay here at the Dekane Mine, but I've heard there is a mine deep in the mountains of Azria...
dialogsBegin.th: มันก็นานมาแล้วนะ แต่ข้าอยากจะลองหาดูว่ามีชิ้นส่วนไหนหลงเหลือทิ้งไว้ในเหมืองบ้างรึเปล่า ตอนที่ข้าอยุ่ที่นั่นข้าไม่เคยเจออะไรเลยใน Dekane Mine แต่ข้าได้ยินว่ามันยังมีเหมืองที่ลึกลงไปอีกที่ภูเขาของ Azria
dialogsBegin.tw: 雖然希望渺茫，但我還是想找找看，當年有沒有遺失在礦坑裡的零件。我一直待在迪坎礦坑，卻始終一無所獲，不過我聽說在阿茲里亞深山裡還有一座礦坑……
dialogsBegin.vi: Đó là một chặng đường dài, nhưng tôi muốn thử tìm kiếm bất kỳ bộ phận nào bị thất lạc từ ​​​​thời đó và bị bỏ lại trong hầm mỏ. Tôi đã không thành công trong việc tìm kiếm bất cứ thứ gì trong thời gian ở đây tại Dekane Mine, nhưng tôi nghe nói có một mỏ nằm sâu trong vùng núi Azria..

dialogsBegin.en: I think there may be lost technology hidden in the Azria Mine that may allow us to create something that could one day rid the world of Shade's cursed creatures, the masquerpets.
dialogsBegin.ar: I think there may be lost technology hidden in the Azria Mine that may allow us to create something that could one day rid the world of Shade's cursed creatures, the masquerpets.
dialogsBegin.br: Eu tenho a impressão de que pode haver tecnologias perdidas na Mina de Azria que nos permitiria criar algo capaz de erradicar as criaturas amaldiçoadas de Shade, os masquerpets.
dialogsBegin.cns: I think there may be lost technology hidden in the Azria Mine that may allow us to create something that could one day rid the world of Shade's cursed creatures, the masquerpets.
dialogsBegin.de: Ich glaube, in der Azria-Mine könnte eine verlorene Technologie versteckt sein, die es uns ermöglichen könnte, etwas zu erschaffen, das die Welt eines Tages von Shades verfluchten Kreaturen, den Masquerpets, befreien könnte.
dialogsBegin.fi: I think there may be lost technology hidden in the Azria Mine that may allow us to create something that could one day rid the world of Shade's cursed creatures, the masquerpets.
dialogsBegin.fil: I think there may be lost technology hidden in the Azria Mine that may allow us to create something that could one day rid the world of Shade's cursed creatures, the masquerpets.
dialogsBegin.fr: Je pense qu'il y a peut-être une technologie perdue cachée dans la mine Azria qui pourrait nous permettre de créer quelque chose qui pourrait un jour débarrasser le monde des créatures maudites de Shade.
dialogsBegin.id: Saya pikir mungkin ada teknologi hilang yang tersembunyi di Azria Mine yang memungkinkan kita menciptakan sesuatu yang suatu hari nanti dapat menyingkirkan dunia dari makhluk terkutuk Shade, para penyamar.
dialogsBegin.it: I think there may be lost technology hidden in the Azria Mine that may allow us to create something that could one day rid the world of Shade's cursed creatures, the masquerpets.
dialogsBegin.jp: アズリア鉱山には失われた技術が隠されているかもしれないので、いつの日かシェイドの呪われた生き物である仮面舞踏会の世界を取り除くことができる何かを作ることができるかもしれません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 아즈리아 광산에 잃어버린 기술이 숨겨져 있다면, 그걸로 언젠가 쉐이드가 만들어낸 저주받은 생명체인 마스커펫들을 없앨 수단을 만들 수 있을지도 모르죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: I think there may be lost technology hidden in the Azria Mine that may allow us to create something that could one day rid the world of Shade's cursed creatures, the masquerpets.
dialogsBegin.pl: I think there may be lost technology hidden in the Azria Mine that may allow us to create something that could one day rid the world of Shade's cursed creatures, the masquerpets.
dialogsBegin.ru: I think there may be lost technology hidden in the Azria Mine that may allow us to create something that could one day rid the world of Shade's cursed creatures, the masquerpets.
dialogsBegin.sp: Creo que puede haber tecnología perdida oculta en la Mina Azria que nos permita crear algo que algún día pueda librar al mundo de las criaturas malditas de Shade, los masquerpets.
dialogsBegin.sw: I think there may be lost technology hidden in the Azria Mine that may allow us to create something that could one day rid the world of Shade's cursed creatures, the masquerpets.
dialogsBegin.th: ข้าคิดว่ามันอาจจะยังมีเทคโนโลยี่ที่สาปสูญซ่อนอยู่ใน Azria Mine ที่จะทำให้วันนึงเราสามารถสร้างบางอย่างที่สามารถกำจัดโลกที่เต็มไปด้วยสัตว์ที่ถูกสาปจาก Shade, masquerpets
dialogsBegin.tw: 我想阿茲里亞礦坑裡也許藏著失落的技術，將來說不定能讓我們打造出足以徹底消滅闇影那些詛咒怪物──假面怪的武器。
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi nghĩ rằng có thể có một công nghệ đã bị thất lạc ẩn giấu trong Azria Mine có thể cho phép chúng ta tạo ra thứ gì đó mà một ngày nào đó có thể giải thoát thế giới khỏi những sinh vật bị nguyền rủa của Shade, những con masquerpet.

dialogsAccept.en: Thank you for helping me... it's rare that I work with humans who are so willing. Please go to the Azria Village and find someone who knows about the Azria Mine.
dialogsAccept.ar: Thank you for helping me... it's rare that I work with humans who are so willing. Please go to the Azria Village and find someone who knows about the Azria Mine.
dialogsAccept.br: Agradeço pela sua ajuda... não é todo dia que encontro humanos tão dispostos a se aventurar. Por favor, vá até a Vila de Azria e encontre alguém que saiba sobre a Mina de Azria.
dialogsAccept.cns: Thank you for helping me... it's rare that I work with humans who are so willing. Please go to the Azria Village and find someone who knows about the Azria Mine.
dialogsAccept.de: Danke, dass du mir hilfst. Es ist selten, dass ich mit Menschen arbeite, die so bereitwillig sind. Bitte geh ins Azria-Dorf und finde jemanden, der etwas über die Azria-Mine weiß.
dialogsAccept.fi: Thank you for helping me... it's rare that I work with humans who are so willing. Please go to the Azria Village and find someone who knows about the Azria Mine.
dialogsAccept.fil: Thank you for helping me... it's rare that I work with humans who are so willing. Please go to the Azria Village and find someone who knows about the Azria Mine.
dialogsAccept.fr: Merci de m'aider... Il est rare que je travaille avec des humains qui sont si bien disposés. Allez au Village d'Azria et trouvez quelqu'un qui connaît la mine Azria.
dialogsAccept.id: Terima kasih telah membantuku.. jarang aku bekerja dengan manusia yang begitu rela. Silakan pergi ke Azria Village dan temukan seseorang yang tahu tentang Azria Mine.
dialogsAccept.it: Thank you for helping me... it's rare that I work with humans who are so willing. Please go to the Azria Village and find someone who knows about the Azria Mine.
dialogsAccept.jp: 私を助けてくれてありがとう..これほど意欲的な人間と一緒に仕事をすることはめったにありません。アズリア村に行って、アズリア鉱山について知っている人を見つけてください。
dialogsAccept.kr: 도와줘서 고맙습니다... 이렇게 기꺼이 도움을 주는 인간은 정말 오랜만이군요. 아즈리아 마을로 가서 아즈리아 광산에 대해 아는 사람을 찾아주세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Thank you for helping me... it's rare that I work with humans who are so willing. Please go to the Azria Village and find someone who knows about the Azria Mine.
dialogsAccept.pl: Thank you for helping me... it's rare that I work with humans who are so willing. Please go to the Azria Village and find someone who knows about the Azria Mine.
dialogsAccept.ru: Thank you for helping me... it's rare that I work with humans who are so willing. Please go to the Azria Village and find someone who knows about the Azria Mine.
dialogsAccept.sp: Gracias por ayudarme... es raro que trabaje con humanos tan dispuestos. Por favor, ve a la Aldea Azria y encuentra a alguien que conozca la Mina Azria.
dialogsAccept.sw: Thank you for helping me... it's rare that I work with humans who are so willing. Please go to the Azria Village and find someone who knows about the Azria Mine.
dialogsAccept.th: ขอบคุณมากที่ช่วยข้า มันหายากมากที่ข้าจะได้ร่วมงานกับมนุษย์ที่ตั้งใจจะช่วย โปรดไปที่ Azria Village และหาใครซักคนที่รู้ข้อมูลเกี่ยวกับ Azria Mine
dialogsAccept.tw: 謝謝你願意幫我……很少有人類會這麼爽快地和我合作。請前往阿茲里亞村，找一位知道阿茲里亞礦坑情報的人。
dialogsAccept.vi: Cảm ơn vì đã giúp đỡ tôi.. thật hiếm khi tôi được làm việc với những con người sẵn lòng như vậy. Vui lòng đến Azria Village và tìm ai đó biết về Azria Mine.

dialogsDecline.en: I'm not surprised... humans were never good to us Dwarpets anyway.
dialogsDecline.ar: I'm not surprised... humans were never good to us Dwarpets anyway.
dialogsDecline.br: Não posso dizer que estou surpreso... afinal, os humanos nunca foram lá muito simpáticos conosco, Dwarpets.
dialogsDecline.cns: I'm not surprised... humans were never good to us Dwarpets anyway.
dialogsDecline.de: Das überrascht mich nicht. Die Menschen waren sowieso nie gut zu uns Dwarpets.
dialogsDecline.fi: I'm not surprised... humans were never good to us Dwarpets anyway.
dialogsDecline.fil: I'm not surprised... humans were never good to us Dwarpets anyway.
dialogsDecline.fr: Je ne suis pas surpris... Les humains n'ont jamais été bons avec nous, les Dwarpets.
dialogsDecline.id: Aku tidak terkejut.. bagaimanapun juga manusia tidak pernah baik pada kita Dwarpet.
dialogsDecline.it: I'm not surprised... humans were never good to us Dwarpets anyway.
dialogsDecline.jp: 私は驚かない..とにかく、人間は私たちドワーペットにとって決して良くありませんでした。
dialogsDecline.kr: 놀랍진 않군요... 어차피 인간은 우리 드워펫에게 잘해줬던 적이 없으니까요.
dialogsDecline.nl: I'm not surprised... humans were never good to us Dwarpets anyway.
dialogsDecline.pl: I'm not surprised... humans were never good to us Dwarpets anyway.
dialogsDecline.ru: I'm not surprised... humans were never good to us Dwarpets anyway.
dialogsDecline.sp: No me sorprende... los humanos nunca fueron buenos con nosotros los Dwarpets de todos modos.
dialogsDecline.sw: I'm not surprised... humans were never good to us Dwarpets anyway.
dialogsDecline.th: ข้าไม่แปลกใจหรอก พวกมนุษย์ไม่เคยจะทำดีอะไรกับพวกเรา Dwarpets อยู่แล้ว
dialogsDecline.tw: 我一點也不意外……反正人類從來就不怎麼善待我們矮寵。
dialogsDecline.vi: Tôi không ngạc nhiên đâu.. Dù sao thì con người cũng không bao giờ tử tế với Dwarpets chúng tôi.

dialogsComplete.en: Hello warrior, so you want to know more about the mines here in Azria?
dialogsComplete.ar: Hello warrior, so you want to know more about the mines here in Azria?
dialogsComplete.br: Saudações, nobre guerreiro! Vejo que deseja conhecer mais sobre as minas aqui em Azria.
dialogsComplete.cns: Hello warrior, so you want to know more about the mines here in Azria?
dialogsComplete.de: Hallo Krieger, du willst also mehr über die Minen hier in Azria erfahren?
dialogsComplete.fi: Hello warrior, so you want to know more about the mines here in Azria?
dialogsComplete.fil: Hello warrior, so you want to know more about the mines here in Azria?
dialogsComplete.fr: Bien le bonjour guerrier ! Alors comme ça vous souhaitez en savoir plus sur les mines à Azria ?
dialogsComplete.id: Halo prajurit, jadi Anda ingin tahu lebih banyak tentang tambang di Azria?
dialogsComplete.it: Hello warrior, so you want to know more about the mines here in Azria?
dialogsComplete.jp: こんにちは戦士、それであなたはここアズリアの鉱山についてもっと知りたいですか?
dialogsComplete.kr: 안녕하세요, 전사님, 이곳 아즈리아의 광산에 관해 더 알고 싶다고요?
dialogsComplete.nl: Hello warrior, so you want to know more about the mines here in Azria?
dialogsComplete.pl: Hello warrior, so you want to know more about the mines here in Azria?
dialogsComplete.ru: Hello warrior, so you want to know more about the mines here in Azria?
dialogsComplete.sp: Hola guerrero, ¿Quieres saber más sobre las minas de Azria?
dialogsComplete.sw: Hello warrior, so you want to know more about the mines here in Azria?
dialogsComplete.th: สวัสดีท่านนักรบ ท่านต้องการรู้มากกว่านี้เกี่ยวกับเหมืองใน Azria ใช่ไหม?
dialogsComplete.tw: 你好啊，戰士。所以你想知道這裡礦坑的事？
dialogsComplete.vi: Xin chào warrior, vậy bạn có muốn biết thêm về các mỏ ở Azria không?

dialogsFail.en: Speak to someone in Azria Village who knows about the Azria Mine.
dialogsFail.ar: Speak to someone in Azria Village who knows about the Azria Mine.
dialogsFail.br: Fale com alguém na Vila de Azria que conheça a Mina de Azria.
dialogsFail.cns: Speak to someone in Azria Village who knows about the Azria Mine.
dialogsFail.de: Sprich mit jemandem in Azria Village, der etwas über die Azria-Mine weiß.
dialogsFail.fi: Speak to someone in Azria Village who knows about the Azria Mine.
dialogsFail.fil: Speak to someone in Azria Village who knows about the Azria Mine.
dialogsFail.fr: Parlez à quelqu'un au Village d'Azria qui en sait d'avantage sur la mine.
dialogsFail.id: Bicaralah dengan seseorang di Desa Azria yang mengetahui tentang Tambang Azria.
dialogsFail.it: Speak to someone in Azria Village who knows about the Azria Mine.
dialogsFail.jp: アズリア鉱山について知っているアズリア村の誰かと話してください。
dialogsFail.kr: 아즈리아 마을에서 아즈리아 광산에 관해 알고 있는 사람을 찾아 대화를 나눠보세요.
dialogsFail.nl: Speak to someone in Azria Village who knows about the Azria Mine.
dialogsFail.pl: Speak to someone in Azria Village who knows about the Azria Mine.
dialogsFail.ru: Speak to someone in Azria Village who knows about the Azria Mine.
dialogsFail.sp: Habla con alguien en la Aldea Azria que conozca la Mina Azria.
dialogsFail.sw: Speak to someone in Azria Village who knows about the Azria Mine.
dialogsFail.th: พูดกับใครซักคนที่ Azria Village ที่อาจจะรู้เรื่องเกี่ยวกับ Azria Mine
dialogsFail.tw: 去找阿茲里亞村中知道阿茲里亞礦坑的人。
dialogsFail.vi: Nói chuyện với ai đó ở Azria Village biết về Azria Mine.

description.br: Derrote 60 Executores Tanuki e o Protetor Tanuki.
description.cns: Defeat 60 Tanuki Enforcer and the Tanuki Protector.
description.de: Besiege 60 Tanuki-Vollstrecker und den Tanuki-Beschützer.
description.fi: Defeat 60 Tanuki Enforcer and the Tanuki Protector.
description.fil: Defeat 60 Tanuki Enforcer and the Tanuki Protector.
description.fr: Vaincre 60 Tanukis Géants et le Guerrier Tanuki Géant.

description.it: Defeat 60 Tanuki Enforcer and the Tanuki Protector.
description.jp: タヌキエンフォーサーとタヌキプロテクターを60体倒す。

description.pl: Defeat 60 Tanuki Enforcer and the Tanuki Protector.

dialogsBegin.en: The fight through the Wilds has only just begun. Armed with your newfound experience in the Wilds, you're ready to confront something even more perilous.
dialogsBegin.ar: The fight through the Wilds has only just begun. Armed with your newfound experience in the Wilds, you're ready to confront something even more perilous.
dialogsBegin.br: A luta pelas Wilds apenas começou. Armado com sua nova experiência nas Wilds, você está pronto para enfrentar algo ainda mais perigoso.
dialogsBegin.cns: The fight through the Wilds has only just begun. Armed with your newfound experience in the Wilds, you're ready to confront something even more perilous.
dialogsBegin.de: Der Kampf durch die Wildnis hat gerade erst begonnen. Mit deiner neu gewonnenen Erfahrung in der Wildnis bist du bereit, dich etwas noch Gefährlicherem zu stellen.
dialogsBegin.fi: The fight through the Wilds has only just begun. Armed with your newfound experience in the Wilds, you're ready to confront something even more perilous.
dialogsBegin.fil: The fight through the Wilds has only just begun. Armed with your newfound experience in the Wilds, you're ready to confront something even more perilous.
dialogsBegin.fr: Le combat dans Désiréa ne fait que commencer. Armé de cette nouvelle expéreince, vous êtes prêt à affronter quelque chose d'encore plus périlleux.
dialogsBegin.id: Pertarungan di Wilds baru saja dimulai. Berbekal pengalaman baru di Wilds, kamu siap menghadapi sesuatu yang lebih berbahaya.
dialogsBegin.it: The fight through the Wilds has only just begun. Armed with your newfound experience in the Wilds, you're ready to confront something even more perilous.
dialogsBegin.jp: 荒野での戦いはまだ始まったばかりです。荒野で新たに得た経験を武器に、さらに危険なものに立ち向かう準備が整いました。
dialogsBegin.kr: 러스티아에서의 싸움은 이제 시작입니다. 러스티아에서 새로운 경험으로 단단히 무장했으니, 이제 더 위험한 존재와도 맞설 준비가 되셨겠죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: The fight through the Wilds has only just begun. Armed with your newfound experience in the Wilds, you're ready to confront something even more perilous.
dialogsBegin.pl: The fight through the Wilds has only just begun. Armed with your newfound experience in the Wilds, you're ready to confront something even more perilous.
dialogsBegin.ru: The fight through the Wilds has only just begun. Armed with your newfound experience in the Wilds, you're ready to confront something even more perilous.
dialogsBegin.sp: La lucha en los Salvajes apenas ha comenzado. Armado con tu nueva experiencia en lo Salvaje, estás listo para enfrentar algo aún más peligroso.
dialogsBegin.sw: The fight through the Wilds has only just begun. Armed with your newfound experience in the Wilds, you're ready to confront something even more perilous.
dialogsBegin.th: การต่อสู้ในป่าเพิ่งจะเริ่มต้นขึ้นเท่านั้น เมื่อคุณได้สัมผัสกับการต่อสู้ในป่าแล้ว คุณก็พร้อมที่จะเผชิญหน้ากับสิ่งที่อันตรายยิ่งกว่าเดิม
dialogsBegin.tw: 荒野叢境中的戰鬥才剛開始而已。如今你已有了在荒野叢境作戰的經驗，也該去面對更加危險的對手了。
dialogsBegin.vi: Cuộc chiến xuyên qua Wilds chỉ mới bắt đầu. Được trang bị với trải nghiệm mới có được ở Wilds, bạn đã sẵn sàng đối đầu với điều gì đó thậm chí còn nguy hiểm hơn.

dialogsAccept.en: Return to the Wilds and face the army of Tanuki warriors who stand as guardians of the King's lush garden.
dialogsAccept.ar: Return to the Wilds and face the army of Tanuki warriors who stand as guardians of the King's lush garden.
dialogsAccept.br: Retorne às Wilds e enfrente o exército de guerreiros Tanuki que se erguem como guardiões do exuberante jardim do Rei.
dialogsAccept.cns: Return to the Wilds and face the army of Tanuki warriors who stand as guardians of the King's lush garden.
dialogsAccept.de: Kehre in die Wildnis zurück und stelle dich einer Armee von Tanuki-Kriegern, die den üppigen Garten des Königs bewachen.
dialogsAccept.fi: Return to the Wilds and face the army of Tanuki warriors who stand as guardians of the King's lush garden.
dialogsAccept.fil: Return to the Wilds and face the army of Tanuki warriors who stand as guardians of the King's lush garden.
dialogsAccept.fr: Retournez dans Désiréa et affrontez l'armée de guerriers Tanuki qui se tiennent en tant que gardiens du jardin luxuriant du roi.
dialogsAccept.id: Kembalilah ke Wilds dan hadapi pasukan prajurit Tanuki yang bertugas sebagai penjaga taman rindang milik Raja.
dialogsAccept.it: Return to the Wilds and face the army of Tanuki warriors who stand as guardians of the King's lush garden.
dialogsAccept.jp: 荒野に戻り、王の緑豊かな庭園の守護者として立っているタヌキの戦士の軍隊に立ち向かいます。
dialogsAccept.kr: 러스티아로 돌아가, 왕의 울창한 정원을 수호하는 타누키 전사 무리와 맞서 싸우세요.
dialogsAccept.nl: Return to the Wilds and face the army of Tanuki warriors who stand as guardians of the King's lush garden.
dialogsAccept.pl: Return to the Wilds and face the army of Tanuki warriors who stand as guardians of the King's lush garden.
dialogsAccept.ru: Return to the Wilds and face the army of Tanuki warriors who stand as guardians of the King's lush garden.
dialogsAccept.sp: Regresa a los Salvajes y enfréntate al ejército de guerreros Tanuki que custodian el exuberante jardín del Rey.
dialogsAccept.sw: Return to the Wilds and face the army of Tanuki warriors who stand as guardians of the King's lush garden.
dialogsAccept.th: กลับสู่ Wilds และเผชิญหน้ากับกองทัพนักรบ Tanuki ที่ยืนเป็นผู้พิทักษ์สวนอันเขียวชอุ่มของราชา
dialogsAccept.tw: 返回荒野叢境，迎戰那些守護獸王繁盛花園的狸貓戰士軍團。
dialogsAccept.vi: Quay trở lại Wilds và đối mặt với đội quân chiến binh Tanuki, những người đứng ra bảo vệ khu vườn tươi tốt của Nhà vua.

dialogsDecline.en: The last fight certainly tested your mettle. Rest for a while, and let me know when you are ready to proceed.
dialogsDecline.ar: The last fight certainly tested your mettle. Rest for a while, and let me know when you are ready to proceed.
dialogsDecline.br: A última luta certamente testou sua coragem. Descanse por um tempo e me avise quando estiver pronto para continuar.
dialogsDecline.cns: The last fight certainly tested your mettle. Rest for a while, and let me know when you are ready to proceed.
dialogsDecline.de: Der letzte Kampf hat dich auf eine harte Probe gestellt. Ruhe dich eine Weile aus und sag mir Bescheid, wenn du bereit bist, weiterzumachen.
dialogsDecline.fi: The last fight certainly tested your mettle. Rest for a while, and let me know when you are ready to proceed.
dialogsDecline.fil: The last fight certainly tested your mettle. Rest for a while, and let me know when you are ready to proceed.
dialogsDecline.fr: Le dernier combat vous a mis à l'épreuve. Reposez-vous un peu et faites-moi savoir quand vous serez prêt à continuer.
dialogsDecline.id: Pertarungan terakhir tentu menguji keberanianmu. Beristirahatlah sejenak, dan beri tahu aku saat kamu siap untuk melanjutkan.
dialogsDecline.it: The last fight certainly tested your mettle. Rest for a while, and let me know when you are ready to proceed.
dialogsDecline.jp: 最後の戦いは確かにあなたの気概を試しました。しばらく休んで、準備ができたら教えてください。
dialogsDecline.kr: 마지막 전투는 정말 만만치 않았어요. 잠시 휴식을 취하시고, 계속할 준비가 되면 알려주세요.
dialogsDecline.nl: The last fight certainly tested your mettle. Rest for a while, and let me know when you are ready to proceed.
dialogsDecline.pl: The last fight certainly tested your mettle. Rest for a while, and let me know when you are ready to proceed.
dialogsDecline.ru: The last fight certainly tested your mettle. Rest for a while, and let me know when you are ready to proceed.
dialogsDecline.sp: La última pelea puso a prueba tu temple. Descansa un rato y avíseme cuando esté listo para continuar.
dialogsDecline.sw: The last fight certainly tested your mettle. Rest for a while, and let me know when you are ready to proceed.
dialogsDecline.th: การต่อสู้ครั้งสุดท้าย จะทดสอบความอดทนของคุณอย่างแน่นอน พักผ่อนสักครู่ แล้วบอกฉัน เมื่อคุณพร้อมที่จะไปต่อ
dialogsDecline.tw: 上一場戰鬥確實很考驗你的膽識。先休息一會兒，等你準備好了再告訴我。
dialogsDecline.vi: Trận chiến vừa qua chắc chắn đã thử thách dũng khí của bạn. Hãy nghỉ ngơi một lúc và cho tôi biết khi nào bạn sẵn sàng tiếp tục.

dialogsComplete.en: The King's army has begun to dwindle! Only the most powerful of his guardians remain to defend him.
dialogsComplete.ar: The King's army has begun to dwindle! Only the most powerful of his guardians remain to defend him.
dialogsComplete.br: O exército do Rei começou a diminuir! Apenas os mais poderosos de seus guardiões permanecem para defendê-lo.
dialogsComplete.cns: The King's army has begun to dwindle! Only the most powerful of his guardians remain to defend him.
dialogsComplete.de: Die Armee des Königs ist geschrumpft! Nur die mächtigsten seiner Wächter können ihn noch verteidigen.
dialogsComplete.fi: The King's army has begun to dwindle! Only the most powerful of his guardians remain to defend him.
dialogsComplete.fil: The King's army has begun to dwindle! Only the most powerful of his guardians remain to defend him.
dialogsComplete.fr: L'armée du Roi a commencé à s'affaiblir ! Seuls les plus puissants de ses gardiens restent pour le défendre.
dialogsComplete.id: Pasukan Raja sudah mulai menyusut! Hanya pengawalnya yang paling kuat yang tersisa untuk melindunginya.
dialogsComplete.it: The King's army has begun to dwindle! Only the most powerful of his guardians remain to defend him.
dialogsComplete.jp: 王の軍隊が減り始めました!彼を守るために残っているのは、彼の守護者の中で最も強力な者だけです。
dialogsComplete.kr: 왕의 군세가 약해지기 시작했어요! 이제 남은 것은 왕을 지키는 가장 강력한 수호자들뿐이군요.
dialogsComplete.nl: The King's army has begun to dwindle! Only the most powerful of his guardians remain to defend him.
dialogsComplete.pl: The King's army has begun to dwindle! Only the most powerful of his guardians remain to defend him.
dialogsComplete.ru: The King's army has begun to dwindle! Only the most powerful of his guardians remain to defend him.
dialogsComplete.sp: ¡El ejército del Rey está menguando! Sólo los más poderosos de sus guardianes quedan para defenderlo.
dialogsComplete.sw: The King's army has begun to dwindle! Only the most powerful of his guardians remain to defend him.
dialogsComplete.th: กองทัพของราชาเริ่มลดน้อยลง! มีเพียงผู้พิทักษ์ที่แข็งแกร่งที่สุดเท่านั้นที่ยังคอยปกป้องพระองค์
dialogsComplete.tw: 獸王的軍勢已開始衰退！現在只剩下牠最強大的守衛還在護著牠。
dialogsComplete.vi: Quân đội của nhà vua đã bắt đầu suy giảm! Chỉ còn lại những người mạnh mẽ nhất để bảo vệ anh ta.

dialogsFail.en: You're so close to victory adventurer, do not give up hope. Defeat the Tanuki, and march ever closer to the King's chambers.
dialogsFail.ar: You're so close to victory adventurer, do not give up hope. Defeat the Tanuki, and march ever closer to the King's chambers.
dialogsFail.br: Você está tão perto da vitória, aventureiro, não perca a esperança. Derrote os Tanuki e marche cada vez mais perto das câmaras do Rei.
dialogsFail.cns: You're so close to victory adventurer, do not give up hope. Defeat the Tanuki, and march ever closer to the King's chambers.
dialogsFail.de: Du bist dem Sieg so nahe, Abenteurer, gib die Hoffnung nicht auf. Besiege die Tanuki und rücke immer weiter zu den Gemächern des Königs vor.
dialogsFail.fi: You're so close to victory adventurer, do not give up hope. Defeat the Tanuki, and march ever closer to the King's chambers.
dialogsFail.fil: You're so close to victory adventurer, do not give up hope. Defeat the Tanuki, and march ever closer to the King's chambers.
dialogsFail.fr: Vous êtes si près de la victoire, aventurier, ne perdez pas espoir. Vainquez les Tanuki et rapprochez-vous des chambres du Roi.
dialogsFail.id: Kamu sudah sangat dekat dengan kemenangan, petualang, jangan menyerah. Kalahkan Tanuki, dan majulah semakin dekat ke kamar Raja.
dialogsFail.it: You're so close to victory adventurer, do not give up hope. Defeat the Tanuki, and march ever closer to the King's chambers.
dialogsFail.jp: あなたは勝利の冒険者に近づきました、希望をあきらめないでください。タヌキを倒し、王の部屋に近づく。
dialogsFail.kr: 성공한 모험가가 코앞이니, 희망을 버리지 마세요. 타누키를 처치하고 왕의 알현실에 더 가까이 진군하세요.
dialogsFail.nl: You're so close to victory adventurer, do not give up hope. Defeat the Tanuki, and march ever closer to the King's chambers.
dialogsFail.pl: You're so close to victory adventurer, do not give up hope. Defeat the Tanuki, and march ever closer to the King's chambers.
dialogsFail.ru: You're so close to victory adventurer, do not give up hope. Defeat the Tanuki, and march ever closer to the King's chambers.
dialogsFail.sp: Estás cerca de la victoria aventurero, no pierdas la esperanza. Derrota a los Tanuki y avanza hacia los aposentos del Rey.
dialogsFail.sw: You're so close to victory adventurer, do not give up hope. Defeat the Tanuki, and march ever closer to the King's chambers.
dialogsFail.th: เจ้าเข้าใกล้ชัยชนะแล้วนักผจญภัย อย่าหมดหวัง จงปราบพวกทานูกิ และเดินทัพให้ใกล้ห้องของราชาให้มากขึ้น
dialogsFail.tw: 你離勝利已經很近了，冒險家，不要放棄。擊敗狸貓們，朝獸王的王座更進一步吧。
dialogsFail.vi: Người du hành, bạn đã gần chạm đến chiến thắng rồi, đừng từ bỏ hy vọng. Đánh bại Tanuki và tiến ngày một gần hơn đến nơi ở của nhà vua.

description.ar: Visit the Atlar of Violet in Darkon 1.
description.br: Visite o Altar de Violeta em Darkon 1.
description.cns: Visit the Atlar of Violet in Darkon 1.
description.de: Besuche den Altar of Violet in Darkon 1.
description.fi: Visit the Atlar of Violet in Darkon 1.

description.fr: Visitez l'Atlar de Violet dans Darkon 1.

description.it: Visit the Atlar of Violet in Darkon 1.
description.jp: ダーコン1のバイオレットのアトラーを訪れてください。

description.pl: Visit the Atlar of Violet in Darkon 1.

dialogsBegin.en: I can feel my power slowly returning... HAHAHAHAHA! Yes... yes... time for another binding to be released!
dialogsBegin.ar: I can feel my power slowly returning... HAHAHAHAHA! Yes... yes... time for another binding to be released!
dialogsBegin.br: Eu posso sentir meu poder retornando lentamente... HAHAHAHAHA! Sim... sim... é hora de libertar mais uma amarra!
dialogsBegin.cns: I can feel my power slowly returning... HAHAHAHAHA! Yes... yes... time for another binding to be released!
dialogsBegin.de: Ich kann spüren, wie meine Kraft langsam zurückkehrt... HAHAHAHAHA! Ja... ja... es wird Zeit, dass eine weitere Bindung gelöst wird!
dialogsBegin.fi: I can feel my power slowly returning... HAHAHAHAHA! Yes... yes... time for another binding to be released!
dialogsBegin.fil: I can feel my power slowly returning... HAHAHAHAHA! Yes... yes... time for another binding to be released!
dialogsBegin.fr: Je sens que mon pouvoir revient lentement... HAHAHAHAHA ! Oui... oui... il est temps de libérer un autre lien !
dialogsBegin.id: Aku bisa merasakan kekuatanku perlahan kembali.. HAHAHAHAHA! Ya .. ya .. waktunya untuk ikatan lain dirilis!
dialogsBegin.it: I can feel my power slowly returning... HAHAHAHAHA! Yes... yes... time for another binding to be released!
dialogsBegin.jp: 私はゆっくりと私の力が戻ってくるのを感じることができます..ハハハハハ!はい。。はい。。別のバインディングがリリースされる時が来ました!
dialogsBegin.kr: 힘이 서서히 돌아오는 게 느껴지는군... 하하하하하! 좋아...좋아... 이제 마지막 속박이 풀릴 때가 되었다!
dialogsBegin.nl: I can feel my power slowly returning... HAHAHAHAHA! Yes... yes... time for another binding to be released!
dialogsBegin.pl: I can feel my power slowly returning... HAHAHAHAHA! Yes... yes... time for another binding to be released!
dialogsBegin.ru: I can feel my power slowly returning... HAHAHAHAHA! Yes... yes... time for another binding to be released!
dialogsBegin.sp: Puedo sentir mi poder volviendo lentamente.. ¡HAHAHAHAHA! Sí... sí... ¡Es hora de soltar otra atadura!
dialogsBegin.sw: I can feel my power slowly returning... HAHAHAHAHA! Yes... yes... time for another binding to be released!
dialogsBegin.th: ข้ารู้สึกถึงพลังที่ค่อย ๆ กลับมา ฮ่าๆๆๆๆๆๆๆๆๆ ! ใช่แล้ว......ใช่.....เวลาสำหรับปลดผนึกที่เหลือมาถึงแล้ว!
dialogsBegin.tw: 我能感覺到我的力量正慢慢回來……哈哈哈哈哈！對……沒錯……是時候解開下一道束縛了！
dialogsBegin.vi: Tôi có thể cảm thấy sức mạnh của mình đang dần trở lại.. HAHAHAHAHA! Đúng.. đúng rồi.. thời khắc để một sơi dây trói buộc khác được giải phóng đã tới!

dialogsAccept.en: Take the cup from inside my chest and fill it with the powers from the nearby Altar of Violet.
dialogsAccept.ar: Take the cup from inside my chest and fill it with the powers from the nearby Altar of Violet.
dialogsAccept.br: Pegue o cálice que está dentro do meu peito e encha-o com os poderes do Altar de Violeta que está próximo.

dialogsAccept.it: Take the cup from inside my chest and fill it with the powers from the nearby Altar of Violet.

dialogsAccept.nl: Take the cup from inside my chest and fill it with the powers from the nearby Altar of Violet.

dialogsAccept.ru: Take the cup from inside my chest and fill it with the powers from the nearby Altar of Violet.

dialogsAccept.sw: Take the cup from inside my chest and fill it with the powers from the nearby Altar of Violet.
dialogsAccept.th: เอาถ้วยออกไปจากหน้าอกของข้าและนำมันไปเติมพลังจาก Altar of Violet ให้เต็ม
dialogsAccept.tw: 從我胸口取出杯子，用附近邪惡祭壇的力量填充它。
dialogsAccept.vi: Lấy chiếc cốc từ trong rương của tôi và đổ đầy sức mạnh từ Altar of Violet. gần đó.

dialogsDecline.en: You could have had all the power... and now you will have nothing!
dialogsDecline.ar: You could have had all the power... and now you will have nothing!
dialogsDecline.br: Você poderia ter tido todo o poder... e agora não terá nada!
dialogsDecline.cns: You could have had all the power... and now you will have nothing!
dialogsDecline.de: Du hättest alle Macht haben können...und jetzt bekommst du gar nichts!
dialogsDecline.fi: You could have had all the power... and now you will have nothing!
dialogsDecline.fil: You could have had all the power... and now you will have nothing!
dialogsDecline.fr: Vous auriez pu avoir tout le pouvoir... et maintenant vous n'aurez plus rien !
dialogsDecline.id: Kamu bisa memiliki semua kekuatan itu .. dan sekarang kamu tidak akan memiliki apa-apa!

dialogsDecline.jp: あなたはすべての力を持っていたかもしれません..そして今、あなたは何も持っていません!
dialogsDecline.kr: 이 모든 힘이 네 것이 될 수도 있었는데... 이제 네게 남은 건 아무것도 없다!
dialogsDecline.nl: You could have had all the power... and now you will have nothing!
dialogsDecline.pl: You could have had all the power... and now you will have nothing!
dialogsDecline.ru: You could have had all the power... and now you will have nothing!
dialogsDecline.sp: Podrías haber tenido todo el poder... ¡Y ahora no tendrás nada!
dialogsDecline.sw: You could have had all the power... and now you will have nothing!
dialogsDecline.th: เจ้าอาจจะมีพลังทั้งหมดได้ และตอนนี้เจ้าไม่มีอะไรเลย!
dialogsDecline.tw: 你本來可以擁有全部的力量……而現在，你什麼都不會得到！
dialogsDecline.vi: Bạn đã có thể có tất cả quyền năng... và bây giờ bạn sẽ không có gì cả!

dialogsComplete.en: Ahhhh... Ahahahahaha... the weakness brought on from these bindings is finally being released. Just one binding left...
dialogsComplete.ar: Ahhhh... Ahahahahaha... the weakness brought on from these bindings is finally being released. Just one binding left...
dialogsComplete.br: Ahhhh... Ahahahahaha... a fraqueza imposta por essas amarras finalmente está sendo dissipada. Resta apenas mais uma amarra...
dialogsComplete.cns: Ahhhh... Ahahahahaha... the weakness brought on from these bindings is finally being released. Just one binding left...
dialogsComplete.de: Ahhhh... Ahahahahaha... die Schwäche, die diese Bindungen mit sich brachten, wird endlich gelöst. Nur noch eine Bindung...
dialogsComplete.fi: Ahhhh... Ahahahahaha... the weakness brought on from these bindings is finally being released. Just one binding left...
dialogsComplete.fil: Ahhhh... Ahahahahaha... the weakness brought on from these bindings is finally being released. Just one binding left...
dialogsComplete.fr: Ahhhhh... Ahahahahaha... la faiblesse engendrée par ces fixations est enfin libérée. Il ne reste plus qu'une fixation...
dialogsComplete.id: Ahhhh.. Ahahahahaha.. kelemahan yang ditimbulkan dari ikatan ini akhirnya terbongkar. Tinggal satu ikatan lagi..
dialogsComplete.it: Ahhhh... Ahahahahaha... the weakness brought on from these bindings is finally being released. Just one binding left...
dialogsComplete.jp: ああ..あははははこれらの束縛からもたらされた弱点がついに解放されつつあります。たった1つのバインディングが残っています..
dialogsComplete.kr: 아아... 아하하하...속박 때문에 약했던 힘이 드디어 풀리고 있구나. 이제 속박 하나만 더...
dialogsComplete.nl: Ahhhh... Ahahahahaha... the weakness brought on from these bindings is finally being released. Just one binding left...
dialogsComplete.pl: Ahhhh... Ahahahahaha... the weakness brought on from these bindings is finally being released. Just one binding left...
dialogsComplete.ru: Ahhhh... Ahahahahaha... the weakness brought on from these bindings is finally being released. Just one binding left...
dialogsComplete.sp: Ahhhh.. Ahahahahaha.. la debilidad provocada por estas fijaciones por fin se libera. Sólo queda una atadura ..
dialogsComplete.sw: Ahhhh... Ahahahahaha... the weakness brought on from these bindings is finally being released. Just one binding left...
dialogsComplete.th: อ้าา....อ้า....... ความอ่อนแอที่มาจากผนึก ในที่สุดก็หายไปแล้ว เหลือผนึกอีกแค่อันเดียวเท่านั้น
dialogsComplete.tw: 啊啊啊……啊哈哈哈哈……這些束縛帶來的虛弱終於正在消散。只剩最後一道……
dialogsComplete.vi: Ahhhh.. Ahahahahaha.. sự yếu đuối do những sợi dây trói buộc gây ra cuối cùng cũng được giải phóng. Chỉ còn một sợi nữa...

dialogsBegin.en: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?

dialogsBegin.en: There has been a disturbance in the flow of Madrigal's magic lately... I've heard rumors that an unsuspecting adventurer released the Black Magician from their prison.
dialogsBegin.ar: There has been a disturbance in the flow of Madrigal's magic lately... I've heard rumors that an unsuspecting adventurer released the Black Magician from their prison.
dialogsBegin.br: Tem havido uma perturbação no fluxo da magia de Madrigal ultimamente... Ouvi rumores de que um aventureiro desprevenido libertou o Mago Negro de sua prisão.
dialogsBegin.cns: There has been a disturbance in the flow of Madrigal's magic lately... I've heard rumors that an unsuspecting adventurer released the Black Magician from their prison.
dialogsBegin.de: In letzter Zeit gab es eine Störung im Fluss der Magie von Madrigal. Ich habe Gerüchte gehört, dass ein ahnungsloser Abenteurer den Schwarzen Magier aus seinem Gefängnis befreit hat.
dialogsBegin.fi: There has been a disturbance in the flow of Madrigal's magic lately... I've heard rumors that an unsuspecting adventurer released the Black Magician from their prison.
dialogsBegin.fil: There has been a disturbance in the flow of Madrigal's magic lately... I've heard rumors that an unsuspecting adventurer released the Black Magician from their prison.
dialogsBegin.fr: Il y a eu une perturbation dans le flux de la magie de Madrigal ces derniers temps... J'ai entendu des rumeurs selon lesquelles un aventurier peu méfiant aurait libéré le Magicien Noir de sa prison.
dialogsBegin.id: Ada gangguan dalam aliran sihir Madrigal akhir-akhir ini.. Aku mendengar desas-desus bahwa seorang petualang yang tidak menaruh curiga melepaskan Black Magician dari penjara mereka.
dialogsBegin.it: There has been a disturbance in the flow of Madrigal's magic lately... I've heard rumors that an unsuspecting adventurer released the Black Magician from their prison.
dialogsBegin.jp: 最近、マドリガルの魔法の流れに乱れがあります。無防備な冒険者が黒魔術師を刑務所から解放したという噂を聞いたことがあります。
dialogsBegin.kr: 최근 마드리갈의 마법 흐름이 흐트러져 있어요... 아무것도 모르는 모험가가 블랙 매지션을 감옥에서 풀어줬다는 이상한 소문을 들었죠.
dialogsBegin.nl: There has been a disturbance in the flow of Madrigal's magic lately... I've heard rumors that an unsuspecting adventurer released the Black Magician from their prison.
dialogsBegin.pl: There has been a disturbance in the flow of Madrigal's magic lately... I've heard rumors that an unsuspecting adventurer released the Black Magician from their prison.
dialogsBegin.ru: There has been a disturbance in the flow of Madrigal's magic lately... I've heard rumors that an unsuspecting adventurer released the Black Magician from their prison.
dialogsBegin.sp: Ha habido una perturbación en el flujo de la magia de Madrigal.. He oído rumores de que un aventurero desprevenido liberó al Mago Negro de su prisión.
dialogsBegin.sw: There has been a disturbance in the flow of Madrigal's magic lately... I've heard rumors that an unsuspecting adventurer released the Black Magician from their prison.
dialogsBegin.th: กระแสเวทย์มนต์ของ Madrigal ถูกรบกวนอยู่ในช่วงนี้ ข้าได้ยินข่าวลือว่ามีนักผจญภัยบางคนได้ปล่อย Black Magician ออกมาจากที่คุมขัง
dialogsBegin.tw: 近來瑪德利賈的魔力流動發生了異變……我聽說，有個不知情的冒險家把黑暗魔法師從囚牢中釋放了出來。
dialogsBegin.vi: Gần đây đã có một sự xáo trộn trong dòng phép thuật của Madrigal.. Tôi đã nghe tin đồn rằng một nhà thám hiểm nhẹ dạ đã thả Hắc Thuật sư khỏi nơi giam giữ.

dialogsBegin.en: The current Black Magician named Lapranche is also sometimes known as the Purple Magician. She has an incredible power that is lost to all of today's magicians, including myself. Lapranche can summon the will of Shade to cast Purple Magic, recreating parts of the world in Shade's image.
dialogsBegin.ar: The current Black Magician named Lapranche is also sometimes known as the Purple Magician. She has an incredible power that is lost to all of today's magicians, including myself. Lapranche can summon the will of Shade to cast Purple Magic, recreating parts of the world in Shade's image.
dialogsBegin.br: A atual Maga Negra chamada Lapranche também é conhecida às vezes como a Maga Roxa. Ela possui um poder incrível que está além de todos os mágicos de hoje, incluindo eu mesmo. Lapranche pode invocar a vontade de Shade para lançar Magia Roxa, recriando partes do mundo à imagem de Shade.
dialogsBegin.cns: The current Black Magician named Lapranche is also sometimes known as the Purple Magician. She has an incredible power that is lost to all of today's magicians, including myself. Lapranche can summon the will of Shade to cast Purple Magic, recreating parts of the world in Shade's image.
dialogsBegin.de: Die derzeitige Schwarze Magierin namens Lapranche wird manchmal auch als Lila Magierin bezeichnet. Sie hat eine unglaubliche Macht, die allen heutigen Magiern, mich eingeschlossen, verloren gegangen ist. Lapranche kann den Willen von Shade heraufbeschwören, um lila Magie zu wirken und so Teile der Welt nach dem Bild von Shade zu erschaffen.
dialogsBegin.fi: The current Black Magician named Lapranche is also sometimes known as the Purple Magician. She has an incredible power that is lost to all of today's magicians, including myself. Lapranche can summon the will of Shade to cast Purple Magic, recreating parts of the world in Shade's image.

dialogsBegin.fr: Le Magicien Noir actuel, Lapranche, est également connu sous le nom de magicien pourpre. Elle possède un pouvoir incroyable que tous les magiciens d'aujourd'hui, moi y compris, ont perdu. Lapranche peut invoquer la volonté de Shade pour lancer de la Magie Pourpre, recréant ainsi des parties du monde à l'image de Shade.
dialogsBegin.id: Black Magician saat ini bernama Lapranche juga terkadang dikenal sebagai Purple Magician. Dia memiliki kekuatan luar biasa yang hilang dari semua penyihir saat ini, termasuk saya. Lapranche dapat memanggil keinginan Shade to cast Purple Magic, menciptakan kembali bagian dunia dalam gambar Shade.
dialogsBegin.it: The current Black Magician named Lapranche is also sometimes known as the Purple Magician. She has an incredible power that is lost to all of today's magicians, including myself. Lapranche can summon the will of Shade to cast Purple Magic, recreating parts of the world in Shade's image.
dialogsBegin.jp: ラプランチェという名前の現在のブラックマジシャンは、パープルマジシャンとしても知られています。彼女は私を含む今日のすべての魔術師に失われている信じられないほどの力を持っています。ラプランシュはシェイドの意志を召喚してパープルマジックを唱え、シェイドのイメージで世界の一部を再現することができます。
dialogsBegin.kr: 지금은 블랙 매지션이라 불리는 라프란체지만, 퍼플 매지션으로도 알려졌죠. 라프란체는 저를 포함해 지금의 매지션들도 갖지 못한, 놀라운 힘을 지니고 있어요. 라프란체에겐 자주색 마법으로 쉐이드의 의지를 소환하고, 쉐이드의 의지대로 세계를 재창조할 능력이 있습니다.
dialogsBegin.nl: The current Black Magician named Lapranche is also sometimes known as the Purple Magician. She has an incredible power that is lost to all of today's magicians, including myself. Lapranche can summon the will of Shade to cast Purple Magic, recreating parts of the world in Shade's image.

dialogsBegin.sp: La actual Maga Negra llamada Lapranche también es conocida a veces como la Maga Púrpura. Tiene un poder increíble que todos los magos actuales, incluido yo mismo, han perdido. Lapranche puede invocar la voluntad de Shade para lanzar Magia Púrpura, recreando partes del mundo a imagen de Shade.
dialogsBegin.sw: The current Black Magician named Lapranche is also sometimes known as the Purple Magician. She has an incredible power that is lost to all of today's magicians, including myself. Lapranche can summon the will of Shade to cast Purple Magic, recreating parts of the world in Shade's image.
dialogsBegin.th: Black Magician คนปัจจุบันชื่อว่า Lapranche หรือที่รุ้จักกันว่า Purple Magician หล่อยทรงพลังอย่างมากและไม่มีนักเวทย์คนไหนมีพลังขนาดนั้นในปัจจุบัน รวมทั้งตัวข้า Lapranche สามารถเรียก เจตนารมณ์แห่ง Shade เพื่อร่าย Purple Magic และโลกส่วนนึงขึ้นมากจากภาพของ Shade
dialogsBegin.tw: 現任黑魔法師拉普朗雪有時也被稱為紫魔法師。她擁有不可思議的力量，這是當今所有魔術師所不具備的，包括我自己。拉普朗什可以召喚闇影的意志來施展紫色魔法，以闇影的形象重建世界的一部分。
dialogsBegin.vi: Black Magician hiện tại tên là Lapranche đôi khi còn được gọi là Purple Magician. Cô ấy có một sức mạnh đáng kinh ngạc mà tất cả các magicians ngày nay đều thua, kể cả tôi. Lapranche có thể triệu hồi ý chí của Shade để thi triển Purple Magic, tái tạo các phần của thế giới theo hình ảnh của Shade.

dialogsBegin.en: As of now we stand no chance in a battle with Lapranche... even I have grown too weak to defeat her, my former pupil. She is certainly in a weakened state, so there is time to prepare. Expect Lapranche to bide her time by causing choas around Madrigal. For now we must build our strength.
dialogsBegin.ar: As of now we stand no chance in a battle with Lapranche... even I have grown too weak to defeat her, my former pupil. She is certainly in a weakened state, so there is time to prepare. Expect Lapranche to bide her time by causing choas around Madrigal. For now we must build our strength.
dialogsBegin.br: Por enquanto, a gente tá lascado se for pra enfrentar a Lapranche... até eu fiquei fraco demais pra botar ela no chão, sendo que ela foi minha discípula. Mas olha só, ela tá numa fase de fraqueza, então dá pra aproveitar e se preparar. Pode esperar que a Lapranche vai causar umas confusões em Madrigal pra ganhar tempo. Por enquanto, vamos fortalecer nossas habilidades.
dialogsBegin.cns: As of now we stand no chance in a battle with Lapranche... even I have grown too weak to defeat her, my former pupil. She is certainly in a weakened state, so there is time to prepare. Expect Lapranche to bide her time by causing choas around Madrigal. For now we must build our strength.
dialogsBegin.de: Ab jetzt haben wir in einem Kampf mit Lapranche keine Chance mehr... selbst ich bin zu schwach geworden, um sie, meine ehemalige Schülerin, zu besiegen. Sie ist sicherlich in einem geschwächten Zustand, also haben wir Zeit, uns vorzubereiten. Erwartet, dass Lapranche ihre Zeit abwartet, indem sie in Madrigal ein Chaos anrichtet. Jetzt müssen wir erst einmal unsere Kräfte sammeln.
dialogsBegin.fi: As of now we stand no chance in a battle with Lapranche... even I have grown too weak to defeat her, my former pupil. She is certainly in a weakened state, so there is time to prepare. Expect Lapranche to bide her time by causing choas around Madrigal. For now we must build our strength.
dialogsBegin.fil: As of now we stand no chance in a battle with Lapranche... even I have grown too weak to defeat her, my former pupil. She is certainly in a weakened state, so there is time to prepare. Expect Lapranche to bide her time by causing choas around Madrigal. For now we must build our strength.
dialogsBegin.fr: Pour l'instant, nous n'avons aucune chance dans un combat contre Lapranche... même moi, mon ancien élève, je suis devenu trop faible pour la vaincre. Elle est certainement affaiblie, nous avons donc le temps de nous préparer. Lapranche attendra son heure en provoquant des troubles autour de Madrigal. Pour l'instant, nous devons nous renforcer.
dialogsBegin.id: Sampai sekarang kami tidak memiliki peluang dalam pertempuran dengan Lapranche .. bahkan aku menjadi terlalu lemah untuk mengalahkannya, mantan muridku. Dia pasti dalam keadaan lemah, jadi ada waktu untuk bersiap. Harapkan Lapranche menunggu waktunya dengan menyebabkan kekacauan di sekitar Madrigal. Untuk saat ini kita harus membangun kekuatan kita.
dialogsBegin.it: As of now we stand no chance in a battle with Lapranche... even I have grown too weak to defeat her, my former pupil. She is certainly in a weakened state, so there is time to prepare. Expect Lapranche to bide her time by causing choas around Madrigal. For now we must build our strength.
dialogsBegin.jp: 今のところ、ラプランシェとの戦いにチャンスはありません。私でさえ、かつての弟子である彼女を打ち負かすには弱くなりすぎました。彼女は確かに弱体化した状態にあるので、準備する時間があります。ラプランシュがマドリガルの周りにチョアを引き起こすことによって彼女の時間を入札することを期待してください。今は力を築かなければなりません。
dialogsBegin.kr: 지금으로선 라프란체와의 싸움에서 승산이 없어요... 이제 스승이었던 저조차도 라프란체를 상대로는 승산이 없으니. 하지만 라프란체는 확실히 약해진 상태니, 준비할 시간은 있어요. 라프란체는 마드리갈에 혼란을 일으켜서 시간을 끌려고 할 겁니다. 지금은 힘을 모아야 해요.
dialogsBegin.nl: As of now we stand no chance in a battle with Lapranche... even I have grown too weak to defeat her, my former pupil. She is certainly in a weakened state, so there is time to prepare. Expect Lapranche to bide her time by causing choas around Madrigal. For now we must build our strength.
dialogsBegin.pl: As of now we stand no chance in a battle with Lapranche... even I have grown too weak to defeat her, my former pupil. She is certainly in a weakened state, so there is time to prepare. Expect Lapranche to bide her time by causing choas around Madrigal. For now we must build our strength.
dialogsBegin.ru: As of now we stand no chance in a battle with Lapranche... even I have grown too weak to defeat her, my former pupil. She is certainly in a weakened state, so there is time to prepare. Expect Lapranche to bide her time by causing choas around Madrigal. For now we must build our strength.
dialogsBegin.sp: Por ahora no tenemos ninguna ventaja en una batalla con Lapranche... incluso yo me he vuelto demasiado débil para derrotarla, mi antigua pupila. Ella está ciertamente en un estado debilitado, así que hay tiempo para prepararse. Espera que Lapranche espere su momento causando problemas alrededor de Madrigal. Por ahora debemos construir nuestra fuerza.
dialogsBegin.sw: As of now we stand no chance in a battle with Lapranche... even I have grown too weak to defeat her, my former pupil. She is certainly in a weakened state, so there is time to prepare. Expect Lapranche to bide her time by causing choas around Madrigal. For now we must build our strength.
dialogsBegin.th: ณ ตอนนี้เราไม่มีโอกาสต่อสู้ชนะกับ Lapranche ได้เลย แม้แต่ตัวข้าเองก็เริ่มที่จะอ่อนแอเกินกว่าที่จะจัดการหล่อน ผู้ซึ่งเคยเป็นลูกศิษย์ข้าได้ แต่ตอนนี้ Lapranche ยังอยู่ในภาพที่ไม่เต็มร้อย ฉะนั้นเรายังคงมีเวลาเตรียมตัว เจ้าคิดไว้ได้เลยว่า Lapranche จะสร้างความวุ่นวายรอบๆ Madrigal เพื่อถ่วงเวลา ตอนนี้เราเองก็ต้องเสริมกำลังของเราให้แข็งแกร่งเช่นกัน
dialogsBegin.tw: 眼下我們根本沒有機會和拉普蘭雪正面交戰……就連我，也已經虛弱到無法擊敗她這位昔日弟子。她現在雖然也還處於虛弱狀態，但我們能準備的時間不多。拉普蘭雪肯定會在瑪德利賈各地製造混亂，替自己爭取時間。現在，我們只能先壯大自己的力量。
dialogsBegin.vi: Hiện tại chúng ta không có cơ hội nào trong trận chiến với Lapranche.. ngay cả tôi cũng đã trở nên quá yếu so với cô ta, học trò cũ của tôi. Cô ta chắc chắn đang ở trong tình trạng suy yếu, vì vậy ta mới có thời gian để chuẩn bị. Ta nên dự phòng việc Lapranche sẽ câu giờ bằng cách gây ra sự hỗn loạn xung quanh Madrigal. Bây giờ chúng ta phải xây dựng dần quân lực của mình.

dialogsAccept.en: Before we move forward with the plan... I need you to prove that you are strong enough to fend for yourself. Bring me 50 Bearnerky Fang, then we can move forward with preparations.
dialogsAccept.ar: Before we move forward with the plan... I need you to prove that you are strong enough to fend for yourself. Bring me 50 Bearnerky Fang, then we can move forward with preparations.
dialogsAccept.br: Antes de partirmos pro próximo passo do plano, preciso ver se você tem poder de verdade. Me traga 50 Presas de Ursofurioso e aí sim vamos partir pra ação!
dialogsAccept.cns: Before we move forward with the plan... I need you to prove that you are strong enough to fend for yourself. Bring me 50 Bearnerky Fang, then we can move forward with preparations.
dialogsAccept.de: Bevor wir mit dem Plan weitermachen... musst du beweisen, dass du stark genug bist, um dich selbst zu verteidigen. Bring mir 50 Bearnerky Fang, dann können wir mit den Vorbereitungen fortfahren.
dialogsAccept.fi: Before we move forward with the plan... I need you to prove that you are strong enough to fend for yourself. Bring me 50 Bearnerky Fang, then we can move forward with preparations.
dialogsAccept.fil: Before we move forward with the plan... I need you to prove that you are strong enough to fend for yourself. Bring me 50 Bearnerky Fang, then we can move forward with preparations.
dialogsAccept.fr: Avant d'aller de l'avant avec le plan... J'ai besoin que vous prouviez que vous êtes assez fort pour vous débrouiller tout seul. Apportez-moi 50 Crocs de Bearnerky, et nous pourrons commencer les préparatifs.
dialogsAccept.id: Sebelum kita melanjutkan rencananya.. Aku ingin kamu membuktikan bahwa kamu cukup kuat untuk menjaga diri sendiri. Bawakan aku 50 Bearnerky Fang, lalu kita bisa melanjutkan persiapan.
dialogsAccept.it: Before we move forward with the plan... I need you to prove that you are strong enough to fend for yourself. Bring me 50 Bearnerky Fang, then we can move forward with preparations.
dialogsAccept.jp: 計画を進める前に..私はあなたがあなた自身のために身を守るのに十分強いことを証明する必要があります。ベアナーキーファングを50個持ってきてくれれば、準備を進めましょう。
dialogsAccept.kr: 계획을 실행하기 전에... 당신이 자신을 지킬 만큼 강한지 확인해 봐야겠어요. 베어너키 송곳니 50개를 가져오고 나면, 함께 준비를 시작하도록 하죠.
dialogsAccept.nl: Before we move forward with the plan... I need you to prove that you are strong enough to fend for yourself. Bring me 50 Bearnerky Fang, then we can move forward with preparations.
dialogsAccept.pl: Before we move forward with the plan... I need you to prove that you are strong enough to fend for yourself. Bring me 50 Bearnerky Fang, then we can move forward with preparations.
dialogsAccept.ru: Before we move forward with the plan... I need you to prove that you are strong enough to fend for yourself. Bring me 50 Bearnerky Fang, then we can move forward with preparations.
dialogsAccept.sp: Antes de seguir adelante con el plan .. Necesito que demuestres que eres lo suficientemente fuerte para valerte por ti mismo. Tráeme 50 Colmillos Bearnerky, entonces podremos avanzar con los preparativos.
dialogsAccept.sw: Before we move forward with the plan... I need you to prove that you are strong enough to fend for yourself. Bring me 50 Bearnerky Fang, then we can move forward with preparations.
dialogsAccept.th: ก่อนที่เราจะเริ่มต้นแผนการ ข้าต้องให้เจ้าพิสูจน์ตัวเองก่อนว่าเจ้าแข็งแกร่งพอที่จะป้องกันตัวเอง นำ 50 Bearnerky Fang มาให้ข้า แล้วเราค่อยมาเตรียมตัวขั้นต่อไปกัน
dialogsAccept.tw: 在我們進一步推動計畫前……我需要你證明自己有足夠的力量保護自己。替我帶來 50 個貝爾納基尖牙，我們再來進行下一步準備。
dialogsAccept.vi: Trước khi chúng ta tiến hành kế hoạch... Tôi cần bạn chứng minh rằng bạn đủ mạnh mẽ để tự bảo vệ mình. Mang cho tôi 50 Bearnerky Fang, sau đó chúng ta có thể tiếp tục chuẩn bị.

dialogsDecline.en: If we are not prepared, Lapranche could unleash evil more terrible than us mortals could ever hope to face.
dialogsDecline.ar: If we are not prepared, Lapranche could unleash evil more terrible than us mortals could ever hope to face.
dialogsDecline.br: Se não estivermos preparados, Lapranche pode desencadear um mal mais terrível do que nós, mortais, poderíamos enfrentar.
dialogsDecline.cns: If we are not prepared, Lapranche could unleash evil more terrible than us mortals could ever hope to face.
dialogsDecline.de: Wenn wir nicht vorbereitet sind, könnte Lapranche ein Übel entfesseln, das schrecklicher ist, als wir Sterblichen es je sein könnten.
dialogsDecline.fi: If we are not prepared, Lapranche could unleash evil more terrible than us mortals could ever hope to face.
dialogsDecline.fil: If we are not prepared, Lapranche could unleash evil more terrible than us mortals could ever hope to face.
dialogsDecline.fr: Si nous ne sommes pas préparés, Lapranche pourrait déchaîner un mal plus terrible que nous, mortels, ne pourrions jamais espérer affronter.
dialogsDecline.id: Jika kita tidak siap, Lapranche dapat melepaskan kejahatan yang lebih mengerikan daripada yang bisa kita harapkan untuk dihadapi oleh manusia fana.
dialogsDecline.it: If we are not prepared, Lapranche could unleash evil more terrible than us mortals could ever hope to face.
dialogsDecline.jp: 私たちが準備ができていなければ、ラプランシュは私たち人間が直面することを望むよりも恐ろしい悪を解き放つ可能性があります。
dialogsDecline.kr: 미리 대비해 놓지 않으면, 라프란체는 우리 인간들이 상상할 수조차 없는 끔찍한 악을 풀어놓을지도 몰라요.
dialogsDecline.nl: If we are not prepared, Lapranche could unleash evil more terrible than us mortals could ever hope to face.
dialogsDecline.pl: If we are not prepared, Lapranche could unleash evil more terrible than us mortals could ever hope to face.
dialogsDecline.ru: If we are not prepared, Lapranche could unleash evil more terrible than us mortals could ever hope to face.
dialogsDecline.sp: Si no estamos preparados, Lapranche podría desencadenar un mal más terrible del que nosotros, los mortales, jamás podríamos imaginar.
dialogsDecline.sw: If we are not prepared, Lapranche could unleash evil more terrible than us mortals could ever hope to face.
dialogsDecline.th: ถ้าเราไม่เตรียมตัวให้พร้อม Lapranche อาจจะปล่อยปีศาจที่น่ากลัวมากกว่าที่เราเคยคิดกันไว้อีก
dialogsDecline.tw: 如果我們沒有做好準備，拉普朗什可能會釋放出比我們凡人所希望面對的更可怕的邪惡。
dialogsDecline.vi: Nếu chúng ta không chuẩn bị, Lapranche có thể giải phóng cái ác khủng khiếp hơn những gì con người chúng ta có thể hy vọng đối mặt.

dialogsComplete.en: I hope you understand my hesitance... the power of Purple Magic is nothing to play with. We may start work on the plan now.
dialogsComplete.ar: I hope you understand my hesitance... the power of Purple Magic is nothing to play with. We may start work on the plan now.
dialogsComplete.br: Espero que você compreenda meu receio... a magia roxa é uma parada séria. Podemos começar a botar o plano em prática agora!
dialogsComplete.cns: I hope you understand my hesitance... the power of Purple Magic is nothing to play with. We may start work on the plan now.
dialogsComplete.de: Ich hoffe, du verstehst mein Zögern, denn mit der Macht der lila Magie ist nicht zu spaßen. Wir können jetzt mit der Arbeit an dem Plan beginnen.
dialogsComplete.fi: I hope you understand my hesitance... the power of Purple Magic is nothing to play with. We may start work on the plan now.
dialogsComplete.fil: I hope you understand my hesitance... the power of Purple Magic is nothing to play with. We may start work on the plan now.
dialogsComplete.fr: J'espère que vous comprenez mon hésitation... il ne faut pas jouer avec la puissance de la Magie Pourpre. Nous pouvons commencer à travailler sur le plan maintenant.
dialogsComplete.id: Ku harap kamu memahami keragu-raguanku .. kekuatan Purple Magic tidak ada artinya. Kami mungkin mulai mengerjakan rencananya sekarang.
dialogsComplete.it: I hope you understand my hesitance... the power of Purple Magic is nothing to play with. We may start work on the plan now.
dialogsComplete.jp: 私の躊躇を理解していただければ幸いです。パープルマジックの力は遊ぶものではありません。今から計画に取り掛かるかもしれません。
dialogsComplete.kr: 망설이는 제 처지도 이해해 주셨으면 해요... 자주색 마법의 힘은 장난이 아니니까요. 이제 계획을 시작해 볼까요.
dialogsComplete.nl: I hope you understand my hesitance... the power of Purple Magic is nothing to play with. We may start work on the plan now.
dialogsComplete.pl: I hope you understand my hesitance... the power of Purple Magic is nothing to play with. We may start work on the plan now.
dialogsComplete.ru: I hope you understand my hesitance... the power of Purple Magic is nothing to play with. We may start work on the plan now.
dialogsComplete.sp: Espero que entiendas mis dudas... con el poder de la Magia Púrpura no se juega. Podemos empezar a trabajar en el plan ahora.
dialogsComplete.sw: I hope you understand my hesitance... the power of Purple Magic is nothing to play with. We may start work on the plan now.
dialogsComplete.th: ถ้าเจ้าอยากจะเข้าใจว่าทำไมข้าถึงลังเล พลังของ Purple Magic ไม่ใช่อะไรที่ควรจะไปเล่นด้วย เราควรจะต้องเริ่มทำตามแผนกันเลย
dialogsComplete.tw: 希望你能理解我為何如此謹慎……紫色魔法的力量絕不是拿來玩的。現在，我們可以開始著手準備計畫了。
dialogsComplete.vi: Tôi hy vọng bạn hiểu sự do dự của tôi .. sức mạnh của Purple Magic không thể đùa được. Chúng ta cần bắt đầu thực hiện kế hoạch ngay bây giờ.

dialogsBegin.en: The Hundur Sharpfoot gather near Kaillun’s borders, and their skulls bear strange markings. The Muran need them to decipher the secrets behind their rituals.

Dieses Grollen war nicht normal...

dialogsBegin.en: Thinking of all the chaos that traitor caused… honestly. Anyway, it seems your name has spread. A lot of people around the village have been asking to meet you. Once you’re done with your own business, why not visit them?
dialogsBegin.ar: Thinking of all the chaos that traitor caused… honestly. Anyway, it seems your name has spread. A lot of people around the village have been asking to meet you. Once you’re done with your own business, why not visit them?
dialogsBegin.br: Thinking of all the chaos that traitor caused… honestly. Anyway, it seems your name has spread. A lot of people around the village have been asking to meet you. Once you’re done with your own business, why not visit them?
dialogsBegin.cns: 一想到那个叛徒惹出的乱子……唉，算了。总之，你的名号已经传开了，村里不少人都在打听你，想见你一面。等你自己的事忙完了，不妨去见见他们？
dialogsBegin.de: Wenn ich an all das Chaos denke, das dieser Verräter verursacht hat… ehrlich. Wie dem auch sei, dein Name hat sich offenbar herumgesprochen. Viele Dorfbewohner möchten dich kennenlernen. Sobald du deine eigenen Angelegenheiten erledigt hast, warum besuchst du sie nicht?

dialogsBegin.fr: En pensant à tout le chaos causé par ce traître… honnêtement. Quoi qu’il en soit, il semble que votre nom se soit répandu. Beaucoup de gens autour du village demandent à vous rencontrer. Une fois vos affaires terminées, pourquoi ne pas leur rendre visite ?
dialogsBegin.id: Thinking of all the chaos that traitor caused… honestly. Anyway, it seems your name has spread. A lot of people around the village have been asking to meet you. Once you’re done with your own business, why not visit them?

dialogsComplete.en: It’s been a while. What brings you here? You found this in Kaillun? I’m Muran as well, though I left my tribe long ago. I can’t say much, but will you hand that over? It’s about summoning a god and speeding up the tower’s completion. Take this as thanks.
dialogsComplete.ar: It’s been a while. What brings you here? You found this in Kaillun? I’m Muran as well, though I left my tribe long ago. I can’t say much, but will you hand that over? It’s about summoning a god and speeding up the tower’s completion. Take this as thanks.

dialogsComplete.cns: 好久不见，你怎么来了？这是在凯伦找到的？我也来自穆兰，虽然很早就离开了部族。我不能多说，把这东西交给我吧。这关乎神的召唤和塔的加速完工，拿好这个当作谢礼。
dialogsComplete.de: Es ist eine Weile her. Was führt dich hierher? Du hast das in Kaillun gefunden? Ich stamme ebenfalls aus Muran, auch wenn ich meinen Stamm vor langer Zeit verlassen habe. Ich kann nicht viel sagen, aber würdest du mir das überlassen? Es geht um die Beschwörung eines Gottes und darum, die Vollendung des Turms zu beschleunigen. Nimm dies als Dank.

dialogsComplete.fr: Ça fait un moment. Qu’est-ce qui vous amène ici ? Vous avez trouvé cela à Kaillun ? Je suis aussi Muran, bien que j’aie quitté ma tribu il y a longtemps. Je ne peux pas en dire beaucoup, mais pourriez-vous me le remettre ? Cela concerne l’invocation d’un dieu et l’accélération de la construction de la tour. Prenez ceci en remerciement.

dialogsAccept.en: Excellent! I knew I could count on you. The creatures under Shade’s command won’t go down easily, but with your skills, I’m confident you can handle them. Go, and show them that we won’t back down! Once you've dealt with them, check back with Sovann.
dialogsAccept.ar: Excellent! I knew I could count on you. The creatures under Shade’s command won’t go down easily, but with your skills, I’m confident you can handle them. Go, and show them that we won’t back down! Once you've dealt with them, check back with Sovann.
dialogsAccept.br: Excellent! I knew I could count on you. The creatures under Shade’s command won’t go down easily, but with your skills, I’m confident you can handle them. Go, and show them that we won’t back down! Once you've dealt with them, check back with Sovann.
dialogsAccept.cns: 太好了！我就知道我能指望你。受影之势力操控的怪物可不简单，但凭你的实力，我相信你完全能应付。去吧，让他们知道我们不会退缩！解决掉它们之后，回去向索万复命。
dialogsAccept.de: Ausgezeichnet! Ich wusste, dass ich auf dich zählen kann. Die Kreaturen unter Shades Befehl werden sich nicht leicht besiegen lassen, aber mit deinen Fähigkeiten bin ich sicher, dass du sie bewältigen kannst. Geh und zeig ihnen, dass wir nicht zurückweichen! Sobald du fertig bist, kehre zu Sovann zurück.
dialogsAccept.fi: Excellent! I knew I could count on you. The creatures under Shade’s command won’t go down easily, but with your skills, I’m confident you can handle them. Go, and show them that we won’t back down! Once you've dealt with them, check back with Sovann.

dialogsDecline.en: What?! You’re refusing?! Don’t you see how serious this is? Shade’s forces won’t stop they’ll only get stronger if we ignore them. Fine, if you’re not willing to help, I’ll find someone who is up to the challenge. But don’t forget you might regret standing by if Shade succeeds.
